sense_groups.english: I just wanna be married again.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我只想要一百万美金
sense_groups.english: And I just want a million dollars!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 老天爷 摩妮卡 感谢上帝
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Monica! Hi! Thank God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚到你那里去 而你不在 那个拿着大锤子的家伙说...
sense_groups.english: I went to your building and this guy with a hammer said...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能在这里 你真在这里
sense_groups.english: ...that you might be here, and you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想喝点咖啡吗？- 无咖啡因的
sense_groups.english: Can I get you some coffee? - Decaf.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 各位 这位是瑞秋 另一个林肯高中的幸存者
sense_groups.english: Okay, everybody, this is Rachel, another Lincoln High survivor.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是各位 这是钱德 菲比
sense_groups.english: This is everybody. This is Chandler and Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 还有 你还记得我哥哥罗斯吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and Joey. And remember my brother, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Sure! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你现在可以告诉我们了吗？
sense_groups.english: So you wanna tell us now,

sense_groups.chinese: 还是说我们在等着四位湿漉的伴娘？
sense_groups.english: or are we waiting for four wet bridesmaids?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大概在婚礼前半个小时
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! Well, it started about a half-hour before the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在礼物间里
sense_groups.english: I was in this room with all the presents...

sense_groups.chinese: 看着那个肉汁壶
sense_groups.english: ...and I was looking at this gravy boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个非常好看的肉汁壶
sense_groups.english: This really gorgeous Limoges gravy boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后 突然…有代糖吗？
sense_groups.english: When all of a sudden... Sweet 'N Low?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现…
sense_groups.english: I realized...

sense_groups.chinese: 我对这个肉汁壶 比对巴瑞更有冲动
sense_groups.english: ...I was more turned on by this gravy boat than by Barry.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我吓呆了 然后这个想法突然出现在脑中
sense_groups.english: Then I got really freaked out, and that's when it hit me

sense_groups.chinese: 巴瑞看起来多像洋芋头先生啊
sense_groups.english: How much Barry looks like Mr. Potato Head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我总是觉得他眼熟 但是…
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, I always knew he looked familiar, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 我必须离开那里 我在想
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I just had to get out of there, and I started wondering

sense_groups.chinese: "我为什么这样做？我为谁这样做？"
sense_groups.english: "Why am I doing this?" And "Who am I doing this for?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该去哪里 而且我知道我和你有点疏远了
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I just didn't know where to go, and I know you and I have drifted apart...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你是我这个城市里唯一认识的人
sense_groups.english: ...but you're the only person I know in the city.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且没有受邀参加你的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Who wasn't invited to the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我希望你不会把它当一回事…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I was kind of hoping that wouldn't be an issue.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜他给她买了个管风琴
sense_groups.english: I'm guessing he bought her the big pipe organ...

sense_groups.chinese: 而她很不喜欢那个
sense_groups.english: ...and she's really not happy about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 老爸 我就是无法和他结婚
sense_groups.english: Daddy, I just... I can't marry him.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不爱他了
sense_groups.english: I just don't love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 这对我很有关系
sense_groups.english: Well, it matters to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真不应该穿那条裤子
sense_groups.english: She should not be wearing those pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得应该把她推下楼
sense_groups.english: I say push her down the stairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 把她推下楼…
sense_groups.english: Push her down the stairs! Push her down the stairs!

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸 听我说
sense_groups.english: Come on, Daddy, listen to me!

sense_groups.chinese: 这就好像在我一生中 所有人都告诉我: "你是鞋子 "
sense_groups.english: It's like all of my life, everyone's always told me, "You're a shoe!

sense_groups.chinese: "你是鞋子…"
sense_groups.english: You're a shoe! You're a shoe! You're a shoe!"

sense_groups.chinese: 然后今天 我停下来对自己说: "如果我不想成为鞋子呢？
sense_groups.english: Then today I stopped and said, "What if I don't wanna be a shoe?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我想成为一个包包？
sense_groups.english: What if I wanna be a purse? You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 或一顶帽子？"
sense_groups.english: Or a hat?"

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是要你给我买帽子 我是说我是帽子
sense_groups.english: I don't want you to buy me a hat, I am a hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个比喻 爸爸
sense_groups.english: It's a metaphor, Daddy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看得出他哪里听不懂
sense_groups.english: You can see where he'd have trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸 这是我的生活
sense_groups.english: Look, Daddy, it's my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我可以和摩妮卡住在一起
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I'll just stay here with Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我们已经确定 她要和摩妮卡住在一起了
sense_groups.english: I guess we've established she's staying with Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许那是我的决定
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe that's my decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我不需要你的钱
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I don't need your money.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我说也许
sense_groups.english: Wait! Wait! I said maybe!

sense_groups.chinese: 呼吸 呼吸 好 就这样
sense_groups.english: Okay. Just breathe, that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 试着想一些让你镇定的事…
sense_groups.english: Just try to think of nice, calm things.

sense_groups.chinese: 玫瑰上的雨滴 还有猫的胡须
sense_groups.english: Raindrops on roses And whiskers on kittens

sense_groups.chinese: 门铃和雪橇铃 还有手套
sense_groups.english: Doorbells and sleigh bells And something with mittens

sense_groups.chinese: 啦啦啦 还有一些条状物
sense_groups.english: La la la something With string

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在好多了
sense_groups.english: I'm all better now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮上忙啦
sense_groups.english: I helped.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧 这也许对你来讲是最好的 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, this is probably for the best, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 独立了 把握自己的生活
sense_groups.english: Independence. Taking control of your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 你还需要什么 你可以随时来找乔伊
sense_groups.english: And, hey, if you need anything, you can always come to Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和钱德就住在对面 而且他经常不在
sense_groups.english: Me and Chandler live right across the hall. And he's away a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 不要再对她放电了 今天是她结婚的日子
sense_groups.english: Joey, stop hitting on her. It's her wedding day.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么啦 难道这还有什么规定吗？
sense_groups.english: What? Like there's a rule or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 请不要再按了 那是很恐怖的声音
sense_groups.english: Please don't do that again. It's a horrible sound.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是保罗 - 让他进来
sense_groups.english: Uh, it's Paul. - Buzz him in.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是保罗？- 保罗 红酒达人 保罗？
sense_groups.english: Who's Paul? - Paul, the wine guy, Paul?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你今晚的"不是真正约会" 是和红酒达人保罗？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Your "not a real date" is with Paul, the wine guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 他终于约你出去啦？- 是的
sense_groups.english: He finally asked you out? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个可以写入日记的时刻
sense_groups.english: Ooh. This is a "Dear Diary" moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 等等 我可以取消
sense_groups.english: Rach, wait, I can cancel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 你去吧 我不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Please, no. Go, I'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你没事吧？你希望我留下来吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, are you okay? I mean, do you want me to stay?

sense_groups.chinese: 能留下就太好了
sense_groups.english: That'd be good.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？- 不 去吧 那可是红酒达人保罗耶
sense_groups.english: Really? - No, go on! It's Paul, the wine guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 进来 保罗 这是…
sense_groups.english: Hi, come in. Paul, this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家 各位 这是保罗
sense_groups.english: ...everybody. Everybody, this is Paul.

sense_groups.chinese: 保罗 红酒达人
sense_groups.english: Paul, the wine guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 红酒达人 - 我没听清楚你的名字 是保罗吗？
sense_groups.english: Wine guy. - I didn't catch your name. Paul, was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 两秒钟就好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Sit down. Two seconds. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚拔掉四根睫毛 不是个好兆头
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I just pulled out four eyelashes. That can't be good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么瑞秋 你今晚打算做什么？
sense_groups.english: So, Rachel, what are you up to tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来应该到阿鲁巴度蜜月
sense_groups.english: Well, I was supposed to be headed for Aruba on my honeymoon...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 没事做
sense_groups.english: ...so, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 对呀 你连蜜月都无法去
sense_groups.english: Right. You're not even getting your honeymoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过 阿鲁巴 这个时候？
sense_groups.english: God. No, no. Although, Aruba. Heh. This time of year? Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以谈论一下…
sense_groups.english: Talk about your...

sense_groups.chinese: 大蜥蜴
sense_groups.english: ...big lizards.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 如果今晚你不想自己一个人的话
sense_groups.english: Anyway, if you don't feel like being alone tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊和钱德要过来 帮我组装我的新家具
sense_groups.english: ...Joey and Chandler are helping me with my furniture.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 而且我们为此感到兴奋
sense_groups.english: Yes, and we're very excited about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢了 不过我想今晚还是留在这里吧
sense_groups.english: Actually, thanks, but I'm just gonna hang out here tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真是漫长的一天 - 是呀 好吧
sense_groups.english: It's been a long day. - Oh, sure. Okay. Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你要来帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, you wanna help?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我希望我能 但是我不想
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wish I could, but I don't want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该把支架固定在侧面
sense_groups.english: I'm supposed to attach a bracket-y thing to the side things...

sense_groups.chinese: 用螺纹涡轮
sense_groups.english: ...using a bunch of these little worm guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有支架 没有看到螺纹涡轮
sense_groups.english: I have no bracket-y thing, I see no worm guys whatsoever...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我的腿麻了
sense_groups.english: ...and I cannot feel my legs.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞定书架了 - 完工了
sense_groups.english: Done with the bookcase. - All finished.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是卡萝最喜欢的啤酒
sense_groups.english: This was Carol's favorite beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 她总是直接从罐子喝 我该知道的
sense_groups.english: She always drank it out of the can. I should have known.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我来问你一个问题
sense_groups.english: Hey. Ross, let me ask you a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 她得到家具、音响、超赞的电视
sense_groups.english: She got the furniture, the stereo, the good TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你得到了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you get?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们啊
sense_groups.english: You guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 天呀 - 你被耍了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Oh, my God. - You got screwed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的老天 - 我知道 我真是个笨蛋
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - I know, I know. I'm such an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 当她一个礼拜见四、五次牙医 我就该知道了
sense_groups.english: I should've caught on when she went to the dentist four and five times a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁的牙齿需要这么干净？
sense_groups.english: I mean, how clean can teeth get?

sense_groups.chinese: 我哥哥正在克服这种事呢 他真是一团糟
sense_groups.english: My brother's going through that. He's such a mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么克服的？
sense_groups.english: How did you get through it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以试着砸烂她的一些贵重的东西
sense_groups.english: He might try accidentally breaking something valuable of hers.

sense_groups.chinese: 比如她的… - 腿？
sense_groups.english: Say her... - Leg?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样也可以
sense_groups.english: Heh. That's one way of going through it, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我则是砸了她的手表
sense_groups.english: Me, I went for the watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的砸了她的手表？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You actually broke her watch? - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴瑞 对不起 对不起
sense_groups.english: Barry, I'm sorry. I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你可能认为和那天我对你说
sense_groups.english: I know you probably think it's about what I said

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你穿袜子做爱有关 但不是的
sense_groups.english: that you making love with your socks on, but it isn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 这和我有关 我只是…
sense_groups.english: It isn't, it's about me. And I...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 机器又把电话挂断了 不管怎样…
sense_groups.english: Hi. Machine cut me off again. Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 知道什么最吓人的吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what's scary?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果每个人只有一个女人适合他呢？
sense_groups.english: What if there's only one woman for everybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 如果你得到一个女人 就这样
sense_groups.english: I mean, what if you get one woman, and that's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不幸的是 以我的例子来讲 是她…得到一个女人
sense_groups.english: Unfortunately, in my case, there was only one woman for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？"一个女人"？
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? One woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就好像你只吃一种口味的冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: That's like saying there's only one flavor of ice cream for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我告诉你 罗斯 还有很多种口味
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you something, Ross. There's lots of flavors out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 有碎糖口味、饼干口味 然后还有香草口味
sense_groups.english: There's rocky road and cookie dough and bing cherry vanilla.

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以加糖条、果仁 或者鲜奶油一起吃
sense_groups.english: You can get them with jimmies or nuts or whipped cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你一生中最棒的时刻了
sense_groups.english: This is the best thing that ever happened to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你难道是八岁结婚的？
sense_groups.english: You got married. You were like, what, 8?

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎回到现实里 拿起汤匙
sense_groups.english: Welcome back to the world. Grab a spoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不知道我是饿了 还是饥渴
sense_groups.english: I honestly don't know if I'm hungry or horny.

sense_groups.chinese: 离我的冰箱远点
sense_groups.english: Then stay out of my freezer.

sense_groups.chinese: 从她离开我之后 我…
sense_groups.english: Ever since she walked out on me, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么啦？
sense_groups.english: What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想边吃面条边讲出来？
sense_groups.english: You wanna spell it out with noodles?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这本该在和你第五次约会时才能说出来的
sense_groups.english: No, it's more of a fifth date kind of revelation.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 所以会有第五次约会啰？
sense_groups.english: Oh, so there's gonna be a fifth date?

sense_groups.chinese: 会有吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得会有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. I think there is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要说什么？
sense_groups.english: What were you gonna say?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well... Er, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 自从她离开我之后…
sense_groups.english: Ever since she left me, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就一直…
sense_groups.english: ...I haven't been able to perform...

sense_groups.chinese: 无法行房
sense_groups.english: ...sexually.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! Oh, God! I am so...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起… - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. - It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 被人吐水应该不是你现在需要的
sense_groups.english: Being spit on is probably not what you need right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 多久了？
sense_groups.english: How long?

sense_groups.chinese: 两年
sense_groups.english: Two years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真高兴你砸了她的手表
sense_groups.english: I'm glad you smashed her watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你还希望有第五次约会吗？
sense_groups.english: So you still think you might want that fifth date?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我希望
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我乔安妮 接受查理斯为我的合法丈夫
sense_groups.english: I, Joanie, take you, Charles, as my lawful husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是否接受乔安妮… - 看吧
sense_groups.english: Do you take Joanie...? - Oh! See.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是乔安妮爱佳奇 就是这里不同
sense_groups.english: But Joanie loved Chachi. That's the difference.

sense_groups.chinese: "拿起汤匙"
sense_groups.english: "Grab a spoon."

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我多久没拿汤匙了吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know long it's been since I grabbed a spoon?

sense_groups.chinese: "比利 别逞英雄" 这句话对你有没有意义？
sense_groups.english: Do the words, "Billy, don't be a hero," mean anything to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 是这样的 就算我想…
sense_groups.english: You know, here's the thing. Even if I could get it together enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 约一个女人出来
sense_groups.english: ...to ask a woman out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我该约谁？
sense_groups.english: ...who am I gonna ask?

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是很不可思议？
sense_groups.english: Isn't this amazing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前从来没泡过咖啡
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have never made coffee before in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 是很不可思议 - 恭喜你
sense_groups.english: That is amazing. - Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在刚好有心情 有没有想做个蛋饼之类的东西…
sense_groups.english: While you're on a roll, if you feel like you gotta make a Western omelet or something...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我还不太饿…
sense_groups.english: Although, actually I'm really not that hungry this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 早安
sense_groups.english: Good morning. - Good morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 早安
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 早安 保罗
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Morning, Paul.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 保罗 - 嘿 是保罗 对吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Paul. - Hi. Paul, is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨晚很开心
sense_groups.english: I had a really great time last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我可能会约你

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 - 晚安

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不必知道那么多
sense_groups.english: Well, they don't have to know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 麻烦你过来帮我弄意大利面
sense_groups.english: Ross, could you come and help me with the spaghetti.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要吃意大利面 那真是...
sense_groups.english: Oh, we're having spaghetti. That's...

sense_groups.chinese: 太轻松了
sense_groups.english: ...easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道听起来我真的很自私
sense_groups.english: I know this is going to sound unbelievably selfish on my part...

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算提起宝宝跟女同志的事吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but were you planning on bringing up the whole baby/lesbian thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想那能帮我挡些子弹
sense_groups.english: Because I think it might take some of the heat off me.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋打算怎么过生活？我们在俱乐部遇到她爸妈
sense_groups.english: What that Rachel did to her life. We ran into her parents at the club.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们似乎很难过
sense_groups.english: They were not playing very well.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想告诉你们 他们花了多少钱办婚礼
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna tell you what they spent on that wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 但四万块是一大笔钱
sense_groups.english: ...but $40,000 is a lot of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少她有机会在婚礼上甩了男人
sense_groups.english: Well, at least she had the chance to leave a man at the altar.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么意思？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What's that supposed to mean? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是一种说法 - 不 不是的
sense_groups.english: It's an expression. - No, it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 别听你妈妈的
sense_groups.english: Don't listen to your mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很独立 你一直都是如此
sense_groups.english: You're independent and you always have been.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使你小时候胖嘟嘟的
sense_groups.english: Even when you were a kid, and you were chubby...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有朋友 你还是过得很好
sense_groups.english: ...and you had no friends, you were just fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一个人在房里看书玩拼图
sense_groups.english: You'd read alone in your room. And your puzzles...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 像罗斯这样的人 必须追求成功
sense_groups.english: Look, there are people, like Ross, who need to shoot for the stars.

sense_groups.chinese: 他到博物馆工作 准备出版论文
sense_groups.english: With his museum and his papers getting published.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他人则是安于现状
sense_groups.english: Other people are satisfied with staying where they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说的是这些人永远不会得癌症
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, these are the people who never get cancer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到报导说这些女人想那么做 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: And I read about these women trying to have it all, and I thank God...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的小摩妮卡没有那样的问题
sense_groups.english: ...our little Harmonica doesn't seem to have that problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, what's going on with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有任何故事吗？没有消息或趣事要跟父母分享？
sense_groups.english: Any stories? No news, no little anecdotes to share with the folks?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我知道你们一直很好奇
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Look, I, uh... I realize you guys have been wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟卡萝到底是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: ...what exactly happened between Carol and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况是这样的
sense_groups.english: And so, well, here's the deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝是女同志
sense_groups.english: Carol's a lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟一个叫苏珊的女人住在一起
sense_groups.english: She's living with a woman named Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 她怀了我的孩子
sense_groups.english: She's pregnant with my child.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟苏珊要一起抚养孩子
sense_groups.english: And she and Susan are going to raise the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你早就知道了？
sense_groups.english: And you knew about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的爸妈真的有那么难过？
sense_groups.english: Your folks are really that bad, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们可是专家
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, these people are pros.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们知道自己在做什么 愿意花时间
sense_groups.english: They know what they're doing. They take their time.

sense_groups.chinese: 不做完誓不甘休
sense_groups.english: They get the job done.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我知道俗话说 人是无法换父母的
sense_groups.english: Boy, I know they say that you can't change your parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 如果可以的话 我想跟你换父母
sense_groups.english: Boy, if you could, I'd want yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去尿尿
sense_groups.english: Must pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 这比你们是双胞胎还糟糕
sense_groups.english: You know, it's even worse when you're twins.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是双胞胎？ - 对 我们不说话
sense_groups.english: You're a twin? - Oh, yeah. We don't speak.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是位高权重的霸道女强人
sense_groups.english: She's like this high-powered, driven, career-type.

sense_groups.chinese: 她做什么样的工作？ - 她是服务生
sense_groups.english: What does she do? - She's a waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 各位 我必须打扫
sense_groups.english: All right. You guys, I kind of gotta clean up now.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你是独生子 你不必忍受这一切
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you're an only child, right? You don't have any of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但我有个幻想的朋友
sense_groups.english: Well, no, although I did have an imaginary friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈比较喜欢他
sense_groups.english: ...who my parents actually preferred.

sense_groups.chinese: 请关灯
sense_groups.english: Hit the lights, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在厕所待了多久？
sense_groups.english: How long was I in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在打扫
sense_groups.english: I'm just cleaning up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, do you, uh...? Do you need any help?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Um, okay, sure. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之
sense_groups.english: Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 你很紧张明天要跟贝瑞见面？
sense_groups.english: So you nervous about Barry tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点 - 唔
sense_groups.english: Oh, a little. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常紧张 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: A lot. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有任何建议吗？
sense_groups.english: So got any advice?

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟你有被甩的经验
sense_groups.english: You know, as someone who's recently been dumped.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该避免用 "甩" 这个字
sense_groups.english: Well, you may want to steer clear of the word "dumped."

sense_groups.chinese: 他很可能心都碎了 你懂吗？
sense_groups.english: Chances are he's going to be this broken shell of a man. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能看起来太漂亮 我知道那很难
sense_groups.english: So you should try not to look too terrific. I know it'll be hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是由我过去把戒指还给贝瑞
sense_groups.english: Or, you know, hey, I'll go down there, and I'll give Barry back his ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 你陪卡萝跟苏珊去看妇产科
sense_groups.english: And you can go with Carol and Susan to the OB-GYN.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天你得去陪卡萝
sense_groups.english: You've got Carol tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 何时世界变得这么复杂？
sense_groups.english: When did it get so complicated?

sense_groups.chinese: 你问倒我了
sense_groups.english: Got me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得我们念高中的时候吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Remember when we were in high school? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得你会遇上某人
sense_groups.english: I mean, didn't you think you' were gonna meet someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 坠入爱河 就这样过了一生吗？
sense_groups.english: ...fall in love, and that'd be it?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Yes, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我没想到我会落到这步田地
sense_groups.english: Oh. Man. I never thought I'd be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我迟到了 我有工作在忙
sense_groups.english: Hi. Sorry I'm late. I got stuck at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 关于这个大恐龙 总之
sense_groups.english: There was this big dinosaur thing. Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你记得苏珊 - 我怎么会忘记呢？
sense_groups.english: Ross, you remember Susan. - How could I forget?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊 握手力道蛮不错的
sense_groups.english: Hello, Susan. Good shake, good shake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在等
sense_groups.english: So, uh, we're just waiting for?

sense_groups.chinese: 欧伯曼医生 - 欧伯曼医生 他是
sense_groups.english: Dr. Oberman. - Dr. Oberman. Okay, and is he...?

sense_groups.chinese: 是她才对 - 当然 是她才对
sense_groups.english: She. - Of course, "she."

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道我们的特殊状况吗？
sense_groups.english: She, uh, familiar with our special situation?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她非常支持我们
sense_groups.english: Yes, and she's very supportive.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 那是件好事
sense_groups.english: Great. Okay, that's great. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我
sense_groups.english: No, I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 呱
sense_groups.english: Quack, quack...

sense_groups.chinese: 呱
sense_groups.english: ...quack, quack, quack.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是用来打开我的子宫颈
sense_groups.english: That opens my cervix.

sense_groups.chinese: 贝瑞 - 请进
sense_groups.english: Barry? - Come on in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 罗比得在这里待上几小时
sense_groups.english: It's fine, it's fine. Robbie's gonna be here for hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: So how are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我
我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你气色很不错
sense_groups.english: You look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 巴巴尔医生 杰森•葛林斯潘笑个不停
sense_groups.english: Dr. Farber, Jason Greenspan's gagging.

sense_groups.chinese: 马上到 我立刻回来
sense_groups.english: Be right there. I'll be back in a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甩了他
sense_groups.english: I dumped him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 这应该怎么做才好？
sense_groups.english: Ross. - So, um...? So how's this going to work...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我们
sense_groups.english: ...ahem, you know, with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说得做出重要决定时
sense_groups.english: You know, when, like, important decisions have to be made?

sense_groups.chinese: 举个例子来听听
sense_groups.english: Give me a "for instance."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know. Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝的名字呢？ - 马龙
sense_groups.english: How about with the baby's name? - Marlon...

sense_groups.chinese: 马龙 - 如果是儿子 女子就叫米妮
sense_groups.english: Marlon. - ...if it's a boy. Minnie, if it's a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟米妮老鼠一样？
sense_groups.english: As in "Mouse"?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我奶奶一样
sense_groups.english: As in my grandmother.

sense_groups.chinese: 但提到米妮 大家会想到米妮老鼠
sense_groups.english: Still, you say "Minnie," you hear "Mouse."

sense_groups.chinese: 何不叫
sense_groups.english: How about, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 何不叫茱莉亚呢？
sense_groups.english: How about "Julia"?

sense_groups.chinese: 茱莉亚？
sense_groups.english: Julia.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们同意叫米妮了
sense_groups.english: We agreed on Minnie.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很有趣 我们同意要共度一生
sense_groups.english: It's funny, um, we agreed we'd spend our lives together.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情变了 我们可以用拳头来决定
sense_groups.english: Things change. Roll with the punches.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信茱莉亚是个好名字
sense_groups.english: I believe Julia's on the table.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sorry about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: So, what have you been up to?

sense_groups.chinese: 还算可以
sense_groups.english: Oh. Not much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到工作了 - 那真的很棒
sense_groups.english: I got a job. - Hey, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你皮肤变得这么黑？
sense_groups.english: Why are you so tan?

sense_groups.chinese: 我
sense_groups.english: Oh, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我去了阿鲁巴
sense_groups.english: I went to Aruba.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你一个人去度我们的蜜月？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. You went on our honeymoon alone?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我跟...
sense_groups.english: See, uh, I went with...

sense_groups.chinese: 这或许会有点痛 - 我吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, this may hurt. - Me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟敏蒂去的
sense_groups.english: I went with Mindy.

sense_groups.chinese: 敏蒂？
sense_groups.english: Mindy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的伴娘敏蒂？
sense_groups.english: My maid of honor, Mindy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们在交往
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, we're kind of a thing now.
Well, I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了植发
sense_groups.english: You got plugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心 它们还没有完全固定
sense_groups.english: Careful, careful. They haven't quite taken yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你戴了隐形眼镜
sense_groups.english: And you got lenses.

sense_groups.chinese: 你讨厌把手指戳到眼睛里
sense_groups.english: But you hate sticking your finger in your eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了她 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Not for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我真的想谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Listen, I really wanted to thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个月前我想伤害你
sense_groups.english: About a month ago, I wanted to hurt you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我最想伤害的人
sense_groups.english: ...more than I've ever wanted to hurt anyone in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是牙齿矫正师
sense_groups.english: And I'm an orthodontist.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我以为我们很快乐
sense_groups.english: You know, you were right. I mean, I thought we were happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不快乐
sense_groups.english: We weren't happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是跟敏蒂在一起
sense_groups.english: But with Mindy...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我很快乐
sense_groups.english: ...now I'm happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 吐吧 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Spit. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我
sense_groups.english: Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之
sense_groups.english: Anyway, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这该还给你
sense_groups.english: I guess, uh... I guess this belongs to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你把它送给我
sense_groups.english: And thank you for giving it to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你把它还给我
sense_groups.english: Well, thank you for giving it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 海伦有什么不好？
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. What's wrong with Helen?

sense_groups.chinese: 海伦•盖勒？
sense_groups.english: Helen Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不觉得好 - 哈罗 宝宝不叫海伦•盖勒
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. - Hello, it's not gonna be Helen Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说宝宝不姓盖勒
sense_groups.english: No. I mean, it's not Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？宝宝叫海伦•威利克？
sense_groups.english: What, it's gonna be Helen Willick?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 事实上她叫海伦•威利克•邦奇
sense_groups.english: No, actually, um, we talked about Helen Willick Bunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 为什么这跟她有关？
sense_groups.english: Well, wait a minute. Why is she in the title?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这也是我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Because it's my baby too.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太好笑了 真的吗？我不记得你会制造精子
sense_groups.english: That's funny. Really? I don't remember you making any sperm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都知道那是个多大的挑战
sense_groups.english: And we all know what a challenge that is.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 - 好了 你们两个 别说了
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. See? - All right, you two, stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她有功劳 我也是
sense_groups.english: No, no. She gets a credit. Hey, I'm in there too.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 宝宝不能叫 海伦•威利克•邦奇•盖勒
sense_groups.english: Honestly. You're not actually suggesting Helen Willick Bunch Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想那跟虐童差不多
sense_groups.english: I think that borders on child abuse.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是 我想宝宝叫盖勒•威利克•邦奇
sense_groups.english: Of course not. I'm suggesting Geller Willick Bunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你知道他在做什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, no, no. You see what he's doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 他知道没有人会那样叫她
sense_groups.english: He knows no one is gonna say all those names.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后他们会叫她盖勒 那样子他就达到目的了
sense_groups.english: He knows they'll wind up calling her Geller. Then he gets his way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的目的？你觉得这是我的目的？
sense_groups.english: My way? You think this is my way?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 目前我想象过的生活
sense_groups.english: Believe me, of all the ways I ever imagined this moment in my life being...

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对不包括这一点 你知道吗？这真的太难了
sense_groups.english: ...this is not my way. You know what? This is too hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好吗？有恶心的感觉吗？
sense_groups.english: Knock, knock. How are we today? Any nausea?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点 - 只有一点
sense_groups.english: A little. - Just a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是指准妈妈的感觉 不过谢谢你们跟我分享
sense_groups.english: Well, I was just wondering about the mother-to-be, but, uh, thanks for sharing.

sense_groups.chinese: 躺好
sense_groups.english: Uh, lie back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我要走了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我无法介入这种家务事
sense_groups.english: Um, I don't think I can be involved in this particular family thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看那个
sense_groups.english: Look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很神奇吧？
sense_groups.english: Well, isn't that amazing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到底要看什么？
sense_groups.english: What are we supposed to be seeing here?

questions.name: S01E03
questions.en:
Hi, guys. - Hey, Phoebe.
Hey, oh, how did it go?
Um, not so good.
He walked me to the subway and said, "We should do this again."
Ouch. - What? He said, "We should do it again."
That's good, right?
Uh, no. Loosely translated, "We should do this again," means
"You will never see me naked."
Since when?
Since always. It's, like, dating language.
You know, like, "It's not you," means, "It is you."
"You're such a nice guy," means
"I'm gonna be dating leather-wearing alcoholics...
...and complaining about them to you."
Or, you know, um, "I think we should see other people," means
"Ha, ha, I already am."
And everybody knows this?
Oh, yeah. Cushions the blow.
Like when you're a kid and your parents put your dog to sleep...
...and they tell you it went off to live on some farm.
That's funny. No, because, uh, our parents actually did...
...uh, send our dog off to live on a farm.
Uh, Ross?
Ha, ha. Hello. The Milner's farm in Connecticut?
The Milners, they had this unbelievable farm.
They had horses and rabbits that he could chase.
And it was...
Oh, my God. Chi-Chi.
"So how does it feel knowing you're about to die?"
Warden, in five minutes my pain will be over.
But you'll have to live with the knowledge that you sent an honest man to die.
Hey, that was really good. - Yeah?
Yeah. - Thanks. Let's keep going.
Okay. "So, what do you want from me, Dimon? Huh?"
I just wanna go back to my cell, because in my cell, I can smoke.
"Smoke away."
Heh.
I think this is probably why Dimon smokes in his cell alone.
What? - Relax your hand.
Let your wrist go.
Not so much. - Whoa.
Hey.
All right. Now try taking a puff.
Right.
Okay, no, give it to me. - No, no, no. I'm not giving you a cigarette.
No, it's fine. It's fine. Look, do you want to get this part or not? Here.
All right. Now, don't think of it as a cigarette.
Think of it as the thing that has been missing from your hand.
When you're holding it, you feel right.
You feel complete. - You miss it?
No, not so much.
All right. Now we smoke.
Oh, my God.
No, no, no.
They say it's the same as the distance from the tip of a guy's thumb...
...to the tip of his index finger.
That's ridiculous.
Can I use either thumb?
All right. Don't tell me, don't tell me.
Decaf cappuccino for Joey.
Coffee, black.
Latte.
And an iced tea.
I'm getting pretty good at this. - Excellent. That's very good.
Good for me.
You okay, Phoebe? - Yeah, no, it's not even worth...
It's my bank.
What did they do to you?
It's nothing, it's just... Okay.
I'm going through my mail, and I open up their monthly "statement."
Easy.
And there's 500 extra dollars in my account.
Oh, Satan's minions at work again.
Yes, because now I have to go down there and deal with them...
What are you talking about? Keep it. - It's not mine.
I didn't earn it. If I kept it, it would be like stealing.
Yeah, but if you spent it, it would be like shopping.
Okay. Okay.
Let's say I bought a really great pair of shoes.
Do you know what I'd hear with every step I took?
"Not mine. Not mine. Not mine."
And even if I was happy, okay, and skipping...
...I'd hear, "Not mine. Not mine."
We're with you. We got it.
Okay, I'd never be able to enjoy it. It'd be like this giant karmic debt.
Chandler, what are you doing? Hey.
What are you doing?
Oh, gross.
What is this? - I'm smoking. I'm smoking. I'm smoking.
I can't believe you. You've been so good for three years.
And this is my reward.
Hold on a second. Just think about what you went through the last time you quit.
Okay, so this time I won't quit.
Put it out. - All right. I'm putting it out.
Oh, no.
I can't drink this now.
All right, I'm gonna go change. I've got a date.
Is this Alan again? How's it going?
It's going pretty good, you know? It's nice and we're having fun.
So when do we get to meet the guy? - Yeah.
Let's see, today's Monday...
Never. - Come on.
No, not after what happened with Steve. - What are you talking about?
We love Steve. Steve was sexy.
Sorry.
Look, I don't know how I feel about him yet. Give me a chance to figure it out.
Well, then can we meet him?
No.
Sorry.
Why should I let them meet him?
I bring a guy home and within five minutes they're all over him.
I mean, they're like coyotes picking off the weak members of the herd.
Listen, as someone who's seen more than her share of bad beef...
...I'll tell you, that is not such a terrible thing.
Come on, they're your friends. They're looking out after you.
I know, I know. I wish that once I'd bring a guy home they actually liked.
Well, you do realize that the odds of that happening are a little slimmer...
...if they never get to meet the guy.
Let it go, Ross.
Yeah? Well, you didn't know Chi-Chi.
Do you all promise?
Yeah, we promise. We'll be good. - We promise.
Chandler, do you promise to be good?
You can come in, but your filter tip little buddy has to stay outside.
Hey, Pheebs.
"Dear Ms. Buffay: Thank you for calling attention to our error.
We have credited your account $500. We're sorry for the inconvenience...
...and hope you'll accept this football phone...
...as our free gift." Do you believe this?
Now I have $1000 and a football phone.
What bank is this?
Okay, it's him.
Who is it? - Alan.
Chandler. He's here.
Okay, please be good. Please?
I mean, remember how much you like me.
Hi. Alan, this is everybody. Everybody, this is Alan.
Hi. - Hey.
I've heard so much about all you guys.
Thanks, I'll call you tomorrow.
Okay.
Okay, let's let the Alan-bashing begin.
Who's gonna take the first shot?
Hmm?
Come on.
I'll go.
Let's start with the way he kept picking at...
You know, I'm sorry, I can't do this.
Can't do it. We loved him.
We loved him. - Wait a minute.
We're talking about someone that I'm going out with?
Yes. - And did you notice?
Yeah.
Know what was great? The way his smile was kind of crooked.
Yes, yes. Like the man in the shoe.
What shoe?
From the nursery rhyme.
"There was a crooked man who had a crooked smile...
...who lived in a shoe for a while..."
So I think Alan...
...will become the yardstick...
...against which all future boyfriends will be measured.
What future boyfriends?
No, no. I think this could be, you know, "it."
Really? - Oh, yeah.
I'd marry him just for his David Hasselhoff impression alone.
You know I'm gonna be doing that at parties, right?
You know what I like most about him? - What?
The way he makes me feel about myself.
Yeah.
Hi.
How was the game?
Well...
We won! - We won! Thank you! Yeah.
Fantastic. I have one question: How is that possible?
Alan. - He was unbelievable.
He was like that Bugs Bunny cartoon where Bugs is playing all the positions.
But instead of Bugs, it was first base, Alan. Second base, Alan...
I mean, it was like he made us into a team.
Yep. We sure showed those Hasidic jewelers...
...a thing or two about softball. - Nice.
Can I ask you guys a question?
Do you ever think that Alan is maybe sometimes...
What? - I don't know. A little too Alan?
Oh, no. That's not possible. You can never be too Alan.
Yeah, it's his innate Alan-ness that we adore.
I, personally, could have a gallon of Alan. - Oh!
Hey, Lizzy. - Hey, Weird Girl.
I brought you alphabet soup. - Did you pick out the vowels?
Yes, but I left in the Y's. Because, you know, "Sometimes Y."
Um, I also have something else for you.
Saltines?
No, but would you like $1000 and a football phone?
What?
Oh, my God.
Oh, my God. There's really money in here. - I know.
Weird Girl, what are you doing?
Oh, I want you to have it. I don't want it.
No, no. I have to give you something.
No, it's fine. You don't...
Do you want my tinfoil hat?
No, because you need that. No, it's okay. Thanks.
Please. Let me do something.
Okay, all right. I'll tell you what.
You buy me a soda and then we're even. Okay?
Okay. - Okay.
Keep the change.
Thanks, Lizzy.
Sure you don't want a pretzel?
No, I'm fine. Thanks. - See you.
Huh.
A thumb?
Ew.
I know, I know. I opened it up and there it was...
...just floating in there, like this tiny little hitchhiker.
Maybe it's a contest, you know? Like "Collect all five."
Does, um, anyone wanna see?
No, thanks.
Oh, hey, don't do that. Come on. - Cut that out.
It's worse than the thumb.
Hey, this is so unfair.
Why is it unfair? - So I have a flaw. Big deal.
Like Joey's constant knuckle-cracking isn't annoying?
And Ross, with his over-pronouncing every single word.
And Monica, with that snort when she laughs.
I mean, what the hell is that thing?
I accept all those flaws. Why can't you accept me for this?
Does the knuckle-cracking bother everybody, or just him?
Well...
...I could live without it.
Huh.
Well, is it, like, a little annoying? Or is it like when Phoebe chews her hair?
Now, don't listen to him, Pheebs, all right? I think it's endearing.
Oh, you do, do you?
You know, there's nothing wrong with speaking correctly.
Indeed there isn't.
I should really get back to work.
Yeah, otherwise someone might get what they actually ordered.
Oh. The hair comes out and the gloves come off.
Did you ever go out with a guy your friends all really like?
No.
Okay. Well, I'm going out with a guy my friends all really like.
We talking about the coyotes here?
Heh. All right. A cow got through.
Can you believe it?
It's just, you know what?
I just don't feel the thing.
I mean, they feel the thing. I don't feel the thing.
Honey, you should always...
...feel the thing.
Listen, if that's how you feel about the guy, Monica, dump him.
I know, it's just gonna be really hard.
Yeah, he's a big boy. He'll get over it.
No, he'll be fine. It's the other five I'm worried about.
Do you have any respect for your body?
Don't you realize what you're doing to yourself?
Hey, you know, I've had it with you and your cancer...
...and your emphysema and your heart disease.
The bottom line is, smoking is cool, and you know it.
Ahem. Chandler?
It's Alan. He wants to speak to you.
Really? He does?
Hey, buddy. What's up?
Oh, she told you about that, huh?
Well, yeah. I have one now and then. Well, yeah, now.
Well, it's not that bad...
Well, that's true.
Gee, you know, no one's ever put it like that before.
Well, okay. Thanks.
God, he's good.
If only he were a woman.
Yeah.
Oh, Lamb Chop.
How old is that sock?
If I had a sock on my hand for 30 years, it'd be talking too.
Okay, I think it's time to change somebody's nicotine patch.
Hey.
Where's Joey?
Joey ate my last stick of gum, so I killed him.
Do you think that was wrong?
I think he's across the hall. - Thanks.
There you go.
Ooh, I'm alive with pleasure now.
Hey, Pheebs, you gonna have the rest of that Pop Tart?
Does anyone want the rest of this Pop Tart?
Hey, I might.
I'm sorry.
You know, those stupid soda people gave me $7000 for the thumb.
Oh, my God. - Seven thousand dollars?
And on my way over here, I stepped in gum.
What is up with the universe?
What's going on?
Nothing. I just think it's nice when we're all here together.
It's even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear.
Uh, Joey... - Oh.
Okay. - Oh, come on.
Please, guys, we have to talk.
Wait, wait. I'm getting a déjà vu.
No, I'm not.
All right, we have to talk. - There it is.
Okay, it's about Alan.
There's something you should know.
Oh, man, there's really no easy way to say this. Uh...
I've decided to break up with Alan.
Is there somebody else?
No, no, no. It's just...
...you know, things change. People change.
We didn't change.
So that's it? It's over?
Just like that?
You know, you let your guard down.
You know, you start to really care about someone, and I just...
Look, I could go on pretending... - Okay.
No. No, that wouldn't be fair to me...
...it wouldn't be fair to Alan, or to you.
Yeah, well, who wants fair?
I mean, I just want things back, you know, the way they were.
I'm sorry. - Oh, she's sorry. I feel better.
I just can't believe this.
I mean, with the holidays coming up. I wanted him to meet my family.
I'll meet someone else. There'll be other Alans.
Yeah, right.
Are you guys gonna be okay? - Hey, hey. We'll be fine.
We're just gonna need a little time.
I understand.
Wow.
I'm really sorry. - Yeah. I mean, I'm sorry too.
But I gotta tell you, I'm a little relieved.
Relieved? - Yeah, well...
...I mean, I had a great time with you.
I just can't stand your friends.
Remember when we went to Central Park and rented boats?
That was fun.
Yeah. He could row like a Viking.
Hi. - Hi.
So how'd it go?
You know. - Did he mention us?
He says he's really gonna miss you guys.
You had a rough day, huh?
Oh, you have no idea. - Come here.
That's it. I'm getting cigarettes. - No, no, no.
I don't care. I don't care.
Game's over. I'm weak. I've gotta smoke. I've gotta have the smoke.
If you never smoke again, I'll give you $7000.
Yeah, all right.

sense_groups.english: "Smoke away."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这是迪蒙独自在牢房抽烟的原因
sense_groups.english: I think this is probably why Dimon smokes in his cell alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 手放轻松
sense_groups.english: What? - Relax your hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 手腕下垂
sense_groups.english: Let your wrist go.

sense_groups.chinese: 别垂得那么低 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Not so much. - Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 试着抽一口
sense_groups.english: All right. Now try taking a puff.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不 快给我 - 不 我才不要给你烟
sense_groups.english: Okay, no, give it to me. - No, no, no. I'm not giving you a cigarette.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 听着 你要不要这个角色？来吧
sense_groups.english: No, it's fine. It's fine. Look, do you want to get this part or not? Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别当这是香烟
sense_groups.english: All right. Now, don't think of it as a cigarette.

sense_groups.chinese: 当它是从你手里不见的东西
sense_groups.english: Think of it as the thing that has been missing from your hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿着它 你觉得安心
sense_groups.english: When you're holding it, you feel right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得圆满 - 你想念它吗？
sense_groups.english: You feel complete. - You miss it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是很想
sense_groups.english: No, not so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在抽一口
sense_groups.english: All right. Now we smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说那个的长度 跟男人拇指尖
sense_groups.english: They say it's the same as the distance from the tip of a guy's thumb...

sense_groups.chinese: 到食指尖的距离一样
sense_groups.english: ...to the tip of his index finger.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太夸张了
sense_groups.english: That's ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以用另一只手的拇指吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I use either thumb?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别告诉我
sense_groups.english: All right. Don't tell me, don't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊是无咖啡因的卡布奇诺
sense_groups.english: Decaf cappuccino for Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 黑咖啡
sense_groups.english: Coffee, black.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿铁
sense_groups.english: Latte.

sense_groups.chinese: 冰茶
sense_groups.english: And an iced tea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很厉害 - 太好了 非常不错
sense_groups.english: I'm getting pretty good at this. - Excellent. That's very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太神了
sense_groups.english: Good for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧 菲比？ - 对 不 那根本不值得…
sense_groups.english: You okay, Phoebe? - Yeah, no, it's not even worth...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的银行
sense_groups.english: It's my bank.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们对你做了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did they do to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 只不过… 好的
sense_groups.english: It's nothing, it's just... Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看邮件时打开他们的月报表
sense_groups.english: I'm going through my mail, and I open up their monthly "statement."

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动
sense_groups.english: Easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的帐户多了五百块
sense_groups.english: And there's 500 extra dollars in my account.

sense_groups.chinese: 撒旦的手下又发威了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Satan's minions at work again.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我得去银行跟他们谈
sense_groups.english: Yes, because now I have to go down there and deal with them...

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛要说呢？留下那笔钱 - 那不是我的钱
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? Keep it. - It's not mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是我赚来的 留下来那笔钱就等于我偷钱
sense_groups.english: I didn't earn it. If I kept it, it would be like stealing.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 把它花掉 可以享受血拼乐趣
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but if you spent it, it would be like shopping.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 假设我买了一双很棒的鞋子
sense_groups.english: Let's say I bought a really great pair of shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我每跨出一步 会听到什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know what I'd hear with every step I took?

sense_groups.chinese: "不是我的钱"
sense_groups.english: "Not mine. Not mine. Not mine."

sense_groups.chinese: 即使我开心地飞舞
sense_groups.english: And even if I was happy, okay, and skipping...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会听到 "不是我的钱"
sense_groups.english: ...I'd hear, "Not mine. Not mine."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们同意你的说法 我们了解
sense_groups.english: We're with you. We got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我无法享受乐趣 那是一大道德考验
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'd never be able to enjoy it. It'd be like this giant karmic debt.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, what are you doing? Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 超恶心的
sense_groups.english: Oh, gross.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么意回事？ - 我在抽烟
sense_groups.english: What is this? - I'm smoking. I'm smoking. I'm smoking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信 三年来你表现很好
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you. You've been so good for three years.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的奖励
sense_groups.english: And this is my reward.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 想想上次戒烟时你吃的苦
sense_groups.english: Hold on a second. Just think about what you went through the last time you quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 所以这次我不戒烟
sense_groups.english: Okay, so this time I won't quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 把烟熄了 - 好吧 我熄了就是
sense_groups.english: Put it out. - All right. I'm putting it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我没办法喝咖啡了
sense_groups.english: I can't drink this now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要去换衣服 我有约会
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm gonna go change. I've got a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 又是亚伦？情况如何？
sense_groups.english: Is this Alan again? How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 非常不错 你们知道吗 我们相处既愉快又开心
sense_groups.english: It's going pretty good, you know? It's nice and we're having fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何时能见到这家伙？ - 对
sense_groups.english: So when do we get to meet the guy? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我想一想 今天是星期一
sense_groups.english: Let's see, today's Monday...

sense_groups.chinese: 永远不可能 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: Never. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 在史提夫后是不可能了 - 你在胡说什么？
sense_groups.english: No, not after what happened with Steve. - What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱史提夫 史提夫超性感
sense_groups.english: We love Steve. Steve was sexy.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我对他有什么感觉 给我机会弄清楚
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't know how I feel about him yet. Give me a chance to figure it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们能跟他见面？
sense_groups.english: Well, then can we meet him?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我要让他们跟他见面？
sense_groups.english: Why should I let them meet him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我带男人回家 五分钟内他们围着他问个不停
sense_groups.english: I bring a guy home and within five minutes they're all over him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们像是土狼 专对弱小猎物下手
sense_groups.english: I mean, they're like coyotes picking off the weak members of the herd.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 对一个什么倒霉事都遇过的人来说
sense_groups.english: Listen, as someone who's seen more than her share of bad beef...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想那不算是太糟糕
sense_groups.english: ...I'll tell you, that is not such a terrible thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是你的朋友 他们关心你
sense_groups.english: Come on, they're your friends. They're looking out after you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我希望我能带个他们喜欢的男人回家
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. I wish that once I'd bring a guy home they actually liked.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 如果他们永远不跟这个男的见面
sense_groups.english: Well, you do realize that the odds of that happening are a little slimmer...

sense_groups.chinese: 机率会更小的
sense_groups.english: ...if they never get to meet the guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了吧 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Let it go, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？你根本不认识奇奇
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Well, you didn't know Chi-Chi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都保证吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you all promise?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们保证 我们会很乖的 - 我们保证
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we promise. We'll be good. - We promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你保证会很乖吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, do you promise to be good?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以进来 但你的烟得放在外面
sense_groups.english: You can come in, but your filter tip little buddy has to stay outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的布非小姐 谢谢你通知我们犯了错"
sense_groups.english: "Dear Ms. Buffay: Thank you for calling attention to our error.

sense_groups.chinese: "我们将五百块汇到你的帐户 抱歉造成你的不便"
sense_groups.english: We have credited your account $500. We're sorry for the inconvenience...

sense_groups.chinese: "希望你收下这个足球电话"
sense_groups.english: ...and hope you'll accept this football phone...

sense_groups.chinese: 做为我们的免费礼物" 你们能相信吗？
sense_groups.english: ...as our free gift." Do you believe this?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我有一千块跟这个足球电话
sense_groups.english: Now I have $1000 and a football phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在哪家银行开的户？
sense_groups.english: What bank is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's him.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪位？ - 亚伦
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - Alan.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 他来了
sense_groups.english: Chandler. He's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 拜托你们乖一点
sense_groups.english: Okay, please be good. Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得你们有多么喜欢我
sense_groups.english: I mean, remember how much you like me.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚伦 他们是我的朋友 各位 他是亚伦
sense_groups.english: Hi. Alan, this is everybody. Everybody, this is Alan.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我常听到你们的事
sense_groups.english: I've heard so much about all you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 明天我再打电话给你
sense_groups.english: Thanks, I'll call you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 开始批评亚伦
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's let the Alan-bashing begin.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要开第一枪？
sense_groups.english: Who's gonna take the first shot?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先来
sense_groups.english: I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 从他一直挑…
sense_groups.english: Let's start with the way he kept picking at...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我办不到
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm sorry, I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不到 我们爱他
sense_groups.english: Can't do it. We loved him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱他 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: We loved him. - Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在谈我的约会对象吗？
sense_groups.english: We're talking about someone that I'm going out with?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 你们注意到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes. - And did you notice?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道哪一点最棒吧？他的笑容有点坏坏的
sense_groups.english: Know what was great? The way his smile was kind of crooked.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 像鞋子里的男人
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes. Like the man in the shoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么鞋子？
sense_groups.english: What shoe?

sense_groups.chinese: 童谣里的歌词
sense_groups.english: From the nursery rhyme.

sense_groups.chinese: "有个坏男人 带着坏坏的笑容"
sense_groups.english: "There was a crooked man who had a crooked smile...

sense_groups.chinese: "他在鞋子里住了一阵子"
sense_groups.english: ...who lived in a shoe for a while..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我想…
sense_groups.english: So I think Alan...

sense_groups.chinese: 把亚伦作为标竿
sense_groups.english: ...will become the yardstick...

sense_groups.chinese: 用来评估你未来所有的男朋友
sense_groups.english: ...against which all future boyfriends will be measured.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么未来的男朋友？
sense_groups.english: What future boyfriends?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想就是他了
sense_groups.english: No, no. I think this could be, you know, "it."

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会嫁给他 因为他的表情 跟大卫•赫索霍夫一样
sense_groups.english: I'd marry him just for his David Hasselhoff impression alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我在派对上会怎么做吧？
sense_groups.english: You know I'm gonna be doing that at parties, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我最喜欢他哪一点吗？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You know what I like most about him? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他让我喜欢我自己
sense_groups.english: The way he makes me feel about myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 比赛还好吧？
sense_groups.english: How was the game?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们赢了 - 我们赢了 谢谢 太棒了
sense_groups.english: We won! - We won! Thank you! Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我有个问题 怎么可能呢？
sense_groups.english: Fantastic. I have one question: How is that possible?

sense_groups.chinese: 亚伦 - 他太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: Alan. - He was unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟兔宝宝卡通里 每个位置都是兔宝宝一样
sense_groups.english: He was like that Bugs Bunny cartoon where Bugs is playing all the positions.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他不是兔宝宝 一垒 亚伦 二垒 亚伦
sense_groups.english: But instead of Bugs, it was first base, Alan. Second base, Alan...

sense_groups.chinese: 他让我们成为真正的球队
sense_groups.english: I mean, it was like he made us into a team.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们真的让那些东正教犹太人珠宝商
sense_groups.english: Yep. We sure showed those Hasidic jewelers...

sense_groups.chinese: 知道我们多会打垒球 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: ...a thing or two about softball. - Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你们一个问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I ask you guys a question?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会不会觉得亚伦有时候…
sense_groups.english: Do you ever think that Alan is maybe sometimes...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我不知道 有点太亚伦了
sense_groups.english: What? - I don't know. A little too Alan?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是不可能的 他不可能会太亚伦
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. That's not possible. You can never be too Alan.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们爱的是亚伦的内在
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's his innate Alan-ness that we adore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就蛮想有一加仑的亚伦 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I, personally, could have a gallon of Alan. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 莉兹 - 怪女孩
sense_groups.english: Hey, Lizzy. - Hey, Weird Girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你买了字母汤 - 你把元音挑出来了吗？
sense_groups.english: I brought you alphabet soup. - Did you pick out the vowels?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我留下Y 因为 "有时候非￥不可"
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I left in the Y's. Because, you know, "Sometimes Y."

sense_groups.chinese: 我还要给你一样东西
sense_groups.english: Um, I also have something else for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 盐脆薄饼干
sense_groups.english: Saltines?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你要一千块跟足球电话吗？
sense_groups.english: No, but would you like $1000 and a football phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 里面是真的钱 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. There's really money in here. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪女孩 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: Weird Girl, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你收下它 我不要这些钱
sense_groups.english: Oh, I want you to have it. I don't want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我得给你一样东西
sense_groups.english: No, no. I have to give you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 你不必…
sense_groups.english: No, it's fine. You don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我的锡箔纸帽吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want my tinfoil hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你需要它 没关系的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, because you need that. No, it's okay. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 让我帮你做些事
sense_groups.english: Please. Let me do something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right. I'll tell you what.

sense_groups.chinese: 你请我喝杯汽水 我们就扯平了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: You buy me a soda and then we're even. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用找了
sense_groups.english: Keep the change.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 莉兹
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Lizzy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不想吃麻花饼？
sense_groups.english: Sure you don't want a pretzel?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不饿 谢谢 - 再见
sense_groups.english: No, I'm fine. Thanks. - See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一根拇指？
sense_groups.english: A thumb?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Ew.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我一打开就看到它
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. I opened it up and there it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 漂浮在汽水里 就像是有人要搭便车一样
sense_groups.english: ...just floating in there, like this tiny little hitchhiker.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这是个比赛 你得收集五根手指
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's a contest, you know? Like "Collect all five."

sense_groups.chinese: 有人想看一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Does, um, anyone wanna see?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 别那么做 少来了 - 别闹了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, don't do that. Come on. - Cut that out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那比拇指更糟糕
sense_groups.english: It's worse than the thumb.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太不公平了
sense_groups.english: Hey, this is so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不公平？ - 我有个缺点 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: Why is it unfair? - So I have a flaw. Big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊老是按压手指不讨厌吗？
sense_groups.english: Like Joey's constant knuckle-cracking isn't annoying?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯说起来会咬文嚼字
sense_groups.english: And Ross, with his over-pronouncing every single word.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡笑的时候会发出怪声
sense_groups.english: And Monica, with that snort when she laughs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说那到底是怎么一回事？
sense_groups.english: I mean, what the hell is that thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我接受那些缺点 为什么你们不接受这样的我？
sense_groups.english: I accept all those flaws. Why can't you accept me for this?

sense_groups.chinese: 按压手指会困扰大家 还是只有他？
sense_groups.english: Does the knuckle-cracking bother everybody, or just him?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有它 我可以过得更好
sense_groups.english: ...I could live without it.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有点讨厌或跟菲比咬头发一样？
sense_groups.english: Well, is it, like, a little annoying? Or is it like when Phoebe chews her hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别听他的 菲比 好吗？我觉得那很可爱
sense_groups.english: Now, don't listen to him, Pheebs, all right? I think it's endearing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you do, do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 发音标准不是件坏事
sense_groups.english: You know, there's nothing wrong with speaking correctly.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Indeed there isn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该回去工作了
sense_groups.english: I should really get back to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然有人会拿到他们点的东西
sense_groups.english: Yeah, otherwise someone might get what they actually ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 真相大白 有人说了实话
sense_groups.english: Oh. The hair comes out and the gloves come off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟你朋友喜欢的男人约过会吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you ever go out with a guy your friends all really like?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我朋友真的喜欢跟我约会的男人
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, I'm going out with a guy my friends all really like.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指那些土狼吗？
sense_groups.english: We talking about the coyotes here?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 有只牛逃过一劫
sense_groups.english: Heh. All right. A cow got through.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe it?

sense_groups.chinese: 那像是… 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: It's just, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点感觉都没有
sense_groups.english: I just don't feel the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们感觉很棒 我一点感觉都没有
sense_groups.english: I mean, they feel the thing. I don't feel the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你应该一直…
sense_groups.english: Honey, you should always...

sense_groups.chinese: 都有感觉的
sense_groups.english: ...feel the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 如果那是你对那家伙的感觉 摩妮卡 甩掉他
sense_groups.english: Listen, if that's how you feel about the guy, Monica, dump him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 那真的很难
sense_groups.english: I know, it's just gonna be really hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是大人了 他会释怀的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's a big boy. He'll get over it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他会没事的 我担心其他五个人
sense_groups.english: No, he'll be fine. It's the other five I'm worried about.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尊重你的身体吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have any respect for your body?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你对自己做了什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't you realize what you're doing to yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有了你们跟癌症
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know, I've had it with you and your cancer...

sense_groups.chinese: 肺气肿及心脏病
sense_groups.english: ...and your emphysema and your heart disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 抽烟很酷 你们知道的
sense_groups.english: The bottom line is, smoking is cool, and you know it.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 是亚伦 他要跟你说话
sense_groups.english: It's Alan. He wants to speak to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really? He does?

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, buddy. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟你说了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, she told you about that, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我偶尔会抽 对 我正在抽
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah. I have one now and then. Well, yeah, now.

sense_groups.chinese: 没那么糟糕
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not that bad...

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Well, that's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 没有人那么跟我说过
sense_groups.english: Gee, you know, no one's ever put it like that before.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Well, okay. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他真的很厉害
sense_groups.english: God, he's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 可惜他不是女人
sense_groups.english: If only he were a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 羊排
sense_groups.english: Oh, Lamb Chop.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只袜子有多旧了？
sense_groups.english: How old is that sock?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我手里存着袜子三十年 它也会说话
sense_groups.english: If I had a sock on my hand for 30 years, it'd be talking too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想有人该换尼古丁贴月了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think it's time to change somebody's nicotine patch.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊人呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊吃掉我最后一块口香糖 我杀了他
sense_groups.english: Joey ate my last stick of gum, so I killed him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得那是不对的吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think that was wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他在对面 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I think he's across the hall. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我开心得要命
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I'm alive with pleasure now.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你要吃剩下的果酱馅饼吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, you gonna have the rest of that Pop Tart?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要吃剩下的果酱馅饼？
sense_groups.english: Does anyone want the rest of this Pop Tart?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想吃
sense_groups.english: Hey, I might.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 汽水公司的人 要为拇指的事赔我七千块
sense_groups.english: You know, those stupid soda people gave me $7000 for the thumb.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 七千块？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Seven thousand dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 我到那里的路上踩到口香糖
sense_groups.english: And on my way over here, I stepped in gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个世界到底是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is up with the universe?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是想跟大家一起聚聚
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I just think it's nice when we're all here together.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果大家有时间穿内裤会更棒
sense_groups.english: It's even nicer when everyone gets to wear their underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey... - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 - 别这样
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 各位 我们得谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Please, guys, we have to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我有种似曾相识的感觉
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait. I'm getting a déjà vu.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想太多了
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们得谈一谈 - 这就对了
sense_groups.english: All right, we have to talk. - There it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这跟亚伦有关
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's about Alan.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该跟你们说一件事
sense_groups.english: There's something you should know.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 要这么说并不容易
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, there's really no easy way to say this. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定跟亚伦分手
sense_groups.english: I've decided to break up with Alan.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有了别人？
sense_groups.english: Is there somebody else?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那只是…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉会变 人是会变的
sense_groups.english: ...you know, things change. People change.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没变
sense_groups.english: We didn't change.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？一切结束了？
sense_groups.english: So that's it? It's over?

sense_groups.chinese: 就那样？
sense_groups.english: Just like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我好不容易打开心房
sense_groups.english: You know, you let your guard down.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的开始关心别人 我只是…
sense_groups.english: You know, you start to really care about someone, and I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我可以继续假装… - 好的
sense_groups.english: Look, I could go on pretending... - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那对我不公平
sense_groups.english: No. No, that wouldn't be fair to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 对亚伦或你们都不公平
sense_groups.english: ...it wouldn't be fair to Alan, or to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 谁要公平呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, who wants fair?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只希望一切回到从前
sense_groups.english: I mean, I just want things back, you know, the way they were.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 - 她觉得抱歉 我好过多了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - Oh, she's sorry. I feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I just can't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 快过节了 我要他跟我家人见面
sense_groups.english: I mean, with the holidays coming up. I wanted him to meet my family.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会认识别人的 还会有别的亚伦
sense_groups.english: I'll meet someone else. There'll be other Alans.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没事吧？ - 我们会没事的
sense_groups.english: Are you guys gonna be okay? - Hey, hey. We'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只需要一点时间
sense_groups.english: We're just gonna need a little time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解
sense_groups.english: I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 - 对 我是说我也有点抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm really sorry. - Yeah. I mean, I'm sorry too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说我是松了一口气
sense_groups.english: But I gotta tell you, I'm a little relieved.

sense_groups.chinese: 松了一口气？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Relieved? - Yeah, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你在一起 我很闹心
sense_groups.english: ...I mean, I had a great time with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受不了你的朋友们
sense_groups.english: I just can't stand your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我们到中央公园租船的事吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember when we went to Central Park and rented boats?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很好玩
sense_groups.english: That was fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他划起船来就像维京人
sense_groups.english: Yeah. He could row like a Viking.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So how'd it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道的 - 他有提到我们吗？
sense_groups.english: You know. - Did he mention us?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他会想念你们的
sense_groups.english: He says he's really gonna miss you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很不好过吧？
sense_groups.english: You had a rough day, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不会懂 - 过来
sense_groups.english: Oh, you have no idea. - Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我要抽烟 - 不…
sense_groups.english: That's it. I'm getting cigarettes. - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't care. I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 游戏结束 我得抽烟
sense_groups.english: Game's over. I'm weak. I've gotta smoke. I've gotta have the smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你不再抽烟 我给你七千块
sense_groups.english: If you never smoke again, I'll give you $7000.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right.
