sense_groups.english: It's because we... Sorry. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 桃子核
sense_groups.english: What? - Peach pit.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事 小伙子？
sense_groups.english: Yes, bunny?

sense_groups.chinese: 桃子核
sense_groups.english: Peach pit.

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚我们吃了… - 蜜桃？
sense_groups.english: That night, we, uh, had... - Peaches?

sense_groups.chinese: 是油桃才对 但基本上来说都一样
sense_groups.english: Actually, nectarines, but basically.

sense_groups.chinese: 算是蜜桃 - 然后我们…
sense_groups.english: Could've been a peach. - Then we, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们穿好衣服 我陪她走到...
sense_groups.english: Then we got dressed and I walked her to...

sense_groups.chinese: 公车站
sense_groups.english: ...the bus stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那女人的屁股跟卡萝很像
sense_groups.english: Hey, that woman's got an ass like Carol's.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我以为我们在找跟她有关的东西
sense_groups.english: What? I thought we were trying to find stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 各位 告诉我所有的八卦消息
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, you guys. Tell me all the dirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 最大的八卦消息 还是你在婚礼上甩了贝瑞
sense_groups.english: Well, the biggest news is still you dumping Barry at the altar.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 来谈一下现实问题 - 好的
sense_groups.english: All right, let's talk reality for a second. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何时要回家？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: When are you coming home? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 我不回家了
sense_groups.english: Guys, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你是在跟我们说 - 我不回家了
sense_groups.english: Heh. Come on. This is us. - I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我现在的生活 我找到这份工作
sense_groups.english: This is what I'm doing now. I've got this job.

sense_groups.chinese: 当服务生？
sense_groups.english: Waitressing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不只是当服务生
sense_groups.english: Heh. I'm not just waitressing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: I, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在特养公告栏写特餐消息
sense_groups.english: I write the specials on the specials board.

sense_groups.chinese: 将枯掉的花从花瓶拿出来
sense_groups.english: And I take the dead flowers out of the vase.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候阿杜洛会让我将小巧克力块放在饼干上
sense_groups.english: Um, and sometimes Arturo lets me put the little chocolate blobbies on the cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈妈没跟我们提小巧克力块的事
sense_groups.english: Well, your mom didn't tell us about the blobbies.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你跟你的朋友聊得还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. How was it with your friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 你要喝点鸡尾酒吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, how would you like some Tiki Death Punch?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我加了兰姆酒跟… - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, it's rum and... - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想既然菲比要留下来过夜 我们要办个睡衣派对
sense_groups.english: We thought since Phoebe's staying over we'd have a slumber party.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们买了八卦杂志 还有饼干跟扭扭乐
sense_groups.english: We got some trashy magazines, we got cookie dough, we got Twister.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带了手术游戏来
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh. And I brought Operation.

sense_groups.chinese: 但镊子不见了 没办法动手术
sense_groups.english: But I lost the tweezers, so we can't operate.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们能帮病人做准备
sense_groups.english: But we can prep the guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 是信用卡公司打来的
sense_groups.english: Rach, it's the Visa-card people.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 问他们想干什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Ask them what they want.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问有何贵事吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you please tell me what this is in reference to?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 请稍等
sense_groups.english: Yes, hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说你的帐户有异常活动
sense_groups.english: Um, they say there's been unusual activity on your account.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我好几个星期没刷卡了 - 那就是异常活动
sense_groups.english: But I haven't used my card in weeks. - That is the unusual activity.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们只想知道你是否没事
sense_groups.english: They just wanna see if you're okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们想知道我是否没事？
sense_groups.english: They wanna know if I'm okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他们想知道我是否没事 让我想一想
sense_groups.english: Okay, they wanna know if I'm okay. Okay, let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我想一想 社会安全税拿走我所有的钱
sense_groups.english: Well, let's see. The FICA guys took all my money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认识的人不是结婚 怀孕就是升官了
sense_groups.english: Everyone I know is either getting married or getting pregnant or getting promoted...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在端咖啡
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm getting coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是我要喝的咖啡
sense_groups.english: And it's not even for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那听起来像是我很好 跟他们说我很好 好吗？
sense_groups.english: So if that sounds like I'm okay, okay, then you can tell them I'm okay. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋不在
sense_groups.english: Uh, Rachel has left the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能再打来吗？ - 好了 来吧
sense_groups.english: Can you call back? - All right. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来玩扭扭乐
sense_groups.english: Let's play Twister.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: Sorry. - Sorry, sorry, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你那晚跟卡萝也看到冰了吗？
sense_groups.english: What? There was ice there that night with Carol?

sense_groups.chinese: 塑胶椅？四千名愤怒的匹兹堡球迷？
sense_groups.english: Plastic seats? Four thousand angry Pittsburgh fans?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说看起来 我们没办法坐在一起
sense_groups.english: No, actually, I was just saying it looks like we're not sitting together.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你都提起了 那晚的确跟冰有关系
sense_groups.english: But now that you mention it, there was ice there that night.

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚是初霜
sense_groups.english: It was the first frost.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们… - 坐吧 快点
sense_groups.english: We were... - Sit. Just sit down. Sit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该觉得很棒
sense_groups.english: You should feel great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在独立过生活
sense_groups.english: You're doing this amazing independent thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 那有什么好的？
sense_groups.english: Monica, what is so amazing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃了一切 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I gave up like everything. And for what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟杰克一样？
sense_groups.english: You are just like Jack.

sense_groups.chinese: 楼下的杰克？
sense_groups.english: Jack from downstairs?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 《杰克与魔豆》
sense_groups.english: No, Jack and the Beanstalk.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一个杰克 - 对
sense_groups.english: Ah, the other Jack. - Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 他放弃一些事 得到魔豆
sense_groups.english: See, he gave up something, but then he got those magic beans.

sense_groups.chinese: 他醒过来 看到一大棵植物
sense_groups.english: And then he woke up and there was this big plant...

sense_groups.chinese: 在他家窗户外面 充满了无限的可能性
sense_groups.english: ...outside of his window, full of possibilities and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 他住在小村子里 你住在村区
sense_groups.english: And he lived in a village, and you live in the Village.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 杰克放弃一头牛
sense_groups.english: Okay, but, Pheebs, Pheebs, Jack gave up a cow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃一位牙齿矫正师
sense_groups.english: I gave up an orthodontist.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我知道我不爱他 可是…
sense_groups.english: Okay, I know I didn't love him, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 杰克爱那头牛
sense_groups.english: Oh, see, Jack did love the cow.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的计划 你知道吗？一切是那么清楚
sense_groups.english: But, see, it was a plan, you know? It was clear.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都已经安排好了 现在是…
sense_groups.english: Everything was figured out, and now everything's just kind of like...

sense_groups.chinese: 一片混乱？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Flupie? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是你 我们也不知道自己要做什么
sense_groups.english: You're not the only one. We don't know where we're going.

sense_groups.chinese: 终有一天你会知道 情况会变得清楚
sense_groups.english: You gotta figure, at some point, it's gonna come together...

sense_groups.chinese: 不再混乱
sense_groups.english: ...and it's just gonna be "unflupie."

sense_groups.chinese: 对 才没有那个字
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like that's a word.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 摩妮卡 如果情况不会好转呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, but, Monica, what if it doesn't come together?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你… 我不喜欢这个问题
sense_groups.english: Well, because you just... I don't like this question.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 如果我们找不到魔豆呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, see? See, you guys? What if we don't get magic beans?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说如果我们只有...
sense_groups.english: I mean, what if all we've got are...

sense_groups.chinese: 一般的豆子呢？
sense_groups.english: ...beans?

sense_groups.chinese: 给他好看
sense_groups.english: Get him! Get him! Get him!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你笑不出来了吧？兄弟
sense_groups.english: Get... Yes! You're not laughing now, are you, pal?

sense_groups.chinese: 那能治好你的忧郁 几个没牙的家伙拿着球棍互打
sense_groups.english: That's all you need, a bunch of toothless guys hitting each other with sticks.

sense_groups.chinese: 传球
sense_groups.english: Pass it. Pass it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有空档 射门
sense_groups.english: He's open, he's open. Shoot it, shoot it, shoot it!

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 噢 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Oh. - Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我们上大银幕了 - 噢…
sense_groups.english: Hey, look, we're on that TV thing. - Ooh, ooh, ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我接到球了 - 我们接到球了
sense_groups.english: I got it! - Hey, hey, we got it! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面说对糖果棒不满意 可以打这个电话号码
sense_groups.english: It says to call this number if you're not completely satisfied with this candy bar.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不满意
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not completely satisfied.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 这是紧急情况
sense_groups.english: Listen, it's kind of an emergency.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你应该知道 不然我们应该是在危机室
sense_groups.english: I guess you'd know that, or we'd be in the predicament room.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 填好表格 坐在那边等
sense_groups.english: Hold on. Fill these out. Sit over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我不想麻烦你
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't wanna make any trouble, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的很痛 我毁容了
sense_groups.english: But I'm in a lot of pain here, all right? My face is dented.

sense_groups.chinese: 你必须排队等 - 你觉得我们得等多久？
sense_groups.english: Well, you'll have to wait your turn. - Well, how long do you think it'll be?

sense_groups.chinese: 随时都会轮到你们
sense_groups.english: Any minute now.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着…
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen... Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我醒过来 开始哭泣
sense_groups.english: I wake up and I start to cry

sense_groups.chinese: 并不希望…
sense_groups.english: Ain't no hope in...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我无意拉你们下水
sense_groups.english: Oh. I'm so sorry, you guys. I didn't mean to bring you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你说的对
sense_groups.english: No, you were right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有计划
sense_groups.english: I don't have a plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨送来了
sense_groups.english: Pizza guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地 - 食物
sense_groups.english: Thank God. - Food.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有计划？ - 我什么都没有
sense_groups.english: Do you have a plan? - I don't even have a "plan".

sense_groups.chinese: 一份蘑菇青椒洋葱披萨？
sense_groups.english: Hi. One mushroom, green pepper and onion?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那不是我们点的披萨
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. That's not what we ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们点了脱脂面皮 多加了起司的披萨
sense_groups.english: We ordered a fat-free crust with extra cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是史帝芬洛普诺斯？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Wait, you're not G. Stephanopoulos? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我爸会杀了我 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. My dad's gonna kill me. - Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说史帝芬洛普诺斯吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you say G. Stephanopoulos?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这是对街订的披萨 我一定把你们的披萨给了他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, this one goes across the street. I must have given him yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 大笨蛋
sense_groups.english: Oh, bonehead. Bonehead.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 他是矮小的地中海裔人 看起来很聪明？
sense_groups.english: Wait, was this a small Mediterranean guy with curiously intelligent good looks?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他就是长那个样子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that sounds about right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他穿着亮蓝色衬衫？ - 打着显眼的领带？
sense_groups.english: Was he wearing a stunning blue suit? - And a power tie?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他只围了一条浴巾
sense_groups.english: No, pretty much just a towel.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. - Oh. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 你们要我把这个拿回去吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - You want me to take this back?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你疯了吗？这是乔治•史帝芬洛普诺斯的披萨
sense_groups.english: What? Are you nuts? We've got George Stephanopoulos' pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是乔治•史帝芬洛普诺斯？
sense_groups.english: Who's George Snuffleupagus?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是大鸟的朋友
sense_groups.english: That's Big Bird's friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到披萨了
sense_groups.english: I see pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要看 让我看看
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wanna see. Let me see. Let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在偷看谁？
sense_groups.english: Hello? Who are we spying on?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道白宫顾问吗？柯林顿的竞选总干事？
sense_groups.english: You know the White House adviser? Clinton's campaign guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个发型帅气 笑容性感 屁股很可爱的帅哥？
sense_groups.english: The one with the great hair, sexy smile, really cute butt?

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是他 那个小矮子 我爱他
sense_groups.english: Oh, him. The little guy. Oh, I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我看到一个女人
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Oh, wait. Wait, I see a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我说那是他妈妈
sense_groups.english: Tell me it's his mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对不是他妈妈 - 不
sense_groups.english: Definitely not his mother. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 她走到对面
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, she's walking across the floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在走
sense_groups.english: She's walking, she's walking.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要去拿披萨 那不是给你吃的 臭女人
sense_groups.english: She's going for the pizza. Hey, that's not for you, bitch!

sense_groups.chinese: 麦斯医生请到中区456
sense_groups.english: Dr. Max to Center 456.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦斯医生请到中区456
sense_groups.english: Dr. Max to Center 456.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我们等了一个小时
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. We've been here for over an hour...

sense_groups.chinese: 没我朋友严重的人都进去了
sense_groups.english: ...and people less sick than my friend have gone in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是指脚趾有问题的家伙 他跟谁上床？
sense_groups.english: I mean, that guy with the toe thing? Who's he sleeping with?

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 朵拉 别生气
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Dora. Don't be mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我们都说了一些
sense_groups.english: I know we both said some things...

sense_groups.chinese: 无心之语
sense_groups.english: ...we didn't mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不代表我们不爱彼此
sense_groups.english: ...but that doesn't mean we still don't love each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我失去她了
sense_groups.english: You know, I feel like I've lost her.

sense_groups.chinese: 还没开灯？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Lights still out? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他们在睡觉
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe they're napping.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 他们在上床
sense_groups.english: Heh. Please. They're having sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得乔治是什么样的人？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you think George is like?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他应该很害羞 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: I think he's shy. - Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我想你得鼓励他
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I think you have to draw him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你那么做时 他会变成做好准备的野兽
sense_groups.english: And then when you do, he's a preppy animal.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得月光从打开的窗户洒了进来
sense_groups.english: I remember the moonlight coming in through the open window...

sense_groups.chinese: 她的脸闪闪发光 美极了
sense_groups.english: ...and her face had the most incredible glow.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 月光 发光 神奇的感觉
sense_groups.english: Yes, the moon, the glow, the magical feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 这部分你说过了
sense_groups.english: You did this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托送点止痛药过来
sense_groups.english: Could I get some painkillers over here, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说的对 够了 今天有什么大不了的？
sense_groups.english: He's right, enough already. What is the big deal about today?

sense_groups.chinese: 你第一次跟她上床 那有什么大不了的？
sense_groups.english: So you slept with her for the first time. So what?

sense_groups.chinese: 之后你跟她睡了七年
sense_groups.english: You slept with her for seven years after that.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况比你说的复杂
sense_groups.english: It's just a little more complicated than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？怎么了？她离开你？她喜欢女人？
sense_groups.english: What? What is it? That she left you? That she likes women?

sense_groups.chinese: 她为了喜欢女人的女人离开你？
sense_groups.english: That she left you for a woman that likes women?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以再大声一点
sense_groups.english: A little louder.

sense_groups.chinese: 12楼陷入昏迷的病人 没听到你在说什么
sense_groups.english: There's a man on the 12th floor in a coma who didn't quite hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Then what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟卡萝的第一次是…
sense_groups.english: My first time with Carol was...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的…

sense_groups.english: I've been talking about myself all night long. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？告诉我你的故事
sense_groups.english: What about you? Tell me your stories.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 有一次…
sense_groups.english: All right, once...

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次我去搭地铁
sense_groups.english: ...once I got on the subway, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那时很晚了…
sense_groups.english: And it was at night...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直坐到布鲁克林站…
sense_groups.english: ...and I rode it all the way to Brooklyn...

sense_groups.chinese: 只为了好玩
sense_groups.english: ...just for the hell of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们聊到两点 实在是完美的夜晚
sense_groups.english: We talked till 2. It was this perfect evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 多多少少啦
sense_groups.english: More or less.

sense_groups.chinese: 突然问 我们发现自己身处叶门
sense_groups.english: Suddenly, we realized we were in Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 谁是我们…？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, so "we" is?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是我和瑞克
sense_groups.english: "We" is me and Rick.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是瑞克？ - 谁是瑞克？
sense_groups.english: Who's Rick? - Who's Rick?

sense_groups.chinese: 我先生
sense_groups.english: My husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 所以你离婚了？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Oh, so you're divorced? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 所以你在守寡吗？希望如此
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. So you're widowed? Hopefully?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我还是有夫之妇
sense_groups.english: No, I'm still married.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你先生对于你在这里 有什么想法？
sense_groups.english: So how would your husband feel about you sitting here with me...

sense_groups.chinese: 还把脚滑到我的脚上面…
sense_groups.english: ...sliding your foot so far up my leg...

sense_groups.chinese: 连口袋里有多少零钱 都数得出来
sense_groups.english: ...you can count the change in my pocket?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心
sense_groups.english: Don't worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说他应该不会介意 因为他也没有太介意伊森
sense_groups.english: I imagine he'd be okay with you because he's okay with Ethan.

sense_groups.chinese: 伊森？谁是伊森？
sense_groups.english: Ethan? There's an Ethan?

sense_groups.chinese: 伊森是我的…
sense_groups.english: Ethan is my...

sense_groups.chinese: 男朋友
sense_groups.english: ...boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我解释一下 竟然你已经有丈夫跟男友了
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what kind of relationship do you imagine us having...

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望我们会有什么样的关系？
sense_groups.english: ...if you already have a husband and a boyfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想主要是性关系吧
sense_groups.english: I suppose, mainly sexual.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾没有成功
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry it didn't work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么没有成功？我星期四还会再跟她见面
sense_groups.english: What not work out? I'm seeing her again on Thursday.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有听到我说的故事吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you listen to the story?

sense_groups.chinese: 太诡异了 你怎么可以 跟这样的女人交往？
sense_groups.english: How could you get involved with a woman like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一开始也很难接受 但是想想其实百益无一害
sense_groups.english: I had trouble with it at first, but I get all the good stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要谈天说笑 还有性…
sense_groups.english: All the fun, all the talking, all the sex...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不用负责任
sense_groups.english: ...and no responsibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可是每个男人的梦想
sense_groups.english: This is every guy's fantasy!

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是 罗斯 这是你的梦想吗？
sense_groups.english: That is not true. Ross, is this your fantasy?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是
sense_groups.english: No, of course not.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们不介意 跟有其他伴侣的女性交往？
sense_groups.english: You'd go out with someone else who's going out with someone else?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做不到
sense_groups.english: I couldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和女性交往时 我必须知道…
sense_groups.english: When I'm with a woman, I need to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我交往的人 比她还多
sense_groups.english: ...that I'm going out with more people than she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 一夫一妻
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 确实值得商榷
sense_groups.english: ...monogamy can be a tricky concept.

sense_groups.chinese: 就人类学上的角度来说…
sense_groups.english: I mean, anthropologically...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们永远都不会知道了
sense_groups.english: Fine. Now you'll never know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是开玩笑啦 说吧
sense_groups.english: We're kidding. Tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都想知道 - 说啦
sense_groups.english: We wanna know. - Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 理查•李基有一个理论…
sense_groups.english: All right. There's a theory put forth by Richard Leakey...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗒哒
sense_groups.english: Ta-da!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以后都要用这样的方式打招呼吗？我还挺喜欢的
sense_groups.english: Are we greeting each other this way now? I like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 我打扫了
sense_groups.english: Look! I cleaned!

sense_groups.chinese: 我擦了窗户 地板
sense_groups.english: I did the windows. I did the floors.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还用了吸尘器所有的接头 除了圆的那一个
sense_groups.english: I used all the attachments on the vacuum except for that round one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道那是用来做什么的
sense_groups.english: I don't know what it's for.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人知道 我们也不该问
sense_groups.english: Nobody knows, and we're not supposed to ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 很干净 - 真的 很棒
sense_groups.english: It's very clean. - Really, it looks great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到你移动了绿色的垫椅
sense_groups.english: Oh. Heh. I see you moved the green ottoman.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哦
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是怎么发生的？
sense_groups.english: How did that happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道啊 我觉得放那边比较好看
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I thought it looked better there.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且茶几旁边 也多一个座位
sense_groups.english: And also, it's an extra seat around the coffee table.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 是蛮有趣的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了 只是好玩…
sense_groups.english: But you know what? Just for fun...

sense_groups.chinese: 看看放在原本的位置会如何
sense_groups.english: ...let's see what it looked like in the old spot.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是比较一下
sense_groups.english: Just to compare.

sense_groups.chinese: 看一下
sense_groups.english: Let's see. Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 放在这里 也很棒
sense_groups.english: Well, it looks good there too.

sense_groups.chinese: 先摆在这里吧
sense_groups.english: Let's leave it there for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信你试着搬动那个绿色的垫椅
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you tried to move the green ottoman.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好你没摊开杂志
sense_groups.english: Thank God you didn't fan out the magazines.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然她会把你的眼睛挖出来
sense_groups.english: She'll scratch your eyes out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有那么糟糕吧？
sense_groups.english: You guys, I am not that bad!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得我跟你住在一起过吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember, I lived with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是一副…
sense_groups.english: You were a little, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样说超不公平的
sense_groups.english: That is so unfair!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我们小时候 你的破娃娃是唯一不破的
sense_groups.english: When we were kids, yours was the only Raggedy Ann doll that wasn't raggedy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我比较有责任心 有组织性
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I'm responsible. I'm organized.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我也能很懒散
sense_groups.english: But, hey, I can be a kook!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 懒女人
sense_groups.english: All right, you madcap gal!

sense_groups.chinese: 想像这个情况
sense_groups.english: Try to imagine this.

sense_groups.chinese: 电话帐单寄来了 但是你没有立刻付费
sense_groups.english: The phone bill arrives, but you don't pay it right away.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么没有？ - 因为你很懒散
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because you're a kook!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你等到他们再寄一张通知给你
sense_groups.english: Instead, you wait until they send you a notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做得到
sense_groups.english: I could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你让我去买…
sense_groups.english: Okay, then you let me go grocery shopping...

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了洗衣精
sense_groups.english: ...and I buy laundry detergent.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不是容易挤出来的那种
sense_groups.english: But it's not the one with the easy-pour spout.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会有人这么做？
sense_groups.english: Why would someone do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人会这样想
sense_groups.english: One might wonder.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人把杯子放在茶几上 没有杯垫
sense_groups.english: A glass is on the table. There's no coaster.

sense_groups.chinese: 是一杯冷饮 在大热天之下
sense_groups.english: It's a cold drink. It's a hot day.

sense_groups.chinese: 小水珠逐渐逼近桌面…
sense_groups.english: Beads of condensation are inching their way closer to the wood...

sense_groups.chinese: 不要说了
sense_groups.english: Stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的 我是什么样的人？
sense_groups.english: It's true. Who am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你是妈妈
sense_groups.english: Monica, you're Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会去的
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚是我经纪人
sense_groups.english: That was my agent.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的经纪人帮我安排在阿尔•帕西诺的新片中演出
sense_groups.english: My agent has just gotten me a job in the new Al Pacino movie!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Whoa! That's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么角色？
sense_groups.english: What's the part?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能相信吗？是阿尔•帕西诺耶
sense_groups.english: Can you believe this? Al Pacino!

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我成为演员的原因
sense_groups.english: This guy's why I became an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: "我失控？你才失控"
sense_groups.english: "I'm out of order? You're out of order!

sense_groups.chinese: "这整个法庭都失控了"
sense_groups.english: This whole courtroom's out of order!"

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 是什么角色？
sense_groups.english: Seriously, what's the part?

sense_groups.chinese: "当我以为已经出局时 他们又把我拉回"
sense_groups.english: "Just when I thought I was out, they pull me back in!"

sense_groups.chinese: 快点说啦 乔伊 是什么角色？
sense_groups.english: Come on. Seriously, Joey, what's the part?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是…什么？
sense_groups.english: You're, you're... What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是他屁股的替身 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm his butt double, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我饰演阿尔•帕西诺的屁股
sense_groups.english: I play Al Pacino's butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？他开始冲澡…
sense_groups.english: All right? He goes into the shower, and then...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就演他的屁股
sense_groups.english: ...I'm his butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们别这样
sense_groups.english: Come on, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是部阿尔•帕西诺主演 大制作的电影
sense_groups.english: This is a real movie, and Al Pacino's in it and that's big!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, it's terrific.

sense_groups.chinese: 你努力了这么多年…
sense_groups.english: After all your years of struggling...

sense_groups.chinese: 终于有机会挤进娱乐圈了
sense_groups.english: ...you've finally been able to crack your way into show business.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们尽量开玩笑 我才不在乎
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. Make jokes, I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的一大突破
sense_groups.english: This is a big break for me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得没错
sense_groups.english: You're right. It is.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你要请我们去看屁股首映会吗？
sense_groups.english: So are you gonna invite us all to the big opening?

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要借点润肤霜 - 干嘛用的？
sense_groups.english: I need to borrow some moisturizer. - For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说呢？今天是大日子
sense_groups.english: What do you think? Today's the big day!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 去厕所 想用什么都可以
sense_groups.english: Okay, go into the bathroom. Use whatever you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要别跟我说 你在里面做了什么
sense_groups.english: Just don't ever tell me what you did in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的妈妈打来 - 他在厕所
sense_groups.english: Joey's mom's on the phone. - He's in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想进去的 - 拜托 我们是室友耶
sense_groups.english: You don't wanna go in there! - Come on, we're roommates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的眼睛啊…
sense_groups.english: My eyes! My eyes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我警告过你了
sense_groups.english: I warned you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁这么吵？
sense_groups.english: Who is being loud?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, that would be Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我可以借点东西吗？我想煮早餐给欧若拉吃
sense_groups.english: Can I borrow some things? I wanna make Aurora breakfast.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你有整夜的时间能陪她？
sense_groups.english: You got the whole night, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我只有二十分钟 直到伊森…
sense_groups.english: Well, I only have 20 minutes until Ethan, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 有人有点哀怨喔？
sense_groups.english: Do I sense a bit of resentment?

sense_groups.chinese: 不…没有哀怨 相信我…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. No resentment. Believe me...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很值得
sense_groups.english: ...it's worth it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 在感情关系中 总是有些特别难忘的时刻
sense_groups.english: In a relationship, you have these key moments...

sense_groups.chinese: 让你一辈子都会记得
sense_groups.english: ...you'll remember for the rest of your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟欧若拉在一起的每分每秒都像那样
sense_groups.english: Well, every single second is like that with Aurora.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我刚刚浪费了三十五秒的时间跟你们说话
sense_groups.english: And I've just wasted 35 of them talking to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你可以帮我开门吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Monica, can you help me with the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 以前的摩妮卡会提醒你…
sense_groups.english: Um, Chandler, you know, the old Monica would remind you...

sense_groups.chinese: 用塑胶刷 刷洗锅子
sense_groups.english: ...to scrub that Teflon pan with a plastic brush.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不会那么做
sense_groups.english: But I'm not gonna do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 就聘请她
sense_groups.english: Damn it! Hire the girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家准备好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, everybody ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我只想谢谢你 给我这么好的机会
sense_groups.english: Uh, listen, I just wanna thank you for this great opportunity.

sense_groups.chinese: 脱掉浴袍
sense_groups.english: Lose the robe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我脱？
sense_groups.english: Me?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样才拍得成
sense_groups.english: That would work.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 解开浴袍中
sense_groups.english: Right. Okay. Losing the robe!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 浴袍脱完了
sense_groups.english: Okay, and the robe is lost.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 我想要一次就拍好
sense_groups.english: Everybody, I would like to get this in one take.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Let's roll it.

sense_groups.chinese: 开水
sense_groups.english: Water's working.

sense_groups.chinese: 开拍
sense_groups.english: And action!

sense_groups.chinese: 卡
sense_groups.english: And cut!

sense_groups.chinese: 屁股男 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Butt guy, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在冲澡
sense_groups.english: I'm showering.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你在挤屁股
sense_groups.english: No, that was clenching.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的想法是 这个家伙很难过
sense_groups.english: Well, the way I see it, the guy's upset here, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 他老婆死了 哥哥又失踪
sense_groups.english: His wife's dead, his brother's missing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的屁股这时候 应该会很生气
sense_groups.english: I think his butt would be angry here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为他的屁股会想在午餐前拍好
sense_groups.english: I think his butt would like to get the shot before lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来一次 开水
sense_groups.english: Once again, rolling. Water working.

sense_groups.chinese: 开拍
sense_groups.english: And action!

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 又怎么了？
sense_groups.english: And cut! What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想表现出沉静的绝望
sense_groups.english: I was going for quiet desperation.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你想问…
sense_groups.english: But if you have to ask...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我好爱这些手指
sense_groups.english: God, I love these fingers.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我其实是指我的手指
sense_groups.english: No, actually, I meant my fingers.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看它们有多开心
sense_groups.english: Look at them. Look at how happy they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我迟到了 - 不要…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I'm late! - Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要走 - 好
sense_groups.english: Don't go, don't go. - Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的得走 - 她要走了
sense_groups.english: I have to. - Look, she's leaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 他会等我
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. He'll be waiting for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你跟瑞克谈过了
sense_groups.english: I thought you talked to Rick.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是瑞克
sense_groups.english: It's not Rick.

sense_groups.chinese: 伊森？他可以陪你一整天的时间
sense_groups.english: Ethan? He gets the whole day with you!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是安德鲁
sense_groups.english: No, it's Andrew.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道会有好几年的时间…
sense_groups.english: I know there'll be many moments...

sense_groups.chinese: 我将后悔问你以下的问题 但是…
sense_groups.english: ...when I'll regret asking the following question, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 安德鲁是谁？
sense_groups.english: And Andrew is?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是…新欢
sense_groups.english: He's... new.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说瑞克 伊森和我 无法满足你？
sense_groups.english: So you're not completely fulfilled by Rick, Ethan and myself?

sense_groups.chinese: 我并不是…
sense_groups.english: No, that's not exactly what I was...

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道有多少女人…
sense_groups.english: Most women would kill...

sense_groups.chinese: 会被我们三个人迷倒
sense_groups.english: ...for three guys like us.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你想要什么？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you want?

sense_groups.chinese: 你
sense_groups.english: You.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经有我了 - 不 只是你
sense_groups.english: You have me. - No, no. Just you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 甩掉其他人
sense_groups.english: Lose the other guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们所有人吗？
sense_groups.english: Like, all of them?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我们在一起很开心 为什么不行？
sense_groups.english: Come on, we're great together. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不能保持这样就好？
sense_groups.english: Why can't we just have what we have now?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要谈天说笑跟性…
sense_groups.english: Why can't we just talk, laugh and make love...

sense_groups.chinese: 彼此没有任何负担？
sense_groups.english: ...without feeling obligated to one another?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚之前 我以为这也是你想要的
sense_groups.english: Up until tonight, I thought that's what you wanted too.

sense_groups.chinese: 部分的我想要…
sense_groups.english: Well, part of me wants that...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我就像个双面人
sense_groups.english: ...but it's like I'm two guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 其中一个说 "闭嘴 这样很棒"
sense_groups.english: I mean, one guy's saying, "Shut up! This is great!"

sense_groups.chinese: 但还有另一个人
sense_groups.english: But there's this other guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他每次都会挺身而出…
sense_groups.english: It's the guy who wells up every time the Grinch's heart...

sense_groups.chinese: 仗义直言
sense_groups.english: ...grows three sizes and breaks that measuring device.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会说 "这太难了 快点脱身"
sense_groups.english: He's saying, you know, "This is too hard. Get out, get out!"

sense_groups.chinese: 那你会听哪个人的话？
sense_groups.english: So which one of the two guys will you listen to?

sense_groups.chinese: 两个人的话我都听 他们一直插嘴
sense_groups.english: I have to listen to both. They don't let each other finish.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个人？
sense_groups.english: Which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 第二个
sense_groups.english: The second guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了
sense_groups.english: I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果改变心意 就打给我
sense_groups.english: Call me if you change your mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 第一个人主管嘴唇
sense_groups.english: Sorry, the first guy runs the lips.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样想吧 是你甩了她
sense_groups.english: Look at it this way. You dumped her!

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？这个女生…
sense_groups.english: Right? I mean, this woman was...

sense_groups.chinese: 超级性感…
sense_groups.english: ...unbelievably sexy...

sense_groups.chinese: 又美丽 聪明 超难追…
sense_groups.english: ...and beautiful, intelligent, unattainable...

sense_groups.chinese: 再说一次你为什么这么做
sense_groups.english: Tell me why you did this again?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 电影明星来了
sense_groups.english: Movie star!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是那个在阿尔•帕西诺的新片中饰演屁股的人吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you the guy who plays the butt in the new Al Pacino movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是？怎么了 大家伙？
sense_groups.english: No? What happened, big guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家伙？
sense_groups.english: Big guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是突然想这么说嘛
sense_groups.english: It felt like a "big guy" moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被炒鱿鱼了
sense_groups.english: I got fired!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说我太投入了
sense_groups.english: They said I acted too much with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我到处宣扬
sense_groups.english: I told everybody about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在大家都会到戏院 想看我演…
sense_groups.english: Everybody will be expecting to see me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 没有人看得出来的
sense_groups.english: You know what? No one will be able to tell.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈会
sense_groups.english: My mom will.

sense_groups.chinese: 这听起来很甜蜜…
sense_groups.english: There's something so sweet...

sense_groups.chinese: 却又很恶心
sense_groups.english: ...and disturbing about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 六年来 我一直在演烂戏…
sense_groups.english: I've done nothing but crappy plays for six years...

sense_groups.chinese: 终于有机会了 却被我搞砸
sense_groups.english: ...and I finally get my shot, and I blow it!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这不是你的机会
sense_groups.english: Maybe this wasn't your shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得当机会真的来临 你就会知道
sense_groups.english: I think when it's your shot, you know it's your shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉像是你的机会吗？
sense_groups.english: Did it feel like your shot?

sense_groups.chinese: 很难说 我当时光着身体
sense_groups.english: Hard to tell. I was naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认为这是你的机会
sense_groups.english: I don't think this was your shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至不认为 你只会有一个机会
sense_groups.english: I don't even think you just get one shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的相信 你会有一番作为
sense_groups.english: I really believe big things are gonna happen for you. I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要想说有一天 有个小孩会说…
sense_groups.english: You've gotta keep thinking about the day that some kid will go...

sense_groups.chinese: "我拿到角色了 我要演乔伊•崔比亚尼的屁股"
sense_groups.english: ..."I got the part! I'm gonna be Joey Tribbiani's ass!"

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？你真贴心
sense_groups.english: You think? That's so nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 乔伊 我要去睡觉了 各位
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Joey. I'm gonna go to bed, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要把你的鞋子留在这里吗？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna leave your shoes out here?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？就这样乱丢…
sense_groups.english: Really? Just casually strewn about...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全都不整齐？
sense_groups.english: ...in that reckless, haphazard manner?

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓 我明天再收拾 或者是改天
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter. I'll get them tomorrow. Or not!

sense_groups.chinese: 随便啦
sense_groups.english: Whenever.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很懒
sense_groups.english: She is a kook.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你这么心烦 就去把鞋子收好
sense_groups.english: If it bothers you that much, just go out and get the shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不要去
sense_groups.english: No, don't do this!

sense_groups.chinese: 太蠢了
sense_groups.english: This is stupid!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要证明任何事 我要去收拾
sense_groups.english: I don't have to prove anything. I'm gonna go get them.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是这样 大家都会知道
sense_groups.english: But then everyone will know.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非收好后 早上早点起来再放回去
sense_groups.english: Unless I get them, and then wake up really early and put them back.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁来帮帮我啊
sense_groups.english: I need help!

sense_groups.chinese: 她说的对 她是吉儿 吉儿•古德克
sense_groups.english: She's right. It's Jill. Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟吉儿•古德克被困在提款机的门廊里
sense_groups.english: I am trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是提款机的门廊吗？或许是提款机的中庭才对
sense_groups.english: Is it a vestibule? Maybe it's an atrium?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那才是重点 白痴
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that is the part to focus on, you idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 我被困在提款机的门廊里
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm fine. I'm just stuck at the bank in an ATM vestibule.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿说这是门廊
sense_groups.english: Jill says vestibule...

sense_groups.chinese: 我投门廊一票
sense_groups.english: ...I'm going with vestibule.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是一个人
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 一个男人
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Some guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 一个男人 我是一个男人
sense_groups.english: Oh, some guy. I am some guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿 昨晚我看到你跟一个男人在一起
sense_groups.english: Hey, Jill, I saw you with some guy last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是一个男的
sense_groups.english: Yes, he was some guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们
sense_groups.english: Hey, everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 主持今晚停电仪式的是 崔比亚尼祭司
sense_groups.english: Officiating at tonight's blackout is Rabbi Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德的前任室友是犹太人 我们只有这些蜡烛
sense_groups.english: Chandler's old roommate was Jewish, and these are the only candles we have...

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节快乐
sense_groups.english: ...so happy Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 丑裸男点了一堆蜡烛
sense_groups.english: Ooh, look. Ugly Naked Guy lit a bunch of candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那一定很痛
sense_groups.english: Ooh. That had to hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 已经过了十四分钟半
sense_groups.english: All right, all right. It's been 14 and a half minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 你一句话都没说 天啊
sense_groups.english: ...and you still haven't said one word. Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 快做点什么 跟她接触 笑一个
sense_groups.english: Do something. Just make contact. Smile.

sense_groups.chinese: 很不错
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你吓坏她了
sense_groups.english: You're definitely scaring her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要打电话吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, would you like to call somebody?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要打电话给三百位高中同学
sense_groups.english: Yeah, about 300 guys I went to high school with.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我 - 是钱德
sense_groups.english: It's me. - It's Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被困在提款机的门廊
sense_groups.english: I'm stuck in an ATM vestibule...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟吉儿•古德克在一起
sense_groups.english: ...with Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我被困在
sense_groups.english: I'm stuck...

sense_groups.chinese: 提款机的门廊
sense_groups.english: ...in an ATM vestibule...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟吉儿•古德克在一起
sense_groups.english: ...with Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全听不懂你在说什么
sense_groups.english: I have no idea what you said.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫乔伊来听电话
sense_groups.english: Put Joey on the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's up, man?

sense_groups.chinese: 我被困在
sense_groups.english: I'm stuck...

sense_groups.chinese: 提款机的门廊
sense_groups.english: ...in an ATM vestibule...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟吉儿•古德克在一起
sense_groups.english: ...with Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 他被困在提款机的门廊 跟吉儿•古德克在一起
sense_groups.english: He's trapped in an ATM vestibule with Jill Goodacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 听着
sense_groups.english: Chandler, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 别以为我没那种念头
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like that thought never entered my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 快一点
sense_groups.english: Come on, somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 轮到我了
sense_groups.english: I'll go. I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 大四那年在桌球台上
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, senior year of college, on a pool table.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 桌球台？
sense_groups.english: Ooh. - Pool table?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的好妹妹
sense_groups.english: That's my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最奇怪的地点是…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. My weirdest place would have to be...

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约市立图书馆二楼的女厕
sense_groups.english: ...the women's room on the second floor of the New York City Public Library.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你去图书馆做什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What were you doing in a library?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你呢？ - 密尔瓦基
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, what about you? - Oh, um, Milwaukee.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Uh, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 一九八九年迪士尼乐园的 "小世界"
sense_groups.english: Disneyland, 1989. "It's a small world after all."

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能
sense_groups.english: No way.

sense_groups.chinese: 游乐设施坏了
sense_groups.english: The, uh, ride broke down...

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝跟我躲在机器荷兰小孩后面
sense_groups.english: ...so Carol and I went behind a couple of those mechanical Dutch children.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们修好游乐设备后 要我们永远别回魔法王国
sense_groups.english: They fixed the ride, and we were asked never to return to the Magic Kingdom.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 少来 我已经说过了
sense_groups.english: I already went.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有 - 我说过了
sense_groups.english: You did not go. - Yes, I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 快告诉我们
sense_groups.english: Tell us. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我最奇怪的地点是…
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, the weirdest place would have to be...

sense_groups.chinese: 床脚
sense_groups.english: ...the foot of the bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧？ - 冠军已经出炉
sense_groups.english: Step back. - We have a winner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从没有过那么激情的关系
sense_groups.english: I've never had a relationship with that kind of passion.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要在游乐园跟某人做爱
sense_groups.english: Where you have to have somebody right there in the middle of a theme park.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是那里唯一不必排队的地方
sense_groups.english: It was the only thing to do there that didn't have a line.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴瑞连在迷你高尔夫球场都不愿意吻我
sense_groups.english: Well, Barry wouldn't even kiss me on a miniature-golf course.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Come on. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说我们会挡到后面的人
sense_groups.english: He said we were holding up the people behind us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有嫁给他是因为…
sense_groups.english: And you didn't marry him because?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得有人终其一生
sense_groups.english: Do you think there are people that go through life...

sense_groups.chinese: 都不会有那种…
sense_groups.english: ...never having that kind of?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Probably. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得告诉你一件事 大家都太高估激情了
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you something. Passion is way overrated.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right. - It is.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后激情会褪去
sense_groups.english: Eventually, it kind of burns out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望留下信任跟安全感
sense_groups.english: But hopefully what you're left with is trust and security and, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我前妻则是成了女同志
sense_groups.english: In my ex-wife's case, lesbianism.

sense_groups.chinese: 对错过激情的人来说
sense_groups.english: For all those people who miss out on that, uh, passion thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是件好事
sense_groups.english: ...there's other good stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信那种事会发生在你身上
sense_groups.english: But, um, I don't think that'll be you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You don't? - Mm-mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看得出来
sense_groups.english: See, I see, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 未来你会有段非常激情的关系
sense_groups.english: ...big passion in your future.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Really? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你那么认为？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: You do? - I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Ross, you're so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: It's never gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你跟瑞秋
sense_groups.english: What? - You and Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你迟迟不肯展开行动
sense_groups.english: Because you waited too long to make your move...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你们进入 "朋友区"
sense_groups.english: ...and now you're in the "Friend Zone."

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不在那一区
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I'm not in the Zone.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你还是区长呢
sense_groups.english: No, Ross. You're mayor of the Zone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在慢慢来 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm taking my time, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在打基础
sense_groups.english: I'm laying the groundwork.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 每天我越来越靠近…
sense_groups.english: Every day I get a little bit closer to, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 成为神父的日子
sense_groups.english: Priesthood.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你 她不知道你在想什么
sense_groups.english: Ross, I'm telling you, she has no idea what you're thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不快约她出去 你们会永远只能做朋友
sense_groups.english: If you don't ask her out soon, you'll end up stuck in the Zone forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I will, I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 在等时机成熟
sense_groups.english: I'm waiting for the, uh, right moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在？ - 对
sense_groups.english: What, now? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得哪里不对劲 美酒？
sense_groups.english: What's messing you up? The wine?

sense_groups.chinese: 蜡烛？月光？
sense_groups.english: The candles? The moonlight? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你只需要走过去跟她说 "瑞秋 我…"
sense_groups.english: You gotta go up to her and say, "Look, Rachel, I think..."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘 - 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh! - Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我们会嘘个不停
sense_groups.english: What are we shushing? - We're shushing...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为我们想听见声音
sense_groups.english: ...because we're trying to hear something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么声音？ - 你没听到吗？
sense_groups.english: What? - Uh, don't you hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 - 哈
sense_groups.english: See? - Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃口香糖吗？ - 是无糖的吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like some gum? - Oh. Is it sugarless?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 不是 - 不用了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Uh, sorry, it's not. - Then, no, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是怎么一回事？
sense_groups.english: What the hell was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 别忘了 吉儿•古德克请你吃口香糖 一定要接受
sense_groups.english: Mental note: If Jill Goodacre offers you gum, you take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算她要你吃动物尸体 你也得接受
sense_groups.english: If she offers you mangled animal carcass, you take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约市停电了
sense_groups.english: New York City has no power

sense_groups.chinese: 牛奶发臭了
sense_groups.english: And the milk is getting sour

sense_groups.chinese: 但我一点都不怕
sense_groups.english: But to me it is not scary

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我不吃奶
sense_groups.english: 'Cause I stay away from dairy

sense_groups.chinese: 啦啦…
sense_groups.english: La-la La-la-la-la-la

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 - 你要开口了？
sense_groups.english: Here goes. - You'll do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 需要我帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: I'll do it. - Want help?

sense_groups.chinese: 你敢出来就死定了
sense_groups.english: You come out there, you're a dead man.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Ross, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Good luck, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里？ - 外面
sense_groups.english: Where you going? - Outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能出去
sense_groups.english: You can't go out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 那是有原因的
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because of, uh, the reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么原因？
sense_groups.english: And that would be?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能告诉你
sense_groups.english: I, uh... I can't tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: Joey, What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你得发誓 你不会告诉罗斯是我说的
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen. You gotta promise you'll never, ever tell Ross that I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？ - 他在筹划你的生日派对
sense_groups.english: About what? - He's planning your birthday party.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我爱他
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好表现出讶异的样子
sense_groups.english: You better act surprised.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我的惊喜派对
sense_groups.english: About what? - My surprise party.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么惊喜派对？ - 别装了 乔伊都跟我说了
sense_groups.english: What surprise party? - Oh, stop it. Joey already told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有告诉我
sense_groups.english: Well, he didn't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 别看我 那是罗斯的事
sense_groups.english: Don't look at me. This is Ross' thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太老套了 每次我都是最后知道的人
sense_groups.english: This is so typical. I'm always the last to know everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪 我们告诉你很多事 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: You are not. We tell you stuff. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德被孔雀咬伤 我是最后一个知道的人
sense_groups.english: I was the last one to know when Chandler got bit by the peacock at the zoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是最后一个知道 你当初暗恋乔伊的人
sense_groups.english: I was the last to know you had a crush on Joey when he was moving in.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来我是倒数第二个
sense_groups.english: Oh. Looks like I was second to last.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的好漂亮
sense_groups.english: It's so nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个问题
sense_groups.english: Hey, I have a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上它不是个问题
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, it's not so much a question...

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是好奇…
sense_groups.english: ...it's more of a general wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 而已
sense_groups.english: ...ment.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说了
sense_groups.english: Here goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都想要…
sense_groups.english: Um, well, for a while now, I've been wanting to, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Yes, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看那只小猫咪
sense_groups.english: Look at that little kitty.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 攀上世界顶端俯瞰众生
sense_groups.english: I'm on the top of the world Looking down on creation

sense_groups.chinese: 我能找到的唯一解释
sense_groups.english: And the only explanation I can find

sense_groups.chinese: 就是你出现后我找到的真爱
sense_groups.english: Is the love that I found Ever since you've been around

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这是急救喷雾剂 不会痛的
sense_groups.english: All right, this is just Bactine. It won't hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Ow. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 那是蜡
sense_groups.english: Sorry, that was wax.

sense_groups.chinese: 可怜的小杜弟吓得半死 我们得找到他的主人
sense_groups.english: Poor little Tootie's scared. We should find his owner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何不将可怜小杜弟放在走廊上？
sense_groups.english: Why not put "poor little Tootie" in the hall?

sense_groups.chinese: 在停电的时候？他会绊倒的
sense_groups.english: During a blackout? She'll get trampled.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想了一下 口香糖很完美
sense_groups.english: You know, on second thought, gum would be perfection.

sense_groups.chinese: 口香糖很完美？
sense_groups.english: Gum would be perfection?

sense_groups.chinese: 口香糖很完美
sense_groups.english: Gum would be perfection.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该说 "口香糖很棒" 或 "我要来一块" 但是不
sense_groups.english: Could've said, "Gum would be nice." "I'll have a stick." But, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说口香糖很完美
sense_groups.english: For me, gum is perfection.

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨自己
sense_groups.english: I loathe myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她们是修女 她们憎恨所有生物
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, the Mellons. They hate all living things, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我们刚刚发现这只猫
sense_groups.english: Hi. We just found this cat...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在找他的主人
sense_groups.english: ...and we're looking for the owner.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是我的猫
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah, it's, uh... It's mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 他似乎很讨厌你 你确定？
sense_groups.english: He seems to hate you. Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是我的猫 快还我
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's my cat. Give me my cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 他叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. What's his name?

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯… 钮扣
sense_groups.english: Um, Bob... Buttons.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯钮扣？ - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Bob Buttons? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 来吧 巴伯钮扣
sense_groups.english: Bob Buttons. Here, Bob Buttons.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个大坏蛋
sense_groups.english: You are a very bad man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们欠我一只猫
sense_groups.english: You owe me a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 小猫咪
sense_groups.english: Here, kitty, kitty, kitty.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 小猫咪
sense_groups.english: Here, kitty, kitty.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到哪里去了？小猫咪
sense_groups.english: Where did you go, little kitty, kitty, kitty?

sense_groups.chinese: 小猫咪 快来吧…
sense_groups.english: Kitty, kitty, kitty. Come here, kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty, kitty...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 幸运数字六
sense_groups.english: Come on, lucky sixes.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 他是巴洛
sense_groups.english: Everybody, this is Paolo.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴洛 我来跟你介绍我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Paolo, I want you to meet my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: This is Monica... - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: ...and Joey... - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: ...and Ross. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不太会说英文
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. He doesn't speak much English.

sense_groups.chinese: 大富翁
sense_groups.english: Monopoly.

sense_groups.chinese: 快看
sense_groups.english: Look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 巴洛是哪来的？
sense_groups.english: Where did, uh, Paolo come from?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是意大利
sense_groups.english: Italy, I think. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说今晚他是从哪里突然进入我们的生活里
sense_groups.english: No, I mean tonight, in the building? Suddenly into our lives?

sense_groups.chinese: 那只猫是巴洛的猫 真的很有趣吧？
sense_groups.english: The cat turned out to be Paolo's cat. Isn't that funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很有趣 瑞秋一直摸他
sense_groups.english: That is funny. And Rachel keeps touching him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我到处找过了 但就是找不到那只猫
sense_groups.english: I looked all over the building and I couldn't find the kitty anywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到他了 他是巴洛的猫
sense_groups.english: Oh, I found him. It was Paolo's cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 又来了 我又是最后一个知道的人
sense_groups.english: Ah. Well, there you go. Last to know again.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然没有人告诉我 我想他是巴洛吧？
sense_groups.english: And I'm guessing, since nobody told me, this is Paolo?

sense_groups.chinese: 巴洛 她是菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh. Paolo, this is Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 说得对
sense_groups.english: You betcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 接下来是什么？
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay. What next?

sense_groups.chinese: 吹泡泡 好主意
sense_groups.english: Blow a bubble. A bubble's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是种雅气的表现 看起来很顽皮
sense_groups.english: It's got a, uh, boyish charm. It's impish.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 做得好 小顽皮
sense_groups.english: Nice going, imp.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只需要…
sense_groups.english: Okay. It's okay. All I need to do is...

sense_groups.chinese: 伸手将它塞回嘴里
sense_groups.english: ...reach over and put it back in my mouth.

sense_groups.chinese: 救得好 回到正轨 我…
sense_groups.english: Good save. We're back on track and I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 在吃别人的口香糖
sense_groups.english: ...chewing someone else's gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是我的口香糖 天啊
sense_groups.english: This is not my gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你被噎住了
sense_groups.english: And now you're choking.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你被噎住了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You're choking.

sense_groups.chinese: 好一点了吗？
sense_groups.english: Better?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那是…
sense_groups.english: Thank you. That was...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是…
sense_groups.english: That was...

sense_groups.chinese: 完美？
sense_groups.english: Perfection?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说了什么事那么好笑？
sense_groups.english: What'd he say that was so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不知道
sense_groups.english: I have absolutely no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太老套了
sense_groups.english: That's classic.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 大伙们 我在做什么？
sense_groups.english: My God, you guys. What am I doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 这太不像我了
sense_groups.english: This is so un-me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你答应 我可以帮你上
sense_groups.english: If you want, I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我好想咬住他的下唇
sense_groups.english: I know. I just wanna bite his bottom lip.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不会那么做
sense_groups.english: But I won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他第一次对着我笑
sense_groups.english: God. The first time he smiled at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 那三秒钟比我跟巴瑞在百慕达度过的三星期还刺激
sense_groups.english: ...those three seconds were more exciting than three weeks in Bermuda with Barry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有租摩托车吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you rent mopeds?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我听说…
sense_groups.english: Because I've heard...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是现在的重点
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's not about that right now. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这超肤浅的 而且我们没有共通点
sense_groups.english: I know it's totally superficial, and we have nothing in common...

sense_groups.chinese: 连说的语言都不一样
sense_groups.english: ...and we don't even speak the same language...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是天啊
sense_groups.english: ...but, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴洛 嗨
sense_groups.english: Paolo, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 听着
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Listen, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事你必须知道
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, heh, something you should, uh, know.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋跟我…
sense_groups.english: Rachel and I are...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间有感觉
sense_groups.english: We're kind of a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉？ - 对 感觉
sense_groups.english: Thing? - Thing. Yes, thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有性关系？ - 不
sense_groups.english: You have the sex? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 技术上来说我们没有性关系 但那…
sense_groups.english: No, no. Um, technically, the sex is not being had. But that's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是重点
sense_groups.english: That's not the point.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是瑞秋跟我应该…
sense_groups.english: The point is that, uh, Rachel and I should be, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋跟我应该在一起
sense_groups.english: Well, Rachel and I should be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你…
sense_groups.english: And if you get in the, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 上床… - 不
sense_groups.english: In bed? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是那个意思
sense_groups.english: Ha. No, not where I was going.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你介入我们之间的感觉
sense_groups.english: If you get in the way of us becoming a thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我会非常难过
sense_groups.english: ...then, uh, I would be, well, very sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你…
sense_groups.english: So do you, um?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会的英文不多？ - 我只懂一些
sense_groups.english: You do know a little English? - Little.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么是 "讨厌鬼" 吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know the word crap-weasel?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那真的很有趣 你是讨厌鬼
sense_groups.english: No? That's funny, you are a huge crap-weasel.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我们已经玩了一小时 看好了 真的很简单
sense_groups.english: Chandler, we've been here for an hour doing this. Watch, it's easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Ready? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 试试看？
sense_groups.english: Okay? Now try it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你得把它甩出去
sense_groups.english: You gotta whip it.

sense_groups.chinese: 快看 最后一根蜡烛要熄了
sense_groups.english: Look, look. The last candle's about to burn out.
...minus 46, minus 47, minus 48...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有灯光感觉好恐怖
sense_groups.english: Kind of spooky without any lights.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 我有个好点子
sense_groups.english: Okay, guys, I have the definitive one.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Uh, Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我不该在这个时候说
sense_groups.english: This probably isn't the best time to bring it up...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你得帮摩妮卡办个派对
sense_groups.english: ...but you have to throw a party for Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太好玩了 - 对
sense_groups.english: This has been fun. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你借我电话
sense_groups.english: Yes. Thanks for, uh, letting me use your phone...

sense_groups.chinese: 还救了我一命
sense_groups.english: ...and for saving my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 钱德
sense_groups.english: Well, goodbye, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 停电时我玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: I had a great blackout.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的帐号是7143457 我不知道你们有没有拍到
sense_groups.english: Hi. Um, I'm account number 7143457. And I don't know if you got any of that...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的很想要拷贝一卷录影带
sense_groups.english: ...but I would really like a copy of the tape.

questions.name: S01E08
questions.en:
Hey, gorgeous. How's it going?
Dehydrated Japanese noodles under fluorescent lights.
Does it get better than this?
Question: You're not dating, are you?
I met somebody who would be perfect for you.
You see, perfect might be a problem.
Had you said co-dependent or self-destructive...
You want a date Saturday? - Yes, please.
He is cute.
He's funny. He's... - He's a he?
Well, yeah.
Oh, God. I just...
You're nice... Oh, God.
Good, Shelly. Okay. I'm gonna go flush myself down the toilet now.
Okay. Bye-bye.
It's hard to enjoy noodles after that. Is that ridiculous?
Can you believe she actually thought that?
Um...
Yeah.
Well, when I first met you, I thought maybe...
...possibly...
...you might be.
You did?
Then you spent Phoebe's birthday party talking to my breasts...
...so then I figured maybe not.
Huh. Did, uh, any of the rest of you guys think that when you first met me?
I did. - I think so.
Not me. - No, no, me neither.
Although, uh, back in college, Susan Saladore did.
You're kidding.
Did you tell her I wasn't? - No.
It's because I wanted to go out with her too.
So I told her, actually, you were seeing Bernie Spellman...
...who also liked her.
Well, this is fascinating.
So, uh, what is it about me?
I don't know. Because you're smart, you're funny...
Ross is smart and funny. You ever think that about him?
Ha, ha. Yeah, right. - What is it?
Okay, I don't know. You just... You have a quality.
Yes, exactly. - Right?
Yeah, a quality.
"A quality." Good. I was worried you were gonna be vague about this.
Hello?
Oh. Rachel.
It's Paolo calling from Rome.
Oh, my God. Calling from Rome.
So he's calling from Rome. I could do that.
Just gotta go to Rome.
Monica, your dad just beeped in. Can you make it quick?
I'm talking to Rome.
Hey, Dad. What's up?
Oh, God.
Ross, it's Nana.
Hey.
How you doing? - Hey, Dad.
So, uh, how's she doing?
The doctor says it's a matter of hours.
How are you, Mom? - Me? I'm fine, fine.
I'm glad you're here.
What's with your hair?
What?
What's different?
Nothing.
Oh, maybe that's it.
She's unbelievable. Her mother's...
Okay, relax, relax.
We are gonna be here a while, it looks like.
We still have boyfriends and your career to cover.
Oh, God.
The fuzzy little mints at the bottom of her purse.
Oh.
Yeah, they were gross.
Oh, you know what I love?
Her Sweet 'N Lows.
How she was always stealing them from restaurants.
Not just restaurants, from our house.
Mrs. Geller?
She looks so small.
I know.
Well, at least she's with Pop-Pop and Aunt Phyllis now.
Goodbye, Nana.
Bye, Nana.
Ross!
Nurse.
What is going on?
You know, uh, how the nurse said Nana had passed?
Well, she's not quite.
What? - She's not passed.
She's present. She's back.
What's going on?
She may have died.
"She may have died"?
We're looking into it.
Uh, I'll go see.
This almost never happens.
Now she's passed.
I just have to know, okay?
Is it my hair?
Yes, Chandler, that's exactly what it is. It's your hair.
Yeah, you have homosexual hair.
Hey. - Hi.
So did she?
Twice.
Oh, that sucks.
You guys okay?
I don't know. It's weird.
I know she's gone, but I just don't feel, uh...
Maybe that's because she's not really gone.
No, no, she's gone.
We checked.
A lot.
No, I mean, maybe no one ever really goes.
Ever since my mom died, every now and then...
...I get this feeling that she's, like, right here, you know?
Oh. And Debbie, my best friend from junior high...
...got struck by lightning on a miniature golf course.
I always get this strong Debbie vibe...
...whenever I use one of those little yellow pencils.
I miss her.
Aw. Here, Pheebs.
Want this?
Oh, thanks. - Sure.
I just sharpened her this morning.
See, I don't believe any of that. I think when you're dead...
...you're dead. You're gone. You're worm food.
So Chandler looks gay, huh?
I don't know who this is, but it's not Debbie.
I thought it'd be a closed casket.
Well, that doesn't mean she can't look nice.
Sweetie, you think you can get in there?
I don't see why not.
Here's my retainer.
I was just thinking...
...when my time comes... - Dad.
Listen to me.
When my time comes, I wanna be buried at sea.
You what?
I wanna be buried at sea. It looks like fun.
Define "fun."
Come on. You'll make a day of it. You'll get a boat, pack a lunch...
And then we throw your body in the water. Gee, that does sound fun.
Everyone thinks they know me.
Everyone says, "Jack Geller, so predictable."
Maybe after I'm gone, they'll say, "Buried at sea? Huh."
That's probably what they'll say.
I'd like that.
Hey, gorgeous. - Hey.
Look, I'm sorry about yesterday.
Don't worry about it. Apparently, other people have made the same mistake.
Oh. Okay. Phew.
So, uh, what do you think it is about me?
I don't know what.
You just have...
...a quality. - A quality. Right. Great.
It's a shame, because you and Lowell would've made a great couple.
Lowell? Financial Services Lowell? That's who you saw me with?
What? He's cute.
Well, yeah.
He's no Brian in Payroll.
Is Brian?
No. I don't know. The point is, if you were gonna set me up...
...I'd like to think it'd be with somebody like him.
Well, I think Brian's a little out of your league.
Excuse me. You don't think I could get a Brian?
Because I could get a Brian. Believe you me.
I'm really not.
This one?
No.
I've shown you every dress we have.
Unless you want her to spend eternity in a lemon-yellow pantsuit...
...go with the burgundy.
Whatever we pick, she would've told us it's the wrong one.
You're right. We'll go with the burgundy.
A fine choice. I'm coming out.
Wait. We need shoes.
Okay. Uh...
How about these?
That's really a day shoe.
And where she's going, everyone else will be dressier?
Could we see something in a slimmer heel?
Okay. I have nothing in an evening shoe in the burgundy.
I can show you something in a silver that may work.
No, it really should be burgundy.
Unless we go with a different dress. - Yes.
No, no, no. Watch this.
Wait, I may have something in the back.
Oh, my God.
Is everything all right, dear?
Yeah. Yeah.
Just Nana's stuff.
How we doing? You guys ready?
Mom called to remind me not to wear my hair up.
Did you know my ears were not my best feature?
Some days it's all I can think about.
Hi. I'm sorry I'm late. I couldn't find my bearings.
Heh. You mean your earrings?
What did I say?
Are these the shoes? - Yes. Paolo sent them from Italy.
What? We, uh, don't have shoes here?
Morning. We ready to go?
Don't we look nice all dressed up?
It's stuff like that, isn't it?
It was a beautiful service. - It really was.
Come here, sweetheart.
You know...
...I think it's time for you to start using night cream.
What?
Nothing. Just your overcoat sounds remarkably like Brent Musburger.
Check it out. Giants-Cowboys.
You're watching football at a funeral?
No, it's the pregame. I'm gonna watch it at the reception.
You're a frightening, frightening man.
Oh, no. My new Paolo shoes.
Oh. I hope they're not ruined.
God, what a great day.
What? Weatherwise.
I know.
The air, the trees.
Even though Nana's gone, there's something almost, uh, life...
Ross, are you okay? - Ross!
I'm fine. No, I'm fine.
Just...
...having my worst fear realized, but...
I'm just checking to see if the muscle's in spasm.
Huh. - What? What is it?
You missed a belt loop. - Ugh.
Okay, it's in spasm.
Here, sweetie. Here.
I took these when I had my golfing accident.
Thanks, Mom.
Sorry.
Hi, I'm Andrea.
I'm Dorothy's daughter.
Hi, I'm Chandler, and I have no idea who Dorothy is.
Hey, look who's up.
Hey. - How do you feel?
I feel great.
I feel great. I feel great.
Wow, those pills really worked, huh?
Yeah. Not the first two, but the second two, whew.
I love you guys.
You guys are the greatest. I love my sister.
I love Pheebs. Ha.
That's so nice. - Hey.
Chandler. - Hey.
I love you, man.
And listen, if you wanna be gay, be gay.
It doesn't matter to me.
You were right.
Rachel. Rachel, Rachel.
I love you the most.
Well, you know who I love the most?
No. - You.
Oh, you don't get it.
Aw! - What do you got there?
Uh, just a, uh, hearing disability.
What's the score?
17-14, Giants. Three minutes to go in the third.
Beautiful.
Pheebs, could you maybe hand me a cracker?
Your grandmother would've hated this.
Well, sure. What with it being her funeral and all.
No, I'd be hearing about...
...why didn't I get the honey-glazed ham?
Or I didn't spend enough on flowers. If I spent more, she'd say
"Why waste your money? I don't need flowers, I'm dead."
That sounds like Nana.
Do you know what it's like to grow up...
...with someone who is critical of every single thing you say?
I can imagine.
I tell you, it's a wonder your mother turned out...
...to be the positive, life-affirming person she is.
That is a wonder.
So tell me something, Mom. If you had to do it all over again...
...I mean, if she was here right now...
...would you tell her?
Tell her what?
How she drove you crazy, picking on every little detail.
Like your hair, for example.
I'm not sure I know what you're getting at.
Would things have been better if you'd just told her the truth?
No.
I think some things are better left unsaid.
I think it's nicer when people just get along.
Ha.
More wine, dear?
Oh, I think so.
Those earrings look really lovely on you.
Thank you.
They're yours.
Actually, they were Nana's.
No!
Now I'm depressed.
Even more than I was.
Hey, who's this little naked guy?
Uh, that little naked guy would be me.
Aw. Look at the little thing.
Yes, fine. That is my penis.
Can we be grownups now?
Who are those people? - Got me.
That's Nana right there in the middle. - Wow.
Yeah, let's see.
"Me and the gang at Java Joe's."
Wow. Monica, you look just like your grandmother.
How old was she there?
Let's see. "1939."
Uh, twenty-four, twenty-five.
Huh. It looks like a fun gang.
Ooh, look, look, look. I got Monica naked.
Let me see.
No, no. That would be me again.
I'm, uh, just trying something.
Hey, Lowell. - Oh, hey, Chandler.
So how's it going in Financial Services?
It's like Mardi Gras without the papier-mâché heads.
How about you?
Good. Good. Listen, um, heh...
...I don't know what Shelly told you about me, but, uh...
...I'm not.
I know. That's what I told her.
Really? - Yeah.
So you can tell?
Pretty much. Most of the time. We have a kind of radar.
So you don't think I have...
...a quality?
Speaking for my people, I'd have to say no.
By the way, your friend Brian from Payroll? He is.
He is? - Yep.
And way out of your league.
Out of my league.
I could get a Brian. If I wanted to get a Brian, I could get a Brian.
Hey, Brian.
