sense_groups.english: He's funny. He's... - He's a he?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我只是…
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 你很棒… 天啊
sense_groups.english: You're nice... Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 雪莉 我实在是没脸见人
sense_groups.english: Good, Shelly. Okay. I'm gonna go flush myself down the toilet now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 经过那件事之后 真的很难继续享受拉面 很夸张对吧？
sense_groups.english: It's hard to enjoy noodles after that. Is that ridiculous?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能相信 她真的这样认为吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe she actually thought that?

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚认识你的时候 我想说或许…
sense_groups.english: Well, when I first met you, I thought maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能…
sense_groups.english: ...possibly...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能是
sense_groups.english: ...you might be.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: You did?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你在菲比的生日派对上 一直对我的胸部说话…
sense_groups.english: Then you spent Phoebe's birthday party talking to my breasts...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我想说应该不是
sense_groups.english: ...so then I figured maybe not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其他人刚认识我的时候 有那么想吗？
sense_groups.english: Huh. Did, uh, any of the rest of you guys think that when you first met me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有 - 我想有
sense_groups.english: I did. - I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 - 不… 我也没有
sense_groups.english: Not me. - No, no, me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过大学时期的苏珊有
sense_groups.english: Although, uh, back in college, Susan Saladore did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: You're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有跟她说我不是吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Did you tell her I wasn't? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我想跟她交往
sense_groups.english: It's because I wanted to go out with her too.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我跟她说 你和伯尼交往…
sense_groups.english: So I told her, actually, you were seeing Bernie Spellman...

sense_groups.chinese: 伯尼也喜欢她
sense_groups.english: ...who also liked her.

sense_groups.chinese: 太有趣了
sense_groups.english: Well, this is fascinating.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么原因？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what is it about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 因为你很聪明 好笑…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Because you're smart, you're funny...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯也是啊 你们有想过他是吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross is smart and funny. You ever think that about him?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 那到底是什么原因？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Yeah, right. - What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你就是… 你有种特质
sense_groups.english: Okay, I don't know. You just... You have a quality.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes, exactly. - Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 某种特质
sense_groups.english: Yeah, a quality.

sense_groups.chinese: "特质" 很好 因为我很担心你们会说得很模糊
sense_groups.english: "A quality." Good. I was worried you were gonna be vague about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh. Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗马的巴洛
sense_groups.english: It's Paolo calling from Rome.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他从罗马打来
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Calling from Rome.

sense_groups.chinese: 他从罗马打来 我也做得到啊
sense_groups.english: So he's calling from Rome. I could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要去罗马就行了
sense_groups.english: Just gotta go to Rome.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你爸打进来 你可以讲快一点吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica, your dad just beeped in. Can you make it quick?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在跟罗马通话
sense_groups.english: I'm talking to Rome.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dad. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 是奶奶
sense_groups.english: Ross, it's Nana.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好吗？ - 嘿 爸
sense_groups.english: How you doing? - Hey, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how's she doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说只剩几小时了
sense_groups.english: The doctor says it's a matter of hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗 妈妈？ - 我？我很好
sense_groups.english: How are you, Mom? - Me? I'm fine, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你来了
sense_groups.english: I'm glad you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的头发怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's with your hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么不同？
sense_groups.english: What's different?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啊
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 大概就是这样吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, maybe that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她实在是令人难以置信 她母亲…
sense_groups.english: She's unbelievable. Her mother's...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 放轻松点
sense_groups.english: Okay, relax, relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我们还要在这里待一段时间
sense_groups.english: We are gonna be here a while, it looks like.

sense_groups.chinese: 免不了还要谈你男友和工作的事
sense_groups.english: We still have boyfriends and your career to cover.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 她皮包里有发霉的薄荷糖
sense_groups.english: The fuzzy little mints at the bottom of her purse.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 超恶心的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, they were gross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我最爱什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what I love?

sense_groups.chinese: 她的代糖
sense_groups.english: Her Sweet 'N Lows.

sense_groups.chinese: 她老是从餐厅偷代糖
sense_groups.english: How she was always stealing them from restaurants.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是餐厅 还有我们家
sense_groups.english: Not just restaurants, from our house.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒太太？
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看起来好小一只
sense_groups.english: She looks so small.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少她现在有爷爷和菲利斯婶婶陪伴
sense_groups.english: Well, at least she's with Pop-Pop and Aunt Phyllis now.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了 奶奶
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Nana.

sense_groups.chinese: 别了 奶奶
sense_groups.english: Bye, Nana.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 护士
sense_groups.english: Nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 护士不是说奶奶走了吗？
sense_groups.english: You know, uh, how the nurse said Nana had passed?

sense_groups.chinese: 但并不是
sense_groups.english: Well, she's not quite.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 她没走
sense_groups.english: What? - She's not passed.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在 她回来了
sense_groups.english: She's present. She's back.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能死了
sense_groups.english: She may have died.

sense_groups.chinese: "她可能死了"？
sense_groups.english: "She may have died"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还在观察
sense_groups.english: We're looking into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我进去看看
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'll go see.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种事几乎不可能发生
sense_groups.english: This almost never happens.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在她走了
sense_groups.english: Now she's passed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定得知道
sense_groups.english: I just have to know, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的头发吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it my hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 钱德 就是这样 你的头发
sense_groups.english: Yes, Chandler, that's exactly what it is. It's your hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你有同志头发
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you have homosexual hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 那她…？
sense_groups.english: So did she?

sense_groups.chinese: 两次
sense_groups.english: Twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是糟透了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还好吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 感觉好怪
sense_groups.english: I don't know. It's weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道她走了 但我就是不觉得…
sense_groups.english: I know she's gone, but I just don't feel, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为 她没有真的走了
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's because she's not really gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她走了
sense_groups.english: No, no, she's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有检查
sense_groups.english: We checked.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多次
sense_groups.english: A lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 或许人不会真的走
sense_groups.english: No, I mean, maybe no one ever really goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从我妈死掉后 我偶尔…
sense_groups.english: Ever since my mom died, every now and then...

sense_groups.chinese: 会感觉到她就在这里
sense_groups.english: ...I get this feeling that she's, like, right here, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有我初中最好的朋友 黛比…
sense_groups.english: Oh. And Debbie, my best friend from junior high...

sense_groups.chinese: 她去打迷你高尔夫时 被闪电击中
sense_groups.english: ...got struck by lightning on a miniature golf course.

sense_groups.chinese: 用黄色的铅笔时
sense_groups.english: I always get this strong Debbie vibe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我总是能感应到黛比
sense_groups.english: ...whenever I use one of those little yellow pencils.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想她
sense_groups.english: I miss her.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Aw. Here, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要这个吗？
sense_groups.english: Want this?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 谢了 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今早才把它削尖的
sense_groups.english: I just sharpened her this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全不相信那一套 你死掉后…
sense_groups.english: See, I don't believe any of that. I think when you're dead...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是死了 消失了 成了虫的食物
sense_groups.english: ...you're dead. You're gone. You're worm food.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德看起来很像同志 对吧？
sense_groups.english: So Chandler looks gay, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这是谁 但绝不是黛比
sense_groups.english: I don't know who this is, but it's not Debbie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为要用密封的棺木
sense_groups.english: I thought it'd be a closed casket.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不代表她不能看起来体面一点
sense_groups.english: Well, that doesn't mean she can't look nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子 你想你进得去吗？
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, you think you can get in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: I don't see why not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的牙齿矫正器在这里
sense_groups.english: Here's my retainer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想…
sense_groups.english: I was just thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 轮到我的时候… - 爸
sense_groups.english: ...when my time comes... - Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说
sense_groups.english: Listen to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 轮到我的时候 我想海葬
sense_groups.english: When my time comes, I wanna be buried at sea.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: You what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想葬在海里 看起来很好玩
sense_groups.english: I wanna be buried at sea. It looks like fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 解释一下 "好玩" 的意思
sense_groups.english: Define "fun."

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 那一天你们会很开心的 租艘船 带些午餐…
sense_groups.english: Come on. You'll make a day of it. You'll get a boat, pack a lunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后把你的尸体丢到海里 听起来真好玩
sense_groups.english: And then we throw your body in the water. Gee, that does sound fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都以为很了解我
sense_groups.english: Everyone thinks they know me.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都说 "杰克•盖勒 太好猜了"
sense_groups.english: Everyone says, "Jack Geller, so predictable."

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我走后 他们会说 "海葬？"
sense_groups.english: Maybe after I'm gone, they'll say, "Buried at sea? Huh."

sense_groups.chinese: 他们大概就会这样说
sense_groups.english: That's probably what they'll say.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这样
sense_groups.english: I'd like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 美女 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, gorgeous. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 昨天的事 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry about yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 显然其他人 也会犯相同的错误
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it. Apparently, other people have made the same mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay. Phew.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你觉得我是哪里像？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what do you think it is about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know what.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是有种…
sense_groups.english: You just have...

sense_groups.chinese: 特质 - 特质 对 太好了
sense_groups.english: ...a quality. - A quality. Right. Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 太可惜 因为你和罗威尔会是很棒的一对
sense_groups.english: It's a shame, because you and Lowell would've made a great couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗威尔？金融服务部的罗威尔？你认为我适合跟他在一起？
sense_groups.english: Lowell? Financial Services Lowell? That's who you saw me with?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？他很可爱啊
sense_groups.english: What? He's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他比出纳处的布莱恩好多了
sense_groups.english: He's no Brian in Payroll.

sense_groups.chinese: 布莱恩是…？
sense_groups.english: Is Brian?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不知道 重点是 如果你要撮合我跟某人…
sense_groups.english: No. I don't know. The point is, if you were gonna set me up...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会希望是像他那样的人
sense_groups.english: ...I'd like to think it'd be with somebody like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为你配不上布莱恩
sense_groups.english: Well, I think Brian's a little out of your league.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 你认为我追不到布莱恩？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. You don't think I could get a Brian?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我绝对可以追到布莱恩 相信我
sense_groups.english: Because I could get a Brian. Believe you me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不是
sense_groups.english: I'm really not.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一件？
sense_groups.english: This one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经给你们看过所有洋装了
sense_groups.english: I've shown you every dress we have.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你们想让她穿着 柠檬黄色套装入土…
sense_groups.english: Unless you want her to spend eternity in a lemon-yellow pantsuit...

sense_groups.chinese: 不然就选酒红色
sense_groups.english: ...go with the burgundy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管我们选什么 她都不会满意
sense_groups.english: Whatever we pick, she would've told us it's the wrong one.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就选酒红色
sense_groups.english: You're right. We'll go with the burgundy.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的选择 我要出来了
sense_groups.english: A fine choice. I'm coming out.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我们还需要鞋子
sense_groups.english: Wait. We need shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 这些如何？
sense_groups.english: How about these?

sense_groups.chinese: 那些是日鞋
sense_groups.english: That's really a day shoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 她去的地方 别人的打扮会更隆重吗？
sense_groups.english: And where she's going, everyone else will be dressier?

sense_groups.chinese: 能找鞋跟细一点的鞋吗？
sense_groups.english: Could we see something in a slimmer heel?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我找不到酒红色的晚鞋
sense_groups.english: Okay. I have nothing in an evening shoe in the burgundy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过有双银色的鞋或许适合
sense_groups.english: I can show you something in a silver that may work.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 一定要酒红色
sense_groups.english: No, it really should be burgundy.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非我们中包另一件洋装 - 对
sense_groups.english: Unless we go with a different dress. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 我看看
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 后面或许有适合的
sense_groups.english: Wait, I may have something in the back.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Is everything all right, dear?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是奶奶的东西
sense_groups.english: Just Nana's stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家怎么样？都好了吗？
sense_groups.english: How we doing? You guys ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈打电话给我 提醒我不要把头发绑起来
sense_groups.english: Mom called to remind me not to wear my hair up.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道我的耳朵 不是我最漂亮的部位吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know my ears were not my best feature?

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我会一直耿耿于怀
sense_groups.english: Some days it's all I can think about.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我迟到了 我找不到我的耳圈
sense_groups.english: Hi. I'm sorry I'm late. I couldn't find my bearings.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说耳环吗？
sense_groups.english: Heh. You mean your earrings?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这双鞋子吗？ - 对 巴洛从意大利寄过来的
sense_groups.english: Are these the shoes? - Yes. Paolo sent them from Italy.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？我们这里 没有鞋子吗？
sense_groups.english: What? We, uh, don't have shoes here?

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 准备好出发了吗？
sense_groups.english: Morning. We ready to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 打扮后 我们看起来都很棒吧？
sense_groups.english: Don't we look nice all dressed up?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这类的评论吧？
sense_groups.english: It's stuff like that, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是很棒的仪式 - 的确
sense_groups.english: It was a beautiful service. - It really was.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Come here, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道…
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为该是你开始使用晚霜的时候了
sense_groups.english: ...I think it's time for you to start using night cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 只是你的大衣很吵
sense_groups.english: Nothing. Just your overcoat sounds remarkably like Brent Musburger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看 巨人队对牛仔队
sense_groups.english: Check it out. Giants-Cowboys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在葬礼时看美式足球赛？
sense_groups.english: You're watching football at a funeral?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这只是赛前分析 待会在宴会上才要看
sense_groups.english: No, it's the pregame. I'm gonna watch it at the reception.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个人真是充满惊奇
sense_groups.english: You're a frightening, frightening man.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不会吧 我的巴洛鞋
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. My new Paolo shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望鞋没坏
sense_groups.english: Oh. I hope they're not ruined.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真是美好的一天
sense_groups.english: God, what a great day.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？我是说天气
sense_groups.english: What? Weatherwise.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 空气和树木
sense_groups.english: The air, the trees.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然奶奶走了 但是…
sense_groups.english: Even though Nana's gone, there's something almost, uh, life...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你没事吧？ - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross, are you okay? - Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm fine. No, I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是…
sense_groups.english: Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我最大的梦魇终于成真 不过…
sense_groups.english: ...having my worst fear realized, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 不用担心 我只是看看 你是否肌肉痉挛
sense_groups.english: I'm just checking to see if the muscle's in spasm.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Huh. - What? What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你少穿了一个皮带孔 - 呕
sense_groups.english: You missed a belt loop. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 有肌肉痉挛
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's in spasm.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了 亲爱的 给你
sense_groups.english: Here, sweetie. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有高尔夫球意外时 都会吃这个
sense_groups.english: I took these when I had my golfing accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 妈妈
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我是安卓亚
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Andrea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是桃乐丝的女儿
sense_groups.english: I'm Dorothy's daughter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我是钱德 我不知道桃乐丝是谁
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Chandler, and I have no idea who Dorothy is.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 看看是谁起来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, look who's up.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你觉得如何？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How do you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很棒
sense_groups.english: I feel great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很棒…
sense_groups.english: I feel great. I feel great.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 那些药丸真的有用
sense_groups.english: Wow, those pills really worked, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 前两颗还好 但后两颗真的…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Not the first two, but the second two, whew.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱你们
sense_groups.english: I love you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们最棒了 我好爱我妹妹
sense_groups.english: You guys are the greatest. I love my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱菲比
sense_groups.english: I love Pheebs. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: That's so nice. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 听好 如果你想当同志 就好好当吧
sense_groups.english: And listen, if you wanna be gay, be gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无所谓
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没说错
sense_groups.english: You were right.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Rachel. Rachel, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最爱你了
sense_groups.english: I love you the most.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那你知道我最爱谁吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, you know who I love the most?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 - 是你
sense_groups.english: No. - You.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你没听懂
sense_groups.english: Oh, you don't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Aw! - What do you got there?

sense_groups.chinese: 听力装置
sense_groups.english: Uh, just a, uh, hearing disability.

sense_groups.chinese: 比数多少？
sense_groups.english: What's the score?

sense_groups.chinese: 巨人队以17分对14分领先 第三节只剩三分钟
sense_groups.english: 17-14, Giants. Three minutes to go in the third.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你可以拿块饼干给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, could you maybe hand me a cracker?

sense_groups.chinese: 你奶奶一定不会喜欢的
sense_groups.english: Your grandmother would've hated this.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 这是她的葬礼
sense_groups.english: Well, sure. What with it being her funeral and all.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我会一直听到她说…
sense_groups.english: No, I'd be hearing about...

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么没有蜜糖火腿？
sense_groups.english: ...why didn't I get the honey-glazed ham?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是我买的花不够 又或者是…
sense_groups.english: Or I didn't spend enough on flowers. If I spent more, she'd say

sense_groups.chinese: 何必浪费那么多钱？我都死了
sense_groups.english: "Why waste your money? I don't need flowers, I'm dead."

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很像奶奶的口气
sense_groups.english: That sounds like Nana.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道和批评你每句话的人...
sense_groups.english: Do you know what it's like to grow up...

sense_groups.chinese: 在一起生活是什么滋味吗？
sense_groups.english: ...with someone who is critical of every single thing you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想象得到
sense_groups.english: I can imagine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你 你的母亲
sense_groups.english: I tell you, it's a wonder your mother turned out...

sense_groups.chinese: 变得这么乐观 积极的人真的很神奇
sense_groups.english: ...to be the positive, life-affirming person she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很神奇
sense_groups.english: That is a wonder.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 告诉我 如果可以重来…
sense_groups.english: So tell me something, Mom. If you had to do it all over again...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果此时此刻她在这里…
sense_groups.english: ...I mean, if she was here right now...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会告诉她吗？
sense_groups.english: ...would you tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉她什么？
sense_groups.english: Tell her what?

sense_groups.chinese: 她如何使你抓狂 挑剔每一件小事
sense_groups.english: How she drove you crazy, picking on every little detail.

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说你的头发
sense_groups.english: Like your hair, for example.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不太懂你在说什么
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure I know what you're getting at.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你说出实话 情况会好一点吗？
sense_groups.english: Would things have been better if you'd just told her the truth?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为某些事 还是不要说比较好
sense_groups.english: I think some things are better left unsaid.

sense_groups.chinese: 家和万事兴
sense_groups.english: I think it's nicer when people just get along.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来些酒吗？
sense_groups.english: More wine, dear?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Oh, I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 你戴这副耳环真好看
sense_groups.english: Those earrings look really lovely on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你的耳环
sense_groups.english: They're yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是奶奶的
sense_groups.english: Actually, they were Nana's.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 真叫人难过
sense_groups.english: Now I'm depressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 比刚才还难过
sense_groups.english: Even more than I was.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个裸体的小家伙是谁？
sense_groups.english: Hey, who's this little naked guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个裸体的小家伙就是我
sense_groups.english: Uh, that little naked guy would be me.

sense_groups.chinese: 看这小东西
sense_groups.english: Aw. Look at the little thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 那是我的小弟弟
sense_groups.english: Yes, fine. That is my penis.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在成熟一点行吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we be grownups now?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些人是谁？ - 考倒我了
sense_groups.english: Who are those people? - Got me.

sense_groups.chinese: 中间那个是奶奶 - 哇
sense_groups.english: That's Nana right there in the middle. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看
sense_groups.english: Yeah, let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: "我和大伙们摄于爪哇咖啡厅"
sense_groups.english: "Me and the gang at Java Joe's."

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你长得好像你奶奶
sense_groups.english: Wow. Monica, you look just like your grandmother.

sense_groups.chinese: 她那时候几岁？
sense_groups.english: How old was she there?

sense_groups.chinese: 看一下 1939年
sense_groups.english: Let's see. "1939."
Uh, twenty-four, twenty-five.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很好玩的一群人
sense_groups.english: Huh. It looks like a fun gang.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们快看 有摩妮卡裸体的照片
sense_groups.english: Ooh, look, look, look. I got Monica naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看
sense_groups.english: Let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那个还是我
sense_groups.english: No, no. That would be me again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在尝试新事物
sense_groups.english: I'm, uh, just trying something.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗威尔 - 嘿 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, Lowell. - Oh, hey, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 金融服务处还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So how's it going in Financial Services?

sense_groups.chinese: 简直是一团乱
sense_groups.english: It's like Mardi Gras without the papier-mâché heads.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们呢？
sense_groups.english: How about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 听着…
sense_groups.english: Good. Good. Listen, um, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道雪莉怎么跟你说我的事 但是…
sense_groups.english: ...I don't know what Shelly told you about me, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我并不是
sense_groups.english: ...I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我也是这样跟她说的
sense_groups.english: I know. That's what I told her.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看得出来？
sense_groups.english: So you can tell?

sense_groups.chinese: 大部分的时候是的 我们有种…雷达
sense_groups.english: Pretty much. Most of the time. We have a kind of radar.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你不认为我有…
sense_groups.english: So you don't think I have...

sense_groups.chinese: 那种特质？
sense_groups.english: ...a quality?

sense_groups.chinese: 代表男同志发言 我得说没有
sense_groups.english: Speaking for my people, I'd have to say no.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你的朋友 出纳处的布莱恩？他是同志
sense_groups.english: By the way, your friend Brian from Payroll? He is.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是？ - 对
sense_groups.english: He is? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且你绝对配不上他
sense_groups.english: And way out of your league.

sense_groups.chinese: 配不上他
sense_groups.english: Out of my league.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以追到布莱恩的 如果我愿意的话
sense_groups.english: I could get a Brian. If I wanted to get a Brian, I could get a Brian.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 布莱恩
sense_groups.english: Hey, Brian.

questions.name: S01E09
questions.en:
Terry, I know I haven't worked here very long...
...but I was wondering, do you think it would be possible...
...if I got a $100 advance on my salary?
An advance?
It's so that I can spend Thanksgiving with my family.
See, every year, we go skiing in Vail, and normally my father pays for my ticket...
...but I've sort of started this whole independent thing, you know...
...which is actually why I took this "job."
Rachel, Rachel, sweetheart.
You're a terrible, terrible waitress.
Really, really awful.
Okay, I hear what you're saying. I'm with you.
Um...
But I'm trying really hard, and I think I'm doing better.
I really do.
Does anybody need coffee?
Yeah, over here. - Yeah, I do.
Heh. Look at that.
Excuse me, sir? Hi. You come in here all the time.
Uh-huh. - I was just wondering...
...you think there's a possibility you could give me an advance on my tips?
Huh? No.
Okay, okay. That's fine, fine. Sorry about that spill before.
Only 98.50 to go.
Hey. Hey. - Hey.
Ross, did you know that Mom and Dad are going to Puerto Rico for Thanksgiving?
What? No, they're not.
Yes, they are. The Blymans invited them. - You're wrong.
I am not wrong. - You're wrong.
No, I just talked to them.
I'm calling Mom.
Hey, hey. - Hey.
Hey. - Coffee.
And this from the Cry for Help Department: Are you wearing makeup?
Yes, I am.
As of today, I am officially Joey Tribbiani, actor/model.
Thank you.
That's funny, I was thinking you look more like Joey Tribbiani, man/woman.
What were you modeling for?
You know those posters for the City Free Clinic?
Oh, wow. You're gonna be one of those healthy, healthy, healthy guys?
Ah? - The asthma guy's really cute.
Oh, he is. - Isn't he?
You know which one you're gonna be? - No, no.
But I hear Lyme disease is open, so, you know...
Good luck, man. I hope you get it.
Thanks.
Well, you were right. How can they do this to us, huh?
It's Thanksgiving.
Aw. Tell you what. How about if I cook dinner at my place?
I'll make it just like Mom's.
Will you make the mashed potatoes with the lumps?
You know they're not actually supposed to...?
I'll work on the lumps.
Joey, you're going home, right? - Yeah.
And I assume, Chandler, you're still boycotting all the Pilgrim holidays?
Yes, every single one of them.
Phoebe, you're gonna be with your grandma?
Yeah, and her boyfriend.
But we're celebrating Thanksgiving in December because he's lunar.
So you're free Thursday, then?
Yeah. Oh, can I come? - Yeah.
Rach, you still thinking you're gonna make it to Vail?
Absolutely. Shoop, shoop, shoop.
Only $102 to go. - I thought it was 98.50.
Yeah, well, it was, but I broke a cup.
Well, I'm off to Carol's.
Ooh, ooh, why don't we invite her?
Ooh, ooh, because she's my ex-wife...
...and will probably wanna bring her, ooh, ooh, lesbian life partner.
Hi. Is Carol here?
No, she's at a faculty meeting. - Oh.
Well, I just came by to pick up my skull.
Well, not mine, but...
Come in. - Thanks.
Yeah, Carol borrowed it for a class, and I have to get it back to the museum.
What's it look like?
Kind of like a big face without skin.
Yes, heh, I'm familiar with the concept.
We can just look for it. - Okay.
Wow, you guys, heh, sure have a lot of books about being a lesbian.
Well, you know, you have to take a course.
Otherwise they don't let you do it.
Hey, hey, Yertle the Turtle. A classic.
Actually, I'm reading it to the baby.
The baby that hasn't been born yet?
Uh, wouldn't that mean you're...
...crazy?
What, you don't think they can hear sounds in there?
You're not serious. I mean, you really talk to it?
Yeah, all the time. I want the baby to know my voice.
Do you, uh...? Do you talk about me?
Yeah, yeah. All the time. - Really?
But, um, we just refer to you as "Bobo the sperm guy."
Look, if she's talking to it, I just think I should get some belly time too.
I mean, not that I believe any of this.
Oh, I believe it. I think the baby can totally hear everything.
Really? - I can show you.
This will seem a little weird.
But you put your head inside this turkey...
...and then we'll all talk, and you'll hear everything we say.
I'd just like to say I'm totally behind this experiment.
In fact, I'd very much like to butter your head.
Hey. - Hey, Rach.
Did you make your money? - No, not even close.
Forget Vail. Forget seeing my family.
Forget shoop, shoop, shoop.
Uh, Rach...
...here's your mail.
Thanks. You can just put it on the table.
Heh. No.
Here's your mail.
Thanks. You can just put it on the table.
Would you just open it?
Oh, my God.
Oh, you guys are great. - Aw. Ha, ha.
Aw. - We all chipped in.
We did? - You owe me 20 bucks.
Thank you. Thank you so much.
Chandler, here you go. Got your traditional holiday feast.
Got your tomato soup...
...your grilled-cheese fixings, and your family-size bag of Funyuns.
Wait, this is what you're having for Thanksgiving dinner?
What is it with you and this holiday?
All right, I'm 9 years old.
Aw. - Aw, I hate this story.
We've just finished Thanksgiving dinner.
I have... And I remember this part vividly. A mouthful of pumpkin pie.
And this is the moment my parents choose to tell me they're getting divorced.
Oh, my God.
It's very difficult to enjoy Thanksgiving dinner once you've seen it in reverse.
Hi.
We used to work together. - We did?
Yeah, at Macy's. You're the Obsession girl, right?
Yes. - I was the Aramis guy.
Aramis? Aramis? Aramis? - Oh.
Yeah, right.
I gotta tell you, you're the best in the business.
Get out. - I'm serious.
You're amazing. You know when to spritz. You know when to lay back.
Really? You don't know what that means to me.
Mm, mm.
You smell great tonight. Uh, what are you wearing?
Nothing.
Listen, do you wanna go get a drink or something?
Yeah, that would be...
What's wrong? - I just remembered I have to do something.
Oh. What?
Um...
Leave.
Whoa. Wait, wait, wait.
So I guess you all saw it.
What? - Saw what?
No, we're just laughing. You know how laughter can be infectious.
Hey.
Set another place for Thanksgiving. My entire family thinks I have VD.
Tonight, on a very special Blossom.
Mm, looking good. Okay.
Cider's mulling, turkey's turking, yams are yamming.
What?
I don't know.
It's just not the same without Mom in the kitchen.
Ugh. All right, that's it. Get out of my way and stop annoying me.
Well, that's closer. That's...
I got the ticket, I got the ticket.
Five hours from now, shoop, shoop, shoop.
Oh, you must stop shooping.
Okay, I'm gonna get my stuff.
Chandler, will you just come in, already?
No, thank you. I prefer to keep a safe distance from all this merriment.
Look out. Incoming pumpkin pie.
Okay, we all laughed when you did it with the stuffing, but that's not funny anymore.
Hey, Monica, I got a question. I don't see any Tater Tots.
That's not a question.
But my mom always makes them. It's like a tradition.
You get a little piece of turkey on your fork, a little cranberry sauce, and a Tot.
I mean, it's bad enough I can't be with my family...
...because of my disease.
All right, fine.
Tonight's potatoes will be both mashed with lumps...
...and in the form of Tots.
Yes.
All right, I'm off to talk to my unborn child.
Ah. - Okay, Mom never hit.
Okay, all done.
What? Phoebe, did you whip the pota...?
Ross needs lumps.
Oh, I'm sorry. Oh, I just...
I thought we could have them whipped and then add some peas and onions.
Why would we do that?
Then they'd be just like my mom used to make it...
...you know, before she died.
Okay, three kinds of potatoes coming up.
Okay. Goodbye, you guys.
Thanks for everything.
Oh, God, look at... Sorry. I'm so sorry.
The most unbelievable thing has happened. Underdog has gotten away.
The balloon? - No, no, the actual cartoon character.
Of course the balloon.
It's all over the news. Before he reached Macy's...
...he broke free and was spotted flying over Washington Square Park.
I'm going to the roof. Who's with me? - Well, I can't. I gotta go.
An 80-foot inflatable dog loose over the city?
How often does that happen? - Almost never.
Got the keys? - Okay.
Any time you're ready.
Okay.
Okay, here we go.
Oh...
Okay, where am I talking to here? I mean, uh...
Well, there is one way that seems to offer a certain acoustical advantage, but...
Just aim for the bump.
Okay.
Okay, okay.
Okay, here goes.
You know, I... You know, I can't do this.
This is... It's too weird. I feel stupid.
All right, so don't do it. It's fine.
You don't have to do it just because Susan does it.
Hello, baby. Hello, hello.
That moment when we first saw the giant dog shadow fall over the park?
But did they have to shoot him down? I mean, that was just mean.
Okay, right about now the turkey should be crispy on the outside...
...and juicy on the inside.
Why are we standing here?
We're waiting for you to open the door. You've got the keys.
No, I don't.
Yes, you do. When we left, you said, "Got the keys."
No, I didn't. I asked, "Got the keys?"
No, no, no. You said, "Got the keys."
Either of you have the keys?
The oven is on. - Oh, I've gotta get my ticket.
Wait. We have a copy of your key. - Well, then get it, get it!
Hey, hey. That tone won't make me go any faster.
Joey. - That one will.
And everyone's telling me
"You gotta pick a major. You gotta pick a major."
So on a dare, I picked paleontology.
And you have no idea what I'm saying, because, let's face it, you're a fetus.
You're just happy you don't have gills anymore.
Look, you don't have to talk to it. You can sing to it.
Oh, please. I am not singing to your stomach, okay?
How's it going? - Shh, shh, shh.
# Here we come #
# Walkin' down the street #
# Get the funniest looks from Everyone we meet #
Hey, hey...
Hey, uh, did you just feel that? - I did.
Well, does it always, uh...? - No, no, that was the first.
Keep singing. Keep singing. - Oh.
Hey, hey, you're my baby
And I can't wait to meet you
When you come out I'll buy you a bagel And then we'll go to the zoo
I felt it that time.
Hey, hey, I'm your daddy
I'm the one without any breasts
Nope, not that one. - Can you go any faster with that?
Hey, I got one keyhole and about a zillion keys.
You do the math.
Why do you guys have so many keys in there anyway?
For an emergency just like this.
All right, listen, smirky.
If it wasn't for your stupid balloon...
...I would be on a plane, watching a woman do this right now.
But I'm not.
I swear you said you had the keys.
No. I wouldn't say I had the keys unless I had the keys.
And I obviously did not have the keys.
Okay, all right, that's it. Enough with the keys. No one say "keys."
Why would I have the keys?
Aside from the fact that you said you did?
But I didn't. - Well, you should have.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才能跟我家人一起过感恩节

sense_groups.chinese: 我们每年都会去维尔滑雪场 我爸都会帮我买机票

sense_groups.chinese: 由于我已经开始要求独立…

sense_groups.chinese: 也因此 我才会来做这个"工作"

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 瑞秋 亲爱的

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个很糟 很糟 很糟的服务生

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 真的很糟糕
sense_groups.english: Really, really awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的意思了 我赞成你的观点
sense_groups.english: Okay, I hear what you're saying. I'm with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我很努力 而且我觉得自己已经进步了

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的
sense_groups.english: I really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人需要咖啡吗？
sense_groups.english: Does anybody need coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 这边 - 我要
sense_groups.english: Yeah, over here. - Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看
sense_groups.english: Heh. Look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 先生？嗨 你常常来
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, sir? Hi. You come in here all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 我在想你是否可以
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - I was just wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能先预借给我一点小费？
sense_groups.english: ...you think there's a possibility you could give me an advance on my tips?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: Huh? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好 没关系的 抱歉曾经给你打翻过
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. That's fine, fine. Sorry about that spill before.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩九十八块五毛钱了

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不 不会的
sense_groups.english: What? No, they're not.

sense_groups.chinese: 有 布莱曼家邀请他们去的 - 你搞错了
sense_groups.english: Yes, they are. The Blymans invited them. - You're wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没错 - 你搞错了
sense_groups.english: I am not wrong. - You're wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我才跟他们谈过
sense_groups.english: No, I just talked to them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打给妈妈

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 咖啡

sense_groups.chinese: 那你… 你有提到我吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you, uh...? Do you talk about me?

sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. All the time. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我信 我想宝宝可以听到所有的声音

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 我可以证明给你看

sense_groups.chinese: 也许有点怪

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 瑞秋

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: Heh. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 我们全都有捐
sense_groups.english: Aw. - We all chipped in.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？ - 你欠我二十块
sense_groups.english: We did? - You owe me 20 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 谢谢大家
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Thank you so much.

sense_groups.english: Chandler, here you go. Got your traditional holiday feast.

sense_groups.chinese: 蕃茄汤
sense_groups.english: Got your tomato soup...

sense_groups.chinese: 香烤起司配菜 还有家庭号的洋葱圈

sense_groups.english: Aw. - Aw, I hate this story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才吃完丰富的感恩节大餐
sense_groups.english: We've just finished Thanksgiving dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我嘴里… 我记得很清楚 还塞满南瓜派
sense_groups.english: I have... And I remember this part vividly. A mouthful of pumpkin pie.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我父母就告诉我 他们要离婚了
sense_groups.english: And this is the moment my parents choose to tell me they're getting divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 一旦你尝过完全相反的滋味 就很难去享受感恩节大餐
sense_groups.english: It's very difficult to enjoy Thanksgiving dinner once you've seen it in reverse.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以前一起工作过 - 有吗？
sense_groups.english: We used to work together. - We did?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 在梅西百货的时候 你就是迷惑香水女孩 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, at Macy's. You're the Obsession girl, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 我就是 "雅男仕" 香水那个
sense_groups.english: Yes. - I was the Aramis guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 雅男仕… - 哦
sense_groups.english: Aramis? Aramis? Aramis? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 是你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说 你是香水这一行最棒的人
sense_groups.english: I gotta tell you, you're the best in the business.

sense_groups.chinese: 别开玩笑了 - 我说真的
sense_groups.english: Get out. - I'm serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很厉害 你就懂何时该喷 何时该往后退
sense_groups.english: You're amazing. You know when to spritz. You know when to lay back.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你不晓得这话对我而言 多么有意义
sense_groups.english: Really? You don't know what that means to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm, mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今夜闻起来真香 你身上的是什么？
sense_groups.english: You smell great tonight. Uh, what are you wearing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我身上什么也没
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你要不要去喝一杯？
sense_groups.english: Listen, do you wanna go get a drink or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我非常愿…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that would be...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 突然想到我另外还有事
sense_groups.english: What's wrong? - I just remembered I have to do something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Oh. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 得离开了
sense_groups.english: Leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下…
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜大家全都看过了
sense_groups.english: So I guess you all saw it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 看过什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - Saw what?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们只是在笑 你也知道 笑声是会传染的
sense_groups.english: No, we're just laughing. You know how laughter can be infectious.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 只好找另一个过节的地方了 整家人都以为我得了性病
sense_groups.english: Set another place for Thanksgiving. My entire family thinks I have VD.

sense_groups.chinese: 今夜的特别节目
sense_groups.english: Tonight, on a very special Blossom.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来不错 好
sense_groups.english: Mm, looking good. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 苹果汁在滚 火鸡在烤 山芋香喷喷…
sense_groups.english: Cider's mulling, turkey's turking, yams are yamming.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正妈妈不在厨房 感觉就不一样
sense_groups.english: It's just not the same without Mom in the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 滚出去 别来烦我
sense_groups.english: Ugh. All right, that's it. Get out of my way and stop annoying me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 这就有点像了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's closer. That's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我买到机票了
sense_groups.english: I got the ticket, I got the ticket.

sense_groups.chinese: 再过五小时 就可以…
sense_groups.english: Five hours from now, shoop, shoop, shoop.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 你不能再咻下去了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you must stop shooping.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要去收拾行李了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna get my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你要进来吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, will you just come in, already?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 我宁可跟这些快乐的活动 保持安全距离
sense_groups.english: No, thank you. I prefer to keep a safe distance from all this merriment.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心 南瓜派来了
sense_groups.english: Look out. Incoming pumpkin pie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以前来这一套我们都会笑 但这可不好笑
sense_groups.english: Okay, we all laughed when you did it with the stuffing, but that's not funny anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我有一个问题 我没看到薯球
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica, I got a question. I don't see any Tater Tots.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不叫问题
sense_groups.english: That's not a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈都会做 那是传统
sense_groups.english: But my mom always makes them. It's like a tradition.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要有一片火鸡肉 一点蔓越橘酱再加一颗薯球啊
sense_groups.english: You get a little piece of turkey on your fork, a little cranberry sauce, and a Tot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 由于我的疾病 害我不能跟家人相聚
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's bad enough I can't be with my family...

sense_groups.chinese: 已经很惨了
sense_groups.english: ...because of my disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 可以
sense_groups.english: All right, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚的马铃薯有做成泥的 有颗粒
sense_groups.english: Tonight's potatoes will be both mashed with lumps...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有做成薯球的
sense_groups.english: ...and in the form of Tots.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要去跟我未出世的孩子谈谈
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm off to talk to my unborn child.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 好 妈妈就不会打人
sense_groups.english: Ah. - Okay, Mom never hit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 全好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, all done.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你有把马铃薯打成…？
sense_groups.english: What? Phoebe, did you whip the pota...?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯要留一些颗粒
sense_groups.english: Ross needs lumps.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我很抱歉 我只有…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Oh, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为我们要弄成泥 然后再加进一些豆子和洋葱
sense_groups.english: I thought we could have them whipped and then add some peas and onions.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么要加？
sense_groups.english: Why would we do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我妈妈死前
sense_groups.english: Then they'd be just like my mom used to make it...

sense_groups.chinese: 都是那样做的
sense_groups.english: ...you know, before she died.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 给你们三种不同风味的马铃薯
sense_groups.english: Okay, three kinds of potatoes coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见了 大家
sense_groups.english: Okay. Goodbye, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢大家
sense_groups.english: Thanks for everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天 你们看… 对不起 很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, look at... Sorry. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议的事件发生了 超狗跑了
sense_groups.english: The most unbelievable thing has happened. Underdog has gotten away.

sense_groups.chinese: 气球超狗？ - 不 不 是真的卡通超狗
sense_groups.english: The balloon? - No, no, the actual cartoon character.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是指气球
sense_groups.english: Of course the balloon.

sense_groups.chinese: 新闻全都在报导 在它抵达梅西百货之前
sense_groups.english: It's all over the news. Before he reached Macy's...

sense_groups.chinese: 它松脱了 被人发现 就要飘过华盛顿广场公园上空
sense_groups.english: ...he broke free and was spotted flying over Washington Square Park.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要到屋顶上去看 谁要跟我去？ - 我不行 我得走了
sense_groups.english: I'm going to the roof. Who's with me? - Well, I can't. I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 一只八十英尺的大狗飘过城市？
sense_groups.english: An 80-foot inflatable dog loose over the city?

sense_groups.chinese: 这种事能有几回？ - 几乎没机会
sense_groups.english: How often does that happen? - Almost never.

sense_groups.chinese: 钥匙拿了吗？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Got the keys? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 随时可以开始
sense_groups.english: Any time you're ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 开始了
sense_groups.english: Okay, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要对着哪里说？我的意思是…
sense_groups.english: Okay, where am I talking to here? I mean, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 有个管道似乎是有听觉上的优势 不过呢…
sense_groups.english: Well, there is one way that seems to offer a certain acoustical advantage, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 对着隆起的部位就可以了
sense_groups.english: Just aim for the bump.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 开始
sense_groups.english: Okay, here goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我没办法
sense_groups.english: You know, I... You know, I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太… 太诡异了 我觉得很蠢
sense_groups.english: This is... It's too weird. I feel stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 那就不要做
sense_groups.english: All right, so don't do it. It's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 别因为苏珊这么做 你就非得也来一下
sense_groups.english: You don't have to do it just because Susan does it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 宝宝 哈罗 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello, baby. Hello, hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们眼看着超狗的影子往公园坠的那种感觉
sense_groups.english: That moment when we first saw the giant dog shadow fall over the park?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们干嘛非得把它打下来？真的很残酷
sense_groups.english: But did they have to shoot him down? I mean, that was just mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在火鸡应该是外脆…
sense_groups.english: Okay, right about now the turkey should be crispy on the outside...

sense_groups.chinese: 内多汁了
sense_groups.english: ...and juicy on the inside.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们干嘛还站在这里？
sense_groups.english: Why are we standing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在等你开门 你有拿钥匙
sense_groups.english: We're waiting for you to open the door. You've got the keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 有 你有 我们要出门时 你说 "钥匙拿了"
sense_groups.english: Yes, you do. When we left, you said, "Got the keys."

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有 我是问 "钥匙拿了吗？"
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't. I asked, "Got the keys?"

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 你是说 "钥匙拿了"
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. You said, "Got the keys."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们谁有钥匙吗？
sense_groups.english: Either of you have the keys?

sense_groups.chinese: 炉子还开着 - 我得拿我的机票
sense_groups.english: The oven is on. - Oh, I've gotta get my ticket.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我们有你们的备用钥匙 - 快去拿
sense_groups.english: Wait. We have a copy of your key. - Well, then get it, get it!

sense_groups.chinese: 这种口气也不能让我快一点
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. That tone won't make me go any faster.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 这倒可以
sense_groups.english: Joey. - That one will.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都对我说
sense_groups.english: And everyone's telling me

sense_groups.chinese: "你得挑一门主修的"
sense_groups.english: "You gotta pick a major. You gotta pick a major."

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我就鼓起勇气 选了古生物学
sense_groups.english: So on a dare, I picked paleontology.

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本不晓得我在说什么 面对现实吧 你只是一个胎儿
sense_groups.english: And you have no idea what I'm saying, because, let's face it, you're a fetus.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只会很开心 你没有腮了
sense_groups.english: You're just happy you don't have gills anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用一直对他说话 你可以用唱的…
sense_groups.english: Look, you don't have to talk to it. You can sing to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我才不要对着你的肚子唱歌 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. I am not singing to your stomach, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 还顺利吗？ - 嘘…
sense_groups.english: How's it going? - Shh, shh, shh.

sense_groups.chinese: # 我们来了 #
sense_groups.english: # Here we come #

sense_groups.chinese: # 穿过街道 #
sense_groups.english: # Walkin' down the street #

sense_groups.chinese: # 看人们有趣的样子 #
sense_groups.english: # Get the funniest looks from Everyone we meet #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你有感觉到吗？ - 有
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, did you just feel that? - I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 一直都有…？ - 不 这是第一次
sense_groups.english: Well, does it always, uh...? - No, no, that was the first.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续唱 继续唱 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Keep singing. Keep singing. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 你是我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, you're my baby

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及要见到你
sense_groups.english: And I can't wait to meet you

sense_groups.chinese: 等你出来了 我要给你买个贝果 然后再一起去动物园
sense_groups.english: When you come out I'll buy you a bagel And then we'll go to the zoo

sense_groups.chinese: 这次我有感觉到
sense_groups.english: I felt it that time.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 我是你的爹地
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, I'm your daddy

sense_groups.chinese: 我是那个没有胸部的爹地
sense_groups.english: I'm the one without any breasts

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那支 - 你们可以快一点吗？
sense_groups.english: Nope, not that one. - Can you go any faster with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有一个钥匙洞 却有一大堆钥匙
sense_groups.english: Hey, I got one keyhole and about a zillion keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己想想
sense_groups.english: You do the math.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们干嘛保存一大堆钥匙？
sense_groups.english: Why do you guys have so many keys in there anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是为了应付这类紧急状况
sense_groups.english: For an emergency just like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你这嘻皮笑脸的
sense_groups.english: All right, listen, smirky.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是因为你的笨气球
sense_groups.english: If it wasn't for your stupid balloon...

sense_groups.chinese: 我早就上飞机 看着一个女人这样做了
sense_groups.english: ...I would be on a plane, watching a woman do this right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我没有
sense_groups.english: But I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你有钥匙的
sense_groups.english: I swear you said you had the keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有 我没钥匙就不会说我有
sense_groups.english: No. I wouldn't say I had the keys unless I had the keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我显然没有钥匙
sense_groups.english: And I obviously did not have the keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 不要再说钥匙了 统统不准说钥匙
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right, that's it. Enough with the keys. No one say "keys."

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么可能会有钥匙？
sense_groups.english: Why would I have the keys?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你说你有
sense_groups.english: Aside from the fact that you said you did?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没说 - 你应该有
sense_groups.english: But I didn't. - Well, you should have.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为…
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？因为一切都是我的责任吗？
sense_groups.english: Why? Because everything is my responsibility?

sense_groups.chinese: 我都负责煮晚饭了还不够？
sense_groups.english: Isn't it enough that I'm making Thanksgiving dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都要不一样的马铃薯 所以我就全做了
sense_groups.english: Everyone wants a different kind of potato, so I'm making different kinds of potatoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是有谁在乎我要哪种马铃薯？
sense_groups.english: You know, does anybody care what kind of potatoes I want?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 没有 没有
sense_groups.english: No, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 只要菲比有她的豆子跟洋葱
sense_groups.english: You know, just as long as Phoebe gets her peas and onions...

sense_groups.chinese: 马利欧先生有薯球…
sense_groups.english: ...and Mario gets his Tots.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的第一个感恩节晚餐 我…
sense_groups.english: It's my first Thanksgiving, and I...

sense_groups.chinese: 全都搞砸了 我没能…
sense_groups.english: It's all burnt, and I can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 现在只有狗听懂你的话
sense_groups.english: Okay, Monica, only dogs can hear you now, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 门开了 我们进去了
sense_groups.english: Look, the door's open. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Ooh. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 火鸡烤焦了
sense_groups.english: Well, the turkey's burnt.

sense_groups.chinese: 马铃薯毁了 马铃薯毁了 马铃薯毁了
sense_groups.english: Potatoes are ruined. Potatoes are ruined. Potatoes are ruined.

sense_groups.chinese: # 我们来了 #
sense_groups.english: # Here we come #

sense_groups.chinese: # 穿过… #
sense_groups.english: # Walkin' down the... #

sense_groups.chinese: 这味道不像妈妈的厨房
sense_groups.english: This doesn't smell like Mom's.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不像 对吧？你要有颗粒的？
sense_groups.english: No, it doesn't, does it? But you wanted lumps, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 给你 兄弟 这就是你的颗粒
sense_groups.english: Well, here you go, buddy. You got one.

sense_groups.chinese: 天 这下可好
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, this is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 飞机跑了 我想我只好跟你们留在这里了
sense_groups.english: The plane is gone, so I guess I'm stuck here with you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我们都有较好的计划 这又不是大家的首选
sense_groups.english: Hey, we all had better plans, okay? This was nobody's first choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 那我干嘛忙得要死
sense_groups.english: So why was I busting my ass...

sense_groups.chinese: 想弄出一顿美味的大餐？
sense_groups.english: ...to make this delicious Thanksgiving dinner?!

sense_groups.chinese: 这叫美味吗？ - 给我闭嘴
sense_groups.english: You call that delicious? - You be quiet!

sense_groups.chinese: 别吵了 别吵了 别吵了
sense_groups.english: All right, stop it, stop it, stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样子感觉才像感恩节
sense_groups.english: Now, this feels like Thanksgiving.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Ew. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 丑陋的裸男 从烤箱里把他的火鸡拿出来了
sense_groups.english: Ugly Naked Guy's taking his turkey out of the oven.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天 他有人陪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. He's not alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 丑陋的裸男…
sense_groups.english: Ugly Naked Guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟丑陋的裸女 共享感恩大餐
sense_groups.english: ...is having Thanksgiving dinner with Ugly Naked Gal.

sense_groups.chinese: 这我得瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: I gotta see this.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Aw.

questions.en:
Guys? There's, uh, somebody I'd like you to meet.
Wait, wait. What is that?
That would be Marcel. You wanna say hi?
No. No, I don't.
Oh, he is precious. Where did you get him?
My friend Bethel rescued him from some lab.
That is so cruel.
Why? Why would a parent name their child Bethel?
Hey, that monkey's got a Ross on his ass.
Ross, is he gonna live with you, like, in your apartment?
Yeah. I mean, it's been kind of quiet since Carol left, so...
Why don't you just get a roommate?
Ah, I don't know. You reach a certain age...
...having a roommate is just kind of pathe...
Uh, sorry, that's "pathet," which is Sanskrit for "really cool way to live."
You guys, I'm doing all-new material tonight.
I have 12 new songs about my mother's suicide...
...and one about a snowman.
Might want to open with the snowman.
Hey, Joey. - Hey.
Hey, Joe. - So how'd it go?
Ah, I didn't get the job.
How could you not get it? You were Santa last year.
I don't know. Some fat guy's sleeping with the store manager.
He's not even jolly. It's all political.
So, what are you gonna be?
I'm gonna be one of his helpers.
It's just such a slap in the face, you know?
Do you guys know what you're doing for New Year's?
Gee, what? What is wrong with New Year's?
Nothing for you. You have Paolo.
You don't have to face the horrible pressures of this holiday...
...desperate scramble to find anything with lips...
...just so can have somebody to kiss when the ball drops. Man, I'm talking loud.
Well, for your information, Paolo's gonna be in Rome this New Year's.
So I'll be just as pathetic as the rest of you.
Yeah, you wish.
It's just that I'm sick of being a victim of this Dick Clark holiday.
I say this year, no dates, we make a pact.
Just the six of us. Dinner.
Sure. - Fine.
You know, I was hoping for a little more enthusiasm.
Woo! - Okay.
Phoebe, you're on. - Oh. Oh, good.
Okay, hi. Ladies and gentlemen, back by popular demand...
...Miss Phoebe Buffay.
Thanks. Hi.
Um, ahem, I want to start with a song that means a lot to me this time of year.
I made a man with eyes of coal
And a smile so bewitchin'
How was I supposed to know
That my mom was dead in the kitchen?
La-la-la
My mother's ashes
Even her eyelashes
Are resting in a little yellow jar
And sometimes when it's freezing - I'm being honest here.
You don't agree.
I feel a little sneezy - You're right.
And now I... Excuse me? Excuse me?
Yeah, noisy boys.
Is it something that you'd like to share with the group?
No. No, that's okay.
Come on, if it's important enough to discuss while I'm playing...
...then I assume it's important enough for everyone else to hear.
That guy's going home with a note.
Nothing. I was just saying... - Could you speak up?
Sorry.
I was just saying to my friend, you were the most beautiful woman I'd ever seen.
And you said Daryl Hannah... - Darryl Hannah.
...was the most beautiful woman that he'd ever seen in his life.
And I said, yeah, I liked her in Splash, but not so much in Wall Street.
I thought she had a hard quality. - A hard quality.
And, uh, while Daryl Hannah is beautiful in a conventional way...
...you are, uh, luminous with a kind of delicate grace.
Then that's when you started yelling.
Okay, we're gonna take a short break.
I think that guy's going home with more than a note.
Come here, Marcel. Sit here.
Pheebs, I can't believe he hasn't kissed you yet.
I mean, God, by my sixth date with Paolo...
...I mean, he had already named both my breasts.
Ooh, did I just share too much?
Just a smidge.
David's, like, you know, a scientist guy. He's very methodical.
I think it's romantic. - Me too. Oh!
Did you ever see An Officer and a Gentleman?
Yeah.
Well, he's kind of like the guy I went to see that with.
Except...
Except he's smarter and gentler and sweeter.
I just... I just want to be with him all the time.
You know, day and night. And night and day.
And special occasions.
Wait a minute. I see where this is going. You're gonna ask him to New Year's.
You're gonna break the pact. She's gonna break the pact.
No, no, no.
Yeah, could I just?
Yeah, because I already asked Janice. - You what?
Come on, this was a pact. This was your pact.
I snapped, okay? I couldn't handle the pressure and I snapped.
Yeah, but Janice? That was, like, the worst breakup in history.
I'm not saying it was a good idea. I'm saying I snapped.
Hi. Hi, sorry I'm late.
Too many jokes.
Must mock Joey.
Nice shoes, huh?
Aah, you're killing me.
Ross. He's playing with my spatulas again.
Look, he's not gonna hurt them, right?
Do you always have to bring him here?
Look, I didn't want to leave him alone, all right?
We had our first fight this morning.
I think it has to do with my working late. I said some things that I didn't mean.
He threw some feces.
You know, if you're gonna work late, I can look in on him for you.
Oh, that would be great. Okay.
But if you do, make sure it seems like you're there to see him, okay?
And you're not, like, doing it as a favor to me.
Okay. But if he asks, I'm not going to lie.
But you can't actually test this theory.
Because today's particle accelerators are nowhere near powerful enough...
...to simulate these conditions.
Okay. All right. I have a question then. - Yeah.
Were you planning on kissing me ever?
Uh, that's definitely a valid question...
...and, uh, the answer...
...would be yes.
Yes, I was.
But see, I wanted it to be this phenomenal kiss...
...that happened at this phenomenal moment because, well, it's you.
Sure. Yeah.
Right. But, see, the longer I waited, the more phenomenal the kiss had to be.
And now, we've reached a place...
...where it's just got to be one of those things where I...
...sweep everything off the table and throw you down on it.
And I'm not really a sweeping sort of fella.
Oh, David, I think you are a sweeping sort of fella.
I mean, you're a sweeper trapped inside a physicist's body.
Really. - Oh, yeah. I'm sure of it.
You should just do it. Just sweep and throw me. Heh.
Now? Now? - Right now. Just...
Okay. Okay, okay.
You know what? This is just really expensive.
Okay. And I'll tell you, this was a gift.
So now you're just kind of tidying up. - Okay, what the hell? What the hell?
You want me to actually throw you...? - I can hop.
Now, tell me something, what does the phase "no-date pact" mean to you?

I thought I'd ask Fun Bobby.

You know more than one Fun Bobby?
I happen to know a Fun Bob.
Okay. Here we go.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. There's no room for milk.
There. Now there is.

...three of you now are gonna have dates.
Uh, four. - Four.
Five. - Five.
Sorry. Paolo's catching an earlier flight.
Yeah, and I met this really hot single mom at the store. Ha, ha.
What's an elf to do?
Okay, so I'm gonna be the only one standing there alone...
...when the ball drops?
Oh, come on. We'll have a big party, and no one will know who's with who.
Hey, you know, this is so not what I needed now.
What's the matter? - Oh, it's Marcel.
He keeps shutting me out, you know?
He's walking around all the time, dragging his hands.
That's so weird. I had such a blast with him the other night.
Really? - Yeah, we played. We watched TV.
That juggling thing is amazing.
What, uh?
What juggling thing?
With the balled-up socks? I figured you taught him that.
No.
You know, it wasn't that big a deal. I mean, just balled-up socks.
And a melon.
Phoebe. Hi. - Hi, Max. Do you know everybody?
No. Have you seen David?
No, he hasn't been around.
Well, if you see him, tell him to pack his bags. We are going to Minsk.
Minsk? - Minsk. It's in Russia.
I know where Minsk is.
Ha, ha. We got the grant.
Three years, all expenses paid.
So when do you leave?
January 1 st.
Hello?
Hey. Hi. Hi. - Hi.
What are you doing here? - Um, well, Max told me about Minsk.
So you know, congratulations. This is so exciting!
Yeah.
It'd be even more exciting, if we were going.
Oh, you're not going? Oh, why?
Tell her, David.
"I don't want to go to Minsk to work with Lipson and Yamaguchi and Flank.
No, no, no. I want to stay here and make out with my girlfriend."
Okay, thank you, Max. Thank you.
So you're really not going?
I don't know. I don't know what I'm gonna do. I just...
You decide.
Oh, don't do that. - Please?
No, but I'm asking you. I can't make a decision.
I can't. Please, just... - Okay. Stay.
Stay. - Stay.
Getting so good at that.
It was Max's stuff.
I love this artichoke thing.
Oh, don't tell me what's in it. The diet starts tomorrow.
You remember Janice.
Vividly.
Hi. - Hi, I'm Sandy.
Sandy, hi. Come on in. Hey.
Ha, ha.
You brought your kids. - Yeah. That's okay, right?
Party.
That thing is not coming in here.
"That thing"? This is how you greet guests at a party?
Let me ask you something. If I showed up with my new girlfriend...
...she wouldn't be welcome?
I'm thinking your new girlfriend wouldn't urinate on my coffee table.
He was more embarrassed about that than anyone.
Okay? And for him to have the courage to walk back in here...
...like nothing happened...
All right. All right. Just keep him away from me.
Thank you. Come on, Marcel.
What do you say you and I do a little mingling?
All right, I'll, uh, catch up with you later.
Oh, my gosh. Rachel, honey...
...are you okay? Where's Paolo?
Rome. Jerk missed his flight.
And then your face exploded?
No. Okay.
I was at the airport getting into a cab...
...when this woman...
...this blond planet with a pocketbook...
...starts yelling at me.
Something about how it was her cab first.
And the next thing I know, she just starts pulling me out by my hair.
And I started blowing my attack whistle thingy...
...and then three more cabs show up.
So as I'm going to get into a cab, she tackles me.
And I hit my head on the curb and cut my lip on my whistle.
Oh! Everybody having fun at the party?
Are people eating my dip?
You know, when I saw you at the store last week...
...it was probably the first time I ever mentally undressed an elf.
Wow, that's, uh, dirty.
Ha, ha. - Yeah.
Hey, kids.
Look at him. I'm not saying he has to spend the whole evening with me...
...but at least check in.
There you are.
You got away from me.
But you found me.
Here, Ross, take our picture.
Smile. You're on Janice Camera.
Kill me. Kill me now. Ha, ha.
Everybody, it's Fun Bobby!
Fun Bobby!
Hey, Bobby.
Hey, sorry I'm late. But my, uh, grandfather...
...died about two hours ago.
But I couldn't get a flight out till tomorrow, so...
...here I am.
Hey, Fun Bobby. How's it going, man?
Whoa. Who died?
It's going to be an open casket, you know?
So at least I'll get to see him again.
I'm gonna blow this one up and I'm gonna write "Reunited" in glitter.
All right, Janice, that's it!
Janice? Janice? Ahem.
Hey, Janice?
When I invited you to this party, I didn't think it meant that we...
Oh, no.
I'm sorry you misunderstood. - Oh, my God.
You listen to me, Chandler. You listen to me.
One of these times, it's just gonna be your last chance with me.
Oh, will you give me the thing?
Hi, Max. - Yoko.
I've decided to go to Minsk without you.

Somebody kiss me. It's midnight. Somebody kiss me. It's midnight.

There.
I wanted this to work so much.
I'm still in there, you know?
Changing his diapers. Picking his fleas.
But he's just phoning it in.
It's just so hard to accept that something you love so much...
...doesn't love you back, you know?
I think that bitch cracked my tooth.
