sense_groups.english: Why don't you just get a roommate?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我觉得到了某种年纪…
sense_groups.english: Ah, I don't know. You reach a certain age...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟室友住有点可悲
sense_groups.english: ...having a roommate is just kind of pathe...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我的意思是说 是很酷的生活方式
sense_groups.english: Uh, sorry, that's "pathet," which is Sanskrit for "really cool way to live."

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 我今晚唱的 都是新写的歌
sense_groups.english: You guys, I'm doing all-new material tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 有十二首有关我母亲自杀的新歌
sense_groups.english: I have 12 new songs about my mother's suicide...

sense_groups.chinese: 一首讲的是雪人
sense_groups.english: ...and one about a snowman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好用雪人那首开场
sense_groups.english: Might want to open with the snowman.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔 - 结果怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe. - So how'd it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没拿到工作
sense_groups.english: Ah, I didn't get the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能？你是去年的圣诞老公公耶
sense_groups.english: How could you not get it? You were Santa last year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 某个胖子跟店经理上床
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Some fat guy's sleeping with the store manager.

sense_groups.chinese: 他根本无法逗人开心 这就是政治
sense_groups.english: He's not even jolly. It's all political.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你要当什么？
sense_groups.english: So, what are you gonna be?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会当他的助手之一
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be one of his helpers.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是个耻辱
sense_groups.english: It's just such a slap in the face, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都知道新年要做什么了吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you guys know what you're doing for New Year's?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？新年有什么问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Gee, what? What is wrong with New Year's?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是没有 你有巴洛
sense_groups.english: Nothing for you. You have Paolo.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用面对那可怕的节庆压力…
sense_groups.english: You don't have to face the horrible pressures of this holiday...

sense_groups.chinese: 亟需寻找有嘴唇的生物…
sense_groups.english: ...desperate scramble to find anything with lips...

sense_groups.chinese: 在球落下的那一刻 有个可以亲嘴的对象 我真大声
sense_groups.english: ...just so can have somebody to kiss when the ball drops. Man, I'm talking loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 巴洛新年时 人会在罗马
sense_groups.english: Well, for your information, Paolo's gonna be in Rome this New Year's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会跟你们一样可悲
sense_groups.english: So I'll be just as pathetic as the rest of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想得美
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you wish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受够了这个节日的疲劳轰炸
sense_groups.english: It's just that I'm sick of being a victim of this Dick Clark holiday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我提议今年不要找伴 大家作个约定
sense_groups.english: I say this year, no dates, we make a pact.

sense_groups.chinese: 就我们六个人 一起吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Just the six of us. Dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望大家的反应 能热烈一点
sense_groups.english: You know, I was hoping for a little more enthusiasm.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 - 好
sense_groups.english: Woo! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 轮到你了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you're on. - Oh. Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 因应观众热烈的要求…
sense_groups.english: Okay, hi. Ladies and gentlemen, back by popular demand...

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家欢迎菲比•布非
sense_groups.english: ...Miss Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢大家
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 一开始我想先唱首 在这个佳节对我意义重大的歌曲
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem, I want to start with a song that means a lot to me this time of year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了一个人 眼睛是煤炭做的
sense_groups.english: I made a man with eyes of coal

sense_groups.chinese: 他有谜一样般的微笑
sense_groups.english: And a smile so bewitchin'

sense_groups.chinese: 我要怎么知道
sense_groups.english: How was I supposed to know

sense_groups.chinese: 我母亲死在厨房的事实？
sense_groups.english: That my mom was dead in the kitchen?

sense_groups.chinese: 啦…
sense_groups.english: La-la-la

sense_groups.chinese: 我母亲的骨灰
sense_groups.english: My mother's ashes

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至是她的睫毛
sense_groups.english: Even her eyelashes

sense_groups.chinese: 安放在一个黄色的小坛子
sense_groups.english: Are resting in a little yellow jar

sense_groups.chinese: 有时天寒地冻 - 我是老实说
sense_groups.english: And sometimes when it's freezing - I'm being honest here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不同意
sense_groups.english: You don't agree.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有点想打喷嚏 - 你说得没错
sense_groups.english: I feel a little sneezy - You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我… 不好意思…
sense_groups.english: And now I... Excuse me? Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 吵闹的男士
sense_groups.english: Yeah, noisy boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有事情想跟大家分享吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it something that you'd like to share with the group?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 没事
sense_groups.english: No. No, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有事情如此重要 非得在我弹奏时讨论…
sense_groups.english: Come on, if it's important enough to discuss while I'm playing...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就应该是重要到 值得与大家分享
sense_groups.english: ...then I assume it's important enough for everyone else to hear.

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙回家后一定会记得这教训
sense_groups.english: That guy's going home with a note.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是说… - 可以请你大声点吗？
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I was just saying... - Could you speak up?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在跟我朋友说 你是我见过最美丽的女人
sense_groups.english: I was just saying to my friend, you were the most beautiful woman I'd ever seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说黛瑞•汉娜… - 黛瑞•汉娜
sense_groups.english: And you said Daryl Hannah... - Darryl Hannah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是他看过最美丽的女性
sense_groups.english: ...was the most beautiful woman that he'd ever seen in his life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我喜欢她在《美人鱼》的演出 《华尔街》就还好
sense_groups.english: And I said, yeah, I liked her in Splash, but not so much in Wall Street.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有种强硬气质 - 强硬特质
sense_groups.english: I thought she had a hard quality. - A hard quality.

sense_groups.chinese: 黛瑞•汉娜是传统的美…
sense_groups.english: And, uh, while Daryl Hannah is beautiful in a conventional way...

sense_groups.chinese: 你则是散发出高雅的气质
sense_groups.english: ...you are, uh, luminous with a kind of delicate grace.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你就开始大吼了
sense_groups.english: Then that's when you started yelling.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们休息片刻
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're gonna take a short break.

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙带回家的 应该不只是教训而已
sense_groups.english: I think that guy's going home with more than a note.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 马塞尔 坐着
sense_groups.english: Come here, Marcel. Sit here.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我不敢相信 他还没亲你
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, I can't believe he hasn't kissed you yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟巴洛约会六次后…
sense_groups.english: I mean, God, by my sixth date with Paolo...

sense_groups.chinese: 他已经替我的胸部取小名了
sense_groups.english: ...I mean, he had already named both my breasts.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是说太多了？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, did I just share too much?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点点啦
sense_groups.english: Just a smidge.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫是个科学家 做事一丝不苟
sense_groups.english: David's, like, you know, a scientist guy. He's very methodical.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很浪漫 - 我也这么觉得
sense_groups.english: I think it's romantic. - Me too. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有没有看过《军官与绅士》？
sense_groups.english: Did you ever see An Officer and a Gentleman?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就像陪我去看那部电影的男生
sense_groups.english: Well, he's kind of like the guy I went to see that with.

sense_groups.chinese: 除了…
sense_groups.english: Except...

sense_groups.chinese: 他更聪明 温柔而且贴心
sense_groups.english: Except he's smarter and gentler and sweeter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想一直和他在一起
sense_groups.english: I just... I just want to be with him all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 日以继夜 夜以继日
sense_groups.english: You know, day and night. And night and day.

sense_groups.chinese: 特殊节日也是
sense_groups.english: And special occasions.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我懂了 你要邀他共度新年
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. I see where this is going. You're gonna ask him to New Year's.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要毁约 抛弃我们
sense_groups.english: You're gonna break the pact. She's gonna break the pact.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 有啦 我可以吗… ？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, could I just?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 因为我已经邀了珍妮丝 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, because I already asked Janice. - You what?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 这是你订的约定耶
sense_groups.english: Come on, this was a pact. This was your pact.

sense_groups.chinese: 我耐不住 我毁约了
sense_groups.english: I snapped, okay? I couldn't handle the pressure and I snapped.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是珍妮丝？你们的分手糟透了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but Janice? That was, like, the worst breakup in history.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说这是好主意 我只是毁约了
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying it was a good idea. I'm saying I snapped.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思我迟到了
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi, sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 太多笑话了
sense_groups.english: Too many jokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要取笑乔伊
sense_groups.english: Must mock Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的鞋子吧？
sense_groups.english: Nice shoes, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我快笑死了
sense_groups.english: Aah, you're killing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他又在玩我的锅铲了
sense_groups.english: Ross. He's playing with my spatulas again.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不会伤害它们 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, he's not gonna hurt them, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要把他带来这里吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you always have to bring him here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想把他单独留在家
sense_groups.english: Look, I didn't want to leave him alone, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今早吵了第一次架
sense_groups.english: We had our first fight this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得是因为我加班的关系 我说了不该说的话
sense_groups.english: I think it has to do with my working late. I said some things that I didn't mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就朝我扔一坨屎
sense_groups.english: He threw some feces.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你加班 我可以替你照顾他
sense_groups.english: You know, if you're gonna work late, I can look in on him for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 好…
sense_groups.english: Oh, that would be great. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你去 一定要假装 你是去找他
sense_groups.english: But if you do, make sure it seems like you're there to see him, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 而不是帮我忙
sense_groups.english: And you're not, like, doing it as a favor to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但是他如果问 我就要直话直说了
sense_groups.english: Okay. But if he asks, I'm not going to lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们仍无法测试这个理论
sense_groups.english: But you can't actually test this theory.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为现今粒子加速器的速度…
sense_groups.english: Because today's particle accelerators are nowhere near powerful enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 仍无法模拟出这样的情况
sense_groups.english: ...to simulate these conditions.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我有个问题 - 请说
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. I have a question then. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有打算要亲我吗？
sense_groups.english: Were you planning on kissing me ever?

sense_groups.chinese: 非常合理的问题…
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's definitely a valid question...

sense_groups.chinese: 答案是…
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, the answer...

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: ...would be yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有这个打算
sense_groups.english: Yes, I was.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我要这非凡的吻…
sense_groups.english: But see, I wanted it to be this phenomenal kiss...

sense_groups.chinese: 发生在非凡的时刻 因为是要亲你
sense_groups.english: ...that happened at this phenomenal moment because, well, it's you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是我等得愈久 这个亲吻得更加非凡
sense_groups.english: Right. But, see, the longer I waited, the more phenomenal the kiss had to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在 已经变成…
sense_groups.english: And now, we've reached a place...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得…
sense_groups.english: ...where it's just got to be one of those things where I...

sense_groups.chinese: 把桌子的东西都扫光 把你丢上去
sense_groups.english: ...sweep everything off the table and throw you down on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我并不是那样的人
sense_groups.english: And I'm not really a sweeping sort of fella.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 我认为你正是那样的人
sense_groups.english: Oh, David, I think you are a sweeping sort of fella.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是你困在物理学家的体内罢了
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're a sweeper trapped inside a physicist's body.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 没错 我很肯定
sense_groups.english: Really. - Oh, yeah. I'm sure of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 就来吧 扫掉一切 把我丢上去
sense_groups.english: You should just do it. Just sweep and throw me. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在做吗？ - 就是现在…
sense_groups.english: Now? Now? - Right now. Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 这个很贵
sense_groups.english: You know what? This is just really expensive.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这个是礼物
sense_groups.english: Okay. And I'll tell you, this was a gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在比较像在打扫 - 好吧 管他的
sense_groups.english: So now you're just kind of tidying up. - Okay, what the hell? What the hell?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我把你丢上去还是你自己跳？ - 我可以跳
sense_groups.english: You want me to actually throw you...? - I can hop.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我 "没有约会的约定" 对你们的意义如何？
sense_groups.english: Now, tell me something, what does the phase "no-date pact" mean to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是钱德约了人 菲比也约了人
sense_groups.english: It's just that Chandler has somebody and Phoebe has somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就想说问问好笑巴比
sense_groups.english: I thought I'd ask Fun Bobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的前男友 好笑巴比？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Fun Bobby, your ex-boyfriend, Fun Bobby? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还知道第二个好笑巴比吗？
sense_groups.english: You know more than one Fun Bobby?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚好还认识一个好笑巴伯
sense_groups.english: I happen to know a Fun Bob.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有空间加牛奶了
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. There's no room for milk.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 现在有了
sense_groups.english: There. Now there is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 在没有约会的夜晚…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so on our no-date evening...

sense_groups.chinese: 三个人都有约会了
sense_groups.english: ...three of you now are gonna have dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 四个 - 四个
sense_groups.english: Uh, four. - Four.

sense_groups.chinese: 五个 - 五个
sense_groups.english: Five. - Five.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 巴洛要搭早一点的班机回来
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Paolo's catching an earlier flight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在店里遇见一位很辣的单亲妈妈
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I met this really hot single mom at the store. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然小精灵还能做什么？
sense_groups.english: What's an elf to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以球落下的时候…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I'm gonna be the only one standing there alone...

sense_groups.chinese: 只有我会孤单一人？
sense_groups.english: ...when the ball drops?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我们会办个大派对 没有人会知道谁的伴是谁
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. We'll have a big party, and no one will know who's with who.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在真的不需要应付这些
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know, this is so not what I needed now.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 噢 是马塞尔
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - Oh, it's Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 他一直拒我于门外
sense_groups.english: He keeps shutting me out, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 老是拖着双手 走来走去
sense_groups.english: He's walking around all the time, dragging his hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 太奇怪了 我前几晚 跟他玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: That's so weird. I had such a blast with him the other night.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是啊 我们一起玩 还看电视
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, we played. We watched TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 杂耍那部分实在太棒了
sense_groups.english: That juggling thing is amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么… ？
sense_groups.english: What, uh?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么杂耍？
sense_groups.english: What juggling thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 拿袜子当球耍啊 我以为是你教的
sense_groups.english: With the balled-up socks? I figured you taught him that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实没什么大不了的 只是袜子球而已
sense_groups.english: You know, it wasn't that big a deal. I mean, just balled-up socks.

sense_groups.chinese: 和一颗香瓜
sense_groups.english: And a melon.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你好 - 嗨 麦克斯 你认识大家了吗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. Hi. - Hi, Max. Do you know everybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 不认识 你有看到大卫吗？
sense_groups.english: No. Have you seen David?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 他不在
sense_groups.english: No, he hasn't been around.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果看到他 叫他打包 我们要去明斯克了
sense_groups.english: Well, if you see him, tell him to pack his bags. We are going to Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 明斯克？ - 明斯克在俄罗斯
sense_groups.english: Minsk? - Minsk. It's in Russia.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道明斯克在哪里
sense_groups.english: I know where Minsk is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们拿到赞助金
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. We got the grant.

sense_groups.chinese: 全额赞助我们三年
sense_groups.english: Three years, all expenses paid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们什么时候走？
sense_groups.english: So when do you leave?

sense_groups.chinese: 一月一号
sense_groups.english: January 1 st.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi. Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么来了？ - 麦克斯跟我说了明斯克的事
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? - Um, well, Max told me about Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来恭喜你的 实在太令人兴奋了
sense_groups.english: So you know, congratulations. This is so exciting!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们要去 就更兴奋了
sense_groups.english: It'd be even more exciting, if we were going.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去吗？为什么啊？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're not going? Oh, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她说啊 大卫
sense_groups.english: Tell her, David.

sense_groups.chinese: "我不想去明斯克 和李波森 山口及法兰克工作"
sense_groups.english: "I don't want to go to Minsk to work with Lipson and Yamaguchi and Flank.

sense_groups.chinese: "不 我想留在这里 和我的女友亲热"
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I want to stay here and make out with my girlfriend."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢你 麦克斯
sense_groups.english: Okay, thank you, Max. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你真的不去吗？
sense_groups.english: So you're really not going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我不知道怎么办…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I don't know what I'm gonna do. I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 由你决定
sense_groups.english: You decide.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 - 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't do that. - Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在问你 我无法做决定
sense_groups.english: No, but I'm asking you. I can't make a decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法 拜托你… - 好 留下来
sense_groups.english: I can't. Please, just... - Okay. Stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 留下来 - 留下来
sense_groups.english: Stay. - Stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你愈来愈厉害了
sense_groups.english: Getting so good at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 都是麦克斯的东西
sense_groups.english: It was Max's stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱这个朝鲜蓟喔
sense_groups.english: I love this artichoke thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要告诉我里面有什么 我明天才开始节食
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't tell me what's in it. The diet starts tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得珍妮丝吧？
sense_groups.english: You remember Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 历历在目
sense_groups.english: Vividly.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 我是珊蒂
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi, I'm Sandy.

sense_groups.chinese: 珊蒂 嗨 进来吧
sense_groups.english: Sandy, hi. Come on in. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把孩子带来了 - 对 可以吧？
sense_groups.english: You brought your kids. - Yeah. That's okay, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 派对
sense_groups.english: Party.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个东西不能进来
sense_groups.english: That thing is not coming in here.

sense_groups.chinese: "那个东西"？你是这样接待客人的吗？
sense_groups.english: "That thing"? This is how you greet guests at a party?

sense_groups.chinese: 我问问你 如果我是和我的新女友来…
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you something. If I showed up with my new girlfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 她在这里也会不受欢迎吗？
sense_groups.english: ...she wouldn't be welcome?

sense_groups.chinese: 可是你的新女友 不会在我的茶几洒尿
sense_groups.english: I'm thinking your new girlfriend wouldn't urinate on my coffee table.

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事情 他比任何人都感到丢脸
sense_groups.english: He was more embarrassed about that than anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？他有这样的勇气 回到这里…
sense_groups.english: Okay? And for him to have the courage to walk back in here...

sense_groups.chinese: 假装没事发生过…
sense_groups.english: ...like nothing happened...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不要让他靠近我就对了
sense_groups.english: All right. All right. Just keep him away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 来吧 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Come on, Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们和大家交际一下吧
sense_groups.english: What do you say you and I do a little mingling?

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 我们之后再见
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll, uh, catch up with you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my gosh. Rachel, honey...

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？巴洛人呢？
sense_groups.english: ...are you okay? Where's Paolo?

sense_groups.chinese: 在罗马 这混帐错过班机
sense_groups.english: Rome. Jerk missed his flight.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你的脸就爆炸了？
sense_groups.english: And then your face exploded?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 好吧
sense_groups.english: No. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在机场准备上计程车…
sense_groups.english: I was at the airport getting into a cab...

sense_groups.chinese: 有个女人…
sense_groups.english: ...when this woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 带着笔记本的金发女人…
sense_groups.english: ...this blond planet with a pocketbook...

sense_groups.chinese: 开始对我大吼
sense_groups.english: ...starts yelling at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 说是她先叫到计程车的
sense_groups.english: Something about how it was her cab first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没意识过来 她就开始扯我的头发
sense_groups.english: And the next thing I know, she just starts pulling me out by my hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始吹我的口哨…
sense_groups.english: And I started blowing my attack whistle thingy...

sense_groups.chinese: 又有三台计程车出现
sense_groups.english: ...and then three more cabs show up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要进去计程车时 她又展开攻击
sense_groups.english: So as I'm going to get into a cab, she tackles me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的头撞到路边 嘴唇被哨子割伤
sense_groups.english: And I hit my head on the curb and cut my lip on my whistle.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家在派对 都玩得愉快吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh! Everybody having fun at the party?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人吃我做的沾酱吗？
sense_groups.english: Are people eating my dip?

sense_groups.chinese: 我上个礼拜 在店里看到你时…
sense_groups.english: You know, when I saw you at the store last week...

sense_groups.chinese: 大概是我第一次 在心里脱掉小精灵的衣服
sense_groups.english: ...it was probably the first time I ever mentally undressed an elf.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真淫荡
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's, uh, dirty.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 - 对
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 孩子们
sense_groups.english: Hey, kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看他 我不要求他整晚陪我
sense_groups.english: Look at him. I'm not saying he has to spend the whole evening with me...

sense_groups.chinese: 但至少关心我一下
sense_groups.english: ...but at least check in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里啊
sense_groups.english: There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你从我身边跑掉了
sense_groups.english: You got away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但被你找到了
sense_groups.english: But you found me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 帮我们照张相
sense_groups.english: Here, Ross, take our picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 笑一个 珍妮丝的相机要照了
sense_groups.english: Smile. You're on Janice Camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在就杀了我
sense_groups.english: Kill me. Kill me now. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 好笑巴比来了
sense_groups.english: Everybody, it's Fun Bobby!

sense_groups.chinese: 好笑巴比
sense_groups.english: Fun Bobby!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 巴比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 不好意思我迟到了 但是我祖父…
sense_groups.english: Hey, sorry I'm late. But my, uh, grandfather...

sense_groups.chinese: 他两个小时前过世了
sense_groups.english: ...died about two hours ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天才有飞机 所以…
sense_groups.english: But I couldn't get a flight out till tomorrow, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就来了
sense_groups.english: ...here I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 好笑巴比 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Fun Bobby. How's it going, man?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 是谁家死人了啊？
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Who died?

sense_groups.chinese: 会开棺
sense_groups.english: It's going to be an open casket, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我至少能再看他最后一面
sense_groups.english: So at least I'll get to see him again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把照片放大 标题写 "破镜重圆"
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna blow this one up and I'm gonna write "Reunited" in glitter.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 珍妮丝 够了
sense_groups.english: All right, Janice, that's it!

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝？珍妮丝？
sense_groups.english: Janice? Janice? Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 珍妮丝？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 我邀你来这个派对时 我并不是想要…
sense_groups.english: When I invited you to this party, I didn't think it meant that we...

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉让你误会了 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry you misunderstood. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我听好 钱德
sense_groups.english: You listen to me, Chandler. You listen to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 总有一次 你将永远失去我
sense_groups.english: One of these times, it's just gonna be your last chance with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 东西拿来啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, will you give me the thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 麦克斯 - 小野洋子
sense_groups.english: Hi, Max. - Yoko.

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定自己去明斯克
sense_groups.english: I've decided to go to Minsk without you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 少了你一切都会不同…
sense_groups.english: It won't be the same...

sense_groups.chinese: 但至少明斯克不会变
sense_groups.english: ...but it will still be Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 新年快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy New Year.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm fine. I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去明斯克
sense_groups.english: You're going to Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不要去明斯克
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not going to Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要去
sense_groups.english: Oh, you are so going to Minsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你属于明斯克 不能为了我留在这里
sense_groups.english: You belong in Minsk. You can't stay here just because of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 如果去 我就得和你分手
sense_groups.english: Yes, I can. Because if I go, it means I have to break up with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法和你分手 - 你可以的
sense_groups.english: And I can't break up with you. - Oh, yes. Yes, you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只要说 "菲比 我爱你 但工作就是我的生命"
sense_groups.english: Just say, uh, "Phoebe, I love you, but my work is my life.

sense_groups.chinese: "我现在只能这么做"
sense_groups.english: And that's what I have to do right now."

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说 "你的工作？你怎么能那么说？"
sense_groups.english: And I say, "Your work? Your work? How can you say that?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你再说 "我的心都碎了… "
sense_groups.english: And then you say, um, "It's tearing me apart...

sense_groups.chinese: "但我别无选择 你能谅解吗？"
sense_groups.english: ...but I have no choice. Can't you understand that?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说 "不 我无法谅解"
sense_groups.english: And I say, "No. No. I can't understand that."

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Uh, ow. - Sorry. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你再抱住我…
sense_groups.english: And then you put your arms around me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你抱住我 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: And then you put your arms around me. - Oh, oh. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你再说你爱我 永远不会忘记我
sense_groups.english: And, um... And then you tell me you love me and you'll never forget me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远都不会忘记你
sense_groups.english: I'll never forget you.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后说已经午夜了 你得走了…
sense_groups.english: And then you say that it's almost midnight and you have to go...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你不想开启一个 无法和我一起结束的新年
sense_groups.english: ...because you don't want to start the new year with me if you can't finish it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会想你的…
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna miss you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你这科学小子
sense_groups.english: ...you scientist guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在时代广场实况报导
sense_groups.english: Hi, this is Dick Clark live in Times Square.

sense_groups.chinese: 时代广场的五彩纸片 纷纷飘下
sense_groups.english: We're in a virtual snowstorm of confetti here in Times Square.

sense_groups.chinese: 一年比一年盛大
sense_groups.english: It gets bigger and better every year.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 孩子们
sense_groups.english: Here you go, kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后孔雀就咬了我
sense_groups.english: And then the peacock bit me. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你在午夜时亲我
sense_groups.english: Please kiss me at midnight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看到珊蒂吗？ - 我不知道怎么说…
sense_groups.english: You seen Sandy? - Ooh. I don't know how to tell you this...

sense_groups.chinese: 她和麦克斯 在摩妮卡的卧房亲热
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, she's in Monica's bedroom getting it on with Max, that scientist geek.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我还是告诉你了
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at that. I did know how to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 各位 球要落下了
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody, the ball is going.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 球要落下了
sense_groups.english: The ball is dropping.

sense_groups.chinese: 再过二十秒就是午夜
sense_groups.english: In 20 seconds, it'll be midnight.

sense_groups.chinese: 兴奋的时刻即将到来
sense_groups.english: And the moment of joy is upon us.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来没有约会的约定奏效了
sense_groups.english: Looks like that "no-date pact" thing worked out.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家看起来都好开心 我讨厌这样
sense_groups.english: Everybody looks so happy. I hate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是每个人都开心 嘿 巴比
sense_groups.english: Not everybody is happy. Hey, Bobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 新年快乐
sense_groups.english: One. Happy New Year!

sense_groups.chinese: 这么说好了 我不是数字大师…
sense_groups.english: You know, I just thought I'd throw this out there. I'm no math whiz...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是这里有三对男女
sense_groups.english: ...but I do believe there are three girls and three guys right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我今晚谁都不想亲
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't feel like kissing anyone tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我谁都不能亲
sense_groups.english: I can't kiss anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要亲每个人？
sense_groups.english: So I'm kissing everyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能亲罗斯 他是你哥
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. You can't kiss Ross. That's your brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 大家都能亲到 除了我
sense_groups.english: Perfect. Perfect. So now everybody's getting kissed but me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 谁来亲我？
sense_groups.english: All right. Somebody kiss me.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁快来亲我 已经午夜了 快来亲我
sense_groups.english: Somebody kiss me. It's midnight. Somebody kiss me. It's midnight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: All right. All right. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲了
sense_groups.english: There.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的希望能成功
sense_groups.english: I wanted this to work so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是很投入
sense_groups.english: I'm still in there, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮他换尿布 抓跳蚤
sense_groups.english: Changing his diapers. Picking his fleas.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他却视为理所当然
sense_groups.english: But he's just phoning it in.

sense_groups.chinese: 深爱某人…却得不到回报
sense_groups.english: It's just so hard to accept that something you love so much...

sense_groups.chinese: 好痛苦 懂吗？
sense_groups.english: ...doesn't love you back, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想那贱人打断了我的牙齿
sense_groups.english: I think that bitch cracked my tooth.

sense_groups.english: There's something I have got to say

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢各位 我得休息一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, thank you very much. I'm gonna take a short break.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢菲比•布非小姐
sense_groups.english: Okay, that was Phoebe Buffay, everybody. Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 她在搞什么东西？ - 菲比刚刚…
sense_groups.english: What the hell was that? - Phoebe just started...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是和乔伊讲话 亲老妈的人
sense_groups.english: I believe I was talking to Joey. All right, there, mother-kisser?

sense_groups.chinese: "亲老妈的人"
sense_groups.english: "Mother-kisser."

sense_groups.chinese: 我闭嘴
sense_groups.english: I'll shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我知道你仍在生我的气
sense_groups.english: Chandler, can I say something? I know you're still mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说那一夜有两个人
sense_groups.english: I just wanna say that there were two people there that night, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 两双嘴唇 - 是 我希望她亲口告诉我
sense_groups.english: There were two sets of lips. - Yes, well, I expect this from her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一直都是个佛洛依德梦魇
sense_groups.english: Okay? She's always been a Freudian nightmare.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她一直这样 你为何不找她谈谈？
sense_groups.english: Okay, but if she always behaves like this, why don't you say something?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为太复杂了 一团乱
sense_groups.english: Because it's complicated. It's complex.

sense_groups.chinese: 你亲了我妈妈
sense_groups.english: Hey, you kissed my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正在排练希腊剧
sense_groups.english: We're rehearsing a Greek play.

sense_groups.chinese: 真幽默 排练完了吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: That's funny. We done now? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不找她谈？不说出你的感受？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you mean you're not gonna talk to her, tell her how you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别以为你亲过她
sense_groups.english: That would be a no. Just because you played tonsil tennis with my mom...

sense_groups.chinese: 就自以为了解她 相信我 不能找她谈
sense_groups.english: ...doesn't mean you know her, all right? Trust me, you can't talk to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底是能还是不能？
sense_groups.english: Okay. "You can't"? Or you can't?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这是我的手指 好 这是我的膝盖
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's my finger. Okay, that's my knee.

sense_groups.chinese: 还在排练
sense_groups.english: Still doing the play.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你对他怎么了？
sense_groups.english: All right, what did you do with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你醒了 - 瞧瞧你
sense_groups.english: You're awake. - Look at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉如何？
sense_groups.english: How do you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 头有点晕 基本上还行
sense_groups.english: Uh, a little woozy, but basically okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的气色好极了
sense_groups.english: Gosh, you look good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我感觉好极了
sense_groups.english: I feel good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 我叫菲比•布非
sense_groups.english: Sorry. - I'm Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫摩妮卡盖勒 我一直在照顾你
sense_groups.english: I'm Monica Geller. I've been taking care of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一直在照顾你
sense_groups.english: We both have.

sense_groups.chinese: 雕刻艺术品是你们送的？ - 其实只有我一个
sense_groups.english: So the Etch A Sketch is from you guys? - Actually, it's just from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我替你做脚底按摩 - 知道是谁帮你刮胡子吗？是我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I got you the foot massager. - Know who shaved you? That was me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我念书给你听 - 我唱歌给你听
sense_groups.english: I read to you. - I sang. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Well, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的荣幸 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, my pleasure. - You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想那就再见了
sense_groups.english: So I guess I'll see you around.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？就这样？
sense_groups.english: What? That's it?

sense_groups.chinese: "再见"？
sense_groups.english: "See you around"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不然要我说什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Well, what do you want me to say? - Well, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许该说
sense_groups.english: Maybe, uh

sense_groups.chinese: "你真好"
sense_groups.english: "That was nice.

sense_groups.chinese: "这对我来讲意义重大"
sense_groups.english: It meant something to me.

sense_groups.chinese: "我会打电话给你"
sense_groups.english: I'll call you."

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会打给你 - 一点诚意都没有
sense_groups.english: All right. I'll call you. - I don't think you mean that.

sense_groups.chinese: 典型的男人
sense_groups.english: This is so typical.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们付出
sense_groups.english: You know, we give...

sense_groups.chinese: 付出
sense_groups.english: ...and we give...

sense_groups.chinese: 不断的付出
sense_groups.english: ...and we give.

sense_groups.chinese: 却得不到任何回报
sense_groups.english: And then we just get nothing back.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一天他醒来却只说 "再见"
sense_groups.english: And then one day, it's just, you know, you wake up and "See you around."

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 菲比
sense_groups.english: Let's go, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？我们以为你与众不同
sense_groups.english: You know what? We thought you were different.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我想这只是昏迷的缘故
sense_groups.english: But I guess it was just the coma.

sense_groups.chinese: 楼下的车已发动
sense_groups.english: The car's running downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想拿几本我的书给你朋友
sense_groups.english: I wanted to drop off these copies of my book for your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要在里斯本帮你买什么？ - 不了 知道你要去就够了
sense_groups.english: Anything you want from Lisbon? - No, just knowing you're there is enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 要乖哦 我爱你
sense_groups.english: All right. Well, be good. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你亲了我最好的罗斯
sense_groups.english: You kissed my best Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像说错了 反正差不多
sense_groups.english: Or something to that effect.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了蠢事
sense_groups.english: Look, it was stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 愚蠢至极 - 愚蠢至极
sense_groups.english: Really stupid. - Really stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道是怎么发生的
sense_groups.english: And I don't even know how it happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 孩子 我保证不会再发生这种事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, honey. I promise it will never happen again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没事吧？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: Are we okay now? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人与门之间禁忌的爱
sense_groups.english: Ah, the forbidden love of a man and his door.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说了 不只是亲吻的事 一切都说出来了
sense_groups.english: He did it. He told her off. And not just about the kiss, about everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑吧？ - 别
sense_groups.english: You're kidding? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说 "你何时才能成熟 开始有个妈妈的样子？"
sense_groups.english: He said, "When are you gonna grow up and start being a mom?"

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 等等 她回答说
sense_groups.english: Wow. - Wait, then she came back with

sense_groups.chinese: "问题是 你何时才能长大 了解我有大屁股？"
sense_groups.english: "The question is, when are you gonna grow up and realize I have a bomb?"

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你确定她不是说
sense_groups.english: Okay, wait. Are you sure she didn't say

sense_groups.chinese: "你何时才能长大 了解我是你妈妈" 吗？
sense_groups.english: "When are you gonna grow up and realize I am your mom?"

sense_groups.chinese: 这样比较说得通 - 你也这样认为吗？
sense_groups.english: That makes more sense. - You think?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在情况怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So, what's going on now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我一直在这里说给你听
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I've been standing here spelling it out for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都听不到 等等…
sense_groups.english: I don't hear anything. Wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看见什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you see?

sense_groups.chinese: 很难说 他们好小而且上下颠倒
sense_groups.english: It's hard to tell. They're so tiny and upside down.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们走过来 他们走过去
sense_groups.english: They're walking away. They're walking away.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是 他们走过来了 快逃
sense_groups.english: No, they're not. They're coming right at us. Run, run!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧 孩子？
sense_groups.english: You okay, kiddo?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好 - 当个乖孩子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm okay. - All right. You be good.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心开车
sense_groups.english: Drive safe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 宾太太 - 盖勒先生
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Bing. - Mr. Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当真？
sense_groups.english: You mean that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 有何不可？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉她了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: So I told her. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况怎么样？ - 简直太糟了
sense_groups.english: How did it go? - Awful. Awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有比这更糟糕的
sense_groups.english: Couldn't have gone worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉怎样？ - 不错
sense_groups.english: Well, how do you feel? - Pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉她了
sense_groups.english: I told her.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧 看到没有？
sense_groups.english: Well, see?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我亲你妈妈不是个坏主意…
sense_groups.english: So maybe it wasn't such a bad idea, you know, me kissing your mom, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们不必继续往下说了吧
sense_groups.english: But we don't have to go down that road.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是第一章
sense_groups.english: Now, this is just the first chapter...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要大家坦白的意见
sense_groups.english: ...and I want your absolute honest opinion. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 在第二页中他的手没伸向她那"尖挺"的双峰
sense_groups.english: Oh, and on page two, he's not reaching for her "heaving beasts."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是"乳投"？
sense_groups.english: What's a "niffle"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在尖挺的双峰上可以找到
sense_groups.english: You can usually find them on the heaving beasts.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧… 算我不会打字
sense_groups.english: All right, all right, so I'm not a great typist.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看到这句吗 "他这只巨大跳动的笔"？
sense_groups.english: Wait, did you get to the part about his "huge, throbbing pens"?

sense_groups.chinese: 他写作时你可得离远一点
sense_groups.english: Tell you, you don't wanna be around when he starts writing with those.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 别看了 还给我 - 不
sense_groups.english: All right, that's it. Give them back. - No.

sense_groups.english: I figure I'm better off staying with the kid...

sense_groups.chinese: 比来回坐渡轮好
sense_groups.english: ...than hauling my ass back and forth on the ferry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没见过他
sense_groups.english: I don't know this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我朋友罗杰 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh. This is my friend Roger. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸会 罗杰 - 彼此彼此
sense_groups.english: Good to meet you. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 玩布偶的那个怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What happened to the, uh, puppet guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Dad, uh... - Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你老婆还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, uh, how's the wife?

sense_groups.chinese: 哪壶不开提哪壶了？
sense_groups.english: Oh for two, huh? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 快点 说点好笑的
sense_groups.english: Uh, Chandler, quick, say something funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得挂电话了 我也想你
sense_groups.english: Gotta go. Ha, ha. I miss you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 但现在很晚了
sense_groups.english: I love you, but it's getting late now...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我向她打声招呼 嘿 妈妈
sense_groups.english: Let me say hi. Hey, Ma.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和包西达大夫约了时间 而且…
sense_groups.english: Listen, I made the appointment with Dr. Bassida and...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道这不是妈妈？
sense_groups.english: Did you know this isn't Ma?

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫罗妮
sense_groups.english: Her name's Ronni.

sense_groups.chinese: 她从事宠物殡葬业
sense_groups.english: She's a pet mortician.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和她多久了…
sense_groups.english: So how long have you been...

sense_groups.chinese: 记得小时候我常带你去海军军港…
sense_groups.english: Remember when you were a kid, I'd take you to the Navy yard...

sense_groups.chinese: 看大船？
sense_groups.english: ...and show you the big ships?

sense_groups.chinese: 从那时候就开始了？ - 没有 才六年
sense_groups.english: Since then? - No, it's only been six years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想勾起你美好的回忆
sense_groups.english: I wanted to give you a nice memory...

sense_groups.chinese: 让你不会觉得我一直是个王八蛋
sense_groups.english: ...so you'd know I wasn't always such a terrible guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你爱过吗？
sense_groups.english: Joe, have you ever been in love?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是没有
sense_groups.english: Then you haven't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的蕃茄烧焦了 - 你还好意思说我
sense_groups.english: You're burning your tomatoes. - Hmm. You're one to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔 你老爸爱得无法自拔
sense_groups.english: Joe, your dad's in love, bigtime.

sense_groups.chinese: 最糟的是我爱上两个不同的女人
sense_groups.english: And the worst part is, it's with two different women.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 拜托你告诉我 其中一个是妈妈
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. Please tell me one of them is Ma.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然其中一个是你妈妈 你秀逗了？
sense_groups.english: Of course one of them's Ma. What's the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 这就像你某天起床突然发现
sense_groups.english: It's like if you woke up one day and found out...

sense_groups.chinese: 你老爸是个双面人
sense_groups.english: ...your dad was leading this double life.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像是为中央情报局工作的间谍
sense_groups.english: He's, like, actually some spy working for the CIA.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒挺酷的
sense_groups.english: That'd be cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在是太逊了
sense_groups.english: This blows.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 为何父母就不能好好当父母？
sense_groups.english: I know. Why can't parents just stay parents?

sense_groups.chinese: 为何他们就得成为一般人？
sense_groups.english: Why do they have to become people?

sense_groups.chinese: 为何他们要…
sense_groups.english: Why do they have...?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么…
sense_groups.english: Why...

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能不要一直盯着我的胸部看？
sense_groups.english: ...can't you stop staring at my breasts?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那一天你还看得不够吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you get a good enough look the other day?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了… 我们都已是成年人
sense_groups.english: All right, we're all adults here.

sense_groups.chinese: 此事只有一个解决方法
sense_groups.english: There's only one way to resolve this.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你看过她的乳房
sense_groups.english: Since you saw her boobies...

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该让她看你的小鸡鸡
sense_groups.english: ...I think, uh, you're gonna have to show her your pee-pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 想都别想
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't see that happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 他说得没错 以眼还眼
sense_groups.english: Come on. He's right. Tit for tat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让你看的
sense_groups.english: Well I'm not showing you my tat.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁啊？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是菲比 - 还有罗杰
sense_groups.english: It's Phoebe. - And Rog.

sense_groups.chinese: 快上来
sense_groups.english: Come on up.

sense_groups.chinese: 这下可好 罗杰来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Rog is here.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗杰怎么了？ - 没什么 小事
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with Rog? - Nothing. It's a little thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这家伙
sense_groups.english: I hate that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？因为他太善于分析 这是职业病啊
sense_groups.english: What? So he was a little analytical. That's what he does.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 他没那么糟
sense_groups.english: Come on, he's not that bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这里错了 如果当初我感觉到她是女同志…
sense_groups.english: That's where you're wrong. Why would I marry her...

sense_groups.chinese: 我何必和她结婚呢？
sense_groups.english: ...if I thought on any level that she was a lesbian?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不确定
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你想让你的婚姻失败
sense_groups.english: Maybe you wanted your marriage to fail.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈 - 为什么？我为什么会这么做？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. - Why? Why would I? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么…
sense_groups.english: Why? Why? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不确定 或许自信心不足
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Maybe low self-esteem?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是弥补你抢兄弟姊妹风头的事情 或许…
sense_groups.english: Maybe to compensate for overshadowing a sibling. Maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 回到兄弟姊妹的话题
sense_groups.english: Wait. Go back to that "sibling" thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让你的婚姻碰壁
sense_groups.english: It's conceivable that you sabotaged your marriage...

sense_groups.chinese: 好显示你兄弟姊妹在父母面前没那么失败
sense_groups.english: ...so the sibling would be less of a failure in the parents' eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太荒谬了 她不成才 我一点都不会感到内疚
sense_groups.english: That's ridiculous. I don't feel guilty for her failures.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我不成才？ - 他不错吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, so you think I'm a failure? - Isn't he good?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是那个意思
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No. That's not what I was saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 多年来我以为你支持我
sense_groups.english: All these years, I thought you were on my side...

sense_groups.chinese: 但或许你婚姻失败的目的是想巴结爸妈
sense_groups.english: ...but maybe you were sucking up to Mom and Dad...

sense_groups.chinese: 好让他们更心疼你
sense_groups.english: ...so they'd favor you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我娶女同志 是想让你看起来更好
sense_groups.english: Hey, I married a lesbian to make you look good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对
sense_groups.english: You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说 你说得对
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是威伯的问题 而是威伯游乐宫
sense_groups.english: It wasn't just the Weebles, but it was the Weeble Play Palace...

sense_groups.chinese: 和威伯游轮的问题
sense_groups.english: ...and the Weeble's Cruise Ship...

sense_groups.chinese: 它上面的救生艇让威伯能缓缓驶出
sense_groups.english: ...which had this little lifeboat for the Weebles to wobble in.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很难受
sense_groups.english: That's tough, tough stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们现在该走了 不然就赶不上电影了
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, if we're gonna catch that movie, we gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你好过一点 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Okay. Feel better, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们快来不及了 甜心 - 好的
sense_groups.english: We're gonna be late, sweetie. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你做的一切 摩妮卡 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Listen, thanks for everything, Mon. - No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 很高兴和各位再度见面
sense_groups.english: It was great seeing you again.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 饼干别吃太多
sense_groups.english: Mon, uh, easy on those cookies, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 切记 那些东西只是食物…
sense_groups.english: Remember, they're just food...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是爱
sense_groups.english: ...they're not love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这家伙
sense_groups.english: I hate that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 各位
sense_groups.english: Good night, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 这是我们订的女人
sense_groups.english: Oh, look. It's the woman we ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 需要帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. Can, uh... Can we help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 谢谢 我在等乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Oh. No, thanks. I'm just waiting for, uh, Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不是你 是老乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, no, not you. Big Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你比照片上帅多了
sense_groups.english: You're so much cuter than your pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗妮
sense_groups.english: I'm Ronni.

sense_groups.chinese: 想吃起司片吗？
sense_groups.english: Cheese Nip?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的脑子有点秀逗了
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey's having an embolism...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我要起司片
sense_groups.english: ...but I'd go for a Nip.

sense_groups.chinese: 大部分人在宠物过世后
sense_groups.english: You see, most people, when their pets pass on...

sense_groups.chinese: 希望他们像睡觉那样躺着
sense_groups.english: ...they want them laid out like they're sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 但有时有些人要他们摆出姿势
sense_groups.english: But occasionally you get a person who wants them in a pose.

sense_groups.chinese: 像追自己的尾巴
sense_groups.english: Like, uh, chasing their tail.

sense_groups.chinese: 或跳起来接住飞盘
sense_groups.english: Or, uh, jumping to catch a Frisbee.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果我先走一步 我的姿势要像找钥匙一样
sense_groups.english: Joey, if I go first, I want to be looking for my keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好笑 - 嗨 乔
sense_groups.english: That's a good one. - Hey, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 爸爸 罗妮来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dad. Ronni's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Huh? - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hello, babe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are...? What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的假发留在我的住处
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, you left your hair at my apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你明天开会用得上
sense_groups.english: I figured you'd need it for your meeting.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想玩大老二？
sense_groups.english: So who's up for a big game of Kerplunk?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我…
sense_groups.english: Look, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该来这里
sense_groups.english: I shouldn't have come.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了 我不想错过最后一班地铁
sense_groups.english: I gotta go. I'll miss the last train.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不想让你这么晚还搭地铁
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want you taking that thing this late.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我要睡哪里？这里吗？ - 哇
sense_groups.english: Where am I gonna stay? Here? - Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去住饭店
sense_groups.english: We'll go to a hotel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 - 不行
sense_groups.english: No, you won't. - No, we won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们去饭店就一定会嘿咻
sense_groups.english: If you go to a hotel, you'll be doing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你们待在这里 这样我就可以盯着你们
sense_groups.english: I want you right here, where I can keep an eye on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要盯着我们？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna keep an eye on us?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 先生
sense_groups.english: That's right, mister.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你年纪多大 只要住在我家屋檐下…
sense_groups.english: I don't care how old you are, while you're here...

sense_groups.chinese: 一切就得听我的
sense_groups.english: ...you're gonna live by my rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是不准你和你女朋友睡在一起
sense_groups.english: And that means no sleeping with your girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 他好严格
sense_groups.english: Wow, he's strict.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 你睡我房问
sense_groups.english: Dad, you'll be in my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗妮 你睡钱德的房问
sense_groups.english: Ronni, uh, you can stay in Chandler's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你真是个好孩子
sense_groups.english: Thanks. You're a good kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 我带你去看我房问
sense_groups.english: Come on. I'll show you to my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉真奇怪你没说 "不 谢了 时候不早了"
sense_groups.english: That sounds weird when it's not followed by, "No, thanks, it's late."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 只有今晚而已 明天你就得做出改变
sense_groups.english: Okay. This is just for tonight. Starting tomorrow, you gotta change.

sense_groups.chinese: 六年时间可不短 - 什么改变？
sense_groups.english: Six years is long enough. - What kind of change?

sense_groups.chinese: 和罗妮分手 - 我不能
sense_groups.english: Break up with Ronni... - I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不就和我妈妈离婚 这样是不对的
sense_groups.english: Then come clean with Ma. This is not right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想听 快进我房里
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna hear it. Now go to my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 踢踏舞者
sense_groups.english: Hey, kickie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？ - 想让自己舒服一点
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Trying to get comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿着内裤我睡不着 - 你非穿不可
sense_groups.english: I can't sleep in my underwear. - Well, you're gonna.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想…
sense_groups.english: I've been thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 我总是看见女人叠在女人上面
sense_groups.english: ...about how I'm always seeing girls on top of girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们是尾对尾相接 还是是像煎饼一样叠起来？
sense_groups.english: Are they end-to-end, or tall, like pancakes?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我什么意思 这些和我约过会的女人
sense_groups.english: You know what I mean. How I date all these women.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我总是想 当真命天女出现时
sense_groups.english: I always figured, when the right one comes along...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就会勇往直前 坚持到最后
sense_groups.english: ...I'll be able to be a standup guy and go the distance, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 但如今看见我爸 我想…
sense_groups.english: Now I'm looking at my Dad thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是他 你是你自己
sense_groups.english: You're not him, you're you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当他们希望你继承你爸的事业时 你有屈服吗？
sense_groups.english: When they wanted you to go into your father's business, did you cave?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 没有
sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你决心从事没有工作的演艺事业
sense_groups.english: You decided to go into the out-of-work-actor business.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是一件容易的事 但你办到了
sense_groups.english: That wasn't easy, but you did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也相信 当真命天女出现时
sense_groups.english: And I believe that when the right woman comes along...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有勇气对她说
sense_groups.english: ...you'll have the guts to say

sense_groups.chinese: "抱歉 我已婚"
sense_groups.english: "No thanks, I'm married."

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的这样认为？
sense_groups.english: You really think so?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我真的这样认为
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 钱德 - 滚开
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Chandler. - Get off.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 有事吗？
sense_groups.english: May I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊说我能用你的浴室 因为钱德正在用我们的
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey said I could use your shower since, uh, Chandler's in ours.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你是谁？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Who are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫罗妮 罗妮•罗普拉诺 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, I'm Ronni. Ronni Rapalono. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 情妇？
sense_groups.english: The mistress?

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Um, come on in. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫瑞秋 浴室在那里
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Rachel. Bathroom's up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 听好 罗妮
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ronni.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德进浴室多久了？
sense_groups.english: How long has Chandler been in the shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约五分钟
sense_groups.english: Oh. Like, uh, five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 请系好安全带
sense_groups.english: Fasten your seat belts...

sense_groups.chinese: 看小鸡鸡的时间到了
sense_groups.english: ...it's pee-pee time.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 崔比亚尼先生
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mr. Trib.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 早安 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hey. Good morning, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德•宾 该换我看你的小东西了
sense_groups.english: Chandler Bing, it's time to see your thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么搞的？ - 我以为你是钱德
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with you? - I thought it was Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该在浴室 这样我才能看见你的小东西
sense_groups.english: You were supposed to be in there so I could see your thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小东西在里面 和我在一起
sense_groups.english: Sorry, my thing was in there with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好吧？ - 不错
sense_groups.english: How's it going? - Good. Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗杰想邀大家一起吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Roger's having a dinner thing and he wanted me to invite you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: So, what's going on? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是…
sense_groups.english: It's just that, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗杰
sense_groups.english: It's Roger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 有些事…
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem, I don't know. There's something about... Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上我们认为他…
sense_groups.english: Basically, we just feel that he's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们讨厌他
sense_groups.english: We hate that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们讨厌他
sense_groups.english: We hate him.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们很抱歉
sense_groups.english: We're sorry, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是他太有洞察力
sense_groups.english: Don't you think maybe it's just that he's so perceptive...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以吓到你们了？
sense_groups.english: ...that it freaked you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我讨厌他 - 不 我们讨厌他…
sense_groups.english: No, I hate him. - No, we hate him.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 你来干什么？
sense_groups.english: Ma. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我把这个带给你
sense_groups.english: I came to give you this...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有这一巴掌 - 哇
sense_groups.english: ...and this. - Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的大戒指打到很痛
sense_groups.english: Big ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要对你爸讲一大堆
sense_groups.english: Why did you fill your father's head with that garbage...

sense_groups.chinese: 关于改邪归正的废话呢？
sense_groups.english: ...about making things right?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切事情本来都很好
sense_groups.english: Things were fine the way they were.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面有鸡肉 放冰箱冰好
sense_groups.english: There's chicken in there. Put it away.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 乔伊 真的
sense_groups.english: For God's sake, Joey. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你都知道？
sense_groups.english: Hold on. You knew?

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然知道 你认为呢？
sense_groups.english: Of course I knew. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸又不是詹姆士•邦德
sense_groups.english: Your father is no James Bond.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该听听他的谎言
sense_groups.english: You should have heard his cover stories.

sense_groups.chinese: "我在会计家里睡"
sense_groups.english: "I'm sleeping over at my accountant's."

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么屁话？拜托
sense_groups.english: I mean, what is that? Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎能…？
sense_groups.english: So then, how could you...?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得你爸以前的模样吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you remember how your father used to be?

sense_groups.chinese: 总是大喊大叫 总是不开心
sense_groups.english: Always yelling. Nothing made him happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 连工作室和瓶内的小船也无法让他开心
sense_groups.english: Not that wood shop, not those stupid little ships in the bottle.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在他很开心
sense_groups.english: Now he's happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很好 他好歹有个嗜好
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's nice. He has a hobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 我无意冒犯 但是…
sense_groups.english: Ma, I don't mean to be disrespectful, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底在说什么？
sense_groups.english: ...what the hell are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 那你怎么办？ - 我很好啊
sense_groups.english: I mean, what about you? - Me? I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 亲爱的…
sense_groups.english: Look, honey...

sense_groups.chinese: 在理想的世界中
sense_groups.english: ...in an ideal world...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有她 而且你爸是个大帅哥
sense_groups.english: ...there'd be no her and your father would look like Sting.

sense_groups.chinese: 再告诉你别的
sense_groups.english: And I'll tell you something else

sense_groups.chinese: 自从那贵妇犬一样的女人出现后
sense_groups.english: Ever since that poodle-stuffer came along...

sense_groups.chinese: 他感觉很羞耻 变得对我很用心
sense_groups.english: ...he's been so ashamed of himself that he's been more attentive.

sense_groups.chinese: 并且开始对我体贴
sense_groups.english: He's been more loving.

sense_groups.chinese: 每天都像我们的结婚纪念日
sense_groups.english: It's like every day is our anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该为你高兴？
sense_groups.english: I'm happy for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不必了
sense_groups.english: Well, don't be.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为现在全搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Because now everything's screwed up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想回到像从前一样
sense_groups.english: I just want it the way it was.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 对不起
sense_groups.english: Ma, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我做了你想做的事
sense_groups.english: I just did what I thought you'd want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 亲爱的 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know you did, cookie. Oh, I know you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我
sense_groups.english: So tell me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你见到她了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you see her?

sense_groups.chinese: 见到了
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你比她漂亮十倍都不止
sense_groups.english: You're 10 times prettier than she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘴巴真甜
sense_groups.english: That's sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打得过她吗？
sense_groups.english: Could I take her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有这么大的戒指 她没辙
sense_groups.english: With this ring, no contest.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 甜心？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What's wrong, sweetie? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底怎么了？快说嘛
sense_groups.english: No, no. What's wrong? Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我没事
sense_groups.english: It's nothing. I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我的朋友
sense_groups.english: It's just, um... It's my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们对你有意见
sense_groups.english: They have a liking problem with you...

sense_groups.chinese: 其实…
sense_groups.english: ...in that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不喜欢你…
sense_groups.english: ...they don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不喜欢我？
sense_groups.english: Oh. They don't?

sense_groups.chinese: 不过 你知道…
sense_groups.english: But you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们看不见 只有我才能看见的好处
sense_groups.english: ...they don't see all of the wonderfulness that I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们看不见你体贴的一面
sense_groups.english: They don't see all the good stuff and all the sweet stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们认为你有点…
sense_groups.english: They think you're a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 执着的恐怖
sense_groups.english: What? - Intense and creepy.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我 菲比不这么认为
sense_groups.english: But I don't. Me. Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对他们的反应 丝毫不感到惊讶
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not at all surprised they feel that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 不惊讶吗？这就是你棒的地方
sense_groups.english: You're not? See, that's why you're so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 当群体动力失调时
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's quite typical behavior...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是很平常的反应
sense_groups.english: ...when you have this kind of dysfunctional group dynamic.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种相互依赖…
sense_groups.english: You know, this kind of codependent...

sense_groups.chinese: 情绪障碍
sense_groups.english: ...emotionally stunted...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐在那家烂咖啡屋 拿着又大又蠢的咖啡杯
sense_groups.english: ...sitting in your stupid coffeehouse, with your stupid big cups...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许还有乳头在上面
sense_groups.english: ...which, I'm sorry, might as well have nipples on them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都会说 "噢 定义我的性格 定义我的性格"
sense_groups.english: And you're all like, "Oh, define me. Define me.

sense_groups.chinese: "爱我 我需要爱"
sense_groups.english: Love me. I need love."

sense_groups.chinese: 你和你爸谈过了？
sense_groups.english: So you talked to your dad, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他要以我妈妈希望的方式 继续对我妈妈劈腿
sense_groups.english: Yeah. He's gonna keep cheating on Ma, like she wanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈要继续假装她一无所知
sense_groups.english: Ma's gonna keep pretending she doesn't know even though she does.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妹妹蒂娜不能再见她丈夫了
sense_groups.english: And my sister Tina can't see her husband anymore...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他接到禁制令
sense_groups.english: ...because he got a restraining order.

sense_groups.chinese: 这两件事没关系 但我今天才听说
sense_groups.english: Which has nothing to do with it, except that I found out today.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 沃顿山这里的事全变了
sense_groups.english: Things sure have changed here on Walton's mountain.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: So, Joey, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是… 父母
sense_groups.english: It's just... You know, they're parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不得不随他们的意思
sense_groups.english: After a certain point, you gotta let go.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使你知道这样做不对
sense_groups.english: Even if you know better...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你还是得让他们犯自己的错误
sense_groups.english: ...you gotta let them make their own mistakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想…
sense_groups.english: And just think...

sense_groups.chinese: 几年后我们就会和他们一样
sense_groups.english: ...in a couple years, we get to turn into them.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我像他们一样 我不是变成…
sense_groups.english: If I turn into my parents, I'll either be an alcoholic blond...

sense_groups.chinese: 追逐年轻帅哥的金发醉鬼老玻璃
sense_groups.english: ...chasing after 20-year-old boys...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是变得和我妈妈一样
sense_groups.english: ...or I'll end up like my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好吧？
sense_groups.english: How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好 只是我和罗杰分手了
sense_groups.english: Okay, except I broke up with Roger.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是真的
sense_groups.english: No, no, really. Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 我说不上来 我是说…
sense_groups.english: What happened? - Ugh. I don't know. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个好人
sense_groups.english: He's a good person...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还对我很体贴
sense_groups.english: ...and he can be really sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在某些方面很适合我
sense_groups.english: And in some ways, I think he is so right for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是… 我讨厌这个人
sense_groups.english: It's just, I hate that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 一劳永逸解决乳房风波
sense_groups.english: Clear the tracks for the boobie payback express.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一站 瑞秋•葛林
sense_groups.english: Next stop, Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在搞什么鬼？
sense_groups.english: Joey, what the hell were you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 看错乳房
sense_groups.english: Sorry, wrong boobies.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hello, dear.
