Then why do you think we keep ending up together?
New Year's, who invited who?
Valentine's, who asked who into whose bed?
I did, but... - You seek me out.
Something deep in your soul calls out to me like a foghorn.
Janice. Janice.
You want me. You need me.
You can't live without me.
And you know it.
You just don't know you know it.
See you.
Call me.
It's not true. I never called your mother a wolverine.
You did so. I swear. I swear to...
How long has she been in the bathroom?
Uh, I don't think she's in the bathroom. Her coat is gone.
Well, maybe it's cold in there.
Maybe I screwed up the first date I had in nine years.
That could be it. - Oh, God.
You know, this is still pretty hot.
Mushroom.
Smile.
They won't all be like this. Some might even stay through dinner.
I'm sorry. That's not funny. - No, it's just...
Well, you know the whole getting-on-with-your-life thing?
Well, do I have to?
I mean, well, I'm sitting here with this cute woman...
...and she's perfectly nice, you know?
But there's...
That's it.
And, uh, then I'm here talking to you, and it's easy and it's fun.
And I don't have to...
I know. - You know?
Here's a wacky thought. Um, ahem.
Let's say you and I give it another shot. - Ross.
No, no, I know what you're gonna say. You're a lesbian.
But what do you say we just put that aside for now, you know?
Let's just stick a pin in it, okay?
Because we're great together, you know?
You can't deny it.
And besides, you're carrying my baby.
I mean, how perfect is that? - Ross...
You keep saying that, but there's something right here.
I love you.
I love you too.
But... - No "but." No "but."
You know that thing we put over here with the pin in it?
It's time to take the pin out.
Yeah.
You'll find someone. I know you will. The right woman is waiting for you.
It's easy for you to say. You found one already.
All you need is a woman who likes men and you'll be set.
Not her.
We get off around midnight. Why don't we pick you up then?
Okay. - Great.
So, um, will you bring the truck?
I'll even let you ring the bell. - Wohoo!
We'll see you later. - Bye. See you later.
Thanks. See you.
Oh, my God.
See, there you go.
The cleansing worked. - You're right.
They're nice guys.
They're firemen guys.
You tell them you're married? - No way.
My girlfriend doesn't know. I'm not gonna tell them.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啦 罗斯 她要你
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, Ross, she wants you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一点也不认识我 只是刚好是邻居
sense_groups.english: She barely knows me. We just live in the same building.

sense_groups.chinese: 有来往吗？ - 有次借我颗鸡蛋
sense_groups.english: Any contact? - She lent me an egg once.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就算数了
sense_groups.english: You're in.

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你该回到情场来
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross. You gotta get back in the game here.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟瑞秋的恋情不成 前妻爱女人
sense_groups.english: The Rachel thing's not happening, your ex-wife's a lesbian, you...

sense_groups.chinese: 不用我再说第三位了吧
sense_groups.english: I don't think we need a third.

sense_groups.chinese: 打扰了 可以给颗全蛋吗 有壳的那种
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Could we get an egg over here, still in the shell?

sense_groups.chinese: 蛋？
sense_groups.english: An egg?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你就上前跟她说 "蛋还你"|
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Go up to her and say, "Here's your egg back. I'm returning your egg."

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很有魅力啊
sense_groups.english: I think it's winning.

sense_groups.chinese: 明明就很瞎 - 她会喜欢
sense_groups.english: I think it's insane. - She'll love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 谢谢 拿去
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Thank you. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 带着蛋去吧
sense_groups.english: Go with the egg, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 去啊
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想会成功吗？ - 是自杀 他携有鸡蛋
sense_groups.english: Think it'll work? - It's suicide. The man's got an egg.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可以这样 - 怎样？不可以怎样？
sense_groups.english: You cannot do this. - What? Do what?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗杰明晚要约她出去
sense_groups.english: Roger wants to take her out.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不行 你难道忘了当初为什么甩掉他的？
sense_groups.english: No. Pheebs. Don't you remember why you dumped the guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他让人毛骨悚然
sense_groups.english: Because he was creepy.

sense_groups.chinese: 刻薄 又让人有点害怕
sense_groups.english: And mean. And a little frightening.

sense_groups.chinese: 但情人节有人约 总比没的好
sense_groups.english: Still, it's nice to have a date on Valentine's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 想约毛骨悚然男 随时都可以
sense_groups.english: You can go out with a creep any night of the year.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我就这样
sense_groups.english: I know I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 明晚你们有什么打算？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing tomorrow night?

sense_groups.chinese: 那要看今晚的发展
sense_groups.english: Actually, tomorrow night depends on how tonight goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚呢 - 不行 不准反悔
sense_groups.english: Oh. Uh, listen, about tonight... - No, no, don't you dare bail on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她答应跟我约会 就是因为我答应帮她朋友找伴
sense_groups.english: She's only going out with me because I'm bringing a friend for her friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她朋友听来似乎是…
sense_groups.english: But her friend sounds like such a...

sense_groups.chinese: 悲惨又很糟 这我知道 但…
sense_groups.english: Pathetic mess. I know, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样啦 老兄 她很渴望 很脆弱 我想呢
sense_groups.english: Come on, man, she's needy, she's vulnerable. I'm thinking

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟珍妮丝分手后就没约会过 今晚你一定要去
sense_groups.english: You haven't been out with a woman since Janice. You're doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 她答应了 - 啊
sense_groups.english: She said yes. - Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 老兄
sense_groups.english: Yes! Way to go, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 蛋你没还人家？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Still got the egg, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我样子如何？ - 哦
sense_groups.english: How do I look? - Oh, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 才不在乎
sense_groups.english: ...I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 洛莲来了
sense_groups.english: There's Lorraine.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住喔 不能跟我换
sense_groups.english: Now, remember, no trading.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮的给你 悲惨的给我
sense_groups.english: You get the pretty one. I get the mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 好
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: Well, well.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这是谁
sense_groups.english: Look what you brought.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒喔
sense_groups.english: Very nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你带了谁？
sense_groups.english: And what did you bring?

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在寄放外套
sense_groups.english: She's checking her coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我去洗手 把计程车味道洗掉
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm gonna go wash the cab smell off of my hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我叫白葡萄酒 帮珍妮丝叫杯红葡萄酒好吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you get me a white zinfandel and a glass of red for Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝？
sense_groups.english: Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的…
天啊
sense_groups.english: ...God.

sense_groups.chinese: 是珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要逃走了 从窗户出去
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm making a break for it. I'm going out the window.

sense_groups.chinese: 别走啦 拜托 我想约洛莲好久了
sense_groups.english: No, don't, please. I've been waiting for forever to go out with Lorraine.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷静点 - 冷静？
sense_groups.english: Just calm down. - Calm down? Calm down?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个五个月内被我甩过两次的女人 你硬把我们凑成对
sense_groups.english: You set me up with a woman I've dumped twice in the last five months.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 别对我吼好吗？这让我好紧张
sense_groups.english: Can you stop yelling? You're making me nervous...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一紧张就尿不出来
sense_groups.english: ...and I can't go when I'm nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你说的没错
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 快尿 快尿
sense_groups.english: Come on! Do it, do it, do it! Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 罗杰是很怪 但跟皮特•卡尼比起来不算什么
sense_groups.english: Okay, Roger was creepy, but he was nothing compared to Pete Carney.

sense_groups.chinese: 皮特•卡尼谁？ - 爱哭鬼皮特？
sense_groups.english: Which one was he? - Pete the Weeper?

sense_groups.chinese: 每次做爱都会哭的家伙 还记得吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember the guy that used to cry every time we had sex?

sense_groups.chinese: "你也舒服吗？"
sense_groups.english: "Oh, was it good for you?"

sense_groups.chinese: 小哭一下何妨 总比不服输霍华 "强"
sense_groups.english: Well, I'd take a little crying any day over Howard, the "I win" guy.

sense_groups.chinese: "我赢了 我赢了"
sense_groups.english: "I win. I win."

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他约会两个月 都没赢过
sense_groups.english: I went out with him for two months. I didn't get to win once.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们人这么好 怎会找到这些混蛋呢？
sense_groups.english: How do we end up with these jerks? We're good people.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 可能是因为 我们拥有特别磁力
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I think we're like some kind of magnets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我确定我有 所以我才不能戴数位手表
sense_groups.english: I know I am. That's why I can't wear a digital watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你那瓶酒比较多 对吧？
sense_groups.english: There's more beer, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我那个把头理光的朋友艾比吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh. You know my friend Abby who shaves her head?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说如果想破除恶男交友魔咒
sense_groups.english: She says to break the bad-boyfriend cycle...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以进行净身仪式
sense_groups.english: ...you can do a cleansing ritual.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这女人志愿变秃耶
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, this woman is voluntarily bald.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 就选明晚来做啊
sense_groups.english: So we can do it tomorrow night, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 情人节 很适合
sense_groups.english: It's Valentine's Day. It's perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样的仪式？
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, what kind of ritual?

sense_groups.chinese: 像是把他们送的东西烧掉
sense_groups.english: Okay, we can, um, burn the stuff they gave us.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者？
sense_groups.english: Or?

sense_groups.chinese: 或者可以脱光了又唱又跳 拿根木棍
sense_groups.english: Or we can chant and dance around naked, you know, with sticks.

sense_groups.chinese: 烧东西比较好 - 烧东西比较好
sense_groups.english: Burning's good. - Burning's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有可以烧的东西
sense_groups.english: I've got stuff to burn.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个呢
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 打从我小时候 我就有办法用脚趾捡硬币
sense_groups.english: ...ever since I was little, I've been able to pick up quarters with my toes.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？好了不起
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 几枚硬币 还是整捆硬币？
sense_groups.english: Uh, quarters or rolls of quarters?

sense_groups.chinese: 顺道一提 钱德 照片上有你的都被我剪了
sense_groups.english: By the way, Chandler, I cut you out of all of my pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想要的话 有一整袋子都是你的头
sense_groups.english: So if you want, I have a bag with just your heads.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了
sense_groups.english: That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？因为可以拿来作成小玩偶
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? Because you could make little puppets out of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后放在残酷剧场演戏
sense_groups.english: And you could use them in your Theater of Cruelty.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能这样
sense_groups.english: We can't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？不能怎样？
sense_groups.english: What? What can't you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以和你聊一聊？到那边？
sense_groups.english: Uh, can I talk to you for a second? Over there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想走了
sense_groups.english: Uh, we might be leaving now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说我跟你的"我们"
sense_groups.english: Tell me it's you and me "we."

sense_groups.chinese: 她说想在我全身涂抹东西 再舔掉
sense_groups.english: She said she wants to slather my body with stuff and then lick it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我连涂抹是什么意思都不懂
sense_groups.english: I'm not even sure what slathering is.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我很想试试
sense_groups.english: But I definitely want to be a part of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不可以这样对我
sense_groups.english: Okay, you cannot do this to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 抱歉 没错
sense_groups.english: You're right. I'm sorry. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦三个巧克力慕丝外带
sense_groups.english: Uh, can we have three chocolate mousses to go, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 信用卡给你 晚餐我请 抱歉喔
sense_groups.english: Here's my credit card. Dinner's on me. I'm sorry, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望她吐在你身上
sense_groups.english: I hope she throws up on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 - 剩我们俩了
sense_groups.english: So... - Just us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好烂的一晚
sense_groups.english: Ugh, what a crappy night.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我还满高兴从你上完厕所后 你的衬衫就从…
sense_groups.english: Although I have enjoyed the fact that your shirt's been sticking out...

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子拉链跑出来
sense_groups.english: ...of your zipper since you came back from the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这算是误交损友吗？
sense_groups.english: So do we have the best friends, or what?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊算不上朋友 他是…
sense_groups.english: Joey's not a friend. He's...

sense_groups.chinese: 把信用卡留给我们用的笨蛋
sense_groups.english: ...a stupid man who left us his credit card.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来一杯？点心？大屏幕电视机？
sense_groups.english: Another drink? Some dessert? A big-screen TV?

sense_groups.chinese: 就再来一杯吧
sense_groups.english: I will go for that drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 小姐
sense_groups.english: You got it. Good woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 最贵的香槟 来一瓶
sense_groups.english: A bottle of your most overpriced champagne.

sense_groups.chinese: 每人一瓶 - 没错 每人一瓶
sense_groups.english: Each. - That's right. Each.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一瓶罗伯•洛伊
sense_groups.english: Oh. And a, uh, Rob Roy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直很好奇那是什么
sense_groups.english: I've always wanted to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 情人节快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy Valentine's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经开始想你了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I miss you already.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信会这样吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe this happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 但却真的发生了
sense_groups.english: And yet it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了 珍妮丝 - 亲一下啊
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Janice. - Kiss me.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, Chandler. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hey, Janice. - Hi, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很特别
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, this was very special.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 快来看外头是谁
sense_groups.english: Rach, come see who's out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么…？天啊
sense_groups.english: What's going on...? Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 你好
sense_groups.english: Janice. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝正要走
sense_groups.english: Janice is gonna go away now.

sense_groups.chinese: 去去就回
sense_groups.english: I'll be right back.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 看谁来了
sense_groups.english: Oh. Joey. Look who it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 乔伊回家了
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Joey's home now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好有趣喔
sense_groups.english: This is so much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像在走廊重逢
sense_groups.english: This is like a reunion in the hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 来打个招呼
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ross. There's someone I want you to say hi to.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚好他打来
sense_groups.english: He just happened to call.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 对 是我 你怎么猜到的？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Ross. Yes, that's right. It's me. How did you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是说如果狗会有时差
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying if dogs do experience jet lag, then...

sense_groups.chinese: 那人一岁等于狗七岁的说法
sense_groups.english: ...because of the whole seven-dog- years-to-one-human-year thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 在遇到狗从纽约飞到洛杉矶时
sense_groups.english: ...that when a dog flies from New York to Los Angeles...

sense_groups.chinese: 他可不只要往返三小时 而是一个半礼拜
sense_groups.english: ...he doesn't just lose three hours, he loses, like, a week and a half.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有趣 - 对
sense_groups.english: That's funny. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些人是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who are they?

sense_groups.chinese: 金发是我前妻
sense_groups.english: The, uh, blond is my ex-wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 摸她的人是她…
sense_groups.english: And the woman touching her is her...

sense_groups.chinese: 密友
sense_groups.english: ...close personal friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 是说她们是爱人吗？
sense_groups.english: You mean they're lovers?

sense_groups.chinese: 硬要给人标签的话 就是了
sense_groups.english: If you want to put a label on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 嘿
sense_groups.english: Wow. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有什么没告诉我的 - 没了 就这么多
sense_groups.english: Anything else I should know? - Nope. That's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 还有她怀了我的孩子
sense_groups.english: Oh, and she's pregnant with my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 这我老是忘掉
sense_groups.english: I always forget that part.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 现在要艾草枝 还有圣酒
sense_groups.english: Okay. So now we need, um, sage branches and the sacramental wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只有牛至叶和饮料
sense_groups.english: All I had is oregano and a Fresca.

sense_groups.chinese: 这也可以
sense_groups.english: Um, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 好
sense_groups.english: Ooh. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 接着要有正派男性的精子
sense_groups.english: All right. Now we need the semen of a righteous man.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是找得到这种人

sense_groups.chinese: 喔

sense_groups.english: Which is bad, because?

sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 周网量

sense_groups.english: Right. Gotcha, gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会再犯了 我不会让你的...
sense_groups.english: Won't happen again. I wouldn't want to do anything to hurt your...

sense_groups.chinese: 非常非常可爱
sense_groups.english: ...she's really, really cute.

sense_groups.english: Marcel.

sense_groups.english: Well, someone was supposed to write

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想等到适当时机
sense_groups.english: I'm just trying to find the right moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该不难 因为你们现在交往
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, that shouldn't be so hard, now that you're dating.

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的 你被开除了 不过上班前我们快快来一下如何"
sense_groups.english: "Sweetheart, you're fired. But how about a quickie before I go to work?"

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然人都进来了 就不用再敲门了
sense_groups.english: Once you're inside, you don't have to knock anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来开
sense_groups.english: I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯先生
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hi, Mr. Heckles.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们又在弄了
sense_groups.english: You're doing it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们什么都没弄啊
sense_groups.english: We're not doing anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是坐着静静聊天而已
sense_groups.english: We're just sitting around talking quietly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我天花板很吵
sense_groups.english: I can hear you through the ceiling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的猫睡不着
sense_groups.english: My cats can't sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本没养猫啊
sense_groups.english: You don't even have cats.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来可能养的
sense_groups.english: I could have cats.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 黑考斯先生
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Mr. Heckles.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会小声点
sense_groups.english: We'll try to keep it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 可以帮个忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, can you do me a favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 试穿一下看合不合身
sense_groups.english: Try this on to make sure it fits.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这辈子第一次收到的生日礼物 真的很…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my first birthday present. Oh, this is really...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 这是送乌苏拉的 但我想你们一样身材
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. It's for Ursula. I just figured, you know, size-wise.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sure. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 很合
sense_groups.english: Okay, it fits.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又要约她了吗？ - 对 冰上嘉年华
sense_groups.english: Are you seeing her again tonight? - Yep, Ice Capades.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们玩真的
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从没见过你肯为女朋友花钱
sense_groups.english: I've never known you to pay money for any kind of capade.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 我就是喜欢她啊
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I like her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟别人不同 她有某种特质
sense_groups.english: She's different. There's, uh, something about her...

sense_groups.chinese: 让你迷上她 懂了 你喜欢她 很好
sense_groups.english: That you like. We get it. You like her. Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我事先问过你 你说没意见的啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Phoebe, I asked you, and you said it was okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在有意见了
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe now it's not okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在我对你有意见这事 很有意见了
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe now I'm not okay with it not being okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 快织 好女人 快织
sense_groups.english: Knit, good woman. Knit. Knit.

sense_groups.chinese: 这边是克莱斯勒大楼
sense_groups.english: And that's the Chrysler Building right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 妮娜 - 道格拉斯先生
sense_groups.english: Nina. - Mr. Douglas.

sense_groups.chinese: 领带很正
sense_groups.english: Cool tie.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在
sense_groups.english: She's still here.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 她还在
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes, she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是有附纸条给你报告过
sense_groups.english: Didn't I memo you on this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我开除她后 她的心理医师 法兰医师
sense_groups.english: See, after I let her go, uh, I got a call from her psychiatrist, Dr. Flanen...

sense_groups.chinese: 发蓝医师
sense_groups.english: ...Dr. Flanan, Dr. Flan.

sense_groups.chinese: 告知我 她对开除一事适应不良
sense_groups.english: And, uh, he informed me that she took the news rather badly.

sense_groups.chinese: 还用了"非常激动"这样的字眼
sense_groups.english: In fact, he, uh, mentioned the word "frenzy."

sense_groups.chinese: 少开玩笑了 她明明就很…
sense_groups.english: You're kidding. She seems so...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 妮娜吗？她…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. Nina? She's

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你去问她
sense_groups.english: In fact, if you asked her now...

sense_groups.chinese: 她对被开除一事完全没有印象了
sense_groups.english: ...she'd have no recollection of being fired at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 太不可置信了
sense_groups.english: That's unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 却又很可信
sense_groups.english: And yet believable.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我决定 在确定她不会伤害自己
sense_groups.english: So I decided not to fire her again...

sense_groups.chinese: 或其他人之前 不要再开除她一次
sense_groups.english: ...until I'm sure she will be of no threat to herself or others.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 人对事情的反应 真的很难预料
sense_groups.english: I see. Hmm. You never really know what's going on inside a person's head.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以才有心理学吧 老板
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess that's why they call it psychology, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟 这是生产的奇迹
sense_groups.english: For this, after all, is the miracle of birth.

sense_groups.chinese: 请开灯
sense_groups.english: Lights, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是生产的过程
sense_groups.english: And that's having a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一周就是最后一堂课了
sense_groups.english: Next week is our final class.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊 往前跑
sense_groups.english: Susan, go deep.

sense_groups.chinese: 太了不起了 真是太了不起了
sense_groups.english: It's impossible. It's just impossible.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么东西了不起？
sense_groups.english: What is, honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才那女人…
sense_groups.english: What that woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 的表现
sense_groups.english: ...did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要经历那种事
sense_groups.english: I am not doing that. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要宝宝不生出来就好了 那就一切依旧
sense_groups.english: It'll have to stay in, that's all. Everything will be the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要不生出来 - 卡萝 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: It'll just stay in. Ha, ha. - Carol, honey. Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 会一切顺利的 - 你懂个屁
sense_groups.english: Everything will be all right. - What do you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 又不会有人跟你说 "那是你的鼻孔吗？"
sense_groups.english: No one's saying to you, "Hi, is that your nostril?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以把这肉块从这推出去吗？
sense_groups.english: Mind if we push this pot roast through it?"

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Carol, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 深呼吸吐气
sense_groups.english: Cleansing breath.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很吓人 但往远想一点
sense_groups.english: I know it's frightening. But big picture

sense_groups.chinese: 生产不过是那短短一天
sense_groups.english: The birth part is just one day...

sense_groups.chinese: 等生完后 我们这辈子就成了人家的父母了
sense_groups.english: ...and when it's over, we'll all be parents for the rest of our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么辛苦不就是为了这点吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's what this is all about, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要当爸爸了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be a father.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在才想到吗？ - 我是知道会有个孩子
sense_groups.english: This is just occurring to you? - I always knew I was having a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一直没想到 孩子也会有我
sense_groups.english: I just never realized the baby was having me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以办到的
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're gonna be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: How could you say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我连叫马塞尔别吃浴室踏垫都没办法了
sense_groups.english: I can't even get Marcel to stop eating the bathmat.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么养育小孩
sense_groups.english: How will I raise a kid?

sense_groups.chinese: 科学家说…
sense_groups.english: You know, Ross, some scientists are now saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子和小孩是不一样的
sense_groups.english: ...that monkeys and babies are actually different.

sense_groups.chinese: 去哪？ - 出去
sense_groups.english: Where are you going? - Out.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟谁？
sense_groups.english: With?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 问你一件事
sense_groups.english: All right, can I just ask you one question?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有那个了吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you two, you know, like, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 就那个
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 有没？
sense_groups.english: Yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然这不干你事
sense_groups.english: Well, not that it's any of your business...

sense_groups.chinese: 但还没 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but no, we haven't, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指做爱 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You meant sex, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 有空吧？ - 有 妮娜 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a sec? - Uh, sure, Nina. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 过去几天 大家都躲着我
sense_groups.english: I don't know. For the past couple days, people have been avoiding me...

sense_groups.chinese: 看到我表情都怪怪的
sense_groups.english: ...and giving me these really strange looks.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 可能是因为…
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, uh, maybe that's because...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都嫉妒我们吧
sense_groups.english: ...they're, uh, jealous of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们收走剪刀 就说不通了吧
sense_groups.english: But that doesn't explain why they keep taking my scissors.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为要给你加薪了
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, maybe that's, uh, because you're getting a big raise.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？ - 当然 有可能啊
sense_groups.english: I am? - Sure. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你好棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You're amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 还不只呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, you don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 海伦 请记得布克邦德小姐加薪的事 文件要弄好
sense_groups.english: Helen, make sure we put through the paperwork on Miss Bookbinder's raise.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还要把她精神病历送到人事处吗？
sense_groups.english: Still want her psychological profile sent to personnel?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 海伦有酗酒问题
sense_groups.english: What? - Helen drinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 愿意嫁给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 最后我全盘托出 - 她反应如何？
sense_groups.english: Well, I ended up telling her everything. - Ooh. How'd she take it?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 除了钉书针
sense_groups.english: Pretty well. Except for the stapler thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 小提示 要是遇到同样状况
sense_groups.english: Little tip. If you're ever in a similar situation...

sense_groups.chinese: 手千万别放在桌上
sense_groups.english: ...never, ever leave your hand on the desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该知道怎么操作了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think I get how to do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以关掉吗？可以弄走吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we turn this off? Can we make them go away?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我看不下去
sense_groups.english: Because I can't watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 关掉了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, they're gone. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？ - 很好
sense_groups.english: Are you all right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 就是… 乌苏拉那事
sense_groups.english: It's just, you know, this whole stupid Ursula thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 问你一句
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, can I ask?

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟她约会就真的有这么糟吗？
sense_groups.english: So he's going out with her. Is it really so terrible?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是说她很坏什么的
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm not saying she's evil or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她老是坏了我的好事
sense_groups.english: She's just, you know, always breaking my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我八岁时 不肯借她儿童厨具组
sense_groups.english: When I was 8, I wouldn't let her have my Judy Jetson Thermos...

sense_groups.chinese: 她就把厨具扔到车底
sense_groups.english: ...so she threw it under the bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有兰迪•布朗
sense_groups.english: And then there's Randy Brown...

sense_groups.chinese: 他就…
sense_groups.english: ...who was like...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有过青梅竹马般的男友吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever had a boyfriend who was like your best friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 没
sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就是我青梅竹马的男友
sense_groups.english: Well, but that's what he was for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她却抢走他
sense_groups.english: And she, you know, kind of stole him away...

sense_groups.chinese: 却让他心碎
sense_groups.english: ...and then broke his heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后他再也不理我了
sense_groups.english: And then he wouldn't even talk to me anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他说不想再看到跟我们一样的人
sense_groups.english: He didn't want to be around anything that looked like either one of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我清楚乔伊不是我男友 或儿童厨具组
sense_groups.english: I mean, I know Joey's not my boyfriend or my Thermos...

sense_groups.chinese: 或什么 但是…
sense_groups.english: ...or anything, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会失去他的 - 你要跟他谈开来
sense_groups.english: You won't lose him. - You gotta talk to Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不会懂你的想法 如果他知道你这么想
sense_groups.english: Come on. He doesn't know this stuff. If he knew how you felt...

sense_groups.chinese: 他爱上她了啊
sense_groups.english: He's falling in love with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 才不过交往一周
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. They've been going out a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 连床都没上过 根本不算什么
sense_groups.english: They haven't even slept together yet. I mean, that's not serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um, may we help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你干嘛啦？好冷喔 你到里头来好吗？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, what are you doing? It's freezing. Would you come inside?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你叫我拆掉的
sense_groups.english: You wanted me to take them down...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就来拆啊
sense_groups.english: ...so I'm taking them down, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm okay. I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯先生
sense_groups.english: Mr. Heckles?

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯先生 帮帮我
sense_groups.english: Mr. Heckles, could you help me, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就说吧
sense_groups.english: See, this is just the kind of thing I was talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 不蠢啦
sense_groups.english: It's not stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 这两位师医生明晚要跟我们约会 我答应了
sense_groups.english: The very cute doctors asked us out for tomorrow night, and I said yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 太疯狂了 他们可是在那家医院上班
sense_groups.english: I think it's totally insane. I mean, they work for the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 这简直就像回到犯罪现场一样
sense_groups.english: It's like returning to the scene of the crime.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们别去约会了 - 什么？摩妮卡 他们又帅
sense_groups.english: I say we blow off the dates. - What? Monica, they are cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 又是医生 帅医生 是医生又很帅
sense_groups.english: They are doctors. Cute doctors. Doctors who are cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 到目前 我们知道什么？
sense_groups.english: All right, what have we learned so far?

sense_groups.chinese: 惊喜
sense_groups.english: Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们搞什么啦？吓死我了
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you doing? You scared the crap out of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是蛋糕吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Was that the cake? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了个柠檬烂糕
sense_groups.english: I got a lemon shmush.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 她马上就到了
sense_groups.english: Come on. She'll be here any minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 但愿没砸烂
sense_groups.english: I hope it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: "生日快乐 灰椅"
sense_groups.english: "Happy Birthday, Peehee."

sense_groups.chinese: 或许可以用玫瑰 写成 "B" 字
sense_groups.english: Maybe we can make a B out of one of those roses.

sense_groups.chinese: 就用特制蛋糕工具
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we'll just use our special cake tools.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 我们只是…
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's going on? - Oh, we just...

sense_groups.chinese: 惊喜
sense_groups.english: Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒喔
sense_groups.english: This is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不吓人
sense_groups.english: This was not at all scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 蓓蒂
sense_groups.english: Hi, everybody. Hi, Betty.

sense_groups.chinese: 蓓蒂
sense_groups.english: Betty, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们找来蓓蒂 天啊 好棒
sense_groups.english: You found Betty. Oh, my gosh. This is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢的人都聚在一堂
sense_groups.english: Everybody I love is in the same room.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 看到蓓蒂吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you see Betty?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你说吧 我不介意投资生产蕃茄干产业
sense_groups.english: I tell you, I wouldn't mind having a piece of this sun-dried-tomato business.

sense_groups.chinese: 五年前要是有人跟我说 我们可以让蕃茄变枣干
sense_groups.english: Five years ago, if somebody'd said to me, "Here's a tomato that looks like a prune"...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说 "给我滚出去"
sense_groups.english: ...I'd have said, "Get out of my office."

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我出生前 你有很紧张吗？
sense_groups.english: Dad, before I was born, did you freak out at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没紧张 我只是说…
sense_groups.english: I'm not freaking out. I'm just saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 要是有人来跟我说
sense_groups.english: ...if someone had come to me with the idea...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我是在说 生小孩的事
sense_groups.english: Dad, Dad, Dad. I'm talking about the whole, uh, baby thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有过那种...
sense_groups.english: Did you, uh, ever get this sort of...

sense_groups.chinese: 为人父恐慌症吗？
sense_groups.english: ...panicky, "Oh, my God, I'm gonna be a father" kind of a thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 没
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈妈很尽责 我全心忙事业
sense_groups.english: Your mother really did the work. I was busy with the business.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不常在家
sense_groups.english: I wasn't around that much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你讲半天是要讲这个吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that what this is about?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 爸 我只是在想
sense_groups.english: No, no, Dad. I was just wondering.

sense_groups.chinese: 还来得及弥补 我可以陪你做些事
sense_groups.english: There's time to make up for that. We can do stuff together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一直说想去威廉斯堡 就去那好了
sense_groups.english: You always wanted to go to colonial Williamsburg. How about we do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 爸
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Dad. Really, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是
sense_groups.english: You know, I just, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想弄清楚
sense_groups.english: I just needed to know, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是何时才觉得自己已经当爸了
sense_groups.english: ...when did you start to feel like a father?

sense_groups.chinese: 好像是你出生第二天
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I guess it must have been the day after you were born.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和你妈妈在病房 你妈妈在睡觉
sense_groups.english: We were in the hospital room, your mother was asleep...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们带你进房 让我抱着
sense_groups.english: ...and they brought you in and gave you to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个长得红红丑丑的东西
sense_groups.english: You were this ugly little red thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 突然间 你用手拽了我手指一下
sense_groups.english: And all of a sudden, you grabbed my finger with your whole fist...

sense_groups.chinese: 紧紧抓住
sense_groups.english: ...and you squeezed it...

sense_groups.chinese: 抓得好牢
sense_groups.english: ...so tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时我才醒悟
sense_groups.english: And that's when I knew.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你不想去威廉斯堡吗？
sense_groups.english: So you don't want to go to Williamsburg?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以啊
sense_groups.english: We can go to Williamsburg.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃鱼吧
sense_groups.english: Eat your fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 帅医生来了
sense_groups.english: Rachel, the cute doctors are here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 麦可 杰夫瑞
sense_groups.english: Hi, come on in. Hey, Michael, Jeffrey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们带了酒来
sense_groups.english: Uh, here, we brought wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是波格奈酒庄的名酒
sense_groups.english: Look at this. It's from the cellars of Ernest and Tova Borgnine.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么能不喝？ - 好棒
sense_groups.english: So how could we resist? - Oh, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 脚踝好吗？ - 就…
sense_groups.english: So, Monica, how's the ankle? - It's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己讲
sense_groups.english: Why don't you tell them?

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟脚踝长在你身上
sense_groups.english: After all, it is your ankle.

sense_groups.chinese: 好多了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You know, it's feeling a lot better. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 我们拿杯子
sense_groups.english: Listen, why don't you guys sit down, and we'll get you some glasses.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 马上
sense_groups.english: Um... - Stat.

sense_groups.chinese: 干脆把身份说清楚吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen, I'm thinking, why don't we just tell them who we really are?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有事的 - 不可能 会惹祸上身
sense_groups.english: I mean, I think it'll be fine. - It will not. We'll get in trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 别这么没用好吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica, would you stop being such a wuss?

sense_groups.chinese: 没用？我头脑清楚 有错吗？
sense_groups.english: A wuss? Excuse me for living in the real world.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？ - 她们还是很正常
sense_groups.english: So? - So they still seem normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她们本来就很正常
sense_groups.english: That's because they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 承认吧 每次跟医院病人约会都…
sense_groups.english: You have to admit, when we go out with women we meet at the hospital...

sense_groups.chinese: 别穷紧张 你看看身边
sense_groups.english: Would you relax? Take a look around.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有异教徒的圣坛
sense_groups.english: There are no pagan altars.

sense_groups.chinese: 角落没堆人骨
sense_groups.english: No piles of bones in the corners.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们没问题 跟我这样做
sense_groups.english: They're fine. Go like this

sense_groups.chinese: 不能那样好吗？你有时候真的太天真
sense_groups.english: I said we are not going to do it, okay? Sometimes you can be such a big baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不天真 - 真的
sense_groups.english: I am not a baby. - Be serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你穷紧张 - 你有公主病
sense_groups.english: You get uptight... - You act like a princess.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道怎样吗？ - 怎样啊？
sense_groups.english: You know what? You know what? - What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你越来越像你妈妈
sense_groups.english: Every day you are becoming more and more like your mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 借过 来了
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Hello, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 这地方很棒 你们住多久了？
sense_groups.english: This is a great place. How long have you lived here?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 差不多六年
sense_groups.english: Thanks. I've been here about six years.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋前几个月才搬来的
sense_groups.english: And Rachel moved in a few months ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来要嫁人了
sense_groups.english: See, I was supposed to get married...

sense_groups.chinese: 但临到圣坛才甩了人家
sense_groups.english: ...but, um, I left the guy at the altar.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 真的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是有点自私啦 不过…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know it's pretty selfish, but, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是这样啊
sense_groups.english: ...hey, that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 尝尝鹰嘴豆沙拉酱吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't you try the hummus?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你是从事什么行业？
sense_groups.english: So, Monica, what do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是上流餐厅的大厨
sense_groups.english: Uh, I am a, uh, chef at a restaurant uptown.

sense_groups.chinese: 好厉害 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, good for you. - Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我可以对人颐指气使 正好是我的嗜好
sense_groups.english: Mostly because I get to boss people around, which I just love to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 沙拉酱好好吃
sense_groups.english: Well, this hummus is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 天佑鹰嘴豆
sense_groups.english: God bless the chickpea.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是被宠坏了
sense_groups.english: I am so spoiled.

sense_groups.chinese: 没了
sense_groups.english: That's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚有说高中时
sense_groups.english: And by the way, have I mentioned that back in high school...

sense_groups.chinese: 我胖得像猪吗？
sense_groups.english: ...I was a cow?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前会尿床
sense_groups.english: I used to wet my bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用胸部吸引人
sense_groups.english: I use my breasts to get other people's attention.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都这样
sense_groups.english: We both do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和瑞秋住处
sense_groups.english: Monica and Rachel's apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 瑞秋 是你爸
sense_groups.english: Uh... Uh, yeah, just one second. Uh, Rachel, it's your dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸
sense_groups.english: Hi, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是我
sense_groups.english: No, no. It's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 现在不方便
sense_groups.english: Listen, Dad, I can't talk right now. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事…
sense_groups.english: But there's something, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想跟你说
sense_groups.english: There's something that I've been meaning to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得大一时
sense_groups.english: Remember back in freshman year?

sense_groups.chinese: 比利•德端斯金和我在你们床上做爱
sense_groups.english: Well, Billy Dreskin and I had sex on your bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸
sense_groups.english: Daddy...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我怎么可能会跟比利•德瑞斯金上床？
sense_groups.english: Daddy... Daddy, why? Why would I sleep with Billy Dreskin?

sense_groups.chinese: 他爸可是你工作上的死对头
sense_groups.english: His father tried to put you out of business.

sense_groups.chinese: 你惨了
sense_groups.english: You are dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他又拿到遥控器了
sense_groups.english: Ross, he's got the remote again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他知道怎么转回来
sense_groups.english: Maybe he can switch it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许不会
sense_groups.english: Maybe not.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Uh, ueah... Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我看她在不在
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh, hold on a second and let me just check and see if she's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 医院的护士 她说表格有问题
sense_groups.english: It's the woman from the hospital. There's a problem with the form.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, what do we do?

sense_groups.chinese: 先问清什么事
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Just find out what they want.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来问啦
sense_groups.english: Okay. No, you do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hello. This is Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 是？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们马上过去 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yes, we'll be right down. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 忘了签入院单
sense_groups.english: We forgot to sign one of the admissions forms.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 不值得这样 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're right, this wasn't worth it. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去换衣服 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, let me just change. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 有麻烦？
sense_groups.english: Trouble?

sense_groups.chinese: 你姐姐前晚失约没到
sense_groups.english: Your sister stood me up the other night.

sense_groups.chinese: 人家不支持感觉是不是很差？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Don't you hate it when people aren't there for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有打给她看看吗？ - 打了两天
sense_groups.english: Did you try calling her? - I've been trying for two days.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅说她在忙
sense_groups.english: When I called the restaurant, they said she was too busy to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 没想到她就这样甩我
sense_groups.english: I can't believe she's blowing me off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 有空吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, you got a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 就工作没什么
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah, I'm just working.

sense_groups.chinese: 那… - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: So... - Uh-huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 送你生日礼物
sense_groups.english: Um, oh, I got you a birthday present.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow, you remembered.

sense_groups.chinese: 是儿童厨具组
sense_groups.english: Oh. It's a Judy Jetson Thermos.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟你…
sense_groups.english: Right. Like the kind you...

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有东西给你
sense_groups.english: Oh, I got something for you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道我要来？
sense_groups.english: How'd you know I was coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 就双胞胎的心电感应
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah, um, "twin" thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你会这样
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you did this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你会…
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样
sense_groups.english: ...did this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和乔伊怎么了？
sense_groups.english: So, what's the deal with, um, you and Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他人很好 但我们结束了
sense_groups.english: He is so great. But that's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 他知情吗？ - 谁？
sense_groups.english: Does he know? - Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 他对你很着迷
sense_groups.english: Joey. You know, um, ahem, he's really nutsy about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？为什么？
sense_groups.english: He is? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 问倒我了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: You got me. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Excuse me...

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是有附沙拉吗？
sense_groups.english: ...doesn't this come with a side salad?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会打给他吗？
sense_groups.english: So, um, are you gonna call him?

sense_groups.chinese: 他有喜欢我吗？ - 不是啦 是乔伊
sense_groups.english: What, you think he likes me? - No. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 他很聪明 他自己会想通的
sense_groups.english: Oh. No, no. He is so smart. He'll figure it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 要吃鸡肉吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want some chicken?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 不吃有脸的东西 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: No, no. No food with a face, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都没变
sense_groups.english: You have not changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你也一样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我们吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hi. Remember us? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前打来说 要签入院表格
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah, you just called about needing a signature on the admissions form?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想干脆重填
sense_groups.english: Well, it turns out we need a whole new one.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为呢…
sense_groups.english: Because, um, you see...

sense_groups.chinese: 名字又写错了
sense_groups.english: ...I put the wrong name again.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为… - 你很笨
sense_groups.english: Because, um... - You're that stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我很笨
sense_groups.english: I am. I'm that stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用支票支付吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I'm just gonna pay for this with a check.

sense_groups.chinese: 这保险会给付 知道吧
sense_groups.english: You know, your insurance will cover that.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道 只是我也不聪明
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. I'm just not that bright either.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 最差的状况
sense_groups.english: Okay, worst case scenario

sense_groups.chinese: 如果说你从没觉得自己成了父亲
sense_groups.english: Say you never feel like a father.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你的儿子从没觉得你是他父亲
sense_groups.english: Say your son never feels connected to you as one.

sense_groups.chinese: 而他的人际关系 因此全受到影响
sense_groups.english: Say all of his relationships are affected by this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底要讲什么？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a point?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该有
sense_groups.english: You know, you'd think I would.

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's up with the simian?

sense_groups.chinese: 有毛球
sense_groups.english: It's just a fur ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 该谁了？
sense_groups.english: Okay, whose turn is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你 "肾脏" 我得43分
sense_groups.english: Yours. I just got 43 points for "kidney."

sense_groups.chinese: 才没 你"恩脏"得零分
sense_groups.english: No, you got zero points for "idney."

sense_groups.chinese: "K" 字母呢？
sense_groups.english: I had a K. Where's my K?

sense_groups.chinese: 救命啊 猴子吞了一颗 "K"
sense_groups.english: You've got to help me. My monkey swallowed a K.

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子给我抱出去
sense_groups.english: Get that animal out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 请谅解 动物医院在城另一边
sense_groups.english: You don't understand. The animal hospital is way across town.

sense_groups.chinese: 他噎到了 我不知如何是好
sense_groups.english: He's choking. I don't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 马塞尔把拼字牌吞下去了
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - Marcel swallowed a Scrabble tile.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 这医院是医人的
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. This hospital is for people.

sense_groups.chinese: 太太 他是人啊 他有名字耶
sense_groups.english: Lady, he is people. He has a name, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他还会看电视
sense_groups.english: He watches Jeopardy...

sense_groups.chinese: 没人注意时还会自慰
sense_groups.english: ...he touches himself when nobody's watching.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你大发慈悲
sense_groups.english: Please, have a heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来看看吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I'll take a look at him. - Oh, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦可 - 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Michael. - Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？ - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: What? - Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乌苏拉
sense_groups.english: Urs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来干嘛 我一直打给你
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? I've been trying to call you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个
sense_groups.english: Listen, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 别说这个 我认得这口气 我常用
sense_groups.english: Don't say "listen." I know that "listen." I've said that "listen."

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: I don't get it. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在桥下说的话呢？
sense_groups.english: What about everything you said under the bridge?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 忘了我在桥下说的事吧
sense_groups.english: You know, just forget about what I said under the bridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我醉了 讲的都是傻话
sense_groups.english: I was talking crazy that night. I was so drunk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喝酒的
sense_groups.english: You don't drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我不喝
sense_groups.english: That's right, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我因为你而醉
sense_groups.english: But I was drunk on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乌苏拉 - 但我们不可能有进展的
sense_groups.english: Oh, Urs. - But, yeah, so it's not gonna work.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？是因为我是菲比的朋友？
sense_groups.english: Why? Is it because I'm friends with Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是这个原因 你会愿意跟她绝交吗？
sense_groups.english: If it was, would you stop hanging out with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不到
sense_groups.english: No, I couldn't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 就是因为菲比
sense_groups.english: Um, then, yeah, it's because of Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个 我跟她只能选一个
sense_groups.english: So you know, it's either her or me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那 真的抱歉了
sense_groups.english: Then, uh... Then I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我呢…
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很难忘得掉你
sense_groups.english: ...you're gonna be really, really hard to get over.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道是因为要分手 还是…
sense_groups.english: I don't know whether it's just because we're breaking up or what...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你从没这么美过
sense_groups.english: ...but you have never looked so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 是
sense_groups.english: Pheebs? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好小一只喔
sense_groups.english: He looks so tiny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们收到消息了 - 他没事吧？
sense_groups.english: We just got the message. - Is he all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 医生把牌拿出来了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the doctor got the K out.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还找到另两颗
sense_groups.english: He also found an M and an O.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们猜他是想拼"猴子"这个字
sense_groups.english: We think he was trying to spell out "monkey."

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说他不会有事 只是睡着了
sense_groups.english: The doctor says he'll be fine. He's just sleeping now.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 有当爸的感觉了吗？
sense_groups.english: So you feel like a dad yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 为什么？
sense_groups.english: No. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都撑过来了 做了该做的事
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on, you came through. You did what you had to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 很有当爸的样子
sense_groups.english: That is very dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 他醒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, he's waking up.

sense_groups.chinese: 小朋友 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, fella. How you doing?

questions.name: S01E18
questions.en:
Rach, we're running low on résumés over here.
Do you really want a job with Popular Mechanics?
Well, if you're gonna work for mechanics, those are the ones to work for.
Hey, look, you guys. I'm going for anything here, okay?
I can't be a waitress anymore. I mean it.
I'm sick of the lousy tips. I'm sick of being called "Excuse Me."
Rach, did you proofread these?
Uh, yeah. Why?
Uh, nothing. I'm sure they'll be impressed with your excellent "compuper" skills.
Oh, my God!
Oh, do you think it's on all of them?
Oh, no, I'm sure the Xerox machine caught a few.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Hey. Hi, ladies.
Uh, can I get you anything?
Did you bring the mail? - Lots of responses.
Really? Sure we have scones left.
Okay, read them to me.
"Dear Miss Green: Thank you for your inquiry. However..."
We have apple cinnamon... - Okay, "Dear Miss Green"...
Yeah. Yeah, yeah. No.
Wow. - What?
Your Visa bill is huge.
Give me that.
You know, I can't believe you. Linda is so great.
Why won't you go out with her again? - I don't know.
Is this still about her whole...
..."The Flintstones could have really happened" thing?
It's not just that.
It's just, I want someone who does something for me...
...you know, who gets my heart pounding...
...who makes me, uh...
Little play things with yarn?
What?
Could you want her more?
Who?
Who? Dee, the sarcastic sister from What's Happening!!
Who?
Look, I am totally, totally over her, okay?
I just... Hi. - Hi. Coffee?
No, we're fine. - Okay.
Shut up.
We're not saying anything.
What? - Uh, Joey cried last night.
Thank you.
We were playing poker, right?
There was chocolate on the three. It looked like an eight, all right?
Oh, God, you should've seen him. "Read them and weep."
And then he did.
Well, now, how come you guys have never played poker with us?
Yeah, what is that? Like some kind of guy thing?
Like some kind of sexist guy thing?
Like, it's poker, so only guys can play?
No. Women are welcome to play.
Oh, okay, so then what is it?
Some kind of, you know, like, some kind of, you know, like...
All right, what is it?
There just don't happen to be any women in our game.
Yeah, we just don't happen to know any women that know how to play poker.
Oh, please. That is such a lame excuse. I mean, it's a typical guy response.
Excuse me, do any of you know how to play?
No.
But you could teach us.
No.
Okay, so now we draw cards.
So I wouldn't need any, right? Because I have a straight.
Oh, good for you. - Congratulations.
Okay, Pheebs, how many do you want?
Okay, I just need two. The 10 of spades and the six of clubs.
No, uh, Pheebs, you can't do that.
I have the 10 of spades. Here, you want it?
Thanks.
Uh, no, see, uh, you can't do that.
No, no. That's okay. I don't need them. I'm going for fours.
Oh, you're...
All right, here we go.
We've got salmon roulettes and assorted crudités.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Monica, what are you doing?
This is a poker game. You can't serve food with more than one syllable.
It's got to be like chips or dip or pretz...
Okay, so at this point, the dealer...
You know what? We got it. We got it. Let's play for real. High stakes. Big bucks.
All right, now, you sure? Phoebe just threw away two jacks...
...because they didn't look happy.
But I'm ready. So just deal.
Okay, all right, last minute lesson. Last minute lesson. Joey.
Eight, three. All right. Here we go.
Damn it, damn it, damn it.
I see. So then, um, you were lying.
About what? - About how good your cards were.
Heh. I was bluffing.
Aha. And what is "bluffing"?
Is it not another word for lying?
Okay, sorry to break up this party...
...but I've got resumes to fax before work tomorrow.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. - Rach, we've got to settle.
Settle what?
The Jamestown colony of Virginia.
You see, King George is giving us the land, so...
The game, Rachel. The game. You owe us money for the game.
Oh, right.
You know what, guys? It's their first time. Why don't we forget about the money?
Hell, no. We'll pay.
Okay, Monica, I had another answer all ready.
And you know what?
We want a rematch. - Well, that's fine with me.
Could use the money.
So, basically, you get your ya-yas by taking money from all of your friends.
Yeah. - Yes, and I get my ya-yas from lkea.
You have to put them together yourself, but they cost a little less.
Look, Rachel, this is poker. I play to win, all right?
In order for me to win, other people have to lose.
So if you're gonna play poker with me, don't expect me to be a nice guy.
Okay, because once those cards are dealt...
Yeah?
I'm not a nice guy.
All right, boys. Let's eat.
Ah, did you get that from the "I Love Rachel" pizzeria?
You still on that? - Come on.
What was with that whole Black Bart speech?
"When I play poker, I'm not a nice guy".
You're way off, pal.
No, I don't think so. See, Ross, because I think you love her.
Uh, no.
See, I might have had feelings for her at one time. Not anymore.
I just... Marcel.
Where are you going with that disk? You are not putting that on again.
Marcel... Okay. If you press that button, you are in very, very big trouble.
You believe what a jerk Ross was being?
Yeah, I know. He can get really competitive.
What?
Oh. "Hello, Kettle, this is Monica. You're black."
Please.
I am not as bad as Ross.
Oh, I beg to differ. The Pictionary incident?
That was not an incident.
I was gesturing and the plate slipped out of my hand.
Oh.
Oh! I got an interview. I got an interview. - You're kidding. Where? Where?
Saks Fifth Avenue. - Oh, Rachel.
Oh, it's like the mother ship is calling you home.
Well, what's the job? - Assistant buyer.
Oh! I would be shopping...
...for a living.
Okay, look. That's Aunt Iris.
This woman has been playing poker since she was 5.
You've gotta listen to every word she says.
Hi. - Is Tony Randall dead?
Oh, why? - I don't think so.
Well, he may be now because I think I hit him with my car.
My God. Really? - No, that's bluffing. Lesson number one.
Let me tell you something.
Everything you hear at a poker game is pure crap.
Nice earrings. - Thank you.
Girls, sit down.
Um, Aunt Iris, this is Phoebe, and Rachel... - Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Listen, I am parked at a meter. Let's do it.
Ross, could we please, please, listen to anything else?
All right.
I'm gonna pay for that tonight.
Hi. - Hey.
Guess what, guess what, guess what.
Uh, okay. The fifth dentist caved, and now they're all recommending Trident?
No, the interview.
She loved me. She absolutely loved me.
We talked for, like, two and a half hours. We have the same taste in clothes.
Oh, I went to camp with her cousin.
And, oh, the job is perfect. I can do this. I can do this well.
That's great.
God. And she told the funniest story.
Okay, great, you'll tell us and we'll laugh.
Let's play poker.
All right, listen, we talked about it...
...and if you don't want to play, we completely understand.
Yes, yes. We can play some other game. Like, I don't know...
...Pictionary?
Very funny. Very funny.
I think we'd like to give poker another try. Shall we, ladies?
Yes, I think we should.
Rach, do you want me to shuffle those?
No, no. That's okay. You know what? I'm gonna give it a go.
All right. - All right.
So Pheebs owes 7.50. Monica, you owe $10.
And, Rachel, you owe 15 big ones.
Thanks for teaching us "Crossed-eyed Mary."
You guys, we gotta play that other way.
All right, here's my 7.50, but I think you should know that this money is cursed.
What? - Oh, I cursed it.
So now bad things will happen to he who spends it.
That's all right, I'll take it. Bad things happen to me anyway.
This way, I can break them up with a movie.
So that just leaves the big Green poker machine, who owes 15.
Hmm, oh, it's so typical
"Ooh, I'm a man. Ooh, I have a penis.
Ooh, I have to win money to exert my power over women."
You know what? This is not over.
We will play you again. And we will win and you will lose.
And you will beg and we will laugh.
And we will take every last dime you have.
And you will hate yourselves forever.
Hmm. Kind of stepped on my point there, Mon.
So you gals wanna hand over your money now?
That way, we don't have to go through the formality of actually playing.
No, that's fine. We'll see who has the last laugh there, monkey boy.
Okay, are we done with the chitchat? Are we ready to play serious poker?
Hey, you guys, look. The one-eyed jack follows me wherever I go.
Right, okay. Serious poker.
Excuse me. Where are you going?
Uh, to the bathroom.
Do you wanna go to the bathroom or do you wanna play poker?
I wanna go to the bathroom.
All right, well, I'm gonna order a pizza. - Oh, no, no, no.
I'm waiting to hear from that job.
And the store closes at 9, so you can eat then.
That's fine. I'll just have a Tic Tac to hold me over.
All right. Cincinnati. No blinds. Everybody ante.
Yes.
Or no.
All right.
Your money's mine, Green.
Your fly's open, Geller.
You guys, you know what I just realized?
"Joker" is "poker" with a "J."
Coincidence?
Hey, that's "jo-incidence" with a "C."
Uh, Phoebe. Phoebe... - Yeah, I'm out.
I'm in.
Me too.
Me too. All right. What do you got?
Well, you better hop out of the shower, because I got a flush.
Well, well, well.
Hop back in, bucko, because I got four sixes.
I got four sixes. I won. I actually won.
Oh, my God. You know what? I think I'm gonna make a little Ross pile.
I think that one was Ross'. And I think, oh, that one was Ross'.
Well, I have got your money. And you'll never see it.
And your fly's still open.
I made you look.
I'm in. - I couldn't be inner.
Monica? Monica, in or out?
I hate this game.
Okay, Joey, your bet.
I fold, like a cheap hooker who got hit in the stomach...
...by a fat guy with sores on his face.
Oh, I'm out.
Ross? - Oh, I'm very in.
Chandler? - Couldn't be more out.
Me too. Rachel?
Um, I will see you and I'll raise you.
What do you say? You wanna waste another buck?
No, not this time.
So, what did you have? - I'm not telling.
Come on, show them to me. - No.
Show them to me. Let me see. - Get your hands out of there.
You know, I've had dates like this.
Boy, you really can't stand to lose, can you?
Your whole face is getting red.
Little veins popping out of your temple.
Plus that shirt doesn't really match those pants.
First of all, I'm not losing.
Just deal. - Hello? Rachel Green.
Excuse me.
It's about the job.
Barbara, hi. How are you?
Uh-huh?
No, I understand.
Yeah, oh, come on. No, I'm fine. Don't be silly.
Yeah. Oh, but you know, if anything else opens up, please...
Hello?
Hmm.
Sorry, Rach.
Yeah, you know, there's gonna be lots of other stuff.
Yeah. Okay.
Where were we? Oh. Okay.
Five card draw. Uh, jacks are better.
Nothing wild, everybody ante.
Look, Rach, we don't have to do this.
Yes, we do.
All right. Check. - Check.
I'm in for 50 cents.
Call. - I'm in.
I see your 50 cents...
...and I raise you...
...$5.
I thought, uh, it was a 50-cent limit.
Well, I just lost a job, and I'd like to raise the bet 5 bucks.
Does anybody have a problem with that?
Not at all. - No, no.
Loser?
No, I fold.
What do you mean, you fold? Hey, come on, what is this?
I thought that, "Once the cards are dealt, I'm not a nice guy."
I mean, what? Were you just full of it?
I'm in.
How many you want? - One.
Dealer takes two.
What do you bet? - I bet $2.
Okay.
See your 2...
...and I raise you...
...20. - Wow.
I see your 20...
...raise you 25.
See your 25...
...and, uh, Monica, get my purse.
Rachel, there's nothing in it.
Okay, then get me your purse.
Okay. Here you go. Good luck.
Thank you.
I saw your 25 and I raise you...
...7.
Joey, I'm a little shy.
That's okay, Ross. You can ask me.
What do you need? What do you need? - Fifteen.
All right, here's 10. - Here, I got 5, I got 5.
Thank you. - Good luck.
Okay, I am calling your 17.
What do you got?
Full house.
You got me.
Oh!
That's a tough hand to beat. - I thought we had them.
Well, when you don't have the cards, you don't have the cards, you know?
But look how happy she is.
Airmail. - Airplane. Airport.
Airport '75. Airport '77. Airport '79.
Time's up.
Bye Bye Birdie.
That's a bird?
That's a bird.
Okay, okay, it's my turn.
Go.
Uh, Bean. Bean.
The Unbearable Lightness of Being. - Yes!
That you get?
