sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 你优秀的电"恼"能力 我相信大家都会印象深刻
sense_groups.english: Uh, nothing. I'm sure they'll be impressed with your excellent "compuper" skills.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 每一张上面都写这样吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, do you think it's on all of them?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会啦 我相信影印机一定帮你抓到几个错误了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, I'm sure the Xerox machine caught a few.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 两位小姐
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi, ladies.

sense_groups.chinese: 要点什么饮料？
sense_groups.english: Uh, can I get you anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 去拿信了吗？ - 一堆回信
sense_groups.english: Did you bring the mail? - Lots of responses.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？当然还有司康松糕罗
sense_groups.english: Really? Sure we have scones left.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 念给我听
sense_groups.english: Okay, read them to me.

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的葛林小姐: 谢谢您的申请 不过…"
sense_groups.english: "Dear Miss Green: Thank you for your inquiry. However..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有苹果肉挂… - 好 "亲爱的葛林小姐"…
sense_groups.english: We have apple cinnamon... - Okay, "Dear Miss Green"...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好 好 不行
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah, yeah. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 什么啊？
sense_groups.english: Wow. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的卡债还真多
sense_groups.english: Your Visa bill is huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿来
sense_groups.english: Give me that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不敢相信 琳达这么可爱
sense_groups.english: You know, I can't believe you. Linda is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不约她出去？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Why won't you go out with her again? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是还在想…
sense_groups.english: Is this still about her whole...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说的"《摩登原始人》有可能是真的"？
sense_groups.english: ..."The Flintstones could have really happened" thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是那样
sense_groups.english: It's not just that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想要一个能让我心动…
sense_groups.english: It's just, I want someone who does something for me...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我小鹿乱撞…
sense_groups.english: ...you know, who gets my heart pounding...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我…
sense_groups.english: ...who makes me, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 身上穿毛衣的小东西？
sense_groups.english: Little play things with yarn?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么啊？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有人更让你心动的吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you want her more?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？
sense_groups.english: Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁？就是肥皂剧里那个女生啊
sense_groups.english: Who? Dee, the sarcastic sister from What's Happening!!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁啊？
sense_groups.english: Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我对她完全没有感觉了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, I am totally, totally over her, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是… 嘿 - 嘿 还要咖啡吗？
sense_groups.english: I just... Hi. - Hi. Coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 这样就好 - 好
sense_groups.english: No, we're fine. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们什么都没说哦
sense_groups.english: We're not saying anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么啊？ - 乔伊昨晚哭了
sense_groups.english: What? - Uh, Joey cried last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢哦
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是在玩牌吗？
sense_groups.english: We were playing poker, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 3号牌上有巧克力 所以看起来像8好吗？
sense_groups.english: There was chocolate on the three. It looked like an eight, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该让你们看看 《看着看着就哭了》
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, you should've seen him. "Read them and weep."

sense_groups.chinese: 他也照办了
sense_groups.english: And then he did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么从来不跟我们玩牌？
sense_groups.english: Well, now, how come you guys have never played poker with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 怎么回事？就是只有男生能玩吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, what is that? Like some kind of guy thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是只有性别歧视的男生能玩吗？
sense_groups.english: Like some kind of sexist guy thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 扑克牌只有男生能玩啊？
sense_groups.english: Like, it's poker, so only guys can play?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也很欢迎女生玩
sense_groups.english: No. Women are welcome to play.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 那怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, so then what is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是… 就是…
sense_groups.english: Some kind of, you know, like, some kind of, you know, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 到底是怎样？
sense_groups.english: All right, what is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 就只是刚好我们玩牌时 没有女人
sense_groups.english: There just don't happen to be any women in our game.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我们不认识会玩扑克牌的女人
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we just don't happen to know any women that know how to play poker.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 烂借口 标准的男生答案
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. That is such a lame excuse. I mean, it's a typical guy response.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 你们当中有人会玩吗？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, do any of you know how to play?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你们可以教我们
sense_groups.english: But you could teach us.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 现在我们抽牌
sense_groups.english: Okay, so now we draw cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这样不需要再抽了吧？我有顺子
sense_groups.english: So I wouldn't need any, right? Because I have a straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 恭喜你
sense_groups.english: Oh, good for you. - Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 菲比 你要几张？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, how many do you want?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要两张 黑桃10跟梅花6
sense_groups.english: Okay, I just need two. The 10 of spades and the six of clubs.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 菲比 不可以这样
sense_groups.english: No, uh, Pheebs, you can't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有黑桃10 你要不要？
sense_groups.english: I have the 10 of spades. Here, you want it?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 不可以这样子
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, see, uh, you can't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我不需要这张牌 我要四张四
sense_groups.english: No, no. That's okay. I don't need them. I'm going for fours.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 你在…
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 上菜了
sense_groups.english: All right, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是鲑鱼轮盘跟什锦生菜棒
sense_groups.english: We've got salmon roulettes and assorted crudités.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Monica, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在玩扑克牌 只能吃垃圾零食
sense_groups.english: This is a poker game. You can't serve food with more than one syllable.

sense_groups.chinese: 像洋芋片 蝴蝶脆饼…
sense_groups.english: It's got to be like chips or dip or pretz...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 现在庄家…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so at this point, the dealer...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了 开始玩真的吧 我们会了 高风险 玩真钱
sense_groups.english: You know what? We got it. We got it. Let's play for real. High stakes. Big bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定吗？菲比刚丢出两张J…
sense_groups.english: All right, now, you sure? Phoebe just threw away two jacks...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为它们看起来很不快乐
sense_groups.english: ...because they didn't look happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我可以玩了 发牌吧
sense_groups.english: But I'm ready. So just deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 最后一课 最后一课 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right, last minute lesson. Last minute lesson. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 8 3 好 可以开始了
sense_groups.english: Eight, three. All right. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 该死 该死
sense_groups.english: Damn it, damn it, damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 原来你是在说谎
sense_groups.english: I see. So then, um, you were lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 说什么谎？ - 说你的牌有多好
sense_groups.english: About what? - About how good your cards were.

sense_groups.chinese: 那叫做唬人
sense_groups.english: Heh. I was bluffing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那"唬人"是什么？
sense_groups.english: Aha. And what is "bluffing"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不就是说谎吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it not another word for lying?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 很抱歉要终止这场派对
sense_groups.english: Okay, sorry to break up this party...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我得在明天上班前把履历表发出去
sense_groups.english: ...but I've got resumes to fax before work tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦… - 瑞秋 我们得定局
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. - Rach, we've got to settle.

sense_groups.chinese: 定什么局？
sense_groups.english: Settle what?

sense_groups.chinese: 为维吉尼亚州 詹姆士镇的殖民地下定局
sense_groups.english: The Jamestown colony of Virginia.

sense_groups.chinese: 那块地是乔治国王要给我们的…
sense_groups.english: You see, King George is giving us the land, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这场牌局 这局你欠我们钱
sense_groups.english: The game, Rachel. The game. You owe us money for the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 对哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 这是她们第一次玩牌 我们就算了好不好？
sense_groups.english: You know what, guys? It's their first time. Why don't we forget about the money?

sense_groups.chinese: 才不要 我们会付的
sense_groups.english: Hell, no. We'll pay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 摩妮卡 我已经准备好另一个答案
sense_groups.english: Okay, Monica, I had another answer all ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了
sense_groups.english: And you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再来一场 - 我没问题
sense_groups.english: We want a rematch. - Well, that's fine with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有钱
sense_groups.english: Could use the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上 你们就是靠从朋友那边赢钱来过瘾的
sense_groups.english: So, basically, you get your ya-yas by taking money from all of your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 对 我靠去宜家过瘾
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yes, and I get my ya-yas from lkea.

sense_groups.chinese: 家具得自己组装 但是便宜一点
sense_groups.english: You have to put them together yourself, but they cost a little less.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我玩扑克牌的目的就是想赢 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, Rachel, this is poker. I play to win, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要赢 别人就得输
sense_groups.english: In order for me to win, other people have to lose.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我玩扑克牌 就别指望我当好好先生
sense_groups.english: So if you're gonna play poker with me, don't expect me to be a nice guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为一发牌…
sense_groups.english: Okay, because once those cards are dealt...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不是好好先生
sense_groups.english: I'm not a nice guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 大家来吃吧
sense_groups.english: All right, boys. Let's eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在"我爱瑞秋"披萨店买的吗？
sense_groups.english: Ah, did you get that from the "I Love Rachel" pizzeria?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在想那个？ - 拜托
sense_groups.english: You still on that? - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 那场"我是坏男人"演讲 是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What was with that whole Black Bart speech?

sense_groups.chinese: "我一玩扑克牌 就不是好好先生"
sense_groups.english: "When I play poker, I'm not a nice guy".

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 完全搞错了
sense_groups.english: You're way off, pal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不这么认为 罗斯 我认为你爱她
sense_groups.english: No, I don't think so. See, Ross, because I think you love her.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: Uh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对她有过好感 那都过去了
sense_groups.english: See, I might have had feelings for her at one time. Not anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是… 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: I just... Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿那片CD干什么？不可以再放了
sense_groups.english: Where are you going with that disk? You are not putting that on again.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔… 好 敢按下那个键 你就完蛋
sense_groups.english: Marcel... Okay. If you press that button, you are in very, very big trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信 罗斯居然那么浑蛋
sense_groups.english: You believe what a jerk Ross was being?

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 他还真是好胜
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. He can get really competitive.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛啊？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你是五十步笑百步吧
sense_groups.english: Oh. "Hello, Kettle, this is Monica. You're black."

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有像罗斯那么糟
sense_groups.english: I am not as bad as Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我看不出差别 记得比手画脚事件吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, I beg to differ. The Pictionary incident?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是什么事件
sense_groups.english: That was not an incident.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在比手画脚 盘子就溜出去了
sense_groups.english: I was gesturing and the plate slipped out of my hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有面试 我有面试了 - 真的吗？哪里？
sense_groups.english: Oh! I got an interview. I got an interview. - You're kidding. Where? Where?

sense_groups.chinese: 萨克斯百货公司 第五大街 - 哇 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Saks Fifth Avenue. - Oh, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就好像母船来召你回家乡了
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's like the mother ship is calling you home.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么样的职位？ - 助理采购人员
sense_groups.english: Well, what's the job? - Assistant buyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以靠血拼…
sense_groups.english: Oh! I would be shopping...

sense_groups.chinese: 吃饭
sense_groups.english: ...for a living.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 爱瑞丝阿姨来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. That's Aunt Iris.

sense_groups.chinese: 她5岁就开始玩扑克牌了
sense_groups.english: This woman has been playing poker since she was 5.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说的每一个字都要注意听
sense_groups.english: You've gotta listen to every word she says.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 喜剧泰斗东尼•蓝道死了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Is Tony Randall dead?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会？ - 我没听说
sense_groups.english: Oh, why? - I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能已经死了 我好像刚刚开车撞到他
sense_groups.english: Well, he may be now because I think I hit him with my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 真的吗？ - 假的 第一课 这就是唬人
sense_groups.english: My God. Really? - No, that's bluffing. Lesson number one.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你们吧
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 在扑克牌桌上听到的 通通不可以当真
sense_groups.english: Everything you hear at a poker game is pure crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 好漂亮的耳环 - 谢…
sense_groups.english: Nice earrings. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位小姐 坐下
sense_groups.english: Girls, sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱瑞丝阿姨 这是菲比 瑞秋… - 好了 好了…
sense_groups.english: Um, Aunt Iris, this is Phoebe, and Rachel... - Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始吧 这里停车要计时收费
sense_groups.english: Listen, I am parked at a meter. Let's do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 拜托 我们能不能听点别的？
sense_groups.english: Ross, could we please, please, listen to anything else?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚我完蛋了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna pay for that tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们猜 你们猜 你们猜
sense_groups.english: Guess what, guess what, guess what.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 第五个牙医投降了 他们开始推荐薄荷口香糖了？
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay. The fifth dentist caved, and now they're all recommending Trident?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是我的面试
sense_groups.english: No, the interview.

sense_groups.chinese: 她好喜欢我 超级喜欢我
sense_groups.english: She loved me. She absolutely loved me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们谈了两个半小时 我们的衣着品味相同
sense_groups.english: We talked for, like, two and a half hours. We have the same taste in clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她表妹还去过同一个夏令营
sense_groups.english: Oh, I went to camp with her cousin.

sense_groups.chinese: 这工作太完美了 我可以做得很好 一定可以
sense_groups.english: And, oh, the job is perfect. I can do this. I can do this well.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且她的故事超好笑的
sense_groups.english: God. And she told the funniest story.

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了 你说出来 我们一定会笑的
sense_groups.english: Okay, great, you'll tell us and we'll laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始玩扑克牌吧
sense_groups.english: Let's play poker.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们谈过了…
sense_groups.english: All right, listen, we talked about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们不想玩 我们可以理解
sense_groups.english: ...and if you don't want to play, we completely understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们可以玩别的 像是 不知道…
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes. We can play some other game. Like, I don't know...

sense_groups.chinese: 比手画脚？
sense_groups.english: ...Pictionary?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好笑 很好笑
sense_groups.english: Very funny. Very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再给扑克牌一次机会吧 好吗 两位小姐？
sense_groups.english: I think we'd like to give poker another try. Shall we, ladies?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 没问题
sense_groups.english: Yes, I think we should.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我洗牌吗？
sense_groups.english: Rach, do you want me to shuffle those?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 没关系 我来试试看吧
sense_groups.english: No, no. That's okay. You know what? I'm gonna give it a go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比欠7块5 摩妮卡 你欠10块
sense_groups.english: So Pheebs owes 7.50. Monica, you owe $10.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你欠15块
sense_groups.english: And, Rachel, you owe 15 big ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你教我们唱《斗鸡眼玛莉》
sense_groups.english: Thanks for teaching us "Crossed-eyed Mary."

sense_groups.chinese: 那个我们一定要放出来的
sense_groups.english: You guys, we gotta play that other way.

sense_groups.chinese: 7块5拿去 你们要知道 这钱被诅咒了
sense_groups.english: All right, here's my 7.50, but I think you should know that this money is cursed.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 哦 诅咒是我下的
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, I cursed it.

sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 被打断了 嗨
sense_groups.english: Gets interrupted. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 电影好看吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, how was the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 非常好看
sense_groups.english: Oh, so wonderful. - Oh, it was so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 烂到爆 - 只有女生才会去看
sense_groups.english: Suck fest. - Total chick flick.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉那不是那种…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry it wasn't one of those movies...

sense_groups.chinese: 有枪有炮…
sense_groups.english: ...with, like, you know, like, guns and bombs...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是巴士开超快的电影
sense_groups.english: ...and, like, buses going really fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 我喜欢的电影不一定要有暴力…
sense_groups.english: Hey, I don't need violence to enjoy a movie...

sense_groups.chinese: 只要有一些裸露镜头就够了
sense_groups.english: ...just so long as there's a little nudity.

sense_groups.chinese: 有裸露镜头啊 - 我是说女性的裸露镜头
sense_groups.english: There was nudity. - I meant female nudity.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我不想看路•葛兰有前戏
sense_groups.english: All right, I don't need to see Lou Grant frolicking.

sense_groups.chinese: 休 休•葛兰
sense_groups.english: Hugh. Hugh Grant.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我该走了
sense_groups.english: All right, I've got to go. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 马塞尔 过来
sense_groups.english: Come on, Marcel. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要去洗澡 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we're gonna go take a bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我们要洗澡哦 好不好？
sense_groups.english: Yes, we are, aren't we? Yes, we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们仍然只是朋友吧？
sense_groups.english: They're still just friends, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明天见
sense_groups.english: And I will see you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 明天你要来瑞秋阿姨这边 对不对？
sense_groups.english: That's right. You're gonna spend tomorrow at Aunt Rachel's, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 等一下 摩妮卡阿姨有没有权利说话？
sense_groups.english: Hang on, hang on. Does Aunt Monica get a say in this?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 摩妮卡阿姨 好不好？
sense_groups.english: Please, Aunt Monica, please? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 放轻松 明天你根本就不在
sense_groups.english: Oh, unclench. You're not even gonna be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信我们居然在讨论这种事
sense_groups.english: I can't believe we're having this discussion.

sense_groups.chinese: 同意 我也不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I agree. I'm, like, in disbelief.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得你跟瑞秋如果能在一起 早就在一起了？
sense_groups.english: Don't you think if things were gonna happen with Rachel, they would've happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你们 她说她想要跟…
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, she said she's looking for a relationship...

sense_groups.chinese: 像我这样的人谈恋爱
sense_groups.english: ...with someone exactly like me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的这么说？
sense_groups.english: She really said that?

sense_groups.chinese: "像我这样的人" 是我自己加的
sense_groups.english: Well, I added the "exactly like me" part.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是她说她在找个好男人 好男人今晚就会出现了
sense_groups.english: But she said she's looking for someone. And someone is gonna be there tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: "今晚"？你是说真的？
sense_groups.english: "Tonight" tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这一定会很完美 就只有我们两个
sense_groups.english: Well, I think it's perfect. It's just gonna be the two of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 她整天都在照顾我的猴子
sense_groups.english: She spent all day taking care of my monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不记得上次有女生照顾我的猴子是什么时候的事了
sense_groups.english: I can't remember the last time I got a girl to take care of my monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正 下班后 我去买一瓶酒…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, you know, I figured after work, I'd go pick up a bottle of wine...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后过去开始追求她
sense_groups.english: ...go over there and, uh, try to woo her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你应该怎么做吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what you should do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该带她回19世纪末 当时还有人使用那种字眼
sense_groups.english: You should take her back to the 1890s when that phrase was last used.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你坚持下去…
sense_groups.english: If you keep this up...

sense_groups.chinese: 不到周末 那个浑蛋就玩完了
sense_groups.english: ...you'll be finished with this sucker by the end of the week.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个围着羽绒围巾的是法兰西斯医生
sense_groups.english: Now, the one in the feathered boa, that's Dr. Francis.

sense_groups.chinese: 她以前是个男人
sense_groups.english: Now, she used to be a man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 那是瑞文 我们讨厌她
sense_groups.english: Oh, look. See, now, there's Raven. We hate her.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴她快死了
sense_groups.english: We're glad she's dying.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后… 怎么了？马塞尔
sense_groups.english: And then... What? Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在玩摩妮卡阿姨的鞋子吗？你知道你不可以…
sense_groups.english: Are you playing with Monica's shoes? You know you're not supposed to...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦…
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 你大便在鞋子里？
sense_groups.english: Marcel, did you poo in the shoe?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 马塞尔 坏猴子
sense_groups.english: Oh, Marcel. Bad monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 巴瑞
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Barry.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点祝贺你订婚的小礼物
sense_groups.english: A little engagement gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的礼物清单上没有这个
sense_groups.english: I'm sure you didn't register for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁死了？谁死了？
sense_groups.english: Who died? Who died?

sense_groups.chinese: 把他翻过来 快点 把他翻过来
sense_groups.english: Roll him over. Oh, come on, roll him over. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道那不是德柯斯特 对不对 马塞尔？因为…
sense_groups.english: Well, we know it wasn't Dexter, right, Marcel? Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？马塞尔？马…
sense_groups.english: Marcel? Marcel? Marc...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可能把他弄丢了？ - 我也不知道
sense_groups.english: How could you lose him? - I don't know, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在看电视 然后他大便在摩妮卡的鞋子里…
sense_groups.english: We were watching TV, and then he pooped in Monica's shoe...

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 他大便在我的鞋子里？哪一只？
sense_groups.english: Wait. He pooped in my shoe? Which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 左脚那一只
sense_groups.english: I don't know. The left one.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一双？
sense_groups.english: Which ones?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那双你认为百搭的笨重黑鞋
sense_groups.english: Oh, those little clunky Amish things you think go with everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么空气中充满了负面情绪？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, oh. Why is the air in here so negative?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋把马塞尔弄丢了 - 不会吧 怎么弄的？
sense_groups.english: Rachel lost Marcel. - Oh, no. How?

sense_groups.chinese: 他大便在我的鞋子里 - 哪一只？
sense_groups.english: He pooped in my shoe. - Which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是我常穿的那双可爱黑鞋
sense_groups.english: Those cute little black ones I wear all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是哪一只？
sense_groups.english: No, which one? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 右脚还是左脚？
sense_groups.english: The right or left?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为左脚的话 代表幸运
sense_groups.english: Because the left one is lucky.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙儿 拜托 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Come on, you guys. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好吧 你是一只猴子…
sense_groups.english: All right, all right, all right. You're a monkey...

sense_groups.chinese: 在城市里走失了
sense_groups.english: ...you're loose in the city.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where do you go?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这是他第一次出门…
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's his first time out...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他可能会去一些观光景点
sense_groups.english: ...so he's probably gonna want to do some of the touristy things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去《猫》音乐剧那边找 你们去俄国茶坊找
sense_groups.english: I'll go to Cats. You go to the Russian Tea Room.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 拜托你们
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Come on, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 他马上就回来 他会杀了我
sense_groups.english: He's gonna be home any minute. He's gonna kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 先从这栋房子开始 你们去1楼和2楼找
sense_groups.english: Start with the building. You take the first and second floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟我去3楼跟4楼
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and I will take third and fourth.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你留在这里等电话
sense_groups.english: Okay, you stay here and just wait by the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我的鞋子里喷清洁剂 等罗斯回来杀你
sense_groups.english: Spray Lysol in my shoe and wait for Ross to kill you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人要跟我交换工作吗？
sense_groups.english: Does anybody want to trade?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想干什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you want?

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯先生 我们朋友的猴子走丢了 你有没有看到？
sense_groups.english: Mr. Heckles, our friend lost a monkey. Have you seen it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我把格子松饼放在外头 是不是你们拿走的？
sense_groups.english: I left a Belgian waffle out here. Did you take it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要把格子松饼放在走道里？
sense_groups.english: Why would you leave your Belgian waffle in the hall?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没准备好要吃
sense_groups.english: I wasn't ready for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子 你有没有看到猴子？
sense_groups.english: The monkey, have you seen a monkey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我见过主持人瑞吉斯一次
sense_groups.english: I saw Regis Philbin once.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 黑考斯先生
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Mr. Heckles.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们欠我一块松饼
sense_groups.english: You owe me a waffle.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是一只白脸的黑色僧帽猴…
sense_groups.english: Okay, he's a black capuchin monkey with a white face...

sense_groups.chinese: 俄式沙拉酱跟腌黄瓜 另外放一边
sense_groups.english: ...with Russian dressing and pickles on the side.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 今天还可以吧？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey. How did it go today?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 好极了 顺利到不行 - 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. It went great. Really great. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你带酒来？ - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, is that wine? - Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 要喝一些吗？
sense_groups.english: You, uh, want some?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我很想喝 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Oh, I would love some. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了 这样好了 我们不要在这里喝
sense_groups.english: But you know what? You know what? Let's not drink it here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我突然想疯一下 你要不要去纽华克？
sense_groups.english: I'm feeling kind of crazy. Do you want to go to Newark?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好啊
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当然可以去那里 但在去东北部的谋杀案首都前…
sense_groups.english: We could do that. But before we head off to the murder capital of the Northeast...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想先跟你谈一件事
sense_groups.english: ...I was, uh, kind of wanted to run something by you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们先前谈过的…
sense_groups.english: You know how we were, you know, talking before...

sense_groups.chinese: 有关恋爱之类的话题…
sense_groups.english: ...about relationships and stuff, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 罗斯 我不能这么做 - 好吧 迅速而痛苦
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Ross, I cannot do this. - Okay, quick and painful.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好吧 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right. All right, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 请不要恨我
sense_groups.english: Ross, please don't hate me.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 怎么了？怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what? What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道马塞尔吧？
sense_groups.english: You know Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Well, ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好像把他弄丢了
sense_groups.english: I kind of, uh... I kind of lost him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要你看着他 别让他离开这间公寓
sense_groups.english: I mean, all I asked you to do was keep him in the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我知道 对不起
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我想我也有错
sense_groups.english: You know what? I guess it's partially my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不应该一开始就请你照顾猴子
sense_groups.english: I shouldn't have asked you to start off with a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该一开始就请你看着一支铅笔之类的
sense_groups.english: I should have started you off with, like, a pen or a pencil.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我已经在尽力找了
sense_groups.english: Ross, I'm doing everything that I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都在找他 而且我还…
sense_groups.english: I've got everybody looking for him and I got...

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一位？ - 动物紧急救援小组
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - Animal Control.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还打电话给动物紧急救援 - 你打给动物救援？
sense_groups.english: See, I've even got Animal Control. - You called Animal Control?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？你不喜欢他们吗？
sense_groups.english: Why? Do you not like them?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔是非法引进的外来动物
sense_groups.english: Heh. Marcel is an illegal exotic animal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能在城市里养
sense_groups.english: I'm not allowed to have him in the city.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一旦找到他 就会把他从我身边带走
sense_groups.english: If they find him, they'll take him away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这样说好了 你从来没有告诉过我们这件事
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, now, see, you never ever, ever told us that.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 因为我没想到你会邀请他们来这里
sense_groups.english: That's right, because I didn't expect you we're gonna invite them to the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 谢谢你赶过来
sense_groups.english: Hi. Thanks for coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是有人打电话 问猴子怎么处理？
sense_groups.english: Somebody called about a monkey?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你知道吗？那完全是个误会
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, you know what? That was a complete misunderstanding.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我们以为我们看到一只猴子 结果不是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we thought we had a monkey, but we didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是顶帽子 - 猫
sense_groups.english: It turned out it was a hat. - Cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 猫 我刚刚说什么？
sense_groups.english: Cat. What did I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 3楼跟4楼 我们都去看过了
sense_groups.english: Hi. We checked the third and fourth floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人看到马塞尔 - 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: No one's seen Marcel. - Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我叔叔马塞尔
sense_groups.english: My uncle Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 猴子的名字就是这样来的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, is that who the monkey's named after?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道私自豢养非法引进的外来动物…
sense_groups.english: Are you aware that possession of an illegal exotic is punishable...

sense_groups.chinese: 最高可罚到两年牢狱 动物没收
sense_groups.english: ...by up to two years in prison and confiscation of the animal.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会把可怜的小动物关在牢里两年？
sense_groups.english: You'd put that poor little creature in jail?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 记不记得我们说过 说话前要先想一下？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, you remember how we talked about saying things quietly to yourself first?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 不过不是随时都有时间可以这样做
sense_groups.english: Yes, but there isn't always time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信一定有更友善的方式解决 你先请坐
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sure there's some friendly way to reconcile this. Um, have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还没自我介绍 我是摩妮卡•盖勒
sense_groups.english: First of all, we haven't been introduced. I'm Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊 是你
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你是瑞秋•葛林 - 对
sense_groups.english: And you're Rachel Green. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 露伊莎•基雅内蒂 我也是林肯高中毕业的
sense_groups.english: Luisa Gianetti. Lincoln High?

sense_groups.chinese: 每次在教室上课时 我都坐在你们后面
sense_groups.english: I sat behind you guys in homeroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 露伊莎 噢 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh! Luisa. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 是露伊莎耶
sense_groups.english: Monica. It's Luisa!

sense_groups.chinese: 同间教室的露伊莎
sense_groups.english: Luisa. From homeroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本不知道我是谁 对不对？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: You have no idea who I am, do you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不知道
sense_groups.english: Not at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是因为整整四年 你正眼都没瞧过我
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe that's because you spent four years ignoring me.

sense_groups.chinese: 说句"早安 露伊莎" 还是…
sense_groups.english: Would it have been so hard to say, "Morning, Luisa"...

sense_groups.chinese: "好可爱的吊带裤" 有那么难吗？
sense_groups.english: ...or "Nice overalls"?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 真对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不怪你 你那时候很胖 问题已经够多了
sense_groups.english: It's not so much you. You were fat. You had your own problems.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你 真是个讨人厌的女生
sense_groups.english: But you. What a bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了 过去就算了
sense_groups.english: You know what? Be that as it may.

sense_groups.chinese: 看在过去的份上 猴子的事能不能请你帮个忙？
sense_groups.english: You think you could you help us out here on that monkey thing, for old times' sake?

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 山猫队
sense_groups.english: Go, Bobcats.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 但是我不帮
sense_groups.english: I could. But I won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子被我找到 就是我的了
sense_groups.english: If I find that monkey, he's mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 哒…
sense_groups.english: Da, da, da

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？- 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Marcel? - Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 有什么事我可以帮忙的吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, can I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有点紧急状况 我们在找东西
sense_groups.english: Uh, we're kind of having an emergency, and, ahem, we were looking for something.

sense_groups.chinese: 找猴子 - 对 你有没有看到一只猴子？
sense_groups.english: A monkey. - Yes, have you seen any?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我没看到什么猴子
sense_groups.english: No. No, I haven't seen a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会不会修理暖气炉？
sense_groups.english: Do you know anything about fixing radiators?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 你们有没有试着把开关往相反方向转？
sense_groups.english: Sure, sure. Did you try turning the knob back the other way?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有 - 那我们就没办法了
sense_groups.english: Of course. - Oh. Then, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尝尝这鸡尾酒 莱姆酒会不会放太多？
sense_groups.english: Taste this daiquiri. Is there too much rum in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 希望你们快点找到猴子
sense_groups.english: Just a second. Hope you find your monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不 等一下等一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, wait. No, no, no. Wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 暖气炉我们可能不太熟悉…
sense_groups.english: Um, we may not know about radiators, per se...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们对环境的冷暖…
sense_groups.english: ...but we do have a certain amount of expertise...

sense_groups.chinese: 有一定程度的认知
sense_groups.english: ...in the heating and cooling milieu.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是还有事情要做吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, weren't we kind of in the middle of something here?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是这些女人很热 而且需要我们帮忙
sense_groups.english: Yes, but these women are very hot and they need our help.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还很辣
sense_groups.english: And they're very hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不可以这样 好吗？
sense_groups.english: We can't, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾
sense_groups.english: We're sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不知道我们有多遗憾
sense_groups.english: You have no idea how sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们已经答应要去找猴子
sense_groups.english: But we promised we'd find this monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们看到他 他大概这么高 叫他马塞尔他会回应
sense_groups.english: If you see him, he's about yea high and answers to the name Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们能够有你们的照片 那对我们帮助很大
sense_groups.english: So if we could get some pictures of you, you'd really be helping us out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 从现在开始 你不准跟外人说话
sense_groups.english: Okay, from now on, you don't get to talk to other people.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？ - 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Marcel? - Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 有东西拂过我的右腿
sense_groups.english: Something just brushed up against my right leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: What is it? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 没什么 那是我的左腿
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's okay. It was just my left leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 菲比
sense_groups.english: Look, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 太好了 噢 马塞尔 过来
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Oh, Marcel. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 马塞尔 - 两位小姐 请让开
sense_groups.english: Oh, come here, Marcel. - Step aside, ladies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要做什么？ - 只是一点镇静剂
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do? - Just a small tranquilizer.

sense_groups.chinese: 快跑 马塞尔 快跑 跑啊 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Run, Marcel, run! Run, Marcel!

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 - 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Damn. - Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 还好 应该没事
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, gosh.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Marcel. Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太荒谬了 我们整个社区都找过了
sense_groups.english: This is ridiculous. We've been all over the neighborhood.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跑掉了 他跑掉了
sense_groups.english: He's gone. He's just gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你怎么知道？ - 噢 拜托 现在又冷又暗
sense_groups.english: Ross, you don't know that. - Oh, come on. It's cold, it's dark.

sense_groups.chinese: 他根本不熟悉格林威治村
sense_groups.english: He doesn't know the Village.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我的脚骨断了 噢 我的…
sense_groups.english: And now I have a broken foot. Oh, my...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的猴子不见了 再加上断脚
sense_groups.english: I have no monkey and a broken foot.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我已经跟你道歉过几百万次了
sense_groups.english: Ross, you know, I've said I'm sorry, like, a million times.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怎么做？你要我也踢断脚吗？
sense_groups.english: What do you want me to do? Huh? You want me to break my foot too?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 我也来踢断我的脚
sense_groups.english: Here, I'm gonna break my foot right now. Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊 好了 这样你高兴了没有？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. There, are you happy now?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 有 你踢过交通标志后…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. You know, now that you kicked the sign...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我突然不再想念马塞尔了
sense_groups.english: ...hey, ha, ha, I don't miss Marcel anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 我又不是故意的
sense_groups.english: You know, it's not like I did this on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 当然不是 这只是标准的瑞秋
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. No, no. This is just vintage Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你身边的倒霉事都会自动发生
sense_groups.english: I mean, things just sort of happen around you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一直都活在自己的世界里 做你自己的事…
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're off in Rachel Land, doing your Rachel thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不顾别人的猴子 还是别人的感受…
sense_groups.english: ...totally oblivious to people's monkeys or to people's feelings and...

sense_groups.chinese: 连我都不想听 - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I don't even want to hear it. - Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 可以吗？ - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Forget it, okay? - Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 香蕉男
sense_groups.english: Hey, banana man.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 真是有够强的
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is so intense.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一边的屁股完全麻掉 另一边却完全不知道
sense_groups.english: One side of my butt is totally asleep and the other side has no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 香蕉是你买的吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. Did you order some bananas?

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？ - 猴子还我
sense_groups.english: What about it? - Give me my monkey back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有猴子
sense_groups.english: I don't have a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那买那么多香蕉干什么？ - 需要钾
sense_groups.english: Then what's with all the bananas? - Potassium.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Marcel? Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 他在哪里 他在哪里？马塞尔 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Okay, where is he? Where is he? Marcel? Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对他做了什么？
sense_groups.english: What have you done to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的猴子 派蒂 猴子派蒂
sense_groups.english: That's my monkey. That's Patty. Patty the monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you insane?

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 快点过来 - 派蒂过来
sense_groups.english: Come here, Marcel. Come on. - Come here, Patty.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来这里 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Come here, Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 派蒂 过来这里
sense_groups.english: Come here, Patty.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 猴子 过来这里
sense_groups.english: Here, monkey. Here, monkey. Here, monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 抓到了
sense_groups.english: Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 猴子还我 - 现在他是我的猴子
sense_groups.english: Okay, give me my monkey back. - That's my monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得去跟法官解释
sense_groups.english: You're gonna have to take this up with the judge.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是我的猴子 不过裙子是我的
sense_groups.english: That's not my monkey. Just the dress is mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你方便的话 再寄回来给我
sense_groups.english: You can send it back whenever.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要我的猴子 - 不行
sense_groups.english: All right, I want my monkey. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你 露伊莎 - 很抱歉 毕业舞会皇后
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Luisa. - Sorry, prom queen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在高中一定要那么讨人厌
sense_groups.english: You had to be a bitch in high school,

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不能当个胖子
sense_groups.english: you couldn't have been fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 听好 高中时 我是毕业舞会皇后…
sense_groups.english: All right, look, in high school, I was the prom queen...

sense_groups.chinese: 也是返校日皇后 班长 而你…
sense_groups.english: ...and I was the homecoming queen and the class president and you...

sense_groups.chinese: 也一直都存在
sense_groups.english: ...were also there.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你带走这只猴子…
sense_groups.english: Look, if you take this monkey...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会失去生命中最重要的一个人
sense_groups.english: ...I will lose one of the most important people in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以恨我 但是请不要惩罚他
sense_groups.english: You can hate me if you want, but please do not punish him.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你 露伊莎 你有机会可以当更高尚的人
sense_groups.english: Come on, Luisa, you have a chance to be the bigger person here.

sense_groups.chinese: 把握这机会
sense_groups.english: Take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就要打电话给你长官 告诉她…
sense_groups.english: Well, then how about I call your supervisor and I tell her...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在我朋友的屁股上开了一枪
sense_groups.english: ...that you shot my friend in the ass with a dart.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 能把这件裙子脱下来 感觉不错吧？
sense_groups.english: Hey, it'll be nice to get this off finally, won't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不然继续让你穿着 也没关系
sense_groups.english: Or we can leave it on for now. That's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 再加上一双漂亮的高跟鞋 整套晚宴装就齐全了
sense_groups.english: You know, with the right pair of pumps, that would be a great little outfit.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉先前对你的态度那么差 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I was so hard on you before. You know, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 罗斯 别这样说 都是我不好 几乎让你失去…
sense_groups.english: No, Ross, come on. No, no. It was my fault. I almost lost your...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 多亏了你 他才能回来
sense_groups.english: No, no. Yeah, but you were the one who got him back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很了不起
sense_groups.english: You know, you were great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我们的酒还在
sense_groups.english: Hey, we still have that bottle of wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想不想来点…
sense_groups.english: Are you in the mood for, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 有葡萄的东西？
sense_groups.english: ...something grape?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 好主意 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure, that would be good. - All right, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是邻居在吸地板
sense_groups.english: The, uh... The neighbors must be vacuuming.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要我们在这里…
sense_groups.english: Well, ah, as long as we're here...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是在谈那个话题…
sense_groups.english: ...and not on the subject, um, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚在想…
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们两个都在生对方的气
sense_groups.english: ...how mad we got at each other before.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想 可能也是因为我们都…
sense_groups.english: And, um, I was thinking maybe it was partially because of how we...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 巴瑞？
sense_groups.english: Rachel? - Barry?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法 我办不到 我不能娶敏蒂
sense_groups.english: I can't. I can't do it. I can't marry Mindy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还爱着你 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I'm still in love with you. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得开始锁门了
sense_groups.english: We have got to start locking that door.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我演《真善美》的时候
sense_groups.english: This is me in The Sound of Music.

sense_groups.chinese: 有看到冯崔普家的孩子们吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: You see the von Trapp kids? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我站在他们前面
sense_groups.english: That's because I'm in front of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 对哦 我以为那是阿尔卑斯山
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I thought that was an alp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我高中时过得不太好
sense_groups.english: Well, high school was not my favorite time.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我高中时超快乐的 你们知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I loved high school, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 四年都在轰趴 约会 跟女生上床…
sense_groups.english: It was just, like, four years of parties and dating and sex and...

sense_groups.chinese: 我则是跟四百个男生一起上寄宿学校
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I went to boarding school with 400 boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 想上床 就得改变整个性向
sense_groups.english: Any sex I had would've involved a major lifestyle choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 感觉好像是几百万年前的事了 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Gosh, doesn't it seem like a million years ago?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我的屁股醒来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my butt cheek is waking up.

sense_groups.english: Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 敏蒂
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Oh, Mindy.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你真的好傻
sense_groups.english: Oh, you are so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我们真的都好傻
sense_groups.english: Oh, we are both so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 很熟悉的味道吧？ - 噢 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Smell familiar? - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不 是我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, me. I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是我很抱歉 对不起
sense_groups.english: No, I am sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 四个字母 "发出声音"
sense_groups.english: Four letters, "circle or hoop."

sense_groups.chinese: 响啊 该死 响啊
sense_groups.english: Ring, damn it, ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们的电话坏掉了吗？
sense_groups.english: You know our phone's not working?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我从咖啡厅打电话给你 一直没有人接
sense_groups.english: I tried to call you from the coffee shop. There was no answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把电话关掉了
sense_groups.english: I turned it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我把电话关掉
sense_groups.english: Mother of God, I turned it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像你跟她讲的那样
sense_groups.english: Just like you told her you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是指出反讽之处
sense_groups.english: Just pointing out the irony.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去跟对面的门房谈过
sense_groups.english: So listen, I went across the street and talked to the doorman.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道偷窥狂的名字 电话可以用了吧？
sense_groups.english: I got the peeper's name. Can I use the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能借用你的电话？
sense_groups.english: Can I use your phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 请给我 辛尼•马克斯的电话号码
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the number for a Sidney Marks, please.

sense_groups.chinese: "加温的工具"
sense_groups.english: "Heating device."

sense_groups.chinese: 电热器
sense_groups.english: Radiator.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个字
sense_groups.english: Five letters.

sense_groups.chinese: "电器"
sense_groups.english: "Rdtor."

sense_groups.chinese: 辛尼在吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, is Sidney there?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 你就是？
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is?

sense_groups.chinese: 辛尼是个女人 - 辛尼是个女人 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Sidney's a woman. - So she's a woman, so what?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 对 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, so what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我住在你对面…
sense_groups.english: Look, I live across the street...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你喜欢用望远镜偷窥
sense_groups.english: ...and I know all about you and your telescope.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很不高兴 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: And I don't appreciate it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我现在就可以看到你 喂？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I can see you right now. Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我喜欢穿着内裤 在我家跑来跑去…
sense_groups.english: Look, if I wanna walk around my apartment in my underwear...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有必要觉得… 谢谢
sense_groups.english: ...I shouldn't have to feel like... Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是重点
sense_groups.english: That's not really the point.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是…
sense_groups.english: The point is, that...

sense_groups.chinese: 主要是重量训练 但是偶尔… - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Mostly free-weights, but occasionally... - Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我的邻居 褐发的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, my neighbor. Yeah, the brunette.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说你那天穿那件绿洋装的时候很漂亮
sense_groups.english: She said you looked pretty that day in the green dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 绿洋装？真的吗？
sense_groups.english: The green dress? Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说那天你很像英格丽•褒曼
sense_groups.english: She said you looked like Ingrid Bergman that day.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有
sense_groups.english: Heh. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 有空吗？ - 当然 当然
sense_groups.english: You got a second? - Sure, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 请…
sense_groups.english: Come on...

sense_groups.chinese: 进
你好 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hello, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个在这里干嘛？ - 我们来甩你
sense_groups.english: What you guys doing here? - Uh, we are here to break up with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一起？
sense_groups.english: Both of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们觉得你是个大烂人 你应该很衰
sense_groups.english: We think you're a horrible human being, and bad things should happen to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 对不起 天啊 真对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. God, I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是大白痴 我很软弱 无法控制自己
sense_groups.english: I'm an idiot. I was weak. I couldn't help myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管我做了什么 我会那么做 都是因为我那么爱你
sense_groups.english: Whatever I did, I only did because I love you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在跟哪一个讲 巴瑞？
sense_groups.english: Uh, which one of us are you talking to there, Bar?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃…
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 敏蒂
sense_groups.english: Mindy.

sense_groups.chinese: 敏蒂 当然是敏蒂 一直都是敏蒂
sense_groups.english: Mindy, of course, Mindy. It was always Mindy.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至包括我们在那张椅子上做爱的时候？
sense_groups.english: Even when we were having sex in that chair?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓 不管我在做什么 心里想的都是你
sense_groups.english: I swear, look, whatever I was doing, I was always thinking of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二次的时候 就算排队等你挑 你都会认不出她来
sense_groups.english: During that second time, you couldn't have picked her out of a lineup.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还做了两次？
sense_groups.english: You did it twice?

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次不能算数 你也认识巴瑞
sense_groups.english: Well, the first time didn't really count. You know, it was Barry.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 对哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 宝贝 亲爱的…
sense_groups.english: Honey, baby, sweetheart, look...

sense_groups.chinese: 再给我一次机会 好不好？
sense_groups.english: Just give me another chance, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再重新来过 我们回去阿鲁巴岛
sense_groups.english: We'll start all over again. We'll go back to Aruba.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么说？
sense_groups.english: What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 法柏医生 有点紧急状况 需要你处理
sense_groups.english: Dr. Farber, we've got an emergency here.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰森•卡斯达拉诺 被活动牙套呛到
sense_groups.english: Jason Castalano's choking on his retainer.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我 马上过去 柏妮丝
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Uh, I'll be right there, Bernice.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 请不要离开 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, please, please don't go anywhere, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'll be right back. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们会留在这里 继续恨你
sense_groups.english: Okay, and we'll be here, hating you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有看到他走出去的时候 满身大汗？
sense_groups.english: See how he was sweating when he walked out of here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我抓他的下面 你就可以踢他…
sense_groups.english: If I'm hogging the ball, you jump right in there...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后揍他两拳 我告诉你 那会感觉超爽
sense_groups.english: ...and take a couple of punches. Because I'm telling you, this feels great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我很确定我还是会嫁他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm pretty sure I'm still gonna marry him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么啊？
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 敏蒂 那家伙是个恶魔
sense_groups.english: Mindy, the guy is the devil.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是披着人皮的撒旦
sense_groups.english: He is Satan in a smock.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我知道他不完美
sense_groups.english: Look, I know he's not perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 到头来 我还是…
sense_groups.english: But the truth is, at the end of the day...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是想当…
sense_groups.english: ...I still really wanna be...

sense_groups.chinese: 巴瑞•法柏牙医…
sense_groups.english: ...Mrs. Dr. Barry Farber...

sense_groups.chinese: 医师娘
噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你还是能够为我高兴
sense_groups.english: I hope you can find some way to be happy for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 也希望你仍然愿意当我的伴娘
sense_groups.english: And I hope you'll still be my maid of honor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望巴瑞不会在阿鲁巴岛把你生吞活剥吃掉
sense_groups.english: And I hope Barry doesn't kill you and eat you in Aruba.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: You okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我把巴瑞丢在婚礼上 逃了婚后…
sense_groups.english: You know, ever since I ran out on Barry at the wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想过我的决定是否正确
sense_groups.english: ...I have wondered whether I made the right choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我知道了
sense_groups.english: Oh. And now I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 很为你高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad.

sense_groups.chinese: 大日子唷
sense_groups.english: Big day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我可以赞成 花生先生比较会穿衣服
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll give you this: Mr. Peanut is a better dresser.

sense_groups.chinese: 他戴着单片眼镜 加上礼帽…
sense_groups.english: I mean, he's got the monocle, he's got the top hat...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道他是同志吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know he's gay?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是想澄清一下 你在揪花生先生出柜吗？
sense_groups.english: I just wanna clarify this. Are you outing Mr. Peanut?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？ - 丹妮儿 你好
sense_groups.english: Chandler? - Danielle, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 这位是丹妮儿 丹妮儿 这都是我朋友
sense_groups.english: Everybody, this is Danielle. Danielle, everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会在这里？ - 我一直打电话给你…
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? - I've been calling you...

sense_groups.chinese: 后来才知道电话号码错了
sense_groups.english: ...but it turns out I had your number wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从查号台拿到正确号码后 却没人接
sense_groups.english: And when I finally got the right one from Information, there was no answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就想来这里 看看你好不好
sense_groups.english: So I thought I'd just come down here and make sure you were okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我很好
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 改天我们出去逛逛好吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, uh, maybe we could get together later?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 我再打给你 还是你打给我 都可以
sense_groups.english: That sounds good. I'll call you. Or you call me, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也知道 - 哈…
sense_groups.english: You know. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 好
sense_groups.english: You got it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙儿再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, everybody. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 就是要这样
sense_groups.english: Woo-hoo! Yeah, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二次约会
sense_groups.english: Second date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不确定？
sense_groups.english: You don't know?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看起来很讨人喜欢 但是大老远跑来这里…
sense_groups.english: Oh, she seems nice, but that thing about her coming all the way here...

sense_groups.chinese: 只为了看我好不好？有人那么黏人的吗？
sense_groups.english: ...just to see if I was okay? I mean, how needy is that?

questions.name: S01E21
questions.en:
How'd someone get your credit card number?
I have no idea. Look how much they spent!
Monica, Calm down.
You only have to pay for the stuff you bought.
Still, it's just such reckless spending.
When somebody steals your credit card...
...they've kind of already thrown caution to the wind.
Wow, what a geek. They spent $69.95 on a Wonder Mop.
That's me.
Oh! Oh, the yuck.
He's doing it again!
Marcel, stop humping the lamp!
Stop humping! Now, Marcel, come back!
Come here, Marcel!
Oh, no, no! Not in my room! I'll get him.
You've got to do something about the humping.
What? It's just a phase.
Well, that's what we said about Joey.
Hey, would you all relax? It's not that big a deal.
Marcel, stop it! Marcel! Bad monkey!
What? - Ugh!
Let's just say my Curious George doll is no longer curious.
Ugh, Monica, you are not still going over that thing.
This woman's living my life. - What?
She's living my life, and she's doing it better than me.
Look at this. Look.
She buys tickets to plays I want to see.
She shops at stores that I'm intimidated by the salespeople.
She spent $300 on art supplies.
You're not an artist.
Yeah, well, I might be if I had the supplies.
I mean, I could do all this stuff. Only I don't.
Oh, Monica, come on. You do cool things.
Oh, really? Let's compare, shall we?
Oh, it's so late for "shall we?"
Do I go horseback riding in the park, hmm?
Do I take classes at The New School?
No. - No.
This is so unfair.
She's got everything I want, and she doesn't have my mother.
How about Joey Paponi?
No, still too ethnic.
My agent thinks I should have a name that's more neutral.
Joey Switzerland?
Plus I think it should be Joe. Joey makes me sound like I'm...
...this big.
Which I'm not!
Joe, Joe, Joe... Stalin?
Stalin.
Do I know that name? That sounds familiar.
Well, it does not ring a bell with me. - Huh.
Joe Stalin.
You know, that's pretty good.
You might want to try Joseph. - Ah!
Joseph Stalin!
I think you'd remember that! - Oh, yes!
Bye Bye Birdie, starring Joseph Stalin.
Joseph Stalin is the Fiddler on the Roof.
Hey. - Hey.
Hi.
Hi. Uh, yes, this is Monica Geller.
Um, I'm taking classes with you, and I was wondering what they were.
What are you doing?
All right, great.
Great. Thanks a lot.
I'm going to tap class.
So you can dance with the woman that stole your card?
She's got my life. I want to see who she is.
Go to the post office! I'm sure her picture's up!
Honey, you're kind of losing it here.
This is really becoming a weird obsession.
This is madness, I tell you.
For the love of God, Monica, don't do it!
Thank you.
What do you think?
Lots of things.
Which one do you think she is?
May I help you? - Oh, no, thanks.
We're just here to observe.
You don't observe a dance class. You dance a dance class!
Spare shoes are over there.
What does she mean?
I think she means, "You dance...
...a dance class!"
Come on, come on, come on!
Really?
Hey, do you see anybody you think could be me?
People, last time there were yogurt containers lying around after class.
Let's not have that happen again!
She could be you.
Let's get started.
Five, six. Five, six, seven, eight.
Okay, I'm not getting this!
I'm totally getting it!
Do you ever just feel like you're so unbelievably uncoordinated?
What? You just click when they click.
All right. Now everyone grab a partner.
Oh! Oh.
All right. And my dead mother said you are it! I'm with Rachel.
Great, it's gym class all over again.
Aww.
That's all right. You can come up to the front and dance with me.
Why don't I just take off my clothes and have a nightmare?
It's okay, it's okay! I'm here, I'm here. I'm so sorry I'm late.
Okay, here I am.
So who's the new tense girl?
She's your partner.
Hi, I'm Monica. - Hi.
Oh, ha.
Monica.
Hi, I'm Mon...
Nana.
Monana? - Yeah.
It's Dutch.
You're kidding. I spent three years in Amsterdam.
Um, Pennsylvania Dutch.
And we're dancing!
Five, six, seven, eight.
Hi.
Hey. - Hey.
Where have you been? - I just got back from the vet.
She's not gonna make you wear a big plastic cone, is she?
She says Marcel's humping thing is not a phase.
Apparently, he's reached sexual maturity.
Hey, he beat you!
She says, as time goes on, he'll start getting aggressive and violent.
What does this mean?
I have to give him up.
I can't believe it, Rose. This sucks!
You just got him. How could he be an adult already?
I know, I know. One day he's this little thing...
...and before you know it, he's this little thing...
...I can't get off my leg.
Isn't there any way you can keep him?
No. No.
The vet said that unless he's in a place where he has regular access...
...to some monkey loving...
...he's just gonna get vicious.
I just gotta get him into a zoo.
How do you get a monkey into a zoo? - I know that one!
No, that's popes into a Volkswagen.
We're applying to a lot of them. Our first choice would be a state zoo.
You know, like, uh, San Diego.
Right?
But that may just be a pipe dream because he's out-of-state.
My vet knows someone at Miami, so that's a possibility.
But that's two blocks from the beach. It's a total party zoo.
Hey. - Hey.
Hi. - We found the girl!
What? - Did you call the cops?
Nope. We took her to lunch.
Ah. Your own brand of vigilante justice.
Are you insane? This woman stole from you!
She stole! She's a stealer!
After you're with this woman for 10 minutes, you forget all that.
I mean, she's this astounding person...
...with this amazing spirit!
Yeah, which she probably stole from some cheerleader!
Take off their hats. - Popes in a Volkswagen!
Mm-hm.
I love that joke.
No way! No way did you do this! - Monana was very brave.
It was so wild.
We told them we were the Gunnersons in room 615...
...only to find out the Boston Celtics had the entire sixth floor!
So when they caught on to the fact that we're short and have breasts...
They threw us out. I was thrown out of a hotel! Me!
Go, Monana!
Well, you ladies are not the only ones living the dream.
I get to go pour coffee for people I don't know. Don't wait up.
Oh, by the way...
...tomorrow we're auditioning for a Broadway show.
Excuse me?
There's an open call for Cats.
I'm thinking we go down there, sing "Memories"...
...and make complete fools of ourselves. What do you say?
No, no, no.
Remember who you're dealing with here. Ha.
I'm not like you. I can't even stand in front of a tap class.
That's because of your Amish background.
What? - Well, you're Pennsylvania Dutch, right?
Right.
Till I bought a blow dryer. Then I was shunned.
I was just like you.
And then one day, I saw a movie that changed my life.
Did you ever see Dead Poets Society? - Uh-huh.
I thought that movie was so incredibly...
...boring!
I mean, that thing at the end where the kid...
...kills himself because he can't be in the play?
What was that?
It's like, "Kid, wait a year. Leave home, do some community theater!"
I walked out of there, and I thought
"Now, that's two hours of my life that I'm never getting back!"
And that scared me more than all the other crap I was afraid to do.
Wow.
Then I would definitely not recommend Mrs. Doubtfire.
Oh, God.
We didn't get into Scranton.
That was our safety zoo.
They take, like, dogs and cows.
See?
I don't know who this is harder on, me or him.
I'd say that chair's taking the brunt of it.
Marcel. Marcel.
Marcel, no.
Good boy!
See? How can nobody want him?
Somebody will.
You know there already is a Joseph Stalin?
You're kidding!
Apparently, he was this Russian dictator who slaughtered all these people!
You'd think you would've known that! - You'd think I would've.
Phoebe, what do you think a good stage name for me would be?
Flame Boy!
Where exactly is your zoo?
Well, it's technically not a zoo per se.
It's, uh, more of an interactive wildlife experience.
Let me ask you some questions about... Is it, uh, Marcel?
Yes. - Yes. Uh...
Does he, uh, fight with other animals?
No, no. He's very docile.
Hmm. Even if he were cornered?
Well, I don't know. Why?
Um, how is he at handling small objects?
He can hold a banana, if that's what you mean.
What about a hammer or a small blade?
Why would he need a blade?
If he's up against a jungle cat or an animal with horns...
...you got to give the little guy something.
Otherwise, it's just cruel!
He got into San Diego!
What? - Yeah.
We were coming back from our walk, and the phone was ringing...
He's in! - He's in? Ah!
Did you hear that, Marcel?
San Diego! San Diego! Yeah!
You're making a mistake. San Diego's well and good...
...but if you give him to me, I'll start him against a blind rabbit...
...and give you 20 percent of the gate.
Yo-ho!
Where have you been?
Monica and I just crashed an embassy party.
Are you drunk?
No!
I'm lying.
I am so drunk!
Oh, God!
Ugh. Great. You know what? You could have called.
I've been up here. I've been worried...
Monica.
Monica?
Water rules!
Yes. Yes, it does.
The restaurant called. They want to know if you're showing up.
