Hi. - We found the girl!
What? - Did you call the cops?
Nope. We took her to lunch.
Ah. Your own brand of vigilante justice.
Are you insane? This woman stole from you!
She stole! She's a stealer!
After you're with this woman for 10 minutes, you forget all that.
I mean, she's this astounding person...
...with this amazing spirit!
Yeah, which she probably stole from some cheerleader!
Take off their hats. - Popes in a Volkswagen!
Mm-hm.
I love that joke.
No way! No way did you do this! - Monana was very brave.
It was so wild.
We told them we were the Gunnersons in room 615...
...only to find out the Boston Celtics had the entire sixth floor!
So when they caught on to the fact that we're short and have breasts...
They threw us out. I was thrown out of a hotel! Me!
Go, Monana!
Well, you ladies are not the only ones living the dream.
I get to go pour coffee for people I don't know. Don't wait up.
Oh, by the way...
...tomorrow we're auditioning for a Broadway show.
Excuse me?
There's an open call for Cats.
I'm thinking we go down there, sing "Memories"...
...and make complete fools of ourselves. What do you say?
No, no, no.
Remember who you're dealing with here. Ha.
I'm not like you. I can't even stand in front of a tap class.
That's because of your Amish background.
What? - Well, you're Pennsylvania Dutch, right?
Right.
Till I bought a blow dryer. Then I was shunned.
I was just like you.
And then one day, I saw a movie that changed my life.
Did you ever see Dead Poets Society? - Uh-huh.
I thought that movie was so incredibly...
...boring!
I mean, that thing at the end where the kid...
...kills himself because he can't be in the play?
What was that?
It's like, "Kid, wait a year. Leave home, do some community theater!"
I walked out of there, and I thought
"Now, that's two hours of my life that I'm never getting back!"
And that scared me more than all the other crap I was afraid to do.
Wow.
Then I would definitely not recommend Mrs. Doubtfire.
Oh, God.
We didn't get into Scranton.
That was our safety zoo.
They take, like, dogs and cows.
See?
I don't know who this is harder on, me or him.
I'd say that chair's taking the brunt of it.
Marcel. Marcel.
Marcel, no.
Good boy!
See? How can nobody want him?
Somebody will.
You know there already is a Joseph Stalin?
You're kidding!
Apparently, he was this Russian dictator who slaughtered all these people!
You'd think you would've known that! - You'd think I would've.
Phoebe, what do you think a good stage name for me would be?
Flame Boy!
Where exactly is your zoo?
Well, it's technically not a zoo per se.
It's, uh, more of an interactive wildlife experience.
Let me ask you some questions about... Is it, uh, Marcel?
Yes. - Yes. Uh...
Does he, uh, fight with other animals?
No, no. He's very docile.
Hmm. Even if he were cornered?
Well, I don't know. Why?
Um, how is he at handling small objects?
He can hold a banana, if that's what you mean.
What about a hammer or a small blade?
Why would he need a blade?
If he's up against a jungle cat or an animal with horns...
...you got to give the little guy something.
Otherwise, it's just cruel!
He got into San Diego!
What? - Yeah.
We were coming back from our walk, and the phone was ringing...
He's in! - He's in? Ah!
Did you hear that, Marcel?
San Diego! San Diego! Yeah!
You're making a mistake. San Diego's well and good...
...but if you give him to me, I'll start him against a blind rabbit...
...and give you 20 percent of the gate.
Yo-ho!
Where have you been?
Monica and I just crashed an embassy party.
Are you drunk?
No!
I'm lying.
I am so drunk!
Oh, God!
Ugh. Great. You know what? You could have called.
I've been up here. I've been worried...
Monica.
Monica?
Water rules!
Yes. Yes, it does.
The restaurant called. They want to know if you're showing up.
Nope!
I'm going to the Big Apple Circus today.
What are you doing? You're gonna lose your job. This is not you!
No, it is me!
I'm not just the person who needs to fluff the pillows...
...and pay the bills as soon as they come in!
You know, when I'm with her, I'm so much more than that!
I'm...
I'm Monana!
Ahem, hello?
Yes, she is. Hold on a second, please.
Ahem, Monana, it's for you.
The credit card people.
Hello?
Yes?
Oh, my God!
Thanks.
What?
They've arrested Monica.
Hi. - Hey.
How are you?
I'm not too bad. Fortunately, blue's my color.
How did you know I was here?
Because...
...I'm Monica Geller.
It was my credit card you were using.
That I was not expecting.
I want you to know, I didn't turn you in.
Oh.
Thanks. - No, thank you.
You have given me so much.
If it wasn't for you, I'd never have gotten...
...to sing "Memories" at the Winter Garden Theater.
Actually, you only got to sing "Memo..."
I can't believe you're in here. What am I gonna do without you?
Who's gonna crash the embassy parties with me?
Who's gonna take me to the Big Apple Circus?
Monica, I started my day by peeing in front of 25 other women...
...and you're worried about who will take you to the Big Apple Circus?
Well, not worried, you know, just wondering.
There's nothing to wonder about.
You'll go back to being who you were because that's who you are.
Not necessarily. - Yes, necessarily.
I don't know what it is.
Maybe it's the Amish thing.
Um, I'm not actually Amish.
Really? Then why are you like that?
You by the door, in or out?
In!
You in the back, you're getting it wrong!
At least I'm doing it!
This is the final boarding call for Flight 67 to San Diego...
...boarding at Gate 42A.
Okay, goodbye, little monkey guy.
I wrote you this poem. - Aw.
Okay, but don't eat it till you get on the plane.
Thank you, Aunt Phoebe. - Aww.
Okay, bye, champ.
There's gonna be a lot of babes in San Diego...
...but remember, there's also a lot to learn.
I don't know what to say, Ross. Uh, it's a monkey.
Just say what you feel, Joey.
Marcel, I'm hungry.
That was good.
Marcel, this is for you. - Oh.
It's, uh, just, you know, something to, um...
...do on the plane.
If you don't mind, I'd like a moment, just me and him.
Sure. - Of course. Absolutely.
Oh.
Marcel, come here. Come here.
Come here.
Well, buddy...
...this is it.
There's just a couple of things I wanted to say.
I'm really gonna miss you.
You know? And I'm never gonna forget about you.
You've been more than just a pet to me.
You've been more like a...
Okay. Marcel, would you...?
Marcel, would you leave my leg alone?
Would you just stop humping me for two seconds? Marc... Would you...?
Okay, would you just take him away? Just take him.
O! That I were a glove upon that hand...
...that I might touch thy cheek.
That's fine. Thank you.
Next.
Hi. Uh, I'll be reading for the role of Mercutio.
Name? - Holden McGroin.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会有人知道你的信用卡号码？
sense_groups.english: How'd someone get your credit card number?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道 看看他们花了多少钱
sense_groups.english: I have no idea. Look how much they spent!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 冷静点
sense_groups.english: Monica, Calm down.

sense_groups.chinese: 信用卡公司说 你只要付你有买东西的钱
sense_groups.english: You only have to pay for the stuff you bought.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这真的是挥霍无度
sense_groups.english: Still, it's just such reckless spending.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他们偷你的信用卡时…
sense_groups.english: When somebody steals your credit card...

sense_groups.chinese: 早就将王法抛诸脑后了
sense_groups.english: ...they've kind of already thrown caution to the wind.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是怪人 花了美金69.95元买神奇拖把
sense_groups.english: Wow, what a geek. They spent $69.95 on a Wonder Mop.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我买的
sense_groups.english: That's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 恶心
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh, the yuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 他又来了
sense_groups.english: He's doing it again!

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 别再侵犯那盏灯了
sense_groups.english: Marcel, stop humping the lamp!

sense_groups.chinese: 不要这样 马塞尔 回来
sense_groups.english: Stop humping! Now, Marcel, come back!

sense_groups.chinese: 过来这里 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Come here, Marcel!

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 别去我房间 我去抓他
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no! Not in my room! I'll get him.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你得想想办法
sense_groups.english: You've got to do something about the humping.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？只是阶段性而已
sense_groups.english: What? It's just a phase.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也是那样说乔伊的
sense_groups.english: Well, that's what we said about Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松点好吗？没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: Hey, would you all relax? It's not that big a deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 给我停止 马塞尔 你这个坏猴子
sense_groups.english: Marcel, stop it! Marcel! Bad monkey!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 呃
sense_groups.english: What? - Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 就说我的好奇娃娃 已经不再好奇了吧
sense_groups.english: Let's just say my Curious George doll is no longer curious.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你不会还在看那个东西吧
sense_groups.english: Ugh, Monica, you are not still going over that thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个女人过着我的生活 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: This woman's living my life. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她在过我的生活 而且过得比我好
sense_groups.english: She's living my life, and she's doing it better than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看这个 看
sense_groups.english: Look at this. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 她买票去看我想看的戏
sense_groups.english: She buys tickets to plays I want to see.

sense_groups.chinese: 她买的衣服是我早就想买的
sense_groups.english: She shops at stores that I'm intimidated by the salespeople.

sense_groups.chinese: 她花三百美金在美术用品上
sense_groups.english: She spent $300 on art supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不是艺术家
sense_groups.english: You're not an artist.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我有那些东西 或许就可以了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I might be if I had the supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些我都可以做啊 只是我都没做
sense_groups.english: I mean, I could do all this stuff. Only I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 别这样 你也做很多很棒的事情啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica, come on. You do cool things.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？来比较一下吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? Let's compare, shall we?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在做比较 会不会太晚了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so late for "shall we?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我会去公园骑马吗？
sense_groups.english: Do I go horseback riding in the park, hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在新学院大学上课吗？
sense_groups.english: Do I take classes at The New School?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 - 不会
sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 太不公平了
sense_groups.english: This is so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有所有我要的东西 而且不用应付我妈妈
sense_groups.english: She's got everything I want, and she doesn't have my mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊•帕帕尼如何？
sense_groups.english: How about Joey Paponi?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 太有种族意味了
sense_groups.english: No, still too ethnic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的经纪人觉得要取中立一点的名字
sense_groups.english: My agent thinks I should have a name that's more neutral.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊•瑞士？
sense_groups.english: Joey Switzerland?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我觉得叫乔就好 乔伊听起来好像我只有…
sense_groups.english: Plus I think it should be Joe. Joey makes me sound like I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 这么大而已
sense_groups.english: ...this big.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我并不是
sense_groups.english: Which I'm not!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔 乔 乔… 史达林？
sense_groups.english: Joe, Joe, Joe... Stalin?

sense_groups.chinese: 史达林
sense_groups.english: Stalin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听过那个名字吗？好耳熟
sense_groups.english: Do I know that name? That sounds familiar.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没印象 - 唔
sense_groups.english: Well, it does not ring a bell with me. - Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔•史达林
sense_groups.english: Joe Stalin.

sense_groups.chinese: 还挺不错的
sense_groups.english: You know, that's pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以试试乔瑟夫 - 啊
sense_groups.english: You might want to try Joseph. - Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔瑟夫•史达林
sense_groups.english: Joseph Stalin!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家一定会记得 - 当然啦
sense_groups.english: I think you'd remember that! - Oh, yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 《别了 鸟儿》由乔瑟夫•史达林主演
sense_groups.english: Bye Bye Birdie, starring Joseph Stalin.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔瑟夫•史达林是《屋顶上的提琴手》
sense_groups.english: Joseph Stalin is the Fiddler on the Roof.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是摩妮卡•盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hi. Uh, yes, this is Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在你们那边上课 我想知道是什么课程
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm taking classes with you, and I was wondering what they were.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 太好了
sense_groups.english: All right, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢了
sense_groups.english: Great. Thanks a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去上踢踏舞课了
sense_groups.english: I'm going to tap class.

sense_groups.chinese: 好让你跟偷了你信用的女人一起跳舞吗？
sense_groups.english: So you can dance with the woman that stole your card?

sense_groups.chinese: 她偷了我的人生 我想知道她是谁
sense_groups.english: She's got my life. I want to see who she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就去邮局啊 我相信里面有张贴她的照片
sense_groups.english: Go to the post office! I'm sure her picture's up!

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 你快失控了
sense_groups.english: Honey, you're kind of losing it here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这已经变成怪异的执迷
sense_groups.english: This is really becoming a weird obsession.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太疯狂了 我告诉你
sense_groups.english: This is madness, I tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 上帝保佑 摩妮卡 别这么做
sense_groups.english: For the love of God, Monica, don't do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么想？
sense_groups.english: What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 想很多事情
sense_groups.english: Lots of things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她是哪一个？
sense_groups.english: Which one do you think she is?

sense_groups.chinese: 有我可以效劳的地方吗？ - 不用了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: May I help you? - Oh, no, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是来参观的
sense_groups.english: We're just here to observe.

sense_groups.chinese: 舞蹈课不是用来参观的 要用跳的
sense_groups.english: You don't observe a dance class. You dance a dance class!

sense_groups.chinese: 那边有鞋子
sense_groups.english: Spare shoes are over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What does she mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想她是说 "舞蹈课…"
sense_groups.english: I think she means, "You dance...

sense_groups.chinese: "要用跳的 "
sense_groups.english: ...a dance class!"

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧…
sense_groups.english: Come on, come on, come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你有看到我的分身吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, do you see anybody you think could be me?

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 上次下课后 有人留下优格空瓶
sense_groups.english: People, last time there were yogurt containers lying around after class.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再让这种事发生了
sense_groups.english: Let's not have that happen again!

sense_groups.chinese: 她可以当你的分身
sense_groups.english: She could be you.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始吧
sense_groups.english: Let's get started.

sense_groups.chinese: 五 六 五 六 七 八
sense_groups.english: Five, six. Five, six, seven, eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我完全不会
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm not getting this!

sense_groups.chinese: 我超会的
sense_groups.english: I'm totally getting it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你会觉得自己超不协调的吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you ever just feel like you're so unbelievably uncoordinated?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？他们踢的时候 跟着踢就是了
sense_groups.english: What? You just click when they click.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 各位 找个舞伴
sense_groups.english: All right. Now everyone grab a partner.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我死去的母亲说 就是你 我跟瑞秋是舞伴
sense_groups.english: All right. And my dead mother said you are it! I'm with Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 体育课的旧事又重演了
sense_groups.english: Great, it's gym class all over again.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aww.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你可以来前面 跟我搭档
sense_groups.english: That's all right. You can come up to the front and dance with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还不如脱掉衣服 做个恶梦算了？
sense_groups.english: Why don't I just take off my clothes and have a nightmare?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系了 我来了 很抱歉我迟到了
sense_groups.english: It's okay, it's okay! I'm here, I'm here. I'm so sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, here I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位紧张的新人是谁？
sense_groups.english: So who's the new tense girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是你的舞伴
sense_groups.english: She's your partner.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Monica. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是摩…
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Mon...

sense_groups.chinese: 娜娜
sense_groups.english: Nana.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩娜娜？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Monana? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是荷兰语
sense_groups.english: It's Dutch.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑吧 我在阿姆斯特丹住了三年
sense_groups.english: You're kidding. I spent three years in Amsterdam.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是宾州的荷兰人
sense_groups.english: Um, Pennsylvania Dutch.

sense_groups.chinese: 要跳舞了
sense_groups.english: And we're dancing!

sense_groups.chinese: 五 六 七 八
sense_groups.english: Five, six, seven, eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪了？ - 我刚从兽医那里回来
sense_groups.english: Where have you been? - I just got back from the vet.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会叫你戴那些塑胶头套吧？
sense_groups.english: She's not gonna make you wear a big plastic cone, is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说马塞尔乱性不是暂时的
sense_groups.english: She says Marcel's humping thing is not a phase.

sense_groups.chinese: 显然他已经性成熟了
sense_groups.english: Apparently, he's reached sexual maturity.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 他比你还快耶
sense_groups.english: Hey, he beat you!

sense_groups.chinese: 她说他会愈来愈暴力 侵略性愈来愈强
sense_groups.english: She says, as time goes on, he'll start getting aggressive and violent.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What does this mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得放弃他
sense_groups.english: I have to give him up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 罗斯 这太扯了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it, Rose. This sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 你才刚养他 怎么可能已经成年了？
sense_groups.english: You just got him. How could he be an adult already?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 前一天才小小只的…
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. One day he's this little thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 不知不觉中就变成…
sense_groups.english: ...and before you know it, he's this little thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 紧抓我的腿不放的小东西
sense_groups.english: ...I can't get off my leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有办法能让你留下他吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't there any way you can keep him?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 兽医说除非有个地方…
sense_groups.english: The vet said that unless he's in a place where he has regular access...

sense_groups.chinese: 让他获得正常的猴爱
sense_groups.english: ...to some monkey loving...

sense_groups.chinese: 否则他会愈来愈残暴
sense_groups.english: ...he's just gonna get vicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得把他送到动物园
sense_groups.english: I just gotta get him into a zoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么把猴子送到动物园？ - 我知道
sense_groups.english: How do you get a monkey into a zoo? - I know that one!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是教宗进入福斯汽车
sense_groups.english: No, that's popes into a Volkswagen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们申请了很多动物园 首要选择当然是州立动物园
sense_groups.english: We're applying to a lot of them. Our first choice would be a state zoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是圣地亚哥
sense_groups.english: You know, like, uh, San Diego.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 但那可能是遥不可及的梦想 因为他来自州外
sense_groups.english: But that may just be a pipe dream because he's out-of-state.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的兽医在迈阿密有认识人 所以有可能去那里
sense_groups.english: My vet knows someone at Miami, so that's a possibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那里离海滩只有两条街 一定是轰趴动物园
sense_groups.english: But that's two blocks from the beach. It's a total party zoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 我们找到那个女生了
sense_groups.english: Hi. - We found the girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 有打电话给警察吗？
sense_groups.english: What? - Did you call the cops?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我们请她吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Nope. We took her to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们自己的私自执法方式
sense_groups.english: Ah. Your own brand of vigilante justice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了吗？这个女人偷了你的东西
sense_groups.english: Are you insane? This woman stole from you!

sense_groups.chinese: 她偷东西 是小偷耶
sense_groups.english: She stole! She's a stealer!

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她相处十分钟之后 你就会忘掉这些了
sense_groups.english: After you're with this woman for 10 minutes, you forget all that.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的是个奇女子…
sense_groups.english: I mean, she's this astounding person...

sense_groups.chinese: 振奋人心
sense_groups.english: ...with this amazing spirit!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 可能是从啦啦队员那里偷来的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, which she probably stole from some cheerleader!

sense_groups.chinese: 把帽子脱掉 - 福斯车里的教宗
sense_groups.english: Take off their hats. - Popes in a Volkswagen!

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超爱那个笑话
sense_groups.english: I love that joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 你不可能这么做 - 摩娜娜很勇敢
sense_groups.english: No way! No way did you do this! - Monana was very brave.

sense_groups.chinese: 超狂野的
sense_groups.english: It was so wild.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们跟他们说我们是 615号房的刚氏姐妹…
sense_groups.english: We told them we were the Gunnersons in room 615...

sense_groups.chinese: 才知道波士顿的《塞尔蒂克队》包下整个六楼
sense_groups.english: ...only to find out the Boston Celtics had the entire sixth floor!

sense_groups.chinese: 当他们发现我们很矮而且有胸部后
sense_groups.english: So when they caught on to the fact that we're short and have breasts...

sense_groups.chinese: 就把我们轰出去 我被饭店赶出去 我耶
sense_groups.english: They threw us out. I was thrown out of a hotel! Me!

sense_groups.chinese: 好样的 摩娜娜
sense_groups.english: Go, Monana!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是只有你们活在梦想中
sense_groups.english: Well, you ladies are not the only ones living the dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去为我不认识的人倒咖啡了 不用等我了
sense_groups.english: I get to go pour coffee for people I don't know. Don't wait up.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 还有一件事…
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明天要去参加百老汇的试镜
sense_groups.english: ...tomorrow we're auditioning for a Broadway show.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 《猫》剧有一个缺额
sense_groups.english: There's an open call for Cats.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说我们可以去演唱《回忆》…
sense_groups.english: I'm thinking we go down there, sing "Memories"...

sense_groups.chinese: 把自己当成傻子 你觉得如何？
sense_groups.english: ...and make complete fools of ourselves. What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 要记得我是什么样的人
sense_groups.english: Remember who you're dealing with here. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不像你 我连站在踢踏舞教室前面都有困难
sense_groups.english: I'm not like you. I can't even stand in front of a tap class.

sense_groups.chinese: 那大概是因为你有孟诺教派的背景
sense_groups.english: That's because of your Amish background.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你是宾州的荷兰人 对吧？
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, you're Pennsylvania Dutch, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 直到我买了吹风机 就被逐出村里
sense_groups.english: Till I bought a blow dryer. Then I was shunned.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前就跟你一样
sense_groups.english: I was just like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后有一天 我看了一部改变我一生的电影
sense_groups.english: And then one day, I saw a movie that changed my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看过《死亡诗社》吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Did you ever see Dead Poets Society? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得那部电影超级…
sense_groups.english: I thought that movie was so incredibly...

sense_groups.chinese: 无聊的
sense_groups.english: ...boring!

sense_groups.chinese: 最后那个孩子自杀…
sense_groups.english: I mean, that thing at the end where the kid...

sense_groups.chinese: 只因为不能参与话剧演出？
sense_groups.english: ...kills himself because he can't be in the play?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞什么？
sense_groups.english: What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 等个一年 离家参与社区话团演出不就行了
sense_groups.english: It's like, "Kid, wait a year. Leave home, do some community theater!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我走出戏院后心想…
sense_groups.english: I walked out of there, and I thought

sense_groups.chinese: "我浪费了永远拿不回来的两小时生命"
sense_groups.english: "Now, that's two hours of my life that I'm never getting back!"

sense_groups.chinese: 那个想法震撼了我 让我及时行乐
sense_groups.english: And that scared me more than all the other crap I was afraid to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我绝对不推荐你看《窈窕奶爸》
sense_groups.english: Then I would definitely not recommend Mrs. Doubtfire.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们进不了斯克兰顿
sense_groups.english: We didn't get into Scranton.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我们的保障动物园
sense_groups.english: That was our safety zoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们连狗和牛都收
sense_groups.english: They take, like, dogs and cows.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂是我还是他 比较难受
sense_groups.english: I don't know who this is harder on, me or him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是那张椅子最难受
sense_groups.english: I'd say that chair's taking the brunt of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 马塞尔
sense_groups.english: Marcel. Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 不要弄了
sense_groups.english: Marcel, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 好孩子
sense_groups.english: Good boy!

sense_groups.chinese: 看到了吗？怎么可能没人要他？
sense_groups.english: See? How can nobody want him?

sense_groups.chinese: 会有人要的
sense_groups.english: Somebody will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道已经有位乔瑟夫•史达林了吗？
sense_groups.english: You know there already is a Joseph Stalin?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吧
sense_groups.english: You're kidding!

sense_groups.chinese: 显然他是个俄国独裁者 屠杀过很多人
sense_groups.english: Apparently, he was this Russian dictator who slaughtered all these people!

sense_groups.chinese: 你会想说这种事应该知道的 - 你会想说我该知道的
sense_groups.english: You'd think you would've known that! - You'd think I would've.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你觉得什么艺名适合我？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what do you think a good stage name for me would be?

sense_groups.chinese: 火焰男孩
sense_groups.english: Flame Boy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的动物园在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where exactly is your zoo?

sense_groups.chinese: 严格来说 它不能算是动物园
sense_groups.english: Well, it's technically not a zoo per se.

sense_groups.chinese: 它比较像是互动的野生体验
sense_groups.english: It's, uh, more of an interactive wildlife experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我问问你几个问题 他叫做马塞尔对吧？
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you some questions about... Is it, uh, Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对…
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Yes. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 他会和其他动物打架吗？
sense_groups.english: Does he, uh, fight with other animals?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 他非常温驯
sense_groups.english: No, no. He's very docile.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使被逼到角落去也一样吗？
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Even if he were cornered?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我不太清楚 为什么问？
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 他掌控小东西的能力为何？
sense_groups.english: Um, how is he at handling small objects?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以握住香蕉 如果你是这个意思的话
sense_groups.english: He can hold a banana, if that's what you mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 铁槌或小刀呢？
sense_groups.english: What about a hammer or a small blade?

sense_groups.chinese: 他为什么会需要小刀？
sense_groups.english: Why would he need a blade?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他得面对猎豹或有角的动物…
sense_groups.english: If he's up against a jungle cat or an animal with horns...

sense_groups.chinese: 总得给他点东西自我防卫吧
sense_groups.english: ...you got to give the little guy something.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然就太残忍了
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, it's just cruel!

sense_groups.chinese: 他能去圣地亚哥了
sense_groups.english: He got into San Diego!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 对
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们散步回来后 电话响起
sense_groups.english: We were coming back from our walk, and the phone was ringing...

sense_groups.chinese: 他进了 - 他进了？
sense_groups.english: He's in! - He's in? Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有听到吗 马塞尔？
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that, Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 是圣地亚哥耶 太棒了
sense_groups.english: San Diego! San Diego! Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的犯下大错 圣地亚哥的环境是很不错…
sense_groups.english: You're making a mistake. San Diego's well and good...

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你把他交给我 我会训练他对抗瞎眼的兔子…
sense_groups.english: ...but if you give him to me, I'll start him against a blind rabbit...

sense_groups.chinese: 还给你百分之二十的门票收入
sense_groups.english: ...and give you 20 percent of the gate.

sense_groups.chinese: 哟嚯
sense_groups.english: Yo-ho!

sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪里了？
sense_groups.english: Where have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和我跑去大使馆派对
sense_groups.english: Monica and I just crashed an embassy party.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喝醉了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you drunk?

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 我说谎
sense_groups.english: I'm lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超醉的
sense_groups.english: I am so drunk!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你该打通电话回来的
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Great. You know what? You could have called.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在家里担心你
sense_groups.english: I've been up here. I've been worried...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 水超棒的
sense_groups.english: Water rules!

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes, it does.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅今天又打来了 他们想知道你会不会去上班
sense_groups.english: The restaurant called. They want to know if you're showing up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: Nope!

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天要去看大苹果马戏团
sense_groups.english: I'm going to the Big Apple Circus today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？你会失去你的工作 这一点都不像你
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? You're gonna lose your job. This is not you!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这正是我
sense_groups.english: No, it is me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不只是那种必须拍松枕头…
sense_groups.english: I'm not just the person who needs to fluff the pillows...

sense_groups.chinese: 帐单一来就立刻缴钱的人
sense_groups.english: ...and pay the bills as soon as they come in!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她在一起时 就不再是那样的人
sense_groups.english: You know, when I'm with her, I'm so much more than that!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是…
我是摩娜娜
sense_groups.english: I'm Monana!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Ahem, hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 她在 请稍等
sense_groups.english: Yes, she is. Hold on a second, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩娜娜 找你的
sense_groups.english: Ahem, Monana, it's for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 信用卡公司打来的
sense_groups.english: The credit card people.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们逮捕摩妮卡了
sense_groups.english: They've arrested Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以 幸好我喜欢蓝色
sense_groups.english: I'm not too bad. Fortunately, blue's my color.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道我在这里的？
sense_groups.english: How did you know I was here?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…
sense_groups.english: Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡•盖勒
sense_groups.english: ...I'm Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前用的是我的信用卡
sense_groups.english: It was my credit card you were using.

sense_groups.chinese: 这点我完全没料到
sense_groups.english: That I was not expecting.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想让你知道 报案的人不是我
sense_groups.english: I want you to know, I didn't turn you in.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 不 我才要谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - No, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你带给我太多东西了
sense_groups.english: You have given me so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是你 我永远无法…
sense_groups.english: If it wasn't for you, I'd never have gotten...

sense_groups.chinese: 在冬花园剧院演唱《回忆》
sense_groups.english: ...to sing "Memories" at the Winter Garden Theater.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实你只开口唱了"回"而已
sense_groups.english: Actually, you only got to sing "Memo..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你在这里 没有你我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're in here. What am I gonna do without you?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会跟我混进大使馆宴会？
sense_groups.english: Who's gonna crash the embassy parties with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要带我去看大苹果马戏团？
sense_groups.english: Who's gonna take me to the Big Apple Circus?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我每天早上都得在25个人面前尿尿…
sense_groups.english: Monica, I started my day by peeing in front of 25 other women...

sense_groups.chinese: 你却担心谁要带你去看大苹果马戏团？
sense_groups.english: ...and you're worried about who will take you to the Big Apple Circus?

sense_groups.chinese: 也不是担心 我只是纳闷而已
sense_groups.english: Well, not worried, you know, just wondering.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么好纳闷的
sense_groups.english: There's nothing to wonder about.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就回去过以前的生活 因为那才是真正的你
sense_groups.english: You'll go back to being who you were because that's who you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不尽然 - 就是这样
sense_groups.english: Not necessarily. - Yes, necessarily.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道是为什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许和你是孟诺教派的人有关
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's the Amish thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我其实不是孟诺教派的人
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm not actually Amish.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？那你为何那么像？
sense_groups.english: Really? Then why are you like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 站在门边的那个 要不要加入？
sense_groups.english: You by the door, in or out?

sense_groups.chinese: 要
sense_groups.english: In!

sense_groups.chinese: 后面的那个 你全都跳错了
sense_groups.english: You in the back, you're getting it wrong!

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我有在跳
sense_groups.english: At least I'm doing it!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是飞往圣地亚哥 67航班的最后登机通知
sense_groups.english: This is the final boarding call for Flight 67 to San Diego...

sense_groups.chinese: 登机门为42A
sense_groups.english: ...boarding at Gate 42A.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见了 小家伙
sense_groups.english: Okay, goodbye, little monkey guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我替你写了一首诗 - 啊
sense_groups.english: I wrote you this poem. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是上了飞机才能吃
sense_groups.english: Okay, but don't eat it till you get on the plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 菲比阿姨 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Aunt Phoebe. - Aww.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见了 好小子
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye, champ.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道圣地亚哥有很多美眉…
sense_groups.english: There's gonna be a lot of babes in San Diego...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是记得要学的事情还很多
sense_groups.english: ...but remember, there's also a lot to learn.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我不知道该说些什么 他是只猴子
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to say, Ross. Uh, it's a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 说出心里的感受就行了
sense_groups.english: Just say what you feel, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 我饿了
sense_groups.english: Marcel, I'm hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很好啊
sense_groups.english: That was good.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 这是给你的 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Marcel, this is for you. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是… 你知道 让你…
sense_groups.english: It's, uh, just, you know, something to, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 在飞机上有事情做
sense_groups.english: ...do on the plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们不介意的话 我想跟他独处一下
sense_groups.english: If you don't mind, I'd like a moment, just me and him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Of course. Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔 过来这边
sense_groups.english: Marcel, come here. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 小子…
sense_groups.english: Well, buddy...

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样了
sense_groups.english: ...this is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说几件事
sense_groups.english: There's just a couple of things I wanted to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会很想念你的
sense_groups.english: I'm really gonna miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远不会忘记你
sense_groups.english: You know? And I'm never gonna forget about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对我而言 一直不只是只宠物
sense_groups.english: You've been more than just a pet to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你更像是…
sense_groups.english: You've been more like a...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 马塞尔 你可以…？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Marcel, would you...?

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能问他哪个金刚战士威力最强大？
sense_groups.english: ...could you ask him which one the strongest Power Ranger is?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 我的人生真是好笑 大家可以闭嘴了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my life is just so amusing. Heh, heh. Can we drop it now?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 抱歉

sense_groups.english: It's morphing time.

sense_groups.chinese: 剑龙 - 暴龙

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Oh, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 头晕
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Ooh, head rush. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来一次 我就得出发了
sense_groups.english: One more and then I have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷
sense_groups.english: Cool. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 有同事要开生日派对
sense_groups.english: Oh, I got a birthday party with some work people.

sense_groups.chinese: 同事？
sense_groups.english: Work people?

sense_groups.chinese: 都没人告诉我 - 对啊 我知道
sense_groups.english: Nobody told me. - No, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个跟他们不喜欢你有很大的关系
sense_groups.english: That's part of the whole, you know, them-not-liking-you extravaganza.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 这些人一个月前都还是我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Know what? I don't get this. A month ago, these people were my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我换了位置 不表示我的脑袋也换了
sense_groups.english: Just because I'm in charge, doesn't mean I'm a different person.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你应该一起来 跟大家聊聊
sense_groups.english: Well, then you should come tonight, just hang out with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们看看你还是跟以前一样好玩好相处
sense_groups.english: Let them see what a great guy you still are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我应该去吗？ - 对啊 真的
sense_groups.english: You think I should? - I really do, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 我们能不能不要一起出现？
sense_groups.english: Oh, but, um, could we not go together?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想当那个邀上司一起来的怪胎
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna be the geek who invited the boss, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚真是好玩
sense_groups.english: I think last night was great.

sense_groups.chinese: 还唱卡啦OK？翠西跟我合唱《黑檀木与白象牙》？

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯… - 哈

sense_groups.chinese: 你很受欢迎 但是他们私底下还是会笑你
sense_groups.english: You were great. But they still made fun of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 现在你成了关心下属先生
sense_groups.english: What? - Now you're more like Mr. Caring-Boss.

sense_groups.chinese: "我们可以同乐" 老板
sense_groups.english: Mr. "I'm-One-of-You"-Boss.

sense_groups.chinese: "我想跟你们一起混"的宾老板
sense_groups.english: Mr. "I-Wanna-Be-Your-Buddy"- Boss-Man-Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这我就搞不清楚了
sense_groups.english: Then I don't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 钱德？我想你得面对现实
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what, Chandler? I think you just gotta face it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在是那个有大办公室的人了
sense_groups.english: You're, like, the guy in the big office, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是那个操纵他们生死大权的的人了
sense_groups.english: You're the one that hires them and fires them.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还是觉得你是个好上司 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: They still say you're a great boss. - They do?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他们已经不是你的朋友了
sense_groups.english: But they're not your friends anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我只想要… - 但是你不行
sense_groups.english: But I just want to... - No, but you can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我只想要… - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: But I just want... - Ah-ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不…？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you gonna...?

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝跟我约好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Carol and I have a new system.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她打来 留下"911"就表示她要生了
sense_groups.english: If she punches in "911," it means she's having a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他的我都不管了 - 那安德烈怎么办？

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上他接到 我觉得好像是我们表哥纳森的电话

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我不想知道那么多
sense_groups.english: And frankly, it was a little more than I needed to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来想抢先讲的
sense_groups.english: That was gonna be my opener.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们看过厕所里面新的干手机吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, did you guys check out those new hand dryers in the bathroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为那只是传闻 - 真的有
sense_groups.english: I thought that was just a rumor. - True story.

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事我得告诉你
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I gotta tell you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是17岁
sense_groups.english: I'm not 17.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我17岁 这样才会让你感觉我可爱又脆弱
sense_groups.english: I only said that so you'd think I was cute and vulnerable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经30了
sense_groups.english: I'm actually 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有老婆 有工作 是你选区的国会议员
sense_groups.english: I have a wife. I have a job. I'm your congressman.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 这太离谱了 我们在一起很快乐
sense_groups.english: Monica, this is ridiculous. We are great together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很有话聊 能逗对方笑 性生活 天啊 太美满了
sense_groups.english: We can talk, we make each other laugh. And the sex. Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我是没得比较 但是我觉得很棒
sense_groups.english: Okay, I have no frame of reference, but I thought that was great.

sense_groups.chinese: 是很棒 - 那么问题在哪里？
sense_groups.english: It was. - Then what's the problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 伊森 这让人…
sense_groups.english: Ethan, it's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 太肉麻了
sense_groups.english: It's icky.

sense_groups.chinese: 肉麻？
sense_groups.english: Icky?

sense_groups.chinese: 就因为你觉得肉麻 就要放弃这段感情？
sense_groups.english: You're actually gonna throw this away because it's icky?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我也很难受
sense_groups.english: Look, this isn't easy for me either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也希望情况不是这样
sense_groups.english: I wish things were different.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你大几岁 还是我小几岁…
sense_groups.english: If you were a few years older or I was a few years younger...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是我们活在《圣经》时代…
sense_groups.english: ...or we lived in biblical times...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就可以… - 不要说出来
sense_groups.english: ...I could really... - No, don't say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱你
sense_groups.english: Love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们手干了吗？ - 还是湿湿的

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 - 我们再去烘一下

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 "这玛格莉特调酒 可以再烈一点"
sense_groups.english: Or, like, "Could these margaritas be any stronger?"

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 - 你好 宾先生
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. - Hello, Mr. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你模仿史蒂夫•汪德真是惟妙惟肖
sense_groups.english: Loved your Stevie Wonder last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 每周报告我需要在…

sense_groups.chinese: 9点前看到
当然 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sure. - No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们忙一点是有必要的 你知道吧？
sense_groups.english: You have to give them something, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那是葛斯顿 山多斯 那个有小胡子的是谁？
sense_groups.english: Okay, that was Gerston, Santos, and who's the guy with the mustache?

sense_groups.chinese: 彼崔 - 彼崔 对 对 好
sense_groups.english: Petrie. - Petrie. Right, right, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人这个周末…
sense_groups.english: Well, some people are gonna be working...

sense_groups.chinese: 要赶工了
sense_groups.english: ...this weekend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好舒服哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？ - 我在这里
sense_groups.english: Ross? - I'm here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里？
sense_groups.english: You are?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Uh... Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚刚正在…
sense_groups.english: We were just...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Wow. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 现在宝宝要出生了
sense_groups.english: Heh. Great. Now I'm having a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝要… 宝宝要出生了 - 噢…
sense_groups.english: No. I'm having... I'm having a baby! - Oh. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 宝宝要…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - I'm having a...!

sense_groups.chinese: 电话 电话 - 电话 电话不在我这边
sense_groups.english: The phone, the phone! - The phone. I don't have the phone. Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？ - 好痛
sense_groups.english: Ross? - I'm hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 快点 动作快 有人要生了
sense_groups.english: Monica, let's go. Come on, now, people. Woman in labor.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 你看我会这样 - 车上再说 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, look what I got going here. - Yeah, save it for the cab, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？我们是要去医院
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? We're going to a hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？我不能打扮一下吗？那边也许有很多医生
sense_groups.english: What, so I can't look nice? There might be doctors there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 不要再翻冰箱了 - 好啦 好啦
sense_groups.english: Joey, get out of the fridge. - All right, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 车上吃的
sense_groups.english: What is that? - For the ride.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啦 在计程车上… - 待会儿再说
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like in a cab you... - Save it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很讨厌 - 摩妮卡 快点 我们要走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, hating this. - Monica, come on, now. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝快出来了 天啊
sense_groups.english: Baby coming. God.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信我要当姑姑了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. I'm gonna be an aunt.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真是… - 我快要有侄儿了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's... - I'm gonna have a nephew.

sense_groups.chinese: 真感人 快滚
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's nice. Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 - 我们快走 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on. - Let's go, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 好啦
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 好啦 在走了 在走了
sense_groups.english: All right, all right, I'm going, I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷静 - 罗斯 冷静 乖
sense_groups.english: Here we go. Here we go. - Rossy. Rossy.

sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, it's an important day. I wanna look nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰兹布劳医生来了吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, has Dr. Franzblau been by?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没见到他
sense_groups.english: No, I haven't seen him.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他在哪？他应该在这的
sense_groups.english: Well, where is he? He is supposed to be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果宝宝需要他怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What if the baby needs him?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你迷恋医生是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, what is the deal with you and doctors?

sense_groups.chinese: 你父亲是医生吗？ - 是啊 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Is, like, your father a doctor? - Yeah. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么
sense_groups.english: No reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 我们说过了
sense_groups.english: Mom, we've been through this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不要打给他
sense_groups.english: No, I am not calling him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎他是孩子的爹 他是混蛋
sense_groups.english: I don't care if it is his kid. The guy's a jerk.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是一个人 乔伊在这
sense_groups.english: No, I am not alone. Joey's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么叫 "哪个乔伊"？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, "Joey who?"

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey who?

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼 - 乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Tribbiani. - Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 好 等一下
sense_groups.english: Yes. Okay. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要跟你说话 - 不
sense_groups.english: She wants to talk to you. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 电话拿去
sense_groups.english: Take the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 是 是我
sense_groups.english: Hi. Yeah, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们只是朋友
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. We're just friends. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 我是单身
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm single.
Twenty-five.

sense_groups.chinese: 演员
sense_groups.english: An actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不太懂电话礼仪 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: She's not much of a phone person. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 孩子的爸做了什么？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what's the deal with this father guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人怀了我的孩子 我会想要知道的
sense_groups.english: I mean, if someone was having my baby somewhere, I'd wanna know about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 尼克队迷 我有兴趣知道你对为人父的想法吗？不
sense_groups.english: Hey, Knick fan, am I interested in your views on fatherhood? Um, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 或许我该走了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh, look, maybe I should just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是 - 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Maybe you should. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重
sense_groups.english: And, uh, take care, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道塞尔蒂克队的问题吗？他们让球员管理球队
sense_groups.english: Know what the Celtics' problem is? They let the players run the team.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是那样
sense_groups.english: Oh, that is so not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那样 - 不是
sense_groups.english: Oh, it is. It is. - It isn't. Isn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 呼吸 - 呼吸
sense_groups.english: Breathe. Breathe. Breathe. - Breathe. Breathe. Breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受不了了
sense_groups.english: You're gonna kill me!
Fifteen more seconds. Fourteen, 13, 12... - Count faster.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的 这一切都是为了乔弟 想着他就好
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be okay. We're doing it for Jordy. Keep focusing on Jordy.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔弟到底是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who the hell is Jordy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你儿子 - 哇…
sense_groups.english: Your son. - Whoa, whoa whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我儿子不叫乔弟
sense_groups.english: I don't have a son named Jordy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说好要叫洁米的
sense_groups.english: We all agreed, my son's name is Jamie.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊的第一任女友也叫洁米
sense_groups.english: Well, Jamie was the name of Susan's first girlfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们改回乔弟
sense_groups.english: ...so we went back to Jordy.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇…
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么改回乔弟？我们从没谈过乔弟这名字
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, "back to Jordy"? We never landed on Jordy.

sense_groups.chinese: 在整个取名字的失败过程 我们压根没提过
sense_groups.english: We just passed by it during the whole Jesse/Cody/Dillon fiasco.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢…
sense_groups.english: Ow, ow, ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 喔 小腿抽筋
sense_groups.english: What? What? What? - Leg cramp, leg cramp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来 - 我来 我在弄了
sense_groups.english: I got it. I got it. - I got it. I'm doing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能跟她睡觉 小腿给我
sense_groups.english: You get to sleep with her. I get the cramps.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我来
sense_groups.english: No, you don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 你们都出去 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: That is it. I want both of you out. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她开始的 - 是他
sense_groups.english: She started it. - He started it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管
sense_groups.english: I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我努力想把一个人从身体生出来
sense_groups.english: I'm trying to get a person out of my body here...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这不是在帮我 现在出去
sense_groups.english: ...and you're not making it any easier. Now go!

sense_groups.chinese: 太感谢了 - 看你干的好事
sense_groups.english: Thanks a lot. - See what you did?

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说… - 出去
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Listen... - Out.

sense_groups.chinese: 呼吸 呼吸 呼吸
sense_groups.english: Breathe. Breathe. Breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Ew.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？有东西爆出来了
sense_groups.english: What is that? Something exploded.

sense_groups.chinese: 她只是羊水破了 冷静点
sense_groups.english: It's just her water breaking. Calm down, will you?

sense_groups.chinese: 羊水破了？什么意思？那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Water breaking? What do you mean? What's that, water breaking?

sense_groups.chinese: 呼吸…
sense_groups.english: Breathe. Breathe. Breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 都是你的错 - 为何是我的错？
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. This is so your fault. - How? How is this my fault?

sense_groups.chinese: 在你出现以前 卡萝从没把我赶出门过
sense_groups.english: Look, Carol never threw me out of a room before you came along.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没出现之前 卡萝有很多事没做过
sense_groups.english: Well, there's a lot of things Carol never did before I came along.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在耍聪明？ - 你觉得我威胁到你…
sense_groups.english: Are you trying to be clever? - You are so threatened by me.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有的事都不太对 - 嘿 好了 够了
sense_groups.english: Everything I say is a problem. - Hey, hey, hey. Okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 进去里面
sense_groups.english: That's it. Get in here. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你们两个 我真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: My God, you guys. I don't believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有孩子等着出世
sense_groups.english: There are children coming into the world in this very building...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们该听到的第一个声音 不是你们负面的争吵
sense_groups.english: ...and your fighting noises are not the first thing they should be hearing.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们别吵了 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: So just stop all the yelling! Just stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 苏珊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 别逼我再这么做 我不喜欢拉高嗓音
sense_groups.english: Don't make me do this again! I don't like my voice like this!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想听听一件无奈的事？
sense_groups.english: Okay, who wants to hear something ironic?

sense_groups.chinese: 快来人啊
sense_groups.english: Help!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 - 快来人啊
sense_groups.english: Come on! - Help!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的孩子要生了 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: I'm having a baby in there! - Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 来人啊 - 好吧 大家拄后退
sense_groups.english: Help! - Okay, everyone stand back.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 他…们…到…了没？
sense_groups.english: Are they here yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 你别担心 我们会找到他们的
sense_groups.english: No, honey, but don't worry, we're gonna find them.

sense_groups.chinese: 在找到之前 我们都在这 好吗？
sense_groups.english: And until we do, we are all here for you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好喔
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. - Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚说巴黎 那听起来很棒
sense_groups.english: Anyway, you were telling me about Paris. It sounds wonderful.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一家很棒的点心店 就在我饭店旁边
sense_groups.english: It really was. There was this great little pastry shop right by my hotel...

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: There you go, dear. You...

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 莉蒂雅 你可以的
sense_groups.english: Come on, Lydia, you can do it. Push.

sense_groups.chinese: 用力挤… 用力…
sense_groups.english: Push him out, push him out. Harder, harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 用力挤… 出来
sense_groups.english: Push him out, push him out. Way out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们抢球的动作要快
sense_groups.english: Let's get that ball and really move. Hey, hey. Ho, ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们…
sense_groups.english: Let's get...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是… 好吧
sense_groups.english: I was just... Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 用力…
sense_groups.english: Push, push, push.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要干嘛？把门吸开？
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do, suck the door open?

sense_groups.chinese: 来人啊… - 来人啊
sense_groups.english: Help! Help! Help! - Help!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在隔天找到他们的尸体
sense_groups.english: And they found their bodies The very next day

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在隔天找到他们的…
sense_groups.english: And they found their bodies The very next...

sense_groups.chinese: 啦啦…
sense_groups.english: La, la, la, la, la, la

sense_groups.chinese: 来人啊
sense_groups.english: Help!

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈 一切都很顺利 罗斯很好 他…
sense_groups.english: No, Mom, everything's going fine, really. Yeah, Ross is great. He's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 他在另外一个地方 不 他走了
sense_groups.english: He's in a whole other place. Yeah. No, he's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不需要飞回来 真的
sense_groups.english: No, no, you don't have to fly back. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么叫 "这可能是你唯一的机会"？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, this might be your only chance?

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了好吗？我才26岁
sense_groups.english: Oh. Would you stop? I'm only 26.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都还没想到孩子的事
sense_groups.english: I'm not even thinking about babies yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪了？ - 刚生了个孩子
sense_groups.english: Where have you been? - Oh, I just had a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜了
sense_groups.english: Mazel tov.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 有可能是1小时或3小时
sense_groups.english: I don't know. It could be an hour, it could be three.

sense_groups.chinese: 但放轻松点 她很好
sense_groups.english: But relax, she's doing great.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 你最近有跟人交往吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, tell me, are you currently involved with anyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 现在没有 没有
sense_groups.english: No. No, not at... At the moment, no, I'm not, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢？ - 不
sense_groups.english: Are you? - No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 要找女人跟我约会很难
sense_groups.english: It's hard enough to get women to go out with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 帅的医生都这样
sense_groups.english: Heh. Right, yeah, I've heard that about cute doctors.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是真的
sense_groups.english: No, no, really.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜是因为我花很多时间…
sense_groups.english: I suppose it's because I spend so much time, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 在我的工作上
sense_groups.english: ...where I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我试着不让工作影响我个人生活 但那很难
sense_groups.english: I try not to let work affect my personal life, but it's hard when you do...

sense_groups.chinese: 做我这样的事就像…
sense_groups.english: ...what I do. It's like, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 比如说 你做哪一行？
sense_groups.english: Well, for instance, what do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是服务生 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm a waitress. - Okay, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 难道你没有 当你很晚回到家
sense_groups.english: Well, aren't there times when you come home at the end of the day...

sense_groups.chinese: 会不想再见到任何一杯咖啡的经验？
sense_groups.english: ...and you're just like, "If I see one more cup of coffee..."

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我懂
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Yeah. Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去看看你的朋友 - 好的 没问题
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna check up on your friend. - Okay, that's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道我在这？ - 你妈妈打电话给我
sense_groups.english: So how did you know I was even here? - Your mom called me.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以这就是她？
sense_groups.english: So is this her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是借来的
sense_groups.english: No, this is a loaner.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉我让你孤单分娩
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm sorry you had to do this by yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不孤单 我有医生 护士 还有个善心男士
sense_groups.english: Oh. I wasn't by myself. I had a doctor, a nurse and a helper guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道谁赢了比赛吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you see who won the game?

sense_groups.chinese: 尼克队赢了10分 他们很烂
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Knicks by 10. They suck.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们也没那么烂啦
sense_groups.english: Eh, they're not so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托…
sense_groups.english: Come on. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死… 都是你的错
sense_groups.english: Damn it, damn it, damn it. This is all your fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 这应该是我生命中最美好的一天
sense_groups.english: This is supposed to be, like, the greatest day of my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我儿子要出生了 我应该在场的
sense_groups.english: My son is being born, and I should be in there, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 而不是跟你困在柜子里
sense_groups.english: Instead I'm stuck in a closet with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱的女人要生了 我跟你一样期待这一天
sense_groups.english: I've been waiting for this just as much as you have.

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 没有人像我这么期待这天的
sense_groups.english: Believe me, no one has been waiting for this as much as I have, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道好笑的是什么吗？
sense_groups.english: And you know what the funny thing is?

sense_groups.chinese: 生完后 孩子可以跟你回去
sense_groups.english: When this day is over, you get to go home with the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我剩什么？ - 你是孩子的父亲
sense_groups.english: Where does that leave me? - You get to be the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都知道你是谁 我算什么？有父亲节 母亲节
sense_groups.english: Everyone knows who you are. Who am I? There's Father's Day. There's Mother's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有女同志情人节
sense_groups.english: There's no Lesbian Lover Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 每天都是女同志情人节
sense_groups.english: Every day is Lesbian Lover Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: This is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 解释一下好吗？
sense_groups.english: You wanna explain that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我小时候 父亲就丢下我
sense_groups.english: I mean, well, because when I was growing up, you know, my dad left...

sense_groups.chinese: 我母亲死了 而我继父去坐牢
sense_groups.english: ...and my mother died, and my stepfather went to jail.

sense_groups.chinese: 我几乎没有任何父母亲的疼爱
sense_groups.english: So I barely had enough pieces of parents to make one whole one.

sense_groups.chinese: 而这个宝宝有三个父母
sense_groups.english: And here's this little baby who has like three whole parents...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是如此关心他 还为此争吵谁最爱他
sense_groups.english: ...who care about it so much that they fight over who gets to love it the most...

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝甚至还没出生呢
sense_groups.english: ...and it's not even born yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是世上最幸运的宝宝
sense_groups.english: It's just the luckiest baby in the whole world.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你们在吵架
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. You were fighting.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在哪？
sense_groups.english: Where are they?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很快就会来的 - 他们不会错过这一刻的
sense_groups.english: I'm sure they'll be here soon. - They wouldn't miss this.

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松 你只开了9公分 宝宝还不会出来
sense_groups.english: Relax. You're only at nine centimeters, and the baby's at zero station.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真令我感到害怕
sense_groups.english: Okay, you are really frightening me.

sense_groups.chinese: 救救我好吗？有人要挖出我的心脏
sense_groups.english: Somebody wanna help me? Trying to rip out my heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 有人看到奶头吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh... Oh, that's great. Anybody seen a nipple?

sense_groups.chinese: 10公分了 开始了
sense_groups.english: All right. Ten centimeters. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 要开始用力了 - 但他们还没到
sense_groups.english: All right, honey, time to start pushing. - But they're not here yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 宝宝不能等的
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I can't tell the baby to wait for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 通气孔打开了
sense_groups.english: Okay, got the vent open.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是班
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是医院工作员班
sense_groups.english: I'm hospital worker Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 班要去救援了
sense_groups.english: It's Ben to the rescue.

sense_groups.chinese: 啦… - 好…
sense_groups.english: La, la, la - Okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 班 你好了没？ - 好了
sense_groups.english: Ben, you ready? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚踩上来 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, give me your foot. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 数到3 班 1 2 3 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Okay, on three, Ben. One, two, three. Unh. - Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 班 就是这样 班 - 好了
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ben. Okay. That's it, Ben. - Okay. Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you see?

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊 看来像是黑黑的通气孔
sense_groups.english: Well, Susan, I see what appears to be a dark vent.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 没错 是黑黑的通气孔
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is, in fact, a dark vent.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 门开了…
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, it's open! It's open!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你们的脚还在这
sense_groups.english: Wait! You forgot your legs!

sense_groups.chinese: 用力… - 我们来了…
sense_groups.english: Push. Push. - We're here!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来了 - 你们死哪儿去了？
sense_groups.english: We're here. - Where have you been?!

sense_groups.chinese: 这故事很长
sense_groups.english: Long story, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你继续用力
sense_groups.english: All right, Carol, I need you to keep pushing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要… 对不起 我要拿这个
sense_groups.english: I need... Excuse me, can I have this?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: All right, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 太多人在这了 而且又有一个要出来
sense_groups.english: There's too many people in this room. There's about to be one more.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是前夫或女同志伴侣的人 请出去
sense_groups.english: So anybody who's not an ex-husband or a lesbian life partner, out you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 出去 - 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Come on, out. - Okay, good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 祝你们幸运
sense_groups.english: Bye, bye, bye. - Good luck, you guys, good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问一下 一定要是卡萝的女同志伴侣才行吗？
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you, do you have to be Carol's lesbian life partner?

sense_groups.chinese: 出去
sense_groups.english: Out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 他要出来了
sense_groups.english: All right. All right, he's crowning. Here he comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看 我一定要看
sense_groups.english: Let me see. I gotta see, I gotta see.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh... Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一颗头
sense_groups.english: Oh! A head.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好大 卡萝 你如何办到的？
sense_groups.english: Oh. It's huge. Carol, how are you doing this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你这不是在帮我
sense_groups.english: Not helping.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做得很好
sense_groups.english: You're doing great. You're doing fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿？ - 喔 对不起
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Oh, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到什么…？
sense_groups.english: What do you see? What do you see?

sense_groups.chinese: 头 肩膀和手臂出来了
sense_groups.english: We got a head, we got shoulders, we got arms, we got...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 看那小小的手指
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at the little... The fingers.

sense_groups.chinese: 胸部和肚子…
sense_groups.english: Oh, a chest and a stomach...

sense_groups.chinese: 是个男孩 货真价实
sense_groups.english: ...and it's a boy, definitely a boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 腿 膝盖和脚
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay, legs, knees and feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他出来了
sense_groups.english: He's here. He's...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是一个人
sense_groups.english: He's a person.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 看啊 - 他看起来像谁？
sense_groups.english: Look at that. - What does he look like?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点像我的叔叔艾德裹着果冻
sense_groups.english: Kind of like my Uncle Ed, covered in Jell-O.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 他很漂亮
sense_groups.english: You guys, he's beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 菲比
sense_groups.english: Aw, thanks, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 别大声叫 但我们还没替宝宝取名字
sense_groups.english: No shouting, but we still need a name for this little guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班怎么样？
sense_groups.english: How about Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢小班
sense_groups.english: I like Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班很好 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Ben's good. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前怎么都没提到？
sense_groups.english: How come you never mentioned Ben before?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚刚才想出来的 - 哈
sense_groups.english: We, uh, just cooked it up. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我们不在这里时 正在做的事
sense_groups.english: That's what we were off doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以进来吗？ - 进来…
sense_groups.english: Can we come in? - Yeah, come in. Come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道…
sense_groups.english: I know. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 我要你们见见一个人
sense_groups.english: Everybody, there's someone I'd like you to meet.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这位是小班
sense_groups.english: Yeah. This is Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小班 - 嗨 小班
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ben. - Hi, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 这是大伙儿 - 嗨 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben, this is everybody. - Hey, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊 他看起来就像你
sense_groups.english: Susan, he looks just like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我真不敢相信 我们当中有人生了宝宝
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I can't believe one of us actually has one of these.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我还是宝宝
sense_groups.english: I know. I still am one of these.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？ - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Ross? Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 小心头 你要…
sense_groups.english: Okay, the head, the head. You gotta...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小班 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ben. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡姑姑 你的姑姑
sense_groups.english: I'm your Aunt Monica. Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡姑姑
sense_groups.english: I'm your Aunt Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
我会随时都带口香糖的
sense_groups.english: I will always have gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你知道有时候我可能
sense_groups.english: ...I want you to know that there may be some times...

sense_groups.chinese: 不会在你身边
sense_groups.english: ...when I may not be around...

sense_groups.chinese: 像这样
sense_groups.english: ...like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我总是会回来的
sense_groups.english: But I'll still always come back...

sense_groups.chinese: 像这样
sense_groups.english: ...like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 而有时候 我可能会离开久一点
sense_groups.english: And sometimes I may be away longer...

sense_groups.chinese: 像这样
sense_groups.english: ...like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我总是会回到你身边的
sense_groups.english: But I'll still always come back...

sense_groups.chinese: 就像这样
sense_groups.english: ...like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候 我会要你去盗垒 那时我会这样做
sense_groups.english: And sometimes I'll want you to steal third, and I'll go like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 他好奇妙
sense_groups.english: Oh, he is so amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 看看他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. Look at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班…
sense_groups.english: Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 小班
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 没反应 我不认为他叫小班
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I don't think that's his name.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要闭上眼睛了 看
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, look, he's closing his eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他张开眼睛了 看
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, he's opening his eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的动作不多 对吧？
sense_groups.english: He doesn't do much, does he?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就是这样了
sense_groups.english: Nope, this is pretty much it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要喝咖啡吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: You guys wanna get some coffee? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会儿再见
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll see you guys later.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 班
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 - 嗨 小班
sense_groups.english: I love you. - Hi, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 他又要闭上眼睛了
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, he's closing his eyes again.
