sense_groups.english: Pheebs, I've studied evolution my entire adult life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们从全球各地搜集许多化石
sense_groups.english: And I can tell you, we've collected fossils from all over the world...

sense_groups.chinese: 这些化石真的可以显现不同物种的进化
sense_groups.english: that actually show the evolution of different species.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 你真的可以看到
sense_groups.english: I mean, you can literally see them...

sense_groups.chinese: 这些物种长时间的进化
sense_groups.english: evolving through time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？真的看得到？
sense_groups.english: Really? You can actually see it?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一定的 美国 中国 非洲 全世界都有
sense_groups.english: You bet! In the U.S., China, Africa, all over!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样啊 我不晓得
sense_groups.english: See, I didn't know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 你长知识了
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真正的关键在于是谁把化石放在那里的 又为了什么？
sense_groups.english: So now the real question is, who put those fossils there and why?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这东西 "我的牢骚语录"
sense_groups.english: Hey. Look at this. My Big Book of Grievances.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 有我
sense_groups.english: Hey, there's me.

sense_groups.chinese: "4月17日 巨大的噪音…
sense_groups.english: "April 17th, excessive noise...

sense_groups.chinese: 意大利佬带约会对象回家"
sense_groups.english: ltalian guy comes home with a date." Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德你看 也有你
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you're in here too.

sense_groups.chinese: "4月18日 巨大噪音…
sense_groups.english: "April 18th, excessive noise...

sense_groups.chinese: 意大利佬的同志室友带干洗衣物回家"
sense_groups.english: Italian guy's gay roommate brings home dry cleaning."

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 记录得很好
sense_groups.english: Well, that's excellent.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 看看这盏灯
sense_groups.english: Monica, look at this lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 这算俗气或什么？ 这个我们一定要
sense_groups.english: Is this tacky or what? We have to have this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们一般的灯已经够多了
sense_groups.english: I think we have enough regular lamps.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？得了 我又不是…
sense_groups.english: What? Come on, it's not like...

sense_groups.chinese: 想要这种娃娃型的钟 或什么的
sense_groups.english: I'm asking for this girlie clock or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我觉得这个也很酷
sense_groups.english: Which, by the way, I also think is really cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 这跟我的东西不搭啦
sense_groups.english: Look, it doesn't go with any of my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那我的东西呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what about my stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 你又没有任何东西
sense_groups.english: You don't have any stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是认为那是你的公寓对吧？
sense_groups.english: You still think of it as your apartment, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 - 是 你是的
sense_groups.english: Mmm... No. - Yes, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为那是你的公寓 我只是租一间房间而已
sense_groups.english: You think of it as your apartment and I just rent a room.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Mmm...

sense_groups.chinese: 你继续"嗯"好了 我要去找个地方放我的新台灯
sense_groups.english: Okay, while you "mmm" on that, I'll go find a place for my new lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 菲比 看到我怎么动这些小玩具的吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs. See how I'm making these little toys move?

sense_groups.chinese: 拇指相对论
sense_groups.english: Opposable thumbs!

sense_groups.chinese: 若非进化论 你如何解释拇指相对论？
sense_groups.english: Without evolution, how do you explain opposable thumbs?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是那些太空舰长为了操纵太空舰才衍生的
sense_groups.english: Maybe the Overlords needed them to steer their spacecrafts.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我说你只是在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: Tell me you're joking.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 这样说好了 你相信某事但我不信
sense_groups.english: Look, can't we just say that you believe in something and I don't?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 菲比 不可以 - 有何不可？
sense_groups.english: No. No, Pheebs, we can't. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛非要别人认同你的看法呢？
sense_groups.english: What is this obsessive need you have to make everybody agree with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 到底是为什么？
sense_groups.english: No, what's that all about? You know what I think?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是你把"罗斯"放在显微镜下的时候了
sense_groups.english: I think maybe it's time you put Ross under the microscope.

sense_groups.chinese: 有血从我耳里喷出来吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there blood coming out of my ears?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 黑考斯的中学纪念册
sense_groups.english: Check it out. Heckles' high-school yearbook.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 他看起来很正常耶
sense_groups.english: Wow. He looks so normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 他甚至有点可爱
sense_groups.english: He's even kind of cute.

sense_groups.chinese: "黑考斯 连自然课你都能让我开怀大笑
sense_groups.english: "Heckles, you crack me up in science class.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是全校最好玩的小孩"
sense_groups.english: You're the funniest kid in school."

sense_groups.chinese: 最好玩？黑考斯？ - 上面是这样说的
sense_groups.english: Funniest? Heckles? - That's what it says.

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯曾当选班上的小丑 我也是
sense_groups.english: Wow. Heckles was voted class clown, and so was I.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是对的 你们听听看
sense_groups.english: He was right. Would you listen to that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会称之为巨大的噪音
sense_groups.english: I'd call that excessive.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Whoa. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯在乐团吹竖笛 我也吹竖笛
sense_groups.english: Heckles played clarinet in band, and I played clarinet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是模型社团的会员 我也是…
sense_groups.english: And he was in the scale modeler's club and I was...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是没有社团 不过我真的觉得他们很酷
sense_groups.english: Well, there was no club, but I sure thought they were cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？ 你们两个都是书呆子
sense_groups.english: So? You were both dorks.

sense_groups.chinese: 有啥大不了的？
sense_groups.english: Big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得很诡异 知道吗？ 黑考斯跟我…
sense_groups.english: I just think it's weird, you know? Heckles and me...

sense_groups.chinese: 黑考斯跟我 我…
sense_groups.english: Heckles and me. Me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟黑考斯
sense_groups.english: Me and Heckles.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们别吵了
sense_groups.english: Hey, would you knock it off!

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你整晚都在这里吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you been here all night?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这个
sense_groups.english: Look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有跟黑考斯交往过的女人
sense_groups.english: Pictures of all the women Heckles went out with.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看他写的评语 "薇薇安 太高"
sense_groups.english: Look what he wrote on them. "Vivian, too tall."

sense_groups.chinese: "玛斯 牙龈太露"
sense_groups.english: "Madge, big gums."

sense_groups.chinese: "太吵"
sense_groups.english: "Too loud."

sense_groups.chinese: "太聪明" "吃东西时太大声"
sense_groups.english: "Too smart." "Makes noise when she eats."

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我
sense_groups.english: This is me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我的作法
sense_groups.english: This is what I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会一人孤独的死去 就像他这样
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna end up alone, just like he did.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 黑考斯是个神经病
sense_groups.english: Chandler, Heckles was a nut case.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的火车走在相同的轨道上
sense_groups.english: Our trains are on the same track.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是落后他30年 可是终点站完全一样
sense_groups.english: I'm coming up 30 years behind him, but the stops are all the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 苦涩的小镇…
sense_groups.english: Bitter Town...

sense_groups.chinese: 孤单的小城 隐者小站
sense_groups.english: Alone-ville, Hermit Junction!

sense_groups.chinese: 知道我们该怎么做吗？ 带你离开这里
sense_groups.english: You know what we gotta do? Get you out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我请你吃早餐
sense_groups.english: Come on, I'll buy you breakfast.

sense_groups.chinese: 万一我永远找不到对象呢？ 或更惨 万一我找到了…
sense_groups.english: What if I never find somebody? Or worse, what if I found her...

sense_groups.chinese: 就因为她的口头禅是"有可能"就甩掉她了呢？
sense_groups.english: but I dumped her because she pronounces it "supposably"?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 得了吧 你会找到对象的
sense_groups.english: Chandler, come on, you're gonna find somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 你哪会知道呢？哪会？
sense_groups.english: How do you know that? How?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不知道 我只是想拉你一把
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I'm just trying to help you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都会结婚
sense_groups.english: You guys will all get married...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我会孤寂而终
sense_groups.english: and I'll end up alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能答应我一件事吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you promise me something?

sense_groups.chinese: 等你结婚后 你可以都邀我过去过节吗？
sense_groups.english: When you're married, will you invite me over for holidays?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得到时候 我们会想做什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what we'll be doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是指 万一我们得去她爸妈家过节呢？
sense_groups.english: I mean, what if we're over at her folks' place?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我了解
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你倒是可以过来看超级杯
sense_groups.english: You can come over and watch the Super Bowl.

sense_groups.chinese: 每年都来 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Every year, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？ 我不要这种结局
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm not gonna end up like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们待会儿见 老兄
sense_groups.english: I'll see you, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 天呐
sense_groups.english: Jeez.

sense_groups.chinese: "有可能"
sense_groups.english: "Supposably."

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能
sense_groups.english: Supposably.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们到动物园去了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did they go to the zoo?

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能
sense_groups.english: Supposably.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 是我
sense_groups.english: Hi. It's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝？你打给珍妮丝？
sense_groups.english: Janice? You called Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Yes. Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们为何如此难以理解？
sense_groups.english: Why is that difficult to comprehend?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得珍妮丝吧？
sense_groups.english: You remember Janice, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她很聪明 很漂亮 而且她真的很在乎我
sense_groups.english: Yes. She was smart, she was pretty and she honestly cared about me.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝是我的最后机会
sense_groups.english: Janice is my last chance to have somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 看看她变得多胖
sense_groups.english: Jeez, look how fat she got.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大家都在 - 嗨 珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's everybody. - Hi, Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 你已经…
sense_groups.english: Janice, you're...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我是
sense_groups.english: Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是…？ - 是你的吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it...? - Is it yours? Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 少作梦了 钱德宾
sense_groups.english: You wish, Chandler Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在可是一个已婚妇人了
sense_groups.english: You are looking at a married lady now.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Aw, sweetie, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 通电话时 你就不能先告诉我？
sense_groups.english: You couldn't tell me on the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后呢？错失你惊讶的表情？ 哦 不行
sense_groups.english: And what? Miss the expression on your face? Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝也想开心一下
sense_groups.english: Janice likes to have her fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 知道我们有一阵子没玩什么游戏了吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what we haven't played in a while?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - "把灯藏起来"
sense_groups.english: What? - Hide the lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 少来了
sense_groups.english: Monica, let it go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我对贝壳类过敏吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know I'm allergic to shellfish?

sense_groups.chinese: 那你只好去吃别的台灯
sense_groups.english: Then you'll just have to eat the other lamps.

sense_groups.chinese: 是那个可怕的科学人
sense_groups.english: Uh oh. It's scary scientist man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 菲比 时候到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Phoebe, this is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这皮箱中 我带来真正的科学事实
sense_groups.english: In this briefcase I carry actual scientific facts.

sense_groups.chinese: 请注意 是有一整箱的事实
sense_groups.english: A briefcase of facts, if you will.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有些化石 都是超过两亿年之久的
sense_groups.english: Some of these fossils are over 200 million years old.

sense_groups.chinese: 在你开始前 我先声明 我不是在否认进化论
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, before you even start, I'm not denying evolution.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说那只是一种可能性
sense_groups.english: It's just one of the possibilities.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 是唯一的可能性
sense_groups.english: It's the only possibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 请开放你的思想 就一点点行吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, could you just open your mind, like, this much? Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 过去也有最聪明的人 相信地球是扁的 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Wasn't there a time when the brightest minds in the world believe the Earth was flat?

sense_groups.chinese: 50年之前 你们还认为原子是最小的东西…
sense_groups.english: And up till 50 years ago, you all thought the atom was the smallest thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到你们打开了原子 才跑出一大堆鬼东西
sense_groups.english: until you split it open and this whole mess of crap came out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在却告诉我 你是如此难以置信的自大
sense_groups.english: Now, are you telling me that you are so unbelievably arrogant...

sense_groups.chinese: 你完全不肯承认此事 的确有一点点 一丝丝…
sense_groups.english: that you can't admit that there's a teeny, tiny possibility...

sense_groups.chinese: 错误的可能性？
sense_groups.english: that you could be wrong about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 是有那么…
sense_groups.english: There might be...

sense_groups.chinese: 一点点…
sense_groups.english: a teeny...

sense_groups.chinese: 一丝丝的…
sense_groups.english: tiny...

sense_groups.chinese: 可能性
sense_groups.english: possibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信你屈服了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you caved.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你刚抛弃你整个信仰系统
sense_groups.english: What? - You just abandoned your whole belief system!

sense_groups.chinese: 之前 我虽然不认同你 最起码我还敬重你
sense_groups.english: Before, I didn't agree with you, but at least I respected you.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是…
sense_groups.english: But...

sense_groups.chinese: 你明天要如何去上班？
sense_groups.english: How are you gonna go into work tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 你将如何面对其他的科学家？
sense_groups.english: How are you going to face the other science guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 你将如何面对你自己？
sense_groups.english: How are you going to face yourself? Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 真好玩 有谁饿了？ - 我
sense_groups.english: That was fun. So who's hungry? - I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 我去拿我的外套
sense_groups.english: Me too. Let me just get my coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 出什么事了？ - 好吧 没事
sense_groups.english: What happened? - Okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 是意外 我发誓
sense_groups.english: It was an accident, I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在穿外套然后那东东 那台灯 就破了
sense_groups.english: I was putting on my jacket and the thing and the lamp and it broke.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 拜托 摩妮卡 你一向讨厌我的灯
sense_groups.english: Oh, please, Monica! You've always hated my lamp!

sense_groups.chinese: 如今 突然的神来一笔 它就破了？
sense_groups.english: And now all of a sudden, it's just magically, it's just broken?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你告诉她
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我没看到 当时我也在穿外套
sense_groups.english: I didn't see it, because I was putting on my jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过 我想相信你
sense_groups.english: But I want to believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡刚刚打破我的贝壳灯
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. Monica just broke my seashell lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 了不起
sense_groups.english: Neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会孤寂而终
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna die alone!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 算你赢
sense_groups.english: Okay, you win.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你不会孤寂而终的啦
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you are not gonna die alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝本来是我的救生网 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Janice was my safety net, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我只好去找一条蛇了
sense_groups.english: And now I have to get a snake.

sense_groups.chinese: 这又是为了什么？
sense_groups.english: Uh huh. Why is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我势必会成为孤伶伶的老头子 我就需要有个东西
sense_groups.english: If I'm gonna be an old, lonely man, I'm gonna need a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是依靠
sense_groups.english: You know, a hook.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像在地下铁吃自己脸的那个家伙
sense_groups.english: Like that guy on the subway who eats his own face.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我想要成为"带着蛇的疯子"
sense_groups.english: So I figure I'll be "Crazy Man With A Snake."

sense_groups.chinese: 疯狂的蛇人
sense_groups.english: Crazy Snake Man.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我会弄更多的蛇 叫他们我的宝贝
sense_groups.english: Then I'll get more snakes, call them my babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 小鬼经过我住的地方都会用跑的
sense_groups.english: Kids won't walk past my place, they will run!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会边跑边叫"逃离疯狂的蛇人"
sense_groups.english: "Run away from Crazy Snake Man," they'll shout!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得走出来才行
sense_groups.english: You've got to get over this. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会孤寂而终的
sense_groups.english: You won't end up alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然会
sense_groups.english: Of course I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我拒绝每一个疯狂到真的跟我交往的对象
sense_groups.english: I reject anyone who's crazy enough to actually go out with me...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我才来抱怨 这世上根本没有好女人
sense_groups.english: and then I bitch that there aren't any great women out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚的形容
sense_groups.english: You have just described...

sense_groups.chinese: 她会向隔壁桌陌生人张开的双臂寻求慰藉
sense_groups.english: she will seek comfort in the open arms of the wry stranger at the next table.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你邪恶到极点
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You are pure evil.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 邪恶到极点
sense_groups.english: Okay, pure evil...

sense_groups.chinese: 欲望难耐又孤单
sense_groups.english: horny and alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我曾经这样过
sense_groups.english: I've done this.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 大家都在这
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, everybody's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大家 向在新墨西哥的茱莉说声嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody. Say hi to Julie in New Mexico.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 茱莉
sense_groups.english: Hi, Julie.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 茱莉
sense_groups.english: Hi, Julie.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 趁着罗斯在讲电话
sense_groups.english: Okay. While Ross is on the phone...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家欠我六十二元 用来庆祝他生日
sense_groups.english: everybody owes me 62 bucks for his birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有可能你取个整数就好？
sense_groups.english: Um, is there any chance that you're rounding up from...

sense_groups.chinese: 像是二十元？
sense_groups.english: you know, from like 20?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我们要买礼物 看演唱会和买蛋糕
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on, we got the gift, the concert and the cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要蛋糕？
sense_groups.english: Do we need a cake?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我知道金额有点高
sense_groups.english: Look, I know it's a little steep.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔嘘
sense_groups.english: Whoosh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过是为了罗斯
sense_groups.english: But it's Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 是为了罗斯 - 你说得对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's Ross. - Yeah, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？好 大家待会见 我必须去…
sense_groups.english: All right? Okay. I'll see you later. I gotta go...

sense_groups.chinese: 做一件事
sense_groups.english: do a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 亲爱的 我今晚再打给你
sense_groups.english: Okay, sweetheart, I'll call you later tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你不会真的要这么做吧？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Hey, you're not really going through with this, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我也许会去做
sense_groups.english: You know, I think I might just.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你们今晚晚饭要做什么？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what are you guys doing for dinner tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我必须开始为罗斯的生日存钱
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess I gotta start saving up for Ross' birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我可能会留在家里吃积尘
sense_groups.english: So I guess I'll just stay home and eat dust bunnies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能相信这要花那么多钱吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe how much this is gonna cost?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有没有过这种感觉… ？
sense_groups.english: Do you guys ever get the feeling that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和他们几个…
sense_groups.english: Chandler and those guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 不了解我们赚的钱不如他们多？
sense_groups.english: just don't get that we don't make as much money as they do?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们老是说"咱们去这里 去那里"
sense_groups.english: It's like they're always saying, "Let's go here, let's go there."

sense_groups.chinese: 像是我们负担得起去这里和那里一样 - 对
sense_groups.english: Like we can afford to go here and there. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 而且我们总是必须去 某个不错的地方
sense_groups.english: Yes, and we always have to go to, you know, someplace nice, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没什么说话的余地 因为像这是为了生日
sense_groups.english: It's not like we can say anything about it, because, like, this is a birthday thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且是为了罗斯
sense_groups.english: you know, and it's for Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了罗斯 - 为了罗斯
sense_groups.english: For Ross. - For Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 是这样的 我在工作
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm at work...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是平凡的一天 切菜… 炒菜…
sense_groups.english: just an ordinary day, you know, chop, chop, sauté, sauté.

sense_groups.chinese: 突然间经理里昂 叫我到他办公室
sense_groups.english: All of a sudden, Leon, the manager, calls me into his office.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来他们开除了午餐主厨 猜猜谁得到那份工作？
sense_groups.english: Turns out they fired the head lunch chef, and guess who got the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 假如不是你 这故事还真悲惨
sense_groups.english: If it's not you, this is a horrible story.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好是我 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Fortunately, it is me. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他们升我为采购主管 多谢大家
sense_groups.english: And they made me head of purchasing, thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 真棒
sense_groups.english: That's so cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚在楼下碰到钱德和罗斯 我们应该出外庆祝
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I just ran into Chandler and Ross. We should go out and celebrate.

sense_groups.chinese: 到某个不错的地方
sense_groups.english: You know, someplace nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 不错的地方 - 对
sense_groups.english: Someplace nice. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想我卖肾能赚多少钱？
sense_groups.english: How much you think I can get for my kidney?

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你 你不能这么做
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, you can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我用普通方法绝对追不到那种女生
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, I can't get a girl like that with conventional methods.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是重点
sense_groups.english: That doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是要打电话给巴伯
sense_groups.english: She wanted to call Bob.

sense_groups.chinese: 就我们所知 巴伯才应该跟她在一起
sense_groups.english: Hey, for all we know, Bob is who she was meant to be with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也许在破坏 两个人追求快乐的机会
sense_groups.english: You may be destroying two people's chance for happiness.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不认识巴伯
sense_groups.english: We don't know Bob.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？我们认识我 我们喜欢我 拜托让我快乐
sense_groups.english: Okay? We know me. We like me. Please let me be happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 过去那里 告诉那女人真相
sense_groups.english: Go over there and tell that woman the truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 去
sense_groups.english: Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我必须…
sense_groups.english: Listen, I have to, uh, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须坦承一件事
sense_groups.english: I have to confess something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 放你鸽子的那个人是烂人
sense_groups.english: Whoever stood you up is a jerk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么… ？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: How did you... - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有种奇怪的感应 不过这就是我 我古怪而敏感
sense_groups.english: I just had this weird sense. You know? But that's me, I'm weird and sensitive.

sense_groups.chinese: 要面纸吗？
sense_groups.english: Tissue?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你留着那包
sense_groups.english: No, no, you keep the pack.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天已经哭完了
sense_groups.english: I'm all cried out today.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在来敬我妹 新上任的午餐主厨
sense_groups.english: Here is to my sister, the newly appointed head lunch chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还负责采购
sense_groups.english: Who is also in charge of purchasing.

sense_groups.chinese: 新上任的午餐主厨 还负责采购
sense_groups.english: Newly appointed head lunch chef, also in charge of purchasing...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有自己的小办公桌 假如罗兰不在场
sense_groups.english: Who has her own little desk when Roland's not there.

sense_groups.chinese: 午餐主厨 采购 罗兰不在场时有自己的小办公桌
sense_groups.english: Uh, lunch chef, purchasing, own little desk when Roland's not there...

sense_groups.chinese: 敬我的妹妹… - 等等 我还收到呼叫器
sense_groups.english: here's to my little sister... - Oh, wait. And I got a beeper.

sense_groups.chinese: 好酷
sense_groups.english: Oh, cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我先等 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: That's fine, I'll just wait. - Aw, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 敬摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家准备点菜了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are we ready to order?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还没看菜单
sense_groups.english: Oh. You know, we haven't even looked yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看过后 请让我知道
sense_groups.english: Well, when you do, just let me know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会坐在我座位边边等候
sense_groups.english: I'll be right over there on the edge of my seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 看看这些价格
sense_groups.english: Wow, look at these prices.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 真不得了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, these are pretty "cha-ching."

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 这些是什么 著名的鸡吗？
sense_groups.english: I know. What are these, famous chickens?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我迟到了 摩妮卡 恭喜 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Sorry I'm late. Congratulations, Mon. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不为迟到感到抱歉 我跟洁德相处的下午超精彩
sense_groups.english: I'm not sorry I'm late. How incredible was my afternoon with Jade?

sense_groups.chinese: 蛮精彩的 根据她在我答录机的留言可知
sense_groups.english: Well, pretty incredible, according to the message she left on my machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 为什么这个女人在我的答录机留言给你？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, why is this woman leaving a message for you on my machine?

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须告诉她 我的号码是你的号码
sense_groups.english: See, I had to tell her that my number was your number.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能告诉她我的号码是我的号码
sense_groups.english: I couldn't tell her my number was my number...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她以为我的号码是巴伯的号码
sense_groups.english: because she thinks my number is Bob's number.

sense_groups.chinese: 再告诉我一次 当古板房东罗普打来 我该怎么做？
sense_groups.english: Hey, tell me again. What do I do when Mr. Roper calls?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该大胆问一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Do I dare ask?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我开胃菜要生牛肉 然后主菜是烤明虾
sense_groups.english: Yes, I'll start with the carpaccio, and then I'll have the grilled prawns.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很棒 我也一样 - 这位男士呢？
sense_groups.english: That sounds great, same for me. - And for the gentleman?

sense_groups.chinese: 是 我点泰式鸡肉披萨
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'll have the Thai chicken pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 听着 假如我的不放坚果 韭葱等材料
sense_groups.english: But, hey, look, if I get it without the nuts and leeks and stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 会比较便宜吗？
sense_groups.english: is it cheaper?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为会 是不是？
sense_groups.english: You'd think, wouldn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: Miss? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要佐餐的沙拉
sense_groups.english: I will have the, uh... side salad.

sense_groups.chinese: 它要佐什么餐？
sense_groups.english: And what would that be on the side of?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不如把它放在我的水旁边
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just put it right here next to my water?

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你呢？
sense_groups.english: And for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要一碗黄瓜汤
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm gonna have a cup of the cucumber soup...

sense_groups.chinese: 以及…
sense_groups.english: and, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 保重
sense_groups.english: take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我点纽奥良鱿鱼 - 还要别的吗？
sense_groups.english: I will have the, uh, Cajun catfish. - Anything else?

sense_groups.chinese: 是 来唱一段《情歌销魂》怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yes, how about a verse of "Killing Me Softly"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会对我的鱼打喷嚏 是不是？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna sneeze in my fish, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 加上小费 除以六
sense_groups.english: Plus tip, divided by six...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 每个人欠我二十八元
sense_groups.english: Okay, everyone owes 28 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人？
sense_groups.english: Um, everyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 真抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh. You're right, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚是摩妮卡的大日子 她不该付钱
sense_groups.english: It's Monica's big night. She shouldn't pay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Aw, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们五个人…
sense_groups.english: So five of us is...

sense_groups.chinese: 各付三十三块半
sense_groups.english: 33.50 apiece.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 才不要 抱歉 不可能
sense_groups.english: No. Uh-uh. No way. Sorry, not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是毕业舞会情景重演
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Whoa. Prom night flashback.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 摩妮卡 我真的很高兴你升迁
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Monica. I'm really happy you got promoted...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是冷黄瓜糊要三十几元？
sense_groups.english: but cold cucumber mush for 30-something bucks?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋只吃了一小份沙拉
sense_groups.english: Rachel just had that little salad...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊则吃他的一小块彼萨
sense_groups.english: and Joey with his, like, teeny pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 菲比
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如我们各付各的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: How about we'll each just pay for what we had, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么大不了 - 对你是这样
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal. - Not for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: All right, what's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听着 我现在真的不想淌这浑水
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I really don't wanna get into this right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只会让大家都不舒服 - 好 没关系 好
sense_groups.english: It'll just make everybody uncomfortable. - Oh, fine. All right, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？ - 你能告诉我们
sense_groups.english: What? Whoa, whoa. - You can tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 拜托 是我们 好吗？ 我们能接受
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hello? It's us. All right? We'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔 好的 恩
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们三个觉得…
sense_groups.english: Uh, we three feel like that, uh, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候你们不了解…
sense_groups.english: sometimes you guys don't get that, uh, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的钱不如你们多
sense_groups.english: We don't have as much money as you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 我听到了
sense_groups.english: Okay. - I hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能讨论这件事
sense_groups.english: We can talk about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: Well, then...

sense_groups.chinese: 就来…
sense_groups.english: let's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我从没想到 钱会构成问题
sense_groups.english: Well, um, I guess I just never think of money as an issue.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你有钱 - 这一点说得好
sense_groups.english: That's because you have it. - That's a good point.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么… 你们为何以前从没提过这件事？
sense_groups.english: So, um, how come you guys haven't talked about this before?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为总是有事情发生 像是摩妮卡的新职位
sense_groups.english: Because it's always something, you know? Like with Monica's new job...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是罗斯生日要盛大庆祝
sense_groups.english: or the whole Ross' birthday hoopla.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？嘿…
sense_groups.english: What? Whoa, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望我的生日 造成任何负面…
sense_groups.english: I don't want my birthday to be the source of any kind of negative...

sense_groups.chinese: 到时候会有盛大庆祝？
sense_groups.english: There's gonna be a hoopla?

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上有那玩意 然后还有那玩意后的事…
sense_groups.english: Basically there's the thing, and then the stuff after the thing and it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 假如这会让大家好过些 我们可以别管那玩意
sense_groups.english: If it makes anybody feel better, we can just forget the thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 只要送礼就好
sense_groups.english: and we'll just do the gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 礼物？那玩意不是礼物？
sense_groups.english: Gift? The thing's not the gift?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那玩意是 我们要去看混混与自大狂合唱团
sense_groups.english: No, the thing was we were gonna go see Hootie and the Blowfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 混混与… 我的天 我听广播就听得到他们的歌
sense_groups.english: Hootie and the... Oh, my... I can catch them on the radio.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 现在我觉得内咎了 你想去参加演唱会
sense_groups.english: No. Now I feel bad. You wanna go to the concert.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 听着 这是我生日
sense_groups.english: No, look, hey, it's my birthday...

sense_groups.chinese: 最重要的是我们能一起欢庆
sense_groups.english: and the important thing is that we all be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们所有人 - 在一起
sense_groups.english: All of us. - Together.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是在演唱会场
sense_groups.english: Not at the concert.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Thank you. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以说 伊波拉病毒 真要命吧？
sense_groups.english: So, the Ebola virus. That's gotta suck, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 天呀 摩妮卡 袋子里有什么？
sense_groups.english: Gee, Monica. What's in the bag?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 钱德 咱们来看看
sense_groups.english: I don't know, Chandler. Let's take a look.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是短剧表演
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's like a skit.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是六人晚餐 五块牛排
sense_groups.english: Why, it's dinner for six. Five steaks...

sense_groups.chinese: 和给菲比的一条茄子
sense_groups.english: and an eggplant for Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们工作地点换了肉类供应商 新商家给我牛排当谢礼
sense_groups.english: We switched meat suppliers at work, and they gave me the steaks as a thank-you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是等等 还有 钱德 那信封里有什么？
sense_groups.english: But wait, there's more. Hey, Chandler, what is in that envelope?

sense_groups.chinese: 顺带一提 在走廊练习时好像没那么呆
sense_groups.english: By the way, this didn't seem so dorky out in the hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是混混与自大狂合唱团的六张门票

sense_groups.english: Maybe that's just how you feel.

sense_groups.english: You know what? You're right.

sense_groups.english: Just let me grab my jacket and tell you I had sex today. Whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.english: What? You had sex today?

sense_groups.english: Wow. It sounds even cooler when somebody else says it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么他表现怎样？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how was he?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃…

sense_groups.chinese: 呃？
sense_groups.english: "Eh"?

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯 他根本比不上你
sense_groups.english: Oh, Bob, he was nothing compared to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须咬着嘴唇 才不会叫出你的名字

sense_groups.chinese: 那令我真欣慰

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你只要习惯就好

sense_groups.chinese: 没多少时间能让我习惯 你懂我意思吧？

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我没办法乐在其中

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我懂 这是我生日 我们应该全都在场

sense_groups.chinese: 那么走吧

sense_groups.chinese: 再说 他们可能也过得很高兴

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 两位 再一次

sense_groups.chinese: 不是

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢大家 我们是混混与自大狂

sense_groups.english: Here's your check. That'll be 4.12.

sense_groups.english: Listen, Bob, I'm probably way out of line here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是假如我们能共度一晚 当作看在往日情分上
sense_groups.english: but if we could just have one night together, just for old time's sake...

sense_groups.chinese: 火热 热情 狂野的一晚…
sense_groups.english: One hot, steamy, wild night...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 拜托 你不能这样对她
sense_groups.english: But, I mean, come on. You cannot do this to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不行…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 得由我告诉她？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I have to do this to her? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 揉搓起泡 冲洗 重覆
sense_groups.english: Lather, rinse, repeat And lather, rinse, repeat

sense_groups.chinese: 视个人需要而定
sense_groups.english: As needed

sense_groups.chinese: 我们东西没带齐全
sense_groups.english: We didn't bring enough stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是忘了带宝宝的铁钻？
sense_groups.english: Did you forget to pack the baby's anvil?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说 这是值得的
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, it'll be worth it.

sense_groups.chinese: 女人都喜欢小宝宝 好吧？
sense_groups.english: It's a known fact that women love babies, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 女人喜欢爱小孩的男人 这是感性的问题
sense_groups.english: Women love guys who love babies. It's the sensitive thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 把宝宝朝向那群美眉 搞不好其中一个会上钩
sense_groups.english: Aim him at that pack of babes. Maybe one of them will break away.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 别管她们 这里有一个 正左方
sense_groups.english: Wait, forget them. We got one. Hard left.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝给我 - 不 我抱就好
sense_groups.english: Give me the baby. - No, I got him.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我说真的
sense_groups.english: Come on, seriously.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是真的想抱他？
sense_groups.english: Oh, seriously, you want him?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 这小可爱是谁呀？
sense_groups.english: Who is this little cutie-pie?

sense_groups.chinese: 别认为我不够谦虚 你是指…
sense_groups.english: Well, don't think me immodest, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 我？
sense_groups.english: me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想闻闻他吗？
sense_groups.english: Want to smell him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指闻宝宝吧？
sense_groups.english: I assume we're talking about the baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 是的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 他身上有种很棒的宝宝味道 你闻他的头
sense_groups.english: He's got that great baby smell. Get a whiff of his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的子宫突然痉挛了一下
sense_groups.english: My uterus just skipped a beat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就说吧
sense_groups.english: What'd I tell you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这么做真好
sense_groups.english: It's great you're doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是好男人
sense_groups.english: Well, we are great guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我弟弟和他男朋友 一直想领养孩子
sense_groups.english: My brother and his boyfriend have been trying to adopt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是透过哪个领养中介机构？
sense_groups.english: What agency did you two go through?

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是我的节目
sense_groups.english: But this is my gig.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在这里表演
sense_groups.english: This is where I play.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的名字用粉笔写在外面黑板上
sense_groups.english: My name is written out there in chalk.

sense_groups.chinese: 粉笔不能那么轻易…抹掉
sense_groups.english: You know, you can't just erase chalk.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Honey, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 他打算付钱给那女人？
sense_groups.english: And he's going to be paying this woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 他干嘛不直接送她一个宝座和皇冠？
sense_groups.english: Why doesn't he just give her a throne and a crown?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一把黄金棍子 上面有一颗大球的？
sense_groups.english: And, like, you know, a gold stick with a ball on top?

sense_groups.chinese: 泰利超烂 所以我们才一直都骂 "泰利是大烂人 "
sense_groups.english: Terry is a jerk! That's why we always say, "Terry's a jerk!"

sense_groups.chinese: 那句话便是那么来的
sense_groups.english: That's where that came from.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你大概已尽力为我争取了
sense_groups.english: You probably did everything you could.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去看是否还能够再商量一下
sense_groups.english: You know what? Let me just see what else I can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着
sense_groups.english: All right, look, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以让她在史黛什么妮的表演完之后上场啦
sense_groups.english: Just let her go on after Stephanie whatever her name is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到时不会在场 你又不付她钱
sense_groups.english: You won't be here. You don't pay her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会清洗卡布奇诺机器
sense_groups.english: I'll clean the cappuccino machine!

sense_groups.chinese: 你平常都不清洗卡布奇诺机器？
sense_groups.english: You don't clean the cappuccino machine?

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然都有清洗
sense_groups.english: Of course I clean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我会清洗的
sense_groups.english: I mean, I will clean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会清洗的
sense_groups.english: I will clean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好啦
sense_groups.english: All right, fine, fine, fine!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 谈好了 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Done. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁替你撑腰卖命啊？
sense_groups.english: Who's working for you, babe?

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 太棒了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! This is so exciting! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以拿多少钱？
sense_groups.english: How much am I gonna get?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他付钱给在这里表演的人
sense_groups.english: He's paying the people who were playing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 他付钱给那女人因为她是职业歌手
sense_groups.english: I meant, he's paying that other woman because she's a professional.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要当这里唯一没拿钱的歌手
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna be the only one who's not getting paid.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是 菲比…
sense_groups.english: But, Pheebs...

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我不接受
sense_groups.english: Uh-uh, I'm sorry, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不是什么次级慈善乐团
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not some sloppy second, you know, charity band.

sense_groups.chinese: 这城里有成上千家店…
sense_groups.english: There are thousands of places in this city...

sense_groups.chinese: 有人愿意付钱听我唱歌
sense_groups.english: where people would pay to hear me play.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只为我自己弹唱
sense_groups.english: When I play, I play for me

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不需要你的怜悯
sense_groups.english: I don't need your charity

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要打针 或许他们可以把针筒…
sense_groups.english: I'm not getting a shot. Maybe they can take the needle...

sense_groups.chinese: 对准我的嘴巴喷射 就像玩喷水枪
sense_groups.english: and squirt it into my mouth. Like a squirt gun.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 我是卡林医生
sense_groups.english: Hello there. I'm Dr. Carlin.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天有人过敏唷
sense_groups.english: I see someone's having a little allergic reaction.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生 我可以借一步说话吗？
sense_groups.english: Doctor, can I see you for just a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 我哥哥有一点针头恐惧症
sense_groups.english: My brother has a slight phobia about needles.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他我的喷水枪点子？
sense_groups.english: Did you tell him about my squirt gun idea?

sense_groups.chinese: 我这个博士哥哥想知道…
sense_groups.english: My brother, the Ph.D., would like to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是否能够以口服剂进行治疗？
sense_groups.english: if there's any way to treat this orally?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这种情况下 必须施以注射 而且必须立即进行
sense_groups.english: Under these circumstances, it has to be an injection, and it has to be now.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下来 医生说必须打针注射
sense_groups.english: Go and have a seat. Um, the doctor says it's got to be a needle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得勇敢一点 你可以为我勇敢一点吗？
sense_groups.english: You're just going to have to be brave. Can you do that for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好乖 你真听话
sense_groups.english: Oh, boy! You are doing so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要捏我的手吗？ - 要
sense_groups.english: You want to squeeze my hand? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别捏太紧
sense_groups.english: Ross, don't squeeze it so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我说真的 别捏太紧
sense_groups.english: Honey, really. Don't squeeze it so hard!

sense_groups.chinese: 快放手
sense_groups.english: Let go of my hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 真是好点子 下次咱们若要把妹…
sense_groups.english: Good plan. Next time we want to pick up women...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以去公园亲亲抱抱
sense_groups.english: we should go to the park and make out.

sense_groups.chinese: 计程车
sense_groups.english: Taxi! Taxi!

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧那两个辣妹
sense_groups.english: Look at that talent.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们练习叫车 没事
sense_groups.english: Just practicing. You're good.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续开吧
sense_groups.english: Carry on.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 小宝宝 他好可爱
sense_groups.english: Hey, you. He's just adorable.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以直接告诉他吗？ 他觉得自己脸色太粉
sense_groups.english: Can you tell him that? Because he thinks he looks too pink.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们今天出来做什么？ - 我们不是…
sense_groups.english: What are you guys out doing today? - We're not out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的
sense_groups.english: No, no. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是两个异性恋男子…
sense_groups.english: We're two heterosexual guys hanging with the son...

sense_groups.chinese: 照顾我们另一个异性恋朋友的儿子 做些异性恋男子做的事
sense_groups.english: of our other heterosexual friend, doing the usual straight-guy stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你讲完了吗？ - 讲完了
sense_groups.english: You done? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的站到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, there's our stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 我们也在这站下车
sense_groups.english: Get out of here! This is our stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们也住在这附近？ - 是的 当然
sense_groups.english: You guys live around here too? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就住在人行道旁那栋大楼
sense_groups.english: We live in the building by the, uh, sidewalk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道？
sense_groups.english: You know it?

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我们是邻居 我们何不去喝一杯？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Since we're neighbors, what do you say we, uh, get together for a drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想去麦考餐厅吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, you want to go to Markel's?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 他们特别欢迎我们
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure, they love us over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的宝宝呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's your baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben! Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben! Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 或许他会听到你喊拉铃下车
sense_groups.english: That's good. Maybe he'll hear you and pull the cord!

sense_groups.chinese: 快停车 喂
sense_groups.english: Stop the bus! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 车上有个宝宝 - 等等
sense_groups.english: Hey, there's a baby! - Wait, wait, wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定他没弄断？真的很痛
sense_groups.english: Are you sure he didn't break it? It hurts.

sense_groups.chinese: 没 只是骨头瘀青
sense_groups.english: No, it's just a good bone bruise.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你戒指造成的割伤口
sense_groups.english: And right here is the puncture wound from your ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm really sorry. - It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我又能发嘶嘶声了
sense_groups.english: Hmm, sorry! I got my S's back! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们晚点再庆祝吧
sense_groups.english: Which we can celebrate later.

sense_groups.chinese: 庆祝 庆祝
sense_groups.english: Celebrate. Celebrate...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是一个双重 双重…
sense_groups.english: He was a double, double

sense_groups.chinese: 双重关节的男孩
sense_groups.english: Double-jointed boy

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是那个专业吉他歌手？
sense_groups.english: So, um, are you the professional guitar player?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我是史黛芬妮
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm Stephanie.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我的名字原本也在上面 现在被换成胡萝卜蚤糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. My name was on there, but now it just says carrot cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会几个音调？
sense_groups.english: So, um, how many chords do you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会所有音调 - 你会D大调罗？
sense_groups.english: All of them. - So you know D?

sense_groups.chinese: 会 - 你会A小调吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Do you know A-minor?

sense_groups.chinese: 会 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你会从D大调转A小调吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know how to go from D to A-minor?

sense_groups.chinese: 会啊 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你的吉它有背带吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, so does your guitar have a strap?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 我的有
sense_groups.english: No. - Oh. Mine does.

sense_groups.chinese: 史黛芬妮什么音调都懂
sense_groups.english: Stephanie knows all the chords

sense_groups.chinese: 快点接电话
sense_groups.english: Come on! Pick up, pick up!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴士运输中心？是的 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Transit Authority? Yes, hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在做写书研究
sense_groups.english: I'm doing research for a book.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想知道如果有人把宝宝遗留在巴士上 应该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I was wondering what somebody might do if they left a baby on a city bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我知道那真的很愚蠢
sense_groups.english: Yes, I realize that would be a stupid character.

sense_groups.chinese: 是这样的 我们把婴儿座椅遗留在巴士上
sense_groups.english: Here's the deal: We lost a car seat on a bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 它是白色塑胶 能放进推车里
sense_groups.english: It's white plastic and it fits onto a stroller.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 里面有一个宝宝
sense_groups.english: Oh, and there was a baby in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他想和你说
sense_groups.english: He wants to talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家为中央咖啡厅欢迎…
sense_groups.english: Everybody, let's give a warm Central Perk welcome to...

sense_groups.chinese: 泰利是个烂人 他不肯让我演唱
sense_groups.english: Terry's a jerk and he won't let me work

sense_groups.chinese: 我痛恨中央咖啡厅
sense_groups.english: And I hate Central Perk

sense_groups.chinese: 史黛芬妮·席佛
sense_groups.english: Uh, to Stephanie Schiffer!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我要演唱一首我为我的初恋爱人写的歌
sense_groups.english: I'd like to start with a song I wrote for the first man I ever loved.

sense_groups.chinese: 查克端…
sense_groups.english: Zachary...

sense_groups.chinese: 都去死吧
sense_groups.english: Are all invited to bite me

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚才打电话来询问宝宝的事 他在这里吗？
sense_groups.english: We're the guys that called about the baby! Is he here?!

sense_groups.chinese: 他在这里 - 哦
sense_groups.english: He's here. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其中一个是宝宝父亲吧
sense_groups.english: I assume one of you is the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是我 - 是我
sense_groups.english: That's me. - I'm him.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我们俩都是孩子的父亲
sense_groups.english: Actually, uh, ahem, we're both the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 小班 嘿 小鬼
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ben! Hey, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 请告诉我你知道哪个是我们的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Please tell me you know which one is our baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个衣服上有鸭子 这个上面是小丑
sense_groups.english: That one has ducks on his T-shirt and this one has clowns.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班的衣服图案是鸭子
sense_groups.english: And Ben was definitely wearing ducks.

sense_groups.chinese: 或小丑
sense_groups.english: Or clowns.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个是小班 记得他嘴巴旁有颗可爱的小痣？
sense_groups.english: That one's Ben! Remember he had that cute little mole by his mouth!

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 小班 记得我们吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ben! Remember us?

sense_groups.chinese: 痣掉下去了
sense_groups.english: Okay, the mole came off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办？ - 呃
sense_groups.english: What are we gonna do? - Uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们丢铜板决定 鸭子或小丑
sense_groups.english: We'll flip for it. Ducks or clowns.

sense_groups.chinese: 丢铜板决定哪个宝宝？ - 你有更好的点子？
sense_groups.english: Flip for the baby? - You got a better idea?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 丢上去就喊
sense_groups.english: All right, call it in the air.

sense_groups.chinese: 正面
sense_groups.english: Heads.

sense_groups.chinese: 正面 - 万岁
sense_groups.english: Heads, it is. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得先决定正面代表什么
sense_groups.english: We have to assign heads to something!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好的
sense_groups.english: Right! Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的…
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 鸭子代表正面 因为鸭子有头
sense_groups.english: Ducks is heads because ducks have heads.

sense_groups.chinese: 你小时候过生日是什么鬼怪小丑去闹场？
sense_groups.english: What kind of scary-ass clowns came to your birthday?

sense_groups.chinese: 叫我清晨天使
sense_groups.english: Just call me angel Of the morning, angel

sense_groups.chinese: 在离开我之前 轻触我的脸颊
sense_groups.english: Just touch my cheek Before you leave me, baby

sense_groups.chinese: 叫我清晨天使
sense_groups.english: Just call me angel Of the morning, angel

sense_groups.chinese: 然后转身离去
sense_groups.english: Then slowly turn away

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会求你留下来
sense_groups.english: I won't beg you to stay

sense_groups.chinese: 陪我
sense_groups.english: With me

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 我想你一定冷了
sense_groups.english: Here. I thought you might be cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢

sense_groups.english: And then the kingdom was his forever. The end!"

sense_groups.english: That's it? That's all you wrote? You're the worst writer in the world!

sense_groups.chinese: 这不好玩
sense_groups.english: This isn't funny anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 那纸上一定写了我什么 我要看
sense_groups.english: There's something about me on that piece of paper, and I want to see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不行
sense_groups.english: No, you don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们要是这么幼雅的话 那就算了
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what? Fine. If you guys wanna be children, that's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要看了 - 哈
sense_groups.english: I do not need to see it! - Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 不不不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 走!
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: What is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是…
sense_groups.english: That is...

sense_groups.chinese: 不不不 - 呃
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. - Ah...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: Ross, what is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你只要记住 我有多爱你就行了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Just remember how crazy I am about you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: "有点三八"？
sense_groups.english: "Kind of ditzy"?

sense_groups.chinese: "太爱漂亮"
sense_groups.english: Ahem. "Too into her looks"?

sense_groups.chinese: "大小姐"？
sense_groups.english: "Spoiled"?

sense_groups.chinese: 是"有点大小姐" 那个白痴少打了"有一点"
sense_groups.english: A little spoiled. He was supposed to type "little," the idiot!

sense_groups.chinese: "只是个服务生"？
sense_groups.english: "Just a waitress"?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是…
sense_groups.english: Now, that was, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 相对于…
sense_groups.english: I mean, as opposed to, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你饶了我吧 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: The, um... Okay, is this over yet? Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的脚踝没有肉肉的
sense_groups.english: Ah! I do not have chubby ankles!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我…
sense_groups.english: No! I... No. Rach, Rach...

sense_groups.chinese: 看另一边 看茱莉的那一栏
sense_groups.english: Okay, look at the other side. Look at Julie's column.

sense_groups.chinese: "她不是瑞球"？
sense_groups.english: "She's not Rachem"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不… - "瑞球"是什么东西？
sense_groups.english: No... - What the hell's a Rachem?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 是古生物学家会用的蠢字眼
sense_groups.english: No, no... - Is that some stupid paleontology word...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我没听过 因为我只是个服务生
sense_groups.english: that I wouldn't know because I'm just a waitress?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 别这样
sense_groups.english: No. Rach, come on! Rach...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋…不…
sense_groups.english: Rach! Rach! No, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 那写的是"她不是瑞秋 " 她不是…
sense_groups.english: It's "She's not Rachel"! She's not...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的日记 太聪明了
sense_groups.english: My diary. My diary! That's brilliant!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我说是日记的话 她就不会要我念了
sense_groups.english: If I'd said it was my diary, she wouldn't have made me read it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒是真的 你是很好的事后诸葛
sense_groups.english: No, that's true. You'd be a great person to have around the day after an emergency.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信罗斯会列这种清单
sense_groups.english: I cannot believe Ross even made this list.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是说啊 - 真是个白痴
sense_groups.english: I know. - What a dinkus!

sense_groups.chinese: 别再骂他了 那是钱德的主意
sense_groups.english: Hey, cut him some slack. It was Chandler's idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我就是在等这一刻
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. I was hoping that would come up.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的主意？ - 你在想什么？
sense_groups.english: This was your idea? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们平心而论 好吗？事出必有因
sense_groups.english: Let's get some perspective here, okay? These things happen for a reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 就是你
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 帮我一下 你信因果轮回之类的鬼话 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, Pheebs, back me up here. You believe in that karma crap, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 顺便祝你下辈子的粪金龟生活幸福
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Listen, by the way, good luck in your next life as a dung beetle.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach! Whoa...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach!

sense_groups.chinese: 打开 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey! Uh, open up! Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 你按铃没人应门 那就表示"滚蛋"…
sense_groups.english: When somebody does not buzz you in, Ross, that means, "Go away."

sense_groups.chinese: 而不是"爬救生梯上来"
sense_groups.english: That doesn't mean, "Climb up the fire escape."

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你 你的优点
sense_groups.english: I just want to read you something, your "Pro List."

sense_groups.chinese: 没兴趣
sense_groups.english: Not interested.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: "第一：你看益智节目时哭的模样
sense_groups.english: "Number one: The way you cry at game shows. Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二：你对朋友超好的
sense_groups.english: Number two: How much you love your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 第三：你紧张时玩头发的模样
sense_groups.english: Number three: The way you play with your hair when you're nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 第四：你能勇敢的展开新生活
sense_groups.english: Number four: How brave you are for starting your life over.

sense_groups.chinese: 第五：你对小班超好的
sense_groups.english: Number five: How great you are with Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 第六：你的味道"
sense_groups.english: Number six: The way you smell."

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你在干嘛
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你可以把窗打开吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, you wanna open the window?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在外面干嘛？ - 我在…
sense_groups.english: What are you doing out there? - I'm, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定冻坏了 你知道你需要什么吗？
sense_groups.english: My gosh, you must be freezing. You know what you need?

sense_groups.chinese: 来杯热腾腾的摩克力如何？
sense_groups.english: How about a nice, steaming cup of hot Mockolate?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 拜托 请开门
sense_groups.english: Rach, come on, open up.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 拜托 你得给我一个机会
sense_groups.english: Rach, come on. Come on. You gotta give me another chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要？ - 没有错
sense_groups.english: No? - That's what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该走了
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不需要 我们讲完了
sense_groups.english: No, you don't have to go. We're done talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解你一定…
sense_groups.english: Rach, come on. I know how you must...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不懂 罗斯
sense_groups.english: No, you don't, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你自己最糟糕的缺点
sense_groups.english: Imagine the worst things you think about yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有何感受？如果你最信任的人…
sense_groups.english: Now, how would you feel if the one person that you trusted the most in the world...

sense_groups.chinese: 不仅把它们列出来
sense_groups.english: not only thinks them too...

sense_groups.chinese: 还以它们做为不跟你在一起的原因
sense_groups.english: but actually uses them as reasons not to be with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想跟你在一起 尽管你有那些缺点
sense_groups.english: No, but see, I wanna be with you in spite of all those things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真伟大 罗斯 我说 别走
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, that's mighty big of you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说 别走
sense_groups.english: I said, don't go!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果今天是你列单子 不管你在单子上写些什么
sense_groups.english: If things were the other way around, there is nothing you could put on a list...

sense_groups.chinese: 都阻止不了我跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: that would ever make me not wanna be with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜那就是我们之间的差异
sense_groups.english: Well, then I guess that's the difference between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是绝不会列清单的
sense_groups.english: See, I'd never make a list.

sense_groups.chinese: 我总是不懂遇到这种情况要等多久才能开口
sense_groups.english: I never know how long you're supposed to wait in this situation before you can talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许再等一会儿
sense_groups.english: Maybe a little longer.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这些食谱当中 有些用量可能不太寻常
sense_groups.english: In some of these recipes, the quantities may seem a little unusual.

sense_groups.chinese: 比如说椰子摩克力坚果棒
sense_groups.english: Uh, like these coconut Mockolate holiday nut bars?

sense_groups.chinese: 我用四杯椰子粉和四杯碎坚果
sense_groups.english: I've indicated four cups of coconut and four cups of crushed nuts...

sense_groups.chinese: 但只有一汤匙摩克力
sense_groups.english: and only one tablespoon of Mockolate.

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓了
sense_groups.english: Doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的食品认证没有下来
sense_groups.english: Our FDA approval didn't come through.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为白老鼠实验没过
sense_groups.english: Something about laboratory rats. Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 - 是啊 不过 这是你的支票
sense_groups.english: Oh, gosh, I'm sorry. - Yeah. Well, anyhoo, here's your check.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢你这么费心准备
sense_groups.english: Thank you for all you went through.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你在准备时没吃太多吧？
sense_groups.english: Um, listen, you didn't eat a lot of it while you were cooking, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是吃了一点
sense_groups.english: Well, I ate some.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 吃一点没关系 没有很多就好
sense_groups.english: Oh, some. That's fine. Some's not a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈哈 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尿尿时没有灼热感吧？
sense_groups.english: So it doesn't burn when you pee, does it?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 又是他？
sense_groups.english: Is that him again?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他 我想接电话 但我的脚踝重到我走不动
sense_groups.english: Tell him I'd come to the phone, but my ankles are weighing me down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这不是好时机
sense_groups.english: Listen, I don't think this is the best time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能为我做一件事吗？
sense_groups.english: Look, can you do something for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以啊 做什么？
sense_groups.english: Sure. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 听音乐好吗？
sense_groups.english: Music?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一首是罗斯要献给瑞秋的歌
sense_groups.english: The next one's dedicated to Rachel from Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 他想告诉你 他深感抱歉
sense_groups.english: Rachel, he wants you to know he's sorry for what he did...

sense_groups.chinese: 他希望你能够原谅他
sense_groups.english: and he hopes you can find it in your heart to forgive him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚接到瑞秋来电
sense_groups.english: Uh, we've just gotten a call from Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 她告诉我们罗斯的恶行
sense_groups.english: and she told us what Ross did.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真是太可怕了 罗斯 如果你在听的话
sense_groups.english: It's pretty appalling. And, Ross, if you're listening...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再播你的歌了
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna play your song anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何不把时间花在有希望的情侣身上
sense_groups.english: Why don't we devote our time to a couple that stands a chance?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾佛瑞 蜜雪儿很抱歉打了你
sense_groups.english: Avery, Michelle's sorry she hit you with her car...

sense_groups.chinese: 她希望你们俩能够和解
sense_groups.english: and she hopes you two will work it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 谢谢你再度过来
sense_groups.english: Hi. Thanks for coming in again.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 我没有良心 而且我需要现金
sense_groups.english: Oh, not at all. I have no morals, and I need the cash.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好像在照镜子
sense_groups.english: It's like I'm looking in a mirror. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 言归正传 这东西叫开心鱼
sense_groups.english: Anyway, they're called Fish-tachios.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃起来完全像开心果
sense_groups.english: Now, they taste exactly like pistachios...

sense_groups.chinese: 但主要是由重组的小鱼干做的
sense_groups.english: but they're made of reconstituted fish bits.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 尝尝看
sense_groups.english: Here, try one.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 你没对什么过敏吧？
sense_groups.english: All right. - You're not allergic to anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 猫毛 - 喔 对不起
sense_groups.english: Uh, cat hair. - Oh, sorry.
