sense_groups.english: Oh, but when Phoebe has a problem, everyone's all ears!

sense_groups.chinese: 顿艾瑟林文斯
sense_groups.english: Esther Livingston.

sense_groups.chinese: 死了
sense_groups.english: Gone!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 小菲
sense_groups.english: Um... Hi, Pooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 外婆 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Gram. Ahem, what you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 更新电话簿
sense_groups.english: Oh, just updating the phone book.

sense_groups.chinese: 外婆
sense_groups.english: Um, Gram? Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我能再看一下我爸的照片吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I see the pictures of my dad again?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Uh... Huh, how come?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想看看他
sense_groups.english: Just, you know, to see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你爸在草原拍的
sense_groups.english: This is the one of your father in a meadow.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在教一个小男生放风筝
sense_groups.english: And, uh, helping a little boy fly a kite.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是他参加毕业典礼
sense_groups.english: And here he is at a graduation.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一场毕业典礼
sense_groups.english: Another graduation.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一场毕业典礼
sense_groups.english: Another graduation.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的是我爸吗？
sense_groups.english: Is this really my father?

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的是你…
sense_groups.english: Is it really your...?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是的
sense_groups.english: Well, of course it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我闻到烟味了 因为有人要火烧屁股了
sense_groups.english: I smell smoke. Maybe because someone's pants are on fire!

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: Well, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当祖孙这么多年
sense_groups.english: In all the years we've been grandmother and granddaughter...

sense_groups.chinese: 你从来没说过谎
sense_groups.english: you've never lied.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他不是你爸 那是相框原有的照片
sense_groups.english: All right, that's not your father. It's a picture of a guy in a frame.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你妈的点子
sense_groups.english: It was your mother's idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不要你知道你生父是谁
sense_groups.english: She didn't want you to know your real father...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他离开时 她真的很伤心
sense_groups.english: because it hurt her so much when he left.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想配合她
sense_groups.english: I didn't wanna go along with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她死了 我很难跟她吵
sense_groups.english: But then she died and it was harder to argue with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是不可能 但真的很难
sense_groups.english: Not impossible, but harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他不是著名的树医生？
sense_groups.english: All right. So he's not a famous tree surgeon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他没有住在 没电话的缅甸小屋子里
sense_groups.english: And I guess he doesn't live in a hut in Burma where there's no phones?

sense_groups.chinese: 就我所知 他在北部当药剂师
sense_groups.english: Last I heard, he was a pharmacist somewhere upstate.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一点道理都没有
sense_groups.english: That makes no sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么村民要崇拜一个药剂师？
sense_groups.english: Why would the villagers worship a pharmacist?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我只知道那么多
sense_groups.english: Anyway, that's all I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有这个
sense_groups.english: and this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是…
sense_groups.english: This...

sense_groups.chinese: 他真正的长相
sense_groups.english: is the real him.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得我爸穿着红衣服
sense_groups.english: I remember my father all dressed up in the red suit...

sense_groups.chinese: 黑色大靴子跟合成皮腰带
sense_groups.english: the big black boots and the patent leather belt...

sense_groups.chinese: 在楼下躲来躲去的 他不要我们看到他
sense_groups.english: sneaking around downstairs. He didn't want us to see him...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他喝醉了 他撞到东西 把大家都吵醒了
sense_groups.english: but he'd be drunk, so he'd crash into something and wake everybody up.

sense_groups.chinese: 那听起来不像是个快乐的耶诞节
sense_groups.english: That doesn't sound like a very merry Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说那跟圣诞节有关系了？
sense_groups.english: Who said anything about Christmas?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 谁有菲比的消息？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Anyone hear from Phoebe yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 完全没消息
sense_groups.english: No, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望她没事
sense_groups.english: I hope she's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能了解她的感觉
sense_groups.english: I know exactly what she's going through.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会了解她的感觉？
sense_groups.english: How do you know what she's going through?

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟我们说了
sense_groups.english: She told us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你买了什么 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: What do you got there, Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 派对要用的东西
sense_groups.english: Stuff for the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该去血拼不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you guys supposed to be shopping?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还没有买礼物？
sense_groups.english: You didn't buy presents yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 明天是圣诞夜 你们打算怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow's Christmas Eve! What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 黏土动画人物才会那样子说话吧？
sense_groups.english: Don't you have to be Claymation to say stuff like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 摩妮卡 我想邮差不喜欢你的饼干
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, Mon, I don't think the mailman liked your cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你妈寄来的装饰品
sense_groups.english: Here are the ornaments your mom sent.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许邮差喜欢饼干 只是我们给他的饼干不够多
sense_groups.english: Maybe the mailman liked the cookies. We just didn't give him enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 连鸽子都比你聪明
sense_groups.english: Monica, pigeons learn faster than you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道怎么做能让你开心一点
sense_groups.english: I think I know what will make you feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何不列一张关于我的清单
sense_groups.english: How about you make a list about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我才不要站在这里…
sense_groups.english: Forget it. I'm not gonna stand here...

sense_groups.chinese: 列清单
sense_groups.english: and make a list.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你爱抱怨
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're whiny...

sense_groups.chinese: 你偏执 没有安全感
sense_groups.english: you are obsessive, you are insecure...

sense_groups.chinese: 非常没胆 - 呃
sense_groups.english: you're gutless. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你无法把握当下
sense_groups.english: You don't ever just seize the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢我一整年 却没采取任何行动
sense_groups.english: You liked me for a year and you didn't do anything about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有…你擦了太多发胶
sense_groups.english: And, uh... Oh, you wear too much of that gel in your hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 你…
sense_groups.english: See, there. You, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你照我的话去做了
sense_groups.english: All right, you did what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？ - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: And you know what? - Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 我觉得舒坦多了
sense_groups.english: You're right. I do feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 在奥巴尼 能告诉我法兰克布非的电话吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, in Albany. Could I have the number of Frank Buffay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 在伊夕卡？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Um, in lthaca?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 在沙拉托加？
sense_groups.english: All right, um, Saratoga?

sense_groups.chinese: 在奥尼昂坦？
sense_groups.english: Oneonta?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？你不该自称是查号台
sense_groups.english: You know what? You shouldn't call yourself Information!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 外婆 如果那是你的真名
sense_groups.english: Hello, Grandma. If that is, in fact, your real name.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 小菲 你的气还没消？
sense_groups.english: Come on now, Pooh. Don't still be mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？ - 没结果
sense_groups.english: How's it going? - Oh, not so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 北部很大 他很渺小 你自己想吧
sense_groups.english: Upstate's pretty big. He's pretty small. You do the math.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想没有他 你能过得更好
sense_groups.english: Well, I think you're better off without him.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我知道他是你爸
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I know he's your daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说 他仍是那个不负责的混蛋
sense_groups.english: But to me, he's still the irresponsible creep...

sense_groups.chinese: 他把你妈锁起来 偷走她的庭院装饰
sense_groups.english: who locked up your mom and stole her Gremlin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 我只想知道他是谁
sense_groups.english: I know. I just wanted to know who he was, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有完全对你坦白 当我跟你说我不知道
sense_groups.english: I wasn't completely honest with you when I told you that, uh, I didn't know...

sense_groups.chinese: 他住在哪里
sense_groups.english: exactly where he lived.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 他住在密德镇罗尔路74号
sense_groups.english: He lives at 74 Laurel Drive in Middletown.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到乳制品女王 就代表你过头了
sense_groups.english: If you hit the Dairy Queen, you've gone too far.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以开我的计程车去
sense_groups.english: You can take my cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能让其他人开那辆计程车 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Nobody else drives that cab. - Uh-huh. Got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去见我爸了 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna see my dad! - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Oh. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Mm, okay. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝我好运吧 外公
sense_groups.english: Wish me luck, Grandpa.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比把计程车开过来了吗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe here with the cab yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她将隐形计程车开过来了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she brought the invisible cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 上车吧
sense_groups.english: Hop in!

sense_groups.chinese: 她得快点过来 商店七点就打烊了
sense_groups.english: She'd better get here. The stores close at 7.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 开车到菲比爸家要两小时
sense_groups.english: It'll be two hours to Phoebe's dad's house...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会见面 聊天 分享人生故事
sense_groups.english: they'll meet, chat, swap life stories.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有的是时间
sense_groups.english: We'll still have plenty of time.

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, here she comes! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能相信吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe this?

sense_groups.chinese: 两小时后我就有爸爸了
sense_groups.english: In like two hours I'm gonna have a dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 非常重大
sense_groups.english: Yeah, big stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们出发吧 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去 这个给你 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Here, you have to hold this. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: "煞车左边 油门右边"？
sense_groups.english: "Brake, left. Gas, right"?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的作弊小抄
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh, that's my cheat sheet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的安全带在哪里？ - 那边没有安全带
sense_groups.english: Where's my seat belt? - That side doesn't have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 急救人员得把它剪开
sense_groups.english: The paramedics had to cut through it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 快告诉我 拜托
sense_groups.english: Come on, just tell me. Please, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是第16次 不 我不觉得你偏执
sense_groups.english: For the 16th time, no, I do not think you're obsessive.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这里真的好热 - 瑞秋 关掉暖气
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's hot in here! - Rach, get the heat.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 拜托你关掉暖气 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Ross, turn the heat down, please? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不一样的 偏执和…
sense_groups.english: There's a difference between obsessive...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 暖气
sense_groups.english: Ross, the heat!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 暖气 我算是偏执吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Heat, heat, heat. And I'm the obsessive one?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这边是开
sense_groups.english: This way is on.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以这边是…
sense_groups.english: So this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 关
sense_groups.english: off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把暖气弄坏了？
sense_groups.english: Did you just break the radiator?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我只是转一下开关
sense_groups.english: No, I was turning the knob and...

sense_groups.chinese: 就变成这样了
sense_groups.english: here it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它装回去
sense_groups.english: Well, put it back!

sense_groups.chinese: 它…
sense_groups.english: It, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 装不回去 - 我得打电话给管理员
sense_groups.english: It won't go back. - Ugh. I'll call the super.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 让我试试看
sense_groups.english: Here, let me try.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我忘记你有融化金属的超能力
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, that's right. I forgot about your ability to fuse metal.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个笑话很不错
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's Funny's cousin...

sense_groups.chinese: 但一点都不好笑
sense_groups.english: Not Funny!

sense_groups.chinese: 崔格先生
sense_groups.english: Hi, Mr. Treeger?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是住在楼上的瑞秋葛林
sense_groups.english: It's Rachel Green from upstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 有人弄坏我们的暖气开关
sense_groups.english: Yes, somebody, uh, broke our knob on the radiator...

sense_groups.chinese: 这里真的很热
sense_groups.english: and it's really hot in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 热到可以烤饼干了
sense_groups.english: Yes, it's hot enough to bake cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能在六点前帮我们换新的吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, do you think we could have a new one by 6?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不 星期二？我们不能等到星期二
sense_groups.english: What? No, no. Tuesday? We can't wait until Tuesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚我们要举行派对
sense_groups.english: We're having a party tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 给他小费
sense_groups.english: Okay, tip the man.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他不喜欢我们的饼干 太可惜了
sense_groups.english: If he doesn't like our cookies, too bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会被勒索
sense_groups.english: I won't be blackmailed.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 就算有点热
sense_groups.english: Look, if it gets a little warm...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以办主题派对
sense_groups.english: it can be a theme party.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是派对主题 "请进 感受一下培根的生活"
sense_groups.english: Here's a theme: "Come on in, live like bacon!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, this is it.
Seventy-four.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来这个的功用是那样啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, so that's what this is for!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这里 我要见到我爸了
sense_groups.english: This is it. I'm gonna meet my dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很重大对吧？
sense_groups.english: This is, like, the biggest thing ever, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Sure is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要进去了
sense_groups.english: Here I go. I'm going in.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 菲比
sense_groups.english: Good luck, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要进去了
sense_groups.english: Here I go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要进去了
sense_groups.english: Here I go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去了
sense_groups.english: I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎光临我们的热带耶诞节派对
sense_groups.english: Welcome to our tropical Christmas party, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 将外套 毛衣 裤子跟衬衫 放到卧室里
sense_groups.english: Put your coats, sweaters, pants and shirts in the bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 很难看得出来 因为我在流汗
sense_groups.english: It's hard to tell because I'm sweating...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我照瓶身说明使用发胶
sense_groups.english: but I use exactly what the gel bottle says.

sense_groups.chinese: 约豆子一样的大小 那样怎么会太多呢？
sense_groups.english: An amount about the size of a pea. How can that be too much?

sense_groups.chinese: 冰块？
sense_groups.english: Ice?

sense_groups.chinese: 冰块 谁要冰块？拿张纸巾
sense_groups.english: Ice? Ice squares anyone? Take a napkin.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica. Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你的客人变成肉干了
sense_groups.english: Monica, your guests are turning into jerky.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？我觉得蛮舒服的
sense_groups.english: Really? I'm perfectly comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 排队 兄弟 我是下一捆
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Hey! Get in line, buddy. I was next.

sense_groups.chinese: 崔格先生
sense_groups.english: Mr. Treeger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你们要办派对
sense_groups.english: You said there was a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎光临我们的桑拿屋
sense_groups.english: Well, hey, welcome to our sauna.

sense_groups.chinese: 很热吗？我的身体一向都能保持凉爽
sense_groups.english: Uh, is it hot? My body always stays cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 洛斯就是罗斯 洛斯 罗斯

sense_groups.chinese: 史帝夫 大夫
sense_groups.english: Steve, sleeve.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没有人名字叫大夫
sense_groups.english: Okay, no one is named sleeve.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你到底在讲什么？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what the hell are we talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 除了他们的名字相似外 我很抱歉 我看不到你看到的
sense_groups.english: Other than their names being similar, I'm sorry, I do not see what you're seeing.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是让你知道 是行家 不是老手
sense_groups.english: For your information, it's a card sharp, not a card shark.

sense_groups.chinese: 你错到底了
sense_groups.english: You could not be more wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以试 但你不会成功的
sense_groups.english: You could try, but you would not be successful.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我先去倒杯咖啡 在你们开始扯头发和戳眼睛前

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的问题是什么了 - 你知道？

sense_groups.chinese: 你在吃醋

sense_groups.chinese: 吃什么醋？

sense_groups.chinese: 你嫉妒我是真的医生

sense_groups.chinese: 你是牙龈医生
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're a doctor of gums.

sense_groups.chinese: 是能主修的人体最小器官

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨

sense_groups.chinese: 呕

sense_groups.english: I don't know. Who would I have to sleep with?

sense_groups.chinese: 我
sense_groups.english: Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要跟你上床？
sense_groups.english: Why would I have to sleep with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的游戏 你要这工作还是不要？
sense_groups.english: It's my game. You want the job or not?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿

sense_groups.chinese: 哦

sense_groups.chinese: 无论如何 希望我们还继续当朋友

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你也保重 - 再见

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.english: Well, we kind of broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些酒谁要？

sense_groups.chinese: 我拿一瓶
sense_groups.english: I'll take one.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时我喜欢拿这种东西 来假装我是巨人
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I like to hold stuff like this and pretend I'm a giant.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 再试镜如何？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. How'd the callback go?

sense_groups.chinese: 真让人不敢相信 我到了那儿 她就对我上下其手
sense_groups.english: Ugh, it was unbelievable. I walked in there and she was all over me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你怎么做？ - 我办不到
sense_groups.english: So, what did you do? - Well, I couldn't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉她我不想这样拿到工作 - 做得好
sense_groups.english: I told her I didn't want the part that way. - Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 等等 但离开她办公室后…
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, wait, wait. But then after I left her office...

sense_groups.chinese: 她追我追到电梯 要给我一个更大的角色
sense_groups.english: she caught up with me at the elevator and offered me an even bigger part.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后呢？
sense_groups.english: So, and?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们现在看到的是德瑞克·雷莫瑞 神经外科医生
sense_groups.english: So you are now looking at Dr. Drake Ramoray, neurosurgeon...

sense_groups.chinese: 至少四集出场机会
sense_groups.english: recurring in at least four episodes.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我要去洗澡了
sense_groups.english: All right, I gotta go shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你们都听说瑞秋甩了我
sense_groups.english: I guess you guys heard Rachel dumped me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 老兄
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 她只说我让她想起另外一个人
sense_groups.english: All she said was that I remind her too much of somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道她是指谁吗？
sense_groups.english: You have any idea who she's talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 是鲍伯·萨格特
sense_groups.english: Oh, I do. It's Bob Saget.

sense_groups.chinese: 她讨厌他 - 哦
sense_groups.english: She hates him. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你好 茱莉
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Julie.

sense_groups.chinese: 最近好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 没有罗斯 真的感觉有些奇怪
sense_groups.english: Oh. I don't know. I mean, it's definitely weird not being with Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我想我还好
sense_groups.english: but I guess I'm doing okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我拿他的东西来…
sense_groups.english: Actually, I've got some of his stuff that he, um...

Um, ahem, I think you might wanna, like, pick a more masculine note. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 甩不掉背上的泼猴吗？
sense_groups.english: Can't get the monkey off your back?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就放进嘴里吧
sense_groups.english: Then put it in your mouth...

sense_groups.chinese: 美味的金猴啤酒
sense_groups.english: with Monkeyshine Beer!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇噢
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 金猴啤酒
sense_groups.english: Monkeyshine Beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 外头就是宽广的丛林
sense_groups.english: Because it's a jungle out there!

sense_groups.chinese: 每次看到这个广告我就难过
sense_groups.english: That commercial always makes me so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是那个男的一打开啤酒 女人就对他投怀送抱
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but then the guy opens his beer and girls run at him...

sense_groups.chinese: 结局很棒啊
sense_groups.english: so everything works out okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是 那只猴子让我想到马塞尔
sense_groups.english: I meant because the monkey in it reminds me of Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解
sense_groups.english: I can see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们都有棕色眼睛跟翘下巴
sense_groups.english: Because they both have those big brown eyes and the little pouty chin.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他们都是猴子？
sense_groups.english: And the fact that they're both monkeys?

sense_groups.chinese: 有时我会想把他送走是对的吗？
sense_groups.english: I wonder if I did the right thing, giving him away.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你只能这样做 他看到什么就跳上去
sense_groups.english: Ross, you had to. He was humping everything in sight.

sense_groups.chinese: 害我的马里布芭比娃娃 不能穿着白纱参加婚礼了
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have a Malibu Barbie who will no longer be wearing white to her wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得他会把你们的帽子借走
sense_groups.english: Remember when he'd borrow your hat...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿回来之后 上面都是猴大便吗？
sense_groups.english: and when you got it back, there'd be little monkey raisins in it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他那样做很好玩 我对我老板那样做的时候…
sense_groups.english: When he did it, it was funny. When I did it to my boss's hat...

sense_groups.chinese: 却被老板责怪我态度不佳
sense_groups.english: All of a sudden, I had this big "attitude problem."

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人告诉你活着有多累
sense_groups.english: ∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘
sense_groups.english: ∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累
sense_groups.english: ∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 日复一日 年复一年
sense_groups.english: ∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 时运不济 活着受罪
sense_groups.english: ∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ but I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 纵有狂风暴雨
sense_groups.english: ∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 支持一如往昔
sense_groups.english: ∮ Like I've been there before ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我相偎相依
sense_groups.english: ∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们猜猜看我拿着什么？ - 韵律？
sense_groups.english: Check it out! Guess what I got? - Rhythm?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是第一封影迷来信啦
sense_groups.english: No. My first fan mail!

sense_groups.chinese: 来看看
sense_groups.english: Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: "Dear Dr. Ramoray

sense_groups.chinese: 要知道我爱你 我愿不惜一切得到你"
sense_groups.english: Know that I love you and would do anything to have you."

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 "你的公开崇拜者 艾瑞卡福特"
sense_groups.english: My gosh! "Your not-so-secret admirer, Erika Ford."

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: "附注 请收下我送的14根睫毛"
sense_groups.english: "P.S. Enclosed, please find 14 of my eyelashes."

sense_groups.chinese: 在疯狂世界 这样代表你已经结婚了
sense_groups.english: You know, in Crazy World, that means you're married.

sense_groups.chinese: 这封信不是寄到《我们的日子》剧组 收信地址是你家耶
sense_groups.english: It's not addressed to Days Of Our Lives. This came to your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面没有邮戳 她就藏身在我们大楼里
sense_groups.english: There's no stamp on it. This woman was in our building.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我竟然有自己的跟踪者了
sense_groups.english: I got my very own stalker!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where are you off to?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去参加洛杉矶的 古生物学研讨会
sense_groups.english: There's this paleontology conference in L.A.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想顺便去动物园给马塞尔惊喜
sense_groups.english: So I figured I'd go and drive down to the zoo and surprise Marcel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他会很惊喜的 直到发现他自己是只猴子
sense_groups.english: I think he will be surprised. Till he realizes he's a monkey...

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有那种情感
sense_groups.english: and, uh, you know, isn't capable of that emotion.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？那个帅哥又来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Phoebe? That really cute guy is here again.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦？噢
sense_groups.english: Oh? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 各位…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so everyone, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 请假装我在跟你们说故事 而且是很好笑的故事
sense_groups.english: pretend I'm telling you a story and it's really funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家快笑啊 快
sense_groups.english: So everyone just laugh. Now!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 对啊
sense_groups.english: I know, I know! Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗伯·杜南
sense_groups.english: I'm Rob Donan.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗伯·杜南
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rob Donan.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对音乐一窍不通 不过我觉得你非常棒
sense_groups.english: I don't know anything about music, but I think you're really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我负责帮儿童图书馆安排表演
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I schedule performers for children's libraries.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想问你有没有考虑过 为孩子们演唱
sense_groups.english: And I was thinking, have you thought about playing your songs for kids?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是很想有小孩…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I would love to have kids...

sense_groups.chinese: 在小孩面前表演我写给他们的歌
sense_groups.english: hear me play the songs that I will write for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐吃什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you wanna do for dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以留在家自己煮
sense_groups.english: We could stay in and cook for ourselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 我是艾瑞卡
sense_groups.english: Hello. - It's Erika.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是那个跟踪者
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. The stalker!

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 门没关
sense_groups.english: Never mind. It's open.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Aah! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 拿锅子打她 好主意啊
sense_groups.english: Yes, hitting her with a frying pan is a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是还得再有一个备用计划 以免她不像卡通人物一样容易被打倒
sense_groups.english: We might wanna have a backup plan, though, just in case she isn't a cartoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们快逃离这里吧
sense_groups.english: Let's get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 竟然挑这个时候不在家
sense_groups.english: The one time they're not home!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要走 在楼梯上碰到的时候…
sense_groups.english: We'll leave. When we pass her...

sense_groups.chinese: …她不会知道是我 因为我们没有见过啊
sense_groups.english: she won't know me, because we never met!

sense_groups.chinese: 只有广播明星能这样摆脱跟踪者
sense_groups.english: That's how radio stars escape stalkers!

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了
sense_groups.english: She's coming!

sense_groups.chinese: 是我 - 噢
sense_groups.english: It's me. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 完了 我们要因此送命了
sense_groups.english: Uh, this is it. This is how we're gonna die.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好没？ - 等一下
sense_groups.english: You ready? - Wait, wait, wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾瑞卡
sense_groups.english: Erika!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒先生？ - 是 嗨
sense_groups.english: Mr. Geller? - Yes, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是狄恩·利浦森 动物园园长
sense_groups.english: Hi. Dean Lipson, zoo administrator.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说你有个问题
sense_groups.english: I was told you had a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找不到去年捐给动物园的猴子
sense_groups.english: I, uh... I can't find the monkey I donated last year. He's a capuchin...

sense_groups.chinese: 一只叫马塞尔的卷尾猴？
sense_groups.english: answers to the name Marcel?

sense_groups.chinese: 恐怕我得告诉你坏消息
sense_groups.english: Ah. I'm afraid I have some bad news.

sense_groups.chinese: 马塞尔已经过世了
sense_groups.english: Marcel has passed on.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 他生了病 病情越来越恶化…
sense_groups.english: Well, he got sick, and then he got sicker...

sense_groups.chinese: 后来状况有一点好转
sense_groups.english: and then he got a little better.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是最后他还是死了
sense_groups.english: But then he died.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 盖勒先生 俗话说的好
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Mr. Geller. But you know, there's an old saying

sense_groups.chinese: "猴子难免一死"
sense_groups.english: "Sometimes monkeys die."

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然这不是句了不起的话
sense_groups.english: It's not a great saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是很适合用在今天这种状况
sense_groups.english: but it certainly is fitting today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该打电话通知我的 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Someone should've called me. - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这样无法挽回他的生命
sense_groups.english: Look, I know this can't bring him back...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过这是我们的一点心意
sense_groups.english: but here, it's just a gesture.

sense_groups.chinese: 动物园代币？
sense_groups.english: Zoo dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你可以参观4点的小鸟秀 金刚鹦鹉戴帽子表演
sense_groups.english: Yes, and come see the bird show at 4. The macaws wear hats.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你的猴子没死就更好了
sense_groups.english: Well, it's a lot cuter if your monkey hasn't just died.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊竟然和跟踪者吃午餐
sense_groups.english: I can't believe Joey's having lunch with his stalker.

sense_groups.chinese: 她长得怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What is she like?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得《战栗游戏》里的凯西·贝兹吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Well, you remember Kathy Bates in Misery? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟她长的完全相反
sense_groups.english: Well, she looks the exact opposite of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没疯吗？
sense_groups.english: And she's not crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 她是个超级大疯子
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. She's a total wack job.

sense_groups.chinese: 她认为乔伊就是德瑞克·雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Yeah. She thinks that Joey is actually Dr. Drake Ramoray.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样他还跟她约会？
sense_groups.english: Oh. And he's going out with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 他这样是不行的
sense_groups.english: He cannot pursue this.

sense_groups.chinese: 仅仅因为这个女人以为她可以在她的客厅通过魔盒看到乔伊…
sense_groups.english: Just because this woman thinks she can see Joey through the magical box...

sense_groups.chinese: 并不表示她就不是人
sense_groups.english: in her living room doesn't mean she's not a person.

sense_groups.chinese: 她难道没有权利去爱 不能追求幸福吗？
sense_groups.english: Does she not deserve happiness? Does she not deserve love?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们干嘛瞪我啊？是他自己要去跟疯子约会的
sense_groups.english: What are you looking at me for? He's the one who wants to boff the maniac.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好 我很紧张
sense_groups.english: No, uh-uh. I'm just nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我想像他们只穿着内衣裤
sense_groups.english: Maybe if I just picture them all in their underwear...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样不太好 上个表演者就是这样被开除的
sense_groups.english: That's not a good idea. That's the reason the last guy got fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是习惯在大人面前表演
sense_groups.english: I'm used to playing for grownups.

sense_groups.chinese: 大人会边喝咖啡 边忙着自己的事情
sense_groups.english: Grownups drink their coffee and do their grownup thing, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是小孩子
sense_groups.english: And kids...

sense_groups.chinese: 会认真听表演
sense_groups.english: listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样我的责任太大了
sense_groups.english: It's just a huge responsibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要亲我吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna kiss me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有这个打算
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 开始表演罗
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. Alrighty. Let's play some tunes!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 大家好 我是菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, everybody. I'm Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Okay. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要唱一首关于爷爷奶奶的歌 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna play, um, some songs about grandparents, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 奶奶是大家都喜欢的人
sense_groups.english: Now Grandma's a person Who everyone likes

sense_groups.chinese: 她会买给你一辆火车跟一辆闪亮脚踏车
sense_groups.english: She bought you a train And a bright shiny bike

sense_groups.chinese: 可是最近她一直没来吃晚饭
sense_groups.english: But lately she hasn't Been coming to dinner

sense_groups.chinese: 你上次看到她时 她瘦了好多
sense_groups.english: And last time you saw her She looked so much thinner

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸跟妈妈说 她搬去秘鲁
sense_groups.english: Now your mom and your dad said She moved to Peru

sense_groups.chinese: 其实她已经死了 有天你也会死
sense_groups.english: But the truth is she died And someday you will too

sense_groups.chinese: 啦啦啦啦啦啦 啦啦啦啦啦啦 啦啦啦啦啦啦
sense_groups.english: La-la-la-la, la-la-la-la La-la-la-la, la-la-la-la-la-la

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克 这一切真的很棒 对吧？ - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, Drake, isn't it amazing? - Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在坐在这里吃饭
sense_groups.english: Well, here we sit, devil-may-care...

sense_groups.chinese: 很难想像你刚才还在帮席蒙接脊椎呢
sense_groups.english: and just a little while ago you were reattaching Simone's spinal cord.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那个手术很困难
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was a tricky one.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上
sense_groups.english: In reality...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样的手术要花10小时 不过他们只播出2分钟
sense_groups.english: that operation takes over 10 hours, but they only showed it for two minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's "they"?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么啦
sense_groups.english: No one.

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克 你好有才华喔 让我看看你的手
sense_groups.english: Oh, Drake, you are so talented. Let me see those hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 这双手真是美丽 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, these hands, these beautiful hands. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想把这双手给吃了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Oh, I could just eat them.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我不会 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: But I won't. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 不然我的手表会掉下来
sense_groups.english: Good. Otherwise my watch would fall off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说真的
sense_groups.english: No, seriously.

sense_groups.chinese: 这双手
sense_groups.english: These hands...

sense_groups.chinese: 这双神奇 拯救生命的手
sense_groups.english: these miracle, magical, life-giving hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想接近它们 碰触它们 甚至舔一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, just to be near them, touch them, maybe even lick one?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 只舔一只喔 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: All right. Ha, ha. Just one. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇噢
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真厉害
sense_groups.english: You're good at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 来个人 他噎到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Someone! He's choking!

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有人是医生吗？
sense_groups.english: Is anyone here a doctor?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有塞伦镇最优秀的医生
sense_groups.english: Yes, the best doctor in Salem!

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克·雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Dr. Drake Ramoray!

sense_groups.chinese: 15分钟后到夜间馆跟我会合
sense_groups.english: Meet me in the nocturnal house in 15 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我不喜欢跟男人做那种接触
sense_groups.english: Uh, hey, look. I don't really enjoy being with other men that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要动物园代币吗？
sense_groups.english: But, um, zoo dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 是关于你猴子的事情
sense_groups.english: It's about your monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还活着
sense_groups.english: It's alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 你为什么不帮那个人？
sense_groups.english: I don't understand. Why didn't you help that man?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我是神经外科医生…
sense_groups.english: Uh, because, uh, I'm a neurosurgeon...

sense_groups.chinese: 而他的状况显然是…
sense_groups.english: and that was clearly a case of, uh, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: "食物噎到症"
sense_groups.english: "foodal chokage."

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道…
sense_groups.english: You know.

sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得承认 我很讶异你会答应跟我来个盲目约会

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我是不会答应的

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 那为什么会为我破例？

sense_groups.chinese: 因为瑞秋跟我说
sense_groups.english: Rachel told me, uh...

sense_groups.english: By the way, Drew has some ground rules and...

sense_groups.english: Say it!

sense_groups.english: No! I'm not gonna!

sense_groups.chinese: 说 你说啊 很好 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Say it! Say it! Great! - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 说对不起
sense_groups.english: Say you're sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要玩是吧？那就来玩吧
sense_groups.english: You wanna play? Okay, let's play.

sense_groups.chinese: 来玩啊
sense_groups.english: Let's play.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 把我毛衣还来 不然我就把义大利面酱倒进你包包里
sense_groups.english: Give me back my sweater or it's handbag marinara.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才没胆那样做
sense_groups.english: You don't have the guts.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？至少我不会没胆跟喜欢的人说他很帅
sense_groups.english: Yeah? At least I wasn't too chicken to tell some guy he was cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 住手 停止这疯狂的行径
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right, stop! Stop the madness!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这样太扯了
sense_groups.english: This is crazy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们谁还记得你们本来在吵什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Who can remember why you're fighting in the first place?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是…
sense_groups.english: But still...

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你的包包
sense_groups.english: Look at your purse!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你的毛衣
sense_groups.english: Look at your sweater!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们两个
sense_groups.english: Look at yourselves!

sense_groups.chinese: 我会帮你把毛衣补好
sense_groups.english: I'll help you fix your sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会帮你…
sense_groups.english: I'll help you...

sense_groups.chinese: 把包包丢掉
sense_groups.english: throw out your purse.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉我强迫你不要跟他约会

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉我明知道你喜欢他 却还是跟他出去
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I went out with him when I knew you liked him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉我跟你借了手套

sense_groups.chinese: 妈？

sense_groups.english: She took off with my clothes!

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么都没穿喔？ - 不完全是

sense_groups.chinese: 我穿着丁字裤
sense_groups.english: I'm wearing panties.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你都穿丁字裤吗？
sense_groups.english: You, uh, always wear panties?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是我第一次穿
sense_groups.english: No, no. This is the first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你运气也太差了吧
sense_groups.english: Wow. Talk about your bad luck!

sense_groups.chinese: 才第一次试穿丁字裤 衣服就被人偷走
sense_groups.english: I mean, the first time you try panties and someone walks off with your clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要试穿 是苏西要我穿的
sense_groups.english: I was not trying them out. Susie asked me to wear them.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看
sense_groups.english: Let me see!

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我才不要让任何人看
sense_groups.english: No! I'm not letting you or anybody else see, ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 好啦
sense_groups.english: All right, all right!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人很爱现喔
sense_groups.english: Someone's flossing!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 不是每个人都喜欢你这样做
sense_groups.english: Joey, some people don't like that.

sense_groups.english: Chandler's wearing panties.

sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看 - 你不用看吧

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 翘臀
sense_groups.english: Hi, tushy!

sense_groups.english: I'm not wearing any.

sense_groups.english: How can you not be wearing any?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为看到一个男的穿了粉红丁字裤 让我火热难耐

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.english: Can I have the milk? - I'm almost done with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别把丁字裤给脱了
sense_groups.english: Keep your panties on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被电影剧组录取啦 - 耶
sense_groups.english: And I'm in the movie! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么办到的？ - 有个演病人的生病了
sense_groups.english: What happened? - A virus victim called in sick...

sense_groups.english: so Cathy recommended me and boom! I'm dying on a gurney!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 马塞尔拍完最后一场戏了 你如果想跟他道别要快点去
sense_groups.english: Oh, Marcel just finished his last scene, if you wanna go say goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 他大概还要 参加杀青派对之类的
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's okay. He's probably got parties to go to and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 他已经有了新的生活 本来就应该这样的 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You know, he's moved on. That's the way it goes, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要写首歌纪念这件事
sense_groups.english: I think I want to write a song about all this.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我的吉他有条弦断了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, except one of the strings on my guitar is broken.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 可以借我你的丁字裤吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, can I borrow your G-string?

sense_groups.chinese: 你等着说这句话等多久了？ - 大概二十分钟了吧
sense_groups.english: How long you been waiting to say that? - About 20 minutes!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还搞不清楚状况吗？这个人快死了
sense_groups.english: Can't you see what's going on here? This man is dying!

sense_groups.english: Cut!

sense_groups.english: Mommy! - Ah.

Hey. - Hey.

and so many slices of pizza I can't even count.

Wow, I don't know what to say.

you know, make a little love...

and we should get some kind of message service.

then I'd feel guilty and tense every time I saw you.

No, no.

but your brother had so many science trophies, plaques, merit badges...

they get with the... They walk around holding the claws.

with the holding and...

say how much our friendship means to me?

I promise, I will never take it off my...
wrist.

you just, you stay in there.
You know what the...

holding up these couch cushions...
as a symbol of my sorrow and regret.

Come on, Monica, do it.
Hey, you guys.
Monica has some news.
So listen, I'm sorry I didn't tell you this before, but...

you know where to find it.

with the holding and...

Wow. You're getting good at that Marcel Marceau thing.
What do you say we play some ball? You and me, huh? What do you say?
Okay, that's my bad.
If you hated the bracelet, you should have just said so.
Doesn't the fact that I wore it...
say how much our friendship means to me?
What about the fact that you insulted the bracelet and you made fun of me?
Well, that's the part where I'm a wank.
I was hoping you wouldn't focus on that.
Come on, man! I said I was sorry a hundred times.
I promise, I will never take it off my...
wrist.

you just, you stay in there.

holding up these couch cushions...
as a symbol of my sorrow and regret.
Much like they did in biblical times.

You know, that Steffi Graf has quite a tush.

Hey, guys. - Hi, darling.

A woman in my office is a lesbian.

Jack, look! There's that house paint commercial that cracks you up!

Hey, you guys.
Monica has some news.
So listen, I'm sorry I didn't tell you this before, but...
I'm no longer at my job. I had to leave it.
Why? - Because they made me.

Judy, relax. This is our little Harmonica we're talking about.
We taught her well.
Ten percent of your paycheck goes where? - In the bank.
So she dips into her savings. That's what it's there for.
She's gonna be fine.

you know where to find it.

Get out of the bitter barn and play in the hay.

For about the fact I just dropped $400 to replace a bracelet I hated to begin with.
Bring on the hay!
Hey!

Guess what Gunther found?
Ohh!

Oh, now you have two.
What am I gonna do?
Hey.
Hey.
How come you have two?
This one's for you.

and I also know this is about more than jewelry.

Wow. Is this friendship? I think so!

You have dinosaur checks?

Nothing.
Hey, you're a cheap-a-saurus!

work on my music.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我一下
sense_groups.english: Hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 厉害 厉害
sense_groups.english: Nice. Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 有东西要给你
sense_groups.english: I got you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？ - 812块钱
sense_groups.english: What's this? - Eight hundred and twelve bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 老鸨没告诉你吗？要一千块
sense_groups.english: I don't know what Big Leon told you, but it's a thousand...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果要我过一整夜的话
sense_groups.english: if you want me for the whole night.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是在干嘛啊？ - 哦 我现在有在赚钱了
sense_groups.english: What is this for? - Well, I'm making money now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是要还你拍大头照的钱 电费
sense_groups.english: And this is paying you back for headshots, electric bills...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有数不清的披萨的钱
sense_groups.english: and so many slices of pizza I can't even count.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 老兄 - 哦 谢了 老兄
sense_groups.english: I love you, man. - Well, thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 这下子我可以买小马了
sense_groups.english: Now I can get my pony.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我小小的心意 谢谢你一直陪在我身边
sense_groups.english: Hey. This is a little extra something for always being there for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我不晓得该说什么才好
sense_groups.english: Wow, I don't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我不晓得该说什么才好
sense_groups.english: Wow, I don't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得怎样？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Eh? What do you say? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是一条手链
sense_groups.english: It's a bracelet.

sense_groups.chinese: 可不是吗？还有刻字 快看看
sense_groups.english: Isn't it? It's engraved too. Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: "送给我的好哥儿"
sense_groups.english: "To my best bud."

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 好哥们儿
sense_groups.english: Thanks, best bud.

sense_groups.chinese: 戴上去 - 现在吗？
sense_groups.english: Put it on. - Oh. Now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这种好货色应该留着 等重大场合才戴
sense_groups.english: No, something this nice should be saved for a special occasion.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 最棒的就在这儿 这手链什么场合都能用
sense_groups.english: No, that's the beauty part. It goes with everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要戴上去 就可风风光光的出门
sense_groups.english: When you put this on, you're good to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真适合戴手链
sense_groups.english: You are so wearing that bracelet!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的咧
sense_groups.english: I so am!

sense_groups.chinese: 知道这种东东 会为你的性生活带来什么好处？
sense_groups.english: Oh! Any idea what this will do for your sex life?

sense_groups.chinese: 一开始可能会让我速度变慢…
sense_groups.english: It'll probably slow it down at first...

sense_groups.chinese: 等我习惯这种重量之后 就可回归常轨
sense_groups.english: but once I'm used to the extra weight, I'll be back on track.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人告诉你活着有多累
sense_groups.english: ∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘
sense_groups.english: ∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累
sense_groups.english: ∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 日复一日 年复一年
sense_groups.english: ∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 时运不济 活着受罪
sense_groups.english: ∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ but I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 纵有狂风暴雨
sense_groups.english: ∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 支持一如往昔
sense_groups.english: ∮ Like I've been there before ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我相偎相依
sense_groups.english: ∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来都很棒 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: This all looks good. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我想找人问问 你过去的工作表现呢？
sense_groups.english: If I want to call for a reference on your last job?

sense_groups.chinese: 就在那边 经理是钱德宾
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's there on the bottom, see? The manager, Chandler Bing?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就来看看你本人有没有纸上写的那么好 给我做个沙拉
sense_groups.english: Let's see if you're as good in person as you are on paper. Make me a salad.

sense_groups.chinese: 沙拉？我可以做更复杂的东西
sense_groups.english: A salad? I could do something more complicated.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 沙拉就可以了
sense_groups.english: No, just the salad will be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我要你一边做一边告诉我你正在做什么
sense_groups.english: Now I want you to tell me what you're doing while you're doing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 哦 我在撕莴苣
sense_groups.english: All right. Well, I'm tearing the lettuce.

sense_groups.chinese: 莴苣很脏吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Is it dirty?

sense_groups.chinese: 放心好了 我会清洗的
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. I'm gonna wash it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我喜欢脏脏的
sense_groups.english: Don't. I like it dirty.

sense_groups.chinese: 悉听尊便了
sense_groups.english: That's your call.

sense_groups.chinese: 你接下来要做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what are you going to do next?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我要切蕃茄
sense_groups.english: I thought that I'd cut up the tomatoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 蕃茄很坚挺吗？
sense_groups.english: Are they firm?

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以 - 你确定没有变坏吗？
sense_groups.english: They're okay. - You sure they haven't gone bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定 都没有很坏 很坏吗？
sense_groups.english: You sure they're not very, very bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 都可以啦
sense_groups.english: Ahem. No, really, they're okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会切片切得很好吗？
sense_groups.english: You gonna slice them up real nice?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我打算切成丝状
sense_groups.english: I was going to do them julienne.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不干了
sense_groups.english: I'm out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋不在 需要我转达什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Rachel's not here right now. Can I take a message?

sense_groups.chinese: 是哪个凯西？
sense_groups.english: All right. And how do we spell Casey?

sense_groups.chinese: 是《凯西出击》或是《凯希阳光合唱团》那个？
sense_groups.english: Is it like "at the bat" or "and The Sunshine Band"?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 这个凯西是谁啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey, who's this Casey?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个她看电影时遇到的家伙
sense_groups.english: Some guy she met at the movies.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要找她干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What does he want with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜他想跟她跳点小舞
sense_groups.english: I'm guessing he wants to do a little dance...

sense_groups.chinese: 也就是去"嘿咻一下"
sense_groups.english: you know, make a little love...

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 也就等于是"上床"去
sense_groups.english: Well, pretty much get down tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得 我不…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 两个月前 我跟瑞秋还很亲密
sense_groups.english: I don't get it! Two months ago, Rachel and I were this close.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我却在帮一个 她看电影时遇到的家伙留话？
sense_groups.english: Now I'm taking messages from guys she meets at the movies?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个凯西才该帮我留言 你们知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, this Casey should be taking down my messages, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋和我才应该在一起…
sense_groups.english: Or Rachel and I should be together...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们一起请电话秘书
sense_groups.english: and we should get some kind of message service.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等吧 会有那么一天的
sense_groups.english: Hang in there. It's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: Now how do you know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她是你的龙虾
sense_groups.english: Because she's your lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 她会说明的
sense_groups.english: Oh, she's going somewhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 龙虾都会爱上一生的伴侣 这是常识
sense_groups.english: It's a known fact that lobsters fall in love and mate for life.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？我们真的可以目睹 年老的龙虾夫妇…
sense_groups.english: You know what? You can actually see old lobster couples...

sense_groups.chinese: 在他们的水槽里 钳子牵着钳子漫步 就像这样…
sense_groups.english: walking around their tank, holding claws, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 有觉得好一点了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you feeling better?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想洗到第五次 就可以把面试的记忆冲掉了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think that fifth shower actually got the interview off me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有别的机会吗？
sense_groups.english: So do you have any other possibilities?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有机会付不出房租
sense_groups.english: Yeah. There is the possibility that I won't make rent.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 如果你想要 我可以借你一点钱
sense_groups.english: Monica, if you want, I can lend you money.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 如果我无法立刻还你钱
sense_groups.english: No, no. If I couldn't pay you back right away...

sense_groups.chinese: 每次见到你 我就会感到充满罪恶感与压力
sense_groups.english: then I'd feel guilty and tense every time I saw you.

sense_groups.chinese: 何不直接找爸爸妈妈借？
sense_groups.english: Oh. Then why don't you borrow it from Mom and Dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正你在他们面前 已经充满罪恶感与压力了
sense_groups.english: You feel guilty and tense around them already.

sense_groups.chinese: 何不顺便捞点钱出来
sense_groups.english: Might as well make some money off of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 说的有理 - 噢
sense_groups.english: The man's got a point. - Ohh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那闪闪发亮的是什么东东？
sense_groups.english: What is that sparkly thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 这玩意儿？
sense_groups.english: That thing? It's a, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 是有点俗气
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's a little flashy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不会
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不俗气的 高凌风来戴正好
sense_groups.english: No, no. It's not flashy. Not for a goodfella.

sense_groups.chinese: 太正点了 你一定有给它"闲"很多钱吧？
sense_groups.english: Man, that is sharp! That must have cost you quite a few doubloons.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 亲爱的 - 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, darling. - So what's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的一些旧东西
sense_groups.english: Some of your old stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 亲爱的 我们要给你一个惊喜
sense_groups.english: Well, sweetie, we have a surprise for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要把你的房间变成健身房
sense_groups.english: We're turning your room into a gym.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是没想到
sense_groups.english: Wow, that is a surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 容我问一下 干嘛不用罗斯的房间？
sense_groups.english: Just one little question. Why not Ross' room?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是有讨论过了…
sense_groups.english: Gosh, we talked about that...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是他有太多 科学类的奖杯 奖状 奖章这类的
sense_groups.english: but your brother had so many science trophies, plaques, merit badges...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不想去动它们
sense_groups.english: Well, we didn't want to disturb them.

sense_groups.chinese: 万万不可
sense_groups.english: God forbid!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Ohh. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rachel. Aww.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很遗憾听到 你的父母分手了
sense_groups.english: We were so sorry to hear about your parents splitting up.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 他们才刚分居而已 还说不定 我们等着瞧就是
sense_groups.english: Well, they're just separated. You never know! We'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不能说感到惊讶啦
sense_groups.english: I can't say any of us were surprised.

sense_groups.chinese: 从我们认识他们之后 就没看他们快乐过
sense_groups.english: Your parents have been unhappy ever since we've known them.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 特别是在夏威夷出状况后
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Especially after that incident in Hawaii.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？什么状况？
sense_groups.english: What? What incident?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 我一定是想错人了
sense_groups.english: Um, no, no. I must be thinking of someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好是我自己
sense_groups.english: Maybe me! Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是有衣服要摺吗？去摺 亲爱的 你去忙
sense_groups.english: Don't you have some folding to do? Go fold, dear. Fold. You fold.

sense_groups.chinese: 要续杯吗？ - 我不要了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Want a refill? - No. I'm all right, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我一下下 我要演得很像
sense_groups.english: You gotta give me a second. I want to get this just right.

sense_groups.chinese: 恩
sense_groups.english: Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 十一点方向 无敌辣妹一直在看你
sense_groups.english: Dude, 11:00, totally hot babe checking you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很棒 我想我可以去变性了

sense_groups.chinese: 在水槽里 他们变老了以后…
sense_groups.english: Uh, in the tank, when they're old...

sense_groups.english: they get with the... They walk around holding the claws.

sense_groups.chinese: 在水槽里

sense_groups.chinese: 牵着钳子而且…
sense_groups.english: with the holding and...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 要来帮我说龙虾的事吗？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, you wanna help me with the lobster thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 再做一次握的动作
sense_groups.english: Do the claws again.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 别管龙虾了 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Rach, forget the lobsters, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来谈谈… 谈谈我们如何？
sense_groups.english: Let's talk... What about us?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 没有所谓的"我们" 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, there is no "us," okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 可是… - 不 你听我说
sense_groups.english: No, but... - No! Listen to me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱上你却深受打击
sense_groups.english: I fell for you and I get clobbered.

sense_groups.chinese: 你爱上我 我还是深受打击
sense_groups.english: You then fall for me and I again get clobbered.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再受伤了 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm tired of being clobbered, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 不值得的
sense_groups.english: It's just not worth it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 可是…
sense_groups.english: Well, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有"可是"了 罗斯
sense_groups.english: No "but," Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是不可能的 好吗？接受吧
sense_groups.english: We are never gonna happen, okay? Accept that.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我接受什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Except... Except that what?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 接受这个事实吧
sense_groups.english: Accept that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 老兄 哇 是我的好哥儿 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, man! Look, it's my best bud! How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你越来越会模仿马歇马叟了
sense_groups.english: Wow. You're getting good at that Marcel Marceau thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们打打球如何？就你和我？
sense_groups.english: What do you say we play some ball? You and me, huh? What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是我不好
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's my bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不喜欢那条手链 你大可直说
sense_groups.english: If you hated the bracelet, you should have just said so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有戴着不就表示
sense_groups.english: Doesn't the fact that I wore it...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗…
sense_groups.english: You know what the...

sense_groups.chinese: 作为我悲伤与悔恨的象征

sense_groups.chinese: 就像《圣经》里的故事一样

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在可以痛快的发泄了…

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是说说 你自己看
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying! It's right there!

sense_groups.english: That's what they'll call us!

sense_groups.english: Oh, I thought that's what they used to cover Connecticut when it rains.

sense_groups.english: Okay, I was wrong. That's what they use to cover Connecticut.

sense_groups.english: We don't have to watch. - Yeah, we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 要啦 - 很好玩的
sense_groups.english: Come on! - It's fun!

sense_groups.chinese: 来拍摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Get a shot of Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡人呢？ - 在这边 爸
sense_groups.english: Where's Monica? - Over here, Dad!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 怎么拉远？
sense_groups.english: Wait. How do you zoom out?

sense_groups.english: There she is!

sense_groups.english: Some girl ate Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴 摄影机本来就会让人多十磅
sense_groups.english: Shut up! The camera adds ten pounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 有几部摄影机同时在拍你啊？
sense_groups.english: So how many cameras are actually on you?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 你看起来好棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, you look so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是 你好美
sense_groups.english: So do you! You look beautiful!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Oops. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的美乃滋沾到你了
sense_groups.english: I think I got mayonnaise on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是肩膀 没沾到衣服
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's just the shoulder, not my dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家 微笑
sense_groups.english: Everybody smile!

sense_groups.chinese: 关掉
sense_groups.english: Oh, Dad, turn it off!

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有 红灯怎么还亮着？ - 那是代表关掉的灯
sense_groups.english: It is off. - It is not! What's with the red light?

sense_groups.chinese: 是吧 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: It's the off light. Right, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 帅哦 科特尔先生
sense_groups.english: Looking good, Mr. Kotter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今夜看起来很美 - 哦 谢了
sense_groups.english: You look pretty tonight. - Oh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个暑假要做什么？ - 我会留下来
sense_groups.english: What are you doing this summer? - I'm gonna hang out...

sense_groups.chinese: 弄我的音乐
sense_groups.english: work on my music.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的扣子松了吗？这些东东一直往下掉
sense_groups.english: Is my hook unhooked? These things keep falling down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看 我不晓得
sense_groups.english: Let me see. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算如何…
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do...

sense_groups.chinese: 男孩子到了
sense_groups.english: Oh! The guys are here!

sense_groups.chinese: 过暑假？
sense_groups.english: This summer?

sense_groups.chinese: 弄你的音乐？
sense_groups.english: Work on your music?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天 是洛伊·贾柏立克
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! There's Roy Gublik!

sense_groups.chinese: 洛伊看了《星际大战》317次
sense_groups.english: You know, Roy saw Star Wars 317 times.

sense_groups.english: I can't go to the prom without a date. I can't! It's too late!

sense_groups.english: If you're not going, then I don't want to go either.

sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm gonna kick Chip's ass!

sense_groups.english: You should take Rachel to the prom.

sense_groups.chinese: 很怀疑呐
sense_groups.english: Doubtful.

sense_groups.english: Jack, give me that. Talk to your son.

sense_groups.english: Your mother's right. Take her. You can wear my tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会想跟我去的
sense_groups.english: She won't wanna go with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她当然愿意 你是大学生了
sense_groups.english: Of course she would! You're a college man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得 - 哦 好了啦
sense_groups.english: I don't know. - Well, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就不想试试看？
sense_groups.english: Don't you wanna find out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是不敢相信 我不能参加毕业舞会了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I can't go to the prom!

sense_groups.chinese: 太糟糕了
sense_groups.english: This is so harsh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 帮我拿键盘 - 好孩子 好孩子
sense_groups.english: Hold my board. - Attaboy! Attaboy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们也看够了
sense_groups.english: I think we've seen enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以关掉了 - 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: Let's turn it off. - No, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我不看了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not gonna watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 小鬼 咱们走
sense_groups.english: Come on, kid. Let's go!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是帅啊 - 给大家瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: My! Are you handsome! - Let's show them!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 爸
sense_groups.english: Just a sec, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 要酷 要酷一点
sense_groups.english: Okay, be cool. Just be cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 爸
sense_groups.english: Okay, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 准备好了没？你的白马王子来了…

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 糟了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 不用等我们了
sense_groups.english: Bye! Don't wait up!

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普
sense_groups.english: Chip!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 真是
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear!

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 我怎么把这东西关了？

sense_groups.chinese: 按下按钮

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一个？哪个按钮？杰克

sense_groups.chinese: 那一个 就那一个
sense_groups.english: The button! The button!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 嗯

sense_groups.chinese: 看到没？他是她的龙虾

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他跳
sense_groups.english: Dance with him!

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 我饿了

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你爸爸跳

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
