sense_groups.chinese: 萝丝·玛丽比较适合小荧幕 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Rose Marie really belongs on a smaller screen, doesn't she?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey, you. - Hey, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 喂 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Whoa, hey, whoa. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how was your day?

sense_groups.chinese: 和平常差不多
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, pretty much the usual.

sense_groups.chinese: 阳光闪耀 鸟在歌唱
sense_groups.english: Uh, sun shining, birds chirping.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？我也是
sense_groups.english: Really? Mine too.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 我也是
sense_groups.english: Hey, cool! Mine too!

sense_groups.chinese: 知道了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回博物馆 所以…
sense_groups.english: I gotta get to the museum. So, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 晚上见？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: I'll see you tonight? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚见？ - 喂 喂
sense_groups.english: Tonight? - Hey, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚有什么事吗？ - 我们的第一次正式约会
sense_groups.english: What's tonight? - It is our first official date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们第一次约会
sense_groups.english: Our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Uh, ha, ha. Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚？你该帮我当服务生？我的餐饮服务？
sense_groups.english: Tonight? You're supposed to waitress for me? My catering thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想起来了吗？ - 天啊 摩妮卡 我忘了
sense_groups.english: Any of that trigger anything? - Oh, God, Monica. I forgot!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们第一次约会
sense_groups.english: This is our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我妈帮我找到这个客人 - 我可以当服务生
sense_groups.english: Yes, but my mom got me this job. - I can be a waitress!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 谢谢你 看吧 菲比
sense_groups.english: Thank you, thank you. See? Phoebe! Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？菲比 - 呃
sense_groups.english: Really, Pheebs? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得当真的服务生
sense_groups.english: You'd have to be an actual waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟当小熊宝宝是不一样的
sense_groups.english: This can't be like your "I can be a bear cub" thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以当服务生 好 看我的
sense_groups.english: I can be a waitress. Okay, watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我两份一号餐 不要培根
sense_groups.english: Um, give me two number ones, 86 the bacon...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一份炒蛋吐司
sense_groups.english: one Adam and Eve on a raft and wreck them!

sense_groups.chinese: 是詹姆斯·庞德
sense_groups.english: It's James Bond!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我们迟到了 - 没关系 请进
sense_groups.english: Sorry we're late. - That's okay. Come on in.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 摩妮卡·盖勒会来吗？我听说她会来
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm sorry, is Monica Geller coming? I was told she was.

sense_groups.chinese: 柏克医生 我就是
sense_groups.english: Dr. Burke, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你以前好…
sense_groups.english: My God! You used to be so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你一定减了…
sense_groups.english: I mean, you've... You must have lost like...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很漂亮 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You look great. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位是菲比 她来帮我忙
sense_groups.english: This is Phoebe. She'll be helping me.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 幸会
sense_groups.english: Hi, Phoebe. Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？ - 我很好 你呢？
sense_groups.english: So how you been? - Great. How have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 你显然知道芭芭拉跟我分开了
sense_groups.english: Oh, obviously you know Barbara and I split up...

sense_groups.chinese: 不然你不会歪着头
sense_groups.english: or you wouldn't do the head tilt.

sense_groups.chinese: 歪着头？
sense_groups.english: The head tilt?

sense_groups.chinese: 自从我离婚后 每个人跟我问好时
sense_groups.english: Since the divorce, everybody asks how I am...

sense_groups.chinese: 都会同情地歪着头 "你还好吧？还可以吧？"
sense_groups.english: with a sympathetic head tilt. "How you doing? You okay?"

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 不会
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 相信我 我也是一样
sense_groups.english: It's fine. Believe me, I do it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都会点头说"我还好"
sense_groups.english: I always answer with the "I'm okay" head bob. "I'm okay."

sense_groups.chinese: "你确定？" "对 我很好"
sense_groups.english: "You're sure?" "Yeah, I'm fine."

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去准备音乐了 我买了新CD换片器
sense_groups.english: I gotta set up the music. I got a new CD changer.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 离婚后我只剩四张CD可换
sense_groups.english: Of course, the divorce only left me with four CDs to change.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太糟糕了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's too bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会撑下来的
sense_groups.english: I'll survive.

sense_groups.chinese: 沃德 反身上篮
sense_groups.english: Ward. With a reverse.

sense_groups.chinese: 两份大的 都要多加起司
sense_groups.english: Uh, two larges, extra cheese on both.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着
sense_groups.english: But listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 不要按19号门铃
sense_groups.english: don't ring the buzzer for 19.

sense_groups.chinese: 按20号盖勒与葛林的门铃
sense_groups.english: Ring 20. Geller/Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们会让你进来的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: They'll let you in, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你按我们的门铃 就拿不到小费
sense_groups.english: If you buzz our door, there's no tip for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨马上就送到 我说过我们根本不必站起来
sense_groups.english: Pizza's on the way. I told you we wouldn't have to get up.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们想尿尿呢？
sense_groups.english: What if we have to pee?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会叫他们别送汽水过来
sense_groups.english: I'll cancel the sodas.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得出去 这是你的派对
sense_groups.english: Get back out there. It's your party!

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们都好无聊 一堆眼科医生
sense_groups.english: But they're so dull. They're all ophthalmologists.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是眼科医生
sense_groups.english: You're an ophthalmologist.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我爸妈要我当医生 我想当警长
sense_groups.english: Because my parents wanted me to be. I wanted to be a sheriff.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好好笑 凯迪拉克 白内障 我懂了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. That's funny. Cadillac, cataract. I get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别过来
sense_groups.english: But you stay out there!

sense_groups.chinese: 看到了没？ - 好吧 听我说
sense_groups.english: You see? - All right, I tell you what.

sense_groups.chinese: 五分钟后我就去救你出来 就说烤肉串出了问题
sense_groups.english: I'll come get you in five minutes with some sort of, um, kebob emergency.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样子好多了
sense_groups.english: Ah. Better.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 想看他们抓狂吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, want to see them go nuts?

sense_groups.chinese: 看好了
sense_groups.english: Watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁需要杯子？
sense_groups.english: Who needs glasses?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好神魂颠倒哦 - 我才没有
sense_groups.english: You are so smitten. - I am not!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 你简直是只神魂颠倒的小猫咪
sense_groups.english: Oh, you are so much the smitten kitten.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该约他出去 - 柏克医生？
sense_groups.english: You should ask him out. - Dr. Burke?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可以 他是大人
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. I mean, like, he's a grown-up.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？你们俩对彼此超有好感的
sense_groups.english: So? You two are totally into each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 他是我爸妈的朋友 他比我大二十岁吧
sense_groups.english: He's a friend of my parents. He's like 20 years older than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你不会再跟他见面？
sense_groups.english: So you're never gonna see him again?

sense_groups.chinese: 也不能那么说
sense_groups.english: Not never.

sense_groups.chinese: 我约他明天帮我检查眼睛
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna see him tomorrow at my eye appointment.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是刚检查过眼睛吗？ - 对 但你知道的
sense_groups.english: Didn't you just get your eyes checked? - Yeah, but, you know, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 27岁的人很容易眼睛发生病变
sense_groups.english: 27 is a dangerous eye age.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说那部电影不好看 我只是说那有一点…
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying it was a bad movie. I'm just saying it was a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 难以理解
sense_groups.english: hard to follow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过那是有字慕的电影
sense_groups.english: I told you there'd be subtitles.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不想 跟你第一次约会就戴眼镜
sense_groups.english: I just didn't want to wear my glasses on our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我吻你时 你叫的不是我妹妹的名字
sense_groups.english: It would help when I'm kissing if you didn't shout my sister's name.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我去看一下 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Honey, I'm just checking. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Monica? - Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩尼卡？ - 摩？
sense_groups.english: Monica? - Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 对不起
sense_groups.english: What? - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 但你伸手摸我屁股时…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's just, when you moved your hands down to my butt...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想到 "罗斯在摸我的屁股 "
sense_groups.english: it was like, "Whoa, Ross' hands are on my butt!"

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很好笑 为什么？
sense_groups.english: And that's funny why?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是好笑
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我想我很紧张
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm sorry. I guess I'm just nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟我面对的人是你
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在一起了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You know, it's us. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们越过那条线 这真的很重要
sense_groups.english: I mean, we're crossing that line. It's sort of a big thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很重要 我只是不知道它很好笑
sense_groups.english: Well, I know it's big. I just didn't know it was ha-ha big.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我没有摸你屁股
sense_groups.english: Okay, my hands were nowhere near your butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know, I know, I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在想 你刚刚摸了我的屁股
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about when they were there the last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 好吧 听着 我保证
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. Okay, look! Whoa, I promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 我准备好了 我不会再笑 把你的手放回去
sense_groups.english: I'm good. I won't laugh anymore. Put your hands back there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你看 现在我没办法了 因为
sense_groups.english: No, see, now I can't, because, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会很清楚的意识到
sense_groups.english: I'm feeling too self-conscious.

sense_groups.chinese: 摸一边就好 - 不了
sense_groups.english: Just one cheek. - No. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉没了
sense_groups.english: The moment's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以背对你 让你摸 - 那还真是浪漫
sense_groups.english: I'll back up into your hands. - That's romantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 摸一下 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Touch it. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 捏一下 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, squeeze it. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 揉一下 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Rub it? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 快抓我的屁股
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on! Would you just grab my ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 看 车子起火了
sense_groups.english: Wow, look at that. The car is on fire...

sense_groups.chinese: 但上面昂贵的烤漆…
sense_groups.english: yet somehow its expensive paint job...

sense_groups.chinese: 在奇迹蜡的保护下完好无缺
sense_groups.english: is protected by the Miracle Wax.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脸上黏了起司条
sense_groups.english: You've got a Cheeto on your face, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里干嘛？你不是要跟瑞秋出去吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you supposed to be out with Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是14小时前的事
sense_groups.english: That was 14 hours ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果如何？ - 嗯…
sense_groups.english: So how'd it go? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们跟女生亲热时…
sense_groups.english: Have you ever been, you know, fooling around with a girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 对方会笑个不停吗？
sense_groups.english: and, uh, she started laughing?

sense_groups.chinese: 会 但那是1982年…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but, uh, it was 1982...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的瀑布发型对着她的下巴搔痒
sense_groups.english: and my Flock of Seagulls haircut was tickling her chin.

sense_groups.chinese: 她对着你猛笑？ - 对
sense_groups.english: She laughed at you? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从九年级开始 一直在等待这一刻
sense_groups.english: I've been wanting this since ninth grade typing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是希望很完美
sense_groups.english: You know, I just want it to be perfect...

sense_groups.chinese: 一切顺利 还有…
sense_groups.english: and right and...

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么雷射无法切穿烤漆？
sense_groups.english: Why isn't that laser beam cutting through the paint?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是奇迹蜡 - 真的是个奇迹
sense_groups.english: It's the Miracle Wax! - It certainly is a miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我一直在想…
sense_groups.english: Listen, I was, um, thinking about...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你们能大声一点吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, can you guys speak up?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们那么小声 真的很难听清楚
sense_groups.english: It's harder for us to hear you when you lower your voice.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚的事我很抱歉 我真的想弥补
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about last night. I really want to make it up to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要弥补 你打算怎么做？
sense_groups.english: No. You know, there's no need to make it up... How?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想来顿浪漫晚餐
sense_groups.english: Well, I was thinking maybe a, um... Ahem, a romantic dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 有烛光跟酒
sense_groups.english: with, um, candles and wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以回我房间
sense_groups.english: And then, uh, ahem, maybe going back to my place...

sense_groups.chinese: 吃甜点
sense_groups.english: for, um, dessert.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 那听起来…
sense_groups.english: That sounds...

sense_groups.chinese: 很完美？
sense_groups.english: perfect? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么一回事？ - 你能帮我们拿啤酒来吗？
sense_groups.english: What's this? - Would you get us a couple of beers?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我会看着你的眼睛
sense_groups.english: I'm going to look into your eyes now.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是我的工作
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 看上面
sense_groups.english: All right. Look up.

sense_groups.chinese: 看下面
sense_groups.english: Look down.

sense_groups.chinese: 张开眼睛 看下面
sense_groups.english: Now, open your eyes and look down.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了
sense_groups.english: That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 看着光
sense_groups.english: Look into the light.

sense_groups.chinese: 看着我
sense_groups.english: Now look at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的眼睛看起来不错 非常健康
sense_groups.english: Your eyes look good. Those are good eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 感觉不错
sense_groups.english: Good. They feel good.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们都还在
sense_groups.english: In my head.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Um, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能见到你 - 我也很高兴
sense_groups.english: It was great to see you. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Goodbye. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 眼药水 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Drops! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 眼药水 拿去 免费的
sense_groups.english: Drops. Here, they're free.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那么…
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Uh, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我该走了
sense_groups.english: I guess I better be going.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 后会有期
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, yeah, I'll see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Thanks again. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得让你们两个懒鬼站起来
sense_groups.english: We have to get you lazy boys out of these chairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂喂喂 - 喂喂喂
sense_groups.english: Hey, whoa, hey, whoa. - Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们该到外面去接触三维的人
sense_groups.english: You should go outside and be with the three-dimensional people.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 家里很好
sense_groups.english: No. Inside good.

sense_groups.chinese: 外面太逊了
sense_groups.english: Outside bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们太可悲了
sense_groups.english: You guys are so pathetic.

sense_groups.chinese: 《仙纳杜》
sense_groups.english: Oh, Xanadu!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 她变成我们的一员了
sense_groups.english: She's one of us now.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是想顺便过来说晚安
sense_groups.english: We just wanted to stop by and, uh, say good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们甚至没转头
sense_groups.english: They won't even turn their heads.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 各位 我要脱掉上衣了
sense_groups.english: All right, you guys. I'm taking off my shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在说谎
sense_groups.english: No, she's lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再把食物送到我家了
sense_groups.english: Stop sending food to our apartment!

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么打扮得这么漂亮？
sense_groups.english: Why are you dressed up?

sense_groups.chinese: 不只你们有约会
sense_groups.english: You're not the only one who has a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你有约会？跟谁？ - 你不认识
sense_groups.english: What? You have a date? Who with? - No one.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 他叫什么名字？ - 你不认识
sense_groups.english: Come on, what's his name? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 告诉我
sense_groups.english: Come on, tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但我真的很期待这次约会
sense_groups.english: All right, but I'm very excited about this, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得答应 不能拿出哥哥那一套来教训我
sense_groups.english: So promise you won't get big-brothery and judgmental.

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应 什么？
sense_groups.english: I promise. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是理查·柏克 - 理查·柏克是谁？
sense_groups.english: It's Richard Burke. - Who's Richard Burke?

sense_groups.chinese: 是柏克医生？
sense_groups.english: Is that Dr...? Dr. Burke?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟柏克医生约会 为什么？为什么？为什么…
sense_groups.english: You have a date with Dr. Burke? Why? Why? Why...

sense_groups.chinese: 我该觉得困扰？
sense_groups.english: should that bother me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢他 他像是…
sense_groups.english: I love that man. He's like, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸的亲兄弟
sense_groups.english: a brother to Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你
sense_groups.english: Well, for your information...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我见过最聪明 最优雅跟性感的男人
sense_groups.english: he is the brightest, most sophisticated, sexiest man I've ever been with.

sense_groups.chinese: 柏克医生很性感？
sense_groups.english: Dr. Burke is sexy?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 当然罗
sense_groups.english: Absolutely!

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Damn!

sense_groups.chinese: 又是博物馆 我能…
sense_groups.english: It's the museum again. Can I...? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 柏克医生吻过我一次 - 什么时候？
sense_groups.english: You know, Dr. Burke kissed me once. - When?

sense_groups.chinese: 我7岁时 骑脚踏车在他家门口跌倒
sense_groups.english: When I was, um, 7, I crashed my bike right out in front of his house...

sense_groups.chinese: 为了安抚我别再哭 他亲了我这里一下
sense_groups.english: and to stop me from crying, he kissed me right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是幸运 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, you are so lucky! - I know. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 南方古猿不该放在那个展示区
sense_groups.english: Australopithecus isn't supposed to be in that display.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 直立猿人可以直立 南方古猿无法完全立起来
sense_groups.english: No, Homo habilis was erect. Australopithecus was never fully erect.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为他很紧张
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe he was nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Oh, look! I can't believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 直立猿人还不会使用工具 他们还把他跟陶壶放在一起？
sense_groups.english: Homo habilis can't use tools yet, and they've got him with clay pots?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们何不给他微波炉呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't they just give him a microwave? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉耽误了这么久
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry this is taking so long.

sense_groups.chinese: 这比我预期中还花时间 我们还是可以去吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: You know, I... It's longer than I expected. We will have dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 - 卡尔
sense_groups.english: That's okay. It's fine. - Karl!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是蜜雪儿？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Wow! Is that Michelle? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 高中毕业后我就没跟她见过面
sense_groups.english: I've not seen her since high-school graduation.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那晚她真的喝…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, that night she got so dru...

sense_groups.chinese: 非常激动
sense_groups.english: Emotional.

sense_groups.chinese: 她又要生了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You know, she's having another baby. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为她刚刚才生完孩子 - 不 亨利快满两岁了
sense_groups.english: I thought she just had one. - No, no. Henry's almost 2.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会说话跟到处乱跑 看吧
sense_groups.english: And he's talking and everything. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 有天他跟我说 他喜欢我胜过喜欢他爷爷
sense_groups.english: The other day he told me he liked me better than his other grandpa.

sense_groups.chinese: 老实说他爷爷是个酒鬼 但是…
sense_groups.english: In all fairness, his other grandpa's a drunk, but still...

sense_groups.chinese: 你当外公了
sense_groups.english: Whoa. You're a grandpa.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are we nuts here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 或许吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我和一个我曾经在他的泳池里尿尿的男人约会
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm dating a man whose pool I once peed in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要知道那么多
sense_groups.english: I didn't need to know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想 21岁是很大的差距
sense_groups.english: I guess 21 years is a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我比你老了整整一个允许饮酒的年龄
sense_groups.english: I mean, hell, I'm a whole person who can drink older than you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该… - 对
sense_groups.english: So maybe we should just... - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样感觉很糟
sense_groups.english: This really sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it sure does.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必现在做决定吧？
sense_groups.english: Uh, we don't really have to decide anything right now, do we?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真的不急
sense_groups.english: No, there's no rush or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨送来了 - 我要杀了那些家伙
sense_groups.english: Pizza delivery! - Oh, I'm gonna kill those guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 喔
sense_groups.english: Rach? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都弄好了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I'm done. Ah. - Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你知道吗？索端汀诺也关门了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, you know what? So is, uh, Sorentino's.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我们… 我们找别的地方吃饭吧？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Let's, uh... Why don't we find someplace else?

sense_groups.chinese: 已经很晚 餐厅全都打烊了 我们可以改天再一起吃饭
sense_groups.english: It's late. Everything will be closed. We'll do it another night.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们不必那样
sense_groups.english: No, no, we won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: We won't?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我来
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那已经死了吧？
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's dead, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么一回事？我们要做什么？ - 嘘
sense_groups.english: What is this? What are we doing? - Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要蔓越莓加苹果或葡萄？ - 葡萄
sense_groups.english: Do you want Cran-Apple or Cran-Grape? - Grape.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay, now...

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐
sense_groups.english: sit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 数十亿年前 地球只是…
sense_groups.english: Billions ofyears ago, Earth was...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在看什么？
sense_groups.english: Ah. So, what are we looking at?

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到那个大星云 旁边的小星云了吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, you see that little cluster of stars next to the big one?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是大熊座
sense_groups.english: That is Ursa Major.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 不知道 有可能
sense_groups.english: Really? - No idea. It could be. Could be.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 很抱歉今晚我必须工作
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm sorry I had to work tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你值得我等待 - 喔
sense_groups.english: You were worth the wait. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不只是指今晚
sense_groups.english: And I don't just mean tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有笑
sense_groups.english: You're not laughing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次一点都不好笑
sense_groups.english: This time it's not so funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Aah! - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 先把领带解开
sense_groups.english: Okay, loosen the knot. Loosen the knot.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Aah! Oh, God! Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是压到果汁盒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. You just rolled over the juice box.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 早
sense_groups.english: Hey, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信我会在你身边醒过来
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm waking up next to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 真的很不可…
sense_groups.english: I know. It is pretty unbel...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 还有别人在
sense_groups.english: What? - We're not alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是火灾警报吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Is that the fire alarm? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 地板是冷的 我们还有时间
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's not warm yet. We still have time.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 - 对 酷啊
sense_groups.english: Cool. - Yeah, yeah. Cool!

questions.name: S02E16
questions.en:
Man, this is weird.
Ever realize Cap'n Crunch's eyebrows are on his hat?
That's what's weird?
The man's been captain of a cereal for 40 years.
Whoa, yuck!
What?
The spoon! You licked and you put.
You licked and you put.
Yeah, so?
Don't you see how gross that is? It's like you using my toothbrush!
You used my toothbrush?
Only because I used the red one to unclog the drain.
Mine is the red one!
Oh, God! Can open. Worms everywhere!
Why can't we use the same toothbrush...
but we can use the same soap?
Because soap is soap. It's self-cleaning.
The next time you shower...
think about the last thing I wash and the first thing you wash.
∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮
∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮
∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮
∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮
∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮
∮ but I'll be there for you ∮
∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ Like I've been there before ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮
Hey. - Hey.
Look at you fancy lads!
What's the occasion?
You know that guy on my show that's in a coma?
He's having a brunch.
Ready when you are.
I can't believe you're actually getting tattoos.
You guys are getting tattoos?
But you cannot tell Ross because I wanna surprise him.
Wow, this is wild! What are you gonna get?
I'm getting a lily.
For my mom, because her name's Lily.
That's lucky. What if her name was Big Ugly Splotch?
Where you getting it? - On my shoulder.
What?
What's on your shoulder?
A chip.
A tattoo. I'm getting a tattoo. - A tattoo?
Why? Why would you wanna do that?
Hi. - Hi.
You don't think they're kind of cool?
No. Sorry, I don't.
Why would anyone pay someone to scar their body for life?
What if it doesn't come out right?
It's like having a bad haircut all the time.
Why is everyone staring at me?
Sign this card for Dad. Richard will be here soon.
Richard's going to the party too?
He's my parents' best friend. He has to go.
So is today the day you'll tell them about you two?
Yeah, for my dad's birthday, I decided to give him a stroke.
No, I think you should tell them.
I don't know how serious he is. Until I do, I won't say anything.
I don't think Mom and Dad would mind.
Remember when you were 9 and Richard was 30, Dad said
"God, I hope they get together."
Shall we?
Okay, wait.
You know what?
Ross, let's switch places. You get in the middle.
This looks like we're trying to cover something up.
You could come in straddling him, they still wouldn't believe it.
We're here!
Hi, kids! - The children!
Happy birthday, Dad. - Thank you.
Happy birthday!
So you kids thanked Dr. Burke for the ride?
Actually, Mom, I think Monica thanked him for the both of us.
So you kids take the train in?
No, Richard Burke gave them a ride.
Speaking of whom...
I hear he's got some 20-year-old twinkie in the city.
Finger cramp! Oh, God!
Sorry. Here, let me get that, Mom.
So Richard's shopping in the junior section?
Are we still on that?
You just know she's got the IQ of a napkin.
She's probably not even pretty.
Just young enough so that everything is still pointing up.
Can you believe this place?
I know. This is a great apartment.
In the bathroom there's mirrors on both sides of you.
When you're in there, it's like peeing with the Rockettes.
Well, there's my fantasy come true.
Seriously.
Hey.
We were just saying, great apartment!
Thanks. You want it?
I'm moving to a bigger place.
You should take this one.
Can you see me in a place like this?
Why not? You hate park views and high ceilings?
Come on, I'll show you the kitchen.
That's all right, I saw a kitchen this morning.
On TV.
Stop talking. Okay!
Come on, tell us! - Is she really 20?
I am not telling you guys anything.
Come on, it's my birthday. Let me live vicariously!
Dad, you really don't want to do that.
What's a little midlife crisis between friends?
Would you let it go?
I know what you're going through. When I turned 50, I got the Porsche.
You got your own little speedster.
Seriously, it's not like that. - Tell you what.
Maybe one of these weekends you can borrow the car and I could...
Dad, I beg you not to finish that sentence!
What? I'm kidding!
You know I'd never let him touch the Porsche.
Okay, Rach.
Which lily? This lily or that lily?
Well, I... - I like this lily.
It's more open and that's like my mom.
She had a more open, giving spirit.
Foghorn Leghorn!
Blond girl? You're in room two.
Not-so-blond girl, you're with me.
Here we go! - Uh-huh.
You're not going.
Uh-huh.
Is this because of what Ross said?
No.
Well, yeah, maybe. - I don't believe this.
Is this how this relationship works? Ross equals boss?
Come on, what is this, 1922?
What's 1922?
Just, you know, a long time ago.
When men used to tell women what to do a lot.
Then there was suffrage, which was a good thing. But it sounds horrible.
Do you want this tattoo?
Yes, I do. It's just that Ross...
Is your boyfriend the boss of you?
No.
Who is the boss of you?
You?
No. You are the boss of you!
You march in there and get that tattoo on your hip!
Go!
How you doing?
I'm a twinkie!
Really? I'm a hero.
This is so hard.
Yeah, I know. I hate it too.
Look, maybe we should just tell them.
Maybe we should just tell your parents first.
My parents are dead.
God, you are so lucky!
I mean... Well, you know what I mean.
Just hang in there, okay?
Okay, I'll go out first, all right?
Judy! Going to the bathroom. Good for you!
Thank you, Richard. I appreciate the support.
Honey.
Seen my Harmon Killebrew bat? Bob doesn't believe I have one.
I have no idea.
Did you know Richard has a twinkie in the city?
I know. He's a new man. It's like a scene from Cocoon.
I just never would have pictured Richard with a bimbo.
He told Johnny Shapiro that she's quite a girl.
He told Johnny that he thinks he's falling in love with her.
Really? - I've never seen him this happy.
So, Jack...
ever think about trading me in for a younger model?
Of course not.
With you, it's like I've got two 25-year-olds.
Oh, Jack, stop!
Come on!
It's my birthday!
Can we drop this?
I am not interested in the guy's apartment.
Oh, please. I saw the way you were checking out his moldings.
You want it.
Why would I want another apartment?
I've already got an apartment that I love.
It wouldn't kill you to say it once in a while.
All right. You want the truth? I'm thinking about it.
What? - I'm sorry.
I'm 28. I've never lived alone...
and I'm at a place where I got enough money...
that I don't need a roommate.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. I don't need a roommate either.
I can afford to live here by myself.
I may have to bring in somebody once a week to lick the silverware.
Why are you getting so bent out of shape?
We didn't agree to live together forever.
We're not Bert and Ernie.
You know what?
If this is the way you feel...
then maybe you should take it.
That's how I feel. - Then maybe you should take it!
Maybe I will!
Fine with me! - Great!
You can spend more quality time with your real friends...
the spoons!
Whose drink can I freshen?
Almost time for cake!
Mon?
Mon, are you okay?
Remember that video of Mom and Dad? - Yeah?
Well, I just caught the live show. - Ew!
Hey there. - What?
Nothing. I just heard something nice about you.
Really?
Richard?
Your son isn't seeing anyone, is he? - Not that I know of.
I was thinking, why doesn't he give Monica a call?
That's an idea.
Well, actually, I'm already seeing someone.
Oh?
Oh...
She never tells us anything.
Ross, did you know Monica's seeing someone?
Mom, there are so many people in my life.
Some are seeing people and some aren't.
Is that crystal?
So who's the mystery man?
Well, he's a doctor.
A real doctor?
No, a doctor of meat.
Of course he's a real doctor.
And he's handsome.
And he's sweet, and I know you'd like him.
Well, that's wonderful.
Mom, it's okay.
It is, Judy.
Jack!
Could you come in here for a moment?
Now!
Found it! - I'll take that, Dad.
It seems your daughter and Richard are something of an item.
That's impossible. He's got a twinkie in the city.
I'm the twinkie.
You're the twinkie? - She's not a twinkie!
Look, this is the best relationship I've been in...
Oh, please! A relationship?
Yes, a relationship!
For your information, I'm crazy about this man.
Really?
Yes.
Am I supposed to stand here and listen to this on my birthday?
This is a good thing. You said you've never seen Richard happier.
When did I say that?
Upstairs in the bathroom, right before you felt up Mom!
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday, dear Jack
Happy birthday to you
It looks so good! Oh, I love it.
I know, so do I! I'm so glad you made me do this.
Okay, let me see yours.
Let's see yours again.
We just saw mine. Let me see yours.
Oh, no!
It's gone! That's so weird.
I don't know how, where it went.
You didn't get it?
No.
Why not?
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
How could you do this to me? This was your idea!
I know! I was gonna get it, but he came in with this needle.
And did you know they do this with needles?
Really? You don't say?
Because mine was licked on by kittens!
Hey. - Hey.
I'm sorry about what...
Yeah, me too. - I know.
Do we need to hug?
No, we're all right.
So I got you something.
Plastic spoons!
Great! - Lick away, my man!
These will go great in my new place till I get real ones.
What?
I can't use these forever. They're no friend of the environment.
No, I mean what's this about your new place?
I'm moving out, like we talked about.
I didn't think that was serious.
You know, I thought that was just a fight.
Well, it was a fight...
based on serious stuff, remember?
About how I never lived alone or anything?
I think it would be good for me. Help me to grow...
or whatever.
Well, there you go.
Hey, are you cool with this?
I don't wanna leave you high and dry.
I've never been lower or wetter.
I'll be fine. I'll just turn your...
bedroom into a game room.
Put the foosball table in there.
Why do you get to keep the table?
I did pay for half of it.
I paid for the other half.
I'll tell you what. I'll play you for it.
All right, you're on.
I can take two minutes out of my day to kick your ass.

I'm a twinkie!
Really? I'm a hero.
This is so hard.
Yeah, I know. I hate it too.
Look, maybe we should just tell them.
Maybe we should just tell your parents first.
My parents are dead.
God, you are so lucky!
I mean... Well, you know what I mean.
Just hang in there, okay?
Okay, I'll go out first, all right?
Judy! Going to the bathroom. Good for you!
Thank you, Richard. I appreciate the support.
Honey.
Seen my Harmon Killebrew bat? Bob doesn't believe I have one.
I have no idea.
Did you know Richard has a twinkie in the city?
I know. He's a new man. It's like a scene from Cocoon.
I just never would have pictured Richard with a bimbo.
He told Johnny Shapiro that she's quite a girl.
He told Johnny that he thinks he's falling in love with her.
Really? - I've never seen him this happy.
So, Jack...
ever think about trading me in for a younger model?
Of course not.
With you, it's like I've got two 25-year-olds.
Oh, Jack, stop!
Come on!
It's my birthday!
Can we drop this?
I am not interested in the guy's apartment.
Oh, please. I saw the way you were checking out his moldings.
You want it.
Why would I want another apartment?
I've already got an apartment that I love.
It wouldn't kill you to say it once in a while.
All right. You want the truth? I'm thinking about it.
What? - I'm sorry.
I'm 28. I've never lived alone...
and I'm at a place where I got enough money...
that I don't need a roommate.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. I don't need a roommate either.
I can afford to live here by myself.
I may have to bring in somebody once a week to lick the silverware.
Why are you getting so bent out of shape?
We didn't agree to live together forever.
We're not Bert and Ernie.
You know what?
If this is the way you feel...
then maybe you should take it.
That's how I feel. - Then maybe you should take it!
Maybe I will!
Fine with me! - Great!
You can spend more quality time with your real friends...
the spoons!
Whose drink can I freshen?
Almost time for cake!
Mon?
Mon, are you okay?
Remember that video of Mom and Dad? - Yeah?
Well, I just caught the live show. - Ew!
Hey there. - What?
Nothing. I just heard something nice about you.
Really?
Richard?
Your son isn't seeing anyone, is he? - Not that I know of.
I was thinking, why doesn't he give Monica a call?
That's an idea.
Well, actually, I'm already seeing someone.
Oh?
Oh...
She never tells us anything.
Ross, did you know Monica's seeing someone?
Mom, there are so many people in my life.
Some are seeing people and some aren't.
Is that crystal?
So who's the mystery man?
Well, he's a doctor.
A real doctor?
No, a doctor of meat.
Of course he's a real doctor.
And he's handsome.
And he's sweet, and I know you'd like him.
Well, that's wonderful.
Mom, it's okay.
It is, Judy.
Jack!
Could you come in here for a moment?
Now!
Found it! - I'll take that, Dad.
It seems your daughter and Richard are something of an item.
That's impossible. He's got a twinkie in the city.
I'm the twinkie.
You're the twinkie? - She's not a twinkie!
Look, this is the best relationship I've been in...
Oh, please! A relationship?
Yes, a relationship!
For your information, I'm crazy about this man.
Really?
Yes.
Am I supposed to stand here and listen to this on my birthday?
This is a good thing. You said you've never seen Richard happier.
When did I say that?
Upstairs in the bathroom, right before you felt up Mom!
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday to you
Happy birthday, dear Jack
Happy birthday to you
It looks so good! Oh, I love it.
I know, so do I! I'm so glad you made me do this.
Okay, let me see yours.
Let's see yours again.
We just saw mine. Let me see yours.
Oh, no!
It's gone! That's so weird.
I don't know how, where it went.
You didn't get it?
No.
Why not?
I'm sorry! I'm sorry!
How could you do this to me? This was your idea!
I know! I was gonna get it, but he came in with this needle.
And did you know they do this with needles?
Really? You don't say?
Because mine was licked on by kittens!
Hey. - Hey.
I'm sorry about what...
Yeah, me too. - I know.
Do we need to hug?
No, we're all right.
So I got you something.
Plastic spoons!
Great! - Lick away, my man!
These will go great in my new place till I get real ones.
What?
I can't use these forever. They're no friend of the environment.
No, I mean what's this about your new place?
I'm moving out, like we talked about.
I didn't think that was serious.
You know, I thought that was just a fight.
Well, it was a fight...
based on serious stuff, remember?
About how I never lived alone or anything?
I think it would be good for me. Help me to grow...
or whatever.
Well, there you go.
Hey, are you cool with this?
I don't wanna leave you high and dry.
I've never been lower or wetter.
I'll be fine. I'll just turn your...
bedroom into a game room.
Put the foosball table in there.
Why do you get to keep the table?
I did pay for half of it.
I paid for the other half.
I'll tell you what. I'll play you for it.
All right, you're on.
I can take two minutes out of my day to kick your ass.
Your men will get scored on more times than your sister.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!
Which sister?
So are you sorry that I told them?
No. It's been a long time since your dad and I went running.
Did you get it?
Is Ross here? - He went out for pizza.
Okay, really quick.
That's great!
Very tasteful.
Wanna see mine? Wanna see mine? - Yes!
What? You didn't get one.
Okay. Well then, what is this?
What are we looking at?
That blue freckle?
That's my tattoo.
That is not a tattoo. That is a nothing.
I got her in the chair...
he barely touched her with the needle, she screamed and that was it.
Okay, hi!
For your information, this is exactly what I wanted.
This is a tattoo of the Earth as seen from a great, great distance.
It's the way my mother sees me from heaven.
Oh, what a load of crap!
That is a dot!
Your mother's in heaven going, "Where the hell's my lily, you wuss!"
That is not a tattoo! This is a tattoo!
You got a tattoo?
Maybe.
But just a little one. Phoebe got the whole world!
Well, let me see.
Well?
Well, it's really...
sexy.
I wouldn't have thought it would be, but...
wow!
Really?
Yeah, so...
So is it sore? Or can you do stuff?
I guess.
Save us some pizza.
Get it out of the corner!
Pass it! Pass it!
Stop talking to your men!
Yes!
And the table is mine.
Congratulations.
You guys will still come visit me, right?
Oh, yeah! You got the big TV.
We'll be over there all the time.
Except when we are here.
I know you're just moving uptown, but I'll really miss you.
How can you not be across the hall anymore?
Who's gonna eat all of our food and tie up our phone lines...
Is that my bra?
What are you doing with my bra? - It's not what you think.
We used it to fling water balloons off the roof.
Remember? Those kids couldn't even get theirs across the street.
Yeah, I remember.
Let's bring the rest of these down to the truck.
You want me to...
give you a hand with the foosball table?
Nah...
You keep it. You need the practice.
Thanks.
So...
I guess this is it.
Yeah, right.
I guess so.
Listen...
When am I gonna see you?
I'm guessing tonight at the coffeehouse.
Right. Yeah. Okay.
Take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这好奇怪
sense_groups.english: Man, this is weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有发现脆脆船长的眉毛长在他的帽子上？
sense_groups.english: Ever realize Cap'n Crunch's eyebrows are on his hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是奇怪的地方？
sense_groups.english: That's what's weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 那人当了40年的早餐谷片船长
sense_groups.english: The man's been captain of a cereal for 40 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真恶心
sense_groups.english: Whoa, yuck!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 汤匙 你舔过后放回去
sense_groups.english: The spoon! You licked and you put.

sense_groups.chinese: 你舔过后放回去
sense_groups.english: You licked and you put.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没发现这有多恶心吗？那等于是你用我的牙刷
sense_groups.english: Don't you see how gross that is? It's like you using my toothbrush!

sense_groups.chinese: 你用过我的牙刷？
sense_groups.english: You used my toothbrush?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为 我用红色那根通排水孔
sense_groups.english: Only because I used the red one to unclog the drain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的是红色那根
sense_groups.english: Mine is the red one!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 揭开封印 到处有鬼
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! Can open. Worms everywhere!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不能用同一根牙刷
sense_groups.english: Why can't we use the same toothbrush...

sense_groups.chinese: 却能用同一块香皂？
sense_groups.english: but we can use the same soap?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为香皂是香皂 那会自我清洁
sense_groups.english: Because soap is soap. It's self-cleaning.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次你洗澡时…
sense_groups.english: The next time you shower...

sense_groups.chinese: 想想我最后洗什么 而你最先洗什么
sense_groups.english: think about the last thing I wash and the first thing you wash.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人告诉你活着有多累
sense_groups.english: ∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘
sense_groups.english: ∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累
sense_groups.english: ∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 日复一日 年复一年
sense_groups.english: ∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 时运不济 活着受罪
sense_groups.english: ∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ but I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 纵有狂风暴雨
sense_groups.english: ∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 支持一如往昔
sense_groups.english: ∮ Like I've been there before ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我永不离弃
sense_groups.english: ∮ I'll be there for you ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 你我相偎相依
sense_groups.english: ∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们这些型男
sense_groups.english: Look at you fancy lads!

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么场合？
sense_groups.english: What's the occasion?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我的电视剧里那个演昏迷不醒的人吗？
sense_groups.english: You know that guy on my show that's in a coma?

sense_groups.chinese: 他要请我吃早午餐
sense_groups.english: He's having a brunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 就等你了
sense_groups.english: Ready when you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信你们居然要刺青
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're actually getting tattoos.

sense_groups.chinese: 打个岔 你们要刺青？
sense_groups.english: You guys are getting tattoos?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但你不能告诉罗斯 因为我想给他惊喜
sense_groups.english: But you cannot tell Ross because I wanna surprise him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好狂放 你要刺什么？
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is wild! What are you gonna get?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要刺一朵百合
sense_groups.english: I'm getting a lily.

sense_groups.chinese: 纪念我妈 因为她叫百合
sense_groups.english: For my mom, because her name's Lily.

sense_groups.chinese: 运气真好 假如她叫丑大污点呢？
sense_groups.english: That's lucky. What if her name was Big Ugly Splotch?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想刺在哪里？ - 我肩膀上
sense_groups.english: Where you getting it? - On my shoulder.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么在你肩膀上？
sense_groups.english: What's on your shoulder?

sense_groups.chinese: 皮包
sense_groups.english: A chip.

sense_groups.chinese: 刺青 我要去刺青 - 刺青？
sense_groups.english: A tattoo. I'm getting a tattoo. - A tattoo?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？你为何要这么做？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why would you wanna do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得刺青蛮酷的？
sense_groups.english: You don't think they're kind of cool?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 抱歉 我不觉得
sense_groups.english: No. Sorry, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 为何有人要付钱请师傅 在身上留下一辈子的伤痕？
sense_groups.english: Why would anyone pay someone to scar their body for life?

sense_groups.chinese: 假如刺得不对劲呢 菲比？
sense_groups.english: What if it doesn't come out right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就像老是顶着剪坏的发型
sense_groups.english: It's like having a bad haircut all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么大家都盯着我看？
sense_groups.english: Why is everyone staring at me?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 过来签给爸的生日卡 理查快要来了
sense_groups.english: Sign this card for Dad. Richard will be here soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查也要参加派对？
sense_groups.english: Richard's going to the party too?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我父母最好的朋友 他非得到场不可
sense_groups.english: He's my parents' best friend. He has to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你打算今天告诉他们你们的事吗？
sense_groups.english: So is today the day you'll tell them about you two?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我决定送我爸中风当他的生日礼物
sense_groups.english: Yeah, for my dad's birthday, I decided to give him a stroke.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想你应该告诉他们
sense_groups.english: No, I think you should tell them.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不知道他对我有多认真 在知道前 我什么都不说
sense_groups.english: I don't know how serious he is. Until I do, I won't say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 很难说 我不认为爸妈会在意
sense_groups.english: I don't think Mom and Dad would mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得你9岁 理查30岁时 爸爸老是说…
sense_groups.english: Remember when you were 9 and Richard was 30, Dad said

sense_groups.chinese: "天啊 真希望他们在一起"
sense_groups.english: "God, I hope they get together."

sense_groups.chinese: 可以进了吗
sense_groups.english: Shall we?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 等一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们换位子 你在中间
sense_groups.english: Ross, let's switch places. You get in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样看起来像是我们想隐瞒什么
sense_groups.english: This looks like we're trying to cover something up.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 就算你你骑着他进去 他们还是不会相信
sense_groups.english: You could come in straddling him, they still wouldn't believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到了
sense_groups.english: We're here!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 孩子们 - 小孩到了
sense_groups.english: Hi, kids! - The children!

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 爸 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, Dad. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个谢过柏克医生载你们吗？
sense_groups.english: So you kids thanked Dr. Burke for the ride?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 妈 我想摩妮卡代我们两人谢过他了
sense_groups.english: Actually, Mom, I think Monica thanked him for the both of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是坐火车来的？
sense_groups.english: So you kids take the train in?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 理查·柏克载他们来的
sense_groups.english: No, Richard Burke gave them a ride.

sense_groups.chinese: 提到他啊…
sense_groups.english: Speaking of whom...

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说他在城里 跟20岁的无脑嫩妹在交往
sense_groups.english: I hear he's got some 20-year-old twinkie in the city.

sense_groups.chinese: 手指抽筋 天啊
sense_groups.english: Finger cramp! Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 来 我来清 妈
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Here, let me get that, Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以说理查在青少年区购物？
sense_groups.english: So Richard's shopping in the junior section?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还在提那码子事？
sense_groups.english: Are we still on that?

sense_groups.chinese: 想也知道她的智商 跟餐巾纸一样高
sense_groups.english: You just know she's got the IQ of a napkin.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说不定连漂亮都算不上
sense_groups.english: She's probably not even pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是够年轻 所以一切都还坚挺
sense_groups.english: Just young enough so that everything is still pointing up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信这地方吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe this place?

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 这间公寓真棒
sense_groups.english: I know. This is a great apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚上过洗手间 两侧都装了镜子
sense_groups.english: In the bathroom there's mirrors on both sides of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在上时 好像跟火箭女郎一起尿尿
sense_groups.english: When you're in there, it's like peeing with the Rockettes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的幻想成真了
sense_groups.english: Well, there's my fantasy come true.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是说真的
sense_groups.english: Seriously.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正好说到这间公寓真棒
sense_groups.english: We were just saying, great apartment!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你想租吗？
sense_groups.english: Thanks. You want it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要搬到更大的地方
sense_groups.english: I'm moving to a bigger place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该租下这间
sense_groups.english: You should take this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能想像我住这种地方吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you see me in a place like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 有何不可？你讨厌公园景观和挑高天花板吗？
sense_groups.english: Why not? You hate park views and high ceilings?

sense_groups.chinese: 来 我带你参观厨房
sense_groups.english: Come on, I'll show you the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我今天早上看过一间厨房
sense_groups.english: That's all right, I saw a kitchen this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 在电视上
sense_groups.english: On TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 别讲话了 好吧
sense_groups.english: Stop talking. Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 告诉我们 - 她真的20岁吗？
sense_groups.english: Come on, tell us! - Is she really 20?

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么也不告诉你们
sense_groups.english: I am not telling you guys anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 理查 今天是我生日 让我想像过那种生活的滋味
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's my birthday. Let me live vicariously!

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 你真的不该这么做
sense_groups.english: Dad, you really don't want to do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 朋友之间谈论下中年危机又怎样？
sense_groups.english: What's a little midlife crisis between friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 你别逼问好吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you let it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的心路历程 我满50岁时 买了保时捷
sense_groups.english: I know what you're going through. When I turned 50, I got the Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 你则得到自己的"小跑车"
sense_groups.english: You got your own little speedster.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 不是那样 - 我告诉你
sense_groups.english: Seriously, it's not like that. - Tell you what.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许找个周末 你可以借我的车 而我可以…
sense_groups.english: Maybe one of these weekends you can borrow the car and I could...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我恳求你别把话讲完
sense_groups.english: Dad, I beg you not to finish that sentence!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我只是开玩笑
sense_groups.english: What? I'm kidding!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我绝不会让他碰那辆保时捷
sense_groups.english: You know I'd never let him touch the Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Okay, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一种百合？这种百合还是那种百合？
sense_groups.english: Which lily? This lily or that lily?

sense_groups.chinese: 我… - 我喜欢这种百合
sense_groups.english: Well, I... - I like this lily.

sense_groups.chinese: 那绽放得更灿烂 就像我妈
sense_groups.english: It's more open and that's like my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有更开放而奉献的精神
sense_groups.english: She had a more open, giving spirit.

sense_groups.chinese: 莱亨鸡
sense_groups.english: Foghorn Leghorn!

sense_groups.chinese: 金发女？你到二号房
sense_groups.english: Blond girl? You're in room two.

sense_groups.chinese: 没那么金发女 你跟我来
sense_groups.english: Not-so-blond girl, you're with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 要开始了 - 恩
sense_groups.english: Here we go! - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去
sense_groups.english: You're not going.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯-哼
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟罗斯说的话有关吗？
sense_groups.english: Is this because of what Ross said?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吧 也许 - 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, maybe. - I don't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你谈这段恋爱都要这样吗？罗斯等于老板？
sense_groups.english: Is this how this relationship works? Ross equals boss?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 什么年代了 还是1922年吗？
sense_groups.english: Come on, what is this, 1922?

sense_groups.chinese: 1922年怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's 1922?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是指很久以前
sense_groups.english: Just, you know, a long time ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个年代的男人经常指使女人
sense_groups.english: When men used to tell women what to do a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后有了投票权 这是好事 不过听起来很糟糕
sense_groups.english: Then there was suffrage, which was a good thing. But it sounds horrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要刺青吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want this tattoo?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想 只是罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Yes, I do. It's just that Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的男友是你老板吗？
sense_groups.english: Is your boyfriend the boss of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的老板是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who is the boss of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你？
sense_groups.english: You?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你是你自己的老板
sense_groups.english: No. You are the boss of you!

sense_groups.chinese: 大摇大摆走进去 在臀部刺上那刺青
sense_groups.english: You march in there and get that tattoo on your hip!

sense_groups.chinese: 去
sense_groups.english: Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我成了无脑嫩妹
sense_groups.english: I'm a twinkie!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？我成了英雄
sense_groups.english: Really? I'm a hero.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真难应付
sense_groups.english: This is so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂 我也讨厌这样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. I hate it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 也许我们该对他们直说
sense_groups.english: Look, maybe we should just tell them.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我们该先告诉你父母
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should just tell your parents first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我父母都过世了
sense_groups.english: My parents are dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你真好运
sense_groups.english: God, you are so lucky!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说… 你懂我的意思
sense_groups.english: I mean... Well, you know what I mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 撑下去 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Just hang in there, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我先出去 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll go out first, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 茱蒂 你想上洗手间 真不错
sense_groups.english: Judy! Going to the bathroom. Good for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 理查 感谢你的支持
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Richard. I appreciate the support.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到我的哈蒙基勒博球棒了吗？劳勃不相信我有
sense_groups.english: Seen my Harmon Killebrew bat? Bob doesn't believe I have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道理查在城内 交了个无脑嫩妹吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know Richard has a twinkie in the city?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 他焕然一新 像是电影《魔茧》的情景
sense_groups.english: I know. He's a new man. It's like a scene from Cocoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是无法想像 理查跟无脑辣妹在一起
sense_groups.english: I just never would have pictured Richard with a bimbo.

sense_groups.chinese: 他似乎告诉强尼夏皮洛说 她很棒
sense_groups.english: He told Johnny Shapiro that she's quite a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实他告诉强尼 他觉得自己爱上她了
sense_groups.english: He told Johnny that he thinks he's falling in love with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 我从没看过他这么快乐
sense_groups.english: Really? - I've never seen him this happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以说 杰克…
sense_groups.english: So, Jack...

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有想过 把我换成更年轻的模特儿？
sense_groups.english: ever think about trading me in for a younger model?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然没有
sense_groups.english: Of course not.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你一起 我像是交了两个25岁小妞
sense_groups.english: With you, it's like I've got two 25-year-olds.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 别这样
sense_groups.english: Oh, Jack, stop!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我生日
sense_groups.english: It's my birthday!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们别提了好吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we drop this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我对那男的公寓不感兴趣
sense_groups.english: I am not interested in the guy's apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我看到 你查看他壁饰的样子
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. I saw the way you were checking out his moldings.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要它
sense_groups.english: You want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为何想要另一间公寓？
sense_groups.english: Why would I want another apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经有我喜爱的公寓
sense_groups.english: I've already got an apartment that I love.

sense_groups.chinese: 你偶尔这么说又不会死
sense_groups.english: It wouldn't kill you to say it once in a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你想听真话？我是在考虑
sense_groups.english: All right. You want the truth? I'm thinking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 对不起
sense_groups.english: What? - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我28岁了 从来没一个人住过
sense_groups.english: I'm 28. I've never lived alone...

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在的状况是 终于拥有足够的钱
sense_groups.english: and I'm at a place where I got enough money...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不再需要室友了
sense_groups.english: that I don't need a roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不需要室友
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. I don't need a roommate either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我负担得起自己住在这里
sense_groups.english: I can afford to live here by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也许得每周带个人过来舔一次餐具
sense_groups.english: I may have to bring in somebody once a week to lick the silverware.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么这样在意？
sense_groups.english: Why are you getting so bent out of shape?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们又不是协议 要永远住在一起
sense_groups.english: We didn't agree to live together forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是布偶毕特和恩尼
sense_groups.english: We're not Bert and Ernie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 假如你是这种感觉…
sense_groups.english: If this is the way you feel...

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你该去租那间公寓
sense_groups.english: then maybe you should take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是那种感觉 - 那么也许你该租下来
sense_groups.english: That's how I feel. - Then maybe you should take it!

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我会租
sense_groups.english: Maybe I will!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不介意 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Fine with me! - Great!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样你就能花更多时间 和真正的朋友…
sense_groups.english: You can spend more quality time with your real friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 汤匙相处
sense_groups.english: the spoons!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁需要我补充饮料？
sense_groups.english: Whose drink can I freshen?

sense_groups.chinese: 快要切蛋糕了
sense_groups.english: Almost time for cake!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩？
sense_groups.english: Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Mon, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得我发现 爸妈做那档事的影片吗？ - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Remember that video of Mom and Dad? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚亲临真人秀 - 呃
sense_groups.english: Well, I just caught the live show. - Ew!

sense_groups.chinese: 你呀… - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Hey there. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我刚听说你的好事
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I just heard something nice about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 理查
sense_groups.english: Richard?

sense_groups.chinese: 你儿子没在跟人交往 对吧？ - 就我所知没有
sense_groups.english: Your son isn't seeing anyone, is he? - Not that I know of.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想 他能不能 打个电话给摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: I was thinking, why doesn't he give Monica a call?

sense_groups.chinese: 这算是一个点子
sense_groups.english: That's an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我已经在跟别人交往
sense_groups.english: Well, actually, I'm already seeing someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔？
sense_groups.english: Oh?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 她什么都不告诉我们
sense_groups.english: She never tells us anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你知道 摩妮卡在跟人约会吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, did you know Monica's seeing someone?

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 我生命中有好多人
sense_groups.english: Mom, there are so many people in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人有在约会 有些人没有
sense_groups.english: Some are seeing people and some aren't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是水晶吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that crystal?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个神秘男子是谁？
sense_groups.english: So who's the mystery man?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个医生
sense_groups.english: Well, he's a doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 真正的医生？
sense_groups.english: A real doctor?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是肉类医生
sense_groups.english: No, a doctor of meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 他当然是真的医生
sense_groups.english: Of course he's a real doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他很英俊
sense_groups.english: And he's handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 很体贴 我知道你会喜欢他
sense_groups.english: And he's sweet, and I know you'd like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's wonderful.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 没关系
sense_groups.english: Mom, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 茱蒂
sense_groups.english: It is, Judy.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克
sense_groups.english: Jack!

sense_groups.chinese: 你能进来一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you come in here for a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 马上
sense_groups.english: Now!

sense_groups.chinese: 找到了 - 我拿着 爸
sense_groups.english: Found it! - I'll take that, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来你女儿和理查算是凑成一对
sense_groups.english: It seems your daughter and Richard are something of an item.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 他在城里交了个嫩妹
sense_groups.english: That's impossible. He's got a twinkie in the city.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我就是那嫩妹
sense_groups.english: I'm the twinkie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是那嫩妹？ - 她不是无脑嫩妹
sense_groups.english: You're the twinkie? - She's not a twinkie!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 这是我长久以来 最棒的恋情…
sense_groups.english: Look, this is the best relationship I've been in...

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 恋情？
sense_groups.english: Oh, please! A relationship?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 恋情
sense_groups.english: Yes, a relationship!

sense_groups.chinese: 顺带告诉你们 我为这男人痴狂
sense_groups.english: For your information, I'm crazy about this man.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该在我生日当天 站着听这种事吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I supposed to stand here and listen to this on my birthday?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 这对我是件好事 你自己说没见过理查这么快乐过
sense_groups.english: This is a good thing. You said you've never seen Richard happier.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么时候说的？
sense_groups.english: When did I say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 在楼上浴室里 就在你对妈妈毛手毛脚前
sense_groups.english: Upstairs in the bathroom, right before you felt up Mom!

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday to you

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday to you

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐 亲爱的杰克
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, dear Jack

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday to you

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来好漂亮 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: It looks so good! Oh, I love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我也喜欢 真高兴你强迫我刺青
sense_groups.english: I know, so do I! I'm so glad you made me do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 让我看你的
sense_groups.english: Okay, let me see yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再来看你
sense_groups.english: Let's see yours again.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们刚看过我的 让我看你的
sense_groups.english: We just saw mine. Let me see yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 消失了 真奇怪
sense_groups.english: It's gone! That's so weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道它怎么会无影无踪
sense_groups.english: I don't know how, where it went.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没刺青？
sense_groups.english: You didn't get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 没
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么没有？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry! I'm sorry!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可以这样对我？这都是你的主意
sense_groups.english: How could you do this to me? This was your idea!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我本来要刺 但是他拿着这种针头出现
sense_groups.english: I know! I was gonna get it, but he came in with this needle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他们用针头干嘛？
sense_groups.english: And did you know they do this with needles?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？不会吧？
sense_groups.english: Really? You don't say?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我的是由猫咪舔上去的
sense_groups.english: Because mine was licked on by kittens!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about what...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也是 - 我懂
sense_groups.english: Yeah, me too. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要抱抱吗？
sense_groups.english: Do we need to hug?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们没事
sense_groups.english: No, we're all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我准备了东西要给你
sense_groups.english: So I got you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 塑胶汤匙
sense_groups.english: Plastic spoons!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 任你舔 我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Great! - Lick away, my man!

sense_groups.chinese: 在我买真正的汤匙之前 很适合在我的新家使用
sense_groups.english: These will go great in my new place till I get real ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能老是使用这种东西 这对环境不友善
sense_groups.english: I can't use these forever. They're no friend of the environment.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说你的什么新家？
sense_groups.english: No, I mean what's this about your new place?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要搬出去 我们讨论过了
sense_groups.english: I'm moving out, like we talked about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为那不是认真的
sense_groups.english: I didn't think that was serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为那只是拌个嘴
sense_groups.english: You know, I thought that was just a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是拌嘴
sense_groups.english: Well, it was a fight...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是话题是认真的 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: based on serious stuff, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 有关我从来没一个人住？
sense_groups.english: About how I never lived alone or anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这样对我有益 能帮助我成长…
sense_groups.english: I think it would be good for me. Help me to grow...

sense_groups.chinese: 有的没的
sense_groups.english: or whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就这样吧
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以接受吧？
sense_groups.english: Hey, are you cool with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想害你进退两难
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna leave you high and dry.

sense_groups.chinese: 进退对我一向都不难
sense_groups.english: I've never been lower or wetter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会没事的 我要把你的…
sense_groups.english: I'll be fine. I'll just turn your...

sense_groups.chinese: 卧室改成游戏间
sense_groups.english: bedroom into a game room.

sense_groups.chinese: 把手足球桌摆进去
sense_groups.english: Put the foosball table in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么是你保留这桌子？
sense_groups.english: Why do you get to keep the table?

sense_groups.chinese: 我出了一半的钱买下
sense_groups.english: I did pay for half of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 另外一半是我出的
sense_groups.english: I paid for the other half.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你 我们用比赛决定
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what. I'll play you for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 跟你拼了
sense_groups.english: All right, you're on.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我能抽个两分钟修理你
sense_groups.english: I can take two minutes out of my day to kick your ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得的分 会比你妹被上过的次数还多
sense_groups.english: Your men will get scored on more times than your sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 哇 哇 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个妹妹？
sense_groups.english: Which sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会难过我告诉他们了吗？
sense_groups.english: So are you sorry that I told them?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你爸和我很久没去跑步了
sense_groups.english: No. It's been a long time since your dad and I went running.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们刺了吗？让我看
sense_groups.english: Did you get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯在吗？ - 他去买披萨
sense_groups.english: Is Ross here? - He went out for pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 快来秀一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, really quick.

sense_groups.chinese: 真漂亮
sense_groups.english: That's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 很有品味
sense_groups.english: Very tasteful.

sense_groups.chinese: 想看我的吗… ？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Wanna see mine? Wanna see mine? - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你又没刺青
sense_groups.english: What? You didn't get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不然这是什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well then, what is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在看什么？
sense_groups.english: What are we looking at?

sense_groups.chinese: 蓝色雀斑？
sense_groups.english: That blue freckle?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的刺青
sense_groups.english: That's my tattoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是刺青 那什么也不是
sense_groups.english: That is not a tattoo. That is a nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于押她坐回椅子上…
sense_groups.english: I got her in the chair...

sense_groups.chinese: 他还没怎么用针头刺到她 她就跳起来惨叫 就此结束
sense_groups.english: he barely touched her with the needle, she screamed and that was it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 嗨
sense_groups.english: Okay, hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 假如你们不知道 这正是我要的
sense_groups.english: For your information, this is exactly what I wanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是地球的刺青 从很远的地方看过来
sense_groups.english: This is a tattoo of the Earth as seen from a great, great distance.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我母亲从天堂看到我的样子
sense_groups.english: It's the way my mother sees me from heaven.

sense_groups.chinese: 胡说八道
sense_groups.english: Oh, what a load of crap!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一个点
sense_groups.english: That is a dot!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在天堂的母亲会说 "我的百合在哪儿？你真没种"
sense_groups.english: Your mother's in heaven going, "Where the hell's my lily, you wuss!"

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 那不是刺青 这才是刺青
sense_groups.english: That is not a tattoo! This is a tattoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 你去刺青？
sense_groups.english: You got a tattoo?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

and that's where I find the world's biggest emerald. It's really big.

forced to play soccer forever? Ugh!

and got to know each other.

Is, uh...
It's not Sean Penn.

I made these pancakes. Like, 50 pancakes.
All of a sudden, she turns to me and says, "Eddie...

ripped out my heart and smeared it all over my life!

I know.

I don't know. I don't have my jammies.
Heh.
You don't need them.
My baby sister, ladies and gentlemen.
Shut up. I'm happy.

Ahem. I just want to say...
of all the guys that Monica has been with, and that is a lot...
I like you the best. - Aw.

You hear that?
She likes me best. And apparently, there have been a lot.
Not a lot.
Phoebe's kidding. Phoebe's crazy.
Phoebe's dead.
Hi. - Hi.

Thanks.
Come on in.

Oh.

It's very thoughtful.

she's not gonna live."

which makes the writers look good. So how could they be mad?

Son of a...

it's a very small percentage. - Hey.

have you seen you?

Well, yeah. - Well, that's not bad at all.
You had me thinking it was, like, a fleet.
You're okay with it?
Oh, honey, I'm fine.
Oh, yay!
Okay, about that two.
What?
All right.
What about my two?

Don't you have a lot of wild oats to sow?

Honey, you are not an oat.
I don't know, I guess I'm just not an oat guy.

You've only slept with two people.
Right.
Wow.
Oh, wow.
You know I love you too, right?

Ugh, Ross!
Ross, please listen to me.
Ross, you are so much better for me than Paolo ever was.
You care about me, you're loving, you make me laugh.
If I make you laugh, here's an idea.

and tell knock-knock jokes. - Ross! Agh!

Not even, like...
chipmunk sex?

I have ever had.

Aah. - Hey.
Hey.
Hey. - Hey.

Let's never speak of this. - You got it.
