sense_groups.chinese: 你没有欲望到处去采花吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't you have a lot of wild oats to sow?

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在就是那样对我吗？天啊 我是花吗？
sense_groups.english: Or is that what you're doing with me? Oh, my God! Am I an oat?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 你不是花
sense_groups.english: Honey, you are not an oat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道 我不是那种采花大盗
sense_groups.english: I don't know, I guess I'm just not an oat guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只和我爱的人上床
sense_groups.english: I've only slept with women I love.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你只跟两个人睡过
sense_groups.english: You've only slept with two people.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我也爱你吧？
sense_groups.english: You know I love you too, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在知道了
sense_groups.english: Now I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ugh, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 请你听我说
sense_groups.english: Ross, please listen to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你比巴洛好太多了
sense_groups.english: Ross, you are so much better for me than Paolo ever was.

sense_groups.chinese: 你关心我 你爱我 你让我发笑
sense_groups.english: You care about me, you're loving, you make me laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样的话 我有个主意
sense_groups.english: If I make you laugh, here's an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就邀请巴洛过来野性一下 我就站在角落…
sense_groups.english: Invite Paolo to have a romp in the sack, and I'll stand in the corner...

sense_groups.chinese: 讲些笑话给你听 - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: and tell knock-knock jokes. - Ross! Agh!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 罗斯
sense_groups.english: God, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 你和我的关系很特别 巴洛和我只是…
sense_groups.english: What you and I have is special! All Paolo and I ever had was...

sense_groups.chinese: 野兽性关系？
sense_groups.english: Animal sex, animal sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: So, what are you saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间完全没有野性吗？
sense_groups.english: There's nothing between us "animal" at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 连小野兽都没有吗？
sense_groups.english: There's not even, like, um, a little animal?

sense_groups.chinese: 连…
sense_groups.english: Not even, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 花粟鼠性关系都没有？
sense_groups.english: chipmunk sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 试着听进我说的话
sense_groups.english: Try to hear me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我不会对你说谎
sense_groups.english: I... Hey. I'm not gonna lie to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟巴洛很棒 - 笑话来了
sense_groups.english: It was good with Paolo. - Knock-knock.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你和我的关系 好太多了
sense_groups.english: But what you and I have is so much better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间有温柔 有亲密 灵犀相通
sense_groups.english: We have tenderness, we have intimacy, we connect.

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的 我医誓
sense_groups.english: You know? I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 到目前为止…
sense_groups.english: This is the best...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我有过最棒的
sense_groups.english: I have ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 直到这一刻 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Until now. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查刚刚告诉我他爱我
sense_groups.english: Richard told me he loved me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 实在太棒了
sense_groups.english: Honey, that's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I know! - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是找不到… - 最上面的抽屉
sense_groups.english: I just can't find... - Top drawer.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 - 为什么？你也要吗？
sense_groups.english: Hurry. - Why? You need one too?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 找到了 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Found them! - Whoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有一个
sense_groups.english: There's only one.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Monica! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 很快就好 我们要决定一点事情
sense_groups.english: Uh, we'll be right there. We're just trying to decide something.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们只是要决定一点事情 - 很好
sense_groups.english: They're trying to decide something. - Good. Good, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…你的胡子 以前是不是不一样？
sense_groups.english: So is, um... So was your mustache... Did it used to be different?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 噢
sense_groups.english: No. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么…保持得这么整齐？
sense_groups.english: How do you, uh, you know, keep it so neat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有把小梳子 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I have a little comb. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么样的梳子？ - 胡子梳
sense_groups.english: What do you call that? - A mustache comb.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会洗你一个月的衣服
sense_groups.english: Okay, I will do your laundry for one month.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: No! - Okay, okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我会 我会…
sense_groups.english: I will, I will, I will...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会打扫两个月的公寓
sense_groups.english: I will clean the apartment for two months.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 马上给你 只要你告诉我畚箕放在哪里
sense_groups.english: I'll give this to you now, if you tell me where we keep the dustpan.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有打过越战？
sense_groups.english: So were you in Nam?

sense_groups.chinese: 剪刀 石头 布？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Rock, paper, scissors? - Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三
sense_groups.english: One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Yes! - Agh!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 好吧 去上床吧
sense_groups.english: Ah! - Fine. Go have sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 你完全搞错了
sense_groups.english: No! You have got it completely wrong!

sense_groups.chinese: 约翰萨维奇演出 《越战猎鹿人》 他没有脚
sense_groups.english: John Savage was Deer Hunter, no legs.

sense_groups.chinese: 强沃特演出《归返家园》 腿瘫痪了
sense_groups.english: Jon Voight was Coming Home, couldn't feel his legs.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 你完全搞错了 强沃特…
sense_groups.english: No, you've got it totally the other way around, my friend. Jon Voight...

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的？ - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Honey? Ahem. - What? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 进去吧 - 今晚不可能了
sense_groups.english: Shall we? - It's not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚他们做 我们可以明天再做
sense_groups.english: They're doing it tonight. We can do it tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一次的时间表 可不可以先让我看看？
sense_groups.english: Uh, in the future, if I could see the schedule beforehand...

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天早上起来时…
sense_groups.english: So when I woke up this morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 他偷走我所有鞋子的鞋垫
sense_groups.english: he'd stolen all the insoles out of my shoes!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他认为我和他的前女友上床 而且杀掉他的鱼
sense_groups.english: He thinks I slept with his ex-girlfriend and killed his fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要杀掉他的鱼？
sense_groups.english: Why would you kill his fish?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为有时候你和某人睡过以后…
sense_groups.english: Because sometimes after you sleep with someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 就得杀掉一条鱼
sense_groups.english: you have to kill a fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德…
sense_groups.english: Chandler, honey...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在可以看乔伊的节目了吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we watch Joey's show now, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 等等 他还没到
sense_groups.english: Yeah! - Wait. He's not here yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有演出 他知道情节
sense_groups.english: He's on the show, he knows what happens.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我不在乎我的问题了
sense_groups.english: I'm fine about my problem now, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 安珀…
sense_groups.english: Amber...

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要的时候 永远有我在身边…
sense_groups.english: I want you to know I'll always be there for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是你一辈子的朋友跟兄弟
sense_groups.english: as a friend and as your brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 德瑞克
sense_groups.english: Oh, Drake.

sense_groups.chinese: 辛苦的一天吧？
sense_groups.english: Hard day, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 先是医学大奖 然后是这个？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: First the medical award, now this? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是呀 我猜有人天生好运 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Some guys are just lucky, I guess. Ha, ha. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Dr. Ramoray...

sense_groups.chinese: 请到一楼急诊室报到 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: report to first floor Emergency stat. - Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: Well, then...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我得走了
sense_groups.english: I, uh, guess that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有人要进电梯吗？荷医生？王医生？
sense_groups.english: Anyone else need to go on the elevator? Dr. Horton? Dr. Wong?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他们只有说你
sense_groups.english: No, no. They only said you.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 德瑞克 - 随便啦
sense_groups.english: I love you, Drake. - Yeah, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 德瑞克 小心啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, no! - Drake, look out!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们让乔伊死掉？ - 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Did they just kill off Joey? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Now maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点开门 我们要跟你说话
sense_groups.english: Come on! Open up! We want to talk to you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想说话
sense_groups.english: I don't feel like talking!

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我们很关心你
sense_groups.english: Come on! We care about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很担心你 - 有些人得尿尿
sense_groups.english: We're worried about you. - And some of us have to pee!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾你死了 真的烂透了
sense_groups.english: Listen, sorry about your death. That really sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一看到就赶过来了 - 你怎么没跟我们说？
sense_groups.english: We came over as soon as we saw. - How could you not tell us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我希望 没有人会知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I was kind of hoping no one would ever find out.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他们有办法 让你活过来
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe they could find a way to bring you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会的 他们说尸体的大脑 已经摔得稀巴烂了
sense_groups.english: No, they said that when they found my body, my brain was so smashed in...

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一能救我的人是我
sense_groups.english: that the only doctor who could've saved me was me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还说这是某种讽刺之类的
sense_groups.english: It's supposed to be some kind of irony.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是乔伊 你不会有事的
sense_groups.english: But Joey, you're gonna be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要那个节目 那只是个蠢肥皂剧
sense_groups.english: You don't need that show. It was just a dumb soap opera.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我这辈子 最棒的事
sense_groups.english: This was the greatest thing that ever happened to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我正要说到那一点
sense_groups.english: Yes! I was going to incorporate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 摩妮卡来了 她会说句好听的
sense_groups.english: Oh, good, here's Monica. She'll have something nice to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把你的浴帘拉直了 免得发霉
sense_groups.english: Um, I straightened out your shower curtain so you won't get mildew.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？那是好事啊
sense_groups.english: What? To me, that's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有事的 你知道的
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be okay. You know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: No, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 这好像你奋斗了一辈子 追求某样东西…
sense_groups.english: It's like you work your whole life for something...

sense_groups.chinese: 当你以为你办到的时候…
sense_groups.english: and you think that when you get it...

sense_groups.chinese: 永远不会像你想像得那么好
sense_groups.english: it'll never be as good as you thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过这个是啊
sense_groups.english: But this so was.

sense_groups.chinese: 它改变了一切
sense_groups.english: It changed everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 前几天 我去申请信用卡…
sense_groups.english: Like, the other day, I got this credit card application...

sense_groups.chinese: 我竟然被预先核淮
sense_groups.english: and I was pre-approved!

sense_groups.chinese: 我这辈子从没被预先核淮过
sense_groups.english: Huh? I've never been pre-approved for anything in my life!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这样 对你有没有意义…
sense_groups.english: I don't know if this'll mean anything to you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你在我们之中 永远都是预先核淮
sense_groups.english: but you'll always be pre-approved with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 一点意义都没有
sense_groups.english: No, that means nothing to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ahh!

sense_groups.chinese: 要吃大胡桃饼吗？刚出炉的
sense_groups.english: Pecan sandy? Just made them.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是葡萄干吗？
sense_groups.english: Are these raisins?

sense_groups.chinese: 有何不可？
sense_groups.english: Uh, sure, why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 艾迪
sense_groups.english: Listen, Eddie. Um, ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想过我们目前 住在一起的情况了
sense_groups.english: I've been thinking about our living situation and, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在笑什么？
sense_groups.english: Why are you smiling?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个小惊喜 有条新的鱼
sense_groups.english: I got a little surprise. Look. There's a new fishy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把它命名为…
sense_groups.english: I named him, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 以你为名
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you know, after you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本不是条真的鱼
sense_groups.english: Well, that's not even a real fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是金鱼饼干
sense_groups.english: No, that's a Goldfish cracker.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: So, what's your point, man?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 晚安了
sense_groups.english: Okay, good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个大怪胎
sense_groups.english: You big freak of nature.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Aah. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚好冷 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Whoo. Brisk tonight. - Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事永远都不要提 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Let's never speak of this. - You got it.

I'll be all right. I'm not starting from square one.
I was Dr. Drake Ramoray on Days of our Lives.
Huh? That's got to have some kind of cachet.
Cachet? Jaunty?
Chandler gave me word-of-the-day toilet paper.
I'm gonna get some coffee.
Hey. - Hey.
Oh! So? Did you read the book?
Oh, my God. It was incredible!
Didn't it, like, totally speak to you?
Whoa, whoa, what book is this? - Oh.
Uh! You have to read this book. It's called Be Your Own Wind Keeper.
Ooh. It's about how women need to become more empowered.
And, oh! But there's wind.
And the wind can make us goddesses.
Do you know who takes our wind? Men. They just take it.
Men just take our wind?
Uh-huh. All the time. Because they are the lightning-bearers.
Wow. - Yeah.
That sounds kind of cool. It's like The Hobbit.
It is nothing like The Hobbit.
It's like reading about every relationship I've ever had.
Except for Richard.
Oh, yes. No. Richard would never steal your wind.
No. - No.
Because he's yummy. - Yes.

Oh, and the part about how they're always drinking...
from our pool of inner power.

Right there. It's like, um...
"Hello. Who wants one of my phallic-shaped man-cakes?"

Joey, look at me.
Look at me!
Do I have lipstick on my teeth?

Uh, can we get back to me?

I already got you an audition for Another World.
All right!
"Cab Driver Number 2"?

I'm not gonna do this.
Joey.
I'm gonna tell you the same thing I told Al Minza...
and his pyramid of dogs.

I'll see you.
Uh, God!
Oh, God! I mean, it's just so...

but it would've made a nice gift for you.
Hey, you guys. - Hey.
Uh, sweetie, we've gotta go.
No!
No? Heh.

Actually, it's the movie theater that has the timetable.

This isn't about the movie theater. This is about you stealing my wind.
You go, girl!
I can't pull that off, can I?

have a problem with that.

I'm sorry.

I don't have to apologize.

and some sacred pool.

sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他是帅哥 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Because he's yummy. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 但其他男人就会
sense_groups.english: But all the other ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一段描述他们不断地吸干
sense_groups.english: Oh, and the part about how they're always drinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的内心力量
sense_groups.english: from our pool of inner power.

sense_groups.chinese: 但上帝禁止我们使用内心力量
sense_groups.english: But God forbid we should take a sip.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要吃油条？
sense_groups.english: Anybody want a cruller?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是闪电人的典型作法
sense_groups.english: This is a typical lightning-bearer thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那像是…
sense_groups.english: Right there. It's like, um...

sense_groups.chinese: "谁要吃我的老二形状蛋糕"？
sense_groups.english: "Hello. Who wants one of my phallic-shaped man-cakes?"

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 情况很不错
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it, already! Things happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你不气我被开除？
sense_groups.english: So you're not mad at me for getting fired and everything?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 看着我
sense_groups.english: Joey, look at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 看着我
sense_groups.english: Look at me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的牙齿沾到口红了吗？
sense_groups.english: Do I have lipstick on my teeth?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能继续谈我的问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, can we get back to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 在这一行常有人被开除
sense_groups.english: Look, honey. People get fired left and right in this business.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经帮你争取到 《未来日记》试镜机会
sense_groups.english: I already got you an audition for Another World.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: All right!

sense_groups.chinese: "二号计程车司机"？
sense_groups.english: "Cab Driver Number 2"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我演过德瑞克雷莫端医生
sense_groups.english: But... But I was Dr. Drake Ramoray!

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么从神经外科医生 变成开计程车的？
sense_groups.english: How can I go from being a neurosurgeon to driving a cab?

sense_groups.chinese: 时代会改变 接受吧
sense_groups.english: Things change. Roll with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这个角色只有两句台词
sense_groups.english: But this is a two-line part!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是在退步
sense_groups.english: It's like taking a step backwards.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要这份工作
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说的话就像我跟阿尔明查
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna tell you the same thing I told Al Minza...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有他的狗狗金字塔说的话一样
sense_groups.english: and his pyramid of dogs.

sense_groups.chinese: 有工作就做 别在地上大便
sense_groups.english: Take any job you can get, and don't make on the floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Uh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我是说它真的…
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! I mean, it's just so...

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 这像是在看我的一生
sense_groups.english: Uh. This is like reading about my own life!

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书应该叫 《做你自己的追风人 瑞秋》
sense_groups.english: This book could have been called Be Your Own Wind Keeper, Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然会卖不了一百万本
sense_groups.english: It wouldn't have sold a million copies...

sense_groups.chinese: 但那会是送你很不错的礼物
sense_groups.english: but it would've made a nice gift for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我们该走了
sense_groups.english: Uh, sweetie, we've gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不？
sense_groups.english: No? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 为什么我们总得 照你的时间表来做事？
sense_groups.english: No! Why do we always have to do everything according to your timetable?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上那是电影院的时间表
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's the movie theater that has the timetable.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样你才不会错过开头
sense_groups.english: It's so you don't miss the beginning.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这跟电影院无关 问题是你抢走我的风了
sense_groups.english: This isn't about the movie theater. This is about you stealing my wind.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 好姊妹
sense_groups.english: You go, girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 我做得很不像吧？
sense_groups.english: I can't pull that off, can I?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你的风？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, your wind?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我的风
sense_groups.english: Yes, my wind.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不让我吹 又怎么能期待成长？
sense_groups.english: How do you expect me to grow if you won't let me blow?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我…
sense_groups.english: You know I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以接受你那么做
sense_groups.english: have a problem with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我需要独处一下
sense_groups.english: I just really need to be with myself right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 - 你们说的对
sense_groups.english: Mm, mm, mm. - Uh, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不必道歉
sense_groups.english: I don't have to apologize.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 该死
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What is it? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面提到风跟树
sense_groups.english: It's got all this stuff about wind and trees...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有圣池
sense_groups.english: and some sacred pool.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不懂 但她似乎非常生气
sense_groups.english: I don't really get it. But she's pretty upset about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我不跟会看书的女人约会
sense_groups.english: This is why I don't date women who read.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哦
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What? What's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的信用卡帐单
sense_groups.english: It's my VISA bill.

sense_groups.chinese: 一式两联
sense_groups.english: Envelope one of two.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不会是好事 - 快打开
sense_groups.english: That can't be good. - Open it, open it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这个 我怎么会花这么多钱？
sense_groups.english: Look at this! How did I spend so much money?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 那是最低应缴额度 总额在那边
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's just the minimum amount. That's your total.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 在"原野瓷器"刷了三千五？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa. Thirty-five hundred dollars at "Porcelain Safari"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的动物们
sense_groups.english: My animals.

sense_groups.chinese: 店员说它们很适合我 他说起话来有口音 我很困惑
sense_groups.english: The guy said they suited me. He spoke with an accent. I was confused.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to do!

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以开始 在《未来日记》开计程车
sense_groups.english: You can start by driving a cab on Another World.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 那个试镜机会？
sense_groups.english: What? - That audition?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个角色只有两句台词
sense_groups.english: That's a two-line part!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在"我爱透明塑胶玻璃"欠下一千一百块
sense_groups.english: Joey, you owe $1100 at "I Love Lucite."

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎么样？ - 接受吧
sense_groups.english: So what? - So suck it up, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是工作 可以赚钱
sense_groups.english: It's a job. It's money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要你变得爱批评 高傲又爱卖弄学问
sense_groups.english: I don't need you getting judgmental and condescending and pedantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 来自卫生纸？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Toilet paper? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是那样的人 我只是很现实
sense_groups.english: I'm not being any of those things. I'm being realistic.

sense_groups.chinese: 不必了 你应该是我的朋友 - 我是你的朋友
sense_groups.english: You're supposed to be my friend! - I am your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你该跟我说"你会没事的"
sense_groups.english: Then tell me things like, "You'll be fine."

sense_groups.chinese: "你一定会出头的 我知道"
sense_groups.english: And "Something big's gonna come along. I know it!"

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的不知道
sense_groups.english: But I don't know it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道你在"漂亮着色"欠下两千三百块钱
sense_groups.english: What I do know is you owe $2300 at "Isn't It Chromantic?"

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我知道我欠了多少钱
sense_groups.english: I'm aware of what I owe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得有点理智 你等了十年才找到那份工作
sense_groups.english: Then get some sense. It took you 10 years to get that job.

sense_groups.chinese: 下份工作又得等多久呢？ - 我不想听
sense_groups.english: How long till you get another? - I don't want to hear this!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是说…
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 别"只是说"
sense_groups.english: Well, don't "just say"!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该先离开
sense_groups.english: Oh. Maybe I should just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 考虑一下
sense_groups.english: Just think about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要考虑
sense_groups.english: I don't need to think about it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是德瑞克雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: I was Dr. Drake Ramoray!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是重要角色
sense_groups.english: That was huge!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的大好机会一定会出现 等着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: Big things are gonna happen! You'll see!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在吗？
sense_groups.english: You still there?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 朋友 - 噢 天呐
sense_groups.english: Hey, pal. - Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you still doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮蔬菜跟水果脱水
sense_groups.english: Uh, just some basic dehydrating of fruits and vegetables.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Man alive, this thing's fantastic!

sense_groups.chinese: 艾迪 你是不是忘了什么？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you forgetting anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我帮我们买了新金鱼
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I got us a new goldfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 他比上一只金鱼还有活力
sense_groups.english: He's feistier than the last one.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许因为上一只金鱼 是培珀莉饼干做的
sense_groups.english: Maybe because the last one was made by Pepperidge Farm.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾迪 你是不是忘了做什么事？
sense_groups.english: Eddie, isn't there something else you're supposed to be doing now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 除非它跟脱水有关
sense_groups.english: Not unless it's got something to do with dehydrating.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为现在我是脱水迷
sense_groups.english: Because right now, I'm a dehydrating maniac!

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我们说好了
sense_groups.english: I thought we had a deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我回来时… - 呃
sense_groups.english: I thought by the time I got... - Uh, uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道这是什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what that is?

sense_groups.chinese: 你前室友的肾脏？
sense_groups.english: Your last roommate's kidney?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是蕃茄
sense_groups.english: That's a tomato. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这应该拿出来公开展示
sense_groups.english: This one definitely goes in the display.

sense_groups.chinese: 这需要公开展示
sense_groups.english: It's in the display.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 我要外带一杯柠檬汁
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther. Let me get a, uh, lemonade to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 柠檬汁？
sense_groups.english: Lemonade?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: You okay, man?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是事业遇到瓶颈
sense_groups.english: Ahh, it's career stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们将我在影集里的角色赐死
sense_groups.english: They killed off my character on the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太可惜了 他们是怎么做的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's too bad. How'd they do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跌落电梯里
sense_groups.english: I fell down an elevator shaft.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很逊
sense_groups.english: Oh. That sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被雪崩掩埋
sense_groups.english: I was buried in an avalanche.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我演过《我的孩子们》里 布莱斯的角色
sense_groups.english: I used to be Brice on All My Children.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么大家都要看我睡觉？
sense_groups.english: Why must everybody watch me sleep?

sense_groups.chinese: 不准再看我睡觉了 不准…
sense_groups.english: There'll be no more watching me sleep! No more...

sense_groups.chinese: 再看了 - 我…
sense_groups.english: watching! - I...

sense_groups.chinese: 那
sense_groups.english: Neh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮一些东西做脱水 葡萄 杏桃
sense_groups.english: I got some great stuff to dehydrate. Grapes, apricots.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这会是个好点子 看看这些水球会变成什么样子
sense_groups.english: I thought it'd be cool to see what happens with these water balloons.

sense_groups.chinese: 滚出去…
sense_groups.english: Get out. Get out, get out, get out!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你给我搬出去
sense_groups.english: What? - You! Move out!

sense_groups.chinese: 带着你的愚蠢脱水水果滚出去
sense_groups.english: Take your fruit! Your stupid small fruit and get out!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我搬走？
sense_groups.english: You want me to move out? Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我 呃...
sense_groups.english: Heh. I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说你不觉得那有点突然吗？
sense_groups.english: Ooh! Ha, ha. I gotta tell you, that's kind of out of the blue, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 这一点都不突然
sense_groups.english: This is not out of the blue!

sense_groups.chinese: 这完全都不突然
sense_groups.english: This is smack-dab in the middle of the blue!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松 别激动
sense_groups.english: Relax! Take it easy, buddy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必告诉我第二次
sense_groups.english: You don't have to tell me twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我会找人来搬我的东西
sense_groups.english: God, I mean, someone will be by for my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你以为我会让你跟我的鱼独处 你就疯了
sense_groups.english: If you think I'm leaving you alone with my fish, you're insane!

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: You want some help?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要帮忙 朋友
sense_groups.english: No help required, chico!

sense_groups.chinese: 一路直达机场？那超过三十里远
sense_groups.english: All the way to the airport, huh? You know, that's over 30 miles.

sense_groups.chinese: 那得花你不少钱
sense_groups.english: That's gonna cost you about so bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 应该是"五十"块
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, that's "50" bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 五十块
sense_groups.english: What? - Fifty dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道这是怎么一回事吗？传真过来的剧本字体有点模糊
sense_groups.english: Oh. You know what it is? It's smudgy because they're fax pages.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在《我们的日子》 演德瑞克雷莫瑞医生时
sense_groups.english: When I was on Days ofour Lives as Dr. Drake Ramoray...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会把完整剧本寄过来给我
sense_groups.english: they'd send over the whole script on real paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要加戏 譬如让计程车发生车祸
sense_groups.english: If you wanted to expand this scene, like have the cab crash...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以治疗乘客
sense_groups.english: I could attend to the victims...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我有演医生的背景
sense_groups.english: because I have a background in medical acting.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说 谢谢你来试镜
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen, thanks for coming in.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别谢我来试镜 至少让我演完
sense_groups.english: No. Uh, don't thank me for coming in. Uh, at least let me finish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以走快速道路
sense_groups.english: Uh, we could take the expressway...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这时你很可能会超过预算
sense_groups.english: but, uh, this time of day you're better off taking the budge.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是要过桥才对吧？
sense_groups.english: You were going for bridge there, weren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我自己出去
sense_groups.english: I'll have a good day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 第28题
sense_groups.english: Okay, question number 28.

sense_groups.chinese: "你曾让闪电人抢走你的风吗？"
sense_groups.english: "Have you ever allowed a lightning-bearer to take your wind?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我要回答"没有"
sense_groups.english: I would have to say no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的答案是"胡扯"
sense_groups.english: And I would have to say, "Pah, ha."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不记得布偶男了吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you not remember the puppet guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你让他在你的内心力量池洗脚
sense_groups.english: You totally let him wash his feet in the pool of your inner power.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有他的布偶
sense_groups.english: And his puppet too!

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我没有让男人
sense_groups.english: Well, at least I didn't let some guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 在第一次约会时进入我的真理森林
sense_groups.english: into the forest of my righteous truth on the first date!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 保罗
sense_groups.english: Who? - Paul!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 继续 下一题
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, moving on, moving on. Next question.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 第29题
sense_groups.english: Okay, number 29.

sense_groups.chinese: "你曾为了闪电人
sense_groups.english: "Have you ever betrayed another goddess...

sense_groups.chinese: 背叛其他女神吗？"好吧 第30题
sense_groups.english: for a lightning-bearer?" Okay, number 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…回到第29题
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa! Let's go back to 29.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 呃...
sense_groups.english: Not, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 在我的记忆里是没有
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Not to my recollection.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼亚夏克 九年级
sense_groups.english: Danny Arshack, ninth grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道瓶口是指向我
sense_groups.english: You know the bottle was pointing at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为你占了一半的空间
sense_groups.english: Only because you took up half the circle!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们两个 真是可悲
sense_groups.english: Listen to you two. It's so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来我得一个人参加女神会议
sense_groups.english: Looks like I'll be going to the goddess meetings alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 唔
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你休想 当她们发现杰森跟摩妮卡分手一小时后
sense_groups.english: Not when they find out you slept with Jason...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就跟他上床
sense_groups.english: an hour after he broke up with Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 一小时？
sense_groups.english: One hour?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个抓耙子 - 噢
sense_groups.english: You are such a leaf blower! - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心3D版《最后晚餐》
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, uh, be careful with that 3-D Last Supper.

sense_groups.chinese: 犹大有点松了
sense_groups.english: Judas is a little loose.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要把我的东西收回去 我想你说得对
sense_groups.english: They're taking all my stuff back. I guess you were right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我错了 所以我来找你
sense_groups.english: No, I wasn't right. That's what I came here to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那天我满脑子只想着自己的事
sense_groups.english: I was totally hung up on my own stuff the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 听着 我非常需要安全感
sense_groups.english: No, listen. I need the whole security thing, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道下一笔收入在哪里 但你不需要那么做
sense_groups.english: To know where my next paycheck is coming from. But you don't need that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的让我很佩服
sense_groups.english: And that's amazing to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远都没办法跟你一样 乔伊
sense_groups.english: I could never do what you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 你有伟大梦想
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - You hold out for something bigger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法告诉你我多么尊重
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how much respect I have...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去参加那个愚蠢的试镜
sense_groups.english: for you not going to that stupid audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去了 - 太棒了 结果如何？
sense_groups.english: I went. - Great! How did it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有被录取 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: I didn't get it. - Good for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你实现梦想
sense_groups.english: You're living the dream!

sense_groups.chinese: 呵？ - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Huh? - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: All right, then!

sense_groups.chinese: 别拿走我的鹦鹉 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, not my parrot. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不下去了
sense_groups.english: I can't watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hey, hold on, hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只鸟要多少钱？
sense_groups.english: How much for the, uh? How much to save the bird?

sense_groups.chinese: －一千两百块 - 美金？
sense_groups.english: Twelve hundred. - Dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 你花一千两百块买只塑胶鸟？
sense_groups.english: You spent $1200 on a plastic bird?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一时冲动 它就在收银台附近
sense_groups.english: Uh, it was an impulse buy. Near the register.

sense_groups.chinese: 把那只鸟带走
sense_groups.english: Go ahead with the bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么东西是两百块左右？ - 呃
sense_groups.english: Do you have anything for around $200? - Uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只狗
sense_groups.english: The dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了
sense_groups.english: I'll take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我送你的礼物
sense_groups.english: My gift to you, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的喜欢那只鸟
sense_groups.english: I really liked that bird, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过狗也可以 - 对
sense_groups.english: But the dog! Oh! - Yeah. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 蛋糕来了
sense_groups.english: Here are your cakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有点蛋糕
sense_groups.english: We didn't order cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道 我请客
sense_groups.english: No, I know. Ahem. They're from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 两位 这不是件好事
sense_groups.english: You guys, this is not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人抢走我们的风已经够麻烦了
sense_groups.english: We have enough trouble with guys stealing our wind...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不该彼此对立
sense_groups.english: without taking it from each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 - 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You're right. - You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你们这些女神
sense_groups.english: I love you goddesses.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再抢你的风了
sense_groups.english: I don't ever want to suck your wind again.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我们没事了吧？ - 我们没事了
sense_groups.english: Thank you. So are we good? - Oh. We're good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没事了吧？ - 对
sense_groups.english: We're good? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得把蛋糕收回去 他们会扣我的薪水
sense_groups.english: Okay. Let me take these back. They'll take it out of my paycheck.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 那个疯子走了
sense_groups.english: Ding-dong, the psycho's gone!

sense_groups.chinese: 这次你确定吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Are you sure this time? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的看到他离开
sense_groups.english: I actually saw him leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙在窗口拿着一颗假人头
sense_groups.english: That guy is holding a human head.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在窗口拿着一颗假人头
sense_groups.english: He's holding a human head!

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Check it out, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我在梅西百货后面的巷子 从假人身上拔下来的
sense_groups.english: I tore it off a mannequin in the alley behind Macy's. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 梅西百货后面没有巷子
sense_groups.english: There is no alley behind Macy's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在少女百货偷来的 都一样啦
sense_groups.english: So I got it in the junior miss department. Big diff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们下一次办鸡尾酒会 这会是个不错的话题
sense_groups.english: It'll make a hell of a conversation piece at our next cocktail party, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: "我们下一次办鸡尾酒会"？
sense_groups.english: "Our next cocktail party"?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们可以把薯片放进去 让它变成薯片小妞
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you know, we'll put chips in it. We'll make it a chip chick.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾迪 你记得昨天吗？
sense_groups.english: Eddie, do you remember yesterday?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我依稀还记得
sense_groups.english: Uh, yes, I think I vaguely recall it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得昨天你跟我说话吗？
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Do you remember talking to me yesterday?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Uh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: So, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开车到拉斯维加斯
sense_groups.english: We took a road trip to Las Vegas!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweet Moses!

sense_groups.chinese: 你去拉斯维加斯有赢到钱吗？
sense_groups.english: So on this road trip, uh, did you win any money?

sense_groups.chinese: 我输光光 但21点先生 他手气可好了
sense_groups.english: Nah, I crapped out. But Mr. 21 here! He cleans up!

sense_groups.chinese: 三百块 他还送我这双新鞋子
sense_groups.english: $300! He buys me these new shoes. Sweet, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 楼上见 大家再见
sense_groups.english: Uh, see you upstairs. See you, pals!

sense_groups.chinese: 有人开始喜欢他了吗？
sense_groups.english: Is anyone else starting to really like him?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事需要我效劳吗？
sense_groups.english: May I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我的钥匙不能用？我的东西为什么在楼下？
sense_groups.english: Why doesn't my key work, and what's my stuff doing downstairs?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Aah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们认识吗？
sense_groups.english: Have we met?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是艾迪 变态 我是你的室友
sense_groups.english: It's Eddie, you freak! Your roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经有室友了
sense_groups.english: I already have a roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 他住在这里很多年 我不知道你到底在胡说什么
sense_groups.english: Um, he's lived here for years. I don't know what you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No, no. He's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他搬出去 我搬进来
sense_groups.english: No, he moved out and I moved in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们会记得那种事
sense_groups.english: Well, I think we'd remember something like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我会记得
sense_groups.english: I know I would. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 说得好
sense_groups.english: That's, uh, a good point. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, wow. Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我走错门了
sense_groups.english: I guess I got the wrong apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我…
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm terribly sorry. - Hey, no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 脱水水果变态狂
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, you fruit-drying psychopath.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我帮你把东西拿出来吗？ - 不用了 我可以的
sense_groups.english: You want me to help you unpack? - Nah, I'm okay. Oh, and, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你该知道我搬回来 不是因为我走投无路
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, I'm not moving back in because I have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确走投无路 可是…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I do have to, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为那里不是…
sense_groups.english: It's just that that place, it wasn't really...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是…
sense_groups.english: I mean, this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎回家 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Welcome home, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 玩一下足球台？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: A little foos? - Absolutely!

sense_groups.chinese: 足球怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What happened to the foosball?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是哈蜜瓜
sense_groups.english: It's a cantaloupe.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次罗斯过来 我们都得把这个搬出来吗？
sense_groups.english: Are we gonna bring this out every time Ross comes over?

sense_groups.chinese: 他付一大笔钱买下它的
sense_groups.english: He paid a lot of money for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要转个方向 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna hold him a different way. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你那么讨厌它 一开始为什么要买下它？
sense_groups.english: If you hated it so much, why'd you buy it in the first place?

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了一大堆瓷器动物摆在那里
sense_groups.english: Well, I had a whole ceramic-zoo thing going over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 少了其他的动物 它看起来怪怪的
sense_groups.english: But without the other ones, it looks tacky.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会使用马桶 或直接在浴室地板上？
sense_groups.english: Is he housetrained or will he leave little bathroom tiles all over?

sense_groups.chinese: 别动
sense_groups.english: Stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 别动
sense_groups.english: Uh, stay!

sense_groups.chinese: 好乖的假狗狗
sense_groups.english: Good fake dog.

questions.name: S02E20
questions.en:
Hey.
What you guys doing? - Monica's making us watch Old Yeller.
Why are you guys upset? It's Old Yeller. It's a happy movie.
What? - What are you talking about?
Come on. Happy family gets a dog.
Frontier fun!
Pheebs, what about the end?
Oh, when Yeller saves the family from the wolf and everyone's happy?
That's not the end.
Yeah-huh. That's when my mother would shut off the TV and say, "The end."
What about when he has rabies?
He doesn't have rabies. He has babies.
That's what my mom said.
Uh, Phoebe, I don't think she'd want you to see what's about to happen.
Why? What's about to happen?
I've never seen this part.
Hey, Travis, what you doing with that gun?
Oh, no.
No, no, Travis, put down the gun.
No, no, he's your buddy. He's your Yeller.
No! The end! The end!
Okay, what kind of a sick doggy snuff film is this?
∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮
∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮
∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮
∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮
∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮
∮ but I'll be there for you ∮
∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ Like I've been there before ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮
Have you guys eaten? Uh, Richard and I just finished, and we've got leftovers.
Chicken and potatoes.
What am I wearing?
Actually, nothing but rubber gloves.
One of these times, you'll really be naked and we won't come over.
I got a leg, three breasts and a wing.
How do you find clothes that fit?
Oh, hey, Monica? We got a question.
All right, yes, I see other women in the shower at the gym.
And no, I don't look.
No, not that one.
We're figuring out who to bring to the Knicks game.
Ross can't go, so it's between my friend Eric Prower, who has breath issues...
and Dan, with the poking. "Did you see that play?"
"You want more beer? Is that Spike Lee?"
Ha, ha, okay.
Why don't you ask Richard?
Uh, Richard, if you had an extra ticket to the Knicks game...
and you had to choose between a friend who smelled...
and one who bruises you, who would you pick?
Wow.
Being a huge Knicks fan myself...
I think you should take someone who's a huge Knicks fan.
Okay.
That's Eric.
Glad to be of help. Matches.
I meant, why don't you take Richard to the game?
Eh.
What?
I don't know. - Come on!
He keeps his fingers to himself, and he's always minty fresh.
Richard's really nice. Uh, we just don't know him really well.
Plus, he's old...
older than some people.
But, uh, younger than some buildings.
So what, he's a little older. Big deal.
He's important to me.
If you ask him, he might take you in his Jag.
How do we say yes...
and make it seem like it's not just to ride in the cool car?
Okay, this could be tough.
Okay, okay, okay. Monica?
We'll bring him, but only if he takes the Jaguar.
Ooh, you almost had it.
No, no, you're fine. You're fine.
Hello, ha, ha. - Hey.
Hi, honey. Oh.
You are not gonna believe what happened!
We were playing on the floor, and he grabs the table...
and he pulls himself up!
He pulled himself up!
Standing man!
I'm sorry you missed it, but I did tape it if you wanna see it.
Uh, we know. He already did it last week.
You can watch our tape if you want.
Ah, see, I don't believe this. I missed the first time of everything.
The first time he rolled over, the first time he crawled.
What else? Has he spoken? Is he driving?
Does he have a favorite liqueur?
He is getting closer on the talking thing.
He can't quite say "mama" yet, but once he said "Yemen."
See, I don't know. I'm so sick of missing stuff.
I want him for more than a day. I want him for a whole weekend.
Listen. I feel...
That would be great.
Really? I had a whole speech prepared.
Oh, shoot, that would've been fun.
Oh, look, did you just see that?
Did you see? He just waved! He just waved!
He's never waved before!
Yes, he has. Very good.
Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. What you got there?
Love Story, Brian's Song and Terms of Endearment.
Wow, all you need now is The Killing Fields...
and some guacamole, and you got yourself a party!
I talked to my grandma about the Old Yeller incident...
and she said my mom used to not show us the ends of sad movies...
to shield us from the pain and sadness.
You know, before she killed herself.
Hey. - Hey.
Where's Richard? Did you ditch him?
After we stole his lunch money and gave him a wedgie.
What's the matter with you? He's parking the car.
Did you guys have fun? - Your boyfriend is so cool.
He let us drive his Jaguar. Joey for 12 blocks. Me for 15.
Wow.
He must like you best.
Oh, what about when he tipped the guy who showed us to our seats?
You never even saw the money.
Hey, Chandler, thanks for showing us to our seats.
Ha, ha, you're welcome. Hey, Joey, thanks for parking the car.
No problem, ha, ha.
Hey, Chandler... - I think they get it.
There's the man!
Hey.
Hey, you're getting better. - Huh? Ha, ha.
I'm gonna keep this.
Okay.
He kept my dollar.
Your first weekend without Ben. What are you doing?
Ah, we're going to colonial Williamsburg.
A woman I went to college with is the first female blacksmith there.
They're a little behind the times in colonial Williamsburg.
Ha, ha. Well, look, I better go before Mommy starts weeping.
We love you. - Bye, Mommy.
Have a good time.
Okay, Ben.
Ross. - Yeah?
Look.
Joey, do you know we can see you from here?
How come Richard looks cooler with one of these?
You may wanna light it and lose the spatula.
It's cute, you trying to be more like Richard.
Not like him, per se.
Just not unlike him.
It's the artist formerly known as Chandler.
I'm just trying something here, you know?
Why didn't you grow a mustache?
Oh, we flipped for it.
I got the cigar, he got the mustache.
If we both grew them, we'd look like dorks.
You really sidestepped that land mine.
I promised Richard we'd meet downstairs.
You're meeting Richard?
Ranger game. - Didn't he tell you?
He said he was going out with the guys. I didn't know that was you.
You hear that?
We're the guys! - We're the guys!
With that mustache, he reminds me of Aunt Sylvia.
Thank you!
Hi, we're visiting. - Yay.
It's Ben and his dada.
Dada.
Can you say "dada"? - Aw.
I'm telling your mommies you said it, so you might as well.
No luck, huh? - No.
A while ago, I got a "seh" out of him...
which I thought might turn into "seh-condary caregiver," but...
Would you, uh, hold him for a sec? I gotta take this off.
Oh, yeah, sure, okay. - There we go.
What are you doing?
I'm holding Ben.
Yeah, well, he's a baby, not a bomb.
Okay.
Hold him like you'd hold a football.
This is how I would hold a football.
Here. Here. There we go.
Sorry, I'm not very good with babies. I haven't been around them.
I mean, you know, since I was one. - Ha, ha.
It's all right. No big deal. - Really?
You'll feel different when it's our baby.
What? - What?
You think about stuff like that?
Uh, yeah. I mean...
Actually, I kind of think that we'll have two babies.
Two babies?
You know, a boy and a girl.
Hopefully, the girl will come first, so Ben won't feel competitive.
Then what's gonna happen?
We won't wanna raise kids in the city, so we'll move to Scarsdale.
Scar... Uh-huh.
We'll be far enough from our parents so we don't have to see them...
but close enough that they can babysit.
And yes, I know the taxes are a little higher than Nassau County...
but the school system's great.
Wow! Ha, ha.
Wow, that's great! Great!
Okay, wow! You know what? - Hmm?
I'm off my break now. So, uh...
Um, here. You take this.
And, um...
I'm gonna go pour these very nice people some coffee.
Okay.
Look at that. I don't have a pot.
I don't have a pot. Maybe I've got one at home.
Or in Scarsdale. Hey, is that a door?
Rach.
Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. What's happening?
Oh, okay, murder, cancer, soccer teams eating each other in the Andes.
You watched the movies? - Uh-huh.
What is happening to the world?
I mean... No, no, because E.T. Leaves...
and Rocky loses. Charlotte dies.
Charlotte who?
With the web. The spider.
She dies. She has babies and dies.
It's like, "Welcome home from the hospital." Thud!
You wanna feel better?
Yeah. - Okay.
Here. Watch this.
It's a Wonderful Life. Yes, I've heard of this.
So you can't lose. It's there in the title.
Wonderfulness is baked right in.
I fell for that with Pride of the Yankees.
I thought I'd see a film about Yankee pride.
And boom! The guy gets Lou Gehrig's disease.
Uh, the guy was Lou Gehrig. Didn't you kind of see it coming?
Watch that. It'll restore all your faith in humanity.
Hey, big guy. Game time.
Hey! Be right there! - There's a game?
I just got my Pik-Up Stiks back from the shop.
Bring your nerves of steel.
It's the basketball playoffs.
Um, I appreciate this, but you don't have to hang out with them for me.
They have each other.
Oh, no, honey. I mean, don't worry.
I like hanging out with them. They're different than my other friends.
They don't start sentences with "You know who just died shoveling snow?"
All right, that's great. Then just go.
Go Knicks!
Uh, it's the college playoffs. - Oh.
Then, go Vassar! - Uh, they're not in it.
Okay, then just go. - Okay.
Ugh, why does this bother me so much?
I'm not one of those people who wants to spend 24 hours a day together.
Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 就艾力克了
sense_groups.english: That's Eric.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能帮上忙 我去抽烟
sense_groups.english: Glad to be of help. Matches.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你们何不约理查去看球赛？
sense_groups.english: I meant, why don't you take Richard to the game?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. - Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 他不会乱戳人 而且口气清新
sense_groups.english: He keeps his fingers to himself, and he's always minty fresh.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查人不错 但我们跟他不熟
sense_groups.english: Richard's really nice. Uh, we just don't know him really well.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他很老
sense_groups.english: Plus, he's old...

sense_groups.chinese: 比一些人老
sense_groups.english: older than some people.

sense_groups.chinese: 但比一些建筑物年轻
sense_groups.english: But, uh, younger than some buildings.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎么样？他年纪有点大 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: So what, he's a little older. Big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 他对我来说很重要
sense_groups.english: He's important to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们问他 或许他会开捷豹跑车载你们去
sense_groups.english: If you ask him, he might take you in his Jag.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要怎么答应她
sense_groups.english: How do we say yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 同时装做我们不是为了想搭跑车？
sense_groups.english: and make it seem like it's not just to ride in the cool car?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这可能有点难
sense_groups.english: Okay, this could be tough.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, okay. Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以带他去 但他一定开捷豹跑车
sense_groups.english: We'll bring him, but only if he takes the Jaguar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你差点就成功了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, you almost had it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 尿布没脏
sense_groups.english: No, no, you're fine. You're fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello, ha, ha. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Hi, honey. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会相信发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: You are not gonna believe what happened!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在地上玩 他抓住桌子
sense_groups.english: We were playing on the floor, and he grabs the table...

sense_groups.chinese: 自己站起来
sense_groups.english: and he pulls himself up!

sense_groups.chinese: 他自己站起来
sense_groups.english: He pulled himself up!

sense_groups.chinese: 他站起来了
sense_groups.english: Standing man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾你们错过了 如果你们想看 我都拍下来了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry you missed it, but I did tape it if you wanna see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道 上星期他就会那么做
sense_groups.english: Uh, we know. He already did it last week.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要的话 你可以看我们的录影带
sense_groups.english: You can watch our tape if you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我不敢相信 我错过所有的第一次
sense_groups.english: Ah, see, I don't believe this. I missed the first time of everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 他第一次翻身跟爬行
sense_groups.english: The first time he rolled over, the first time he crawled.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有什么？他会说话或开车吗？
sense_groups.english: What else? Has he spoken? Is he driving?

sense_groups.chinese: 他有最喜欢的酒类饮料吗？
sense_groups.english: Does he have a favorite liqueur?

sense_groups.chinese: 他就快会说话了
sense_groups.english: He is getting closer on the talking thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还不会叫妈妈 但有一次他说"阿姆"
sense_groups.english: He can't quite say "mama" yet, but once he said "Yemen."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我厌倦了老是在错过
sense_groups.english: See, I don't know. I'm so sick of missing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不只要陪他一天 我要陪他一整个周末
sense_groups.english: I want him for more than a day. I want him for a whole weekend.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我认为…
sense_groups.english: Listen. I feel...

sense_groups.chinese: 那应该会很棒
sense_groups.english: That would be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？我准备了一大套台词
sense_groups.english: Really? I had a whole speech prepared.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜 那应该会很有趣
sense_groups.english: Oh, shoot, that would've been fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, did you just see that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看到了吗？他挥手了
sense_groups.english: Did you see? He just waved! He just waved!

sense_groups.chinese: 他不曾挥过手
sense_groups.english: He's never waved before!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他挥过手 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yes, he has. Very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 菲比 你买了什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. What you got there?

sense_groups.chinese: 《爱的故事》 《挑战不可能》 跟《亲密关系》
sense_groups.english: Love Story, Brian's Song and Terms of Endearment.

sense_groups.chinese: 加上《杀戮战场》
sense_groups.english: Wow, all you need now is The Killing Fields...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟一些酪梨酱 你就可以办派对了
sense_groups.english: and some guacamole, and you got yourself a party!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟我外婆聊到《老黄狗》的事
sense_groups.english: I talked to my grandma about the Old Yeller incident...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说我妈不让我们看悲伤电影结局
sense_groups.english: and she said my mom used to not show us the ends of sad movies...

sense_groups.chinese: 不希望我们接触到痛苦与悲伤
sense_groups.english: to shield us from the pain and sadness.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？就在她自杀前
sense_groups.english: You know, before she killed herself.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查在哪里？你们甩了他？
sense_groups.english: Where's Richard? Did you ditch him?

sense_groups.chinese: 在我们偷了他的午餐钱 还拉他的内裤之后
sense_groups.english: After we stole his lunch money and gave him a wedgie.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？他去停车
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with you? He's parking the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们玩得开心吗？ - 你男朋友太酷了
sense_groups.english: Did you guys have fun? - Your boyfriend is so cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 他让我们开着他的捷豹跑车 乔伊开了12条街 我是15条街
sense_groups.english: He let us drive his Jaguar. Joey for 12 blocks. Me for 15.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 他一定最喜欢你
sense_groups.english: He must like you best.

sense_groups.chinese: 他给带位员小费那一段呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what about when he tipped the guy who showed us to our seats?

sense_groups.chinese: 根本没看到他拿出钱
sense_groups.english: You never even saw the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 谢谢你帮我们带位
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, thanks for showing us to our seats.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 乔伊 谢谢你帮忙停车
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, you're welcome. Hey, Joey, thanks for parking the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: No problem, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 我想她们了解了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler... - I think they get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 大英雄来了
sense_groups.english: There's the man!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你越来越厉害了 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're getting better. - Huh? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要留下这个
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna keep this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他把我的钱拿走了
sense_groups.english: He kept my dollar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们第一次离开班去度周末 你们要做什么？
sense_groups.english: Your first weekend without Ben. What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要去参观殖民时期的威廉斯堡
sense_groups.english: Ah, we're going to colonial Williamsburg.

sense_groups.chinese: 我念大学时认识的一个女孩 是那里的第一位女铁匠
sense_groups.english: A woman I went to college with is the first female blacksmith there.

sense_groups.chinese: 殖民时期的威廉斯堡 有点跟不上时代
sense_groups.english: They're a little behind the times in colonial Williamsburg.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我得走了 不然妈妈要哭了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Well, look, I better go before Mommy starts weeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱你 - 再见 妈妈
sense_groups.english: We love you. - Bye, Mommy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好玩吧
sense_groups.english: Have a good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 小班
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 快看
sense_groups.english: Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你知道我们在这里能看到你吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, do you know we can see you from here?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么理查这么做就是比我酷？
sense_groups.english: How come Richard looks cooler with one of these?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你得先点雪茄 然后放下铲子
sense_groups.english: You may wanna light it and lose the spatula.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很可爱 你试着模仿理查
sense_groups.english: It's cute, you trying to be more like Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是在学他
sense_groups.english: Not like him, per se.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是不想跟他不一样
sense_groups.english: Just not unlike him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是之前名为钱德的艺人
sense_groups.english: It's the artist formerly known as Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是在尝试新造型
sense_groups.english: I'm just trying something here, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你不留胡子？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you grow a mustache?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们丢铜板决定
sense_groups.english: Oh, we flipped for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我抽到雪茄 他抽到胡子
sense_groups.english: I got the cigar, he got the mustache.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们两个都留胡子 看起来会很像呆瓜
sense_groups.english: If we both grew them, we'd look like dorks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的不像呆瓜
sense_groups.english: You really sidestepped that land mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应理查到楼下跟他碰面
sense_groups.english: I promised Richard we'd meet downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们跟理查有约？
sense_groups.english: You're meeting Richard?

sense_groups.chinese: 《游骑兵队》比赛 - 他没跟你说吗？
sense_groups.english: Ranger game. - Didn't he tell you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他要跟朋友出去 我不知道他是指你们
sense_groups.english: He said he was going out with the guys. I didn't know that was you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗？
sense_groups.english: You hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是朋友 - 我们是朋友
sense_groups.english: We're the guys! - We're the guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 他留胡子的样子 让你想起席薇亚阿姨？
sense_groups.english: With that mustache, he reminds me of Aunt Sylvia.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我们来了 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, we're visiting. - Yay.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班跟爸爸
sense_groups.english: It's Ben and his dada.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸
sense_groups.english: Dada.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会叫爸爸吗？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: Can you say "dada"? - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你的妈妈们说你会说 所以你非说不可
sense_groups.english: I'm telling your mommies you said it, so you might as well.

sense_groups.chinese: 运气不好？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: No luck, huh? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚我听到他说二
sense_groups.english: A while ago, I got a "seh" out of him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为他是说第二照顾者 可是…
sense_groups.english: which I thought might turn into "seh-condary caregiver," but...

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我抱抱他吗？我得把包包放好
sense_groups.english: Would you, uh, hold him for a sec? I gotta take this off.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 没问题 - 来吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, sure, okay. - There we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在抱小班
sense_groups.english: I'm holding Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是小宝宝 不是炸弹
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, he's a baby, not a bomb.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 像抱足球一样抱着他
sense_groups.english: Hold him like you'd hold a football.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都是这样抱足球的
sense_groups.english: This is how I would hold a football.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 好了
sense_groups.english: Here. Here. There we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不太会带小孩 我一直跟小孩没什么接触
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I'm not very good with babies. I haven't been around them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说从我一岁后 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I mean, you know, since I was one. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 没什么大不了的 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: It's all right. No big deal. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信我们生了孩子后 你会有不一样的想法
sense_groups.english: You'll feel different when it's our baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想过那种事了？
sense_groups.english: You think about stuff like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我是说…
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我想我们得生两个
sense_groups.english: Actually, I kind of think that we'll have two babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 生两个？
sense_groups.english: Two babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 一男一女
sense_groups.english: You know, a boy and a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望先生女儿 小班才不会有竞争压力
sense_groups.english: Hopefully, the girl will come first, so Ben won't feel competitive.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后呢？
sense_groups.english: Then what's gonna happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不想让孩子们在城市里长大 所以我们会搬到史卡戴尔
sense_groups.english: We won't wanna raise kids in the city, so we'll move to Scarsdale.

sense_groups.chinese: 史卡... 嗯-哼
sense_groups.english: Scar... Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以远离我们的爸妈 不必看到他们
sense_groups.english: We'll be far enough from our parents so we don't have to see them...

sense_groups.chinese: 但距离也够近 他们能来当保姆
sense_groups.english: but close enough that they can babysit.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道税率比拿索郡高
sense_groups.english: And yes, I know the taxes are a little higher than Nassau County...

sense_groups.chinese: 但学区非常不错
sense_groups.english: but the school system's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Wow! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's great! Great!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗？ - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Okay, wow! You know what? - Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的休息时间结束了
sense_groups.english: I'm off my break now. So, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 你抱着他
sense_groups.english: Um, here. You take this.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 恩...
sense_groups.english: And, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去帮这些非常好的人倒咖啡
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go pour these very nice people some coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我没拿咖啡壶
sense_groups.english: Look at that. I don't have a pot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没拿咖啡壶 或许我把咖啡壶放在家里
sense_groups.english: I don't have a pot. Maybe I've got one at home.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是放在史卡戴尔了 那是门吗？
sense_groups.english: Or in Scarsdale. Hey, is that a door?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 菲比 怎么样啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. What's happening?

sense_groups.chinese: 杀人 癌症 足球队在安地斯山脉吃掉彼此
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, murder, cancer, soccer teams eating each other in the Andes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看了电影？ - 呃
sense_groups.english: You watched the movies? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个世界是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is happening to the world?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说…不 因为E.T.离开了
sense_groups.english: I mean... No, no, because E.T. Leaves...

sense_groups.chinese: 洛基输了 夏绿蒂死了
sense_groups.english: and Rocky loses. Charlotte dies.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个夏绿蒂？
sense_groups.english: Charlotte who?

sense_groups.chinese: 织网的那个 蜘珠夏绿蒂
sense_groups.english: With the web. The spider.

sense_groups.chinese: 他死了 他生下宝宝后就死了
sense_groups.english: She dies. She has babies and dies.

sense_groups.chinese: 那像是"欢迎出院回家" 然后他死了
sense_groups.english: It's like, "Welcome home from the hospital." Thud!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想觉得开心点吗？
sense_groups.english: You wanna feel better?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 看这个
sense_groups.english: Here. Watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 《风云人物》 我听过这部电影
sense_groups.english: It's a Wonderful Life. Yes, I've heard of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会喜欢 片名说明了一切
sense_groups.english: So you can't lose. It's there in the title.

sense_groups.chinese: 剧情保证美好
sense_groups.english: Wonderfulness is baked right in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被《洋基之光》骗了
sense_groups.english: I fell for that with Pride of the Yankees.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为电影描述《洋基队》的光荣
sense_groups.english: I thought I'd see a film about Yankee pride.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果是主角得了路贾里格症
sense_groups.english: And boom! The guy gets Lou Gehrig's disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 主角就是路贾里格 你没发现吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, the guy was Lou Gehrig. Didn't you kind of see it coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 看一下那部电影 它会让你恢复对人性的信心
sense_groups.english: Watch that. It'll restore all your faith in humanity.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大英雄 比赛时间
sense_groups.english: Hey, big guy. Game time.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 马上到 - 有比赛？
sense_groups.english: Hey! Be right there! - There's a game?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我刚去买了戳戳棒
sense_groups.english: I just got my Pik-Up Stiks back from the shop.

sense_groups.chinese: 有种放马过来
sense_groups.english: Bring your nerves of steel.

sense_groups.chinese: 是篮球季后赛
sense_groups.english: It's the basketball playoffs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很高兴 但你不必看在我的面子上陪他们
sense_groups.english: Um, I appreciate this, but you don't have to hang out with them for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有彼此的陪伴
sense_groups.english: They have each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 甜心 别担心
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, honey. I mean, don't worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢跟他们在一起 他们跟我其他的朋友不一样
sense_groups.english: I like hanging out with them. They're different than my other friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不会一开始就说 "你知道谁在铲雪时死掉了吗？"
sense_groups.english: They don't start sentences with "You know who just died shoveling snow?"

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 太棒了 快去吧
sense_groups.english: All right, that's great. Then just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 《尼克队》
sense_groups.english: Go Knicks!

sense_groups.chinese: 是大学篮球季后赛 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh, it's the college playoffs. - Oh.
