sense_groups.chinese: 对啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 干脆不要去打壁球了 我们待在这里聊天怎么样？
sense_groups.english: You wanna forget racquetball and hang out?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 你们坐了我们的位子 - 不好意思 我们不知道
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're in our seats. - Oh, sorry, we didn't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 我们刚才坐在这里的
sense_groups.english: Hey, we were sitting there.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有另外一种说法
sense_groups.english: Okay. There is one more way to say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人知道吗？ - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Who knows it? Ha, ha. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说这话是自以为幽默吗？ - 不 只是想说得生动一点
sense_groups.english: Is that supposed to be funny? - Actually, I was going for colorful.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙是怎么回事？ - 你是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What's with this guy? - What's with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 他没怎么样
sense_groups.english: Uh, nothing. Nothing's with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢慢享受你们的咖啡吧
sense_groups.english: Enjoy your coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What just happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是拿了你的帽子
sense_groups.english: I just took your hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我也可以很幽默
sense_groups.english: See, I can be funny too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的笑话就是 我拿了你的帽子
sense_groups.english: My joke is that I took your hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很好笑
sense_groups.english: That is funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能拿回来吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I have it back?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行？ - 不行
sense_groups.english: No? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗？我认为你很幽默
sense_groups.english: You know what? I think you're very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个帽子笑话很不错
sense_groups.english: Kudos on that hat joke. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 兄弟 帽子还给他吧
sense_groups.english: But come on, guys, just give him back the hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why should we?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那是一顶很特别的帽子
sense_groups.english: Because it's a special hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 他买这顶帽子 是因为他那天情绪低落
sense_groups.english: He bought it because he was feeling down one day.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他才买了这帽子…
sense_groups.english: So he got the hat...

sense_groups.chinese: 让自己高兴一点 你知道
sense_groups.english: to cheer himself up, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德他… - 别说了 不要再说了
sense_groups.english: Now, Chandler... - Stop talking. Stop talking now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我直说了吧 你偷了我的帽子？
sense_groups.english: Let me get this straight. You're stealing my hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？有问题吗？
sense_groups.english: You got a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 只是确认一下我们有共识
sense_groups.english: I just want to make sure we're on the same page.

sense_groups.chinese: 面试如何？
sense_groups.english: How'd the interview go?

sense_groups.chinese: 糟透了
sense_groups.english: It bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个50年代主题餐馆
sense_groups.english: It was a '50s theme restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得穿着戏服做饭 还要在柜台上跳舞
sense_groups.english: I'd have to cook in a costume and dance on the counter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前是艺术家咖啡馆的二厨
sense_groups.english: I was a sous-chef at Café des Artistes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能在这样的快餐店炸薯条？
sense_groups.english: How can I take a job where I have to make Laverne-and-Curly Fries?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就别去做啊 - 我怎么能不去做？
sense_groups.english: Don't do it. - How can I not do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的存款只剩下127元了
sense_groups.english: I have $127 in the bank.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 放轻松 去拿瓶啤酒
sense_groups.english: Monica, relax. Go get a beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想喝啤酒
sense_groups.english: I don't want a beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说是要给你的？
sense_groups.english: Who said it was for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们又怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 有两个烂人在咖啡厅 拿走我的帽子
sense_groups.english: Some mean guys at the coffeehouse took my hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 - 是在开玩笑吧
sense_groups.english: No. - You're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 那两人太荒谬了 他们是霸凌
sense_groups.english: It was ridiculous. These guys were bullies.

sense_groups.chinese: 真正的霸凌
sense_groups.english: Actual bullies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都是成人了 这种事情不应该再发生了
sense_groups.english: We're grownups. This kind of stuff isn't supposed to happen anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 恩…
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 等等 我身边一个人也没有
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, wait a minute. I have no one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们下去把你的帽子拿回来
sense_groups.english: Let's go down there and get your hat back.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了吧 很可能都已经剥开分块卖了
sense_groups.english: Forget it. It's probably stripped and sold for parts by now.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我涨了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey. I went up! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的股票 MEG升了两点
sense_groups.english: My stock, MEG, it went up two points.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你们意识到如果昨天 我把127元投资到我身上
sense_groups.english: Do you realize that if I'd invested my $127 in myself yesterday...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我就有… 比现在多的钱了
sense_groups.english: that I'd, like, have a lot more than that today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们猜怎么着？我真的要做
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 做什么？ - 把钱投资到我身上
sense_groups.english: Do what? - Put all my money in me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对股票市场一无所知
sense_groups.english: You don't know a thing about the stock market.

sense_groups.chinese: 这有什么困难的？买呀卖的 高呀低的 空头多头…
sense_groups.english: What's to know? Buy, sell. High, low. Bears, bulls.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 曼哈顿
sense_groups.english: Yes, Manhattan.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要股票…
sense_groups.english: Telephone number to the stock...

sense_groups.chinese: 店的电话号码
sense_groups.english: selling store.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我就跟你说 带枕头来是个好主意
sense_groups.english: See? Didn't I tell you these pillows would be a good idea?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 老天
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我有生以来第一次要说 "你好 生父 "
sense_groups.english: For the first time in my life, I'm gonna say, "Hi, birth father!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱你 我们支持你 - 对啊 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: We love you. We're here for you. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 想吃点三明治吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, you, uh, want some sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 那里面都夹了些什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what is in that?

sense_groups.chinese: 橄榄面包跟火腿酱 没有美乃滋
sense_groups.english: Olive loaf and ham spread. No mayo.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不 因为美乃滋 会把这个弄得很恶心
sense_groups.english: No, because mayo, that would make it gross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿…喂
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey... No, oh, oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 跑 菲比 快跑 - 小狗狗 别这样
sense_groups.english: Run, Phoebe, run. - No, no, doggy, please!

sense_groups.chinese: 我热爱所有的动物 别这样 放开我
sense_groups.english: I do so want to love all animals. Please, no. Back off!

sense_groups.chinese: 去拿骨头？你有骨头吗？ - 开什么玩笑？
sense_groups.english: You got a bone? - Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 别咬了
sense_groups.english: Look, kibbles! Bits, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 好吧 从我腿上滚开 你这个混帐东西
sense_groups.english: Get the hell off my leg, you yippity piece of crap!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们有麻烦了
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. We have a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不把他的弹簧床移走？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you take his trampoline?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 我知道怎么做了 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, here, I know what we can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 喂 不行 喂
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey. Hey, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 狗狗 去吃那块三明治
sense_groups.english: Okay, doggy, get the sandwich! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 狗狗 吃吧 乖狗狗 吃三明治
sense_groups.english: Go get the sandwich! Good doggy. Get the sandwich!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 那狗肯舔自己 却不碰你的三明治
sense_groups.english: The dog will lick himself but he will not touch your sandwich.

sense_groups.chinese: 这说明什么了？
sense_groups.english: What does that tell you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他要是不吃的话 我还想吃呢 - 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Lf he's not gonna eat it, I will. - Are you crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 那只是一只小狗
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, he's just a little dog. Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是要成为 一个21世纪不动产经纪
sense_groups.english: Do you have to be a Century 21 real-estate agent...

sense_groups.chinese: 才能穿那种很酷的外套？
sense_groups.english: to get to wear those cool jackets?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都跟女孩子们说这个？
sense_groups.english: Do you say this stuff to girls?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是那个以前戴你帽子的家伙吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, isn't that the guy who used to wear your hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 你看他们现在坐在哪儿
sense_groups.english: And look where they're sitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你开玩笑吧？你们才刚刚进门
sense_groups.english: You're joking, right? You guys just walked through the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我们没跟他们说清楚 - 对
sense_groups.english: Maybe we didn't make it clear enough. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这沙发属于我们的
sense_groups.english: This couch belongs to us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这么办吧 你们叫这沙发…
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what, you call the couch...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也叫它…
sense_groups.english: and then we'll call the couch...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后看它会走向谁
sense_groups.english: and we'll see who it comes to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我在想什么吗？你们为什么还坐在这里？
sense_groups.english: You know what I keep wondering? Why you two are still sitting here.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: All right, that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受够了
sense_groups.english: I have had enough of this, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 这两个家伙想抢我们的座位
sense_groups.english: These guys are trying to take our seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 他们先来的
sense_groups.english: Fellas, these guys were here first.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 没注意到 - 呃
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry, didn't realize. - Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 行了
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是一定要这样才行的
sense_groups.english: We didn't want to have to go and do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 他告我们的状？
sense_groups.english: He told on us?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告我们的状？
sense_groups.english: You told on us?

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你们没给我别的选择
sense_groups.english: Well, pal, you didn't give me much of a choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 别玩他的东西 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Don't play with his thing. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到外面谈谈吧
sense_groups.english: Let's take this outside.

sense_groups.chinese: "我们到外面谈谈"？
sense_groups.english: "Let's take this outside"?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁这么说话啊？
sense_groups.english: Who talks like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 马上就要痛宰你的人这么说话
sense_groups.english: The guy who's about to kick your ass talks like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要问 是吧？ - 真是的
sense_groups.english: You had to ask. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这样…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, look. See...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们并不打算跟你们打架
sense_groups.english: the thing is, we're not gonna fight you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有个条件
sense_groups.english: Here's the deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你们永远不在这里出现 就不用跟我们打架
sense_groups.english: You won't have to, so long as you never ever show your faces here again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为你的阿甘牌打得太早了
sense_groups.english: I think you played the Gunther card too soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比 我想你现在能去了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, I think you're good to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得 这是一个很糟的征兆
sense_groups.english: I just think that this was a really bad sign.

sense_groups.chinese: 门口有一只野兽
sense_groups.english: Like the beast at the threshold.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有别的亲人了 除了我祖母以外
sense_groups.english: It's just I have no family left, except for my grandmother.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是面对现实吧 她不可能一直都在
sense_groups.english: But let's face it, she's not gonna be around forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管她怎么说
sense_groups.english: Despite what she says.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有个妹妹 尽管我们分享过 同一个子宫 但我几乎不和她说话
sense_groups.english: And I have a sister who I've barely spoken to since we shared a womb.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 这是我真正的父亲…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. This is my real father...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只希望事情很顺利
sense_groups.english: and I want things to be, like, just right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全理解
sense_groups.english: I completely understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想怎么做都好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, whatever you need.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想回家吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you want to go home?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 多谢了 再一次 对不起呀
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks. Sorry again.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想一开始的路障已经清掉了
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'm guessing the threshold's clear now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要买5股SGJ 现在就要
sense_groups.english: I want to buy five shares of SGJ. Now.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 时间就是金钱 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Come on, time is money, my friend!

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you! Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: "时间就是金钱 兄弟"？
sense_groups.english: "Time is money, my friend"?

sense_groups.chinese: 是呀 你错过了"钱能生钱"
sense_groups.english: You missed "Takes money to make money"...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 "别逼我过去痛宰 你们这些华尔街浑蛋"
sense_groups.english: and "Don't make me come down there and kick your Wall Street butt."

sense_groups.chinese: 我在早餐之前赚了17元 你呢？
sense_groups.english: I made $17 before breakfast. What have you done?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里吃的早餐 所以严格地说 我省了3块5
sense_groups.english: I had breakfast here, so technically I saved $3.50.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么赚到17元的？
sense_groups.english: How did you make $17?

sense_groups.chinese: 金融常识有待加强的朋友…
sense_groups.english: Well, my financially challenged friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 我用我的钱分别买了 一些CHP和ZXY
sense_groups.english: I split my money and I bought some shares of CHP and ZXY.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么要买这些？
sense_groups.english: How come those?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 CHP是我以前很喜欢的演员名字缩写
sense_groups.english: Well, CHP because I used to have a crush on Erik Estrada.

sense_groups.chinese: ZXY是因为 我认为它听起来像"性感"
sense_groups.english: And ZXY because I think it sounds "zexy."

sense_groups.chinese: 那MEG呢？
sense_groups.english: Ahem, what happened to MEG?

sense_groups.chinese: MEG不错 但是我甩了她
sense_groups.english: MEG was good for me, but I dumped her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 我的座右铭是 "下跌之前滚开"
sense_groups.english: My motto is, "Get out before they go down."

sense_groups.chinese: 这绝对不是我的座右铭
sense_groups.english: That is so not my motto.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 那狗怎么样了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, how's the dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟兽医谈过了 北边的人真是很友善
sense_groups.english: Okay. I talked to the vet. People are so nice upstate.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说小家伙会没事的 我明天就可以去接他
sense_groups.english: He said the little fella's gonna be okay, and I can get him tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了 - 多谢老天爷
sense_groups.english: Good. - Oh, thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他不得不多缝几针
sense_groups.english: But he did have to have a bunch of stitches.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他说 狗的耳朵重新长出来 真的是千载难逢
sense_groups.english: And he said that only once in a blue moon does a dog's ear grow back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在盼望中
sense_groups.english: So still hoping.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 现在你会打电话给你父亲 让他知道他的狗没事了吧？
sense_groups.english: Now are you gonna call your dad to let him know that his dog is okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想跟我爸在电话上相认
sense_groups.english: I don't want to meet my father over the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说什么？"我是菲比 你抛弃的女儿
sense_groups.english: What will I say, "Hi, I'm the daughter you abandoned.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便说一句 我弄伤了你的狗"
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, I broke your dog."

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 如果你愿意 我来帮你打
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, if you want, I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说任何关于我的事情
sense_groups.english: Listen, just don't say anything about me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 别…
sense_groups.english: Don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 用太久的电话
sense_groups.english: be too long with the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 股票市场关了后 她会是个更好的朋友
sense_groups.english: She'll be a much better friend once the market closes.

sense_groups.chinese: 是个女人
sense_groups.english: It's a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她说话
sense_groups.english: So talk to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 布非太太
sense_groups.english: Uh, hello, Mrs. Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的狗在哪里
sense_groups.english: I know where your dog is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想让你知道 24小时之内…
sense_groups.english: I want you to know he'll be returned to you almost as good as new...

sense_groups.chinese: 他会几乎 像全新一样还给你
sense_groups.english: within 24 hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Uh, goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么是那种声音？ - 很难说
sense_groups.english: Why the voice? - Hard to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生 您的卡布其诺
sense_groups.english: Your cappuccino, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这里比咖啡店好多了 - 绝对好多了
sense_groups.english: This is better than the coffeehouse. - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 这怎么不会溶在水里？
sense_groups.english: How come it's not mixing with the water?

sense_groups.chinese: 包装上说 你要不停的搅动
sense_groups.english: The package says to keep it moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 边搅边喝 边搅边喝 别停下来
sense_groups.english: Stir and drink, never let it settle.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太荒谬了
sense_groups.english: This is ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 等我从我侄女的洗礼回来后
sense_groups.english: After I get back from my niece's christening...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你们一起到咖啡厅 我们一起享受一杯好咖啡
sense_groups.english: I'll go to the coffeehouse with you and we'll have a cup of coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 有乔伊在
sense_groups.english: No problem. Joey's there, hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 不行
sense_groups.english: Okay. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行？ - 不行
sense_groups.english: No? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想要每次想喝杯好咖啡 都要有乔伊陪着
sense_groups.english: I don't want to have to have Joey with me every time I want decent coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想在后半生都喝 "K"开头的卡布其诺
sense_groups.english: And I don't want to drink cappuccino with a "k."

sense_groups.chinese: 我说 你和我下去 勇敢面对那些家伙
sense_groups.english: I say you and I go and stand up to those guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 猛男
sense_groups.english: All right, hang on a second there, Custer.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你被痛揍过吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, have you ever been beaten up before?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 被摩妮卡以外的人？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: By someone besides Monica? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎么？
sense_groups.english: So what?

sense_groups.chinese: 被痛揍又怎样？也许那是 每个男人一生中都要经历的事情
sense_groups.english: So we get beaten up. Maybe that's something a man has to go through.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像成年礼之类的东西
sense_groups.english: Like a rite of passage or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能不能 只是再次失去我们的童贞？
sense_groups.english: Couldn't we just lose our virginities again?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我觉得我的又长回来了
sense_groups.english: Because I think actually mine's growing back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要借一百块 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I need $100. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎回家
sense_groups.english: Hi. Welcome home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要借一百块 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I need $100. - For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要重新回到游戏之中 - 为什么？你什么时候退出游戏的？
sense_groups.english: To get back in the game. - When did you get out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我全赔了 赔光了 - 不会吧
sense_groups.english: I lost it all, I lost it. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经跟他们达成协议了 你也要
sense_groups.english: I've come to terms with it, you have to too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Look, uh, Mon, I'm really sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的一百块呢？
sense_groups.english: Where are we on the $100?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有一百块
sense_groups.english: I don't have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我需要
sense_groups.english: But I need it!

sense_groups.chinese: 要不然我就不得不去做 那份烂到爆的养馆工作了
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, I'll have to take that diner job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 就是穿着戏服跳舞
sense_groups.english: You know, with the dancing and the costumes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想戴阻燃剂做的假胸部
sense_groups.english: I don't want to have to wear flame-retardant boobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人会想 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Nobody does, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 面条
sense_groups.english: Noodle!

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 我的狗怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What the hell happened to my dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生意外
sense_groups.english: It was an accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个造成意外的女人 绝对不是故意的
sense_groups.english: And the woman who did this would never hurt a dog on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是个素食者
sense_groups.english: She's a vegetarian.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？缝针？
sense_groups.english: Are these stitches?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 8针 他身上总共缝了56针
sense_groups.english: Yeah, eight of them. That's 56 to him, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 另外 如果下雨 不能让他向上看太久
sense_groups.english: If it's raining, you can't let him look up too long...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那个圆锥形护颈 很快就会满
sense_groups.english: because that cone will fill up fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢你把他剩余的部分带回来
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, thanks for bringing back what's left of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克在家吗？ - 你怎么会认识法兰克？
sense_groups.english: Is Frank home? - How do you know Frank?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 认识很久了 他在吗？
sense_groups.english: Just from a long time ago. Is he here?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在 法兰克
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是指老法兰克
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, um, I mean Frank Senior.

sense_groups.chinese: 他出去买菜了
sense_groups.english: He went out for groceries.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他会很快回来吗？
sense_groups.english: Will he be back soon?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是四年前离开的 所以我们估计他很快就会回来了
sense_groups.english: He left four years ago. We're expecting him back any minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我得走了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 关于狗的事 非常对不起 还有其他所有的事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about the dog. Everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小姐
sense_groups.english: Hey, lady!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 等等
sense_groups.english: Hey, wait up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么认识我爸的？ - 嗯 其实我不认识
sense_groups.english: How do you know my dad? - Um, well, I don't really.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是从基因角度讲…
sense_groups.english: Just genetically.

sense_groups.chinese: 他也是我爸
sense_groups.english: He's kind of my dad too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好沉重
sense_groups.english: Heavy.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说起过我吗？菲比？
sense_groups.english: So, um, did he ever talk about me? Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但是他什么都不说的
sense_groups.english: No, but he didn't really talk about anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 除了高跷
sense_groups.english: Except stilts.

sense_groups.chinese: 高跷？ - 对 他喜欢踩高跷
sense_groups.english: Stilts? - Yeah, he loved stilts.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次我在楼上 从我妈的包包里面偷烟 然后…
sense_groups.english: One time, I was upstairs stealing cigarettes out of my mom's purse...

sense_groups.chinese: 忽然间 我向外看…
sense_groups.english: and, uh, all of a sudden I look over...

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸的脑袋 正一蹦一跳地移过窗口
sense_groups.english: and there's Dad's head, bobbing past the window.

sense_groups.chinese: 在他脸上有很开心的微笑 他还向我挥手
sense_groups.english: He just had this big smile on his face and he was waving...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他踩在高跷上的时候 总是很高兴
sense_groups.english: because he was happiest when he was on his stilts.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 是的
sense_groups.english: Wow. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道怎么玩那东西
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to do with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Me neither, ha, ha. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是我的姊姊罗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: So are you, like, my big sister? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太好了 你可以买啤酒给我
sense_groups.english: This is huge. You can buy me beer, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会买啤酒给你 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你知道什么事情很酷吗？如果你有叫彼得的朋友 我就可以说
sense_groups.english: But you know what's cool? If you had a friend named Pete, I could say

sense_groups.chinese: "我认识彼得 他是我弟弟的朋友"
sense_groups.english: "I know Pete. He's friends with my brother."

sense_groups.chinese: 我有叫马克的朋友 - 那也行
sense_groups.english: I got a friend named Mark. - That'll work too.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷 真不错
sense_groups.english: Cool. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许 我偶尔可以给你电话
sense_groups.english: So maybe, you know, I could give you a call sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以聊聊什么的
sense_groups.english: We could talk or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 那没问题 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that'd be okay. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的号码在电话簿里
sense_groups.english: I'm in the book.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, yeah. - Okay, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 高跷是吧？
sense_groups.english: So, um, stilts, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你愿意 我可以带你到后面 看他的脑袋是在哪里撞到排水槽的
sense_groups.english: If you want, I can show you where he hit his head on the rain gutter.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们做到了 我们来到这里 挺立在我们的领地上
sense_groups.english: We did it. We're here. We are standing our ground.

sense_groups.chinese: 弄杯咖啡要花这么长的时间？ - 你能不能快点 快点
sense_groups.english: How long does coffee take? - Would you come on? Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们做到了 - 我想我们已经证明了我们的能力
sense_groups.english: There we go. - I think we proved our point.

sense_groups.chinese: 你烫到嘴了？ - 感觉不到舌头了
sense_groups.english: You burn your mouth? - Cannot feel my tongue.

sense_groups.chinese: 霸凌 超级霸凌
sense_groups.english: Bullies! Big bullies!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 瞧瞧谁在这儿 是小不点们
sense_groups.english: Oh, look who's here. It's the weenies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们那天没说清楚吗？
sense_groups.english: Did we not make ourselves clear the other day?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我们来的原因
sense_groups.english: That's why we're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们挺立在我们的领地上
sense_groups.english: Yes, we're standing our ground.

sense_groups.chinese: 显而易见
sense_groups.english: Apparently.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来吧 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Let's do this already. - Whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么？武器？
sense_groups.english: You got a weapon?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是只好表 我不想碎在你的肋骨上
sense_groups.english: A nice watch. I don't want to break it on your ribs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们开始吧
sense_groups.english: All right, let's do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有问题 如果我不在乎我的手表 我能用来作为武器吗？
sense_groups.english: If I don't care about my watch, can I use it as a weapon?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？ - 这很尖锐 是金属的
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? - It's sharp, it's metal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这能用来造成严重伤害
sense_groups.english: I think I can do some serious damage with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你不能用你的表
sense_groups.english: No, you can't use your watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者是钥匙 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Or your keys. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧
sense_groups.english: Here's what we'll do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把所有的表 钥匙放在 这顶帽子里 帽子放到那边
sense_groups.english: We'll put all keys and watches in the hat over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right? - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 来吧
sense_groups.english: All right, come on, man. Let's do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 在我忘了之前问一句 我们打脸吗？
sense_groups.english: Before I forget, are we hitting faces?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然打脸 为什么不打脸？
sense_groups.english: Of course. Why wouldn't you hit faces?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我周一要上班 我有个很重要的演讲
sense_groups.english: I have to work on Monday. I have a big presentation.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实 我明天要展示那个公寓
sense_groups.english: Actually, I gotta show this apartment tomorrow...

sense_groups.chinese: 不打脸算是个好主意
sense_groups.english: and, uh, this no-faces thing might not be a bad idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 不打脖子以上
sense_groups.english: Okay, nothing from the neck up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是腰以下
sense_groups.english: Or the waist down.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹娜正在排卵期 - 真的吗？你们又在试了？
sense_groups.english: Dana's ovulating. - Oh, really? You guys trying again?

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我直说了吧 我们就是指中间这部分？
sense_groups.english: Let me get this straight. We're talking about the middle?

sense_groups.chinese: 来呀 - 喂 喂
sense_groups.english: Come on! - Hey, hey, whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想被我揍吗？我就站在这儿呢
sense_groups.english: You want a piece of this? I'm standing here!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 喂 喂
sense_groups.english: Huh! - Hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那两个家伙 拿我们的东西
sense_groups.english: Those guys are taking our stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 喂
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 刚才真是太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: God, that was amazing. That was incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们狠狠揍了那家伙一下 - 我们？你们才厉害
sense_groups.english: You guys kicked butt! - Us? What about you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 你从后面槌了那一拳
sense_groups.english: You really, bing, gave it to old Mr. Clean back there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那可是个大家伙 - 对 他是很大块 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: He was a big guy. - Yeah, he was, wasn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪知道？我真不该错过的
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't know, having missed everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这么说自己
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't do that to yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们每个人都有可能 被那小女孩的跳绳绊倒的
sense_groups.english: Any one of us could have tripped over that little girl's jump rope.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 兄弟
sense_groups.english: So listen, guys, are we, uh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没问题了吧？
sense_groups.english: Are we okay here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没问题 - 哈哈 好吧
sense_groups.english: We're okay. - Ha, ha, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能要回我的帽子吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, so can I have my hat back?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 你们看她
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Look at her.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hi, Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 做得还上手吧？
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha, how's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 胸部好漂亮
sense_groups.english: Hey, nice boobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看看这个
sense_groups.english: Guys, guys. Check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Excellent.

Okay, so I still have to invite Dylan and Emma and Shannon Cooper.

and Joey slept with her and never called her back.

All right? Maybe too much. I don't know.
I guess I just got scared.
I'm sorry. I didn't know.

Hi, honey. How did it go? - Ugh. It was the graduation from hell.
You know, my cousin went to hell on a football scholarship.
You know, I mean, this is supposed to be a joyous occasion.
My sister's graduating from college. Nobody thought she would.
It's a true testament to what a girl from Long Island would do for a Celica.
So, what happened? - My parents happened.
All they had to do was sit in the same stadium, smile proudly...
and not talk about the divorce. But no.
They got into a huge fight in the middle of the commencement address.
Bishop Tutu actually had to stop and shush them.
Ugh. But you know what? You know what the good news is?
I get to serve coffee for the next eight hours.
Okay, so I guess we don't invite her parents.
Well, how about just her mom? - Why her mom?
Because I already invited her.
Ooh, did you ask Stacy Roth?
Uh, can't invite her.
She also steals.
Okay, here are the candles. Where's the birthday cake?
Okay, we're not having birthday cake. We're having birthday flan.
Excuse me?
It's a traditional Mexican custard dessert.
Whoa, that's nice.
Happy birthday, Rachel. Here's some goo.
Dr. Green.
Oh, my God. It's Rachel's dad.
What are you doing here?
What, the father can't drop by to see the daughter on her birthday?
No, no, the father can.
But, um, since I am the roommate, I can tell you that she's not here.
And I'll pass along the message. Okay? So bye-bye.
Oh. You're having a party.
No, no, not a party.
Just a surprise gathering of some people Rachel knows.
Uh, this is Phoebe and Chandler and Joey. - I'll never remember all of that.
So, uh, what's the deal?
Rachel comes home, people pop out and yell stuff? Is that it?
This isn't your first surprise party, is it, sir?
Hi, Monica.
The Chinese menu guy. Forgot the menus.
So basically, just a Chinese guy.
Hey, Dr. Green, come with me. We'll put your jacket on Rachel's bed.
All right. That sounds like a two-person job.
Well, my goodness. What was that?
Sandra, I am so sorry. I thought you were Rachel.
And we weren't ready for you yet.
You thought I was Rachel? - Yes, because, uh, you look so young.
And because you're both, you know, white women.
Oh, I missed you kids.
Well, should I put my coat in the bedroom?
No.
No, I'll take that for you. - Oh, well, thank you.
Okay. - Such a gentleman. Thank you.
Oh.
Oh, it all looks so nice. So festive. All the balloons.
Oh, the funniest thing happened to me on the way here.
I was driving... - That's great. Ha-ha-ha.
I can't wait to hear the rest, but I have to go to the bathroom.
So... Hey, come with me.
What? - Yeah, yeah. It will be like we're gal pals.

sense_groups.english: Okay, so I guess we don't invite her parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 只邀她妈妈呢？ - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, how about just her mom? - Why her mom?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我已经跟她开口了
sense_groups.english: Because I already invited her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你邀了史黛西萝丝了吗？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, did you ask Stacy Roth?

sense_groups.chinese: 不能邀请她
sense_groups.english: Uh, can't invite her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也会偷东西
sense_groups.english: She also steals.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是生日蜡烛 蛋糕在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Okay, here are the candles. Where's the birthday cake?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有生日蛋糕 我们要吃生日果馅饼
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're not having birthday cake. We're having birthday flan.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是传统墨西哥馅饼甜点
sense_groups.english: It's a traditional Mexican custard dessert.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Whoa, that's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 瑞秋 吃点馅料
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, Rachel. Here's some goo.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林医生
sense_groups.english: Dr. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是瑞秋的爸爸
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. It's Rachel's dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 做父亲的 不能在女儿过生日时来看她？
sense_groups.english: What, the father can't drop by to see the daughter on her birthday?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你当然可以
sense_groups.english: No, no, the father can.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我是她的室友 我可以告诉你她不在
sense_groups.english: But, um, since I am the roommate, I can tell you that she's not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会告诉她的 好吗？再见
sense_groups.english: And I'll pass along the message. Okay? So bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要办派对
sense_groups.english: Oh. You're having a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是派对
sense_groups.english: No, no, not a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一些认识瑞秋的人 要做惊喜聚会
sense_groups.english: Just a surprise gathering of some people Rachel knows.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是菲比 钱德跟乔伊 - 反正我也记不住
sense_groups.english: Uh, this is Phoebe and Chandler and Joey. - I'll never remember all of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what's the deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋一回家 就会有人跳出来大叫？
sense_groups.english: Rachel comes home, people pop out and yell stuff? Is that it?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是你第一次参加惊喜派对吧？
sense_groups.english: This isn't your first surprise party, is it, sir?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hi, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 是中国餐馆的人 他忘了拿菜单
sense_groups.english: The Chinese menu guy. Forgot the menus.

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上他只是一个中国人
sense_groups.english: So basically, just a Chinese guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林医生 请跟我来 我们得把你的外套放在瑞秋床上
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dr. Green, come with me. We'll put your jacket on Rachel's bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听起来那需要两个人才能做好
sense_groups.english: All right. That sounds like a two-person job.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那是怎么一回事？
sense_groups.english: Well, my goodness. What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我以为你是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Sandra, I am so sorry. I thought you were Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还没准备好
sense_groups.english: And we weren't ready for you yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我是瑞秋？ - 对 因为你看起来很年轻
sense_groups.english: You thought I was Rachel? - Yes, because, uh, you look so young.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你们都是白种女人
sense_groups.english: And because you're both, you know, white women.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想念你们
sense_groups.english: Oh, I missed you kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该把外套放到卧室去吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, should I put my coat in the bedroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我帮你拿外套 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, I'll take that for you. - Oh, well, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 你真是个绅士 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Such a gentleman. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很漂亮 非常喜气 好多气球
sense_groups.english: Oh, it all looks so nice. So festive. All the balloons.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来这里的路上 发生了一件非常有趣的事
sense_groups.english: Oh, the funniest thing happened to me on the way here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开着车… - 真好笑
sense_groups.english: I was driving... - That's great. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及要听完其他部分 但我得去上厕所
sense_groups.english: I can't wait to hear the rest, but I have to go to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我来吧
sense_groups.english: So... Hey, come with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 就当我们是好朋友
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, yeah. It will be like we're gal pals.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像是一起去餐厅吃饭 一定会很好玩 来吧
sense_groups.english: You know, like at a restaurant. Oh, it'll be fun. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊… - 快想
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God. Oh, my God. - Okay, think. Think.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克跟克丽丝会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: What would Jack and Chrissy do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的外套已经放在床上…
sense_groups.english: Okay, now that your coat is safely in the bed...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以回客厅了
sense_groups.english: Okay. We can come back out in the living room. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊跟钱德 你们该带葛林医生去你们家
sense_groups.english: So, Joey and Chandler, I think it's time that you take Dr. Green over to your place.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Uh, yes, absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Um, why, again?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为派对要在那里举行 笨蛋
sense_groups.english: Because that's where the party is, you goon.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里只是准备区
sense_groups.english: See, this is just the staging area.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里只是准备区 - 对 这里是准备区
sense_groups.english: Right, it's the staging area. - This is the staging area.

sense_groups.chinese: 你走错地方了
sense_groups.english: This is clearly in the wrong apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们去一号派对
sense_groups.english: All right, you guys are off to party number one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们…
sense_groups.english: And you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们去二号派对
sense_groups.english: You are off to party number two.

sense_groups.chinese: 动作快…
sense_groups.english: All right, fellas, let's keep it moving, let's keep it moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 拜托你请一些女客人 来参加我的派对
sense_groups.english: Chandler, could you at least send some women to my party.

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗斯 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's Ross. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, they're coming. Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你请我吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Thank you for such a wonderful dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你出生在这个世界上
sense_groups.english: Thanks for being born.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你送我漂亮耳环 它们非常完美
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you for my beautiful earrings. They're perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Aw. - I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喜欢的话可以拿去换 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh. Now, you can exchange them if you want, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我更爱你了
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Now I love you even more.

sense_groups.chinese: 大惊喜
sense_groups.english: Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my gosh. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 天啊 妈
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica. Oh, my God. Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: This is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 甜心
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你 我都不知道
sense_groups.english: Wow. You. I had no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 不 我知道
sense_groups.english: Really? - No, I knew.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 大伙们 桌上有食物跟饮料
sense_groups.english: Everybody, there's food and drinks on the table.

sense_groups.chinese: 快到对面 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Go across the hall. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 到钱德跟乔伊家去
sense_groups.english: Right now, Joey and Chandler's. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 快去
sense_groups.english: Why? - Just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 真奇怪 - 大惊喜
sense_groups.english: Weird. - Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 宝贝女儿
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, sweet pea.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸
sense_groups.english: Daddy! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都来了？
sense_groups.english: Both of them are here? Both of them? Both of them are here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以再数一次吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, we could count again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信会发生这种事 - 你知道吗？这太可笑了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is happening. - You know what? This is ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的生日跟你的派对
sense_groups.english: Okay, this is your birthday, this is your party.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得让他们知道实情 如果他们不接受 谁在乎呢？
sense_groups.english: I say we just put them all together. If they can't deal with it, who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在乎 - 那才是最重要的
sense_groups.english: I do. - That's who.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Look, are you gonna be okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的没有选择
sense_groups.english: Well, I have to be. I don't really have a choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得往好的方面去想
sense_groups.english: I mean, I can look at the bright side.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有两个生日派对 跟两个生日蛋糕
sense_groups.english: I get two birthday parties and two birthday cakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上有一个是生日果馅饼
sense_groups.english: Well, actually just one birthday flan.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 它是传统墨西哥馅饼甜点
sense_groups.english: What? - It's a traditional Mexican custard dessert.

sense_groups.chinese: 去问摩妮卡 她负责食物 我不能…
sense_groups.english: Look, talk to Monica. She's on the food committee.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 有个女孩走向我 她说"我要你 丹尼斯"
sense_groups.english: Joe, Joe, hey, some girl just walked up to me and said, "I want you, Dennis"...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后把她的舌头伸进我的喉咙里
sense_groups.english: and stuck her tongue down my throat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱这个派对
sense_groups.english: I love this party.

sense_groups.chinese: 排球机智问答 - 排球
sense_groups.english: Quick volleyball question. - Volleyball.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在你房里搭了一个球场
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we set up a court in your room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喜欢那盏灰色的灯吧？
sense_groups.english: Uh, you didn't like that gray lamp, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有个女人将舌头伸进我的喉咙里
sense_groups.english: Joey, a woman just stuck her tongue down my throat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本听不到你说话
sense_groups.english: I'm not even listening to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼斯 - 她在叫我了
sense_groups.english: Dennis. - Okay, that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你能去陪爸爸吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, ahem, honey, can you keep Dad occupied?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得跟妈妈谈一谈
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go talk to Mom for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我该说些什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay, do you have any ideas for any openers?

sense_groups.chinese: 千万别提 "我正在跟你女儿上床"
sense_groups.english: Uh, let's just stay clear of "I'm the guy that's doing your daughter"...

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该就会没事
sense_groups.english: and you should be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大家快来拿张纸
sense_groups.english: Okay, people, I want you to take a piece of paper...

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 写下你们最丢脸的事
sense_groups.english: Here you go. And write down your most embarrassing memory.

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家不用麦克笔时
sense_groups.english: And I do ask that when you're not using the markers...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要将笔盖盖上
sense_groups.english: you put the caps back on them...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为它们会干掉
sense_groups.english: because they will dry out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 葛林医生
sense_groups.english: Hi, Dr. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 血管外科游戏…
sense_groups.english: So how's everything in the, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 还好玩吧？
sense_groups.english: vascular surgery game?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是游戏 罗斯 今天有个女人死在手术台上
sense_groups.english: It's not a game, Ross. A woman died on my table today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我工作上的一大好处
sense_groups.english: See, that's the good thing about my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我工作台上的恐龙早就死了
sense_groups.english: All the dinosaurs on my table are already dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 我不想罗嗦
sense_groups.english: Listen, you guys, um, I don't mean to be a pain about this...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我发现有些人只是随意盖上
sense_groups.english: but, um, I've noticed that some of you are just placing them on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们得用力压笔盖
sense_groups.english: You want to push the caps...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到听见卡的一声
sense_groups.english: until you hear them click.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Gunther. Where you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想或许…
sense_groups.english: I, uh, was sort of thinking about maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能走 这很好玩
sense_groups.english: No. No, you can't go. No, this is fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才刚要开始 拿去 这是你的麦克笔
sense_groups.english: Come on, come on, we're just getting started. Here's your marker.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想走的话快点走
sense_groups.english: Listen, if you want to go, just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她会骂我的
sense_groups.english: No. She'll yell at me again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我能把你弄出去
sense_groups.english: All right, ahem, I can get you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一分钟后我会分散她的注意力
sense_groups.english: In a minute, I'm gonna create a diversion.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得趁乱走出去 千万别回头
sense_groups.english: When I do, walk quickly to the door and don't look back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我需要喝一杯 - 我去帮你拿
sense_groups.english: I think I need a drink. - Oh, I'll get it for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要喝什么？ - 威士忌
sense_groups.english: What do you want? - Scotch.

sense_groups.chinese: 十秒内我会拿着一杯加冰威士忌回来
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll be back in 10 seconds with your Scotch on the rocks in a glass.

sense_groups.chinese: 纯的
sense_groups.english: Neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 太酷了 - 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: Cool. - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 纯的 不要加冰块
sense_groups.english: Neat, as in no rocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Heh. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你跑到哪里去了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hello, Ross. Now, where have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我在厕所里
sense_groups.english: Hi. Uh, I have been in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得将鲑鱼慕斯吐出来
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Stay clear of the salmon mousse.

sense_groups.chinese: 纯威士忌
sense_groups.english: Oh. Scotch neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋的爸爸也喝那个
sense_groups.english: You know, that's Rachel's father's drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 呵
sense_groups.english: Oh. Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 很纯正 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Mine too. Isn't that neat?

sense_groups.chinese: 纯威士忌
sense_groups.english: Scotch neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 失陪一下
sense_groups.english: Would you excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要溜到哪里去 先生？
sense_groups.english: Where are you sneaking off to, mister? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去拿外套里的烟
sense_groups.english: I'm getting my cigarettes out of my jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 你是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: No. - No. What do you mean "no"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 因为那是准备区
sense_groups.english: No, um, see, because that's the staging area.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到那里去 会毁了你对派对的幻想
sense_groups.english: You go in there, it'll ruin the whole illusion of the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 拿着你的威士忌回那里去
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think, you take your Scotch back in there...

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮你拿烟
sense_groups.english: and I will get your cigarettes for you, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 也帮我拿眼镜来 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: And get my glasses too. - All righty-roo.

sense_groups.chinese: 我第一次那么说 竟然是在这种情况下
sense_groups.english: What a great moment to say that for the first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 第一个人的最丢脸回忆是
sense_groups.english: Okay, the first person's most embarrassing memory is

sense_groups.chinese: "摩妮卡 你的派对烂透了"
sense_groups.english: "Monica, your party sucks."

sense_groups.chinese: 真好笑
sense_groups.english: All right. Very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 有人忘了用杯垫吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Ooh. Did someone forget to use a coaster?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都没看到
sense_groups.english: I don't see anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我又看到水纹
sense_groups.english: Great, I'm seeing water rings again.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 那是谁的眼镜？
sense_groups.english: Ross, whose glasses are those?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的
sense_groups.english: Mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你戴两用眼镜？
sense_groups.english: You wear bifocals?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的眼睛有些问题
sense_groups.english: I have a condition apparently...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我需要…
sense_groups.english: that I require...

sense_groups.chinese: 戴两用眼镜
sense_groups.english: two different sets of focals.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我丈夫也有那种眼镜吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know my husband has glasses just like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 那种镜框很普遍
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Well, those are very popular frames.

sense_groups.chinese: 尼尔赛达卡也戴这种
sense_groups.english: Neil Sedaka wears them.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说你能把人弄出这里
sense_groups.english: I hear you can get people out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Rachel? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没告诉我你男朋友会抽烟
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell me your boyfriend smokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他烟瘾非常重
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like a chimney.

sense_groups.chinese: 大烟枪
sense_groups.english: Big smoker.

sense_groups.chinese: 超级大烟枪
sense_groups.english: Big, big smoker.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我要到走廊 点燃这个坏小子
sense_groups.english: In fact, I'm gonna go out into the hallway and fire up this bad boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你戴我的眼镜？
sense_groups.english: Are you wearing my glasses?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想帮你暖一下耳垫
sense_groups.english: I was just warming up the earpieces for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的烟？
sense_groups.english: Is that one of my cigarettes?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我只是想帮你润润烟屁股
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is. I was just moistening the tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 她要去倒垃圾 我能把你们弄出去
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. She's taking the trash out, so I can get you out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们得快离开 她随时都会回来
sense_groups.english: But it has to be now. She'll be back any minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的朋友呢？
sense_groups.english: What about my friend Victor?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有你们三个 再多她一定会起疑
sense_groups.english: No, only the three of you. Any more than that and she'll get suspicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我去拿外套 - 没时间了
sense_groups.english: All right. Let me just get my coat. - There isn't time.

sense_groups.chinese: 别拿任何东西
sense_groups.english: Just leave everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 隔壁的人会照顾你们
sense_groups.english: They'll take care of you next door.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们真的有啤酒？
sense_groups.english: Is it true they have beer?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们听到的事都是真的
sense_groups.english: Everything you've heard is true.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能不能小声点？
sense_groups.english: Could you guys please try and keep it down?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要闻始玩惊异大巡航
sense_groups.english: We're trying to start a Boggle tournament.

sense_groups.chinese: 你 还有你
sense_groups.english: You. And you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该在我的派对上 还有阿甘
sense_groups.english: You're supposed to be at my party. And Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 恩…
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎光临…
sense_groups.english: Hey, welcome to the fo...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 对不起 但这些人需要我
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm sorry. But these people needed me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们努力工作了一星期 今天是星期六
sense_groups.english: You know, they work hard all week. It's Saturday night.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们需要狂欢 去吧
sense_groups.english: They deserve to have a little fun. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的派对很有趣
sense_groups.english: You know, my party is fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是安静了那么点 不那么明显的乐趣
sense_groups.english: I mean, maybe it's a little quieter, less obvious sort of fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果大家愿意给它一个机会 它非常…
sense_groups.english: But, you know, if people would just give it a chance, it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我去看心理医生？ - 甜心 你有问题
sense_groups.english: You want me to see a therapist? - Sweetheart, you obviously have a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 你选的男朋友 跟你爸是一个模子印出来的
sense_groups.english: You've chosen a boyfriend exactly like your father.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 妈 我会去预约
sense_groups.english: Okay, Mom, you know what? Fine. I'll make an appointment.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得走了 我还有事要做
sense_groups.english: Okay? But you know what? Right now, I gotta go. I gotta go do a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你妈花一千二买盆栽吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know your mother spent $1200 on bonsai trees?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得自己被绑得喘不过气
sense_groups.english: I felt like Gulliver around that place.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我真的很想听你说
sense_groups.english: Daddy, Daddy, I really want to hear more about this...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我还有事要做
sense_groups.english: I really do, but I just have to do, uh, some stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我努力经营婚姻
sense_groups.english: You work and you work and you work at a marriage...

sense_groups.chinese: 但他只在乎他的笨船
sense_groups.english: but all he cares about is his stupid boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我努力将船弄好
sense_groups.english: You work and you work and you work on a boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 他老是嘲笑我的陶艺课
sense_groups.english: He always ridiculed my pottery classes.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮它打光上漆
sense_groups.english: And you sand it and you varnish it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用尽所有办法 他还是用马克杯喝东西
sense_groups.english: But when all is said and done, he still drinks out of the mugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一晚是她的瑜伽课 跟《麦迪逊之桥》
sense_groups.english: One night of her yoga and her Bridges of Madison County...

sense_groups.chinese: 威士忌 香烟 - 盆栽 吉娃娃
sense_groups.english: Scotch, cigarettes... - Bonsais, the Chihuahua...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只做了三星期的心理治疗 但…
sense_groups.english: I've only been in therapy three weeks now but...

sense_groups.chinese: 她要一半的船做什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell does she want with half a boat?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你当上衣 我当皮肤
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, okay, you can be shirts and I'll be skins.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以当皮肤
sense_groups.english: I'll be skins.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧 老虎？
sense_groups.english: How you holding up there, tiger?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我爸妈离婚时 很多人叫我老虎
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sorry. When my parents were getting divorced, I got a lot of "tigers."

sense_groups.chinese: 也有人叫我冠军 老大跟小子
sense_groups.english: Ahem. I got a lot of "champs," "chiefs," "sports."

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个人叫我州长
sense_groups.english: Ahem. I even got a "governor."

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样 对吧？这就是我未来的人生
sense_groups.english: This is it, isn't it? I mean, this is what my life is gonna be like.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈在那里 我爸在那里
sense_groups.english: My mom there, my dad there.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节 圣诞节
sense_groups.english: Thanksgiving, Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 她拿到房子 他住公寓 我妹妹会用藤制品装饰它
sense_groups.english: She gets the house, he's in some condo my sister's gonna decorate with wicker.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你是怎么撑过来的？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, how did you get through this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了精心设计的心理治疗
sense_groups.english: Well, I relied on a carefully regimented program...

sense_groups.chinese: 治疗我的否认心态
sense_groups.english: of denial...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟尿床问题
sense_groups.english: and wetting the bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…感觉真的好怪
sense_groups.english: You know, I just... It's so weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在那里听他们责备彼此
sense_groups.english: I mean, I was in there just listening to them bitch about each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 脑袋里只想到国庆日
sense_groups.english: All I kept thinking about was the Fourth of July.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那让你想起
sense_groups.english: Because it reminded you of the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的开国元老如何责备彼此？
sense_groups.english: our forefathers used to bitch at each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是每年我们会…
sense_groups.english: It's just this thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 搭我爸的船出海看烟火
sense_groups.english: Every year we would go out on my dad's boat and watch the fireworks.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈非常讨厌那么做 因为海风会将她的头发吹乱
sense_groups.english: Mom always hated it because the ocean air made her hair all big.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妹妹吉儿会趴在船边吐
sense_groups.english: My sister Jill would be throwing up over the side...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸很生气因为没有人帮他
sense_groups.english: and my dad would be upset because nobody was helping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的去帮他时 他会骂我们做错了
sense_groups.english: And then when we did help, he would scream at us for doing it wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 但开始施放烟火后 大家会闭嘴
sense_groups.english: But then when the fireworks started, everybody just shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为真的很冷
sense_groups.english: You know, and it'd get really cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会一起窝在毯子里
sense_groups.english: And we'd all just sort of smoosh under this one blanket.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人想过要多带一条毯子
sense_groups.english: It never occurred to anybody to bring another one.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在…
sense_groups.english: And now it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们的光临 希望你们玩得开心
sense_groups.english: Thanks for coming. I hope you had fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得回去了
sense_groups.english: All right, Monica, dear, I'm gonna hit the road.

sense_groups.chinese: 我将我的十个动词放在桌上
sense_groups.english: Now, I've left my 10 verbs on the table.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要把完成的诗寄给我
sense_groups.english: Yes, and you be sure and send me that finished poem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的 很高兴你来了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, will do. So glad you came. - All right, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到瑞秋在走廊上 - 我去看看
sense_groups.english: I think I saw Rachel out in the hall. - Okay, let me go check.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈要跟你道别 - 噢 好
sense_groups.english: Your mom wants to say goodbye. - Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 甜心
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好开车
sense_groups.english: Uh, you drive safe.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 罗斯 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay. - What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我准备要去滑冰
sense_groups.english: I'm getting ready for the water skiing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再抱一次 快点
sense_groups.english: Okay, big hug. One more. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里？ - 拿我的外套
sense_groups.english: Dr. Green. Where are you going? - To get my coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 我们去帮你拿
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. We'll get that for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我可以自己去拿外套
sense_groups.english: All right, all right. I can get my own coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我们吃果馅饼兴奋过头了
sense_groups.english: Sorry, we're on a major flan high.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不该在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, you're not supposed to be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是准备区 这是不对的 你应该离开
sense_groups.english: This is the staging area. It's all wrong. You should leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得离开这里
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. You know, just get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你想来杯薄荷甜酒
sense_groups.english: Or perhaps you'd like a crème de menthe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回我的城堡去 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I have to be heading toward my chateau. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们要回走廊了
sense_groups.english: All right, well, then I guess we're going back into the hallway again.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你赶过来 葛林太太
sense_groups.english: Thanks for coming, Mrs. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重
sense_groups.english: You take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这些孩子
sense_groups.english: Oh, you kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是多年来我参加过最棒的派对
sense_groups.english: This is the best party I've been to in years.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 果馅饼时间到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, everybody, it's time for flan.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备大尝好吃的果冻
sense_groups.english: Yep. Get ready for the gelatinous fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很像严重成染时涂的药膏
sense_groups.english: Kind of looks like that stuff you get when you get a bad infection.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 许个特别的果馅饼愿望
sense_groups.english: Okay, Rachel, make a special flan wish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我许好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I've got one.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心
sense_groups.english: Heads up.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些愿望几乎都无法成真
sense_groups.english: Wow. Those things almost never come true.

questions.name: S02E23
questions.en:
Okay, Chandler, Mon, there's only one banana-nut muffin left.
I ordered mine first.
Yeah, but I'm so much faster.
Give it to me.
No.
Give it to me.
Okay, you can have it.
There you go. Enjoy your coffee.
That was there when I got here.
Hey, you guys, you will never guess who's coming to New York.
Quick, Phoebe, tell us before he swallows.
Ryan, that guy I went out with who's in the Navy.
You went out with a guy in the Navy?
Yeah, I met him while playing guitar in the park.
Ryan threw in saltwater taffy because he didn't have change.
Hey, is that when you wrote "Saltwater Taffy Man"?
No. Heh.
No, he's my submarine guy. He resurfaces, like, every couple years...
and we have the most amazing three days together.
Only this time, he's coming for two weeks. Two whole weeks, which means "yay."
So wait, this guy goes down for, like, two years at a time?
That'll teach you to lick my muffin.
Hi.
Oh, no. What happened?
I just spoke to Carol. Ben's got chicken pox.
Oh, no. You're kidding.
Yeah, so if you haven't had it, chances are you're gonna get it.
Well, I've had it. - Yeah, I've had it.
Had it. - Had it.
I've never had it. I feel so left out. Oh, look.
∮ So no one told you life was gonna be this way ∮
∮ Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. ∮
∮ It's like you're always stuck in second gear ∮
∮ When it hasn't been your day, ∮
∮ your week, your month, or even your year ∮
∮ but I'll be there for you ∮
∮ When the rain starts to pour ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ Like I've been there before ∮
∮ I'll be there for you ∮
∮ 'Cause you're there for me too ∮
Honey, you made the bed again.
I told you, you don't have to do that. This isn't camp.
Oh. Then I guess the panty raid last night was totally uncalled for.
Okay, I am going to take a shower.
And today I will be singing Jim Croce's "Leroy Brown."
Monica?
Hey, Mon, I have a question.
Is Leroy the baddest man in the whole damn town...
or the fattest man in the whole damn town?
The baddest. Otherwise, the song would be "Fat, Fat Leroy Brown."
What are you doing?
I'm just waiting for you, sweetie.
Are you remaking the bed?
I'm sorry, I'm sorry. You know what? The way you did it, it was just fine.
Then you're redoing it because?
If I tell you, you'll think I'm crazy.
You're pretty much running that risk either way.
Okay. You see...
the duvet tag shouldn't be at the top left corner...
it should be at the bottom right corner.
Uh-huh. Well, that's not so crazy. - I'm just easing you in.
Ha. All right.
All right, you see these little flower blossoms?
They should be facing up, not down...
because, well, the head of the bed is where the sun would be.
You don't love me anymore, do you?
Actually, if it's possible, I love you more.
Really?
Wow. Well, then, come on.
I wanna show you how to fold the toilet paper into a point.
Joey, if you need something to hold you over...
I can get you a job right here as an entry-level processor.
Don't you need experience for a job like that?
It's not that hard to learn.
And as for people realizing you don't know what you're doing, hey, you're an actor.
Act like a processor, people will think you're a processor.
Hey, Chandler. Here's this morning's projections.
Hey, thanks. Scott Alexander, Joey Tribbiani.
Hey - Hey.
Joey is a, uh, fellow processor.
No kidding?
Oh, yeah.
I process. People want the processing, I'm the one they call.
Where do you work? - Uh, well, right now I'm in between things.
You know how it is. One day you're processing, the next day...
you're not so much processing anymore.
I was telling Joey about the opening in Fleischman's group.
Fleischman's group.
Whatever you do, don't touch his sandwiches.
Are all you processors dorks?
Ugh. This lipstick looks just great on you.
You look fabulous, honey. You really do.
Yeah, are you sure? Really?
See, you look beautiful. For God sakes, dim the lights.
I'm hideous.
It's gonna be okay.
Ryan's been underwater.
He's just gonna be so glad that you don't have barnacles on your butt.
Come in.
Hey, baby, I'm back...
Hey, Ryan. What's up?
What's going on?
No, no. You have to stay back. I have the pox.
Chicken or small?
Chicken, which is so ironic considering I'm a vegetarian.
Why aren't you at home in bed? - My grandmother's never had chicken pox.
Please, please, tell me you have...
because oh, my God, I forgot how cute you are.
I'm sorry, I never had them. - Oh, oh!
If I had one wish, it'd be to build a time machine, go back to when I was 7...
when Jimmy Hauser had chicken pox...
I would grab that kid and rub him all over my face.
Yeah, or, you know, you could just wish that I didn't have them now.
Can I please see your face?
No. You don't wanna see a face covered with pox.
Your face could be covered with lox, I wouldn't care.
And you hate fish. Oh.
So sweet. All right.
Okay, all right. You can see.
This, ahem, is me.
Sorry.
I am scary.
Sorry, the lightning...
Lightning was an unfortunate coincidence.
You look lovely. Lovely.
I hate this.
I tell you, I had the most amazing two weeks planned for us.
And almost everything I had in mind, we had to be a lot closer than this.
Phoebe, I've spent the last eight months in a steel tube with men...
thinking about this moment.
I am not gonna let a bunch...
of itchy spots stand between us.
Okay. This is the most romantic disease I've ever had.
Hey. - Hey. How's the first day going?
Pretty good. It's like you said.
It's mostly just putting numbers from one column into another column.
Well, there you go.
Hey, and everybody's so nice.
I just had a good talk with that lady with the red hair, Jeannie.
Jeannie? The head of East Coast Operations, Jeannie?
Yeah. Turns out our kids go to the same school.
Yeah. Small world, huh? Ha, ha.
Weird world.
Your kids? - I figure my character has kids.
You know, there isn't a part of that sentence that I don't need explained.
Well, see, when you're acting, you need to think about stuff like that.
My character, Joseph the processing guy...
has two little girls, Ashley and Brittany.
Ashley copies everything Brittany does.
Oh. Well, invisible kids can be that way sometimes.
Yeah, yeah. You know, Joseph and his wife, Karen, are thinking of having a third kid.
You know what?
Just did.
Really, wow. That's some pretty powerful imaginary sperm you must have there.
You know what makes the itching even worse?
That you don't stop talking about it?
Fine. - Let's just play, okay?
Good, okay.
Here we go, double sixes.
Here we go...
Here we go.
Come to Mama. Just getting ready to roll the dice.
What are you doing? Are you scratching?
No. This is what I do for luck, okay?
You're scratching.
Give me the dice. - No.
Give me the dice. - No. Here. There.
Look, double sixes.
We can't scratch. You know we can't. We'll scar.
I can't stop thinking about it. It's just so hard.
I just wanna grab these houses and rub them all over my body.
No. No. - Give it.
Come on.
You know you want it. You know you want it too. Come on.
Let's just be bad. It'll feel so good.
Oh, come on. Come on.
Uh-huh. - Oh, God, help me.
Uh-huh. Good, huh? - Yeah.
Oh, yeah. - Okay, good. Now do me.
Do my back. Oh, come on. Harder.
There you go.
Don't move. - Why?
Don't move. - What are you?
Aah! Stop that. Stop that right now.
You know, I might've expected this of you, Phoebe.
But, Ryan, you're a military man.
You and Milton have to join us on the boat.
Karen will pack a lunch, you bring the kids. We'll make a day of it.
Oh, that sounds lovely. We're gonna have to set that up.
Oh, I better get back. Hope the baby feels better.
Oh, thanks. Thanks.
Bye-bye, Jeannie. Ha, ha. - Bye-bye, Joseph.
What a phony.
Well, I'm sure you'll teach her a lesson when she steps off the dock onto nothing.
Hey, Mr. Douglas. - Sir.
Uh, listen, Bing, I got your memo.
So we're not gonna see the report until next Friday?
Well, the people in my group want to spend the holiday with family.
I have a family. I'm gonna be here.
Yeah, Bing. What's that about?
It's about cutting my people a little slack, you know, for morale.
If you wanna see some rough numbers, I can get them to you by Wednesday.
Rough numbers?
This company was not built on rough numbers. Right, Mr. Douglas?
Have the final numbers on my desk by Tuesday.
If you say so, sir.
Joseph's good, isn't he?
Well, I'm going to kill you.
Hey, hey, I just figured Joseph's the kind of guy who likes to mix it up.
You know, get in there, ruffle some feathers.
Why?
Look, I'm sorry, but that's what Joseph does.
Okay? If you try to pull something...
he'll call you on it.
"What are you trying to pull?" he'll say.
Ooh. Duct tape.
Was I supposed to bring something too?
This is for the scratchy twins out there. I taped oven mitts to their hands.
You're strict.
Yeah, well, it's for their own good.
You know, I like the way you have efficiently folded this tab under.
See, in a tape emergency, you could shave valuable seconds off your time.
Exactly. Oh.
God, I love that I can be totally neurotic around you now.
