sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我处理人们要处理的东西 我是他们要找的人
sense_groups.english: I process. People want the processing, I'm the one they call.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在哪儿工作？ - 好吧 我现在在待业中
sense_groups.english: Where do you work? - Uh, well, right now I'm in between things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道是怎么回事 有一天 你在处理 第二天…
sense_groups.english: You know how it is. One day you're processing, the next day...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有那么多… 可处理了
sense_groups.english: you're not so much processing anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正告诉乔伊关于 佛莱许曼小组的职缺
sense_groups.english: I was telling Joey about the opening in Fleischman's group.

sense_groups.chinese: 佛莱许曼小组
sense_groups.english: Fleischman's group.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你做什么 不要碰三明治
sense_groups.english: Whatever you do, don't touch his sandwiches.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都是怪胎处理员吗？
sense_groups.english: Are all you processors dorks?

sense_groups.chinese: 这唇膏你涂起来很棒
sense_groups.english: Ugh. This lipstick looks just great on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很美 甜心 真的
sense_groups.english: You look fabulous, honey. You really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你确定吗？真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, are you sure? Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 看 你看起来很漂亮 拜托 把灯光调暗
sense_groups.english: See, you look beautiful. For God sakes, dim the lights.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好丑陋
sense_groups.english: I'm hideous.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有问题的
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 雷恩在水底下很久
sense_groups.english: Ryan's been underwater.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会很高兴看到 你的屁股上没有长牡蛎
sense_groups.english: He's just gonna be so glad that you don't have barnacles on your butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 进来
sense_groups.english: Come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 宝贝 我回来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, baby, I'm back...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 雷恩 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ryan. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 不…你必须保持距离 我长了痘痘
sense_groups.english: No, no. You have to stay back. I have the pox.

sense_groups.chinese: 水痘或天花？
sense_groups.english: Chicken or small?

sense_groups.chinese: 是水痘 真是讽刺 考虑到你刚从水底出来
sense_groups.english: Chicken, which is so ironic considering I'm a vegetarian.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你不在家里的床上？ - 因为我祖母从未得过水痘
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you at home in bed? - My grandmother's never had chicken pox.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 拜托 告诉我你得过
sense_groups.english: Please, please, tell me you have...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…哦 我的天 我忘了你有多么可爱
sense_groups.english: because oh, my God, I forgot how cute you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我从来没有得过 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I never had them. - Oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我有一个愿望 会是组装一台 时间机器 回去我还是七岁时
sense_groups.english: If I had one wish, it'd be to build a time machine, go back to when I was 7...

sense_groups.chinese: 当吉米豪瑟得水痘时…
sense_groups.english: when Jimmy Hauser had chicken pox...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会抓住那小子 把他抹遍我的脸
sense_groups.english: I would grab that kid and rub him all over my face.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 或是你知道 你可以希望 我现在没有得
sense_groups.english: Yeah, or, you know, you could just wish that I didn't have them now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以看看你的脸吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I please see your face?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 你不会想见到 长了痘痘的脸
sense_groups.english: No. You don't wanna see a face covered with pox.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脸盖满了鲑鱼 我也不会在意
sense_groups.english: Your face could be covered with lox, I wouldn't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你讨厌鱼
sense_groups.english: And you hate fish. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好心 好吧
sense_groups.english: So sweet. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你可以看
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right. You can see.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我
sense_groups.english: This, ahem, is me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很可怕
sense_groups.english: I am scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 是闪电…
sense_groups.english: Sorry, the lightning...

sense_groups.chinese: 闪电是不幸的巧合
sense_groups.english: Lightning was an unfortunate coincidence.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很可爱…
sense_groups.english: You look lovely. Lovely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这样
sense_groups.english: I hate this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你 我为我们计划了 最棒的两周
sense_groups.english: I tell you, I had the most amazing two weeks planned for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我脑海里 我们是比这样更接近的
sense_groups.english: And almost everything I had in mind, we had to be a lot closer than this.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我花了将近八个月的时间 与男人们在钢管中生活
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I've spent the last eight months in a steel tube with men...

sense_groups.chinese: 一直都在想像这个时刻
sense_groups.english: thinking about this moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让一堆…
sense_groups.english: I am not gonna let a bunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 会发痒的斑点挡在我们之间
sense_groups.english: of itchy spots stand between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这是我得过最浪漫的病了
sense_groups.english: Okay. This is the most romantic disease I've ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 第一天过得如何？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. How's the first day going?

sense_groups.chinese: 相当不错 就像你说的那样
sense_groups.english: Pretty good. It's like you said.

sense_groups.chinese: 大部分只是把号码从 一列填到另一列
sense_groups.english: It's mostly just putting numbers from one column into another column.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 就是这样
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大家都好友善
sense_groups.english: Hey, and everybody's so nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚才和一位叫珍妮的红头发女士畅谈
sense_groups.english: I just had a good talk with that lady with the red hair, Jeannie.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮？东岸开发部门主管的珍妮？
sense_groups.english: Jeannie? The head of East Coast Operations, Jeannie?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 原来我们的孩子上同一所学校
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Turns out our kids go to the same school.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 世界真小 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Small world, huh? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 世界真怪
sense_groups.english: Weird world.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的孩子？ - 我想我的角色应该有孩子
sense_groups.english: Your kids? - I figure my character has kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 那句话我没有一个字听得懂的
sense_groups.english: You know, there isn't a part of that sentence that I don't need explained.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 跟你说 当你在演戏时 你需要思考这样的东西
sense_groups.english: Well, see, when you're acting, you need to think about stuff like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的角色 约瑟夫处理员…
sense_groups.english: My character, Joseph the processing guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 有两个小女孩 爱绪莉和布莉塔妮
sense_groups.english: has two little girls, Ashley and Brittany.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱绪莉重复布莉塔妮所做的一切
sense_groups.english: Ashley copies everything Brittany does.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 无形的孩子 有时是会这样
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, invisible kids can be that way sometimes.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你知道 约瑟夫和他的妻子 凯伦在考虑生第三个孩子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. You know, Joseph and his wife, Karen, are thinking of having a third kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚生了
sense_groups.english: Just did.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 哇 你一定是有一些 非常强而有力的虚精子
sense_groups.english: Really, wow. That's some pretty powerful imaginary sperm you must have there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道是什么使痒痒 更糟糕的吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what makes the itching even worse?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不停谈论它吗？
sense_groups.english: That you don't stop talking about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 我们玩就好了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Let's just play, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Good, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 双六
sense_groups.english: Here we go, double sixes.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧…
sense_groups.english: Here we go...

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 准备掷骰子了
sense_groups.english: Come to Mama. Just getting ready to roll the dice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？你在抓痒吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? Are you scratching?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我这是在祈求好运 好吗？
sense_groups.english: No. This is what I do for luck, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在抓痒
sense_groups.english: You're scratching.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我骰子 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Give me the dice. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我骰子 - 不要 拿去
sense_groups.english: Give me the dice. - No. Here. There.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 双六
sense_groups.english: Look, double sixes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能抓痒 你知道的 我们不能 会有疤痕
sense_groups.english: We can't scratch. You know we can't. We'll scar.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法停止这么想 好难喔
sense_groups.english: I can't stop thinking about it. It's just so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想拿起这些房子 把它们在我身上磨擦
sense_groups.english: I just wanna grab these houses and rub them all over my body.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 - 给我
sense_groups.english: No. No. - Give it.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你想要 你知道你也想要 来吧
sense_groups.english: You know you want it. You know you want it too. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都来使坏 感觉会很棒
sense_groups.english: Let's just be bad. It'll feel so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 来吧 来吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 - 哦 上帝 帮助我
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - Oh, God, help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Good, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是的 - 好 好现在帮我
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. - Okay, good. Now do me.

sense_groups.chinese: 抓我的背 哦 来吧 用力一点
sense_groups.english: Do my back. Oh, come on. Harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要动 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Don't move. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要动 - 你在…？
sense_groups.english: Don't move. - What are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 停止 现在就停止
sense_groups.english: Aah! Stop that. Stop that right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 菲比 我是想过你可能会这样
sense_groups.english: You know, I might've expected this of you, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 雷恩 你是一个军人耶
sense_groups.english: But, Ryan, you're a military man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和米尔顿一定要 上船加入我们
sense_groups.english: You and Milton have to join us on the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯伦会准备午餐 你带孩子来 我们会玩得很痛快
sense_groups.english: Karen will pack a lunch, you bring the kids. We'll make a day of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 这听起来很棒 我们得订一个时间
sense_groups.english: Oh, that sounds lovely. We're gonna have to set that up.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我最好回去了 希望宝宝感觉好一些
sense_groups.english: Oh, I better get back. Hope the baby feels better.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 谢谢 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见 珍妮 约瑟夫
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye, Jeannie. Ha, ha. - Bye-bye, Joseph.

sense_groups.chinese: 好假的一个人
sense_groups.english: What a phony.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我敢肯定 你会给她一个教训 当她走下空无一物的码头时
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sure you'll teach her a lesson when she steps off the dock onto nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 道格拉斯先生 - 老板
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mr. Douglas. - Sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 宾 我得到了你的备忘录
sense_groups.english: Uh, listen, Bing, I got your memo.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们要到 下周五才看得到报告？
sense_groups.english: So we're not gonna see the report until next Friday?

sense_groups.chinese: 我这组的人 想与家人共度周末的节日
sense_groups.english: Well, the people in my group want to spend the holiday with family.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有家庭 但我会在这里
sense_groups.english: I have a family. I'm gonna be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 宾 那是怎么一回事呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Bing. What's that about?

sense_groups.chinese: 是要让我的人休息一下 知道吗 在道德上
sense_groups.english: It's about cutting my people a little slack, you know, for morale.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想看一些粗略的数字 我可以让他们在星期三给你
sense_groups.english: If you wanna see some rough numbers, I can get them to you by Wednesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 粗略数字？
sense_groups.english: Rough numbers?

sense_groups.chinese: 这家公司可不是用 粗略数字建立的对吧 道格拉斯先生？
sense_groups.english: This company was not built on rough numbers. Right, Mr. Douglas?

sense_groups.chinese: 在周二把最后的数字 放在我的办公桌上
sense_groups.english: Have the final numbers on my desk by Tuesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 就照你说的 老板
sense_groups.english: If you say so, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 约瑟夫很棒 是不是？
sense_groups.english: Joseph's good, isn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要杀死你
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm going to kill you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 我只是想约瑟夫 是喜欢搅和事情的人
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, I just figured Joseph's the kind of guy who likes to mix it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 进入状况 搅乱一池春水
sense_groups.english: You know, get in there, ruffle some feathers.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很抱歉 但是约瑟夫就是这样的人
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, but that's what Joseph does.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？如果你想把事情完成
sense_groups.english: Okay? If you try to pull something...

sense_groups.chinese: 他会拉你一把的
sense_groups.english: he'll call you on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会说:"你想要一把什么？"
sense_groups.english: "What are you trying to pull?" he'll say.

sense_groups.chinese: 胶带
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Duct tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我应该带的东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Was I supposed to bring something too?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是给外面那对抓痒双胞胎的 我用胶带把烤箱手套黏在他们手上
sense_groups.english: This is for the scratchy twins out there. I taped oven mitts to their hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真严厉
sense_groups.english: You're strict.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 为他们好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, it's for their own good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我喜欢你 很有效率地在底下这样摺
sense_groups.english: You know, I like the way you have efficiently folded this tab under.

sense_groups.chinese: 一有胶带的紧急状况 就可以省去宝贵的时间
sense_groups.english: See, in a tape emergency, you could shave valuable seconds off your time.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Exactly. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我很喜欢现在 可以在你身边表现得很神经质
sense_groups.english: God, I love that I can be totally neurotic around you now.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我说实话 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Tell me the truth. - Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得你更喜欢办公桌上的一切 都是垂直摆设的吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't you like it better that everything on your desk is perpendicular?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是正确的角度 那就是错误的角度
sense_groups.english: If it's not a right angle, it is a wrong angle.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Very good. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？明天我要调整你的时钟
sense_groups.english: You know what? Tomorrow, I'm gonna do your clocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要怎么调整我的时钟？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna do what to my clocks?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要设成我的时间
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna set them to my time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我很困惑
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm confused.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我们共享时间
sense_groups.english: I thought we shared time.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 没有 你看 在我的卧室 我设置我的时钟快六分钟
sense_groups.english: No, no. See, in my bedroom I set my clock six minutes fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想知道为什么？
sense_groups.english: You wanna know why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为在厨房的时区有点不同？
sense_groups.english: Because it's in a slightly different time zone than the kitchen?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？算了 我不要告诉你 - 不 来吧 来吧 告诉我
sense_groups.english: You know what? Forget it. - No, come on, come on, tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不明白 - 不 说吧
sense_groups.english: No, you don't understand. - No, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有任何这些 痴迷可爱的东西
sense_groups.english: No, you don't have any of these cute obsessive things.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 这不是真的 事实并非如此
sense_groups.english: No, that's not true. That is not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那告诉我你的事
sense_groups.english: All right, well, tell me one of yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的事情之一就是 我总是把我的运动袜…
sense_groups.english: One of my things is, I always separate my sweat socks...

sense_groups.chinese: 和套装袜分开
sense_groups.english: from my dress socks.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 如果它们混在一起呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - What if they get mixed up?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我会…
sense_groups.english: Boy, I would just, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会吓坏了
sense_groups.english: I would freak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不会
sense_groups.english: You would not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 我讨厌这样 你太正常了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. I hate this. You're too normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我的男友 没有任何东东
sense_groups.english: I can't believe my boyfriend doesn't have a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的男朋友 没有任何东东
sense_groups.english: My boyfriend doesn't have a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 如果有人偷听到 我的名声就完了
sense_groups.english: See, if anyone overheard that, I didn't come off well there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 道格拉斯先生正在找你 - 为什么道格拉斯先生要找我？
sense_groups.english: Mr. Douglas is looking for you. - Why? Why is Mr. Douglas looking for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他强烈的怀疑 你的贷款项目搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Because he has a strong suspicion that you dropped the ball on the Lender project.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么呢？为什么要他怀疑？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why does he suspect that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为一开始 他以为是约瑟夫…
sense_groups.english: Because at first, he thought it was Joseph...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过在问过约瑟夫后 原来是你…
sense_groups.english: but after he asked Joseph about it, turns out it was you.

sense_groups.english: She likes art...

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢古怪的字

sense_groups.english: yet for all you know, she could be 90 years old or have two heads.

sense_groups.english: Okay, ask her what is her method of birth control.

sense_groups.chinese: "我丈夫跟他的秘书上床"

sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. This is so humiliating.

What's that?

What?

What do I do with this?

It's weird, but I don't want to throw this away.
This is all I have left of him.
Gross...
...drain hair.
Cool! Oh, it looks like a tiny little person drowning in your cereal.
God, what is wrong with me? - You need to get some sleep.
I need to get some Richard.

I know. I know. I'm just so tired of missing him.
Tired of wondering why he hasn't called. Why hasn't he called?
Maybe because you told him not to?
What are you, the Memory Woman?
They're not breaking up! Chandler and Janice?
They're not breaking up! He didn't blink!
Well, you koow I'm not surprised. Have you seen them together?
They're really cute.
"Cute"? This is Janice!
You remember Janice?
Yes, I remember. She's annoying. But you know what?
She's his girlfriend now. I mean, what can we do?
There you go! That's the spirit I'm looking for! "What can we do?"
All right, who's first, huh? Ross?
Chandler's our friend, and Janice makes him happy.
So I say we be adult about it and accept her.
We'll call that Plan B.
Honey...
...I was wondering...
...do you still have that, um, Navy uniform?
No, I had to return it to the costume place.
I think I have an old band uniform from high school.
You remember not having sex in high school, right?
Yeah.
Well, honey, what about you?
What? - I mean...
Do you have any fun, you know, fantasy-type things?
No.
Come on. You gotta have one.
Nope.
Ross, you know what? - What?
If you tell me, I might do it.
Okay.
Did you ever see, um, Return of the Jedi?
Yeah.
Do you remember the scene...
...with, um, Jabba the Hutt?
Jabba had as his prisoner...
...Princess Leia.
Princess Leia was wearing...
...this, um, gold bikini thing.
It was pretty cool.
Yeah, Princess Leia and the gold bikini? Oh, every guy our age loved that.
Really?
It's huge! That's the moment when she stopped being a princess...
...and she became, like, you know, a woman.
Did you ever do the Leia thing?
Oh, yeah. Mm-hm.
Really? That great, huh?
No, it's just that I got this new pager, and I have it on "vibrate."
See you.
Hey.
Hi, you guys!
Look who I found standing outside the Szechuan Dragon...
...staring at a parking meter.
Ahem. Mon. Hi. - Hi.
Why aren't you at work? - Oh, they sent me home.
Why?
Because I don't work at the Szechuan Dragon.
You really need to get some sleep.
I know I do.
Hi. - Hi.

Oh! Really? Let me see, let me see.
Rach, look!
No.
Hi. Ha, ha.

There he is!
Hey. - Wheel!
Fortune!
This guy's so stupid.

I say I am there!
Cool! Oh.
Is Ross going too?
No. Janice.
Janice?
Because I just feel bad for Ross, you know?
We always go together. We're like The Three Hockey-teers, you know?
You koow, I may be way out on a limb here, but do you have a problem with Janice?
No!
Yes...
Oh, God, how do I say this? Uh...
You know that girl from the restaurant with the hair?

sense_groups.english: Has she slept at all? - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 已经连续三个晚上了
sense_groups.english: It's been three nights in a row.

sense_groups.chinese: 从昨天起 她终于不哭了
sense_groups.english: She finally stopped crying yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是她又在阳台发现理查抽过的雪茄
sense_groups.english: But then she found one of Richard's cigar butts on the terrace...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这说明了为何我在清晨两点接到一通电话
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay, that explains it. I got a call at 2 in the morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我只能听到一些吱吱的声音
sense_groups.english: ...and all I could hear was this squeaky sound.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就想"一定是老鼠或负鼠"
sense_groups.english: So I thought, "Oh, it's a mouse or a possum."

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我就想 好吧…
sense_groups.english: Then I realized, like, okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 老鼠或负鼠怎么会有钱打电话呢
sense_groups.english: ...where would a mouse or a possum get the money to make the phone call?

sense_groups.chinese: 早 - 早 嘿
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Morning. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了煎饼啊
sense_groups.english: You made pancakes?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你还以为我真的会做呢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like there's any way I could ever do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和瑞秋有糖浆
sense_groups.english: Monica and Rachel had syrup

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我可以让我的男人开心了
sense_groups.english: Uh, uh Now I can get my man to cheer up.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Good morning, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安
sense_groups.english: Good morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 干脆这样吧
sense_groups.english: Here's a thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别去上班 跟我在一起就好了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you stay home from work and just hang out with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 但愿如此
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有报告要做 而我得去见律师
sense_groups.english: You have that report to finish, and I've got to see my lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不敢相信 我竟跟要离婚的女生约会
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I date a girl who's getting divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真像个大人
sense_groups.english: I'm such a grownup.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了…
sense_groups.english: I gotta go, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我个吻才能走
sense_groups.english: Not without a kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者我就不亲你 这样你就会留下来
sense_groups.english: Maybe I won't kiss you so you'll stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲她
sense_groups.english: Kiss her. Kiss her!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见亲爱的 拜 乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'll see you later, sweetie. Bye, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye, Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候要甩掉她
sense_groups.english: So when are you dumping her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次不会了
sense_groups.english: Not this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 别整我了
sense_groups.english: Heh. Come on, quit yanking me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有整你啊
sense_groups.english: I'm not yanking you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位可是珍妮丝 - 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: This is Janice. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 她让我很开心
sense_groups.english: She makes me happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看着我的眼睛 毫不犹豫地告诉我
sense_groups.english: You look me in the eye and tell me, without blinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 说你不会跟她分手 不准眨眼睛哦
sense_groups.english: ...that you're not breaking up with her. No blinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会跟她分手
sense_groups.english: I'm not breaking up with her!

sense_groups.chinese: 搞什么
sense_groups.english: What's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你看我在排水管里发现什么
sense_groups.english: God, look what I found in the drain!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是理查的头发
sense_groups.english: It's some of Richard's hair!

sense_groups.chinese: 我该拿这些怎么办
sense_groups.english: What do I do with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 第一件事就是把它从我身边拿开
sense_groups.english: Getting it away from me would be job one.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么说有点奇怪 但我并不想把它丢掉
sense_groups.english: It's weird, but I don't want to throw this away.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是我仅有属于他的东西
sense_groups.english: This is all I have left of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 恶心的…
sense_groups.english: Gross...

sense_groups.chinese: 排水管的头发
sense_groups.english: ...drain hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好玩 好像有一个小人在你的麦片里淹死了
sense_groups.english: Cool! Oh, it looks like a tiny little person drowning in your cereal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是怎么了 - 你需要一些睡眠
sense_groups.english: God, what is wrong with me? - You need to get some sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要的是理查
sense_groups.english: I need to get some Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟他分手是有原因的
sense_groups.english: You broke up with him for a reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道… 我只是不想再这么想他
sense_groups.english: I know. I know. I'm just so tired of missing him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不愿再去想 他为何不打来 他为何都没打来
sense_groups.english: Tired of wondering why he hasn't called. Why hasn't he called?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能因为你叫他别再打来
sense_groups.english: Maybe because you told him not to?

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底是什么 记忆女王吗
sense_groups.english: What are you, the Memory Woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不会分手 我是说钱德和珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: They're not breaking up! Chandler and Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不会分手 他连眼睛都没眨一下
sense_groups.english: They're not breaking up! He didn't blink!

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点也不惊讶 你看过他们在一起的样子吗
sense_groups.english: Well, you koow I'm not surprised. Have you seen them together?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们真的好可爱
sense_groups.english: They're really cute.

sense_groups.chinese: "可爱" 那可是珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: "Cute"? This is Janice!

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得珍妮丝吗
sense_groups.english: You remember Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得啊 她很惹人厌 但是你知道吗
sense_groups.english: Yes, I remember. She's annoying. But you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 她现在是他的女朋友 那我们能怎么办
sense_groups.english: She's his girlfriend now. I mean, what can we do?

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了 我就是要这种精神 "我们能怎么办"
sense_groups.english: There you go! That's the spirit I'm looking for! "What can we do?"

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谁先来罗斯
sense_groups.english: All right, who's first, huh? Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德是我们的朋友 而珍妮丝能让他快乐
sense_groups.english: Chandler's our friend, and Janice makes him happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们就成熟点 接受她
sense_groups.english: So I say we be adult about it and accept her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个先归类在B计划
sense_groups.english: We'll call that Plan B.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Honey...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想啊…
sense_groups.english: ...I was wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 你那套海军制服还在吗
sense_groups.english: ...do you still have that, um, Navy uniform?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我拿去戏服店还了
sense_groups.english: No, I had to return it to the costume place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有一套高中乐团的旧制服
sense_groups.english: I think I have an old band uniform from high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得高中时没有做爱吧
sense_groups.english: You remember not having sex in high school, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 那么你呢
sense_groups.english: Well, honey, what about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么啊 - 我的意思是…
sense_groups.english: What? - I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有过任何有趣的幻想吗
sense_groups.english: Do you have any fun, you know, fantasy-type things?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你一定有
sense_groups.english: Come on. You gotta have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你知道吗 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Ross, you know what? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你跟我说 或许我会帮你实现
sense_groups.english: If you tell me, I might do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有看过 "星际大战 绝地大反攻"
sense_groups.english: Did you ever see, um, Return of the Jedi?

sense_groups.chinese: 看过
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记不记得那个镜头…
sense_groups.english: Do you remember the scene...

sense_groups.chinese: 当赫特族的贾霸出现时
sense_groups.english: ...with, um, Jabba the Hutt?

sense_groups.chinese: 贾霸和他的囚犯…
sense_groups.english: Jabba had as his prisoner...

sense_groups.chinese: 莉亚公主
sense_groups.english: ...Princess Leia.

sense_groups.chinese: 莉亚公主穿着…
sense_groups.english: Princess Leia was wearing...

sense_groups.chinese: 金色的比基尼
sense_groups.english: ...this, um, gold bikini thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样还蛮酷的
sense_groups.english: It was pretty cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 莉亚公主穿金色比基尼 我们这年纪的男人都很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Princess Leia and the gold bikini? Oh, every guy our age loved that.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 很重要的 那个时刻 她不再是个公主
sense_groups.english: It's huge! That's the moment when she stopped being a princess...

sense_groups.chinese: 她变成了一个女人
sense_groups.english: ...and she became, like, you know, a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你曾扮过莉亚公主吗
sense_groups.english: Did you ever do the Leia thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 有那么棒啊
sense_groups.english: Really? That great, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只是我买了新的呼叫器 我把它调成振动
sense_groups.english: No, it's just that I got this new pager, and I have it on "vibrate."

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好啊
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看我在四川龙餐厅外找到谁了
sense_groups.english: Look who I found standing outside the Szechuan Dragon...

sense_groups.chinese: 她盯着停车收费表看
sense_groups.english: ...staring at a parking meter.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Mon. Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么没去上班 - 他们把我送回家了
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you at work? - Oh, they sent me home.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我并不是在四川龙餐厅上班
sense_groups.english: Because I don't work at the Szechuan Dragon.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的需要睡一下
sense_groups.english: You really need to get some sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我需要
sense_groups.english: I know I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜发生了什么事 他们发表了我的论文
sense_groups.english: Guess what? They published my paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 让我看看…
sense_groups.english: Oh! Really? Let me see, let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你看
sense_groups.english: Rach, look!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我那强壮的罗斯天行者何时会来拯救我
sense_groups.english: Where is my strong Ross Skywalker to come rescue me?

sense_groups.chinese: 他来了
sense_groups.english: There he is!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 轮盘…
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Wheel!

sense_groups.chinese: 财富
sense_groups.english: Fortune!

sense_groups.chinese: 这个家伙好笨
sense_groups.english: This guy's so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗斯摩尔伯爵啦
sense_groups.english: It's Count Rushmore!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的该去参加这个节目
sense_groups.english: You should really go on this show.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有三张今晚去看"游骑兵队"的票 你觉得如何
sense_groups.english: All right, lisen, I got three tickets to the Rangers tonight. What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定去
sense_groups.english: I say I am there!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Cool! Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯也会去吗
sense_groups.english: Is Ross going too?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: No. Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我会替罗斯难过 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: Because I just feel bad for Ross, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们总是一起去的 我们是冰球三兄弟啊
sense_groups.english: We always go together. We're like The Three Hockey-teers, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是我误会你了 你是否反成珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: You koow, I may be way out on a limb here, but do you have a problem with Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 对啦…
sense_groups.english: Yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我该怎么说
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, how do I say this? Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道希腊餐厅里那个头发很蓬的女孩子
sense_groups.english: You know that girl from the restaurant with the hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个我很讨厌的女孩子 她快把我逼疯了
sense_groups.english: Ooh! That girl that I hate? Ugh! She drives me crazy. Ew.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我不讨厌珍妮丝 只是她令人难以忍受
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't hate Janice. She's just a lot to take, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你终于说出来了
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 别那样看着我
sense_groups.english: Come on, don't look at me like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前她也快把你逼疯了 记得吗
sense_groups.english: She drove you nuts before too, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我现在为她疯狂 这次可能是来真的
sense_groups.english: I'm crazy about her now. l think this could be the real thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说"真的"
sense_groups.english: Capital R, capital T!

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我语法没错
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, those are the right letters.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底要我说什么
sense_groups.english: Look, what do you want me to say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你说你喜欢她
sense_groups.english: I want you to say that you like her!

sense_groups.chinese: 我说不出来 这像是一种化学作用
sense_groups.english: I can't. It's like this chemical thing, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 每次她一开始笑 我就想…
sense_groups.english: Every time she starts laughing, I just wanna...

sense_groups.chinese: 想把我的手臂拔下来 我就能往她身上砸
sense_groups.english: ...pull my arm off so I have something to throw at her.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你的努力
sense_groups.english: Thanks for trying.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 根本就没有罗斯摩尔伯爵
sense_groups.english: Oh, and by the way, there is no Count Rushmore!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是谁在罗斯摩尔山上塑了那些总统肖像
sense_groups.english: Then who's the guy that painted the faces on the mountain?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可以告诉她
sense_groups.english: How could you tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想又没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: I didn't think it would be that big a deal!

sense_groups.chinese: 她认为没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: Oh. She didn't think it would be a big deal!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在跟谁讲话
sense_groups.english: Who are you talking to when you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些应该是我们之间很私密的对话
sense_groups.english: Look, that was supposed to be a private, personal thing between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比是我的闺密 好吗 我们无话不谈的
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, Phoebe is my girlfriend, okay? We tell each other everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人也一样啊
sense_groups.english: l mean, come on! Guys do the same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些更衣室里的谈话呢
sense_groups.english: I mean, what about all that locker-room stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不一样 我们会谈 像是谁跟脱衣舞娘约会
sense_groups.english: That's different, okay? That's like, uh, who dated a stripper?

sense_groups.chinese: 或谁在史坦登岛渡轮后面做爱
sense_groups.english: Or who did it on the back of the Staten Island ferry?

sense_groups.chinese: 这两个都是乔伊吧 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Both of those Joey? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们不谈自己的女友…
sense_groups.english: But you don't talk about your girlfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有和女友之间做的亲密的事
sense_groups.english: ...and the intimate stuff you do with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 连最好的朋友也不谈 - 不啊
sense_groups.english: Not even with your best friend? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可悲啊
sense_groups.english: That is so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们错过太多乐趣了
sense_groups.english: You're missing out on so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是种交心与分享的感觉…
sense_groups.english: I mean, the bonding and the sharing...

sense_groups.chinese: 并知道他们也和你经历过一样的事
sense_groups.english: ...and knowing they're going through the same thing you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你们什么都跟对方说吗
sense_groups.english: Oh. So, what, you tell each other everything?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多啊
sense_groups.english: Pretty much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有没有谈过那次一夜五次的事
sense_groups.english: Did you talk about the Night of Five Times?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有告诉她们那次一夜五次的事
sense_groups.english: Do you tell people about the Night of Five Times?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 你那次是跟卡萝
sense_groups.english: Uh, honey, that was with Carol.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我想还是值得一提
sense_groups.english: I know, but it's still worth mentioning, I think.

sense_groups.chinese: 全身肌肉放松
sense_groups.english: Relax every muscle in your body.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着叮叮咚咚的音乐
sense_groups.english: Listen to the plinky-plunky music.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 闭上你的眼睛
sense_groups.english: Okay, now close your eyes...

sense_groups.chinese: 想一个很愉快的地方
sense_groups.english: ...and think of a happy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我让你快乐的地方是哪里
sense_groups.english: Tell me your happy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查家的客厅 一起喝红酒
sense_groups.english: Richard's living room, drinking wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…不可以跟理查有关 把酒杯放下 快出来
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Not a Richard thing. Just put down the glass and get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 那是让我快乐的地方
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, but that's my happy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我的快乐地方借你用 但别弄乱
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. Use my happy place. Just don't move anything in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会试着不乱动
sense_groups.english: I'll try not to.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你现在在草地上…
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right, so, you're in a meadow...

sense_groups.chinese: 天上有一月繁星
sense_groups.english: ...millions of stars in the sky...

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得分手是错误的吗
sense_groups.english: You think breaking up was a huge mistake?

sense_groups.chinese: 快乐的地方不准问问题
sense_groups.english: There are no questions in the happy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有和煦的微风和从树上洒下的月光
sense_groups.english: Just the warm breeze and the moonlight flowing through the trees.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌他一定忘了我 我打赌他好得很
sense_groups.english: I'll bet he's over me. I'll bet he's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 快乐的地方不允许赌博和下注
sense_groups.english: Betting and wagering of any kind are not permitted in the happy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 那里只有…美丽的瀑布
sense_groups.english: There's just, you know, the lovely waterfalls...

sense_groups.chinese: 和缓慢流动着的喷泉
sense_groups.english: ...and the trickling fountains...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有低声轻语的小溪产生平静的音律
sense_groups.english: ...and the calming sounds of the babbling brook.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 一点用也没有
sense_groups.english: Okay, this isn't working.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是醒着的 而且我得去上厕所
sense_groups.english: I'm still awake, and now I have to pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说…
sense_groups.english: So I hear...

sense_groups.chinese: 你讨厌我
sense_groups.english: ...you hate me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没说我讨厌你 我可是很小心的
sense_groups.english: I, uh, never said hate. I was very careful about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人私下告诉我 你想扯下手臂丢到我身上
sense_groups.english: A little birdie told me you wanting to rip your arm off and throw it at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样你就觉得我讨厌你 你也太断章取义了吧
sense_groups.english: And you got "hate" from that? You're taking a big leap there, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, fine, fine, fine!

sense_groups.chinese: 这种情形我们得想点策略
sense_groups.english: We have got to do something about our little situation here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的主意
sense_groups.english: So this is my idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和我花点时间 好好相处
sense_groups.english: You and me spending some quality time together.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是那有什么关系…
sense_groups.english: But what does that...?

sense_groups.chinese: 为了钱德
sense_groups.english: For Chandler!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我加入
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm in.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这就叫做 乔伊和珍妮丝的快乐一日游
sense_groups.english: Okay! This is what we'll call it: Joey and Janice's Day of Fun!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的要一整天吗
sense_groups.english: Does it have to be a day?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为如果要你爱上我 得花上一整天
sense_groups.english: Yes, because that's how long it takes to love me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 我知道 我睡在你们的隔壁
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. Ha. I sleep in the next room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天去了邮局
sense_groups.english: I went down to the post office...

sense_groups.chinese: 寄来的是我订的录影带
sense_groups.english: ...and it turns out it was those videos that I ordered...

sense_groups.chinese: 是帮理查订的有关内战的
sense_groups.english: ...for Richard about the Civil War.

sense_groups.chinese: 他很喜欢看内战电影
sense_groups.english: He loved the Civil War.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要我们带你回家
sense_groups.english: Do you want us to take you home?

sense_groups.chinese: 带我到遥远的银河去吧
sense_groups.english: Or maybe to a galaxy far, far away.

sense_groups.chinese: 女人什么事都聊 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: Women tell each other everything. Did you know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 钱德 我是说全部的事
sense_groups.english: No, Chandler, everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢的东西 她喜欢的东西
sense_groups.english: Like stuff you like. Stuff she likes.

sense_groups.chinese: 技巧 精力 腰围
sense_groups.english: Technique. Stamina. Girth.

sense_groups.chinese: 腰围
sense_groups.english: Girth?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么…
sense_groups.english: Why? Why? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 她们为何这样做
sense_groups.english: Why would they do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋说分享的感觉很棒 而…
sense_groups.english: Rachel says sharing's great and supposedly...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也应该这么做
sense_groups.english: ...we ought to be doing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要吗
sense_groups.english: Uh, do you want to?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会要讨论腰围吧 - 那倒不是
sense_groups.english: We're not gonna talk about girth? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay. Yeah. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你先吧
sense_groups.english: All right, you go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我先说 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, I'll go first. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有天晚上…
sense_groups.english: So, uh, the other night...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋和我在床上讨论彼此的性幻想
sense_groups.english: ...Rachel and I are in bed talking about fantasies...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就形容了一个画面…
sense_groups.english: ...and I happened to describe a particular...

sense_groups.chinese: "星际大战"里的…
sense_groups.english: ...Star Wars thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 莉亚公主和金色比基尼 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Princess Leia and the gold bikini. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know! - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这倒挺容易的
sense_groups.english: Well, that was easy. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 换你了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 来吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 当你跟一个女人在床上…
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know when you're in bed with a woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 正在亲热…
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, ahem, you know, you're fooling around...

sense_groups.chinese: 脑袋里突然出现一些疯狂的念头
sense_groups.english: ...and you get all these mental images in your brain?

sense_groups.chinese: 就像超级名模艾尔或是影印店的那个女孩吗
sense_groups.english: Like Elle MacPherson or the girl at the Xerox place?

sense_groups.chinese: 穿了肚脐环的那个 - 我就知道
sense_groups.english: With the bellybutton ring? Oh. - Oh! I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是突然之间你忽然想到你妈
sense_groups.english: And then all of a sudden, your mom pops into your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你就想 "妈 快走开啦"
sense_groups.english: And you're, like, "Mom, get out of here!"

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 这之后你就完全没情绪再想其他人了
sense_groups.english: But after that, you can't think of anything else.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你正在做的事又不能停止 所以你就好像…
sense_groups.english: And you can't stop what you're doing. So it's kind of like you're...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道…
sense_groups.english: ...you know, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道
sense_groups.english: You don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈妈
sense_groups.english: Your mom?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说跟你妈一起 你究竟有什么毛病
sense_groups.english: You're telling me about your mom? What's the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说… - 我说要"分享" 不是"吓唬人"
sense_groups.english: You said... - I said "share," not "scare"!

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我坐到那边去
sense_groups.english: Go sit over there!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回来了
sense_groups.english: We're back!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们俩在一起干嘛
sense_groups.english: What are you guys doing together?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊和珍妮丝的快乐一日游
sense_groups.english: Joey and Janice's Day of Fun!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去看"纽约大都会"的比赛 还吃了中国菜
sense_groups.english: We went to a Mets game. We got Chinese food.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 我爱这个女人
sense_groups.english: And, uh, you know, I love this woman. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有竞争对手了 兄弟
sense_groups.english: You have got competition, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是上来亲你一下
sense_groups.english: Well, I just came by to give you a kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去接孩子了 等一下见 甜心
sense_groups.english: I have to go pick up the baby. So I'll see you later, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是 钱德
sense_groups.english: You too, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是受不了她 是吗 - 抱歉 我已尽最大努力了
sense_groups.english: You still can't stand her, can you? - I'm sorry, man. I tried! I really did!

sense_groups.chinese: 还是谢谢你的努力
sense_groups.english: I appreciate you giving it a shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是有一点可喜的是…
sense_groups.english: But you know, the good thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们整天在一起 而我还能存活
sense_groups.english: ...is that we spent the whole day together and I survived.

sense_groups.chinese: 更了不起的是 她也做到了
sense_groups.english: And what's even more amazing, so did she. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天是"大都会"主场的球棒日
sense_groups.english: It was Bat Day at Shea Stadium.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这还蛮了不起的
sense_groups.english: I guess that's something.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这可是大事呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, that's huge!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我知道我可以待在她旁边 表示…
sense_groups.english: Now I know I can stand to be around her. Which means...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以和你一起出去…
sense_groups.english: ...I get to hang out with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正这就是我的重点
sense_groups.english: Which is kind of the whole point anyway. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在咖啡店停了一下 结果遇到罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey! We, uh, stopped by the coffee shop and, uh, ran into Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望这会让你好过点 我也会有这种想法
sense_groups.english: If it makes you feel any better, I do it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 当我在做爱时 一直都会想像你妈的样子
sense_groups.english: I always picture your mom when I'm having sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 美国在山德堡的部队受到炮轰
sense_groups.english: The United States garrison at Fort Sumter was fired upon.

sense_groups.chinese: 这场炮轰是由于…
sense_groups.english: It is now under bombardment by...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 你怎么来了
sense_groups.english: Dad, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈今晚打桥牌 所以我进城来抱抱摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: It's your mother's bridge night, so I came into the city for a Moni-cuddle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候开始抽雪茄了
sense_groups.english: Since when did you start smoking cigars?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 只是喜欢闻它的味道
sense_groups.english: I don't. I just like the smell of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里真正的目的是什么
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what are you really doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想确定一下你没事
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to make sure you're okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么会不好呢
sense_groups.english: Why wouldn't I be okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到理查了
sense_groups.english: I saw Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗
sense_groups.english: So how you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有点累 但我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm just a little tired, but I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查怎么样了 - 你不会想知道的
sense_groups.english: Ahem. How's Richard doing? - You don't want to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想知道
sense_groups.english: No, I really, really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的情况很糟
sense_groups.english: Well, he's doing terrible!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 比他跟芭芭拉分手时还糟
sense_groups.english: Worse than when he broke up with Barbara.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是故意这么说的吧 - 那个男人简直一团糟
sense_groups.english: You're not just saying that, are you? - No, the man is a mess!

sense_groups.chinese: 他有没有哭 - 没有
sense_groups.english: Was he crying? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他是否等你走后才开始哭
sense_groups.english: Do you think he was waiting till after you left, so he could cry?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想也是
sense_groups.english: I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 感情这回事很难说 就像我跟你妈
sense_groups.english: Honey, relationships are hard. Like with your mom and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 大学毕业后我们曾分手一阵子
sense_groups.english: You know, after we graduated from college, we broke up for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 她父亲 就是你外公 似乎…
sense_groups.english: It seems her father, your grandfather...

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你妈跟他一样到欧洲四处旅行…
sense_groups.english: ...wanted her to travel around Europe like he did.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 他花的是美国政府的钱
sense_groups.english: Of course, he got to do it on Uncle Sam's nickel...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为当时他也在猛轰德国列车
sense_groups.english: ...because he was also strafing German troop trains at the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 然而…
sense_groups.english: However...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 开始吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是贾霸的囚犯 而你…
sense_groups.english: I am Jabba's prisoner. And you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你脸上的表情好怪
sense_groups.english: ...have a really weird look on your face.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 亲爱的有什么问题
sense_groups.english: What? Honey, what is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的头发不对吗
sense_groups.english: Did I get the hair wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是别的问题 跟你想像的不同 还是…
sense_groups.english: Or what? Did you just picture it differently? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你的问题 是…
sense_groups.english: No, no. It's, um... It's not you. It's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 拜托 甜心 你快把我吓坏了
sense_groups.english: What is it? Come on, sweetie. You're, like, freaking me out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨死钱德了 那个王八蛋毁了我的人生
sense_groups.english: I hate Chandler. The bastard ruined my life!

Hey.

I'd feel better if you got dressed now.
Okay. - Okay.

Really?
Hi. - Hi.

No.

Makeup's on. Hair's done.
I just have to get dressed.
And that takes, what? Just 6 or 7 minutes?
Yeah. Once I figure out what I'm wearing.
Glass of fat?
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

Nope.
You wanna hear it? - Am I in it?
After I thank everyone for donating to the museum...
...I sing a song about the wonder that is Joey.
Hello. - Hey.
Hello! You look great!
Thank you. I know, though.
You see this? This is a person who is ready to go.
Phoebe, you...
You are my star.
Aw. Well, you're my lucky penny.
All right, I took the quiz, and it turns out I do put career before men.
Get up.
What?
You're in my seat. - How is this your seat?
I was sitting there.
But then you left.
Well, it's not like I went to Spain.
I went to the bathroom. You knew I'd be back.
What's the big deal? Sit somewhere else!
The "big deal" is, I was sitting there last! So...
...it's my seat.
Well, actually, the last place you were sitting was in there, so...
You guys, you know what? It doesn't matter.
You both have to go get dressed before the big vein in my head pops.
I just have to do one thing. It's not a big deal.
Get up!
Hi. - Hey.
Ooh. Phoebe, you look great!
All right already.
Ooh. Are you gonna do magic?
That's funny. Change.
Hang on, I just got in. - I don't care.
It starts at 8. We can't be late.
"He could not, would not, want to wait."
Our table is down in front. My boss will be there.
Everyone will see if we arrive after it starts.
Has somebody been drinking my fat?
Does this look like something a paleontologist's girlfriend would wear?
I don't know. You might be the first one.
Rach, did you check the machine? - No.
Wait. This is the outfit that makes my calves look fat. Never mind.
Well, Joey, I wrote a little song today.
It's called, "Get up!"
All right. You can have the chair.
Really? - Oh, my. Would you look at that?
I'm coming over.
What if I'm already there when you play this message?
Is that too spooky?
Hi, Rach, are you there? It's me. Pick up.
Rachel? Rach?
What?
Never mind.
Monica, it's Richard. Call me.
Is that message old or new?
Old or new? Old or new?
It's definitely old. Didn't you hear the double beep?
What if it's new? We agreed not to talk.
It could be important. Shouldn't I call him back?
Honey, you did call him back. It's old.
Yeah, see, Mon, listen. Listen.
When Carol and I broke up...
...I went through the same thing. You know what I did?
I got dressed.
Really, really quickly, okay? Okay?
There we go. There we go.
You know what? Don't get up. Just sit there.
I just hope you don't mind my hand right here.
Not touching. Can't get mad! Not touching. Can't get mad!
Not touching. Can't get mad!
Oh! Oh, my God!
You rotten boys!
Sorry, Phoebe. - What am I gonna do?
Don't rub it! What gets out hummus?
What gets out hummus?
Monica! What gets out hummus?
If it is a new message, what is he calling to say?
Okay, thanks. Yeah, I'll try that.
Maybe he called to say you're obsessive and crazy?
So should I call him back? - No!
No!
Fine, we'll both sit in the chair. - Fine with me.
I am so comfortable.
Me too.
In fact, I think I might be a little too comfortable.
Okay, we have 19 minutes. I want you to go and change.
When you come back, Joey will go change, and he'll have vacated the chair.
Okay. - All right.
Fine. I'm going.
When I get back, it's Chair City. And I'm the guy...
...who's sitting in a chair!
Is this a little too...?
Pheebs? What happened?
I got the hummus.
Oh, honey, we'll find you something. You wanna wear my black jacket?
It won't go with this dress. - You're right.
Well, let's just get you out of that. - No, no, no. Not out of that.
Not out of clothes. - Can Phoebe borrow your green dress?
I called him.
Yes. I got his machine and I left a message.
But it's okay. It's okay...
...because it was, like, a casual, breezy message.
It was breezy.
Oh, God, what if it wasn't breezy?
How could it not be breezy? No, because you're in such a breezy place.
I got it. I'll play my message, and you guys tell me if it's breezy enough.
But how you gonna do that?
I know the code to his answering machine.
Okay, Mon, I really don't think this is the...
Okay, you're dialing. You are dialing.
Hi, this is Richard. Please leave a message at the tone.
You have two new messages.
What a cool job.
"You have two new messages."
Please pass the pie.
Hi, it's Monica. I'm just checking in.
I got a message and didn't know if it was old or new...
...so I'm just checking.
So let me know.
Or don't. Whatever.
I'm breezy!
You can't say you're "breezy." That negates the "breezy."
Hola. It's me. Yesterday was really fun.
Call me about this weekend, okay?
Now, she sounded breezy.
He's seeing someone. I can't believe he's seeing someone.
You don't know that. - Well, whose voice was that?
Maybe it was his sister's. Maybe it was his daughter's.
Michelle. Of course! Did it sound like Michelle?
Oh, great. It's starting to rain. That'll make it easier to get a cab.
It was Michelle.
It was definitely Michelle.
Try Monica's green dress. If it doesn't fit, wear my gray silk one.
Unless I wear it. - You don't know what you're wearing?
I'm just trying to look nice for your big night.
Yeah, which we have to leave for in 12 minutes.
Come on, I'll just pick something out for you.
You'll notice that I'm fully dressed.
I, in turn, have noticed that you are not.
So in the words of A.A. Milne, "Get out of my chair, dill-hole."
Okay.
What are you doing? - You said to give you the chair.
You didn't say anything about cushions.
They're the essence of the chair!
That's right! I'm taking the essence.
Oh, he'll be back.
Oh, there's nobody in the room.
I'm sorry, I thought it looked pretty. - That was a Halloween costume.
Unless you would like me to go as Little Bo Peep.
I didn't recognize it without that inflatable sheep.
