sense_groups.chinese: 真好笑 给我换衣服去
sense_groups.english: That's funny. Change.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢点 我才刚进门 - 我才不管
sense_groups.english: Hang on, I just got in. - I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚会八点开始 我们不能迟到
sense_groups.english: It starts at 8. We can't be late.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不能等 也不愿意等
sense_groups.english: "He could not, would not, want to wait."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的桌子在前方 我老板也会在那里
sense_groups.english: Our table is down in front. My boss will be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 若晚会开始后我们才进场 大家都看得到
sense_groups.english: Everyone will see if we arrive after it starts.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人喝过我这一杯脂肪吗
sense_groups.english: Has somebody been drinking my fat?

sense_groups.chinese: 这像是古生物学家女友会穿的衣服吗
sense_groups.english: Does this look like something a paleontologist's girlfriend would wear?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你大概是首开先例吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You might be the first one.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你听答录机留言了吗 - 没有
sense_groups.english: Rach, did you check the machine? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 这件衣服会显得我小腿很粗 算了
sense_groups.english: Wait. This is the outfit that makes my calves look fat. Never mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我今天写了一首歌
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey, I wrote a little song today.

sense_groups.chinese: 歌名叫做"起来"
sense_groups.english: It's called, "Get up!"

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 椅子给你啦
sense_groups.english: All right. You can have the chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 - 天啊 你看看这个
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, my. Would you look at that?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我 我正要过去
sense_groups.english: I'm coming over.

sense_groups.chinese: 若你播出这则留言时 我已经到了呢
sense_groups.english: What if I'm already there when you play this message?

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是很诡异
sense_groups.english: Is that too spooky?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你在不在 是我 快接电话
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rach, are you there? It's me. Pick up.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Rachel? Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Never mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我是理查 打电话给我
sense_groups.english: Monica, it's Richard. Call me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这则留言是新的还是旧的
sense_groups.english: Is that message old or new?

sense_groups.chinese: 新的还是旧的…
sense_groups.english: Old or new? Old or new?

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对是旧的 你没听到两声哔哔声吗
sense_groups.english: It's definitely old. Didn't you hear the double beep?

sense_groups.chinese: 若是新的怎么办 我们说好不联络的
sense_groups.english: What if it's new? We agreed not to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能有重要的事 我该不该回电话
sense_groups.english: It could be important. Shouldn't I call him back?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你已经打过了 这是旧的留言
sense_groups.english: Honey, you did call him back. It's old.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 你听
sense_groups.english: Yeah, see, Mon, listen. Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 当卡萝与我分手时
sense_groups.english: When Carol and I broke up...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也经历一样的事 你知道我怎么做吗
sense_groups.english: ...I went through the same thing. You know what I did?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去换好衣服
sense_groups.english: I got dressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 快 快 快
sense_groups.english: Really, really quickly, okay? Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了…
sense_groups.english: There we go. There we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 别起来了 就坐在那里吧
sense_groups.english: You know what? Don't get up. Just sit there.

sense_groups.chinese: 只希望你别介意 我的手放在这里
sense_groups.english: I just hope you don't mind my hand right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 没碰到 不能生气 没碰到 不能生气
sense_groups.english: Not touching. Can't get mad! Not touching. Can't get mad!

sense_groups.chinese: 没碰到 不能生气
sense_groups.english: Not touching. Can't get mad!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这些坏孩子
sense_groups.english: You rotten boys!

sense_groups.chinese: 真抱歉 菲比 - 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Phoebe. - What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 别乱抹 有什么可以去除豆泥
sense_groups.english: Don't rub it! What gets out hummus?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么可以去除豆泥
sense_groups.english: What gets out hummus?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 有什么可以去除豆泥
sense_groups.english: Monica! What gets out hummus?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那个留言是新的 他到底打来说什么
sense_groups.english: If it is a new message, what is he calling to say?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢 我会试试看的
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks. Yeah, I'll try that.

sense_groups.chinese: 说不定他打来说 你执迷不悟 而且太疯狂
sense_groups.english: Maybe he called to say you're obsessive and crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该不该回电话给他 - 不
sense_groups.english: So should I call him back? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我们一起坐在椅子上 - 随便啊
sense_groups.english: Fine, we'll both sit in the chair. - Fine with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好舒服啊
sense_groups.english: I am so comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我可能有点太舒服
sense_groups.english: In fact, I think I might be a little too comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们有19分钟 钱德 我要你去换衣服
sense_groups.english: Okay, we have 19 minutes. I want you to go and change.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你回来后 乔伊去换衣服 他就会把椅子空出来
sense_groups.english: When you come back, Joey will go change, and he'll have vacated the chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Fine. I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我回来后这里就是椅子王国 而我是…
sense_groups.english: When I get back, it's Chair City. And I'm the guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐在椅子上的那个人
sense_groups.english: ...who's sitting in a chair!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是不是有点太…
sense_groups.english: Is this a little too...?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 怎么回事
sense_groups.english: Pheebs? What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我沾到豆泥了
sense_groups.english: I got the hummus.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我们会找出衣服给你 你要不要穿我的黑外套
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, we'll find you something. You wanna wear my black jacket?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样跟洋装抗不能搭配了 - 没错
sense_groups.english: It won't go with this dress. - You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我们把衣服换掉 - 不…别换掉
sense_groups.english: Well, let's just get you out of that. - No, no, no. Not out of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 千万别把衣服脱掉 - 菲比 可以穿你的绿洋装吗
sense_groups.english: Not out of clothes. - Can Phoebe borrow your green dress?

sense_groups.chinese: 我打给他了
sense_groups.english: I called him.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 电话进到他的答录机 然后我留言了
sense_groups.english: Yes. I got his machine and I left a message.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过没关系…
sense_groups.english: But it's okay. It's okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那是个闲聊式的 轻松的留言
sense_groups.english: ...because it was, like, a casual, breezy message.

sense_groups.chinese: 很轻松
sense_groups.english: It was breezy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 若听起来并不轻松该怎么办
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, what if it wasn't breezy?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能不轻松 不会 这里是个轻松的地方
sense_groups.english: How could it not be breezy? No, because you're in such a breezy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 我播出我的留言 你们再告诉我是否轻松
sense_groups.english: I got it. I'll play my message, and you guys tell me if it's breezy enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可能那样做
sense_groups.english: But how you gonna do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道他答录机的密码
sense_groups.english: I know the code to his answering machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 摩妮卡 我不认为现在应该…
sense_groups.english: Okay, Mon, I really don't think this is the...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你在拨号了…
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're dialing. You are dialing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是理查 请在哔声后留言
sense_groups.english: Hi, this is Richard. Please leave a message at the tone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有两个新讯息
sense_groups.english: You have two new messages.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个好差事
sense_groups.english: What a cool job.

sense_groups.chinese: "你有两个新讯息"
sense_groups.english: "You have two new messages."

sense_groups.chinese: 请把派递给我
sense_groups.english: Please pass the pie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡 我只是想确定一下
sense_groups.english: Hi, it's Monica. I'm just checking in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一通留言 不知道是新的还是旧的
sense_groups.english: I got a message and didn't know if it was old or new...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 我只是问问看
sense_groups.english: ...so I'm just checking.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我吧
sense_groups.english: So let me know.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者不告诉我 都可以
sense_groups.english: Or don't. Whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很轻松
sense_groups.english: I'm breezy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能说"我很轻松" 这样就不轻松了
sense_groups.english: You can't say you're "breezy." That negates the "breezy."

sense_groups.chinese: 你好啊 是我 昨天真的很开心
sense_groups.english: Hola. It's me. Yesterday was really fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 打给我 我们来聊聊周末的计划 好吗
sense_groups.english: Call me about this weekend, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 看 她听起来就很轻松
sense_groups.english: Now, she sounded breezy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他开始约会了 我真不敢相信他开始约会
sense_groups.english: He's seeing someone. I can't believe he's seeing someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还不能那么肯定 - 那么那是谁的声音
sense_groups.english: You don't know that. - Well, whose voice was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 说不定是他妹妹的 说不定是他女儿的
sense_groups.english: Maybe it was his sister's. Maybe it was his daughter's.

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜雪儿 一定是了 听起来像蜜雪儿吗
sense_groups.english: Michelle. Of course! Did it sound like Michelle?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 开始下雨了 这样计程车更难叫到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. It's starting to rain. That'll make it easier to get a cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 是蜜雪儿
sense_groups.english: It was Michelle.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对是蜜雪儿
sense_groups.english: It was definitely Michelle.

sense_groups.chinese: 去试穿摩妮卡的绿洋装 不适合就穿我的灰色丝质洋装
sense_groups.english: Try Monica's green dress. If it doesn't fit, wear my gray silk one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我要穿哪件 - 你还不知道自己要穿什么
sense_groups.english: Unless I wear it. - You don't know what you're wearing?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚是你的大日子 我只是希望自己好看一点
sense_groups.english: I'm just trying to look nice for your big night.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 而我们在12分钟内必须出门
sense_groups.english: Yeah, which we have to leave for in 12 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我帮你选衣服
sense_groups.english: Come on, I'll just pick something out for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到了 我全换好了
sense_groups.english: You'll notice that I'm fully dressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我呢 也发现你什么都还没换
sense_groups.english: I, in turn, have noticed that you are not.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 引用艾伦•米恩的话 "离开我的椅子 驴蛋 "
sense_groups.english: So in the words of A.A. Milne, "Get out of my chair, dill-hole."

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么 - 你叫我离开椅子啊
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - You said to give you the chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又没说不能带走椅垫
sense_groups.english: You didn't say anything about cushions.

sense_groups.chinese: 但椅垫是椅子的重点
sense_groups.english: They're the essence of the chair!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我要带走重点
sense_groups.english: That's right! I'm taking the essence.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会回来的
sense_groups.english: Oh, he'll be back.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里什么人也没有
sense_groups.english: Oh, there's nobody in the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我觉得这样很美 - 这是万圣节服装
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I thought it looked pretty. - That was a Halloween costume.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你要我穿的像小牧羊女一样
sense_groups.english: Unless you would like me to go as Little Bo Peep.

sense_groups.chinese: 若没有那只可充气的羊 我还真认不出来
sense_groups.english: I didn't recognize it without that inflatable sheep.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 对了 钱德 记得还给我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, which, by the way, Chandler, I would like back one of these days.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 很好啊 这件是不是很适合我
sense_groups.english: Rach, good! Listen, isn't this perfect for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 但是不适合今晚
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's perfect! But not for tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不适合今晚 这像是去慈善晚会的装束
sense_groups.english: Of course not for tonight. Hi. I'm going to a benefit.

sense_groups.chinese: 不适合今晚 那你穿它干嘛
sense_groups.english: Not for tonight? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 他没别的意思 我爱你…深呼吸
sense_groups.english: No, I'm sorry. We didn't mean it. I love you. Breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去露营时 把它们当枕头
sense_groups.english: We used them as pillows when we went camping.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那些羊啊
sense_groups.english: The sheep.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的闲暇时间在干嘛…
sense_groups.english: Hey, what you do on your own time...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的内裤呢
sense_groups.english: Where's my underwear?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你拿了他的内裤 - 他拿走我的重点啊
sense_groups.english: Come on, you took his underwear? - He took my essence!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 等等 你干嘛不穿你身上的内裤
sense_groups.english: Okay, hold on. Why can't you just wear the underwear you're wearing now?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我现在根本没有穿内裤
sense_groups.english: Because I'm not wearing any underwear now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你今晚为何要穿内裤
sense_groups.english: Then why do you have to wear underwear tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这燕尾服是用租的
sense_groups.english: It's a rented tux, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想没穿内裤就穿别人的衣服
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna go "commando" in another man's fatigues.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有人就得把椅垫还给别人
sense_groups.english: Then somebody's gonna have to give somebody back his cushions.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你把我衣服藏起来 我要做一件完全相反的事
sense_groups.english: Okay. You hide my clothes. I'm gonna do the exact opposite to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 难道你要给我看我的衣服吗
sense_groups.english: What, are you gonna show me my clothes?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 相反的…
sense_groups.english: Hey, opposite...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是相反的事
sense_groups.english: ...is opposite.

sense_groups.chinese: 他什么都没有
sense_groups.english: He's got nothing!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我准备好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋那里没有我喜欢的 除了这个圣诞彩带
sense_groups.english: Rachel didn't have anything I liked but this ribbon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想 好吧 那我就政治化一点吧
sense_groups.english: I thought, all right, I'll be political.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你在支持什么 - 当然是圣诞节
sense_groups.english: What are you supporting? - Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无所谓 已经搞定两个了 我还有整整12分钟
sense_groups.english: Hey, that's okay with me. Two down, and I have exactly 12 minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的表停了 我的表 你看…
sense_groups.english: My watch stopped. My watch. Okay, see...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个恐龙指针的尾巴不动了
sense_groups.english: ...the dinosaur tail isn't going around anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在几点已经7点33分 我还有7分钟
sense_groups.english: What time is it? It's 7:33. I have 7 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有7分钟
sense_groups.english: I have seven minutes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我该穿哪一双鞋 黑色的还是紫色的
sense_groups.english: Which shoes should I wear? The black or the purple?

sense_groups.chinese: 随便挑一双 好吗 - 好啦 黑色的
sense_groups.english: Just pick one, okay? - Oh, okay, okay. The black.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有黑色的然后有细带子的
sense_groups.english: Do you have black with little strappies?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 不过那种适合配裤子或者我该穿裤子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but those go better with pants. Maybe I should wear pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 穿裤子是好主意 或者不要穿裤子更好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, pants! What an idea! Or better yet, go without pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你在做什么 但是你快进去…
sense_groups.english: I don't know what you're doing but just get in there...

sense_groups.chinese: 找出随便一双可以穿的鞋子
sense_groups.english: ...and pick out any shoes that fit your feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管它是否搭配 我不管它是否会…
sense_groups.english: I don't care if they match. I don't care if they make...

sense_groups.chinese: 让你的脚踝 膝盖或耳垂看起来胖胖的 快去吧
sense_groups.english: ...your ankles or your knees or your earlobes look fat. Just do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 进去房间里 挑出要穿的 然后我们就可以走了
sense_groups.english: Go in there, pick something out so we can go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: All right. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打给蜜雪儿 确定那是她的声音
sense_groups.english: I've got to call Michelle to see if that was her voice.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 那就是她的声音
sense_groups.english: It was. It was her voice.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我想你又开始偏执了
sense_groups.english: Monica, I think you've gone over to the bad place.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hola.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello? Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那是她的声音 对吗 - 绝对是 对啊
sense_groups.english: Okay. That was her, right? - Definitely. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样就解决啦
sense_groups.english: So there you go. Whew!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的危险解除啦 我要去换衣服了
sense_groups.english: We're out of the woods. I think I'll get dressed now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来接 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'll get it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 摩妮卡与瑞秋的家
sense_groups.english: Hi, Monica and Rachel's.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 请稍等 请问你是哪位
sense_groups.english: Yeah, just a second. Can I ask who's calling?

sense_groups.chinese: 是蜜雪儿
sense_groups.english: Ooh! It's Michelle! Ooh!

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定装了来电显示功能 你也该去装一个
sense_groups.english: She must have that "caller I.D." thing. You should get that.

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜雪儿
sense_groups.english: Michelle?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 就是我 我不小心拨了你的电话
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was me. I dialed your number by mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要试着…
sense_groups.english: Just try to be...

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的好贴心
sense_groups.english: You're so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我们曾经是一对很好的情侣
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we were a great couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我真的很想他
sense_groups.english: I know, I really miss him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你了解的
sense_groups.english: Well, you know how it is. It's just that...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道奇怪的是什么
sense_groups.english: You know what's weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 唐老鸭从来不穿裤子
sense_groups.english: Donald Duck never wore pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是当他洗完澡出来…
sense_groups.english: But when he gets out of the shower...

sense_groups.chinese: 他总是在腰间围上一条毛巾
sense_groups.english: ...he always puts a towel around his waist.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 那算什么
sense_groups.english: I mean, what is that about?

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜雪儿 我只是进入信箱来听我自己的留言
sense_groups.english: I only beeped in so I could hear my own message.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样说得过去吧
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's allowed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的希望你别告诉你爸…
sense_groups.english: I would really appreciate it if you wouldn't tell your dad about...

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你不爽是什么意思 我们是朋友啊
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, you don't feel comfortable with this? We're friends!

sense_groups.chinese: 那个小婊子根本就讨厌我
sense_groups.english: That bitch always hated me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要再打给她 - 别…
sense_groups.english: I'm calling her back. - No, no, no! Tick, tick, tick.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她房间里有电话吧 - 好 我们来处理吧
sense_groups.english: She's got a phone in there, right? - Okay, we're on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道单子上写 "打不打领带都没关系"
sense_groups.english: I know it says, "black tie optional"...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你这样好像过于随便了
sense_groups.english: ...but this may be pushing it a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不去了
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去了
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna go?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想更新我的通讯录
sense_groups.english: No, I think I'm gonna catch up on my correspondence.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可以不去呢
sense_groups.english: How can you not be going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是不去了
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这样 就表明了"我不去"的意思
sense_groups.english: So I think that will accomplish the "not going."

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是好奇…
sense_groups.english: Um, you know, just out of curiosity...

sense_groups.chinese: 自从你在我朋友面前羞辱我 又对我大吼
sense_groups.english: Ever since I was humiliated and yelled at in front of my friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就没有情绪去参加什么博物馆的慈善会了
sense_groups.english: ...I'm just, I don't know, not in a very museum benefit-y kind of mood.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…天啊 很抱歉 我对你大吼大叫 对不起
sense_groups.english: Right. Well, okay. Okay. God, I'm sorry. I'm sorry I yelled.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 - 可是你在生气
sense_groups.english: That's fine. - No, but you're mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有生气 我只是不去了
sense_groups.english: I'm not mad. I'm just not going.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我一定要去吧
sense_groups.english: You know that I have to go, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那这样会不会变成我在你难过时离你而去
sense_groups.english: So is it gonna be like I'm abandoning you while you're upset?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不
sense_groups.english: No. - No?

sense_groups.chinese: 我对你大吼 你不难过 - 对 还包括你的羞辱
sense_groups.english: You're not upset about the yelling. - Right. And the humiliating.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 还有羞辱
sense_groups.english: Well, of course, the humiliating.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么
sense_groups.english: So we...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间没问题
sense_groups.english: ...we're okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没问题 - 对
sense_groups.english: We're good. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我爱你 - 是的 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Honey? I love you. - Yes, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 把电话放下
sense_groups.english: Get away from that phone!

sense_groups.chinese: 她已经开始换衣服了
sense_groups.english: She's just getting dressed now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然因此而兴奋 我是不是有问题
sense_groups.english: Is it wrong that I was totally aroused by that?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 兄弟 就是这样啦
sense_groups.english: Okay, buddy boy, here it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把我衣服藏起来 我就把你所有的衣服穿上
sense_groups.english: You hide my clothes. I'm wearing everything you own.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 这算什么与藏人家内裤相反的事
sense_groups.english: That is so not the opposite of taking somebody's underwear!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看我 我是钱德
sense_groups.english: Look at me! I'm Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还能再多穿一件衣服吗
sense_groups.english: Could I be wearing any more clothes?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我不该不穿内裤的…
sense_groups.english: Maybe if I wasn't going commando...

sense_groups.chinese: 穿这么多真是热死我了
sense_groups.english: It's hot with all this stuff on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最好别再做些运动… 像是跨步之类的
sense_groups.english: I better not do any, I don't know, lunges.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 别再跨步了
sense_groups.english: Okay, enough. Enough with the lunging.

sense_groups.chinese: 我快被烦死了 我真的已经受够了
sense_groups.english: I'm sick of this. I've had it up to here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个都不准参加晚会
sense_groups.english: Neither of you can come to the party!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真幼雅
sense_groups.english: Jeez, what a baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛破坏一切 我正要去换衣服了
sense_groups.english: Way to ruin it. I was just gonna go get dressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个唯一我会在乎是否换好衣服的人…
sense_groups.english: The only person I cared about getting dressed...

sense_groups.chinese: 却是那个不肯去的人
sense_groups.english: ...is the person who's not even gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我很抱歉 好吗
sense_groups.english: Look, Rach, I'm sorry, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是个混球 抱歉对你大吼 我希望你能去
sense_groups.english: Look, I was a jerk, okay? I'm sorry I yelled. I want you there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要你去
sense_groups.english: I need you there.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎样做才能证明我有多希望你去
sense_groups.english: What can I do to show you how much I want you to be there?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以把那杯脂肪喝掉
sense_groups.english: You could drink the fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎你进入大人的谈话世界
sense_groups.english: Welcome to an adult conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Now wait a minute. Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 这听起来还蛮有意思的 - 什么
sense_groups.english: That actually sounds interesting. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你应该把那杯脂肪喝掉
sense_groups.english: I think you should drink the fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 若这样就能证明你对我有多重要…
sense_groups.english: Okay, if that's what it takes to show you how much you mean to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 以及我多希望你能去 那我就愿意去做
sense_groups.english: ...and how much I want you there, that's what I'll do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你换一个杯子 这一杯放好久了
sense_groups.english: Let me get you another glass. That's been sitting out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这样可以了
sense_groups.english: I think this will be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 香草奶昔 只不过是香草奶昔…
sense_groups.english: Okay, vanilla milkshake. Just a vanilla milkshake...

sense_groups.chinese: 只不过有鸡肉的碎屑浮着
sense_groups.english: ...with chicken bits floating in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 干杯
sense_groups.english: Cheers.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不要 好吧 我去就是了…
sense_groups.english: No, don't! Okay, okay, I'll go. I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你肯去
sense_groups.english: You will?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的会那么做
sense_groups.english: You were really gonna do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 是啊
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的愿意喝下脂肪
sense_groups.english: You were gonna drink the fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来看看他还能做什么
sense_groups.english: Let's see what else he'll do!

sense_groups.chinese: 不如你现在去换衣服 你把他的内裤还给他
sense_groups.english: How about you get changed? Give him his underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来叫计程车 我要大家在两分钟内下楼
sense_groups.english: I'll get a cab. I want everyone downstairs in two minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 别做了
sense_groups.english: Stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再做了
sense_groups.english: Stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯去叫计程车了 那我们…
sense_groups.english: Ross went to get a cab so we...

sense_groups.chinese: 别 摩妮卡 你在干什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? No, Monica, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是理查
sense_groups.english: Hi, this is Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有三个新讯息
sense_groups.english: You have three new messages.

sense_groups.chinese: 再也没有了
sense_groups.english: Not anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 讯息已删除
sense_groups.english: Message erased.

sense_groups.chinese: 请在哔声后留言
sense_groups.english: To record your message, begin speaking at the tone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 理查 我是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hi, Richard. It's Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚做了一件很疯狂的事
sense_groups.english: Listen, I did something kind of crazy tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我大姨妈快来了 我也不知道怎么回事
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'm getting my period or something. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我进入你的答录机 然后听到一个留言…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I beeped into your machine and I heard this message...

sense_groups.chinese: 快把我搞疯了
sense_groups.english: ...that freaked me out...

sense_groups.chinese: 其他的蜜雪儿会告诉你
sense_groups.english: ...and Michelle will tell you the rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 我希望 我们会忘了这整件事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, okay? And I hope that we can just forget the whole thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的主人留言已经更改
sense_groups.english: Your outgoing message has now been changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 主人留言
sense_groups.english: Outgoing?

sense_groups.chinese: 它刚刚是说主人留言
sense_groups.english: Did that say outgoing?

sense_groups.chinese: 别是主人留言
sense_groups.english: Not outgoing!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 理查 我是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hi, Richard, it's Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚做了一件疯狂的事
sense_groups.english: Listen, I did something kind of crazy tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我大姨妈快来了 我也不知道怎么回事
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'm getting my period or something. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么做的 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: How did you do that? - I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 不
sense_groups.english: Goodbye. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我叫到两辆计程车 但没人下来 走吧 走吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, I've got two cabs and no people! Go, go, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以打给电话公司 他们也许可以改掉那个留言
sense_groups.english: Maybe we can call the phone company to change the message?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们也许可以把他的电话号码改掉
sense_groups.english: They could change his number.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想经过这件事 他会自己处理了
sense_groups.english: I think after this, he'll be doing that himself.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来…
sense_groups.english: You... You look...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我还剩下5秒钟
sense_groups.english: And I still have about five seconds to spare.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样大概花掉7秒钟
sense_groups.english: That was about 7 seconds.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们迟了一点
sense_groups.english: So we're a little late.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且…
sense_groups.english: Oh, and by the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我下面也是真空
sense_groups.english: I'm going commando too.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士
sense_groups.english: Dr. Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是伦敦学院来的雪曼•惠菲 - 很荣幸见到你
sense_groups.english: Sherman Whitfield, London Institute. - What a pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的前白垩纪化石报告写得真赞
sense_groups.english: I was quite impressed with your paper on pre-Cretaceous fossils.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 你再次验证了我以前写的东西
sense_groups.english: Yes, it confirmed everything I'd written.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好像坐在我的位子上
sense_groups.english: You're kind of sitting in my seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思 你的位子
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, your seat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我本来坐在这里 - 但是你离开了
sense_groups.english: I mean, I was sitting there. - But you got up.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我没有离开这个房间
sense_groups.english: But I never left the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你离开椅子区域了
sense_groups.english: But you left the chair area.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这样吧 把你的内裤给我
sense_groups.english: All right, that's it. Give me your underwear.

questions.name: S03E03
questions.en:
See, Joe, that's why your parents told you not to jump on the bed.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey, look at me. I'm making jam.
I've been at it since 4:00 this morning.
Where'd you get fruit at 4 in the morning?
Went down at the docks.
Bet you didn't know you can get it wholesale.
I didn't know there were docks.
Hey.
Aw, is it broken?
No, but I gotta wear this thing for a couple weeks.
Did you tell the doctor you did it jumping up and down on your bed?
No. I had a whole story worked out, but then...
...Chandler sold me out.
I'm sorry, Joe.
I didn't think the doctor was gonna buy that it just fell out of his socket.
What is this? Fruit?
Monica's making jam.
Jam? I love jam. Hey, how come we never have jam at our place?
Because the kids need new shoes.
I'm going into business, people. I'm sick of being depressed about Richard.
I needed a plan. A plan to get over my man.
What's the opposite of man? Jam.
Joey, don't. It's way too hot.
This will just be my batch.
Um, that's it. No. Hey you. J. Crew guy...
Yeah. Why are you following me?
All week long, everywhere I look, there's you.
You wouldn't return my calls. You sent back my letters.
What? - One more chance, Ursula. Please.
Oh. Well, this is awkward.
Why?
Yeah, because you want Ursula, and I'm Phoebe. Twin sisters.
Seriously.
Oh. That's great. I'm stalking the wrong woman.
I am such a dingus!
Oh, you're not a dingus.
I just... I want you to know I didn't used to be like this.
Before I met your sister, I was, like, this normal guy...
...who sold beepers and cellular phones.
Well... I mean, look, it's not your fault, you know?
I mean, this is just what she does to guys, okay?
Just...
Well, thanks.
Wait. You know what? I got a little story.
When I was in junior high school...
...I went through this period where I thought I was a witch.
And there was this guidance counselor who said something to me...
...that I think will help you a lot.
He said, "Okay, you're not a witch. You're just an average student."
See what I'm saying? - Not really.
Um, well, get over it.
I mean, you just... You seem like a really nice guy.
You know, I just... Don't be so hard on yourself, okay?
Wait, you're right. I know you're right. And thanks for being so nice.
Here.
Thanks a lot.
Do you wanna get a cup of coffee or...?
Yeah, okay. - Okay.
You don't have to walk behind me anymore.
Sorry.
Mon? - Mon?
"Gone for more jars. Back later. Monica Geller."
Wait a minute. Look.
Look, look, look. - What, what, what?
It's an empty apartment. - Mm.
We're all alone in an empty apartment.
Aw, honey, come on. I have to be at work in, like, 10 minutes and, oh...
All right. Well, it's not like I'm employee of the year or anything.
There it is.
Oh, that's what you're talking about.
Hey. - Hey.
Do I look fat?
No.
Okay, I accept that.
When Janice asked me and I said no...
...she took that to mean that I was calling her a cow.
Okay, walk us through it, honey. Walk us through it.
Okay, well, Janice said, uh
"Hi. Do I look fat today?" And I looked at her...
You looked at her?
You never look.
You just answer. It's like a reflex. "Do I look fat?" "No."
"Is she prettier than I am?" "No."
"Does size matter?" - No.
And it works both ways.
Okay, so you both just know this stuff?
You know, after about 30 or 40 fights, you kind of catch on.
Okay. For instance, ahem
Let's say Janice is coming back from a trip and she gives you two options.
Option number one: She'll take a cab home from the airport.
Or option two: You can meet her at baggage claim. What do you do?
That's easy. Baggage claim.
Ehh! Wrong. Now you're single.
It's actually secret option number three.
You meet her at the gate. That way she knows you love her.
Okay, this is good. This is good.
All right, listen, I have one. Janice likes to cuddle...
...at night, which I'm all for.
But, uh, you know, when you want to go to sleep, you want some space.
So, uh, you know, how do I tell her that without...
...you know, accidentally calling her fat or something?
Oh. Honey, I'm sorry. We can't help you there, because we're cuddly sleepers.
Okay, I'm late for work.
Are you guys gonna come down? - Uh, yeah. I'm right behind you.
Good luck, Chandler. - Thank you, Rachel.
Bye, sweetie. - Bye, honey.
Okay, the sleeping thing.
Very tricky business but there is something you can do.
I thought you were cuddly sleepers. - No.
No, not cuddly. Not me. Just her.
I'm like you. I need the room. Ahem.
Okay, come here. Ahem.
Okay. You're in bed.
Yeah?
I'm gonna use the cushion. - Yeah.
Okay. You're in bed. She's over on your side cuddling.
Now, you wait for her to drift off...
...and then you hug her...
...and roll her over to her side of the bed.
And then you...
...roll away.
Hug for her.
Roll for you.
Okay, the old "hug and roll." - Yep.
Okay. One question. - Shoot.
You're pretending the pillow's a girl, right?
Remember when you were a kid...
...and your mom would drop you off at the movies...
...with a jar ofjam and a little spoon?
You're so pretty.
Hi. - Hey, Phoebe.
Hey, oh! You know that guy who's been following me? I talked to him today.
You talked to him? Are you crazy?
Okay, first, I'm not crazy. And second, say it. Don't spray it.
Anyway, his name is Malcolm, and he wasn't following me.
I mean, he was, but just because he thought I was Ursula. Ick.
And that's why... That's why he couldn't just come up and talk to me.
Because of the restraining order.
Hmm. Not feeling better about Malcolm.
Oh! No, no, no, he's not like a kook.
No, he's just this, like, very passionate, incredibly romantic guy...
...that just got a teensy bit carried away, you know?
And we just get along really well, and he's so cute.
Oh, my God. You've got a crush on your sister's stalker.
No, I'm just gonna help him, you know, get "de-Ursula-ized."
Like, you know... Like I did for Joey after he went out with her.
Yeah, but I didn't stalk her. I mean...
I asked for the news, not the weather.
Hey, guys. - Hey, Mon.
Joey, this is for you. It's blackberry currant.
Yeah.
Hey, Joe, I gotta ask.
The girl from the Xerox place, buck naked...
...or a big tub of jam?
Put your hands together.
Joey, take your time with that. That's my last batch.
No more jam?
What happened to your jam plan?
Well, I figured out I'd need to charge 17 bucks a jar just to break even.
So I've got a new plan now. Babies.
Well, you're gonna need much bigger jars.
What are you talking about? - About me having a baby.
Are you serious? - Yeah.
The great thing about the jam plan was I was take control of my life.
So I asked myself, "What is the most important thing to me?"
And that's when I came up with the baby plan.
Well, aren't you forgetting something?
What is, uh...? What is that guy's name? Dad.
It took me 28 years to find one man that I wanted to spend my life with.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一接 今晚就得跟她见面
sense_groups.english: And if I get it, I'm gonna have to see her tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 今晚我得跟她见面
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. I'm gonna have to see her tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你不想见珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Why don't you wanna see Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨天吃晚餐时 一上菜
sense_groups.english: Last night at dinner, when the meals came...

sense_groups.chinese: 她将她点的柠檬香鸡排一半放进我盘子里 挖走我的番茄
sense_groups.english: ...she put half her chicken piccata on my plate and took all my tomatoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很糟糕 因为…
sense_groups.english: And that's bad...

sense_groups.chinese: 你讨厌柠檬香鸡排
sense_groups.english: ...because you hate chicken piccata?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想分享番茄 番茄对你来说很重要
sense_groups.english: You didn't wanna share your tomatoes. Tomatoes are very important to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是突然间我们变成这样的情侣
sense_groups.english: All of a sudden, we were this couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的脑海里警铃大响
sense_groups.english: And this alarm started going off in my head.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了你的人生 快跑 快离开这栋大楼
sense_groups.english: "Run for your life! Get out of the building!"

sense_groups.chinese: 男人太难以置信了 珍妮丝以为她给了你鸡肉
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Men are unbelievable. Janice thought she was giving you chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们到底是怎么了
sense_groups.english: What is it with you people?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一有感觉就得逃跑
sense_groups.english: The minute you feel something, you have to run away?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 那…
sense_groups.english: I know. That...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以今晚我不想去 我担心我会说出蠢话
sense_groups.english: That's why I don't wanna go tonight. I'm afraid I'm gonna say something stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说男人会装出冷淡无情
sense_groups.english: Oh. You mean that guy thing where you act mean and distant...

sense_groups.chinese: 逼我们跟你们分手
sense_groups.english: ...until you get us to break up with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都知道
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么做我要过这一关
sense_groups.english: What do I do? I wanna get past this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要害怕承诺
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna be afraid of the commitment thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要通过隧道 直奔另一头
sense_groups.english: I wanna go through the tunnel to the other side.

sense_groups.chinese: 在那里你不会害怕承诺
sense_groups.english: Where there's no fear of commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家有…
sense_groups.english: Do we have any...?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家有点子吗
sense_groups.english: Do we have any thoughts here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不曾通过隧道 因为…
sense_groups.english: I've never been through the tunnel myself because...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为车上只能有一个女孩
sense_groups.english: ...you're not allowed through with more than one girl in the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我觉得这跟其他事一样 面对恐惧
sense_groups.english: But it seems to me it's pretty much like anything else. Face your fear.

sense_groups.chinese: 怕高的人就爬到大楼顶楼
sense_groups.english: You have a fear of heights? Go to the top of the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 怕虫子的人
sense_groups.english: You're afraid of bugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 去抓只虫子来
sense_groups.english: Get a bug.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 以现在的情况 你害怕承诺
sense_groups.english: You have a fear of commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我建议你乖乖出现 成为史上最爱承诺的男人
sense_groups.english: So I say you go in there and you be the most committed guy there ever was.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 那真的很有道理
sense_groups.english: Amazingly, that makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的那么想 - 对 冲啊 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Do you think? - Oh, yeah. Go for it, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 从高处跳下
sense_groups.english: Jump off the high dive.

sense_groups.chinese: 盯着枪管 逆风尿尿
sense_groups.english: Stare down the barrel of the gun. Pee into the wind.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果我得盯着枪管看
sense_groups.english: Joe, if I'm staring down the barrel of a gun...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会尿得到处都是
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna be pretty much peeing every which way.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你今天早上的试镜结果
sense_groups.english: Ooh, it's your audition from this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能打一下电话吗
sense_groups.english: Can I use the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 那是电话的功能 供紧急事件跟假经纪人使用
sense_groups.english: Sure, that's what it's there for. Emergencies and, uh, pretend agents.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Come on, baby. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是菲比•布非 请问哪位找
sense_groups.english: Hi. I have Phoebe Buffay returning a page.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 她在车里 我帮你接过去
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, she's in her car. I'll have to patch you through.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常聪明
sense_groups.english: Very nice touch.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 请说
sense_groups.english: Okay, go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 快说…
sense_groups.english: Talk, talk, talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 安妮
sense_groups.english: Hi, Annie?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Fantastic.

sense_groups.chinese: 你被录取了 - 你被录取了
sense_groups.english: You got it. - Oh! You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你问我他是照薪资标准计薪吗
sense_groups.english: Um, will he work for scale, you ask me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要他那么做 他就得那么做
sense_groups.english: Except that l do and he will.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你真是个甜心
sense_groups.english: Great. Oh, you are such a sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意跟你共进午餐
sense_groups.english: I would love to have lunch with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何不约下…
sense_groups.english: How about we have lunch next...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我进隧道了
sense_groups.english: Oop, went through a tunnel. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 太谢谢你了
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很好玩 我是说我没用过汽车电话
sense_groups.english: It was really fun. I mean, I've never talked on a car phone before.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太棒了 你能帮我一个大忙吗
sense_groups.english: Oh. You are so amazing. Could you do me this huge favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要参加另一场试镜 但伊斯特始终没办法帮我安排
sense_groups.english: There's this one other audition I want, and Estelle couldn't get me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 一次还蛮好玩的 可是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't know. It was fun one time, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 拜托 再一次就好
sense_groups.english: Come on, please? It would just be this one more.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上是两次
sense_groups.english: Well, actually it's two.

sense_groups.chinese: 两次 - 对
sense_groups.english: Two? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是三次
sense_groups.english: Well, really it's three.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你真的很厉害 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Please? You're so good at it. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 就三次 对吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. But just these three, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是四次
sense_groups.english: No, it's four.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么今晚你想在家里吃饭
sense_groups.english: So how come you wanted to eat in tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我要…
sense_groups.english: Because I wanted...

sense_groups.chinese: 送你这个
sense_groups.english: ...to give you this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太窝心了
sense_groups.english: Oh. Are you a puppy!

sense_groups.chinese: 壁纸贴
sense_groups.english: Contact paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你上床的人送你壁纸贴时
sense_groups.english: You never know what to say when someone you're sleeping with...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: ...gives you contact paper. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 还有一样礼物 看吧 壁纸贴少不了
sense_groups.english: Wait, there's more. See, the contact paper is to go...

sense_groups.chinese: 全新抽屉
sense_groups.english: ...in your brand-new drawer.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 这是我柜子的抽屉
sense_groups.english: See, the drawer actually goes in my dresser.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必这么做
sense_groups.english: Oh. You didn't have to do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定要
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定要 因为你是我的女朋友
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did. Because you're my girlfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 女朋友就该得到那些东西
sense_groups.english: ...and that's what girlfriends should get.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该怎么说
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I gotta buy a vowel...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…天啊
sense_groups.english: ...because, oh, my God. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想得到有一天
sense_groups.english: Who would've thought that someday...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾会送我抽屉呢
sense_groups.english: ...Chandler Bing would buy me a drawer?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想不到
sense_groups.english: Well, not me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但事实就是那样 还有一件事
sense_groups.english: But that's what's happened. And, uh, there's more.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该去旅行
sense_groups.english: We should take a trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: We should?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们是情侣 情侣都会那么做
sense_groups.english: Yup. We're a couple, and that's what couples do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟你爸妈见面
sense_groups.english: And I wanna meet your parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该跟你爸妈一起旅行
sense_groups.english: We should take a trip with your parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们不必那么做 因为你吓到我了
sense_groups.english: I don't think we need to, because you're tripping me out right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧 - 我很好
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - No, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好得很 这真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I actually am. This is amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一辈子都害怕这么做
sense_groups.english: My entire life, I have feared this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我做了 这有什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: And now that I'm here, it's like, what was the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以说"我们一起住吧" 我也能接受
sense_groups.english: I could probably say, "Let's move in together," and I'd be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你要我们住在一起
sense_groups.english: You probably want us to move in together?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不害怕 - 对 我害怕得要命
sense_groups.english: It doesn't scare me. - Yeah, well it scares me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有办好离婚手续 你邀请我来吃意大利面
sense_groups.english: I'm not even divorced yet. You just invited me over here for pasta...

sense_groups.chinese: 突然间你说我们得住在一起
sense_groups.english: ...and all of a sudden you're talking about moving in together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至一点都不饿
sense_groups.english: And I wasn't even that hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 已经很晚了 我该…
sense_groups.english: You know what? It's getting really late, and I should just, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 别走 我吓到你了 我说太多了
sense_groups.english: Don't go. I've scared you. I've said too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无药可救又绝望 渴求着爱情
sense_groups.english: I'm hopeless and awkward and desperate for love.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 珍妮丝 是我
sense_groups.english: Hey, Janice, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要预先跟你道歉 因为我要跑到街上追你
sense_groups.english: I wanted to apologize in advance for having chased you down the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 甜心 这应该会有帮助
sense_groups.english: Here you go, honey. This will help.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于追上她 她说
sense_groups.english: So I catch up to her and she says...

sense_groups.chinese: 这段关系发展得太快 我们应该放慢脚步
sense_groups.english: ...this relationship's going too fast and we have to slow down.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是件好事
sense_groups.english: gh. That is never good.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后她说我…
sense_groups.english: Then I got all...

sense_groups.chinese: 太黏人 太依赖了
sense_groups.english: ...needy and clingy.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 或许没那么糟糕 你们是怎么分开的
sense_groups.english: Now, wait a minute. Maybe it's not so bad. How did you leave it?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她会打电话给我
sense_groups.english: She said she'd call me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎光临我们这边的隧道
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Welcome to our side of the tunnel.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 这个冰淇淋好难吃的
sense_groups.english: This ice cream tastes like crap, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是低卡脱脂豆浆冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, it's that low-cal, nondairy, soy-milk junk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只在无药可救时 才会吃真的冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: We save the real stuff for the truly terminal cases.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你常常无药可救时 就得改吃低脂冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: When you start getting screwed over all the time, you gotta switch to low-fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不觉得我无药可救
sense_groups.english: So you don't think I'm terminal?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 你不是无药可救 我们只是得做些损害控管
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, not at all. You're not terminal. We just need some damage control.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我该打电话给她吗
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. So should I call her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是关键时刻 如果你想打电话给她
sense_groups.english: It's a critical time. If you feel yourself reaching for that phone...

sense_groups.chinese: 你得去血拼或泡个澡
sense_groups.english: ...you go shopping, you get your butt in a bubble bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要她回来 就得开始表现出高傲的样子
sense_groups.english: If you want her back, you have got to start acting aloof.

sense_groups.chinese: 她得知道你一点都不黏人
sense_groups.english: She has to know you're not needy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要做的是
sense_groups.english: So, what you have to do is...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是故意跟她巧遇
sense_groups.english: ...you have to accidentally run into her on purpose...

sense_groups.chinese: 装出高仿的模样
sense_groups.english: ...and then act aloof.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样我就不会失去她
sense_groups.english: So I'm not gonna lose her?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你不是个失败者
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, you're not a total loser.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是问我就不会失去她了吗
sense_groups.english: I said, so I'm not gonna lose her?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看是谁来了
sense_groups.english: Guess who's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是玩具王国的超级硬汉 小班
sense_groups.english: It's the toughest guy in Toyland, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 真正的美国英雄 我是特种部队
sense_groups.english: Real American hero I'm G.I. Joe

sense_groups.chinese: 放下洋娃娃…
sense_groups.english: Drop the Barbie. Drop the Barbie.

sense_groups.chinese: 特种部队 你真的觉得他会玩吗
sense_groups.english: G.I. Joe? You really think he's gonna fall for that?

sense_groups.chinese: 特种部队 酷啊 我能玩吗
sense_groups.english: G.I. Joe? Cool. Can I play?

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 小班 他是保护美国海外石油利益的玩具
sense_groups.english: Look, Ben. It's a toy that protects U.S. Oil interests overseas.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 特种部队
sense_groups.english: Go, Joe!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你来了 - 不 我走错门了 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, there you are. - No, it's not. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 等一下
sense_groups.english: But, Phoebe, wait, wait. Phoebe. Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 好吧 你穿那条裤子
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey. Oh, okay. See, I didn't recognize you...

sense_groups.chinese: 害我都认不出来了
sense_groups.english: ...in those pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我试镜的那部电视电影 有消息了吗
sense_groups.english: That TV movie I went in for, did you hear anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我有机会
sense_groups.english: I think I got a shot at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他们打电话来 你没被录取
sense_groups.english: Yes, they called. You didn't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗你没被录取 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Okay? I mean, you didn't get it. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 这种事常发生
sense_groups.english: That's okay. These things happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不该是这样的 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: But they shouldn't happen. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你从事一个非常糟糕的行业
sense_groups.english: You're in a terrible, terrible business.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想害你露出那种表情
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna be the person who makes your face look like that. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 看吧
sense_groups.english: I'm okay. See?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你既悲伤又可怕
sense_groups.english: Now you're sad and creepy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 对不起 我不干了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm sorry. I quit, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能不干了 你是我最棒的经纪人
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, you can't quit. You're the best agent I ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 当演员你一定会被拒绝 你不能把它视为人身攻击
sense_groups.english: Look, rejection is part of being an actor. You can't take it personal.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是人身攻击 他们说从没看过
sense_groups.english: Not personal? They said they'd never met an Italian actor

sense_groups.chinese: 意大利腔这么怪的意大利裔演员
sense_groups.english: with a worse Italian accent.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们真的那样说
sense_groups.english: They actually said that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 天啊 你又是那个表情 看吧 我没办法做这份工作
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh, God, there's that face again. See? I can't do this job.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 所以你非做这份工作不可
sense_groups.english: No, this is why you have to do this job.

sense_groups.chinese: 经纪人老是在说谎
sense_groups.english: Agents always lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 伊斯特会说 "他们挑了其他类型的演员“
sense_groups.english: Estelle just says stuff like, "They went another way."

sense_groups.chinese: 但我可以利用这一点
sense_groups.english: But this? I can use this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以练习新腔调
sense_groups.english: I can work on a new accent.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果那真的能帮助你 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. No. If it helps you, okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你永远抓不到我 特种部队
sense_groups.english: You'll never get me, Joe!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Hello, Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来买东西
sense_groups.english: Uh, just a bit of shopping.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗
sense_groups.english: How have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在学英国口音吗
sense_groups.english: Are you being British?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以加强一下
sense_groups.english: So you can work on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 还有什么

sense_groups.chinese: 听着

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很感激你 菲比

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 一定会没事的

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我为你疯狂

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 她已经跟别人上床了

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你

sense_groups.chinese: 太不公平了

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们无法接受 那是你们的问题

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛这么紧张 他有洋娃娃 没什么了不起的

sense_groups.chinese: 以前你会打扮成女生

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以前总是会穿妈妈的衣服

sense_groups.chinese: 你在胡说什么

sense_groups.chinese: 大帽子 珍珠项链 粉红色小手提包

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会不记得
sense_groups.english: How can you not remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 你逼我们叫你小碧

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有这么快乐过
sense_groups.english: I've literally never been this happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是很喜欢唱那首歌吗
sense_groups.english: Wasn't there a little song?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 天啊 我们想听
sense_groups.english: Oh, please, God, let there be a song.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有唱歌
sense_groups.english: There was no song. There was no song.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是小碧
sense_groups.english: I am Bea

sense_groups.chinese: 我会喝茶 - 够了

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想…
sense_groups.english: Won't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想…
sense_groups.english: Won't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想…
sense_groups.english: Won't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想跟我跳舞吗
sense_groups.english: Won't you dance around with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 就在昨天 那个人取代了你
sense_groups.english: ...and yesterday, I just bumped you for that guy over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个人…
sense_groups.english: That?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当朋友就好了
sense_groups.english: We're just gonna be friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌我可以进得去
sense_groups.english: Betcha I could fit in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我拿5元赌你进不去
sense_groups.english: I got 5 bucks says you can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好支票吧 先生
sense_groups.english: Get out your checkbook, mister.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有现金

sense_groups.chinese: 你栽了吧
sense_groups.english: You are dog, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全进得去
sense_groups.english: I totally fit.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你赢了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You got me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我输了5元美金
sense_groups.english: I'm out five big ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢

sense_groups.english: Oh, well, hello, Mr. Lincoln.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你下次好运 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Better luck next time, buddy.

Well, then answer me this

In the sink.

Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚放在地上 不然以后就不欢迎你了
sense_groups.english: Foot on the floor or come over no more.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的衣橱不见了 她却只注意到这个
sense_groups.english: Your dresser is missing, but this she notices.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我得走了
sense_groups.english: What? - I have to go. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝应该回到家了 所以…
sense_groups.english: Carol should be home by now, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们俩个情况如何 - 好多了 其实
sense_groups.english: How's it going with you guys? - Better, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于知道为什么我们最近问题这么多了
sense_groups.english: I finally figured out why we're having so much trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对 我有你们这班好朋友
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? - Yeah. You know how I have you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有自己的一群好友
sense_groups.english: She doesn't have any close friends that are just hers.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是上星期 她在健身房认识一个叫苏珊的人
sense_groups.english: But last week, she met this woman at the gym, Susan something.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们感情变得很好 我觉得这会让情况有所改变
sense_groups.english: And they really hit it off, and I think it's gonna make a difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 艾瑞克…
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Eric...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是哪类的摄影师
sense_groups.english: ...what kind of photography do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 大部分是时尚
sense_groups.english: Oh, mostly fashion.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以可能偶尔会有模特儿过来 希望你没问题
sense_groups.english: There may be models here sometimes. I hope that's cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有问题
sense_groups.english: Yes, that is cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这里…模特儿…
sense_groups.english: Uh, because I have models here, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 从来不会来
sense_groups.english: ...never.

sense_groups.chinese: 夏天时 我在周末大部分会在我姊姊海滩的家
sense_groups.english: Ooh! During the summer, I spend most weekends at my sister's beach house...

sense_groups.chinese: 也很欢迎你来
sense_groups.english: ...which you're welcome to use.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得先告诉你 她是A片女星
sense_groups.english: Although I should tell you, she's a porn star.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我还得跟一个人面谈
sense_groups.english: Well, I still have one more person to meet.

sense_groups.chinese: 但除非那个人是你姊姊…
sense_groups.english: But unless it turns out to be your sister...

sense_groups.chinese: 不然你的机会应该很大
sense_groups.english: ...ahem, I think your chances are pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 卧房 厕所 客厅
sense_groups.english: Bedroom, bathroom, living room.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是厨房 谢谢你过来 再见
sense_groups.english: This here is the kitchen, and thanks for coming by. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想问点问题吗
sense_groups.english: Don't you, uh, wanna ask me any questions?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure. Uh... Hmm...

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么新鲜事
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我是演员
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还蛮干净的
sense_groups.english: I'm fairly neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有自己的电视
sense_groups.english: I got my own TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 别担心 我对同性恋绝对没异议
sense_groups.english: Oh, and don't worry, I'm totally okay with the gay thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么同性恋
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. What gay thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 就是一般… 有人是同性恋
sense_groups.english: Uh, just, you know, in general. The whole people-being-gay thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全没问题
sense_groups.english: Totally cool with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 杰瑞 谢谢你过来
sense_groups.english: Okay, Jerry. Thanks for stopping by.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 小摩
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 想听点糟透的事吗 - 我想听吗
sense_groups.english: Wanna hear something that sucks? - Do I ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 克里斯说他们要关闭酒吧 - 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Chris says they're closing the bar. - No way!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要改成什么咖啡厅
sense_groups.english: They're turning it into a coffee place.

sense_groups.chinese: 只卖咖啡
sense_groups.english: Just coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们要去哪里聚会 - 问倒我了
sense_groups.english: Where are we gonna hang out? - You got me.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦给我一罐啤酒 - 你找到室友了吗
sense_groups.english: Can I get a beer? - Did you pick a roommate?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 是那个意大利人吗
sense_groups.english: You bet. - Is it the Italian guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Hmm, yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他好可爱
sense_groups.english: He's so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我正需要这样的室友跟他走在一起
sense_groups.english: That's what I want. A roommate I can walk around with...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都说他是好笑的那个
sense_groups.english: ...and be referred to as "the funny one."

sense_groups.chinese: 球桌空下来了 把球排好 很快回来
sense_groups.english: Table's free. Rack them up. Back in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 等着我给你好看吧
sense_groups.english: Get ready for me to whip your butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但在那之后 我们要打点撞球
sense_groups.english: Okay, but after that we're shooting some pool.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对… 不好意思 麻烦一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, ahem, no, no, no. Excuse me? Hello? Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的朋友点了加洋葱的
sense_groups.english: My friend ordered an onion...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是加橄榄的
sense_groups.english: ...not an olive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我点的是兰姆酒加健怡可乐
sense_groups.english: And I ordered a rum and Diet Coke...

sense_groups.chinese: 这杯应该不是
sense_groups.english: ...which I don't think this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry. - That's all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 弄杯对的饮料会有多难啊
sense_groups.english: How hard is it to get a couple drinks right, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 那么
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想敬杯酒…
sense_groups.english: I would like to propose a toast...

sense_groups.chinese: 敬这位一年后会成为…
sense_groups.english: ...to the woman who, in one year from today, will become...

sense_groups.chinese: 牙医师巴瑞•法伯太太
sense_groups.english: ...Mrs. Dr. Barry Farber, D.D.S.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是再看一次戒指的时候了
sense_groups.english: I think it's time to see the ring again.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太棒了 好像跟男朋友在一起一辈子一样
sense_groups.english: Ugh! Isn't it exciting? I mean, it's like having a boyfriend for life! Heh!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我知道
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是想到…
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe it's just the idea...

sense_groups.chinese: 要跟巴瑞共度下半辈子
sense_groups.english: ...of Barry for the rest of my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我觉得自己…
sense_groups.english: I don't know, I think I...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该在那之前放纵一下
sense_groups.english: I feel like having one last fling...

sense_groups.chinese: 让自己发泄掉所有欲望
sense_groups.english: ...just to sort of get it out of my system.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 别说了 - 你好坏喔
sense_groups.english: Rachel, stop! - You're so bad! Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的 我真的觉得我得…
sense_groups.english: I'm serious. I really think I need to just have...

sense_groups.chinese: 来点无意义的性爱
sense_groups.english: ...some meaningless sex, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟下一个我看到的男人
sense_groups.english: With the next guy I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我的球 好像掉了
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, I seem to have dropped my ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我又把它捡了起来
sense_groups.english: And now I've picked it up again.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我跟她一起念过高中
sense_groups.english: My God! I went to high school with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 你好 你觉得美吗
sense_groups.english: Look! Hi! What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 完全看不出来被泰坦尼克号撞过
sense_groups.english: You can't even see where the Titanic hit it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫做巴瑞 他是个医生 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yes, his name is Barry. He's a doctor, thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你梦想的一样 恭喜了
sense_groups.english: Aw, just like you always wanted. Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那你呢 你有对象吗
sense_groups.english: Thank you. So how about you? Are you seeing anybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在没有
sense_groups.english: Not right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 没有关系啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回去跟我朋友打球了
sense_groups.english: So I think I'll get back to my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Sure, sure, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一次我进城的时候 一起吃午餐好吗
sense_groups.english: Can we have lunch the next time I'm in the city?

sense_groups.chinese: 那一定会很棒
sense_groups.english: That'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见 - 谢谢 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye. - Thanks. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 赌十块钱 我再也不会看到她了
sense_groups.english: Ten bucks says I never see that woman again in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 亲爱的 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, honey, really. It's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟苏珊去
sense_groups.english: Just go with Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我认为…
sense_groups.english: Really, I think...

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得女生之夜是很棒的主意
sense_groups.english: I think girls' night out is a great idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们要做什么 - 不知道 女生的事情
sense_groups.english: What are they doing? - I don't know. Something girly.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你回来早了
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're early.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿着灯干嘛
sense_groups.english: What are you doing with the lamp?

sense_groups.chinese: 要拿去重新装电线
sense_groups.english: Just taking it to get rewired.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要拿去你修音响的地方 已经修一个礼拜了
sense_groups.english: Don't take it where you took the stereo. They've had that over a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 海克斯先生 没有人在这里发出噪音
sense_groups.english: No, no. Mr. Heckles, no one is making any noise up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们干扰我的双簧管练习
sense_groups.english: You're disturbing my oboe practice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不会吹双簧管 - 我可能会吹
sense_groups.english: You don't play the oboe. - I could play the oboe.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我要请你小声一点
sense_groups.english: Then I'm gonna have to ask you to keep it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是谁
sense_groups.english: Who are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是艾瑞克 钱德的新室友 - 我才是钱德的新室友
sense_groups.english: I'm Eric, Chandler's new roommate. - I'm Chandler's new roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不这么认为 - 我可以是钱德的新室友
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. - I could be Chandler's new roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他在电话中说… - 他亲自跟我说的
sense_groups.english: But he told me over the phone... - He told me in person.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是奇怪
sense_groups.english: That's weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要回去我的新公寓里了
sense_groups.english: I'm going to, uh, go into my new apartment now.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 又见面了
sense_groups.english: Hi again.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用谢我 谢那个放我鸽子的混蛋
sense_groups.english: Don't thank me. Thank the jerk that never showed up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我得去工作了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I gotta get to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要帮忙吗 - 谢了 我没问题
sense_groups.english: You want some help? - No, thanks. I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪
sense_groups.english: No, I don't!

sense_groups.chinese: 没事吧 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You okay? - Yeah. Phew!

sense_groups.chinese: 我太快站起来了 有点头晕
sense_groups.english: I stood up too fast. Got a little head rush.

sense_groups.chinese: 是天气太热了
sense_groups.english: It's the heat.

sense_groups.chinese: 又潮湿
sense_groups.english: And the humidity.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这是…
sense_groups.english: That's...

sense_groups.chinese: 很糟糕的组合
sense_groups.english: ...a tough combination.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想进来喝点柠檬汁吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want to come in for some lemonade?

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对不会相信我有多想
sense_groups.english: Like you wouldn't believe.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的地方
sense_groups.english: Wow. This is a great place.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当作自己家
sense_groups.english: Just make yourself comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 懂了
sense_groups.english: Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里其实是我奶奶的公寓
sense_groups.english: So this place is really my grandmother's.

sense_groups.chinese: 她搬去佛罗里达时我才接手 不然我根本负担不起
sense_groups.english: I got it when she moved to Florida. Otherwise I could never afford it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果房东问起…
sense_groups.english: So if the landlord ever asks...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个害怕录放影机的 八十七岁老太太 你口渴吗
sense_groups.english: ...I'm an 87-year-old woman who's afraid of her VCR. You thirsty?

sense_groups.chinese: 超渴的
sense_groups.english: You bet I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的"小弟"来了
sense_groups.english: ...here's your penis!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你在干什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! What the hell are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 是你请我进来喝点柠檬汁的
sense_groups.english: You said, "You wanna come in for some lemonade?"

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢
sense_groups.english: So?

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是要给我柠檬汁喝 - 对
sense_groups.english: Ah! Were you just gonna give me lemonade? - Yuh-huh!

sense_groups.chinese: 穿点衣服
sense_groups.english: Cover yourself up!

sense_groups.chinese: 对喔 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: God, I don't believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 有人问你要不要喝柠檬汁就代表想上床吗
sense_groups.english: Someone asks you in for lemonade and that means they want to have sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 通常是的 不只是柠檬汁…
sense_groups.english: Usually, yeah. Well, not just lemonade...

sense_groups.chinese: 柠檬红茶 有时候是果汁
sense_groups.english: ...iced tea, sometimes juice.

sense_groups.chinese: 听好 真的很对不起 我只是…
sense_groups.english: Look, sorry. I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你喜欢我
sense_groups.english: I thought you liked me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是个混蛋
sense_groups.english: I'm such a jerk.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这有可能发生在任何人身上
sense_groups.english: I suppose it could happen to anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我认识的人 但是…
sense_groups.english: Not anyone I know, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我还是看得到
sense_groups.english: By the way, I can still see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的床呢
sense_groups.english: Where's your bed?

sense_groups.chinese: 不在公寓里
sense_groups.english: It's not in the apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 这又发生了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is happening again.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 好了 不需要再用质问的语气了
sense_groups.english: What? - Okay, enough with the third degree!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不住在这里了
sense_groups.english: I don't live here anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不住在这里了
sense_groups.english: I don't live here anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道怎么跟你说 但是其他人都知道
sense_groups.english: I didn't know how to tell you. But, you know, everybody else knows.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都知道
sense_groups.english: Everybody knows?

sense_groups.chinese: 这应该是件好事的 我忘记原因了
sense_groups.english: That was supposed to be a good thing. I forget why.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我有一个月的时间睡不着觉
sense_groups.english: Monica, do you know I couldn't sleep for a month...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为沙发的抱枕上有个小黑点
sense_groups.english: ...because I got a dot of ink on one of the sofa cushions?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以把抱枕翻面啊
sense_groups.english: You could've just turned the cushion over.

sense_groups.chinese: 本来会的 但是另外一边有意大利面污渍
sense_groups.english: I would have, but I had a spaghetti stain on the other side.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是这个意思
sense_groups.english: This is what I'm talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要住在一个可以弄脏的地方
sense_groups.english: I need to live in a land where people can spill!

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以啊
sense_groups.english: Well, you can spill.

sense_groups.chinese: 在水槽就行
sense_groups.english: In the sink.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 这不是你的错 这是你的本性
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey. It's not your fault, you know. This is who you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很爱你 我希望我们能当朋友
sense_groups.english: And I love you. And I want us to be friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我留在这里 就没办法了
sense_groups.english: And if I stay here, I don't see that happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你 - 好
sense_groups.english: I love you too. - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 我只是难过而已
sense_groups.english: What? I'm just sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是 你想问抱枕在哪里
sense_groups.english: No, you're not. You're wondering which cushion it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看什么
sense_groups.english: So what are you watching?

sense_groups.chinese: "海滩游侠"
sense_groups.english: Baywatch.

sense_groups.chinese: 在演什么
sense_groups.english: What's it about?

sense_groups.chinese: 救生员
sense_groups.english: Lifeguards.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 听起来有点蠢…
sense_groups.english: Well, it sounds kind of stup...

sense_groups.chinese: 她是谁啊
sense_groups.english: Who's she?

sense_groups.chinese: 妮可•艾吉特
sense_groups.english: Nicole Eggert.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都喜欢她
