But, you know, if he was a regular at the coffee house...
...I'd be serving him sneezers.
So? - So, Ross...
...I've bugged him about this a million times. He's not gonna change.
Do you really serve people sneezers?
Ahem, well, um, I don't.
All right, kids. Ready? - Yes.
Thanks again, Dr. Green.
Wait, wait, wait, I think I forgot my receipt.
Oh, you don't need that. - Ahem, why not?
The carbon. It's messy. I mean, gets on your fingers and causes...
...the, uh, night blindness.
What is this?
Who put a 20 down here?
Oh, yeah, that would be me.
Um, I have... I have a problem.
I tip way too much, way, way too much.
It's a sickness, really. - Yeah, it is. It is.
We have to do something about that. - Excuse me.
You think I'm cheap?
He didn't mean anything by that.
He really didn't. - Nothing I do means anything. Really.
This is nice. I pay $200 for dinner.
You put down 20 and you come out looking like Mr. Big-Shot.
You really wanna be Mr. Big-Shot?
Here. I'll tell you what. You pay the whole bill, Mr. Big-Shot. All right?
Well, "Mr. Big-Shot" is better than "Wet-Head."
Okay, some tricks of the trade.
Now, I've never been able to cry as an actor...
...so if I'm in a scene where I have to cry...
...I cut a hole in my pocket...
...take a pair of tweezers...
...and just start pulling.
Okay. Or uh... Or let's say I want to convey...
...that I've, uh, just done something evil.
Well, that would be your basic I've-got-a fish-hook-in-my-eyebrow-and-I-like-it.
No? Okay. Let's say I've just gotten bad news.
Well, all I do there is try and divide 232 by 13.
And that's how it's done.
Great soap opera acting tonight, everybody.
Class dismissed.
Hey, Mr. Trib. - Hey.
Guess what. I got an audition.
Oh. One of my students got an audition. I'm so proud.
I was wondering if you would consider coaching me for it.
Oh, you bet. What's the part? - Oh, it's great.
It's a role on All My Children. Nick the boxer.
Had to do it, didn't you? You couldn't leave it alone.
Four percent, okay? I tip more than that when there's a bug in my food.
Ross, tonight was about the two of you getting along.
Would you see my chiropractor already?
Yeah, I'm gonna go to a doctor who went to medical school in a mini-mall.
Hey, Pheebs. What are you doing?
I'm... I'm freaking out.
Monica kind of trusted me with something and she shouldn't have.
All right, I haven't lived here in a while, so I have to ask you.
Does Monica still turn the lights on in her bedroom?
Ahem. Yeah. - I am so dead.
All right, look, here's the bottom line, Ross.
This is fixable if we act fast, okay?
So I'll invite him to brunch tomorrow and you can make nice.
Honey, I have tried to make nice. It doesn't work.
Okay. Look, I realize my father is difficult...
...but that's why you have got to be the bigger man here.
Look, sweetie, I could be the bigger man. I could be the biggest man.
I could be a big, huge, giant man and it still wouldn't make a difference.
Except that I could pick your father up and say, "Like me. Like me, tiny doctor."
Okay, well, can't you just try it one more time, Ross? For me? For me?
Rachel, one brunch is not gonna solve anything.
You've gotta face it. We're never gonna get along.
Okay, well, you are just going to have to.
Okay? I've already got a mother and father who cannot stay in the same room.
I don't want to have a separate room for you too.
Okay, okay. Okay.
I'll get the bagels.
What's this?
Isn't it cool? Vroom. Vroom.
This is not the bed I ordered.
I know. You must have won, like, a contest or something.
Phoebe.
Why is this car in my bedroom?
I'm sorry, okay. I wasn't looking...
...and the store said that they won't take it back because you signed for it.
When did I sign for it? - When I was you.
You know what? It's all Joey's fault because he left his nose open.
Did you make brownies today?
Knock, knock.
Quick. Take off your dress. He won't notice the bed.
Hey, I'm going for sushi. Does anybody want, uh...?
Whoa. Somebody missed the off-ramp.
It's Monica's bed. What?
Okay...
It's a race car.
So? This has always been Monica's bed. What, you're just noticing now?
How self-involved are you?
Okay, well, if this bed isn't new...
...then how come there's plastic on the mattress?
Sometimes I have bad dreams.
Look...
...I just saw my best friend's brain smeared across the canvas.
It's not gonna be me.
Not me.
That was good. That was...
Tweezers? - No.
That was really good. - Thanks.
Any suggestions?
Hmm, I...
You told him to play the boxer gay?
Well, I might have said "super-gay."
You totally screwed him over.
Joey, you're this guy's teacher. I mean, how could you do this?
Because, Monica, the guy's so good.
And I really, really want this part.
Well, if you really, really want it, then it's okay.
Hi, Daddy. - Baby.
Ross? - Dr. Green, how are you?
Thanks for dinner last night.
Thank you for teaching me a valuable lesson.
Nice hair. What did you do, swim here?
Okay, that's it. I can't take it anymore.
What, what? He's interested in you.
He just wants to know how you got here. - Oh, please.
Sweetie, it's hopeless. I'm just gonna go. - What? Ross.
I'm sorry. It's just... - Ross?
What's with the neck?
He's got this thing and I keep telling him to go to my chiropractor.
You still going to that chiropractor?
That man couldn't get into med school in lxtapa.
Yeah, thank you. That's what I keep saying.
Excuse me, ahem, Dr. Bobby happens to be an excellent doctor.
Wait a minute. His name is Dr. Bobby?
Well, that's his last name. - And his first name.
He's Bobby Bobby?
Ahem. It's Robert Bobby.
And, um, excuse me. He helps me.
Oh. Please. Ask her how? - What do you need help for?
With my alignment. One leg's shorter than the other.
Oh, my God. - Yeah. Argue with that.
What? It's true. My right leg is two inches shorter.
Come on, you're just tilting.
Her legs are fine. - I know that.
So why do you let her go to a chiropractor? - I'm sorry, "Let her"?
What can I do? She doesn't listen to me about renter's insurance, either.
Wait a minute. You don't have renter's insurance?
No. Ahem. - So, what if somebody steals something?
How you gonna run after him with one leg shorter than the other?
Hey, would you, uh...? Would you like some juice?
I'd love some juice. - Okay.
Well, this is going so well. Did you see us? Did you see?
Yeah, honey. I was standing right there.
Why don't you tell him about the mole I haven't gotten checked?
Excellent.
There will come a time in each of your careers...
...when you'll have a chance to screw over another soap opera actor.
I had such an opportunity in the recent present.
And I'm ashamed to say...
...that I took it.
I advised a fellow actor to play a role...
...homosexually.
Yeah.
We both auditioned for the part and, uh...
...as it turned out...
...they...
They liked the stupid gay thing and cast him.
And now...
...he's got a two-year contract...
...opposite Susan Lucci...
...the first lady of daytime television.
And me?
Me, I'm stuck here teaching a bunch of people...
... most of whom are too ugly to even be on TV.
I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
Thank you.
Uh, may I help you? - Yes, hi.
I'm the lady who got stuck with the race-car bed.
Look, it's like I told you. There's nothing I can do.
You signed for it. "Monica Felula Geller."
All right, jester man, look, we wanna see the king.
Nobody sees the king.
Okay. I'm talking to the king.
Hey, you can't go back there.
Oh, my God.
Hey, watch it, lady.
Hey, good-looking.
All right, I'll leave.
My bed's so boring.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我跟卡尔说 不管他们的父母多有名
sense_groups.english: So I told Carl, nobody, no matter how famous their parents are...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人可以爬到恐龙上面
sense_groups.english: ...nobody is allowed to climb on the dinosaur.

sense_groups.chinese: 但大家当然是 一耳进…
sense_groups.english: But of course, this went right in one ear...

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢他如此在乎事情
sense_groups.english: I love how he cares so much about stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我眯眼看 还可以假装他是亚伦•艾达
sense_groups.english: If I squint, I can pretend he's Alan Alda.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 又在讲恐龙故事
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Another dinosaur story.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些故事什么时候才会绝种
sense_groups.english: When are those gonna become extinct?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我是个可以飞行和隐形的超级英雄
sense_groups.english: If I was a superhero who could fly and be invisible...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就太棒了
sense_groups.english: ...that would be the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋到底看上这家伙哪一点
sense_groups.english: What does Rachel see in this guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I love Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望她是我老婆
sense_groups.english: I wish she was my wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁在唱歌
sense_groups.english: Who's singing?

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们小时候 玩"快乐时光"扮家家酒时…
sense_groups.english: Hey, when you guys were kids and you played Happy Days...

sense_groups.chinese: 都扮演谁我都演瑞奇 - 我是琼妮
sense_groups.english: ...who were you? I was always Richie. - I was always Joanie.

sense_groups.chinese: 问题 "丢鸡蛋砸盖勒家" 是你街坊的口号吗
sense_groups.english: Was, uh, "Egg the Gellers" the war cry of your neighborhood?

sense_groups.chinese: 是床垫大王
sense_groups.english: Ew, ew! It's the Mattress King.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要看 快点转台
sense_groups.english: Don't look. Change the channel.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我想看 我跟他离婚后…
sense_groups.english: Wait. I want to see this. After I divorce him...

sense_groups.chinese: 半个王国都会是我的
sense_groups.english: ...half of that kingdom is gonna be mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 陈列室是如此地绝望
sense_groups.english: Despair fills the mattress showroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的王国突然间少了皇后
sense_groups.english: My kingdom is suddenly without a queen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超沮丧的…
sense_groups.english: I'm so depressed...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要大砍…
sense_groups.english: ...I'm going to slash...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的售价 快来选购
sense_groups.english: ...my prices! Check it out!

sense_groups.chinese: 加州特大床垫599元 舒适层加大床垫499元
sense_groups.english: 599 for a California king. 499 for a pillow-top queen set.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的价钱超中世纪的
sense_groups.english: I'm going medieval on prices.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是低贱
sense_groups.english: What a wank.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法相信他利用我们的离婚来卖床垫
sense_groups.english: Oh, I cannot believe he's using our divorce to sell mattresses.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊 舒适层加大床垫499元 谁还管离婚啊
sense_groups.english: I know. At 499 for a pillow-top queen, who cares about the divorce?

sense_groups.chinese: 它们一定卖得出去
sense_groups.english: Those babies will sell themselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我为你感到惊骇
sense_groups.english: And I'm appalled for you, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的卖场很近 我很便宜 我是国王
sense_groups.english: I'm close. I'm cheap. I'm the king.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 爸 我们明晚再见了 拜拜
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, Daddy. We'll see you tomorrow night. Okay, bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们
sense_groups.english: "We"?

sense_groups.chinese: 明天要跟我爸吃晚餐 希望没关系
sense_groups.english: Are, uh, having dinner with my dad tomorrow night. I hope that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 明天不太行
sense_groups.english: Oh, shoot. Tomorrow's not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该要从帝国大厦跳下来
sense_groups.english: I'm supposed to, um, fall off the Empire State Building...

sense_groups.chinese: 掉在一个没有坐垫的脚踏车上面…
sense_groups.english: ...and land on a bicycle with no seat, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我爸不讨厌你
sense_groups.english: Ross, my father doesn't hate you.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来 他说我是"油头"
sense_groups.english: Please. He refers to me as "Wet-Head."

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 他都用绰号称呼别人
sense_groups.english: Honey, he calls everybody by a nickname.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 一顿晚餐就好 为了我就一晚 好吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I know. Just one dinner. Please, one night. For me. Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只希望他像我一样爱你
sense_groups.english: I just want him to love you like I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不全然一样
sense_groups.english: All right. Well, not exactly like I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你来吃晚餐…
sense_groups.english: But if you do come to dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会穿着你喜欢的那件黑色衣服爱你
sense_groups.english: ...I'll love you like I do in that black thing that you like.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意去
sense_groups.english: I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Hi, Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 再说吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. We'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大家 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你们猜怎么着
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey. - Guess what.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有头路了 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: I got a gig. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我就是不能当演员 因为我说不出"头路"
sense_groups.english: See, that's why I can never be an actor. Because I can't say "gig."

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我也说不出"可颂" 天啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I can't say "croissant." Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么角色 - 不是角色
sense_groups.english: What's the part? - It's not a part. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在学习中心教人如何演肥皂剧
sense_groups.english: I'm teaching Acting for Soap Operas at the Learning Extension.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Come on. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的机会回馈…
sense_groups.english: It's like my chance to give something back...

sense_groups.chinese: 演艺圈
sense_groups.english: ...to the acting community.

sense_groups.chinese: 你大概不能和你的学生们上床
sense_groups.english: You know, you're probably not allowed to sleep with any of your students.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道耶 摩妮卡 光是来这里感觉就很奇怪
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I don't know, Monica. It feels funny just being here.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你跟珍妮丝的前夫买床垫…
sense_groups.english: I mean, if you buy a bed from Janice's ex-husband...

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟背叛钱德没两样
sense_groups.english: ...that's like betraying Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 价钱太好了
sense_groups.english: Not at these prices.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 如果在英国 这辆车就会在店的另外一边
sense_groups.english: You know, in England this car would be on the other side of the store.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 快过来
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我的新床
sense_groups.english: Ah, this is my new bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定得躺躺看
sense_groups.english: You gotta feel this bad boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 感觉还是很怪
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Monica, it still feels so weird, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德是你的朋友
sense_groups.english: Chandler's your friend. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 买这张床 你可以交别的朋友
sense_groups.english: Oh. All right, take this bed. You can make other friends. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是崔比亚尼先生
sense_groups.english: I am Mr. Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要教大家如何演肥皂剧
sense_groups.english: And I will be teaching Acting for Soap Operas.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: Now, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在"我们的日子" 饰演德瑞克•雷莫端医生的第一天…
sense_groups.english: ...on my first day as Dr. Drake Ramoray on Days of our Lives...

sense_groups.chinese: 我学到在肥皂剧中
sense_groups.english: ...uh, ahem, I learned that one of the most important things...

sense_groups.chinese: 最重要的一件事就是反应
sense_groups.english: ...in soap opera acting is reacting.

sense_groups.chinese: 不代表再演一次
sense_groups.english: This does not mean acting again.

sense_groups.chinese: 这代表你没有台词 而是别人刚讲完
sense_groups.english: It means you don't have a line, but someone else just did.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像这样
sense_groups.english: And it goes something like this. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了…
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Thanks. Thanks a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 在我忘记之前 要演肥皂剧…
sense_groups.english: By the way, before I forget. To work in soap operas...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有些人得变得迷人一点
sense_groups.english: ...some of you are gonna have to become much more attractive.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 继续吧…
sense_groups.english: All right, moving right along...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚教得如何 - 超棒的 可以说些很棒的话
sense_groups.english: Oh! How was teaching last night? - Oh, it was great. You get to say stuff like

sense_groups.chinese: "钟声不能让你下课 我才可以"
sense_groups.english: "Hey, the bell doesn't dismiss you. I dismiss you."

sense_groups.chinese: 真棒 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, nice. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我得到 "我的孩子们"的试演机会
sense_groups.english: Oh, and guess what. I got an audition for All My Children.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的一个角色
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's this great part.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个叫做尼克的拳击手
sense_groups.english: This boxer named Nick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超适合的 他跟我很像…
sense_groups.english: And I'm so, so right for it, you know? He's just like me...

sense_groups.chinese: 除了他是拳击手…
sense_groups.english: ...except that he's a boxer...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且有个邪恶的双胞胎之外
sense_groups.english: ...and has an evil twin.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了 来了 床垫大王送货来了
sense_groups.english: Hear ye, hear ye. Delivery from the Mattress King.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是盖勒小姐吗
sense_groups.english: You Miss Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 在这里签名
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Sign here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有中间名吗
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Do I have a middle name?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 摩妮卡•法鲁拉…
sense_groups.english: All right. Monica Felula...

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒
sense_groups.english: ...Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 那间卧房
sense_groups.english: It's that bedroom there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡在床垫大王买了张床
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica bought a bed from the Mattress King?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 拜托千万不要跟钱德讲
sense_groups.english: Yeah. So please, please, please don't say anything to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我对钱德撒谎 - 有问题吗
sense_groups.english: You want me to lie to Chandler? - Is that a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 拳击手尼克 来看你有什么能耐
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, hey, Nick the boxer. Let's see what you got.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好 做好动作啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - All right, put them up. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你还蛮行的嘛
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're pretty good at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我学过 我之前待过青年中心
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I had to learn. I was staying at the Y...

sense_groups.chinese: 有些少年表现得不像基督徒
sense_groups.english: ...and some of the young men weren't acting Christian enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 轻一点 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, now. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我流血了 太好了
sense_groups.english: Ow. And I'm bleeding. Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还吃素呢
sense_groups.english: Wow. And I'm a vegetarian.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 对不起 我们敷点冰块
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm sorry. We'll put some ice on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 头往后 - 好
sense_groups.english: Put your head back. Ooh. - Okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不到 - 我抓着你
sense_groups.english: I can't see. - I have you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒小姐 要放哪间卧房
sense_groups.english: Which bedroom do you want it in, Ms. Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 窗户边看起来像有洁癖的那间
sense_groups.english: Oh. It's the compulsively neat one by the window, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道了
sense_groups.english: Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 老爸
sense_groups.english: Hi, Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们把我们安排在这桌
sense_groups.english: This is where they put us?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么厨房没位置了吗
sense_groups.english: What? There was no table available in the kitchen?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的宝贝 - 你记得罗斯吧
sense_groups.english: Hello, baby. - You remember Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴再看到你 葛林医生
sense_groups.english: Nice to see you again, Dr. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So.

sense_groups.chinese: 图书馆怎么样 - 博物馆
sense_groups.english: How's the library? - Uh, museum.

sense_groups.chinese: 图书馆怎么了 -从来都没有过图书馆
sense_groups.english: What happened to the library? - There never was a library.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说到处都有图书馆
sense_groups.english: I mean, there are libraries. It's just that I, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我没在任何一间工作过
sense_groups.english: I've never worked at one. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道这里什么好吃吗
sense_groups.english: You know what's really good here?

sense_groups.chinese: 龙虾
sense_groups.english: The lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得怎样 直接点三只 - 好啊 如果你很饿的话
sense_groups.english: What do you say? Shall I just order three? - Yeah, if you're really hungry. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是笑话 我讲了笑话
sense_groups.english: It was a joke. I made a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实 罗斯对龙虾过敏
sense_groups.english: Yeah, actually, Daddy, Ross is allergic to lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么人会对龙虾过敏
sense_groups.english: What kind of person's allergic to lobster?

sense_groups.chinese: 大概是在图书馆工作的人吧
sense_groups.english: I guess the kind of person that works in a library. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是… - 我知道 是博物馆
sense_groups.english: It's not... - I know. It's a museum.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是唯一可以开玩笑的人吗 至少我的比较好笑
sense_groups.english: What, you're the only who can make a joke? At least mine was funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 服务生
sense_groups.english: Uh, waiter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要两只龙虾和一份菜单
sense_groups.english: We will have two lobsters and a menu.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林医生 那艘旧船怎么样了
sense_groups.english: So, Dr. Green, how's the old boat?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们发现有铁锈
sense_groups.english: They found rust.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道锈会让船怎样吗 - 有怀旧风
sense_groups.english: Do you know what rust does to a boat? - Gives it a nice antique-y look?

sense_groups.chinese: 铁锈等同于船癌 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Rust is boat cancer, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真遗憾
sense_groups.english: Wow, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我小时候 因为这样失去一台脚踏车
sense_groups.english: When I was a kid, I lost a bike to that. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 失陪一下
sense_groups.english: Excuse me for a moment, will you, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走之前 我想跟李文他们说再见
sense_groups.english: I wanna say good night to the Levines before we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 别这样 没那么糟糕
sense_groups.english: Honey, stop. It's not that bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你爸写错了
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. I think your dad must have added wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只给了百分之四的小费
sense_groups.english: He only tipped, like, 4 percent.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他就是这样
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Ahem, that's Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: "他就是这样" 这不会困扰你吗 你也是服务生
sense_groups.english: "That's Daddy"? Doesn't it bother you? You're a waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 的确会 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Yes, it bothers me, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果他是咖啡厅的常客…
sense_groups.english: But, you know, if he was a regular at the coffee house...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在饮料里加喷嚏
sense_groups.english: ...I'd be serving him sneezers.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样 - 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: So? - So, Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他抱怨几百次了 他不会变的
sense_groups.english: ...I've bugged him about this a million times. He's not gonna change.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的在饮料里加喷嚏
sense_groups.english: Do you really serve people sneezers?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我是不会
sense_groups.english: Ahem, well, um, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 准备走了吗 - 好了
sense_groups.english: All right, kids. Ready? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 再次谢谢你 葛林医生
sense_groups.english: Thanks again, Dr. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我忘了拿帐单
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait, I think I forgot my receipt.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你不需要的 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, you don't need that. - Ahem, why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 上面的碳会弄脏你的手指 导致…
sense_groups.english: The carbon. It's messy. I mean, gets on your fingers and causes...

sense_groups.chinese: 夜盲症
sense_groups.english: ...the, uh, night blindness.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么
sense_groups.english: What is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁放的二十元
sense_groups.english: Who put a 20 down here?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 是我
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, that would be me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…我有个问题
sense_groups.english: Um, I have... I have a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我小费给太多了 太多了
sense_groups.english: I tip way too much, way, way too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了病态的地步 - 没错
sense_groups.english: It's a sickness, really. - Yeah, it is. It is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得想点办法 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: We have to do something about that. - Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我很小气
sense_groups.english: You think I'm cheap?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 他没有这个意思
sense_groups.english: He didn't mean anything by that.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的没有 - 我做的事都没有什么意思
sense_groups.english: He really didn't. - Nothing I do means anything. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 晚餐我付了两百块
sense_groups.english: This is nice. I pay $200 for dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你放下二十块 就一副大爷的样子
sense_groups.english: You put down 20 and you come out looking like Mr. Big-Shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的想当大爷吗
sense_groups.english: You really wanna be Mr. Big-Shot?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 帐单由你来付 大爷
sense_groups.english: Here. I'll tell you what. You pay the whole bill, Mr. Big-Shot. All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 至少"大爷" 比"油头"好多了
sense_groups.english: Well, "Mr. Big-Shot" is better than "Wet-Head."

sense_groups.chinese: 来点演戏的小诀窍
sense_groups.english: Okay, some tricks of the trade.

sense_groups.chinese: 我演戏时都哭不出来
sense_groups.english: Now, I've never been able to cry as an actor...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我得演哭戏…
sense_groups.english: ...so if I'm in a scene where I have to cry...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在口袋剪个洞
sense_groups.english: ...I cut a hole in my pocket...

sense_groups.chinese: 放个钳子在里面
sense_groups.english: ...take a pair of tweezers...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后开始拔毛
sense_groups.english: ...and just start pulling.

sense_groups.chinese: 好… 假如我要诠释…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Or uh... Or let's say I want to convey...

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚做了邪恶的事情
sense_groups.english: ...that I've, uh, just done something evil.

sense_groups.chinese: 就得做出"我的眉毛有个鱼钩"的表情
sense_groups.english: Well, that would be your basic I've-got-a fish-hook-in-my-eyebrow-and-I-like-it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 假如我刚刚听到坏消息
sense_groups.english: No? Okay. Let's say I've just gotten bad news.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就会试着算232除以13
sense_groups.english: Well, all I do there is try and divide 232 by 13.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样
sense_groups.english: And that's how it's done.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚的肥皂剧演出到此结束
sense_groups.english: Great soap opera acting tonight, everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 下课
sense_groups.english: Class dismissed.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 老师 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mr. Trib. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎么着 我得到试演机会
sense_groups.english: Guess what. I got an audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的学生有试演机会 我好骄傲
sense_groups.english: Oh. One of my students got an audition. I'm so proud.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想问你可不可以教教我
sense_groups.english: I was wondering if you would consider coaching me for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 什么角色 - 很棒的角色
sense_groups.english: Oh, you bet. What's the part? - Oh, it's great.

sense_groups.chinese: "我的孩子们" 饰演拳击手尼克
sense_groups.english: It's a role on All My Children. Nick the boxer.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要放钱就对了 不放不行
sense_groups.english: Had to do it, didn't you? You couldn't leave it alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 百分之四就算食物里面有虫 我给的小费都比这个多
sense_groups.english: Four percent, okay? I tip more than that when there's a bug in my food.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 今晚只是要让你们两个处得来
sense_groups.english: Ross, tonight was about the two of you getting along.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以去看看我的脊椎按摩师吗
sense_groups.english: Would you see my chiropractor already?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我会去看一个在小购物商场念医学院的医生
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm gonna go to a doctor who went to medical school in a mini-mall.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你在干嘛
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我整个人都吓死了
sense_groups.english: I'm... I'm freaking out.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡交待我做某件事 她真的不该这么做的
sense_groups.english: Monica kind of trusted me with something and she shouldn't have.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经不住在这里很久了 所以得问问你们
sense_groups.english: All right, I haven't lived here in a while, so I have to ask you.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡还会打开她卧室的灯吗
sense_groups.english: Does Monica still turn the lights on in her bedroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 会 - 我完蛋了
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Yeah. - I am so dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听好我的重点 罗斯
sense_groups.english: All right, look, here's the bottom line, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 动作快的话 还可以补救 好吗
sense_groups.english: This is fixable if we act fast, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我请他吃早午餐 你可以表现得和善一点
sense_groups.english: So I'll invite him to brunch tomorrow and you can make nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我试过了 但是没用
sense_groups.english: Honey, I have tried to make nice. It doesn't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我知道我爸很难搞…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Look, I realize my father is difficult...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你心胸要放大一点
sense_groups.english: ...but that's why you have got to be the bigger man here.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我可以心胸大一点
sense_groups.english: Look, sweetie, I could be the bigger man. I could be the biggest man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我心胸可以超大的 但情况还是不会有所改变
sense_groups.english: I could be a big, huge, giant man and it still wouldn't make a difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 除了把他抓起来说 "你得喜欢我 小医生"之外
sense_groups.english: Except that I could pick your father up and say, "Like me. Like me, tiny doctor."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你可不可以再试一次 就当作是为了我
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, can't you just try it one more time, Ross? For me? For me?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 一场早午餐是不能解决问题的
sense_groups.english: Rachel, one brunch is not gonna solve anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 面对事实吧 我们就是合不来
sense_groups.english: You've gotta face it. We're never gonna get along.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你就是得试试看
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, you are just going to have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 懂吗 我已经有两个不能待在同一间房间的双亲
sense_groups.english: Okay? I've already got a mother and father who cannot stay in the same room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望还得替你准备另一个房间
sense_groups.english: I don't want to have a separate room for you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去买贝果
sense_groups.english: I'll get the bagels.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么东东
sense_groups.english: What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 很酷吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't it cool? Vroom. Vroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是我订的床垫
sense_groups.english: This is not the bed I ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你一定是赢了某种大奖
sense_groups.english: I know. You must have won, like, a contest or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么这台车会在我房间
sense_groups.english: Why is this car in my bedroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我那时没注意…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, okay. I wasn't looking...

sense_groups.chinese: 店家说他们不能收回 因为你已经签收了
sense_groups.english: ...and the store said that they won't take it back because you signed for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么时候签收的 - 我假装是你的时候
sense_groups.english: When did I sign for it? - When I was you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这都是乔伊的错 因为他的鼻子流血
sense_groups.english: You know what? It's all Joey's fault because he left his nose open.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天烤了布朗尼吗
sense_groups.english: Did you make brownies today?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人来了
sense_groups.english: Knock, knock.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 脱掉你的衣服 他就不会注意到床
sense_groups.english: Quick. Take off your dress. He won't notice the bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我要去吃寿司 有人要…
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm going for sushi. Does anybody want, uh...?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 有人忘了下交流道
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Somebody missed the off-ramp.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是摩妮卡的床 干嘛
sense_groups.english: It's Monica's bed. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那好…
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是台赛车
sense_groups.english: It's a race car.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一直是摩妮卡的床 你现在才注意到吗
sense_groups.english: So? This has always been Monica's bed. What, you're just noticing now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是自我中心
sense_groups.english: How self-involved are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这张床不是新的…
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, if this bed isn't new...

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么上面会有胶膜
sense_groups.english: ...then how come there's plastic on the mattress?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有时候会做恶梦
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I have bad dreams.

sense_groups.chinese: 听好…
sense_groups.english: Look...

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚才看到我的死党脑浆溅在帆布上
sense_groups.english: ...I just saw my best friend's brain smeared across the canvas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要跟他一样
sense_groups.english: It's not gonna be me.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对不会
sense_groups.english: Not me.

sense_groups.chinese: 表演很棒 非常…
sense_groups.english: That was good. That was...

sense_groups.chinese: 有用钳子吗 - 没有
sense_groups.english: Tweezers? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很棒 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: That was really good. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么建议吗
sense_groups.english: Any suggestions?

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: Hmm, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫他演同志拳击手
sense_groups.english: You told him to play the boxer gay?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我可能是说"越明显越好"
sense_groups.english: Well, I might have said "super-gay."

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的是恶搞他
sense_groups.english: You totally screwed him over.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你是他的老师 怎么可以这样
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're this guy's teacher. I mean, how could you do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他真的很厉害
sense_groups.english: Because, Monica, the guy's so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的真的很想要这个角色
sense_groups.english: And I really, really want this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你真的真的想要这个角色 就没有关系
sense_groups.english: Well, if you really, really want it, then it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 老爸 - 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Hi, Daddy. - Baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 葛林医师 你好
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Dr. Green, how are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚的晚餐谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thanks for dinner last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你教了我宝贵的一课
sense_groups.english: Thank you for teaching me a valuable lesson.

sense_groups.chinese: 头发还不赖 你游泳过来的吗
sense_groups.english: Nice hair. What did you do, swim here?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 够了 我不能承受了
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's it. I can't take it anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 他对你很感兴趣
sense_groups.english: What, what? He's interested in you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喜欢你的头发 只想知道你怎么来的 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: He just wants to know how you got here. - Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 没用的 我要走了 - 什么 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, it's hopeless. I'm just gonna go. - What? Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 只是… - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's just... - Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 你脖子怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's with the neck?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不舒服 我一直叫他去看我的脊椎按摩师
sense_groups.english: He's got this thing and I keep telling him to go to my chiropractor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在看那个脊椎按摩师
sense_groups.english: You still going to that chiropractor?

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙连三流的医学院都进不去
sense_groups.english: That man couldn't get into med school in lxtapa.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 我也是这样说的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, thank you. That's what I keep saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 巴比医生是个很棒的医生
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, ahem, Dr. Bobby happens to be an excellent doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 他叫做巴比医生
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. His name is Dr. Bobby?

sense_groups.chinese: 是他的姓氏 - 名字也是
sense_groups.english: Well, that's his last name. - And his first name.

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫做巴比•巴比
sense_groups.english: He's Bobby Bobby?

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗伯•巴比
sense_groups.english: Ahem. It's Robert Bobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且不好意思 他帮了我很多
sense_groups.english: And, um, excuse me. He helps me.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你问问她怎么帮的 - 帮你做什么
sense_groups.english: Oh. Please. Ask her how? - What do you need help for?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我调整骨架 我一只脚比较长
sense_groups.english: With my alignment. One leg's shorter than the other.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 是啊 要怎么跟她争
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Yeah. Argue with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了

sense_groups.english: ...when you'll have a chance to screw over another soap opera actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最近有这样的机会
sense_groups.english: I had such an opportunity in the recent present.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很惭愧地说…
sense_groups.english: And I'm ashamed to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也做了

sense_groups.chinese: 我建议另一位演员以不同的方法表演…
sense_groups.english: I advised a fellow actor to play a role...

sense_groups.chinese: 演得像同志一样
sense_groups.english: ...homosexually.

sense_groups.chinese: 对

sense_groups.chinese: 我们两人都参与同一个角色的试演
sense_groups.english: We both auditioned for the part and, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果…

sense_groups.chinese: 他们…
sense_groups.english: ...they...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在…

sense_groups.chinese: 他签了两年合约…

sense_groups.chinese: 跟苏珊•路奇合作…
sense_groups.english: ...opposite Susan Lucci...

sense_groups.chinese: 日间电视的大红人
sense_groups.english: ...the first lady of daytime television.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我呢
sense_groups.english: And me?

sense_groups.chinese: 困在这里教一群…
sense_groups.english: Me, I'm stuck here teaching a bunch of people...

sense_groups.chinese: 丑到连上电视都不行的人
sense_groups.english: ... most of whom are too ugly to even be on TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你通过电话 我拿到那张赛车床

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经说过了 我帮不上你的忙
sense_groups.english: Look, it's like I told you. There's nothing I can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经签收了 "摩妮卡•法鲁拉•盖勒"

sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm talking to the king.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你不能进去

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 菲比
sense_groups.english: Here you go, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要吃我的特殊自制布朗尼蛋糕
sense_groups.english: Who wants one of my special home-baked brownies?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要吃一块
sense_groups.english: I'll have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 - 我不吃了
sense_groups.english: That's okay. - I'm not having one.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是牙齿痛
sense_groups.english: No, no. It's just my tooth.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 我要吃一块
sense_groups.english: All right. - I'll have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要牙医吗 我的牙医很不错
sense_groups.english: So you need a dentist? I've got a good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我的牙医也很不错 但我没办法去看他
sense_groups.english: Thanks. I have a good one too. I just can't see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 那就是隐形牙医的问题
sense_groups.english: See, that is the problem with invisible dentists.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你不能去看他
sense_groups.english: Why can't you go to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为每次我去看牙医 都会有人死掉
sense_groups.english: Because every time I go to the dentist, somebody dies.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很奇怪 因为每次我去看牙医
sense_groups.english: That's so weird. Every time I go to the dentist...

sense_groups.chinese: 我都会看助理的胸部
sense_groups.english: ...I look down the hygienist's blouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你说…
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what, um?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 首先是我的玛丽阿姨
sense_groups.english: First, it was my Aunt Mary.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后是我的邮差约翰
sense_groups.english: And then there was, um, John, my mailman.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的牛仔朋友艾比诺•巴伯
sense_groups.english: And then my cowboy friend, Albino Bob.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些人真的死了
sense_groups.english: Ahem. And all these people actually died?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我去看牙医的时候
sense_groups.english: Yes. While I was in the chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我很保护我的牙齿 这跟口腔卫生无关
sense_groups.english: That's why I take care of my teeth. It's not about oral hygiene.

sense_groups.chinese: 我使用牙线是为了救人一命
sense_groups.english: I floss to save lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你没有害死任何人
sense_groups.english: Come on, you didn't kill anybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些人只是刚好 在你去看牙医时死掉了
sense_groups.english: These people just happened to die when you went to the dentist.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个巧合
sense_groups.english: It's just a coincidence.

sense_groups.chinese: 去跟他们说吧 不行 他们死了
sense_groups.english: Tell that to them. Oh, you can't! They're dead!

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 能给我一张纸巾吗
sense_groups.english: Um, can I get a napkin too?

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经什么都有了
sense_groups.english: Oh, like you don't already have everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你痛得要命 你该去看牙医 快去吧
sense_groups.english: You're in pain. Would you just go to the dentist? Just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你是我下一个受害者
sense_groups.english: Fine. But if you're my next victim...

sense_groups.chinese: 别化身为厉鬼回来找我 把我吸进电视机里
sense_groups.english: ...don't come back as a poltergeist who sucks me into the TV set.

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证绝对不会
sense_groups.english: I promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 别以为你就能不来看我了
sense_groups.english: Although, don't feel like you can't visit.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德在吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, is Chandler here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他不在
sense_groups.english: No. No, he's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 乔伊看到珍妮丝吻她的前夫
sense_groups.english: You guys, Joey just saw Janice kissing her ex-husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么办 你怎么跟钱德说
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do? How are you gonna tell Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在想那一点 我认为最好的方法就是…
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about that. I think the best way would be...

sense_groups.chinese: 不要说
sense_groups.english: ...to not.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你知道这件事就一定要告诉他
sense_groups.english: Joey, if you know about this, you have to tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 这会要了他的命
sense_groups.english: It'll kill him. It'll just kill him.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我去看牙医后再说 或许我会先要了他的命
sense_groups.english: Wait till I go to the dentist. Maybe I'll kill him.

sense_groups.chinese: 丑八怪裸男躺在吊床上 那像是黏土肥油工厂
sense_groups.english: Ugly Naked Guy's using a hammock. It's like a Play-Doh fat factory.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去看牙医 听我说
sense_groups.english: I'm going to the dentist. So listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 小心别跌倒了
sense_groups.english: ...just be on the lookout for anything that you could fall into...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是别被东西砸到
sense_groups.english: ...or that can fall on you...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是…
好吧 小心一点就对了
sense_groups.english: All right, just look out!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 我只是想…
sense_groups.english: Okay? And, um, I also just want to...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想告诉大家…
sense_groups.english: I just want to tell you all that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个问题 我得去工作几小时
sense_groups.english: I have a problem. I have to go into work for a few hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些小鬼搞乱了智人展示品
sense_groups.english: Some kids messed up the Homo sapien display.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们做了什么
sense_groups.english: What did they do?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们把招牌上的"智"涂掉了
sense_groups.english: They painted over the word "sapien," for one thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 还把人偶重新排列 我真的不想说太多
sense_groups.english: Then they rearranged the figures. Let's just leave it at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我帮你照顾小班吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to watch Ben for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我正想问你 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yes, that's what I was gonna ask. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我呢
sense_groups.english: Woah, wait, hello! Heh, what about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你 你想照顾小班
sense_groups.english: You. You want to watch Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了 我正要问摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: That would be great! I just asked Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我知道她的生活有多么空虚
sense_groups.english: ...because I know how empty her life is.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我要问你一个科学问题 - 对
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross? I got a science question. - Yeah. Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果智人真的是同性恋
sense_groups.english: If the Homo sapiens were, in fact, "homo" sapiens...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是他们灭绝的原因吗
sense_groups.english: ...is that why they're extinct?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 智人就是人
sense_groups.english: Joey, Homo sapiens are people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是在批评他们
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm not judging.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 小班 汤匙
sense_groups.english: Look, Benny! Spoon!

sense_groups.chinese: 汤匙
sense_groups.english: Spoon!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 好了 你知道吗 我想他很无聊
sense_groups.english: Come on. All right, you know what? I think he's bored.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要玩飞机游戏吗
sense_groups.english: Here. You wanna play the airplane game?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要玩给瑞秋看吗 来吧
sense_groups.english: You wanna show Rachel? Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要做些有趣的事吗 好吧
sense_groups.english: You wanna do something fun? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好勇敢 没错
sense_groups.english: You're so brave. You're so brave! Yes, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好勇敢 - 你很不错
sense_groups.english: You're so brave. - You're okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没事的 把他放下来
sense_groups.english: He's fine. Let's just put him down.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 宝贝 你是个好孩子
sense_groups.english: Come here, babe. Yes, you're such a good boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能那么做 罗斯相信我 他会怎么说
sense_groups.english: How could you do that to him? Ross trusted me! What's he gonna say?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的 因为我们不会告诉他
sense_groups.english: Nothing, because we're not telling him.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 - 没错
sense_groups.english: We're not? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我喜欢那样 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, I like that. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事了 对吧
sense_groups.english: So we're okay. We're okay, aren't we?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 问题大了 他的头肿了起来
sense_groups.english: No, we're not okay. There's a bump.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的头肿了起来 - 在哪里
sense_groups.english: There's a bump. - What bump?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 把它压回去
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Well, push it in! Push it in!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法把它压回去
sense_groups.english: I can not push it in!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们需要分散注意力 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're gonna need a distraction. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 好的
sense_groups.english: That's it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: I got it! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯一进门 - 对
sense_groups.english: The second Ross walks in... - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 带他到你的房间 不论你要做什么 让他开心大叫
sense_groups.english: ...take him to your bedroom and do whatever you do that makes him go

sense_groups.chinese: 或是…
sense_groups.english: Or...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以帮他戴帽子
sense_groups.english: ...we could put a hat on his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 帽子 没错 我们需要帽子 我们去哪里找顶小帽子
sense_groups.english: A hat! Yes! We need a hat! Where are we gonna find a tiny little hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有雨天小熊
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh! I'll get Rainy Day Bear!

sense_groups.chinese: 它知道该怎么做
sense_groups.english: Because he'll know what to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你是个天才
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You're a genius!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 帽子缝死了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. It's kind of sewn on.

sense_groups.chinese: 快给我 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Give it. Give it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天就跟一场血战一样
sense_groups.english: Agh, it's just like a bloodbath in here today!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hey, hold on a second. Hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得这条珍珠项链漂亮吗
sense_groups.english: Do you think these pearls are nice?

sense_groups.chinese: 我比较喜欢登山自行车
sense_groups.english: I'd prefer a mountain bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝的生日快到了 我要送她一样特别的礼物
sense_groups.english: Janice's birthday's coming. I wanna get her something special.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我一起进去 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Come in here with me. - Woah, woah, whoa, wait. Woah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要送她特别的礼物 送她花
sense_groups.english: You wanna get her something special? Get her flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 送她糖果 送她口香糖 女生喜欢口香糖
sense_groups.english: Get her candy. Get her gum. Girls love gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个好点子 亲爱的珍妮丝 祝你生日吹泡泡快乐
sense_groups.english: That's a good idea. "Dear Janice: Have a Hubba-Bubba birthday."

sense_groups.chinese: 我要送她认真一点的礼物
sense_groups.english: I'd like to get her something serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要认真一点的礼物
sense_groups.english: Oh, you want something serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你该怎么办吗 你该送她…
sense_groups.english: You know what you should do? You should get her one of those, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 灌肠剂
sense_groups.english: ...barium enemas.

sense_groups.chinese: 那保证认真
sense_groups.english: Those are dead serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我要进去了 千万别买礼物送我
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm gonna go in here. And you don't buy me anything, ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能送她珍珠项链
sense_groups.english: You can't! You can't. You can't buy her pearls.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是不能那么做
sense_groups.english: You just can't, you can't, you can't!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不能
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Uh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情是这样的
sense_groups.english: Here's the thing. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情是这样的 好吧 问题是…
sense_groups.english: This is the thing. Okay, the thing is...

sense_groups.chinese: 到底怎么了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: What is the thing? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在床垫大王卖场
sense_groups.english: I went down to the Mattress King's showroom...

sense_groups.chinese: 看到珍妮丝吻她的前夫
sense_groups.english: ...and I saw Janice kissing her ex-husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在他的办公室里
sense_groups.english: They were in his office.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会那么做 她跟我在一起
sense_groups.english: Well, she... She wouldn't do that. She's with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说真的 我看到了
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, I saw it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看错了 好吗
sense_groups.english: Well, you're wrong. Okay? You're wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没看错
sense_groups.english: I'm not wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也希望我看错了
sense_groups.english: I wish I was.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 灌肠剂是个不错的点子吧
sense_groups.english: Bet that barium enema doesn't sound so bad now, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 整套穿上比较逼真 他不会注意到帽子的部分
sense_groups.english: It makes more sense as an ensemble. And it takes the focus off the hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还活着
sense_groups.english: Oh! You're alive! You're alive!

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我保证过不会有人死掉 对吧
sense_groups.english: See? I promised you no one would die, didn't I?

sense_groups.chinese: 走着瞧吧 我能借用你的电话 问一下我认识的所有人吗
sense_groups.english: We'll see about that. Can I use your phone to call everyone I know?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我们没有钱 请便
sense_groups.english: Sure. We have no money. Go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're not dead! Okay, see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他会说我的名字
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! He just said my name!

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡撞到了
sense_groups.english: Monica bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我听到了
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Okay, I heard that.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说"摩妮卡撞到了"
sense_groups.english: Did he just say, "Monica bang"?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他要告我的密
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! He's gonna rat me out!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡撞到了
sense_groups.english: Monica bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你不能再那么说
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, you need to stop saying that now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那没什么大不了的 根本不值一提
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal. It's not even worth mentioning.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我们常那么做
sense_groups.english: You see? We all do it all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到了吗 看我的
sense_groups.english: See? Watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班
sense_groups.english: Ben, Ben, Ben. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡撞到了 大家撞到了
sense_groups.english: Monica bang! Everybody bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 班撞到了
sense_groups.english: Ben bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋撞到了
sense_groups.english: Rachel bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 撞 瑞秋 撞
sense_groups.english: Bang, Rachel! Bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 很好玩吧 - 看我的
sense_groups.english: Oh, isn't it fun? - Look at that! Look at that!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都会那么做
sense_groups.english: We all do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我不再撞了 - 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm stopping now. - Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 如果不是撞床头板 真的不值得这么做
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. You know, if it's not a headboard, it's just not worth it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小宝贝还好吧
sense_groups.english: How's my Bing-a-ling?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来告诉我吧
sense_groups.english: You tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有事要跟我说吗
sense_groups.english: Anything you, uh, want to tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为如果你…你该…
sense_groups.english: Because if you, uh... You should...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会告诉我的
sense_groups.english: You would tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛睁大了眼睛
sense_groups.english: Why are your eyes so wide?

sense_groups.chinese: 你来告诉我吧
sense_groups.english: You tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许那是因为我跟我前女友胡来
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's because I was just fooling around with my ex.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是你跟前夫胡来
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, no, no. That was you!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 你怎么知道
sense_groups.english: All right! - How did you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊跟我说的 他看到你们两个在接吻
sense_groups.english: Joey told me. He saw you two kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 在公园里
sense_groups.english: In the park?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他的办公室里 你们接吻过几次
sense_groups.english: No. In his office. How many kisses were there?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有那两次 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Just those two! - Wh...? Why? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你们要接吻 你们不该接吻的
sense_groups.english: Why was there kissing? There should be no kissing!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 甜心 我真的…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry, honey. I'm so, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 我是…
sense_groups.english: I'm so, so sorry. I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 事实是我…我无法呼吸
sense_groups.english: What happened was I... I can't breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我拿个袋子过来吗
sense_groups.english: Can you get me a bag or something? Aah.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去
sense_groups.english: Here. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: There.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是收据 - 我来处理
sense_groups.english: It's the receipt. - I'll take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我得知道
sense_groups.english: Look, I've got to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我分手吗
sense_groups.english: Are you finished with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟他分手吗
sense_groups.english: Are you finished with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还爱他
sense_groups.english: Do you still love him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还爱我
sense_groups.english: Do you still love me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听着
sense_groups.english: All right, look...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要真的答案 好吗
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna need an actual answer here, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 到底你要哪一个
sense_groups.english: So which is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他或我
sense_groups.english: Him or me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你还活着 你该接电话的
sense_groups.english: Okay, if you're alive, you answer your phone!

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 我不会跟你爸说你在晚餐前吃冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: Ben, I won't tell your daddy that you had ice cream before dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你不跟他说我们撞到头的小意外
sense_groups.english: ...if you won't tell him about our little bonking incident.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一 我想小班不了解贿赂的概念
sense_groups.english: Number one, I don't think Ben understands the concept of bribery.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二 我…
sense_groups.english: And number two, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说"第二"
sense_groups.english: You said "number two."

sense_groups.chinese: 我还说了"第一"
sense_groups.english: I also said "number one."

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, everyone! - Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 我儿子还好吗
sense_groups.english: How's my little boy?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很好 对吧 小班
sense_groups.english: He's perfect. Aren't you, Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 他再好不过了 - 你们做了什么 带他去赏鲸
sense_groups.english: He's never been better. - What did you do, take him whaling?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他会叫你的名字 太棒了 做得好 小班
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! He just said your name! That's great! Good job, Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡撞到了
sense_groups.english: Monica bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会一副要爆炸的模样
sense_groups.english: That's what I'd sound like if I exploded.

sense_groups.chinese: 诅咒被打破了 我打电话给我认识的所有人
sense_groups.english: Woo-hoo! The curse is broken! I called everybody I know...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都活着
sense_groups.english: ...and everyone is alive!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 丑八怪裸男一动都不动
sense_groups.english: Ugly Naked Guy looks awfully still.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我又杀人了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I killed another one!

sense_groups.chinese: 诅咒越来越强 连那么胖的人都会死
sense_groups.english: The curse is getting stronger too, to bring down something that big.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他只是在睡午觉
sense_groups.english: Maybe he's just taking a nap.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说他从今天早上开始就一动都不动的
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, he hasn't moved since this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该报警
sense_groups.english: We should call somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他们说我们偷窥的裸男一动都不动
sense_groups.english: Tell them the naked guy we stare at isn't moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得知道他是不是还活着
sense_groups.english: We've got to find out if he's alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: How are we gonna do that? There's no way.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个办法
sense_groups.english: Well, there is one way.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的窗户没关 我是说…
sense_groups.english: His window's open. I say...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以戳戳他
sense_groups.english: ...we poke him.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们吃中国菜时
sense_groups.english: You know how we, uh, save all those chopsticks...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是会把筷子留下来吗
sense_groups.english: ...for no reason when we get Chinese food?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在能派上用场了
sense_groups.english: Well, now we got a reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要做非常长的戳人棒
sense_groups.english: Well, we're fashioning a very long poking device.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, what's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟珍妮丝谈过
sense_groups.english: I talked to Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她要跟他复合吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Is she going back to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不知道
sense_groups.english: She doesn't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她爱我们两个
sense_groups.english: Says she loves us both.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上醒来时 我沉溺在爱河里
sense_groups.english: I woke up this morning, I was in love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很幸福
sense_groups.english: I was happy!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我去买了12包保险套
sense_groups.english: It serves me right for buying that 12-pack of condoms.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我没办法退货 因为她把收据吞了下去
sense_groups.english: And now I can't even return them, because she choked on the receipt!

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么办
sense_groups.english: What are you, uh...? What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会怎么做呢
sense_groups.english: You know? What would you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会怎么做并不重要
sense_groups.english: Uh, it doesn't matter what I'd do.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 快告诉我
sense_groups.english: Come on. Come on. Tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你…
sense_groups.english: All right, you, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你不想听 可是…
sense_groups.english: ...you probably won't want to hear this, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 换作是我 这是我的做法 我会…
sense_groups.english: ...if it was me, and this is just me, I would, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会自己闪人 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I would bow out. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在胡说什么
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有个孩子
sense_groups.english: They have a kid together...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 他们是…
sense_groups.english: ...you know? They're like...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是一家人
sense_groups.english: They're, like, a family.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果…我不知道
sense_groups.english: And if, I don't know...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他们有机会复合
sense_groups.english: ...if there's a chance they can make that work...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想变成破坏他们家庭的人
sense_groups.english: ...I wouldn't want to be the guy who stood in the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: You okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你…
sense_groups.english: You, uh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去戳裸男吗
sense_groups.english: You wanna come poke a nude guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 他终于睡着了
sense_groups.english: Well, he's finally asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的头肿了起来
sense_groups.english: About that, uh, bump on his head...

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定那是新伤口吗
sense_groups.english: Are you, uh, sure it's a new bump?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有恶意 但我觉得小班是头鼓鼓的小孩
sense_groups.english: No offense, but I've always thought of Ben as a fairly bumpy-headed child.

sense_groups.chinese: 他撞到头不是大事 小孩子常撞到头
sense_groups.english: It's okay if he bumps his head. Kids bump their heads all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你第一次当褓姆 你尽力了
sense_groups.english: It was your first time babysitting. You did your best.

sense_groups.chinese: 我尽力了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I did! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得无时无刻看着他
sense_groups.english: You just have to watch them all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有啊 我有看着他
sense_groups.english: I did! I watched! I watched!

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到摩妮卡撞到他的头
sense_groups.english: I watched Monica bang his head against that thing!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是摩妮卡撞的
sense_groups.english: Monica did it?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Monica? Um... - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天你注意到有点小班怪怪的吗
sense_groups.english: Did you notice anything weird about Ben today?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啊 怎么了
sense_groups.english: No, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他玩 我们在唱字母歌
sense_groups.english: I was just playing with him, and we were doing the "Alphabet Song"...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是他的拿手歌曲 但他忘了唱E跟F
sense_groups.english: ...which he's good at. But he left out "E" and "F."

sense_groups.chinese: 就像是…我不知道 他完全忘得精光
sense_groups.english: It's like they just, uh, I don't know, fell out of his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有他走路的样子
sense_groups.english: Oh, and also, he's walking...

sense_groups.chinese: 有点怪怪的
sense_groups.english: ...kind of funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的左脚比右脚迈步快
sense_groups.english: It's like his left leg is moving a lot faster than his right leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他在房里会这么做
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's in there, just sort of, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我把你儿子弄坏了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! I wrecked your baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你下地狱后还会觉得很好笑
sense_groups.english: I hope it's still funny when you're in hell.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个混蛋
sense_groups.english: You jerk!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我爱那个孩子 - 摩妮卡撞到了
sense_groups.english: You know I love that kid! - Monica bang! Monica bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 我去拿帽子
sense_groups.english: I'll get the hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 我有事要跟你说
sense_groups.english: I have something to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你听我说完
sense_groups.english: And I want you to let me get through it...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…
sense_groups.english: ...because...

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是件容易启齿的事
sense_groups.english: ...it's not gonna be easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你该跟盖瑞复合
sense_groups.english: I think you should go back with Gary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想拆散你们一家人
sense_groups.english: I don't want to be the guy that breaks up a family.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈因为那个男人分手
sense_groups.english: You know, when my parents split up, it was because of that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次见到他 我都会想
sense_groups.english: Whenever I'd see him, I'd always think

sense_groups.chinese: 就是你害的 你让他们无法在一起
sense_groups.english: "You're the reason. You are why they're not together."

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨那个男人
sense_groups.english: And I hated that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不论他人多好 他让我爸多么开心
sense_groups.english: And it didn't matter how nice he was or how happy he made my dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么做才是对的
sense_groups.english: It's the right thing to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对
sense_groups.english: You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 在我跟你道别前
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. But before I can say goodbye...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有件事得跟你说
sense_groups.english: ...there's something I really need you to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对你的感觉
sense_groups.english: The way I feel about you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于能体会
sense_groups.english: ...it's like I finally understand...

sense_groups.chinese: 莱诺•李奇唱的那首歌
sense_groups.english: ...what Lionel Richie's been singing about.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我们拥有的一切
sense_groups.english: You know? I mean, what we have...

sense_groups.chinese: 像是电影里的爱情故事
sense_groups.english: ...it's like movie love.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我的灵魂伴侣
sense_groups.english: You're my soul mate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我们无法共度一生
sense_groups.english: I can't believe we're not gonna spend the rest of our lives together.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就别离开我
sense_groups.english: Then don't leave me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 忘了我说过的话 我在胡说八道 挑我吧
sense_groups.english: Forget what I said! I was babbling! Pick me!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你说的对 我得再给我的婚姻一次机会
sense_groups.english: No, you were right! I gotta give my marriage another chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能那么做
sense_groups.english: Pssh! No, you don't!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说 你得给你的离婚手续一次机会
sense_groups.english: No, I say you have to give your divorce another chance!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 别走
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我非走不可
sense_groups.english: No, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No. No. No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Honey. Honey. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都在看 - 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: People are looking. - I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't care!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好吧 我…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um, okay. I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm leaving now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你走不了 我把你的鞋子拿走了
sense_groups.english: You can't leave! I have your shoe!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 钱德宾
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Chandler Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋也有一双紫红色的
sense_groups.english: Rachel has those in burgundy.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 像这样又粗又长的东西操作起来会非常困难
sense_groups.english: Remember, something this big and long will be very difficult to maneuver.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好在那方面我的经验丰富
sense_groups.english: Fortunately, I have experience in that area.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能专心一点吗 这跟裸男的死活有关
sense_groups.english: Can we please focus here? A naked man's life hangs in the balance.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌他死了
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, he's dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会发现插了一根棍子的死胖子
sense_groups.english: What we're about to have here is a dead fat guy on a stick!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 各位先生女士 开始戳
sense_groups.english: All right, ladies and gentlemen, let's poke.

sense_groups.chinese: 稳住
sense_groups.english: Steady.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 高一点
sense_groups.english: Okay, a little higher.

sense_groups.chinese: 注意角度
sense_groups.english: Careful of the angle.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 已经到窗边了
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. We're approaching the window.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿过去
sense_groups.english: Thread the needle. Thread the needle.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还活着
sense_groups.english: He's alive! He's alive!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们还在戳他
sense_groups.english: And yet we're still poking him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 收工了
sense_groups.english: Okay, retract the device! Retract the device!

sense_groups.chinese: 他似乎不太开心
sense_groups.english: He does not look happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他露出他戳人的东西了
sense_groups.english: Now he's showing us his poking device.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是戳不到这里来的 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Hey, that's never gonna make it all the way over here, buddy! Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: # 我紧拥你在怀中 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll hold you close in my arms #

sense_groups.chinese: # 无法抵挡你的魅力 #
sense_groups.english: # I can't resist your charms #

sense_groups.chinese: # 爱情 #
sense_groups.english: # And love #

sense_groups.chinese: # 爱情 #
sense_groups.english: # Love #

sense_groups.chinese: # 为你 我会变成一个傻瓜 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be a fool for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 是的 我确定 #
sense_groups.english: # I'm sure #

sense_groups.chinese: # 但你知道我不会介意 #
sense_groups.english: # You know I don't mind #

sense_groups.chinese: # 噢 你知道我不会介意#
sense_groups.english: # Oh, you know I don't mind #

sense_groups.chinese: # 没错 #
sense_groups.english: # Yes #

sense_groups.chinese: # 对我而言你就是全世界 #
sense_groups.english: # You mean the world to me #

sense_groups.chinese: # - 我知道 - 我知道 #
sense_groups.english: # - Oh, I know - I know #

sense_groups.chinese: # - 我找到 - 我找到 #
sense_groups.english: # - I've found - I've found #

sense_groups.chinese: # 在你身上 #
sense_groups.english: # In you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 我找到了无尽的爱 #
sense_groups.english: # My endless love #

sense_groups.chinese: # 爱情 #
sense_groups.english: # Love #

sense_groups.chinese: # - 爱情 - 爱情 #
sense_groups.english: # - Lo... Love - Love #

questions.name: S03E09
questions.en:
Oh, come on!
Hey, it's your Thanksgiving too.
You know, instead of watching football, you could help.
We know.
Rachel, you wanna put the marshmallows in concentric circles.
No, you want to put them in concentric circles.
I want to do this.
Every year.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
To the 10, to the 5. Touchdown, Giants!
You know, for once, I am gonna try to watch one of these things.
Halftime.
Who wants to, uh, throw the ball around? Get a little 3-on-3 going?
Oh, that would be so much fun! - Can I play too?
I've never played football, ever.
Great! You can cover Chandler.
I don't... I don't really want to play.
You never do anything since you and Janice broke up.
Not true.
I wanted to wear my bathrobe and eat peanut clusters all day.
And start drinking in the morning. Don't say I don't have goals!
You have to start getting over her, all right?
If you play, maybe it'll take your mind off Janice.
If you don't, everyone will be mad at you because the teams won't be even.
All right, I'll play.
Yay! Let's do it! Ross?
What? - Wanna play football?
Monica and I aren't supposed to play football.
Says who? Your mom? Ha-ha-ha.
Yes.
Ahem. Every Thanksgiving, um, we used to have a touch football game...
...called The Geller Bowl.
No, no, no. You say that proudly!
Anyway, Ross and I were always captains, and, um...
It got kind of competitive. And one year, Geller Bowl VI...
...I accidentally broke Ross' nose.
It was so not an accident.
She saw I was about to tag her, so she threw...
...her big fat grandma-arm elbow in my face...
...and just kept running.
To score the winning touchdown, by the way.
Uh, you did not win the game. The touchdown didn't count...
...because of the spectacularly illegal, and savage, nose-breaking.
I won the game.
Yeah? Then how come you didn't get the Geller Cup?
Ahem, there was a Geller Cup?
Yes, the trophy you got if you won the game.
But Dad said nobody won, and he was sick of our fighting.
So he took the trophy...
...threw it in the lake.
And was the curse lifted?
Anyway...
...Mom said we weren't allowed to play football again.
You know what? I think we should play a game.
I mean, come on. It's been 12 years.
Can I see you for a second?

sense_groups.english: But Dad said nobody won, and he was sick of our fighting.
