sense_groups.english: So he took the trophy...

sense_groups.chinese: 丢进湖里
sense_groups.english: ...threw it in the lake.

sense_groups.chinese: 诅咒破解了吗
sense_groups.english: And was the curse lifted?

sense_groups.chinese: 总之…
sense_groups.english: Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 妈说我们再也不准玩足球
sense_groups.english: ...Mom said we weren't allowed to play football again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我想我们能打一场比赛
sense_groups.english: You know what? I think we should play a game.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 那是十二年前的事
sense_groups.english: I mean, come on. It's been 12 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能谈一谈吗
sense_groups.english: Can I see you for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 胆小鬼
sense_groups.english: Wuss!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们要玩
sense_groups.english: All right, we're gonna play.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我们怎么去球场 我妈不让我过街
sense_groups.english: Wait. How we gonna get there? My mom won't let me cross the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始了 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Let's bring it in. - Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 传给我
sense_groups.english: Honey, throw it to me!

sense_groups.chinese: 接住了
sense_groups.english: Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那几乎打中我的脸
sense_groups.english: That almost hit me in the face!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得选出队长
sense_groups.english: We have to pick captains.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后是跟班
sense_groups.english: And then "Tennilles."

sense_groups.chinese: 该怎么选呢
sense_groups.english: So how do we decide that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何不跳兔子舞 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Why don't we just bunny up? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 兔子 - 兔子
sense_groups.english: Bunny! - Bunny!

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来罗斯跟我是队长
sense_groups.english: Looks like Ross and I are captains.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我先跳的 我能先选 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, um, I bunnied first, so I get to pick first. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是你的好朋友
sense_groups.english: I'm your best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 别担心 你会被选中的
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, don't worry, you'll get picked.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我要选你
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, now I pick you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才没有挑我 你是没有选择了
sense_groups.english: You don't pick me. You're stuck with me!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 就这么办了
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. So let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 比赛场地从垃圾桶到灯柱 好吗
sense_groups.english: Let's play from the, uh, trash can to the light post, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 双手达阵得分 比赛开始了
sense_groups.english: Two-hand touch. We'll kick off.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 听着 我还有28分钟
sense_groups.english: People, listen. I've got 28 minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我得去帮火鸡涂酱汁
sense_groups.english: ...before I have to baste again.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像在参加职业比赛
sense_groups.english: Wow, just like in the pros.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 小组会议
sense_groups.english: Okay, huddle up! Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 到这边开小组会议 - 等等我
sense_groups.english: Huddle up over here! - Wait for me! Wait for me!

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 我的第一次小组会议
sense_groups.english: Oh, cool! My first huddle.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Ha, ha. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们对钱德有什么想法
sense_groups.english: So what do you guys really think of Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你要做什么吧 - 对
sense_groups.english: You know what you're doing, right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 乔伊接球 我们阻挡
sense_groups.english: Okay. Joey will catch it. We'll block.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是阻挡
sense_groups.english: What's "block"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你知道你要做什么 - 我以为你是指在生活中
sense_groups.english: I thought you knew what you were doing. - I thought you meant in life!

sense_groups.chinese: 分开
sense_groups.english: Break!

sense_groups.chinese: 球是珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: The ball is Janice. The ball is Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 大混蛋
sense_groups.english: Ow! Son of a...! Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托哦 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: Come on! - I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗 我们要直接丢球
sense_groups.english: You know what? We're just gonna throw it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来接
sense_groups.english: I got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 得分 七比零
sense_groups.english: Score! Seven to nothing!

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Honey, you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我们走
sense_groups.english: Come on, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 输家滚开
sense_groups.english: Whoo. Losers walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 输家只爱放话
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Losers talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你得跟"输家"押韵
sense_groups.english: No, no, actually, losers rhyme.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要直接来 - 对
sense_groups.english: You wanna go shotgun? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 开球
sense_groups.english: Hike.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 - 这边
sense_groups.english: One Mississippi... - Over here! Over here! Unh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我差点接到那一球
sense_groups.english: Ha! I almost caught that one!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 现在比数是七比差点七
sense_groups.english: Great. Now the score's seven to almost seven.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这一球我要你直冲切右
sense_groups.english: Okay, on this play, I want you to do a down-and-out to the right, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 分开 - 等一下 我要做什么
sense_groups.english: Break! - Wait. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢
sense_groups.english: You?

sense_groups.chinese: 你直接冲
sense_groups.english: You go long.

sense_groups.chinese: 冲到哪里
sense_groups.english: How long?

sense_groups.chinese: 直到我们变得很小
sense_groups.english: Until we start to look very small.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 分开 - 分开
sense_groups.english: Okay. Break! - Break!

sense_groups.chinese: 预备 开始 - 一
sense_groups.english: Set, hike! - One Mississippi...

sense_groups.chinese: 换边
sense_groups.english: Switch! Switch! Switch!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你帮我们捡球
sense_groups.english: Hey. Thanks for stopping our ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在玩美式足球
sense_groups.english: You are playing American football?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你像是从外国来的
sense_groups.english: Wow, you're, like, from a whole other country!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是荷兰人 - 我是乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'm Dutch. - Hi, I'm Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是玛哈
sense_groups.english: I am Margha.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 荷兰人 尾音我没听清楚
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Dutch, I didn't get that last little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要玩足球或…我是钱德
sense_groups.english: You wanna play football or...? Hi, I'm Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hello, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫荷兰人跟玛汉
sense_groups.english: Her name is Dutch and also "Margham."

sense_groups.chinese: 玛哈 - 玛荷
sense_groups.english: Margha. - Margha.

sense_groups.chinese: 玛哈
sense_groups.english: Margha.

sense_groups.chinese: 玛汉
sense_groups.english: Mahan.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 大伙们 开始了 第二次十码进攻
sense_groups.english: Come on, guys! Let's go! Second down!

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是第三次十码进攻了 - 才不是 是第二次
sense_groups.english: Uh, hello? It's third down. - No, it's not. It's second.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: "Wow" what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很讶异你还是会这么做
sense_groups.english: It just amazes me that you're still pulling stuff like this. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么本来就是第二次进攻 - 好吧 第二次
sense_groups.english: Pulling what? It's second down. - Okay, it's second down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说是就是
sense_groups.english: Take all the second downs you need.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到了 - 我本来就说得很大声
sense_groups.english: I heard that. - Well, I said it loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在旁边看吗
sense_groups.english: It is okay if I stay and watch?

sense_groups.chinese: 就坐那边吧 - 对 你何不留下来呢
sense_groups.english: Just sit right there. - Yeah, why don't you stick around?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切进行得顺利 - 我也那么想
sense_groups.english: That went well. - I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我考虑跟她要电话号码
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about, uh, asking her for her number.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 兄弟 我自己问的话会比较有诚意
sense_groups.english: Thanks, man, but it makes a stronger statement if I ask for it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是想自己追她 为了忘记珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about for me, as part of that getting-over-Janice thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. That.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那真的很重要 我就让你追她
sense_groups.english: If it means that much, I'll let you have her.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么让我追她
sense_groups.english: Wh...? "Let me have her"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你不让我的话 我就毫无机会吗
sense_groups.english: You mean if you didn't, I wouldn't have a shot?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不想说出来
sense_groups.english: I don't like to say it out loud...

sense_groups.chinese: 但事实就是如此
sense_groups.english: ...but yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都有自己的优点 你对数字就比较在行
sense_groups.english: We all have our strengths. You're better with numbers and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 数学你要跟我提数学的事
sense_groups.english: Math? You're giving me math?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗 算了
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what? Forget about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也能追那个女孩 来看看谁可以成功
sense_groups.english: You go for the girl. We'll see who gets her.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我要你跑向球门左边 甜心
sense_groups.english: I want you to run a post-pattern to the left. And, sweetie...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道 继续跑
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. Go long.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在人群中前后跑动
sense_groups.english: All I'm doing is running back and forth from the huddle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想待在那边吗
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, you wanna just stay out there?

sense_groups.chinese: 球能给我一下吗 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Can I see that for a second? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 好的 开始了
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来盯钱德 - 开始
sense_groups.english: I got Chandler - Hike!

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三
sense_groups.english: One Mississippi, two Mississippi, three Mississippi.

sense_groups.chinese: 掉球
sense_groups.english: Fumble!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么毛病 这是我最喜欢的球衣
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with you? This is my favorite jersey.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你有两件了
sense_groups.english: Well, now you have two.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对数学真的很在行
sense_groups.english: Hey, I am good at math!

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我还是要让你去追她
sense_groups.english: That's it. I was still gonna let you have her.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在准备好好难过一场吧
sense_groups.english: But now, prepare to feel bad about yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一辈子都在为那个做准备
sense_groups.english: I've been preparing for that my entire life!

sense_groups.chinese: 或是为了你的不礼貌
sense_groups.english: Or something about you that's mean!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 各位 开始了
sense_groups.english: Come on, guys. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 追平比数 没时问了
sense_groups.english: Tie score. We're running out of time.
Forty-two, 38, hike!

sense_groups.chinese: 我来接
sense_groups.english: I got it! Ooh! Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的胸部骨折了
sense_groups.english: Broken boobs! Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 快跑 跑 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, run! - Run, Phoebe! Run!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 没错 达阵得分 达阵得分
sense_groups.english: God! Touchdown! Touchdown! - Yes! Touchdown! Hey, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 闹钟响了 那一球不算
sense_groups.english: Uh, the buzzer buzzed. It doesn't count.

sense_groups.chinese: 在接到球之后 - 在接到球之前
sense_groups.english: After the snap. - Before the snap.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后 - 之前
sense_groups.english: After. - Before.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很重要吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Does it really matter? - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 但我达阵得分 那是我第一次达阵得分
sense_groups.english: But I made a touchdown. It was my first touchdown.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 那真的很棒 可惜不算
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, that's great. Doesn't count.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一球算数 - 作弊鬼 霸道女王
sense_groups.english: Does so count. - Cheater, cheater, compulsive eater.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 或许你没长大 但我已经长大了
sense_groups.english: That's fine. Maybe you haven't grown up, but I have.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 去死吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. - Dead leg!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你想靠作弊赢球 尽管去吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. You want to win by cheating, go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 达阵得分算数 你们赢了
sense_groups.english: The touchdown does count. You win.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要再这么做 我要打败你 让你无法抱怨
sense_groups.english: I won't do this again. I wanna beat you when you can't blame it...

sense_groups.chinese: 鼻子断了 铃声响了 或你可能白血球过多
sense_groups.english: ...on the broken nose or the buzzer or the fact that you might have mono.

sense_groups.chinese: 就说双方平手 现在是中场休息
sense_groups.english: Let's just call this tie score and it's halftime.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我不跟作弊的人比赛
sense_groups.english: First, I don't play with cheaters.

sense_groups.chinese: 其次你知道我的扁桃腺肿了起来
sense_groups.english: Second of all, you know I had swollen glands!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我想你会玩的
sense_groups.english: You know what? I think you'll play.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 为什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? Why's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为赢的人可以拿到这个
sense_groups.english: Because the winner gets this.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒杯
sense_groups.english: The Geller Cup!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都看到那个钉在木板上的丑娃娃了吗
sense_groups.english: Is everybody else seeing a troll doll nailed to a two-by-four?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 太好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 它怎么会在你手上
sense_groups.english: Okay, where the hell did you get that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们到医院治疗你的鼻子
sense_groups.english: When you went to the hospital for your nose...

sense_groups.chinese: 我游到湖里把它捞出来
sense_groups.english: ...I swam into the lake and fished it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个奖杯是我的
sense_groups.english: That cup is mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 才不是 想要把它带回家 你就得赢球
sense_groups.english: No, it's not. You want it, you're gonna have to win it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不吃晚餐了吗
sense_groups.english: So are we not having dinner at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 开始了 认真点 小组会议
sense_groups.english: Come on, let's go. It's time to get serious. Huddle up.

sense_groups.chinese: 专心在比赛上
sense_groups.english: Keep your head in the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很难 他在那个荷兰女孩旁边开小组会议
sense_groups.english: It's hard, you know? His huddle's close to the Dutch girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我在带球时扑倒钱德 你能专心一点吗
sense_groups.english: If I take Chandler out of the running, will you be able to focus?

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么做 - 确定让他接到球
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do? - Just make sure he catches the ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他的交给我来办
sense_groups.english: I'll do the rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 胆小鬼 - 好了 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, you wuss! - Okay, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 快跑 钱德 - 我来接
sense_groups.english: Go, Cha... Chandler. - I got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 这边 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on! This way! Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 小心
sense_groups.english: Look out! - Oof!

sense_groups.chinese: 被女生拥抱 这种画面不多见吧
sense_groups.english: Tackled by a girl! Bet you don't see that every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么要做拥抱
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa! What's with the tackling?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一碰到他 他就跌倒了
sense_groups.english: I just touched him and he went over.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你要来硬的吗 我们也可以来硬的
sense_groups.english: Okay. You wanna play rough? We can play rough.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备开打了
sense_groups.english: Let's get ready to rumble!

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 - 抓住她
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go! - Get her! Get her!

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这种运动
sense_groups.english: I love this game!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会有那个
sense_groups.english: Where'd you get that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的跑好远
sense_groups.english: I went really long.
Forty-two to 21.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟火鸡一样 罗斯输了
sense_groups.english: Like the turkey, Ross is done!

sense_groups.chinese: 你先挑队员 所以你那一队的实力比较好
sense_groups.english: You got to pick first, so you got the better team.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太可悲了 你何不接受事实 我们会赢
sense_groups.english: Pathetic! Why can't you just accept that we're winning...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我比你厉害
sense_groups.english: ...because I'm better than you?

sense_groups.chinese: 说得太有道理了 你只会吐气
sense_groups.english: Oh, what a great argument. Exhaling!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我可以跟你证明
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll prove it to you. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我用乔伊跟你换瑞秋 我还是能赢
sense_groups.english: I'll trade you Joey for Rachel and I'll still win the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么男生对女生
sense_groups.english: What? The guys against the girls?

sense_groups.chinese: 我太可笑了 我只落后三记达阵得分
sense_groups.english: That's ridiculous because I'm only down by three touchdowns.

sense_groups.chinese: 就那么办吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, then bring it on!

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你害怕会输给一群女生
sense_groups.english: Unless you're afraid you might lose to a bunch of girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 瑞秋 你到摩妮卡那边 乔伊 你得加入我
sense_groups.english: Fine. Rachel, you're with Monica. Joey, you're with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你把我换出去
sense_groups.english: I can not believe you're trading me.

sense_groups.chinese: 试试看持在优胜队的滋味吧
sense_groups.english: Let's see what it's like to be on a winning team for a change.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会让我摸球吗
sense_groups.english: You're gonna let me play?

sense_groups.chinese: 那么好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, then!

sense_groups.chinese: 比赛结束了吗 我们要吃饭了吗
sense_groups.english: The game is over? We eat now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 比赛还没有结束 我们在交换队友
sense_groups.english: No, the game's not over. We're switching teams.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德发现我太厉害了 我们同一队会比较好
sense_groups.english: Chandler finds me so intimidating that it's better if we're on the same team.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 开始了
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's play. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 荷兰人是从哪里来的
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Where do Dutch people come from?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, the, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 宾州荷兰人来自宾州
sense_groups.english: ...Pennsylvania Dutch come from Pennsylvania.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他荷兰人呢
sense_groups.english: And the, uh, other Dutch people?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们来自荷兰 对吧
sense_groups.english: They come from somewhere near the Netherlands, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 少唬人了
sense_groups.english: Nice try.

sense_groups.chinese: 荷兰是虚构的地方
sense_groups.english: The Netherlands is this make-believe place...

sense_groups.chinese: 彼得潘跟小仙女住在那里
sense_groups.english: ...where Peter Pan and Tinker Bell come from.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 疯狂地理课结束了 开始打球吧
sense_groups.english: Enough "geography for the insane." Let's play ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不要跟这家伙同队
sense_groups.english: No. No, I'm not playing with this guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没意见 - 我受够了
sense_groups.english: Oh, fine with me. - I've had enough of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就废话少说了 海蒂 你喜欢我的哪个朋友
sense_groups.english: Let's just cut to the chase. Heidi, which of my boys do you like?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢哪一个
sense_groups.english: Which do I like?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 约会 打打闹闹 带他回你的风车
sense_groups.english: Yeah, for dating, general merriment, taking back to your windmill?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果现在我必须选择
sense_groups.english: Well, if I had to choose right now...

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我觉得这很奇怪
sense_groups.english: ...which, by the way, I find really weird...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会选钱德
sense_groups.english: ...I would have to say Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 她不了解问题
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. She didn't understand the question.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你不请虎克船长跟他解释一下
sense_groups.english: Why don't you have Captain Hook explain it to her?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 那是我的真心话
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. That is my truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗 那是她的真心话 "我让你追她"先生
sense_groups.english: You hear that? That is her truth, Mr. "I'll Let You Have Her"!

sense_groups.chinese: 我赢了 你太逊了 我是最棒的
sense_groups.english: I win! You suck! I rule all!

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我跳迷你波浪舞庆祝一下
sense_groups.english: Mini-wave in celebration of me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我的答案要改成 "我谁都不要选"
sense_groups.english: I am now thinking I would like to change my answer to "no one."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现你很肤浅
sense_groups.english: I now find you shallow, and, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 是个呆瓜
sense_groups.english: ...a dork.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 干得好
sense_groups.english: Heh. Nice going.

sense_groups.chinese: 你害自己几个月没有性生活
sense_groups.english: You just saved yourself a couple months of sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不重要 因为她选了我
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter, because she picked me.

sense_groups.chinese: 从现在开始 我可以去约会
sense_groups.english: From now on, I get the dates...

sense_groups.chinese: 星期六晚上 你只能待在家里看烹饪节目
sense_groups.english: ...and you stay home on Saturday nights watching Ready, Set, Cook!

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了 时间紧迫
sense_groups.english: Save the breakthroughs for therapy. The clock is ticking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没时间了 我们输给女生
sense_groups.english: We have no time, and we are losing to girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会输给女生
sense_groups.english: We're not gonna lose to girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在比数是42比21
这真的很逊 刚刚我还赢那么多
sense_groups.english: This sucks! I was just up by that much!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到底要不要比赛 来吧 你们这些长毛猩猩
sense_groups.english: Are we playing football or what? Come on, you hairy-backed Marys!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们非赢不可 我们为全世界的女人这么做
sense_groups.english: We have to do this. We're playing for women everywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你们的每一次烂约会
sense_groups.english: Think about every lousy date you ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次亲热时 男人的眼睛都盯着电视看
sense_groups.english: Every guy who kept one eye on the TV while you were making out.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你也跟装了玻璃假眼的男人约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You dated someone with a glass eye too?

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 好吗 这都是为了女人 痛宰他们
sense_groups.english: Come on, okay? This is for all womankind. Let's kill them!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 痛宰他们
sense_groups.english: Yeah! Kill them!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我也想痛宰他们
sense_groups.english: All right, I want to kill them too.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们是男生
sense_groups.english: But they're boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么打败三个男生
sense_groups.english: You know, how are we gonna beat three boys?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一分钟半 我们落后两分
sense_groups.english: A minute and a half left, and we're down by two points.

sense_groups.chinese: 两分 姊妹们
sense_groups.english: Two points, ladies.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你再做后转身进攻
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you do a buttonhook again.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你往前跑
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you go long.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别逼我往前跑 利用我 他们从来不防守我
sense_groups.english: No, don't make me go long. Use me. They never cover me.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 那是有原因的
sense_groups.english: Honey, there's a reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点都不逊 好吗 我可以有点贡献
sense_groups.english: I'm not lame, okay? I can do something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能让我丢球吗 这也是我的比赛
sense_groups.english: Would you let me throw? This is my game too.

sense_groups.chinese: 让她丢球吧
sense_groups.english: Let her throw the ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到后面 我会把球传给你 你把球丢给菲比
sense_groups.english: Sweep behind, I'll pitch it. You throw it downfield to Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 分开 - 分开
sense_groups.english: Break! - Break!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 开始吧
sense_groups.english: All right, here we go.
Thirty-two, 71, hike!

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三
sense_groups.english: One Mississippi, two Mississippi, three Mississippi!

sense_groups.chinese: 快点跑
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 接住
sense_groups.english: Catch it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的好抱歉 你没事吧 - 不 我有事
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. Are you okay? - No, I'm not okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们来追我 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: They were coming at me, and I didn't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩三十秒
sense_groups.english: Thirty seconds left on the timer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得把那个笨娃娃带回家
sense_groups.english: So we get to take that, uh, stupid troll thing home.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 快点 没时间了
sense_groups.english: Come on! Hurry! We're running out of time.

sense_groups.chinese: 小组会议 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Huddle up! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们最后一次小组会议
sense_groups.english: Oh! This is our last huddle!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 菲比 准备接球 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: All right, Phoebe, get open. Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 往前跑 - 好的
sense_groups.english: ...go long. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 分开
sense_groups.english: Break!

sense_groups.chinese: 我办到了 达阵得分 我们办到了
sense_groups.english: Ahh! I did it! Touchdown! We did it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗 这真的很好笑 终点在灯柱那边
sense_groups.english: You know? Funny thing, actually. The end zone starts at that pole.

sense_groups.chinese: 你少了五尺 所以…
sense_groups.english: So you're five feet short. So...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们赢了
sense_groups.english: ...ha-ha-ha, we win!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 请解释一下
sense_groups.english: Wait, explain something, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果没有人扑倒瑞秋 比赛还在进行中吧
sense_groups.english: If nobody tagged Rachel, then isn't the play still going?

sense_groups.chinese: 让我来 - 不行 放手
sense_groups.english: Let me in! Let me in! - No way! Let go!

sense_groups.chinese: 放手 我只是个小女孩
sense_groups.english: Let go? I'm a tiny little woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 两位 好了 今天是感恩节
sense_groups.english: Guys, come on, it's Thanksgiving!

sense_groups.chinese: 输赢不重要
sense_groups.english: It's not important who wins or loses.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是那个荷兰女孩选了我
sense_groups.english: The important thing is the Dutch girl picked me!

sense_groups.chinese: 她选了我 不是你 荷兰爱钱德 谢谢阿姆斯特丹 晚安
sense_groups.english: Me, not you! Holland loves Chandler! Thank you, Amsterdam! Good night!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该常常玩足球
sense_groups.english: We should play football more often.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以加入联盟
sense_groups.english: Maybe there's a league we could join.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是有国家美式足球联盟吗
sense_groups.english: Isn't there a "national football league"?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 他们会在星期天跟星期一晚上比赛
sense_groups.english: Yes, there is. They play on Sundays and Monday nights.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 星期一晚上我得上班
sense_groups.english: Oh, shoot! I work Monday nights.

sense_groups.chinese: 馅料好好吃 你们觉得我们该包一点给他们吃吗
sense_groups.english: This stuffing is amazing. Do you think we should bring them some?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们饿了就会回家
sense_groups.english: When they're hungry, they'll come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 放手 - 不 你才要放手
sense_groups.english: Let go! - No, you let go!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么每次都是我们死抱着球不放
sense_groups.english: How come it's always us left holding the ball?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我想其他人就是不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I guess the other people just don't care enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 下雪了
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's starting to snow.

sense_groups.chinese: 球给我 - 放手 快点
sense_groups.english: Give it to me! Let go! - Let it go! Come on, let go!

That's why they call it "the tray spot."
I always heard them talk about that. I just thought it was a club they went to.
Oh, God.
I'm sorry. - It's all right.
Sweetheart.
So this must be kind of neat for you, huh?
Your dad tells me you get a couple of days off school...
...and you don't have to sell those cookies anymore.
Well, I kind of wanted to sell the cookies.
The girl who sells the most wins a trip to Space Camp...
...and gets to sit in a real space shuttle.
Wow, you really like all this space stuff, huh?
Yeah. My dad says if I'd spend as much time helping him clean apartments...
...as I do daydreaming about outer space...
...he'd be able to afford a trip to the Taj Mahal.
I think you'd have to clean a whole lot of apartments to go all the way to India.
No, the one in Atlantic City. Dad loves the slots.
He says he's gonna double the college money my grandma left me.
Well, good luck to Dad.
Say, how many more boxes would you have to sell in order to win?
The girl who won last year sold 475. - Yeah?
So far, I've sold 75.
Four hundred, huh?
Well, that sounds doable. How much are the boxes?
Five dollars a box.
And what is second prize?
A 10-speed bike.
But I'd rather have something my dad couldn't sell.
Well, that makes sense.
Could you do me one favor? If it's not too much trouble.
Yeah, Sarah, anything. - Could you pull the curtains open for me?
The astronauts from the space shuttle are gonna be on the news.
Since we don't have a TV, the lady across the alley...
...said she'd push hers up to her window so I can watch it.
Yes?
Yeah, hi. I'm selling Brown Bird cookies.
You're no Brown Bird. I can see you through my peephole.
Um, no, hi. I'm an honorary Brown Bird.
What does that mean?
Uh, well, it means that I can sell cookies, but I'm not invited to sleepovers.
I can dial 911 at the press of a button, you know.
Now, go away.
Please, please. It's for a poor little girl...
...who wants to go to Space Camp more than anything in the world.
I'm pressing. - No...
A policeman is on his way.
Okay, okay. I'm going, I'm going.
I can still see you. - All right.
Hey.
Hey. What are you doing here?
Well, I thought a lot about what you said...
...and I realized, all right, maybe I was a little judgmental.
Yeah. Oh, but, oh. Ugh.
Now, now, Phoebe, remember, hey...
...they're just fulfilling their Christmas...
Destiny. Yes. - Sure.
Right. - Okay.
Yikes. That one doesn't look very fulfilled.
Oh, that's one of the old ones. He's just taking it to the back.
You keep the old ones in the back?
That is so ageist.
We have to make room for the fresh ones. - So, what happens to the old guys?
Well, they go into the chipper.
Why do I have a feeling that's not as happy as it sounds?
No. No!
Hey, hey, hey.
And these come in the shapes of Christmas characters.
Santa, Rudolph and Baby Jesus.
All right. I'll take a box of the cream-filled Jesuses.
Wait a minute, one box? I'm trying to send a poor little girl to Space Camp.
I'm putting you down for five boxes. Chandler, what about you?
All right, do you have any, uh, coconut-flavored deities?
No, but there's coconut in the Hanukkah Menorah-eos.
I'll put you down for eight boxes, one for each night.
Okay.
Mon? - I'll take one box of the Mint Treasures.
One, and that's it.
I started gaining weight after I joined the Brown Birds.
Remember Dad bought every one of my boxes and I ate them all?
No, Mon, Dad had to buy every one of your boxes...
...because you ate them all.
But, you know, I'm sure that's not gonna happen this time.
Why don't I just put you down for three Mint Treasures...
...and just a couple of the Rudolphs?
No.
Oh, come on, now. You know you want them.
Don't do this.
I'll tell you what, Mon. I'll give you the first box for free.
Oh, God, I gotta go.
Come on. All the cool kids are eating them.
And later I wanna show you why we don't just trap spiders...
...under coffee mugs and leave them there.
I'm training to be better at a job that I hate. My life officially sucks.
But wasn't this supposed to be temporary? I thought you wanted to do fashion stuff.
Well, yeah, I'm still pursuing that.
How, exactly, are you pursuing that?
You know, other than sending out resumes, like, what, two years ago?
Well, I'm also sending out...
...good thoughts.
If you ask me, as long as you got this job...
...you got nothing pushing you to get another one.
You need The Fear.
The Fear? - He's right.
If you quit this job, you then have motivation...
...to go after a job you really want.
How come you're still at a job you hate? Why don't you quit and get The Fear?
Because I'm too afraid.
God. I don't know.
I mean, I would give anything to work for a designer, you know, or a buyer.
Ugh. I just don't wanna be 30 and still work here.
Yeah, that'd be much worse than being 28 and still working here.
Rachel? - Yeah?
Remind me to review with you which pot is decaf and which is regular.
Can't I just look at the handles on them?
You would think.
Okay, fine. Gunther, you know what? I am a terrible waitress.
Do you know why I'm a terrible waitress? Because I don't care.
I don't care. I don't care which pot is regular and which pot is decaf.
I don't care where the tray spot is.
I just don't care. This is not what I wanna do.
So I don't think I should do it anymore.
I'm gonna give you my week's notice. - What?
Gunther, I quit.
Does this mean we're gonna have to start paying for coffee?
Okay, 12.
What? - I spelled out "boobies." Ha, ha.
Ross, put me down for another box of the Mint Treasures, okay?
Where are the Mint Treasures?
Uh, we're out. I sold them all.
What?
Monica, I'm cutting you off.
No. No.
Just a couple more boxes.
It's no big deal, all right? I'm cool.
You gotta help me out with a couple more boxes.
Mon, look at yourself. You have cookie on your neck.
Oh, God.
Whoa. So how many you sold so far? - Ah? Check this out.
Five hundred and seventeen boxes. - Oh, my God. How did you do that?
Ahem. Okay, the other night, I was leaving the museum...
...just as Laser Floyd was letting out of the planetarium.
Without even trying, I sold 50 boxes.
That's when it occurred to me. The key to my success: The munchies.
So I started hitting the NYU dorms around midnight.
I am selling cookies by the case.
They call me...
..."Cookie Dude."
Okay, stop what you're doing. I need envelope stuffers, stamp lickers...
Oh, hey. Who did these resumes for you?
Me, on my computer.
Well, you sure used a large font.
Uh, yeah. Well, "Waitress at a Coffeehouse"...
...and "Cheer Squad Co-captain" only took up so much room.
Heh, heh. Hey, that's funny.
You're funny, Chandler. You're a funny guy.
You know what else is really funny?
Something else I might have said?
I don't know, I don't know.
Weren't you the guy that told me to quit my job...
...when I had absolutely nothing else to do?
Sweetie, calm down. It's gonna be okay.
No, it's not gonna be okay, Ross.
Tomorrow is my last day, and I don't have a lead.
Okay, you know what? I'm just gonna call Gunther...
...and I'm gonna tell him I'm not quitting.
You don't wanna give in to The Fear.
You and your stupid Fear. I hate your Fear.
I would like to take you and your Fear...
Hey. I got great news.
Run, Joey. Run for your life.
What? Rach, listen, have you ever heard of Fortunata Fashions?
No. - My old man's doing a plumbing job there...
...and he heard they have an opening.
Want me to see if he can get you an interview?
Oh, my God, yes. I would love that. Oh, that's so sweet, Joey.
Not a problem. And now for the great news.
What, that wasn't the great news? - Only if you think it's better than this.
Snow-in-a-Can.
I got it at work. You want me to decorate the window?
Give it kind of a Christmas looky? - Christmas cookie?
Okay, and this one here's a Douglas fir.
Now, it's a little more money, but you get a nicer smell.
Looks good. I'll take it.
Wait, wait, wait. No, no, no. You don't want that one. Uh-uh.
No. You can have this cool brown one. Ooh.
It's almost dead.
But that's why you have to buy it, so that it can fulfill its Christmas destiny.
Otherwise, they're gonna throw it into the chipper. Tell him, Joey.
Yeah, the trees that don't fulfill their Christmas destiny, heh...
...are thrown in the chipper.
I think I'm gonna look around a little bit more.
Pheebs. Heh. You gotta stop doing this. I'm working on commission here.
Hey, guys. I'm here to pick out my Christmas tree.
Well, look no further. This one's yours.
Is this the one that I threw out last year?
All right, you know what? Never mind. Everybody wants to have a green one.
I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to get so emotional.
I guess it's just... The holidays are just hard.
Oh, honey, is that because your mom died around Christmas?
Oh, I wasn't even thinking about that.
Hi there. How many did you sell?
I'm not gonna tell you. You're the bad man who broke Sarah's leg.
Hey, now. That was an accident, okay?
You're a big scrud.
What's a scrud?
Why don't you look in the mirror, scrud?
I don't have to. I can just look at you.
All right, girls...
...and man.
Let's see your final tallies.
Oh... Debbie.
Three hundred and twenty-one boxes of cookies. Very nice.
Not nice enough.
Charla.
Two hundred and seventy-eight.
Sorry, dear, but still good.
Good for a scrud.
Let's see.
Ooh. Yes, Elizabeth.
Eight hundred and seventy-one.
That's crap.
Sister Brown Bird.
Good going.
Who's next?
Hi there. - Hi.
And batting for Sarah...
...Ross Geller.
Eight hundred and seventy-two.
Although it looks like you bought an awful lot of cookies yourself.
Ahem. That is because my doctor says that I have a very serious...
...nougat...
...deficiency.
Tell us what happened, Brown Bird Ross.
Well, I lost.
Some little girl loaned her uniform to her 19-year-old sister...
...who went down to the USS Nimitz and sold over 2000 boxes.
Hey. How'd the interview go? - Oh, I blew it.
I wouldn't have even hired me.
Come here, sweetie.
Listen, you're gonna go on like a thousand interviews before you get a job.
That's not how that was supposed to come out.
This is just the worst Christmas ever.
Rach, maybe you should just, you know, stay here at the coffeehouse.
I can't. It's too late. Terry already hired that girl over there.
Look at her. She's even got waitress experience. Ugh.
Last night she was...
...teaching everybody how to make napkins into...
...swans.
That word was "swans."
"Swans."
Well, seeing that drunk Santa wet himself really perked up my Christmas.
Ah! Oh, my God.
Merry Christmas!
You saved them. You guys.
Oh, God, you're the best.
Looks like Night of the Living Dead Christmas Trees.
Hello?
Yeah, this is she.
Oh! You're kidding. You're kidding.
Oh, thank you. I love you.
Sure, everybody loves a kidder.
I got the job.
Oh, hey. All right! - That's great.
Oh! God bless us, every one.
Here we go. I'm serving my last cup of coffee.
There you go. Enjoy.
Should I tell her I ordered tea? - No.
No. - No.
Um, excuse me, everyone?
Uh, this is my last night working here...
...and I just wanted to say that I made some really good friends here.
And it's just time to move on.
And no offense to everybody who still works here...
...but you have no idea how good it feels to say...
...that as of this moment...
...I will never have to make coffee again.
Now, Mr. Kaplan Sr. Likes his coffee strong.
So you're gonna use two bags instead of one, see?
Now, pay attention because this part's tricky.
See, some people use filters just once.
I'm sorry you didn't get to go to Space Camp...
...and I'm hoping that maybe somehow, this may help make up for it. Okay?
Presenting...
...Sarah Tuddle's Private, Very Special Space Camp!
Really, Mr. Geller, you don't have to do this.
Oh, come on. Here we go.
Stand by for mission countdown.
Ten, ten, ten.
Nine, nine, nine.
Eight, eight, eight. Ow.
Okay, blast off.
I'm an alien. I'm an alien.
Oh, no, an asteroid!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Oh, I don't know. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 照狗的年纪来算…
sense_groups.english: Well, as old as he is in dog years...

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得史努比可以驾驶飞机吗
sense_groups.english: ...do you think Snoopy should still be allowed to fly this thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Rachel? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得你刚来的时候 另一位服务生训练你两星期吗
sense_groups.english: Remember when you came, you spent two weeks getting trained by another waitress?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 你要我训练新人吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure. Do you need me to train somebody new?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好笑
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. Good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 泰利要你再受训一次
sense_groups.english: Actually, uh, Terry wants you to take the training again.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你有空的时候
sense_groups.english: Whenever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信吗
sense_groups.english: Do you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 一共是两盒佳节杏仁饼干
sense_groups.english: So that's two boxes of the Holiday Macaroons.

sense_groups.chinese: 我代表美国棕鸟跟你致敬
sense_groups.english: On behalf of the Brown Birds of America, I salute you.

sense_groups.chinese: 承认吧 你的反手拍打不好
sense_groups.english: Just admit it. You have no backhand.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 小家伙 我的反手拍打得非常好
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, little one. I have a very solid backhand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你用手挡住脸 跟小女孩一样蹲下来
sense_groups.english: Shielding your face and shrieking like a girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不算是反手拍
sense_groups.english: ...is not a backhand.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确蹲了下来
sense_groups.english: I was shrieking...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟海军陆战队一样
sense_groups.english: ...like a Marine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说 你得做到冠军3P原则
sense_groups.english: All right, here, watch me execute the three P's of championship play.

sense_groups.chinese: 力量
sense_groups.english: Power, huah...

sense_groups.chinese: 精准
sense_groups.english: ...precision, shew...

sense_groups.chinese: 架式
sense_groups.english: ...and panache.

sense_groups.chinese: 你害一个小女孩摔断腿
sense_groups.english: You broke a little girl's leg?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我很难过 好吗
sense_groups.english: I know. I feel horrible, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 报上说昨晚有个布偶在芝麻街被打了
sense_groups.english: It says here that a Muppet got whacked on Sesame Street last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 十点多时你在哪里
sense_groups.english: Where exactly were you around 10-ish?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去看她 买些东西送她
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm gonna go see her. I wanna bring her something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她会喜欢什么 - 或许你该送她凯蒂猫娃娃
sense_groups.english: What do you think she'd like? - Maybe a Hello Kitty doll?

sense_groups.chinese: 行走能力
sense_groups.english: The ability to walk?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回去受训了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna get back to retraining. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大家再见
sense_groups.english: All right. See you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心点 孩子们 他来了
sense_groups.english: Look out, kids. He's coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去卖圣诞树
sense_groups.english: And I gotta go sell some Christmas trees.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你玩得开心 等一下 不 别那么做
sense_groups.english: Have fun. Oh, wait. No, don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了 我百分之百反对那种事
sense_groups.english: I forgot. I am totally against that now.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你反对我有工作
sense_groups.english: What? Me having a job?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我反对无辜的树在巅峰时期被砍掉
sense_groups.english: No, no. I am against innocent trees being cut down in their prime...

sense_groups.chinese: 华丽地装饰它们的尸体
sense_groups.english: ...and their corpses grotesquely dressed...

sense_groups.chinese: 挂上一堆金箔和闪灯
sense_groups.english: ...in, like, tinsel and twinkly lights.

sense_groups.chinese: 你晚上怎么睡得着呢
sense_groups.english: Hey, how do you sleep at night?

sense_groups.chinese: 整天搬树可把我累坏了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm pretty tired from lugging the trees around.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 听我说
sense_groups.english: Hey, Phoebe, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你误会了
sense_groups.english: You got this all wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些树生来要当圣诞树
sense_groups.english: Those trees were born to be Christmas trees.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们完成了毕生志愿 让大家成到开心
sense_groups.english: They're fulfilling their life purpose by making people happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 树也很开心
sense_groups.english: Yes, and, uh, the trees are happy too...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为对多数的树来说 这是它们参观纽约的唯一机会
sense_groups.english: ...because for most of them, it's their only chance to see New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 上饮料后 你得拿着空托盘…
sense_groups.english: After you've delivered the drinks, you take the tray...

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 拜托 我在这里工作了两年半
sense_groups.english: Gunther, Gunther, please. I have worked here for two and a half years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道空托盘得放在那边
sense_groups.english: I know the empty trays go over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何不把它们放在这里
sense_groups.english: What if you put them here?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 那是个好点子 那里离托盘比较近
sense_groups.english: You know, that's actually a good idea. They'll be closer to the mugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你该要求其他服务生也那么做
sense_groups.english: You know what? You should have the other waitresses do that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们早就那么做了
sense_groups.english: They already do.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他们叫这里是托盘区
sense_groups.english: That's why they call it "the tray spot."

sense_groups.chinese: 我常听到他们那么说 我以为那是他们去玩的夜店
sense_groups.english: I always heard them talk about that. I just thought it was a club they went to.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - It's all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该会觉得很开心吧
sense_groups.english: So this must be kind of neat for you, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸跟我说你得跟学校请假几天
sense_groups.english: Your dad tells me you get a couple of days off school...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必再去卖饼干了
sense_groups.english: ...and you don't have to sell those cookies anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想去卖饼干
sense_groups.english: Well, I kind of wanted to sell the cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 卖最多饼干的女孩能参加太空营
sense_groups.english: The girl who sells the most wins a trip to Space Camp...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐在真的航天飞机里
sense_groups.english: ...and gets to sit in a real space shuttle.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 看来你真的很喜欢太空对吗
sense_groups.english: Wow, you really like all this space stuff, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我爸说只要我乖乖地帮他打扫公寓
sense_groups.english: Yeah. My dad says if I'd spend as much time helping him clean apartments...

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟我老是梦想自己上了太空一样
sense_groups.english: ...as I do daydreaming about outer space...

sense_groups.chinese: 他就会赚到足够的钱去秦姬陵玩
sense_groups.english: ...he'd be able to afford a trip to the Taj Mahal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你得打扫很多公寓才能去印度玩
sense_groups.english: I think you'd have to clean a whole lot of apartments to go all the way to India.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是大西洋城那一个 爸爸喜欢玩吃角子老虎
sense_groups.english: No, the one in Atlantic City. Dad loves the slots.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他可以让奶奶留给我的大学基金翻成两倍
sense_groups.english: He says he's gonna double the college money my grandma left me.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你爸好运
sense_groups.english: Well, good luck to Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还得卖几盒饼干才能赢
sense_groups.english: Say, how many more boxes would you have to sell in order to win?

sense_groups.chinese: 去年的冠军卖了475盒 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: The girl who won last year sold 475. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 目前我卖了75盒
sense_groups.english: So far, I've sold 75.

sense_groups.chinese: 还差四百盒
sense_groups.english: Four hundred, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来不难 一盒多少钱
sense_groups.english: Well, that sounds doable. How much are the boxes?

sense_groups.chinese: 一盒五块钱
sense_groups.english: Five dollars a box.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二名能拿到什么奖品
sense_groups.english: And what is second prize?

sense_groups.chinese: 十段变速自行车
sense_groups.english: A 10-speed bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要爸爸卖不掉的奖品
sense_groups.english: But I'd rather have something my dad couldn't sell.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很合理
sense_groups.english: Well, that makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我一个忙吗 希望不会太麻烦你
sense_groups.english: Could you do me one favor? If it's not too much trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 莎拉 没问题 - 你能帮我拉开窗帘吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Sarah, anything. - Could you pull the curtains open for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 航天飞机的太空人一定会上新闻
sense_groups.english: The astronauts from the space shuttle are gonna be on the news.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们家没有电视 对面巷子的女士说
sense_groups.english: Since we don't have a TV, the lady across the alley...

sense_groups.chinese: 她会把窗户打开 我就能看到她家的电视
sense_groups.english: ...said she'd push hers up to her window so I can watch it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我来卖棕鸟饼干
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hi. I'm selling Brown Bird cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是棕鸟女童军 我能从窥视孔看到你
sense_groups.english: You're no Brown Bird. I can see you through my peephole.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是荣誉棕鸟女童军
sense_groups.english: Um, no, hi. I'm an honorary Brown Bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么意思
sense_groups.english: What does that mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 那代表我可以卖饼干 但不能参加过夜派对
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, it means that I can sell cookies, but I'm not invited to sleepovers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一按按钮 就可以跟警局连线
sense_groups.english: I can dial 911 at the press of a button, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 快滚开
sense_groups.english: Now, go away.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 这是为了一个可怜的小女孩
sense_groups.english: Please, please. It's for a poor little girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很想去参加太空营
sense_groups.english: ...who wants to go to Space Camp more than anything in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我按下按钮了 - 不
sense_groups.english: I'm pressing. - No...

sense_groups.chinese: 警察马上就到
sense_groups.english: A policeman is on his way.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我走就是了
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. I'm going, I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是看得到你 - 好啦
sense_groups.english: I can still see you. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你来这里做什么
sense_groups.english: Hey. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想你说的话
sense_groups.english: Well, I thought a lot about what you said...

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解到或许我太爱批评了
sense_groups.english: ...and I realized, all right, maybe I was a little judgmental.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 可是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh, but, oh. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 记住
sense_groups.english: Now, now, Phoebe, remember, hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 它们只是在完成它们的圣诞节…
sense_groups.english: ...they're just fulfilling their Christmas...

sense_groups.chinese: 使命 对 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Destiny. Yes. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一棵看起来无法完成使命
sense_groups.english: Yikes. That one doesn't look very fulfilled.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是棵老树 他只是把它搬到后面
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's one of the old ones. He's just taking it to the back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们把老树搬到后面
sense_groups.english: You keep the old ones in the back?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是年龄歧视
sense_groups.english: That is so ageist.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得挪出空间放新树 - 那老树怎么处理
sense_groups.english: We have to make room for the fresh ones. - So, what happens to the old guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 它们会被放进碎木机
sense_groups.english: Well, they go into the chipper.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我觉得那听起来一点都不快乐
sense_groups.english: Why do I have a feeling that's not as happy as it sounds?

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No. No!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是圣诞节人物的造型
sense_groups.english: And these come in the shapes of Christmas characters.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老人 鲁道夫跟耶稣•基督宝宝
sense_groups.english: Santa, Rudolph and Baby Jesus.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要一盒奶油口味的耶稣•基督
sense_groups.english: All right. I'll take a box of the cream-filled Jesuses.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 一盒 我要送可怜小女孩到太空营
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, one box? I'm trying to send a poor little girl to Space Camp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你登记五盒 钱德 你呢
sense_groups.english: I'm putting you down for five boxes. Chandler, what about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 有椰子口味 天神造型饼干吗
sense_groups.english: All right, do you have any, uh, coconut-flavored deities?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但是有椰子口味 光明节烛台造型饼干
sense_groups.english: No, but there's coconut in the Hanukkah Menorah-eos.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你登记八盒 每晚一盒
sense_groups.english: I'll put you down for eight boxes, one for each night.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 我要一盒薄荷宝藏
sense_groups.english: Mon? - I'll take one box of the Mint Treasures.

sense_groups.chinese: 一盒 就那样
sense_groups.english: One, and that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我加入棕鸟后体重开始增加
sense_groups.english: I started gaining weight after I joined the Brown Birds.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得爸买光我的饼干 而我把它们都吃光了吗
sense_groups.english: Remember Dad bought every one of my boxes and I ate them all?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 摩妮卡 爸必须买光你的饼干
sense_groups.english: No, Mon, Dad had to buy every one of your boxes...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你把它们吃光了
sense_groups.english: ...because you ate them all.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我相信这一次不会是那样的
sense_groups.english: But, you know, I'm sure that's not gonna happen this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我何不帮你登记三盒薄荷宝藏
sense_groups.english: Why don't I just put you down for three Mint Treasures...

sense_groups.chinese: 两盒鲁道夫呢
sense_groups.english: ...and just a couple of the Rudolphs?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你知道你很想吃它们
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, now. You know you want them.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这么做
sense_groups.english: Don't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 摩妮卡 第一盒我免费送你
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what, Mon. I'll give you the first box for free.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我得走了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 酷小孩都会吃的
sense_groups.english: Come on. All the cool kids are eating them.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下我要教你为什么我们不能只拿马克杯
sense_groups.english: And later I wanna show you why we don't just trap spiders...

sense_groups.chinese: 把蜘蛛困在里面后就不管了
sense_groups.english: ...under coffee mugs and leave them there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受训做好我讨厌的工作 我的生活根本是一团糟
sense_groups.english: I'm training to be better at a job that I hate. My life officially sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是过渡期而已吗 我以为你要踏入时尚界
sense_groups.english: But wasn't this supposed to be temporary? I thought you wanted to do fashion stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我还没有放弃啊
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, I'm still pursuing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么不放弃的呢
sense_groups.english: How, exactly, are you pursuing that?

sense_groups.chinese: 除了你在两年前寄出履历表
sense_groups.english: You know, other than sending out resumes, like, what, two years ago?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是有很多…
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm also sending out...

sense_groups.chinese: 好点子
sense_groups.english: ...good thoughts.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想只要你继续做这份工作
sense_groups.english: If you ask me, as long as you got this job...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就不会想找其他工作
sense_groups.english: ...you got nothing pushing you to get another one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要恐惧
sense_groups.english: You need The Fear.

sense_groups.chinese: 恐惧 - 他说的对
sense_groups.english: The Fear? - He's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你辞掉这份工作 你就会有动力
sense_groups.english: If you quit this job, you then have motivation...

sense_groups.chinese: 去找你想做的事
sense_groups.english: ...to go after a job you really want.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你还在做你讨厌的工作 为什么你不辞职 过着恐惧生活
sense_groups.english: How come you're still at a job you hate? Why don't you quit and get The Fear?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我太害怕了
sense_groups.english: Because I'm too afraid.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我不知道
sense_groups.english: God. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意付出一切为设计师工作或采购
sense_groups.english: I mean, I would give anything to work for a designer, you know, or a buyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想到了三十岁仍在这里工作
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I just don't wanna be 30 and still work here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那比到了28岁仍在这里工作还糟糕
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that'd be much worse than being 28 and still working here.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 什么事
sense_groups.english: Rachel? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 提醒我教你分辨无咖啡因咖啡跟一般咖啡
sense_groups.english: Remind me to review with you which pot is decaf and which is regular.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能用把手来分辨吗
sense_groups.english: Can't I just look at the handles on them?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不行
sense_groups.english: You would think.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 阿甘 你知道吗 我是个烂服务生
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. Gunther, you know what? I am a terrible waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道为什么我是烂服务生吗 因为我不在乎
sense_groups.english: Do you know why I'm a terrible waitress? Because I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 我不在乎无咖啡因咖啡跟一般咖啡
sense_groups.english: I don't care. I don't care which pot is regular and which pot is decaf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎托盘区在哪里
sense_groups.english: I don't care where the tray spot is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 这不是我想做的事
sense_groups.english: I just don't care. This is not what I wanna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不该再做下去了
sense_groups.english: So I don't think I should do it anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟你提出辞呈 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna give you my week's notice. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 我不干了
sense_groups.english: Gunther, I quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 这代表我们得开始付咖啡钱了吗
sense_groups.english: Does this mean we're gonna have to start paying for coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 12
sense_groups.english: Okay, 12.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我拼出"咪咪"了
sense_groups.english: What? - I spelled out "boobies." Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 再给我一盒薄荷宝藏 好吗
sense_groups.english: Ross, put me down for another box of the Mint Treasures, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 薄荷宝藏在哪里
sense_groups.english: Where are the Mint Treasures?

sense_groups.chinese: 没了 我都卖光了
sense_groups.english: Uh, we're out. I sold them all.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我不再卖饼干给你了
sense_groups.english: Monica, I'm cutting you off.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行…
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是多几盒饼干而已
sense_groups.english: Just a couple more boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么大不了的 我很好
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal, all right? I'm cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得帮我再拿几盒饼干过来
sense_groups.english: You gotta help me out with a couple more boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 看看你自己 你的脖子上沾了饼干
sense_groups.english: Mon, look at yourself. You have cookie on your neck.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 目前你卖掉几盒了 - 听好了
sense_groups.english: Whoa. So how many you sold so far? - Ah? Check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 517盒 - 天啊 你怎么办到的
sense_groups.english: Five hundred and seventeen boxes. - Oh, my God. How did you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那晚我离开博物馆时
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Okay, the other night, I was leaving the museum...

sense_groups.chinese: 雷射•弗洛伊德在天文馆演出
sense_groups.english: ...just as Laser Floyd was letting out of the planetarium.

sense_groups.chinese: 我轻轻松松卖掉五十盒
sense_groups.english: Without even trying, I sold 50 boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时我想到这个点子 我的成功之道在于贪嘴
sense_groups.english: That's when it occurred to me. The key to my success: The munchies.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我午夜时跑到纽约大学宿含
sense_groups.english: So I started hitting the NYU dorms around midnight.

sense_groups.chinese: 卖掉一箱箱饼干
sense_groups.english: I am selling cookies by the case.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们叫我
sense_groups.english: They call me...

sense_groups.chinese: 饼干兄弟
sense_groups.english: ..."Cookie Dude."

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 停下你们手边的工作 我要找人帮忙装信封及贴邮票
sense_groups.english: Okay, stop what you're doing. I need envelope stuffers, stamp lickers...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁帮你写履历表的
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. Who did these resumes for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我用我的电脑写的
sense_groups.english: Me, on my computer.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真的用了大型字体
sense_groups.english: Well, you sure used a large font.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 咖啡厅服务生
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah. Well, "Waitress at a Coffeehouse"...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟啦啦队长占不了太多空间
sense_groups.english: ...and "Cheer Squad Co-captain" only took up so much room.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的好好笑
sense_groups.english: Heh, heh. Hey, that's funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很好笑 钱德 你是个幽默的家伙
sense_groups.english: You're funny, Chandler. You're a funny guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道还有什么事很好笑吗
sense_groups.english: You know what else is really funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还说了其他的事吗
sense_groups.english: Something else I might have said?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你要我辞职吗
sense_groups.english: Weren't you the guy that told me to quit my job...

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本没有别的事可做
sense_groups.english: ...when I had absolutely nothing else to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 冷静点 不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, calm down. It's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 事情不好了 罗斯
sense_groups.english: No, it's not gonna be okay, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天是最后一天 我一点头绪都没有
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow is my last day, and I don't have a lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们知道吗 我要打电话给何甘
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? I'm just gonna call Gunther...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他说我不要辞职
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm gonna tell him I'm not quitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能屈服在恐惧下
sense_groups.english: You don't wanna give in to The Fear.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟你的愚蠢恐惧 我讨厌你的恐惧
sense_groups.english: You and your stupid Fear. I hate your Fear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要将你跟你的恐惧…
sense_groups.english: I would like to take you and your Fear...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我有好消息
sense_groups.english: Hey. I got great news.

sense_groups.chinese: 逃吧 乔伊 快点逃命
sense_groups.english: Run, Joey. Run for your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么瑞秋 听我说 你听说过好运到时装吗
sense_groups.english: What? Rach, listen, have you ever heard of Fortunata Fashions?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 我爸帮他们修水电
sense_groups.english: No. - My old man's doing a plumbing job there...

sense_groups.chinese: 他听说他们在找人
sense_groups.english: ...and he heard they have an opening.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我帮你问一下 他能不能帮你争取面试机会吗
sense_groups.english: Want me to see if he can get you an interview?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那太棒了 你太好了 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, yes. I would love that. Oh, that's so sweet, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气 现在才是真正的好消息
sense_groups.english: Not a problem. And now for the great news.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么那不是好消息吗 - 这个更棒
sense_groups.english: What, that wasn't the great news? - Only if you think it's better than this.

sense_groups.chinese: 雪花罐
sense_groups.english: Snow-in-a-Can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在工作时拿到的 你要我装饰一下窗户吗
sense_groups.english: I got it at work. You want me to decorate the window?

sense_groups.chinese: 做出圣诞造型 - 圣诞饼干
sense_groups.english: Give it kind of a Christmas looky? - Christmas cookie?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这棵是道格拉斯杉
sense_groups.english: Okay, and this one here's a Douglas fir.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然比较贵 但味道很香
sense_groups.english: Now, it's a little more money, but you get a nicer smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来不错 我买了
sense_groups.english: Looks good. I'll take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 不 你不会想买那棵
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait. No, no, no. You don't want that one. Uh-uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你可以买这棵超酷的桔树
sense_groups.english: No. You can have this cool brown one. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 它快死掉了
sense_groups.english: It's almost dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你得买下它 它才能完成它的圣诞节使命
sense_groups.english: But that's why you have to buy it, so that it can fulfill its Christmas destiny.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然他们会把它丢进碎木机 告诉他 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, they're gonna throw it into the chipper. Tell him, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 无法完成圣诞节使命的树
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the trees that don't fulfill their Christmas destiny, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 会被丢进碎木机
sense_groups.english: ...are thrown in the chipper.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我要再逛一下
sense_groups.english: I think I'm gonna look around a little bit more.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你不能再这么做 我是靠佣金赚钱的
sense_groups.english: Pheebs. Heh. You gotta stop doing this. I'm working on commission here.

sense_groups.chinese: 两位 我来买圣诞树
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. I'm here to pick out my Christmas tree.

sense_groups.chinese: 别忙了 这是你的圣诞树
sense_groups.english: Well, look no further. This one's yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是去年我丢掉的圣诞树吗
sense_groups.english: Is this the one that I threw out last year?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗 算了 大家都想买青翠的圣诞树
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what? Never mind. Everybody wants to have a green one.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我无意那么激动
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I didn't mean to get so emotional.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是…我想过节让人很感伤
sense_groups.english: I guess it's just... The holidays are just hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 因为你妈妈在圣诞节前后过世吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, is that because your mom died around Christmas?

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至没想到那一点
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wasn't even thinking about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 你卖了几盒
sense_groups.english: Hi there. How many did you sell?

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要告诉你 你是害莎拉摔断腿的坏人
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna tell you. You're the bad man who broke Sarah's leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个意外 好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, now. That was an accident, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是大坏蛋
sense_groups.english: You're a big scrud.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么意思
sense_groups.english: What's a scrud?

sense_groups.english: Why don't you look in the mirror, scrud?

sense_groups.english: I don't have to. I can just look at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 女孩们
sense_groups.english: All right, girls...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有大男人
sense_groups.english: ...and man.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们的最后统计数字
sense_groups.english: Let's see your final tallies.

sense_groups.chinese: 黛比
sense_groups.english: Oh... Debbie.

sense_groups.english: Three hundred and twenty-one boxes of cookies. Very nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还不够好
sense_groups.english: Not nice enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 夏拉
sense_groups.english: Charla.
Two hundred and seventy-eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 亲爱的 还是很不错
sense_groups.english: Sorry, dear, but still good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对坏蛋来说够好了
sense_groups.english: Good for a scrud.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看
sense_groups.english: Let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 伊莉莎白
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Yes, Elizabeth.
Eight hundred and seventy-one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本不可能
sense_groups.english: That's crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 棕鸟姊妹
sense_groups.english: Sister Brown Bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 做得好
sense_groups.english: Good going.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一个是谁
sense_groups.english: Who's next?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi there. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 代替莎拉上场
sense_groups.english: And batting for Sarah...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯•盖勒
sense_groups.english: ...Ross Geller.
Eight hundred and seventy-two.

sense_groups.chinese: 但看起来你自己买了不少饼干
sense_groups.english: Although it looks like you bought an awful lot of cookies yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为医生说我有非常严重的
sense_groups.english: Ahem. That is because my doctor says that I have a very serious...

sense_groups.chinese: 牛轧糖…
sense_groups.english: ...nougat...

sense_groups.chinese: 不耐症
sense_groups.english: ...deficiency.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我们发生了什么事 棕鸟罗斯
sense_groups.english: Tell us what happened, Brown Bird Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我输了
sense_groups.english: Well, I lost.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个小女孩把她的制服借给她19岁的姊姊
sense_groups.english: Some little girl loaned her uniform to her 19-year-old sister...

sense_groups.chinese: 她跑到尼米兹号卖掉两千盒饼干
sense_groups.english: ...who went down to the USS Nimitz and sold over 2000 boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 面试进行得如何 - 我搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Hey. How'd the interview go? - Oh, I blew it.

sense_groups.chinese: 连我都不会雇用我自己
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't have even hired me.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 甜心
sense_groups.english: Come here, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你得面试一千次才能找到一份工作
sense_groups.english: Listen, you're gonna go on like a thousand interviews before you get a job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我原本不是那个意思
sense_groups.english: That's not how that was supposed to come out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是史上最糟糕的圣诞节
sense_groups.english: This is just the worst Christmas ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 瑞秋 或许你该待在咖啡厅工作
sense_groups.english: Rach, maybe you should just, you know, stay here at the coffeehouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 太迟了 泰利已经雇用了那个女孩
sense_groups.english: I can't. It's too late. Terry already hired that girl over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看她 她甚至有服务生资历
sense_groups.english: Look at her. She's even got waitress experience. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚她…
sense_groups.english: Last night she was...

sense_groups.chinese: 教大家怎么把纸巾折成…
sense_groups.english: ...teaching everybody how to make napkins into...

sense_groups.chinese: 天鹅
sense_groups.english: ...swans.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是说"天鹅"
sense_groups.english: That word was "swans."

sense_groups.chinese: "天鹅"
sense_groups.english: "Swans."

sense_groups.chinese: 看到喝醉酒的圣诞老人尿湿裤子 坏了我的过节兴致
sense_groups.english: Well, seeing that drunk Santa wet himself really perked up my Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Ah! Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐 - 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Merry Christmas!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们救了它们
sense_groups.english: You saved them. You guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你们最棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, you're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来像是枯死圣诞树复活之夜
sense_groups.english: Looks like Night of the Living Dead Christmas Trees.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我就是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, this is she.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: Oh! You're kidding. You're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 大家都爱开玩笑的人
sense_groups.english: Sure, everybody loves a kidder.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被录取了
sense_groups.english: I got the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 那是最棒的
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. All right! - That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 上帝保佑所有人
sense_groups.english: Oh! God bless us, every one.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 这是我端的最后一杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: Here we go. I'm serving my last cup of coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 好好享用
sense_groups.english: There you go. Enjoy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该跟她说我点的是茶吗 - 不
sense_groups.english: Should I tell her I ordered tea? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不
sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 请听我说
sense_groups.english: Um, excuse me, everyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我在这里工作的最后一夜
sense_groups.english: Uh, this is my last night working here...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说我在这里交到一些好朋友
sense_groups.english: ...and I just wanted to say that I made some really good friends here.

sense_groups.chinese: 是该离开的时候了
sense_groups.english: And it's just time to move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无意冒犯仍在这里工作的人
sense_groups.english: And no offense to everybody who still works here...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们不知道我多么开心能这么说
sense_groups.english: ...but you have no idea how good it feels to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我宣布
sense_groups.english: ...that as of this moment...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不必再煮咖啡了
sense_groups.english: ...I will never have to make coffee again.

sense_groups.chinese: 老卡普兰先生喜欢喝浓咖啡
sense_groups.english: Now, Mr. Kaplan Sr. Likes his coffee strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得用两包 不是一包
sense_groups.english: So you're gonna use two bags instead of one, see?

sense_groups.chinese: 注意听 这个部分很难
sense_groups.english: Now, pay attention because this part's tricky.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 有些人滤纸只用一次
sense_groups.english: See, some people use filters just once.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉你没办法参加太空营
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry you didn't get to go to Space Camp...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望这能弥补你 好吗
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm hoping that maybe somehow, this may help make up for it. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你介绍
sense_groups.english: Presenting...

sense_groups.chinese: 莎拉•杜铎私人特别太空营
sense_groups.english: ...Sarah Tuddle's Private, Very Special Space Camp!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒先生 你真的不必这么做
sense_groups.english: Really, Mr. Geller, you don't have to do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 要开始了
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备任务倒数
sense_groups.english: Stand by for mission countdown.

sense_groups.chinese: 十…
sense_groups.english: Ten, ten, ten.

sense_groups.chinese: 九…
sense_groups.english: Nine, nine, nine.

sense_groups.chinese: 八…
sense_groups.english: Eight, eight, eight. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 发射
sense_groups.english: Okay, blast off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是外星人
sense_groups.english: I'm an alien. I'm an alien.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是小行星
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, an asteroid!
