questions.en:
Okay, pick a card, any card.
All right, now memorize it.
Show it to everybody.
Got it?
All right. Give it back to me.
Five of hearts.
Real magic does exist.
Wow. Joey, how do you do it?
I can't tell you that. No.
Uh, somebody's at the door on the ceiling.
Heh. No, that's our unbelievably loud upstairs neighbor.
He took up the carpets, and now you can hear everything.
Well, why don't you go up there and ask him to just step lightly, please?
I have, like five times, but the guy is so charming...
...that I go up there to yell, and I end up apologizing to him.
Oh, that is silly.
I'll go up there. I'll tell him to keep it down.
All right, be my guest. - Good luck.
All right, all right, all right.
If you really wanna know how I did it, I'll show you.
When you handed me back the card, what you didn't see was...
...I looked at it so fast, it was invisible to the naked eye.
I just did it.
Just did it again.
Here, I'll slow it down so you guys can see it. Ready?
I got it now. Okay.
I was at my friend's downstairs...
...and we hear every single thing that you do.
Oh. Ha, ha. Thank you.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey.
Anybody got a length of rope about 6 feet long with a noose at the end?
Honey, what's the matter? - I just saw Janice.
She was at Rockefeller Center, skating with her husband.
She looked so happy.
I almost feel bad for whipping that kid's pretzel at them.
I remember the first time I saw that girl Katherine after we broke up.
She was walking with her friend Donna, just laughing and talking.
God, it killed me.
Yes, but you ended up having sex with both of them that afternoon.
Sorry, I just... Any excuse to tell that story.
Hey, Chandler, there's a party tomorrow. You'll feel better then.
Oh. You know what? I'm gonna be okay. You don't have to throw a party for me.
It's Joey's birthday.
Oh, well, then if anybody should have a party, it should be him.
Shh. I cannot believe she's still up there.
Okay, well, he totally screwed up the punch line.
You know, it's supposed to be
How's that coffee coming, dear? - Yeah. Right away, Mr. Kaplan.
I'm not supposed to drink coffee. It makes me gassy.
I know.
I'll bet you're thinking, "What's an intelligent girl...
...who wants to be in fashion doing making coffee?"
Oh, ha, ha. You got me. Heh.
Don't think I haven't noticed your potential.
Well, I've got a project for you that's a lot more related to fashion.
How does that sound? - Oh. That sounds great.
Come on over here, sweetheart. - Thank you so much, Mr. Kaplan.
I need these hangers separated ASAP.
You're welcome.
Oh, God, I hate my job. I hate it. I hate my job.
I know, honey. I'm sorry.
Oh. I wanna quit, but then I think I should stick it out.
Then I think...
...why would such a person stay in such a demeaning job...
...just because it's remotely related to the field they're interested in?
Gee, I don't know, Rach.
Order up. I got a Yentl soup, James Beans, and a Howdy, hold the Doody.
Oh. Honey, come on, I'm sorry. I didn't...
I don't mind paying my dues.
It's just, how much am I gonna learn about fashion...
...by walking Myra, the arthritic seamstress...
...to the bathroom?
Hi. Is my misery amusing to you?
I'm sorry, I was just, uh... Ha, ha.
It's not funny. This is actually my job.
Oh, believe me, I've been there.
I had to sort mannequin heads at Mannequins Plus.
Oh. Well, then, so I'm just gonna go back to talking to my friend here.
You can go back to enjoying your little hamburger.
Uh, just one other thing. - Ahem. Yes?
I work at Bloomingdale's...
...and I might know of a job possibility, if you're interested.
Do you want my pickle?
Hey, guys.
Hey, Gunther. - Hi.
You're going out on a date with the noisy guy upstairs?
Well, he's very charming. - I know, he's too charming.
But if you go out, it's gonna make it so much harder for me to hate him.
Well, you're just going to have to try.
All right. Joey? Where are the Jell-O shots?
I don't know. Chandler's supposed to be passing them...
Chandler. - Hello-dee-lo.
Well, somebody's feeling better.
Stick out your tongue. - Take off your shirt.
Oh, my. - Oh, my God.
How many of these did you have? These are pure vodka.
Yeah, Jell-O just like Mom used to make.
The most unbelievable thing happened to me today.
Hi. - Hi.
I'm having lunch at Monica's and this guy starts talking to me...
...and he works for a buyer at Bloomingdale's...
...and there's an opening in his department. So I gave him my phone number...
...and he's gonna call me this weekend to see if he can get me an interview.
I know.
What, so this guy's helping you for no apparent reason?
And he's a total stranger?
Yeah. His name is, um, Mark something.
Ah. Sounds like Mark Something wants to have some sex.
What?
I'm just saying, why else would he just swoop in out of nowhere for no reason?
To be nice?
Hey, Joey, are men ever nice to strange women for no reason?
No, only for sex. - Thank you.
So did you tell Mark Something about me?
I didn't have to, because I was wearing my "I Heart Ross" sandwich board...
...and ringing my bell.
Joey! Happy birthday!
Hey!
Okay, how many of that girl are you seeing?
How hammered are you? Huh? These are Joey's sisters.
Hi, Joey's sisters.
Hey. - Hey. Hey.
What are we drinking over here?
Oh, well, I have a vodka and cranberry juice.
No kidding?
That's the exact same drink I made myself right after I shot my husband.
Okay, I don't know how to talk to you.
What are you doing?
I'm taking my ex-girlfriend off my speed dialer.
No, no, no, it's a good thing.
Why must we dial so speedily anyway? Why must we rush through life?
Why can't we savor the precious moments? Those are some huge breasts you have.
Hi. - Hi.
Yeah, heh. So, um, I heard about this Mark guy that Rachel met today.
Oh, yeah, isn't that great? - Oh, yeah.
So, uh, yeah, pretty good. He sounds like a nice, good guy.
Oh, he is. And he is so dreamy.
I mean, you know what? When he left, I actually used the phrase...
..."homina, homina, homina."
That's excellent.
So he's just a nice guy.
You really think this Mark doesn't want anything in exchange for helping you?
Well, I assume I'll have to take showers with him.

How you feeling?

...because I drank it.
Where'd you get to? We lost you after you opened up all the presents.

Really?
No "woo-hooing." No "woo-hooing."
Why, what happened?
I fooled around with Joey's sister.
Well, that's not the worst part. - What is the worst part?
I can't remember which sister.
You see what men do? Don't tell me men are nice.
This is men.
Are you insane?
Joey's gonna kill you. He's actually going to kill you dead.
Okay. You don't think I thought of that?
How can you not know which one? - I mean, that's unbelievable.
I mean, was it Gina? - Which one is Gina?
The dark, big hair, with the airplane earrings.
No, no, no, that's not Gina, that's Dina.
See? You can't tell which is which either. Blah.
We didn't fool around with any of them. Blah. Blah.
Veronica. Look, it's gotta be Veronica. The girl in the red skirt.
I definitely stuck my tongue down her throat.
That was me.
Oh. When I've been drinking, sometimes I tend to get overly friendly.
And I'm sorry. - That's okay.
That's all right. - That's okay.
Can I talk to you for a second?
Hey, Joey. - Hey.
Come on.
Why can't we talk in here, with witnesses?
I just got off the phone with my sister. - Uh, which one?
Mary Angela. - Mary Angela.
Yeah. - Now, which one is she again?
Ask Chandler. He's the one who fooled around with her.
She told me you said you could really fall for her.
Now, is that true, or are you just getting over Janice by groping my sister?
It's gotta be the first one.
Really?
That's great.
You and my sister, sitting in a tree.
Yep, I'm in a tree.
Did he call? Did Mark call?
No, honey, I'm sorry. But the weekend's not over yet.
Oh, my God. Is that Phoebe?
Guess they're back from their date. - Ah.
Music. Very nice.
Oh, my God.
So how are you?
I am good. I finished my book. - Oh, yeah? What's it about?
I don't remember. Do you wanna take a walk?
Yeah, I do.
"Dear Mary Angela
Hi, how's it going?

All right, look, look, you've got to do this yourself, okay?
In person. At least you know her name.
You just go to the house and you ask for Mary Angela, okay?
When whichever one she is comes to the door...
...take her for a walk, you let her down easy.
Okay.
What if Mary Angela comes to the door and I ask for Mary Angela?
Where in Cuba?
Joey, what...? What are you doing here?
Waiting for my grandma to finish my laundry.
What about you?
Uh, I'm here to see Mary Angela.
You are so the man. Come on.
Now, look, listen. Listen.
You gotta be cool, because my grandma doesn't know about you two.
You do not wanna tick her off.
She was, like, the sixth person to spit on Mussolini's hanging body.
Yeah.
Where's Mary Angela?
She's right in there. - Okay.
Hey, Chandler.
I can't believe Mark didn't call. It's Sunday night and he didn't call.
Bummer.
Yeah, right. Look at you. You're practically giddy.
No, I'm genuinely sorry the Mark thing didn't work out.
Look, Rach, I want only good things for you.
Wait a minute. Why don't you just call Mark?
Who says you have to sit here and wait for him?
You've got to make stuff happen.
Yeah, but you don't wanna seem too pushy.
Honey, it's not pushy. He gave her his home number.
Wha...? He gave you his home number, as in, like, to his home?
Yeah. And you don't mind if I call, because you only want good things for me.
That's right, good things. That is what I said.
Ahem. Hello, Mark? Hi, it's Rachel Green.
Ha, ha. Oh, no. Don't you apologize.
Yeah, I'll hold.
He left my number at work.
He was gonna get it, but he was helping his niece with her report on the pioneers.
That is so made up.
Yeah. Oh, my God. Tomorrow? That's... No, it's perfect.
Oh, God. Thank you so much. Great. Bye.
Oh! I got the interview.
There you go.

Oh, that is amazing. - Yeah.
Well, if I know Mark, and I think I do...
...I'd expect nothing less. - I gotta figure out what I'm gonna wear.
High collar and baggy pants say, "I'm a pro."
Yeah, right. Okay, I'll see you guys later.
Okay.
You go get them.
What did I do to you? Did I hurt you in some way?
What? - "Why don't you call him?"
Well, thank you very much. Now he's gonna prep her.
You know, prep her, as in what you do before you surgically remove the boyfriend.
Are you crazy?
Oh, am I? Am I? Am I out of my mind? Am I losing my senses?
This dreamy guy is taking my girlfriend out for a meal.
Ross, you know, this isn't even about you.
This is about Rachel and something happening for her.
Even if you're right.

No, but... - I mean, don't you trust her?
Well, yeah...
Then get over yourself. Grow up.
You grow up.

Well, it's yummy.
So, uh, Mary Angela, do you like it?
Of course. It's her favorite.
So, um, hmm...

More of Grandma's tiramisu.
Oh, would you just please...
...give me your recipe, because this is great.
It's top-notch.

Excuse yourself and go to the bathroom.
Oh, no, I was just squinting. That doesn't mean anything.
Just do it.
Will you excuse me? I have to, um...
Hey...

Look, I may have jumped the gun here. Whoa.

And I'm not really in a... In a commitment kind of place.
So? Me neither.
God, Mary Angela was right. You do have the softest lips.

I am.
Oh, it's so bad.
Joey! - No Joey. No Joey. No Joey.
Joey. - What's going on?
You're it. Now run and hide.
It's no big deal.

What? How could you do that? How could you think she was Mary Angela?

Look, I'm sorry, okay?
I was really drunk, and you guys all look really similar.
I say punch him, Joey.
Yeah, punch him. - Yeah, kick him.
We should all calm down...
...because, you know, your brother's not gonna punch me.
Are you?
Well, that is usually what I would do.

How could you do this?

You're my best friend.

So what?
I say punch him. Punch him. - Yeah, punch him.
Come on, punch him. - No. No. I'm not gonna punch Chandler.
I'll do it. - No, you won't.
Look, he knows he did a terrible thing, and I believe him.
He's sorry. But you got one more apology to make.
All right? You gotta apologize to Mary Angela.
Okay. Absolutely. You got it. - All right.
Cookie, now you can punch him. - What?
Hey. - Hi.
What are you doing here?
You know, this building's on my paper route, so...
Oh. Hi. - Hi.
How did it go?
Oh, well, the woman I interviewed with was pretty tough...
...but, you know, thank God Mark coached me.
Once I started talking about the fall line, she got all happy.
I'm so proud of you. - Me too.
Listen, I'm, uh...
I'm sorry I've been so crazy and jealous and...
It's just, I like you a lot, so...
I know.
Yeah? - Yeah.
Rachel. - Yeah?
Hi. Hi. - Hi, Mark.
I just talked to Joanna, and she loves you. You got it. You got the job.
What? - Oh! I did?
Yes.
Oh, my God!
Congratulations...
So, Phoebe.
How was your date?
Oh, well, you know. Ha, ha.
Yeah, I do know.
Ick. You were eavesdropping?

sense_groups.chinese: 选张牌 任何一张
sense_groups.english: Okay, pick a card, any card.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 记住它
sense_groups.english: All right, now memorize it.

sense_groups.chinese: 让大家看
sense_groups.english: Show it to everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了吗
sense_groups.english: Got it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 还给我
sense_groups.english: All right. Give it back to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 红心五
sense_groups.english: Five of hearts.

sense_groups.chinese: 魔术真是神奇
sense_groups.english: Real magic does exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你怎么变的
sense_groups.english: Wow. Joey, how do you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 无可奉告
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you that. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人在天花板上敲门
sense_groups.english: Uh, somebody's at the door on the ceiling.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是我们楼上邻居的噪音
sense_groups.english: Heh. No, that's our unbelievably loud upstairs neighbor.

sense_groups.chinese: 他收起地毯 所有声音一清二楚
sense_groups.english: He took up the carpets, and now you can hear everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 为何不上楼请他放轻脚步
sense_groups.english: Well, why don't you go up there and ask him to just step lightly, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我试过…五次了吧 但那家伙魅力无法挡…
sense_groups.english: I have, like five times, but the guy is so charming...

sense_groups.chinese: 我上去骂人 结果反而跟他道歉
sense_groups.english: ...that I go up there to yell, and I end up apologizing to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 太离谱了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that is silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上去叫他小声点
sense_groups.english: I'll go up there. I'll tell him to keep it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 请便 - 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: All right, be my guest. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好吧…
sense_groups.english: All right, all right, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们真想知道我怎么变的 我就告诉你们

sense_groups.chinese: 你们把牌还给我的时候 趁你们不注意…

sense_groups.chinese: 我很快的偷看一下 肉眼是看不到的
sense_groups.english: ...I looked at it so fast, it was invisible to the naked eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 偷看到了
sense_groups.english: I just did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 又看了一次
sense_groups.english: Just did it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 我放慢速度给你们看 准备好了吗
sense_groups.english: Here, I'll slow it down so you guys can see it. Ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 原来如此
sense_groups.english: I got it now. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我朋友住在楼下
sense_groups.english: I was at my friend's downstairs...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的动静我们听得一清二楚
sense_groups.english: ...and we hear every single thing that you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh. Ha, ha. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁有一条六尺长的绳子 末端还打了个结
sense_groups.english: Anybody got a length of rope about 6 feet long with a noose at the end?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 发生什么事 - 我刚遇到珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Honey, what's the matter? - I just saw Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在洛克斐勒中心与她先生溜冰
sense_groups.english: She was at Rockefeller Center, skating with her husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很幸福
sense_groups.english: She looked so happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我几乎因为向他们丢椒盐卷饼感到难过
sense_groups.english: I almost feel bad for whipping that kid's pretzel at them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得与凯瑟琳分手后第一次偶遇
sense_groups.english: I remember the first time I saw that girl Katherine after we broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 她和好友唐娜在路上有说有笑
sense_groups.english: She was walking with her friend Donna, just laughing and talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真难过
sense_groups.english: God, it killed me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你那天下午和她们两个上床
sense_groups.english: Yes, but you ended up having sex with both of them that afternoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我只是想趁机炫耀这件事
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I just... Any excuse to tell that story.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 明天会有个派对 你会好过点的
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, there's a party tomorrow. You'll feel better then.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我没事 不用特地为我举行派对
sense_groups.english: Oh. You know what? I'm gonna be okay. You don't have to throw a party for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是乔伊的生日派对
sense_groups.english: It's Joey's birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 如果要帮某人办派对 那一定是他了
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, then if anybody should have a party, it should be him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信她还在楼上
sense_groups.english: Shh. I cannot believe she's still up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他完全弄错关键句了
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, he totally screwed up the punch line.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是…
sense_groups.english: You know, it's supposed to be

sense_groups.chinese: 咖啡好了吗 亲爱的 - 马上来 卡普兰先生
sense_groups.english: How's that coffee coming, dear? - Yeah. Right away, Mr. Kaplan.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我不该喝咖啡 它让我一直放屁
sense_groups.english: I'm not supposed to drink coffee. It makes me gassy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你心里一定很纳闷 "这么一个聪慧的女孩…
sense_groups.english: I'll bet you're thinking, "What's an intelligent girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 该在时尚业发光发热 怎么会在这泡咖啡"
sense_groups.english: ...who wants to be in fashion doing making coffee?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜对了
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha, ha. You got me. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 别以为我从未注意到你的潜力
sense_groups.english: Don't think I haven't noticed your potential.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一份与时尚更有关联的任务给你
sense_groups.english: Well, I've got a project for you that's a lot more related to fashion.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来如何 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: How does that sound? - Oh. That sounds great.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 亲爱的 - 太感谢你了 卡普兰先生
sense_groups.english: Come on over here, sweetheart. - Thank you so much, Mr. Kaplan.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要立刻将这些衣架分开
sense_groups.english: I need these hangers separated ASAP.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 我痛恨我的工作
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I hate my job. I hate it. I hate my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 亲爱的 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I know, honey. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想辞职 又觉得该坚持下去
sense_groups.english: Oh. I wanna quit, but then I think I should stick it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又觉得…
sense_groups.english: Then I think...

sense_groups.chinese: 为何要屈就于这种贬低人格的工作
sense_groups.english: ...why would such a person stay in such a demeaning job...

sense_groups.chinese: 只因为它与我有兴趣的领域有这么一点点关系
sense_groups.english: ...just because it's remotely related to the field they're interested in?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Gee, I don't know, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 点菜吧 我有杨朵汤 詹姆斯豆 还有木偶餐
sense_groups.english: Order up. I got a Yentl soup, James Beans, and a Howdy, hold the Doody.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 对不起 我不是…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Honey, come on, I'm sorry. I didn't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不介意吃苦
sense_groups.english: I don't mind paying my dues.

sense_groups.chinese: 光是扶得了关节炎的
sense_groups.english: It's just, how much am I gonna learn about fashion...

sense_groups.chinese: 裁缝师到厕所
sense_groups.english: ...by walking Myra, the arthritic seamstress...

sense_groups.chinese: 是学不了时尚的
sense_groups.english: ...to the bathroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你是幸灾乐祸吗
sense_groups.english: Hi. Is my misery amusing to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I was just, uh... Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好笑 那就是我的工作
sense_groups.english: It's not funny. This is actually my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 我是过来人
sense_groups.english: Oh, believe me, I've been there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前专门整理假人模特儿的头
sense_groups.english: I had to sort mannequin heads at Mannequins Plus.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 我要继续跟我朋友聊天
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, then, so I'm just gonna go back to talking to my friend here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你继续享用你的汉堡吧
sense_groups.english: You can go back to enjoying your little hamburger.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一件事 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Uh, just one other thing. - Ahem. Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在布鲁明岱尔百货工作
sense_groups.english: I work at Bloomingdale's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能有个你会感兴趣的工作机会
sense_groups.english: ...and I might know of a job possibility, if you're interested.

sense_groups.chinese: 想吃我的腌黄瓜吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want my pickle?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 阿甘 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟楼上的吵闹家伙约会
sense_groups.english: You're going out on a date with the noisy guy upstairs?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很迷人 - 我知道 他太迷人了
sense_groups.english: Well, he's very charming. - I know, he's too charming.

sense_groups.chinese: 若你和他约会 我就更难讨厌他
sense_groups.english: But if you go out, it's gonna make it so much harder for me to hate him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只得尽力而为了
sense_groups.english: Well, you're just going to have to try.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 乔伊 果冻酒呢
sense_groups.english: All right. Joey? Where are the Jell-O shots?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 钱德应该端出去
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Chandler's supposed to be passing them...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Hello-dee-lo.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人心情好多了
sense_groups.english: Well, somebody's feeling better.

sense_groups.chinese: 舌头伸出来 - 上衣脱下来
sense_groups.english: Stick out your tongue. - Take off your shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 老天 喔喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, my. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底吃了多少 这些是纯伏特加做的
sense_groups.english: How many of these did you have? These are pure vodka.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 有妈妈的味道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Jell-O just like Mom used to make.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天遇到一件不可思议的事情
sense_groups.english: The most unbelievable thing happened to me today.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在摩妮卡的店吃午餐 然后有人与我攀谈·…
sense_groups.english: I'm having lunch at Monica's and this guy starts talking to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 他在布鲁明岱尔百货帮忙采购
sense_groups.english: ...and he works for a buyer at Bloomingdale's...

sense_groups.chinese: 他的部门有空缺 于是我把电话给了他
sense_groups.english: ...and there's an opening in his department. So I gave him my phone number...

sense_groups.chinese: 他周末会打给我 看是否能安排面试

sense_groups.chinese: 准备去打击练习场了吗 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Ready to go to the batting cage? - You bet.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 有个礼物要送你
sense_groups.english: And first, here's a gift. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 伸缩内裤
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Stretchy pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 最棒的发明之一
sense_groups.english: Well, those are the greatest things in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我是你 一定每天都穿
sense_groups.english: If I were you, I'd wear them every day, every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 谢谢 你真的很贴心
sense_groups.english: Jeez, thank you. Really, that's so nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是老实说 我不认为自己会穿
sense_groups.english: But, um, to be honest, I don't think I can wear these.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们太紧了 让我觉得大家都看得到
sense_groups.english: They're so tight. I'd feel like I'm on display.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我可以…
sense_groups.english: That's all right. I'll figure...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: How's it going? - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 - 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Good. - Hey, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: "鬼店"看得如何了 - 丹尼刚刚进去217号房
sense_groups.english: How you doing with The Shining? - Uh, Danny just went into Room 217.

sense_groups.chinese: 接下来是最棒的部分 浴缸里死去的女人…
sense_groups.english: Ooh. The next part's the best. When that dead lady in the bathtub...

sense_groups.chinese: 不要说 别这样 你不要说
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Come on. You're gonna ruin it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我用暗号说
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll talk in code.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得那个孩子在走廊看到两个东西的时候吗
sense_groups.english: Remember when the kid sees those two blanks in the hallway?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 很酷 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's very cool. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有东西和没东西 让东西变东西 对吧
sense_groups.english: Ooh. All blank and no blank makes blank a blank-blank, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不 还有最后
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. No, the end.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克差点用那东西杀掉所有人
sense_groups.english: When Jack almost kills them all with that blank...

sense_groups.chinese: 但在最后关头 他们逃掉了
sense_groups.english: ...but then in the last second they get away. Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我不敢相信 你竟然这么做
sense_groups.english: Joey, I can't believe you just did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 她解读了你的暗号
sense_groups.english: I can't believe she cracked your code.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗瑞跟乔求婚 但是她拒绝…
sense_groups.english: All right, okay. Laurie proposes to Jo and she says no...

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然她还很爱他 最后他娶艾咪
sense_groups.english: ...even though she's still in love with him. And then he ends up marrying Amy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的是个意外
sense_groups.english: Mine was by accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 锅炉爆炸 毁掉饭店 杀死父亲
sense_groups.english: The boiler explodes and destroys the hotel and kills the dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 贝丝会死掉
sense_groups.english: Beth dies.

sense_groups.chinese: 贝丝… 贝丝会死掉
sense_groups.english: Beth...? Beth dies?

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的吗 如果我读下去 贝丝会死掉
sense_groups.english: Is that true? If I keep reading, is Beth gonna die?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 贝丝不会死 她不会死 对吧 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: No, Beth doesn't die. She doesn't die. Does she, Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 乔伊在问你是不是毁了…
sense_groups.english: What? - Joey's asking if you've just ruined...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是由杰克•尼克逊主演 他喜爱的第一本小说
sense_groups.english: ...the first book he's ever loved that didn't star Jack Nicholson.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她不会死
sense_groups.english: No. She doesn't die.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么要那么说
sense_groups.english: Then why would you say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我想伤害你
sense_groups.english: Because I wanted to hurt you.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 在这里 我的钥匙掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, there they are. I dropped my keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 找到了
sense_groups.english: Got them.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: Sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天过得超糟的
sense_groups.english: You would not believe my day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我值了两班 最糟的是…
sense_groups.english: I had to work two shifts. And then to top it off...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在烤束西时 连一边的假胸部都烤掉了
sense_groups.english: ...I lost one of my fake boobs in a grill fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在笑什么
sense_groups.english: What are you smiling at?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我只是在想 你今天还可以更好
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I was just thinking your day could still pick up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超爱这种朋友关系的
sense_groups.english: I love this friend thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 听好 罗伯很快就会到了…
sense_groups.english: Listen, Robert's gonna be here any second...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其中一人可以跟他说吗
sense_groups.english: ...so could one of you just tell him?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 现在就得说
sense_groups.english: Please, right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我每次看到他都会担心 "是不是又松了在盯着我瞧吗"
sense_groups.english: No, every time I see him, it's like, "Is it on the loose? Is it watching me?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能跟他说
sense_groups.english: We can't tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可以随便跟不太熟的人聊他的…
sense_groups.english: You can't go up to a guy you barely know and talk about his...

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝
sense_groups.english: ...stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 即使是赞美也一样
sense_groups.english: He's right. Even if it's to say something complimentary.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备去健身房了吗
sense_groups.english: So you ready for the gym?

sense_groups.chinese: 里面有新的攀岩墙 我们可以互相观照
sense_groups.english: They've got this new rock-climbing wall. We can spot each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里就可以观照你了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I can spot you from here.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听好了 罗伯…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Listen, ahem, Robert...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我们不是要… - 对 我们得去…
sense_groups.english: Hey, don't we have to? - Yeah, we got... Yeah. Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你人真的很好
sense_groups.english: I think you're really, really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 又来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Here we go again.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么这一直发生在我身上 是因为我表现出什么吗
sense_groups.english: Why does this keep happening to me? Is it something I'm putting out there?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的错吗 还是我有病
sense_groups.english: Is this my fault? Or am I just nuts?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 这里是老少咸宜的咖啡厅 把老鼠关回去
sense_groups.english: Hey, buddy? This is a family place. Put the mouse back in the house.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 就像其他人的公寓一样
sense_groups.english: Really? Well, it's just like everyone else's apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 有房间 有墙和天花板
sense_groups.english: It's got, uh, rooms and walls and ceilings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想看看你住的地方 带我看看吧
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to see where you live. Now give me the tour.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是客厅 - 很棒
sense_groups.english: Uh, this is the living room. - That's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 厨房在这里 - 很漂亮
sense_groups.english: And this is the kitchen. - That's real pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我不能看卧室吗
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Don't I get to see the bedroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 卧室 喔 就是很普通的…
sense_groups.english: The bedroom. Well, it's pretty much your typical...

sense_groups.chinese: 卧室
sense_groups.english: ...bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还在门的另一边
sense_groups.english: We're still on this side of the door. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没看到
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I didn't get to see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 真该死 或许下次再看吧 今晚很愉快
sense_groups.english: Oh, shoot. Maybe next time. Thanks for a lovely evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是谁
sense_groups.english: So, um, who is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是我跟你说的相亲
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha, ha. That was the blind date I told you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 她打来 改成今天
sense_groups.english: She called and switched it from Tuesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢她吗
sense_groups.english: Did you like her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是以朋友的身份问 因为我完全不介意
sense_groups.english: And I'm just asking as a friend because I am totally fine with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你似乎是不介意
sense_groups.english: Well, you seem fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我非常介意
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? I'm not fine. I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么可能不介意 听到你跟她回来
sense_groups.english: I mean, how could I be fine? Hearing you come in with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她想看你的卧房
sense_groups.english: She wants to see your bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以当…
sense_groups.english: What if we're friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 不跟其他人约会的朋友
sense_groups.english: ...who don't see other people?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说专属朋友吗
sense_groups.english: You mean like exclusive friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不行
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 过去这礼拜实在太棒了
sense_groups.english: I mean, this has been the most amazing week.

sense_groups.chinese: 有那么糟糕吗
sense_groups.english: Would it be so terrible?

sense_groups.chinese: 即使我们是住在一起的朋友
sense_groups.english: Even if we were friends who lived together?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是站在其他朋友面前的朋友…
sense_groups.english: Or maybe someday, friends who stood up in front of their other friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 发誓一辈子当朋友
sense_groups.english: ...and vowed to be friends forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们又回到原点了
sense_groups.english: You know, we're back where we were.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 那些我都想做 但是一切都没变
sense_groups.english: Honey, I would love to do all that, but nothing's changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 你没有胡子了
sense_groups.english: That's not true. You don't have a mustache.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 一件事情不同了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, one thing's changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们想要的东西还是不一样 我们都知道结果会如何
sense_groups.english: But we still want different things, and we know how this is gonna end.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在得离开了
sense_groups.english: I gotta walk out of here right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为忘记你是我做过最困难的事
sense_groups.english: Because getting over you is the hardest thing that I have ever had to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认为自己还能再来一次
sense_groups.english: Um, I don't think I could do it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我自己做不到
sense_groups.english: I know I couldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 打最后一场壁球如何
sense_groups.english: How about one last game of racquetball? Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 小心刺
sense_groups.english: Watch the thorns.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 贝丝病得很重
sense_groups.english: Beth is really, really sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔也在 但我不认为她有办法
sense_groups.english: Jo's there, but I don't think there's anything she can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 怎样
sense_groups.english: Joey? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想把书放在冷冻库吗
sense_groups.english: You wanna put the book in the freezer?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚又是莱丝莉打来 看可不可以复合
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was Leslie calling again to see if we can get back together.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天打了差不多二十次 祝你好运 莱丝莉
sense_groups.english: It's like the 20th time today. Yeah, good luck, Leslie.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定很伤你的心吧
sense_groups.english: Wow. She must've hurt you pretty bad, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我们以前是最要好的朋友…
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah. You know, we were best friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 小时候 我们两个人的妈妈都在驳船上工作
sense_groups.english: ...ever since we were little. Our moms worked on the barge together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个人在驳船上跑来跑去一定很可爱
sense_groups.english: You two must've been so cute running around on a barge.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝不能在驳船上跑步
sense_groups.english: You never run on a barge.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德在吗
sense_groups.english: Is, uh...? Is Chandler around?

sense_groups.chinese: 不在 他在咖啡厅认识了一个女生
sense_groups.english: No, um, he met some girl at the coffeehouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像叫做琴吉
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Ginger something.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 你确定不是 听起来像琴吉
sense_groups.english: No, no. Uh, are you sure it wasn't something that sounded liked Ginger?

sense_groups.chinese: 像是"琴吉尔"
sense_groups.english: Like, uh, "Gingeer"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是琴吉
sense_groups.english: No, it was Ginger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会记得是因为他告诉我时 我说…
sense_groups.english: I remember because when he told me, I said

sense_groups.chinese: 电影明星
sense_groups.english: The movie star.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我之前就是在躲那个女孩
sense_groups.english: That's the girl I was hiding from.

sense_groups.chinese: 她如果知道他是我室友 一定会跟他说我做了什么
sense_groups.english: When she finds out he's my roommate, she'll tell him what I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了什么 - 噢 不 我不能…
sense_groups.english: What did you do? - Oh. Oh, no, no. I can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说 那是我这辈子…
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you that. It's like the most awful, horrible thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 做过最糟糕的事 - 这样吧 不要跟我们说
sense_groups.english: ...I've ever done in my whole life. - You know what? Don't tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 等钱德回来再说 那样比较好玩
sense_groups.english: We'll wait till Chandler gets home because it'll be more fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 大概是四年前
sense_groups.english: Okay, it was, like, four years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 琴吉跟我约会了几次 有个周末…
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ginger and I had gone out a few times. Then one weekend...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去了她父亲的小屋…
sense_groups.english: ...we went to her dad's cabin...

sense_groups.chinese: 就我跟她和她烦人的小狗 胡椒
sense_groups.english: ...just me, her and her annoying little dog, Pepper. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一晚 我煮了一道很浪漫的晚赛…
sense_groups.english: Well, that night I cooked this really romantic dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在食物中下毒
sense_groups.english: You gave her food poisoning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还希望是如此
sense_groups.english: I wish. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐后 我 她和小狗都在炉火前睡着了
sense_groups.english: After dinner, me, her and Pepper all fell asleep in front of the fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在半夜醒来 看到火快没了
sense_groups.english: Well, I woke up in the middle of the night and I saw that the fire was dying out...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以捡了一块木头 丢进去
sense_groups.english: ...so I picked up a log and threw it on.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我以为那是块木头
sense_groups.english: Or at least what I thought was a log.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你把狗丢进去
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You threw Pepper on the fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望如此
sense_groups.english: I wish.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一件琴吉的事 我或许得告诉你们…
sense_groups.english: See, I guess another thing I probably should've told you about Ginger...

sense_groups.chinese: 她有…
sense_groups.english: ...is that she kind of has a, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 假肢
sense_groups.english: ...artificial leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你把她的脚丢到火里之后做了什么
sense_groups.english: Joey. What did you do after you threw her leg on the fire?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就跑了
sense_groups.english: I ran.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我有过最棒的吻…
sense_groups.english: Well, that's the best kiss I've had...

sense_groups.chinese: 至少跟在男厕认识的人是的
sense_groups.english: ...with anybody I met in a men's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 也是我最棒的吻
sense_groups.english: Actually, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚在水坑里 都弄湿了
sense_groups.english: Oh. Foot in a puddle. Foot all in the puddle.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我最讨厌这样了
sense_groups.english: Oh, damn. I hate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得让你脱掉鞋子
sense_groups.english: We're gonna have to get you out of those shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不用担心
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你会很冷 - 我不会
sense_groups.english: No, really. You're gonna freeze. - No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会你有生化电子脚吗
sense_groups.english: Huh. You're not? What do you got, a bionic foot?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许有一天会有吧
sense_groups.english: Someday. Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 书很好笑吗
sense_groups.english: Funny book?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我只是在想一件今天好笑的事
sense_groups.english: Hmm? Oh, no, no. I'm just thinking about something funny I heard today.

sense_groups.chinese: 马克说了"星期六见"
sense_groups.english: Um, Mark saying, "I'll see you Saturday."

sense_groups.chinese: 对 去听演讲
sense_groups.english: Yeah, at the lecture.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上个礼拜就跟你说了 你说你不介意
sense_groups.english: I told you that last week. You said you didn't mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不是 不是听演讲的关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. It's not the lecture, uh, I mind. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托不要说是因为我跟马克去的关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, please tell me it's not because I'm going with Mark.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯… - 天啊 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Well... - Oh, my God. Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 但是… 如果他不是你的同事了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sorry, but... Look, if you're not working with him anymore...

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么还要跟他出去
sense_groups.english: ...why do you still have to do stuff with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他是我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Because he's my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但你真的需要多一个朋友吗…
sense_groups.english: Okay. But do you really need another friend? I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果我停止跟乔伊和钱德玩耍 就可以跟马克玩吗
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, if I stop playing with Joey and Chandler, can I play with Mark?

sense_groups.chinese: 这很好笑吗 我应该笑吗
sense_groups.english: Is that funny? Am I suppose to be laughing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你也觉得 "星期六见"很好笑
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You thought "See you Saturday" was funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 马克是时尚业的人
sense_groups.english: Look, honey, Mark is in fashion, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢有共同兴趣的朋友
sense_groups.english: I like having a friend that I can share this stuff with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们永远不会跟我去听演讲的
sense_groups.english: You guys would never go to a lecture with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想跟你去
sense_groups.english: I would love to go with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我有衣服 我也会挑衣服
sense_groups.english: Hey, I have clothes. I even pick them out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也可以当个时尚…
sense_groups.english: I mean, for all you know, I could be a fashion...

sense_groups.chinese: 贩子
sense_groups.english: ...monger.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 亲爱的 我会很高兴你跟我去
sense_groups.english: Okay. Honey, I would love for you to go with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该穿什么 我开始紧张了
sense_groups.english: What should I wear? Now I'm all nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 有句话说 "有人看的锅子不会叫"
sense_groups.english: You know, they say, "A watched pot never beeps."

sense_groups.chinese: 只是… 已经两个小时了…
sense_groups.english: It's, you know, ahem... It's been a couple hours...

sense_groups.chinese: 她还没打来
sense_groups.english: ...and she hasn't called.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不是说我介意 我一点都不
sense_groups.english: Not that I even care. I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你为什么不直接打给她
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, why don't you just call her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你很明显想要打
sense_groups.english: You obviously want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为你很了解我
sense_groups.english: You think you know me so well.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想打吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Well, don't you wanna? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 所以我很了解你 - 我就是那样说啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I do know you. - That's what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么呢 - 我做不到
sense_groups.english: Well, so? - I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 做不到 她甩了我
sense_groups.english: I can't. She dumped me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我超相信她的 然后突然有一天…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I totally trusted her, and then one day it was like

sense_groups.chinese: "好 再见了 菲比" 就这样走了
sense_groups.english: "Okay, bye, Pheebs." Gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道最难过的部分是什么吗 我们一起弹奏的时光…
sense_groups.english: You know what the saddest part is? When we were playing together...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我最棒的时光 这辈子最棒的
sense_groups.english: ...that was like the most fun I've ever had in, like, all my lives.

sense_groups.chinese: # 我最爱的鞋子对我真好 我每天都穿它 #
sense_groups.english: # My favorite shoes So good to me, I wear them every day #

sense_groups.chinese: # 就算鞋子磨破 我也不在乎 #
sense_groups.english: # Down at the heel, holes in the toes Don't care what people say #

sense_groups.chinese: # 我双脚最要好的朋友 #
sense_groups.english: # My feet's best friend Pals to the end #

sense_groups.chinese: # 穿上它显得我很辣 #
sense_groups.english: # With them, I'm one hot chickie #

sense_groups.chinese: # 但是有一晚 天不是很亮 #
sense_groups.english: # Though late one night Not much light #

sense_groups.chinese: # 我踩到黏黏的东西 #
sense_groups.english: # I stepped in something icky #

sense_groups.chinese: # 黏黏鞋 黏黏鞋 #
sense_groups.english: # Sticky shoes, sticky shoes #

sense_groups.chinese: # 总是让我微笑 #
sense_groups.english: # Always make me smile #

sense_groups.chinese: # 黏黏鞋 黏黏鞋 下次我会 #
sense_groups.english: # Sticky shoes, sticky shoes Next time I'll #

sense_groups.chinese: # 避开 #
sense_groups.english: # Avoid the #
# Pile #

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始看到很多纱布和颜色层层搭配
sense_groups.english: We're beginning to see a lot of layering of sheer fabrics and colors.

sense_groups.chinese: 举例说明 透明的海蓝色上衣搭在粉红色的…
sense_groups.english: For instance, a sheer navy blouse over a pink...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴我们来了
sense_groups.english: I'm really glad we came.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好漂亮
sense_groups.english: You're so pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: # 臭猫 臭猫 #
sense_groups.english: # Smelly cat, smelly cat #

sense_groups.chinese: # 他们喂你吃了什么 #
sense_groups.english: # What are they feeding you? #

sense_groups.chinese: # 臭猫 臭猫 #
sense_groups.english: # Smelly cat, smelly cat #

sense_groups.chinese: # 这不是你的错 #
sense_groups.english: # It's not your fault #

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 实在太棒了
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 - 这可以大卖的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - You know, you could totally sell this.

sense_groups.chinese: 很适合做猫砂广告
sense_groups.english: It'd be perfect for, like, um, a kitty-litter campaign.

sense_groups.chinese: 广告歌 不要
sense_groups.english: A jingle? No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 你可以赚很多钱
sense_groups.english: Why not? You make a ton of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是为了钱 我现在早就是百万富翁了
sense_groups.english: Okay, if I was in this for the money, I'd be a millionaire by now, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能再想广告歌曲的事了
sense_groups.english: You gotta get out of that jingle-head, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Ugh. You're right. You're right. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 - 好
sense_groups.english: That's okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 现在我要弹奏一首很难过的歌
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm gonna play a song now that's really, really sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 歌名叫做"搞混的魔术师盒子"
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay, it's called "Magician Box Mix-Up."

sense_groups.chinese: 超大的手镯 超大的耳环…
sense_groups.english: Oversized bracelets, oversized earrings...

sense_groups.chinese: 总之只要是超大的饰品 现在都很流行
sense_groups.english: ...oversizing of accessories in general is very popular now.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个可以借我吗 我的牛奶坏掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, can I borrow this? My milk's gone bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最讨厌那样了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I hate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有次喝了低脂的 偷了我的车
sense_groups.english: I once had a thing of half-and-half. Stole my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和琴吉的约会如何
sense_groups.english: So how was your date with Ginger?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 很棒 她很…
sense_groups.english: Great. Ahem. It was great. She's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 她很棒 个性很好 很漂亮 就是很棒
sense_groups.english: She's great. Great looking, great personality. She's greatness.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来她…
sense_groups.english: Sounds like she's got the, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 整个人都很好
sense_groups.english: ...whole package.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊跟你说脚的事情了
sense_groups.english: Joey told you about the leg, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我吓死了 我知道不该这样 但没办法
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. It freaked me out. Okay? I know it shouldn't have, but it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想停止见她 但偶尔会变成…
sense_groups.english: I like her. I don't wanna stop seeing her, but every so often, it's like

sense_groups.chinese: "嘿 你的脚呢"
sense_groups.english: "Hey, you know what? Where's your leg?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我是世上心胸最狭窄的人 对吧
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm the smallest person in the world, aren't I?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是世上心胸最狭窄的人
sense_groups.english: I'm the smallest person in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安
sense_groups.english: Morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实他才是心胸最狭窄的人
sense_groups.english: Actually, he's the smallest person in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 听过烧脚的事了 对吧
sense_groups.english: Heard about the leg-burning, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 有提到
sense_groups.english: It came up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道机会不大 但是…
sense_groups.english: Ahem, listen, I, uh... I know it's a long shot, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 她有觉得还蛮好笑的吗
sense_groups.english: ...by any chance, did she find that funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是打盹了一下
sense_groups.english: So I nodded off a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 打盹 罗斯 你还打呼
sense_groups.english: "Nodded off"? Ross, you were snoring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸的船撞到岩石时都没发出那么大的声响
sense_groups.english: My father's boat didn't make that much noise when it hit rocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 四十五分钟耶
sense_groups.english: Come on. Forty-five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个人花了四十五分钟讲有背带的裙子
sense_groups.english: Forty-five minutes, the man talked about strappy-backed dresses.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 如果是在超冷的会堂里花四个小时…
sense_groups.english: Well, okay, how about four hours in a freezing museum auditorium...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着皮蛋教授说…
sense_groups.english: ...listening to Professor Pitstains and his

sense_groups.chinese: "嘿 各位 还记得那个死了几千万年的东西吗
sense_groups.english: "Hey, everybody. Remember that thing that's been dead for a gazillion years?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不知道他有这根骨头"
sense_groups.english: Well, here's a little bone we didn't know it had."

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 他是皮坦教授
sense_groups.english: First of all, it's Professor Pitain.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来 那一小根骨头证明了…
sense_groups.english: And second of all, that little bone proved that...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个恐龙有翅膀 但不会飞
sense_groups.english: ...that particular dinosaur had wings but didn't fly.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你知道我刚刚听到什么吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what I just heard?

sense_groups.chinese: 几百万人会去戏院看我研究的东西
sense_groups.english: You know what? A hundred million people went to see a movie about what I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想会有多少人去看 叫做"侏罗纪大衣"的电影
sense_groups.english: I wonder how many people would go see a movie called Jurassic Parka.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 这实在太…
sense_groups.english: Oh, that is so...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 一堆失控的大衣…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. A bunch of out-of-control jackets...

sense_groups.chinese: 占领了小岛
sense_groups.english: ...take over an island.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我的工作这么无趣…
sense_groups.english: You know, if what I do is so lame...

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么还坚持要跟我去
sense_groups.english: ...then why did you insist on coming with me this morning?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是好让我不能跟马克去吗
sense_groups.english: Huh? Was it so I just wouldn't go with Mark?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…我想跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: I... I wanted to be with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我觉得最近…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I feel like lately...

sense_groups.chinese: 你离我越来越远…
sense_groups.english: I feel like you're slipping away from me...

sense_groups.chinese: 有新工作 新朋友
sense_groups.english: ...with this new job and all these new people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有全新的生活
sense_groups.english: And you've got this whole other life going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很蠢…
sense_groups.english: I know it's dumb...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不喜欢自己不是你那个生活的一部分
sense_groups.english: ...but I just hate that I'm not a part of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不蠢
sense_groups.english: It's not dumb.

sense_groups.chinese: 但或许你不是其中一部分也没有关系
sense_groups.english: But maybe it's okay that you're not a part of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你懂吗
sense_groups.english: You know what I mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们该来看看的 - 我们一定到

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 到时候见

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 摇吧

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我准备了北非小米
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I've got couscous.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 抱歉 我知道今天是我们的周年纪念日
sense_groups.english: Honey. Honey, I'm sorry. I know it's our anniversary...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在电话里说过我没时间停下来
sense_groups.english: ...but I told you on the phone I don't have time to stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你不必停下来 我是隐形人 就当我不在这里
sense_groups.english: Okay, you don't have to stop. I'm invisible. I'm not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 可是我…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁批准那笔订单的
sense_groups.english: Who approved that order?

sense_groups.chinese: 但我没有同事叫做马克•罗宾森
sense_groups.english: Well, there is no Mark Robinson in this office.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我打电话给马克 - 我爱马克 你认识马克吗
sense_groups.english: Get me Mark on the phone. - Ugh. I love Mark. Do you know Mark?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 我得查一下手边的资料
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Let me check that with what I've got here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 038不是本店代码 038是亚特兰大的代码
sense_groups.english: All right, see, 038 is not the number for this store. Zero-three-eight is Atlanta.

sense_groups.chinese: 要胡椒吗
sense_groups.english: Heh. Pepper?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要 - 好吧 抱歉
sense_groups.english: None for me. - Okay, sorry. Whoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我说过分店代码错了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. As I was saying, the store number is wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 可是…天啊
sense_groups.english: And I'm sorry, but... Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 没事了
sense_groups.english: Okay. It's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我再回你电话
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, I'm sorry, I'm gonna have to call you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的办公室来了一个疯子
sense_groups.english: I've got Shemp in my office.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人挂掉电话了
sense_groups.english: But, um, hey, oh, somebody's off the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要在火边来杯酒 我可以再生一次火
sense_groups.english: How about a glass of wine by the fire? I can get it going again...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你没在听 我没时间停下来
sense_groups.english: Ross, you're not listening. I don't have time to stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你连十分钟都没有 - 我没有十分钟
sense_groups.english: Come on, you don't have 10 minutes? - I don't have 10 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲 她没有十分钟吗 - 罗斯 我说过我没有时间
sense_groups.english: Sophie, does she have 10 minutes? - Hey, Ross. I told you, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 别对我大叫 好吗 这是整个星期我们见面最久的一次
sense_groups.english: Don't yell at me, okay? This is the most I've seen you all week.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 现在我没空跟你说 我得在时限内完成工作
sense_groups.english: Look, I cannot do this right now, okay? I've got a deadline.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能回家吗 我们晚点再谈
sense_groups.english: Would you just go home? I'll talk to you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 等一下 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but wait... - Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我们的打洞机
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, that's our three-hole punch.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 之前发生的事
sense_groups.english: Look, um, about what happened earlier...

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全了解 你压力很大
sense_groups.english: Whoa. I completely understand. You were stressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会给你机会跟我道歉
sense_groups.english: I was gonna give you a chance to apologize to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 因为我让你在你的办公室对我发脾气
sense_groups.english: For what? For letting you throw me out of your office?

sense_groups.chinese: 你无权跑到我的办公室 罗斯
sense_groups.english: You had no right coming down to my office, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能带着野餐篮跑到别人的办公室
sense_groups.english: You do not bring a picnic basket to somebody's work...

sense_groups.chinese: 除非他们是公园巡警
sense_groups.english: ...unless maybe they were a park ranger.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 请原谅我想跟女朋友一起庆祝我们的周年纪念日
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, excuse me for wanting to be with my girlfriend on our anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我真是个大混蛋
sense_groups.english: Boy, what an ass am I.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我说过我没时间
sense_groups.english: But I told you I didn't have the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你总是没时间
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, you never have the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我觉得我不像有女朋友了 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I mean, I don't feel like I have a girlfriend anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你要我怎么做
sense_groups.english: Ross, what do you want from me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我辞掉工作 让你觉得你有女朋友
sense_groups.english: You want me to quit my job so you can feel like you have a girlfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 或许那是个好点子 你得了解那只是一份工作
sense_groups.english: No. But it would nice if you'd realize that it's just a job.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一份工作
sense_groups.english: Just a job?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你知道这是我一生中第一次我在做我在乎的事吗
sense_groups.english: Ross, do you realize this is the first time in my life I'm doing something I care about?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我一生中第一次在做我拿手的事吗
sense_groups.english: This is the first time in my life I'm doing something I'm actually good at?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你无法了解
sense_groups.english: I mean, if you don't get that...

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 好吗 我了解 也为你感到开心
sense_groups.english: No, hey, I get that. Okay? I get that and I'm happy for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我厌倦了跟你的答录机谈恋爱
sense_groups.english: I'm tired of having a relationship with your answering machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再那么做了 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to do anymore. - Well, neither do I.

sense_groups.chinese: 这跟马克有关吗
sense_groups.english: Is this about Mark?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 好吧 跟他无关
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Okay, it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法老是跟你吵这件事 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I cannot keep having this same fight over and over again, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你让我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: No, you're making this too hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你不知道该怎么办 好 你要我怎么做
sense_groups.english: I'm making this too hard? What do you want me to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 或许我们该休息一下
sense_groups.english: Look, ugh, maybe we should just take a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. Fine. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们休息一下 让自己冷静下来
sense_groups.english: Let's, uh... Let's take a break. Let's cool off, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去吃冷冻优格吧
sense_groups.english: Let's get some frozen yogurt or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该分手了
sense_groups.english: A break from us.

sense_groups.chinese: 过去五年来 装订有了很大的进步
sense_groups.english: And the advances in collating in the past five years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚刚买了一部X5000
sense_groups.english: I mean, we just got in an X-5000, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: X5000让X50看起来像T71
sense_groups.english: The X-5000 makes an X-50 look like a T-71.

sense_groups.chinese: 恐龙先生来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's the dinosaur guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗斯 - 可洛
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ross. - Oh, hi, Chloe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你介绍一下我的朋友
sense_groups.english: I want you to meet some friends of mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙是我的英雄 他会拿着资料过来
sense_groups.english: This guy's my hero. He comes in with some stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 要我们放大四倍
sense_groups.english: ...he wants it blown up 400 percent.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说我们办不到 他说你们非得这么做不可
sense_groups.english: We say we don't do that. He says, "You gotta."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗 我们办到了
sense_groups.english: And you know what? We did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在有人要放大资料四倍 我们都会说我们得学罗斯精神
sense_groups.english: And now any time anybody wants 400, we just say, "Let's Ross it."

sense_groups.chinese: 那是唯一合理的地方
sense_groups.english: And that's the only color that comes in.

sense_groups.chinese: 可洛 你有铜板借我投保险套贩卖机吗
sense_groups.english: Yo, Chloe. Do you have a quarter for the condom machine?

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么
sense_groups.english: So, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为今晚你们要去吃晚餐庆祝周年纪念日
sense_groups.english: I thought tonight was your big anniversary dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 计划有变
sense_groups.english: Yeah, a little change of plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们决定分手
sense_groups.english: Uh, we're gonna break up instead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说一点法文
sense_groups.english: Oh, and I can also speak a little French.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我说了什么
sense_groups.english: Why? What did I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 你问我今晚要不要跟你上床
sense_groups.english: Well, you just asked if I wanted to go to bed with you tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪我在墨利斯咖啡厅得到超棒的服务
sense_groups.english: No wonder I get such great service at Cafe Maurice.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Knock, knock, knock.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能告诉赛吉我很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Hi. Um, could you please tell Sergei that, um, I was fascinated...

sense_groups.chinese: 布特罗斯•盖里在"纽约时报"发表的言论吗
sense_groups.english: ...by what Boutros Boutros-Ghali said in the New York Times?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没提到布特罗斯•盖里
sense_groups.english: You didn't say, "Boutros Boutros-Ghali."

sense_groups.chinese: 布特罗斯•盖里
sense_groups.english: Boutros Boutros-Ghali.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他也是
sense_groups.english: He says he was too.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有趣
sense_groups.english: Interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还蛮好奇的
sense_groups.english: Uh, so I was wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 在你们又聊起来之前
sense_groups.english: Before you get all talky again...

sense_groups.chinese: 你能告诉赛吉
sense_groups.english: ...um, could you also please tell Sergei...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢他的西装吗
sense_groups.english: ...that I really like his suit.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说谢谢 今晚你也很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Uh, he said, "Thank you very much. You look very pretty tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的头发跟阳光一样闪亮 你是厨师吗
sense_groups.english: Your hair, golden like the sun." So you're a chef?

sense_groups.chinese: 我考虑自己开家餐厅
sense_groups.english: I'm also thinking of opening up my own restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? - Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能在菜单后面谈一谈吗
sense_groups.english: ...could I talk to you behind my menu, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 我在聊天
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Well, I was having a conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 但米夏对你非常有兴趣
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but Mischa's so interested in you...

sense_groups.chinese: 赛吉跟我却没办法说话
sense_groups.english: ...that Sergei and I haven't been able to say two words to each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我呆呆地坐在这里听你们三个聊天
sense_groups.english: What do you want me to do? Sit here while the three of you have a conversation?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就真的太棒了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: That would be great. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 嗨 我是马克
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Oh, hi. It's Mark.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 我有口臭吗
sense_groups.english: What? Is it my breath?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 抱歉 我以为你是别人 嗨…
sense_groups.english: No. Sorry. I just thought you were somebody else. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 听着 我正要留话给你
sense_groups.english: Hi, well, look, I was just gonna leave a message.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚不是你的周年纪念日晚餐吗
sense_groups.english: Isn't tonight your anniversary dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Rach? Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要聊一聊吗 我可以过去
sense_groups.english: You wanna talk? I mean, I can come over.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真的 拜托 没事的
sense_groups.english: No, really, no. Please. That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我立刻过去 我会带中国菜过去
sense_groups.english: All right. I'm coming over and I'm bringing Chinese food.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不饿 - 是我要吃的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I'm not hungry. - It's for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么办 - 我能做什么
sense_groups.english: So, what'll you do? - What can I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 对方要分手 你只能接受
sense_groups.english: One person wants to break up, you break up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你们不一样 打电话跟她谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Hey, no way. Come on, this is you guys. Call her and work it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 我们刚刚大吵一架 我不能等一下再打吗
sense_groups.english: Come on. We just had this huge fight. Don't I have to wait a while?

sense_groups.chinese: 这又不是吃完饭后不能游泳 快去打电话
sense_groups.english: Hey, this isn't like swimming after you eat. Pick up your phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃完东西后不能游泳是个迷
sense_groups.english: You know that whole swimming thing is a myth.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 跟我的蓝尼叔叔说吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, tell that to my Uncle Lenny.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 他怎么了
sense_groups.english: Why? What happened to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 他只是相信那套说法
sense_groups.english: Nothing. He just really believes in that.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们愚蠢地大吵一架 这真的很可怕
sense_groups.english: Ugh. And then we got into this big, stupid fight... It was awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他说他把我当成公园巡警
sense_groups.english: I told him he treats me like a park ranger, something, ugh...

sense_groups.chinese: 后来…
sense_groups.english: And then...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他说我要分手
sense_groups.english: ...I told him I wanted to take a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想分手
sense_groups.english: I don't want to take a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 春卷 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Egg roll? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我打电话给他 他不在
sense_groups.english: And then I called him, and he wasn't there.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他只是出去了
sense_groups.english: He's probably just out.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那真的帮了我一个大忙 我很高兴你来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. That's very helpful. I'm glad you came over.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 嗨 是我
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Hi, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好高兴你打电话来 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Hi. Oh, I'm so glad you called. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想这真的很疯狂 你不觉得我们能解决这个问题吗
sense_groups.english: I've been thinking this is crazy. Don't you think we can work on this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要喝什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, what do you want to drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁在说话
sense_groups.english: Who's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啊
sense_groups.english: Nobody?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以喝完苹果汁吗
sense_groups.english: Is it okay if I finish the apple juice?

sense_groups.chinese: 是 马克吗
sense_groups.english: Is that Mark?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 听着 他刚好过来 - 对 我明白了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, honey, look, he just came over... - Yeah, got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 恐龙先生 看看你 你一副苦瓜脸的模样
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dinosaur Guy. Look at you, so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 来跳舞吧 - 我不要 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Come dance. - Uh, that's okay. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必笑 你只要跳舞
sense_groups.english: You don't have to smile. You just have to dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我不想跳舞 我想喝一杯 好吗
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't feel like dancing. I feel like having a drink, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 两杯啤酒
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Hey, two beers.

sense_groups.chinese: 兽医说时间到了
sense_groups.english: And the vet said it was time.

sense_groups.chinese: 在地球的另一端
sense_groups.english: And so from half-a-world away...

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈将话筒放在他的耳边
sense_groups.english: ...while my mother held the phone to his ear...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟我的狗道别
sense_groups.english: ...I said goodbye to my dog...

sense_groups.chinese: 使用七种语言
sense_groups.english: ...in seven languages.

sense_groups.chinese: 能给我面纸吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Could I have a tissue? - Oh, yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你不会意外地把它塞进鼻孔里
sense_groups.english: I just hope you don't accidentally suck it up through your nose...

sense_groups.chinese: 害自己窒息死掉
sense_groups.english: ...and choke on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 赛吉要为我今晚的行为道歉
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Sergei would like to apologize for my behavior tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他说我接受他的致歉
sense_groups.english: Well, tell him, "Apology accepted."

sense_groups.chinese: 他太不可思议了 三年来第一次有人要跟我说话
sense_groups.english: He's unbelievable. For the first time in three years, someone wants to talk to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他会让我享受一下吗 不
sense_groups.english: But do you think he would let me enjoy that? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个笨外交官 为什么他不学英文 赛吉
sense_groups.english: You silly diplomat. Why don't you learn some English, Sergei?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 他不是帮你付晚餐钱吗
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, but, um, ahem, isn't he paying for your dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 他的狗才死不久
sense_groups.english: Hey, the man's dog just died.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚辞职了
sense_groups.english: I have just resigned my post.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能陪我到彩虹室吗
sense_groups.english: Would you care to accompany me to the Rainbow Room?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有外交官折价券
sense_groups.english: I have diplomatic coupons.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的荣幸
sense_groups.english: It would be my pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的男伴有折价券
sense_groups.english: My guy has coupons.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的男伴连折价券都不会说
sense_groups.english: Your guy can't even say "coupons."

sense_groups.chinese: 盘子
sense_groups.english: Uh, plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 盘子 对 - 盘子
sense_groups.english: Plate. Yes. Plate. Plate. - Plate. Plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 盘子
sense_groups.english: Plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我们不需要他们
sense_groups.english: See, we don't need them.

sense_groups.chinese: 盘子
sense_groups.english: Plate?
