sense_groups.english: It'll be great for next weekend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 真的很棒喔
sense_groups.english: I mean, "lt'll be great."

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们受邀去滑雪 去瑞秋妹妹的小屋
sense_groups.english: We're, um, sort of invited to go skiing. You know, Rachel's sister's cabin?

sense_groups.chinese: 要去整个周末
sense_groups.english: So, for the whole weekend?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉 不过是她先问的
sense_groups.english: We're really sorry, but she did ask us first.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我失恋的第一个周末…
sense_groups.english: That's okay. If you all have to go away...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都要出城去…
sense_groups.english: ...for the first weekend I'm alone by myself...

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全可以理解
sense_groups.english: ...then I totally understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以留下来 我留下来
sense_groups.english: I can stay. I'm gonna stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上次去滑雪时 根本不敢跳下吊车
sense_groups.english: The last time I went, I was afraid to leave the chair lift.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样坐来坐去
sense_groups.english: I just went round and round.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你需要开你奶奶的车载大家去
sense_groups.english: We need you to drive us there in your grandmother's cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我会留下来 - 不 我留下来 他是我哥耶
sense_groups.english: But you know what? I'll stay. - No, I'll stay. He's my brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛 同情我吗 - 没有
sense_groups.english: What, a "pity stay"? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会玩得很开心的
sense_groups.english: We're gonna have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以做牛奶软糖
sense_groups.english: We can make fudge.

sense_groups.chinese: 同情食物
sense_groups.english: Pity food?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我不需要你们任何人留下来
sense_groups.english: You know what? I don't need any of you to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人该留下来
sense_groups.english: Nobody stays.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那么我也表示一下好了
sense_groups.english: Well, then I might as well offer to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人替罗斯难过吗
sense_groups.english: Does anybody else feel bad about Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他还在生我们的气吗
sense_groups.english: You think he's still mad?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能更生气了 因为你今天早上还跟他借雪镜
sense_groups.english: He's probably more mad since you called him to borrow his goggles.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样 我的没有反光层啊
sense_groups.english: What? Mine aren't tinted.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 标志上写什么
sense_groups.english: What does the sign say?

sense_groups.chinese: "照耀我 耶稣"
sense_groups.english: "Beam me up, Jesus."

sense_groups.chinese: 是"禁止吸烟"那个标志
sense_groups.english: The "No Smoking" sign.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我奶奶的车里不能抽烟
sense_groups.english: There's no smoking in my grandmother's cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那么我得去厕所
sense_groups.english: Well, then I have to go to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 不可以随便停车 加油的时候你再去
sense_groups.english: No unscheduled stops. You can go when we stop for gas.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 前面就有一个休息站 我真的得去
sense_groups.english: There's a rest stop right up there. Come on, I really have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 现在我也得去了
sense_groups.english: Oh, now I have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 抓好了 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Brace yourself. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去吗 - 不用了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Aren't you gonna go? - No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋不上公共厕所的
sense_groups.english: Rachel never pees in public restrooms.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们老是没有卫生纸
sense_groups.english: They never have any paper in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我的规则是 没有卫生纸 就不去厕所
sense_groups.english: So my rule is, "No tissue, no tushy."

sense_groups.chinese: 既然大家都要去…
sense_groups.english: Well, if everybody's going...

sense_groups.chinese: 不要关门 钥匙在里面
sense_groups.english: Don't close it. The keys are in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 千万不要
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 我的打火机在里面
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - My lighter's in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 排气管不够热 不能点烟
sense_groups.english: Damn. The tailpipe's not hot enough to light this.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我可以打开 有人有衣架吗
sense_groups.english: I can open this. Anybody got a coat hanger?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有
sense_groups.english: Oh, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不对 我今早穿衣服时 把衣架拿出来了
sense_groups.english: No, I took it out of my shirt when I put it on this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你父母亲如果没有离婚的话
sense_groups.english: So if your parents hadn't divorced...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就有办法跟正常人一样回答问题吗
sense_groups.english: ...you'd be able to answer a question like a normal person?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是需要金属线把它撬开
sense_groups.english: Look, I just need a wire something to jimmy it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其中一个人把胸罩的钢圈给我
sense_groups.english: One of you give me your bra underwire.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 谁的胸部最大
sense_groups.english: Come on. Who has the biggest boobs?

sense_groups.chinese: 胸部最大的人胸罩最大 钢圈也最长
sense_groups.english: Whoever has the biggest boobs, has the biggest bra and wire.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不要 - 胸罩很贵
sense_groups.english: No. - It's too expensive.

sense_groups.chinese: 要回车里 就需要钢圈
sense_groups.english: To get back in the car, we need that wire.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们自己做决定
sense_groups.english: Your call.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 摩妮卡的最大
sense_groups.english: Monica's are the biggest.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些小红豆 拜托 瑞秋的最大
sense_groups.english: These tiny little non-breasts? Please. It's gotta be Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 我的是骗人的
sense_groups.english: No, mine are deceptively small.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有时候会在胸罩上塞东西
sense_groups.english: I mean, I actually sometimes stuff my bra.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是你的胸罩还是一样很大
sense_groups.english: Well, then your bra would still be big.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 我是塞在胸罩外面
sense_groups.english: No, I stuff outside the bra.

sense_groups.chinese: 女士们 你们就让步吧
sense_groups.english: Ladies, let's just compromise, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 瑞秋 把摩妮卡的胸罩脱掉
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, Rachel, take off Monica's bra.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 算了
sense_groups.english: All right, forget it, never mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 用我的 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You can have mine. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你在干嘛 那里就有一个垃圾筒
sense_groups.english: Chandler. What are you doing? There's a trash can right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说只要乱丢垃圾 就可以引来那个印第安人来救我们
sense_groups.english: I thought if I littered, that crying Indian might come by and save us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: There.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 菲比 你真大方
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Phoebe. That's very, very generous.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在来讨论 谁的屁股最正
sense_groups.english: Now, let's decide who has the nicest ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 开了
sense_groups.english: And there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少让我吸烟爽一下
sense_groups.english: Well, at least let me smoke it to the good part.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这以前有发生过
sense_groups.english: Yeah, this has happened before.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你知道该怎么办 - 对 加多点油
sense_groups.english: So you know how to fix it? - Yep. Put more gas in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你怎么会来了
sense_groups.english: Hi. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在想… 我们分开的时候
sense_groups.english: I was wondering, when you and I split up...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是拿了录了"风流医生俏护士"最后一集
sense_groups.english: ...did you get the tape that was half the last episode of M.A.S. H...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟人质回国新闻的那卷带子
sense_groups.english: ...and half the hostages coming home?

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在是我和苏珊游墨西哥 跟人质回国的新闻
sense_groups.english: But now it's Susan and me in Mexico and the hostages coming home.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班呢
sense_groups.english: Where's Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在睡觉
sense_groups.english: He's sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来得不是时候吗
sense_groups.english: Is this a bad time?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 苏珊很快就会到了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, actually. Susan's gonna be here any minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天是个纪念日
sense_groups.english: It's kind of an anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是一月结婚的吗
sense_groups.english: I thought you guys got married in January.

sense_groups.chinese: 是另一个纪念日
sense_groups.english: A different kind of anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 蜡烛 香槟…
sense_groups.english: Candles, champagne...

sense_groups.chinese: 纪念日最棒了…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, anniversaries are great...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为爱会流传永世…
sense_groups.english: ...because love lasts forever, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么比爱情可靠
sense_groups.english: There's nothing like it in this life. Money in the bank.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋和我分手了
sense_groups.english: So Rachel and I broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 罗斯 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: God, Ross, I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想陪你聊一聊…
sense_groups.english: I wanna talk about this so much...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是要找个能长谈的时间
sense_groups.english: ...but when we can really get into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天晚餐怎么样 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: You free for dinner tomorrow? - I'd love that.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都是因为瑞秋找到新工作
sense_groups.english: I guess it all started when Rachel got this new job.

sense_groups.chinese: 汽车协会可以来载我们
sense_groups.english: Triple A can pick us up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们靠近哪个城镇
sense_groups.english: What town are we near?

sense_groups.chinese: 佛里蒙特 - 威斯蒙特
sense_groups.english: Freemont. Westmont.

sense_groups.chinese: 威斯伯格
sense_groups.english: Uh, Westberg?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道就别回答
sense_groups.english: Why are you answering?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在哪条路上
sense_groups.english: Do you know what route we're on?

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对是27号公路
sense_groups.english: We are definitely on Route 27.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在27号公路的休息站
sense_groups.english: We are at a rest stop on Route 27...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有27号公路
sense_groups.english: There is no Route 27.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是93就是76 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Either 93 or 76. - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 每次来的时候我都在后座睡觉
sense_groups.english: I always slept in the back when we drove here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以派人到76号公路检查所有休息站吗
sense_groups.english: Can you just send someone up and down 76 and check every rest stop?

sense_groups.chinese: 93号也是
sense_groups.english: And also 93?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 他们不肯
sense_groups.english: No, they don't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 会有人来救我们的
sense_groups.english: Somebody will come and save us.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁啊 过去一个半小时 你有看到车子吗
sense_groups.english: Who? Have you seen a car in the last hour and a half?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该打给罗斯 或许他可以派辆车来
sense_groups.english: We should call Ross. Maybe he can get a car to get us.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我不要跟罗斯同车
sense_groups.english: I am not getting in a car with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只能…
sense_groups.english: We will just have to...

sense_groups.chinese: 住在这里
sense_groups.english: ...live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是好冷 - 不行
sense_groups.english: But it's so cold. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要坐他的车 想其他办法
sense_groups.english: I won't get in a car with him. Think of something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 乔伊和钱德回来了
sense_groups.english: Joey and Chandler are back.

sense_groups.chinese: 求救的情况如何
sense_groups.english: So the going-for-help went well?

sense_groups.chinese: 老烟枪走到一半就不行了
sense_groups.english: Smokey Joe here got halfway to the highway and collapsed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的肺活量跟两岁小孩一样
sense_groups.english: I have the lung capacity of a 2-year-old.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你干嘛还抽烟
sense_groups.english: Then why are you smoking?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很不安
sense_groups.english: It's very unsettling.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 真是太扯了
sense_groups.english: Right? I mean, it's pretty unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们就这样走了 头也不回的走
sense_groups.english: They just took off without even looking back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不需要他们 我有你们做我的朋友
sense_groups.english: I don't need them. I've got you guys now as friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和苏珊
sense_groups.english: You and Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊会很开心的
sense_groups.english: Susan will be so pleased.

sense_groups.chinese: 717在哪里
sense_groups.english: Where's 717?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有帮苏珊留一些 对吧
sense_groups.english: You have more of these for Susan, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但是没关系
sense_groups.english: No, but that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再放点酸黄瓜就行了
sense_groups.english: I'll just put out pickles or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 谢天谢地 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Ross, thank God. - Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么这么小声
sense_groups.english: Why are you whispering?

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃了一只虫
sense_groups.english: I ate a bug.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这里的棉条只要一毛钱
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. The tampons here are only a penny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们买回去囤积
sense_groups.english: Let's stock up.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们车子没油 也不知道身在何处 所以没办法找拖车
sense_groups.english: We're out of gas and don't know where we are, so we can't get a tow truck.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在需要帮忙啦 - 是的 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh. Now you want a favor? - Yes, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾你的车子不能动了…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry your car broke down, Pheebs...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我现在忙着跟我真正的朋友在一起
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm too busy with some of my real friends right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 但记得让我知道你们安全回到家…
sense_groups.english: But please call to let me know you got home safely.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 等等
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, hang on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 开我的车去接他们
sense_groups.english: Take my car. Get your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我才不要
sense_groups.english: No, I won't pick them up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都知道你会去的 因为你不是混蛋
sense_groups.english: We both know you'll do it because you're not a jerk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你顶多再骂半小时就会去接他们…
sense_groups.english: So you can sulk here for half an hour, then go get them...

sense_groups.chinese: 不如一边开车一边骂 - 不要 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: ...or save time and sulk in the car. - Rachel doesn't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾瑞秋为了马克甩掉你…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry Rachel dumped you for Mark...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是无辜的受害者
sense_groups.english: ...and you're the innocent victim in this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不能因为这样就迁怒你的朋友
sense_groups.english: But don't punish your friends for what Rachel did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 等等 罗斯有话要说
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, hang on. Ross wants to say something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 你跟其他人上床
sense_groups.english: What? You slept with someone else?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当时是分手状态
sense_groups.english: We were on a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们…嗯
sense_groups.english: We were... Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在哪 我去找你们
sense_groups.english: Where are you? I'll find you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟其他女人上床
sense_groups.english: You slept with another woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有资格说啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're one to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, done.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是"命救"
sense_groups.english: What's "pleh"?

sense_groups.chinese: 是救命反过来写…
sense_groups.english: That's "help" spelled backwards...

sense_groups.chinese: 直升机在天空飞的时候 才看得懂
sense_groups.english: ...so that the helicopters can read it from the air.

sense_groups.chinese: 蠢人 反过来写是什么
sense_groups.english: Ha. What's "dufus" spelled backwards?

sense_groups.chinese: 有车了
sense_groups.english: Car. Car.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 罗斯出来兜风了
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's Ross on one of his drives.

sense_groups.chinese: 他来这里干什么
sense_groups.english: What is he doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是来救你们大家一命的
sense_groups.english: He is saving your butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非我惹到某人…
sense_groups.english: Unless I'm stepping on some toes here...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我可以闪人
sense_groups.english: ...in which case, I could just mosey on.

sense_groups.chinese: 州际公路上有很多人需要帮助
sense_groups.english: I have plenty of people to help on the interstate.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 - 我们需要你的帮忙 拜托你
sense_groups.english: Come on. - We need your help, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦…
sense_groups.english: Fine. Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 完了 别人会看不懂
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Now it's not gonna make any sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位…
sense_groups.english: You guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯怎么办 他大老远开来这里
sense_groups.english: ...what do we do about Ross? He drove all the way up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫他回去 我们留在这里滑雪吗
sense_groups.english: Just send him back, then we'll go skiing?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是烦死了
sense_groups.english: This is horrible. It's just horrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我们是不是应该叫罗斯一起来
sense_groups.english: Should we ask Ross to come along?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是瑞秋怎么办 要怎么问她
sense_groups.english: But what about Rachel? How are we gonna even ask her?

sense_groups.chinese: 问我什么
sense_groups.english: Ask me what?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以让罗斯留下来滑雪吗
sense_groups.english: If, uh, it might be okay if Ross came skiing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有要问啊
sense_groups.english: No, I wasn't gonna ask that.

sense_groups.chinese: 实在太扯了 当然不行
sense_groups.english: You guys are unbelievable. No, he cannot come.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 烦死了
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - It's horrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我不能去你的神奇小屋吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, please? Can't I come to your special, magical cabin?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么会想要来呢 你滑雪糟透了
sense_groups.english: Why would you even want to come? You're a horrible skier.

sense_groups.chinese: 攻击我的痛处 滑雪技巧
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hitting me where it hurts. My ski skills.

sense_groups.chinese: 又来了
sense_groups.english: Here we go again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受不了了
sense_groups.english: I can't handle this, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 我的绰号是"受得了"
sense_groups.english: I can handle it. "Handle" is my middle name.

sense_groups.chinese: 去头去尾后 就是"受得了"
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's the middle part of my first name.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 你的车好了
sense_groups.english: All right, Pheebs, your cab's ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你是在跟我说话还是跟别人睡觉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Were you speaking to me, or sleeping with someone else?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当时是分手状态
sense_groups.english: We were on a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛不把那句话录在答录机上
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just put that on your answering machine?

sense_groups.chinese: 本来就是 我不是唯一一个同意的人
sense_groups.english: It's valid, and I'm not the only one who thinks so.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡也同意
sense_groups.english: Monica agrees with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你昨晚是这么说的
sense_groups.english: You said it last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我能了解
sense_groups.english: What I said was that I understood.

sense_groups.chinese: 是乔伊同意你说的话 - 好
sense_groups.english: Joey is the one who agreed with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Really, Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实没有谁对谁错
sense_groups.english: You know what? There is no right or wrong here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我认为错的人很明显
sense_groups.english: I think it's very obvious who's wrong here.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊很明显不这么认为
sense_groups.english: Obviously not to Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊和摩妮卡的想法跟我一样 - 你只会装无辜
sense_groups.english: Joey and Monica feel like I do. - You and this innocent act.

sense_groups.chinese: 猜猜我是谁
sense_groups.english: Hey, guess who I am?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们对钱德做了什么好事
sense_groups.english: Look what you're doing to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们都知道你们两个很难受
sense_groups.english: Look. We know that this is really, really hard for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不用彼此相爱
sense_groups.english: You don't have to love each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在甚至不用喜欢彼此
sense_groups.english: You don't even have to like each other much right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们必须想个办法和平相处
sense_groups.english: But please find a way to be around each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让我们左右为难
sense_groups.english: And not put us in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则我们以后就没办法在一起了
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, I mean, that's just it for us hanging out together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的想这样吗
sense_groups.english: Is that what you want?

sense_groups.chinese: 讲理一点好吗
sense_groups.english: Can you be civil?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 我可以
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 回车上去 快冷死了…
sense_groups.english: Good, let's get back in the car. It's freezing...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我的胸部没有东西支撑
sense_groups.english: ...and my chest is unsupported.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 那现在是怎样 谁跟谁一起走
sense_groups.english: I mean, what are we doing? Who's going with who?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你们去吧
sense_groups.english: Look, you guys should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都计划好了…
sense_groups.english: You know, you planned this all out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想毁了你们的周末 去吧
sense_groups.english: ...and I don't wanna ruin it. So just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你开了那么久的车过来
sense_groups.english: You drove all the way up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我车子也得开回去
sense_groups.english: I've gotta take the car back anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天一整天都得陪小班
sense_groups.english: I'm spending all day tomorrow with Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 去吧 不需要有罪恶感 真的
sense_groups.english: It's fine, okay? Just go. No guilt, I promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回去以后再打给你
sense_groups.english: We'll call you when we get back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以去看电影什么的
sense_groups.english: Maybe we can, like, go to a movie or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是马术表演
sense_groups.english: Or the rodeo.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太好了
sense_groups.english: That would be great. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚是在演"海神号遇险记"的 莎丽•温德丝
sense_groups.english: I was being Shelley Winters from The Poseidon Adventure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 对不起 我这么晚来
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Hi. Sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚在睡觉吗 -没有
sense_groups.english: Were you sleeping? - Uh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮你买电池 买了最好的那种
sense_groups.english: I had to get you a new battery. I got the best I could.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种东西不能省
sense_groups.english: You don't want to skimp there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太棒了
sense_groups.english: You're a genius.

sense_groups.chinese: 总共花了112块
sense_groups.english: It came to about $112.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过随便啦 给我110就好
sense_groups.english: But what the hell, call it an even 110?

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天再付钱给你 再见
sense_groups.english: I'll pay you tomorrow. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都走了
sense_groups.english: So they, uh, all took off.

sense_groups.chinese: 看他们离开还蛮难受的
sense_groups.english: It was pretty hard watching them go, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我走了
sense_groups.english: So I'm gonna take off then.

questions.name: S03E18
questions.en:
What's so funny?
Oh, nothing. It's an acting exercise. I'm practicing my fake laugh.
What? What's so funny?
Oh, no, no.
No, no. There's none of that in here.
Oh, come on. At least let me finish this last one.
Okay, but only if you give me a drag.
Okay.
Oh, dark mother, once again I suckle at your smoky teat.
Why don't you hold on to that one.
That's, like, the least fun game ever.
I'm sick of your smoking, so I brought something...
...that is going to help you quit.
That patch is no good.
It's a hypnosis tape.
A woman at work used it for two weeks and hasn't smoked since.
What's your problem?
Nothing. It's just that hypnosis is beyond crap.
I watched you get hypnotized in Atlantic City.
That guy did not hypnotize me, okay?
You always pull your pants down and play "Wipe Out" on your butt.
Forget hypnosis.
The way to quit smoking is to dance naked in a field of heather...
...and then bathe in the sweat of six healthy young men.
Or what my father calls "Thursday night."
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Here you go. - I didn't want cinnamon on this.
Sorry.
Hi. Hi. - Oh, my God! Frank!
Ha, ha. Hi. How are you?
What are you doing here?
I would've called, but I lost your number.
And then, uh, my mom locked me out of the house, so I couldn't find it.
And, uh, then I tried to find a pay phone, and the receiver was cut off.
What happened?
Uh, oh. Vandalism.
But also, what happened between you and your mom?
We got in a fight. She said that I was too immature to get married.
You're getting married? - Oh, yeah.
My little brother's getting married! Ha, ha.
I knew you'd be so cool about this. Uh, hey, do you wanna meet her?
Do I?
Do you?
Yeah, I do.
Cool, all right. She's just parking the truck.
I'm gonna... I'm gonna go get my, uh, fiancee, man!
I'd have bet good money that he'd be the first one of us to get married.
Isn't it fantastic?
Yeah, but don't you think he's a little young to get married?
What? He's 18. - It'll be illegal for him to drink...
...at his own bachelor party.
Yeah, or to get a hooker.
Always illegal, Joe.
Hey! Hey!
This is, uh, my fiancee...
...Mrs. Knight.
That's my sister. - You know, it's funny.
Frank told me so much about you, but you're not how I pictured you at all.
Yeah, I'm a big surprise.
Here you go. Here, grab a seat.
So how did you guys meet?
Well, um, I was in Mrs. Knight's...
I mean, Alice. Sorry. I always do that. Ha, ha.
I was in her Home Ec class.
He was my best student.
She was my best teacher.
If that doesn't keep kids in school, what will?
And so now you guys are gonna be married?
Yeah. Ha, ha.
We talked about just living together, but, um...
...we wanna have kids right away.
Oh, my God!
Great!
Wow, kids. Frank, are you sure you're ready for that?
How hard can it be?
You know, I mean, you know, babies. Who doesn't want babies? Right?
And besides, I never had a dad around.
And now I always will, because it'll be me.
Really, we do realize that there's an age difference between us.
Good. Because you were acting like you didn't.
But when it comes to love, what does age matter?
You are falling fast asleep.
Deeper, deeper, deeper.
You are now completely asleep.
You don't need to smoke.
Cigarettes don't control you.
You are a strong, confident woman...
...who does not need to smoke.
A strong, confident woman.
You know what? I realized in the last year I've only gone out with Richard and Julio.
You gotta help me out. Set me up. Get me back in the game.
Shouldn't be a problem. I work in fashion, and all I meet are eligible straight men.
Can I get you something else?
Cheesecake and a date, if you're giving them out.
Heh. Haven't we covered that topic?
You just said to her... - You wanna go out with me...
...because of my wig, the big boobs, and I serve you food.
If that were true, I'd be dating my Aunt Ruth.
And the two times we went out, it was plain awkward.
You think she should go out with me, don't you?
Well, I mean...
...are you sure you wanna go out with her?
That ain't a pretty picture in the morning, know what I mean?
That wig all in disarray, and boobs flung over the nightstand.
Really. Think about it.
Oh, I will. Ha-ha-ha.
No, I know. I know that this is Frank's life.
You know?
I don't wanna be judgmental, but it's sick. It's sick and wrong!
What, is it the age thing?
No, I'm fine with the age thing...
...until it sticks its tongue down my brother's throat.
Pheebs, he seems to enjoy it.
You think he'll enjoy it when he's up to his elbows in diapers...
...of all the babies they have to have right away?
This is not fair to Frank, and it's not fair to the babies.
You know what? It's not good home economics.
Have you told him how you feel?
Yes. Not out loud.
If you don't tell him, soon he'll be married, then you'll hate yourself.
Yeah, but if I do tell him, then he's gonna hate myself.
Look at him and his mom. I can't.
But you guys can. You talk him out of it.
No, no, no, no, no, no.
Come on, you guys.
You have nothing to lose. I have everything to lose.
Do you want me to lose everything? Everything?
No. - No.
Okay, I'm gonna go get Frank.
We're walking down the street, and I turn to you and say
"Let's go hang out at Totally Nude Nudes." Remember?
And then, heh, you say, "Let's just hang out at your place."
Well, that was a nice move, dumb-ass.
I think you should go out with this guy.
No, he doesn't do anything for me.
Last Saturday night, what happened on Walker, Texas Ranger?
Well, um, Walker was looking for this big busload of kids. Heh.
All right, I get your point.
Hey. - Hey.
I forgot the combination to this about a year ago.
I just carry it around.
You got any Chap Stick? - Uh, yeah.
Hey, how are those tapes working out?
Pretty good. Good. I haven't smoked yet today.
I feel great and confident. That is a stunning blouse.
Thank you.
Here you go. - Thanks.
Okay, Mon. Let's give Pete a chance. He was funny. He seems really nice.
That check thing was adorable.
What check thing?
As a joke, this customer who has a crush on me, gave me a $20,000 tip.
His number's on the check. He did it so I'd call.
Pete Becker. Pete...
Is this him?
That's Bill Clinton.
Who's he hugging?
Oh, my God. That's Pete. Why is Bill hugging Pete?
This guy invented Moss 865.
Every office in the world uses that program.
We use it! - There you go!
Oh, my God. Monica's gonna go out with a millionaire.
No, I'm not gonna go out with him. - Oh, my God.
I can't believe this is a real $20,000 check. This is so exciting.
Or incredibly offensive.
Yeah, sure. That too.
What?
All we're saying is, don't rush into anything.
Come on, think about it. You're 18, okay? She's 44.
When you're 36, she's gonna be 88.
You don't think I know that?
Look, the point is...
...there's a lot of women you haven't had sex with yet.
Yeah, he's right. He's right. This is your time, you know?
You're young. You're weird. Chicks dig that.
But isn't sex better when it's with one person that you really care about?
Yeah, in a poem, maybe.
No, the man's right. That's what I had with Rachel.
You don't have it anymore?
No, I, uh... I slept with someone else.
So wait. So how did that make things better?
It didn't.
What you used to have with Rachel is what I got with Alice.
Now what is that like?
It's so cool, man.
It's because being with her is so much better than not being with her.
Yeah. Yeah.
Why can't I find that? - I had it and I blew it.
Well, I want it! - You can have it.
Maybe I can't. Maybe there's something wrong with me.
No, it's out there, man. I've seen it! I got it!
Then you hold on to it! - All right, man!
All right! Congratulations, you lucky bastard!
You're Frank's best man?
I couldn't help it. Their love is so pure.
What about you, huh?
I'm the ring bearer.
Hi! Oh, Alice, hi. Thanks.
I'm so glad you could come. I've got a real, um, Home Ec emergency.
Oh, my God. Who died on this? - Yeah, I know.
It's a real "mustard-tastrophe."
Can you help me? - Absolutely.
Okay, first, we'll start with a little club soda and salt.
Then if that doesn't work... - You know what? Forget it. It's ruined.
Oh, no, never say that. If you can't get it out, cut around the stain...
...add a little lace, you make a stylish throw.
Or instead, maybe you could just not marry my brother, Frank?
Can we make it smaller? Make it fit on the head of a pin?
I love when we make things fit on the head of a pin.
Got it, yeah. - Yeah, okay.
You have Monica Geller here.
Uh, absolutely. Yeah, send her in.
Hi.
What the hell is this?
Hang on for a sec. I'll talk to you in the morning?
You got it.
I'm sorry. What? - What's this supposed to mean?
Well, you know, I never know how much to tip.
You double the tax. Not double the tax of Romania.
I mean, what's the deal? Are you trying to buy me?
Is this the way you get girls to go out with you?
Uh, I'm still here.
You're taking this wrong. If I didn't leave you that tip...
...you wouldn't have come, we wouldn't have this argument...
...and there wouldn't be this, uh, heat between us.
What? - Come on.
You gotta admit that our relationship is hitting a new level now.
You were the chef, and I was the customer.
But now we're this couple that fights.
Okay, um...
...you're a loon.
Look, forget the check, okay? I like you.
I think you're great.
Come on, what do you say?
I don't know.
Why not?
I don't wanna encourage this behavior.
One meal. That's all I'm asking for. Please?
We go out, we eat.
If you don't have a good time, I'll give you 10 grand, we're even.
Hi. - Aah! No!
Wait, no. Just put the mail down. It's me.
Sorry. Why were you just all in the dark?
Well, um, your laundry smelled so good that I thought I'd curl up in it.
Is that all right? - Yeah, sure.
So how was your day?
It's just probably the worst one since I've been alive.
What, um...? What happened?
Um, Alice, uh...
She, uh, called it off.
Oh, no.
Did, um... Did she say why?
Uh, no, not really. Just that I was too young.
I don't see how I could suddenly be too young...
...because I'm older than I was when we first got together.
Yeah, yeah, no, I don't...
I don't know. But you know what? Maybe it's just all for the best.
Well, yeah, if the best is like unbelievable pain.
Oh, sweetie.
You know, I was just finally happy.
For the first time in my life...
...after my dad left me...
...and then getting arrested for stealing those birds...
...and then the whole punctured-lung thing.
It's still really hard to take deep breaths in cold weather...
...but with Alice, all that stuff kind of went away.
And now it's gone, and I don't know why.
Ugh. Well, I can tell you why. It's because of me.
But you know what? I only did it because I love you, okay?
What? - Um, I kind of had a little chat with Alice...
...and I sort of made her see why you two shouldn't be together.
And you'll see it too, one day. You really, really will.
Wait a minute. This is because of you?
Okay...
Wait, no. My mother didn't want us to be together...
...but the worst thing she did was tie me to the porch.
Okay, but...
I came to you because I thought you'd understand.
Oh, no!
I would storm out of here...
...if I had some money or a place to go.
Oh, my God! The millionaire's here!
Oh, my God!
Guys, please. I'm just gonna have dinner with him.
Okay, just because he buys you dinner does not mean you owe him anything.
I know.
Okay, then get the lobster.
Hey. - Hi.
Hi. - Hey.
Hello.
Hey, how much cash you got in your pocket right now?
And that's why I'm not inviting you in for a drink. Bye.
Why not? Hey, come in for drink.
Where do you wanna go? - You like pizza?
Oh, that sounds great. - I know a great little place.
You're not paying for the pizza.
Come on, it's only fair. You paid for the flight.
Is that enough lira?
Uh, I'd throw another 1000 on that.
How much is that? - That's about 60 cents.
Every night!
You don't need to smoke.
Cigarettes don't control you.
You are a strong, confident woman...
...who does not need to smoke.
A strong, confident woman...
...who does not need to smoke.
So can I.
Hey, Frank.
Look, I know that you think I did this totally evil thing.
But I so didn't.
Someone's here who can explain this better than I can.
We can go look.
Hi, Frank.
Hi, Mrs. Knight.
Phoebe's right, Frank.
It's hard to hear, but it would've been wrong to go through with it.
I was being selfish.
Even though we want the same things right now...
...in the future, we may not.
Is that what it is? - Yes, but not just that.
Right, not just that.
Even though we love each other as much as we do...
...nonetheless...
Nonetheless. - Nonetheless.
You're too young...
...to really know what you want.
That's right, exactly.
That's a goodbye kiss. That's good.
Bye-bye.
The important thing is, is that you see what I'm saying.
This is clearly wrong.
I've decided I'm gonna let this happen.
Okay, can I just get my purse?
Okay, all right, good.
Cigarettes don't control you.
You are a strong, confident woman...
...who does not need to smoke.
Joey's your best friend.
You wanna make him a cheese sandwich every day.
And you also wanna buy him hundreds of dollars worth of pants.

What? - Um, I kind of had a little chat with Alice...

Oh, my God!

Come on, it's only fair. You paid for the flight.

How much is that? - That's about 60 cents.
Every night!

A strong, confident woman...

Hey, Frank.

But I so didn't.

Hi, Mrs. Knight.
Phoebe's right, Frank.

I was being selfish.

...nonetheless...
Nonetheless. - Nonetheless.

Bye-bye.

This is clearly wrong.
I've decided I'm gonna let this happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事那么好笑
sense_groups.english: What's so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我在练习演戏 我只是在练习假笑
sense_groups.english: Oh, nothing. It's an acting exercise. I'm practicing my fake laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 什么事那么好笑
sense_groups.english: What? What's so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这里禁烟
sense_groups.english: No, no. There's none of that in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 至少让我抽完最后一根
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. At least let me finish this last one.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 除非你让我抽一口
sense_groups.english: Okay, but only if you give me a drag.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我又屈服在自己的欲望下
sense_groups.english: Oh, dark mother, once again I suckle at your smoky teat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那根就给你抽了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you hold on to that one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是最不好玩的游戏
sense_groups.english: That's, like, the least fun game ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我厌倦了你的抽烟习惯 所以我带了一样东西
sense_groups.english: I'm sick of your smoking, so I brought something...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以帮助你戒烟
sense_groups.english: ...that is going to help you quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个戒烟贴片没有用
sense_groups.english: That patch is no good.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是催眠录音带
sense_groups.english: It's a hypnosis tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的女同事听了两星期 再也没抽过烟
sense_groups.english: A woman at work used it for two weeks and hasn't smoked since.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么问题
sense_groups.english: What's your problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是觉得催眠完全是在胡扯
sense_groups.english: Nothing. It's just that hypnosis is beyond crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我看过你在大西洋城被催眠
sense_groups.english: I watched you get hypnotized in Atlantic City.

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙没有催眠我 好吗
sense_groups.english: That guy did not hypnotize me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你常常脱掉裤子表演擦屁股
sense_groups.english: You always pull your pants down and play "Wipe Out" on your butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 别提催眠了
sense_groups.english: Forget hypnosis.

sense_groups.chinese: 想戒烟就得在石南田里裸舞
sense_groups.english: The way to quit smoking is to dance naked in a field of heather...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟六名健康年轻男子 一起畅快地流汗
sense_groups.english: ...and then bathe in the sweat of six healthy young men.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是我爸打电话到"周四夜"
sense_groups.english: Or what my father calls "Thursday night."

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 - 我不要加肉桂
sense_groups.english: Here you go. - I didn't want cinnamon on this.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨… - 天啊 法兰克
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi. - Oh, my God! Frank!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Hi. How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该打电话给你的 但我把你的电话号码搞丢了
sense_groups.english: I would've called, but I lost your number.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈把我锁在屋外 所以我没办法去找电话号码
sense_groups.english: And then, uh, my mom locked me out of the house, so I couldn't find it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我试着找公用电话 但话筒被切断了
sense_groups.english: And, uh, then I tried to find a pay phone, and the receiver was cut off.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人破坏公物
sense_groups.english: Uh, oh. Vandalism.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 就是你跟你妈怎么了
sense_groups.english: But also, what happened between you and your mom?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们大吵一架 因为她说我太幼雅 不该结婚
sense_groups.english: We got in a fight. She said that I was too immature to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要结婚了 - 对
sense_groups.english: You're getting married? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我弟弟要结婚了
sense_groups.english: My little brother's getting married! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你会很开心 你要跟她见面吗
sense_groups.english: I knew you'd be so cool about this. Uh, hey, do you wanna meet her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要吗
sense_groups.english: Do I?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吗
sense_groups.english: Do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然要
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 好吧 她正在停车
sense_groups.english: Cool, all right. She's just parking the truck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去叫我未婚妻进来
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna... I'm gonna go get my, uh, fiancee, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌他是我们之中第一个结婚的人
sense_groups.english: I'd have bet good money that he'd be the first one of us to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't it fantastic?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但你不觉得他还太小 不该结婚吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but don't you think he's a little young to get married?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么他18岁了 - 他在自己的单身派对上喝酒
sense_groups.english: What? He's 18. - It'll be illegal for him to drink...

sense_groups.chinese: 是犯法的
sense_groups.english: ...at his own bachelor party.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 也不能召妓
sense_groups.english: Yeah, or to get a hooker.

sense_groups.chinese: 那本来就是犯法的 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Always illegal, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的未婚妻
sense_groups.english: This is, uh, my fiancee...

sense_groups.chinese: 奈特老师
sense_groups.english: ...Mrs. Knight.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我姊姊 - 这真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: That's my sister. - You know, it's funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克常跟我提起你 但你跟我想像中完全不一样
sense_groups.english: Frank told me so much about you, but you're not how I pictured you at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我非常讶异
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm a big surprise.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 来吧 坐下
sense_groups.english: Here you go. Here, grab a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是怎么认识的
sense_groups.english: So how did you guys meet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在奈特老师的…
sense_groups.english: Well, um, I was in Mrs. Knight's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说爱丽丝 抱歉 我常那么做
sense_groups.english: I mean, Alice. Sorry. I always do that. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上她的家政课
sense_groups.english: I was in her Home Ec class.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我最好的学生
sense_groups.english: He was my best student.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我最好的老师
sense_groups.english: She was my best teacher.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这无法让孩子们待在学校里 还有什么办法呢
sense_groups.english: If that doesn't keep kids in school, what will?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们要结婚了
sense_groups.english: And so now you guys are gonna be married?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们谈到要同居
sense_groups.english: We talked about just living together, but, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们想快点生小孩
sense_groups.english: ...we wanna have kids right away.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Great!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 生小孩 法兰克 你确定你准备好了吗
sense_groups.english: Wow, kids. Frank, are you sure you're ready for that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那会有多难呢
sense_groups.english: How hard can it be?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说宝宝 谁不想要宝宝 对吧
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, you know, babies. Who doesn't want babies? Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我一直没有父亲陪我
sense_groups.english: And besides, I never had a dad around.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我有个父亲了 那就是我
sense_groups.english: And now I always will, because it'll be me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道我们的年龄有点差距
sense_groups.english: Really, we do realize that there's an age difference between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 因为你一副你不知道的样子
sense_groups.english: Good. Because you were acting like you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但在爱情的世界里 年龄又有什么关系呢
sense_groups.english: But when it comes to love, what does age matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 你很快就睡着了
sense_groups.english: You are falling fast asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 睡得很熟
sense_groups.english: Deeper, deeper, deeper.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你完全睡着了
sense_groups.english: You are now completely asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: You don't need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 香烟无法控制你
sense_groups.english: Cigarettes don't control you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是坚强有自信的女人
sense_groups.english: You are a strong, confident woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: ...who does not need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 坚强有自信的女人
sense_groups.english: A strong, confident woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我发现去年我只跟理查及胡立欧约过会
sense_groups.english: You know what? I realized in the last year I've only gone out with Richard and Julio.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得帮帮我 帮我介绍男人 让我重享爱情的滋味
sense_groups.english: You gotta help me out. Set me up. Get me back in the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 那应该不是问题 我在时尚界工作 常遇见单身异性恋男人
sense_groups.english: Shouldn't be a problem. I work in fashion, and all I meet are eligible straight men.

sense_groups.chinese: 还需要什么服务吗
sense_groups.english: Can I get you something else?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要起司蛋糕 还有你能跟我约会
sense_groups.english: Cheesecake and a date, if you're giving them out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是谈过那一点吗
sense_groups.english: Heh. Haven't we covered that topic?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚才跟她说… - 你想跟我约会
sense_groups.english: You just said to her... - You wanna go out with me...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我的假发 大胸部 我还会帮你上菜
sense_groups.english: ...because of my wig, the big boobs, and I serve you food.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那是真的 我该跟我的萝丝阿姨约会
sense_groups.english: If that were true, I'd be dating my Aunt Ruth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们出去过两次 那真的很怪
sense_groups.english: And the two times we went out, it was plain awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她该跟我去约会 对吧
sense_groups.english: You think she should go out with me, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说…
sense_groups.english: Well, I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定你要跟她约会吗
sense_groups.english: ...are you sure you wanna go out with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 早上不会太好看 你知道我的意思吗
sense_groups.english: That ain't a pretty picture in the morning, know what I mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 假发都乱了 胸部挂在床头柜上
sense_groups.english: That wig all in disarray, and boobs flung over the nightstand.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 好好考虑一下
sense_groups.english: Really. Think about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的
sense_groups.english: Oh, I will. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我知道这是法兰克的人生
sense_groups.english: No, I know. I know that this is Frank's life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想批评别人 但这太变态了 也是不对的
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna be judgmental, but it's sick. It's sick and wrong!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么因为年龄的关系吗
sense_groups.english: What, is it the age thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我能接受年龄差距
sense_groups.english: No, I'm fine with the age thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到她把舌头伸进我弟弟的喉咙里
sense_groups.english: ...until it sticks its tongue down my brother's throat.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 他似乎很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, he seems to enjoy it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得他会喜欢忙着换尿布吗
sense_groups.english: You think he'll enjoy it when he's up to his elbows in diapers...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们必须立刻生孩子
sense_groups.english: ...of all the babies they have to have right away?

sense_groups.chinese: 这对法兰克及宝宝都不公平
sense_groups.english: This is not fair to Frank, and it's not fair to the babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 这不是很棒的家政教育
sense_groups.english: You know what? It's not good home economics.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟他谈过你的感觉吗
sense_groups.english: Have you told him how you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 但我没有直说
sense_groups.english: Yes. Not out loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 如果你不跟他说 很快地他就会结婚 而你就会自责
sense_groups.english: If you don't tell him, soon he'll be married, then you'll hate yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 如果我跟他说 他就会恨我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but if I do tell him, then he's gonna hate myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看他跟他妈 我说不出口
sense_groups.english: Look at him and his mom. I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你们可以跟他谈 你们得说服他放弃这个念头
sense_groups.english: But you guys can. You talk him out of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你们两个
sense_groups.english: Come on, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没什么好损失的 我会失去一切
sense_groups.english: You have nothing to lose. I have everything to lose.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要我失去一切吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to lose everything? Everything?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 不要
sense_groups.english: No. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得去找法兰克
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna go get Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走在街上 我转头跟你说
sense_groups.english: We're walking down the street, and I turn to you and say

sense_groups.chinese: "我们去泡脱衣酒吧" 还记得吗
sense_groups.english: "Let's go hang out at Totally Nude Nudes." Remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你说"我们还是去你家吧"
sense_groups.english: And then, heh, you say, "Let's just hang out at your place."

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很聪明 大傻瓜
sense_groups.english: Well, that was a nice move, dumb-ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你该跟这家伙约会
sense_groups.english: I think you should go out with this guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他跟我完全不配
sense_groups.english: No, he doesn't do anything for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 上星期六晚上 "德州骑警"演到哪里了
sense_groups.english: Last Saturday night, what happened on Walker, Texas Ranger?

sense_groups.chinese: 德州骑警在找一整车的孩子
sense_groups.english: Well, um, Walker was looking for this big busload of kids. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我了解你的意思
sense_groups.english: All right, I get your point.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 一年前我忘了手提包的密码
sense_groups.english: I forgot the combination to this about a year ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是抬着装样子
sense_groups.english: I just carry it around.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有护唇膏吗 - 当然有
sense_groups.english: You got any Chap Stick? - Uh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 录音带有用吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, how are those tapes working out?

sense_groups.chinese: 非常有用 今天我还没有抽烟
sense_groups.english: Pretty good. Good. I haven't smoked yet today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得非常棒 自信满满 那件上衣好漂亮
sense_groups.english: I feel great and confident. That is a stunning blouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here you go. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 摩妮卡 给彼特一个机会 他非常风趣 似乎是个好男人
sense_groups.english: Okay, Mon. Let's give Pete a chance. He was funny. He seems really nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 开支票的事真的很可爱
sense_groups.english: That check thing was adorable.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么支票
sense_groups.english: What check thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是开玩笑的 这个客人暗恋我 他给我两万块小费
sense_groups.english: As a joke, this customer who has a crush on me, gave me a $20,000 tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的电话号码在支票上 他那么做是要我打电话给他
sense_groups.english: His number's on the check. He did it so I'd call.

sense_groups.chinese: 彼特•贝克 彼特…
sense_groups.english: Pete Becker. Pete...

sense_groups.chinese: 是他吗
sense_groups.english: Is this him?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是柯林顿总统
sense_groups.english: That's Bill Clinton.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在拥抱谁
sense_groups.english: Who's he hugging?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那是彼特 为什么总统要拥抱彼特
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. That's Pete. Why is Bill hugging Pete?

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙发明了摩斯865
sense_groups.english: This guy invented Moss 865.

sense_groups.chinese: 全世界所有办公室都在使用那套程式
sense_groups.english: Every office in the world uses that program.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就有用 - 没错
sense_groups.english: We use it! - There you go!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 摩妮卡要跟百万富翁约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Monica's gonna go out with a millionaire.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不要跟他约会 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not gonna go out with him. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信这是两万块支票 太令人兴奋了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is a real $20,000 check. This is so exciting.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一种侮辱
sense_groups.english: Or incredibly offensive.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. That too.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是说你不需要那么急
sense_groups.english: All we're saying is, don't rush into anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 好好想一想 你18岁 她是44岁
sense_groups.english: Come on, think about it. You're 18, okay? She's 44.

sense_groups.chinese: 你36岁时 她会是88岁
sense_groups.english: When you're 36, she's gonna be 88.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我不知道吗
sense_groups.english: You don't think I know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 重点是
sense_groups.english: Look, the point is...

sense_groups.chinese: 很多女人还没有跟你上过床
sense_groups.english: ...there's a lot of women you haven't had sex with yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他说的对 你的时代来了 你懂吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's right. He's right. This is your time, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你年轻古怪 女人喜欢那样的男人
sense_groups.english: You're young. You're weird. Chicks dig that.

sense_groups.chinese: 但跟你真正关心的人上床 性爱会更加美满吧
sense_groups.english: But isn't sex better when it's with one person that you really care about?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 在诗里的确是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, in a poem, maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他说的对 以前我跟瑞秋就是那样
sense_groups.english: No, the man's right. That's what I had with Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在不一样了
sense_groups.english: You don't have it anymore?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我跟别人上床
sense_groups.english: No, I, uh... I slept with someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 为什么那样让生活变得更美好
sense_groups.english: So wait. So how did that make things better?

sense_groups.chinese: 的确是没有
sense_groups.english: It didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前你跟瑞秋的关系就是现在我跟爱丽丝的关系
sense_groups.english: What you used to have with Rachel is what I got with Alice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么样的关系
sense_groups.english: Now what is that like?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很酷
sense_groups.english: It's so cool, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为跟她在一起比没有她的日子好多了
sense_groups.english: It's because being with her is so much better than not being with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我不能那么做 - 我有过机会 却搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Why can't I find that? - I had it and I blew it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也要 - 你可以那么做
sense_groups.english: Well, I want it! - You can have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我办不到 或许我有问题
sense_groups.english: Maybe I can't. Maybe there's something wrong with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真爱的确存在 我找到了 也得到了
sense_groups.english: No, it's out there, man. I've seen it! I got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 那你得好好把握 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Then you hold on to it! - All right, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 恭喜 你这个幸运的混蛋
sense_groups.english: All right! Congratulations, you lucky bastard!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是法兰克的伴郎
sense_groups.english: You're Frank's best man?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法拒绝 他们的爱是那么纯洁
sense_groups.english: I couldn't help it. Their love is so pure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢
sense_groups.english: What about you, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我负责拿婚戒
sense_groups.english: I'm the ring bearer.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱丽丝 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Hi! Oh, Alice, hi. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你能赶过来 我有紧急家政状况
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you could come. I've got a real, um, Home Ec emergency.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 谁死在这上面了 - 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Who died on this? - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是真正的芥末酱灾难
sense_groups.english: It's a real "mustard-tastrophe."

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮帮我吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Can you help me? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 首先我们需要苏打水跟盐
sense_groups.english: Okay, first, we'll start with a little club soda and salt.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果还不行的话… - 你知道吗算了 它已经毁了
sense_groups.english: Then if that doesn't work... - You know what? Forget it. It's ruined.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 千万别那么做 洗不掉的话就把它剪掉
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, never say that. If you can't get it out, cut around the stain...

sense_groups.chinese: 缝上蕾丝就能做出漂亮抱枕
sense_groups.english: ...add a little lace, you make a stylish throw.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是你别跟我弟弟法兰克结婚
sense_groups.english: Or instead, maybe you could just not marry my brother, Frank?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以小一点吗 让它从针头穿过去
sense_groups.english: Can we make it smaller? Make it fit on the head of a pin?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢做出能穿过针头的东西
sense_groups.english: I love when we make things fit on the head of a pin.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Got it, yeah. - Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡•盖勒来了
sense_groups.english: You have Monica Geller here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 请她进来
sense_groups.english: Uh, absolutely. Yeah, send her in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么东西
sense_groups.english: What the hell is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 明天早上再谈
sense_groups.english: Hang on for a sec. I'll talk to you in the morning?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 什么 - 这到底是什么意思
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. What? - What's this supposed to mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来都搞不清楚该付多少小费
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, I never know how much to tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 小费是消费税的两倍 不是罗马尼亚国税的两倍
sense_groups.english: You double the tax. Not double the tax of Romania.

sense_groups.chinese: 这到底是怎么一回事 你想收买我吗
sense_groups.english: I mean, what's the deal? Are you trying to buy me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都用这招要女人跟你约会
sense_groups.english: Is this the way you get girls to go out with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'm still here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你误会了 如果我不给你小费
sense_groups.english: You're taking this wrong. If I didn't leave you that tip...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会来 我们不会吵架
sense_groups.english: ...you wouldn't have come, we wouldn't have this argument...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间就不会有火花
sense_groups.english: ...and there wouldn't be this, uh, heat between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: What? - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得承认我们的关系迈向新境界
sense_groups.english: You gotta admit that our relationship is hitting a new level now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是大厨 我是客人
sense_groups.english: You were the chef, and I was the customer.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们是在吵嘴的情侣
sense_groups.english: But now we're this couple that fights.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个疯子
sense_groups.english: ...you're a loon.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 忘了支票的事 好吗 我喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Look, forget the check, okay? I like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你很棒
sense_groups.english: I think you're great.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: Come on, what do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想鼓励这种行为
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna encourage this behavior.

sense_groups.chinese: 一顿饭 那是我唯一的要求 拜托
sense_groups.english: One meal. That's all I'm asking for. Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们出去吃饭
sense_groups.english: We go out, we eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你玩得不开心 我给你一万块 我们就扯平了
sense_groups.english: If you don't have a good time, I'll give you 10 grand, we're even.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 不
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Aah! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 放下邮件 是我
sense_groups.english: Wait, no. Just put the mail down. It's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 为什么你不开灯呢
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Why were you just all in the dark?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的衣服闻起来好香 我只想窝在里面
sense_groups.english: Well, um, your laundry smelled so good that I thought I'd curl up in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Is that all right? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天你过得还好吗
sense_groups.english: So how was your day?

sense_groups.chinese: 这可能是我一生中最糟糕的一天
sense_groups.english: It's just probably the worst one since I've been alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: What, um...? What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 爱丽丝…
sense_groups.english: Um, Alice, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟我分手
sense_groups.english: She, uh, called it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有说为什么吗
sense_groups.english: Did, um... Did she say why?

sense_groups.chinese: 她没说 她只说我太年轻
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, not really. Just that I was too young.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂为什么突然间我会太年轻
sense_groups.english: I don't see how I could suddenly be too young...

sense_groups.chinese: 我比我们刚在一起时还老
sense_groups.english: ...because I'm older than I was when we first got together.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 不 我不…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, no, I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你知道吗 或许这样子也好
sense_groups.english: I don't know. But you know what? Maybe it's just all for the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 如果那代表我会超心痛的
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, if the best is like unbelievable pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于找到幸福
sense_groups.english: You know, I was just finally happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我人生中的第一次
sense_groups.english: For the first time in my life...

sense_groups.chinese: 在我爸离开我后
sense_groups.english: ...after my dad left me...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为偷鸟被捕
sense_groups.english: ...and then getting arrested for stealing those birds...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有肺部崩塌的事之后
sense_groups.english: ...and then the whole punctured-lung thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 天气冷时我还是很难深呼吸
sense_groups.english: It's still really hard to take deep breaths in cold weather...

sense_groups.chinese: 但有了爱丽丝后 那些痛苦都不见了
sense_groups.english: ...but with Alice, all that stuff kind of went away.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在她走了 我不知道为什么
sense_groups.english: And now it's gone, and I don't know why.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来告诉你为什么 都是我害的
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Well, I can tell you why. It's because of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我会那么做是因为我爱你 好吗
sense_groups.english: But you know what? I only did it because I love you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我跟爱丽丝谈了一下
sense_groups.english: What? - Um, I kind of had a little chat with Alice...

sense_groups.chinese: 让她了解为什么你们不能在一起
sense_groups.english: ...and I sort of made her see why you two shouldn't be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一天你也会明白 真的
sense_groups.english: And you'll see it too, one day. You really, really will.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 这都是你搞的鬼
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. This is because of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 不 我妈妈不要我们在一起
sense_groups.english: Wait, no. My mother didn't want us to be together...

sense_groups.chinese: 但她也只是把我绑在门廊上
sense_groups.english: ...but the worst thing she did was tie me to the porch.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 可是…
sense_groups.english: Okay, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 我来找你 因为我以为你能了解
sense_groups.english: I came to you because I thought you'd understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 我该冲出这里
sense_groups.english: I would storm out of here...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我有钱或有地方可去的话
sense_groups.english: ...if I had some money or a place to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 百万富翁来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! The millionaire's here!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 拜托 我只是要跟他去吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Guys, please. I'm just gonna have dinner with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他请你吃晚餐 不代表你欠他任何东西
sense_groups.english: Okay, just because he buys you dinner does not mean you owe him anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 记得点龙虾
sense_groups.english: Okay, then get the lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的口袋里装了多少现金
sense_groups.english: Hey, how much cash you got in your pocket right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 这正是我不请你进来喝一杯的原因 再见
sense_groups.english: And that's why I'm not inviting you in for a drink. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 有何不可 进来喝一杯吧
sense_groups.english: Why not? Hey, come in for drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里 - 你喜欢比萨吗
sense_groups.english: Where do you wanna go? - You like pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很棒 - 我知道有家小店很不错
sense_groups.english: Oh, that sounds great. - I know a great little place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必付比萨钱
sense_groups.english: You're not paying for the pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 这样才公平 你付了机票钱
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's only fair. You paid for the flight.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了吗
sense_groups.english: Is that enough lira?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会再加一千里拉
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'd throw another 1000 on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那等于多少 - 大约美金六毛钱
sense_groups.english: How much is that? - That's about 60 cents.

sense_groups.chinese: 每晚都这样
sense_groups.english: Every night!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: You don't need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 香烟无法控制你
sense_groups.english: Cigarettes don't control you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是坚强有自信的女人
sense_groups.english: You are a strong, confident woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: ...who does not need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 坚强有自信的女人
sense_groups.english: A strong, confident woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: ...who does not need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也可以
sense_groups.english: So can I.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克
sense_groups.english: Hey, Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我知道你认为我做了坏事
sense_groups.english: Look, I know that you think I did this totally evil thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的没有
sense_groups.english: But I so didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人能解释得比我清楚
sense_groups.english: Someone's here who can explain this better than I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以去看一下
sense_groups.english: We can go look.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 法兰克
sense_groups.english: Hi, Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 奈特老师
sense_groups.english: Hi, Mrs. Knight.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比说的对 法兰克
sense_groups.english: Phoebe's right, Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 这让人很难接受 但我们真的那么做是不对的
sense_groups.english: It's hard to hear, but it would've been wrong to go through with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太自私了
sense_groups.english: I was being selfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使现在我们的目标一样
sense_groups.english: Even though we want the same things right now...

sense_groups.chinese: 未来可能不是那样的
sense_groups.english: ...in the future, we may not.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 - 对 但不只是那样
sense_groups.english: Is that what it is? - Yes, but not just that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但不只是那样
sense_groups.english: Right, not just that.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我们深爱彼此
sense_groups.english: Even though we love each other as much as we do...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是…
sense_groups.english: ...nonetheless...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是… - 可是…
sense_groups.english: Nonetheless. - Nonetheless.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太年轻
sense_groups.english: You're too young...

sense_groups.chinese: 还不知道你要什么
sense_groups.english: ...to really know what you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right, exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是道别亲吻 太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's a goodbye kiss. That's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是你了解我的意思
sense_groups.english: The important thing is, is that you see what I'm saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 很显然 这样是不对的
sense_groups.english: This is clearly wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定要让你们继续做下去
sense_groups.english: I've decided I'm gonna let this happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我能拿一下皮包吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, can I just get my purse?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 香烟无法控制你
sense_groups.english: Cigarettes don't control you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是坚强有自信的女人
sense_groups.english: You are a strong, confident woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不需要抽烟
sense_groups.english: ...who does not need to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊是你最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Joey's your best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 每天你都要做起司三明治给他吃
sense_groups.english: You wanna make him a cheese sandwich every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还要送他价值数百块美金的裤子
sense_groups.english: And you also wanna buy him hundreds of dollars worth of pants.

questions.en:
Here you go. - Thank you.
"Say, Rachel...
...I was wondering if you'd like to go to a movie with me sometime...
...as my lover."
Mm. Too out there.
"Maybe you'd just like to get something to eat with me sometime...
...as my lover."
Hi. - Hi.
All right, let's go shopping.
You know, before we go, uh, there's something I need to say.
Oh. Okay. - Okay.
