sense_groups.chinese: 或是葛洛丽雅•伊斯特芬说对了
sense_groups.english: Either that or Gloria Estefan was right.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后 节奏会让你上了瘾
sense_groups.english: Eventually, the rhythm is going to get you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 还好吗 - 我很好
sense_groups.english: Joe, how's it going? - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你演安德丽娜
sense_groups.english: Ah, so you're playing Adrianne, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你是白痴表弟吗
sense_groups.english: Yes. Are you one of the retarded cousins?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我演你的丈夫维多 我是乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: No, no. Uh, I'm playing your husband, Victor. I'm Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸会 凯特•米勒
sense_groups.english: Hi. Nice to meet you. Kate Miller.

sense_groups.chinese: 这出戏很不错吧
sense_groups.english: Heh. So the, uh, play's pretty great, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我喜欢珍妮佛•班伯利的作品
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I love Jennifer Banberry's work.

sense_groups.chinese: 她非常尖锐地
sense_groups.english: She's so brilliantly incisive...

sense_groups.chinese: 剖析中产阶级心态
sense_groups.english: ...when it comes to deconstructing the psyche of the middle class.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了吧 她超棒的
sense_groups.english: Oh, forget about it. She rocks. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们见过面吗
sense_groups.english: Where do I know you from?

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克•雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Dr. Drake Ramoray?

sense_groups.chinese: "我们的日子"
sense_groups.english: Days of our Lives?

sense_groups.chinese: 被"青春节奏"票选为最想交往的外科医生
sense_groups.english: Voted most datable neurosurgeon by Teen Beat?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是那样的
sense_groups.english: No, that's not it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是肥皂剧演员
sense_groups.english: So you're a soap actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 能演出真正的戏剧 你一定非常兴奋
sense_groups.english: Well, this must be exciting for you, being in a real play. Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我演过戏 我是认真的演员
sense_groups.english: Hey, I've done plays before. I'm a serious actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 是那部广告
sense_groups.english: That infomercial.

sense_groups.chinese: 牛奶洒出来的广告
sense_groups.english: For the milk-carton-spout thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不会倒牛奶的那个家伙
sense_groups.english: You're the guy who doesn't know how to pour milk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会倒牛奶 但我让你相信我不会
sense_groups.english: See, I actually can pour milk. But I got you believing that I couldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 那才是演技
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Now, see, that's acting.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 最后你被饼干噎到
sense_groups.english: Right. At the end, you choked on a cookie.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was real.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信马克会约你出去 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Wow. I cannot believe Mark asked you out. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么跟他说
sense_groups.english: Well, So, what are you gonna tell him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他说我会考虑 但我要拒绝他
sense_groups.english: Well, I told him I would think about it, but I'm gonna tell him no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在我不想跟任何人约会
sense_groups.english: I mean, I think I'd say no to anybody right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很奇怪 我站在那里
sense_groups.english: Oh, but it was so strange. I mean, I'm standing there...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个迷人可爱的男人要跟我约会
sense_groups.english: ...with this charming, cute guy who's asking me to go out with him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以那么做
sense_groups.english: ...which I'm allowed to do...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我觉得有罪恶感 就像是我背叛了罗斯
sense_groups.english: ...and I felt guilty, you know, like I'd be cheating on Ross or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 或许那表示
sense_groups.english: Wow. So, okay, maybe that means...

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没有忘记罗斯 还有你跟你爸之间有问题
sense_groups.english: ...that you're not over Ross yet and you have issues with your father.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟我爸没问题
sense_groups.english: I don't have any issues with my father.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 或许那只是罗斯的关系
sense_groups.english: Okay, so it's probably just the Ross thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这个女人 我恨她
sense_groups.english: I hate this woman. I hate her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟剧团里的人说广告的事
sense_groups.english: She told everyone in the company about that infomercial...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在他们老找我帮他们打开饮料罐
sense_groups.english: ...and now they all keep asking me to open their drinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 每次我办不到时 他们都会嘲笑我
sense_groups.english: Okay? And whenever I can't do it, they're all, like, laughing at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋打电话给我
sense_groups.english: So Rachel called.

sense_groups.chinese: 她想见我
sense_groups.english: Wants to see me.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下我就要过去
sense_groups.english: Going over in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她想谈什么吗 - 或许她终于冷静下来
sense_groups.english: Wow. What do you think she wants? - Well, maybe the crazy fog has lifted...

sense_groups.chinese: 了解到没有我的生活…
sense_groups.english: ...and she realizes that life without me...

sense_groups.chinese: 太逊了
sense_groups.english: ...sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能 你非常可爱 如果我跟你分手 我也会想你
sense_groups.english: It's possible. You are very lovable. I'd miss you if I broke up with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想支持你
sense_groups.english: Just trying to be supportive.

sense_groups.chinese: 像个男子汉来支持我吧
sense_groups.english: Well, be supportive like a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我跟你分手 我也会想你
sense_groups.english: If I broke up with you, I'd miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找我
sense_groups.english: You, uh, wanted to see me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这箱是你的东西
sense_groups.english: Uh, here's a box of your stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 里面是帽子 衬衫跟光碟
sense_groups.english: What? - Uh, it's just like hats and a shirt and CD's.

sense_groups.chinese: 你留在这里的东西
sense_groups.english: Just sort of stuff that you've left here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 你想伤害我吗
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? Are you trying to hurt me or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来我们都该有新生活了
sense_groups.english: It just seems that, you know, it's time we, you know, move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不那么认为吗
sense_groups.english: I mean, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我是那么想的 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Yes, I do. - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的是那么想的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是礼物耶
sense_groups.english: This was a gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 那是你从博物馆礼品店免费拿回来的
sense_groups.english: Ross, you got that for free from the museum gift shop.

sense_groups.chinese: 它还是礼物
sense_groups.english: It's still a gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从礼品店拿回来的
sense_groups.english: I got it from the gift shop.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 马克杯给我 我可以留下马克杯
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. Give me the mug. I'll keep the mug.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别可怜我 事实上…
sense_groups.english: No. You know, don't do me any favors. In fact, where...

sense_groups.chinese: 我其他的东西在哪里 譬如我的…
sense_groups.english: Where's the rest of my stuff? Huh? Like my, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书是我的
sense_groups.english: Hey. This book is mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你穿着睡觉的汗衫呢 我要把它拿回来 没错
sense_groups.english: And that T-shirt you sleep in? I'd like that back too. Yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我多爱那件汗衫 你从来不穿那件汗衫
sense_groups.english: You know how much I love that T-shirt. You never even wear that T-shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想帮助你追寻新生活
sense_groups.english: I'm just trying to help you move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是个小气的家伙
sense_groups.english: Oh, you are a petty man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个小气…
sense_groups.english: You are a petty, petty...

sense_groups.chinese: 小气 - 小气
sense_groups.english: Petty... - ...petty, petty...

sense_groups.chinese: 小心眼 - 小心眼
sense_groups.english: ...small... - ...small...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不爽才会这么做
sense_groups.english: You are so just doing this out of spite.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: Uh-uh. No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要一直穿着它 我喜欢这件汗衫
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna wear this all the time. I love this shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你15岁后就没穿过它 你根本就穿不下了
sense_groups.english: You haven't worn that since you were 15. It doesn't even fit you anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, yeah, yeah. - Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不介意的话 我要拿着我的东西…
sense_groups.english: Now, if you don't mind, I'm gonna take the rest of my stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 去放轻松了
sense_groups.english: ...and relax...

sense_groups.chinese: 穿着我最喜欢的汗衫
sense_groups.english: ...in my favorite shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你有个愉快的夜晚
sense_groups.english: You have a pleasant evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是亿万富翁
sense_groups.english: So you're, like, a zillionaire.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的年纪跟我们一样大
sense_groups.english: And you're our age. You're our age.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你该买下一个州
sense_groups.english: You know what? You should, like, buy a state...

sense_groups.chinese: 把州名改成你的名字
sense_groups.english: ...and then just name it after yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 譬如说彼特•达科塔
sense_groups.english: What, like, "Pete Dakota"?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是密西西比•彼特
sense_groups.english: Or "Mississi-Pete."

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 彼特•芝加哥
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh, I got it: "Pete Chicago."

sense_groups.chinese: 芝加哥不是一个州 乔伊
sense_groups.english: That's not a state, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 密西西比•彼特就是吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, and "Mississi-Pete" is?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 后会有期
sense_groups.english: I gotta go, so, uh, I'll see you guys later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你的年纪跟我们一样大 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. You're our age. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天见面
sense_groups.english: So, uh, are we on for tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 快走吧
sense_groups.english: Now get out of here, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我该摸的地方都摸过了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm running out of places I can touch him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有毛病吗
sense_groups.english: Is there something wrong with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我只喜欢跟我没有未来的男人
sense_groups.english: I mean, why am I only attracted to guys where there's no future?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不是太老 就是太年轻
sense_groups.english: Either they're too old or they're too young.

sense_groups.chinese: 彼特为我疯狂
sense_groups.english: And there's Pete, who's crazy about me...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是那么完美 我对他是手到擒来
sense_groups.english: ...and he's absolutely perfect, and there's, like, zip going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我真的有毛病吗
sense_groups.english: Seriously. Does it sound like something's wrong with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 应该是吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, kind of.

sense_groups.chinese: 开心 我该那么做吗 维多
sense_groups.english: Happy? Is that what I'm supposed to be, Vic?

sense_groups.chinese: 开心
sense_groups.english: Happy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你何不告诉我你想怎么做
sense_groups.english: Well, why don't you tell me what you're supposed to be? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我就是搞不懂
sense_groups.english: Because I sure as hell can't figure it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说话 你没反应
sense_groups.english: I talk to you, and nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看着我 完全没反应
sense_groups.english: You look at me, and it's nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是没反应
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Tasty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的开始觉得你们有一段情 太棒了
sense_groups.english: I'm really starting to feel like you guys have a history. It's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对这场戏有个问题 - 请说
sense_groups.english: I have a question about this scene. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不了解 为什么安德丽娜会喜欢维多
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't understand why Adrianne's attracted to Victor.

sense_groups.chinese: 要抽丝剥茧
sense_groups.english: Peel the onion.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先他长得很帅
sense_groups.english: First of all, he's good-looking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我的角色还需要其他的理由
sense_groups.english: I think my character is gonna need a bit more of a reason than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个理由可以吗 剧本是那么写的
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, how about this one? Uh, it says so in the script.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道为什么我的角色会喜欢你
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't know why my character likes you either.

sense_groups.chinese: 剧本上写着你是个贱人
sense_groups.english: I mean, it says in the script here that you're a bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 剧本才没有那么写 - 我的剧本就是那么写的
sense_groups.english: It doesn't say that in the script. - It does in mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以把它吹干 或是涂发胶 那一点都不重要
sense_groups.english: I can blow-dry it, I can put gel on it. It doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 中间那个部分
sense_groups.english: I still wind up with this little cowlick-y thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是翘了起来 真的很讨厌
sense_groups.english: ...on the middle part of my head. It's so annoying.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得困扰吗 - 是你让我觉得困扰
sense_groups.english: Does it bug you? - You bug me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有可能没看到这一幕吗
sense_groups.english: Is there any chance you didn't see that?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别再那么做了
sense_groups.english: Ross, you gotta stop, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能连续盯着窥视孔三小时
sense_groups.english: You can't just stare through the peephole for three hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的眼睛会坏掉的
sense_groups.english: You're gonna get peep-eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道 我一直都知道她喜欢他
sense_groups.english: I knew it. I knew it. I always knew she liked him.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可以拒绝的 看看她做了什么
sense_groups.english: She'd say no, but here we are, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才刚分手 她马上就跟他约会
sense_groups.english: We just broke up, first thing she does.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是才刚分手
sense_groups.english: You didn't just break up.

sense_groups.chinese: 才三星期而已
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's been, like, three weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在以为你们分手后三小时就跑去跟别人上床
sense_groups.english: You slept with somebody three hours after you thought you broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 子弹飞出去的速度都没那么快
sense_groups.english: I mean, bullets have left guns slower.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们回来了
sense_groups.english: Here they come. Here they... Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她跟他吻别 我发誓我要自杀
sense_groups.english: If she kisses him good night, I'm gonna kill myself. I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不下去了
sense_groups.english: I can't watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 约会结束了
sense_groups.english: Come on. Date over. Date over.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 她要进去了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Here we go. She's going in. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要进去了 等一下 他也进去了
sense_groups.english: She's going in. Ha, ha. Wait. He's going in.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要进去了
sense_groups.english: He's going in.

sense_groups.chinese: 门关上了 门关着我看不到
sense_groups.english: The door's closed. I can't see anything with the door closed.

sense_groups.chinese: 发明门的人可以安息了
sense_groups.english: And the inventor of the door rests happily in his grave.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得想想办法 我必须阻止他们
sense_groups.english: Okay, I have to do something. I mean, I have to stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 阻止他们做什么 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Stop what? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但直觉跟我说换作是我 我们会做什么
sense_groups.english: But I have a feeling that my being there will do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要过去借东西
sense_groups.english: I'll go over and I will borrow something.

sense_groups.chinese: 果汁 我需要果汁 - 不
sense_groups.english: Juice. I need juice. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可以 - 帮帮我
sense_groups.english: You can't. - A little help.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得阻止他们 - 我是你的朋友
sense_groups.english: They must be stopped. - I am your friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能让你这么做
sense_groups.english: ...and I am not gonna let you do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的好壮
sense_groups.english: You are surprisingly strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要果汁 人们需要果汁 - 听着
sense_groups.english: I need juice. People need juice. - Look, man...

sense_groups.chinese: 人们需要果汁 他们需要… - 听我说
sense_groups.english: People need juice. Juice. They need... - Listen to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她展开新生活了 就算不是他 也会是别人
sense_groups.english: She's moving on, okay? If it's not this guy, it's gonna be somebody else.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你考虑租用我的窥视孔
sense_groups.english: And unless you're thinking about subletting my peephole...

sense_groups.chinese: 你得接受事实 你们结束了
sense_groups.english: ...you are gonna have to get used to the fact that the relationship is over.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 你们结束了
sense_groups.english: Okay, man? It's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想她
sense_groups.english: It's just I miss her so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你们的马克杯底写着编号
sense_groups.english: Why do all your coffee mugs have numbers on the bottom?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样子摩妮卡才能加以追踪
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so Monica can keep track.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有杯子不见了 她会说"27号杯在哪里"
sense_groups.english: That way, if one of them is missing, she can be like, "Where's number 27?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想我不要知道
sense_groups.english: No, and I don't think I'm gonna want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法
sense_groups.english: I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 所以我不想知道
sense_groups.english: Yep. Yep. That's what I didn't want to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 马克 我这么做是不对的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh, Mark, I'm just doing this for the wrong reasons, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想报复罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm just doing it to get back at Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 这对你来说不公平
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's not very fair to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 公平 天啊 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: Ah. Fair, shmair. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 如果你想报复罗斯 我可以帮你
sense_groups.english: Look, you wanna get back at Ross, I am here for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说我们就在这张沙发上 好好地报复他吧
sense_groups.english: No, no. I say we get back at him right here on this couch. Right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: You sure? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以回家自己报复他
sense_groups.english: I can just go home and get back at him by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 那会是21世纪的盘尼西林
sense_groups.english: And should become the penicillin of the 21 st century.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在这家医院要迈开大步
sense_groups.english: And so today, this hospital is about to take major steps...

sense_groups.chinese: 领导这场革命
sense_groups.english: ...toward leading that revolution.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太讽刺了 - 我能问你一件事吗
sense_groups.english: It is truly ironic. - Hey. Can I ask you something?

sense_groups.chinese: 目前是什么状况
sense_groups.english: Where are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 看到那些医生跟护士
sense_groups.english: Well, with all these doctors and nurses...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该是矮人马戏团
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna say, Midget Rodeo.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我说实话
sense_groups.english: Just tell me the truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我没跟你提过这件事
sense_groups.english: Um, you know, I don't think I told you this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚结束一段认真的恋情
sense_groups.english: ...but, um, I just recently got out of a really serious relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那不是一年前的事吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Wasn't that like a year ago?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说过了
sense_groups.english: So I did tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那不是问题
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, you know, that's not really the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 问题是我现在的生活状态是
sense_groups.english: The thing is, is that right now I'm just in a place in my life...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想好好做自己
sense_groups.english: ...where I just need to focus on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你了解我的意思吗 - 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: Do you know what I mean? - Oh, yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想喜欢你 - 但你不喜欢我 好吧
sense_groups.english: I so want to be attracted to you. - But you're not. Okay. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 别那么说 这不是…
sense_groups.english: You know what? Don't be. This is not...

sense_groups.chinese: 别那么说 真的没那么糟糕
sense_groups.english: Don't be, because it's not so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 - 对 我知道我不是琼邦•乔飞
sense_groups.english: It's not? - Yeah. I know I'm no Jon Bon Jovi.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是你喜欢的那一型
sense_groups.english: Or someone you find attractive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得…
sense_groups.english: I just think, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你终究会爱上我
sense_groups.english: ...that you might end up feeling differently.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我没有恶意
sense_groups.english: Well, look, I don't want this to come out wrong...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我刚刚拒绝了你 你似乎还蛮有自信的
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, you seem awfully confident for a guy I just told I wasn't attracted to.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我超迷人的对吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, stupidly charming, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你要吃点东西吗
sense_groups.english: Uh, listen. Let's... You wanna get something to eat?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里让人觉得压力好大
sense_groups.english: Because this place is kind of depressing.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎幕后大功臣彼特•贝克先生
sense_groups.english: Now the man who made this possible, Mr. Peter Becker.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: One second.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这个小镇容不下我们两个
sense_groups.english: I don't think this town is big enough for the both of us to relax in.

sense_groups.chinese: 拔枪吧
sense_groups.english: Draw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都没做
sense_groups.english: I wasn't doing anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 她又做了什么
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. What did she do now?

sense_groups.chinese: 她念过耶鲁戏剧系 她就觉得她是自从有面包片以来
sense_groups.english: Just because she went to Yale Drama, she thinks she's, like, the greatest actress...

sense_groups.chinese: 最伟大的女演员
sense_groups.english: ...since sliced bread.

sense_groups.chinese: 面包片 超棒的马克白夫人
sense_groups.english: Ah, Sliced Bread. A wonderful Lady Macbeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我恨她 我讨厌她说"我超有天分的"
sense_groups.english: God, I just... I hate her. I hate her with her "Oh, I'm so talented"...

sense_groups.chinese: "我真的好漂亮 我闻起来好香"
sense_groups.english: ...and "Oh, I'm so pretty," and "Oh, I smell so good."

sense_groups.chinese: 我想有人喜欢上某人了
sense_groups.english: I think somebody has a crush on somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 拜托你专心在我的问题上
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, can we please try and stay focused on my problem here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是在说你 大怪胎
sense_groups.english: I'm talking about you, you big, big freak.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了
sense_groups.english: Oh. You're out of your mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 过去48小时以来 你满口都是她
sense_groups.english: Hey, you've done nothing but talk about her for the last 48 hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你还在念小学
sense_groups.english: If you were in school yard...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会拉她的马尾 把她推倒
sense_groups.english: ...you'd be pulling her pigtails and pushing her down now.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 为什么我满脑子都是她
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Then how come I keep thinking about her...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有春梦呢
sense_groups.english: ...in all these sexual scenarios and stuff, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 开心 我该那么做吗 维多 开心
sense_groups.english: Happy? Is that what I'm supposed to be, Vic? Happy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你何不告诉我你想怎么做
sense_groups.english: Well, why don't you tell me what you're supposed to be, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我就是搞不懂
sense_groups.english: Because I sure as hell can't figure it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说话 你没反应
sense_groups.english: I talk to you, and it's nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看着我 完全没反应
sense_groups.english: You look at me, and nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是没反应
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们让我想飞上天
sense_groups.english: You guys make me fly.

sense_groups.chinese: 飞很高
sense_groups.english: High.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 明天从这里接下去
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're gonna pick it up here tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是… - 好多了
sense_groups.english: Well, that was, uh... - Better?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那真的是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, it was definitely...

sense_groups.chinese: 一大进步
sense_groups.english: ...an improvement.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 - 凯特
sense_groups.english: Good night. - Uh, Kate.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你忘了穿鞋
sense_groups.english: You, uh... You forgot your shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我需要鞋子 对吧
sense_groups.english: I'm probably gonna need those, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 听着
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Hey, listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 要一起喝杯咖啡吗
sense_groups.english: ...you, uh, feel like getting a cup of coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Um... Yo. - Kate.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备要走了吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: You ready to go? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好
sense_groups.english: Very nice. Very nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就…
sense_groups.english: So, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 明天见 - 当然
sense_groups.english: See you tomorrow, huh? - Yeah. Yeah. Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Right. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不是"蜘蛛人"
sense_groups.english: Why isn't it "Spiderman"?

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如葛德曼或席佛曼
sense_groups.english: You know, like Goldman, Silverman?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那不是他的姓氏
sense_groups.english: Because it's not his last name.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 - 没错 他又不是…
sense_groups.english: It isn't? - No, it's not, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲尔•史派德曼
sense_groups.english: Like Phil Spiderman.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是变身为蜘殊的…
sense_groups.english: He's a spider...

sense_groups.chinese: 人
sense_groups.english: ...man.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛德曼是姓氏
sense_groups.english: You know, like, uh... Like Goldman is a last name.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是根本就没有金人
sense_groups.english: But there's no gold man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该有金人的
sense_groups.english: There should be a Gold Man.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 工作还顺利吧 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: How was work? - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我一屁股坐下 发现根本没有椅子
sense_groups.english: Although I did sit down where there wasn't a chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 罗斯把你的东西拿过来
sense_groups.english: By the way, Ross dropped by a box of your stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我早就知道他会那么做
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I guess I had that one coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把它拿去丢了 或许只是一堆洗发精跟…
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna throw it out. It's probably just a bunch of shampoo and...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Something wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没事
sense_groups.english: Hmm. No. Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 金人有什么样的力量
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what kind of powers would Gold Man have?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他能点石成金
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, he would turn things to gold.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那本来就是黄金呢 - 他就完成了他的使命
sense_groups.english: What about things that are already gold? - Ah. His work is done.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 来玩我的游戏
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's play my game.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你这个王八蛋
sense_groups.english: All right, you yellow-bellied, lily-livered...

sense_groups.chinese: 拔枪吧
sense_groups.english: Draw.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这真的很好玩
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's fun.

questions.name: S03E20
questions.en:
Wait a minute. You're telling me this actress person...
...is the only woman you ever wanted who didn't want you back?
Yeah.
Oh, my God.
Is this what it's like to be you?
Wow, you're really crazy about her, huh? - Oh. You have no idea.
And when we're on-stage, I get to kiss her and touch her.
But then she goes home with the director...
...and it's like somebody's ripping out my heart.
Oh, it's so great to see you feeling like this.
Hey. - Hey.
Monica, uh, Dad called this morning...
...and, uh, Aunt Sylvia passed away.
Yes. Yes. Yeah, yeah, yeah.
We were all pretty shaken up about it.
Wait, am I missing something?
Because I always thought death was supposed to be sad, in a way.
Well, uh, Aunt Sylvia was...
...well, not a nice person.
No, she was a cruel, cranky old bitch.
And I'm sorry she died.
Did Dad say I get the dollhouse?
You get the dollhouse. - I get the dollhouse.
Wow. A house for dolls. That is so cool.
When I was a kid, I had a barrel.
Uh, Pheebs, you had a barrel for a dollhouse?
No, just a barrel.
You know what? You can play with my dollhouse.
Really? Really? - Any time you want.
When I was younger, all I wanted to do was to play with this dollhouse.
But no. It was to be looked at, but never played with.
My grandmother used to say that exact same thing to me.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey, Sophie. - Hey, Rach.
Hey. - Hey.
Thanks for lunch, Chandler. You didn't have to walk me here.
Oh, that's okay. No problem.
Honey, you do realize we don't keep the women's lingerie here in the office.
Yes, I realize that.
Summer catalog. - That's the stuff.
Rachel, I need the Versace invoice.
Hello. You don't work for me.
Joanna, this is my friend Chandler Bing. Joanna.
Bing? Heh. That's a great name.
Thanks, it's Gaelic for, "Thy turkey's done."
So, uh, I'm gonna go. Nice meeting you. - You too.
Bye, Chandler.
So, uh, what's wrong with him?
Oh, nothing. He's just goofy like that. I actually hardly notice it anymore.
Oh, no, no, no. I mean, is he, um, married or involved with anyone?
No, no. He's not married or involved with anyone.
Oh, Rachel...
Actually, you know what? Forget it.
I'll ask him for you if you want me to. - Would you?
Or is it just too sad and desperate...
...you know, something that Sophie would do?
I am here. - I know that.
Look at it.
Wallpaper's a little faded. That's okay.
Carpet's a little loose.
Hardwood floors?
Hey. Oh! - Hello.
Oh, Monica.
It's so beautiful. - I know.
So I'm here, ready to play. Hee-hee. - Okay.
I brought a bunch of stuff for the house, so check it out. Ha, ha.
What's this?
That's a dog. Every house should have a dog.
Not one that can pee on the roof.
Well, maybe it's so big because the house was built on radioactive waste.
And is this in case the house sneezes?
No. No, that's the ghost for the attic.
I don't want a ghost. - Well, nobody wants a ghost.
But you've got one...
...because the house is sitting on an ancient Indian burial ground.
Wait a minute. The house was built on radioactive waste...
...and an ancient Indian burial ground?
Ha, ha. That would never happen.
Okay, obviously you don't know much about the U.S. Government. Ha, ha.
Hey. - Hey.
I need to talk to you. - Sure. What's up?
Oh, sorry. I meant Chandler.
Heh. I know.
Well, if something comes up...
Well, I'm glad you guys are past that little awkward phase.
Okay. My boss, Joanna. When you left...
...she started asking questions about you.
Ha, ha. Liked what she saw, huh?
Dug my action, did she?
Checking out the Chan Chan Man.
That was...
...surreal.
Okay, what do you think? You interested at all?
Yeah, she seemed cool, attractive. I'll do it.
Oh, thank you, Chandler. This is great. She's gonna love me.
Okay, dinosaur attack. Quick, everybody into the house. Aah!
All right, Phoebe, you know what? That's it. That's it. All right?
No dinosaurs, no ghosts, no giant dogs, okay?
They're not the right size, they're not Victorian, and they just don't go.
Okay.
Fine.
Come, dinosaur. We're not welcome in the house of no imagination.
Uh, Pheebs, while we're hovering around the subject...
...I just have to say that dinosaurs, they don't go, "Ruff."
The little ones do.
Hey, Kate. - Morning.
Listen, I, uh, went to that restaurant you talked about...
Hey, lovely.
Come, talk to me for a minute.
And I ate the food. It was good. I had the fish.
Yeah, it was pretty good. Yeah.
Hi.
I'm Lauren. Kate's understudy.
Oh. Hey. Joey Tribbiani.
I know. I'm a big fan of yours.
What?
I used to, um, schedule my classes so I could watch Dr. Drake Ramoray...
...on Days of our Lives.
Get out of here. Really?
Absolutely.
Oh, but then they went and dropped you down that elevator shaft.
Yeah, they gave me the shaft, all right.
You're so funny.
Listen, um, what are you doing after rehearsal?
Do you wanna get a drink or something?
Well, uh...
Yeah. Yeah, sure. A drink sounds great.
Cool. I'll see you then. - Okay. All right.
All right. It's time to act, my talking props.
Hey. - Hey.
Look, everybody. Look at my new dollhouse.
Ha, ha. Look, look.
Hey, what's this?
Oh, okay. It's a slide instead of stairs. Look.
Very interesting, Phoebe.
What's this?
The licorice room. You can eat all the furniture.
And when guests come over, they can stay on the Tootsie Roll-away bed.
This is the coolest house ever.
Hey. Does anyone want to join me in the Aroma Room?
All right. - I would.
Hey, guys? Guys.
Did you see my new china cabinet?
Watch. Watch.
And? And?
Hey, my father's house does that.
Okay, how did it go? Tell me everything.
Well, the movie was great...
...dinner was great, and there's nothing like a cool, crisp New York evening.
Of course, I didn't get to enjoy any of that because Joanna's such a big dull dud.
Chandler is fantastic.
What? - Oh, God. You know how people just click?
Like, he came by to pick me up. I opened the door, and it was just like, "click."
Did he tell you? - Well...
Oh, and he's got such a good heart. Doesn't he have a good heart?
Oh, I know. And he's so sweet.
He said he'd call, so put him straight through.
Isn't this great? - Don't spoil it.
Come on, baby, don't go. Please?
What do you say?
Hello? Oh!
It's you. Just, uh... Just one sec.
I am going to take this call.
When I continue, I hope that there will appear on-stage...
...this magical thing that in the theater we call...
...committing to the moment.
The guy's like a cartoon.
What do you see in him, anyway?
He happens to be brilliant.
Which is more than I can say for that sweater you're dating.
Hey, I'm not interested in her sweater.
It's what's underneath her sweater that counts.
And besides, since, uh...
Since when do you care who I'm going out with?
I don't care. Why? Do you want me to care?
Heh. Do you want me to want you to care?
Do you?
What?
Okay. I'm afraid to say this, but let's pick it up where we left off.
Come on, baby, don't go. Please? What do you say?
I've got no reason to stay.
Stop.
Stop it. You must stop.
You are bad actors.
This is a terrible play.
I'll see you in the morning.
I can't believe we go on in a week.
Hey, it's gonna be all right.
So since we're getting off early, do you want to go and paint mugs?
What?
You know, at that place I told you about last night?
Oh, yeah, with the mug-painting. Yeah.
I was so listening to that.
But, uh, you know what? I think I need to work on my stuff tonight.
Oh, okay. - Okay.
I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.
Okay. Ha, ha. - Night.
Uh, are you okay?
Yeah, I guess.
Like, what are we gonna do about the scene, huh?
I don't know.
Well, um...
Maybe if it had more heat.
Well, how do you mean?
Well, Adrianne's looking for a reason to stay, right?
Victor can't just kiss her. He's gotta...
He's gotta really give her a reason, you know?
Maybe he could slip her the tongue.
Or maybe...
Maybe he could grab her and lift her up.
Yeah, yeah. Then Adrianne, maybe she could wrap her legs around his waist.
And then she could rip off his shirt and kiss his chest and his stomach.
And then he could use his teeth, his teeth, to undo her dress and...
And bite her.
And then right when the scene ends, he could take her...
...with this raw, animal...
Something like that?
Yeah, that's pretty much what I had in mind.
Yeah. - Yeah.
Hi. - Hey.
It's a little early to be drinking.
Things, uh, finally happened with Kate.
Oh. That's great. - You're kidding. That's great.
Oh, it was so amazing.
After the lovemaking...
Oh, my.
I just watched her sleep for, like, hours.
Just breathing in...
...and breathing out.
And I knew she was dreaming because her eyes kept going like this
I'm telling you, Joanna's got it all wrong, okay?
All I said was, "This was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
I'll give you a call."
I wonder why she thinks you're going to call her?
That's what you say at the end of a date.
You can't just say, "Nice to meet you. Good night"?
To her face?
It's the end of the date, I'm standing there...
...she's waiting for me to say I'll call her...
...and it just, you know, comes out. I can't help it.
It's a compulsion.
Come on, Rach, when a guy says he's gonna call...
...it doesn't mean he's going to call.
This never happened to you?
Well, they always called.
Bite me.
Did he call? - No, sorry.
Why? Why? He said he'd call. Why hasn't he called?
Maybe he's intimidated by really smart, strong, successful women.
Sophie, will you please climb out of my butt.
Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? - Okay, okay.
Um, well, uh, maybe he feels awkward because you are my boss.
Awkward? Why should he feel awkward?
The only person that should feel awkward is you.
You didn't tell him not to call me?
If you're uncomfortable with your friend dating someone you work for...
...there are always ways to fix that.
Call her. Call her now.
Multiple, so many paper cuts.
"Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? Why?
I don't understand. He said he'd call."
Chandler, I'm telling you, she's flipped out. She's gone crazy.
Oh. Well, give me the phone, then.
This isn't funny. She thinks it's my fault you haven't called her.
You have to call her.
Look, you can't call somebody after this long just to say
"In case you didn't notice, I don't like you."
Then you're gonna have to take her out again.
No. She's really dull, and she gets this...
...gross mascara-goop thing in the corner of her eye.
I don't care. I don't care.

All right, Phoebe, you know what? That's it. That's it. All right?
No dinosaurs, no ghosts, no giant dogs, okay?
They're not the right size, they're not Victorian, and they just don't go.
Okay.
Fine.
Come, dinosaur. We're not welcome in the house of no imagination.
Uh, Pheebs, while we're hovering around the subject...
...I just have to say that dinosaurs, they don't go, "Ruff."
The little ones do.
Hey, Kate. - Morning.
Listen, I, uh, went to that restaurant you talked about...
Hey, lovely.
Come, talk to me for a minute.
And I ate the food. It was good. I had the fish.
Yeah, it was pretty good. Yeah.
Hi.
I'm Lauren. Kate's understudy.
Oh. Hey. Joey Tribbiani.
I know. I'm a big fan of yours.
What?
I used to, um, schedule my classes so I could watch Dr. Drake Ramoray...
...on Days of our Lives.
Get out of here. Really?
Absolutely.
Oh, but then they went and dropped you down that elevator shaft.
Yeah, they gave me the shaft, all right.
You're so funny.
Listen, um, what are you doing after rehearsal?
Do you wanna get a drink or something?
Well, uh...
Yeah. Yeah, sure. A drink sounds great.
Cool. I'll see you then. - Okay. All right.
All right. It's time to act, my talking props.
Hey. - Hey.
Look, everybody. Look at my new dollhouse.
Ha, ha. Look, look.
Hey, what's this?
Oh, okay. It's a slide instead of stairs. Look.
Very interesting, Phoebe.
What's this?
The licorice room. You can eat all the furniture.
And when guests come over, they can stay on the Tootsie Roll-away bed.
This is the coolest house ever.
Hey. Does anyone want to join me in the Aroma Room?
All right. - I would.
Hey, guys? Guys.
Did you see my new china cabinet?
Watch. Watch.
And? And?
Hey, my father's house does that.
Okay, how did it go? Tell me everything.
Well, the movie was great...
...dinner was great, and there's nothing like a cool, crisp New York evening.
Of course, I didn't get to enjoy any of that because Joanna's such a big dull dud.
Chandler is fantastic.
What? - Oh, God. You know how people just click?
Like, he came by to pick me up. I opened the door, and it was just like, "click."
Did he tell you? - Well...
Oh, and he's got such a good heart. Doesn't he have a good heart?
Oh, I know. And he's so sweet.
He said he'd call, so put him straight through.
Isn't this great? - Don't spoil it.
Come on, baby, don't go. Please?
What do you say?
Hello? Oh!
It's you. Just, uh... Just one sec.
I am going to take this call.
When I continue, I hope that there will appear on-stage...
...this magical thing that in the theater we call...
...committing to the moment.
The guy's like a cartoon.
What do you see in him, anyway?
He happens to be brilliant.
Which is more than I can say for that sweater you're dating.
Hey, I'm not interested in her sweater.
It's what's underneath her sweater that counts.
And besides, since, uh...
Since when do you care who I'm going out with?
I don't care. Why? Do you want me to care?
Heh. Do you want me to want you to care?
Do you?
What?
Okay. I'm afraid to say this, but let's pick it up where we left off.
Come on, baby, don't go. Please? What do you say?
I've got no reason to stay.
Stop.
Stop it. You must stop.
You are bad actors.
This is a terrible play.
I'll see you in the morning.
I can't believe we go on in a week.
Hey, it's gonna be all right.
So since we're getting off early, do you want to go and paint mugs?
What?
You know, at that place I told you about last night?
Oh, yeah, with the mug-painting. Yeah.
I was so listening to that.
But, uh, you know what? I think I need to work on my stuff tonight.
Oh, okay. - Okay.
I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.
Okay. Ha, ha. - Night.
Uh, are you okay?
Yeah, I guess.
Like, what are we gonna do about the scene, huh?
I don't know.
Well, um...
Maybe if it had more heat.
Well, how do you mean?
Well, Adrianne's looking for a reason to stay, right?
Victor can't just kiss her. He's gotta...
He's gotta really give her a reason, you know?
Maybe he could slip her the tongue.
Or maybe...
Maybe he could grab her and lift her up.
Yeah, yeah. Then Adrianne, maybe she could wrap her legs around his waist.
And then she could rip off his shirt and kiss his chest and his stomach.
And then he could use his teeth, his teeth, to undo her dress and...
And bite her.
And then right when the scene ends, he could take her...
...with this raw, animal...
Something like that?
Yeah, that's pretty much what I had in mind.
Yeah. - Yeah.
Hi. - Hey.
It's a little early to be drinking.
Things, uh, finally happened with Kate.
Oh. That's great. - You're kidding. That's great.
Oh, it was so amazing.
After the lovemaking...
Oh, my.
I just watched her sleep for, like, hours.
Just breathing in...
...and breathing out.
And I knew she was dreaming because her eyes kept going like this
I'm telling you, Joanna's got it all wrong, okay?
All I said was, "This was fun. Let's do it again sometime.
I'll give you a call."
I wonder why she thinks you're going to call her?
That's what you say at the end of a date.
You can't just say, "Nice to meet you. Good night"?
To her face?
It's the end of the date, I'm standing there...
...she's waiting for me to say I'll call her...
...and it just, you know, comes out. I can't help it.
It's a compulsion.
Come on, Rach, when a guy says he's gonna call...
...it doesn't mean he's going to call.
This never happened to you?
Well, they always called.
Bite me.
Did he call? - No, sorry.
Why? Why? He said he'd call. Why hasn't he called?
Maybe he's intimidated by really smart, strong, successful women.
Sophie, will you please climb out of my butt.
Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? - Okay, okay.
Um, well, uh, maybe he feels awkward because you are my boss.
Awkward? Why should he feel awkward?
The only person that should feel awkward is you.
You didn't tell him not to call me?
If you're uncomfortable with your friend dating someone you work for...
...there are always ways to fix that.
Call her. Call her now.
Multiple, so many paper cuts.
"Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? Why?
I don't understand. He said he'd call."
Chandler, I'm telling you, she's flipped out. She's gone crazy.
Oh. Well, give me the phone, then.
This isn't funny. She thinks it's my fault you haven't called her.
You have to call her.
Look, you can't call somebody after this long just to say
"In case you didn't notice, I don't like you."
Then you're gonna have to take her out again.
No. She's really dull, and she gets this...
...gross mascara-goop thing in the corner of her eye.
I don't care. I don't care.
You'll take her out again and end it...
...and end it in a way that she knows it's actually ended.
And I don't care how hard it is for you. Do not tell her you'll call her again.
All right, fine.
But it's just a lunch date. From now on, I get my own dates.
I don't want you setting me up with anybody again.
That's fine.
That's just a lot of big talk, you know. - I know.
Mon?
I'm in the shower.
Aah! Fire. There's a fire. Fire.
Hey. - Hi.
So I, uh, talked to Lauren. I kind of told her how things were with us.
Did you, uh...? Did you talk to Marshall?
About what?
Ha, ha. You know, about what happened with us.
No.
And there's really no reason why he should find out.
So, uh, let's not make a big deal out of it, okay?
What are you talking about?
It was a big deal.
I mean, come on, you can't tell me last night didn't mean something to you.
I was there. You're not that good an actress.
Look.
Um, I was... I was just caught up in the moment.
That's all it was.
Joey, I'm sorry you feel bad...
...but haven't you ever slept with a woman where it meant more to her than to you?
No.
Hi, Kate. - Hi, Lauren.
Hi, Lauren.
Hi, pig.
Sorry I, uh... I scared you in there.
Oh, that's okay.
By the way...
...I was just checking the shower massager.
Yeah.
Hey.
I tried to reach you at work.
There's been a fire.
What? Oh, my... Oh, my God.
What happened?
Well, we believe it originated here...
...in the Aroma Room.
All right, did everyone get out okay?
Well, the giraffe's okay and so is the pirate.
What is this? - No, Phoebe, don't look.
You don't want to see what's under there.
The foster puppets.
It's not a big deal.
It's just... It's right here, and it's all the time.
Well, thanks again for lunch.
Yes, this was pleasant. - It was, wasn't it?
The food there was great. - Wasn't it?
So take care.
You too.
This was great. I'll give you a call. We should do it again.
Great. I'm looking forward to it.
Rachel, any messages? - Sophie's desk.
Chandler. Are you gonna call her?
No. - Chandler.
Look, I'm sorry, okay? I'm weak and pathetic and sorry.
Okay, you are gonna tell her. You're gonna tell her now.
Ow, I'm not gonna call you.
What?
I'm sorry.
I'm sorry that I said I was going to when I'm not.
Ugh. Look, this has nothing to do with you.
And this isn't Rachel's fault. It's me.
I have serious, serious problems when it comes to women.
I have issues with commitment, intimacy...
...mascara goop.
And I'm really sorry. It's just that this is not... This isn't gonna work out.
Well, this isn't how I was hoping this would end...
...but I guess I have to appreciate your honesty.
Yeah, okay.
So...
Well, this is great. I'll give you a call. We should do it again sometime.
Wha... So anyway, Beth, what I'm saying is...
...I should have considered your feelings before I went home with you that night.
I've, uh...
I've recently learned what it's like to be on your side of it...
...and I'm sorry.
So do you think you can forgive me?
Great. Thanks.
Okay. Bye.
Hello, Jennifer?
Oh, hi, Mrs. Laurio. Is Jennifer there?
Oh, she's not home, huh?
Well, uh, actually I kind of need to talk to you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你说这个女演员
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. You're telling me this actress person...

sense_groups.chinese: 是唯一你渴望着她 她却不要你的女人
sense_groups.english: ...is the only woman you ever wanted who didn't want you back?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的人生都是这样吗
sense_groups.english: Is this what it's like to be you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的爱上她了吧 - 你不懂
sense_groups.english: Wow, you're really crazy about her, huh? - Oh. You have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在舞台上 我得吻她跟触碰她
sense_groups.english: And when we're on-stage, I get to kiss her and touch her.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后她跟导演回家
sense_groups.english: But then she goes home with the director...

sense_groups.chinese: 那像是有人把我的心挖了出来一样
sense_groups.english: ...and it's like somebody's ripping out my heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴你也有这种感觉
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so great to see you feeling like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 今天早上爸打电话来
sense_groups.english: Monica, uh, Dad called this morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 席薇亚阿姨过世了
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, Aunt Sylvia passed away.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes. Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都很震惊
sense_groups.english: We were all pretty shaken up about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我是不是漏掉了什么事
sense_groups.english: Wait, am I missing something?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为死亡只会带来悲伤
sense_groups.english: Because I always thought death was supposed to be sad, in a way.

sense_groups.chinese: 席薇亚阿姨
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, Aunt Sylvia was...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是个好人
sense_groups.english: ...well, not a nice person.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 她是个残忍爱挑剔的老太婆
sense_groups.english: No, she was a cruel, cranky old bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾她过世了
sense_groups.english: And I'm sorry she died.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸说我得到娃娃屋了吗
sense_groups.english: Did Dad say I get the dollhouse?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得到娃娃屋了 - 我得到娃娃屋了
sense_groups.english: You get the dollhouse. - I get the dollhouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 娃娃住的房子 超棒的
sense_groups.english: Wow. A house for dolls. That is so cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 小时候我只有一个桶子
sense_groups.english: When I was a kid, I had a barrel.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你把娃娃放在桶子里
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs, you had a barrel for a dollhouse?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只有桶子
sense_groups.english: No, just a barrel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你可以玩我的娃娃屋
sense_groups.english: You know what? You can play with my dollhouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 随时都可以
sense_groups.english: Really? Really? - Any time you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 小时候我只想玩这个娃娃屋
sense_groups.english: When I was younger, all I wanted to do was to play with this dollhouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 它只能远观 不能亵玩
sense_groups.english: But no. It was to be looked at, but never played with.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前我奶奶也是那么说我的
sense_groups.english: My grandmother used to say that exact same thing to me.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 苏菲 - 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Sophie. - Hey, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你请我吃午餐 钱德 你不必陪我走回办公室
sense_groups.english: Thanks for lunch, Chandler. You didn't have to walk me here.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气 不成问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay. No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你知道我们不会把女用内衣放在办公室里

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道

sense_groups.chinese: 夏季型录 - 那才是我要的东西
sense_groups.english: Summer catalog. - That's the stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我要凡赛斯的发票
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I need the Versace invoice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 你不是我的员工
sense_groups.english: Hello. You don't work for me.

sense_groups.english: Joanna, this is my friend Chandler Bing. Joanna.

sense_groups.chinese: 宾 非常不错的姓氏
sense_groups.english: Bing? Heh. That's a great name.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 盖尔语的意思是"你的火鸡熟了"
sense_groups.english: Thanks, it's Gaelic for, "Thy turkey's done."

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 幸会 - 幸会
sense_groups.english: So, uh, I'm gonna go. Nice meeting you. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 钱德
sense_groups.english: Bye, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是怎么了
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what's wrong with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 他本来就呆呆的 我几乎不再注意到这一点

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说他已婚或有交往对象吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. I mean, is he, um, married or involved with anyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他是单身 也没有跟任何人交往
sense_groups.english: No, no. He's not married or involved with anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 算了
sense_groups.english: Actually, you know what? Forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要的话 我能帮你约他 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: I'll ask him for you if you want me to. - Would you?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不会显得我太悲惨绝望吗
sense_groups.english: Or is it just too sad and desperate...

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟苏菲会做的事一样
sense_groups.english: ...you know, something that Sophie would do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I am here. - I know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看
sense_groups.english: Look at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 壁纸有点褪色 没关系

sense_groups.chinese: 地毯有点松了

sense_groups.chinese: 硬木地板
