sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hey. Oh! - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 好漂亮 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: It's so beautiful. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来了 准备开始玩了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: So I'm here, ready to play. Hee-hee. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带了一些东西来装饰娃娃屋 看吧
sense_groups.english: I brought a bunch of stuff for the house, so check it out. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么
sense_groups.english: What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是狗 每间屋子都该有狗
sense_groups.english: That's a dog. Every house should have a dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要会在屋顶尿尿的狗
sense_groups.english: Not one that can pee on the roof.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他会这么大 因为屋子是用辐射废弃物盖成的
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe it's so big because the house was built on radioactive waste.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是为了预防屋子打喷嚏吗
sense_groups.english: And is this in case the house sneezes?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是阁楼的鬼魂
sense_groups.english: No. No, that's the ghost for the attic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要鬼 - 没有人要鬼
sense_groups.english: I don't want a ghost. - Well, nobody wants a ghost.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你有一个鬼
sense_groups.english: But you've got one...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为屋子盖在古老的印第安坟场上
sense_groups.english: ...because the house is sitting on an ancient Indian burial ground.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 屋子用辐射废弃物盖成
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. The house was built on radioactive waste...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且位于古老印第安坟场
sense_groups.english: ...and an ancient Indian burial ground?

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能会有那种事
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. That would never happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 显然你不太了解美国政府
sense_groups.english: Okay, obviously you don't know much about the U.S. Government. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得跟你谈一谈 - 没问题 什么事
sense_groups.english: I need to talk to you. - Sure. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我是指钱德
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry. I meant Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Heh. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有事的话…
sense_groups.english: Well, if something comes up...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你们度过尴尬期了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm glad you guys are past that little awkward phase.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我的上司 乔安娜 你离开后
sense_groups.english: Okay. My boss, Joanna. When you left...

sense_groups.chinese: 她开始问起关于你的问题
sense_groups.english: ...she started asking questions about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 看上眼了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Liked what she saw, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 她喜欢我的活力 对吧
sense_groups.english: Dug my action, did she?

sense_groups.chinese: 打探小钱钱的事
sense_groups.english: Checking out the Chan Chan Man.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的…
sense_groups.english: That was...

sense_groups.chinese: 太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: ...surreal.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你觉得呢 你有兴趣吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, what do you think? You interested at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她蛮酷的 也很迷人 我愿意
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she seemed cool, attractive. I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 钱德 这太棒了 她一定会爱死我的
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you, Chandler. This is great. She's gonna love me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 恐龙攻击 快点 大家躲进屋里
sense_groups.english: Okay, dinosaur attack. Quick, everybody into the house. Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 就那样 你知道吗 好吗
sense_groups.english: All right, Phoebe, you know what? That's it. That's it. All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不准有恐龙 鬼或大狗 好吗
sense_groups.english: No dinosaurs, no ghosts, no giant dogs, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 它们的尺寸不对 不是维多利亚时代风格 完全不配
sense_groups.english: They're not the right size, they're not Victorian, and they just don't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 恐龙 没想像力的屋子不欢迎我们
sense_groups.english: Come, dinosaur. We're not welcome in the house of no imagination.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 既然我们谈到这一点
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs, while we're hovering around the subject...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想说恐龙不会汪汪叫
sense_groups.english: ...I just have to say that dinosaurs, they don't go, "Ruff."

sense_groups.chinese: 小恐龙就会
sense_groups.english: The little ones do.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特 - 早安
sense_groups.english: Hey, Kate. - Morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我去了你提过的那家餐厅
sense_groups.english: Listen, I, uh, went to that restaurant you talked about...

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Hey, lovely.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我得跟你谈一下
sense_groups.english: Come, talk to me for a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃了那里的食物 真的很好吃 我点了鱼
sense_groups.english: And I ate the food. It was good. I had the fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那真的很不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it was pretty good. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是萝伦 凯特的替补演员
sense_groups.english: I'm Lauren. Kate's understudy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hey. Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我是你的超级粉丝
sense_groups.english: I know. I'm a big fan of yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 以前我会调整课表 只为了在"我们的日子"
sense_groups.english: I used to, um, schedule my classes so I could watch Dr. Drake Ramoray...

sense_groups.chinese: 看到德瑞克•雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: ...on Days of our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Get out of here. Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来他们把你推下电梯井
sense_groups.english: Oh, but then they went and dropped you down that elevator shaft.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他们真的杀了我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, they gave me the shaft, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的好好笑
sense_groups.english: You're so funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 彩排后你要做什么
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, what are you doing after rehearsal?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去喝一杯吗
sense_groups.english: Do you wanna get a drink or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 喝一杯是个好点子
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah, sure. A drink sounds great.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 到时候见 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Cool. I'll see you then. - Okay. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 该开始演戏了 我会说话的道具们
sense_groups.english: All right. It's time to act, my talking props.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家看吧 看看我的新娃娃屋
sense_groups.english: Look, everybody. Look at my new dollhouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Look, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那是用溜滑梯代替楼梯 看吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. It's a slide instead of stairs. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常有趣 菲比
sense_groups.english: Very interesting, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么
sense_groups.english: What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 甘草糖房间 家具都可以吃
sense_groups.english: The licorice room. You can eat all the furniture.

sense_groups.chinese: 客人来的时候 可以睡在糖果床上面
sense_groups.english: And when guests come over, they can stay on the Tootsie Roll-away bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是史上最酷的屋子
sense_groups.english: This is the coolest house ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要跟我一起到芬芳疗室
sense_groups.english: Hey. Does anyone want to join me in the Aroma Room?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 我要
sense_groups.english: All right. - I would.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys? Guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看到我的新瓷器柜了吗
sense_groups.english: Did you see my new china cabinet?

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧
sense_groups.english: Watch. Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有呢
sense_groups.english: And? And?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸的房子也会那样
sense_groups.english: Hey, my father's house does that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 怎么样 快告诉我
sense_groups.english: Okay, how did it go? Tell me everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 电影非常不错
sense_groups.english: Well, the movie was great...

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐非常不错 凉爽的纽约夜晚是最棒的
sense_groups.english: ...dinner was great, and there's nothing like a cool, crisp New York evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然我没办法好好享受 因为乔安娜超无聊的
sense_groups.english: Of course, I didn't get to enjoy any of that because Joanna's such a big dull dud.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Chandler is fantastic.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 天啊 你知道一拍即合吗
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, God. You know how people just click?

sense_groups.chinese: 他来家里接我 我一开门就觉得心动
sense_groups.english: Like, he came by to pick me up. I opened the door, and it was just like, "click."

sense_groups.chinese: 他有跟你说吗 - 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Did he tell you? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的很好心 他是个好心人吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, and he's got such a good heart. Doesn't he have a good heart?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 他真的好体贴
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know. And he's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他会打电话来 直接帮我接到办公室
sense_groups.english: He said he'd call, so put him straight through.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很棒吧 - 别扫兴
sense_groups.english: Isn't this great? - Don't spoil it.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 宝贝 别走 求求你
sense_groups.english: Come on, baby, don't go. Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello? Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 是你 等一下
sense_groups.english: It's you. Just, uh... Just one sec.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得接这通电话
sense_groups.english: I am going to take this call.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我希望在舞台上
sense_groups.english: When I continue, I hope that there will appear on-stage...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以看到魔法 在剧场界我们称之为
sense_groups.english: ...this magical thing that in the theater we call...

sense_groups.chinese: 入戏
sense_groups.english: ...committing to the moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙跟卡通人物一样
sense_groups.english: The guy's like a cartoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底看上他哪一点
sense_groups.english: What do you see in him, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 他非常聪明
sense_groups.english: He happens to be brilliant.

sense_groups.chinese: 比跟你约会的毛衣女好多了
sense_groups.english: Which is more than I can say for that sweater you're dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对她的毛衣没兴趣
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm not interested in her sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 重要的是毛衣下面的东西
sense_groups.english: It's what's underneath her sweater that counts.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且…
sense_groups.english: And besides, since, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛在乎我跟谁约会
sense_groups.english: Since when do you care who I'm going out with?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 为什么 你要我在乎吗
sense_groups.english: I don't care. Why? Do you want me to care?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我希望你在乎吗
sense_groups.english: Heh. Do you want me to want you to care?

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: Do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 恐怕我得这么做 从刚刚中断那里开始
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm afraid to say this, but let's pick it up where we left off.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 宝贝 别走 求求你 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: Come on, baby, don't go. Please? What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有留下来的理由
sense_groups.english: I've got no reason to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 停
sense_groups.english: Stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 停 你们必须停下来
sense_groups.english: Stop it. You must stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都是烂演员
sense_groups.english: You are bad actors.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是出烂戏
sense_groups.english: This is a terrible play.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天早上见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信再过一星期我们就要演出
sense_groups.english: I can't believe we go on in a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定不会有问题的
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's gonna be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然提早收工 你要去画马克杯吗
sense_groups.english: So since we're getting off early, do you want to go and paint mugs?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我跟你提过的那个地方
sense_groups.english: You know, at that place I told you about last night?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 画马克杯
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, with the mug-painting. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有注意听
sense_groups.english: I was so listening to that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我想今晚我得练习一下
sense_groups.english: But, uh, you know what? I think I need to work on my stuff tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天见 - 好的
sense_groups.english: I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ha, ha. - Night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该没事
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该如何演这场戏
sense_groups.english: Like, what are we gonna do about the scene, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该激烈一点
sense_groups.english: Maybe if it had more heat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思
sense_groups.english: Well, how do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 安德丽娜在找理由留下来 对吧
sense_groups.english: Well, Adrianne's looking for a reason to stay, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 维多不能只是吻她 他必须…
sense_groups.english: Victor can't just kiss her. He's gotta...

sense_groups.chinese: 他必须给她一个理由 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: He's gotta really give her a reason, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他可以跟她舌吻
sense_groups.english: Maybe he could slip her the tongue.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许…
sense_groups.english: Or maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他可以抓住她 把她抱起来
sense_groups.english: Maybe he could grab her and lift her up.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 安德丽娜用脚环住他的腰
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. Then Adrianne, maybe she could wrap her legs around his waist.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后她撕开他的衬衫 亲他的胸膛跟肚子
sense_groups.english: And then she could rip off his shirt and kiss his chest and his stomach.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以用他的牙齿扯开她的洋装
sense_groups.english: And then he could use his teeth, his teeth, to undo her dress and...

sense_groups.chinese: 还要咬她
sense_groups.english: And bite her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这场戏结束时他可以占有她
sense_groups.english: And then right when the scene ends, he could take her...

sense_groups.chinese: 发挥他的原始兽性
sense_groups.english: ...with this raw, animal...

sense_groups.chinese: 就像那样吗
sense_groups.english: Something like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 差不多跟我想的一样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's pretty much what I had in mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在喝酒太早了
sense_groups.english: It's a little early to be drinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于跟凯特更进一步了
sense_groups.english: Things, uh, finally happened with Kate.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑 太棒了 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh. That's great. - You're kidding. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, it was so amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她做爱后…
sense_groups.english: After the lovemaking...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看着她沉睡 一 看就好几个小时
sense_groups.english: I just watched her sleep for, like, hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 她只是在吸气
sense_groups.english: Just breathing in...

sense_groups.chinese: 吐气
sense_groups.english: ...and breathing out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道她在做梦 因为她的眼睛是这样的
sense_groups.english: And I knew she was dreaming because her eyes kept going like this

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说乔安娜误会了 好吗
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, Joanna's got it all wrong, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是说"这真的很好玩 我们有空再出来"
sense_groups.english: All I said was, "This was fun. Let's do it again sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: "我会打电话给你"
sense_groups.english: I'll give you a call."

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道为什么 她以为你会打电话给她
sense_groups.english: I wonder why she thinks you're going to call her?

sense_groups.chinese: 约会后就得那么说
sense_groups.english: That's what you say at the end of a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就不能说"幸会 晚安"吗
sense_groups.english: You can't just say, "Nice to meet you. Good night"?

sense_groups.chinese: 当她的面说
sense_groups.english: To her face?

sense_groups.chinese: 那时我们结束约会 我站在那里
sense_groups.english: It's the end of the date, I'm standing there...

sense_groups.chinese: 她等着我说我会打电话给她
sense_groups.english: ...she's waiting for me to say I'll call her...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是脱口而出 无法控制自己
sense_groups.english: ...and it just, you know, comes out. I can't help it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一时冲动
sense_groups.english: It's a compulsion.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 瑞秋 男人说他会打电话
sense_groups.english: Come on, Rach, when a guy says he's gonna call...

sense_groups.chinese: 不代表他一定会打
sense_groups.english: ...it doesn't mean he's going to call.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没遇过那种事吗
sense_groups.english: This never happened to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一向会打电话来
sense_groups.english: Well, they always called.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Bite me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有打电话来吗 - 没有 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Did he call? - No, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 他说他会打电话 为什么他没打
sense_groups.english: Why? Why? He said he'd call. Why hasn't he called?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他害怕聪明 坚强 成功的女强人
sense_groups.english: Maybe he's intimidated by really smart, strong, successful women.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲 拜托你别拍我马屁
sense_groups.english: Sophie, will you please climb out of my butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么他不打来 瑞秋 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? - Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他觉得很怪 因为你是我的上司
sense_groups.english: Um, well, uh, maybe he feels awkward because you are my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么他要觉得怪
sense_groups.english: Awkward? Why should he feel awkward?

sense_groups.chinese: 该觉得怪的人是你
sense_groups.english: The only person that should feel awkward is you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有叫他别打电话来 对吧
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell him not to call me?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不喜欢你朋友跟你老板约会
sense_groups.english: If you're uncomfortable with your friend dating someone you work for...

sense_groups.chinese: 总是有办法可以解决这问题的
sense_groups.english: ...there are always ways to fix that.

sense_groups.chinese: 立刻打电话给她
sense_groups.english: Call her. Call her now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的手被割伤了
sense_groups.english: Multiple, so many paper cuts.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么他不打电话来 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: "Why hasn't he called, Rachel? Why? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不了解 他说他会打电话的 为什么…
sense_groups.english: I don't understand. He said he'd call."

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我得说她抓狂了 她发疯了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I'm telling you, she's flipped out. She's gone crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么把电话给我吧
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, give me the phone, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一点都不好玩 她觉得你没打电话都是我的错
sense_groups.english: This isn't funny. She thinks it's my fault you haven't called her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你分须打电话给她
sense_groups.english: You have to call her.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 隔了这么久 你不能打电话跟对方说
sense_groups.english: Look, you can't call somebody after this long just to say

sense_groups.chinese: "如果你没发现 我不喜欢你"
sense_groups.english: "In case you didn't notice, I don't like you."

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你得再约她出去
sense_groups.english: Then you're gonna have to take her out again.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她真的很无趣 而且她的眼角
sense_groups.english: No. She's really dull, and she gets this...

sense_groups.chinese: 还积着睫毛膏留下的污渍
sense_groups.english: ...gross mascara-goop thing in the corner of her eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't care. I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得再约她出去做个了断
sense_groups.english: You'll take her out again and end it...

sense_groups.chinese: 让她知道你们真的没希望
sense_groups.english: ...and end it in a way that she knows it's actually ended.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这对你来说有多难 别再跟她说你会打电话给她
sense_groups.english: And I don't care how hard it is for you. Do not tell her you'll call her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一次午餐约会 从现在开始我会自己追女生
sense_groups.english: But it's just a lunch date. From now on, I get my own dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要你再帮我牵红线了
sense_groups.english: I don't want you setting me up with anybody again.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: That's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在说大话 你知道的 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That's just a lot of big talk, you know. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在浴室
sense_groups.english: I'm in the shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 失火了…
sense_groups.english: Aah! Fire. There's a fire. Fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟萝伦说过了 我跟她提了我们的事
sense_groups.english: So I, uh, talked to Lauren. I kind of told her how things were with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟马歇尔说了吗
sense_groups.english: Did you, uh...? Did you talk to Marshall?

sense_groups.chinese: 说什么
sense_groups.english: About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 我们之间的事
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. You know, about what happened with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没理由让他知道
sense_groups.english: And there's really no reason why he should find out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不要小题大做 好吗
sense_groups.english: So, uh, let's not make a big deal out of it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事很重要
sense_groups.english: It was a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你不能跟我说昨晚的事对你来说毫无意义
sense_groups.english: I mean, come on, you can't tell me last night didn't mean something to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也在场 你的演技没那么厉害
sense_groups.english: I was there. You're not that good an actress.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着
sense_groups.english: Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是一时意乱情迷
sense_groups.english: Um, I was... I was just caught up in the moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 就那样
sense_groups.english: That's all it was.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我很遗憾让你伤心
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm sorry you feel bad...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没跟你在乎她 多过于她在乎你的女人上床过
sense_groups.english: ...but haven't you ever slept with a woman where it meant more to her than to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 凯特 - 嗨 萝伦
sense_groups.english: Hi, Kate. - Hi, Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 萝伦
sense_groups.english: Hi, Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 猪猡
sense_groups.english: Hi, pig.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我吓到你了
sense_groups.english: Sorry I, uh... I scared you in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了
sense_groups.english: By the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在检查莲蓬头的按摩功能
sense_groups.english: ...I was just checking the shower massager.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打电话到你工作的地方找你
sense_groups.english: I tried to reach you at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 今生了火灾
sense_groups.english: There's been a fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 天啊
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, my... Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们相信起火点在这里
sense_groups.english: Well, we believe it originated here...

sense_groups.chinese: 就在芬芳疗室
sense_groups.english: ...in the Aroma Room.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大家都逃出来了吗
sense_groups.english: All right, did everyone get out okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 长颈鹿跟海盗都没事
sense_groups.english: Well, the giraffe's okay and so is the pirate.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么 - 不 菲比别看
sense_groups.english: What is this? - No, Phoebe, don't look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会想看那个的
sense_groups.english: You don't want to see what's under there.

sense_groups.chinese: 寄宿小狗
sense_groups.english: The foster puppets.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: It's not a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 它只是…一直都积在这里
sense_groups.english: It's just... It's right here, and it's all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你请我吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Well, thanks again for lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 很愉快 - 真的 没错吧
sense_groups.english: Yes, this was pleasant. - It was, wasn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 那里的食物很好吃 - 可不是吗
sense_groups.english: The food there was great. - Wasn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 保重
sense_groups.english: So take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是
sense_groups.english: You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太棒了 我会打电话给你 我们再出去吃饭
sense_groups.english: This was great. I'll give you a call. We should do it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我很期待
sense_groups.english: Great. I'm looking forward to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 有留言吗 - 在苏菲的桌上
sense_groups.english: Rachel, any messages? - Sophie's desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你要打电话给她吗
sense_groups.english: Chandler. Are you gonna call her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 钱德
sense_groups.english: No. - Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 对不起 我软弱 可悲又抱歉
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, okay? I'm weak and pathetic and sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你得立刻告诉她
sense_groups.english: Okay, you are gonna tell her. You're gonna tell her now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会打电话给你
sense_groups.english: Ow, I'm not gonna call you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我说我会打电话给你 我根本就不想打
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry that I said I was going to when I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 这跟你无关
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Look, this has nothing to do with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是瑞秋的错 都是我的错
sense_groups.english: And this isn't Rachel's fault. It's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 提到女人 我有很严重的问题
sense_groups.english: I have serious, serious problems when it comes to women.

sense_groups.chinese: 我害怕承诺 亲密
sense_groups.english: I have issues with commitment, intimacy...

sense_groups.chinese: 睫毛膏污渍
sense_groups.english: ...mascara goop.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉 这是行不通的
sense_groups.english: And I'm really sorry. It's just that this is not... This isn't gonna work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这跟我希望的结局不同
sense_groups.english: Well, this isn't how I was hoping this would end...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我得感激你的诚实
sense_groups.english: ...but I guess I have to appreciate your honesty.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太棒了 我会打电话给你 我们再约时间见面
sense_groups.english: Well, this is great. I'll give you a call. We should do it again sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 贝丝 我的意思是
sense_groups.english: Wha... So anyway, Beth, what I'm saying is...

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚我跟你回家前 我该考虑到你的感受
sense_groups.english: ...I should have considered your feelings before I went home with you that night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: I've, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 最近我能体会你的感觉
sense_groups.english: I've recently learned what it's like to be on your side of it...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能原谅我吗
sense_groups.english: So do you think you can forgive me?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Great. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 珍妮佛
sense_groups.english: Hello, Jennifer?

sense_groups.chinese: 洛瑞欧太太 珍妮佛在吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Mrs. Laurio. Is Jennifer there?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不在家吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, she's not home, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我也得跟你谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, actually I kind of need to talk to you too.

questions.name: S03E21
questions.en:
So whose idea was it to put everybody in the diner on skates?
Some idiot customer put a suggestion in the suggestion box.
Oh, my God. They took my idea. - That was you?
Yeah.
Okay, there you go.
Rachel, I made you a cocoa.
Oh, that's so... Aah!
Oh, my God. Are you guys okay? - You all right?
Oh, my.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# When the rain starts to pour #
# I'll be there for you #
# Like I've been there before #
# I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey. - Hey.
You know, with that goatee, you kind of look like Satan.
Oh, so that's why the priest threw holy water on me.
Okay, listen, you have to cheer up.
Okay? You should come out with Ross and me.
I mean, anything is better than sitting around here crying all day about Kate.
Hey, I was crying because...
Because nobody believed Quincy's theory, okay?
Hey. I'm gonna be on TV.
No way. - Yeah.
They're putting together this panel to talk about these fossils they found in Peru.
The Discovery Channel's gonna film it.
Oh, my God. Heh. Who's gonna watch that?
Thanks. You ready to go? - Yeah.
Ahem, I saw a girl with that vest.
Thanks.
Most of us think of chocolate bunnies and baskets as traditional Easter gifts.
Some people insist on giving live chicks as presents.
Unfortunately, the sad fact remains...
...that most of these little guys won't live to see the Fourth of July.
Because as a result of improper care, they will be dead.
You guys got any of those baby chicks?
Because I was watching this, uh, commercial on TV...
...and, man, those things are cute.
Hi. - Hi.
Oh, Pete, you're back. Hey, check this out.
Wow. Skates. Ha, ha.
Wow. You're a lot sturdier than Chandler. He crumbled like a piece of paper.
So how was your trip?
Well... - Oh, what did you bring me?
Aw, hotel toiletries from Japan. Oh.
These are gonna go in my permanent collection.
You want some coffee? - Sure, that'd be great.
Okay.
Regular or decaf?
Uh, whichever's closest. - All right.
Okay. - So ask me what I did today.
So, what did you do today, Pete?
I bought a restaurant, and I would like you to be the chef.
What? Oh.
Can you believe he just offered me a restaurant?
What a jerk. You want me to kick his ass?
I mean, this has been my dream since I got my first Easy-Bake Oven...
...and opened Easy-Monica's Bakery.
I mean, I would kill for this job. I mean, I can totally do this job...
...and God knows I've paid my dues. Ugh.
But Pete's just doing this because he has a crush on me.
And you're still not attracted to him at all? - Mm. No.
I mean, how could I accept a restaurant from him? I can't.
I couldn't even accept a necklace from Stu Vincent in the seventh grade.
Yeah, Mon, that was totally different. He was your health teacher.
What, honey?
Ow, my side still hurts from when you crashed into me yesterday.
Oh, God, I'm so sorry. - I know. Ow.
Oh, God.
Hey, you guys. Guess what.
Got a job on a riverboat?
You know what? I didn't wear this suit for a year because you hated it.
Guess what. You're not my girlfriend anymore, so...
Oh, I see. So this suit is making a point.
Now that you're on your own, you're free to look as stupid as you'd like.
You like it, right?
Absolutely. I like it even more on you than I did on Colonel Sanders.
Huh. Ross, Ross, I'm kidding. Come here.
What were you gonna tell us? - Was it how you invented the cotton gin?
Okay, goodbye.
So, um, after you put the suggestion in the box...
...how long did it take for the roller-skating thing to happen?
Um, about three months.
Okay, so I guess that's about, uh, two weeks...
...before the topless thing kicks in.
Hey. - Hey.
I got you something. Open it. Open it.
Okay.
It's a chicken.
It's cute, huh?
Whoa, whoa, whoa. You guys, do you know anything about chicks?
Fowl? No.
Women? No.
Okay, well, they are a huge responsibility.
Especially at this age. They require constant care.
They need just the right food and lots and lots of love.
Oh, well, no problem there.
Easy, Lenny.
So, I mean, have you thought about it?
Okay, here's the thing.
Oh, no. Not "the thing." I hate "the thing."
What's "the thing"?
I can't do it.
I'm sorry. I wish I could...
...but, um, see, you have these feelings for me.
Wait, wait, wait. That's what you're worried about?
If that's the problem, we've got no problem.
I was gonna tell you this over dinner, but I met somebody else, on my trip.
Her name's Ann. She's a journalist. Uh, we met on the plane.
She asked me if she could finish off my peanuts.
I thought she said something else. We had a big laugh.
Yeah, I just... I mean, I got tired of waiting.
Oh, that's great. I mean, I'm sorry, but I'm so happy for you.
And now I can work for you. - I guess you can.
Oh, my God. Oh, this is incredible. Oh.
All right. You know what? I'm just gonna roll right into that office and quit.
All right. - Okay.
Could you give me a little push? - Yeah, sure.
Good luck. - I'm quitting. Woo-hoo!
I'm okay. I'm all right.
Wow. That's exciting. You went to Japan, made up a woman.
What?
I'm just saying, this woman, I mean, she's fictitious, no?
Why would you say that? - You're still into Monica.
So you told her there's somebody else so she'd agree to work with you.
Because you figure, if you spend time together, maybe something might happen.
You're good. You're good.
Yeah. No, I'm fairly intuitive. And psychic.
It's a substantial gift.
Listen, can you promise me that you won't tell her, though?
Absolutely. Oh, I promise. Tell her what?
Thanks a lot.
No, I'm serious. I mean, I'm intuitive, but my memory sucks.
Okay, but this is the last time.
With a chick-chick here And a chick-chick there
Here a chick, there a chick Everywhere a chick-chick
Chicken
Hey. - Hey.
How's she doing?
She?
Well, yeah. Don't you think it's a she?
I don't know.
I can't tell. Whatever it was, went back in too quickly.
Anyway, I gotta change. I'm meeting some of the cast for drinks.
Excuse me?
What?
I stayed home from work while you were at rehearsal...
...so somebody could be here with our chick.
Hey. Who was up from 2:00 this morning until 5:00 this morning...
...trying to get her back to sleep?
You don't think I get up when you get up?
Oh, here it comes.
Yes. Here it comes. I'm stuck here all day.
And then you come in and spend two seconds with us...
...and then expect to go off gallivanting with your friends?
Well, I don't think so, mister.
Hey. I need to relax, okay? I was working all day.
And you don't think taking care of our chick is work?
That's not what I said. Okay, I just meant...
I know what you meant.
Did you notice that ever since we got this chick...
...we've been fighting a lot more than we used to?
I don't know, maybe we weren't ready to have a chick.
I'll take her back tomorrow.
You think we'll get our 3 bucks back?
Hey. - Hey.
Oh. Hey.
Listen, I have that TV thing in, like, two hours, and I need your help.
Okay, what do you think? This blue suit or this brown one?
Well, the brown one brings out your eyes.
But your butt looks great in the blue one.
Really?
Wow. That aspirin dance really works.
Oh, my God. Is that still?
I'm fine. I'm fine.
No, you're not. - Yes, I am.
Rach. - Look, I'm fine.
Watch. Look at that. Uh-oh.
Okay, okay. Look, you've got to go to a doctor, okay?
No, I have to get ready and go to a dinner at my boss's house.
Very big deal. There's people there that I have to meet.
Yeah, and I'm sure you're gonna make a great impression. "Hi, I'm Rachel.
It's nice to meet you."
Come on, you probably have a broken rib.
Well, I will go to the hospital tomorrow. It'll still be broken then.
But you know, I could use a hand getting ready.
Rachel. - Look, either help me or go.
Fine. I'll go.
Okay, but before you go, could you help me first?
Sure. I'll help you.
Oh, good. Good.
Do you guys know how to get a chick out of a VCR?
You know what? I cannot do this with my left hand.
Would you please help me with this too?
Okay. Let's use this brush. - Okay.
This stuff? All right. - Yeah. Careful.
Light. Okay, you know, just sweep it across the lid.
Okay, just sweep it. - Okey-dokey.
Oh. Hey. - Sorry.
Ha, ha. That's poking me in the eye. - Ha, ha.
I'm sorry. Close, close, close.
Okay, just sweep it. - I'm sweeping.
Right. - Sweep, sweep...
Okay, now make it even, because we don't...
What? - We don't want it...
I don't want it to be too much. I want it to be subtle.
You know, you don't wear enough of this.
Since when...? Since when do you think I don't wear enough of this?
Well, I... Close your eye. I just think you're gonna like this better because...
Close, close. - Blow it.
Sorry.
Because, um, I think this will make you a little more sophisticated.
Sophisticated like a hooker?
Hey. - Hey.
Guess what I'm doing tonight. - What?
I'm checking out the restaurant with Pete.
Oh. Monica, I am so excited for you. - I know.
Ooh, I have to tell you something.
What? - Well, I can't tell you.
Okay, but wouldn't it be easier to tell me something that you could tell me?
Well, sure, in a perfect world.
But no. I promised I wouldn't tell, and I swore to, like, all my gods.
Okay.
Does it have to do with Ross and Rachel?
No.
Does it have to do with Joey? - No.
Does it have to do with Chandler and that sock that he keeps by his bed?
No, but let's come back to that later.
There you go. Good enough for your party? Huh?
Sure.
Sure. I'll just sit next to the transsexual from Purchasing.
Come on.
Okay, come on. All right, I gotta go. So good luck at the party, okay?
Oh, wait, Ross. Could you just stay and help me get dressed?
Sure. Okay.
Okay. Okay, great. Um, okay, just turn around.
What? - I don't want you to see me naked.
Rachel, I've seen you naked a million times. I ate hot fudge off you naked.
I sucked that mini-marshmallow out of your bellybutton.
Yeah, but that was different, you know? We were going out then.
Now it's weird.
Rach, you know, I can see you naked anytime I want.
What?
All I have to do is close my eyes. See? Woo-hoo.
Ross, stop that. - I'm sorry.
Come on. I don't want you thinking of me like that anymore.
Uh, sorry. Nothing you can do about it.
It's one of my, uh, rights as the ex-boyfriend.
Huh? Oh. Oh, yeah.
Stop it. Cut it out. Cut it out. - Okay, okay.
I'm sorry. It will never happen... Uh-oh.
Wait a minute. Wait, wait...
Now there are a hundred of you, and I'm the king.
Ross... - Oh, come on.
Would you grow up? It's no big deal.
All right. Fine.
Okay.
See what you did? I'm gonna be doing it by myself now.
Okay, that's it. Ow! - Oh, come on.
Oh, my God. All right, look, look, okay.
Rach. Easy. Easy. You have to go to the hospital, okay?
Okay, I do. I really do. - Okay.
Okay, I'm gonna get your coat, then I'll put you in a cab.
Oh, wait, wait, you're not gonna come with me?
Of course I am.
Uh, I just have to make a call.
Okay. - Okay?
Thank you.
What's wrong?
I'm sorry. I just can't go to the hospital looking like this.
Does it involve travel? - No.
Does it involve clogs?
Wait, wait. Clogs or claws?
Clogs. - No.
Claws? - No.
Okay, so it doesn't involve Ross or Rachel or Chandler or Joey.
What about Pete? - No.
What is it?
What about Pete? - I don't know.
Okay, I feel like I'm talking to Lassie.
Phoebe, would you just tell me? - I can't.
Okay, you know, I gotta go. - But you're so close. No.
Something to do with Pete's company?
Ugh. Just go. You're never gonna get it.
I know.
See, yes. That's Yasmine Bleeth.
She's a completely different kind of chick.
I love you both.
But in very different ways.
Hey. - Hey.
What are you doing? I though you were gonna take her back.
I did. But the store wouldn't take her back.
So then I took her to the shelter. And you know what I found out?
If they can't find a home for her, they kill her.
And I'm not gonna let that happen to little Yasmine.
Okay, good, good, good.
Because I was kind of having second thoughts too.
Okay. And it's not just chicks, you know? It's all kinds of other animals.
That's horrible. Well, you did the right thing, man.
Thanks. I'm glad you see it that way.
Oh, funny story.
I don't believe this.
Wow, look at this refrigerator. It's gigantic.
I mean, I could live in this thing. I'd be cold, but I'm always cold.
Oh, my God. Look at these spider burners. I love spider burners.
So you like it?
Oh, it is so perfect. Thank you so much.
You're welcome.
Did you just smell my hair?
No. No way. What? No.
Oh, God. - What?
You still have feelings for me, don't you?
No. I'm just excited about the restaurant, that's all.
Pete? - Okay, I love you. Is that so bad?
No, it's not bad. It's not bad at all.
It's really nice.
Look, the only one who stands to get hurt is me, and I'm okay with that.
Yeah, you may be okay with getting hurt...
...but I am not okay with being the one who hurts you.
That's why I can't take this job. - What?
Well, we probably shouldn't see each other anymore.
I'm sorry.
Okay. Yeah.
I mean, if that's really what you want, okay.
Okay. Bye.
I'm sorry things didn't work out...
Shut up for a second and let me just see something.
Okay, you'd tell me the truth, right?
Rach, you can't look fat in an x-ray. - Okay.
Hey, now, you stay out here and you think about what you did.
That's a duck. - That's a bad duck.
How'd the thing go tonight, Ross? - Oh, it was... No, no.
What thing? What thing?
Nothing. There was this thing at the museum. Come on.
Easy.
Okay, now, when you come back...
...I hope you remember that that chick is not a toy.
What thing? What is this thing?
Aw, I was kind of supposed to be on TV tonight for the Discovery Channel.
Oh, my God.
Ross, why didn't you tell me that?
Ah, I knew that if I told you, you'd make me go...
...and I knew you needed someone to be with you tonight. Come on.
Come on. - I cannot believe you.
What? - That is the sweetest thing.
You should get some sleep.
Okay.
So I'll, um... - I'm sorry I spoiled your evening.
No, that's... No, as long as you're okay.
So I'll, uh... I'll see you tomorrow.
Mm-hm. Yeah.
See you.
What did you do?
What you doing?
Having a swim.
What about the chick?
Chicks don't swim.
Are you sure?
I don't know.
Should we try? - Sure.
See, I told you. They don't swim.
Well, give him a minute. - No.
Oh, it's okay. It's okay, baby, baby, baby.

Sophisticated like a hooker?
Hey. - Hey.
Guess what I'm doing tonight. - What?
I'm checking out the restaurant with Pete.
Oh. Monica, I am so excited for you. - I know.
Ooh, I have to tell you something.
What? - Well, I can't tell you.
Okay, but wouldn't it be easier to tell me something that you could tell me?
Well, sure, in a perfect world.
But no. I promised I wouldn't tell, and I swore to, like, all my gods.
Okay.
Does it have to do with Ross and Rachel?
No.
Does it have to do with Joey? - No.
Does it have to do with Chandler and that sock that he keeps by his bed?
No, but let's come back to that later.
There you go. Good enough for your party? Huh?
Sure.
Sure. I'll just sit next to the transsexual from Purchasing.
Come on.
Okay, come on. All right, I gotta go. So good luck at the party, okay?
Oh, wait, Ross. Could you just stay and help me get dressed?
Sure. Okay.
Okay. Okay, great. Um, okay, just turn around.
What? - I don't want you to see me naked.
Rachel, I've seen you naked a million times. I ate hot fudge off you naked.
I sucked that mini-marshmallow out of your bellybutton.
Yeah, but that was different, you know? We were going out then.
Now it's weird.
Rach, you know, I can see you naked anytime I want.
What?
All I have to do is close my eyes. See? Woo-hoo.
Ross, stop that. - I'm sorry.
Come on. I don't want you thinking of me like that anymore.
Uh, sorry. Nothing you can do about it.
It's one of my, uh, rights as the ex-boyfriend.
Huh? Oh. Oh, yeah.
Stop it. Cut it out. Cut it out. - Okay, okay.
I'm sorry. It will never happen... Uh-oh.
Wait a minute. Wait, wait...
Now there are a hundred of you, and I'm the king.
Ross... - Oh, come on.
Would you grow up? It's no big deal.
All right. Fine.
Okay.
See what you did? I'm gonna be doing it by myself now.
Okay, that's it. Ow! - Oh, come on.
Oh, my God. All right, look, look, okay.
Rach. Easy. Easy. You have to go to the hospital, okay?
Okay, I do. I really do. - Okay.
Okay, I'm gonna get your coat, then I'll put you in a cab.
Oh, wait, wait, you're not gonna come with me?
Of course I am.
Uh, I just have to make a call.
Okay. - Okay?
Thank you.
What's wrong?
I'm sorry. I just can't go to the hospital looking like this.
Does it involve travel? - No.
Does it involve clogs?
Wait, wait. Clogs or claws?
Clogs. - No.
Claws? - No.
Okay, so it doesn't involve Ross or Rachel or Chandler or Joey.
What about Pete? - No.
What is it?
What about Pete? - I don't know.
Okay, I feel like I'm talking to Lassie.
Phoebe, would you just tell me? - I can't.
Okay, you know, I gotta go. - But you're so close. No.
Something to do with Pete's company?
Ugh. Just go. You're never gonna get it.
I know.
See, yes. That's Yasmine Bleeth.
She's a completely different kind of chick.
I love you both.
But in very different ways.
Hey. - Hey.
What are you doing? I though you were gonna take her back.
I did. But the store wouldn't take her back.
So then I took her to the shelter. And you know what I found out?
If they can't find a home for her, they kill her.
And I'm not gonna let that happen to little Yasmine.
Okay, good, good, good.
Because I was kind of having second thoughts too.
Okay. And it's not just chicks, you know? It's all kinds of other animals.
That's horrible. Well, you did the right thing, man.
Thanks. I'm glad you see it that way.
Oh, funny story.
I don't believe this.
Wow, look at this refrigerator. It's gigantic.
I mean, I could live in this thing. I'd be cold, but I'm always cold.
Oh, my God. Look at these spider burners. I love spider burners.
So you like it?
Oh, it is so perfect. Thank you so much.
You're welcome.
Did you just smell my hair?
No. No way. What? No.
Oh, God. - What?
You still have feelings for me, don't you?
No. I'm just excited about the restaurant, that's all.
Pete? - Okay, I love you. Is that so bad?
No, it's not bad. It's not bad at all.
It's really nice.
Look, the only one who stands to get hurt is me, and I'm okay with that.
Yeah, you may be okay with getting hurt...
...but I am not okay with being the one who hurts you.
That's why I can't take this job. - What?
Well, we probably shouldn't see each other anymore.
I'm sorry.
Okay. Yeah.
I mean, if that's really what you want, okay.
Okay. Bye.
I'm sorry things didn't work out...
Shut up for a second and let me just see something.
Okay, you'd tell me the truth, right?
Rach, you can't look fat in an x-ray. - Okay.
Hey, now, you stay out here and you think about what you did.
That's a duck. - That's a bad duck.
How'd the thing go tonight, Ross? - Oh, it was... No, no.
What thing? What thing?
Nothing. There was this thing at the museum. Come on.
Easy.
Okay, now, when you come back...
...I hope you remember that that chick is not a toy.
What thing? What is this thing?
Aw, I was kind of supposed to be on TV tonight for the Discovery Channel.
Oh, my God.
Ross, why didn't you tell me that?
Ah, I knew that if I told you, you'd make me go...
...and I knew you needed someone to be with you tonight. Come on.
Come on. - I cannot believe you.
What? - That is the sweetest thing.
You should get some sleep.
Okay.
So I'll, um... - I'm sorry I spoiled your evening.
No, that's... No, as long as you're okay.
So I'll, uh... I'll see you tomorrow.
Mm-hm. Yeah.
See you.
What did you do?
What you doing?
Having a swim.
What about the chick?
Chicks don't swim.
Are you sure?
I don't know.
Should we try? - Sure.
See, I told you. They don't swim.
Well, give him a minute. - No.
Oh, it's okay. It's okay, baby, baby, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想出要餐馆的人都穿上溜冰鞋的点子
sense_groups.english: So whose idea was it to put everybody in the diner on skates?

sense_groups.chinese: 某个白痴客人投书意见箱
sense_groups.english: Some idiot customer put a suggestion in the suggestion box.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他们接受我的建议 - 是你干的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. They took my idea. - That was you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 来吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我帮你泡了一杯可可亚
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I made you a cocoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是…
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so... Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你们没事吧 - 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Are you guys okay? - You all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 纵有狂风暴雨 #
sense_groups.english: # When the rain starts to pour #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 支持一如往昔 #
sense_groups.english: # Like I've been there before #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 留起山羊胡 你看起来蛮像撒旦的
sense_groups.english: You know, with that goatee, you kind of look like Satan.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以神父朝我洒圣水
sense_groups.english: Oh, so that's why the priest threw holy water on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你得打起精神
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen, you have to cheer up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 你该跟我及罗斯一起出去玩
sense_groups.english: Okay? You should come out with Ross and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那总比整天坐在这里为了凯特哭泣还好
sense_groups.english: I mean, anything is better than sitting around here crying all day about Kate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会哭是因为…
sense_groups.english: Hey, I was crying because...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为没有人相信昆西的理论 好吗
sense_groups.english: Because nobody believed Quincy's theory, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要上电视了
sense_groups.english: Hey. I'm gonna be on TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 - 对
sense_groups.english: No way. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要找专家讨论在秘鲁发现的化石
sense_groups.english: They're putting together this panel to talk about these fossils they found in Peru.

sense_groups.chinese: 探索频道要来录影
sense_groups.english: The Discovery Channel's gonna film it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 谁会看那种节目
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Heh. Who's gonna watch that?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 可以出门了吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Thanks. You ready to go? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过一个女孩穿那件背心
sense_groups.english: Ahem, I saw a girl with that vest.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 多数人觉得巧克力兔子跟篮子是传统复活节礼物
sense_groups.english: Most of us think of chocolate bunnies and baskets as traditional Easter gifts.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人坚持送活的小鸡当礼物
sense_groups.english: Some people insist on giving live chicks as presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 不幸地是事实上
sense_groups.english: Unfortunately, the sad fact remains...

sense_groups.chinese: 这些小家伙活不过国庆日
sense_groups.english: ...that most of these little guys won't live to see the Fourth of July.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为照顾不周 他们都会死掉
sense_groups.english: Because as a result of improper care, they will be dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有卖小鸡
sense_groups.english: You guys got any of those baby chicks?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到电视广告
sense_groups.english: Because I was watching this, uh, commercial on TV...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那些小鸡好可爱
sense_groups.english: ...and, man, those things are cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 彼特 你回来了 快来看看这个
sense_groups.english: Oh, Pete, you're back. Hey, check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 溜冰鞋
sense_groups.english: Wow. Skates. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你比钱德壮多了 他真的是跟纸片人差不多
sense_groups.english: Wow. You're a lot sturdier than Chandler. He crumbled like a piece of paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一路还顺风吗
sense_groups.english: So how was your trip?

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以 - 你帮我带了什么
sense_groups.english: Well... - Oh, what did you bring me?

sense_groups.chinese: 日本饭店的沐浴用品
sense_groups.english: Aw, hotel toiletries from Japan. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会把它们列为永久收藏品
sense_groups.english: These are gonna go in my permanent collection.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要喝咖啡吗 - 当然要
sense_groups.english: You want some coffee? - Sure, that'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一般或无咖啡因
sense_groups.english: Regular or decaf?

sense_groups.chinese: 最近的就可以了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Uh, whichever's closest. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 问我今天做了什么
sense_groups.english: Okay. - So ask me what I did today.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天你做了什么
sense_groups.english: So, what did you do today, Pete?

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了一家餐厅 想雇用你当主厨
sense_groups.english: I bought a restaurant, and I would like you to be the chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信他为我买了一家餐厅吗
sense_groups.english: Can you believe he just offered me a restaurant?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个混蛋 你要我踢他屁股吗
sense_groups.english: What a jerk. You want me to kick his ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 这一直是我的梦想 自从我买了第一个快速烤箱
sense_groups.english: I mean, this has been my dream since I got my first Easy-Bake Oven...

sense_groups.chinese: 开了第一家快速摩妮卡面包店后
sense_groups.english: ...and opened Easy-Monica's Bakery.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我能胜任这份工作 这份工作难不了我
sense_groups.english: I mean, I would kill for this job. I mean, I can totally do this job...

sense_groups.chinese: 天知道我已经受够了
sense_groups.english: ...and God knows I've paid my dues. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但彼特会这么做是因为他喜欢我
sense_groups.english: But Pete's just doing this because he has a crush on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是对他没感觉 - 没错
sense_groups.english: And you're still not attracted to him at all? - Mm. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能接受他送我餐厅 我没办法
sense_groups.english: I mean, how could I accept a restaurant from him? I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我念七年级时 就没办法收下史都文森送我的项链
sense_groups.english: I couldn't even accept a necklace from Stu Vincent in the seventh grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 那不一样 他是你的健康教育老师
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Mon, that was totally different. He was your health teacher.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了甜心
sense_groups.english: What, honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 自从昨天你撞到我后 我的肋骨一直痛到现在
sense_groups.english: Ow, my side still hurts from when you crashed into me yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我好抱歉 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I'm so sorry. - I know. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 美女们 猜猜怎么了
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. Guess what.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要到观光游轮工作
sense_groups.english: Got a job on a riverboat?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 因为你很讨厌它 所以我一年没穿这套西装
sense_groups.english: You know what? I didn't wear this suit for a year because you hated it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎么了 你不再是我的女朋友了
sense_groups.english: Guess what. You're not my girlfriend anymore, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了 你用这套西装发表宣言
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see. So this suit is making a point.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你是单身 你有耍呆的自由
sense_groups.english: Now that you're on your own, you're free to look as stupid as you'd like.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很喜欢 对吧
sense_groups.english: You like it, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我觉得你穿上它比肯德基爷爷帅多了
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. I like it even more on you than I did on Colonel Sanders.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我是开玩笑的 快回来
sense_groups.english: Huh. Ross, Ross, I'm kidding. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我们说什么 - 你怎么发明轧棉机的
sense_groups.english: What were you gonna tell us? - Was it how you invented the cotton gin?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你投书意见箱后
sense_groups.english: So, um, after you put the suggestion in the box...

sense_groups.chinese: 餐馆多久后要大家穿上溜冰鞋
sense_groups.english: ...how long did it take for the roller-skating thing to happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约三个月
sense_groups.english: Um, about three months.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想再过两星期
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I guess that's about, uh, two weeks...

sense_groups.chinese: 就可以看到上空服务生了
sense_groups.english: ...before the topless thing kicks in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了一样东西要送你 快打开
sense_groups.english: I got you something. Open it. Open it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是一只鸡
sense_groups.english: It's a chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 很可爱吧
sense_groups.english: It's cute, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们了解鸡吗
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. You guys, do you know anything about chicks?

sense_groups.chinese: 了解鸡 不
sense_groups.english: Fowl? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解女人 不
sense_groups.english: Women? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这是一份重责大任
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, they are a huge responsibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 特别是在这个年龄 他们随时都需要照顾
sense_groups.english: Especially at this age. They require constant care.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们需要正确的食物 还有许多的爱
sense_groups.english: They need just the right food and lots and lots of love.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, no problem there.

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Easy, Lenny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想问你考虑过了吗
sense_groups.english: So, I mean, have you thought about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 问题是这样的
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别那么说 我讨厌你那么说
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Not "the thing." I hate "the thing."

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么问题呢
sense_groups.english: What's "the thing"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法那么做
sense_groups.english: I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我真的很想答应
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I wish I could...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你暗恋我
sense_groups.english: ...but, um, see, you have these feelings for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你在担心那个
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait. That's what you're worried about?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那是问题 我们之间没有问题
sense_groups.english: If that's the problem, we've got no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我打算在吃晚餐时告诉你 出差时我认识一个女孩
sense_groups.english: I was gonna tell you this over dinner, but I met somebody else, on my trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫作安 她是个记者 我们在飞机上认识
sense_groups.english: Her name's Ann. She's a journalist. Uh, we met on the plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 她问我可不可以吃掉我的花生
sense_groups.english: She asked me if she could finish off my peanuts.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为她是指别的东西 我们哈哈大笑
sense_groups.english: I thought she said something else. We had a big laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是厌倦了等待
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I just... I mean, I got tired of waiting.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒 我是说对不起 但我为你感到高兴
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. I mean, I'm sorry, but I'm so happy for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我能为你工作了 - 我想是的
sense_groups.english: And now I can work for you. - I guess you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, this is incredible. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗 我得进办公室提出辞呈
sense_groups.english: All right. You know what? I'm just gonna roll right into that office and quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我推一把吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Could you give me a little push? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 - 我要辞职了
sense_groups.english: Good luck. - I'm quitting. Woo-hoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 没问题的
sense_groups.english: I'm okay. I'm all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了 你去了日本 编出一个假女友
sense_groups.english: Wow. That's exciting. You went to Japan, made up a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说这个女人 是你编出来的 对吧
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying, this woman, I mean, she's fictitious, no?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你要那么说 - 因为你还是喜欢摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Why would you say that? - You're still into Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你跟她说你有了别人 她会答应跟你合作
sense_groups.english: So you told her there's somebody else so she'd agree to work with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你认为只要有点时间相处 或许她会喜欢上你
sense_groups.english: Because you figure, if you spend time together, maybe something might happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很厉害 你很厉害
sense_groups.english: You're good. You're good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 不 我的直觉很准 还有通灵能力
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No, I'm fairly intuitive. And psychic.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是老天爷的赏赐
sense_groups.english: It's a substantial gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你能答应我不会告诉她吗
sense_groups.english: Listen, can you promise me that you won't tell her, though?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我保证 跟她说什么
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. Oh, I promise. Tell her what?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是认真的 我的直觉很准 但记忆力超差

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不想当那个伤害你的人
sense_groups.english: ...but I am not okay with being the one who hurts you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我无法接受这份工作 - 什么
sense_groups.english: That's why I can't take this job. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们不该再见面了
sense_groups.english: Well, we probably shouldn't see each other anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 如果你真的想这么做 好吧
sense_groups.english: I mean, if that's really what you want, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾我们无法…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry things didn't work out...

sense_groups.chinese: 暂时闭上你的嘴巴 让我确定一件事
sense_groups.english: Shut up for a second and let me just see something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你没跟我说实话 对吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, you'd tell me the truth, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你的X光片看起来不胖 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Rach, you can't look fat in an x-ray. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我待在那里 好好为你做的事反省一下
sense_groups.english: Hey, now, you stay out here and you think about what you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一只鸭子 - 那是只坏鸭子
sense_groups.english: That's a duck. - That's a bad duck.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚你还好吧 罗斯 - 那是…不
sense_groups.english: How'd the thing go tonight, Ross? - Oh, it was... No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事
sense_groups.english: What thing? What thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 只是博物馆的工作 来吧
sense_groups.english: Nothing. There was this thing at the museum. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢慢走
sense_groups.english: Easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 当你回家后
sense_groups.english: Okay, now, when you come back...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你记得那只小鸡不是玩具
sense_groups.english: ...I hope you remember that that chick is not a toy.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底有什么事
sense_groups.english: What thing? What is this thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚我原本要上探索频道的节目
sense_groups.english: Aw, I was kind of supposed to be on TV tonight for the Discovery Channel.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 为什么你不告诉我
sense_groups.english: Ross, why didn't you tell me that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我跟你说的话 你会坚持我一定要去
sense_groups.english: Ah, I knew that if I told you, you'd make me go...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道今晚你需要人陪你 来吧
sense_groups.english: ...and I knew you needed someone to be with you tonight. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 - 我不敢相信你
sense_groups.english: Come on. - I cannot believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 那是最体贴的事
sense_groups.english: What? - That is the sweetest thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该睡一下
sense_groups.english: You should get some sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会… - 抱歉 我打乱你今晚的计划
sense_groups.english: So I'll, um... - I'm sorry I spoiled your evening.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只要你没事就好
sense_groups.english: No, that's... No, as long as you're okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就…明天见
sense_groups.english: So I'll, uh... I'll see you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了什么
sense_groups.english: What did you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 游泳
sense_groups.english: Having a swim.

sense_groups.chinese: 小鸡呢
sense_groups.english: What about the chick?

sense_groups.chinese: 小鸡不会游泳
sense_groups.english: Chicks don't swim.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定
sense_groups.english: Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该试试看吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Should we try? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我就说他们不会游泳
sense_groups.english: See, I told you. They don't swim.

sense_groups.chinese: 给他一点时间 - 不
sense_groups.english: Well, give him a minute. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's okay. It's okay, baby, baby, baby.
