sense_groups.chinese: 不赖吧？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Looks good, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: "高级视听娱乐柜 精致…
sense_groups.english: "Stunning entertainment center, fine...

sense_groups.chinese: 精致意大利手工"
sense_groups.english: Fine Italian craftsmanship."

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你们要卖娱乐柜？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You guys are selling the entertainment center?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？我喜欢那个柜子 - 你们要吗？
sense_groups.english: Why? I love that thing. - You want it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: "名家手艺"？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Gepetto?

sense_groups.chinese: "定价五千"？
sense_groups.english: Five thousand dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you insane?

sense_groups.chinese: 登广告就要三百块耶
sense_groups.english: Hey, the ad alone cost 300 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要改成五十元或再议
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I'm changing it to $50 or your best offer.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有什么利润可言？你也配当会计师？
sense_groups.english: What kind of profit is that? And you call yourself an accountant?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你是什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然不知道我干哪一行
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you don't know what I do for a living.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道 - 是不是跟数字有关？
sense_groups.english: I actually don't know. - Yeah, something to do with numbers?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 不要 走开 小猫
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, no. Shoo, kitty. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要… 别这样 给我过来 来吧
sense_groups.english: No, no. Shoo. Come on, you. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 太疯狂了
sense_groups.english: Crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Nothing. Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What? What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有一股强烈的感觉 觉得这只猫是我妈
sense_groups.english: I just have this really strong feeling that this cat is my mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙塔克那个妈妈？她是一只猫？
sense_groups.english: You mean, the mom you met in Montauk? She was a cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她是一个人
sense_groups.english: No. No, no. She was a human lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是莉莉妈妈的灵魂 自杀的那个
sense_groups.english: This is the spirit of my mom, Lily. The one that killed herself.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她变成一只猫
sense_groups.english: Are you sure she's in the cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是你又偷吃外婆的青光眼药
sense_groups.english: Or have you been taking your grandma's glaucoma medicine again?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 疑心病博士
sense_groups.english: No, Dr. Skeptismo.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很肯定 第一 我有这种感觉
sense_groups.english: I'm sure. First of all, okay, there's the feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 她跑进我的吉他盒里
sense_groups.english: Okay, and for another, how about the fact that she went into my guitar case...

sense_groups.chinese: 它的衬里是橘色的
sense_groups.english: ...which is lined with orange felt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈最喜欢的鱼是橘棘鲷
sense_groups.english: My mother's favorite fish was orange roughy.

sense_groups.chinese: 猫喜欢吃鱼
sense_groups.english: Cats like fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈
sense_groups.english: Hi, Mommy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我十七年没看到这个笑容了
sense_groups.english: Oh. I haven't seen this smile in 17 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比的妈有两颗好大的… - 算了吧
sense_groups.english: Dude, Phoebe's mom's got a huge pair of... - Let it go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候要告诉我 你要跟奇普约会？
sense_groups.english: Um, when were you gonna tell me that you're going out with Chip Matthews?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在？
sense_groups.english: Now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他约会没关系吧？ - 当然有关系
sense_groups.english: Is it okay if I go out with Chip Matthews? - No. It's not okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他那样对我耶
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you'd want to after what he did to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说舞会的事？
sense_groups.english: What, that thing at the prom?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我两个小时都找不到他 他跑去跟艾美威许做爱
sense_groups.english: Monica, I couldn't find him for two hours. He was having sex with Amy Welsh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是高中的事 你怎么还会在意？
sense_groups.english: Come on, that was back in high school. How could that still bother you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么偏要跟奇普约会？
sense_groups.english: I mean, why of all people do you have to go out with Chip?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的高中不一样
sense_groups.english: Look, you and I went to different schools.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来 我们上同一所高中
sense_groups.english: Okay, that doesn't help because we went to the same high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在高中是风云人物
sense_groups.english: You went to one where you were popular.

sense_groups.chinese: 你坐奇普的摩托车
sense_groups.english: And you got to ride off on Chip's motorcycle...

sense_groups.chinese: 穿他的特优选手外套
sense_groups.english: ...and wear his letterman jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 我穿的是特制的乐队制服
sense_groups.english: I went to one where I wore a band uniform that you had to have specially made.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是特制的？
sense_groups.english: They had to have that specially made?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是家政课的作业之一
sense_groups.english: It was a project for one of the Home Ec. Classes.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 他们说那是给吉祥物穿的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. They told us that was for the mascot.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时候 我以为 我永远不可能
sense_groups.english: Back then I thought that I'd never, ever get the chance...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟奇普约会
sense_groups.english: ...to go out with a Chip Matthews.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在他打来约我
sense_groups.english: And now he's called me up and asked me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我心中那个胖女孩真的很想去 这是我欠她的
sense_groups.english: And the fat girl inside of me really wants to go. I owe her this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从不让她尽情的吃
sense_groups.english: I never let her eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去吧 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you go out with him. - Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果可以 你能不能丢下他
sense_groups.english: If it's possible, could you leave him somewhere...

sense_groups.chinese: 去跟别人上床？
sense_groups.english: ...and go have sex with another guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我试试看
sense_groups.english: I'll try.

sense_groups.chinese: 娱乐柜卖得怎样？
sense_groups.english: So you guys having any luck getting rid of the entertainment center?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚有几通询问电话
sense_groups.english: There were a couple calls last night...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我都觉得不可行
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, I don't think any of them are gonna work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊有一套严格的筛选过程
sense_groups.english: Yes, Joey has a very careful screening process.

sense_groups.chinese: 并非每个人都适合拥有木制品
sense_groups.english: Apparently not everyone is qualified to own wood and nails.

sense_groups.chinese: 别挣扎了
sense_groups.english: Stop it. Stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一直想跑走
sense_groups.english: She keeps squirming and trying to get away.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟在世时一样
sense_groups.english: Just like when she was alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈要跟我们在一起多久？
sense_groups.english: So, Pheebs, how long is your mom gonna be with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 直到她能接受我有了…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I guess until she, you know, gets used to the fact that there's...

sense_groups.chinese: 新妈妈吧
sense_groups.english: ...you know, a new mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很担心会被取代
sense_groups.english: You know, I think she's worried that she's gonna be replaced.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不会呢 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Well, that's not gonna happen, is it? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去房里回个电话
sense_groups.english: Okay, I have to return a call in the other room.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么不在这里打？
sense_groups.english: Why can't you use the phone in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打给住在"海边"的妈妈
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm returning a call from a certain mom at the B-E-A-C-H.

sense_groups.chinese: 该小声的字说错了
sense_groups.english: I just spelled the wrong word.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我疯了 还是有人也觉得 菲比的妈像一只猫？
sense_groups.english: So, guys, am I crazy or does Phoebe's mom remind anyone else of a cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别提了 - 拜托
sense_groups.english: Ross, don't start. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的相信 那只猫是一个女人变的？
sense_groups.english: You can't tell me you actually believe that there's a woman inside that cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信
sense_groups.english: I believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不信 - 我信
sense_groups.english: No, you don't. - Yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不…
sense_groups.english: No, you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会跟你争辩
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna suck me into this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会 你总是要说服别人
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure I am. Because you always have to be right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有… 好
sense_groups.english: I do not always have... Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 《侏罗纪公园》是有可能的
sense_groups.english: Jurassic Park could happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 还不赖嘛
sense_groups.english: Wow. That's, uh... That's pretty nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 还不赖？
sense_groups.english: "Pretty nice"?

sense_groups.chinese: 原谅我的室友 他简直想娶它过门
sense_groups.english: You'll have to pardon my roommate. He wanted to marry this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有五十块钱 你们愿意交换吗？
sense_groups.english: We don't have 50 bucks. But would you be willing to trade for it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有一艘独木舟
sense_groups.english: We got a canoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不需要独木舟
sense_groups.english: You know, I really don't think we need a canoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一定要收下独木舟
sense_groups.english: You gotta take the canoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, just...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们就把柜子搬走吧
sense_groups.english: Just take the entertainment center.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你们到家 再把独木舟扔掉
sense_groups.english: And then when you get home, throw the canoe away.

sense_groups.chinese: 想都别想 那是我亲手做的
sense_groups.english: We're not throwing it away. I built that canoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 干得好
sense_groups.english: Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看我在电线秆上发现什么
sense_groups.english: You guys, you're never gonna believe what I just found on a telephone pole.

sense_groups.chinese: 眼熟吗？
sense_groups.english: Looks kind of familiar?

sense_groups.chinese: 显然菲比的母亲也叫胡立欧
sense_groups.english: Apparently Phoebe's mother also goes by the name Julio.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个小女孩在找这只猫
sense_groups.english: You guys, there's a little girl in SoHo looking for this cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道这代表什么吗？ - 知道 五个人平分两百元赏金
sense_groups.english: I mean, you know what that means? - Yeah, 200-dollar reward split five ways.

sense_groups.chinese: 要告诉她吗？
sense_groups.english: Do we have to tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然要告诉她 - 但她现在好开心
sense_groups.english: Yes, we have to tell her. - Oh, but it's made her so happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 想念猫味的小女孩
sense_groups.english: Little girl misses her cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得猫是母亲转世的疯婆子
sense_groups.english: Crazy lady thinks her mother is in a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要去跟我儿子吃饭了
sense_groups.english: Okay, ha, ha, you know what? I have to go have dinner with my son.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们见到菲比会告诉她吧？
sense_groups.english: Can I trust that when you see Phoebe, you will tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 会的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最讨厌罗斯说对了
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I hate it when Ross is right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说得对 对吧？ - 你知道吗?
sense_groups.english: He is right, isn't he? - You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好这一次他错了
sense_groups.english: This might be one of the times when he's wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 不 他说得对
sense_groups.english: You think? - Oh, no, he's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 关于你的母亲… - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: About your mom, heh. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们处得好吗？
sense_groups.english: How's that going?

sense_groups.chinese: 棒呆了 我们今天一起睡午觉
sense_groups.english: So great. Oh, we took a nap together today.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈在我肚子上睡着还打呼
sense_groups.english: My mom fell asleep on my tummy and purred.

sense_groups.chinese: 真温馨
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去点咖啡
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna get some coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你说什么？我马上过去
sense_groups.english: Huh? What'd you say, Joe? I'll be right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 我觉得好…
sense_groups.english: Pheebs... - I just feel so...

sense_groups.chinese: 知道了啦 - 马上来
sense_groups.english: All right. - I'm coming already.

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 还没 还没…
sense_groups.english: Not yet, not yet, not yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普 - 瑞秋 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Chip. - Hey, Rach. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: I'm great. I'm great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一份好工作 一群好朋友
sense_groups.english: Got a great job at Bloomingdale's. I have wonderful friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然现在没有男朋友
sense_groups.english: And even though I'm not seeing anyone right now...

sense_groups.chinese: 却对自己很满意
sense_groups.english: ...I've really never felt better about myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡好了吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Monica ready yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 她 马上就好
sense_groups.english: She'll be out in a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普 艾美威许好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, Chip, how's, um, Amy Welsh?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾美威许？我们自从…
sense_groups.english: Amy Welsh? Wow, I haven't seen her since...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡快好了吗？
sense_groups.english: So, Monica about ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 买这个柜子就对了
sense_groups.english: This is the unit for you, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 坚固耐用 容量超大
sense_groups.english: Sturdy construction, tons of storage compartments.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至塞得进一个大人
sense_groups.english: Some big enough to fit a grown man.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我就进去过一次
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I got in there myself once.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的室友赌五块说我进不去
sense_groups.english: My roommate bet me 5 bucks that I couldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后在门把上塞棍子把我关住
sense_groups.english: And then he stuck a board through the handles and locked me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 是的
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 起先很好玩 后来感觉像棺材
sense_groups.english: It was funny till I started feeling like I was in a coffin.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才进不去 它不够深
sense_groups.english: No, you... You can't fit in that thing. That's not deep enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我进不去…
sense_groups.english: If I can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 就少算你五块钱
sense_groups.english: ...I'll knock 5 bucks off the price of the unit.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这么说定 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, you have yourself a deal. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我就说吧
sense_groups.english: See? I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我会进进出出的玩
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I come in here just to get away from it.

sense_groups.chinese: 有五分钱耶
sense_groups.english: Hey, a nickel.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了
sense_groups.english: Here we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你的奇普还在
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you still have the Chipper.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: The what?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的车子在高中的外号
sense_groups.english: That's what we used to call your, uh, motorcycle in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩托车也叫机车
sense_groups.english: You know, a motorcycle's a chopper.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你叫奇普
sense_groups.english: And you're Chip.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Never mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可爱
sense_groups.english: No, I think it's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普亲亲
sense_groups.english: A lipper from the Chipper.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有跟哪些同学联络吗？
sense_groups.english: So are you still in touch with anyone from high school?

sense_groups.chinese: 有瑞秋 还有…
sense_groups.english: Um, there's Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样 你呢？
sense_groups.english: ...and that's it. How about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在跟西门斯 萨纳混
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I still hang with Simens and Zana.

sense_groups.chinese: 也常跟史宾 莱文 凯利见面
sense_groups.english: You know, and I see Spindler a lot, and Levine, Kelly.

sense_groups.chinese: 时不时会遇见高第
sense_groups.english: And I run into Goldie from time to time...

sense_groups.chinese: 史迪 布朗 苏卡夫 麦奎尔
sense_groups.english: ...Stick, Brown, Sulkov, McGuire...

sense_groups.chinese: 杰弟 毕斯利
sense_groups.english: ...J.T., Beardsley.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？
sense_groups.english: Is that all?

sense_groups.chinese: 毕了业都会失去联络
sense_groups.english: Ah, you know, after high school, you just kind of lose touch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有遇见李察多夫曼
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I ran into Richard Dorfman.

sense_groups.chinese: 他好吗？ - 不太好
sense_groups.english: Oh, how is he? - Not so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 被我和西门斯内裤弹射 哈哈…
sense_groups.english: Me and Simens gave him a wedgie. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不是建筑师吗？ - 建筑师也要穿内裤
sense_groups.english: Isn't he an architect now? - Yeah, they still wear underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？ - 还好
sense_groups.english: Are you all right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 他答应不拿沙发椅的
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, he promised he wouldn't take the chairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底发生了什么？你怎么会被关进去？
sense_groups.english: What the hell happened? How were you locked in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的东西呢？
sense_groups.english: Where the hell is all of our stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个人来看柜子
sense_groups.english: Well, this guy came by to look at the unit...

sense_groups.chinese: 他说它塞不下一个大人
sense_groups.english: ...and he said he didn't think it was big enough to fit a grown man.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你自愿进去？
sense_groups.english: So you got in voluntarily?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想把柜子卖出去
sense_groups.english: I was trying to make a sale.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是让我碰上他 你猜我会怎样？
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. If I ever run into that guy again, you know what I'm gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 把屁股翘起来？
sense_groups.english: Bend over?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后萨纳干脆让另一个破掉
sense_groups.english: And then Zana just let one rip.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是不喜欢回忆往事
sense_groups.english: Look, not that I don't enjoy talking about people who we went to high school with...

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: ...because I do. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们可以聊点别的
sense_groups.english: But, um, maybe we can talk about something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 像你 我还不晓得你的工作
sense_groups.english: Like you. I don't even know where you work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道啊 - 我知道？
sense_groups.english: You know where I work. - I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 电影院啊 你以前常来
sense_groups.english: The movie theater. You used to come in all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在影城做事？ - 我怎么可能换工作？
sense_groups.english: You still work at the Multiplex? - Like I'd give up that job. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 随时都有爆米花和糖果可吃
sense_groups.english: Free popcorn and candy any time I want?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮你拿海报 - 谢谢 不用了
sense_groups.english: I can get you free posters for your room. - Thanks, I'm set.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还住在家里吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you live with your parents?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是没有门禁
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I can stay out as late as I want.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还真是大搬家 电视 沙发椅
sense_groups.english: Wow, they really got you guys. Your TV, the chairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 微波炉 音响
sense_groups.english: Yeah, your microwave, the stereo.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他把黑桃5拿走了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, he took the five of spades.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, here it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊出生 二十八年后 我被抢了
sense_groups.english: Oh. Um, Joey was born, and then 28 years later, I was robbed.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So how was your date?

sense_groups.chinese: 我高中时一直想跟奇普约会
sense_groups.english: Well, you know how I always wanted to go out with Chip in high school?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚 我真的 跟高中的奇普约会了
sense_groups.english: Well, tonight, I actually went out with Chip Matthews in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 我不但跟奇普约了会
sense_groups.english: No, it's okay. Not only did I get to go out with Chip Matthews...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还甩了他
sense_groups.english: ...I got to dump Chip Matthews.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so great. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 保险公司怎么说？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what did the insurance company say?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说
sense_groups.english: Oh, they said, uh

sense_groups.chinese: "你们没投保 别再打来了"
sense_groups.english: "You don't have insurance here, so stop calling us."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没有告诉她？
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs? - Yeah. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说
sense_groups.english: Hi. Listen, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 这只猫是一个小女孩的
sense_groups.english: ...this cat belongs to a little girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 路上贴满了寻猫启事
sense_groups.english: All right? There are flyers all over the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以陪你把猫送回去
sense_groups.english: Hey, we can take her back with you if you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh. Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是她选择来找我
sense_groups.english: But, you know, she chose to find me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得尊重她的决定 对吧？
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have to respect her decision, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 有道理 - 没错
sense_groups.english: That's a good call. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 别再闹了
sense_groups.english: No, no. Hey, enough is enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾你跟新妈妈在一起
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry that you feel guilty or whatever...

sense_groups.chinese: 会有罪恶感 但这不是你的旧妈妈
sense_groups.english: ...about spending time with your new mom. But this is not your old mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是一只猫
sense_groups.english: This is a cat. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫做胡立欧
sense_groups.english: Julio the cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是妈妈 是猫
sense_groups.english: Not Mom. Cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你失去过几个父母？
sense_groups.english: Ross, how many parents have you lost?

sense_groups.chinese: 零个
sense_groups.english: None.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你就无法体会 其中一个回来的感觉 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Okay, then you don't know what it feels like when one of them comes back. Do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信这是我的母亲
sense_groups.english: I believe this is my mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算不是又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Even if I'm wrong, who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 你就当个好朋友 支持我
sense_groups.english: Just be a friend, okay? Be supportive.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to say. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以向她的妈妈道歉
sense_groups.english: You could say you're sorry to her mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想她会接受
sense_groups.english: I think she would like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 乖 过来吧
sense_groups.english: Come here. Here, come here, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 布非太太？
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Buffay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我为我说的话道歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry about what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 我实在很伤人
sense_groups.english: Um, it was insensitive of me to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 说你只是一只猫
sense_groups.english: ...that you were just a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 很显然的 你也是…
sense_groups.english: When, clearly, you are also the reincarnated spirit...

sense_groups.chinese: 像我朋友的母亲 灵魂转世
sense_groups.english: ...of my friend's mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都原谅你 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: We both forgive you. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个小女孩怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do about the little girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听我说
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 你对我还是很重要
sense_groups.english: Um, Mom, I hope you know that you still mean a lot to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你随时都可以回来
sense_groups.english: And you're welcome to come back any time.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她可以变成一张沙发 我们会很感激
sense_groups.english: If she could come back as a couch, we'd really appreciate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 我带你回家
sense_groups.english: Come on, Mom, I'm gonna take you home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你去 - 我也去
sense_groups.english: I'll go with you. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有很多的床垫
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, you know, I got an extra futon.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拽个屁啊 我们什么都没有
sense_groups.english: Dude, you don't have to brag. We got nothing here.

questions.name: S04E03
questions.en:
Hey. We are so in luck.
Treeger said we could have all this cool stuff from the basement.
Wait right there.
Oh, no, no. I'm paddling away.
Huh?
Wow. Really? We got all this rusty crap for free?
Uh-huh. This and a bunch of bubble wrap...
...and some of it is not even popped.
Could we be more white trash?
How desperate am I?
Oh, good thing Chandler's not here. He always wins at this game.
I just told my mom I'd cater her party for her.
How come? - Because I need the money.
And I thought it'd be a great way to get rid of that last little smidgen of self-respect.
Come on, I think this is a good thing.
I don't think Mom would've hired you...
...if she didn't think you were good at what you do.
You don't have to stick up for her. She can't hear you.
Hey, um, do you guys have any juice?
Just pickle.
Hey, uh, Rach. Funny story.
I bumped into Joanna on the street yesterday.
My boss, Joanna? Wow, that must have been awkward.
Well, no. Actually, she asked me if I wanted to get a drink.
You, uh, didn't say yes to that, did you?
Ha, ha. No. No.
Hello, Rachel.
Well, not at first.
What is she doing here?
I don't understand.
Last time you went out with her, you said she was a dud.
I think I judged her too quickly.
And this time, we were able to take the relationship to the next level.
Well, last time, I almost got fired. You must end it. You must end it now.
It's not like this is an everyday occurrence for me.
I mean, usually I'm pretty much in there by myself.
Chandler.
Promise me you will end it.
Okay. I promise I'll end it. - Thank you.
But I hope you know what I'm giving up for you.
Because she's not just the boss in your office.
You know what I mean?
Yeah.
Oh, sorry. I knew what he meant.
How's the hired help?
Doing great. Quiches are coming along.
What's this? Blue nail polish?
Yeah, I thought it was cute.
Ha. It's what your grandmother's hands looked like when we found her.
Let me ask you a question.
Why did you hire me?
Oh, well, Richard raved about the food at his party...
...of course, you were sleeping with him.
Then I heard the food at that lesbian wedding was very nice.
I assume you weren't sleeping with anyone there.
Though, at least that would be something.
Oh, my God. Did you hear that?
She hired me because she thinks I'm good.
Okay, I didn't hear that.
Yeah. She didn't hire me out of pity.
It wasn't so she could pick on me in front of her friends.
She actually thinks I'm good.
Wow. And hey, it's cool if you're a lesbian. Ha, ha.
Good afternoon. Are you the decision-maker of the house?
Uh...
Do you, uh, currently own a set of encyclopedias?
No, no, but, uh, try the classifieds. People sell everything in there.
Actually, I'm not buying. I'm selling.
Let me ask you one question.
Do your friends ever have a conversation...
...and you just nod along...
...even though you're not really sure what they're talking about?
I'm telling you, it's totally unconstitutional.
I hear you. Yeah it is. - I totally agree.
I think he deserves a Nobel Prize.
No.
It was like the Algonquin kids' table.
Excuse me. I'm sorry.
You haven't said anything for about two and a half minutes.
Are you at all interested?
Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, oh, yeah. Come on in. Come on.
That's weird. - What?
Your nails.
Oh, I know. I never wear fake ones.
I just did it so my mom wouldn't give me grief about biting them.
No, I meant it's weird that you only have nine now.
Oh, my God.
Wait a minute.
I had them when I put...
Oh, my God. It's in the quiche.
Oh, my God. - Okay, don't panic.
I'm gonna go to the store, get you another set of nails.
No one is gonna know, and you're gonna look great.
Oh. Oh, it's because they're gonna eat... That's the problem.
Honey, don't bite your nails.
Okay, uh, please don't freak out.
Um, but there's a blue fingernail in one of the quiche cups.
And there's no way to know which one.
And whoever finds it wins the prize.
Ha, ha. I'm not freaking out.
Why are you laughing?
It's nothing. It's just that now your father owes me $5.
Ha, ha. What, you bet I'd lose a nail?
Oh, no, don't be silly. I just bet that I'd need these.
Frozen lasagnas? - Mm.
You bet that I'd screw up?
So all that stuff about hiring me because I was good was...
No, that was all true.
This was just in case you pulled a Monica.
You promised Dr. Weinberg you'd never use that phrase.
Honey, come on. Have a sense of humor.
You're never able to laugh at yourself.
That's right. Ha, ha.
My mom doesn't have any faith in me. Oh, that's hilarious.
I don't get it.
No. I have faith.
No. You have lasagnas.
Oh, the ruined quiches are ready.
It just doesn't feel like we're breaking up.
No, we are. I'm sad.
Okay.
Yes?
Uh, can you wait till tomorrow? All right.
Unbelievable.
Thanks.
No, no. That was my boss. I have to go.
Okay.
What are you doing?
I'm getting dressed. - Why?
When I walk outside naked, people throw garbage at me.
Wait. I want to show you something.
What is it?
Just a little gag gift somebody gave me.
Put your hands together.
You're not the boss of me.
Yeah, you are.
Hmm. Saucy.
I'll be back in two minutes.
You're, uh...? You're going to leave me like this?
Knowing you're here waiting for me, I think that's kind of exciting, don't you?
Okay, but if you don't come back soon...
...there's pretty much nothing I can do about it.
Oh. - Hi.I brought you back a macaroon.
Oh, great. I'll keep it in my butt with your nose.
That's weird. She locked the door.
You know why? She's got the Christmas bonus list in there.
I saw her working on it this morning.
Okay, swear you won't tell.
But when Mark left, he gave me a key to Joanna's office.
You want to see the list? - Yeah.
Hi.
How are you?
Hello, Joanna...
...'s office.
I'm sorry. I may be a little longer.
How little? - A couple hours. I feel awful.
Look, this isn't funny. You get back here now.
I can't. - Why not?
I'm in my boss' car.
What? - Uh-oh, tunnel.
What?
Rachel, could I see you for a moment?
Okay, here's the situation. Ahem.
The keys to the cuffs are on the back of the door.
Could you be a doll...
...and grab them and scoot on over here and unlock me?
And on a totally separate subject, that is a lovely pantsuit.
You promised you would break up with her.
I did break up with her. She just took it really, really well.
And the fact that you were jeopardizing my career never entered your mind?
It did enter my mind.
But then something happened that made it shoot right out.
You know what, Chandler?
You got yourself into those cuffs, you get yourself out them.
No, no, no. I can't get myself right out of them.
You must have me confused with the Amazing Chandler.
Come on, you have to unlock me.
She could be gone for hours, and I'm cold and...
Ugh! Chandler. All right. This is it.
You never see Joanna again.
Never.
You never come into this office again. - Fine.
You give me back my Walkman. - I...
I never borrowed your Walkman.
Well, then I lost it. You buy me one.
You got it. Here we go. Come on. This is great.
Aw. - Does it hurt?
No, I just always see guys doing this when they get handcuffs taken off.
Hello, sweet pants.
Wait a minute. What are you gonna tell Joanna?
About what?
When she sees that you're gone, she's gonna know I let you out and I'm gonna get fired.
I'll make something up. I'm good at lying.
I actually did borrow your Walkman.
No, there's nothing to make up. She's gonna know I have a key to her office.
I've gotta get you locked back the way you were.
Oh, I don't think so.
Well, this is much better.
So here's somebody interesting, Joey.
What do you know about Van Gogh?
Uh, he cut off his ear. - And?
I'm out.
He painted that.
Wow. That's pretty nice.
I thought he cut off his ear because he sucked.
What else you got in there? - Let's see, uh...
Where does the Pope live? - In the woods.
Wait, wait, that's the joke answer.
Actually, it's Vatican City.
Now, uh, what do you know about, uh, vulcanized rubber?
Spock's birth control.
You need these books.
Hey. - Hi.
This used to be your room?
Wow. Oh, you must have been in really good shape as a kid.
Oh, I'm such an idiot.
I can't believe I actually thought she could change.
Look, who cares what your mom thinks?
So you pulled a Monica.
Oh, good. I'm glad that's catching on.
Why does that have to be a bad thing? Just change what it means.
You know, go down there and prove your mother wrong.
You finish the job you were hired to do and we'll call that "pulling a Monica."
What?
Okay, um, if a kid gets straight A's, his parents would say
"Yeah, you pulled a Monica." Ha, ha.
Oh, or a fireman saves a baby, and they go, "Yeah, no, he pulled a Monica."
Or someone hits a home run, and the announcer says
"Yeah, that one's out of here."
Because some things don't change.
All right. I'll go down there.
But I'm not gonna serve the lasagna. I'm gonna serve something that I make.
Wait.
Ooh.
Oh! Wow.
Wow, my breasts are really strong.
Chandler.
Chandler, please. I have to get you locked up back the way you were.
I'm so going to lose my job.
She's very private about her office.
Now I know why.
Hey, look. You're in trouble either way, okay?
If she comes and sees me locked to this instead of the chair...
...she's gonna know you were in here. So you might as well just let me go.
I'll clean your bathroom for a month. - Still wouldn't be clean.
All I want is my freedom.
Foot rubs for a month. - Freedom.
I'll take all your photos and put them into albums.
Freedom. I want my freedom.
Why won't you hear me? Sophie, help me.
Help me. - Sophie, sit.
God, would you just calm down?
I'm going to say this for the last time.
Would you please just...?
Wow, there's a lot I didn't know about vomit.
In a minute.
So, what do you say, Joey?
You get the whole set of encyclopedias for $1200.
That works out to just 50 bucks a book.
Twelve hundred dollars?
You think I have $1200?
I'm home in the middle of the day...
...and I got patio furniture in my living room.
I guess there's a few things you don't get from book learning.
Well, uh, what can you swing?
How about zero down and zero a month for a long, long time?
You don't have anything?
You want to see what I got? Okay.
I got a baby Tootsie Roll...
...a movie stub, keys, a Kleenex...
...a rock...
...and an army man.
Okay, I get the picture. Uh, thanks for your time.
And a fifty.
Huh. These must be Chandler's pants.
For 50 bucks you can get one book.
What will it be? A? B? C?
I think I'm gonna stick with the V.
I want to see how this bad boy turns out. Heh.
I, uh, will buy and wrap all of your Christmas gifts.
No. - Oh.
I, uh... Oh, I'll squeeze you fresh orange juice every morning.
With extra pulp? - Yeah.
No.
I've got it.
You don't have it.
I have so got it.
There's gonna be rumors about this. There's no way to stop it.
Sophie knows, Monica and Phoebe know.
How do Monica and Phoebe know? - Oh, I called them.
When they ask me what I saw...
...I can be very generous...
...or very stingy.
Go on. - I can make you a legend.
I can make you this generation's Milton Berle.
And Milton Berle has... - Oh. Not compared to you.
Well? - They're not even touching the lasagna.
Really? - Oh, they love your casserole.
Yes.
It's hard to believe, just a little while ago, this was nothing but ingredients.
Everyone seems to like your dish.
And you?
I thought it was...
...quite tasty.
So if everyone liked it, and you liked it...
...that would make this a success. Which would make you...
A bitch?
Well, I was going for "wrong," but we can use your word.
Yes, well, I was wrong.
And I have to say...
...you really impressed me today.
Wow.
Um, you might even say that she pulled a Monica.
She doesn't know we switched it.
And the next time you cater for me...
...there will be nothing but ice in the freezer.
Well, that really means a lot.
Oh, Mom, don't bite your nails.
Hello. - Hey.
Hello, Chandler.
I love you.
Hey, what's going on?
Oh.
No, he doesn't.
Two hours, that lasted.
So did you break up with Joanna?
I think so.
Well, it's a good thing you got out when you did, before she blew up like Vesuvius.
The volcano? - Yeah.
And speaking of volcanoes, man, are they a violent, igneous-rock formation.
What?
Oh, yeah. Lava spewing, hot ash.
Of course, some are dormant.
Why are you talking about volcanoes all of a sudden?
Oh, we can talk about something else.
What do you want to talk about? Vivisection?
The vas deferens?
The Vietnam War?
Oh, did anybody see that documentary on the Korean War?
Oh, yeah.
Oh, God, Korea's such a beautiful country.
With such a sad history. - Yeah.
Could there be more Kims?
Who's out there? - It's me. Good morning.
Rachel, could you come in here a moment?
Yeah, sure. Um, they didn't have poppy-seed bagels...
...so I have sesame ones... Oh, my word.
I...
I seem to have had a slight office mishap.
Could you get the key off the back of the door?
Yeah, sure. I...
I'm so sorry.
Tell your friend Chandler that we're definitely broken up this time.
Okay.

So did you break up with Joanna?
I think so.
Well, it's a good thing you got out when you did, before she blew up like Vesuvius.
The volcano? - Yeah.
And speaking of volcanoes, man, are they a violent, igneous-rock formation.
What?
Oh, yeah. Lava spewing, hot ash.
Of course, some are dormant.
Why are you talking about volcanoes all of a sudden?
Oh, we can talk about something else.
What do you want to talk about? Vivisection?
The vas deferens?
The Vietnam War?
Oh, did anybody see that documentary on the Korean War?
Oh, yeah.
Oh, God, Korea's such a beautiful country.
With such a sad history. - Yeah.
Could there be more Kims?
Who's out there? - It's me. Good morning.
Rachel, could you come in here a moment?
Yeah, sure. Um, they didn't have poppy-seed bagels...
...so I have sesame ones... Oh, my word.
I...
I seem to have had a slight office mishap.
Could you get the key off the back of the door?
Yeah, sure. I...
I'm so sorry.
Tell your friend Chandler that we're definitely broken up this time.
Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走运了
sense_groups.english: Hey. We are so in luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 房东说这些很酷的都可以给我们
sense_groups.english: Treeger said we could have all this cool stuff from the basement.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我要划走了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. I'm paddling away.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？这些生锈的垃圾不用钱？
sense_groups.english: Wow. Really? We got all this rusty crap for free?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一堆泡泡棉
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. This and a bunch of bubble wrap...

sense_groups.chinese: 有些完全没挤过
sense_groups.english: ...and some of it is not even popped.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真是白人垃圾
sense_groups.english: Could we be more white trash?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是绝望透了
sense_groups.english: How desperate am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好钱德不在 谁也惨不过他
sense_groups.english: Oh, good thing Chandler's not here. He always wins at this game.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚答应帮我妈的宴会办外烩
sense_groups.english: I just told my mom I'd cater her party for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为我需要钱
sense_groups.english: How come? - Because I need the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且这样正好可以抛开 最后一丝自尊
sense_groups.english: And I thought it'd be a great way to get rid of that last little smidgen of self-respect.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 这是好事啊
sense_groups.english: Come on, I think this is a good thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是觉得你行
sense_groups.english: I don't think Mom would've hired you...

sense_groups.chinese: 妈不会找你
sense_groups.english: ...if she didn't think you were good at what you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必替她说话 她听不到
sense_groups.english: You don't have to stick up for her. She can't hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们有果汁吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, um, do you guys have any juice?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有腌黄瓜汁
sense_groups.english: Just pickle.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 说来好笑
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, Rach. Funny story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨天在路上遇见乔安娜
sense_groups.english: I bumped into Joanna on the street yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的上司乔安娜？一定很尴尬
sense_groups.english: My boss, Joanna? Wow, that must have been awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上她找我一起去喝杯东西
sense_groups.english: Well, no. Actually, she asked me if I wanted to get a drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有答应吧？
sense_groups.english: You, uh, didn't say yes to that, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hello, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始没答应
sense_groups.english: Well, not at first.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在这里干什么？
sense_groups.english: What is she doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂
sense_groups.english: I don't understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上次跟她约会时说她很无聊
sense_groups.english: Last time you went out with her, you said she was a dud.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太快下定论了
sense_groups.english: I think I judged her too quickly.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次我们进展到下一个阶段
sense_groups.english: And this time, we were able to take the relationship to the next level.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上次差点被炒鱿鱼 你马上给我做个了结
sense_groups.english: Well, last time, I almost got fired. You must end it. You must end it now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可不是每天都有的事
sense_groups.english: It's not like this is an everyday occurrence for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我都一个人睡
sense_groups.english: I mean, usually I'm pretty much in there by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 答应我跟她分手
sense_groups.english: Promise me you will end it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会跟她分手 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay. I promise I'll end it. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我的牺牲很大
sense_groups.english: But I hope you know what I'm giving up for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可不只是你的上司
sense_groups.english: Because she's not just the boss in your office.

sense_groups.chinese: 懂吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what I mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我懂
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry. I knew what he meant.

sense_groups.chinese: 外烩大厨忙得怎样？
sense_groups.english: How's the hired help?

sense_groups.chinese: 很顺利 法式咸派快好了
sense_groups.english: Doing great. Quiches are coming along.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？蓝色指甲油？
sense_groups.english: What's this? Blue nail polish?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我觉得很好看
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I thought it was cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你奶奶死后 指甲就是这个颜色
sense_groups.english: Ha. It's what your grandmother's hands looked like when we found her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你一个问题
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么找我？
sense_groups.english: Why did you hire me?

sense_groups.chinese: 理查一直说他的派对餐点很棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, Richard raved about the food at his party...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你当时在跟他上床
sense_groups.english: ...of course, you were sleeping with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来我听说 那场同志婚礼的菜很好
sense_groups.english: Then I heard the food at that lesbian wedding was very nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该没跟那些人上床吧
sense_groups.english: I assume you weren't sleeping with anyone there.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则起码很特别
sense_groups.english: Though, at least that would be something.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你听到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Did you hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是觉得我很行才找我
sense_groups.english: She hired me because she thinks I'm good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没听到这个
sense_groups.english: Okay, I didn't hear that.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是在可怜我
sense_groups.english: Yeah. She didn't hire me out of pity.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是想在朋友面前刁难我
sense_groups.english: It wasn't so she could pick on me in front of her friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是真的觉得我行
sense_groups.english: She actually thinks I'm good.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 如果你是同志就太酷了
sense_groups.english: Wow. And hey, it's cool if you're a lesbian. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 午安 你是这里的家长吗？
sense_groups.english: Good afternoon. Are you the decision-maker of the house?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你目前拥有一套百科全书吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you, uh, currently own a set of encyclopedias?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 不过分类广告上什么都有
sense_groups.english: No, no, but, uh, try the classifieds. People sell everything in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要买 我是要卖
sense_groups.english: Actually, I'm not buying. I'm selling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你一个问题
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you one question.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是否曾在朋友们聊天时
sense_groups.english: Do your friends ever have a conversation...

sense_groups.chinese: 只能跟着点头
sense_groups.english: ...and you just nod along...

sense_groups.chinese: 却搞不懂他们在说什么？
sense_groups.english: ...even though you're not really sure what they're talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 这根本是违宪
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, it's totally unconstitutional.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 完全同意
sense_groups.english: I hear you. Yeah it is. - I totally agree.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得他应该得诺贝尔奖
sense_groups.english: I think he deserves a Nobel Prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 很像阿尔冈昆族小孩的桌子
sense_groups.english: It was like the Algonquin kids' table.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 对不起
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你发了大约两分半钟的呆
sense_groups.english: You haven't said anything for about two and a half minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底有没有兴趣？
sense_groups.english: Are you at all interested?

sense_groups.chinese: 有… 请进
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, oh, yeah. Come on in. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪了 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: That's weird. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的假指甲
sense_groups.english: Your nails.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我永远不用假指甲
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know. I never wear fake ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怕咬指甲被我妈念
sense_groups.english: I just did it so my mom wouldn't give me grief about biting them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你现在只有九个指甲
sense_groups.english: No, I meant it's weird that you only have nine now.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我之前要烤…
sense_groups.english: I had them when I put...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 在咸派里面
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. It's in the quiche.

sense_groups.chinese: 完了 - 好 不要慌
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Okay, don't panic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮你买一组新指甲
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to the store, get you another set of nails.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人会知道 你还是很美
sense_groups.english: No one is gonna know, and you're gonna look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 你是怕他们会吃到
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, it's because they're gonna eat... That's the problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 女儿 别咬指甲
sense_groups.english: Honey, don't bite your nails.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别发疯
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh, please don't freak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过某个咸派里有一片蓝指甲
sense_groups.english: Um, but there's a blue fingernail in one of the quiche cups.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且无从找起
sense_groups.english: And there's no way to know which one.

sense_groups.chinese: 找到的人可以中大奖
sense_groups.english: And whoever finds it wins the prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会发疯
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I'm not freaking out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在笑什么？
sense_groups.english: Why are you laughing?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 你爸输我五块钱
sense_groups.english: It's nothing. It's just that now your father owes me $5.

sense_groups.chinese: 你赌我会掉指甲？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. What, you bet I'd lose a nail?

sense_groups.chinese: 别傻了 我只是赌我会用上这个
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, don't be silly. I just bet that I'd need these.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷冻千层面？ -嗯
sense_groups.english: Frozen lasagnas? - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你赌我会搞砸？
sense_groups.english: You bet that I'd screw up?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还说什么我很行…
sense_groups.english: So all that stuff about hiring me because I was good was...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那都是真的
sense_groups.english: No, that was all true.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是怕你搞摩妮卡飞机
sense_groups.english: This was just in case you pulled a Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应心理医生不再这么说了
sense_groups.english: You promised Dr. Weinberg you'd never use that phrase.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 有点幽默感嘛
sense_groups.english: Honey, come on. Have a sense of humor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你总是不懂得自嘲
sense_groups.english: You're never able to laugh at yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: That's right. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈对我没信心 好好笑喔
sense_groups.english: My mom doesn't have any faith in me. Oh, that's hilarious.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪里好笑？
sense_groups.english: I don't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对你有信心
sense_groups.english: No. I have faith.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有的是千层面
sense_groups.english: No. You have lasagnas.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 毁掉的咸派好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, the ruined quiches are ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种感觉不像是分手
sense_groups.english: It just doesn't feel like we're breaking up.

sense_groups.chinese: 是分手啊 我好伤心喔
sense_groups.english: No, we are. I'm sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以等到明天吗？好吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, can you wait till tomorrow? All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 实在无法相信
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我得去见我的老板
sense_groups.english: No, no. That was my boss. I have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 穿衣服 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm getting dressed. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 光着屁股走在路上会被扔东西
sense_groups.english: When I walk outside naked, people throw garbage at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 给你看个东西
sense_groups.english: Wait. I want to show you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么东西？
sense_groups.english: What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 别人送的一个小道具
sense_groups.english: Just a little gag gift somebody gave me.

sense_groups.chinese: 把手合在一起
sense_groups.english: Put your hands together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不是我的老板
sense_groups.english: You're not the boss of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 粉辣喔
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Saucy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我两分钟后就回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in two minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要这样把我和住？
sense_groups.english: You're, uh...? You're going to leave me like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道你在等我 感觉很令人兴奋
sense_groups.english: Knowing you're here waiting for me, I think that's kind of exciting, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但要是你不马上回来…
sense_groups.english: Okay, but if you don't come back soon...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不能怎么样
sense_groups.english: ...there's pretty much nothing I can do about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 嗨 我帮你带了杏仁饼回来
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Hi.I brought you back a macaroon.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我会把它贴在屁股上
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. I'll keep it in my butt with your nose.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇怪 她把门锁上了
sense_groups.english: That's weird. She locked the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道为什么吗？里面有圣诞奖金名单
sense_groups.english: You know why? She's got the Christmas bonus list in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我早上看到她在打
sense_groups.english: I saw her working on it this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你可别说出去
sense_groups.english: Okay, swear you won't tell.

sense_groups.chinese: 马克离职时给了我一把钥匙
sense_groups.english: But when Mark left, he gave me a key to Joanna's office.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想看名单吗？ - 想
sense_groups.english: You want to see the list? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 乔安娜…
sense_groups.english: Hello, Joanna...

sense_groups.chinese: 的办公室
sense_groups.english: ...'s office.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我还要一阵子
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I may be a little longer.

sense_groups.chinese: 多久？ - 两个小时 我觉得很抱歉
sense_groups.english: How little? - A couple hours. I feel awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不好玩 马上给我回来
sense_groups.english: Look, this isn't funny. You get back here now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I can't. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在我老板的车上
sense_groups.english: I'm in my boss' car.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 进隧道了
sense_groups.english: What? - Uh-oh, tunnel.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 请进来一下
sense_groups.english: Rachel, could I see you for a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 情况是这样的
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's the situation. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 手铐的钥匙挂在门上
sense_groups.english: The keys to the cuffs are on the back of the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能行行好…
sense_groups.english: Could you be a doll...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿了钥匙冲过来帮我解套？
sense_groups.english: ...and grab them and scoot on over here and unlock me?

sense_groups.chinese: 题外话 好漂亮的套装
sense_groups.english: And on a totally separate subject, that is a lovely pantsuit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应要跟她分手的
sense_groups.english: You promised you would break up with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她分手啦 只不过她分得很狂野
sense_groups.english: I did break up with her. She just took it really, really well.

sense_groups.chinese: 你都没想过 这样会破坏我的事业吗？
sense_groups.english: And the fact that you were jeopardizing my career never entered your mind?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想过啊
sense_groups.english: It did enter my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 但后来的事让这个念头飞了
sense_groups.english: But then something happened that made it shoot right out.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: You know what, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你害自己被铐住 就自己脱困
sense_groups.english: You got yourself into those cuffs, you get yourself out them.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没办法自己脱困
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I can't get myself right out of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把我跟脱逃大师钱德搞混了
sense_groups.english: You must have me confused with the Amazing Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮帮我啦
sense_groups.english: Come on, you have to unlock me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能要去很久 我好冷 而且…
sense_groups.english: She could be gone for hours, and I'm cold and...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 好 够了
sense_groups.english: Ugh! Chandler. All right. This is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不准你再见她
sense_groups.english: You never see Joanna again.

sense_groups.chinese: 永远
sense_groups.english: Never.

sense_groups.chinese: 不准再进这个办公室 - 好
sense_groups.english: You never come into this office again. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 把随身听还给我 - 我…
sense_groups.english: You give me back my Walkman. - I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没借过
sense_groups.english: I never borrowed your Walkman.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我弄丢了 买一台给我
sense_groups.english: Well, then I lost it. You buy me one.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 快解开吧 太好了
sense_groups.english: You got it. Here we go. Come on. This is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 - 会痛吗？
sense_groups.english: Aw. - Does it hurt?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 我只是看别人都会叫一声
sense_groups.english: No, I just always see guys doing this when they get handcuffs taken off.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的裤子
sense_groups.english: Hello, sweet pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 你要怎么跟乔安娜说？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. What are you gonna tell Joanna?

sense_groups.chinese: 说什么？
sense_groups.english: About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看你走了会知道是我放的 我会被解雇
sense_groups.english: When she sees that you're gone, she's gonna know I let you out and I'm gonna get fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会撒谎 我最会撒谎了
sense_groups.english: I'll make something up. I'm good at lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确借了你的随身听
sense_groups.english: I actually did borrow your Walkman.

sense_groups.chinese: 行不通的 她会知道我有钥匙
sense_groups.english: No, there's nothing to make up. She's gonna know I have a key to her office.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得把你铐回去
sense_groups.english: I've gotta get you locked back the way you were.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 想都别想
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好多了
sense_groups.english: Well, this is much better.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个人很有意思
sense_groups.english: So here's somebody interesting, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对梵谷认识多少？
sense_groups.english: What do you know about Van Gogh?

sense_groups.chinese: 他割掉自己的耳朵 - 还有呢？
sense_groups.english: Uh, he cut off his ear. - And?

sense_groups.chinese: 没了
sense_groups.english: I'm out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是他画的
sense_groups.english: He painted that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不赖嘛
sense_groups.english: Wow. That's pretty nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为他割掉自己的耳朵 是因为他很逊
sense_groups.english: I thought he cut off his ear because he sucked.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有什么？ - 我看看
sense_groups.english: What else you got in there? - Let's see, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 教宗住在哪里？ - 森林里
sense_groups.english: Where does the Pope live? - In the woods.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 那是开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, that's the joke answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 他住在梵蒂冈
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's Vatican City.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么是硫化橡胶吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, uh, what do you know about, uh, vulcanized rubber?

sense_groups.chinese: 节育用品
sense_groups.english: Spock's birth control.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要这套书
sense_groups.english: You need these books.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是你的旧房间？
sense_groups.english: This used to be your room?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你小时候一定很健美
sense_groups.english: Wow. Oh, you must have been in really good shape as a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是个白痴
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm such an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然以为她会改变
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I actually thought she could change.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁管你娘怎么想？
sense_groups.english: Look, who cares what your mom thinks?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞摩妮卡飞机又怎样？
sense_groups.english: So you pulled a Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好的 我很高兴能迎头赶上
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. I'm glad that's catching on.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说这一定要是坏话？去改变它的意义
sense_groups.english: Why does that have to be a bad thing? Just change what it means.

sense_groups.chinese: 去证明你妈是错的
sense_groups.english: You know, go down there and prove your mother wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把工作顺利完成 我们就把它叫做搞摩妮卡飞机
sense_groups.english: You finish the job you were hired to do and we'll call that "pulling a Monica."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 小孩每一科都拿优等 父母会说
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, if a kid gets straight A's, his parents would say

sense_groups.chinese: "你搞了摩妮卡飞机" 哈哈…
sense_groups.english: "Yeah, you pulled a Monica." Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 消防员救出一个宝宝 大家会说"他搞摩妮卡飞机"
sense_groups.english: Oh, or a fireman saves a baby, and they go, "Yeah, no, he pulled a Monica."

sense_groups.chinese: 有人打全垒打 播报员会说
sense_groups.english: Or someone hits a home run, and the announcer says

sense_groups.chinese: "这是一支红不让"
sense_groups.english: "Yeah, that one's out of here."

sense_groups.chinese: 有些事是不会变的
sense_groups.english: Because some things don't change.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要下楼去
sense_groups.english: All right. I'll go down there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不上千层面 我要上我做的菜
sense_groups.english: But I'm not gonna serve the lasagna. I'm gonna serve something that I make.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh! Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我的咪咪真有力
sense_groups.english: Wow, my breasts are really strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我得把你铐回去
sense_groups.english: Chandler, please. I have to get you locked up back the way you were.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的饭碗快不保了
sense_groups.english: I'm so going to lose my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很在意办公室的隐私权
sense_groups.english: She's very private about her office.

sense_groups.chinese: 我总算知道原因了
sense_groups.english: Now I know why.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不管怎样都有麻烦
sense_groups.english: Hey, look. You're in trouble either way, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看见我被铐在柜子上
sense_groups.english: If she comes and sees me locked to this instead of the chair...

sense_groups.chinese: 就会知道你进来过 你还不如让我走
sense_groups.english: ...she's gonna know you were in here. So you might as well just let me go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你洗浴室一个月 - 还是洗不干净
sense_groups.english: I'll clean your bathroom for a month. - Still wouldn't be clean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只要我的自由
sense_groups.english: All I want is my freedom.

sense_groups.chinese: 揉脚一个月 - 自由
sense_groups.english: Foot rubs for a month. - Freedom.

sense_groups.chinese: 把你的相片通通整理好
sense_groups.english: I'll take all your photos and put them into albums.

sense_groups.chinese: 自由 我要我的自由
sense_groups.english: Freedom. I want my freedom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不听？苏菲 救救我
sense_groups.english: Why won't you hear me? Sophie, help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 救我 - 苏菲 坐下
sense_groups.english: Help me. - Sophie, sit.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你冷静好吗？
sense_groups.english: God, would you just calm down?

sense_groups.chinese: 我再说最后一次
sense_groups.english: I'm going to say this for the last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能请你… ？
sense_groups.english: Would you please just...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我对呕吐的了解还真少
sense_groups.english: Wow, there's a lot I didn't know about vomit.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: In a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得如何？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you say, Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要一千两百块 就能拥有整套百科全书
sense_groups.english: You get the whole set of encyclopedias for $1200.

sense_groups.chinese: 平均一本才五十元
sense_groups.english: That works out to just 50 bucks a book.

sense_groups.chinese: 一千两百块？
sense_groups.english: Twelve hundred dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我有一千两百块吗？
sense_groups.english: You think I have $1200?

sense_groups.chinese: 我大白天窝在家里
sense_groups.english: I'm home in the middle of the day...

sense_groups.chinese: 还用凉椅 洋伞当家具
sense_groups.english: ...and I got patio furniture in my living room.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些事是书上学不到的
sense_groups.english: I guess there's a few things you don't get from book learning.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能凑出多少？
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, what can you swing?

sense_groups.chinese: 零头期款 月付零元如何？
sense_groups.english: How about zero down and zero a month for a long, long time?

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么都没有？
sense_groups.english: You don't have anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想看我有什么吗？好
sense_groups.english: You want to see what I got? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一个巧克力棒
sense_groups.english: I got a baby Tootsie Roll...

sense_groups.chinese: 张电影票根 钥匙 面纸
sense_groups.english: ...a movie stub, keys, a Kleenex...

sense_groups.chinese: 一块小石头
sense_groups.english: ...a rock...

sense_groups.chinese: 和一个玩具兵
sense_groups.english: ...and an army man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我懂了 耽误你了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I get the picture. Uh, thanks for your time.

sense_groups.chinese: 和一张五十元
sense_groups.english: And a fifty.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一定是钱德的裤子
sense_groups.english: Huh. These must be Chandler's pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 五十元可以买一本
sense_groups.english: For 50 bucks you can get one book.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要哪一本？A？B？C？
sense_groups.english: What will it be? A? B? C?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是买V好了
sense_groups.english: I think I'm gonna stick with the V.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想看看结局如何
sense_groups.english: I want to see how this bad boy turns out. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你买和包装圣诞礼物
sense_groups.english: I, uh, will buy and wrap all of your Christmas gifts.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 噢
sense_groups.english: No. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我每天早上帮你榨柳橙汁
sense_groups.english: I, uh... Oh, I'll squeeze you fresh orange juice every morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 有果肉？ - 有
sense_groups.english: With extra pulp? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了
sense_groups.english: I've got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不知道
sense_groups.english: You don't have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全知道了
sense_groups.english: I have so got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事会传出去 挡也挡不住
sense_groups.english: There's gonna be rumors about this. There's no way to stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲知道 摩妮卡 菲比知道
sense_groups.english: Sophie knows, Monica and Phoebe know.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们怎么会知道？ - 我打给她们了
sense_groups.english: How do Monica and Phoebe know? - Oh, I called them.

sense_groups.chinese: 当她们问我看到什么
sense_groups.english: When they ask me what I saw...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以很大方…
sense_groups.english: ...I can be very generous...

sense_groups.chinese: 也可以很小气
sense_groups.english: ...or very stingy.

sense_groups.chinese: 说下去 - 我可以让你成为传奇
sense_groups.english: Go on. - I can make you a legend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以让你成为现代唐璜
sense_groups.english: I can make you this generation's Milton Berle.

sense_groups.chinese: 而唐璜… - 根本比不上你
sense_groups.english: And Milton Berle has... - Oh. Not compared to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？ - 客人碰都没碰千层面
sense_groups.english: Well? - They're not even touching the lasagna.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 他们好喜欢你的砂锅料理
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, they love your casserole.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 不久前这些都还是材料呢
sense_groups.english: It's hard to believe, just a little while ago, this was nothing but ingredients.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都很喜欢你做的菜
sense_groups.english: Everyone seems to like your dish.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？
sense_groups.english: And you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得…
sense_groups.english: I thought it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 很好吃
sense_groups.english: ...quite tasty.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是大家都喜欢 你也喜欢
sense_groups.english: So if everyone liked it, and you liked it...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就代表很成功 而你…
sense_groups.english: ...that would make this a success. Which would make you...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是恶婆娘？
sense_groups.english: A bitch?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说"你就错了" 但你的说法也行
sense_groups.english: Well, I was going for "wrong," but we can use your word.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我错了
sense_groups.english: Yes, well, I was wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须要说…
sense_groups.english: And I have to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 你让我大开眼界
sense_groups.english: ...you really impressed me today.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还可以说她搞了摩妮卡飞机
sense_groups.english: Um, you might even say that she pulled a Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不知道我们改过了
sense_groups.english: She doesn't know we switched it.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次你帮我办外烩
sense_groups.english: And the next time you cater for me...

sense_groups.chinese: 冷冻库里只会有冰
sense_groups.english: ...there will be nothing but ice in the freezer.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是很大的鼓励
sense_groups.english: Well, that really means a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 别咬指甲
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mom, don't bite your nails.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你好啊
sense_groups.english: Hello, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了
sense_groups.english: No, he doesn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 拖了两小时
sense_groups.english: Two hours, that lasted.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你跟乔安娜分手了吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you break up with Joanna?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是吧
sense_groups.english: I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好她跟维苏威一样爆炸之前 你就闪了
sense_groups.english: Well, it's a good thing you got out when you did, before she blew up like Vesuvius.

sense_groups.chinese: 那座火山？ - 对
sense_groups.english: The volcano? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 讲到火山 那些火成岩还真暴力
sense_groups.english: And speaking of volcanoes, man, are they a violent, igneous-rock formation.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 熔岩乱喷 热灰乱飞
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Lava spewing, hot ash.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过有些是休火山
sense_groups.english: Of course, some are dormant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么突然聊起火山来了？
sense_groups.english: Why are you talking about volcanoes all of a sudden?

sense_groups.chinese: 不一定要聊火山
sense_groups.english: Oh, we can talk about something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想聊什么？活体解剖？
sense_groups.english: What do you want to talk about? Vivisection?

sense_groups.chinese: 输精管？
sense_groups.english: The vas deferens?

sense_groups.chinese: 越战？
sense_groups.english: The Vietnam War?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人看了那部韩战纪录片吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, did anybody see that documentary on the Korean War?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 有
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 韩国好美喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Korea's such a beautiful country.

sense_groups.chinese: 命运却好悲惨 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: With such a sad history. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 有好多姓金的
sense_groups.english: Could there be more Kims?

sense_groups.chinese: 外面是谁？ - 是我 早安
sense_groups.english: Who's out there? - It's me. Good morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你能不能进来一下？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, could you come in here a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没有罂粟籽焙果了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. Um, they didn't have poppy-seed bagels...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我买了芝麻… 天哪
sense_groups.english: ...so I have sesame ones... Oh, my word.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
我出了一点办公室灾难
sense_groups.english: I seem to have had a slight office mishap.

sense_groups.chinese: 请把门后的钥匙拿给我
sense_groups.english: Could you get the key off the back of the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. I...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你的朋友钱德 我们这次绝对是分手了
sense_groups.english: Tell your friend Chandler that we're definitely broken up this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

questions.name: S04E04
questions.en:
Hey, new wallet?
It was time.
The old condom ring in the leather just doesn't say "cool" anymore.
Rachel, you just put an empty carton back in the fridge.
I know, but the garbage was full.
Have you ever taken out the trash?
Well, I thought you liked doing it.
Third door on the left. - Right!
Hey, Mr. Treeger.
What are you doing?
Um... Oh! Oh!
I'm sorry.
It's a little old but...
You're clogging up the chute I just unclogged.
I'm sorry. I don't come in here a lot.
Aw, of course not. You're a little princess.
Daddy, buy me a pizza.
Daddy, buy me a candy factory.
Daddy, make the cast of Cats sing "Happy Birthday" to me.
You think you can come here...
...make a mess and a big man in coveralls will clean it up?
Think of someone else for a change.
Okay, I'm sorry.
God, if you're going to cry about it!
Whoa, whoa! Treeger made you cry? - Yes.
He said really mean things that were only partly true.
I'll teach him a lesson.
Joey, don't. Let's forget about it.
That's easy for you to say. You weren't almost just killed!
All right, that's it. School is in session!
My God.
Is this a gym card?
Oh, yeah, gym member.
I try to go four times a week, but I've missed...
...the last 1200 times.
So why don't you quit?
You don't think I've tried?
You think I like having $50 a month taken from my account?
They make you go all the way down there.
They use all these phrases and peppiness to confuse you.
And then they bring out Maria.
Who is Maria? - Oh, Maria!
You can't say no to her.
She's like this lycra, spandex -covered, gym treat.
Do you need me to go with you and hold your hand?
No. - You're strong enough to face her?
Oh, no. You'll have to come.
Tribbiani.
Hold on. I'll get the plunger.
Hey. You hold on. You made my friend Rachel cry.
So you'll go and apologize to her...
...unless you want me to call the landlord.
And tell him what?
Maybe you haven't heard of "not making girls cry."
Maybe you haven't heard of the Rent Stabilization Act of 1968.
I have actually not heard of that.
Your friends are violating it.
I've been nice until now, but I don't need this grief.
I'm telling the landlord...
...Monica's illegally subletting her grandmother's place.
Your friends are out of here, pal.
Why don't you tell me something I don't know?
Somebody tell me I don't have to work today.
What's the matter?
My first massage is this incredibly gorgeous guy.
Every time I see him, I want to...
...do things to him I can't charge for.
So do them for free.
No, it is forbidden.
No, no. Mrs. Potter fires people for messing around with clients.
And it's against my oath as a masseuse.
They make you take one?
No, I made myself take one.
No fooling around with clients...
...and, um, always be prepared.
That one's from the Boy Scouts, but it just makes good sense.
Why not give him to someone else?
No, I can handle it. I'm a professional.
Pheebs, is that a new ankle bracelet?
You got a pedicure.
Your feet are all dressed up.
That's the only part he can see when he's on the table!
You're going to do some feet flirting!
I don't know what you're talking about. Heh.
How do you explain the toe ring?
It's Arabian Princess Day at work. Leave me alone!
My hero! What happened?
Well, I told him no one treats my friends like that.
And he better apologize. See you!
Wait a minute.
What did he say? - Uh...
He wouldn't apologize, because you're living here illegally.
Instead, he'll evict you. See you later!
You got us evicted? - I told you not to go down there.
He made Rachel cry!
Rachel always cries!
That's not true!
You go down there, and you suck up to him.
You suck like you've never sucked before!
All right, I'll try.
If I can't, you stay with us till you get settled.
Go! - All right, all right.
I'll have to check first, but he'll be cool.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Remember what we talked about. You got to be strong.
Yes, yes!
Now one more time.
Don't you want a washboard stomach...
...and rock -hard pecs?
No, I want a flabby gut and saggy man breasts.
Good. That's good. - Okay.
I want to quit the gym.
You want to quit?
I want to quit the gym.
You do realize you won't have access to our new Swedish spa?
I want to quit the gym.
Dave in the Membership Office handles quitters.
Excuse me. Are you a member?
Me?
No. - Sorry. Members only.
I want to quit the gym!
It's okay, man. Be strong.
So are you a member of any gym?
No, and I'm not going to be. So save your little speech.
Okay, no problem.
Could you come here?
Hi, I'm Maria.
Hi, M...
Wow. You have really pretty feet.
These old things? Ha.
Would you spend time on my sciatic area? It's killing me.
You mean...
By sciatic, you mean...
...the towel -covered portion?
Yeah.
Sure, I can do that.
Because, um, the muscles in the sciatic area can get...
...real nice and tight.
Yeah. So, um, tell me, Rick, how did you injure the area?

sense_groups.english: So you'll go and apologize to her...

sense_groups.english: A 16 -hour sit -in for Greenpeace.

sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.english: Please don't kick the girls out. This was my fault.

sense_groups.english: You want me to kick you guys out instead?

sense_groups.english: You can't. Where would the chick and the duck live?

sense_groups.english: Those are, uh, nicknames.
