sense_groups.english: Come on. Let the girls stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我做什么都行
sense_groups.english: I'll do whatever you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？什么都行？
sense_groups.english: Really? You'd do anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你能做什么了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I got something. - What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能当我的舞伴吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you be my dancing partner?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是牢里的黑话吧？
sense_groups.english: That's not prison lingo, is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他的舞伴？
sense_groups.english: His dancing partner? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他们有一个管理员舞会 叫"管舞会"
sense_groups.english: There's this superintendents' dance, "The Super Ball."

sense_groups.chinese: 他想引起一个女管理员 玛姬的主意
sense_groups.english: He wants to impress Marge, this lady super he likes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那怎么不找女生练？
sense_groups.english: Why not practice with a girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不好意思
sense_groups.english: He's too shy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他觉得他还没资格跟女生跳
sense_groups.english: He's not good enough to dance with girls yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他差点害我进那个垃圾槽里
sense_groups.english: He almost danced me right down that garbage chute.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再念了 你又没事
sense_groups.english: Would you let it go already? You're fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你退出了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - So did you quit?

sense_groups.chinese: 差一点
sense_groups.english: No. I almost did.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不能丢下罗斯不管
sense_groups.english: Couldn't leave Ross there without a spotter.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你加入会员了？
sense_groups.english: Wait, now, so you joined the gym?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好笑 为什么？
sense_groups.english: And that's funny, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 呵呵…
sense_groups.english: Oh, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在想像你在健身和…
sense_groups.english: I was just, you know, picturing you working out, and...

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样
sense_groups.english: Well, that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们毁了
sense_groups.english: We're doomed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们下半辈子 每个月都会被扣50元
sense_groups.english: They'll take $50 a month from our accounts for the rest of our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What'll we do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以去健身啊
sense_groups.english: You could actually go to the gym.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者…
sense_groups.english: Or...

sense_groups.chinese: 或者是去银行
sense_groups.english: Or we could go to the bank...

sense_groups.chinese: 结掉户头 断了他们的财路
sense_groups.english: ...close our accounts and cut them off at the source.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是天才
sense_groups.english: You're a genius.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们就不能当银行好兄弟了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man! But then we won't be bank buddies.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在又多了一个理由
sense_groups.english: Now there's two reasons.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我说的那个帅哥客人吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys, remember that cute client I told you about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我咬了他
sense_groups.english: I bit him.

sense_groups.chinese: 咬哪里？ - 屁屁
sense_groups.english: Where? - On the tushy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样不违反你的誓约？
sense_groups.english: And that's not against your oath?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 对不起嘛 但是一模到他
sense_groups.english: I know, but the moment I touch him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就想抛开旧誓约 发一个限制级的新誓
sense_groups.english: ...I want to throw out my old oath and take a new, dirty one.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次你就让自己分心
sense_groups.english: Next time, try to distract yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 像我如果在做很兴奋的事
sense_groups.english: Like when I'm doing something exciting...

sense_groups.chinese: 又不想太…
sense_groups.english: ...and I don't want to get too...

sense_groups.chinese: 兴奋
sense_groups.english: ...excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就会想别的事 像三明治啦
sense_groups.english: I try and think of other things. Like, uh, sandwiches...

sense_groups.chinese: 棒球啦
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, baseball...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有… 钱德
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你啊 - 不 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Oh, no, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来了 咱们速战速决吧
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm here. Let's get this over with.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟着我的舞步
sense_groups.english: ...just follow my lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 不必先做点准备吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't we need to do some kind of preparation first?

sense_groups.chinese: 像是喝个烂醉？
sense_groups.english: Like get really drunk?

sense_groups.chinese: 来 把手环抱着我
sense_groups.english: Come on. Hey, just put your arms around me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 不过如果我是玛姬
sense_groups.english: No. It's okay. But if I'm Marge...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的咪咪会被投到背后去
sense_groups.english: ...my breasts are coming out my back.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我根本不会跳舞
sense_groups.english: Ah, forget it! I'm not being any good at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈说得对
sense_groups.english: My mom was right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是只穿了衣服的大猪公
sense_groups.english: I'm just a big potato with arms and legs and a head.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你不是猪公
sense_groups.english: Come on, man. You're not a potato.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我不适合跳舞 练也没用
sense_groups.english: I'm sure as hell not a dancer. It's no use.

sense_groups.chinese: 玛姬不会看上我的
sense_groups.english: Marge will never go for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这么说嘛
sense_groups.english: Come on, Treeger. Don't say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是需要练习
sense_groups.english: You just need more practice.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 再试一次
sense_groups.english: Come on. Let's try it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 而且问题八成是出在我身上
sense_groups.english: Plus, it was probably mostly my fault anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不太习惯跟一个…
sense_groups.english: I'm not that comfortable dancing with a... Whee -hee!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 舞练得怎样？有"同志"情谊了吗？
sense_groups.english: So how goes the dancing? Gay yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们欠我一个人情
sense_groups.english: Ha -ha -ha. You guys owe me bigtime.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你刚才在跳舞
sense_groups.english: What? - You just did a little dancy thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪有 - 你有
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't. - Yes, you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才跳了两下 你玩得很乐喔
sense_groups.english: You did a little hop. - You are so enjoying this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且那不是跳 那是滑走步
sense_groups.english: And it wasn't a hop. It was a pas de bourrée.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还知道术语
sense_groups.english: You know the words!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很投入
sense_groups.english: You are so into this!

sense_groups.chinese: 也许有一点吧 我越跳越好
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'm enjoying it a little. I'm getting pretty good at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好可爱喔 乔伊小舞伶
sense_groups.english: This is so sweet. Joey, our little twinkletoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可不是什么娘娘腔的舞
sense_groups.english: This isn't some kind of girly dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是一种运动 很阳刚的
sense_groups.english: It's like a sport, it's manly.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 秀几个阳刚的舞步 - 好
sense_groups.english: Show me some "manly" moves. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会带舞
sense_groups.english: I don't know how to lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想把户头结掉
sense_groups.english: We'd like to close our accounts.

sense_groups.chinese: 把户头结掉？有什么问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Close your accounts? Is there a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 没有 我们只是想结掉
sense_groups.english: No, no. - No, we'd just like to close them.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 终止帐户由蓝伯小姐负责
sense_groups.english: Ms. Lambert handles all our closures.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你来一下
sense_groups.english: Would you come over here, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是凯伦
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Karen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要退出这家银行
sense_groups.english: I want to quit the bank!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 棒球
sense_groups.english: Okay. Baseball.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞克打棒球 滑上二垒
sense_groups.english: Rick playing baseball. He slides into second.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许裤子可以拉低一点
sense_groups.english: Maybe even his pants come down a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, wait! No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 三明治
sense_groups.english: Okay, sandwiches. Sandwiches. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 三明治在盘子上
sense_groups.english: Okay, on a plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞克的裤子拉低一点 不对
sense_groups.english: Maybe Rick's pants come down a little. No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 钱德 有用耶
sense_groups.english: Okay, Chandler. Ooh, that's working!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德的膝盖
sense_groups.english: Chandler's knees.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德的脚踝
sense_groups.english: Chandler's ankles.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德的脚踝毛
sense_groups.english: Chandler's ankle hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 完了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're all set. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是不可思议
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow! That was amazing!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的只有l小时吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Was that really just an hour? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 在1小时超长的世界里
sense_groups.english: In really long hour -world.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Ugh! Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢你
sense_groups.english: I have an enormous crush on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你是客人 我不能约你
sense_groups.english: But since you're a client, I can't ask you out...

sense_groups.chinese: 即使对你有感觉
sense_groups.english: ...even though you give me the feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全不知道
sense_groups.english: Wow. I had no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过
sense_groups.english: But, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以找别的按摩师
sense_groups.english: I can always find another masseuse.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, really.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我突然意识到我光着身体
sense_groups.english: Suddenly I'm very aware I'm naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 别吵
sense_groups.english: Quiet down.

sense_groups.chinese: 赛门先生等了… 天哪
sense_groups.english: Mr. Simon's been waiting... Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么没有？
sense_groups.english: Why wasn't I offered that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意多付钱
sense_groups.english: I'd definitely pay more for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这里是有规矩的 我们不搞色情
sense_groups.english: We have rules here. This is not that kind of place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但是你完全误会了
sense_groups.english: I know, but this isn't how it looks at all...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为瑞克是我的丈夫
sense_groups.english: ...because Rick is, um, my husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好告诉他的另一个老婆
sense_groups.english: You'd better tell his other wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 她已经打三次来查勤了
sense_groups.english: She called three times asking where he is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会告诉她
sense_groups.english: Yes, I will tell her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没有结掉户头？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: So you didn't leave the bank? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还一起办了一个活存帐户
sense_groups.english: And somehow we ended up with a joint checking account.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要那个帐户干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What will you ever use that for?

sense_groups.chinese: 转帐给健身中心
sense_groups.english: To pay for the gym.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天过得真好
sense_groups.english: So I had a great day.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞克和我一拍即合 我们亲热
sense_groups.english: Rick and I hit it off. We were making out.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后老板走进来 因为我卖春而开除我
sense_groups.english: Then my boss walked in and fired me for being a whore.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你被炒鱿鱼？ - 天哪
sense_groups.english: You got fired? - Oh, my gosh!

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉好怪 我从来没被开除过
sense_groups.english: It's so weird. I have never been fired from anything before.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始漫无目的的乱走
sense_groups.english: I started walking around, not knowing what to do next.

sense_groups.chinese: 还问路上的人要不要按摩
sense_groups.english: I started asking people on the street if they wanted massages.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果警察也以为我是妓女
sense_groups.english: Then these policemen thought I was a whore too.

sense_groups.chinese: 以一个妓女来说今天还真背
sense_groups.english: It's really been a bad day, whore -wise.

sense_groups.chinese: 小鸭 小鸡在吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Duck. Is Chick here?

sense_groups.chinese: 在 兔宝宝？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Bunny Rabbit.

sense_groups.chinese: 要练最后一次了？
sense_groups.english: Ready for our last practice?

sense_groups.chinese: 转圈还不够好 我那里太小了
sense_groups.english: We're not getting that spin right, because my place is small.

sense_groups.chinese: 要去我家吗？ - 不 我有别的主意
sense_groups.english: Want to use our place? - No, I had another idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 成功了
sense_groups.english: We did it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 太棒了
sense_groups.english: That was incredible!

sense_groups.chinese: 太精彩了 非常完美 太棒了
sense_groups.english: That was amazing! We totally nailed it!

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼 真是谢了
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen. Thanks a lot, Tribbiani. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 都几点了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Look at the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得赶公车去舞会
sense_groups.english: I got to catch the bus to the ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Oh! Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Good luck. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是你想练狐步舞？或是探戈
sense_groups.english: Unless you want to practice the fox trot. Or the tango?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 不用了
sense_groups.english: Aw, thanks, but no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经可以跟女生跳了
sense_groups.english: You see, I think I'm ready to dance with girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 去迷倒她们吧 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Go get them, Treeger. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨…
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你想去吗？玛姬有个朋友
sense_groups.english: You want to come? Marge has a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 真的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会很习惯 她跟我差不多壮
sense_groups.english: You'd dance good with her. She's the same size as me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了
sense_groups.english: No, I'm good.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来你很有经验
sense_groups.english: You've got great experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看 你为什么辞去上一份工作？
sense_groups.english: Let's see. Reason for leaving last job?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们以为我是妓女
sense_groups.english: They thought I was a whore.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 有消息我们会通知你
sense_groups.english: Okay. We'll give you a call if anything comes up.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Great. Thank you very much.

...but your place kind of has a weird smell.
Is everything in the car? - Did you settle the bill?
No. I hate this part.
Ooh! Oh! Look what we almost left!
That's not mine. - Oh.
Ooh. Look what we almost took!
Excuse me, Ms. Burkart?
Well, we're all cleaned up.
Oh. Good. Thank you.
Um, ahem...
And, well, there's this small matter of the, um...
Dear? - The matter of...
...payment.
Jack used to handle the finances.
You know what we should all do?
Go see a musical.
Sure.
You know which one?
The 1996 Tony Award winner.
Do you know the name of that one?
I don't know, um, Grease?
No.
Rent?
Yes! Rent!
So when do you want to go?
What? I'm sorry. I can't, I'm busy.
Hey...
Man, it is so hard to shop for girls. Ugh!
Yes, it is, at Office Max!
What did you get her?
A pen.
It's two gifts in one. It's a pen that's also a clock. Huh?
Ha, ha. You can't give her that. - Why not?
She's not 11!
And it's not the seventh night of Chanukah.
What he means by that is, while this is a very nice gift...
...maybe it's not something a boyfriend gives.
Sure, it is.
She needs a pen for work.
She's writing. She turns it over. "Whoa! It's time for my date with Joey!"
All right. What did you get for Angela Del Veccio's birthday?
She didn't have one.
For three years?
Look, it's too late, and I got an audition.
I can't shop anymore.
I will go out and try to find something for her.
Thanks, man.
While you're at it, could you get her a card?
Would you like me to write her a little poem as well?
Or just get a card that has a poem already in it.
Oh! You have to get our money. - She couldn't stop crying.
With those thick glasses, her tears look giant.
I know, it's tough.
You know what the first thing I did after my mom's funeral was?
What? - Pay the caterer!
I've had a lot of jobs.
And there are some people who always try to get out of paying.
It's either "That massage wasn't long enough"...
...or "I don't know any of those songs"...
...or "These sombreros aren't big enough. Bad little white girl!"
Okay.
So you think she's faking?
There weren't any tears till you showed her the bill.
She sounded pretty upset to me.
You're a grand old flag
You're a high -flying flag And forever in peace may you wave
She seems fine now.
So you just left? Her place was really that bad?
You throw your jacket on a chair at the end of the day.
Like that, only instead of a chair, it's a pile of garbage.
And instead of a jacket, it's a pile of garbage.
And instead of the end of the day, it's the end of time...
...and garbage is all that has survived.
Here. - Wow. Thanks.
So, uh, what happened?
Nothing. I had to get out of there.
Next time, you take her to your place.
I tried that. She says it has a weird smell.
What kind of smell? - I don't know. Soap?
Listen, you like this girl, right? - Yeah.
You want to see her again? - Yeah.
So you're going to have to do it in the mess!
Yeah, okay. You're right.
I mean, uh, who cares about a little sloppiness?
Yeah.
It's endearing, really. - All right!
Now you go get that beautiful pig!
I just spent the entire afternoon looking for a present...
...for Kathy that would be better than the rabbit.
Any luck?
Yeah, I found this great place called "Invisible Things for Kathy."
Can you give me a hand with all this stuff?
Just return the book, let Joey give her the clock pen...
...and you get her something worse than that...
...like a regular pen.
She's really going to love this, you know?
The bottom line is, I want her to have it...
...even if I don't get to be the one who gives it to her.
Aw, honey, that's so sweet.
Yeah? You don't think it's just pathetic?
Oh, "pathetic"!
Hey! I've been looking all over for you.
Where? - Our place. The hall.
I got something.
It's a book.
A book?
Is it a book that's also a safe?
It's a book that's just a book.
It's The Velveteen Rabbit. It was her favorite as a kid.
So, uh, just let me know if she likes it, okay?
You got it.
Thanks for doing this. I owe you one.
There wasn't any change from that twenty, was there?
No, it came out to an even twenty.
Wow. That's almost as much as a new book.
Jeepers Creepers
Where'd you get those peepers?
Jeepers Creepers Where'd you get those eyes?
You didn't get the money?
Maybe I can try at intermission?
You know what? Let's just go.
No! Hey! We're not leaving till we get paid!
I don't know who she thinks she is.
Enough is enough!
Hey, widow?
Widow? Excuse me? Excuse me!
Thanks. Um, clearly this is a very, very hard time for you.
Um, but we provided a service, and we deserve to be paid...
...because you ate that service.
We are not leaving here until we are paid every penny, because...
...we're part-time caterers and we have no place else to go.
All right. I'll get my bag.
Good.
I'm going to leave some cards here.
Please think of us for your next event.
You want to come inside?
Yes.
Yes, I do.
I'll be right back. Make yourself comfortable.
Guess who. - Uh...
Department of Sanitation?
It's me. - Ha, oh!
Aw!
What?
Oh, Cheryl! - Oh, Ross!
Oh! Oh!
Oh! God!
Aah! Oh, my God!
No! No!
It's my hamster! It's Mitzi!
Oh, my God! I'm so sorry. I must have freaked out.
Thank God it's not Mitzi!
It's just a rat.
I did it! Aah!
I finished it! I did it all by myself!
And there's nobody to hug.
Hey! Hey, you guys!
I finished it all by myself! Hug me.
Yay! So good!
Congratulations. - Thank you.
How did it go?
The widow wouldn't pay, so Phoebe yelled at her till she did.
I'm a hard-ass.
And I'm a wuss. We should be partners.
Hard-ass and wuss. We could fight crime.
Wait a minute, Phoebe.
We should be partners.
We should be catering partners.
You're not working now, and we have a great time together.
Okay. - I cook and you take care of the money.
Oh! Lt'll be like I have a wife in the '50s!
Hey. - Hey!
How did she like the gift?
She loved it. She's showing the girls right now.
Yeah? That's great.
I got to tell you...
...I feel bad taking credit for this, because...
...am I going to get a lot of credit for this!
Hey. - Hey.
Hey. Happy birthday.
Thank you.
You know, uh, Chandler got you a gift too.
No, he didn't.
Yeah, he did. Look, it's right there on the counter. Ho, ho!
Happy birthday.
I'm sorry.
You really didn't have to.
Wow! - See...
You think it's just a pen, but you turn it over and it's also a clock.
Really? No, this is great!
Thank you, Chandler. - Oh. Yeah.
Aw. Heh.
Want to go to bed?
I'll be in, in a minute.
Oh, uh... Don't forget your coupon.
Good night.
Um, thank you for the gift.
Oh, uh, I just knew that sometimes when you're writing...
...you don't always know the exact time.
No, I didn't mean the pen. Thank you for the book.
Uh, the book?
The Velveteen Rabbit?
I have a feeling you had something to do with it.
What do you mean?
When Joey gave it to me he said
"This is because I know you like rabbits, and I know you like cheese."
Thanks. I love it.
I know how hard it must have been for you to find.
In case you missed that, that sound was, "Oh, well."
You must really like Joey to go to all that trouble.
Oh, yeah. He's my...
He's my best friend.
Well... - Good night.
Hey, that coupon expires, you know.
Hi, uh, you don't know me. I'm Monica Geller, Ross' sister.
You know, it's too bad that didn't work out.
Anyway, he told me about your apartment.
Well, I couldn't sleep thinking about it.
So, uh, would it be okay if I cleaned it?
No?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你的美味晚餐 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thanks for the tasty dinner. - You're welcome for a tasty dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在看什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you guys looking at?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯和宇宙无敌第一美女
sense_groups.english: Ross and the most beautiful girl in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 好骚的娘儿们
sense_groups.english: Yeah, come to Papa!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在不像我会说的话
sense_groups.english: Probably the only time I'll say this...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们看到她的屁股了吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but did you see the ass on her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是… 你是…
sense_groups.english: What did you? When did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么… 你怎么把到那种货色的？
sense_groups.english: How did you? How did you get a girl like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是谁 代言模特儿？有氧舞蹈教练？
sense_groups.english: So what is she, like a spokesmodel? An aerobics instructor?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是古生物学博士候选人
sense_groups.english: Actually, she's a paleontology doctoral candidate...

sense_groups.chinese: 专攻新生代
sense_groups.english: ...specializing in the Cenozoic Era.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过那是最简单的时代
sense_groups.english: But that's, like, the easiest era.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在馆里见过她 但总觉得…
sense_groups.english: I've seen her at work, but I always figured...

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我做饭给她吃
sense_groups.english: But, uh, I made her dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们聊得很愉快 明天还要见面
sense_groups.english: We had a great time. And we're going out again tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许她跟朋友打赌 谁能钓到最怪的怪胎
sense_groups.english: Maybe her friends are betting to see who gets the biggest geek.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无所谓 祝她胜利
sense_groups.english: Fine by me. Hope she wins.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 有包装纸吗？
sense_groups.english: You have any wrapping paper?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要包我的生日礼物？
sense_groups.english: Is it for my birthday present?

sense_groups.chinese: 你生日都过了1个月
sense_groups.english: It was your birthday months ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但你说订了特别的东西 还没送来
sense_groups.english: You said you ordered something special and it just hadn't come yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有接到电话
sense_groups.english: I have a call in about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是给凯西的生日礼物 是她最喜欢的书的早期版本
sense_groups.english: It's for Kathy. It's an early copy of her favorite book.

sense_groups.chinese: 《天鹅绒兔宝宝》
sense_groups.english: Oh! The Velveteen Rabbit!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 当男孩的爱让他变成真兔子…
sense_groups.english: When the boy's love makes the rabbit real...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 别模 你的手有油污
sense_groups.english: Don't touch it, because your fingers have destructive oils.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你最好别靠近罗斯的头发
sense_groups.english: Then you'd better keep it away from Ross' hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 这很珍贵 你是怎么找到的？
sense_groups.english: This is pretty rare. How did you get that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 我只是跑了几家书店 问了几个书商
sense_groups.english: No big deal. I just went to some bookstores...

sense_groups.chinese: 联络了几个作者的孙子
sense_groups.english: ...talked to some dealers, called some of the author's grandchildren.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太贴心了
sense_groups.english: Honey, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全宣告了 "室友的马子 我在暗恋你"
sense_groups.english: What a great way to say, "I secretly love you, roommate's girlfriend."

sense_groups.chinese: 哪会啊…
sense_groups.english: It doesn't say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 会吗？
sense_groups.english: Does it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己看嘛 你送的礼物别具意义又昂贵
sense_groups.english: How will it look when you get her something incredibly meaningful...

sense_groups.chinese: 她的男朋友却送她一个柳橙
sense_groups.english: ...and expensive, and her boyfriend, Joey, gives her an orange?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会叫乔伊送她很好的礼物
sense_groups.english: I'll make sure Joey gets her something really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 可得比那本书还好
sense_groups.english: It's got to be better than that book.

sense_groups.chinese: 像十字弓啦
sense_groups.english: Ooh! Like a crossbow!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Once again, I am sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 再见
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我推掉一个60人的丧礼外烩
sense_groups.english: I had to turn down a job catering a funeral for 60 people.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 出了什么事？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 是60个"客人"
sense_groups.english: Sixty guests.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要推掉？
sense_groups.english: Why'd you have to turn it down?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我没有钱和用具
sense_groups.english: I don't have the money or equipment...

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能临时接这种大生意
sense_groups.english: ...to handle something that big on such short notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么消极是怎样？
sense_groups.english: Wow, what is with all the negativity?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好像"摩妮不可" 而不是"摩妮可"
sense_groups.english: You sound like "Moni-can't," not "Moni-can"!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮"卡"
sense_groups.english: Moni-ca.

sense_groups.chinese: 你办外烩都3年多了
sense_groups.english: You've been playing around with this catering for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底想不想当外烩厨师？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Do you want to be a caterer? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了
sense_groups.english: There you go! That's the spirit!

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要钱我借你 你就接吧
sense_groups.english: If you need money, I will lend you money. Just get moving!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？我需要5百元来采买
sense_groups.english: Really? I'd need $500 for all the food and supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 能让你接就值得 你好几个月没工作了
sense_groups.english: It's worth it if it'll get you moving. You haven't worked in months!

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是
sense_groups.english: Neither have you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我正在资助你
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I'm doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: That would be great! Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你家的钥匙借我
sense_groups.english: Can I borrow your apartment keys?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以在这里尿啊
sense_groups.english: You can pee here.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. Yes, I can, of course. Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正正好鸭子也在用浴室
sense_groups.english: It's okay. The duck's using our bathroom anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要送她什么生日礼物？
sense_groups.english: What are you getting for her birthday?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才交往2星期也要送吗？
sense_groups.english: We've been dating a couple weeks. I got to get her something?

sense_groups.chinese: 要啊
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 不但要送 还要送得很好
sense_groups.english: Yes! You have to get her something really nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 有了 - 1小时的…
sense_groups.english: I know! - And not one of your coupons...

sense_groups.chinese: "乔伊猛男体验券"不算
sense_groups.english: ...for an hour of "Joey Love."

sense_groups.chinese: 填字游戏 我可以帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Ooh! A crossword! Can I help?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 可是上星期我几乎全答对了
sense_groups.english: Last week I got all but three answers...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想独力完成一次
sense_groups.english: ...and I want to finish one without any help.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你也不能帮我研发新宇宙语
sense_groups.english: But you can't help me develop my new universal language.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey! - How'd it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这个葬礼太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! It was the best funeral ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都说好吃 还有
sense_groups.english: Everyone loved the food.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还接了明天的另一场葬礼
sense_groups.english: I even got another funeral for tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 是今天的死者的死党
sense_groups.english: The dead guy from today's best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我成了那场事故的指定外绘
sense_groups.english: It's like I am the official caterer for that accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真替你高兴
sense_groups.english: Mon, I'm so happy for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 你看我的新用具
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Check out my new catering stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 我可以去卖蛋卷
sense_groups.english: Look! I'm an omelet station!

sense_groups.chinese: 要特制蛋卷吗？
sense_groups.english: Omelet? Made to order? - Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 请给我一份 还有我的钱
sense_groups.english: I'll have one, please. Plus my money.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得你 马上就要
sense_groups.english: I didn't realize you needed it right away.

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫我去当外烩厨师 我就去了
sense_groups.english: You told me to go and be a caterer. So I went. I be'd.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把钱都花掉了
sense_groups.english: I used it to buy all this stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天还有生意 到时就能还你
sense_groups.english: I got another job tomorrow, so I'll pay you back then.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 抱歉刚才一副银行嘴脸
sense_groups.english: Oh! Okay. Sorry I acted like a bank.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要进来吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, would you like to come in?

sense_groups.chinese: 直立人是用木器打猎吗？
sense_groups.english: Did Homo erectus hunt with wooden tools?

sense_groups.chinese: 最新证据显示是的
sense_groups.english: According to recent findings.

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜琪 来 来 蜜琪
sense_groups.english: Here, Mitzi! Here, Mitzi!

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜琪是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, Mitzi is?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的仓鼠
sense_groups.english: My hamster.

sense_groups.chinese: 但愿他没事 好久没见到他了
sense_groups.english: I hope she's okay. I haven't seen her in a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐
sense_groups.english: Have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你…
sense_groups.english: Uh, oh! Do you, uh...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有肉桂水果烤吐司吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have any, um, Cinnamon Fruit Toasties?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我有
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回我家去 点几根蜡烛
sense_groups.english: Let's go back to my place, light a couple candles...

sense_groups.chinese: 开一盒肉桂水果烤吐司
sense_groups.english: ...break open a box of Cinnamon Fruit Toasties?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是不要好了 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I'd rather not. - Oh, yeah? Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有恶意
sense_groups.english: Okay, um... Don't take this the wrong way...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你家有一股怪味
sense_groups.english: ...but your place kind of has a weird smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 东西都上车了？ - 对 钱拿到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Is everything in the car? - Did you settle the bill?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 我最讨厌要钱了
sense_groups.english: No. I hate this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 差点忘了这个
sense_groups.english: Ooh! Oh! Look what we almost left!

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是我的 - 噢
sense_groups.english: That's not mine. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 差点偷了这个
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Look what we almost took!

sense_groups.chinese: 柏卡特太太？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, Ms. Burkart?

sense_groups.chinese: 厨房都收拾好了
sense_groups.english: Well, we're all cleaned up.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh. Good. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一件小事…
sense_groups.english: And, well, there's this small matter of the, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？ - 就是…
sense_groups.english: Dear? - The matter of...

sense_groups.chinese: 费用的事
sense_groups.english: ...payment.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱都是杰克在管
sense_groups.english: Jack used to handle the finances.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what we should all do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该去看歌舞剧
sense_groups.english: Go see a musical.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道应该看哪一部？
sense_groups.english: You know which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 1996年东尼奖得奖作品
sense_groups.english: The 1996 Tony Award winner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道它的名字吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know the name of that one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得《火爆浪子》？
sense_groups.english: I don't know, um, Grease?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 《吉屋出租》？
sense_groups.english: Rent?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 《吉屋出租》
sense_groups.english: Yes! Rent!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 什么时候去？
sense_groups.english: So when do you want to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我不行 我很忙
sense_groups.english: What? I'm sorry. I can't, I'm busy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 女孩子的礼物真难买
sense_groups.english: Man, it is so hard to shop for girls. Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 的确很难… 文具店？
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is, at Office Max!

sense_groups.chinese: 你买了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you get her?

sense_groups.chinese: 一支笔
sense_groups.english: A pen.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是二合一 是笔 也是时钟
sense_groups.english: It's two gifts in one. It's a pen that's also a clock. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能送这个 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. You can't give her that. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是小孩子
sense_groups.english: She's not 11!

sense_groups.chinese: 这也不是光明节结束前夕
sense_groups.english: And it's not the seventh night of Chanukah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的意思是 这个礼物虽然好
sense_groups.english: What he means by that is, while this is a very nice gift...

sense_groups.chinese: 却不适合送给女朋友
sense_groups.english: ...maybe it's not something a boyfriend gives.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然适合
sense_groups.english: Sure, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 她上班要用到笔
sense_groups.english: She needs a pen for work.

sense_groups.chinese: 写到一半转过来一看 "哇 该去跟乔伊约会了"
sense_groups.english: She's writing. She turns it over. "Whoa! It's time for my date with Joey!"

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你送安琪拉什么生日礼物？
sense_groups.english: All right. What did you get for Angela Del Veccio's birthday?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交柱时没碰上生日
sense_groups.english: She didn't have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 整整3年？
sense_groups.english: For three years?

sense_groups.chinese: 已经来不及了 我还要试镜
sense_groups.english: Look, it's too late, and I got an audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能再找了
sense_groups.english: I can't shop anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮你找 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I will go out and try to find something for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能顺便买张卡片？
sense_groups.english: While you're at it, could you get her a card?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要我顺便写一首小诗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like me to write her a little poem as well?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是买张印了诗的卡片
sense_groups.english: Or just get a card that has a poem already in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得把钱要到 - 但是她哭个不停
sense_groups.english: Oh! You have to get our money. - She couldn't stop crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 眼泪还被眼镜放大了
sense_groups.english: With those thick glasses, her tears look giant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道很难
sense_groups.english: I know, it's tough.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我妈一下葬我做了什么
sense_groups.english: You know what the first thing I did after my mom's funeral was?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 付钱给外烩厨师
sense_groups.english: What? - Pay the caterer!

sense_groups.chinese: 我做过很多工作
sense_groups.english: I've had a lot of jobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人总是想赖帐
sense_groups.english: And there are some people who always try to get out of paying.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是"按摩时间不够长"
sense_groups.english: It's either "That massage wasn't long enough"...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是"我没听过这几首歌"
sense_groups.english: ...or "I don't know any of those songs"...

sense_groups.chinese: 或"这些墨西哥草帽不够大" "坏心眼的白妞"
sense_groups.english: ...or "These sombreros aren't big enough. Bad little white girl!"

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她在装？
sense_groups.english: So you think she's faking?

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿出帐单前她根本没哭
sense_groups.english: There weren't any tears till you showed her the bill.

sense_groups.chinese: 她听起来很难过
sense_groups.english: She sounded pretty upset to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是一个古老而绚丽的旗帜
sense_groups.english: You're a grand old flag

sense_groups.chinese: 你是一个野心勃勃的国旗 永远在为和平努力
sense_groups.english: You're a high -flying flag And forever in peace may you wave

sense_groups.chinese: 现在似乎没事了
sense_groups.english: She seems fine now.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你就走了？她家真的那么脏？
sense_groups.english: So you just left? Her place was really that bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们下班回家 会把外套扔到椅子上
sense_groups.english: You throw your jacket on a chair at the end of the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 在她家是扔到一堆垃圾上
sense_groups.english: Like that, only instead of a chair, it's a pile of garbage.

sense_groups.chinese: 那也不是外套 而是一堆垃圾
sense_groups.english: And instead of a jacket, it's a pile of garbage.

sense_groups.chinese: 那也不是下班回家 而是世界末日
sense_groups.english: And instead of the end of the day, it's the end of time...

sense_groups.chinese: 只有垃圾存留下来
sense_groups.english: ...and garbage is all that has survived.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Here. - Wow. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后呢？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有然后 我逃之夭夭
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I had to get out of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次你就带她去你家
sense_groups.english: Next time, you take her to your place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我试过了 她说我家有怪味
sense_groups.english: I tried that. She says it has a weird smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么怪味？ - 不晓得 香皂味？
sense_groups.english: What kind of smell? - I don't know. Soap?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你喜欢她对吧？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Listen, you like this girl, right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想再跟她见面？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You want to see her again? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你就得在垃圾里跟她做
sense_groups.english: So you're going to have to do it in the mess!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说得对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 稍微乱一点又怎样？
sense_groups.english: I mean, uh, who cares about a little sloppiness?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实蛮可爱的 - 很好
sense_groups.english: It's endearing, really. - All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 去搏倒那只美丽的猪吧
sense_groups.english: Now you go get that beautiful pig!

sense_groups.chinese: 我花了一下午替凯西找一件
sense_groups.english: I just spent the entire afternoon looking for a present...

sense_groups.chinese: 比这只兔子好的礼物
sense_groups.english: ...for Kathy that would be better than the rabbit.

sense_groups.chinese: 有找到吗？
sense_groups.english: Any luck?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我找到一家店 叫"送给凯西的隐形礼物"
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I found this great place called "Invisible Things for Kathy."

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能帮我搬一这些礼物？
sense_groups.english: Can you give me a hand with all this stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 你就把书退回去 让乔伊送她那支时钟笔
sense_groups.english: Just return the book, let Joey give her the clock pen...

sense_groups.chinese: 你送个更差的东西 例如…
sense_groups.english: ...and you get her something worse than that...

sense_groups.chinese: 一支普通的笔
sense_groups.english: ...like a regular pen.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会很喜欢这本书
sense_groups.english: She's really going to love this, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望她拥有这本书
sense_groups.english: The bottom line is, I want her to have it...

sense_groups.chinese: 就算不是我送的也行
sense_groups.english: ...even if I don't get to be the one who gives it to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好贴心喔
sense_groups.english: Aw, honey, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得很可悲吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah? You don't think it's just pathetic?

sense_groups.chinese: 是"可悲"
sense_groups.english: Oh, "pathetic"!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去见凯西了 我到处找你
sense_groups.english: Hey! I've been looking all over for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 在哪里找？ - 家里啦 大厅啦
sense_groups.english: Where? - Our place. The hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到礼物了
sense_groups.english: I got something.

sense_groups.chinese: 是一本书
sense_groups.english: It's a book.

sense_groups.chinese: 书？
sense_groups.english: A book?

sense_groups.chinese: 是书也是保险盒？
sense_groups.english: Is it a book that's also a safe?

sense_groups.chinese: 它就是一本书
sense_groups.english: It's a book that's just a book.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她小时候最喜欢的书 《天鹅绒兔宝宝》的珍本
sense_groups.english: It's The Velveteen Rabbit. It was her favorite as a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我知道她喜不喜欢 好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, just let me know if she likes it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 我欠你一次
sense_groups.english: Thanks for doing this. I owe you one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那20块没有找钱是吧？
sense_groups.english: There wasn't any change from that twenty, was there?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 刚好20块
sense_groups.english: No, it came out to an even twenty.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 跟新书差不多贵
sense_groups.english: Wow. That's almost as much as a new book.

sense_groups.chinese: 惊心食人族
sense_groups.english: Jeepers Creepers

sense_groups.chinese: 你从哪里找到这些私家侦探的?
sense_groups.english: Where'd you get those peepers?

sense_groups.chinese: 惊心食人族哪里来的那些眼睛?
sense_groups.english: Jeepers Creepers Where'd you get those eyes?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是没要到 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You didn't get the money?

sense_groups.chinese: 等她暂停再去好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe I can try at intermission?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就走吧
sense_groups.english: You know what? Let's just go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 钱没拿到不能走
sense_groups.english: No! Hey! We're not leaving till we get paid!

sense_groups.chinese: 她以为她是谁啊
sense_groups.english: I don't know who she thinks she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我受够了
sense_groups.english: Enough is enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 未亡人
sense_groups.english: Hey, widow?

sense_groups.chinese: 死老公的 打扰一下
sense_groups.english: Widow? Excuse me? Excuse me!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 你现在当然十分难过
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Um, clearly this is a very, very hard time for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们提供服务 就该领到费用
sense_groups.english: Um, but we provided a service, and we deserve to be paid...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你吃都吃了
sense_groups.english: ...because you ate that service.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱没付清我们不会走
sense_groups.english: We are not leaving here until we are paid every penny, because...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们是兼职的 不必赶场
sense_groups.english: ...we're part-time caterers and we have no place else to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我去拿皮包
sense_groups.english: All right. I'll get my bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我留几张名片
sense_groups.english: I'm going to leave some cards here.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次有需要请考虑我们
sense_groups.english: Please think of us for your next event.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想进来吗？
sense_groups.english: You want to come inside?

sense_groups.chinese: 想
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想
sense_groups.english: Yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来 你随便坐
sense_groups.english: I'll be right back. Make yourself comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 猜精我是谁？
sense_groups.english: Guess who. - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 卫生稽查人员？
sense_groups.english: Department of Sanitation?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我 - 噢
sense_groups.english: It's me. - Ha, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Aw!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 雪柔 - 喔 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, Cheryl! - Oh, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 上帝
sense_groups.english: Oh! God!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我的上帝
sense_groups.english: Aah! Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的仓鼠 是蜜琪
sense_groups.english: It's my hamster! It's Mitzi!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 对不起 我吓到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! I'm so sorry. I must have freaked out.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好不是蜜琪
sense_groups.english: Thank God it's not Mitzi!

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一只老鼠
sense_groups.english: It's just a rat.

sense_groups.chinese: 完成了
sense_groups.english: I did it! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我填完了 我一个人把它填完了
sense_groups.english: I finished it! I did it all by myself!

sense_groups.chinese: 却没有人可抱
sense_groups.english: And there's nobody to hug.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们
sense_groups.english: Hey! Hey, you guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 我一个人把字谜填完了 抱我
sense_groups.english: I finished it all by myself! Hug me.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yay! So good!

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Congratulations. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 外烩办得怎样？
sense_groups.english: How did it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个寡妇不肯付钱 菲比就骂到她付钱为止
sense_groups.english: The widow wouldn't pay, so Phoebe yelled at her till she did.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我是狠角色
sense_groups.english: I'm a hard-ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我是软脚虾 我们应该联手
sense_groups.english: And I'm a wuss. We should be partners.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 狠角色和软脚虾打击犯罪
sense_groups.english: Hard-ass and wuss. We could fight crime.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是该联手
sense_groups.english: We should be partners.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该合伙办外烩
sense_groups.english: We should be catering partners.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想嘛 你现在没工作 我们又合作无间
sense_groups.english: You're not working now, and we have a great time together.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 我下厨 你管钱
sense_groups.english: Okay. - I cook and you take care of the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就像娶了个很传统的老婆
sense_groups.english: Oh! Lt'll be like I have a wife in the '50s!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？她喜欢吗？
sense_groups.english: How did she like the gift?

sense_groups.chinese: 她爱死了 她拿去隔壁给女生们看
sense_groups.english: She loved it. She's showing the girls right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？太好了
sense_groups.english: Yeah? That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 老实说
sense_groups.english: I got to tell you...

sense_groups.chinese: 占了这个功劳我很过意不去
sense_groups.english: ...I feel bad taking credit for this, because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可有得爽了
sense_groups.english: ...am I going to get a lot of credit for this!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Hey. Happy birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德也有礼物要送你
sense_groups.english: You know, uh, Chandler got you a gift too.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有
sense_groups.english: No, he didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有 看 就在餐台上
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he did. Look, it's right there on the counter. Ho, ho!

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐…
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何必破费
sense_groups.english: You really didn't have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 看呐
sense_groups.english: Wow! - See...

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为这是一支笔 其实转过来还有时钟
sense_groups.english: You think it's just a pen, but you turn it over and it's also a clock.

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒的礼物
sense_groups.english: Really? No, this is great!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 钱德 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Chandler. - Oh. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Aw. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 要睡觉了吗？
sense_groups.english: Want to go to bed?

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上就来
sense_groups.english: I'll be in, in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 别忘了带"猛男体验券"
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh... Don't forget your coupon.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你的礼物
sense_groups.english: Um, thank you for the gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想有时你写字时
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, I just knew that sometimes when you're writing...

sense_groups.chinese: 不一定知道确切时间
sense_groups.english: ...you don't always know the exact time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说这支笔 谢谢你那本书
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't mean the pen. Thank you for the book.

sense_groups.chinese: 书？
sense_groups.english: Uh, the book?

sense_groups.chinese: 《天鹅绒兔宝宝》
sense_groups.english: The Velveteen Rabbit?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得跟你有关
sense_groups.english: I have a feeling you had something to do with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊送我的时候说
sense_groups.english: When Joey gave it to me he said

sense_groups.chinese: "因为我知道你喜欢兔子 也喜欢起司"
sense_groups.english: "This is because I know you like rabbits, and I know you like cheese."

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我好喜欢
sense_groups.english: Thanks. I love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定花了很多功夫
sense_groups.english: I know how hard it must have been for you to find.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你没听到 我的意思是"还好啦"
sense_groups.english: In case you missed that, that sound was, "Oh, well."

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定很喜欢乔伊 才会这么费心
sense_groups.english: You must really like Joey to go to all that trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 他是…
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. He's my...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: He's my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯… - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Well... - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 那可是限时体验券
sense_groups.english: Hey, that coupon expires, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不认识我 我是摩妮卡盖勒 罗斯的妹妹
sense_groups.english: Hi, uh, you don't know me. I'm Monica Geller, Ross' sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 我们合不来的
sense_groups.english: You know, it's too bad that didn't work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之他提到你家的情况
sense_groups.english: Anyway, he told me about your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想得睡不着
sense_groups.english: Well, I couldn't sleep thinking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮你打扫吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, would it be okay if I cleaned it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行吗？
sense_groups.english: No?

questions.name: S04E07
questions.en:
I just saw Kathy naked.
It was like torture.
If we go to war and you're captured, you're in for a surprise.
It keeps getting worse.
I'm in love with my roommate's girlfriend.
Every time we're in the same room, there's weird energy between us.
Call me crazy, but I think she likes me too.
And now I have seen her naked.
At least with her clothes on...
...I could imagine her body was covered in boils.
But there are no boils. She's smooth.
Smooth!
Wow...
Could you see up his robe?
Oh, my God. - Yeah.
Here you go. - I'll call you.
Great.
Hey, hey. Who was that?
Casey. We're going out tonight.
Going out? Wow.
It didn't work out with Kathy? Bummer.
No, things are fine.
I'm having a late meal with her after an early one with Casey.
What? - Yeah.

sense_groups.english: I just figured we hit a dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 请凯西来听 我要跟她道歉
sense_groups.english: Could you put Kathy on? I want to apologize to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊找你
sense_groups.english: It's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 放心好了
sense_groups.english: No, it's fine. Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再道歉了 没关系
sense_groups.english: Yeah, no, stop apologizing. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 明天再联络
sense_groups.english: I'll talk to you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了 - 对
sense_groups.english: I should probably go. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yeah...

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了带皮包
sense_groups.english: I forgot my purse.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是真的忘了带皮包 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I really did. I forgot my purse.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很不好 - 太糟糕了
sense_groups.english: This is bad. It's bad. - Horrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说吻还是状况？
sense_groups.english: Wait, the kiss or the situation?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个吻很棒
sense_groups.english: The kiss was good.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这样很不好 - 对 好 这样吧
sense_groups.english: But that's bad. - Here's what we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们忘了这件事 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: We forget it. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们压抑我们的感觉 即使这样会痛苦一辈子 不错吧？
sense_groups.english: We swallow our feelings, even if we're unhappy forever. Sound good?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的做得到？
sense_groups.english: Can you really do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不得不 他是我最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: I have to. He's my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你在跟他交往
sense_groups.english: And you're seeing him.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我很喜欢乔伊
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I like Joey a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是跟你…
sense_groups.english: But with you...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别说了
sense_groups.english: No, don't. Don't, see?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会把我搞乱 我已经开始渴望了
sense_groups.english: You're getting me confused. I'm starting to yearn.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你想假装没事 我可以试试看
sense_groups.english: If you want to pretend that nothing happened, I can try.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们非这么做不可
sense_groups.english: I think we have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在外面吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you still out there?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 振奋人心
sense_groups.english: Electrifying

sense_groups.chinese: 无穷的时间
sense_groups.english: Infinite time

sense_groups.chinese: 三条街外有一家星巴克
sense_groups.english: There's a Starbucks about three blocks down.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的灵感好丰富 你们看他
sense_groups.english: He's so inspired. Just look at him. Look at him go.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢各位
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 接着不是该你？
sense_groups.english: Hey, aren't you up next?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我今天不唱了 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm not playing tonight. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能接在罗斯后面
sense_groups.english: I can't follow Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就像骑脚踏车的猩猩
sense_groups.english: It'd be like those poor bicycle-riding chimps...

sense_groups.chinese: 接在彼头四后面一样 天哪
sense_groups.english: ...who had to follow the Beatles. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 罗斯很烂
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. Ross sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 他把客人都吓跑了
sense_groups.english: The place has emptied because of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 当世甚至没有人欣赏他
sense_groups.english: My God, he's not even appreciated in his own time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我巴不得能跟他一样寂寞
sense_groups.english: I'd give anything to not be appreciated in my own time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 菲比…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 你也很烂
sense_groups.english: You suck too.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 菲比
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你…烂透了
sense_groups.english: You're awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的
sense_groups.english: You guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们也很烂
sense_groups.english: You suck too.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我居然又把自己锁在外面了
sense_groups.english: Man. I can't believe I locked myself out again.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hang on, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 出了什么事？
sense_groups.english: My God. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 这都是你买的？为什么？ - 就是我
sense_groups.english: Did you do all this? Why? - I sure did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢为我的朋友尽一点心
sense_groups.english: It made me feel good to do something nice for my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好
sense_groups.english: You're amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这个才叫好
sense_groups.english: No, this is amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 凭空冒出来的电视
sense_groups.english: A TV appears from nowhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的梦想
sense_groups.english: The dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 你哪来这么多钱？
sense_groups.english: How did you afford all this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我都29了 还存什么钱？
sense_groups.english: I'm 29. I mean, who needs a savings account?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是世界上最棒的朋友
sense_groups.english: You're the best friend anyone has ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不敢说
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么不敢
sense_groups.english: No, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你买这些东西 还给我忠告
sense_groups.english: You do this, you give me advice...

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你不是要我定下来？
sense_groups.english: What you said about focusing on one woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定照做
sense_groups.english: I'll do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟凯希？
sense_groups.english: With Casey?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我要跟凯西继续 她很酷
sense_groups.english: I'll see how things go with Kathy. She's cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者凯希 - 不 凯西
sense_groups.english: Or Casey. - No, Kathy.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯希也行
sense_groups.english: Could be Casey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 凯西
sense_groups.english: No, Kathy.

sense_groups.chinese: 考虑一下凯希
sense_groups.english: Consider Casey.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来有人在喜欢凯希喔
sense_groups.english: I think somebody's got a little crush on Casey.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要我帮你们牵线？
sense_groups.english: I'll fix you two up. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 那我这一生将了无遗憾
sense_groups.english: That all the pieces of my life are falling right into place.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好厉害 真的真的好厉害
sense_groups.english: You were really great. You were really, really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡说你不想再表演了
sense_groups.english: Monica tells me you don't want to play anymore because of me...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我和我的才华
sense_groups.english: ...and, you know, my talent.

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that true?

sense_groups.chinese: 算是吧 - 菲比·布菲
sense_groups.english: Well, kind of, yeah. - Pheebs...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想抱持无所谓乐观的态度
sense_groups.english: I was trying to be really okay and upbeat about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你的才华令我自惭形秽
sense_groups.english: ...but I just feel so dwarfed by your musical gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是…
sense_groups.english: See, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这跟我做音乐的用意 正好相反
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, that is the exact opposite intent of my music.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做音乐是想要鼓舞人心
sense_groups.english: You know, my music is meant to inspire.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你这么困扰 那我…
sense_groups.english: If it bothers you this much...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不弹了
sense_groups.english: ...then I won't play anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 千万不要
sense_groups.english: No, don't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能让这个世界 失去你的音乐？
sense_groups.english: How could I live if I knew I was depriving the world of your music?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 新家具很棒喔
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. Saw the new furniture. Very nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊有你这个男朋友真好
sense_groups.english: Joey has the best boyfriend ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吻了凯西
sense_groups.english: I kissed Kathy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的还假的？
sense_groups.english: What? Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊知道吗？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Does Joey know? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想他有可能谅解吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there any way you think he will understand this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你显然没有背叛过朋友
sense_groups.english: You obviously haven't screwed over your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都很感激
sense_groups.english: Which we all appreciate.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你先坦承你的感觉再亲她
sense_groups.english: If you'd told him how you felt before you kissed her...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊一定会退让
sense_groups.english: ...knowing Joey, he'd have stepped aside.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这么说 这不是真的吧？
sense_groups.english: Don't say that. That's not true, is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啊 - 他爱你
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - He loves you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你们怎么不告诉我？
sense_groups.english: Then why didn't you tell me to do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟菲比聊过
sense_groups.english: I said something to Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我觉得这是个好主意
sense_groups.english: And I thought it was a really good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我记得 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I remember. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What am I going to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得告诉他
sense_groups.english: You'll have to tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我要告诉他？
sense_groups.english: Why do I have to?

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是得说 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Because you do. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以拿这件事写一首歌吗？
sense_groups.english: Would it be okay if I wrote a song about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 茴香玛格丽特？
sense_groups.english: Sambuca Margarita?

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的吗？
sense_groups.english: It that a real thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只有茴香酒 所以是
sense_groups.english: Well, we only had sambuca, so it is now.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Listen, Joe. I need to...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有事要说
sense_groups.english: I need to talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 是凯西的事
sense_groups.english: It's about Kathy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢她
sense_groups.english: I like her.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是非常喜欢
sense_groups.english: I like her a lot, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: You do?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你的时机正好
sense_groups.english: Your timing couldn't be better.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是我的女朋友了
sense_groups.english: She's not my girlfriend anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟我分手了 - 什么时候？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she broke up with me. - When?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才上完表演课后
sense_groups.english: Just now, after acting class.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为她在演戏 还让别人看
sense_groups.english: I thought she was doing some scene, so I let people watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 太可惜了 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Man, I am so sorry. Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不太好 但我没事 你喜欢她？
sense_groups.english: I've been better, but I'm all right. So you like her?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我不一定要喜欢她
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I don't have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道为什么？因为你先来告诉我
sense_groups.english: You know why? Because you came to me first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这么做最好
sense_groups.english: I thought that would be the best thing to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能会很辛苦
sense_groups.english: You might have your work cut out for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她谈的时候 觉得她在喜欢别人
sense_groups.english: When I talked to her, I got the feeling she's into some other guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我要跟你谈的事
sense_groups.english: See, that's actually what I wanted to talk to you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我知道那个人是谁
sense_groups.english: I think I know who the other guy is.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我
sense_groups.english: It's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是那个别人
sense_groups.english: I'm the other guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你昨天晚归 凯西和我聊了起来
sense_groups.english: When you were late last night, Kathy and I got to talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 事情演变到后来就…
sense_groups.english: ...and one thing led to another, and...

sense_groups.chinese: 就什么？你跟她上床？
sense_groups.english: And what? Did you sleep with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我只是吻了她
sense_groups.english: No, I just kissed her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？那样更糟
sense_groups.english: What? That's even worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会更糟？- 我不知道 反正都一样
sense_groups.english: How is that worse? - It's the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我也没办法 我爱上她了
sense_groups.english: There's nothing I could do. I'm in love with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 你背着我乱来？我绝不会那样对你
sense_groups.english: You went behind my back? I'd never do that to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我无话可说 我太过份了
sense_groups.english: I have no excuses. I was totally over the line.

sense_groups.chinese: 过份？你根本就过份到连过份都不算过份
sense_groups.english: You're so far past the line, that you can't even see the line.

sense_groups.chinese: 只能算正常
sense_groups.english: It's a dot to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我很自责 你要相信我
sense_groups.english: Yes, right. And I feel horrible. You have to believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你买了这些东西？
sense_groups.english: Is that why you bought all this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不看你的电视
sense_groups.english: I will not watch your TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不听你的音响
sense_groups.english: I won't listen to your stereo.

sense_groups.chinese: 烤面包机里有一个面包我不吃 你知道为什么？
sense_groups.english: And there's a loaf in the new bread maker I won't eat. Know why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…
sense_groups.english: Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为它被你的背叛弄脏了
sense_groups.english: It's all tainted with your betrayal.

sense_groups.chinese: 今后这间房子对我而言是空的 我对你也很不爽
sense_groups.english: This apartment is empty to me. I'm not happy about you, either.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你说一声
sense_groups.english: And just so you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个面包是为你烤的
sense_groups.english: ...I made that bread for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 他完全不行了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. He's totally lost it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 他的音乐本来就烂到最高点
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. This cannot get any worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 地下室的老鼠都去上吊了
sense_groups.english: Rats in the basement are hanging themselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不行了
sense_groups.english: I lost it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再也不玩音乐了
sense_groups.english: I won't play anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意… 你可以完成我的作品吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you... Can you finish my set?

sense_groups.chinese: 接着上台？可以
sense_groups.english: After that? Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我愿意尽力
sense_groups.english: No, I mean, if I can help.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么可能不行了
sense_groups.english: Like I could lose it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我是故意弹得很烂
sense_groups.english: What? - I played bad on purpose, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你一直都在故意
sense_groups.english: You were playing bad this whole time.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只有刚才那首
sense_groups.english: Just that last song.

questions.name: S04E08
questions.en:
Hello?
It's me. I know you can't stand to be in the same room.
I just thought I'd try and apologize over the phone...
Hello?
Look, I never should've kissed your girlfriend, and I'm...
Stop calling!
Hey, hey, hey. This is 92.3 WXRK K-Rock...
...calling with our $1000 daily challenge.
All right.
What is the name of...
...your roommate who is very, very sorry and would do anything...?
Ugh, turkey.
Ugh, giving thanks. Ugh.
Look, everyone, it's the spirit of Thanksgiving.
Are things with Joey any better?
They couldn't be worse. I spent eight hours calling him...
...trying to get him to talk to me.
Oh, wow. Eight hours.
So you could probably really use one of those plug-in telephone headsets, huh?
Should we all expect Christmas gifts that can be stolen from your office?
You shouldn't.
Speaking of Christmas...
...since Monica and I are starting a new business and have like no money...
...this year maybe we could do Secret Santa and then we each only buy one gift.
And there's the added mystery of, you know, who gets who.
Who gets "whom."
I don't know why I do that.
Oh, I'm gonna take a nap. Turkey makes me sleepy.
We haven't eaten yet.
I know, but all that work you're doing to get it ready, and I just...
Hey, did either of you pick Rachel for your Secret Santa?
Because I wanna trade for her. - I picked her. Oh, thank God, you want her.
Ooh.
Wow, why do you wanna get rid of her so badly?
Because she exchanges every gift she gets.
It's, like, impossible to get her something she likes.
Come on, let's trade.
That's not true. I got her that backpack and she loved it.
I remember how much she was crying the day that big dog ran off with...
There was no big dog.
This sucks, because I already got her this briefcase and I had "R.G." put on it.
Her initials. - Oh.
Maybe you can give it to somebody else. Oh. Like Ross Geller.
Oh, you know what, though? It's a girlie briefcase.
Who cares? He works in a museum.
Hey, what time is it? The big game's about to start.
Ross and Joey aren't here. You can watch the parade if you want.
Thanks.
What is wrong with this freezer? Ow! Ow!
God, what happened? - Oh, my God, ice just got in my eye.
People are trying to sleep in here.
Monica got ice in her eye and it hurts.
Open it up. Let me see. - Oh, I can't. It really kills.
Well, maybe you should put some ice on it.
Ooh, it looks bad. - Maybe we should take you to a doctor.
No, my eye doctor is Richard.
I can't go to him when I don't have a boyfriend.
He's really picky about his patients.
Okay, you've gotta go. What's his office number?
Oh, like I remember his office number.
Speed dial 7.
Hi, yeah, I'm calling on behalf of Monica Geller's eye, and...
Is Richard Burke in today?
He's out of town. Does she wanna see the on-call doctor?
Yes. - Yes. She's very excited about that.
It's so cool.
Till Monica gets back, it's like I'm head chef and I get to make all the decisions.
Hey, hey, I thought she told you to follow the recipe exactly.
Okay, get out of my kitchen.
All right, okay. I think I'm making some progress with Joey.
