sense_groups.chinese: 但我已经替她买了光明节礼物
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm getting her something for Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想换吗？
sense_groups.english: You wanna switch?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我想换成你
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? I was trying to trade for, uh, ahem, well, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？真好 你要送我什么？
sense_groups.english: Really? Wow, that's so nice. What are you gonna get me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得 RG 某种女性化的上班用品吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know, R.G. I was thinking something girlie for your office.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许菲比会跟我换
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Well, maybe Phoebe will switch with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好不要 那你会抽到瑞秋 她什么礼物都会拿去换
sense_groups.english: Then you're gonna get stuck with Rachel, and she exchanges every gift she ever gets.

sense_groups.chinese: 乱讲 我送她很多东西她都没退
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's not true. I got her lots of stuff she never took back.

sense_groups.chinese: 像什么？
sense_groups.english: Like?

sense_groups.chinese: 像我去年送她的金项链
sense_groups.english: Like that gold necklace I got her last year.

sense_groups.chinese: 她上次戴是哪时？
sense_groups.english: When was the last time you saw her wear it?

sense_groups.chinese: 她圣诞节整天都戴着 然后…
sense_groups.english: Well, she wore it all Christmas day and then, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 大狗？
sense_groups.english: Big dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 把钱德因内疚买的东西退回去
sense_groups.english: Sending back this stuff Chandler bought out of guilt.

sense_groups.chinese: 全部？包括电视？ - 不 电视要搬进我房里
sense_groups.english: Everything? Even the TV? - No, I'm gonna put that in my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 乔伊 我知道他做错了
sense_groups.english: Listen, Joey. I know what he did was wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你就不能听他解释吗？
sense_groups.english: But don't you think you could hear the guy out?

sense_groups.chinese: 你和瑞秋在一起时
sense_groups.english: When you and Rachel were together...

sense_groups.chinese: 要是钱德吻了她 你会听他解释吗？
sense_groups.english: ...if Chandler had kissed her, would you hear him out?

sense_groups.chinese: 说得好
sense_groups.english: That's a good point.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你要惩罚他多久？
sense_groups.english: So how long you gonna punish him?

sense_groups.chinese: 5年
sense_groups.english: Five years.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还判了刑？
sense_groups.english: You've sentenced him?

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢当就不要做
sense_groups.english: Hey, don't do the crime if you can't do the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是你最要好的朋友 - 那是以前
sense_groups.english: But, Joey, the guy's your best friend. - No, was my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛拼命替他说情？
sense_groups.english: I don't know why you're pushing for him so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 少了他碍事 我"最要好的朋友"就空出来了
sense_groups.english: With him out of the way as my best friend, there's a spot open.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Who, me? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真荣幸
sense_groups.english: Wow. I'm honored.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 当最好的朋友我首先要做什么？
sense_groups.english: You know what I'm gonna do as my first act as your best friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 扛你去跟钱德说话
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna get you to talk to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 若非你是我最好的朋友…
sense_groups.english: Oh, but if you weren't my best friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 真的那么严重？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Is it really that bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 我进了门 他根本不理我
sense_groups.english: I walk in the room, and he won't even talk to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 只碎碎念了几句意大利文
sense_groups.english: He just mumbles something in Italian.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道他只会脏话
sense_groups.english: And I know he only knows the bad words.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 你有看见钱德吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther, have you seen Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你才是钱德
sense_groups.english: I thought you were Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其中一个在那边
sense_groups.english: But, um, one of you is over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上就好
sense_groups.english: I'll be right with you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thanks for coming in.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这个代诊医生真可爱
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. How cute is the on-call doctor?

sense_groups.chinese: 可爱到我想拿笔插我的眼睛
sense_groups.english: Oh. So cute that I'm thinking about jamming this pen in my eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 柏克医生可以见你了
sense_groups.english: Dr. Burke will see you now.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是柏克医生 柏克医生不在
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no, not Dr. Burke. Dr. Burke's out of town.

sense_groups.chinese: 是代诊医生要帮我看
sense_groups.english: The on-call doctor will see me now.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查柏克医生不在
sense_groups.english: Dr. Richard Burke is out.

sense_groups.chinese: 他儿子提摩西柏克医生帮你看
sense_groups.english: Dr. Timothy Burke, his son, will see you now.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 刚才…
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm sorry. That...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里？ - 我爸妈家
sense_groups.english: Where you going? - My folks'.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候回来？
sense_groups.english: When you coming back?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能会住几天顺便找房子
sense_groups.english: I might stay there for a few days while I look for an apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 原先我以为我们可以谈开来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you know, at first I thought we could talk about this, work it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是看到你们在一起…
sense_groups.english: But seeing you two together, I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我说什么？说我不见她了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, look, what do you want me to say? Do you want me to say I'll stop seeing her?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她无关 好吗？
sense_groups.english: It's not about her. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 但看到你们在一起 就让我想起你做的事
sense_groups.english: But seeing you two together just reminds me of what you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不跟一个不懂朋友道义的人 住在一起
sense_groups.english: And I don't wanna live with someone who doesn't know what it is to be a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 我懂朋友道义
sense_groups.english: So I'll see you. - Hey, look, I know what it is to be a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我搞砸了 - 对 没错
sense_groups.english: I just... I screwed up. - Yeah, you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要离开
sense_groups.english: And that's why I'm leaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你不为我留下来 至少为他们留下来
sense_groups.english: Look, if you're not gonna stay for me, then at least stay for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们这一年很不顺 还被抢
sense_groups.english: Okay? They have had a very difficult year, what with the robbery and all.

sense_groups.chinese: 当那个人抢了我们
sense_groups.english: When that guy was robbing us...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在柜子里关了六小时
sense_groups.english: ...and I was locked in the entertainment unit for six hours...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我在做什么？
sense_groups.english: ...do you know what I was doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想我太让你失望了
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about how I let you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 对
sense_groups.english: Wow. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 早知道你会见色忘友 我根本不会担心
sense_groups.english: If I'd have known what kind of friend you were gonna be, I wouldn't have worried.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: See you around. - All right, wait, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 一定有什么我能做的
sense_groups.english: Just wait one second. There has to be something that I can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果柜子还在
sense_groups.english: If we still had that unit...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会关六小时 检讨我有多让你失望
sense_groups.english: ...I would get in there for six hours and think about how I let you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有一个箱子
sense_groups.english: We got a box.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得上次见到你
sense_groups.english: I remember the last time I saw you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是去外地念书的早上
sense_groups.english: It was the morning I left for college.

sense_groups.chinese: 你站在乳品皇后外面
sense_groups.english: You were just standing outside the Dairy Queen.

sense_groups.chinese: 八成是在等它开店
sense_groups.english: Heh. Just probably waiting for it to open.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说 你现在好漂亮
sense_groups.english: Gotta tell you, you look great now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也漂亮 - 你真是个好病人
sense_groups.english: You look great too. - You're an excellent patient.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况如何？
sense_groups.english: So how does it look?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的角膜有刮伤 得戴几天眼罩
sense_groups.english: You've got a little scratch on your cornea. You're gonna have to wear a patch.

sense_groups.chinese: 像海盗那样？
sense_groups.english: Like a pirate?

sense_groups.chinese: 大致是那样
sense_groups.english: If that helps you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟你爸一起工作多久了？
sense_groups.english: Ahem. So how long have you been working with your dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 总得有人提到他
sense_groups.english: Come on, one of us had to mention him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是两个月前搬回来的
sense_groups.english: I moved back here a couple months ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚上要家庭聚餐？ - 哦…
sense_groups.english: Big family dinner tonight? - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: No way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来要去女朋友家吃饭
sense_groups.english: I was gonna have Thanksgiving at my girlfriend's.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们分手了
sense_groups.english: Oh. - But we broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢？
sense_groups.english: Oh?

sense_groups.chinese: 她还不想定下来
sense_groups.english: She wasn't ready for a serious commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你让她跳海吃自己？
sense_groups.english: So you made her walk the plank, aye, matey?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没戴眼罩呢
sense_groups.english: You're not wearing the patch yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要来过感恩节？ - 对啊 好变态喔
sense_groups.english: He's coming here for Thanksgiving? - I know. It's sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么变态？ - 因为他是理查的儿子
sense_groups.english: Why is it sick? - Because it's Richard's son.

sense_groups.chinese: 这跟找希腊悲剧来吃饭一样
sense_groups.english: It's like inviting a Greek tragedy over for dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你了解吧？
sense_groups.english: I mean, come on, Phoebe, you understand, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你为什么指望我 但是我不了解
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I could see where I'd be your best shot, but no.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我觉得很畸形 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Sorry, honey. I think it's twisted. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是畸形？ - 我跟理查的儿子交往
sense_groups.english: What's twisted? - Oh. Me going out with Richard's son.

sense_groups.chinese: 好嗯
sense_groups.english: Ew.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯嗯嗯
sense_groups.english: Ew, ew, ew.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得实在是个烂主意
sense_groups.english: It sounds like a really bad idea to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在里面可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Is he okay in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 他好得很
sense_groups.english: He's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你跟理查的儿子有结果 你就可以告诉孩子
sense_groups.english: You know, if things work out between you and Richard's son...

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟他们的爷爷上过床
sense_groups.english: ...you'll be able to tell your kids that you slept with their grandfather.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 随你们怎么批评
sense_groups.english: Fine, judge all you want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 娶到女同志 临阵逃婚 爱上同性恋冰上舞者
sense_groups.english: But married a lesbian, left a man at the altar, fell in love with a gay ice dancer...

sense_groups.chinese: 把女生的木腿丢进火里 住在箱子里
sense_groups.english: ...threw a girl's wooden leg in the fire, live in a box.

sense_groups.chinese: 住箱子的用意到底何在？
sense_groups.english: So, now, ahem, what exactly is the point of the box?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 住箱子有三重意义
sense_groups.english: The meaning of the box is threefold.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一 让我有时间反省我的 所作所为
sense_groups.english: One, it gives me the time to think about what I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二 证明我有多重视 跟乔伊的友谊
sense_groups.english: Two, it proves how much I care about my friendship with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 第三…
sense_groups.english: And three...

sense_groups.chinese: 会痛
sense_groups.english: ...it hurts.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿… - 喔？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, hey, uh... - Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我去年送你的项链吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember that necklace I gave you last year?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以给我看吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I see it?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想看一下
sense_groups.english: I just wanna check something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: Now we'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 没气了 没气了
sense_groups.english: Air hole! Air hole!

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里 我很喜欢 我常戴
sense_groups.english: Here it is. I love it. I wear it all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我送的是金项链 这是银的
sense_groups.english: The necklace I got you was gold. This is silver.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许它…
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe, it, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 变色了
sense_groups.english: ...it changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你真的拿去换
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You actually exchanged it.

sense_groups.chinese: 换一个我喜欢又常用的东西
sense_groups.english: Isn't it better that I exchange it for something that I enjoy...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是比较好？
sense_groups.english: ...and I can get a lot of use out of?

sense_groups.chinese: 你换了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you get?

sense_groups.chinese: 换购金额
sense_groups.english: Credit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来开 我来开…
sense_groups.english: I'll get it, I'll get it, I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 提姆 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, Tim. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 谢谢 来见我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Hi. Thank you. Come meet my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是菲比 - 幸会
sense_groups.english: This is Phoebe. - Hi, nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 你好
sense_groups.english: And Joey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 我哥哥罗斯
sense_groups.english: Joey. - My brother, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 还有瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey. - And Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是钱德 - 你好
sense_groups.english: That's Chandler. - How do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是 - 他在
sense_groups.english: What's...? - Um, well, he's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 他在反省
sense_groups.english: He's doing some thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 他得分了
sense_groups.english: He's got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Yes! - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 发生什么事了？ - 你亲了我的女友
sense_groups.english: What happened? - You kissed my girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我喜欢那副太阳眼镜
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I like those sunglasses.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的喜欢还是
sense_groups.english: "Like them" like them...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以到店里换东西的喜欢
sense_groups.english: ...or "I'd like to get store credit for that amount" like them?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了各位 火鸡上桌了
sense_groups.english: All right, everybody. This turkey is ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以洗个手吗？ - 这里
sense_groups.english: Where can I wash up? - Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带你去
sense_groups.english: Let me show you.

sense_groups.chinese: 毛巾挂在洗手台旁边 你可以用高级香皂
sense_groups.english: The towels are hanging next to the sink. And you can use the fancy soap. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 高级香皂？我以为要留给教宗用
sense_groups.english: Fancy soap? I thought we were saving that for the Pope.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 他人很好吧？
sense_groups.english: See? He's nice, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 但你真的想在谈恋爱时说
sense_groups.english: Do you really wanna be in a relationship where you can actually use the phrase...

sense_groups.chinese: "你爸的做法不同"？
sense_groups.english: ..."That's not how your dad used to do it"?

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来好好吃 我坐哪里？
sense_groups.english: Wow, everything looks great. Where should I sit?

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你留这个位子
sense_groups.english: Saved you a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 变态 变态 变态 变态
sense_groups.english: Sick, sick, sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去开
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 被我骗了
sense_groups.english: Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这听起来不像是反省
sense_groups.english: That doesn't sound like thinking to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 你不应该说话的
sense_groups.english: Sorry. - I don't think you should be talking at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要想的太多了 不该说话开玩笑
sense_groups.english: I think you got too much thinking to do to be talking and making jokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没问题
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, you got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 把蕃薯给我 - 好
sense_groups.english: Ross, could you pass me the yams? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想换的话 乔伊那里有马铃薯泥
sense_groups.english: Oh, and Joey's got the mashed potatoes if you want to exchange them.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 你是怎么搞的？
sense_groups.english: Will you stop? What is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有客人喔
sense_groups.english: Heh, heh. We've got company.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没怎么搞的
sense_groups.english: There's nothing the matter with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是麻木不仁的人
sense_groups.english: See, I'm not completely devoid of sentiment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有感觉的
sense_groups.english: See, I have feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 很好
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看不到 但我正在露屁股打圆场
sense_groups.english: You can't tell, but I'm trying to break the tension by mooning you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听着
sense_groups.english: All right, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你把它当成笑话 那就算了
sense_groups.english: If this is just a big joke to you, then forget about it, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这对我很重要
sense_groups.english: This means something to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是对你不重要 你就死出来
sense_groups.english: If it doesn't mean anything to you, then get out of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则只是个白痴在箱子里
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, you're just an idiot in a box.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 对不起 这对我非常重要
sense_groups.english: You're right. I'm sorry. This means a lot to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟你再次当朋友 我发誓今晚不会再说话了
sense_groups.english: I want you to be my friend again. I swear I won't say another word tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的会当一回事？ - 绝对会
sense_groups.english: So you're gonna take this thing seriously? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又说话罗
sense_groups.english: That sounds like another word to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的会当一回事吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna take this seriously?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说我麻木不仁
sense_groups.english: Don't say that I have no sentiment.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是第一次约会的电影票根
sense_groups.english: This is a movie stub from our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你第一次 为我做床上早赛的蛋壳
sense_groups.english: This is an eggshell from the first time you made me breakfast in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是博物馆的 我们第一次…
sense_groups.english: This is from the museum, the first time we...

sense_groups.chinese: 在一起
sense_groups.english: ...were together.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 或许我有时会换礼物 但重要的东西我会留
sense_groups.english: Okay, maybe I exchange gifts sometimes, but I keep the things that matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该说什么 对不起
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to say. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是…
sense_groups.english: Though...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个不能拿
sense_groups.english: ...you're not supposed to take these.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有百万年的历史
sense_groups.english: It's like a million years old.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还派专人去找呢
sense_groups.english: We actually... We have people looking for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 老是会卡住
sense_groups.english: Oh, this always happens.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我来
sense_groups.english: Here, let me, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的眼睛…
sense_groups.english: You have very beautiful...

sense_groups.chinese: 很漂亮
sense_groups.english: ...eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友都觉得这样很怪
sense_groups.english: My friends all think this is weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我原先也觉得会 还差点取消 但其实不会
sense_groups.english: I thought it was gonna be weird. I almost called to cancel, but it really isn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我跟你爸完全是两回事
sense_groups.english: I know. I mean, it's like me and your dad, that's a totally separate thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全同意
sense_groups.english: Oh, I totally agree.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是两个…
sense_groups.english: I mean, we're just two people who find each other...

sense_groups.chinese: 互相吸引的人
sense_groups.english: ...very attractive.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What? - Nothing, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个吻不好吗？
sense_groups.english: No, no, really. Oh, was that not okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 很好
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, that was good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个吻很好
sense_groups.english: That was, uh... That was a good kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 它让你想到… - 别说
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. It didn't remind you of my...? - Oh, don't say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是有 对吧？ - 对
sense_groups.english: But it did, didn't it? - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去开
sense_groups.english: I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我真的很抱歉… - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I want you to know how sorry I am... - It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我气的是钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler's the one I'm mad at, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm still sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在吗？ - 在箱子里
sense_groups.english: Is he here? - In the box.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 他现在不能说话
sense_groups.english: Oh, he can't talk right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Why not? What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 他想表示他很重视乔伊
sense_groups.english: He's trying to show Joey how much he means to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以窝在箱子里？ - 乔伊有他的理由
sense_groups.english: By being in a box? - Joey had reasons.

sense_groups.chinese: 有三重意义
sense_groups.english: They were threefold.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能说话反而让事情好办一些
sense_groups.english: ...you not being able to talk might actually make this easier.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说…
sense_groups.english: Listen, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说
sense_groups.english: Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想介入两个最要好的朋友之问
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna be someone who comes between two best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不忍心看着这件事影响你们
sense_groups.english: I just... I can't stand seeing what this is doing to you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想成为罪魁祸首
sense_groups.english: And I don't wanna be the cause of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们不该再见面了
sense_groups.english: So I don't think we can see each other anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去芝加哥找我妈
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to my mom's in Chicago.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会住一阵子
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna stay there for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为这段感情会很美好
sense_groups.english: I think this could have been something really amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 但或许这么做最好
sense_groups.english: But, you know, this is probably for the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 你懂吗？
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会想念你的
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了 钱德
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 把箱子打开啦
sense_groups.english: Open the box.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 他还追得上她
sense_groups.english: What? - He can still catch her.

sense_groups.chinese: 快出来啦…
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on. Get out of there. Get out of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以"' - 我们没事了啦 出来啦
sense_groups.english: So...? - Yeah, we're gonna be fine. Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好好反省过了
sense_groups.english: You did some real good thinking in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是…
sense_groups.english: I mean, this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 快 你还追得上她
sense_groups.english: Now go. You could still catch her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的神秘圣诞老人祝你圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: And merry Christmas from your Secret Santa.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁抽到钱德？我要换
sense_groups.english: All right, who got Chandler? Because I need to trade.

sense_groups.chinese: 他看到她了
sense_groups.english: Oh, he sees her.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在追她
sense_groups.english: Aw, and he's catching up to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她看到他了
sense_groups.english: Oh, she sees him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们拥抱了 - 呃
sense_groups.english: Oh, they're hugging. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在抢她的皮包
sense_groups.english: He's taking her purse.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是他们 我去报警
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's not them. I'm gonna go call the police.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 他们在那里？ - 哪里
sense_groups.english: Oh, there they are. - Where?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Ah! - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 快去开房间吧
sense_groups.english: All right, get a room.

questions.name: S04E09
questions.en:
Okay. - Come on, no peeking.
Our eyes are closed, and we're about to cross the street. Very good.
Okay. Open up.
What do you want to show us? Because all I can see is this bitchen van.
Yeah, it's for our catering business.
Oh. - I think I know that girl.
We're not gonna keep it this way, though. - No?
We're gonna paint over the sword and replace it with a baguette.
Oh.
Um, also, we don't know what to do with this.
Oh, yeah, I definitely know her.
Remember that guy from cooking school that put cilantro in everything?
Oh, sure, Cilantro Larry. - Yeah.
Well, I'm gonna fill in for him as food critic for the Chelsea Reporter.
Wow. Monica, what an amazing opportunity to influence...
...dozens of people.
What about our catering business?
Oh, no, no, it's just one night a week.
Plus, I get to take all of you out for free dinners.
Hey. - Oh.
Well, in that case
That was me hopping onboard. - Oh.
Hey, guys. Hey, Ross. Quick question for you.
Are you ready to party?
I don't know, I could maybe go out for a couple of beers.
But there's this thing about bumblebees on the Discovery Channel.
No, no, no, I don't think you heard me. Are you ready to party?
No.
Gandalf? Gandalf is coming to town?
Kathy's with her parents, I have nothing to do.
Tomorrow we are partying with Gandalf, dude.
Dude, we are so gonna party. Yeah.
Wow, okay. Dude alert.
And who is this guy?
Mike "Gandalf" Ganderson. Only, like, the funnest guy in the world.
I'm gonna call and get off work tomorrow.
Oh. I'm gonna call after you.
This is gonna be so cool. Dude, we never party anymore.
Whoo!
All right, were you guys smoking something in the back of our van?
What do you mean, we never have fun? You have fun with me.
Remember the time we saw those strippers and you paid me 50 bucks to eat that book?
Joey, you are gonna love this guy. Gandalf is like the party wizard.
Well, why do you call him Gandalf? - Gandalf the wizard.
Hello? Didn't you read Lord of the Rings in high school?
No, I had sex in high school.
Oh. Uh, Joanna? I was wondering if I could ask you something.
There's an opening for an assistant buyer in Junior Miss...
Okay, but that would be a step down for me.
No, actually, I meant for me.
The hiring committee is meeting people all day and...
Oh. Well, I wish I could say no, but I guess you can't stay my assistant forever.
Neither can you, Sophie, but for different reasons.
I'm so glad you don't have a problem with this.
If you did, I wouldn't have considered applying.
Really? In that case...
And that's why I'm so glad there's no problem.
Yeah, it's fine. I'm on the hiring committee, so there'll be one friendly face.
Oh, that's great.
You know, Junior Miss is where I started. - Really?
I had to sleep with the ugliest guy to get that job.
Really? - No. Ha, ha.
Yeah.
I mean, no. No, no, no. Ha, ha. - No. Ha, ha.
I'm sure with your qualifications, you won't need to sleep with some guy.
Oh. Ha, ha.
Although, uh, I might need some convincing.
Um... Oh. - Kidding. Ha, ha.
God, I feel wild today. - Aah!
Oh, man, I am so excited, I may vomit.
Will you calm down? He's just a human guy.
Look, you don't understand. Gandalf is amazing.
You never know what's gonna happen.
You go out for a couple of beers and end up on a fishing boat to Nova Scotia.
Really? - Oh, yeah, it's beautiful country up there.
Hey. Okay.
I got my passport, fresh socks, and a snakebite kit.
It's not gonna be exactly like last time.
All right, I'll see you guys.
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
I have an audition, but I'll hook up with you later.
Where you gonna be around noon? - Heh.
Somewhere maybe along the equator?
Okay.
Hello?
It's Gandalf.
So are you in town?
Oh, well...
Well, maybe next time, then.
What happened?
He's not gonna make it. He's stuck in Chicago.
Oh, man.
Chicago's so lucky.
Stupid, useless Canadian money.
You have a very impressive résumé, Ms. Green.
I especially like what I see here about implementing a new filing system.
Thank you.
Filing system? Oh, you mean those little colored labels you put on all the folders?
It certainly did brighten up the inside of the filing cabinets.
Well, they, uh... They did more than that.
I notice that you've been entrusted with a lot of important responsibilities.
Yes. Joanna really has been an incredible mentor to me.
Oh. And Rachel has been really incredible at getting my morning bagel.
It's amazing how she gets it right almost every time.
Of course, I have more responsibilities than that.
Oh, yes, of course. There's the coffee too. Rachel can carry two things at once.
That's, uh, very good.
Now, a big part of this job...
...is cultivating personal relationships, especially with designers.
Yes, I realize... - Rachel shouldn't have any problem.
Her only problem might be getting a little too friendly, if you know what I mean.
I love working with designers.
With them, under them, what's the difference, eh, Rach?
Hey. My first review is out.
Oh! Oh, the Chelsea Reporter.
Ah. These used to keep me so warm.
All right, look, I'm on the back page. - Ooh. Oh!
Okay. "Would I go back to Allesandro's? Sure, but I would have to order two meals.
One for me, and one for the guy pointing the gun to my head."
Wow, you really laid into this place.
Hey, they don't pay me a penny a word to make friends.
Ooh, I gotta go. I found a guy who could fix up the van for catering.
Oh. You want me to go with you? - No, no, it's okay.
But are we sure we don't want the waterbed?
Haven't we made this decision? - Yeah, all right.
Bye. - Bye.
Who is it?
It's Allesandro, from Allesandro's.
Oh, my God.
I wanna talk to you about your review. - Oh, my God. Oh, my God.
Call me on the phone.
What, so you can hang up on me?
I'm never gonna let you up, so you may as well just go away.
Just give me a chance to...
Do you need to get in? Here you go.
No, Phoebe! - Oh, hey, Monica.
I want a retraction. Our food is not "inedible swill."
I couldn't eat it.
I have five friends who couldn't eat it, and one of them eats books.
Well, our service is not "grossly incompetent."
The waiter carried the breadsticks in his pants.
Well, you said that we accept the Discover Card...
...which we do not.
All right, that I'll retract.
But I stand by my review. I know food, and that wasn't it.
Your marinara sauce tastes like tomato juice.
You should serve it with vodka and a piece of celery.
Hey, I'm proud of that sauce. It's delicious.
Oh, my God.
You own an Italian restaurant and you think that tastes good?
Where are you even from?
Lebanon.
Hand me those tomatoes.
I'm gonna show you what it should taste like. Come on, hand them to me.
How long is this gonna take? I got another critic I gotta go yell at.
Ahem. Uh, Joanna, I wanna talk about that interview.
I thought it went very well.
No, it didn't. That's what I wanna talk to you about.
[IN STRAINED VOICE] Now, just to brief you...
...I may cry.
But they are not tears of sadness or of anger...
...but just of me having this discussion with you.
Rachel, please, don't make a scene.
There's nobody here.
Sophie, get in here.
You see? Now you're making Sophie uncomfortable.
She's not making me uncomfortable.
Congratulations, you've just crossed the line into completely useless. Get out.
[IN NORMAL VOICE] Do you want me to quit?
What? What would make you think that?
Well, all of those things you said in the interview.
If you believe any of them, I must not be a very good assistant.
You know what?
I am just going to pack up my desk...
...and I will be gone by the end of the day.
Well, I guess there's no use me sticking around till the end of the day.
Wait, wait, wait.
You can put your sad little muffin back in its drawer.
If you must know the truth, I didn't wanna lose a good assistant.
What?
That's why I said all those things about your flirting and your drinking.
My drinking?
Oh. I must have said that after you left.
Said what, exactly?
That you enjoy the occasional drink...
...- ing binge.
Oh, my God. Oh. That is it. I'm leaving.
You are just a horrible person. - No, wait, wait, wait.
Now, if you're gonna get all sensitive about it.
I don't want to lose you.
What if I create a position for you?
I'll make you assistant buyer in this department.
Say more things like that. - Um...
You can have your own office and a raise, effective tomorrow.
I'd need an expense account. - Done.
And an assistant. - Sophie, get in here.
Now it seems like a lifetime, doesn't it? Starting from...
Hey, what are you guys doing here?
I thought you'd be partying with Gandoldorf.
It's Gandalf, and he's not coming.
So you've been sitting here all morning? - No.
I balanced my checkbook.
Yeah, and I gave first names to all the foosball players.
I can't believe he didn't come.
So what if he didn't come? We can still go out and party ourselves.
Oh, no, you know, with Gandalf, we'd be out all night.
Yeah, we'd meet total strangers and hang out with them.
Well, we could do that.
There was other stuff too.
We'll do it all, and better.
Look, after tonight, Gandalf will wanna party with us, dude.
Come on.
Yeah. - Yeah.
It's not like we don't know how to party. - Yeah. All right. Let's go.
And maybe we could end up on a boat again?
Yeah! - All right!
Ah!
Hey, hey, hey. When were we on a boat?
Remember that really cold morning...
...when you woke up and those dogs were licking your face?
Yeah. - Those were seals, man.
Hey, how do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer...?
The owner of Allesandro's came to yell at me...
...but I made him some sauce, and he offered me the job as head chef.
Oh, my God.
You just ruined the thing I was practicing the whole way home, but I'm so happy.
Can you believe it? I finally get to run my own kitchen.
Oh, you've waited so long.
Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. Quick question for you.
How do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer at Bloomingdale's?
I don't know. It would totally depend on her coloring and...
You got the job! - Yes!
Oh! You got the job? Why didn't you tell me?
Oh. It's gonna be so great. I'm gonna get to help decide what we sell.
I'm gonna have an office with walls and everything.
I'm gonna have walls. - Aw.
Is this the day of good news or what? I got us a job.
The wedding reception.
Oh.
Um, Phoebe, I kind of need to talk to you about that.
Um...
Well, I think it might be time for me to take a step back from the catering.
But we've only had one job. - Tsk.
I know, but now we have this second one, and it just feels like it's snowballing.
Yeah, what are you saying?
I got offered the head-chef job at Allesandro's.
What? - It's okay, you don't really need me.
You're the cook.
Without you, it's just me driving up to people's houses...
...with empty trays and asking for money.
All right.
But, um, well, I'll pay you back all the money you invested.
And you can keep the van. - For what?
I can't believe this. I gotta get out of here.
Phoebe, wait a minute.
I'm an assistant buyer!
All right, we'll get a little coffee, get energized, then we'll head back out.
Yeah, all right. - Okay.
So we're having fun, right? We don't need that wizard guy.
We hit a couple of clubs, talked to some strangers...
...then after this, we'll go down to the docks and see about that boat thing.
I'm kind of beat.
Actually...
...me too.
Are you serious?
Yeah.
Thank God. I'm exhausted.
So you guys want coffees?
Yeah, but I don't wanna be up too late, so I'll have a decaf.
Yeah, me too.
Actually, could I get some hot water with a little lemon?
I strained my voice screaming in there. Does it have to be so loud?
Oh. I can't hear a word you're saying, my ears are ringing so bad.
Huh. I was glad I brought that extra pair of socks, you know?
I used them as mittens.
I didn't wanna touch a thing in that last place.
Oh.
How sad are we?
Yeah, I know.
You know what? We're not sad.
We're not sad, we're just not 21 anymore, you know?
I'm 29 years old, damn it.
I wanna sit in a comfortable chair, watch television...
...and go to sleep at a reasonable hour.
Yeah, and I like to hang out in a quiet place where I can talk to my friends.
Yeah.
And so what if I like to go home, throw on some Kenny G, and take a bath?
We're 29. We're not women.
Oh. There you are.
Hey, I'm glad that you decided to hear me out.
Okay, I'm hearing.
I've been doing a lot of thinking. A lot.
And, well, I came up with a whole bunch of businesses that you can do with your van.
Okay, um...
You could be a flower delivery person. - What?
Or a bakery delivery person.
Pizza?
Monica.
All right, I got a whole bunch of stuff in this area...
...but I'm getting the feeling you don't wanna deliver.
No. - Okay.
I'm guessing if you don't wanna deliver...
...you probably don't wanna pick up stuff either.
No.
You know what?
Let's do the catering business. - Really? Are you sure?
Yeah. You know, I made a commitment to you.
Know what? Lt'd be fun. - Oh, it will be fun.
Okay. Ooh, let's plan the wedding reception. Okay.
Wow.
You really wanted me to do something with this van.
You know what? I want you to take the chefjob.
Really? - Yeah.
That's what you really want.
Yeah, I don't wanna be the reason you're unhappy.
That would make me unhappy.
And I really don't wanna be the reason I'm unhappy.
Thank you.
Besides, it might be kind of fun to form the new A-Team.
Oh, hi, Mrs. Lynch. Is Joanna in already?
Oh, my goodness. You haven't heard.
Heard what?
Joanna passed away last night.
Oh, my God. How?
Well, she was leaving work, and she was hit by a cab.
Oh, my God. Oh, I cannot believe it.
I know. - Oh, God.
Oh, God.
I didn't realize that you were so close.
Yes. So close.
Mrs. Lynch, I know that this is an emotional and difficult time for all of us.
But by any chance, did Joanna send any paperwork your way...
...before it happened?
No, nothing.
Imagine, if she'd just stepped off that curb a few seconds later...
Oh. Yes, yes, just a few seconds and she'd still be with us.
Nothing about an assistant buyer?
I'm sorry. I have to go.
Good morning.
Oh, Sophie, I guess you didn't hear about Joanna.
I sure did.
I'm so excited about having Monica come onboard with us.
Although I do feel bad about having fired Chef Emilio.
It is like losing a member of the family.
Of course, that literally is the case for several of you.
Tony, Carlos, Marie...
...please tell your father how much we're going to miss him.
Now, I know that Monica has a lot of great ideas for this place.
Well, you all read the review. Ha, ha.
So without much further ado...
...I present to you our new head chef.
Um, I just wanna say, uh, that with a pinch of excitement...
...a dash of hard work, and a dollop of cooperation...
...we can have the recipe...
Are you going to kill me?

Sophie, get in here.
You see? Now you're making Sophie uncomfortable.
She's not making me uncomfortable.
Congratulations, you've just crossed the line into completely useless. Get out.
[IN NORMAL VOICE] Do you want me to quit?
What? What would make you think that?

You know what?
I am just going to pack up my desk...

Well, I guess there's no use me sticking around till the end of the day.
Wait, wait, wait.
You can put your sad little muffin back in its drawer.
If you must know the truth, I didn't wanna lose a good assistant.
What?
That's why I said all those things about your flirting and your drinking.
My drinking?
Oh. I must have said that after you left.
Said what, exactly?
That you enjoy the occasional drink...
...- ing binge.
Oh, my God. Oh. That is it. I'm leaving.
You are just a horrible person. - No, wait, wait, wait.
Now, if you're gonna get all sensitive about it.
I don't want to lose you.
What if I create a position for you?
I'll make you assistant buyer in this department.
Say more things like that. - Um...
You can have your own office and a raise, effective tomorrow.
I'd need an expense account. - Done.
And an assistant. - Sophie, get in here.
Now it seems like a lifetime, doesn't it? Starting from...
Hey, what are you guys doing here?
I thought you'd be partying with Gandoldorf.
It's Gandalf, and he's not coming.
So you've been sitting here all morning? - No.
I balanced my checkbook.
Yeah, and I gave first names to all the foosball players.
I can't believe he didn't come.
So what if he didn't come? We can still go out and party ourselves.
Oh, no, you know, with Gandalf, we'd be out all night.
Yeah, we'd meet total strangers and hang out with them.
Well, we could do that.
There was other stuff too.
We'll do it all, and better.
Look, after tonight, Gandalf will wanna party with us, dude.
Come on.
Yeah. - Yeah.
It's not like we don't know how to party. - Yeah. All right. Let's go.
And maybe we could end up on a boat again?
Yeah! - All right!
Ah!
Hey, hey, hey. When were we on a boat?
Remember that really cold morning...
...when you woke up and those dogs were licking your face?
Yeah. - Those were seals, man.
Hey, how do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer...?
The owner of Allesandro's came to yell at me...
...but I made him some sauce, and he offered me the job as head chef.
Oh, my God.
You just ruined the thing I was practicing the whole way home, but I'm so happy.
Can you believe it? I finally get to run my own kitchen.
Oh, you've waited so long.
Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. Quick question for you.
How do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer at Bloomingdale's?
I don't know. It would totally depend on her coloring and...
You got the job! - Yes!
Oh! You got the job? Why didn't you tell me?
Oh. It's gonna be so great. I'm gonna get to help decide what we sell.
I'm gonna have an office with walls and everything.
I'm gonna have walls. - Aw.
Is this the day of good news or what? I got us a job.
The wedding reception.
Oh.
Um, Phoebe, I kind of need to talk to you about that.
Um...
Well, I think it might be time for me to take a step back from the catering.
But we've only had one job. - Tsk.
I know, but now we have this second one, and it just feels like it's snowballing.
Yeah, what are you saying?
I got offered the head-chef job at Allesandro's.
What? - It's okay, you don't really need me.
You're the cook.
Without you, it's just me driving up to people's houses...
...with empty trays and asking for money.
All right.
But, um, well, I'll pay you back all the money you invested.
And you can keep the van. - For what?
I can't believe this. I gotta get out of here.
Phoebe, wait a minute.
I'm an assistant buyer!
All right, we'll get a little coffee, get energized, then we'll head back out.
Yeah, all right. - Okay.
So we're having fun, right? We don't need that wizard guy.
We hit a couple of clubs, talked to some strangers...
...then after this, we'll go down to the docks and see about that boat thing.
I'm kind of beat.
Actually...
...me too.
Are you serious?
Yeah.
Thank God. I'm exhausted.
So you guys want coffees?
Yeah, but I don't wanna be up too late, so I'll have a decaf.
Yeah, me too.
Actually, could I get some hot water with a little lemon?
I strained my voice screaming in there. Does it have to be so loud?
Oh. I can't hear a word you're saying, my ears are ringing so bad.
Huh. I was glad I brought that extra pair of socks, you know?
I used them as mittens.
I didn't wanna touch a thing in that last place.
Oh.
How sad are we?
Yeah, I know.
You know what? We're not sad.
We're not sad, we're just not 21 anymore, you know?
I'm 29 years old, damn it.
I wanna sit in a comfortable chair, watch television...
...and go to sleep at a reasonable hour.
Yeah, and I like to hang out in a quiet place where I can talk to my friends.
Yeah.
And so what if I like to go home, throw on some Kenny G, and take a bath?
We're 29. We're not women.
Oh. There you are.
Hey, I'm glad that you decided to hear me out.
Okay, I'm hearing.
I've been doing a lot of thinking. A lot.
And, well, I came up with a whole bunch of businesses that you can do with your van.
Okay, um...
You could be a flower delivery person. - What?
Or a bakery delivery person.
Pizza?
Monica.
All right, I got a whole bunch of stuff in this area...
...but I'm getting the feeling you don't wanna deliver.
No. - Okay.
I'm guessing if you don't wanna deliver...
...you probably don't wanna pick up stuff either.
No.
You know what?
Let's do the catering business. - Really? Are you sure?
Yeah. You know, I made a commitment to you.
Know what? Lt'd be fun. - Oh, it will be fun.
Okay. Ooh, let's plan the wedding reception. Okay.
Wow.
You really wanted me to do something with this van.
You know what? I want you to take the chefjob.
Really? - Yeah.
That's what you really want.
Yeah, I don't wanna be the reason you're unhappy.
That would make me unhappy.
And I really don't wanna be the reason I'm unhappy.
Thank you.

Oh, hi, Mrs. Lynch. Is Joanna in already?
Oh, my goodness. You haven't heard.
Heard what?

Oh, my God. How?
Well, she was leaving work, and she was hit by a cab.
Oh, my God. Oh, I cannot believe it.
I know. - Oh, God.
Oh, God.
I didn't realize that you were so close.
Yes. So close.

But by any chance, did Joanna send any paperwork your way...
...before it happened?
No, nothing.
Imagine, if she'd just stepped off that curb a few seconds later...
Oh. Yes, yes, just a few seconds and she'd still be with us.
Nothing about an assistant buyer?
I'm sorry. I have to go.
Good morning.
Oh, Sophie, I guess you didn't hear about Joanna.
I sure did.
I'm so excited about having Monica come onboard with us.
Although I do feel bad about having fired Chef Emilio.
It is like losing a member of the family.
Of course, that literally is the case for several of you.
Tony, Carlos, Marie...
...please tell your father how much we're going to miss him.
Now, I know that Monica has a lot of great ideas for this place.
Well, you all read the review. Ha, ha.
So without much further ado...
...I present to you our new head chef.
Um, I just wanna say, uh, that with a pinch of excitement...
...a dash of hard work, and a dollop of cooperation...
...we can have the recipe...
Are you going to kill me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 过来 不能偷看喔
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Come on, no peeking.

sense_groups.english: Our eyes are closed, and we're about to cross the street. Very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 可以看了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Open up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是要我们看什么？因为我只看到超炫的厢型车
sense_groups.english: What do you want to show us? Because all I can see is this bitchen van.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们做外烩的专用车
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's for our catering business.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 我好像认识那女孩
sense_groups.english: Oh. - I think I know that girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但最后不会是这样 - 不会吗？
sense_groups.english: We're not gonna keep it this way, though. - No?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会把宝刀换成法国面包
sense_groups.english: We're gonna paint over the sword and replace it with a baguette.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有这个也不知道要怎么处理
sense_groups.english: Um, also, we don't know what to do with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我一定认识她
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I definitely know her.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得我说过那梱在烹饪学校 煮什么都加香菜的人吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember that guy from cooking school that put cilantro in everything?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 香菜赖瑞嘛 - 记得
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure, Cilantro Larry. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要替他代班 帮《赤尔夕通讯报》做美食评监
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm gonna fill in for him as food critic for the Chelsea Reporter.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 摩妮卡 这可是大好机会呢 你能影响到…
sense_groups.english: Wow. Monica, what an amazing opportunity to influence...

sense_groups.chinese: 二 三十个人呢
sense_groups.english: ...dozens of people.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们的外烩生意怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What about our catering business?

sense_groups.chinese: 我这个一星期只要一个晚上
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, it's just one night a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还能带你们到处去吃免钱的
sense_groups.english: Plus, I get to take all of you out for free dinners.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然是那样的话…
sense_groups.english: Well, in that case

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才是我跳上车一起去 - 噢
sense_groups.english: That was me hopping onboard. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙儿好 罗斯？快问快答
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. Hey, Ross. Quick question for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备好要狂欢没？
sense_groups.english: Are you ready to party?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 出去喝几杯啤酒或许行
sense_groups.english: I don't know, I could maybe go out for a couple of beers.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是今晚发现频道要演大黄峰
sense_groups.english: But there's this thing about bumblebees on the Discovery Channel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能没听清楚 你准备好要狂欢没？
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, I don't think you heard me. Are you ready to party?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 甘道夫… 甘道夫要来？
sense_groups.english: Gandalf? Gandalf is coming to town?

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西去找她父母 我没事干
sense_groups.english: Kathy's with her parents, I have nothing to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我们去跟甘道夫狂欢吧 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow we are partying with Gandalf, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 我们要去狂欢了耶
sense_groups.english: Dude, we are so gonna party. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 兄弟请注意
sense_groups.english: Wow, okay. Dude alert.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个人是谁？
sense_groups.english: And who is this guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克甘道夫甘德森 世界上最爆笑的人
sense_groups.english: Mike "Gandalf" Ganderson. Only, like, the funnest guy in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打给公司说明天请假
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna call and get off work tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打完换我
sense_groups.english: Oh. I'm gonna call after you.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 这一定超酷的 我们八百年没狂欢了
sense_groups.english: This is gonna be so cool. Dude, we never party anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是不是躲在厢型车里 偷抽了大麻？
sense_groups.english: All right, were you guys smoking something in the back of our van?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 什么叫八百年没狂欢 跟我在一起就很乐啊
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, we never have fun? You have fun with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得去看脱衣舞那回？你们给我50美元要我吞书
sense_groups.english: Remember the time we saw those strippers and you paid me 50 bucks to eat that book?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们干嘛叫他"甘道夫"？ - 巫师甘道夫啊
sense_groups.english: Well, why do you call him Gandalf? - Gandalf the wizard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你念高中没看过《魔戒》吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? Didn't you read Lord of the Rings in high school?

sense_groups.chinese: 没 但我念高中有上过床
sense_groups.english: No, I had sex in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔安娜 我有件事想请问一下
sense_groups.english: Oh. Uh, Joanna? I was wondering if I could ask you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我岂不是连降三级了？
sense_groups.english: Okay, but that would be a step down for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 我是毛遂自荐
sense_groups.english: No, actually, I meant for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 招聘委员会每天都在面试…
sense_groups.english: The hiring committee is meeting people all day and...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很希望我能拒绝 但总不能让你永远当我助理吧
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I wish I could say no, but I guess you can't stay my assistant forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲 你也是 但理由不同
sense_groups.english: Neither can you, Sophie, but for different reasons.

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴你完全没有意见
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you don't have a problem with this.

sense_groups.english: If you did, I wouldn't have considered applying.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啊 那样的话…
sense_groups.english: Really? In that case...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我才很高兴你没意见
sense_groups.english: And that's why I'm so glad there's no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是从少淑女部起家的 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: You know, Junior Miss is where I started. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啊？ - 才不呢
sense_groups.english: Really? - No. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 话说回来… - 没有啦
sense_groups.english: I mean, no. No, no, no. Ha, ha. - No. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我可能要验货确定一下
sense_groups.english: Although, uh, I might need some convincing.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢… - 逗你的啦
sense_groups.english: Um... Oh. - Kidding. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我今天真兴奋 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: God, I feel wild today. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 要命 我兴奋到都快吐了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, I am so excited, I may vomit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你兴奋个什么劲？他不过就是个人嘛
sense_groups.english: Will you calm down? He's just a human guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有所不知 甘道夫超神的
sense_groups.english: Look, you don't understand. Gandalf is amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他出去可是惊喜连连
sense_groups.english: You never know what's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对 那里风景很美
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, yeah, it's beautiful country up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Hey. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带了护照 干净的袜子 还有蛇毒解药

sense_groups.chinese: 这次不会跟上次完全一样啦
sense_groups.english: It's not gonna be exactly like last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 回头见了
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll see you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等…
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要先去试镜 晚点一定去跟你们会合

sense_groups.chinese: 你们中午左右会在哪里？ - 哦
sense_groups.english: Where you gonna be around noon? - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多在赤道附近吧
sense_groups.english: Somewhere maybe along the equator?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 甘道夫打来的
sense_groups.english: It's Gandalf.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经到了？
sense_groups.english: So are you in town?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这样啊…
sense_groups.english: Oh, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就下次再约吧
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe next time, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在芝加哥被耽搁了 没办法来
sense_groups.english: He's not gonna make it. He's stuck in Chicago.

sense_groups.chinese: 要命
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 芝加哥真是太走运了
sense_groups.english: Chicago's so lucky.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是愚蠢又没有用的加拿大币
sense_groups.english: Stupid, useless Canadian money.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林小姐 你的履历非常精彩

sense_groups.chinese: 特别是我看到了这一段 "实施档案管理系统"
sense_groups.english: I especially like what I see here about implementing a new filing system.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: "档案管理系统"？你说资料夹上黏的彩色标签啊

sense_groups.chinese: 那的确是让档案柜生色不少
sense_groups.english: It certainly did brighten up the inside of the filing cabinets.

sense_groups.chinese: 功能不只是那样而已
sense_groups.english: Well, they, uh... They did more than that.
