sense_groups.english: I notice that you've been entrusted with a lot of important responsibilities.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 乔安娜真是我的导师
sense_groups.english: Yes. Joanna really has been an incredible mentor to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋也是帮我买贝果的贵人
sense_groups.english: Oh. And Rachel has been really incredible at getting my morning bagel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 她几乎每次都不会买错
sense_groups.english: It's amazing how she gets it right almost every time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的职责当然不止那样
sense_groups.english: Of course, I have more responsibilities than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 还有咖啡也是 瑞秋一次能拎两样东西
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes, of course. There's the coffee too. Rachel can carry two things at once.

sense_groups.chinese: 相当优秀
sense_groups.english: That's, uh, very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 这项工作的一大重点是
sense_groups.english: Now, a big part of this job...

sense_groups.chinese: 打好人际关系 尤其是和设计师
sense_groups.english: ...is cultivating personal relationships, especially with designers.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道… - 这一点瑞秋没问题
sense_groups.english: Yes, I realize... - Rachel shouldn't have any problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 只怕她打得太火热 懂吧？
sense_groups.english: Her only problem might be getting a little too friendly, if you know what I mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最爱和设计师共事了
sense_groups.english: I love working with designers.

sense_groups.chinese: 共事或共枕又有何差别呢？瑞秋
sense_groups.english: With them, under them, what's the difference, eh, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 我第一篇美食评论上报了
sense_groups.english: Hey. My first review is out.

sense_groups.chinese: 《赤尔夕通讯报》
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh, the Chelsea Reporter.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前我都拿这来当棉被盖
sense_groups.english: Ah. These used to keep me so warm.

sense_groups.chinese: 快看 我写的专刊在反面 - 噢
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I'm on the back page. - Ooh. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 "我会再光顾亚历山卓吗？当然 但我会点两份餐
sense_groups.english: Okay. "Would I go back to Allesandro's? Sure, but I would have to order two meals.

sense_groups.chinese: 一份给自己一份给拿枪抵着我的人"
sense_groups.english: One for me, and one for the guy pointing the gun to my head."

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你真把这家店批得一文不值
sense_groups.english: Wow, you really laid into this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 报社付我钱 可不是要我广结善缘
sense_groups.english: Hey, they don't pay me a penny a word to make friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 我找到一个人 他能搞定那部外烩厢型车
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I gotta go. I found a guy who could fix up the van for catering.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我一起去吗？ - 不用了 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh. You want me to go with you? - No, no, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你确定我们不要那张水床？
sense_groups.english: But are we sure we don't want the waterbed?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是早就说好了？ - 对啦 算了
sense_groups.english: Haven't we made this decision? - Yeah, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁啊？
sense_groups.english: Who is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是亚历山卓的老板
sense_groups.english: It's Allesandro, from Allesandro's.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟你讨论美食评监的事 - 天啊…
sense_groups.english: I wanna talk to you about your review. - Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打电话给我
sense_groups.english: Call me on the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好让你挂我电话？
sense_groups.english: What, so you can hang up on me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让你上来的 你还是走吧
sense_groups.english: I'm never gonna let you up, so you may as well just go away.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我一个机会…
sense_groups.english: Just give me a chance to...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要进来吗？请进
sense_groups.english: Do you need to get in? Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不行啦 - 嗨 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: No, Phoebe! - Oh, hey, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你收回你的话 我们的食物绝非"难以下咽"
sense_groups.english: I want a retraction. Our food is not "inedible swill."

sense_groups.chinese: 我就吃不下去
sense_groups.english: I couldn't eat it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我那五个朋友也难以下咽 其中一佃人连书都能吃了
sense_groups.english: I have five friends who couldn't eat it, and one of them eats books.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的服务 也不是宾至如"衰"
sense_groups.english: Well, our service is not "grossly incompetent."

sense_groups.chinese: 那侍者把面包棒塞在裤子里
sense_groups.english: The waiter carried the breadsticks in his pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还写说 我们店里接受发现卡
sense_groups.english: Well, you said that we accept the Discover Card...

sense_groups.chinese: 其实不行
sense_groups.english: ...which we do not.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 那段话我可以收回
sense_groups.english: All right, that I'll retract.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我扞卫我写的评论 我懂美食 你们的差远了
sense_groups.english: But I stand by my review. I know food, and that wasn't it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的大蒜番茄酱 简直跟蕃茄汁没两样
sense_groups.english: Your marinara sauce tastes like tomato juice.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该要加伏特加和芹菜
sense_groups.english: You should serve it with vodka and a piece of celery.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很以店里那酱汁为荣 可口极了
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm proud of that sauce. It's delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是开意大利餐厅的 竟然觉得那样叫做可口？
sense_groups.english: You own an Italian restaurant and you think that tastes good?

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底是哪里人？
sense_groups.english: Where are you even from?

sense_groups.chinese: 黎巴嫩
sense_groups.english: Lebanon.

sense_groups.chinese: 把那些蕃茄给我
sense_groups.english: Hand me those tomatoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来示范纯正的味道是怎样 来 给我
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna show you what it should taste like. Come on, hand them to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要弄多久？我还要去骂另一个美食评论家
sense_groups.english: How long is this gonna take? I got another critic I gotta go yell at.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔安娜 我要谈谈面试的事
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Uh, Joanna, I wanna talk about that interview.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你在面试中表现得很棒
sense_groups.english: I thought it went very well.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 才怪 我就是要跟你说这件事
sense_groups.english: No, it didn't. That's what I wanna talk to you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先声明一句…
sense_groups.english: [IN STRAINED VOICE] Now, just to brief you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能会哭出来
sense_groups.english: ...I may cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那不是悲伤或气愤的泪水
sense_groups.english: But they are not tears of sadness or of anger...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是因为我要你跟讨论这件事
sense_groups.english: ...but just of me having this discussion with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 麻烦你别丢人现眼了
sense_groups.english: Rachel, please, don't make a scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里又没人
sense_groups.english: There's nobody here.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲 你进来
sense_groups.english: Sophie, get in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 你让苏菲尴尬了
sense_groups.english: You see? Now you're making Sophie uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有尴尬啊
sense_groups.english: She's not making me uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 你刚刚证明了 自己一无是处 滚吧
sense_groups.english: Congratulations, you've just crossed the line into completely useless. Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是要我辞职吗？
sense_groups.english: [IN NORMAL VOICE] Do you want me to quit?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你怎么会这样想？
sense_groups.english: What? What would make you think that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你在面试时讲的那些话
sense_groups.english: Well, all of those things you said in the interview.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果里面有你的真心话 那我一定不是个好助理
sense_groups.english: If you believe any of them, I must not be a very good assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如这样吧
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要来收拾办公桌
sense_groups.english: I am just going to pack up my desk...

sense_groups.chinese: 我等今天下班就走人
sense_groups.english: ...and I will be gone by the end of the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想没必要耗到今天下班了
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess there's no use me sticking around till the end of the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你等等…
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 把那可怜的松糕放回抽屉里
sense_groups.english: You can put your sad little muffin back in its drawer.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要听实话的话 是我不想失去你这完美的助理
sense_groups.english: If you must know the truth, I didn't wanna lose a good assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我才瞎办出那些招峰引蝶 还有你酗酒的事
sense_groups.english: That's why I said all those things about your flirting and your drinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我酗酒？
sense_groups.english: My drinking?

sense_groups.chinese: 我等你离开之后才说的
sense_groups.english: Oh. I must have said that after you left.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底说了什么？
sense_groups.english: Said what, exactly?

sense_groups.chinese: 你三不五时喜欢喝一杯…
sense_groups.english: That you enjoy the occasional drink...

sense_groups.chinese: 酒后乱性
sense_groups.english: ...- ing binge.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真是够了 我走人了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh. That is it. I'm leaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个人真的很糟糕 - 等等…
sense_groups.english: You are just a horrible person. - No, wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 反应不用那么激烈嘛
sense_groups.english: Now, if you're gonna get all sensitive about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想失去你
sense_groups.english: I don't want to lose you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如我变出个职位给你？
sense_groups.english: What if I create a position for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你在这个部门里 担任采购助理
sense_groups.english: I'll make you assistant buyer in this department.

sense_groups.chinese: 你再多说一点 - 呃…
sense_groups.english: Say more things like that. - Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有自己的办公室 外带加薪 明天就生效
sense_groups.english: You can have your own office and a raise, effective tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要公关费 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: I'd need an expense account. - Done.

sense_groups.chinese: 还要有助理 - 苏菲 进来
sense_groups.english: And an assistant. - Sophie, get in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在感觉像是一辈子 不是吗？从…
sense_groups.english: Now it seems like a lifetime, doesn't it? Starting from...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么在这里？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what are you guys doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是跟甘呆夫去狂欢了？
sense_groups.english: I thought you'd be partying with Gandoldorf.

sense_groups.chinese: 是甘道夫 他不来了
sense_groups.english: It's Gandalf, and he's not coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你们一早都呆坐在这里？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: So you've been sitting here all morning? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚把帐算好了
sense_groups.english: I balanced my checkbook.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 足球台里的选手 我也全都取好了名字
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I gave first names to all the foosball players.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信甘道夫竟然没来
sense_groups.english: I can't believe he didn't come.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不来又怎样？我们还是可以自己出去狂欢啊
sense_groups.english: So what if he didn't come? We can still go out and party ourselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 有甘道夫在 一整晚都有的玩
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, you know, with Gandalf, we'd be out all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且能和一堆陌生人一起混
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we'd meet total strangers and hang out with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也可以啊
sense_groups.english: Well, we could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还有其他的绝招啦
sense_groups.english: There was other stuff too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一网打尽 更胜于蓝
sense_groups.english: We'll do it all, and better.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 今晚过后 就换我们带甘道夫去狂欢
sense_groups.english: Look, after tonight, Gandalf will wanna party with us, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 活像我们不会狂欢似的 - 好 咱们走
sense_groups.english: It's not like we don't know how to party. - Yeah. All right. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后再到一次船上如何？
sense_groups.english: And maybe we could end up on a boat again?

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah! - All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 上次在船上是何时？
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, hey. When were we on a boat?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得那天早上很冷
sense_groups.english: Remember that really cold morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 一早醒来还有狗舔你的脸？
sense_groups.english: ...when you woke up and those dogs were licking your face?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 - 老兄 舔你的可是海豹呢
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Those were seals, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 快问快答 采购助理穿这套装如何？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer...?

sense_groups.chinese: 亚历山卓的老板上门来吼我
sense_groups.english: The owner of Allesandro's came to yell at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我趁机帮他做了酱料 结果他挖我去店里当主厨
sense_groups.english: ...but I made him some sauce, and he offered me the job as head chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你毁了我练的好戏 但我真是替你高兴
sense_groups.english: You just ruined the thing I was practicing the whole way home, but I'm so happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信吗？我终于可以在厨房当老大了
sense_groups.english: Can you believe it? I finally get to run my own kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你盼了那么久
sense_groups.english: Oh, you've waited so long.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 菲比 快问快答
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Pheebs. Quick question for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 布鲁明岱尔的采购助理穿上这套装如何？
sense_groups.english: How do you think this suit would look on an assistant buyer at Bloomingdale's?

sense_groups.chinese: 那完全要看她的肤色而定
sense_groups.english: I don't know. It would totally depend on her coloring and...

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿到那工作了 - 是的
sense_groups.english: You got the job! - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 你被录取了？怎么没跟我说？
sense_groups.english: Oh! You got the job? Why didn't you tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 一定超棒的 我能帮忙决定要卖什么
sense_groups.english: Oh. It's gonna be so great. I'm gonna get to help decide what we sell.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有全套装置和墙的办公室
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna have an office with walls and everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 四面都有墙耶 - 哇
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna have walls. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真是喜事连连 我帮我们找到工作了
sense_groups.english: Is this the day of good news or what? I got us a job.

sense_groups.chinese: 喜宴外烩
sense_groups.english: The wedding reception.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我有话要跟你说
sense_groups.english: Um, Phoebe, I kind of need to talk to you about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想外烩的事不能操之过急
sense_groups.english: Well, I think it might be time for me to take a step back from the catering.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们才做了一笔生意啊 - 啧啧
sense_groups.english: But we've only had one job. - Tsk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但现在有第二笔了 就像雪球越滚越大
sense_groups.english: I know, but now we have this second one, and it just feels like it's snowballing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, what are you saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 亚历山卓餐厅请我去当主厨
sense_groups.english: I got offered the head-chef job at Allesandro's.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 不碍事的 仔细想想 其实你也不需要我
sense_groups.english: What? - It's okay, you don't really need me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是厨师耶
sense_groups.english: You're the cook.

sense_groups.chinese: 总不能我自己一个开去别人家
sense_groups.english: Without you, it's just me driving up to people's houses...

sense_groups.chinese: 带着空盘子就跟人要钱吧？
sense_groups.english: ...with empty trays and asking for money.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会还回所有你投资的钱
sense_groups.english: But, um, well, I'll pay you back all the money you invested.

sense_groups.chinese: 而那部厢型车归你 - 我要拿来干嘛？
sense_groups.english: And you can keep the van. - For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是不敢相信 我得离开这里
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. I gotta get out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你等等
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我升采购助理了
sense_groups.english: I'm an assistant buyer!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们先喝咖啡养足精神 再重新出发
sense_groups.english: All right, we'll get a little coffee, get energized, then we'll head back out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好玩嘛 对不对？我们才不需要那个什么巫师的
sense_groups.english: So we're having fun, right? We don't need that wizard guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去了几家俱乐部 跟一些陌生人说过话
sense_groups.english: We hit a couple of clubs, talked to some strangers...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下去码头安排坐船的事
sense_groups.english: ...then after this, we'll go down to the docks and see about that boat thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有点累了
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of beat.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实…
sense_groups.english: Actually...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: ...me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是真的假的？
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢老天 我也累毙了
sense_groups.english: Thank God. I'm exhausted.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要喝咖啡吗？
sense_groups.english: So you guys want coffees?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我今天想早点睡 所以我要无咖啡因的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I don't wanna be up too late, so I'll have a decaf.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能来杯热水加点柠檬汁吗？
sense_groups.english: Actually, could I get some hot water with a little lemon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才在那家店里都喊到哑了 他们音乐非要开那么大声吗？
sense_groups.english: I strained my voice screaming in there. Does it have to be so loud?

sense_groups.chinese: 我听不到你说什么 我耳鸣得厉害
sense_groups.english: Oh. I can't hear a word you're saying, my ears are ringing so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好我多带了一双袜子
sense_groups.english: Huh. I was glad I brought that extra pair of socks, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 拿来当手套用
sense_groups.english: I used them as mittens.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后那家店脏到我不敢用手碰
sense_groups.english: I didn't wanna touch a thing in that last place.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真是可悲到了极点
sense_groups.english: How sad are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我们并不可悲
sense_groups.english: You know what? We're not sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我们都不再是21岁了
sense_groups.english: We're not sad, we're just not 21 anymore, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我都已经29岁了
sense_groups.english: I'm 29 years old, damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只想舒服地坐着看电视
sense_groups.english: I wanna sit in a comfortable chair, watch television...

sense_groups.chinese: 时间到了就上床睡觉
sense_groups.english: ...and go to sleep at a reasonable hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢去安静一点的地方 才能好好跟朋友聊天
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I like to hang out in a quiet place where I can talk to my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算回家听肯尼吉的音乐洗澡 又有什么大不了的？
sense_groups.english: And so what if I like to go home, throw on some Kenny G, and take a bath?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是29岁没错 但我们可不是娘儿们
sense_groups.english: We're 29. We're not women.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来了
sense_groups.english: Oh. There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你决定听我解释
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm glad that you decided to hear me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你说吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm hearing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想了很多 很多
sense_groups.english: I've been doing a lot of thinking. A lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想出了你用厢型车 可以做的所有生意
sense_groups.english: And, well, I came up with a whole bunch of businesses that you can do with your van.

sense_groups.chinese: 对的 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以去送花 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You could be a flower delivery person. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是送面包？
sense_groups.english: Or a bakery delivery person.

sense_groups.chinese: 送比萨？
sense_groups.english: Pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我写了一堆你能运送的东西
sense_groups.english: All right, I got a whole bunch of stuff in this area...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我有预感你不想送货
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm getting the feeling you don't wanna deliver.

sense_groups.chinese: 不想 - 那好吧
sense_groups.english: No. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜若你不想送货的话…
sense_groups.english: I'm guessing if you don't wanna deliver...

sense_groups.chinese: 八成也不会想去取货
sense_groups.english: ...you probably don't wanna pick up stuff either.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如这样吧
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来做外烩 - 真的？你确定？
sense_groups.english: Let's do the catering business. - Really? Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我承诺过你
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You know, I made a commitment to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 会很有趣的 - 一定会很有趣的
sense_groups.english: Know what? Lt'd be fun. - Oh, it will be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们来计划喜宴的事
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ooh, let's plan the wedding reception. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真的是很用心 想让我用这厢型车来做些事
sense_groups.english: You really wanted me to do something with this van.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如这样吧 我要你接下那主厨的工作
sense_groups.english: You know what? I want you to take the chefjob.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你真心想要做的
sense_groups.english: That's what you really want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想成为你不高兴的原因
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't wanna be the reason you're unhappy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样我也会不高兴
sense_groups.english: That would make me unhappy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我更不想让自己不高兴
sense_groups.english: And I really don't wanna be the reason I'm unhappy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且成立新的天龙特攻队 应该会很好玩
sense_groups.english: Besides, it might be kind of fun to form the new A-Team.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 林区太太 乔安娜进公司了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Mrs. Lynch. Is Joanna in already?

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 你还没听说
sense_groups.english: Oh, my goodness. You haven't heard.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说什么？
sense_groups.english: Heard what?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔安娜昨晚过世了
sense_groups.english: Joanna passed away last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 怎么会这样？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. How?

sense_groups.chinese: 她下班出去时被计程车撞上
sense_groups.english: Well, she was leaving work, and she was hit by a cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, I cannot believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 天啊…
sense_groups.english: I know. - Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 没想到你们两个这么好
sense_groups.english: I didn't realize that you were so close.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好到就差那么一点
sense_groups.english: Yes. So close.

sense_groups.chinese: 林区太太 我知道这佃节骨眼 大家在情绪上都很煎熬
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Lynch, I know that this is an emotional and difficult time for all of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 但在事发之前 乔安娜是不是正好有…
sense_groups.english: But by any chance, did Joanna send any paperwork your way...

sense_groups.chinese: 把人事调动公文交给你？
sense_groups.english: ...before it happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 完全没有
sense_groups.english: No, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 只盼当初 她晚个几秒钟过街就没事了
sense_groups.english: Imagine, if she'd just stepped off that curb a few seconds later...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 差个几秒钟 她就还能跟我们在一起
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yes, yes, just a few seconds and she'd still be with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没说到采购助理的事？
sense_groups.english: Nothing about an assistant buyer?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 我得走了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安
sense_groups.english: Good morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏菲 我猜你还不知道 乔安娜的事
sense_groups.english: Oh, Sophie, I guess you didn't hear about Joanna.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然知道
sense_groups.english: I sure did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很兴奋能请到摩妮卡加入
sense_groups.english: I'm so excited about having Monica come onboard with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然开除艾米里欧主厨 让我觉得很过意不去
sense_groups.english: Although I do feel bad about having fired Chef Emilio.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就像是失去了一个家人
sense_groups.english: It is like losing a member of the family.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过对你们其中几位而言 真的是失去家人
sense_groups.english: Of course, that literally is the case for several of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 东尼 卡洛斯 玛莉…
sense_groups.english: Tony, Carlos, Marie...

sense_groups.chinese: 请向令尊转达 我们会有多想念艾米里欧
sense_groups.english: ...please tell your father how much we're going to miss him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道摩妮卡对这家店 有许多很棒的点子
sense_groups.english: Now, I know that Monica has a lot of great ideas for this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都看过她那篇评论了
sense_groups.english: Well, you all read the review. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以废话不多说
sense_groups.english: So without much further ado...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在此向各位介绍本店的新主厨
sense_groups.english: ...I present to you our new head chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说只要有热忱
sense_groups.english: Um, I just wanna say, uh, that with a pinch of excitement...

sense_groups.chinese: 肯吃苦 肯合作
sense_groups.english: ...a dash of hard work, and a dollop of cooperation...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就能将本店的菜色…
sense_groups.english: ...we can have the recipe...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们打算杀我了我吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you going to kill me?

questions.name: S04E10
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey.
Sorry I'm late. Did I miss anything?
Joey stuffing fifteen Oreos in his mouth.
Fifteen?
Your personal best! Ha, ha.
Where were you?
On a date.
I met this girl on a train going to a museum upstate.
Which museum? - How'd you meet her?
No. Answer his.
We were at the back of the train.
I sat near the door so she'd have to pass by me...
...if she wanted to switch cars. She was totally at my mercy.
Were you so late because you were burying this woman?
I'm late because she lives in Poughkeepsie.
She seems great, but she's two and a half hours away.
How can she be great if she's from Poughkeepsie? Ha-ha-ha.
That joke would have killed in Albany.
Done! I did it.
Who's stupid now?
Look! They're lighting the big Christmas tree tonight.
Um, that paper is two weeks old.
Who keeps leaving old newspapers in the trash?
I really wanted to take Kathy to this.
At least you have somebody to miss stuff with.
I hate being alone this time of year.
Next it's Valentine's Day...
...then my birthday, then bang!
Then they're lighting that damn tree again.
I want somebody!
You know, I want a man!
It doesn't even have to be a big relationship. Just a fling!
I didn't think girls ever just wanted a fling.
Let me tell you, it's been a long time since I've been flung.
I know what I'm giving you for Christmas.
There are nice guys in my office. Want me to set you up?
Yeah.
I've been single a long time. Why haven't you offered before?
I have a girlfriend. I'm happy.
I no longer go out of my way to stop others from being happy.
Okay.
No accountants.
And no one from "legal." I don't like boring jobs.
And Ross was what? A lion tamer?
What's wrong, Mon?
Everybody at work still hates me.
I was making headway.
Everyone was smiling at me, and then I get off work...
...and find out they wrote this on my chef's hat.
Maybe they meant to write "Quiet, Bitch."
What's the matter?
Fine! Just trying to be nice.
I haven't been picked on this much since kindergarten.
And they brought in someone from junior high to do the see-saw with me.
Aw.
They're trying to make me quit. If it were any other job, I would.
But I've waited for this my whole life.
Wait, you're the boss. Yell at them. Or fire them!
I would love to, but I can't. I'm not good at confrontation.
You know what you can do?
I read about this director, Orson Welles...
...who, at the beginning, would hire somebody just to fire them.
Then they would all know who was boss.
I'm not doing anything. Why not fire me?
It's a good idea. Can you waiter?
Good enough to get fired.
All right. You're hired!
Hey!
That's why I got fired last week! Does Orson Welles direct commercials?
Yes.
I say, Drew? Are you seeing anybody right now?
I'm not asking for me.
I'm not gay. I'm not asking you out.
I'm not gay.
I didn't think you were gay.
I do now.
My friend, Rachel, wants to be set up.
I just got out of a big relationship.
I'm not looking to get serious.
That's okay. A fling might be all right with her.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Is this "Hot Rachel" that you took to the Christmas Party?
By the way, that is her full name.
Wow! I'm free for her.
Wait, I didn't say I wasn't free.
Let's talk it over at the Ranger game.
Hold on. I just got a box of Cubans.
I'll bring them by your office at 5.
That's a little later than I usually stay, but sure.
Before the game, we could enjoy some eight-year-old Basil Haydens.
I don't know what that is, but let's!
I'm writing a holiday song for everyone. Do you want to hear it?
Yeah! - Yes!
Okay.
Happy Hanukkah, Monica
May your Christmas be snowy, Joey
Happy New Year, Chandler and Ross
Spin the dreidel, Rachel
Pheebs, that's great! - Oh, yay!
But you know, uh, Rachel doesn't rhyme with dreidel.
I know, but it's so hard. Nothing rhymes with your stupid name!
What are you talking about? Lots of things rhyme with Rachel
Bagel, mail, jail, bail, cable.
Maypole.
All good. Thanks.
Um, do you, maybe, have a nickname that's easier to rhyme?
Didn't your dad call you "Pumpkin"? - Oh, yeah.
But did he ever call you "Budolph"?
Hello, children. - Hey.
Have I got the 50 guys for you!
Really?
I showed them your picture.
Guys are throwing themselves at me and giving me stuff.
Knicks tonight? - Where are the seats?
Wherever! I've got 20.
Will I like any of these guys?
You know, I'm going to, uh...
...play the field a little bit more. - Chandler...
Guys are signing over their 401 Ks to me.
You work with robots?
Yes.
One guy, Patrick, you'll like him. He's nice, funny and a swimmer.
I like swimmers' bodies.
His dad made the magnetic strip on credit cards.
I like credit cards!
I'm not bad at this!
What does he do? - He works in fine foods.
You have a fine foods division? - It's a big company...
Now, wait a second. You make food and robots?
No, the robots just work for them.
All right, I'm going to work.
Does anybody have a problem with that?
Yeah, lady. I do!
I got a problem!
I'll give you a problem!
What will you do? Fire me?
You bet your ass I'll fire you!
See you later.
I should go. I've got a date.
With who?
You know the girl who lives in Poughkeepsie?
Not her.
This is someone else.
I can't decide between the two.
The one from Poughkeepsie, though two hours away, is pretty...
...really smart and a lot of fun.
But this other girl, she lives right uptown.
She's just as pretty.
I guess she's smart.
She's not fun.
If she's no fun, why date her at all?
I want to give her a chance. She lives so close.
And, at the end of the date, she said something that...
...if she was kidding, was very funny.
If she wasn't kidding, she's not fun. She's stupid and racist.
Hey. - Hey.
How was your first day at the restaurant?
Damn!
Hey. - Hey.
What happened to your fancy jacket?
They baked it.
I can't take this anymore.
I'm going to fire you tonight. - You got it. Oh, oh!
What are you doing?
You're still on fire there.
I think you got it!
Chandler, you have the best taste in men.
Like father, like son.
Patrick and I had such a great time last night!
This could, maybe, get serious.
I thought you weren't looking for serious. Just a fling?
Well, you know, possibly.
You didn't tell him that, though, right?
Uh, no?
You told this guy that I was looking for a fling?
You don't tell him that! - Why not?
I'd be thrilled if some hot girl...
I see.
You telling him I want a fling and me putting out...
...he's so going to get the wrong idea!
Joey, could you pass the cheese?
I'd prefer you didn't call me Joey.
I thought it might be fun to try out a cool nickname.
Hey, Dragon!
Here's your tips from Monday and Tuesday.
There's $300 in this one.
People get generous around the holidays.
And it never hurts to wear tight trousers.
Could the waiters listen to the specials?
There's Chilean sea bass with a mango relish...
Why is nobody writing these?
We can remember them.
Because you'll make up fake specials and make me cook them?
Sure, that too.
Forget the specials for a minute. Um, here's the thing...
For the last two weeks I have, uh...
...tried hard to create a positive atmosphere.
Can't hear you!
Positive atmosphere.
But I've had it up to here.
From now on, it is going to be my way...
...or the highway. All right?
Does anybody have a problem with that?
Hey, new guy.
I said, does anybody have a problem with that?
No, ma'am.
He has a name. It's Dragon.
You want to know your name? Check your hat.
We did the hat, right?
What the hell just happened? - I am so sorry.
I was going to do it.
But I was standing there with $327 in one hand...
...and $238 in the other. And I was thinking...
...it's been a long time since I had...
...327 plus $238!
We had a deal! It's why you're here. I've got to fire you!
And I got to pay rent!
How about you don't fire me.
Instead, I stay. I gain their trust.
They'll listen to the nice things I say about you.
What nice things?
Nothing yet. They hate you, and I want to fit in.
Happy Hanukkah, Chandler and Monica, Merry, merry...
You know what, Pheebs?
I'm not Jewish so...
Ross doesn't decorate his tree with floss...
...but he's not complaining.
Bad dream?
I wasn't sleeping.
What was Phoebe's song about?
It's the one with the cat.
I got to go. I've got another date.
Did you pick one yet?
It turns out the one from uptown was making a joke.
It was a different joke. It wasn't that funny.
So I'm still torn.
You don't like the one from uptown.
And you're exhausted from dating Poughkeepsie.
Just end them both!
Go to Poughkeepsie and break up with her.
Then break up with uptown.
By the time you get home, you're done!
You're right. Thank you.
I had a similar problem when I lived in Prague.
Prague? - So much you don't know.
Chandler?
Patrick just, uh, ended things with me.
Did you or didn't you tell him I wanted a serious relationship?
I did! I absolutely did!
You idiot!
I'm sure you're right. But why?
You don't tell a guy that you want a serious relationship.
Now you scared him away!
I am sorry. I am so sorry.
You should never be allowed to talk to people!
I know, I know!
Now I'm right back where I started.
This sucks!
Being alone sucks!
You'll meet somebody.
You're a great catch!
When I told those guys about you, I didn't have to lie once.
Really? - Yeah.
You graduated magna cum laude, right?
No.
It doesn't matter.
I got tickets to the Ranger game. You want to come with me?
Cute guys in little shorts?
Sure.
Actually, it's a hockey team. Angry Canadians with no teeth.
That sounds fun too. Thank you.
Okay.
Have you ever been with a woman?
What?
What is the matter with you?
There is no good time to ask that question.
The station is Poughkeepsie. Poughkeepsie!
Ross?
Wake up!
Ross? Ross! Ross!
I need more swordfish.
Can you get me more swordfish? - I don't speak English.
You just did.
I don't know what to tell you.
Fine.
Very funny.
Let me out, please.
Come on, I'm cold!
And covered in marinara sauce!
Let me out!
You found that handle, did you?
It's not funny. - Well, that's not true.
I'm a good person. And I'm a good chef.
And I don't deserve to have marinara sauce all over me!
If you want me to quit this bad then...
Hey. Chef Geller?
You know that speech you made?
I got a problem with it!
You do? - You bet I do!
I just, uh, wasn't listening then, that's all.
If you want a problem, I'll give you a problem!
What are you going to do? Fire me?
You bet I'll fire you! Get out of my kitchen!
Get out!
All right.
Anybody else got a problem?
How about you, chuckles?
You think this is funny now?
No.
What if I dance covered in sauce? You think it's funny?
No, it's really good.
Take those salads to table four.
And you, get the swordfish!
And you!
Get a haircut!
Last stop, Montreal. The stop is Montreal!
What?
I bet myself that you had beautiful eyes.
Now that I see them, I win!
What?
We're at my stop. Would you like to have coffee?
Are we really in Montreal?
Yes, we are.
So coffee?
Coffee sounds great.
Wait.
So you live in Montreal?
No, but it's only a two-hour ferry ride to Nova Scotia.
I should have thought about my wife and kids...
...before I talked back to Chef Geller.
Thanks.
It will be a lean Christmas at the Dragon house this year.
Enough!
Lean, lean, lean!
Went to the store Sat on Santa's lap
Asked him to bring my friends All kinds of crap
Said all you need is To write them a song
Now you haven't heard it yet So don't try to sing along
No, don't sing along
Monica, Monica
Have a happy Hanukkah
Saw Santa Claus
He said hello to Ross
And please tell Joey
Christmas will be snowy
And Rachel and Chandler
Happy holidays, everybody!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是两周前的报纸耶
sense_groups.english: Um, that paper is two weeks old.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁老是把旧报纸 丢在垃圾桶里的？
sense_groups.english: Who keeps leaving old newspapers in the trash?

sense_groups.chinese: 人家好想带凯西去看 没想到居然错过了
sense_groups.english: I really wanted to take Kathy to this.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你还有伴
sense_groups.english: At least you have somebody to miss stuff with.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌过节时孤伶伶的
sense_groups.english: I hate being alone this time of year.

sense_groups.chinese: 情人节 我的日生转眼就到
sense_groups.english: Next it's Valentine's Day...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后…
sense_groups.english: ...then my birthday, then bang!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们又要点亮那株讨厌的圣诞树
sense_groups.english: Then they're lighting that damn tree again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想找个伴
sense_groups.english: I want somebody!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想找个男人
sense_groups.english: You know, I want a man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想谈轰轰烈烈的恋爱 来段露水姻缘就好了
sense_groups.english: It doesn't even have to be a big relationship. Just a fling!

sense_groups.chinese: 没想到你也想要露水姻缘
sense_groups.english: I didn't think girls ever just wanted a fling.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 我缺水缺得可久了
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you, it's been a long time since I've been flung.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我知道圣诞节要送你什么了
sense_groups.english: I know what I'm giving you for Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有几个同事挺不错的 要不要帮你介绍一下？
sense_groups.english: There are nice guys in my office. Want me to set you up?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我单身了好一阵子 你以前怎么没提出这个建议？
sense_groups.english: I've been single a long time. Why haven't you offered before?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在有女朋友 很快乐
sense_groups.english: I have a girlfriend. I'm happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不需要再处心积虑 破坏别人的好事
sense_groups.english: I no longer go out of my way to stop others from being happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要会计师
sense_groups.english: No accountants.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不要法律部门的人 我不喜欢工作无聊的男人
sense_groups.english: And no one from "legal." I don't like boring jobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 难不成罗斯是训兽师吗？
sense_groups.english: And Ross was what? A lion tamer?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong, Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅里的人 还是把我视为眼中钉
sense_groups.english: Everybody at work still hates me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为渐入佳境
sense_groups.english: I was making headway.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都冲着我微笑 下班后…
sense_groups.english: Everyone was smiling at me, and then I get off work...

sense_groups.chinese: 才发现他们在我帽子上写了这个
sense_groups.english: ...and find out they wrote this on my chef's hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许他们想写的是 "婊子 快住嘴"
sense_groups.english: Maybe they meant to write "Quiet, Bitch."

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？火气这么大
sense_groups.english: Fine! Just trying to be nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我幼稚园毕业后 就没受过这等鸟气
sense_groups.english: I haven't been picked on this much since kindergarten.

sense_groups.chinese: 当时他们找了个国中生 来跟我玩翘翘板
sense_groups.english: And they brought in someone from junior high to do the see-saw with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们无所不用其极的想逼我辞职 换做是别的工作我早就不干了
sense_groups.english: They're trying to make me quit. If it were any other job, I would.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我等当主厨等了大半辈子
sense_groups.english: But I've waited for this my whole life.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你是老大 你为什么不吼他们 或干脆炒了他们？
sense_groups.english: Wait, you're the boss. Yell at them. Or fire them!

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很想这样 但我最不会处理冲突场面
sense_groups.english: I would love to, but I can't. I'm not good at confrontation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道该怎么做吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what you can do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我读过有关这位名导 奥森威尔斯…
sense_groups.english: I read about this director, Orson Welles...

sense_groups.chinese: 在片子开拍前 都会刻意花钱请一个人 目的就是当着大家的面开除他
sense_groups.english: ...who, at the beginning, would hire somebody just to fire them.

sense_groups.chinese: 好杀鸡儆猴
sense_groups.english: Then they would all know who was boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我反正没事 你干脆开除我算了
sense_groups.english: I'm not doing anything. Why not fire me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 你知道怎么当服务生吗？
sense_groups.english: It's a good idea. Can you waiter?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正你要开除我 管那么多干嘛
sense_groups.english: Good enough to get fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我决定用你了
sense_groups.english: All right. You're hired!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪我上个礼拜被开除 奥森威尔斯导不导广告片？
sense_groups.english: That's why I got fired last week! Does Orson Welles direct commercials?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有在跟谁交往吗？
sense_groups.english: I say, Drew? Are you seeing anybody right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是帮我自己问啦
sense_groups.english: I'm not asking for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是同志 不是在约你
sense_groups.english: I'm not gay. I'm not asking you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是同志
sense_groups.english: I'm not gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前没把你当同志
sense_groups.english: I didn't think you were gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过现在觉得有点像
sense_groups.english: I do now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友瑞秋 希望我帮她介绍个男人
sense_groups.english: My friend, Rachel, wants to be set up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才刚刚跟前女友分手
sense_groups.english: I just got out of a big relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 还没准备好要谈感情
sense_groups.english: I'm not looking to get serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算只是春风一度也没关系 瑞秋不会有意见的
sense_groups.english: That's okay. A fling might be all right with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的是来参加耶诞派对的 火练瑞秋吗？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Is this "Hot Rachel" that you took to the Christmas Party?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 那就是她的本名
sense_groups.english: By the way, that is her full name.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有空 帮我介绍一下吧
sense_groups.english: Wow! I'm free for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我又没说我没空
sense_groups.english: Wait, I didn't say I wasn't free.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 咱们边看球赛边聊
sense_groups.english: Let's talk it over at the Ranger game.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一盒古巴雪茄
sense_groups.english: Hold on. I just got a box of Cubans.

sense_groups.chinese: 我五点钟拿到你办公室去
sense_groups.english: I'll bring them by your office at 5.

sense_groups.chinese: 我平常不会待到这么晚 不过可以破个例
sense_groups.english: That's a little later than I usually stay, but sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 咱们在看球赛之前 可以先喝上两杯陈年巴素海顿波本
sense_groups.english: Before the game, we could enjoy some eight-year-old Basil Haydens.

sense_groups.chinese: 天晓得那是什么东东 但好吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know what that is, but let's!

sense_groups.chinese: 我为大家写了首圣诞歌 想不想听？
sense_groups.english: I'm writing a holiday song for everyone. Do you want to hear it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah! - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 光明节快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy Hanukkah, Monica

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 愿你圣诞节瑞雪纷飞
sense_groups.english: May your Christmas be snowy, Joey

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 罗斯 新年快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy New Year, Chandler and Ross

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 快来玩陀螺
sense_groups.english: Spin the dreidel, Rachel

sense_groups.chinese: 真好听 - 噢 是的
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, that's great! - Oh, yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是瑞秋跟陀螺不押韵
sense_groups.english: But you know, uh, Rachel doesn't rhyme with dreidel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但是要找跟你那笨名字 押韵的东西太难了
sense_groups.english: I know, but it's so hard. Nothing rhymes with your stupid name!

sense_groups.chinese: 跟瑞秋押韵的字多得很
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? Lots of things rhyme with Rachel

sense_groups.chinese: 如 贝果 信件 监狱 保释金 第四台…
sense_groups.english: Bagel, mail, jail, bail, cable.

sense_groups.chinese: 五月节花柱…
sense_groups.english: Maypole.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些都不错 谢了
sense_groups.english: All good. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有比较容易押韵的外号？
sense_groups.english: Um, do you, maybe, have a nickname that's easier to rhyme?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸以前不是常叫你小南瓜吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Didn't your dad call you "Pumpkin"? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他有没有叫过你布道夫？
sense_groups.english: But did he ever call you "Budolph"?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello, children. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你找了50个好男人
sense_groups.english: Have I got the 50 guys for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不过把你的照片亮给他们看
sense_groups.english: I showed them your picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们就穷拍我的马屁 请我喝酒 送我东西
sense_groups.english: Guys are throwing themselves at me and giving me stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚想不想看《尼克队》的球赛？ - 当然 第几排？
sense_groups.english: Knicks tonight? - Where are the seats?

sense_groups.chinese: 随你挑 我有20张票
sense_groups.english: Wherever! I've got 20.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会喜欢你帮我挑的男人吗？
sense_groups.english: Will I like any of these guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想再多…
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm going to, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 观察一阵子 - 钱德
sense_groups.english: ...play the field a little bit more. - Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们对我简直是 一个口令一个动作
sense_groups.english: Guys are signing over their 401 Ks to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的同事都是机器人啊？
sense_groups.english: You work with robots?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会喜欢我同事派崔克 他人好 风趣 还是个游泳高手
sense_groups.english: One guy, Patrick, you'll like him. He's nice, funny and a swimmer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱死游泳选手的体格了
sense_groups.english: I like swimmers' bodies.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他老爸还发明了 信用卡背面的磁条
sense_groups.english: His dad made the magnetic strip on credit cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱死信用卡了
sense_groups.english: I like credit cards!

sense_groups.chinese: 我还蛮会当红娘的
sense_groups.english: I'm not bad at this!

sense_groups.chinese: 他是做什么的？- 他在美食部上班
sense_groups.english: What does he do? - He works in fine foods.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们公司有美食部？ - 敝公司很大…
sense_groups.english: You have a fine foods division? - It's a big company...

sense_groups.chinese: 等等… 你们公司生产食物和机器人？
sense_groups.english: Now, wait a second. You make food and robots?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 机器人在那里工作
sense_groups.english: No, the robots just work for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去工作了
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm going to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人有意见吗？
sense_groups.english: Does anybody have a problem with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐
sense_groups.english: Yeah, lady. I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有意见
sense_groups.english: I got a problem!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想鸡蛋里挑骨头 就别怪我不客气了
sense_groups.english: I'll give you a problem!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想怎样？开除我？
sense_groups.english: What will you do? Fire me?

sense_groups.chinese: 那还用说
sense_groups.english: You bet your ass I'll fire you!

sense_groups.chinese: 回头见
sense_groups.english: See you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 今晚有约会
sense_groups.english: I should go. I've got a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟谁？
sense_groups.english: With who?

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得那个住在波基普西的女孩吗？
sense_groups.english: You know the girl who lives in Poughkeepsie?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是她
sense_groups.english: Not her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又认识了一个女孩
sense_groups.english: This is someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在左右为难
sense_groups.english: I can't decide between the two.

sense_groups.chinese: 波基普西那个女孩 虽然住得远 但漂亮
sense_groups.english: The one from Poughkeepsie, though two hours away, is pretty...

sense_groups.chinese: 聪明又有趣
sense_groups.english: ...really smart and a lot of fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 但另一个女孩… 就住在上城区
sense_groups.english: But this other girl, she lives right uptown.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也很漂亮
sense_groups.english: She's just as pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该也蛮聪明的
sense_groups.english: I guess she's smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是无趣得要命
sense_groups.english: She's not fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么还要跟她约会？
sense_groups.english: If she's no fun, why date her at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想再给她一个机会 因为她家实在太近了
sense_groups.english: I want to give her a chance. She lives so close.

sense_groups.chinese: 上次她说了一句话…
sense_groups.english: And, at the end of the date, she said something that...

sense_groups.chinese: 若她在开玩笑就好笑到不行
sense_groups.english: ...if she was kidding, was very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则她不仅无聊 愚蠢 又有种族歧视
sense_groups.english: If she wasn't kidding, she's not fun. She's stupid and racist.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一天在餐厅工作的 情况如何？
sense_groups.english: How was your first day at the restaurant?

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶
sense_groups.english: Damn!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的制服怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What happened to your fancy jacket?

sense_groups.chinese: 被他们烤了
sense_groups.english: They baked it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再也受不了了
sense_groups.english: I can't take this anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚就要开除你 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: I'm going to fire you tonight. - You got it. Oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你衣服上还有火星
sense_groups.english: You're still on fire there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该已经拍灭了吧
sense_groups.english: I think you got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你对男人的品味一流
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you have the best taste in men.

sense_groups.chinese: 虎父无犬子嘛
sense_groups.english: Like father, like son.

sense_groups.chinese: 派崔克和我昨晚玩得好开心
sense_groups.english: Patrick and I had such a great time last night!

sense_groups.chinese: 说不定能发展出一段 认真的感情
sense_groups.english: This could, maybe, get serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 认真的感情？你不是要露水姻缘吗？
sense_groups.english: I thought you weren't looking for serious. Just a fling?

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能噢
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, possibly.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没告诉他吧？
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell him that, though, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: Uh, no?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他 我想找一段露水姻缘？
sense_groups.english: You told this guy that I was looking for a fling?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能告诉他？- 为什么不行？
sense_groups.english: You don't tell him that! - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 若某个辣妹只想来段露水姻缘 我高兴都来不及…
sense_groups.english: I'd be thrilled if some hot girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 我明白了
sense_groups.english: I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他我不打算认真 咱们第一次约会时我又火力全开
sense_groups.english: You telling him I want a fling and me putting out...

sense_groups.chinese: 他一定会误会的
sense_groups.english: ...he's so going to get the wrong idea!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 把乳酪拿来好吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, could you pass the cheese?

sense_groups.chinese: 可不可不要叫我乔伊？
sense_groups.english: I'd prefer you didn't call me Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我帮自己 取了个超炫的外号
sense_groups.english: I thought it might be fun to try out a cool nickname.

sense_groups.chinese: 龙哥
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dragon!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你这两天赚的小费
sense_groups.english: Here's your tips from Monday and Tuesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 有三百块耶
sense_groups.english: There's $300 in this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 过节时客人总是特别大方
sense_groups.english: People get generous around the holidays.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿紧身裤的效果更是棒到不行
sense_groups.english: And it never hurts to wear tight trousers.

sense_groups.chinese: 请服务生过来听听今晚的特餐
sense_groups.english: Could the waiters listen to the specials?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚有芒果腌鲈鱼…
sense_groups.english: There's Chilean sea bass with a mango relish...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么都不做笔记？
sense_groups.english: Why is nobody writing these?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们用背的就行了
sense_groups.english: We can remember them.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是要随口乱谓好整我？
sense_groups.english: Because you'll make up fake specials and make me cook them?

sense_groups.chinese: 那也行
sense_groups.english: Sure, that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 特餐的事先别说了 是这样的…
sense_groups.english: Forget the specials for a minute. Um, here's the thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 过去两周…
sense_groups.english: For the last two weeks I have, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我试着想营造一个愉快的工作环境
sense_groups.english: ...tried hard to create a positive atmosphere.

sense_groups.chinese: 听不到
sense_groups.english: Can't hear you!

sense_groups.chinese: 愉快的工作环境
sense_groups.english: Positive atmosphere.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的气已经满到这里来了
sense_groups.english: But I've had it up to here.

sense_groups.chinese: 从现在开始 不听我话的人…
sense_groups.english: From now on, it is going to be my way...

sense_groups.chinese: 就滚蛋
sense_groups.english: ...or the highway. All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人有意见吗？
sense_groups.english: Does anybody have a problem with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 菜鸟
sense_groups.english: Hey, new guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说有人有意见吗？
sense_groups.english: I said, does anybody have a problem with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No, ma'am.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有名字 他叫龙哥
sense_groups.english: He has a name. It's Dragon.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想知道你的名字吗？看看你的帽子
sense_groups.english: You want to know your name? Check your hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有在帽子上写字吧？
sense_groups.english: We did the hat, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚那是怎么回事？ - 真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: What the hell just happened? - I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想配合你
sense_groups.english: I was going to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我一手拿着327块
sense_groups.english: But I was standing there with $327 in one hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 另一手拿着238块 我在想…
sense_groups.english: ...and $238 in the other. And I was thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很久没拿到…
sense_groups.english: ...it's been a long time since I had...

sense_groups.chinese: 327块加238块 这么多钱了
我们说好的 我用你就是为了开除你
sense_groups.english: We had a deal! It's why you're here. I've got to fire you!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我得付房租
sense_groups.english: And I got to pay rent!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 你别开除我
sense_groups.english: How about you don't fire me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我留在这里争取他们的信任
sense_groups.english: Instead, I stay. I gain their trust.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说你的好话 他们就听得进去了
sense_groups.english: They'll listen to the nice things I say about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么好话？
sense_groups.english: What nice things?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没有 他们讨厌死你了 我想跟他们打成一片
sense_groups.english: Nothing yet. They hate you, and I want to fit in.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡 光明节快乐… 圣诞…
sense_groups.english: Happy Hanukkah, Chandler and Monica, Merry, merry...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what, Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是犹太人 所以…
sense_groups.english: I'm not Jewish so...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯也不用牙线装饰圣诞树
sense_groups.english: Ross doesn't decorate his tree with floss...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有听到他抱怨吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but he's not complaining.

sense_groups.chinese: 做恶梦啦？
sense_groups.english: Bad dream?

sense_groups.chinese: 我又没在睡觉
sense_groups.english: I wasn't sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？那菲比刚刚在唱什么歌？
sense_groups.english: What was Phoebe's song about?

sense_groups.chinese: 在唱那首猫歌
sense_groups.english: It's the one with the cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 又有约
sense_groups.english: I got to go. I've got another date.

sense_groups.chinese: 你决定要挑哪一个了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you pick one yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 上城区那个女孩 那次的确在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: It turns out the one from uptown was making a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是和我想像中的不同 而且没那么好笑
sense_groups.english: It was a different joke. It wasn't that funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是左右为难
sense_groups.english: So I'm still torn.

sense_groups.chinese: 你并不喜欢上城区那个女孩
sense_groups.english: You don't like the one from uptown.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了跟波基普西妞约会 又累得半死
sense_groups.english: And you're exhausted from dating Poughkeepsie.

sense_groups.chinese: 把她们两个都甩了
sense_groups.english: Just end them both!

sense_groups.chinese: 坐火车去波基普西跟她分手
sense_groups.english: Go to Poughkeepsie and break up with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 回程跟上城妞分手
sense_groups.english: Then break up with uptown.

sense_groups.chinese: 到家时一切都解决了
sense_groups.english: By the time you get home, you're done!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You're right. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在布扛格也碰过这种问题
sense_groups.english: I had a similar problem when I lived in Prague.

sense_groups.chinese: 布拉格？- 我的事你不知道的可多了
sense_groups.english: Prague? - So much you don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 派崔克刚刚跟我分手了
sense_groups.english: Patrick just, uh, ended things with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有告诉他 我想认真谈段感情？
sense_groups.english: Did you or didn't you tell him I wanted a serious relationship?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有 我真的有
sense_groups.english: I did! I absolutely did!

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个白痴
sense_groups.english: You idiot!

sense_groups.chinese: 有道理 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm sure you're right. But why?

sense_groups.chinese: 千万不能告诉男人 你要谈段认真的感情
sense_groups.english: You don't tell a guy that you want a serious relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把他吓跑了
sense_groups.english: Now you scared him away!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: I am sorry. I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该禁止你跟别人说话
sense_groups.english: You should never be allowed to talk to people!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道…
sense_groups.english: I know, I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在又回到原点了
sense_groups.english: Now I'm right back where I started.

sense_groups.chinese: 粉难过
sense_groups.english: This sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 孤孤单单的真难过
sense_groups.english: Being alone sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 你迟早会遇见意中人
sense_groups.english: You'll meet somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 你棒呆了
sense_groups.english: You're a great catch!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟同事形容你时 一句谎话都没说
sense_groups.english: When I told those guys about you, I didn't have to lie once.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？- 真的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你毕业时 有拿优秀毕业生奖吧？
sense_groups.english: You graduated magna cum laude, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要紧
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有两张今晚球赛的门票 要不要跟我去看？
sense_groups.english: I got tickets to the Ranger game. You want to come with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 看猛男穿短裤满场飞？
sense_groups.english: Cute guys in little shorts?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然要去
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚是冰上曲棍球赛 你只能看到 没牙的暴躁加拿大佬
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's a hockey team. Angry Canadians with no teeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像挺好玩的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: That sounds fun too. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有跟女人在一起过吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever been with a woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有毛病
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不管什么时候问这个问题 都会被人骂
sense_groups.english: There is no good time to ask that question.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一站是波基普西…
sense_groups.english: The station is Poughkeepsie. Poughkeepsie!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 醒醒
sense_groups.english: Wake up!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Ross? Ross! Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 再拿点鱼来
sense_groups.english: I need more swordfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能再拿点鱼来？- 我不讲英文
sense_groups.english: Can you get me more swordfish? - I don't speak English.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚讲的就是英文
sense_groups.english: You just did.

sense_groups.chinese: 这下我哑口无言了
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 很幽默
sense_groups.english: Very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 快放我出来
sense_groups.english: Let me out, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面好冷
sense_groups.english: Come on, I'm cold!

sense_groups.chinese: 而且全身都是酱汁
sense_groups.english: And covered in marinara sauce!

sense_groups.chinese: 放我出去
sense_groups.english: Let me out!

sense_groups.chinese: 找到把手啦？
sense_groups.english: You found that handle, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好笑 - 怎么不好笑？
sense_groups.english: It's not funny. - Well, that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个好人 也是个好厨师
sense_groups.english: I'm a good person. And I'm a good chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该被弄得全身都是酱汁
sense_groups.english: And I don't deserve to have marinara sauce all over me!

sense_groups.chinese: 若你们这么希望我辞职…
sense_groups.english: If you want me to quit this bad then...

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒主厨
sense_groups.english: Hey. Chef Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得那天你讲的那段话吗？
sense_groups.english: You know that speech you made?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有意见
sense_groups.english: I got a problem with it!

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: You do? - You bet I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我那时没专心听
sense_groups.english: I just, uh, wasn't listening then, that's all.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想鸡蛋里挑骨头 就别怪我不客气了
sense_groups.english: If you want a problem, I'll give you a problem!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想怎样？开除我？
sense_groups.english: What are you going to do? Fire me?

sense_groups.chinese: 那还用说 滚出我的厨房
sense_groups.english: You bet I'll fire you! Get out of my kitchen!

sense_groups.chinese: 滚
sense_groups.english: Get out!

sense_groups.chinese: 这才像话
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁有意见？
sense_groups.english: Anybody else got a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有意见？
sense_groups.english: How about you, chuckles?

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在还觉得好笑吗？
sense_groups.english: You think this is funny now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好笑
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我全身沾满酱汁跳舞… 好不好笑？
sense_groups.english: What if I dance covered in sauce? You think it's funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你跳得很好
sense_groups.english: No, it's really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 沙拉送去给四号桌的客人
sense_groups.english: Take those salads to table four.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去帮我拿鱼
sense_groups.english: And you, get the swordfish!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你…
sense_groups.english: And you!

sense_groups.chinese: 去剪头发
sense_groups.english: Get a haircut!

sense_groups.chinese: 终点站 蒙特利尔…
sense_groups.english: Last stop, Montreal. The stop is Montreal!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟自己打赌 赌你有一对美目
sense_groups.english: I bet myself that you had beautiful eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来… 我赢了
sense_groups.english: Now that I see them, I win!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要在这站下车 你想不想喝杯咖啡？
sense_groups.english: We're at my stop. Would you like to have coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的在蒙特利尔吗？
sense_groups.english: Are we really in Montreal?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes, we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不想喝咖啡？
sense_groups.english: So coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意
sense_groups.english: Coffee sounds great.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你住在蒙特利尔？
sense_groups.english: So you live in Montreal?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我住新斯科细亚 坐渡轮两小时就到了
sense_groups.english: No, but it's only a two-hour ferry ride to Nova Scotia.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我顶嘴之前
sense_groups.english: I should have thought about my wife and kids...

sense_groups.chinese: 真该想想家中妻小
sense_groups.english: ...before I talked back to Chef Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来咱们龙府今年得过个冷飕飕的圣诞节
sense_groups.english: It will be a lean Christmas at the Dragon house this year.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: Enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 冷飕飕啊
sense_groups.english: Lean, lean, lean!

sense_groups.chinese: 我去店里 坐在圣诞老公公大腿上
sense_groups.english: Went to the store Sat on Santa's lap

sense_groups.chinese: 要他送堆礼物给我朋友
sense_groups.english: Asked him to bring my friends All kinds of crap

sense_groups.chinese: 他说你只需要帮他们写首歌
sense_groups.english: Said all you need is To write them a song

sense_groups.chinese: 这首歌你们没听过 别想跟着我唱
sense_groups.english: Now you haven't heard it yet So don't try to sing along

sense_groups.chinese: 不要跟我唱
sense_groups.english: No, don't sing along

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡…
sense_groups.english: Monica, Monica

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节快乐
sense_groups.english: Have a happy Hanukkah

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到圣诞老公公
sense_groups.english: Saw Santa Claus

sense_groups.chinese: 他要我跟罗斯说哈罗
sense_groups.english: He said hello to Ross

sense_groups.chinese: 请告诉乔伊
sense_groups.english: And please tell Joey

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞节将瑞雪纷飞
sense_groups.english: Christmas will be snowy

sense_groups.chinese: 还有瑞秋和钱德
sense_groups.english: And Rachel and Chandler

sense_groups.chinese: 祝各位佳节快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy holidays, everybody!

questions.name: S04E11
questions.en:
I can't believe my little brother's married!
Why didn't you tell me you were eloping?
Well, we were at court, eating lunch...
Why were you at court?
Lunch.
We were like...
...we're here, we're having lunch. Let's get married! Right?
A year ago, I didn't know I had a brother. Now I have a sister!
Oh, it's so great.
Okay.
Stop it! Don't!
I'll get you a gift now.
Is there anything you need?
Uh, yeah.
We've been trying to get pregnant. Thought we'd get a jump on things.
No one's getting any younger. Ha-ha-ha.
Because the thing is, um, we're not able to, you know, uh, conceive.
We've seen a bunch of doctors.
They say that our only chance to have a baby...
...is that if they take my sperm, her egg, put it together in a dish...
...and put it into another girl.
We were wondering if you could be that girl.
That's a really nice gift.
I was thinking of a gravy boat.
Check it out! Guess what job I just got.
I don't know, but Donald Trump wants his blue blazer black.
What?
Blue blazer back. He wants it back.
You said "black." Why would he want his blue blazer black?
Well, you know what I meant.
You messed it up.
You're stupid.
So what job'd you get?
Tour guide at the museum. Ross got it for me.
Don't you have to be a dinosaur expert?
They give you all the information.
It's like memorizing a script.
On your left, tyrannosaurus rex, from the Jurassic Period.
Very nice.
Yeah, actually, Joey, it's the Cretaceous Period.
But I can pronounce Jurassic.
Hey!
Frank Jr. And Alice got married!
Oh, my God!
They're having a baby!
They want me to grow it for them in my uterus!
My God! - Are you serious?
Yeah.
You're thinking of having sex with your brother?
Ew! And, oh, no!
They want me to be the surrogate.
It's her egg and his sperm. I'm the oven. It's their bun.
What did you say?
I had to think about it, but what is there to think of?
I'll be giving someone the greatest gift.
You'll carry their child, and get them a Sony PlayStation?
This is an incredible thing to do.
But there are things to think about.
Yeah, you'd be pregnant. I mean pregnant.
I know.
You'll put your body through an awful lot.
I mean, morning sickness, uh, labor.
It's all for somebody else.
Yeah. What's your point?
Well, the stuff I just mentioned.
I couldn't do that.
I figure, the first time I had a baby, it'd be with someone I love.
And that baby was, you know...
...a keeper.
You were more supportive when I wanted to make denim furniture.
If you decide to do this, we'll be supportive like crazy.
Just think it through.
Talk to somebody who's had a baby. Like your mom.
My mom never gave birth. Oh! But my birth mom did!
I love this tushy! Can I take it to work with me?
Yeah, sure. It's not mine anyway. It came with the pants.
I am so jealous.
You guys are just right there.
Yes.
Right where?
The beginning, where it's all sex and talking...
...and sex and talking.
You got to love the talking.
And the sex?
We haven't had sex.
What's the big deal? This is special.
I want our love to grow before moving to the next level.
Oh, Chandler, that is so nice.
That is really nice...
...lying!
No way is that the reason. - Why?
You're not mature enough to understand that!
He's right. I'm totally lying.
Then what is it?
Kathy's last boyfriend was Joey.
And you're afraid you won't be able to fill his shoes?
I'm afraid I won't make love as well as him.
I was going for the metaphor.
I was saying the actual words.
He's had girlfriends. It doesn't mean he's great in bed.
We share a wall.
Either he's great, or she liked to agree with him a lot.
It'll be different. The sex will be great because you are in love.
Yeah? - Yeah.
Just go for it.
Yeah, you should.
All right. I'll sleep with my girlfriend.
But I'm just doing it for you guys.
Now, the mastodon is from the semi-late Jurassic Period.
Isn't the mastodon from the Pliocene Epoch?
Shh.
This is a museum. No talking.
Right down here we have...
...a large foot.
And over here we have Ross Geller.
Everyone wave "hi" to Ross.
Ross is one of our scientists. Look at him hard at work.
Okay, moving right along.
Come on.
It's open. Come in.
I'm sorry I'm late. - That's okay.
I had time to finish glazing my nipples.
You go all out when you're expecting company.
I was working on my pottery.
Oh! Oh!
Oh! I didn't know that you did pot.
Mostly nudes. It combines my two passions: Pottery and erotica.
Erottery!
Hey! Okay!
Thanks for coming out to see me.
I thought it'd be a good idea to talk about this baby stuff in person.
I don't think it's a good idea.
Why not?
You'd be giving up a baby.
And I really don't...
I don't know if anything I say...
...would make you understand the pain of giving up a baby.
So...
No, no, I understand the pain. Don't hurt the puppy!
No, no. The puppy is yours.
I get a puppy?
But for only three days.
Why?
I realize I don't have any right to start getting parenty on you now.
Look at me and not the puppy. It's very important.
I know what I'm talking about.
I gave up two babies.
I only wish I had someone who'd given up babies that told me...
...how terrible it is.
It'd be something you'd regret every day for the rest of your life.
So however hard it is for you to give up this puppy...
...it'd be a million times harder to give up a child.
I shouldn't have given you the puppy first.
Could you sit there? I'm saving this seat for my friend Ross.
You mean Dr. Geller?
Doctor? I didn't know he had a nickname.
Oh, he won't sit here.
Only people in white coats sit there.
Only people in blue blazers sit here.
How come?
That's how it is.
That's crazy.
It's crazy in a perfect world: A world without lab coats and blazers.
But you not in a perfect world. You in a museum now.
See that scientist?
He and I used to play together in grade school, but now...
Peter! Hey, Peter!
It's me, Rhonda from P.S. 129?
I shared my pudding with you, man!
I gave you my snack pack!
See? He pretend he don't even hear me!
Everyone's pretending they don't hear you.
I don't know about your jackets and separate tables...
...but Ross is my friend.
And if I save him a seat, he will sit in it.
Ross. Ross.
Here! I saved you a seat!
I'm cool here. I'll catch up with you later.
This is saved.
Gift shop.
I'm sorry about what happened today.
You do what you got to do.
The scientists and the tour guides never sit together.
It's like that everywhere. Mon, back me up.
Where you work, the waiters eat with the waiters.
And the chefs eat with the other chefs?
I eat by myself in the alley, because everybody hates me.
Look, Ross.
It's no big deal.
You wear a white coat. I wear a blue blazer.
If that means we can't be friends at work, so be it.
I understand, you know?
When I'm in a play and you're in the audience, I don't talk to you.
So it's, you know, it's, uh, cool.
I'll see you tomorrow.
When we're in the audience, he does wave.
Hi. - Hey.
Why's Phoebe singing to Karl Malden?
I think it's time for puppy to go out again.
Come on, let's go to the balcony. - What?
The street. Come on, let's go to the street.
Don't go on the balcony until after I get back.
So did you do it?
Yes, yes, we had the sex.
Uh-oh. It was bad?
It was fine, but she didn't agree with me as strongly as with Joey.
She was like, uh, "I see your point. I'm all right with it."
There's not always a lot of agreement the first time.
Yeah. Not for girls, anyway. Guys agree like that.
Look, you have to help me.
I mean...
I know what to do with a woman. It's always nice.
I need to know...
...what makes it go from nice to...
..."My God! Somebody's killing her in there!"
I'll show you something a lot of guys don't know.
All right.
Now.
You don't have to draw an actual... Whoa, she's hot!
Everyone knows the erogenous zones.
You got one, two, three...
...four...
...five, six and seven.
There are seven?
Let me see that.
Oh, yeah.
That's one?
Kind of an important one.
I was looking at it upside down.
Well, you know sometimes that helps.
Most guys will hit one, two, three and then go to seven and set up camp.
That's bad?
At Disneyland, you don't spend the whole day on the Matterhorn.
You might if it were like seven.
The important thing is to take your time.
You want to hit them all...
...mix them up. Keep them on their toes.
Oh, toes!
For some people.
All right.
You could, uh, start out with a little one.
A two.
A one, two, three.
A three.
A five.
A four.
A three, two.
Two. A two, four, six.
Two, four, six.
