sense_groups.english: I know what I'm talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我送走过两个孩子
sense_groups.english: I gave up two babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 只希望当时能有前辈告诉我
sense_groups.english: I only wish I had someone who'd given up babies that told me...

sense_groups.chinese: 送走自己的小孩会有多痛苦
sense_groups.english: ...how terrible it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得送走孩子后 你会每天后悔直到死掉
sense_groups.english: It'd be something you'd regret every day for the rest of your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到时送走这条小狗的痛苦
sense_groups.english: So however hard it is for you to give up this puppy...

sense_groups.chinese: 还不及送走孩子的百万分之一
sense_groups.english: ...it'd be a million times harder to give up a child.

sense_groups.chinese: 早知道就不先把小狗给你
sense_groups.english: I shouldn't have given you the puppy first.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能坐对面？我帮朋友罗斯留了位置
sense_groups.english: Could you sit there? I'm saving this seat for my friend Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说盖勒博士？
sense_groups.english: You mean Dr. Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 博士？我不知道他有这绰号
sense_groups.english: Doctor? I didn't know he had a nickname.

sense_groups.chinese: 他才不会坐这里呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, he won't sit here.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿白袍的都会坐在那里
sense_groups.english: Only people in white coats sit there.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿蓝色外套的只能坐这里
sense_groups.english: Only people in blue blazers sit here.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么这样？
sense_groups.english: How come?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样
sense_groups.english: That's how it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 岂有此理
sense_groups.english: That's crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许在不分蓝白的完美世界里 这样就会是岂有此理
sense_groups.english: It's crazy in a perfect world: A world without lab coats and blazers.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不是活在完美世界 而且这里是博物馆
sense_groups.english: But you not in a perfect world. You in a museum now.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到那戴眼镜的科学家没？
sense_groups.english: See that scientist?

sense_groups.chinese: 想当年我们念小学还是玩伴 但现在呢？
sense_groups.english: He and I used to play together in grade school, but now...

sense_groups.chinese: 彼德…
sense_groups.english: Peter! Hey, Peter!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是朗姐 我们是同届的啊
sense_groups.english: It's me, Rhonda from P.S. 129?

sense_groups.chinese: 亏我把布丁分你吃过
sense_groups.english: I shared my pudding with you, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 我还把点心棒送给你吃
sense_groups.english: I gave you my snack pack!

sense_groups.chinese: 看到没？他假装通通没听到
sense_groups.english: See? He pretend he don't even hear me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想大家都在假装没听到
sense_groups.english: Everyone's pretending they don't hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不知道什么制服 还有你们分桌吃饭的事啦
sense_groups.english: I don't know about your jackets and separate tables...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过罗斯是我的死党
sense_groups.english: ...but Ross is my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 若我帮他留了位置 我告诉你 他一定会坐
sense_groups.english: And if I save him a seat, he will sit in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Ross. Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 来这里坐 我帮你留了位置
sense_groups.english: Here! I saved you a seat!

sense_groups.chinese: 我坐这里就好了 之后再去找你聊
sense_groups.english: I'm cool here. I'll catch up with you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个位置有人坐了
sense_groups.english: This is saved.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是礼品店的
sense_groups.english: Gift shop.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天在自助餐厅的事很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about what happened today.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 该怎么做就怎么做
sense_groups.english: You do what you got to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是我而已 科学家和导览员从来不坐一起
sense_groups.english: The scientists and the tour guides never sit together.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种情况到处都有 摩妮卡 帮我说说话啊
sense_groups.english: It's like that everywhere. Mon, back me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 在你工作的地方 侍者和侍者一起吃饭
sense_groups.english: Where you work, the waiters eat with the waiters.

sense_groups.chinese: 厨师和厨师吃饭 对吧？
sense_groups.english: And the chefs eat with the other chefs?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是自己躲在巷子里吃 因为大家都恨我
sense_groups.english: I eat by myself in the alley, because everybody hates me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你听我说
sense_groups.english: Look, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 这没哈大不了的啦
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿白袍 我穿蓝色外套
sense_groups.english: You wear a white coat. I wear a blue blazer.

sense_groups.chinese: 若这表示我们上班不能当朋友 那就这样吧
sense_groups.english: If that means we can't be friends at work, so be it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能了解
sense_groups.english: I understand, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我演舞台剧 你坐观众席 我也不会跟你说话 是吧？
sense_groups.english: When I'm in a play and you're in the audience, I don't talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以没事了
sense_groups.english: So it's, you know, it's, uh, cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们坐在观众席 他是没说话 但有跟我们招手
sense_groups.english: When we're in the audience, he does wave.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比干嘛唱歌给卡尔马登听？
sense_groups.english: Why's Phoebe singing to Karl Malden?

sense_groups.chinese: 小狗又应该出去了
sense_groups.english: I think it's time for puppy to go out again.

sense_groups.chinese: 走 我们去阳台
sense_groups.english: Come on, let's go to the balcony. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 去街上 走 我们去街上
sense_groups.english: The street. Come on, let's go to the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我回来之前 别去阳台
sense_groups.english: Don't go on the balcony until after I get back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了没？
sense_groups.english: So did you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 有… 我们上床了
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, we had the sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 不好喔？
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. It was bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 好是好 但是她附和我的程度 不像附和乔伊那样强烈
sense_groups.english: It was fine, but she didn't agree with me as strongly as with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉像是"我了解 无所谓"
sense_groups.english: She was like, uh, "I see your point. I'm all right with it."

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次的互动总是比较生疏
sense_groups.english: There's not always a lot of agreement the first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 女生要慢慢来 不像男生一趣就互动了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Not for girls, anyway. Guys agree like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们得帮帮我
sense_groups.english: Look, you have to help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说…
sense_groups.english: I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道怎么在床上取悦女人 我知道步骤 一直也都很好
sense_groups.english: I know what to do with a woman. It's always nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我需要知道…
sense_groups.english: I need to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么从"好"进阶到…
sense_groups.english: ...what makes it go from nice to...

sense_groups.chinese: "老天 那家伙让她欲仙欲死"
sense_groups.english: ..."My God! Somebody's killing her in there!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我来开释一个很多男人不知道的事
sense_groups.english: I'll show you something a lot of guys don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 来啰
sense_groups.english: Now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用真的画出… 哇 她身材真惹火
sense_groups.english: You don't have to draw an actual... Whoa, she's hot!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都知道性感带在哪里
sense_groups.english: Everyone knows the erogenous zones.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一 二 三
sense_groups.english: You got one, two, three...

sense_groups.chinese: 四…
sense_groups.english: ...four...

sense_groups.chinese: 五 六 还有七
sense_groups.english: ...five, six and seven.

sense_groups.chinese: 性感带有七个？
sense_groups.english: There are seven?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看
sense_groups.english: Let me see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那里也算一个？
sense_groups.english: That's one?

sense_groups.chinese: 还蛮重要的呢
sense_groups.english: Kind of an important one.

sense_groups.chinese: 反过来看会有误差嘛
sense_groups.english: I was looking at it upside down.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候反过来也不错
sense_groups.english: Well, you know sometimes that helps.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人大多数爱抚过一 二 三 就直接跳到第七个 结束比赛
sense_groups.english: Most guys will hit one, two, three and then go to seven and set up camp.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样不好吗？
sense_groups.english: That's bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 你去迪士尼乐园 也不会整天只玩马特洪雪橇啊
sense_groups.english: At Disneyland, you don't spend the whole day on the Matterhorn.

sense_groups.chinese: 若那是第七个就有可能
sense_groups.english: You might if it were like seven.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是慢慢来
sense_groups.english: The important thing is to take your time.

sense_groups.chinese: 七个性感带都要照顾到
sense_groups.english: You want to hit them all...

sense_groups.chinese: 还要搭配混和使用 就像路脚那样维持紧绷
sense_groups.english: ...mix them up. Keep them on their toes.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚趾
sense_groups.english: Oh, toes!

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人的脚趾会兴奋嘛
sense_groups.english: For some people.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以先小小来个一
sense_groups.english: You could, uh, start out with a little one.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来二
sense_groups.english: A two.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三搭配
sense_groups.english: A one, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个三
sense_groups.english: A three.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个五
sense_groups.english: A five.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个四
sense_groups.english: A four.

sense_groups.chinese: 来个三和二
sense_groups.english: A three, two.

sense_groups.chinese: 二 再配个二 四 六
sense_groups.english: Two. A two, four, six.

sense_groups.chinese: 二 四 六
sense_groups.english: Two, four, six.

sense_groups.chinese: 四 二
sense_groups.english: Four. Two.

sense_groups.chinese: 二 四和七
sense_groups.english: Two. Four, seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 五配七 六配七
sense_groups.english: Five, seven! Six, seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 七…
sense_groups.english: Seven! Seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 七…
sense_groups.english: Seven, seven, seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 七
sense_groups.english: Seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士 这里有位置
sense_groups.english: Dr. Geller? There's a seat here.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲利普斯博士 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Dr. Phillips.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我的午餐…
sense_groups.english: But I'm having my lunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 要在这张桌子上吃 中间这一张
sense_groups.english: ...at this table. Here in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的午餐…
sense_groups.english: I'm eating...

sense_groups.chinese: 就在这里和好友乔伊一起吃
sense_groups.english: ...right here with my good friend, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 若他愿意跟我坐一起的话
sense_groups.english: If he'll sit with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士 我跟你坐
sense_groups.english: I will sit with you, Dr. Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗…
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在自然史博物馆工作
sense_groups.english: ...we work in a museum of natural history.

sense_groups.chinese: 然而却有一件事…
sense_groups.english: And yet, there is something...

sense_groups.chinese: 很不自然
sense_groups.english: ...unnatural...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们吃中饭的方式很不自然
sense_groups.english: ...about the way we eat lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我环顾这自助餐的四周 看到了什么？我看到隔阂
sense_groups.english: I look around, and you know what I see? I see division.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿白袍的人和穿蓝外套的人 彼此有着隔阂
sense_groups.english: Division between people in white coats and people in blue blazers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我扪心自问 "天啊 这是为什么？"
sense_groups.english: I ask myself, "My God, why?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我建议大家脱掉…
sense_groups.english: Now, I say we shed these coats...

sense_groups.chinese: 造成我们隔阂的这些外套
sense_groups.english: ...that separate us.

sense_groups.chinese: 才能认识衣服里面的人
sense_groups.english: And we get to know the people underneath.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 我离过婚 有个小孩
sense_groups.english: I'm divorced and I have a kid!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊 我是个演员
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey! I'm an actor!

sense_groups.chinese: 我对恐龙一窍不通
sense_groups.english: I don't know squat about dinosaurs!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是泰德 一个月前才搬来 纽约真是吓坏我了
sense_groups.english: I'm Ted, and I just moved here, and New York really scares me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了 - 秦德 你要撑住
sense_groups.english: There you go! - Hang in there, Teddy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是安德鲁
sense_groups.english: I'm Andrew.

sense_groups.chinese: 这颗梨我没付钱
sense_groups.english: And I didn't pay for this pear.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 有你的
sense_groups.english: Okay. Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是朗姐 这一对不是真的
sense_groups.english: I'm Rhonda! And these aren't real!

sense_groups.chinese: 朗姐…
sense_groups.english: Wow, Rhonda.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是史考特 - 帮史考特加油
sense_groups.english: I'm Scott. - Yeah, okay, Scott!

sense_groups.chinese: 我在离开一个房间之前 一定要连续开灯关灯17次
sense_groups.english: I flip the light switch on and off 17 times when I leave a room...

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我全家都会死光光
sense_groups.english: ...or my family will die.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈随时会来
sense_groups.english: My mom will be here soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法 我不能送走他
sense_groups.english: I can't. I can't give him up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 我可以
sense_groups.english: Yes, no. I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想
sense_groups.english: I don't want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我可以
sense_groups.english: But I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再看下去一定会崩溃 这就像是《苏菲的选择》
sense_groups.english: I can't watch this. It's like Sophie's Choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从没看过那部电影
sense_groups.english: You know, I never saw that.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实很普通而已啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, it was only okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不到
sense_groups.english: I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈说的对 若我连一条狗都拾不得
sense_groups.english: My mom was right. If I can't give him up...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能送走自己生的小孩
sense_groups.english: ...there's no way I can give up a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克和艾莉丝一定会很受伤
sense_groups.english: Frank and Alice are going to be so crushed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能给他什么别的？肾脏？
sense_groups.english: What else can I give them? A kidney!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正好在附近
sense_groups.english: We were in the neighborhood.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们顺路过来是要让你知道 还是不要有压力
sense_groups.english: We want to let you know that there's still no pressure.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会的
sense_groups.english: None.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是如果你有事要跟我们说 我们就坐在那里喝咖啡
sense_groups.english: If there was something you wanted to say, we'll be right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个小家伙是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's this little guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦…
sense_groups.english: Oh, um, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 真可爱 让我想起我的老狗肿瘤
sense_groups.english: He's so cute! He reminds me of my old dog, Tumor.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧你可爱的 真想带你回家
sense_groups.english: You are so precious, I'd take you home.

sense_groups.chinese: 有何不可呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说真的？
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？ - 这样不会让我难过
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - I'm okay with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道原因吗？看看他们
sense_groups.english: You know why? Because look at them.

sense_groups.chinese: 看他们高兴成那样
sense_groups.english: Look how happy they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的功劳 所以…
sense_groups.english: And I made that, so you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道送走自己生出来的孩子 一定会难上百万倍…
sense_groups.english: ...it'll be a million times harder to give up a baby. But God!

sense_groups.chinese: 但到时的快乐 一定也会是百万倍 对吧？
sense_groups.english: It'll feel a million times better, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 决定了 我要怀你们的孩子
sense_groups.english: I'll do this. I want to carry your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太感谢了
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much!

sense_groups.chinese: 这对我们意义非凡
sense_groups.english: You don't know what this means to us.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我都快哭了
sense_groups.english: I think I'm going to cry!

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会很棒的
sense_groups.english: It's going to be so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 我把小狗给了他们
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - I gave them the puppy.

sense_groups.chinese: 看他们高兴成那样 我决定帮他们怀小孩
sense_groups.english: It made them so happy, I decided to carry their baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 你不用说 我知道
sense_groups.english: Phoebe... - No, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你我是完全不同的人
sense_groups.english: We're different, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且情况也完全不同
sense_groups.english: This is a different situation.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我这样做绝不会后悔
sense_groups.english: I am not going to regret this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的我都了解
sense_groups.english: I understand all that.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是… 那小狗是我的耶
sense_groups.english: It's just, that was my puppy.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意帮别人当代理孕母吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you ever be a surrogate?

sense_groups.chinese: 要看是谁要我帮忙
sense_groups.english: Depends who asked.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是我要你帮忙呢？
sense_groups.english: What if I asked?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 那我当然愿意啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mon, sure!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？- 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是真要我帮忙吧？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: You're not asking me, are you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然帮你 一定帮
sense_groups.english: Yes. Totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你…

What the hell is that?
What the hell is that? Is that you?
Boy, you're really not a morning person. - Just back off!
Get up! Get up! Get up!
What is that noise?
You.
It's the chick.
She's going through some changes.
What kind of changes?
Well, the vet seems to think that she's becoming a rooster.
We're getting a second opinion.
Hey, what are you doing shopping at 8 in the morning?
Well, I've been up since 6...
...thanks to somebody's dumb-ass rooster.
You guys, you really should get rid of those animals.
They shouldn't be in an apartment.
Yeah, especially not with all these knives and cookbooks around.
All right, I'm gonna go to the fertility doctor and, uh, see if I'm ready...
...to have Frank and Alice's embryo transferred into my uterus.
Now, how will they know if you're ready?
Oh, they're just gonna look and see if my endometrial layer is thick.
Oh, I can check that for you.
Okay, everyone, think "thick."
Good luck.
Hey. Wish me luck. - Hey.
Oh, good luck. - Good luck.
And I'm still right. - That is so not true.
What?
She's mad because I know today's her laundry day...
...and that means she's wearing her old-lady underpants.
I can check that for you.
I just can't believe that you think that you and Chandler know me and Rachel...
...better than we know you.
Well, we do.
You can only eat Tic Tacs in even numbers.
Yeah, what's that about?
And you. Ross, I believe if you check Rachel's bag...
...you will find a half-eaten box of cookies in there.
You're good.
These are not.
I'm so not impressed. Everybody snacks when they shop.
Yeah. - Oh, yeah?
Ross, how many items left in that bag?
Five. - Okay.
Ten bucks says that we can name every item in that bag.
How many guesses do you get? - Six.
Challenge extended.
Deal. - Challenge accepted.
All right, we'll start with...
...apples.
We'll be starting with apples.
Stop that now.
Yes.
Okay. Uh, tortilla chips.
Yogurt. - Diet soda.
Yes, yes, yes.
Orange juice. - No, there's no orange juice in there.
We win. - Ha, ha.
They have another guess.
Okay, well, we won that one.
Okay. The last thing is...
Ooh, ooh, ooh.
No, no. Not for, like, another two weeks.
I got it. Scotch...
...tape.
How did you know she would buy Scotch tape?
Well, we used up theirs last night making scary faces.
Oh, man.
All right. Ten bucks. Fork it over.
Cough it up. Pay the piper.
Give me it.
That does not mean you know us better. I want a rematch.
Yeah, and none of these stupid grocery questions. Real personal questions.
Yeah. And the winner gets 100 bucks.
Serious?
Are you scared?
No.
Okay, who makes up the questions?
Ross will do it.
Oh, sure, Ross will do it.
It's not like he has a job or a child or a life of his own.
Well, fine. We'll ask Phoebe.
No, no, no, I wanna play.
Looks like your uterus is ready for implantation.
Oh, I knew it. I knew it. I felt really thick this morning.
Ha, ha. - Okay, so, what's now?
Go get the eggs. Put them in there.
Okay. It'll take just a little while to prepare the embryos.
Embryos? As in more than one? - Mm-hm. Five, actually.
Five? Okay, where am I giving birth...
...in a hospital or a big box under the stairs?
Ha, ha. We do five because that gives you a 25-percent chance...
...that at least one will attach.
That's it? Twenty-five percent?
That means that it's, like, 75-percent chance of no baby at all?
Yeah, you know, I was thinking, what are the odds...
...if, like, you stuff, like, 200 of them in there?
Sweetie, now...
...she's a woman, not a gumball machine.
Okay, well, you know what? Don't worry.
I'm gonna do this as many times as it takes to get it right.
Well, see, the thing is, we kind of only have one shot.
Um, it costs $16,000 each time you do this.
So, um, we're kind of using all the money we have to do it just this one time.
Whoa.
That's... Okay, that's a lot of pressure on me and my uterus.
So... Well, okay.
So maybe there's something that I can do, you know, just to make sure I get pregnant.
No, I'm sorry.
Wow, you guys really don't know anything.
I know. Why doesn't she get drunk?
That worked for a bunch of girls in my high school.
Hey, guys. Do you realize that any minute now...
...Phoebe could be pregnant?
I know, I know.
It's such a huge, life-altering thing. - I know.
The test is ready.
Okay. Each team will answer 10 questions.
The first team to answer the most questions wins.
The categories are "Fears And Pet Peeves"...
..."Ancient History"...
..."Literature"...
...and "It's All Relative."
Now, the coin toss, to see who goes first.
Okay.
Somebody call it this time. - Yeah.
Tails.
It's heads. - Yeah!
Gentlemen, pick your category.
"Fears And Pet Peeves."
"What is Monica's biggest pet peeve?"
Animals dressed as humans. - That's correct.
Ladies? - Same category.
Okay.
"According to Chandler, what phenomenon scares the bejesus out of him?"
Michael Flatley, Lord of the Dance.
That is correct.
The Irish jig guy?
His legs flail about as if independent from his body.
Gentlemen, your pick.
"It's All Relative."
"Monica and I had a grandmother who died.
You both went to her funeral.
Name that grandmother."
Nana? - She has a real name.
Althea. - Althea?
What are you doing? - Took a shot.
Shooting with Althea?
Althea is correct. - Nice shooting.
We'll take "Literature."
"Every week, the TV Guide comes to Chandler and Joey's apartment.
What name appears on the address label?"
Oh! Chandler gets it. It's Chandler Bing.
No.
I'm afraid the TV Guide comes to "Chanandler Bong."
I knew that.
Rachel, use your head.
Actually, it's Miss Chanandler Bong.
Hello, teeny embryos.
Oh, I'm Phoebe Buffay. Hi.
I'm hoping to be your uterus for the next nine months.
You should know that we're doing this for Frank and Alice...
...who you know. You've been there.
Um...
You know, they want you so much.
So when you guys get in there, really grab on.
Okay, and I promise that I'll keep you safe and warm...
...until, you know, you're ready to have them take you home.
So...
Okay.
Oh, and also, next time you see me, if I'm screaming, don't worry.
That's what's supposed to happen.
Ready? - Uh-huh?
Good luck.
All right, the score is nine to eight in favor of the guys.
Ladies, if you miss this, the game is theirs. Pick your category.
"It's All Relative"!
You don't have to shout everything. - I'm sorry!
Ooh. "What is the name of Chandler's father's...
...Las Vegas all-male burlesque?"
Viva Las Gaygas.
Unfortunately, that is correct.
Yes.
All right. We have a tie.
Luckily, I've prepared for such an event.
The Lightning Round. - Ooh.
Thirty seconds. All the questions you can answer.
You guys are dead.
I am so good at Lightning Rounds.
I majored in Lightning Rounds, all right?
We're gonna destroy you. - Want to bet?
Oh, I'm so confused as to what we've been doing so far.
How about we play for more money? Say 150?
One hundred and fifty dollars.
Say 200?
Two hundred dollars.
You're doing it again.
Excuse me.
Monica, I don't want to lose $200. - We won't.
Okay. - Three hundred?
Monica. - I'm just trying to spice it up.
Okay, so then play for some pepper. Stop spending my money.
I got it.
How about if we win, they have to get rid of the rooster.
Ooh, that's interesting.
Hey, no way. That rooster's family.
Throw in the duck too. - What do you have against the duck?
It doesn't make noise. - Well, he gets the other one all riled up.
Look, we are not... - All right, hold on.
If you win...
...we give up the bird.
But if we win...
...we get your apartment.
Ooh!
Deal!
Monica, betting the apartment? I don't know about this.
Rachel, I have not missed one question the whole game.
I own this game.
Look at my hand.
Why, do you have the answers written on there?
No. Steady as a rock. Now, are you with me?
All right, let's do it. Okay. - Come on.
All right. Gentlemen, you're up first.
Okay.
You have 30 seconds.
The Lightning Round begins...
Stop it.
Now. "What was Monica's nickname when she was a field-hockey goalie?"
Big Fat Goalie. - Correct.
"Rachel claims this is her favorite movie."
Dangerous Liaisons. - Correct.
"Her actual favorite is?" - Weekend at Bernie's. Correct.
"In what part of her body did Monica get a pencil stuck at age 14?"
Oh!
Ew, no!
Her ear.
All right, "Monica categorizes her towels. How many categories are there?"
Okay, everyday use. - Fancy.
Guest. - Fancy guest.
Two seconds. - Uh, eleven?
Eleven. Unbelievable. Eleven is correct.
Yes!
All right.
That's four for the guys. Ladies, you're up.
All right, all right, come on!
Thirty seconds on the clock.
Five correct questions wins the game.
The Lightning Round begins now. "What is Joey's favorite food?"
Sandwiches. - Correct.
"Chandler was how old when he first touched a girl's breast?"
Fourteen? - No, 19.
Thanks, man.
"Joey had an imaginary childhood friend.
His name was..." - Maurice.
"His profession was?" - Space cowboy.
Correct.
"What is Chandler Bing's job?"
Oh.
Oh, gosh. It has something to do with numbers.
And processing. - And he carries a briefcase.
Ten seconds. You need this or you lose the game.
It has something to do with transponding.
Oh! Oh! He's a transponster.
That's not even a word!
I can get this. I can get this.
No!
Yes!
I call Monica's room. - You can't just call Monica's room.
Sure I can. Standard Shotgun Rules. I'm in sight of the room and I called it.
Damn.
Man, I feel like I'm coming down with something.
Oh. - Yeah.
Bet you can't guess what color my tonsils are. I bet the apartment.
Oh, I would never bet this apartment. It's too nice.
Hey. - Ooh, Pheebs, are they in there?
Um, yeah, uh-huh, I'm implanted.
How do you feel? - Well, freaked.
Because it turns out the odds are, like, really sucky.
And this is Frank and Alice's, like, only shot.
I mean, they are, like, literally putting all their eggs in my basket.
Yeah, but I bet it works.
Really? How much?
All right, I'm gonna go take a pregnancy test right now.
Oh, wow. You can tell this soon?
Well, the doctor says it takes a couple days.
But, I mean, my body's always been a little faster than Western medicine, so...
Oh, my God. I can't believe you guys actually think you're moving in here.
Well, believe it, baby.
Well, I'm not moving.
What?
No. It was a stupid bet. We were just playing a game.
You just can't ignore the bet. It's a bet.
You bet on a bet, and if you lose, you lose the bet.
Rach, we have to move.
If we had lost, we would have made them get rid of the birds.
No.
All right, look, I hate this as much as you, but if it makes you feel better...
...this is all your fault.
What? - Chanandler Bong.
Come on, we steal that TV Guide every week.
I knew it.
I don't care. I'm not going anywhere.
Cool. Girl roommate.
Well?
Nope, not knocked up yet.
It's only been a couple hours, so just give it some time.
Yeah, all right. Meanwhile, I'm gonna do whatever I can to help this...
...so I'm just gonna, you know, lie in your chair, okay?
You know, just...
Yeah, good. I'm gonna let gravity, you know, do its jobs.
Hey, Rach, can you give me a hand with this box?
No. Put that box down. We are not going anywhere!
This is my apartment and I like it.
This is a girl's apartment.
That is a boy's apartment. It's dirty and it smells.
This is pretty. It's so pretty.
And look, and it's purple.
And I'm telling you, you with your steady hand, I am not moving.
And now I have got the steady hand.
I'll take care of it. - That's right.
You do what the hand says.
How'd it go? - I lost our mattresses.
Are you in there, little fetus?
In nine months, will you come greet us?
I will buy you some Adidas
Hi. - Hi.
Oh, hi, Phoebe?
Um, we were just at the drugstore, um, so we got you a little present.
Um, it's a lollipop and a home pregnancy test.
Hey, don't mix those up. You could really ruin that lollipop.
So, um, you feel like taking a test? There's only one question.
All right. I will. No, I will.
But, um, you know, just remember that it's still really early.

...that doesn't mean I'm not gonna get pregnant, okay?

...just try not to put all your hopes on this, okay?
Okay.
Great.
You know what? You are mean boys who are just being mean.
Hey, don't get mad at us. No one forced you to raise the stakes.
That is not true. She did. She forced me.
We'd still be here if you hadn't got the question wrong.
Well, it was a stupid, unfair question!
Don't blame the questions!
Would you all stop yelling in our apartment?
You are ruining moving day for us.
Would you stop calling it your apartment? - It is ours.
Guys, you guys, you're gonna have a baby.
They're gonna have a baby.
My sister's going to have my baby!
Okay, but this can't be good for the baby.
I can't find garbage bags.
Oh, I think I saw some in here.
What is it?
I don't know. But maybe if we keep that drawer shut, it'll die.
I can't believe we're living here.
What? What is it?
Did you see the size of the closets?
I can't believe we live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 麻烦你通知他
sense_groups.english: Really? - Will you call him?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没问题
sense_groups.english: Yes, I will. Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hello, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 约书亚
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joshua.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是故意留下皮夹的
sense_groups.english: I left my wallet here on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想再见到你
sense_groups.english: Yes, I just wanted to see you again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好高兴
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm glad.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我有话要对你说
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I'd like to say something to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么话？
sense_groups.english: Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也是到了1776年才自由独立
sense_groups.english: Heh. Well, we didn't have freedom here until 1776 either, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 明天2点公园见
sense_groups.english: So good, then. We'll see you at Riverside Park at 2.

sense_groups.chinese: 干杯 - 干杯
sense_groups.english: Cheers. - Cheers.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我最喜欢唱歌了
sense_groups.english: Oh, boy. I just love to sing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你喜欢
sense_groups.english: Yes, I know that you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他人之所以抱怨
sense_groups.english: One of the reasons people were complaining...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为他们是花钱听演员唱
sense_groups.english: ...was because most of the people had paid to hear the actor sing "Old Man River."

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看我们
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at us.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不到在美容院也有爱神驻扎
sense_groups.english: Who would've thought that Cupid had a station at 14th Street Nails?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Okay, we have to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚结束一段很认真的恋情
sense_groups.english: I'm just getting out of a very serious relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 而我刚结束一段婚姻
sense_groups.english: I know. And I'm just getting out of a marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就叫做三生注定
sense_groups.english: I mean, talk about meant to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我觉得进展太快了
sense_groups.english: Right. But I just think this is happening too soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么太快 是太慢
sense_groups.english: Oh, too soon, too schmoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 认命吧 这次我不会放过你的
sense_groups.english: Face it, honey, I am not letting you get away this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听见了 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I hear you. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 很不幸的 我公司…
sense_groups.english: But unfortunately, my company...

sense_groups.chinese: 要把我调到海外
sense_groups.english: ...is transferring me overseas.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 调去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where to?

sense_groups.chinese: 巴黎？ - 不 不是巴黎
sense_groups.english: To Paris? - No. No, not Paris.

sense_groups.chinese: 伦敦？罗马？维也纳？巴塞隆纳？
sense_groups.english: To London? Oh. No, Rome? Vienna? Ooh, ooh. Barcelona?

sense_groups.chinese: 你先别讲话 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, could you just stop talking for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 叶门
sense_groups.english: Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错 我要被调去叶门
sense_groups.english: That's right. Yes. I'm being transferred to Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候？ - 我不太清楚
sense_groups.english: When? - I don't know exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我只好细细品尝 钱德宾的一切
sense_groups.english: Well, I will just have to soak up every ounce of Chandler Bing...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到那一刻来临
sense_groups.english: ...until that moment comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道是明天某时
sense_groups.english: But I do know it's sometime tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Done? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 干什么？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个开关快把我逼疯了
sense_groups.english: This switch thing has been driving me crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我把它关掉 检查每个插座
sense_groups.english: So I turned it off and checked every outlet.

sense_groups.chinese: 有四个不能用 表示其中一个由它控制
sense_groups.english: Now, four don't work, which means one of them has to be controlled by the switch.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我插上会发出声音的东西
sense_groups.english: So I plugged in things in all four outlets that make noise.

sense_groups.chinese: 到时候一打开
sense_groups.english: That way, when I turn it on, I just follow the noise...

sense_groups.chinese: 顺着声音去找就行了
sense_groups.english: ...and find out which one it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会第一个放弃
sense_groups.english: I bet I stopped listening before you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以插电灯
sense_groups.english: You know, you also could have used lamps...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后找灯光
sense_groups.english: ...and then followed the light.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要找声音 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I'm using noise. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, so everybody ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 开罗
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 有声音 我听到了 在哪里？
sense_groups.english: There's something. I hear something. Where is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 是乔伊发出来的
sense_groups.english: It's coming from Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 好诡异喔 把他关掉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. That's so freaky. Turn him off.

sense_groups.chinese: 在中央球场争球
sense_groups.english: With the set scrum in center field.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以看新闻吗？可能在下雨
sense_groups.english: Could we put on the news? I think it might be raining.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我在看体育频道的橄榄球赛
sense_groups.english: No, just hold on a sec. I'm watching this rugby thing on ESPN.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么大不了的 我也能打
sense_groups.english: I don't know what the big deal is. I'm man enough to play this sport.

sense_groups.chinese: 你家连运动台都没有
sense_groups.english: Dude, you're not even man enough to order the channel that carries the sport.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey there, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 是珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不必帮我打包
sense_groups.english: You know, uh, you really didn't have to help me pack.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你出发之前…
sense_groups.english: Oh. When you said all you were gonna be doing...

sense_groups.chinese: 都要打包
sense_groups.english: ...between now and the time you leave is packing...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有什么选择？
sense_groups.english: ...you really didn't leave me much choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为有 看来是没有
sense_groups.english: Well, I thought I did, but I guess I did not.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 我要打包
sense_groups.english: Hey. What's going on? - Oh, I'm packing.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我明天要搬去叶门
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm packing because I'm moving to Yemen tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你告诉我啊
sense_groups.english: Thanks for telling me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是假装要搬去叶门好摆脱她
sense_groups.english: I'm only pretend-moving to Yemen, okay? It's the only way I can get rid of her.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Oh. Good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 也门 听起来还真像个国家
sense_groups.english: And Yemen. That actually sounds like a real country.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 快来
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我教你怎么把内衣裤塞进鞋子
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna show you how to roll your underwear and stuff it in your shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以省空问 - 我那样做是想垫高
sense_groups.english: It's a real space-saver. - I do that because it makes me look taller.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 来啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 跟我交换人生 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Joey, trade lives with me. - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你看看 罗斯 你居然说你要打
sense_groups.english: Man, look at this. Ross, I can't believe you said you'd play.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种运动好野蛮 - 我可以应付
sense_groups.english: Look how brutal this is. - Hey, I can handle it, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, please, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你连跟我爸打羽毛球都会受伤
sense_groups.english: You got hurt playing badminton with my dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为你妈的狗一直看我
sense_groups.english: That's because your mom's dog kept looking at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你看 这个叫斗牛阵
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, look, look, look. Right here, it's called a "scrum," okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 就像聚商 - 那商斗就像聚牛阵吗？
sense_groups.english: It's kind of like a huddle. - And is a hum kind of like a scruddle?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他们会宰了你
sense_groups.english: Ross, they're gonna kill you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要打？
sense_groups.english: Why are you doing this, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该看看她以前交往的人
sense_groups.english: Well, you should've seen the guy that she used to go out with.

sense_groups.chinese: 他活像颗大橄榄球
sense_groups.english: I mean, he's like Joe Rugby.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 而他又打橄榄球？好好玩
sense_groups.english: You're kidding. And he plays rugby? That's so funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂你的意思了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see. You did that. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之她觉得我打橄榄球很好笑
sense_groups.english: Anyway, she thought the very idea of me playing rugby with him was, like, hilarious.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要证明我有多猛
sense_groups.english: So I'm gonna show her how tough I really am.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你说得对 你是很猛
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. You're right. You are a tough guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我认识最猛的古生物学家
sense_groups.english: You're the toughest paleontologist I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题啦 罗斯会照顾自己
sense_groups.english: All right, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 他又不是钱德
sense_groups.english: Look, Ross can take care of himself. It's not like he's Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 别替我担心
sense_groups.english: Look, don't worry about me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会装得很有冲劲 跟球保持距离
sense_groups.english: I'll just look real energetic and stay away from the ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会学那个人站在外面
sense_groups.english: I'll be that guy, right outside the circle.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, jeez.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许有狗在看他
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, maybe there was a dog looking at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, Ross, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 别靠近那个人 那个人 和那个人
sense_groups.english: You're gonna wanna stay away from that guy and that guy and that one.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都好壮
sense_groups.english: Dude, they're all huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 又没比我壮
sense_groups.english: They don't look any bigger than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你离你比较近
sense_groups.english: That's because you're closer to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以看你自己比较壮
sense_groups.english: So you look bigger to you from where you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去跟他们打个招呼
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna go and say hello to the lads.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还蛮可爱的
sense_groups.english: I kind of liked it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 我要变成赤面罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay, I know what I've gotta do. I've gotta go Red Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 赤面罗斯啊
sense_groups.english: You know, Red Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 完全给他不知道
sense_groups.english: Totally don't know what you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 那次我们去看《与狼共舞》
sense_groups.english: That time that we were all waiting in line for Dances With Wolves...

sense_groups.chinese: 有人插队 我不是就抓狂了？
sense_groups.english: ...and that one guy cut in front of us, and I just lost it?

sense_groups.chinese: 破口大骂 脸都涨红了
sense_groups.english: Huh? Screamed at him, turned all red.

sense_groups.chinese: 赤面罗斯啊
sense_groups.english: Red Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 等着瞧
sense_groups.english: You'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 连 恩 帮个忙
sense_groups.english: Liam, do me a favor.

sense_groups.chinese: 对罗斯手下留情 他是第一次打
sense_groups.english: Tell the lads to go easy on Ross. It's his first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: You don't say?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油
sense_groups.english: Good luck, babe.

sense_groups.chinese: 老弟 快进来
sense_groups.english: Ross. Ross, come on, get in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点
sense_groups.english: Ross, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 快进来争球
sense_groups.english: Ross, come on, get in the bloody scrum.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 进去
sense_groups.english: Ross, get in.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 说了你一定不信 约书亚今天来 你猜怎样？
sense_groups.english: Oh. You are not gonna believe it. Joshua came in today, and guess what.

sense_groups.chinese: 他约你？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: He asked you out? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我给他看一些袖扣 结果模到他的脉搏
sense_groups.english: But I was showing him some cuff links, and I felt his pulse.

sense_groups.chinese: 乱死了
sense_groups.english: Saucy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？ - 这栋楼的电路图
sense_groups.english: What are these? - Oh. Electrical plans for the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该要害怕吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, okay, should I be scared?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个开关一定有作用 这是去市政府调的
sense_groups.english: I know that switch has gotta do something. So I went to City Hall and I got these.

sense_groups.chinese: 只花了二十五元 排了三小时
sense_groups.english: All I had to do was pay $25 and wait in line for three hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 可惜大家不知道
sense_groups.english: Wow. If only more people knew.

sense_groups.chinese: 你实在不必送我来机场
sense_groups.english: You know, you really didn't have to take me to the airport.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 每分每秒都很珍贵
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. Every moment is precious.

sense_groups.chinese: 况且总得有人帮你提行李
sense_groups.english: Besides, somebody had to ride in that other taxi with your luggage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你朋友好像都不关心你要走了
sense_groups.english: And your friends don't seem to care very much that you're leaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们其实没那么要好
sense_groups.english: Well, we're not really that close.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就再见了
sense_groups.english: Okay. So I guess this is, uh, you know, goodbye, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 还没呢 你上了飞机我才要走
sense_groups.english: It's not goodbye. I'm not leaving until you get on that plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就请你"在此等候"
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, I guess it's just "wait here," then.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要一张去也门的假机票
sense_groups.english: Hi. I need a fake ticket to Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 一张去也门的机票？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: One ticket to Yemen? - Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只需要一张假机票
sense_groups.english: I just need a pretend ticket.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不懂
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, sir, I don't understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你会拿什么给小朋友玩？
sense_groups.english: What would you give to a kid if he wanted a ticket to play with?

sense_groups.chinese: 您有带小孩子？
sense_groups.english: Are you traveling with a child?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会以为我在拿信用卡给你
sense_groups.english: Oh. She's gonna think that I'm handing you a credit card.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我拿的是借书证
sense_groups.english: But what I'm really gonna do is hand you a library card.

sense_groups.chinese: 去也门的机票是2100元 我们不收借书证
sense_groups.english: Uh, sir, a ticket to Yemen is $2100, and we don't take library cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？有什么问题吗？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? Is something wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得留下来吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have to stay?

sense_groups.chinese: 美国运通卡？
sense_groups.english: American Express?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们怎么这样？我明明叫他们手下留情
sense_groups.english: I can't believe they're doing that to him. I told them to go easy on him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有恶意 但有时…
sense_groups.english: No offense, but sometimes it's hard to understand you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的口音很难懂
sense_groups.english: ...you know, with the accent, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 才上半场结束 还有下半场 - 噢
sense_groups.english: That's just halftime. There's more of this. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看到了吗？我挺强的 好过瘾的球赛
sense_groups.english: Did you see me? I was pretty good, huh? That is one fun game.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 帮个忙 去帮我拿水
sense_groups.english: Right. - Do me a favor? Grab me a bottle of water?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我快死了 真的 - 真可怜
sense_groups.english: I think I'm dying. I really do. - Oh, poor baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我儿子我爱他
sense_groups.english: Tell my son that I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我还要再打个过瘾
sense_groups.english: Oh, excellent. Okay, gotta have some more fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你快被整死了
sense_groups.english: Ross, they are killing you out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乱讲 - 她说得对 你不能再打了
sense_groups.english: That's not true. - She's right. You have to stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我是赤面罗斯
sense_groups.english: What? No. No, I'm not stopping. I'm Red Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你再上场会变成死面罗斯
sense_groups.english: Dude, you go back out there, you're gonna be Dead Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝不退场 我要打完
sense_groups.english: I don't care. I am not quitting. I am gonna finish this game.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果你一定要打 至少让我帮忙
sense_groups.english: All right. If you insist on doing this, at least let me help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 这不是女人玩的 那些人什么都捉
sense_groups.english: God, no. That is no place for a woman. Those guys will grab anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要上场
sense_groups.english: That's not what I was saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是知道怎样让别人受伤
sense_groups.english: I just might know a few things that could help you inflict some pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 - 是吗？听好
sense_groups.english: I like that. - Yeah? Listen closely.

sense_groups.chinese: 戴文的脚踝很弱 - 呃？
sense_groups.english: Devon has got a weak ankle. - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 踢一下就会倒
sense_groups.english: One swift kick and he'll back off.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 脚踝虚 了解
sense_groups.english: All right, bad ankle. Got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个留落腮胡的大个子 - 呃
sense_groups.english: And that big bloke with the beard? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 臀部毛病很多 - 臀部毛病很多
sense_groups.english: He's got a trick hip. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那边的大卫没穿护档
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And David over there, I heard that he doesn't wear a cup.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？蛮有用的 臀部不好 没穿护档 好
sense_groups.english: Real...? I could use that. Trick hip, no cup. Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 连恩的膝盖不好
sense_groups.english: And Liam. Liam's got bad knees.

sense_groups.chinese: 看准了一撞就倒
sense_groups.english: You hit him right and he'll go down like a lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是连恩跟我同队
sense_groups.english: But Liam's on my team.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 你去宰了他 - 好 宰了他
sense_groups.english: I don't care. You just get him. - Go get him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要回场上了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I am going back in.

sense_groups.chinese: 赤面罗斯
sense_groups.english: Red Ross. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是什么？
sense_groups.english: What are these?

sense_groups.chinese: 我画了一些画挂起来
sense_groups.english: Oh, just some pictures I made and hung up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好让客厅看起来更漂亮 有用吧？
sense_groups.english: I thought they'd brighten up the place. They do, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 别撕
sense_groups.english: Aah! - No, no, don't, don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那里没有洞 我只是很喜欢那幅画
sense_groups.english: I know that there's no hole there. I just really like that picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你看看
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是那边有电线 一定连到某个地方
sense_groups.english: But there is a wire back there. That switch is connected to something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 你才是脑筋脱线了
sense_groups.english: I don't care. The wires have come loose in your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺着电线就能找出它的功用
sense_groups.english: I thought if I could follow the wire, I could find out what it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你找到了吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: And did you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了地板上就断了
sense_groups.english: It disappears back behind that baseboard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为跑到楼下去了
sense_groups.english: For a minute there, I thought it went downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果没有
sense_groups.english: But it didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟楼下邻居打声招呼吧 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Say hello to Mrs. Catrokis. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 亲爱的 - 你好啊
sense_groups.english: Hello, darling. - Hello, Mrs. Catrokis.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定不去看医生吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you sure you don't wanna go see a doctor?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 这只会让我沮丧而已
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, that'll just bring me down.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我很厉害 今天太棒了
sense_groups.english: This was great. I mean, I was great. This was a great day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我请大家喝咖徘
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm buying everyone coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我拿皮夹 在我的口袋里
sense_groups.english: Someone just grab my wallet. It's in my pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 不是你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. - No, not you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的眼睛还是突的 我去拿冰块
sense_groups.english: Look, your eye's still popping out a little. I'm gonna go get some ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 冰块 我正想吃冰块
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Ooh, ice, yeah. I'm so in the mood for ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才好神勇 - 噢
sense_groups.english: You were amazing out there. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 对吧？ - 天啊
sense_groups.english: I kind of was, wasn't I? - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让一个壮我两倍的人哭了
sense_groups.english: I made a man twice my size cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 上一次是四岁 我用石头洗我爸的保时捷
sense_groups.english: I mean, I haven't done that since I was 4 and I washed my dad's Porsche with rocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的打得很过瘾 对不对？
sense_groups.english: You really enjoyed yourself, didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑 我干掉三个大块头
sense_groups.english: Please, are you kidding? I hurt three huge men.

sense_groups.chinese: 还让一个人流鼻血
sense_groups.english: I gave a guy a bloody nose.

sense_groups.chinese: 这没什么好得意的 不过…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm not proud of it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的好得意
sense_groups.english: ...but I really am.

sense_groups.chinese: 都是因为你
sense_groups.english: And it's all because of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 最棒最棒的你 - 我看你是脑震荡了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Wonderful, amazing you. - I think you've got a concussion.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说真的 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: No, no, I'm serious. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 会痛吗？ - 痛也值得
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Did that hurt you? - It's worth the pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实不值得
sense_groups.english: You know what? You know what? It's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后一次呼叫前往也门的旅客
sense_groups.english: This is the final boarding call for Flight 664 to Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我该走了
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: Oh. My Bing-a-ling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会等你的
sense_groups.english: I'll wait for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去多久？
sense_groups.english: Do you even know how long you're gonna be gone?

sense_groups.chinese: 直到找出可以替代石油的能源
sense_groups.english: Well, just until we find an energy source to replace fuel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会每天写信给你
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I'll write you every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 也门也门路15号
sense_groups.english: 15 Yemen Road, Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？ - 不是我
sense_groups.english: Chandler? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 你在这里 我得跟你做最后吻别
sense_groups.english: Janice. There you are. There you are. I had to have one last kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 另外你也说 我一上机你就要走
sense_groups.english: And also, also, you said you were gonna leave right after I got on the plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想看着你起飞
sense_groups.english: No. No. I wanna see you take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我要去也门罗
sense_groups.english: Well, then I guess I'm going to Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去也门了
sense_groups.english: I'm going to Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了也门 我可以住你家吗？
sense_groups.english: When we get to Yemen, can I stay with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 管理员不知道它的作用
sense_groups.english: All right. The super couldn't figure out what it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 一小时两百块的电工 不晓得它的作用
sense_groups.english: The $200-an-hour electrician couldn't figure out what it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我被狠狠电到七次
sense_groups.english: I've had seven pretty serious shocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃了 - 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: I officially give up. - Thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来乔伊说得对
sense_groups.english: I guess Joey was right.

sense_groups.chinese: 它没有用
sense_groups.english: It does nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我弄的 真的是我弄的
sense_groups.english: I'm doing it. I am totally doing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 超能力没了
sense_groups.english: I lost it.

questions.name: S04E16
questions.en:
What is it?
Nothing. I can't find anything that I want to eat.
Everything makes me nauseous.
I'm telling you, being pregnant is no piece of cake. Oh, cake.
No.
Aw, honey, I'm sorry. - God.
Ooh, what is that smell? It's coming from the bathroom.
Wow, pregnancy does give you some weird cravings.
Yeah. It's me. It's Phoebe.
Listen, there's something in here I want to eat. What?
What smells so good?
Is it the shampoo? It's guava.
No.
Ugh. - Oh, wait, wait.
Is it my bologna sandwich?
Yes, yes, yes.
I can't believe it. The baby wants bologna. The baby wants me to eat meat.
I can't eat meat. - Uh, wait, wait.
Maybe it's the pickle.
What are you writing?
Well, Joshua's coming in tomorrow...
...and since I don't have the guts to ask him out...
...I'm gonna sell him a coat and put this note in the pocket.
Oh, yeah? - Oh.
"Joshua, give me a call sometime. Guys like you...
...never go out of style."
What did you throw away?
Hi, guys. - Hey, what have you guys been up to?
Oh, we went to see a collection of Victorian doorknobs at the Cooper-Hewitt museum.
Without me?
My uncle dragged us there, but actually it turned out to be interesting.
Yeah. - They were so ornate and beautiful.
I mean, look at that.
I don't know how museums work in England...
...but here, you're not supposed to take stuff.
I, uh... I got it from the gift shop.
They have really lax security there.
It's a joke.
Bye.
Right, I've got to be off. I'll see you. Bye-bye, then.
Bye.
Wow. Hey, you guys seem to be having a good time.
Oh, yeah, she is amazing, and she's so much fun.
And you know what? When I'm with her, I'm fun.
I even signed up for helicopter classes.
She's leaving in two days. I don't have to do it.
Aw, two days? You must be bummed. - Yeah.
She's got to go back to London.
But you know what? I've been prepared for this from the start.
We both knew we had two weeks together and then that's it, you know?
Hey, that's what all my relationships are like.
Yes, but in Ross' case, they both know in two weeks that's it.
Pheebs, hey.
Hello, hello. - Yeah, I know. Yeah.
So the baby is totally craving meat.
This afternoon, I tried tricking it.
I made it a soy burger so that maybe it'd think it was getting meat.
You know? And I got nauseous.
Well, maybe that's because soy burgers suck.
Being pregnant is hard on your tummy.
Hey, but at least you got that cool, pregnant-lady glow.
Oh, that's sweat. You throw up all morning, you'll have that glow too.
Okay. - Uh, here's that trench coat you wanted.
Oh, great. Great.
Wow, yeah, it's comfortable. - Yeah.
Man, you could really flash somebody in this thing.
Ha, ha. They don't want you to put your hands in the pockets...
...until you are out of the store.
Why not?
Well, because...
...we get a lot of...
You know, they ruin it for everybody.
I know.
You know, I wore that cashmere sweater on a date last night.
Oh. - It was the first date since the divorce.
Well, congratulations. So do you love her?
No, no, no. She's nice, but, you know, it made me realize...
...I'm just not ready to be dating, you know?
Huh.
Well, uh...
That's, uh... That's interesting.
What was that? - Oh, that's just an antitheft device.
Then what's this?
Well, you need that too, because obviously a thief could just tear this up.
Listen, we have to have a party tonight.
We have to have one in five minutes, so everybody cancel your plans.
What? - Yeah, what's going on?
We have to have a surprise bon-voyage party for Emily.
But it's actually for Joshua.
Look, he said he's not ready to date.
So I had to invite him to a party if I wanted to see him outside work.
And now I have created the perfect opportunity to seduce him.
Well, as much as I'd like to meet Josh and warn him...
...Emily and I aren't gonna be here, all right?
She's gonna come by first to say goodbye.
And then I've got a whole special evening planned. So sorry. No party.
Aw.
Hello? - Surprise!
Surprise!
No one's ever thrown me a surprise party before.
Well, it was all Ross' idea.
You're so sweet.
And I'm so surprised.
You really didn't know?
There's dancin'
Behind movie scenes
Why are you over here if Joshua's all the way over there?
Uh, because I'm trying to play hard-to-get.
Oh, quick. He's looking over here. Say something funny.
Like what? - Ha-ha-ha.
What's so funny?
I said, "Like what?"
Now that's a thinker.
Okay, you know what? This playing-hard-to-get thing is not working.
Uh, hand me those cherries. Okay.
Okay.
Hi. - Hey.
Care for a cherry? - No, thanks.
You know, I can tie one of these into a knot using just my tongue.
You okay?
You all right?
So we should probably get going soon.
Oh, but the party's only just getting started.
Yeah, but we have to be at The Four Seasons for drinks in, oh, 15 minutes.
And then, uh, you know, then the Plaza for dinner.
So why did you plan a party at the same time?
No, no, no. Ha, ha.
Actually, American surprise parties are very short.
It's usually, "Surprise!" Then, "Oh, my God, I'm so surprised. Goodbye."
Ross, I'm having such a great time.
Your sister has just been telling me that you used to dressed up like old ladies...
...and host make-believe tea parties.
Monica said that, did she?
Oh, yeah. Then what are you going to put on top of that?
A little salami. - Ooh, yeah. Yeah.
Then, um, what goes on top of the salami?
Pastrami. - Oh, yeah.
You're a genius.
Can someone give me a hand with the zipper.
Up.
You changed? - Yeah, I just needed my lucky dress.
And "lucky" means "more cleavage"? - Does for me.
Oh, God, look at him. He's so cute.
I just want to go over there and grab him and kiss him.
How could I kiss him without letting him know that I like him?
Hey, I know how you can get him. Take off your bra.
What?
There was a scene in Footloose... - Flashdance.
Yeah, yeah. Yeah, with that plumber girl? - She was a welder.
Were you, like, in the movie?
Anyway, she takes off her bra under the shirt...
...and pulls it out the sleeve.
Very sexy. And classy.
Or if you wanna kiss him, um, you could use mistletoe.
It's not Christmas.
Or spin the bottle. - And he's not 11.
Thank you so much for this. It was really so thoughtful of you.
You're leaving?
Yes, we have something we have to get to. - Uh, yeah, I think I'm gonna take off too.
No, you guys, you can't leave yet. You have to stay.
We've got the whole big thing planned.
What big thing?
So, Spin-The-Bottle works like this.
I spin the bottle.
Lands on Gunther, so I would have to kiss Gunther.
All right.
Who wants to go first?
I'll go.
Welcome to America.
Oh.
All right.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my gosh. Two in a row. You gotta use your tongues now.
All right.
What are the odds? What are the odds?
Okay, that's enough, you know. Ha, ha.
Let's let someone else play.
Hey, if you didn't want to play, then why'd you come to the party?
Okay, my turn.
Oh! Look at that.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my God. The baby just kicked.
It's okay, it's okay. If it kicked once, it'll kick again.
All right, well, everybody just remember where they were sitting.
It was a bug.
It doesn't matter how much I'm craving it.
You know why I'm never gonna eat meat? Because it's cold-blooded murder.
Okay.
There's a Phoebe on my sandwich.
Phoebe, what are you doing?
I can't help it.
I need the meat. The baby needs the meat.
You know how when you're dating someone...
...and you don't want to cheat on them unless it's with someone really hot?
Yeah, totally. - All right, okay.
Well, this is the same kind of deal.
If you're gonna do something wrong...
...do it right.
Feel better?
Yeah, but at what cost?
Six more months, three meals a day?
I'm gonna eat like, you know, millions of cows.
Hey, what if I said I could even things out for you, meat-wise?
What? - Well, I eat a lot of meat, right?
Yeah. - But suppose, until the baby's born...
...I laid off it.
No extra animals would die. You'd just be eating my animals.
Joey, I can't believe you'd do that for me.
Absolutely. I could be a vegetarian.
There's no meat in beer, right?
Okay, we can still make dinner if we skip the appetizers...
...and ask for our check right away.
We can't go now. Looks like Rachel is going to put on a skit.
Oh, my God. Have you lost your mind?
No, no, no. I am finally thinking clearly.
My lucky dress wasn't working out too well for me.
But for four years, this baby never missed.
Rachel, wait, I can't let...
Actually, I kind of want to see what happens.
Hey. - Hey.
Nice, uh, costume.
Oh, yeah.
Well, I wanted to give Emily a big American goodbye cheer.
So okay. Whoo!
Ready. Okay.
Give me an "E." - E.
Give me an "M." - M.
Give me an "I." - I.
Give me an "L." - L.
Give me a "Y." - Y.
What do you get?
Oh! Emily.
Whoo! Emily.
Okay. That's me as a cheerleader. Ta-da!
It's no big deal. I have a dentist, you know?
I'm gonna go put some ice on it. Excuse me.
What do I do now? What do I do now? - I think you're done.
Okay, time to take off the bra.
Uh, that was really great.
But I got to take off, actually.
Take the bra off.
All right, come on, let's go get your coat.
Okay.
Rachel's my girlfriend.
So this was really fun.
Oh, yeah, it was real fun.
You know, this bra...
...is really bothering me.
You know, this used to be my bedroom.
Yeah.
A lot of memories in here. Lot of memories.
If these walls could talk, you know what they'd say?
"Want to hear some memories?"
Need a...? Need a little hand there?
Oh, no, no, no. No, I got this all under control.
You really don't seem like you do.
God. Forget it! Oh, this is...
This is not how this was supposed to happen.
What was supposed to happen?
Can you not look at me when I say this?
I thought that if I could get you here...
...I could seduce you.
Uh, I don't wear suits to work...
...and I bought six of them from you.
Well, I'm sorry. I thought you needed them.
My point is, I kept coming back because I wanted to see you.
Why? - Because I like you.
You like me?
Yeah.
I mean, you're beautiful and smart and sophisticated.
A lot of this isn't, you know, based on tonight.
But you like me?
Oh, my God. I can't believe this. All this time, I liked you and you liked me.
Oh!
But... - No don't say "but."
"But" is never good. Let's leave it at "I like you and you like me."
Okay, uh...
However... - No, that's a fancy "but."
My marriage, like, just ended.
And I'm really not ready to get into anything yet.
But...
I'm sorry. I just need a little time.
Okay.
Oh, there you are. I was looking for you before.
Joshua's gone, so you and Emily are free to go.
It's okay.
She's still in there enjoying her fake party.
And, uh, it's too late to do any of the stuff I had planned, so...
Ross.
I'm sorry. I completely ruined your evening.
Ahem. Yeah.
Well, if it makes you feel any better, I made a fool of myself.
Helps a little.
Is there a room on that step for a pathetic loser?
Yeah, have a seat.
I'm so sorry.
It's okay.
I mean, it was just a two-week thing anyway.
I just didn't want it to end this way, you know.
Or maybe you didn't want it to end?
What do you mean?
You seem to really like her.
Yeah, I really do.
Yeah, but what am I gonna do?
We both agreed it was gonna be a two-week thing.
You know? No commitment.
Ross?
That girl just spent the entire evening talking to your friends...
...asking to hear stories about you...
...looking through Monica's photo albums.
I mean, you don't do that if you're just in it for two weeks.
You think?
You've got, like, 14 hours until she has to be at the airport.
And you're sitting here in a hallway...
...with a 28-year-old cheerleader with a fat lip.
Hey, you're right. - Yeah.
Thanks.
What photo album was it?
I don't know. It was you and a bunch of albino kids.
Oh, my God. Those weren't albino kids.
That was computer camp. Rach.
Hey. - Hey.
You're a pathetic loser, right? - Oh, yeah.
Hi.
Oh, my God. Joshua.
Look.
All those things I said about not being ready...
They're not true? - No, they're all true.
But...
Oh, I love that "but."
Um, do you want to go inside and get some coffee?
Yeah. - Okay.
Every time.
Ooh, what do you got there? - Pastrami.
Yeah.
Hey, you know what goes good with that? - Mm-hm. Corned beef.
Ooh, I was going to say bologna. But that's better.
How about a little of that smoked turkey? - Okay.
Oh, Mama.
When is the baby due? - Six months.
Hey, now, if a cow should die of natural causes...
...I could have one of those, right?
Not if I get there first.
