sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝居然想吃红肠 宝宝想吃肉
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. The baby wants bologna. The baby wants me to eat meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能吃肉 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: I can't eat meat. - Uh, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是腌黄瓜
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's the pickle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在写什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you writing?

sense_groups.chinese: 约书亚明天要来…
sense_groups.english: Well, Joshua's coming in tomorrow...

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我没胆约他
sense_groups.english: ...and since I don't have the guts to ask him out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定卖他一件外套 再把纸条塞进口袋
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna sell him a coat and put this note in the pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: "约书亚 有空打电话给我 你这样的人…
sense_groups.english: "Joshua, give me a call sometime. Guys like you...

sense_groups.chinese: 永不退流行"
sense_groups.english: ...never go out of style."

sense_groups.chinese: 你扔了哪些话？
sense_groups.english: What did you throw away?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 - 你们做了什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, guys. - Hey, what have you guys been up to?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去看维多利亚时期门把展
sense_groups.english: Oh, we went to see a collection of Victorian doorknobs at the Cooper-Hewitt museum.

sense_groups.chinese: 没找我去？
sense_groups.english: Without me?

sense_groups.chinese: 是舅舅拖我们去的 结果很有意思
sense_groups.english: My uncle dragged us there, but actually it turned out to be interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 那些门把很华丽
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - They were so ornate and beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看
sense_groups.english: I mean, look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道英国的国情
sense_groups.english: I don't know how museums work in England...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这里不能顺手牵羊
sense_groups.english: ...but here, you're not supposed to take stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是礼品部的
sense_groups.english: I, uh... I got it from the gift shop.

sense_groups.chinese: 那里没什么防盗措施
sense_groups.english: They have really lax security there.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是笑话
sense_groups.english: It's a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了 再见啰
sense_groups.english: Right, I've got to be off. I'll see you. Bye-bye, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见啰
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们相处得很愉快
sense_groups.english: Wow. Hey, you guys seem to be having a good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她人很棒 而且很有趣
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, she is amazing, and she's so much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她在一起时 我也很有趣
sense_groups.english: And you know what? When I'm with her, I'm fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至报名学开直升机
sense_groups.english: I even signed up for helicopter classes.

sense_groups.chinese: 她过两天就走了 我不必真学
sense_groups.english: She's leaving in two days. I don't have to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 两天？你一定很失望 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Aw, two days? You must be bummed. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 她非回去伦敦不可
sense_groups.english: She's got to go back to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我早就有心理准备
sense_groups.english: But you know what? I've been prepared for this from the start.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都知道我们只有这两星期
sense_groups.english: We both knew we had two weeks together and then that's it, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的每段恋情都是
sense_groups.english: Hey, that's what all my relationships are like.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯他们是"双方"都知道 只有两星期
sense_groups.english: Yes, but in Ross' case, they both know in two weeks that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝好啊 - 好啦
sense_groups.english: Hello, hello. - Yeah, I know. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝想肉想疯了
sense_groups.english: So the baby is totally craving meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 下午我想用素肉堡骗他…
sense_groups.english: This afternoon, I tried tricking it.

sense_groups.chinese: 让他以为他吃到肉
sense_groups.english: I made it a soy burger so that maybe it'd think it was getting meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果就反胃了
sense_groups.english: You know? And I got nauseous.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是因为素肉堡粉难吃
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe that's because soy burgers suck.

sense_groups.chinese: 怀孕真难吃东西
sense_groups.english: Being pregnant is hard on your tummy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你有一种孕妇的光彩
sense_groups.english: Hey, but at least you got that cool, pregnant-lady glow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要是吐一早上也会有光彩
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's sweat. You throw up all morning, you'll have that glow too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 这是你要的风衣
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Uh, here's that trench coat you wanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 很舒服 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Wow, yeah, it's comfortable. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可以用来装变态
sense_groups.english: Man, you could really flash somebody in this thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 出了店门
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. They don't want you to put your hands in the pockets...

sense_groups.chinese: 才能把手放进口袋里
sense_groups.english: ...until you are out of the store.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为…
sense_groups.english: Well, because...

sense_groups.chinese: 有很多人…
sense_groups.english: ...we get a lot of...

sense_groups.chinese: 真是害群之马
sense_groups.english: You know, they ruin it for everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨晚穿那件 喀什米尔毛衣去约会
sense_groups.english: You know, I wore that cashmere sweater on a date last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 我离婚后第一次约会
sense_groups.english: Oh. - It was the first date since the divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 你爱她吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, congratulations. So do you love her?

sense_groups.chinese: 她还不错 不过我也发现
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. She's nice, but, you know, it made me realize...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有心情约会
sense_groups.english: ...I'm just not ready to be dating, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 真有意思
sense_groups.english: That's, uh... That's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 只是防盗磁条
sense_groups.english: What was that? - Oh, that's just an antitheft device.

sense_groups.chinese: 那这是什么？
sense_groups.english: Then what's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个也要 因为这个一撕就碎
sense_groups.english: Well, you need that too, because obviously a thief could just tear this up.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚上有派对
sense_groups.english: Listen, we have to have a party tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是5分钟后 有事快取消
sense_groups.english: We have to have one in five minutes, so everybody cancel your plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？ - 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, what's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要帮艾蜜莉办惊喜欢送会
sense_groups.english: We have to have a surprise bon-voyage party for Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是为了约书亚
sense_groups.english: But it's actually for Joshua.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他还没有心情约会
sense_groups.english: Look, he said he's not ready to date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得找他参加派对 才能在工作之外见到他
sense_groups.english: So I had to invite him to a party if I wanted to see him outside work.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我制造了一个色诱他的完美机会
sense_groups.english: And now I have created the perfect opportunity to seduce him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想当面警告约书亚
sense_groups.english: Well, as much as I'd like to meet Josh and warn him...

sense_groups.chinese: 但艾蜜莉和我不能参加
sense_groups.english: ...Emily and I aren't gonna be here, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 她会来说声再见
sense_groups.english: She's gonna come by first to say goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我安排了整晚的节目 对不起 没戏唱了
sense_groups.english: And then I've got a whole special evening planned. So sorry. No party.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人吗？ - 惊喜
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 惊喜 惊喜
sense_groups.english: Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人替我办过惊喜派对
sense_groups.english: No one's ever thrown me a surprise party before.

sense_groups.chinese: 这都是罗斯的主意
sense_groups.english: Well, it was all Ross' idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好
sense_groups.english: You're so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好惊喜喔
sense_groups.english: And I'm so surprised.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的没料到？
sense_groups.english: You really didn't know?

sense_groups.chinese: 演员在…
sense_groups.english: There's dancin'

sense_groups.chinese: 电影场景背后
sense_groups.english: Behind movie scenes

sense_groups.chinese: 约书亚在那边 你怎么在这边？
sense_groups.english: Why are you over here if Joshua's all the way over there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想假装很难上手
sense_groups.english: Uh, because I'm trying to play hard-to-get.

sense_groups.chinese: 快 说句好笑的话
sense_groups.english: Oh, quick. He's looking over here. Say something funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 举个例？ - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Like what? - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事这么好笑？
sense_groups.english: What's so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"举个例"
sense_groups.english: I said, "Like what?"

sense_groups.chinese: 真深奥
sense_groups.english: Now that's a thinker.

sense_groups.chinese: 假装很难上手没用
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? This playing-hard-to-get thing is not working.

sense_groups.chinese: 把樱桃给我 好…
sense_groups.english: Uh, hand me those cherries. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 要吃樱桃吗？ - 不要 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Care for a cherry? - No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以用舌头把樱桃梗打结
sense_groups.english: You know, I can tie one of these into a knot using just my tongue.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: You okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事吧？
sense_groups.english: You all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得赶快走了
sense_groups.english: So we should probably get going soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是派对才刚开始
sense_groups.english: Oh, but the party's only just getting started.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得在15分钟内 赶去四季赛厅喝酒
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but we have to be at The Four Seasons for drinks in, oh, 15 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后去广场饭店吃晚饭
sense_groups.english: And then, uh, you know, then the Plaza for dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么还办派对？
sense_groups.english: So why did you plan a party at the same time?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实美国的惊喜派对都很短
sense_groups.english: Actually, American surprise parties are very short.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常都"惊喜" 然后就"我好惊喜喔 再见"
sense_groups.english: It's usually, "Surprise!" Then, "Oh, my God, I'm so surprised. Goodbye."

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我觉得好好玩
sense_groups.english: Ross, I'm having such a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妹说你以前会扮成老太太
sense_groups.english: Your sister has just been telling me that you used to dressed up like old ladies...

sense_groups.chinese: 举办假的茶会
sense_groups.english: ...and host make-believe tea parties.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡说的是吧？
sense_groups.english: Monica said that, did she?

sense_groups.chinese: 好赞 你接下来要放什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Then what are you going to put on top of that?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点蒜味肉肠 赞
sense_groups.english: A little salami. - Ooh, yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒜味肉肠上面呢？
sense_groups.english: Then, um, what goes on top of the salami?

sense_groups.chinese: 燻牛肉 太赞了
sense_groups.english: Pastrami. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是天才
sense_groups.english: You're a genius.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我扛一下拉链
sense_groups.english: Can someone give me a hand with the zipper.

sense_groups.chinese: 往上拉
sense_groups.english: Up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你换衣服？对 我需要我的幸运裙
sense_groups.english: You changed? - Yeah, I just needed my lucky dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸运是指露更多乳沟？我觉得是
sense_groups.english: And "lucky" means "more cleavage"? - Does for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看他多帅
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, look at him. He's so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想一把捉过来亲下去
sense_groups.english: I just want to go over there and grab him and kiss him.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他不知道我喜欢他
sense_groups.english: How could I kiss him without letting him know that I like him?

sense_groups.chinese: 有个办法 脱胸罩
sense_groups.english: Hey, I know how you can get him. Take off your bra.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 在《浑身是劲》里… - 是《闪舞》
sense_groups.english: There was a scene in Footloose... - Flashdance.

sense_groups.chinese: 对… 那个水电女工？ - 是悍接工
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. Yeah, with that plumber girl? - She was a welder.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是有演吗？
sense_groups.english: Were you, like, in the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 她在衣服底下脱掉胸罩
sense_groups.english: Anyway, she takes off her bra under the shirt...

sense_groups.chinese: 从袖子抽出来
sense_groups.english: ...and pulls it out the sleeve.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常性感 而且有格调
sense_groups.english: Very sexy. And classy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然你也可以用树寄生
sense_groups.english: Or if you wanna kiss him, um, you could use mistletoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 又不是圣诞节
sense_groups.english: It's not Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 转瓶子 - 他不是小孩子
sense_groups.english: Or spin the bottle. - And he's not 11.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们 你们真用心
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much for this. It was really so thoughtful of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要走了？
sense_groups.english: You're leaving?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们还有事 - 我也要走了
sense_groups.english: Yes, we have something we have to get to. - Uh, yeah, I think I'm gonna take off too.

sense_groups.chinese: 先别走 留下来
sense_groups.english: No, you guys, you can't leave yet. You have to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们准备了重头戏
sense_groups.english: We've got the whole big thing planned.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么重头戏？
sense_groups.english: What big thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 转瓶子的规则是
sense_groups.english: So, Spin-The-Bottle works like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我转瓶子
sense_groups.english: I spin the bottle.

sense_groups.chinese: 指向阿甘 我就要亲阿甘
sense_groups.english: Lands on Gunther, so I would have to kiss Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要先？
sense_groups.english: Who wants to go first?

sense_groups.chinese: 我先
sense_groups.english: I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎来到美国
sense_groups.english: Welcome to America.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 连续两次 来个舌吻吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, my gosh. Two in a row. You gotta use your tongues now.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 太巧了
sense_groups.english: What are the odds? What are the odds?

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's enough, you know. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 让别人玩吧
sense_groups.english: Let's let someone else play.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想玩干嘛来？
sense_groups.english: Hey, if you didn't want to play, then why'd you come to the party?

sense_groups.chinese: 该我
sense_groups.english: Okay, my turn.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你
sense_groups.english: Oh! Look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 宝宝踢了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. The baby just kicked.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会再踢的
sense_groups.english: It's okay, it's okay. If it kicked once, it'll kick again.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家要记住刚才的位置
sense_groups.english: All right, well, everybody just remember where they were sitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 有虫
sense_groups.english: It was a bug.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管我多想吃
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter how much I'm craving it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝不吃肉 那是冷血谋杀
sense_groups.english: You know why I'm never gonna eat meat? Because it's cold-blooded murder.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的三明治上有菲比
sense_groups.english: There's a Phoebe on my sandwich.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你干什么？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法
sense_groups.english: I can't help it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要吃肉 宝宝要吃肉
sense_groups.english: I need the meat. The baby needs the meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟别人交往要专一
sense_groups.english: You know how when you're dating someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 除非第三者真的很辣
sense_groups.english: ...and you don't want to cheat on them unless it's with someone really hot?

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然 - 这就对了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, totally. - All right, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃肉也一样
sense_groups.english: Well, this is the same kind of deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 要错…
sense_groups.english: If you're gonna do something wrong...

sense_groups.chinese: 就要错得漂亮
sense_groups.english: ...do it right.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉好多了吗？
sense_groups.english: Feel better?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是代价呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but at what cost?

sense_groups.chinese: 三餐吃肉吃半年？我会吃掉…
sense_groups.english: Six more months, three meals a day?

sense_groups.chinese: 几百万头牛
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna eat like, you know, millions of cows.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我帮你平衡过来呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what if I said I could even things out for you, meat-wise?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我很会吃肉对吧？对
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, I eat a lot of meat, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 要是在宝宝出生前
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - But suppose, until the baby's born...

sense_groups.chinese: 我戒吃肉
sense_groups.english: ...I laid off it.

sense_groups.chinese: 就不会多死动物 你是在吃我的那份
sense_groups.english: No extra animals would die. You'd just be eating my animals.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然愿意为我这么做
sense_groups.english: Joey, I can't believe you'd do that for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然愿意 我也可以吃素
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. I could be a vegetarian.

sense_groups.chinese: 啤酒里没有肉吧？
sense_groups.english: There's no meat in beer, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不吃开胃菜 马上买单
sense_groups.english: Okay, we can still make dinner if we skip the appetizers...

sense_groups.chinese: 还赶得上吃主菜
sense_groups.english: ...and ask for our check right away.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在不能走 瑞秋要表演
sense_groups.english: We can't go now. Looks like Rachel is going to put on a skit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Have you lost your mind?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我终于想通了
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I am finally thinking clearly.

sense_groups.chinese: 去看他是不是真的觉得 超级名模都太瘦
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna find out if he really thinks supermodels are too skinny.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们反应如何？
sense_groups.english: How'd it go with Frank and Alice?

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克得休学
sense_groups.english: Frank has to quit college...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为很能生的姐姐一次怀三胎
sense_groups.english: ...because his super-fertile sister is having three babies. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得赚快钱
sense_groups.english: I need to make a lot of money really fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟你谈一个想法
sense_groups.english: And I had an idea that I wanted to talk to you about...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你在大公司上班
sense_groups.english: ...because you work for a big company. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 内线交易
sense_groups.english: Insider trading.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么内慕可以给我？
sense_groups.english: What information is there that you can give me?

sense_groups.chinese: 大头不会跟我们讲这些
sense_groups.english: Well, actually, they don't really talk to us about that stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我可以帮你立可白
sense_groups.english: I can get you some free White-Out, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有照我说的告诉她吗？
sense_groups.english: Huh! Did you do what I said? Did you tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 - 她怎么说？
sense_groups.english: I did. - And what did she say?

sense_groups.chinese: "谢谢"
sense_groups.english: "Thank you."

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 她说什么？
sense_groups.english: You're totally welcome. What'd she say?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说"谢谢"
sense_groups.english: She said, "Thank you."

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"我爱你"
sense_groups.english: I said, "I love you."

sense_groups.chinese: 她说"谢谢"
sense_groups.english: And she said, "Thank you."

sense_groups.chinese: 不对啊 你说你爱她？
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. Did you say you love her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想骗她做什么？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, what were you trying to get her to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What do I do now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你假装很难钓
sense_groups.english: You play hard-to-get.

sense_groups.chinese: 她已经住在伦敦了
sense_groups.english: She already lives in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 你搬去东京
sense_groups.english: So you go to Tokyo.

sense_groups.chinese: 别想了
sense_groups.english: All right, look, forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你爱她 没戏唱了
sense_groups.english: Okay, forget it. You told her you love her. It's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说的 你才没戏唱
sense_groups.english: It is not over. You're over.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你懂我的意思
sense_groups.english: You know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 说得好
sense_groups.english: Good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情还没完 她会打来说她爱你
sense_groups.english: It's not over because she's gonna call you and tell you she loves you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的感觉强烈到今她害怕
sense_groups.english: The reason why she couldn't is because her feelings were so strong that it scared her.

sense_groups.chinese: 快回去等电话
sense_groups.english: Now, you go home and you wait for her call.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能会从飞机上打 快去 好
sense_groups.english: She could be calling you from the plane. Come on, go.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她没打来 那就是结束了
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. But if she doesn't call, it is definitely over.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非最后我打给她探探口风
sense_groups.english: No, wait, wait. Unless, eventually, I call her, you know, to see what's going on...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她会再打给我 结果没打
sense_groups.english: ...and she says she'll call me back, but then she doesn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就真的结束了
sense_groups.english: Then it's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 真够力
sense_groups.english: Way to be strong, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以在这里看卡通吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, can we watch cartoons on your television?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要休息一下
sense_groups.english: We need a porn break.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们看了2小时的 《杀进杀出又杀进》
sense_groups.english: We spent the last two hours watching In and Out and In Again.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不关掉算了？
sense_groups.english: Well, so why don't you just turn it off?

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们会变成关掉A片的白痴
sense_groups.english: Because then we'd be the guys who turned off free porn.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你们都在
sense_groups.english: Oh, good, you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你手上拿什么？
sense_groups.english: What you got there?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个？问得好
sense_groups.english: Oh, this? Well, I'm glad you asked.

sense_groups.chinese: 用普通刀子切锡罐
sense_groups.english: Now, don't you hate it when you have to cut a tin can...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是很难切吗？
sense_groups.english: ...with an ordinary steak knife?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们在想什么
sense_groups.english: Now, I know what you're thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: "孕妇发狂砍杀四人"？
sense_groups.english: Pregnant woman slays four?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没买下这些刀子吧？
sense_groups.english: They didn't make you pay for those knives, did they?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 你确定？
sense_groups.english: No. - Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 卖刀赚不了多少钱的
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna make enough money to help Frank and Alice by selling knives.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: No, no. I know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只需要后续计划的本钱
sense_groups.english: But I just need to make enough money for the second part of my plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 后续计划是什么？ - 经销废弃物处理设备
sense_groups.english: What's the second part of your plan? - My Saturn dealership.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 旅途还顺利吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, how was your flight?

sense_groups.chinese: 很惨
sense_groups.english: It was dreadful.

sense_groups.chinese: 真抱歉你对我告白 我的反应却那么差劲
sense_groups.english: Uh, I felt terrible about how I acted when you said those wonderful things.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, no, that's all right. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你打来
sense_groups.english: I'm just glad you called.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我有事要告诉你
sense_groups.english: Ross, um, there's something that I've got to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有男朋友了
sense_groups.english: There's someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 这句话在英国的意思 跟在美国一样吗？
sense_groups.english: Does that mean the same thing in England as it does in America?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不知道她想要谁
sense_groups.english: She doesn't know which one of us she wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是那个柯林
sense_groups.english: Me or this "Colin" guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 原本明明很完美 现在都乱了 怎么会有第三者
sense_groups.english: This isn't how it was supposed to go. I mean, there can't be another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有第三者
sense_groups.english: Of course there's another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样更完美
sense_groups.english: Heh. This is even more perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你得证明你的爱
sense_groups.english: Now you have to prove your love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么也不证明 我不会再听你的了
sense_groups.english: I'm not proving anything, okay? I'm done listening to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是被你说服跑去机场
sense_groups.english: If I hadn't let you talk me into going to the airport in the first place...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不会搞到去槌墙
sense_groups.english: ...I wouldn't have put my fist through the wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 你槌墙？
sense_groups.english: You put your fist through the wall?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果没打中 打到门
sense_groups.english: No, I missed and hit the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过门弹得很用力
sense_groups.english: But it opened really hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得去伦敦 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You have to go to London. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得去争取她
sense_groups.english: Yep. You have to go fight for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 有道理
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, sure. That makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你爱她 她没有回应
sense_groups.english: Because you already told her you loved her, and she didn't say it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后她打来说有男朋友
sense_groups.english: Then she called you and told you there was another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 去伦敦吧 她会被吓死
sense_groups.english: So yeah. Go to London. That will scare her.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋跟保罗在一起时 你做了什么？
sense_groups.english: When Rachel was with Paolo, what did you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我嘲笑他的口音
sense_groups.english: I made fun of his accent.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让他轻松得手 你完全没争取 没错吧？
sense_groups.english: You sat back and let him have her. You didn't fight at all. Am I right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想让艾蜜莉也被抢走？
sense_groups.english: You want the same thing to happen with Emily?

sense_groups.chinese: 不想 - 好
sense_groups.english: No. - All right, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就去争取她 飞去伦敦
sense_groups.english: Go fight for her. Go to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和艾蜜莉也可以那样
sense_groups.english: I mean, that could be you and Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 比他们唯美
sense_groups.english: That, but nicer.

sense_groups.chinese: 飞去伦敦
sense_groups.english: Just go to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 快点
sense_groups.english: Really? - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 到她家门口 给她惊喜 别把她拱手让人
sense_groups.english: Surprise her. Show up at her doorstep. Don't let her go without a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 就这么决定 - 好的
sense_groups.english: All right. All right. I'm going to do it. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去伦敦争取她
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to London, and I am gonna fight for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 加油
sense_groups.english: Okay. Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你到了机场
sense_groups.english: Ross, Ross. If you're going to the airport...

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能帮我买特大三角巧克力
sense_groups.english: ...can you pick me up another one of those Toblerone bars?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想到了 我想到赚钱的路子了
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, I did it. I did it. I figured out a way to make money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要开按摩院 找法兰克帮忙
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna open up my own massage place and Frank's gonna help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 配合他的时问 他就不必休学
sense_groups.english: And we can work it around his schedule, so he doesn't have to quit school.

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 但你哪来的钱？
sense_groups.english: That sounds great. But how can you afford it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走在路上
sense_groups.english: We were walking down the street...

sense_groups.chinese: 看见你们办外烩的小巴
sense_groups.english: ...and we saw that van you used for catering.

sense_groups.chinese: 就想到… - 我要说啦
sense_groups.english: And we realized... - I'm telling it. I'm telling it.

sense_groups.chinese: 人们需要交通工具
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know how people need transportation...

sense_groups.chinese: 也需要按摩放松
sense_groups.english: ...but they also need massages to relax?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以结合两者 我按摩 法兰克开车
sense_groups.english: So I just figured we could combine the two. Okay, I give the massages and Frank drives.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在小巴里装个桌子 结果就是什么？
sense_groups.english: I can fix up the van, bolt the table in the back and you know what I've got?

sense_groups.chinese: 有进无出的死亡小巴？
sense_groups.english: A place that no one will ever get out of alive?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 你们想嘛 就是给想放松的人搭的计程车
sense_groups.english: No, think about it. It's a taxi that people take when they need to relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫做轻松任你行
sense_groups.english: It's a Relaxi-Taxi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最想讲的就是名字
sense_groups.english: The name was my favorite part.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我想出来的 - 你乱讲
sense_groups.english: Well, I came up with it. - You did not!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想的是轻松之行 点也不好
sense_groups.english: No. You came up with Relaxi-Cab. That's not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗斯 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hello? ROSS - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你在英国吗？艾蜜莉惊喜吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Ross, are you in England? Was Emily surprised?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 因为她还没回家
sense_groups.english: No, because she hasn't come home yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 她整晚都没回家
sense_groups.english: And she hasn't been home all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 显然是跟另一个人在一起
sense_groups.english: She's obviously staying with that other guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我则是在这里守夜的白痴
sense_groups.english: And I'm the stupid moron who spent the whole night outside her apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 下班飞机是几点？
sense_groups.english: All right, when is the next flight out?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约4小时后
sense_groups.english: About four hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 再等一下 如果她还不出现就回来
sense_groups.english: Okay, just stay there a couple more hours. If she doesn't show up, come home.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他轻松任你行的事
sense_groups.english: Hey, tell him about Relaxi-Taxi.

sense_groups.chinese: 问他是不是比轻松之行好
sense_groups.english: And ask him if he thinks that is better than Relaxi-Cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是轻松之行 是轻松车行 正像计程车行
sense_groups.english: It's not Relaxi-Cab. It's Relaxi-Cab. Like Taxi-Cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个比较好
sense_groups.english: Ooh, that is better.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是伦敦吗？
sense_groups.english: Are we in London?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么在这里？你不能在这里
sense_groups.english: Why are you doing here? You can't be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有话要对罗斯说
sense_groups.english: I've come to talk to Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Nothing. No, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来想打给他
sense_groups.english: I was gonna call him...

sense_groups.chinese: 你来说你爱他 我就知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, you came to tell him you love him. I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是对的 我是对的吧？
sense_groups.english: I was right! I'm right, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想跟他谈
sense_groups.english: I'd really rather talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去过他家 他不在
sense_groups.english: I've been to his apartment and he's not there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得跟他谈谈
sense_groups.english: And I need to talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道他在哪里吗？
sense_groups.english: So do you have any idea where he is?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你在吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, are you there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得你听不听得见 不过我就说了
sense_groups.english: Ross, I don't know if you can hear this, but I'm gonna talk anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在美国 跟你的妹妹和朋友在一起
sense_groups.english: I'm in the States with your sister and your friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟柯林分手了
sense_groups.english: And it's all over with Colin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来告诉你这件事 还有…
sense_groups.english: I came here to tell you that and to tell you...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你想要巧克力就拿吧
sense_groups.english: Yes, Joey, you can have all the chocolate you want. Just take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来告诉你… 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I came here to tell you that I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就打公共电话给你
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna call you right now from the phone booth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听不见
sense_groups.english: You can't hear me.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想知道你听不听得见
sense_groups.english: I wish I could know if you'd heard any of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是刚告白完 就是给了邻居笑柄
sense_groups.english: I suppose I've either told you that I love you or given my neighbors a good laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 纽曼太太 如果你在听 滚开 不关你的事
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Newman, if you're listening, bugger off. This is none of your business.

sense_groups.chinese: 你八成听不见
sense_groups.english: Suppose there's not much chance you did hear that.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且有电话进来了
sense_groups.english: And there's the call waiting...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得挂了…
sense_groups.english: ...so I should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样
sense_groups.english: Oh, well.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Ross, I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才去银行 有个很辣的行员
sense_groups.english: I was just at the bank and there was this really hot teller.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有找我去金库嘿咻
sense_groups.english: And she didn't ask me to go do it with her in the vault.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Same kind of thing happened to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 彼萨外送小妹来
sense_groups.english: Woman pizza delivery guy comes over...

sense_groups.chinese: 放下披萨收了钱就走了
sense_groups.english: ...gives me the pizza, takes the money and leaves.

sense_groups.chinese: 没说"你家好漂亮 卧房一定很大吧？"
sense_groups.english: What, no "Nice apartment, bet the bedrooms are huge"?

sense_groups.chinese: 完全没有
sense_groups.english: No, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我们得把A片关掉
sense_groups.english: You know what? We have to turn off the porn.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对
sense_groups.english: I think you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 一 - 二
sense_groups.english: One. - Two.

sense_groups.chinese: 三 - 三
sense_groups.english: Three. - Three.

sense_groups.chinese: 蛮好的
sense_groups.english: That's kind of nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 有种解脱感
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's kind of a relief.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不想看它还在不在？ - 想
sense_groups.english: You want to see if we still have it? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 免费A片 我们有免费A片
sense_groups.english: Free porn! We have free porn!

sense_groups.english: ...if what you need him for is that you're really hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: What do you say? What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟心爱的人同名的想法很好
sense_groups.english: Well, I like the idea of naming him after someone I love.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊和钱德都是很棒的名字
sense_groups.english: And Joey and Chandler are both great names.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不…
sense_groups.english: All right, I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是就叫绿巨人好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe I will just name him The Hulk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该提的 我想留给我小孩用
sense_groups.english: I knew I shouldn't have mentioned it. That's what I wanted to name my kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你想跟约书亚上床…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon? If you were hoping to sleep with Joshua for the first time tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 会穿哪一件？
sense_groups.english: ...which one of these would you want to be wearing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得帮别人挑性感睡衣很怪
sense_groups.english: You know what? It really creeps me out choosing other people's sex clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我太兴奋了
sense_groups.english: Sorry. I'm just so excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等了好几个月 我跑去染发
sense_groups.english: I've been waiting for this for months. I got my hair colored.

sense_groups.chinese: 换了床单 还帮他煮大餐
sense_groups.english: I got new sheets. I'm making him a very fancy meal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在煮什么？
sense_groups.english: What am I making him, by the way?

sense_groups.chinese: 什锦沙拉 有羊酪 松子
sense_groups.english: Well, you're making him a frisée salad with goat cheese and pine nuts...

sense_groups.chinese: 菰米饭 烤庐笋和鲑鱼面包丁
sense_groups.english: ...wild rice, roasted asparagus and salmon en croute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要做腓力牛排？
sense_groups.english: I thought I was making him filet mignon.

sense_groups.chinese: 本来是 但餐厅的鲑鱼有剩 所以你决定煮鲑鱼
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you were, but you decided to make salmon because you had some left over.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你想到要是你抱怨 "你"就会罢煮
sense_groups.english: And then you realized if you bitched about it, then you would stop cooking...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就得上烤马铃薯加健怡可乐
sense_groups.english: ...and you would have to make your famous baked potato and Diet Coke.

sense_groups.chinese: "我"煮菜时火气真大
sense_groups.english: Wow, I really get crabby when I cook.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉昨晚打电话来
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Emily called last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在才转告我？
sense_groups.english: And now you're giving me the message?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果艾蜜莉爱死苏珊了
sense_groups.english: Turns out that Emily is just crazy about Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们一起去看戏
sense_groups.english: Yeah. They're going to the theater together.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们一起吃晚饭
sense_groups.english: They're going to dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们一起去骑马
sense_groups.english: They're going horseback riding.

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊真会玩
sense_groups.english: God, Susan is so fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个情节太熟悉了一点
sense_groups.english: Look, this is just a little too familiar.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和卡萝分手前整整半年
sense_groups.english: Okay, for, like, six months before Carol and I split up...

sense_groups.chinese: 我整天只听到 "我朋友苏珊好聪明"
sense_groups.english: ...all I heard was, "My friend Susan is so smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友苏珊好风趣 我朋友苏珊好棒"
sense_groups.english: My friend Susan is so funny. My friend Susan is so great."

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得艾蜜莉和苏珊 会擦出火花？
sense_groups.english: You actually think that something could happen between Emily and Susan?

sense_groups.chinese: 她们一起上健身房耶
sense_groups.english: Hey, they're going to the gym together.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个女人…
sense_groups.english: Two women...

sense_groups.chinese: 劈腿拉筋
sense_groups.english: ...stretching.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们洗蒸汽浴 开始互相逗弄
sense_groups.english: You know, they take a steam together, things get a little playful.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没看过《登峰造极》吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you see Personal Best?

sense_groups.chinese: 没 但我一定要看
sense_groups.english: No, but I'm gonna.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生 你疯了
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi. You're crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是艾蜜莉 艾蜜莉是异性恋
sense_groups.english: Okay, this is Emily. Emily is straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: How do you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们原先也以为卡萝是异性恋
sense_groups.english: I mean, we thought Carol was straight before I married her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我肯定不喜欢罗斯这个名字
sense_groups.english: Yeah, definitely. I don't like the name Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你落井下石的方式还真怪
sense_groups.english: What a weird way to kick me when I'm down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说宝宝的名字
sense_groups.english: No, no, I just meant for the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯有什么不好？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 绿巨人就不会…
sense_groups.english: It's just, you know, something like this...

sense_groups.chinese: 遇上这种事
sense_groups.english: ...would never happen to The Hulk, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说的
sense_groups.english: Actually, that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 《绿巨人》第72集里 布鲁斯班纳博士发现…
sense_groups.english: In The Incredible Hulk, number 72, Dr. Bruce Banner found...

sense_groups.chinese: 不重要 我女朋友是同性恋
sense_groups.english: You know, never mind. My girlfriend's a lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定不是乔伊就是钱德
sense_groups.english: So I decided I'm definitely gonna go with either Joey or Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要选乔伊
sense_groups.english: You gotta pick Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 有哪个名人叫钱德？
sense_groups.english: I mean, name one famous person named Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 雷蒙钱德勒 - 你捏造的人不算
sense_groups.english: Raymond Chandler. - Someone you didn't make up.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊才没有名人 除了…
sense_groups.english: Okay, there are no famous Joeys. Except for, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊巴塔富寇
sense_groups.english: ...Joey Buttafuoco.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的确是我们的心头之痛 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that guy really hurt us. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 加起来除以二如何？例如…
sense_groups.english: Well, how about a compromise then? Okay, what if it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱道伊？
sense_groups.english: ...you know, Chan-no-ey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？你想嘛 他绝对当不上总统
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, Joey? Come on, think about it. He'll never be president.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对不会出现乔伊总统
sense_groups.english: I mean, there's never gonna be a President Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我本来不想提的
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I didn't want to bring this up.

sense_groups.chinese: 但钱德是我听过最蠢的名字
sense_groups.english: But Chandler is the stupidest name I've heard in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 它根本不是名字 连个词都不是
sense_groups.english: It's not even a name. It's barely even a word.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有点接近钱包 但又不是
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's kind of like chandelier but it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 它是个蠢到爆的非名字
sense_groups.english: All right? It's a stupid, stupid, non-name.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我的名字烂透了
sense_groups.english: You're right. I have a horrible, horrible name.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我不是… 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, man. I didn't... I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以就是乔伊罗
sense_groups.english: So I guess it's Joey, then. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 真好 谢谢你这么费心
sense_groups.english: This is so nice. Thank you for doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气 烹饪能舒缓我的心
sense_groups.english: Oh. Please. Cooking soothes me.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: So dig in. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来都好好吃 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Well, it all looks so good. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 天哪 这个饭好…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know. My God, this rice is so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的手艺真好
sense_groups.english: I am so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你后面
sense_groups.english: Behind you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 他们以前住这里 有时会迁徙回来
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, sorry. They used to live here, and sometimes they migrate back over.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能让他们不要在这里
sense_groups.english: Is there, uh...? Is there some way that they could, uh, not be here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我最怕家禽了
sense_groups.english: It's just that, uh, farm birds really kind of freak me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 出去
sense_groups.english: Here we go. Here we go. Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 出去
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么会敲门？
sense_groups.english: Hey. How'd you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 进来
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 都走了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: All gone. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 家禽是吧？
sense_groups.english: So, farm birds, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只有这个怪癖 我发誓
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's my only weird thing, I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道会有鸡鸭 否则我会告诉你
sense_groups.english: And I would have told you about it but I didn't know that they'd be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要来点…
sense_groups.english: So can I serve you a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What, what, what?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 只是我知道他们还在
sense_groups.english: Nothing. Uh, it's just that I know that they're still out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在对门 隔着两道墙
sense_groups.english: They're across the hall. I mean, that's two doors away.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们得啄很久才能把墙啄穿
sense_groups.english: It's gonna take them a long time to peck their way back over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不好笑
sense_groups.english: That's not funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 那要不要换个地方？
sense_groups.english: Would you feel better if we went someplace else?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以把东西打包去你家
sense_groups.english: I mean, we could pack all this stuff up and, you know, go to your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我家正在装修 一团混乱
sense_groups.english: Oh, they're working on it this week. It's a mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们可以去我父母家
sense_groups.english: But, uh, I'm staying at my parents' house. We could go there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你父母家？ - 对 他们出国了
sense_groups.english: Your parents'? - They're out of town.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那里地方很大
sense_groups.english: It's a huge place, and it's got this gorgeous view of the park.

sense_groups.chinese: 视野很棒 会很浪漫
sense_groups.english: It'd be very, very romantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 如何？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: What do you say? - Yeah, that works.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们闻得出恐惧
sense_groups.english: They can smell the fear.

sense_groups.chinese: 班好吗？
sense_groups.english: How's Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 我问他要不要吃东西 他说不要
sense_groups.english: Well, I asked him if he wanted to eat. He said no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问他要不要睡觉 他说不要
sense_groups.english: I asked him if he wanted to sleep. He said no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问他想做什么 他说不要
sense_groups.english: I asked what he wanted to do. He said no.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他在扫地
sense_groups.english: So he's sweeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 有苏珊的消.急吗？
sense_groups.english: So, um, any word from Susan?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她跟艾蜜莉玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: Ooh, yeah, she said she's having so much fun with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你有没有想过
sense_groups.english: Uh, by the by, did it ever occur to you that...

sense_groups.chinese: 她们或许太开心了一点？
sense_groups.english: ...I don't know, maybe they might be having a little too much fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么叫太开心？
sense_groups.english: What's too much fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们结婚时 你和苏珊的那种闭心
sense_groups.english: You know, the kind of fun you and Susan had when we were married.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你真会乱想
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You are so paranoid.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是
sense_groups.english: Am I? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉我不知道
sense_groups.english: I can't speak for Emily...

sense_groups.chinese: 但苏珊和我的关系很稳定
sense_groups.english: ...but Susan is in a loving, committed relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝 我们也是
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Carol, so were we.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就想像一下
sense_groups.english: All right, just imagine for a moment...

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊认识了别人 她们一拍即合
sense_groups.english: ...that Susan meets someone, and they really hit it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们从剧院回来
sense_groups.english: Say they're coming back from the theater...

sense_groups.chinese: 去酒吧喝个小酒
sense_groups.english: ...and they stop at a pub for a couple of drinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 有说有笑
sense_groups.english: They're laughing, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人不经意的碰了另一个人
sense_groups.english: Someone innocently touches someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 有火花
sense_groups.english: There's electricity.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉很新鲜 很刺激
sense_groups.english: It's new. It's exciting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你敢说完全…
sense_groups.english: Are you telling me there isn't even the slightest possibility...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有可能出事？
sense_groups.english: ...of something happening?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许有 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: Maybe. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 听你说我才真的信了
sense_groups.english: I didn't really believe it until you just said it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别的小朋友都不信 但那只鸭子真的推我
sense_groups.english: None of the other kids believed me, I swear to God, that duck pushed me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里真豪华
sense_groups.english: Wow. This place is fabulous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带你参观 这是楼下的客厅
sense_groups.english: Yeah, let me show you around. This is the downstairs living room.

sense_groups.chinese: 有两个客厅？
sense_groups.english: There's two living rooms?

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定靠这里把到很多美眉
sense_groups.english: God, growing up here, this place must have been a real babe magnet.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该会 但我父母刚搬来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, it would have been, but, uh, my parents just moved here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以靠这里把到很多美眉
sense_groups.english: Well, you should know this place is a real babe magnet.

sense_groups.chinese: 要亲热吗？
sense_groups.english: Want to make out?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 我去把吃的冰起来
sense_groups.english: You know, here's an idea. Why don't I put the food in the fridge...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们待会再吃
sense_groups.english: ...and we can eat it later?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来不错 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: That sounds like a plan. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪里可以让我梳洗一下？
sense_groups.english: Um, is there a place that I could go freshen up?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 直走左边第二个门
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Yeah. Um, just down the hall and, uh, second door to your left.

sense_groups.chinese: 儿子 - 你们怎么回来了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, darling. - Mom, Dad, what are you guys doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们提前结束行程 - 法国烂透了
sense_groups.english: Oh, we cut the trip short. - France sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况有点特殊 我带了人回来
sense_groups.english: Um, this may be a little weird, but I've got a date here.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解
sense_groups.english: Say no more.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们拿了吃的就上楼不妨碍你
sense_groups.english: We'll just grab some food, take it with us upstairs and be out of your hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就好 所以你们没去意大利
sense_groups.english: Oh, that'd be great. So you didn't even get to Italy?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 烂
sense_groups.english: Yep. Sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来了
sense_groups.english: Hi, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我不只会做菜
sense_groups.english: I know. I can do more than cook.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢她 她似乎很聪明
sense_groups.english: I like her. She seems smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我爸妈
sense_groups.english: Rachel, my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你们
sense_groups.english: So nice to meet you. Hello, hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 约书亚 那5百元是给你买日用品的
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joshua, that $500 was for groceries.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？这… 不 你们误会了
sense_groups.english: What, this? Oh, no. That's not what it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在时装界工作
sense_groups.english: Okay, I work in fashion.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是正式的洋装
sense_groups.english: See, and this is a real dress, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 米兰正在流行
sense_groups.english: They're wearing it in Milan.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也必须试穿衣服 观察一般人的反应
sense_groups.english: So part of my job is to wear the clothes and then I see how people respond.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后回报给布鲁明戴尔的上司
sense_groups.english: And then I report back to my superiors at Bloomingdale's, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 这次我显然得…
sense_groups.english: And obviously, in this case...

sense_groups.chinese: 回报说
sense_groups.english: ...I am going to report back

sense_groups.chinese: "美国 尚嫌大胆"
sense_groups.english: "U.S.A. Not ready."

sense_groups.chinese: 洛杉矶或许可以 - 也对
sense_groups.english: Maybe in L.A. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 有道理 - 你们吃过饭了吗？
sense_groups.english: There you go. - So have you kids eaten yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想等事后… 不是
sense_groups.english: Well, ahem, we were going to do that after. I mean, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 正要吃 - 我们饿死了
sense_groups.english: Next. - Well, we're starving.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家一起出去吃吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't we just all go get something to eat?

sense_groups.chinese: 也好 穿着它窝在家里太可惜了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, ha, ha, no use wasting this baby just lying around the house.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们去吃饭
sense_groups.english: So we'll go eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就穿那样
sense_groups.english: You'll wear that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就穿那样吃饭
sense_groups.english: We'll be eating and, of course, you'll be wearing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为我说的话道歉
sense_groups.english: Dude, I am sorry about what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你说得对 这个名字太可笑了
sense_groups.english: Nope, nope, you're right. It is a ridiculous name.

sense_groups.chinese: 也没那么糟 - 当然有
sense_groups.english: It's not that bad. - Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 从此以后 我没有名字
sense_groups.english: From now on, I have no first name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就叫宾？
sense_groups.english: So you're just Bing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我无名无姓
sense_groups.english: I have no name.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们要叫你什么？
sense_groups.english: So, what are we supposed to call you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你们就暂时叫我…
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh, for now, temporarily, you can call me...

sense_groups.chinese: 克林
sense_groups.english: ...Clint.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不够酷
sense_groups.english: No way are you cool enough to pull off "Clint."

sense_groups.chinese: 那我可以叫什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, what name am I cool enough to pull off?

sense_groups.chinese: 金
sense_groups.english: Um, Gene.

sense_groups.chinese: 克林 就是克林
sense_groups.english: It's Clint. It's Clint.

sense_groups.chinese: 金 再见 - 金 再见
sense_groups.english: See you later, Gene. - Bye, Gene.

sense_groups.chinese: 是克林 克林
sense_groups.english: It's Clint. Clint!

sense_groups.chinese: 金有什么不好？
sense_groups.english: What's up with Gene?

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿你的睡衣去吃饭？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: You wore your nightie to dinner? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 最精彩的是 我背后被服务生泼到水时
sense_groups.english: And the best part though, was when the waiter spilled water down my back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一跳 咪咪弹了出来
sense_groups.english: I jumped up and my boob popped out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好惨 - 噢 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我的胸型很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's all right. I got nice boobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚收到艾蜜莉的留言
sense_groups.english: So I just picked up a message from Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 她和苏珊要一起去读诗会
sense_groups.english: She and Susan are going to a poetry reading together.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？ - 所以呢？
sense_groups.english: So? - So?

sense_groups.chinese: 诗耶？
sense_groups.english: Poetry?

sense_groups.chinese: 苏珊是同志…
sense_groups.english: Susan's gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们有志一同
sense_groups.english: They're being gay together.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉是异性恋 - 你醒醒吧
sense_groups.english: Emily's straight. - Oh, wake up.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝真的把你害惨了
sense_groups.english: Carol really messed you up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 她害你变成不信任别人 疯疯癫癫爱吃醋的谗臣
sense_groups.english: She turned you into this untrusting, crazy, jealous sycophant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道馋臣是什么 但其他都没说错
sense_groups.english: All right, so I don't know what "sycophant" means, but the rest is right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪有疯疯癫癫爱吃醋
sense_groups.english: I don't know what you're talking about. I am not a crazy, jealous person.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 她说得没错
sense_groups.english: What? - She's totally right.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前你老爱吃马克的醋
sense_groups.english: When we were together, you got all freaked out about Mark...

sense_groups.chinese: 其实根本没事 - 太有道理了
sense_groups.english: ...and there was nothing going on. - This makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪
sense_groups.english: It does not.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有道理 高中时你每个女友都不忠
sense_groups.english: Sure it does. In high school, you weren't jealous at all...

sense_groups.chinese: 你也没吃过醋
sense_groups.english: ...even though all your girlfriends were cheating on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 直到92 93年 他都很信任别人
sense_groups.english: All right, so up until '92, '93, he was very trusting.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后94年来临 卡萝离开他 砰 纽约鬼影幢幢
sense_groups.english: Then '94 hit, Carol left him, and bam. Paranoid City.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样
sense_groups.english: Absolutely, absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好玩喔
sense_groups.english: This is so much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不好玩
sense_groups.english: This is not fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只想说别让你和卡萝的事
sense_groups.english: Look, all we're trying to say is...

sense_groups.chinese: 破坏你和艾蜜莉的感情
sense_groups.english: ...don't let what happened with Carol ruin what you've got with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 92年的罗斯就不会
sense_groups.english: The '92 Ross wouldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是觉得马克一定有问题
sense_groups.english: I still think I was right about that whole Mark thing, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你知道吗？我希望艾蜜莉是同志
sense_groups.english: Wha...? Well, you know what? I hope Emily is a lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 击鼓
sense_groups.english: Drum roll.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮个忙 我是马克还是约翰？
sense_groups.english: Help. Am I a Mark or a John?

sense_groups.chinese: 你当马克不够高
sense_groups.english: Ehh, you're not tall enough to be a Mark.

sense_groups.chinese: 你或许可以当个好巴尼
sense_groups.english: But you might make a good Barney.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I am serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天3点半我就要上法院
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow at 3:30, I'm going to the courthouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要改名？
sense_groups.english: You're actually going through with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个名字拖累了我一辈子
sense_groups.english: Hey, look, this name has been holding me back my entire life.

sense_groups.chinese: 害我被其他小朋友找茬 女人运很差
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's probably why kids picked on me and why I never do well with women.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天4点起我不是马克·约翰森 就是约翰·马克森
sense_groups.english: So as of 4:00 tomorrow, I'm either gonna be Mark Johnson or John Markson.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的问题在于你 与名字无关
sense_groups.english: You've got problems because of you, not your name.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再闹了 钱德这个名字很棒
sense_groups.english: This has got to stop. Chandler is a great name.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上…
sense_groups.english: In fact...

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我知道你希望宝宝叫乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I know you really wanted me to name the baby Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我要… 我要让他叫钱德
sense_groups.english: But... So I'm gonna name the baby Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但你也得保留这个名字
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but you have to keep the name too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢啦 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要抱下？ - 好
sense_groups.english: You want to hug it out? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就去告诉法兰克他们
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna go tell Frank and Alice right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, Pheebs. - Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 004班机已到达17号门
sense_groups.english: Flight 004 is now arriving at Gate 17.

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的行李箱 我正要说
sense_groups.english: Nice luggage. - I was going to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想你 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I missed you. - Oh, I missed you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 我玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: Thanks for everything, I had a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Oh, so did I.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是舌吻
sense_groups.english: No tongue.

questions.en:

The morning's here

Hey!
Do you have to do that? It's Saturday!
Oh, come on!
Morning's here!
Morning's here
The morning's here
Sunshine is here
I hate this apartment!
I hate the color of these walls! I hate that this place still smells like bird!
I hate that singing guy!
Are you kidding? I love that guy!
Morning's here, morning is...
Stop it!
I will kill you.
I hate that my room is so small.
I have all the space I need. Just do what I did.
Monica, you don't even have a bed. You sleep in a ball on the floor!
You know what? I am tired of your bellyaching.
I've worked really hard at making this a nice place for us to live.
I know. I'm so sorry.
I'm sorry, okay?
This is a great apartment.
Shut up. This place is a hole.
Oh, blimey, I still can't believe you've got an earring!
I know, I know. Who am I? David Bowie?
He does that?
I don't know. Whatever.
Well, I think it makes you look really dangerous.
Oh, I know.
You know what?
I never would've gotten this if it weren't for you.
No, really. When I'm with you, I'm like...
...this whole other guy. I love that guy!
I mean, I love you too. A lot.
But that guy!
I love that guy!
I love both of you.
I wish I didn't have to go.
Then don't.
Stay here. Don't go so soon to London.
Just one more day. - Oh, Ross.
One more day. - Please don't do this to me again.
You know I'd stay, but I've already missed so much work. They'll fire me.
So? Then you could stay as long as you want.
I wish I could.
Oh, no, don't... Don't... Don't start packing.
Come on.
I don't think you understand packing.
I don't want to leave it till the last minute.
Last time I packed in a rush, I left my knickers here.
Yeah, I know. I, uh, tried them on.
You didn't!
No, I didn't. I didn't want to be "that guy."
Hello.
Ho, ho, ho.
Excuse me? - Your pants.
Oh, yeah! You like them?
I went to a used-clothes store and got maternity stuff.
These are so comfortable.
Uh, Pheebs, those are, uh, Santa pants.
What? - Santa pants.
Santa Claus' pants.
Nuh-uh. They're maternity pants.
They even came with a list of baby names. See?
These names are good, and these are bad.
Hey! - Hey.
Hey, Pheebs.
So, how are the elves?
I don't know. How are the, uh, you know?
Your clothes aren't funny.
Hey, guys, what should I wear to a Knicks game?
Uh, a T-shirt that says, "I Don't Belong Here"?
You have tickets?
Mom got Dad's season tickets in the divorce, so she gave them to me.
Apparently, they're good seats.
Oh, my God! Those are almost on the floor!
Do you guys want these?
Yeah! - Yeah, we do!
Well, you got them!
All right! - Just give us our apartment back.
Whoa, I didn't see that coming.
Are you serious?
Come on. We know what these are worth.
Do you think we're stupid?
Not stupid. You're meaner than I thought.
What do you say? - Forget it.
Okay? I'm not giving up my bachelor pad for basketball seats.
Your "bachelor pad"?
Have you even had a girl here?
No.
But Joey has, and I usually talk to them in the morning time.
Yeah, you do.
Come on!
Gunther, can I get two cups of chino, please?
Good one.
Come on. Season tickets.
Season tickets! You know what that means?
Forget it. I'm not giving up the apartment.
When I was a kid, my dad's company gave season tickets...
...to the Number 1 salesman every year. All right? My dad never won.
Of course, he wasn't in sales. But still, I never forgot that!
Hey guys! - Hey.
Oh, my God.
We don't make enough fun of you already?
Oh, yeah. Emily convinced me to do it.
You do know that Wham broke up?
I like it. And Emily likes it. And that's what counts.
So, uh, how are you guys doing?
Don't try and talk all normal with that thing in your ear.
Where's Emily?
Ugh, she's saying goodbye to her uncle.
Didn't she, like, just get here? - Yeah! Yeah.
Easy, tiger.
I just hate this so much.
Every time I go pick her up at the airport, it's so great.
But I'm thinking, "I'll be right back in a couple of days, dropping her off."
So, what'll you do? - There's nothing to do.
She lives there. I live here.
She'd have to move here.
She should move here.
What?
I can ask her to live with me. - Are you serious?
Why not? I mean, why not? - You've only known her six weeks!
I've got a carton of milk in my fridge I've had a longer relationship with.
Look, guys, when I'm with her, it's like...
Uh, she brings out this great side of me.
I mean, I love her, you know?
And I love the milk!
But I won't ask some British girl to move in with me.
Joey, you say things now.
Look, Ross. He's right. Emily's great.
She's great!
But this is too soon. You're only gonna scare her.
I don't wanna do that. - No.
You don't want to wreck it. Don't go too fast.
No. You're right. I know, you're right.
I'm not going to do it.
Thanks guys. - No problem.
Just remember to wake us up before you go-go.
It's too hard. Too hard!
All right, boys. Last chance for the tickets.
Otherwise, I give them to my new boyfriend, Joshua.
No, thank you.
Wait, wait. Come on, come on! Let's trade.
The timing's perfect! I just clogged the toilet!
I want those seats as much as you. But we can't live in the small apartment...
...after we've lived here! Ever read Flowers for Algernon?
Yes.
Ever read Sports Illustrated?
No, I didn't read yours!
We can go to the game tonight!
The only way I'll consider this...
...is if they offer more than just season seats.
It's the Knicks! - Screw the Knicks.
I didn't mean that. I just meant...
...that the apartment is worth so much more.
And the Knicks rule all.
Yeah, the Knicks rule all!
Hey, so? Are you going to do it?
No, we're not going to because it's not an even trade.
All right, look.
What if you could keep the apartment and the tickets?
Done!
Let me finish. I'm talking about a bet. Winner takes all.
Ooh, we could get nothing.
Or you can end up with everything. - Oh, I like that.
What do you say?
No! - Just do it!
Oh! Oh, I'm convinced!
Come on, man! You know I'd do it for you.
Because you're my best friend.
All right. But you can't use that again for a whole year.
I'm in.
This is so exciting! What are you going to bet?
Okay. Well, we should let Phoebe decide...
...because she's the only one who's impartial, and she's so pretty.
Okay. Ha, ha. Um...
Ooh, ooh. Oh, I have a game!
This is great! - Okay. What's the game?
Um, well, it doesn't have a name. No, okay. Phoebe Ball!
No, it doesn't have a name. Um...
Okay, Monica.
What is your favorite thing about trees?
They're green? - Good! Good, five points!
All right, Joey...
Same question.
Oh! Heh. They're tall. - Ooh, three points.
Both fine answers, but we were looking for leafy. Leafy.
That's not even a game.
Shut up. We're winning!
You want to finish this? We get a deck of cards.
High card wins. What do you say?
Let's do it! - Oh, I have cards!
Oh, good. - Yeah. Here.
No, these are the trick deck.
Okay. Here, yes.
Okay, you guys, uh, you pick first.
Okay. - Okay?
Four. - That's a low one!
Phoebe, you look. I can't do it.
What makes you think I can? - That's okay.
Ace!
Why are you hugging?
Because we won our apartment back!
What? Ace is high! Jack, queen, king, ace!
No! Ace is low! Ace, two, three, four!
I don't know.
Look it! Aah!
All right, come on, pick again! - Okay, give me.
Okay. - Okay.
Come on, apartment! Come on, apartment!
Aah! I know queen is high!
Not as high as...
It worked! King!
We pick again! We pick again!
Why? - I don't know.
Tickets, please.
That's courtside, baby!
Seriously, good game, though. Good game.
What are they so mad about? They got the apartment back.
No, they didn't.
Packed while you were gone.
I left some knickers under your pillow.
Move in with me.
What?
Don't be scared. It sounds crazy, and people will say it's too soon...
...but just think. Think how great it would be.
I don't know.
Uh, oh, leaving London.
My whole family lives there... - I know.
My job. - You'll get a job here.
I always hear about them foreigners stealing American jobs.
That could be you.
Yeah, but it's my whole life.
You come to England.
I can't. I would. I really would. But my son is here.
I can't leave him. You don't think there's any way?
Oh, I don't think so.
It would be different if it was way into the future...
...and we were getting married or something.
What?
Uh, no, right. I shouldn't have said "married."
Uh, please don't go freaky on me.
I didn't mean it. I didn't say it. I take it back.
No. Don't.
Why don't we?
Why don't we what?
Get married.
You are mad!
No, I'm not! It's perfect. It's better than you moving here.
It's us together forever, and that's what I want.
We've known each other six weeks! - Yeah, I know.
So what? Who's to say? Does that mean we can't do it?
Look. I was with Carol for four years before we got married...
...and I wound up divorced from a pregnant lesbian.
I mean, this...
This makes sense for us.
Come on. Our first date, we ended up spending the whole weekend in Vermont.
I mean, last night I got my ear pierced. Me!
This feels right.
Doesn't it?
My parents are gonna be really mad.
Is that...? Are you saying "Yes"? Is that "Yes"?
Yes.
Yes! - Yes?
We're getting married! - Oh, my God!
Yes! Ha, ha. - We're getting married!
Come here, come here.
Emily, will you marry me?
Yes.
Oh, it's a bit small.
Damn! I thought that'd be romantic as hell.
It was.
Those were, like, the best seats ever. - Oh, yeah.
Hey, should we give these to the girls? Like a peace offering?
That's very nice. Plus, they were free and too small.
Oh, God.
Hey, you want a beer?
Whoa! - I know!
Open up! Open up! Open up!
We'll discuss it in the morning.
What the hell is going on?
We took our apartment back!
I had nothing to do with it.
Okay, it was my idea. But I don't feel good about it.
We are switching back right now.
No, we're not. We're not leaving!
You'll have to. You both have jobs.
As soon as you do, we're switching back! There's nothing you can do to stop us.
Right, Joe?
I don't know.
What?
I don't want to move again, with...
I don't care! This is our apartment and they stole...
You stole!
Our apartment! We won it fair and square. Twice!
And I am getting it back right now! I'm getting it back right now!
All right.
We figured you might respond this way, so we have a backup offer.
Oh, no more offers. You can't offer anything to us!
Let us keep the apartment and... - As a thank you...
...Rachel and I will kiss for one minute.
Totally worth it. - That was one good minute.
Good night. - Good night.
Men are such idiots. - I know.
Can you believe something that stupid actually got us our apartment back?
It's funny. If you had just done that after the last contest...
...no one would have had to move at all. Ha, ha.
Let's pretend that's not true.
Okay. Scarf's done.
Come on. Come on, come on! - Okay.
Hey! - Hey.
What's going on?
Ross has some big thing to tell everyone.
Well, okay. It's, uh... Ahem.
Emily and I, we decided to, uh...
...to get married.
What? - Oh, my God.
Oh, are you pregnant too?
No.
When did...? How did you...?
We just decided to go for it.
We know it's a bit hasty, but, uh...
...it just feels so right.
Um, I was just telling the guys...
Yeah, I heard.
I think it's great! Aah!
I'm so happy for you!
Well, yeah! Congratulations!
I can't believe you're getting married! - Yeah.
Monica and Rachel made out.
Morning's here
The morning's here
Sunshine is here
The sky is clear
The morning's here
Hey, you're back! - Hey!
Get into gear - Breakfast is near
The dark of night has disappeared
I'll see you tomorrow morning! - Okay!
