sense_groups.english: I've worked really hard at making this a nice place for us to live.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 对不起
sense_groups.english: I know. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 这里很好
sense_groups.english: This is a great apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴 这里烂死了
sense_groups.english: Shut up. This place is a hole.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不敢相信你穿了耳洞
sense_groups.english: Oh, blimey, I still can't believe you've got an earring!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我是谁？大卫鲍伊？
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. Who am I? David Bowie?

sense_groups.chinese: 他会那样吗？
sense_groups.english: He does that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得 随便
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样看起来好危险
sense_groups.english: Well, I think it makes you look really dangerous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是你 我永远不会穿耳洞
sense_groups.english: I never would've gotten this if it weren't for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 跟你在一起时
sense_groups.english: No, really. When I'm with you, I'm like...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就变了一个人 我爱那个人
sense_groups.english: ...this whole other guy. I love that guy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很爱你
sense_groups.english: I mean, I love you too. A lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过那个人…
sense_groups.english: But that guy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱那个人
sense_groups.english: I love that guy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你们两个
sense_groups.english: I love both of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望我不必走
sense_groups.english: I wish I didn't have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就别走 留下来
sense_groups.english: Then don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 别急着回伦敦
sense_groups.english: Stay here. Don't go so soon to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 再留一天就好 - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Just one more day. - Oh, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 再留一天就好 - 别再引诱我了
sense_groups.english: One more day. - Please don't do this to me again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想 但我请了那么多假 会被开除
sense_groups.english: You know I'd stay, but I've already missed so much work. They'll fire me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你就可以尽情留下来了
sense_groups.english: So? Then you could stay as long as you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很想
sense_groups.english: I wish I could.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 不要打包
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, don't... Don't... Don't start packing.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不叫打包
sense_groups.english: I don't think you understand packing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想拖到最后一刻
sense_groups.english: I don't want to leave it till the last minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 上次我把球鞋忘在这里
sense_groups.english: Last time I packed in a rush, I left my knickers here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我有偷穿
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. I, uh, tried them on.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: You didn't!

sense_groups.chinese: 骗你的 我不想学另一个我
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't. I didn't want to be "that guy."

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵 呵 呵
sense_groups.english: Ho, ho, ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你的裤子
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - Your pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔对 你喜欢吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah! You like them?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去二手衣店买孕妇装
sense_groups.english: I went to a used-clothes store and got maternity stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 这条裤子好舒服
sense_groups.english: These are so comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 那是圣诞裤
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs, those are, uh, Santa pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 圣诞裤
sense_groups.english: What? - Santa pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老人的裤子
sense_groups.english: Santa Claus' pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是 这是孕妇裤
sense_groups.english: Nuh-uh. They're maternity pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 还附赠宝宝姓名表
sense_groups.english: They even came with a list of baby names. See?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些名字好 这些名字不好
sense_groups.english: These names are good, and these are bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 驯鹿都好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, how are the elves?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 那你… 那个…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. How are the, uh, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的衣服不好玩
sense_groups.english: Your clothes aren't funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该穿什么去看《尼克队》比赛？
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, what should I wear to a Knicks game?

sense_groups.chinese: 上面印有 "我不看篮球〞的衣服？
sense_groups.english: Uh, a T-shirt that says, "I Don't Belong Here"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有票？
sense_groups.english: You have tickets?

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈离婚时分到爸的季票 就送给我了
sense_groups.english: Mom got Dad's season tickets in the divorce, so she gave them to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 位子显然很好
sense_groups.english: Apparently, they're good seats.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 几乎就在场边
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Those are almost on the floor!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想要吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you guys want these?

sense_groups.chinese: 废话 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Yeah! - Yeah, we do!

sense_groups.chinese: 那就给你们
sense_groups.english: Well, you got them!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 只要把这里还给我们就可以了
sense_groups.english: All right! - Just give us our apartment back.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不到有这一招
sense_groups.english: Whoa, I didn't see that coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说真的？
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道你们哈死这些票了
sense_groups.english: Come on. We know what these are worth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们以为我们是白痴吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think we're stupid?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是白痴 是很恶劣
sense_groups.english: Not stupid. You're meaner than I thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 如何？ - 想都别想
sense_groups.english: What do you say? - Forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不会为了篮球票 放弃我的单身公寓
sense_groups.english: Okay? I'm not giving up my bachelor pad for basketball seats.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的单身公寓？
sense_groups.english: Your "bachelor pad"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你带女生回来过吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you even had a girl here?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是乔伊有 我早上都会跟她们聊天
sense_groups.english: But Joey has, and I usually talk to them in the morning time.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 请给我两杯奇诺
sense_groups.english: Gunther, can I get two cups of chino, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 很有趣
sense_groups.english: Good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 季票耶
sense_groups.english: Come on. Season tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道那代表什么？
sense_groups.english: Season tickets! You know what that means?

sense_groups.chinese: 甭想了 我绝不让出那问公寓
sense_groups.english: Forget it. I'm not giving up the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 小时候我爸的公司都会送季票
sense_groups.english: When I was a kid, my dad's company gave season tickets...

sense_groups.chinese: 给业绩第一的业务员 我爸从来没拿到过
sense_groups.english: ...to the Number 1 salesman every year. All right? My dad never won.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他也不在业务部 但我还是一直耿耿于怀
sense_groups.english: Of course, he wasn't in sales. But still, I never forgot that!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在啊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey guys! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们笑你笑得还不够吗？
sense_groups.english: We don't make enough fun of you already?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉说服我去穿的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Emily convinced me to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道《轰》合唱团解散了吧？
sense_groups.english: You do know that Wham broke up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 艾蜜莉也喜欢 这点最重要
sense_groups.english: I like it. And Emily likes it. And that's what counts.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how are you guys doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 别戴了耳环还装正常
sense_groups.english: Don't try and talk all normal with that thing in your ear.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's Emily?

sense_groups.chinese: 去跟她舅舅道别
sense_groups.english: Ugh, she's saying goodbye to her uncle.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是才刚来？ - 就是嘛 对啊
sense_groups.english: Didn't she, like, just get here? - Yeah! Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 大哥
sense_groups.english: Easy, tiger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好讨厌这样
sense_groups.english: I just hate this so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次去机场接她 我都好开心
sense_groups.english: Every time I go pick her up at the airport, it's so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我又会想 "过两天又要送她来机场了"
sense_groups.english: But I'm thinking, "I'll be right back in a couple of days, dropping her off."

sense_groups.chinese: 那你要怎么办？ - 不能怎么办
sense_groups.english: So, what'll you do? - There's nothing to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 她住在那里 我住在这里
sense_groups.english: She lives there. I live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 她得搬来这里
sense_groups.english: She'd have to move here.

sense_groups.chinese: 她应该搬来这里
sense_groups.english: She should move here.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以叫她跟我住 - 你说真的吗？
sense_groups.english: I can ask her to live with me. - Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不行？ - 你才认识她六个星期
sense_groups.english: Why not? I mean, why not? - You've only known her six weeks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我冰箱里有盒牛奶放得还更久
sense_groups.english: I've got a carton of milk in my fridge I've had a longer relationship with.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她在一起时
sense_groups.english: Look, guys, when I'm with her, it's like...

sense_groups.chinese: 她会激发出我好的一面
sense_groups.english: Uh, she brings out this great side of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱她
sense_groups.english: I mean, I love her, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱那盒牛奶
sense_groups.english: And I love the milk!

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不会要一个英国女生 跟我同居
sense_groups.english: But I won't ask some British girl to move in with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 该你说了
sense_groups.english: Joey, you say things now.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他说得对 艾蜜莉很棒
sense_groups.english: Look, Ross. He's right. Emily's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很棒
sense_groups.english: She's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 但这样太快了 你只会吓到她
sense_groups.english: But this is too soon. You're only gonna scare her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想吓到她 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna do that. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 别坏了好事 别太心急
sense_groups.english: You don't want to wreck it. Don't go too fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们说得对
sense_groups.english: No. You're right. I know, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会这样
sense_groups.english: I'm not going to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 两位 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thanks guys. - No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得要走时摇它两下 (《轰》所唱的歌词)
sense_groups.english: Just remember to wake us up before you go-go.

sense_groups.chinese: 太难了 太难了
sense_groups.english: It's too hard. Too hard!

sense_groups.chinese: 两位 最后的机会
sense_groups.english: All right, boys. Last chance for the tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则我就送给我的新男友 约书亚
sense_groups.english: Otherwise, I give them to my new boyfriend, Joshua.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了
sense_groups.english: No, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下… 拜托 跟她们换啦
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait. Come on, come on! Let's trade.

sense_groups.chinese: 时机正好 我刚把．马桶堵住
sense_groups.english: The timing's perfect! I just clogged the toilet!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你一样想要球票 但住过这里就觉得对面太小了
sense_groups.english: I want those seats as much as you. But we can't live in the small apartment...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看过 《献给阿尔吉侬的花束》吗？
sense_groups.english: ...after we've lived here! Ever read Flowers for Algernon?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看过《运动画报》吗？
sense_groups.english: Ever read Sports Illustrated?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没偷看你的
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't read yours!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们晚上就可以去看球
sense_groups.english: We can go to the game tonight!

sense_groups.chinese: 她们提出比季票更好的东西
sense_groups.english: The only way I'll consider this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我才要考虑
sense_groups.english: ...is if they offer more than just season seats.

sense_groups.chinese: 是《尼克队》耶 - 去他的《尼克队》
sense_groups.english: It's the Knicks! - Screw the Knicks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是那个意思 我是说…
sense_groups.english: I didn't mean that. I just meant...

sense_groups.chinese: 这层公寓的价值要更大
sense_groups.english: ...that the apartment is worth so much more.

sense_groups.chinese: 《尼克队》万岁
sense_groups.english: And the Knicks rule all.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 《尼克队》万岁
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the Knicks rule all!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？要不要？
sense_groups.english: Hey, so? Are you going to do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 因为这个交易不公平
sense_groups.english: No, we're not going to because it's not an even trade.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听着
sense_groups.english: All right, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你们能保住公寓 又拿到球票呢？
sense_groups.english: What if you could keep the apartment and the tickets?

sense_groups.chinese: 成交
sense_groups.english: Done!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我说完 我是说我们来赌 赢的人通杀
sense_groups.english: Let me finish. I'm talking about a bet. Winner takes all.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可能输光光
sense_groups.english: Ooh, we could get nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是通杀 - 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: Or you can end up with everything. - Oh, I like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 赌了啦
sense_groups.english: No! - Just do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 真有说服力啊
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh, I'm convinced!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 我也会为你这么做
sense_groups.english: Come on, man! You know I'd do it for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你是我最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Because you're my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但你一整年不准再用这招
sense_groups.english: All right. But you can't use that again for a whole year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌了
sense_groups.english: I'm in.

sense_groups.chinese: 好兴奋喔 你们要赌什么？
sense_groups.english: This is so exciting! What are you going to bet?

sense_groups.chinese: 就让菲比决定
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, we should let Phoebe decide...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为只有她没有利害关系 而且她好美
sense_groups.english: ...because she's the only one who's impartial, and she's so pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ha, ha. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh. Oh, I have a game!

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒喔 - 比什么？
sense_groups.english: This is great! - Okay. What's the game?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有名字 叫菲比球 不
sense_groups.english: Um, well, it doesn't have a name. No, okay. Phoebe Ball!

sense_groups.chinese: 没有名字 不
sense_groups.english: No, it doesn't have a name. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Okay, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最喜欢树的哪一点？
sense_groups.english: What is your favorite thing about trees?

sense_groups.chinese: 树是绿色的 - 很好 5分
sense_groups.english: They're green? - Good! Good, five points!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: All right, Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 同样的问题
sense_groups.english: Same question.

sense_groups.chinese: 树很高 3分 - 都答得很好
sense_groups.english: Oh! Heh. They're tall. - Ooh, three points.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们说的是阔叶植物
sense_groups.english: Both fine answers, but we were looking for leafy. Leafy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这根本不是比赛
sense_groups.english: That's not even a game.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴 我们领先
sense_groups.english: Shut up. We're winning!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想速战速决？我们抽牌
sense_groups.english: You want to finish this? We get a deck of cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 点数大的赢 如何？
sense_groups.english: High card wins. What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 就这么办 我刚好有牌
sense_groups.english: Let's do it! - Oh, I have cards!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不错 - 在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. - Yeah. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是魔术牌
sense_groups.english: No, these are the trick deck.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一副
sense_groups.english: Okay. Here, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你们先抽
sense_groups.english: Okay, you guys, uh, you pick first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 4点 - 够少了
sense_groups.english: Four. - That's a low one!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你看 我不敢看
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you look. I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我就敢看？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: What makes you think I can? - That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 1点
sense_groups.english: Ace!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在爽什么？
sense_groups.english: Why are you hugging?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把这里抢回来了
sense_groups.english: Because we won our apartment back!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？王牌最大 杰克皮蛋老K王牌
sense_groups.english: What? Ace is high! Jack, queen, king, ace!

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 1点最小 1 2 3 4
sense_groups.english: No! Ace is low! Ace, two, three, four!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看
sense_groups.english: Look it! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 再抽一次 - 好的 给我
sense_groups.english: All right, come on, pick again! - Okay, give me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要公寓 我要公寓
sense_groups.english: Come on, apartment! Come on, apartment!

sense_groups.chinese: 皮蛋点数很大
sense_groups.english: Aah! I know queen is high!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是大不过…
sense_groups.english: Not as high as...

sense_groups.chinese: 成功了 老K
sense_groups.english: It worked! King!

sense_groups.chinese: 再抽一次
sense_groups.english: We pick again! We pick again!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 球票请拿来
sense_groups.english: Tickets, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 场边区喔
sense_groups.english: That's courtside, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 很精彩的比赛
sense_groups.english: Seriously, good game, though. Good game.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们气什么气？ 公寓都还给她们了
sense_groups.english: What are they so mad about? They got the apartment back.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有呢
sense_groups.english: No, they didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 趁你不在打包好了
sense_groups.english: Packed while you were gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我留了双球鞋在枕头底下
sense_groups.english: I left some knickers under your pillow.

sense_groups.chinese: 搬来跟我住
sense_groups.english: Move in with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 别怕 我知道听起来很疯狂 别人会说太快了
sense_groups.english: Don't be scared. It sounds crazy, and people will say it's too soon...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你想想 那样多棒啊
sense_groups.english: ...but just think. Think how great it would be.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我离开伦敦…
sense_groups.english: Uh, oh, leaving London.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的家人都在那里 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: My whole family lives there... - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的工作 - 你可以在这里找工作
sense_groups.english: My job. - You'll get a job here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我常听说美国人的工作 都被外国人抢走了
sense_groups.english: I always hear about them foreigners stealing American jobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也可以
sense_groups.english: That could be you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但事关我的人生
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but it's my whole life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来英国
sense_groups.english: You come to England.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不行 我很愿意 但我儿子在这里
sense_groups.english: I can't. I would. I really would. But my son is here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我离不开他 没别的办法了吗？
sense_groups.english: I can't leave him. You don't think there's any way?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看是没有了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是长久的打算就不同了
sense_groups.english: It would be different if it was way into the future...

sense_groups.chinese: 例如结婚或什么的
sense_groups.english: ...and we were getting married or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好 我不该提结婚的
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, right. I shouldn't have said "married."

sense_groups.chinese: 别被我吓到
sense_groups.english: Uh, please don't go freaky on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是认真的 我没说 我收回
sense_groups.english: I didn't mean it. I didn't say it. I take it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不要收回
sense_groups.english: No. Don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 何不就这么做？
sense_groups.english: Why don't we?

sense_groups.chinese: 做什么？
sense_groups.english: Why don't we what?

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚啊
sense_groups.english: Get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了
sense_groups.english: You are mad!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 这样很完美 比你搬来住更棒
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not! It's perfect. It's better than you moving here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以永远在一起 我就是要这样
sense_groups.english: It's us together forever, and that's what I want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才认识六个星期 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: We've known each other six weeks! - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？谁说不行？这样就不行吗？
sense_groups.english: So what? Who's to say? Does that mean we can't do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我跟卡萝结婚前 在一起四年
sense_groups.english: Look. I was with Carol for four years before we got married...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果是跟一个怀孕的女同志离婚
sense_groups.english: ...and I wound up divorced from a pregnant lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么做…
sense_groups.english: I mean, this...

sense_groups.chinese: 对我们是顺理成章
sense_groups.english: This makes sense for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们第一次约会 就跑去佛蒙特度周末
sense_groups.english: Come on. Our first date, we ended up spending the whole weekend in Vermont.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我还去穿耳洞 我耶
sense_groups.english: I mean, last night I got my ear pierced. Me!

sense_groups.chinese: 这个感觉很对
sense_groups.english: This feels right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Doesn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈会气死
sense_groups.english: My parents are gonna be really mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应了吗？那是好吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that...? Are you saying "Yes"? Is that "Yes"?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: Yes! - Yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要结婚了 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: We're getting married! - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 - 我们要结婚了
sense_groups.english: Yes! Ha, ha. - We're getting married!

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come here, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 你愿意嫁给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Emily, will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 愿意
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点小
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's a bit small.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的 我还以为会很浪漫
sense_groups.english: Damn! I thought that'd be romantic as hell.

sense_groups.chinese: 是很浪漫
sense_groups.english: It was.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是史上最棒的位子
sense_groups.english: Those were, like, the best seats ever. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要把衣服送给女生 表示和解？
sense_groups.english: Hey, should we give these to the girls? Like a peace offering?

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 反正不用钱又太小
sense_groups.english: That's very nice. Plus, they were free and too small.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要喝酒吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you want a beer?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Whoa! - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 开门 开门
sense_groups.english: Open up! Open up! Open up!

sense_groups.chinese: 明天早上再说
sense_groups.english: We'll discuss it in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What the hell is going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把我们家抢回来了
sense_groups.english: We took our apartment back!

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我无关
sense_groups.english: I had nothing to do with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 是我的主意 但我并不好过
sense_groups.english: Okay, it was my idea. But I don't feel good about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在就换回来
sense_groups.english: We are switching back right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我们不走
sense_groups.english: No, we're not. We're not leaving!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们非走不可 你们都有工作
sense_groups.english: You'll have to. You both have jobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你们去上班 我们就换回来 你们阻止不了的
sense_groups.english: As soon as you do, we're switching back! There's nothing you can do to stop us.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Right, Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再搬了
sense_groups.english: I don't want to move again, with...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 这是我们的公寓 她们偷了…
sense_groups.english: I don't care! This is our apartment and they stole...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们偷了
sense_groups.english: You stole!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的公寓 我们光明正大的赢了两次
sense_groups.english: Our apartment! We won it fair and square. Twice!

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就要要回来 我现在就要要回来
sense_groups.english: And I am getting it back right now! I'm getting it back right now!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们早料到会有这种反应 所以我们准备了备案
sense_groups.english: We figured you might respond this way, so we have a backup offer.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 你们搞不定我们的
sense_groups.english: Oh, no more offers. You can't offer anything to us!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我们留在这里 为了表示感谢
sense_groups.english: Let us keep the apartment and... - As a thank you...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋和我会接吻一分钟
sense_groups.english: ...Rachel and I will kiss for one minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全值得 好爽的一分钟
sense_groups.english: Totally worth it. - That was one good minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人真是白痴 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Men are such idiots. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么白痴的事 居然让我们得逞了
sense_groups.english: Can you believe something that stupid actually got us our apartment back?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你们上次比完就这么做
sense_groups.english: It's funny. If you had just done that after the last contest...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁都不必搬家
sense_groups.english: ...no one would have had to move at all. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 就装做没这回事
sense_groups.english: Let's pretend that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 围巾织好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Scarf's done.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 - 好
sense_groups.english: Come on. Come on, come on! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯有大事要宣布
sense_groups.english: Ross has some big thing to tell everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 是…
sense_groups.english: Well, okay. It's, uh... Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉和我决定…
sense_groups.english: Emily and I, we decided to, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 要结婚
sense_groups.english: ...to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我的天
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也怀孕了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, are you pregnant too?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么… 怎么…
sense_groups.english: When did...? How did you...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就是决定要结婚
sense_groups.english: We just decided to go for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个决定是仓卒了些 但是…
sense_groups.english: We know it's a bit hasty, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉真的很对
sense_groups.english: ...it just feels so right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在告诉他们…
sense_groups.english: Um, I was just telling the guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I heard.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: I think it's great! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真替你高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm so happy for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah! Congratulations!

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然要结婚了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're getting married! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和瑞秋亲热
sense_groups.english: Monica and Rachel made out.

sense_groups.chinese: 美好的早晨又来到
sense_groups.english: Morning's here

sense_groups.chinese: 美好的早晨又来到
sense_groups.english: The morning's here

sense_groups.chinese: 阳光露脸
sense_groups.english: Sunshine is here

sense_groups.chinese: 晴空万里
sense_groups.english: The sky is clear

sense_groups.chinese: 美好的早晨
sense_groups.english: The morning's here

sense_groups.chinese: 你回来了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're back! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 准备就绪 - 早餐就快上桌
sense_groups.english: Get into gear - Breakfast is near

sense_groups.chinese: 夜晚的黑暗一扫而空
sense_groups.english: The dark of night has disappeared

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明天见 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'll see you tomorrow morning! - Okay!

sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, Ross, you know I absolutely adore Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是… 怕你会尴尬
sense_groups.english: It's just that, well, I thought it might be a bit awkward for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你决定就好
sense_groups.english: But it's absolutely your decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 还要茶吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: More tea? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 伯爵？ - 呃？

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你想请谁就请谁
sense_groups.english: Fine, yeah, invite whoever you want.

sense_groups.english: I don't want to be single, okay? I just want to be married again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要一百万
sense_groups.english: And I just want a million dollars.

sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Monica. Hi. Thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: ...and Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得我哥罗斯吗？ - 当然记得
sense_groups.english: Do you remember my brother, Ross? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 喔 天啊 - 嗨

sense_groups.chinese: 你或许不知道 念高中时…
sense_groups.english: You know, back in high school...

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常喜欢你
sense_groups.english: ...I had a, um, major crush on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 真的？喔 好吧
sense_groups.english: I knew. - You did? Oh, okay.

sense_groups.english: ...ment.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 没错 那是…
sense_groups.english: Oh... - Yes. Yes. That's...

sense_groups.english: What? - That little kitty.

sense_groups.chinese: 但要是时间能让你看清楚一点
sense_groups.english: But if time was what you needed just to gain a little perspective...

sense_groups.english: We were on a break!

sense_groups.chinese: 你似乎真的很喜欢她
sense_groups.english: You seem to really like her.

sense_groups.english: Yeah, but what am I gonna do? We agreed it was gonna be a two-week thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要有承诺
sense_groups.english: You know? No commitment.

sense_groups.english: Ross, that girl just spent the entire evening talking to your friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 嚷着要听你的事

sense_groups.english: I mean, you don't do that if you're just in it for two weeks.

sense_groups.english: You think? Heh.

sense_groups.english: You've got like 14 hours until she has to be at the airport.

sense_groups.english: And you're sitting here in a hallway...

sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right. - Yeah.

sense_groups.english: Oh, this is so amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 很难相信我哥哥居然要去伦敦结婚
sense_groups.english: I can't believe my brother's getting married, and in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 好浪漫喔

sense_groups.chinese: 真聪明
sense_groups.english: Hey, pretty smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 附面纸
sense_groups.english: Tissue paper.

sense_groups.english: You're at the wedding. You have to cry.

sense_groups.english: Handkerchief? No, I got my invitation.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可爱
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, isn't this adorable?

sense_groups.english: Ross let Ben address mine.

sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hey.

sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.english: Hey, did you get your invitation to Ross' wedding?

sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 我可以带一位亲友 看他怎么说
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, man, I get to bring a guest. We'll show him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好嫉妒你们都要去
sense_groups.english: I'm so jealous you're all going.

sense_groups.english: I can't believe I never knew you can't fly in your third trimester.

sense_groups.chinese: 从来都不知道 - 我也不知道
sense_groups.english: I never knew that. - I didn't, either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I knew that.

sense_groups.english: So didn't know that. But you should see your faces.

sense_groups.english: What's this? Is this Ross' wedding invitation?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许该藏的是那一张
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's the one we should have actually hidden.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不必那样
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, you guys, come on. You don't have to do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很替他高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm happy for him.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我很…
sense_groups.english: I am. I really... I'm... I'm ha...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会调适的
sense_groups.english: I'll work on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 甜心
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你会去吧？
sense_groups.english: Rach, you're going to come though, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I don't know. I...

sense_groups.chinese: 该不会她不去我们就不去吧？
sense_groups.english: This isn't one of those "If she doesn't come, we don't come"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经买票了
sense_groups.english: Because I already bought my ticket...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去才会真的很奇怪
sense_groups.english: You know what would be real weird? If you weren't there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就考虑下吧 - 我会的
sense_groups.english: Just say you'll think about it, okay? - No, I'll think about it. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是谁送的？ - 罗斯送的
sense_groups.english: Who's this from? - That's Ross'.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 他记得
sense_groups.english: He remembered.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得什么？
sense_groups.english: Remembered what?

sense_groups.chinese: 好几个月前 我们经过一家古董店
sense_groups.english: It was like months ago. We were walking by this antique store.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到这个别针对他说
sense_groups.english: I saw this pin, and I told him it was just like one my grandmother had...

sense_groups.chinese: 小时我奶奶有一个一模一样的
sense_groups.english: ...when I was a little girl. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他居然记得
sense_groups.english: I can't believe he remembered.

sense_groups.chinese: 他定花了很多钱
sense_groups.english: This must have cost him a fortune.

sense_groups.chinese: 他居然这么大方
sense_groups.english: I can't believe he did this.

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗斯耶 记得他大学爱上卡萝时
sense_groups.english: Remember back in college when he fell in love with Carol...

sense_groups.chinese: 就送了她一只超贵的水晶鸭
sense_groups.english: ...and bought her that ridiculously expensive crystal duck?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you just say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 来自北京的457号班机 刚刚才抵达
sense_groups.english: Flight number 457 from Beijing now arriving.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是老同学 - 毕业后就没见过
sense_groups.english: We were in school together. - We haven't seen each other since then.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了中国 你们猜是谁主持挖掘工作？
sense_groups.english: Well, I land in China. Guess who's in charge of the dig?

sense_groups.chinese: 茱莉
sense_groups.english: Julie!

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒吧？
sense_groups.english: Julie! Isn't that great?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是老二被踹到 朝你脖子上吐口水
sense_groups.english: Isn't that just kick-you-in-the-crotch, spit-on-your-neck fantastic?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, that is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 不… 不
sense_groups.english: No... Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先挂
sense_groups.english: No... Okay. No, you hang up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你… 好
sense_groups.english: No, you... Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三
sense_groups.english: One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也没挂
sense_groups.english: You didn't hang up either.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也没挂 - 她也没挂
sense_groups.english: She didn't hang up. - She didn't hang up either.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: Okay, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你挂 你挂
sense_groups.english: No, you hang up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你挂…
sense_groups.english: You. You. Y...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 嗨
sense_groups.english: Ross, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是打来告诉你一切都很好
sense_groups.english: I'm just calling to say that, um, everything's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很替你…
sense_groups.english: And I'm really happy for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 和你的猫高兴
sense_groups.english: ...and your cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以显然的 我已经放下你了
sense_groups.english: So obviously, I am over you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经放下你了
sense_groups.english: I am over you.

sense_groups.chinese: 而那样 就是所谓的了结
sense_groups.english: And that, my friend, is what they call closure.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 有你打的留言
sense_groups.english: Rach, I got a message from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 完了 罗斯 挂掉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, no. Hang up the phone. Give me the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 电话给我…
sense_groups.english: Give me the phone, give me the phone. Give me the phone!

sense_groups.chinese: 你放下我了？
sense_groups.english: You're over me?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你… ？ - 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: What...? You're, uh? - Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你放下我？
sense_groups.english: You're over me?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天 - 你何时… ？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - When were you...

sense_groups.chinese: 举起我的？
sense_groups.english: ...under me?

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上…
sense_groups.english: Basically, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 最近… 我…
sense_groups.english: ...lately, I've, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有点对你有感觉
sense_groups.english: Ahem. I've sort of had feelings for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我得躺下
sense_groups.english: Okay, I need to lie down.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟茱莉分手了
sense_groups.english: He broke up with Julie.

sense_groups.chinese: 过去抱她啊
sense_groups.english: Well, go hug her, for God's sakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 真的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都只要你 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's always been you, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉今晚还得工作
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm sorry I had to work tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你值得我等 - 噢
sense_groups.english: You're worth the wait. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不只是指今晚
sense_groups.english: And I don't just mean tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有想过我会遇见你这样的人
sense_groups.english: I never dreamed That I'd meet somebody like you

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有想过我会遇见你这样的人
sense_groups.english: I never dreamed That I'd lose somebody like you

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想谈恋爱
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want to fall in love

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Oh. Honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 你压到果汁了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, you just rolled over the juice box.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 你没告诉瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Gunther, please tell me you didn't say anything to Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟影印店女生的事吧？
sense_groups.english: ...about me and the girl from the copy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该说吗？
sense_groups.english: Was I not supposed to?

sense_groups.chinese: 是你要分手的 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: You're the one who ended it.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我很气你 不是因为我不爱你了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, because I was mad at you. Not because I stopped loving you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还爱我？
sense_groups.english: You still love me?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？你想复合吗？
sense_groups.english: What does this mean? What do you...? I mean, do you want to get back together?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是… 也许吧
sense_groups.english: No. Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不… 知道 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I don't... I don't know. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得…
sense_groups.english: I just... I feel...

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然会想跟你复合 我们根本就完了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I even thought of getting back together with you. We are so over.

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓
sense_groups.english: Fine by me!

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便告诉你 这种事并不常见
sense_groups.english: And, hey, just so you know, it's not that common...

sense_groups.chinese: 并非男人都会这样 这是很严重的
sense_groups.english: ...it doesn't happen to every guy, and it is a big deal!

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道
sense_groups.english: I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋来了 她是不是很美啊？
sense_groups.english: JUDY [ON TV]: Rachel's coming up. Doesn't she look pretty, Jack?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们准备要去参加舞会 - 噢
sense_groups.english: This is us getting ready for the prom. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？这种带子真别看了
sense_groups.english: You know what? We don't have to watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然要看 - 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we do. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 拍下摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Get a shot of Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么拉远？
sense_groups.english: Wait, how do you zoom out?

sense_groups.chinese: 有了
sense_groups.english: There she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴 上镜头会多10磅
sense_groups.english: Shut up. The camera adds 10 pounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以到底有几个镜头对着你？
sense_groups.english: Huh, so how many cameras are actually on you?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 关掉啦
sense_groups.english: Dad, turn it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我关了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: It is off. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Right, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 粉丝喔 麦克风头
sense_groups.english: Looking good, Mr. Kotter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没舞伴不能去舞会 时间来不及了
sense_groups.english: I can't go to my own prom without a date. I can't. It's too late.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你不去 我也不想去了
sense_groups.english: If you're not going, then I don't wanna go either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个好主意
sense_groups.english: I have a wonderful idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你带瑞秋去参加舞会
sense_groups.english: You should take Rachel to the prom.

sense_groups.chinese: 看够了 关掉吧
sense_groups.english: We've seen enough. Let's turn it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要啦 - 那我不看 行吧？
sense_groups.english: I want to see. - Fine, I'm not going to watch, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, kid. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好帅
sense_groups.english: Are you handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 去让他们瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: Let's show them.

sense_groups.chinese: 行了 - 瑞秋 不管你好了没
sense_groups.english: Okay, Dad. - Rachel, ready or not.

sense_groups.chinese: 解救你的白马王…
sense_groups.english: Here comes your knight in shining...

sense_groups.chinese: 糟了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 奇普 不用等我们 快点
sense_groups.english: Bye. Don't wait up. - Okay, Chip, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪…
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么关掉？
sense_groups.english: Jack, how do I turn this off?

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你居然这样做
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我就…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 他是她的龙虾
sense_groups.english: See? He's her lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧…
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不去？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You're really not going? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会很难面对
sense_groups.english: It's just going to be too hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟…
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是罗斯
sense_groups.english: ...it's Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能看着他结婚？
sense_groups.english: How can I watch him get married?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样最好 真的
sense_groups.english: You know? It's just for the best, you know? It is.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且总得有人陪菲比
sense_groups.english: Plus somebody's got to stay here with Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 到时她的肚子会很大
sense_groups.english: She's going to be pretty big by then...

sense_groups.chinese: 她会需要别人绑鞋带
sense_groups.english: ...and she'll need someone to help her tie her shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 在她要生的时候送她去医院
sense_groups.english: Drive her to the hospital in case she goes into labor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有车
sense_groups.english: You don't have a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 驾照也过期了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: And your license expired. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 事情那么多 时间却那么少
sense_groups.english: Yeah. See, there's so much to do, and I have so little time to do it in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看
sense_groups.english: Check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有完整的博物馆录影带
sense_groups.english: It says there's a place you can go to rent videos of all the museums.

sense_groups.chinese: "几乎如同身历其境"
sense_groups.english: "It's almost as good as being there."

sense_groups.chinese: 更棒 你不能只穿内裤去博物馆
sense_groups.english: It's better. You can't go to a museum in your underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 但之后你会被封杀
sense_groups.english: Well, you could, but probably just the one time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以去租所有景点的录影带
sense_groups.english: I bet we could get videos of all the sights...

sense_groups.chinese: 搬台录放影机到房间 这样就不必出房间了
sense_groups.english: ...get a VCR in our hotel room, we'd never even have to go outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一定要租《终极警探》
sense_groups.english: If we do that, we've got to rent Die Hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 来自北京的457号班机 刚刚才抵达
sense_groups.english: Flight number 457 from Beijing now arriving.

questions.name: S04E22
questions.en:
That was the 10th time I've peed since I've been here.
It's also, like, the 10th time you've told us. Ha, ha.
Yeah, oh, I'm sorry, it must be hard to hear.
I'll tell you, it's easier having babies playing...
..."Bring in 'da Noise, Bring in 'da Funk" on your bladder.
I am so sick of being pregnant.
The only happiness I get is from a cup of coffee...
...which of course is decaf because, oh, I'm pregnant. Heh.
Pheebs, you want a cookie?
Thank you so much.
So, uh, Pheebs, honey, how are those mood swings coming?
I haven't really had any yet.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
All right. Here's the ring.
Yes, yes. A thousand times, yes.
So, uh, any ideas for the bachelor party?
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
Before you start handing out rings and planning bachelor parties...
...don't you have to decide who your best man's gonna be?
Oh, it's awkward. It's awkward, it's awkward.
I sort of already asked Chandler.
What? He got to do it at your first wedding.
Joey, I figured you'd understand. I've known him a lot longer.
Come on, Ross. I don't have any brothers. I'm never gonna get to be a best man.
You can be the best man when I get married.
I'm never gonna get to be a best man.
Wait, wait.
So you get to be my best man twice, and I don't get to be yours at all?
Oh, no. Yeah, of course, you can be my best man.
What about me? You just said I could.
I'm not even getting married!
Okay, this is a question for science-fiction writers.
I can't believe you're not picking me.
Hey, how could it not be me? - I'm not even...
I'm not even... - All right, you know what? That's it.
From now on, Joey I want you to be my best man.
Yes. Shame about you, though.
Stop it. - What?
One of the babies is kicking.
I thought that was a good thing. - It's not kicking me.
It's kicking one of the other babies.
Oh. Don't make me come in there!
Hey. - Hey.
Do you guys have, like, a big bowl I can borrow?
Yeah, there's one right under the cabinet.
Thanks. - Why do you need it?
Oh, we're having a party tomorrow night. Later.
Hey, hey. Are you planning on inviting us?
No. No, no. Later.
Hey, get your ass back here, Tribbiani!
Hormones.
What Phoebe meant was...
...how come you're having a party and we're not invited?
Oh. It's Ross' bachelor party.
So? - Are you bachelors?
No. - Are you strippers?
No. - Then you're not invited.
All right, fine. You're not invited to the party that we're gonna have either.
Oh, what party?
Well, um...
The baby shower for Phoebe.
Baby shower?
Wow. That so doesn't sound like something I want to do. Later.
I can't believe I'm going to have a party!
Ha, ha. That's so great. A party!
I don't know why. - Oh.
This is what I got going for the party so far liquor-wise.
Get a lot of liquor. - Great. Great.
Okay, now, uh, in terms of the invite list, obviously I got you, me and Chandler.
And I'm invite Gunther because, well, we've been talking pretty loud.
I'll be there.
Oh, listen. I know it's your party...
...but I'd really like to limit the number of museum geeks that are gonna be there.
Yeah. Tell you what. Let's not invite any anthropologists, okay?
Just the dinosaur dudes.
Okay, we'll need a six-pack of Zima.
Hey, guys, what are you doing?
Oh, just planning my bachelor party with my best man.
Yeah, well, good luck trying to top the last one.
I don't think it's gonna be that difficult, considering this one won't take place...
...in the basement of a Pizza Hut. Heh.
Oh, I'm Ross, I'm Ross.
I'm too good for the Hut. I'm too good for the Hut.
Look, I gotta go pick up Ben. Uh, everything so far sounds great, Joey.
Just remember, keep it on the mellow side, okay?
Just a couple guys hanging out playing poker.
No strippers or anything, okay? - You got it.
Okay, see you later. - Yeah.
Ha, ha. Have fun planning your mellow party.
There's gonna be strippers there.
He didn't say anything about no strippers.
He just said, "No strippers." - Oh. I chose not to hear that.
Look what I got, look what I got, look what I got.
Can you believe they made these for little people?
Aw. Little Village People.
Aw, okay. Look at this one. This is my favorite.
Oh, that is so sweet.
Phoebe's gonna love dressing them in these.
Huh. Except, uh, Phoebe's not gonna be the one who gets to dress them.
I guess she's not gonna get to keep the babies.
Oh, my God, we are throwing the most depressing baby shower.
Wait a minute. Unless we give her all gifts that she can use...
...after she's done being pregnant. Like, um, regular coffee. Tequila.
Oh, and somebody can get her those leather pants she's always wanted.
Oh, she's gonna love that.
What the hell is this?
You actually thought it'd make me feel better?
To give me something I can't even use for another two months?
This sucks! Oh!
All right, what's my next present?
Hey, listen, man, about the stripper...
Yeah? - Good call.
A little announcement. A little announcement.
I've decided that my best man is my best friend Gunther.
What's my last name?
Central Perk?
Thanks for not marrying Rachel.
Oh, hey, Gunther. Don't forget your shirt.
Hey. Hey, what are those?
Little party favors. Check it out.
Wow, yeah.
Oh, oh, oh!
Okay, little announcement.
Just want everybody to know the position of my best man is still open.
And, uh, you know, so is the position of the bride.
Great.
Smooth, man. Yeah. You got some chili on your neck.
Well, I just want to say thanks, everyone. This was great.
Okay? And hey, I'll see you guys Monday morning.
Thanks, Joey. - Oh, hey. Don't forget your shirt.
Oh, thanks.
Ahem. Okay. Hey, museum geeks. Party's over.
Okay, wave bye-bye to the nice lady. There you go.
Back to your parents' basement. All right.
Come on, boys, come on out. Here you go.
Oh. Look at the birdies.
Are those yours? - Yeah.
Wow, I didn't know they let you keep chickens and ducks as pets?
Oh, yeah, yeah. And I got the duck totally trained too.
Watch this. Stare at the wall.
Hardly move.
Be white.
You are really good at that.
So I had fun tonight.
You throw one hell of a party.
Thanks, thanks. Yeah, it was great meeting you.
And listen, if any of my friends ever get married or have a birthday or a Tuesday...
Yeah, that'd be great. - Okay. Ha, ha.
So, I guess, um, good night.
Oh, unless you, uh... Unless you want to hang around.
Yeah? - Yeah. I'll let you play with my duck.
Hey...
Stripper.
The stripper stole the ring!
Chandler, get up, get up! The stripper stole the ring!
What? - The ring is gone!
Oh. Okay, just, like, give me a minute to wake up for this.
You lost the ring. You're the worst best man ever.
Dude, this isn't funny. What am I gonna do?
I go to sleep last night, everything's cool.
I wake up this morning, the stripper's gone, and the ring is gone!
You slept with the stripper? - Of course!
Hi, guys.
Hi, Phoebe.
