sense_groups.english: To give me something I can't even use for another two months?

sense_groups.chinese: 烂透了
sense_groups.english: This sucks! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 下个礼物呢？我们都没带
sense_groups.english: All right, what's my next present?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 那个脱衣舞娘…
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen, man, about the stripper...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？ - 叫得好
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Good call.

sense_groups.chinese: 请注意…
sense_groups.english: A little announcement. A little announcement.

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定我的伴郎 是我最要好的朋友阿甘
sense_groups.english: I've decided that my best man is my best friend Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 我姓什么？
sense_groups.english: What's my last name?

sense_groups.chinese: 中央咖啡厅？
sense_groups.english: Central Perk?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你没娶瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Thanks for not marrying Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 记得拿衣服
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Gunther. Don't forget your shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey, what are those?

sense_groups.chinese: 派对小赠品 你看
sense_groups.english: Little party favors. Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 耶
sense_groups.english: Wow, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢…
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 请注意
sense_groups.english: Okay, little announcement.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的伴郎人选还空着
sense_groups.english: Just want everybody to know the position of my best man is still open.

sense_groups.chinese: 新娘人选也是
sense_groups.english: And, uh, you know, so is the position of the bride.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一套 你的脖子沾到辣椒
sense_groups.english: Smooth, man. Yeah. You got some chili on your neck.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢大家 今晚很愉快
sense_groups.english: Well, I just want to say thanks, everyone. This was great.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期一早上见
sense_groups.english: Okay? And hey, I'll see you guys Monday morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 谢了 - 别忘了拿衣服
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Joey. - Oh, hey. Don't forget your shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 博物馆怪胎 派对结束了
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Okay. Hey, museum geeks. Party's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟小姐说再见 快点
sense_groups.english: Okay, wave bye-bye to the nice lady. There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 回爸妈的地下室去
sense_groups.english: Back to your parents' basement. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 出来吧 来
sense_groups.english: Come on, boys, come on out. Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 看小鸟
sense_groups.english: Oh. Look at the birdies.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些是你的？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Are those yours? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道可以养鸡鸭当宠物
sense_groups.english: Wow, I didn't know they let you keep chickens and ducks as pets?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我把鸭子训练得很好
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, yeah. And I got the duck totally trained too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 盯着墙壁
sense_groups.english: Watch this. Stare at the wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 几乎不动
sense_groups.english: Hardly move.

sense_groups.chinese: 白白的
sense_groups.english: Be white.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真行
sense_groups.english: You are really good at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚很愉快
sense_groups.english: So I had fun tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 派对办得很棒
sense_groups.english: You throw one hell of a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Thanks, thanks. Yeah, it was great meeting you.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我有朋友要结婚 或是过生日 过星期二…
sense_groups.english: And listen, if any of my friends ever get married or have a birthday or a Tuesday...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就太好了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that'd be great. - Okay. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就再见了
sense_groups.english: So, I guess, um, good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你… 想留下来
sense_groups.english: Oh, unless you, uh... Unless you want to hang around.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？对 你可以跟我的鸭子玩
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah. I'll let you play with my duck.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 跳脱衣舞的
sense_groups.english: Stripper.

sense_groups.chinese: 舞娘把戒指偷走了
sense_groups.english: The stripper stole the ring!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 起床 舞娘把戒指偷走了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, get up, get up! The stripper stole the ring!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 戒指被偷了
sense_groups.english: What? - The ring is gone!

sense_groups.chinese: 先让我清醒一下
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay, just, like, give me a minute to wake up for this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把戒指弄丢了 你是最烂的伴郎
sense_groups.english: You lost the ring. You're the worst best man ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好笑 怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Dude, this isn't funny. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去睡觉 一切正常
sense_groups.english: I go to sleep last night, everything's cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我醒来 舞娘不见了 戒指也不见了
sense_groups.english: I wake up this morning, the stripper's gone, and the ring is gone!

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她上床？ - 废话
sense_groups.english: You slept with the stripper? - Of course!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说声抱歉 我昨天在送礼会上
sense_groups.english: Ahem. I wanted to apologize if I, you know, seemed a tad edgy yesterday...

sense_groups.chinese: 似乎凶了点
sense_groups.english: ...at my shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 荷尔蒙作祟
sense_groups.english: You know, it's just the hormones. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我们… - 荷尔蒙嘛
sense_groups.english: No, we... Hormones. Yeah. - Hormones.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们 你们真有心
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you. It was just... It was so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你似乎好多了
sense_groups.english: Wow, you seem to be doing much better.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你现在怎样？ - 很好
sense_groups.english: That's great. How are things going? - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 最近的注意力都在我
sense_groups.english: No, but... Okay, it feels like everything's been about me lately.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们呢？
sense_groups.english: So, what's happening with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正在说 我不去参加罗斯的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, actually, we were just talking about me not going to Ross' wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 有那段过往 - 我可能…
sense_groups.english: Oh. - It just might be too hard...

sense_groups.chinese: 很难面对
sense_groups.english: ...given the history and all that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我想起当年流落街头时
sense_groups.english: Wow, this reminds me of the time when I was, um, living on the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人说我陪他上床就请我吃饭
sense_groups.english: And this guy offered to buy me food if I slept with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 这两件事哪里像？
sense_groups.english: Well, how is this like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想想… 的确不像
sense_groups.english: Well, let's see. It's not really like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那才算是问题
sense_groups.english: Because, you see, that was an actual problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这只是高中女生无病呻吟
sense_groups.english: And, uh, yours is just, like, a bunch of high-school crap...

sense_groups.chinese: 没人在乎
sense_groups.english: ...that nobody really gives... Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我只是…
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sorry. I just thought...

sense_groups.chinese: 泪眼攻势来了
sense_groups.english: All right, here come the waterworks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经没辄了
sense_groups.english: Oh. I don't know what I'm gonna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打给中介站 他们不管
sense_groups.english: I called the company that sent her, and they don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打119又被吼
sense_groups.english: And I called 911 and they yelled at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这还不算紧急事件吗？
sense_groups.english: If this isn't an emergency, then what is?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 两位 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 昨晚派对办得很棒
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to thank you for last night. What a great party.

sense_groups.chinese: 博物馆那伙人玩得很爽
sense_groups.english: And the guys from work had a blast.

sense_groups.chinese: 其中有一个没参加过单身派对
sense_groups.english: You know, one of them had never been to a bachelor party before.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一个没参加过任何派对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and another one had never been to a party before, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个结婚戒指
sense_groups.english: So, uh, hey, that wedding ring, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 可真漂亮 - 漂亮吧
sense_groups.english: Man, that is nice. - Yeah. Yeah, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想买一只
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I was thinking I might pick one of those babies up for myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 要去哪里买？
sense_groups.english: Where might one get one of those?

sense_groups.chinese: 那只戒指？我奶奶刚来到这个国家时
sense_groups.english: That ring, when my grandmother first came to this country...

sense_groups.chinese: 全身上下只有那只戒指 和一小包衣服
sense_groups.english: ...that ring and the clothes on her back were all she had with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以那只戒指可说是无可取代
sense_groups.english: So you might say that the ring is irreplaceable.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 它是我家的传家宝
sense_groups.english: Oh, absolutely. It's been in my family for generations.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个戴上它的新娘 都能幸福到老
sense_groups.english: And every bride who's worn it has lived a long and happy life.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以简直算是一只魔戒
sense_groups.english: So you might say it's a magic ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 被脱衣舞娘偷了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the stripper stole it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的戒指？我的结婚…
sense_groups.english: My ring? My wedding ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 脱衣舞娘偷了我的结婚戒指？
sense_groups.english: The stripper stole my wedding ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这样？
sense_groups.english: How? How could this happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 原因就在于你说了 "乔伊 你来当我的伴郎吧"
sense_groups.english: Well, I think it all started when you said, "Hey, Joey, why don't you be my best man."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我来报警
sense_groups.english: All right, all right. Fine. I'm gonna call the cops.

sense_groups.chinese: 我搞砸了你也不用报官捉我啊
sense_groups.english: Dude, I screwed up. You don't have to turn me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是捉你 是捉那个舞娘 - 我试过了
sense_groups.english: Not on you, on the stripper. - Oh, yeah, well, I already did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说等侦破所有谋杀案再说
sense_groups.english: They said they're gonna look into it right after they solve all the murders...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就找中介站
sense_groups.english: Okay, we'll call the company that sent her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也试过了
sense_groups.english: I did that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不肯透露她的真名或电话
sense_groups.english: They wouldn't give me her name or number.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说我再打去就要报警
sense_groups.english: They said if I bother them again, they'd call the police.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"你去啊 就说我掉了一只戒指"
sense_groups.english: I said, "You talk to the police, you tell them I'm missing a ring."

sense_groups.chinese: 难道一点办法也没有？
sense_groups.english: So, what, Joey? What are you telling me? That there's nothing we can do?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这样？ - 罗斯 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: How could this happen? - Look, Ross, I am so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何不再叫她一次
sense_groups.english: Well, what if we just, uh, called her...

sense_groups.chinese: 用假名把她找去我的办公室
sense_groups.english: ...used a fake name and had her come to my office?

sense_groups.chinese: 好像不赖 但我们得找戒指
sense_groups.english: Oh, that sounds like fun, but we got a ring to find!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你的茶
sense_groups.english: Here's your tea, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉真好
sense_groups.english: Mm. It's so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks. That's sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就好 - 你喜欢就好
sense_groups.english: Good. - So glad you like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 茶是她泡的
sense_groups.english: What? She made the tea.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我刚才阵痛了
sense_groups.english: No, I think I just had a contraction.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 天哪
sense_groups.english: You what? - My God.

sense_groups.chinese: 几分钟前就有一次
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I thought I felt one a couple minutes ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次绝对错不了 - 你不能在这里生
sense_groups.english: And now I know that definitely was one. - Well, you can't have the baby here!

sense_groups.chinese: 男生搬走之后我还没消毒
sense_groups.english: I haven't sterilized the apartment since the guys moved out!

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 别怕
sense_groups.english: It's okay. We're gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来烧水 撕床单
sense_groups.english: You know what? It's okay. I'm gonna boil some water and just rip up some sheets.

sense_groups.chinese: 别紧张 可能是假性阵痛
sense_groups.english: Ow, it's all right. It's probably false labor.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说接近预产期会这样
sense_groups.english: They said that, that can happen near the end. So just...

sense_groups.chinese: 去拿书来 - 瑞秋 拿书来
sense_groups.english: Somebody get the book. - Rachel, get the book.

sense_groups.chinese: 书 好
sense_groups.english: The book. Okay. Okay. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 《圣经》？ - 我哪知啊
sense_groups.english: The Bible? - I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 很好
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay, okay. This is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你站到桌子后面
sense_groups.english: Uh, Chandler, you get behind the desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 但愿她一进来不会认得你 因为…
sense_groups.english: And when she comes in, hopefully she won't recognize you because...

sense_groups.chinese: 她怎么会认得你
sense_groups.english: Well, why would she?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你对罗斯和我打暗号
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay. And then you buzz Ross and I.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是冈萨勒斯先生 我是王先生
sense_groups.english: You be Mr. Gonzales, and I'll be Mr. Wong.

sense_groups.chinese: 民族大熔炉
sense_groups.english: Diverse.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人叫警卫吗？
sense_groups.english: STRIPPER: Anybody call for security?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们冷静
sense_groups.english: You be cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 哪位是阿甘中央咖啡厅？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Which one of you guys is Gunther Central Perk?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的戒指呢？我过世的奶奶的结婚戒指呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's my ring? My dead grandmother's wedding ring! Where is it? Where is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真冷静
sense_groups.english: Way to be cool, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在说什么？
sense_groups.english: What's he talking about? - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 床头柜的丝绒盒里有只戒指
sense_groups.english: There was a ring in a box on my nightstand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一走它就不见了
sense_groups.english: After you left, it was gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们认为我偷了戒指？
sense_groups.english: Wait, you guys think I stole some ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 定是你偷的 少废话 从实招来
sense_groups.english: We know you took it! So just save yourself the time and confess.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是少年侦探团吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Who are you, the Hardy Boys?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不必偷什么白痴戒指
sense_groups.english: I don't need to steal some stupid ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一星期赚一千六
sense_groups.english: I make $1,600 a week doing what I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有人赚那么多吗？
sense_groups.english: Any of you guys make that?

sense_groups.chinese: 嫁给我
sense_groups.english: Marry me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不懂 戒指整晚都在我房里
sense_groups.english: I don't get it. It was in my room all night. If she didn't take it...

sense_groups.chinese: 她没拿 我没拿 你没拿 那是谁拿的？
sense_groups.english: ...and I didn't take it and you didn't take it. Then who did?

sense_groups.chinese: 安静 我们在想事情
sense_groups.english: Shh. We're trying to think.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会知道是假痛？
sense_groups.english: I still don't get how you know when it's false labor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看到宝宝吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, do you see any babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 你感觉如何？还好吧
sense_groups.english: How do you feel? - Okay, I guess. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 大概是知道快要结束了
sense_groups.english: I guess I know it's going to be over soon so...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是很好吗？
sense_groups.english: But isn't that a good thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你受够了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I mean, you said you were sick of this. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是通常怀孕完之后
sense_groups.english: It's just usually, when you're done with the pregnant thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是当妈妈
sense_groups.english: ...then you get to do the mom thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我却会穿着皮裤喝龙舌兰酒
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be, you know, sitting around in my leather pants, drinking tequila.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些妈妈也会那样
sense_groups.english: Some moms do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样更悲惨
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's even sadder.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这么做的复果
sense_groups.english: Look, I know what I got myself into, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们现在在我肚子里
sense_groups.english: It's just that now that they're in me, it's like...

sense_groups.chinese: 我彷佛了解他们
sense_groups.english: It's like I know them, you know, and...

sense_groups.chinese: 把他们送走时我会很难受
sense_groups.english: It just not gonna be easy when, you know, these little babies have to go away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh. I know, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你并不会一无所有
sense_groups.english: But it's not like you're not gonna have anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有侄子 侄女
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're gonna have nieces and nephews.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样甚至更棒
sense_groups.english: In some ways, that's even better.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来 - 不 是真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. - No, really.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必担心他们的大学学费
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're not gonna be the one worrying about saving for college.

sense_groups.chinese: 或在他们不乖时骂他们
sense_groups.english: Or yelling at them when they're bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 或在他们吵个不停时
sense_groups.english: You know? Or deciding to put them on Ritalin...

sense_groups.chinese: 喂他们吃立得宁
sense_groups.english: ...when they just won't calm down.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们逃家会来找你
sense_groups.english: You're gonna be the one they come to when they run away from home.

sense_groups.chinese: 会找你讨论性的问题
sense_groups.english: And the one they talk to about sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以当酷阿姨菲比
sense_groups.english: You just get to be cool Aunt Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷阿姨菲比
sense_groups.english: Cool Aunt Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是蛮酷的
sense_groups.english: I am pretty cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 他们一定会爱死你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and you know what else? Oh, my God, are they going to love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会爱死我
sense_groups.english: They are going to love me.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们… 再次成谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks, you guys. Again.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 喔… - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Oh! - What? Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: Just kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 天哪
sense_groups.english: Ah! - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 又骗到了 你们真好骗
sense_groups.english: Got you again. You're so easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是他发生什么事… - 乔伊 兽医说手术很简单
sense_groups.english: If anything should happen to him... - Joey, the vet said it's a simple procedure.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？搞不好会出错 要是他没撑过来呢？
sense_groups.english: So? Things can go wrong. You don't know. What if he doesn't make it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他会的 - 要是没有呢？
sense_groups.english: He will, Joe. - Yeah, but what if he doesn't?

sense_groups.chinese: 他这么乖巧
sense_groups.english: He's such a good duck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好担心他
sense_groups.english: I'm so worried about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人掉了戒指吗？
sense_groups.english: Somebody lose a ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 谢谢你 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Thank you. Thank you so much. Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 鸭子怎么样？
sense_groups.english: How's the duck?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很好 正在休息 你们可以去见他
sense_groups.english: He's doing just fine. You'll see him in a bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 罗斯 谢谢你这么好脾气
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, listen, Ross, thanks for being so cool about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 - 当然有关系
sense_groups.english: No, that's all right. - No, it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找我当伴郎 我却让你失望
sense_groups.english: I mean, you made me your best man and I totally let you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 又不是你的错 - 当然是
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on. It's not your fault. - Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就不会弄丢戒指
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't have lost the ring, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？罗斯 你是对的
sense_groups.english: You know what? Ross, you were right from the start.

sense_groups.chinese: 他才应该当你的伴郎 - 不 应该你当
sense_groups.english: He should be your best man. - No, you should.

sense_groups.chinese: 别吵了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Look, don't argue with me. - Hey, hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 伴郎是我选的
sense_groups.english: I get to choose my best man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个我都要
sense_groups.english: I want both you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都应该陪我站在台前
sense_groups.english: Both you guys should be up there with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是我的…
sense_groups.english: I mean, you two are my...

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个好朋友就…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm lucky to have just one good...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Well, thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去那边看看
sense_groups.english: I got to go check something, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 真孩子气 - 有够爱哭的
sense_groups.english: What a baby. - Total wuss.

questions.name: S04E23
questions.en:
You guys, hurry up. The flight leaves in four hours.
There could be traffic. The plane could leave early.
When we get to London, there could be a line at customs. Come on.
Six-hour trip to London. That's a lot of Monica.
Passport, check. Camera, check. Traveler's checks, check.
Who are you saying "check" to? - Myself.
For remembering to pack the thing.
You know, you do a good thing, you get a check.
My mom does it. I never realized it was weird.
Hey, my mom used to put her head in the oven, so...
Actually, she only did it the one time. But it was pretty weird.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey. Are you ready yet?
Yep. You got the tickets? - Oh, got them right here. Check.
It's all London, baby. Here we go.
You got your passport?
Yeah, in my third drawer of my dresser. You don't wanna lose that.
Oh. - There it is.
Okay, if you need the vacuum, it's in my closet on the left side.
The garbage bags are next to the refrigerator.
But Rachel's gonna be here too. Can't I just ask her?
Heh. Yeah, okay. Give that a try.
All right, let's do it. - Woohoo.
Yeah. Cheerio. - London, baby.
Because that's not gonna get annoying. - London, baby!
Oh, you know what? I was wrong.
Well, we're all here. I guess we should get going.
Oh, I wanna come over there and give you a hug...
...and wish you luck on your wedding, but I can't get up.
Oh, I'll come hug you. - Great, can you bring me the newspaper?
Yeah.
Have a great wedding. Oh. - Thanks.
Hey, Chandler, I wanna hug you too. - Hey.
And you might as well bring me my book. It's on the counter in your apartment.
So we're off. - Have fun.
Thanks.
Oh. I can't believe you're not gonna be there.
Oh, I know.
So come. Why don't you come? - What?
To London. Come to London. Please? It would mean so much to me.
Yeah, well, I gotta work. I'm sorry.
Why can't you take a couple of days off? - Because I can't. I told you. No, I can't.
This is my wedding.
All right, you know what? Now we are late. Let's go, let's go, let's go!
Fine, you'll watch it on video when we get back.
Here you go, Phoebe. Here you go, Phoebo, Phoobala, Phobayboo.
You. Ha, ha.
All right, let's go. Bye, Pheebs.
Bye. - Bye, Pheebs.
Mwah. Goodbye. Mwah.
Bye. - Safe flight.
London, baby.
Oh, God. - Oh. Do you need a hug?
You don't have to bring me anything.
All right, Chandler, do something.
Come on, do something. - I am. I'm ignoring you.
Okay, I'm gonna be the on-camera guy. All right.
First stop, Westminster Abbey.
Oh, what the hell is that? - That's London, baby.
All right, the hotel's here.
Wait. No, we wanna go...
No.
I know.
I'm gonna have to go into the map.
Okay, if you see a little version of me in there, kill it.
I got it.
Here we go.
Okay, listen, listen, we're not gonna have to walk this way the entire time, are we?
Shh.
Oh, man, you made me lose it.
And that was all before 10:00.
The caterer rang to say it's gonna be chicken kiev instead of tarragon.
The florist phoned to say there aren't any tulips.
Oh, and then the cellist has carpal tunnel syndrome...
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Emily, honey. Okay?
Well, up yours too. - What?
No, no. That's "time-out." - Sorry.
Sweetie, you gotta relax. Everything's gonna be great, okay?
Come on, come on.
Chicken kiev?
Doesn't that sound delicious at the last minute?
I know, but something like salmon would just...
It would be so much more elegant than chicken.
And you wouldn't have to worry about the salmonella.
Oh.
I can't wait to see where you're getting married.
Yes. This place is beautiful. Emily's parents got married here.
I still can't believe they're tearing it down.
It really is the most lovely building you'll ever see.
I mean, it's over...
Oh, my God.
It's nice.
Oh. Oh, my God.
How can this be happening? What are we gonna do?
Everything's gonna be all right.
How is it gonna be all right? - Uh-huh, I see that.
Okay, I talked to the guy and found out what happened.
What? - They tore it down a few days early.
All right.
Westminster Abbey.
Hands down, best abbey I ever seen.
Hey.
Okay.
What do you think of the abbey, Chandler?
Oh, I think it's great. They're thinking of changing the name.
Really? To what? - To "Put the Camera Away."
Man, you are Westminster Crabby.
Honey, don't get up. What do you need? - Oh, no. Oh, nothing.
Come on. I'm here to take care of you. What do you need? Anything.
Okay, I have a wedgie.
Okay, that is all you.
So, what do you want for lunch?
Oh, I don't know.
I guess we have to eat. - Yeah, I do.
What's the matter?
I'm just bummed the way I left things with Ross.
I wish I didn't lie to him about having to work.
He seemed so mad at me.
Ah, don't be so hard on yourself. If someone I was still in love with was...
Still in love with? - Yeah.
I'm not in love with Ross.
Oh.
No, no. Good.
Yeah, me neither.
Phoebe, I'm not going to Ross' wedding, because he's my ex-boyfriend...
...and that would be really uncomfortable.
Not because I'm still in love with him. Hey, I like Ross as much as the next guy.
You know, clearly I have feelings for him, but feelings don't mean love.
You know, I mean, do I still have loving feelings for Ross?
Yeah.
I have continuing feelings of love.
But that doesn't mean that I'm still in love with him.
You know, I mean, I have sexual feelings for him, but I do love him.
Oh, my God. Oh, my...
Why didn't you tell me?
We thought you knew. - We?
Yeah, we all know. We talk about it all the time.
You all know? Does Ross know?
Oh, no. Ross doesn't know anything.
Oh. I cannot believe you didn't tell me.
Because we thought you knew. It's so obvious.
God, it would be like, you know, telling Monica
"Hey," you know, "you like things clean."
Hi.
So, what are you fine gentlemen in the market for?
We've got scarves, souvenir postcards. - Check this out, huh?
Oh, yeah.
That's the stuff. What do you think?
Well, I'm not gonna have to buy that "I'm with stupid" T-shirt anymore.
Well, I like it. Here you go.
You're not really gonna buy that. Don't you think you've embarrassed me enough?
Oh, I embarrass you?
How can I answer that when I'm pretending I don't know you?
He's just jealous. You'll fit right in. All Londoners wear them.
Oh, really? Then how come no one here anywhere is wearing one?
They're all tourists.
All right, look, if you insist on wearing that in public, you know...
...you're gonna spend the rest of the afternoon all by yourself.
Oh, yeah?
If you're gonna make me choose between you and the hat, I choose the hat.
Good choice. - Thanks.
Okay, look. All right, that's it, okay?
I'm out of here. I'm not gonna be embarrassed anymore.
Hello? - Hey.
I just spoke to your dad, and you know what?
He thinks we'll be able to find a new place.
We don't have to. - What, you found a place?
No, but Monica and I were talking...
...and I was so upset about the hall being knocked down...
...and she suggested that we just put the wedding off for a bit.
She said what? - She said if I'm not happy...
...getting married somewhere we can find in a day, well, we should just postpone it.
Postpone it? Heh.
Emily, do you think Monica realizes how much our parents spent on this wedding?
Huh? Do you think my sister's teeny, tiny little brain comprehends...
...that people took time out of their lives...
...to fly thousands of miles to be here? Huh?
This isn't right.
I realize that people are gonna be disappointed.
But they'll come back when we can do it right.
Well, I can't ask people to do that. Would you ask people to do that?
Don't you point your pants at me.
We have no choice.
Anywhere that's half-decent will have been booked months ago.
Ross, don't you understand? This is our wedding.
The only thing I understand is postponing it is not an option.
This is when we're getting married.
What are you saying, it's now or never? - No, I'm saying it's now.
Or? - There's no "or" in mine.
What is wrong with these pants?
It's not the pants. It's you who's backwards.
And if you don't understand how important this is to me...
...perhaps we shouldn't be getting married at all.
Emily, no. Wait, stop. Emily, please...
Hey. - Hi.
So did shopping help you feel any better about Ross?
Manhattan does not have enough stores.
Well, I think I can help you get over him.
You can? - Yeah.
I just need you to bring me some photos of Ross...
...and, um, a small piece of chocolate...
...and a glass of tepid water.
Ooh. Is this one of those things where you throw stuff in a bag with graveyard dirt...
...and hang it from a north-facing tree?
Uh, only if you have the hiccups too.
The pictures are for you. The chocolate and water's for me.
I just didn't feel like getting up.
Okay. I'm gonna show you a picture of Ross, okay...
...and you're going to remember all the bad things about him, all right?
Really focus on his flaws. - I can do that.
Certainly did that while we were going out. Heh.
Okay. Mm.
Before we get started, I just wanna say, for the record, I love Ross.
I think he's such a great guy.
Okay. Now close your eyes.
And imagine that you're with Ross. - Mm-hm.
Okay, and imagine that you're kissing him. - Mm-hm.
You're running your hands all over his body.
And then you run your hands through his hair...
...but, oh, ew, gross, it's some kind of grease, it's... Ugh.
Ah?
I don't know.
I don't know, his hair never bothered me that much.
And you know, it was always more crunchy than it was greasy.
Okay. This is gonna be harder than I thought.
Um, ahem. Let's try some aversion therapy.
Okay. All right. - Okay? All right.
Look at the picture. - Okay.
All right, and, um...
Ow!
Okay. How do you feel now? - Well, I like you less.
Hey. - Hey.
Oh. Sorry. - No, no, you know what? I'm sorry.
I shouldn't have said you were embarrassing me.
That really wasn't cool.
And if it makes you feel any better, I've had a really lousy day.
Me too.
Yeah? - No!
I had the best day ever.
Dude, check this out.
Say hi to my friend and tell him you like my hat.
Okay, so, what's your friend's name? - Oh. Chandler.
Hi, Chandler.
That's... That's...
Oh, my God. - That's Fergie, baby!
Joey says you don't really like his hat, but I think it's kind of dashing.
When did you...? How...?
I was trying to figure out how to get to Buckingham Palace.
So I'm in my map and...
Hey. - Hey.
I understand you had a little talk with Emily.
Ha, ha. Yes, I did.
And you are welcome.
Am I?
And was it your idea to postpone the wedding?
I'm gonna go to the bathroom. - Wait up.
Hey, hey, since you're the fix-it lady, here's a pickle
What do you do when the bride says she doesn't wanna have the wedding at all?
She said that? - Yeah.
Why? - I don't know.
I told her it was stupid to put off the wedding just because the hall was gone...
...and she, like, flipped out.
Oh, my God. You're even dumber than I am.
Excuse me?
Ross, how long have you been planning this wedding?
I don't know. A month?
Emily has probably been planning it since she was 5.
Ever since the first time she took a pillowcase and hung it off her head.
That's what we did.
We dreamed about the perfect wedding.
In the perfect place.
With the perfect four-tiered wedding cake.
With the little people on top.
But the most important part...
...is that we had the perfect guy...
...who understood just how important all that other stuff was.
I had no idea.
That pillowcase thing, I thought you guys were just doing The Flying Nun.
Sometimes we were.
Come on.
You gotta help me figure out what to do.
Okay? - All right.
Come on.
Whoa. Pretty intense, huh? - Yeah.
I hope Ross didn't think we went in there because we were uncomfortable out here.
I hope he did.
Hello? - Hey, Pheebs, it's Joey.
Hey, Joey. Hey. Ooh, ooh.
I just saw someone that looks just like you on the subway.
I was gonna go over and say hi, but then I figured he doesn't care he looks like you.
That just cost me 4 bucks.
I just called to see how the chick and the duck are doing.
They're having a great time with Aunt Phoebe.
Aunt Rachel hasn't been helpful at all.
So do you miss me?
Kind of, but I've just been having way too much fun.
Oh, so you're not homesick yet?
No, I don't think so.
All right, well, the seven of us miss you.
Who's seven? - Well, you know, me, Rachel...
...the birds, the babies.
Aw, the babies miss me?
Ooh, pizza guy's here. - What? You ordered pizza without me?
Yeah, but we were thinking about you. We ordered the Joey Special.
Two pizzas?
Yeah. Okay, gotta go. Talk to you later. - Wait, wait. Where did you get it from?
Where everybody knows your name
And they're always glad you came
You wanna be where you can see The troubles are all the same
You wanna be Where everybody knows your name
Monica, why have you brought me here? - You'll see.
I tell you, this wedding is not gonna happen.
Oh, Ross.
Okay? But imagine a lot more lights, okay, and, you know, fewer bricks...
...and flowers and candles.
Okay, and the musicians, they can go over here, okay?
And the chairs, they can face this way and...
You go.
But if you don't love this, then we'll do it any other place...
...any other time.
Really, it's fine. Whatever you want.
It's perfect.
And, I don't know, if it starts to rain... - Well, then we'll get wet.
I don't even have a date.
Pheebs? - Yeah?
Do you remember where the duck food is?
Yeah, it's in the guys' apartment, under the sink. Why?
Because I'm going to London.
What? What do you mean, you're going to London?
Yeah, I have to tell Ross that I love him.
Now, honey, you take care, and you don't have those babies till I get back. Mwah.
Rachel, you can't go. Ross loves Emily.
I know, I know, I know he does, but I have to tell him how I feel.
He deserves to have all of the information. Then he can make an informed decision.
That's not why you're going. You're going because you hope he'll say
"Yeah, I love you too, Rach. Forget about that British chippie."
Do you think he will?
No, because he's in love with the British chippie.
Look, Rachel, if you go, you're just gonna mess with his head and ruin his wedding.
You know? It's too late. You missed your chance.
I'm sorry. I know this must be really hard.
But it's over.
You know what? No. It's not over until someone says "I do."
I do. I do! I do!
Yeah, like I can really chase you. I'm carrying a litter.

sense_groups.english: It's all London, baby. Here we go.

sense_groups.english: You got your passport?

sense_groups.chinese: 衣橱第三个抽屉 弄丢就糟了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, in my third drawer of my dresser. You don't wanna lose that.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 快去
sense_groups.english: Oh. - There it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 吸尘器在我的柜子里的左边
sense_groups.english: Okay, if you need the vacuum, it's in my closet on the left side.

sense_groups.chinese: 垃圾袋在冰箱旁边
sense_groups.english: The garbage bags are next to the refrigerator.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋会在 我不能问她吗？
sense_groups.english: But Rachel's gonna be here too. Can't I just ask her?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 你问啊
sense_groups.english: Heh. Yeah, okay. Give that a try.

sense_groups.chinese: 走啰 - 好耶
sense_groups.english: All right, let's do it. - Woohoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 恭喜恭喜 - 伦敦 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Cheerio. - London, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对不会觉得烦 - 伦敦 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Because that's not gonna get annoying. - London, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我错了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? I was wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 人都到了 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Well, we're all here. I guess we should get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想过去抱你…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wanna come over there and give you a hug...

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你 但是我起不来
sense_groups.english: ...and wish you luck on your wedding, but I can't get up.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我过去抱你 - 太好了 帮我拿报纸
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'll come hug you. - Great, can you bring me the newspaper?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 快快乐乐的结婚吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Have a great wedding. Oh. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我也想抱你 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, I wanna hug you too. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便去你家餐台把我的书拿来
sense_groups.english: And you might as well bring me my book. It's on the counter in your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要走了 - 玩得开心点
sense_groups.english: So we're off. - Have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然不能去
sense_groups.english: Oh. I can't believe you're not gonna be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 去嘛 你为什么不能去？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: So come. Why don't you come? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 去伦敦 一起去 拜托 我会很高兴
sense_groups.english: To London. Come to London. Please? It would mean so much to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要忙 对不起
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I gotta work. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不能请两天假？ - 我不行 我说过了
sense_groups.english: Why can't you take a couple of days off? - Because I can't. I told you. No, I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的婚礼
sense_groups.english: This is my wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的来不及了 走走走
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what? Now we are late. Let's go, let's go, let's go!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 回来再让你看录影带
sense_groups.english: Fine, you'll watch it on video when we get back.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你的书书 苏苏
sense_groups.english: Here you go, Phoebe. Here you go, Phoebo, Phoobala, Phobayboo.

sense_groups.chinese: 你啊
sense_groups.english: You. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 菲比再见
sense_groups.english: All right, let's go. Bye, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 菲比 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Mwah. Goodbye. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 旅途愉快
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Safe flight.

sense_groups.chinese: 伦敦 宝贝
sense_groups.english: London, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 - 你要抱抱吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. - Oh. Do you need a hug?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必拿东西给我
sense_groups.english: You don't have to bring me anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 做点动作
sense_groups.english: All right, Chandler, do something.

sense_groups.chinese: 做动作啊 - 我有啊 我在不理你
sense_groups.english: Come on, do something. - I am. I'm ignoring you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我来上镜头 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna be the on-camera guy. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一站 西敏寺
sense_groups.english: First stop, Westminster Abbey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 伦敦啊 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, what the hell is that? - That's London, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 饭店在这里
sense_groups.english: All right, the hotel's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 不对 我们要去…
sense_groups.english: Wait. No, we wanna go...

sense_groups.chinese: 不对
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得进入地图里
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna have to go into the map.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是里面有个小钱德 杀了它
sense_groups.english: Okay, if you see a little version of me in there, kill it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了
sense_groups.english: I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是要这样逛大街吧？
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen, listen, we're not gonna have to walk this way the entire time, are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你害我又乱了啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, you made me lose it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时候才10点
sense_groups.english: And that was all before 10:00.

sense_groups.chinese: 外烩打来说龙蒿鸡换成基辅鸡
sense_groups.english: The caterer rang to say it's gonna be chicken kiev instead of tarragon.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后花匠说没有郁金香了
sense_groups.english: The florist phoned to say there aren't any tulips.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后大提琴手得了 手腕隧道症候群…
sense_groups.english: Oh, and then the cellist has carpal tunnel syndrome...

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 亲爱的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. Emily, honey. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也去你的 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, up yours too. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是暂停的意思 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: No, no. That's "time-out." - Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松 一切都会很美好
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, you gotta relax. Everything's gonna be great, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚辅鸡？
sense_groups.english: Chicken kiev?

sense_groups.chinese: 临时能有这道菜不错吧？
sense_groups.english: Doesn't that sound delicious at the last minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 但鲑鱼这种食物…
sense_groups.english: I know, but something like salmon would just...

sense_groups.chinese: 会比鸡肉高雅
sense_groups.english: It would be so much more elegant than chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不必担心沙门氏菌
sense_groups.english: And you wouldn't have to worry about the salmonella.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想赶快看到婚礼场地
sense_groups.english: I can't wait to see where you're getting married.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对 那里很美 她父母就在那里结婚
sense_groups.english: Yes. This place is beautiful. Emily's parents got married here.

sense_groups.chinese: 它居然要被折了
sense_groups.english: I still can't believe they're tearing it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对没看过那么美的房子
sense_groups.english: It really is the most lovely building you'll ever see.

sense_groups.chinese: 就在…
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's over...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 还不错
sense_groups.english: It's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这样？怎么办？
sense_groups.english: How can this be happening? What are we gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 不会有问题的
sense_groups.english: Everything's gonna be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会没问题？ - 说得也是
sense_groups.english: How is it gonna be all right? - Uh-huh, I see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟一个人问到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I talked to the guy and found out what happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 提前进行拆除
sense_groups.english: What? - They tore it down a few days early.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 西敏寺
sense_groups.english: Westminster Abbey.

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对是我见过最美的寺
sense_groups.english: Hands down, best abbey I ever seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你觉得西敏寺如何？
sense_groups.english: What do you think of the abbey, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 很宏伟 他们正打算改名
sense_groups.english: Oh, I think it's great. They're thinking of changing the name.

sense_groups.chinese: 改成什么？ - 改成"摄影机收起来"
sense_groups.english: Really? To what? - To "Put the Camera Away."

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是西敏之狼
sense_groups.english: Man, you are Westminster Crabby.

sense_groups.chinese: 别起来 你需要什么？ - 没什么
sense_groups.english: Honey, don't get up. What do you need? - Oh, no. Oh, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是留下来照顾你的 你需要什么？
sense_groups.english: Come on. I'm here to take care of you. What do you need? Anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 屁屁夹到内裤了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I have a wedgie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己解决
sense_groups.english: Okay, that is all you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你中午想吃什么？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you want for lunch?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是得吃饭 - 我定要吃
sense_groups.english: I guess we have to eat. - Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我应付罗斯的方式真差劲
sense_groups.english: I'm just bummed the way I left things with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 真后悔骗他说我要工作
sense_groups.english: I wish I didn't lie to him about having to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 他好像很气我
sense_groups.english: He seemed so mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 别太苛责自己 要是我还爱的人要结婚…
sense_groups.english: Ah, don't be so hard on yourself. If someone I was still in love with was...

sense_groups.chinese: 还爱？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Still in love with? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有爱着罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm not in love with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是没有 很好
sense_groups.english: No, no. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也没有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不去是因为他是我的旧情人
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I'm not going to Ross' wedding, because he's my ex-boyfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 去了会很不自在
sense_groups.english: ...and that would be really uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是因为我还爱他 我跟大家一样喜欢罗斯
sense_groups.english: Not because I'm still in love with him. Hey, I like Ross as much as the next guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对他的确有成情 但那不是爱
sense_groups.english: You know, clearly I have feelings for him, but feelings don't mean love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对罗斯还有爱的感觉吗？
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, do I still have loving feelings for Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都有
sense_groups.english: I have continuing feelings of love.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那并不表示我还爱着他
sense_groups.english: But that doesn't mean that I'm still in love with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对他还有性趣 但我当然爱他
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, I have sexual feelings for him, but I do love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my...

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不告诉我？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以为你知道 - 我们？
sense_groups.english: We thought you knew. - We?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们都知道 还经常在聊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we all know. We talk about it all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都知道？罗斯知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You all know? Does Ross know?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 罗斯什么都不知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Ross doesn't know anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们居然没告诉我
sense_groups.english: Oh. I cannot believe you didn't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以为你知道 那么明显
sense_groups.english: Because we thought you knew. It's so obvious.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你等于告诉摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: God, it would be like, you know, telling Monica

sense_groups.chinese: "喂 你很爱干净喔"
sense_groups.english: "Hey," you know, "you like things clean."

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生想买什么？
sense_groups.english: So, what are you fine gentlemen in the market for?

sense_groups.chinese: 有围巾 明信片… - 你看
sense_groups.english: We've got scarves, souvenir postcards. - Check this out, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 棒极了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个就对了 你觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: That's the stuff. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不必买印着 "与笨蛋同行"的衣服了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not gonna have to buy that "I'm with stupid" T-shirt anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 钱给你
sense_groups.english: Well, I like it. Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是来真的吧 你丢我的脸丢得还不够吗？
sense_groups.english: You're not really gonna buy that. Don't you think you've embarrassed me enough?

sense_groups.chinese: 我丢你的脸？
sense_groups.english: Oh, I embarrass you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我假装不认识你 无法回答
sense_groups.english: How can I answer that when I'm pretending I don't know you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是在嫉妒 伦敦人都在戴
sense_groups.english: He's just jealous. You'll fit right in. All Londoners wear them.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？那这袒怎么没人戴？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? Then how come no one here anywhere is wearing one?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都是观光客
sense_groups.english: They're all tourists.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要当街戴着那顶帽子
sense_groups.english: All right, look, if you insist on wearing that in public, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 下午你就自己去逛
sense_groups.english: ...you're gonna spend the rest of the afternoon all by yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果要在你和帽子之间做选择 我选择帽子
sense_groups.english: If you're gonna make me choose between you and the hat, I choose the hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 够英明 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Good choice. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 够了
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. All right, that's it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了 我不想再丢脸了
sense_groups.english: I'm out of here. I'm not gonna be embarrassed anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈啰 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你爸谈过 你猜怎样？
sense_groups.english: I just spoke to your dad, and you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 他觉得可以另外找到场地
sense_groups.english: He thinks we'll be able to find a new place.

sense_groups.chinese: 不必了 - 你找到地方了？
sense_groups.english: We don't have to. - What, you found a place?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但摩妮卡和我讨论过
sense_groups.english: No, but Monica and I were talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 我为了礼堂被拆的事很烦
sense_groups.english: ...and I was so upset about the hall being knocked down...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果她建议把婚期延后
sense_groups.english: ...and she suggested that we just put the wedding off for a bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说什么？ - 她说如果我不喜欢…
sense_groups.english: She said what? - She said if I'm not happy...

sense_groups.chinese: 临时找个地方 我们就应该延期
sense_groups.english: ...getting married somewhere we can find in a day, well, we should just postpone it.

sense_groups.chinese: 延期？
sense_groups.english: Postpone it? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 你觉得摩妮卡知道 我们爸妈花了多少钱吗？
sense_groups.english: Emily, do you think Monica realizes how much our parents spent on this wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我妹的小脑袋能理解
sense_groups.english: Huh? Do you think my sister's teeny, tiny little brain comprehends...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家特地挪出时间
sense_groups.english: ...that people took time out of their lives...

sense_groups.chinese: 大老远飞来这里吗？
sense_groups.english: ...to fly thousands of miles to be here? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 这么做是不对的
sense_groups.english: This isn't right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道大家会失望
sense_groups.english: I realize that people are gonna be disappointed.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们下次一定会再来
sense_groups.english: But they'll come back when we can do it right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能叫人家这么做 你会吗
sense_groups.english: Well, I can't ask people to do that. Would you ask people to do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 别拿你的裤子指着我
sense_groups.english: Don't you point your pants at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们别无选择
sense_groups.english: We have no choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 像样一点的场地一定没空档
sense_groups.english: Anywhere that's half-decent will have been booked months ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不懂吗？罗斯 这是我们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Ross, don't you understand? This is our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道延期是不可能的
sense_groups.english: The only thing I understand is postponing it is not an option.

sense_groups.chinese: 要结就现在结
sense_groups.english: This is when we're getting married.

sense_groups.chinese: 意思是否则就不结罗？ - 不 我是说现在就结
sense_groups.english: What are you saying, it's now or never? - No, I'm saying it's now.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则呢？ - 我没说否则
sense_groups.english: Or? - There's no "or" in mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这条裤子是怎么搞的？
sense_groups.english: What is wrong with these pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是裤子 是你本末倒置
sense_groups.english: It's not the pants. It's you who's backwards.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你不懂这件事对我多重要
sense_groups.english: And if you don't understand how important this is to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们根本不该结婚
sense_groups.english: ...perhaps we shouldn't be getting married at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 等一下 别走
sense_groups.english: Emily, no. Wait, stop. Emily, please...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 血拼完有舒服一点吗？
sense_groups.english: So did shopping help you feel any better about Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 曼哈顿的店不够
sense_groups.english: Manhattan does not have enough stores.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮你忘了他
sense_groups.english: Well, I think I can help you get over him.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You can? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿几张罗斯的照片…
sense_groups.english: I just need you to bring me some photos of Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 一小片巧克力…
sense_groups.english: ...and, um, a small piece of chocolate...

sense_groups.chinese: 和一杯温水来
sense_groups.english: ...and a glass of tepid water.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是要跟墓地的土装在一起
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Is this one of those things where you throw stuff in a bag with graveyard dirt...

sense_groups.chinese: 挂在面北的树上？
sense_groups.english: ...and hang it from a north-facing tree?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你也在打喝的话
sense_groups.english: Uh, only if you have the hiccups too.

sense_groups.chinese: 照片是给你的 其他是我要的
sense_groups.english: The pictures are for you. The chocolate and water's for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不想起来
sense_groups.english: I just didn't feel like getting up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给你看一张罗斯的照片 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm gonna show you a picture of Ross, okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去想他不好的地方
sense_groups.english: ...and you're going to remember all the bad things about him, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 专心想他的缺点 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Really focus on his flaws. - I can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交往时我就这样
sense_groups.english: Certainly did that while we were going out. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我想先声明 我爱罗斯
sense_groups.english: Before we get started, I just wanna say, for the record, I love Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的好棒
sense_groups.english: I think he's such a great guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 闭上眼睛
sense_groups.english: Okay. Now close your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你跟罗斯在一起 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: And imagine that you're with Ross. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你在亲他 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Okay, and imagine that you're kissing him. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的手在他的身上游移
sense_groups.english: You're running your hands all over his body.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的手抚弄他的头发
sense_groups.english: And then you run your hands through his hair...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是好念 是某种油
sense_groups.english: ...but, oh, ew, gross, it's some kind of grease, it's... Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊？
sense_groups.english: Ah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的头发没那么困扰我
sense_groups.english: I don't know, his hair never bothered me that much.

sense_groups.chinese: 那应该算是硬而不是油
sense_groups.english: And you know, it was always more crunchy than it was greasy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 难度比我想的还高
sense_groups.english: Okay. This is gonna be harder than I thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 试试厌恶疗法好了
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem. Let's try some aversion therapy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好吧 - 怎么样？好
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. - Okay? All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 看着照片 - 好
sense_groups.english: Look at the picture. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 然后
sense_groups.english: All right, and, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在觉得怎样？ - 我比较不喜欢你了
sense_groups.english: Okay. How do you feel now? - Well, I like you less.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 - 我才抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sorry. - No, no, you know what? I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该说你丢我的脸
sense_groups.english: I shouldn't have said you were embarrassing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样很过份
sense_groups.english: That really wasn't cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你会高兴一点 我今天过得很悲惨
sense_groups.english: And if it makes you feel any better, I've had a really lousy day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 才怪
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 我玩得超过瘾的
sense_groups.english: I had the best day ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: Dude, check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我朋友你喜欢我的帽子
sense_groups.english: Say hi to my friend and tell him you like my hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你朋友叫什么？ - 钱德
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, what's your friend's name? - Oh. Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德你好
sense_groups.english: Hi, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是…
sense_groups.english: That's... That's...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 那是佛姬 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - That's Fergie, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊说你不喜欢他的帽子 但我觉得蛮时髦的
sense_groups.english: Joey says you don't really like his hat, but I think it's kind of dashing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会… 什么时候…
sense_groups.english: When did you...? How...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想去白金汉宫
sense_groups.english: I was trying to figure out how to get to Buckingham Palace.

sense_groups.chinese: 就进入地图 然后…
sense_groups.english: So I'm in my map and...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说你和艾蜜莉谈过
sense_groups.english: I understand you had a little talk with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Yes, I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: And you are welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 是你提议把婚期延后的？
sense_groups.english: And was it your idea to postpone the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要上厕所 - 等我
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to the bathroom. - Wait up.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你这么会解决问题 问题来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, since you're the fix-it lady, here's a pickle

sense_groups.chinese: 当新娘说她不想结婚时 你怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What do you do when the bride says she doesn't wanna have the wedding at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 她这么说？ - 对
sense_groups.english: She said that? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说为了礼堂被拆就延期很蠢
sense_groups.english: I told her it was stupid to put off the wedding just because the hall was gone...

sense_groups.chinese: 她就捉狂了
sense_groups.english: ...and she, like, flipped out.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你比我还笨
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You're even dumber than I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你筹备这次婚礼多久了？
sense_groups.english: Ross, how long have you been planning this wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得 1个月吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know. A month?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉可能从5岁就在计划了
sense_groups.english: Emily has probably been planning it since she was 5.

sense_groups.chinese: 从她第一次把枕头套 彼在头上开始
sense_groups.english: Ever since the first time she took a pillowcase and hung it off her head.

sense_groups.chinese: 女生都这样
sense_groups.english: That's what we did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们梦想在一个完美的场地
sense_groups.english: We dreamed about the perfect wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 办一场完美的婚礼
sense_groups.english: In the perfect place.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个完美的四层结婚蛋糕
sense_groups.english: With the perfect four-tiered wedding cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面有小人偶
sense_groups.english: With the little people on top.

sense_groups.chinese: 但最重要的是…
sense_groups.english: But the most important part...

sense_groups.chinese: 有个完美的男人
sense_groups.english: ...is that we had the perfect guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 了解这一切对我们有多重要
sense_groups.english: ...who understood just how important all that other stuff was.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都不知道
sense_groups.english: I had no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你披枕头套 是在学《飞天修女》
sense_groups.english: That pillowcase thing, I thought you guys were just doing The Flying Nun.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候是啦
sense_groups.english: Sometimes we were.

sense_groups.chinese: 别哭了
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我想想办法
sense_groups.english: You gotta help me figure out what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay? - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 场面蛮紧张的 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Pretty intense, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望罗斯不会以为 我们是怕尴尬才进厕所
sense_groups.english: I hope Ross didn't think we went in there because we were uncomfortable out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望他就是这么想的
sense_groups.english: I hope he did.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 菲比 我是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Hey, Pheebs, it's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. Hey. Ooh, ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在地铁看到一个很像你的人
sense_groups.english: I just saw someone that looks just like you on the subway.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正想打招呼 又想到他不会在乎他长得像你
sense_groups.english: I was gonna go over and say hi, but then I figured he doesn't care he looks like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你讲了我4块钱
sense_groups.english: That just cost me 4 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打来问小鸡小鸭好不好
sense_groups.english: I just called to see how the chick and the duck are doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们跟菲比阿姨玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: They're having a great time with Aunt Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋阿姨没什么用
sense_groups.english: Aunt Rachel hasn't been helpful at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想我吗？
sense_groups.english: So do you miss me?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点 但我玩得太高兴了
sense_groups.english: Kind of, but I've just been having way too much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没想家？
sense_groups.english: Oh, so you're not homesick yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 应该没有
sense_groups.english: No, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们七个都很想你
sense_groups.english: All right, well, the seven of us miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪七个？ - 我 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Who's seven? - Well, you know, me, Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 鸡鸭 宝宝
sense_groups.english: ...the birds, the babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝也想我？
sense_groups.english: Aw, the babies miss me?

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨来了 你们趁我不在叫彼萨？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, pizza guy's here. - What? You ordered pizza without me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我们有想着你 我们点了乔伊特餐
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but we were thinking about you. We ordered the Joey Special.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个披萨？
sense_groups.english: Two pizzas?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我得挂了 再聊 - 等等 你们叫哪家的？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay, gotta go. Talk to you later. - Wait, wait. Where did you get it from?

sense_groups.chinese: 人人都知道你的名字
sense_groups.english: Where everybody knows your name

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很高兴你能来
sense_groups.english: And they're always glad you came

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要 你可以看到困境都是相同的
sense_groups.english: You wanna be where you can see The troubles are all the same

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要每个人知道你的名字
sense_groups.english: You wanna be Where everybody knows your name

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你带我来这里干什么？ - 等着瞧
sense_groups.english: Monica, why have you brought me here? - You'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你讲 我们不会结婚了
sense_groups.english: I tell you, this wedding is not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但想像更多灯火 少一点砖瓦
sense_groups.english: Okay? But imagine a lot more lights, okay, and, you know, fewer bricks...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有鲜花蜡烛
sense_groups.english: ...and flowers and candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 乐队可以摆在这里
sense_groups.english: Okay, and the musicians, they can go over here, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 椅子可以朝这边 然后…
sense_groups.english: And the chairs, they can face this way and...

sense_groups.chinese: 你讲
sense_groups.english: You go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过要是你不喜欢 我们就改地点
sense_groups.english: But if you don't love this, then we'll do it any other place...

sense_groups.chinese: 改时间
sense_groups.english: ...any other time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的没关系 你高兴就好
sense_groups.english: Really, it's fine. Whatever you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很完美
sense_groups.english: It's perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 要是下雨… - 那就淋湿吧
sense_groups.english: And, I don't know, if it starts to rain... - Well, then we'll get wet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我连男朋友都没有
sense_groups.english: I don't even have a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得饲料在哪里吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you remember where the duck food is?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 在男生那边的水槽下面 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's in the guys' apartment, under the sink. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我要去伦敦
sense_groups.english: Because I'm going to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？什么叫你要去伦敦？
sense_groups.english: What? What do you mean, you're going to London?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉罗斯我爱他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I have to tell Ross that I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重 等我回来再生
sense_groups.english: Now, honey, you take care, and you don't have those babies till I get back. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能去 罗斯爱的是艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you can't go. Ross loves Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但我得告诉他我的成觉
sense_groups.english: I know, I know, I know he does, but I have to tell him how I feel.

sense_groups.chinese: 他应该知道所有状况 好做出知道状况的决定
sense_groups.english: He deserves to have all of the information. Then he can make an informed decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪 你去是希望他说
sense_groups.english: That's not why you're going. You're going because you hope he'll say

sense_groups.chinese: "我也爱你 别理那个英国妹了"
sense_groups.english: "Yeah, I love you too, Rach. Forget about that British chippie."

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他会吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think he will?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 因为他爱那个英国妹
sense_groups.english: No, because he's in love with the British chippie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去了只会把他搞乱 毁了他的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Look, Rachel, if you go, you're just gonna mess with his head and ruin his wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 太迟了 你错过机会了
sense_groups.english: You know? It's too late. You missed your chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你一定很难受
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I know this must be really hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 但已经结束了
sense_groups.english: But it's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 有人说"我愿意" 才算结束
sense_groups.english: You know what? No. It's not over until someone says "I do."

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意…
sense_groups.english: I do. I do! I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁追得上你 我怀了一窝猪仔
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like I can really chase you. I'm carrying a litter.

questions.name: S04E24
questions.en:
I can't believe you won't be there. - I know.

Because I can't. - This is my wedding.
I can't wait to see it. - Her parents got married there.
It's the most beautiful place. It's right over...
Oh, my God!
The only thing I understand is postponing is not an option.
This wedding is not gonna happen.
If you don't love this, then we'll do it any other place or time. It's fine.
It's perfect.
I'm going to London. - What?
It's not over until someone says, "I do."
I do! I do! I do!
Rachel, no!
The Waltham residence.
Hi, is this Emily's parents' house?
This is the housekeeper.

I was wondering, please...
...if it's not too much trouble, please...
...um, might I speak with Miss Emily Waltham, please?

Hello? Hello? Oh!

Hi, sweetheart.
Mom, Dad.
Oh, sorry, we're late.

Judy, the kids!

Oh!
I thought...
Dad, we got it.
Oh! Here comes my dad and stepmom.
Mr. And Mrs. Geller.
This is Steven...
How do you do? Very nice to meet you.
Ha, ha! - Eh, darling, the Gellers.
Darling, it's the Gellers.
She's self-involved. I should never have married her.
Sorry, what? - It's the Gellers.
Where? - That's one and that's another one.
Lovely to meet you.
Nice of you to pay for half the wedding.
Oh, the hell with tradition! We're happy to do it.
Oh, we know how expensive weddings can be.
Besides, this may be the only wedding we get to throw.
A joke that's funny in all countries.
Sir?
What's in it? - Goat cheese, watercress and pancetta.
That's not food.
No, I don't want it.
Everything's different here. I want to go home.
I miss my family, the coffeehouse.
I can't remember what Phoebe looks like!
Joey, it's been three days.
Okay, you're just a little homesick.
Would you just try to relax and just enjoy yourself?
You're different here too.
You're mean in England!
What the hell?
What's up, Dad?
This bill for my half. It's insane.
Why is it so much? The reception's at their house.
Flowers, liquor. Re-carpet first floor?
New guest bath, landscaping.
I'm paying to remodel this house.
I'll give that son of a bitch a piece of my mind.
Dad. Please.
I don't want anything to upset Emily.
She's had a hard enough couple of days as it is.
Here. Let me go talk to him.
You tell him no one takes advantage of the Gellers.
Ooh, Jack.
Sometimes I forget how powerful you can be.
And I'll go get drunk.
Hi. - Hello.
Hello.
Um, when is your next flight to London?
There's one leaving in 30 minutes. - Oh!
And I do have one seat left.
Oh, thank you, thank you.
The last-minute fare on this ticket is $2700.
Ugh. I don't have enough left on my credit card.
You can split it with another card.
Okay, how about five?
Oh, thank you.
I need to see your passport.
I don't have it, but I can tell you where it is on my nightstand.
You know what? I have my driver's license.
And I have a 20.
Face it, my father is not gonna pay for the built-in barbecue.
And believe me, you can kiss your gazebo goodbye.
I might be able to get you the new lawn.
Ah! Then you have to give us the lawn ornaments.
I go back there with lawn ornaments, he'll laugh in my face.
Will you say something, Steven?
Don't take that tone with me.
All right, you can.
Hi, Pheebs. - Oh, thank God!
Oh, you changed your mind. Ugh!
You probably don't want to talk about it.
You're doing the right thing.
Bye, Pheebs. - Where are you going?
What are you doing? No, wait.
Why am I always pregnant when she does that?
I'd like to toast Ross and Emily.
My big toast is tomorrow.
This is kind of my little toast, or Melba toast, if you will.
Okay.
Ahem. I knew Ross when he was, uh, going out with his first girlfriend.
I thought things would work out until he over-inflated her.
Oh, dear God!
Hello, Waltham Interiors.
Oh! Hi, Mrs. Waltham.
I need to speak with, um, one of the best men or Ross' sister.
Who is this? - Oh, Phoebe, one of Ross' best friends.
If you're Ross' friend, why aren't you here?
Um, I can't fly. I'm having my brother's babies.
Am I on the radio?
No. Um...
...can I talk to one of them? It's important.
I'm bored of you now. I'm going to cut you off.
We're excited that, uh, Ross and Emily are getting married at Montgomery Hall.
To think, my friend getting married in Monty Hall.
Oh, come on, Monty Hall!
Let's Make a Deal. Come on, you people!
All right, forget it. Congratulations, Ross and Emily.
Hey. Best man number two, Joey Tribbiani. Ha, ha.
I'm not good with the jokes like Chandler here.
But, uh...
...congratulations to the happy couple.
I first met Ross in this coffeehouse back home.
Home.
New York City.
Where everybody knows my name.
Uh, anyway...
...uh, I love you guys.
But not as much as I love America.
Can we please go home now?
Are you going home?
I was hoping to get to know you better.
I'm not going anywhere, sweetheart.
I was laughing.
Out loud?
I didn't want everyone to think I was stupid.
So how are you doing?
My mom's driving me crazy. But Ross is getting married!
I'm happy. I won't let anything spoil that.
I just want to say that Ross is a wonderful young man.
Oh, thanks. We like him. Ha, ha.
My God! You must have been a teenager when you had him.
There's no way in hell I'm paying for it.
Look, we're down to just one point.
Could we please just settle it after the wedding?
Fine, but I'm not paying for your wine cellar...
...you thieving, would-be-speaking- German-if-it-weren't-for-us man!
The guy was hammered. There's no way you look like Ross' mother.
Then why would he say it? - Because he's crazy!
Earlier, he thanked me for my very moving performance in Titanic.
My mother's right. I'll never get married.
Ha! You know what, that is...
Who wouldn't want you?
Please! I'm a single mom with a 30-year-old son.
I'm getting married today!
Whoo! Heh.
Morning.
I'm getting married today!
Yeah, you are. - Woo-hoo!
Do you think he knew I was here?
I've never done that with you before. Heh.
Nope. Ha, ha.
So, uh, how are you?
You okay?
Yeah, yeah.
You? - Oh, yes, yes.
You?
We did you.
Well...
I better get going. - Oh, absolutely. Ha, ha.
Could you not look?
