Whoo! Heh.
Morning.
I'm getting married today!
Yeah, you are. - Woo-hoo!
Do you think he knew I was here?
I've never done that with you before. Heh.
Nope. Ha, ha.
So, uh, how are you?
You okay?
Yeah, yeah.
You? - Oh, yes, yes.
You?
We did you.
Well...
I better get going. - Oh, absolutely. Ha, ha.
Could you not look?
I don't want to look.
Uh, uh, excuse me. - Yeah.
If you're planning on doing that the entire flight...
...please tell me now so that I can take a sedative.
Or maybe slip you one.
It's just, I'm, uh, kind of excited.
I'm, um, going to London to, uh, tell this guy that I love him.
Hello. - Where the hell have you been?
I spent the night out. I met this cute bridesmaid. She is...
I don't want to hear it!
Aw, Pheebs, you know you're still my number one girl.
We have an emergency. Rachel's coming to London.
Oh, great!
No, she's coming to tell Ross that she loves him.
But he loves Emily.
I know that!
You have to stop her. She's going to ruin the wedding.
Okay.
I've done my part, okay?
It's your responsibility now. The burden is off me.
Right.
So tell me about this girl.
Hey. Have you seen Monica?
I'm not seeing Monica.
What? - What?
Look, we gotta find her.
Phoebe called. Rachel's coming to tell Ross she loves him.
Oh, my God. - I know. We gotta find Monica.
Know where she is? - No, okay?
What's with the third degree? Why don't you just shine a light in my eyes?
Then I realized all this stuff I had been doing...
...proposing to Joshua, lying about why I couldn't come...
...was all just a way of...
I'm sorry. Can I interrupt?
I just want to say that you are a horrible, horrible person.
Pardon me?
You're about to ruin the happiest day of his life.
I have to agree with your friend Pheebs.
This is a terrible, terrible plan.
But he has to know how I feel. - But why?
He loves this Emily. No good can come of this.
Ugh! I think you're wrong.
Oh, no!
By the way, it seems to be clear you were on a break.
Oh, my God!
It's like a fairyland.
I know. It's horrible, isn't it?
I love it. I only hope my wedding looks this good.
Ha! I just hope... - You can let some go by.
Psst. Monica.
Start looking out for Rachel.
I'll cover the door. You watch that big hole.
I've got Chandler covering Ross.
Why would I care where Chandler is? Heh.
You know, uh...
...sometimes I don't even like Chandler.
Okay. - Heh.
I do.
I do.
Oh, it's the second one.
Right?
Hello, Joey.
Hey, Felicity.
Um, I thought about you all day.
Yeah?
Talk New York to me again.
Forget about it.
How you doing?
We're not paying for your wine cellar.
You have to meet me in the middle.
My foot will meet the middle of your ass.
What's going on? - Oh, everything's under control.
You want a piece of me? Is that what you're saying?
That's it!
Parents! Parents! Back away!
This is our wedding day!
From now on, everyone gets along.
And if I hear one more word...
...no grandchildren!
That's right!
Okay, okay.
Sorry, old boy.
Sorry. Sorry.
I could kill you with my thumb, you know.
What was that about?
It was this disagreement over...
My God! You look beautiful.
Oh! You can't see me before the wedding. It's bad luck.
I think we've had all the bad luck we're going to have.
My God, heh, Rachel!
You're here. I can't believe it.
Why are you here?
I just came to...
I just needed to tell you...
...congratulations.
Waltham Interiors.
Mrs. Waltham? It's Phoebe.
Can I talk to one of the best men? This is going to be the last time.
There's a girl on the phone for you.
Oh, great!
Hello?
It's Phoebe.
Did you stop Rachel?
But she just hugged him. That's it.
Nothing got ruined? - No.
Oh, that's so great!
Oh! So, what's going on now?
...I'm walking down the aisle.
Still walking.
Now I'm at the front with Ross.
It's Phoebe!
He looks pretty mad.
Uh, I better go.
Wait! Hold it up so I can listen.
What we did last night was... - Stupid. Hmm.
Totally crazy, stupid. - Ha, ha.
What were we thinking? Heh.
I'm coming over tonight though, right?
Oh, yeah, definitely.
Friends, family...
...we are gathered to celebrate...
...the joyous union of Ross and Emily.
May the happiness of today...
...be with them always.
Now, Emily, repeat after me.
I, Emily. - I, Emily.
Take thee, Ross. - Take thee, Ross.
As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health...
...till death parts us.
As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health...
...until death parts us.
Now, Ross.
Repeat after me.
I, Ross.
Take thee, Emily.
Take thee, Rachel...
Emily!
Ha. Emily.
Shall I go on?

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然不能去 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you won't be there. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不能请两天假？
sense_groups.english: Why can't you take a couple of days off?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不行 我说过了 - 这是我的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Because I can't. - This is my wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想赶快看到婚礼场地 - 她父母就在那里结婚
sense_groups.english: I can't wait to see it. - Her parents got married there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对没看过 那么美的房子 就在…
sense_groups.english: It's the most beautiful place. It's right over...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道延期是不可能的
sense_groups.english: The only thing I understand is postponing is not an option.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会结婚了
sense_groups.english: This wedding is not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你不喜欢 我们就改地点 改时问 真的没关系
sense_groups.english: If you don't love this, then we'll do it any other place or time. It's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很完美
sense_groups.english: It's perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去伦敦 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm going to London. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人说"我愿意"才算结束
sense_groups.english: It's not over until someone says, "I do."

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意…
sense_groups.english: I do! I do! I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 不
sense_groups.english: Rachel, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 华森公馆
sense_groups.english: The Waltham residence.

sense_groups.chinese: 是艾蜜莉的父母家吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, is this Emily's parents' house?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是管家
sense_groups.english: This is the housekeeper.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 小姐 讲电话不能这样讲
sense_groups.english: And, by the way, that is not how one addresses a person on the telephone.

sense_groups.chinese: 先表明身份
sense_groups.english: First one identifies oneself...

sense_groups.chinese: 再请你想找的人过来
sense_groups.english: ...and then asks for the person with whom one wishes to speak.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菲比布非
sense_groups.english: Um, this is Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是想麻烦你
sense_groups.english: I was wondering, please...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是很麻烦的话
sense_groups.english: ...if it's not too much trouble, please...

sense_groups.chinese: 我能和艾蜜莉华森小姐通话吗？
sense_groups.english: ...um, might I speak with Miss Emily Waltham, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 华森小姐去排练餐会了
sense_groups.english: Miss Waltham is at the rehearsal dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘲弄别人的口音是不礼貌的 再见
sense_groups.english: And it is not polite to make fun of people. Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我会有礼貌 我发誓
sense_groups.english: No, no! I'll be nice, I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以把电话给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you just give me their number?

sense_groups.chinese: 我恐怕没有权利泄露这项讯息
sense_groups.english: I'm afraid I'm not at liberty to divulge that information.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人正要去破坏婚礼 我得警告他们
sense_groups.english: Somebody is on their way to ruin the wedding, and I have to warn them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不给我号码 我就杀到伦敦
sense_groups.english: So give me that number or I'll come over there...

sense_groups.chinese: 把你一脚瑞到新咕噜肯夏去
sense_groups.english: ...and I'll kick your snooty ass all the way to New Gloukenshire!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂…
sense_groups.english: Hello? Hello? Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道我说到做到
sense_groups.english: Ooh, she knew I could kick her ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 乖儿子
sense_groups.english: Hi, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 爸
sense_groups.english: Mom, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉迟到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry, we're late.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我不好 我坚持要坐管子
sense_groups.english: My fault. I insisted on riding the tube.

sense_groups.chinese: 茱蒂 孩子都在
sense_groups.english: Judy, the kids!

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 那是地铁的俗称
sense_groups.english: That's what they call the subway.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为…
sense_groups.english: I thought...

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我们懂
sense_groups.english: Dad, we got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸和继母来了
sense_groups.english: Oh! Here comes my dad and stepmom.

sense_groups.chinese: 伯父 伯母
sense_groups.english: Mr. And Mrs. Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是史蒂芬…
sense_groups.english: This is Steven...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 幸会
sense_groups.english: How do you do? Very nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 - 老婆 是盖勒家的人
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha! - Eh, darling, the Gellers.

sense_groups.chinese: 老婆 是亲家
sense_groups.english: Darling, it's the Gellers.

sense_groups.chinese: 她只想着自己 我不该娶她的
sense_groups.english: She's self-involved. I should never have married her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？ - 是盖勒家的人
sense_groups.english: Sorry, what? - It's the Gellers.

sense_groups.chinese: 在哪里？ - 那边个 那边个
sense_groups.english: Where? - That's one and that's another one.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你们
sense_groups.english: Lovely to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们出一半的钱
sense_groups.english: Nice of you to pay for half the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 去他的习俗 我们很乐意
sense_groups.english: Oh, the hell with tradition! We're happy to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道结个婚有多花钱
sense_groups.english: Oh, we know how expensive weddings can be.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且以后可能就没机会了
sense_groups.english: Besides, this may be the only wedding we get to throw.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个世界通行的笑话
sense_groups.english: A joke that's funny in all countries.

sense_groups.chinese: 您要吗？
sense_groups.english: Sir?

sense_groups.chinese: 里面包什么？ - 羊酪 水田芥和义式培根
sense_groups.english: What's in it? - Goat cheese, watercress and pancetta.

sense_groups.chinese: 这能吃吗？
sense_groups.english: That's not food.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要呢
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里的东西都不一样 我想回家
sense_groups.english: Everything's different here. I want to go home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想念我的家人 想念咖啡馆
sense_groups.english: I miss my family, the coffeehouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 我连菲比的长相都不记得了
sense_groups.english: I can't remember what Phoebe looks like!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才来三天
sense_groups.english: Joey, it's been three days.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是想家了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're just a little homesick.

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松 好好玩就对了
sense_groups.english: Would you just try to relax and just enjoy yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 连你都变了
sense_groups.english: You're different here too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在英国好坏
sense_groups.english: You're mean in England!

sense_groups.chinese: 搞什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's up, Dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的这份帐单太扯了
sense_groups.english: This bill for my half. It's insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这么贵？请客是在家里请
sense_groups.english: Why is it so much? The reception's at their house.

sense_groups.chinese: 花 酒 一楼重铺地毯？
sense_groups.english: Flowers, liquor. Re-carpet first floor?

sense_groups.chinese: 新的客用浴室 造景
sense_groups.english: New guest bath, landscaping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在出钱让他们装修
sense_groups.english: I'm paying to remodel this house.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把那个混蛋骂一顿
sense_groups.english: I'll give that son of a bitch a piece of my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 别激动
sense_groups.english: Dad. Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想让艾蜜莉不闲心
sense_groups.english: I don't want anything to upset Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 她这两天已经够心烦了
sense_groups.english: She's had a hard enough couple of days as it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我 我去跟他谈
sense_groups.english: Here. Let me go talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他谁也别想占盖勒家便宜
sense_groups.english: You tell him no one takes advantage of the Gellers.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克
sense_groups.english: Ooh, Jack.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我都忘了你多有气概
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I forget how powerful you can be.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去喝个烂醉
sense_groups.english: And I'll go get drunk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一班飞往伦敦的班机？
sense_groups.english: Um, when is your next flight to London?

sense_groups.chinese: 半小时后有一班 - 噢
sense_groups.english: There's one leaving in 30 minutes. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 还剩一个空位
sense_groups.english: And I do have one seat left.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 临时票的价钱是2700元
sense_groups.english: The last-minute fare on this ticket is $2700.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的信用卡额度不够
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I don't have enough left on my credit card.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以分两张刷
sense_groups.english: You can split it with another card.

sense_groups.chinese: 五张可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, how about five?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请出示护照
sense_groups.english: I need to see your passport.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没带 不过我可以告诉你 它就在我的床头柜上
sense_groups.english: I don't have it, but I can tell you where it is on my nightstand.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 我有驾照
sense_groups.english: You know what? I have my driver's license.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一张20元钞票
sense_groups.english: And I have a 20.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我爸不会付内建烤炉的钱
sense_groups.english: Face it, my father is not gonna pay for the built-in barbecue.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 凉亭也免谈
sense_groups.english: And believe me, you can kiss your gazebo goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我或许可以争取到新草皮
sense_groups.english: I might be able to get you the new lawn.

sense_groups.chinese: 那也得给草坪的装饰品
sense_groups.english: Ah! Then you have to give us the lawn ornaments.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要是答应会被我爸笑死
sense_groups.english: I go back there with lawn ornaments, he'll laugh in my face.

sense_groups.chinese: 史蒂芬 你说句话好吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you say something, Steven?

sense_groups.chinese: 别对我这么不客气
sense_groups.english: Don't take that tone with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 随你
sense_groups.english: All right, you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: Hi, Pheebs. - Oh, thank God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你改变心意了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you changed your mind. Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在或许想静一静
sense_groups.english: You probably don't want to talk about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你这么做是对的
sense_groups.english: You're doing the right thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 等等 你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Bye, Pheebs. - Where are you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 你又想干什么？等等
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? No, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么每次她这样 我都在怀孕
sense_groups.english: Why am I always pregnant when she does that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想敬罗斯和艾蜜莉一杯
sense_groups.english: I'd like to toast Ross and Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天会正式敬酒
sense_groups.english: My big toast is tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是随便敬敬
sense_groups.english: This is kind of my little toast, or Melba toast, if you will.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟罗斯认识很久了 他第一次交女朋友我都知道
sense_groups.english: Ahem. I knew Ross when he was, uh, going out with his first girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为他们很顺利 直到那天他替她充气
sense_groups.english: I thought things would work out until he over-inflated her.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 华森装渍
sense_groups.english: Hello, Waltham Interiors.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 华森太太
sense_groups.english: Oh! Hi, Mrs. Waltham.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想找罗斯的伴郎之一或妹妹
sense_groups.english: I need to speak with, um, one of the best men or Ross' sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是谁？ - 我是菲比布非 罗斯好朋友之
sense_groups.english: Who is this? - Oh, Phoebe, one of Ross' best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然是罗斯的朋友怎么没来？
sense_groups.english: If you're Ross' friend, why aren't you here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能坐飞机 我怀了我弟的孩子
sense_groups.english: Um, I can't fly. I'm having my brother's babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 是广播节目吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I on the radio?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以找他们吗？我有要紧事
sense_groups.english: ...can I talk to one of them? It's important.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对你没兴趣了 我要挂了
sense_groups.english: I'm bored of you now. I'm going to cut you off.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴罗斯和艾蜜莉 要在蒙哥·马利礼堂结婚
sense_groups.english: We're excited that, uh, Ross and Emily are getting married at Montgomery Hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友要在"蒙帝霍尔"结婚 (霍尔字同礼堂)
sense_groups.english: To think, my friend getting married in Monty Hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 蒙帝霍尔啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Monty Hall!

sense_groups.chinese: 《一起做个买卖》主持人啊 你们怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Let's Make a Deal. Come on, you people!

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 恭喜你们 罗斯和艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: All right, forget it. Congratulations, Ross and Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 伴郎二号 乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Hey. Best man number two, Joey Tribbiani. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没钱德那么会说笑话
sense_groups.english: I'm not good with the jokes like Chandler here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说…
sense_groups.english: But, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜这对幸福的新人
sense_groups.english: ...congratulations to the happy couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在我家附近咖啡馆认识罗斯
sense_groups.english: I first met Ross in this coffeehouse back home.

sense_groups.chinese: 家
sense_groups.english: Home.

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约市…
sense_groups.english: New York City.

sense_groups.chinese: 在那里大家都认识我
sense_groups.english: Where everybody knows my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之
sense_groups.english: Uh, anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你们
sense_groups.english: ...uh, I love you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我更爱美国
sense_groups.english: But not as much as I love America.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回家了好不好？
sense_groups.english: Can we please go home now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要回去了？
sense_groups.english: Are you going home?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正想进一步认识你
sense_groups.english: I was hoping to get to know you better.

sense_groups.chinese: 美人 我哪儿也不去
sense_groups.english: I'm not going anywhere, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有笑啊
sense_groups.english: I was laughing.

sense_groups.chinese: 有笑出声吗？
sense_groups.english: Out loud?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想让别人觉得我很白痴
sense_groups.english: I didn't want everyone to think I was stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: So how are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈快把我逼疯了 但我很替罗斯高兴
sense_groups.english: My mom's driving me crazy. But Ross is getting married!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让任何人扫我的兴
sense_groups.english: I'm happy. I won't let anything spoil that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说罗斯真是个好青年
sense_groups.english: I just want to say that Ross is a wonderful young man.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我们都喜欢他
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks. We like him. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你生他时一定才十几岁
sense_groups.english: My God! You must have been a teenager when you had him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对不会付钱
sense_groups.english: There's no way in hell I'm paying for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们只差一件事
sense_groups.english: Look, we're down to just one point.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能婚礼后再解决？
sense_groups.english: Could we please just settle it after the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但我绝不付酒窖的钱
sense_groups.english: Fine, but I'm not paying for your wine cellar...

sense_groups.chinese: 靠美国才没被德国殖民的小人
sense_groups.english: ...you thieving, would-be-speaking- German-if-it-weren't-for-us man!

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙醉昏了 你怎么可能像罗斯的妈
sense_groups.english: The guy was hammered. There's no way you look like Ross' mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他为何要这样讲？ - 因为他疯了
sense_groups.english: Then why would he say it? - Because he's crazy!

sense_groups.chinese: 之前他还谢谢我 在《铁达尼号》里演得很棒
sense_groups.english: Earlier, he thanked me for my very moving performance in Titanic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈说得对 我嫁不出去了
sense_groups.english: My mother's right. I'll never get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么说吧 那是…
sense_groups.english: Ha! You know what, that is...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁不想要你？
sense_groups.english: Who wouldn't want you?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我是个儿子30岁的单亲妈妈
sense_groups.english: Please! I'm a single mom with a 30-year-old son.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天要结婚了
sense_groups.english: I'm getting married today!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoo! Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 早啊
sense_groups.english: Morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天要结婚了
sense_groups.english: I'm getting married today!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you are. - Woo-hoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他有发现吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think he knew I was here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没跟你做过这档事
sense_groups.english: I've never done that with you before. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是没有
sense_groups.english: Nope. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎样？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好吗？
sense_groups.english: You okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢？ - 很好
sense_groups.english: You? - Oh, yes, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢？
sense_groups.english: You?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们问过你了
sense_groups.english: We did you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了 - 好 当然
sense_groups.english: I better get going. - Oh, absolutely. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能不要看？
sense_groups.english: Could you not look?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想看
sense_groups.english: I don't want to look.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 什么事？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh, uh, excuse me. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你打算一路敲打到伦敦
sense_groups.english: If you're planning on doing that the entire flight...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在就说 我好吃镇静剂
sense_groups.english: ...please tell me now so that I can take a sedative.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是给你一颗
sense_groups.english: Or maybe slip you one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有点兴奋
sense_groups.english: It's just, I'm, uh, kind of excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去伦敦告诉一个人我爱他
sense_groups.english: I'm, um, going to London to, uh, tell this guy that I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 你死哪去了？
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Where the hell have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没回来睡 我认识了可爱的伴娘 她好…
sense_groups.english: I spent the night out. I met this cute bridesmaid. She is...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想听
sense_groups.english: I don't want to hear it!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我最喜欢的还是你
sense_groups.english: Aw, Pheebs, you know you're still my number one girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 出事了 瑞秋跑去伦敦了
sense_groups.english: We have an emergency. Rachel's coming to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great!

sense_groups.chinese: 点也不好 她要去告诉罗斯她爱他
sense_groups.english: No, she's coming to tell Ross that she loves him.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是罗斯爱艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: But he loves Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know that!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得阻止她 她会破坏婚礼
sense_groups.english: You have to stop her. She's going to ruin the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该做的都做了
sense_groups.english: I've done my part, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在该你负责 我卸下这个责任了 对吧？
sense_groups.english: It's your responsibility now. The burden is off me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 说说这个伴娘吧
sense_groups.english: So tell me about this girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看见摩妮卡吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. Have you seen Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有在跟摩妮卡交往
sense_groups.english: I'm not seeing Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 哈？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得找到她
sense_groups.english: Look, we gotta find her.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比说瑞秋要来向罗斯表白
sense_groups.english: Phoebe called. Rachel's coming to tell Ross she loves him.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 - 没错 所以要找到摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - I know. We gotta find Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道她在哪里吗？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Know where she is? - No, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在逼问什么？干脆拿灯照我的眼睛算了
sense_groups.english: What's with the third degree? Why don't you just shine a light in my eyes?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我发现我的一切举动
sense_groups.english: Then I realized all this stuff I had been doing...

sense_groups.chinese: 向约书亚求婚 骗说我要忙
sense_groups.english: ...proposing to Joshua, lying about why I couldn't come...

sense_groups.chinese: 都只是一种…
sense_groups.english: ...was all just a way of...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 可以打个岔吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Can I interrupt?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是个很糟糕 很糟糕的人
sense_groups.english: I just want to say that you are a horrible, horrible person.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Pardon me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你爱这个人 却要去破坏他的大喜之日
sense_groups.english: You're about to ruin the happiest day of his life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不得不同意你朋友菲比的话
sense_groups.english: I have to agree with your friend Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个很差劲 很差劲的打算
sense_groups.english: This is a terrible, terrible plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他必须知道我的感受 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: But he has to know how I feel. - But why?

sense_groups.chinese: 他爱这个艾蜜莉 这么做绝对没好处
sense_groups.english: He loves this Emily. No good can come of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你错了
sense_groups.english: Ugh! I think you're wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 你们当时显然是分手了
sense_groups.english: By the way, it seems to be clear you were on a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 跟仙境一样
sense_groups.english: It's like a fairyland.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 很恐怖吧？
sense_groups.english: I know. It's horrible, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我好喜欢 希望我的婚礼也能这么美
sense_groups.english: I love it. I only hope my wedding looks this good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得… - 有些话就别接了
sense_groups.english: Ha! I just hope... - You can let some go by.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Psst. Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始注意瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Start looking out for Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我守前门 你守后面那佃大洞
sense_groups.english: I'll cover the door. You watch that big hole.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯那里有钱德顾着
sense_groups.english: I've got Chandler covering Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我干嘛管钱德在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Why would I care where Chandler is? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道…
sense_groups.english: You know, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 有的时候我根本不喜欢钱德
sense_groups.english: ...sometimes I don't even like Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意
sense_groups.english: I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意
sense_groups.english: I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 第二个比较好
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's the second one.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hello, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 费丽西蒂
sense_groups.english: Hey, Felicity.

sense_groups.chinese: 我整天都在想你
sense_groups.english: Um, I thought about you all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 再跟我讲讲纽约的事
sense_groups.english: Talk New York to me again.

sense_groups.chinese: 别管纽约了
sense_groups.english: Forget about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会付酒窖的钱
sense_groups.english: We're not paying for your wine cellar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们总得折衷一下
sense_groups.english: You have to meet me in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你再罗唆我就踹你的屁眼
sense_groups.english: My foot will meet the middle of your ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 没事 切都在掌握中
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - Oh, everything's under control.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想干架？你是这个意思吗？
sense_groups.english: You want a piece of me? Is that what you're saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: That's it!

sense_groups.chinese: 双方家长 退后
sense_groups.english: Parents! Parents! Back away!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们的大喜之日
sense_groups.english: This is our wedding day!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们给我好好相处
sense_groups.english: From now on, everyone gets along.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁再多说一个字
sense_groups.english: And if I hear one more word...

sense_groups.chinese: 就别想抱孙子
sense_groups.english: ...no grandchildren!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry, old boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉…
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用大拇指就能扳倒你
sense_groups.english: I could kill you with my thumb, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What was that about?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一些费用上的…
sense_groups.english: It was this disagreement over...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你真美
sense_groups.english: My God! You look beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 行礼前看到新娘会不吉利
sense_groups.english: Oh! You can't see me before the wedding. It's bad luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的恶运应该都用完了
sense_groups.english: I think we've had all the bad luck we're going to have.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: My God, heh, Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 你来了 我真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: You're here. I can't believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么跑来了？
sense_groups.english: Why are you here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是来…
sense_groups.english: I just came to...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是得告诉你…
sense_groups.english: I just needed to tell you...

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你
sense_groups.english: ...congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 华森装渍
sense_groups.english: Waltham Interiors.

sense_groups.chinese: 华森太太吗？又是我 菲比
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Waltham? It's Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以跟伴郎之一说话吗？我保证这是最后一次
sense_groups.english: Can I talk to one of the best men? This is going to be the last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个女生找你
sense_groups.english: There's a girl on the phone for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, great!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是菲比
sense_groups.english: It's Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有堵到瑞秋吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you stop Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 但没事 她只有抱抱他而已
sense_groups.english: But she just hugged him. That's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有破坏什么？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Nothing got ruined? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在怎么样了？
sense_groups.english: Oh! So, what's going on now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在走红毯
sense_groups.english: ...I'm walking down the aisle.

sense_groups.chinese: 还在走
sense_groups.english: Still walking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟罗斯站在一起了
sense_groups.english: Now I'm at the front with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 是菲比
sense_groups.english: It's Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 他看起来很不爽
sense_groups.english: He looks pretty mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得挂了
sense_groups.english: Uh, I better go.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 拿着让我听
sense_groups.english: Wait! Hold it up so I can listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚的事真是… - 愚蠢
sense_groups.english: What we did last night was... - Stupid. Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 既夸张又愚蠢 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Totally crazy, stupid. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在想什么？
sense_groups.english: What were we thinking? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我晚上去找你 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm coming over tonight though, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然好
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, definitely.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位亲朋好友
sense_groups.english: Friends, family...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今天齐聚一堂
sense_groups.english: ...we are gathered to celebrate...

sense_groups.chinese: 庆祝罗斯与艾蜜莉缔结良缘
sense_groups.english: ...the joyous union of Ross and Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 愿今朝的幸福
sense_groups.english: May the happiness of today...

sense_groups.chinese: 永远与他们同在
sense_groups.english: ...be with them always.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 跟着我念
sense_groups.english: Now, Emily, repeat after me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我 艾蜜莉 - 我 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: I, Emily. - I, Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 嫁给你 罗斯 - 嫁给你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Take thee, Ross. - Take thee, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 做我合法的丈夫 祸福与共
sense_groups.english: As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health...

sense_groups.chinese: 至死方休
sense_groups.english: ...till death parts us.

sense_groups.chinese: 做我合法的丈夫 祸福与共
sense_groups.english: As my lawfully wedded husband, in sickness and in health...

sense_groups.chinese: 至死方休
sense_groups.english: ...until death parts us.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Now, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟着我念
sense_groups.english: Repeat after me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 迎娶你 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Take thee, Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 迎娶你 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Take thee, Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily!

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Ha. Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 还要继续吗？
sense_groups.english: Shall I go on?

questions.name: S05E01
questions.en:
Friends, family, we're gathered to celebrate here today...
...the joyous union of Ross and Emily.
Now Ross, repeat after me.
I, Ross.
I, Ross.
Take thee, Emily.
Take thee, Rachel.
Emily.
Heh. Emily.
Uh, shall I go on?
He said "Rachel," right?
Do you think I should go up there?
Yes. Yes. Do go on.
I think we'd better start again.
Ross, repeat after me.
I, Ross.
Take thee, Emily.
Ha, ha. Like there'd be anybody else.
As my lawfully wedded wife, in sickness and in health...
...till death parts us.
As my lawfully wedded wife, in sickness and in health...
...until death parts us.
Really, I do. Emily.
Do you have the rings?
Emily, place this ring on Ross' finger...
...as a symbol of your bond everlasting.
Ross, place this ring...
...on Emily's hand as a symbol...
...of the love that encircles you forever.
Happy to.
They have made their declarations...
...and it gives me great pleasure to declare them husband and wife.
You may kiss the bride.
This is worse than when he married the lesbian.
Just keep smiling.
Okay...
Well, that went well. Yeah.
It could've been worse. He could've shot her.
Ha, ha. That was pretty funny, wasn't it?
You spoiled everything. It's like a nightmare.
All my friends and family are out there. How can I face them?
How could you do this to me?
Hey, no matter what happens with Ross and Emily...
...we still get cake, right?
That's all right. No, no. You take your time, sweetie.
I'll be out here. Ha, ha.
She's just fixing her makeup.
I hate you.
And I love you.
Boy, a bad time to say the wrong name, huh, Ross?
That's true. Thanks, Dad.
People should be dancing, huh?
Hey, this is a party. Come on.
Joey. Dance.
Yes, Waltham Interiors.
Hello, this is Ross Geller's personal physician, Dr. Phalange.
Who?
Yeah, I discovered that Ross forgot to take his brain medicine.
Um, now, without it, uh, in the brain of Ross...
...uh, women's names are interchangeable.
Through no fault of his own.
Oh, my God. Phoebe.
No, not Phoebe. Dr. Phalange.
Oh, no. You have it too.
Hello?
Hey. - Hey.
Wow, I hope you don't take this the wrong way...
...but I know we had plans to meet up tonight and...
Ugh. I'm just kind of worried about what it might do to our friendship.
I know.
Ugh. How could we have let this happen? - Seven times.
You know, look. We were away.
In a foreign, romantic country. - Right.
I blame London.
Bad London.
So look, um...
...while we're still in London, I mean, we can keep doing it, right?
Well, I don't see that we have a choice.
But when we're back home, we don't do it.
Only here.
You know, I saw a wine cellar downstairs.
I'll meet you there in two minutes. - Okay.
Mon? Mon, I got to ask you something. - Now?
Ross said my name up there. I mean, come on.
I can't just pretend that didn't happen.
I don't know.
Monica, what should I do? - Just do the right thing.
What?
Tow the line. Thread the needle. Think outside the box.
Monica, wait, listen. I'm gonna talk to Ross about what he thinks it meant.
Wait. Rachel, no.
He's married.
Married.
If you don't realize that, I can't help you.
Okay. You're right.
You're right. You can't help me.
Jack, is it all our fault? Were we bad parents?
Yes.
Oh yeah? Well, who serves steak when there's no place to sit?
I mean, how are you supposed to eat this?
Hey, what's up?
Where were you? We were supposed to meet.
Forget it. That's off. - Why?
The next tour of the wine cellar...
...will commence in two minutes.
Joey, what are you doing?
You promised Phoebe no meat till she has the babies.
Well, I figured we're in another country, so it doesn't count.
That's true. - The man's got a point.
Oh, hi.
Hi. - Hi.
I'm sorry things aren't working out so well.
Oh, no. Ha, ha. It could be better. It's gonna be okay, right?
Oh, yeah. Of course. I mean, she's gonna get over this, you know?
I mean, so you said my name.
You know, you just said it because you saw me there.
If you'd seen a circus freak, you would've said
I take thee Circus Freak.
It didn't mean anything. It's just a mistake.
It didn't mean anything.
Right? - No, no.
Of course it didn't mean anything.
I mean, I can understand why Emily would think it meant something...
...you know, because it was you.
But it absolutely didn't. It didn't! It didn't!
Ross, hey, the band's ready outside for your first dance with Emily.
Oh. Oh, the band's ready.

sense_groups.english: If you'd seen a circus freak, you would've said

sense_groups.english: I take thee Circus Freak.

sense_groups.chinese: 根本没有别的意思 只是无心之过
sense_groups.english: It didn't mean anything. It's just a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有别的意思
sense_groups.english: It didn't mean anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？ - 不 不
sense_groups.english: Right? - No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然没有
sense_groups.english: Of course it didn't mean anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我明白艾蜜莉为何误会
sense_groups.english: I mean, I can understand why Emily would think it meant something...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这刚好是你的名字
sense_groups.english: ...you know, because it was you.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实没有意义 真的没有
sense_groups.english: But it absolutely didn't. It didn't! It didn't!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 乐队正在等你跟艾蜜莉开舞
sense_groups.english: Ross, hey, the band's ready outside for your first dance with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 乐队准备好了
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, the band's ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们最好听乐队的话
sense_groups.english: Well, we got to do what the band says.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不在乎哩
sense_groups.english: I don't care about the stupid band!

sense_groups.chinese: 你口水喷到我了
sense_groups.english: You spit on me, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉也进去太久了吧？ - 呵
sense_groups.english: Emily is taking kind of a long time, huh? - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我结婚时也躲在厕所不出来
sense_groups.english: When I locked myself in the bathroom at my wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过那是因为我要撬开窗户
sense_groups.english: ...it was because I was trying to pop the window out of the frame.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 我心想要逃出去
sense_groups.english: Right. - Get the hell out of there. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要进去了
sense_groups.english: I'm coming in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 同一招
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at that. Same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我中途…
sense_groups.english: In the middle of everything...

sense_groups.chinese: 大喊"好耶"你就当作没听到
sense_groups.english: ...if I scream the word "yippee," just ignore me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瑞秋 - 嗨 你好啊 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Huh! Oh, my God. Rachel. - Oh, hello, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯叫出我的名字
sense_groups.english: Ross said my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？是我耶
sense_groups.english: Okay? My name.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会说成我的名字
sense_groups.english: Ross said my name up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 表示他还爱我
sense_groups.english: That obviously means that he still loves me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不信就算了 我绝对没误会
sense_groups.english: Okay, don't believe me. I know I'm right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要不要下楼喝一杯？
sense_groups.english: All right. Do you guys want to go and get a drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yes, we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们要先换衣服
sense_groups.english: But we have to change first.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我想换衣服
sense_groups.english: Yes, I want to change.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先下去占位子 - 我们五分钟就下去
sense_groups.english: Why don't you go get a table? - We'll be down in five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 十五分钟吧 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Fifteen minutes. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比啊 是菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, Pheebs. It's Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, hey. - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯说成我的名字
sense_groups.english: Well, Ross said my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 不过他是无心的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know, but I don't think that means anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们冷静客观想想看
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, let's look at this objectively.

sense_groups.chinese: 他从国三就暗恋我
sense_groups.english: All right, ninth grade, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那时就疯狂迷上我
sense_groups.english: The obsession starts.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？那年暑假
sense_groups.english: All right? Summer after ninth grade...

sense_groups.chinese: 他头一次看我穿两件式泳装
sense_groups.english: ...he sees me in a two-piece for the first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 更是不可自拔爱上我
sense_groups.english: His obsession begins to grow, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 去我房间换衣服好了
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen, why don't we go change in my room?

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我的衣服在…
sense_groups.english: My clothes are... Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来真是… - 没时间废话了
sense_groups.english: Wow, you look... - No time for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 让我进去 我有女伴
sense_groups.english: Hey, dude. Let me in. I got a girl out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有
sense_groups.english: Well, I've got a girl in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪 我看到你跟摩妮卡进去
sense_groups.english: No, you don't. I just saw you go in there with Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在里面聊天
sense_groups.english: Well, we're hanging out in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说我们谁有机会嘿咻？我还是你？
sense_groups.english: Which one of us is gonna be having sex in there? Me or you?

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我只能说是你了
sense_groups.english: Well, I suppose I would have to say you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正在看电影呢 - 没错
sense_groups.english: What if we're watching a movie in here? - Which we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们付费了 正在看《我的巨人》
sense_groups.english: And we've already paid for it. It's My Giant.

sense_groups.chinese: 《我的巨人》？我爱死那部片
sense_groups.english: My Giant? I love that movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定这样好吗？
sense_groups.english: You really think this is okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正罗斯跟艾蜜莉也用不到
sense_groups.english: Well, Ross and Emily aren't gonna use it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里好漂亮
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我总觉得不太妥当
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't feel right about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是蜜月套房
sense_groups.english: This is the honeymoon suite.

sense_groups.chinese: 本来就该有人在这里嘿咻
sense_groups.english: The room expects sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果没有 这间房一定很失望
sense_groups.english: The room would be disappointed if it didn't get sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 在其他蜜月套房面前抬不起头
sense_groups.english: All the other honeymoon suites would think it was a loser.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉？ - 没有 没看到
sense_groups.english: Emily? - Nope. Not under here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没找到她？ - 我到处都找不到
sense_groups.english: You didn't find her? - No, I've looked everywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定漏掉什么地方 否则早就找到了
sense_groups.english: Well, you couldn't have, or else you would've found her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该继续找 - 大概再找个30分钟
sense_groups.english: I think you should keep looking. - Yeah. For about, uh, 30 minutes?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是45分钟
sense_groups.english: Or 45?

sense_groups.chinese: 45分钟可以找到两次了
sense_groups.english: Wow, in 45 minutes, you could find her twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 她一定也找不到我
sense_groups.english: No. For all I know, she's trying to find me...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我跑来跑去
sense_groups.english: ...but couldn't because I kept moving around.

sense_groups.chinese: 从现在开始我不动了
sense_groups.english: No, from now on, I'm staying in one place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就待在这里
sense_groups.english: Right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 时间晚了 - 我们要走了
sense_groups.english: It's getting late. - Yeah, We're going to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个…
sense_groups.english: Actually...

sense_groups.chinese: 待一会儿如何？
sense_groups.english: ...do you guys mind staying here for a while?

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我们明天一早 就要搭机回纽约(音同捕捉)
sense_groups.english: Ugh. You know, we got to get up early and catch that plane to New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且那班飞机又很大
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's a very large plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就算了
sense_groups.english: That's cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们还是陪你一会
sense_groups.english: But we'll stay here with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks, guys. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很感激你们的好意 但是你也不用摸我屁股
sense_groups.english: I really appreciate this, you know, but you don't need to rub my butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一小时后就要回纽约了
sense_groups.english: We have to leave for New York in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我一直在看那扇门
sense_groups.english: I know. I've been looking at those doors.

sense_groups.chinese: 隔音效果似乎很好 你觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: They look pretty soundproof, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你疯了
sense_groups.english: We can't do that. That's insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一 他可能醒来 第二 你知道…
sense_groups.english: I mean, A, he could wake up. And B, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 管他的
sense_groups.english: ...let's go for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉？艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily? Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 - 不是她
sense_groups.english: Emily! - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用找她了 她没跟来 - 我们来拿她的东西
sense_groups.english: Forget about Emily. She's not with us. - We've come for her things.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 她躲起来了 因为她很丢脸 这辈子都不想再见到你
sense_groups.english: She's in hiding. She's utterly humiliated. She doesn't want to see you ever again.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾你们两个闹成这样 兔崽子
sense_groups.english: We're very sad that it didn't work out between you and Emily, monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你实在是秀色可餐
sense_groups.english: But I think you're absolutely delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我人还站在这里
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, I'm standing right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 阴魂不散
sense_groups.english: There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家动作快 外面还有一堆
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey, you guys. Hurry up. Get some. There's a whole cart outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了 盖勒 - 等下…
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Geller. - Now, hold on. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 令媛跟我…
sense_groups.english: Look, look. Your daughter and I...

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚预定去度蜜月
sense_groups.english: ...are supposed to leave tonight for our honeymoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你们转告她 我会去机场
sense_groups.english: Now, you tell her that I'm gonna be at that airport...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望她也会去
sense_groups.english: ...and I hope that she'll be there too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说成瑞秋的名字 但这只是无心之过
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I said Rachel's name, but it didn't mean anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不过是我的朋友 就这样 请转告艾蜜莉我爱她
sense_groups.english: She's just a friend. That's all. Now, look, just tell Emily I love her...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想跟她共度余生
sense_groups.english: ...and that I can't imagine spending my life with anyone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 请保证你们一定会转告她
sense_groups.english: Please, promise me that you'll tell her that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会告诉她
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll tell her.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 臭婆娘
sense_groups.english: Come on, bugger face.

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给我
sense_groups.english: Call me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也一天到晚待在厕所
sense_groups.english: You spend half your life in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么就不会从窗户滚蛋？
sense_groups.english: Why do you never go out the bloody window?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们不再上床才对
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe it's best we never got to do it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则那晚就不特别了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it kind of makes that one night special.

sense_groups.chinese: 理论上而言 我们还在海外
sense_groups.english: You know, technically, we still are over international waters.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去洗手间 待会来找我？
sense_groups.english: I'm going to the bathroom. Maybe I'll see you there in a bit?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以问个问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, can I ask you something?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: Uh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨晚跟费丽西蒂 一起看《我的巨人》 我心想
sense_groups.english: Felicity and I, we were watching My Giant. And I was thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 自己永远不可能 演得跟那个巨人一样棒
sense_groups.english: ...I'm never gonna be as good an actor as that giant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我想当演员 是否只是痴心妄想？
sense_groups.english: Do you think I'm just wasting my life with this acting thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个巨人大概比我小五岁
sense_groups.english: I mean, the giant's like five years younger than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有办法跟他一样优秀吗？
sense_groups.english: You know, you think I'll ever get there?

sense_groups.chinese: 会的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Thanks, man. - Okay, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他比我高好多啊
sense_groups.english: But what about how much taller he is than me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在已经不可能再长高
sense_groups.english: I mean, there's no way I can make myself taller now.

sense_groups.chinese: 以后科学怎么发展我不知道
sense_groups.english: And who knows what science will come up with in the future...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我死时只是一个身高平庸的小人物呢？
sense_groups.english: ...but, Chandler, what if I die an unsuccessful, regular-size man?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你厕所上了半个小时
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica. Wow, you've been in the bathroom for, like, a half-hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也吃了牛肉？
sense_groups.english: Had the beef tips, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你吃过肉了
sense_groups.english: You ate meat!

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟人嘿咻
sense_groups.english: You had sex!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才没有 - 我知道你没有
sense_groups.english: No, we didn't. - I know you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: I was talking about Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我才没跟人嘿咻
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I did not have sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 怀孕害我灵感不准
sense_groups.english: Oh, this pregnancy is throwing me all off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去跟小鸡小鸭打招呼 - 我跟你去
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna say hi to the chick and duck. - Oh, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何必去？你不是四天都去喂它们？
sense_groups.english: Why would you need to say hi? You've been feeding them for four days.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我回家好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Maybe I'll just go home.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩下我们两个
sense_groups.english: Well, we certainly are alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好我们说好回纽约就不行
sense_groups.english: Good thing we have that "not New York" rule.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你说到这个
sense_groups.english: Um, listen, since we're on that subject...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想告诉你…
sense_groups.english: ...um, I just wanted to tell you that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 当时我在伦敦心情很不好
sense_groups.english: Well, I was going through a really hard time in London...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为哥哥结婚 别人还把我认作他妈
sense_groups.english: ...what with my brother getting married and that guy thinking I was Ross' mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 总而言之…
sense_groups.english: Well, anyway, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚对我来说意义非凡 我的意思是我要谢谢你
sense_groups.english: That night meant a lot to me. And I guess I'm trying to say thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我那天也不是随便上床
sense_groups.english: You know, that night meant a lot to me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 并不是因为我心情不好
sense_groups.english: And it wasn't because I was in a bad place or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很重视那晚是因为你真的很热
sense_groups.english: It just meant a lot to me because you're really hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样说可以吗？ - 没关系
sense_groups.english: Is that okay? - Ha, ha. That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很可爱？
sense_groups.english: And I'm cute too?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很可爱 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: And you're cute too. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去整理行李了 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, I got to go unpack. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我时差还没调回来 这表示我还在伦敦吧？
sense_groups.english: I'm still on London time. Does that count?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that counts. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会在这里？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在等候补机位回纽约
sense_groups.english: Well, I've been on standby for a flight home for hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 你还没等到艾蜜莉？
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Oh. So no sign of Emily, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没
sense_groups.english: Not yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么
sense_groups.english: So, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是几点的飞机？
sense_groups.english: What time are you supposed to leave?

sense_groups.chinese: 最后次呼叫 前往雅典的1066班机
sense_groups.english: This is the last call for Flight 1066 to Athens.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后一次呼叫
sense_groups.english: The last call.

sense_groups.chinese: 就快了
sense_groups.english: Pretty soon, I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不明白她怎么可以这么做？
sense_groups.english: I just... I don't understand. I mean, how could she do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是白痴？
sense_groups.english: What, am I like a complete idiot...

sense_groups.chinese: 竟然以为她会来
sense_groups.english: ...for thinking she'd actually show up?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是白痴 罗斯
sense_groups.english: You're not an idiot, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是爱得无可救药
sense_groups.english: You're a guy very much in love.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还不是一样
sense_groups.english: Same difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 搭乘1066班机 前往雅典的旅客请登机
sense_groups.english: All passengers for Flight 1066 to Athens should now be onboard.

sense_groups.chinese: 听到了
sense_groups.english: I get it!

sense_groups.chinese: 没搞头了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你知道什么
sense_groups.english: No, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该去
sense_groups.english: I think you should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 对 我认为你应该…
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, I do think you should go...

sense_groups.chinese: 自己去 到遥远的地方
sense_groups.english: ...by yourself. Get some distance.

sense_groups.chinese: 想个清楚 这对你一定有好处
sense_groups.english: Clear your head. I think it would be really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你应该要去
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Ross. I think it would be really good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我应该去
sense_groups.english: I could. I could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她实在太扯了
sense_groups.english: I can't even believe her.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？我决定去了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I am going to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 - 有何不可呢？
sense_groups.english: Good. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不对？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Right? - Right. Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 我们纽约见了
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - Okay, I'll see you back at home.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望我搭得上飞机
sense_groups.english: If I ever get a flight out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实…
sense_groups.english: Hey, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No. - What? Wait, what?

sense_groups.chinese: 不如你也一起来
sense_groups.english: Why don't you come?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我有两张机票
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have two tickets. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 不太好吧？真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know, Ross. Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 一定很好玩
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. It'd be great. I mean, you can...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以躺在海滩上
sense_groups.english: You can lay on the beach...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以哭诉婚姻失败
sense_groups.english: ...and I can cry over my failed marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看我多幽默啊？ - 额
sense_groups.english: You see how I make jokes? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Really. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要有朋友陪我
sense_groups.english: God, I could use a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 无妨
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Okay, maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以陪你去
sense_groups.english: Yes, I can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 是啊
sense_groups.english: All right, cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这就走
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're going to Greece. Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了拿外套
sense_groups.english: Aah, aah. I forgot my jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫他们等下 - 好
sense_groups.english: Well, you tell them to wait. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等下 - 好
sense_groups.english: Wait. Wait. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 别走
sense_groups.english: No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要梅洛红酒
sense_groups.english: Ah, yes. I will have a glass of the Merlot...

sense_groups.chinese: 这位要气泡白酒
sense_groups.english: ...and he will have a white-wine spritzer.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 机场在动
sense_groups.english: Hey, look at that. The airport's moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 飞机在动吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, are we moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 飞机在动吗？为什么？
sense_groups.english: Are we moving? Why are we moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们…
sense_groups.english: They... Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 机长知道飞机在动吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, does the captain know that we're moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my gosh.

questions.name: S05E02
questions.en:
Cheers. - Cheers.
You look cute in bubbles.
Ahh, you're just all liquored up.
Hey, it's me. I'm coming in.
I've had a very long, hard day.
Want some chicken?
No, thanks. No chicken. Bye-bye.
You sure? Some extra-crispy, dirty rice?
For the last time, no! Get out, Joey!
All right.
Are you okay? He wouldn't leave.
He kept asking me if I wanted chicken.
Chicken?
I could eat some chicken.
Hey, Joe!
Could I get a, uh, three-piece, some coleslaw, some beans and a Coke?
Aah! Diet Coke.
Hey. - Hey.
Morning, Pheebs. - I have to tell you this story.
I was coming over and this cabdriver...
Was his name Angus?
What?
He was a cabdriver we had in London.
Oh. Ha, ha, ha.
All right. Anyway...
What was that pub he took us to?
The Wheat Sheaf!
And they had that beer...
Boddington's. - Boddington's.
Ooh, uh, Pheebs was going to tell a story.
So he had a really funny hat.
I don't want to talk about it.
Hey. - Hey, Ross!
Boddington's!
Oh, man!
I'd walk back to London for another frosty one of those bad boys.
They have them at the British pub by the Trade Center.
Later!
Shouldn't Rachel be back?
Her plane got delayed.
But she should be here by now.
So you talked to her? Did she sound mad?
No. But she likes me.
You abandoned her on a plane to Greece.
I did not "abandon" Rachel. Okay?
Emily showed up at the airport.
I had to go after her. I did what I had to do.
She's my wife. Rachel is my wife.
Emily!
Emily is my wife.
Man, what is that?
You haven't heard from Emily?
Not since I lost her at the airport.
I can't believe she can outrun you.
Hey! She's fast, okay?
You think you can beat me? Let's go! Outside!
Hi!
Hi! Rachel!
Rach, I am so sorry. I am so, so sorry.
Come on. You just did what you had to do.
Hi, Pheebs.
That's it? You're not mad? It must've been terrible.
Terrible? Hell, I was in Greece!
There was a nice hotel, nice beach, met the nice people.
It's not too shabby for Rachel.
So, what, that's it?
Well, yeah. We're cool. Totally cool.
Thanks, Rach. You're the best.
Oh, no. You're the best.
Oh, I got to go to the flower store.
No one will tell me where Emily is...
...so I'm sending 72 long-stemmed, red roses to her parents' house.
One for each day I've known and loved her.
That should get her talking.
When you make out the card, be sure to make it out to "Emily."
It's good that you had such a good time in Greece.
What?
I didn't have a good time in Greece!
Ross abandoned me!
I couldn't get a plane out. I had to stay in their suite!
People came up to me going, "Mrs. Geller! Why are you cry?"
I mean, it was so humiliating!
I felt like such an idiot!
It's all my fault. You know why?
Because I make very bad decisions.
Oh, that's not true.
Yes, it is true. I went after Ross in stupid London!
London is stupid! Stupid!
I should've never gone to London.
From now on, you make all my decisions for me.
Oh, no. I did that for someone once.
I'm not comfortable having that power over someone's life.
I'll do it.
Fine. Monica, you are now in charge of my love life.
Okay. I got to go to work.
And, uh, Rachel, great to have you back.
Pheebs!
Always a pleasure.
Rachel? Sweetie, look.
Here's a cute picture of you and Joey.
He's married.
Ross is married. I still can't believe it.
Honey, sweetie, by the edges.
I'll just have to accept it.
I mean, it's my fault.
Edges! Fingers! Smudgy!
Oh, my God!
That's okay. I know that you're very upset right now.
I know that wasn't about me.
I bet it was about her a little.
If you'd stop thinking about Ross...
...you'd notice there are great guys everywhere.
Look. Gunther.
He's nice. He's cute.
Yeah. I guess Gunther is...
What about that guy over there?
That's the guy you flirted with at the counter.
Oh, I don't know. I don't know.
You're going to talk to him.
I make your decisions, and I say you're going to talk to him.
All right.
You're the boss. I got to do what you tell me.
Say that to him, and you're golden.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey, Pheebs. We got our pictures back from London.
Here's all of us at the Tower of London...
Here we all are.
There's Ross and Joey and you and...
And me.
We've been talking about London too much.
Sorry, it's just because I couldn't be there.
All I get to do now is pregnant stuff. It bums me out.
I'm sorry. - Sorry.
What happened? - A little of this, a little of that.
I got myself a date tomorrow.
See? Didn't I tell you? You're getting over Ross already.
Get out.
What took so long?
I got caught up at work. But I'm quitting tomorrow.
So thanks for having me over.
Rach...
Pheebs...
See you, man.
What the hell was that?
Probably some European goodbye thing he picked up in London.
That's not European.
It felt French.
I really had a good time.
Yeah, me too.
So... - So...
I guess this is it.
Yeah, um...
Unless you want to come inside? - Yeah!
Oh, uh, wait a minute. You know what? I can't decide this.
Okay. Just hold on a second.
Um, hi.
Hi.
Where's Monica? I have to ask her something.
Doing her laundry.
What's that?
It came in the mail today.
It's 72 long-stemmed, red roses.
One for each day I've known and loved Emily...
...cut up into mulch.
Honey, that's awful.
It's not so bad.
Monica's going to make potpourri.
I think I'm going to go wander out in the rain for a while.
It's not raining.
I can't catch a break.
You're not going anywhere. Sit right here.
I'll make you some tea and we'll talk this out.
All right?
Okay.
Hey, Dave. - Yeah.
Um, I need to take a rain check. My roommate is really sick.
Okay. Bye.
Honey, listen.
I know things seem so bad...
...and that they won't get any...
Could I talk to you?
I dropped some socks.
Yeah.
What is the matter with you? Do you want to fall into the trap?
You did not drop any socks!
I saw Dave, and he said you blew him off!
You listen to me!
I'm calling the shots! I say you leave Ross and go get Dave.
What are you doing?
Well, ultimately I was trying, you know, I wanted...
...to tell him that I'm still in love with him.
What? You cannot tell him that!
Why? Why not?
People love to hear that!
I make the decisions and I say no!
You know what? No, you don't make my decisions, because...
...you're fired.
You can't fire me.
I make your decisions, and I say I'm not fired. Ha!
Well...
Rachel! Come on, let me in!
Having some trouble?
Rachel locked the door.
I'll kick that door in if you give me some sugar.
Rachel! Let me in!
Thank you.
Rachel? Can I talk to you outside for a sec?
No.
We really need to talk.
Well, then talk.
Okay, I will.
Remember that thing we just discussed that you wanted to do?
Yes.
What thing?
Rachel wants to take swing dance lessons.
Which I think is a really stupid idea.
It's dangerous. She won't get what she wants.
And who knows who she might end up hurting?
Monica's right. Swing dancing can be tricky.
I have to use the phone.
I got to cancel those five, giant teddy bears I sent to Emily.
My God. Think of the massacre.
I'm going to do it.
I know you think I'm crazy.
But before you tell him, try to find one person...
...who thinks it's a good idea. I bet you can't.
Please?
All right. Fine.
Joey! I'm in!
All right. Good deal.
Pheebs! Hey!
Uh, Pheebs? Yeah?
Um, you know how you were saying you didn't get to go to London...
...and you were feeling left out? - Yeah.
Well, we all felt really bad about that...
...so we decided to take a little trip together.
Oh, that's so nice!
How great! Where's the trip?
Well, we thought we would all go to a picnic...
...in Central Park! - Central Park?
All of us. All day.
That sucks!
That's not a trip! I just came from there.
What'll we high-five about at the stupid park?
It's right by my house. All right!
I'm going home to bask in the triumph of my Central Park idea.
Hold on a sec there, Mr. Kissy.
I wanted to talk to you about...
...this whole new European thing you've got going on.
And I need to say it makes me very uncomfortable...
...and I just, you know, just stop it!
Just bringing some culture to the group.
That's fine. Just don't bring it in my mouth.
It makes me want to puke.
Hey, everybody! Pheebs is here!
Phoebe! Whoo! Okay. Whoo! Hi!
Pheebs, we decided that the picnic idea was a little...
It didn't have any... Well, it blew.
We thought that this afternoon we'd all go away for the whole weekend...
...to Atlantic City.
Ooh, Atlantic City! Oh, that's a great plan! Whose plan was that?
Mine!
Wait. It was my plan. - No...
...I said we needed a new plan.
And I came up with Atlantic City.
Which is the new plan.
Why don't we, um, all meet upstairs in an hour?
Okay.
I'm going to go pack. I'm going to go pack my ass off.
Let's go.
You know what? I'll meet you in a minute.
Rachel, you didn't find anyone, so you can't tell him.
You know what? That doesn't matter.
Do you know how painful it is to tell someone you love them...
...and not have them say it back?
I don't care.
Okay...
I can't watch.
What you reading?
Paper.
Yeah? What's it about?
The events from around the globe.
Okay...
Uh, there's something I have to talk to you about.
Everyone's saying I shouldn't.
But I think they're wrong. People can be wrong.
Once at work...
...I thought carbon dating is fossilized...
I'm really trying to tell you something here.
Yeah...
Go ahead.
I think I'm just going to say it.
I'm just going to say it.
Uh...
I'm still in love with you, Ross.
Wow, uh...
Huh. I'm...
Wow. I'm not sure what to do with that right now.
What? Was that a joke? Because it's mean.
I'm so dead serious.
I'm totally serious.
Why are you laughing?
Because I just heard it!
I heard it! And it's ridiculous!
I mean...
You're married!
You're married, and it's just ridiculous.
When I said it, I sort of floated up out of my body.
And then I heard myself say it, and then the floating Rachel...
I was like, "You are such an idiot!"
Well, I am married. - I know.
Though I haven't spoken to her since the wedding.
I'm sorry. That's not funny.
Actually, it kind of is.
My wife won't return my calls.
I don't know where my wife is.
"Hey, Ross! Where's the missus?" "Don't know!"
Oh, God.
Okay.
You know what? Could you forget I told you this?
Well, I kind of have to.
Because the thing is...
The thing is, you know, that you're married to Emily.
That is what the thing is.
Oh, God.
Things won't be weird between us, right? Was that stupid?
Me telling you that?
No, no. I'm glad you did.
If nothing else...
...it's always great when someone tells you they love you.
That's what I said!
Thank you for being so nice. - No. Thank you for...
Thank you.
Okay, let's go! - Yeah, Atlantic City!
Come on!
Atlantic City, baby!
Let's roll some bones. Hey, Joey!
High-five for rolling bones.
Ow! - Ow!
Oh.
Ooh!
Uh, Pheebs, you're leaking.
Oh, my God. Your water broke.
Oh! Okay!
Well, don't worry. I call shotgun.
Pheebs, we have to take you to the hospital now.
Pheebs, the babies are coming now.
Honey! High-five! The babies are coming!
Whoo!
Remember when my water broke?
Phoebe's going to have her babies.
I know. It's beautiful and amazing.
I had to kiss Phoebe and Rachel every time I left the room.
It's too bad they didn't see us having sex.
Do you know anything about women?
No.
It's all right. - Okay.
