sense_groups.english: You think you can beat me? Let's go! Outside!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi! Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我很抱歉 非常对不起你
sense_groups.english: Rach, I am so sorry. I am so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你没做错
sense_groups.english: Come on. You just did what you had to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？你不生气？你应该很火大
sense_groups.english: That's it? You're not mad? It must've been terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 火大？我可是在希腊
sense_groups.english: Terrible? Hell, I was in Greece!

sense_groups.chinese: 那间饭店非常棒 海滩很美 人又和善
sense_groups.english: There was a nice hotel, nice beach, met the nice people.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我瑞秋来说可不差
sense_groups.english: It's not too shabby for Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？
sense_groups.english: So, what, that's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我没生你的气
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah. We're cool. Totally cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你真好
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Rach. You're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才好呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. You're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去花店一趟
sense_groups.english: Oh, I got to go to the flower store.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都不肯说艾蜜莉在哪里
sense_groups.english: No one will tell me where Emily is...

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定买72朵长茎红玫瑰 送去艾蜜莉爸妈家
sense_groups.english: ...so I'm sending 72 long-stemmed, red roses to her parents' house.

sense_groups.chinese: 每朵代表我认识她 并且深爱她的每一天
sense_groups.english: One for each day I've known and loved her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定会感动的软化
sense_groups.english: That should get her talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 写卡片时别忘了 对方是"艾蜜莉"
sense_groups.english: When you make out the card, be sure to make it out to "Emily."

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 幸好你在希腊玩得开心
sense_groups.english: It's good that you had such a good time in Greece.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在希腊才不开心
sense_groups.english: I didn't have a good time in Greece!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯丢下我一人
sense_groups.english: Ross abandoned me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我买不到机票回来 只好住在他们的蜜月套房
sense_groups.english: I couldn't get a plane out. I had to stay in their suite!

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都要来问我 "盖勒太太 你哭什么？"
sense_groups.english: People came up to me going, "Mrs. Geller! Why are you cry?"

sense_groups.chinese: 简直丢死人了
sense_groups.english: I mean, it was so humiliating!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是个白痴
sense_groups.english: I felt like such an idiot!

sense_groups.chinese: 这都是我的错 你们知道为什么吗？
sense_groups.english: It's all my fault. You know why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我的决定都不对
sense_groups.english: Because I make very bad decisions.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要这么说
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样 我没胡说 我跑去伦敦追罗斯
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is true. I went after Ross in stupid London!

sense_groups.chinese: 伦敦是个坏地方
sense_groups.english: London is stupid! Stupid!

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不该去伦敦
sense_groups.english: I should've never gone to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 从今开始由你帮我做决定
sense_groups.english: From now on, you make all my decisions for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我以前就这么做过
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I did that for someone once.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢主宰别人的生活
sense_groups.english: I'm not comfortable having that power over someone's life.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我来
sense_groups.english: I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 摩妮卡 以后由你主宰我的爱情生活
sense_groups.english: Fine. Monica, you are now in charge of my love life.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我该去上班了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I got to go to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 很高兴看到你回来
sense_groups.english: And, uh, Rachel, great to have you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs!

sense_groups.chinese: 看到你真开心
sense_groups.english: Always a pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你看
sense_groups.english: Rachel? Sweetie, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你跟乔伊在招待会的照片
sense_groups.english: Here's a cute picture of you and Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他已经结婚了
sense_groups.english: He's married.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯结婚了 我到现在还不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Ross is married. I still can't believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 抓旁边就好
sense_groups.english: Honey, sweetie, by the edges.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我只好接受事实
sense_groups.english: I'll just have to accept it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这都要怪我
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 别抓中间 指纹会弄脏照片
sense_groups.english: Edges! Fingers! Smudgy!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我知道你心情低落
sense_groups.english: That's okay. I know that you're very upset right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是故意找我麻烦
sense_groups.english: I know that wasn't about me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看她就是跟她作对
sense_groups.english: I bet it was about her a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要是肯放下罗斯一分钟
sense_groups.english: If you'd stop thinking about Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 就会发现到处有帅哥
sense_groups.english: ...you'd notice there are great guys everywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 例如阿甘
sense_groups.english: Look. Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 他既善良又可爱
sense_groups.english: He's nice. He's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘的确…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I guess Gunther is...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有那边那个家伙
sense_groups.english: What about that guy over there?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得吗？你以前跟他打情骂俏过
sense_groups.english: That's the guy you flirted with at the counter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要和他谈谈
sense_groups.english: You're going to talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说好由我发号施今 我命令你去跟他说话
sense_groups.english: I make your decisions, and I say you're going to talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说了算 看来我只好照办
sense_groups.english: You're the boss. I got to do what you tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他听到这句话肯定上钩
sense_groups.english: Say that to him, and you're golden.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 伦敦的照片洗出来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. We got our pictures back from London.

sense_groups.chinese: 这张是所有人在伦敦塔拍的
sense_groups.english: Here's all of us at the Tower of London...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都在照片中
sense_groups.english: Here we all are.

sense_groups.chinese: 有罗斯 乔伊 你…
sense_groups.english: There's Ross and Joey and you and...

sense_groups.chinese: 和我
sense_groups.english: And me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定听烦我们说伦敦的事了
sense_groups.english: We've been talking about London too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我不好 因为我去不了
sense_groups.english: Sorry, it's just because I couldn't be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能大着肚子 烦都快烦死了
sense_groups.english: All I get to do now is pregnant stuff. It bums me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 可怜啊… - 真抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？ - 总之我们东扯西扯
sense_groups.english: What happened? - A little of this, a little of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天晚上要出去约会
sense_groups.english: I got myself a date tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧？你就要忘记罗斯了
sense_groups.english: See? Didn't I tell you? You're getting over Ross already.

sense_groups.chinese: 滚出去
sense_groups.english: Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么去那么久？
sense_groups.english: What took so long?

sense_groups.chinese: 公事担搁了 不过我明天就辞职
sense_groups.english: I got caught up at work. But I'm quitting tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你邀我过来
sense_groups.english: So thanks for having me over.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs...

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 他发什么神经？
sense_groups.english: What the hell was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能在伦敦学到的欧洲风俗
sense_groups.english: Probably some European goodbye thing he picked up in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 那才不是欧洲风俗
sense_groups.english: That's not European.

sense_groups.chinese: 比较像法式热吻
sense_groups.english: It felt French.

sense_groups.chinese: 我玩得好开心
sense_groups.english: I really had a good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么… - 那么…
看来今天要结束了
sense_groups.english: I guess this is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你想进来？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Unless you want to come inside? - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我无法自做主张
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, wait a minute. You know what? I can't decide this.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我一下
sense_groups.english: Okay. Just hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Um, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡在吗？我有事要问她
sense_groups.english: Where's Monica? I have to ask her something.

sense_groups.chinese: 她去洗衣服
sense_groups.english: Doing her laundry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天收到的包裹
sense_groups.english: It came in the mail today.

sense_groups.chinese: 72朵长茎红玫瑰
sense_groups.english: It's 72 long-stemmed, red roses.

sense_groups.chinese: 每朵代表我认识她 并且深爱她的每一天
sense_groups.english: One for each day I've known and loved Emily...

sense_groups.chinese: 给剪成碎片
sense_groups.english: ...cut up into mulch.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是糟糕
sense_groups.english: Honey, that's awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好啦
sense_groups.english: It's not so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡要用来做香料
sense_groups.english: Monica's going to make potpourri.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去淋雨散散心
sense_groups.english: I think I'm going to go wander out in the rain for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 外面没下雨
sense_groups.english: It's not raining.

sense_groups.chinese: 连老天都不赏脸
sense_groups.english: I can't catch a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你哪也别去 就坐这里
sense_groups.english: You're not going anywhere. Sit right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们喝茶聊天
sense_groups.english: I'll make you some tea and we'll talk this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？
sense_groups.english: All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 - 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Dave. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 改天再请你进来 我的室友病得很重
sense_groups.english: Um, I need to take a rain check. My roommate is really sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着
sense_groups.english: Honey, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道事情成这样很糟
sense_groups.english: I know things seem so bad...

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来不会好…
sense_groups.english: ...and that they won't get any...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以跟你谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Could I talk to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我掉了几只袜子
sense_groups.english: I dropped some socks.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又想老调重弹？又想跳回去自找苦吃？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you? Do you want to fall into the trap?

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本没掉袜子
sense_groups.english: You did not drop any socks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚碰到大卫 他说你打发他走
sense_groups.english: I saw Dave, and he said you blew him off!

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我听好
sense_groups.english: You listen to me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你离开罗斯去追大卫
sense_groups.english: I'm calling the shots! I say you leave Ross and go get Dave.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底想怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我想… 我打算…
sense_groups.english: Well, ultimately I was trying, you know, I wanted...

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他我还爱他
sense_groups.english: ...to tell him that I'm still in love with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你不准说
sense_groups.english: What? You cannot tell him that!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都喜欢听到这种话
sense_groups.english: People love to hear that!

sense_groups.chinese: 这里由我做决定 我不准你说
sense_groups.english: I make the decisions and I say no!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？你不能帮我做决定 因为…
sense_groups.english: You know what? No, you don't make my decisions, because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要开除你
sense_groups.english: ...you're fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能开除我
sense_groups.english: You can't fire me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的事情由我来决定 我说我没被开除
sense_groups.english: I make your decisions, and I say I'm not fired. Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 既然如此…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 让我进去
sense_groups.english: Rachel! Come on, let me in!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Having some trouble?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋把我锁在门外
sense_groups.english: Rachel locked the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 你肯亲我 我就帮你撞开
sense_groups.english: I'll kick that door in if you give me some sugar.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 让我进去
sense_groups.english: Rachel! Let me in!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我可以跟你谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Rachel? Can I talk to you outside for a sec?

sense_groups.chinese: 不可以
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的有话要跟你说
sense_groups.english: We really need to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就说啊
sense_groups.english: Well, then talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就说了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我们刚说你要做的事吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember that thing we just discussed that you wanted to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋要去学摇摆舞
sense_groups.english: Rachel wants to take swing dance lessons.

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常不赞成
sense_groups.english: Which I think is a really stupid idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这种舞很危险 她一定学不会
sense_groups.english: It's dangerous. She won't get what she wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且搞不好还会撞伤人
sense_groups.english: And who knows who she might end up hurting?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡说得对 摇摆舞有点危险
sense_groups.english: Monica's right. Swing dancing can be tricky.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打电话
sense_groups.english: I have to use the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要取消五只 送给艾蜜莉的熊宝宝
sense_groups.english: I got to cancel those five, giant teddy bears I sent to Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则熊宝宝难逃死劫
sense_groups.english: My God. Think of the massacre.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是要说
sense_groups.english: I'm going to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你认为我疯了
sense_groups.english: I know you think I'm crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是在你告诉他之前 至少找到一个…
sense_groups.english: But before you tell him, try to find one person...

sense_groups.chinese: 同意你想法的人 我打赌你找不到
sense_groups.english: ...who thinks it's a good idea. I bet you can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right. Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我已经进来了
sense_groups.english: Joey! I'm in!

sense_groups.chinese: 那好
sense_groups.english: All right. Good deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 嘿
sense_groups.english: Pheebs! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？怎样？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs? Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你上次说你都不能去伦敦
sense_groups.english: Um, you know how you were saying you didn't get to go to London...

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得自己遭大家遗弃 - 如何？
sense_groups.english: ...and you were feeling left out? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很愧疚
sense_groups.english: Well, we all felt really bad about that...

sense_groups.chinese: 决定大家一起去旅行
sense_groups.english: ...so we decided to take a little trip together.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so nice!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: How great! Where's the trip?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以一起去野餐
sense_groups.english: Well, we thought we would all go to a picnic...

sense_groups.chinese: 就去中央公园 - 中央公园？
sense_groups.english: ...in Central Park! - Central Park?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 大家一起去个一整天
sense_groups.english: All of us. All day.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么鸟地方？
sense_groups.english: That sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本不算旅行 我才刚从公园过来
sense_groups.english: That's not a trip! I just came from there.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家去中央公园有什么好兴奋
sense_groups.english: What'll we high-five about at the stupid park?

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 就在我家旁边
sense_groups.english: It's right by my house. All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定回家反省这个烂主意
sense_groups.english: I'm going home to bask in the triumph of my Central Park idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 热吻先生
sense_groups.english: Hold on a sec there, Mr. Kissy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想跟你讨论
sense_groups.english: I wanted to talk to you about...

sense_groups.chinese: 你新学的欧洲民情
sense_groups.english: ...this whole new European thing you've got going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞得我非常不自在
sense_groups.english: And I need to say it makes me very uncomfortable...

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你别再亲了
sense_groups.english: ...and I just, you know, just stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想介绍大家认识欧洲文化
sense_groups.english: Just bringing some culture to the group.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要不要介绍到我嘴里就好了
sense_groups.english: That's fine. Just don't bring it in my mouth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都快吐了
sense_groups.english: It makes me want to puke.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 菲比来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody! Pheebs is here!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 大家好
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! Whoo! Okay. Whoo! Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们认为野餐的主意…
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, we decided that the picnic idea was a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 实在烂透了
sense_groups.english: It didn't have any... Well, it blew.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以今天下午决定 到大西洋城…
sense_groups.english: We thought that this afternoon we'd all go away for the whole weekend...

sense_groups.chinese: 去度周末
sense_groups.english: ...to Atlantic City.

sense_groups.chinese: 大西洋城 太好了 谁想到的？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, Atlantic City! Oh, that's a great plan! Whose plan was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我
sense_groups.english: Mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 是我提议的 - 错
sense_groups.english: Wait. It was my plan. - No...

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我们应该想个新的计划
sense_groups.english: ...I said we needed a new plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我想到要去大西洋城
sense_groups.english: And I came up with Atlantic City.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是新的计划啊
sense_groups.english: Which is the new plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家一小时后楼上见
sense_groups.english: Why don't we, um, all meet upstairs in an hour?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去打包了 我要摇着大屁股好好打包
sense_groups.english: I'm going to go pack. I'm going to go pack my ass off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等一下再上去找你
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'll meet you in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 瑞秋 没有人支持你 所以你不能说
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you didn't find anyone, so you can't tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓
sense_groups.english: You know what? That doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道对方不能回应你的爱意
sense_groups.english: Do you know how painful it is to tell someone you love them...

sense_groups.chinese: 会有多痛苦吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and not have them say it back?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我看不下去
sense_groups.english: I can't watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看什么？
sense_groups.english: What you reading?

sense_groups.chinese: 报纸
sense_groups.english: Paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面说了什么？
sense_groups.english: Yeah? What's it about?

sense_groups.chinese: 世界各地的新闻
sense_groups.english: The events from around the globe.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有件事要告诉你
sense_groups.english: Uh, there's something I have to talk to you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然大家都叫我别说
sense_groups.english: Everyone's saying I shouldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他们都错了 有时候别人就是看不清楚
sense_groups.english: But I think they're wrong. People can be wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次上班时
sense_groups.english: Once at work...

sense_groups.chinese: 我说放射性碳测定法太老旧…
sense_groups.english: ...I thought carbon dating is fossilized...

sense_groups.chinese: 我说正经的
sense_groups.english: I'm really trying to tell you something here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Yeah...

sense_groups.chinese: 说吧
sense_groups.english: Go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这就说了
sense_groups.english: I think I'm just going to say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在就告诉你
sense_groups.english: I'm just going to say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还爱着你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm still in love with you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Wow, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 哈 我…
sense_groups.english: Huh. I'm...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道现在该怎么回答
sense_groups.english: Wow. I'm not sure what to do with that right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？你跟我开玩笑？这就太恶劣了
sense_groups.english: What? Was that a joke? Because it's mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很正经
sense_groups.english: I'm so dead serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能再正经了
sense_groups.english: I'm totally serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你笑什么？
sense_groups.english: Why are you laughing?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我刚听到自己的话
sense_groups.english: Because I just heard it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到了 而且觉得很荒谬
sense_groups.english: I heard it! And it's ridiculous!

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟…
sense_groups.english: I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经结婚
sense_groups.english: You're married!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有老婆 我说这话太可笑
sense_groups.english: You're married, and it's just ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说话时似乎灵魂出壳
sense_groups.english: When I said it, I sort of floated up out of my body.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的灵魂听到肉身说话
sense_groups.english: And then I heard myself say it, and then the floating Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 灵魂认为 自己实在很白痴
sense_groups.english: I was like, "You are such an idiot!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确已经结婚 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Well, I am married. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然婚礼后就没跟老婆说过话
sense_groups.english: Though I haven't spoken to her since the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 这不好笑
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. That's not funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实还蛮好笑的
sense_groups.english: Actually, it kind of is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老婆不回我电话
sense_groups.english: My wife won't return my calls.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道太太在哪里
sense_groups.english: I don't know where my wife is.

sense_groups.chinese: "罗斯 你老婆呢？" "我也不知道"
sense_groups.english: "Hey, Ross! Where's the missus?" "Don't know!"

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以忘记我刚说的话吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what? Could you forget I told you this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不忘记也不行
sense_groups.english: Well, I kind of have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为事实是…
sense_groups.english: Because the thing is...

sense_groups.chinese: 事实就是你已经娶了艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: The thing is, you know, that you're married to Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实正是如此
sense_groups.english: That is what the thing is.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们还是好朋友吧 我说自己还爱你…
sense_groups.english: Things won't be weird between us, right? Was that stupid?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是蠢毙了
sense_groups.english: Me telling you that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 我很高兴你告诉我
sense_groups.english: No, no. I'm glad you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算日子不顺利
sense_groups.english: If nothing else...

sense_groups.chinese: 听到有人说爱你还是很开心
sense_groups.english: ...it's always great when someone tells you they love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我早说过了
sense_groups.english: That's what I said!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你对我这么好 - 我才该谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you for being so nice. - No. Thank you for...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家走吧 - 前往大西洋城
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go! - Yeah, Atlantic City!

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 去大西洋城罗
sense_groups.english: Atlantic City, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去大赌一笔 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Let's roll some bones. Hey, Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 赌博万岁
sense_groups.english: High-five for rolling bones.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Ow! - Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ooh!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你尿失禁？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Pheebs, you're leaking.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你羊水破了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Your water broke.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh! Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 别放在心上 我要坐前座
sense_groups.english: Well, don't worry. I call shotgun.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们得送你去医院
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, we have to take you to the hospital now.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你快要生了
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, the babies are coming now.

sense_groups.chinese: 击掌 你要生了
sense_groups.english: Honey! High-five! The babies are coming!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 记不记得 我羊水破的那天？
sense_groups.english: Remember when my water broke?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比竟然快生了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe's going to have her babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: I know. It's beautiful and amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我竟然每次离开 都得亲菲比跟瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I had to kiss Phoebe and Rachel every time I left the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 可惜她们没看到我们嘿咻
sense_groups.english: It's too bad they didn't see us having sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底了不了解女人？
sense_groups.english: Do you know anything about women?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了解
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 - 好
sense_groups.english: It's all right. - Okay.

questions.name: S05E03
questions.en:
Hi. - Hi.
Hi. Yeah, hi. I'm, um, Phoebe Buffay and I have babies coming out.
Okay. Have you started having contractions?
Not yet. Um, I heard they really hurt. Do they?
Well... - Oh, my God.
Which of you is the father?
None of them are. The father is my brother.
Okay.
I'll miss watching you freak people out like that.
Pheebs...
This is for the babies to look at someday.
Do you want to say anything before it starts?
Okay. Um...
Hi, kids! Um, it's me, Aunt Phoebe.
Can't wait to see you. Please don't hurt me.
What took you so long?
Your cab left when ours did.
We went back because I forgot my jacket.
You're not wearing one.
Oh, man! I did it again!
Someone has to call Frank and Alice.
My mom might... What are you doing?
I've got to get the before shot.
We spoke to the nurse. The reason your doctor is late...
...is because, uh, she's not coming.
What? - She hit her head in the shower.
Oh, my God. She's so stupid!
Pheebs, it's going to be okay.
I don't see three kids coming out of your vagina.
Listen. The nurse said the doctor is wonderful.
He's head of the department.
All right. Ooh. Oh, dear God, save me.
I'm having my first contraction.
Oh, it's not bad. - Okay.
And so the miracle of birth begins. And I...
You okay?
Something hurts.
Ooh, it's sympathy pains. Oh, that's so sweet.
I didn't know I cared that much.
Hello. - Hi.
I'm Dr. Harad. I'll be delivering your babies.
You'll be in good hands. I've been doing this a long time.
I'll be back to do your internal.
Just relax, everything looks great.
And also, I love Fonzie.
Did he just say he loves Fonzie?
That's what it sounded like.
All right.
Hey!
Am I late? Nobody came out yet, right?
No, we haven't started yet. Where's Alice?
Uh, Delaware. Until she gets here, I'll be your coach.
Don't worry. She told me about the LaMazda stuff.
If you get the babies out by month's end...
...you get two percent financing.
Yeah.
Monica, you're going to be very proud of me.
I just got us dates with two unbelievably cute nurses.
Oh, my.
They're male nurses.
Heh, heh. Not in my head.
They want to take us out Saturday night. What do you say?
Um...
I don't think so. - What?
What are you talking about?
You've been telling me to get over Ross and move on.
I'm moving on and so are you.
Why don't you want to go?
Um...
Why don't you give me a good reason...
...and I'll tell you if it's true.
What? - Harder than it sounds, isn't it?
You're coming. And when they get off...
...we'll go get some Jello with them.
Yep. There's always room for Jello.
How do you make that dirty?
It's easy. I can do it with anything.
Grandma's chicken salad...
Ross!
Get a shot of this.
Hey, babies, these are the headlines when you were born.
Now girl baby, turn away. And boy babies...
...check it out.
This is what naked women looked like when you were born.
Now let's dive into the good stuff.
Okay, I'm having another one.
This one doesn't hurt eith... Ooh, yes, it does! Ow.
Ow, ow, ow!
Ooh.
Ooh, I was kind of hoping that was it.
Where are Monica and Rachel, anyway?
A couple of nurses asked them out. Maybe they're with them.
Really? Male nurses?
Yeah, I was bummed too.
So they're going on dates?
When? - I think Saturday.
What's with him? - Um, sympathy pains.
It was sweet at first, but now I think he's trying to steal my thunder.
Okay.
Let's see what we got here.
Oh, you know, Fonzie dated triplets.
This Fonzie person you keep referring to...
...is that another doctor?
Oh, no, no.
Fonzie is the nickname of Arthur Fonzerelli.
The Fonz.
All right.
Soon.
It's not that weird, is it?
It's very weird.
I don't want some guy down there telling me I'm "dilated-a-mundo."
He doesn't seem to be impersonating Fonzie...
What are you doing?
Why are you defending him? Just get me another doctor...
...who isn't crazy and doesn't Fonzie!
Again, it's not... - Aah! Aah!
Hey, there you are.
Um, there's something you should know.
Is this about you dating the nurse? Joey told me.
I am so fine. You and I, we're just, nothing.
Just goofing around.
Um, I was about to tell you I was getting out of it.
But, um, if we're just "goofing around," maybe I will go out with him.
Fine. Maybe I will too.
Hey! Look what I found in the gift shop...
Oh. Get up! Get up! Get up!
Okay, Pheebs?
This is Dr. Oberman.
He has no strong feelings about Fonzie...
...or any of the Happy Days gang.
You're going into what grade?
I'm actually a first-year resident. I graduated early.
Uh-huh. Me too.
Ross, I should have specified I'd need a grown-up doctor.
Really, I'm fully qualified...
Shh, Doogie. Shh.
Doesn't anybody understand that I'm going to be having babies soon? Huh?
Go, little boy! Go!
Oh, cool. You made him cry!
Mr. Tribbiani, I'm afraid you've got kidney stones.
Uh, well, what else could it be?
It's kidney stones.
Or...
Kidney stones.
You're getting there.
These babies are very, very lucky.
They are? Why?
They'll be born on the Fonz's half-birthday.
Happy birthday.
Just to clarify.
I'm not Fonzie.
Yeah.
It's a terrific thing that you're having these babies for Frank and Alice.
I know, it is. - Yeah.
Can I tell you a secret? - Yeah.
I want to keep one.
Oh, I'm going to be on the news.
You've gotta be kidding.
You know you can't keep one of these babies.
Maybe I can. You don't know.
I do. Frank and Alice will want to keep all their children.
Maybe not. You know?
Three babies are a handful.
Maybe they'll want to unload one.
I hate to miss an opportunity because I didn't ask.
Phoebe, no. This is insane.
Just ask him.
What? Me?
I can't ask him!
Do you know how inappropriate that would be?
All I'm saying is, just talk to Frank.
Just feel him out.
No. I will not ask Frank to give you one of his kids.
You're right.
Tell him it's for you.
Feeling better, sweetie?
Maybe a little.
Wish you hadn't seen me throw up.
Me too.
Hey. I just heard. What's up?
Kidney stones.
Ordinarily, we try to break the stones up with shock waves.
But they're too close to the bladder.
Either we wait for you to pass them or else go up the urethra...
Whoa!
No, no, no. Nothing is going "up," okay?
"Up" is not an option. What's a urethra?
Are you crazy?
Did you ask him?
No, I haven't had a chance yet.
I'm kind of on a clock here.
Oh, Fonzie.
You know who I always liked? Mork.
Undo it. Undo it. Undo it.
Fonzie met Mork.
Mork froze Fonzie.
Yeah...
Yes...
...but Fonzie was already cool.
So he wasn't hurt. Right?
Yeah, that's right.
How you doing?
Okay. Doctor says any minute now.
You know, Alice is going to be here so soon.
You couldn't just do me a favor and, like, hold them in?
Sorry, I'm in the middle of the last favor you asked me to do.
Hey, Rachel. Hi!
This is Dan, one of the guys we're going out with on Saturday.
Dan, Monica.
Nice to meet you.
Hello, Dan.
I'm really looking forward to Saturday night. Really! Really!
So Dan...
Nurse, not a doctor, huh?
Kind of girlie, isn't it?
Chandler. - That's okay.
I'm doing this to get through medical school.
Oh.
And it didn't feel "girlie" during the Gulf War.
Sure.
Thanks for doing that for us, by the way.
Why wait till Saturday? Are you free tomorrow?
Sure. I'll get somebody to cover me.
Aw, great.
Hey, you and me, Saturday night?
No. - All right, very good!
This is a big one.
Unh! Get these things out of me!
Breathe! Breathe through the pain.
I want the drugs, Ross!
I do too! I do too!
Yeah, I love you. Okay, bye.
Hi. - Hi.
That was Alice's mom. Alice left five hours ago.
She should be here.
She'll make it on time.
Yeah. - Yeah.
So Frank...
Three babies. Whoo, that just seems like a lot, huh?
Not to me.
Fair enough.
You're at 10 centimeters. Time to start having babies.
I want only the father here.
We love you. - Good luck.
Bye, Dan! - Uh, bye, Monica.
I need a clamp, a sterile towel and Channel 31.
What is that?
Oh, my God!
Oh, no, no! It's a good one. Fonzie plays the bongos.
Ready? Time to try pushing.
Ready? Time to try peeing.
Wait, wait, wait, wait! It's almost time to try peeing.
Push. Concentrate on pushing.
I see the head.
Yes, it is a head!
Keep pushing. Come on.
I can't believe somebody's coming out!
There's somebody coming out of you!
It's my son!
All right.
Here's your first baby.
Yes!
Yes! We got a baby boy!
Frank Junior, Junior!
How does he look?
So gross!
Okay. You ready to push again?
I already had a baby. Leave me alone.
Come on, you can do it. You can do it.
Yeah!
Little Leslie's here! We got another one!
Oh, my God! I can't believe I have two children.
How scary is that?
Come on, little Chandler, it's time to be born.
He's coming! Yes, he's coming!
Hey, where's his thing?
Chandler's a girl!
Oh, God. Kindergarten flashback.
They read the sonogram wrong, because they thought it was a boy.
But Chandler's a girl! Chandler's a girl!
Okay, keep saying it.
Am I too late? - No, no. Everything's okay.
There's 30 fingers and 30 toes.
We have our babies?
Yeah.
We have our babies.
Oh, my God.
You did it, man.
Would you like to see them?
They're so small.
I'll call you tomorrow. - Great.
Are you really going to date that nurse man?
You and I are just "goofing around."
I thought, why not "goof around" with him?
I don't know if you've looked up "goofing around" in the dictionary.
Well, I have...
...and the technical definition is
"Two friends who care a lot about each other...
...and have amazing sex...
...and just want to spend more time together."
But if you have this new dictionary that gets you mad at me...
...then we have to get you my original dictionary.
I am so bad at this.
You're better than you think you are. - Really?
Okay. So if...
Know when to stop. - I sensed that I should stop.
So we're okay? - Yeah.
I'm gonna go tell Dan that it's not going to happen.
Don't do the dance. - Right.
You're my favorite.
Which one do you have? - I don't care.
Hi.
Hey.
Frank and Alice want me to tell you they're making phone calls.
Did you talk to them about, you know...
Yeah, um...
No, honey.
Oh, okay.
It was a long shot.
You guys? Can I just have a second alone with the babies?
Yeah.
So here you are.
Seems like yesterday I was talking to you in that petri dish.
Everyone said labor was the hardest thing.
But they were wrong. This is.
Well, I had the most fun with you guys.
I wish I could take you home and see you every day.
I'll settle for being your favorite aunt.
I know Alice's sister has a pool, but you lived in me.
Okay, so we're cool.
We're going to be great.
Little high-fives.
Aah, aah, aah.
Well, if you're going to cry...
Phoebe, we are so proud of you. You're amazing!
I know.
Does it hurt as bad as they say?
You won't be able to take it.
Now that little Chandler is a girl, what'll they name her?
They'll call her Chandler.
Kind of a masculine name, don't you think?
It works on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的 我又忘了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man! I did it again!

sense_groups.chinese: 得有人通知法兰克和爱丽丝
sense_groups.english: Someone has to call Frank and Alice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈也想… 乔伊 你干什么？
sense_groups.english: My mom might... What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得拍生产前的镜头
sense_groups.english: I've got to get the before shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们问过护士了 你的医生之所以迟到…
sense_groups.english: We spoke to the nurse. The reason your doctor is late...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为她不来了
sense_groups.english: ...is because, uh, she's not coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 她在浴室跌倒撞到头了
sense_groups.english: What? - She hit her head in the shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 那个蠢女人
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's so stupid!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, it's going to be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得轻松 你的阴道又没有宝宝要出来
sense_groups.english: I don't see three kids coming out of your vagina.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 护士说这个医生很好
sense_groups.english: Listen. The nurse said the doctor is wonderful.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是妇产科主任
sense_groups.english: He's head of the department.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 老天爷救救我
sense_groups.english: All right. Ooh. Oh, dear God, save me.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次阵痛来了
sense_groups.english: I'm having my first contraction.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好嘛 - 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's not bad. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 生命的奇迹开始了…
sense_groups.english: And so the miracle of birth begins. And I...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: You okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 有个地方好痛
sense_groups.english: Something hurts.

sense_groups.chinese: 是感同身受 如此甜蜜啊
sense_groups.english: Ooh, it's sympathy pains. Oh, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我有那么在意
sense_groups.english: I didn't know I cared that much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是哈洛医生 我负责替你接生
sense_groups.english: I'm Dr. Harad. I'll be delivering your babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 有我在你放心 我是老手了
sense_groups.english: You'll be in good hands. I've been doing this a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来帮你做检查
sense_groups.english: I'll be back to do your internal.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先放轻松 目前一切都很好
sense_groups.english: Just relax, everything looks great.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我爱方奇
sense_groups.english: And also, I love Fonzie.

sense_groups.chinese: 他刚才说他爱方奇吗？
sense_groups.english: Did he just say he loves Fonzie?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来是
sense_groups.english: That's what it sounded like.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我来晚了吗？还没有人出来吧？
sense_groups.english: Am I late? Nobody came out yet, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 还没开始呢 爱丽丝呢？
sense_groups.english: No, we haven't started yet. Where's Alice?

sense_groups.chinese: 在德拉威 不过她正在赶来 目前先由我充当教练
sense_groups.english: Uh, Delaware. Until she gets here, I'll be your coach.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 她有教我拉马兹什么的
sense_groups.english: Don't worry. She told me about the LaMazda stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是在月底前生产
sense_groups.english: If you get the babies out by month's end...

sense_groups.chinese: 就能获得2%的补助
sense_groups.english: ...you get two percent financing.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你一定会很以我为荣
sense_groups.english: Monica, you're going to be very proud of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮我们约到两个俏护士
sense_groups.english: I just got us dates with two unbelievably cute nurses.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 是男看护
sense_groups.english: They're male nurses.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我想像中不是
sense_groups.english: Heh, heh. Not in my head.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们约我们周六晚上出去 如何？
sense_groups.english: They want to take us out Saturday night. What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我看算了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么叫算了？
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 是你劝我忘记罗斯向前看的
sense_groups.english: You've been telling me to get over Ross and move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我向前看了 你得陪我
sense_groups.english: I'm moving on and so are you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说 你为什么不去
sense_groups.english: Why don't you want to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 不如你说一个理由
sense_groups.english: Why don't you give me a good reason...

sense_groups.chinese: 我再告诉你是对是错
sense_groups.english: ...and I'll tell you if it's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 没那么简单吧？
sense_groups.english: What? - Harder than it sounds, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 总之你也要去 我还答应他们下班…
sense_groups.english: You're coming. And when they get off...

sense_groups.chinese: 一起去吃果冻
sense_groups.english: ...we'll go get some Jello with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 人永远吃得下果冻
sense_groups.english: Yep. There's always room for Jello.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么能说得那么色？
sense_groups.english: How do you make that dirty?

sense_groups.chinese: 简单 我什么都能说得很色
sense_groups.english: It's easy. I can do it with anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 奶奶的鸡肉沙拉…
sense_groups.english: Grandma's chicken salad...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 拍这里
sense_groups.english: Get a shot of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你们出生当天的头条
sense_groups.english: Hey, babies, these are the headlines when you were born.

sense_groups.chinese: 女宝宝把头转开 男宝宝…
sense_groups.english: Now girl baby, turn away. And boy babies...

sense_groups.chinese: 看看
sense_groups.english: ...check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是你出生当月的裸女
sense_groups.english: This is what naked women looked like when you were born.

sense_groups.chinese: 尽情欣赏吧
sense_groups.english: Now let's dive into the good stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 阵痛又来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm having another one.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次也不太痛… 错 很痛
sense_groups.english: This one doesn't hurt eith... Ooh, yes, it does! Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Ow, ow, ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有点希望已经生了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I was kind of hoping that was it.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和瑞秋呢？
sense_groups.english: Where are Monica and Rachel, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能跟约她们的护士在一起
sense_groups.english: A couple of nurses asked them out. Maybe they're with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？男看护？
sense_groups.english: Really? Male nurses?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也很失望
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I was bummed too.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们要去约会？
sense_groups.english: So they're going on dates?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候？ - 星期六吧…
sense_groups.english: When? - I think Saturday.

sense_groups.chinese: 他怎么了？ - 他感同身受
sense_groups.english: What's with him? - Um, sympathy pains.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来很感动 现在我觉得他只是想抢风头
sense_groups.english: It was sweet at first, but now I think he's trying to steal my thunder.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 来看看你的情况
sense_groups.english: Let's see what we got here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？方奇跟三胞胎约过会
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, Fonzie dated triplets.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一直提到的这位方奇
sense_groups.english: This Fonzie person you keep referring to...

sense_groups.chinese: 他是另一位医生吗？
sense_groups.english: ...is that another doctor?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 方奇是亚瑟方塞瑞利的昵称
sense_groups.english: Fonzie is the nickname of Arthur Fonzerelli.

sense_groups.chinese: 也叫方子
sense_groups.english: The Fonz.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 很快了
sense_groups.english: Soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实不会很怪吧？
sense_groups.english: It's not that weird, is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 怪得不得了
sense_groups.english: It's very weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要听某人告诉我 我扩张了"一滴滴"
sense_groups.english: I don't want some guy down there telling me I'm "dilated-a-mundo."

sense_groups.chinese: 老实说 他不是在模仿方奇…
sense_groups.english: He doesn't seem to be impersonating Fonzie...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛替他辩解？去帮我另外找一个没有发疯的医生
sense_groups.english: Why are you defending him? Just get me another doctor...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是方奇的医生
sense_groups.english: ...who isn't crazy and doesn't Fonzie!

sense_groups.chinese: 其实他不是… - 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Again, it's not... - Aah! Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你在这里
sense_groups.english: Hey, there you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事应该让你知道
sense_groups.english: Um, there's something you should know.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你要跟护士约会的事吗？我听乔伊说了
sense_groups.english: Is this about you dating the nurse? Joey told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点也不在意 你和我又没什么
sense_groups.english: I am so fine. You and I, we're just, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是玩玩
sense_groups.english: Just goofing around.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我是想告诉你我打算推掉
sense_groups.english: Um, I was about to tell you I was getting out of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我们只是玩玩 那我就跟他出去好了
sense_groups.english: But, um, if we're just "goofing around," maybe I will go out with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我也要
sense_groups.english: Fine. Maybe I will too.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 你们看我在礼品店发现了什么…
sense_groups.english: Hey! Look what I found in the gift shop...

sense_groups.chinese: 起来 快起来
sense_groups.english: Oh. Get up! Get up! Get up!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是欧伯曼医生
sense_groups.english: This is Dr. Oberman.

sense_groups.chinese: 他对方奇或《欢乐时光》里的所有人物…
sense_groups.english: He has no strong feelings about Fonzie...

sense_groups.chinese: 都没什么感觉
sense_groups.english: ...or any of the Happy Days gang.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要升几年级？
sense_groups.english: You're going into what grade?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚升住院医师 常有人那样问我 我提前…
sense_groups.english: I'm actually a first-year resident. I graduated early.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 或许我应该强调 我是要已成年的医师
sense_groups.english: Ross, I should have specified I'd need a grown-up doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对有能力…
sense_groups.english: Really, I'm fully qualified...

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shh, Doogie. Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底有没有人了解我快生了？
sense_groups.english: Doesn't anybody understand that I'm going to be having babies soon? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你走 走啊 小毛头
sense_groups.english: Go, little boy! Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 你把他弄哭了
sense_groups.english: Oh, cool. You made him cry!

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼先生 你有肾结石
sense_groups.english: Mr. Tribbiani, I'm afraid you've got kidney stones.

sense_groups.chinese: 有别的可能吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, what else could it be?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是肾结石
sense_groups.english: It's kidney stones.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是…
sense_groups.english: Or...

sense_groups.chinese: 肾结石
sense_groups.english: Kidney stones.

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多了
sense_groups.english: You're getting there.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些宝宝很幸运
sense_groups.english: These babies are very, very lucky.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 为什么？
sense_groups.english: They are? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们的生日日期是方子的一半
sense_groups.english: They'll be born on the Fonz's half-birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我澄清一下
sense_groups.english: Just to clarify.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是方奇
sense_groups.english: I'm not Fonzie.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶额
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你能替你弟生孩子真的很棒
sense_groups.english: It's a terrific thing that you're having these babies for Frank and Alice.

sense_groups.chinese: 的确 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: I know, it is. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以告诉你个秘密吗？ - 你说
sense_groups.english: Can I tell you a secret? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要自己留一个
sense_groups.english: I want to keep one.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我要上新闻
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm going to be on the news.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别开玩笑了
sense_groups.english: You've gotta be kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你明知道你不能这么做
sense_groups.english: You know you can't keep one of these babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？搞不好可以 你怎么知道
sense_groups.english: Maybe I can. You don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然知道 法兰克他们一定三个都要
sense_groups.english: I do. Frank and Alice will want to keep all their children.

sense_groups.chinese: 不一定 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Maybe not. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 三个宝宝很多
sense_groups.english: Three babies are a handful.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许他们正在找机会送走一个
sense_groups.english: Maybe they'll want to unload one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想因为没开口而失去机会
sense_groups.english: I hate to miss an opportunity because I didn't ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这件事太扯了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, no. This is insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就问问看嘛
sense_groups.english: Just ask him.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我？
sense_groups.english: What? Me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能自己问
sense_groups.english: I can't ask him!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道那样多不成体统吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know how inappropriate that would be?

sense_groups.chinese: 总之你去找法兰克谈
sense_groups.english: All I'm saying is, just talk to Frank.

sense_groups.chinese: 探探他的口风
sense_groups.english: Just feel him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我怎么能叫法兰克 送你一个孩子
sense_groups.english: No. I will not ask Frank to give you one of his kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对
sense_groups.english: You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 就说是你要的
sense_groups.english: Tell him it's for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好一点了吗？
sense_groups.english: Feeling better, sweetie?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点点吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望你没看到我吐
sense_groups.english: Wish you hadn't seen me throw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也希望
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚听说 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: Hey. I just heard. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 肾结石
sense_groups.english: Kidney stones.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我们会用冲击波震碎结石
sense_groups.english: Ordinarily, we try to break the stones up with shock waves.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你的结石已经太靠近膀胱
sense_groups.english: But they're too close to the bladder.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是等你排尿排出来 震是从尿道往上…
sense_groups.english: Either we wait for you to pass them or else go up the urethra...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 不能往上
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Nothing is going "up," okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对不考虑往上 尿道是什么？
sense_groups.english: "Up" is not an option. What's a urethra?

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你问他了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you ask him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有机会跟他独处
sense_groups.english: No, I haven't had a chance yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的时间有限
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of on a clock here.

sense_groups.chinese: 方奇
sense_groups.english: Oh, Fonzie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都很喜欢魔克
sense_groups.english: You know who I always liked? Mork.

sense_groups.chinese: 收回 收回
sense_groups.english: Undo it. Undo it. Undo it.

sense_groups.chinese: 方奇见过魔克
sense_groups.english: Fonzie met Mork.

sense_groups.chinese: 魔克把方奇结冻
sense_groups.english: Mork froze Fonzie.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但…
sense_groups.english: Yeah...

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是方奇本来就很酷
sense_groups.english: ...but Fonzie was already cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他不会有事 对吧？
sense_groups.english: So he wasn't hurt. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 也对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 医生说随时都会生
sense_groups.english: Okay. Doctor says any minute now.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱丽丝马上就会到
sense_groups.english: You know, Alice is going to be here so soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能帮个忙 先留住？
sense_groups.english: You couldn't just do me a favor and, like, hold them in?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我正在处理你请我帮的最后一个忙
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I'm in the middle of the last favor you asked me to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 他是丹 我们星期六的男伴之一
sense_groups.english: This is Dan, one of the guys we're going out with on Saturday.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹 这是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Dan, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 丹
sense_groups.english: Hello, Dan.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很期待星期六的约会 非常期持
sense_groups.english: I'm really looking forward to Saturday night. Really! Really!

sense_groups.chinese: 丹
sense_groups.english: So Dan...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是护士不是医生？
sense_groups.english: Nurse, not a doctor, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点娘娘腔对吧？
sense_groups.english: Kind of girlie, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是为了挣钱 好上完医学院
sense_groups.english: I'm doing this to get through medical school.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且海湾战争时 感觉没那么娘娘腔
sense_groups.english: And it didn't feel "girlie" during the Gulf War.

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢你保家卫国
sense_groups.english: Thanks for doing that for us, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 何必等到星期六 你明天有空吗？
sense_groups.english: Why wait till Saturday? Are you free tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 行啊 我找人代班
sense_groups.english: Sure. I'll get somebody to cover me.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Aw, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们星期六去约个会如何？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you and me, Saturday night?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 很好
sense_groups.english: No. - All right, very good!

sense_groups.chinese: 这一回很痛
sense_groups.english: This is a big one.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它弄出来
sense_groups.english: Unh! Get these things out of me!

sense_groups.chinese: 深呼吸 深呼吸可以止痛
sense_groups.english: Breathe! Breathe through the pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想吃止痛药 我想吃止痛药
sense_groups.english: I want the drugs, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 我也是
sense_groups.english: I do too! I do too!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 再见
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I love you. Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱丽丝的妈说她出发5小时了
sense_groups.english: That was Alice's mom. Alice left five hours ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 她早就该到了
sense_groups.english: She should be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 她会赶上的
sense_groups.english: She'll make it on time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克…
sense_groups.english: So Frank...

sense_groups.chinese: 三个宝宝耶 还真多 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Three babies. Whoo, that just seems like a lot, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不觉得
sense_groups.english: Not to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Fair enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 扩张10公分 该生了
sense_groups.english: You're at 10 centimeters. Time to start having babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 请父亲留下来就好
sense_groups.english: I want only the father here.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱你哦 - 加油
sense_groups.english: We love you. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹 再见 - 再见 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Bye, Dan! - Uh, bye, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要产钳 消毒毛巾和31频道
sense_groups.english: I need a clamp, a sterile towel and Channel 31.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: What is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 这一集很棒 方奇玩曼波鼓
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no! It's a good one. Fonzie plays the bongos.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？该用力了
sense_groups.english: Ready? Time to try pushing.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了吗？该撒尿了
sense_groups.english: Ready? Time to try peeing.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 是差不多该撒尿了
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait, wait! It's almost time to try peeing.

sense_groups.chinese: 用力 很好 专心用力
sense_groups.english: Push. Concentrate on pushing.

sense_groups.chinese: 有了 我看到头了
sense_groups.english: I see the head.

sense_groups.chinese: 万岁 他有头
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is a head!

sense_groups.chinese: 继续用力 加油
sense_groups.english: Keep pushing. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 居然有人从你肚子里跑出来
sense_groups.english: I can't believe somebody's coming out!

sense_groups.chinese: 有人从你肚子里跑出来
sense_groups.english: There's somebody coming out of you!

sense_groups.chinese: 是我儿子
sense_groups.english: It's my son!

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的第一个宝宝
sense_groups.english: Here's your first baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 万岁
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 万岁 小男生出来了
sense_groups.english: Yes! We got a baby boy!

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克二世 二世
sense_groups.english: Frank Junior, Junior!

sense_groups.chinese: 他长得怎样？
sense_groups.english: How does he look?

sense_groups.chinese: 粗俗死了
sense_groups.english: So gross!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 可以再用力了吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. You ready to push again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经生一个了 不要烦我
sense_groups.english: I already had a baby. Leave me alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 你一定行
sense_groups.english: Come on, you can do it. You can do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 万岁
sense_groups.english: Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 小莱丝莉出来了
sense_groups.english: Little Leslie's here! We got another one!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我居然有两个孩子了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! I can't believe I have two children.

sense_groups.chinese: 真吓人
sense_groups.english: How scary is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 小钱德 快啊 该出来了 小钱德
sense_groups.english: Come on, little Chandler, it's time to be born.

sense_groups.chinese: 他出来了 他出来了
sense_groups.english: He's coming! Yes, he's coming!

sense_groups.chinese: 他的小象呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, where's his thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德是女生
sense_groups.english: Chandler's a girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 幼稚园回忆重现
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Kindergarten flashback.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是照超音波看错了 医生以为是个男生
sense_groups.english: They read the sonogram wrong, because they thought it was a boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但钱德是女生 钱德是女生
sense_groups.english: But Chandler's a girl! Chandler's a girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 继续叫
sense_groups.english: Okay, keep saying it.

sense_groups.chinese: 来晚了吗？ - 没有 一切都很好
sense_groups.english: Am I too late? - No, no. Everything's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个宝宝都好手好脚的
sense_groups.english: There's 30 fingers and 30 toes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的孩子生了？
sense_groups.english: We have our babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有孩子了
sense_groups.english: We have our babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你办到了
sense_groups.english: You did it, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要看看它们吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like to see them?

sense_groups.chinese: 好小喔
sense_groups.english: They're so small.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天跟你联络 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'll call you tomorrow. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要跟那个男护士约会？
sense_groups.english: Are you really going to date that nurse man?

sense_groups.chinese: 你和我只是"玩玩"
sense_groups.english: You and I are just "goofing around."

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然也可以跟他"玩玩"
sense_groups.english: I thought, why not "goof around" with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你有没有查过字典
sense_groups.english: I don't know if you've looked up "goofing around" in the dictionary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有
sense_groups.english: Well, I have...

sense_groups.chinese: "玩玩"的定义是…
sense_groups.english: ...and the technical definition is

sense_groups.chinese: "两个好朋友 非常在乎对方
sense_groups.english: "Two friends who care a lot about each other...

sense_groups.chinese: 在床上很性福
sense_groups.english: ...and have amazing sex...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且想多跟对方相处"
sense_groups.english: ...and just want to spend more time together."

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你用的是这个版本那真是让你气死我了
sense_groups.english: But if you have this new dictionary that gets you mad at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们应该买我的版本给你
sense_groups.english: ...then we have to get you my original dictionary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我实在很糟糕
sense_groups.english: I am so bad at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 比你想像的要好 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: You're better than you think you are. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那…
sense_groups.english: Okay. So if...

sense_groups.chinese: 要见好就收 - 我也觉得够了
sense_groups.english: Know when to stop. - I sensed that I should stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没事了？ - 没事了
sense_groups.english: So we're okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去告诉丹我不跟他约会
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go tell Dan that it's not going to happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要跳舞 - 好
sense_groups.english: Don't do the dance. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我最喜欢你
sense_groups.english: You're my favorite.

sense_groups.chinese: 你抱的是哪个？ - 无所谓
sense_groups.english: Which one do you have? - I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克和爱丽丝说 他们还要打电话
sense_groups.english: Frank and Alice want me to tell you they're making phone calls.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有问他们…
sense_groups.english: Did you talk to them about, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正也不太可能
sense_groups.english: It was a long shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我跟宝宝独处一下好吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys? Can I just have a second alone with the babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都在了
sense_groups.english: So here you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对着培养皿跟你们说话 彷佛是昨天的事
sense_groups.english: Seems like yesterday I was talking to you in that petri dish.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都说生产最难熬
sense_groups.english: Everyone said labor was the hardest thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实跟你们分开才是
sense_groups.english: But they were wrong. This is.

sense_groups.chinese: 这段日子真的很开心
sense_groups.english: Well, I had the most fun with you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想带你们回家每天看着你们
sense_groups.english: I wish I could take you home and see you every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就当你们最喜欢的姑姑吧
sense_groups.english: I'll settle for being your favorite aunt.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱丽丝的妹妹家有游泳池 但你们在我肚子里游过
sense_groups.english: I know Alice's sister has a pool, but you lived in me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就这样了
sense_groups.english: Okay, so we're cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会处得很好
sense_groups.english: We're going to be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 小击掌
sense_groups.english: Little high-fives.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Aah, aah, aah.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你都哭了
sense_groups.english: Well, if you're going to cry...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们好以你为荣 你真了不起
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, we are so proud of you. You're amazing!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的有那么痛吗？
sense_groups.english: Does it hurt as bad as they say?

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对受不了
sense_groups.english: You won't be able to take it.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然小钱德是个女生 他们打算叫她什么？
sense_groups.english: Now that little Chandler is a girl, what'll they name her?

sense_groups.chinese: 就叫她钱德
sense_groups.english: They'll call her Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个名字有点男性化吧？
sense_groups.english: Kind of a masculine name, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都能用了
sense_groups.english: It works on you.

questions.name: S05E04
questions.en:
Come in.
I've been waiting for you.
Hi, I just...
Ah! Oh, my God! Monica!
Oh, my God!
I'm sorry! I was...
I was taking a nap.
Since when do you take naps in that position?
Tell me you were waiting for a guy. Please tell me.
Yes, I was. A guy.
From work.
I'm seeing a guy from work! Ha!
That cute waiter guy from your restaurant.
The one that looks like a non-threatening Ray Liotta?
Aha. That one!
Give me a second. I'll be out of your hair. I'm just going to grab a jacket.
When I get back, I want every little detail.
Maybe that's him.
Okay, um... Okay, um...
It's just Joey and Ross.
Why aren't you at the movie?
We were, but Ross was talking so loud on his phone, they threw us out.
I had to talk loud because the movie was loud!
He's talking to London. - Did he get in touch with Emily?
No. He's calling everyone on her side of the family...
...hoping someone will help him get in touch with her.
I don't care if I said some other girl's name, you prissy old twit!
Ross.
Way to suck up to the family!
I'm so glad you're all here. My office finally got wrinkle-free fax paper!
Hey - Oh, no, no! Vomit tux! No, no! Vomit tux!
Don't worry, I had it dry-cleaned.
Vomit tux?
Who vomited on...
You know what? What you up to, Joe?
They're doing this telethon thing on TV.
And my agent got me a job as co-host!
That's great!
A little good deed for PBS, plus some TV exposure.
That's the kind of math Joey likes to do.
Oh, PBS!
What's wrong with PBS? - What's right with them?
Why don't you like PBS?
Right after my Mom killed herself, I was in this bad place, you know, personally.
So I just thought it would make me feel better if I wrote to Sesame Street.
Because they were so nice when I was a little kid.
No one ever wrote back.
A lot of those Muppets don't have thumbs.
All I got was a lousy keychain, and by that time, I was living in a box.
I didn't have keys!
I'm sorry, Pheebs.
I just wanted to do a good deed, like you did with the babies.
This isn't a good deed. You just want to get on TV. This is totally selfish.
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
What about you having those babies for your brother?
Talk about selfish!
What are you talking about?
It was a nice thing, but it made you feel good, right?
Yeah, so?
It made you feel good so that makes it selfish.
Look, there's no unselfish good deeds. Sorry.
Yes, there are totally good deeds that are selfless!
May I ask for one example?
Yeah, it's... You know, there's...
No, you may not!
That's because all people are selfish.
Are you calling me selfish?
Are you calling you people?
Sorry to burst that bubble, Pheebs, but selfless good deeds don't exist.
Okay?
And you know the deal on Santa Claus, right?
I'm gonna find a selfless good deed. I'm going to beat you, you evil genius!
Hello? - Hello, Ross?
Emily?
Oh, my God! It's Emily!
It's Emily, everyone! Shh! Shh! Shh!
Hi.
I'm only ringing to say stop harassing my relatives. Goodbye.
Wait! Okay, okay, you can hang up, but I'll keep calling everyone in England...
...if that's what it takes to get you to talk to me.
Really? About what?
Look, you're my wife. We're married.
You know, I love you.
I really miss you.
I miss you too.
Well, at least I think I do.
She's talking.
When you said "the deal with Santa Claus," you meant?
That he doesn't exist.
Right.
Chandler, have you heard about Monica's secret boyfriend?
Yeah, she might have mentioned him.
So, Mon, when are we going to meet this new, secret waiter man?
He's really shy. I don't think he's up to meeting everyone yet.
Yeah, I don't think he's up to meeting everyone yet.
I don't care, I wanna meet this guy who's the best sex she ever had.
Really?
That's what you heard? You said that?
I might have said that.
Why is that funny?
Because I'm very happy for him.
And you! You lucky dog!
Hi. - Hey.
Well, Emily's willing to work on the relationship.
That's great! - Yes!
In London.
What? - She wants me to move to London.
But you live here.
You know that.
What are you gonna do?
I bet if I talked to Carol and Susan...
...I could convince them to move to London with Ben.
I'm sure your ex-wife would be more than happy to move to another country...
...so you can patch things up with your new wife.
It could happen.
How you doing? Welcome. Good to see you.
This'll be your phone.
That's great.
But I'm not really expecting a lot of calls.
No, you answer it and take pledges.
But I'm the host.
No, Gary Collins is the host. You'll be answering the phone.
You don't seem to understand. See, I was Dr. Drake Ramoray.
Well, here's your phone, doctor.
I can't believe I can't find a selfless good deed.
You know that really old guy that lives next door to me?
I snuck over there and raked up all the leaves on his front stoop.
But he caught me, and he force-fed me cider and cookies.
Then I felt wonderful. That old jackass!
Maybe Joey's right. Maybe all good deeds are selfish.
I will find a selfless good deed. Because I just gave birth to three children...
...and I will not let them be raised in a world where Joey's right!
Hey, Monica? Can I ask you a cooking question?
Sure. - If you're cooking on the stove...
...does that mean that your new secret boyfriend is better in bed than Richard?
Chandler.
Is he?
I think I'm going to respect the privacy of my new, secret boyfriend.
Why?
If this guy was me...
...and it's me who'd learned that it was me who was the best you'd ever had...
...I'd be going like this
All right, Emily.
As much as I love you...
...I'm sorry, I can't move to London without Ben.
I understand that would be difficult.
Would you consider moving here? You were moving here anyway.
Why can't you just do that?
I don't know. It's just...
Okay, okay, but I know that even though I've been a complete idiot up till now...
...you have to come here.
You have to, so we can work this out together.
All right.
All right? Did you just say "all right"?
I did. Now I'm the idiot.
Emily, that is so great!
It'll be great!
We're going to be like two idiots in love!
Ross, there's one thing that really scares me still.
Yes, tell me. - You have to understand...
...how humiliating it was for me up on that altar...
...in front of my entire family, all my friends.
I know. I am so sorry.
And then, after deciding to forgive you...
...seeing you at the airport, catching our plane with her.
Again, very sorry.
I mean, I can't be in the same room as her.
It drives me mad thinking of you being in the same room as her.
Emily, there is nothing between Rachel and me.
Okay?
I love you.
All right.
I'll come to New York and we'll try to make this work.
That is so great!
As long as you don't see Rachel anymore.
I asked Emily if she would come to New York.
And she said yes.
Great! - No, no, no.
Only if I promise never to see Rachel again.
What? You can't...
What did you tell her?
I told her I'd have to think about it.
I mean, how the hell am I supposed to make this kind of a decision?
I'm actually asking you!
Well, you can't just not see Rachel anymore.
She's one of your best friends.
But he can't not see Emily, I mean that's his wife!
That's true! - Yeah, right?
But you've known Rachel since high school and...
you cannot just cut her out of your life.
That's true! - No, you cannot.
Thanks for the help. Problem solved!
Hello? - Hey, Mon.
Oh, hey, Joey. We've been watching all day. When are you gonna be on TV?
There was kind of a mix-up in my agent's office...
...but I'm still on TV, and that's good exposure.
You're not on TV.
Oh, okay. How about now?
Yeah! There he is! There he is!
Hello, New York!
Maybe just put the whole duck right in there. Who cares?
Now I got the legs. - Aw! Aw!
How many times have I told you guys to never watch the cooking channel?
Hi, Chandler. - Hey.
Listen, I need that broiling pan that Joey borrowed the other day.
That was yours?
We used it when the duck was throwing up caterpillars.
Williams-Sonoma, fall catalog, page 27.
Expect it in 4 to 6 weeks.
Hey. Joey's gonna be at the telethon for the rest of the day.
We have the whole place to ourselves.
Yeah, so?
Just thought maybe you'd want to book some time with "the best you've ever had."
You know what, champ?
I think I'll pass.
Why? - Why?
What's your point?
PBS Telethon.
Hey, Joey.
I just wanted to let you know that I found a selfless good deed.
I went down to the park and I let a bee sting me.
What good is that going to do anybody?
It helps the bee look tough in front of his bee friends.
The bee is happy, and I am definitely not.
You know, the bee probably died after he stung you.
Damn it!
Back on in 30 seconds, people!
Excuse me, would you mind switching with me?
No way. I'm in the shot, man.
You've been here all day! - I'm taking pledges.
And we're on three, two...
Welcome back to our fall telethon.
If you've been enjoying the performance of Cirque du Soleil...
...and you'd like to see more of the same kind of programming, it's very simple.
All you have to do is call in and pledge...
...and at that time tell one of our volunteers what type of programming you...
Okay.
That's it. I cannot make this decision. It is too difficult.
So I'm just going leave it entirely up to the gods of fate.
A Magic 8 Ball?
You can't make this decision with a toy!
It's not a toy.
I don't know what else to do!
I either keep my wife and lose one of my best friends...
...or I keep my friend and get divorced for the second time before I'm 30.
So if anyone else has a better suggestion, let's hear it.
Because I got nothing! Don't be shy.
Any suggestion will do.
Okay, then.
Here we go.
Magic 8 Ball...
...should I never see Rachel again?
"Ask Again Later."
Later is not good enough!
"Ask Again Later."
What the hell?
This is broken! It is broken!
Let me see.
Will Chandler have sex tonight?
"Don't Count On lt."
Seems like it works to me.
PBS Telethon.
Hi, Joey.
Hey, Pheebs.
I'd like to make a pledge.
I would like to donate $200.
Two hundred dollars?
You sure? After what Sesame Street did to you?
I'm still mad at them, but I also know that they bring happiness...
...to lots of kids whose moms didn't kill themselves.
You know, so...
...by supporting them, I'm doing a good thing, but I'm not happy about it.
So there! A selfless good deed.
And you don't feel a little good about donating the money?
No, it sucks. I was saving up to buy a hamster.
A hamster? Those things are, like, 10 bucks.
Not the one I had my eye on.
It looks like we have surpassed last year's pledge total.
Thank you!
And the pledge that did it was taken by one of our volunteers.
Oh, boy! And may I say, one of our sharpest dressed volunteers.
Mr. Joseph Tribbiani!
Oh, look!
Joey's on TV!
Isn't that great?
My pledge got Joey on TV! That makes me feel so...
Oh, no!
Look...
...maybe I got carried away before, but there's something you gotta know.
If I'm the best, it's only because you made me the best.
Keep talking.
I was nothing before you.
Call the other girls and ask.
Which wouldn't take long.
But when I'm with you, and we're together...
...oh, my God!
Really? - Oh, my God!
Now, I understand if you never want to sleep with me again.
But that would be wrong.
We're too good.
We owe it to sex!
Well, if we owe it!
Oh, my!
When is Joey gonna be home?
I was kind of hoping we could do this without him.
No, no, no! Leave the gloves on.
But I just cleaned the bathroom.
Yeah, why don't we lose the gloves? - Yeah.
All right. Let's show them how it's done.
Okay. Ow!
That wasn't part of it. - I know.
Hi. You ready? We're going to be late.
For what? - For Stella, remember?
