What's your point?
PBS Telethon.
Hey, Joey.
I just wanted to let you know that I found a selfless good deed.
I went down to the park and I let a bee sting me.
What good is that going to do anybody?
It helps the bee look tough in front of his bee friends.
The bee is happy, and I am definitely not.
You know, the bee probably died after he stung you.
Damn it!
Back on in 30 seconds, people!
Excuse me, would you mind switching with me?
No way. I'm in the shot, man.
You've been here all day! - I'm taking pledges.
And we're on three, two...
Welcome back to our fall telethon.
If you've been enjoying the performance of Cirque du Soleil...
...and you'd like to see more of the same kind of programming, it's very simple.
All you have to do is call in and pledge...
...and at that time tell one of our volunteers what type of programming you...
Okay.
That's it. I cannot make this decision. It is too difficult.
So I'm just going leave it entirely up to the gods of fate.
A Magic 8 Ball?
You can't make this decision with a toy!
It's not a toy.
I don't know what else to do!
I either keep my wife and lose one of my best friends...
...or I keep my friend and get divorced for the second time before I'm 30.
So if anyone else has a better suggestion, let's hear it.
Because I got nothing! Don't be shy.
Any suggestion will do.
Okay, then.
Here we go.
Magic 8 Ball...
...should I never see Rachel again?
"Ask Again Later."
Later is not good enough!
"Ask Again Later."
What the hell?
This is broken! It is broken!
Let me see.
Will Chandler have sex tonight?
"Don't Count On lt."
Seems like it works to me.
PBS Telethon.
Hi, Joey.
Hey, Pheebs.
I'd like to make a pledge.
I would like to donate $200.
Two hundred dollars?
You sure? After what Sesame Street did to you?
I'm still mad at them, but I also know that they bring happiness...
...to lots of kids whose moms didn't kill themselves.
You know, so...
...by supporting them, I'm doing a good thing, but I'm not happy about it.
So there! A selfless good deed.
And you don't feel a little good about donating the money?
No, it sucks. I was saving up to buy a hamster.
A hamster? Those things are, like, 10 bucks.
Not the one I had my eye on.
It looks like we have surpassed last year's pledge total.
Thank you!
And the pledge that did it was taken by one of our volunteers.
Oh, boy! And may I say, one of our sharpest dressed volunteers.
Mr. Joseph Tribbiani!
Oh, look!
Joey's on TV!
Isn't that great?
My pledge got Joey on TV! That makes me feel so...
Oh, no!
Look...
...maybe I got carried away before, but there's something you gotta know.
If I'm the best, it's only because you made me the best.
Keep talking.
I was nothing before you.
Call the other girls and ask.
Which wouldn't take long.
But when I'm with you, and we're together...
...oh, my God!
Really? - Oh, my God!
Now, I understand if you never want to sleep with me again.
But that would be wrong.
We're too good.
We owe it to sex!
Well, if we owe it!
Oh, my!
When is Joey gonna be home?
I was kind of hoping we could do this without him.
No, no, no! Leave the gloves on.
But I just cleaned the bathroom.
Yeah, why don't we lose the gloves? - Yeah.
All right. Let's show them how it's done.
Okay. Ow!
That wasn't part of it. - I know.
Hi. You ready? We're going to be late.
For what? - For Stella, remember?
She's getting her groove back in 20 minutes.
Yeah, I totally forgot about that.
Mind if I take a rain check? I'm waiting for a call from Emily.
Sure, I guess.
Hey, I hear you don't have to go to London. Yay.
It's not that easy. There's still a lot of relationship stuff.
Like what?
Just stuff.
You know, kind of what Emily wants.
Why don't you talk to me about it? Maybe I can help.
No, no, you can't help.
I mean, I kind of have to do this without your help.
Well, I...
I know you can do that too. I'm just saying if you need somebody to talk to...
Hi.
Thanks.
Ross, look, whatever this relationship stuff is that Emily wants...
...just give it to her.
The bottom line is that you love her.
So just fix whatever she wants fixed.
Just do it.
You're going to have to try. You'll just hate yourself if you don't.
Come on, answer it! It's driving me crazy.
Hello?
Hi, sweetie.
Good.
Look. Yes, I've been thinking...
...about that thing you wanted me to do...
...and I can do it.
So will you come to New York?
What?
Never done that before. - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 进来
sense_groups.english: Come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等你很久了
sense_groups.english: I've been waiting for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…
sense_groups.english: Hi, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Ah! Oh, my God! Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉抱歉 我…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry! I was...

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在睡午觉
sense_groups.english: I was taking a nap.

sense_groups.chinese: 你从何时开始用那种怪姿势睡觉？
sense_groups.english: Since when do you take naps in that position?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你是在等男人吧？拜托你说是在等男人
sense_groups.english: Tell me you were waiting for a guy. Please tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我在等男人
sense_groups.english: Yes, I was. A guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅同事
sense_groups.english: From work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最近跟同事约会
sense_groups.english: I'm seeing a guy from work! Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 那个长得像雷李欧塔…
sense_groups.english: That cute waiter guy from your restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲切版帅哥服务生？
sense_groups.english: The one that looks like a non-threatening Ray Liotta?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是他
sense_groups.english: Aha. That one!

sense_groups.chinese: 我 马上闪人 我只是回来拿件外套
sense_groups.english: Give me a second. I'll be out of your hair. I'm just going to grab a jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我回来可要告诉我详情
sense_groups.english: When I get back, I want every little detail.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能来了
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, um... Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是乔伊跟罗斯
sense_groups.english: It's just Joey and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是去看电影吗？
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you at the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 可是罗斯讲电话太吵 才被电影院轰出来
sense_groups.english: We were, but Ross was talking so loud on his phone, they threw us out.

sense_groups.chinese: 电影太吵 我当然得大声讲
sense_groups.english: I had to talk loud because the movie was loud!

sense_groups.chinese: 他打电话去伦敦 - 他找到艾蜜莉了？
sense_groups.english: He's talking to London. - Did he get in touch with Emily?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 但是他打给女方亲戚
sense_groups.english: No. He's calling everyone on her side of the family...

sense_groups.chinese: 希望有人愿意帮他
sense_groups.english: ...hoping someone will help him get in touch with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算我说错名字又如何 你这大惊小怪的笨蛋
sense_groups.english: I don't care if I said some other girl's name, you prissy old twit!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你巴结亲戚真有一套
sense_groups.english: Way to suck up to the family!

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴大家都在 我们公司终于买免皱传真纸了
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you're all here. My office finally got wrinkle-free fax paper!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 别过来 那是呕吐西装
sense_groups.english: Hey - Oh, no, no! Vomit tux! No, no! Vomit tux!

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 我送去干洗过了
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, I had it dry-cleaned.

sense_groups.chinese: 呕吐西装？
sense_groups.english: Vomit tux?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会吐在…
sense_groups.english: Who vomited on...

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 乔伊 你为何穿成这样？
sense_groups.english: You know what? What you up to, Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要上马拉松式电视节目
sense_groups.english: They're doing this telethon thing on TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的经纪人帮我争取当主持人
sense_groups.english: And my agent got me a job as co-host!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 帮公视做好事能增加曝光率
sense_groups.english: A little good deed for PBS, plus some TV exposure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我乔伊最爱做这种事了
sense_groups.english: That's the kind of math Joey likes to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 公视啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, PBS!

sense_groups.chinese: 公视哪里不对了？ - 他们哪里对？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with PBS? - What's right with them?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为何不喜欢公视？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you like PBS?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我妈自杀之后 我个人非常难过
sense_groups.english: Right after my Mom killed herself, I was in this bad place, you know, personally.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我想写信给《芝麻街》心情应该会好一点
sense_groups.english: So I just thought it would make me feel better if I wrote to Sesame Street.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我小时候 总觉得他们很亲切
sense_groups.english: Because they were so nice when I was a little kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果根本没人回信
sense_groups.english: No one ever wrote back.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些布偶根本没有手指
sense_groups.english: A lot of those Muppets don't have thumbs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只收到一个破烂钥匙环 拜托 我那时住在纸箱里耶
sense_groups.english: All I got was a lousy keychain, and by that time, I was living in a box.

sense_groups.chinese: 连钥匙都没有
sense_groups.english: I didn't have keys!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 菲比
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想做好事 就像你帮忙生小孩
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to do a good deed, like you did with the babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不是做善事 只是想上电视 根本就很自私
sense_groups.english: This isn't a good deed. You just want to get on TV. This is totally selfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 哇 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮弟弟生小孩又怎么说？
sense_groups.english: What about you having those babies for your brother?

sense_groups.chinese: 自私的不是只有我
sense_groups.english: Talk about selfish!

sense_groups.chinese: 你胡说什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的确是帮忙他们 不过自己心情也很好吧？
sense_groups.english: It was a nice thing, but it made you feel good, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那又如何？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你做善事心情好 也算是自私的一种
sense_groups.english: It made you feel good so that makes it selfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 世界上根本就没有无私的好事
sense_groups.english: Look, there's no unselfish good deeds. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 明明就有 有很多行善的人都没有私心
sense_groups.english: Yes, there are totally good deeds that are selfless!

sense_groups.chinese: 请你举出一个例子
sense_groups.english: May I ask for one example?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是有 例如…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's... You know, there's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想说
sense_groups.english: No, you may not!

sense_groups.chinese: 因为所有人都很自私
sense_groups.english: That's because all people are selfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说我自私？
sense_groups.english: Are you calling me selfish?

sense_groups.chinese: 你难道不是人？
sense_groups.english: Are you calling you people?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 很抱歉打破你的美梦 世界上没有无私的善事
sense_groups.english: Sorry to burst that bubble, Pheebs, but selfless good deeds don't exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧？
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你也知道圣诞老人吧？
sense_groups.english: And you know the deal on Santa Claus, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会找到一件无私的善事 打败你这个邪恶博士
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna find a selfless good deed. I'm going to beat you, you evil genius!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 罗斯吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Hello, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Emily?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! It's Emily!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家 是艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: It's Emily, everyone! Shh! Shh! Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打来只是要告诉你 别再骚扰我家人了 再见
sense_groups.english: I'm only ringing to say stop harassing my relatives. Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 就算你挂断 我也会继续打 如果要打给所有英国人
sense_groups.english: Wait! Okay, okay, you can hang up, but I'll keep calling everyone in England...

sense_groups.chinese: 才能逼你跟我说话 我也办得到
sense_groups.english: ...if that's what it takes to get you to talk to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你想谈什么？
sense_groups.english: Really? About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我太太 我们已经结婚
sense_groups.english: Look, you're my wife. We're married.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我爱你
sense_groups.english: You know, I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想你
sense_groups.english: I really miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很想你
sense_groups.english: I miss you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我认为如此
sense_groups.english: Well, at least I think I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 她肯跟我说话了
sense_groups.english: She's talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚 为何提到"圣诞老人"？
sense_groups.english: When you said "the deal with Santa Claus," you meant?

sense_groups.chinese: 根本没有这号人物
sense_groups.english: That he doesn't exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样啊
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你听说 摩妮卡的地下情人了吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, have you heard about Monica's secret boyfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道 她是提起过
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she might have mentioned him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到底何时 才能认识这个服务生？
sense_groups.english: So, Mon, when are we going to meet this new, secret waiter man?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很害羞 现在还没准备认识大家
sense_groups.english: He's really shy. I don't think he's up to meeting everyone yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他还没准备好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't think he's up to meeting everyone yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 我想见他 她说对方床上一级棒
sense_groups.english: I don't care, I wanna meet this guy who's the best sex she ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说过？你说过？
sense_groups.english: That's what you heard? You said that?

sense_groups.chinese: 大概吧
sense_groups.english: I might have said that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这有什么好笑？
sense_groups.english: Why is that funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我很为他高兴
sense_groups.english: Because I'm very happy for him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是走狗屎运
sense_groups.english: And you! You lucky dog!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉愿意跟我复合
sense_groups.english: Well, Emily's willing to work on the relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 好耶
sense_groups.english: That's great! - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 她要我去伦敦
sense_groups.english: In London.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 她要我搬到伦敦去
sense_groups.english: What? - She wants me to move to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是你住在这里
sense_groups.english: But you live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这是废话
sense_groups.english: You know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要跟卡萝 苏珊谈谈
sense_groups.english: I bet if I talked to Carol and Susan...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定能说服她们带小班搬到伦敦
sense_groups.english: ...I could convince them to move to London with Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 想必你前妻一定乐意搬到国外
sense_groups.english: I'm sure your ex-wife would be more than happy to move to another country...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮你挽回新太太
sense_groups.english: ...so you can patch things up with your new wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是不可能啊
sense_groups.english: It could happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 欢迎 幸会
sense_groups.english: How you doing? Welcome. Good to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是你的电话
sense_groups.english: This'll be your phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过应该没有人会打来找我
sense_groups.english: But I'm not really expecting a lot of calls.

sense_groups.chinese: 你负责接电话接受捐款
sense_groups.english: No, you answer it and take pledges.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是主持人
sense_groups.english: But I'm the host.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞卡林才是主持人 你负责接电话
sense_groups.english: No, Gary Collins is the host. You'll be answering the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你恐怕搞不清楚状况 我是雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: You don't seem to understand. See, I was Dr. Drake Ramoray.

sense_groups.chinese: 你负责这支电话 医生
sense_groups.english: Well, here's your phone, doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我竟然找不到一件无私的善行
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I can't find a selfless good deed.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前我家隔壁有个老头
sense_groups.english: You know that really old guy that lives next door to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我偷溜到他家 帮他打扫前廊的落叶
sense_groups.english: I snuck over there and raked up all the leaves on his front stoop.

sense_groups.chinese: 他捉到我之后 强迫我喝西打 吃饼干
sense_groups.english: But he caught me, and he force-fed me cider and cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我却很开心 那个呆子
sense_groups.english: Then I felt wonderful. That old jackass!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许乔伊说得对 所有好事的出发点都有私心
sense_groups.english: Maybe Joey's right. Maybe all good deeds are selfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定要找到一件无私的善行 毕竟我才刚生出三个宝宝
sense_groups.english: I will find a selfless good deed. Because I just gave birth to three children...

sense_groups.chinese: 不能让他们在 乔伊有理的世界里长大
sense_groups.english: ...and I will not let them be raised in a world where Joey's right!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 可以问你有关烹饪的问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica? Can I ask you a cooking question?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 如果你用炉子烹饪
sense_groups.english: Sure. - If you're cooking on the stove...

sense_groups.chinese: 是否代表你新男友在床上 比理查还厉害？
sense_groups.english: ...does that mean that your new secret boyfriend is better in bed than Richard?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？
sense_groups.english: Is he?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要尊重秘密新男友的隐私
sense_groups.english: I think I'm going to respect the privacy of my new, secret boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我是他
sense_groups.english: If this guy was me...

sense_groups.chinese: 又知道 自己是你遇到过最棒的情人
sense_groups.english: ...and it's me who'd learned that it was me who was the best you'd ever had...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定乐歪了
sense_groups.english: ...I'd be going like this

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: All right, Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我很爱你
sense_groups.english: As much as I love you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不能丢下小班去伦敦
sense_groups.english: ...I'm sorry, I can't move to London without Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很为难你
sense_groups.english: I understand that would be difficult.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你考虑搬过来好吗？你本来就打算搬来
sense_groups.english: Would you consider moving here? You were moving here anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 为何不现在就来呢？
sense_groups.english: Why can't you just do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 只是…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好 我知道自己到目前为止 都蠢头蠢脑
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, but I know that even though I've been a complete idiot up till now...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你还是应该过来
sense_groups.english: ...you have to come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来嘛 我们才能继续走下去
sense_groups.english: You have to, so we can work this out together.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚说好？
sense_groups.english: All right? Did you just say "all right"?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 现在换我是白痴
sense_groups.english: I did. Now I'm the idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Emily, that is so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 会很棒的
sense_groups.english: It'll be great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就像坠入爱河的白痴
sense_groups.english: We're going to be like two idiots in love!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 有件事还是让我很担心
sense_groups.english: Ross, there's one thing that really scares me still.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尽管说 - 你要知道
sense_groups.english: Yes, tell me. - You have to understand...

sense_groups.chinese: 当天婚礼我在…
sense_groups.english: ...how humiliating it was for me up on that altar...

sense_groups.chinese: 亲朋好友面前有多丢脸
sense_groups.english: ...in front of my entire family, all my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我非常抱歉
sense_groups.english: I know. I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我决定原谅你
sense_groups.english: And then, after deciding to forgive you...

sense_groups.chinese: 却看到你跟她赶着上飞机
sense_groups.english: ...seeing you at the airport, catching our plane with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这也是我的错
sense_groups.english: Again, very sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本无法与她共处一室
sense_groups.english: I mean, I can't be in the same room as her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我光想到你跟她共处一室 就快气坏了
sense_groups.english: It drives me mad thinking of you being in the same room as her.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉 我跟瑞秋根本没什么
sense_groups.english: Emily, there is nothing between Rachel and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱的是你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去纽约 我们再试试看
sense_groups.english: I'll come to New York and we'll try to make this work.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: That is so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你答应不再见瑞秋
sense_groups.english: As long as you don't see Rachel anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就问艾蜜莉愿不愿意来纽约
sense_groups.english: I asked Emily if she would come to New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 她答应了
sense_groups.english: And she said yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 不不不
sense_groups.english: Great! - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 条件是我不准再见瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Only if I promise never to see Rachel again.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不成啦
sense_groups.english: What? You can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么说？
sense_groups.english: What did you tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说在考虑
sense_groups.english: I told her I'd have to think about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我到底该怎么决定？
sense_groups.english: I mean, how the hell am I supposed to make this kind of a decision?

sense_groups.chinese: 我这是在问你们
sense_groups.english: I'm actually asking you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能就此不见瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Well, you can't just not see Rachel anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是你的好朋友
sense_groups.english: She's one of your best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他也不能不见艾蜜莉 她可是他老婆
sense_groups.english: But he can't not see Emily, I mean that's his wife!

sense_groups.chinese: 也是 - 对
sense_groups.english: That's true! - Yeah, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟瑞秋从高中就认识
sense_groups.english: But you've known Rachel since high school and...

sense_groups.chinese: 不能说不见就不见
sense_groups.english: you cannot just cut her out of your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得也对 - 的确不行
sense_groups.english: That's true! - No, you cannot.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们的帮忙 问题一点也没解决
sense_groups.english: Thanks for the help. Problem solved!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Hey, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我们看了一整天电视 你到底何时才会出现？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Joey. We've been watching all day. When are you gonna be on TV?

sense_groups.chinese: 我经纪人搞错了
sense_groups.english: There was kind of a mix-up in my agent's office...

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我上了电视就有曝光率
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm still on TV, and that's good exposure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没上电视啊
sense_groups.english: You're not on TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. How about now?

sense_groups.chinese: 有了 看到他了
sense_groups.english: Yeah! There he is! There he is!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 纽约
sense_groups.english: Hello, New York!

sense_groups.chinese: 问题是这里有整只鸭 不过管他的
sense_groups.english: Maybe just put the whole duck right in there. Who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 我先处理鸭腿 - 嗷 嗷
sense_groups.english: Now I got the legs. - Aw! Aw!

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过多少次 不准看烹饪频道
sense_groups.english: How many times have I told you guys to never watch the cooking channel?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 钱德 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, Chandler. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来要回乔伊上次借的烤盘
sense_groups.english: Listen, I need that broiling pan that Joey borrowed the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的？
sense_groups.english: That was yours?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们上次用来盛小甲鸟吐出来的虫子
sense_groups.english: We used it when the duck was throwing up caterpillars.

sense_groups.chinese: 威廉索诺玛牌 秋季刊第27页
sense_groups.english: Williams-Sonoma, fall catalog, page 27.

sense_groups.chinese: 4到6周后送货到家
sense_groups.english: Expect it in 4 to 6 weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊今天一整天都不在
sense_groups.english: Hey. Joey's gonna be at the telethon for the rest of the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 整个家里就只有我们两个
sense_groups.english: We have the whole place to ourselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又如何？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你想跟最佳情人预约时间约会
sense_groups.english: Just thought maybe you'd want to book some time with "the best you've ever had."

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 冠军先生？
sense_groups.english: You know what, champ?

sense_groups.chinese: 我自愿放弃
sense_groups.english: I think I'll pass.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why? - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What's your point?

sense_groups.chinese: 公视电视募捐
sense_groups.english: PBS Telethon.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 我找到无私的善行了
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to let you know that I found a selfless good deed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚去公园让蜜峰叮我
sense_groups.english: I went down to the park and I let a bee sting me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？这对谁有好处？
sense_groups.english: What good is that going to do anybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 这只蜜峰在同伴面前 脸上有光
sense_groups.english: It helps the bee look tough in front of his bee friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜峰很开心 我却很痛
sense_groups.english: The bee is happy, and I am definitely not.

sense_groups.chinese: 蜜峰叮了你它就死了
sense_groups.english: You know, the bee probably died after he stung you.

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶
sense_groups.english: Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 30秒后开始录影
sense_groups.english: Back on in 30 seconds, people!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 可以跟你换位子吗？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, would you mind switching with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 甭想 我刚好在镜头里
sense_groups.english: No way. I'm in the shot, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你已经占这位子半天了 - 我在接受捐款
sense_groups.english: You've been here all day! - I'm taking pledges.

sense_groups.chinese: 倒数计时3 2…
sense_groups.english: And we're on three, two...

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎收看电视募捐
sense_groups.english: Welcome back to our fall telethon.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果各位喜欢《太阳马戏团》
sense_groups.english: If you've been enjoying the performance of Cirque du Soleil...

sense_groups.chinese: 以后还想收看同类型节目 方法很简单
sense_groups.english: ...and you'd like to see more of the same kind of programming, it's very simple.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要打电话捐款
sense_groups.english: All you have to do is call in and pledge...

sense_groups.chinese: 并告诉我们的义工 阁下喜欢收看哪类型节目
sense_groups.english: ...and at that time tell one of our volunteers what type of programming you...

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我无法做决定 这实在太难了
sense_groups.english: That's it. I cannot make this decision. It is too difficult.

sense_groups.chinese: 我决定交给命运之神
sense_groups.english: So I'm just going leave it entirely up to the gods of fate.

sense_groups.chinese: 神奇8号球？
sense_groups.english: A Magic 8 Ball?

sense_groups.chinese: 你开玩笑吧？怎么可以用玩具决定命运？
sense_groups.english: You can't make this decision with a toy!

sense_groups.chinese: 这可不是玩具
sense_groups.english: It's not a toy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我别无选择
sense_groups.english: I don't know what else to do!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是追回老婆 失去好朋友
sense_groups.english: I either keep my wife and lose one of my best friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是留下朋友 在30岁前离婚两次
sense_groups.english: ...or I keep my friend and get divorced for the second time before I'm 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是有人有更好的建议 现在就说出来
sense_groups.english: So if anyone else has a better suggestion, let's hear it.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则我真的没有办法 大家别害羞
sense_groups.english: Because I got nothing! Don't be shy.

sense_groups.chinese: 各种建议都可以
sense_groups.english: Any suggestion will do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 神奇8号球
sense_groups.english: Magic 8 Ball...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是不该再见瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: ...should I never see Rachel again?

sense_groups.chinese: "待会再问"
sense_groups.english: "Ask Again Later."

sense_groups.chinese: 这个答案不够好
sense_groups.english: Later is not good enough!

sense_groups.chinese: "待会再问"
sense_groups.english: "Ask Again Later."

sense_groups.chinese: 搞屁啊
sense_groups.english: What the hell?

sense_groups.chinese: 这东西坏掉了
sense_groups.english: This is broken! It is broken!

sense_groups.chinese: 我来看看
sense_groups.english: Let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德今晚会跟女人上床吗？
sense_groups.english: Will Chandler have sex tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: "别太笃定"
sense_groups.english: "Don't Count On lt."

sense_groups.chinese: 我倒觉得没坏掉
sense_groups.english: Seems like it works to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 公视电视募款
sense_groups.english: PBS Telethon.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要捐钱
sense_groups.english: I'd like to make a pledge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想捐200元
sense_groups.english: I would like to donate $200.
Two hundred dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？《芝麻街》可是伤你不浅
sense_groups.english: You sure? After what Sesame Street did to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是很生气 不过我也知道很多妈妈…
sense_groups.english: I'm still mad at them, but I also know that they bring happiness...

sense_groups.chinese: 没自杀的小孩很爱看
sense_groups.english: ...to lots of kids whose moms didn't kill themselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 所以…
sense_groups.english: You know, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 为了支持这节目 我决定做件好事 不过我自己可不开心
sense_groups.english: ...by supporting them, I'm doing a good thing, but I'm not happy about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 这就是无私的善行
sense_groups.english: So there! A selfless good deed.

sense_groups.chinese: 难道你捐钱没有一点开心？
sense_groups.english: And you don't feel a little good about donating the money?

sense_groups.chinese: 难过死了 我本想用那笔钱买只黄金鼠
sense_groups.english: No, it sucks. I was saving up to buy a hamster.

sense_groups.chinese: 黄金鼠？那种宠物10元就买得到
sense_groups.english: A hamster? Those things are, like, 10 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢那只可没那么便宜
sense_groups.english: Not the one I had my eye on.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来今年的募款 已经超过去年总额
sense_groups.english: It looks like we have surpassed last year's pledge total.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢各位
sense_groups.english: Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 打破纪录的捐款是由 我们的义工募捐得
sense_groups.english: And the pledge that did it was taken by one of our volunteers.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且这位还穿得很体面
sense_groups.english: Oh, boy! And may I say, one of our sharpest dressed volunteers.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位就是乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Mr. Joseph Tribbiani!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: Oh, look!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊上电视了
sense_groups.english: Joey's on TV!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Isn't that great?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的捐款让乔伊上了电视 这真是让我…
sense_groups.english: My pledge got Joey on TV! That makes me feel so...

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Look...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我先前太得意了 不过有件事要告诉你
sense_groups.english: ...maybe I got carried away before, but there's something you gotta know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我表现得很好也是因为你
sense_groups.english: If I'm the best, it's only because you made me the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 说下去
sense_groups.english: Keep talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你在一起之前 我根本表现平平
sense_groups.english: I was nothing before you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以打去问我以前那些女友
sense_groups.english: Call the other girls and ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定很快就问完了
sense_groups.english: Which wouldn't take long.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我跟你在一起时…
sense_groups.english: But when I'm with you, and we're together...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: ...oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不想再跟我上床 我也能体谅
sense_groups.english: Now, I understand if you never want to sleep with me again.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过这决定就不对了
sense_groups.english: But that would be wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们太厉害了
sense_groups.english: We're too good.

sense_groups.chinese: 不上床实在太可惜
sense_groups.english: We owe it to sex!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果真是这样…
sense_groups.english: Well, if we owe it!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊何时回来？
sense_groups.english: When is Joey gonna be home?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该不需要等他
sense_groups.english: I was kind of hoping we could do this without him.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 手套不用脱
sense_groups.english: No, no, no! Leave the gloves on.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我刚才在清厕所
sense_groups.english: But I just cleaned the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就脱掉吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, why don't we lose the gloves? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 让大家看看谁才是高手
sense_groups.english: All right. Let's show them how it's done.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 这不包括在内 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That wasn't part of it. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你准备好没？我们要迟到了
sense_groups.english: Hi. You ready? We're going to be late.

sense_groups.chinese: 迟到什么？ - 看电影啊 你没忘吧？
sense_groups.english: For what? - For Stella, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 史黛扛都快把到男人了
sense_groups.english: She's getting her groove back in 20 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全忘记了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I totally forgot about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不介意我爽约一次吧？我正在等艾蜜莉的电话
sense_groups.english: Mind if I take a rain check? I'm waiting for a call from Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Sure, I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说你不用去伦敦了
sense_groups.english: Hey, I hear you don't have to go to London. Yay.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情没那么简单 我们还有很多问题
sense_groups.english: It's not that easy. There's still a lot of relationship stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 例如？
sense_groups.english: Like what?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是一些问题
sense_groups.english: Just stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉对我有些要求
sense_groups.english: You know, kind of what Emily wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以告诉我 或许我帮得上忙
sense_groups.english: Why don't you talk to me about it? Maybe I can help.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你帮不上忙
sense_groups.english: No, no, you can't help.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是 这件事你帮不上忙
sense_groups.english: I mean, I kind of have to do this without your help.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我…
sense_groups.english: Well, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你自己办得到 但是如果你想找人谈谈…
sense_groups.english: I know you can do that too. I'm just saying if you need somebody to talk to...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 无论艾蜜莉有何要求
sense_groups.english: Ross, look, whatever this relationship stuff is that Emily wants...

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应就是了
sense_groups.english: ...just give it to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 最重要的是你爱她
sense_groups.english: The bottom line is that you love her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她怎么要求 你就怎么做
sense_groups.english: So just fix whatever she wants fixed.

sense_groups.chinese: 答应就对了
sense_groups.english: Just do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你总得试试看 不试试以后一定会后悔
sense_groups.english: You're going to have to try. You'll just hate yourself if you don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 快接电话啊 我都快被逼疯了
sense_groups.english: Come on, answer it! It's driving me crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hi, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我有考虑过…
sense_groups.english: Look. Yes, I've been thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的要求
sense_groups.english: ...about that thing you wanted me to do...

sense_groups.chinese: 我办得到
sense_groups.english: ...and I can do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意来纽约吗？
sense_groups.english: So will you come to New York?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 以前没试过这招 - 我也没
sense_groups.english: Never done that before. - Nope.

questions.name: S05E05
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey, ha, ha.
Monica?
What time is it?
Uh, 9.
But it's dark out.
Um, well, that's because you always sleep till noon, silly.
This is what 9 looks like.
I guess I'll get washed up then.
Watch that sunrise.
I'm really getting tired of sneaking around all the time.
I know, me too. Hey, what if we went away for the whole weekend? No interruptions.
And we could be naked the entire time.
All weekend?
That's a whole lot of naked. - Mm-hm.
Yeah, I could say I have a conference and you can say you have a chef thing.
Oh, I've always wanted to go to this culinary fair in Jersey!
Ha, ha, okay. You know you're not, though.
Right. Okay. - Let's go.
Wait. What about Joey?
Hey, guess what I'm doing this weekend.
Going to this culinary fair in Jersey.
How weird! Chandler just told us he's got a conference there. Huh.
Oh, that's funny, ha, ha. Seems like Chandler's conference could've been in Connecticut or Vermont.
I'm not in charge of where the conference is held.
Do you want people to think it's a fake conference? It's a real conference.
Hey.JOEY - Hey.
Is Rachel here? I gotta talk to her. - No, she's out shopping.
Damn. - What's going on?
I told Emily to come.
And I just need to, you know, talk to Rachel about it.
Wait a minute.
So when Emily comes, you're not gonna see Rachel anymore?
I'm focusing on the "I get to see my wife" part, all right...
...and not on the part that makes me do this, huh?
So you'll never be in the same room together? How is that even gonna work?
I have no idea. I mean...
But I assure you, I will figure it out.
It doesn't seem like it's gonna work.

sense_groups.english: No, they gave us glasses with lipstick on them.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果连杯子都没换 谁晓得还有哪些东西没换
sense_groups.english: If they didn't change the glasses, who knows what else they didn't change.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我只是希望 过个完美的周末
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, sweetie. I just want this weekend to be perfect, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 换个房间嘛 - 好
sense_groups.english: We can change rooms, can't we? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 要换快换 5号直升机刚跟丢了
sense_groups.english: Okay, but let's do it now, though, because Chopper 5 just lost its feed!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey, so, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我上次有事告诉你吗？
sense_groups.english: You know how there was something I wanted to talk to you about?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我很希望跟艾蜜莉合好
sense_groups.english: ...you know I'm trying to work things out with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过…
sense_groups.english: Well, there's this...

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事
sense_groups.english: ...one thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要说了
sense_groups.english: Okay, here goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应她… 嘿
sense_groups.english: I made a promise that... Oh, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你流鼻血
sense_groups.english: What? - Your nose is bleeding.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 你流血了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! - You're bleeding.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: Ah. Ah, not again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我祖父过世时也一样
sense_groups.english: This happened when my grandfather died.

sense_groups.chinese: 实在是… 抱歉
sense_groups.english: It's... Ugh, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 额
sense_groups.english: Oh, gross, unh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 对不起 你刚刚要说什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay. So I'm sorry. What did you wanna tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯… - 额
sense_groups.english: Um... - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我 额…
sense_groups.english: I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能再见你了
sense_groups.english: I can't see you anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我也看不见你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know, it's ridiculous. I can't see you, either.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可能会喜欢这间房
sense_groups.english: I think you'll find this room more to your liking.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说他只剩下一半的汽油
sense_groups.english: They say he's only got half a tank left.

sense_groups.chinese: 一半？那还可以跑很久
sense_groups.english: Half a tank? We still got a lot of high-speed chasing to do!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们必须换房间 - 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: We're switching rooms again. - What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 这间房是花园景观 我们订的是观海房
sense_groups.english: This is a garden-view room and we paid for an ocean-view room.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩一间观海房 可是你们不喜欢
sense_groups.english: Our last ocean-view room was unacceptable to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 我可以跟你谈一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Um, can I talk to you over here for just a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 来了
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些小人想占我们便宜 我才没那么蠢
sense_groups.english: Look, these clowns are trying to take us for a ride. I won't let them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可不是呆头鹅
sense_groups.english: We're not a couple of suckers.

sense_groups.chinese: 说得好 大姐头
sense_groups.english: I hear you, Mugsy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些房间都还好啊
sense_groups.english: But, look, all these rooms are fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你赶快选定 让我看…
sense_groups.english: Okay? Can you just pick one so I can watch the...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我跟你一起好好度假
sense_groups.english: Have a perfect, magical weekend together with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这间 - 没了
sense_groups.english: Okay, this one I like. - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 没了 结束了
sense_groups.english: Nothing. It's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 竟然没有延长时间
sense_groups.english: Damn it, this is regularly scheduled programming!

sense_groups.chinese: 可以关掉电视吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we turn the TV off, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 难道整个周末都要看电视？
sense_groups.english: Do we really wanna spend the weekend like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我是不是妨碍你换房间了？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, am I getting in the way of all the room-switching fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 你火大可别怪到我身上 - 否则该怪谁？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, don't blame me for ruining tonight. - Who should I blame?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个拖着行李跑过10间房的倒霉服务生？
sense_groups.english: The nice bellman who had to drag our luggage to 10 rooms?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道或许该怪那个…
sense_groups.english: Or the idiot who thought he could drive...

sense_groups.chinese: 以为用半箱汽油可以从纽约跑到加拿大的家伙
sense_groups.english: ...from Albany to Canada on a half a tank of gas?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要说死者的坏话
sense_groups.english: Do not speak ill of the dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们出来是为了过浪漫周末
sense_groups.english: We're supposed to be spending a romantic weekend together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底哪里有毛病？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想看点电视 有何不对？
sense_groups.english: I just wanna watch a little television. What's the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 放轻松嘛 老妈
sense_groups.english: Jeez, relax, Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"放轻松 小摩"
sense_groups.english: I said, "Jeez, relax, Mon."

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我一直有话要告诉你 我非说不可
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I've been wanting to tell you something and I just have to get it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上次不是说我应该不惜任何代价挽救婚姻吗？
sense_groups.english: You know how you told me I should do whatever it takes to fix my marriage?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我叫你答应艾蜜莉所有要求
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I told you to give Emily whatever she wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的建议不错 不过我必须告诉你她开的条件
sense_groups.english: And while that was good advice, you should know that what she wants...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是叫我永远不能再见你
sense_groups.english: ...is for me not to see you anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 太扯了 你才做不到 你要怎么告诉她？
sense_groups.english: Well, that's crazy. You can't do that. What are you gonna tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经答应了 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you've already agreed to this, haven't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道自己很恶劣
sense_groups.english: It's awful, I know. Uh, it's... Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我心情也很糟糕 但这是挽救婚姻的唯一方法
sense_groups.english: I mean, I feel terrible, but I have to do this if I want my marriage to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很希望跟她合好 必须挽救这段婚姻
sense_groups.english: And I do. I have to make this marriage work. I have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 好在我们在她抵达之前 还可以继续见面
sense_groups.english: But the good thing is, we can still see each other until she gets here.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真幸运 天啊 这真是好消息 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, lucky me! Oh, my God! That is good news, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 自从拉普过世之后 最大的好消息
sense_groups.english: I think that's the best news I've heard since LaPooh died!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道我有多难过 我也很痛苦
sense_groups.english: You have no idea what a nightmare this has been. Uh, this is so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？真的吗 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, really? Is it, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以为你减轻压力 - 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, let me make this a little easier for you. - What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 离家出走 - 瑞秋 这是你家
sense_groups.english: Storming out. - Rachel, this is your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看我有多火大
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Well, that's how mad I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 臭巧克力糖
sense_groups.english: Damn Rolos!

sense_groups.chinese: 你回来了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're back. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次出差如何？
sense_groups.english: How was your conference?

sense_groups.chinese: 糟透了 我跟同事吵架 到回来前都没合好
sense_groups.english: It was terrible. I fought with my colleagues for the entire time.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么还有？
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 整个周末都泡汤？
sense_groups.english: Uh, so your weekend was a bust?

sense_groups.chinese: 也不会 我看到唐纳川普在等电梯
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, I got to see Donald Trump waiting for an elevator.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你也回来了
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey, you're back too.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 钱德 可以出来一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Um, Chandler, could I talk to you outside for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 烹饪大会好玩吗？ - 糟透了
sense_groups.english: How was your chef thing? - Ugh. It was awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人根本不会欣赏美食
sense_groups.english: I guess some people don't appreciate really good food.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的食物可能看起来很美味
sense_groups.english: Maybe it was the kind of food that tasted good at first...

sense_groups.chinese: 吃下去却害人上吐下泻
sense_groups.english: ...but then made everybody vomit and have diarrhea.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 旅馆费用多少？我要付我那一半
sense_groups.english: I wanna know how much the room was. I'll pay my half.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 三百元
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. $300.

sense_groups.chinese: 三百元？ - 就想成每间二十五元
sense_groups.english: Three hundred dollars? - Yeah. Just think of it as $25 per room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们鬼叫什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you guys woofing about?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德从我皮包偷了二十元纸钞
sense_groups.english: Chandler stole a 20 from my purse!

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？现在回头想想
sense_groups.english: You know what? Now that I think about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我老是没二十元 而你…
sense_groups.english: ...I constantly find myself without 20s, and you...

sense_groups.chinese: 皮夹总是有很多
sense_groups.english: ...always have lots.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该看看她当时的表情
sense_groups.english: You should've seen the look on her face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望瑞秋恨我 真不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't want Rachel to hate me. I don't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要听我的建议吗？ - 请说
sense_groups.english: You want my advice? - Yes. Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听了肯定不高兴 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna like it. - That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你决定结婚太匆促了
sense_groups.english: You got married too fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 这算哪门子忠告？ - 看吧
sense_groups.english: That's not advice. - I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去趟洗手间
sense_groups.english: I'm going to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是有人叫我别见你们其中一个 我绝对办不到
sense_groups.english: Man, if anyone asked me to give up any of you, I don't think I could do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不行
sense_groups.english: Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以
sense_groups.english: Maybe I could do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们听说罗斯跟我的事情了
sense_groups.english: I know you guys heard about the whole thing with me and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经烦了一整天请你们别再提起了
sense_groups.english: But I've been obsessing about it all day and would love not to talk about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这算不算提起
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't know if this falls under that category...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过罗斯就在后面
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, Ross is right back there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那才不是罗斯 - 不是那个
sense_groups.english: That's not Ross. - Oh, no, not that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然他很像
sense_groups.english: He does look like him, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯去洗手间了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ross is in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 开始了 现在就这样 我就像阿吉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. It's happening. It's already started. I'm Kip.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你才不是阿吉
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, you're not Kip.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道阿吉是谁吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you even know who Kip is?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁管他？你是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Who cares? You're Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿吉是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's Kip?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前的室友 以前也跟大家很好
sense_groups.english: Kip, my old roommate. We all hung out together.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个可怜人 - 额嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh, that poor bastard. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧？你们跟我说过那件事 他以前跟摩妮卡约会
sense_groups.english: See? You told me the story. He and Monica dated.

sense_groups.chinese: 分手后却无法共处一室
sense_groups.english: They broke up, they couldn't be in the same room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都答应继续跟他当朋友
sense_groups.english: You all promised you'd stay his friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果呢？他从此遭到排挤
sense_groups.english: And what happened? He got phased out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才不会排挤你 - 好吧 当然我也是
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna be phased out. - Well, of course I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯定可以留下来 因为他是你哥哥 他又是你大学室友
sense_groups.english: It won't happen to Ross. He's your brother, your old college roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 迟早有人会离开这个小圈圈
sense_groups.english: It was a matter of time before someone had to leave the group.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前还以为走的是菲比
sense_groups.english: I always assumed Phoebe would be the one to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你住得远 又不是谁的亲戚
sense_groups.english: Honey, come on, you live far away, you're not related.

sense_groups.chinese: 很快就会被淡忘
sense_groups.english: You lift right out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 宾先生
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mr. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你住的饭店打电话来
sense_groups.english: That, uh, hotel you stayed at called.

sense_groups.chinese: 说在你房间捡到睫毛夹
sense_groups.english: Said someone left an eyelash curler in your room.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的
sense_groups.english: Yes, that was mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你钓上哪个马子 她忘了带走
sense_groups.english: I figured you hooked up with some girl and she left it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种说法的确比较合理
sense_groups.english: Yes, that would have made more sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都快要不认识你了
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't even feel like I know you anymore, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只问你一次就好
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, look, I'm just gonna ask you this one time, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 无论你怎么说 我都相信你
sense_groups.english: And whatever you say, I'll believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是去参加…
sense_groups.english: Were you or were you not on a gay cruise...

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋大会
sense_groups.english: ...on a gay cruise?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该说大家会淡忘你
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about the whole lifting-out thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得跟着我
sense_groups.english: You gotta come with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 去哪里？ - 跟着我就对了
sense_groups.english: Come where? - Wherever I go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以重组一个团体 毕竟我跟你才是精华
sense_groups.english: Come on, you and me, we'll start a new group. We're the best ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不过记得拉乔伊入伙
sense_groups.english: Okay, but try to get Joey too.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我可以跟瑞秋私下谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, do you mind if I speak to Rachel alone for a sec?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Bye, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 永远不见了
sense_groups.english: Forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Ahem. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来做什么？这不是违反规定吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? Isn't this against the rules?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟摩妮卡谈过
sense_groups.english: I talked to Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我做这个选择
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm the one who made the choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我害大家必须要改变
sense_groups.english: I'm the one who's making things change.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以离开的应该是我
sense_groups.english: So I should be the one to, you know, step back.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯… - 真的没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross... - No, no, it's okay. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多人只有在感恩节见到妹妹
sense_groups.english: Plenty of people just see their sisters at Thanksgiving...

sense_groups.chinese: 同学会才见到大学室友
sense_groups.english: ...and just see their college roommates at reunions...

sense_groups.chinese: 在"汉堡王"才见到乔伊
sense_groups.english: ...and just see Joey at Burger King.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样你舒服一点了吗？
sense_groups.english: So is that better?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也没有
sense_groups.english: No, it's not better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是见不到你
sense_groups.english: I still don't get to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 换做你会怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Well, what would you do, Rach? If you were me, what would you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 我在婚礼上 就不会说错名字
sense_groups.english: ...for starters, I would have said the right name at my wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 竟然得走到这一步
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也知道
sense_groups.english: I know that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Hey, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉打扰 菲比说我们要去哪里
sense_groups.english: Sorry to interrupt, but, uh, Phoebe said you wanted to talk to me about a trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我过来主要是…
sense_groups.english: I just came over to drop off...

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: ...nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 上周末过得很糟吧？
sense_groups.english: So that weekend kind of sucked, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it did.

sense_groups.chinese: 那大概没得玩了
sense_groups.english: So I guess this is over?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我说你跟我啦
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, you know, you and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正迟早得结束
sense_groups.english: I mean, it had to end sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why exactly?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们上周末吵架啊
sense_groups.english: Because of the weekend. We had a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你太扯了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, that's crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你每次吵架就分手 交往大概不会超过…
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. If you give up every time you have a fight with someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 你从来不与任何人长期…
sense_groups.english: ...you'd never be with anyone longer than...

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 我们还可以继续？
sense_groups.english: So this isn't over?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真可爱
sense_groups.english: You are so cute!

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我们只是吵架
sense_groups.english: No, no. It was a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 吵过之后就算了 根本没什么好害怕
sense_groups.english: You deal with it and you move on. It's nothing to freak out about.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？太好了 - 呵
sense_groups.english: Really? Okay, great. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎加入成熟恋人行列
sense_groups.english: Aw. Welcome to an adult relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们算是男女朋友？
sense_groups.english: We're in a relationship?

sense_groups.chinese: 恐怕是 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm afraid so. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 听说你上周看到唐纳川普
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Monica, I heard you saw Donald Trump at your convention.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我看到他在等电梯
sense_groups.english: Yeah, saw him waiting for an elevator.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 借我下睫毛夹 我的不见了
sense_groups.english: Rach, can I borrow your eyelash curler? I lost mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 在厕所
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 过来一下 - 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Joey, can I talk to you for a second? - Ooh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我有话跟你说 - 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Joey, I need to talk to you. - Oh! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你？跟你？
sense_groups.english: You? And you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是你不能告诉别人 还没有人知道
sense_groups.english: Yes, but you cannot tell anyone. No one knows.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会？何时的事？
sense_groups.english: But how? When?

sense_groups.chinese: 要从伦敦说起 - 伦敦？
sense_groups.english: It happened in London. - In London!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之所以没告诉大家 是不想你们大惊小怪
sense_groups.english: The reason we didn't tell anyone was we didn't wanna make a big deal out of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这的确是大事 我非告诉谁不可
sense_groups.english: But it is a big deal! I have to tell someone!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 你不能说
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. You can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你 我们就是 不想面对大家质问
sense_groups.english: Please, please. We just don't wanna deal with telling everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你保证不说
sense_groups.english: Please, just promise you won't tell.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议
sense_groups.english: Man, this is unbelievable!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是件好事 可是…
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's great! But...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 的确很棒
sense_groups.english: I know. It's great! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不想看到这慕
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't wanna see that!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真是太蠢了
sense_groups.english: We're so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他们在做什么吗？他们想抢走乔伊
sense_groups.english: Do you know what's going on in there? They're trying to take Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 网球界最有名的菲比 就叫做杀球菲比
sense_groups.english: "The most popular Phoebe in tennis is called the overhand Phoebe. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 赢了就得跟对方击掌 说"嗨 菲比"
sense_groups.english: If you win, you must slap your opponent on the Phoebe and say, 'Hi, Phoebe!"'

sense_groups.chinese: 真有意思 很好玩
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's cute. We really all enjoyed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是这不算 - 不算什么？
sense_groups.english: But you know it doesn't count. - For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 这可不算疯狂字谜
sense_groups.english: Just count in our heads as good Mad Libs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想玩了 - 不好玩了
sense_groups.english: I guess fun time's over. - Yeah, I'm done.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 要遵守规则才有意思
sense_groups.english: Wait, guys, if we follow the rules...

sense_groups.chinese: 也才有意义啊
sense_groups.english: ...it's still fun and it means something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要闪人了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 有规则才好
sense_groups.english: Guys, rules are good!

sense_groups.chinese: 不守规则怎么会好玩
sense_groups.english: Rules help control the fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh!

questions.name: S05E06
questions.en:
Hey, hey, hey, hey.
None of that. Not while you're living under my roof.
What?
Look, just because I know about you two doesn't mean I like looking at it.
Aren't you supposed to be at an audition for another hour?
Well, I'm sorry if I'm not a middle-aged black woman.
And I'm also sorry if sometimes I go to the wrong audition.
Okay, look, if I have to pretend I don't know about you two...
...then you two are gonna have to pretend there's nothing to know about.
Okay, sorry.
I can hear that.
Rachel's at work.
I can still hear you.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey. What's that?
Yeah, my mom sent me a family heirloom that once belonged to my grandmother.
Can you believe it?
A year ago I didn't even have a family...
...and now I have heirlooms for crying out loud.
Oh, God! - Aah!
Oh, soft.
Is this mink? - Yeah.
Why would my mother send me a fur? Doesn't she know me but at all?
Plus, I have a perfectly fine coat that no innocent animals suffered to make.
Yeah, just some 9-year-old Filipino kids who worked their fingers bloody...
...for 12 cents an hour.
That didn't happen, I made that up.
Hey. - Ross?
Ross, you can't put up flyers in here.
How come? Everybody else does.
You can't.
What is that?
Oh, uh, I'm getting rid of a couple of things.
This is all of your things.
Yes, yes, it is.
No, but it's good. Emily thinks we should get all new stuff.
Stuff that's just ours. Together, you know, brand new.
So basically this is a "getting rid of anything Rachel ever touched" sale.
Touched, used, sat on, slept on...
I'll take it all.
Hey, Ross, you're okay with that?
Look, if I can just do what Emily wants...
...and get her to New York, I'm sure everything will be fine.
Okay, but don't you think that's a little extreme?
After what I did, can you blame her? - Oh, my God. You got off easy.
When my friend Sylvie's husband said someone else's name in bed...
...she cursed him and turned his thingy green.
What is he doing?
Emily thinks Ross' furniture has got Rachel cooties?
Calm down, Joey. - No.
Everything's getting all messed up, you know?
Emily won't let Ross see Rachel.
We're not gonna stop seeing Rachel, hence, Ross stops seeing us.
Oh, I hate this. Everything's changing.
Yeah, I know. We're losing Ross, Joey said "hence."
I'm not happy about this either, but, you know, if Ross says he's happy...
...then we just have to keep our feelings about Emily to ourselves.
Are you cool with that?
No.
But, you know, I'm an actor.
I'll act cool.
Ooh. Oh, God, storage rooms give me the creeps.
Monica, please, hurry up, honey, please.
If you want the little round waffles...
...you've gotta wait till I find the little round waffle iron.
I want the little round waffles. - All right.
Here it is.
Right underneath the can of bug bomb.
I wonder if the best place to put something that cooks food is underneath the poison?
Okay, you know what? I'll have toast.
Fog him! Fog him!
I don't know what I'm gonna do about this coat.
I'll take it.
That might work. - Oh, yeah, ha, ha.
Huh? All right, what do you think?
You're on in five, Ms. Minnelli.
No, no, no, it's just a bit sudden.
No, it's great, okay? I am totally on board.
I love you too. All right, bye.
What's the matter, Ross? - Nothing. No. Oh, uh, actually...
...great news. Heh.
Um, just got off the phone with Emily...
...and looks like I'm moving to a new apartment.
Whoo-hoo!
Why? - Well, her thought is... And I agree.
Fresh new furniture, why not a fresh new apartment?
Her cousin has this great place to sublet.
It's got a view of the river on one side and Columbia on the other.
That's way uptown. That's like three trains away...
...which is great.
I love to ride that rail.
So you're really okay with this?
Yes, yes. I mean, it's kind of far from work...
...but, uh, you know, I'll get so much done on the commute.
I've been given the gift of time.
That's so funny, because last Christmas I got the gift of space.
We should get them together and make a continuum.
Now he's moving?
Man, what is Emily doing to him? Ow!
He's not even here.
You guys. You guys.
We were just in the storage area and we saw this really creepy man.
He was like this crazy-eyed, hairy beast-man.
He was like a Bigfoot or a yeti or something.
He came at us with an ax, so Rachel had to use the bug bomb on him.
Yeah, I pulled the tab and I just fogged his yeti ass.
Uh, like, dark hair, bushy beard?
Yeah. - Yeah, you fogged Danny.
Ugh, please. We did not fog Danny.
Who's Danny?
Danny just moved in downstairs.
He just got back from this four-month trek in the Andes. Nice fella.
Oh, he's nice. He's nice. You know, you always...
...stick up for the people we fog.
Yeah? - Hi.
You might not remember us, but we are the girls that fogged you.
We're really sorry we fogged you. - Yeah.
Okay.
Hi, uh, just so you know, we didn't mean to fog you.
We actually thought you were like a yeti or something.
Okay.
Yes?
Hi. Ahem, sorry to bother you...
...but I don't think that we can accept your acceptance of our apology.
It just doesn't really seem like you mean it.
Okay.
Wow. That guy is so rude.
Really. What is with that guy?
I mean, you'd forgive me if I fogged you.
Well, you did, a little bit.
Oh, my God, honey. I'm so sorry.
I totally forgive you. - Really?
Hey. - Hey.
So listen, you know my friend Chris who owns the crematorium?
Crematorium Chris? Sure.
Well, he said that he would cremate my fur coat for free...
...if I, um, you know, bring in the next person I know who dies.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my God. Look at these pelts.
Don't get too attached. She's having it cremated.
What...?
Phoebe? Ha. Honey?
Honey, I know you're quirky, and I get a big kick out of it. We all do, actually.
But if you destroy a coat like this...
...I mean, that is like a crime against nature.
Not nature. Fashion.
This is fashion?
Okay, so to you, death is fashion?
That's really funny. Yeah, here's Phoebe, uh...
...sporting, you know, cutting-edge hairy carcass...
...from, you know, the steel traps of wintry Russia.
I mean, you really think this looks good?
Because I do.
I know, I miss you too. I can't wait to see you.
I love you. Bye.
Okay, what is in here, rocks?
No, this is my collection of, uh, fossil samples.
So rocks.
I'm really gonna miss this apartment. Heh.
You know, Ben took his first steps right over there.
Hey, remember when I ran into this thing and it kind of knocked me out a little?
I love this place.
To tell you the truth, I wish I didn't have to move.
Uh, are you saying that you're not entirely happy about this?
Well, I mean, if, uh, Emily gave me a choice...
You do have a choice.
Ross, why are you listening to her? Are you crazy?
What?
It's not right what Emily wants you to do. She is totally... Ow!
Stop pinching me.
You guys said I only had to keep my mouth shut as long as Ross was happy, right?
Well, he just told me that he's not entirely happy.
What's going on?
We all hate Emily.
No. - No, Ross, we do not hate Emily.
We just think that you're having to sacrifice...
...a whole lot to make her happy.
Yeah.
We just think that maybe she's being a little unreasonable.
Yes, yes, unreasonable.
Unreasonable?
How about we have this conversation when one of you guys gets married?
You have no idea what it takes to make a marriage work.
It's about compromise. Do you always like it? No.
Do you do it? Yes.
Because it's not all laughing, happy, candy in the sky...
...drinking coffee at Central Perk all the time. It's real life, okay?
It's what grownups do.
I think he's right.
You guys hang out at the coffeehouse way too much.
God, I feel so guilty about Ross. - Ugh, I know.
I kind of feel like it's my fault.
Kind of?
If you just kept this to yourself, none of this would have happened.
Well, I'm keeping so many things to myself these days...
...something was bound to slip out.
Well, I think it's very brave what you said.
I can't sit here anymore. I have to walk places.
Pheebs, what are you doing with the coat? How about the whole animal rights thing?
Well, ahem, I've been reading up, and for your information...
...minks are not very nice.
Okay, I admit it. I love this coat, okay?
It's the best thing I've ever had wrapped around me, including Phil Huntley.
Remember Phil Huntley? He was fine.
Hi.
So you like the short hair better? - What?
Yeti? Uh, Danny?
I had to cut my hair to get rid of the, uh...
...fogger smell.
Listen, I'm so sorry. I would have never fogged you...
...you know, if you hadn't looked so... You know, um...
Absolutely. Some people are just into appearances.
What? - That's cool. That's cool.
What...? Hey, whoa, no, no, no, that is not cool.
You don't even know me.
Come on. You got the shopping bags and the Saks catalogue.
So from that, you think you've got me all figured out?
Well, you don't.
You know, I could have toys for underprivileged kids in here.
Do you?
Well, you know, if kids like to play with capri pants.
Okay.
And stop saying that. I hate that.
Okay.
Fine. I judged you. I made a snap judgment.
But you did it too, and you're worse...
...because you are sticking to your stupid snap judgment.
You can't even open up your mind for a second to see that you might be wrong.
What does that say about you?
That pizza place across the street any good?
What? - I'm hungry.
You wanna get some pizza? You can keep yelling if there's more.
Okay.
Okay. - Stop saying that. I hate that.
Uh, Ross?
Are you still mad at us? - Yup.
Oh, good, because we have an "I'm Sorry" song. Ha, ha.
You know what? I'm really not in the mood.
Look, Ross.
I feel really bad. I mean, you're going through all this stuff...
...and I just acted like a jerk.
Yeah, we are so sorry. - You're stepping on the song.
Look, we were way out of line, all right? We totally support you.
Whatever you decide, whatever you do.
Okay, now you're just taking lines right out of the song.
Look, this is hard enough, okay? I really need you guys right now.
Yes, exactly. And that's why...
Why don't you come over tonight, and I'll make you your favorite dinner?
Come on.
Okay.
Thanks, you guys.
Pheebs, are you wearing fur?
Okay, let's get some perspective, people.
It's not like I'm wearing a seeing-eye dog coat.
You know, Ross, I, uh, think I kind of understand why I lost it today.
You do, huh? - Yeah, you see, um...
...I'm an actor, right?
So I gotta keep my emotions right at the surface, you know?
I got a lot of balls in the air, you know what I mean?
It's tough. Guys like me, you know, you wander around, you're alone.
What are you talking about?
I'm not sure.
Hi. - Hey, look at you. Where have you been?
Oh, I went to have pizza. With Danny.
How did that happen? - That yeti is one smooth talker.
I hope you're not too full, because dinner's almost ready.
Yeah, you know, I think I'm probably just gonna hang out in my room.
Oh, no. - Why?
Come on, you guys.
Listen, if Emily knew I was here having dinner with you, she would flip out...
...and you know it.
It's okay. I really... I don't mind.
Wait, wait, wait. You know what? Just stay.
Please.
It would really mean a lot for me if you stay.
Ross, I just...
Rachel, please, just have dinner with us.
Okay, Joey, it's okay. Settle down.
All right. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.
You see, Rach, I'm an actor.
Hey. Hey, look. Ugly naked guy's back.
We haven't seen him in so long.
Oh, God. I really missed that fat bastard.
Wow. This is so weird.
I just realized this may be the last time we're all hanging out together.
It's almost as if he knew.
I'll get it.
Hello?
Hi, Emily.
Yeah, uh, you tracked him down. Hold on one second.
Hey.
Yeah, yeah, we're, uh, just having dinner.
Uh, yeah, sure, hold on.
She wants to say hi. Hold on.
Hi, Emily.
Hello, everyone.
So who am I saying hello to?
Well, uh, I don't know about who's here...
...but I can tell you for damn sure who's not here, and that's Rachel.
Well, I should hope not. Ross knows better than that by now.
You know what? Uh, Rachel is here.
She's there?
Oh, yeah, there she is.
Yeah. Yeah, she's here.
Ross, take me off speakerphone.
Hi. - How could you do this to me?
I thought I'd made my feelings about Rachel perfectly clear.
Look, Emily, I'm just having dinner with my friends, okay?
You obviously can't keep away from her. - That's ridiculous.
Look, I'm moving for you. I'm cutting friends out of my life for you.
Please, just get on the plane and come to New York, okay?
You'll see you're the only person I want to be with.
I'll feel better when I'm there and I can know where you are all the time.
Well, you can't know where I am all the time.
Look, this marriage is never gonna work if you don't trust me.
You're right.
So... can you trust me?
No.
I think it's going okay.
Looks like he's smiling.
How can you tell? You can only see the back of his head.
You can totally tell.
Here, look, watch me.
Smile. Frown. Smile. Frown. Smile.
Well, I guess that's it.
Why? What happened?
My marriage is over.
What? - Oh, sweetie.
Oh, look at you, you're shivering.
Here.
Ross, honey, is there anything we can do?
Yeah.
You can help me get my furniture back from Gunther.
Okay, stop tormenting me.
This is mink, okay? They're mean, and they hate squirrels.
And, you know, most of these probably wanted to be coats.
All right, fine. No, I get it. Here.
You take it.
Are you happy now? I'm cold.
