But then I could be your sidekick, Voonda, heh.
Maybe, uh, I could ask Voonda to dinner sometime?
She would love that...
...since you know all the clean places to eat, heh.
I'll call you.
Okay.
He's so funny! Whoa, oh.
Thank you. - Thanks.
How's Ross doing since all the Emily stuff?
He's not great. But, um, he's dealing with it.
Oh. - Wait, you're not...
Oh, I can't get started with all that Ross stuff again.
He'll be screwed up for a long time.
Besides, I don't go for guys right after they get divorced.
Right, you only go for them five minutes before they get married.
Two pounds of mocha java. - It's Danny.
Are you going to go out again?
I don't know. He hasn't called since we went out.
I see him in the hallway. We flirt. I'm all...
...and then nothing.
Hey. - Hi, Danny.
Wow, thirsty, huh?
I'm having a party on Saturday. Sort of a housewarming thing.
Oh, fun. - Oh, great!
Really looking forward to it. - Yeah.
See you!
So I guess we won't be warming his house.
Oh, ha, ha, okay.
All right, I see what he's doing.
He's not asking me out because he wants me to ask him out.
And you won't do that.
That's right!
Because that would give him the control.
So now he comes up with this "I've got a party" thing...
...to get me to hint for an invitation.
Blew up in his face, didn't it? Ha.
So there is no party?
No, there's a party. There's a party.
But the power?
That is still up for grabs.
You follow me?
I think so.
So he won't invite you to his party because he likes you?
Exactly!
Ross?
Hey, roomies!
I love what you've done with the place.
Oh, I know it's a lot of boxes.
I appreciate you letting me stay here. - Not a problem.
Since you'll be here a while...
...we, uh, could put your name on the answering machine.
Oh, I, uh, hope you don't mind...
...but I kind of already jazzed it up a little, ha, ha.
Check it out.
We will We will call you back
Pretty cool, huh? - Oh, yes.
You're fake laughing too, right? - The tears are real.
Oh, yeah. Ha, ha.
You look beautiful this evening. - Heh.
Show me the badge again.
Shiny, ha, ha.
Oh, you mind if I wash up? Who knows where these have been?
You are just nonstop, ha-ha-ha!
We're out of here. - Why?
I saw ten violations. I'm shutting this place down!
You have the power to do that? - This does.
Shut it down.
Hey.
What are you doing?
Nothing.
You built a fort, didn't you?
Kind of, heh.
Oh, my God! The air purifier. Ross' air purifier.
All I heard for four years through college was...
You should have gone out once in a while.
I hate this thing! - Come on, Chandler.
Ross is our friend. He needs us right now.
So why don't you be a grownup and come watch TV in the fort?
Oh, hi, Danny. - Hey, guys.
Uh, I wanted to invite you to the party.
Oh, thanks, I'll try to stop by.
Actually, I think, ahem, I'm going to be busy.
You are?
Yeah.
Remember? I've got that, uh, gala.
What's the gala for?
Uh, it's a, um...
It's, uh, a regatta gala.
Do you sail?
No, but I support it.
I hope I see you tomorrow night. Take care.
Okay.
Walked right into that one, didn't he?
What one?
You wanted him to invite you and he did.
He waited until the last minute. So if I said yes...
...he'd know I had nothing better to do than wait for his invitation.
But I said no...
...which puts me back in the driver's seat.
So the ball is in his court?
Ball?
No, there's no ball.
Joey, please.
Sorry.
Hello, children. - Hey.
You want to play some foosball? Please?
Okay. - No, no, no.
We moved the table into my room because of all the boxes, ha, ha.
Come on!
I have one question.
What is the deal with this?
Bye-bye, little puppet Joey hand?
No, the quiet down thing.
Oh. You mean this.
Mm-hm.
I don't know how much more I can take.
Did you know he taped over my Baywatch tape with a show about bugs?
My God!
What if that had been porn? - Oh!
All right, this may be tough...
...but it's Ross. I survived college with him.
I guess I can hold out a little longer.
Let's have a game. - Okay.
Don't be scored on. No, no, no.
Yes. Ha-ha-ha.
Uh, fellas?
So he's out of here. - Mm-hm.
Hey. - Hey.
Got anything to eat? I went to Jono's and it was closed.
Oh, I took Larry there, but it was all violated, so we shut it down.
If this guy keeps closing our favorite places, where will we eat?
I don't know. Clean places?
Mm, yum!
It's Danny.
Don't let him in! I'm supposed to be at a gala.
We'll be right there. Can't you say it's later?
What kind of a regatta gala starts at night?
The fake kind.
Um, I need a ladle. You got a ladle? - We have a ladle.
See you at the party.
Okay, great.
You know what Larry would say? He'd say, "See you ladle."
I'm done. You want anything? Uh, sports? International?
Apartment listings?
I'll take sports.
Mine!
All right, uh, international.
That's mine too.
I'm Italian.
I could check apartment listings, though there's never anything here.
Not even on page seven?
Oh, yeah.
You're right. Oh, here's an affordable place.
Two bedroom, close to work. Ooh, it's available in five weeks.
What about that circled one?
Ooh, I don't know. It's kind of expensive for a studio.
But it's available now.
Isn't it?
Yes, it is.
Let's go look at it, heh!
Oh, okay. Let's go. - There we go! Yay!
Oh, oh, oh, guys, would you, uh, chip in for some new air filters for the purifier?
I mean, after all, we are all using it.
Let's go quicker!
Yeah.
Oh, my God! - Mm.
Oh, look at this kitchen/bathroom.
That's great! So you can cook while in the tub.
Somebody was using his head.
Let's check out the rest of the place.
I think this is it.
I don't know. Maybe we should keep looking.
But this place is available now.
You don't want to be stuck with us for five weeks.
So you think I should take this place?
Oh, it's perfect!
How about you?
Kitchen, slash, bathroom.
Ah, I see what you guys are saying.
I'll, uh, go downstairs and fill out an application.
We are bad people.
He knew we were trying to get rid of him.
Could we get a bathtub in our kitchen?
Ready for dinner?
Ooh, absolutely. - Great.
You wanted to go to the Italian place on Bleecker St?
Oh, I love that place, ha, ha.
So no. - Oh.
How about Mama Lozetti's?
Yuck.
Sure.
How long has that milk been sitting out?
No, this place is totally healthy.
This milk is mine. I bought this today...
...because I was thirsty for milk, you know?
Okay, let's go.
Hey, buddy.
Health Code 11 B requires that refuse be taken out the back exit.
But then I have to go all the way around.
So you choose convenience over health?
Stop, Larry.
Can't you just be Larry and not Larry the health inspector guy?
It was exciting at first.
But now, it's like, so where are we going to eat ever?
I suppose I could give him a warning.
Thank you.
Go, go!
If, after dinner, you still need to bust someone...
...I know a hot dog vendor who picks his nose.
Maybe we did good, helping Ross get back on his feet.
That was a nice place.
No closet space, but he could hang his stuff out the window in a bag.
What do we do?
I don't know.
Maybe pizza?
About Ross! - Oh.
Hello.
Oh, yeah.
It's the apartment manager. Ross put us as references.
Ross is the greatest guy. He's very reliable...
Of course, he has a big, huge dog that, uh, barks into the night.
Well, who doesn't love dogs?
Uh, he's a tap dancer.
Yes, some would say that is a lost art.
He's a pimp!
There you go. He's a pimp.
He's a big, tap-dancing pimp!
Hello?
Oh.
Watching for a sound To lead me to wherever...
Shh, this is never going to work. He's right there.
Just go say hi.
I have to go downstairs and back up, as if I'm coming home from the gala.
So just go distract him. But don't be sexy.
Hey, Danny. - Hey.
What's going on?
This is a great party. Great food, ha, ha.
Oh, you know, most parties, it's, uh, all chips and salsa, chips and salsa.
So, um...
What's this?
Salad.
Oh.
And what's this?
Bread.
Aren't you a chef?
Oh.
Hey, Rachel. - Hey.
Oh, right, tonight was your party.
You look great! I'm glad you made it.
Oh, well, you know, the gala had to end sometime.
Don't go anywhere. I'll be right back.
Yeah, sure. - All right?
Whose court is the ball in now?
I thought there wasn't a ball.
Come on. He's glad I came. He doesn't want me to go anywhere.
Ball's flying all over the place.
This is my friend, Tom.
This is the girl I told you about.
Oh, come on! You telling people about me?
I think you two could really hit it off.
I'm gonna go mingle.
So you work at Bloomingdale's, huh? My mom calls it "Bloomies."
Yeah, okay.
At ease, soldier, heh.
I'm sorry?
You can just drop the act. I know what's going on.
You're Danny's wingman, right?
You guys are best buds, frat bros.
I'm going to go talk to, uh, a friend.
Yeah, you go talk to your friend.
Go tell him, "Nice try."
He just keeps lobbing them up...
...and I keep knocking them right out of the park.
I think I need a drink.
Yeah.
Okay. Go.
Dude, I'm telling you, I'm fine.
Here we go, here we go.
Hey. - Hey.
So I, uh, didn't get that apartment. Some problem with my application.
You're kidding?
But Phoebe said I could stay at her place for a while, so...
Well, you can't stay with Phoebe. We're roomies.
You don't need me taking up all your space.
We got plenty of space. There's still some by that speaker.
Please, just stay.
Yeah.
Are you sure?
Definitely. - You have to stay.
All right. - All right, buddy.
So I'm a pimp, huh?
It's okay.
Sometimes I can be a pain in the ass.
But just talk to me. Tell me if something bothers you.
And I'll do everything I can to keep my annoying habits just...
Well, I see you've had a very productive day.
The cowboy hat's a little much.
Come on, it's fun!
All right.
Isn't this a woman's hat?
Dude, stop talking crazy, and make us some tea!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看原住民裸女吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you looking at naked tribeswomen?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 你看
sense_groups.english: No, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是猪耶
sense_groups.english: That's a pig.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你看他的咪咪多大
sense_groups.english: I know. But look at the knobs on it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉的表妹 竟然把我赶出来
sense_groups.english: Emily's cousin kicked me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你跟老婆的表妹分租公寓 要是之援又离婚
sense_groups.english: When you sublet from your wife's cousin...

sense_groups.chinese: 表妹就会突然把房子要回去
sense_groups.english: ...then you divorce, sometimes the cousin wants his apartment back.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可以这样？你们没签约吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you sign a lease?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁跟亲戚租公寓还签约？
sense_groups.english: Who needs a lease when it's "family"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以跟我们住
sense_groups.english: You can stay with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 包在我们身上
sense_groups.english: Anything you need.

sense_groups.chinese: 你心情好一点就说一声…
sense_groups.english: But you have to let us know when you feel better...

sense_groups.chinese: 好让我们取笑你的鸡窝头
sense_groups.english: ...so we can make fun of your hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 好
sense_groups.english: You got it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们 我太感激了 我得回去打包行李了
sense_groups.english: Thanks, I really appreciate this. I'm going to get packing again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最近不断搬家 简直像是游民
sense_groups.english: I've been moving around so much that I feel like a nomad.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 他以为你说的是"咪咪"
sense_groups.english: What? - He thought you said gonad.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 摩妮卡 要是每家餐厅都跟你的一样干净 我就没饭吃了
sense_groups.english: Wow, Monica. If every place were this clean, it'd be tough making a living.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了 赖瑞
sense_groups.english: Ha, oh, Larry!

sense_groups.chinese: 卫生稽查员收佣金吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, do health inspectors work on commission?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不过收红包
sense_groups.english: No, bribes.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈哈 我可以笑吧？ - 我开玩笑的啦
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha, it's okay to laugh? - I was just kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去检查厨房地板 - 请自便
sense_groups.english: I'll check the kitchen floor. - Knock yourself out.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可口
sense_groups.english: Yummy! Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说赖瑞？
sense_groups.english: Larry?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也愿意让他检查我厨房地板
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'd let him check out my kitchen floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没戴帽子所以扣两分
sense_groups.english: I deducted two points for not wearing your hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为违反第五条规定
sense_groups.english: That is a Section 5 violation.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 赖瑞 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Oh. Now look, Larry, honey, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我写过第五条条文的书
sense_groups.english: Um, I wrote the book on Section 5.

sense_groups.chinese: 在厨房才要戴帽子
sense_groups.english: You only need to wear it in the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你的帽子呢？ - 在厨房 我进去拿
sense_groups.english: Where's your hat? - In the kitchen. I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这里和两分
sense_groups.english: Ah, there's the two points!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真该读读你自己写的书
sense_groups.english: You should really read that book you wrote.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到帽子在厨房知道她进去拿时没戴帽子
sense_groups.english: You saw the hat in the kitchen and knew she'd go in hatless to get it, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以主演 卫生稽查员兼侦探的电视剧了
sense_groups.english: You could have your own health inspector detective show.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太客气了
sense_groups.english: Ah, I don't know about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我可以演你的助手薇达
sense_groups.english: But then I could be your sidekick, Voonda, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许薇达可以留电话给我 我就能约她出去吃饭
sense_groups.english: Maybe, uh, I could ask Voonda to dinner sometime?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 她一定会很高兴
sense_groups.english: She would love that...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你知道哪家餐厅才卫生
sense_groups.english: ...since you know all the clean places to eat, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再打给你
sense_groups.english: I'll call you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真幽默
sense_groups.english: He's so funny! Whoa, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 罗斯还好吧？还在为艾蜜莉伤心吗？
sense_groups.english: How's Ross doing since all the Emily stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 心情不太好 不过 他还撑得下去
sense_groups.english: He's not great. But, um, he's dealing with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 等等 你该不会…
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Wait, you're not...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不可能再跟罗斯交往
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't get started with all that Ross stuff again.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还要失魂落魄很久的时间
sense_groups.english: He'll be screwed up for a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 况且你也知道 我不喜欢追刚离婚的男人
sense_groups.english: Besides, I don't go for guys right after they get divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 快结婚的人你才要
sense_groups.english: Right, you only go for them five minutes before they get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要两磅爪哇摩卡咖啡 - 是丹尼
sense_groups.english: Two pounds of mocha java. - It's Danny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还会出去吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you going to go out again?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 上次出去一次之后他就没再打给我
sense_groups.english: I don't know. He hasn't called since we went out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只在走廊上打情骂俏 我笑得下巴掉下来
sense_groups.english: I see him in the hallway. We flirt. I'm all...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果却没下文
sense_groups.english: ...and then nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨 丹尼
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi, Danny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很渴吧？
sense_groups.english: Wow, thirsty, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我周六要办派对 庆祝我搬新家
sense_groups.english: I'm having a party on Saturday. Sort of a housewarming thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有意思 - 真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, fun. - Oh, great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常期待 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really looking forward to it. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我走了
sense_groups.english: See you!

sense_groups.chinese: 看来他新家不欢迎我们
sense_groups.english: So I guess we won't be warming his house.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 哈 哈 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha, ha, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我知道他在玩什么把戏
sense_groups.english: All right, I see what he's doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 他故意不约我 因为他要我主动约他
sense_groups.english: He's not asking me out because he wants me to ask him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是你不鸟他
sense_groups.english: And you won't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right!

sense_groups.chinese: 否则主导权就落在他手里
sense_groups.english: Because that would give him the control.

sense_groups.chinese: 他现在故意说什么要办派对
sense_groups.english: So now he comes up with this "I've got a party" thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 要我暗示他约我
sense_groups.english: ...to get me to hint for an invitation.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我当场给他好看 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Blew up in his face, didn't it? Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他根本没有要办派对
sense_groups.english: So there is no party?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 当然有 当然有
sense_groups.english: No, there's a party. There's a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过
sense_groups.english: But the power?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是老大还不知道哩
sense_groups.english: That is still up for grabs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听得懂吗？
sense_groups.english: You follow me?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该吧
sense_groups.english: I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说他故意不约你 是因为他喜欢你
sense_groups.english: So he won't invite you to his party because he likes you?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样
sense_groups.english: Exactly!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 室友们
sense_groups.english: Hey, roomies!

sense_groups.chinese: 你把家里布置得真温馨
sense_groups.english: I love what you've done with the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道箱子堆得到处都是
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know it's a lot of boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要再次感谢你们收容我 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: I appreciate you letting me stay here. - Not a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你要在这里住阵子
sense_groups.english: Since you'll be here a while...

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 喔 干脆录段你的留官
sense_groups.english: ...we, uh, could put your name on the answering machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 希望你们别介意
sense_groups.english: Oh, I, uh, hope you don't mind...

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经录了一段
sense_groups.english: ...but I kind of already jazzed it up a little, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们听
sense_groups.english: Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一定一定会回你电话
sense_groups.english: We will We will call you back

sense_groups.chinese: 很酷吧？ - 喔 对
sense_groups.english: Pretty cool, huh? - Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是假笑吧？ - 不过眼泪是真的
sense_groups.english: You're fake laughing too, right? - The tears are real.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是的 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今晚真漂亮 - 呵
sense_groups.english: You look beautiful this evening. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 再给我看一次徽章
sense_groups.english: Show me the badge again.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是闪闪发亮
sense_groups.english: Shiny, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以去洗个手吗？谁晓得这两个宝贝去过什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, you mind if I wash up? Who knows where these have been?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是马不停蹄 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: You are just nonstop, ha-ha-ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们必须立刻离开这里 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: We're out of here. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚经过厨房就看到十项违规 我要勒今他们停业
sense_groups.english: I saw ten violations. I'm shutting this place down!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有权限可以这样做吗？ - 有这个就可以
sense_groups.english: You have the power to do that? - This does.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就让他们停业吧
sense_groups.english: Shut it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你造了一座城堡 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You built a fort, didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多
sense_groups.english: Kind of, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是他的空气清净器 罗斯的空气清净器
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! The air purifier. Ross' air purifier.

sense_groups.chinese: 我大学四年只听得到…
sense_groups.english: All I heard for four years through college was...

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你应该偶尔出去走走
sense_groups.english: You should have gone out once in a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这东西 - 来吧 钱德
sense_groups.english: I hate this thing! - Come on, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯是我们的好友 他现在需要我们帮忙
sense_groups.english: Ross is our friend. He needs us right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以成熟点 进来城堡看电视吧
sense_groups.english: So why don't you be a grownup and come watch TV in the fort?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 嗨 丹尼 - 嘿 你这家伙
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Danny. - Hey, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来请你们参加明晚的派对
sense_groups.english: Uh, I wanted to invite you to the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 我们有时间就过去
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks, I'll try to stop by.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我可能有事
sense_groups.english: Actually, I think, ahem, I'm going to be busy.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: You are?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我上次跟你说 要参加开慕酒会
sense_groups.english: Remember? I've got that, uh, gala.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么开慕酒会？
sense_groups.english: What's the gala for?

sense_groups.chinese: 是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, it's a, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 赛船开慕酒会
sense_groups.english: It's, uh, a regatta gala.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你会驾驶帆船？
sense_groups.english: Do you sail?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 可是我赞助比赛
sense_groups.english: No, but I support it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 明晚见罗 好
sense_groups.english: I hope I see you tomorrow night. Take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这招打得他满脸豆花
sense_groups.english: Walked right into that one, didn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一招？
sense_groups.english: What one?

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望他邀你参加派对 他也来啦
sense_groups.english: You wanted him to invite you and he did.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是他等到最后一刻才来 如果我答应…
sense_groups.english: He waited until the last minute. So if I said yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 他就知道 我没事可做等着去那白痴派对
sense_groups.english: ...he'd know I had nothing better to do than wait for his invitation.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我说不去
sense_groups.english: But I said no...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以还是我占上风
sense_groups.english: ...which puts me back in the driver's seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 正点 所以换他出招喽？
sense_groups.english: So the ball is in his court?

sense_groups.chinese: 出招？
sense_groups.english: Ball?

sense_groups.chinese: 他没招可出了
sense_groups.english: No, there's no ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 麻烦你
sense_groups.english: Joey, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 小鬼们 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello, children. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要玩手足球？求求你？
sense_groups.english: You want to play some foosball? Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: Okay. - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 游戏桌搬进我房间了因为外面太多箱子
sense_groups.english: We moved the table into my room because of all the boxes, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 进来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我有个问题
sense_groups.english: I have one question.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么碗糕？
sense_groups.english: What is the deal with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 小布偶乔伊说再见？
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye, little puppet Joey hand?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 叫我闭嘴的手势
sense_groups.english: No, the quiet down thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说这样啊
sense_groups.english: Oh. You mean this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我还能憋多久
sense_groups.english: I don't know how much more I can take.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他竟然拿我的海滩游侠录影带 去录什么怪小虫吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you know he taped over my Baywatch tape with a show about bugs?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: My God!

sense_groups.chinese: 要是当面录的是A片呢？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: What if that had been porn? - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这样也许不好过
sense_groups.english: All right, this may be tough...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 是罗斯耶 我和他一起度过大学生活的
sense_groups.english: ...but it's Ross. I survived college with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 也许我可以再忍受一阵子
sense_groups.english: I guess I can hold out a little longer.

sense_groups.chinese: 来玩吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Let's have a game. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要…
sense_groups.english: Don't be scored on. No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Yes. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 两位？
sense_groups.english: Uh, fellas?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 他非走不可 - 唔
sense_groups.english: So he's out of here. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有没有东西可吃？我刚去强诺买鸡块那里竟然停业了
sense_groups.english: Got anything to eat? I went to Jono's and it was closed.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我带赖瑞去 餐厅不合规定 所以我们勒令他们停业
sense_groups.english: Oh, I took Larry there, but it was all violated, so we shut it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙不断关掉大家喜欢去的餐馆 以后我们上哪吃饭？
sense_groups.english: If this guy keeps closing our favorite places, where will we eat?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得 干净的地方？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Clean places?

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了
sense_groups.english: Mm, yum!

sense_groups.chinese: 是丹尼
sense_groups.english: It's Danny.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让他进来 我现在 应该去船赛开慕酒会了
sense_groups.english: Don't let him in! I'm supposed to be at a gala.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们马上过去 不能说酒会还没开始吗？
sense_groups.english: We'll be right there. Can't you say it's later?

sense_groups.chinese: 哪种船赛开慕酒会在晚上开慕？
sense_groups.english: What kind of a regatta gala starts at night?

sense_groups.chinese: 假的那种
sense_groups.english: The fake kind.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我想借个勺子 你有吗？ - 我们有
sense_groups.english: Um, I need a ladle. You got a ladle? - We have a ladle.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 待会儿见 好
sense_groups.english: See you at the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道赖瑞会怎么回答吗？他会说"稍后见"
sense_groups.english: You know what Larry would say? He'd say, "See you ladle."

sense_groups.chinese: 我看完了 你要看吗 有体育？国际？
sense_groups.english: I'm done. You want anything? Uh, sports? International?

sense_groups.chinese: 租屋版？
sense_groups.english: Apartment listings?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要体育版
sense_groups.english: I'll take sports.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要
sense_groups.english: Mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就国际版好了
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, international.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也要
sense_groups.english: That's mine too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是意大利裔
sense_groups.english: I'm Italian.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然看看租屋广告吧 不过报上向来没吉屋
sense_groups.english: I could check apartment listings, though there's never anything here.

sense_groups.chinese: 第7页也没有吗？
sense_groups.english: Not even on page seven?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 有个地方价钱很公道
sense_groups.english: You're right. Oh, here's an affordable place.

sense_groups.chinese: 两房 上班也近 可是还要五周才能搬进去
sense_groups.english: Two bedroom, close to work. Ooh, it's available in five weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 那圈起来那个呢？
sense_groups.english: What about that circled one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道耶 就套房来说有点贵
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I don't know. It's kind of expensive for a studio.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是现在就能搬进去
sense_groups.english: But it's available now.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 的确是
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去看看
sense_groups.english: Let's go look at it, heh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们走吧 - 走吧 耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Let's go. - There we go! Yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 忘了告诉你们 可不可以大家分摊买滤芯？
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, oh, guys, would you, uh, chip in for some new air filters for the purifier?

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟空气清净器大家都有用到
sense_groups.english: I mean, after all, we are all using it.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点走
sense_groups.english: Let's go quicker!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看这个厨房兼浴室
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at this kitchen/bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 可以一边煮饭 一边洗澡
sense_groups.english: That's great! So you can cook while in the tub.

sense_groups.chinese: 房东真是太聪明了
sense_groups.english: Somebody was using his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 再看看其他地方
sense_groups.english: Let's check out the rest of the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想就这么大了
sense_groups.english: I think this is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道耶 我们应该看看别的公寓
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Maybe we should keep looking.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是罗斯 这地方马上就能搬进来
sense_groups.english: But this place is available now.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 你不会愿意 继续跟我们住五周
sense_groups.english: You don't want to be stuck with us for five weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我应该租下？
sense_groups.english: So you think I should take this place?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里很棒啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's perfect!

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢？
sense_groups.english: How about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有厨房兼浴室耶
sense_groups.english: Kitchen, slash, bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我懂了
sense_groups.english: Ah, I see what you guys are saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我下楼填申请表
sense_groups.english: I'll, uh, go downstairs and fill out an application.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是坏人
sense_groups.english: We are bad people.

sense_groups.chinese: 他知道我们想赶他走
sense_groups.english: He knew we were trying to get rid of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们厨房能不能装浴缸？
sense_groups.english: Could we get a bathtub in our kitchen?

sense_groups.chinese: 要去吃饭了吗？
sense_groups.english: Ready for dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 好
sense_groups.english: Ooh, absolutely. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上次不是说要去布里克街 那家意大利赛厅？
sense_groups.english: You wanted to go to the Italian place on Bleecker St?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱死那里了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I love that place, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 不行 - 噢
sense_groups.english: So no. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那去李赛提老妈呢？
sense_groups.english: How about Mama Lozetti's?

sense_groups.chinese: 呸
sense_groups.english: Yuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道那瓶牛奶放多久了？
sense_groups.english: How long has that milk been sitting out?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这地方非常干净
sense_groups.english: No, this place is totally healthy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那瓶牛奶是我的 我今天买的
sense_groups.english: This milk is mine. I bought this today...

sense_groups.chinese: 我突然想喝牛奶
sense_groups.english: ...because I was thirsty for milk, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 老兄
sense_groups.english: Hey, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道卫生规则第11条B款垃圾应该从后门拿出去
sense_groups.english: Health Code 11 B requires that refuse be taken out the back exit.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是这样就得从干洗店烧路
sense_groups.english: But then I have to go all the way around.

sense_groups.chinese: 你宁可方便也不顾卫生？
sense_groups.english: So you choose convenience over health?

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 赖瑞
sense_groups.english: Stop, Larry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能当赖瑞就好 而不是卫生稽查员赖瑞？
sense_groups.english: Can't you just be Larry and not Larry the health inspector guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 开始还很刺激
sense_groups.english: It was exciting at first.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是现在简直是 哪家餐厅也去不了
sense_groups.english: But now, it's like, so where are we going to eat ever?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我可以口头警告就好了
sense_groups.english: I suppose I could give him a warning.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 快走啊
sense_groups.english: Go, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 要是吃饱饭后你还想抓人
sense_groups.english: If, after dinner, you still need to bust someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道哪个热狗摊老板 喜欢挖鼻子
sense_groups.english: ...I know a hot dog vendor who picks his nose.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好我们做的是好事 帮助罗斯早点恢复正常
sense_groups.english: Maybe we did good, helping Ross get back on his feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 况且那地方实在不错 是啊
sense_groups.english: That was a nice place.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然柜子不多 不过可以用袋子装好挂在窗外
sense_groups.english: No closet space, but he could hang his stuff out the window in a bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What do we do?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 要吃披萨吗？
sense_groups.english: Maybe pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的是罗斯 - 噢
sense_groups.english: About Ross! - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我是
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是公寓经理 罗斯填我们当介绍人
sense_groups.english: It's the apartment manager. Ross put us as references.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯绝对是好人 这人非常可靠
sense_groups.english: Ross is the greatest guy. He's very reliable...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他养了一只大狗 那只狗半夜叫个不停
sense_groups.english: Of course, he has a big, huge dog that, uh, barks into the night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁不喜欢狗？
sense_groups.english: Well, who doesn't love dogs?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个踢踏舞者
sense_groups.english: Uh, he's a tap dancer.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人说这的确是失传的艺术
sense_groups.english: Yes, some would say that is a lost art.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是皮条客
sense_groups.english: He's a pimp!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就是皮条客
sense_groups.english: There you go. He's a pimp.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是会跳踢踏舞的皮条客
sense_groups.english: He's a big, tap-dancing pimp!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着这声音要带我去哪里
sense_groups.english: Watching for a sound To lead me to wherever...

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 这可不行 他就站在那里
sense_groups.english: Shh, this is never going to work. He's right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 去打声招呼就行啦
sense_groups.english: Just go say hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我得从楼下走上来 假装我刚从外面回来
sense_groups.english: I have to go downstairs and back up, as if I'm coming home from the gala.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去引开他的注意力 但是别勾引他
sense_groups.english: So just go distract him. But don't be sexy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 丹尼 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey, Danny. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个派对真不错 食物也很好
sense_groups.english: This is a great party. Great food, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 大部分派对都只有薯片 辣酱 薯片 沙拉酱
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, most parties, it's, uh, all chips and salsa, chips and salsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么
sense_groups.english: So, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 沙拉
sense_groups.english: Salad.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这又是什么？
sense_groups.english: And what's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 面包
sense_groups.english: Bread.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是厨师吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you a chef?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你今晚要办派对
sense_groups.english: Oh, right, tonight was your party.

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿得真漂亮 幸好你赶回来了
sense_groups.english: You look great! I'm glad you made it.

sense_groups.chinese: 开慕会总不能没完没了
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, you know, the gala had to end sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别走开 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: Don't go anywhere. I'll be right back.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. - All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你说现在换谁出招啦？
sense_groups.english: Whose court is the ball in now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是说他没招可出？
sense_groups.english: I thought there wasn't a ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 他很高兴我来了 而且还叫我别走开
sense_groups.english: Come on. He's glad I came. He doesn't want me to go anywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们两个现在是你来我往
sense_groups.english: Ball's flying all over the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这是我朋友汤姆
sense_groups.english: This is my friend, Tom.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我跟你提过的小姐
sense_groups.english: This is the girl I told you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你跟人提过我？
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on! You telling people about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一定会来电
sense_groups.english: I think you two could really hit it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去跟朋友哈拉了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go mingle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在布鲁明岱尔百货上班？我妈都说那里是"布鲁迷"
sense_groups.english: So you work at Bloomingdale's, huh? My mom calls it "Bloomies."

sense_groups.chinese: 真不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 稍息 大兵
sense_groups.english: At ease, soldier, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 汤姆 你别装了 我知道你们搞什么鬼
sense_groups.english: You can just drop the act. I know what's going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是丹尼的好友对不对？
sense_groups.english: You're Danny's wingman, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们交情老 感情好
sense_groups.english: You guys are best buds, frat bros.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去…找朋友
sense_groups.english: I'm going to go talk to, uh, a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 请便 去找你朋友吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you go talk to your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他"这招漂亮"
sense_groups.english: Go tell him, "Nice try."

sense_groups.chinese: 他真是出招连连
sense_groups.english: He just keeps lobbing them up...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我可是招招都破
sense_groups.english: ...and I keep knocking them right out of the park.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想喝杯饮料 我也要
sense_groups.english: I think I need a drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 我没问题
sense_groups.english: Dude, I'm telling you, I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我扶住你了…
sense_groups.english: Here we go, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没租到那间公寓 我的申请资格有问题
sense_groups.english: So I, uh, didn't get that apartment. Some problem with my application.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有可能？不会吧
sense_groups.english: You're kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 不过好消息是 菲比答应让我搬去跟她住一阵子
sense_groups.english: But Phoebe said I could stay at her place for a while, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能住菲比家 我们可是室友耶
sense_groups.english: Well, you can't stay with Phoebe. We're roomies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能再占用你们公寓
sense_groups.english: You don't need me taking up all your space.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正这里大得很 喇叭旁边还有空间
sense_groups.english: We got plenty of space. There's still some by that speaker.

sense_groups.chinese: 住下来吧
sense_groups.english: Please, just stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们确定？
sense_groups.english: Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 你非留下来不可
sense_groups.english: Definitely. - You have to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 就这么办
sense_groups.english: All right. - All right, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我是皮条客？
sense_groups.english: So I'm a pimp, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我有时候很招人怨 不过你们可以直说
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I can be a pain in the ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 明白告诉我哪里让你们不舒服
sense_groups.english: But just talk to me. Tell me if something bothers you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以尽量改掉惹人嫌的习惯 只要你们…
sense_groups.english: And I'll do everything I can to keep my annoying habits just...

sense_groups.chinese: 显然你今天过得很充实
sense_groups.english: Well, I see you've had a very productive day.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过戴牛仔帽也太扯了吧？
sense_groups.english: The cowboy hat's a little much.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 进来一起玩
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's fun!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是女人的帽子吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't this a woman's hat?

sense_groups.chinese: 小子 还不赶快闭嘴去泡茶？
sense_groups.english: Dude, stop talking crazy, and make us some tea!

questions.name: S05E08
questions.en:
Monica, that was the best Thanksgiving dinner ever.
It was so good. I think you killed us.
I couldn't possibly eat another bite.
I need something sweet.
Does anyone wanna watch TV?
Yeah. Sure.
Monica, your remote doesn't work.
Phoebe, you have to lift it and point.
Oh.
Oh, forget it.
Hey, you know what we should all do?
We should play that game where everyone says one thing they're thankful for.
Oh, I... I am thankful for this beautiful fall we've been having.
Very nice. - Sweet, Joe.
Yeah, the other day, I was at the bus stop...
...and this lovely fall breeze came in out of nowhere...
...and blew this chick's skirt right up.
Oh, which reminds me, I'm also thankful for thongs.
It's not so much an underpant as it is a feat of engineering.
It's amazing how much they can do with so little material.
And the way they play with your mind. I mean, is it there? Is it not there?
Are you aware that you're still talking?
Is anyone thankful for anything else besides a thong?
Huh. I don't know what to pick.
Am I more thankful for my divorce, or my eviction? Hmm.
Wow, see, and I didn't think you'd be able to come up with anything.
I'm sorry. It's just this is the worst Thanksgiving ever.
No, no, no. I am the king of bad Thanksgivings.
You can't just swoop in here with your bad marriage...
...and take that away from me.
You're not gonna tell the whole story...
...about how your parents got divorced, are you?
No, no.
Come on. I want to hear it.
It wouldn't be Thanksgiving without Chandler bumming us out.
It's a tradition, like the parade.
If the parade decided it was gay, moved out and abandoned its entire family.
Now, Chandler, dear.
Just because your father and I are getting a divorce...
...doesn't mean we don't love you.
It just means...
...he would rather sleep with the houseboy than with me.
More turkey, Mr. Chandler?
You're right, yours is worse. You are the king of bad Thanksgivings.
I don't know about that. I've got one that's worse.
Really? Worse than
"More turkey, Mr. Chandler?"
Did the little rich boy had a problem with the butler?
Yes, mine's worse.
[GUNFIRE AND BOMBS EXPLODING]
More bandages! More bandages!
Please, can I get some more bandages in here?
This man is... Aah!
Oh, no.
In this life, Phoebe.
Oh, this life.
Oh, okay. No, Chandler's is worse.
Man, it must be so cool remembering stuff like that.
I don't have any past life memories.
Of course, you don't, sweetie. You're brand-new.
I know Monica's worst Thanksgiving.
Oh, let's not tell this story. - Oh, come on.
Oh, no! I know! I know!
It's the one where Joey got Monica's turkey stuck on his head.
What? - What?
Joey got a turkey stuck on his head?
Hey, it's not like it sounds.
It's exactly like it sounds.
Hello?
Hello?
Phoebe? - Joey?
What's going on?
Oh, my God.
I know.
It's stuck.
Step. How did it get on?
I put it on to scare Chandler.
Oh, my God. Monica's going to totally freak out.
Well, then help me get it off.
Plus, it smells really bad in here.
Of course it smells really bad. You have your head up a dead animal.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey, did you get the turkey...? Oh, my God!
Oh, my God!
Who is that?
It's Joey.
What are you doing? Is this supposed to be funny?
No, it's not supposed to be funny. It's supposed to be scary.
Get that off now.
I can't. It's stuck.
Well, I don't care. That turkey has to feed 20 people.
They're not going to eat it off your head.
Hold on, okay? Let's just all think.
Okay, I got it. Phoebe?
All right. You pull.
I'm gonna spread the legs as wide as I can.
Joey, now is not the time. - Yeah. Sorry. Right, sorry.
Okay, count to three. One, two...
...three.
It worked. I scared you. I knew it. Ha, ha!
I'm over here, big guy. - Yeah, you are. Ha, ha!
I scared you. Whoo!
You did look like an idiot.
Hey, I wasn't the only one who looked like an idiot, all right?
Remember when Ross tried to say "butternut squash"...
...and it came out, "squatternut bosh"?
Yeah, that's the same.
That's it. That's my worst Thanksgiving.
Oh, wait. That can't be the one that Rachel was talking about...
...because she didn't even know that that happened.
So, what's yours? - What was it?
Um, I really don't wanna tell this story.
Oh, come on, Monica.
Reliving past pain and getting depressed is what Thanksgiving's all about.
You know, for me, anyway. And, of course, the Indians.
Look, of all people, you do not want me to tell this story.
What is that supposed to mean?
Monica, I think Rachel's here.
I'll get it.
Happy Thanksgiving. - Not for me.
Chip and I broke up.
Oh. Why?
Well, what happened?
You know how my parents are out of town, and Chip was gonna come over?
Yeah, yeah. And you were gonna give him, you know...
...your "flower."
Okay, Monica, can you just call it sex?
It really creeps me out when you call it that.
Okay, and by the way...
...while we're at it, a guy's thing is not called his "tenderness."
Believe me.
Hi. - Hi, Rachel.
Happy Thanksgiving. - You too, sweetheart.
Hey.
Oh. Hi.
Uh, everyone...
...this is Chandler.
My roommate and lead singer of our band. Heh.
Ross?
Oh. This is Monica.
Hi, I'm Ross' little sister.
Okay.
I'm so glad you could come, Chandler.
We've got plenty of food, so I hope you're hungry.
Oh, Mom, no, no, Chandler hates Thanksgiving...
...and doesn't eat any Thanksgiving food.
Oh. Well, I'm so glad you brought him here, then.
Hey, Chandler, um...
If you want, I can make you some macaroni and cheese for dinner.
As long as the Pilgrims didn't eat it, then I'm in.
Damn it.
So, uh, Rach...
Does it...? Does it feel weird around here now?
You know, since I've been away at college?
Oh.
No, not really.
That's cool.
So...
Ugh! I cannot believe Chip dumped me for that slut, Nancy Branson.
I am never going out with him again.
I don't care how much he begs.
I think his begging days are over, now that he's with Nancy Branson.
You know what? I've just had it with high-school boys.
They're just silly.
They're just silly, stupid boys.
I'm gonna start dating men.
Uh, I'm sorry, Judy.
I couldn't find that bowl you and Jack were looking for.
Call them Mom and Dad, you loser.
Monica.
Hey, Chandler?
Did you like the macaroni and cheese?
Oh, yeah. It was great. You should be a chef.
Okay.
Guess what.
All this stuff about Nancy Branson being a slut was all a rumor.
Chip dumped her, and he wants to come over to my house tonight.
Oh, that is so great. - I know.
Oh, gosh. Listen, if you and Chip do it tonight...
...um, promise me you'll tell me everything?
Oh, totally, totally. It's not that big a deal. We already kind of did it once, you know.
I know, but this time you're gonna definitely know whether or not you did it.
I know.
Oh, and Chip promised that this time it would last at least for an entire song.
So I'm thinking of asking Rachel out tonight.
You know, maybe playing her that song we wrote last week.
"Emotional Knapsack"? Right on. - Right on.
Oh, uh, but don't take long, okay? Because we're testing our fake ID's tonight.
Right, Clifford Alvarez?
Listen, Roland Cheng...
...if things go well, I may be out with her all night.
Dude, don't do that to me.
Oh, no. It's cool, you can stay here. My parents won't mind.
It's not that. I don't wanna be stuck here all night with your fat sister.
Hey.
Monica, why don't you finish off these pies?
I don't have any more room in the fridge.
No.
No, thank you.
Well, Judy, you did it.
She's finally full.
I called you fat?
I don't even remember that. - Well, I do.
I'm so sorry. I really am. But, come on, I was an idiot back then.
I rushed the stage at a Wham! Concert, for crying out loud.
Oh, I can't believe you called her fat.
I can't believe you let George Michael slap you.
I am really sorry.
That is so terrible. I'm so, so sorry.
Actually, that's not the Thanksgiving I was talking about.
Yes, it was. - No, it wasn't. It was actually...
Thanksgiving's over. Get ready for Christmas.
Who wants to get a Christmas tree?
Oh, no. I have the cutest Christmas story.
We wanna hear Monica's Thanksgiving story.
Fine, all right. Mine had a dwarf that got broke in half.
But, you know, whatever.
So, Rachel, your mom tells me you changed your major again?
Oh, yeah, I had to.
There was never any parking by the Psychology building.
Hi, Rachel. - Oh, hi.
Wow. Love your new nose. - Jack.
What? Dr. Wolfson's an artist.
He removed my mole cluster.
Want to see?
No, God. Please, let me.
Hey. - Hey.
Happy Thanksgiving. - Hi.
God, your hair sure is different.
Yeah, we were just talking about that.
Can't we can't believe how stupid we used to look.
So, uh, where's Monica?
She's upstairs. Monica.
Come down, everyone's here.
Ross, Rachel and the boy who hates Thanksgiving.
Hi, Chandler.
Oh, my God.
What's the matter?
Is there something on my dress?
You just... You look so different. Terrific.
That dress, that body...
Dude. - Sorry.
Yes, yes, Monica is thin. It's wonderful.
But what we really want to hear about is Ross' new girlfriend.
Oh, Mom... Okay.
Um, ahem, her name is Carol...
...and she's really pretty and smart.
And, uh, she's on the lacrosse team and the golf team.
Can you believe it?
She plays for both teams.
So, Chandler, I guess I'll see you at dinner.
Dude. - Sorry.
Oh, my God.
That was so awesome.
You totally got him back for calling you fat.
He was just drooling all over you.
That must have felt so great. - Well, it didn't.
What?
Yeah, I mean, I look great.
And yeah, I feel great, and, yeah, my heart's not in trouble anymore.
Blah, blah, blah.
I just don't feel like I got him back, you know?
I mean, I just want to humiliate him.
I want him to be, like, naked...
...and I want to point at him and I wanna laugh.
Okay. That, we may be able to do.
How?
Well, guys tend to get naked before they're gonna have sex.
What? I mean, I didn't work this hard and lose all this weight...
...just so I could give my flower to someone like him.
Okay, first of all, if you keep calling it that, no one is ever gonna take it.
And then second of all, you're not gonna actually have sex with him.
You're just gonna make him think that you are.
Yeah. - Yeah.
And then when he's naked...
...I can throw him out, lock the door...
...and all our neighbors will just humiliate him.
And then you will definitely get him back.
Okay, so how do I make him think I want to have sex?
Uh, Oh! Here's what you do.
Just act like everything around you turns you on.
What do you mean? - Well, like, anything can be sexy.
Like, um... Oh, okay. Like this dish towel.
Ooh, ooh.
This feels so good against my cheek.
And if I get a little hot, I can just dab myself with it.
Or I can bring it down to my side and maybe run it through my fingers...
...while I talk to him.
I can do that. - Okay, good, good, good.
Get busy. He's coming. He's coming.
Hey, what's up? - Hey.
I was wondering if you could make me some mac and cheese...
...like last year?
I'd love to.
Ooh.
I love macaroni and cheese.
I love the way this box feels against my cheek.
Okay. - Ooh, and I love carrots.
Oh!
Sometimes I like to put them between my fingers.
Like this.
And hold them down here while I talk to you.
Um, and, you know, if I get really hot...
...um, I like to pick up this knife.
And, um, I put the cool steel...
...against, um...
...my body.
Are you all right?
I'm fine.
What do got? - Twenty-year-old male.
He's got a severed toe on his right foot.
Ow!
Could you please not do that feet first?
You know where his injury is. Severed toe, you just said it!
It says here the knife went right through your shoe.
Of course it did. They're made of wicker.
Did you bring the toe? - Oh, yes.
I have it right here on ice.
Don't worry, son. We'll just reattach it and then...
What is it? - You brought a carrot.
What? - This isn't your toe.
This is a small, very cold piece of carrot.
You brought a carrot?
Oh, my God.
There's a toe in my kitchen.
God, I'm sorry. I'll go back and get it.
It's too late. All we can do is sew up the wound.
Without my toe? I need my toe. - Okay.
No, no, no. I can go really fast. Dad, give me the keys to your Porsche.
Oh, I'm not falling for that one.
That's why I lost my toe? Because I called you fat?
I didn't mean to cut it off. It was an accident.
That's why for an entire year people called me Sir Limps-a-lot?
I'm sorry.
It wasn't your whole toe.
Yeah, well, I miss the tip.
It's the best part.
It has the nail.
Chandler...
Sir Limps-a-lot.
I came up with that.
You're a dork.
I can't believe this. - Chandler, I said I was sorry.
Yeah, well, "sorry" doesn't bring back the little piggy that cried all the way home.
I hate this stupid day and everything about it.
I'll see you later. - Wait, Chandler.
Come here.
Is there anything I can do? Anything?
Yeah, just leave me alone for a little while.
Oh, I'm a duck. I go quack-quack. I'm happy all the time.
Nice try.
Wait, wait, wait.
Look, Monica... - Look.
This is not gonna work.
I bet this will work.
You're so great. I love you.
What?
Nothing. I said you're so great, and then I just stopped talking.
You said you loved me. I can't believe this.
No, I didn't.
Yes, you did. - No, I didn't.
You love me.
No, I don't. Stop it, stop it, stop it.
Gauze!
Gauze! I need to get some gauze in here!
Can I please get some more gauze?
This is getting ridiculous.

sense_groups.english: Huh. I don't know what to pick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我更感谢为我的离婚 还是我驱逐？
sense_groups.english: Am I more thankful for my divorce, or my eviction? Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 我还以为你会没得谢
sense_groups.english: Wow, see, and I didn't think you'd be able to come up with anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 这是最惨的一次感恩节
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's just this is the worst Thanksgiving ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我才是悲惨感恩节盟主
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I am the king of bad Thanksgivings.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能挟失败的婚姻空降…
sense_groups.english: You can't just swoop in here with your bad marriage...

sense_groups.chinese: 抢了我的宝座
sense_groups.english: ...and take that away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又要说…
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna tell the whole story...

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸妈离婚的事了？
sense_groups.english: ...about how your parents got divorced, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样嘛
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 我想听
sense_groups.english: Come on. I want to hear it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有钱德扫兴就不算感恩节了
sense_groups.english: It wouldn't be Thanksgiving without Chandler bumming us out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这跟游行一样是一项传统
sense_groups.english: It's a tradition, like the parade.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果游行也出轨离家 抛妻弃子的话
sense_groups.english: If the parade decided it was gay, moved out and abandoned its entire family.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Now, Chandler, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸和我要离婚
sense_groups.english: Just because your father and I are getting a divorce...

sense_groups.chinese: 并不代表我们不爱你
sense_groups.english: ...doesn't mean we don't love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是…
sense_groups.english: It just means...

sense_groups.chinese: 代表他上床的对像是男仆 不是我
sense_groups.english: ...he would rather sleep with the houseboy than with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 小少爷还要火鸡吗？
sense_groups.english: More turkey, Mr. Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 你的更惨 你是悲惨感恩节盟主
sense_groups.english: You're right, yours is worse. You are the king of bad Thanksgivings.

sense_groups.chinese: 不一定 我有一次更惨
sense_groups.english: I don't know about that. I've got one that's worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？惨过…
sense_groups.english: Really? Worse than

sense_groups.chinese: "小少爷还要火鸡"吗？
sense_groups.english: "More turkey, Mr. Chandler?"

sense_groups.chinese: 小少爷跟仆人有仇吗？
sense_groups.english: Did the little rich boy had a problem with the butler?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我的更惨
sense_groups.english: Yes, mine's worse.

sense_groups.chinese: (1862年感恩节)
sense_groups.english: [GUNFIRE AND BOMBS EXPLODING]

sense_groups.chinese: 还要绷带 还要绷带
sense_groups.english: More bandages! More bandages!

sense_groups.chinese: 快 能在给我一些绷带吗？
sense_groups.english: Please, can I get some more bandages in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个人快死… 啊
sense_groups.english: This man is... Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 今生的才算
sense_groups.english: In this life, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 今生是吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, this life.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是的 不 那钱德的比较惨
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. No, Chandler's is worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得前世的事一定很酷
sense_groups.english: Man, it must be so cool remembering stuff like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都没有前世的记忆
sense_groups.english: I don't have any past life memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然没有 你是新生命
sense_groups.english: Of course, you don't, sweetie. You're brand-new.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道摩妮卡最惨的感恩节
sense_groups.english: I know Monica's worst Thanksgiving.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个就别提了 - 说嘛
sense_groups.english: Oh, let's not tell this story. - Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 不 我知道 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, no! I know! I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 就是摩妮卡的火鸡 卡在乔伊头上那次
sense_groups.english: It's the one where Joey got Monica's turkey stuck on his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊头上卡了只火鸡？
sense_groups.english: Joey got a turkey stuck on his head?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实不是那样
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's not like it sounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实就是那样
sense_groups.english: It's exactly like it sounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? - Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 它卡住了
sense_groups.english: It's stuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心台阶 它怎么会跑到你头上？
sense_groups.english: Step. How did it get on?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我套上去想吓钱德
sense_groups.english: I put it on to scare Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 摩妮卡一定会气死
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Monica's going to totally freak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就赶快帮我拿下来
sense_groups.english: Well, then help me get it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且这里面好臭
sense_groups.english: Plus, it smells really bad in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然很臭 你的头塞在动物尸体的屁股里
sense_groups.english: Of course it smells really bad. You have your head up a dead animal.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你替火鸡涂… 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Hey, did you get the turkey...? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊啦
sense_groups.english: It's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？你是在搞笑吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? Is this supposed to be funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是搞笑 是吓人
sense_groups.english: No, it's not supposed to be funny. It's supposed to be scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 马上给我拿掉
sense_groups.english: Get that off now.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿不掉 卡住了
sense_groups.english: I can't. It's stuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 我爸妈的20个客人
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't care. That turkey has to feed 20 people.

sense_groups.chinese: 可不能就着你的头吃
sense_groups.english: They're not going to eat it off your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 先别急 大家一起想办法
sense_groups.english: Hold on, okay? Let's just all think.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我知道了 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Okay, I got it. Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你扛
sense_groups.english: All right. You pull.

sense_groups.chinese: 我尽量把腿撑开
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna spread the legs as wide as I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 现在不要闹 - 对不起 好吧 对不起
sense_groups.english: Joey, now is not the time. - Yeah. Sorry. Right, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 数到一 二
sense_groups.english: Okay, count to three. One, two...

sense_groups.chinese: 三
sense_groups.english: ...three.

sense_groups.chinese: 成功了 我吓到你了
sense_groups.english: It worked. I scared you. I knew it. Ha, ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 大哥 我在这里 - 是 你在那儿 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: I'm over here, big guy. - Yeah, you are. Ha, ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 我吓到你了
sense_groups.english: I scared you. Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来真的很白痴
sense_groups.english: You did look like an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 白痴的不只是我
sense_groups.english: Hey, I wasn't the only one who looked like an idiot, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯有一次想说"冬南瓜"
sense_groups.english: Remember when Ross tried to say "butternut squash"...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果讲成"南冬瓜"
sense_groups.english: ...and it came out, "squatternut bosh"?

sense_groups.chinese: 的确一样白痴
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我最惨的感恩节
sense_groups.english: That's it. That's my worst Thanksgiving.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 瑞秋说的不可能是那次
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. That can't be the one that Rachel was talking about...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她根本不知道那件事
sense_groups.english: ...because she didn't even know that that happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以是哪次？ - 哪次？
sense_groups.english: So, what's yours? - What was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不想提这件事
sense_groups.english: Um, I really don't wanna tell this story.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 讲嘛 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 重温悲惨的回忆 是感恩节的精神
sense_groups.english: Reliving past pain and getting depressed is what Thanksgiving's all about.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我觉得是 还有原住民的帮忙
sense_groups.english: You know, for me, anyway. And, of course, the Indians.

sense_groups.chinese: 最不希望我提的绝对是你
sense_groups.english: Look, of all people, you do not want me to tell this story.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What is that supposed to mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 应该是瑞秋来了
sense_groups.english: Monica, I think Rachel's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来开
sense_groups.english: I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节快乐 - 我不快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy Thanksgiving. - Not for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普和我分手了
sense_groups.english: Chip and I broke up.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Well, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈不是要出门 奇普不是要来…
sense_groups.english: You know how my parents are out of town, and Chip was gonna come over?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 对 你要给他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. And you were gonna give him, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的花芯
sense_groups.english: ...your "flower."

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你能不能直接说做爱？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Monica, can you just call it sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 你那样讲让我浑身发毛
sense_groups.english: It really creeps me out when you call it that.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 在做的时候
sense_groups.english: Okay, and by the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 男人的那里不叫他的温柔
sense_groups.english: ...while we're at it, a guy's thing is not called his "tenderness."

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我
sense_groups.english: Believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节快乐 - 你也是
sense_groups.english: Happy Thanksgiving. - You too, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位
sense_groups.english: Uh, everyone...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是钱德
sense_groups.english: ...this is Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的室友兼我们乐团的主唱 呵
sense_groups.english: My roommate and lead singer of our band. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 这是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh. This is Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是罗斯的妹妹
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Ross' little sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎你来 钱德
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you could come, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这儿有很多吃的 希望你饿了
sense_groups.english: We've got plenty of food, so I hope you're hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 妈 不不 钱德痛恨感恩节
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mom, no, no, Chandler hates Thanksgiving...

sense_groups.chinese: 他不吃感恩节食物
sense_groups.english: ...and doesn't eat any Thanksgiving food.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还真是欢迎啊
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I'm so glad you brought him here, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 额…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮你煮起司通心面
sense_groups.english: If you want, I can make you some macaroni and cheese for dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要当年的清教徒没吃我就吃
sense_groups.english: As long as the Pilgrims didn't eat it, then I'm in.

sense_groups.chinese: 讨厌
sense_groups.english: Damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Rach...

sense_groups.chinese: 我去上大学不在？
sense_groups.english: Does it...? Does it feel weird around here now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会不会觉得怪怪的？
sense_groups.english: You know, since I've been away at college?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒不会
sense_groups.english: No, not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就好
sense_groups.english: That's cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普居然为了那个花痴南西 而甩了我
sense_groups.english: Ugh! I cannot believe Chip dumped me for that slut, Nancy Branson.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再也不跟他约会了
sense_groups.english: I am never going out with him again.

sense_groups.chinese: 他再怎么求我也没用
sense_groups.english: I don't care how much he begs.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有了南西 应该不会求你了
sense_groups.english: I think his begging days are over, now that he's with Nancy Branson.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我受够高中男生了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I've just had it with high-school boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们全是些愚蠢的
sense_groups.english: They're just silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 又笨又呆的小毛头
sense_groups.english: They're just silly, stupid boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要开始跟男人交柱
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna start dating men.

sense_groups.chinese: 茱蒂 对不起
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'm sorry, Judy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找不到你和杰克要的碗公
sense_groups.english: I couldn't find that bowl you and Jack were looking for.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫爸爸妈妈吧 俗辣
sense_groups.english: Call them Mom and Dad, you loser.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 起司通心面好吃吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you like the macaroni and cheese?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好吃 你应该去当厨师
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. It was great. You should be a chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎样？
sense_groups.english: Guess what.

sense_groups.chinese: 南西很花痴的传闻都是假的
sense_groups.english: All this stuff about Nancy Branson being a slut was all a rumor.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以奇普甩了她 他今天晚上想来找我
sense_groups.english: Chip dumped her, and he wants to come over to my house tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, that is so great. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 要是你和奇普晚上做了
sense_groups.english: Oh, gosh. Listen, if you and Chip do it tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会把细节都告诉我的？
sense_groups.english: ...um, promise me you'll tell me everything?

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然 其实也没什么 我们应该有做过一次
sense_groups.english: Oh, totally, totally. It's not that big a deal. We already kind of did it once, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但这回你定能确定
sense_groups.english: I know, but this time you're gonna definitely know whether or not you did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇普还保证 这次会持续一整首歌的长度
sense_groups.english: Oh, and Chip promised that this time it would last at least for an entire song.

sense_groups.chinese: 我晚上打算约瑞秋出去
sense_groups.english: So I'm thinking of asking Rachel out tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 弹我们上周写的那首歌给她听
sense_groups.english: You know, maybe playing her that song we wrote last week.

sense_groups.chinese: 《忧愁的背包》对吗 - 对的
sense_groups.english: "Emotional Knapsack"? Right on. - Right on.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过不要拖太久 好吗？我们还要去试用假身份证
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, but don't take long, okay? Because we're testing our fake ID's tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 克里夫艾维瑞兹？
sense_groups.english: Right, Clifford Alvarez?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 罗兰陈
sense_groups.english: Listen, Roland Cheng...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果一切顺利 我们搞不好不会回来
sense_groups.english: ...if things go well, I may be out with her all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 别丢下我
sense_groups.english: Dude, don't do that to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你可以留下来 我爸妈不会介意
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. It's cool, you can stay here. My parents won't mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我不想整晚 跟你的肥猪妹妹在一起
sense_groups.english: It's not that. I don't wanna be stuck here all night with your fat sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 为什么不把这些派吃完？
sense_groups.english: Monica, why don't you finish off these pies?

sense_groups.chinese: 冰箱塞不下了
sense_groups.english: I don't have any more room in the fridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 不了
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 茱蒂 你感功了
sense_groups.english: Well, Judy, you did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她终于吃不下了
sense_groups.english: She's finally full.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说你肥？
sense_groups.english: I called you fat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全不记得 - 我可记得
sense_groups.english: I don't even remember that. - Well, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 真的 我那时候很愚蠢
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. I really am. But, come on, I was an idiot back then.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在"轰"的演唱会上 冲上台大叫
sense_groups.english: I rushed the stage at a Wham! Concert, for crying out loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然说她肥
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't believe you called her fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然让乔治麦可赏你耳光
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you let George Michael slap you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I am really sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太差劲了 真是对不起
sense_groups.english: That is so terrible. I'm so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我说的不是那次感恩节
sense_groups.english: Actually, that's not the Thanksgiving I was talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 就是 - 不是 我说的是…
sense_groups.english: Yes, it was. - No, it wasn't. It was actually...

sense_groups.chinese: 威恩节结束 准备过圣诞节吧
sense_groups.english: Thanksgiving's over. Get ready for Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要去买圣诞树？
sense_groups.english: Who wants to get a Christmas tree?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有最可爱的圣诞节故事
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I have the cutest Christmas story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想听摩妮卡的感恩节故事
sense_groups.english: We wanna hear Monica's Thanksgiving story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的故事里有小矮人断成两截
sense_groups.english: Fine, all right. Mine had a dwarf that got broke in half.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过 你知道的 随便
sense_groups.english: But, you know, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: (1988年感恩节)瑞秋 你妈说你又转系了
sense_groups.english: So, Rachel, your mom tells me you changed your major again?

sense_groups.chinese: 没办法
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I had to.

sense_groups.chinese: 心理系馆旁边很难停车
sense_groups.english: There was never any parking by the Psychology building.

Ross?

...refusal to meet deadlines.

Yeah.

A sandwich?

Ha-ha-ha. Oh, you know what?
I'm sorry.

You ate my sandwich?

No, I...

That said it was...
...my sandwich!
Now calm down.
Look in my office. Some may be in the trash.
What?

You threw my sandwich away?
My sandwich?
Hi. - Hi.
What's this book about?
You didn't read it, either?
I was going to, but I, uh, accidentally read something else.
What? - Vogue.

No, read it yourself.
Come on, don't be such a goody-goody.
Fine.
All right. So Jane Eyre?

She's a cyborg.
A cyborg? Isn't that like a robot?

Sorry I'm late. Let's get started.

Um, Rachel and I were discussing it, and she had very interesting insights.
Go ahead, Rachel.
Um, thank you, Phoebe.
What struck me most when reading Jane Eyre...
...was, uh, how the book was so ahead of its time.
If you're talking about feminism, I think you're right.
Well, feminism, yes. But also the robots.
Hey. - Hey.

...I thought that I would give you just a little preview.
You're naked!
I know!
Ross?
Hey, Chandler.
Monica!
Are you okay?
I'm fine.

Why?
On account of my rage.
Which, if I may say, right now is out of control.
He gave me a pill for it.
A pill?

...because I yelled at my boss, I started to get worked up again.
So he offered me a tranquilizer.
And I thought it was a good idea.
So I took it.
They're making you take time off work?
And you're okay with that?
I don't know.
It's going to be weird not having a job for a while.
But I definitely don't care about my sandwich.
It's so embarrassing! I can't believe you let me go on like that!
I'm sorry.
It was so funny when you compared Jane Eyre to Robocop.
That was not funny!

Come on! What is the big deal?

I thought it would be fun.
Fun is good.

Oh.

You know, Pheebs, I just wanted to have fun.

Monica.

Yes, it's true.

Uh... Oh!

Uh, Monica?

Huh?
All right.

I'm only eating the skin, so the chicken's up for grabs.

Test?
