sense_groups.chinese: 还有人叫我"疯子"
sense_groups.english: A guy called me "Mental."

sense_groups.chinese: "疯子盖勒"
sense_groups.english: "Mental Geller."

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直梦想有这种超酷的外号
sense_groups.english: I've always wanted a cool nickname like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前你最酷的外号 就是"尿裤子盖勒"
sense_groups.english: The best you got in high school was, uh, "Wet Pants Geller."

sense_groups.chinese: 那是饮水机喷到的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: It was the water fountain, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正…
sense_groups.english: Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在有人愿意帮我写报告…
sense_groups.english: ...people are writing reports for me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱什么时候交就什么时候交
sense_groups.english: ...uh, pushing back deadlines to fit my schedule.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来对人耍狠就可以呼风唤雨
sense_groups.english: I tell you, you get tough with people...

sense_groups.chinese: 和你得到你想要的任何东西
sense_groups.english: ...and you can get anything you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼 咖啡拿来
sense_groups.english: Hey, Tribbiani! Give me that coffee! Now!

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真有意思
sense_groups.english: This was really fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来还怀疑你会不会约我
sense_groups.english: I've been wondering if you'd ask me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在怀疑吗？
sense_groups.english: So you, uh, still wondering?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们刚刚才约过会啊
sense_groups.english: No. We just went out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真聪明
sense_groups.english: You're smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: I like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有蜡烛啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, candles!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？毯子？
sense_groups.english: What is that, a blanket?

sense_groups.chinese: 摄影机？我的天啊
sense_groups.english: A video camera? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是这样… 等等啊
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你竟然在第一次约会 就想拍下我们上床过程
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you thought you'd tape us having sex on the first date!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 她刚说的…
sense_groups.english: Joey, is what she just said, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还真打算…
sense_groups.english: You're actually going...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What is going on here?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且钱德还在家 你是… 变态吗？
sense_groups.english: And with Chandler in the next room. What are you, sick?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊啊
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来就很恶心
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm disgusting.

sense_groups.chinese: 还拍低成本的色情片
sense_groups.english: I make low-budget adult films.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们答应我要更小心的
sense_groups.english: You promised to be more careful!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的好名声都给你们毁了
sense_groups.english: The good Joey name's been dragged through the mud!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 抱歉
sense_groups.english: We're so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把你们的事情说出去
sense_groups.english: I'm telling everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则内裤跟摄影机的事情 只会让人觉得我是变态猪猡
sense_groups.english: It's the only explanation that doesn't make me look like a pig!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 一定有其他方法
sense_groups.english: No, there's a better explanation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以说你在拍色情片 因为你在…
sense_groups.english: Tell them you had to make an adult film for your...

sense_groups.chinese: 上色情片的课
sense_groups.english: ...adult film class.

sense_groups.chinese: 这理由还不错 但是不行
sense_groups.english: I like that. But no!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋在你家 发现我内裤的事又怎么说？
sense_groups.english: How does that explain my underwear at your place?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来你们得出来承认了
sense_groups.english: Get ready to come out of the non-gay closet.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你等等 我保证一定会想出理由
sense_groups.english: I promise to come up with something. Just give us time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好让我保住面子
sense_groups.english: But it better make me look really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有…
sense_groups.english: And another thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 摄影机？
sense_groups.english: The video camera?

sense_groups.chinese: 了不起
sense_groups.english: Nice!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以跟你谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: May I have a word?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 唐诺
sense_groups.english: Of course, Donald.

sense_groups.chinese: 有同事抱怨你最近脾气火爆
sense_groups.english: We've been getting reports of very angry behavior on your part.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 恐吓信
sense_groups.english: What? - Threatening letters...

sense_groups.chinese: 写信威胁大家 拒绝按时交报告
sense_groups.english: ...refusal to meet deadlines.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有人叫你是"疯子"
sense_groups.english: Apparently people now call you Mental.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们希望你找精神科医生谈谈
sense_groups.english: We want you to speak to a psychiatrist.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Uh, you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不懂 其实是误会
sense_groups.english: You don't understand. This is so silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切要从我的三明治说起
sense_groups.english: Um, this is all just because of a sandwich.

sense_groups.chinese: 三明治？
sense_groups.english: A sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 我妹妹非常会做火鸡三明治
sense_groups.english: You see, my sister makes these amazing turkey sandwiches.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的秘诀就是 多夹一片浸过肉汁的面包在中问
sense_groups.english: Her secret is, she puts an extra slice of gravy-soaked bread in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 我称那片为"多汁秘方"
sense_groups.english: I call it "The Moistmaker."

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次我把三明治放在冰箱
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I put my sandwich in the fridge...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？什么？
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. Oh, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是我吃掉了
sense_groups.english: I believe I ate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你吃了我的三明治？
sense_groups.english: You ate my sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一时看错 谁都可能拿错
sense_groups.english: A simple mistake. It can happen to anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 难道你的三明治 也有"多汁秘方"？
sense_groups.english: Did you confuse it with your own turkey sandwich with a Moistmaker?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我…
sense_groups.english: No, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 你也许还记得
sense_groups.english: Do you, perhaps, remember...

sense_groups.chinese: 那字条上写的是什么？
sense_groups.english: ...seeing a note on top of it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为那是有人开玩笑或是随手写的打油诗
sense_groups.english: There may have been a joke or limerick of some kind.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面清楚写着…
sense_groups.english: That said it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的三明治
sense_groups.english: ...my sandwich!

sense_groups.chinese: 你别激动
sense_groups.english: Now calm down.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以到我办公室找找 可能垃圾筒里还有剩
sense_groups.english: Look in my office. Some may be in the trash.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个三明治很大 我必须丢掉一大半
sense_groups.english: It was quite large. I had to throw most of it away.

sense_groups.chinese: 你丢掉我的三明治
sense_groups.english: You threw my sandwich away?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的三明治
sense_groups.english: My sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书在讲什么？
sense_groups.english: What's this book about?

sense_groups.chinese: 你这本也没看？
sense_groups.english: You didn't read it, either?

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来要看 结果看了别本书
sense_groups.english: I was going to, but I, uh, accidentally read something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 《时尚杂志》
sense_groups.english: What? - Vogue.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我说 这本《简爱》是在说什么？
sense_groups.english: So tell me about Jane Eyre.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你应该自己看
sense_groups.english: No, read it yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别这么假正经嘛
sense_groups.english: Come on, don't be such a goody-goody.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那么简爱呢？
sense_groups.english: All right. So Jane Eyre?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会以为她是女人 其实她不是
sense_groups.english: First you'd think she's a woman, but she's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是生化人
sense_groups.english: She's a cyborg.

sense_groups.chinese: 生化人？就是机器人？
sense_groups.english: A cyborg? Isn't that like a robot?

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书在当时超级先进
sense_groups.english: This book was light years ahead of its time.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉迟到 开始上课吧
sense_groups.english: Sorry I'm late. Let's get started.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家对《简爱》有何感想？
sense_groups.english: What did you think of Jane Eyre?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋刚跟我讨论过 她有些看法非常有趣
sense_groups.english: Um, Rachel and I were discussing it, and she had very interesting insights.

sense_groups.chinese: 请说 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Go ahead, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 菲比
sense_groups.english: Um, thank you, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 《简爱》最让我震惊的就是…
sense_groups.english: What struck me most when reading Jane Eyre...

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书非常惊世骇俗
sense_groups.english: ...was, uh, how the book was so ahead of its time.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你指的是女性主义 这么说也成
sense_groups.english: If you're talking about feminism, I think you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有写到女性主义 不过还有机器人
sense_groups.english: Well, feminism, yes. But also the robots.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然上次拍摄不成功
sense_groups.english: Since that video camera thing didn't work out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我先给你一点预告片段
sense_groups.english: ...I thought that I would give you just a little preview.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在照片中没穿衣服
sense_groups.english: You're naked!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天上班去看过精神医生
sense_groups.english: I saw a psychiatrist at work today.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我脾气太暴躁
sense_groups.english: On account of my rage.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且最近越来越严重
sense_groups.english: Which, if I may say, right now is out of control.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他开药丸给我
sense_groups.english: He gave me a pill for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 药丸？
sense_groups.english: A pill?

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说我对上司大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. When the psychiatrist told me to take a leave of absence...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以应该请假 我又开始暴跳如雷
sense_groups.english: ...because I yelled at my boss, I started to get worked up again.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他要我吃颗镇定剂
sense_groups.english: So he offered me a tranquilizer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这主意不错
sense_groups.english: And I thought it was a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以就吃了
sense_groups.english: So I took it.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 他们逼你请假？
sense_groups.english: They're making you take time off work?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且你也同意？
sense_groups.english: And you're okay with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不晓得
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚开始不工作可能不习惯
sense_groups.english: It's going to be weird not having a job for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我已经不在乎三明治了
sense_groups.english: But I definitely don't care about my sandwich.

sense_groups.chinese: 我丢脸丢大了 你竟然还让我一直说下去
sense_groups.english: It's so embarrassing! I can't believe you let me go on like that!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把简爱比成机器战警 实在太爆笑了
sense_groups.english: It was so funny when you compared Jane Eyre to Robocop.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不好笑
sense_groups.english: That was not funny!

sense_groups.chinese: 我太气了好吗？你根本不想好好上课
sense_groups.english: I snapped, okay? You weren't taking the class seriously.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这有什么了不起？
sense_groups.english: Come on! What is the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我们就是一起出去上课打发时间闹着玩
sense_groups.english: I thought it'd be something we could do together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为它会很有趣
sense_groups.english: I thought it would be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 好玩很重要
sense_groups.english: Fun is good.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我也想学点东西
sense_groups.english: But I also wanted to learn.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家老说在高中学东学西 我却没上过高中
sense_groups.english: People talk about what they learned in high school. I never went.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你真的想学东西
sense_groups.english: So you really wanted to learn.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 菲比 我只想找点乐子
sense_groups.english: You know, Pheebs, I just wanted to have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你该拉谁去吗？
sense_groups.english: You know who should go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道…
sense_groups.english: I know! I know! I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 问题是你提的
sense_groups.english: Monica, you asked the question.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, that's Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是这样… 你别误会
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 离我远点 你这个大变态
sense_groups.english: You get away from me, you sick, sick, sicko!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么啦？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊有偷窥癖
sense_groups.english: Joey has got a secret peephole!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他有摩妮卡的裸体照片
sense_groups.english: He has a naked picture of Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 他拍下我们裸体的样子 还一边吃鸡块一边看
sense_groups.english: He takes naked pictures of us, then he eats chicken and looks at them!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 - 那是我老妹耶
sense_groups.english: Look. - Oh! Dude, that's my sister!

sense_groups.chinese: 给我
sense_groups.english: Give me that!

sense_groups.chinese: 等下 大家先别激动 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Wait! Everybody calm down, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 要给我们的老友乔伊 有机会解释他为何如此变态
sense_groups.english: Let's give our friend a chance to explain why he's such a big pervert!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是变态好吗？
sense_groups.english: I am not a pervert, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是…
sense_groups.english: It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I just kind of...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮他解释
sense_groups.english: I think I can explain this.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊是性爱狂
sense_groups.english: Joey's a sex addict.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？才怪
sense_groups.english: What? No, I'm not!

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 不怪你
sense_groups.english: It's okay! It's good!

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是一种病
sense_groups.english: It's a disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 胡说 我才不是性爱狂
sense_groups.english: I am not a sex addict!

sense_groups.chinese: 你明明就是
sense_groups.english: Yes, you are!

sense_groups.chinese: 这才能解释最近这一连串的事
sense_groups.english: That's the only way to explain all this stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 事实不是这样
sense_groups.english: No, it isn't. It's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也可以说出真相
sense_groups.english: Because you could also explain it with the truth!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么真相？
sense_groups.english: What is the truth?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 你在说什么？
sense_groups.english: What's up? - What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟摩妮卡上床了
sense_groups.english: I slept with Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 听听大家怎么说？
sense_groups.english: Well, let's see what everybody thinks of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟我老妹上床？
sense_groups.english: You slept with my sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 额 对 但是只是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, yes, but it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在伦敦发生过一次
sense_groups.english: We just did it once, uh, in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 这会让我开始抓狂
sense_groups.english: This is not good for my rage.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Is this true?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是真的
sense_groups.english: Of course, it's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则怎么解释这些怪事？
sense_groups.english: How else would you explain all the weird stuff that's been going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的
sense_groups.english: Yes, it's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果只发生过一次 你的内裤怎么会出现在我们家？
sense_groups.english: If it happened once, how come we found your underwear in our apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 额… 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh... Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那件内裤是我当天在伦敦穿的
sense_groups.english: That was the underwear I was wearing that night in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不对 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Right, Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想留下来…
sense_groups.english: I guess I wanted to keep it...

sense_groups.chinese: 当纪念品
sense_groups.english: ...as a souvenir.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: My God, Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定乔伊？你确定你不是性爱狂？
sense_groups.english: Are you sure you're not just a sex addict?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 要是有人是性爱狂 那也是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: If anyone's a sex addict here, it's Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 打从我们自伦敦回来 她就想再勾引我上床
sense_groups.english: She has been trying to get me back in the sack ever since London!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以她才拍裸照给你
sense_groups.english: That's why she gave you a naked picture of herself.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样说得通
sense_groups.english: That makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 录影机呢？
sense_groups.english: And the video camera?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我架好录影机是为了引诱乔伊上钩

What are you doing? - I reorganized the fridge, heh.
See? Uh, bottom shelf, meats and dairy.
Middle shelf, fruits and vegetables.
And top shelf, expired products.
Why are you doing this? - Because I am bored out of my mind.
I've already been to the bank, post office and dry cleaners.
Dude, you just described seven days worth of stuff.
Gotta spread it out a little, you know. Haven't you ever been unemployed?
I am not unemployed. I'm on sabbatical.
Hey, don't get religious on me, okay?
A guy in your position needs to be a little better at relaxing, you know.
Why do you think we have the comfortable chairs, huh? Here, sit down.
Ready? Watch.
Aw!
And then...
Aw, yeah! Huh?
So, what? We just sit? - Oh, no, no.
We're not gonna just sit. Watch.
Shh.
Hello. Chandler Bing.
Hello, Mr. Bing.
I love you.
All right, whoever this is, stop calling me.
It's been six months! It's not funny!
But I love you.
Leave me alone! For the love of God, leave me alone!
And that's Wednesday. Ah!
Hey, you guys. Guess what?
The British are coming?
Oh, you and your ways.
Since it's Christmas, I'm gonna be one of those people collecting donations.
Yeah. I already have my bell, and later on I get my bucket.
Oh.
Yeah, yeah. I'll be spreading joy to the people.
Last year I spread a little joy, but not enough.
So this year, I'm gonna do the whole city. Heh.
I knew a girl in high school who did that. She was very popular.
Uh, so, Pheebs, where are you doing your bell ringing?
They gave me a great spot right by Macy's.
They never give such a good corner to a rookie...
...but I'm the only one who can say "Merry Christmas" in 25 languages.
I lied.
Oh, my God. Okay, you guys, here's Danny.
Just watch this.
See? Still pretending he's not interested.
Okay, he's coming over. Pretend we've forgotten who he is.
Hey, guys. - Hey, Danny.
Oh, Danny! Hey!
Oh, uh...
Danny, you know Rachel. She's nice. She's not bad to look at, right?
Thanks, Mon. - Of course.
Do you wanna go out on a date with her? - Monica.
Absolutely. Is Friday okay?
Oh, my God.
Friday is perfect. She can't wait.
On the date, I will be able to talk to her directly, right?
See you Friday.
Okay, what the hell was that? You know what? Don't answer me.
I have a date with Danny. Ha!
How could I not get the part?
The play was about a 29-year-old Italian actor from Queens.
Well, Talia Shire suddenly became available.
She's a woman!
What can I say? She nailed it.
Uh, okay. Is there anything else?
Well, you're just gonna say no again, but...
...gay porn?
Happy holidays!
SPEAKING IN SPANISH
And Merry Christmas.
Oh, thank you, sir. Here's some joy.
Hey. - How's it going?
Well, it's going okay.
Oh, good. Here, let me help you out. - Oh, thanks.
Yeah. - Wow. Ha, ha.
Is that a new suede jacket? It looks really expensive.
Yeah. I guess.
Just get your nails done?
Yes, Phoebe, but this is all I have, okay?
Okay, thanks. Happy holidays.
Here's your joy. - Thank you.
Thank you. Happy holidays and... Wait.
You can't take the money out. - I'm making change for the bus.
Can't you leave the dollar? This money's for the poor.
I'm poor. I gotta take the bus.
Okay. Seasons greetings and everything. But still...
Bite me, blondie!
Oh!
Oh, I'm gonna give him something besides joy. Just...
That part was perfect for me. I can't believe I didn't get it.
I'm sorry, man.
You know what you should do?
You should make something happen for yourself.
You know, like write a play.
Write a movie, huh? What about those Good Will Hunting guys?
Come on, Ross. Be realistic, you know? If I did write something...
...what are the chances I could get those guys to star in it?
Wait a second. I could star in it! - Or that.
I can't write, you know. I mean, I'm an actor.
I don't have the discipline that it takes, you know. I can't do it.
I'll help you.
Yeah. I'll make up a schedule and make sure you stick to it.
Plus it'll give me something to do.
Really? You'd do that for me? Thanks. - Yeah.
We'll start off slow. The only thing you have to do tonight...
...is come up with the name of your main character.
Done. - And it can't be Joey.
It's not. - Or Joseph.
Oh.
Hi. What's up?
I just saw Danny getting on the subway with a girl...
...and he had his arm around her.
Oh, honey, I'm sorry.
Well, you should be. This is all your fault.
You meddled in our relationship.
You had no relationship.
No, but I was doing my thing, and everything...
...was going according to the plan!
Oh, God. Stop with the plan.
Unh. So what if you saw him with a girl?
Who cares? That doesn't mean anything.
You'll go out on a date with Danny and be so charming he'll forget all about...
...that stupid subway girl.
She was kind of stupid.
You're right. All right. I'm just gonna go on the date.
I'm just gonna go on the date. That is the new plan.
Hurry, hurry!
Mm.
Hey, how do you spell "suspicious"? - Why?
Because I think this character is gonna be suspicious about stuff.
Yes!
Chandler Bing, seven, Chandler Bing, zero.
You're driving me crazy with that.
Okay, I'll stop. - No, don't stop.
Move the bowl further away. Ross could make that shot.
Well, you suck. But at least you suck at a man's game now.
You wanna play? - I can't be playing games.
Ross will be home soon. I have to write five pages to stick to his schedule.
Well, so play for the next 30 minutes, then you can write until he gets home.
All right.
But, listen, what do you say we, uh...
...crank it up a notch?
I'm intrigued.
All right. All we need is a little lighter fluid.
Okay, but be careful. I wanna get our security deposit back.
Yeah, I think we said goodbye to that when we invented hammer darts.
Do you remember which part of the wall is not spackle?
Uh, yeah, right here.
Thank you. Happy holiday.
No, that's trash, young lady. No, you can't...
Hey. Stop that young lady! She donated trash!
Hey.
The charity's on fire!
Help! Good, thank you. I need that.
Whoo!
What is this? It's 9:00 in the morning.
All right. "A room.
A man enters. He looks suspicious."
That's it?
Joey, you were supposed to have five pages done by now...
...including an exciting incident.
What is all this? "The Official Rulebook of Fireball."
Yeah, that's the game we played.
Yeah, it's great. You take a tennis ball, a bowl and lighter fl...
Oh, oh.

Not the creator of Crazy Lawsuit Game.
You're right, you're right. I'll get back to work.
And shame on you. You should know better. Joey needs to work.
Now come on. - Hey.
No, uh-uh. You can have this back when the five pages are done, huh?
I had a really nice time tonight. - So did I.
I'm really glad Monica asked us out.
I'd love to ask you in but my sister's visiting.
I think she's asleep on the couch. - Your sister?
Your sister's asleep on the couch?
Ah, I saw you with her on the subway and now she's asleep on the couch.
Oh, God!
Oh, I thought I heard you. - Oh, hey, great, you're up.
Rachel, my sister Krista. Krista, Rachel.
Hi. - Nice to meet you.
Wish you told me we were having company. I'd have fixed myself.
Like it would help. - You are so bad.
You are. - You are.
You are. You are. - You are. You are!
You are so dead. - Ha.
I'm gonna get you. Come here. - Aah!
Come here. Come here! - Ha-ha-ha!
Um, it's very nice to meet you.
Nobody. Nobody respects the bucket.
You wouldn't believe what people put in here.
Look. Okay, does this look like...
...a garbage can to you? - No.
Does it look like an ashtray? - No.
Does it look like a urinal?
Ew!
So, Pheebs, you gonna go back out there? - Yeah, but I'm not gonna take any more crap.
Okay? No more Mrs. Nice Bucket.
Yeah, good for you. You're tough. You lived on the street.
Yeah, I'm gonna go back to being Street Phoebe.
Yeah. Oh, but you know what? I can't go totally back...
...because Street Phoebe really wouldn't be friends with you guys.
Hey. - Hey.
Um, can I ask you guys something? - Sure.
Um, I don't have any brothers so I don't know, but did you guys wrestle?
Oh, yeah. - All the time.
In fact, I was undefeated.
Well, you weighed 200 pounds.
Still, I was quick as a cat.
Well, I met Danny's sister yesterday.
Uh, that was the girl on the subway. - Oh, you're kidding.
And they were very, you know...
...wrestle-y.
But I guess that's normal?
We don't wrestle now.
Not since I got too strong for you. Ha, ha.
Too strong for me? - Yeah.
You wanna go right now?
Because I'll take you right now, buddy. You wanna go?
Oh, fine.
Ready?
Wrestle!
Okay, you know what, um?
Actually, that's great. That helps a lot. Thanks.

Because tomorrow he's redoing yesterday's pages.
Yesterday's pages did not reflect my best work.
Why don't you cut him a little slack? Maybe if he relaxes, he'll get some work done.
I think he's been relaxing enough, thanks to you...
...and Fireball.

The only reason you're doing this to Joey is you're bored.
It's not his fault that you're unemployed.
I am not unemployed. I'm on sabbatical.
Look, look. Guys, don't fight.
And the reason I'm doing this is because I am Joey's friend.
And if you were a good friend, you'd be doing the same thing.
So being a good friend means acting like a jerk?
If it does, then you're an amazing friend of mine.
Hey, guys. How about we settle this over a friendly game of Fireball, huh?
I'll go unhook the smoke detectors. - How about we settle this right now?
There. Now no one's going to the game. Ha-ha-ha.

So we finally get to the top of the mountain, ahem...
...and airhead here forgets the camera.
You know, that same thing happened to me one time.

Don't you remember? We were jogging in the park, we saw that pretty bird.
And I wanted to take a picture but I didn't have my camera.
Okay. First of all, chasing the churro guy is not jogging.

That is good.

Mm.

They're brother and sister?
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
Wait a minute. Open your hand. Let me take a look.
Quarter, dime. Lint? Not interested in that.
What's this? A Canadian coin? Get out of here!
Gosh.

Set it down over there and then you can make a contribution.

"Hey, man." - "What is up?"

"I am sorry, Chandler."
"I am sorry, Ross."

"Hey. How's it going, guys?

You. You wouldn't let me give up on myself.
And you. Well, you co-created Fireball.
The End." Yeah.

I spent the rest of the day coming up with New Ultimate Fireball. Ha, ha!
Okay. "It's a typical New York apartment.
Two girls are just hanging out." Go.
"Hi, how are you doing, Kelly?" - "I'm doing just fine.
God, Tiffany, you smell so great."
"It's my new perfume.
Why don't you come closer where you can really appreciate it?"
Oh, you know, Joey, you are sick. - This is disgusting.
I'm not reading this.
What? Wait, wait, wait. The handsome man was about to enter!

sense_groups.english: I am not unemployed. I'm on sabbatical.

sense_groups.chinese: 少跟我传教
sense_groups.english: Hey, don't get religious on me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该练习放轻松
sense_groups.english: A guy in your position needs to be a little better at relaxing, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我们家怎么会有安乐椅？过来 坐下
sense_groups.english: Why do you think we have the comfortable chairs, huh? Here, sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好没？仔细看了
sense_groups.english: Ready? Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw!

sense_groups.chinese: 然后…
sense_groups.english: And then...

sense_groups.chinese: 真好 哈？
sense_groups.english: Aw, yeah! Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？就光坐着？ - 噢 当然不是
sense_groups.english: So, what? We just sit? - Oh, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是坐着 看好了
sense_groups.english: We're not gonna just sit. Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是钱德宾
sense_groups.english: Hello. Chandler Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 宾先生
sense_groups.english: Hello, Mr. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你是谁 别再打了
sense_groups.english: All right, whoever this is, stop calling me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经骚扰我半年 一点也不好笑
sense_groups.english: It's been six months! It's not funny!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 我爱你
sense_groups.english: But I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 求你行行好 别再骚扰我了
sense_groups.english: Leave me alone! For the love of God, leave me alone!

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是周三的乐子
sense_groups.english: And that's Wednesday. Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 告诉你们
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. Guess what?

sense_groups.chinese: 英国人要打来啦？
sense_groups.english: The British are coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的笑话真冷
sense_groups.english: Oh, you and your ways.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞节快到了 我要负责去乐募集捐款
sense_groups.english: Since it's Christmas, I'm gonna be one of those people collecting donations.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经拿到铃铛 过几天就能拿到募捐筒
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I already have my bell, and later on I get my bucket.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要散播欢乐给大家
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. I'll be spreading joy to the people.

sense_groups.chinese: 去年散播的不够多
sense_groups.english: Last year I spread a little joy, but not enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以今年一定要让全纽约 都感受到
sense_groups.english: So this year, I'm gonna do the whole city. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个高中同学也跟你一样 她很红
sense_groups.english: I knew a girl in high school who did that. She was very popular.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你要去哪里摇铃？
sense_groups.english: Uh, so, Pheebs, where are you doing your bell ringing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我分到梅西百货旁当红的位子
sense_groups.english: They gave me a great spot right by Macy's.

sense_groups.chinese: 新人很少分到这位子
sense_groups.english: They never give such a good corner to a rookie...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是只有我会用25种语官 说圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm the only one who can say "Merry Christmas" in 25 languages.

sense_groups.chinese: 我唬的
sense_groups.english: I lied.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 丹尼在那边 你们看
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Okay, you guys, here's Danny.

sense_groups.chinese: 看这个
sense_groups.english: Just watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 看见没？还在假装对我没兴趣
sense_groups.english: See? Still pretending he's not interested.

sense_groups.chinese: 他走过来了 大家装不认识他 忘记他是谁
sense_groups.english: Okay, he's coming over. Pretend we've forgotten who he is.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们好 - 嘿 丹尼
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey, Danny.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 丹尼
sense_groups.english: Oh, Danny! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 额…
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼 你认得瑞秋吧 她人很好 长得也不赖吧？
sense_groups.english: Danny, you know Rachel. She's nice. She's not bad to look at, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 摩妮卡 - 当然啦
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Mon. - Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要跟她约会？ - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Do you wanna go out on a date with her? - Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 肯定 是星期五好吗?
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. Is Friday okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好 她等不及要赴约
sense_groups.english: Friday is perfect. She can't wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会时 我可以直接跟她说话吧？
sense_groups.english: On the date, I will be able to talk to her directly, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 周五见
sense_groups.english: See you Friday.

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞什么飞机？你知道什么？不用说了
sense_groups.english: Okay, what the hell was that? You know what? Don't answer me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟丹尼约会罗
sense_groups.english: I have a date with Danny. Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么会落选？
sense_groups.english: How could I not get the part?

sense_groups.chinese: 主角就是出身皇后区的29岁意大利演员
sense_groups.english: The play was about a 29-year-old Italian actor from Queens.

sense_groups.chinese: 泰莉雅雪儿突然有空
sense_groups.english: Well, Talia Shire suddenly became available.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是欧巴桑耶
sense_groups.english: She's a woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我说什么？人家就是有办法
sense_groups.english: What can I say? She nailed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 还有什么戏份？
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay. Is there anything else?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你一定又会拒绝 但是…
sense_groups.english: Well, you're just gonna say no again, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋A片？
sense_groups.english: ...gay porn?

sense_groups.chinese: 佳节快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy holidays!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐(西班牙文)
sense_groups.english: SPEAKING IN SPANISH

sense_groups.chinese: (法文) 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: And Merry Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 祝你幸福
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you, sir. Here's some joy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 - 我来看看你做得如何
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 很顺利
sense_groups.english: Well, it's going okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 我顺便捐点钱 - 谢谢 不客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Here, let me help you out. - Oh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 哇哦 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Wow. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 新的鹿皮外套？好像很贵
sense_groups.english: Is that a new suede jacket? It looks really expensive.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不便宜
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚去做指甲？
sense_groups.english: Just get your nails done?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我只剩这些钱了
sense_groups.english: Yes, Phoebe, but this is all I have, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢啦 佳节快乐
sense_groups.english: Okay, thanks. Happy holidays.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你幸福 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here's your joy. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 佳节愉快 等等
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Happy holidays and... Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以不拿钱 - 我跟你换零钱搭公车
sense_groups.english: You can't take the money out. - I'm making change for the bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿零钱就好 其他钱是要救济穷人的
sense_groups.english: Can't you leave the dollar? This money's for the poor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是穷人 而且还得搭公车
sense_groups.english: I'm poor. I gotta take the bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 佳节愉快 可是你不能…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Seasons greetings and everything. But still...

sense_groups.chinese: 咬我啊 小妞
sense_groups.english: Bite me, blondie!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 除了祝他幸福 我还要…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm gonna give him something besides joy. Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个角色根本就是为我而写的 不敢相信我竟然落选
sense_groups.english: That part was perfect for me. I can't believe I didn't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道该怎么做吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what you should do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要自己创造机会
sense_groups.english: You should make something happen for yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 例如写部电影剧本
sense_groups.english: You know, like write a play.

sense_groups.chinese: 写一部电影剧本 哈？就像《心灵捕手》那两个
sense_groups.english: Write a movie, huh? What about those Good Will Hunting guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 少作白日梦了 知道吗？就算我写出剧本
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross. Be realistic, you know? If I did write something...

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有办法请到他们来演？
sense_groups.english: ...what are the chances I could get those guys to star in it?

sense_groups.chinese: 有了 我可以自己主演 - 也可以
sense_groups.english: Wait a second. I could star in it! - Or that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会写剧本 你知道的 我是一个演员
sense_groups.english: I can't write, you know. I mean, I'm an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没受过编剧的训练 我办不到
sense_groups.english: I don't have the discipline that it takes, you know. I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮你
sense_groups.english: I'll help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮你订出时间表 盯着你乖乖照做
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'll make up a schedule and make sure you stick to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样我自己也有事做了
sense_groups.english: Plus it'll give me something to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你愿意帮我？谢谢 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Really? You'd do that for me? Thanks. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始慢慢来 今晚之前只要…
sense_groups.english: We'll start off slow. The only thing you have to do tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 想好主角名字
sense_groups.english: ...is come up with the name of your main character.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 - 不可以是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Done. - And it can't be Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 - 也不能是约瑟夫
sense_groups.english: It's not. - Or Joseph.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你怎么啦？
sense_groups.english: Hi. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚看到丹尼跟女生搭地铁
sense_groups.english: I just saw Danny getting on the subway with a girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 他还搂着她
sense_groups.english: ...and he had his arm around her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真为你难过
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的确该难过 一切都要怪你
sense_groups.english: Well, you should be. This is all your fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁叫你插手我们的感情世界
sense_groups.english: You meddled in our relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们根本没在一起
sense_groups.english: You had no relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我已经拟好计划 一切…
sense_groups.english: No, but I was doing my thing, and everything...

sense_groups.chinese: 都按部就班进行中
sense_groups.english: ...was going according to the plan!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托别再提你的鸟计划了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Stop with the plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到他跟女生在一起又如何？
sense_groups.english: Unh. So what if you saw him with a girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁在乎呢？他们不见得是情人
sense_groups.english: Who cares? That doesn't mean anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就快跟丹尼约会了 到时你可以火力全开
sense_groups.english: You'll go out on a date with Danny and be so charming he'll forget all about...

sense_groups.chinese: 迷得他忘记地铁那个蠢妞
sense_groups.english: ...that stupid subway girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 那女生的确傻里傻气的
sense_groups.english: She was kind of stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 好 我就去赴约
sense_groups.english: You're right. All right. I'm just gonna go on the date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会去赴约 这就是我的新计划
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna go on the date. That is the new plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点
sense_groups.english: Hurry, hurry!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 "多疑"怎么写？ - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how do you spell "suspicious"? - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这个角色很"多疑"
sense_groups.english: Because I think this character is gonna be suspicious about stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾7分 钱德宾0分
sense_groups.english: Chandler Bing, seven, Chandler Bing, zero.

sense_groups.chinese: 看你玩那个都快让我抓狂了
sense_groups.english: You're driving me crazy with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我不玩就是了 - 继续玩
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll stop. - No, don't stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 碗拿远一点 连罗斯都投得进
sense_groups.english: Move the bowl further away. Ross could make that shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是逊毙了 不过至少你进了成人组
sense_groups.english: Well, you suck. But at least you suck at a man's game now.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要玩？ - 我不能跟你玩
sense_groups.english: You wanna play? - I can't be playing games.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯就快回来了 按照他的时间表我今天应该写完5页
sense_groups.english: Ross will be home soon. I have to write five pages to stick to his schedule.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以先玩30分钟 再继续用功到他回家
sense_groups.english: Well, so play for the next 30 minutes, then you can write until he gets home.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过 规则应该 额…
sense_groups.english: But, listen, what do you say we, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 更上一层楼？
sense_groups.english: ...crank it up a notch?

sense_groups.chinese: 愿闻其详
sense_groups.english: I'm intrigued.

sense_groups.chinese: 要先找到可燃性液体
sense_groups.english: All right. All we need is a little lighter fluid.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 不过你小心点 我还想拿回房租订金
sense_groups.english: Okay, but be careful. I wanna get our security deposit back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们发明铁饼标枪时 就拿不回来了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think we said goodbye to that when we invented hammer darts.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得哪面墙壁没补过吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you remember which part of the wall is not spackle?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 这里
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 佳节愉快
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Happy holiday.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐 那可是垃圾 不可以…
sense_groups.english: No, that's trash, young lady. No, you can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 阻止那位小姐 她竟然捐垃圾
sense_groups.english: Hey. Stop that young lady! She donated trash!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乐捐筒着火了 来人啊
sense_groups.english: The charity's on fire!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 谢谢 我正需要
sense_groups.english: Help! Good, thank you. I need that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么鬼东西？现在才早上9点耶
sense_groups.english: What is this? It's 9:00 in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看看"场景 房间
sense_groups.english: All right. "A room.

sense_groups.chinese: 一名男子多疑地走进来"
sense_groups.english: A man enters. He looks suspicious."

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？
sense_groups.english: That's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你今天应该写5页
sense_groups.english: Joey, you were supposed to have five pages done by now...

sense_groups.chinese: 还包括一个高潮
sense_groups.english: ...including an exciting incident.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么东西？"大火球游戏规则"
sense_groups.english: What is all this? "The Official Rulebook of Fireball."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚在玩这游戏
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's the game we played.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好玩 道具就是一颗网球 一个碗 可燃液体
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's great. You take a tennis ball, a bowl and lighter fl...

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这对你的事业有帮助吗？我还以为你想当演员
sense_groups.english: This is helping your career, huh? You wanted to be an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是发明危险游戏被人告
sense_groups.english: Not the creator of Crazy Lawsuit Game.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我该工作了
sense_groups.english: You're right, you're right. I'll get back to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真不应该 还带坏他 明知道乔伊应该要工作
sense_groups.english: And shame on you. You should know better. Joey needs to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 振作点 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Now come on. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 不行 等你写完5页才还 哈？
sense_groups.english: No, uh-uh. You can have this back when the five pages are done, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚才最开心 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I had a really nice time tonight. - So did I.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好摩妮卡约我们出来
sense_groups.english: I'm really glad Monica asked us out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想请你进去 不过我妹来住我家
sense_groups.english: I'd love to ask you in but my sister's visiting.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能睡在沙发上了 - 你妹妹？
sense_groups.english: I think she's asleep on the couch. - Your sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 你妹妹睡在沙发上？
sense_groups.english: Your sister's asleep on the couch?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我上次看到你们搭地铁 现在她还睡在你沙发上
sense_groups.english: Ah, I saw you with her on the subway and now she's asleep on the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我就猜是你 - 哦 嘿 太好了 你起床了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I thought I heard you. - Oh, hey, great, you're up.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这是我妹妹克莉丝塔 克莉丝塔 这是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel, my sister Krista. Krista, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该告诉我要带朋友回来 害我穿得邋里邋遢的
sense_groups.english: Wish you told me we were having company. I'd have fixed myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 有差吗？ - 你真恶劣
sense_groups.english: Like it would help. - You are so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才是 - 是你
sense_groups.english: You are. - You are.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你 是你 - 是你 是你
sense_groups.english: You are. You are. - You are. You are!

sense_groups.chinese: 你完蛋了 - 哈
sense_groups.english: You are so dead. - Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要教训你一顿 过来啊 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna get you. Come here. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 过来啊 过来啊 - 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Come here. Come here! - Ha-ha-ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Um, it's very nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人 没一个人尊重募捐筒
sense_groups.english: Nobody. Nobody respects the bucket.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都丢些莫名其妙的东西
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't believe what people put in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得这像…
sense_groups.english: Look. Okay, does this look like...

sense_groups.chinese: 垃圾桶吗？ - 不像
sense_groups.english: ...a garbage can to you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 像烟灰缸吗？ - 不
sense_groups.english: Does it look like an ashtray? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 像个尿桶吗？
sense_groups.english: Does it look like a urinal?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Ew!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你还要回去募捐吗？ - 当然 不过我受够了
sense_groups.english: So, Pheebs, you gonna go back out there? - Yeah, but I'm not gonna take any more crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 再也不当募捐好好小姐
sense_groups.english: Okay? No more Mrs. Nice Bucket.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 你在街上流浪过 够悍
sense_groups.english: Yeah, good for you. You're tough. You lived on the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要当回强悍菲比
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm gonna go back to being Street Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过也不能全当回去
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh, but you know what? I can't go totally back...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为强悍菲比才不会鸟你们
sense_groups.english: ...because Street Phoebe really wouldn't be friends with you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以问个问题吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: Um, can I ask you guys something? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有兄弟实在不了解 不过你们会打来打去吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, I don't have any brothers so I don't know, but did you guys wrestle?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然会 - 常常
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. - All the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我从没输过
sense_groups.english: In fact, I was undefeated.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你以前90多公斤
sense_groups.english: Well, you weighed 200 pounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我还是跟猫咪一样矫捷
sense_groups.english: Still, I was quick as a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨天见到丹尼的妹妹
sense_groups.english: Well, I met Danny's sister yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是跟他起搭地铁的那个 - 噢 真的假的
sense_groups.english: Uh, that was the girl on the subway. - Oh, you're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们非常…
sense_groups.english: And they were very, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 会扭打
sense_groups.english: ...wrestle-y.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样正常吗？
sense_groups.english: But I guess that's normal?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在不会这样了
sense_groups.english: We don't wrestle now.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从我长大变壮后就不打了
sense_groups.english: Not since I got too strong for you. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 长大变壮？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Too strong for me? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要比划一下吗？
sense_groups.english: You wanna go right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以立刻打败你 信不信？
sense_groups.english: Because I'll take you right now, buddy. You wanna go?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 预备
sense_groups.english: Ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 开始
sense_groups.english: Wrestle!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这个嘛？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what, um?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 谢谢你们帮了大忙
sense_groups.english: Actually, that's great. That helps a lot. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快走 20分后球赛就要开始了 乔伊 快点
sense_groups.english: Guys, come on, let's go. The puck drops in 20 minutes. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊不能去 - 我还没写完5页
sense_groups.english: Joey's not going. - I didn't finish my five pages.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天再写不就成了？
sense_groups.english: Why can't you finish them tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他明天要修改昨天的5页
sense_groups.english: Because tomorrow he's redoing yesterday's pages.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨天写的有待改进
sense_groups.english: Yesterday's pages did not reflect my best work.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再逼他 让他透口气 搞不好会写得更好
sense_groups.english: Why don't you cut him a little slack? Maybe if he relaxes, he'll get some work done.

sense_groups.chinese: 他已经透够多气了 这都要感谢你…
sense_groups.english: I think he's been relaxing enough, thanks to you...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟大火球
sense_groups.english: ...and Fireball.

sense_groups.chinese: 玩大火球可是很紧张 显然你没玩过
sense_groups.english: If you think Fireball's relaxing, you obviously have never played.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拼命压榨乔伊 是因为你太无聊了
sense_groups.english: The only reason you're doing this to Joey is you're bored.

sense_groups.chinese: 又不是乔伊害你失业的
sense_groups.english: It's not his fault that you're unemployed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是失业 只是进修中
sense_groups.english: I am not unemployed. I'm on sabbatical.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们别吵架
sense_groups.english: Look, look. Guys, don't fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我之所以这么做 是因为我是乔伊的朋友
sense_groups.english: And the reason I'm doing this is because I am Joey's friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你也是他麻吉 就该跟我一样
sense_groups.english: And if you were a good friend, you'd be doing the same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 当麻吉就得这么混帐？
sense_groups.english: So being a good friend means acting like a jerk?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是真如你所说 你可真是我第一号好友
sense_groups.english: If it does, then you're an amazing friend of mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 别吵了 何不大家玩场大火球 尽弃前嫌
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. How about we settle this over a friendly game of Fireball, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去拆掉防火警铃 - 何不现在就一了百了
sense_groups.english: I'll go unhook the smoke detectors. - How about we settle this right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 谁也不准去看球赛 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: There. Now no one's going to the game. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 门票是我买的 - 才怪
sense_groups.english: I paid for those tickets. - No, you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你每次都说要付钱 却一次也没吐过钱 - 哦 也对
sense_groups.english: You said you would, but you never did. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们终于爬到山顶
sense_groups.english: So we finally get to the top of the mountain, ahem...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果这个笨蛋竟然忘了相机
sense_groups.english: ...and airhead here forgets the camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也发生过这种事情
sense_groups.english: You know, that same thing happened to me one time.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候？
sense_groups.english: When did that happen to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 上次我们不是到公园慢跑 结果想拍只可爱小乌
sense_groups.english: Don't you remember? We were jogging in the park, we saw that pretty bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想拍张照片但是我竟然没带相机
sense_groups.english: And I wanted to take a picture but I didn't have my camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对 不过追小贩可不算慢跑
sense_groups.english: Okay. First of all, chasing the churro guy is not jogging.

sense_groups.chinese: 超好吃 你一定要吃一口
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is so good. You have got to try it.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不错
sense_groups.english: That is good.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 裤子沾到了 - 我来擦
sense_groups.english: Oh, damn. I got it on my pants. - Here, I'll get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好上楼换件裤子 否则以后洗不掉
sense_groups.english: We better take these off or that stain will set.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我今晚约会还要穿 - 喔 真好
sense_groups.english: I wanna wear these pants on our date tonight. - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 老天爷啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 - 看吧 我早说过了
sense_groups.english: That was unbelievable. - Okay, see? I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 可怜的瑞秋 - 我不相信他们是兄妹
sense_groups.english: Yeah, wow. Sorry, Rach. - I don't believe they're brother and sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是兄妹？
sense_groups.english: They're brother and sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 哇哦 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 手张开给我检查
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Open your hand. Let me take a look.

sense_groups.chinese: 两毛五 一毛 线头？不要
sense_groups.english: Quarter, dime. Lint? Not interested in that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？加拿大硬币？滚蛋
sense_groups.english: What's this? A Canadian coin? Get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Gosh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不准在募捐筒旁边喝东西
sense_groups.english: Whoa. No drinks near the bucket.

sense_groups.chinese: 先放在那边才准捐款
sense_groups.english: Set it down over there and then you can make a contribution.

sense_groups.chinese: 少装一副可怜兮兮的样子
sense_groups.english: And you can leave the "hurt bunny" look over there too.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 鲍柏 不是叫你滚蛋了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Bob. I thought I told you to get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们接到申诉
sense_groups.english: Uh, Phoebe, we've been getting complaints.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面要调你离开
sense_groups.english: And we're gonna move you to a less high-profile spot.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 以后这里由金洁负责 - 这小妞才没这能耐
sense_groups.english: Uh, Ginger's gonna take over this corner. - That chick can't handle my corner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不走 我们就得赶你走
sense_groups.english: Look, either you leave or we remove you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 劝你一句 注意那个臭婆娘
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll give you one pointer. Look out for that bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 瑞秋 不是约好7点吗？ - 耶 额
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Rach. I thought we said 7. - Yeah, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么？额 今天就算了
sense_groups.english: ...you know what? Uh, let's skip it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: What? Uh, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 额… 看
sense_groups.english: Um... Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们兄妹似乎… 非常要好
sense_groups.english: You and your sister seem to have, um, a very special bond...

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 又说这句话
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. That "special bond" again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟我妹感情好 又是哪里让人看不顺眼了？
sense_groups.english: Why do women have such a problem with the fact that I'm close with my sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 我不知道事实真相 但是 - 你有兄弟吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I don't know, but... - Do you have brothers?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我有两个姐姐 其中一个很像男人婆
sense_groups.english: No, I have two sisters, but one of them actually has a very masculine energy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要好吗？ - 没有 她们不是好人
sense_groups.english: Are you close with them? - No, no. They're not very nice people.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 过来 听着
sense_groups.english: Okay, come here. Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢你 好吗？交往下去应该会有结果
sense_groups.english: I really like you, okay? I think this could go somewhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是跟家人感情深厚 你就为了这点拒绝我？
sense_groups.english: So what if I'm close to my family? You gonna let that stand in the way of us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道…
sense_groups.english: Well, I... I don't know...

sense_groups.chinese: 听你这么说也有道理
sense_groups.english: See, when you put it that way, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼快点 洗澡水快凉了
sense_groups.english: Danny, hurry up. The bath's getting cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 又怎么了？ - 好吧 我先走了
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, okay, I'll see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 嘿 路上有小孩在玩耍
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. There's some kids playing in the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要去叫他们写作业 毁了他们的一天？
sense_groups.english: You wanna go down there, give them a project, ruin their day?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你手边有球 就可以插上剃刀
sense_groups.english: Hey, if they have a ball, maybe you could stick razor blades in it...

sense_groups.chinese: 教他们玩新游戏"杀人球"
sense_groups.english: ...and teach them a new game: "Gonna-Need-Stitches Ball."

sense_groups.chinese: 两位 我整个早上都待在图书馆 已经写完今天的5页了
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. I was at the library all morning and I already finished my five pages for today.

sense_groups.chinese: 那敢情好 我们可以去看昨晚的《骑兵队》比赛了
sense_groups.english: Great. Now we can go to the Ranger game last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 门票被罗斯撕掉了
sense_groups.english: No, dude. Ross tore up the tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有让你分心的事情 就比较容易专心吧？
sense_groups.english: I guess when you don't have so many distractions, it's easier for you to focus, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 没人整天跟在你屁股后面 也比较得心应手吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, or also when you don't have somebody breathing down your neck all the livelong day!

sense_groups.chinese: 随便你们说 总之我写完了 而且写得还不错
sense_groups.english: Well, that's fine, but the important thing is I finished it. And I think it's really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你们帮忙念台词 才是真正帮大忙 可不可以帮个忙？
sense_groups.english: But you know what would help me, is if I could hear it. Would you guys read it for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 "是一间普通的纽约公寓
sense_groups.english: Okay. "It's a typical New York City apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个男人正在家里" 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Two guys are hanging out." Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: "嗨 老兄" - "有什么事？"
sense_groups.english: "Hey, man." - "What is up?"

sense_groups.chinese: "昨天是我错了 对不起"
sense_groups.english: "About yesterday. I was really wrong. I am sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: "是我 我才该道歉 我反应过头了"
sense_groups.english: "No, it was me. I'm sorry. I overreacted."

sense_groups.chinese: "或许我们都有错 反正我们都是为了朋友…"
sense_groups.english: "Maybe it was both of us. But we had our best friend's inter...

sense_groups.chinese: "我们都是为了朋友好"
sense_groups.english: But we had our best friend's interest at heart."

sense_groups.chinese: "我非常不好意思"
sense_groups.english: "Could I be more sorry?"

sense_groups.chinese: "我不知道 我才是该道歉的…
sense_groups.english: "I don't know. I am one sorry...

sense_groups.chinese: 古生物学家"
sense_groups.english: ...polontologist."

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我们懂了
sense_groups.english: All right, Joey, we get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 我也该道歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - I'm sorry too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不… 你们要继续读下去 精彩的才要上场 继续念
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. Keep reading. The good part's coming up. Keep going.

sense_groups.chinese: "对不起 钱德"
sense_groups.english: "I am sorry, Chandler."

sense_groups.chinese: "对不起 罗斯"
sense_groups.english: "I am sorry, Ross."

sense_groups.chinese: "帅哥上场"
sense_groups.english: Ahem. "A handsome man enters."

sense_groups.chinese: "你们好吗？
sense_groups.english: "Hey. How's it going, guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道你们在扯什么 不过我要向你们两位道谢
sense_groups.english: I don't know what you two are talking about, but I'd just like to say thanks to both of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让我不放弃自己
sense_groups.english: You. You wouldn't let me give up on myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你 你与我一起创造了大火球"
sense_groups.english: And you. Well, you co-created Fireball.

sense_groups.chinese: "剧终"
sense_groups.english: The End." Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就花了你一整天？
sense_groups.english: This took you all day?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我只写了5分钟
sense_groups.english: No, no, this only took five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他时问都在写 "终极大火球"游戏规则
sense_groups.english: I spent the rest of the day coming up with New Ultimate Fireball. Ha, ha!

sense_groups.chinese: "场景在一般纽约公寓
sense_groups.english: Okay. "It's a typical New York apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 屋内有两个女生"
sense_groups.english: Two girls are just hanging out." Go.

sense_groups.chinese: "嗨 凯莉 你好吗？" - "我很好"
sense_groups.english: "Hi, how are you doing, Kelly?" - "I'm doing just fine.

sense_groups.chinese: "天啊 提芬妮 你今天好香"
sense_groups.english: God, Tiffany, you smell so great."

sense_groups.chinese: "我喷了新香水"
sense_groups.english: "It's my new perfume.

sense_groups.chinese: "你靠近一点才闻得仔细"
sense_groups.english: Why don't you come closer where you can really appreciate it?"

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你这大变态 - 酷毙了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, Joey, you are sick. - This is disgusting.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要念呢
sense_groups.english: I'm not reading this.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？等等 帅哥才刚要上场
sense_groups.english: What? Wait, wait, wait. The handsome man was about to enter!

questions.name: S05E11
questions.en:
Is there any entertainment there?
All right. Here we go. 1999, the year of Joey.
We're very happy for you.
What's the matter?
We wanted to kiss at midnight, but nobody else is going to so, you know...
All right, I'll take care of it. - Oh, no.
Joey.
Thirty-three, 32, 31. - Ross, Ross, Ross.
Listen, who are you kissing at midnight? Rachel or Phoebe?
What? - Well, you gotta kiss someone.
Can't kiss your sister. - Who's gonna kiss my sister?
Chandler. - Oh, man. Really?
Who would you rather have kiss your sister?
That's a good point. - Yeah.
Uh, well, since I have that whole history with Rachel, I guess Phoebe.
Okay, great. Pheebs, Pheebs. Listen. Ross wants to kiss you at midnight.
So obvious. Why doesn't he just ask?
Rach, Rach. Listen, I'm going to kiss you at midnight.
What? - You can't kiss Ross. You got the history.
So? - So?
Would you prefer me or Chandler? - Oh, good point.
Happy New Year!
Happy New Year. - Happy New Year.
Happy New Year, Pheebs. - You too.
Happy New Year, Joey.
So that do anything for you?
You know what?
I'm going to go out on a limb and say,"No divorces in '99."
But your divorce isn't even final yet.
Just the one divorce in '99.
You know what? I'm gonna be happy this year.
I'm gonna make myself happy.
Do you want us to leave the room or?
Every day, I am going to do one thing I have never done before.
That, my friends, is my New Year's resolution.
Ooh. That's a good one. - Yeah?
Mine is to pilot a commercial jet.
That's a good one too. Now you only have to find a planeload of people...
...whose resolution is to plummet to their deaths.
Maybe your resolution should be not to make fun of your friends.
Especially the ones who may soon be flying you to Europe for free...
...on their own plane.
She has a better chance of sprouting wings and flying up your nose...
...than you do of not making fun of us.
In fact, I'll bet you 50 bucks you can't go the whole year without making fun of us.
You know what? Better yet, a week.
I'll take that bet, my friend.
And you know what? Paying me the 50 bucks can be...
...the "new thing you do" that day.
And it starts right now.
All right, my New Year's resolution is to learn how to play guitar.
Really? How come? - Ah.
You know those special skills I have listed on my résumé?
I would love it if one of those was true.
Do you want me to teach you? I'm a great teacher.
Really? Who have you taught?
Well, I taught me and I loved me.
That'd be great. Yeah, thanks, Pheebs.
Oh, look. Blaire forgot her glasses.
She's gonna be needing these to keep an eye on that boyfriend.
Who, from what I hear, needs to keep his stapler...
...in his desk drawer, if you know what I'm talking about.
Hey, Rach, maybe your resolution should be to, um, gossip less.
What? I don't gossip.
Maybe sometimes I find out things.
Or I hear something and I pass that information on.
You know, kind of like a public service.
Doesn't mean I'm a gossip. I mean, would you call Ted Koppel a gossip?
Well, if Ted Koppel talked about his coworkers' botched boob jobs...
...yeah, I would.
Well, they were like this.
I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.
Hey. - Hey.
I just asked that girl out.
Nice. - Nice. Yeah.
Is that part of your resolution, your "new thing" for today?
Yes, it is. See?
"Elizabeth...
...Hornswoggle"?
That's right.
Elizabeth Hornswoggle.
Hornswoggle.
You okay, Chandler? Is there something...?
Something funny about that name?
No, no, I just think that maybe I've heard it somewhere before.
Oh, really? Where?
Somewhere funny I'll bet.
