sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你看
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. Check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞定老太太了
sense_groups.english: Ooh. You nailed the Old Lady. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha, ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 听着 我觉得我进步了…
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen, I thought I was getting better...

sense_groups.chinese: 就在回家的路上去吉他店…
sense_groups.english: ...so on my way home today I stopped by this guitar store...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在店里有碰吉他吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you touch any of the guitars while you were there?

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 手给我
sense_groups.english: Give me your hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 琴弦 这一手
sense_groups.english: Strings.

sense_groups.chinese: 弹片
sense_groups.english: Pick.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想学吉他吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want to learn to play guitar?

sense_groups.chinese: 想啊 - 那就不要碰吉他
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Then don't touch one!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 海 班 - 摩妮卡姑姑
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ben. - Auntie Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯穿皮裤
sense_groups.english: Ross is wearing leather pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人看见罗斯穿皮裤吗？
sense_groups.english: Does nobody else see that Ross is wearing leather pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁来说句话吧
sense_groups.english: Someone comment on the pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 很帅气啊 - 我才很喜欢
sense_groups.english: I think they're very nice. - I really like them a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想的不是这个
sense_groups.english: Not what I had in mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯这种人通常不穿这种裤子
sense_groups.english: See, people like Ross don't generally wear these types of pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种裤子很紧
sense_groups.english: You see, they're very tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许可以评论一下
sense_groups.english: Maybe there's something in that area?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好看啊 - 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: I think they look really good. - I like them.

sense_groups.chinese: 在哪里买的？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, where did you get them?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没做今天的新鲜事
sense_groups.english: See, I needed a new thing for today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直觉得这家皮衣店很香
sense_groups.english: And there's this leather store I go by that always smells so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我心想 "哇哦 你知道吗 我从来没买过…
sense_groups.english: And I thought to myself, "Wow. You know, I've never owned...

sense_groups.chinese: 一条很香的皮裤"
sense_groups.english: ...a really good-smelling pair of pants before."

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你们觉得怎样？
sense_groups.english: Okay, seriously. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 好怪 难看死了 - 难看死了
sense_groups.english: You look like a freak. Yeah, awful. - Awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你在干什么？你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey. What are you doing? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的新年新希望 - 把我儿子弄瞎？
sense_groups.english: It's my New Year's resolution. - To blind my child?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是多照照我们的相片
sense_groups.english: No, to take more pictures of all of us together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这样最好 大家都会喜欢
sense_groups.english: I really think it's the best resolution. Everyone can enjoy them.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家也都会喜欢我的演奏
sense_groups.english: Well, everyone will enjoy my music as well.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这条裤子热死了
sense_groups.english: My God, these pants. I'm burning up.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天啊 她现在靠过来？是想让我死吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. She wants to snuggle now? What, is she trying to kill me?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里面跟火山一样
sense_groups.english: It's like a volcano in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你热吗？ - 不会
sense_groups.english: Are you hot? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我在热
sense_groups.english: Okay, it must just be me then.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是裤子跟沙发磨擦的声音
sense_groups.english: That was just the pants and the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 嘿 可以借用一下洗手间吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, hey, do you mind if I use your bathroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 请便 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, go ahead. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最喜欢的部分要来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, my favorite part's coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 完蛋了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 老虎 恐龙
sense_groups.english: Tiger. Dragon.

sense_groups.chinese: 冰山
sense_groups.english: Iceberg.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔瑟夫 你昨晚有练习吗？
sense_groups.english: Joseph, did you even study at all last night?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有啊 - 那就把冰山做出来
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes, I did. - Then do Iceberg.

sense_groups.chinese: 升G - 升G？
sense_groups.english: G-sharp. - G-sharp?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在偷学和弦名称吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you been studying the real names of the chords?

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有？
sense_groups.english: Have you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？我又没有碰吉他
sense_groups.english: What? I didn't touch a guitar.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但是你质疑我的教学方式
sense_groups.english: No, but you're questioning my method.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是质疑 我根本就觉得很蠢
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not questioning it, Phoebe. I'm saying it's stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他学生都不…
sense_groups.english: You know, none of my other student...

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得我蠢
sense_groups.english: ...thought I was stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的其他学生就是你
sense_groups.english: Your other student was you!

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样 也许你应该更用功
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, you know, maybe you just need to try a little harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我应该找个正牌老师
sense_groups.english: Maybe I need to try a real teacher.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里 安迪古柏 他在教吉他
sense_groups.english: Right here. Here. Andy Cooper. He teaches guitar.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 这里还有他跟小朋友的合照
sense_groups.english: And look. Ooh, there's a picture of him with a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 小朋友拿着吉他
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and the kid's got a guitar!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你去跟你的专业老师学
sense_groups.english: Fine. You go learn from your qualified instructor.

sense_groups.chinese: 等大家听腻"坏蛋李洛布朗"
sense_groups.english: But don't come crying to me when everyone is sick and tired...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可别哭着来找我
sense_groups.english: ...of hearing you play "Bad, Bad Leroy Brown."

sense_groups.chinese: 全城最坏的大坏蛋
sense_groups.english: Baddest man in the whole damn town

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 你去帮他啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, fine. Take his side.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想赶快去找你
sense_groups.english: I can't wait to be with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯把小孩接走我就溜过去
sense_groups.english: I'll sneak over as soon as Ross picks up Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会告诉瑞秋 我要洗两个小时衣服
sense_groups.english: I'll tell Rachel I'm gonna be doing laundry for a couple hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 洗衣服 呵呵 那是我的新绰号吗？
sense_groups.english: Laundry. Huh. Is that my new nickname?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 你明知你的绰号是大鹏
sense_groups.english: You know what your nickname is, Mr. Big...

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？ - 乔伊 我是罗斯 我需要帮忙
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Joey, it's Ross. I need some help.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 钱德不在
sense_groups.english: Uh, Chandler's not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以帮我
sense_groups.english: Well, you can help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 听着
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在伊丽莎白的浴室里
sense_groups.english: I'm in Elizabeth's bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我觉得皮裤很热 就进来脱掉
sense_groups.english: No, I got really hot in my leather pants so I took them off.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果它一定是遇汗缩水
sense_groups.english: But they must have shrunk from the sweat or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是我的腿因热膨胀
sense_groups.english: Or my legs expanded from the heat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在穿不回去了
sense_groups.english: I can't get them back on, Joey. I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个情况蛮严重的
sense_groups.english: Oh. That is quite a situation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有粉之类的东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, do you see any, like, powder?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我有爽身粉
sense_groups.english: Powder. Yeah, yeah, I have powder.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Good, good. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它撒在腿上吸汗
sense_groups.english: Sprinkle some on your legs. It'll absorb moisture.

sense_groups.chinese: 就能把裤子穿回去了
sense_groups.english: Then you can get your pants back on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 等一下
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子还是拉不上来
sense_groups.english: They're not coming on, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 你找得到… 凡士林吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, you see any...? Oh, Vaseline?

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到乳液 我有乳液 乳液行吗？
sense_groups.english: I see lotion. I have lotion. Will that work?

sense_groups.chinese: 行 把它涂在腿上 - 等下
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure, throw some of that on there. - Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧
sense_groups.english: Ross, you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子还是扛不上来
sense_groups.english: They're still not coming on, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且乳液和爽身粉糊成一团
sense_groups.english: And the lotion and the powder have made a paste.

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 额 什么颜色？
sense_groups.english: Uh, what color is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么颜色有差吗？
sense_groups.english: What difference does that make?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果跟裤子的颜色一样 你就糊一条假裤子
sense_groups.english: Well, if the paste matches the pants, you can make yourself paste pants...

sense_groups.chinese: 她就看不出来了
sense_groups.english: ...and she won't know the difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你有空吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, do you have a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么…
sense_groups.english: Dude, what am I...?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋来了 祝你好运 让我知道结果
sense_groups.english: Rachel's here, so good luck, man. Let me know how it works out.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我遇到天大的问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey, I have such a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好吧 你来得正好
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, your timing couldn't be better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在到处救火
sense_groups.english: I'm putting out fires all over the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 乔伊 我得告诉你一件事
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. Joey, I have got to tell you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What is it? What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这件事太大了 但你得保证不说出去
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. It's so huge. But you have to promise me, you cannot tell anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我不想知道 - 什么
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I don't want to know. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对想知道 太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, yes. You do want to know. This is unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 我不想再当知道秘密 却不能…
sense_groups.english: I don't care, Rach. Look, I'm tired of being the guy who knows all the secrets...

sense_groups.chinese: 说的人
sense_groups.english: ...and can't tell anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么秘密？你知道什么秘密？
sense_groups.english: You know secrets? What are they?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不该八卦的
sense_groups.english: And you're not supposed to be gossiping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但这件事我憋不住 我刚才拿起电话…
sense_groups.english: No, I know, I can't keep this in. So I pick up the phone...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不听
sense_groups.english: I'm not listening to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 额…
sense_groups.english: Ross? Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你进去很久了
sense_groups.english: You've been in there for a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始有点害怕了
sense_groups.english: I'm starting to get kind of freaked out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要出去了
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm coming out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以把灯关掉吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, can you turn the lights off?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 灯就让它开着
sense_groups.english: No. Let's just leave the lights on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我出了一点状况
sense_groups.english: I had a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能跟你说话 我没在电话簿上登广告
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't talk to you. I don't have a fancy ad in the yellow pages.

sense_groups.chinese: 看…
sense_groups.english: Look...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你听我说…
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我为批评你的教法道歉
sense_groups.english: I want to apologize for saying your method was stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想重新拜你为师
sense_groups.english: And maybe, ask you to be my teacher again?

sense_groups.chinese: 在你说可以之前 我绝对不碰吉他
sense_groups.english: And I promise, I won't touch a guitar until you say I'm ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的可以了？ - 额
sense_groups.english: You really think I'm ready? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷毙了
sense_groups.english: Wow, cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个和弦弹对了吗？ - 不对
sense_groups.english: Was the chord at least right before...? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们听说了 好惨
sense_groups.english: We heard about your pants. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 今年应该很美好才对
sense_groups.english: This year was supposed to be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 才第二天我就成了 穿不合身的…
sense_groups.english: Well, it's only the second day, and I'm a loser...

sense_groups.chinese: 皮裤的逊人
sense_groups.english: ...with stupid leather pants that don't even fit.

sense_groups.chinese: 没这回事 你不逊
sense_groups.english: You're not a loser.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看我
sense_groups.english: Look at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 看 看 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey, look. Look, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 班画了你的画像
sense_groups.english: Ben drew a picture of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是牛仔喔
sense_groups.english: Huh? You're a cowboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我穿皮裤？
sense_groups.english: Because of the leather pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 班并不觉得你逊 他觉得你是牛仔
sense_groups.english: Ben doesn't think you're a loser. He thinks you're a cowboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为 很棒吧
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's something.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很棒 - 牛仔哥
sense_groups.english: It really is something. - Howdy, partner. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我应该再去买一条
sense_groups.english: Maybe I should get another pair.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有一些…
sense_groups.english: Ooh, you know, they had some...

sense_groups.chinese: 侧边有流苏的
sense_groups.english: ...with fringe all down the sides.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去跟班说晚安
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go kiss Ben good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 他居然觉得我是牛仔
sense_groups.english: I can't believe he thinks I'm a cowboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会是个好牛仔
sense_groups.english: I would make a good cowboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 既然没事 我要去洗衣服了
sense_groups.english: Okay, now that everything's wrapped up here, I'm gonna go do my laundry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 如果这一件脏了的话 脏了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, me too. You know, if this shirt is dirty. Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也要走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna go to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去机场 只要等久一点…
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to the airport. If I hang around there long enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该能逮到没人管的飞机
sense_groups.english: ...someone's bound to leave one of those planes unattended.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 再见 - 拜
sense_groups.english: Good luck, honey. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 记得我要说的那件大事吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, Joey, remember that big thing I was going to tell you about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会告诉你 但如果你自己发现
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna tell you. But if you found out on your own...

sense_groups.chinese: 那就没关系 我们就可以讨论了对吧？
sense_groups.english: ...that would be okay, and then we could talk about it, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样就不是秘密 的确没关系
sense_groups.english: Well, then it wouldn't be a secret. So, yeah, that would be okay. Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你去钱德的房间…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe, would you mind going over into Chandler's bedroom...

sense_groups.chinese: 把我借给他的书拿回来好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and getting that book back that he borrowed from me?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在？你要我现在去？
sense_groups.english: Now? You want me to go over there now?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么吗？ - 你知道什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know something? - Do you know something?

sense_groups.chinese: 我或许知道 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I might know something. - I might too something too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么？ - 不行 你先说我才能说
sense_groups.english: What's the thing you know? - You tell me what you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说 - 那我也不能说
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you. - Then I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才不知道
sense_groups.english: You don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如我现在就去钱德的房间
sense_groups.english: How about I go there and walk into Chandler's bedroom and see the thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 就可以知道我想的确实没错
sense_groups.english: ...that I think I know is actually the thing I think I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 - 你也知道
sense_groups.english: You know. - And you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和摩妮卡？真叫人不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Chandler and Monica? Oh, this is unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道多久了？ - 太久了 噢 天哪
sense_groups.english: How long have you known? - Too long. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我早就想找人说了
sense_groups.english: Rach, I've been dying to talk to someone about this for so long.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们不能告诉别人 他们两个好紧张…
sense_groups.english: Listen, listen. You can't say anything to anybody. They're so weird about that.

sense_groups.english: Oh, I am going to go for a walk in the rain. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪人

questions.name: S05E12
questions.en:
Come on, Joey!
Rach, I told you everything I knew last night.
It's not that big a deal. So Monica and Chandler are doing it.
I cannot believe you would say that!
Sorry. Monica and Chandler are "making love."
No, I mean, come on. This is a huge deal!
I need more details. Who initiated the first kiss?
I don't know.
Is he romantic with her?
I don't know.
Are they in love?
I don't know. - Ugh.
You don't know anything.
Oh! I know one thing. - What?
They did it right there on the couch.
Hey, Ross. - Yeah.
Gunther, could I have a scone, please?
Want to hear some good news?
Someone I know is getting married.
Yeah, weddings are happy occasions. Oh, by the by, it's my ex-wife, Emily!
Sorry, man.
Here's your scone. - Thanks, Gunther.
Thanks.
Stupid British snack food!
Did they teach you that in anger management?
You know what might help deal with it? Think of it this way.
You and Emily are in the past. You can't be mad about the past.
Are you still mad about, you know, the Louisiana Purchase?
I don't think anybody's mad about that. - Exactly! Because it's in the past.
Anybody going to eat that?
Look at us all dressed up for the party. What are we celebrating?
We had a lot of liquor left over from the Christmas party.
I think this is cool. None of our friends are here.
We can be a real couple. We don't have to hide.
I know. I can do this. - Ooh.
And I can do this.
We can't do that. - We can't do that.
Hey, Bing! Ha-ha-ha.
Whoa! Who's the pretty lady, and what is she doing with you?
Ha-ha-ha! I ask myself that very question. This is Monica.
My boss, Doug. This is Monica. - Hi, nice to meet you.
Hi! This is my wife, Kara. - Nice to meet you.
Bing! - Okay!
Did you hear about the new law firm working for us?
No, sir. - Yeah, Dewey, Cheatem & Howe.
Come on, let's go drink our body weight.
What was that? - What?
That noise you made?
Oh, that was my work laugh. - Your work laugh?
If you're going to survive this party, you have to come up with one too.
All right. Check me out. - Okay.
He says, "$30, Father. Same as in town." Ha!
Hey, everybody at work loved you last night.
Really? - And they like me more...
...just because I was with you.
You repaired a lot of the damage from when they met Joey.
Doug wants us to play tennis. He's never talked to me outside of work.
Except for that time at that strip club.
Strip church.
I'm gonna go try to find a racket. - I thought you had one.
I used to, but then Joey thought it'd be fun to go to Central Park and hit rocks...
...at bigger rocks.
Hey, Rach, do you have a tennis racket? - Hey.
Oh, um, I lent it to Joey and I've never gotten it back.
Okay, good luck with that.
Ahem. Hey. - Hey.
What's up?
What are you doing here? I thought you had inventory.
Well I do, but I decided I'd take a long lunch...
...and spend some time with my friend, Monica.
You know, I feel like we don't talk anymore.
How are you?
What is new with you?
Heh, um...
Not much. Um, work's good.
We don't have to talk about work. We could talk about anything.
Okay. Um...
Hey! You know what?
Let's talk about relationships.
Okay. What's going on with you? - Nothing.
You go.
Well, I... There was this guy at the bank that I thought was cute.
Um, but I don't anymore.
Wow, that's, uh, juicy. Ahem, um...
You know what? I actually do have a lot of work to do.
You're sure there's just not anything else?
Yes, I'm sure. Is there something you want to talk to me about?
No.
I...
If there was, I wouldn't tell you.
Okay, then what happened?
Uh, oh! Aw.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
Ah-ah, you'll get your turn.
Hey, Pheebs. What's going on? - Hey. Nothing.
This is not over.
No, no, no! - What?
Ugh, I was up all night writing this really nasty letter to Emily.
It was perfect, and now it's all covered in...
Actually, thanks!
All right! Everybody ready to go to the movies?
Uh, actually, I think I'm gonna skip it.
Really? - I'm gonna stay and read my book.
I just want to be alone right now.
Oh. Sure you don't want to come?
Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan. They get mail and stuff.
That's okay, Joe. - All right.
Let's go, Pheebs.
Oh, God!
Bing!
Unh! - Aah!
Game!
Yeah, I gotta tell you, that partner of yours is a real tiger.
Are you all right?
We'll just get a little sip of water.
Am I on fire today or what?
Those birds are browned, basted and ready to be carved.
Okay, easy, Martina.
I think we should let them win the next game.
I'm sorry, I don't understand what you just said.
Let them win one.
Are you crazy? We own those two. Look at them!
He can't even breathe, and she's popping pills.
You're not giving them a chance.
They have rackets, don't they?
Uh, Bing, I think we're gonna make this the last game.
Yes, sir. Put me out of my misery.
Are you sure you never played pro? Ha-ha-ha.
Please let them win.
I'll take it down to 95 percent, but that's the best I can do.
Oopsie! Missed it! - I got it!
Nice shot.
I got it!
Long!
I can't believe you let them win.
Yeah, well, at least you hid your feelings well about it.
I was frustrated. - It was my racket.
I was frustrated with you!
If we hadn't lost, they would never have invited us to dinner tomorrow.
What bothers me...
...is how different you act around them.
The throwing the tennis games, the fake laugh...
...the "See you later, Bing!" "Not if I see you first, Doug!"
I don't like "work Chandler." The guy's a suck-up.
You know what? Because you said that...
...I'm not putting out tonight!
Something's wrong. My brother does not stay out all night.
Maybe we should check the trash chute.
Ross couldn't fit down the trash chute.
That's right. He almost could.
Which is exactly how I got stuck there.
Hey! - Hey.
Oh, my God!
Where the hell have you been?
Just, you know, out.
Oh, out! God, I don't know why we didn't think to check there.
What were you doing?
I, uh, went to a bar and then...
...I just, uh, walked around for a while.
You walked around all night in the city by yourself?
He hooked up!
He hooked up with someone.
I don't have to answer your questions. Okay? I'm a big boy.
I can do whatever I want.
He hooked up!
Tell us about her!
Ross, you left your scarf...
Hey, you guys.
Okay. Okay.
I know what you all are thinking, but Chandler is in Yemen.
I'm a young woman. I have needs. I can't wait forever.
Yeah, no, that's what I was thinking.
So I'm asking you, please just take a moment before you judge me.
Oh, nobody's judging you.
Oh.
Okay, you, Mr. Right-place-at-the-right-time...
...call me.
Okay, look, I know what you guys are going to say.
You two would have very hairy children.
I didn't know you'd say that.
Ross! Janice?
All right. Hold on, hold on, hold on.
This is Ross. Okay?
He's our friend. He obviously went crazy.
He obviously lost his mind.
I didn't lose my mind, okay? Janice and I have a lot in common.
We've both been divorced. We both have kids.
Are you going to see her again?
Don't put ideas in his head! - I am gonna see her again.
Damn it, Phoebe!
I have to tell you something that I've never admitted.
In high school, I made out with James even though I knew that you liked him.
Wow! That feels so good to get off my chest. Okay, you go.
My turn? What are you talking about? - Ugh.
Monica...
I know about you and Chandler.
What?
I overheard you on the phone the other day.
You said, "I'll tell Rachel I'm doing laundry for a couple of hours."
And he said, "Laundry? Is that my new nickname?"
And you said, "No.
You know what your nickname is, Mr. Big."
Well, heh...
Sounds like you're writing yourself a little play there, Rach.
Wow, I... Let me know how that one turns out.
I wouldn't know because I got so freaked out I hung up the phone.
Well, if you had kept listening, ha-ha-ha...
...you would have heard me call him Mister Big...
...ot. - What?
Mr. Bigot.
Ha, ha. He tells the most racist jokes.
All right. So that's it.
You're telling me there's nothing going on between you and Chandler?
Me and Chandler?
Put your $20 down. - Okay.
First one to find the tasty treat wins.
Okay? All right. - Mm-hm.
Let's get the contestants out of their isolation booths.
And they're off!
Whoa.
Get your foot off my contestant! Judge?
Judge rules no violation.
Agh.
Hey, guys. - Yeah.
It's so weird to say this, but I just had a great date with Janice.
What? - Are you serious?
Yeah. I opened up to her about all the terrible stuff that's been happening to me.
I mean, I talked for hours.
It is amazing...
...to have someone give you such focused attention.
You don't need Janice for that. You've got us.
And the duck gets the Nutter Butter! - No! Agh!
That's not a Nutter Butter. That's an old won ton!
Judge rules...
...Nutter Butter. - Ugh.
Tough call. - Yeah.
Seriously, I strongly believe that we should all support President Clinton...
...and her husband, Bill.
So how do you like your coffee?
None for me. - Just a little bit of sugar.
I'll have Monica stick her finger in it.
That ought to sweeten it up.
How does that not give you a headache? - You get used to it.
I don't think that I can.
Maybe this will be it for me on the work things.
So I laugh at my boss's jokes. What's the big deal?
I'd rather not hang out with this work-weasel guy...
...when I could be with my boyfriend, who I actually respect.
Oh.
Ah, heh.
I gotta apologize for Kara's coffee.
I'd feel sorry for it if it got in a fight.
It's not strong enough to defend itself. Ha-ha-ha!
Hear what I said?
What?
It's a joke, Bing. What's the matter with you?
Well, I just didn't think it was funny, sir.
Excuse me?
Well, I just... - Honey?
I just don't think you understood the joke.
Really? - Yeah.
I mean, it was really funny. I just don't think that you got it.
Heh, you see, Kara's coffee is weak-tasting.
But what Doug did was imply that it was weak physically.
You get it now, honey? - I think I do!
Thank you, Monica. - I thought you could use the help.
Ha-ha-ha.
Coffee in a fight!
Hey, Rach.
You mind if I read my comic books in here?
Sure. Why?
Chandler and Monica are over there. It's kind of hard to concentrate.
What? She just called and said she was going to be working late.
She keeps lying to me.
That's it! I'm gonna go over there and I'm confronting them right now.
So you're telling me that I have to tell racist jokes now?
I'm just not very good at this.
I'm a terrible liar. I hate having to lie to Rachel.
But we're not ready to tell yet. - I know.
Ever since high school, Rachel was the one person that I told everything to.
I miss that so much now.
She's my best friend.
Joey?
Oh, my God, Rachel! - Hey!
Hi!
What are you doing here?
Well, I actually came over here to borrow this lamp...
...to, um, look at my books.
You know, see them a little better. Heh.
Okay, great. Great. Um... - Yeah.
Well, what I was doing in Chandler's room is that, um...
...I was cleaning it.
In fact, he pays me to clean it. - Oh!
What a great way to make some extra pocket money.
When I said to you earlier that I was at work, um...
...I'm at my new work.
Good enough. Right?
Okay, well, um...
I'm gonna go look at my books.
Okay. Go get back to my new job. - Okay.
Okay.
Congratulations on your new job!
Man, she is really gullible.
Here you go. - Thanks.
Actually, I should get going. - You're sure?
I can stay out as late as you want.
I told you I'm on sabbatical from work...
Yes, yes. You did. Ha-ha-ha.
Oh, man! - What is wrong now?
This isn't what I ordered.
Man! Can't anything go right in my life?
First, my marriage falls apart, and then...
I know, I know!
You lose your apartment, then you lose your job...
...then your ex-wife gets married so fast! And now the coffee!
Aah!
Ross...
...we need to talk. - Okay.
Sometimes I feel... - No, no, don't.
I'm going to talk.
I believe...
...that the sun has set...
...on our day in the sun.
What? - You're a very sweet person, Ross.
Um...
Unfortunately...
...I just don't think I can take another second of you whining!
Let me make sure I'm hearing this right.
You're ending this with me because...
...I'm too whiny?
Mm.
So you're saying...
...I've become so whiny...
...that I...
...annoy you...
...Janice.
Well, yeah!
Oh, my God!
Are you gonna be okay? - I am now.
Okay.
Hi. - Oh, hi.
Well...
I guess, that's two out of three...
...Joey!
Dude, we gotta talk. - Okay.
I want to tell you something before you heard it from someone else.
I hope this isn't too weird but, uh...
...I had a thing with Janice.
You're not mad?
Why would I be mad?
Because there's certain rules about this kind of stuff.
You don't, uh... You don't fool around with your friends' ex-girlfriends...
...or, uh...
...possible girlfriends or girls they're related to.
I am mad.
But you know what I'm gonna do? I'm gonna forgive you.
Because that's what friends do.
They forgive their friends when they do everything you just said.
All the things on the list there. - Thank you.
But I want you to remember...
...that I forgave you.
Okay. - I also want you to remember...
...that I let you live here rent-free.
All right. - And I want you to remember...
...that I gave you 27 dollars.
No strings attached!
If you can't remember that...
...I think we should write it down. Let's write it down!

sense_groups.english: Bing! - Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到公司找新法律顾问公司 的消息了吗?
sense_groups.english: Did you hear about the new law firm working for us?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 杜塔 片达 豪伊事务所
sense_groups.english: No, sir. - Yeah, Dewey, Cheatem & Howe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去喝个痛快
sense_groups.english: Come on, let's go drink our body weight.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What was that? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才发出的声音
sense_groups.english: That noise you made?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的工作笑 - 你的工作笑？
sense_groups.english: Oh, that was my work laugh. - Your work laugh?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 想熬过这场派对 你也得编出一个来
sense_groups.english: If you're going to survive this party, you have to come up with one too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 看我的 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. Check me out. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说 "30块钱 跟城里一样"
sense_groups.english: He says, "$30, Father. Same as in town." Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚公司的人都好喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody at work loved you last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 而且他们因为你…
sense_groups.english: Really? - And they like me more...

sense_groups.chinese: 而更喜欢我
sense_groups.english: ...just because I was with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你弥补了不少乔伊造成的伤害
sense_groups.english: You repaired a lot of the damage from when they met Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 道格还找我们打网球 他出了公司还没理过我
sense_groups.english: Doug wants us to play tennis. He's never talked to me outside of work.

sense_groups.chinese: 除了在脱衣舞夜总会那次
sense_groups.english: Except for that time at that strip club.

sense_groups.chinese: 脱衣舞教堂
sense_groups.english: Strip church.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去找支球拍 - 你不是有支？
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go try to find a racket. - I thought you had one.

sense_groups.chinese: 本来有 后来被乔伊 拿去中央公园对着大石头打…
sense_groups.english: I used to, but then Joey thought it'd be fun to go to Central Park and hit rocks...

sense_groups.chinese: 石头
sense_groups.english: ...at bigger rocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你有网球拍吗？ - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, do you have a tennis racket? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我借给乔伊就没拿回来过
sense_groups.english: Oh, um, I lent it to Joey and I've never gotten it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Okay, good luck with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗?
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么来了?今天不是要盘点
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? I thought you had inventory.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 但我决定午休久一点
sense_groups.english: Well I do, but I decided I'd take a long lunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 陪陪我的朋友摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: ...and spend some time with my friend, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在都不谈心了
sense_groups.english: You know, I feel like we don't talk anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗?
sense_groups.english: How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么新变化?
sense_groups.english: What is new with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 呵 额…
sense_groups.english: Heh, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 不多 工作很顺利
sense_groups.english: Not much. Um, work's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必聊工作 什么都可以聊
sense_groups.english: We don't have to talk about work. We could talk about anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧
sense_groups.english: Hey! You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来聊感情的事
sense_groups.english: Let's talk about relationships.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你最近怎样？ - 没人追
sense_groups.english: Okay. What's going on with you? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 该你
sense_groups.english: You go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我原本觉得银行有一个人很帅
sense_groups.english: Well, I... There was this guy at the bank that I thought was cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在不觉得了
sense_groups.english: Um, but I don't anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 真精彩
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's, uh, juicy. Ahem, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我确实很忙
sense_groups.english: You know what? I actually do have a lot of work to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定没别的了?
sense_groups.english: You're sure there's just not anything else?

sense_groups.chinese: 确定 你有什么事想说吗?
sense_groups.english: Yes, I'm sure. Is there something you want to talk to me about?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
有也不告诉你
sense_groups.english: If there was, I wouldn't tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 然后呢?
sense_groups.english: Okay, then what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 额 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh, oh! Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会才轮到你
sense_groups.english: Ah-ah, you'll get your turn.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 在干什么？ - 没什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. What's going on? - Hey. Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会再继续
sense_groups.english: This is not over.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No, no, no! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我熬了一整晚写信骂艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I was up all night writing this really nasty letter to Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 原本写得很好 现在沾满了…
sense_groups.english: It was perfect, and now it's all covered in...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Actually, thanks!

sense_groups.chinese: 可以去看电影了吗?
sense_groups.english: All right! Everybody ready to go to the movies?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不去了
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, I think I'm gonna skip it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不去？ -对 我要留下来看书
sense_groups.english: Really? - I'm gonna stay and read my book.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在只想静一静
sense_groups.english: I just want to be alone right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不去?
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sure you don't want to come?

sense_groups.chinese: 汤姆·汉克斯 梅格·莱恩 写信什么的
sense_groups.english: Tom Hanks, Meg Ryan. They get mail and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不去了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: That's okay, Joe. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比我们走
sense_groups.english: Let's go, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 宾
sense_groups.english: Bing!

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Unh! - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 赢了
sense_groups.english: Game!

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你的搭档真是快狠准
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I gotta tell you, that partner of yours is a real tiger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗?
sense_groups.english: Are you all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们喝口水
sense_groups.english: We'll just get a little sip of water.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天很猛吧?
sense_groups.english: Am I on fire today or what?

sense_groups.chinese: 那两只肉鸡已经烤好 等着被切来吃了
sense_groups.english: Those birds are browned, basted and ready to be carved.

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 网球名将
sense_groups.english: Okay, easy, Martina.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得下一场应该让他们赢
sense_groups.english: I think we should let them win the next game.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你刚说的话我听不懂
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I don't understand what you just said.

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们赢一场
sense_groups.english: Let them win one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了吗?他们任我们宰割 你看他们
sense_groups.english: Are you crazy? We own those two. Look at them!

sense_groups.chinese: 他喘不过气来 她在吃药
sense_groups.english: He can't even breathe, and she's popping pills.

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本不给他们机会
sense_groups.english: You're not giving them a chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有球拍不是吗?
sense_groups.english: They have rackets, don't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 宾 我想打完这场就收了
sense_groups.english: Uh, Bing, I think we're gonna make this the last game.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解 我求之不得
sense_groups.english: Yes, sir. Put me out of my misery.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的没打过职业?
sense_groups.english: Are you sure you never played pro? Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托让他们赢
sense_groups.english: Please let them win.

sense_groups.chinese: 我顶多只能把战力降到95%
sense_groups.english: I'll take it down to 95 percent, but that's the best I can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 漏掉了 - 我来
sense_groups.english: Oopsie! Missed it! - I got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好球
sense_groups.english: Nice shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来
sense_groups.english: I got it!

sense_groups.chinese: 出界
sense_groups.english: Long!

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然让他们赢
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you let them win.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你把不爽掩饰得很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, at least you hid your feelings well about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很沮丧 - 这是我的球拍
sense_groups.english: I was frustrated. - It was my racket.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你让我沮丧
sense_groups.english: I was frustrated with you!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果没输那场球 他们也不会找我们去吃饭
sense_groups.english: If we hadn't lost, they would never have invited us to dinner tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最困扰的是…
sense_groups.english: What bothers me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在他们身边整个人都变了
sense_groups.english: ...is how different you act around them.

sense_groups.chinese: 故意输球 工作笑
sense_groups.english: The throwing the tennis games, the fake laugh...

sense_groups.chinese: "回头见 宾" "不回头就不见"
sense_groups.english: ...the "See you later, Bing!" "Not if I see you first, Doug!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢工作的钱德 那家伙是个狗腿
sense_groups.english: I don't like "work Chandler." The guy's a suck-up.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你这些话…
sense_groups.english: You know what? Because you said that...

sense_groups.chinese: 我晚上不跟你玩了
sense_groups.english: ...I'm not putting out tonight!

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对有问题 我哥从来不彻夜不归
sense_groups.english: Something's wrong. My brother does not stay out all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许应该去看看垃圾槽
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should check the trash chute.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯挤不进垃圾槽
sense_groups.english: Ross couldn't fit down the trash chute.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就差那么一点点
sense_groups.english: That's right. He almost could.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我之前卡住过
sense_groups.english: Which is exactly how I got stuck there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你死哪去了?
sense_groups.english: Where the hell have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是去外面了
sense_groups.english: Just, you know, out.

sense_groups.chinese: 外面 天哪 我们怎么没去那里找
sense_groups.english: Oh, out! God, I don't know why we didn't think to check there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你都在做什么?
sense_groups.english: What were you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我先去喝酒 然后…
sense_groups.english: I, uh, went to a bar and then...

sense_groups.chinese: 就晃了一下
sense_groups.english: ...I just, uh, walked around for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 你整夜一个人在外面乱逛？
sense_groups.english: You walked around all night in the city by yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 他嘿咻了
sense_groups.english: He hooked up!

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟某人嘿咻了
sense_groups.english: He hooked up with someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不必回答你们的问题 我是个大人
sense_groups.english: I don't have to answer your questions. Okay? I'm a big boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱怎样就怎样
sense_groups.english: I can do whatever I want.

sense_groups.chinese: 他嘿咻了
sense_groups.english: He hooked up!

sense_groups.chinese: 聊聊她嘛
sense_groups.english: Tell us about her!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你把围巾掉在…
sense_groups.english: Ross, you left your scarf...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我知道你们在想什么 但钱德在叶门
sense_groups.english: I know what you all are thinking, but Chandler is in Yemen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还年轻 我有需求 我不能等一辈子
sense_groups.english: I'm a young woman. I have needs. I can't wait forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是这么想的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, no, that's what I was thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我求求你们 在批评我之前先想一下
sense_groups.english: So I'm asking you, please just take a moment before you judge me.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人在批评你
sense_groups.english: Oh, nobody's judging you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你 天时地利人和先生
sense_groups.english: Okay, you, Mr. Right-place-at-the-right-time...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我联络
sense_groups.english: ...call me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们要说什么
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I know what you guys are going to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的孩子会毛茸茸的
sense_groups.english: You two would have very hairy children.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你会说那个
sense_groups.english: I didn't know you'd say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 珍妮丝耶
sense_groups.english: Ross! Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 等一下…
sense_groups.english: All right. Hold on, hold on, hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是罗斯
sense_groups.english: This is Ross. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我们的朋友 他显然是疯了
sense_groups.english: He's our friend. He obviously went crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 脑筋秀逗了
sense_groups.english: He obviously lost his mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 没那么夸张 好吗? 珍妮丝和我有很多共同点
sense_groups.english: I didn't lose my mind, okay? Janice and I have a lot in common.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都离过婚 我们都有小孩
sense_groups.english: We've both been divorced. We both have kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要再见她?
sense_groups.english: Are you going to see her again?

sense_groups.chinese: 别影响他 - 我确实要再见她
sense_groups.english: Don't put ideas in his head! - I am gonna see her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看啦 菲比
sense_groups.english: Damn it, Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说出一件我没坦承过的事
sense_groups.english: I have to tell you something that I've never admitted.

sense_groups.chinese: 高中时我知道你喜欢詹姆法洛 但我还是跟他上了床
sense_groups.english: In high school, I made out with James even though I knew that you liked him.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 说出来的感觉真好 好 该你了
sense_groups.english: Wow! That feels so good to get off my chest. Okay, you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 该我了？ - 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: My turn? What are you talking about? - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你和钱德的事
sense_groups.english: I know about you and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么?
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我那天听到你们在讲电话
sense_groups.english: I overheard you on the phone the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说"我会告诉瑞秋 我要花两个小时洗衣服"
sense_groups.english: You said, "I'll tell Rachel I'm doing laundry for a couple of hours."

sense_groups.chinese: 他说"洗衣服? 那是我的新绰号吗?"
sense_groups.english: And he said, "Laundry? Is that my new nickname?"

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你说"不是
sense_groups.english: And you said, "No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你明知你的绰号是大鹏"
sense_groups.english: You know what your nickname is, Mr. Big."

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你正在写剧本
sense_groups.english: Sounds like you're writing yourself a little play there, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得把结局告诉我
sense_groups.english: Wow, I... Let me know how that one turns out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 因为我吓到把电话挂掉了
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't know because I got so freaked out I hung up the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你听完
sense_groups.english: Well, if you had kept listening, ha-ha-ha...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会听到我是叫他大…
sense_groups.english: ...you would have heard me call him Mister Big...

sense_groups.chinese: 碉堡 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: ...ot. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 大碉堡
sense_groups.english: Mr. Bigot.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 他喜欢讲碉堡的笑话
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. He tells the most racist jokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 所以就这样
sense_groups.english: All right. So that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你和钱德之间没什么
sense_groups.english: You're telling me there's nothing going on between you and Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我和钱德?
sense_groups.english: Me and Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 拿出20元来 - 好
sense_groups.english: Put your $20 down. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 先找到零食的赢
sense_groups.english: First one to find the tasty treat wins.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay? All right. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 请参赛者从休息室出场
sense_groups.english: Let's get the contestants out of their isolation booths.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们出场了
sense_groups.english: And they're off!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 别挡住我的参赛者 栽判
sense_groups.english: Get your foot off my contestant! Judge?

sense_groups.chinese: 裁判判定没有违规
sense_groups.english: Judge rules no violation.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Agh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 说也奇怪 我今天跟珍妮丝过得很开心
sense_groups.english: It's so weird to say this, but I just had a great date with Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 真的假的？
sense_groups.english: What? - Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我跟她诉说近来的惨事
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I opened up to her about all the terrible stuff that's been happening to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说了好几个小时
sense_groups.english: I mean, I talked for hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人专心…
sense_groups.english: It is amazing...

sense_groups.chinese: 听你倾诉的感觉真好
sense_groups.english: ...to have someone give you such focused attention.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你何必找她 你有我们
sense_groups.english: You don't need Janice for that. You've got us.

sense_groups.chinese: 甲鸟子找到花生酱饼干了 - 不
sense_groups.english: And the duck gets the Nutter Butter! - No! Agh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是花生酱饼干 那是一颗馄饨
sense_groups.english: That's not a Nutter Butter. That's an old won ton!

sense_groups.chinese: 裁判判定
sense_groups.english: Judge rules...

sense_groups.chinese: 是花生酱饼干 - 额
sense_groups.english: ...Nutter Butter. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真难判 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Tough call. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我们应该支持克林顿总统
sense_groups.english: Seriously, I strongly believe that we should all support President Clinton...

sense_groups.chinese: 和她的老公比尔
sense_groups.english: ...and her husband, Bill.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的咖啡要怎么上?
sense_groups.english: So how do you like your coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要 谢谢 - 我要点点糖
sense_groups.english: None for me. - Just a little bit of sugar.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就让摩妮卡把指头伸进去
sense_groups.english: I'll have Monica stick her finger in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该就会甜了
sense_groups.english: That ought to sweeten it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你那样笑怎么不会头痛？ - 久了就习惯了
sense_groups.english: How does that not give you a headache? - You get used to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不觉得我会习惯
sense_groups.english: I don't think that I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以后就不用这套了
sense_groups.english: Maybe this will be it for me on the work things.

sense_groups.chinese: 老板说笑我就笑 这有什么吗?
sense_groups.english: So I laugh at my boss's jokes. What's the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果能跟我尊敬的男友在一起
sense_groups.english: I'd rather not hang out with this work-weasel guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 我干嘛陪一个没尊严的马屁精
sense_groups.english: ...when I could be with my boyfriend, who I actually respect.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 呵
sense_groups.english: Ah, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得为卡拉煮的咖啡道歉
sense_groups.english: I gotta apologize for Kara's coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果它去打架
sense_groups.english: I'd feel sorry for it if it got in a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 连自己都保护不了
sense_groups.english: It's not strong enough to defend itself. Ha-ha-ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到我的话了吗?
sense_groups.english: Hear what I said?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么?
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个笑话啊 你是怎么了?
sense_groups.english: It's a joke, Bing. What's the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得不好笑
sense_groups.english: Well, I just didn't think it was funny, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么?
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是… - 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Well, I just... - Honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你没听懂
sense_groups.english: I just don't think you understood the joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好笑耶 你一定是没听懂
sense_groups.english: I mean, it was really funny. I just don't think that you got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡拉煮的咖啡很稀
sense_groups.english: Heh, you see, Kara's coffee is weak-tasting.

sense_groups.chinese: 但道格是在暗示它很虚弱
sense_groups.english: But what Doug did was imply that it was weak physically.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你懂了吗？ - 我懂了
sense_groups.english: You get it now, honey? - I think I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 我觉得你需要解释
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Monica. - I thought you could use the help.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 咖啡打架
sense_groups.english: Coffee in a fight!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在这里看漫画吗?
sense_groups.english: You mind if I read my comic books in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 怎么了?
sense_groups.english: Sure. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和摩妮卡在一起 我很难专心
sense_groups.english: Chandler and Monica are over there. It's kind of hard to concentrate.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么?她刚打来说她要加班
sense_groups.english: What? She just called and said she was going to be working late.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一直骗我
sense_groups.english: She keeps lying to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我现在就过去揭穿他们
sense_groups.english: That's it! I'm gonna go over there and I'm confronting them right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我得讲碉堡的笑话?
sense_groups.english: So you're telling me that I have to tell racist jokes now?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我不太会圆谎
sense_groups.english: I'm just not very good at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很不会骗人 我又讨厌骗瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I'm a terrible liar. I hate having to lie to Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们还不能公开 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: But we're not ready to tell yet. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是从高中起 我什么事都告诉瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Ever since high school, Rachel was the one person that I told everything to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好怀念那种感觉
sense_groups.english: I miss that so much now.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: She's my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊?
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 瑞秋 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Rachel! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么跑来这里?
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛 我是来借这盏灯
sense_groups.english: Well, I actually came over here to borrow this lamp...

sense_groups.chinese: 好看书
sense_groups.english: ...to, um, look at my books.

sense_groups.chinese: 看得清楚一点
sense_groups.english: You know, see them a little better. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, great. Great. Um... - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在钱德的房间里是因为…
sense_groups.english: Well, what I was doing in Chandler's room is that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在帮忙打扫
sense_groups.english: ...I was cleaning it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他付钱请我打扫 - 是喔
sense_groups.english: In fact, he pays me to clean it. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个赚零用钱的好办法
sense_groups.english: What a great way to make some extra pocket money.

sense_groups.chinese: 之前我说要加班
sense_groups.english: When I said to you earlier that I was at work, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 是指我的新工作
sense_groups.english: ...I'm at my new work.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不错 对吧?
sense_groups.english: Good enough. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那…
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去看书了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go look at my books.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我得去忙我的新工作了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Go get back to my new job. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你找到这份工作
sense_groups.english: Congratulations on your new job!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 她可真好骗
sense_groups.english: Man, she is really gullible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的咖啡 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here you go. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我该走了 - 你确定？
sense_groups.english: Actually, I should get going. - You're sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想留多晚我都奉陪
sense_groups.english: I can stay out as late as you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过我为什么休长假吧?
sense_groups.english: I told you I'm on sabbatical from work...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你说过
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes. You did. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的 - 又怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, man! - What is wrong now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是点这个
sense_groups.english: This isn't what I ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的人生就不能顺利一点吗?
sense_groups.english: Man! Can't anything go right in my life?

sense_groups.chinese: 先是我的婚姻破裂 然后…
sense_groups.english: First, my marriage falls apart, and then...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know, I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你被赶出你家 你的工作没了
sense_groups.english: You lose your apartment, then you lose your job...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的前妻很快就再婚 现在咖啡又错了
sense_groups.english: ...then your ex-wife gets married so fast! And now the coffee!

sense_groups.chinese: 哎呀
sense_groups.english: Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得谈谈 - 好
sense_groups.english: ...we need to talk. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时我觉得… - 不…
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I feel... - No, no, don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我要说
sense_groups.english: I'm going to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为
sense_groups.english: I believe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的美好时光
sense_groups.english: ...that the sun has set...

sense_groups.chinese: 已经落日了
sense_groups.english: ...on our day in the sun.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你是个很好的人
sense_groups.english: What? - You're a very sweet person, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是…
sense_groups.english: Unfortunately...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法再听你哀下去了
sense_groups.english: ...I just don't think I can take another second of you whining!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你确认一下
sense_groups.english: Let me make sure I'm hearing this right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我结束 因为…
sense_groups.english: You're ending this with me because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我太会发牢骚?
sense_groups.english: ...I'm too whiny?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说…
sense_groups.english: So you're saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是这么的爱发牢骚
sense_groups.english: ...I've become so whiny...

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你…
sense_groups.english: ...that I...

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝…
sense_groups.english: ...annoy you...

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得很烦
sense_groups.english: ...Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不要紧吧？ - 现在不要紧了
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna be okay? - I am now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 已经两人出局了
sense_groups.english: I guess, that's two out of three...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: ...Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得谈谈 - 好
sense_groups.english: Dude, we gotta talk. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想趁你听说之前告诉你
sense_groups.english: I want to tell you something before you heard it from someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望不会太奇怪
sense_groups.english: I hope this isn't too weird but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我最近跟珍妮丝交柱过
sense_groups.english: ...I had a thing with Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不生气?
sense_groups.english: You're not mad?

sense_groups.chinese: 我干嘛生气?
sense_groups.english: Why would I be mad?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这种事有它的道义在
sense_groups.english: Because there's certain rules about this kind of stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能追朋友的旧情人
sense_groups.english: You don't, uh... You don't fool around with your friends' ex-girlfriends...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是…
心上人 或是有亲属关系的人
sense_groups.english: ...possible girlfriends or girls they're related to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很生气
sense_groups.english: I am mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你知道吗?我要原谅你
sense_groups.english: But you know what I'm gonna do? I'm gonna forgive you.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那样才叫兄弟
sense_groups.english: Because that's what friends do.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会原谅朋友 犯了你念的…
sense_groups.english: They forgive their friends when they do everything you just said.

sense_groups.chinese: 那串禁忌 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: All the things on the list there. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我要你记住
sense_groups.english: But I want you to remember...

sense_groups.chinese: 我原谅了你
sense_groups.english: ...that I forgave you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 我还要你记住
sense_groups.english: Okay. - I also want you to remember...

sense_groups.chinese: 我免费收留你
sense_groups.english: ...that I let you live here rent-free.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 我还要你记住
sense_groups.english: All right. - And I want you to remember...

sense_groups.chinese: 我送你27块钱
sense_groups.english: ...that I gave you 27 dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 无条件奉送
sense_groups.english: No strings attached!

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你记不住
sense_groups.english: If you can't remember that...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该写 我们写下来吧
sense_groups.english: ...I think we should write it down. Let's write it down!

questions.name: S05E13
questions.en:
Ah, I can't believe we've never done this. It's so good!
It's so good for Monica.
Time's up! My turn.
That was half an hour? - It's your timer.
Okay. - All right.
I don't like to brag about it, but I give the best massages.
All right, then massage me up right nice!
Aah! Aah! Aah.
It's so good, isn't it?
I don't know what I did to deserve it.
Say goodbye to sore muscles!
Goodbye, muscles!
She gives the worst massages ever.
It was like she was torturing me for information.
I wanted to give it up. I just didn't know what it was!
If it hurts that bad, you should tell her.
For the first time, I'm in a real relationship.
I won't screw that up by telling the truth.
Dude, look out!
You almost crushed my hat.
Sorry.
And the bunny got away.
This would be the place where you explain the hat.
Oh. Yeah.
There's this play, right?
I'm up for the part of this cool, suave, international guy.
A clothes horse, so I figure...
...everyone at the audition will wear ultra-hip, high fashion stuff.
And you'll make them disappear?
Like you could find something this sophisticated.
Done!
If you want to look good, come to the store. I'll help you.
Thanks! - Sure.
Please, take those off!
Hey, Pheebs. How's it going?
Um, only okay. Because I just got back from the hospital.
Are you all right?
I'm fine. But, uh, my grandma sort of died.
Pheebs, sorry. - It's okay.
She had a really incredible life.
It's not like I won't see her again. She'll visit.
Maybe she's with us right now.
Right. She's on a new spiritual plane and she'll come to the coffeehouse.
I just saw two people having sex in a car right outside!
Uh, Pheebs' grandmother just died.
Oh, my God! I'm so sorry.
Actually, it's kind of cool. Because it's like...
...you know, one life ends and another begins.
Not the way they're doing it.
What happened? How did she die?
We were in the market...
...and she bent down to get some yogurt and never came back up again.
I'm so sorry.
The last thing she said was
"You get the eggs, I'll get the yogurt, and we'll meet at the checkout counter."
You know what?
We will meet at the checkout counter.
Since you're returning all this stuff...
...you'll have to wear underwear.
All right. You'd better show me that too.
It's missing something.
Oh, I know. Um, okay.
Really? A purse?
It's not a purse. It's a shoulder bag.
It looks like a woman's purse. - No.
Trust me, all the men are carrying them in the spring catalog.
See, look. Men carrying the bag.
See, look. Women carrying the bag.
But it is odd how a woman's purse looks so good on me, a man.
Exactly. Unisex!
Maybe you need sex. I had sex a couple days ago.
No, Joey. U-N-I sex.
I ain't going to say no to that!
Who is it? - It's Phoebe.
Oh, great!
Oh, you.
Um, what's up?
Um, well, I sort of have some bad news. Can I come in?
Um, no, thanks.
Um...
Well, um, Grandma died today. - Wow!
Didn't she die like five years ago?
No, she just died today.
Um, we're having a memorial service tomorrow.
Okay, I know I went to that already.
No, you didn't!
Then who's been dead?
Lots of people!
Look, are you coming or not?
Um, no.
I thought she was dead, so I've made my peace.
Plus I'm going to a concert.
I'd invite you, but, um, I only have two tickets left.
Fine. Okay, enjoy your concert. - Thanks. Enjoy your funeral!
Hey. - Hey.
You look just like your son, Mrs. Tribbiani.
What? Are you referring to my man's bag?
I thought it just looked good, but it's practical too.
It's got compartments for all your stuff.
Your wallet, keys, address book... - Your makeup.
What are you doing? The audition's tomorrow.
Yeah, but sandwich time is right now.
You get mustard on that bag, you can't return it.
Why would I return this? I love this bag!
All right, then you owe me $350. - Fine.
Do you take Vasa or Mooster Card?
Joey...
Relax, I'll pay you with the money from the job I'll get. Thanks to you.
What's the part? Auntie Mame?
Don't listen to them. I think it's sexy.
You-and-I sexy?
Hello, Mrs. Pinilla. Thank you for coming.
Here's your, um, 3-D glasses.
Reverend Pong will say when to put them on.
Hi, sweetie.
How are you holding up? - Fine.
Hey, Pheebs. I'm so sorry.
You know what? My grandma had the exact same bag!
I brought you flowers.
Oh, thanks!
Pulling flowers out makes the bag look masculine.
Excuse me, is this the, uh, memorial?
Welcome.
Here's your 3-D glasses.
All right.
So how did you know Frances?
Actually, I hadn't seen her for years.
But, um, I was pretty tight with her and her daughter.
What's your name?
Frank Buffay.
You know what? Strike that. My name, uh, actually, is Joe.
Um, uh, Joe, uh, Hill.
You're Frank Buf... - Shh. No! Joe Hill.
You just said...
I got to go. Thank you so much for coming.
But...
Oh, my God!
What happened?
That was my dad.
Oh, my God! What? - Check it out!
It's like it's coming right at me.
Did you catch him? - What did he say?
He said, um, "Nice to meet you, Glenda."
I couldn't give him my real name.
Why not?
You saw the way he ran.
You think he'd talk to the daughter he abandoned?
What did you say to him?
I said I was the executor of the will and I needed to talk to him.
I'm going to meet him at the coffeehouse.
Could everyone take their seats?
I just can't think about that now.
I want to say goodbye to my grandma. - Okay.
Let's go say goodbye.
I'm off to my audition. How do I look?
Great! That bag will get you that part.
And a date with a man.
You know what? Make fun all you want. This is a great bag.
And it's as handy as it is becoming.
Just because you don't understand something, doesn't make it wrong.
You guys have to get used to the fact that Joey...
...comes with a bag!
I've got to meet my dad.
Will you tell him who you are?
Not at first. I don't want to freak him out.
But aren't you pissed at him?
This guy abandoned you.
If it were me, this guy would be in some serious physical danger.
I'd walk in there, I'd be like, "Yo, Dad!
You and me, outside. Right now!"
I kind of scared myself.
Well, at least you scared someone.
You'd think I'd be angry.
You'd think I'd want to rip his tiny little head off!
Fortunately, I'm past it.
You do seem a little tense. Here, let me help you.
Oh, get off! Ow!
Stop it! Why are you doing that to me?
What are you talking about?
As a masseuse and a human...
...I'm begging you, never do that to anyone.
I give good massages.
I gave them to Rachel before she got allergic.
And Chandler, he loves them! Watch.
He does not like it. He's in pain!
No, he's not. - Yes, he is!
What? - I'm sorry but, ow!
You've been lying to me?
I can't believe that.
Maybe he didn't want to hurt you.
But the minute we start to lie to each other...
And by "we"...
...I mean society.
Anytime you're ready.
Ahem, well, you must be new here.
Maybe we get a table, I buy you a drink.
Could you try it without the purse?
Yeah, sure.
Ahem, well, you must be new here. Maybe we sit...
Can I ask you something? - Sure. What?
Well, first, it's not a purse.
Okay...
Anytime.
If you think it's a woman's bag, it's not.
It's a man's bag.
Okay. And go.
Let me show you the catalog.
Look. See?
Huh? It's the latest thing.
Everyone's got one. Men, women, children.
Do you sell these?
No, these babies sell themselves.
Thank you. That was great.
But I didn't read anything.
I think we've seen enough.
All right, I'll see you.
We got it. We got it.
Is Rachel here? - No.
Listen, I just wanted to apologize about the whole massage thing.
I really like them.
Please stop.
We're supposed to be honest.
I wish you could tell me, "I don't like your massages."
I don't like your massages.
See? It's no big deal.
But now you're crying.
I'm not crying about that. I'm crying about something at work.
My boyfriend said he didn't like my massages.
You don't have to be best at everything.
Oh, my God! You don't know me at all!
Okay...
You give the worst massages in the world.
I'm crying here!
Look, hear me out.
You give the best bad massages.
If anybody was looking for the best bad massage...
...and they thought, "Who's the best?"
They'd have to go to you.
Huh.
So you're saying that if there was an award...
...for the best bad massage... Who would get that?
It would be you!
You, Monica! And you'd get all the votes.
So they could call the award, "The Monica"?
Absolutely.
Okay...
I suck!
Thank you for meeting me.
Thank you.
Come sit.
Sit.
Sit!
Um, alrighty. Um, before we get started, I need you...
...to state for the record that you are, in fact, Frank Buffay.
Yes, I am. Mm-hm.
Okay. - So, what did Frances leave me?
Huh? - That's why you wanted me to come.
Oh, yes.
Yes, she did. She left you, um...
...this lipstick.
Oh. Huh.
Oh, it's, ew, used.
Uh, cool.
I have just a few questions to ask, so I'll get out my official forms.
So question one
You were married to Frances' daughter, Lilly. Correct?
Yes, I was.
Okay, um, question two: Um, did that marriage end...
...A, happily...
...B, medium...
...or, C, in the total abandonment...
...of her and her two children?
It really says that?
Yeah, see?
I guess then I would have to say C.
Total abandonment.
Reasons for abandonment
Um, A, top secret government work...
...B, amnesia...
...or, C, you're just a selfish, irresponsible...
...bad, bad man.
I don't want the lipstick that much.
Would you do me a favor?
Would you give Lilly...
...that, please? What?
When you see Lilly, give her that note.
I wanted to talk to her at the memorial...
...but I pictured her getting mad the way you did, and I chickened out.
I wrote her a note. Give it to her, please?
But you came to see Lilly?
Yeah. Why?
Lilly's dead.
She what?
She's dead.
Are you sure?
If she isn't, cremating her was a big mistake.
I can't believe this. I just can't believe...
How? Oh, my God.
How long ago?
Seventeen years ago.
