sense_groups.chinese: 应该不是 不过你待会可以玩连连看
sense_groups.english: I think that's wrong, but there's a connect-the-dots in here for you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 赭红色呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how, uh, about maroon?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你好聪明 - 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Yes! You are so smart! - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好可爱喔
sense_groups.english: You guys are so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 明天早上见
sense_groups.english: All right. I'll see you in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最喜欢跟你填字谜了
sense_groups.english: You know, I love doing crossword puzzles with you, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Oh, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快填完去睡觉 - 好
sense_groups.english: Now, let's finish this and go to bed. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩个
sense_groups.english: There's only one left.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个字的动物 不是小狗 是…
sense_groups.english: Three-letter word. Not dog, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 猫咪
sense_groups.english: Cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好聪明
sense_groups.english: You are so smart!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还差小费
sense_groups.english: We still need a tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 等等
sense_groups.english: All right. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 有了…
sense_groups.english: I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 5分钱
sense_groups.english: Nickel.

sense_groups.chinese: 还差多少？ - 2块钱
sense_groups.english: How much more do we need? - Couple of bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 10分钱
sense_groups.english: Okay, dime.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们继续聊 我会多花一点时问
sense_groups.english: You guys should probably keep talking. This could take a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你们看
sense_groups.english: Wait, lookit!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这是警徽
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. This is a police badge!

sense_groups.chinese: 真酷 但警察来这里干嘛？这里又不卖甜甜圈
sense_groups.english: Oh, cool. But why would a cop come in here? They don't serve doughnuts. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能重来一次？
sense_groups.english: Can you discover the badge again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以说个更好笑的
sense_groups.english: I think I can come up with something better than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 一定有人正在找那个警徽
sense_groups.english: I bet somebody's missing that badge.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我应该送回去 知道吗？我去了警察局
sense_groups.english: I should take it back. Ooh, but while I'm at the police station...

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以看看十大通缉犯名单
sense_groups.english: ...I could check their Ten Most Wanted list.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友丽西一直是第十一大 她今年也许会出运
sense_groups.english: My friend Fritzi's been Number 11 forever. This could be her year!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. - Hey, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的衣服吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that my sweatshirt?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 是它 对不起 我很冷就借来穿了 没关系吧？
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is. I'm sorry. I borrowed it. I was cold. I hope it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要穿 应该穿你男朋友…
sense_groups.english: It's just that, uh, if you wear someone's sweatshirt...

sense_groups.chinese: 的衣服才对吧？
sense_groups.english: ...shouldn't it be your boyfriend's?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是你的男朋友
sense_groups.english: And I'm not him.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我现在就还你
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'll give it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No, no. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 上面会沾满你的味道
sense_groups.english: It's going to be all smelling like Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说我很臭吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you saying I smell bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有一股青草香
sense_groups.english: You smell like a meadow.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊上次去青草地 他妈妈被猎人射杀了
sense_groups.english: The last time Joey went to a meadow, his mother was shot by a hunter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不确定
sense_groups.english: I still don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我想买到理想的沙发 我希望这张沙发能让人觉得
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I just want to make sure I bought the right couch, one that says

sense_groups.chinese: "欢迎小朋友"同时也能让人觉得
sense_groups.english: "Kids welcome here," but that also says

sense_groups.chinese: "来我身边吧"
sense_groups.english: "Come here to me."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你对小朋友说那种话？
sense_groups.english: What? You say that to kids?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: "来我身边吧" 是对小姐们说的
sense_groups.english: The "Come here to me" is, you know, for the ladies.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这是张好沙发 但不是神奇沙发
sense_groups.english: Ross, honey, it's a nice couch, not a magic couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的选择很正确
sense_groups.english: Well, you picked a great couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 请在这里签个名 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sign here please. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是…
sense_groups.english: Oh, what's, heh...?

sense_groups.chinese: 运费几乎跟沙发价格一样贵
sense_groups.english: The delivery charge is almost as much as the couch!

sense_groups.chinese: 太扯了 他家离这里才三条街
sense_groups.english: That's ridiculous. He lives three blocks away.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我自己搬就好 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'll take it myself. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 来吧
sense_groups.english: All right, Rach, come on. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 开什么玩笑
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 才三条街 又不是很重 抬抬看 快
sense_groups.english: Come on. It's only three blocks. Uh, it's not very heavy. Try it.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我行嘛 - 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can do it. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会很喜欢这张沙发的
sense_groups.english: You two will really enjoy that couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是一对
sense_groups.english: We're, uh, not together.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 好吧 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Yeah. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪我觉得怪怪的
sense_groups.english: Something didn't quite add up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 这话是什么意思？ - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: What's that supposed to mean? - Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你 她
sense_groups.english: Well, you. Her. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很…你知道 而你却…
sense_groups.english: I mean, she's very...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道
sense_groups.english: ...you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 和你一样…
sense_groups.english: And you're, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道？
sense_groups.english: ...you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然与你无关 但我们确实交往过
sense_groups.english: Not that it's any of your business, but we did go out.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你们两个？
sense_groups.english: Really? You two?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在不想讲这个 我抬着一张很重的沙发
sense_groups.english: I don't want to do this now. I'm carrying a heavy couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就赶快告诉他
sense_groups.english: Then tell him quickly.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们交往过
sense_groups.english: Fine. We went out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只交往过
sense_groups.english: Not only did we go out...

sense_groups.chinese: 还做过298次
sense_groups.english: ...we did it 298 times!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我实在…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my...

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然有在算？你真没用
sense_groups.english: Ugh, you kept count? You are such a loser!

sense_groups.chinese: 再没用你也做了298次
sense_groups.english: A loser you did it with 298 times!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 这位小姐 你不能在树上熄香烟
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, ma'am. You can't put your cigarette out on a tree.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 很方便
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I can. It worked well.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不该这么做 别再这么做了
sense_groups.english: But you shouldn't. So don't ever do that again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会了… 抽下一根烟之前不会
sense_groups.english: I won't till I have my next cigarette.

sense_groups.chinese: 站住
sense_groups.english: Hold it!

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约警察 别动
sense_groups.english: NYPD. Freeze, punk!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你被活逮了
sense_groups.english: That's right. You are so busted.

sense_groups.chinese: 把她带走
sense_groups.english: Book them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在跟谁说话？ - 别挣扎了 红发女
sense_groups.english: Who are you talking to? - Save it, red!

sense_groups.chinese: 不想在笼子里过夜 就跟那棵树道歉
sense_groups.english: Unless you want to spend the night in the slammer, you apologize to the tree.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不跟一棵树道歉
sense_groups.english: I am not going to apologize to a tree.

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快道歉 否则我要叫人了
sense_groups.english: You apologize to the tree right now, or I am calling for backup.

sense_groups.chinese: 来人啊 来人啊
sense_groups.english: Backup! Backup!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry! Sorry!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 别来了 别来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, cancel backup! Cancel backup!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你不是说有电梯？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you say there was, um, an elevator in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有说 但其实没有 来吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, yes, I did, but there isn't. Here we go!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 往左
sense_groups.english: Okay, go left.

sense_groups.chinese: 左 左…
sense_groups.english: Left. Left.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 已经没有左可以往左了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? There's no more left left.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 抬高到你的头上
sense_groups.english: Lift it straight up over your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 抬高到你的头上 你行的
sense_groups.english: Straight up over your head. You can do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你行的
sense_groups.english: You can do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没问题吧？ - 很好
sense_groups.english: Okay. You got it? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 走 走 - 好 好
sense_groups.english: Go, go. - Good, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题吧？没问题吧？没问…
sense_groups.english: You got it, right? You got it, right? You got...

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得放在那里如何？
sense_groups.english: Any chance you think the couch looks good there?

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙还在碎碎念
sense_groups.english: This guy was all...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就说"重案组布非"
sense_groups.english: And I'm all, "Buffay! Homicide!"

sense_groups.chinese: 真是酷毙了
sense_groups.english: It was just so cool! Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你应该拿去还的
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you were supposed to take that back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但行善的感觉好棒
sense_groups.english: I know, but I'm having so much fun doing good deeds.

sense_groups.chinese: 但假扮警察很严重 你会被逮捕的
sense_groups.english: Okay, but impersonating a police officer is a serious thing. You can get arrested.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在就会被逮捕
sense_groups.english: You could get arrested right now!

sense_groups.chinese: 我得拿去还 我被权力冲昏头了
sense_groups.english: All right, yeah, I'd better take it back. I'm totally drunk with power.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你们会在
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I didn't know you guys were gonna be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你尝尝看 - 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: Do me a favor, sweetie. Taste this. - What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么了？ - 没事啊
sense_groups.english: What is going on with you? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你一整天都怪怪的
sense_groups.english: You've been acting strange all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 是有一件事
sense_groups.english: All right. There is something. I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了一个梦…
sense_groups.english: I kind of had a dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不想谈
sense_groups.english: But I don't want to talk about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 马丁·路德·金也这么说还得了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, whoa. What if Martin Luther King had said that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一个梦…
sense_groups.english: I kind of have a dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不想谈
sense_groups.english: I don't want to talk about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟摩妮卡有关
sense_groups.english: Look, it involved Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你梦到我在交往的女孩？真酷
sense_groups.english: You had a dream about a girl I'm seeing? Oh, that is so cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知梦见他的女朋友多少次
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how many times I dreamt about a girl he was seeing.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我们在谈你的梦 我爱你 你的梦？
sense_groups.english: Anyway, we were talking about your dream. I love you. Your dream?

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 没有任何性意味 自从发现你们的事…
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, there wasn't any sex in it. I haven't dreamt about her like that...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不对她做那种梦了
sense_groups.english: ...since I found out about you two-ish.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你梦到什么？
sense_groups.english: What was the dream about?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我的女朋友 我们在填字谜
sense_groups.english: You were my girlfriend. We were doing the crossword puzzle.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像你们昨晚那样
sense_groups.english: Like you guys were doing last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样 我爱上摩妮卡了 我会搬走
sense_groups.english: So that's it. I'm in love with Monica and I'll be moving out.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊等等 那并不代表你爱我
sense_groups.english: Joey, come on. That doesn't mean that you're in love with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: It doesn't?

sense_groups.chinese: 它可能有很多涵义 例如…
sense_groups.english: It could mean anything. Like, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你突然眼红我成为这里的猛男
sense_groups.english: ...all of a sudden you're jealous that I've become the apartment stud.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来比较像你的梦
sense_groups.english: Kind of sounds like your dream, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是你看到我和钱德很亲密…
sense_groups.english: Or it could mean you saw Chandler and me together, being close and stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 你也想跟别人拥有这种关系
sense_groups.english: ...and you just wanna have that with someone too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在梦里的确很享受那种亲密
sense_groups.english: In the dream I did enjoy the closeness.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听着
sense_groups.english: Okay, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在此时此刻爱上摩妮卡吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you attracted to Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是现在 你吸引到她？
sense_groups.english: Right here, right now, are you attracted to her?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实没有 - 这就对了
sense_groups.english: Not really. - There you have it!

sense_groups.chinese: 当然啊 我穿得这么随便
sense_groups.english: Heh. Well, sure! I'm just wearing sweats!

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是好事
sense_groups.english: But that's good!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是爱我 你只是想交个女朋友
sense_groups.english: You're not in love with me. You just want a girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得不是交女朋友的问题
sense_groups.english: No, I don't think it's just about getting a girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我可以找个女朋友
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I could get a girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们可以坐在那里填字谜
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we could sit in the chair and do crossword puzzles.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们会拥有你们那种亲密吗？
sense_groups.english: But are we ever gonna have the closeness like you guys have?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和我是从朋友做起 也许关键在这里
sense_groups.english: Monica and I were friends before we started dating. Maybe that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 先做朋友？
sense_groups.english: Friends first?

sense_groups.chinese: 有意思
sense_groups.english: That's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都事后当朋友？ - 没有 也从来没有过
sense_groups.english: You become friends after? - No, never done that either.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们有量尺吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, do you guys have a tape measure?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 在我房里
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. It's actually in my bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's up, Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 这是你的车吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Is this your car? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 停在这里不太好 你挡住出入口了
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't think it's nice of you to park here. You're blocking the entrance.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it. It's not a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得有关系 你就有关系 因为我是条子
sense_groups.english: It's a problem for me, which means it's a problem for you because I'm a cop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: So am I.

sense_groups.chinese: 完了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你是条子 可以任意停车
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. So you're a cop. You can park anywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个我知道 因为我也是条子
sense_groups.english: I know that because I'm a cop too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 继续努力 收到
sense_groups.english: All right. Keep up the good work. Ten-four.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你是哪个分局的？
sense_groups.english: Wait a second. So, what precinct are you with?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在57分局
sense_groups.english: I'm with the, um, the 57th.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认识你们重案组一位刑警 - 我在风化组
sense_groups.english: I know a guy in Homicide up there. - I'm in Vice.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我正在卧底 我是妓女
sense_groups.english: In fact, I'm undercover right now. I'm a whore.

sense_groups.chinese: 风化组还有谁？
sense_groups.english: Who else is in Vice up there?

sense_groups.chinese: 你认识…
sense_groups.english: Um, do you know, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 西波威兹吗？
sense_groups.english: ...Sipowitz?

sense_groups.chinese: 西波威兹？应该不认识
sense_groups.english: Sipowitz? No, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 西波威兹 大块头 有点秃
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Sipowitz. Yeah. Big guy, kind of bald.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认识他
sense_groups.english: I don't know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要打给他 他不在 他出去了
sense_groups.english: Don't try to call him or anything. Because he's not there. He's out.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的拍档刚死了
sense_groups.english: His, um, partner just died.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我跟西波威兹致意
sense_groups.english: Tell Sipowitz I'm real sorry for his loss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的 保重
sense_groups.english: I sure will. Take care.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我相信西波威兹不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Hey, by the way, I'm sure Sipowitz is gonna be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说那个新来的小伙子很不错
sense_groups.english: I heard that kid from Silver Spoons is really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在哪里找到我的警徽的？
sense_groups.english: Where'd you find my badge?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 你能不能帮我和罗斯搬沙发？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey, would you mind giving me and Ross a hand moving his couch?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想 但我要去上表演课
sense_groups.english: Aw, I'd love to but I got acting class. But you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我可以为了你跷课
sense_groups.english: I guess I could blow that off for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你件事 我刚在对面跟摩妮卡钱德聊天
sense_groups.english: Uh, let me ask you something. I was talking with Monica and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们可真亲密
sense_groups.english: Boy, they are really tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那种关系实在很不错
sense_groups.english: That's not a bad situation they got over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想自己弄一段
sense_groups.english: Thinking of getting me one of those.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想说什么？
sense_groups.english: What's up, Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得他们感觉会那么好…
sense_groups.english: The reason I think Monica and Chandler are so great...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为他们是先做朋友
sense_groups.english: ...is because they were friends first, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我问自己 谁是我朋友？你和菲比
sense_groups.english: So I asked myself, who are my friends? You and Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我先遇见你 所以…
sense_groups.english: I saw you first, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 呵 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Heh. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？ - 我是说也许你我可以更进步
sense_groups.english: What are you saying? - I'm saying maybe you and I crank it up a notch.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: You know, honey, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你先过见我真令我
sense_groups.english: ...as, uh, flattered as I am...

sense_groups.chinese: 受宠若惊
sense_groups.english: ...that you saw me first...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不觉得我们应该更进一步
sense_groups.english: ...uh, I just don't think we should be cranking anything up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会对你很好
sense_groups.english: I'll treat you real nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你知道吗…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Well, you know, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得先做朋友再交往 是一个很好的想法
sense_groups.english: Listen, I think it's a great idea to become friends with someone before you date.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你应该先去认识一个人 跟她做朋友
sense_groups.english: But I think the way you do it is you meet someone, become their friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 建立基础 再约她出去
sense_groups.english: ...build a foundation, then ask them out on a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 别对现有的朋友下手
sense_groups.english: Don't hit on your existing friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是要很久？
sense_groups.english: Won't that take longer?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是一旦得到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, but once you find it...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很值得
sense_groups.english: ...it's so worth the wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂
sense_groups.english: I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 如果先遇见菲比就好了
sense_groups.english: Man, I wish I saw Phoebe first.

sense_groups.chinese: 来我身边吧
sense_groups.english: Come here to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你来我身边
sense_groups.english: No, no. You come here to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 我带援军来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 是乔伊吗？ - 只比他差点
sense_groups.english: Ahem, I brought reinforcements. - Oh, great! You brought Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我带来了一件好事情
sense_groups.english: I brought the next best thing. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？你带钱德来？只差一点的应该是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: You brought Chandler? The next best thing would be Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该要不爽 但摩妮卡真的壮得可怕
sense_groups.english: I would be offended, but Monica is freakishly strong, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我画了一张搬运草图
sense_groups.english: Look, I drew a sketch of how we'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 瑞秋 这是你
sense_groups.english: Rach, that's you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是沙发
sense_groups.english: That's the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把自己看得很雄壮喔
sense_groups.english: Certainly think a lot of yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是我的手臂
sense_groups.english: No. That's my arm.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔… 我知道了 我想你真的 真的很喜欢你的新沙发
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see. I thought you just really, really liked your new couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之听我的指示
sense_groups.english: Just follow my lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 开始了 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以了吗？
sense_groups.english: All right. Ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 - 可以
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 转 - 好
sense_groups.english: Turn! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 转
sense_groups.english: Turn!

sense_groups.chinese: 转
sense_groups.english: Turn!

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是转不动了 - 我觉得挤不上去
sense_groups.english: I don't think we can turn anymore! - I don't think it'll fit!

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 快抬起来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it will. Come on! Up, up, up!

sense_groups.chinese: 抬起来
sense_groups.english: Up! Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 中心点
sense_groups.english: Here we go! Pivot!

sense_groups.chinese: 中心点
sense_groups.english: Pivot!

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴 闭嘴 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up! Shut up! Shut up!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我看是上不来了
sense_groups.english: I don't think it's gonna pivot anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: You think?

sense_groups.chinese: 搬下去再来一次
sense_groups.english: All right, let's, uh, bring it back down and try again.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在真的卡死了
sense_groups.english: I think it's really stuck now.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不到居然没成功 - 就是啊 我也没想到
sense_groups.english: I can't believe that didn't work. - I know. Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 你都画了图了
sense_groups.english: I mean, you had a sketch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说"中心点"是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What did you mean when you said "pivot"?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？有交到新朋友吗？
sense_groups.english: How's it going? Did you make any new friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我认识了一个女人
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I met this woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 哇哦 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Hey. Whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 她怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What's she like?

sense_groups.chinese: 她的…
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, she's...

sense_groups.chinese: 床上功夫很棒
sense_groups.english: ...really good in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你不是要先当朋友？
sense_groups.english: I thought you were going to try to be friends first.

sense_groups.chinese: 都是你的错 - 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's all your fault. - What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你给的不是忠告 是搭讪词
sense_groups.english: You didn't give me advice. You gave me a pickup line.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一说要建立基础 先当朋友
sense_groups.english: I told her I wanted to "build a foundation and be friends."

sense_groups.chinese: 她突然就…与我本身无关 觉得我难以抗拒
sense_groups.english: Suddenly, through no fault of my own, I became irresistible to her!

sense_groups.chinese: 她的室友也是
sense_groups.english: And her roommate!

sense_groups.chinese: 那亲密关系呢？
sense_groups.english: What about the "closeness"?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁还管亲密啊 我们玩三P耶
sense_groups.english: Closeness, schmosness! There was three of us, for crying out loud!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要吃彼萨？
sense_groups.english: Who wants pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要…
sense_groups.english: I do! I do! I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 赞 这是我在二楼捡到的
sense_groups.english: This is great! Can you believe I found this on the second floor?

sense_groups.chinese: 哪位？ - 纽约警察
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - NYPD.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 等下 警察先生
sense_groups.english: Uh, just a minute, officer!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要找菲比布非 - 完了 是那个警察
sense_groups.english: I'm looking for Phoebe Buffay. - My God, it's him! It's that cop!

sense_groups.chinese: 他居然找到我了 - 天哪 菲比 你会去坐牢吗？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe he found me! - Are you going to go to jail?

sense_groups.chinese: 我死也会拖你们下水
sense_groups.english: If I'm going down, you guys are going down with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 窝藏逃犯起码要关1到3年
sense_groups.english: Harboring a fugitive? That's one-to-three years minimum.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Good luck, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你可以逮捕我 但你抓不到我的把柄
sense_groups.english: You can arrest me, but you'll never make it stick and you know it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我别无选择 这是职责所在 你了解吧？
sense_groups.english: I kind of don't have a choice, it's my job. You understand, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 只要你了解我会找我的律师来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, as long as you understand that I'm gonna call my lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会让你在庭上像个猪头 猪头
sense_groups.english: And once he puts you on the stand, he's gonna make you look like a fool! Like a fool!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢当猪头
sense_groups.english: I don't like looking foolish.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 也许我今天不抓你 就说我来了 但你不在
sense_groups.english: Maybe, uh, I don't arrest you today. Maybe I came by and you weren't here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在就太好了
sense_groups.english: I would love it if I weren't here!

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你今晚不会入狱 我能不能
sense_groups.english: Since, um, you're not going to jail tonight, I was wondering if you'd, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 请你去晚赛？
sense_groups.english: ...like to go to dinner with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Me? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从你对我亮警徽 我就对你念念不忘
sense_groups.english: Ever since you flashed my badge at me, I kind of can't stop thinking about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我见过最美的假卧底妓女
sense_groups.english: You're the prettiest fake undercover whore I've ever seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想不到你会约我出去
sense_groups.english: Wow, I didn't see that coming. You're asking me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以表现得更好 但这些人一直盯着我看
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I could've done it better, but these people keep staring at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我愿意跟你吃饭 警察先生
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah, I'd like to go out with you, officer.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞 - 盖瑞
sense_groups.english: Gary. - Gary.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就这么说定了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, so it's a date. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我一定要问 你是怎么找到我的？
sense_groups.english: I gotta ask you, though. How did you know where to find me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的警徽上都是你的指纹 所以我上电脑查询
sense_groups.english: Your fingerprints were all over my badge so I ran them through the computer.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你最后登记的住址 所以我就来看看
sense_groups.english: This was listed as your last known address so I checked it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好厉害 没有你厉害
sense_groups.english: Oh, impressive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过你的纪录 你干过不少怪事
sense_groups.english: Not as impressive as you. I looked at your record and you've done some weird stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃饭时再说
sense_groups.english: We'll talk at dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我两个小时后来接你？
sense_groups.english: So I'll come by in a couple hours and pick you up?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我好兴奋 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, I can't wait. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 我不会只带你吃甜甜圈
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, I won't just take you out for doughnuts.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有枪
sense_groups.english: He has a gun!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要退这张沙发 我对它不满意
sense_groups.english: I'd like to return this couch. I'm not satisfied with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要退这张沙发？
sense_groups.english: You want to return this couch?

sense_groups.chinese: 它断成两半了
sense_groups.english: It's cut in half.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是这个意思 - 是你把它切成两半的？
sense_groups.english: That's what I'm telling you. - Did you cut this couch in half?

sense_groups.chinese: 这张沙发被切成两半
sense_groups.english: This couch is cut in half!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要换一张没有被切成两半的
sense_groups.english: I would like to exchange it for one that is not cut in half.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说它送过去就这样了？
sense_groups.english: You're telling me this couch was delivered to you like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很讲道理
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm a reasonable man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意接受换购金额
sense_groups.english: I will accept store credit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给你4元的换购金额
sense_groups.english: I'll give you store credit in the amount of $4.

sense_groups.chinese: 我接受
sense_groups.english: I will take it.

questions.name: S05E17
questions.en:
Good! You guys are all here. - Hey, what's up?
Well, I have a job interview at Ralph Lauren tomorrow.
Congratulations!
Oh, boy. That guy's underwear sucks!
What? - Well, I got this pair marked "XS."
Let me tell you, there was no room for excess anything in there.
Anyway, I'm gonna be the coordinator of the women's collection.
I'll work right under the director. It's the perfect job for me.
Wow. Well, if you nail the interview, you'll get it.
Yeah. - Want to work on your interview skills?
Okay! - Okay! Let's start with the handshake.
Hi. - Hi.
Very good handshake. Good wrist action.
Thank you. - Let me try.
Okay.
Oh, my God! What did I ever do to you?
Did I squeeze too hard?
Let's just say I'm glad I'm not Chandler.
That's right, Ross. I can see you in your new apartment. You see me.
Same as yesterday, same as the day before.
Is he doing his "shark attack" bit yet?
No. Oh, wait! There he goes.
Very funny, Ross.
Very lifelike and funny. Okay.
Oh, no, no, no. I wasn't waving at you, lady.
Whoa, maybe I was. Hey!
Monica, this hot girl in Ross' building is flirting with me.
Get in there, man. Flirt back. Mix it up!
Yeah, I'm down with that.
Okay, here it goes.
How...
...you...
...doing?
It worked! She's waving me over. I'll be right over.
Let's see, she's on the third floor...
Wow.
She is pretty, huh? - Tell me about it, huh?
Oh, no, no.
No, no! I'm not with her.
Oh, that's just Monica.
Blah!
Hey, Joey!
Great stuff, huh?
This is your place? - Yeah, of course it is. Oh, come on in.
Ooh, ohh. Uh, go by the window. You can pretend to be surfing.
But I counted. You're not supposed to live here.
Oh, man!
Unh! - What happened?
I ended up at Ross' place. I must have miscounted or something.
Damn! She's not there anymore.
Oh, look, Ross is doing his "watching TV" bit.
No, Joe, I think he's just watching TV.
We've lost visual contact with the suspect.
Okay, now I really have to go.
It's so unfair that our date has to get cut short...
...just because some guy shot at a store clerk.
I know, but it's my job. - Then maybe I could come too?
Suspect has just emerged naked from the sewer.
All right, you go.
Bye-bye. - Okay. Bye.
Oh, God! - What?
Oh, I just miss him so much!
Wow.
For just a week, you guys are close, huh?
Yeah, it's weird. I can't help it, though. He's so sweet.
He's like this little puppy dog, you know?
But like a really tough one who shoots bad guys.
Ugh, I love the beginning parts of relationships, you know?
You can't keep your hands off each other.
I know. It is the best. Ha, ha. - Ha, ha.
God, how long did that last for you and Chandler?
What? It's still going on.
Come on, seriously. When did it end?
I am serious. We're all over each other all the time.
Okay, you know where you are better than I do. I was just curious.
Why don't you just calm down, Phoebe, all right?
Get all your facts before you tell everybody you're the only hot couple.
God, I woke the beast. Um...
I was wrong obviously. I just misspoke. It's okay.
Well, it is okay. I mean...
As long as you know Chandler and I are also hot and fiery.
I mean, just as hot as you.
I mean, our flame...
Whoo! It is on fire!
Monica, here's your broom back.
You are so cute.
Oh, hey! How'd the interview go? - Ugh!
Horrible! I did the stupidest, most embarrassing thing.
Did you tell the guy you wanted to have sex with his wife then fall off your chair?
No. - So, what happened?
Ugh, it was horrible! And the interview part went so well.
You know, like, I even made him laugh. He said something about a boat...
...and I was like, "Well, yeah, if you've got enough life jackets."
Trust me. It was actually very funny.
Anyway, so we were saying goodbye and, uh... Ugh.
What happened? - All right, we were shaking hands...
...and he kind of leaned in toward me. Maybe he was going to open the door.
But I totally misread him and I, uh...
You kissed him?
I didn't know what else to do!
Well, you could have tried...
...not kissing him.
Thanks, Chandler.
Hey, Rach, a guy from Ralph Lauren called.
You got a second interview.
I can't believe it! I got a second interview. - Yes!
That kiss isn't looking like such a mistake now, is it?
Wait a minute, wait. You don't think that's why he wants me back?
Yeah!
No?
Kiss? What are you talking about?
Ugh, I accidentally kissed him in the interview...
...and now he wants me back of course...
...because, "Let's bring back the girl who kisses everybody"!
Come on, Rach.
What if he thinks I'm the kind of girl that'll just sleep with him?
He wants you back because you're right for the job.
Maybe. I don't know. Oh, God! How could I be so stupid?
Oh, Rachel, look, don't say that.
I think you just need a hug from Joey. Heh.
Come on. Come on, ha-ha-ha.
She's back! Hot girl's back!
Aw, well, I'm not totally back yet. But I appreciate it.
No, in Ross' building. She's back! She's back!
Okay, wait there. I'll be over in a second.
One, two, three. Got it!
I gotta check out this hot girl.
There she is!
Damn it! Did you move?
Yes.
I lived with you for a while. Then I found this place.
I'm Ross.
Yes?
Uh...
Do you happen to have a hot girl in there?
No, I'm all alone.
Yeah. Sorry about that.
Oh. Hey, little girl.
Is your mommy or sister or babysitter by any chance, a hot girl?
Daddy! - Later, girl! Aah.
Oh, man!
Hot girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 宾警官得要先行告退 执行10一100勤务
sense_groups.english: Now, I gotta go. Officer Bing's got a 10-100.

sense_groups.chinese: 去尿尿
sense_groups.english: That's pee-pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你头发里有树枝
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you have a twig in your hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哈哈 额…
sense_groups.english: Oh, ha, ha. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 来这里的路上 我们烧了一点路
sense_groups.english: We kind of took a detour on our way over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们去公园里散步 看四下无人就…
sense_groups.english: We were strolling through the park and no one was around, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧？ - 真的有
sense_groups.english: You didn't. - We did!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们违反了犯罪条例 第12条第7款
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. We violated section 12, paragraph 7 of the criminal code.

sense_groups.chinese: 在公园 是吧？ - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: The park, huh? - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 公共场所 - 额
sense_groups.english: Public place. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到了 失陪一下
sense_groups.english: I hear you. Can you excuse me for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hi, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 这是男厕
sense_groups.english: Monica, this is the men's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错吧？
sense_groups.english: Isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都觉得男厕很性感
sense_groups.english: But see, I've always found the men's bathroom very sexual.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得吗？ - 不觉得
sense_groups.english: Haven't you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 否则我们就不会在一起了
sense_groups.english: And if I did, I don't think we'd be going out.

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧 这越搞越离谱了
sense_groups.english: This is getting ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我们不能让他们赢 - 额
sense_groups.english: Come on, we can't let them win! - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经证明我们在热恋了 为何你走火入魔成这样？
sense_groups.english: We've proved that we are hot, okay? So why are you obsessed about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为菲比和盖瑞… 不仅难分难舍 还在公园里做了那档事
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and Gary are in that "can't keep their hands off each other" phase!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？ - 所以呢？
sense_groups.english: So? - So.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我很难过 因为我们激情不在了
sense_groups.english: It makes me really sad that we're not really there anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是为了这档事？
sense_groups.english: Oh, is that what this has all been about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们成天腻在一起的那时
sense_groups.english: Wasn't it a lot more exciting when we were, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是比较让人兴奋吗？
sense_groups.english: ...all over each other all the time?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那时很棒 真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was great. That was really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是老实跟你说 我们现在的状况让我更兴奋
sense_groups.english: But to tell you the truth, I'm more excited about where we are now.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从没谈过这么久的恋爱
sense_groups.english: I've never been in a relationship that's lasted this long before.

sense_groups.chinese: 过了刚开始的激情期 还想跟对方相处在一起
sense_groups.english: To get past the beginning and still want to be around each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这是很不凡的
sense_groups.english: I think that's pretty incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还是和你在一起
sense_groups.english: And the fact that this is happening with you...

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我很兴奋
sense_groups.english: ...I think that's pretty exciting.

sense_groups.chinese: 真甜
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我表现得有点过火
sense_groups.english: I know that I was acting a little crazy...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的感觉跟你一样 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: ...but I feel the same way. - Mm?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我刚领悟到什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what I just realized?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的关系让你惊慌
sense_groups.english: You just freaked out about our relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有 就是有 - 承认吧
sense_groups.english: Pfft, I did not. - Yes, you did!

sense_groups.chinese: 你很惊慌
sense_groups.english: Admit it. You freaked out!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 我是有一点惊慌
sense_groups.english: I freaked out a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 岂止有一点 你超级惊慌的
sense_groups.english: A little? You freaked out bigtime, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我救你的 我们角色互换了
sense_groups.english: And I fixed it! We have switched places.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在是国王 你是搞砸又发疯的输家
sense_groups.english: I am the relationship king, and you are the crazy, irrational screwup!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在又回到原位了
sense_groups.english: And now we're back.

sense_groups.chinese: 没想到罗斯还真的相信
sense_groups.english: I cannot believe Ross is buying this.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地 我再也看不下去了 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Thank God. I can't watch him anymore. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们准备好去看电影没？ - 好了
sense_groups.english: You guys ready for the movies? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 多谢你把 潘蜜拉和洁丝敏借给我们
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, thank you for loaning us Pamela and Yasmine.

sense_groups.chinese: 要命 她们还真是看不腻
sense_groups.english: Man, they cannot get enough!

questions.name: S05E18
questions.en:
Pick a card. - Okay.
All right. Now memorize it.
You got it? - Oh, yes.
Okay. Is that your card?
Yes. - Ha, ha.
Hey, guys. - Hi there.
Guess what. Ben is gonna be in a TV commercial.
What are you talking about? - Well, it's not for sure.
But, uh, we met this guy in the park who thought Ben was really cute.
You know, which he is. Um, anyhoo, he gave us his card...
...and told us to bring him down for this commercial he's auditioning.
Whoa.
The guy's like the biggest commercial casting director in town.
Ben takes one lousy walk in the park and gets an audition?
I mean, way to go, Ben!
Man, I've been in that park a million times. No one's ever offered me an audition.
I know, it's crazy. We were just pushing Ben on the swings...
I'm always on the swings.
What am I doing wrong?
That.
Okay, gotta go. Wish me luck. - Good luck.
Hey, Rach, now that you working at Ralph Lauren, can you get me some shirts?
Uh, well, you know what? I don't know if I'd feel comfortable stealing...
...on my very first day.
Unwilling to steal from work.
Interesting.
Besides, if anybody is gonna get free stuff, it's me.
Okay, guys, way to wish me luck.
Go get them. - Bye.
Okay, let's discuss Rachel's birthday.
I say we throw a surprise party this weekend.
Whoa, whoa. But her birthday's not for another month.
Okay, but if we throw her a party on her birthday, then it's not a surprise.
I think that's a great idea. We can have a dinner party and invite her close friends.
Ross. We're having a surprise party for Rachel.
Okay. - Done.
Okay, great. So do you wanna do it together?
I would love to do it together.
They're gonna do it together.
Dude, that's my girlfriend.
So I gotta shut it down now?
All right, I gotta take off. I'm picking up Ben...
...and then we're off to the big audition.
It's gonna be weird seeing some actor pretending to be Ben's dad.
Yeah. - Weirder than his two moms making out?
Whoa, whoa. Dad? There's a dad in the commercial?
Yeah. The dad and Ben eat soup and pretend to enjoy it.
Well, maybe I'll go with you and see if I can audition as the dad.
I mean, who better to play Ben's father than his godfather?
You're not his godfather. - What?
Are you kidding?
Of course I am.
Okay, let's go, godfather. - All right. Ha, ha.
Hey, I'm in. They're gonna let me audition.
Really? That's great.
I know, I know. One of the casting ladies has actually seen me in a play.
So I steered clear of her.
That kid looks familiar. - Oh, yeah.
Yeah, he's done tons of commercials.
I've seen him in Sugar Smacks, PlayStation...
...and that one for the phone company.
In fact, he was so good in that one...
...he actually convinced me to switch phone companies.
Chandler was mad.
Yeah, well, he's not gonna get this one. All right? Ben is way cuter than that kid.
I mean, look at him.
That's great.
Listen, wouldn't it be great if I got to play Ben's dad?
Joey, you look nothing like Ben.
I look more like him than you do.
Well, I really don't know you well enough for you to do that.
So it's down to these two. Nancy, I know you like this one...
...and I think I agree. Rachel, what do you think?
Well, um, that one is pretty...
...but I just love this fabric. Sorry.
Oh, don't be. That's part of your job here, to give your opinions.
And then I take credit for them. I'm kidding. Ha, ha.
She is kidding. But don't ever disagree with her again.
Okay, now I'm kidding. - Oh, ha, ha.
Oh, what a fun office.
I don't know which one. But I do know I need a cigarette.
So, what do you say we take a break, go outside...
...and figure this out when we come back.
Rachel? - Yeah.
You smoke? - No.
My dad's a doctor. And he would always tell me just horror stories...
About ghosts and goblins...
...who totally supported the princess' right to smoke.
And then they came back from smoking...
...and they'd made all of the decisions without me.
That doesn't seem fair. - I know.
It's like I'm being punished for not having this disgusting, poisonous habit.
Yeah, it is the best.
I mean, what if this keeps happening?
They'll be outside smoking, making all the decisions...
...and I'll just be up in my office breathing in my stupid clean air.
You know? And when Kim wants to promote one of us...
...who do you think she's gonna pick? Me or Smokey Smokerson?
Rachel, you can go down there, you don't have to smoke.
Just say you wanna get some fresh air.
Yeah, I could do that.
Yeah, or you could just do the easy thing and smoke.
Hey. Do you wanna go get coffee? - Hey.
Oh, I would love to. - Oh, good.
I'm gonna go too, babe. - Oh, good.
Yay. - Yay.
Oh, I changed my mind.
Okay, let's talk about the party. I have so many ideas.
Ooh, me too. - Oh!
Yeah! - Oh, look at that.
All right. This is a little sketch of the cake. - Uh-huh. Wow.
See? Um, some sample menus.
Um, you know, I thought we'd start with a Tuscan-style finger food.
Okay. And for music, here's an alphabetized list of all of my CDs.
I've highlighted the ones that'll go really good with the food.
What happened to the dinner party? - We're not doing that.
Okay? So... - Wow. All right.
Looks like you took care of everything. Thanks a lot, cohost.
Wait. I didn't take care of everything.
There's plenty of things for you to do.
Uh-huh? Like what?
Cups.
Cups. You're giving me cups?
And ice.
Cups and ice? Oh, I get to be in charge of cups and ice?
All right.
Fine. Okay, I will be in charge of cups and ice.
Wait, I can get ice at the restaurant... - I got it.
Hi. - Hey.
How did the audition go? - Not so good.
Wait a minute. Are you doing Joey's
"The audition didn't go so well. Yeah, it did!"
Yeah, I am!
Yeah, Ben got a second audition. - Oh, great.
Yeah, I had to teach Ross my bit because I actually didn't get a callback.
You got a callback too, didn't you?
Yeah, I did!
Hey, Rachel. What are you doing out here?
You know, it got kind of lonely up there, so I just thought I would come out here...
...and get some fresh air.
We were talking about the fall collection.
Oh, great. - So anyway, we really...
I'm sorry. We're smoking all over you. - That's okay.
No, no, no. We'll move. You stay there.
I sent the designs to Ralph. He was excited about it.
That's great. You are the best.
Excuse me. Can I bum one of those?
Actually, this one's...
Okay, okay, okay. What's so funny over here?
I thought you didn't smoke.
You know, I thought you guys meant marijuana cigarettes.
You know what I mean? Like, doobies?
Actually, I thought to myself, "Those guys are crazy."
But no, actually, I smoke the regular ones all the time.
We get high.
Me too.
I'm kidding. - Oh!
Me too.
Oh, God. This is so nerve-racking. How do you do this?
Well, fortunately, I don't get many callbacks so...
Is it a good sign that they asked us to hang around after?
Who knows?
Okay. We have narrowed it down to Raymond, Ben, Kyle and Joey.
The rest of you, thank you very much.
Yes! I knew it!
Ah. Bye-bye.
So long.
Later.
This is great. I might actually get to play Ben's dad.
Actually, that can't happen.
Because you all have such different looks...
...we're putting you with Raymond and Kyle with Ben.
So it'll either be you two or you two.
Oh, man.
This is gonna be kind of weird. - Yeah, it is.
Yeah. It's gonna be weird.
No. We're like best friends. That's why it's weird.
Oh, oh.
I thought we were just talking.
Hey. - Hey.
Is it okay if I leave this stuff here till Rachel's birthday party?
Uh, sure. What's in them? - Um, cups.
Oh, good, because we got Rachel 800 gallons of water.
Seriously, that's a lot of cups.
Yeah, well, I'm in charge of cups and ice.
And Monica's gonna rue the day that she put me in charge of cups and ice.
You know, I rued the day once. Didn't get a whole lot else done.
Okay, time to bring up the rest of the cups.
Hey, Joey. - Hey, Pheebs.
Hey. - Ross, good, I'm glad you're here.
I want to talk to you about something. - Oh. What's up?
Well, I've been thinking about this whole commercial thing.
You know me against Ben.
The two of us competing. Well, that can't lead to anything good.
I think I'm just gonna step aside.
I'm gonna tell them that I won't audition.
Wow. Uh...
Joey, that's great. Thanks, man.
That's it?
You're gonna let me do this? This is my career we're talking about here.
But you just...
I just said that so you wouldn't let Ben do it.
Look, Ross, if anyone should step aside, it should be Ben.
What? - Chandler, tell him.
Well, let me get the door first.
Oh, hi, no one.
Why should Ben step aside?
It was his audition in the first place. You just tagged along.
You're like the tag-along dad.
At least I care about his feelings.
What?
Do you know how hard this is gonna be on him when he doesn't get it?
And why wouldn't he get it?
Oh, come on.
Have you seen what my kid can do? Huh?
I mean, he dials phones, he eats tortilla chips.
He plays soccer with the cartoon tiger.
Are you saying your kid eats soup better than my kid?
You just give him a spoon, baby.
Oh, yeah? I guess we'll see. - Yeah.
Because this commercial belongs to me and Mitch.
Your kid's name is Raymond. - Yeah? So is yours.
How did work go? - Oh, it was great. It was great.
I went down there just like you said. And we talked business.
And Kim totally took my opinions.
You stink.
Thanks. - No, I'm serious.
That's because I went down there and they were smoking.
This is actually the smell of success.
But there's something different, though.
Oh, my God. You smoked.
I did not. - Yes, you did.
You look happy and sick. You smoked.
All right, fine. But I had to. I had to do it for my career.
I wish I had to smoke for my career.
That's so gross.
Well, no, it's not that bad, you know?
I mean, yeah, my tongue feels a little fuzzy and my fingers sort of smell.
I actually feel like I could throw up.
But you gotta push past this, okay? Because it's about to get so good.
Chandler.
You smell so smoky, I gotta get up.
I'm not kidding.
I think you smell great.
So we're decided. No on plaid, yes on pink.
Absolutely.
I'm so onboard.
Rachel, didn't you just light that? - Yeah.
But you know what?
I'm just really, really trying to cut back, you know.
Good luck, Rach.
I've actually been thinking about quitting.
Oh, well, sure. Every Sunday night, I tell myself I'm quitting.
Every Monday morning, it's like
Tell me about it.
Well, let's quit. We'll just quit. Let's all quit.
It does sound appealing.
I never could do it. - But you could. You can. Absolutely.
We can help each other out. We could get those patches.
We could be like the Patch Sisters.
You know, we really should quit. Okay, let's quit.
Yes. Great. Give me those cigs. Come on.
Give it. Give it. Out. Done. Quit. Whoo!
My late husband gave me that lighter. - Ha, ha.
I'm not kidding.
Okay, then. Okay.
Mm, soup.
Joey, Ross is gonna be here any second.
Would you mind watching Ben while I use the ladies' room?
Yeah, no problem. - Thanks.
Mm.
Hi, Ben.
So you want to be an actor, huh? Well, I gotta tell you, it's no picnic.
There's tons of rejection. No stability.
I mean, one day, you're Dr. Drake Ramoray.
The next day, you're eating ketchup right out of the bottle.
Joey.
Ross.
Ben.
I mean, Ben. Ben.
Okay, Raymond, Joey, you're up.
Hi. - Okay.
All right, well, let's try one. Whenever you guys are ready.
Uh-oh. - Is there a problem?
Well, this is noodle soup. And I've been working with tomato.
But that's okay. No problem. No problem.
Mm, noodle soup.
You know, that's fine. But the line is, "Mm, soup."
Oh. What'd I say? - Mm, noodle soup.
How's that different?
Oh. Right. Yeah.
All right. Let's try one.
Mm, noodle soup.
Okay. Let's do it again.
Okay.
Mm, soup.
I mean, noodle soup. I mean, soup.
Come on!
You know what? We need to move on.
Oh, no, I could do it one more time.
See, look.
Mm, noodle soup.
Damn it.
Hey. Hey.
Uh-oh. Busted.
Come on, you guys. What are you doing?
I thought we were the Patch Sisters.
Yeah, that didn't work out.
Rachel, we tried to quit. But it was too hard.
Well, if you started smoking again, you could have at least told me.
Come on, give me one of those. What are we talking about?
No, you're doing great. Don't give up.
That's why we didn't tell you, and we are not gonna drag you down.
Oh, wait. No, no. Drag me down. Drag me down.
Forget it, Rachel. We're both so proud of how well you're doing.
I'm not gonna let you blow it. In fact, if I catch you, you're fired.
So go on, get out of here. Go on. I don't want you breathing this stuff. Go on.
So okay. So you'll come with me on the Paris trip?
Oh, man.
Hey, check it out. Cup hat, cup banner...
...cup chandelier and the thing that started it all. The cup.
Great job with the cups, Pheebs. - Ha, ha.
Why don't you just go out with her?
Did you notice the ice? Look.
We have it all. We have crushed, cubed and dry. Watch.
Ah.
Mystical.
No one's eating my Tuscan finger food. They're filling up on Phoebe's snow cones.
There are snow cones?
Snow cones. Yuck.
Go, go. - Thank you. Thank you.
Look, look. - Surprise.
What? My birthday is not for another month.
That's the surprise.
Oh, my God, you guys. This is so great. It's so unexpected.
I mean, Chandler's birthday's even before mine.
Surprise.
Wow. This is so great. Look at all these...
...cups. This is so weird.
I was in charge of cups.
Oh, okay. Not so weird.
Hey. - Hey.
Listen, man. I'm sorry the audition didn't go well.
Yeah, right.
No, really. I am, Joey. I feel bad.
Well, look, Ross. You don't have to, okay?
It's not your fault I suck.
What kind of an actor can't even say, "Mm, noodle soup"?
Hey, you know what? Maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you suck.
Maybe you messed up because you care more about your godson.
What do you mean? - I think, subconsciously...
Whoa, you lost me.
I think, on some level, you sabotaged...
...your own audition so Ben would get the part.
Well, your way sounds a lot better than mine.
Yeah.
Yeah. It's not that I'm a bad actor. - No.
No, it's just that, uh, I care so damn much about little Ben...
...that, uh, it was more important for me to see him succeed.
There you go. Thank you. - Thank you.
So did he get it? - No.
Ah, what are you gonna do?
Oh, hi. Excuse me. Is Rachel Green here? I'm supposed to meet her for lunch.
Oh, she doesn't come down anymore. You can find her up on 10.
Okay, great.
So we talked about the presentation at lunch.
He wondered if one person would be enough for me to take on the trip.
And I said, "Yeah, absolutely."
I'll catch you guys later.
