I mean, yeah, my tongue feels a little fuzzy and my fingers sort of smell.
I actually feel like I could throw up.
But you gotta push past this, okay? Because it's about to get so good.
Chandler.
You smell so smoky, I gotta get up.
I'm not kidding.
I think you smell great.
So we're decided. No on plaid, yes on pink.
Absolutely.
I'm so onboard.
Rachel, didn't you just light that? - Yeah.
But you know what?
I'm just really, really trying to cut back, you know.
Good luck, Rach.
I've actually been thinking about quitting.
Oh, well, sure. Every Sunday night, I tell myself I'm quitting.
Every Monday morning, it's like
Tell me about it.
Well, let's quit. We'll just quit. Let's all quit.
It does sound appealing.
I never could do it. - But you could. You can. Absolutely.
We can help each other out. We could get those patches.
We could be like the Patch Sisters.
You know, we really should quit. Okay, let's quit.
Yes. Great. Give me those cigs. Come on.
Give it. Give it. Out. Done. Quit. Whoo!
My late husband gave me that lighter. - Ha, ha.
I'm not kidding.
Okay, then. Okay.
Mm, soup.
Joey, Ross is gonna be here any second.
Would you mind watching Ben while I use the ladies' room?
Yeah, no problem. - Thanks.
Mm.
Hi, Ben.
So you want to be an actor, huh? Well, I gotta tell you, it's no picnic.
There's tons of rejection. No stability.
I mean, one day, you're Dr. Drake Ramoray.
The next day, you're eating ketchup right out of the bottle.
Joey.
Ross.
Ben.
I mean, Ben. Ben.
Okay, Raymond, Joey, you're up.
Hi. - Okay.
All right, well, let's try one. Whenever you guys are ready.
Uh-oh. - Is there a problem?
Well, this is noodle soup. And I've been working with tomato.
But that's okay. No problem. No problem.
Mm, noodle soup.
You know, that's fine. But the line is, "Mm, soup."
Oh. What'd I say? - Mm, noodle soup.
How's that different?
Oh. Right. Yeah.
All right. Let's try one.
Mm, noodle soup.
Okay. Let's do it again.
Okay.
Mm, soup.
I mean, noodle soup. I mean, soup.
Come on!
You know what? We need to move on.
Oh, no, I could do it one more time.
See, look.
Mm, noodle soup.
Damn it.
Hey. Hey.
Uh-oh. Busted.
Come on, you guys. What are you doing?
I thought we were the Patch Sisters.
Yeah, that didn't work out.
Rachel, we tried to quit. But it was too hard.
Well, if you started smoking again, you could have at least told me.
Come on, give me one of those. What are we talking about?
No, you're doing great. Don't give up.
That's why we didn't tell you, and we are not gonna drag you down.
Oh, wait. No, no. Drag me down. Drag me down.
Forget it, Rachel. We're both so proud of how well you're doing.
I'm not gonna let you blow it. In fact, if I catch you, you're fired.
So go on, get out of here. Go on. I don't want you breathing this stuff. Go on.
So okay. So you'll come with me on the Paris trip?
Oh, man.
Hey, check it out. Cup hat, cup banner...
...cup chandelier and the thing that started it all. The cup.
Great job with the cups, Pheebs. - Ha, ha.
Why don't you just go out with her?
Did you notice the ice? Look.
We have it all. We have crushed, cubed and dry. Watch.
Ah.
Mystical.
No one's eating my Tuscan finger food. They're filling up on Phoebe's snow cones.
There are snow cones?
Snow cones. Yuck.
Go, go. - Thank you. Thank you.
Look, look. - Surprise.
What? My birthday is not for another month.
That's the surprise.
Oh, my God, you guys. This is so great. It's so unexpected.
I mean, Chandler's birthday's even before mine.
Surprise.
Wow. This is so great. Look at all these...
...cups. This is so weird.
I was in charge of cups.
Oh, okay. Not so weird.
Hey. - Hey.
Listen, man. I'm sorry the audition didn't go well.
Yeah, right.
No, really. I am, Joey. I feel bad.
Well, look, Ross. You don't have to, okay?
It's not your fault I suck.
What kind of an actor can't even say, "Mm, noodle soup"?
Hey, you know what? Maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you suck.
Maybe you messed up because you care more about your godson.
What do you mean? - I think, subconsciously...
Whoa, you lost me.
I think, on some level, you sabotaged...
...your own audition so Ben would get the part.
Well, your way sounds a lot better than mine.
Yeah.
Yeah. It's not that I'm a bad actor. - No.
No, it's just that, uh, I care so damn much about little Ben...
...that, uh, it was more important for me to see him succeed.
There you go. Thank you. - Thank you.
So did he get it? - No.
Ah, what are you gonna do?
Oh, hi. Excuse me. Is Rachel Green here? I'm supposed to meet her for lunch.
Oh, she doesn't come down anymore. You can find her up on 10.
Okay, great.
So we talked about the presentation at lunch.
He wondered if one person would be enough for me to take on the trip.
And I said, "Yeah, absolutely."
I'll catch you guys later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了选张卡 - 好
sense_groups.english: Pick a card. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在记住花色号码
sense_groups.english: All right. Now memorize it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了没？ - 好了
sense_groups.english: You got it? - Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是这张吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Is that your card?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这张 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hi there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们猜怎么着？班要上电视拍广告了
sense_groups.english: Guess what. Ben is gonna be in a TV commercial.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在说什么？ - 还没有定案
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? - Well, it's not for sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们在公园里遇到一个人 他觉得班很可爱
sense_groups.english: But, uh, we met this guy in the park who thought Ben was really cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 这也是事实啦 所以那个人留了张名片…
sense_groups.english: You know, which he is. Um, anyhoo, he gave us his card...

sense_groups.chinese: 要我带班去参加广告试镜
sense_groups.english: ...and told us to bring him down for this commercial he's auditioning.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个人是本地最大的选角导演
sense_groups.english: The guy's like the biggest commercial casting director in town.

sense_groups.chinese: 班去公园随便散个步 就有试镜自动送上门
sense_groups.english: Ben takes one lousy walk in the park and gets an audition?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 班 真有你的
sense_groups.english: I mean, way to go, Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 那个公园我都去烂了 从来没人主动找我去试镜
sense_groups.english: Man, I've been in that park a million times. No one's ever offered me an audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 真的很神奇 我们只是在陪班玩荡秋千…
sense_groups.english: I know, it's crazy. We were just pushing Ben on the swings...

sense_groups.chinese: 我每次都玩荡秋千啊
sense_groups.english: I'm always on the swings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是哪里做错了？
sense_groups.english: What am I doing wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是荡秋千那里
sense_groups.english: That.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要出门了 祝我好运 - 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Okay, gotta go. Wish me luck. - Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 既然你在罗夫罗兰工作 能不能带几件马球衫回来？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, now that you working at Ralph Lauren, can you get me some shirts?

sense_groups.chinese: 第一天上班就偷公司东西 我可能…
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, you know what? I don't know if I'd feel comfortable stealing...

sense_groups.chinese: 下不了手喔
sense_groups.english: ...on my very first day.

sense_groups.chinese: 不愿意慷公司之慨
sense_groups.english: Unwilling to steal from work.

sense_groups.chinese: 有意思了
sense_groups.english: Interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算有人能拿免费的 那也非我莫属
sense_groups.english: Besides, if anybody is gonna get free stuff, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 各位 祝我好运吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, guys, way to wish me luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 给他们好看 - 拜
sense_groups.english: Go get them. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 来讨论帮瑞秋庆生的事
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's discuss Rachel's birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我建议在这周末办惊喜派对
sense_groups.english: I say we throw a surprise party this weekend.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 可是一个月后才是她生日啊
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa. But her birthday's not for another month.

sense_groups.chinese: 是没错 但在生日当天开派对 那就不惊喜啦
sense_groups.english: Okay, but if we throw her a party on her birthday, then it's not a surprise.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这主意不错 我们办个晚养派对邀请好朋友过来
sense_groups.english: I think that's a great idea. We can have a dinner party and invite her close friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们要帮瑞秋办惊喜派对罗
sense_groups.english: Ross. We're having a surprise party for Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 搞定
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Done.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那你要一起办吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, great. So do you wanna do it together?

sense_groups.chinese: 乐意之至
sense_groups.english: I would love to do it together.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们要一起来耶
sense_groups.english: They're gonna do it together.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 那位可是我女友
sense_groups.english: Dude, that's my girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我就得闭嘴？
sense_groups.english: So I gotta shut it down now?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我得走了
sense_groups.english: All right, I gotta take off. I'm picking up Ben...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要接班去参加大试镜
sense_groups.english: ...and then we're off to the big audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到有演员假装是班的父亲 那种感觉一定很怪
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be weird seeing some actor pretending to be Ben's dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 怪过看班的两个妈妈温存？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Weirder than his two moms making out?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸？广告里面有爸爸？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa. Dad? There's a dad in the commercial?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 班和爸爸喝汤 演得很陶醉的样子
sense_groups.english: Yeah. The dad and Ben eat soup and pretend to enjoy it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以跟你们一起去 搞不好能试镜演那个爸爸
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I'll go with you and see if I can audition as the dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 说到扮演班的爸爸 由我这教父上场最适合了
sense_groups.english: I mean, who better to play Ben's father than his godfather?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是班的教父 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You're not his godfather. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是啊
sense_groups.english: Of course I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧 教父 - 好 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go, godfather. - All right. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我获选了 他们让我试镜
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm in. They're gonna let me audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？太棒了
sense_groups.english: Really? That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 有个女的看过我演舞台剧
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. One of the casting ladies has actually seen me in a play.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我离她离得远远的
sense_groups.english: So I steered clear of her.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个孩子看起来很眼熟 - 哦 耶
sense_groups.english: That kid looks familiar. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 他拍过一堆广告
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's done tons of commercials.

sense_groups.chinese: 有糖果广告 新力游戏机
sense_groups.english: I've seen him in Sugar Smacks, PlayStation...

sense_groups.chinese: 还帮电话公司拍过广告
sense_groups.english: ...and that one for the phone company.

sense_groups.chinese: 他演得实在是太好了…
sense_groups.english: In fact, he was so good in that one...

sense_groups.chinese: 我索性跟着换了电话公司
sense_groups.english: ...he actually convinced me to switch phone companies.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德因此还气得半死
sense_groups.english: Chandler was mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他这次休想拿到这角色 因为班比他可爱多了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, he's not gonna get this one. All right? Ben is way cuter than that kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 看就知道 宝贝 看看你
sense_groups.english: I mean, look at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过若我能演班的爸爸 这样是不是很棒？
sense_groups.english: Listen, wouldn't it be great if I got to play Ben's dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你跟班一点都不像
sense_groups.english: Joey, you look nothing like Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 比你跟他像多了
sense_groups.english: I look more like him than you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你还不熟 哪里生得出小孩？
sense_groups.english: Well, I really don't know you well enough for you to do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是最后的二选一 南西 我知道你喜欢这一个…
sense_groups.english: So it's down to these two. Nancy, I know you like this one...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有同感 瑞秋 你觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: ...and I think I agree. Rachel, what do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个是很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Well, um, that one is pretty...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我超爱这个质料 抱歉了
sense_groups.english: ...but I just love this fabric. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用抱歉 提供意见是你的职责之一
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't be. That's part of your job here, to give your opinions.

sense_groups.chinese: 功劳归我 开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: And then I take credit for them. I'm kidding. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 她这次是在开玩笑 但下次可别跟她意见相左
sense_groups.english: She is kidding. But don't ever disagree with her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次换我在开玩笑 - 哦 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Okay, now I'm kidding. - Oh, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个办公室真有趣
sense_groups.english: Oh, what a fun office.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道要选哪一个 不过先来根烟倒是真的
sense_groups.english: I don't know which one. But I do know I need a cigarette.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如我们出去休息一下
sense_groups.english: So, what do you say we take a break, go outside...

sense_groups.chinese: 等回来之后再解决？
sense_groups.english: ...and figure this out when we come back.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Rachel? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你抽烟吗？ - 不抽
sense_groups.english: You smoke? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸是医生 老跟我说些恐怖的故事…
sense_groups.english: My dad's a doctor. And he would always tell me just horror stories...

sense_groups.chinese: 说那些鬼神精灵的…
sense_groups.english: About ghosts and goblins...

sense_groups.chinese: 完全赞同公主抽烟的权利
sense_groups.english: ...who totally supported the princess' right to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们在抽烟的时候…
sense_groups.english: And then they came back from smoking...

sense_groups.chinese: 就背着我做出了决定
sense_groups.english: ...and they'd made all of the decisions without me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样不太公平 - 我知道啊
sense_groups.english: That doesn't seem fair. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不同流合污还被处罚 抽烟可是恶心又伤身的习惯
sense_groups.english: It's like I'm being punished for not having this disgusting, poisonous habit.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 抽烟最棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it is the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 万一这种事没完没了怎么办？
sense_groups.english: I mean, what if this keeps happening?

sense_groups.chinese: 她们在外头抽烟做决定
sense_groups.english: They'll be outside smoking, making all the decisions...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能在办公室里 呼吸愚蠢的新鲜空气
sense_groups.english: ...and I'll just be up in my office breathing in my stupid clean air.

sense_groups.chinese: 到时等阿金要升我们的职…
sense_groups.english: You know? And when Kim wants to promote one of us...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想她会选谁？是我还是乌烟瘴气的冒烟女？
sense_groups.english: ...who do you think she's gonna pick? Me or Smokey Smokerson?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你也可以一起去 不用抽烟
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you can go down there, you don't have to smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 就说要去透透气
sense_groups.english: Just say you wanna get some fresh air.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这我做得到
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 简单点的就是一起抽烟
sense_groups.english: Yeah, or you could just do the easy thing and smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 要去喝咖啡吗？ - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Do you wanna go get coffee? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乐意之至 - 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, I would love to. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 我也想起去 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go too, babe. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Yay. - Yay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我变卦了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I changed my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 来讨论派对的事 我有一大堆点子
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's talk about the party. I have so many ideas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Ooh, me too. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 真是壮观
sense_groups.english: Yeah! - Oh, look at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这是蛋糕的素描图 - 哇哦
sense_groups.english: All right. This is a little sketch of the cake. - Uh-huh. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一些菜单的样本
sense_groups.english: See? Um, some sample menus.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如用异国小点心当前菜
sense_groups.english: Um, you know, I thought we'd start with a Tuscan-style finger food.

sense_groups.chinese: 至于音乐呢 这是我CD收藏的字母列表
sense_groups.english: Okay. And for music, here's an alphabetized list of all of my CDs.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟食物超搭配的还做了记号
sense_groups.english: I've highlighted the ones that'll go really good with the food.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是说要亲密的晚餐派对吗？ - 现在不那样做了
sense_groups.english: What happened to the dinner party? - We're not doing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好？那么… - 哇哦 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay? So... - Wow. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来你全包办了 多谢 "共同"主办人
sense_groups.english: Looks like you took care of everything. Thanks a lot, cohost.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？我没有一手包办啊
sense_groups.english: Wait. I didn't take care of everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要做的事还有很多
sense_groups.english: There's plenty of things for you to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 举个例子
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh? Like what?

sense_groups.chinese: 杯子
sense_groups.english: Cups.

sense_groups.chinese: 杯子？你让我准备杯子？
sense_groups.english: Cups. You're giving me cups?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有冰块
sense_groups.english: And ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 杯子和冰块？我可以负责杯子和冰块？
sense_groups.english: Cups and ice? Oh, I get to be in charge of cups and ice?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 行 我就负责杯子和冰块
sense_groups.english: Fine. Okay, I will be in charge of cups and ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 冰块可以从餐厅拿… - 冰块是我的
sense_groups.english: Wait, I can get ice at the restaurant... - I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 试镜顺利吗？ - 不太顺利
sense_groups.english: How did the audition go? - Not so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 你在学乔伊那招吗？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Are you doing Joey's

sense_groups.chinese: "试镜不太顺利 事实上很顺利对吧"
sense_groups.english: "The audition didn't go so well. Yeah, it did!"

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 班取得了第二次试镜的资格 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Ben got a second audition. - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我得教导罗斯我的戏分 因为我没有过关
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I had to teach Ross my bit because I actually didn't get a callback.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也过关了 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You got a callback too, didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I did!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你怎么会来这里？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. What are you doing out here?

sense_groups.chinese: 里头有点无聊 我想说来…
sense_groups.english: You know, it got kind of lonely up there, so I just thought I would come out here...

sense_groups.chinese: 这里透透气
sense_groups.english: ...and get some fresh air.

sense_groups.chinese: 南西和我正好讨论到秋装
sense_groups.english: We were talking about the fall collection.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 所以这是要…
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. - So anyway, we really...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 瞧你被我们熏的 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. We're smoking all over you. - That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不成…你待着 我们走
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. We'll move. You stay there.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我把设计寄给罗夫 他很喜欢
sense_groups.english: I sent the designs to Ralph. He was excited about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你是最棒的
sense_groups.english: That's great. You are the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 能借支烟吗？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Can I bum one of those?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个就好…
sense_groups.english: Actually, this one's...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在聊什么好笑的？
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, okay. What's so funny over here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为你不抽烟的
sense_groups.english: I thought you didn't smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你们是说大麻烟
sense_groups.english: You know, I thought you guys meant marijuana cigarettes.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是天使尘那种
sense_groups.english: You know what I mean? Like, doobies?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还纳闷你们是疯了不成
sense_groups.english: Actually, I thought to myself, "Those guys are crazy."

sense_groups.chinese: 没啦 我自己也抽烟 照三餐天天都抽
sense_groups.english: But no, actually, I smoke the regular ones all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会抽大麻
sense_groups.english: We get high.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 闹你的 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I'm kidding. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 这真是折磨人 你是怎么习惯的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. This is so nerve-racking. How do you do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我过关的经验不多 所以…
sense_groups.english: Well, fortunately, I don't get many callbacks so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在试镜之后被留下来 这是好现象吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it a good sign that they asked us to hang around after?

sense_groups.chinese: 天知道
sense_groups.english: Who knows?

sense_groups.chinese: 最后入围的是雷蒙 班 凯尔和乔伊
sense_groups.english: Okay. We have narrowed it down to Raymond, Ben, Kyle and Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 其余的人辛苦了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: The rest of you, thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 我就知道
sense_groups.english: Yes! I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Ah. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再会
sense_groups.english: So long.

sense_groups.chinese: 后会有期
sense_groups.english: Later.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我有可能饰演班的爸爸
sense_groups.english: This is great. I might actually get to play Ben's dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: Actually, that can't happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你们各自的长相都不同
sense_groups.english: Because you all have such different looks...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们把你和雷蒙配对 凯尔和班是一组
sense_groups.english: ...we're putting you with Raymond and Kyle with Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以最后只有一组会出线
sense_groups.english: So it'll either be you two or you two.

sense_groups.chinese: 要命
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样就有点尴尬了 - 真的是
sense_groups.english: This is gonna be kind of weird. - Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 一定会很尴尬
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's gonna be weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们是最好的朋友 所以才会尴尬
sense_groups.english: No. We're like best friends. That's why it's weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来如此… 我只是搭腔而已
sense_groups.english: I thought we were just talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能把这些东西放这里 等着给瑞秋过生日吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it okay if I leave this stuff here till Rachel's birthday party?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 里头是什么？ - 杯子
sense_groups.english: Uh, sure. What's in them? - Um, cups.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 因为我们替瑞秋 准备了八百加仑的水
sense_groups.english: Oh, good, because we got Rachel 800 gallons of water.

sense_groups.chinese: 老实说 这些杯子还真不少
sense_groups.english: Seriously, that's a lot of cups.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这是因为我负责杯子和冰块
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I'm in charge of cups and ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡在这一天将后悔莫及 因为她要我负责杯子和冰块
sense_groups.english: And Monica's gonna rue the day that she put me in charge of cups and ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也后悔过一次 除了后悔没做别的
sense_groups.english: You know, I rued the day once. Didn't get a whole lot else done.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 该把其他杯子搬上来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, time to bring up the rest of the cups.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 - 嘿 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 罗斯 你在这里正好
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Ross, good, I'm glad you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有事要跟你说 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: I want to talk to you about something. - Oh. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想这次拍广告的事
sense_groups.english: Well, I've been thinking about this whole commercial thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和班硬碰硬
sense_groups.english: You know me against Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 捉对厮杀 这样横竖都不会有好结果
sense_groups.english: The two of us competing. Well, that can't lead to anything good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我还是退出好了
sense_groups.english: I think I'm just gonna step aside.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他们我不去试镜
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna tell them that I won't audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 太好了 多谢
sense_groups.english: Joey, that's great. Thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？
sense_groups.english: That's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要让我这样做？这事关我的职业生涯耶
sense_groups.english: You're gonna let me do this? This is my career we're talking about here.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是你说…
sense_groups.english: But you just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是要你说出让班退出
sense_groups.english: I just said that so you wouldn't let Ben do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 如果真有人要退出 那也应该是班
sense_groups.english: Look, Ross, if anyone should step aside, it should be Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 钱德 告诉他为什么
sense_groups.english: What? - Chandler, tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先去开门
sense_groups.english: Well, let me get the door first.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人 你好
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, no one.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么班应该退出？
sense_groups.english: Why should Ben step aside?

sense_groups.chinese: 这原本就是他的试镜 你是跟过去的
sense_groups.english: It was his audition in the first place. You just tagged along.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像是跟班老爹
sense_groups.english: You're like the tag-along dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 起码我有顾虑到班的感受
sense_groups.english: At least I care about his feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道万一他没通过试镜 到时他会有多难过吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know how hard this is gonna be on him when he doesn't get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 那他又为什么不会通过？
sense_groups.english: And why wouldn't he get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧 ？
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有看过跟我同组的小子有多厉害？
sense_groups.english: Have you seen what my kid can do? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 他会拨电话 吃墨西哥脆片
sense_groups.english: I mean, he dials phones, he eats tortilla chips.

sense_groups.chinese: 还会凭空踢足球演对手戏呢
sense_groups.english: He plays soccer with the cartoon tiger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你的小子喝汤 比我儿子厉害？
sense_groups.english: Are you saying your kid eats soup better than my kid?

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是给他一根汤匙罢了
sense_groups.english: You just give him a spoon, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我们走着瞧 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? I guess we'll see. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这支广告片的主角 非我和米契莫属
sense_groups.english: Because this commercial belongs to me and Mitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的孩子叫做雷蒙 - 对？你的也是
sense_groups.english: Your kid's name is Raymond. - Yeah? So is yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有用？ - 很棒…
sense_groups.english: How did work go? - Oh, it was great. It was great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听你们的建议去她们抽烟的地方 我们讨论到了生意
sense_groups.english: I went down there just like you said. And we talked business.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿金完全接受我的意见
sense_groups.english: And Kim totally took my opinions.

sense_groups.chinese: 你浑身烟味
sense_groups.english: You stink.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢 - 我是说真的
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - No, I'm serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那里的人全都在抽烟
sense_groups.english: That's because I went down there and they were smoking.

sense_groups.chinese: 这其实是成功的味道
sense_groups.english: This is actually the smell of success.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过有点怪怪的
sense_groups.english: But there's something different, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你有抽烟
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You smoked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 - 才怪
sense_groups.english: I did not. - Yes, you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来生病又快乐 你一定有抽烟
sense_groups.english: You look happy and sick. You smoked.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦…我有抽 为了事业不得已嘛
sense_groups.english: All right, fine. But I had to. I had to do it for my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望我也可以 为了事业这么做
sense_groups.english: I wish I had to smoke for my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很恶心耶
sense_groups.english: That's so gross.

sense_groups.chinese: 没那么糟啦
sense_groups.english: Well, no, it's not that bad, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然舌头有点打结 手指也有点怪味
sense_groups.english: I mean, yeah, my tongue feels a little fuzzy and my fingers sort of smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我感觉快吐了
sense_groups.english: I actually feel like I could throw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但你一定要撑过这一关 再来就会是乐无比了
sense_groups.english: But you gotta push past this, okay? Because it's about to get so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你浑身烟味 我得去透透气
sense_groups.english: You smell so smoky, I gotta get up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没骗你
sense_groups.english: I'm not kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你闻起来很香
sense_groups.english: I think you smell great.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以大家都同意了 不要格子图案 要粉红？
sense_groups.english: So we're decided. No on plaid, yes on pink.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全正确
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我举双手双脚赞成
sense_groups.english: I'm so onboard.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这支烟不是才刚点吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Rachel, didn't you just light that? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你知道什么？
sense_groups.english: But you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在努力少抽烟
sense_groups.english: I'm just really, really trying to cut back, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我等着看笑话
sense_groups.english: Good luck, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我最近有想要戒烟
sense_groups.english: I've actually been thinking about quitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 我每周日晚上 都告诉自己要戒烟
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, sure. Every Sunday night, I tell myself I'm quitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果周一还不是狂抽猛抽
sense_groups.english: Every Monday morning, it's like

sense_groups.chinese: 还用你说
sense_groups.english: Tell me about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就戒了吧 我们一起戒烟
sense_groups.english: Well, let's quit. We'll just quit. Let's all quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来是很诱人啦
sense_groups.english: It does sound appealing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我戒烟从没成功过 - 你可以的 一定行
sense_groups.english: I never could do it. - But you could. You can. Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以互相帮忙 用那个什么戒烟贴布的
sense_groups.english: We can help each other out. We could get those patches.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能组成戒烟三姐妹
sense_groups.english: We could be like the Patch Sisters.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我们真的应该戒烟 好吧 一起来戒烟
sense_groups.english: You know, we really should quit. Okay, let's quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 太棒了 把香烟给我 来
sense_groups.english: Yes. Great. Give me those cigs. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 通通交出来
sense_groups.english: Give it. Give it. Out. Done. Quit. Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 那个打火机是我先生送我的 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: My late husband gave me that lighter. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: I'm not kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, then. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 汤
sense_groups.english: Mm, soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 罗斯随时会到
sense_groups.english: Joey, Ross is gonna be here any second.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去上个厕所 帮我看一下班 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you mind watching Ben while I use the ladies' room?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 没问题 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, no problem. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 班
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想当演员啊？告诉你 演戏可不像野餐
sense_groups.english: So you want to be an actor, huh? Well, I gotta tell you, it's no picnic.

sense_groups.chinese: 有碰不完的钉子 一点都不稳定
sense_groups.english: There's tons of rejection. No stability.

sense_groups.chinese: 前一天你还是德瑞克医生
sense_groups.english: I mean, one day, you're Dr. Drake Ramoray.

sense_groups.chinese: 隔天你就要去啃蕃茄酱
sense_groups.english: The next day, you're eating ketchup right out of the bottle.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 班
sense_groups.english: Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 班…
sense_groups.english: I mean, Ben. Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 雷蒙 乔伊 该你们上场了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Raymond, Joey, you're up.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们来试一次 你们准备好了就开始
sense_groups.english: All right, well, let's try one. Whenever you guys are ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 有问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. - Is there a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是面汤 我练习时是用蕃茄汤
sense_groups.english: Well, this is noodle soup. And I've been working with tomato.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过没关系…
sense_groups.english: But that's okay. No problem. No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 面汤…
sense_groups.english: Mm, noodle soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 你那样不错 不过台词是"汤"
sense_groups.english: You know, that's fine. But the line is, "Mm, soup."

sense_groups.chinese: 那我刚才说什么？ - 面汤
sense_groups.english: Oh. What'd I say? - Mm, noodle soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么不一样？
sense_groups.english: How's that different?

sense_groups.chinese: 对…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Right. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们来试一次
sense_groups.english: All right. Let's try one.

sense_groups.chinese: 面汤
sense_groups.english: Mm, noodle soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们再来次
sense_groups.english: Okay. Let's do it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 汤
sense_groups.english: Mm, soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 不对 是 "面汤" "汤"
sense_groups.english: I mean, noodle soup. I mean, soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 你争气点
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得换下一组了
sense_groups.english: You know what? We need to move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 不… 我再演一次
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, I could do it one more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: See, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 面汤…
sense_groups.english: Mm, noodle soup.

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶
sense_groups.english: Damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 被逮到了
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. Busted.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这是在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Come on, you guys. What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是戒烟姐妹花
sense_groups.english: I thought we were the Patch Sisters.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那样行不通
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that didn't work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我们有试着戒烟 但那实在是太难了
sense_groups.english: Rachel, we tried to quit. But it was too hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们开始抽烟 起码也该告诉我嘛
sense_groups.english: Well, if you started smoking again, you could have at least told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点来支 刚才说到哪里？不行
sense_groups.english: Come on, give me one of those. What are we talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 你戒烟很成功 不许放弃
sense_groups.english: No, you're doing great. Don't give up.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们才没跟你说 我们不想拖你下水
sense_groups.english: That's why we didn't tell you, and we are not gonna drag you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 别这样 拖我下水…
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. No, no. Drag me down. Drag me down.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 万万不可 你戒烟成功 我们都替你骄傲
sense_groups.english: Forget it, Rachel. We're both so proud of how well you're doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能让你前功尽弃 若被我查到你有带烟 我一定炒你鱿鱼
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna let you blow it. In fact, if I catch you, you're fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 离开这里 我不要你吸二手烟
sense_groups.english: So go on, get out of here. Go on. I don't want you breathing this stuff. Go on.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 你和我一起去法国出差
sense_groups.english: So okay. So you'll come with me on the Paris trip?

sense_groups.chinese: 要命
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你瞧瞧 杯子帽 杯子布条
sense_groups.english: Hey, check it out. Cup hat, cup banner...

sense_groups.chinese: 杯子吊灯 还有本尊 杯子
sense_groups.english: ...cup chandelier and the thing that started it all. The cup.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你对杯子还真有一套 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Great job with the cups, Pheebs. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干脆跟她去约会算了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just go out with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有注意到冰？
sense_groups.english: Did you notice the ice? Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 各式各样的都有 有碎冰 冰块还有干冰 注意看
sense_groups.english: We have it all. We have crushed, cubed and dry. Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 很有神秘感吧？
sense_groups.english: Mystical.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人想吃我的小点心 他们全跑去吃菲比的雪花冰
sense_groups.english: No one's eating my Tuscan finger food. They're filling up on Phoebe's snow cones.

sense_groups.chinese: 有雪花冰？
sense_groups.english: There are snow cones?

sense_groups.chinese: 雪花冰最恶心了

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔

sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what? Maybe you didn't mess up your audition because you suck.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你搞砸了试镜 是因为你更在意你的教子

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？ - 我认为 在潜意识里…

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得在某种程度上 你破坏了…

sense_groups.chinese: 自己的试镜好让班拿到那个角色

sense_groups.chinese: 你的说法比我的好多了

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我念兹在兹都是班
sense_groups.english: No, it's just that, uh, I care so damn much about little Ben...

sense_groups.chinese: 看到他成功对我来说更重要
sense_groups.english: ...that, uh, it was more important for me to see him succeed.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样 谢谢你 - 谢谢你

sense_groups.chinese: 那他拿到角色没？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: So did he get it? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 她现在不会下来这里了 她在十楼
sense_groups.english: Oh, she doesn't come down anymore. You can find her up on 10.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们昨天中饭聊到提案报告

sense_groups.english: And I said, "Yeah, absolutely."

sense_groups.chinese: 后会有期了
sense_groups.english: I'll catch you guys later.

sense_groups.english: On your dresser.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是原来的那一个 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Okay, that is the one we already have. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的主戏到了 就是现在
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's my big scene. My big scene's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你敢打赌 没有人听说过什么？ - 不敢
sense_groups.english: What do you bet nobody heard anything? - No bet.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人在吗？
sense_groups.english: Anybody home?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家继续笑 我祖母发现一定会难过到死掉
sense_groups.english: Okay, everybody just keep smiling. It'll kill my grandmother if she finds out. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 我那段被剪掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, what is it? - Uh, they cut me out of the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？ - 或许现在才轮到你上
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Maybe your scene's coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不太可能 看到那个装尸体的袋子没？
sense_groups.english: Not likely. Because you see that body bag right there?

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 - 里头装的是我
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - I'm in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 太糟糕了 你要怎么办？
sense_groups.english: This is terrible. What'll you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 我的老祖母活着就是为了看我演戏
sense_groups.english: I don't know. But this little old lady lives for my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 上回《我们的日子》不要我 她差点难过到死掉
sense_groups.english: When they dumped me off Days of Our Lives, she almost died.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样很不妙
sense_groups.english: That's not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没在笑 别用那种表情 大家继续笑…
sense_groups.english: You're not smiling. Not that face! Smile, everybody smile! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你怎么不实话实说？那又不能怪你
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just tell her what happened? It's not your fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们继续这样说话 会不会吓到她？
sense_groups.english: If we keep talking this way, aren't we gonna freak her out soon?

sense_groups.chinese: 很快… 马上就轮我上场了
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, soon. I'm gonna be on soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是我
sense_groups.english: There I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 山姆瓦特斯顿
sense_groups.english: Sam Waterston!

sense_groups.chinese: 不对… 那是我…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. That's me. That's me!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 那是山姆瓦特斯顿
sense_groups.english: No. Sam Waterston.

sense_groups.chinese: 《爱与罪》 《摩羯一号大行动》
sense_groups.english: Crime Misdemeanor, Capricorn One.

sense_groups.chinese: 她听不懂"你好" 却知道《摩羯一号大行动》
sense_groups.english: She doesn't know "hello," but she knows Capricorn One.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 哈？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要那副耳环 节目一演完我们就要出去了
sense_groups.english: I need those earrings. We're leaving when the show's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我已经还你了啊
sense_groups.english: But I already gave them back to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有
sense_groups.english: No, you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我已经没还给你 我就是这样说的啊
sense_groups.english: All right, I already didn't gave them back to you. That's what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 另一个耳环在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Where's that other earring?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不在这里…
sense_groups.english: It's not here, Pheebs. It's not here. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨晚有去钱德和乔伊那里
sense_groups.english: I went to Chandler's last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 记得要检查钱德的珠宝盒
sense_groups.english: Make sure you check Chandler's jewelry box.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 钱德有珠宝盒？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, Chandler has a jewelry box?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 时间紧迫 你要我现在就跟你解释？
sense_groups.english: Okay, we have 10 minutes. Do you want me to get into that now?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个素食披萨…
sense_groups.english: How's that, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你吃得还习惯吗？
sense_groups.english: ...vegetarian pizza working out for you, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你和那些蔬菜 还真是有两下子
sense_groups.english: You and those, uh, vegetables have a real, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 是吧？
sense_groups.english: ...thing going on, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛怪里怪气的？
sense_groups.english: Why are you being weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜不喜欢？
sense_groups.english: Do you like it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不喜欢 否则我就会问 "你干嘛装可爱"了
sense_groups.english: No. That would be, "Why are you being cute?"

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我在练习打情骂俏
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm working on my flirting.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来如此 我没看出来
sense_groups.english: Oh! I did not get that.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你喜欢看 《法网游龙》吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Monica, do you like Law and Order?

sense_groups.chinese: 喜欢 很好看 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's good. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天发现到了新的你 好比你爱看《法网游龙》
sense_groups.english: I found out all this stuff about you. You like Law and Order...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你到处跟人打情骂俏
sense_groups.english: ...and you've flirted with every guy in the tri-state area.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh. Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我来问个清楚
sense_groups.english: Okay, let me get this straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以打情骂俏 我却不行？
sense_groups.english: It's okay for you to flirt, but not for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴我们把话说清楚了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so glad we cleared that up.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 但你听我说 男女有些事是不一样的
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, but some things are different for men and women.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续 解释我一些男女的差别
sense_groups.english: Go on, teach me about men and women.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我已经教过你很多了 不过…
sense_groups.english: Okay. I've already taught you so much already, but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟男人打情骂俏的时候 你觉得"没啥大不了的"
sense_groups.english: When you flirt with a guy, you think, "No big deal."

sense_groups.chinese: 但对方会觉得 他终于找到人上床了
sense_groups.english: But the guy thinks, "Finally! Somebody who wants to sleep with me."

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 - 这是真的
sense_groups.english: No way! - It's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可悲 - 这也是真的
sense_groups.english: Well, that's pathetic. - Again, true.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人都这样吗？ - 醒着的男人都适用
sense_groups.english: This goes for all guys? - All guys that are awake.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我们上床睡觉后
sense_groups.english: Then we go to sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 世界另一边的男人起床 继续做一模一样的事
sense_groups.english: All guys from the other end of the world wake up and behave the exact same way.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 又进广告了 我还是没跟她说
sense_groups.english: All right. It's another commercial and I still haven't told her.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这是最后一段广告
sense_groups.english: Joey, this is the last commercial.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只剩十分钟 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: You got, like, 10 minutes left. - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 不许你落跑 留她在这里
sense_groups.english: You are not gonna run out and leave her here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好啦
sense_groups.english: Yeah, all right. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 马上回来 马上回来？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey's gonna be right back. Right back?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们先来聊聊你吧
sense_groups.english: Meanwhile, let's talk about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你年纪大 个子小
sense_groups.english: So, you're old and small.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 找到没？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Did you find it?

sense_groups.chinese: 耳环是没有 但我在沙发底下 找到我的太阳眼镜
sense_groups.english: The earring, no. But I found my sunglasses.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从去年夏天找到现在
sense_groups.english: I've been looking for these since last summer.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我借你的太阳眼镜
sense_groups.english: Those are my sunglasses. You borrowed them from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 别激动 还你就是了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Calm down. Here they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要怎么办？ - 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: What do we do? - I don't know. I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只好老实跟摩妮卡说了
sense_groups.english: We'll just have to tell Monica, that's all.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 她一定会杀了我
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! She's gonna kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 我可以跟她说是我弄掉的
sense_groups.english: Oh. - I could tell her it was all my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我有话要跟你说
sense_groups.english: Mon, could I talk to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 什么事？ - 额…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. What is it? - Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我弄丢了你一只耳环
sense_groups.english: I lost one of your earrings.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I am so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 都弄丢了还能怎样
sense_groups.english: All right, well, I mean, what can you do? If you lost it, you lost it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证会赔你一副新的 我真的很愧疚
sense_groups.english: I'll replace it, I promise. I feel so terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你又不是故意的 不是
sense_groups.english: That's fine. You didn't do it on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 噢
sense_groups.english: No. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧你难过的 来
sense_groups.english: Look at you. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 好点了没？ - 有啊 你最棒了
sense_groups.english: You feel better? Ha, ha. - Yeah. You're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 等一等
sense_groups.english: Okay, wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能这样
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实不是菲比弄丢的
sense_groups.english: Listen, honey, it's not Phoebe's fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 她把你的耳环借我
sense_groups.english: She lent me the earrings.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我弄丢的 我真的很抱歉 我也觉得好愧疚
sense_groups.english: I lost it. I'm so sorry, honey. I feel terrible too.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我才不借你东西
sense_groups.english: That is exactly why I do not lend you stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 先是我的首饰 不是首饰 就是我的蓝色毛衣
sense_groups.english: First it's my jewelry. If it's not that, it's my sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是蓝色毛衣 就是我的太阳眼镜
sense_groups.english: And if it's not my sweater, it's my sunglasses.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的太阳眼镜？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Your sunglasses? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨外送 - 我的 …
sense_groups.english: Pizza. - Mine, mine, mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 要开始了
sense_groups.english: Okay, here goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备见识一流的打情骂俏
sense_groups.english: Prepare yourselves for some class-A flirting.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等…
sense_groups.english: Okay, hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我准备好了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你犯不着这样 若你真的喜欢这个女孩 我也不觉得打情骂俏是…
sense_groups.english: If you really like this girl, I don't think flirting is the right way...

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 啊 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah! Ah! Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 等着看就知道
sense_groups.english: You'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what's her name?

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特琳…
sense_groups.english: Caitlin!

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特琳
sense_groups.english: Caitlin.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吃下去也不是办法
sense_groups.english: Oh, we can't keep eating like this. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 12块半
sense_groups.english: Heh. It's, uh, $12.50.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们做披萨 是用烧木头的炉子吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you make the pizzas in one of those, uh, wood-burning ovens?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 其实是瓦斯炉
sense_groups.english: No, actually, I think they're gas.

sense_groups.chinese: 瓦斯炉？
sense_groups.english: Gas? Wow, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 真带劲
sense_groups.english: Intense.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果盖勒家的人 都这样打情骂俏的话 我们就没有问题了
sense_groups.english: If this is the way all the Gellers flirt, we don't have a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道瓦斯的味道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know that smell gas has?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是加进去的
sense_groups.english: They put that in.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 瓦斯其实是无色无味
sense_groups.english: The gas is odorless.

sense_groups.chinese: 加上味道是为了让人 在瓦斯漏气时能闻得出来
sense_groups.english: But they add the smell so you know when there's a leak.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多气体都有味道…
sense_groups.english: A lot of other gas smells.

sense_groups.chinese: 救命喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, the humanity.

sense_groups.chinese: 甲烧有味道…
sense_groups.english: Methane smells...

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 我真的得走了
sense_groups.english: You know what? Um, actually, I really should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没付钱呢 - 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, but I haven't paid you yet. - That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们点了那么多这一个算我请客
sense_groups.english: You guys have ordered so many that this one's on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 上次我听说…
sense_groups.english: Last I heard...

sense_groups.chinese: 警察报称失踪的妇女仍然超过600
sense_groups.english: ...the cops had over 600 reported missing women still.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是跟她说到瓦斯的事？
sense_groups.english: Was I talking to her about gas?

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本就是主题
sense_groups.english: More so than anything else.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很有意思
sense_groups.english: I found it interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 别担心
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 九年之后 我和她就能在一起了
sense_groups.english: In nine years, she and I will be right there! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我去清掉这些披萨盒
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, I'm gonna clear out some of these boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？ - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有哪些气体会加味道？
sense_groups.english: What else do they add smell to?

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特琳… 嗨
sense_groups.english: Caitlin! Caitlin! Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Rachel. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 住楼上的 叫一堆彼萨的那家
sense_groups.english: From upstairs, people with all the pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 彼萨有问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, was there a problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是… 披萨很好吃
sense_groups.english: No, they're fine. Great pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是我朋友罗斯
sense_groups.english: But, actually, um, my friend Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 他只要打情骂俏就会紧张
sense_groups.english: ...he just gets really nervous when he's flirting.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他是在打情骂俏？没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! That was flirting?

sense_groups.chinese: 是 - 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的感觉…
sense_groups.english: I know, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过一旦过了那个阶段
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, once you get past that part...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个让你想要去死的阶段
sense_groups.english: ...where it just feels like you wanna die...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就会发现他是个大好人
sense_groups.english: ...he's a really good person.

sense_groups.chinese: 开口闭口都是瓦斯的那个人？ - 是
sense_groups.english: The guy with the gas? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的很体贴风趣
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, he's really sweet and really funny...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一副好心肠
sense_groups.english: ...and he's just, oh, got a good heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我觉得他很喜欢你 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: And besides, I think he really likes you. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们七个人 却叫了十个披萨 这还不够明显吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, we have seven people and 10 pizzas. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说乔伊很会吃
sense_groups.english: I thought Joey was there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以留到星期一 然后我会强制驱离
sense_groups.english: You've got till Monday. Then I move to dismiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才在走廊遇到凯特琳
sense_groups.english: Um, I just ran into Caitlin in the hallway.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打情骂俏的技巧 肯定比我想像中更高明
sense_groups.english: Uh, you must be getting better at this flirting stuff than I thought. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？ - 虽然我搞不懂
sense_groups.english: What? - I don't get it...

sense_groups.chinese: 但她要我转交她的电话给你
sense_groups.english: ...but she wanted me to give you her phone number.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 她自己给你的？
sense_groups.english: And she just gave you this?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 谢了 但我不需要你帮忙
sense_groups.english: Rach, thanks. But I don't need you doing me any favors.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没帮忙啊 是她觉得你很可爱
sense_groups.english: I didn't. I didn't. She thought you were cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 这点我倒是相信
sense_groups.english: Well, that I can believe.

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 还在演吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, is the show still on?

sense_groups.chinese: 快要演完了
sense_groups.english: Almost over, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大妈
sense_groups.english: Hey, Nonnie.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是教宗吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh! Is that the Pope?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我干嘛跟过去看？
sense_groups.english: Why am I looking?

sense_groups.chinese: 来了 我的主戏上场
sense_groups.english: Oh, Nonnie, here I am! This is my big scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 快退后
sense_groups.english: All right, back off!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有枪喔
sense_groups.english: I got a gun!

sense_groups.chinese: 用起来可不会手软
sense_groups.english: I'm not afraid to use it.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 阿妈
sense_groups.english: That's right, Nonnie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你起码也该换一件上衣
sense_groups.english: You couldn't have at least changed your shirt?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你在手提箱里 装满十万美元…
sense_groups.english: Now, I want a suitcase filled with $100,000...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘 嘘 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh! Shoo, shoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 装满十万美元的小钞票
sense_groups.english: Filled with $100,000 in small bills.

sense_groups.chinese: 若是我没拿到…
sense_groups.english: And if I don't get... Shoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 若是我没拿到…
sense_groups.english: And if I don't get it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就毙了这只鸭子
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna shoot this duck!

sense_groups.chinese: 不能这样
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要出去了
sense_groups.english: I'm coming out!

sense_groups.chinese: 她会相信吗？
sense_groups.english: And she's supposed to buy this?

sense_groups.chinese: 地面控制队呼叫总部…
sense_groups.english: Ground control to Major Tom

sense_groups.chinese: 倒计时开始…
sense_groups.english: Commencing countdown

sense_groups.chinese: 动力…
sense_groups.english: Engines

sense_groups.chinese: 全开
sense_groups.english: On

sense_groups.chinese: 这是下周的片段… 下周的
sense_groups.english: That's, uh, scenes from next week's show. Next week.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定要等着看
sense_groups.english: I am definitely gonna watch that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一副呢？看起来一样吗？
sense_groups.english: What about these? Do these look the same?

sense_groups.chinese: 一模一样 - 不是分开来看
sense_groups.english: Definitely. - Not as each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就不样了
sense_groups.english: Oh, then, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 准备好了？ - 嗨 是
sense_groups.english: Hey, you ready? - Hi. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真美 - 额
sense_groups.english: You look amazing. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是全世界最幸运的男人
sense_groups.english: I'm the luckiest man in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 你即将要更幸运了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're about to get a little luckier. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 耳环让我看看 - 喔 对 耳环…
sense_groups.english: Let me see the earrings. - Oh, right, the earrings.

sense_groups.chinese: 好看极了
sense_groups.english: They look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你男友真是品味一流呢
sense_groups.english: Does your boyfriend have the best taste or what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我男友的品味真的很棒
sense_groups.english: My boyfriend really does have great taste.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢你帮我选耳环 - 嗯嗯
sense_groups.english: Thanks for picking out the earrings. - Mm-hm.

questions.name: S05E20
questions.en:
Okay, guys, listen.
Tomorrow, Emily gets married again.
So try to really keep Ross' mind off of it.
Okay. - Good idea.
Hey, man. What's up?
Just thinking about Emily getting married tomorrow.
Oh, Ross. Look, look.
What? Where?
Right over there. There. Look, look, look.
What am I looking at? - Somebody help me out here.
Hey. - Hey.
Monica, sorry I didn't come by. I was out with Gary.
He let me ride around with him. We saw and prevented crimes.
You got to go on a ride-along? - Uh-huh.
I want to go on a ride-along. - Me too.
Okay. - Yeah. Me too.
Really? You?
Yeah.
Well, it's kind of dangerous. - Well, I like danger.
Okay, you guys free tonight? - Yeah.
You didn't say it was gonna be at nighttime.
Hey. - Hey.
I'm glad you're home. We can finally organize these photos.
Oh, thank God.
Finally.
I've broken them down into categories.
We got holidays, birthdays, candids...
And I've cross-referenced them by subject.
So if you're looking up, say...
...birthdays and dogs, you get photo 152.
See?
Oh, it's me and LePoo.
Wow, I miss that dog.
You can also find him under "dog" and "dead."
Great. Thanks.
Hand me that other box of photos. That's the last one.
Oops.
Sorry.
Good thing you numbered them.
I hadn't.
Photo 152 was a prototype.
Honey, it's okay. It's okay.
How about I fix you a drink? Maybe a margarita?
Ross has the blender.
Everything's just falling apart.
It's okay. I'll go to Ross', get the blender.
You get the margarita stuff ready. - All right.
His keys are in the drawer. Also, I need some cash.
Want me to stop at the ATM?
No. While you're at Ross', if you see any lying around.
What? - What?
I don't do that.
That was so cool, man. The way you leaned on that guy.
It is starting to get dark out there.
He told you everything. You cracked him.
He was the victim. They're usually pretty talkative.
Okay, but it is officially nighttime.
Want me to grab the berry? - It's called a cherry.
It's called... Chandler.
Okay, I got it.
This place makes the best sandwich in the world.
Does it have meatballs?
Oh, yeah.
Melted cheese and marinara sauce?
Yep.
You can't eat that in my car.
Yeah, okay.
Even though my tax dollars paid for this car.
Your tax dollars?
Yeah, okay.
Wow, that sandwich smells good.
Did I say you could smell it?
I can't smell it?
Half the taste is in the smell. You're sucking up all the taste units.
Okay, I'll give them back.
What is so great about that sandwich?
Okay. Imagine the best sex you ever had. - Okay.
Are you thinking about Monica? - Yeah.
What's that like?
Please don't be from a real dinosaur. Please, please.
Please, please, please.
"Made in Mexico." Yes!
Who would buy this?
Rach, it's me. Pick up.
What's up?
I need more margarita things.
I need some salt, some margarita mix and tequila.
So all we had was ice?
See if he has ice.
Okay.
Hello, Ross?
It's Emily here.
I know this is out of the blue, but I'm getting married tomorrow.
Well, maybe I am...
I keep thinking about you.
And I'm wondering if we made a mistake giving up so fast.
Are you thinking about me?
No, of course you're not. But if you are, call me tonight.
Okay, bye.
Where we going?
This witness won't return my calls. We'll surprise him coming home.
Surprise him? We're not gonna make anybody mad, are we?
Come on, man.
You gonna squeeze the perp's shoes a bit before he lawyers up?
He's a witness, not a perp. And no one talks like that.
Yeah. No one talks like that.
Oh, what, like you're Mr. Cop? - I'm more cop than you two.
How do you figure that?
I'm in the front seat, okay?
I'm Gary's partner.
When you say "partner," it doesn't sound cop.
It sounds gay.
Um, jealous.
Hey, we're undercover here. - Oh, yeah. No problem.
Ross. - Sorry.
There.
Hey, Gary. Who am I?
Phone home.
Look at Officer Ross riding back here with the visitors.
What's up with that, Serpico?
Are you thinking about me? No, of course you're not.
But if you are, call me tonight.
Okay, bye.
No.
I know.
Thank God you were here. We have to erase that.
What? We can't do that.
We have to. What if Ross hears that...
...and calls her and they get back together?
Is that what you want? Ross back with that controlling...
...neurotic, crazy Emily who wouldn't let him see you?
No. Oh, no, no.
God, no. He should not get back with her.
I know that, you know that. Even Ross knows that.
But we have no right to erase his message.
Look, I'm his sister and I love him. I don't want to see him get hurt.
Doesn't that give me the right to control...
Help him?
He's not the one who needs help.
She's obviously unstable.
She's thinking about running out on her wedding day.
Okay, fine. But look at the position she's putting him in.
And what's he gonna do?
Break up their marriage on their wedding day?
Who would do that?
Okay, fine. All right. But that was different.
Although it did involve a lot of the same people.
This is some twisted joke she's playing on him.
You are crazy. She sounded genuinely upset.
I mean, listen.
Your messages have been erased.
No.
Okay, but we're safe, right? Nothing bad's gonna go down.
No. But that reminds me. Sign this.
What is it?
It says you can't sue if you scrape your knee...
...or get your head blown off.
Oh, hurry up. I want to sign that.
Here he comes.
What is he doing? What the hell is he doing?
What is it?
Is everything okay? - What?
He sees us. Don't move. And don't look at him.
Hey, it's okay. It was just a car backfire.
Hey, look at that. You tried to save your buddy.
You see that?
You see what he did?
You okay, man?
Uh-huh.
Thanks, Joey.
Uh... Hello?
Hi.
We should go.
No, wait.
Oh, yeah. Right.
No. Monica.
Monica, we have to fix this.
What can we do? You erased the message.
Unless we tell him.
If you want to be rational, I can't argue with you.
All right?
Fine, tell him. I just don't want to be a part of it.
Maybe that's Emily leaving the exact same message.
Hey, Ross, it's you.
I just want you to remember this feeling.
You are lucky to be alive.
So live every day to the fullest.
Love yourself, okay?
And also get stamps. Bye.
Play that message for Emily, and this problem goes away.
Right?
Anybody want to meet a hero?
John Glenn is here?
No. Joey.
We had the most incredible night.
We're in the car... - Wait. Hold on.
Hi. - Hi.
Okay, go ahead.
So we're in the car, and bang. A shot was fired.
And Joey, with no regard for his own safety...
...throws himself on me.
My God.
It was a car backfire.
But he didn't know that.
Yeah, I didn't know that.
It could just as easily have been a bullet.
Ever think about joining the force? We could use a guy like you.
Who jumps at loud noises.
Wow. I could have died tonight.
If the car that backfired had run over you.
I'm going before he starts rambling about his newfound respect for life.
I do have a newfound respect for life.
Oh, my God.
You want to get some dinner? - Yeah, sure.
You know what? If I heard a shot right now, I'd throw my body on you.
Maybe we should walk in a bad neighborhood.
Okay.
Bye. - Bye.
Cut it out.
I'd hate to save your life and kick your ass on the same day.
Dude.
Why'd you take off?
Just going for a walk.
Around the living room, whatever.
Is something wrong? - No. No, I'm just tired.
You know, from the walk.
Okay.
You dove in front of Ross.
Ross.
That's what this is about.
Oh, my God. You hate Ross.
I don't hate Ross.
Of course you do. I saved him. You're mad at me. It adds up.
You want Ross out of the picture.
What picture?
I don't know. But I don't like what I'm hearing.
I'm glad you saved Ross. But it could've been a bullet.
And you didn't try to save me.
Oh.
You're upset because you think I chose Ross over you.
No, I knew you could take care of yourself.
You know? I mean, Ross needs help. He's not "street" like us.
You'd risk your life for Ross before you would for me.
That's the bottom line.
No, not exactly.
All right, look.
I wasn't trying to save Ross.
Okay?
My sandwich was next to Ross.
All right?
I was trying to save my sandwich.
From a bullet?
I know it doesn't make much sense. - "Much" sense?
Chandler, it was instinct. I just went for it.
You risked your life for a sandwich?
I know it sounds crazy...
...but this is the greatest sandwich in the world.
So you didn't choose Ross before me?
No. I would never do that.
You're like my brother.
Really? - Yeah.
In fact, to prove how much you mean to me...
Here.
Thanks. - Easy, it's not a hot dog.
How good is that?
Oh, yeah.
See?
What are you doing?
You're showing me how much I mean to you.
With a bite.
Jeez.
Hi.
What are you doing here?
Hey, you know what?
You are in our apartment all the time.
This is just a drop in the bucket, mister.
It doesn't matter. The important thing is that you're here.
You're my friend and you're here.
Okay, just a little scared. What's going on?
The most amazing thing happened tonight.
I thought my number was up.
I had an actual near-death experience.
What happened?
We were on the ride-along with Gary and somebody took a shot at me.
Really?
No. A car backfired.
But I thought somebody was taking a shot at me. And, Rach...
...I survived.
And I was filled with this great respect for life.
I want to experience every moment.
I want to seize every opportunity.
I am seeing everything so clearly now.
Because a car backfired?
Okay. Why are you here?
I don't know how this fits into your whole seizing thing...
...but Emily called you today.
You talked to her? - She left a message.
But it kind of got erased.
I mean, there's something wrong with your machine.
What did she say?
Something about having second thoughts about the wedding.
And did you guys make a mistake breaking up?
And she wants you to call her.
Wow.
That was a good thing that I told you, right?
Yeah. Yes. Of course.
Okay, thank you. Thank you. Because...
I'm gonna tell Monica I was right.
Because she didn't want...
Not important. Point is, I was right. Your decision.
Okay?
I was right.
Your decision.
Right.
I guess I should call Emily.
No, that's not the right decision.
That's not right.
Ross, come on.
I mean...
...that woman made you miserable.
Okay, Ross?
Do you really want to get back into that?
Okay, look. Yesterday...
...I wouldn't have even considered calling her back.
But my ex-wife calls on the same day...
...I have a near-death experience?
That's gotta mean something.
That was not a near-death experience. That was barely an experience.
You weren't there.
Maybe this is something that I'm supposed to seize, you know?
Okay. You know what?
Maybe this is not about seizing stuff.
Maybe this is about escaping stuff.
Okay? Look at today.
I mean, you escaped...
...death.
And maybe this is a chance for you to escape...
...getting back together with Emily.
That does make sense.
Because I do want to seize some opportunity...
...but I really don't want to see or talk to her.
Well, there you go.
Yeah, maybe today's just...
...close-call day.
Hey, thanks, Rach.
Oh, honey. No problem.
Wait, wait. The message is blinking.
Maybe you didn't erase it.
Hey, Ross, it's you...
That's an old message. Nobody needs to hear that.
Hey, um, was Monica here?
Yeah.
I want my money back.
You probably need that for stamps, right?
Hey, Pheebs?
Has Gary ever been shot at for real?
Yes, once.
A little.
He kind of did it to himself.
It's not really a good story.
I wonder how I'd react under fire. And not backfire...
...but heavy fire.
Like if I was in a war.
Man, I would be great in a war.
I think I'd make a fantastic military leader.
I mean, I know I'd make general before any of you guys.
Before or after you were shot by your own troops?
I know Joey would be in the foxhole protecting all of us.
If the foxhole was lined with sandwiches.
Yeah, hero sandwiches.
You all know I'm a pacifist, so I'm not interested in war in any way.
But when the revolution comes, I'll have to destroy you all.
Not you, Joey.
