sense_groups.english: Great. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 把另一箱照片递给我 那是最后箱
sense_groups.english: Hand me that other box of photos. That's the last one.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oops.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起啦
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好你有写上号码
sense_groups.english: Good thing you numbered them.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧
sense_groups.english: I hadn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 还没152号相片是范例
sense_groups.english: Photo 152 was a prototype.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Honey, it's okay. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你弄杯喝的？玛格丽特好吗？
sense_groups.english: How about I fix you a drink? Maybe a margarita?

sense_groups.chinese: 果汁机在罗斯那里
sense_groups.english: Ross has the blender.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都毁了
sense_groups.english: Everything's just falling apart.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 不碍事 我去找罗斯拿果汁机
sense_groups.english: It's okay. I'll go to Ross', get the blender.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先准备玛格莉特的材料 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: You get the margarita stuff ready. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他家钥匙放在抽屉里 我还需要一些现金
sense_groups.english: His keys are in the drawer. Also, I need some cash.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我去自动柜员机取吗？
sense_groups.english: Want me to stop at the ATM?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 到罗斯家里拿就好
sense_groups.english: No. While you're at Ross', if you see any lying around.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不做那种事的
sense_groups.english: I don't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你逼问那家伙的方式 真是太酷了
sense_groups.english: That was so cool, man. The way you leaned on that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天色越来越黑了
sense_groups.english: It is starting to get dark out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 他什么都招了 他对你毫不保留
sense_groups.english: He told you everything. You cracked him.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是受害者 他们通常都很多话
sense_groups.english: He was the victim. They're usually pretty talkative.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 正式进入夜晚了
sense_groups.english: Okay, but it is officially nighttime.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞 要我帮你拿红灯吗？ - 这叫做"警灯"
sense_groups.english: Want me to grab the berry? - It's called a cherry.

sense_groups.chinese: 是警灯 钱德
sense_groups.english: It's called... Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 买到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家店做的三明治 世界第一
sense_groups.english: This place makes the best sandwich in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 里头有肉球吗？
sense_groups.english: Does it have meatballs?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 有融化的起司 和大蒜蕃茄酱吗？
sense_groups.english: Melted cheese and marinara sauce?

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就不能在我的车上吃
sense_groups.english: You can't eat that in my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 买这部警车的钱 我缴的税也有一份
sense_groups.english: Even though my tax dollars paid for this car.

sense_groups.chinese: 你缴的税？
sense_groups.english: Your tax dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 你的钱
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个三明治还真香
sense_groups.english: Wow, that sandwich smells good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有说你可以闻吗？
sense_groups.english: Did I say you could smell it?

sense_groups.chinese: 闻个三明治都不行？
sense_groups.english: I can't smell it?

sense_groups.chinese: 香味就占去了好吃的一半 你把好吃都吸光了
sense_groups.english: Half the taste is in the smell. You're sucking up all the taste units.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 还给你
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll give them back.

sense_groups.chinese: 这三明治到底棒在哪里？
sense_groups.english: What is so great about that sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你做爱最爽的一次 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Imagine the best sex you ever had. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想的是摩妮卡吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Are you thinking about Monica? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么感觉？
sense_groups.english: What's that like?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托不要是真的恐龙 拜托…
sense_groups.english: Please don't be from a real dinosaur. Please, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 千万不要…
sense_groups.english: Please, please, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 墨西哥制造 好耶
sense_groups.english: "Made in Mexico." Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会买这种东西？
sense_groups.english: Who would buy this?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 是我 快接啊
sense_groups.english: Rach, it's me. Pick up.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做玛格丽特还缺材料
sense_groups.english: I need more margarita things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要盐巴 玛格丽特调汁 还有龙舌兰酒
sense_groups.english: I need some salt, some margarita mix and tequila.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们家里只有冰块喔？
sense_groups.english: So all we had was ice?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看他有没有冰块
sense_groups.english: See if he has ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: It's Emily here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很突然 但是我明天就要结婚了
sense_groups.english: I know this is out of the blue, but I'm getting married tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许啦…
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I am...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想你
sense_groups.english: I keep thinking about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道我们太快放弃 是不是一个错误
sense_groups.english: And I'm wondering if we made a mistake giving up so fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有在想我吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you thinking about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 一定没有 如果有的话 今晚打给我
sense_groups.english: No, of course you're not. But if you are, call me tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一站是哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where we going?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个目击证人不回我电话 我们去他家堵他
sense_groups.english: This witness won't return my calls. We'll surprise him coming home.

sense_groups.chinese: 去堵他？他不会生气吧？
sense_groups.english: Surprise him? We're not gonna make anybody mad, are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧你
sense_groups.english: Come on, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你会在那贼人的律师出现前 先从他身上挤出一些汁来？
sense_groups.english: You gonna squeeze the perp's shoes a bit before he lawyers up?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是目击证人 不是贼人 而且没有人会那样说话
sense_groups.english: He's a witness, not a perp. And no one talks like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 没人会那样说话
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No one talks like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 难不成你是警察？ - 我比你们两个都像警察
sense_groups.english: Oh, what, like you're Mr. Cop? - I'm more cop than you two.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么道理？
sense_groups.english: How do you figure that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我坐在前座 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm in the front seat, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是盖瑞的搭档
sense_groups.english: I'm Gary's partner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说搭档的时候不像警察
sense_groups.english: When you say "partner," it doesn't sound cop.

sense_groups.chinese: 倒像是同志
sense_groups.english: It sounds gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱吃醋
sense_groups.english: Um, jealous.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦别张扬 我们这是秘密出勤 - 好 没问题
sense_groups.english: Hey, we're undercover here. - Oh, yeah. No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 抱歉…
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: There.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞 我是谁？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gary. Who am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话回家
sense_groups.english: Phone home.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这位罗斯警官 被打入后座了
sense_groups.english: Look at Officer Ross riding back here with the visitors.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 这是怎么一回事呢？
sense_groups.english: What's up with that, Serpico?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有在想我吗？一定没有
sense_groups.english: Are you thinking about me? No, of course you're not.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有的话 今晚打给我
sense_groups.english: But if you are, call me tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好先被你听到了 我们一定要把这留言洗掉
sense_groups.english: Thank God you were here. We have to erase that.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我们不能那样
sense_groups.english: What? We can't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 非这样不可 万一罗斯听到了…
sense_groups.english: We have to. What if Ross hears that...

sense_groups.chinese: 回电给她 他们又复合了怎么办？
sense_groups.english: ...and calls her and they get back together?

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望那样吗？看到罗斯跟那个控制欲超强…
sense_groups.english: Is that what you want? Ross back with that controlling...

sense_groups.chinese: 神经兮兮的疯子艾蜜莉复合 那个不让罗斯见你的艾蜜莉？
sense_groups.english: ...neurotic, crazy Emily who wouldn't let him see you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 万万不可…
sense_groups.english: No. Oh, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 不 罗斯绝对不能和她复合
sense_groups.english: God, no. He should not get back with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知我知 就连罗斯都知道
sense_groups.english: I know that, you know that. Even Ross knows that.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们还是没有权力 擅自洗掉给罗斯的留言
sense_groups.english: But we have no right to erase his message.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可是他的妹妹 我爱他 不想看他受到伤害
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm his sister and I love him. I don't want to see him get hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 得了 我这样还没有权控制…
sense_groups.english: Doesn't that give me the right to control...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮助他吗？
sense_groups.english: Help him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得需要帮忙的不是他
sense_groups.english: He's not the one who needs help.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉非常不稳定
sense_groups.english: She's obviously unstable.

sense_groups.chinese: 她竟然想在结婚当天落跑
sense_groups.english: She's thinking about running out on her wedding day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 但你看看 她让罗斯陷入了什么处境
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. But look at the position she's putting him in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要罗斯怎么办？
sense_groups.english: And what's he gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 难不成在艾蜜莉结婚当天 跑去破坏婚礼？
sense_groups.english: Break up their marriage on their wedding day?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁做得出那种事？
sense_groups.english: Who would do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 不过这是两码子事
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. All right. But that was different.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然有很多人都是重复的
sense_groups.english: Although it did involve a lot of the same people.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾蜜莉显然想用变态的笑话 来恶整罗斯
sense_groups.english: This is some twisted joke she's playing on him.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 你疯了 她听起来真的很沮丧
sense_groups.english: You are crazy. She sounded genuinely upset.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听听就知道
sense_groups.english: I mean, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 您的留官已经删除
sense_groups.english: Your messages have been erased.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧…
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们很安全 对吧？不可能会有厄运降临
sense_groups.english: Okay, but we're safe, right? Nothing bad's gonna go down.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 不过我倒想起来了 签一下这个
sense_groups.english: No. But that reminds me. Sign this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？
sense_groups.english: What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 只是断腿或脑袋开花…
sense_groups.english: It says you can't sue if you scrape your knee...

sense_groups.chinese: 也不能告到市政府头上
sense_groups.english: ...or get your head blown off.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点喔 我要签
sense_groups.english: Oh, hurry up. I want to sign that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 他来了
sense_groups.english: Here he comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在干嘛？搞什么鬼？
sense_groups.english: What is he doing? What the hell is he doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？…怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事吧？ - 发生什么事？
sense_groups.english: Is everything okay? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他看到我们了 别动 不要看他
sense_groups.english: He sees us. Don't move. And don't look at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的 只是车子逆火
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's okay. It was just a car backfire.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看 你想用身体掩护朋友
sense_groups.english: Hey, look at that. You tried to save your buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到了吗？
sense_groups.english: You see that?

sense_groups.chinese: 看到他冒命拯救朋友没？
sense_groups.english: You see what he did?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: You okay, man?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我呢？
sense_groups.english: Uh... Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该走了
sense_groups.english: We should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等等…
sense_groups.english: No, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 摩妮卡…
sense_groups.english: No. Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我们得补救这个
sense_groups.english: Monica, we have to fix this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们无能为力啊 你已经把留言删掉了
sense_groups.english: What can we do? You erased the message.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以老实跟他说啊
sense_groups.english: Unless we tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想要这么明理的话 我也争不过你
sense_groups.english: If you want to be rational, I can't argue with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？
sense_groups.english: All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 你要说就说 我不想介入
sense_groups.english: Fine, tell him. I just don't want to be a part of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许又是艾蜜莉打来的 她想说一样的话
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's Emily leaving the exact same message.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 是你啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, it's you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要你记得这种感觉
sense_groups.english: I just want you to remember this feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 活着是一种幸运
sense_groups.english: You are lucky to be alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以每一天都要活得精彩
sense_groups.english: So live every day to the fullest.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍爱自己 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Love yourself, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 也别忘了买邮票 再见
sense_groups.english: And also get stamps. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 只要把这留言放给艾蜜莉听 所有的问题就都解决了
sense_groups.english: Play that message for Emily, and this problem goes away.

sense_groups.chinese: 可不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要来见见英雄？
sense_groups.english: Anybody want to meet a hero?

sense_groups.chinese: 约翰葛林来了？
sense_groups.english: John Glenn is here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是乔伊
sense_groups.english: No. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 今晚真是太不可思议了
sense_groups.english: We had the most incredible night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在警车里… - 慢着…
sense_groups.english: We're in the car... - Wait. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 继续说
sense_groups.english: Okay, go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 好… 我们在警车里 突然响声 有人开枪
sense_groups.english: So we're in the car, and bang. A shot was fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊完全不顾自己的安危…
sense_groups.english: And Joey, with no regard for his own safety...

sense_groups.chinese: 扑到我身上保护我
sense_groups.english: ...throws himself on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 乔伊
sense_groups.english: My God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是汽车逆火放屁的声音
sense_groups.english: It was a car backfire.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是当时他并不知道
sense_groups.english: But he didn't know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I didn't know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很有可能是子弹
sense_groups.english: It could just as easily have been a bullet.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 有没有想过要当警察？警界很需要你这种人
sense_groups.english: Ever think about joining the force? We could use a guy like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 听到巨响就吓得跳起来
sense_groups.english: Who jumps at loud noises.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚有可能丧命的
sense_groups.english: Wow. I could have died tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 如果那部放屁的车 把你碾过去的话
sense_groups.english: If the car that backfired had run over you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先回家去了 省得罗斯大谈人生新发现
sense_groups.english: I'm going before he starts rambling about his newfound respect for life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的人生的确有了新发现
sense_groups.english: I do have a newfound respect for life.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃晚餐吗？ - 好啊 当然
sense_groups.english: You want to get some dinner? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 若现在听到枪声 我一定会扑倒你身上
sense_groups.english: You know what? If I heard a shot right now, I'd throw my body on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？那我们或许应该 去穷山恶极的社区散步
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should walk in a bad neighborhood.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你别再闹了
sense_groups.english: Cut it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想在同一天里 先是救你又痛扁你一顿
sense_groups.english: I'd hate to save your life and kick your ass on the same day.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才怎么先闪了？
sense_groups.english: Why'd you take off?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是去散步
sense_groups.english: Just going for a walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 在客厅里绕来绕去
sense_groups.english: Around the living room, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么不对吗？ - 没有 我只是累了
sense_groups.english: Is something wrong? - No. No, I'm just tired.

sense_groups.chinese: 走路走累了
sense_groups.english: You know, from the walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你扑上去救罗斯
sense_groups.english: You dove in front of Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯耶
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是这么一回事
sense_groups.english: That's what this is about.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你恨罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You hate Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有恨罗斯 你当然有
sense_groups.english: I don't hate Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我救了他 你生我的气 这样全都说得通了
sense_groups.english: Of course you do. I saved him. You're mad at me. It adds up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想铲除罗斯？
sense_groups.english: You want Ross out of the picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 铲除什么？
sense_groups.english: What picture?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 但是你说的话很吓人
sense_groups.english: I don't know. But I don't like what I'm hearing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你在汽车放屁事件中救了罗斯一命 但那若真的是子弹怎么办？
sense_groups.english: I'm glad you saved Ross. But it could've been a bullet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你竟然救他不救我
sense_groups.english: And you didn't try to save me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你是在气这个 你以为我觉得罗斯比你重要
sense_groups.english: You're upset because you think I chose Ross over you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是这样的… 我知道你能照顾自己
sense_groups.english: No, I knew you could take care of yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯需要别人帮忙 他不像你我见过大场面
sense_groups.english: You know? I mean, Ross needs help. He's not "street" like us.

sense_groups.chinese: 话说到头 你宁愿先去救罗斯 也不来救我
sense_groups.english: You'd risk your life for Ross before you would for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这才是重点
sense_groups.english: That's the bottom line.

sense_groups.chinese: 不完全是这样
sense_groups.english: No, not exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧
sense_groups.english: All right, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我那不是要救罗斯
sense_groups.english: I wasn't trying to save Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的三明治在罗斯旁边
sense_groups.english: My sandwich was next to Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吗？
sense_groups.english: All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是要救我的三明治
sense_groups.english: I was trying to save my sandwich.

sense_groups.chinese: 怕它被枪打到？
sense_groups.english: From a bullet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这说来没啥道理… - 岂止没啥道理
sense_groups.english: I know it doesn't make much sense. - "Much" sense?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 那是本能反应 当下就扑过去了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, it was instinct. I just went for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你冒命去救三明治
sense_groups.english: You risked your life for a sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这听起来很夸张
sense_groups.english: I know it sounds crazy...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 这可是世界上最棒的三明治
sense_groups.english: ...but this is the greatest sandwich in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你并不觉得罗斯比我重要
sense_groups.english: So you didn't choose Ross before me?

sense_groups.chinese: 才不 我绝对不会那样
sense_groups.english: No. I would never do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就像是我的亲兄弟
sense_groups.english: You're like my brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了证明你对我的意义…
sense_groups.english: In fact, to prove how much you mean to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 给你
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 - 轻点 这不是热狗
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - Easy, it's not a hot dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是很好吃？
sense_groups.english: How good is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 你在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是要证明我对你的意义？
sense_groups.english: You're showing me how much I mean to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 用一口来证明
sense_groups.english: With a bite.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也帮帮忙
sense_groups.english: Jeez.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你在这里干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你知道什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你动不动就往我们的公寓跑
sense_groups.english: You are in our apartment all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这只是小巫见大巫而已
sense_groups.english: This is just a drop in the bucket, mister.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系啦 重点是你来了
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter. The important thing is that you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我朋友 而你来到了这里
sense_groups.english: You're my friend and you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我有一点点害怕 罗斯 你是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Okay, just a little scared. What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚发生了最不寻常的事
sense_groups.english: The most amazing thing happened tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为自己要去见阎王了
sense_groups.english: I thought my number was up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真正面临到了濒死经验
sense_groups.english: I had an actual near-death experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是跟盖瑞坐警车兜风 有人朝着我开枪
sense_groups.english: We were on the ride-along with Gary and somebody took a shot at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是车子放屁
sense_groups.english: No. A car backfired.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 我当时以为是有人对我开枪 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: But I thought somebody was taking a shot at me. And, Rach...

sense_groups.chinese: 我劫后余生
sense_groups.english: ...I survived.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的人生拥有了全新视野
sense_groups.english: And I was filled with this great respect for life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要真切体验每一刻
sense_groups.english: I want to experience every moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把握每一个机会
sense_groups.english: I want to seize every opportunity.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在的一切都变得好清晰
sense_groups.english: I am seeing everything so clearly now.

sense_groups.chinese: 全都是因为汽车放屁？
sense_groups.english: Because a car backfired?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你来这里干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Why are you here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这件事符不符合 你所谓的"把握每一个机会"
sense_groups.english: I don't know how this fits into your whole seizing thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过艾蜜莉今天打电话给你
sense_groups.english: ...but Emily called you today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她说了话？ - 她在你电话里留言
sense_groups.english: You talked to her? - She left a message.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过留言被删掉了
sense_groups.english: But it kind of got erased.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的答录机有问题
sense_groups.english: I mean, there's something wrong with your machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那她说了什么？
sense_groups.english: What did she say?

sense_groups.chinese: 说什么对结婚的事有点反悔
sense_groups.english: Something about having second thoughts about the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 说你们分手是个错误
sense_groups.english: And did you guys make a mistake breaking up?

sense_groups.chinese: 她要你回电
sense_groups.english: And she wants you to call her.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说这件事很对吧？
sense_groups.english: That was a good thing that I told you, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 当然是这样
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yes. Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 谢谢你…
sense_groups.english: Okay, thank you. Thank you. Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去跟摩妮卡说我这样做是对的
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna tell Monica I was right.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你知道吗？她不希望…
sense_groups.english: Because she didn't want...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不重要 重点是我是对的 你自己决定
sense_groups.english: Not important. Point is, I was right. Your decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是对的
sense_groups.english: I was right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己决定要不要回电
sense_groups.english: Your decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我应该回电给艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: I guess I should call Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 你的决定不对…
sense_groups.english: No, that's not the right decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对的
sense_groups.english: That's not right.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你清醒一点
sense_groups.english: Ross, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为…
sense_groups.english: I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个女人把你给整惨了
sense_groups.english: ...that woman made you miserable.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的想要再来一次？
sense_groups.english: Do you really want to get back into that?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她是在昨天打来的…
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. Yesterday...

sense_groups.chinese: 我压根不会想回电
sense_groups.english: ...I wouldn't have even considered calling her back.

sense_groups.chinese: 但在我面对濒死经验的同一天…
sense_groups.english: But my ex-wife calls on the same day...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的前妻正好打电话来？
sense_groups.english: ...I have a near-death experience?

sense_groups.chinese: 这一定有所含意
sense_groups.english: That's gotta mean something.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 那不是濒死经验 就连经验都谈不上
sense_groups.english: That was not a near-death experience. That was barely an experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 当时你并不在场
sense_groups.english: You weren't there.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这就是我应该把握的事
sense_groups.english: Maybe this is something that I'm supposed to seize, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这无关把握或是不把握
sense_groups.english: Maybe this is not about seizing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这是关于逃避
sense_groups.english: Maybe this is about escaping stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 就拿今天来说
sense_groups.english: Okay? Look at today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为 你逃过了…
sense_groups.english: I mean, you escaped...

sense_groups.chinese: 死亡
sense_groups.english: ...death.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你这是你逃避的机会…
sense_groups.english: And maybe this is a chance for you to escape...

sense_groups.chinese: 不去和艾蜜莉复合
sense_groups.english: ...getting back together with Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 这还蛮有道理的
sense_groups.english: That does make sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我要把握住这个机会
sense_groups.english: Because I do want to seize some opportunity...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我真的不想她见面或联络
sense_groups.english: ...but I really don't want to see or talk to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不就结了
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许今天只是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, maybe today's just...

sense_groups.chinese: "千钧一发"日
sense_groups.english: ...close-call day.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 谢了
sense_groups.english: Hey, thanks, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 甭客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey. No problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等… 留官灯号在闪
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait. The message is blinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许留言没被删掉
sense_groups.english: Maybe you didn't erase it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 是你啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, it's you...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是旧的留言 没什么好听的 没错
sense_groups.english: That's an old message. Nobody needs to hear that.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡有来过吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, um, was Monica here?

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 要她把我的钱还来
sense_groups.english: I want my money back.

sense_groups.chinese: 是要用来买邮票的吧？
sense_groups.english: You probably need that for stamps, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞有真的中枪过吗？
sense_groups.english: Has Gary ever been shot at for real?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 一次
sense_groups.english: Yes, once.

sense_groups.chinese: 小小的一次
sense_groups.english: A little.

sense_groups.chinese: 算是他自己打的
sense_groups.english: He kind of did it to himself.

sense_groups.chinese: 这故事没什么好讲的
sense_groups.english: It's not really a good story.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道我置身战火会怎样 不是汽车放屁…
sense_groups.english: I wonder how I'd react under fire. And not backfire...

sense_groups.chinese: 是枪林弹雨
sense_groups.english: ...but heavy fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 好比我在战场上之类的
sense_groups.english: Like if I was in a war.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去打仗一定很厉害
sense_groups.english: Man, I would be great in a war.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会是很棒的军事领袖
sense_groups.english: I think I'd make a fantastic military leader.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你们这些人比起来 我一定会最先当上将军
sense_groups.english: I mean, I know I'd make general before any of you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 在你被自己的部下枪杀前 还是之后？
sense_groups.english: Before or after you were shot by your own troops?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道乔伊会在哪里
sense_groups.english: I know Joey would be in the foxhole protecting all of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 如果那个散兵坑 是用三明治围起来的话
sense_groups.english: If the foxhole was lined with sandwiches.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 英雄三明治
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hero sandwiches.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道我主张和平 我对什么战争都没兴趣
sense_groups.english: You all know I'm a pacifist, so I'm not interested in war in any way.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过等到革命的那一天来临 我一定要把你们消灭光光
sense_groups.english: But when the revolution comes, I'll have to destroy you all.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你例外
sense_groups.english: Not you, Joey.

questions.name: S05E21
questions.en:
I'm gonna get more coffee, do you want anything, baby doll?
I'm fine. Thanks.
See, I can't pull off "baby doll," can I?
No, I think we learned that from the "sugar lips" incident.
I'm gonna get some tea. - Okay.
How you doing, pumpkin?
Nope.
So it looks like it's going well for you two. - I know. Really well.
In fact, I'm gonna ask Phoebe to move in with me.
Oh, my God. - What do you think?
I think that it's great. When are you gonna ask her?
Tonight. But don't say anything, okay? - I swear. I promise. I promise.
My God, I'm so excited.
But listen, do not get her flowers, okay?
Because she cries when they die, then there's the whole funeral.
I'll see you after work, sweetie. - Okay. Bye.
So, what movie should we see?
Gary's gonna ask you to move in with him.
What? Really?
He told me at the counter. He made me promise not to tell...
...but I couldn't hold it in any longer.
I can't believe this.
Right? Because it's fast. Because it's so fast. It's fast.
Relax. It's Phoebe, not you. - Oh.
Good for you, Pheebs. Way to go.
No, but it is fast, isn't it? - No.
I like him a lot but I don't think I'm ready. - So, what are you gonna do?
I don't know. I'll just handle it. I'll ask you to talk to him.
Me? Why me?
Because you are so afraid of commitment.
You talk to him. Make him scared like you, make him a man.
I'll try, but I'm not sure what good it would do...
...because I'm less afraid of commitment than I used to be.
That is so sweet.
Still terrified. I'll take care of it no problem.
Hey, Ross, is, uh, Staten Island really an island?
Uh-huh. That's why they call it Staten "Island."
Oh, I thought it was like Long Island.
Also an island.
Hey, what time is it? - Two seventeen.
Wow, you realize we've been throwing this ball without dropping it for an hour?
Are you serious?
Yeah, I realized it a half-hour ago, but I didn't wanna say anything...
...because I didn't wanna jinx it.
Wow, we are pretty good at this.
Hey, we totally forgot about lunch.
I think that's the first time I've ever missed a meal.
I think my pants are a little loose.
Hey, you guys. Uh, is Monica here?
No. - No.
Listen, um, I bought something. I'm not sure she's gonna like it.
And it's gonna seem crazy...
...but this is something I've wanted since I was a little girl.
You bought Shaun Cassidy.
No. I wish.
Okay, you ready?
Yeah.
Check it out.
Oh, my God. What is it? - What the hell is that?
It's a cat. - That is not a cat.
Yes, it is.
Why is it inside out?
Excuse me, but this is a purebred, show-quality sphinx cat.
How much did you pay for that?
Well, it was a little extravagant, but I got a good deal.
Yeah, how much? - Thousand bucks.
On a cat?
It's not a cat.
All right. Listen, ball boys.
My grandmother had one of these when I was little...
...and it was the sweetest thing.
I mean, it was so cute, it would sit in my lap and just purr all day long...
...and I would drag a shoe string on the ground and it would chase it.
Free cats do that too, you know.
It's not a cat.
Look, guys, I'm really excited about this, okay?
I don't care what you think.
I'm gonna go set up a little litter box for Mrs. Whiskerson.
Well, what am I gonna call her? Fluffy?
Hey, do you wanna get something to eat or, uh...
...see how long we can throw this ball back and forth?
Uh, the ball thing. - Yeah?
Hey, Ross, wouldn't it be great if we could go for like two straight hours...
...without dropping it?
Uh, yeah, it would.
Let's do it. - Okay.
Uh-oh. - What?
I have to pee.
And Rachel's in the bathroom.
Man, I didn't think we were gonna make it.
I know.
Don't switch hands, okay?
Hey, ladies. What are you in here for?
Hey, Chandler, what are you doing here?
Gary, I am here to report a crime. - Yeah?
It is a crime that you and I don't spend time together.
Ha, ha. What's up?
Uh, well, I heard that you were thinking about asking Phoebe to move in with you...
...and I thought maybe we should have a talk, you know, man to... well, me.
Sure, okay.
Um, are you crazy?
Are you insane?
If you live with Phoebe, you two are gonna be, you know, living together.
Yeah, I considered that. I just know it'd make me happy.
Heh. You mean scared. - No, I mean happy.
Scared happy.
Chandler, what are you doing? - I'm trying to open your eyes, my man.
Don't you see? If you live with Phoebe, she is always gonna be there.
You're gonna get home, she's there. You go to bed, she's there.
You wake up and oh, yes, she's there.
I know. I can't wait.
Were your parents happy or something?
Listen, Chandler, the way I see it...
...I was lucky enough to find someone that I really love.
I just wanna be around her as much as I can.
Wow, you know, when you say it, it doesn't sound so scary.
So you know what I'm talking about? - Yeah, I think I do.
You know what?
You move in with her. You move in right with her right now.
Maybe I should move in with Monica. - No, it's too soon for you guys.
You're right about that.
When they found the remains of the Mesozoic mastodon...
...they discovered what appeared to be the remains...
...of a Paleozoic amphibian in its jaws.
How did it get there?
Maybe this should be more of a quiet game.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Joey, I left my watch on the counter last night.
It was here. Where is it? - I don't know.
Well, come on, I'm late for work.
How do you know? You don't have a watch.
Guys, could you stop throwing the ball for one minute and just help me find it?
Oh, I don't know. Yeah, can't do it.
What? - Whatever you do, do not drop that ball.
Yeah, we haven't dropped it in... - Two hours, 27 minutes.
Really?
I'm not gonna be able to make it in to work today.
Um, I don't feel very good.
Yes!
Wow, uh, for a second there, I thought I was feeling better, but I'm not.
Hey, Rach. - Hey.
Check it out. Almost three hours without dropping it.
Wow, congratulations. That's quite a waste of time.
Rach. - Yeah.
You have scratches all over you. What happened?
Well, it's my cat. - What?
Oh, yeah, I got a cat. - I don't want a cat.
Oh, don't worry, it's not a cat. - Yeah.
You guys, this cat is nothing like my grandmother's cat.
It's not sweet. It's not cute.
I even dragged a string on the ground...
...and it just flipped out and scratched the hell out of me.
And I swear... I know this sounds crazy, but every time this cat hisses at me...
...I know it's saying, "Rachel."
Doesn't sound as crazy as paying $1000 for a cat.
You paid $1000 for a cat when you owe me 300?
Well, I was gonna let you play with it.
Hey.
Did you talk to Gary about the moving in thing?
Yes, I did, and I think you should do it. - What?
He's a great guy and he loves you a lot. You are a very lucky lady.
You are useless.
Freaking out about commitment is the one thing you can do...
...and you can't even do that right. God.
Sorry. If he asked me, I'd move in with him.
Oh!
Ooh, ooh, get out of here, good-for-nothing.
Hey, Chandler. - Hey, Gar.
Hey, sweetie.
Can I talk to you for a second? - Yeah. Okay.
You look very pretty today. - Thanks. Okay.
Here's the thing. - Yeah.
You know, I really want this relationship to move forward.
Because if you're not moving forward, you know, you're just moving backwards.
Now, that's not true. If you're not moving forward, you're staying still.
And staying still is good. Watch this.
Phoebe? - Yeah?
I want you to move in with me.
That is so sweet.
But don't you think that it's a little it's too soon?
I mean, there's so much we don't know about each other.
Oh.
Oh, okay. I get it.
I don't want us to jump into something that we're not ready for, you know.
Uh-huh.
I really don't want to mess up what we have.
I'm just worried it's gonna be a big mistake.
Yeah.

sense_groups.english: Listen, um, I bought something. I'm not sure she's gonna like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起有点奇怪
sense_groups.english: And it's gonna seem crazy...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个东西我从小就想要了
sense_groups.english: ...but this is something I've wanted since I was a little girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 你带史恩卡希迪来？
sense_groups.english: You bought Shaun Cassidy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我也希望是
sense_groups.english: No. I wish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们准备好了没？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 请看
sense_groups.english: Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是啥啊？ - 什么鬼东西？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What is it? - What the hell is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是猫啊 - 这才不是猫
sense_groups.english: It's a cat. - That is not a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是猫啊
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的皮怎么翻出来了？
sense_groups.english: Why is it inside out?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮帮忙 这可是展示级的 纯种狮身人面猫
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, but this is a purebred, show-quality sphinx cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你花了多少钱买的？
sense_groups.english: How much did you pay for that?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点奢侈 但我谈到了很好的价钱
sense_groups.english: Well, it was a little extravagant, but I got a good deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？多少钱？ - 一千美元
sense_groups.english: Yeah, how much? - Thousand bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 买一只猫？
sense_groups.english: On a cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 那才不是猫
sense_groups.english: It's not a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这两个玩球的给我听好
sense_groups.english: All right. Listen, ball boys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我小时候祖母就养了这种猫…
sense_groups.english: My grandmother had one of these when I was little...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们最讨人喜欢了
sense_groups.english: ...and it was the sweetest thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 超可爱的 躺在我的膝盖上 整天满足地猫叫
sense_groups.english: I mean, it was so cute, it would sit in my lap and just purr all day long...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还会拿鞋带在地上拖 让他追着跑
sense_groups.english: ...and I would drag a shoe string on the ground and it would chase it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要钱的猫也会那样
sense_groups.english: Free cats do that too, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那才不是猫
sense_groups.english: It's not a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我买得很兴奋
sense_groups.english: Look, guys, I'm really excited about this, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不管你们怎么想
sense_groups.english: I don't care what you think.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去帮威丝克森太太 张罗出一个小猫饭盒
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go set up a little litter box for Mrs. Whiskerson.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我要叫他"毛毛"吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, what am I gonna call her? Fluffy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去吃点东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, do you wanna get something to eat or, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是要看我们能来回丢多久？
sense_groups.english: ...see how long we can throw this ball back and forth?

sense_groups.chinese: 继续丢球 - 是喔
sense_groups.english: Uh, the ball thing. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 若我们连丢两小时不落地…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, wouldn't it be great if we could go for like two straight hours...

sense_groups.chinese: 那样是不是棒？
sense_groups.english: ...without dropping it?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然啦
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, it would.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Let's do it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要尿尿
sense_groups.english: I have to pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋却在厕所里
sense_groups.english: And Rachel's in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 没想到这样也行
sense_groups.english: Man, I didn't think we were gonna make it.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别换手喔
sense_groups.english: Don't switch hands, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐们 你们在这里干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Hey, ladies. What are you in here for?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你来这里干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 盖瑞 我是来报案的 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Gary, I am here to report a crime. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们俩不常聚在一起 是一种罪
sense_groups.english: It is a crime that you and I don't spend time together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么事？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 听说你在考虑要菲比跟你同居
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, I heard that you were thinking about asking Phoebe to move in with you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我心想我们或许应该聊聊 男人… 跟我的对话
sense_groups.english: ...and I thought maybe we should have a talk, you know, man to... well, me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sure, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在发什么神经？
sense_groups.english: Um, are you crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了？
sense_groups.english: Are you insane?

sense_groups.chinese: 若你和菲比同居 你们两个就会住在一起了
sense_groups.english: If you live with Phoebe, you two are gonna be, you know, living together.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我考虑过了 我知道这会让我快乐
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I considered that. I just know it'd make me happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说害怕吧 - 不 我是说快乐
sense_groups.english: Heh. You mean scared. - No, I mean happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 害怕快乐
sense_groups.english: Scared happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你在干嘛？ - 我在让你张开眼睛啊 你看不出来吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, what are you doing? - I'm trying to open your eyes, my man.

sense_groups.chinese: 若你和菲比同居 她就永远都会在
sense_groups.english: Don't you see? If you live with Phoebe, she is always gonna be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你回家会看到她 你上床也会看到她
sense_groups.english: You're gonna get home, she's there. You go to bed, she's there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你起床呢？对 她还是在
sense_groups.english: You wake up and oh, yes, she's there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我都等不及了
sense_groups.english: I know. I can't wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你父母的婚姻很幸福 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Were your parents happy or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我看这件事的角度是…
sense_groups.english: Listen, Chandler, the way I see it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很幸运能找到我的真爱
sense_groups.english: ...I was lucky enough to find someone that I really love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要尽量多跟她在一起
sense_groups.english: I just wanna be around her as much as I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪了 这件事从你嘴里说出来 感觉就没那么恐怖了
sense_groups.english: Wow, you know, when you say it, it doesn't sound so scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你懂我的意思吧？ - 对 我想我懂
sense_groups.english: So you know what I'm talking about? - Yeah, I think I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她同居 马上就去跟她同居
sense_groups.english: You move in with her. You move in right with her right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我也应该和摩妮卡同居 - 不成 你们不能操之过急
sense_groups.english: Maybe I should move in with Monica. - No, it's too soon for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你说的对
sense_groups.english: You're right about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们找到中生代乳齿象化石
sense_groups.english: When they found the remains of the Mesozoic mastodon...

sense_groups.chinese: 却在嘴部发现到…
sense_groups.english: ...they discovered what appeared to be the remains...

sense_groups.chinese: 类似古生代两栖类的构造
sense_groups.english: ...of a Paleozoic amphibian in its jaws.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会牛头不对马嘴？
sense_groups.english: How did it get there?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这个游戏应该安静一点
sense_groups.english: Maybe this should be more of a quiet game.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 大家 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我昨晚把手表放在柜子上
sense_groups.english: Joey, I left my watch on the counter last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 本来还在这里 到哪儿去了？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: It was here. Where is it? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 别闹了 我上班快迟到了
sense_groups.english: Well, come on, I'm late for work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？你又没戴表
sense_groups.english: How do you know? You don't have a watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能不能停一下再丢球 先帮我找表？
sense_groups.english: Guys, could you stop throwing the ball for one minute and just help me find it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 没办法喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know. Yeah, can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样啦？ - 怎样都好 千万别把球掉地上
sense_groups.english: What? - Whatever you do, do not drop that ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们保持球不落地已经… - 2小时27分钟
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we haven't dropped it in... - Two hours, 27 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啊？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天没办法去上班
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna be able to make it in to work today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不太舒服
sense_groups.english: Um, I don't feel very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才突然觉得自己好多了 但其实没有
sense_groups.english: Wow, uh, for a second there, I thought I was feeling better, but I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 快来看 球不落地接近三小时
sense_groups.english: Check it out. Almost three hours without dropping it.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜了 真是浪费时问
sense_groups.english: Wow, congratulations. That's quite a waste of time.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Rach. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你身上都是抓痕 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: You have scratches all over you. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的猫 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, it's my cat. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我养了只猫 - 我不想养猫
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I got a cat. - I don't want a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 那不是猫 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't worry, it's not a cat. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只猫跟我祖母养过的猫 完全不一样
sense_groups.english: You guys, this cat is nothing like my grandmother's cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 既不讨人喜欢 也不可爱
sense_groups.english: It's not sweet. It's not cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在地上拉着线逗他玩
sense_groups.english: I even dragged a string on the ground...

sense_groups.chinese: 他竟然发疯 把我抓得乱七八糟
sense_groups.english: ...and it just flipped out and scratched the hell out of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这听来很疯狂 但我发誓 这只猫每次嘘我的时候 …
sense_groups.english: And I swear... I know this sounds crazy, but every time this cat hisses at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道他都在说"瑞秋"
sense_groups.english: ...I know it's saying, "Rachel."

sense_groups.chinese: 花一千买美元买一只猫 比刚才那些话更疯狂
sense_groups.english: Doesn't sound as crazy as paying $1000 for a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你欠我三百美元不还 还拿一千美元去买猫？
sense_groups.english: You paid $1000 for a cat when you owe me 300?

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来打算让你跟它玩的
sense_groups.english: Well, I was gonna let you play with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟盖瑞聊过同居的事没？
sense_groups.english: Did you talk to Gary about the moving in thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 聊过了 我觉得你应该答应 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did, and I think you should do it. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很棒 他也很爱你 你非常幸运
sense_groups.english: He's a great guy and he loves you a lot. You are a very lucky lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真没用
sense_groups.english: You are useless.

sense_groups.chinese: 害怕承诺是你唯一会做的事
sense_groups.english: Freaking out about commitment is the one thing you can do...

sense_groups.chinese: 你竟然连那件事都做不好 天啊
sense_groups.english: ...and you can't even do that right. God.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 换做我都愿意和他同居
sense_groups.english: Sorry. If he asked me, I'd move in with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 窝囊废 你滚吧
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh, get out of here, good-for-nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 - 嘿 盖瑞
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. - Hey, Gar.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hey, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能先聊下？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Can I talk to you for a second? - Yeah. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天很美 - 谢谢 好吧
sense_groups.english: You look very pretty today. - Thanks. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是这样的 - 好
sense_groups.english: Here's the thing. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想让这段关系更进一步
sense_groups.english: You know, I really want this relationship to move forward.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为不进则退
sense_groups.english: Because if you're not moving forward, you know, you're just moving backwards.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 那不是真的 如果不进 就是静止不动
sense_groups.english: Now, that's not true. If you're not moving forward, you're staying still.

sense_groups.chinese: 静止不动是很好的 你看
sense_groups.english: And staying still is good. Watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 是
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你搬来一起住
sense_groups.english: I want you to move in with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真是太甜蜜了
sense_groups.english: That is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不觉得太快了些吗？
sense_groups.english: But don't you think that it's a little it's too soon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们彼此还有太多地方不了解
sense_groups.english: I mean, there's so much we don't know about each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我懂了
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. I get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不希望我们操之过急 你懂吧？
sense_groups.english: I don't want us to jump into something that we're not ready for, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想搞砸我们现在的一切
sense_groups.english: I really don't want to mess up what we have.

sense_groups.chinese: 我担心同居会铸成大错
sense_groups.english: I'm just worried it's gonna be a big mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我的答案是我答应
sense_groups.english: Which is why my answer is yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Really? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好高兴
sense_groups.english: You're so happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 别丢那么大力
sense_groups.english: Monica, stop throwing it so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是同一队
sense_groups.english: We're on the same team.

sense_groups.chinese: 四个小时？你们就这样丢了四小时？
sense_groups.english: Four hours? You guys have been doing this for four hours?

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 不行 让我加入 - 不 不行
sense_groups.english: All right. Let me in. - No, no. Don't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是漏球大王
sense_groups.english: He's a dropper.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不是漏球大王
sense_groups.english: I'm not a dropper.

sense_groups.chinese: 这其实是三个人的游戏
sense_groups.english: It's really a three-person game, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 还不就是你丢我接
sense_groups.english: It's throwing and catching.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好难喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, it's so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 别紧张 那不是猫喔
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, guys. It's not a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的… 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my... Oh, good God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃了 我不知道要怎么处理这玩意儿
sense_groups.english: I give up, you guys. I don't know what I'm gonna do with this thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 送他进烤箱也没用？
sense_groups.english: Baking it didn't help, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 把他送回你买的地方呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just take it back to where you got it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我试过了 他们不收
sense_groups.english: I tried. They won't take her back.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为他是反基督的爪牙
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's because she's a minion of the Antichrist.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 店家为什么不收？
sense_groups.english: Rach, why won't they take it back?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说要收回可以 但只退我店里的购物券
sense_groups.english: Well, they said they would, but would only give me store credit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要拿来买什么？一千只普通的猫不成？
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do, get a thousand regular cats?

sense_groups.chinese: 不然你先留着罗 等到你找到处理的方法
sense_groups.english: If you want, you can keep it until you find out what to do with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 那不是重点 我破费一千美元…
sense_groups.english: No, Mon, that's not the point. I'm out a thousand dollars...

sense_groups.chinese: 搞得全身都是抓痕…
sense_groups.english: ...I'm all scratched up...

sense_groups.chinese: 还跟长得像手的蠢猫困在一起
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm stuck with this stupid cat that looks like a hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只猫害我流眼泪了 别丢球给我
sense_groups.english: The cat's made my eyes water. Don't throw it to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的视力受损了
sense_groups.english: My vision's been compromised.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 好了…
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在好了 真是惊险
sense_groups.english: It's okay. Man, that was close.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你的反应也太大了点
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you almost overreacted to something.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有个好消息 我们要同居了 - 是不是很棒？
sense_groups.english: We have great news. - We're moving in together. Isn't it great?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 是啊 - 我好兴奋
sense_groups.english: Congratulations. - That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我太激动了 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I know, I'm so excited. - So am I.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 你不是比我更激动 没办法 我最激动了
sense_groups.english: Well, you're not more excited than I am. No way. I'm the most excited. Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 晚点在局里见
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll see you at the station later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 晚点见 别忘了同居的事喔
sense_groups.english: Okay, yeah, I'll see you later. Don't forget about the moving-in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要搬去跟他住 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: So you're moving in with him? What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不忍心拒绝他 看他伤心成那样 或许不会有事的
sense_groups.english: I couldn't tell him no. He got so sad. But maybe it'll be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢他…
sense_groups.english: I do really like him a lot...

sense_groups.chinese: 同居八成也是迟早的事
sense_groups.english: ...and probably do it eventually anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 想想也可以省下不少邮票钱
sense_groups.english: And plus, think of all the money I'll save on stamps.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么着？你常写信给他？
sense_groups.english: Why, do you write him a lot?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 只是我听说同居的人…
sense_groups.english: No, I just heard when people live together...

sense_groups.chinese: 会分担邮票的费用 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: ...they split the cost of stamps, don't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 没错…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 耐热手套吓了我一跳
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, the oven mitts really freaked me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Hey, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找到公寓没？布鲁克林高地有吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you find any apartments in Brooklyn Heights?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 没找到
sense_groups.english: No, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 问都没有？ - 不
sense_groups.english: Nothing at all? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 只要有公寓招租 我们马上搬进去
sense_groups.english: As soon as something opens up, we'll move in.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过要有附泳池的 我需要泳池
sense_groups.english: Unless it doesn't have a pool. I need a pool.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 可以跟你聊一下吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, can I talk to you for a second? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 好
sense_groups.english: Take a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？还好吧？
sense_groups.english: You okay? You feel all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好啊 因为我们要同居了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I feel great because we're moving in together.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So you, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 报上布鲁克林高地的租屋广告 你都看过了？
sense_groups.english: You checked the paper for listings in Brooklyn Heights, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 《邮报》你有查过吗？
sense_groups.english: You checked the Post?

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 啥都没有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, uh-huh, there was nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能喝点水吗？ - 等下
sense_groups.english: Can I get some water? - In a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你查过今天的《邮报》吗？ - 对 我是看今天的
sense_groups.english: You checked today's Post? - Um, yeah, today's.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是今天的《邮报》
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Because, uh, this is today's Post.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到了这些租屋广告
sense_groups.english: And, uh, these are the listings I found.

sense_groups.chinese: 布鲁克林高地 两房 布鲁克林高地 一房
sense_groups.english: Brooklyn Heights, two bedrooms. Brooklyn Heights, one bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 布鲁克林高地区…
sense_groups.english: Brooklyn Heights, Brooklyn Heights, Brooklyn Heights.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是要租的吗？我以为他们是在炫耀自己的房子有多棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, are these for rent? I thought people were just bragging.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来告诉你我的想法
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you what I think might be going on here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要看桌子 看着我
sense_groups.english: No, no, don't look at the table. Look at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 一个男生要求一个女生同居
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think somebody asked someone to move in with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 女生本来说好 现在反悔了
sense_groups.english: And I think someone said yes, but now she's having doubts...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为女生觉得这样太快了
sense_groups.english: ...because things are moving too fast for someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得是不是这样？
sense_groups.english: Does that sound at all possible to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对… 好 我就是那个女生
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes. Yes, fine, I am someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我说老实话？对 我是不确定
sense_groups.english: You want me to say it? I have doubts.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有这种感觉也没关系
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's okay that you feel this way.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是很快 我们对彼此有许多地方不了解
sense_groups.english: I mean, it is soon, and there's a lot of things we don't know about each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得我知道的你 我都很喜欢
sense_groups.english: I just figured everything I know about you, I really like.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还不知道的你 就等同居后再慢慢了解
sense_groups.english: The things I don't know, I get to learn in a place with both our names on the mailbox.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样好甜蜜喔
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 如果你觉得这样太快就行不通
sense_groups.english: Sweetheart, but none of that matters if it's too soon for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不用赶着现在就同居 我只要你快乐
sense_groups.english: It's fine. We don't have to move in together. I just want you to be happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你同居会让我快乐的 - 菲比 你不用那样说
sense_groups.english: Living with you would make me happy. - Phoebe, you don't have to say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我很想跟你住在一起 我要跟你同居
sense_groups.english: No, I really wanna live with you. I wanna move in with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 百分之百确定 我们一起住在公寓同居吧
sense_groups.english: Definitely, yes. Let's live in an apartment that we both live in.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 等等…
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. - Oh, wait, one sec. One sec.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 镜子后面的人 你看个什么劲啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you. Behind the glass. Who are you looking at?

sense_groups.chinese: 我每次进来这种房间 都想说这句话
sense_groups.english: I've always wanted to say that every time I was in one of these rooms...

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我从没进来过
sense_groups.english: ...which was never.

sense_groups.chinese: 展示猫 高级的展示猫
sense_groups.english: Show cat. Quality show cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 展示猫 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Show cat. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的宝宝怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with your baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是宝宝 这是猫
sense_groups.english: That's not a baby. That's a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 长得还真吓人 - 噢 不
sense_groups.english: Ew, it's creepy looking. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他其实很讨人喜欢的… 不信你看
sense_groups.english: No, it's actually very sweet. It's very sweet. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要？ - 不了 我讨厌猫
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Do you want it? - Ha, ha. No, I hate cats.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你干嘛跟我扯半天？
sense_groups.english: Well, so then what are you doing to me? Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 滚吧 继续走你的路
sense_groups.english: Just get out of here, all right? Move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮帮忙 - 这只猫真不寻常
sense_groups.english: Jeez. - Wow, what an unusual cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 谢谢你 真的是这样 你要吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes, thank you. Exactly. You want it?

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我考虑要养猫 我正好要去流浪动物之家…
sense_groups.english: I was thinking about getting a cat. I was just gonna go to the shelter, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 就他了 - 太好了 总共是两千美元
sense_groups.english: Okay. Why not? - Oh, terrific. That'll be $2,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 好吧 一千
sense_groups.english: Ha. What? - Okay, a thousand.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你是要我认养你的猫
sense_groups.english: I thought you wanted me to adopt your cat?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 不过这不只是猫 更是一项投资
sense_groups.english: Well, I do, but you're gonna have to look at this as more of an investment than a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要的只是猫
sense_groups.english: Okay, yeah. I just wanted a cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你显然是杀价高手
sense_groups.english: Obviously, you know how to haggle...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我就不唬弄你了
sense_groups.english: ...so I'm not gonna try and take you on, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 算你八百 我也不报警了…
sense_groups.english: So $800, and I don't call the cops...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你这根本是抢劫
sense_groups.english: ...which I should because you are robbing me blind.

sense_groups.chinese: 把钱留下 猫带走
sense_groups.english: Blind. Just take the cat, leave the money and run away.

sense_groups.chinese: 溜之大吉吧 可恶
sense_groups.english: Just run away. Damn it. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 死猫 你起码也笑一下嘛
sense_groups.english: Can't you at least smile or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有人听到？谁听到了？
sense_groups.english: Okay, did anybody just hear that? Anybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 我饿死了 - 你们振作一点
sense_groups.english: I'm starving. - Come on, guys. Suck it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 就快达成连续十小时了
sense_groups.english: We're closing in on 10 hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是比毅力的时刻
sense_groups.english: It's gut-check time.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么变成是你当老大？这游戏是我们发明的
sense_groups.english: I don't know who made you the boss. We invented this game.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮帮忙 这游戏是因为我 才有现在的局面
sense_groups.english: Please. I made this game what it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 不再好玩的局面？
sense_groups.english: Not fun anymore?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是很饿
sense_groups.english: I'm still hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我家还有一点披萨
sense_groups.english: All right, there's some pizza at my place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以用一手吃吧？要不要？
sense_groups.english: We can eat with one hand, right? Are you with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要 - 好 我们走…
sense_groups.english: I am. - All right, let's go. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡大队 走罗
sense_groups.english: Let's go, Team Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 队名等一下再讨论
sense_groups.english: All right, we can work out the name later.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你的猫在我碗里干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, what is your cat doing in one of my bowls?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 我在解冻鸡肉
sense_groups.english: It's not. I'm defrosting a chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把威丝克森太太卖掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I sold, uh, Mrs. Whiskerson.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的钱拿回来没？ - 有 一千五百美元
sense_groups.english: Did you get your money back? - Yeah, $1500.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你还有赚耶
sense_groups.english: Wow, you made a profit?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来拿红丝绒枕头的 - 哦 是
sense_groups.english: I just came for the red velvet pillow. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里 - 瑞秋 谢了
sense_groups.english: There you go. - Thanks, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 别忘了 你随时可以来看它
sense_groups.english: And, uh, don't forget, you can come visit her any time you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 好… 我会记得的
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Great. I'll keep that in mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 嘿 这是啥？某种蛇吗？
sense_groups.english: Ahem, hey. So, what is this, some kind of snake or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真喜欢和你一起醒来
sense_groups.english: I really like waking up with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: I like waking up with you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上真美
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's such a beautiful morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在床上待一整天
sense_groups.english: I could stay here all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样不错
sense_groups.english: That would be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以在床上吃早餐 - 等等 好
sense_groups.english: We could have breakfast in bed. - Wait, just a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 摩妮卡 有活力点…
sense_groups.english: All right. Come on, Monica. Look alive. Come on, look alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 你们都起床了
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. You're all up.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 现在才早上六点 你怎么没在盖瑞那里？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's six o'clock in the morning. Why aren't you at Gary's?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 结束了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. That's over. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 盖瑞这么好 有什么问题都能解决的
sense_groups.english: Come on, Gary's such a great guy. Whatever the problem, you can work it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 他开枪杀了只鸟 - 喔 结束了
sense_groups.english: He shot a bird. - Oh, that is over.

sense_groups.chinese: 太糟糕了 - 我很遗憾…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - That's terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你还好吧？ - 对… 我不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - Yeah, yeah, I'll be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 接住 - 我不太想玩球
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, here, Pheebs. - Oh. Nah, I don't feel like playing.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事…
sense_groups.english: It's okay. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 就当没发生这件事 没必要让别人知道
sense_groups.english: Just pretend that it didn't happen, okay? No one needs to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比又不是正式的队员
sense_groups.english: Phoebe's not an official ball player.

sense_groups.chinese: 正式队员漏球才算数
sense_groups.english: I mean, only official ball players can drop the ball.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我好饿… - 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on. - Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 要吃早餐吗？好啊
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, honey, you wanna get breakfast?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好 我们来赛跑
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay. Okay, let's race.

sense_groups.chinese: 最先到的赢
sense_groups.english: First one there wins. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要在这里吃吗？ - 好啊 在这里就好
sense_groups.english: You guys wanna eat here? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 想起来真的很棒吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, that was great, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信我们丢了那么久
sense_groups.english: Can you believe how long we threw that ball around?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 撑了那么久 真的很不可思议
sense_groups.english: It is amazing it lasted that long.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我的手臂酸死了
sense_groups.english: I know. My arm is killing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我是说有漏球高手在 还能撑那么久
sense_groups.english: No, I meant with the dropper over here.

sense_groups.chinese: "漏球高手"这称号 怎么会落到我头上？
sense_groups.english: You know, how did I get this reputation as a dropper?

sense_groups.chinese: 我再怎么说也不是漏球高手
sense_groups.english: I am anything but a dropper.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Ross.

questions.name: S05E22
questions.en:
What's going on?
Well, my eye is a little itchy.
Uh, mine too. Yeah.
Wow, it's really red. You should go see my eye doctor.
Richard? I'm not gonna go see your ex-boyfriend.
Richard, that's all I ever hear. Richard, Richard, Richard.
Since we've been going out, I think I've mentioned his name twice.
Okay. So Richard, Richard.
It's not Richard, okay? It's this new guy. He's really good.
I'm sorry. I'm not going to an eye doctor.
Oh, God. Here we go. - What?
Any time anything comes close to touching her eye or anyone else's...
...she, like, freaks out. Watch.
Ross, come on.
All right, fine. I have a weird thing with my eye. Can we not talk about it please?
All right.
Hey, Rach. You know that great song? Um, "Me, myself and eye."
Aah! Monica. Come on.
Does anyone wanna get some lunch? All those in favor, say "eye."
Ross, stop it. Come on.
How much did I love The King and "Eye."
Chandler. - Me too, me too.
Just stop it. That's enough. Come on.
You okay there, man? - Yeah. I got too excited.
All right, I gotta go. I'm taking Ben to the park.
Oh, give him a kiss for me. - All right. Bye.
Bye. - Bye.
Later.
I am so sorry you got caught in the middle of that.
I didn't mean to be so out there, but I am furious with him.
Wow, um...
Calm down?
I'm trying, but, man, that guy can push my buttons.
Why are you so mad at him?
Look, I don't wanna talk about it, okay? - Well, it seems like...
You wanna be on my list too? Keep talking.
Has anyone seen my list, by the way?
Uh, no. What's it look like?
Um, a piece of paper and it says "Ross." - I see.
Hey.
I just got off the phone with Estelle. Guess what?
I got the lead in a movie.
You got the lead in a movie? What's the movie about?
Oh, it's called Shutterspeed. It's really cool.
Yeah, um, I meet this girl in the subway and we fall in love in, like, a day, right?
And then she disappears. But I find out where she lives.
And when I get there, this old lady answers the door. I say, "Where's Betsy?"
Right? And she says, "Betsy's been dead 10 years."
Ooh. Chilling.
Oh, and the best part is we're filming in the desert outside of Vegas.
You know what that means, buddy. - Yeah, I know.
Road trip. Yeah, we can rent a car. I just have to be there by Tuesday.
Oh, wait. My grandmother's dead.
Well, uh, we can talk about that too, Pheebs.
No, no, her cab.
She probably won't be using it. You could drive it to Las Vegas.
All right. Thanks, Pheebs.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are we gonna do about my job?
Oh, uh, not go. - All right, great. Road trip, baby.
Is this okay with you?
Chandler, you don't have to ask for my permission.
You can go. - Thank you.
Hey, Rach, come on, you're gonna be late for the eye doctor.
All right. Let's get this over with. Ugh.
Oh, no.
Look what I did.
I mean, look at this mess.
I mean, we're gonna probably have to clean this up, you know?
I mean, we're gonna have to reschedule.
If you thought that this mess was gonna bother me, you are wrong.
All right, let's go, Blinky.
Chandler.
Oh, hey, Joey. What's up?
I can't decide which route to take to Vegas.
Hey, you've traveled a lot, right?
Yeah, I've been around. - Okay.
So which route should I take? The northern route or the southern route?
Ooh, if you take the north route, there's a man in Illinois with a beard of bees.
Great. Problem solved.
But on the southern route, there's a chicken that plays tic-tac-toe.
Well, back to square one.
Oh, I know a way that you can decide.
All right, I'm gonna ask you a series of questions...
...and you answer as quickly as you can.
Yes. - Good. But wait.
Here we go. I want you to relax.
Take a deep breath.
Clear your mind. Which do you like better...
...peanut butter or egg whites? - Peanut butter.
Rather be a fireman or a swimmer? - Swimmer.
Rather sleep with Monica or Rachel? - Monica. Oh.
I always thought it'd be Rachel.
No thinking, no thinking. Tie or ascot? - Ascot.
North route or south route? - North.
Bam, there you go. Huh? - Wow.
That was incredible. Beard of bees here I come.
Hey. - Oh, this guy again.
Hey, what's up?
Uh, not much. You guys wanna see a movie tonight?
Sure. What do you wanna see? - I don't know. Um...
I know how we can decide. Phoebe, show him your game.
Um, no, thank you.
What's with her?
I don't know. But I know how we can decide.
Okay, I'm gonna ask you questions and you answer real quick, okay?
What's better, action or comedy? - Action.
Who would you rather sleep with, Monica or Rachel?
Dude, you are sick.
Oh. I'm sorry. I forgot you had that whole Rachel thing.
Oh, my God. What does that thing do?
Uh, that's an eye removal machine. - All right, I'm out of here.
I'm kidding. I'm kidding.
Hi, Rachel, I'm Dr. Miller.
Monica told me you were a little nervous, but everything's gonna be just fine.
So we're done then. - Almost, but first we gotta start.
This is the glaucoma test. Sit down. - Uh-huh.
Okay. - Put your chin here.
Mm-hm.
Now, you'll feel a small puff of air in each eye.
Uh, a what?
A small puff of air. Now, come on.
Here we go. - All right.
One, two, three.
Okay.
I'm sorry. All right.
Ha, ha, I'm gonna stay in here this time. Okay.
Ready? - Uh-huh.
One, two... - I'm sorry.
