sense_groups.chinese: 你要演电影主角 太厉害了 是什么电影？
sense_groups.english: You got the lead in a movie? What's the movie about?

sense_groups.chinese: 片名是《极限速度》
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's called Shutterspeed. It's really cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 超酷的 我在地铁遇见一个女孩 一天之内坠入情网
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um, I meet this girl in the subway and we fall in love in, like, a day, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 后来她消失无踪 但我找出了她住在哪里
sense_groups.english: And then she disappears. But I find out where she lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 到那儿后一个老太太出来开门 我问她"贝丝在哪里？"
sense_groups.english: And when I get there, this old lady answers the door. I say, "Where's Betsy?"

sense_groups.chinese: 她说"贝丝已经过世十年了"
sense_groups.english: Right? And she says, "Betsy's been dead 10 years."

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 毛骨悚然
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Chilling.

sense_groups.chinese: 最棒的部分是 拍片地点在赌城外的沙漠
sense_groups.english: Oh, and the best part is we're filming in the desert outside of Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 你知道那是哈意思 - 对 我知道那是哈意思
sense_groups.english: You know what that means, buddy. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 开车杀过去 我们可以租车 我周二以前到那里就行了
sense_groups.english: Road trip. Yeah, we can rent a car. I just have to be there by Tuesday.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我祖母过世了
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. My grandmother's dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们也可以聊聊那件事
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, we can talk about that too, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 不… 我是说她的计程车
sense_groups.english: No, no, her cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 她八成用不到了 你们可以开去赌城
sense_groups.english: She probably won't be using it. You could drive it to Las Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 菲比 谢了
sense_groups.english: All right. Thanks, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等… 那我的工作怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are we gonna do about my job?

sense_groups.chinese: 别去了 - 好耶 棒 上路罗
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, not go. - All right, great. Road trip, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没意见吧？
sense_groups.english: Is this okay with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你不用征求我的允许…
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you don't have to ask for my permission.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你去 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You can go. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 快点 要去看眼科了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, come on, you're gonna be late for the eye doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 早去早解脱
sense_groups.english: All right. Let's get this over with. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是笨手笨脚的
sense_groups.english: Look what I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞得一团乱
sense_groups.english: I mean, look at this mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得先来清理一下
sense_groups.english: I mean, we're gonna probably have to clean this up, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 看诊时间得要重约了
sense_groups.english: I mean, we're gonna have to reschedule.

sense_groups.chinese: 若你认为这点脏乱会困扰我 那你就错了
sense_groups.english: If you thought that this mess was gonna bother me, you are wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧 眨眼姑娘
sense_groups.english: All right, let's go, Blinky.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Joey. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法决定走哪条路去赌城
sense_groups.english: I can't decide which route to take to Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你去过不少地方吧？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you've traveled a lot, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 见过世面 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I've been around. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我该选哪一条？北线还是南线？
sense_groups.english: So which route should I take? The northern route or the southern route?

sense_groups.chinese: 走北线途经伊利诺州 有个男人会用蜜蜂当胡子
sense_groups.english: Ooh, if you take the north route, there's a man in Illinois with a beard of bees.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 问题解决
sense_groups.english: Great. Problem solved.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是走南线的话 可以看会玩井字游戏的鸡
sense_groups.english: But on the southern route, there's a chicken that plays tic-tac-toe.

sense_groups.chinese: 又回到原点了
sense_groups.english: Well, back to square one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道有个方法能让你做决定
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know a way that you can decide.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会问你一连串的问题 你回答得…
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm gonna ask you a series of questions...

sense_groups.chinese: 越快越好
sense_groups.english: ...and you answer as quickly as you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 很好 不过先别急
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Good. But wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始罗 你先放轻松
sense_groups.english: Here we go. I want you to relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 深呼吸一口气
sense_groups.english: Take a deep breath.

sense_groups.chinese: 心里不要想事情
sense_groups.english: Clear your mind. Which do you like better...

sense_groups.chinese: 花生酱和蛋白 你喜欢哪个？ - 花生酱
sense_groups.english: ...peanut butter or egg whites? - Peanut butter.

sense_groups.chinese: 消防员和游泳选手你比较想当哪一个？ - 游泳选手
sense_groups.english: Rather be a fireman or a swimmer? - Swimmer.

sense_groups.chinese: 愿意睡莫妮卡或雷切尔？ - 摩妮卡 喔
sense_groups.english: Rather sleep with Monica or Rachel? - Monica. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都以为会是瑞秋呢
sense_groups.english: I always thought it'd be Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要想事情… 领带或领巾？ - 领巾
sense_groups.english: No thinking, no thinking. Tie or ascot? - Ascot.

sense_groups.chinese: 南线或北线？ - 北线
sense_groups.english: North route or south route? - North.

sense_groups.chinese: 答案出现 - 厉害吧
sense_groups.english: Bam, there you go. Huh? - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 蜜蜂胡 我来罗
sense_groups.english: That was incredible. Beard of bees here I come.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 这家伙又来了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Oh, this guy again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 普通 今晚想看电影吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, not much. You guys wanna see a movie tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 你要看什么？ - 不知道…
sense_groups.english: Sure. What do you wanna see? - I don't know. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我们要如何决定 菲比 让他见识你的游戏
sense_groups.english: I know how we can decide. Phoebe, show him your game.

sense_groups.chinese: 免了 多谢
sense_groups.english: Um, no, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 但我知道怎么决定了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. But I know how we can decide.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你问题 你要很快回答 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna ask you questions and you answer real quick, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 动作片或喜剧 你比较喜欢哪一个？ - 动作片
sense_groups.english: What's better, action or comedy? - Action.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和瑞秋 你比较想跟谁上床？
sense_groups.english: Who would you rather sleep with, Monica or Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你真变态
sense_groups.english: Dude, you are sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我忘了你迷恋过瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh. I'm sorry. I forgot you had that whole Rachel thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这是干嘛的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What does that thing do?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是眼球摘除机 - 好了 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's an eye removal machine. - All right, I'm out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑的啦…
sense_groups.english: I'm kidding. I'm kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我是米勒医生
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rachel, I'm Dr. Miller.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡说你有点紧张 不过别担心 不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Monica told me you were a little nervous, but everything's gonna be just fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就结束了 - 还差点 我们要先开始
sense_groups.english: So we're done then. - Almost, but first we gotta start.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是青光眼测试 请坐 - 额
sense_groups.english: This is the glaucoma test. Sit down. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 把脸颊放在这里
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Put your chin here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 眼睛会有风吹的成觉
sense_groups.english: Now, you'll feel a small puff of air in each eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Uh, a what?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点点的风啦 你快点
sense_groups.english: A small puff of air. Now, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 来罗 - 好
sense_groups.english: Here we go. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三…
sense_groups.english: One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉…好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这次不会动
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, I'm gonna stay in here this time. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Ready? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二… - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: One, two... - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来抓她头好了 好
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna hold her head.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 - 好
sense_groups.english: That's okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 - 额
sense_groups.english: One... - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 二 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: ...two... - Oh! I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还年轻 应该没有青光眼
sense_groups.english: You know what? You're young. You probably don't have glaucoma.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 很高兴认识您
sense_groups.english: Okay, so it was very, very nice to meet you, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？你疯了不成？ - 好
sense_groups.english: Ow! Hey, what are you...? Are you crazy? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的左眼有些微感染
sense_groups.english: You got a small, minor infection in that left eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 这眼药水一天点三次 连续一周你就宛如新生了
sense_groups.english: I want you to take these drops for a week and you'll be as good as new.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不把任何东西放进眼睛里
sense_groups.english: No, I don't put things in my eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好吧 三个月后再见
sense_groups.english: Okay then. I guess we'll see you back here in three months.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 我到时帮你装上玻璃眼
sense_groups.english: Great. - And I'll fit you for a glass eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 把那死眼药水给我
sense_groups.english: Okay, just give me the damn drops.

sense_groups.chinese: 米勒医生？
sense_groups.english: Dr. Miller?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 棒极了
sense_groups.english: Very good, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道奖品放在哪里 - 我当然知道
sense_groups.english: You know where they are. - I sure do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有
sense_groups.english: And you don't get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那眼药水实在是太神奇了
sense_groups.english: You know, I gotta tell you, those eye drops are a miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的眼睛百分之百好了
sense_groups.english: My eye is 100 percent better.

sense_groups.chinese: 眼药水还放在我的外套里 - 可恶
sense_groups.english: They're still in my coat. - Damn.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 准备好上路了没？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, you ready to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 不过那边会有多冷？
sense_groups.english: Listen, how cold is it gonna be there?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要带外套 还是带这些毛衣就够了？
sense_groups.english: Do I need a coat or will all these sweater vests be enough?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 我爱你
sense_groups.english: What? - I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望罗斯也能一起去 我一定会很想念他的
sense_groups.english: Man, I wish Ross was coming with us. I'm gonna miss him.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是多谢你了 我才刚把那个混蛋给忘掉
sense_groups.english: Thanks a lot. I just got that jerk out of my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们住哪里？电影公司招持的饭店大套房？
sense_groups.english: Hey, so where are we staying? Is the movie putting us up in a big hotel suite?

sense_groups.chinese: 不算是 这是独立制月的电影
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, not really. It's an independent film.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有大预算 我想我住你房间好了
sense_groups.english: So we don't have a real big budget. I figured I'd just stay in your room.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解 但等你拿到酬劳之后 你会请我住饭店大套房吧？
sense_groups.english: I see, but once you get your first paycheck, you'll be springing for a suite.

sense_groups.chinese: 主演电影的片酬一定不少吧？
sense_groups.english: Lead in the movie, they must be paying you a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我算给你听 《极限速度》每赚一块钱…
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Check this out. For every dollar Shutterspeed makes...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊就能分到百分之一
sense_groups.english: ...one penny of it goes right in Joey's pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以电影赚钱你才有钱拿？
sense_groups.english: So you don't get paid unless the movie makes money?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道这电影的情节吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you not hear the plot of the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: "贝丝已经过世十年了"
sense_groups.english: "She's been dead for 10 years."

sense_groups.chinese: 我就快变成百万富翁了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be a millionaire.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要来跟你们说个再见
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to say goodbye to you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便托你们帮我下个注
sense_groups.english: And to see if maybe you guys will place a little bet for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 20美元押黑色15号
sense_groups.english: Twenty bucks on black 15.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 好
sense_groups.english: You got it. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见… - 再见
sense_groups.english: All right. Bye-bye, now. - Bye, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去车子那里替你送行 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna say goodbye at the car. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要去车子那里替我送行？
sense_groups.english: Anybody wanna say goodbye to me at the car?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以替你送行 只要你不介意我眼睛化脓
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I'll say goodbye to you at the car if you don't mind the pus.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 化脓是好现象 表示快要好了
sense_groups.english: But wait a minute. The pus is good. It means it's healing.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你在看什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. What you reading?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？…
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？别闹了啦
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不知道你在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry, I didn't see you there.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你在生我的气吗？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, are you mad at me or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了什么让你生气的事？
sense_groups.english: Because if you are, please tell me what it is I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道 我也帮不了你 - 我是不知道啊
sense_groups.english: Well, if you don't know, I can't help you. - Well, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我也无能为力了
sense_groups.english: Well, I can't help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管是什么事 我都非常抱歉
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, whatever it is, I am very, very sorry. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我接受你的道歉
sense_groups.english: Apology accepted.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们没事了？ - 额
sense_groups.english: So we're good? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚点见罗？
sense_groups.english: I'll, uh, see you later, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 大屁股 - 够了
sense_groups.english: Bye, fat ass. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你快点说 我做了什么让你这么不爽？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, come on, will you please tell me what it is that made you so mad at me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我不记得了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I don't remember.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然忘了 那能不能就算了？
sense_groups.english: Well, if you can't remember, can't we just forget about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我生你的气 这很确定
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I am mad at you. I know that much.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我很抱歉骂你大屁股
sense_groups.english: But I am sorry about the "fat ass" thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你的小屁屁很可爱
sense_groups.english: ...because you actually have a very sweet little heinie.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我开得好累 你得随时准备接手
sense_groups.english: Man, I'm getting pretty tired. You might have to take over soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才上路半小时 而且你都没在看路
sense_groups.english: We've been driving for a half-hour. And you haven't looked at the road once.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 路就是路嘛
sense_groups.english: Don't worry. It's out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我该吃午饭了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Maybe I just need lunch. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃吗？我请客
sense_groups.english: You wanna eat? My treat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是罗斯的钱吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't that Ross' money?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗斯请客？
sense_groups.english: Ross' treat. Where do you wanna eat?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想吃什么？ - 我不知道 我知道要怎么决定了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. - Oh, hey, I know how we can decide.

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你一堆问题…
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, I'm gonna ask you questions...

sense_groups.chinese: 你得很快回答？
sense_groups.english: ...and then you have to answer real fast, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要想事情 什么都不要想
sense_groups.english: So, uh, clear your mind. Clear it right out. Clear it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你宁愿太湿或太干？ - 太干
sense_groups.english: Would you rather be too wet or too dry? - Too dry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相不相信有鬼？ - 不相信
sense_groups.english: Do you believe in ghosts? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 这电影会让我翻身吗？ - 不会
sense_groups.english: Is this movie gonna be my big break? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 会
sense_groups.english: What? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说不会 - 我也说了会啊
sense_groups.english: Dude, you said no. - I also said yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得我这次会翻身？
sense_groups.english: You don't think this is gonna be a big break for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 岂有此理
sense_groups.english: I don't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我只是不要你期望太高
sense_groups.english: Look, Joe, I just don't want you to get your hopes up too high.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在胡说什么？我是电影主角耶
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? I'm the lead in a movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他们还不付你片酬 这电影听来跟幌子一样
sense_groups.english: They're not even paying you. This doesn't even sound like a real movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要听这种话 搞不懂你干嘛泄我的气
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't know why you're dumping all over my big break.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我不认为你这次能翻身
sense_groups.english: Because, Joe, I don't think this is going to be your big break.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你才来这儿？让我觉得自己是窝囊废？
sense_groups.english: Is that why you're on this trip? Huh? To make me feel like a loser?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是这样 那我宁愿自己去 - 你不要我陪你去？
sense_groups.english: Because if it is, I'd rather be alone. - You don't want me on the trip?

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样我不要也罢
sense_groups.english: Not if you're like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好吧 下次你再问那种问题 我骗你就是了
sense_groups.english: Tell you what, the next time you ask me a question like that, I'll lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我不要你一起去
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't want you on the trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 无所谓… 你停车 我马上走
sense_groups.english: All right, fine. Why don't you pull over? I'll get out now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 滚吧
sense_groups.english: Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 在桥上不能随便就停车
sense_groups.english: You're not supposed to stop on a bridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 滚啦 - 好啦
sense_groups.english: Get out. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等… 桥上没有人行道
sense_groups.english: Wait. Wait. There's no sidewalk.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我一定会死在这里
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'm gonna die here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你生我的气 是因为我发胶有怪味？
sense_groups.english: Okay, are you mad at me because my hair gel smells?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你生我的气 是因为我说你写字像小孩？
sense_groups.english: Are you angry with me because I said your handwriting is childlike?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 这样才特别啊
sense_groups.english: No, that made me feel precious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 因为他老爱纠正别人文法？
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know. Is it because he's always correcting people's grammar?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么"whom"个没完 有时候是用"who"啦
sense_groups.english: You know, "whom, whom." Sometimes it's "who."

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？有时候是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Sometimes it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是你玩西洋棋赢了他？
sense_groups.english: Oh, did you beat him at a board game?

sense_groups.chinese: 他开始居于劣势就很孩子气
sense_groups.english: He turns into such a baby when he starts to lose.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我孩子气 - 住手
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm the baby. - Hey. Stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 钱德 - 你怎么会在这里？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊在华盛顿大桥上 把我赶下车
sense_groups.english: Joey kicked me out of the car on the bridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 不知道 他突然发讽
sense_groups.english: Why? - I don't know. He went crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在玩快问快答的游戏
sense_groups.english: We were playing that game where you ask a question and have to answer fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有我在场监督绝对不能玩那个游戏
sense_groups.english: Oh, that game should not be played without my supervision.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道他干嘛气成那样
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know what made him mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是说他这次不会翻身
sense_groups.english: All I said was that, uh, I didn't think this was gonna be his big break...

sense_groups.chinese: 说这部电影帮不了他
sense_groups.english: ...that this movie wasn't gonna do anything for him...

sense_groups.chinese: 说这部电影很像是幌子
sense_groups.english: ...and that it didn't sound like a real movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 他该把我推下桥才对
sense_groups.english: Okay, he should've pushed me off the bridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 你袋子里有什么？
sense_groups.english: What's in the bag?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜想你们大家也会对我不爽
sense_groups.english: Oh, I figured you guys would all be mad at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我在路边捡了些礼物
sense_groups.english: ...so I got you some gifts that I found on the side of the road.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁要一条腿的泰迪熊？ - 我要
sense_groups.english: Who wants the teddy bear with one leg? - I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 差远了 - 好啦 你帮我 我没办法
sense_groups.english: Not even close. - Okay, well, help me. I can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 我帮你
sense_groups.english: All right, come on. Let's do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. - Sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 头往后仰 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, put your head back. All right. - Yes. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 把眼睛张开 - 好 张开了
sense_groups.english: Now, open your eyes. - Okay, they are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我举了几只手指头？ - 四只
sense_groups.english: How many fingers am I holding up? - Four.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我心里想的也是四只
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I was thinking four.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 我们先来预演次 好
sense_groups.english: All right, why don't we start with a practice one, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不滴眼药水 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: No drops. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 数到三 一 二 三…
sense_groups.english: On three. One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把我枕头弄湿了
sense_groups.english: My pillow's all wet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己说是预演的
sense_groups.english: Well, you said it was practice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你干嘛动？ - 因为我知道你在骗我
sense_groups.english: Then why did you move? - Because I knew you were lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 过来 你要干嘛？
sense_groups.english: All right. Come here. Come on. - What are you doing? Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 天啊 住手 …
sense_groups.english: Stop it! Oh, my God, stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要…
sense_groups.english: I am going...

sense_groups.chinese: 转回来 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Turn it over. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把眼药水…
sense_groups.english: I am going to get...

sense_groups.chinese: 滴进你眼睛
sense_groups.english: Get these drops in your eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你蛮力真大
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You really are freakishly strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 住手 …
sense_groups.english: Aah! Aah! Monica, stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶 滴完了
sense_groups.english: Damn, it's empty.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果现在乔伊和钱德走进来 我们就发了
sense_groups.english: Wow. If Joey and Chandler walked in right now, we could make a fortune.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是钱德 乔伊或罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ooh, that is definitely Chandler, Joey or Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Or Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hello? It's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴你打来 钱德都说了 他很难过
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you called. Chandler told me what happened. He's really upset.

sense_groups.chinese: 等他知道他毛衣的下场 他一定会更难过
sense_groups.english: Not as upset as he's gonna be when he finds out what I did with his sweater vests.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把他的毛衣怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What did you do to his sweater vests?

sense_groups.chinese: 这么说吧 在俄玄俄州 有一伙打扮亮丽的狗
sense_groups.english: Let's just say there's a well-dressed pack of dogs in Ohio.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？菲比在吗？我有车子的事要问她
sense_groups.english: Monica, listen, is Phoebe there? I gotta ask her something about the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在 你等等
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hold on one second.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 老兄 - 嘿 你听我说
sense_groups.english: Hey, dude. - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 座位底下有个木盒滑出来 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Listen, this wooden box keeps sliding out from under the seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是谁？ - 那是我祖母
sense_groups.english: What is it? - Oh, that's my grandma.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 谢谢你 她玩得很愉快
sense_groups.english: And thanks, Joey. She's having a really great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 是乔伊吗？我要跟他说…
sense_groups.english: Is that Joey? Is that Joey? Let me talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？钱德在这儿 不知道你…
sense_groups.english: Joey, Chandler's here. He was wondering if...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他零钱正好用完了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I guess he ran out of change.

sense_groups.chinese: 他连话都不想跟我说
sense_groups.english: He won't even talk to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样我要怎么跟他道歉？
sense_groups.english: How am I gonna apologize to him if he won't even talk to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你应该寄点东西给他
sense_groups.english: Maybe you should send him something.

sense_groups.chinese: 等他到了赌城 就知道你想表达歉意了
sense_groups.english: So when he gets to Las Vegas, he'll know that you're sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 上哪儿找一堆A片？
sense_groups.english: That's a good idea. I wonder where I could get a basket of porn?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 不能用A片道歉啦 真的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, don't say I'm sorry with porn.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该寄一条烟过去
sense_groups.english: You know what you should send him? A carton of cigarettes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以用来换取保护
sense_groups.english: Because that way he can trade it for protection.

sense_groups.chinese: 错了 监狱里才是这样
sense_groups.english: No. That's prison.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道要怎么找出原因
sense_groups.english: I know how we're gonna figure this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 什么都不要想
sense_groups.english: Okay. Clear your mind...

sense_groups.chinese: 想到什么就直接回答 好了吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and answer the first thing that comes into your head. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你比较喜欢植物还是动物？ - 动物
sense_groups.english: What's better, flora or fauna? - Fauna.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想当赛门还是葛芬柯？ - 葛芬柯
sense_groups.english: Simon or Garfunkel? - Garfunkel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为何生我的气？ - 因为你说我很无趣
sense_groups.english: Why are you mad at me? - You said I was boring. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我何时说过你无趣了？
sense_groups.english: When did I say you were boring?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我想起来了 我们下西洋棋那次
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I remember now. We were playing chess.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我和你没下过西洋棋
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you and I have never played chess.

sense_groups.chinese: 有啦
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得冰冻湖那次吗？我们玩西洋棋 你说我很无趣
sense_groups.english: Remember that time on the frozen lake? We were playing. You said I was boring.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你脱下面具 变成了卡麦蓉狄亚
sense_groups.english: And then you took off your energy mask and you were Cameron Diaz.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这有可能是梦境
sense_groups.english: Okay, there's a chance this may have been a dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 史丹利 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Stanley. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的主角来了 咱们开工吧
sense_groups.english: Your leading man is here. Let's get to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 计划有些改变 我们停拍了
sense_groups.english: Um, slight change of plans. We've shut down.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没钱
sense_groups.english: It's a money thing. We don't have any.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吧？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. You're kidding, right? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 这或许只是暂时的
sense_groups.english: What? - It's probably just temporary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们希望能快点筹到资金 你先撑一下
sense_groups.english: We're hoping to get more money soon, so if you could just, uh, hang out.

sense_groups.chinese: 撑一下？要撑多久？
sense_groups.english: Hang out? How long?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 一两个星期吧 资金会出现的
sense_groups.english: I don't know. A week. Maybe two. The money'll turn up.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都爱投资拍片 你该不会是有钱人吧？我不是
sense_groups.english: People always wanna invest in movies. Hey, you're not rich, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 问一下也无妨
sense_groups.english: No. - Worth a shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 让我知道你在哪儿落脚
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey, let me know where you're staying, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你是乔伊崔比亚尼吗？ - 我是
sense_groups.english: Hey, pal. Are you Joey Tribbiani? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是有人留给你的
sense_groups.english: These got left for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: "恭喜你翻身了"
sense_groups.english: "Congratulations on your big break."

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我是乔伊 - 嘿乔伊
sense_groups.english: Monica, it's Joey. - Hey, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当了大明星还是记得我
sense_groups.english: Aw, you remember me even though you're a big star.

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧 忘记你也要好几年
sense_groups.english: Aw, come on. It'll be years before I forget you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 拍片现场是什么样子？
sense_groups.english: Joey, what's it like on a movie set, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有自己的更衣室吗？有专属的座椅吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a dressing room? Do you have a chair with your name on it?

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 一切都在进行当中
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, yeah, I got all that going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定要跟钱德说 他完完全全看走眼了
sense_groups.english: Listen, uh, make sure you tell Chandler he couldn't have been more wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我得挂了 我的寿司送来了
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh, I gotta go, Monica. My, uh, sushi's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 多谢你们等我 没关系
sense_groups.english: Sorry about that. Thanks for waiting. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家笑一个
sense_groups.english: Everybody smile.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢 希望你们在凯萨住得愉快 祝福你们"罗马"精神
sense_groups.english: Thanks a lot. Enjoy your stay at Caesar's. We hope it's toga-rific.

sense_groups.chinese: 杀了我吧…
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Kill me. Kill me now.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 《电视指南》递给我好吗？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, can you pass me the TV Guide? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 上 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Go! - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛 住手 天啊
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? Get off! Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了… - 啊
sense_groups.english: Hold it open. Okay. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 三 四个小时后再见
sense_groups.english: We'll see you in about three or four hours.

questions.name: S05E23
questions.en:
Hello?
Hey, Joey! JOEY - Hey, Pheebs.
Can you do me a favor?
I forgot the PIN to my ATM card. Can you get it for me?
Sure. Where is it?
Uh, I scratched it on the ATM machine on the corner.
Oh, so you're 5-6-3-9?
That's it! Thanks.
Wanna talk to Chandler? - Let me talk to him.
He didn't believe in my movie...
...which is a big mistake, because it is real. Real.
I've tried to apologize.
If I can't do it on the phone, I'll go and do it in person.
I heard that. Uh, can you put him on?
Yeah.
Hey. - Don't come out here.
I support you 100 percent and I wanna prove that to you in person.
I got that. I forgive you. Don't come out here.
You haven't taken my calls for a week.
I'm totally over it. Friends forever. Don't come out here.
Would you mind doing a picture with us?
Uh, what was that?
Uh, Entertainment Tonight.
Good talking to you and don't come out here.
Monica?
I'm sorry I'm late.
Monica?
Phoebe?
I'm so sorry. Have you been here long?
That's okay.
What the hell took you so long?
You can't tell Chandler. I ran into Richard.
Which Richard? - The Richard.
Richard Simmons? Oh, my God!
No, my ex-boyfriend Richard. You know, the tall guy, mustache.
Okay, that actually makes more sense. How was it?
It was really nice. We talked and I had lunch with him.
That's weird. I dreamed you had lunch with Richard.
Really? - Again, Richard Simmons.
Go on.
The strange part was he was really nice...
...and he looks great, but I didn't feel anything.
So why can't we tell Chandler?
It'll freak him out and tomorrow's our anniversary. I don't wanna spoil it.
I can't believe you guys have lasted a whole year!
Wow, I owe Rachel 20 bucks.
What?
On a totally different bet.
Hey!
It's almost our anniversary! - I know.
One year ago today, I was just your annoying friend Chandler.
Aw, now you're just my annoying friend Chandler.
Huh. - I got you a gift.
It's not till tomorrow. - I know, but you have to open it today.
Okay! There you go!
It's two tickets to Vegas! - Wow.
Yeah! For this weekend! It'll be perfect.
You'll see Joey, plus, we'll start our celebration on the plane.
We can call it our "Plane-a-versary."
We have to?
This is great, but Joey didn't want any of us there.
He doesn't want us to go to any trouble. He'll be excited when we surprise him.
Plus, we get to have our own "Anna-Vegas-ry"!
"Anna-vada-versary!"
I think we should see other people.
We can go, right?
Great idea.
I'm gonna go too!
Pheebs, it's kind of our anniversary.
You won't ditch me like you did with London.
Ditch you? You were pregnant...
Uh-huh. Great story. I'm going.
Hi. - Hey.
Listen, this weekend we're all gonna go to Las Vegas to surprise Joey!
Including me!
Do you wanna go?
I can take a couple days off work.
Of course you can take a couple days off, because this trip includes me!
I've got a presentation tomorrow. I can't miss that.
I've got tickets to the Van Gogh exhibit. I waited a year for this.
Rach, maybe we can fly out Saturday? - Sounds great.
I'll call the airlines.
That'll be nice to have the apartment to myself.
To walk around naked.
No, so I can be by myself. Have a little alone time.
Naked alone time.
Just because I'm alone doesn't mean I wanna walk around naked.
You live alone, you don't walk around naked.
Uh-huh. Why does it takes me so long to answer the door?
So far, is this trip to Las Vegas better or worse than the trip to London?
So far, it's pretty much the same, Pheebs.
What about after I give you these candies?
I guess it's a little better now. - Ha, ha.
Las Vegas, 1. London, 0.
I'll be back.
Happy Plane-a-versary.
Aw. I love you.
Can I give you your present now? - Okay!
Oh, don't tell me I did this.
I love "I forgot the present" fake-out!
How about "I did forget the present, forgive me" not fake-out?
You can give it to me when we get back.
This is the worst thing that could happen.
You decided to tell him about the Richard thing.
What "Richard thing"?
Oh, no.
What "Richard thing"?
Simmons. Go with Simmons.
I ran into Richard yesterday.
He asked me if I wanted to go for a bite and I did.
I didn't tell you because you'd get mad...
...and I didn't wanna spoil our anniversary.
I'm not mad.
Really?
So you bumped into Richard. You grabbed a "bite."
No big deal.
Great.
Okay, London, 1.
Ooh.
Hmm.
Oh, look what happened.
Huh, check me out.
I'm in my kitchen...
...naked.
I'm picking up an orange.
I'm naked.
I'm lighting the candles.
Naked. And carefully.
Oh, my God! That's Rachel, naked!
I can't look at that. I am looking at this.
Okay, vivid colors, expressive brush strokes.
Unless she wants me to be looking at that.
She knows I'm home.
She knows I can see her.
What kind of game is she playing?
I think maybe someone's lonely tonight.
Oh, Dr. Geller.
Stop it. You're being silly. Ha, ha.
Or am I?
Darn it!
Hey.
May I come in?
Uh, yeah, if you want to.
Do you want me to?
Yeah, sure?
So do I.
Okay, Rach, before anything happens...
...I wanna lay down a couple of ground rules.

Just because I'm alone doesn't mean I wanna walk around naked.
You live alone, you don't walk around naked.
Uh-huh. Why does it takes me so long to answer the door?
So far, is this trip to Las Vegas better or worse than the trip to London?
So far, it's pretty much the same, Pheebs.
What about after I give you these candies?
I guess it's a little better now. - Ha, ha.
Las Vegas, 1. London, 0.
I'll be back.
Happy Plane-a-versary.
Aw. I love you.
Can I give you your present now? - Okay!
Oh, don't tell me I did this.
I love "I forgot the present" fake-out!
How about "I did forget the present, forgive me" not fake-out?
You can give it to me when we get back.
This is the worst thing that could happen.
You decided to tell him about the Richard thing.
What "Richard thing"?
Oh, no.
What "Richard thing"?
Simmons. Go with Simmons.
I ran into Richard yesterday.
He asked me if I wanted to go for a bite and I did.
I didn't tell you because you'd get mad...
...and I didn't wanna spoil our anniversary.
I'm not mad.
Really?
So you bumped into Richard. You grabbed a "bite."
No big deal.
Great.
Okay, London, 1.
Ooh.
Hmm.
Oh, look what happened.
Huh, check me out.
I'm in my kitchen...
...naked.
I'm picking up an orange.
I'm naked.
I'm lighting the candles.
Naked. And carefully.
Oh, my God! That's Rachel, naked!
I can't look at that. I am looking at this.
Okay, vivid colors, expressive brush strokes.
Unless she wants me to be looking at that.
She knows I'm home.
She knows I can see her.
What kind of game is she playing?
I think maybe someone's lonely tonight.
Oh, Dr. Geller.
Stop it. You're being silly. Ha, ha.
Or am I?
Darn it!
Hey.
May I come in?
Uh, yeah, if you want to.
Do you want me to?
Yeah, sure?
So do I.
Okay, Rach, before anything happens...
...I wanna lay down a couple of ground rules.
This is just about tonight.
I won't go through with this if it'll raise the question of "us."
I just want this to be...
...about what it is.
And, um...
...what is that, Ross?
The physical act of love.
What, are you crazy?
So you weren't trying to entice me just now with your nakedness?
Oh, God. You saw me?
You weren't trying to entice me with your nakedness?
No!
You actually thought I wanted to have sex with you?
No!
No.
No, no, no, no.
Hey, you guys, wait! You guys.
This place is much better than London.
A lady dressed like Cleopatra gave me this.
Ninety-nine cent steak and lobster dinner. Huh.
You don't eat animals.
For ninety-nine cents I'd eat you.
I can totally settle down here.
It's got everything I could ever want. Including Joey! Look!
Look! Hey!
Oh, my God.
Hey, Joey!
Wow! - Hi.
Love your condoms, my man.
Why are you here? I told you not to come.
Why are you dressed as a gladiator?
Uh, because I'm shooting a scene right now. I play a gladiator.
Hold on a second. Can we cut?
My friends are here. I'm gonna take a break.
Who are you talking to?
The director.
Uh, her.
All right, it's not a gladiator movie. I work here.
Why? What happened?
The movie shut down. Ran out of money.
I'm working here till it starts up, if it ever does.
I'm so sorry. - Such a drag.
Sorry I didn't tell you. I'm sorry.
Apparently there's a new policy of not sharing.
I knew you weren't okay with that. - So you're a gladiator!
What's going on?
Monica had lunch with Richard. - Dawson?
No...
But that would've been so cool!
Her boyfriend Richard.
It meant nothing. After all this time, how can you not trust me?
When you go lunching with hunky men and don't tell me!
You're right. I'm sorry. I should've told you.
Thanks.
Aw, there we go. - Now I love Vegas.
I promise you next time I absolutely will tell you.
"Next time"?
Ooh, so close.
There won't be a next time. You cannot see him again.
I cannot see him? You can't tell me what to do.
That's funny, I think I just did.
If you act like this, I won't be around you.
Fine. - Happy anniversary!
Guys, please! Come on, come on.
This is obviously a misunderstanding.
No, it's not. - What're you talking about?
Don't look at me. I just work here.
Okay, um, Ross? I'm a little warm, so I'm gonna be taking off my sweater.
Now, I'm just letting you know...
...this is not an invitation to the physical act of love.
Yep, that's hilarious.
I'm sorry. I'm done. I'm done.
You know, last night was embarrassing for you too.
No, not really.
But you know, I just don't embarrass that easily.
What? You totally get embarrassed.
No, I don't. Ross, I think I'm just a more secure person than you are.
Is that so? - Yeah.
Hey, lady!
I don't care how much you want it, okay?
I am not gonna have sex with you in the bathroom!
You know, in Roman times, this was more than just a hat.
Really?
Yeah, sure, sure.
They would scrub the floors.
They'd use it to get the mud off their shoe.
Sometimes underneath the horse would get dirty.
So they would stick it right...
I can't believe this is how I'm spending my anniversary.
I'll take you someplace nice. A guy tipped me $100.
Whoa! - Yeah.
He was playing blackjack for an hour and he won $5000.
Can you believe that?
If I won $5000, I'd join a gym.
Build up my upper body...
...and hit Richard from behind with a stick.
Wait! Why don't I just do what that guy did?
I'll take this $100, turn it into $5000...
...and I'll turn that into enough to get my movie going!
Good luck.
I don't need luck. I've thought this through. - I see.
Thank you. - Thanks.
I can't believe this. This is like the worst night ever.
You had a minor setback in your relationship.
Big deal. It's only Chandler.
I am so sorry.
This is crazy having such a stupid argument.
I don't wanna see Richard.
So go fix it.
Find Chandler. He's probably in your room.
Tell him sorry and you love him.
You're right, Phoebe.
Thank you. - Sure.
Yeah! Las Vegas! Number one!
Anybody lose this? - Coming out.
Place your bet.
Dice her out.
Yellow 11. Pay the front line!
Hmm.
So, uh, I'm on my way back to the bathroom.
All right, all right. Just keep walking, all right?
What are you... I am sorry, sir.
I think he just really likes you.
Hey...
You know that teacher who had a baby with her student?
Can I help you? - Yes.
Do you have any extra pants? Uh, my friend seems to have had a little accident.
Can I change 100? - Changing 100.
Good luck, sir. - Thanks.
That's right.
Thirteen. - Hit me!
Oh, man!
Wait!
You are not gonna believe this!
I have found my identical hand twin.
What?
My identical hand twin!
What's an identical hand twin?
It was incredible. The dealer's hands were exactly like mine.
It was like looking at my hands in a mirror!
You sure you weren't looking at your hands in a mirror?
Don't you see what this means? I can forget about that stupid movie.
I'm gonna be a millionaire!
How?
I don't have it all worked out yet.
But it's gotta mean big money. Come on, identical hands!
Again, I must go back to...
...how?
This is Vegas, man. People will pay to see freaky stuff!
How much would you pay to see this hand...
...twice? Huh?
I can't really put a price on that.
Are you un-supporting me again?
No. No.
I support you 100 percent. I just didn't get it right away.
Now I'm caught up.
Identical hand twins.
It's a million-dollar idea!
Hey! - Pheebs!
I found my identical hand twin!
Oh, you're so lucky!
So where's Monica? Did you guys make up?
No. - But she just came up here.
That was Joey.
I wonder where she is? It's so weird.
She's probably talking to Richard.
Would you stop that?
You know what she said after her lunch with Richard?
She didn't feel anything for him. She loves you.
Really? - Yes.
She feels terrible. She really wants to make up. You've gotta find her.
Okay.
Good.
I should really start wearing hats.
Welcome to Las Vegas.
Did you enjoy your flight? - I did.
Thank you very much. It was excellent.
I hope you had a nice flight. - Oh, it was the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？乔伊 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey! JOEY - Hey, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我个忙好吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you do me a favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘记提款卡的密码 你可以帮我去找吗？
sense_groups.english: I forgot the PIN to my ATM card. Can you get it for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Sure. Where is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刻在提款机的角落那里
sense_groups.english: Uh, I scratched it on the ATM machine on the corner.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来5639是你的密码
sense_groups.english: Oh, so you're 5-6-3-9?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 菲比 谢了
sense_groups.english: That's it! Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟钱德说话吗？ - 是乔伊吗？让我跟他说
sense_groups.english: Wanna talk to Chandler? - Let me talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不相信我的电影
sense_groups.english: He didn't believe in my movie...

sense_groups.chinese: 他大错特错 这次的电影是真的 …
sense_groups.english: ...which is a big mistake, because it is real. Real.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这星期来都试着跟他道歉
sense_groups.english: I've tried to apologize.

sense_groups.chinese: 若他不让我在电话上说 我就直接杀过去当面说
sense_groups.english: If I can't do it on the phone, I'll go and do it in person.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我听到了 请他听电话
sense_groups.english: I heard that. Uh, can you put him on?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你别过来
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Don't come out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行… 我百分之百支持你 我要当面证明给你看
sense_groups.english: I support you 100 percent and I wanna prove that to you in person.

sense_groups.chinese: 收到 我原谅你 你别过来
sense_groups.english: I got that. I forgive you. Don't come out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 原谅我？你一星期都不接我电话
sense_groups.english: You haven't taken my calls for a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我早都不介意了 咱们是一辈子的朋友 你别过来
sense_groups.english: I'm totally over it. Friends forever. Don't come out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以跟我们照张相吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you mind doing a picture with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？
sense_groups.english: Uh, what was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 《今夜娱乐》节目
sense_groups.english: Uh, Entertainment Tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 很高兴跟你说话 你别过来
sense_groups.english: Good talking to you and don't come out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我迟到了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 真对不起 你到很久了吧？
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. Have you been here long?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系啦
sense_groups.english: That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么拖了那么久？
sense_groups.english: What the hell took you so long?

sense_groups.chinese: 不许你跟钱德说 我遇见了理查
sense_groups.english: You can't tell Chandler. I ran into Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个理查？ - 那个理查
sense_groups.english: Which Richard? - The Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查西蒙斯？天啊
sense_groups.english: Richard Simmons? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 是我前男友理查 个子高高 有胡子那个
sense_groups.english: No, my ex-boyfriend Richard. You know, the tall guy, mustache.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这就说得过去了 情况如何？
sense_groups.english: Okay, that actually makes more sense. How was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了 我们先是闲聊后来一起吃了个午饭
sense_groups.english: It was really nice. We talked and I had lunch with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪了 我有梦到你跟理查吃饭
sense_groups.english: That's weird. I dreamed you had lunch with Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 不过是跟理查西蒙斯啦
sense_groups.english: Really? - Again, Richard Simmons.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟上
sense_groups.english: Go on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你继续说 奇怪的是虽然他很棒也很帅
sense_groups.english: The strange part was he was really nice...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我对他完全没感觉了
sense_groups.english: ...and he looks great, but I didn't feel anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 那为什么不能跟钱德说？
sense_groups.english: So why can't we tell Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他听了一定会发神经 明天就是我们的纪念日 我不想搞砸
sense_groups.english: It'll freak him out and tomorrow's our anniversary. I don't wanna spoil it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你们交往一年了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you guys have lasted a whole year!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我欠瑞秋20美元
sense_groups.english: Wow, I owe Rachel 20 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是完全不相干的赌局啦
sense_groups.english: On a totally different bet.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 一周年纪念日快到了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: It's almost our anniversary! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信吗？一年前的今天 我还是只是烦人的朋友钱德
sense_groups.english: One year ago today, I was just your annoying friend Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你是我烦人的朋友钱德
sense_groups.english: Aw, now you're just my annoying friend Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 我帮你买了礼物
sense_groups.english: Huh. - I got you a gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 纪念日明天才到 - 我知道 但你今天就要开礼物 好吧
sense_groups.english: It's not till tomorrow. - I know, but you have to open it today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来啦
sense_groups.english: Okay! There you go!

sense_groups.chinese: 两张去赌城的机票 - 哇
sense_groups.english: It's two tickets to Vegas! - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这周末的来回机票 一定很完美
sense_groups.english: Yeah! For this weekend! It'll be perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 不但能去看乔伊 还能在飞机上开始过纪念日
sense_groups.english: You'll see Joey, plus, we'll start our celebration on the plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 就叫做"飞机纪念日"吧
sense_groups.english: We can call it our "Plane-a-versary."

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要这样叫？
sense_groups.english: We have to?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是很棒没错 但乔伊说了不要我们过去
sense_groups.english: This is great, but Joey didn't want any of us there.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只是怕麻烦我们而已 到时我们突然出现 他一定超兴奋的
sense_groups.english: He doesn't want us to go to any trouble. He'll be excited when we surprise him.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我们自己还有"赌城纪念日"
sense_groups.english: Plus, we get to have our own "Anna-Vegas-ry"!

sense_groups.chinese: "内华达纪念日"
sense_groups.english: "Anna-vada-versary!"

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们该开始和别人交往
sense_groups.english: I think we should see other people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以去吧？对
sense_groups.english: We can go, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个好主意
sense_groups.english: Great idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 我也要去
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go too!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这是我俩的纪念日耶
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, it's kind of our anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来 休想比照伦敦那次 把我甩掉
sense_groups.english: You won't ditch me like you did with London.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 哪有甩掉？当时你怀了三胞胎耶
sense_groups.english: Ditch you? You were pregnant...

sense_groups.chinese: 真会办 我非去不可
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Great story. I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 注意 这周末大家一起去赌城 给乔伊一个惊喜
sense_groups.english: Listen, this weekend we're all gonna go to Las Vegas to surprise Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 包括我
sense_groups.english: Including me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要去吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you wanna go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该可以请几天假
sense_groups.english: I can take a couple days off work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然可以请几天假 因为这趟我也要去
sense_groups.english: Of course you can take a couple days off, because this trip includes me!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 差点忘了 我明天要提报告 不能缺席
sense_groups.english: I've got a presentation tomorrow. I can't miss that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也买了梵谷画展的票 我盼了一年才盼到
sense_groups.english: I've got tickets to the Van Gogh exhibit. I waited a year for this.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 不如你我周六再飞去？ - 听起来很可行
sense_groups.english: Rach, maybe we can fly out Saturday? - Sounds great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我打电话去订票
sense_groups.english: I'll call the airlines.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实想起来很不赖 我可以独自在公寓过一晚
sense_groups.english: That'll be nice to have the apartment to myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你可以脱光光到处走
sense_groups.english: To walk around naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我可以自己一个人 享受独处的时光
sense_groups.english: No, so I can be by myself. Have a little alone time.

sense_groups.chinese: 脱光光的独处时光
sense_groups.english: Naked alone time.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我想一个人独处 并不表示我就想脱光光到处走
sense_groups.english: Just because I'm alone doesn't mean I wanna walk around naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己一个人住 你也不会脱光光到处走啊
sense_groups.english: You live alone, you don't walk around naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我为何老半天才开门？
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Why does it takes me so long to answer the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 这趟旅程到现在为止 比起伦敦那趟是好还是坏？
sense_groups.english: So far, is this trip to Las Vegas better or worse than the trip to London?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 到现在为止都差不多
sense_groups.english: So far, it's pretty much the same, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我给你们糖果之后呢？
sense_groups.english: What about after I give you these candies?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我想好一点了 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I guess it's a little better now. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 赌城1分 伦敦O分
sense_groups.english: Las Vegas, 1. London, 0.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be back.

sense_groups.chinese: 飞机纪念日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy Plane-a-versary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Aw. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 礼物能趁现在给你吗？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Can I give you your present now? - Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 要命 不会吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't tell me I did this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最爱你假装没带礼物了
sense_groups.english: I love "I forgot the present" fake-out!

sense_groups.chinese: 那如果"我是真的没带礼物 请你多多包涵呢"？
sense_groups.english: How about "I did forget the present, forgive me" not fake-out?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系啦 别放在心上 等回去再给我就行了
sense_groups.english: You can give it to me when we get back.

sense_groups.chinese: 纪念日发生这种事 真是再扫兴不过了
sense_groups.english: This is the worst thing that could happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 你最后还是决定 要跟钱德说理查的事了
sense_groups.english: You decided to tell him about the Richard thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么理查的事？
sense_groups.english: What "Richard thing"?

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么理查的事？
sense_groups.english: What "Richard thing"?

sense_groups.chinese: 用西蒙斯混过去
sense_groups.english: Simmons. Go with Simmons.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我昨天遇到了理查
sense_groups.english: I ran into Richard yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 他问我要不要一起吃饭 我答应了
sense_groups.english: He asked me if I wanted to go for a bite and I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没跟你说是因为
sense_groups.english: I didn't tell you because you'd get mad...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你会生气 而我不想毁了周年纪念日
sense_groups.english: ...and I didn't wanna spoil our anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不生气啊
sense_groups.english: I'm not mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你遇到理查 一起吃饭
sense_groups.english: So you bumped into Richard. You grabbed a "bite."

sense_groups.chinese: 没啥大不了的
sense_groups.english: No big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 伦敦1分
sense_groups.english: Okay, London, 1.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 怎么会这样
sense_groups.english: Oh, look what happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧我自己
sense_groups.english: Huh, check me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在自家的厨房
sense_groups.english: I'm in my kitchen...

sense_groups.chinese: 脱光光
sense_groups.english: ...naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿起一颗柳丁
sense_groups.english: I'm picking up an orange.

sense_groups.chinese: 我脱光光
sense_groups.english: I'm naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 点起蜡烛
sense_groups.english: I'm lighting the candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 脱光光 要小心
sense_groups.english: Naked. And carefully.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瑞秋脱光光
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! That's Rachel, naked!

sense_groups.chinese: 不能看 我在看书
sense_groups.english: I can't look at that. I am looking at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 鲜明的色彩 有力的笔记
sense_groups.english: Okay, vivid colors, expressive brush strokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非她故意要我看就另当别论了
sense_groups.english: Unless she wants me to be looking at that.

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道我在家
sense_groups.english: She knows I'm home.

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道我看得到她
sense_groups.english: She knows I can see her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她这是在玩什么把戏？
sense_groups.english: What kind of game is she playing?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许今晚有人寂寞
sense_groups.english: I think maybe someone's lonely tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士
sense_groups.english: Oh, Dr. Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 别胡思乱想 别自讨没趣了
sense_groups.english: Stop it. You're being silly. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是这样吗？
sense_groups.english: Or am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 讨厌
sense_groups.english: Darn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以进去吗？
sense_groups.english: May I come in?

sense_groups.chinese: 想要的话就进来啊
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, if you want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我进去吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然罗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 彼此彼此
sense_groups.english: So do I.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 在一切还没开始之前
sense_groups.english: Okay, Rach, before anything happens...

sense_groups.chinese: 有几个原则我想先说清楚
sense_groups.english: ...I wanna lay down a couple of ground rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只适用于今晚
sense_groups.english: This is just about tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚过后 你是你 我是我
sense_groups.english: I won't go through with this if it'll raise the question of "us."

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望这一切…
sense_groups.english: I just want this to be...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是各取所需
sense_groups.english: ...about what it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: And, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么各取所需？
sense_groups.english: ...what is that, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 出自于兽欲的性爱
sense_groups.english: The physical act of love.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你疯了不成？
sense_groups.english: What, are you crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你刚才脱光光 不是在勾引我？
sense_groups.english: So you weren't trying to entice me just now with your nakedness?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你有看到？
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. You saw me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你脱光光不是在勾引我？
sense_groups.english: You weren't trying to entice me with your nakedness?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你当真以为我想跟你上床？
sense_groups.english: You actually thought I wanted to have sex with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是呢…
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是…
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们等等啊 等等我
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, wait! You guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 这地方比伦敦好多了吧
sense_groups.english: This place is much better than London.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个打扮成埃及艳后的女士 给了我这张折价春
sense_groups.english: A lady dressed like Cleopatra gave me this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用一块美元 就能吃到牛排龙虾晚餐
sense_groups.english: Ninety-nine cent steak and lobster dinner. Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你又不吃肉
sense_groups.english: You don't eat animals.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用一美元 我连你都吃
sense_groups.english: For ninety-nine cents I'd eat you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全可以耗在这里
sense_groups.english: I can totally settle down here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要的东西应有尽有 就连乔伊都在 你们看
sense_groups.english: It's got everything I could ever want. Including Joey! Look!

sense_groups.chinese: 快点看
sense_groups.english: Look! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Wow! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的保险套真不赖
sense_groups.english: Love your condoms, my man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么在这儿？不是要你们别来了？
sense_groups.english: Why are you here? I told you not to come.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛打扮成神鬼战士？
sense_groups.english: Why are you dressed as a gladiator?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我正在拍戏 我扮演神鬼战士
sense_groups.english: Uh, because I'm shooting a scene right now. I play a gladiator.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们等等 可以卡一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Hold on a second. Can we cut?

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友来了 我要休息一下
sense_groups.english: My friends are here. I'm gonna take a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在跟谁说话？
sense_groups.english: Who are you talking to?

sense_groups.chinese: 导演啊
sense_groups.english: The director.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是她
sense_groups.english: Uh, her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 我不是在拍神鬼战士 我在这里工作
sense_groups.english: All right, it's not a gladiator movie. I work here.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: Why? What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 那部电影因为没钱而停拍
sense_groups.english: The movie shut down. Ran out of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里工作等电影重新开拍 如果真有这一天的话
sense_groups.english: I'm working here till it starts up, if it ever does.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很遗憾 - 这样啊
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. - Such a drag.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 没跟你们说 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry I didn't tell you. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系… 互相隐瞒显然成了新的规矩
sense_groups.english: Apparently there's a new policy of not sharing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你听了会有疙瘩 - 你是神鬼战士耶
sense_groups.english: I knew you weren't okay with that. - So you're a gladiator!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟理查吃了中饭 - 理查道森？
sense_groups.english: Monica had lunch with Richard. - Dawson?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦
sense_groups.english: No...

sense_groups.chinese: 要不然一定超酷的
sense_groups.english: But that would've been so cool!

sense_groups.chinese: 是那个男朋友理查
sense_groups.english: Her boyfriend Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本不碍事 你怎么到现在还不相信我？
sense_groups.english: It meant nothing. After all this time, how can you not trust me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你瞒着我跟大胡子帅哥吃午餐 要我怎么相信你？
sense_groups.english: When you go lunching with hunky men and don't tell me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 对不起 我早该跟你说的
sense_groups.english: You're right. I'm sorry. I should've told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样才对嘛 - 我爱赌城
sense_groups.english: Aw, there we go. - Now I love Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证下次一定会跟你说
sense_groups.english: I promise you next time I absolutely will tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: "下一次"？
sense_groups.english: "Next time"?

sense_groups.chinese: 功亏一篑
sense_groups.english: Ooh, so close.

sense_groups.chinese: 下不为例 你不能再跟他见面
sense_groups.english: There won't be a next time. You cannot see him again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能跟他见面？你不能对我发号施令
sense_groups.english: I cannot see him? You can't tell me what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 很有趣 刚才不就是了
sense_groups.english: That's funny, I think I just did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这种态度 我眼不见为净 我无所谓
sense_groups.english: If you act like this, I won't be around you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 纪念日快乐
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Happy anniversary!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们别这样嘛
sense_groups.english: Guys, please! Come on, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 这显然是个大误会
sense_groups.english: This is obviously a misunderstanding.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是误会 - 你在说什么…
sense_groups.english: No, it's not. - What're you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 别看我 我只是在这里工作
sense_groups.english: Don't look at me. I just work here.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？我有点热 要脱毛衣
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, Ross? I'm a little warm, so I'm gonna be taking off my sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要你知道
sense_groups.english: Now, I'm just letting you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是在勾引你一夜情
sense_groups.english: ...this is not an invitation to the physical act of love.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 真是太爆笑了
sense_groups.english: Yep, that's hilarious.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不闹了…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm done. I'm done.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚对你其实也很尴尬
sense_groups.english: You know, last night was embarrassing for you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不尽然
sense_groups.english: No, not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是没有那么容易尴尬
sense_groups.english: But you know, I just don't embarrass that easily.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你根本尴尬得要死
sense_groups.english: What? You totally get embarrassed.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有 罗斯 这是因为我比你更有安全感
sense_groups.english: No, I don't. Ross, I think I'm just a more secure person than you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Is that so? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐
sense_groups.english: Hey, lady!

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你有多想
sense_groups.english: I don't care how much you want it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝不会和你去厕所做爱
sense_groups.english: I am not gonna have sex with you in the bathroom!

sense_groups.chinese: 在古罗马时代 这不只是顶帽子而已
sense_groups.english: You know, in Roman times, this was more than just a hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然罗…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可以用来刷地板
sense_groups.english: They would scrub the floors.

sense_groups.chinese: 抹去鞋子上的泥巴
sense_groups.english: They'd use it to get the mud off their shoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候下面的马会弄脏 把这个戮进去就能…
sense_groups.english: Sometimes underneath the horse would get dirty.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: So they would stick it right...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的周年纪念日是这样过的
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is how I'm spending my anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我带你去个好地方 今天有个人赏我一百美元小费
sense_groups.english: I'll take you someplace nice. A guy tipped me $100.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Whoa! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他玩21点 才一小时就赢了五千美元
sense_groups.english: He was playing blackjack for an hour and he won $5000.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信吗？五千美元耶
sense_groups.english: Can you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 若我赢了五千美元 我就去加入健身房
sense_groups.english: If I won $5000, I'd join a gym.

sense_groups.chinese: 把我的上半身练壮
sense_groups.english: Build up my upper body...

sense_groups.chinese: 再用棍子插理查的屁眼
sense_groups.english: ...and hit Richard from behind with a stick.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我何不效仿那个人？
sense_groups.english: Wait! Why don't I just do what that guy did?

sense_groups.chinese: 把这一百元变成五千
sense_groups.english: I'll take this $100, turn it into $5000...

sense_groups.chinese: 到时再连三翻 就有钱让电影重新开拍了
sense_groups.english: ...and I'll turn that into enough to get my movie going!

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运了
sense_groups.english: Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我不需要好运 - 我已经想透了
sense_groups.english: I don't need luck. I've thought this through. - I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信 今晚真是糟透了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. This is like the worst night ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你和钱德的关系 有了小小挫折
sense_groups.english: You had a minor setback in your relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 有啥大不了？不过是钱德罢了
sense_groups.english: Big deal. It's only Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们吵架的理由太蠢了
sense_groups.english: This is crazy having such a stupid argument.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不想再跟理查见面
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna see Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就去挽回啊
sense_groups.english: So go fix it.

sense_groups.chinese: 去找钱德 他八成就待在你房间里
sense_groups.english: Find Chandler. He's probably in your room.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他说对不起 说你爱他
sense_groups.english: Tell him sorry and you love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你说的对
sense_groups.english: You're right, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 小意思
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 叫赌城第一名
sense_groups.english: Yeah! Las Vegas! Number one!

sense_groups.chinese: 所有人都失去了这个问题？ - 走出
sense_groups.english: Anybody lose this? - Coming out.

sense_groups.chinese: 下注吧
sense_groups.english: Place your bet.

sense_groups.chinese: 下好离手
sense_groups.english: Dice her out.

sense_groups.chinese: 一赔二 不还本
sense_groups.english: Yellow 11. Pay the front line!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正好要去厕所
sense_groups.english: So, uh, I'm on my way back to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦… 继续走就是了
sense_groups.english: All right, all right. Just keep walking, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你干嘛… 先生 对不起
sense_groups.english: What are you... I am sorry, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 他太喜欢你了
sense_groups.english: I think he just really likes you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道那个老师吗？跟学生生孩子的那个？
sense_groups.english: You know that teacher who had a baby with her student?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小姐 需要我效劳吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Can I help you? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有多的裤子吗？我朋友出了点小状况
sense_groups.english: Do you have any extra pants? Uh, my friend seems to have had a little accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以换百元筹码吗？ - 换百元筹码
sense_groups.english: Can I change 100? - Changing 100.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生 祝您好运 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Good luck, sir. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 全押了
sense_groups.english: That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 13点 - 再来
sense_groups.english: Thirteen. - Hit me!

sense_groups.chinese: 要命
sense_groups.english: Oh, man!

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着
sense_groups.english: Wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 说了你一定不相信
sense_groups.english: You are not gonna believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到我的双胞手了
sense_groups.english: I have found my identical hand twin.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的双胞手啊
sense_groups.english: My identical hand twin!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是双胞手？
sense_groups.english: What's an identical hand twin?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来像什么？有个人的手跟我一模一样
sense_groups.english: It was incredible. The dealer's hands were exactly like mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟照镜子没两样
sense_groups.english: It was like looking at my hands in a mirror!

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定不是在照镜子？
sense_groups.english: You sure you weren't looking at your hands in a mirror?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不懂这件事的意义吗？我大可忘了那部蠢电影
sense_groups.english: Don't you see what this means? I can forget about that stupid movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要变成百万富翁了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be a millionaire!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么变？
sense_groups.english: How?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有完全想出来
sense_groups.english: I don't have it all worked out yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过保证很有赚头 拜托 一模一样的手耶
sense_groups.english: But it's gotta mean big money. Come on, identical hands!

sense_groups.chinese: 我得再问一次
sense_groups.english: Again, I must go back to...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么赚？
sense_groups.english: ...how?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里可是赌城 大家就爱付钱看怪东西
sense_groups.english: This is Vegas, man. People will pay to see freaky stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你愿意付多少钱 看这只手
sense_groups.english: How much would you pay to see this hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 两次？
sense_groups.english: ...twice? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我说不太出个价钱
sense_groups.english: I can't really put a price on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不支持我了？
sense_groups.english: Are you un-supporting me again?

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我百分之百支持你 只是我一时没回过神来
sense_groups.english: I support you 100 percent. I just didn't get it right away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在懂了
sense_groups.english: Now I'm caught up.

sense_groups.chinese: 双胞手
sense_groups.english: Identical hand twins.

sense_groups.chinese: 这点子值上百万
sense_groups.english: It's a million-dollar idea!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Pheebs!

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到我的双胞手了
sense_groups.english: I found my identical hand twin!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真幸运
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're so lucky!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡呢？你们和好没？
sense_groups.english: So where's Monica? Did you guys make up?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啊 - 可是她刚才上来了啊
sense_groups.english: No. - But she just came up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是乔伊
sense_groups.english: That was Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怪了 那她去了哪里？
sense_groups.english: I wonder where she is? It's so weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许在跟理查说话吧
sense_groups.english: She's probably talking to Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有完没完？
sense_groups.english: Would you stop that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他和理查吃完中饭 回来后第一句话是什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what she said after her lunch with Richard?

sense_groups.chinese: 她对他完全没感觉了 她爱的是你
sense_groups.english: She didn't feel anything for him. She loves you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且她很难过 她真的很想跟你和好 你一定得找到她
sense_groups.english: She feels terrible. She really wants to make up. You've gotta find her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真应该开始戴帽子
sense_groups.english: I should really start wearing hats.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎来到赌城
sense_groups.english: Welcome to Las Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 路还愉快吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Did you enjoy your flight? - I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 非常棒
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much. It was excellent.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望您一路愉快 - 太愉快了
sense_groups.english: I hope you had a nice flight. - Oh, it was the best.

questions.name: S05E24
questions.en:
Don't come out here.
I ran into Richard. - Which Richard?
My ex-boyfriend.
This is the worst thing that could happen.
