sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很喜欢吃果仁是吧
sense_groups.english: Really like those macadamia nuts, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不喜欢
sense_groups.english: Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟赌人 走开啦
sense_groups.english: Get out of here, you lurker!

sense_groups.chinese: 滚啦
sense_groups.english: Go on, get!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 - 你们和好了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - You made up.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我没办法一直生他的气
sense_groups.english: I couldn't be mad at him for too long.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有钱德的爱 她不能活
sense_groups.english: She couldn't live without the "Chand love."

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 去开房间啦
sense_groups.english: Get a room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有房间 - 我知道 快去用啊
sense_groups.english: We have one. - I know. Use it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 可得好好照顾你的手
sense_groups.english: That's right. Take good care of those babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？ - 我是乔伊啊
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - It's me. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认识你吗？
sense_groups.english: Do I know you?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊啊
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 秀手的那个
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the hand guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要怎么处理双胞手的事？
sense_groups.english: So, what are we gonna do about this hand twin thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用处理？
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和我拥有上帝的赐礼
sense_groups.english: Look, you and I have been given a gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得要好好利用 好比手部模特或是变魔术
sense_groups.english: We have to do something with it. Like hand modeling. Or magic.

sense_groups.chinese: 太空总署一定也想找我们聊聊
sense_groups.english: And you know NASA's gonna want to talk to us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回去… - 等等…
sense_groups.english: I have to get back to work. - Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以自己组秀
sense_groups.english: We can have our own show.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把手掌合在一起 大家一定超爱看的
sense_groups.english: We can clap our hands together. People will love it!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还替我们写了一首主题曲
sense_groups.english: And I wrote a song for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的手
sense_groups.english: This hand is your hand

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的手
sense_groups.english: This hand is my hand

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 那是你的手才对
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, that's your hand

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 是我的手才对
sense_groups.english: No, wait, it's my hand

sense_groups.chinese: 还是算了 - 你还没听到副歌耶
sense_groups.english: That's okay. - But you haven't even heard the chorus!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在看起来 好像我姑婆茉莉儿
sense_groups.english: I look like my great-aunt, Muriel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么？
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我们用不着下楼
sense_groups.english: We don't have to go downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 房间里就可以是赌城
sense_groups.english: We can bring Vegas up to us.

sense_groups.chinese: 快
sense_groups.english: All right, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来玩黑杰克 来罗
sense_groups.english: We'll play some blackjack. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 13点 - 再加
sense_groups.english: Thirteen. - Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 23 爆了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, 23.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这间赌场23点最大
sense_groups.english: Which is what we play to at this casino!

sense_groups.chinese: 你赢了10美元
sense_groups.english: You win $10!

sense_groups.chinese: 我押了20美元 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I bet 20. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我的小钱钱买双新鞋
sense_groups.english: A new pair of shoes for the Chan-Chan man!

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我这辈子还没看过有这么旺的
sense_groups.english: I've never seen a roll like this!

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 你说对了
sense_groups.english: That's right, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 这次要押几号？
sense_groups.english: What do I want now?

sense_groups.chinese: 8号 还是6号？
sense_groups.english: Eight? Uh, six.

sense_groups.chinese: 选一个啦 你只有这个任务
sense_groups.english: Pick a number! That is your only job.

sense_groups.chinese: 8号 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Eight. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你中了这一把 晚赛就请在场的各位吃牛排
sense_groups.english: If you get this, we buy everybody a steak dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 8号 - 好耶
sense_groups.english: Eight it is. - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的要请他们吃牛排？假的
sense_groups.english: We're not buying steak dinners, are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 那就好
sense_groups.english: No. - Okay, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次要押几号？ - 再硬押个8
sense_groups.english: What do I want now? - Try a hard eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 4加4啦
sense_groups.english: What? - Two fours.

sense_groups.chinese: 8号
sense_groups.english: Eight!

sense_groups.chinese: 千万要把握住她 你太幸运了
sense_groups.english: Don't you let her go. You're a lucky guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 醉赌徒先生
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Mr. Drunken Gambler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果你中了这一把 我们就租下这里最大的套房
sense_groups.english: You get this, and, uh, we get the biggest suite in the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的我们是我和她
sense_groups.english: We get the biggest suite in the place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这里最大的套房来罗
sense_groups.english: The biggest suite in the place!

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 我都忘记我们在吵什么了
sense_groups.english: I love you! I can't remember why we fought.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我和理查吃中饭…
sense_groups.english: Because I had lunch with Rich...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也忘了
sense_groups.english: Me neither!

sense_groups.chinese: 这次要押几号？ - 再硬押次8
sense_groups.english: What now? - Uh, another hard eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 硬押8？简单8才对
sense_groups.english: Hard eight? Let's call it easy eight!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这样吧 如果这次再中…
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what. You roll another hard eight...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今晚就在这里结婚
sense_groups.english: ...and we get married here, tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 快啊…
sense_groups.english: Come on

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up!

sense_groups.chinese: 好戏才正要上场
sense_groups.english: It just got interesting!

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说什么？
sense_groups.english: What did you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 你再赢一次8 我们今晚就在这里结婚
sense_groups.english: You roll another eight, we get married tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是认真的？ - 是啊 我爱你
sense_groups.english: You serious? - Yes. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不曾这样爱过一个人我也不曾爱过你
sense_groups.english: I've never loved anybody as much as I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果再出8就是天意 我们今晚就结婚
sense_groups.english: So if an eight comes up, we take it as a sign and we do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好不好？
sense_groups.english: What do you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧… 8号…
sense_groups.english: Hard eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个是4 另一个呢？
sense_groups.english: That's a four. And where's the other one?

sense_groups.chinese: 掉到桌子底下了 - 通通不许动
sense_groups.english: Under the table. - Nobody move!

sense_groups.chinese: 你找那边 我找这边 好
sense_groups.english: You look that way, I look this way.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里…
sense_groups.english: Here it is, here it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 一半4 一半5
sense_groups.english: That could be 4 or 5.

sense_groups.chinese: 你决定
sense_groups.english: It's your call.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是4
sense_groups.english: It's a four.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也这样觉得
sense_groups.english: I think so too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 又没赢到钱
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, lost again.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我们去外面解决
sense_groups.english: That's it. You and me. Outside!

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不想看到 你美丽的金发少了一撮
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't want you to lose a chunk of that pretty blond hair!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 假装没事…
sense_groups.english: Be cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 女士 你跟赌的日子结束了
sense_groups.english: Okay, your lurking days are over.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 从现在开始 我要抢先你一步
sense_groups.english: What? - Everyone you lurk, I'll lurk first.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你找谁下手 我都会捷足先登
sense_groups.english: You move on, I'll be one step ahead of you...

sense_groups.chinese: 一次都不放过
sense_groups.english: ...every single time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我每天都会紧紧跟着你…
sense_groups.english: And then I'll be on your ass every hour of every day...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到星期一
sense_groups.english: ...till Monday...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我那天要回家
sense_groups.english: ...because that's when I go home.

sense_groups.chinese: 你何时要回家？ - 也是星期一
sense_groups.english: When do you leave? - Also Monday.

sense_groups.chinese: 几点？说不定能共乘计程车
sense_groups.english: What time? Maybe we can share a cab.

sense_groups.chinese: 再加
sense_groups.english: Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 再加
sense_groups.english: Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得再去买牌
sense_groups.english: We need more cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 还要再来点酒 你等等
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and we also need more, um, drinks. Hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？赌城吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Vegas?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还需要酒
sense_groups.english: We would like more alcohol.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 再来点啤酒
sense_groups.english: You know what else? We would like some more beers.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我竟然忘了拨号
sense_groups.english: Oh, I forgot to dial.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是送酒来了
sense_groups.english: That must be our alcohol and beers.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 是乔伊 我爱乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey. - It's Joey! I love Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I love Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊跟鸭子住一起
sense_groups.english: Joey lives with a duck.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们听我说 我需要帮助
sense_groups.english: Look, I need some help, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁去叫我那双胞手合作点
sense_groups.english: Someone has to convince my hand twin to cooperate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去 不管你有什么需要 找我就对了
sense_groups.english: I'll do it. Whatever you need me to do, I'm your man.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Whoa. Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我很好 谢了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Fine. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 我很好 你呢？
sense_groups.english: I'm doing good, baby. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别再让她喝了
sense_groups.english: Don't let her drink anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 是那颗夏威夷果仁
sense_groups.english: Here's that macadamia nut.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 是别的东西 - 糟糕
sense_groups.english: No, something else. - Oops.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你现在要干嘛？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you wanna do now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要离开这房间
sense_groups.english: I wanna get out of the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真想念楼下
sense_groups.english: I really miss downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说 要我离开这个房间 只有一个方法
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? There is only one way I am leaving this hotel room.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Well, hello!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 - 抱歉 先生 你脸上有东西
sense_groups.english: Good luck to you. - Sir, you've got a little something...

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赢了 …我终于赢了
sense_groups.english: I won! I won! I finally won!

sense_groups.chinese: 是我赢才对 那是我的硬币
sense_groups.english: I won! That was my quarter!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 还给你 滚吧
sense_groups.english: Take a hike, toots.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位小姐用我的硬币玩 这是我赢的钱
sense_groups.english: This lady played my quarter. This is my money.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐 真的是这样吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that true, miss?

sense_groups.chinese: 卖毒品给小孩 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Sells drugs to kids. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她卖毒品给小孩
sense_groups.english: She sells drugs to kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的硬币
sense_groups.english: It was my quarter.

sense_groups.chinese: 那硬币是她的吗？
sense_groups.english: Was it her quarter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们等吃晚餐再聊如何？
sense_groups.english: How about we talk about this over dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 小姐 请你出去 - 不 你不能逮捕我
sense_groups.english: Okay, lady, you're out of here. - No, you can't arrest me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要重回火坑
sense_groups.english: I won't go back to that hellhole!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要把你带出去而已
sense_groups.english: I'm just taking you outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 一定要凑齐四样东西 我们才能结婚
sense_groups.english: I need something old, something new, something borrowed and something blue.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是蓝色的 而且也是新的
sense_groups.english: Here's something blue and new.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真有效率 我爱你
sense_groups.english: You are so efficient. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 - 还不行…
sense_groups.english: Let's go. - No, wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还需要旧的东西
sense_groups.english: We need something old.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我皮夹里有个保险套 我从12岁放到现在
sense_groups.english: I have a condom in my wallet that I've had since I was 12.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以用啊
sense_groups.english: That'll work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该不能用了
sense_groups.english: I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 现在只剩借来的东西
sense_groups.english: Now something borrowed.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就把这毛衣拿走 - 这是偷窃耶
sense_groups.english: Here, just take this. - That's stealing.

sense_groups.chinese: 到时再还回来就是了 塞进你的洋装里
sense_groups.english: We'll bring it back. Put it under your dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 先结婚再怀孕
sense_groups.english: Okay. One thing at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要玩吗？ - 不要 我没半毛钱
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna play? - No, I don't really have any money.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是时候未到而已喔
sense_groups.english: Not yet, anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不玩就不能坐在这里
sense_groups.english: Can't sit here if you don't play.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是瑞吉娜佛兰姬
sense_groups.english: Hello. My name is Regina Phalange.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是生意人 这趟是来出差的
sense_groups.english: I'm a businesswoman in town on business.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我的名片吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like to see my card?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的名片夹到哪儿去了？
sense_groups.english: What did I do with my Filofax?

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是忘在B会议室
sense_groups.english: I must've left it in Conference Room B.

sense_groups.chinese: 14点 - 再加
sense_groups.english: Fourteen. - Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我得说两位的手一模一样
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. May I just say that you gentlemen have the exact same hands?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个模子刻出来的
sense_groups.english: They're identical.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在商业界做了这么久 从来没看过这种事
sense_groups.english: I've never seen that in the business world.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再说了
sense_groups.english: Stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 佛兰姬女士 以局外人的身分 我能请教你一个问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Miss Phalange, may I ask you a question as an impartial person at this table?

sense_groups.chinese: 请你别再说了
sense_groups.english: Please stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿不愿意花大钱 去看手掌一模一样的两个人…
sense_groups.english: Wouldn't you pay good money to see identical hands...

sense_groups.chinese: 这种娱乐性的演出？
sense_groups.english: ...showcased in some type of an entertainment venue?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你愿意离开 我就把手砍下来送你
sense_groups.english: If you leave now, I will chop off my hand and give it to you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是才把你赶出去了吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't I just throw you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你赶出去的是菲比
sense_groups.english: No, you threw out Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是瑞吉娜佛兰姬女士
sense_groups.english: I'm Regina Phalange. Phalange.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐 你别闹了
sense_groups.english: Come on, lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你把他也带走
sense_groups.english: Please take him too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我？别这样嘛
sense_groups.english: Me? Oh, come on, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能这样
sense_groups.english: Don't let him do this. Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是你的双胞手耶
sense_groups.english: I'm your hand twin!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 登记结婚
sense_groups.english: Hello. One marriage, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们要结婚
sense_groups.english: We want to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 有婚礼正在进行 先请坐
sense_groups.english: There's a service in progress. Have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是结婚进行曲 听了有没有吓到？
sense_groups.english: The "Wedding March." Does that freak you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 因为那是毕业歌
sense_groups.english: No, it's the graduation song.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我们要结婚了
sense_groups.english: This is it. We're gonna get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定你真的想结婚？
sense_groups.english: You sure you wanna do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗斯太太
sense_groups.english: Hello, Mrs. Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋先生
sense_groups.english: Well, hello, Mr. Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 好
sense_groups.english: Wait. Okay.

questions.en:
Okay, this is it.
You sure you wanna do this?
Hello, Mrs. Ross. Woo-hoo!
Well, hello, Mr. Rachel.
Whoa! - Oh, my God.
Come on, Pheebs, hurry! Hurry, hurry, hurry.
Okay! Okay!
Oh, my God! Is everybody getting married?

sense_groups.english: Yes, you do. This is your third divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道我爱你
sense_groups.english: I know I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也知道我爱你 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: I know I love you. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们还要...
sense_groups.english: Where are we on the whole "going back...

sense_groups.chinese: 回过头去结婚吗？我爱你
sense_groups.english: to where they have the marriages" thing? I love you.

sense_groups.english: That's a good question.

sense_groups.english: Okay? So say, uh...

sense_groups.english: All right. Eight we get married...

sense_groups.english: but 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12, we don't get married.

sense_groups.english: Sounds great. - Okay.

sense_groups.english: Hey, we got a shooter.

sense_groups.chinese: 请押注
sense_groups.english: Money, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了吗？ - 好了

sense_groups.chinese: 来个八吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, eight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们让命运决定

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 你不问就...

sense_groups.english: questions!

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样啦？ - 你说会很好玩

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦

sense_groups.english: Because the radio's broken, and you are selfish, but you have a nice voice.

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔？ - 快唱

sense_groups.chinese: 真是开也开不完
sense_groups.english: Man, this is a long drive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的眼睛有睁开吗？
sense_groups.english: Are my eyes open?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 老公

sense_groups.chinese: 我想找你讨论...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Heh.

sense_groups.english: So we'll just stay married.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会请大家叫我盖勒太太

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is so amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为得加把劲说服你
sense_groups.english: I, uh, really thought I'd have to talk you into this more.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在怕了 因为你好像不是在说笑
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Now I'm scared because I don't actually think you're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是啊
sense_groups.english: I'm not kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我...
sense_groups.english: Look, I... I... Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能有三次失败的婚姻
sense_groups.english: I can't have three failed marriages.

sense_groups.english: I can't, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要当那个人
sense_groups.english: I am not gonna be that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们要永远这样下去？
sense_groups.english: So, what, we just stay married forever?

sense_groups.english: You are asking me to be your wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个小孩踢得好用力

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 说真的 真的很痛

sense_groups.english: Do you like car games?

sense_groups.english: I love the license plate game!

sense_groups.english: Ooh, I'll play. I'll play.

sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.english: but I have an idea that may make you wanna stay married.
Uh...

sense_groups.english: We register...

sense_groups.english: This is a difference of opinion.

sense_groups.english: You can still sleep at night and stuff.

sense_groups.english: You are the master!

sense_groups.english: Go out and come back in!

sense_groups.english: It's an old key! - Oh, my God, it's old.

sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我也没有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 手续办得还顺利吗？
sense_groups.english: So did everything go all right with the annulment?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 都办好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. No problems. It's all taken care of.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Ross, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要不要去看电影？
sense_groups.english: Do you wanna go see a movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, why not? - Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 眼前抗有出
sense_groups.english: Thanks, I've already seen one.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我去穿毛衣 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, I'm gonna get my sweater. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 想不想听一件奇怪的事？
sense_groups.english: You wanna hear something weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Always.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没去办注销
sense_groups.english: I didn't get the annulment.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我们还是夫妻
sense_groups.english: What? - We're still married.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要告诉瑞秋 待会儿见
sense_groups.english: Don't tell Rachel. See you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 钥匙断在钥匙孔里

sense_groups.chinese: 我会修 等下
sense_groups.english: I can fix it. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 让开
sense_groups.english: Watch out, watch out.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是打不开
sense_groups.english: It still doesn't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没弄完 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I'm not finished. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮 你的技术真好
sense_groups.english: Nice job, Joe. You are quite the craftsman.

questions.name: S06E02
questions.en:
Hi. - Hey.
So, uh, did everything go okay with the annulment?
Oh, yeah. No problems. It's all taken care of.
Ross, thank you. - Ah.
You guys want to go see a movie? - Yeah, why not?
Let me get my sweater. - Okay.
Want to hear something weird?
Always.
I didn't get the annulment.
What? - We're still married.
Don't tell Rachel. See you later.
Hey, do you have any gum? - Oh, yeah.
Wait! Wait! Hi. Ross, can I just talk to you for just a second?
Oh, but we'll be late for the movie.
Oh, there's a cab. Taxi!
Oh, that's great.
What timing! My God, huh? There you go.
We're gonna walk. It's right at the Angelika.
Oh, the Angelika! Go! Go!
You didn't get the annulment?
I know. - Ross!
I tried, but when I got to my lawyer's office, all I heard was
"Three divorces! Three divorces!"
I just don't want my tombstone to read "Ross Geller: Three Divorces."
Don't worry about that. Your tombstone can say whatever you want.
It can say, "Ross Geller: Good at Marriage."
You know? Mine's gonna say, "Phoebe Buffay: Buried Alive."
All I know is, I can't have another failed marriage.
So you're gonna be married to a girl who doesn't even know about it?
Woman. Sorry.
Well, okay, so I don't have it all worked out quite yet.
Just don't say anything to Rachel. - Rachel is one of my closest friends.
But being the only one that knows about this makes me feel special. Okay.
Okay, stop, stop! Phoebe?
Hey, Rach!
What was that?
Sorry. Mix-up.
How was the movie?
I haven't seen it yet.
You'd better hurry. The Angelika! Go. Go!
No!
When we move in together, can I get a gumball machine?
Of course. Joey wouldn't let you have one?
No, when it comes to sweets, he's surprisingly strict.
Did you tell him you're moving out?
No, I keep trying. And I can get out "Joey, I have to..."
Then I lose my nerve and I finish with "...go to the bathroom."
He may think I'm sick.
I have to tell Rachel, but I... We just gotta get it over with.
Next time we see them, we'll just tell them. That's it.
That's how it'll work now? You'll just order me around?
Pretty much. - All right.
Hey, Monica. Hey, man, you feeling better?
Joey.
We have something to tell you.
Oh, my God!
You're pregnant!
No! No?
No. - No!
Look, Joe, here's the thing. Um...
Monica and I have decided to live together, here.
So I'm gonna be moving out, man.
Wow.
Oh, uh, hey!
I'm really happy for you guys. Congratulations. See you later.
Joey! Joey! Are you okay? - Yeah.
I gotta go. I've got an acting job.
Like you'd believe that.
This sucks!
I'll be across the hall. And I promise you...
the minute Monica and I break up, I'm moving right back in.
Look, uh, If you're gonna move in with him...
I feel it is my responsibility to tell you the truth about him.
He's a terrible roommate. Terrible.
He, uh, forgets to, um...
He always, he always, uh...
Who am I kidding? He's the best roommate!
Hey, Pheebs. Have you seen Rachel? - Hey.
No, why? - I have some exciting news.
You're pregnant.
No!
Chandler and I are moving in together.
Oh, that's good!
But if you were pregnant, what would you name it? Hint, Phoebe.
Hey. - Hey.
What's up? - Well, um...
Chandler and I are moving in together.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my little sister and my best friend...
shacking up.
That's great. That's great. Mwah.
Guys, I'm happy too. - Okay, come here.
Big day, huh? People moving in. People getting annulled.
I gotta go find Rachel. But, um...
If you see her, give her some really bad news, so mine doesn't seem so bad.
Okay, bye.
Hmm. Something bad to tell Rachel.
Bad news for Rachel. What could that be?
Can you just lay off, please?
My life is an embarrassment. I should just go live under somebody's stairs.
It's not that big a deal. You'll have been divorced three times.
You'll have a life, you'll date...
No, I won't. I'll be at the bottom of the dating barrel now.
The only guys below me will be Four-Divorce Guy...
uh, Murderer Guy...
and geologists.
Ross, you're being ridiculous. You are cute and smart and sweet.
That is much more important than three stupid divorces.
Have you dated anyone who's been divorced three times?
That's not fair. Most guys that have been divorced three times are 60.
Nobody cares about this except you.
This embarrassment thing is all in your head.
Here, I'll show you. Come here. - What?
Hi. My friend Ross is about to be divorced for the third time.
But wouldn't you date him?
And if you wait right here, I'll go get Ross.
Hey. - Agh. Thought you were Rachel.
What gave me away? - I gotta tell her.
Get it over with. I told Ross and Phoebe. She's the only one left.
It's official. We're moving in together.
No turning back.
Are you scared? Are you?
No.
That was my scariest voice. You're brave.
Hey. Ugh. - Hey.
The worst day.
You're finally making progress at work, then your boss calls you Racquel.
First four years of my work, they called me...
Seriously. - I believe you.
It was in the middle of a meeting, so no one wants to correct her.
So everyone's calling me Racquel.
By the end of the day, the mailroom guys were calling me Rocky.
Well, I still think you're very, very nice and very pretty.
What?
All yours, babe.
Rachel, come here.
Have a seat.
Okay.
Listen, um, Chandler and I...
are going to live together.
Here.
Oh, my God.
That's so great!
I'm so happy for you guys!
Really?
And that was so sweet of you to ask.
The three of us are gonna have such a good time living together!
Yes, we are.
Chandler, you'll have to watch those long showers you take...
because you know Racquel can't be late.
Rach. - He'll work on that.
Oh. Aw, this is so exciting!
Oh, wow.
Come and knock on our door
We'll be waiting for you
See? Once you know the stories, it's not that bad.
First marriage: Wife's hidden sexuality. Not my fault.
Second marriage: Said the wrong name at the altar.
A little my fault.
Third marriage: They shouldn't let you get married...
when you're drunk and have writing on your face.
Nevada's fault.
So, what do you think, ladies? Who wouldn't want to date him?
The divorces don't bother me. I'd date him.
But not while he's still married.
And you, wouldn't you want a date?
I'm not dating at all anymore.
I was only dating guys that were bad for me.
So I decided that until I work that...
Good. Good. Whatever.
What about you, Meg?
Well, I don't care about the divorces either.
But I wouldn't date him.
It's just that he's obviously still in love with this Rachel girl.
What?
She said, "He's obviously still in love with this Rachel girl."
This is crazy. I mean, yes, Rachel is my good friend.
And I have loved her in the past...
but now, she is just my wife.
Phoebe, will you help me out here?
Well, I thought you loved her when you married her.
We were drunk! I would've married Joey with that amount of alcohol.
Hey! You could do a lot worse than Joey Tribbiani!
I'm sorry, but you guys are wrong.
I just don't want to be divorced three times.
Yes, and now he's using this three-divorces reason...
because he wants to stay married to her because he loves her.
I must say, well done. Bravo, Meg.
Okay, fine. If this is what you think...
forget about the whole three-divorce thing.
I'll go to my lawyer's office right now and get this marriage annulled. Okay?
She means nothing to me.
Noth... Nothing!
Okay, now I wouldn't date you because you seem a little creepy.
I am so attracted to him right now.
When will we tell Rachel what actually will happen?
Soon.
I just couldn't before. You saw how upset Joey got.
I couldn't do it. She's my best friend.
Joey's my best friend.
I'm not your best friend?
You just said...!
Ugh.
Of course, you're my best friend.
Would you tell Rachel?
All right. At least I'm prepared. - Okay.
Oh, yes. - Hey!
Hey, hey.
They're not for you. Are you upset? - I am now.
Hey, roomie.
Okay, bye.
Rach. Ahem.
There's something, um, important I have to tell you.
Are you pregnant?
No, but I'm throwing this shirt away.
I think there was a little misunderstanding before.
Mm-hm. - Um...
When I said that, uh, Chandler and I wanted to live together...
we meant alone together.
Oh, my God. That's funny. I can't believe I did that.
No, sweetie. You know what? This is my fault.
I wasn't clear.
I'm really sorry.
Listen, you take as much time as you need to move out, okay?
There's absolutely no rush.
Okay.
Don't you want a cookie?
Sure.
Thanks.
Do you need a tissue?
Mm-hm.
Where did you get these? - I made them.
Oh, God, they're so yummy!
It's gonna be weird when I come home and you're not here.
No more Joey and Chan's.
No more J and C's.
Want to go to Joey and Chandler's? Can't. It's not there.
I'll be across the hall. We can still do all the same stuff.
We won't be able in the night and have those long talks...
about our feelings and the future.
Not once did we do that.
Hi. - Hey.
So I told Rachel that it's just gonna be the two of us.
Oh, yeah? Well, how'd she take it?
Really well. Yeah.
Surprisingly well.
She didn't cry. She wasn't angry or sad.
And you're upset because you didn't make your best friend cry?
All I'm asking for is a little emotion.
Is that too much to ask after six years?
What, are Rachel and I not as close as you guys?
I mean, did we not have as much fun? Don't I deserve a few tears?
When we told Joey, he cried his eyes out.
Hey! I did not cry my eyes out!
Come on, it's like the end of an era.
No more J-Man and Channy's!
Okay, I gotta ask, who calls us that?
You got married again?
Yes.
So that's your second marriage in two years?
Yes. Second in two years.
Third, overall.
I have been a divorce attorney for 23 years...
and never have I had so much business from one client.
Why don't you tell me what happened?
Basically, Rachel and I were in Vegas, and we got drunk.
I'm sorry, is this the same Rachel whose name you said...
at the altar in the second marriage?
Yes, yes, yes. Heh.
But I do not love her.
Oh.
That's better then.
This was just a drunken mistake, and I need to get it annulled.
I see.
Have you considered therapy?
I think just the annulment for today.
There are some forms to fill out. - Easy.
We'll need witnesses who can testify that you were not of sound mind.
No problem. Heh.
We'll need you and Rachel to testify before a judge.
Ooh.
There's no way to do this without her?
Because I kind of already told her it was taken care of.
Of course you did.
Look, you can't get an annulment unless you and Rachel are both there.
Uh-huh.
What about someone who looks like Rachel?
I will think about the therapy.
Hey. - Hey.
So, um, I was thinking that maybe we should start dividing up our stuff.
Okay.
No point in dragging it out.
Dragging out the long process of you moving out...
and us not living together anymore.
Okay.
Hey, Rach. - Yeah?
What about this? Who gets this?
I don't know if I want it because it might be too many memories.
What is that? - I don't know.
Rachel.
How about this? I want you to have the big plate.
Wow, Monica, thanks. I love this plate.
Something to remember me by.
Mon, you're not dying. I'm just moving out.
We're gonna see each other all the time.
But still, it's a big change.
The end of an era, you might say.
Are you okay? You're not blinking.
I'm fine. I was thinking about how it's an end of an era.
Oh, all right.
But I gotta say, I don't think six years counts as an era.
An era is defined as a significant period of time.
It was significant for me. Maybe it wasn't significant to you!
What is the matter with you? - What is the matter with you?
Why aren't you more upset?
Aren't you gonna be sad that we're not living together?
Aren't you gonna miss me at all?
Monica, all right. But don't get mad at me.
It's just a little hard to believe.
What's hard to believe?
I mean, it's you guys. You do this kind of stuff, you know?
You were gonna get married in Vegas, and then you backed out.
I'm not upset because I don't see you going through with it. I'm sorry.
Rachel.
It's going to happen.
Chandler is gonna move in here.
But I... - No, wait. Just let me finish, okay?
This isn't something that we just impulsively decided to do in Vegas.
This is something that we both really want.
And it is going to happen.
It is?
Really?
Yeah, sweetie.
You mean, we're not gonna live together anymore?
No.
Well...
Oh, my God. I'm gonna miss you so much.
I'm gonna miss you.
I mean, it's the end of an era!
I know!
Okay, bye. - Oh, no.
So did you get the annulment?
I couldn't. - I knew it. Because you love Rachel.
It's not that. Annulments are more complicated...
Complicated because of the love.
I do not love Rachel.
I'm telling her about the whole thing...
so we can get this marriage annulled as fast as possible.
Would I do that if I loved her?
I've never been more convinced of your love for her.
I do not have feelings for Rachel, okay?
Oh, what's wrong?
Monica and Chandler are moving in here...
and I have to move out and everything is changing.
Oh, my, come here, come here. It's okay.
Aw, everything's gonna be okay.
Thank you.
Of course.
So Ross and Rachel got married.
Monica and Chandler almost got married.
You think you and I should hook up?
Oh, we do. Ha, ha.
But not just yet.
Really? Well, when?
Okay. Um.
Ahem, well, first Chandler and Monica will get married...
and be filthy rich, by the way.
But it won't work out. - Wow.
I know.
Then I'm gonna marry Chandler for the money.
And you'll marry Rachel and have the beautiful kids.
Great.
But then we ditch those two and we get married.
We'll have Chandler's money and Rachel's kids.
Getting custody will be easy because of Rachel's drinking problem.
Ooh, ooh, what about Ross?
I don't want to go into the whole thing, but, um...
we have words and I kill him.

sense_groups.english: Woman. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没想好要怎么做
sense_groups.english: Well, okay, so I don't have it all worked out quite yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你先别告诉瑞秋 - 瑞秋是我最要好的朋友之一
sense_groups.english: Just don't say anything to Rachel. - Rachel is one of my closest friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过当唯一知情的人威觉不赖 好吧
sense_groups.english: But being the only one that knows about this makes me feel special. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 停车 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Okay, stop, stop! Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在搞什么？
sense_groups.english: What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 弄错了
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Mix-up.

sense_groups.chinese: 电影好看吗？
sense_groups.english: How was the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没看
sense_groups.english: I haven't seen it yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就要快了 安洁丽戏院 开车
sense_groups.english: You'd better hurry. The Angelika! Go. Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 等我们同居 我可以买一台泡泡糖机吗？
sense_groups.english: When we move in together, can I get a gumball machine?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 乔伊不让你买？
sense_groups.english: Of course. Joey wouldn't let you have one?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他对甜食要求特别严
sense_groups.english: No, when it comes to sweets, he's surprisingly strict.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想好要怎么说了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you tell him you're moving out?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 我试了好几次 只能说出"乔伊 我得..."
sense_groups.english: No, I keep trying. And I can get out "Joey, I have to..."

sense_groups.chinese: 然后就退缩改说 "去上厕所"
sense_groups.english: Then I lose my nerve and I finish with "...go to the bathroom."

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能以为我有病
sense_groups.english: He may think I'm sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的得告诉瑞秋了... 早死早超生
sense_groups.english: I have to tell Rachel, but I... We just gotta get it over with.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次见到他们 我们就说 就这么决定
sense_groups.english: Next time we see them, we'll just tell them. That's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 以后你都要这样指使我是吧？
sense_groups.english: That's how it'll work now? You'll just order me around?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多 - 好
sense_groups.english: Pretty much. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡 你有没有好一点？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica. Hey, man, you feeling better?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有事要说
sense_groups.english: We have something to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怀孕了
sense_groups.english: You're pregnant!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 没有吧？
sense_groups.english: No! No?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 - 没有
sense_groups.english: No. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 是这样的...
sense_groups.english: Look, Joe, here's the thing. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和我决定在这里同居
sense_groups.english: Monica and I have decided to live together, here.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我会搬出来
sense_groups.english: So I'm gonna be moving out, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真替你们高兴 恭喜 回见
sense_groups.english: I'm really happy for you guys. Congratulations. See you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 乔伊 你还好吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Joey! Joey! Are you okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我得走了 我有戏要演
sense_groups.english: I gotta go. I've got an acting job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会信才怪
sense_groups.english: Like you'd believe that.

sense_groups.chinese: 讨厌啦
sense_groups.english: This sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要搬到对面 我保证...
sense_groups.english: I'll be across the hall. And I promise you...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和我一分手 我就回去跟你住
sense_groups.english: the minute Monica and I break up, I'm moving right back in.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果你要跟他住...
sense_groups.english: Look, uh, If you're gonna move in with him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有责任揭穿他的真面目
sense_groups.english: I feel it is my responsibility to tell you the truth about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个很烂的室友
sense_groups.english: He's a terrible roommate. Terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会忘记...
sense_groups.english: He, uh, forgets to, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 他老是...
sense_groups.english: He always, he always, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我骗谁啊？他最棒了
sense_groups.english: Who am I kidding? He's the best roommate!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你有看到瑞秋吗？ - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. Have you seen Rachel? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 怎么？ - 我有个好消息
sense_groups.english: No, why? - I have some exciting news.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怀孕了
sense_groups.english: You're pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和我决定同居
sense_groups.english: Chandler and I are moving in together.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's good!

sense_groups.chinese: 不过如果你有宝宝要叫什么？提示 菲比
sense_groups.english: But if you were pregnant, what would you name it? Hint, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？ - 嗯...
sense_groups.english: What's up? - Well, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和我要住在一起
sense_groups.english: Chandler and I are moving in together.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妹妹和我的死党...
sense_groups.english: Oh, my little sister and my best friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 搞在一起
sense_groups.english: shacking up.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: That's great. That's great. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 我也很高兴 - 好 起来
sense_groups.english: Guys, I'm happy too. - Okay, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真热闹 有人要同居 有人办注销
sense_groups.english: Big day, huh? People moving in. People getting annulled.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去找瑞秋了 不过...
sense_groups.english: I gotta go find Rachel. But, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能不能先灌些坏消息给她 减轻一些冲击？
sense_groups.english: If you see her, give her some really bad news, so mine doesn't seem so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 讲给瑞秋听的坏消息
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Something bad to tell Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是她的坏消息？
sense_groups.english: Bad news for Rachel. What could that be?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能别再提了？
sense_groups.english: Can you just lay off, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的人生很难堪 我应该去住在别人的楼梯底下
sense_groups.english: My life is an embarrassment. I should just go live under somebody's stairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 根本没那么严重 离婚三次又怎样？
sense_groups.english: It's not that big a deal. You'll have been divorced three times.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是会有生活 会约会...
sense_groups.english: You'll have a life, you'll date...

sense_groups.chinese: 才不会 我的约会指数降到谷底
sense_groups.english: No, I won't. I'll be at the bottom of the dating barrel now.

sense_groups.chinese: 比我低的只有离婚四次的人
sense_groups.english: The only guys below me will be Four-Divorce Guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 杀人犯...
sense_groups.english: uh, Murderer Guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 和地质学家
sense_groups.english: and geologists.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你别傻了 你可爱 聪明又体贴
sense_groups.english: Ross, you're being ridiculous. You are cute and smart and sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 这比离婚三次重要多了
sense_groups.english: That is much more important than three stupid divorces.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？你交过离婚三次的男朋友吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you dated anyone who's been divorced three times?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样问不公平 离三次婚的人通常都六十了
sense_groups.english: That's not fair. Most guys that have been divorced three times are 60.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有你自己在意
sense_groups.english: Nobody cares about this except you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么难堪都是你在想像
sense_groups.english: This embarrassment thing is all in your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我证明给你看 过来 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Here, I'll show you. Come here. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我朋友罗斯即将三度离婚
sense_groups.english: Hi. My friend Ross is about to be divorced for the third time.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们会和他约会吧？
sense_groups.english: But wouldn't you date him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们稍候 我去找罗斯来
sense_groups.english: And if you wait right here, I'll go get Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 我还以为你是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Agh. Thought you were Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪里露出破绽了？ - 我得赶快告诉她
sense_groups.english: What gave me away? - I gotta tell her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经告诉罗斯和菲比 只剩她了
sense_groups.english: Get it over with. I told Ross and Phoebe. She's the only one left.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以大家都知道了 我们确定要同居了
sense_groups.english: It's official. We're moving in together.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能反悔
sense_groups.english: No turning back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怕吗？怕吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you scared? Are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不怕
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我最可怕的声音 你真勇敢
sense_groups.english: That was my scariest voice. You're brave.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. Ugh. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真惨
sense_groups.english: The worst day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为自己终于受重视了 结果老板却叫你拉壳儿
sense_groups.english: You're finally making progress at work, then your boss calls you Racquel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我进公司前四年 大家都叫我...
sense_groups.english: First four years of my work, they called me...

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的 - 我相信
sense_groups.english: Seriously. - I believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当时正在开员工大会 当然不会有人纠正她
sense_groups.english: It was in the middle of a meeting, so no one wants to correct her.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是大家都叫我拉壳儿
sense_groups.english: So everyone's calling me Racquel.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了下班前 收发室的人已经叫成洛基了
sense_groups.english: By the end of the day, the mailroom guys were calling me Rocky.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是觉得你很好很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Well, I still think you're very, very nice and very pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 交给你了
sense_groups.english: All yours, babe.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 过来
sense_groups.english: Rachel, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐
sense_groups.english: Have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 钱德和我...
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, Chandler and I...

sense_groups.chinese: 要一起住
sense_groups.english: are going to live together.

sense_groups.chinese: 住在这里
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真替你们高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm so happy for you guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好 还先问我
sense_groups.english: And that was so sweet of you to ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我们三个 在一起一定会很开心
sense_groups.english: The three of us are gonna have such a good time living together!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yes, we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你早上不能慢慢冲澡了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you'll have to watch those long showers you take...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为拉壳儿不能迟到
sense_groups.english: because you know Racquel can't be late.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 他会注意的
sense_groups.english: Rach. - He'll work on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好兴奋喔
sense_groups.english: Oh. Aw, this is so exciting!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 来敲我的门
sense_groups.english: Come and knock on our door

sense_groups.chinese: 我们等着你
sense_groups.english: We'll be waiting for you

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 一旦知道内情 就没那么糟了
sense_groups.english: See? Once you know the stories, it's not that bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次 老婆隐瞒性向 不是我的错
sense_groups.english: First marriage: Wife's hidden sexuality. Not my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二次 宣誓时叫错人
sense_groups.english: Second marriage: Said the wrong name at the altar.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点点是我的错
sense_groups.english: A little my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 第三次 他们不让你结婚
sense_groups.english: Third marriage: They shouldn't let you get married...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么能让脸上涂鸦的醉鬼结婚？
sense_groups.english: when you're drunk and have writing on your face.

sense_groups.chinese: 内华达州的错
sense_groups.english: Nevada's fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得怎样？谁会没兴趣？谁会不想和他约会？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you think, ladies? Who wouldn't want to date him?

sense_groups.chinese: 离婚无所谓 我会和他约会
sense_groups.english: The divorces don't bother me. I'd date him.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他得先恢复自由身
sense_groups.english: But not while he's still married.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？你也想吧？
sense_groups.english: And you, wouldn't you want a date?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我再也不约会了
sense_groups.english: I'm not dating at all anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老是看上对我不好的男人
sense_groups.english: I was only dating guys that were bad for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我解决这个...
sense_groups.english: So I decided that until I work that...

sense_groups.chinese: 随便啦
sense_groups.english: Good. Good. Whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 梅格 你呢？
sense_groups.english: What about you, Meg?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不在意离婚的事
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't care about the divorces either.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不会和他约会
sense_groups.english: But I wouldn't date him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他显然还爱着这个瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's just that he's obviously still in love with this Rachel girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说"他显然还爱着这个瑞秋"
sense_groups.english: She said, "He's obviously still in love with this Rachel girl."

sense_groups.chinese: 这话太扯了 没错 瑞秋是我的好朋友
sense_groups.english: This is crazy. I mean, yes, Rachel is my good friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我过去确实爱过她...
sense_groups.english: And I have loved her in the past...

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在她只是我的妻子
sense_groups.english: but now, she is just my wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 帮我说句话好吗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, will you help me out here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你娶她时我也以为你爱她
sense_groups.english: Well, I thought you loved her when you married her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们喝醉了 喝那么多我连乔伊都会娶
sense_groups.english: We were drunk! I would've married Joey with that amount of alcohol.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 比乔伊?崔比亚尼烂的人多得是
sense_groups.english: Hey! You could do a lot worse than Joey Tribbiani!

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 但是你们错了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, but you guys are wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不想离三次婚
sense_groups.english: I just don't want to be divorced three times.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 他以此为藉口不想离婚
sense_groups.english: Yes, and now he's using this three-divorces reason...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他爱她
sense_groups.english: because he wants to stay married to her because he loves her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须说:梅格 干得好
sense_groups.english: I must say, well done. Bravo, Meg.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果你们这么想...
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. If this is what you think...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就不管了
sense_groups.english: forget about the whole three-divorce thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就去找律师办注销
sense_groups.english: I'll go to my lawyer's office right now and get this marriage annulled. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我一点也不爱她
sense_groups.english: She means nothing to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不爱
sense_groups.english: Noth... Nothing!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是你的神经质让我发毛
sense_groups.english: Okay, now I wouldn't date you because you seem a little creepy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我突然觉得他好有魅力
sense_groups.english: I am so attracted to him right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们什么时候要跟瑞秋说实话？
sense_groups.english: When will we tell Rachel what actually will happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 快了
sense_groups.english: Soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才说不出口 你也看到乔伊多难过
sense_groups.english: I just couldn't before. You saw how upset Joey got.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不忍心伤害我最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: I couldn't do it. She's my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊也是我最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Joey's my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm not your best friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己刚才说...
sense_groups.english: You just said...!

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然是
sense_groups.english: Of course, you're my best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 但请你告诉瑞秋 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you tell Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 至少我现在有准备 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. At least I'm prepared. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes. - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是给你的 你有不开心吗？ - 现在有了
sense_groups.english: They're not for you. Are you upset? - I am now.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 室友
sense_groups.english: Hey, roomie.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有重要的事要告诉你
sense_groups.english: There's something, um, important I have to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怀孕了？
sense_groups.english: Are you pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但我要扔掉这件衣服
sense_groups.english: No, but I'm throwing this shirt away.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才有一些误会
sense_groups.english: I think there was a little misunderstanding before.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼 - 唔...
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. - Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我说钱德和我想住在一起
sense_groups.english: When I said that, uh, Chandler and I wanted to live together...

sense_groups.chinese: 意思是只有我们两个人
sense_groups.english: we meant alone together.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 真好笑 我居然会误会
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. That's funny. I can't believe I did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是我不好
sense_groups.english: No, sweetie. You know what? This is my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没说清楚
sense_groups.english: I wasn't clear.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm really sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以慢慢找房子
sense_groups.english: Listen, you take as much time as you need to move out, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不用急
sense_groups.english: There's absolutely no rush.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不吃饼干吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't you want a cookie?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要面纸吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you need a tissue?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是哪里的饼干？ - 我做的
sense_groups.english: Where did you get these? - I made them.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 真好吃
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, they're so yummy!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 回到家你人却不在 感觉一定会很奇怪
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be weird when I come home and you're not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有乔伊和钱德家了
sense_groups.english: No more Joey and Chan's.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有乔和钱家了
sense_groups.english: No more J and C's.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要去乔伊和钱德家？不行 已经不在了
sense_groups.english: Want to go to Joey and Chandler's? Can't. It's not there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是搬到对面 我们还是可以跟以前一样
sense_groups.english: I'll be across the hall. We can still do all the same stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 但以后就不能半夜起来
sense_groups.english: We won't be able in the night and have those long talks...

sense_groups.chinese: 促膝长谈感觉和未来了
sense_groups.english: about our feelings and the future.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一次也没做过
sense_groups.english: Not once did we do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉瑞秋我们要自己住了
sense_groups.english: So I told Rachel that it's just gonna be the two of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？她还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Well, how'd she take it?

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好
sense_groups.english: Really well. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 令人意外的好
sense_groups.english: Surprisingly well.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有哭 也没有生气或难过
sense_groups.english: She didn't cry. She wasn't angry or sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很不爽没把手帕交弄哭？
sense_groups.english: And you're upset because you didn't make your best friend cry?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只求一点真情流露
sense_groups.english: All I'm asking for is a little emotion.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们六年室友耶
sense_groups.english: Is that too much to ask after six years?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没你们要好吗？没你们开心吗？
sense_groups.english: What, are Rachel and I not as close as you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不值得她掉几滴泪吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, did we not have as much fun? Don't I deserve a few tears?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊一听到就哭得死去活来
sense_groups.english: When we told Joey, he cried his eyes out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我才没有哭得死去活来
sense_groups.english: Hey! I did not cry my eyes out!

sense_groups.chinese: 这就像一个时代的结束
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's like the end of an era.

sense_groups.chinese: 再也没有乔兄和钱哥了
sense_groups.english: No more J-Man and Channy's!

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定要问 有谁那样叫我们？
sense_groups.english: Okay, I gotta ask, who calls us that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你又结婚了？
sense_groups.english: You got married again?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你两年内第二次结婚
sense_groups.english: So that's your second marriage in two years?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 两年两次
sense_groups.english: Yes. Second in two years.

sense_groups.chinese: 总共三次
sense_groups.english: Third, overall.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我当了二十三年离婚律师
sense_groups.english: I have been a divorce attorney for 23 years...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有一个客户比你捧场
sense_groups.english: and never have I had so much business from one client.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我怎么回事
sense_groups.english: Why don't you tell me what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 基本上 瑞秋和我在赌城 我们喝醉了
sense_groups.english: Basically, Rachel and I were in Vegas, and we got drunk.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 她就是你上次结婚
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, is this the same Rachel whose name you said...

sense_groups.chinese: 叫错的那个瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: at the altar in the second marriage?
Yes, yes, yes. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我并不爱她
sense_groups.english: But I do not love her.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就好多了
sense_groups.english: That's better then.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是酒醉犯错 我要办注销
sense_groups.english: This was just a drunken mistake, and I need to get it annulled.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了
sense_groups.english: I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 你考虑过接受治疗吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you considered therapy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想今天办注销就好了
sense_groups.english: I think just the annulment for today.

sense_groups.chinese: 要填几份表格 - 简单
sense_groups.english: There are some forms to fill out. - Easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 必须有证人证明 你们当时神智不清
sense_groups.english: We'll need witnesses who can testify that you were not of sound mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: No problem. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和瑞秋得向法官说明
sense_groups.english: We'll need you and Rachel to testify before a judge.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能不找她吗？
sense_groups.english: There's no way to do this without her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经告诉她事情都办妥了
sense_groups.english: Because I kind of already told her it was taken care of.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然这么说
sense_groups.english: Of course you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你和瑞秋都在场 才能办理注销
sense_groups.english: Look, you can't get an annulment unless you and Rachel are both there.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那找一个长得像瑞秋的人呢？
sense_groups.english: What about someone who looks like Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会考虑接受治疗
sense_groups.english: I will think about the therapy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们应该开始分东西了
sense_groups.english: So, um, I was thinking that maybe we should start dividing up our stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没必要拖拖拉拉的
sense_groups.english: No point in dragging it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你搬走
sense_groups.english: Dragging out the long process of you moving out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们分开的事
sense_groups.english: and us not living together anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个要归谁？
sense_groups.english: What about this? Who gets this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我想不想要 它有太多回忆
sense_groups.english: I don't know if I want it because it might be too many memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What is that? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 大盘子呢？我要你留着大盘子
sense_groups.english: How about this? I want you to have the big plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我很喜欢这个盘子
sense_groups.english: Wow, Monica, thanks. I love this plate.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样你就会记得我
sense_groups.english: Something to remember me by.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不是快死了 我只是要搬出去
sense_groups.english: Mon, you're not dying. I'm just moving out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还是会常常见面
sense_groups.english: We're gonna see each other all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这是个大转变
sense_groups.english: But still, it's a big change.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至是一个时代的结束
sense_groups.english: The end of an era, you might say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？眼睛都没眨
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? You're not blinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好 我只是在想一个时代要结束了
sense_groups.english: I'm fine. I was thinking about how it's an end of an era.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 但老实说 六年应该称不上一个时代
sense_groups.english: But I gotta say, I don't think six years counts as an era.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个时代就是一段重要的日子
sense_groups.english: An era is defined as a significant period of time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得重要 或许你不觉得重要
sense_groups.english: It was significant for me. Maybe it wasn't significant to you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么了？ - 你才怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you? - What is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么没有更不开心？
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you more upset?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要分开了你不难过吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you gonna be sad that we're not living together?

sense_groups.chinese: 你都不会想我吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you gonna miss me at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 说出来你别生气
sense_groups.english: Monica, all right. But don't get mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有点难以相信
sense_groups.english: It's just a little hard to believe.

sense_groups.chinese: 难以相信什么？
sense_groups.english: What's hard to believe?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们啊 你们就是这样
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's you guys. You do this kind of stuff, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在赌城说要结婚 又不结了
sense_groups.english: You were gonna get married in Vegas, and then you backed out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我并不认为你们会真的同居 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm not upset because I don't see you going through with it. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情已经确定了
sense_groups.english: It's going to happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德会搬进来
sense_groups.english: Chandler is gonna move in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我... - 你先听我说完
sense_groups.english: But I... - No, wait. Just let me finish, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是在赌城的一时冲动
sense_groups.english: This isn't something that we just impulsively decided to do in Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的想要住在一起
sense_groups.english: This is something that we both really want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会住在一起
sense_groups.english: And it is going to happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: It is?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能再住在一起了？
sense_groups.english: You mean, we're not gonna live together anymore?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行了
sense_groups.english: No.
Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我会好想你
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm gonna miss you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个时代的结束
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's the end of an era!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 又来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去办注销了吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you get the annulment?

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不了 - 我就知道 因为你爱瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I couldn't. - I knew it. Because you love Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那样的 事情比想像中复杂...
sense_groups.english: It's not that. Annulments are more complicated...

sense_groups.chinese: 爱让它变得复杂
sense_groups.english: Complicated because of the love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不爱瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I do not love Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就去告诉她
sense_groups.english: I'm telling her about the whole thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 好尽快把手续办好
sense_groups.english: so we can get this marriage annulled as fast as possible.

sense_groups.chinese: 我如果爱她会这么做吗？
sense_groups.english: Would I do that if I loved her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在更确信你爱她
sense_groups.english: I've never been more convinced of your love for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对瑞秋没有感觉 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I do not have feelings for Rachel, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和钱德真的要同居了
sense_groups.english: Monica and Chandler are moving in here...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得搬出去 一切都要变了
sense_groups.english: and I have to move out and everything is changing.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 别难过
sense_groups.english: Oh, my, come here, come here. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有事的
sense_groups.english: Aw, everything's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯和瑞秋结婚了
sense_groups.english: So Ross and Rachel got married.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和钱德差点结婚
sense_groups.english: Monica and Chandler almost got married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要不要试试？
sense_groups.english: You think you and I should hook up?

sense_groups.chinese: 要
sense_groups.english: Oh, we do. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不是现在
sense_groups.english: But not just yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？那是什么时候？
sense_groups.english: Really? Well, when?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Um.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 钱德和摩妮卡会结婚
sense_groups.english: Ahem, well, first Chandler and Monica will get married...

sense_groups.chinese: 还会发大财
sense_groups.english: and be filthy rich, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 但婚姻会破裂 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: But it won't work out. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我会为钱嫁给钱德
sense_groups.english: Then I'm gonna marry Chandler for the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会娶瑞秋生几个漂亮小孩
sense_groups.english: And you'll marry Rachel and have the beautiful kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 接着我们就抛弃他们结婚
sense_groups.english: But then we ditch those two and we get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会有钱德的财产 瑞秋的孩子
sense_groups.english: We'll have Chandler's money and Rachel's kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 监护权很好抢 因为瑞秋酗酒
sense_groups.english: Getting custody will be easy because of Rachel's drinking problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 那罗斯呢？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh, what about Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想多说 不过...
sense_groups.english: I don't want to go into the whole thing, but, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们吵架 我杀了他
sense_groups.english: we have words and I kill him.

questions.name: S06E03
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey, check it out. This is unbelievable.
Joey has been holding his breath for almost four minutes.
Are you trying to kill me?
Pheebs, I wanna ask you something. - Uh-huh, what?
Um, well, since I'm moving out and you're so beautiful...
how about I move in with you?
Well, that would be great, but then what do we do about Denise?
Who's Denise? - My roommate.
You have a roommate? - Yes, Denise. Denise.
Hey, what is with the secrecy, Phoebe? Huh?
And what about this Denise? She cute?
How can you have a roommate that none of us know about?
Maybe because you never listen to anything I say.
I talk about her all the time. Denise!
Rach, I was thinking, I'm gonna have an extra room over at my place.
Oh, that's true. - Why don't you move in with me?
It'll be great. We can stay up late talking, watch movies.
And you know about naked Thursdays, right?
Yeah, yeah, I think I'm gonna find my own place.
Hey, hey. I thought naked Thursdays was just our thing, man.
Hey. - Hey.
What did Rachel say when you told her you were still married to her?
Oh, that. Um, she took it really well.
Oh. You didn't tell her, did you? - No.
Because you're in love with her. - I am not in love with her.
She was very upset about having to move out.
So I didn't tell her we were still married, because she'd only get more upset.
I comforted her. As a friend.
What do you mean, "comforted her"? - It was nothing. I gave her a hug.
Aha. A classic sign of love, the hug.
It's also a sign of friendship.
Yeah, not in your case, Lovey Loverson.
It was a hug.
Just tell me this, did you or did you not smell her hair?
Smell her hair? Well, what if I did?
Ninety percent of a woman's pheromones come out the top of her head.
That's why women are shorter.
So that men will fall in love when they hug them.
Come on, Ross, you're a scientist.
I was hugging her as a friend, okay?
It's not my fault her hair got in my face.
She's got a lot of it, and it smells all, uh...
you know, coconutty.
What? Oh. It doesn't mean I have feelings for Rachel.
Maybe it means I have feelings for coconuts.
Okay, whatever you say. But just be careful. Rachel's not in the same place you are.
Okay, if the place you're referring to is being in love...
then she is in the same place as me, because I am not in that place.
Okay, I didn't understand that.
But maybe that's because you were speaking the secret language of love.
Hey. - Hey.
Dude, some guy just called for you. - Who was it?
I don't know.
How about "Thanks for taking the message"? Jeez.
Hey, listen.
When you move in, Rachel's room's gonna be empty.
You wanna talk about what we wanna do with it?
Sure. - Okay.
I think we should have a beautiful guest room...
with a mahogany sleigh bed and bedside tables with flowers on them.
Then we could have a rolltop desk with comment cards...
so people can tell us how much they love staying here.
Whatever, you know, I really haven't thought about it that much.
Well, I like that idea, obviously. Ha, ha.
But I was thinking maybe it could be a game room, you know?
I mean, you can buy old arcade games...
like "Space Invaders" and "Asteroids" for $200.
The real ones. The big, big, big ones.
No.
Okay, so you mean "no" as in, "Gee, Chandler, what an interesting idea.
Let's discuss it before we reject it completely."
Oh. I'm sorry. Of course.
Yes. Interesting idea, um, talk about it, but no.
So that's it?
Well, I just don't think that arcade games go in the beautiful guest room.
The guest room's gonna be filled with antiques.
Which is why "Asteroids" is perfect. It's the oldest game.
What do you have against the guest room?
I don't have anything against the guest room.
Especially since everybody that we know lives about 30 seconds away.
Are you mocking me?
No, I'm not mocking you or your beautiful guest room.
What's up?
Nothing. Monica and I had a stupid fight.
But you're still moving in together, right? Because my ad came out today.
"Wanted: Female roommate, nonsmoker, nonugly."
Nice. - Ah?
I figured after living with you...
it'd be an interesting change to have a female roommate.
You know? Someone I could learn from. Someone who's different than me.
And what's more different than me, a guy who's not 19...
than, say, a girl who is 19?
Ah? Ha, ha.
Not just a hat rack, my friend.
Pheebs, I have to ask you... - Shh. I'm swamped right now.
You're just staring into space.
Um, I'm trying to move that pencil.
This one? - It worked!
Pheebs, this whole apartment thing is a nightmare.
Every place that I can afford comes with a roommate who is a freak.
Look at this.
"Wanted: Female roommate, nonsmoker, nonugly."
It's just there's nothing. This city is full. - Wait, no, look at this.
"Two-bedroom, two-bath. Must be nonsmoker.
Satan worshipers okay."
Oh. Yeah, but it's on the ground floor.
Hey. - Hey.
Rach, are you still looking for a place? - Yeah, why?
Okay, there's this guy Warren from the museum...
and he's going on a dig for like two years.
And he's got this great place he needs to sublet.
So you interested?
That sounds great. I'd love to live at Warren's. I love Warren.
Thank you. - Oh, don't thank me.
You wanna thank someone, thank the volcano...
that erupted thousands of years ago...
killing but perfectly preserving an entire civilization.
Here's Warren's number.
Oh, this is great. I am gonna call him right now.
Oh, okay. Oh. - Thank you. Ha, ha.
Okay, you go call him.
I saw it.
I don't know what you're talking about.
I'm talking about that which you already know but won't admit.
You know, that you love her again. You relove her.
Look, I do not relove her.
I can't believe you won't just admit it.
Okay, just promise me that you won't do anything stupid.
Look, we're just friends now, okay? Why would I do anything stupid?
Ugh. Well, the apartment is already subletted.
I mean, this is just hopeless. I'm never gonna find anything.
You can live with me.
What? - What?
What?
Oh, my God, are you serious? - Uh-huh.
I would love to live with you, Ross. That's great. Thank you.
I'm just glad I could, you know, help you out.
Wow, I'm so happy for you guys. This is so, so not stupid.
Ross, Ross, you have no idea what this means to me.
I mean, I was gonna be homeless. You've just saved me. You're my hero.
Hero? I don't know. Well, all right.
Oh. I have to go tell Monica what a wonderful brother she has.
Aw. Mwah. - Oh, please.
You're gonna say things now, aren't you?
No. No, I won't.
But I should tell you this.
This exact same thing happened to my roommate, Denise.
She moved in with a guy...
who was secretly married to her and said he didn't love her but really did.
It just blew up.
And that's how she ended up living with me.
Okay, that's a lie.
Hi. - Hi.
Hi. Listen, I'm sorry about before. I don't need to have a game room.
When I was a kid, I only played those games because I couldn't get girls.
Now I can get...
Now I have you.
No, not that I think that I have you...
or think of you as property in any sort of way.
I see women... - Stop it, Chandler.
I'm sorry too.
Really? - Yeah. Oh, yes.
Oh.
Listen, we don't have to make that a guest room.
We can think of something together. - That's a great idea.
We can easily think of a way for us both to enjoy the room.
