sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 当然啦
sense_groups.english: Oh. I'm sorry. Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 很有趣的主意 谈过了 但是不要
sense_groups.english: Yes. Interesting idea, um, talk about it, but no.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？
sense_groups.english: So that's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮的客房不适合放游戏机
sense_groups.english: Well, I just don't think that arcade games go in the beautiful guest room.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮的客房里会有很多古董
sense_groups.english: The guest room's gonna be filled with antiques.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以《小行星》才适合 那是最古老的游戏机
sense_groups.english: Which is why "Asteroids" is perfect. It's the oldest game.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对漂亮的客房有什么意见？
sense_groups.english: What do you have against the guest room?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有意见
sense_groups.english: I don't have anything against the guest room.

sense_groups.chinese: 尤其是我们认识的人 都住在方圆数公尺内
sense_groups.english: Especially since everybody that we know lives about 30 seconds away.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在嘲笑我吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you mocking me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有在嘲笑你 或是你漂亮的客房
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not mocking you or your beautiful guest room.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 摩妮卡和我吵架了
sense_groups.english: Nothing. Monica and I had a stupid fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们还是要同居吧？我的广告今天出来了
sense_groups.english: But you're still moving in together, right? Because my ad came out today.

sense_groups.chinese: "诚征女性室友 不抽烟 不丑"
sense_groups.english: "Wanted: Female roommate, nonsmoker, nonugly."

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮 - 啊？
sense_groups.english: Nice. - Ah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说在你之后
sense_groups.english: I figured after living with you...

sense_groups.chinese: 换个女室友会蛮有趣的
sense_groups.english: it'd be an interesting change to have a female roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个我可以学习 和我不样的人
sense_groups.english: You know? Someone I could learn from. Someone who's different than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁和我最不一样？年过十九的男人
sense_groups.english: And what's more different than me, a guy who's not 19...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是十九岁的女孩？
sense_groups.english: than, say, a girl who is 19?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ah? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不是草包
sense_groups.english: Not just a hat rack, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我想问... - 嘘 我正在忙
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, I have to ask you... - Shh. I'm swamped right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是在发呆
sense_groups.english: You're just staring into space.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想移动那支铅笔
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm trying to move that pencil.

sense_groups.chinese: 这支吗？ - 成功了
sense_groups.english: This one? - It worked!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 找房子真是恶梦
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, this whole apartment thing is a nightmare.

sense_groups.chinese: 我租得起的地方都有怪胎室友
sense_groups.english: Every place that I can afford comes with a roommate who is a freak.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看嘛
sense_groups.english: Look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: "诚征女性室友 不抽烟 不丑"
sense_groups.english: "Wanted: Female roommate, nonsmoker, nonugly."

sense_groups.chinese: 没房子了 纽约都住满了 - 等等 这里有
sense_groups.english: It's just there's nothing. This city is full. - Wait, no, look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: "两房两卫 不得抽烟"
sense_groups.english: "Two-bedroom, two-bath. Must be nonsmoker.

sense_groups.chinese: "拜撒旦者可"
sense_groups.english: Satan worshipers okay."

sense_groups.chinese: 不过是一楼
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yeah, but it's on the ground floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你还在找房子？ - 对 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Rach, are you still looking for a place? - Yeah, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们博物馆有个华伦
sense_groups.english: Okay, there's this guy Warren from the museum...

sense_groups.chinese: 要去参与挖掘工作两年
sense_groups.english: and he's going on a dig for like two years.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有个漂亮的家要转租
sense_groups.english: And he's got this great place he needs to sublet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有兴趣吗？
sense_groups.english: So you interested?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来好棒 我愿意住华伦家 我爱华伦
sense_groups.english: That sounds great. I'd love to live at Warren's. I love Warren.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 别谢我
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Oh, don't thank me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想要谢谢谁
sense_groups.english: You wanna thank someone, thank the volcano...

sense_groups.chinese: 就谢那座火山几千年前爆靥
sense_groups.english: that erupted thousands of years ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 毁灭却也保存了一整个文明
sense_groups.english: killing but perfectly preserving an entire civilization.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是华伦的电话
sense_groups.english: Here's Warren's number.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我现在就打给他
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is great. I am gonna call him right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 好 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Oh. - Thank you. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 快去吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, you go call him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到了
sense_groups.english: I saw it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你在说什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在说你知道却不肯承认的事
sense_groups.english: I'm talking about that which you already know but won't admit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又爱上她了 你重复爱她
sense_groups.english: You know, that you love her again. You relove her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有重复爱她
sense_groups.english: Look, I do not relove her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然这么嘴硬
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you won't just admit it.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之你千万别做蠢事
sense_groups.english: Okay, just promise me that you won't do anything stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在只是朋友 我为什么要做蠢事？
sense_groups.english: Look, we're just friends now, okay? Why would I do anything stupid?

sense_groups.chinese: 房子已经租出去了
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Well, the apartment is already subletted.

sense_groups.chinese: 没希望了 我找不到房子了
sense_groups.english: I mean, this is just hopeless. I'm never gonna find anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以来跟我住
sense_groups.english: You can live with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你是说真的吗？ - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, are you serious? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我求之不得 太好了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: I would love to live with you, Ross. That's great. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有帮到你就好
sense_groups.english: I'm just glad I could, you know, help you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真替你们高兴 这真是非常的不蠢
sense_groups.english: Wow, I'm so happy for you guys. This is so, so not stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这对我太重要了
sense_groups.english: Ross, Ross, you have no idea what this means to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我差点就要流落街头 你救了我 你是我的英雄
sense_groups.english: I mean, I was gonna be homeless. You've just saved me. You're my hero.

sense_groups.chinese: 说英雄就太... 好吧
sense_groups.english: Hero? I don't know. Well, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去告诉摩妮卡 她的哥哥有多棒
sense_groups.english: Oh. I have to go tell Monica what a wonderful brother she has.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 别这样
sense_groups.english: Aw. Mwah. - Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又有话要说了吧？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna say things now, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有...
sense_groups.english: No. No, I won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我告诉你
sense_groups.english: But I should tell you this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的室友狄妮丝就是这样
sense_groups.english: This exact same thing happened to my roommate, Denise.

sense_groups.chinese: 她搬去跟一个偷娶她的人住
sense_groups.english: She moved in with a guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 他嘴上说不爱 其实很爱她
sense_groups.english: who was secretly married to her and said he didn't love her but really did.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来事情爆发
sense_groups.english: It just blew up.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以她才搬来跟我住
sense_groups.english: And that's how she ended up living with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我骗你的
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's a lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才很抱歉 我不需要游戏房
sense_groups.english: Hi. Listen, I'm sorry about before. I don't need to have a game room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前把不到马子才去打游戏
sense_groups.english: When I was a kid, I only played those games because I couldn't get girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我把得到了...
sense_groups.english: Now I can get...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我有了你
sense_groups.english: Now I have you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我并不是把你当成
sense_groups.english: No, not that I think that I have you...

sense_groups.chinese: 或想成一件财产
sense_groups.english: or think of you as property in any sort of way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对女人... - 别再说了
sense_groups.english: I see women... - Stop it, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry too.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对 当然
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah. Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必弄一个客房
sense_groups.english: Listen, we don't have to make that a guest room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以一起想要怎么利用 - 好主意
sense_groups.english: We can think of something together. - That's a great idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 要做到皆大欢喜很容易
sense_groups.english: We can easily think of a way for us both to enjoy the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必现在想 - 好
sense_groups.english: We don't have to come up with this now. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如来想想客厅要怎么变化
sense_groups.english: Why don't we think about changes that we can make in the living room?

sense_groups.chinese: 变化？
sense_groups.english: Changes?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们得移动一些家俱 来放我的椅子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I mean, we're gonna have to move some furniture to make room for my chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要把懒人椅搬过来？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna bring the Barcalounger over here?

sense_groups.chinese: 有问题吗？ - 嗯...
sense_groups.english: Is that a problem? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一组的 应该摆在一起
sense_groups.english: It's just that they're a set and they should probably stay together.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 那我就都搬过来
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's cool. Then I'll just bring them both over.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是要它们离开老家
sense_groups.english: See, now you're taking them away from their home.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我懂了 这里没我的东西 只有你的东西
sense_groups.english: Okay, I get it. So I get nothing. Nothing here is mine. Everything is yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 我早上起床就穿上你的衣服 然后去上班
sense_groups.english: I'll get up in the morning, put on your clothes, and head off to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 这里只有我的东西
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah, you know what? That's it. That's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有你的 这是我说的
sense_groups.english: Everything will be mine. Nothing will be yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我是在讲懒人椅
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. I'm talking about the Barcalounger.

sense_groups.chinese: 它跟这里不搭 你要摆哪里？
sense_groups.english: It doesn't match. Where is it gonna go?

sense_groups.chinese: 游戏房里
sense_groups.english: In the game room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的椅子丑到爆又不是我的错
sense_groups.english: Look, it is not my fault that your chairs are incredibly ugly.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我不搬椅子过来 我什么都不搬过来
sense_groups.english: That's fine. I won't bring over the chairs. I won't bring anything over.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不想破坏老奶奶家的调调
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't wanna ruin the ambiance over here at Grandma's place!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的条件看起来很好
sense_groups.english: Everything on your application looks really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后一个问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, just one last question.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和你朋友 会不会常来这里狂欢聚会？
sense_groups.english: Are you and your friends gonna be over here all the time partying?

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 我不太爱玩
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't worry. I'm not really a party girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 别想都不想就说
sense_groups.english: Now, don't just be blurting stuff out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你想清楚再答
sense_groups.english: I want you to really think about your answers.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必找室友了 嗨 我要住在这里
sense_groups.english: You can call off the roommate search. Hi. I'll be living here.

sense_groups.chinese: 别理他
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't listen to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他很想住进来
sense_groups.english: He's just some guy who wants the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不会选他
sense_groups.english: But I don't think he's gonna get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛把浴帘拿掉？
sense_groups.english: Why did you take the shower curtain down?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个东西很危险
sense_groups.english: That thing was a hazard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很注重安全
sense_groups.english: I'm very safety-conscious.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在清些空间给你
sense_groups.english: Oh, I was just clearing some space for your stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我刚去找摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: But listen, I was just at Monica's...

sense_groups.chinese: 她和钱德大吵一架 不同居了
sense_groups.english: and she and Chandler had a big fight and they're not moving in.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么叫不同居了？他们还是要同居吧？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean, not moving in? They're still moving in, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他们为了怎么利用空房 大吵一架
sense_groups.english: No, no, they just had a big blowout over what to do with my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 就为了一个烂房间？
sense_groups.english: What? Over a stupid room?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有点替他们可惜
sense_groups.english: I feel kind of bad for them...

sense_groups.chinese: 却又很高兴不必搬过来了
sense_groups.english: but I'm also psyched because I don't have to move in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 这一点的确很棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Yeah. No, that part's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个是在吵什么？
sense_groups.english: What's all this about you guys fighting?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的就为了一个房间？
sense_groups.english: Is this really over a room?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太傻了
sense_groups.english: I mean, that is so silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们自己可以摆平 - 显然不行
sense_groups.english: Ross, we can handle this. - Well, apparently not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能坐视两个我关心的人
sense_groups.english: And I can't just stand by and watch two people I care about so much...

sense_groups.chinese: 为了这么傻的事伤感情
sense_groups.english: be hurt by something that is so silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再傻了 - 你叫她别傻啊
sense_groups.english: I mean, enough of the silliness. - Why don't you tell her to stop being silly?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 双方都有理
sense_groups.english: Two very good points.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认识你们两个很久了
sense_groups.english: Look, I've known you both a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在一起之后
sense_groups.english: And I've never seen either of you one-millionth as happy...

sense_groups.chinese: 比以前快乐一百万倍
sense_groups.english: as you've been since you got together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的要为了一个房间 放弃这一切？
sense_groups.english: Do you really wanna throw that all away over a room?

sense_groups.chinese: 多傻啊
sense_groups.english: That is so silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么比较重要
sense_groups.english: What's more important, love...

sense_groups.chinese: 爱情还是傻气？
sense_groups.english: or silliness?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们喜欢傻气
sense_groups.english: Well, we are fond of the silliness.

sense_groups.chinese: 但面对爱情也会心软
sense_groups.english: But we also have a soft spot for the love.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱是万灵药 - 欢笑才是吧？
sense_groups.english: Love is the best medicine. - That's laughter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么这样？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why do you do it? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 钱德 你想跟摩妮卡住吧？
sense_groups.english: Now, Chandler, you wanna live with Monica, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你想跟钱德住吧？
sense_groups.english: And, Mon, you wanna live with Chandler, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 口头契约 在纽约州有约束力
sense_groups.english: Good. A verbal contract is binding in the state of New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说你在找房子
sense_groups.english: So I understand you're looking for a place?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不搬了 - 哦
sense_groups.english: No, no, I'm staying put. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来打算找你来我家住
sense_groups.english: I was going to offer you my apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Why? Where are you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 说了你一定不信 钱德和摩妮卡又要同居了
sense_groups.english: Uh, you're never gonna believe it. Monica and Chandler are moving in again.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太好了... 对他们来说 对吧？
sense_groups.english: That's great news, right? I mean, for them, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过好处是 我们又能当室友了
sense_groups.english: But on the bright side, we get to be roommates again.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 关于这件事...
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You know, about that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很感谢你主动提议 但是...
sense_groups.english: Ross, ahem, I really appreciate your offer to let me move in and everything...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得会很怪吗？
sense_groups.english: but don't you think it's gonna be weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？为... 为什么会怪？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why? Why would it...? Why would it be weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们...
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, because of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的过去
sense_groups.english: Because of our history.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 - 不会吗？
sense_groups.english: No. - No?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非我们还余情未了
sense_groups.english: It would only be weird if we were still in that place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还余情未了吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, are you still in that place?

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也没有 - 很好 我也没有
sense_groups.english: No, not at all. - Good. Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就没问题了
sense_groups.english: So it's not a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是刚好是室友的朋友
sense_groups.english: We're just two friends who happen to be roommates.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但我们迟早会约会
sense_groups.english: Okay, but, Ross, eventually, you and I are gonna be dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really? We are?

sense_groups.english: That's great, but shouldn't you be on the toilet right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What? - What's wrong with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才举哑铃时 肚子突然一阵剧痛
sense_groups.english: Well, I got this blinding pain in my stomach when I was lifting weights before.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后就昏倒了
sense_groups.english: And then I, uh, passed out...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且一直站不起来
sense_groups.english: and, uh, I haven't been able to stand up since. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过应该没什么
sense_groups.english: But I don't think it's anything serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 这应该是疝气 你得去看医生
sense_groups.english: This sounds like a hernia. You have to... Go to the doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要
sense_groups.english: No way.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算要去看医生
sense_groups.english: If I'm gonna go to the doctor for anything...

sense_groups.chinese: 也是因为肚子这里突出来
sense_groups.english: it's gonna be for this thing sticking out of my stomach.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是疝气
sense_groups.english: That's a hernia.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要恢复健身？
sense_groups.english: Why'd I have to start working out again?

sense_groups.chinese: 烂哑铃
sense_groups.english: Damn you, 15s.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们早到了 还要十五分钟才会开始
sense_groups.english: We're a little early. The lecture doesn't end for 15 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我们可以偷溜进去看 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but we can sneak in and watch. - Yeah. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 是姊妹会的人 我以前也是会员
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, look. There's some Kappa Kappa Deltas.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 姊妹们
sense_groups.english: I was a Kappa. Hey, sisters.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我们以前真的很机灵
sense_groups.english: Wow, we really are bitches.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 瑞格比...
sense_groups.english: Right. So when Rigby got his samples...

sense_groups.chinese: 从实验室取回样本后
sense_groups.english: back from the laboratory...

sense_groups.chinese: 有了惊人的发现
sense_groups.english: he made a startling discovery.

sense_groups.chinese: 他原以为那是火山物质 其实是沉积物
sense_groups.english: What he believed to be igneous was, in fact, sedimentary.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的惊愕...
sense_groups.english: Imagine his consternation when...

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, bloody hell.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在搞什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很紧张
sense_groups.english: Look, I was nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们害我担心我会很无聊
sense_groups.english: You guys had me all worried I was gonna be boring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上了台 学生都盯着我看
sense_groups.english: I got up there and they were all, like, staring at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我一开口就是英国腔了
sense_groups.english: I opened my mouth and this British accent just came out.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还很锉
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and not a very good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再说了
sense_groups.english: Will you, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士 我是寇特?拉斯曼
sense_groups.english: Dr. Geller? Kurt Rathman.

sense_groups.chinese: 古生物学系教授
sense_groups.english: I'm a professor in the paleontology department here.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以聊聊你的课吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a moment to talk about your lecture?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我和姊妹有约
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I've got plans with my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡·盖勒
sense_groups.english: Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 失陪一下
sense_groups.english: Right. Will you excuse us for one moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 你干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能装我就不能装？
sense_groups.english: You can have an accent, but I can't?

sense_groups.chinese: 小伙子早啊
sense_groups.english: Top of the morning to you, laddies.

sense_groups.chinese: 别闹了
sense_groups.english: Would you just please stop?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个季节的孟买 灰常怡人
sense_groups.english: Bombay is very, very nice this time of year.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我点个小煎饼
sense_groups.english: Hey, will you grab me a cruller?

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下啦
sense_groups.english: Sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我拜托你去看医生 - 大哥 疝气手术...
sense_groups.english: Will you go to the hospital? - Dude, hernia operations cost, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该很贵
sense_groups.english: a lot probably, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且它越来越黑 越来越痛
sense_groups.english: Besides, it's getting darker and more painful.

sense_groups.chinese: 就表示有在好
sense_groups.english: That means it's healing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我借你钱
sense_groups.english: Look, I will loan you the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快去医院把它...
sense_groups.english: Just go to the hospital and let's just get that thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 塞回去
sense_groups.english: pushed back in.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 但我要很久才能还你
sense_groups.english: Thank you, but it'd take me forever to pay you that money back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想惦记这件事
sense_groups.english: And I don't want that hanging over my head, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且只要健保恢复
sense_groups.english: Besides, as soon as my insurance kicks in...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就可以动各种免费手术
sense_groups.english: I can get all the free operations I want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打算先去做眼睛雷射手术
sense_groups.english: I think I'll probably start with that laser eye surgery.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的疝气很严重
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey's got a bad hernia...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过动个眼睛雷射手术就好了
sense_groups.english: but it's nothing a little laser eye surgery won't fix.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 把手压在这里...
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm telling you, if I put my hand on my stomach right here...

sense_groups.chinese: 就还好
sense_groups.english: it doesn't hurt that bad. Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好你会死
sense_groups.english: Hey, maybe you'll die.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我怕了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I'm scared.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以一起走
sense_groups.english: No, we can go together.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不要拖太久
sense_groups.english: Just don't wait too long, though...

sense_groups.chinese: 我星期五之前就会挂掉
sense_groups.english: because I'm out of here sometime before Friday.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不想死
sense_groups.english: But I don't want to die.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 会很好玩
sense_groups.english: No, no. It'll be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以回来吓他们
sense_groups.english: We can come back and we can haunt these guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我 - 不要 这是我的
sense_groups.english: Give me them. - No, they are mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你偷我的 - 你才偷我的
sense_groups.english: You stole them from me. - You stole them from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿来
sense_groups.english: Give me them.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要一人一个？
sense_groups.english: You just wanna each take one?

sense_groups.chinese: 很公平 反正也没用过
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that seems fair. We never use them.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你们真的得帮我
sense_groups.english: Look, I really need some help, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我要说英国腔？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why did I have to speak in a British accent?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What do I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 先把口音改掉
sense_groups.english: Well, why don't you phase it out? Yeah, phase the accent out.

sense_groups.chinese: 别人会以为你在适应美国生活
sense_groups.english: People will think that you're adjusting to life in America.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 根本不会有人注意
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I mean, come on. No one will even notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好根本没人在听
sense_groups.english: I mean, they're probably not even listening to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人在听我讲话？
sense_groups.english: They're not listening to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有
sense_groups.english: Of course they're listening to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都在听你讲话
sense_groups.english: Everybody listens to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的觉得我该慢慢改吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica, do you really think I should try this phasing-out thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你很帅啊
sense_groups.english: I think you look fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了就开始 - 好
sense_groups.english: Whenever you're ready. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 提米
sense_groups.english: Hey, Timmy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要给你...
sense_groups.english: I've got a surprise...

sense_groups.chinese: 一个惊喜
sense_groups.english: for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 停 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Hold it. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个惊喜是一组新秋千 别演得这么凝重
sense_groups.english: The surprise is a new swing set. If you could play it less intense.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没问题 等我下
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Sure, no problem. Just hold on one second.

sense_groups.chinese: 提米
sense_groups.english: Hey, Timmy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要给你一个惊喜
sense_groups.english: I've got a surprise for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我都喂我的狗吃粉霜
sense_groups.english: So that's why I feed my dog Purina One.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天就去搬一包吧
sense_groups.english: Pick up a bag today.

sense_groups.chinese: 这时候你要把它搬起来 - 没错
sense_groups.english: That's where you pick up the bag. - Exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 台词是搬一包 所以你得把它搬起来
sense_groups.english: No, the line is, "Pick up a bag," so you need to pick up the bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是用指的
sense_groups.english: Or I could just point to it. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 粉霜 今天就去指一包吧
sense_groups.english: Blah, blah, blah. Purina One. Point to a bag today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没过 对吧？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: I didn't get it, did I? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊·崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来应征... 的人
sense_groups.english: I'm here to audition for "Man."

sense_groups.chinese: 垂死的人吗？
sense_groups.english: You mean "Dying Man."

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 快 再打次 - 真的要打？好
sense_groups.english: Okay, come on. Do it one more time. - Really? Really? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯你好
sense_groups.english: Ross, this is Dr. McNeely...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是假口音大学的麦尼利博士
sense_groups.english: from Fake Accent University.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想胯你当专任教授
sense_groups.english: We'd like you to come onboard with us full-time.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说
sense_groups.english: Listen to this.

sense_groups.chinese: 预言错了 我不会死了
sense_groups.english: My reading was wrong. I'm not going to die.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你怎么知道？ - 因为我的灵媒死了
sense_groups.english: Really? How do you know? - Because my psychic is dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定是看错牌了 - 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: She must have read the cards wrong. - Oh, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 总比我死好
sense_groups.english: Ah, better her than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来烤饼干
sense_groups.english: Hey, let's bake cookies!

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你拿到这个角色 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm really glad you got the part.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的能演吗？ - 能
sense_groups.english: Are you sure you can do this? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你陪我来
sense_groups.english: And, hey, thanks for coming with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谢谢你帮我洗澡
sense_groups.english: And thanks again for helping me take a shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样叫绝口不提吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, is that "never talking about it again"?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 都准备好了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. We're ready for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是亚历 他演你的儿子
sense_groups.english: Joey, this is Alex. He's gonna be playing your son.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi, Alex.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的手可没塞在裤子里
sense_groups.english: And, uh, as you can see, my hands are not in my pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚历 当乔伊说到"好好照顾你妈妈"
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, Alex. Now, when Joey says his line

sense_groups.chinese: 你就要哭 懂吗？
sense_groups.english: "Take good care of your mama, son," that's your cue to cry. Got it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 来吧
sense_groups.english: All right, let's do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 第五场 拍第一次
sense_groups.english: Scene five, take one.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始
sense_groups.english: And action.

sense_groups.chinese: 儿子 好好照顾你妈妈
sense_groups.english: Take good care of your mama, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 儿子 好好照顾你妈妈
sense_groups.english: Take good care of your mama, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Come on, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈是个好人
sense_groups.english: Your mama's good people.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡
sense_groups.english: Cut.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚历 这里应该要哭
sense_groups.english: Alex, remember, you're supposed to cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这次可以哭吗？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Can you cry for us this time? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 重来
sense_groups.english: All right. From the top.

sense_groups.chinese: 第五场 拍第二次
sense_groups.english: Scene five, take two.

sense_groups.chinese: 拍第三十六次要来了
sense_groups.english: Take 36 is up.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来一次
sense_groups.english: Let's try this again.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你好了吗？
sense_groups.english: You ready, Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 请问一下 你喊开始前
sense_groups.english: Uh, one thing, is it all right with you if I scream...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以大叫吗？
sense_groups.english: right up until you say, "Action"?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始 - 儿子 好好照顾你妈妈
sense_groups.english: Action! - Take good care of your mama, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Cut. - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉... 乔伊 你把衣服掀开来
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Hey, hey. Joe, why don't you lift up your shirt?

sense_groups.chinese: 小鬼你看
sense_groups.english: Take a look at this, kiddo.

sense_groups.chinese: 有小孩哭了 摄影机快拍
sense_groups.english: We have a crying child! Roll the damn cameras!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 - 罗斯在吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hello, is Ross there?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不在 你要留言吗？
sense_groups.english: No, he's not. Can I take a message?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我是罗斯的离婚律师
sense_groups.english: Yes, this is Russell, Ross' divorce lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直没有他的回音
sense_groups.english: Just tell him that since I haven't heard from him...

sense_groups.chinese: 他应该是想试着经营这段婚姻
sense_groups.english: I assume he's decided to give the marriage a try.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯又结婚了？不会吧...
sense_groups.english: Ross got married again? Aah! No.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续 慢慢
sense_groups.english: All right, keep going. We are phasing the accent out.

sense_groups.chinese: 改掉口音
sense_groups.english: Phasing it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是进实验室重新化验结果
sense_groups.english: "So without retesting their results in the laboratory...

sense_groups.chinese: 研究小组也不会发现...
sense_groups.english: the team would never have identified...

sense_groups.chinese: 原先的碳十四定年结果有误
sense_groups.english: the initial errors in their carbon dating analysis."

sense_groups.chinese: 到这里有问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Were there any questions at this point?

sense_groups.chinese: 请说 - 你的口音怎么没了？
sense_groups.english: Yes. - What's happening to your accent?

sense_groups.chinese: 再说一次 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Come again? What's this nonsense?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我不是英国人
sense_groups.english: All right. I'm not English.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是长岛人
sense_groups.english: I'm from Long Island.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一紧张就...
sense_groups.english: I was really nervous, and the accent...

sense_groups.chinese: 冒出那个腔调了
sense_groups.english: just, um... Just came out.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 回到课堂上来
sense_groups.english: So if we could just get back to the lecture.

sense_groups.chinese: 有任何问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, were there any questions?

sense_groups.chinese: 古生物学的问题
sense_groups.english: About paleontology?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想留下良好的第一印象
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I was just trying to make a good first impression.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我显然搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Obviously, I screwed up.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们对我的看法很重要
sense_groups.english: But what you guys think of me is really important...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我想成为专任教授
sense_groups.english: because I'm hoping to get a permanent job here.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们肯再给我一次机会 制造好感...
sense_groups.english: So if you'd just give me another chance to make a good impression...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你疯了吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross. Are you crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是你的老婆？你想瞒我一辈子吗？
sense_groups.english: I am still your wife? What, were you just never gonna tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是哪里有病？
sense_groups.english: What the hell is wrong with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真想宰了你
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I could just kill you!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你好
sense_groups.english: Well, hello, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的玩过？ - 真的
sense_groups.english: You've really done this before? - Yeah. Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就用力打下去
sense_groups.english: You just take a big, big swing, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要手软 好
sense_groups.english: Now, don't hold back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 庆祝乔伊的健保恢复了
sense_groups.english: We're just celebrating that Joey got his health insurance back.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right.

questions.name: S06E05
questions.en:
Oh, I cannot believe that you didn't tell me we are still married.
Look, I was going to tell you.
When? After the birth of our first secret child?
Ross didn't get the annulment. We are still married.
You're kidding? - Oh, my God.
Ross.
Okay, maybe it wasn't my best decision...
but I couldn't face another failed marriage.
Let me just jump in and ask.
At what point did you think this was a successful marriage?
Rach, come on. If you think about it, it's actually kind of funny.
Okay, maybe it's best not to think about it.
Oh, this is inexcusable. I'm shocked to my very core.
Phoebe, I told her you already knew.
Another lie. You have a sickness.
Ross, just for my own peace of mind...
you're not married to any more of us, are you?
Oh, hey, someone left their keys.
Ooh, to a Porsche.
Hey, Gunther, are these yours? - Yeah. That's what I drive.
I make 4 bucks an hour. I saved up for 350 years.
Uh-uh.
Hey, did anybody lose their keys?
Why don't you put them in the lost and found?
There's a lost and found?
My shoe!
You left a shoe here?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且很舒服
sense_groups.english: And comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢皮椅吗？ - 喜欢
sense_groups.english: Do you, uh, like leather seats? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有皮椅
sense_groups.english: It's got them.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里还有我的东西
sense_groups.english: So I still have boxes here.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯家也有我的东西
sense_groups.english: I still have boxes at Ross'.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我却没地方住
sense_groups.english: And I have nowhere to live.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在应该要抓狂才对
sense_groups.english: Wow, I could so easily freak out right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我呢？
sense_groups.english: What about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚发现 狄妮丝要出远门 我没室友了
sense_groups.english: I just found out Denise is leaving town for a while. I don't have a roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我可以当你的室友
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I could be your roommate, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你可以当我的室友
sense_groups.english: Maybe you could be my roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 有办法了 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Well, there's an idea. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 哦
sense_groups.english: That would be great. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 狄妮丝要去多久？ - 她说她12月26日回来
sense_groups.english: Wait, how long is Denise gone for? - Um, she said she'd be back December 26th.
Oh! December 26th.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许她是圣诞老公公
sense_groups.english: Heh, maybe she's Santa Claus.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 是我老公 我的心肝宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, look who it is. My husband, the apple of my eye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经约好明天2点出庭
sense_groups.english: Okay, I got us a court date for tomorrow at 2...

sense_groups.chinese: 表格也都拿了
sense_groups.english: and I picked up all the forms.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会搞定
sense_groups.english: I'll take care of everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 既然你说你会搞定
sense_groups.english: Sure, if you say you're gonna take care of everything...

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然没理由怀疑你
sense_groups.english: I have no reason to doubt you.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿来啦
sense_groups.english: Give me those forms.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要照我的方式去做 你不准叽叽歪歪
sense_groups.english: All right, now, I'm gonna do this my way, and I don't wanna hear a peep out of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但是... - 你在叽叽歪歪喔
sense_groups.english: Okay, Rach, but... - Ah, you're peeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我实在是...
sense_groups.english: Ross, you know what? I just got...

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要这样？ - 我说过...
sense_groups.english: Why? Why did you do this? - Look, I told you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想听三次失败的婚姻
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna hear "three failed marriages."

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你失败过两次就会了解了
sense_groups.english: Look, if you'd had two failed marriages, you'd understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 多亏你 我现在只差一次
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what? Thanks to you, I'm halfway there.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我快气死了 我从来没有这么气过
sense_groups.english: Oh, I am so mad, Ross. I don't think I've ever been this angry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我们分手了那次呢？
sense_groups.english: What about the time I said we were on a break?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你那边怎样？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, how's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好 蛮不错的 你觉得他们开心吗？我讲话太快了吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm doing okay. Do you think they're having fun? Am I talking too fast?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 跟我差不多
sense_groups.english: No. You sound like me.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都很好 你看钱德和小女生钱德
sense_groups.english: It's going great. Look at Chandler with Little Baby Girl Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 小女生钱德 我在哪里听过？对了 鲁本教练
sense_groups.english: Little Baby Girl Chandler. Where have I heard that before? Oh, right, Coach Rubin.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: You know what, Pheebs?

sense_groups.chinese: 等你那边忙完 我们这里也有状况
sense_groups.english: When you're done over there, we've got a kind of situation over here too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 自己的小孩自己顾
sense_groups.english: Uh-uh. No. We are all responsible for our own babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你就错了 我们一直采取人盯人战术
sense_groups.english: See, that's where I think you're wrong. We've been playing them man-to-man.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们应该打区域联防
sense_groups.english: We should really be playing a zone defense.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得分工会比较顺畅
sense_groups.english: I just think things will go smoother...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你可以负责擦屁屁
sense_groups.english: if we each have our own zone, you know? Phoebe, you can be in charge of wiping.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你负责包尿布
sense_groups.english: And, Mon, you can be in charge of diapering.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就负责看他们捉着我的手...
sense_groups.english: And I can be in charge of looking at how cute they are when they put their hands...

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 也许你才应该擦屁屁
sense_groups.english: That sounds really great, but you should be in charge of wiping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菜鸟 不该守球门区
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm a rookie. I should not be in the end zone.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅都这样准备餐点的
sense_groups.english: This is exactly how we set the plates at the restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我可不是点这个
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Well, this is not what I ordered.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝们好
sense_groups.english: Hey, babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 早上真过瘾
sense_groups.english: I'm having the best morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 那辆保时捷还在
sense_groups.english: That, uh, Porsche I've got the keys to? Still there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 毕竟钥匙在你手上
sense_groups.english: Shocking, since you still have the keys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该看看大家对我的态度
sense_groups.english: You should see the treatment I get when I'm with that car.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都很友善 找我聊天 而且不只是聊车子
sense_groups.english: People are friendly. They wanna talk. And not just about the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有人教我投资策略
sense_groups.english: One guy advised me on my equity investments.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么投资？
sense_groups.english: What equity investments?

sense_groups.chinese: 赚到保时捷的股票投资 你跟上好吗？
sense_groups.english: The ones that got me the Porsche. Will you keep up?

sense_groups.chinese: 但要是我光杵在那里
sense_groups.english: I figured, if people keep seeing me just standing there...

sense_groups.chinese: 别人会觉得那不是我的车
sense_groups.english: they're gonna start to think I don't own it.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要洗车 摩妮卡 你有水桶和肥皂吗？
sense_groups.english: So I figure I'll wash it, right? Monica, you got a bucket and some soap?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我有肥皂 海绵
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I got soap and sponges and rags...

sense_groups.chinese: 抹布 亮光腊和打腊工具组
sense_groups.english: and carnauba wax and polishing compound.

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本没有车
sense_groups.english: You don't even have a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但楼下停过一辆很脏的车
sense_groups.english: I know. But one time there was this dirty car parked in front of the building...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就把它给洗了
sense_groups.english: so I washed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有呢？ - 还有另外六辆
sense_groups.english: And? - And six others.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了
sense_groups.english: There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 它可以飚到130 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she tops out at 130. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这还是市内 到了城外可以开到160
sense_groups.english: And that's just in the city. I get her up to 160 upstate.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？你在城外有房子？
sense_groups.english: Really? You got a place upstate?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 改天见 - 好 慢走
sense_groups.english: Well, I'll see you later. - Okay. Take it easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？那是我的车
sense_groups.english: Hey. That's my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really? Oh, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 再给我五分钟
sense_groups.english: Just give me five more minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我捡到钥匙 现在在帮它打腊
sense_groups.english: Well, I found the keys, and now I'm just polishing her up.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这是我的车 - 这是我的腊
sense_groups.english: But it's my car. - Yeah, but it's my wax.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很少进市区
sense_groups.english: Listen, I don't come to the city much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你是疯子 还是在演街头剧
sense_groups.english: And I don't know if you're crazy or if this is some kind of street theater...

sense_groups.chinese: 但请把钥匙还给我
sense_groups.english: but could I have my keys?

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去 我帮你占车位
sense_groups.english: Sure. Yeah. I'll save your parking spot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不回来了
sense_groups.english: I'm not coming back.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我住在城外
sense_groups.english: Why not? - I live upstate.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我本来也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so did I.

sense_groups.chinese: 我之前不晓得在紧张什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know why I was so nervous about this...

sense_groups.chinese: 法兰克他们为什么会抱怨 带孩子太容易了
sense_groups.english: and I don't know why Frank and Alice are always complaining. This is easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 两小时和一辈子一样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, two hours, a lifetime, that's the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 宝宝醒来后...
sense_groups.english: Check it out. Check it out. When the babies wake up...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以认识克洛格
sense_groups.english: they can meet Krog.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？那个东西会害人
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? That thing could put someone's eye out.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只 他还能毁灭宇宙
sense_groups.english: He can do more than that. He can destroy the universe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 宝宝可能会误食那些零件
sense_groups.english: No, Chandler, they could swallow one of those little parts.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且那个光滑的部位 会误导他们
sense_groups.english: And also, look at his smooth area. That's just gonna mess them up.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们才不会误食什么 你们这叫保护过度
sense_groups.english: They're not gonna swallow anything. You're too overprotective.

sense_groups.chinese: 我小时候 我妈都把我扔在碎玻璃堆里
sense_groups.english: When I was a kid, my mom used to just throw me into a pile of broken glass.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 玻璃 沙子 还不都一样嘛
sense_groups.english: What? - Glass, sand, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 小莱丝莉边睡边伸懒腰
sense_groups.english: Oh, look at little Leslie stretching in her sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 好可爱喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道要到几岁 才没办法把腿举到头上
sense_groups.english: I wonder what age it is when you stop putting both legs behind your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在还是可以
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can still do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会还没结婚？
sense_groups.english: How are you still single?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想或许你们说得对
sense_groups.english: All right, ahem. I thought about it, and maybe you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许克洛格不够安全
sense_groups.english: Maybe Krog is not a safe toy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么改口了？ - 我吞了音波死光枪
sense_groups.english: Good. What made you change your mind? - I swallowed his sonic blaster gun.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这样？
sense_groups.english: How did that happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想证明我是对的
sense_groups.english: Well, I was trying to prove that I was right, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我错了
sense_groups.english: And it turns out I was wrong...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在它卡在我的喉咙里
sense_groups.english: and now it's lodged in my throat.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的 我们光顾着带小孩
sense_groups.english: Damn it, this whole time we were concentrating on the babies...

sense_groups.chinese: 都忘了要看着钱德
sense_groups.english: and no one was watching Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 两位要申请注销婚姻？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you two are asking the court for an annulment?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 申请表都填好了
sense_groups.english: Yes, Your Honor. And here are our forms, all filled out.

sense_groups.chinese: 根据申请书所言
sense_groups.english: So based on your petition...

sense_groups.chinese: 你申请注销的理由是
sense_groups.english: you are seeking an annulment on the grounds...

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒先生的精神状况不稳定
sense_groups.english: that "Mr. Geller is mentally unstable."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我精神状况不稳定
sense_groups.english: Fine. I'm mentally unstable.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他使用静脉注射毒品
sense_groups.english: And based on the fact that "Mr. Geller is an intravenous drug user."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 是的 海洛因与快克
sense_groups.english: What? - Uh, yes. Heroin and crack.

sense_groups.chinese: 快克根本不是静脉注射毒品
sense_groups.english: Crack isn't even an intravenous drug.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然知道
sense_groups.english: Well, you would know.

sense_groups.chinese: 这上面还说...
sense_groups.english: Now, it also says here that you

sense_groups.chinese: 你在婚前隐瞒性向
sense_groups.english: "Lied about your sexual preference before marriage."

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 - 罗斯 我发现那些杂志了
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. - Ross, please. I found the magazines.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你无法履行夫妻间的义务
sense_groups.english: And, finally, that you were "unable to consummate the marriage."

sense_groups.chinese: 这也难怪 你是同志 又打海洛因
sense_groups.english: Well, that makes sense since you're gay and addicted to heroin.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 这太夸张了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know, I'm sorry, this is insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有打海洛因 我不是同志
sense_groups.english: I'm not addicted to heroin, I'm not gay, and there is no problem...

sense_groups.chinese: 我履行什么都没问题
sense_groups.english: with my ability to consummate anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就可以在这里履行
sense_groups.english: Look, I'll consummate this marriage right here, right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有这个必要
sense_groups.english: That won't be necessary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交往时简直跟兔子有得拼
sense_groups.english: And when we were dating, we consummated like bunnies.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们曾经认真交往
sense_groups.english: Now, if you two were involved in a serious relationship,

sense_groups.chinese: 那就有问题了
sense_groups.english: that really creates a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 大人 我们两年前就分手了
sense_groups.english: Your Honor, rest assured, that relationship ended two years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以删掉"跟兔子有得拼"吗
sense_groups.english: And can you please strike "consummated like bunnies" from the record.

sense_groups.chinese: 这份申请书有任何实言吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there anything in this record that is actually true?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我们确实在赌城结婚
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, yes. We got married in Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 名字应该也没错
sense_groups.english: And, uh, the names, I think.

sense_groups.chinese: 从刚才的话听来
sense_groups.english: Well, based on what I've heard...

sense_groups.chinese: 两位不符合注销资格
sense_groups.english: you two certainly don't qualify for an annulment.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们不想在一起 就必须办理离婚
sense_groups.english: If you don't wanna be together, you'll have to file for divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你高兴了吗？都是你的搞笑表格害的
sense_groups.english: That's great. You happy now? Look what you did with your funny, funny form.

sense_groups.chinese: 我？你那句跟兔子有得拼呢？
sense_groups.english: What? Me? What about you and your "consummated like bunnies" nonsense?

sense_groups.chinese: 那... 你打什么打？
sense_groups.english: And what...? What are you typing that for?

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到没？我们不能办注销了
sense_groups.english: She already said we don't get the annulment.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要打
sense_groups.english: Don't type that. What...?

sense_groups.chinese: 别再打了
sense_groups.english: Stop typing. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再打了
sense_groups.english: Stop typing.

sense_groups.chinese: 别打了 别打了
sense_groups.english: Stop typing, "stop typing."

sense_groups.chinese: 你看你让我嫁的是什么人？
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, do you see what you're keeping me married to?

sense_groups.chinese: 请两位离开我的办公室
sense_groups.english: You need to get out of my chambers.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你给我听着
sense_groups.english: All right, lady, here's the deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来办注销的 没办成我绝对不走
sense_groups.english: I came here for an annulment, and I'm not leaving here until I get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想在牢里过夜吗？ - 耽误您了
sense_groups.english: Would you like to spend the night in jail? - Thank you for your time.

sense_groups.chinese: 保时捷的主人把车开走了
sense_groups.english: That Porsche guy took his car back.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你捡到他的衣橱钥匙？
sense_groups.english: But you found the keys to his clothes?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我只是喜欢
sense_groups.english: No, I just, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 大家以为我有保时捷的感觉
sense_groups.english: I love the way it feels when everybody thinks I own a Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿这样别人就会以为你有？
sense_groups.english: People would think you own a Porsche because of the clothes?

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然
sense_groups.english: Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 白痴才会没车还穿成这样
sense_groups.english: Only an idiot would wear this stuff if he didn't have the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒是
sense_groups.english: That is true.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过只有天才 才会误食音波死光枪
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but only a genius would swallow a sonic blaster gun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也误食过
sense_groups.english: Oh, I've been there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去开我的保时捷了
sense_groups.english: I am gonna go drive my Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你知道你没有保时捷吧
sense_groups.english: Joey, you know you don't actually have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你搞什么？我正在入戏 你说说她 好吗
sense_groups.english: Come on. What are you doing? I'm in character. Will you talk to her?

sense_groups.chinese: 它动了 现在真的好刺
sense_groups.english: Ah, I think it just moved. It's really poking me.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我们去挂急诊
sense_groups.english: That's it. We're going to the emergency room.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你们不能把我扔给他们 我们正在带孩子
sense_groups.english: What? No, you can't leave me here with them. We're babysitting.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝都睡了 你撑一下一定没问题
sense_groups.english: The babies are asleep. I'm sure you'll be okay on your own.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们不能把我扔给他们
sense_groups.english: But you can't leave me with them. We're a team.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是一队的 在打区域联防 他们会以三打一
sense_groups.english: We're playing a zone. They're gonna triple-team me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的喉咙卡了个塑胶玩具 我们非去医院不可
sense_groups.english: He's got something plastic in his throat. We gotta go to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 但医生也帮不了他
sense_groups.english: But, no, because a doctor won't be able to help him. And it's just gonna, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 反正过个7年就会自动排出
sense_groups.english: naturally pass through his system in, like, seven years.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是口香糖 - 我确定是死光枪
sense_groups.english: I think that's gum. - I'm pretty sure it's gun.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很痛 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, listen, this really hurts. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 男子汉才不会冲去医院
sense_groups.english: But no. A real man wouldn't just run to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 克洛格会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: No. What would Krog do?

sense_groups.chinese: 泊车小弟怎么还没 把我的保时捷开来？
sense_groups.english: Why isn't that valet back with my Porsche?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为钥匙在你手上吗？
sense_groups.english: Maybe because you've got the keys?

sense_groups.chinese: 都是你的错 - 我的错？你威胁法官
sense_groups.english: That was totally your fault. - My fault? You threatened the judge.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把书记员的打字纸撕下来
sense_groups.english: Well, you ripped the paper out of the court reporter's machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样才能阻止他打下去
sense_groups.english: That was the only way I could get him to stop typing!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒夫妇好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. How are the Gellers?

sense_groups.chinese: 不准那样叫我们
sense_groups.english: Don't call us that.

sense_groups.chinese: 法官不准我们办注销 我们得去办离婚
sense_groups.english: The judge wouldn't let us get an annulment. Now we gotta get a divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 你被保捷附身了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did a Porsche throw up on you?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 是保时捷
sense_groups.english: It's "Porsche."

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全可以照顾你们对吧？
sense_groups.english: Me taking care of you is no problem, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得很安心吧？
sense_groups.english: You guys feel safe, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 吐泡泡就表示"安心"
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna take that spit bubble as a "Yeah, I do."

sense_groups.chinese: 我扔了脏尿布 就帮你换一块干净的
sense_groups.english: Let's get rid of this dirty diaper, Leslie. I'll set you up with a nice clean one.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不是故意的 我得先清理一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm sorry. I didn't mean to scare you. I just have to clean that up, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是摩妮卡的家
sense_groups.english: Because, let's face it, we're at Monica's.

sense_groups.chinese: 破了 反正东西迟早都会坏
sense_groups.english: I broke it. All right. Well, that's just the way things go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 就这样
sense_groups.english: Okay. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么只剩两个？
sense_groups.english: Why are there only two of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 莱丝莉呢？
sense_groups.english: Where's Leslie?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会说话 莱丝莉？你在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Well, you can't answer. Leslie? Where are you, Leslie?

sense_groups.chinese: 莱丝莉 现在是开口说话的好时机
sense_groups.english: Leslie, now would be a good time for your first words.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看你
sense_groups.english: Well, look at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是个小顽皮
sense_groups.english: You are a little bit mischievous. My gosh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是非常皮
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're a lot mischievous.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正会干
sense_groups.english: Well, it'll dry.

sense_groups.chinese: 去跟哥哥妹妹躺在一起...
sense_groups.english: Okay, you sit with your brother and sister now...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不在
sense_groups.english: who aren't there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How do you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 再过12到14小时
sense_groups.english: Well, let's just say that Krog will be equipped to destroy the universe again...

sense_groups.chinese: 克洛格就又能毁灭宇宙了
sense_groups.english: in 12 to 14 hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一个人把孩子都带好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I totally took care of the babies all by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂奶 洗澡 哄他们睡觉
sense_groups.english: I fed them, bathed them and put them to bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 还保护他们躲过龙卷风？
sense_groups.english: And protected them from a tornado?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 宝宝都睡了
sense_groups.english: I know. The babies are asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 家里是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what happened here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做到了 我一个人照顾宝宝
sense_groups.english: I did it. I took care of the babies all by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的房子 - 是菲比胜利的战场
sense_groups.english: But my apartment. - Was the setting of Phoebe's triumph.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是这儿乱的
sense_groups.english: But the mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 比起菲比的辛劳实在不算什么
sense_groups.english: Is not as important as the fact that Phoebe took care of the babies all by herself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我不该大惊小怪
sense_groups.english: You're right. You're right, I shouldn't freak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我们有了孩子也会这样
sense_groups.english: This is what it's gonna be like when we have babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么时候呢？
sense_groups.english: When will that be?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你看你弄得多乱
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, would you take a look at this mess?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 你总算回来了 我都开始担心了
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, thank God you're home. I was getting worried.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去领了离婚证书
sense_groups.english: I picked up the divorce papers.

sense_groups.chinese: 该签的我都签了
sense_groups.english: Uh, I've already signed everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要签的地方我也打了勾
sense_groups.english: And I put little X's where you need to sign.

sense_groups.chinese: 打勾 真好 这样就前嫌尽释了
sense_groups.english: Oh, little X's. Great. That makes up for everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我... 你也干过很多蠢事好吗
sense_groups.english: You know, you've done a lot of stupid stuff too, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 有哪一件跟这次一样蠢
sense_groups.english: Oh, name one stupid thing that is as stupid as this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你飞去伦敦阻止我结婚怎么说
sense_groups.english: Okay, how about you flew to London to stop my wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经结婚了 你还说你爱我
sense_groups.english: How about you told me you loved me after I was married?

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 那不一样
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, that was different.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做那些事是因为我爱你
sense_groups.english: I did those things because I was in love with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 正是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 的确很不一样
sense_groups.english: You're right. That's very different.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之赶快签吧
sense_groups.english: So let's just sign the papers.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 请签名
sense_groups.english: Okay, can we just sign, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你
sense_groups.english: Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 等一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, wait, Ross. Wait a minute. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有件事要坦白
sense_groups.english: I, uh, kind of have a little confession.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚这件事
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, you know, this whole marriage thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 算是我的主意
sense_groups.english: Kind of my idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是醉到...
sense_groups.english: Remember how we were too drunk to remember anything...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么都想不起来？
sense_groups.english: the night we were married?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很不想说
sense_groups.english: And yeah, I didn't really wanna say anything...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的记忆回来了
sense_groups.english: but it just kind of kept coming back to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 记不记得我们在赌场
sense_groups.english: Um, remember, we were in the casino...

sense_groups.chinese: 你突然觉得狂吃葡萄会很好玩
sense_groups.english: and for some reason, you thought it'd be funny to eat a lot of grapes.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我觉得我们结婚会更好玩
sense_groups.english: And I thought it would be funnier if we got married.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我们折衷 先去结婚
sense_groups.english: So, ahem, as a compromise, we decided first to get married and then...

sense_groups.chinese: 再去吃很多葡萄 - 再去吃很多葡萄
sense_groups.english: to eat a lot of grapes. - To eat a lot of grapes.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以...
sense_groups.english: So, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉惹出这些麻烦
sense_groups.english: Sorry I got us into this whole thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以仔细想想
sense_groups.english: So then, I mean, if you think about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 这一切都是你的错
sense_groups.english: this is all your fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要得寸进尺
sense_groups.english: Yeah, don't push it, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道...
sense_groups.english: I gotta say...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟很多人离过婚
sense_groups.english: I know I divorce a lot of women.

sense_groups.chinese: 却从来没想过会跟你离婚
sense_groups.english: Never thought I'd be divorcing you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我总觉得要是我们结婚 一定会天长地久
sense_groups.english: I always thought if you and I got married, that would be the one that stuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会是秘密结婚
sense_groups.english: And it wouldn't be a secret...

sense_groups.chinese: 也不会在必胜客吃酒席
sense_groups.english: and we wouldn't have our wedding dinner at Pizza Hut.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有请客吗？
sense_groups.english: Did I even treat?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 那是免费的 新婚夫妇特权
sense_groups.english: No, it was on the house. It was a newlywed special.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没听过这么令人沮丧的事
sense_groups.english: That may be the most depressing thing I've heard in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去律师那里送件
sense_groups.english: Well, I should probably get these to my lawyer's office.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你把事情都办妥
sense_groups.english: Hey, thanks, Ross, for taking care of all this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Ah, no problem. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要份副本 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna need a copy of those. - Totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 别在我的保时捷旁边乱跑
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, hey. Careful around my Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 他有一辆最拉风的保时捷
sense_groups.english: He has the most amazing Porsche under there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想给你们看 但我刚哄到她睡着
sense_groups.english: I'd love to show you, but I just tucked her in. She's sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要去喝杯酒？
sense_groups.english: Hey, would you two girls like to go for a drink?

questions.name: S06E06
questions.en:
Okay. - Aah.
Listen, I'm gonna be moving out, so you are gonna be in charge of paying the rent.
Right, and when is that due? - First of the month.
And that's every month?
No, just the months you actually want to live here.
Ah.
Okay, here's the phone bill.
Oh, my God!
That's our phone number.
Look, I know I kind of sprung this whole me-moving-out-on-you thing.
So why don't I just cover you for a while? - No, no. No way.
Joey Tribbiani does not take charity...
anymore.
It's not charity, Joe. - No, forget it.
Okay? I mean, thanks, but I'm done taking money from you.
All right? I can take care of myself. Now, what's next? Come on.
Okay, uh, here's the electric bill.
This is how much we pay for electric? - Well, yeah.
So we'll do the rest of the bills later, then?
So is Joey gonna have to give up the apartment?
I hope not. I tried to offer him money, but he wouldn't take it.
How much do you think he needs?
I figure $1500 would cover him for a few months, you know...
but I have to trick him into taking it so I don't hurt his pride.
Yeah. Well, why don't you hire him as an actor?
You could have him dress up and put on little skits whenever you want.
Well, that would help the pride thing.
Hey. - Hey.
Wow, you look great. Do you wanna move in with me tomorrow?
Okay. - Okay.
What do you girls have planned for tonight?
Instead of being sad that tonight's my last night with Rachel...
we thought we'd go out and celebrate
Rachel's moving in with Phoebe.
And also my birthday. Ha, ha. - It's not your birthday.
What a mean thing to say.
I would never tell you it was not your birthday.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey, so you guys have anything planned for the big last night?
Well, instead of just hanging out, we figure we'd do nothing.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Knicks' season opener tonight.
I thought maybe you guys would come and watch it.
I don't know, Ross.
Not if you talk about how you gave up basketball...
to become a paleontologist.
I did give up a career in basketball to become a paleontologist.
Pheebs, I was wondering... - You're not dressed yet?
We're supposed to start having fun in 15 minutes!
Well, and clearly, not a minute sooner.
Rachel, you are packed, though, right? I mean, please tell me you're packed.
Of course I'm packed. Monica, relax.
I wanted to ask Phoebe for her opinion on what I should wear.
My God, I cannot get a minute of peace.
Oh, my God.
Monica's just gonna kill you.
I know.
What you're wearing is fine for that.
Rachel, I want to borrow
You're not packed!
You're not packed even a little bit.
Surprise.
Don't get mad, because, look, this is what happened.
So I started packing, and then I realized, "What am I doing?"
I am lousy at packing, right?
But you love packing.
So as a gift to you on our last night...
Ta-da.
I'll be coordinator.
Oh, my God, I'm so sorry. I didn't get you anything.
Oh.
Look, everybody has to help. Phoebe, you can help, can't you?
I have plans.
You have plans with us. - That's right.
All right. Chandler can make boxes, Ross can wrap, and Joey can lift things.
Tell the guys they have to help out. - Okay.
Okay. - My God, thank you.
Hurry! Monica's gonna make you pack. She's got jobs for everyone.
Now, it's too late for me, but save yourselves.
Okay.
The movers will be here in 11 hours. Rachel has not packed.
Now, everybody has to help. Chandler...
No, I have plans with Joey.
I thought you said you were doing nothing. - Yes, but for the last time.
Okay, fine. Now, Ross...
Oh, but I can't do it. - Why not?
Don't you have Ben? - Because I have Ben.
It's almost 8:00, it's almost past his bedtime. Where is he?
He's at a dinner party.
Is he really coming? Because I can see into your apartment.
Of course he is. Uh, what?
You think I'd just use my son as an excuse?
What kind of father do you think I am?
All right. Sorry.
I gotta go make a fake Ben.
Here it is. Our last pizzas together as roommates.
I wish I'd known you were gonna do that. I ordered Chinese.
Oh. Oh, that's okay.
Hey, actually, in a way it's kind of nice. You know?
Our last dinner together. Me, bringing the food of my ancestors...
you, the food of yours.
Huh?
Say, Joe, I had a strange idea for what to do on our last night.
What do you say we play a little, uh, foosball for money?
Are you crazy? You haven't beaten me once since my injury- plagued '97 season.
It'd be easier if you'd just give me your money.
Yes, it would.
Ahem. What do you say to $50?
Okay, you're on. - Okay, let's play.
The big game. Italy versus...
China, apparently.
Oh, look, it's the Rollerblades.
Oh, God.
You remember when we got these?
No.
Oh, I guess you weren't there.
You guys, we said we were gonna have fun.
Come on. Hey, ha, ha, remember the time?
You don't remember?
Sorry, Pheebs. I guess I'm just really sad that I'm leaving.
I'm gonna miss you so much.
Well, this doesn't have to be so sad though, you know?
Instead of thinking about how much you're gonna miss about each other...
you should, like, think about some of the things you're not gonna miss.
I don't think there's anything.
Come on, there's gotta be something.
Nope. She's perfect.
I have one.
Good. Great. Okay, you can go first.
Uh, well, I guess I'm not gonna miss the fact...
that you're never allowed to move the phone pen. Ha, ha.
That's a good one. Okay, Monica, anything?
You know, does Rachel move the phone pen?
Aw, sometimes. - Ha, ha.
Always, actually.
Good. There you go. Doesn't everyone feel better?
It's not just the phone pen.
It's just that I never get my messages.
You get your messages.
Well, I don't think it counts if you have to read them off your hand...
after you've fallen asleep on the couch.
So you missed a message from who? Chandler?
Or your mom?
Or Chandler?
Or your mom?
Great, it worked. No one's sad. Heh.
Yes. - Ah.
I win again. Ha, ha, that's, like, 500 bucks you owe me. Woo- hoo!
Man. Five hundred dollars.
That is a lot of electricity, huh? Woo- hoo!
Ooh, I gotta buy some food.
Okay, okay. Give me a chance to win my money back. Sudden death...
one goal, $1000.
You serious? - Oh, yes.
Okay.
Get ready to owe me. - Okay.
Okay, here we go. Ready?
No, no, no! - No, no, no!
No one can beat me.
See, now that's why only the little fake men are supposed to do the kicking.
Hello?
Oh, hi, Ross. See, other people call me.
Ooh, your brother. Score.
What's up? - I'm here with Ben.
Thought we'd say hi.
Put him on. - Ben, say hi to Aunt Monica.
Oh, I guess he doesn't feel like talking right now.
Uh, he's smiling, though.
Okay, talk to you later.
I think it was better when you guys were sad.
Hey, oh, remember the Rollerblades? Oh.
You know what else I'm not gonna miss? "I'm Monica.
I wash the toilets 17 times a day, even if people are on it."
"Hi, I'm Rachel. Is my sweater too tight? No?
Oh, I'd better wash it and shrink it."
"I'm Monica. I don't get phone messages from interesting people. Ever."
Hey, I call her.
"Oh, my God. I love Ross. I hate Ross. I love Ross. I hate Ross."
"Oh, my God. I can't find a boyfriend.
So I guess I'll just stumble across the hall
and sleep with the first guy I find in there."
Yeah, we should get a move on if we want to make those dinner reservations.
Still broken?
It sucks, man.
Your last night here, and I lose the two most important things
The foosball table...
and $500.
Well, you know, there are other ways you can win back your money.
How about blackjack? - Ah, not my game.
Okay, uh, you know what? We can play a new game.
A new game. It's fun. - What's it called?
Cups.
I don't know how to play Cups. - I'll teach you. It's really easy and fun.
All right. - Okay, here you go.
I have two queens. What do you have?
A two and a five. - Whoa, you win. Fifty dollars.
Really? - Oh, yeah. Okay, let's play again. Ready?
What have you got? - A four and a nine.
You're kidding, right?
No. Why? - Well, that's a full cup.
Damn, I am good at Cups.
I'm not talking to her.
One of you has to take the first step...
and it should be you because she's the one who's leaving.
It's harder for her.
Maybe you're right.
But she made fun of my phone pen.
I know. I took it hard too.
Listen, Rachel, I feel bad about what happened...
What are you doing? - I'm unpacking.
What? - I'm not moving. Is that picture straight?
It needs to go about 20 blocks to the left.
Hey, you know what?
You're the one who wants this big change and move in with Chandler.
You should go. Why do I have to leave?
Because It's my apartment! - Well, it's mine too. What else you got?
How about: You're moving!
No, no, no. - Yes, yes, yes.
Okay, Monica...
This is ridiculous.
We should be packing you.
Hey, how you guys doing? - Great. Monica's moving.
I am not!
Oh, really? Well, how come all your stuff is in this box?
Okay, you guys, you guys, I think I know what's going on here.
Okay? You guys? Stop!
I know that you're acting mad because you think that will make it easier to leave.
But deep down, you're still really sad. Deep, deep down.
No, Phoebe, I am mad! - Well, deep, deep, deep down.
Yeah, I'm just mad.
Then keep running.
You win.
What did you have? - Doesn't matter. Nothing beats...
a three and a six.
That, my friend, is "D Cup."
Okay, now, how much have you won so far?
Wow. Seven hundred. - Not 700 exactly?
Yeah. - Heh. Double it.
What? - Yeah, see, in Cups, once you get $700...
you have to double it.
Really? - Hey, I didn't make up the rules.
Okay, so now, after you receive the doubling bonus, you get, uh, one card.
Now, that one card could be worth $100, which brings your total to 1500.
Ooh. - No, no, no.
Don't get too excited, because that's not gonna happen unless you get the... No way.
Well, this is the last box of your clothes.
I'm just gonna label it "What were you thinking?"
Funny, I was just gonna go across the hall and write that on Chandler.
Okay, you guys, I don't mean to make things worse, but...
I don't wanna live with Rachel anymore.
What? - You're just so mean to each other.
And I don't wanna end up like that with Rachel. I still like you.
Well, Phoebe, that's fine because I'm not moving.
Whoa, whoa, whoa. Phoebe, you gotta take her.
You know, I know I said some bad stuff...
but Rachel does have some qualities that make her a good roommate.
Oh, really? Like what, Monica?
You know how she has 147,000 pair of boots?
Oh, yeah, good start, Mon.
She lets you borrow them. - Yeah.
And you stretch them out with your big old clown feet.
Do you wanna live outside? Because it's getting cold.
She gets tons of catalogs...
and, um, she'll fold down the pages of the things she thinks I'd like.
What else? - Uh...
