sense_groups.chinese: 而我呢？"这是" "和" 还有"留言" 我不要
sense_groups.english: What do I get? I get "it's, and." Oh, I'm sorry, I have "A." Forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别闹了 - 好 不要 那我们交换
sense_groups.english: Come on, that's silly. - All right. So let's switch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都分到好的字
sense_groups.english: No, I have all the good words.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们交换
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine, fine. We can switch.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是 - 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's. - Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 和 - 菲比的家
sense_groups.english: And. - Phoebe's.

sense_groups.chinese: 请...慢着 你是怎么弄的？
sense_groups.english: Pleas... Wait. How did you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是普通角色对吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're no ordinary roommate, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 待会再录好吗？ 我想在天黑前去慢跑
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, come on, can we finish this later? I wanna go running before it gets dark.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也一起来嘛 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you come with me? - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 一定很好玩
sense_groups.english: Yeah, oh, it'll be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 去公园跑步 当做室友问第一次联络威情
sense_groups.english: We'll run in the park. It'll be like our first, you know, roommate-bonding thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们去跑步
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go running!

sense_groups.chinese: 而且那里有帅哥 - 那就往他们跑过去
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and there's cute guys there. - Let's run towards them!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你等我一下
sense_groups.english: Wait just one more second.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 这是瑞秋和菲比的家 请在哔声后留言 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Hi, it's Phoebe and Rachel's. Please leave a message. Thanks!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你都讲完了
sense_groups.english: Now, wait a minute. You just took all the words.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 你遇到对手了 瑞秋葛林
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. You've met your match, Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚看完一本很棒的书 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: So I just finished this fascinating book. - Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了2030年 有些电脑
sense_groups.english: By the year 2030, there'll be computers...

sense_groups.chinese: 能执行跟人脑一样多的功能
sense_groups.english: that can carry out the same amount of functions as an actual human brain.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以理论上你可以把思想记忆
sense_groups.english: So, theoretically, you could download...

sense_groups.chinese: 下载到这种电脑上
sense_groups.english: your thoughts and memories into this computer...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后以机器的形态长生不死
sense_groups.english: and live forever as a machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚发现我能睁着眼睛睡觉
sense_groups.english: And I just realized I can sleep with my eyes open.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 把箱子钉在地上真是个好主意
sense_groups.english: Honey, it was a great idea, nailing the boxes to the floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没把箱子钉在地上 - 所以你可以搬走咯
sense_groups.english: I didn't nail the boxes to the floor. - Oh, so you can move them.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这就搬 罗斯有个很好听的电脑故事
sense_groups.english: Yes, and while I'm doing that, Ross has a great computer story for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 这是吉宁
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody. Uh, I'd like you to meet Janine.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的新室友
sense_groups.english: She's gonna be my new roommate.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要来跟我住
sense_groups.english: And she's gonna live with me!

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你 吉宁
sense_groups.english: It's nice to meet you. Janine?

sense_groups.chinese: 勒夸 吉宁勒夸
sense_groups.english: Lecroix. Janine Lecroix.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都不知道 好好听的姓
sense_groups.english: I didn't know that. What a pretty last name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是哪里人？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, where are you from?

sense_groups.chinese: 澳洲人2星期前刚到
sense_groups.english: Australia. I just moved here a couple of weeks ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 来自南半球？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: From the land down under? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个我也不知道
sense_groups.english: I didn't know that either.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做哪一行？
sense_groups.english: So, what do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个舞者 - 你是个舞者？
sense_groups.english: I'm a dancer. - You're a dancer?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是个舞者
sense_groups.english: She's a dancer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去整理东西了 - 我帮你开门
sense_groups.english: Well, I think I'll go and unpack. - Here, let me...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Joey? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫她搬来之前有先面试吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you even interview this woman before you asked her to move in?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Of course I did. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底问了什么？
sense_groups.english: What exactly did you ask her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候可以搬来？
sense_groups.english: When can you move in?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你把她带到我们身边
sense_groups.english: Thank you for bringing her into our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 好个大美人
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也喜欢她？
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, so you like her too, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你看这堆箱子
sense_groups.english: Hey, look at all the boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想赶快约她
sense_groups.english: I cannot wait to ask her out.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你不能约她
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, Joey. Joey, you can't ask her out.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是你的室友 那样会太复杂
sense_groups.english: She's your roommate. It'll be way too complicated.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 千万不要
sense_groups.english: Yeah, man, don't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你约了她 我就不能约她了
sense_groups.english: I mean, if you date her, then I can't date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前跟一个唐娜交往 后来分手
sense_groups.english: Think about it. Remember when you were going out with Donna and you broke up...

sense_groups.chinese: 记得你们在超市巧遇的尴尬吗
sense_groups.english: remember how horrible it was when you bumped into her at the supermarket?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你住在超市里
sense_groups.english: Now imagine you live at the supermarket.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 - 噢
sense_groups.english: No, no. - Oh. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 那样很不好 我不能约她
sense_groups.english: You're right. I don't want that. I can't date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好也别跟她调情 住得这么近
sense_groups.english: And you'd better watch the flirting too, because in close quarters...

sense_groups.chinese: 可能会出事 - 太难了
sense_groups.english: it could be trouble. - Well, that's gonna be tough, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 毕竟美女当前 我很难不打情骂俏
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's hard for me to be around an attractive woman and not flirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老是在你面前 你也没怎样
sense_groups.english: Heh. Well, you're around me all the time, and you don't flirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点难过是吧？
sense_groups.english: A little sad about that, sweetie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要绑鞋带 你先跑 我就来
sense_groups.english: I have to tie my shoes, so you go ahead. I'll catch up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 那哪叫跑步 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on, that's not running. Let's go!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说真的 她跑步的时候
sense_groups.english: You guys, I'm telling you, when she runs...

sense_groups.chinese: 就像大嘴蛙
sense_groups.english: she looks like a cross between Kermit the Frog...

sense_groups.chinese: 和生化机器人合体
sense_groups.english: and the Six Million Dollar Man.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡以前好喜欢他
sense_groups.english: Monica had such a crush on him. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 她睡觉之前都会亲他的海报
sense_groups.english: She used to kiss his poster every night before she went to bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会
sense_groups.english: I used to do that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有他的专辑 《全身绿色的烦恼》吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Did you also have his album, It's Not Easy Being Green?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以菲比的姿势很怪？
sense_groups.english: So Phoebe runs weird, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 而且她还会想再去跑
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And you know what? And I know she's gonna want to run again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我躲不掉 我跟她住在一起
sense_groups.english: I don't know how to get out of it. I mean, I live with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就实话实说嘛
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just be straight with her? Tell her the truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我应该跟她直说
sense_groups.english: You're right. You're right. I should just tell her the truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 摩妮卡把我绊倒 我再也不能跑步了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, Monica tripped me. I don't think I can ever run again, ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要绊倒她？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why would you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 抱歉害你两个脚踝受伤
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I'm sorry that I hurt your ankles.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有一个 - 等着瞧
sense_groups.english: Ankle. - We'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 东西都拿出来了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I am officially unpacked.

sense_groups.chinese: 多谢帮忙
sense_groups.english: Thanks for helping me, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 看来他回家了
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess Joey went home.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 还有一个箱子没拆
sense_groups.english: Oh, and look, there is still one box that I have to unpack.

sense_groups.chinese: 你被骗了
sense_groups.english: I got you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我差点被吓出心脏病
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you almost gave me a heart attack.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想笑想得好辛苦
sense_groups.english: It was so hard not to laugh, I'll tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 很像回事嘛
sense_groups.english: Hey, the place looks great.

sense_groups.chinese: 不赖吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, not bad, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡今天要加班 我要把这里打扫得一尘不染
sense_groups.english: You know what? Monica's working late, so I'm gonna make this place spotless.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有还有
sense_groups.english: You know what else I'm gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还要下楼去买花送她
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go downstairs, I'm gonna get her some flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会不想跟我住？
sense_groups.english: Now, who would not want to live with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想
sense_groups.english: I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟性威的澳洲舞者住
sense_groups.english: No, I want to live with the super-hot Australian dancer.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况如何？你能不打情骂俏吗
sense_groups.english: How's that going, though? Are you okay with the not-flirting thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 目前还可以 但是好累
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so far. Yeah. But it's tough, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的调情能量一直累积 无处发泄
sense_groups.english: I've got all this built-up flirting energy, and I don't know how to get rid of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 客厅比较宽
sense_groups.english: Sorry. There's just more room out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我只是想到 我也该拉拉筋了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, you just, uh, reminded me that I have to do my stretches too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该... - 啊
sense_groups.english: Why don't you try to be? - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What's wrong? - Uh, nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不要打趣我
sense_groups.english: I just... I didn't want you to touch me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我拉筋拉得全身是汗 哈哈
sense_groups.english: because I'm all sweaty from the workout. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去洗个澡
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna hit the shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉在浴室晾衣服
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry about that stuff hanging in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的丁字裤很娇贵 不能烘干
sense_groups.english: It's just my thongs are too delicate for the dryer.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Aah! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 是我
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, uh - huh, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到你抄了慢跑鞋溜出来
sense_groups.english: I saw you grab your running shoes this morning and sneak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你骗我好自己跑步
sense_groups.english: You lied so you could run by yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, Phoebe, no. I was... No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是我只是跑跑看...
sense_groups.english: I was actually just checking...

sense_groups.chinese: 看我
sense_groups.english: to see...

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能跑 结果可以
sense_groups.english: if I could run. And I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我又不是白痴
sense_groups.english: Please, Rachel, I'm not an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 菲比
sense_groups.english: No, wait. Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 同居真的会让人越来越像
sense_groups.english: Wow. Couples who live together do start to look alike.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩德...
sense_groups.english: So, Mondler...

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What, uh...? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说呢？我在打扫
sense_groups.english: What does it look like? I am cleaning.

sense_groups.chinese: 你动她的东西有经过她同意吗
sense_groups.english: Did you get Monica's authorization to move all of her stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 没必要 我会把东西都放回去
sense_groups.english: Authorizat... I don't need that. I'm gonna put everything back.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全恢复原状吗？
sense_groups.english: Put it back exactly where you found it?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是完全恢复原状
sense_groups.english: Yes. I'm gonna put it back exactly where I found it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种态度对你没有帮助
sense_groups.english: Okay, first of all, that attitude is not helping.

sense_groups.chinese: 她才不会在乎有没有恢复原状
sense_groups.english: She won't care if I put her stuff back in the same stupid place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是刚认识摩妮卡吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? Did you just meet Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 她会认同我的体贴
sense_groups.english: She's gonna recognize that I did a nice thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 并感到窝心
sense_groups.english: and appreciate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实这样也蛮好的
sense_groups.english: Huh. No, actually, this will work out well.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你必须搬回去跟乔伊住
sense_groups.english: Because when you have to move back with Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的新室友就可以来跟我住
sense_groups.english: Joey's hot new roommate can come live with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了 你想吓我
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see, I see. You're trying to freak me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡对这种事有怪癖
sense_groups.english: Look, Chandler, Monica is really weird about this kind of stuff, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 我跟她住了16年 她会捉狂
sense_groups.english: Believe me, I lived with her for 16 years. She's going to freak out.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 她会压在你身上
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's going to sit on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她才不会 我证明给你看
sense_groups.english: No, she is not, okay? I'll prove it to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在就打给她
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna call her right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 电话擦好了
sense_groups.english: Phone's done.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 摩妮卡 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey, Mon. How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 烂透了 什么事都得我自己来
sense_groups.english: Terrible. If I want something done right, I have to do it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他人只会搞砸
sense_groups.english: Other people just wreck stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚可能会杀人
sense_groups.english: I really think I might kill someone tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 没那么糟吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, come on, it can't be that bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 是非常糟 想到快见到你了
sense_groups.english: It's worse. The only thing getting me through...

sense_groups.chinese: 我才撑得下去
sense_groups.english: is knowing I'm gonna see you soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我搞不好会设法早退 - 不要
sense_groups.english: I might get out of here early. - No. No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅似乎很需要你
sense_groups.english: No, no, it sounds like they need you there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟罗斯在起吗？ － 一切都很好 再见
sense_groups.english: You're just hanging out with Ross? - It's all good. Okay, bye, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会宰了我
sense_groups.english: She's gonna kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 电话放反了
sense_groups.english: The phone was facing the other way.

sense_groups.chinese: 相框应该摆在上面
sense_groups.english: And that goes back up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们从大型家具复原起
sense_groups.english: Know what we should do? We should start with the big stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 比较简单 先搬沙发
sense_groups.english: That'll be the easiest. So, uh, let's start with the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没问题
sense_groups.english: I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 位置好像不对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that doesn't look right.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？沙发刚好跟毯子对齐
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? The couch is perfectly in line with the carpet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以走到这边 轻松的把脚翘在...
sense_groups.english: Then I can just walk over here and casually just put my feet right up on...

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's what we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就把沙发往茶几那边挪
sense_groups.english: We just move the couch closer to the coffee table.

sense_groups.chinese: 那沙发的背后 就不会跟毯子边缘对齐了
sense_groups.english: But then the back of the couch won't line up with the back of the carpet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就把茶几往沙发
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, here, we'll just, uh, move the coffee table...

sense_groups.chinese: 那边推
sense_groups.english: closer to the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 那茶几就不在座位区正中央了
sense_groups.english: No, whoa, whoa! But then the coffee table won't be centered in the seating area.

sense_groups.chinese: 那茶几就无法配上桌子...罗斯
sense_groups.english: But the coffee table doesn't match the table... Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Hi. Look, what am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不调情 却还是吸引着她 就像火吸引着飞蛾
sense_groups.english: I'm not flirting, but still I'm drawing her to me like a moth to a flame.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What the hell's going on over here?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡会宰了你
sense_groups.english: Monica's gonna kill you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要你们的帮忙
sense_groups.english: Look, I need your help, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得想办法把这个女人吓跑
sense_groups.english: I have to do something to repel this woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们最会把女人吓跑了
sense_groups.english: You guys repel women all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可是结过三次婚
sense_groups.english: Hey, I've been married three times.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我亲眼见识过
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, I've seen it happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们跟女人交柱得好好的 最后却总是能搞砸
sense_groups.english: You get a rapport going with a woman, but somehow you manage to kill it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的秘诀是什么？
sense_groups.english: What's your secret?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们并不会把女人吓跑
sense_groups.english: Look, we do not repel women, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 完全没有这回事
sense_groups.english: That is completely untrue.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们确实会
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes, we do, my man.

sense_groups.chinese: 记不记得大学参加春季舞会
sense_groups.english: Remember back in college when we went to that dance...

sense_groups.chinese: 你走向看对眼的女生
sense_groups.english: and you walked right up to that girl you liked and couldn't stop talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 却大谈爱尔兰马铃薯饥荒？
sense_groups.english: about the Irish potato famine?

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？你当年也没那么酷
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, what about you? You weren't so hot in college either.

sense_groups.chinese: 他每次说完话都会加
sense_groups.english: After everything he said, he'd go

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡也不喜欢 也许我应该改掉
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Monica doesn't like that either. Maybe I should stop doing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 女生不喜欢我聊科学
sense_groups.english: You know what? Girls don't like it when I start talking about science.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是女生
sense_groups.english: That's not specific to girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 还有呢？
sense_groups.english: This is great. This is great. What else?

sense_groups.chinese: 她们不喜欢你纠正她们的文法
sense_groups.english: They don't like you correcting their grammar.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们不喜欢你解释 你的笑话哪袒好笑
sense_groups.english: And they don't like it when you explain why your jokes are funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们不喜欢你一直问她们 喜不喜欢你
sense_groups.english: You know, they don't like it when you keep asking them if they like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 幸好我有摩妮卡 - 我再也别想谈恋爱了
sense_groups.english: Man, I am so lucky I have Monica. - I'm never gonna find love again.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 可以跟你谈谈吗？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, can I talk to you for a second? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我...
sense_groups.english: Okay. Um, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我只是想跟你道歉
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, look, I just wanted to say that I'm sorry, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我处理得很差
sense_groups.english: I handled the situation horribly.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我不该骗你
sense_groups.english: And I should not have lied to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你应该怎样？
sense_groups.english: So what should you have done?

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该跟你说实话
sense_groups.english: Well, I should have told you the truth.

sense_groups.chinese: 而实话是...
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Which is?

sense_groups.chinese: 我之所以不想跟你跑步
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, the reason that I didn't want to go running with you is...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为...
sense_groups.english: because, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑步的姿势有点...
sense_groups.english: well, you know, the way that you run is just a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？ - 很尴尬
sense_groups.english: So? - Well, it's embarrassing.

sense_groups.chinese: 别人都当我们是疯子
sense_groups.english: People were looking at us like we were crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛在意？ - 因为他们是人
sense_groups.english: Why do you care? - Because they're people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不认识也不会再见到的人
sense_groups.english: But people that you don't know and will never see again.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们依旧是人
sense_groups.english: Yes, but still they are people...

sense_groups.chinese: 有眼睛
sense_groups.english: with eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不怕跟喘气小姐跑步
sense_groups.english: Well, I didn't get embarrassed running next to Miss

sense_groups.chinese: 咻 咻 咻 咻
sense_groups.english: Choo, choo, choo, choo.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 好吧
sense_groups.english: But, oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪你会觉得 跟我跑步很尴尬
sense_groups.english: No, no, I can see why running with me would be embarrassing to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很放不开
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay. You're uptight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪有放不开...
sense_groups.english: What? I am not uptight. Whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不会放不开 老兄
sense_groups.english: Listen, I am not uptight, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我不是在批评你 你就是这样
sense_groups.english: That's okay, Rachel. I'm not judging you. That's just who you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就比较自由 我从小就这样跑
sense_groups.english: Me, I'm more free, you know? I run like I did when I was a kid...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这样才好玩
sense_groups.english: because that's the only way it's fun, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你从来没有往前冲到 腿好像快断了吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, didn't you ever run so fast you thought your legs would fall off...

sense_groups.chinese: 例如要跑去玩荡秋千
sense_groups.english: you know, like, when you were running towards the swings...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是在躲魔鬼时？
sense_groups.english: or running away from Satan?

sense_groups.chinese: 邻居的狗
sense_groups.english: The neighbor's dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 这盏灯没摆错吧？
sense_groups.english: Okay, is this lamp in the right place?

sense_groups.chinese: 管他的 我会把女人吓跑
sense_groups.english: Who cares? I repel women.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你不能进来
sense_groups.english: No, no, no! You can't come in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯光着身体
sense_groups.english: Ross is naked!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说我光着身体 她可以看我光着身体
sense_groups.english: I couldn't say that I was naked, because she's allowed to see me naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么一定要有人光着身体？
sense_groups.english: Why does anyone have to be naked?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯为什么光着身体？
sense_groups.english: Why is Ross naked?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要给钱德看一个东西
sense_groups.english: I had to show Chandler something.

sense_groups.chinese: 光着身体看？
sense_groups.english: Naked?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我好像有
sense_groups.english: I guess I have, a, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 男人病
sense_groups.english: A guy problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟钱德的一样吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it the same thing that Chandler had?

sense_groups.chinese: 待会再回来
sense_groups.english: Look, just come back later.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们搞定了你再回来
sense_groups.english: We'll get everything squared away, and you can come back later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听着
sense_groups.english: Okay. Hey, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 浴室洗手台底下 还有钱德的药
sense_groups.english: There's still some of Chandler's medicine left under the sink in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: Thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么病？
sense_groups.english: Dude, what'd you have?

sense_groups.chinese: 没时间了 我们必须专心
sense_groups.english: Look, we have no time, okay? We must focus.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得把一切恢复原状
sense_groups.english: We've got to get everything back into its original place.

sense_groups.chinese: 相簿
sense_groups.english: The photo album.

sense_groups.chinese: 相簿里有一大堆这里的照片
sense_groups.english: There were millions of pictures of the apartment in the photo album.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以拿照片来对
sense_groups.english: We just go through it and match everything to the pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 好主意 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: That's perfect. That's brilliant. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你有什么病？
sense_groups.english: So really, what did you have?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我帮你买了啤酒
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. I've got some beer for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是"帮谁"吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, don't you mean "for whom"?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正想叫彼萨 你要一起吃吗
sense_groups.english: Listen, I was gonna order some pizza. You wanna share one?

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨 我又不是没吃过
sense_groups.english: Pizza? It's not like I never had that before.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there something wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就明说了
sense_groups.english: Let's just get this out in the open, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你很火辣
sense_groups.english: You're hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很俊俏
sense_groups.english: I'm lovable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们两个显然很有感觉
sense_groups.english: Clearly, there's a vibe going on between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们是室友
sense_groups.english: But we're roommates...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能走上这条路
sense_groups.english: and it's a huge mistake for us to continue down this road.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊... - 不 我是说真的
sense_groups.english: Joey... - No, no, no. I'm telling you.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像你住在超市里 这样你就懂了
sense_groups.english: Imagine yourself living in a supermarket and you'll understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Okay? So the question is, what do we do?

sense_groups.chinese: 不怎么办
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't think there is anything to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你人很好
sense_groups.english: I mean, I think you're really sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我对你没兴趣
sense_groups.english: But I'm just not interested in you like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是...
sense_groups.english: No, I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你人真的很好 我很高兴能当你的室友和朋友
sense_groups.english: You're a really nice guy, and I'm happy to be your roommate and your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是我对你
sense_groups.english: I'm just, you know, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有那种感觉
sense_groups.english: don't feel that way about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 哈哈
sense_groups.english: I see what happened. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我一直想把你吓跑
sense_groups.english: It's because I was trying to repel you.

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 等我一放电 情况就不同了
sense_groups.english: Right? Believe me, you'd feel a lot different if I turned it on.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该不会 - 绝对会
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. - Oh, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear God.

sense_groups.chinese: 咻 咻 咻
sense_groups.english: Choo, choo, choo.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你说得对 感觉好爽
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. You're right. This feels great.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧？你不会在意别人的目光
sense_groups.english: See? And you don't care if people are staring.

sense_groups.chinese: 才几秒钟你就跑不见了
sense_groups.english: It's just for a second, because then you're gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 感觉真的好棒 我觉得好自由好优雅
sense_groups.english: It's amazing, Pheebs. I feel so free and so graceful.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 小心那匹 马...
sense_groups.english: Ha! Hey, look out for the horse.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以进去了吗？
sense_groups.english: Is it okay for me to come in now?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么东西都变了？ - 再见
sense_groups.english: Why is everything different? - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有变啊
sense_groups.english: I don't see anything different...

sense_groups.chinese: 只不过你一进来 房里变得更亮了
sense_groups.english: other than the fact that the room got so much brighter when you came into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 小茶几位置不对 沙发怪怪的
sense_groups.english: Well, the end table is wrong, the couch looks bizarre...

sense_groups.chinese: 更别提冰箱上的磁铁
sense_groups.english: and don't even get me started on the refrigerator magnets.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别生气
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, don't be mad, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我整理完东西 想做点让你高兴的事
sense_groups.english: But after I unpacked the boxes, I wanted to do something nice for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我就大扫除
sense_groups.english: so I cleaned the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把东西乱搬
sense_groups.english: So I moved everything around, and then I forgot...

sense_groups.chinese: 却忘了该怎么复原 对不起 对不起
sense_groups.english: where it went back. And I'm sorry, I'm very sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你在怕我吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, are you afraid of me or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怕你吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to be afraid of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是
sense_groups.english: Of course not.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你做了这么棒的事
sense_groups.english: My gosh, Chandler, what you did is a wonderful thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很开心
sense_groups.english: and I really appreciate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我对东西的摆设有怪癖
sense_groups.english: I know I have this thing where I want everything in the perfect place.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我万万没想到你会担心
sense_groups.english: But I'd never expect you to worry about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是真的
sense_groups.english: Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来我抱抱
sense_groups.english: You come here to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 先做该做的事
sense_groups.english: Hold on, okay? First things first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在...
sense_groups.english: Okay. Now...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯光着身体时坐过哪里？
sense_groups.english: Did Ross sit anywhere while he was naked?

sense_groups.chinese: 书上说到了2030年
sense_groups.english: So it said that by the year 2030...

sense_groups.chinese: 有些电脑 能执行
sense_groups.english: there will be computers carrying out the same number of functions...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟人脑一样多的功能
sense_groups.english: as an actual human brain.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以理论上人可以把思想记忆
sense_groups.english: So theoretically, you could download your thoughts...

sense_groups.chinese: 下载到这种电脑上
sense_groups.english: and your memories into this computer...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后以机器的形态长生不死
sense_groups.english: And live forever as a machine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们现在在做什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, so, Janine, do you know what we're doing right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在连结
sense_groups.english: You and I, we're interfacing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I gotta go.

questions.name: S06E08
questions.en:
Hi, my name's Chandler. I just moved in next door.
Would you like to battle me in a post-apocalyptic world...
for control of the galaxy's last remaining energy source?
Sure, neighbor. Come on in.
Is Janine around?
She's at dance class.
Can I check my room?
Don't go through her stuff. She gets really mad.
Oh, my God.
It's like a guy never lived in here.
You gotta be careful. This girl thing is dangerous. It's spreading.
It is?
Is this your pretty pink pillow on the couch?
No.
Is that your tiny little box that's too small to put anything in?
No. - No.
Okay, this is not good. You are a guy, okay?
This is a "guy's" place.
Soon, you'll be soaking your fingers in stuff.
You're right. I'll talk to her. - Talk to her. Be a man.
I'm a man. - Defend yourself.
We have to hem the new dust ruffle.
Be right there, sweetums.
Totally different situation.
Hey, guys.
How was breakfast with Hillary? - Okay.
She's still depressed because she broke up with her boyfriend.
Is this Hillary, your hot assistant chef, Hillary?
Yeah. - The one that stares at me?
No. The one who looked at you once because you got in her way.
Still, I could tell. She was into me.
Why don't you set us up?
Ooh, are you setting Ross up with someone?
Does she have a wedding dress?
Hey. - Hey.
Rachel, I'm making up flyers to try to get new massage clients.
So can I come to Bloomingdale's and use the copy machine?
Well, sure, but they might think it's weird considering I don't work there anymore.
Oh, my God. What happened?
I got a job at Ralph Lauren.
Well, that's great. Congratulations.
A year ago.
You've lasted all year. Good for you.
But, Pheebs, you could still use the copy machine where I actually work.
But come by at lunch so my boss doesn't see you.
Kim will freak out. She already doesn't like me.
I don't think my boss likes me. - I don't think mine likes me either.
Maybe it's a universal thing.
Or maybe because you're all hanging around here at 11:30 on a Wednesday.
Yeah, let's head off to work.
Thank you. - Sure.
You will not believe this.
I was making copies, and Ralph Lauren came in.
Oh, my God. Did you talk to him?
Yeah, a little. He seems really nice.
Good kisser. - What?
What?
You kissed him? - Totally.
Phoebe, are you serious?
Yeah, I was just in there, he came in and introduced himself.
The next thing I know, we're making out.
Phoebe, you do know he's married?
No.
Phoebe.
What am I supposed to do, ask every guy I make out with if he's married?
No, yeah, I should.
Hey, Joey. - Hey.
Uh, can I talk to you for a second? There's a kid in this picture.
Do you, uh, know this kid? Is it a relative?
No. I just thought it was cute.
Yeah, that's what I was afraid of. Okay, uh...
Look, Janine, I really want you to feel at home here, but...
some of this new stuff, it's too girlie.
Oh. Like what?
Uh, like this. Pictures of cute babies we don't know.
We can't have that.
Joey, it's Anne Geddes. She's a famous artist.
I don't know this baby. I don't know if she's a famous artist or not.
I don't want to be a jerk, but you're changing too much around here.
I'm sorry. I just thought I'd try and make the place a little nicer.
Yeah, but it's too much stuff.
You know, you got the candles and the "foofy schmoofer" thing here.
Over here, you got a picture of a watering can.
I just thought... - I'm sure it's a famous watering can.
But come on.
And what is with the really hot stick in the bathroom?
It's a curling iron.
Oh. Well, that's okay then.
Okay, my towels, for instance. I come into the bathroom...
and my towel is not on the floor, where I keep it.
It's up here on some hook. And it smells different.
It's clean. - Yeah, well, it feels different.
It's dry.
All right, I can make my peace with the clean, dry towels.
Okay, also, what is with these chips you bought?
No, no, no. It's potpourri. You're supposed to smell it.
Well, that's like summer in a bowl.
Oh.
Kim, hi.
Uh-huh.
So I handed in that marketing report, and I never got to hear what you thought.
I didn't read it. - Ah.
So, wow, the spring line's really gonna be great this year, huh?
Yeah.
So I hear, uh, Ralph Lauren fooled around with someone in the copy room.
Tell me everything.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
What's up?
You know...
Oh, my God.
What happened to your teeth?
I whitened them.
Really?
Yeah, what do you think?
I think I shouldn't look directly at them.
Come on, seriously.
They're really, really, really white. - What was wrong with your old...
human teeth?
I did leave the gel on a little longer than it said to.
How much longer? - A day.
Ross, tonight is your date with Hillary.

sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说罗夫罗兰在影印室 跟某人亲热
sense_groups.english: So I hear, uh, Ralph Lauren fooled around with someone in the copy room.

sense_groups.chinese: 从头说起
sense_groups.english: Tell me everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样啊？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是...
sense_groups.english: You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的牙齿怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What happened to your teeth?

sense_groups.chinese: 我漂白了
sense_groups.english: I whitened them.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, what do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我不该直视它
sense_groups.english: I think I shouldn't look directly at them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说真的
sense_groups.english: Come on, seriously.

sense_groups.chinese: 也白得太夸张了 - 你原来的
sense_groups.english: They're really, really, really white. - What was wrong with your old...

sense_groups.chinese: 牙齿呢？
sense_groups.english: human teeth?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确把漂白胶上得比较久
sense_groups.english: I did leave the gel on a little longer than it said to.

sense_groups.chinese: 有多久？ - 1天
sense_groups.english: How much longer? - A day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道今晚要跟希拉蕊约会吧
sense_groups.english: Ross, tonight is your date with Hillary.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道 所以我才漂白牙齿 真的有那么糟吗？
sense_groups.english: I know. That's why I did it. Are they really that bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: No. No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心好了 希拉蕊是瞎子吧？
sense_groups.english: You'll be fine. Hillary's blind, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 过了今晚就是了
sense_groups.english: She will be after tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你有没有发现...
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rach. Uh, do you notice anything...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的牙齿？我在外面就看到了
sense_groups.english: Your teeth? Yes, I saw them from outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 说了你们绝对不信
sense_groups.english: You guys are never gonna believe this...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟罗夫罗兰亲热
sense_groups.english: but Phoebe made out with Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 她去我的办公室 然后他们就亲热了
sense_groups.english: She ran into him at my office, and they just made out.

sense_groups.chinese: 最扯的是我因此赢得老板欢心
sense_groups.english: The craziest thing is, now my boss likes me because...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说这是这一整年最棒的八卦
sense_groups.english: it's the best gossip she's heard all year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天真以我的朋友们为荣
sense_groups.english: I am proud of all my friends today.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比居然跟罗夫罗兰亲热
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I can't believe Phoebe made out with Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是忌妒死了
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I'm so jealous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是钱德 你活生生的男朋友
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Chandler, your live-in boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Chandler, please. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己看
sense_groups.english: Look at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是女人 不过他还真秀色可餐
sense_groups.english: Well, I am no woman, but that is one tasty dish.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去
sense_groups.english: Here. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个银发老帅哥是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's the silver fox?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的亲热对象 你不认得吗？
sense_groups.english: That is your make-out buddy. Don't you recognize him?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等...菲比我爱你 吻我
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. "Ooh, Phoebe, I love you. Kiss me, please."

sense_groups.chinese: 那才不是罗夫罗兰 不过声音有像
sense_groups.english: That's not Ralph Lauren. It sounds like him, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗夫跟他一点也不像
sense_groups.english: Yeah, no, Ralph doesn't look like that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他很年轻 长发落腮胡 背个大包包
sense_groups.english: He's young, and he's got long hair and a beard and a Hacky Sack...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 那不是罗夫罗兰 那是影印小弟肯尼
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. That's not Ralph Lauren. That's Kenny the copy guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 完了 我还跑去告诉我老板
sense_groups.english: Oh, God... I told my boss that someone made out with Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她发现我骗她 一定会更讨厌我 菲比
sense_groups.english: If she finds out that I lied to her, she is gonna hate me even more. Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 那个小弟为什么自称罗夫罗兰
sense_groups.english: Why would the copy guy say he's Ralph Lauren?

sense_groups.chinese: 好骗你跟他亲热啊
sense_groups.english: To get you to make out with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许这件能压住你的白牙
sense_groups.english: Okay, maybe this will make them look less white.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: Nope. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没有用的颜色有
sense_groups.english: Okay, so colors that don't work are...

sense_groups.chinese: 蓝黄绿红黑白橘和紫
sense_groups.english: blue, yellow, green, red, black, white, orange and purple.

sense_groups.chinese: 离约会只剩1小时 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't know what I'm gonna do. The date starts in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你的肤色白一点 牙齿就不会那么显眼
sense_groups.english: Ross, maybe if your skin was lighter, your teeth wouldn't look so bright.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 所以我去换肤就行了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. So all I need to do is get some new skin. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你可以化点妆
sense_groups.english: If we put just a little bit of makeup on you...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 喔
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经不是13岁了
sense_groups.english: We're not 13 anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩这个可行的办法
sense_groups.english: Ross, this is the only thing left that has a shot at working.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会发现我有化妆吗？
sense_groups.english: Won't she notice I have makeup on?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 半数的男人都有化妆
sense_groups.english: Half the guys out there have makeup on.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 半数的人 你就试试看嘛
sense_groups.english: Half the people... I mean... Just try it and see.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我死也不化妆
sense_groups.english: No, I am not putting on makeup.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 帮我贴几张传单好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? Ross, could you put up some of these flyers for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 魔鬼！魔鬼！
sense_groups.english: No! Demon! Demon!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样抽屉就会香香的 旧裤袜也没浪费
sense_groups.english: Now our drawers will smell nice, and we didn't waste these pantyhose.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 扔旧内衣会遭天打雷劈
sense_groups.english: God forbid we throw out old underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去乔伊那边
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna go over to Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还要整理包装纸抽屉
sense_groups.english: We're supposed to organize the wrapping paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我今天已经够女性化了
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I've really gotten in touch with my feminine side enough today.

sense_groups.chinese: 再缝两个香袋 我们就要变成女同志了
sense_groups.english: In fact, we're two sachets away from becoming a lesbian couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天的确很女孩子气 你说得对 抱歉
sense_groups.english: This has been kind of a girlie day. You're right. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 我只是想去男人的家
sense_groups.english: It's okay. I just feel like I need to be in a guy place...

sense_groups.chinese: 做男人做的事
sense_groups.english: do kind of a man thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 去乔伊家吧
sense_groups.english: Go over to Joey's and...

sense_groups.chinese: 去乔伊家喝啤酒槌墙壁
sense_groups.english: drink some beer and hammer up some dry wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人并非只会喝酒槌墙壁
sense_groups.english: When guys hang out, they don't just drink beer and hammer up dry wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 女生也不会穿内衣打枕头仗
sense_groups.english: When girls hang out, we don't have pillow fights in our underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我们会
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. We do. We do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道为什么说不会
sense_groups.english: I don't know why I said that.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 进来 我们在织隔热手套
sense_groups.english: Come on in. We're knitting potholders.

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 乔瑟芬
sense_groups.english: No, thanks, Josephine.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我想说...
sense_groups.english: Ross, I was wondering if...

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 男人都死哪去了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Where are all the men?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 金 - 嗨 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hi, Kim. - Hi, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我昨天说的事吗？ 其实没那回事
sense_groups.english: Uh, remember that thing that happened yesterday? Well, it didn't happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有取消台湾的布料订单？
sense_groups.english: You didn't cancel the fabric order from Taiwan?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 有两件事没那回事
sense_groups.english: Okay, two things didn't happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说有人在影印室 跟罗夫罗兰亲热？
sense_groups.english: Remember I told you someone made out with Ralph Lauren?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果是假的
sense_groups.english: Well, it turns out that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 是假的？那就好玩了
sense_groups.english: It's not true? Oh, that's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我去查过 昨天午休时间
sense_groups.english: Because I checked. Only one keycard was used to access the copy machine...

sense_groups.chinese: 刷卡进影印室的 只有你一个
sense_groups.english: yesterday during lunch, and that keycard belonged to you, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不...天哪 你以为我跟他亲热
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, no, no. Oh, God, you think I made out with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 要是你以为跟罗夫上床 就能坐上我的位子
sense_groups.english: Listen to me, if you think sleeping with Ralph is gonna get you my job...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就错了
sense_groups.english: you are sadly mistaken.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想坐你的位子 真的
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I don't want your job. I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是天大的误会 我没跟他亲热
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is such a mistake. I didn't make out with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人跟他亲热 我昨天没用我的卡
sense_groups.english: Nobody made out with him. I did not use my keycard yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我连刷卡都不会
sense_groups.english: I don't even know how to use my keycard.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗夫 - 嗨 金
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ralph. - Hi, Kim.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 没跟他亲热
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Nothing happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才的情欲张力一触即发
sense_groups.english: You could cut the sexual tension in here with a knife.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后我也只能去当厨师
sense_groups.english: After that, what could I do except become a chef?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我将来想自己开餐厅
sense_groups.english: And someday soon, I hope to open my own restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很善于倾听
sense_groups.english: You know, you're a really great listener.

sense_groups.chinese: 我交往过的男人多半讲个不停
sense_groups.english: Most guys I go out with, they just talk and talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 听到后来真想叫他们闭嘴
sense_groups.english: After a while, it's like, "Shut your mouth." You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说太多了 来聊聊你吧
sense_groups.english: I've probably been talking too much. Why don't we talk about you?

sense_groups.chinese: 说嘛 我想知道
sense_groups.english: Come on, I want to know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我是长岛人
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm from Long Island.

sense_groups.chinese: 来纽约念书
sense_groups.english: I came to the city for college.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个5岁的儿子 平常喜欢
sense_groups.english: Um, I, uh, have a 5-year-old son, and in my spare time...

sense_groups.chinese: 看看谍报小说 再来聊聊你吧
sense_groups.english: I like to read spy novels. But let's talk more about you. Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 很棒的是如果先把花茎底部 在平底锅上烤一下
sense_groups.english: So if you sear the stems of the flowers first in a frying pan...

sense_groups.chinese: 花就能开得更久
sense_groups.english: your arrangement will look fresh much longer.

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒的小秘诀
sense_groups.english: Joey, that is such a great tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 请你出去一下 我有事找那位插花的女士
sense_groups.english: Monica, can you excuse us? I need to talk to the girl with the flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你待会过来
sense_groups.english: Okay, but, Joey, come over later.

sense_groups.chinese: 我教你 用松果和花生酱
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna teach you how to make a bird feeder...

sense_groups.chinese: 做喂鸟器
sense_groups.english: out of just a pine cone and some peanut butter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最喜欢鸟了
sense_groups.english: Aw. I love birds.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么搞的？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你在插花
sense_groups.english: What? - You're arranging flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还摆弄干花
sense_groups.english: You got dead flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 你挂扮成一朵花的宝宝照片
sense_groups.english: You've got a picture of a baby dressed like flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是乔伊
sense_groups.english: This is not Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是乔伊 好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, look, I am still Joey, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 花只不过是很好看
sense_groups.english: Flowers, they're just, you know, nice to look at.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一个名摄影师照的 宝宝也很有名
sense_groups.english: And that happens to be a picture by a famous artist of a famous baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你正在变成女人
sense_groups.english: You're turning into a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么这么说？ 好恶劣喔
sense_groups.english: Why would you say that? That's just mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我惹你生气了？我说了什么？
sense_groups.english: Now I've upset you? What did I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你说了什么 是你的口气
sense_groups.english: It's not what you said. It's the way you said it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是女人
sense_groups.english: I'm a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在她觉得我跟他上床 好把她踢下去
sense_groups.english: So now she thinks that I made out with him and that I did it to get her job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么不跟她说实话？ - 我说了
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you just tell the truth? - I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是她觉得不会有人蠢到 把影印小弟当成罗夫罗兰
sense_groups.english: She doesn't think anyone would confuse Kenny the copy guy with Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果肯尼才是公司的首脑呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what if Kenny were the real brains behind the whole company?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好罗夫罗兰只是个门面
sense_groups.english: What if Kenny hired that Ralph guy to be the pretty front man, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 她想过吗？
sense_groups.english: Did she ever think of that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天跟肯尼约会了吧？
sense_groups.english: You were with Kenny today, weren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 就一小会儿 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Just for a second. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我该怎么办？ - 唔...
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what am I gonna do? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 你只好跟罗夫罗兰上床了
sense_groups.english: The only thing you can do. Sleep with Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不跟罗夫罗兰上床 我可以 但是我不会
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna sleep with Ralph Lauren. I mean, I could, but I wouldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟肯尼上床
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Sleep with Kenny.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样对我也没好处 - 好处可大了
sense_groups.english: That wouldn't help me. - Oh, yes, it would.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚真的很开心 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: I've had a really good time tonight. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很少第一次约会 就这么心有灵犀
sense_groups.english: You know, I rarely connect with someone this much on the first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很开心
sense_groups.english: Uh, I've had a really good time too, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃那块面包吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna eat that bread?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是喜欢闻
sense_groups.english: Oh, I just like the smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好好笑
sense_groups.english: You make me laugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要去沙发上坐？
sense_groups.english: Would you like to move over to the couch?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把灯光调暗一点好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'll just turn down the lights a little?

sense_groups.chinese: 干脆关灯如何？
sense_groups.english: How about all the way?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好酷的海报
sense_groups.english: Wow, cool poster.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是要说好抢眼的海报
sense_groups.english: Or should I say, "groovy poster"?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: So, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才聊到哪里？
sense_groups.english: where were we?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的牙齿吗？
sense_groups.english: Are those your teeth?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看得见是吧？
sense_groups.english: You can see them, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 白得很吓人
sense_groups.english: Yes. They're insanely white.

sense_groups.chinese: 我特地为你漂白的
sense_groups.english: I did that for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有毛病吗？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有毛病？你还装黑光灯咧 都1999年了
sense_groups.english: What's the matter with me? You've got a black light. It's 1999.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 金
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. Kim, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我一直想问你 你看过新的罗夫罗兰床单吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rachel. Oh. I wanted to ask you, have you seen the new Ralph Lauren sheets?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想什么 你当然看过
sense_groups.english: What am I thinking? Of course you have.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉之前对你说谎
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry that I lied to you before.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜得没错 罗夫和我交往过 但已经结束了
sense_groups.english: You were right. Ralph and I were an item, but we're not anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他甩了我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he dumped me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说"瑞秋 我不能这样"

sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

questions.name: S06E09
questions.en:
Okay, great. Bye.
So guess who's coming to Thanksgiving dinner.
Sidney Poitier? Ha, ha.
I miss Rachel.
No, my parents.
Oh, great, they haven't seen the place since I moved in.
Yeah, and if you could not mention that we live together, that'd be great.
I was thinking we'd eat around 4.
Why can't I tell them we live together?
They don't know we're dating. Should we eat in the kitchen?
Why haven't you told them?
Um, well, I was going to. I really was.
But, um, then somewhere, just out of nowhere, I didn't.
Why haven't you told them? Wouldn't they be happy?
So, dinner in the kitchen around 4. I'll see you then.
Why wouldn't they be happy?
Well, um, because...
mainly, um...
they don't like you.
I'm sorry. - What? Why? Why?
Maybe because you used to be aloof...
or that you're really sarcastic or that you joke around all the time...
or that you take off your clothes and throw them on the couch.
Is this why they don't like me or why you don't like me?
I know I should have told them. I know I shouldn't care what they think.
I'm sorry.
You know, it'll be okay, because when they come over, I will be charming.
I will make them love me, then we'll tell them.
You think that'll work?
Hey, I can be pretty charming, babe. I won you over, didn't I?
I don't think you'll ever get my parents that drunk.
Hey. Oh, good, Ross. Your parents like me, right?
Yes, of course they like you.
Monica told me they don't.
Yeah, they don't like you.
Do you know why?
Maybe it's because you're really sarcastic, or maybe it's because you...
If people don't know, they shouldn't just guess.
Great. Another Thanksgiving with nothing to give thanks for.
Maybe I give thanks for you shutting up, huh?
Maybe I give thanks by taking my PlayStation to my new apartment.
Maybe I love you.
Hi. - Hi.
Hey, guys.
No, I don't want to play video games, Joey.
Are you guys going to Chandler's for Thanksgiving?
Yeah, why, what's up?
Well, me and my dancer friends are doing Thanksgiving uptown.
I thought you might like to come.
For real?
You should go to Chandler's. None of us can cook.
We'll probably just drink all day.
We go to yours. - Yeah.
Yeah, see, we have to stop across the hall because it's my sister.
But, you know, actually, uh, growing up with a sister was nice...
because it really helped me understand women.
Yeah, you should tell your friends that.
Okay.
How you got three women to marry you, I'll never know.
Hey. - Hey.
Pheebs, check it out. For my dessert...
I have chosen to make a traditional English trifle.
Wow, that sounds great. And what are you making, Monica?
In case Rachel's dessert is so good that I eat all of it...
and there's none left for anybody else.
Nothing.
Nothing?
No, sweetie. I trust you.
So if I mess this up, there's nothing else for dessert?
You're not gonna mess it up.
Wow, Monica, I love that. You really have faith in me. Thank you.
Technical question: How do you know when the butter is done?
Well, it's done about two minutes before it looks like that.
Hey. - Hey.
Oh. The food smells great, Mon. - And the place looks so nice.
Hey, happy Thanksgiving, everybody. - Happy Thanksgiving.
Happy Thanksgiving.
Well, this has been great. - See you.
Whoa, whoa, whoa.
Where you going? - Oh, oh.
We did say we'd stop by this little thing Joey's roommate is having.
Oh, Janine, the really hot dancer girl?
Some would say she's attractive, yes.
Who else is going to be there?
Uh, some of her friends. - Her dancer friends?
Yes. All right?
All of her hot dancer friends are gonna be there...
and they'll be drinking and dancing and we really want to go.
Dude, we were good.
You're not going. You said you'd eat here and you'll eat here.
Yeah, and leaving us to go see hot dancer girls...
is not very Thanksgiving-y.
Oh, but it is.
Uh, it's like the first Thanksgiving when the Indians and Pilgrims sat down.
Yeah, and then the Indians taught the Pilgrims...
what it meant to be hot in the New World.
Hello, everybody. - Hi.
Hi, Dad. Mom.
Look. Look who it is. It's Chandler.
Oh, yes, of course. Hello, Chandler.
Mr. And Mrs. Geller, you look wonderful.
It is great to have you here. Let us take your coats.
Whoa, it snowing out there?
No.
Monica, all this food looks wonderful.
You should think about doing this for a living.
Okay, I have dandruff. There's no need to laugh and point.
Dad, Chandler was laughing at your joke.
My joke wasn't funny.
Rach, I just remembered.
I had a dream about Mr. Geller last night.
Really?
Yeah. I dreamt that he saved me from a burning building...
and he was so brave and so strong.
And it's making me look at him totally differently.
You know, I mean, he used to be just "Jack Geller, Monica and Ross' dad."
Now he's "Jack Geller, dream hunk."
I don't know. To me, he'll always be "Jack Geller...
walks in while you're changing."
You know, Dad, Chandler is one of Ross' very best friends.
Ross sure is a great guy.
You know, I've always felt that how a young man turns out...
is a reflection on his father.
I always thought that too. Tell me, what does your father do?
He's a headliner of a...
gay burlesque show.
Rach, you're killing us. Will you serve the dessert already?
There's drunken dancers a-waiting.
Look at it. Isn't it beautiful?
Yeah. What is it?
It's a trifle. It's got all these layers.
First there's a layer of ladyfingers, then a layer of jam...
then custard, which I made from scratch...
then raspberries, more ladyfingers...
then beef sautéed with peas and onions...
then a little bit more custard...
then bananas and then I put whipped cream on top.
What was the one right before bananas?
The beef. Yeah, that was weird to me too.
But then I thought, "Well, there's minced meat pie."
That's an English dessert.
These people just put very strange things in their food.
By the way, can I borrow rum from your place?
Yeah, sure.
And while I'm gone, don't you boys sneak a taste.
Okay. - Okay.
Beef in a dessert?
No, no, no. There is no way.
I know. And only one layer ofjam?
What is up with that?
Oh, my God.
The pages are stuck together. - Chandler.
Oh, my God. She made half an English trifle and...
half a shepherd's pie.
Man, now she's gonna start all over.
We're never gonna get to introduce the hot girls to the New World.
No, no, we will. We just won't tell her she messed up.
Just let her serve the beef-custard thing?
Yeah. It'll be like a funny Thanksgiving story.
Vomiting stories are funny, I guess.
Joey. God, your apartment is like a hundred degrees.
Did it make you want to walk around in your underwear?
No.
Still not hot enough.
Rachel. Okay, look at him.
Look at those strong hands.
Oh, what I wouldn't give to be that can of condensed milk.
Mom, uh, Chandler was just saying how beautiful your sweater is.
Oh, thank you, Chandler. I just bought it.
Oh. Yes, well, it's very beautiful and it's cream-colored and tight and...
I don't mean tight. It's not too tight. Not that I was looking at...
What's the matter with him?
I think he's stoned again.
What? - What?
Dude, I need to talk to you a sec.
Okay, I think I might know why my parents don't like you.
You do? Why? - Okay, remember we were young. Heh.
Spring break, sophomore year, I got high in my bedroom...
and my parents walked in and smelled it...
so I told them that you had gotten stoned and jumped out the window.
What? Why did you do that?
I don't know. Uh, yours was the first name that popped into my head.
I'm sorry. I didn't think it'd matter.
How could it not matter?
How was I to know we'd be friends after college...
let alone you'd be living with my sister?
What about all that "friends forever" stuff?
I don't know. I was all high.
Mom and Dad just sent me to find out if you were trying to get Ross stoned.
Your parents caught Ross smoking pot in college, and he blamed it on me.
Ross, I can't believe you'd do that.
We haven't told them we're together because they hate me, okay? So fix this.
Okay, okay, I'll tell them it wasn't Chandler who got high.
Now, who should I say it was?
You. It's not like it's a big deal. You don't still do it or anything.
All right. Now, who should I say tricked me into doing it?
Dad.
Dad, please don't pick your teeth out here.
And if you're gonna put your feet up... - Monica, leave him alone.
Will you hurry up?
Did you not hear me when I told you that all of Janine's friends are dancers?
Huh? And that they're gonna be drinking a lot?
No, I did. But tell me again because it's so romantic.
You're whipping so slow. Can't you do it any faster?
Joey, come on, I don't want to make any mistakes.
This is the only dessert. If I screw it up, everybody's gonna be like
"Oh, remember that Thanksgiving when Rachel screwed up the trifle?"
So just let me worry about making it, and you just worry about eating it.
Oh, I am.
Ross, if you don't tell them, then I will. - Okay. Fine.
Ross, can I talk to you for a second? - Oh, uh...
Can it wait a second, Joey? I have to tell my parents something.
No, it can't? Okay.
Okay, look, I think we have to tell Rachel she messed up her dessert.
What? What is with everybody?
It's Thanksgiving, not...
Truth Day.
Look, when everyone eats that banana-meat thing...
they'll all make fun of her. Do you want that?
Okay. We'll just get everyone to act like they like it.
That way, no one makes fun of her...
and we still get to go to sweet potato pie.
Dude, they're not objects.
Oh.
Just kidding. I'll talk to them. You distract her.
Hey, Rach, can I talk to you outside for a sec?
Okay.
What's up, Ross?
So, um...
Thanksgiving.
The holiday season is upon us, hmm?
Yeah.
And, um...
you look nice today.
Oh, no. No, Ross, don't do this. - What?
I just don't think us getting back together is a good idea.
Huh?
I thought this might happen today.
Ross, I know the holidays can be rough...
and it's probably really hard for you to be alone right now.
You're alone.
No, I live with Phoebe.
I mean, you're alone-alone.
And it's just not the time for us. I'm sorry.
Oh, well. Can't blame a guy for trying.
And, uh, if anyone needs help pretending to like it...
I learned some things in acting class. Try, uh, rubbing your stomach.
Or, uh, saying "Mm."
And, uh, oh, smiling.
Okay?
Yeah, I'm not gonna pay for those acting classes anymore.
Rachel, there you are. Let's serve that dessert already.
Joey, you have to stop rushing me. You know what? You don't get any dessert.
Really?
No, just kidding. I would never do that to you.
Okay, everybody, it's trifle time.
So, now, Rach, this is a traditional English trifle, isn't it?
It sure is. - Wow.
So did you make it with beef or eggplant?
Beef. - I can't have any. I don't eat meat. Oh.
Aw.
Monica, I want you to have the first taste.
Really?
Wait, you only got whipped cream.
You gotta take a bite with all the layers.
Okay.
You dropped a pea.
Well?
Mm.
It's good.
Really? How good?
It's so good that I feel really selfish...
about being the only one who's eating it.
I think we should have everyone taste how good it is.
Especially Ross.
Mm-hm.
Mm.
Yeah. This is so good that I'm gonna go enjoy it on the balcony.
So that I can enjoy the view whilst I enjoy my dessert.
I've gotta call my friend...
and tell her how good this is from Monica's room.
I'll help you dial.
I'm gonna go into the bathroom...
so I can look at it in the mirror as I eat it.
Okay, what was that all about? Does it not taste good?
Let me try it. - No, no.
All gone.
So good.
Maybe Chandler has some left.
It tastes like feet.
I like it.
Are you kidding?
What's not to like? Custard, good.
Jam, good. Meat, good.
So a bird just grabbed it...
and then tried to fly away with it...
and then just dropped it on the street?
Yes, but, if it's any consolation, before the bird dropped it...
he seemed to enjoy it.
Rachel, come here.
Okay.
I was just taking my Thanksgiving nap and I had another dream about Jack.
Phoebe, do I want to hear this? - I don't know, let's see.
Okay, I dreamt we were getting married...
and he left because he had to go fight a fire.
And, um, so, okay, I went to a nightclub and I saw him making out with a girl.
Oh, my God, he dream-cheated on you.
Yeah. But then Jacques Cousteau came...
and he kicked his ass for betraying me.
It was so cool.
Then he took me diving and introduced me to his pet sea horse...
who was coming on to me. And, please, that is not gonna happen.
Boy, I'm glad I wore the big belt today.
Five minutes ago, a line like that would have floored me.
But now, nothing. Well, not nothing. I am still a woman.
Ross? Let's go.
Oh, yeah. About telling Mom and Dad...
I was thinking about maybe writing a letter.
You know what? That's it. You've had your chance.
what?
Mom, Dad. Ross smoked pot in college.
What? - What?
You are such a tattletale.
Mom, Dad, heh...
you remember that time you walked in my room...
and smelled marijuana?
Yes. - Yes.
I told you it was Chandler...
who was smoking the pot but...
it was me. I'm sorry.
It was you?
And, Dad, you know that mailman that you got fired?
He didn't steal your Playboys. Ross did.
Well, Hurricane Gloria didn't break the porch swing. Monica did.
Ross hasn't worked at the museum for a year.
Monica and Chandler are living together!
Ross married Rachel in Vegas. And got divorced. Again!
I love Jacques Cousteau.
I wasn't supposed to put beef in the trifle.
I want to go!
That's a lot of information to get in 30 seconds.
All right. Joey, if you want to leave, just leave.
Rachel, no, you weren't supposed to put beef in the trifle.
It did not taste good.
Phoebe, I'm sorry...
but I think Jacques Cousteau is dead.
Monica, why you felt you had to hide the fact...
that you're in an important relationship is beyond me.
And we kind of figured about the porch swing.
Ross.
Drugs?
Divorced again?
What happened, son?
I... I, uh... I got tricked into all those things.
Chandler, you've been Ross' best friend all these years...
stuck by him during the drug problems...
and now you've taken on Monica as well.
Well, I don't know what to say.
You're a wonderful human being.
Thank you. - No.
Thank you.
Monica and Ross, I don't know what I'm gonna do about the two of you.
I'll talk to them.
You guys, it was bananas...
cream and beef.
I just cannot believe that you ate that so that I wouldn't feel bad.
Well, actually, I didn't eat mine. It's still in the bathroom.
No it isn't, I ate that.
And we left ours in Monica's bedroom.
Nope, got it and got yours too.
