sense_groups.chinese: 钱德跟我一直在一对情侣朋友 现在总算找到了
sense_groups.english: We wanted a couple to go out with and now we have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是成双又成对
sense_groups.english: We're a couple of couples.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚真开心 那家餐厅好棒
sense_groups.english: I had so much fun tonight. What a great restaurant!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我居然让你请客
sense_groups.english: And Chandler, I can't believe I let you pay for this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 再次感谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks again, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天要不要过来？我来做我说的那种意大利面
sense_groups.english: If you come over tomorrow, I'll make pasta.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太好了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: That'd be great! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过至少让我们带酒来
sense_groups.english: But at least let us bring the wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 不必客气了 - 不行 我坚持
sense_groups.english: You don't have to. - Ah, I insist.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会买吧？ - 会啦
sense_groups.english: You'll get the wine, right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就晚安 - 明天见
sense_groups.english: Okay, good night. - See you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好期待喔
sense_groups.english: Can't wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要怎么逃过一劫？
sense_groups.english: How are we going to get out of that one?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我没办法连续应酬他们...
sense_groups.english: What? - I can't handle two nights in a row...

sense_groups.chinese: 两晚
sense_groups.english: with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和钱德有什么不好？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with them?

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得 他们就是有点...
sense_groups.english: They're just a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 哈啦
sense_groups.english: blah!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈啦？
sense_groups.english: Blah?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很哈啦 她...
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, he's blah. She's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 她很娇小嗓门却很大
sense_groups.english: She's very loud for such a small person.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是我最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Uh, they're my best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能跟他们往来吗？ 那可就麻烦了
sense_groups.english: Are you saying we can't go out? 'Cause that'd be a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 往来当然可以
sense_groups.english: Of course we can still hang out with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是不要连续两晚
sense_groups.english: Just not two nights in a row.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay? - I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我卖了朋友 给你买礼物都行
sense_groups.english: I'll sell my friends and use the money to buy you presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒的桌子 在哪里买的？
sense_groups.english: Ooh! What a great table! Where did you get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜
sense_groups.english: Guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 跳蚤市场？
sense_groups.english: Um, a flea market?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你会一猜就中
sense_groups.english: Ha, I knew you would get it on the first guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 很酷吧 这是药师桌
sense_groups.english: Isn't it cool? It's an apothecary table.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: Ah, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以想像 他们就是把药材...
sense_groups.english: You can just imagine that this is where...

sense_groups.chinese: 存放在这里面
sense_groups.english: they kept all their stuff to make potions.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道？ - 对啊
sense_groups.english: You know? - Ooh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 几乎能闻到鸦片的味道
sense_groups.english: Ooh, you can almost smell the opium.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Almost.

sense_groups.chinese: 多少钱？
sense_groups.english: Oh, how much was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 才5百
sense_groups.english: Just only 500 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 跳蚤市场买的要5百？
sense_groups.english: 500 bucks at a flea market?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你是问...
sense_groups.english: I thought you meant how much was it...

sense_groups.chinese: 当年全新时的价钱
sense_groups.english: when it was new, back then.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 - 就是说嘛
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - Yeah, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为是跳蚤市场 所以差不多1块钱
sense_groups.english: It was at a flea market, so it was like a dollar.

sense_groups.chinese: 1块钱？ - 再加50元
sense_groups.english: A dollar? - And fifty?

sense_groups.chinese: 总共51元
sense_groups.english: So it was like one and fifty dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们用古法算钱 - 对
sense_groups.english: They gave you the old-time pricing. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是哪个年代的？
sense_groups.english: Well, what period is it from?

sense_groups.chinese: 往昔年代
sense_groups.english: Uh, it's from yore.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是往昔的时代
sense_groups.english: Like, the "days of yore," you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 真是太完美 - 确实不错
sense_groups.english: It's just perfect. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一定有很棒的典故
sense_groups.english: I bet it has a great story too.

sense_groups.chinese: 卖方有提到它的出处或...
sense_groups.english: Did they tell you where it's from or...

sense_groups.chinese: 有 这个我知道 它来自白原
sense_groups.english: Yes, that I know. This is from, uh, White Plains.

sense_groups.chinese: 白原 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: White Plains. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来好神奇
sense_groups.english: Ooh, it sounds like such a magical place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来了 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: I'm here. - Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢吗？ - 完了
sense_groups.english: You like it? - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的新药师桌
sense_groups.english: It's my new apothecary table!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 菲比就快到了 不能让她看到
sense_groups.english: Phoebe'll be here any second. She can't see this.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？她一定会喜欢 这是好东西
sense_groups.english: Why not? She'll love it. It's the real thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 是在陶瓷货仓买的
sense_groups.english: I got it at Pottery Barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我也买了一张
sense_groups.english: I know. I bought the same one.

sense_groups.chinese: 她看到你的桌子 就会知道我骗她
sense_groups.english: And if she sees your table, she'll know I lied.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我们的是原版 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I said ours was an original. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她讨厌陶瓷货仓
sense_groups.english: Because she hates Pottery Barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 她讨厌陶瓷货仓？
sense_groups.english: She hates Pottery Barn?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很惊讶 她说那是量产
sense_groups.english: She says it's all mass-produced...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有真品 大家买的都一样
sense_groups.english: nothing is authentic, and everyone winds up having the same stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 她随时会进来 拿个东西盖住它好吗？
sense_groups.english: So come on! Can we cover this up, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: What? No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不要遮遮掩掩的
sense_groups.english: I am not gonna hide it from Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我也买了很漂亮的床单
sense_groups.english: Although I did get some great Pottery Barn sheets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了他们也有出床单
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I forgot they made sheets!

sense_groups.chinese: 废话
sense_groups.english: Heh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她居然会讨厌陶瓷货仓
sense_groups.english: I still can't believe she hates Pottery Barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再念了 她又不是讨厌你
sense_groups.english: It's not like she hates you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是陶瓷货仓耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but Pottery Barn?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得根本是她怪胎
sense_groups.english: You know what I think? She's just weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她是双胞胎 双胞胎都很怪
sense_groups.english: It's because she's a twin. Twins are weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是怪 她只是希望她的东西独一无二
sense_groups.english: She's not weird. She likes her stuff to be one-of-a-kind.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么最不独一无二？双胞胎
sense_groups.english: Huh. You know what's not one-of-a-kind? A twin!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比来了 把灯关掉看电影吧
sense_groups.english: Let's turn out the lights and watch the movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 好...好漂亮的床单 - 喜欢是吧？
sense_groups.english: Hey, ooh, cool sheet! - You like it?

sense_groups.chinese: 想知道哪里买的吗？ - 好啊
sense_groups.english: You want to know where I got it? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是在跳蚤市场买的
sense_groups.english: At a flea market.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上跳蚤市场买床单？
sense_groups.english: You buy your sheets at a flea market?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别这么小气吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, you gotta loosen the purse strings a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐再过20分钟就好了 好兴奋喔
sense_groups.english: Dinner will be ready in 20 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你今晚要带过来的酒
sense_groups.english: Here is the wine to bring over tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想送花给摩妮卡...
sense_groups.english: You were also gonna buy Monica flowers...

sense_groups.chinese: 却买不起 因为你付了昨晚晚餐的钱
sense_groups.english: but you couldn't because you paid for dinner last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 但今晚只有我要过去
sense_groups.english: Thanks. But, uh, it's just gonna be me tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉宁怎么了？ - 她病得很重
sense_groups.english: What happened to Janine? - She's, uh, really sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 真糟糕 - 对啊 她整天都在房里
sense_groups.english: That's too bad. - Yeah, she's been in there all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 发高烧 鼻塞...
sense_groups.english: Uh, high fever, nose problem. It's...

sense_groups.chinese: 痰痰痰痰痰
sense_groups.english: phlegm, phlegm, phlegm, phlegm, phlegm.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 钱德
sense_groups.english: Monica! Chandler!

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚真抱歉 乔伊说了吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about tonight. I don't know if Joey told you...

sense_groups.chinese: 有出戏我一定得去看 抱歉
sense_groups.english: but I couldn't get out of going to this play.

sense_groups.chinese: 玩得开心点 好
sense_groups.english: Have a great time, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 怪了 没有痰啊
sense_groups.english: That's funny, I saw no phlegm.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她真的病得很重
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, she really is sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 那她为什么要去看戏？
sense_groups.english: Then why is she going to a play?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 感冒想退烧...
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, you know, "Starve a fever...

sense_groups.chinese: 就要去看戏
sense_groups.english: go to a play for a cold."

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 吉宁为什么不来吃饭？
sense_groups.english: Why is Janine not coming over for dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不想连续两晚都陪你们
sense_groups.english: Uh, she didn't want to hang out with you guys two nights in a row.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 她为什么不想陪我们？
sense_groups.english: Why doesn't she want to hang out with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她觉得你很哈啦
sense_groups.english: Because she, uh, thinks that you are "blah."

sense_groups.chinese: 而摩妮卡 你的嗓门太大
sense_groups.english: And that, uh, you, Monica, are too loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以她昨晚只是假装开心？
sense_groups.english: So she just pretended to have a good time?

sense_groups.chinese: 她当面骗我们？
sense_groups.english: She was lying to our faces?

sense_groups.chinese: 太扯了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 她凭什么批评我们？
sense_groups.english: Who is she to judge us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们对她多好 - 我才不是哈啦 我是谈笑风生
sense_groups.english: We couldn't have been nicer to her. - And I am not "blah." I am a hoot!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 别生气
sense_groups.english: Come on, please, you guys. Don't be mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定是...
sense_groups.english: I'm sure she said it...

sense_groups.chinese: 紧张才会这么说 你们是我最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: because she was nervous 'cause you're my best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们又是第一次约会
sense_groups.english: And it was our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且她病得很重
sense_groups.english: Plus, she's really sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 你明明说那是假的
sense_groups.english: You said you made that up!

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不觉得生病比看戏好吗？
sense_groups.english: But isn't the "sick" thing better than the "play" thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 都很好 我通常都说摩妮卡又醉了
sense_groups.english: They're both good. I generally just go with, "Monica's drunk again."

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 再给她一次机会
sense_groups.english: Come on, please just give her another chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 她定会喜欢你们的 - 当然好
sense_groups.english: She'll come around, I promise. - Of course we will.

sense_groups.chinese: 回去煮饭吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Come on, we gotta make dinner. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢那个女人
sense_groups.english: I do not like that woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 我听得见
sense_groups.english: I can hear you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的嗓门真的很大
sense_groups.english: I am loud!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好笑
sense_groups.english: Isn't it good?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别把脚翘在我的新...
sense_groups.english: Can you please not put your feet up on my new...

sense_groups.chinese: 旧床单上
sense_groups.english: old sheet.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的药师桌
sense_groups.english: My apothecary table!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 不
sense_groups.english: What? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 这张桌子是哪里买的？ - 陶瓷货仓 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Where did you get this? - At Pottery Barn, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 陶瓷货仓抄袭我们古董的设计
sense_groups.english: Pottery Barn has ripped off the design of our antique!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 要是他们会抄袭
sense_groups.english: Wow. If they've ripped off our table...

sense_groups.chinese: 那张桌子一定不只值51元
sense_groups.english: ours must be worth much more than one and fifty dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 这张连鸦片的味道都没有
sense_groups.english: This doesn't even smell like opium.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然没有 只有你洒出来的酒味
sense_groups.english: It smells like wine, which you spilled.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你还毁了我的床单
sense_groups.english: And thanks for wrecking my sheet.

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 罗斯 我赔你80分就是了
sense_groups.english: Ross, calm down. I'll give you the 80 cents.

sense_groups.chinese: 再来一次
sense_groups.english: Okay, one more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你还要柳橙汁吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like some orange juice?

sense_groups.chinese: 音量刚刚好 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Perfect decibel. - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Uh, what are you guys doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么 就是聊天哈啦
sense_groups.english: Nothing. We're just talking. You know, blah-blah-blah.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你们说过要尽力的
sense_groups.english: Come on, you said you were gonna try.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来找你们一起去看电影
sense_groups.english: I came over to invite you to a movie with me and Janine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得呢？ - 非常乐意
sense_groups.english: What do you say? - I'd like to...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是...
sense_groups.english: but I'm not sure if we have the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好笑...我也很无奈
sense_groups.english: Ha, very funny. I don't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很希望你们处得来
sense_groups.english: I really want you to get along.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你们跟我们去吧 这是你们欠我的
sense_groups.english: Please, come to the movie with us. You owe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们欠你？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: We owe you? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们刚交往时 我帮了很多忙
sense_groups.english: I helped you out in the start of your relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你们偷鸡模狗6个月
sense_groups.english: I helped you sneak around for six months.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟白痴一样
sense_groups.english: I looked like an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 还被羞辱
sense_groups.english: And I was humiliated.

sense_groups.chinese: 却只赚了2百
sense_groups.english: And I only made $200.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有给你钱
sense_groups.english: We didn't give you any money.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我不知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You don't think I know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该拿它配藤条餐桌椅...
sense_groups.english: I can't decide if it goes better by the new chair...

sense_groups.chinese: 黄色书桌...
sense_groups.english: the Sahara desk...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是螺形托脚桌
sense_groups.english: or the Parker console table.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你们这里也有陶瓷货仓
sense_groups.english: I didn't know there was a Pottery Barn up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我有点买疯了 - 有点？
sense_groups.english: I know, I went a little crazy. - A little?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里就像目录第72页
sense_groups.english: Your place looks like page 72 of the catalog.

sense_groups.chinese: 看
sense_groups.english: Look at that!

sense_groups.chinese: 装饰鸟笼 大号的 - 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: The ornamental birdcage! Large. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 小心 那个很老了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross? Be careful. That is very old.

sense_groups.chinese: 殖民地时代早期的鸟商 都用那个带鸟上市场
sense_groups.english: Colonial bird merchants used to bring their birds to market in that.

sense_groups.chinese: 有意思
sense_groups.english: Fascinating.

sense_groups.chinese: 又一个惊人的发现
sense_groups.english: Another amazing find! Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 它定也有很棒的典故 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I bet this has a great story too. - It does.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是殖民地时期 分隔房间的装置
sense_groups.english: It is a room-separating apparatus from Colonial times.

sense_groups.chinese: 有好多东西都来自殖民地时期
sense_groups.english: Huh, a lot of this stuff is from the Colonial times.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有哪些时期呢 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: What are some other time periods, Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 有往昔
sense_groups.english: Well, there's yore.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有昨年
sense_groups.english: Ahem, and, uh, you know, yesteryear.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋对这种东西真的很有眼光
sense_groups.english: Rachel has such a good eye for this stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 如果你家要重新布置...
sense_groups.english: Ross, if you ever decide to redecorate...

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很有必要重新布置
sense_groups.english: and I think you should...

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该找瑞秋帮忙
sense_groups.english: you should ask Rachel to help.

sense_groups.chinese: 他才不需要我的帮忙
sense_groups.english: Aw, he doesn't need my help.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 他早该扔掉那些... 你是怎么说的？
sense_groups.english: I think he's ready to get rid of the... What'd you call it?

sense_groups.chinese: 廉价的赝品和恐龙垃圾
sense_groups.english: The, uh, "cheap knockoffs and dinosaur junk"?

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？ 既然你这么清楚我的需求
sense_groups.english: You know, since you have such a great sense of what I need...

sense_groups.chinese: 我这里有60元
sense_groups.english: Uh, here's 60 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你带着菲比去殖民时期跳蚤市场
sense_groups.english: Why don't you take Phoebe down to that Colonial, uh, flea market...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我办货吧
sense_groups.english: and get me some stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得菲比不会想去
sense_groups.english: I don't think Phoebe wants to come.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想去 - 她想去
sense_groups.english: I do want to. - She does want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 她想去 - 没错
sense_groups.english: She does want to. - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该说什么 上次比较有得进
sense_groups.english: I guess the flea market was just better last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我帮罗斯买了床单 没错
sense_groups.english: Well, at least I got these sheets for Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 是陶瓷货仓
sense_groups.english: Ugh, look at this. Pottery Barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 别看了
sense_groups.english: Ugh, yeah, you know what? Don't look at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 别看了 - 你看
sense_groups.english: Seriously, don't look at it. - Look!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们抄袭我们的咖啡桌
sense_groups.english: There's the table they stole from us.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些混蛋我们走
sense_groups.english: Oh, those bastards! Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那台电风扇跟我们的有点像 还有那个鸟笼和...
sense_groups.english: That fan kind of looks like ours, and the birdcage, and...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 这根本就是我们的客厅
sense_groups.english: Wait a second, this is our exact living room!

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是呢
sense_groups.english: No, it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的完全不一样
sense_groups.english: Come on, ours is totally different.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有... 我们没有那盏灯
sense_groups.english: I mean, we don't have the... We don't have that lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有那扇屏风是在另一边
sense_groups.english: And that screen is on the other side.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 那些都是陶瓷货仓的东西
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. This is where you got all our stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 陶瓷货仓的东西 我的天哪 - 不是
sense_groups.english: Pottery Barn! Oh, my God! - No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 你说对了 对不起
sense_groups.english: Okay, I did, all right? I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲彼 我想要这些东西 又知道你讨厌陶瓷货仓
sense_groups.english: I wanted this stuff and I know how you feel about Pottery Barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不要生气 - 但是我气死了
sense_groups.english: Come on, don't be mad. - No, but I am mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 这代表世间所有丑恶的东西...
sense_groups.english: Because this stuff is what's wrong with the world...

sense_groups.chinese: 都在我的客厅里
sense_groups.english: and it's in my living room...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我却只想着我没有那盏灯
sense_groups.english: and all I can think about is how I don't have that lamp!

sense_groups.chinese: 那就买下那盏灯
sense_groups.english: Well, then, honey, buy the lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有罗斯给的60元
sense_groups.english: We have that 60 bucks from Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 不行
sense_groups.english: I can't! I can't!

sense_groups.chinese: 除非...
sense_groups.english: Unless...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说我不买那盏灯 你就要搬走吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you saying you'd move out if I didn't buy that lamp?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不会搬走
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not gonna move out!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说我不买那盏灯 你就要搬走吗？
sense_groups.english: But are you saying that you would move out if I didn't buy that lamp?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我定会搬走 - 那我就没办法了
sense_groups.english: Yes! I would so move out. - Then I don't have a choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就得买那盏灯 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I have to buy that lamp! - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过至少那张药师桌是真货
sense_groups.english: But at least the apothecary table's real.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好 大家都很尽兴吧？
sense_groups.english: This was great. Didn't everybody have a great time?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很尽兴 真的
sense_groups.english: I did. I really did. And I've got to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有很抱歉上次聚会后 我态度怪怪的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry if I was weird after the last time we went out.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能是紧张吧
sense_groups.english: I guess I was just nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们完全可以理解 - 别放在心上
sense_groups.english: That's understandable. - Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我们可以再一起出去罗？
sense_groups.english: So we can go out again?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. - Well, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就 晚安 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, good night. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧？
sense_groups.english: See, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好玩吧？
sense_groups.english: Wasn't that fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们非搬家不可
sense_groups.english: We have got to move.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道
sense_groups.english: I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的嗓门也不小 死丫头
sense_groups.english: You're not so quiet yourself, missy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我哈啦？ 比看现代舞更无聊的...
sense_groups.english: I'm blah? The only thing more boring than modern dance...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是听你聊现代舞
sense_groups.english: is you talking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德...
sense_groups.english: Oh, Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才看得浑然忘我
sense_groups.english: I just lost myself in the movement."

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你在说话
sense_groups.english: You know, I know you're talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我只听到叽哩呱啦叽哩呱啦
sense_groups.english: but all I hear is blah-blah-blah-blah-blah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在就出去 马上
sense_groups.english: All right, you and me! Let's go, right now!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 够了够了
sense_groups.english: All right, enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们回去我要跟吉宁谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Enough! You two, go home. I gotta talk to Janine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你绝对可以打倒她
sense_groups.english: I really think you could take her.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让我在走廊上碰到你
sense_groups.english: You better hope I don't see you in the hallway!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了...
sense_groups.english: All right. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有个小小的问题
sense_groups.english: Look, we got a little bit of a problem here.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是我的朋友 你不能对他们无礼
sense_groups.english: You can't my treat my friends that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们也对我出言不逊 我知道 - 我会找他们谈
sense_groups.english: They said stuff to me too. - I know, I'll talk to them about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们对我很重要
sense_groups.english: They mean so much to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像我的家人
sense_groups.english: They're like my family, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们一见面就吵 我...
sense_groups.english: If you guys are gonna be fighting all the time...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就不能在一起 这是行不通的
sense_groups.english: I don't think we can be together. It just can't work, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 行不通的
sense_groups.english: It can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很不开心
sense_groups.english: I'm very upset.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我过去道歉呢？
sense_groups.english: Would it help if I apologized?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就太好了
sense_groups.english: That'd be very helpful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过在走廊上碰到会怎样？
sense_groups.english: What did I tell you about the hall?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要过去向你们道歉
sense_groups.english: I was coming over to apologize for my behavior.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很希望能跟你们做朋友
sense_groups.english: I'd really like it if we could be friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道那样会让乔伊很高兴...
sense_groups.english: Well, I know that would make Joey happy, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我也愿意
sense_groups.english: I would like that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 来吧
sense_groups.english: Great. - Now, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能达成共识 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'm glad we worked it out. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 回头见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 听都听得见 - 够了 来吧
sense_groups.english: Or I'll hear you. - That's it, big girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着
sense_groups.english: Wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好快逃
sense_groups.english: You'd better run!

sense_groups.chinese: 你听见了吗？ 听见了
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？ - 难为你了
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? - I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 要去看吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: Want to go watch? - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 她搬出去了吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing? - So, uh, did she move out?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多了
sense_groups.english: Pretty much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然就这样跟她分手
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you just broke up with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 不适合就是不适合
sense_groups.english: When it's not right, you know it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？ - 死不了
sense_groups.english: You okay? - I'll be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有办法让你开心 - 什么办法？
sense_groups.english: You know what'd cheer you up? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我明晚要教侵蚀理论
sense_groups.english: I'm giving this lecture on erosion theories tomorrow night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该来听
sense_groups.english: I think you should come.

sense_groups.chinese: 我确实开心多了
sense_groups.english: You're right, that did cheer me up.

questions.name: S06E12
questions.en:
Hey. You're not gonna believe this.
I made up a joke and sent it in to Playboy.
They printed it. Yeah.
I didn't know they prints jokes.
They print jokes, interviews, hard-hitting journalism.
It's not just about the pictures.
It didn't work on Mom, it's not gonna work on us.
Here, check it out. It's the first one too.
Right there.
Ha, ha.
That is funny.
It was also funny when I made it up.
What? - I made that joke up.
Uh, oh, oh. No, you didn't. I did.
Uh, uh, oh. Yes, I did. I told Dan
and he said it was the funniest joke he'd ever heard.
Hey, tell Dan thanks.
What?
I'm sorry. I was just reading the joke below it. Man, that one is funny.
Monica, you remember me telling you that joke, right?
No. - Seriously?
You tell a lot of jokes.
Look, it's my joke.
But if it makes you feel any better, they don't print the name.
So it doesn't really matter who gets credit.
Yeah, I guess.
Hey, guys. - Joey, Playboy printed my joke!
No, it's mine! It's my joke. Call them! They'll tell you!
My joke! - My joke!
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
Jokes? What...?
You guys know they have naked chicks in there, right?
Dude! You have got to turn on Behind The Music.
The band Heart is having a really tough time and they may break up.
Let's watch that at your place.
Monica's watching a show. I don't want to miss when they were skinny.
Hey, Chandler. You know what we should do?
You and I should go out and get some new sunglasses.
What? No, I want to watch this.
Did your cable go out? - No. No, that's VH1.
I gotta tell you, the music these kids listen to today...
it's a lot of noise to me.
Why is your cable out?
Uh... Oh, because I haven't really paid the bill. Heh, heh.
If you need money, would you please let me loan you some money?
No, Chandler. Forget about it, okay?
I know things have been tight since Janine moved out. God, was she hot.
Whoa. - I know, yeah.
Look, I can handle it, all right? I can listen to the radio.
And Ross gave me this great book.
Want to see if the joke stealer will let us watch the show at his place?
Sure.
Paid your phone bill? - Not so much.
Hey. - Oh.
It's only you.
What are you doing? - We are looking at a Playboy.
I want to look too!
Yikes!
Do you think these pictures are trying to tell a story?
Sure. Like in the case of this young woman...
she has lost her clothes.
So she rides naked on the horse, she's crying out, "Where are they? Where are they?"
She's not gonna find them, lying in the grass like that.
Oh. Yeah.
Remember the days when you'd go out to the barn...
lift up your shirt and bend over? - Yeah.
You see, now, I would date this girl.
She's cute, she's outdoorsy.
And she knows how to build a fire. That'll come in handy.
I got a question.
If you had to pick one of us to date, who would it be?
I don't know. - Me neither.
Rachel.
What?
I don't know.
Me neither.
You know, you forget how many great songs Heart had.
Yeah.
"Barracuda" was the first song I learned to play on the keyboard.
So you heard it, you repeated it...
so that must mean you wrote it.
Oh, you guys with this joke. Well, I gotta say...
I know I cracked up, but I'm not even sure I got it.
What?
You didn't get it?
The doctor is a monkey.
And monkeys can't write out prescriptions.
You are not allowed to laugh at my joke.
Your joke?
Well, I think the Hef would disagree.
Which is why he sent me a check...
for $100.
So you stole my joke and you stole my money?
I was gonna stick it in the ATM.
But now I think I'll show the sexy teller...
that I am a published writer.
Well, she'll know that you stole the joke.
You gonna follow me down there?
Yeah. - I'm not gonna go now.
Okay.
Here you go. - Oh.
Ah.
Uh, Gunther?
I can't pay for this now, because I'm not working.
I've had to cut down on some luxuries like...
paying for stuff, so...
Well, if you want, you can work here.
Uh, I don't know.
It's just...
See, I was a regular on a soap opera, you know?
And to go from that to this, it's just...
And plus, I'd have to wait on all my friends.
Okay. But the money's good.
Plus, you get to stare at Rachel as much as you want.
What?
Flexible hours.
Maybe I could be a waiter.
Could I use the phone?
She picked Rachel.
She tried to back out of it, but it was obvious. She picked Rachel.
He took my joke. He just took it.
This is wrong. You know what else is wrong?
Phoebe picking Rachel.
You know who else picked Rachel? Ross.
You know what else Ross did? He stole my joke.
I'm gonna get a joke journal, you know?
And document the date and time of every single one of my jokes.
Good idea. Know what's a bad idea?
Picking Rachel. - That's right.
Did you hear something?
Maybe it's the sound of Ross climbing into my brain and stealing my thoughts.
It's coming from the living room.
I finished my book.
Hey, you guys. - Hey.
Don't you guys look cute.
You guys make a cute couple.
Monica, what are you doing?
Just trying to re-create some of the fun that we had at my place the other day.
Remember? When you picked Rachel over me?
That was funny. Ha, ha, ha.
It was kind of funny. - It wasn't funny at all!
Why would you do that?
Why didn't you pick me?
Fine.
The reason I was leaning a little bit more toward Rachel than you...
is just, you know, you're...
high maintenance. Let's go to lunch.
That is completely untrue.
You think I'm high maintenance? Prove it.
You write out a list, and we'll go through it point by point.
No, you're right, you're easygoing.
You're just not as easygoing as Rachel. She's just more...
flexible and mellow. That's all.
Well, people are different.
Yeah, Rachel will do whatever you want. You can just walk all over her.
What? Are you saying, that I'm a pushover? I'm not a pushover.
Oh, okay. You're not a pushover.
You think I'm a pushover. Well, watch this.
You're not invited to lunch!
What do you think? I think that's pretty strong.
Come on, Monica, let's go to lunch.
You start working on that list.
I cannot believe her. - I know. Where do you want to eat?
Oh... Oh, I love that Japanese place.
I'm sick of Japanese. Not going there.
Wherever you want to go is cool. - All right.
Oh, hey, Gunther...
check this out.
Yeah. Man, that Chandler cracks me up.
Hey, Ross, you want anything to drink? I'm heading up there.
Yeah. I'll take a coffee. Thanks. - Sure.
Coffee? - No.
Coffee? I'm going up there.
No. - No, thank you.
You need anything? I'm heading up there.
I'd love ice water.
You got it.
Joey, what are you doing?
Just being friendly.
Joey, you're not supposed to go back there.
No, it's okay. Right, Gunther?
Don't wink at me.
And put on your apron.
Okay. Heh, heh.
I don't see you asking other paying customers to put on aprons.
Joey, do you work here? - No.
Waiter. - Yeah!
Joey, what's going on? Why didn't you tell us you work here?
Uh...
It's kind of embarrassing. I mean, I was an actor, now I'm a waiter.
It's supposed to go in the other direction.
So's your apron. You're wearing it like a cape.
I mean, the job's easy and the money's good, you know?
I guess if I'm hanging out here, I might as well get paid for it. Right?
I just feel kind of weird serving you guys, you know?
It'll be great.
Come on, I did it and it was fine.
Why would it be weird?
Hey, Joey? Can I get some coffee?
Okay. It doesn't seem that weird.
Seriously, I asked before. You still haven't gotten it.
See, now it's weird again.
I think it's great. You're gonna make a lot of money. Here's your first tip.
Don't eat yellow snow. Ha, ha, ha.
2: 15, coffeehouse.
This is great. Finally, I have someone I can pass my wisdom to.
Let me tell you some things I learned working at the coffeehouse.
First, the customer is always right.
A smile goes a long way.
And if anyone is ever rude to you, sneeze muffin.
Thanks, Rach.
Hey, look, you guys are just terrific, you know?
How about clearing out so I can get some new customers, huh?
It's all about turnover.
Joey.
Seriously, can I get my coffee?
I'm sorry, Ross. I'll get it right now.
And since you wait, I'll toss in a free muffin.
Phoebe, we'd like to talk to you.
Okay.
So, maybe I am a little high maintenance.
And maybe Rachel is a little bit of a pushover.
But you know what we decided you are?
We are sorry to tell you this, but you, Phoebe, are flaky.
Ha!
That's true, I am flaky.
So, what, you're just okay with being flaky?
Yeah, totally.
Then I'm okay with being high maintenance.
Yeah. And I am okay with being a pushover.
That's great. Good for you guys.
I am not high maintenance! - I am not a pushover!
Who said you were? - You did!
I'm flaky. I'll say anything.
Hey, Gunther.
Can you cover for me? I got an audition.
No, I'm leaving to get my hair dyed.
Really? I like your natural color.
It's a great part. Check it out. I'm the lead guy's best friend.
I wait for him in this bar and save his seat. Listen.
"I'm sorry, that seat's saved."
That's the whole part? - Okay, maybe he's not his best friend, but...
Okay, I'll see you in an hour.
Oh, man.
I could totally get that part. "I'm sorry, this seat is taken."
Excuse me. - No, I didn't mean you.
But you believed me, huh?
I believed you were saving this seat for someone.
So you'd hire me, right?
For what?
Exactly! All right, everybody listen up!
The coffeehouse will be closed for about an hour.
What?
It's for the kids.
Yeah, to keep the kids off drugs.
Yeah. It's a very important issue in this month's Playboy.
I'm sure you all read about it.
It's my joke. - It's my joke.
It's my joke.
I don't think we're gonna settle this.
No. Let's have Monica decide. - Yeah.
Hey, Mon! - Mon, get out here!
Monica? - Okay.
You have to help us decide whose joke this is.
Why do I have to?
You're the only one that can be fair. - Yeah.
I can't be. You're my boyfriend.
But I'm your brother. We're family.
That's the most important thing in the world.
Don't try to sway her.
I'm your only chance to have a baby.
Okay, let's go. - All right.
We'll each tell you how we came up with the joke...
then you decide which one of us is telling the truth. Me.
Chandler, you go first.
I thought of the joke two months ago at lunch with Steve.
Did I meet him at Christmas? - Can I finish my story?
Do you want me to pick you?
See, I would never snap at you like that.
Two babies.
Continue. - Okay.
Steve said he had to go to the doctor. And his doctor's name is Dr. Mompey.
I said, "Dr. Monkey?" And that is how the whole Dr. Monkey thing came up.
Are you kidding?
Okay, look, I study evolution.
Remember? Evolution.
Monkey into man.
Plus, I'm a doctor. And...
I had a monkey.
I'm Dr. Monkey!
I'm not arguing with that. - All right.
I've heard enough. I've made my decision.
Oh! - Okay, so what...? Do tell.
You are both idiots.
The joke is not funny, and it's offensive to women.
And doctors. And monkeys.
You shouldn't argue over who gets credit.
You should be arguing over who gets blamed for inflicting this horrible joke upon the world.
Now, let it go.
The joke sucks.
It's your joke. - It is not.
Oh, my God, Chandler, there you are. - Hi.
Hey, it's Phoebe and Rachel.
Why don't you tell them...
what you were telling me earlier about me not being high maintenance.
Monica is a self-sufficient, together lady.

sense_groups.english: Just trying to re-create some of the fun that we had at my place the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是你选瑞秋不选我那次
sense_groups.english: Remember? When you picked Rachel over me?

sense_groups.chinese: 多好玩啊
sense_groups.english: That was funny. Ha, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 是蛮好玩的 - 一点也不好玩
sense_groups.english: It was kind of funny. - It wasn't funny at all!

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么选她？
sense_groups.english: Why would you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不选我？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you pick me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我之所以稍微倾向瑞秋
sense_groups.english: The reason I was leaning a little bit more toward Rachel than you...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为你...
sense_groups.english: is just, you know, you're...

sense_groups.chinese: 有点难搞 我们去吃饭吧
sense_groups.english: high maintenance. Let's go to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪有这回事
sense_groups.english: That is completely untrue.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我难搞？证明给我看
sense_groups.english: You think I'm high maintenance? Prove it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你列一张清单 我们逐条讨论
sense_groups.english: You write out a list, and we'll go through it point by point.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 你很好相处
sense_groups.english: No, you're right, you're easygoing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是没有瑞秋那么好相处 她比较...
sense_groups.english: You're just not as easygoing as Rachel. She's just more...

sense_groups.chinese: 圆滑 比较成熟 就这样
sense_groups.english: flexible and mellow. That's all.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都不一样
sense_groups.english: Well, people are different.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋什么都好 怎么欺负她都行
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Rachel will do whatever you want. You can just walk all over her.

sense_groups.chinese: 慢着 你是说我没个性吗？我才没有
sense_groups.english: What? Are you saying, that I'm a pushover? I'm not a pushover.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你有个性
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. You're not a pushover.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你觉得我没个性
sense_groups.english: You think I'm a pushover. Well, watch this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听着 我们不跟你吃饭了
sense_groups.english: You're not invited to lunch!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？够强硬了吧？
sense_groups.english: What do you think? I think that's pretty strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我们去吃饭
sense_groups.english: Come on, Monica, let's go to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 清单给我列出来
sense_groups.english: You start working on that list.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真是太扯了 - 就是啊 你想吃什么？
sense_groups.english: I cannot believe her. - I know. Where do you want to eat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢那家日本料理
sense_groups.english: Oh... Oh, I love that Japanese place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃腻日本菜了 不要去那家
sense_groups.english: I'm sick of Japanese. Not going there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那看你想去哪里 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Wherever you want to go is cool. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Gunther...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个钱德真的很好笑
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Man, that Chandler cracks me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你要喝什么吗？我要去柜台
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, you want anything to drink? I'm heading up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 要 我要咖啡 谢谢 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'll take a coffee. Thanks. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 咖啡？ - 不要
sense_groups.english: Coffee? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 要咖啡吗？我要去柜台
sense_groups.english: Coffee? I'm going up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 - 不了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No. - No, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要什么吗？我要去柜台
sense_groups.english: You need anything? I'm heading up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要一杯冰水
sense_groups.english: I'd love ice water.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Joey, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 表示友善啊
sense_groups.english: Just being friendly.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你不能去柜台后面
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're not supposed to go back there.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系啦 对吧 阿甘？
sense_groups.english: No, it's okay. Right, Gunther?

sense_groups.chinese: 别跟我使眼色
sense_groups.english: Don't wink at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 把围裙穿上
sense_groups.english: And put on your apron.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿就穿
sense_groups.english: Okay. Heh, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么不叫其他客人穿围裙
sense_groups.english: I don't see you asking other paying customers to put on aprons.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在这里打工吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Joey, do you work here? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 服务生 - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Waiter. - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 怎么回事？为什么不告诉我们你在这里打工？
sense_groups.english: Joey, what's going on? Why didn't you tell us you work here?
Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事蛮尴尬的 我之前是演员 现在是服务生
sense_groups.english: It's kind of embarrassing. I mean, I was an actor, now I'm a waiter.

sense_groups.chinese: 这应该反过来才对
sense_groups.english: It's supposed to go in the other direction.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的围裙也反穿成披风了
sense_groups.english: So's your apron. You're wearing it like a cape.

sense_groups.chinese: 这份工作很简单 薪水很高
sense_groups.english: I mean, the job's easy and the money's good, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我都在这儿混 干脆赚个钱
sense_groups.english: I guess if I'm hanging out here, I might as well get paid for it. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是要招呼你们感觉很怪
sense_groups.english: I just feel kind of weird serving you guys, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会
sense_groups.english: It'll be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我也做过 还好啊
sense_groups.english: Come on, I did it and it was fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 怎么会怪？
sense_groups.english: Why would it be weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 帮我瑞个咖啡
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey? Can I get some coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 确实没那么怪
sense_groups.english: Okay. It doesn't seem that weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说真的 我点的咖啡还没来
sense_groups.english: Seriously, I asked before. You still haven't gotten it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在又变怪了
sense_groups.english: See, now it's weird again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里工作是好事 你会赚大钱 先给你一个忠告
sense_groups.english: I think it's great. You're gonna make a lot of money. Here's your first tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 黄色的雪不要吃
sense_groups.english: Don't eat yellow snow. Ha, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 2点15分 咖啡馆
sense_groups.english: 2: 15, coffeehouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 总算有人能传承我的智慧
sense_groups.english: This is great. Finally, I have someone I can pass my wisdom to.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你几件我在这里学到的事
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you some things I learned working at the coffeehouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 顾客永远是对的
sense_groups.english: First, the customer is always right.

sense_groups.chinese: 微笑能让你无往不利
sense_groups.english: A smile goes a long way.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人对你不客气 就朝松饼打喷嚏
sense_groups.english: And if anyone is ever rude to you, sneeze muffin.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们对我真好
sense_groups.english: Hey, look, you guys are just terrific, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要清场 让别人进来了？
sense_groups.english: How about clearing out so I can get some new customers, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 有流动才有商机
sense_groups.english: It's all about turnover.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想喝咖啡了
sense_groups.english: Seriously, can I get my coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 马上来
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Ross. I'll get it right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你等那么久 送你一块松饼作为补偿吧
sense_groups.english: And since you wait, I'll toss in a free muffin.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们想跟你谈谈
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, we'd like to talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我是有点难搞
sense_groups.english: So, maybe I am a little high maintenance.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许瑞秋是有点没个性
sense_groups.english: And maybe Rachel is a little bit of a pushover.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你知道你是什么吗？
sense_groups.english: But you know what we decided you are?

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉这么说 但是你 菲比 是个怪人
sense_groups.english: We are sorry to tell you this, but you, Phoebe, are flaky.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我是很怪
sense_groups.english: That's true, I am flaky.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你怪也无所谓？
sense_groups.english: So, what, you're just okay with being flaky?

sense_groups.chinese: 完全无所谓
sense_groups.english: Yeah, totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我难搞也无所谓
sense_groups.english: Then I'm okay with being high maintenance.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没个性也无所谓
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And I am okay with being a pushover.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 无所谓就好
sense_groups.english: That's great. Good for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不难搞 - 我才不会没个性
sense_groups.english: I am not high maintenance! - I am not a pushover!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁说你们是了？ - 你啊
sense_groups.english: Who said you were? - You did!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是怪人 专门乱说话
sense_groups.english: I'm flaky. I'll say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我挡一下 我接到试镜通知
sense_groups.english: Can you cover for me? I got an audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我要去染头发
sense_groups.english: No, I'm leaving to get my hair dyed.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我喜欢你的自然色
sense_groups.english: Really? I like your natural color.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 这是个好角色 我演男主角的死党
sense_groups.english: It's a great part. Check it out. I'm the lead guy's best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 在酒吧帮他占位子 你听
sense_groups.english: I wait for him in this bar and save his seat. Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: "抱歉 这个位子有人坐"
sense_groups.english: "I'm sorry, that seat's saved."

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？ - 或许不是他的死党 但是...
sense_groups.english: That's the whole part? - Okay, maybe he's not his best friend, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 1小时后见
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll see you in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对能拿到那个角色 "抱歉 这个位子有人坐"
sense_groups.english: I could totally get that part. "I'm sorry, this seat is taken."

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 - 不 我不是说你
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. - No, I didn't mean you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你以为是真的吧？
sense_groups.english: But you believed me, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你在帮别人占位
sense_groups.english: I believed you were saving this seat for someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你会用我啰？
sense_groups.english: So you'd hire me, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 用你干嘛？
sense_groups.english: For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是说嘛 各位请注意
sense_groups.english: Exactly! All right, everybody listen up!

sense_groups.chinese: 本店要暂停营业1小时
sense_groups.english: The coffeehouse will be closed for about an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是为了孩子们
sense_groups.english: It's for the kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮助孩子们远离毒品
sense_groups.english: Yeah, to keep the kids off drugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是本期《花花公子》的重要报导
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's a very important issue in this month's Playboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位一定都看过
sense_groups.english: I'm sure you all read about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的笑话 - 是我的
sense_groups.english: It's my joke. - It's my joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的
sense_groups.english: It's my joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再吵也吵不出结果
sense_groups.english: I don't think we're gonna settle this.

sense_groups.chinese: 让摩妮卡决定吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: No. Let's have Monica decide. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 小妹 - 亲爱的 出来下
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon! - Mon, get out here!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 好
sense_groups.english: Monica? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来帮我们决定 这个笑话是谁的
sense_groups.english: You have to help us decide whose joke this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么要我决定？
sense_groups.english: Why do I have to?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你才能客观公正 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: You're the only one that can be fair. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能 你是我的男朋友
sense_groups.english: I can't be. You're my boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我是你哥哥 我们是家人
sense_groups.english: But I'm your brother. We're family.

sense_groups.chinese: 世上最重要的就是亲情
sense_groups.english: That's the most important thing in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要想左右她
sense_groups.english: Don't try to sway her.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有我能让你生小孩
sense_groups.english: I'm your only chance to have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会说出这个笑话的由来
sense_groups.english: We'll each tell you how we came up with the joke...

sense_groups.chinese: 你再决定谁说的是实话... 是我
sense_groups.english: then you decide which one of us is telling the truth. Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你先
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我是2个月前 跟史提夫吃饭时想到的
sense_groups.english: I thought of the joke two months ago at lunch with Steve.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是圣诞节那家伙吗？ - 让我说完好吗？
sense_groups.english: Did I meet him at Christmas? - Can I finish my story?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我选你吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to pick you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对不会那样凶你
sense_groups.english: See, I would never snap at you like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个小孩
sense_groups.english: Two babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 请继续 - 好
sense_groups.english: Continue. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 史提夫说他去看医生 他的医生姓侯奇
sense_groups.english: Steve said he had to go to the doctor. And his doctor's name is Dr. Mompey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就说"猴子医生？" 所以才会有猴子医生这个笑话
sense_groups.english: I said, "Dr. Monkey?" And that is how the whole Dr. Monkey thing came up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你开什么玩笑
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是念进化论的
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I study evolution.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得吧？进化论
sense_groups.english: Remember? Evolution.

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子进化成人？
sense_groups.english: Monkey into man.

sense_groups.chinese: 况且我是博士...
sense_groups.english: Plus, I'm a doctor. And...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还养过猴子
sense_groups.english: I had a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是猴子博士
sense_groups.english: I'm Dr. Monkey!

sense_groups.chinese: 这点我不跟你争 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'm not arguing with that. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以了 我决定好了
sense_groups.english: I've heard enough. I've made my decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 好 请说
sense_groups.english: Oh! - Okay, so what...? Do tell.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个都是白痴
sense_groups.english: You are both idiots.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个笑话不但不好笑 还冒犯了女性
sense_groups.english: The joke is not funny, and it's offensive to women.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有医生 还有猴子
sense_groups.english: And doctors. And monkeys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不该争笑话是谁的
sense_groups.english: You shouldn't argue over who gets credit.

sense_groups.chinese: 应该争是谁让这世界受这种罪
sense_groups.english: You should be arguing over who gets blamed for inflicting this horrible joke upon the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再争了
sense_groups.english: Now, let it go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个笑话烂透了
sense_groups.english: The joke sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你的笑话 - 才不是
sense_groups.english: It's your joke. - It is not.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你在这里 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Chandler, there you are. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 是菲比和瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's Phoebe and Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要告诉她们...
sense_groups.english: Why don't you tell them...

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说我并不难搞？
sense_groups.english: what you were telling me earlier about me not being high maintenance.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡是个自信沉着的女性
sense_groups.english: Monica is a self-sufficient, together lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她在一起就像在度假
sense_groups.english: Being with her has been like being on a vacation.

sense_groups.chinese: 至于所谓的难搞...
sense_groups.english: And what may be perceived as high maintenance...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是注重小细节...
sense_groups.english: is merely attention to detail...
and...

sense_groups.chinese: 心灵的慷慨
sense_groups.english: generosity of spirit.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是我所听过最棒的假话
sense_groups.english: Wow. You know what? That is the best fake speech I think I've ever heard.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？我听过更棒的
sense_groups.english: Really? I've heard better.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 那是他自己说的 你告诉她们
sense_groups.english: Wait, he came up with that himself. Tell them, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经词穷了 可不可以重复就好？
sense_groups.english: I'm out of words. Should I say it again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点也不难搞
sense_groups.english: Look, I am not high maintenance!

sense_groups.chinese: 一点也不难搞 钱德
sense_groups.english: I am not. Chandler!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是有点难搞
sense_groups.english: You're high maintenance.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上黑名单了
sense_groups.english: You are on my list!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你并不...
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, but you're not...

sense_groups.chinese: 你并不好相处 但你很热情
sense_groups.english: You're not easygoing, but you're passionate.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很好
sense_groups.english: And that's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你为小事不高兴时 我觉得我蛮能...
sense_groups.english: And when you get upset about little things, I think I'm pretty good...

sense_groups.chinese: 安抚你的
sense_groups.english: at making you feel better about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样也很好 所以她们说你难搞也行
sense_groups.english: That's good too. They say you're high maintenance...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我喜欢...
sense_groups.english: but it's okay, because I like...

sense_groups.chinese: 搞定你
sense_groups.english: maintaining you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没叫他说这些
sense_groups.english: I didn't even tell him to say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 好
sense_groups.english: Aw. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你从黑名单除名了 - 我除名了
sense_groups.english: All right, you're off my list. - I'm off the list.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不找我当女朋友也没关系 因为我有...
sense_groups.english: It's okay that you don't want me to be your girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 最棒的男朋友
sense_groups.english: Because I have the best boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我突然觉得你好迷人
sense_groups.english: You know, suddenly I find you very attractive.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 试镜结果如何？

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人觉得你娘娘腔
sense_groups.english: Honey, no one thinks that you're a pansy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们觉得你需要面纸
sense_groups.english: But we do think that you need a tissue.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经3年多没感冒了
sense_groups.english: I have not been sick in over three years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你拿几张面纸 - 我不需要面纸 我很好...哪
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna grab you some tissue. - I don't need a tissue. I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的后面还加个哪 就不好哪
sense_groups.english: When you put a D at the end of "fine," you're not fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好...哪
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这句话很难说
sense_groups.english: You know, it's a really hard word to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪位？ - 瑞秋在吗？我是她的妹妹
sense_groups.english: Yes? - Hi. Is Rachel here? I'm her sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 吉儿 - 天哪 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Jill. - Oh, my God, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 介绍一下吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, introduce us.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位是钱德 - 你好
sense_groups.english: This is Chandler. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认识摩妮卡和罗斯
sense_groups.english: And you know Monica and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 那是菲比 那是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi. - And that's Phoebe, and that's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？ - 不好
sense_groups.english: Hey. How you doing? - Don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么来了？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: Honey, what are you doing here? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是哪个妹妹？
sense_groups.english: Which sister is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 被宠坏的还是咬她的那一位？
sense_groups.english: Is this the spoiled one or the one that bit her?

sense_groups.chinese: 老爸断了我的财源 - 我知道了
sense_groups.english: Daddy cut me off. - Never mind, I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我怎么说？
sense_groups.english: And you know what I said to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"我要请一个律师 把你的钱都告过来
sense_groups.english: I said, "I'm gonna hire a lawyer, sue you and take all your money...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后断了你的财源"
sense_groups.english: and then I'm gonna cut you off."

sense_groups.chinese: 那他怎么说？ - 他说不帮我付律师费
sense_groups.english: What did he say? - He said he wouldn't pay for my lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 还叫我来跟他唯一自豪的女儿
sense_groups.english: Ah. - Then he told me to come and learn the value of money...

sense_groups.chinese: 学学金钱的价值 - 哦
sense_groups.english: from the one daughter he's proud of. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们听到了吗？我爸以我为荣 我爸以我为荣
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that? My dad's proud of me. My dad's proud of me. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 好 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Rach? - Oh, yeah, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸为什么不给你钱？
sense_groups.english: Hey, honey, so, what did you do that made Dad cut you off?

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了艘船 - 你买了艘船？
sense_groups.english: Okay, I bought a boat. - You bought a boat?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我要的 是要送朋友的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but it wasn't for me, it was for a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不该跟姊姊交朋友的
sense_groups.english: Boy, did we make friends with the wrong sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿 这是一次最好的教训
sense_groups.english: Jill, I think this is the best thing that could've ever happened to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正你也得独立
sense_groups.english: You've needed to get out on your own anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚独立时也很害怕
sense_groups.english: And you know, when I did it, at first I was scared...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果现在呢
sense_groups.english: but then look at me now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是唯一让老爸骄傲的女儿
sense_groups.english: I am the only daughter that Dad is proud of.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在要做的是找一份工作
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, this is what you're gonna do. You're gonna get a job.

sense_groups.chinese: 找一间公寓 我会帮你
sense_groups.english: You're gonna get an apartment. And I'll help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以跟我们住 对吧？菲比 可以吧？
sense_groups.english: You can stay with us. Right? She can stay with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Of course, yeah. - Oh, that's so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我就来独立 真不知道该怎么谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm really gonna do this. I don't know how to thank you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢汽车
sense_groups.english: Aw. I like cars.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还要用吗？ - 不要了
sense_groups.english: You all finished here? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 早上的小费出来了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Okay, here are the tips for this morning. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍50、我50 乔伊欠8块钱
sense_groups.english: Jen gets 50, 50 for me, and Joey owes $8.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 因为你到处送吃的
sense_groups.english: What? - For all the free food you gave away.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然是送的 为什么跟我要钱
sense_groups.english: Well, if it's free food, how come you're charging me for it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只免费招持寿星
sense_groups.english: We don't give anything away unless it's someone's birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 那模特儿比赛第三名呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh. What if they came in third in a modeling contest?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: No. - Oh. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天好惨 这些袋子好重
sense_groups.english: I just had the hardest day. Some of these are so heavy.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿 你怎么有钱？你爸不是把信用卡都收走了？
sense_groups.english: Jill, how did you pay for all this? I thought your dad took your credit card.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我15岁就会背卡号了
sense_groups.english: Oh, please, I memorized those numbers when I was 15.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看我买的这些独立行头
sense_groups.english: But look at all the cool make-it-on-my-own stuff I got.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是"请雇用我"毛衣
sense_groups.english: This is my "Please hire me" sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是"你不想把房子租我吗"裤子
sense_groups.english: And these are my "Don't you want to rent me this apartment?" pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫你爸付你的置装费不算独立
sense_groups.english: I don't think charging clothes to your dad qualifies as making it on your own.

sense_groups.chinese: 大科学家就是这么死板
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mr. Scientist has to get all technical.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋真的不会赞成
sense_groups.english: I don't think Rachel's gonna think it's a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁封她当女王了？ - 我超想当女王的
sense_groups.english: So who made her queen of the world? - I would love that job.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样啊？ - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. What's going on? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿
sense_groups.english: Jill.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑去逛街吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you shop?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 是他们
sense_groups.english: They did.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们跑去进街 - 对 我们跑去逛街
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we went shopping. - Yeah, we went shopping. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们跑去进街？
sense_groups.english: You went shopping?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后把东西秀给吉儿看？
sense_groups.english: Then you came in here and paraded it right under Jill's nose...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们明知她想戒掉
sense_groups.english: when you know she's trying to quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真差劲
sense_groups.english: Wow. You guys, that's terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 吉儿 - 吉儿 对不起
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Jill. - Sorry, Jill.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们买了什么？ - 我买了...谢谢
sense_groups.english: So, what did you get? - Oh, well, all right. I got... Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了这件 "我要工作"毛衣 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I got, um, this, you know, "I want a job" sweater. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还买了这条公寓裤
sense_groups.english: And then I got, uh... These are apartment pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 公寓裤？
sense_groups.english: Apartment pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你没听过吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you've never heard of them?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然听过
sense_groups.english: No, of course. Of course I've heard of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯那你呢？ - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Ross, what did you get? - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了这个...
sense_groups.english: I got this...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个
sense_groups.english: This.

sense_groups.chinese: 喀什米尔？ - 对
sense_groups.english: A pashmina? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱死它了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I love these babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Really? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 喀什米尔是什么？
sense_groups.english: Ross, what's a pashmina?

sense_groups.chinese: 一种小毯子
sense_groups.english: It's a rug.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿？
sense_groups.english: Jill?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 对不起...
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你真以为我会上当？
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, you really think that's gonna work on me?

sense_groups.chinese: 泪眼攻势是我发明的
sense_groups.english: I invented that.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对 但我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. But I am sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 走一次回头路还好
sense_groups.english: All right, it's okay. One little setback is okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是别再犯了 好吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: But don't let it happen again, all right? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然这是老爸付的钱 我应该全都没收
sense_groups.english: Now, since Daddy paid for all this stuff, I should take it all away.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我没收披肩就好
sense_groups.english: But I'm just gonna take the pashmina.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有那条裤子
sense_groups.english: And the pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是都没收好了 这样你才能得到教训
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm just gonna take it all, because that way, you'll learn the lesson.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Alrighty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有事要忙 我们晚餐见
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna run a couple of errands, and I will see you at dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 都被她拿走了
sense_groups.english: She took all my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 除了这个蓝色小袋子
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Everything but the little blue one.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一样最棒了
sense_groups.english: That's the best one.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 谢谢你 - 这个嘛
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Thank you so much. - Oh. Well, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你好逊喔 喀什米尔怎么会是小毯子
sense_groups.english: Oh, my gosh, that was so lame. Like a pashmina could be a rug.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Well, how about you with the

sense_groups.chinese: "对不起..." - 闭嘴 我哪有那么恶心
sense_groups.english: "I'm sorry." - Shut up. I wasn't like that at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 我那个公寓裤呢？
sense_groups.english: What about what I said, you know, about the apartment pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 够蠢吧？
sense_groups.english: How dumb was I?

sense_groups.chinese: 你高中时有这么可爱吗？ - 别闹了
sense_groups.english: Were you this cute in high school? - Oh, stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才别闹了 - 你才别闹了
sense_groups.english: No, you stop. - No, you stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 你别闹了
sense_groups.english: You stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我坐中间 你们都别闹了
sense_groups.english: Okay, why don't I sit here and then you'll both stop it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想做什么？我们来疯一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, what do you wanna do? Let's do something crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我们来多休息多喝水
sense_groups.english: I know, let's rest and drink lots of fluids.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我休息
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过如果我要上床 你也得跟我来
sense_groups.english: But, you know, if I'm going to bed, then you're coming with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来很难说不 但是你鼻水流不停
sense_groups.english: See, that would be impossible to resist if you weren't all drippy here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你不想要我吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you saying that you don't wanna get with this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好连健康时都不要这样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't think you should say that even when you're healthy.

sense_groups.chinese: 来嘛
sense_groups.english: Oh. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是针对你
sense_groups.english: Don't take this personally, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是没办法跟病人上床
sense_groups.english: It's just that I just can't have sex with a sick person.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'm with you, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不跟病人上床 那样好恶心
sense_groups.english: I can't have sex with a sick person either. That's disgusting.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我没病 让我证明给你看
sense_groups.english: But I'm not sick. Let me prove it to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们身强体壮 青春正盛
sense_groups.english: We are two healthy people in the prime of life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是想继续身强体壮
sense_groups.english: See, that's the thing. I would like to stay in the prime of life.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么样啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 有件事或许你应该知道
sense_groups.english: Um, I think there's something you should maybe know.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好不是公寓裤的事
sense_groups.english: It better not be about the apartment pants...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我的上司爱死这个构想了
sense_groups.english: because I just pitched the idea to my boss at Ralph Lauren, and she loved it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我刚...
sense_groups.english: No, no. It's just, I was, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你走了后 我跟罗斯和吉儿在一起
sense_groups.english: I was with Ross and Jill after you left...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很确定他们之间有火花
sense_groups.english: and I'm pretty sure I saw a little spark between them.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 或许没事
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, I mean, it's probably nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想提醒你 他们或许有什么
sense_groups.english: But I just wanted to warn you that there might be something there.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯跟吉儿？ - 对
sense_groups.english: With Ross and Jill? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯和我妹妹？
sense_groups.english: With Ross and my sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 我妹吉儿和我的前男友罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - With my sister Jill and my ex-boyfriend Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 不可能的 - 那好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Oh, there is no way. - Okay, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪 我真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I cannot believe that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我反对罗斯交女朋友 但居然跟我妹
sense_groups.english: I don't really like it when Ross goes out with anyone, but my sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是等于乱伦吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't that like incest or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 而且他们会上床 要是他还娶她呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, and they're gonna have sex. Oh, no. What if he marries her too?

sense_groups.chinese: 太恐怖了 真是太恐怖了
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is just terrible. This is just terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我又不能阻止 罗斯又不是我的
sense_groups.english: And I can't stop it. I don't own Ross, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且吉儿有她的行动自由
sense_groups.english: And Jill, she should be able to do whatever it is she wants to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪 罗斯居然要娶我妹
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I can't believe Ross is marrying my little sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 这简直...
sense_groups.english: This is just...

sense_groups.chinese: 天那 这真是我这一生最悲惨的遭遇
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, this is just the worst thing that could've ever happened to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过公寓裤的事真是太好了
sense_groups.english: But great news about the apartment pants, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 总共3块85
sense_groups.english: That'll be 3.85.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？昨天你还说我太美不该付钱
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? Yesterday you said I was too pretty to pay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能请客 因为经理说我...
sense_groups.english: It's just I can't, because my manager said that I...

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐 祝你生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday to you. Happy birthday to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝安妮生日快乐 - 艾美
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday, dear Annie... - Amy.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾美
sense_groups.english: Amy

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你生日快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday to you

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 还真巧 今天也是我的生日
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, that's weird, today's my birthday too.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里不是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, not in here it isn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉迟到了 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Sorry I'm late. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想问你工作找得怎样
sense_groups.english: You know, I just wanted to see if there were any leads on the old job front.

sense_groups.chinese: 没进展 但我经过三家折和店都没进去
sense_groups.english: Oh. No. But I just walked past three sales and I didn't go in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很坚强吧？ - 哦
sense_groups.english: How strong am I? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: That is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道谁不必找工作？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know who doesn't have to job-hunt?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他在大学教书 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Ross. He works at the university. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你知道 你们聊过 你们很投缘 你们要约会吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, so you know that? You guys talked? So you get along? So you're gonna go out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟罗斯约会？当然不会 你哪来的念头？
sense_groups.english: Me go out with Ross? No. God, no. What would make you think that?
It's just Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得你们有什么
sense_groups.english: said she, you know, thought she saw something between you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 他人是很好 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: No. I mean, he's nice. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会想和他做朋友 但不会想和他交往
sense_groups.english: He's the kind of guy you're friends with but not the kind of guy you date.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会 你跟他交往过 我呢？
sense_groups.english: I mean, he's the kind of guy you date, because you did, but me?

sense_groups.chinese: 就没什么兴趣
sense_groups.english: Hmm, not so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么兴趣？什么意思？
sense_groups.english: Oh, not so much? What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯有哪里不好吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, is there something wrong with Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 只不过...
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. He's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道...他有点书呆吧
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You know, he's just a little bookish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他是怪胎？ - 你也有同感？
