sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对吉儿的看法或许没错 - 我就知道 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: You, uh, may have been right about Jill. - Oh, I knew it. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 她吻了我 - 什么？你们亲嘴了？
sense_groups.english: Um, she kissed me. - What? You kissed?

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我们应该回避一下 - 嘘
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should give them some privacy. - Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我尽量不去亲她
sense_groups.english: Look, I tried not to kiss her, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来不像 想不亲一个人...
sense_groups.english: It doesn't sound like it. It's pretty easy not to kiss someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要亲就对了 我们现在就没有亲嘴
sense_groups.english: You just don't kiss them. See? Look at us right now, not kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我说完好吗？
sense_groups.english: Let me finish, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 她过来亲我 我没有阻止
sense_groups.english: She started kissing me, and I didn't stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有多想
sense_groups.english: I guess I just wasn't thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 没有多想 我来让你好好想一想
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's right. I'm gonna give you something to think about.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来我一想就把她推开了
sense_groups.english: But then I started thinking and I stopped the kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你把舌头 从我妹的嘴里缩回来告诉我
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, thank you for taking your tongue out of my sister's mouth to tell me that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是想到如果我跟吉儿怎样
sense_groups.english: Look, I realized if anything were to happen with me and Jill...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就再也不能怎样了
sense_groups.english: then nothing could ever happen with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我是说...
sense_groups.english: What? - No, I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我们还会不会怎样
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't know if anything is ever going to happen with us again, ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不想断绝这个可能性
sense_groups.english: But I don't wanna know that it never could.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我喊停 然后...
sense_groups.english: So I stopped it...

sense_groups.chinese: 她气得摔坏我的投影机
sense_groups.english: and she got mad and broke my projector.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都不知道该说什么了
sense_groups.english: I don't even know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪 你在哭吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, are you crying?

sense_groups.chinese: 这两个人为何就是不能在一起
sense_groups.english: I just don't see why those two can't work things out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要走了 我要远离某个...
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm leaving. I'm not gonna spend one more day...

sense_groups.chinese: 一直害我的人
sense_groups.english: with someone who's out to sabotage my every move.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是你 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: That's you, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I got that.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你 我投怀送抱 你却不要
sense_groups.english: And you. I throw myself at you, and you say no?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有够同性恋的
sense_groups.english: How gay are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己保重 吉儿
sense_groups.english: You take care, Jill.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, see you. - Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉儿居然走了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe Jill's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 没办法 我一发不可收拾
sense_groups.english: I can't help it. I opened a gate.

questions.name: S06E15
questions.en:
Hey, you guys, guess what?
Barry and Mindy are getting a divorce.
What is the matter with you?
No. Barry and Mindy.
Oh, sorry. I hear "divorce," I immediately go to Ross. Heh.
Who's Barry and Mindy?
Barry was the guy I almost married, and Mindy was my best friend.
Wasn't he cheating on you with her?
That just means he was falling asleep on top of her instead of me.
Can you imagine if I'd married him? How different would my life be?
I know. I've always wondered how different life would be...
if I'd never gotten divorced.
Which time? - The first time!
Imagine if Carol hadn't realized she was a lesbian.
I can't. I keep seeing it the good way.
I bet I'd still be doing my karate.
Towards the end of our marriage, I did karate as a way of releasing the tension...
from, you know, not doing anything else physical.
Maybe the problem was pronouncing it "ka-ra-tay."
What if I was still fat?
You wouldn't be dating me, that's for sure.
Sure I would.
What? You guys think I'm that shallow?
No, I think Monica was that fat.
Hey, imagine if I'd never gotten fired off Days of Our Lives.
Hey. Hey, there's Carol again.
What if I had had the guts to quit my job?
I'd probably be writing for The New Yorker, being paid to be funny.
But my job's fun too. I mean, tomorrow...
I don't have to wear a tie.
What if I'd taken that job at Merrill Lynch?
What? - Merrill Lynch?
A massage client who worked there said I had a knack for stocks.
Why didn't you take it?
At that time, you see, I thought that everything that rhymed was true.
So I thought if I worked with stocks...
I'd have to live in a box and only eat lox and have a pet fox.
Do you think if all those things happened, we'd still hang out?
Oh, my God. Rachel Green?
Aah! Rob Tilman!
No, heh, no, it's me. Ross.
Oh, I'm sorry. Ross Tilman.
No. No, no. Ross Geller. - Of course! Monica's brother.
Yeah. Right. - Wow! How are you?
Good. Good, I'm married. - Oh! Me too! Ha, ha.
Isn't it the best? - Oh, it's the best. Heh.
So, um, how's Monica? - Really, really great.
Actually, she's right down the street. Um, you should stop by and say hi.
Oh, I would love to. - Yeah, she'd be so excited.
Oh, okay. - Come on.
Wait, don't you have to pay for...
Busty Ladies?
No, that's okay. Some kid asked me to pick it up for him, but I...
So, Monica, still going out with Dr. Boring, huh?
He's not boring. He's just...
He's just low-key.
Here you go, one hazelnut latte. - Thank you.
You know, the hazelnut, actually not a nut.
It's a seed.
Wow.
Can anyone else name a well-known seed that's been masquerading as a nut?
Oh, dear God. Let me think.
Hey.
Oh, no. What's the matter?
I got another rejection letter.
They said my writing was funny, just not "Archie Comic funny."
I gotta get back to the hospital.
All right. - Okay.
Bye. - Bye-bye.
Oh, uh, by the way, the answer is the Brazil nut.
Was his question, "What's more boring than him?"
Hey, man. Sorry about that Archie thing.
You, uh, need me to give you some money?
Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.
Really?
Eh.
Joey doesn't have to give you money.
TV stars have assistants, right? - That's an idea.
If I hire an assistant, would you take money from her?
No, Joey. Chandler could be your assistant.
He could answer your fan mail and stuff.
That would be great! Let's do that!
I could use the money. Give me time to write.
Great! Welcome aboard. - Okay!
All right. I need to use the bathroom.
Since I don't need assistance in there, take a break!
All right.
Hey. - Hey, Phoebe.
Guess what? - What?
Joey just hired Chandler.
Oh, that's so sweet.
Oh! Hang on!
Hang on!
Go!
No. No, no. I said sell when it hits 50!
Five-oh! It's a number! It comes after four-nine!
No, it's okay. It's okay. You're allowed one mistake.
Just kidding. You are of course fired.
Ugh.
Hey, Mon? - Hey.
Mon, look who I ran into.
Oh, my God, Rachel!
God, you look terrific! - Oh, so do you!
Thanks.
Did you lose weight? - You are so sweet to notice.
Yes, I lost 3 and a half pounds.
Ah!
You remember my friend Chandler? - Hi.
And that's Phoebe. - Hi.
Sit down. Sit down. How long's it been since we've seen each other?
1987, the day after Christmas. Uh, Sean McMahan's party.
I played you one of my songs. "Interplanetary Courtship Ritual."
Oh, yeah. Right.
So, now, do you still do music? - Well, sometimes.
Sometime I'll play you... - Oh, my God!
Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives just walked in here!
Rach, he's a friend of ours.
You are friends with Dr. Drake Ramoray?
It's hard to be friends with Drake...
because of his busy schedule and the fact that he's not real.
Hey, or I could bring my keyboard here sometime.
He's coming over. - Joey?
I know. Here, here.
Oh.
No. This is my friend Rachel. We went to high school together.
Ha, ha, hi. - Hi.
I...
I love you on that show.
Oh. - I watch you every day.
When you took out your kidney to save your ex-wife...
even though she tried to kill you...
It's always nice to meet fans.
She's not crazy, is she? - No.
So, uh, how you doing?
Hang on.
Hang on. Hang on.
Go!
Who's this?
Oh, you're gonna like working for me.
What's your name? What kind of name is Brindy?
I... Uh, whatever.
Stop talking.
All right, from now on your name is Joan.
You can pick your own last name.
Hey, there you are. - Uh-oh, it's my boss.
All right, here's a list of things for you to do today.
This is gonna be so great. Thank you so much.
I gotta go to work. I'm delivering twins, but only one of them is mine.
"Drop off my dry cleaning. Pick up my vitamins."
Teach me how to spell vitamins.
"Wear in my new jeans."
You realize what you are, don't you? - What?
You're his bitch.
No, no! No!
Wait! You didn't sit on my Kit Kats did you?
No, there was a little, little dip in the market...
and I lost $13 million.
But the Kit Kats are all right?
What am I gonna do? I can't call my office, they'll kill me.
I can't call my clients, they'll kill themselves!
All right, now my chest hurts. - What?
My chest hurts. Ugh.
Ugh! And now, I can't breathe. - Are you having a heart attack?
If I were, would I have shooting pains up and down my left arm?
Yes. - Then, yes. That is what I'm having.
Oh, my God!
Come on, Pheebs, it's not that bad.
Most people'd be excited if they didn't work for a couple weeks.
Most people don't like their jobs. I love my job.
I've been not working for three hours, and I'm already going crazy.
I miss Joan.
Honey, a heart attack is nature's way of telling you to slow down.
I always thought it was nature's way of telling you to die. Heh.
You're not gonna die.
I mean, you are going to die, but you're not gonna die today.
I wish I was dead.
Let's take a walk.
You should consider writing for Talking Out of Your Ass magazine.
So what's going on with you?
Well, um, I've been doing a lot more of my karate.
Still a dry spell with Carol? - Yeah.
How long has it been since you've had sex?
Well, last weekend... - That's not so bad.
will be two months...
since I stopped trying.
You need to spice things up.
What do you mean? - I don't know.
You could tie her up. You could eat stuff off each other.
Oh.
Dirty talk, menage a trois, toys. - Wow.
Role-playing. You're warden, she's prisoner.
You're the pirate, she's the wench. - Okay, I think I got it.
You could be two stockbrokers, rolling naked on the trading floor...
and everybody's watching.
It never happened.
And over there is Brady's Pub...
where I unwind after a long day of "surgeoning."
Wow! This is so amazing. What else?
Well, that is a large piece of television equipment.
And, uh, that is an old man.
Hey, old man! - Hey.
Alrighty. What do you say we head back to my place?
Well, wow. Um, you know, I would really love to, but I shouldn't.
Why? Why can't the world stop turning?
Just for a moment. Just for us.
Isn't that a line from the show?
Uh, yeah, but, uh...
I may have said those things before, but...
I never truly meant them until now.
That's a line from the show too!
Okay, you watch too much TV.
Joe, here's the freshly-squeezed orange juice you asked for.
Thanks. - Hi.
Yeah, there's pulp in that.
Yeah? - Heh.
I thought we talked about this. I don't like pulp.
No pulp. Pulp isn't juice. All juice. Okay?
I'm sorry. I guess I just like the pulp.
God, I'm sorry. I am being so rude.
Rachel, would you like a soda or something?
Because Chandler will run right out and get it.
Yeah, well, sure, iced tea would be great.
Iced tea.
Okay. Anything for you, sir?
Did I not just tell him?
Okay, look, Chandler, if this is gonna work...
you have got to listen.
You're gonna throw that juice at me, aren't you?
It's not all juice.
Honey, this morning was fun, huh?
Me hopping in on you in the shower there?
Yeah, maybe someday we could get a place with two bathrooms.
Look, Carol, um, I was thinking maybe...
maybe we can spice things up a little.
What do you mean? - Carol, our sex life. It's just not...
Dad! - Hey there, little fella!
Hey, why don't we get some shoes on you?
Show Dad how you put your shoes on in your room.
Seriously, our sex life.
I was thinking maybe, I don't know...
we could try some new things, you know, for fun.
Like what? - Well, I don't know. Um...
What if we, uh, were to...
tie each other up?
Um, some people eat stuff off one another.
Yeah.
Um, you know, we could try dirty talk. Uh, heh.
Um, we could have a threesome. - I love that idea!
Who sold a story to Archie Comics?
Oh, my God, that's so great. Oh, wow!
You're a published writer. I wish I had a present.
Aw. - Wait a minute.
My last Kit Kat bar.
You want to share it? - Okay!
Hey. - Hey.
Chandler, I know you're mad. I'm sorry.
I was a total jerk. Completely over the line.
I just... I hate pulp.
You know how Monica feels about low-fat mayonnaise?
It's not mayonnaise!
Okay, uh, anyway, I just wanted to say I'm sorry, and here.
What's this? - Fresh-squeezed orange juice, with pulp.
Just the way you like. - Aw, thanks, man.
Hey, Joey? Chandler sold a story to Archie Comics.
Oh, my God, that's great! Congratulations! What's the story?
Oh, you wouldn't care. It's just a stupid comic book story.
Are you kidding me? I love Archie and the whole gang.
Well, um, Archie needs money to fix his jalopy.
Uh, but he doesn't want Reggie to just give him the money.
So Reggie hires him as his assist...
As his butler.
And makes him do crazy things...
like bring him milk shakes that can't have lumps.
Wait a minute. That sounds a little familiar.
Did they already do that? I think I read it!
Monica, listen. I have to ask.
Okay, Joey Tribbiani invited me back to his apartment.
Does he do this with a lot of girls? - Yeah, a lot. A lot, a lot.
Ah! And I'm one of them.
Wow.
I just cannot believe this. I mean, Joey Tribbiani.
It's none of my business, but aren't you married?
Yeah.
I wish we could just not be married for a little bit.
You know, I just wish we could be, like, on a break.
Well, you're not.
It's easy for you. You get to have sex with whoever you want.
Yeah, I can. Ha.
Don't think I don't. I do.
I mean, all the time. You bet!
Monica? - Hmm?
You've done it, right?
Of course I have. What do you think, I'm like some 30-year-old virgin?
Oh, my God. You're a 30-year-old virgin.
Louder. I don't think the guy in the back heard.
Yeah, I heard it.
It's not like I haven't had the opportunity.
I'm waiting for the perfect guy. - Mm-hm.
I'm seeing this guy Roger. He's not perfect...
but, uh, I'm thinking maybe I should get it over with.
You know, give him my flower.
Oh, my God, do it! Honey, you've waited long enough.
You know what? You are right. - Sex does not have to be a big deal.
There shouldn't be all these rules and restrictions.
People should be able to sleep with whoever, whenever...
Rachel. I'm never gonna think it's okay for you to cheat on your husband.
Oh, what do you know, virgin?
Phoebe?
Why is smoke coming out of the bathroom?
Oh, yeah. The doctor said that could be one of the side effects.
Put the cigarette out.
No, it's not a cigarette. The smoke is coming out of me!
Put it out. - Okay, okay!
I'm so glad you're here. - Come on.
I got it. I got it. - Give it to me! Give it!
Hello?
No, she can't come to the phone now.
Oh, right. No problem. Okay, bye-bye.
Was it work? Were they mad? Was it Jack? Did he yell?
No, just relax. Nobody yelled.
Jack was making sure you were getting better.
Thank God.
Yeah, she's fired.
You've done all you can, Dr. Wesley.
You've got to let her go.
Goodbye and Godspeed, Hope Brady.
Not so fast, Wesley.
Ramoray. - That's right, Wesley.
I just stopped by to say that you're not a real doctor.
And that woman's brain is fine.
Oh, thank God. Oh, thank God.
Hope? Hope? - Drake.
You're not dying, Hope.
You're gonna live a long, healthy life. With me.
Oh, Drake.
Okay.
Here we go.
Okay. Ahem.
Mm.
Hi, Joey? It's Rachel.
Um, I am free tomorrow night.
Yeah, sure, sure I can bring some sandwiches.

sense_groups.chinese: 好发泄缺乏肉体运动的精力
sense_groups.english: from, you know, not doing anything else physical.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你不把空手道 念成控手道就没事了
sense_groups.english: Maybe the problem was pronouncing it "ka-ra-tay."

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我还是很胖呢？
sense_groups.english: What if I was still fat?

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定不会跟我交往
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't be dating me, that's for sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然会 少来了
sense_groups.english: Sure I would.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真的觉得我那么肤浅？
sense_groups.english: What? You guys think I'm that shallow?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我只是觉得摩妮卡太胖
sense_groups.english: No, I think Monica was that fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我没被 《我们的日子》开除呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, imagine if I'd never gotten fired off Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝又出现了
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hey, there's Carol again.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我有勇气辞职呢？
sense_groups.english: What if I had had the guts to quit my job?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能在帮《纽约客》写稿 拿钱搞笑
sense_groups.english: I'd probably be writing for The New Yorker, being paid to be funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在的工作也很有趣
sense_groups.english: But my job's fun too. I mean, tomorrow...

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我不必打领带
sense_groups.english: I don't have to wear a tie.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我去美林证券上班呢？
sense_groups.english: What if I'd taken that job at Merrill Lynch?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 美林证券？
sense_groups.english: What? - Merrill Lynch?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我有个客人在那里上班 他说我有炒股票的头脑
sense_groups.english: A massage client who worked there said I had a knack for stocks.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你怎么不去？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you take it?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为当时我很相信押韵这回事
sense_groups.english: At that time, you see, I thought that everything that rhymed was true.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得要是我去做股票 就得住地窖
sense_groups.english: So I thought if I worked with stocks...

sense_groups.chinese: 只能吃安眠药 养三脚猫
sense_groups.english: I'd have to live in a box and only eat lox and have a pet fox.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得如果有这些事 我们还会在一起吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think if all those things happened, we'd still hang out?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 瑞秋葛林？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Rachel Green?

sense_groups.chinese: 劳勃提尔曼
sense_groups.english: Aah! Rob Tilman!

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 是我 罗斯
sense_groups.english: No, heh, no, it's me. Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 罗斯提尔曼
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Ross Tilman.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是罗斯盖勒 - 也对 摩妮卡的哥哥
sense_groups.english: No. No, no. Ross Geller. - Of course! Monica's brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Right. - Wow! How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我结婚了 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: Good. Good, I'm married. - Oh! Me too! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚真好不是吗？ - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Isn't it the best? - Oh, it's the best. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡好吗？ - 非常好
sense_groups.english: So, um, how's Monica? - Really, really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上她就在前面 你应该过去打个招呼
sense_groups.english: Actually, she's right down the street. Um, you should stop by and say hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 她会很高兴
sense_groups.english: Oh, I would love to. - Yeah, she'd be so excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 走吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你不是要买...
sense_groups.english: Wait, don't you have to pay for...

sense_groups.chinese: 《巨乳女郎》？
sense_groups.english: Busty Ladies?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 有个小孩托我帮他买
sense_groups.english: No, that's okay. Some kid asked me to pick it up for him, but I...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你还在跟无聊医生交往？
sense_groups.english: So, Monica, still going out with Dr. Boring, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 他才不无聊 他只是...
sense_groups.english: He's not boring. He's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 只是比较低调
sense_groups.english: He's just low-key.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的榛果拿铁 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here you go, one hazelnut latte. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实榛果不是果实
sense_groups.english: You know, the hazelnut, actually not a nut.

sense_groups.chinese: 而是种籽
sense_groups.english: It's a seed.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁能说出一种 假装是果实的常见种籽？
sense_groups.english: Can anyone else name a well-known seed that's been masquerading as a nut?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我想想看
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear God. Let me think.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我又被退稿了
sense_groups.english: I got another rejection letter.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说我的东西很有趣 只是不符合《阿奇漫画》风
sense_groups.english: They said my writing was funny, just not "Archie Comic funny."

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 我得回医院了
sense_groups.english: I gotta get back to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 答案是巴西果
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, by the way, the answer is the Brazil nut.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的问题比他的人更无趣
sense_groups.english: Was his question, "What's more boring than him?"

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 退稿的事真可惜
sense_groups.english: Hey, man. Sorry about that Archie thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我给你一些钱吗？
sense_groups.english: You, uh, need me to give you some money?

sense_groups.chinese: 我穷归穷 还是有骨气
sense_groups.english: Hey, I may have no money, but I still have my pride.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许乔伊不必给你钱
sense_groups.english: Joey doesn't have to give you money.

sense_groups.chinese: 电视明星都有助理对吧？ - 可行喔
sense_groups.english: TV stars have assistants, right? - That's an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我请助理转交 你会收吗？
sense_groups.english: If I hire an assistant, would you take money from her?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 钱德可以当你的助理
sense_groups.english: No, Joey. Chandler could be your assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以帮你回信给影迷
sense_groups.english: He could answer your fan mail and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 好主意 就这么办吧
sense_groups.english: That would be great! Let's do that!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有钱领 还有时间写作
sense_groups.english: I could use the money. Give me time to write.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮 欢迎加入 - 感谢
sense_groups.english: Great! Welcome aboard. - Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在要去上厕所
sense_groups.english: All right. I need to use the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我上厕所不用人帮 你就休息吧
sense_groups.english: Since I don't need assistance in there, take a break!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎样？ - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Guess what? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊找钱德当他的助理
sense_groups.english: Joey just hired Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Oh! Hang on!

sense_groups.chinese: 等我一下
sense_groups.english: Hang on!

sense_groups.chinese: 说
sense_groups.english: Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 不对 我是说一到50点就卖
sense_groups.english: No. No, no. I said sell when it hits 50!

sense_groups.chinese: 50是一个数字 在49后面
sense_groups.english: Five-oh! It's a number! It comes after four-nine!

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 一次错误可以接受
sense_groups.english: No, it's okay. It's okay. You're allowed one mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑的 你当然被开除了
sense_groups.english: Just kidding. You are of course fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你看我遇见谁
sense_groups.english: Mon, look who I ran into.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好漂亮 - 你也是
sense_groups.english: God, you look terrific! - Oh, so do you!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是瘦了？ - 你居然注意到了
sense_groups.english: Did you lose weight? - You are so sweet to notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我瘦了三磅半
sense_groups.english: Yes, I lost 3 and a half pounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我的朋友钱德吧 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: You remember my friend Chandler? - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 那位是菲比 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: And that's Phoebe. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 快坐下 我们多久没见面了？
sense_groups.english: Sit down. Sit down. How long's it been since we've seen each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 1987年 圣诞节第二天 西 巴麦克曼的派对
sense_groups.english: 1987, the day after Christmas. Uh, Sean McMahan's party.

sense_groups.chinese: 我弹了我的创作曲给你听 《星际求爱仪式》
sense_groups.english: I played you one of my songs. "Interplanetary Courtship Ritual."

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在玩音乐吗？ - 偶尔
sense_groups.english: So, now, do you still do music? - Well, sometimes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该来我家 我弹... - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Sometime I'll play you... - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 《我们的日子》的乔伊崔比亚尼刚刚走进来
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives just walked in here!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 他是我们的朋友
sense_groups.english: Rach, he's a friend of ours.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是雷莫瑞医生的朋友？
sense_groups.english: You are friends with Dr. Drake Ramoray?

sense_groups.chinese: 要跟他交朋友有点难 因为他很忙
sense_groups.english: It's hard to be friends with Drake...

sense_groups.chinese: 又是个虚构人物
sense_groups.english: because of his busy schedule and the fact that he's not real.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也可以把键盘带来
sense_groups.english: Hey, or I could bring my keyboard here sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 他过来了 - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: He's coming over. - Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 拿去
sense_groups.english: I know. Here, here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是啦 这是我朋友瑞秋 我们是高中同学
sense_groups.english: No. This is my friend Rachel. We went to high school together.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈 哈 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我
我好喜欢你演的戏
sense_groups.english: I love you on that show.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 我每天都看
sense_groups.english: Oh. - I watch you every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的前妻明明想杀你
sense_groups.english: When you took out your kidney to save your ex-wife...

sense_groups.chinese: 你还捐肾救她...
sense_groups.english: even though she tried to kill you...

sense_groups.chinese: 遇见影迷总是很开心
sense_groups.english: It's always nice to meet fans.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会很神经吧？ - 不会
sense_groups.english: She's not crazy, is she? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以...你好吗？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等...
sense_groups.english: Hang on.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hang on. Hang on.

sense_groups.chinese: 说
sense_groups.english: Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你要替我工作 你叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're gonna like working for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 布伦蒂是什么鸟名字？
sense_groups.english: What's your name? What kind of name is Brindy?
I... Uh, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Stop talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 以后你就叫琼安
sense_groups.english: All right, from now on your name is Joan.

sense_groups.chinese: 姓你自己选
sense_groups.english: You can pick your own last name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里 - 是老板大人
sense_groups.english: Hey, there you are. - Uh-oh, it's my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你今天的工作项目
sense_groups.english: All right, here's a list of things for you to do today.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: This is gonna be so great. Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去接生双胞胎了 但只有一个是我的骨肉
sense_groups.english: I gotta go to work. I'm delivering twins, but only one of them is mine.

sense_groups.chinese: "把衣服送去干洗 去拿我的维他命"
sense_groups.english: "Drop off my dry cleaning. Pick up my vitamins."

sense_groups.chinese: 教我怎么写维他命
sense_groups.english: Teach me how to spell vitamins.

sense_groups.chinese: 把我的新牛仔裤穿软
sense_groups.english: "Wear in my new jeans."

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你的角色吧？ - 什么角色？
sense_groups.english: You realize what you are, don't you? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是他的喽罗
sense_groups.english: You're his bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是压坏了我的巧克力酥吧
sense_groups.english: Wait! You didn't sit on my Kit Kats did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 市场出了点变化
sense_groups.english: No, there was a little, little dip in the market...

sense_groups.chinese: 我损失了1千3百万
sense_groups.english: and I lost $13 million.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过巧克力酥没事吧？
sense_groups.english: But the Kit Kats are all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么办？怎么办？通知公司我会被砍死
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? I can't call my office, they'll kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 通知客户 他们会砍自己
sense_groups.english: I can't call my clients, they'll kill themselves!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在又胸口痛 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: All right, now my chest hurts. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的胸口在痛
sense_groups.english: My chest hurts. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是喘不过气来 - 菲比 你是心脏病发作吗？
sense_groups.english: Ugh! And now, I can't breathe. - Are you having a heart attack?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是 左臂会来回抽痛吗？
sense_groups.english: If I were, would I have shooting pains up and down my left arm?

sense_groups.chinese: 会 - 那就是了
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Then, yes. That is what I'm having.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 没那么严重
sense_groups.english: Come on, Pheebs, it's not that bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 一般人如果可以休息两星期 会放鞭炮庆祝
sense_groups.english: Most people'd be excited if they didn't work for a couple weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 一般人不喜欢他们的工作 我喜欢我的工作
sense_groups.english: Most people don't like their jobs. I love my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才休息3小时就快疯掉了
sense_groups.english: I've been not working for three hours, and I'm already going crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想念琼安
sense_groups.english: I miss Joan.

sense_groups.chinese: 心脏病发就表示你该放慢脚步
sense_groups.english: Honey, a heart attack is nature's way of telling you to slow down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直以为心脏病发 就表示你要死了
sense_groups.english: I always thought it was nature's way of telling you to die. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你不会死
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna die.

sense_groups.chinese: 你迟早会死 但不是今天
sense_groups.english: I mean, you are going to die, but you're not gonna die today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去死算了
sense_groups.english: I wish I was dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去走走
sense_groups.english: Let's take a walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该考虑去替"讲话不经大脑"杂志写稿
sense_groups.english: You should consider writing for Talking Out of Your Ass magazine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最近怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So what's going on with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我练控手道练得更勤了
sense_groups.english: Well, um, I've been doing a lot more of my karate.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟卡萝还是爱理不理？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Still a dry spell with Carol? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们多久没上床了？
sense_groups.english: How long has it been since you've had sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 到上个周末... - 那还好嘛
sense_groups.english: Well, last weekend... - That's not so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 就已经2个月...
sense_groups.english: will be two months...

sense_groups.chinese: 放弃尝试了
sense_groups.english: since I stopped trying.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你应该玩点刺激的
sense_groups.english: You need to spice things up.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么说？ - 不晓得
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以绑住对方 可以在对方身上吃东西
sense_groups.english: You could tie her up. You could eat stuff off each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 淫言秽语 3P 辅助工具 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Dirty talk, menage a trois, toys. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 角色扮演 你当典狱长她当囚犯
sense_groups.english: Role-playing. You're warden, she's prisoner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当海盗她当村姑 - 好 我懂了
sense_groups.english: You're the pirate, she's the wench. - Okay, I think I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者你们都当股票经纪人 裸体 在交易大厅的地板上翻滚
sense_groups.english: You could be two stockbrokers, rolling naked on the trading floor...

sense_groups.chinese: 给大家看
sense_groups.english: and everybody's watching.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没干过
sense_groups.english: It never happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 那里是布瑞帝酒吧
sense_groups.english: And over there is Brady's Pub...

sense_groups.chinese: 我行完医喜欢去轻松一下
sense_groups.english: where I unwind after a long day of "surgeoning."

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒喔 还有呢？
sense_groups.english: Wow! This is so amazing. What else?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一个大型电视台设备
sense_groups.english: Well, that is a large piece of television equipment.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一个老男人
sense_groups.english: And, uh, that is an old man.

sense_groups.chinese: 老男人 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey, old man! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要不要回我家去？
sense_groups.english: Alrighty. What do you say we head back to my place?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想去 但是不行
sense_groups.english: Well, wow. Um, you know, I would really love to, but I shouldn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？为什么世界不能停止转动
sense_groups.english: Why? Why can't the world stop turning?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要一下下 只为了我们？
sense_groups.english: Just for a moment. Just for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是戏里的台词吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't that a line from the show?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 不过
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我或许说过同样的话 但是...
sense_groups.english: I may have said those things before, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 只有这一刻 我才是真心的

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 要做礼物好兴奋喔
sense_groups.english: What? - Just so excited to make the presents!

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的
sense_groups.english: Shoot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我是乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想捐赠一些体液
sense_groups.english: And with all due respect, I'd like to donate some fluids.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的研究刚告一段落
sense_groups.english: We're at the end of one of our research cycles...

sense_groups.chinese: 目前没有在找人
sense_groups.english: so we're not looking for applicants now.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜 我存了一阵子
sense_groups.english: That's too bad. I've kind of been saving up.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的没有我能参加的研究？
sense_groups.english: Uh, you sure there's no studies I can participate in?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是接下来的一览表
sense_groups.english: Well, here's a schedule of what's coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Ah, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是这个已经开始了
sense_groups.english: Oh, but this one starts now.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 但只限双胞胎
sense_groups.english: That one is available now, but only identical twins are eligible.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是双胞胎研究 - 但是有两千块钱
sense_groups.english: It's a twin study. - But it's $2000.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Sorry. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 那这个怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Well, how about this one?

sense_groups.chinese: 测试乔伊崔比亚尼对美女接待的影响力实验呢？
sense_groups.english: "Testing the Effects of Joey Tribbiani on Attractive Nurse Receptionists."

sense_groups.chinese: 结果已经出来了 不太理想
sense_groups.english: We already got the results back on that one, and they're not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的不错 - 很棒对不对？
sense_groups.english: That was good. - Wasn't that a blast?

sense_groups.chinese: 危险 危险 - 天啊 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Danger! Danger! - God, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞什么啊？
sense_groups.english: What the hell was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 让你们认识Unagi的重要
sense_groups.english: A lesson in the importance of unagi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个变态
sense_groups.english: You're a freak.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Perhaps.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好奇
sense_groups.english: Now, I'm curious.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们那样哀哀叫 什么时候才要修理我？
sense_groups.english: At what point during those girlish screams would you have begun to kick my ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们没有准备
sense_groups.english: All right, so we weren't prepared.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉用这种方法传达我的重点
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I had to take such drastic measures to make my point.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是为你们的安全着想
sense_groups.english: But, look, I just want you guys to be safe.
Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 危险
sense_groups.english: Danger!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯？Unagi
sense_groups.english: Ah, huh? Unagi.

sense_groups.chinese: 两千块好多
sense_groups.english: Two thousand bucks is a lot of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 真想有个双胞胎兄弟
sense_groups.english: Boy, I wish I had a twin.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪里才能找到
sense_groups.english: Where could I find someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我长得一样的人？
sense_groups.english: who looks exactly like me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我感觉到是你
sense_groups.english: I sensed it was you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远全知
sense_groups.english: I'm always aware.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道Unagi是鳗鱼吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, are you aware that unagi is an eel?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？ - 我不知道该为摩妮卡做什么礼物
sense_groups.english: What's up? - I can't figure out what to make Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以讲个笑话
sense_groups.english: Oh. Why don't you make her one of your little jokes?

sense_groups.chinese: 我快急死了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm going crazy, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有状似自制的东西？
sense_groups.english: Do you have anything around here that looks homemade?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？这个她一定会喜欢
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? She'd love this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是阿波罗八号的模型 我六年级时做的
sense_groups.english: It's an exact replica of Apollo 8. I made it in the sixth grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个也许可以用 我可以说你的爱让我飞上月亮
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess I could use that. I could say, "Your love sends me to the moon."

sense_groups.chinese: 对 可是阿波罗八号没有登陆月球
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. Except Apollo 8 didn't actually land on the moon.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你可以写
sense_groups.english: But you could write, um

sense_groups.chinese: "你的爱 让我绕行月球两圈后顺利返航"
sense_groups.english: "Your love lets me orbit the moon twice and return safely."

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我不能送这个
sense_groups.english: Wait, I can't give this to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为旁边写着"罗斯队长"
sense_groups.english: Why not? - It says "Captain Ross" on the side.

sense_groups.chinese: 底下写着"我讨厌摩妮卡" - 哦
sense_groups.english: And it says "I hate Monica" on the bottom. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 危险 - 危险
sense_groups.english: Danger! - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 鲑鱼卷寿司
sense_groups.english: Ah. Salmon-skin roll.
Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 甜心 这是我自己做的
sense_groups.english: Yes, honey, I made it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我剪不下去 我剪不下去
sense_groups.english: I can't do it. I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 自己录的合辑...
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh. A mixed tape. A mixed tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备交换礼物了吗？ - 当然 你先
sense_groups.english: You ready to exchange gifts? - Sure. Okay, you go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 过来 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, come here, come here. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有包装 因为我刚做好
sense_groups.english: Okay, now, it's not wrapped, because I just finished it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我录了一卷浪漫情歌给你
sense_groups.english: But I made you a tape of what I think are all romantic songs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒的礼物
sense_groups.english: What a great gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 有《你今晚的模样》吗？
sense_groups.english: Is "The Way You Look Tonight" on it?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许听了就知道
sense_groups.english: Maybe. We'll have to listen and see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好喜欢喔 谢谢你 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, I love it. Thank you so much. Mwah. - Aw. Okay. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要拆你的了吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you ready to open yours?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是袜子兔
sense_groups.english: It's a sock bunny.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我不是有叫你小兔兔？
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Yeah, yeah. Remember how I call you "bunny"?

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？
sense_groups.english: Not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫过一次 以后我想多叫
sense_groups.english: Well, I did one time. And I wanna start doing it more.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以做了袜子兔 - 我懂了
sense_groups.english: That's what this is about. - I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比也有做袜子兔
sense_groups.english: You know, um, Phoebe makes sock bunnies.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没有
sense_groups.english: No. No, she doesn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比做的是袜子兔子
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, what she makes, that's... They're sock rabbits.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不一样...好啦...
sense_groups.english: They're completely different. Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是我做的 对不起 我完全忘了今晚
sense_groups.english: Okay, I didn't make it. I'm sorry. I totally forgot about tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 和做礼物的事
sense_groups.english: and that we were supposed to make the presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我... - 不 当然有关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's okay. I don't... - No, no, it's not okay. It's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你那么...你那么用心
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're so incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 花那么多心血录情歌给我
sense_groups.english: You went through all this time and effort to make this tape for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要补偿你 我一定会的
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm just gonna... I'm gonna make this up to you. I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会下厨房煮你想吃的菜
sense_groups.english: I am going to cook you anything you want in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 进卧房玩你想玩的花样
sense_groups.english: And I'm going to do anything you want in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确花了很多心血
sense_groups.english: Well, I did put a lot of thought into the tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还小 不该看的 - 哦 哈哈
sense_groups.english: You are way too young to have seen that. - Oops. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 再1个半月就是你的生日
sense_groups.english: Your birthday's in a month and a half.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我又忘记准备礼物呢？
sense_groups.english: What do you say I forget to get you a present for that too?

sense_groups.chinese: 我百分之百完全原谅你
sense_groups.english: You are totally and completely 100 percent forgiven.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个得拿去洗 - 没错
sense_groups.english: We have got to wash that. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是看上一件外套
sense_groups.english: Hey, do you remember that jacket that you loved so much...

sense_groups.chinese: 又嫌它太贵？ - 你对我已经够好了
sense_groups.english: that you thought was too expensive? - You have done enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要一早跑去买来送你
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I'm gonna wake up early and get it for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必...买黑色 别买咖啡色
sense_groups.english: No, you don't have... Get it in black, not brown.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的蛋糕好了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Oop. Your cake is ready. - Oop.

sense_groups.chinese: 俗话说得好"做做爱 吃吃蛋糕"
sense_groups.english: It's like that old saying, "Have sex, eat some cake."

sense_groups.chinese: 小摩 老钱 我来拿汽水
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon. Hey, Chan. Just getting a soda.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who the hell are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊啊
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 错错错
sense_groups.english: No, no, no!

sense_groups.chinese: "是你好吗？"
sense_groups.english: "How you doing?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗... 真是的 去走廊等我
sense_groups.english: "How you doing?" Damn it, Carl. Go wait in the hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 我代替卡尔道歉 - 卡尔是谁？
sense_groups.english: Look, I got to apologize on behalf of Carl. - Who the hell is Carl?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没说吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, did I not mention?

sense_groups.chinese: 我找卡尔来演我的双胞胎兄弟 好参加医学研究
sense_groups.english: Carl is a guy I hired to be my identical twin for a medical research project.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时妙计就在眼前 是吧？
sense_groups.english: You know, sometimes the good ideas are just right in front of you, aren't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道很扯 但搞不好会成功
sense_groups.english: Look, I know it sounds crazy, but I think it might work.

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一的问题是卡尔的演技...
sense_groups.english: But the only problem is Carl's acting is

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一的问题？
sense_groups.english: The only problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他害我两年前 痛失那只果汁大广告 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. He's the reason I didn't get that big Minute Maid commercial.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们演兄弟 他却搞砸了
sense_groups.english: We were supposed to be brothers, but he messed it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我可以吃一小块蛋糕吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. Can I get a little piece of that cake?

sense_groups.chinese: 彼萨 我们爱吃彼萨 滚出去
sense_groups.english: Pizza. We like pizza. Get out!

sense_groups.chinese: 派特赛贾克？ - 可以
sense_groups.english: Pat Sajak? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚历崔贝克？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: Alex Trebek? - Oh, of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 恰克乌勒利？ - 绝对行
sense_groups.english: Chuck Woolery? - Definitely.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有的综艺节目主持人
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you will not find a single game-show host...

sense_groups.chinese: 我都能修理
sense_groups.english: whose ass I cannot kick.

sense_groups.chinese: 说 - 说我们是Unagi
sense_groups.english: Say it. - Say we are unagi.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你是不是 是你有没有
sense_groups.english: It's not something you are, it's something you have.

sense_groups.chinese: 快说
sense_groups.english: Say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以轻易挣脱
sense_groups.english: I could easily get out of this...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们可能会死得很惨
sense_groups.english: but there's a chance you could get very, very hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 卡尔 接着就是我们 记住 这次不能怎样？
sense_groups.english: All right, Carl, we're next. Now, remember, what is this not gonna be?

sense_groups.chinese: 重蹈那次果汁广告的覆辙 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Another Minute Maid fiasco. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能怎样？
sense_groups.english: And what are you not gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能讲话 因为... - 你还讲 卡尔
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna talk, because... - Ah. Damn it, Carl.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我下一组的资料...
sense_groups.english: Can I have the next one, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊和汤尼崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Joey and Tony Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就是
sense_groups.english: That's us.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是这是双胞胎的研究
sense_groups.english: But, uh, this is a study for identical twins.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 两千大洋
sense_groups.english: That's right. Two thousand dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们不是双胞胎
sense_groups.english: But you're not identical twins.

sense_groups.chinese: 都是你啦 卡尔
sense_groups.english: Damn it, Carl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my good God.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你最爱吃的食物倒数
sense_groups.english: Hey. Continuing the countdown of your favorite meals.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚 第三名
sense_groups.english: Tonight, number three

sense_groups.chinese: 起司通心粉加切丁的热狗
sense_groups.english: Macaroni and cheese with cut-up hot dogs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对我够好了 别再费心了
sense_groups.english: Look, you have done enough, okay? You have to stop this now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的 但不是今晚
sense_groups.english: I will, but not tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐音乐就来听你录的带子
sense_groups.english: For dinner music, I thought we could listen to that tape that you made me.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 那卷合辑 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh, the mixed tape. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚好有收录《你今晚的模样》
sense_groups.english: Oh. "The Way You Look Tonight" is on here.

sense_groups.chinese: 陪我跳舞
sense_groups.english: Dance with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好最好了
sense_groups.english: You are just the sweetest.

sense_groups.chinese: 你每晚的模样我都爱 钱德
sense_groups.english: I love the way you look every night, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我录这卷带子给你
sense_groups.english: That's why I made you this tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日快乐 爱你的珍妮丝
sense_groups.english: Happy birthday. Love, Janice. Mwah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你最好最好了
sense_groups.english: No, you're the sweetest.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐们 今天的课到此为止 记住 一定要平安
sense_groups.english: Okay, ladies, that ends today's class. Let's remember, let's be safe out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你教得真好 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Great class. Heh. - Thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看得很仔细
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. I was watching.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 不过我有一些问题
sense_groups.english: Um, hey, a couple of questions, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才最后
sense_groups.english: Um, you know that last move...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个女人把你绊倒 压在地上
sense_groups.english: where that woman tripped you and then pinned you to the floor?

sense_groups.chinese: 你接下来会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: What would you do next?

sense_groups.chinese: 她会拿钥匙来刺...
sense_groups.english: Well, then she'd take her keys and jam them in your...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是你会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. What would you do next?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说攻击者？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Who, me, the attacker? - Yes, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想偷袭两个女人 却没成功
sense_groups.english: I tried attacking two women. Did not work.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 没关系 她们是我的朋友
sense_groups.english: What? - No, I mean, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还跟其中一个结过婚
sense_groups.english: I mean, they're my friends. In fact, I was married to one of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你偷击你的前妻？
sense_groups.english: Let me get this straight. You attacked your ex-wife?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是...
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我尝试
sense_groups.english: I tried.

sense_groups.chinese: 却打不过她 所以才来找你
sense_groups.english: But I couldn't. That's why I'm here.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以一起对付她们
sense_groups.english: Maybe we could attack them together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不要
sense_groups.english: That's a no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常非常非常对不起
sense_groups.english: I am so, so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会下厨房煮你想吃的菜
sense_groups.english: Oh! And I will cook anything you want in here...

sense_groups.chinese: 进卧房玩你想玩的花样
sense_groups.english: and do anything you want in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然得煮 你想得美喔
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you will, and are you kidding me?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 这是我们的情人节
sense_groups.english: Come on, Monica, it's our Valentine's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦？
sense_groups.english: Please, please, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 要进房间了吗？ - 我要
sense_groups.english: So are we going in there? - I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Aha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们逃不掉了
sense_groups.english: Nowhere to run.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢坐这里 我要过去...
sense_groups.english: I don't like sitting up here. I'm gonna go over...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 是他们先来的
sense_groups.english: No, Rachel, they got here first.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯在干嘛？ - 危险
sense_groups.english: Why is Ross doing that? - Danger!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 他干嘛扑向那两个女人？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Why is he jumping on those women?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该去帮她们
sense_groups.english: We should help them.

questions.name: S06E18
questions.en:
Hey.
I just got my teacher evaluations. Check out what this one student wrote.
"I loved Dr. Geller's class. Mind-blowing lectures.
Dr. Geller, you are definitely the hottie of the Paleontology Department."
Ah, "Hotties of the Paleontology Department."
There's a big-selling calendar, huh?
Who wrote it?
I wish I knew, but the evaluations are all anonymous.
Do you still have their final exams? - Yeah.
Match the evaluation to the exam with the same handwriting and there's your admirer.
A hot girl's at stake and all of a sudden he's Rain Man.
Hey, wait a minute, wait a minute. Why are we so sure that this is a girl?
It's a girl.
Anyway, it wouldn't matter, okay?
Because I'm a teacher. She's a student. - Oh, is that against the rules?
No, but it is frowned upon. - I see.
Besides, there's a big age difference.
Think of it like this. When you're 90...
I know, when I'm 90, she'll be 80...
and it won't seem like such a big difference.
No, that's not what I was gonna say at all.
What I was gonna say is when you're 90...
you'll still have the memory of what it was like to be with a 20-year-old.
Chandler, you know that girl you went to college with who became a movie director?
Oh, yeah, Dana Keystone. She was in my movement class.
What's a movement class?
It's Chandler's way of pretending he didn't take mime.
Listen, anyway, she's directing the new Al Pacino movie.
You gotta get me an audition. - Oh. I haven't talked to her in like 10 years.
Oh, no, no, no. Please, Chandler, I would owe you so much.
You do owe me so much. You owe me 3400...
Hey, hey, dude. Why you changing the subject? What?
Will you make the call or what? - Okay, I'll try.
All right. Thanks, you're the best.
The last day of auditions is Thursday, so I gotta get in by Thursday.
Just remember Thursday. Thursday. Can you remember Thursday?
Yeah, so Tuesday?
Thursday. Look, if you need help remembering, just think of it like this.
The third day. All right? Monday, one day.
Tuesday, two day.
Wednesday, when, huh, what day? Thursday.
The third day, okay?
Thank you. - Okay.
Hey, Mon, I'm gonna check my messages. - You just thought of that in there?
Sure, you know, nature called. She wants to see who else did.
Hello?
Uh...
Rachel.
You guys, someone is in our apartment. Call the cops.
You're on the phone.
Oh, my God. - What?
Oh, my God. Thank you. That was the Fire Department.
There was a fire at our place. - Oh, my God. How bad was it?
He didn't say, but it was a fire. I'm guessing not very good.
Come on, we gotta go. - Phoebe, come on.
What are you smiling about? What is so funny?
The part I wanna audition for is a fireman. This is so meant to be.
Wow. Looks like you were very generous with your grades this semester.
Professor Geller? - Yeah? Huh?
I wanted to say how much I enjoyed your class.
Oh, thank you. Thanks very much. Ow.
I'm a little embarrassed about calling you a hottie on my evaluation.
That was you? - Yeah.
I felt a little weird about it. You're a teacher. I'm a student.
But would you maybe wanna go out with me sometime?
Oh, I... Heh. I don't think that would be the best idea.
Oh, because I was thinking, um, the semester's over.
You're not my teacher anymore. - What time?
Oh, you know what? Forget it. I see you already gave me an A.
Gotcha. - I'm kidding. Ha-ha-ha.
Oh. Ha-ha-ha. - Ha-ha-ha.
So seriously, what time?
Coming through. Oh. Coming through. Oh. Hello. Hi.
No, right. Coming through.
Oh. - Okay. Well, it's not so bad.
Most of the damage was contained to the bedrooms.
Oh, my God.
Hey, buddy, you think I could borrow your uniform this Thursday?
Excuse me? - Joey. He's working.
You would look good in that.
Uh-oh. How bad is it? - Oh, it's bad, it's really bad.
The only thing that isn't burned is an ax, which I do not remember buying.
How's your room, Rach? - Everything's ruined.
My bed, my clothes. Look at my favorite blue sweater.
Isn't that mine?
Fine. I'm sorry for your loss.
You're not gonna be able to live here for a while.
You ladies have a place to stay? - Oh. Wow.
Okay, look, pal...
I am not in the mood to be hit on right now.
But if you give me your number, I will call you some other time.
Yes, they can stay with us.
Have you figured out what started the fire, Mr. Fireman?
Well, uh, do either of you smoke?
No, not usually.
But yeah, I could use one now. Thanks. - No, no.
Do you light candles, burn incense? - Yes, I do all the time. I love them.
Oh, my God, I did it. It's me, it's me.
I burned down the house. I burned down the house!
Okay, Phoebe, calm down. There's no need to place blame. Okay?
I warned her about those candles.
It's great to catch up. I can't believe how long it's been.
Hey, Chandler, is that?
Oh, that's great. Good for you. - So, hey, hey, is it?
Okay, so, yeah, maybe we can get together, um...
Can you hold on for one second, please?
What?
When you're off the phone, you wanna get a pizza?
Hi, I'm back.
Yeah, that sounds great. Okay, well, we'll do it then. Okay, bye.
Hey, listen, so when's my audition? I know it's Thursday, but what time?
Hi. We didn't get to the audition.
I'm gonna take her to coffee and do it then. - Ah.
Wow, so now you're going on a date with this girl?
Not a date. I haven't talked to her in 10 years.
You can't call somebody you haven't talked to in 10 years and ask for a favor.
There are rules, you know? You gotta put in some time.
You're right, I'm sorry.
It's not like you're going out with an ex. - No, we only went out once.
You dated her?
Not once.
Great. Why don't I just go out with an ex, you know, and do Joey a favor?
Hey, you wanna do Joey a favor? Maybe you go out with Joey.
Oh. That's great. My friend Joey's in the movie business.
Mm. You know who I ran into from school? Howie.
Hmm. My friend's name is Joey. - Heh.
Apparently, Howie's editing now.
Yeah, he calls me up and asks me if he can edit my new movie.
Heh. Can you believe that?
You know, I haven't spoken to him in, what, 10 years...
and he asks me for a favor?
Yeah, I've always hated that Howie.
No "How you doing?" Heh.
Man, I mean, not even a cup of coffee first.
Heh. The nerve, huh? - Yeah.
Refill?
Now, this is last-minute, so I want to apologize for the mess.
Oh. - Who cares?
Oh, my God.
It sure didn't look this way when I lived here.
I know.
There's one problem, though.
There's only room for one, so I guess one of you will have to stay at Joey's.
Well, since the fire was kind of my fault, I guess you should get to stay here.
Hey, hey, hey, now.
This was no one's fault, Pheebs, okay? It was an accident.
It was my fault. You should get the nice room.
Okay. Whoo!
So, Rach, you're the first guest at Hotel Monica.
Hotel Monica.
Just tell me how you like your eggs.
I thought I'd bring them to you, you know, in bed.
Aw. - You've been through so much.
I have.
This right here is where I keep the pizza.
And that's where the napkin is.
What's that smell? - I know. I don't...
Oh, please, it was such a big class. You never even noticed me.
What? Of course I did. You sat next to Sleepy Sleeperson.
Who?
Oh. I had trouble remembering everyone's names...
so I came up with nicknames.
Like the guy on the other side of you was Smelly von Brown-Shirt.
Oh, yeah. Ha, ha.
So, um, did you have a nickname for me? - Uh, no. No.
Yes, you did. What was it?
Um, it's...
Cutie McPretty.
Oh, that's so sweet.
Listen, I gotta tell you, I'm having a great time.
You know how you said it might be weird, the whole student-teacher thing?
And to be frank, I thought it would be too. But it's not. I mean, it's not at all.
Dr. Geller. - Burt.
So did you sleep well last night?
I did. - Yeah?
I did. Monica was so sweet. She left a little mint on my pillow.
Know what Joey left on my pillow? - What?
Gum.
Well, we determined the cause of the fire.
Yeah, I know. It was my candle, my candle.
No, there was an appliance left on in the bathroom.
It looks like a curling iron.
I don't use a curling iron. - Well, someone does.
Don't look at me, my hair's straight. Straight, straight, straight.
It could've been a hair-straightener. - Oh.
This is where I keep the pizza.
And... Hey, where'd the napkin go?
There you go. I wouldn't want my best guest to strain her eyes.
Thanks, Monica.
Does that smell bother you? - What, the smell from Joey's?
No, I can hardly smell it over here.
Well, you let me know if you can. Because I can bake a pie to cover it.
I can smell it a little. Bake the pie. - Okay.
Hello?
Oh, yes, one minute, please. It's for you. It's the fire inspector.
Oh. Hello? Yeah, this is Phoebe.
Really?
Yeah, so it turns out that it wasn't the hair-straightener...
that started the fire.
No, no. It was the candles.
Yeah. It's very not good leaving candles unattended.
In fact, one of the first things they teach you in fire school is...
Uh...
Uh, okay, well, I have to go now.
We had such a great time. She's incredible.
I thought the age difference might be a problem, but it wasn't.
It wasn't at all. Elizabeth is very mature for her age.
A concept lost on some people.
So it's okay to date a student?
Well, not really.
I mean, technically, it's not against the rules or anything.
But it is frowned upon...
especially by that professor we ran into last night.
Judgy von Holier-Than-Thou.
Just be careful, okay?
You don't wanna get a reputation as Professor McNails-His-Students. Ha, ha.
Yeah. What should I do? - Well, Ross, it seems pretty clear.
I mean, what's more important, what people think or how you feel? Huh?
Ross, you gotta follow your heart. - Joey, that is so sweet.
Hey. - Hey, hey. So how'd it go with Dana?
Any reason I should leave a block of time open, say, Thursday?
I couldn't do it. - You couldn't do it?
Relax, I just need more time. We're going to dinner.
What? You're going out with her again?
Going out with who? - Dana Keystone, from college.
Oh, yeah. Wasn't she, uh, mm?
No, that was Dana Kaplan.
Oh. - Ah.
Joey, you didn't even know her. - Yeah, whatever.
Great story again.
The yarns that you weave.
Ha-ha-ha. Woo-hoo!
You know, uh, actually, I should get going.
Oh, no, no, no, stay, stay, because you should...
You should stay.
Wow.
Oh, I am really flattered.
But I just... I don't feel that way about you.
Oh, no, no, no. That's not... No, no, no. - I'm sorry, Chandler.
You know, you are such a sweet guy, and I don't wanna hurt you.
Oh, I wish there were something I could do to make you feel better.
No, no, no... Really?
Of course.
Well, it just hurts so bad, I, uh...
Oh, I'm sorry.
Well, maybe there is one thing you can do. - What? Anything. Anything.
Well, I mean, this is just off the top of my head now. Um...
Ahem. But I have this friend, uh, this actor friend...
and he would kill me if he knew that I was doing this, um...
but, um, would it be possible for him to get an audition for your movie...
say, on Thursday?
Absolutely.
But you'd really feel better about me rejecting you...
if your friend can audition for my movie?
Well, the heart wants what it wants. I'll see you later.
Hey. How's it going?
Well, not much has changed in the last five minutes.
Yes, it has. I made cookies.
That's all right. I'm still full from your homemade potato chips, so...
Oh. But you should eat them now because they're hot from the oven.
Okay. - Oh. But not in here.
Can't eat them in bed, remember? No crummies.
Oh.
I'll be out in a second.
Okay.
What are you doing? - This doesn't lock, does it?
Oh. Joey, sorry. Oh. - Oh, it's all right, don't worry about it.
No, but look. Oh, that's gonna leave a stain.
Rach, hey, it's fine. You're at Joey's.
Really? - Yeah, look.
Huh. - Yeah.
I've never lived like this before. - I know.
Whoo! Ha-ha-ha.
All right, well, don't waste it. I mean, it's still food.
What do you wanna do now, huh? You wanna go get a drink?
Uh, I can't.
Oh, you have some studying to do? - No, I have some turning 21 to do.
Okay. Ha, ha.
You know, I remember when I was in college, we used to...
What are you doing? - Nothing, I'm just...
I'm so comfortable with you.
Do you not wanna be seen with me? - What?
No, of course I do. Are they gone?
No, they're still here. But I think I'm about to leave.
What? No, no, wait, wait.
You're right, this is stupid. Who cares what people think?
I mean, we like each other, right? There's nothing wrong with that.
Come on.
Burt. Lydia. Mel.
This is Elizabeth. - Hi.
Aren't you in my Popular Culture class?
That's right, Lydia. Elizabeth here is a student.
And we're dating.
And you may frown upon that...
but we're not gonna hide it anymore.
You are so fired.
What? - They're gonna fire you.
You can't date a student. It's against the rules.
Really? It's not just frowned upon?
Oh. Ah. - Ah!
I love it at Joey's.
There you go.
Ooh. Thanks. - Nice.
So you busy Thursday? - Oh, very funny.
I don't know if you remember, but my audition was supposed to be Thursday.
You got me the audition?
Yeah. - Oh, let's hug it up.
Okay, okay, okay.
What are you gonna do to me if you get the part?
Hey. - Hey.
Hi. - Hi.
Yeah, okay, I need to talk to you. - Uh-huh.
Now, I know that they said that the hair-straightener started the fire...
but I think I'm partly at fault.
You see, I didn't tell you, but, um, I had recently refilled the tissues.
And so, you know, let's face it, that's just kindling.
So I think it's better that I stay at Joey's.
No, no, no, Phoebe, this was my fault.
Besides, you know what? I'm fine here. - Okay.
Oh, Chandler, Monica's looking for you. - Really?
Yeah, she said something about crummies. - No, no, no. I was so careful.
Okay. You have to switch with me. Monica is driving me crazy.
That's right. All the ladies wanna stay at Joey's.
No, Phoebe, come on, I don't wanna switch.
Please. Come on, I can throw wet paper towels here.
No, but at Monica's, you can eat cookies over the sink.
I know. I'm sorry.
All right, fine.
This looks like so much fun. - Ha, ha.
God, what a mess.
Wow, it actually is in the handbook.
I can't date you or have a hot plate in my office.
Oh, I can't believe we have to stop seeing each other.
For what it's worth, I did appreciate you standing up for me.
That felt really nice.
Kind of made me like you even more.
I know, I know. I really like you too. But we can't date.
It's against the rules. It's forbidden.
Wow.
What? - Just hearing you describe it...
as forbidden, it's really hot.
Really?
Yeah.
Well, I don't care how hot it is, it's, uh... It's wrong.
Stop it. - No, no. It's wrong. It's...
It's naughty.
It's...
taboo.
Shut the book.
Hey. Let's also get a hot plate. - Oh.
Hey. - Hey.
So? - So?
It's Thursday. How was the audition? - It's Thur...?
Monday, one day. Tuesday, two day. Wednesday, when, huh, what day? Thur...
Oh!
