sense_groups.english: Chandler, you know that girl you went to college with who became a movie director?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道 黛娜基史东 我们一起修动作课
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, Dana Keystone. She was in my movement class.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是动作课？
sense_groups.english: What's a movement class?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德在假装他没修默剧
sense_groups.english: It's Chandler's way of pretending he didn't take mime.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之她要导艾尔帕西诺的新片
sense_groups.english: Listen, anyway, she's directing the new Al Pacino movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得帮我争取试镜 - 我不知道 我们10年没联络了
sense_groups.english: You gotta get me an audition. - Oh. I haven't talked to her in like 10 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 求求你 就当我欠你
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. Please, Chandler, I would owe you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你本来就欠我 你欠我3千4百...
sense_groups.english: You do owe me so much. You owe me 3400...

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你干嘛转移话题？
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, dude. Why you changing the subject? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你打不打电话？ - 好吧 我试试看
sense_groups.english: Will you make the call or what? - Okay, I'll try.

sense_groups.chinese: 万岁 谢了 你最好了
sense_groups.english: All right. Thanks, you're the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 试镜是星期四截止 我星期四之前得过去
sense_groups.english: The last day of auditions is Thursday, so I gotta get in by Thursday.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得星期四就对了 你记得吗？
sense_groups.english: Just remember Thursday. Thursday. Can you remember Thursday?

sense_groups.chinese: 星期二吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so Tuesday?

sense_groups.chinese: 是星期四 你如果记不住
sense_groups.english: Thursday. Look, if you need help remembering, just think of it like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 就记是第三天 星期一 一天
sense_groups.english: The third day. All right? Monday, one day.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期二 二天
sense_groups.english: Tuesday, two day.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期三 三天？哪一天？星期四
sense_groups.english: Wednesday, when, huh, what day? Thursday.

sense_groups.chinese: 第三天 好吗？
sense_groups.english: The third day, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡 我要听留官 - 你在厕所里想到这个？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon, I'm gonna check my messages. - You just thought of that in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 生理需求结束 她想知道还有谁需要她
sense_groups.english: Sure, you know, nature called. She wants to see who else did.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?
Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们家有人 快报警
sense_groups.english: You guys, someone is in our apartment. Call the cops.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在用电话
sense_groups.english: You're on the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天哪... - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 谢谢你 是消防队
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Thank you. That was the Fire Department.

sense_groups.chinese: 家里失火了 - 天哪 有多严重？
sense_groups.english: There was a fire at our place. - Oh, my God. How bad was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 他没说 但失火总是不太妙
sense_groups.english: He didn't say, but it was a fire. I'm guessing not very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 快走吧 - 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on, we gotta go. - Phoebe, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 笑什么笑？有什么好笑的？
sense_groups.english: What are you smiling about? What is so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要应徵的角色是消防队员 这真是天意
sense_groups.english: The part I wanna audition for is a fireman. This is so meant to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你这学期的成绩给得很大方喔
sense_groups.english: Wow. Looks like you were very generous with your grades this semester.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授？ - 是？
sense_groups.english: Professor Geller? - Yeah? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要说我很喜欢你的课
sense_groups.english: I wanted to say how much I enjoyed your class.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 非常成谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. Thanks very much. Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 很不好意思 在评监表说你是猛男
sense_groups.english: I'm a little embarrassed about calling you a hottie on my evaluation.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你？ - 对
sense_groups.english: That was you? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我后来觉得怪怪的 你是老师 我是学生
sense_groups.english: I felt a little weird about it. You're a teacher. I'm a student.

sense_groups.chinese: 但或许你愿意和我约会？
sense_groups.english: But would you maybe wanna go out with me sometime?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我... 这样恐怕不太好
sense_groups.english: Oh, I... Heh. I don't think that would be the best idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说学期结束后
sense_groups.english: Oh, because I was thinking, um, the semester's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就不是我的老师了 - 什么时候？
sense_groups.english: You're not my teacher anymore. - What time?

sense_groups.chinese: 当我没说 你已经给我A了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? Forget it. I see you already gave me an A.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解 - 开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: Gotcha. - I'm kidding. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哈哈 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh. Ha-ha-ha. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 什么时候？
sense_groups.english: So seriously, what time?

sense_groups.chinese: 借过 借过 你好
sense_groups.english: Coming through. Oh. Coming through. Oh. Hello. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 借过
sense_groups.english: No, right. Coming through.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 还好嘛
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Okay. Well, it's not so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 灾情主要集中在卧房
sense_groups.english: Most of the damage was contained to the bedrooms.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 这星期四可以跟你借制服吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, buddy, you think I could borrow your uniform this Thursday?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 乔伊 人家在忙
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - Joey. He's working.

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿一定很帅
sense_groups.english: You would look good in that.

sense_groups.chinese: 灾情如何？ - 很惨 非常惨
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. How bad is it? - Oh, it's bad, it's really bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有一把斧头没被烧到 我根本不记得有买过
sense_groups.english: The only thing that isn't burned is an ax, which I do not remember buying.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋你的呢？ - 东西都烧光了
sense_groups.english: How's your room, Rach? - Everything's ruined.

sense_groups.chinese: 床铺 衣服 你看我最喜欢的蓝毛衣
sense_groups.english: My bed, my clothes. Look at my favorite blue sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是我的吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't that mine?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我对你的损失深感遗憾
sense_groups.english: Fine. I'm sorry for your loss.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里暂时不能住人
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna be able to live here for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有地方去吗？ - 哦 哇
sense_groups.english: You ladies have a place to stay? - Oh. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你给我听着 老兄
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, pal...

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在没心情被搭讪
sense_groups.english: I am not in the mood to be hit on right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过要是你给我电话 我改天会打给你
sense_groups.english: But if you give me your number, I will call you some other time.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们可以跟我们住
sense_groups.english: Yes, they can stay with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问起火原因是什么？消防员
sense_groups.english: Have you figured out what started the fire, Mr. Fireman?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有人抽烟吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, do either of you smoke?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No, not usually.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过现在来一根也好 - 不是
sense_groups.english: But yeah, I could use one now. Thanks. - No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有人点蜡烛烧香吗？ - 有 我常点 我很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Do you light candles, burn incense? - Yes, I do all the time. I love them.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 是我害的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I did it. It's me, it's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把房子给烧了
sense_groups.english: I burned down the house. I burned down the house!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别激动 没有必要怪谁 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, Phoebe, calm down. There's no need to place blame. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我警告过她
sense_groups.english: I warned her about those candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 能聊聊真好 居然这么久了
sense_groups.english: It's great to catch up. I can't believe how long it's been.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 是不是...
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 恭喜你 - 听着...
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. Good for you. - So, hey, hey, is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们可以见个面...
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, yeah, maybe we can get together, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你等我一下...
sense_groups.english: Can you hold on for one second, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 等你讲完 要不要叫彼萨？
sense_groups.english: When you're off the phone, you wanna get a pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我回来了
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm back.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来不错 好 就这么决定...好 再见
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that sounds great. Okay, well, we'll do it then. Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么时候试镜？我知道是星期四 但是几点？
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen, so when's my audition? I know it's Thursday, but what time?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我们没聊到那个
sense_groups.english: Hi. We didn't get to the audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带她去喝咖啡时再说 - 啊
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take her to coffee and do it then. - Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你要跟这个女生约会？
sense_groups.english: Wow, so now you're going on a date with this girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是约会 我们失联10年
sense_groups.english: Not a date. I haven't talked to her in 10 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 总不能一通电话过去 就要人家帮忙
sense_groups.english: You can't call somebody you haven't talked to in 10 years and ask for a favor.

sense_groups.chinese: 要讲人情世故 花点时间客套
sense_groups.english: There are rules, you know? You gotta put in some time.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 对不起
sense_groups.english: You're right, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不是去见旧情人 - 我们只约过一次会
sense_groups.english: It's not like you're going out with an ex. - No, we only went out once.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她交往过？
sense_groups.english: You dated her?

sense_groups.chinese: 一次也没有
sense_groups.english: Not once.

sense_groups.chinese: 干脆我也去找个前男友 来帮乔伊的忙
sense_groups.english: Great. Why don't I just go out with an ex, you know, and do Joey a favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 想帮乔伊的忙 跟乔伊约会就好
sense_groups.english: Hey, you wanna do Joey a favor? Maybe you go out with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好 我朋友乔伊也在电影圈
sense_groups.english: Oh. That's great. My friend Joey's in the movie business.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜我那天遇见谁？豪伊
sense_groups.english: Mm. You know who I ran into from school? Howie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的朋友叫乔伊 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hmm. My friend's name is Joey. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 显然 豪伊在当剪接师
sense_groups.english: Apparently, Howie's editing now.

sense_groups.chinese: 他打来问能不能剪我的新片
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he calls me up and asks me if he can edit my new movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信吗？
sense_groups.english: Heh. Can you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们10年没联络
sense_groups.english: You know, I haven't spoken to him in, what, 10 years...

sense_groups.chinese: 他居然来找我帮忙
sense_groups.english: and he asks me for a favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一向很讨厌那家伙
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I've always hated that Howie.

sense_groups.chinese: 连声好都没问
sense_groups.english: No "How you doing?" Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 连先喝杯咖啡都没有
sense_groups.english: Man, I mean, not even a cup of coffee first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好大胆 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Heh. The nerve, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 续杯吗？
sense_groups.english: Refill?

sense_groups.chinese: 事出突然 抱歉房里一团乱
sense_groups.english: Now, this is last-minute, so I want to apologize for the mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 谁在乎
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我住的时候绝对不是长这样
sense_groups.english: It sure didn't look this way when I lived here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 问题是
sense_groups.english: There's one problem, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里只能睡一个人 另一个人得去住乔伊家
sense_groups.english: There's only room for one, so I guess one of you will have to stay at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然火算是我放的 你就睡这里吧
sense_groups.english: Well, since the fire was kind of my fault, I guess you should get to stay here.
Hey, hey, hey, now.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁也没有错 那是个意外
sense_groups.english: This was no one's fault, Pheebs, okay? It was an accident.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是我害的 你应该睡这里
sense_groups.english: It was my fault. You should get the nice room.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你是本饭店的首位贵客
sense_groups.english: So, Rach, you're the first guest at Hotel Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡饭店
sense_groups.english: Hotel Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得告诉我早餐想吃什么蛋
sense_groups.english: Just tell me how you like your eggs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打算瑞到床上给你
sense_groups.english: I thought I'd bring them to you, you know, in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 你吃了这么多苦
sense_groups.english: Aw. - You've been through so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊
sense_groups.english: I have.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我放彼萨的地方
sense_groups.english: This right here is where I keep the pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 纸巾在那里
sense_groups.english: And that's where the napkin is.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么味道？ - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: What's that smell? - I know. I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 那么大一个班 你根本没有注意到我
sense_groups.english: Oh, please, it was such a big class. You never even noticed me.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有 你坐在爱困睡人森旁边
sense_groups.english: What? Of course I did. You sat next to Sleepy Sleeperson.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？
sense_groups.english: Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 我记不住全班的名字
sense_groups.english: Oh. I had trouble remembering everyone's names...

sense_groups.chinese: 就取绰号代替
sense_groups.english: so I came up with nicknames.

sense_groups.chinese: 像你的另一边是发臭冯棕上衣
sense_groups.english: Like the guy on the other side of you was Smelly von Brown-Shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有帮我取绰号吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: So, um, did you have a nickname for me? - Uh, no. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有 是什么？
sense_groups.english: Yes, you did. What was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 是...
sense_groups.english: Um, it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 可爱麦美眉
sense_groups.english: Cutie McPretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 今晚真的很开心
sense_groups.english: Listen, I gotta tell you, I'm having a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前说师生约会很奇怪
sense_groups.english: You know how you said it might be weird, the whole student-teacher thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我也有同感 结果不会 一点也不会
sense_groups.english: And to be frank, I thought it would be too. But it's not. I mean, it's not at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士 - 伯特
sense_groups.english: Dr. Geller. - Burt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你昨晚睡得好吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you sleep well last night?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: I did. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡还在我的枕头上 放了一小片薄荷
sense_groups.english: I did. Monica was so sweet. She left a little mint on my pillow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜乔伊在我枕头上放什么？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Know what Joey left on my pillow? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 口香糖
sense_groups.english: Gum.

sense_groups.chinese: 找到起火原因了
sense_groups.english: Well, we determined the cause of the fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 是我的蜡烛害的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. It was my candle, my candle.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 浴室有个电器没拔掉
sense_groups.english: No, there was an appliance left on in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像是卷发器
sense_groups.english: It looks like a curling iron.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没用卷发器 - 总有人在用
sense_groups.english: I don't use a curling iron. - Well, someone does.

sense_groups.chinese: 别看我 我的头发是直的 直的直的直的
sense_groups.english: Don't look at me, my hair's straight. Straight, straight, straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 也可能是直发夹 - 哦
sense_groups.english: It could've been a hair-straightener. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 彼萨都放这里
sense_groups.english: This is where I keep the pizza.

sense_groups.chinese: 纸巾呢？
sense_groups.english: And... Hey, where'd the napkin go?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 可不能让贵客眼睛疲劳
sense_groups.english: There you go. I wouldn't want my best guest to strain her eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Thanks, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怕那个味道吗？ - 乔伊家的味道？
sense_groups.english: Does that smell bother you? - What, the smell from Joey's?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里又闻不到
sense_groups.english: No, I can hardly smell it over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 闻得到就说 我可以烤个派把它盖过去
sense_groups.english: Well, you let me know if you can. Because I can bake a pie to cover it.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点闻得到 烤个派吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: I can smell it a little. Bake the pie. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 在 请稍候 火场调查员找你
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes, one minute, please. It's for you. It's the fire inspector.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？我是菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hello? Yeah, this is Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 所以直发夹不是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so it turns out that it wasn't the hair-straightener...

sense_groups.chinese: 起火原因
sense_groups.english: that started the fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是蜡烛
sense_groups.english: No, no. It was the candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 把蜡烛点着不管实在不太好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's very not good leaving candles unattended.

sense_groups.chinese: 消防学校最先教的事情之一...
sense_groups.english: In fact, one of the first things they teach you in fire school is...
Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我该挂了
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay, well, I have to go now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们玩得好开心 她好棒
sense_groups.english: We had such a great time. She's incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为年龄会造成问题 结果一点也不会
sense_groups.english: I thought the age difference might be a problem, but it wasn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 伊丽莎白非常成熟
sense_groups.english: It wasn't at all. Elizabeth is very mature for her age.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人就是不懂
sense_groups.english: A concept lost on some people.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以师生可以约会？
sense_groups.english: So it's okay to date a student?

sense_groups.chinese: 也不是
sense_groups.english: Well, not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 技术上没触犯校规
sense_groups.english: I mean, technically, it's not against the rules or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是会受争议
sense_groups.english: But it is frowned upon...

sense_groups.chinese: 尤其是我们昨晚遇见的教授
sense_groups.english: especially by that professor we ran into last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 属于自以为是的学者
sense_groups.english: Judgy von Holier-Than-Thou.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 小心一点
sense_groups.english: Just be careful, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 别被叫成麦泡学生教授
sense_groups.english: You don't wanna get a reputation as Professor McNails-His-Students. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？ - 很简单
sense_groups.english: Yeah. What should I do? - Well, Ross, it seems pretty clear.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么比较重要？别人的看法还是你的感觉？
sense_groups.english: I mean, what's more important, what people think or how you feel? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得忠于你的心 - 乔伊 你说得真好
sense_groups.english: Ross, you gotta follow your heart. - Joey, that is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 你跟黛娜谈得怎样？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, hey. So how'd it go with Dana?

sense_groups.chinese: 我星期四该不该空出时间来？
sense_groups.english: Any reason I should leave a block of time open, say, Thursday?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说不出口 - 你说不出口？
sense_groups.english: I couldn't do it. - You couldn't do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 别急 我需要更多时间 我们晚上要吃饭
sense_groups.english: Relax, I just need more time. We're going to dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你还要跟她出去
sense_groups.english: What? You're going out with her again?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟谁出去？ - 大学的黛娜基史东
sense_groups.english: Going out with who? - Dana Keystone, from college.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对 她不是...
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Wasn't she, uh, mm?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是黛娜卡普林
sense_groups.english: No, that was Dana Kaplan.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你根本不认识她 - 随便啦
sense_groups.english: Joey, you didn't even know her. - Yeah, whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 故事真的好棒
sense_groups.english: Great story again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好错综复杂
sense_groups.english: The yarns that you weave.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈哈 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. Woo-hoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 我该走了
sense_groups.english: You know, uh, actually, I should get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 留下来
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no, stay, stay, because you should...

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该留下来
sense_groups.english: You should stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很受宠若惊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I am really flattered.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我对你没感觉
sense_groups.english: But I just... I don't feel that way about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是...不是 - 钱德 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. That's not... No, no, no. - I'm sorry, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你人很好 我也不想伤害你
sense_groups.english: You know, you are such a sweet guy, and I don't wanna hurt you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望有什么可以让你好过点
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wish there were something I could do to make you feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 不... 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: No, no, no... Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是太伤心了 我...
sense_groups.english: Well, it just hurts so bad, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你可以做件事 - 什么事？你尽管说
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe there is one thing you can do. - What? Anything. Anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是刚刚才想到的
sense_groups.english: Well, I mean, this is just off the top of my head now. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个演员朋友
sense_groups.english: Ahem. But I have this friend, uh, this actor friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 他要是知道一定会杀了我
sense_groups.english: and he would kill me if he knew that I was doing this, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你可不可能让他去为你的电影试镜
sense_groups.english: but, um, would it be possible for him to get an audition for your movie...

sense_groups.chinese: 就星期四吧？
sense_groups.english: say, on Thursday?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我让你的朋友来试镜
sense_groups.english: But you'd really feel better about me rejecting you...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的能让你好过一点？
sense_groups.english: if your friend can audition for my movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的心愿 再见
sense_groups.english: Well, the heart wants what it wants. I'll see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey. How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 这5分钟都没什么变化
sense_groups.english: Well, not much has changed in the last five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实有 我烤了饼干
sense_groups.english: Yes, it has. I made cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 我还在消化你做的薯片
sense_groups.english: That's all right. I'm still full from your homemade potato chips, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是饼干应该刚烤好就趁热吃
sense_groups.english: Oh. But you should eat them now because they're hot from the oven.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 但不是在这里
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Oh. But not in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 床上不能吃饼干 不能掉屑屑
sense_groups.english: Can't eat them in bed, remember? No crummies.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我马上出去
sense_groups.english: I'll be out in a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？ - 门锁不起来 对吧？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - This doesn't lock, does it?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 对不起 - 没关系 别在意
sense_groups.english: Oh. Joey, sorry. Oh. - Oh, it's all right, don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你看 会有污渍
sense_groups.english: No, but look. Oh, that's gonna leave a stain.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 没关系 这是乔伊家
sense_groups.english: Rach, hey, it's fine. You're at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 当然 你看
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Huh. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有这样吃过东西 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I've never lived like this before. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Whoo! Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 别浪费了 这是食物
sense_groups.english: All right, well, don't waste it. I mean, it's still food.

sense_groups.chinese: 接着要干嘛？要不要去喝酒？
sense_groups.english: What do you wanna do now, huh? You wanna go get a drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不行
sense_groups.english: Uh, I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要念书？ - 不是 我要满21岁才行
sense_groups.english: Oh, you have some studying to do? - No, I have some turning 21 to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前念大学时 我们都...
sense_groups.english: You know, I remember when I was in college, we used to...

sense_groups.chinese: 你干什么？ - 没事
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Nothing, I'm just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得好舒服
sense_groups.english: I'm so comfortable with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怕被别人看见？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Do you not wanna be seen with me? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是 他们走了吗？
sense_groups.english: No, of course I do. Are they gone?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还在 不过我要走了
sense_groups.english: No, they're still here. But I think I'm about to leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？等下
sense_groups.english: What? No, no, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 这样太蠢了 管别人怎么想
sense_groups.english: You're right, this is stupid. Who cares what people think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们情投意合 对吧？这样并没有错
sense_groups.english: I mean, we like each other, right? There's nothing wrong with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 伯特、莉蒂亚、梅尔
sense_groups.english: Burt. Lydia. Mel.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位是伊丽莎白 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: This is Elizabeth. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是有修我的大众文化？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you in my Popular Culture class?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 莉蒂亚 伊丽莎白是学生
sense_groups.english: That's right, Lydia. Elizabeth here is a student.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在交往
sense_groups.english: And we're dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以皱眉摇头
sense_groups.english: And you may frown upon that...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们不会再躲了
sense_groups.english: but we're not gonna hide it anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的饭碗砸定了
sense_groups.english: You are so fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你会被解聘
sense_groups.english: What? - They're gonna fire you.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟学生交往是违规的
sense_groups.english: You can't date a student. It's against the rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？不只是受争议？
sense_groups.english: Really? It's not just frowned upon?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh. Ah. - Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我最喜欢乔伊家了
sense_groups.english: I love it at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 去吧
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Thanks. - Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你星期四有事吗？ - 真好笑
sense_groups.english: So you busy Thursday? - Oh, very funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 不晓得你记不记得 我的试镜就是星期四
sense_groups.english: I don't know if you remember, but my audition was supposed to be Thursday.

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮我争取到了？
sense_groups.english: You got me the audition?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 来抱抱
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Oh, let's hug it up.
Okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你入选还得了
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do to me if you get the part?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有事要找你 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay, I need to talk to you. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道他们说直发夹是起火源
sense_groups.english: Now, I know that they said that the hair-straightener started the fire...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我也有责任
sense_groups.english: but I think I'm partly at fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有告诉你 我放了新的卫生纸
sense_groups.english: You see, I didn't tell you, but, um, I had recently refilled the tissues.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个太容易着火了
sense_groups.english: And so, you know, let's face it, that's just kindling.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我应该来住乔伊家
sense_groups.english: So I think it's better that I stay at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 菲比 都是我不好
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, Phoebe, this was my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我在这里好得很 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Besides, you know what? I'm fine here. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡在找你 - 是喔？
sense_groups.english: Oh, Chandler, Monica's looking for you. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 好像跟饼干屑有关 - 不会吧 我那么小心
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she said something about crummies. - No, no, no. I was so careful.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你一定要跟我换 摩妮卡快把我逼疯了
sense_groups.english: Okay. You have to switch with me. Monica is driving me crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 小姐们都想住乔伊家
sense_groups.english: That's right. All the ladies wanna stay at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 我不想换
sense_groups.english: No, Phoebe, come on, I don't wanna switch.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 我在这里可以扔纸巾
sense_groups.english: Please. Come on, I can throw wet paper towels here.

sense_groups.chinese: 在对面你可以对着水槽吃饼干
sense_groups.english: No, but at Monica's, you can eat cookies over the sink.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 对不起
sense_groups.english: I know. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 算了
sense_groups.english: All right, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个好像很好玩 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: This looks like so much fun. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 湿答答的
sense_groups.english: God, what a mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 校规里真的有写
sense_groups.english: Wow, it actually is in the handbook.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能和你约会 或是在研究室放电磁炉
sense_groups.english: I can't date you or have a hot plate in my office.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们居然不能再见面了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't believe we have to stop seeing each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过谢谢你为我挺身而出
sense_groups.english: For what it's worth, I did appreciate you standing up for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好感动
sense_groups.english: That felt really nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我更喜欢你了
sense_groups.english: Kind of made me like you even more.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我也很喜欢你 但是我们不能交往
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. I really like you too. But we can't date.

sense_groups.chinese: 校规明文禁止师生恋
sense_groups.english: It's against the rules. It's forbidden.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 光听你说校规"禁止"
sense_groups.english: What? - Just hearing you describe it...

sense_groups.chinese: 就觉得好性感
sense_groups.english: as forbidden, it's really hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管有多性感 这都是错的
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't care how hot it is, it's, uh... It's wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再说了 - 不 这是错的
sense_groups.english: Stop it. - No, no. It's wrong. It's...

sense_groups.chinese: 这样很坏
sense_groups.english: It's naughty.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是...
sense_groups.english: It's...

sense_groups.chinese: 禁忌
sense_groups.english: taboo.

sense_groups.chinese: 把书搁起来
sense_groups.english: Shut the book.

sense_groups.chinese: 再去弄个电磁炉吧 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Hey. Let's also get a hot plate. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样啊？ - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: So? - So?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天是星期四 试镜结果如何？ - 哈？
sense_groups.english: It's Thursday. How was the audition? - It's Thur...?

sense_groups.chinese: 星期一一天 星期二二天 星期三三天？星期四...
sense_groups.english: Monday, one day. Tuesday, two day. Wednesday, when, huh, what day? Thur...

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

questions.name: S06E19
questions.en:
Well, that thing's clearly in the way.
All right. A-ha. Heh.
Damn fridge!
Hi, Joey. How you doing? - Great...
roomie. - Ah!
Yeah, I guess we are roommates now. - I know. Now that you bring it up...
uh, our fridge is broken. We have to get a new one.
I checked around and your half is $400. Thanks a lot.
I'm not paying for half of that.
I'm only staying here until my apartment gets fixed.
Look, Rach, my parents bought this fridge just after I was born. Okay?
Now, I have never had a problem with it. Then you show up and it breaks!
What does that tell you?
That refrigerators don't live as long as people?
All right, you know that the ATM only lets you take out 300 at a time...
so I'll take a check for the other 100.
Heh. You're joking, right?
Of course I'm joking. I don't take checks.
Thank God you're pretty.
Hey! - Hey.
Hey, do you guys know any cute guys?
Well, of course, I do. My good friend, Joey, over here.
Oh, I'm sorry. Thank you, Chandler.
Anyway, there's a charity ball this weekend and Ralph Lauren bought a table...
so I kind of have to go.
What's the charity? - I don't know.
Something, either trees or disease, I...
Ralph mumbles a lot. - Does Ralph mumble...
when you're not paying attention? - Yeah. It's weird.
But the thing is, I need to find a date.
What kind of guy are you looking for?
Someone that has his own tux or the ability to rent a tux.
So he has to be a male who has at least $50.
Ooh, so close.
Hey, everybody. - Hey.
Uh, this is Elizabeth. - Hi, Elizabeth.
I'm the student. - Ha-ha-ha.
Isn't she cute? Nope.
This is none of my business, but weren't you guys supposed...
to not be seen in public together? - Oh, we're not together.
No. We're just two people who happen to have run into each other...
here at the coffee house. Heh, this is...
Oh, sly.
I really wanted to meet you guys, but I have to run.
I'll see you later? - Okay.
Bye, Ross. - Bye. See you.
Didn't mean to run into you like that, sir. - That is quite all right, ma'am.
Bye.
So why's she leaving? Is it a school night and she has a lot of homework to do?
Yes. Her molecular epidemiology paper is due tomorrow.
Well, tell her "good luck" with that.
Anyone else, huh? Bring them on.
Oh! When's her birthday? - I don't know, Rachel. Why?
Well, you know it's just been so long since I've been to Chuck E. Cheese.
I like Elizabeth. - Well, thanks.
In fact, I like her so much that you tell her I want my cookies early this year.
A box of Thin Mints and some Tagalongs.
Guys, give him a break. Ross, seriously, how's it going with her?
Well, it's actually been great.
She's 20, so she's not looking for anything too serious...
which is perfect for me now.
Well, that is great. And seriously, she seems very nice.
I know you guys like to give me a hard time...
but it means a lot to me that you like her.
Just knowing you guys are, like... - Okay, I got a good one.
Okay, um... Heh.
What is she, like, 12?
Chandler, do you think we talk about our relationship enough?
Yeah. Do we have any Fruit Roll Ups?
Hey. - Hey.
Okay, I just thought of the perfect guy for Rachel to take to her thing.
That's so funny, we found someone too.
That's good. I guess she'll have a choice between my guy and your weirdo.
Why would our guy be a weirdo? - Because that's just your taste.
See, Rachel's not gonna pick your stupid guy.
Oh, yeah? - Yeah.
My guy is a lawyer who does volunteer work.
And he has one of these.
A face ass?
A chin dimple. - Well, uh, our guy works with Chandler.
And he's really nice and smart and he's a great dresser.
Have you seen your guy's body? - No. Our guy's just a floating head.
Well, my guy is spectacular, okay? He's a massage client.
And one time, um, when he was on the table, I looked at it. And I mean, all of it.
You're not supposed to look. - Yeah, like there are police for that.
What, you look? You massaged me. - I know.
All right, your guy may have a great body, but our guy...
is really funny. - Chandler funny?
Our guy's a great dancer. - My guy's well-read.
Our guy has great hair. - My guy has great teeth.
Our guys smells incredible.
Do you want our guy to be your guy?
Hey. - Hey.
Well, you don't look good, Joe.
Well, the fridge broke, so I had to eat everything.
Cold cuts, ice cream, limes.
Hey, what was in that brown jar?
That's still in there? - Not anymore.
Ahem, so, anyway, how do you want to pay me?
Is this a service you're providing me?
No, for my new fridge. For our new fridge.
Our new fridge?
I don't live here anymore. - So what?
Look, okay, suppose we were a, uh, divorced couple.
Uh-huh. - And I got custody of the kid. Right?
Now, suppose the kid dies and I gotta buy a new kid.
Okay.
Give me $400!
Professor Geller? - Hmm?
Oh, a student I don't know.
I was wondering if I could talk to you for a moment?
Yes, of course. What would this be regarding?
Making out in your office. - Wh... Shh!
Uh, of course. Why don't we go inside.
Mm... Oh, oh.
What? - Doorknob. Doorknob.
Sorry. Ha-ha-ha.
Um, I actually do need to talk to you. - Oh. Okay, what about?
Spring vacation. - Spring vacation?
Yeah, we have time off, and a lot of people are going on trips...
Professor Geller. - Yes, Professor Fiesenstinlender?
I'll be with you in one moment.
So I will take one box of the Thin Mints.
You don't understand. Elizabeth was about to ask me to go on a trip with her.
Is that taking it slow? I'm not ready for this, okay?
What do I tell her? - Tell her the truth. You're not ready.
I could do that.
Well, what if she gets upset? - Then you distract her with a Barbie doll.
Or...
you could just, you know, you...
What the hell are you doing?
Wha...?
What the hell am I doing? You just broke my fridge!
What? How do you know if... How do you know it's even broken?
Oh, you think I don't know what breaks my fridge?
Excuse me.
Well, what do you know? Broken!
That'll be $400.
Joey, I saw you push him.

sense_groups.english: That's so funny, we found someone too.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 她可以在我的人 和你们的怪胎之中选一个
sense_groups.english: That's good. I guess she'll have a choice between my guy and your weirdo.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我们的人是怪胎？ - 因为你们的品味就是那样
sense_groups.english: Why would our guy be a weirdo? - Because that's just your taste.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋才不会选你的蠢人
sense_groups.english: See, Rachel's not gonna pick your stupid guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这个是律师 还当义工
sense_groups.english: My guy is a lawyer who does volunteer work.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他有这个东西
sense_groups.english: And he has one of these.

sense_groups.chinese: 脸屁股？
sense_groups.english: A face ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 酒窝啦 - 我们这个是钱德的同事
sense_groups.english: A chin dimple. - Well, uh, our guy works with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 人好聪明又会打扮
sense_groups.english: And he's really nice and smart and he's a great dresser.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看过他的身体吗？ - 没有 他是一颗飘来飘去的头
sense_groups.english: Have you seen your guy's body? - No. Our guy's just a floating head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这个身材很赞 他是我的按摩客人
sense_groups.english: Well, my guy is spectacular, okay? He's a massage client.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次他在按摩台上 就被我看光光了
sense_groups.english: And one time, um, when he was on the table, I looked at it. And I mean, all of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是不能偷看吗？ - 报警来抓我啊
sense_groups.english: You're not supposed to look. - Yeah, like there are police for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会偷看？你给我按摩过 - 没错
sense_groups.english: What, you look? You massaged me. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你那个或许身材很好 但我们这个
sense_groups.english: All right, your guy may have a great body, but our guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 很风趣 - 钱德式的风趣？
sense_groups.english: is really funny. - Chandler funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这个舞功高强 - 我这个饱读诗书
sense_groups.english: Our guy's a great dancer. - My guy's well-read.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这个发质很好 - 我这个牙齿漂亮
sense_groups.english: Our guy has great hair. - My guy has great teeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这个香的不得了
sense_groups.english: Our guys smells incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真这么哈他？
sense_groups.english: Do you want our guy to be your guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脸色不太好 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Well, you don't look good, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 冰箱坏了 我得把东西都吃掉
sense_groups.english: Well, the fridge broke, so I had to eat everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷盘 冰淇淋 莱姆...
sense_groups.english: Cold cuts, ice cream, limes.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 咖啡色罐子里的是什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what was in that brown jar?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个还在？ - 已经不在了
sense_groups.english: That's still in there? - Not anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之你要怎么付钱给我？
sense_groups.english: Ahem, so, anyway, how do you want to pay me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要提供某种服务吗？
sense_groups.english: Is this a service you're providing me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 是我要买冰箱 我们的新冰箱
sense_groups.english: No, for my new fridge. For our new fridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的新冰箱？
sense_groups.english: Our new fridge?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经不住这里了 - 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: I don't live here anymore. - So what?

sense_groups.chinese: 假设我们是离婚夫妻
sense_groups.english: Look, okay, suppose we were a, uh, divorced couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯哼 - 我取得孩子的监护权
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - And I got custody of the kid. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果孩子死了 我总得买个新孩子
sense_groups.english: Now, suppose the kid dies and I gotta buy a new kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我四百元
sense_groups.english: Give me $400!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授？ -嗯？
sense_groups.english: Professor Geller? - Hmm?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 一名我不认识的学生
sense_groups.english: Oh, a student I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 能不能跟您谈一下？
sense_groups.english: I was wondering if I could talk to you for a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 是哪方面的事？
sense_groups.english: Yes, of course. What would this be regarding?

sense_groups.chinese: 在你的研究室亲热 - 嘘
sense_groups.english: Making out in your office. - Wh... Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们何不先进去再说
sense_groups.english: Uh, of course. Why don't we go inside.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯...哦
sense_groups.english: Mm... Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 门把
sense_groups.english: What? - Doorknob. Doorknob.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的有事要讲 - 好 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Um, I actually do need to talk to you. - Oh. Okay, what about?

sense_groups.chinese: 春假的事 - 春假的事？
sense_groups.english: Spring vacation. - Spring vacation?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 学校没课 很多人要去旅行...
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we have time off, and a lot of people are going on trips...

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授 - 是 菲森死盯个乐教授...
sense_groups.english: Professor Geller. - Yes, Professor Fiesenstinlender?

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上就好
sense_groups.english: I'll be with you in one moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就买一盒薄荷巧克力饼
sense_groups.english: So I will take one box of the Thin Mints.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不懂 伊丽莎白想找我跟她去旅行
sense_groups.english: You don't understand. Elizabeth was about to ask me to go on a trip with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样叫慢漫来吗？我还没准备好 我该怎么说？
sense_groups.english: Is that taking it slow? I'm not ready for this, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 实话实说 - 说你还没准备好
sense_groups.english: What do I tell her? - Tell her the truth. You're not ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以试试
sense_groups.english: I could do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她不高兴呢？ - 你就拿芭比娃娃逗她
sense_groups.english: Well, what if she gets upset? - Then you distract her with a Barbie doll.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者
sense_groups.english: Or...

sense_groups.chinese: 你也可以...
sense_groups.english: you could just, you know, you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你干什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: Wha...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我干什么？你刚弄坏我的冰箱
sense_groups.english: What the hell am I doing? You just broke my fridge!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你怎么知道它坏了？
sense_groups.english: What? How do you know if... How do you know it's even broken?

sense_groups.chinese: 它怎么坏的我会不知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you think I don't know what breaks my fridge?

sense_groups.chinese: 你等一下
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 坏了
sense_groups.english: Well, what do you know? Broken!

sense_groups.chinese: 要赔四百元
sense_groups.english: That'll be $400.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我看见你推他了
sense_groups.english: Joey, I saw you push him.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你推的
sense_groups.english: You pushed him.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我没把它弄坏... 它已经坏一阵子了
sense_groups.english: Joey, I did not break this. Okay? That has been broken for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我不是提过我们的冰箱的事？ - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Remember I told you about our fridge? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没拿到你该出的钱
sense_groups.english: I still haven't gotten the check for your half yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要给他钱
sense_groups.english: Do not give him any money.

sense_groups.chinese: 你少插嘴 你撞坏我的冰箱
sense_groups.english: I'm not talking to you! You broke my fridge!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授 你找我？ - 是的 请进
sense_groups.english: You wanted to see me, Professor Geller? - Yes. Yes. Please come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 哦
sense_groups.english: Mm, ooh, ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 门把？ - 对 有点玩上瘾了
sense_groups.english: Doorknob? - Yeah. It kind of grows on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想继续上次春假的话题
sense_groups.english: Actually, I wanted to finish talking to you about spring vacation.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 我...
sense_groups.english: Look, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我跟你在一起很开心
sense_groups.english: Look, I've been having a great time with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想进展得太快 或是给我们太多压力
sense_groups.english: And I just don't want us to move too fast or put too much pressure on us.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以很抱歉 我们还不能一起旅行
sense_groups.english: So I'm sorry, I just don't think we should go away together yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 太快了
sense_groups.english: It's too soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你误会我的意思了
sense_groups.english: Uh, Ross, I think you misunderstood what I was saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想告诉你 我要去佛罗里达两星期
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to tell you that I'm going to Florida for a couple weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你误会我的意思了
sense_groups.english: I think you misunderstood what I was saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是... - 你好可爱
sense_groups.english: What I meant was... - You are so adorable.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个 我们来讨论这个
sense_groups.english: That. Let's talk about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟伊丽莎白谈得怎样？ - 嗯？哦
sense_groups.english: How did it go with Elizabeth? - Huh? Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 只是一场误会 她没有要找我去
sense_groups.english: Fine. It was just a misunderstanding. She didn't want me to go with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她只是要告诉我她要去放春假
sense_groups.english: She just wanted to let me know that she's going to Florida for spring vacation.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 她是去放春假 还是去春游
sense_groups.english: Wait, is she going for spring vacation or going for spring break.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么差别？
sense_groups.english: What's the difference?

sense_groups.chinese: 春假是跟爷爷奶奶共享天伦
sense_groups.english: A spring vacation, you're doing nice things with your grandparents.

sense_groups.chinese: 春游是跟兄弟会的人上床
sense_groups.english: Spring break, you're doing frat guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 并非每个人的春游都那样
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what? Not all spring breaks are like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你做了什么？ - 我跟我爸去埃及
sense_groups.english: What did you do on yours? - I went to Egypt with my dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以想像 "爸 是人面狮身像"
sense_groups.english: I can see it now. "Look, Dad, it's the Sphinx."

sense_groups.chinese: 我想伊丽莎白那么正经 不会去"春游"
sense_groups.english: I think Elizabeth is a little more serious than, "Spring break!"

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？她修了我的课
sense_groups.english: All right? Come on, she's taking my class.

sense_groups.chinese: 还跟教授上床 - 我要去打给她
sense_groups.english: And slept with the professor. - I'm gonna call her.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位 这是赛巴斯钦
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, I want you to meet Sebastian.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 我们刚刚
sense_groups.english: Hi. - We just, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 在报摊认识 我们都买了《原野与河流》
sense_groups.english: We just met at the newsstand. We both grabbed for the last Field and Stream. Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有在看啊
sense_groups.english: What, I read that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要咖啡吗？ - 要 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Can I get you a cup of coffee? - Oh, yes. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你这是什么意思？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, what the hell is this? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫我们帮你找人 却自己带了个人来
sense_groups.english: You ask us to find you a guy, and then you come in here with a guy of your own.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们帮我找到人了？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You found me a guy? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在钱德的公司 相中一个可爱风趣的人
sense_groups.english: We found you a really cute, funny guy from Chandler's work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也找了一个不是怪胎的人
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I found you one, too, who is not a weirdo.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗？真是谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: You know what though, guys, I really appreciate that...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我带赛巴斯钦去就好了
sense_groups.english: but I'm just gonna take Sebastian to the charity.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？我们这个很香喔
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? Because our guy smells incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再提那个了好吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you stop it with that already?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的咖啡 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here you go. Sure. - Oh, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 赛巴斯钦 你有在当义工吗？
sense_groups.english: So, Sebastian, do you do any volunteer work?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, not really. Why? - No reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是认识一个关心别人的单身汉
sense_groups.english: It's just I know a single guy who does care about other people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你风趣吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ -你们在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - What are you guys doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你风趣吗？讲个笑话来听
sense_groups.english: Are you funny? Tell us a joke!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想和瑞秋喝杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: Look, I just wanted to have coffee with Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多人都想
sense_groups.english: Well, so do a lot of people.

sense_groups.chinese: 说实话 我该走了 - 哦 但你...
sense_groups.english: Actually, uh, I gotta get going. - Oh, but you...

sense_groups.chinese: 有空打电话给我 - 你没给我电话号码
sense_groups.english: Give me a call sometime. - But you didn't give me your number.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就改天见
sense_groups.english: Okay, see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来他蛮风趣的
sense_groups.english: Turns out he is kind of funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真是太扯了
sense_groups.english: I cannot believe you guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 他人很好 却被你们赶走了
sense_groups.english: He was really nice and he just left because of you!

sense_groups.chinese: "赛巴斯钦"耶？那是猫的名字吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but, "Sebastian"? What is that, a cat's name?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我发现什么？他很容易被吓到
sense_groups.english: You know what I noticed, Rachel, he scares easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想带这种人参加舞会吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, is that the kind of guy you want to take to a ball?

sense_groups.chinese: "赛巴斯钦 要不要跳舞"
sense_groups.english: "Sebastian, would you like to dance?"

sense_groups.chinese: "好 我得走了"
sense_groups.english: "Uh, okay. I gotta go. Aah!"

sense_groups.chinese: 别再说了 瑞秋 对不起
sense_groups.english: All right, guys stop it. Rachel, we're very sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们太过分了
sense_groups.english: That is a very insensitive thing for us to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 让我们补偿你 我们有两个好男人让你挑
sense_groups.english: You know what? Let us make it up to you. We've two great guys for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 你有什么损失？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, what have you got to lose?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好会认识让你心动的人 如果你选我这边的人的话
sense_groups.english: You might even end up with someone really special. If you pick my guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好 你愿意见我们找的人？
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay. So you will meet our guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意
sense_groups.english: Yes, I'll meet them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要选谁都行 由你自己决定
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter which one you choose. It's up to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这个才更完美
sense_groups.english: Our guy is perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者你也可以选 菲比自己
sense_groups.english: Or you could go out with the guy Phoebe deemed...

sense_groups.chinese: 看不上眼的人 - 啊哦
sense_groups.english: not good enough to go out with herself. - Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你在这里 你弄坏我的冰箱
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, there you are! Okay, you broke my fridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 欠我四百元
sense_groups.english: You owe me 400 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: Okay, sure. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 技术上来说你欠我六百元
sense_groups.english: Ooh, technically, you owe me $600 for sending out happy thoughts...

sense_groups.chinese: 你最近十次试镜我都有祝祷
sense_groups.english: on your last 10 auditions.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就算扯平了？
sense_groups.english: Call it even?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 回来了 伊丽莎白怎么说？
sense_groups.english: There you are. So, what did Elizabeth say?

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的是要去德通纳春游 呼呼
sense_groups.english: Well, turns out she is going to Daytona for "spring break, woo-hoo."

sense_groups.chinese: 也就是有湿恤美女选拔赛 男生朝女生身上扔水球
sense_groups.english: That means wet T-shirt contests, guys doing shots off of girls' bodies...

sense_groups.chinese: 在陌生人身边醒来
sense_groups.english: waking up next to people you don't even know.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会玩得很爽
sense_groups.english: Man, she is gonna have a great time!

sense_groups.chinese: 她要住可乐娜饭店吗？
sense_groups.english: Is she staying at the Hotel Corona?

sense_groups.chinese: 你熟那里的饭店？ - 当然 我参加过81年春游 呼呼
sense_groups.english: You know the hotels? - I was there, Spring Break '81!

sense_groups.chinese: 81年你才13岁
sense_groups.english: In 1981, you were 13.

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？我开车去卖了恤 玩得好开心
sense_groups.english: So what? I drove down, sold T-shirts. I had a blast.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道谁最会疯？酒醉的大学女生
sense_groups.english: You know who knows how to party? Drunk college chicks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 她不准去
sense_groups.english: Okay, she can't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你不能叫她不准去 你们才交往没多久
sense_groups.english: You can't tell her not to go. You just started dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我该怎么办？ - 不怎么办 你只能接受
sense_groups.english: Then what am I supposed to do? - Nothing. Just be cool with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她跑去跟一堆人上床呢？
sense_groups.english: What if she goes down there and sleeps with a bunch of guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 那这次你就别娶她
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe you don't marry this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能去旅行真是好事
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you're going on this trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊 我这学期那么用功
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I've been working so hard this semester.

sense_groups.chinese: 很需要疯狂下 好解压力
sense_groups.english: I really need to go crazy, you know? Blow off some steam.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure. Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你的计划到底定了没
sense_groups.english: Look, I don't know if your plans are finalized yet...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道 还有一个办法可以好解压力
sense_groups.english: but I know another great way to blow off steam.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么办法？ - 你喜欢做手工艺吗？
sense_groups.english: What? - Are you into crafts at all?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你还好吗？ - 我当然很好
sense_groups.english: Ross, are you okay? - Uh, yeah. Of course I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在表示支持
sense_groups.english: Heh, I'm just being, uh, supportive.

sense_groups.chinese: 支持你和这次旅行
sense_groups.english: Supportive of you and this whole trip...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有这是什么？
sense_groups.english: and what... What is, uh...? What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是泳衣 - 你要穿它去见人？
sense_groups.english: It's a bathing suit? - To wear in front of people?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样叫支持吗？ - 这样是吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that supportive? - Is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Good, good, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴你答应见我们找的人 - 哦
sense_groups.english: We're glad you decided to meet our guy. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会很喜欢他
sense_groups.english: You're gonna like him so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要什么时候见他？ - 不晓得
sense_groups.english: Uh, when do you want to meet him? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我明晚不用加班 - 明晚不错
sense_groups.english: I don't work late tomorrow night. - Tomorrow night is good.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过现在能做的事 为什么要拖到明天？
sense_groups.english: But why put off something till tomorrow that you can do right now. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾达 过来 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Eldad, come here! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾达 这位是瑞秋 - 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Eldad, this is Rachel. - How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点措手不及 不过我很好
sense_groups.english: A little blind-sided, but, you know, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾达 坐...你坐过去
sense_groups.english: Eldad, sit down. Move over. Move over now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了
sense_groups.english: There you go. There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们知道了 - 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Okay, we can take a hint! - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你来干什么？ - 这位是派屈克
sense_groups.english: Wait. What are you doing here? - This is Patrick.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来晚了 她跟我们那个在一起了
sense_groups.english: You're too late, because she's already with our guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我是来晚了 他们正坐在沙发上聊天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you're right, I am too late. They're sitting on the couch and talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这是派屈克 - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Rachel? This is Patrick. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就是我说的那个人
sense_groups.english: This is the guy I was telling you about.

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 这套西装 太委屈底下的身材了
sense_groups.english: Believe me, this suit does not do justice to what's underneath it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是菲比 我现在正在忙
sense_groups.english: But Pheebs, I'm just sort of in the middle of something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没关系 你坐
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. That's okay. Have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能这样 - 我走好了
sense_groups.english: You can't do that! - Maybe I should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下 我们占上风
sense_groups.english: Just sit down, we're winning.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我才应该走
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? Maybe I should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 - 坐下
sense_groups.english: No, no! - Have a seat!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你还没模过艾达的头发
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you haven't touched Eldad's hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 超柔顺的 你模模看 - 不必了
sense_groups.english: It is the softest hair. Touch it. - I'm good.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 派屈克很有钱 拿钱给她
sense_groups.english: Rachel, Patrick is really rich. Give her some money.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这个免费按摩的代价太高了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, this isn't really worth the free massage.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 派屈克 再见
sense_groups.english: That's right, Patrick. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾达合作多了 而且很会跳舞
sense_groups.english: Eldad is much more cooperative and he can dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跳舞给瑞秋看
sense_groups.english: You dance for Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 拜托不要
sense_groups.english: No, don't dance for me, please!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是怎么搞的？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 大家来说清楚
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay, let's talk it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有我觉得尴尬吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I the only one that this is embarrassing for?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有点尴尬 - 嘘
sense_groups.english: I'm a little embarrassed. - Shh, shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 该尴尬的是你们 这实在是太扯了
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you who should be embarrassed. It's you guys. This is ridiculous!

sense_groups.chinese: 很谢谢你们 但我不需要你们帮我找人
sense_groups.english: Thank you, but I do not need you to get me a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么叫我们... - 我还没说完
sense_groups.english: Then why did she ask us to help... - I am still talking!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还把我真正喜欢的人赶走
sense_groups.english: Then you chase away the one guy that I actually liked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有冒犯的意思 真的 恭喜你有
sense_groups.english: No offense to you guys. Really, congratulations on...

sense_groups.chinese: 那么多现金
sense_groups.english: all the cash.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你...你的头发真的很柔顺
sense_groups.english: And you really... Wow, you do have very soft hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我宁可自己一人参加晚会 也不要再受这种气
sense_groups.english: But I'd much rather go to the ball by myself than go through any more of this!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有用什么特别的润发乳吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, do you use some sort of special conditioner on that hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 木瓜粹取液 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yes, papaya extract. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好去玩吧 - 我会的
sense_groups.english: So, uh, have a great time down there. - I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有带那套泳衣吗？ - 有
sense_groups.english: Did you pack that bathing suit? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才把它藏起来 实在蛮好玩的
sense_groups.english: It was pretty funny when I hid it for a while, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 总之...
sense_groups.english: Anyway. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是担心那套泳装太曝露
sense_groups.english: I am worried about that bathing suit.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一点我不在意
sense_groups.english: Not because it's revealing, which I'm fine with.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是关心你的健康
sense_groups.english: No, I'm concerned about your health.

sense_groups.chinese: 怕你晒到
sense_groups.english: Um, sun exposure.

sense_groups.chinese: 放心 我带了一大堆防晒油
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't worry, I have plenty of sun block.

sense_groups.chinese: 防晒指数30 - 好的
sense_groups.english: It's SPF 30. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果真的有30就好了
sense_groups.english: Well, if what's in the bottle is actually 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候是30 有时候只有4 我发誓
sense_groups.english: I mean, sometimes you get 30, sometimes it's 4, and I swear...

sense_groups.chinese: 有很多都只是牛奶
sense_groups.english: more often than not, it's just milk.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你放心
sense_groups.english: Ross, it's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要去跟一堆男生鬼混
sense_groups.english: I'm not going down there to hook up with a bunch of guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢你 我喜欢我们的关系
sense_groups.english: I really like you. I like how things are going between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是跟朋友们去玩玩
sense_groups.english: I'm just going down there to relax and hang out with my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Cool. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 他们来了 - 嘿 伊丽莎白
sense_groups.english: Oh, here they are. - Hey, Elizabeth!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye!

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给我
sense_groups.english: Call me!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 抱歉把那些人硬塞给你
sense_groups.english: Rachel, we're sorry for pushing those guys on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 结果我玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: That's all right. I ended up having a really good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚会很成功 募到很多款 引起很多重视
sense_groups.english: The charity was a big success, they raised a lot of money and awareness.

sense_groups.chinese: 它到底是为什么慕款？
sense_groups.english: So, what was it for, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想说是一种疾病
sense_groups.english: I wanna say a disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯留了奇怪的留言 叫我们看MTV台
sense_groups.english: I just got this weird message from Ross. He said turn on MTV. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 是伊丽莎白 - 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, look! That's Elizabeth! - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔...盖勒教授
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, Professor Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 重温13岁旧梦 是啊
sense_groups.english: Ah, to be 13 again.

questions.name: S06E20
questions.en:
"We've got three minutes till the reactor blows.
We'll never make it!"
"You've got to get out of here! Save yourself!"
"No, I won't leave you."
"Don't worry about me. I'm a robot. I'm just a machine!"
"No, you're not. Not to me." - Oh, my God.
What? - I am extremely talented.
Yeah. You're great. - Yeah.
Okay, let's take it from... - No, I was really acting my ass off.
I thought I was pretty good too.
Yeah, you're solid. You're just no me.
You know what? I think that's enough for now.
I don't want to be over-rehearsed. Ha-ha-ha.
Fine. I'll do it without you!
I don't need you or anybody else!
I'm gonna make it on my own!
You'll see! You'll all see!
So, what's this thing you're auditioning for?
It's a new TV show. Yeah.
I'm up for the part of Mac, Machiavelli, or "Mac"!
I'm a detective and I solve crimes with the help of my robot partner.
He's a computerized, humanoid...
electronically enhanced secret enforcer.
Or, "C.H.E.E.S.E."
So, Mac and C.H.E.E.S. E? - That's the title!
They really lucked out that the initials spell "cheese."
That is lucky.
Huh. So, Joey, if you get this, you're gonna be, like...
the star of your own TV show.
I mean, you'll be like the "Big Cheese" or the "Big Mac." Hey, you love those!
Don't get your hopes up, because it's probably not gonna happen.
Now, why would you say that, Joseph?
Well, I mean, come on, you guys. My own TV show?
I don't know if I'm good enough. - I am. Heh.
What are you talking about? You're a terrific actor.
You really think so? - How can you even ask that question?
She's pretty. - Yeah. And she's really nice too.
She taught me all about, you know, how to work with cameras...
and "smell the fart" acting.
I'm sorry, what'd you say? - Excuse me?
It's like you got so many lines to learn so fast...
that sometimes you need a minute to remember your next one.
So while you're thinking of it, you take this big pause where you look all intense.
You know, like this
Oh. - Okay.
Here's my scene! Here's my scene!
Mrs. Wallace? I'm Dr. Drake Ramoray, your sister's neurosurgeon.
You sister is suffering from a...
Well, Eva, we've done some excellent work here.
And I would have to say, your problem is quite clear.
I play Al Pacino's butt.
All right? He goes into the shower and then, I'm his butt.
Oh, my God. - Come on, you guys.
This is a real movie and Al Pacino's in it, and that's big!
No, it's terrific. You deserve this after all your years of struggling...
you've finally been able to crack your way into show business.
Okay, fine, make jokes. I don't care. This is a big break for me.
No, you're right, it is. - Yeah.
So, you gonna invite us all to the big opening?
All right, I'm out of here. Wish me luck.
Good luck, good luck We all wish you good luck
Yeah, whatever.
It's your turn.
Oh, are we playing this?
Hey. - Hey. How did the audition go?
Terrible. I messed up every line. I shouldn't even be an actor.
Wait. Are you doing that thing where you pretend it didn't go well...
but it really did go well?
Yeah, did I fool you? - Totally!
So, it did go well? - It went amazingly well!
Great. - That's great.
It's down to me and two other guys. - Oh, my God.
I know both of them, and they're really good.
One's from those allergy commercials who's always being chased...
by those big flowers. - Oh, I love that guy.
Oh. What are you doing?
What am I doing?
I'm so nervous, you know? The callback isn't till tomorrow at 5.
I feel like my head's gonna explode.
Well, it is overdue.
Don't worry, okay? You're gonna be fine.
Yeah, but it's so much pressure.
No offense, but what you guys all do is very different.
I don't know if you'd understand.
Yeah, none of the rest of us have to deal with pressure at our jobs.
Yes, I know what time it is...
but I'm looking at the WENIS and I'm not happy.
Well, I'm tearing the lettuce.
Uh-huh? Is it dirty? - No, don't worry, I'm gonna wash it.
Don't. I like it dirty.
That's your call.
So, uh, what are you going to do next?
Well, I thought that I would cut up the tomatoes.
Are they firm?
They're all right.
You sure they haven't gone bad? You sure they're not very, very bad?
No, really. They're okay.
You gonna slice them up real nice?
Ahem. Actually, I was gonna do them julienne.
I'm out of here.
Monica, I'm quitting. I just helped an 81-year-old woman put on a thong...
and she didn't even buy it.
I'm quitting. That's it. I'm talking to my boss right now.
Yes, I am. Yes, I am.
Okay, bye. Call me when you get this message.
Well, what happened?
Well, he came in for a massage, and everything was fine until...
Oh, my God.
And all of a sudden, his hands weren't the problem anymore.
Was it? - Oh, Boy Scouts could've camped under there.
You ate my sandwich.
It was a simple mistake. It could happen to anyone.
Oh, really?
Now calm down.
Come look in my office. Some of it may still be in the trash.
What? - Well, it was quite large.
I had to throw most of it away.
You threw my sandwich away?
My sandwich?
My sandwich!
It's just, I want this part so much, you know?
If I don't get this part, I'm never gonna eat macaroni and cheese again.
No, I didn't say that. That doesn't count.
Come on, guys. It's not like I moved to Europe.
I just moved across the hall.
And we would have you over all the time...
if it weren't for Monica's allergies.
You're right, I could never lie to you.
She hates you.
Should I get that? Ha-ha-ha.
Hello? Uh, no, Joey's not here right now.
Can I take a message?
Yeah, okay. So the audition's been moved from 5 to 2:30?
Okay, great. Bye.
Aren't you dressed yet? - Am I naked again?
We're supposed to meet my parents in 15 minutes.
Okay. I was just talking to the guys. Just look at them.
I mean, is it okay if they come visit?
What about my allergies?
Right. Your allergies.
All her. She hates you.
Ooh, ooh, ooh.
Yes! All right.
How cool would it be if you could watch like a real life-size version of this?
I mean, how crazy would that be? - As crazy as soccer?
Hello?
What are you talking about? The audition's not till 5.
Well, nobody told me.
Who'd you talk to?
Never mind.
You mean you didn't get it from this?
The allergy guy got the part. Thanks.
Maybe we can fix it, you know?
Maybe we can send him some big, big flowers and scare him!
How could you do this to me?
This part could've turned my whole career around.
I messed up, okay? I'm sorry. I really messed up.
You don't even live here anymore. Why'd you answer my phone?
I have a machine! - Which I bought for you.
Taught you how to use it. You thought it was a copier.
If there was anything I could do, I would do it, okay?
But everybody's allowed one mistake, right?
He could have gotten me a VCR. He could have gotten me golf clubs.
But no, he has to get me the "woman repeller."
The eyesore from the "Liberace House of Crap!"
It's not that bad. - Easy for you to say.
You don't have to sport a reject from the "Mr. T Collection."
Chandler. Chandler.
I pity the fool who puts on my jewelry! I do! I do!
I pity the fool that...
Hi...
When you were late last night, Kathy and I got to talking...
and one thing led to another and...
And what? Did you sleep with her?
No! No, I just kissed her. - What? That's even worse!
How is that worse? - I don't know! But it's the same!
You're right, I have no excuses. I was totally over the line.
"Over the line?"
You're so far past the line that you can't even see the line!
Yeah, the line is a dot to you!
I'm not saying that you should magically forgive me.
But you're not perfect. You've made some errors in judgment too.
Name one.
What happened?
Aw, man! He promised he wouldn't take the chairs!
What the hell happened? How were you locked in?
And where the hell's all of our stuff?
This guy came by to look at the unit...
and he said he didn't think it was big enough to fit a grown man.
So you got in voluntarily?
I was trying to make a sale!
Oh, man, if I ever run into that guy again, you know what I'm gonna do?
Bend over?
There's Lorraine.
Okay, now remember, no trading. You get the pretty one, I get the mess.
Hi, Joey. - Hey.
Well, well. Look what you brought.
And what did you bring?
She's checking her coat.
Joey, I'm gonna go wash the cab smell off my hands.
Will you get me a white Zinfandel and a glass of red for Janice?
Janice?
Oh, my God!
Joey's tailor took advantage of me.
What?
No way. I've been going to the guy for 12 years.
He said he was gonna do my inseam...
then he ran his hand up my leg and then there was definite...
What?
Cupping.
That's how they do pants!
Ross, will you tell him?
Isn't that how a tailor measures pants? - Yes, yes, it is. In prison!
I said name one!
I can't believe I did this. What an idiot. - Stop beating yourself up.
People make mistakes. These things happen.
There aren't any messages you've forgotten to give me, are there?
Apparently, you're not very good at it.
Do you think he'll ever forgive me? - Of course he will.
Chandler, the most important thing is that you forgive yourself.
You know what, I kind of have. - Already?
That was pretty bad, what you did.
You know what? He will forgive you.
I like to bring a pad with me when I go answer the phone, just in case. Okay.
You didn't see how mad he was, you know?
I'm sure he will forgive you.
Look, we've all been there, you know? You fight, you make up.
That's the way it works.
It took two people to break up this relationship!
Yeah! You and that girl from the copy place...
which yesterday you took full responsibility for!
I didn't know what I was taking responsibility for, okay?
I didn't finish the whole letter.
What? - I fell asleep.
You fell asleep?
It was 5:30 in the morning.
And you had rambled on for 18 pages.
Front and back!
And by the way? Y-O-U, apostrophe R-E means, "you are."
Y-O-U-R means "your."
I can't believe I thought of getting back together with you.
We are so over!
Fine by me!
And just so you know, it's not that common...
it doesn't happen to every guy, and it is a big deal!
I knew it!
You had no right to go out with him. - That is the most ridiculous...
You sold me out! - I did not sell you out!
Yes, you did! You absolutely sold me... - Would you let me talk?
Did you just flick me?
Okay, well, you wouldn't let me finish and I was just... Ow!
Stop it! Ow! - Ow!
Stop. - Stop.
All right. No, let's not do this. - No!
Happy thoughts. - No!
Stop it! - Oh! Oh!
Okay, now I'm gonna kick some ass!
Ow! - Ow!
Ow. Ow. Ow. - I know, I know.
All right. Now, I will let go if you both stop.
Fine. - Fine.
There we go.
Ha. You know what? If we were in prison, you guys would be like my bitches.
Okay, buddy boy, here it is.
You hide my clothes? I'm wearing everything you own.
Oh, my God!
Look at me, I'm Chandler! Could I be wearing any more clothes?
Maybe if I wasn't going "commando."
Whew. I tell you, it's hot with all this stuff on. I'd better not do any lunges.
Joey?
Got you the Joey special. Two pizzas!
Joe?
Hello? Damn it!
Hello?
No, Joey's not here right now, but I can take a message. I think.
He's still got a chance for the part? That's great news!
Well, no, obviously not for the actor who was mauled by his dog.
Well, that's great. I will give Joey the message. Thank you.
Yes!
Okay.
Mac...
audition...
at 2.
Allergy...
actor...
attacked.
By dog...
not...
flowers.
Hey. - Please tell me you got the message.
What message? - The actor playing Mac couldn't do it.
They needed to see you at 2:00. - What? It's 6:00!
Look! I wrote it! I wrote it on the board!
I wrote it on the board, then went looking all over for you!
I went to Ross's, the coffee house.
I went to any place that they make sandwiches!
I can't believe this, Chandler! - I'm sorry.
I don't know what to say!
You might say, "Congratulations."
I saw the board, I went to the audition, I got the part!
Was that supposed to be funny? I was worried over here.
I'm sorry. - At times that fake-out thing is mean.
Okay, man. I'm sorry. I did not mean to make you feel bad.
Well, that's good.
Because you didn't. And I'm incredibly happy for you!
That's mean!
You had me going there! - We could do this all day.
Yeah, you're right.
Look, let's talk about what a huge star I'm gonna be.
You are gonna be a huge star. I'm gonna hug you.
You hug me. - All right.
Do we do this too much? - I think so.
Yeah. Get off me. - Yeah.
"Come on, C.H.E.E.S.E., I'm not leaving without you.
Try routing your backup power source through your primary CPU."
"I can't! My circuits are fried! They're fried, I tell you!"
Wow.
"Well, then I'll just have to carry you."
