sense_groups.chinese: 你根本也不住这里了 干嘛接我的电话？
sense_groups.english: You don't even live here anymore. Why'd you answer my phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有答录机 - 是我买给你的
sense_groups.english: I have a machine! - Which I bought for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还教你怎么使用 你以为它是影印机
sense_groups.english: Taught you how to use it. You thought it was a copier.

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意尽全力挽救这个错误
sense_groups.english: If there was anything I could do, I would do it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是人起码可以犯一次错
sense_groups.english: But everybody's allowed one mistake, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可以送我录影机 可以送我高尔夫球具
sense_groups.english: He could have gotten me a VCR. He could have gotten me golf clubs.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是他偏偏要让我把女人吓跑
sense_groups.english: But no, he has to get me the "woman repeller."

sense_groups.chinese: 一个废五金行里最丑的东西
sense_groups.english: The eyesore from the "Liberace House of Crap!"

sense_groups.chinese: 没那么严重啦 - 说得轻巧
sense_groups.english: It's not that bad. - Easy for you to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又不必戴着 被某个老粗淘汰的金饰到处跑
sense_groups.english: You don't have to sport a reject from the "Mr. T Collection."

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler. Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真同情戴这个手饰的人 真的
sense_groups.english: I pity the fool who puts on my jewelry! I do! I do!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真同情戴这个...
sense_groups.english: I pity the fool that...

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi...

sense_groups.chinese: 你昨天晚归 凯西和我聊了起来
sense_groups.english: When you were late last night, Kathy and I got to talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 事情演变到后来就...
sense_groups.english: and one thing led to another and...

sense_groups.chinese: 就什么？你跟她上床？
sense_groups.english: And what? Did you sleep with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我只是吻了她 - 什么？那样更糟
sense_groups.english: No! No, I just kissed her. - What? That's even worse!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会更糟？ - 我不知道 反正都一样
sense_groups.english: How is that worse? - I don't know! But it's the same!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我无话可说 我太过分了
sense_groups.english: You're right, I have no excuses. I was totally over the line.

sense_groups.chinese: 过分？
sense_groups.english: "Over the line?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本就过分到连过分见到你
sense_groups.english: You're so far past the line that you can't even see the line!

sense_groups.chinese: 都会说你过分
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the line is a dot to you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要你奇迹式的原谅我
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying that you should magically forgive me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你也不完美 你也做过错误的判断
sense_groups.english: But you're not perfect. You've made some errors in judgment too.

sense_groups.chinese: 举个例子
sense_groups.english: Name one.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 他答应不拿沙发椅的
sense_groups.english: Aw, man! He promised he wouldn't take the chairs!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？你怎么会被关进去
sense_groups.english: What the hell happened? How were you locked in?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的东西呢？
sense_groups.english: And where the hell's all of our stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个人来看柜子
sense_groups.english: This guy came by to look at the unit...

sense_groups.chinese: 他说它塞不下一个大人
sense_groups.english: and he said he didn't think it was big enough to fit a grown man.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你就自愿进去？
sense_groups.english: So you got in voluntarily?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想把柜子卖出去
sense_groups.english: I was trying to make a sale!

sense_groups.chinese: 要是让我碰上他 你猜我会怎样？
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, if I ever run into that guy again, you know what I'm gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 把屁股翘起来？
sense_groups.english: Bend over?

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了
sense_groups.english: There's Lorraine.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住 不准交换 美女是你的 失恋女是我的
sense_groups.english: Okay, now remember, no trading. You get the pretty one, I get the mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就是你带来的人
sense_groups.english: Well, well. Look what you brought.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又带了谁来？
sense_groups.english: And what did you bring?

sense_groups.chinese: 她在寄放外套
sense_groups.english: She's checking her coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我要去洗个手
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm gonna go wash the cab smell off my hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮我叫一杯白酒 帮珍妮丝叫一杯红酒
sense_groups.english: Will you get me a white Zinfandel and a glass of red for Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝？
sense_groups.english: Janice?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的栽缝吃我豆腐
sense_groups.english: Joey's tailor took advantage of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 我找他做了12年衣服
sense_groups.english: No way. I've been going to the guy for 12 years.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 他说要量裤管内侧
sense_groups.english: He said he was gonna do my inseam...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后他的手一路模上来 然后就...
sense_groups.english: then he ran his hand up my leg and then there was definite...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 包住了
sense_groups.english: Cupping.

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子就是那样量的
sense_groups.english: That's how they do pants!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你告诉他
sense_groups.english: Ross, will you tell him?

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子不都是那样量的？ - 是啊是啊...在监狱里
sense_groups.english: Isn't that how a tailor measures pants? - Yes, yes, it is. In prison!

sense_groups.chinese: 叫你举一个就好
sense_groups.english: I said name one!

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然这么粗心 我真白痴 - 别再自责了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I did this. What an idiot. - Stop beating yourself up.

sense_groups.chinese: 人都会犯错 这是难免的
sense_groups.english: People make mistakes. These things happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有忘记帮我记留言吧？
sense_groups.english: There aren't any messages you've forgotten to give me, are there?

sense_groups.chinese: 显然你不太会记留言
sense_groups.english: Apparently, you're not very good at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得他会原谅我吗？ - 当然会
sense_groups.english: Do you think he'll ever forgive me? - Of course he will.

sense_groups.chinese: 但最重要的是 你得原谅自己
sense_groups.english: Chandler, the most important thing is that you forgive yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我已经原谅自己了 - 这么快？
sense_groups.english: You know what, I kind of have. - Already?

sense_groups.chinese: 你犯的错蛮严重的
sense_groups.english: That was pretty bad, what you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会原谅你的
sense_groups.english: You know what? He will forgive you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我接电话时都会带便条纸... 好啦
sense_groups.english: I like to bring a pad with me when I go answer the phone, just in case. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没看到他气成什么样子
sense_groups.english: You didn't see how mad he was, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 他一定会原谅你的
sense_groups.english: I'm sure he will forgive you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都有这种经验 吵架 和解
sense_groups.english: Look, we've all been there, you know? You fight, you make up.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样
sense_groups.english: That's the way it works.

sense_groups.chinese: 这段感情会破裂是两个人的错
sense_groups.english: It took two people to break up this relationship!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你和影印店那个女的
sense_groups.english: Yeah! You and that girl from the copy place...

sense_groups.chinese: 你昨天表明愿意负责
sense_groups.english: which yesterday you took full responsibility for!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我负的是什么责
sense_groups.english: I didn't know what I was taking responsibility for, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没把信看完
sense_groups.english: I didn't finish the whole letter.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我睡着了
sense_groups.english: What? - I fell asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 你睡着了？
sense_groups.english: You fell asleep?

sense_groups.chinese: 当时是早上5点半
sense_groups.english: It was 5:30 in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一废话就废话了十八页
sense_groups.english: And you had rambled on for 18 pages.

sense_groups.chinese: 正反面都写满了
sense_groups.english: Front and back!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有"你得"是指"你必须"
sense_groups.english: And by the way? Y-O-U, apostrophe R-E means, "you are."

sense_groups.chinese: "你的"是所有格
sense_groups.english: Y-O-U-R means "your."

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然会想跟你复合
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I thought of getting back together with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们根本就完了
sense_groups.english: We are so over!

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓
sense_groups.english: Fine by me!

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便告诉你 那种事并不常见
sense_groups.english: And just so you know, it's not that common...

sense_groups.chinese: 并非男人都会那样 那是很严重的
sense_groups.english: it doesn't happen to every guy, and it is a big deal!

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道
sense_groups.english: I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有权利和他约会 - 这真是太荒谬...
sense_groups.english: You had no right to go out with him. - That is the most ridiculous...

sense_groups.chinese: 你出卖我 - 我没有出卖你
sense_groups.english: You sold me out! - I did not sell you out!

sense_groups.chinese: 你出卖了 - 让我说话好吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes, you did! You absolutely sold me... - Would you let me talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 你弹我的额头吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you just flick me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不让我说完 我很...
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, you wouldn't let me finish and I was just... Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 住手 噢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Stop it! Ow! - Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 住手 - 住手
sense_groups.english: Stop. - Stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 不要这样 - 不
sense_groups.english: All right. No, let's not do this. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 想想快乐的事 - 不
sense_groups.english: Happy thoughts. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 住手 - 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Stop it! - Oh! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要发威了
sense_groups.english: Okay, now I'm gonna kick some ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Ow! - Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢 噢 - 我明白了
sense_groups.english: Ow. Ow. Ow. - I know, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你们住手 我就放手
sense_groups.english: All right. Now, I will let go if you both stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不就结了
sense_groups.english: There we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们在监狱 你们就是我的喽罗
sense_groups.english: Ha. You know what? If we were in prison, you guys would be like my bitches.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 如何啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, buddy boy, here it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你藏我的衣服 我就穿你全部的衣服
sense_groups.english: You hide my clothes? I'm wearing everything you own.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 看啊 我是钱德 我穿的衣服够多吧？
sense_groups.english: Look at me, I'm Chandler! Could I be wearing any more clothes?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我去玩野战游戏
sense_groups.english: Maybe if I wasn't going "commando."

sense_groups.chinese: 穿这么多衣服真热 我最好别做弓箭步
sense_groups.english: Whew. I tell you, it's hot with all this stuff on. I'd better not do any lunges.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了欢乐套餐 有两个披萨
sense_groups.english: Got you the Joey special. Two pizzas!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？又来了
sense_groups.english: Hello? Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊现在不在 我可以帮你留官...应该吧
sense_groups.english: No, Joey's not here right now, but I can take a message. I think.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还有机会？真是太好了
sense_groups.english: He's still got a chance for the part? That's great news!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说那位被狗咬伤的演员
sense_groups.english: Well, no, obviously not for the actor who was mauled by his dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我会转告乔伊 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Well, that's great. I will give Joey the message. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克...
sense_groups.english: Mac...

sense_groups.chinese: 试镜...
sense_groups.english: audition...

sense_groups.chinese: 2点钟
sense_groups.english: at 2.

sense_groups.chinese: 过敏...
sense_groups.english: Allergy...

sense_groups.chinese: 演员...
sense_groups.english: actor...

sense_groups.chinese: 遭攻击
sense_groups.english: attacked.

sense_groups.chinese: 被狗...
sense_groups.english: By dog...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是...
sense_groups.english: not...

sense_groups.chinese: 被花
sense_groups.english: flowers.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 请告诉我你有收到留言
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Please tell me you got the message.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么留言？ - 要演麦克的演员不能演
sense_groups.english: What message? - The actor playing Mac couldn't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要你2点过去 - 什么？明明是6点
sense_groups.english: They needed to see you at 2:00. - What? It's 6:00!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有写在留言板上
sense_groups.english: Look! I wrote it! I wrote it on the board!

sense_groups.chinese: 我写在留言板上 然后跑遍整个纽约找你
sense_groups.english: I wrote it on the board, then went looking all over for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跑去罗斯家 跑去咖啡厅
sense_groups.english: I went to Ross's, the coffee house.

sense_groups.chinese: 跑去每一个有三明治的地方
sense_groups.english: I went to any place that they make sandwiches!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 钱德 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this, Chandler! - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to say!

sense_groups.chinese: 那就说恭喜吧
sense_groups.english: You might say, "Congratulations."

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到留官板 跑去试镜 我得到那角色了
sense_groups.english: I saw the board, I went to the audition, I got the part!

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得很好笑吗？我刚才真的很担心
sense_groups.english: Was that supposed to be funny? I was worried over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 有时候这样骗人真的很恶劣
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - At times that fake-out thing is mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不是故意要害你内疚
sense_groups.english: Okay, man. I'm sorry. I did not mean to make you feel bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就好
sense_groups.english: Well, that's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我没有内疚 我好替你高兴
sense_groups.english: Because you didn't. And I'm incredibly happy for you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好恶劣
sense_groups.english: That's mean!

sense_groups.chinese: 你害我惭愧 - 再玩就玩不完了
sense_groups.english: You had me going there! - We could do this all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们来聊聊我会有多红
sense_groups.english: Look, let's talk about what a huge star I'm gonna be.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会变成超级大明星
sense_groups.english: You are gonna be a huge star. I'm gonna hug you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要抱你 - 来抱吧
sense_groups.english: You hug me. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会不会太爱抱了？ - 我也觉得
sense_groups.english: Do we do this too much? - I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 放开我 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Get off me. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: "吉事 我不会扔下你的
sense_groups.english: "Come on, C.H.E.E.S.E., I'm not leaving without you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你从中央处理器 启动备用电源"
sense_groups.english: Try routing your backup power source through your primary CPU."

sense_groups.chinese: "没办法 我的电路烧焦了 焦到不能再焦"
sense_groups.english: "I can't! My circuits are fried! They're fried, I tell you!"

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: "那我就背你"
sense_groups.english: "Well, then I'll just have to carry you."

sense_groups.chinese: "好棒的招数啊
sense_groups.english: "That'll be a neat trick...

sense_groups.chinese: 等你死了再说"
sense_groups.english: when you're dead!"

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你不必用喊的
sense_groups.english: Ross, you don't have to yell.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才有爆炸 我的听力会受损
sense_groups.english: There was just an explosion, okay? My hearing would be impaired.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你很棒
sense_groups.english: I thought you were excellent.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才我甚至觉得"罗斯呢？"
sense_groups.english: In fact, for a minute there, I was like, "Ooh, where did Ross go?"

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你和麦克见面的第一场戏...
sense_groups.english: Thank you. And I have to say that first scene where you meet Mac...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？ - 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Oh, my God. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天就到此为止 多谢帮忙
sense_groups.english: I think that's enough for today. Thanks for your help.

sense_groups.chinese: 他欺压新人 - 就是啊
sense_groups.english: Holding us back. - Totally.

questions.name: S06E21
questions.en:
Okay, Chandler. - Okay.
And your horoscope says
"On the 5th, a special someone is going to give you a gift."
Oh, well, thank you in advance. Mm. - Ha, ha.
"But the 12th brings a lover's spat."
You're going to make a joke about my special present.
Why would you do that?
Oh, wait. "On the 19th, a secret crush announces itself."
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Oh, my God! It's Joey Tribbiani of Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.
That's right. It's your first day.
Are you psyched to fight fake crime with your robot sidekick?
Am I psyched? The lead in my own TV series?
I've dreamed about this for years.
Why have I not been preparing?
No, Joey, you're gonna be great.
But I gotta act with a robot. I don't know anything about technology.
I can't even use Chandler's computer, except to find porn.
And that's only because it's there when you turn it on.
Our lover's spat will start a little early this month.
I'll be waiting.
Are you judging them by their covers? Because you're really not supposed to.
I'm deciding which one to use. I'm going to start writing another book.
Because the last one was such a big seller?
Well, if you must know, I have written 14 books.
And as I'm the only one who has read them...
I can tell you that they have all been very well received.
Hey. - Hey.
Hi. - What are you doing later?
Oh, Rachel and I have to get our hair cut.
We do? - I want to see what he wants first.
I just found out Elizabeth's dad wants to meet me.
Wait a minute. Hold the phone.
You're not Elizabeth's dad?
Come on, guys. I really want this guy to like me.
It would really help me out if you guys could be here...
to make me look good. - Of course we'll help.
We'll be here. - Thanks.
We know how tough those parent-teacher conferences can be.
So here's your office set. - Wow, huh?
Mac Machiavelli, Private Investigator. Eh?
Let's get you to wardrobe for a fitting. - Okay.
Hey, uh, when do I meet the robot?
Why don't we do that right now? He's right here.
Okay. - Joey Tribbiani, this is...
Wow! He's so lifelike.
Unbelievable.
This is Wayne, the man who created and operates C.H.E.E.S.E.
How do you do there, buddy?
I'll let you two guys get acquainted, huh? - Okay.
Sorry about that.
Uh, so where's C.H.E.E.S.E? - C.H.E.E.S.E. is right here.
Nice to meet you, Mac.
This is the temporary robot, right? - No. Why?
Well, I just thought it was gonna be a really cool robot.
Like the Terminator, or, uh, when I first saw you.
I spent two years developing this machine. It's absolutely state of the art.
I'm sorry. It doesn't look like it can do anything.
It can do this.
Hey... Oh, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 乔伊崔比亚尼 这位...
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Joey Tribbiani, this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是栩栩如生
sense_groups.english: Wow! He's so lifelike.

sense_groups.chinese: 了不起
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位是创造 操作吉事的韦恩
sense_groups.english: This is Wayne, the man who created and operates C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 韦恩 你好
sense_groups.english: How do you do there, buddy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个慢慢聊 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'll let you two guys get acquainted, huh? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚才很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉事呢？ - 吉事就在这里
sense_groups.english: Uh, so where's C.H.E.E.S.E? - C.H.E.E.S.E. is right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克 幸会
sense_groups.english: Nice to meet you, Mac.

sense_groups.chinese: 它是半成品吧？ - 不是 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: This is the temporary robot, right? - No. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为它会长得很酷
sense_groups.english: Well, I just thought it was gonna be a really cool robot.

sense_groups.chinese: 像魔鬼终结者 或刚才的你
sense_groups.english: Like the Terminator, or, uh, when I first saw you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我花了两年研发这台机器 它非常先进
sense_groups.english: I spent two years developing this machine. It's absolutely state of the art.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 只是它看起来一无是处
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It doesn't look like it can do anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会这样
sense_groups.english: It can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨... 哦 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Hey... Oh, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我爸 保罗史提芬斯 爸 这是罗斯盖勒
sense_groups.english: This is my father, Paul Stevens. Dad, this is Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 保罗 幸会
sense_groups.english: It's great to meet you, Paul.

sense_groups.chinese: 我比较喜欢伊丽莎白的男友 叫我史提芬斯先生
sense_groups.english: I prefer that Liz's boyfriends to address me as Mr. Stevens.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 史提芬斯先生
sense_groups.english: Uh, of course. Mr. Stevens.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯...
sense_groups.english: Good. So, Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么毛病？
sense_groups.english: what's your problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不交年龄相近的女友？
sense_groups.english: Why can't you get a girlfriend your own age?

sense_groups.chinese: 真好笑...
sense_groups.english: Heh. It's funny...

sense_groups.chinese: 不好笑
sense_groups.english: Um, it's not funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢你跟我女儿交往 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I don't like you going out with my daughter, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我看得出来
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, I can see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 但要是你给我机会 我一定能改变你的看法
sense_groups.english: But I think if you give me, um, one chance, I can change your mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我给你机会改变我的看法
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'll give you one chance to change my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 计时1分钟
sense_groups.english: You've got one minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Daddy. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 2分钟 开始
sense_groups.english: Two minutes. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: l分50秒
sense_groups.english: A minute and 50 seconds.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你 我以前没做过这种事
sense_groups.english: I want you to know, I have never done anything like this before.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我跟别人交往过
sense_groups.english: I mean, I've been in, um, relationships in general.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我没跟学生做过...不...
sense_groups.english: But I've never done it with a student. I mean, not...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那档事 我们还没做过
sense_groups.english: Not "it." We haven't done "it."

sense_groups.chinese: 当然我们做过一些事...
sense_groups.english: Uh... We, I mean... I mean, we've done stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 讲个笑话轻松一下
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. A joke. A joke. Lighten the mood.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个男人走进酒吧 一个是爱尔兰人
sense_groups.english: Um, two guys go into a bar. One of them is Irish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是爱尔兰人 - 结果爱尔兰人赢了
sense_groups.english: I'm Irish. - And the Irish guy wins the joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？ - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 居然会在这里遇见你 - 天哪 谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: How crazy that we would run into you. - Oh, my God! Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 史提芬斯先生 他们是我朋友
sense_groups.english: Mr. Stevens, I'd like you to meet my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 摩妮卡和钱德
sense_groups.english: This is Phoebe, Monica, and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是伊丽莎白的父亲？难怪她有一种...
sense_groups.english: So you're Elizabeth's father, huh? I can see now where she gets her...

sense_groups.chinese: 粗犷的美
sense_groups.english: rugged handsomeness.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有老婆吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there a Mrs. Stevens?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有老公
sense_groups.english: There's a Mr. Bing!

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 丽莎出生不久 她妈妈就过世了
sense_groups.english: No, unfortunately, Lizzie's mom passed away shortly after she was born.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一手把她带大的 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I raised her by myself. - Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我常碰上这种反应
sense_groups.english: I get that a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 大家都坐吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, why don't we all take a seat, you know? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮大家点杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: And, uh, I'll get us all some, uh, coffees.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来...
sense_groups.english: Yeah, why don't you... Ahem. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们先随便聊
sense_groups.english: And you guys can talk about whatever you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 想到什么就聊什么
sense_groups.english: Whatever pops into your head.

sense_groups.chinese: 这时候在这里遇见罗斯真怪
sense_groups.english: It is so strange seeing Ross here, this time of day...

sense_groups.chinese: 他通常都要去儿童医院
sense_groups.english: because usually he's at the children's hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是去泡美眉喔
sense_groups.english: Yeah. But not looking for dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡是罗斯的妹妹
sense_groups.english: So, um, Monica is Ross' sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个很棒的哥哥
sense_groups.english: He's a great brother!

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有个妹妹 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I had a sister. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 她过世了 - 哦
sense_groups.english: She passed away. - Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不必每次都这样
sense_groups.english: You don't have to do that every time.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过罗斯人真的很好 我们是大学室友
sense_groups.english: But, uh, Ross is a great guy. I was roommates with him in college.

sense_groups.chinese: 好笑的是...
sense_groups.english: Funny story, heh, ha, ha...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的大学室友死了对吧？
sense_groups.english: Your roommate in college died, didn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 他算是半死不活
sense_groups.english: A part of him did, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 保罗 伊丽莎白
sense_groups.english: Okay! Here we are, Paul, Elizabeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你们有找到话题
sense_groups.english: I hope you guys were finding something to talk about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正在... - 抱歉我来晚了
sense_groups.english: Yes. We were just... - Sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我已经准备好要捧你了
sense_groups.english: But I am ready, ready to talk you up. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 丽莎的爸爸什么时候来？ - 我已经来了
sense_groups.english: When does Liz's father get here? - I'm already here.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯人最好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross is so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你买给小女生的 你明明说要买给小宝宝的
sense_groups.english: Honey, you got the kind with the little girl. You said we'd get the kind with the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说那个小宝宝有点恐怖 - 是小女生有点恐怖
sense_groups.english: You said the baby creeps you out. - The little girl creeps me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说小宝宝 - 小宝宝为什么会恐怖？
sense_groups.english: You said the baby. - Why would the baby creep me out?

sense_groups.chinese: 小女生为什么会恐怖？
sense_groups.english: Why would the little girl creep you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你们讲慢点好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Can you please talk a little slower.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要写进书里？ - 对 这是探讨男女关系的书
sense_groups.english: This is for your book? - It's about relationships.

sense_groups.chinese: 尔虞我诈 各种禁忌
sense_groups.english: You know, the traps, the pitfalls, what not to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续 太精彩了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Keep going. This stuff's great. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有真心相爱就能克服一切
sense_groups.english: And how none of it matters when the people really love each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有人都喜欢听好话
sense_groups.english: And how people will believe anything you tell them as long as it's a compliment.
Oh, hi! Hi. - Hi. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把钥匙掉在这里 - 喔 那赶快找
sense_groups.english: I left my keys here somewhere. - Oh, well, let's look for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这下面 嗨
sense_groups.english: Under here... Oh, hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 是这一串吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey! Are these them?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 哦
sense_groups.english: All right. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Here they are. - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 保罗先生 - 叫我保罗就好
sense_groups.english: Mr. Paul? - Just call me Paul.

sense_groups.chinese: 保罗 我只是想说
sense_groups.english: Paul. Um, I just wanted you to know that...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯人真的很好
sense_groups.english: you know, Ross really is a great guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如你跟他交往 省得我宰了他
sense_groups.english: Maybe you could date him then. It would save me the trouble of killing him.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不像是有20岁女儿的人
sense_groups.english: You just don't look old enough to have a 20-year-old daughter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们生她的时候很年轻
sense_groups.english: Well, we were very young when we had her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们？ - 对 通常一男一女才能...
sense_groups.english: Ah. We? - Yeah, it usually takes two people to...

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, no! Yes! Of course. I know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在也是我们 还是只剩下你？
sense_groups.english: What I meant was are you still "we" or are you just you?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有我
sense_groups.english: I'm just me. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 丽莎出生没多久 我妻子就死了
sense_groups.english: My wife died shortly after Lizzie was born.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你亲手把她带大的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: So you raised her all on your own? - Yes, I did.
Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一天顺利吗？ - 不错
sense_groups.english: How was your first day? - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 但机器人的态度有点差
sense_groups.english: Except I got a little attitude from the robot.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些死的机器人 它们应该是人类忠实的仆人
sense_groups.english: Damn those robots. They're supposed to be our faithful servants!

sense_groups.chinese: 不是机器人 是操作它的人
sense_groups.english: It wasn't the robot, it was the guy who controls him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不喜欢我 我正要拿三明治
sense_groups.english: He doesn't like me. He had C.H.E.E.S.E. Knock over the sandwich table...

sense_groups.chinese: 他就让吉事打翻盘子
sense_groups.english: right when I was reaching for one. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么不让他被炒鱿鱼？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you get him fired?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞不好我会 我也不想 但我是主角
sense_groups.english: I may have to. I hate to do it. But I'm the star, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 总不能老捡地上的三明治吃
sense_groups.english: There's a limit to how many sandwiches I can eat off the floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 小子 找到你就好 有试镜
sense_groups.english: Joe! I'm glad I found you! I got an audition for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 - 这件事是个秘密
sense_groups.english: Wow. - The thing is, it's kind of on the q.t.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个演员不知道 他可能会被换掉
sense_groups.english: The actor who has the part doesn't know he might be fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 是一部影集的主角
sense_groups.english: It's the lead in a series.

sense_groups.chinese: 《麦克与吉事》
sense_groups.english: Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是《麦克与吉事》的主角
sense_groups.english: I'm the lead in Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在让他喜欢你
sense_groups.english: I was just getting him to like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 嗨 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Joey! - Hey, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 乔伊不在
sense_groups.english: Ross, Joey is not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我在房里面等
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll just wait for him in here!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 没关系 你可以出来
sense_groups.english: Ross, it's okay. You can come out.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 没关系 是我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Ross. It's okay. It's me...

sense_groups.chinese: 史提芬斯先生
sense_groups.english: Mr. Stevens.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我刚才没看见你
sense_groups.english: Oh, I didn't... Oh, my gosh. I didn't even see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有 你走进来 觉得很窘
sense_groups.english: Sure you did. You came in, got all awkward and ran to the bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跑进房里去 还大叫"乔伊 乔伊"
sense_groups.english: You were shouting, "Joey, Joey!"

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 瑞秋 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, Rachel. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再打给你 - 好 再见
sense_groups.english: I'll call you later. - Okay. See you!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 再见 - 啊 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Bye, Ross. - Ah, hoo. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在...你怎么...你在怎么？
sense_groups.english: What? What the...? How did...? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他的钥匙掉了 就回来找
sense_groups.english: You know, he lost his keys. So he was looking for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 在你的嘴里找？
sense_groups.english: In your mouth?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 在楼下找 我们聊了
sense_groups.english: Downstairs. And we got to talking...

sense_groups.chinese: 2小时 我很喜欢他 就请他上来喝杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: for two hours. I really liked him. I invited him for a cup of coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们就在咖啡厅里
sense_groups.english: You were at the coffee house!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 就算我亲了他又怎样？
sense_groups.english: Ross, what's the big deal? So I kissed the guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我的女朋友的爸爸 这样很怪
sense_groups.english: He's my girlfriend's father. Okay? It's weird!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还不是跟我妹约会 - 那不一样
sense_groups.english: You dated my sister. - That was different!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 这次是我觉得怪
sense_groups.english: What? Why? - This is weird for me!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 听好 这样对你有好处
sense_groups.english: Ross, look. This is good for you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 承认吧 目前他一点也不喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Let's face it. So far the guy's not loving you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我可以扭转形势 我有门路
sense_groups.english: But I can turn that around. I've got the inside track.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以一起去吃饭 我可以把你捧上天
sense_groups.english: We could all go out to dinner. And I could talk you up.

sense_groups.chinese: 况且他是个超有名的律师
sense_groups.english: Plus the guy is a very, very successful lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个为什么重要？ - 可重要了
sense_groups.english: How is that important? - Oh, it's important.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果有一百万人可以演麦克
sense_groups.english: There's a million guys out there who can play Mac...

sense_groups.chinese: 机器人和操作员却都只有一个
sense_groups.english: and there's only one robot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道他能让我被炒鱿鱼
sense_groups.english: And this one guy who controls it. I didn't know he could get me fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？ - 听着 乔伊
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? - Well, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很有魅力
sense_groups.english: You're a pretty charming guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 但我有问题要解决
sense_groups.english: Thanks. But I have a problem to deal with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得让那个操作员喜欢你
sense_groups.english: No, sweetie. You've got to win over the guy who controls C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得用力拍他的机器马屁
sense_groups.english: Go back there and kiss some serious robot ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 这个主意不错
sense_groups.english: That's not a bad idea!

sense_groups.chinese: 既然明天要施展魅力 现在还是别浪费的好
sense_groups.english: If I have to turn on the charm tomorrow, I'm not wasting any of it on you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过菲比 我为你留了一点
sense_groups.english: Oh, actually I got a little bit saved for you, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得乔伊比我有魅力？
sense_groups.english: So do you think, uh, Joey is more charming than me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 所以我跟他有一腿
sense_groups.english: Yeah. That's why I'm sleeping with him on the side.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想得美喔
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you wish.

sense_groups.chinese: "你想得美喔" - 菲比 别再写我们了
sense_groups.english: "You wish." - Phoebe, stop writing about us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 我是在写别人
sense_groups.english: I'm not writing about you. I'm writing about other people.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 摩莎和钱特
sense_groups.english: Who? - Marsha and Chester.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我就来写菲莉丝
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. Fine. Then you know what? I will just write about Phyllis.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: Hmm. - Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: "菲莉丝坐在椅子上" - 我知道你想干嘛
sense_groups.english: "Phyllis is sitting in the chair." - I see what you're doing.

sense_groups.chinese: "菲莉丝知道我想干嘛" - 哦
sense_groups.english: "Phyllis sees what I'm doing." - Oh, ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我终于自食恶果了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, I have tasted my own medicine and it is bitter.

sense_groups.chinese: 早
sense_groups.english: Morning! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我最欣赏的天才 和我的机器人兄弟好吗？
sense_groups.english: How's my favorite genius and his robot buddy?

sense_groups.chinese: 别碰他 - 好
sense_groups.english: Don't touch him! - Okay. All right. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 韦恩 你老实说 我一直听说我会被换掉
sense_groups.english: Wayne, level with me. I keep hearing all these rumors that I might get fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还找人来试我这个角色
sense_groups.english: They even have actors coming in to read for my part.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦 再给我一次机会
sense_groups.english: Come on, man. You gotta give me a second chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱死这个小家伙...
sense_groups.english: I love this little guy... Aah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 难怪你不让我碰他 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. That's why you didn't want me to touch him, right? There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 白痴 真是的
sense_groups.english: Stupid! I can't believe this! God.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 看样子我是被放鸽子了
sense_groups.english: So it seemed that my prom date had stood me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯就大方的提议要带我去
sense_groups.english: So Ross selflessly offered to take me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好感人喔 - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: What a nice story. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯上大学时想趁虚而入
sense_groups.english: So Ross was in college...

sense_groups.chinese: 带一名少女参加高中舞会
sense_groups.english: and decided to jump at the chance to take a young girl to her prom.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 想不到会有这种反效果
sense_groups.english: Wow. I definitely did not see that one backfiring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去洗手间 - 你慢慢上
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to the bathroom. - Yeah. Take your time.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我是大一 她是高三 所以没那么...
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, I was a freshman and she was a senior. So it wasn't as bad as...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我知道我一直找你麻烦
sense_groups.english: Ross, look. I know I've been giving you a lot of jabs.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我很保护丽莎
sense_groups.english: It's partly because I'm very protective of Lizzie...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且你的缺点实在很多
sense_groups.english: and partly because they just keep coming to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我得承认 丽莎一直夸你
sense_groups.english: I have to admit that after all the wonderful things Lizzie has told me...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋又说了那么多事
sense_groups.english: and the many, many, many stories that Rachel has told me...

sense_groups.chinese: 看来你也...
sense_groups.english: that, well...
you're not...

sense_groups.chinese: 那么糟
sense_groups.english: all bad.

sense_groups.chinese: "是没那么糟"
sense_groups.english: "Not all bad."

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉之前对你那么凶 你必须了解
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I was so harsh. But you have to understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 丽莎在我眼中仍是个12岁小女孩
sense_groups.english: I still look at Lizzie like she's a 12-year-old girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂你的意思 我也有同感
sense_groups.english: You know, I know what you mean. I do that, too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？ - 不 我不是把她当成12岁小女孩
sense_groups.english: I beg your pardon? - No! I don't see her as a 12-year-old girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我有个6岁的儿子 在我眼中仍是个小宝宝
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have a son who's, um, 6, and I still think of him as a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有儿子？ - 对 我和前妻
sense_groups.english: You have a son? - Yeah. My ex-wife and I...

sense_groups.chinese: 取得共同监护权
sense_groups.english: uh, share custody of Ben. And, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 卡萝和我的关系很好
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, Carol and I are on excellent terms...

sense_groups.chinese: 相信你和你太太也是
sense_groups.english: as I'm sure you are with your wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh! I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是白痴
sense_groups.english: It's unbelievable!

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是不知道你结过婚
sense_groups.english: Don't worry. I just didn't realize you were married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是结过婚 那只是...
sense_groups.english: Oh, we were. But that was just a...

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是酒后闹事
sense_groups.english: I mean, that was just a big drunken mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 你回来了
sense_groups.english: You're back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们结过婚？
sense_groups.english: You two were married?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你在讲艾蜜莉
sense_groups.english: Oh, whoops. I'm sorry. You were talking about Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我们是约6点楼下见
sense_groups.english: We said we would meet at the coffee house at 6:00.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是约7点 - 我们是约6点
sense_groups.english: We said 7:00. - We said 6:00!

sense_groups.chinese: 我如果有讲到6点
sense_groups.english: The only way that I said 6:00...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是说:"我们约7点" "不要约6点"
sense_groups.english: would be if I said the sentence, "Let's meet at 7:00, not at 6:00."

sense_groups.chinese: 我如果有讲到7点 应该会是说
sense_groups.english: If I had said 7:00, I would have said something like

sense_groups.chinese: "我男朋友真自作聪明 什么7点"
sense_groups.english: "Wow, my boyfriend is such a wiseass. 7:00!"

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 天哪
sense_groups.english: Hi! - Oh, my good God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们约几点 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I know what time you said. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道摩莎和钱特约几点
sense_groups.english: Well, actually I know what time Chester and Marsha said.

sense_groups.chinese: 几点？ - 真有趣的转变
sense_groups.english: What time? - Quite an interesting turn of events.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的书突然成了救星
sense_groups.english: Suddenly it's my book to the rescue, huh? Let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 有意思
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Very interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样就很清楚了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well this certainly clears things up.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底是几点？ - 我会告诉你...
sense_groups.english: What does it say? - I will tell you...

sense_groups.chinese: 在你们谢谢我写书后
sense_groups.english: as soon as you thank me for writing my book.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你写书 这真是一本好书
sense_groups.english: Thank you for writing your book. It's a great book...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是女王中的女王
sense_groups.english: and you are the queen of everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你也是
sense_groups.english: Thanks. So are you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就说我不该穿这个颜色
sense_groups.english: I told you I should not wear this color.

sense_groups.chinese: "摩...摩莎和钱特 打算星期天晚上去看电影
sense_groups.english: "Monica... Marsha and Chester are planning on seeing a movie Sunday night.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩莎觉得应该约6点
sense_groups.english: "Marsha thinks they're supposed to meet at 6:00.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱特觉得电影是7点"
sense_groups.english: Chester thinks it's at 7:00."

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们会赶不上电影？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: You knew we would miss the movie? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只把它写在这本白痴书里 不告诉我们？
sense_groups.english: Instead of telling us, you decided to write it in your stupid book?

sense_groups.chinese: "摩莎和钱特很气菲莉丝"
sense_groups.english: "Marsha and Chester are mad at Phyllis."

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信我居然要被换角
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm gonna lose this job.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜 我能帮什么忙吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry, man. Is there anything I can do?

sense_groups.chinese: 能 帮我把那个小冰箱搬走 不被保安发现
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Help me get this mini-fridge past the security guard.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我有事找你
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey, I want to talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不想理你 韦恩 我恨你 你毁了我的一生
sense_groups.english: Yeah? I don't want to talk to you, Wayne. I hate you. You ruined my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 韦恩 韦恩 钱德 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, Chandler, Wayne. Wayne, Chandler. - Hi. How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你帮我 我就叫他们不要换角
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'll get you your job back if you help me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要帮你？
sense_groups.english: Why should I help you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 理由他已经说了 - 帮你什么？
sense_groups.english: The reason he just said. - What do you need?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到你跟那个美女说话
sense_groups.english: I saw you on stage talking to that beautiful woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是莎拉 我很想跟她说话
sense_groups.english: You know, Sarah. I wish I could talk to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你爱上她了吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Are you in love with her? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她 所有的女人 谁都好
sense_groups.english: Her. All of them. Anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是过来人
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I've been there, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你教我跟女人搭讪
sense_groups.english: Listen, I guarantee you keep your job...

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证让你留下来
sense_groups.english: if you can teach me how to talk to women like you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 韦恩 这种事是教不来的 这是一种天生的...
sense_groups.english: Oh, Wayne, it's not something you can teach. It's something you're born with...

sense_groups.chinese: 教得来 我教你
sense_groups.english: You can teach it. I can show you right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说
sense_groups.english: I mean, if you think about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 其实罗斯每次结婚 都学到一点东西
sense_groups.english: Ross did learn something from each marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 学到如何让婚姻变短吗？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: How to make the next one even shorter? - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 这么说不公平
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. That's not fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的婚姻比他和艾蜜莉的长
sense_groups.english: He was married to me a hell of a lot longer than he was to Emily.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只是没告诉我
sense_groups.english: He just didn't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再撒一次尿好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe I have to pee again.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有意思
sense_groups.english: Well, this is fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: So Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 有哪个老婆被你杀了吗？
sense_groups.english: did you kill any of these wives?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what? I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我受够了 我很喜欢你的女儿
sense_groups.english: I have had enough of this. I care a great deal about your daughter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直很尊重她
sense_groups.english: And I have treated her with nothing but respect.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你对我有意见 说实话...
sense_groups.english: So if you've got a problem with me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在跟我呛声吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you yelling at me?

sense_groups.chinese: 绝对没有
sense_groups.english: God, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 你不喜欢罗斯也无所谓
sense_groups.english: You know what, Daddy? If you don't like Ross, that's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不管 我还是要跟他交往
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter to me. I'm gonna go out with him anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她不管
sense_groups.english: Well, if it doesn't matter to her...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我也不管 这不是呛声喔
sense_groups.english: it doesn't matter to me. Still not yelling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还能说什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what can I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我并没有比较喜欢你
sense_groups.english: This doesn't make me like you better.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我也不太喜欢我自己
sense_groups.english: That's okay. I'm not so crazy about myself right now either.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们达成共识 - 对 可以这么说
sense_groups.english: Then we agree? - Yeah, I guess so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有人喜欢罗斯 - 我喜欢罗斯
sense_groups.english: Neither of us like Ross. - I like Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 小孩子
sense_groups.english: Oh, heh, kids!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我又想到罗斯人很好的实例了
sense_groups.english: Wait. I just thought of another story about how nice Ross is.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 瑞秋 我们现在不喜欢罗斯
sense_groups.english: That's okay, Rach. We're not liking Ross right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种实例也很多 - 呃...
sense_groups.english: Oh! Well, I got a lot of those, too. - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果你是对的 吉事
sense_groups.english: Well, it turns out you were right, C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 那批货根本没抵达奥哈马？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: That shipment never made it to Omaha? - You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且那个拉比的胡子 百分百是马毛
sense_groups.english: And the rabbi's beard? 100 percent horse hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 干得好 吉事
sense_groups.english: Nice catch, C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉事 该你说话了
sense_groups.english: It's your line, C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 韦恩 韦恩
sense_groups.english: Wayne! Wayne!

questions.name: S06E22
questions.en:
Hi, you guys. - Hey.
What's the matter?
Well, it's just... It's one of these situations that I just hate.
You know, a massage client gave me three tickets...
to the Helmut Peltz Exhibit at the Morgan Chase Museum.
Now you're thinking you gotta sleep with him.
No. No, it's just that he gave me three tickets and there are six of us.
I'll give up my ticket. - Me too.
Okay. That's so generous.
And I think Ross is generous too.
Great. Okay. Then it's just us girls.
Great. - Yeah.
So, what is the exhibit?
It's mostly just photographs...
of, um, lesbian love scenes interspersed with video games and free sandwiches.
Oh, man.
Hi. - Hi. Hi there.
Hey, Ross, listen.
Chandler got you out of going to the lesbian sandwich museum this weekend.
Thanks? But I have plans. Uh, Elizabeth and I are going out of town.
Oh, that's great. - Yeah.
Think about all the money that you're gonna make.
Why? What?
Well, her father pays you for babysitting, right?
Uh-oh. - Ha, ha.
No, no. That's funny. But maybe it's time to move on.
You know, let it go. Stop it.
Besides, Rachel's going out with Elizabeth's father.
So, uh, he's much older than she is.
Looks like I'm not the only one interested in fossils. Huh?
Ross, all that does is remind us that you are interested in fossils.
Okay, okay.
Uh, well, Rachel's gonna need to yell sweet nothings in his ear. Huh?
Ross? - Oh, come on, that's funny, you know?
Because he's got, like, a hearing aid, you know?
Because he's all old.
One second.
Okay, look, Ross.
Just so you know, since Lizzie likes you so much...
I accept the fact that you're going out with her.
Really? Okay, that's great.
Yeah. But then I changed my mind.
I'm funny like that.
So I've told Lizzie and now I'm telling you.
I don't want you seeing my daughter anymore.
All right, look. I realize it upsets you.
Yes, it does.
But Elizabeth and I are both adults...
and so I don't think there's really anything you can do about it.
I'll tell the university about your relationship and have you fired.
Oh, a man with a plan.
This is so exciting. You get your picture back up on the wall of fame.
I know. It was so cool when it was up there before.
Me and Jim Belushi would just be cracking up about something.
Then I get fired off Days of Our Lives and he takes me down.
Now he's just laughing at me.
Look at him. That smug Belushi bastard.
Oh. Okay. Maybe when they put your picture back up...
they could put you next to Matt Lauer.
Look at him just smiling at me. Hee-hee.
Yeah, I know. We'd be great together.
Hey. So I'm back. - Who are you?
Joey Tribbiani.
From the wall?
Okay, maybe this will jog your memory, huh?
Huh?
Okay, anyway.
I'm ready to go back up on the wall. I'm the star of a new TV show.
Show me in the TV book. - Oh, well, it's not on TV yet.
Well, then it's not on the wall yet.
Okay, fine. I will bring you a tape. Huh?
So, um, now, do you have any of Matt Lauer's clothes here?
Maybe just ones that haven't been cleaned yet?
God.
I love museums.
Soaking up all the culture. - Yeah.
Where do you want to start? - Ooh, the gift shop.
Yeah.
Hey, and then lunch. - Oh, wait, yes, but I can't eat too much.
Paul's taking me out to dinner tonight. He said he has a big surprise planned.
Ow, wow. What do you think? Maybe he's gonna tell you he's gay?
What? No, why?
No reason. That would just be a really big surprise, right?
You could put the aisle over here and then have the wedding ceremony here.
I didn't know you could get married here.
This would be a beautiful place to get married.
Yeah, but I wouldn't put the aisle there. And I'd never have the ceremony there.
You'd have the ceremony under this big, beautiful arch.
May I help you?
Oh, sorry. Didn't mean to interrupt. It's a beautiful space.
Do you do a lot of weddings here? - Yes, we're very popular.
There's a two-year waiting list. Sorry.
Monica, you should totally put your name down for this place.
What? Are you crazy?
I'm not getting married. I'm not even engaged.
Yeah, but there's a two-year wait. What if you get engaged in two years?
Then you've gotta wait another two years for this place?
That's four years. Chandler's not gonna wait that long.
He's gonna find somebody else, you know?
Someone who put their name on the list. - Mm-hm.
Yeah. Honey, it can't hurt to put your name down.
If in two years you're not engaged, you just don't use it.
Well, I guess there is no harm in putting my name down.
I'm gonna do it too. - Me too.
Really? Who would you marry?
I don't know. I don't have anyone right now, you know?
Oh, Pheebs.
Don't feel too sorry for me. At least my boyfriend isn't gay.
Phoebe, that's not... - Don't even get me started on yours.
So, did you watch the tape of my show? - I did.
All right. Let's get me back up there. - No. You don't go up on the wall.
What? But you saw the show. - Yes. It was very offensive to my people.
Dry cleaners?
Russians. It showed them as terrorists and villains.
Okay, okay. Look, you got Harrison Ford up there.
That's right. Mr. Ford is a very good customer.
He brings us a lot of clothes. You bring us nothing.
Okay, well, that may be true.
But in Air Force One, okay, the Russians were terrorists and evil.
And plus, he kills a bunch of them. That's offensive to Russians.
I've never seen it. - Oh, you should. It's great.
This place is really beautiful.
Yeah. I've been coming here since I was a kid. This used to be my grandma's.
Wow. The only thing I got from my grandmother was her eyes. Heh.
I mean, not her actual eyeballs.
But people say that my eyes look...
Do you want to make out? - Sure. Ha, ha.
Are you okay?
What's wrong? - Uh...
Yeah, I was just thinking about your father.
Well, whatever works for you. - No.
No, no. Uh, he just really freaked me out before.
Oh.
Well, so we have to hide our relationship from one more person.
Big deal. Besides, we've had fun hiding it.
Yeah.
Hey. - Yeah.
Um, you brought protection, right?
Why? Are there, like, bears or something?
No. - Oh, uh...
Oh, protection, yeah. No. That I forgot.
Ha, ha. I'll just run to the store and get some.
No. Hey, hey. I'm the guy. I'll get it.
Do you know where the store is? - No.
Do you want to ride around town on my little pink bicycle?
A little bit.
I'll be back in 10 minutes. - Okay.
Why don't you get in the hot tub and I'll meet you there.
Oh, okay.
Oh, my God. What a great surprise. This is such a beautiful house.
Thank you. It used to be my mother's. So this is the kitchen.
You've reached Monica and Chandler's.
If you're listening to this message, we're probably screening.
Yeah, we are.
Hi, this is Hildy from the Morgan Chase Museum.
I'm calling for Monica Geller.
I want to let her know there was a cancellation.
If she's still interested in having the Bing-Geller wedding at our facility...
it is available.
This is Chandler Bing. This is Chandler Bing.
Yes, the groom. No, not the groom!
It's so secluded up here.
I know. That's why I like it here. - Mm-hm.
I feel like we're the only two people in the world.
Whoops. Sorry.
What's the matter, honey?
Did you see a little mouse? - No. Big bear. Big bear outside.
I think I...
Actually, would you go check on that?
Honey, we don't have any bears here.
Well, okay.
Would you get me a Diet Coke?
Okay. Be right back. - Okay.
What are you doing here? - What are you doing here?
I came with Paul. - Yeah. I recognized the ankles.
Hurry up. Get out.
Here you go, honey.
Ah. Thank you. - Diet Coke.
Oh. Ice.
I need ice.
Okay.
Thank you. - Be right back.
Okay.
You and your ice. - Oh.
Get out. Get out. Go. Come on.
Quick.
No, not in there! Not in there! He's in there!
Did you really hear a bear? - Go!
Here you go, honey.
One Diet Coke with ice.
Oh, thank you.
I am so happy that you're here.
Here I am. - Elizabeth.
Oh, look. Elizabeth's here.
Who were you talking to?
You guys?
How did you know we were here?
Um... - Well, she obviously saw the tire tracks...
that were leading up to the closed garage.
Obviously. Heh.
Elizabeth, what are you doing here?
Did you come up here to work on that term paper or something?
Yeah. Yeah.
Well, why don't you, you know, go in that room and do your homework?
Oh, I wouldn't do it in there. Um, that's my dad's bedroom.
That's your dad's bedroom.
Ha, ha. That's your dad's bedroom.
Ho-ho.
Why are you yelling? - Oh!
That Diet Coke, I think, went straight to my head. Whoo!
Hi, honey.

sense_groups.english: I mean, what's the harm in that? - Right here.

sense_groups.english: Please don't think I was trying to pressure you.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比和瑞秋觉得... - 菲比和瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and Rachel just thought... - Phoebe and Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以比我早知道 我们要结婚的 有你...
sense_groups.english: So the people that knew about our wedding before me were you...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比和瑞秋 希蒂...
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and Rachel, Hildy...

sense_groups.chinese: 和一个叫《星光魔力》的乐团

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 他们也有空

sense_groups.chinese: 我错了
sense_groups.english: It was a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全没有那个意思
sense_groups.english: Please don't take this to mean anything, because it doesn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你真的没有那个意思 你知道我还没准备好
sense_groups.english: Yes. If it really doesn't mean anything, because you know I'm just not ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去告诉乔伊你回来了
sense_groups.english: Now, I'm gonna go tell Joey that you're back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚才好担心
sense_groups.english: We were really worried about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她相信了吗？ - 相信了
sense_groups.english: Hey, did she buy it? - Totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 希蒂有带你参观吗？ - 有 那里好漂亮
sense_groups.english: So did Hildy show you the place? - Yeah. It's beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然要跟摩妮卡求婚了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're gonna ask Monica to marry you.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是啊
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 - 把这些卡布奇诺瑞到十一桌
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther. - Take these cappuccinos to Table 11.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个男的要意大利脆棒
sense_groups.english: And that guy over there wants some biscotti.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要外带一杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, I just actually came in for a cup of coffee to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在这里工作吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you still work here?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我早就不做了
sense_groups.english: No, no. I quit a long time ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有告诉你吗？抱歉
sense_groups.english: Did I forget to tell you that? I'm sorry.

questions.name: S06E23
questions.en:
Can you help me pick an engagement ring for Monica?
I can't figure this out. It's so hard.
Should I get her a Tiffany cut, or a princess cut or a...
Ow! Paper cut!
Have you told anyone else?
No, I don't want to tell anybody. I don't want Monica to find out.
You told me.
Well, that's because I trust you, and we're best friends...
and you walked in on me while I was looking at ring brochures.
Well, once again, not knocking pays off.
I only wish you hadn't been on the toilet. - Me too.
Hey. - Hey.
Chandler, wanna go to the coffeehouse? - Oh, all right.
Oh, perfect. We were just gonna see if you wanted to go.
Oh, well, we don't, because we got the other place.
How rude.
Oh, I'm sorry. You want a bite?
So how are things going with Paul?
Good. - Huh.
Although, you know, he's a private guy. - Mm-hm.
You know, I wish I could get him to open up a bit. Share some feelings.
That's easy. You just have to think of him as a jar of pickles that won't open.
So, what are you saying?
I should run him under hot water and bang his head against a table?
No, that's what you do when you want to get the truth out of someone.
Hi. - Hi.
How are you? - Watch this.
Hey, Paul. - Hi, Phoebe.
So how are things going with you?
Can't complain.
Hey! - Hi.
Great to... - Ross, good to see you too.
Good. Bye. - You take care.
Hey, Pheebs, what was the deal with you and Chandler blowing us off before?
Ah, that was so weird, huh?
Phoebe, why did you do it?
I didn't do it. It was Chandler.
He's... He's mad at you.
What? Why? - Oh, please. I think you know why.
I can't think of anything.
Come on, Ross. You're a paleontologist. Dig a little deeper.
Wait a minute, is it because Joey and I didn't invite him to that Knicks game...
a couple weeks ago?
Do you think that's something that he'd be mad at you for?
I guess it could. - Well, then I think that's it.
Well, if he's angry, he really shouldn't just cover it up.
I wish he'd just tell me the truth.
Well, if that's what you want...
then you should run him under hot water and bang his head against the table.
Honey, I made a reservation at China Garden. Is that okay?
Yeah, that's great.
But first, wait, talk to me, talk to me. Tell me about your day.
It was fine.
Okay.
Hey, what are you thinking? What are you thinking right now?
That you are looking really fine in that dress.
Yeah, that's great, Paul. But, you know...
I want to know what... Wow, those are really great.
I just want to know...
what is behind this strong, silent exterior?
You know, they say that still waters run deep...
and I want to swim in yours.
Are you talking about having sex?
No, Paul.
I don't know anything about you.
You know, like your childhood. Tell me about your childhood.
Normal.
Okay, well, then how about puberty? Come on. That's always a painful time.
You know, your friends invite you to a slumber party...
and stick your hand in warm water...
while you're sleeping so that you pee in your sleeping bag.
No, that never happened to me.
Well, you're lucky you never met that bitch, Sharon Majeski.
Anyway...
The rest of your life, you know. Any regrets?
No.
All right, Paul. I'm not asking for a lot here.
Just give me something. Anything.
Okay. - Okay.
When I was 6 years old... - Mm-hm.
I wanted a Big Wheel.
And instead, my parents got me this little...
plastic chicken that you hop around on.
It was embarrassing. Kids made fun of me.
That was a pretty tough year.
That's great. See? - Heh.
I already feel like I know you a little better. Thank you.
Okay, come on. Now we can go eat. Let's go.
It was horrible.
They called me "Chicken Boy."
In fifth grade, I got in a fight. Well, it wasn't really a fight.
Richard Danville bit me on the nose.
I fell down, still have a little scar right here. You can see it.
Yeah, yeah. I see the scar.
Listen, Paul, I think this is really great that, you know, you've shared your feelings.
It's really... It's beautiful.
But, um, what do you say we go share some food?
No, I couldn't eat now.
What are you talking about? You love their Kung Pao chicken.
Chicken?
Chicken Boy! - I'm sorry. I didn't mean to do that.
Well, this is the nine millionth ring store we've been to...
and I can't find the perfect ring.
Ugly ring, ugly ring, ugly ring...
It's a beautiful selection.
Okay, so maybe you don't get her a ring.
Maybe you do something different, you know?
Maybe you get her an engagement bracelet. Or an engagement tiara.
Ooh! An engagement Revolutionary War musket.
You know, I'm so glad I picked you to help me with this.
Huh? - Uh-huh.
Can't you imagine getting down on one knee...
and handing her this gorgeous piece of weaponry?
Yeah, I'm gonna stick with the ring.
Oh, this one's nice. I like it this one.
Sir? Kind sir, can I see this one?
Wait a minute. This is the reason you brought me, okay?
I know how to haggle. So let me handle this from here on out.
Can I help you?
Yes, I would like to see that ring, please. - Or not. Whatever.
This ring is from the 1920s.
It's a one-and-a-half karat diamond with sapphires on either side.
Sir, could I ask you to, um?
Could you hold out that ring and ask me to marry you?
Okay. - Okay.
Will you marry me?
Oh, my God, that's it. That's the ring.
How much is it? - Chandler, I will handle this.
How much is it?
Eight thousand six hundred.
We will give you $10.
Are you interested in this ring? - Yes. Yes.
But I can only pay $8000.
Okay. I can let it go for 8. - We stand firm at $10.
How would you like to pay? - Uh, credit card.
Oh, no. No, no, but I lent my credit card to Joey.
Okay, I'll go get it. You guard the ring. - Okay.
Listen, I'm sorry about before.
Do you have anything here for $10?
Uh, yes. I have these two rather beautiful...
five-dollar bills.
I'll give you $1 for them.
Hey, remember how Chandler and Phoebe blew us off yesterday?
No.
Remember, you were eating pizza? - Yeah.
Well, apparently Chandler's angry at us...
for not getting him a ticket to that Knicks game a couple weeks ago.
What, we were supposed to just get him a ticket?
That guy is always mooching off of us. - Yeah.
Anyway, I still think we should try to patch things up, you know?
Like, maybe we could get him tickets to another Knicks game and invite him.
Wow, that's a great idea. And I still have his credit card.
Here you go.
Hey, hey. I got this one. Here you go.
You know, I gotta tell you, sometimes I just don't get Chandler.
You know, me and him do stuff all the time without you...
and you don't get all upset.
All the time? - All the time.
Oh, my God! Oh, my God!
Still crying? - Like a little girl.
I know, I know, I know. This is all my fault.
I wanted him to open up.
But God, I didn't know that I was gonna unleash...
this weepy, clingy, moist monster.
You know, I only know of two sure-fire ways to shut a man up.
And one of them is sex.
What's the other? - I Don't know.
I never had to use the other one.
I'm just saying, you know, if we're having sex, he's not talking.
Ah, that's right. You're the talker.
Anyway, uh, great idea. - Yeah.
Um, I gotta go to the store. I told him that I would buy him some more tissues.
Uh, we have some here. - No, you don't.
Okay. Um, I'd also like to try on the tiara.
Oh, yeah. Okay.
Wow, what do you think? Too much?
A tad.
Then take the tiara back...
and let me hold the musket again.
Something's missing.
Let me see the ring that my friend picked out.
Where's the 1920s princess-cut ring?
I just sold it to that gentleman.
Oh, my God!
Wait, no!
Let me out! Now!
Rachel?
No.
How are you, Paul? - Okay.
Chandler...
did your dad ever hug you? - No. Did he hug you?
No. No.
It's just that my dad never did.
I miss my dad.
Well, you can see my dad in Vegas kissing other dads.
Hey, Chandler? - Yeah?
Would you?
Would you hug me?
I'm a little busy here, Paul. - That's exactly what my dad used to say.
Okay. A quick one. Come on, hug it out.
Hey. Hey.
There you go.
Okay.
Five more seconds... - Okay.
Joey! - What? Hey, what...?
Hi. Paul, is it?
Do you have my credit card? - Yeah. It's in my...
In my pocket.
My back pocket. Back pocket. - Thank God.
Listen, I got tickets to the Knicks tonight. - I can't go.
Come on, it'll be fun.
Me, you, Ross and... Paul, probably.
Chandler, I found the perfect ring.
Oh, that's pretty nice, but I'm gonna go with the one I picked first.
Oh, wake up, Chandler. The one you picked is gone. It's over.
What?
Some guy bought it. I'm sorry. I tried to stop him but they put me in jail.
They put you in jail? - The little jail between the doors!
Phoebe, I asked you to guard the ring. - I know. I'm sorry.
But, you know, this ring is better. And Monica never even saw the other ring.
Yeah. But when he proposed to me with the ring, I got goose bumps.
Maybe it was the guy. - It was the ring.
Hey, so was he excited about the tickets? - No. He blew us off.
What? - I know.
I can't believe it.
Can I tell you something?
I'm a little mad at him now.
Can I tell you something?
Me too.
You know what? He didn't want to talk to us about being angry?
Well, maybe we don't talk to him at all.
Ooh.
Freeze him out. - That's right.
I like it. - Ah? We'll show him.
From now on, it's gonna be Joey and Ross, best friends.
Okay, we're gonna be the new Joey and Chandler. Ha, ha.
Hi, I'm back.
There's more to tell you. I've written it all down.
Oh, that's great.
No, actually, that's...
That's great. That's really great.
You know, I gotta tell you, writing, all that writing, it gets me, uh...
It gets me kind of hot.
Wait, wait. Listen to this
Know what I wanted to be when I was that age?
A lover?
A surfer. - Oh, yeah. A surfer?
I wanted to be one with the waves... - Honey, hold on real quick.
Hold on a second. Let me just get a little more comfortable here.
Wait a second.
This isn't too revealing, is it? - No.
Whatever happened to that little dude?
So full of dreams.
I don't care about the little dude.
I can't. I cannot listen to any more of this.
The only one who'd listen to this is a mental health professional.
And that's only because they get paid $100 an hour.
Do you know how much money I could've made listening to you?
Two thousand dollars.
And you know when I figured that out? While you were talking.
I can't believe you're trying to stifle me, when just 14 hours ago...
we figured out that that's exactly what my mother was trying to do to me.
I'm sorry.
I don't mean... I didn't mean to stifle you.
This is all just a little overwhelming.
Oh, Rachel.
I'm so sorry.
I didn't mean to overwhelm you.
It's just that when those gates open...
it's hard to close them.
But they are closed now. Believe me.
I'm so glad. I'm so glad you shared.
And I'm glad that you're done.
So, what do you say we, um...
I'd really like that. - Mm-hm.
That was so good.
Oh, oh, ugh.
Hey. - I can't believe you talked me into...
buying this stupid gumball-machine-looking ring.
It's not a stupid gumball-machine-looking ring. It's a beautiful ring.
No, it's not.
When I looked at the other ring...
I could see Monica's face when I gave it to her...
and I could see her saying yes.
When I look at this ring, all I see is a ring.
Unless I look at it really closely, and then I can see my own eye.
Look, this is the most important thing I'm gonna do in my life.
I want to make sure it's perfect.
Okay. There may be a way that we could get the other ring back.
Because I heard the guy tell the jeweler where he was gonna propose.
So maybe we could get him to trade rings or something.
I can't do that.
Well, you certainly can't give her that stupid gumball ring.
There he is.
Okay, and he hasn't proposed yet. She has no ring on her finger.
Wow, you're good. After this, we should solve crimes.
Yeah. Okay. Go get him.
Oh, okay.
Excuse me, sir. Could you come with me, please? You have a phone call.
Who is it? - It is your office.
Do you know who at my office? - John.
Oh, John. Great.
There he is. - Hi. Hi. Okay.
Okay, there was a mix-up at the jewelry store.
The ring you're about to propose with was supposed to be held for me.
So I'm gonna need to have that back.
But in exchange, I'm willing to trade you this beautiful, more expensive ring.
Wow, I would trade.
It is beautiful, but I'm gonna use this one. Now, if you'll excuse me.
No, no. See, this is my fiancee, and her heart was set on that ring.
You don't want to break her heart now, do you?
Yeah. Do you want to break a dying woman's heart?
You're dying?
Yeah, she's dying...
of a cough, apparently.
It's my dying wish to have that ring. See, if I'm not buried with that ring...
then my spirit will wander the netherworld...
Okay, that's enough, honey.
Oh, I don't know.
Let me see the ring. - Great. Okay, here.
All right, I'll do it. - Thank you. Thank you. Thank you.
And you are about to marry a wonderful man.
Hey, I'm marrying a dead woman.
Guys?
I got something important to tell you.
Guys.
Guys?
I'm gonna ask Monica to marry me.
I think we gotta end the freeze-out.
Wait a minute. Is this for real?
Yeah. Check out the ring.
Oh, my God.
So you two are really serious?
Yeah, pretty much.
You're gonna get married? I mean...
We're gonna be brothers-in-law. Come here!
And we're gonna be friends again. - Hey.
What?
Water under the bridge. Forget it! - Okay.
I was gonna wait till it was official, you know, but I had to tell you guys...
because you're my best friends.
I think I'm gonna cry. - Oh. No more crying.
Please, I just dumped one crybaby. I'll dump you too.
I'm gonna ask Monica to marry me.
Oh, my God.
Oh, Chandler. You guys are gonna be so happy.
I know. - Where's all the tissues?
Check out the ring.
Oh, nice. One-and-a-half karat, easy.
Hey. - Hey, Pheebs.
Chandler's gonna ask Monica to marry him.
I know. I helped pick out the ring.
Oh.
You told her before you told us?
She walked in while I was looking at ring brochures.
You can understand that, right?
Guys?
