So what's going on here?
Well, uh, this is a silent auction.
They lay the stuff here. You write down your offer.
The highest bid gets it.
No. I know what a silent auction is. What's going on with your hair?
Uh, why? - No, it's nice.
Nice to see you. So glad you brought someone.
Someone? I brought people.
This is Phoebe. Phoebe, this is Mr. Thompson.
He's the head of my department. - Oh, hi.
And I also brought my friend Joey. - Ohh! Shrimp toast!
You know, I don't know where he is.
I hope you're gonna bid.
Actually, I was about to bid on this lovely trip to Paris.
Nice choice. - Yeah.
Good luck. - Thank you.
Ha.
Okay, $20.00.
Shut the door! Shut the door!
What's going on?
Guys across the hall are throwing water balloons.
Call the police. That's what I did to kids in my building.
No, it's a water balloon fight. We started it.
Oh. Hmm.
Um, I just stopped by to see if you wanted to see this play tonight.
Um, it's excellent. The director is...
Who drank all the kamikazes? - Nobody. We put them in here!
You want some? - No, I... Okay, okay.
Could I talk to you for a second? - Yeah, sure.
Um, so this play, um, what do you think?
It's gotten great reviews. - Attack!
Put your balloons down! - You put your balloons down!
Everybody put their balloons down!
Now, this is a nice suit!
Our next item is the romantic trip to Paris.
It goes to Emil Alexander with a high bid of $2300.
Oh! So close!
Hey, you guys, look. Got me some drinks.
What are you doing? - Open bar.
Finally, our biggest item of the night.
The 22-foot Gentleman's Daysailer sailboat.
The winning bid was a whopping $20,000.
I won!
That was my guess!
What? What? What?
I guessed $20,000.
Joey, it is an auction. You don't guess. You buy!
What?
I don't have $20,000.
Congratulations on your new boat, Joey Tribbiani.
Joey, sit down.
Forget her. You enjoy this. Whoo!
What are you doing?
"One nation...
under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all."
Ha, ha. I remembered it. The champagne is here.
Are you okay? - Yes. Yes.
I'm good. Are you good?
Are you perfect?
Yeah. I'm okay.
I'm a little cold. Can I have your jacket?
Oh. Yeah.
Uh, no, you can't have my jacket.
Because then I would be cold.
If you thought you'd be cold, you should have brought a jacket.
Uh, other than that, are you okay?
Are you sure you're okay?
Yes. I'm fine.
In fact, I've been fine for a long time now and I think...
the reason is you.
That's sweet.
Okay. Um.
Before I met you, I had really little life.
And I couldn't imagine growing old...
Oh, my God.
I know. But let me say it. - Oh, my God. Richard.
What? I'm Chandler.
Oh, that's Richard.
Maybe he won't see us. Richard!
Monica. Chandler. - Hey.
I don't know why I did that.
It's good to see you. - You too. You let your hair grow.
Yeah. Oh, that's right, you always wanted me to.
I see your mustache is back.
Well, my nose got lonely.
And you don't have a mustache, which is good. Ha, ha.
I'm Chandler. I make jokes when I'm uncomfortable.
I'm sorry. Lisa, Monica, Chandler. We used to date.
Richard! No one's supposed to know about us!
See, I did it again.
Chandler, sit down. - I'll sit down.
Good to see you.
Your table is ready, sir.
Oh. Good to see you guys. - Yes.
If you prefer, this table's available.
That might be fun.
What were you thinking?
I didn't know it was an auction.
I figured I'd take a guess.
Help a charity. Free boat!
Why would a charity give away a free boat?
I don't know. Charity? - Oh!
Well, just buy the damn boat.
Phoebe, don't you think you've had enough to drink?
I'm just helping the kids.
How is you drinking helping the kids?
Because the more I drink, the less there is for the kids to drink.
Mr. Tribbiani. Your contribution brings us...
a big step closer to building the youth center.
Just out of curiosity, how much is that boat worth?
I think it was valued at 19,000.
Hey, I was pretty close.
Uh, so, bad news.
Um, I can't buy the boat. I don't have any money.
Joey! Joey, good one!
Good! Very good!
So, uh, I think I'm gonna take off now. - You can't leave, Joey!
You agreed to buy that boat. It is a contract.
Plus, if you leave, my boss is gonna kill me.
Well, what am I gonna do, Rach? I don't have that kind of money.
I know. Okay, okay, okay, okay.
This is what we'll do.
We'll go to the next highest bidder, and we'll let them buy it.
Then you're just gonna pay the difference.
Okay.
I don't know why the kids need a youth center anyway.
They should just watch TV after school like I did. And I turned out fine.
Not great.
So we're hiding in the bathroom...
Then I sneak out. But before Monica can, her parents come in.
I hid in the shower, next thing you know...
they're going at it on the floor.
Oh, my God!
I got a good one.
I once walked in on both my parents making love to the same guy.
It's so great seeing you guys again. I'd like to make a toast.
Uh, as a poet once said, "In the sweetness of friendship...
let there be laughter and sharing of pleasures...
for in the dew of little things...
the heart finds its morning and is refreshed."
Aw.
What?
Oh, my God! You guys!
Before you say anything, have we got a story for you. Guess who we bumped into?
Who? - Richard!
Oh. Oh.
I thought you were going out with Elizabeth.
I was. Uh, she was a little busy with a water balloon fight.
Sometimes grownups have commitments they can't get out of.
Maybe she is too young for me.
When I was over there, I felt like I was a babysitter.
I finally see what you were talking about. I don't know what to do.
Just weigh the good stuff about the relationship against the bad.
That's what I did when I first started weighing stuff.
Okay, um, bad stuff. I'm 12 years older than she is.
If school finds out, you're fired.
She's leaving for three months. - For camp.
Okay, good stuff. Um...
Well, she's sweet and pretty and...
The only question you need to ask is, do you see a future?
Do you see yourself marrying her?
My God. You did it already. You married her, didn't you?
No, I didn't do that. It's just...
Honestly, no, I don't see a big future with her.
Okay, I think that's your answer.
I gotta talk to her. I hate this part.
Forget Elizabeth. If you're not careful...
you may not get married at all this year.
Rach, Rach.
Next highest bidder is at table one. - Great.
The guy who got the Paris trip is at table four.
You care about the guy who won the Paris trip?
It's a trip for two.
Excuse me.
Excuse me. Is the person who won the Paris trip at this table?
That was me. - Oh. Enchante.
Uh, is there a Mr. Bowmont at this table?
That's me. - Ah.
Hello. This is your lucky day, Mr. Bowmont.
The, uh, Gentleman Daysailer has become available again.
I believe you made a bid of $18,000?
You have to pay that. It's not just a guess.
I was actually relieved, uh, I didn't win the boat.
My wife would've killed me.
Are you kidding? She'll love this boat!
What is your wife's name? - It's Pam.
It's Pam. Just imagine this. The Pam.
Aw.
I don't think she'd like that.
Okay. Uh, imagine this: The Mr. Bowmont.
Ooh.
I don't think so.
Okay, look. Let me paint you a little picture. All right.
You are setting sail up the Hudson. You've got the wind in your ha... Arms.
You get all that peace and quiet you've always wanted.
You get back to nature. You can go fishing.
You get one of those hats, people call you captain.
And then when you're old, Cappy.
What the hell. It's for a good cause. All right!
No way! It's mine! - What?
The stuff you said, I want that!
But, Joey, you don't have $20,000!
Who cares? I'll make payments! I want the Mr. Bowmont!
Oh, my God! You're back!
Let me see your hand!
Why do you want to see my hand?
I want to see what's in your hand, the trash.
Ew, it's all dirty. You should throw this out.
Okay.
What did you just do? - What happened?
Richard was there. I couldn't do it. - Oh, no.
I was gonna do it tomorrow and surprise her. Now you've ruined it.
We didn't.
Who walks into a room and asks to see a person's hands?
A palm reader, a manicurist, a hand doctor.
Glove salesman. - Good one!
This is terrible. What am I gonna do?
She only suspects something. So just throw her off the track.
I'll make her think, uh, marriage is the last thing on my mind.
Yeah. Convince her you're scared of commitment.
I can do that. I've had 30 years of practice.
Being you is finally gonna pay off!
Had to go to the basement...
some idiot keeps stuffing the chute with pizza boxes.
That guy's still doing that?
Hey. My God, let me see your hand!
No, you're too late! She already took out the trash!
Wow. I have never had such a healthy breakup.
She was such a grownup about it.
She didn't seem too immature for me.
Did I just make a huge mistake?
Ross? Wait!
Elizabeth, thank God. I was just thinking about...
You suck!
What?
Okay.
Breakup's still on.
Here she comes.
Do I look like a guy who doesn't want to get married?
Yeah.
And, also, a little like a French guy.
I never noticed that before.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
What are you up to?
Just hanging out. Talking about, uh, web sites.
Ha.
Ahem. We saw this interesting website about marriage.
How unnecessary it is.
How it's a way for governments to keep tabs on you.
Yeah, Big Brother. Ha, ha.
That's a little crazy.
Although I am glad you're looking at other things on the Internet.
Got me thinking, why would anybody want to get married?
Why? To celebrate the relationship. To solidify the commitment.
To declare your love for one another to the world.
Eh.
Okay. Well, that's good to know.
The Mr. Bowmont's here!
A customer wants to compliment you. Shall I let him in?
Sure! I love this part!
Come on in. - Hi.
Richard.
I'm not here to compliment the chef.
Oh. I hate when people come back to compliment the chef.
Like I've nothing better to do.
What's up?
It was great seeing you the other night.
Good to see you too.
Come down here to tell me that?
No. Came here to tell you something else.
Came here to tell you I still love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是世上最美的订婚戒指
sense_groups.english: That is the most beautiful engagement ring ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定很了解 你买过一大堆
sense_groups.english: You should know, you bought like a billion of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就没拿到
sense_groups.english: You didn't get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 就是今晚了 - 你要怎么进行？
sense_groups.english: Tonight's the big night. - How will you ask her?

sense_groups.chinese: 保证完美 我会带她上她最爱的餐厅
sense_groups.english: It'll be perfect. We'll go to her favorite restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要送她一瓶她很喜欢的香槟
sense_groups.english: I'll get her a bottle of the champagne she really loves,

sense_groups.chinese: 那她就知道有多贵了
sense_groups.english: therefore knows how expensive it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后等酒斟好了 我不会敬酒 我会向她求婚
sense_groups.english: Then, when the glasses are full, instead of proposing a toast, I'll propose.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哦 - 好棒喔
sense_groups.english: Aw. - Sounds perfect!

sense_groups.chinese: 你会搞砸 让我来吧
sense_groups.english: You'll mess up. Let me do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不会搞砸
sense_groups.english: I won't mess up.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是她说不 戒指可以给我吗？
sense_groups.english: If she says no, can I have the ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会说不的 - 要是呢？
sense_groups.english: She won't say no. - If?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 还给我 - 吞下去了
sense_groups.english: Give it. - It's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在接吻喔
sense_groups.english: We're practically kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚上有人有空吗？我主管要主持救助贫童慈善会
sense_groups.english: Anyone free tonight? My boss is hosting a charity event for kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带越多人去越有面子
sense_groups.english: And the more people I bring, the better I look.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？钱德？
sense_groups.english: So Monica, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡和钱德不能去 我们要去吃饭 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: We can't go. We're going to dinner. Remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 真抱歉 - 干嘛这么激动？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm so sorry. - What's the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是很气 瑞秋不记得我们要去哪里
sense_groups.english: I just get mad when Rachel doesn't remember where we're going.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where are you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 那你们呢？ - 酒品免费？
sense_groups.english: How about you guys? - Open bar?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是 - 我可以为孩子们喝酒
sense_groups.english: I think so. - I can do that for the kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我也要去 我现在有收入 也该回报社会了
sense_groups.english: I'll come. I'm making money now. It's time I give some back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也可以把欠我的钱还给我
sense_groups.english: You could give back the money you owe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 那你办慈善晚会啊
sense_groups.english: Okay. Have a benefit.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你晚上可以 来参加慈善晚会吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, can you come to a charity event tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我跟伊丽莎白有约
sense_groups.english: Oh. No, I have plans with Elizabeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经在为孩童贡献心力了
sense_groups.english: Oh. You're already doing your part for the kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 再过几天 她要去夏令营去当辅导员
sense_groups.english: It's our last night together before she leaves for camp. To be a counselor.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我问你 撇开笑话不提 这段感情要往哪里走？
sense_groups.english: I have a question. All jokes aside. Where is this relationship going?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 撇开笑话不提？我可不同意
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. All jokes aside? I didn't agree to that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为你们可以长久吗？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Do you see this as long-term thing? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你比她大12岁喔
sense_groups.english: You are 12 years older than her.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你们都这么认为吗？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Does everyone feel this way?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点 - 抱歉 有点
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Yeah, sort of.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你们只是开玩笑 我都不知道
sense_groups.english: Uh, wow. Uh, I thought you were making jokes. I had no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过你们都错了 没错 我们是有年龄上的差异
sense_groups.english: You guys are wrong. Yes, there is a chronological age difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我都感觉不到 为什么？因为她很成熟
sense_groups.english: But I never notice it, because she is very mature.

sense_groups.chinese: 况且我根本不在意你们的看法 跟她交往的是我 不是你们
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter what you guys think. I'm dating Elizabeth, not you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她昨晚可不是这么说的
sense_groups.english: Not what she said last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 他配她就够幼雅
sense_groups.english: See, now he could date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意嫁给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 嫁给我
sense_groups.english: Hey, you marry me.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 小精灵们？
sense_groups.english: What's going on, little elves?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚很重要 我们想祝你好运
sense_groups.english: It's the big night. We wanted to wish you luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 戒指带了吗？ - 在口袋里
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Have the ring? - In my pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 哦 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Pheebs. - Oh. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你们出去 我想给她惊喜 她会看出来
sense_groups.english: Will you guys get out of here? I want this to be a surprise, and she's gonna know.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你们快出去
sense_groups.english: Yeah, guys. Get out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好漂亮 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You look beautiful. - Aww. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是...
sense_groups.english: We're just really...

sense_groups.chinese: 要参加慈善晚会觉得很兴奋
sense_groups.english: excited about this charity event that we have to go to.

sense_groups.chinese: 给你 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是怎样？
sense_groups.english: So what's going on here?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是一场不喊价拍卖会
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, this is a silent auction.

sense_groups.chinese: 要卖的东西都在这里 你写下竞标价
sense_groups.english: They lay the stuff here. You write down your offer.

sense_groups.chinese: 出价最高的就是得主
sense_groups.english: The highest bid gets it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道什么叫不喊价拍卖会 我是说你的头发怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No. I know what a silent auction is. What's going on with your hair?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么说？ - 没什么 真的很好看
sense_groups.english: Uh, why? - No, it's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 欢迎 你带了一位朋友来
sense_groups.english: Nice to see you. So glad you brought someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 一位？我带了两位
sense_groups.english: Someone? I brought people.

sense_groups.chinese: 汤普森先生 这位是菲比 菲比 这位是汤普森先生
sense_groups.english: This is Phoebe. Phoebe, this is Mr. Thompson.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我的部门主管 - 哦 嗨
sense_groups.english: He's the head of my department. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还带了我的朋友乔伊... - 虾子吐司
sense_groups.english: And I also brought my friend Joey. - Ohh! Shrimp toast!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道他在哪里
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't know where he is.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你会参加竞标 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I hope you're gonna bid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正打算投标这趟巴黎之旅
sense_groups.english: Actually, I was about to bid on this lovely trip to Paris.

sense_groups.chinese: 有眼光 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: Nice choice. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Good luck. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 把门关上 把门关上
sense_groups.english: Shut the door! Shut the door!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 对面的男生在朝我们丢水球
sense_groups.english: Guys across the hall are throwing water balloons.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们得报警 我都这样对付我家那栋的小孩
sense_groups.english: Call the police. That's what I did to kids in my building.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是水球仗 是我们挑起的
sense_groups.english: No, it's a water balloon fight. We started it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 我来问你晚上要不要去看戏
sense_groups.english: Um, I just stopped by to see if you wanted to see this play tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 这出戏应该很棒 导演...
sense_groups.english: Um, it's excellent. The director is...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁把神风特攻队都喝了？ - 没有 都在水球里
sense_groups.english: Who drank all the kamikazes? - Nobody. We put them in here!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吗？ - 不要
sense_groups.english: You want some? - No, I... Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我可以跟你讲下话吗？ - 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Could I talk to you for a second? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你要去看戏吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, so this play, um, what do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 它的剧评很好... - 攻击
sense_groups.english: It's gotten great reviews. - Attack!

sense_groups.chinese: 放下水球 - 你们才放下
sense_groups.english: Put your balloons down! - You put your balloons down!

sense_groups.chinese: 统统都把水球放下
sense_groups.english: Everybody put their balloons down!

sense_groups.chinese: 这可是高级西装
sense_groups.english: Now, this is a nice suit!

sense_groups.chinese: 下项拍卖品 是巴黎浪漫之旅
sense_groups.english: Our next item is the romantic trip to Paris.

sense_groups.chinese: 由艾弥尔亚历山大 以2千3百元的高价得标
sense_groups.english: It goes to Emil Alexander with a high bid of $2300.

sense_groups.chinese: 只差一点
sense_groups.english: Oh! So close!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 我拿了几杯酒
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, look. Got me some drinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？ - 不用钱嘛
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Open bar.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后是今晚的最大项目
sense_groups.english: Finally, our biggest item of the night.

sense_groups.chinese: 22呎豪华帆船
sense_groups.english: The 22-foot Gentleman's Daysailer sailboat.

sense_groups.chinese: 得标金额高达两万元
sense_groups.english: The winning bid was a whopping $20,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赢了
sense_groups.english: I won!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我猜的
sense_groups.english: That was my guess!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？什么？
sense_groups.english: What? What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜两万
sense_groups.english: I guessed $20,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这是拍卖会 你不是猜 是买
sense_groups.english: Joey, it is an auction. You don't guess. You buy!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有两万
sense_groups.english: I don't have $20,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你购得新船 乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Congratulations on your new boat, Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下啦
sense_groups.english: Joey, sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 别理她 开心就好
sense_groups.english: Forget her. You enjoy this. Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: "一个国家...
sense_groups.english: "One nation...

sense_groups.chinese: 在神之下 不可分割 全民拥有自由公正"
sense_groups.english: under God, indivisible, with liberty and justice for all."

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得是这样背 香槟来了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I remembered it. The champagne is here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？ - 我很好
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - Yes. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm good. Are you good?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都好吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you perfect?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我有点冷 外套可以借我吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm a little cold. Can I have your jacket?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我的外套不能借你
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, you can't have my jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那样我就会冷
sense_groups.english: Because then I would be cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要是觉得会冷 应该自己带外套
sense_groups.english: If you thought you'd be cold, you should have brought a jacket.

sense_groups.chinese: 除此之外 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, other than that, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的没事吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you sure you're okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很好
sense_groups.english: Yes. I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这段日子一直都很好 我觉得...
sense_groups.english: In fact, I've been fine for a long time now and I think...

sense_groups.chinese: 都是托你的福
sense_groups.english: the reason is you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好甜蜜喔
sense_groups.english: That's sweet.
Okay. Um.

sense_groups.chinese: 认识你之前 我的人生微不足道
sense_groups.english: Before I met you, I had really little life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法想像一个人...
sense_groups.english: And I couldn't imagine growing old...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 不过让我说完 - 我的天哪 理查
sense_groups.english: I know. But let me say it. - Oh, my God. Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我是钱德
sense_groups.english: What? I'm Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 是理查
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 也许他看不见我们 理查
sense_groups.english: Maybe he won't see us. Richard!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 钱德 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Monica. Chandler. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我为什么要抱你
sense_groups.english: I don't know why I did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 见到你真好 - 彼此彼此 你把头发留长了
sense_groups.english: It's good to see you. - You too. You let your hair grow.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊对 你一直希望我留长
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Oh, that's right, you always wanted me to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又开始留胡子了
sense_groups.english: I see your mustache is back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的鼻子感到寂寞
sense_groups.english: Well, my nose got lonely.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没留胡子 很好
sense_groups.english: And you don't have a mustache, which is good. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是钱德 我一不舒服就开玩笑
sense_groups.english: I'm Chandler. I make jokes when I'm uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 丽莎 摩妮卡 钱德 我们交往过
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Lisa, Monica, Chandler. We used to date.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查 我们的事应该保密
sense_groups.english: Richard! No one's supposed to know about us!

sense_groups.chinese: 我又来了
sense_groups.english: See, I did it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我们坐下吧 - 好 我坐
sense_groups.english: Chandler, sit down. - I'll sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴见到你们
sense_groups.english: Good to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 您的桌子准备好了
sense_groups.english: Your table is ready, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴遇见你们 - 好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Good to see you guys. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一桌也是空的
sense_groups.english: If you prefer, this table's available.

sense_groups.chinese: 一起坐应该不错
sense_groups.english: That might be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在想什么？
sense_groups.english: What were you thinking?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这是拍卖会
sense_groups.english: I didn't know it was an auction.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为是猜一猜
sense_groups.english: I figured I'd take a guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮助慈善团体 免费得帆船
sense_groups.english: Help a charity. Free boat!

sense_groups.chinese: 慈善团体为什么要送帆船？
sense_groups.english: Why would a charity give away a free boat?

sense_groups.chinese: 我哪知道 做慈善吗？ - 噢
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Charity? - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你就买吧
sense_groups.english: Well, just buy the damn boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你喝够了吧？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, don't you think you've had enough to drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在帮助儿童
sense_groups.english: I'm just helping the kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喝酒怎么能帮助儿童？
sense_groups.english: How is you drinking helping the kids?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喝得越多 孩子们能喝的就越少
sense_groups.english: Because the more I drink, the less there is for the kids to drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼先生 你慷慨解囊
sense_groups.english: Mr. Tribbiani. Your contribution brings us...

sense_groups.chinese: 让兴建活动中心的事大有进展
sense_groups.english: a big step closer to building the youth center.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好奇 那艘船值多少？
sense_groups.english: Just out of curiosity, how much is that boat worth?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多是1万9
sense_groups.english: I think it was valued at 19,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜得蛮准的
sense_groups.english: Hey, I was pretty close.

sense_groups.chinese: 坏消急
sense_groups.english: Uh, so, bad news.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能买那艘船 我没有钱
sense_groups.english: Um, I can't buy the boat. I don't have any money.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你真幽默
sense_groups.english: Joey! Joey, good one!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真会演
sense_groups.english: Good! Very good!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我要问人了 - 你不能走 乔伊
sense_groups.english: So, uh, I think I'm gonna take off now. - You can't leave, Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应要买船 那具有约束力
sense_groups.english: You agreed to buy that boat. It is a contract.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且你走了 我的主管会宰了我
sense_groups.english: Plus, if you leave, my boss is gonna kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那怎么办？我没有那么多钱
sense_groups.english: Well, what am I gonna do, Rach? I don't have that kind of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 好...
sense_groups.english: I know. Okay, okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这样吧
sense_groups.english: This is what we'll do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去找出价第二高的人 然后让他们去买
sense_groups.english: We'll go to the next highest bidder, and we'll let them buy it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只要付差价
sense_groups.english: Then you're just gonna pay the difference.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些小孩要活动中心干嘛
sense_groups.english: I don't know why the kids need a youth center anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 放了学跟我一样看电视就好了 我现在也蛮好的
sense_groups.english: They should just watch TV after school like I did. And I turned out fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是不优秀
sense_groups.english: Not great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们躲在洗手间里...
sense_groups.english: So we're hiding in the bathroom...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我溜出来 但摩妮卡还没出来 她父母就进去了
sense_groups.english: Then I sneak out. But before Monica can, her parents come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我躲到浴帘后面
sense_groups.english: I hid in the shower, next thing you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 接着他们就在地上做起来了
sense_groups.english: they're going at it on the floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一个 我有一个
sense_groups.english: I got a good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一次撞见我父母 跟同一个男人做爱
sense_groups.english: I once walked in on both my parents making love to the same guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 遇见你们真的好开心 我想敬酒
sense_groups.english: It's so great seeing you guys again. I'd like to make a toast.

sense_groups.chinese: 正如一位诗人所说 "在友谊的甜蜜里
sense_groups.english: Uh, as a poet once said, "In the sweetness of friendship...

sense_groups.chinese: 尽情欢笑 分享欢乐吧
sense_groups.english: let there be laughter and sharing of pleasures...

sense_groups.chinese: 人心正是...
sense_groups.english: for in the dew of little things...

sense_groups.chinese: 从中获得朝气 焕然一新"
sense_groups.english: the heart finds its morning and is refreshed."

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哦
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你们两个
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! You guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 在你开口之前 我们有事要说 你猜我们吃饭时遇见谁？
sense_groups.english: Before you say anything, have we got a story for you. Guess who we bumped into?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 理查
sense_groups.english: Who? - Richard!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是要跟伊丽莎白约会？
sense_groups.english: I thought you were going out with Elizabeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 但是她忙着打水球仗
sense_groups.english: I was. Uh, she was a little busy with a water balloon fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时大人就是会有事无法脱身
sense_groups.english: Sometimes grownups have commitments they can't get out of.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许她真的太年轻了
sense_groups.english: Maybe she is too young for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我看到她跟朋友横冲直撞 我觉得我好像保姆
sense_groups.english: When I was over there, I felt like I was a babysitter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于开始了解你们说的话 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I finally see what you were talking about. I don't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以比较这段感情的利弊
sense_groups.english: Just weigh the good stuff about the relationship against the bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当初就是这样... 比较东西的
sense_groups.english: That's what I did when I first started weighing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 嗯 我比她大12岁
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, bad stuff. I'm 12 years older than she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 学校发现会开除你
sense_groups.english: If school finds out, you're fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要离开3个月 - 去参加夏令营
sense_groups.english: She's leaving for three months. - For camp.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 呃...
sense_groups.english: Okay, good stuff. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 她很甜很漂亮...
sense_groups.english: Well, she's sweet and pretty and...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你只需要问你自己 你看得见未来吗？
sense_groups.english: The only question you need to ask is, do you see a future?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能想像跟她结婚吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you see yourself marrying her?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你已经娶她了对不对？
sense_groups.english: My God. You did it already. You married her, didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啦 我只是...
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't do that. It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 老实说 我觉得我们没什么未来
sense_groups.english: Honestly, no, I don't see a big future with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 那这就是你的答案了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think that's your answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉她 我最恨这个步骤了
sense_groups.english: I gotta talk to her. I hate this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 你必须忘了伊丽莎白 你要是不小心...
sense_groups.english: Forget Elizabeth. If you're not careful...

sense_groups.chinese: 今年可能会结不到婚
sense_groups.english: you may not get married at all this year.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 出第2高价的人在1号桌 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Next highest bidder is at table one. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 标到巴黎之旅的人坐4号桌 噢 好
sense_groups.english: The guy who got the Paris trip is at table four.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛管谁赢得巴黎之旅？
sense_groups.english: You care about the guy who won the Paris trip?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是双人之旅
sense_groups.english: It's a trip for two.

sense_groups.chinese: 失陪了
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 标到巴黎之旅的人 在这一桌吗？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Is the person who won the Paris trip at this table?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: That was me. - Oh. Enchante.

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有一位波芒先生？
sense_groups.english: Uh, is there a Mr. Bowmont at this table?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是 - 啊
sense_groups.english: That's me. - Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 你今天走运了 波芒先生
sense_groups.english: Hello. This is your lucky day, Mr. Bowmont.

sense_groups.chinese: 那艘帆船又要卖了
sense_groups.english: The, uh, Gentleman Daysailer has become available again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你开了1万8的价格 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: I believe you made a bid of $18,000?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得付钱 那不是猜好玩的
sense_groups.english: You have to pay that. It's not just a guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 没标到船 我还松了一口气
sense_groups.english: I was actually relieved, uh, I didn't win the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老婆会宰了我
sense_groups.english: My wife would've killed me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧？她会爱死这艘船
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? She'll love this boat!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 尊夫人芳名？ - 她叫潘
sense_groups.english: What is your wife's name? - It's Pam.

sense_groups.chinese: 潘 天哪 想像一下 "潘号"
sense_groups.english: It's Pam. Just imagine this. The Pam.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哦
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想她不会喜欢
sense_groups.english: I don't think she'd like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 那想像..."波芒先生号"
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh, imagine this: The Mr. Bowmont.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是不要了
sense_groups.english: I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我为你描绘一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. Let me paint you a little picture. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在哈德逊河上航行 风吹过你的头...左手
sense_groups.english: You are setting sail up the Hudson. You've got the wind in your ha... Arms.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得到你企盼已久的安宁
sense_groups.english: You get all that peace and quiet you've always wanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 你回到大自然怀抱 你可以钓鱼
sense_groups.english: You get back to nature. You can go fishing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以买一顶帽子 让大家叫你船长
sense_groups.english: You get one of those hats, people call you captain.

sense_groups.chinese: 等你老了就是老船长
sense_groups.english: And then when you're old, Cappy.

sense_groups.chinese: 管他的 不买说不过去 我买了
sense_groups.english: What the hell. It's for a good cause. All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 别想 船是我的 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: No way! It's mine! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说的那些事我也要
sense_groups.english: The stuff you said, I want that!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是乔伊 你没有两万元
sense_groups.english: But, Joey, you don't have $20,000!

sense_groups.chinese: 管他的我分期 怎样都好 我要"波芒先生号"
sense_groups.english: Who cares? I'll make payments! I want the Mr. Bowmont!

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你们回来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! You're back!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看 让我看你的手
sense_groups.english: Let me see your hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要看我的手？
sense_groups.english: Why do you want to see my hand?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想看你手上拿的垃圾
sense_groups.english: I want to see what's in your hand, the trash.

sense_groups.chinese: 好脏 你最好拿去扔
sense_groups.english: Ew, it's all dirty. You should throw this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们搞什么？ - 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What did you just do? - What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 理查也在 我无法开口 - 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Richard was there. I couldn't do it. - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要延到明天 给她惊喜 却被你们破坏了
sense_groups.english: I was gonna do it tomorrow and surprise her. Now you've ruined it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有破坏
sense_groups.english: We didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会一进门就要看别人的手？
sense_groups.english: Who walks into a room and asks to see a person's hands?

sense_groups.chinese: 算命师 修指甲的小姐 手部医生...
sense_groups.english: A palm reader, a manicurist, a hand doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 手套推销员 - 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Glove salesman. - Good one!

sense_groups.chinese: 真惨 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: This is terrible. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 她只是在怀疑 又不确定 你可以唬她
sense_groups.english: She only suspects something. So just throw her off the track.

sense_groups.chinese: 也对 我可以让她觉得 我完全不考虑结婚
sense_groups.english: I'll make her think, uh, marriage is the last thing on my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 让她相信你很害怕承诺
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Convince her you're scared of commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做得到 我练了30年
sense_groups.english: I can do that. I've had 30 years of practice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个人总算有点价值了
sense_groups.english: Being you is finally gonna pay off!

sense_groups.chinese: 我还得跑去地下室扔...
sense_groups.english: Had to go to the basement...

sense_groups.chinese: 某个白痴小孩老是用披萨盒 把垃圾槽堵住
sense_groups.english: some idiot keeps stuffing the chute with pizza boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个家伙还是没改？
sense_groups.english: That guy's still doing that?

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 你们回来了 我看看你的手
sense_groups.english: Hey. My God, let me see your hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 来不及了 她已经把垃圾拿去扔了
sense_groups.english: No, you're too late! She already took out the trash!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟别人分手没这么平和过
sense_groups.english: Wow. I have never had such a healthy breakup.

sense_groups.chinese: 她表现得好成熟
sense_groups.english: She was such a grownup about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得她一点也不幼雅
sense_groups.english: She didn't seem too immature for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是犯了个大错？
sense_groups.english: Did I just make a huge mistake?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 等等
sense_groups.english: Ross? Wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 伊丽莎白 太好了 我正在想说...
sense_groups.english: Elizabeth, thank God. I was just thinking about...

sense_groups.chinese: 你最烂了
sense_groups.english: You suck!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 分手还是有效
sense_groups.english: Breakup's still on.

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了
sense_groups.english: Here she comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？我像不像不想结婚的人？
sense_groups.english: Do I look like a guy who doesn't want to get married?

sense_groups.chinese: 像
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有点像法国人
sense_groups.english: And, also, a little like a French guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我第一次发现
sense_groups.english: I never noticed that before.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you up to?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是在杀时间 聊网站
sense_groups.english: Just hanging out. Talking about, uh, web sites.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个有趣的网站在讨论婚姻
sense_groups.english: Ahem. We saw this interesting website about marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 及婚姻的一无是处
sense_groups.english: How unnecessary it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 说那只是政府监视你的方式
sense_groups.english: How it's a way for governments to keep tabs on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 老大哥
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Big Brother. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点夸张
sense_groups.english: That's a little crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过很高兴你们总算上了 其他类别的网站
sense_groups.english: Although I am glad you're looking at other things on the Internet.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我就想 为什么会有人想要结婚？
sense_groups.english: Got me thinking, why would anybody want to get married?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？因为要赞颂这段感情 要巩固你们的承诺
sense_groups.english: Why? To celebrate the relationship. To solidify the commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 要向全世界宣布你们的爱
sense_groups.english: To declare your love for one another to the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃
sense_groups.english: Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 能知道你的反应真好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, that's good to know.

sense_groups.chinese: "波芒先生号"来了
sense_groups.english: The Mr. Bowmont's here!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 有一位客人 想向主厨致意 要让他进来吗？
sense_groups.english: A customer wants to compliment you. Shall I let him in?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我最爱这种事了
sense_groups.english: Sure! I love this part!

sense_groups.chinese: 进来吧 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Come on in. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查
sense_groups.english: Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我不是来向主厨致意的
sense_groups.english: I'm not here to compliment the chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我最讨厌客人跑来致意
sense_groups.english: Oh. I hate when people come back to compliment the chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像我很闲似的
sense_groups.english: Like I've nothing better to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 那天晚上遇见你很开心
sense_groups.english: It was great seeing you the other night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很开心
sense_groups.english: Good to see you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是来说这个的？
sense_groups.english: Come down here to tell me that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我是来说别的
sense_groups.english: No. Came here to tell you something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来说我仍然爱你
sense_groups.english: Came here to tell you I still love you.

questions.name: S06E25
questions.en:
What? What did you... What?
I still love you.
I know I shouldn't even be here telling you this.
You're with Chandler, a guy I really like.
You say he's straight, I'll believe you.
After seeing you, I knew if I didn't tell you I'd always regret it.
Letting you go was the stupidest thing I ever did.
You're really not supposed to be back here.
I'm sorry. I know this is the wrong time and the wrong place...
but I had to tell you.
I want to spend my life with you and marry you.
I want to have kids with you.
Oh, my God.
Why don't they put chairs back here?
I know this is crazy, but am I too late?
Yes, you're too late. Where was all this three years ago?
I know. I was an idiot.
And I tried to forget you. I really did.
After we had lunch last year, I spent six months in Africa trying to forget.
What were you doing in Africa? - Working with blind kids.
What are you doing to me?
Look, I...
I'm sorry, but it's not gonna happen.
That's fine. I'll walk away. And I'll never bother you again.
Only if you tell me Chandler's willing to give you everything I am.
Well, he is. I mean...
marriage is all he talks about.
My goodness.
In fact, I'm the one making him wait.
You are? - Yeah.
Why? - Why?
Because of the government.
Isn't it incredible?
Monica and Chandler are getting married.
I know. They'll be so happy together.
Two best friends in love. How often does that happen?
Not that often. - No.
I'm so happy for them.
Me too. So happy for them.
I'm so happy and not at all jealous.
Oh, no! God, definitely not jealous. - Mm-mm.
I'm probably 98 percent happy and maybe 2 percent jealous.
What's 2 percent? That's nothing.
Totally.
I'm like 90-10. - Yeah. Me too.
Hey, have you guys seen Chandler?
No. But you know who was looking for you?
Tennille.
So that marriage stuff you were saying yesterday?
You don't really believe that. - Sure, I do.
In fact, I think the whole concept of marriage is unnatural.
Look at pigs. Let's take a second here and look at pigs.
Pigs don't mate for life.
A pig can have 100 sexual partners in a lifetime.
And that's just an ordinary pig, not even a pig that's good at sports.
Wait a minute.
Are you telling me you may never want to get married?
Never say never, but, probably...
yeah, never.
Oh, my God.
Then what are we even doing? What is this?
Whoa, whoa, whoa, what is all this pressure?
Is this some new strategy?
Why don't you put down your copy of The Rules, huh, man-trap?
You know what? I gotta go.
It's okay. I got a plan.
We're gonna find love. - Definitely.
Yeah, I'm pretty confident about that.
That's what makes it so easy to be 80 percent happy for Monica and Chandler.
Would be nice to have a guarantee. - What do you mean?
Some people make deals with a friend.
Like if neither of them are married by 40, they marry each other.
You mean a backup? - Exactly.
Yeah, yeah. I've got that.
You do? - Mm-hm.
Who? - Joey?
Joey? Are you serious? - Yeah.
Yeah, I locked him in years ago.
Wait. So if neither of you are married by 40, you'll marry Joey?
Yep. We shook on it.
Yeah. But believe me, that is not how he wanted to seal the deal.
Seriously?
I think his exact words were...
Charming.
Ah, he's just a backup. - Yeah.
Hey, Monica.
Have you seen Rachel? Or a mirror?
It's for my boat. Cool, huh?
Yeah, it's great.
What's the matter? Talk to the captain.
Just realizing I'm in a dead-end relationship.
Chandler's giving you a hard time?
I don't want to get married tomorrow. But I want to believe...
we're going somewhere, that I'm not wasting my time.
You know Chandler. - No, I don't know Chandler.
Not anymore. It's like something's changed.
Maybe you changed.
I didn't change.
Maybe that's the problem.
What? - Chandler is a complex fellow.
One who is unlikely to take a wife.
Does he think I'll just wait around for nothing?
Face it. Chandler is against marriage.
And always will be.
Well, there's some people who do want to marry me.
There are? - Yeah. Richard.
Richard said he wants to marry you?
And Chandler says he hates marriage? - That's right.
Chandler loves marriage!
You just told me he hates marriage!
That he's a complex fellow who's unlikely to take a wife!
That he's against marriage and always will be!
You got that from what I said?
Rach. - Hey, you.
Hey, come on in. - Thank you.
I'm so sorry to hear about you and Elizabeth.
Thanks. Yeah, I really thought we'd be able to make it work.
I guess it just wasn't meant to be.
Yeah. Love.
It's a tricky business, isn't it?
I guess so.
So, what do you say we make a pact?
If you and I are both single by 40, we get married.
I mean, we know each other, we like each other...
we've already slept together, so there'll be no surprises there.
No, like, "What's that?"
Oh, you want me to be your backup. - Exactly.
Oh, yeah. I already have one.
Who? - Phoebe.
Phoebe?
But she just said Joey is her backup.
Oh, I don't think so.
I just spoke with her. She said that she and Joey made a deal.
That's impossible. We have had a deal for years.
We shook on it.
Although, believe me, she wanted to do a lot more than that.
Where have you been?
I was making a coconut phone with the Professor.
Richard told Monica he wants to marry her.
What? - I've been looking for you.
Stop messing with her!
And I would have if these damn boat shoes wouldn't keep flying off!
Oh, my God! - I know! They suck!
He's not supposed to ask her to marry him! I am!
I know! - What...?
You know what I'll do? I'll go over there and kick his ass!
Will you help me?
Look, us getting our asses kicked is not a solution.
Okay?
Look, just go and find Monica. - You're right.
I'm gonna get the ring...
I'll go find her...
and I'll propose!
Dude! Dude! Dude!
That coconut phone might be good for the boat.
Hi.
I don't know why I'm here.
I didn't ask.
You want to come in?
I don't know.
Oh, okay.
I'll just leave the door open and go sit on the couch.
Chandler is such an idiot!
Drink?
Scotch on the... - Rocks with a twist?
I remember.
You still smoking cigars? - Uh...
No, no. That's art.
If it bothers you, I can put my art out.
No, that's okay.
So, Monica...
let me ask you a question.
Since we broke up, do you ever...
think about me?
Actually, I thought about you a couple months ago.
Really? - Yeah, but it's because I...
had an eye exam, and I don't like my new eye doctor.
Who is it? - Edward Nevsky.
Yeah, he's no good.
Do you ever think about me in...
a non-eye-doctor way?
No.
Ah.
Because getting over you was the hardest thing I've ever had to do.
I never let myself think about you.
Wow.
Phoebe, you picked Joey and Ross?
You can't have two backups!
Of course I can.
It's just good sense to back up your backup.
Look, I've already lost Chandler. - What?
Hey, Phoebe!
We're both backups?
How could you do this to me?
What are you complaining about? You were both aware of the situation.
I was not! - No, we weren't!
This kind of back talk isn't gonna fly when we're married.
You can't have both. Pick one.
Pick me! - No, pick me!
I don't want to end up an old maid.
Well, let's see.
Ross is a good father.
But...
Joey has a boat. This is hard.
This is crazy. I want to switch to Rachel.
I want to switch too.
No, wait! Okay, just wait!
Wait, guys. Don't make any rash decisions.
Remember my promise
If we get married, three times a week.
Oh, my God. Phoebe...
I'm talking about massages.
No, I'm not.
I know how to settle this. Here's what we'll do.
I'll write "Joey"...
on one napkin.
And I'm going to write "Ross" on the other napkin...
and we'll pick one.
That person will be our backup. Here we go.
That sounds fair. - All right.
Good. Switching them up.
Ooh...
Pick one. - Left.
Thank you. - You're welcome.
Ross. - Joey.
We should just switch. - Absolutely.
I miss this apartment.
Now, this is a grownup's apartment.
I should be with a grownup, you know? - Yeah.
You're saying you need to be with someone more mature.
Maybe someone with...
a license to practice medicine.
Or a mustache.
Let's face it. I'm not a kid anymore.
I need to be with someone who wants the same things.
Coming to my work and telling me you love me, I want that!
Talking about pig sex over lunch, I don't want that!
I think that's fair.
Fair? Please. Don't even talk to me about fair.
Fair would've been you wanting to marry me then.
Or Chandler wanting to marry me now.
Believe me, nothing about this is fair. Nothing.
Nothing! Nothing! - It's okay.
Hey. Shh.
Nothing.
I don't know.
I know.
Yeah, I... I...
I have to figure...
some stuff, before I can...
Yeah, I understand.
Take as much time as you want.
Ten, 20 minutes, if you need it.
I'll be here. Not smoking.
Chandler. - Where is she?
I'm not scared of you.
She's not here. And please come in.
Scotch on the rocks...
with a twist, on a coaster.
Monica? Monica?
Okay, she was here. But she left.
Where did she go?
She said she had to think things over.
Oh, my God. I can't believe this. I thought you were a good guy.
Oh, hey. Look, nothing happened.
Nothing happened? Nothing? You didn't tell her you love her?
Well, all right, one thing happened.
You know what you did?
My girlfriend is thinking things over.
You made my girlfriend think!
Well, I'm sorry.
What's to think about? I love her.
Well, apparently I'm willing to offer her things that you are not.
I'm willing to offer her those things. This was just a plan.
To throw her off so when I offered all these things, she'd be surprised.
If it helps, it worked very well.
It was working till you showed up, you big tree.
This isn't fair.
You had your chance with her, and you blew it!
This is my chance and I won't blow it...
because we are meant for each other.
And this has all just been one stupid mistake!
I was gonna propose tonight.
You were?
Yeah, I even...
got a ring.
Did you get a ring?
No, I don't have a ring.
You go get her.
And can I give you a piece of advice?
If you do get her...
don't let her go.
Trust me.
You know, Richard, you are a good guy.
I know.
I hate that.
Dude. - I've gotta find Monica.
She's gone.
What? - She had a bag and she left.
What? - She was crying.
She said you want different things and she needs to think.
Why didn't you tell her it was a plan?
I did! I told her everything. She wouldn't believe me.
Well, where...?
Where did she go?
To her parents'. She said you shouldn't call.
But if I were you, I would.
Can't believe I ruined this.
I am so sorry, man.
You wanted it to be a surprise.
Oh, my God.
Chandler...
in all my life...
I never thought I would be so lucky...
as to fall in love with my best...
My best...
There's a reason why girls don't do this! - Okay, okay, okay.
I'll do it. I thought...
Wait, I can do this.
I thought that it mattered...
what I said or where I said it.
Then I realized...
the only thing that matters is that you...
You make me happier than I ever thought I could be.
And if you let me...
I will spend the rest of my life trying to make you feel the same way.
Monica...
will you marry me?
Yes.
I knew you were likely to take a wife!
Can we come in yet? We're dying out here!
Come in! Come in!
We're engaged!
Oh!
This is the least jealous I've ever been!
Oh, no, wait! This is wrong! Ross isn't here!
Oh. - Oh.
He's done it three times. He knows what it's about!
Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会找到真爱的 - 一定会的
sense_groups.english: We're gonna find love. - Definitely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对这点有信心
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm pretty confident about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我可以有八成 替摩妮卡和钱德高兴
sense_groups.english: That's what makes it so easy to be 80 percent happy for Monica and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过要是有保障就好了 - 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: Would be nice to have a guarantee. - What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人不是会跟朋友约定...
sense_groups.english: Some people make deals with a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是两个人到了40都还单身 他们就结婚
sense_groups.english: Like if neither of them are married by 40, they marry each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指备胎？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: You mean a backup? - Exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经找好了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. I've got that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找好了？ - 嗯哼
sense_groups.english: You do? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？ - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Who? - Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？真的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Joey? Are you serious? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我好几年前就锁定他了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I locked him in years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以要是你们40岁都还单身 你就嫁给乔伊
sense_groups.english: Wait. So if neither of you are married by 40, you'll marry Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们握手为定
sense_groups.english: Yep. We shook on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他可不想就此打住
sense_groups.english: Yeah. But believe me, that is not how he wanted to seal the deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Seriously?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他说的是...
sense_groups.english: I think his exact words were...

sense_groups.chinese: 真迷人
sense_groups.english: Charming.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只是个备胎 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Ah, he's just a backup. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有见到瑞秋？或是镜子吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you seen Rachel? Or a mirror?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的船长装 酷吧？
sense_groups.english: It's for my boat. Cool, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 很酷
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？告诉船长吧
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? Talk to the captain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现这段感情又是死路一条
sense_groups.english: Just realizing I'm in a dead-end relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德欺负你是吧？
sense_groups.english: Chandler's giving you a hard time?

sense_groups.chinese: 我又不是明天就要结婚 我只是想知道...
sense_groups.english: I don't want to get married tomorrow. But I want to believe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是在原地打转 浪费时问
sense_groups.english: we're going somewhere, that I'm not wasting my time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也了解钱德 - 我已经不了解钱德了
sense_groups.english: You know Chandler. - No, I don't know Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全不了解 仿佛有什么事变了
sense_groups.english: Not anymore. It's like something's changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是你变了？
sense_groups.english: Maybe you changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没变
sense_groups.english: I didn't change.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许问题就在这里
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's the problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 钱德很复杂
sense_groups.english: What? - Chandler is a complex fellow.

sense_groups.chinese: 不太可能娶妻
sense_groups.english: One who is unlikely to take a wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在想什么？他以为我会空等下去吗？
sense_groups.english: Does he think I'll just wait around for nothing?

sense_groups.chinese: 面对现实吧 钱德反对婚姻
sense_groups.english: Face it. Chandler is against marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是不会变了
sense_groups.english: And always will be.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人可是真心想娶我
sense_groups.english: Well, there's some people who do want to marry me.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？ - 有 理查
sense_groups.english: There are? - Yeah. Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查说他想娶你？
sense_groups.english: Richard said he wants to marry you?

sense_groups.chinese: 而钱德说他痛恨婚姻？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: And Chandler says he hates marriage? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德热爱婚姻
sense_groups.english: Chandler loves marriage!

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚才说他痛恨婚姻
sense_groups.english: You just told me he hates marriage!

sense_groups.chinese: 说他很复杂 不太可能娶妻
sense_groups.english: That he's a complex fellow who's unlikely to take a wife!

sense_groups.chinese: 说他反对婚姻 而且永远不会变
sense_groups.english: That he's against marriage and always will be!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的解读是这样？
sense_groups.english: You got that from what I said?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 帅哥
sense_groups.english: Rach. - Hey, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on in. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾你跟伊丽莎白分手了
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry to hear about you and Elizabeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我以为 我们能克服万难 不过...
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Yeah, I really thought we'd be able to make it work.

sense_groups.chinese: 这大概是命中注定的
sense_groups.english: I guess it just wasn't meant to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 爱情...
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Love.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱情真是微妙
sense_groups.english: It's a tricky business, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I guess so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要不要来做个约定
sense_groups.english: So, what do you say we make a pact?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我们到了40都还单身 我们就结婚
sense_groups.english: If you and I are both single by 40, we get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经熟悉 喜欢对方...
sense_groups.english: I mean, we know each other, we like each other...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经上过床 不会有意外
sense_groups.english: we've already slept together, so there'll be no surprises there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会觉得"搞什么？"
sense_groups.english: No, like, "What's that?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你想找我当备胎？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, you want me to be your backup. - Exactly.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我已经有备胎了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I already have one.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 菲比
sense_groups.english: Who? - Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是她说乔伊是她的备胎
sense_groups.english: But she just said Joey is her backup.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我刚跟她聊过 她说她和乔伊约好了
sense_groups.english: I just spoke with her. She said that she and Joey made a deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能的 我们几年前早就约好了
sense_groups.english: That's impossible. We have had a deal for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 还握手为定
sense_groups.english: We shook on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只不过她觉得握手还不够...
sense_groups.english: Although, believe me, she wanted to do a lot more than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到哪儿去了？
sense_groups.english: Where have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在跟教授做椰子电话
sense_groups.english: I was making a coconut phone with the Professor.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查跟摩妮卡说他想娶她
sense_groups.english: Richard told Monica he wants to marry her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 就是啊 我直在找你
sense_groups.english: What? - I've been looking for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫你别玩了
sense_groups.english: Stop messing with her!

sense_groups.chinese: 可是这双鞋子跑一跑就掉
sense_groups.english: And I would have if these damn boat shoes wouldn't keep flying off!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 - 就是啊 烂死了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - I know! They suck!

sense_groups.chinese: 他不该向我的女朋友求婚 该求婚的人是我
sense_groups.english: He's not supposed to ask her to marry him! I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 那...
sense_groups.english: I know! - What...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我要去找他 好好教训他一顿
sense_groups.english: You know what I'll do? I'll go over there and kick his ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you help me?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 被他海扁一顿不是办法
sense_groups.english: Look, us getting our asses kicked is not a solution.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快去找摩妮卡吧 - 你说的对 好
sense_groups.english: Look, just go and find Monica. - You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去拿戒指...
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna get the ring...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要找到她
sense_groups.english: I'll go find her...

sense_groups.chinese: 直接向她求婚
sense_groups.english: and I'll propose!

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 老兄 老兄
sense_groups.english: Dude! Dude! Dude!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的椰子电话 也许很适合摆在船上
sense_groups.english: That coconut phone might be good for the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我来干什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know why I'm here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又没问
sense_groups.english: I didn't ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要进来吗？
sense_groups.english: You want to come in?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我把门开着 回去坐下
sense_groups.english: I'll just leave the door open and go sit on the couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德真是个白痴
sense_groups.english: Chandler is such an idiot!

sense_groups.chinese: 要喝点酒吗？
sense_groups.english: Drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要威士忌加... - 冰块和莱姆片？
sense_groups.english: Scotch on the... - Rocks with a twist?

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得
sense_groups.english: I remember.

sense_groups.chinese: 还在抽雪茄？ - 呃...
sense_groups.english: You still smoking cigars? - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 那是艺术
sense_groups.english: No, no. That's art.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不喜欢 我可以把艺术熄掉
sense_groups.english: If it bothers you, I can put my art out.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡...
sense_groups.english: So, Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 我问你一件事
sense_groups.english: let me ask you a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们分手后...
sense_groups.english: Since we broke up, do you ever...

sense_groups.chinese: 你想过我吗？
sense_groups.english: think about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我两个月前还想到你
sense_groups.english: Actually, I thought about you a couple months ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 不过是因为...
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, but it's because I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我去做眼睛检查 又不喜欢我的新医生
sense_groups.english: had an eye exam, and I don't like my new eye doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？ - 爱德华奈夫斯基
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - Edward Nevsky.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的确很差
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's no good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有想过...
sense_groups.english: Do you ever think about me in...

sense_groups.chinese: 非眼科医生的我吗？
sense_groups.english: a non-eye-doctor way?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为忘记你 是我这辈子做过最难的事
sense_groups.english: Because getting over you was the hardest thing I've ever had to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不让自己想到你
sense_groups.english: I never let myself think about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比你找了乔伊和罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you picked Joey and Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能有两个备胎
sense_groups.english: You can't have two backups!

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Of course I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 眼光独到才会替备胎找备胎
sense_groups.english: It's just good sense to back up your backup.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经折损钱德了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Look, I've already lost Chandler. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都是你的备胎？
sense_groups.english: We're both backups?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你怎么可以这样？
sense_groups.english: How could you do this to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你们在抱怨什么 你们都知道这个状况
sense_groups.english: What are you complaining about? You were both aware of the situation.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 - 我们不知道
sense_groups.english: I was not! - No, we weren't!

sense_groups.chinese: 婚后你们可不能这样顶嘴
sense_groups.english: This kind of back talk isn't gonna fly when we're married.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你不能独占他们 你得选一个
sense_groups.english: You can't have both. Pick one.

sense_groups.chinese: 选我 - 不 选我
sense_groups.english: Pick me! - No, pick me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想当老处女
sense_groups.english: I don't want to end up an old maid.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我看看
sense_groups.english: Well, let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯是个好爸爸
sense_groups.english: Ross is a good father.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是...
sense_groups.english: But...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊有船 好难选喔
sense_groups.english: Joey has a boat. This is hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 太扯了 我要换成瑞秋
sense_groups.english: This is crazy. I want to switch to Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也要换成瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I want to switch too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下 等一下
sense_groups.english: No, wait! Okay, just wait!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们别急着做决定
sense_groups.english: Wait, guys. Don't make any rash decisions.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我的承诺吧？
sense_groups.english: Remember my promise

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚之后 1星期3次
sense_groups.english: If we get married, three times a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是在说按摩
sense_groups.english: I'm talking about massages.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道该怎么解决了 办法就是...
sense_groups.english: I know how to settle this. Here's what we'll do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在一张纸巾上
sense_groups.english: I'll write "Joey"...

sense_groups.chinese: 写"乔伊"
sense_groups.english: on one napkin.

sense_groups.chinese: 一张纸巾上写"罗斯"
sense_groups.english: And I'm going to write "Ross" on the other napkin...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们一人选一张
sense_groups.english: and we'll pick one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个人就是我们的备胎
sense_groups.english: That person will be our backup. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 很公平 - 那好
sense_groups.english: That sounds fair. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来弄乱
sense_groups.english: Good. Switching them up.
Ooh...

sense_groups.chinese: 选一边 - 左边
sense_groups.english: Pick one. - Left.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交换好了 - 没错
sense_groups.english: We should just switch. - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想念这间房子...
sense_groups.english: I miss this apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 这才是大人的房子
sense_groups.english: Now, this is a grownup's apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该跟大人在一起 - 你懂吧
sense_groups.english: I should be with a grownup, you know? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 懂啊 你是说 你要跟比较成熟的人在一起
sense_groups.english: You're saying you need to be with someone more mature.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许是一个...
sense_groups.english: Maybe someone with...

sense_groups.chinese: 有医师执照的人
sense_groups.english: a license to practice medicine.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是有胡子的人
sense_groups.english: Or a mustache.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 我不是小孩子了
sense_groups.english: Let's face it. I'm not a kid anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要一个目标相同的人
sense_groups.english: I need to be with someone who wants the same things.

sense_groups.chinese: 来我工作的地方跟我示爱 我要的是那样
sense_groups.english: Coming to my work and telling me you love me, I want that!

sense_groups.chinese: 吃饭时聊猪的性爱 我不要那样
sense_groups.english: Talking about pig sex over lunch, I don't want that!

sense_groups.chinese: 很公平
sense_groups.english: I think that's fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 公平？别跟我提公平
sense_groups.english: Fair? Please. Don't even talk to me about fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 公平的意思是 当年你想娶我...
sense_groups.english: Fair would've been you wanting to marry me then.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是钱德现在想娶我
sense_groups.english: Or Chandler wanting to marry me now.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 这整件事一点也不公平
sense_groups.english: Believe me, nothing about this is fair. Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不公平 不公平 - 别激动
sense_groups.english: Nothing! Nothing! - It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 嘘
sense_groups.english: Hey. Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不公平
sense_groups.english: Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我...
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I... I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得先把事情...
sense_groups.english: I have to figure...

sense_groups.chinese: 想清楚 然后才能...
sense_groups.english: some stuff, before I can...

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只管慢漫想
sense_groups.english: Take as much time as you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 10分钟 20分钟都行
sense_groups.english: Ten, 20 minutes, if you need it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在这里 不会抽烟
sense_groups.english: I'll be here. Not smoking.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 她人呢？
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Where is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不怕你
sense_groups.english: I'm not scared of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不在 请进
sense_groups.english: She's not here. And please come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 威士忌加冰...
sense_groups.english: Scotch on the rocks...

sense_groups.chinese: 和莱姆片 放在杯垫上？
sense_groups.english: with a twist, on a coaster.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica? Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 她来过 又走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, she was here. But she left.

sense_groups.chinese: 她去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where did she go?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说 她要想清楚
sense_groups.english: She said she had to think things over.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 我真不敢相信 我以为...我以为你是个好人
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I can't believe this. I thought you were a good guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们又没怎样
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. Look, nothing happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 没怎样？没怎样？你没跟我女朋友示爱？
sense_groups.english: Nothing happened? Nothing? You didn't tell her you love her?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 只有这样
sense_groups.english: Well, all right, one thing happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你做了什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what you did?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的女朋友在想事情
sense_groups.english: My girlfriend is thinking things over.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让我的女朋友思考
sense_groups.english: You made my girlfriend think!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还需要想什么？我爱她

sense_groups.chinese: 直到你半路杀出来 水泥墙
sense_groups.english: It was working till you showed up, you big tree.

sense_groups.english: This isn't fair.

sense_groups.english: You had your chance with her, and you blew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在轮到我了 我不会搞砸
sense_groups.english: This is my chance and I won't blow it...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们是天生一对
sense_groups.english: because we are meant for each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 而这一切只是个愚蠢的错误
sense_groups.english: And this has all just been one stupid mistake!

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来打算今晚求婚的
sense_groups.english: I was gonna propose tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要求婚？
sense_groups.english: You were?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我还...
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I even...

sense_groups.chinese: 准备了戒指
sense_groups.english: got a ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you get a ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我没准备
sense_groups.english: No, I don't have a ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去找她吧 钱德
sense_groups.english: You go get her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以给你一个忠告吗？
sense_groups.english: And can I give you a piece of advice?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是你得到她
sense_groups.english: If you do get her...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要好好把握
sense_groups.english: don't let her go.

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我
sense_groups.english: Trust me.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查...你的确是个好人
sense_groups.english: You know, Richard, you are a good guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 真讨厌
sense_groups.english: I hate that.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 持会儿再说 我得去找摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Dude. - I've gotta find Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 她走了
sense_groups.english: She's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 她走了 提着个包包走了
sense_groups.english: What? - She had a bag and she left.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？ - 她哭得很伤心
sense_groups.english: What? - She was crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 说你们要的东西不一样 说她需要时间思考
sense_groups.english: She said you want different things and she needs to think.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不栏住她？不说出我的计划？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you tell her it was a plan?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有啊 我都说了 钱德 但是她不信
sense_groups.english: I did! I told her everything. She wouldn't believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那她...
sense_groups.english: Well, where...?

sense_groups.chinese: 她上哪儿去了？
sense_groups.english: Where did she go?

sense_groups.chinese: 她父母家吧 我想 她叫你不要打给她
sense_groups.english: To her parents'. She said you shouldn't call.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我就会打
sense_groups.english: But if I were you, I would.

sense_groups.chinese: 我居然搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Can't believe I ruined this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望是个惊喜的
sense_groups.english: You wanted it to be a surprise.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德...
sense_groups.english: Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 我这辈子...
sense_groups.english: in all my life...

sense_groups.chinese: 从来没想过我会这么幸运
sense_groups.english: I never thought I would be so lucky...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以...爱上我最要好的...
sense_groups.english: as to fall in love with my best...

sense_groups.chinese: 我最要好的...
sense_groups.english: My best...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以说都是男人在求婚的嘛 - 好好好
sense_groups.english: There's a reason why girls don't do this! - Okay, okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来 我以为...
sense_groups.english: I'll do it. I thought...

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我一定行
sense_groups.english: Wait, I can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为 开口的...
sense_groups.english: I thought that it mattered...

sense_groups.chinese: 时间地点很重要
sense_groups.english: what I said or where I said it.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来才发现...
sense_groups.english: Then I realized...

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一重要的是你...
sense_groups.english: the only thing that matters is that you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你让我得到超乎想像的幸福
sense_groups.english: You make me happier than I ever thought I could be.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以如果你愿意...
sense_groups.english: And if you let me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意用下半生 让你跟我一样幸福
sense_groups.english: I will spend the rest of my life trying to make you feel the same way.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡...
sense_groups.english: Monica...

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意嫁给我吗？
sense_groups.english: will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你应该会娶妻
sense_groups.english: I knew you were likely to take a wife!

sense_groups.chinese: 可以进去了吗？我们快愁死了
sense_groups.english: Can we come in yet? We're dying out here!

sense_groups.chinese: 进来 进来
sense_groups.english: Come in! Come in!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们订婚了
sense_groups.english: We're engaged!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我最不嫉妒的时候
sense_groups.english: This is the least jealous I've ever been!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 不行啦 罗斯不在

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他都玩三次了 知道这是怎么回事
