questions.name: S07E01
questions.en:
Hey, what's going on?
I found a note on my door, "Come to Monica's.
Bring champagne and a Three Musketeers bar"?
Yeah, I'll take that.
What's up?
Monica and I are engaged. - Oh, my God.
Congratulations. Where is she?
I'm engaged! I'm engaged!
She's been there for 20 minutes. You didn't hear?
I thought it was a kid yelling, "I'm gay!"
Can I bring her in? - Let her stay. It's sweet.
I'm getting married! I'm gonna be a bride!
Shut up.
No, I will not shut up, because I'm engaged!
Oh, big talk! Why don't you come here and say that to me?
My fiancé will kick your ass.
Come on, apartment 20, apartment 20.
You get her in, you bolt the door, I'll be in the closet.
Okay, wait, wait, wait. Okay, shh.
Okay. Um.
I just want to say that I love you guys so, so much...
...and thank you for being here on my special night.
Our special night.
It just wouldn't be my night... Our night...
...if you weren't here to celebrate with me... Us. Damn it!
It's okay, I want this to be your night too.
To Monica.
Come on, wait, stop it.
Okay, to Monica. - To Monica.
Have you decided on a band for the wedding, because I'm kind of musical.
She got engaged a few hours ago, I doubt she's had time to think...
Speaking of chiming in, remember burning my apartment?
Yeah, you're on your own.
We should get dressed up and go have champagne at the Plaza.
Oh, okay! - Yeah.
I can't stay too long.
I gotta get up early for an audition. I gotta look good.
I'm supposed to be playing a 19-year-old.
What?
So when you said get up early, did you mean 1986?
You guys don't think I look 19?
Oh, 19! We thought you said 90.
Oh.
Okay, everybody, let's go. - Okay.
Is my candy bar around here?
No, you ate it all.
I was afraid of that.
You know what shoes would look great with this ring?
Diamond shoes.
You're not getting dressed.
Know what I mean?
Yeah, but I don't think we have time.
There's gonna be a wedding.
You're gonna be the bride.
Two hundred people are gonna be looking at you in a clean, white dress.
Let's do it.
Chandler, it happens to lots of guys.
You're tired, you had a lot of champagne.
Don't worry about it.
I'm not worried. I'm fascinated.
You know? It's like biology.
Which is funny, because in high school I failed biology...
...and tonight biology failed me.
Check it out. I could play this while the guests are coming in, okay.
First time I met Chandler I thought he was gay
But here I am singing On his wedding day
Phoebe, no.
If you'd let me finish, it goes on to say that he's probably not gay.
You guys don't have this problem, you're made of wood.
Hey, you look great. - Hey.
Oh, thanks.
You okay over there?
I don't know. You know? I feel a little...
You know what? Never mind. I'll be fine.
Don't worry about it. You're probably tired, you had a lot of champagne.
It happens to everybody.
Hey. Wow. - Hi.
Happy Monica's Night. - Well, thank you. You too.
Can you believe they are actually getting married?
Well, sure, but I get married all the time.
You okay? - Yeah, I guess.
Do you think we'll ever have that?
You mean "we," you and me?
Oh, no, no, no.
"We," you with someone, me with someone.
Good, you scared me a minute.
I know. Shake it off.
It's just because you and I, we were like a nightmare.
No, but there were some good times. - Absolutely. Like there was...
Surely you can think of something. - Just give me a minute.
Oh, well, yes.
I can think of one good thing. - What?
You were always good at the...
...at the, uh, the stuff.
Yeah, I...
I was good at the stuff?
Mm-hm. Yup.
I really liked your hands.
My hands? - Yeah.
Yeah? - Uh-huh.
Way to go, guys.
You were really good at the stuff too.
Oh, I know.
Hey, you know what we never did?
Oh, no, not that.
We never had bonus night.
A what? - You know, bonus night.
Two people break up, but they get back together for one night.
One night, just sex? No strings attached?
Yeah, yeah, we never had that.
No. - No.
Okay, this is getting a little crazy.
Um, I mean...
...I'm sure it would be amazing...
...but I really don't think it would be a good idea.
I really...
...really...
...don't.
What's up?
What's up, dude?
Take whatever you want, just don't hurt me.
You playing a little PlayStation, huh?
That's wack.
PlayStation is wack.
What's up with the wack PlayStation, what's up?
Huh?
Come on, am I 19 or what?
Yes, on a scale of one to 10, 10 being the dumbest a person can look...
...you are definitely 19.
Come on, really. How old?
Young. You're a man-child, okay?
Now get changed, everybody's ready. And please, please, keep my underwear.
Oh, thanks. - Okay.
Joe. - Yeah.
Uh.
You've had a lot of sex, right?
When, today?
Some, not a lot.
The reason I'm asking is because I had kind of a, uh...
I was unable to...
I really wanted to, but I couldn't...
There, ha, hm.
There was an incident.
Don't worry about that, man. That happens.
It's happened to you? - Yeah, once.
Well, what'd you do? - I did it anyway.
Phoebe, come on, let's go.
Come on.
Why aren't you dressed yet?
I'm sorry. But I wrote the best song for your wedding.
Check this out. - No Phoeb.
If you get ready now, you can play.
Really? - Yes.
That's so exciting! Thanks, Mon.
But if you touch my guitar again, I'll have to pound on you a little bit.
Fair enough. Get ready. I'll get everybody.
Finally we can start celebrating my...
I'm sorry, apparently I opened the door to the past.
Okay, Monica, Mon. Okay, what you just saw...
Can I ask you just a little question? Why tonight?
What? - I waited my whole life to be engaged.
And unlike some, I only plan on doing this once.
Maybe it's selfish, I'm sorry, but I hoped tonight could just be about that.
Oh, honey, but it is. - No, it's not.
Now it's about you getting back together.
See, you kind of stole my thunder.
We did not steal your thunder. We are not getting back together.
Yeah, no, and nobody even saw. - Yeah.
That's true.
We just kissed. - It was just a kiss.
You guys kissed?
What does this mean?
Are you back together? Can I sing at your wedding?
Thunder being stolen.
Phoebe, it's nothing. - Let's not make a big deal of this.
It was a one-time thing. It doesn't even matter.
Oh, my God.
I cannot believe you guys are talking about this.
Problems in the bedroom are between a man and woman.
All right? Now, Chandler is doing the best he can.
I don't think that's what they were talking about.
What a great night. Chandler can't do it, they kissed.
What? - You guys kissed? This is huge.
No, it's not huge.
People thinking it's huge has led Monica to believe...
...we're stealing her thunder, which we aren't.
We're still talking about it.
That, and Chandler's problem.
Monica, listen, listen.
Would you feel better if we stopped talking about Ross and Rachel?
That would be lovely. - You got it.
Now, I can pass for 19, right?
Yes, you can pass for 19.
Really? - Yes.
Seriously? - Seriously?
Seriously, no. Okay? You can play your own age, which is 31.
I'm 30!
Joey, you are not. You're 31.
Oh, crap!
So, the Plaza. We'll get some mai tais? Maybe no more for you though.
You know, I think I don't feel like going to the Plaza.
Why? - This is ridiculous.
I don't want to talk about it. I don't. Especially with you.
Pssh. That is wack.
Yeah?
I'll play it at the wedding.
Yeah, well, we'll see if they actually let you play, huh?
They tell you anything you want to hear...
...like, "You look 19."
Then they just take it away, like, "No, you don't."
Monica won't take this away.
Wouldn't she? - Would she?
Would she?
You ate my candy bar!
Guess who.
Hey.
Hey, I just realized we kind of left some stuff up in the air.
What did Monica mean
"I don't want to talk," especially with me?
Why not especially you and me? We were both kissing.
Still thinking about it?
I'm serious. What did she mean by that? "Especially you."
Oh, who cares? - I care.
And so do I.
I have to talk to her. Will you let me get changed?
Okay, sure.
Am I going to let you watch me?
No.
I can't believe her. It's just so typical.
I know you're upset, but don't forget there is going to be a wedding.
You are going to throw the bouquet, and then a honeymoon.
Maybe in Paris. - Paris?
We will take a moonlit walk on the Rue de la blah-blah-blah.
Keep talking.
We will sprinkle rose petals on the bed and make love...
...not just because it's romantic, but because I can.
I love you.
Mmm.
Bonjour, monsieur.
Don't say anything, you might scare it away.
It's Paris. Who knows we're here?
Hi, Pheebs. What's up?
You said I could sing at your wedding, so I need a small deposit.
What? - Good-faith money to hold the date.
We're not giving you a deposit for our wedding.
Oh, I see.
They break your heart, don't they?
You know, I don't really need their permission.
You want to sing at their wedding, sing at their wedding.
Yeah, and if you want to look 19, then you...
You got to do something about your eyes.
What's wrong with my eyes?
They give you away. There's too much wisdom in there.
Put some tea bags on them for 15 minutes.
That'll get rid of my wisdom? - Maybe 10 minutes for you.
Give her the deposit, give her the ring. I don't care.
Yes? - What did you mean when you said...
...you didn't want to talk to anyone, especially me?
What a great apology. And you accept it. Bye-bye.
No, seriously, what was the "especially me" part about?
Let's just say it's not the first time you've stolen my thunder.
Wha?
Hey, here's a thought...
Monica, what are you talking about?
My sweet 16. You went to third base with my cousin Charlie.
Ah, third base.
It was all everybody could talk about.
The only reason I did that was because your party was so boring.
We had a caricaturist. - Oh.
Whenever I get married Guess who won't be asked to sing
Somebody named Geller And somebody else named Bing
Monica, your sweet 16 was like a million years ago.
Yet here you are doing it again.
Oh, I don't want to steal your stupid thunder.
Why else would you have made out with Ross?
Got me.
Easy, mimey, the moment has passed. It ain't gonna happen.
It'd be nice if I could have this night.
I never wanted any part of your night.
No one was supposed to see us.
Is that why you did it in the secret hallway, where nobody ever goes?
Uh, Rachel, I've been thinking.
I don't think us getting together tonight is such a good idea.
I'm calling it off.
Way to save your dignity, my man.
Mon, why, why would I ever want to take away from your night?
I don't know, maybe you feel a little resentful.
Maybe you thought you'd get married first.
Maybe you can't stand...
...that your formerly fat friend is getting married first.
Oh, wow, that... You know what? That is so unfair.
Now I want to steal your thunder.
Come on, Ross. Let's go have sex!
I can't believe you're gonna have sex on my engagement night.
Well, somebody should.
Look, if we're gonna do this...
We're not. She's just gonna think we are.
I see, so everybody wins.
Who is it? - It's Monica, open up.
Okay, Ross, stop it. Please, wait a minute.
Ow!
Yeah, you like that, baby?
May we help you?
I wanted to say I hope you have sex, and I hope you get back together.
I warn you, the night you announce your engagement...
...I'm going to announce that I'm pregnant.
How is that ever going to happen?
Do you want to know why I was with Ross tonight?
I know why. - You don't.
Okay, why? - Because I was sad.
What do you mean?
Look, I am so...
...so happy for you guys.
But you getting married reminds me of the fact that I'm not.
I'm not even close.
Maybe I just wanted to make myself feel better.
I know that that's dumb, but you were so depressed...
...when Ross got married, you slept with Chandler.
I don't care, she slept with me.
Anyway, sweetie, I am so sorry I ruined your night.
I'm sorry I almost made you sleep with Ross.
I'm gonna take off.
Congratulations, man. - Thanks.
And Rachel. - Yeah.
What can I say?
You missed your chance.
From now on, the only person who's going to enjoy these bad boys is me.
We thought Phoebe would leave
But she just stayed and stayed
That's right, I'm here all night
And Chandler will never get...
Hey, here's a dollar.
Consider it a deposit. Please sing at our wedding.
Oh, thank you - Okay.
Now who will perform the ceremony?
Who will perform the cer...?
Oh, oh.
I'll pound on him in the morning.

sense_groups.english: You know? It's like biology.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚生物学当掉我

sense_groups.english: First time I met Chandler I thought he was gay

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不要

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 你看来很不错

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不知道？觉得有一点…

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 你大概只是累了 喝了太多香槟

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 哇 - 嗨

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡之夜快乐 - 谢谢 你也一样

sense_groups.english: Well, sure, but I get married all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？ - 我想是吧

sense_groups.chinese: 在行

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊…

sense_groups.chinese: 对

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 做得好 兄弟

sense_groups.chinese: 你也有很多事很在行

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你知道我们从没做过什么吗？

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那个啦

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - "红利"夜

sense_groups.chinese: 两个人分手了 然后见面度过最后一夜

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这有一点怪怪的

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的…

sense_groups.chinese: 真的…

sense_groups.chinese: 不

sense_groups.english: ...you are definitely 19.

sense_groups.chinese: 是这样…

sense_groups.chinese: 不要担心 有时会这样的

sense_groups.english: Maybe it's selfish, I'm sorry, but I hoped tonight could just be about that.

sense_groups.english: I cannot believe you guys are talking about this.

sense_groups.english: No, it's not huge.

sense_groups.english: People thinking it's huge has led Monica to believe...

sense_groups.english: ...we're stealing her thunder, which we aren't.

sense_groups.english: We're still talking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那件事 还有钱德的问题
sense_groups.english: That, and Chandler's problem.

sense_groups.english: Now, I can pass for 19, right?

sense_groups.english: Yes, you can pass for 19.

sense_groups.english: Seriously, no. Okay? You can play your own age, which is 31.

乔伊 你不是 你31岁

sense_groups.english: You know, I think I don't feel like going to the Plaza.

sense_groups.english: Why? - This is ridiculous.

sense_groups.english: I don't want to talk about it. I don't. Especially with you.

sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会在婚礼唱这首歌
sense_groups.english: I'll play it at the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 不过要看他们 是不是真的让你演唱
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, we'll see if they actually let you play, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会说你想听的话…
sense_groups.english: They tell you anything you want to hear...

sense_groups.chinese: 像是 "你看起来像19岁"
sense_groups.english: ...like, "You look 19."

sense_groups.chinese: 然后又反悔 说 "不 你不像"
sense_groups.english: Then they just take it away, like, "No, you don't."

sense_groups.chinese: 这件事摩妮卡不会反悔的
sense_groups.english: Monica won't take this away.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会吗？ - 她会吗？
sense_groups.english: Wouldn't she? - Would she?

sense_groups.chinese: 她会吗？
sense_groups.english: Would she?

sense_groups.chinese: 你吃了我的糖果
sense_groups.english: You ate my candy bar!

sense_groups.chinese: 猜猜是谁
sense_groups.english: Guess who.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚发现 我们似乎还有些事没解决
sense_groups.english: Hey, I just realized we kind of left some stuff up in the air.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为摩妮卡说
sense_groups.english: What did Monica mean

sense_groups.chinese: "我不想谈"特别是和我 是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: "I don't want to talk," especially with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不特别是你和我？ 是我们两人在接吻耶
sense_groups.english: Why not especially you and me? We were both kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在想那件事？
sense_groups.english: Still thinking about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的 她说 "尤其是你" 是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: I'm serious. What did she mean by that? "Especially you."

sense_groups.chinese: 谁在乎啊？ - 我在乎
sense_groups.english: Oh, who cares? - I care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也在乎
sense_groups.english: And so do I.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要和她谈谈 让我换衣服好吗？
sense_groups.english: I have to talk to her. Will you let me get changed?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 没问题
sense_groups.english: Okay, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要让你看我换衣服吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I going to let you watch me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信她竟然如此 她就是这样
sense_groups.english: I can't believe her. It's just so typical.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我知道你不高兴 可别忘了要举行婚礼了
sense_groups.english: I know you're upset, but don't forget there is going to be a wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会要丢捧花 然后去蜜月
sense_groups.english: You are going to throw the bouquet, and then a honeymoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能去巴黎 - 巴黎？
sense_groups.english: Maybe in Paris. - Paris?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会在月光下的 那叫什么来着的大道上散步
sense_groups.english: We will take a moonlit walk on the Rue de la blah-blah-blah.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续说
sense_groups.english: Keep talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 会在床上洒玫瑰块花辫 做爱…
sense_groups.english: We will sprinkle rose petals on the bed and make love...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是因为那很浪漫 而是因为我可以
sense_groups.english: ...not just because it's romantic, but because I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mmm.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生
sense_groups.english: Bonjour, monsieur.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说话 你会吓跑它
sense_groups.english: Don't say anything, you might scare it away.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是巴黎 谁知道我们在这里？
sense_groups.english: It's Paris. Who knows we're here?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Pheebs. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说我可以在你的婚礼演唱 所以我要订金
sense_groups.english: You said I could sing at your wedding, so I need a small deposit.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你知道 一笔钱来保留那个日期
sense_groups.english: What? - Good-faith money to hold the date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会给你订金
sense_groups.english: We're not giving you a deposit for our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我懂了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们真能伤你的心 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: They break your heart, don't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要他们的同意
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't really need their permission.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想在他们婚礼唱歌 就在他们婚礼唱歌
sense_groups.english: You want to sing at their wedding, sing at their wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想看起来像19岁 就…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and if you want to look 19, then you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要修饰一下你的眼睛
sense_groups.english: You got to do something about your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？我的眼睛怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with my eyes?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们出卖了你 里头有太多的智慧
sense_groups.english: They give you away. There's too much wisdom in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 在上面放茶袋敷15分钟
sense_groups.english: Put some tea bags on them for 15 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 也会去除我的智慧？ - 也许你只需要10分钟
sense_groups.english: That'll get rid of my wisdom? - Maybe 10 minutes for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 给她订金 给她戒指 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: Give her the deposit, give her the ring. I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？ - 摩妮卡 你是什么意思 当你说…
sense_groups.english: Yes? - What did you mean when you said...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想和任何人谈 尤其是我？
sense_groups.english: ...you didn't want to talk to anyone, especially me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒的道歉 你接受了 再见
sense_groups.english: What a great apology. And you accept it. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是认真的 "特别是和我"是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: No, seriously, what was the "especially me" part about?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样说吧 这不是你第一次抢了我的锋头
sense_groups.english: Let's just say it's not the first time you've stolen my thunder.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇？
sense_groups.english: Wha?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得…
sense_groups.english: Hey, here's a thought...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你在说什么？
sense_groups.english: Monica, what are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我16岁的生日宴会上 记得你和我表哥查理上三垒
sense_groups.english: My sweet 16. You went to third base with my cousin Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 上三垒
sense_groups.english: Ah, third base.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都在讲那件事
sense_groups.english: It was all everybody could talk about.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 那会发生是因为你的宴会太无聊
sense_groups.english: The only reason I did that was because your party was so boring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们请了一捆漫画家 - 哦
sense_groups.english: We had a caricaturist. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我结婚时 猜猜不会请谁来演唱
sense_groups.english: Whenever I get married Guess who won't be asked to sing

sense_groups.chinese: 叫盖勒的还有叫宾的
sense_groups.english: Somebody named Geller And somebody else named Bing

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你的甜蜜16岁生日 是一百万年前的事了
sense_groups.english: Monica, your sweet 16 was like a million years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你现在又再做了一次
sense_groups.english: Yet here you are doing it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想抢你的笨锋头
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't want to steal your stupid thunder.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还有什么原因你会和罗斯亲热？
sense_groups.english: Why else would you have made out with Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Got me.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了啦 时机已过 不会发生了
sense_groups.english: Easy, mimey, the moment has passed. It ain't gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果今晚的注意力都在我身上就好了
sense_groups.english: It'd be nice if I could have this night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓 我从没有想要过抢你的锋头
sense_groups.english: I never wanted any part of your night.

sense_groups.chinese: 不应该有人看到我们接吻的
sense_groups.english: No one was supposed to see us.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们就在秘密走廊上做 因为没有人会到那儿去？
sense_groups.english: Is that why you did it in the secret hallway, where nobody ever goes?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我想过了
sense_groups.english: Uh, Rachel, I've been thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我们今晚 在一起的主意不是很好
sense_groups.english: I don't think us getting together tonight is such a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我退出
sense_groups.english: I'm calling it off.

sense_groups.chinese: 挽救尊严的好方法
sense_groups.english: Way to save your dignity, my man.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我为什么要抢走 属于你的晚上？
sense_groups.english: Mon, why, why would I ever want to take away from your night?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 也许你有一点生气
sense_groups.english: I don't know, maybe you feel a little resentful.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你以为你会先结婚
sense_groups.english: Maybe you thought you'd get married first.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你不能忍耐…
sense_groups.english: Maybe you can't stand...

sense_groups.chinese: 你那个以前很胖的朋友会先结婚
sense_groups.english: ...that your formerly fat friend is getting married first.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦…你知道吗？太不公平了
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow, that... You know what? That is so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？现在我想抢你锋头了
sense_groups.english: Now I want to steal your thunder.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 走 我们做爱去
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross. Let's go have sex!

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信 你竟然在我的订婚夜做爱
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're gonna have sex on my engagement night.

sense_groups.chinese: 总得有人做啊
sense_groups.english: Well, somebody should.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们要做…
sense_groups.english: Look, if we're gonna do this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有要做 只是要让她以为我们有
sense_groups.english: We're not. She's just gonna think we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了 人人都是赢家
sense_groups.english: I see, so everybody wins.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？ - 是摩妮卡 开门
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - It's Monica, open up.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 停一下 拜托 等一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, stop it. Please, wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 你喜欢吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you like that, baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: May we help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你 我希望你们上床 希望你们复合
sense_groups.english: I wanted to say I hope you have sex, and I hope you get back together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我警告你 你宣布订婚那一晚…
sense_groups.english: I warn you, the night you announce your engagement...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会宣布我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: ...I'm going to announce that I'm pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 那怎么可能呢？
sense_groups.english: How is that ever going to happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你想知道今晚 我为什么会和罗斯在一起？
sense_groups.english: Do you want to know why I was with Ross tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道为什么 - 你不知道
sense_groups.english: I know why. - You don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 为什么？ - 因为我很伤心
sense_groups.english: Okay, why? - Because I was sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很…
sense_groups.english: Look, I am so...

sense_groups.chinese: 很为你们高兴
sense_groups.english: ...so happy for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你要结婚这件事 提醒了我 我没有
sense_groups.english: But you getting married reminds me of the fact that I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 八字都没一撇
sense_groups.english: I'm not even close.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我只想让自己好过一点
sense_groups.english: Maybe I just wanted to make myself feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很笨 可是罗斯结婚时…
sense_groups.english: I know that that's dumb, but you were so depressed...

sense_groups.chinese: 你沮丧得和钱德上床
sense_groups.english: ...when Ross got married, you slept with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无所谓 和她上床的是我
sense_groups.english: I don't care, she slept with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 很抱歉毁了属于你的今晚
sense_groups.english: Anyway, sweetie, I am so sorry I ruined your night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉我几乎让你和罗斯上床
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I almost made you sleep with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Congratulations, man. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋… - 什么？
sense_groups.english: And Rachel. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能说什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What can I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 你失去了你的机会
sense_groups.english: You missed your chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 从现在起 只有我能享受他们了
sense_groups.english: From now on, the only person who's going to enjoy these bad boys is me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以为菲比会离开
sense_groups.english: We thought Phoebe would leave

sense_groups.chinese: 但她留了下来
sense_groups.english: But she just stayed and stayed

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我整夜留在这里
sense_groups.english: That's right, I'm here all night

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德永远不会…
sense_groups.english: And Chandler will never get...

sense_groups.chinese: 来 这儿是一块钱
sense_groups.english: Hey, here's a dollar.

sense_groups.chinese: 算是订金 请在我婚礼上演唱
sense_groups.english: Consider it a deposit. Please sing at our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 谢谢 - 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在谁会在婚礼表演
sense_groups.english: Now who will perform the ceremony?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会在婚…
sense_groups.english: Who will perform the cer...?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我早上再来打他
sense_groups.english: I'll pound on him in the morning.

questions.name: S07E02
questions.en:
Hey. Who wants French toast? - Oh, I'll have some.
Me too. Eggs and milk in the fridge. Thanks.
Ow.
Oh, what's the matter, honey? - My hand feels weird.
I guess it's because I'm engaged.
When will that start getting annoying? - Start?
So let's actually get started on the wedding plans.
Okay. - Already?
Yeah, we got a lot to do. We gotta think about the flowers...
...the caterers, the music...
Oh, I got some thoughts on the music... - Chandler, too many cooks...
Take it from me. All you have to do is show up and try to say the right name.
Okay.
What in God's name is that? - Oh, my God, the wedding book?
I haven't seen that since the 4th grade.
This baby has everything. Take, you know, locations for instance
First organized alphabetically, then geographically...
...then by square footage.
That is so smart. Ha.
Break it off. Ahem. Break it off, now.
And that should conclusively prove...
...that I had the idea for Jurassic Park first.
Now, let's take a look... - Hey, Ross.
Phoebe, oh, my God, what are you doing here?
I need to talk to you. It's pretty urgent. It's about Monica and Chandler.
Oh, my God. Um, of course.
Uh, would you please excuse me for a moment?
Um, heh, do you know each other's hometowns? Why don't you?
What's going on?
Well, um, not much. I was just thinking that since those guys just got engaged...
...that maybe it'd be nice if they had some privacy.
So could I just move in with you for a couple days?
Um...
Okay, yeah, sure. But what's wrong with Monica and Chandler?
Nothing. Why?
Phoebe, you said it was urgent.
Oh, yeah, it is. I'm going to the movies and it starts in like five minutes.
Do you realize I have a classroom full of students?
Oh, I'm sorry. I'm so rude. Does anyone want to come to the movies?
I haven't cleared the budget with my parents yet...
...but tell me how this is for music.
All right, um, a string quartet for the processional, a jazz trio for cocktails...
...the Bay City Rollers for dancing...
Wait, that was for my 6th grade wedding.
Well, you couldn't get them anyway. Ian doesn't play anymore, and Derek...
Well, Derek is a name I shouldn't know.
Hey, Mon, do you have another pillow, you know, something a little snugglier?
Why are you napping over here instead of over at your place?
The duck. - What, the duck?
What the hell did the damn duck do now?
Uh, well, he did not get sick somewhere in there...
...and it was immediately found and properly cleaned up.
Now, do I get to look at this book...
...or is it just for people who are actually involved in the wedding?
Of course you can look at it. Yeah, I want your opinion too.
Okay. - Here you go.
What do you think about centerpieces? - Centerpieces.
Roses or lilies? - Definitely roses.
Well, I just think they're a bit more wedding-y, you know.
But lilies are the clear choice. - Oh, my God, it's like one mind.
Uh-huh.
Guys, guys, you gotta let me nap.
I'm gonna get cranky.
Joey, there is a perfectly good couch across the hall.
Yes, it is perfectly good...
...and it is not one of the places the duck got sick.
What?
All right, I'm gonna go. - Joey, what did the duck do?
I don't know, but he did not eat your face cream.
Hey, little buddy.
How you feeling? Aah.
What the hell is in that face cream?
That's so soft.
Pillowcases.
Oh, ah.
"Zelda looked at the chimney sweep. Her father, the vicar..."
Vicar?
"...wouldn't be home for hours.
Her loins were burning.
She threw caution to the wind and reached out and grabbed his..."
Whoa.
This is a dirty book.
Uh, Phoebe?
Oh, Ross, hi.
Phoebe, what are you doing? - I'm sorry, I'm with a client right now.
Phoebe. - Okay, let's talk outside.
Phoebe, you can't massage people in my apartment.
What's the big deal? I did it at Monica and Chandler's.
And they knew about it?
Okay, look, Ross, what is this really about?
Look, this is my home, and I want to be able to come and go whenever I want.
Okay. I will find someplace else to do the rest of my appointments.
I just don't know what the big deal is.
The big deal is I don't want naked, greasy strangers in my apartment...
...when I want to kick back with a puzzle... Beer, cold beer.
Hey, Joey. What are you doing?
Sweeping. Why? Does it turn you on?
No.
Hmm.
What if I was, uh, sweeping a chimney?
Joey, did you eat my face cream?
Where are you going? The vicar won't be home for hours.
Joey...
...where did you learn that word?
Where do you think...
...Zelda?
You found my book? - Yeah, I did.
Joey, what are you doing going into my bedroom?
Okay, I'm sorry. I went in there to take a nap.
And I know I shouldn't have, but you got porn.
Ugh.
You know what? I don't care. I'm not ashamed of my book.
There's nothing wrong with a woman enjoying a little erotica.
It's just a healthy expression of female sexuality...
...which, by the way, is something that you will never understand.
You got porn.
Hello. - Hi, is, uh, Phoebe here?
Uh, no, no, she's out for the night. - Oh, great.
Heh. Can I help you with something?
I don't know. Are you a masseur?
Yes, I am.
Great. Dad?
Thank you so much. I'll be back to pick him up in an hour.
So, Chandler, your parents must've been thrilled...
...when you told them you were engaged.
Oh, yeah. I should probably call them.
I remember when we first got engaged.
I don't think I've heard that story. - Dad, you don't...
Well, I'd gotten Judy pregnant.
I still don't know how.
You don't know how? Your dog thought my diaphragm was a chew toy.
What a sweet story.
At least you're not hearing it at your 5th grade Halloween party.
What? They wanted a scary story.
Anyway, we're really excited about our wedding plans.
Pretty soon we'll be making a big withdrawal from the Monica wedding fund.
What? - You tell her, Jack. I can't do it.
What happened? You still have the wedding fund, don't you?
We have it. Only now we call it "the beach house."
I can't believe you spent my wedding fund on the beach house.
We're sorry. We assumed...
...if you got married after you turned 30 you'd pay for it yourself.
You bought the beach house when I was 23.
Which means you had seven years of beach fun...
...and you can't put a price on that, sweetie.
We really do feel bad about this though.
We started saving again when you dated Richard.
But then that went to hell, so we redid the kitchen.
What about when I started dating Chandler?
It was Chandler. We didn't think he'd ever propose.
Clearly I did not start drinking enough at the start of the meal. Heh.
I can't believe there is no money for my wedding.
We might still have some if your father hadn't thought...
...to sell ice over the Internet.
It seemed like such a simple idea. - Stupid, Jack. The word is stupid.
All right, enough. I don't want to hear about it anymore.
Good luck, Chandler.
Okay, now I'm going to...
...touch you.
Oh, that's soft.
I can't believe this. Do you think your parents could help pay for it?
I don't know.
My mother spent most of her money on her fourth wedding.
She's saving the rest for her divorce.
And any extra cash my father has, he saves for his yearly trips to...
...Dollywood.
What happened at dinner?
My parents spent the money for our wedding.
My God, what did you order?
Wait, there's no money? Well, this is terrible.
You guys are gonna have to get married in, like, a rec center.
Honey, it's gonna be okay. - No, it's not gonna be okay. It sucks.
No swing band, no lilies. - No, you know what? It's gonna be okay.
I mean, you don't need to have this...
...rustic Italian feast, you know?
And you don't need this custom-made empire-waisted, duchess satin gown.
You can wear off-the-rack.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 一小时后我来接他
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much. I'll be back to pick him up in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你父母听到你…
sense_groups.english: So, Chandler, your parents must've been thrilled...

sense_groups.chinese: 订婚一定很开心
sense_groups.english: ...when you told them you were engaged.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是啊 我应该打电话给他们
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I should probably call them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得我们刚订婚的时候
sense_groups.english: I remember when we first got engaged.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没听过这个故事 - 爸 你不必…
sense_groups.english: I don't think I've heard that story. - Dad, you don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 我让茱蒂怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'd gotten Judy pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不知道怎么发生的
sense_groups.english: I still don't know how.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道怎么发生的？ 你的狗 以为我的避孕器是磨牙玩具
sense_groups.english: You don't know how? Your dog thought my diaphragm was a chew toy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真感人的故事
sense_groups.english: What a sweet story.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你不是在五年级的 万圣节派对听到这故事
sense_groups.english: At least you're not hearing it at your 5th grade Halloween party.

sense_groups.chinese: 是他们要听吓人的故事
sense_groups.english: What? They wanted a scary story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们对婚礼计划很兴奋
sense_groups.english: Anyway, we're really excited about our wedding plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 很快我们就要从婚礼基金 提一大笔钱
sense_groups.english: Pretty soon we'll be making a big withdrawal from the Monica wedding fund.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 杰克 你告诉她 我做不到
sense_groups.english: What? - You tell her, Jack. I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的婚礼基金还在 对吧？
sense_groups.english: What happened? You still have the wedding fund, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有 只是现在叫做 "海滩别墅"
sense_groups.english: We have it. Only now we call it "the beach house."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 你把我的婚礼基金 花在海滩别墅？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you spent my wedding fund on the beach house.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我们以为…
sense_groups.english: We're sorry. We assumed...

sense_groups.chinese: 等你30岁后 你会自己付钱
sense_groups.english: ...if you got married after you turned 30 you'd pay for it yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们买海滩别墅时我才23岁
sense_groups.english: You bought the beach house when I was 23.

sense_groups.chinese: 那也表示 你在海边享受了7年好时光…
sense_groups.english: Which means you had seven years of beach fun...

sense_groups.chinese: 那可是无价的
sense_groups.english: ...and you can't put a price on that, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们觉得很抱歉
sense_groups.english: We really do feel bad about this though.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和理查交往时 我们又开始存钱
sense_groups.english: We started saving again when you dated Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果你们闹翻了 我们重新装潢了厨房
sense_groups.english: But then that went to hell, so we redid the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 那当我开始和钱德约会呢？
sense_groups.english: What about when I started dating Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们以为钱德不会求婚
sense_groups.english: It was Chandler. We didn't think he'd ever propose.

sense_groups.chinese: 很显然开始吃饭时 我酒喝得不够
sense_groups.english: Clearly I did not start drinking enough at the start of the meal. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信竟然没有钱让我结婚
sense_groups.english: I can't believe there is no money for my wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许还有 如果你爸没有…
sense_groups.english: We might still have some if your father hadn't thought...

sense_groups.chinese: 在网上卖冰的话
sense_groups.english: ...to sell ice over the Internet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个主意看来很简单 - 只能用"笨"来形容
sense_groups.english: It seemed like such a simple idea. - Stupid, Jack. The word is stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再细听了
sense_groups.english: All right, enough. I don't want to hear about it anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 钱德
sense_groups.english: Good luck, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我要…
sense_groups.english: Okay, now I'm going to...

sense_groups.chinese: 摸你了
sense_groups.english: ...touch you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好软
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's soft.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 你认为你的父母可能帮忙付吗？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. Do you think your parents could help pay for it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈大部分的钱 都花在她第四次的婚礼了
sense_groups.english: My mother spent most of her money on her fourth wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 剩下的钱她离婚要用
sense_groups.english: She's saving the rest for her divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我爸存的钱用在…
sense_groups.english: And any extra cash my father has, he saves for his yearly trips to...

sense_groups.chinese: 到桃利屋的年度旅行
sense_groups.english: ...Dollywood.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的晚餐发生什么事了？
sense_groups.english: What happened at dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 我父母把婚礼基金花掉了
sense_groups.english: My parents spent the money for our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你点了什么菜？
sense_groups.english: My God, what did you order?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 没有婚礼基金了？ 太惨了
sense_groups.english: Wait, there's no money? Well, this is terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们必须在活动中心结婚了
sense_groups.english: You guys are gonna have to get married in, like, a rec center.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 没关系的 - 不 有关系
sense_groups.english: Honey, it's gonna be okay. - No, it's not gonna be okay. It sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有乐团 没有百合 - 那很好啊
sense_groups.english: No swing band, no lilies. - No, you know what? It's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要有这种…
sense_groups.english: I mean, you don't need to have this...

sense_groups.chinese: 意大利野宴
sense_groups.english: ...rustic Italian feast, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要这种订做的帝国式腰线 公主型丝缎礼服
sense_groups.english: And you don't need this custom-made empire-waisted, duchess satin gown.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以买现成的礼服
sense_groups.english: You can wear off-the-rack.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的不会有问题的
sense_groups.english: Look, it really is gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 重要的是我们彼此相爱 要结婚了
sense_groups.english: The important thing is that we love each other and we're gonna get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知不知道"现成的"是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: Do you even understand what "off-the-rack" means?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不自己付钱呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just pay for it yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么付？ 我没钱
sense_groups.english: How? I don't have any money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有 - 多少？
sense_groups.english: Well, I have some. - How much?

sense_groups.chinese: 将近有…
sense_groups.english: Well, close to...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你开玩笑？ - 多少？
sense_groups.english: Whoa! Are you kidding me? - What? How much?

sense_groups.chinese: 够办婚礼计划A - 真的？
sense_groups.english: It's enough for wedding scenario A. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好 努力存钱的人
sense_groups.english: How great are you, you little saver? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 正是理想婚礼的预算
sense_groups.english: The amount you have is exactly the budget of my dream wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 你们真是天造地设的一对
sense_groups.english: Oh, you guys are so made for each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是要把所有的钱 都花在婚礼上吧？
sense_groups.english: Well, you're not suggesting we spend all of the money on the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我花了六年存到这些…
sense_groups.english: Look, Mon, I've been saving this money for six years...

sense_groups.chinese: 有些是将来要用的 不是都花在一场派对上的
sense_groups.english: ...and I kind of have some of it earmarked for the future, not just for a party.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 钱德先生 你好啊
sense_groups.english: Wow. Hello, Mr. Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 这是我们一生中 最重要的一天
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, this is the most special day of our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 宝贝 但我不要把钱都花在一场派对上
sense_groups.english: I realize that, honey, but I'm not gonna spend all the money on one party.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Honey, um, I love you. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你再叫我们的婚礼 一场派对…
sense_groups.english: But, um, if you call our wedding a party one more time...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能不会被邀请
sense_groups.english: ...you may not get invited.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱可以再赚 但我们只结婚一次
sense_groups.english: We can always earn more money, okay? But we're only gonna get married once.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 但我非常坚决 我的答案是不
sense_groups.english: Look, I understand, but I have to put my foot down, okay? The answer is no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很坚决？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna have to put your foot down?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我是
sense_groups.english: Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 有钱和有一只坚定的手
sense_groups.english: Wow. Money and a firm hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运 钱德
sense_groups.english: Good luck, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach. - Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 有没有闻到烟味？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, do you smell smoke?

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了 烟 烟囱 扫烟囱的人 很好笑
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. I get it. Smoke, chimney, chimney sweep. Very funny. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 我说真的 你没闻到？
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, I'm serious. You don't smell it?

sense_groups.chinese: 有东西着火了
sense_groups.english: Something's on fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没闻到什么
sense_groups.english: No, I don't smell anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？ 可能是你熊熊的欲火
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? It's probably just your burning loins.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在讲什么？ - 没什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, what are you guys talking about? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 讨厌 咖啡冷了
sense_groups.english: Mm, damn, this coffee's cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 可以在你身上加温一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, do you mind if I heat this up on your loins?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你竟然告诉他…
sense_groups.english: You know, I cannot believe you told him. Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你是在我们分手后买了那本书
sense_groups.english: So I guess you bought that book after we broke up, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 因为第一本 在我们交往时被翻烂了
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh, I did, because I wore out my first copy when I was with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交往时 我看了一大堆色情杂志
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, when we were going out, I read tons of porno magazines.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: 'Sup?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你怎么可以 那样对待一位老先生？
sense_groups.english: Ross, how could you do that to an old man?

sense_groups.chinese: 失陪了 小姐们
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, ladies.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么啊？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的按摩客人 亚瑟
sense_groups.english: My massage client, Arthur.

sense_groups.chinese: 他女儿说替我工作的那个人…
sense_groups.english: His daughter called and said some guy that worked for me...

sense_groups.chinese: 今天下午替他做了很奇怪的按摩
sense_groups.english: ...gave him a really weird massage this afternoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了很专业的按摩
sense_groups.english: I gave him an extremely professional massage.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说你用木汤匙戳他
sense_groups.english: He said you poked at him with wooden spoons.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不是传统的按摩
sense_groups.english: Okay, so it wasn't a traditional massage.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我有用筷子替他刺激穴道…
sense_groups.english: But I did give him acupressure with a pair of chopsticks...

sense_groups.chinese: 并温和地用拖把去角质
sense_groups.english: ...and I gently exfoliated him with a mop.

sense_groups.chinese: 他再也不会来了 你害我一星期少进帐八十元
sense_groups.english: Well, he's never coming back, okay? You just cost me $80 a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的错 你没更改他约的时间
sense_groups.english: You know what? This is your fault. You didn't move his appointment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的错？ 你不必替他按摩的
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's my fault? You didn't have to massage him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以请他回去的
sense_groups.english: You could've sent him away.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必用玩具推土机 在他背上滚来滚去
sense_groups.english: You could've not rolled Tonka trucks up and down his back.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他很喜欢
sense_groups.english: He said he liked that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对 你对 对不起
sense_groups.english: You're right, you're right. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你干嘛按摩一位老先生？
sense_groups.english: Dude, what are you massaging an old man for?

sense_groups.chinese: 他女儿很辣 - 懂了
sense_groups.english: His daughter was hot. - Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着…
sense_groups.english: Listen, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想过了
sense_groups.english: ...I've been thinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 要你把所有的钱 花在婚礼上很不公平
sense_groups.english: And it's not fair for me to ask you to spend all your money on our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很辛苦才赚来的
sense_groups.english: I mean, you work really hard for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 是你赚来的
sense_groups.english: Well. - Well, you work for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想过了
sense_groups.english: Look, I thought about it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我们应该把 所有的钱花在婚礼的
sense_groups.english: And I'm sorry. I think we should spend all of the money on the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 对 我很坚决
sense_groups.english: You do? - Yeah, I'm putting my foot down.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我求婚时 我告诉你…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, look, when I proposed, I told you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会尽力让你快乐
sense_groups.english: ...that I would do anything to make you happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果办一场完美婚礼 能让你开心…
sense_groups.english: And if having the perfect wedding makes you happy...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们就这么做
sense_groups.english: ...then that's what we're gonna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对我真好
sense_groups.english: You are so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 等等
sense_groups.english: Oh, but wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 那未来怎么办呢？
sense_groups.english: What about our...? What about the future and stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 管他呢
sense_groups.english: Ah, forget about the future and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只生两个就好
sense_groups.english: So we only have two kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 选一个我们最喜欢的 让他去念大学
sense_groups.english: You know, we'll pick our favorite and that one will get to go to college.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想过这些？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Have you thought about that? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你本来要几个孩子？
sense_groups.english: How many kids were we gonna have?

sense_groups.chinese: 四个 一个男孩 一对双胞胎女儿 再一个男孩
sense_groups.english: Uh, four. A boy, twin girls and another boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还想过什么？
sense_groups.english: What else did you think about?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有我们要住的地方
sense_groups.english: Well, heh, stuff like where we'd live, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是在市中心外的小房子…
sense_groups.english: Like a small place outside the city...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的小孩可以学骑单车
sense_groups.english: ...where our kids could learn to ride their bikes and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以养只猫咪 脖子上挂着铃铛…
sense_groups.english: We could have a cat that had a bell on its collar...

sense_groups.chinese: 每次它跑出小门时 都听得见铃声
sense_groups.english: ...and we could hear it every time it ran through the little kitty door.

sense_groups.chinese: 在车库上盖个房间 让乔伊终老
sense_groups.english: Of course we'd have an apartment over the garage where Joey could grow old.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要一个盛大的婚礼
sense_groups.english: I don't want a big, fancy wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要的 - 不
sense_groups.english: Sure you do. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你刚刚说的每一样东西 我要一个婚姻
sense_groups.english: I want everything that you've just said. I want a marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You sure? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好爱你 - 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you so much. - I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚说到将来的时候 你说猫咪
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen, when you were talking about our future, you said cat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你指的是狗 对不对？
sense_groups.english: But you meant dog, right? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好
sense_groups.english: Ha, yeah, totally. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 柔达
sense_groups.english: Hello, Zelda.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又是谁呢？ - 传道者
sense_groups.english: Who are you supposed to be? - The vicar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道传道者是什么吗？ - 像是个守门员 对不对？
sense_groups.english: Do you even know what a vicar is? - Like a goalie, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我是说真的 够了
sense_groups.english: Look, Joey, it's enough, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你老是开这些笨玩笑 还有无聊的暗讽…
sense_groups.english: You keep making these stupid jokes and these sleazy innuendoes...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是不好笑
sense_groups.english: ...and it's just not funny anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 瑞秋 对不起
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm sorry. Rach, I'm sorry. Okay? I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我可以在谷仓里 粗暴地对待你来补偿你
sense_groups.english: Maybe I could make it up to you by taking you roughly in the barn.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 够了 你想做吗？ 我们做吧
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what? That's it. You want to do it? Let's do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我想和你做
sense_groups.english: That's right. I want to do it with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想抗拒 但你说的每一句话 都深深打动了我
sense_groups.english: Been trying to fight it, but you just said all the right things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, I did?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我想得到你的身体想了好久
sense_groups.english: Yeah, oh, I've been waiting so long to get on that body.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的身体？ - 对 没错
sense_groups.english: This body? - Yeah, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 放马过来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, Joey, sex me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听起来开始像 第七章里的屠夫妻子
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're starting to sound like the butcher's wife there in chapter seven.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 不要让我等 脱掉你的衣服
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, now. Don't keep me waiting. Get those clothes off.

sense_groups.chinese: 但留着你的头盔 因为 这会是一场狂风暴雨
sense_groups.english: But I would keep that helmet on, because you're in for a rough ride.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要 我好害怕
sense_groups.english: I don't want to. I'm scared.

questions.name: S07E03
questions.en:
Hey, guys. - Hey.
So, what do you think?
About what? - What?
