sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很难过 好吧
sense_groups.english: Break my heart. Oh, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要当能做出全世界 最好吃饼干的妈妈
sense_groups.english: I'll be the mom who makes the world's best chocolate chip cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的孩子会是胖子 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Our kids are gonna be fat, aren't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Ahoy! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 驾帆船出海还好玩吧？ - 很棒 我闻始喜欢驾驶帆船了
sense_groups.english: How's the boat? - I'm getting into this sailing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次你终于出海了？
sense_groups.english: You finally took it out of the marina?

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要那么做？
sense_groups.english: Why would I do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 三个彪形大汉使出吃奶的力气 才把它漂在海上
sense_groups.english: It took three guys to get the thing in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不想开它出海 你在船上都做些什么呢？
sense_groups.english: If you don't sail it, what do you do on it?

sense_groups.chinese: 光是坐在那里就很舒服了…
sense_groups.english: It's a great place to just kind of sit...

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都不做 喝啤酒 吃洋芋片
sense_groups.english: ...hang around, drink a few beers, eat some chips.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你终于找到 能那么做的地方了
sense_groups.english: It's good that you finally have a place to do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果你要的话 我可以教你驾驶帆船
sense_groups.english: Joey, I could teach you to sail if you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会驾驶帆船？ - 对啊 我这辈子都在驾船
sense_groups.english: You could? - Yeah, I've been sailing my whole life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我十五岁时 我爸送我一艘帆船
sense_groups.english: When I was 15, my dad bought me my own boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有一艘帆船？ - 怎么…他想要安慰我
sense_groups.english: Your own boat? - He was trying to cheer me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小马生病了
sense_groups.english: My pony was sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我在想什么吗？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You know what I was thinking? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是想这么做
sense_groups.english: Nothing, I just like to go like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 今晚你要做什么？ - 你有课吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, what are you doing tonight? - Why, do you have a lecture?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有啊 怎么了？ - 那么我没事 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No, why? - Then, free as a bird. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸想约你去打回力球
sense_groups.english: Uh, my dad wants to know if you want to play racquetball.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 爸一定很喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's great! Dad must like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他从来不会约人去打回力球 - 他没有约你
sense_groups.english: He doesn't ask just anyone to play. - He didn't really ask for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要约"小钱" 我猜他应该是指你
sense_groups.english: He asked for "Chauncey." I assumed he meant you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你纠正他了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you correct him?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我觉得那样子比较好玩
sense_groups.english: No, I thought it would be more fun this way.

sense_groups.chinese: 太酷了 或许你们每星期都该这么做
sense_groups.english: Maybe this is something you could do this every week.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是你也可以坐在走廊上…
sense_groups.english: Or you could sit on the porch...

sense_groups.chinese: 确定垃圾桶不会被偷走
sense_groups.english: ...and make sure no one steals the trashcans.

sense_groups.chinese: 他每星期都会这么做
sense_groups.english: He does that every week too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得让他赢 他最讨厌输了
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, you have to let him win. He hates to lose.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 或许我该用左手打球
sense_groups.english: Oh, no problem. Maybe I'll play with my left hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是左撇子吗？
sense_groups.english: You're not a lefty?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人认识我吗？
sense_groups.english: Does anybody know me?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？菲比
sense_groups.english: What's wrong, Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我到以前的公寓拿饼干食谱…
sense_groups.english: I just went to my old apartment to get you the cookie recipe...

sense_groups.chinese: 那场愚蠢的大火把它烧了
sense_groups.english: ...and that stupid fire burned it up!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你为什么没有影印一份 把它放在防火的盒子里…
sense_groups.english: No! Why didn't you make a copy and keep it in a fireproof box...

sense_groups.chinese: 将盒子放在离起火点 至少一百码的地方？
sense_groups.english: ...and keep it at least 100 yards away from the original?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我是个凡人
sense_groups.english: Because I'm normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我奶奶留给我的传奇
sense_groups.english: That was the one legacy my grandmother left me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你要它当你的订婚礼物
sense_groups.english: And I know you wanted it as an engagement present.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得送你们订婚礼物？
sense_groups.english: We have to get you an engagement present?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 菲比
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人送我订婚礼物
sense_groups.english: No one got me an engagement present.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我没有食谱 但这个给你
sense_groups.english: Okay, here. I don't have the recipe, but here.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你们健康快乐
sense_groups.english: I wish you health and happiness.

sense_groups.chinese: 一块放了很久的饼干？
sense_groups.english: An old cookie?

sense_groups.chinese: 不列出礼物清单 就是会发生这种事
sense_groups.english: See, this is what happens when you don't register for gifts.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了一些饼干 把它们冷冻起来 这是最后一块
sense_groups.english: I made a batch and I froze it. And this is the only one left.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能收下它 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: We can't accept this. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为它很恶心
sense_groups.english: Because it's gross.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下 我想我可以 利用这块饼干猜出整个食谱
sense_groups.english: No, wait. I think I can figure out the recipe from this cookie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在工作时常常这么做
sense_groups.english: I do this at work all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 我想我可以做到
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, I think I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗斯 我们欠你一份礼物
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, we owe you a present.

sense_groups.chinese: 是两份 我订过两次婚
sense_groups.english: Two! I've been engaged twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 快来看看这捆小丑
sense_groups.english: Look at this clown.

sense_groups.chinese: 他以为整条河都是他的
sense_groups.english: Because he's got a bigger boat he thinks he can take up the whole river.

sense_groups.chinese: 别档路 大混蛋
sense_groups.english: Get out of the way, jackass!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会把自己的船 命名为"海岸防卫队"？
sense_groups.english: Who names their boat Coast Guard, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们就是海岸防卫队 - 他们在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: That is the Coast Guard. - What are they doing out here?

sense_groups.chinese: 海岸在那边
sense_groups.english: The coast is all the way over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 别管那些船
sense_groups.english: Joey, just ignore the boats.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的课还没有上完 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: We're not finished with our lesson. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要帮你复习一下基本要点 准备好了吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go over the basic points one more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 别麻烦了 瑞秋 我已经懂了
sense_groups.english: Come on, Rach. Not again. I got it, okay? Let's start sailing!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始驾驶吧 我想把船开到那一船小妞旁边去
sense_groups.english: I want to go over there where that boatload of girls is. Yeah, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, is that what you wanna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要跟那些小妞鬼混？
sense_groups.english: You want to give a shout out to the old hot chicas?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 来吧 水手乔伊
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's do that, Sailor Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 快问快答 这叫什么？
sense_groups.english: Quick question, though: What's this called?

sense_groups.chinese: 船上的绳子？ - 错了
sense_groups.english: Uh, boat rope? - Wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么把主帆扛上去？ - 额
sense_groups.english: How do you get the mainsail up? - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 摸一下就行了？
sense_groups.english: Rub it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 如果我说我们要转向了 你该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: No. What do you do if I say we're coming about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说 "随你转？ "
sense_groups.english: I'd say, "Come again?" Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 这一题我会
sense_groups.english: No, no, I know this one. I know this one. Uh, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 时间到 现在你死了
sense_groups.english: Time's up. Now you're dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也聋了
sense_groups.english: And deaf!

sense_groups.chinese: 你继续开玩笑吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, you go on and make your little jokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不知道自己在海上做什么…
sense_groups.english: If you don't know what you're doing at sea...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就会在海上没命 你听懂了吗？ 水手
sense_groups.english: ...you will die at sea. Am I getting through to you, sailor?

sense_groups.chinese: 懂了 - 别只是说你懂了
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Don't just say yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是游戏 你很可能会受伤
sense_groups.english: This isn't a game. You could get hurt out here!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要注意听我说话呢 还是想死呢？
sense_groups.english: So do you want to pay attention, or do you want to die?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想从船上打电话给钱德
sense_groups.english: I want to make a ship-to-shore call to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃到了肉豆壳 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, I definitely taste nutmeg. - You do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没吃到吗？ 那就是…
sense_groups.english: You don't? Heh. Well, that's the difference...

sense_groups.chinese: 专业人员跟外行人的不同
sense_groups.english: ...between a professional and a layman.

sense_groups.chinese: 专业人员很傲慢
sense_groups.english: That and arrogance.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 驾驶帆船出海好玩吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. How was sailing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想谈这件事
sense_groups.english: I don't want to talk about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们至少可以留一块饼干给我 - 不
sense_groups.english: You could've saved me a whole cookie. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 女人太无情了
sense_groups.english: Women are mean!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe that.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我奶奶的传奇 只剩下…
sense_groups.english: Now the only thing left of my grandmother's legacy is...

sense_groups.chinese: 这块碎屑
sense_groups.english: ...this crumb.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你们白头偕老 婚姻美满
sense_groups.english: I wish you a long and happy marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: Well, I had a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是小钱…
sense_groups.english: Um, Chauncey on the other hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我来说吧
sense_groups.english: I will tell the story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们相处甚欢 我放手让他赢球 他喜欢我…
sense_groups.english: It was going great. I let him win, we were bonding...

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至说我可以叫他爸爸
sense_groups.english: ...he even said I could call him Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要你不能叫他什么？
sense_groups.english: And what did he ask you not to call him?

sense_groups.chinese: 爹地
sense_groups.english: "Daddy."

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 事情是这样的
sense_groups.english: Look, here's the story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们打完球 决定去…
sense_groups.english: We had just finished playing racquetball...

sense_groups.chinese: 做三温暖
sense_groups.english: ...and we were gonna take a steam.

sense_groups.chinese: 我走进蒸气室…
sense_groups.english: I walk into the steam room...

sense_groups.chinese: 里面雾气弥漫
sense_groups.english: ...and it's really steamy.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是我拿下眼镜 悲剧发生了
sense_groups.english: So I take off my glasses, and that's when it happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 这边 - 坐吧 孩子
sense_groups.english: Over here. - Have a seat, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 钱德 我不敢相信 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Chandler! I can't believe it. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在我爸大腿上跳艳舞
sense_groups.english: You gave my father a lap dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们为什么 要把那里弄得雾气弥漫的？
sense_groups.english: Why do they put so much steam in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 不那么做的话 那里只能叫做"房间"
sense_groups.english: Because otherwise they'd have to call it the "room" room.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ 为什么会发生那种事？
sense_groups.english: Why, okay? Why? Why did that have to happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 那没有什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's not that big a deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 那没有什么大不了的？
sense_groups.english: Not that big a deal? There...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有种异样的触感
sense_groups.english: There was touching of things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你想跟我爸打好关系…
sense_groups.english: I know you wanted to bond with my dad...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你一定要从他那个地方开始吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but did you have to bond to that part?

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信爸不会在乎的 或许他会觉得很好笑
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm sure Dad doesn't care. He probably thought this was funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会把这个故事挂在嘴边好几年
sense_groups.english: He'll be telling this story for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是不希望 他把这个故事挂在嘴边好几年
sense_groups.english: I don't want him to tell this story for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 他会那么做的
sense_groups.english: Oh, but he will.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还是会告诉大家 摩妮卡试图逃出减肥营的故事
sense_groups.english: He still tells the story about how Monica tried to escape from fat camp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有逃跑
sense_groups.english: I wasn't escaping.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你怎么会 被卡在铁丝网上的？
sense_groups.english: Then how'd you get caught in the barbed wire?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要救一只松鼠
sense_groups.english: I was trying to help out a squirrel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想吃掉他
sense_groups.english: You were trying to eat it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是你爸打电话来 告诉你这件事…
sense_groups.english: If that is your father calling to tell this story...

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我们的婚礼取消了
sense_groups.english: ...then the marriage is off!

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 喂？
sense_groups.english: Come on. Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你打错电话了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, you have the wrong number.

sense_groups.chinese: 我待会回你电话 爸 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll call you later, Dad. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我要去见你爸了 - 哇哦
sense_groups.english: All right, I'm off to see your dad. - Oh, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会穿太多了吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you a little overdressed?

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好确定 这次他会付你小费
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and you better make sure he tips you this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说服他 别再提那件事…
sense_groups.english: I figured I would try to convince him not to tell the story anymore...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想最好的办法 就是跟他面对面谈一谈
sense_groups.english: ...and I figured the best way to do that was face to face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的"面对面" 指的不是他的大腿
sense_groups.english: And by "face," I don't mean his lap.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的"面对面" 指的不是我的屁股
sense_groups.english: And by "face," I don't mean my ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要送摩妮卡跟钱德订婚礼物？
sense_groups.english: Are you getting Monica and Chandler an engagement present?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 他们没有送我们礼物
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You know, they didn't get us anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Well, hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们什么时候要再出航？伙伴
sense_groups.english: So when are we getting back out on the water, matey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道水手是怎么说的 但我死都不要
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, I don't know the boat way to say this, but, never.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为你在船上很凶
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because you're mean on the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想教会你
sense_groups.english: Wha...? I was just trying to teach you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确学会了教训 那就是瑞秋很凶
sense_groups.english: Well, lesson learned. Rachel is mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Yep, yep, yep, yep, yep, yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还记得她驾驶她爸的船 带我出海
sense_groups.english: I remember when she took me out on her dad's boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 她完全不让我插手
sense_groups.english: She wouldn't let me help out at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我要你帮我 但你连动都动不了…
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, I wanted you to help. But you couldn't move your arms...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你穿了三件救生衣
sense_groups.english: ...because you were wearing three life jackets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得敬畏大海
sense_groups.english: You have to respect the sea.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果你觉得我很凶 对不起
sense_groups.english: Look, Joey, I'm sorry if you thought that was mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我告诉你 我一点都不凶
sense_groups.english: But I tell you something, that was not mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸才凶 以前在船上 他总会对我大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: My father is mean. He used to yell at me all the time on the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很可怕 我是个很棒的老师
sense_groups.english: It was horrible. I was being a really good teacher.

sense_groups.chinese: 好老师会说 "把啤酒放下 猪头"？
sense_groups.english: Does a good teacher say, "Put down the beer, pinhead!"

sense_groups.chinese: 好学生会在上第一堂课时 就喝掉七罐啤酒？
sense_groups.english: Does a good student drink 7 beers during his first lesson?

sense_groups.chinese: 是六罐半
sense_groups.english: Six and a half.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把最后一罐从我手里 敲掉 还记得吗？
sense_groups.english: You knocked that last one out of my hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望你被船桁打中
sense_groups.english: I didn't want you to get hit by the boom.

sense_groups.chinese: 它的确打中我了
sense_groups.english: Well, it hit me anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我能喝完最后一罐啤酒 或许不会那么痛
sense_groups.english: It would have hurt a lot less if I had finished that last beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我会试着小声点 不再对你大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I will try to tone it down and, uh, stop yelling.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会再使唤我？ - 我不会再使唤你
sense_groups.english: You won't boss me around? - I won't boss you around.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会对我很好？ - 我对你很好
sense_groups.english: And you'll be nice? - I'll be nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会脱掉上衣？ - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: And you'll be topless? - And I... Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你希望我学会吗？
sense_groups.english: You want me to learn?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是二十二号
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's batch 22.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许它们跟你奶奶的饼干味道很像
sense_groups.english: Maybe these'll taste like your grandmother's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放了一些橘子皮 没有放肉豆壳
sense_groups.english: This has a bit of orange peel, but no nutmeg.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来试吃吧 - 额
sense_groups.english: Mm. Let's give it a shot. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从九年级后 我再也没做过这么多饼干
sense_groups.english: I have not made so many cookies since 9th grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为了义卖会做那么多饼干吗？ - 不 那是我星期五晚上要吃的
sense_groups.english: What was that for, a bake sale? - No, just a Friday night.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些饼干真的很好吃
sense_groups.english: Mm. These are pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但没有十七号好吃 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but not as good as batch 17. - Mm-mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 十七号是哪一块？
sense_groups.english: Which one was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你几乎快吐出来后 吃的那块饼干
sense_groups.english: The ones we had after you almost threw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 十七号很好吃
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, batch 17 was good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢十六号
sense_groups.english: I did not like batch 16.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吃的还有剩吗？ 我们可以好好研究一下那一些
sense_groups.english: Are there any more from the good batch? We could work off those.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我想十七号应该还剩一块
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, I think there's one from batch 17 left. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 十六号 这是十六号 别挡路
sense_groups.english: Batch 16. Sixteen, people, get out of the way!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 你表现得很好
sense_groups.english: Okay, Joey. Honey, you're doing really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你站到左舷去
sense_groups.english: I just need you to step to the portside.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得左舷是哪一边吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember how we talked about the portside?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. - Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 是左边 甜心 但没关系 那一题太难了
sense_groups.english: It's left, sweetie, but that's okay. That's a tough one.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不干脆说左边就好了呢？
sense_groups.english: Why not just say left?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 到左边去
sense_groups.english: Okay, go to the left.

sense_groups.chinese: 左边
sense_groups.english: Ahem, the left.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？ -坐在那边
sense_groups.english: Huh? - Just sit over there!

sense_groups.chinese: 看到没？ 你又在大吼大叫了
sense_groups.english: Okay! Okay! You're yelling again. See that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我很小声 语气充满了爱意 我没有大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no. Very quiet. Said with love, no yelling.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我已经坐在这里 我要在左舷喝一罐啤酒
sense_groups.english: Since I'm here, I'm gonna have a beer on the portside.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到我刚刚做了什么吗？
sense_groups.english: See what I did there? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 风有点大 麻烦你把船绳拉紧
sense_groups.english: We're luffing a little. Will you tighten up the Cunningham?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说了一堆我听不懂的话
sense_groups.english: Whoa, you just said a bunch of stuff I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 别这样 我刚刚才教过你
sense_groups.english: Joey, come on! We just went over this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你教我的时候 有只乌嘴巴里衔着鱼飞过去
sense_groups.english: Oh, when we did that was when that bird was overhead with the fish in his mouth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到了吗？那真的很恶心 - 没有 我没有看到鸟或鱼
sense_groups.english: Did you see it? It was gross. - No! I did not see the bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 也没看到形状像泰森的保丽龙
sense_groups.english: I did not see the fish! I did not see the piece of Styrofoam shaped like Mike Tyson!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有看到 因为我忙着教你驾驶帆船
sense_groups.english: I did not, because I was trying to teach you how to sail a boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: Which obviously is an impossible thing to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 你在大吼大叫 而且你没有脱掉上衣
sense_groups.english: That's it! You're yelling, and I don't see you taking your top off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃了
sense_groups.english: I quit!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思？你不能放弃 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? You can't quit. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没有学会 我不准你那么做 葛林家的人不会放弃
sense_groups.english: Because you're not finished! I won't have it. Greens do not quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林家的人？
sense_groups.english: Greens?

sense_groups.chinese: 我姓崔比亚尼 崔比亚尼家的人会放弃
sense_groups.english: I'm a Tribbiani. Tribbianis quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚我说 "葛林家的人不会放弃"对吧？
sense_groups.english: Did I...? I just said, "Greens don't quit," didn't I?

sense_groups.chinese: 我到底说了没有？ - 对 你还在对我大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: Did I say, "Greens don't quit"? - Yes! And you're still yelling at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有对你大吼大叫 我是对你身边的空气大吼大叫
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not yelling at you. I'm just yelling near you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 乔伊 我就跟我爸一样
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Joey. Oh, I'm my father.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这真的太可怕了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. This is horrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很努力不要跟我妈一样 却没有提防到这一点
sense_groups.english: I've been trying so hard not to be my mother, I did not see this coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Ugh, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 我只希望你能学会驾驶帆船
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I'm so sorry. I just wanted you to learn.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 嘿 我…
sense_groups.english: Ugh. - Hey, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确学会了
sense_groups.english: I did learn.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 没错 来吧
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 没关系的
sense_groups.english: No. - Yeah. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道主帆是什么
sense_groups.english: I know what a mainsail is. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道船桁过来时 一定要低头
sense_groups.english: I know to duck when the boom comes across.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道左舷是右边 - 左边才对
sense_groups.english: I know port is right. - Left.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们试着研究出她的食谱…
sense_groups.english: You know, I bet it would make my grandma happy...

sense_groups.chinese: 这会让我奶奶觉得开心
sense_groups.english: ...to know that we're trying to figure out her recipe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说她正抬头看着我们 对我们微笑
sense_groups.english: I bet she's looking up at us and smiling right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 抬头看我们？
sense_groups.english: Looking up?

sense_groups.chinese: 她对我真的很好 但现在她一定在地狱里
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, no, she was really nice to me but she's in hell for sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经努力过了
sense_groups.english: Well, I've tried everything. I give up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我放弃 我没办法成为做出全世界 最好吃饼干的妈妈
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna be the mom who makes the world's best cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我会做最好吃的 花椰菜配油封鸭
sense_groups.english: I do make the best duck confit with broccoli raab.

sense_groups.chinese: 小孩子很喜欢吃那道菜吧？
sense_groups.english: Kids love that, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 难道你家的亲戚 都没有食谱吗？
sense_groups.english: Aw, Pheeb, isn't there any relative that would have the recipe?

sense_groups.chinese: 你姐姐呢？
sense_groups.english: What about your sister?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我跟自己发誓…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I made a promise to myself that the next time...

sense_groups.chinese: 除非我死掉 不然我不会跟乌苏拉说话
sense_groups.english: ...I would talk to Ursula is over my dead body.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一天将会是 2032年10月15日
sense_groups.english: And that's not happening until October 15, 2032.

sense_groups.chinese: 那天你会死掉？
sense_groups.english: That's the day you're gonna die? See.

sense_groups.chinese: 那天我要去玩推圆盘游戏
sense_groups.english: Darn it, I've got shuffleboard that day. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你少做梦了
sense_groups.english: That's what you think.

sense_groups.chinese: 你奶奶的朋友呢？ 他们没有食谱吗？
sense_groups.english: What about friends of your grandmother? Would they have the recipe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在法国的亲戚 可能有人知道
sense_groups.english: You know, I may have relatives in France who would know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我奶奶说食谱是她奶奶
sense_groups.english: My grandmother said she got the recipe...

sense_groups.chinese: "鸟巢"传给她的
sense_groups.english: ...from her grandmother, "Nestley Toulouse."

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: What was her name?

sense_groups.chinese: 鸟巢
sense_groups.english: Nestley Toulouse.

sense_groups.chinese: 雀巢？
sense_groups.english: Nestley Toulouse?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 美国人就是 没办法说好法文
sense_groups.english: You Americans always butcher the French language.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这是你奶奶的食谱吗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, is this the recipe?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我花了两天时间研究那份食谱
sense_groups.english: I cannot believe that I spent the last two days trying to figure out that recipe.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果它一直在这里
sense_groups.english: It was in my cupboard the whole time!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 就是这样的事情…
sense_groups.english: I know! You see, it is stuff like this...

sense_groups.chinese: 害得你得在地狱里受苦
sense_groups.english: ...which is why you're burning in hell!

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你懂了
sense_groups.english: So you understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你可以不把那件事说出去 我会觉得舒服一点
sense_groups.english: I'd feel more comfortable if you didn't tell people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很不好意思
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm a little embarrassed about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全了解
sense_groups.english: I understand completely. There's nothing more horrifying...

sense_groups.chinese: 最可怕的事莫过于 在丈人跟丈母娘面前丢脸
sense_groups.english: ...than embarrassing yourself in front of your in-laws.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我开始跟茱蒂交往时 根本就没有工作
sense_groups.english: As a matter of fact, when I started dating Judy, I was unemployed.

sense_groups.chinese: 她爸问我是干哪一行的
sense_groups.english: Her father asked me what I did for a living.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我是律师 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: I told him I was a lawyer. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们发现事实后你怎么办？ - 他们一直都没有发现
sense_groups.english: What'd you do when they found out? - They never did.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你看到我在帮他们做法律咨询 只要点头就行了
sense_groups.english: So if you ever see me giving them legal advice, just nod along.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以进去了吗？
sense_groups.english: Shall we?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜这里得穿泳装才能进来
sense_groups.english: So, I guess we wear swimsuits in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我得承认…
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey, I hate to admit it...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的航海方式 真的有趣多了
sense_groups.english: ...your way of sailing is a lot more fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 对…
sense_groups.english: Yep, yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你何不拉一下那条绳子？
sense_groups.english: Hey, why don't you give a pull on that rope?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有要出海
sense_groups.english: We're not sailing.

sense_groups.chinese: 拉一下 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Just pull on it. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 额
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Eh?

sense_groups.chinese: 三明治
sense_groups.english: Sandwiches!

sense_groups.chinese: 不然会是什么呢？ - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: What else? - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个给你
sense_groups.english: Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？ - 对不起
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Oops. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 别那样 好料的都掉在地上了
sense_groups.english: Don't hold it like that. You're letting all the good stuff fall out.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心 - 小心
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oops. - Careful!

sense_groups.chinese: 你浪费了好吃的腌燻牛肉
sense_groups.english: You're wasting good pastrami!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我就跟我爸一样
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm my dad!

questions.name: S07E04
questions.en:
We learned one thing, C.H.E.E.S.E
Cheerleaders and high explosives don't mix.
You can say that again, Mac.
I couldn't have done it alone. You're a genius.
Oh, yeah? Well, how come I can't get my VCR to stop blinking 12:00?
What did you guys think?
Hey, the phone. - I got it. I got it.
Hello.
Hold on. Joey, it's your mom. - It's Mommy.
Aw... - That's nice.
Ma, so what did you think?
Well...
...that was, um, okay.
It wasn't the best.
That was one of the worst things ever...
...and not just on TV.
What should we say? - The lighting was okay.
You got lighting last time. Lighting is mine.
I have costumes.
That means I'm stuck with
"So we were watching you in there, and you were sitting right here. Whoa."
What about you? - I don't know.
I can't lie to him again. Oh, no, I... No.
I'm just gonna press my breasts up against him.
And say nothing? - Uh-huh, yeah, that's right.
Wow, my folks really liked it.
What did you guys think?
It wasn't that good.
Do you think that your favorite animal says much about you?
You mean behind my back?
Oh, you'll never believe what happened to me today.
I am sitting in my office... - You guys!
Guess what my agent just said?
I'm in the middle of a story here.
Sorry, you finish.
I'm sitting in my office, and guess who walks in.
I'm gonna be on two TV shows.
That's great.
Joey. - You weren't finished?
Yeah, "Guess who walks into my office" is my story.
Ralph Lauren walked into my office.
Uh, if you're starting another story, at least let me finish mine.
It's the same story.
Uh, wow, it's really long.
Ralph just came in to tell me that he's so happy with my work...
...that he wants me to be the new merchandising manager for Polo retail.
Aw...
Still get a discount on wedding gowns? - Yeah.
I'm so happy for you.
These really are the days of our lives.
What? - Well, since you ask, ha, ha...
They want me back on Days of our Lives.
I get a big pay raise! - Oh, hey!
I'll be playing Drake Ramoray's twin brother, Stryker.
Ooh...
I get to hire my own assistant.
Well... I got a head rush from standing up too fast.
You were at this job four years?
That's right. - This is all very impressive, Hilda.
Um, I just have one last question for you, uh...
How did I do? Was this okay?
What? - I've never interviewed anyone.
I've never had anyone work for me.
When I was a kid we had a maid, but this isn't the same.
No, dear, it's not.
And I know that.
Well, thank you so much for coming in.
Nice to meet you. - Good meeting you.
All right.
I'm a total pro.
Hello. - Wow. Huh, um...
Hi, yes, I'm sorry. The models are down the hall.
I'm here about the assistant job.
Really?
Okay, well, then, all right. Well, just have a seat there.
Um, so what's...? What your name?
Tag Jones.
Uh-huh, go on.
That's it. That's my whole name.
That's your whole name. Of course.
Okay, let's just have a look-see here.
I haven't worked in an office before. I don't have much experience...
What are you talking about? You got three years painting houses...
...two whole summers at T.G.I. Friday's.
It's lame, I know.
But I'm a goal-oriented person, eager to learn...
Just hold on a second, please.
It's for Human Resources. Everybody has to. Would you stand up?
Ha, ha, no, no, no.
Hey. - Shh, shh, shh.
Anyway, I should go. - Okay. Bye.
Hey, sweetie. - Hi, sweetie.
What was with all the whispering?
I can't tell you. It's a secret.
Secret? Married people aren't supposed to have secrets.
We love and respect one another too much.
Aw...
But still, no, ha, ha.
We should tell each other everything. I don't have secrets from you.
Really? So tell me what happened to Ross, junior year at Disneyland.
No, I can't do that.
I'll tell you what Phoebe said.
Okay. - Okay.
So, ahem, Ross and I are going to Disneyland.
We stop at this restaurant for tacos.
When I say restaurant, I mean a guy, a hibachi, and the trunk of his car.
So Ross has about ten tacos.
Anyway, we're on Space Mountain and Ross starts to feel a little iffy.
Oh, my God. He threw up?
No, he visited a town a little south of throw up.
Oh, my God!
What was Phoebe's secret?
Um, Nancy Thompson, from Phoebe's old massage place, is getting fired.
Oh.
That's it? I gave up my Disneyland story for that?
Hm, that's right. You lose, sucker!
Please still marry me.
You have an assistant, right?
Did she call?
You told her I was sick, right? Always tell her I am sick.
I don't know. How do you decide who to hire?
I have it down to two people.
One has great references and a lot of experience.
And then, there's this guy. - What about him?
I love him.
He's so pretty, I want to cry.
I don't know what to do.
Come on, you know what to do. You hire the first one.
Don't hire assistants because they're cute. Do it because they're qualified.
Uh-huh.
I hear you. You make a lot of sense. Can I just say one more thing?
Look how pretty.
Let me see.
Oh, my God.
Oh. But, no.
No. You can't... You can't hire him because it's not professional.
Um, this is for me, yes?
Okay, you're right. I'll hire Hilda tomorrow.
Dumb, old, perfect-for-the-job Hilda.
Let me see.
Wo-ha-ow!
Don't show this to Monica.
And don't tell her about the "Wo-ha-ow!"
Ha, ha, hey, Joey. - Hey, Terry.
Nice to see you again. - Been a while.
Funny, these halls look smaller than they used to.
It's a different building.
So...
...Stryker Ramoray, huh?
When do I start? - How about right now?
Okay.
Here are the audition scenes.
I thought you were offering me the part.
Why?
I was Doctor Drake Ramoray, Stryker's twin brother.
Who looks more like me than me, right?
Everybody has to audition. Ha, ha.
You know, Terry, I don't really need to do this.
I got my own cable TV series...
...with a robot.
I'm sorry, Joey. That's the way it is.
Well...
...I guess you think you're pretty special, huh?
Sitting up here in your fancy, small-halled building...
...making stars jump through hoops for you, huh?
Well, you know what?
This is one star whose hoop...
This is the star the hoop... This hoop...
I was Doctor Drake Ramoray!
Hi, Tag. What are you doing here?
I came to thank you for not laughing in my face yesterday.
I noticed there were no plants so I brought you your first.
There is a plant in your office.
Kind of.
Right.
So I guess I shouldn't put "good at noticing stuff" on my résumé.
Oh...
Thank you. - Anyway...
...I'm guessing you hired somebody.
Well...
Gotcha.
Thanks again for meeting with me.
But I hired you.
What? - Yeah, you got the job.
You're my new assistant. - I am?
Yeah.
I can't believe it. - Ha, ha, me either.
First, I need you to go downstairs...
...find a woman named Hilda, and tell her to go home.
Hey. - Hey, good, you're home.
Always nicer to hear than, "Oh, crap, you again."
Hey, sweetie, I made you a surprise.
Oh, yeah? - Yeah, tacos.
Ever since that story, I've had such a craving.
Did you not understand the story?
Hey. - Hey, what's up?
Ah, nothing. Just figuring out what to do for dinner.
Hey, ooh, what's that? Dinner stuff?
You making dinner? - No.
Shh!

sense_groups.english: I can't tell you. It's a secret.

sense_groups.chinese: 秘密？ 夫妻不该有秘密的
sense_groups.english: Secret? Married people aren't supposed to have secrets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们深爱并且尊重彼此
sense_groups.english: We love and respect one another too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Aw...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我还是不能说
sense_groups.english: But still, no, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该对彼此坦诚一切 我就不会对你隐藏任何秘密
sense_groups.english: We should tell each other everything. I don't have secrets from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？告诉我罗斯在大三时 在迪士尼乐园发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: Really? So tell me what happened to Ross, junior year at Disneyland.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不能那么做
sense_groups.english: No, I can't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟我说 我就会告诉你菲比说了什么
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what Phoebe said.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯跟我 一起去迪士尼乐园玩
sense_groups.english: So, ahem, Ross and I are going to Disneyland.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在一家餐厅吃墨西哥卷饼
sense_groups.english: We stop at this restaurant for tacos.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上那只是一个家伙 改装了他的车子开的路边摊
sense_groups.english: When I say restaurant, I mean a guy, a hibachi, and the trunk of his car.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯吃了十个墨西哥卷饼
sense_groups.english: So Ross has about ten tacos.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我们在玩太空山 罗斯开始觉得不舒服
sense_groups.english: Anyway, we're on Space Mountain and Ross starts to feel a little iffy.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他吐了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. He threw up?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他从另一边 把东西全拉了出来
sense_groups.english: No, he visited a town a little south of throw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 那菲比有什么秘密？
sense_groups.english: What was Phoebe's secret?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比以前的按摩师同事 南西汤普森被开除了
sense_groups.english: Um, Nancy Thompson, from Phoebe's old massage place, is getting fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 就那样？我为了那件事 说出迪士尼的秘密？
sense_groups.english: That's it? I gave up my Disneyland story for that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你输了 笨蛋
sense_groups.english: Hm, that's right. You lose, sucker!

sense_groups.chinese: 请你还是要娶我
sense_groups.english: Please still marry me.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你有助理吧？
sense_groups.english: You have an assistant, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 她打电话来了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did she call?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉她我病了吧？每次都要说我生病了
sense_groups.english: You told her I was sick, right? Always tell her I am sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我只是不知道 你怎么决定要雇用谁？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. How do you decide who to hire?

sense_groups.chinese: 我把选择范围缩小到两个人
sense_groups.english: I have it down to two people.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个的推荐信很棒 经验非常丰富
sense_groups.english: One has great references and a lot of experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有另一个家伙 - 他怎么了？
sense_groups.english: And then, there's this guy. - What about him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱他
sense_groups.english: I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他帅呆了 我真的好想哭
sense_groups.english: He's so pretty, I want to cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 你知道自己该怎么办 你得雇用第一个人
sense_groups.english: Come on, you know what to do. You hire the first one.

sense_groups.chinese: 别因为他长得帅就雇他当助理 你得考虑到他们的工作能力
sense_groups.english: Don't hire assistants because they're cute. Do it because they're qualified.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 你说的有道理 我可以再说一件事吗？
sense_groups.english: I hear you. You make a lot of sense. Can I just say one more thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 看他有多帅
sense_groups.english: Look how pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看
sense_groups.english: Let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…但还是不行
sense_groups.english: Oh. But, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能雇用他 因为那么做太不专业了
sense_groups.english: No. You can't... You can't hire him because it's not professional.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是给我的 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Um, this is for me, yes?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说的对 明天我会雇用西尔达
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're right. I'll hire Hilda tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个又蠢又老 适合这份工作的西尔达
sense_groups.english: Dumb, old, perfect-for-the-job Hilda.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: Let me see.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wo-ha-ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 别让摩妮卡看到照片
sense_groups.english: Don't show this to Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 别告诉她我说 "哇"
sense_groups.english: And don't tell her about the "Wo-ha-ow!"

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 - 嗨 泰瑞
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, hey, Joey. - Hey, Terry.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能再跟你见面 - 好久不见
sense_groups.english: Nice to see you again. - Been a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有趣 这里的走廊看起来比以前小
sense_groups.english: Funny, these halls look smaller than they used to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们搬家了
sense_groups.english: It's a different building.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 史崔克是吧？
sense_groups.english: ...Stryker Ramoray, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么时候开始？ - 何不现在就开始呢？
sense_groups.english: When do I start? - How about right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是试镜的剧本
sense_groups.english: Here are the audition scenes.

sense_groups.chinese: 试镜？我还以为 你们决定让我饰演那个角色
sense_groups.english: I thought you were offering me the part.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我演过德瑞克医生 他是史崔克的双胞胎哥哥
sense_groups.english: I was Doctor Drake Ramoray, Stryker's twin brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会比我长得更像我呢？
sense_groups.english: Who looks more like me than me, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都得参加试镜
sense_groups.english: Everybody has to audition. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 秦瑞 我真的不需要这么做
sense_groups.english: You know, Terry, I don't really need to do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有自己的第四台电视剧…
sense_groups.english: I got my own cable TV series...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟机器人搭档演出
sense_groups.english: ...with a robot.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 乔伊 这是规定
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Joey. That's the way it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你以为你很特别
sense_groups.english: ...I guess you think you're pretty special, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你坐在漂亮的小办公室里…
sense_groups.english: Sitting up here in your fancy, small-halled building...

sense_groups.chinese: 要大明星在你面前试演
sense_groups.english: ...making stars jump through hoops for you, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是那个大明星…
sense_groups.english: This is one star whose hoop...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是试演的… 大明星…
sense_groups.english: This is the star the hoop... This hoop...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是德瑞克雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: I was Doctor Drake Ramoray!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 泰格 你在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Tag. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来谢谢你 昨天没当着我的面笑我
sense_groups.english: I came to thank you for not laughing in my face yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我注意到你办公室里没有植物 所以就帮你带盆植物过来
sense_groups.english: I noticed there were no plants so I brought you your first.

sense_groups.chinese: 你办公室里有植物
sense_groups.english: There is a plant in your office.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以那么说
sense_groups.english: Kind of.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我不应该在履历表上写着 "注意力敏锐"
sense_groups.english: So I guess I shouldn't put "good at noticing stuff" on my résumé.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 总之…
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你录取了别人
sense_groups.english: ...I'm guessing you hired somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜中了
sense_groups.english: Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你愿意面试我
sense_groups.english: Thanks again for meeting with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我录取了你
sense_groups.english: But I hired you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 对 你得到了这份工作
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, you got the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我的新助理 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: You're my new assistant. - I am?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. - Ha, ha, me either.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我要你到楼下…
sense_groups.english: First, I need you to go downstairs...

sense_groups.chinese: 找一个叫西尔达的女人 要她回家去
sense_groups.english: ...find a woman named Hilda, and tell her to go home.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 太好了 你回来了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, good, you're home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这要比听到 "该死 又是你"还好
sense_groups.english: Always nicer to hear than, "Oh, crap, you again."

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我帮你准备了一个大惊喜
sense_groups.english: Hey, sweetie, I made you a surprise.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 对 墨西哥卷饼
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? - Yeah, tacos.

sense_groups.chinese: 听完那个故事后 我就一直都想吃墨西哥卷饼
sense_groups.english: Ever since that story, I've had such a craving.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听不懂那个故事吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you not understand the story?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我只是想知道晚餐要吃什么
sense_groups.english: Ah, nothing. Just figuring out what to do for dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 那是什么？晚餐吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, ooh, what's that? Dinner stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做晚餐？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: You making dinner? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘
sense_groups.english: Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么？ 墨西哥卷饼吗？
sense_groups.english: What's over there? Tacos?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们只是…
sense_groups.english: They're just, uh... They're...

sense_groups.chinese: 牛肉包大饼
sense_groups.english: They're ground beef smileys.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是墨西哥卷饼
sense_groups.english: Uh, those are tacos.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 墨西哥先生
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, Mr. Mexico.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我不吃了 我还是不敢吃那玩意
sense_groups.english: Either way, I'll pass. Still can't eat those.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事那么好笑？
sense_groups.english: What's so funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有笑
sense_groups.english: I'm not laughing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她说了
sense_groups.english: You told her!

sense_groups.chinese: 南西汤普森被开除了
sense_groups.english: Nancy Thompson's getting fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那时我食物中毒 我不是故意要那么做
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. I had food poisoning. It's not like I chose to do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我又没有说 "该怎么做才会更好玩呢？ "
sense_groups.english: It's not like I said, "What would make this ride more fun?"

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你说的对 抱歉 我不该笑的
sense_groups.english: Right. You're right, I'm sorry. I shouldn't be laughing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该帮你先铺好报纸
sense_groups.english: I should be laying down papers for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可以告诉她？ - 我非说不可 我们要结婚了
sense_groups.english: How could you? - I had to. We're getting married.

sense_groups.chinese: 夫妻不该有秘密
sense_groups.english: Married couples can't keep secrets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜摩妮卡应该知道 在大西洋城发生的事
sense_groups.english: I... I guess Monica should know about Atlantic City.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Du... ude!

sense_groups.chinese: 大西洋城发生了什么事？ - 钱德跟我在酒吧里…
sense_groups.english: What happened? - Chandler and I are in a bar...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有听到我说"兄弟"吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you not hear me say, "Du... ude"?

sense_groups.chinese: 有个女孩跟钱德抛媚眼
sense_groups.english: And this girl is making eyes at Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 一会儿之后 他走过去 一两分钟后我看到他们在接吻
sense_groups.english: So he goes over to her and, uh, after a minute or two, I see them kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会觉得他是那种会在酒吧里泡女人的男人
sense_groups.english: You're thinking he's not the type to go to bars and make out with girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是对的 他的确不是那种…
sense_groups.english: And you're right. He's not the type...

sense_groups.chinese: 在酒吧里泡女人的男人
sense_groups.english: ...to go to bars and make out with "girls."

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟男人接吻？
sense_groups.english: You kissed a guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我得为自己辩驳 那时很暗而且他长得很漂亮
sense_groups.english: In my defense, it was dark and he was a very pretty guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 老妹 我笑得肚子疼…
sense_groups.english: Oh, Mon, I laughed so hard...

sense_groups.chinese: 你笑到又拉了一裤子？
sense_groups.english: Ho-ho, so hard we had to throw out your underwear again?

sense_groups.chinese: 随便你 兄弟 你吻了男人
sense_groups.english: Whatever, dude. You kissed a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 西尔达适应的还好吧？
sense_groups.english: How's Hilda working out?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的新助理适应的很好 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, my new assistant is working out. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很高兴能够得到这份工作吗？
sense_groups.english: She happy she got the job?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的新助理非常高兴 我雇用了我的新助理
sense_groups.english: My new assistant is very happy that I hired my new assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你能等一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey! Can you hang on a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 是《麦克与起司》的制片
sense_groups.english: It's the producers at Mac and C.H.E.E.S. E...

sense_groups.chinese: 打来的 先失陪一下
sense_groups.english: ...if you'll excuse me for a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我没想到你会打来 我正在看下星期的剧本
sense_groups.english: Hey, funny you should call. I was just looking over next week's script.

sense_groups.chinese: 取消了
sense_groups.english: Canceled?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不播了？
sense_groups.english: Like, they're taking it off the air? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 星期一见
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll see you Monday.

sense_groups.chinese: 不再拍了？
sense_groups.english: We're not even shooting them anymore!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见
sense_groups.english: All right. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们取消了《麦克与起司》
sense_groups.english: They canceled Mac and C.H.E.E.S.E.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 - 我真的很遗憾 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry. - Oh, sorry, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们为什么要那么做？ 那出戏很棒 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Why would they do that? It was a good show, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想说秘密吗？ 好吧 念大学时…
sense_groups.english: You want to tell secrets? Okay, in college...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯都会穿卫生裤
sense_groups.english: ...Ross used to wear leg warmers.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 钱德参加模仿香草冰大赛 还拿到了冠军
sense_groups.english: All right, Chandler entered a Vanilla Ice look-alike contest and won.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯得了第四名 抱头痛哭
sense_groups.english: Ross came in fourth and cried!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 那很好笑吗？ 你觉得那很好笑吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, is that funny? You find that funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许钱德也应该 知道你的一些秘密
sense_groups.english: Maybe Chandler should know your secrets too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经告诉他一切了
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Oh, I... I already told him everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我闭嘴
sense_groups.english: You shush!

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次她被罚不准吃晚餐…
sense_groups.english: Once, she was sent to bed without dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 结果她吃掉了 她用义大利面做的珠宝盒
sense_groups.english: ...so she ate the macaroni off a jewelry box she'd made.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯每个星期六晚上 都待在家里看《黄金女郎》
sense_groups.english: Ross stayed home every Saturday night to watch Golden Girls.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡到十三岁才会看时间
sense_groups.english: Monica couldn't tell time until she was 13.

sense_groups.chinese: 对有些人就是很难
sense_groups.english: It's hard for some people!

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然
sense_groups.english: Of course it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德曾穿我的内裤去上班 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Chandler wore my underwear to work! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我想不出来 罗斯还有什么挫事
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry, I couldn't think of any more for Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 在大学时有一次钱德喝醉了…
sense_groups.english: In college, Chandler got drunk...

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟打扫房间的清洁妇上床
sense_groups.english: ...and slept with the lady who cleaned our dorm.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你
sense_groups.english: That was you.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便 兄弟 你吻了男人
sense_groups.english: Whatever, dude. You kissed a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这种事怎么会发生在我身上？
sense_groups.english: How could this happen to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨天我演出两出电视剧 今天我什么都没有
sense_groups.english: Yesterday, I had two TV shows. Today, I got nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 《我们的日子》呢？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, what happened to Days ofour Lives?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有点生我的气
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, they might be a little mad at me over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我有点太嚣张 我告诉他们该怎么做
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I got a little upset, and maybe I told them where they could go.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你为什么要那么做？
sense_groups.english: Joey, why would you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们要我试镜
sense_groups.english: Because! They wanted me to audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可是个演员 那么做太过分了
sense_groups.english: You, an actor? That's madness!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋葛林办公室
sense_groups.english: Rachel Green's office.

sense_groups.chinese: 秦格
sense_groups.english: Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 谁打电话找我？
sense_groups.english: Hi, who was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人 我只是在练习
sense_groups.english: Nobody. I was just practicing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 瑞秋葛林办公室
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi, Rachel Green's office.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定是西尔达 - 额
sense_groups.english: You must be Hilda. - Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是泰格 这位是菲比
sense_groups.english: He's Tag. This is Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你能进来一下吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, can I see you for a sec? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个名字很不错 - 你喜欢吗？
sense_groups.english: Great name. - You like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该听听我的电话号码 - 好吧 我们马上回来
sense_groups.english: You should hear my phone number. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为了自己雇用 那个大帅哥 对吧？
sense_groups.english: So you hired yourself a little treat, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这样看起来像什么 菲比 但是我要告诉你…
sense_groups.english: I know how it looks, but I am telling you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能勾搭你的助理
sense_groups.english: You can't get involved with your assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我知道雇用他 不是明智之举
sense_groups.english: I know that, and I know hiring him was not the smartest thing I've ever done.

sense_groups.chinese: 但从现在开始 我发誓我们之间是纯公事
sense_groups.english: But, from now on, I swear this is strictly professional.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Hey, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你助理很帅 你了解他吗？
sense_groups.english: Cute assistant. What's his story?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是…？ - 是同性恋吗？对
sense_groups.english: Is he...? - Gay? Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 秦瑞
sense_groups.english: Hey, Terry.

sense_groups.chinese: 是乔伊•崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很惊讶像你这样的大人物 会到我们的小办公室来
sense_groups.english: Surprised your big head could fit through our small halls.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 乔伊 - 等一下 泰瑞 听我说
sense_groups.english: I gotta go, Joey. - Wait, Terry! Look, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 之前的事我抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm really sorry about before.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个白痴 以为自己很大牌 根本不必做试镜
sense_groups.english: I was an idiot, thinking I'm too big to audition for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 再给我一次机会 - 我办不到
sense_groups.english: Give me another chance. - I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 秦瑞 求求你
sense_groups.english: Wait, Terry, please!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我失去了我另一份工作
sense_groups.english: Look, I just lost my other job, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道我多需要这出戏
sense_groups.english: You have no idea how much I need this.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你帮帮我
sense_groups.english: Please, help me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是老朋友了
sense_groups.english: For old times' sake.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙昏迷了五年 他已经没希望了
sense_groups.english: This guy's been in a coma for five years. It's hopeless.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会的 史崔克医生擅长展现奇迹
sense_groups.english: It's not. Dr. Stryker Ramoray is a miracle worker.

sense_groups.chinese: 他来了
sense_groups.english: Here he comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安
sense_groups.english: Good morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克 我是你弟弟史崔克 你听到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Drake, it's your brother, Stryker. Can you hear me?

sense_groups.chinese: 卡
sense_groups.english: And cut.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又回来了 宝贝
sense_groups.english: I'm back, baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的解释是…
sense_groups.english: You know, in my defense, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 义大利面上没有珠宝 而且我用的胶水很少
sense_groups.english: ...there was no glitter on the macaroni and very little glue.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的解释是 那个清洁妇勾引我的
sense_groups.english: And in my defense, the cleaning lady came on to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在会看时间了对吧？ - 会
sense_groups.english: Do you have trouble telling time now? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 现在几点了？ - 不知道 吻男人的时间到了吗？
sense_groups.english: Quick, what time is it? - I don't know. Time to kiss a guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在笑什么？尿布宝宝
sense_groups.english: What are you laughing at, Pampers?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我说夫妻…
sense_groups.english: You know when I said married people...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该分享一切 不可以有秘密吗？
sense_groups.english: ...should share everything and not have any secrets?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 那太蠢了 我们千万别那么做
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - That was stupid. Let's not do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不该把告诉彼此的秘密 再告诉其他人
sense_groups.english: We should keep the stuff we told each other secret from everyone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, definitely.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 对不起…
sense_groups.english: Okay, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟不知道 太空山事件…
sense_groups.english: If you'll excuse me, I'm gonna hang out with people...

sense_groups.chinese: 的人去玩了
sense_groups.english: ...who don't know the Space Mountain story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我建议你别去找菲比 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Then I'd steer clear of Phoebe. - Man!

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错 我也建议你别去找我同事
sense_groups.english: Not that you would, but I wouldn't hang out with the guys at my office.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有空吗？ - 当然 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a minute? - Sure. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我吃午餐的时候 有两个人想约我出去…
sense_groups.english: I got asked out twice today while I was at lunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都是男人
sense_groups.english: ...by guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有告诉别人我是同性恋吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you tell someone that I was gay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不希望别人知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, did you not want people to know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是同性恋 我特别不希望 你以为我是同性恋
sense_groups.english: I'm not gay. I especially wouldn't want you to think I was gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不该说的 - 你说吧
sense_groups.english: I don't think I should say. - Oh, you can say.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我不希望 你有事不敢告诉我
sense_groups.english: Come on, I don't want you to feel like you can't tell me things.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个… - 是的
sense_groups.english: Well... - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想约你朋友菲比出去
sense_groups.english: ...I'd love to ask out your friend Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 她是同性恋
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she's gay.

questions.name: S07E05
questions.en:
Hey.
What's the matter? - Someone on the subway licked my neck!
Licked my neck! - Whoa! Willy's still alive.
What are you doing? - My mom called.
They're gonna run our engagement announcement in the paper.
We're looking for a good picture. - Ooh, I'm afraid that does not exist.
Not true. There are great pictures of us.
No, there are great pictures of you next to a guy who's going like this...
Oh, my God, that's the creep that you're with at the Statue of Liberty.
I don't know what it is. I just can't take a good picture.
Oh, here's a great one.
Yeah, I'm not in that. - No, but look at me, all tan.
Why don't you get portraits done by a professional photographer?
That's a great idea. I bet they have one of those wind machines, like
Yeah, that's great. Next to that, Chandler won't look so stupid.
Chandler, what do you say? - All right, but I should warn you.
I'm not going. I'm going.
Dude, that reverse lay-up. Ugh!
And how about those three-pointers? - Amazing.
And those guys were this close to letting us play this time too.
Hey, look. Phoebe's talking to Cute Coffeehouse Guy.
You call him "Cute Coffeehouse Guy"? We call him "Hums While He Pees."
Yes, and we call Ross "Lingers in the Bathroom."
Hey, you guys, "Hums While He Pees" just asked me out.
I thought that guy was married. - He is, but he's getting divorced.
Ross, maybe you know him.
It's not a club.
If this guy's going through a divorce, is it a good idea to go out with him?
Hey, divorced men are not bad men.
They have that that on the napkins at the club.
Oh, I gotta get back to work. - You don't have to be back for a half-hour.
My assistant, Tag, does sit-ups in the office during lunch. Heh.
Ugh, I could just spread him on a cracker.
If you have a crush on this guy, why would you hire him?
You know you can't date him, right? - Oh, no, I know that.
Although we made a joke that we spend so much time together...
...he should call me his "work-wife."
Soon he'll be able to call you "that lady he knew that got fired."
I'm not gonna get fired, because I'm not gonna act on it.
You wouldn't mind if he was dating someone?
Why, is he? He is, isn't he? He's dating that slut in marketing.
Maybe I should open a divorced men's club.
Dude, that's so sad.
I could put a basketball court in the back. - Heh.
Could I play?
Oh, no sit-ups today, Tag?
I just did them. - Oh, well, drop and give me 10 more. Heh.
What?
I had a drink with lunch. Did those, um...?
Did those cost reports come in? - Yeah, I filled them out last night.
Oh, great. Could you make me 4 copies?
Sure. - Great, thank you.
Huh.
Ah.
Hey, Rachel. - Hi. Hi, Melissa. What's up?
I'm just about to, um, go out to the store.
Get some stuff to put in my backpack.
You know, like dried fruit and granola, and stuff like that.
Um, what's up? - Is Tag here?
No. Why? - Oh, I was gonna talk to him...
...about doing something tonight. - Really?
You got a little crush on Tag there, do you?
Well, we've been flirting back and forth...
...but I was hoping tonight it would turn into something a little more than that.
Okay, whoa, whoa. Easy there, Melissa. This ain't a locker room, okay.
But you know, I remember him saying that he had plans tonight.
Oh, no. - Oh, yeah.
All right, back to work.
Hey, isn't that Tag's backpack?
Yeah, Melissa, I don't want to be known as the, uh, office bitch...
...but I will call your supervisor.
PHOTOGRAPHER: Great, that's great, Monica. Great.
Now, Chandler, you want to give us a smile?
Okay.
I'm sorry, is the seat uncomfortable? - No, I am.
Chandler, I know you can do this. You have a beautiful smile.
I do? - Yeah.
All right, maybe you don't have to smile. Let's try something else. Let's try, um...
Try looking sexy. - Okay.
Or not.
Hi, Joey, what are you doing here?
I got an audition down the street, and I spilled sauce all over my shirt.
You got an extra one? - Yeah, sure. Um...
Here.
Great.
You got anything that's not Ralph Lauren?
Yeah, I don't think so, Joe.
I guess this'll be fine.
Listen, uh, what are you doing tonight? - Nothing. Why?
How would you feel about taking out my assistant Tag?
I'll pay. - Heh.
It's gonna take a lot of money for me to go out on a date with a dude.
I'm not asking you to go on a date with him.
Really? Because I could kind of use the money.
Joey, just... He's new in town and he doesn't have any guy friends.
Take him to a ball game or something. I'd appreciate it.
Yeah, okay, no problem. - Thank you.
Ooh, hey, doughnuts! - Uh-huh.
I know. Let's try a look...
...of far-off wonderment.
Gaze into our future and think about our marriage and the days to come.
Chandler, what is the matter with your face?
This picture's supposed to say "Geller and Bing to be married"...
...not "Local woman saves drowning moron."
Ha-ha-ha. - Hey, don't laugh at him.
He's my drowning moron.
Aw. - That's it, that's it! Take it, take it!
I like this one.
It seems to say, "I love you and that's why I have to kill you."
Can't all be bad.
Find the one where you make your bedroom eyes.
Oh, there it is.
Oh, my God, those are my bedroom eyes?
Why did you ever sleep with me?
Do you really want to pull at that thread?
I'm having a really good time. - Me too.
Sorry that guy on the subway licked your neck.
Oh!
No, that's okay. He's a friend.
Uh, I don't mean to be presumptuous...
...but I have tickets to the ballroom-dancing finals tomorrow.
Yeah, I...
Well, I missed the semifinals, so I think I would just be lost.
Heh, I know that it's lame, but I got these tickets from my boss...
Oh, no, no, no, my God!
Okay, don't freak out. I'll go. - No, it's...
My ex-wife Whitney is out there.
I cannot deal with her now. That woman is crazy.
Okay, I know. Hold on.
Hey, Ross. - Yeah.
Yeah. Um, that's Whitney, Kyle's ex-wife out there.
Do you think you could divert her so we could slip out?
What? No.
Okay, but I have two tickets to the ballroom-dance finals.
I don't think so, Pheebs. I, heh...
All right, I'll do it.
But just because you're a friend. - Okay.
Aah!
Hi, Ginger.
I want my key back.
I don't have it. - It's right there.
Ugh. Okay, Sherlock.
I'm sorry, but you'd better go, Pheebs.
All right. I just wanted to thank you for diverting Kyle's ex.
Oh, yeah, no, you're welcome. We'll, uh, talk about it later.
Okay. - Heh.
Hi, Whitney. - Hi, Ross.
Are you ready for breakfast? - Yep. Ooh.
Kyle's ex-wife? You were supposed to divert her, not date her.
Sorry, can you give me a second while I talk to this woman...
...uh, who, by the way, did not spend the night?
Sure. - Okay. Eh, heh...
I did divert her, and we ended up having a great time, okay?
Watching ballroom dancing? - Yes.
That's where we realized we are both super cool people.
Look, okay, Ross. Kyle just told me some really bad stuff about her.
Like what? - Like she's really mean.
And she's overly critical and... And... No.
She will paint a room a really bright color without even checking with you.
Okay.
And she uses sex as a weapon.
Fine. Thank you for warning me.
At breakfast, I'll be on full alert for room painting and sex weapons.
You're still gonna go out with her? - Yeah.
Well, didn't you hear what I just said?
Pheebs, come on. I mean, consider the source.
Of course her ex-husband's gonna say that stuff. Now if you'll excuse me.
No, listen to me, she is crazy!
WHITNEY: Uh, your door isn't soundproof.
You see? Nothing is good enough for her.
Morning. - Hi, Tag.
Hey, so did you have fun with, uh, Joey last night?
Yeah, we went to the Knicks game.
Aw, that's nice.
Then we went to this bar, and he hooked us up with all these women.
Women? You mean, like old women?
Kind of old, like 30.
Oh. - I never used to be able...
...to just talk to girls in bars...
...but I got, like, 20 phone numbers last night.
That's great.
Oh, man. So Joey must have really taught you some stuff.
A little. - Yeah.
How you doing?
See? That's a great smile. Easy, natural.
Now pretend I have a camera.
You're changing it. - I can't help it.
All right. You want to know what I do when I take résumé shots?
Borrow money from me?
Yeah. Okay, first of all, you want to make it look spontaneous.
So here's what I do. I look down, look down, keep looking down.
Then I look up.
See? All right, now you try.
Look down. You're looking down. Keep looking down.
Why is there jelly on your shoe?
I had a doughnut. - Oh.
Hi. - Hey.
So, I heard you had some fun with Tag last night.
Yeah, that guy's all right.
Yeah, and you had fun teaching him how to be all "Joey."
What? - You know, all the women.
You can't teach someone to be good with women.
That's why I never had any luck with Chandler.
I'm right here.
Would you mind just not going out with him again?
Just the idea of you and he and all these women...
I know he's my assistant, and I can't date him, blah!
But it bothers me, all right?
No, no, no, you can't take him away from me.
I got a great partner to pick up girls with. Finally!
I'm still right here.
All right, will you talk to him...
...and tell him how hollow and unsatisfying this dating-tons-of-women thing is?
What?
I don't want him to meet anybody until I'm over my crush.
And I will get over it.
It's not like I love him. It's just physical.
I get these crushes all the time. Hell, I had a crush on you when I met you.
I know. Monica told me.
Did you have a crush on me when you first met me?
Yeah, sure.
Can you people not see me?
So will you talk to him?
I don't know, Rach. - I'll give you 10 Ralph Lauren shirts.
One.
No, 10. You said 10. You can't take that back.
Hey. You wanted to talk to me?
I don't know. You, uh, got something for me?
Oh, yeah, this is from Rachel.
Ten. Okay.
Tag, there's such a thing as too many women.
Really? - Yeah, for you.
Hey, there you are. - There I am.
You okay? - Yeah, Joey said I, uh, needed to relax.
So he gave me an antihistamine.
What? - Yeah.
Then I fell asleep on the subway and went to Brooklyn.
Brooklyn is far.
What were you thinking?
But don't worry, because I know how to take a picture now.
Okay, see. Look down.
Look down.
Chandler? - Yeah?
Hi. - Hi.
So how are things going with Crazy? Has she cooked your rabbit yet?
Listen, you are hearing one side of the story. Okay?
FYI, she must have shown Kyle over 30 paint samples...
...before she painted that room.
And his response to each one was, "I don't give a tiny rat's ass."
Maybe she should have spent a little less time decorating...
...and a little more time in the bedroom.
I don't think we are going to have that problem...
...but maybe that's because I am not emotionally unavailable.
You think he's emotionally unavailable?
I think he can be.
Maybe he wouldn't be...
...if she didn't bring the office home every night.
Well excuse her for knowing what she wants to do with her life.
Well, she certainly knew what she was doing New Year's Eve 1997.
I knew you were gonna throw that in my face!
That was three years ago. She apologized and apologized.
What more do you want?
We want the last six years back!
So do we! So do we!
I'm sorry you had to see that.
Morning, Rachel. - Hi.
Hey, so, uh, what'd you do last night?
Went out with Joey. - Oh, yeah?
Another night of bird-dogging the chicas?
No, we had a really good talk. - Oh.
I don't think I'm gonna do that bar scene anymore.
Wow, I did not see that coming.
It's just not really who I am.
No, I've always been happier when...
Why am I telling you this?
You don't care about this stuff. - Yes, I do. I do.
Go on. You were saying, "I'm happier when I'm..."
When I'm in a relationship.
I love having a girlfriend. - Really?
Yeah. Someone I can spoil, you know.
Sp... Spoil? - Uh-huh.
Let me ask you something. - Uh-huh?
Do you believe there's one perfect person for everyone?
I'm starting to.
If that person's in your life, you should do something about it?
Yes. Hell, yes.
All right, then, it's settled. - Okay.
I'm getting back together with my ex. - I would love to!
What?
Hello?
Oh. This is gonna be a while. Excuse me.
Um, yeah.
Yeah.
My God!
Oh, I'm sorry. Is that annoying?
And speaking of being selfish in bed, how's Whitney?
Maybe she wouldn't have to be selfish in bed...
...if someone else knew where everything was.
Oh, he knows. Heh.
For the most part.
Oh, hey. Good, you're both here.
We kind of need to talk.
Both of you together? - What's up?
Well, I went over to Kyle's last night to pick up a few things...
...and we got to reminiscing.
We talked most of the night...
...and realized the reason we're angry with each other...
...is because there are still feelings there.
So...
Oh, just say it, Kyle!
We're gonna give it another try.
What about her whining, and her constant need for attention?
I'm gonna work on that.
Oh, right, because you're so capable of change.
You know, he hums when he pees.
I do know. - Makes him miss the bowl, but whatever.
We're so sorry.
That's all right. We don't need you. I'm over it already.
Yeah, and I don't even give a tiny rat's ass.
Yeah, we're gonna go.
I'm sorry.
Agh.
Pheebs, you were right about her.
You know, she did try to use sex as a weapon.
Yeah, I hurt my back a little.
You know, he hums while he does other stuff too.
We're better off without them. - Heh.
Even if they break up again, you better not let him in your sad men's club.
Divorced men's club. - Potato, "potato."
Hey, guys, check it out.
My mom sent me the paper. - Ooh, let's see it. Yay.
Oh, yeah, that looks good. - You make a very attractive couple.
Yeah, we look great together. - We really do.
Okay.
Imagine what our kids would look like.
You know, we don't have to imagine.
I'm marrying her.
We'll just see.
