Women? You mean, like old women?
Kind of old, like 30.
Oh. - I never used to be able...
...to just talk to girls in bars...
...but I got, like, 20 phone numbers last night.
That's great.
Oh, man. So Joey must have really taught you some stuff.
A little. - Yeah.
How you doing?
See? That's a great smile. Easy, natural.
Now pretend I have a camera.
You're changing it. - I can't help it.
All right. You want to know what I do when I take résumé shots?
Borrow money from me?
Yeah. Okay, first of all, you want to make it look spontaneous.
So here's what I do. I look down, look down, keep looking down.
Then I look up.
See? All right, now you try.
Look down. You're looking down. Keep looking down.
Why is there jelly on your shoe?
I had a doughnut. - Oh.
Hi. - Hey.
So, I heard you had some fun with Tag last night.
Yeah, that guy's all right.
Yeah, and you had fun teaching him how to be all "Joey."
What? - You know, all the women.
You can't teach someone to be good with women.
That's why I never had any luck with Chandler.
I'm right here.
Would you mind just not going out with him again?
Just the idea of you and he and all these women...
I know he's my assistant, and I can't date him, blah!
But it bothers me, all right?
No, no, no, you can't take him away from me.
I got a great partner to pick up girls with. Finally!
I'm still right here.
All right, will you talk to him...
...and tell him how hollow and unsatisfying this dating-tons-of-women thing is?
What?
I don't want him to meet anybody until I'm over my crush.
And I will get over it.
It's not like I love him. It's just physical.
I get these crushes all the time. Hell, I had a crush on you when I met you.
I know. Monica told me.
Did you have a crush on me when you first met me?
Yeah, sure.
Can you people not see me?
So will you talk to him?
I don't know, Rach. - I'll give you 10 Ralph Lauren shirts.
One.
No, 10. You said 10. You can't take that back.
Hey. You wanted to talk to me?
I don't know. You, uh, got something for me?
Oh, yeah, this is from Rachel.
Ten. Okay.
Tag, there's such a thing as too many women.
Really? - Yeah, for you.
Hey, there you are. - There I am.
You okay? - Yeah, Joey said I, uh, needed to relax.
So he gave me an antihistamine.
What? - Yeah.
Then I fell asleep on the subway and went to Brooklyn.
Brooklyn is far.
What were you thinking?
But don't worry, because I know how to take a picture now.
Okay, see. Look down.
Look down.
Chandler? - Yeah?
Hi. - Hi.
So how are things going with Crazy? Has she cooked your rabbit yet?
Listen, you are hearing one side of the story. Okay?
FYI, she must have shown Kyle over 30 paint samples...
...before she painted that room.
And his response to each one was, "I don't give a tiny rat's ass."
Maybe she should have spent a little less time decorating...
...and a little more time in the bedroom.
I don't think we are going to have that problem...
...but maybe that's because I am not emotionally unavailable.
You think he's emotionally unavailable?
I think he can be.
Maybe he wouldn't be...
...if she didn't bring the office home every night.
Well excuse her for knowing what she wants to do with her life.
Well, she certainly knew what she was doing New Year's Eve 1997.
I knew you were gonna throw that in my face!
That was three years ago. She apologized and apologized.
What more do you want?
We want the last six years back!
So do we! So do we!
I'm sorry you had to see that.
Morning, Rachel. - Hi.
Hey, so, uh, what'd you do last night?
Went out with Joey. - Oh, yeah?
Another night of bird-dogging the chicas?
No, we had a really good talk. - Oh.
I don't think I'm gonna do that bar scene anymore.
Wow, I did not see that coming.
It's just not really who I am.
No, I've always been happier when...
Why am I telling you this?
You don't care about this stuff. - Yes, I do. I do.
Go on. You were saying, "I'm happier when I'm..."
When I'm in a relationship.
I love having a girlfriend. - Really?
Yeah. Someone I can spoil, you know.
Sp... Spoil? - Uh-huh.
Let me ask you something. - Uh-huh?
Do you believe there's one perfect person for everyone?
I'm starting to.
If that person's in your life, you should do something about it?
Yes. Hell, yes.
All right, then, it's settled. - Okay.
I'm getting back together with my ex. - I would love to!
What?
Hello?
Oh. This is gonna be a while. Excuse me.
Um, yeah.
Yeah.
My God!
Oh, I'm sorry. Is that annoying?
And speaking of being selfish in bed, how's Whitney?
Maybe she wouldn't have to be selfish in bed...
...if someone else knew where everything was.
Oh, he knows. Heh.
For the most part.
Oh, hey. Good, you're both here.
We kind of need to talk.
Both of you together? - What's up?
Well, I went over to Kyle's last night to pick up a few things...
...and we got to reminiscing.
We talked most of the night...
...and realized the reason we're angry with each other...
...is because there are still feelings there.
So...
Oh, just say it, Kyle!
We're gonna give it another try.
What about her whining, and her constant need for attention?
I'm gonna work on that.
Oh, right, because you're so capable of change.
You know, he hums when he pees.
I do know. - Makes him miss the bowl, but whatever.
We're so sorry.
That's all right. We don't need you. I'm over it already.
Yeah, and I don't even give a tiny rat's ass.
Yeah, we're gonna go.
I'm sorry.
Agh.
Pheebs, you were right about her.
You know, she did try to use sex as a weapon.
Yeah, I hurt my back a little.
You know, he hums while he does other stuff too.
We're better off without them. - Heh.
Even if they break up again, you better not let him in your sad men's club.
Divorced men's club. - Potato, "potato."
Hey, guys, check it out.
My mom sent me the paper. - Ooh, let's see it. Yay.
Oh, yeah, that looks good. - You make a very attractive couple.
Yeah, we look great together. - We really do.
Okay.
Imagine what our kids would look like.
You know, we don't have to imagine.
I'm marrying her.
We'll just see.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 搭地铁时有人舔我的脖子
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - Someone on the subway licked my neck!

sense_groups.chinese: 舔我的脖子耶 - 威利还活着
sense_groups.english: Licked my neck! - Whoa! Willy's still alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在做什么？ - 我妈打电话来
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - My mom called.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要登报通知亲友 我们要订婚了
sense_groups.english: They're gonna run our engagement announcement in the paper.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在找一张很漂亮的合照 - 恐怕那是不可能的事
sense_groups.english: We're looking for a good picture. - Ooh, I'm afraid that does not exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们合拍了很多不错的照片
sense_groups.english: Not true. There are great pictures of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你照得很好 但你旁边的男人是这样的
sense_groups.english: No, there are great pictures of you next to a guy who's going like this...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他就是在自由女神像旁 跟你合照的怪胎
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, that's the creep that you're with at the Statue of Liberty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这是怎么一回事 我就没办法好好照相
sense_groups.english: I don't know what it is. I just can't take a good picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一张很不错
sense_groups.english: Oh, here's a great one.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那一张没有我 - 没错 但我全身晒得黑亮
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm not in that. - No, but look at me, all tan.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们为什么不请专业摄影师 帮你们拍照呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you get portraits done by a professional photographer?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个好点子 我敢说他们一定有大风扇
sense_groups.english: That's a great idea. I bet they have one of those wind machines, like

sense_groups.chinese: 那的确很棒 真的那么做的话 钱德应该看起来不会这么蠢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's great. Next to that, Chandler won't look so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你觉得呢？ - 没问题 但我得警告你
sense_groups.english: Chandler, what do you say? - All right, but I should warn you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不去 "我"会去
sense_groups.english: I'm not going. I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 那一记反手投篮帅呆了
sense_groups.english: Dude, that reverse lay-up. Ugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 那些三分球呢？ - 棒到不行
sense_groups.english: And how about those three-pointers? - Amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次也是就差这么一点 那些家伙就答应让我们上场了
sense_groups.english: And those guys were this close to letting us play this time too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看 菲比在跟咖啡厅帅哥说话
sense_groups.english: Hey, look. Phoebe's talking to Cute Coffeehouse Guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫他"咖啡厅帅哥"吗？ 我们叫他"边尿边哼歌先生"
sense_groups.english: You call him "Cute Coffeehouse Guy"? We call him "Hums While He Pees."

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们叫罗斯 "厕所里逗留男"
sense_groups.english: Yes, and we call Ross "Lingers in the Bathroom."

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 "边尿边哼歌先生" 刚刚约我出去
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, "Hums While He Pees" just asked me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为他结婚了 - 没错 但他正在办离婚
sense_groups.english: I thought that guy was married. - He is, but he's getting divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 或许你认识他
sense_groups.english: Ross, maybe you know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 这又不是俱乐部
sense_groups.english: It's not a club.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他正在办离婚 你觉得跟他约会适当吗？
sense_groups.english: If this guy's going through a divorce, is it a good idea to go out with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 离婚男人不是坏男人
sense_groups.english: Hey, divorced men are not bad men.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们把那句话印在俱乐部的纸巾上
sense_groups.english: They have that that on the napkins at the club.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回去上班了 - 你还可以休息半小时
sense_groups.english: Oh, I gotta get back to work. - You don't have to be back for a half-hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的助理泰格午餐时间时
sense_groups.english: My assistant, Tag, does sit-ups in the office during lunch. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 会在办公室做仰卧起坐
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I could just spread him on a cracker.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在暗恋他 为什么还要雇用他？
sense_groups.english: If you have a crush on this guy, why would you hire him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该清楚你不能跟他约会 对吧？ - 不 我知道
sense_groups.english: You know you can't date him, right? - Oh, no, I know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开玩笑说 因为
sense_groups.english: Although we made a joke that we spend so much time together...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们常常在一起…
sense_groups.english: ...he should call me his "work-wife."

sense_groups.chinese: 很快地他就可以叫你"那个被开除的女人"
sense_groups.english: Soon he'll be able to call you "that lady he knew that got fired."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会被开除 因为我不会采取行动
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna get fired, because I'm not gonna act on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会介意 他跟别人约会吧？
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't mind if he was dating someone?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？他有吗？他有 对吧？ 他跟行销部那个荡妇约会
sense_groups.english: Why, is he? He is, isn't he? He's dating that slut in marketing.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该成立 一个离婚男子俱乐部
sense_groups.english: Maybe I should open a divorced men's club.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 那太惨了
sense_groups.english: Dude, that's so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在后院设一个篮球场
sense_groups.english: I could put a basketball court in the back. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能下场打球吗？
sense_groups.english: Could I play?

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天不做仰卧起坐吗？泰格
sense_groups.english: Oh, no sit-ups today, Tag?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚做完 - 再做十下吧
sense_groups.english: I just did them. - Oh, well, drop and give me 10 more. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我午餐喝了酒 那些…
sense_groups.english: I had a drink with lunch. Did those, um...?

sense_groups.chinese: 成本报告送过来了吗？ - 我昨晚就已经归档了
sense_groups.english: Did those cost reports come in? - Yeah, I filled them out last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 麻烦你帮我影印四份
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Could you make me 4 copies?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 太棒了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Great, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 端秋 - 嗨 梅丽莎 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. - Hi. Hi, Melissa. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正好要去血拼
sense_groups.english: I'm just about to, um, go out to the store.

sense_groups.chinese: 买些东西放进我的背包里
sense_groups.english: Get some stuff to put in my backpack.

sense_groups.chinese: 水果干 速食麦片 那一类的东西
sense_groups.english: You know, like dried fruit and granola, and stuff like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事吗？ - 泰格在吗？
sense_groups.english: Um, what's up? - Is Tag here?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不在 怎么了？ - 我要来问他…
sense_groups.english: No. Why? - Oh, I was gonna talk to him...

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚要不要跟我出去 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: ...about doing something tonight. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢泰格 对吧？
sense_groups.english: You got a little crush on Tag there, do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一直都在眉来眼去的
sense_groups.english: Well, we've been flirting back and forth...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我希望今晚 事情能有点进展
sense_groups.english: ...but I was hoping tonight it would turn into something a little more than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 别猴急 梅丽莎 这里不是更衣室
sense_groups.english: Okay, whoa, whoa. Easy there, Melissa. This ain't a locker room, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我记得他说过 今晚他已经有约了
sense_groups.english: But you know, I remember him saying that he had plans tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 快回去工作
sense_groups.english: All right, back to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是泰格的背包吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, isn't that Tag's backpack?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想当办公室的臭女人
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Melissa, I don't want to be known as the, uh, office bitch...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我会打电话给你主管
sense_groups.english: ...but I will call your supervisor.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 非常不错 摩妮卡 很好
sense_groups.english: PHOTOGRAPHER: Great, that's great, Monica. Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 钱德 你能笑一个吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, Chandler, you want to give us a smile?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 那张椅子很不舒服吗？ - 不 是我很不舒服
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, is the seat uncomfortable? - No, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我知道你办得到 你笑起来很帅
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I know you can do this. You have a beautiful smile.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: I do? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你不必笑 我们来试试别的点子 试着…
sense_groups.english: All right, maybe you don't have to smile. Let's try something else. Let's try, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 试着表现出性成的样子 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Try looking sexy. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是不要吧
sense_groups.english: Or not.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要在附近试镜 结果酱汁沾到衣服上了
sense_groups.english: I got an audition down the street, and I spilled sauce all over my shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有多余的衬衫吗？ - 当然有
sense_groups.english: You got an extra one? - Yeah, sure. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有除了罗夫罗兰外 其他品牌的衣服吗？
sense_groups.english: You got anything that's not Ralph Lauren?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该没有 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't think so, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜这件应该可以
sense_groups.english: I guess this'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今晚要做什么？ - 没事 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Listen, uh, what are you doing tonight? - Nothing. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要带我的助理泰格 出去玩？
sense_groups.english: How would you feel about taking out my assistant Tag?

sense_groups.chinese: 我付钱 - 呵
sense_groups.english: I'll pay. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 要我跟男人出去约会 可得付我一大笔钱
sense_groups.english: It's gonna take a lot of money for me to go out on a date with a dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是要你跟他约会
sense_groups.english: I'm not asking you to go on a date with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？因为我真的很缺钱
sense_groups.english: Really? Because I could kind of use the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 他刚搬到这里来 我知道他没有男性朋友
sense_groups.english: Joey, just... He's new in town and he doesn't have any guy friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 带他去看球赛或做别的事 我会非常成激你
sense_groups.english: Take him to a ball game or something. I'd appreciate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 没问题 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay, no problem. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是甜甜圈 - 额
sense_groups.english: Ooh, hey, doughnuts! - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我们来试试看…
sense_groups.english: I know. Let's try a look...

sense_groups.chinese: 出神的表情
sense_groups.english: ...of far-off wonderment.

sense_groups.chinese: 凝视我们的未来 想想我们的婚姻跟以后的日子
sense_groups.english: Gaze into our future and think about our marriage and the days to come.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你的脸到底是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, what is the matter with your face?

sense_groups.chinese: 这张照片应该要表达 "盖勒和宾府喜事"的
sense_groups.english: This picture's supposed to say "Geller and Bing to be married"...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是"英勇女市民 救了快淹死的蠢蛋"
sense_groups.english: ...not "Local woman saves drowning moron."

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈 - 嘿 别笑他
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha. - Hey, don't laugh at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个快淹死的蠢蛋是我的
sense_groups.english: He's my drowning moron.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 对了 就是这样 快拍下来
sense_groups.english: Aw. - That's it, that's it! Take it, take it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这一张
sense_groups.english: I like this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 它似乎是在说 "我爱你所以我要杀了你"
sense_groups.english: It seems to say, "I love you and that's why I have to kill you."

sense_groups.chinese: 不会全部都那么糟糕啦
sense_groups.english: Can't all be bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 找那张你装出 睡眼朦胧的照片
sense_groups.english: Find the one where you make your bedroom eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, there it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 这就是我睡眼朦胧的样子？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, those are my bedroom eyes?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要跟我同床共枕？
sense_groups.english: Why did you ever sleep with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的想提这件事情吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you really want to pull at that thread?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的玩得很开心 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'm having a really good time. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉地铁里那个家伙 舔了你的脖子
sense_groups.english: Sorry that guy on the subway licked your neck.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没关系 他是朋友
sense_groups.english: No, that's okay. He's a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 恕我放肆…
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't mean to be presumptuous...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我有明天 国标舞总决赛的门票
sense_groups.english: ...but I have tickets to the ballroom-dancing finals tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有看准决赛 我想我会看不懂
sense_groups.english: Well, I missed the semifinals, so I think I would just be lost.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道那真的很无聊 但这些票是我的老板…
sense_groups.english: Heh, I know that it's lame, but I got these tickets from my boss...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 别大惊小怪 我去就是 - 不
sense_groups.english: Okay, don't freak out. I'll go. - No, it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的前妻惠特妮
sense_groups.english: My ex-wife Whitney is out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在没办法面对她 那个女人疯了
sense_groups.english: I cannot deal with her now. That woman is crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我知道 等一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, I know. Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯尔的前妻惠特妮就在外面
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Um, that's Whitney, Kyle's ex-wife out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以把她诱开 让我们脱身吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you think you could divert her so we could slip out?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不
sense_groups.english: What? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但我有两张 国标舞总决赛的门票
sense_groups.english: Okay, but I have two tickets to the ballroom-dance finals.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想还是不要吧 菲比
sense_groups.english: I don't think so, Pheebs. I, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我愿意
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那只是因为你是我的朋友 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: But just because you're a friend. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 大舞王
sense_groups.english: Hi, Ginger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要拿回我的钥匙
sense_groups.english: I want my key back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没拿 - 钥匙就那里
sense_groups.english: I don't have it. - It's right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大侦探福尔摩斯
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Okay, Sherlock.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 但你最好快点离开 菲比
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, but you'd better go, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要谢谢你 帮我们诱开凯尔的前妻
sense_groups.english: All right. I just wanted to thank you for diverting Kyle's ex.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气 待会再谈
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, no, you're welcome. We'll, uh, talk about it later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 呵
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 惠特妮 - 嗨 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hi, Whitney. - Hi, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备好要去吃早餐了吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Are you ready for breakfast? - Yep. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯尔的前妻？你应该要诱开她 不是跟她约会
sense_groups.english: Kyle's ex-wife? You were supposed to divert her, not date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能等我一下？ 我得跟这个女人谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Sorry, can you give me a second while I talk to this woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 顺道一提 她没有在这里过夜
sense_groups.english: ...uh, who, by the way, did not spend the night?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay. Eh, heh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确诱开她了 后来我们玩得很开心 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I did divert her, and we ended up having a great time, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一起去看国标舞比赛？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Watching ballroom dancing? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时我们发现 事实上我们都酷呆了
sense_groups.english: That's where we realized we are both super cool people.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 罗斯 凯尔告诉我 她有些很差劲的缺点
sense_groups.english: Look, okay, Ross. Kyle just told me some really bad stuff about her.

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说呢？ - 譬如说她很无情
sense_groups.english: Like what? - Like she's really mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 她喜欢吹毛求疵
sense_groups.english: And she's overly critical and... And... No.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会不经过你的同意 把房间漆成很明亮的颜色
sense_groups.english: She will paint a room a really bright color without even checking with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还会把性当成武器
sense_groups.english: And she uses sex as a weapon.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你的警告
sense_groups.english: Fine. Thank you for warning me.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃早餮时我会注意 油漆跟性武器
sense_groups.english: At breakfast, I'll be on full alert for room painting and sex weapons.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是要跟她约会？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You're still gonna go out with her? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有听到 刚刚我说的话吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, didn't you hear what I just said?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 少来了 你的消息来源有问题
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, come on. I mean, consider the source.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的前夫当然会那么说 请你离开了啦
sense_groups.english: Of course her ex-husband's gonna say that stuff. Now if you'll excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 她疯了
sense_groups.english: No, listen to me, she is crazy!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的门没有隔音功能
sense_groups.english: WHITNEY: Uh, your door isn't soundproof.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到了吧？她就是爱挑剔
sense_groups.english: You see? Nothing is good enough for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 嗨 泰格
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Hi, Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚你跟乔伊玩得开心吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, so did you have fun with, uh, Joey last night?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们去看《尼克队》比赛
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we went to the Knicks game.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Aw, that's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们去酒吧玩 他帮我们泡上好多女人
sense_groups.english: Then we went to this bar, and he hooked us up with all these women.

sense_groups.chinese: 女人？你是说老女人？
sense_groups.english: Women? You mean, like old women?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点老 大概三十岁
sense_groups.english: Kind of old, like 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔 - 我以前没办法…
sense_groups.english: Oh. - I never used to be able...

sense_groups.chinese: 在酒吧里跟女人聊天
sense_groups.english: ...to just talk to girls in bars...

sense_groups.chinese: 但昨晚我就拿到了 二十个电话号码
sense_groups.english: ...but I got, like, 20 phone numbers last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊真的教会你一些事
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. So Joey must have really taught you some stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: A little. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧？那个笑容非常灿烂 轻松 自然
sense_groups.english: See? That's a great smile. Easy, natural.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在假装我手上拿了照相机
sense_groups.english: Now pretend I have a camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的笑容变了 - 我控制不了自己
sense_groups.english: You're changing it. - I can't help it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你想知道 我都是怎么拍沙龙照的吗？
sense_groups.english: All right. You want to know what I do when I take résumé shots?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟我借钱？
sense_groups.english: Borrow money from me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好吧 首先 你得装出自然的样子
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay, first of all, you want to make it look spontaneous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都是这么做的 我会低头 低头 继续低头
sense_groups.english: So here's what I do. I look down, look down, keep looking down.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后抬头
sense_groups.english: Then I look up.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到没？现在你来试试看
sense_groups.english: See? All right, now you try.

sense_groups.chinese: 低头 低头 继续低头
sense_groups.english: Look down. You're looking down. Keep looking down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的鞋子上为什么会有果酱？
sense_groups.english: Why is there jelly on your shoe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃了甜甜圈 - 是喔
sense_groups.english: I had a doughnut. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说昨晚你跟泰格玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: So, I heard you had some fun with Tag last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那家伙还不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that guy's all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你很高兴教他怎么当"乔伊"
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and you had fun teaching him how to be all "Joey."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你知道的 泡马子
sense_groups.english: What? - You know, all the women.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没办法教别人怎么泡马子
sense_groups.english: You can't teach someone to be good with women.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我跟钱德出去 老是泡不到马子
sense_groups.english: That's why I never had any luck with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里耶
sense_groups.english: I'm right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能别再跟他一起出去？
sense_groups.english: Would you mind just not going out with him again?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是你跟他一起去泡马子…
sense_groups.english: Just the idea of you and he and all these women...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道他是我的助理 我不能跟他约会
sense_groups.english: I know he's my assistant, and I can't date him, blah!

sense_groups.chinese: 但这真的让我很困扰 好吗？
sense_groups.english: But it bothers me, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能抢走他
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, you can't take him away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于找到一个 可以跟我一起去泡马子的拍档
sense_groups.english: I got a great partner to pick up girls with. Finally!

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在这里耶
sense_groups.english: I'm still right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你可以跟他谈一谈
sense_groups.english: All right, will you talk to him...

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他跟一大堆女人约会 既空虚又得不到满足
sense_groups.english: ...and tell him how hollow and unsatisfying this dating-tons-of-women thing is?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 在我结束对他的暗恋之前 我不要他跟任何人约会
sense_groups.english: I don't want him to meet anybody until I'm over my crush.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会忘记他的
sense_groups.english: And I will get over it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我并不爱他 那只是肉体上的吸引力
sense_groups.english: It's not like I love him. It's just physical.

sense_groups.chinese: 我常常这样暗恋男人 刚认识你时我就暗恋过你
sense_groups.english: I get these crushes all the time. Hell, I had a crush on you when I met you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 摩妮卡跟我说过
sense_groups.english: I know. Monica told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚认识时 你暗恋过我吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you have a crush on me when you first met me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 有啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 难道你们就是看不到我吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you people not see me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能跟他谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: So will you talk to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 瑞秋 - 我会送你十件罗夫罗兰的衬衫
sense_groups.english: I don't know, Rach. - I'll give you 10 Ralph Lauren shirts.

sense_groups.chinese: 一件
sense_groups.english: One.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 十件 你说十件 你不能反侮
sense_groups.english: No, 10. You said 10. You can't take that back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你有事要跟我谈？
sense_groups.english: Hey. You wanted to talk to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你拿了东西来给我吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You, uh, got something for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这是端秋要给你的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, this is from Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 十件 好吧
sense_groups.english: Ten. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 泰格 跟太多女人约会 是不好的
sense_groups.english: Tag, there's such a thing as too many women.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对你来说是的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你来了 - 我来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, there you are. - There I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？ - 没事 乔伊说我需要放轻松
sense_groups.english: You okay? - Yeah, Joey said I, uh, needed to relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 他给我吃抗组胺药
sense_groups.english: So he gave me an antihistamine.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 对啊
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我搭地铁时睡着了 结果到了布鲁克林
sense_groups.english: Then I fell asleep on the subway and went to Brooklyn.

sense_groups.chinese: 布鲁克林好远
sense_groups.english: Brooklyn is far.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在想什么？
sense_groups.english: What were you thinking?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 因为现在我知道要怎么拍照了
sense_groups.english: But don't worry, because I know how to take a picture now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 看吧 低头
sense_groups.english: Okay, see. Look down.

sense_groups.chinese: 低头
sense_groups.english: Look down.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Chandler? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟疯婆子还好吧？ 她把你的兔子拿去煮了吗？
sense_groups.english: So how are things going with Crazy? Has she cooked your rabbit yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你只听到片面之词 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, you are hearing one side of the story. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 她拿了三十份 油漆样本给凯尔看…
sense_groups.english: FYI, she must have shown Kyle over 30 paint samples...

sense_groups.chinese: 之后才动手漆房间
sense_groups.english: ...before she painted that room.

sense_groups.chinese: 他对每一份样本的反应是 "我一点都不在乎"
sense_groups.english: And his response to each one was, "I don't give a tiny rat's ass."

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她该少花点时间在装潢上
sense_groups.english: Maybe she should have spent a little less time decorating...

sense_groups.chinese: 多花一点时间在卧室里
sense_groups.english: ...and a little more time in the bedroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们不会 有那样的问题
sense_groups.english: I don't think we are going to have that problem...

sense_groups.chinese: 但或许那是因为 我不会吝于付出感情
sense_groups.english: ...but maybe that's because I am not emotionally unavailable.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为他吝于付出感情？
sense_groups.english: You think he's emotionally unavailable?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想有那个可能
sense_groups.english: I think he can be.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她没有…
sense_groups.english: Maybe he wouldn't be...

sense_groups.chinese: 每晚把公事带回家做 或许他就不会那样子
sense_groups.english: ...if she didn't bring the office home every night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得原谅她 知道该怎么面对她的生活
sense_groups.english: Well excuse her for knowing what she wants to do with her life.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的确知道 她在1997年除夕做了什么
sense_groups.english: Well, she certainly knew what she was doing New Year's Eve 1997.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你会那么说
sense_groups.english: I knew you were gonna throw that in my face!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是三年前的事 她一再地道歉
sense_groups.english: That was three years ago. She apologized and apologized.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还想怎么样？
sense_groups.english: What more do you want?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要找回六年的时光
sense_groups.english: We want the last six years back!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也是
sense_groups.english: So do we! So do we!

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉让你们看这一慕
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry you had to see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 瑞秋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Morning, Rachel. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚你做了什么？
sense_groups.english: Hey, so, uh, what'd you do last night?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟乔伊出去 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Went out with Joey. - Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们又去泡妞了？
sense_groups.english: Another night of bird-dogging the chicas?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们坐下来长谈 - 哦
sense_groups.english: No, we had a really good talk. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不会 再去酒吧泡女人了
sense_groups.english: I don't think I'm gonna do that bar scene anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没想到你会那么说
sense_groups.english: Wow, I did not see that coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是真正的我
sense_groups.english: It's just not really who I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都很快乐 当…
sense_groups.english: No, I've always been happier when...

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要告诉你这件事？
sense_groups.english: Why am I telling you this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会关心这种事 - 不 我很关心
sense_groups.english: You don't care about this stuff. - Yes, I do. I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚你说 "我一直都很快乐 当…"
sense_groups.english: Go on. You were saying, "I'm happier when I'm..."

sense_groups.chinese: 当我谈恋爱时
sense_groups.english: When I'm in a relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢女朋友陪在身边 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: I love having a girlfriend. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以好好宠爱她
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Someone I can spoil, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 宠爱？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Sp... Spoil? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要问你一件事 - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you something. - Uh-huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信我们都在寻找另一半吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you believe there's one perfect person for everyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始相信了
sense_groups.english: I'm starting to.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那个人已经出现在你的生命中 你应该努力去争取吗？
sense_groups.english: If that person's in your life, you should do something about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 当然
sense_groups.english: Yes. Hell, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那么我就安心了 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, then, it's settled. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟我前女友复合 - 我愿意
sense_groups.english: I'm getting back together with my ex. - I would love to!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该会谈上一阵子 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh. This is gonna be a while. Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Um, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: My God!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 吵到你了吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Is that annoying?

sense_groups.chinese: 说到在床上很自私 惠特妮还好吗？
sense_groups.english: And speaking of being selfish in bed, how's Whitney?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她不必在床上很自私…
sense_groups.english: Maybe she wouldn't have to be selfish in bed...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果另一个人知道 哪里是哪里
sense_groups.english: ...if someone else knew where everything was.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的确知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, he knows. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 大部份啦
sense_groups.english: For the most part.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 太好了 你们两个都在
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. Good, you're both here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得谈一谈
sense_groups.english: We kind of need to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个在一起？ - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Both of you together? - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我到凯尔家 拿一些东西
sense_groups.english: Well, I went over to Kyle's last night to pick up a few things...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回忆了一些往事
sense_groups.english: ...and we got to reminiscing.

sense_groups.chinese: 几乎谈了一整个晚上
sense_groups.english: We talked most of the night...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明白 我们会这么气对方…
sense_groups.english: ...and realized the reason we're angry with each other...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为我们还对彼此有感觉
sense_groups.english: ...is because there are still feelings there.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 快说吧 凯尔
sense_groups.english: Oh, just say it, Kyle!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要再试一次
sense_groups.english: We're gonna give it another try.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是说她爱抱怨 常常要人注意她吗？
sense_groups.english: What about her whining, and her constant need for attention?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会努力调整自己
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna work on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 因为你很善变
sense_groups.english: Oh, right, because you're so capable of change.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 他会边尿边哼歌
sense_groups.english: You know, he hums when he pees.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 所以他都尿不准 但那不重要
sense_groups.english: I do know. - Makes him miss the bowl, but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很抱歉
sense_groups.english: We're so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我们不需要你们 我已经忘了这件事
sense_groups.english: That's all right. We don't need you. I'm over it already.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我根本一点都不在乎
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I don't even give a tiny rat's ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得走了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we're gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Agh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你没有看错她
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, you were right about her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的确试图把性当成武器
sense_groups.english: You know, she did try to use sex as a weapon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的背有一点痛
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I hurt my back a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 他做其他事时 也会哼歌
sense_groups.english: You know, he hums while he does other stuff too.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有他们 我们能过得更好 - 呵
sense_groups.english: We're better off without them. - Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算他们再分手 千万别让他 加入你的伤心男子俱乐部
sense_groups.english: Even if they break up again, you better not let him in your sad men's club.

sense_groups.chinese: 是离婚男人俱乐部 - 有什么不一样呢
sense_groups.english: Divorced men's club. - Potato, "potato."

sense_groups.chinese: 大家快来看
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈把报纸寄给我 - 我们来瞧瞧
sense_groups.english: My mom sent me the paper. - Ooh, let's see it. Yay.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来不错 - 你们看起来很配
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, that looks good. - You make a very attractive couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们是天生一对 － 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we look great together. - We really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 想像一下我们的孩子会是什么模样
sense_groups.english: Imagine what our kids would look like.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必想像
sense_groups.english: You know, we don't have to imagine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要娶她
sense_groups.english: I'm marrying her.

sense_groups.chinese: 走着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: We'll just see.

questions.name: S07E06
questions.en:
The reason I asked you to brunch...
...is because I've been thinking about my maid of honor.
Oh, my God. This is it. Oh.
I hope it's you.
I hope it's you. - Me too.
First of all, I love you both so much.
You're both so important to me. - Blah, blah, blah. Who is it?
I was thinking we could come up with a system...
...where we trade off being maid of honor.
Hypothetically, if Phoebe were mine... - Yes! Oh.
Hypothetically.
Still.
If Phoebe were mine, Rachel would be Phoebe's, I'd be Rachel's.
We all get to do it and no one gets upset.
That's a pretty good idea. - I'll do that. So who's yours?
Well, that's the best part. You guys get to decide.
Why is that the best part? - I don't have to.
Of course we'll help you decide. We'll do anything we can to help you.
I'd like to make a toast.
To the future Mrs. Chandler Bing...
...my best friend and truly one of the nicest people that...
Really not deciding. - Fine.
Excuse me, I couldn't help overhearing.
You're marrying Chandler Bing? - Yeah.
Huh.
Good luck!
Oh, and good luck to you too!
What a nice lady.
Yeah!
Die Hard, still great. - Yep.
Let's make it a double feature?
What else did you rent?
Die Hard 2.
Joey, this is Die Hard 1 again.
Well, we'll watch it a second time and it's Die Hard 2.
Joey, we just saw it. - And?
It would be cool to see it again!
Yeah! Die Hard! - Die Hard!
Dude, you didn't say Die Hard.
Is everything okay?
Yeah, I just got plans.
Well, John McClane had plans.
I want to leave before Joey gets all worked up...
...and starts calling everybody "bitch."
What are you talking about, bitch?
Hey, Rachel. - Yeah?
When I get married, will you be my maid of honor?
Really?
Oh, my God, Phoebe. I mean, I'm just...
Wait a minute.
If I'm your maid of honor, that means that you are Monica's.
Oh.
Well, if that's what you want. - Oh!
No way, Phoebe. I want to be Monica's.
Why does it even matter? - Why does it matter to you?
Because this one is now.
And it's two of our best friends.
And who knows what you're gonna marry.
What if I marry Ross? Or Joey?
You wouldn't.
Okay, look, Rachel. I know you really want to do this...
...but I've never been maid of honor to anyone before.
I know you've done it at least twice.
Yeah, but, Phoebe... - Please let me finish.
I guess that was it.
Okay.
Okay. Since you've never done it before, you can be Monica's maid of honor.
Oh, thank you so much!
Yay.
I'm gonna marry someone good.
Oh, I know.
Better than Chandler. - Pfft.
What happened? - I don't know.
We fell asleep. That is all.
Yeah. Yeah? Yeah.
All right, well, I'd better go.
I think that would be best. - Yeah.
I'll talk to you later. - Okay.
But not about this. - No, never. Never!
So, uh... - Uh...
Bye. - No touch. No touch.
Hey, a weird thing happened at brunch.
This woman overheard that I was marrying you...
...and she wished me good luck.
That's sweet.
No, it was more like a "good luck."
So, what did this woman look like?
She was like 30, dark hair, attractive.
Any chance you were looking into a bright, shiny thing called a mirror?
Was it someone you dated in college?
No, I only dated two girls in college...
...both blond, both not attractive.
Let me check this out.
What are you doing? - Well, let's see.
Okay, uh, is that her?
Oh, my God, yes!
Who is she? - Julie Graff, my camp girlfriend.
Did you break up with her?
No, we're still together.
We went out for two summers and then I broke up with her.
Why? - She came back the third summer...
...and she'd gotten really fa... Ahh.
Fat? - I did not say fat.
I said fa... Ahh.
You broke up with a girl because she was fat?
Yeah. Yeah.
But it was a really long time ago. Does she still feel bad?
Apparently she does.
You know what they say, "Elephants never forget."
Seriously, good luck marrying me.
Hey, what's going on?
Phoebe is gonna be Monica's maid of honor.
Hey. Hope it goes better than the last time you did it for that girl downstairs.
You have been maid of honor before?
You see? This is exactly why you shouldn't lie.
That's it. I am maid of honor.
No, I am. - How come you are?
Because I cared enough to lie.
Hey, I could help you decide who should do it.
We could have an audition.
See how you'd handle maid-of-honor-type situations.
What are you talking about? - When I want a job...
...I audition and if I'm the best of the people they see...
...they give me the part.
Okay, so after this audition, who decides who gets it?
Oh, me and Ross can be the judges.
It's better than us deciding. - Oh, this is crazy.
Can't we just flip a coin? - No, coins hate me.
Okay, fine. You know what? We will let Ross and Joey decide.
Hi!
Ross, sweetie.
Hey there, handsome thing.
Wow, this cologne really is every bit as good as Giorgio.
Hey.
Just brought back your videos.
Hey, Ross. Look, I think we need to talk about before.
No. No, we don't.
Yes, we do.
Now, look. That was the best nap I ever had.
I don't know what you're talking about.
Come on, admit it.
That was the best nap you ever had.
I've had better.
Okay. When?
All right! All right! It was the best nap ever!
Ah! - I said it, okay?
But it's over, Joey!
I want to do it again.
We can't do it again.
Why not? - Because it's weird!
Fine.
You want a drink?
Sure. What do you got? - Warm milk and Excedrin PM.
Chandler.
I just figured out who you are.
Can you figure out what I'm doing?
You're Louis Posen. - Who?
He was my best friend in fifth grade.
One day, I asked him to be my boyfriend and he said no.
Do you know why?
Because you kept talking to him while he was trying to go to the bathroom?
No, but because he thought I was too fa... Ahh.
Every time I think about it, I feel as bad as I did then.
I really think you should apologize to Julie.
Honey, are you kidding? That was like 16 years ago.
It would make me feel better if Louis apologized to me.
I'll do it. But I warn you, this may make me a better person.
And that is not the man you fell in love with.
This is how it's gonna work.
We'll give you hypothetical maid-of-honor situations.
You'll be scored on a scale of one to 10.
One being the highest. - Ten is the highest.
Why is 10 the highest? - Because it's the highest.
Okay, Rachel, you're up first.
Situation number one: You're with Monica.
The wedding is about to start when Monica gets cold feet. Go!
I don't want to marry Chandler.
I've got cold feet. - It's gonna be okay.
One man the rest of my life? I don't know.
This means I'll never get to sleep with Joey.
Look, Monica...
...getting cold feet is very common.
It's just because of all the anticipation.
And you just have to remember that you love Chandler.
And also, I ran out on a wedding.
You don't get to keep the gifts.
Very good, drawing on your own experience.
Very good.
Yes, very nice, Rachel.
Thank you, judges.
Kiss-ass. - Oh.
Okay, Phoebe. - Yes, Your Honor.
We're now in the ceremony.
Monica is about to say, "I do"...
...when her drunk uncle starts yelling.
What do you do? Go!
When Monica was a little girl...
...I remember that...
Ow!
Very good! - Oh.
Yes, excellent. Perfect score.
She just made a scene in the middle of the ceremony!
Hey, you want a little taste of Pheebs?
It is time for you to give your maid-of-honor speech.
We haven't even prepared...
Go! - Okay, okay, okay. Um...
Webster's Dictionary defines marriage as...
Okay, no! Forget that! That sucks! Okay, never mind. Forget it. Um, um...
I met... I met Monica when we were just a couple of 6-year-olds...
...and became friends with Chandler when he was 25...
...although he seemed like a 6-year-old.
Oh.
Thank you. Thank you very much. Um...
I've known them separately and together.
To know them as a couple is to know that you are truly in the presence of love.
So I would like to raise my glass...
...to Monica and Chandler...
...and the beautiful adventure they are about to embark upon together.
I can think of no two people better prepared for the journey.
Wow.
Great speech. - Yeah, it really was.
Oh, thanks.
Okay, Phoebe, I guess you're next. Although I really don't see the point.
Okay.
I can't believe that Monica and Chandler are getting married.
I remember talking about this day with Rachel...
...while we were showering together, naked.
And she's back in the game!
Julie. Hi.
Chandler Bing. I guess you remember me.
Hello, Skidmark.
It's a nickname. I'll explain later.
It's pretty clear.
I owe you a long-overdue apology.
I shouldn't have broken up with you because you were overweight.
That's why you broke up with me?
You didn't know that?
Well, I guess my work here is done.
First of all, I would like to say you both performed very well, okay?
You should be proud.
And I'd also like to say, in this competition, there are no losers.
Well, except Rachel. Damn it!
Really? I won?
What? - I'm sorry, Rach, it was really close.
Well, then I demand a recount! - Actually, it wasn't that close.
You know what? Your thing was so stupid anyway.
We're gonna flip a coin, all right?
Heads. Oh!
What? The coins have finally forgiven me!
You know what? I hope Monica forgives you after you throw her...
...her vegetarian-voodoo-goddess-circle-y shower.
Rach, it's gonna be okay. You guys are the best!
Boy, I tell you. That judging stuff took a lot out of me.
Yeah? - Yeah.
Thinking about maybe going upstairs and taking a little nap on my couch.
Why would I care about that?
No reason. I'm just saying that...
...that's where I'll be.
As bad as that went, I actually enjoyed myself.
I think that I'm going to apologize for all the stupid things that I do.
Why don't you just stop doing stupid things?
Then you wouldn't have to apologize. - I'd love it if I could do both.
All right, I have to ask.
What?
Will you break up with me if I get fat again?
What?
You broke up with Julie. How much weight did she gain?
A hundred and forty-five pounds.
In one year?
My God, what did she eat? Her family?
That's not the point.
I know it was a stupid reason to break up with someone, but I was 15.
Yeah, well, that's not the only time this was an issue.
You remember when you spent Thanksgiving with us?
You called me fat.
Wait a minute.
That was totally different. - How?
You were not supposed to hear that. I said that behind your back.
What if I have babies, okay? I'm gonna look different.
I'm okay with that, but I'm not sure you are.
You have to realize I don't think of you as a thin, beautiful woman.
This is one of the things that I can apologize for later.
What I mean is, you're Monica.
Okay? And I am in love with Monica.
Keep going.
So you can balloon up or you can shrink down...
...and I will still love you.
Even if I shrink down to 2 inches tall?
I'd carry you around in my pocket.
I love you.
Skidmark still got a way with the ladies.
Hi, Pheebs.
Hi. - Hi.
I just want to apologize.
I'm really sorry I was a baby.
That's ridiculous. Rachel, we were all babies once.
Oh, you mean today. - Yeah.
Yeah, and you know, you deserve to win.
And I was thinking about it.
If you're Monica's maid of honor, I get to be yours.
Oh, yeah. - Yeah.
When Monica and Chandler got engaged, I put some stuff together.
Just in case. - Oh, that's so sweet. Thanks.
Here is a book of poetry that I know Monica loves.
Oh, God, this is funny. Look.
Here's a picture from one Halloween when she dressed up as a bride.
She made me carry her train...
...which was weird because I was Wonder Woman.
Oh, and here's a little purse that I found.
I just thought they could hold the rings in there.
Oh. - Something. And...
...vintage handkerchiefs, you know, because people cry at weddings.
I'm just gonna grab a couple of these.
This stuff is great.
I forgot this was in here.
This was the garter that I was saving for my wedding.
And I wanted it to be Monica's "something borrowed."
And it's blue.
Yeah.
Rach, I think that you should be Monica's maid of honor.
You do?
Why? - Because I think it means more to you.
But, Pheebs, honey, you earned it.
It's fine. I mean, this is something...
...that you've been thinking about since you were, what, 14?
No, I was 10. I just developed early.
Man alive!
Hey, what's going on? - Hey!
We decided Rachel is going to be your maid of honor.
Oh, that's great!
Oh, wow. Okay, we really have to start planning.
I have really specific ideas.
We should meet four times a week.
Come to my place, we'll get together before work.
What do you say, 6:30, my place? So excited!
Yeah, okay. You laugh now.
She's gonna be yours.
Great nap.
It really was.
Dude, what the hell are you doing?
God!
Excuse me.
