Today was great. Thanks. - I know.
Okay.
And Joey, last night was fun.
Yeah. I'll call you.
I'll call you too. - Or I'll call you.
And call me. - Okay.
Good to see you again. - Bye.
Bye-bye. - Bye.
The system kind of broke down, huh?
Joey, I'm sorry. I just couldn't tell her all those things.
And we got to talking, and I...
We want you to marry her.
What?
She is so amazing. You have no idea.
Who do you think brought her here?
Cupid.
She's so cool. She speaks four languages.
Man, do you know what guys want.
Come on, she's so perfect for you. She's sweet.
She likes baseball. She had two beers at lunch.
My beers?!
Look, she's a very nice girl.
We had a very good time, but I don't see it going anywhere.
You always say that.
Maybe if you gave her a chance, it would go somewhere.
I'm sorry, you guys. I just don't think so.
Whatever. - Fine.
Hey, don't start judging me.
You're in love with your assistant.
You're sleeping with the guy who keeps pigeons on the roof.
Phoebe!
Secret affair.
People are doing it in front of my book.
I'm sorry?
My doctoral dissertation is in the library at school. I went to see it.
And there were students making babies right in the paleontology section.
Oh, my God. Did you get to see anything good?
At your school...
...was there a place on campus where students went to fool around?
Yeah, there was.
In the corner of the library where all the books were that nobody ever read.
Yes, there was.
Great, because people kept showing up. I think it's like a thing.
Hold on a second.
Fifth floor, against that back wall?
Oh, for crying out loud!
So we should go catch our movie. - What's the rush?
I'd like to see the previews.
The candy.
Oh, hey. - Well, look who's here.
Hey, Joey. - Hey, Erin.
Hey, Rachel. - Hi.
We were about to take off and see a movie.
Oh, no! - What's wrong?
Phoebe, we forgot that party we have to go to.
Oh, no.
What party?
A birthday party.
Whose birthday party?
Alison's birthday party.
Oh. And how old is Alison?
Thirty-two.
Wait a minute. Why don't you guys do something?
Look how that worked out.
Excuse me. Hi, I'm a professor here.
Do you know the paleontology section, fifth floor, stack 437?
Well, yes. Just give me five minutes.
I just have to find someone to cover my shift.
No, no, no.
Can I speak to someone in charge?
How can I help?
Hi, I was wondering, is it possible to increase security...
...in the paleontology section?
I wrote a book that's up there.
And instead of reading it, people are...
Well, they're rolling around in front of it.
We are aware of the problem you're referring to.
As far as increasing security, I'm afraid the library's understaffed.
I can't help you.
Well, fine.
If I'm the only person with any appreciation...
...of the sanctity of the written word, then I'll go defend it myself.
Don't you follow me.
Hey. - Hey.
How did it go with Erin? - Unbelievable.
We had the best time.
Yay!
So you're not mad anymore? - No, no. You guys were totally right.
This was much better than the first date.
It was awkward. We were both nervous.
Didn't you sleep together? - Yeah, that calms me down.
And we have so much in common.
She loves sandwiches, sports. Although she is a Met fan.
Not an issue now, but if we had kids...
Oh, my God! Listen to you talking about having kids.
Oh, my Joey.
Please don't get married before I do. - Oh.
Oh!
I just cannot believe that Clark stood me up.
He may still show up.
What are you, stupid?
It's been three hours. - Is that all?
Let's go on to happier things.
Why don't you tell me about your lovely wedding?
There was something that we wanted to tell you about the wedding.
It's going to be a small ceremony.
Tiny.
We're not even sure why we're having it.
It's actually going to be just family.
Oh, wait.
You two think of me as family?
I have to ask you something now, and be honest.
Do you want me to sing "Careless Whisper" or "Lady in Red"?
How can you say that? The Mets have no closer.
What about Benitez? - What about game one of the Series?
What about shut up? - You shut up.
I love arguing with her.
Be right back. - Okay.
How's it going with Joey?
Oh, okay.
Okay?
Tell me that you like him, please. I mean, tell me that you like him.
He's a really great guy, and I know you really want this to work out...
...but I just don't see this having a future.
What?
But you said that you liked him. What happened?
Did you just change your mind?
Kind of. - Then change it back!
I'm sorry. It's just there's no real spark.
Didn't you sleep together?
Yeah.
Tramp.
Does Joey have any idea?
I don't think he does. You know what?
Maybe you could tell him I'm not interested...
...in a serious relationship.
You mean, like, that you're kind of a loner?
Yeah, that'd be great.
And maybe that you're a real stronzo. - I'm sorry?
I guess Italian isn't one of the four languages you speak.
Hey. Want to go? - Yeah, let's go.
Okay. See you guys later. - Bye, guys.
Hey, thank you so much.
Wow.
I guess it wasn't Cupid that brought her here.
No, just a regular old flying dwarf.
Yes, yes. How can I help you?
We were just looking around.
Oh, you're fellow scholars.
What exactly were you looking for?
Perhaps...
Perhaps Dr. Chester Stock's musings...
...on the Smilodon californicus?
Uh... - Uh! Uh!
Get out of here!
Meeting someone?
Or are you just here to brush up...
...on Merriam's views on evolution?
Actually, I find Merriam's views far too progressionist.
I find Merriam's views far too progressionist.
I'm sorry. Who are you?
I'm a professor here. Ross Geller.
Ross Geller? Why do I know that name? It's a...
Wait.
Did you write this?
Yes.
You're the person who checked out my book?
You know, you look nothing like I would have thought.
You're so young.
Well, I skipped fourth grade.
I am very, very sorry.
Hey. - Hey.
Hi.
So how was your date? - Great. We walked around the Village.
We went to this ice cream place. Split a milk shake.
Seventy-thirty, but still.
I'm thinking of taking her upstate to one of those bed-and-breakfasts.
Really? She said she wants to go?
No, it's a surprise. It's gonna be tricky, because she's busy at work.
Oh. - Oh.
Joey, look, honey, we need to talk, okay?
Um...
I got the feeling from her...
...that she's not looking for a serious relationship.
Where are you getting this? - She told me.
She said she's kind of a loner.
Oh.
Joey... - Hey, Rach, it's cool, you know.
I'm a loner too, right?
Hey, Joey. You know what? You are way too good for her.
I promise, next time I will tell them you're not looking for a relationship.
No.
No, don't do that. Just...
Next time, make sure she likes me. - Well, that too.
Joey?
Yeah?
Do you want some pancakes? - Finally.
What are we gonna do?
I say we go with "Careless Whisper."
Chandler?
Did she see us yet? Did she see us?
Janice, what are you doing here?
I thought I was gonna go back to my apartment...
...but I just felt like I really couldn't be alone tonight.
I was just wondering if I could maybe stay here with you.
Just I really feel like I need to be with family.
Our kids are gonna call her Aunt Janice, aren't they?
Please. Because otherwise, I really don't know what I might do.
Aren't you just a teensy bit curious?
You have any tissues? - Yeah, in the bathroom.
We'll just let her stay.
No. If we let her stay, she will stay forever.
Kind of like your Barcalounger. - Is that what you're thinking about?
I never stop thinking about it.
Hey, you guys?
Do either one of you want to get in there before I take my bath?
Janice, I'm sorry...
...but you can't stay here tonight.
Why not?
Honestly?
Our apartment is a hotbed...
...for electromagnetic activity.
Monica and I have been immunized, but sadly...
...you have not.
I'm gonna need a comforter.
Do you have a hypoallergenic one? Because otherwise I get very nasal.
Do you have a cat? Because it's already happening.
Eh. Do you hear that? Listen.
Oh, my God! Oh, my God! You have to go.
Why?
Because Chandler still has feelings for you.
He does?
Say again?
That's right. That's right.
And that is why you can't stay here tonight.
And probably why you shouldn't come to the wedding.
Feelings. Such strong feelings.
I mean, I realize that his feelings may never completely go away...
...but you can.
Oh, my God.
I understand. I am so sorry.
I'll go.
Goodbye, Monica.
I wish you a lifetime of happiness with him.
Chandler.
You call me when this goes in the pooper.
I've got this section covered.
Yeah, in fact, I've got this baby to shine in people's eyes.
Okay, see you later.
I just wanted to show Monica your book.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Morning. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会还顺利吗？
sense_groups.english: How was your date?

sense_groups.chinese: 很不错 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Pretty good. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 天啊 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Aah! - My God. Sorry about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Okay, really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 我要迟到了
sense_groups.english: I gotta go. I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要把她丢给我？
sense_groups.english: You're going to leave her with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 她真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, she's a terrific girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我一个忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you do me a favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能跟她说我不想定下来吗？谢谢你帮我这个大忙
sense_groups.english: Could you mention I'm not looking for a relationship? That'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你在开玩笑吗？
sense_groups.english: What, are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 不经意跟她提起这件事 装做轻描淡写的样子
sense_groups.english: Just casually slip it in, you know. Lay the groundwork.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉她我是个独行侠 不 我是爱的逃犯
sense_groups.english: Tell her I'm a loner. No, an outlaw.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会想跟我这种人混在一起
sense_groups.english: She doesn't want to get mixed up with the likes of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太复杂了
sense_groups.english: That's a lot to remember.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能直接告诉她你是猪吗？
sense_groups.english: Can't I tell her that you're a pig?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会找时间亲自打电话给她
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna call her later myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证
sense_groups.english: Honest.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德以前常这么做 他还会做煎饼给她吃
sense_groups.english: Chandler used to do it. He'd make her pancakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还会多做几块留给我吃
sense_groups.english: He'd make extras and leave them for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都不会告诉她 这不是我的责任
sense_groups.english: I'm not telling her anything. It's not my responsibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些煎饼应该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Now, where did we land on those pancakes?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我没办法把门锁上
sense_groups.english: Sorry, but I couldn't get that lock to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我搬进来时 乔伊就把它弄坏了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Joey kind of disabled it when I moved in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定是瑞秋 我是艾玲 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: You must be Rachel. I'm Erin. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想跟高中女生一样无聊 但他有跟你谈到我吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't mean this to sound like high school, but did he talk about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃煎饼吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like some pancakes?

sense_groups.chinese: 快说吧 我们为什么要来这里？ - 好吧 猜一下
sense_groups.english: Come on. Why are we here? - Okay, okay, take a guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有辣妹？
sense_groups.english: The hot chicks?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 之前我将一些名字 输入图书馆的电脑里…
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, I was typing names into the library computer earlier...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 只是为了好玩
sense_groups.english: ...you know, for fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我输入我的名字 你猜我发现了什么？
sense_groups.english: And I typed mine in, and guess what came up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的博士论文
sense_groups.english: My doctoral dissertation.

sense_groups.chinese: 它就放在大学中最大的图书馆里
sense_groups.english: It's right down here in the biggest library in the university.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 那真的很酷
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's actually pretty cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里还收藏了一本书 作者是叫做温蒂巴琴娜的女人
sense_groups.english: There's also a book here by a woman named Wendy Bagina.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是怎么一回事？
sense_groups.english: What is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来这两个家伙 真的很喜欢杜威十进分类法
sense_groups.english: Sounds like two people are really enjoying the Dewey decimal system.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: We're so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该不会是带我 来这里做那档子事吧？
sense_groups.english: You didn't bring me here to do that, did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 她又把鸡肉退了回来？
sense_groups.english: She sent the chicken back again?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说鸡肉太干 想亲自跟你解释 她要什么样的鸡肉
sense_groups.english: She said it's too dry and wants to explain to you how she wants it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我倒想会会这个鸡肉专家
sense_groups.english: I'd like to meet this chicken expert.

sense_groups.chinese: 叫她进来吧
sense_groups.english: Send the colonel in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 幸运的混蛋
sense_groups.english: Lucky bastard.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 - 你好吗…
sense_groups.english: Janice. - How are you...

sense_groups.chinese: 高级大餐厅里 处理上等鸡肉的辣妹大厨师
sense_groups.english: ...Ms. Hotshot-Chef-at-the-Big-Fancy- Restaurant-With-the-Best-Chicken-Ever?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你手上戴了什么？我看不见了
sense_groups.english: Oh, what is that on your finger? I'm blind.

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是那个幸运的男人？
sense_groups.english: So who's the lucky guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 甜心
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有告诉她我们将会结婚吧？
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell her we're engaged?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看到戒指了 - 她被吓到了吗？
sense_groups.english: She saw the ring. - Did she freak out?

sense_groups.chinese: 她的确吓了一大跳 但很多人都吓了一大跳
sense_groups.english: She was shocked, but then again, so were most people.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上她也交了男朋友
sense_groups.english: She actually has a boyfriend herself.

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫做克拉克
sense_groups.english: Name's Clark.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还邀请自己来参加我们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: She also invited herself to our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有克拉克
sense_groups.english: Clark too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拒绝了她吧？
sense_groups.english: You said no, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你拒绝了她吧？
sense_groups.english: You said no, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 她逼得我头晕 还质问我 婚礼是不是在城里举行
sense_groups.english: She cornered me. She asked me if the wedding was in town.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？ - 说谎骗她
sense_groups.english: What was I supposed to do? - Lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 那会有多难呢？"你的支票寄出去了"
sense_groups.english: How hard is that? "Your check's in the mail."

sense_groups.chinese: "你的宝宝好可爱"
sense_groups.english: "Oh, your baby's so cute."

sense_groups.chinese: "我等不及要看你的书 罗斯"
sense_groups.english: "I can't wait to read your book, Ross."

sense_groups.chinese: 她会来参加婚礼 或许那不会是件坏事
sense_groups.english: So she comes to the wedding. Maybe it won't be so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为她会安静地坐着？你不认为她会想举杯致词吗？
sense_groups.english: Think she'll sit quietly? Think she'll want to make a toast?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不认为她会想唱 《兼职情人》吧？
sense_groups.english: You don't think she'll want to sing "Part-Time Lover"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 她不会喜欢鸡肉 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's not gonna like the chicken either, is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？一定会没事的
sense_groups.english: You know what? It'll be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她根本不想来
sense_groups.english: She's probably not gonna even want to come.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 不 那是个谎言
sense_groups.english: Really? - No, that was a lie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道说谎有多容易了吧？
sense_groups.english: See how easy that was?

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你会骗她吗？
sense_groups.english: So you would have just lied?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 它真的那么简单？ - 对
sense_groups.english: It would have really been that easy? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 那星期六表演给我看 我们要跟她和克拉克共进晚餐
sense_groups.english: Do it Saturday. We're having dinner with her and Clark.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你的朋友是谁啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey, who's your friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 - 艾玲
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. - Erin.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在这里
sense_groups.english: You're still here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们整天泡在一起 玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: We ended up spending the day together and had such a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然 艾玲真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Why wouldn't you? Erin is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们也是
sense_groups.english: And then there's you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我得走了
sense_groups.english: Well, listen, I better get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天真的很愉快 谢谢 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Today was great. Thanks. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 昨晚真的很棒
sense_groups.english: And Joey, last night was fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我再打电话给你
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'll call you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会打电话给你 - 我会打电话给你
sense_groups.english: I'll call you too. - Or I'll call you.

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给我 - 好
sense_groups.english: And call me. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能再见到你 - 拜
sense_groups.english: Good to see you again. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 那套系统已经崩溃了？
sense_groups.english: The system kind of broke down, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 对不起 我没办法 告诉她那些话
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm sorry. I just couldn't tell her all those things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始聊起天来 我…
sense_groups.english: And we got to talking, and I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要你娶她
sense_groups.english: We want you to marry her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很棒 你根本不了解她
sense_groups.english: She is so amazing. You have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得是谁把她带回这里的？
sense_groups.english: Who do you think brought her here?

sense_groups.chinese: 丘比特
sense_groups.english: Cupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的好酷 还会说四种语言
sense_groups.english: She's so cool. She speaks four languages.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你们真的知道男人要什么
sense_groups.english: Man, do you know what guys want.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 她跟你是天生一对 她真的很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Come on, she's so perfect for you. She's sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 她喜欢棒球 午餐时喝了两瓶啤酒
sense_groups.english: She likes baseball. She had two beers at lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的啤酒？
sense_groups.english: My beers?!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 她真的是个好女孩
sense_groups.english: Look, she's a very nice girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们相处甚欢 但我不觉得我们会有结局
sense_groups.english: We had a very good time, but I don't see it going anywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 你总是那么说
sense_groups.english: You always say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许只要你给她一次机会 事情就会变得不一样
sense_groups.english: Maybe if you gave her a chance, it would go somewhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我真的不那么认为
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, you guys. I just don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便你 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Whatever. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 别开始评论我
sense_groups.english: Hey, don't start judging me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你爱上了你的助理
sense_groups.english: You're in love with your assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟在屋顶上养鸽子的男人有一腿
sense_groups.english: You're sleeping with the guy who keeps pigeons on the roof.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是秘密恋情
sense_groups.english: Secret affair.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家在我的书面前做那档子事
sense_groups.english: People are doing it in front of my book.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry?

sense_groups.chinese: 学校图书馆收藏了 我的博士论文 我跑去看它
sense_groups.english: My doctoral dissertation is in the library at school. I went to see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 发现学生们在古生物学区做人
sense_groups.english: And there were students making babies right in the paleontology section.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你有看到精彩好戏吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Did you get to see anything good?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们念书的时候…
sense_groups.english: At your school...

sense_groups.chinese: 校园里有没有什么地方 是学生会跑去鬼混的？
sense_groups.english: ...was there a place on campus where students went to fool around?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 真的有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, there was.

sense_groups.chinese: 图书馆的角落里 有些书根本不会有人去借
sense_groups.english: In the corner of the library where all the books were that nobody ever read.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, there was.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 因为大家都会跑到那里去 像是秘密基地一样
sense_groups.english: Great, because people kept showing up. I think it's like a thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hold on a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指五楼后区的墙边吗？
sense_groups.english: Fifth floor, against that back wall?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的老天爷啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, for crying out loud!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该去看电影了 - 干嘛这么急？
sense_groups.english: So we should go catch our movie. - What's the rush?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想看预告片
sense_groups.english: I'd like to see the previews.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要吃糖果
sense_groups.english: The candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 看看是谁来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Well, look who's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 - 嗨 艾玲
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. - Hey, Erin.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正要去看电影
sense_groups.english: We were about to take off and see a movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no! - What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们忘了 我们得去参加派对
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, we forgot that party we have to go to.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么派对？
sense_groups.english: What party?

sense_groups.chinese: 生日派对
sense_groups.english: A birthday party.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁的生日派对？
sense_groups.english: Whose birthday party?

sense_groups.chinese: 爱莉森的生日派对
sense_groups.english: Alison's birthday party.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱莉森几岁了？
sense_groups.english: Oh. And how old is Alison?

sense_groups.chinese: 三十二岁
sense_groups.english: Thirty-two.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你们为什么 不一起出去玩呢？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Why don't you guys do something?

sense_groups.chinese: 这一招还真的有用
sense_groups.english: Look how that worked out.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我是学校里的教授
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Hi, I'm a professor here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道五楼437号书架的 古生物学区吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know the paleontology section, fifth floor, stack 437?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 等我五分钟
sense_groups.english: Well, yes. Just give me five minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得找人来帮我代班
sense_groups.english: I just have to find someone to cover my shift.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能跟负责人谈一谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I speak to someone in charge?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: How can I help?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我想问馆方 能不能增加人手…
sense_groups.english: Hi, I was wondering, is it possible to increase security...

sense_groups.chinese: 巡逻古生物学区？
sense_groups.english: ...in the paleontology section?

sense_groups.chinese: 我写的书放在那里
sense_groups.english: I wrote a book that's up there.

sense_groups.chinese: 但大家去那里不是看书 而是…
sense_groups.english: And instead of reading it, people are...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在我的书面前打滚
sense_groups.english: Well, they're rolling around in front of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道你提及的问题
sense_groups.english: We are aware of the problem you're referring to.

sense_groups.chinese: 但增加巡逻这件事 恐怕馆方的人力不足
sense_groups.english: As far as increasing security, I'm afraid the library's understaffed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮不上你的忙
sense_groups.english: I can't help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我是唯一愿意欣赏…
sense_groups.english: If I'm the only person with any appreciation...

sense_groups.chinese: 书写文字之美的人 我会亲自去捍卫它
sense_groups.english: ...of the sanctity of the written word, then I'll go defend it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 别跟着我
sense_groups.english: Don't you follow me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟艾玲玩得还开心吗？ - 真是不可思议
sense_groups.english: How did it go with Erin? - Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们玩得非常开心
sense_groups.english: We had the best time.

sense_groups.chinese: 呀
sense_groups.english: Yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 那你不再生我们的气了？ - 不 你们是对的
sense_groups.english: So you're not mad anymore? - No, no. You guys were totally right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次比我们第一次约会棒得多
sense_groups.english: This was much better than the first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次真的很尴尬 我们都很紧张
sense_groups.english: It was awkward. We were both nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是上过床了？ - 对 那让我冷静下来
sense_groups.english: Didn't you sleep together? - Yeah, that calms me down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有很多共同点
sense_groups.english: And we have so much in common.

sense_groups.chinese: 她喜欢三明治 运动 虽然她是大都会队的球迷
sense_groups.english: She loves sandwiches, sports. Although she is a Met fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在那不是问题 但如果我们有了孩子…
sense_groups.english: Not an issue now, but if we had kids...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你竟然会提到生孩子的事
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Listen to you talking about having kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你别比我先结婚 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Please don't get married before I do. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信克拉克会放我鸽子
sense_groups.english: I just cannot believe that Clark stood me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能还是会来
sense_groups.english: He may still show up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是笨蛋吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you, stupid?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经等了三小时 - 只有三小时吗？
sense_groups.english: It's been three hours. - Is that all?

sense_groups.chinese: 谈一些比较快乐的事
sense_groups.english: Let's go on to happier things.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不告诉我你们的婚礼呢？
sense_groups.english: Why don't you tell me about your lovely wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 关于我们的婚礼 有件事我们想告诉你
sense_groups.english: There was something that we wanted to tell you about the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼的规模很小
sense_groups.english: It's going to be a small ceremony.

sense_groups.chinese: 小到不行
sense_groups.english: Tiny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们甚至不知道为什么要举行婚礼
sense_groups.english: We're not even sure why we're having it.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我们只会邀请家人来参加
sense_groups.english: It's actually going to be just family.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 等一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们把我当家人看待？
sense_groups.english: You two think of me as family?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得问你们一件事 请老实地回答我
sense_groups.english: I have to ask you something now, and be honest.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要我唱《无心呢喃》 或《红衣女郎》？
sense_groups.english: Do you want me to sing "Careless Whisper" or "Lady in Red"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能那么说？大都会队也好不到哪里去
sense_groups.english: How can you say that? The Mets have no closer.

sense_groups.chinese: 班尼提兹呢？ - 第一场比赛呢？
sense_groups.english: What about Benitez? - What about game one of the Series?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不闭嘴？ - 你才要闭嘴
sense_groups.english: What about shut up? - You shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢跟她吵架
sense_groups.english: I love arguing with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来 - 好
sense_groups.english: Be right back. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟乔伊进行得如何？
sense_groups.english: How's it going with Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 还好
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好？
sense_groups.english: Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 请告诉我你喜欢他 告诉我你真的喜欢他
sense_groups.english: Tell me that you like him, please. I mean, tell me that you like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的很棒 我知道 你们希望我们能成功…
sense_groups.english: He's a really great guy, and I know you really want this to work out...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不觉得我们会有未来
sense_groups.english: ...but I just don't see this having a future.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 但你说过你喜欢他 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: But you said that you liked him. What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 你改变了心意吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you just change your mind?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以那么说 - 那么快改回来
sense_groups.english: Kind of. - Then change it back!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我们之间真的没有火花
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's just there's no real spark.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是上过床了吗？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you sleep together?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 荡妇
sense_groups.english: Tramp.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Does Joey have any idea?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他不知道 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't think he does. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你们可以告诉他我不想…
sense_groups.english: Maybe you could tell him I'm not interested...

sense_groups.chinese: 认真地跟别人交往
sense_groups.english: ...in a serious relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你是个独行侠？
sense_groups.english: You mean, like, that you're kind of a loner?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那个说法不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你真的是个淫娃 - 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: And maybe that you're a real stronzo. - I'm sorry?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你会说的四种语官 不包括义大利文
sense_groups.english: I guess Italian isn't one of the four languages you speak.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 要走了吗？ - 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Hey. Want to go? - Yeah, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. See you guys later. - Bye, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: Hey, thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜不是丘比特把她带来这里的
sense_groups.english: I guess it wasn't Cupid that brought her here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只是一个会飞的老矮人
sense_groups.english: No, just a regular old flying dwarf.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？需要我帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes. How can I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是四处看看
sense_groups.english: We were just looking around.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你们是爱念书的学生
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're fellow scholars.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们到底在找什么？
sense_groups.english: What exactly were you looking for?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许…
sense_groups.english: Perhaps...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想看查斯特史塔克博士…
sense_groups.english: Perhaps Dr. Chester Stock's musings...

sense_groups.chinese: 对剑齿虎的研究？
sense_groups.english: ...on the Smilodon californicus?

sense_groups.chinese: 额… - 额 额
sense_groups.english: Uh... - Uh! Uh!

sense_groups.chinese: 快滚
sense_groups.english: Get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 你来找人吗？
sense_groups.english: Meeting someone?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是你想来看看…
sense_groups.english: Or are you just here to brush up...

sense_groups.chinese: 玛莉安对进化论的看法？
sense_groups.english: ...on Merriam's views on evolution?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我觉得玛莉安的观点 太先进了
sense_groups.english: Actually, I find Merriam's views far too progressionist.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也觉得玛莉安的观点太先进了
sense_groups.english: I find Merriam's views far too progressionist.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你是哪位？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Who are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是本校的教授罗斯盖勒
sense_groups.english: I'm a professor here. Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯盖勒？为什么 那个名字好熟？它是…
sense_groups.english: Ross Geller? Why do I know that name? It's a...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 这本书是你写的吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you write this?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是借走我的书的人？
sense_groups.english: You're the person who checked out my book?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟我想像中完全不一样
sense_groups.english: You know, you look nothing like I would have thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好年轻
sense_groups.english: You're so young.

sense_groups.chinese: 我四年级跳级
sense_groups.english: Well, I skipped fourth grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I am very, very sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的约会还顺利吗？ - 太棒了 我们在格林威治村散步
sense_groups.english: So how was your date? - Great. We walked around the Village.

sense_groups.chinese: 还去了冰淇淋店 一起喝一杯奶昔
sense_groups.english: We went to this ice cream place. Split a milk shake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喝的比较多 但那还是很棒
sense_groups.english: Seventy-thirty, but still.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想带她到北区的民宿 去过一夜
sense_groups.english: I'm thinking of taking her upstate to one of those bed-and-breakfasts.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？她答应了吗？
sense_groups.english: Really? She said she wants to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是个惊喜 但那有点难 因为她的工作很忙
sense_groups.english: No, it's a surprise. It's gonna be tricky, because she's busy at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 甜心 乔伊 我们得谈一谈 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, look, honey, we need to talk, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 她让我觉得…
sense_groups.english: I got the feeling from her...

sense_groups.chinese: 她不想认真地跟别人交往
sense_groups.english: ...that she's not looking for a serious relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会那么想？ - 是她告诉我的
sense_groups.english: Where are you getting this? - She told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她是个独行侠
sense_groups.english: She said she's kind of a loner.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊… - 嘿 瑞秋 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Joey... - Hey, Rach, it's cool, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是个独行侠 对吧？
sense_groups.english: I'm a loner too, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你知道吗？她配不上你
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. You know what? You are way too good for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓下次我会告诉她们 你不想定下来
sense_groups.english: I promise, next time I will tell them you're not looking for a relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别那么做 只要…
sense_groups.english: No, don't do that. Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 下次确定她真的喜欢我 - 对 你说得没错
sense_groups.english: Next time, make sure she likes me. - Well, that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃煎饼吗？ - 终于问了
sense_groups.english: Do you want some pancakes? - Finally.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What are we gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该选《无心呢喃》
sense_groups.english: I say we go with "Careless Whisper."

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看到我们了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did she see us yet? Did she see us?

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 你来这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: Janice, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想回我家去…
sense_groups.english: I thought I was gonna go back to my apartment...

sense_groups.chinese: 但今晚我不想独处
sense_groups.english: ...but I just felt like I really couldn't be alone tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想或许我可以待在你们家
sense_groups.english: I was just wondering if I could maybe stay here with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的觉得我该跟家人在一起
sense_groups.english: Just I really feel like I need to be with family.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的孩子会叫她 珍妮丝阿姨 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Our kids are gonna call her Aunt Janice, aren't they?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 因为我真的不知道 我会做出什么事来
sense_groups.english: Please. Because otherwise, I really don't know what I might do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会有点好奇吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you just a teensy bit curious?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有面纸吗？ - 有 在浴室里
sense_groups.english: You have any tissues? - Yeah, in the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得收留她
sense_groups.english: We'll just let her stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 如果我们收留她 她会永远住在这里
sense_groups.english: No. If we let her stay, she will stay forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像你的躺椅一样 - 你真的那么想？
sense_groups.english: Kind of like your Barcalounger. - Is that what you're thinking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都是那么想
sense_groups.english: I never stop thinking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 两位？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想上洗手间吗？因为我要洗澡了
sense_groups.english: Do either one of you want to get in there before I take my bath?

sense_groups.chinese: 珍妮丝 对不起…
sense_groups.english: Janice, I'm sorry...

sense_groups.chinese: 但今晚你不能留下来
sense_groups.english: ...but you can't stay here tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 实情吗？
sense_groups.english: Honestly?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们家因为电磁辐射的关系…
sense_groups.english: Our apartment is a hotbed...

sense_groups.chinese: 遭到了污染
sense_groups.english: ...for electromagnetic activity.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟我已经免疫了 但不幸地…
sense_groups.english: Monica and I have been immunized, but sadly...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有免疫力
sense_groups.english: ...you have not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要一条棉被
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna need a comforter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有抗过敏的棉被吗？ 不然的话我的鼻子会过敏
sense_groups.english: Do you have a hypoallergenic one? Because otherwise I get very nasal.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们养了猫吗？因为我已经开始过敏了
sense_groups.english: Do you have a cat? Because it's already happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们听到了吗？你们听
sense_groups.english: Eh. Do you hear that? Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你非离开不可
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Oh, my God! You have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为钱德对你还有感觉
sense_groups.english: Because Chandler still has feelings for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: He does?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Say again?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right. That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以今晚你不能留下来
sense_groups.english: And that is why you can't stay here tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你不该来参加婚礼
sense_groups.english: And probably why you shouldn't come to the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉 很强烈的感觉
sense_groups.english: Feelings. Such strong feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我知道他对你的感觉 永远都不会完全消失…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I realize that his feelings may never completely go away...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你可以消失
sense_groups.english: ...but you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I understand. I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会离开的
sense_groups.english: I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Goodbye, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我祝你跟他永远幸福快乐
sense_groups.english: I wish you a lifetime of happiness with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们处得不好 就打电话给我
sense_groups.english: You call me when this goes in the pooper.

sense_groups.chinese: 这区由我负责
sense_groups.english: I've got this section covered.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我会拿着手电筒 照别人的眼睛…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, in fact, I've got this baby to shine in people's eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 待会见
sense_groups.english: Okay, see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是带摩妮卡来看你的书
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to show Monica your book.

questions.name: S07E08
questions.en:
Hey, everybody. Happy Thanksgiving. - Shh.
What, are we keeping Thanksgiving a secret this year?
No, we're playing this game I learned at work.
You have to name all the states in six minutes.
What? That's, like, insanely easy.
No, it's harder than it sounds. You always forget at least one.
Or in some cases, 14.
It's a stupid game and I wasn't playing against other people...
...so technically, I didn't lose.
You forgot 14 states?
Nobody cares about the Dakotas.
Oh, okay, time's up.
All right, I got 48.
Oh, that's not bad. Pheebs?
Oh, I got tired of naming states, so I decided to list the types of celery.
And I have one, regular celery.
Okay, so Rachel's got 48 and Phoebe has the lead in...
...vegetables. Joey?
Say hello to the new champ of Chandler's dumb states game.
Wow, how many you got? - Fifty-six.
Hey, how is New England not a state?
Huh? They have a sports team.
Does South Oregon have a sports team?
There you go.
How come we have one extra place setting?
Because you invited your assistant. - Oh, right, sorry. Tag's not coming.
His girlfriend came into town, so he's spending Thanksgiving with her.
Oh, why didn't you tell me?
I made him his own individual sweet potato stuffed pumpkin.
Oh, well, I was going to, but then I figured, you know...
...your food is so delicious and perfect...
...you can never have too many of those pumpkin things.
You'd think I wouldn't enjoy that because it is so fake, ha, ha, but I still do.
Regular celery.
Oh, I already have that.
Done, with time to spare.
Ooh, this may be a new world's record. - You know, I hate to lecture you guys...
...but it's kind of disgraceful that a group of well-educated adults...
...and Joey, can't name all the states.
You ever see a map or one of those round colorful things called a globe?
Uh, Magellan? You got 46 states.
What? That's impossible. - Forty-six.
Well, who's well-educated now, Mr. I-Forgot-Ten-States?
I'm out of oven space. I'm gonna go turn on Joey's.
Please, watch him. Do not let Joey eat any of the food.
I am only one man.
Okay, time is up. - Give me another minute.
Ross, if you don't know them by now, you will never know them, okay?
That is the beauty of this game. It makes you want to kill yourself.
This is crazy. I can do this.
All right, uh, I bet I can get all 50, uh, before dinner.
Okay, but if you can't, no dinner.
You're on.
All right, don't look at my list, because there's a lot on there that you don't have.
Hey, did you guys know your oven doesn't work?
But the drawer full of takeout menus is okay, right?
Ross, I'm gonna use yours, okay? - Shh.
Chandler, give me a hand.
Sure. Joey, do not let Ross look at any maps or the globe in your apartment.
Don't worry, Chandler. It's not a globe of the United States.
Hey, you guys, I'm gonna go out and take a walk.
Phoebe, why is your bag moving?
Oh, it's not. - Seriously, it's moving.
What the hell's in there? - It's just my knitting. That's all.
Yes, I knit this.
I'm very good.
Ross' apartment is nice. Why don't we hang out here more often?
I don't know. Maybe because it smells weird.
It's like old pumpkins or something.
That's my pie. - Which smells delicious.
Uh-oh. Uh-oh. - What?
We left Joey alone with the food.
Yep, yep, I knew it.
There he is...
...feeding stuffing to a dog.
Hi, Geller-Bing residence. How can I help?
Phoebe, why is there a dog in our apartment?
I'm sorry, who's this?
Phoebe, there's a dog sitting on my couch.
Tell her I'm allergic, and I will sue.
No, there's no dog here. - There is.
He's black and white and shaggy.
He's sitting next to Rachel and licking Rachel's hand.
Oh, my God. Where are you?
I'll be right there.
They're here already? How are they doing this?
Hi, Tag. What are you doing here?
I, uh, wanted to see if your offer to spend Thanksgiving with you was still good.
Well, sure. Come in.
Well, what happened to your girlfriend?
We, uh, kind of broke up this morning.
Oh, I'm sorry. - Yeah, so she went back to Ohio.
Ohio, thank you.
Huh. Where's the dog?
What dog? There's no dog here.
Yeah, that dog left.
Phoebe.
Phoebe, open up.
There's no dog in here.
Phoebe, we can hear the dog barking.
No, that's just me coughing.
Oh, good. There you are.
Listen, um, I have a dog in my room.
What is it doing here?
I'm watching it for friends who went out of town.
Wait.
Hello, my name is Klunkers.
May I please stay with you nice people?
Oh, I wish he could stay here, but Chandler's allergic.
Extremely allergic, okay?
If I am anywhere near a dog for more than five minutes...
...my throat will just close up.
That's odd, because this dog's been living here for the past three days.
Really?
If the dog has been here that long...
...and you haven't had a reaction, maybe you're not allergic to this dog.
Well, it still has to go, right?
Why?
Okay, it's, um... - Don't do it.
Don't do what? - I have to.
Okay? It's time.
Okay, I hate dogs.
What? - That's crazy. Why?
Told you.
They are needy...
...they are jumpy, and you can't tell what they are thinking...
...and that scares me a little bit.
You're right. They are scary. Aah!
She just ate a treat out of my hand!
Wait a minute. Do you not like all dogs? I mean, not even puppies?
Is there a puppy here?
You don't like puppies? - Okay, you are new.
Look, Chandler, I told you. Never tell anyone about this dog thing.
It's like Ross not liking ice cream.
You don't like ice cream? - It's too cold.
Okay, it's just that dogs make me a little uncomfortable.
Hurts my teeth.
I don't wanna say this. I don't want you guys to hate me...
...but, uh, I don't think I can be around that dog anymore, okay?
So either the dog goes or I go. Huh.
Oh, my God.
How can I not get this?
I'm a college professor. I got 1450 on my SATs.
Twelve fifty.
Damn, I forgot you were here.
All right. We're gonna take Klunkers to Ross'.
We'll be back in a minute.
Oh, wait, before you go, can I ask a question?
Um, when a guy breaks up with his girlfriend...
...what is an appropriate amount of time to wait before you make a move?
Oh, I'd say about a month.
Really? I'd say three to four. - Half-hour.
Interesting.
When it's your assistant, I would say never.
All right, Rach, the big question is, does he like you?
Right? Because if he doesn't like you, this is all a moo point.
Huh. A "moo" point?
Yeah. It's like a cow's opinion.
It just doesn't matter.
It's "moo."
Have I been living with him for too long, or did that all just make sense?
Please don't listen to Joey. Okay? Would you look at him?
He's obviously depressed. He's away from his family.
He's spending Thanksgiving with strangers.
What he needs right now is for you to be his friend.
Oh, you're right. I'm sorry. Thank you.
Okay, that's what I'm going to do. - Fine, take their advice.
No one ever listens to me.
When the package is this pretty, no one cares what's inside.
Hey. - Hey.
How you holding up?
Not bad. - Yeah?
I'm sorry about your girlfriend. - Thanks.
Were you guys together a long time? - A year, on and off.
I thought we'd end up together. I don't anymore.
Now that she broke up with you. - Yeah.
Hmm. - It's weird.
I always used to assume that I would meet someone and fall in love and be happy.
That all that was just a given. Well, lately, it's like, what if it's not?
Do you ever have that feeling?
No.
Yeah.
All the time. Constantly. It's terrifying.
But, you know, then I figure it has to work out.
Why?
Because it has to.
You have all the answers, don't you? - Yeah, I know, I do. I really do.
Hey, thanks for talking to me. - Come on, what are bosses for?
Hug it out.
All right, he likes you back.
Huh? Told you you should go for it.
What?
Street noise drown any of that out?
No? All right, I'll see you later. Ha, ha. Okay.
What did Joey say? I like you back?
Uh, yeah... You know, well, see, he...
Joey knows that I'm very insecure about my back.
And... And you were hugging me...
...so obviously you are not repulsed by it. Yeah. Heh.
Wait a minute, that doesn't make any sense.
No?
All right, here's the truth. Ahem.
Joey said what he said because, um...
...I'm attracted to you.
Wow. - Yeah, I admit it.
I have a crush on you. And, uh, I know that's crazy because we work together...
...and nothing could ever happen.
And the last thing I wanted to do was freak you out...
...or make you feel uncomfortable.
Which is why it would be really great if you said something right about now.
Oh, my God. Those guys are stealing my car.
What? - Right there. That's my car.
Hey! - Okay, that's gonna take a minute.
Do you have anything else you wanna get off your chest?
I can't believe this.
Wait, we still have time to talk, and they're not even in the car yet.
Oh, look, there they go. Okay.
Okay, Phoebe. We should probably go back now.
Please, don't leave me. I'll be lonely.
Stop it. Stop.
Okay, let's go. We can be strong. - Yeah, okay.
Oh, my God, did you hear that? She said "Monica."
Oh, I can't leave her.
If you want, we could sneak the dog back in and Chandler wouldn't even know.
That's not gonna work.
I had that dog there for three days and Chandler had no idea.
He's not so smart.
Hey. I didn't know either.
Yeah, but you kind of knew that something was going on, didn't you?
Yeah, I knew. Heh.
Where's Chandler?
Here I am. - Wash your hands.
How did you know?
Hey, what's she doing back here?
Relax, Ross. She's not made of ice cream.
Hey, look, Phoebe. I, uh, laid out the states geographically.
No, no, we don't have time for this.
We have to keep Chandler away from my room.
Yeah, but, look what I...
See, this is exactly what we do not have time for.
Where's Monica? - Uh, in Phoebe's room. You can't go in.
Why not?
Monica's crying.
She's very upset about this whole Klunkers thing.
Well, I should go in there. - No, no.
No, she doesn't want to see you right now.
Why not? - Because you sent away the dog.
That's ridiculous. - Oh, is it? Is it?
Look, when Monica and I were kids, we had a dog named Rover.
And, um, one day, my dad decides he doesn't like dogs.
So Monica and her friend... Phyllis...
...take away the dog, and that was the last time we ever saw him.
Don't you see? This is just like that...
...only with a few details changed.
Okay, I'm in my sweatpants.
Bring on the food.
What's the matter? - Monica's all upset...
...because I sent Klunkers away.
So? Bring the dog back. You're a hero.
Yeah, I could be a hero. I could do that. I could... I could do...
What if it...? What if it attacks me?
Chandler, it's like a big gerbil.
And that doesn't scare you?
Ross, you need some help?
From you?
Yes, please.
First of all, Utah?
Dude, you can't just make stuff up.
I hate America.
When I finish this game, I swear I am moving.
Hey. Tag still talking to the police? - Yeah.
Ugh, damn it. Why did I open my mouth?
"I have a crush on you. I'm attracted to you."
I know that I freaked him out.
If you said it like that, you probably did, yeah.
Hey, is Chandler here?
Uh, no, no, he went for a walk.
Okay, well, you cannot tell him, but look who's back.
Hi. - Oh, no, no, no, no, no.
He went over to Ross' to bring the dog back here.
Oh, no, the dog's not going to be there.
You think?
Hi, honey.
Please, please, please, don't be mad at me.
What? Why would...? - Shh. Wait and see.
Maybe we will, maybe we won't.
Okay, I went over to Ross' apartment to bring back Klunkers, you know, for you...
...and, ahem, I left the door open, and she must've gotten out.
And I looked everywhere, all over the apartment, including the roof.
Which, FYI, Ross, one of your neighbors, growing weed.
I couldn't find him...
...and I am so, so, so sorry.
But I do know where we can all go ease the pain.
We have good news. Look who's back.
Hi.
Klunkers. Oh, my God.
That's right. She came back all by herself. - It's a Thanksgiving miracle.
It is so good to see you.
Yeah, she came all the way back from Ross' building.
Oh, the things she must've seen.
Then she climbed up the fire escape...
...and she tapped on the window with her teeny little paw...
...and we ran to let her in.
I went too far, didn't I?
When should I have stopped?
Okay, maybe this is so hard because there aren't 50 states.
Let me tell you something. I have 49 states.
Now, there are no more.
Now, I think I should be able to eat something.
It's up to you.
Oh, hi. How are you doing? - I'm okay.
I gotta go down to the police station and look at mug shots.
Thanks for having me over, you guys. - Tag, you're going? Uh...
We didn't, uh, get a chance to talk.
So where did you say you're from again?
Colorado. - Ah, what good are you?
Look, um, I think we should talk about what happened on the terrace.
Okay. - Uh...
I never should've said what I said.
You know what? It just doesn't matter how I feel.
We work together, so nothing could really ever happen between us.
What I would love is just to go to work on Monday and never talk about this again.
Okay? Big day, Monday. Lots to do.
So we okay?
Um, I'm not.
Oh, God, I knew it. I freaked you out. - No, you didn't.
The only thing that freaked me out was you saying...
...that nothing could happen between us.
Really? - Yeah.
So please don't fire me for doing this.
Okay, well, that's one less thing we have to do on Monday.
Delaware.
Delaware.
All right. - I want my turkey now.
You got it.
You got Nevada twice.
I know. - Yeah.
