sense_groups.chinese: 好 瑞秋写出四十八州 菲比在蔬菜名称方面…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so Rachel's got 48 and Phoebe has the lead in...

sense_groups.chinese: 称霸 乔伊呢？
sense_groups.english: ...vegetables. Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟钱德的愚蠢州名游戏 新冠军打声招呼吧
sense_groups.english: Say hello to the new champ of Chandler's dumb states game.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你写了几个？ - 五十六个
sense_groups.english: Wow, how many you got? - Fifty-six.

sense_groups.chinese: 新英格兰为什么不是一州？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how is New England not a state?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有运动代表队
sense_groups.english: Huh? They have a sports team.

sense_groups.chinese: 南奥勒冈有运动代表队吗？
sense_groups.english: Does South Oregon have a sports team?

sense_groups.chinese: 对啦
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么多了一付餐具？
sense_groups.english: How come we have one extra place setting?

sense_groups.chinese: 你邀了你的助理过来 - 对了 抱歉 泰格不来了
sense_groups.english: Because you invited your assistant. - Oh, right, sorry. Tag's not coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 他女朋友来了 所以他得去陪她
sense_groups.english: His girlfriend came into town, so he's spending Thanksgiving with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么没有告诉我？
sense_groups.english: Oh, why didn't you tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮他做了专属的 番薯酿南瓜
sense_groups.english: I made him his own individual sweet potato stuffed pumpkin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来想说 但我想…
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, I was going to, but then I figured, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你做的菜既好吃 又好看…
sense_groups.english: ...your food is so delicious and perfect...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想多吃一点 你做的南瓜
sense_groups.english: ...you can never have too many of those pumpkin things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为你拗得太硬 我会不相信
sense_groups.english: You'd think I wouldn't enjoy that because it is so fake, ha, ha, but I still do.

sense_groups.chinese: 芹菜
sense_groups.english: Regular celery.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我还是觉得很高兴
sense_groups.english: Oh, I already have that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 时间还剩下很多
sense_groups.english: Done, with time to spare.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可能是新世界记录 - 我讨厌对你们说教…
sense_groups.english: Ooh, this may be a new world's record. - You know, I hate to lecture you guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这真的是太丢脸了 一群受过良好教育的成年人…
sense_groups.english: ...but it's kind of disgraceful that a group of well-educated adults...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟乔伊 无法写出全部的州名
sense_groups.english: ...and Joey, can't name all the states.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看过地图 或是圆圆而且色彩鲜艳 叫做"地球仪"的东西吗？
sense_groups.english: You ever see a map or one of those round colorful things called a globe?

sense_groups.chinese: 麦哲伦先生？你只答对了四十六州
sense_groups.english: Uh, Magellan? You got 46 states.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？那是不可能的 - 四十六州
sense_groups.english: What? That's impossible. - Forty-six.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个受过良好教育 写不出剩下十州州名的人是谁？
sense_groups.english: Well, who's well-educated now, Mr. I-Forgot-Ten-States?

sense_groups.chinese: 烤箱太满了 我要借用乔伊的烤箱
sense_groups.english: I'm out of oven space. I'm gonna go turn on Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托看好他 别让乔伊偷吃东西
sense_groups.english: Please, watch him. Do not let Joey eat any of the food.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只有一个人
sense_groups.english: I am only one man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 时间到 - 再给我一分钟
sense_groups.english: Okay, time is up. - Give me another minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果现在想不出来 你永远都想不出来 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, if you don't know them by now, you will never know them, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是这个游戏好玩的地方 它会让你想要杀了自己
sense_groups.english: That is the beauty of this game. It makes you want to kill yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太疯狂了 我一定答得出来
sense_groups.english: This is crazy. I can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我敢说我能在 吃晚餐前写出五十州的州名
sense_groups.english: All right, uh, I bet I can get all 50, uh, before dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但你写不出来就不能吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Okay, but if you can't, no dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这么说定了
sense_groups.english: You're on.

sense_groups.chinese: 别偷看我写的答案 里面有很多你写不出来的州名
sense_groups.english: All right, don't look at my list, because there's a lot on there that you don't have.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你的烤箱坏了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, did you guys know your oven doesn't work?

sense_groups.chinese: 装满外送菜单的抽屉 没坏吧？
sense_groups.english: But the drawer full of takeout menus is okay, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我要借用你的烤箱 - 嘘
sense_groups.english: Ross, I'm gonna use yours, okay? - Shh.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 快来帮我
sense_groups.english: Chandler, give me a hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 别让罗斯偷看地图 或你家的地球仪
sense_groups.english: Sure. Joey, do not let Ross look at any maps or the globe in your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 那又不是美国的地球仪
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, Chandler. It's not a globe of the United States.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我要去散个步
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, I'm gonna go out and take a walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你的包包为什么在动？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, why is your bag moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有 - 它真的在动
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's not. - Seriously, it's moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面装了什么东西？ - 只是我编织的东西而已
sense_groups.english: What the hell's in there? - It's just my knitting. That's all.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我织了这个
sense_groups.english: Yes, I knit this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很厉害
sense_groups.english: I'm very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯的公寓很漂亮 为什么我们从不来这里混？
sense_groups.english: Ross' apartment is nice. Why don't we hang out here more often?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为它有个怪味道
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Maybe because it smells weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点像是放了很久的南瓜味
sense_groups.english: It's like old pumpkins or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的派 - 这个味道好香
sense_groups.english: That's my pie. - Which smells delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. Uh-oh. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们让乔伊跟食物独处
sense_groups.english: We left Joey alone with the food.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我就知道
sense_groups.english: Yep, yep, I knew it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在…
sense_groups.english: There he is...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿馅料喂小狗吃
sense_groups.english: ...feeding stuffing to a dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 这里是盖勒及宾的家 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Geller-Bing residence. How can I help?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 为什么我们家会有狗？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, why is there a dog in our apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你是谁？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, who's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 有只狗坐在我的沙发上
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, there's a dog sitting on my couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉她我对狗过敏 我会告她
sense_groups.english: Tell her I'm allergic, and I will sue.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里没有狗 - 不 真的有
sense_groups.english: No, there's no dog here. - There is.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是黑白相间 而且毛很长
sense_groups.english: He's black and white and shaggy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就坐在瑞秋旁边 正在舔她的手
sense_groups.english: He's sitting next to Rachel and licking Rachel's hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Where are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回去
sense_groups.english: I'll be right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们已经回来了？ 他们怎么办到的？
sense_groups.english: They're here already? How are they doing this?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 泰格 你来这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Tag. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想知道你的邀请 是不是还有效
sense_groups.english: I, uh, wanted to see if your offer to spend Thanksgiving with you was still good.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 快进来
sense_groups.english: Well, sure. Come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你女朋友呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what happened to your girlfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上我们分手了
sense_groups.english: We, uh, kind of broke up this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾 - 所以她回俄亥俄去了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. - Yeah, so she went back to Ohio.

sense_groups.chinese: 俄亥俄州 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Ohio, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 狗在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Huh. Where's the dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么狗？这里没有狗
sense_groups.english: What dog? There's no dog here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只狗离开了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that dog left.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 快开门
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, open up.

sense_groups.chinese: 房间里没有狗
sense_groups.english: There's no dog in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们听到了狗叫声
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, we can hear the dog barking.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那只是我的咳嗽声
sense_groups.english: No, that's just me coughing.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 你们回来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. There you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我房间里有只狗
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, I have a dog in my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: What is it doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮我朋友照顾他 他们有事出城去了
sense_groups.english: I'm watching it for friends who went out of town.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是克朗克
sense_groups.english: Hello, my name is Klunkers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以跟你们这些大好人 住在一起吗？
sense_groups.english: May I please stay with you nice people?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也希望能留他住下来 但钱德对狗过敏
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wish he could stay here, but Chandler's allergic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对狗严重过敏 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Extremely allergic, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要我一靠近狗 超过五分钟…
sense_groups.english: If I am anywhere near a dog for more than five minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的喉咙就会紧缩
sense_groups.english: ...my throat will just close up.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是奇怪 这只狗在这里住了三天
sense_groups.english: That's odd, because this dog's been living here for the past three days.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他在这里住了那么久…
sense_groups.english: If the dog has been here that long...

sense_groups.chinese: 你一点反应都没有 或许你对他不会过敏
sense_groups.english: ...and you haven't had a reaction, maybe you're not allergic to this dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还是得离开 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, it still has to go, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我… - 别那么做
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's, um... - Don't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别做什么？ - 我非说不可
sense_groups.english: Don't do what? - I have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？时间到了
sense_groups.english: Okay? It's time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我讨厌狗
sense_groups.english: Okay, I hate dogs.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 那太疯狂了 为什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - That's crazy. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我早跟你说过了
sense_groups.english: Told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很黏人…
sense_groups.english: They are needy...

sense_groups.chinese: 爱乱跳 你不知道他们在想什么…
sense_groups.english: ...they are jumpy, and you can't tell what they are thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 那把我吓得半死
sense_groups.english: ...and that scares me a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 他们很可怕
sense_groups.english: You're right. They are scary. Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 他吃掉放在我手上的点心
sense_groups.english: She just ate a treat out of my hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你不喜欢所有的狗？ 连小狗都不喜欢？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Do you not like all dogs? I mean, not even puppies?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有小狗吗？
sense_groups.english: Is there a puppy here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喜欢小狗？ - 喂 你是新来的
sense_groups.english: You don't like puppies? - Okay, you are new.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 钱德 我跟你说过 别跟其他人说你不喜欢狗
sense_groups.english: Look, Chandler, I told you. Never tell anyone about this dog thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就像罗斯不喜欢冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: It's like Ross not liking ice cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喜欢冰淇淋？ - 它太冰了
sense_groups.english: You don't like ice cream? - It's too cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 狗让我觉得很不舒服
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's just that dogs make me a little uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的牙齿冰得好痛
sense_groups.english: Hurts my teeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想这么说 不希望你们讨厌我…
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna say this. I don't want you guys to hate me...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不喜欢这只狗待在我身边 好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, I don't think I can be around that dog anymore, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那只狗走 就是我走
sense_groups.english: So either the dog goes or I go. Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么可能答不出来？
sense_groups.english: How can I not get this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是大学教授 SAT考了1450分
sense_groups.english: I'm a college professor. I got 1450 on my SATs.

sense_groups.chinese: 是1250分才对
sense_groups.english: Twelve fifty.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我忘了你在这里
sense_groups.english: Damn, I forgot you were here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们得把克朗克送到罗斯家
sense_groups.english: All right. We're gonna take Klunkers to Ross'.

sense_groups.chinese: 马上就回来
sense_groups.english: We'll be back in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 在你们离开前 我能问你们一个问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, before you go, can I ask a question?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果一个男人跟女朋友分手了…
sense_groups.english: Um, when a guy breaks up with his girlfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得等多久才能采取行动？
sense_groups.english: ...what is an appropriate amount of time to wait before you make a move?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是一个月
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'd say about a month.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？我觉得是三到四个月 - 半小时
sense_groups.english: Really? I'd say three to four. - Half-hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有趣
sense_groups.english: Interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他是你的助理 我劝你别那么做
sense_groups.english: When it's your assistant, I would say never.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 瑞秋 问题是 他喜欢你吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, Rach, the big question is, does he like you?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他不喜欢你 这只是在对牛放屁
sense_groups.english: Right? Because if he doesn't like you, this is all a moo point.

sense_groups.chinese: 对牛"放屁"？
sense_groups.english: Huh. A "moo" point?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 牛不知道你做了什么
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's like a cow's opinion.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不重要
sense_groups.english: It just doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是在"放屁"
sense_groups.english: It's "moo."

sense_groups.chinese: 是我跟他同居太久 还是他的话真的有道理？
sense_groups.english: Have I been living with him for too long, or did that all just make sense?

sense_groups.chinese: 别听乔伊的 好吗？ 看看他的样子
sense_groups.english: Please don't listen to Joey. Okay? Would you look at him?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很沮丧 家人又不在身边
sense_groups.english: He's obviously depressed. He's away from his family.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在跟陌生人过感恩节
sense_groups.english: He's spending Thanksgiving with strangers.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在他需要你这个朋友
sense_groups.english: What he needs right now is for you to be his friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 对不起 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're right. I'm sorry. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会那么做的 - 很好 照她们的话去做
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's what I'm going to do. - Fine, take their advice.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正没有人会听我的话
sense_groups.english: No one ever listens to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要包装好看 没有人会在乎内容
sense_groups.english: When the package is this pretty, no one cares what's inside.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？
sense_groups.english: How you holding up?

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Not bad. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 关于你女朋友的事我很遗憾 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about your girlfriend. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在- 起很久了吗？ - 一年了 总是分分合合的
sense_groups.english: Were you guys together a long time? - A year, on and off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我们会相守一生 现在我不会那么想了
sense_groups.english: I thought we'd end up together. I don't anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她跟你分手了 - 对
sense_groups.english: Now that she broke up with you. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 这真的很奇怪
sense_groups.english: Hmm. - It's weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前总以为我会遇见一个人 坠入爱河 过着幸福的生活
sense_groups.english: I always used to assume that I would meet someone and fall in love and be happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像很自然而然 最近我会想如果不是那样呢？
sense_groups.english: That all that was just a given. Well, lately, it's like, what if it's not?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有那种感觉吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you ever have that feeling?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 有
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我常有那种感觉 一直都有 那真的很可怕
sense_groups.english: All the time. Constantly. It's terrifying.

sense_groups.chinese: 但后来我想通了 一定会发生的
sense_groups.english: But, you know, then I figure it has to work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为一定会的
sense_groups.english: Because it has to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的什么都知道 对吧？ - 没错 我真的什么都知道
sense_groups.english: You have all the answers, don't you? - Yeah, I know, I do. I really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你陪我聊 - 别这样 这不是上司的工作吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, thanks for talking to me. - Come on, what are bosses for?

sense_groups.chinese: 快来抱一下吧
sense_groups.english: Hug it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 他也喜欢你
sense_groups.english: All right, he likes you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过你该表白的
sense_groups.english: Huh? Told you you should go for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 下面的噪音有没有盖过那句话？
sense_groups.english: Street noise drown any of that out?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有吗？待会见 好吧
sense_groups.english: No? All right, I'll see you later. Ha, ha. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚乔伊说了什么？我也喜欢你？
sense_groups.english: What did Joey say? I like you back?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的…喔…他…
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah... You know, well, see, he...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊知道我对我的背没信心
sense_groups.english: Joey knows that I'm very insecure about my back.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚你在抱我
sense_groups.english: And... And you were hugging me...

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 你不讨厌它 没错
sense_groups.english: ...so obviously you are not repulsed by it. Yeah. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 那根本就说不通
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, that doesn't make any sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: No?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 事实是这样的
sense_groups.english: All right, here's the truth. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊会那么说…
sense_groups.english: Joey said what he said because, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我被你吸引
sense_groups.english: ...I'm attracted to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 - 对 我承认
sense_groups.english: Wow. - Yeah, I admit it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我暗恋你 我知道那很疯狂 因为我们是同事
sense_groups.english: I have a crush on you. And, uh, I know that's crazy because we work together...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间不该发生任何事
sense_groups.english: ...and nothing could ever happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点都不想吓到你…
sense_groups.english: And the last thing I wanted to do was freak you out...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是让你觉得不自在
sense_groups.english: ...or make you feel uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我认为你最好快说句话
sense_groups.english: Which is why it would be really great if you said something right about now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 那些家伙在偷我的车
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Those guys are stealing my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 就在那边 那是我的车
sense_groups.english: What? - Right there. That's my car.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 好了 他们得花点时间
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Okay, that's gonna take a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有话要跟我说吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have anything else you wanna get off your chest?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还有时间谈 他们还没上车
sense_groups.english: Wait, we still have time to talk, and they're not even in the car yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 他们上车了
sense_groups.english: Oh, look, there they go. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 或许我们该回去了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Phoebe. We should probably go back now.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你别离开我 我会很寂寞的
sense_groups.english: Please, don't leave me. I'll be lonely.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了
sense_groups.english: Stop it. Stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧 我们可以很坚强的 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's go. We can be strong. - Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你听到了吗？ 他在叫"摩妮卡"
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, did you hear that? She said "Monica."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能丢下他
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't leave her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以偷偷把狗带回去 钱德不会发现的
sense_groups.english: If you want, we could sneak the dog back in and Chandler wouldn't even know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是行不通的
sense_groups.english: That's not gonna work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把小狗藏在房间里三天 钱德完全不知道
sense_groups.english: I had that dog there for three days and Chandler had no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有那么聪明
sense_groups.english: He's not so smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我也不知道
sense_groups.english: Hey. I didn't know either.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是你觉得怪怪的 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but you kind of knew that something was going on, didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I knew. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where's Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里 - 快去洗手
sense_groups.english: Here I am. - Wash your hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: How did you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 他怎么又回来了？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what's she doing back here?

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 罗斯 他不是冰淇淋做的
sense_groups.english: Relax, Ross. She's not made of ice cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 菲比 我照位置将各州州名排好
sense_groups.english: Hey, look, Phoebe. I, uh, laid out the states geographically.

sense_groups.chinese: 没时间谈这件事了
sense_groups.english: No, no, we don't have time for this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能让钱德靠近我房间
sense_groups.english: We have to keep Chandler away from my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but, look what I...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们没有时间了
sense_groups.english: See, this is exactly what we do not have time for.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡在哪里？ - 她在菲比房里 你不能进去
sense_groups.english: Where's Monica? - Uh, in Phoebe's room. You can't go in.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡在哭
sense_groups.english: Monica's crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 关于克朗克的事 她非常难过
sense_groups.english: She's very upset about this whole Klunkers thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该进去的 - 不
sense_groups.english: Well, I should go in there. - No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 现在她不想见你
sense_groups.english: No, she doesn't want to see you right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为你把那只狗赶走
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because you sent away the dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太可笑了 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: That's ridiculous. - Oh, is it? Is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 摩妮卡跟我小时候 我们养了一只狗叫路佛
sense_groups.english: Look, when Monica and I were kids, we had a dog named Rover.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一天我爸说他不喜欢狗
sense_groups.english: And, um, one day, my dad decides he doesn't like dogs.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟她的朋友菲丽丝…
sense_groups.english: So Monica and her friend... Phyllis...

sense_groups.chinese: 把狗送走 那是我们最后一次见到他
sense_groups.english: ...take away the dog, and that was the last time we ever saw him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你懂吗？这次也一样
sense_groups.english: Don't you see? This is just like that...

sense_groups.chinese: 只不过有些细节不一样
sense_groups.english: ...only with a few details changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我换了运动裤
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm in my sweatpants.

sense_groups.chinese: 把食物端上来吧
sense_groups.english: Bring on the food.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 摩妮卡因为…
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - Monica's all upset...

sense_groups.chinese: 克朗克的事很难过
sense_groups.english: ...because I sent Klunkers away.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？把狗抱回来 你会成为大英雄的
sense_groups.english: So? Bring the dog back. You're a hero.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我可以当大英雄 我可以那么做
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I could be a hero. I could do that. I could... I could do...

sense_groups.chinese: 万一他攻击我呢？
sense_groups.english: What if it...? What if it attacks me?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 他就像只大沙鼠
sense_groups.english: Chandler, it's like a big gerbil.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不害怕吗？
sense_groups.english: And that doesn't scare you?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你需要帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross, you need some help?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要帮我忙？
sense_groups.english: From you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 拜托你了
sense_groups.english: Yes, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 犹他州？
sense_groups.english: First of all, Utah?

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 你不能乱编州名
sense_groups.english: Dude, you can't just make stuff up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨美国
sense_groups.english: I hate America.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个游戏结束后 我发誓我要搬家
sense_groups.english: When I finish this game, I swear I am moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 泰格还在跟警察谈？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Hey. Tag still talking to the police? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我为什么要说话？
sense_groups.english: Ugh, damn it. Why did I open my mouth?

sense_groups.chinese: "我暗恋你 我被你吸引"
sense_groups.english: "I have a crush on you. I'm attracted to you."

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我吓坏他了
sense_groups.english: I know that I freaked him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你是那种口气 他一定吓坏了
sense_groups.english: If you said it like that, you probably did, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德在吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, is Chandler here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他去散步了
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, no, he went for a walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你们不能告诉他 但看看是谁回来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, you cannot tell him, but look who's back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 喔 不…
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Oh, no, no, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 他到罗斯家去带小狗回来
sense_groups.english: He went over to Ross' to bring the dog back here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 小狗不在那里耶
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, the dog's not going to be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这么觉得啊？
sense_groups.english: You think?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 甜心
sense_groups.english: Hi, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 求求你别对我生气
sense_groups.english: Please, please, please, don't be mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？为什么…？ - 等着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: What? Why would...? - Shh. Wait and see.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们会 或许我们不会
sense_groups.english: Maybe we will, maybe we won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跑到罗斯家 想帮你把克朗克抱回来
sense_groups.english: Okay, I went over to Ross' apartment to bring back Klunkers, you know, for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了关门 他一定是跑出去了
sense_groups.english: ...and, ahem, I left the door open, and she must've gotten out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我到处都找过 找遍整栋公寓 包括屋顶
sense_groups.english: And I looked everywhere, all over the apartment, including the roof.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 罗斯 你邻居在屋顶上种大麻
sense_groups.english: Which, FYI, Ross, one of your neighbors, growing weed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找不到他
sense_groups.english: I couldn't find him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: ...and I am so, so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道 怎么样能让大家忘记痛苦
sense_groups.english: But I do know where we can all go ease the pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有好消息 看看谁回来了
sense_groups.english: We have good news. Look who's back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 克朗克 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Klunkers. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 他是自己跑回来的 - 这是感恩节奇迹
sense_groups.english: That's right. She came back all by herself. - It's a Thanksgiving miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴能见到你
sense_groups.english: It is so good to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他从罗斯家跑了回来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she came all the way back from Ross' building.

sense_groups.chinese: 他一定遇到很多事
sense_groups.english: Oh, the things she must've seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 他爬上消防梯…
sense_groups.english: Then she climbed up the fire escape...

sense_groups.chinese: 用他的小脚拍打窗户
sense_groups.english: ...and she tapped on the window with her teeny little paw...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们跑去开窗让他进来
sense_groups.english: ...and we ran to let her in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的太过火了 对吧？
sense_groups.english: I went too far, didn't I?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该在哪里就住口呢？
sense_groups.english: When should I have stopped?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 或许这个游戏很难 是因为美国没有五十州
sense_groups.english: Okay, maybe this is so hard because there aren't 50 states.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你一件事 我写出四十九州的州名
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you something. I have 49 states.

sense_groups.chinese: 那已经是全部的答案了
sense_groups.english: Now, there are no more.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我应该可以吃点东西了
sense_groups.english: Now, I think I should be able to eat something.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便你
sense_groups.english: It's up to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你还好吗？ - 我很好
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi. How are you doing? - I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得到警局去 指认嫌犯的照片
sense_groups.english: I gotta go down to the police station and look at mug shots.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们邀请我来这里 - 泰格 你要走了吗？
sense_groups.english: Thanks for having me over, you guys. - Tag, you're going? Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还没有机会好好谈一谈
sense_groups.english: We didn't, uh, get a chance to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你是哪一州的人？
sense_groups.english: So where did you say you're from again?

sense_groups.chinese: 科罗拉多州 - 你真是没用
sense_groups.english: Colorado. - Ah, what good are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我想我们该谈谈 在阳台上发生的事
sense_groups.english: Look, um, I think we should talk about what happened on the terrace.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 额
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该说那些话的
sense_groups.english: I never should've said what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的感觉并不重要
sense_groups.english: You know what? It just doesn't matter how I feel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起工作 不应该有任何私人关系
sense_groups.english: We work together, so nothing could really ever happen between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期一我想高高兴兴去上班 再也不提这件事
sense_groups.english: What I would love is just to go to work on Monday and never talk about this again.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 星期一是个大日子 我们还有很多事要做
sense_groups.english: Okay? Big day, Monday. Lots to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该还好吧？
sense_groups.english: So we okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点都不好
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道我吓到你了 - 不 你没有
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I knew it. I freaked you out. - No, you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 吓坏我的是你说…
sense_groups.english: The only thing that freaked me out was you saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不该有私人关系
sense_groups.english: ...that nothing could happen between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 请不要因为我这么做 就炒我鱿鱼
sense_groups.english: So please don't fire me for doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期一我们得做的事少了一件
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, that's one less thing we have to do on Monday.

sense_groups.chinese: 德拉瓦州
sense_groups.english: Delaware.

sense_groups.chinese: 德拉瓦州
sense_groups.english: Delaware.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 我要吃我的火鸡
sense_groups.english: All right. - I want my turkey now.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你重覆写了两次内华达州
sense_groups.english: You got Nevada twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I know. - Yeah.

questions.name: S07E09
questions.en:
I'm ready.
You sure? - Uh-huh.
Okay, let me just straighten out your helmet there.
Thanks, Daddy. - No, no. One daddy, two mommies.
All right, it's all yours. - Okay, okay.
There you go, there you go.
Wow, Ben's first big kid's bike. This is so exciting.
Oh, yeah, I remember mine.
It was my sixth birthday. My dad took me to the park...
...and I got on it and... it bent. Yeah.
I never had a bike of my own. - What?
Well, we didn't have a lot of money.
But the girl across the street had the best bike.
It was pink and it had rainbow-colored tassels hanging off the handle grips...
...and a bell, and this big, white wicker basket...
...with those plastic daisies stuck on.
That sounds like my first bike.
My dad gave me his old one.
Did the girl ever let you ride it? - No.
But she gave me the box that it came in.
It had a picture of the bike on the front.
So I would sit on it and my stepdad would drag me around the backyard.
That is so unfair.
Not really, I got to drag him around too.
Hey, what are you guys doing?
Making holiday candy for the neighbors.
I'm sorry, who?
I'm gonna hang this basket on the door.
When the neighbors walk by, they can all take a piece.
But we don't know the neighbors. - I do.
There's, uh, let's see, the guy with the mustache...
...smokes-a-lot lady, some kids I've seen...
...and the red-haired guy who does not like to be called Rusty.
See, this is exactly why I'm making this candy.
We can learn their names and get to know our neighbors.
Wouldn't it be easier if we just moved?
Good morning.
Ah, somebody's in a good mood. - Well, why shouldn't I be?
I have great friends. I have a wonderful job...
Where you can make out with your assistant.
Come on, it's not a big deal.
We stayed up all night coming up with a plan...
...so that us dating will not be a problem.
Oh, yeah? What's the plan?
We... We are not...
...going to let it...
...be a problem.
Wow. It took you all night to come up with that plan?
Oh, well, you know, we did other stuff too.
Did you two?
Oh, Monica, you know I don't sleep with guys on the first date.
Matt Wire, Mark Lynn, Ben Wise... - Anymore.
Hi, Tag, um, I have a conference call today, is that correct?
Yes, at 4. - Okay, thank you, that'll be all.
Wait, wait.
Did you see that?
That mail guy had no idea there was something going on between us.
I'd better get back to my desk. - Okay, hard worker.
I'll remember to put that in your evaluation.
My what? - You've been here for two months now...
...and your boss is required to hand in a performance evaluation.
But you know, there is one thing that I have yet to evaluate.
Are you serious? - No, I've just always wanted to do that.
Can you help me clean this up?
The basket is totally empty. My God, the neighbors ate all the candy.
Well, either that or, uh...
Joey.
Yeah?
Did you eat all the neighbor candy? - Uh, well, yeah, that was the plan.
But by the time I got to it there was only a couple pieces left.
Yeah. They've been coming by all day. They love it.
They love my candy?
Oh, man, I gotta go make more. - Hey, Mon.
Make some more lasagna too. Something might have happened to a huge chunk of it.
Ross, the neighbors ate all my candy.
Mine stole my newspaper.
It's like a crime wave.
Pheebs, you, uh, got a second?
Sure. - Yeah.
Ever since you, uh, told me that story about that bike...
...I couldn't stop thinking about it.
I mean, everyone should have a first bike, you know? So...
Oh, my God, Ross.
You like it? - I love it.
Yeah? - Oh. Oh, God...
And I love you. - Ah.
Not that way.
But the bike got you a lot closer. - Oh.
Well, uh, take it downstairs.
You know, give it a test drive.
Okay. Oh, my God.
My first bike.
Thank you for the best present I've ever gotten.
You're welcome.
Oh, and Chandler's about to cry.
Am not.
Who is that?
Don't worry, I'm brave. I am brave. I... I am brave.
No, no, no, no, no.
Can you tell me who is there, please?
My name's Gary. I live upstairs.
Hi. - Hi.
Do you know what time it is? - It's candy time.
My roommate says that they taste like little drops of heaven.
Oh, please. Heh.
Did you hear that? "Little drops of heaven."
Four a.m.
So can I get some candy?
I am sorry, but some of us have to get up early and go to work.
He does not know that I am not "some of us."
Um, listen, I'm sorry, but I'll put some out first thing in the morning.
Well, okay, I'll swing by later.
You live in this building? - Mm-hm.
Mm. Seems like I would have remembered you.
Mm. Night, Gar.
So did you read your evaluation yet?
No, it was marked "confidential."
I just sent it down to human resources.
Okay, please, you're kidding, right? I wrote that one as a joke for you.
A joke they would appreciate?
I'm thinking no.
What did you say? - Um, I said that you were a good kisser...
...and, uh, that I liked your teeny, tiny tushy.
No, not my tushy.
Well, it gets worse.
When asked if you take initiative, I wrote
"Yes, he was able to unhook my bra with minimal supervision."
And under problems with performance, I wrote, "Dear God, I hope not."
And then, uh... And then I drew a little smiley face.
And then a small pornographic sketch.
Ross, that is so sweet of you to get Phoebe that bike.
When I heard the story, I almost cried.
Almost cried, huh?
Hear that, Chandler? "Almost" cried.
Hey, you cry every time somebody talks about Titanic.
Those two had only each other.
Phoebe really likes the bike, huh?
Oh, yeah. I saw her walking it down the street the other day.
She had these flowers in the basket. It was so cute.
Yeah, I saw her this morning walking it by the park.
Wait a minute, she was walking the bike? Both times?
Hey, Pheebs. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从你告诉我 那个脚踏车的故事…
sense_groups.english: Ever since you, uh, told me that story about that bike...

sense_groups.chinese: 它一直在我脑中挥之不去
sense_groups.english: ...I couldn't stop thinking about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说大家都该有第一辆脚踏车 你知道吗？所以…
sense_groups.english: I mean, everyone should have a first bike, you know? So...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢吗？ - 我爱死它了
sense_groups.english: You like it? - I love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 喔 天啊…
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Oh. Oh, God...

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 - 啊
sense_groups.english: And I love you. - Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是那一种爱
sense_groups.english: Not that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这辆脚踏车让你跟我更亲近了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: But the bike got you a lot closer. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 把它牵到楼下去
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, take it downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 试骑一下
sense_groups.english: You know, give it a test drive.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Okay. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的第一辆脚踏车
sense_groups.english: My first bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 这是我收过最棒的礼物
sense_groups.english: Thank you for the best present I've ever gotten.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德快哭了
sense_groups.english: Oh, and Chandler's about to cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有
sense_groups.english: Am not.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我很勇敢 我很勇敢 我…我很勇敢
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, I'm brave. I am brave. I... I am brave.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问你是谁？
sense_groups.english: Can you tell me who is there, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是盖瑞 我住在楼上
sense_groups.english: My name's Gary. I live upstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道现在几点了吗？ - 现在是糖果时间
sense_groups.english: Do you know what time it is? - It's candy time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我室友说它们吃起来 就像是天上掉下来的礼物
sense_groups.english: My roommate says that they taste like little drops of heaven.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗？ "天上掉下来的礼物"
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that? "Little drops of heaven."

sense_groups.chinese: 凌晨四点
sense_groups.english: Four a.m.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能给我一点糖果吗？
sense_groups.english: So can I get some candy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 但我们之中有人 还得早起去上班
sense_groups.english: I am sorry, but some of us have to get up early and go to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不知道我不是那个人
sense_groups.english: He does not know that I am not "some of us."

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 但明天一大早我会做一些糖果
sense_groups.english: Um, listen, I'm sorry, but I'll put some out first thing in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我待会儿再来
sense_groups.english: Well, okay, I'll swing by later.

sense_groups.chinese: 你住在这里？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: You live in this building? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该会记得你
sense_groups.english: Mm. Seems like I would have remembered you.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 盖瑞
sense_groups.english: Mm. Night, Gar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看了你的评估表吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you read your evaluation yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 上面写了"极机密"
sense_groups.english: No, it was marked "confidential."

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚把它送到人事处了
sense_groups.english: I just sent it down to human resources.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你是在开玩笑 对吧？ 我故意写那份评估表来跟你闲玩笑
sense_groups.english: Okay, please, you're kidding, right? I wrote that one as a joke for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会喜欢这个玩笑吗？
sense_groups.english: A joke they would appreciate?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想不会
sense_groups.english: I'm thinking no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你写了什么？ - 我说你是接吻高手
sense_groups.english: What did you say? - Um, I said that you were a good kisser...

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你又小又挺的屁股
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, that I liked your teeny, tiny tushy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不该那么说
sense_groups.english: No, not my tushy.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有更糟糕的事
sense_groups.english: Well, it gets worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 关于你的主动性 我写…
sense_groups.english: When asked if you take initiative, I wrote

sense_groups.chinese: "他几乎不需要指导 就能解开我的胸罩"
sense_groups.english: "Yes, he was able to unhook my bra with minimal supervision."

sense_groups.chinese: 至于你的表现会不会有问题 我写"天啊 希望不要有"
sense_groups.english: And under problems with performance, I wrote, "Dear God, I hope not."

sense_groups.chinese: 然后…然后我画了 一个微笑的小脸
sense_groups.english: And then, uh... And then I drew a little smiley face.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一张色情小素描
sense_groups.english: And then a small pornographic sketch.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你送菲比脚踏车 真的太贴心了
sense_groups.english: Ross, that is so sweet of you to get Phoebe that bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到那个故事时 差点就哭了
sense_groups.english: When I heard the story, I almost cried.

sense_groups.chinese: 你差点哭了？
sense_groups.english: Almost cried, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗？钱德 "差点"哭了
sense_groups.english: Hear that, Chandler? "Almost" cried.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要有人提到《铁达尼号》 你每次都会哭
sense_groups.english: Hey, you cry every time somebody talks about Titanic.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们两个只有彼此
sense_groups.english: Those two had only each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比真的很喜欢它吧？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe really likes the bike, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我看到她牵着它过街
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I saw her walking it down the street the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的篮子里面还有花 那真的很可爱
sense_groups.english: She had these flowers in the basket. It was so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上我看到她 牵着它在公园散步
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I saw her this morning walking it by the park.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 她牵着脚踏车？ 两次都是？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, she was walking the bike? Both times?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢你的脚踏车吗？ - 非常喜欢
sense_groups.english: Hey, so you enjoying the bike? - Oh, uh-huh, so much. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你会骑脚踏车吧？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, you, uh... You do know how to ride a bike, don't you? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能看你骑脚踏车吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we see you ride it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看到了吗？
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 我早晨跟你说 不要跟助理交柱
sense_groups.english: This is why I told you never get involved with your assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要是地下情 绝对是纸包不住火的
sense_groups.english: And there's no such thing as keeping secrets when it comes to having affairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗？钱德
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 纸是包不住火的
sense_groups.english: No such thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？我只是在吃糖果
sense_groups.english: What happened? I'm just eating candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许没有那么糟糕 他们可能看不懂我的意思
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's not as bad as I think. Maybe they didn't take it the way I meant it.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然啰 你知道吗？ 因为"小屁屁"可以指屁股…
sense_groups.english: Absolutely, you know? Because "tushy" can mean both ass...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟好员工
sense_groups.english: ...and good worker.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得把评估表拿回来
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I just gotta get the thing back.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 还记得你提到的素描吗？
sense_groups.english: Rach? That sketch you mentioned?

sense_groups.chinese: 它跟这幅素描很像吗？
sense_groups.english: Might it have looked a little something like this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么了？ - 天啊
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you? - God.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我买不起色情杂志前 这点天份还蛮有用的
sense_groups.english: I tell you, this little talent came in handy before I could afford porn.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 对不起 我知道现在是 休息时间 但我真的需要糖果
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm sorry. I know it's after hours, but I really need candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我帮不了你 看到了没？规定就是规定
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I can't help you. See? Rules are rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我住在外地的朋友 今天来看我
sense_groups.english: Please, I have people coming from out of town today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他们提起你的糖果 - 你是在开玩笑吧？
sense_groups.english: I told them all about your candy. - You're kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是外地来的？ 你怎么跟他们说的？
sense_groups.english: Out-of-towners, huh? Heh. What did you tell them?

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉他们你的糖果 真的是好吃到无法形容
sense_groups.english: I told them your candy was absolutely indescribable.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人说它是"天上 掉下来的礼物" 但那不重要
sense_groups.english: Well, some people have been saying it's "little drops of heaven," but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你不能帮帮我吗？ - 钱德 我们认识那位女士吗？
sense_groups.english: Please, can't you help me out? - Hey, Chandler, do we know that lady?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能吧 她不是住在你楼下 做爱时会大叫的那个女人吗？
sense_groups.english: Maybe. Isn't she the woman who lives below you and has sex really loud?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我只破例一次
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll do it just this once.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不能告诉任何人 - 好 求求你 快给我吧
sense_groups.english: But you can't tell anybody. - Yes, yes, please, just give it to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 就是她
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's her.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 不可思议
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信纸条没有用
sense_groups.english: I can't believe that sign didn't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么才会有用吗？ 别再做糖果了
sense_groups.english: You know what would work? Stop making candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们喜欢它
sense_groups.english: But they like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说他们喜欢你
sense_groups.english: You mean they like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是你当厨师的原因？ 你要大家喜欢你？
sense_groups.english: Is that why you became a chef, so that people would like you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我谈怎么让别人 喜欢你吗？小丑
sense_groups.english: Heh. You want to talk about getting people to like you, huh, funny man?

sense_groups.chinese: 记住我教你的一切 你会没事的
sense_groups.english: Okay, now, just remember everything I taught you and you'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？开始吧
sense_groups.english: Okay? Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 就位 预备…
sense_groups.english: Ready, set...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 这个座垫 真的很不舒服
sense_groups.english: Wait, this seat is really uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如先换掉再来练习
sense_groups.english: Maybe before we start we should just get another one.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该换个飞机座椅 或懒骨头
sense_groups.english: Perhaps like an airplane seat, or a beanbag chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你不能逃避这件事 你得学会骑脚踏车
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you can't get out of this, okay? You have to learn how to ride a bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？为什么我非学不可？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why do I have to learn?

sense_groups.chinese: 以防发生紧急事故 - 什么样的紧急事故？
sense_groups.english: Well, in case of an emergency. - What kind of emergency?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人走过来 拿枪抵着你的头说…
sense_groups.english: Well, what if a man comes along and puts a gun to your head and says

sense_groups.chinese: "快骑上脚踏车 不然我会…
sense_groups.english: "You ride this bike or I'll...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会开枪打你"
sense_groups.english: I'll shoot you."

sense_groups.chinese: 我会按铃铛分散他的注意力
sense_groups.english: Okay. I would ring the bell to distract him...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我会用中国飞镖 把那个家伙敲昏
sense_groups.english: ...and then I would knock the gun out of his hand with a Chinese throwing star.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 菲比 快坐上脚踏车
sense_groups.english: Okay, Phoebe, just get on the bike...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会扶着你帮你推好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and, hey, I'll hold you up and push you. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会放手？
sense_groups.english: You won't let go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会 - 你发誓
sense_groups.english: No. - You swear?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓
sense_groups.english: I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 来吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 要开始了 好吗？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Here we go. All right? All right? - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉不错吧？ 好了 试着踩踏板
sense_groups.english: Feel good? All right, try pedaling.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你做的很好 对 控制住车子
sense_groups.english: That's it, you're doing great. Yes, take control.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, yes. - Whee! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你发过誓的
sense_groups.english: You swore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为你骑得很好 - 我真的很震惊
sense_groups.english: I just thought you were doing so well. - I am shocked. Shocked.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都是那样子学脚踏车的
sense_groups.english: It's a legitimate learning technique.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 外面有些人在问糖果的事
sense_groups.english: There's, uh, some people outside asking about candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们得等 好吗？ 我只有两只手
sense_groups.english: They're just gonna have to wait, aren't they? I only got two hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我帮忙吗？ - 不 你不熟悉流程
sense_groups.english: Need some help? - No, you don't know the system.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望任何人破坏我的流程
sense_groups.english: I don't need nobody messing with the system.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 你结婚前一个星期 不会常常看到我
sense_groups.english: By the way, the week before your wedding, you may not see a lot of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 骗子
sense_groups.english: Oh, hello, liar.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我真的很抱歉 放开了你的脚踏车
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm really sorry I let go of the bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能会没命的
sense_groups.english: I could've been killed, I hope you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你能再试一次吗？
sense_groups.english: But can we please try it again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说你只差一点就成功了 菲比
sense_groups.english: I mean, you were so close, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我很乐意…
sense_groups.english: Well, I would love to...

sense_groups.chinese: 但脚踏车被偷了 警察找不到嫌犯
sense_groups.english: ...but the bike got stolen and the police have no suspects.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会这样？
sense_groups.english: What the hell?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不学骑脚踏车 那么我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: If you are not going to learn how to ride this bike, then I'm sorry...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得把它收回去 - 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: ...I'm just gonna have to take it back. - What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为 因为它…
sense_groups.english: Because. Because it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 它就像你买了这把吉他…
sense_groups.english: It'd be like you having this guitar...

sense_groups.chinese: 却从来不弹它
sense_groups.english: ...and never playing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这把吉他希望被弹
sense_groups.english: Okay, this guitar wants to be played.

sense_groups.chinese: 这辆脚踏车希望被骑
sense_groups.english: And this bike wants to be ridden.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不骑它…
sense_groups.english: And if you don't ride it...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是在扼杀它的灵魂
sense_groups.english: ...you're killing its spirit.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚踏车…
sense_groups.english: The bike...

sense_groups.chinese: 快死了
sense_groups.english: ...is dying.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你真的那么在乎 不惜撒下漫天大谎 我学就是了
sense_groups.english: All right. If you care enough to make up that load of crap, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让脚踏车非常快乐
sense_groups.english: You're making the bike very happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道啦 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 请不要死掉
sense_groups.english: Please don't die.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得在他们看到评估表前 把它拿回来…
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think we can get the evaluation back before they see it.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们得溜进塞纳的办公室 通常他十点才会到
sense_groups.english: We have to get into Mr. Zelner's office. He doesn't get in until 10, so no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他的助理贝蒂一大早 就会到办公室吃早餐
sense_groups.english: But his assistant, Betty, comes in early to eat her breakfast at her desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很悲惨 - 没错 贝蒂有点惨
sense_groups.english: That's kind of sad. - Yeah, well, Betty's kind of sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我相信我可以 用这些巧克力把她诱开
sense_groups.english: Which is why I believe I can lure her away with these chocolates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我诱开她后 你就跑进去
sense_groups.english: Now, while I distract her, you go in the office.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 - 我们行动吧
sense_groups.english: Got it. - Let's roll.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋 你有空吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello, Rachel. You, uh, got a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 塞纳先生 你有事吗？我随时都有空
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure, Mr. Zelner. For you? Anything. Minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 取消计划
sense_groups.english: Abort the plan. Abort the plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我想跟你们两个谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, I'd like to speak to both of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事需要帮忙吗？塞纳先生 或许你想吃点巧克力
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, can we get you anything, Mr. Zelner? Maybe some chocolates?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢你 但我可以把它们送给贝蒂
sense_groups.english: Um, no, thanks, but I'll give these to Betty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过你对泰格做的评估表
sense_groups.english: So I read your evaluation of Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该叫他的全名 泰格"小可爱"琼斯？
sense_groups.english: Or, uh, to use his full name, Tag "Sweet Cheeks" Jones?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们之间有什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Is something going on with you two?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你能想像如果有会怎么样吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, can you imagine if there was?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是那样的话会怎样？
sense_groups.english: I mean, what would happen exactly?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样啊 我一定得写份报告
sense_groups.english: Well, I'd be forced to file a report.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得跟法律部门商量
sense_groups.english: I'd have to consult with the legal department.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在公司的未来 可能会有问题
sense_groups.english: And your future at the company would be in jeopardy.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔… - 塞纳先生…
sense_groups.english: Well... - Uh, Mr. Zelner...

sense_groups.chinese: 那份评估表是我写的
sense_groups.english: ...I'm the one who filled in that evaluation.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不… - 对 对 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, no... - Yeah, yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为这会很好玩
sense_groups.english: I thought it would be funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你写着你有可爱的小屁屁？
sense_groups.english: You wrote that you have a cute tushy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的幽默感很奇怪
sense_groups.english: I have a weird sense of humor.

sense_groups.chinese: 很奇怪地 我以自己的屁股为荣
sense_groups.english: And I'm kind of strangely proud of my butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 开这种玩笑太危险了 泰格
sense_groups.english: It's kind of a risky joke, Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 这到底是在画什么？我看不懂
sense_groups.english: And what is this drawing? I can't figure out what this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 它倒过来了 你知道吗？那不重要
sense_groups.english: You're looking at it upside down... You know what? It doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是没有幽默感的人
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's not like I don't have a sense of humor, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我甚至很喜欢写 挑逗性的打油诗
sense_groups.english: Hell, I even enjoy a naughty limerick every now and then.

sense_groups.chinese: 但时间跟地点是很重要的
sense_groups.english: But there's a time and a place, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你有写打油诗的灵感
sense_groups.english: Unless you, uh, have a limerick right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有吗？好吧 你知道我的传真机号码
sense_groups.english: No? Okay. Well, uh, you've got my fax number.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你会那么做 那太贴心了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you did that. That was really sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 - 你可能会丢掉工作
sense_groups.english: Ah, don't worry about it. - No, you could've lost your job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗？有这么可爱的屁股 我一定能找到工作
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding me? With a cute butt like this, I'd find work.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 你太棒了
sense_groups.english: Thank you, you're great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You know what? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我感觉棒极了
sense_groups.english: I feel great.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上…
sense_groups.english: In fact...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…我花了很多时间 才把桌子整理好
sense_groups.english: It's just... It took me so long to get that desk organized.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就对了
sense_groups.english: There it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在等糖果 把糖果拿出来
sense_groups.english: We're waiting for the candy. Bring out the candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 小姐 快给我们糖果
sense_groups.english: Yeah, lady, give us candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事？兄弟 - 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What's up, buddy? - What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在等着拿糖果
sense_groups.english: Waiting to get candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 快进来
sense_groups.english: Get in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你不能在这里抽烟
sense_groups.english: Hey, and you cannot smoke in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Merry Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 糖果做好了 我得让它 冷却十五分钟
sense_groups.english: Okay, guys, the candy is coming. I just need 15 minutes for the chocolate to cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 大伙们 安静 安静 请闭嘴
sense_groups.english: All right, everybody, just be quiet. Be quiet. Be quiet. Pipe down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you people?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个女人在为你们做好事
sense_groups.english: This woman was trying to do a nice thing for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她想做糖果 是为了要认识你们
sense_groups.english: She was making candy so she could try to get to know all of you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说你们没有人 能叫出她的名字
sense_groups.english: ...and I'll bet that not one of you can tell me her name.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没说错吧？
sense_groups.english: Am I right?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是糖果小姐？
sense_groups.english: Candy Lady?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是"糖果小姐"
sense_groups.english: No, not "Candy Lady."

sense_groups.chinese: 知道她的名字就能拿到糖果吗？
sense_groups.english: If we know it, can we have candy?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们知道吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 忘了糖果 你们毁了一切
sense_groups.english: Forget it. All of you, forget it. You've ruined it.

sense_groups.chinese: 回家去吧 你们毁了一切
sense_groups.english: Go home. You've ruined it. You've ruined it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不对的 你们毁了一切 你们毁了这个机会
sense_groups.english: That's all wrong. You guys ruined everything. You ruined it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 别客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 你抽了烟吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you smoke?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 老烟枪婆婆 把烟直接喷入我的嘴巴里
sense_groups.english: No, smokes-a-lot lady blew smoke directly into my mouth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧？
sense_groups.english: Uh, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 但刚刚真的有点可怕
sense_groups.english: I'm fine now, but it was really scary there for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人将恐吓纸条 塞到门缝下
sense_groups.english: Someone slipped a threatening note under the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我很抱歉 我受到暴动状态的影响
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Sorry about that. Mob mentality or whatever. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 我办到了 我会骑脚踏车了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. I did it. I rode a bike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没想过我能这么做 谢谢你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: I never thought I'd be able to do that. Thank you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 别谢我 谢谢你自己
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, don't thank me. Thank yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你面对了自己的恐惧 终于克服了它
sense_groups.english: You're the one who faced your fears and ultimately overcame them.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说些陈腔滥调的话 又不是《我的这一班》
sense_groups.english: Don't be so corny, Ross. It's not an After School Special.

questions.name: S07E10
questions.en:
Bye-bye.
I just got reservations at Michelle's...
...and tickets to The Music Man to celebrate...
...our first holiday as a betrothed couple.
"Betrothed." - Betrothed couple.
Hey. - Hi.
Aw. - Oh.
Pheebs? - Uh-huh?
Skull?
Oh. Yeah, it's my mom's.
Oh, my God!
No, no, no. It's not my mom.
It belonged to my mom.
She used to put it out every Christmas...
...to remind us that even though it's Christmas, people still die.
And you can put candy in it.
Hey. - Hey.
Licorice?
Sure. Ha, ha.
I get Ben for the holidays this year. - That's great!
Are you gonna dress up as Santa? - Nope.
I know Susan does every year.
I want to take this year to teach him about Hanukkah.
And maybe I could teach Ben...
...about the Christmas skull and how people die.
You may need to use this year to teach Ben about Phoebe.
Mm.
Hey.
Did you know he was in there? - No.
How long have we been home? - About half an hour.
Lovely.
You know what I was thinking? When we get married, will you, uh...
...change your name to "Bing"?
No.
Why not?
Bing's weird.
Oh, hey, you guys.
Hey. - Hey
Guess what?
My landlord just called. My apartment's gonna be ready soon.
I guess I'll be moving out.
Aw, Phoebe, I'm gonna miss you.
Yes, you will be very sad.
I gotta go tell Rachel the good news. - Oh. You'll be living together again?
Why not? - She's having so much fun with Joey...
...I assumed she'd still be living with him.
Why do you think she's having so much fun?
No reason, except she...
...told me.
She said she didn't want to live with me?
No. No, she didn't say that.
I think you should talk to Monica now.
Phoebe, I'm sure she wants to live with you.
You're absolutely sure?
No, but I'll bet she probably does.
Oh, probably?
I don't like that word.
I know what "probably" really means. Yeah, uh-huh, yeah.
"Oh, your mom probably won't kill herself."
You know. I'm sorry, but I'm not hanging my hopes...
...of Rachel and I living together on "probably."
You gotta take care of yourself in this world.
History teaches us nothing.
Bing doesn't seem so weird now, does it?
You're home.
Guess what Phoebe got me for Christmas?
Drums? - No, drums!
Could we get two burritos to go, please? Ha, ha.
I'm sorry. But not that sorry, you don't have to live with it.
Um, we have a reservation under Bing.
Okay, we'll have a table for you in about 45 minutes.
We have tickets to The Music Man at 8.
I'm sorry. Christmas is a very busy time, sir.
Is this because of the burrito thing?
You need to give him money. - Give him money? It was a joke!
To get a table. Places like this are always shaking you down.
Everybody wants a payoff. - All right, calm down, O'Malley.
I'll slip him some money. - But you've got to be smooth.
Hey, I can be smooth.
We're in a hurry. If you could get us a table...
...a bit quicker, I'd appreciate it.
Of course, sir. - Okay.
How'd it go? - Had the money in the wrong hand.
You don't feel...
...like you're gonna throw up? - No.
Well, I do. So let's...
So, Ben, you, uh...
You know what holiday is coming up?
Christmas.
Yeah, and you know what other holiday is coming up?
Christmas Eve.
Yes, but also...
Hanukkah!
See, you're part Jewish and Hanukkah is a Jewish holiday.
Santa has reindeers that can fly.
Right, um, but on Hanukkah...
Hanukkah is a celebration of a miracle.
Years and years ago there were these people called the Maccabees.
Jingle bells, jingle bells
Okay, that's right. Yes...
...but on Hanukkah, we sing, uh
Dreidel, dreidel, dreidel I made you out of clay
Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer
Ha, ha. Okay, it's not a contest.
When is Santa coming?
How about this year, instead of Santa...
...we have fun celebrating Hanukkah?
No Santa?
Was I bad?
No, no, no, you weren't bad. You've been very good, Ben.
Santa's mad at me. - No, hey, hey, come on.
Ben, Santa is not mad at you, okay?
You're his favorite little guy.
So Santa's coming?
Yes!
Santa's coming.
It's easy. Just keep it casual.
Shake his hand and give him the money.
How do you know so much about this? - I don't know.
Richard used to do it, didn't he?
We'd be eating our soup right now.
Mustached bastard.
Those people just left. Come on. Quick, give him the money.
Excuse me.
We're in a bit of a hurry. Can we please?
Ah-ha-ha-ha.
Ha!
So you like the drums.
That's great.
I was worried that they would create maybe...
...an unbearable living situation.
But, okay, well, apparently not. So, yay!
Hey, we already learned a song.
Ready? One, two, three, four.
Tequila!
That's fun.
Here you go.
Thank you, Gunther. Put her there.
Definitely not easier with coins.
Thank you.
Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.
Here. Now I only owe you $49.50.
Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.
If you want to get Joey a gift that disrupts the entire building...
...why not something more subtle...
...like a wrecking ball...
...or a vial of smallpox to release in the hallway?
It's not just the drum noise. Every five minutes...
...Joey throws his sticks in the air...
...and I have to hear: "Oh, my eye! Oh, God, my eye!"
I mean, it's so annoying. - Yes, thank you.
You see, this is how normal people are supposed to react to drums.
You got Joey drums to annoy Rachel...
...so she wouldn't want to live there anymore?
Maybe on some level.
You could just not throw the sticks up in the air.
What is rock 'n' roll about that?
Hey, Joey, I got you another present.
Hold it! Before you tell me what it is...
Okay, what is it?
It's a...
...tarantula!
Oh.
God, Rachel, I'm sorry. What was I thinking...
...giving Joey this big, gross, scary spider...
...in such a poorly constructed cage?
What are you talking about? I love them.
I had a tarantula when I was a kid. But it died because my cat ate it.
And then my cat died.
But, Joey, isn't this cool?
Is it on me? I feel like it's on me. I got...
Oh, isn't that adorable?
Joey is afraid of the tarantula. - Oh.
He's so adorable.
He's so much fun.
I'm glad you're having so much fun here.
Whoa. Wait a minute.
What's the matter?
Our apartment is ready.
And that makes you angry because?
Because you'd rather live here with Joey.
Where did you get that? - Monica and Chandler...
...said you were having so much fun here...
...and apparently no amount of drums or tarantulas is gonna change that.
Did you get all this stuff for Joey...
...to try to drive me out of the apartment?
You might as well have gotten him a fish.
You know how fish freak me out.
Fish.
But it wouldn't have mattered. We're gonna live together.
That's the deal.
Yes, but I wanted you to want to live with me.
But if you're having so much fun over here...
Oh. It's so much more fun with you.
We did have fun, didn't we? - We did.
They say if we want, we could see it tonight.
I would love to. - Yay, okay!
Good, good, good. - Great. All right. Good.
And Monica asked me to make the drumming stop.
Um, ahem.
Done.
Hey.
Hello, sir. You here to return those pants?
No, these are my pants.
Oh.
Okay.
How can I help you? - Um, do you have a Santa outfit left?
Two days before Christmas? Sorry, man.
Okay, look. Do you have anything, uh, Christmas-y?
I promised my son, and I really don't want to disappoint him.
Um, come on, you gotta have something.
I'm the Holiday Armadillo!
I'm a friend of Santa's...
...and he sent me here to wish you...
...a merry Christmas!
What happened to Santa, Holiday Armadillo?
Santa was unavailable...
...so close to Christmas.
Come in, have a seat.
You must be exhausted, coming all the way from Texas.
Texas? - That's right, Ben.
I'm Santa's representative...
...for all the Southern states.
And Mexico!
But Santa sent me here...
...to give you these presents, Ben.
Maybe the lady will help me with these presents.
Wow, thanks!
You're welcome, Ben.
Merry Christmas. Ooh.
And happy Hanukkah!
Are you for Hanukkah too? Because I'm part Jewish.
You are? Me too.
Because armadillos also wandered in the desert?
You want to wander in the hall?
Oh. Hey, Ben!
What if the Holiday Armadillo...
...told you all about the Festival of Lights?
Cool!
Come on, Ben.
Years and years ago...
...there were these people called...
...the Maccabees!
Ho-ho-ho. Merry Christmas!
Santa!
Hey.
What are you doing here, Santa?
Well, I'm here to see my old buddy, Ben.
What are you doing here...
...Weird Turtle Man?
I'm the Holiday Armadillo...
...your part-Jewish friend.
You sent me here to give Ben some presents.
Remember?
What?
Did you bring me any presents, Santa?
You bet I did, Ben.
Put her there.
Well, it would have worked this time if his hands weren't so damn small.
Ho-ho-ho.
Ben, come open more presents.
Santa, the armadillo and I will have a talk in the kitchen.
There's a sentence I never thought I'd say.
What are you doing?
You said you were having trouble finding a Santa costume...
...so I borrowed one from a guy at work.
Thank you, but you gotta leave.
Why? - Because...
...I'm finally getting him excited about Hanukkah...
...and you're wrecking it.
But I didn't get to shake my belly like a bowlful of jelly.
I'm sorry, Chandler, but this is really important to me.
Fine, I'll give the suit back.
Hey, you think you can keep it another night?
Santa, really?
Yeah, is that okay?
Did your dad ever dress up like Santa?
No. - Then it's okay!
Okay, Ben. Santa has to go.
Say goodbye.
No, why does he have to go?
Because if Santa and the Holiday...
...Armadillo...
...are ever in the same room for too long...
...the universe will implode!
Merry Christmas!
No, why can't the armadillo leave? I want Santa.
Fine, I give up. Santa...
Santa can stay!
Well, I'll stay...
...but only because I want to hear about Hanukkah.
Ben, will you sit here with Santa...
...and learn about Hanukkah?
Okay, Santa.
Thank you. - You're welcome.
All right, it's time...
...for the story of Hanukkah.
Years and years ago...
...there were these people called the Maccabees!
Merry Christmas!
Oh, wow, look at this place!
Oh, this is terrible.
They've made so many changes...
...I can't even feel my grandmother's presence anymore.
Oh, new sconces!
Oh, my God! - What?
Remember, uh, how you told me your grandmother put up that wall...
...to make that into two bedrooms? - Yeah.
And that the landlord might find out...
...and then tear it down? - Yeah?
Do you really not know where I'm going?
It left. It's one huge room.
Oh, no!
Wow!
See?
I guess we'll have to put the wall back up.
You can't because of the new skylight. - There's a skylight?
Wow!
Oh. So should we start looking for a new place?
You know, I'm sensing...
...that, um, my grandmother would not be comfortable with that.
Oh, yeah?
Starting to feel her again there, are we?
A little bit. Yeah. - Yeah.
Is your grandmother maybe saying that you should live here alone?
You heard it too? You have the gift.
Phoebe, it's okay.
I like living with Joey.
Are you sure? - Please. I hate packing...
...it's closer to work.
And we do have fun.
Although, I'm really gonna miss living with you.
Oh, me too. - I know.
Oh. Did you hear that?
I'm getting something from your grandmother.
She said since you get to keep the one-bedroom apartment...
...you should give Rachel the purple chair.
No, I do not hear that.
And the miracle was that that little bit of oil...
...that should have lasted just one day, burned for...
Eight whole days. - That's right.
And that's why we celebrate Hanukkah today. The end.
Awesome. - Yeah.
My favorite part...
...was when Superman flew all the Jews out of Egypt.
The armadillo was actually not so thrilled about that part.
Okay, Ben, it's time to light...
...the Hanukkah candles!
Ho-ho-ho.
Hey.
Oh. - Wow.
Looks like the Easter Bunny's funeral in here.
Come on, come on. We're lighting the candles.
Oh, oh.
I understand why Superman is here...
...but why is there a porcupine at the Easter Bunny's funeral?
You get it? - I got it.
Back in the cage?
It's back in the cage.
Is the cage closed?
Joey, will you just come out here and stop being such a baby?
