Awesome. - Yeah.
My favorite part...
...was when Superman flew all the Jews out of Egypt.
The armadillo was actually not so thrilled about that part.
Okay, Ben, it's time to light...
...the Hanukkah candles!
Ho-ho-ho.
Hey.
Oh. - Wow.
Looks like the Easter Bunny's funeral in here.
Come on, come on. We're lighting the candles.
Oh, oh.
I understand why Superman is here...
...but why is there a porcupine at the Easter Bunny's funeral?
You get it? - I got it.
Back in the cage?
It's back in the cage.
Is the cage closed?
Joey, will you just come out here and stop being such a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在米雪餐厅订好位子了…
sense_groups.english: I just got reservations at Michelle's...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有《音乐人》的票来庆祝…
sense_groups.english: ...and tickets to The Music Man to celebrate...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们成为"顶婚"夫妻后 第一个正式的节日
sense_groups.english: ...our first holiday as a betrothed couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 是"订婚" - 订婚夫妻
sense_groups.english: "Betrothed." - Betrothed couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Aw. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 哈？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs? - Uh-huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 骷髅头？
sense_groups.english: Skull?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 是我妈的
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yeah, it's my mom's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 不是我妈
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. It's not my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 是属于我妈的
sense_groups.english: It belonged to my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 她以前每次圣诞节都会拿出来…
sense_groups.english: She used to put it out every Christmas...

sense_groups.chinese: 要我们记得即使是圣诞节 人还是会死的
sense_groups.english: ...to remind us that even though it's Christmas, people still die.

sense_groups.chinese: 还可以放糖果在里面
sense_groups.english: And you can put candy in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃糖？
sense_groups.english: Licorice?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Sure. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 今年班和我一起过节 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: I get Ben for the holidays this year. - That's great!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要扮成圣诞老公公吗？ - 不要
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna dress up as Santa? - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道苏珊每年都这么做…
sense_groups.english: I know Susan does every year.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是今年我想教他了解光明节
sense_groups.english: I want to take this year to teach him about Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我能教班…
sense_groups.english: And maybe I could teach Ben...

sense_groups.chinese: 有关圣诞骷髅头和人怎么死亡
sense_groups.english: ...about the Christmas skull and how people die.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以在今年教班认识菲比
sense_groups.english: You may need to use this year to teach Ben about Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他在里面吗？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Did you know he was in there? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回来多久了？ - 大概半小时
sense_groups.english: How long have we been home? - About half an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了
sense_groups.english: Lovely.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我在想什么？ 我们结婚后 你要不要…
sense_groups.english: You know what I was thinking? When we get married, will you, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 改冠夫姓"宾"？
sense_groups.english: ...change your name to "Bing"?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不要？
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: "宾"很奇怪
sense_groups.english: Bing's weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Guess what?

sense_groups.chinese: 猜猜怎么着 我房东刚刚通知我 我的房子快好了
sense_groups.english: My landlord just called. My apartment's gonna be ready soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我很快就会搬出去了
sense_groups.english: I guess I'll be moving out.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我会想念你的
sense_groups.english: Aw, Phoebe, I'm gonna miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你会很伤心
sense_groups.english: Yes, you will be very sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉瑞秋这个好消息 - 你们要再住在一起吗？
sense_groups.english: I gotta go tell Rachel the good news. - Oh. You'll be living together again?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 为什么不？ - 她和乔伊住得很开心…
sense_groups.english: Why not? - She's having so much fun with Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为她还会 继续和他住在一起
sense_groups.english: ...I assumed she'd still be living with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你认为 她和乔伊住得很开心？
sense_groups.english: Why do you think she's having so much fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 没为什么 只不过…
sense_groups.english: No reason, except she...

sense_groups.chinese: 她是这么跟我说的
sense_groups.english: ...told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？她说她不要和我住？
sense_groups.english: She said she didn't want to live with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 她没这么说
sense_groups.english: No. No, she didn't say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你该和摩妮卡说话了
sense_groups.english: I think you should talk to Monica now.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别担心 我确定她想和你住的
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I'm sure she wants to live with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定？你很肯定？
sense_groups.english: You're absolutely sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我打赌她大概会
sense_groups.english: No, but I'll bet she probably does.

sense_groups.chinese: 大概？
sense_groups.english: Oh, probably?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢这个词
sense_groups.english: I don't like that word.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道"大概"真正的意思 是啊 是啊
sense_groups.english: I know what "probably" really means. Yeah, uh-huh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: "你妈大概不会自杀"
sense_groups.english: "Oh, your mom probably won't kill herself."

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我不要把我和瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: You know. I'm sorry, but I'm not hanging my hopes...

sense_groups.chinese: 住在一起的希望寄托在"大概"上面
sense_groups.english: ...of Rachel and I living together on "probably."

sense_groups.chinese: 人在这世上要自己照顾自己
sense_groups.english: You gotta take care of yourself in this world.

sense_groups.chinese: 历史教训完全没用
sense_groups.english: History teaches us nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: "宾"现在不是那么奇怪了吧？
sense_groups.english: Bing doesn't seem so weird now, does it?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你在家
sense_groups.english: You're home.

sense_groups.chinese: 猜猜菲比送我什么圣诞礼物
sense_groups.english: Guess what Phoebe got me for Christmas?

sense_groups.chinese: 鼓？ - 不 鼓
sense_groups.english: Drums? - No, drums!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 请给我们两个墨西哥卷外带
sense_groups.english: Could we get two burritos to go, please? Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 不过没那么抱歉 因为你不用和他在一起生活
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. But not that sorry, you don't have to live with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们用钱德宾的名字订了位子
sense_groups.english: Um, we have a reservation under Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 大约要等45分钟
sense_groups.english: Okay, we'll have a table for you in about 45 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 45分钟？《音乐人》的票是8点的
sense_groups.english: We have tickets to The Music Man at 8.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 圣诞节是最忙的时候
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Christmas is a very busy time, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是因为墨西哥卷的玩笑吗？
sense_groups.english: Is this because of the burrito thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 要给他钱 - 给他钱？那只是个玩笑
sense_groups.english: You need to give him money. - Give him money? It was a joke!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 为了我们的位子 这种地方都是死要钱的
sense_groups.english: To get a table. Places like this are always shaking you down.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都要小费 - 好 镇静下来
sense_groups.english: Everybody wants a payoff. - All right, calm down, O'Malley.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会塞钱给他 - 可是要不着痕迹
sense_groups.english: I'll slip him some money. - But you've got to be smooth.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我可以不着痕迹
sense_groups.english: Hey, I can be smooth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有点赶时间 如果可以让我们早一点…
sense_groups.english: We're in a hurry. If you could get us a table...

sense_groups.chinese: 排到位子 我会很感激
sense_groups.english: ...a bit quicker, I'd appreciate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 先生 - 好
sense_groups.english: Of course, sir. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？ - 钱在另一只手里
sense_groups.english: How'd it go? - Had the money in the wrong hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得的…
sense_groups.english: You don't feel...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要扔了吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: ...like you're gonna throw up? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会 所以我们…
sense_groups.english: Well, I do. So let's...

sense_groups.chinese: 班 你…
sense_groups.english: So, Ben, you, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道快过节了 对不对？
sense_groups.english: You know what holiday is coming up?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞节
sense_groups.english: Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你知道另一个节日也要到了？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and you know what other holiday is coming up?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞夜
sense_groups.english: Christmas Eve.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但…
sense_groups.english: Yes, but also...

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节也是
sense_groups.english: Hanukkah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是一半犹太人 光明节是犹太人的节日
sense_groups.english: See, you're part Jewish and Hanukkah is a Jewish holiday.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公有会飞的麋鹿
sense_groups.english: Santa has reindeers that can fly.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但在光明节…
sense_groups.english: Right, um, but on Hanukkah...

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节是庆祝一个奇迹
sense_groups.english: Hanukkah is a celebration of a miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多年前 有一群人叫做玛加伯人
sense_groups.english: Years and years ago there were these people called the Maccabees.

sense_groups.chinese: 叮叮当 叮叮当
sense_groups.english: Jingle bells, jingle bells

sense_groups.chinese: 好 对 是的…
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's right. Yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 但在光明节 我们唱的是
sense_groups.english: ...but on Hanukkah, we sing, uh

sense_groups.chinese: 陀螺 陀螺 陀螺 我给你做粘土
sense_groups.english: Dreidel, dreidel, dreidel I made you out of clay

sense_groups.chinese: 鲁道夫 红鼻子的驯鹿
sense_groups.english: Rudolph the red-nosed reindeer

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这不是在比赛
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Okay, it's not a contest.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公什么时候来？
sense_groups.english: When is Santa coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好不好 今年我们 不要圣诞老公公…
sense_groups.english: How about this year, instead of Santa...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来庆祝光明节？
sense_groups.english: ...we have fun celebrating Hanukkah?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有圣诞老公公？
sense_groups.english: No Santa?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不乖吗？
sense_groups.english: Was I bad?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 你没有不乖 你今年很乖 班
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, you weren't bad. You've been very good, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公生我的气 - 不是 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Santa's mad at me. - No, hey, hey, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 班 圣诞老公公 没有生你的气 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Ben, Santa is not mad at you, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是他最喜欢的小孩
sense_groups.english: You're his favorite little guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以圣诞老公公会来罗？
sense_groups.english: So Santa's coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公会来
sense_groups.english: Santa's coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 很简单 保持轻松
sense_groups.english: It's easy. Just keep it casual.

sense_groups.chinese: 说句好话 和他握手 塞钱给他
sense_groups.english: Shake his hand and give him the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么这么了解？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: How do you know so much about this? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查以前常这么做 是不是？
sense_groups.english: Richard used to do it, didn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在可能已经在喝汤了
sense_groups.english: We'd be eating our soup right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶的小胡子
sense_groups.english: Mustached bastard.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些人刚走 快 给他钱
sense_groups.english: Those people just left. Come on. Quick, give him the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们赶时间 可不可以…？
sense_groups.english: We're in a bit of a hurry. Can we please?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 哈哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ah-ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢鼓啊
sense_groups.english: So you like the drums.

sense_groups.chinese: 真好
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来还担心它们会造成…
sense_groups.english: I was worried that they would create maybe...

sense_groups.chinese: 无法忍耐的居住状况
sense_groups.english: ...an unbearable living situation.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 看来没有 好
sense_groups.english: But, okay, well, apparently not. So, yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我们学会了一首歌
sense_groups.english: Hey, we already learned a song.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了？1 2 3 4
sense_groups.english: Ready? One, two, three, four.

sense_groups.chinese: 塔奇拉
sense_groups.english: Tequila!

sense_groups.chinese: 真好玩
sense_groups.english: That's fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了
sense_groups.english: Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 阿甘 放在这里
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Gunther. Put her there.

sense_groups.chinese: 用铜板更不容易
sense_groups.english: Definitely not easier with coins.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 给你 现在我只欠你49块半
sense_groups.english: Here. Now I only owe you $49.50.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比… - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要送乔伊 毁掉整栋楼的圣诞礼物…
sense_groups.english: If you want to get Joey a gift that disrupts the entire building...

sense_groups.chinese: 何不送更微妙一点的…
sense_groups.english: ...why not something more subtle...

sense_groups.chinese: 像是铁锤…
sense_groups.english: ...like a wrecking ball...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是天花病毒散播在走廊上？
sense_groups.english: ...or a vial of smallpox to release in the hallway?

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是鼓的声音 每5分钟…
sense_groups.english: It's not just the drum noise. Every five minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊把鼓棒丢到空中…
sense_groups.english: ...Joey throws his sticks in the air...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我就会听到 "喔 我的眼睛 我的眼睛 "
sense_groups.english: ...and I have to hear: "Oh, my eye! Oh, God, my eye!"

sense_groups.chinese: 烦死人了 - 对 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's so annoying. - Yes, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 这是正常人对鼓的反应
sense_groups.english: You see, this is how normal people are supposed to react to drums.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你送乔伊鼓是为了烦瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: You got Joey drums to annoy Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 让她不想继续住在那里？
sense_groups.english: ...so she wouldn't want to live there anymore?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能有一点
sense_groups.english: Maybe on some level.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你知道你不用丢鼓棒的
sense_groups.english: You could just not throw the sticks up in the air.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样怎么能算是摇滚乐呢？
sense_groups.english: What is rock 'n' roll about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 送你另一个礼物
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey, I got you another present.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 先不要告诉我是什么…
sense_groups.english: Hold it! Before you tell me what it is...

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay, what is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 是一只…
sense_groups.english: It's a...

sense_groups.chinese: 毒蜘蛛
sense_groups.english: ...tarantula!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瑞秋 抱歉 我在想什么…
sense_groups.english: God, Rachel, I'm sorry. What was I thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 送乔伊这么一个 恶心的 可怕的蜘蛛…
sense_groups.english: ...giving Joey this big, gross, scary spider...

sense_groups.chinese: 还用这么一个松散的笼子？
sense_groups.english: ...in such a poorly constructed cage?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？我喜欢
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? I love them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我小时候就有一只 后来我的猫咪吃掉了它
sense_groups.english: I had a tarantula when I was a kid. But it died because my cat ate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后猫咪死了
sense_groups.english: And then my cat died.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这不是很酷吗？
sense_groups.english: But, Joey, isn't this cool?

sense_groups.chinese: 在我身上吗？ 我觉得他在我身上 我…
sense_groups.english: Is it on me? I feel like it's on me. I got...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是很可爱吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, isn't that adorable?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊怕蜘蛛 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Joey is afraid of the tarantula. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他好可爱哟
sense_groups.english: He's so adorable.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 他很好玩
sense_groups.english: He's so much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊是最棒的 很高兴你在这里住得很开心
sense_groups.english: I'm glad you're having so much fun here.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的房子好了
sense_groups.english: Our apartment is ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不高兴是因为…？
sense_groups.english: And that makes you angry because?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你比较想和乔伊住在这里
sense_groups.english: Because you'd rather live here with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么这么想？ - 摩妮卡和钱德…
sense_groups.english: Where did you get that? - Monica and Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 说你和乔伊住得很开心…
sense_groups.english: ...said you were having so much fun here...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且不管是鼓还是毒蜘殊 都不会改变这点
sense_groups.english: ...and apparently no amount of drums or tarantulas is gonna change that.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你送乔伊这些东西…
sense_groups.english: Did you get all this stuff for Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 是要让我不想住在这里？
sense_groups.english: ...to try to drive me out of the apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还不如送他一条鱼
sense_groups.english: You might as well have gotten him a fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我有多怕鱼
sense_groups.english: You know how fish freak me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 鱼
sense_groups.english: Fish.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些都不重要 我们会一起住的
sense_groups.english: But it wouldn't have mattered. We're gonna live together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是室友 讲好的
sense_groups.english: That's the deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 可是我希望你想和我一起住
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I wanted you to want to live with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是如果你在这里住得这么开心…
sense_groups.english: But if you're having so much fun over here...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 和你在一起更开心
sense_groups.english: Oh. It's so much more fun with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们住一起时很开心 对不对？ - 对啊 好玩的不得了
sense_groups.english: We did have fun, didn't we? - We did.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说如果要的话 今晚可以去看
sense_groups.english: They say if we want, we could see it tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 - 好 好
sense_groups.english: I would love to. - Yay, okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Good, good, good. - Great. All right. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡要我让鼓声停止
sense_groups.english: And Monica asked me to make the drumming stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Done.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 要退还那件裤子吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello, sir. You here to return those pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是我的裤子
sense_groups.english: No, these are my pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要什么？ - 还有没有圣诞老公公衣服？
sense_groups.english: How can I help you? - Um, do you have a Santa outfit left?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞节前两天？抱歉
sense_groups.english: Two days before Christmas? Sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 有没有什么 比较算是圣诞节的？
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. Do you have anything, uh, Christmas-y?

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应了我儿子 不想让他失望
sense_groups.english: I promised my son, and I really don't want to disappoint him.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你们一定有什么吧
sense_groups.english: Um, come on, you gotta have something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是佳节犰狳
sense_groups.english: I'm the Holiday Armadillo!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是圣诞老公公的朋友…
sense_groups.english: I'm a friend of Santa's...

sense_groups.chinese: 他要我来祝你…
sense_groups.english: ...and he sent me here to wish you...

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: ...a merry Christmas!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公怎么了 佳节犰狳？
sense_groups.english: What happened to Santa, Holiday Armadillo?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公没有空…
sense_groups.english: Santa was unavailable...

sense_groups.chinese: 在这么接近圣诞节的时候
sense_groups.english: ...so close to Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 请坐
sense_groups.english: Come in, have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定累坏了 大老远从德州跑来
sense_groups.english: You must be exhausted, coming all the way from Texas.

sense_groups.chinese: 德州？ - 对 班
sense_groups.english: Texas? - That's right, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是圣诞老公公的…
sense_groups.english: I'm Santa's representative...

sense_groups.chinese: 西南州代表
sense_groups.english: ...for all the Southern states.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有墨西哥
sense_groups.english: And Mexico!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公要我来这里…
sense_groups.english: But Santa sent me here...

sense_groups.chinese: 送礼物给你 班
sense_groups.english: ...to give you these presents, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这位小姐可以帮我拿礼物
sense_groups.english: Maybe the lady will help me with these presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Wow, thanks!

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 班
sense_groups.english: You're welcome, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Merry Christmas. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有…光明节快乐
sense_groups.english: And happy Hanukkah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你也为光明节而来吗？ 因为我是一半犹太人
sense_groups.english: Are you for Hanukkah too? Because I'm part Jewish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是？我也是
sense_groups.english: You are? Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为犰狳也在沙漠里游荡？
sense_groups.english: Because armadillos also wandered in the desert?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想在走廊游荡吗？
sense_groups.english: You want to wander in the hall?

sense_groups.chinese: 班
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hey, Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 何不让佳节犰狳…
sense_groups.english: What if the Holiday Armadillo...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你说光之节的故事好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...told you all about the Festival of Lights?

sense_groups.chinese: 酷
sense_groups.english: Cool!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 班
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多年以前…
sense_groups.english: Years and years ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 有一群人 叫做…
sense_groups.english: ...there were these people called...

sense_groups.chinese: 玛加伯人
sense_groups.english: ...the Maccabees!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Ho-ho-ho. Merry Christmas!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公
sense_groups.english: Santa!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来干什么 圣诞老公公？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here, Santa?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来看我的老朋友班
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm here to see my old buddy, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这儿干什么…
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here...

sense_groups.chinese: 怪…乌龟人？
sense_groups.english: ...Weird Turtle Man?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是佳节犰狳…
sense_groups.english: I'm the Holiday Armadillo...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的半犹太人朋友
sense_groups.english: ...your part-Jewish friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我来送礼物给班
sense_groups.english: You sent me here to give Ben some presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公 你有带礼物给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you bring me any presents, Santa?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然有 班
sense_groups.english: You bet I did, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 放在这里
sense_groups.english: Put her there.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是他的手太小 这次会成功的
sense_groups.english: Well, it would have worked this time if his hands weren't so damn small.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵 呵 呵
sense_groups.english: Ho-ho-ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 班 来开礼物
sense_groups.english: Ben, come open more presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公 佳节犰狳和我 要在厨房谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Santa, the armadillo and I will have a talk in the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝对想不到会说出这句话
sense_groups.english: There's a sentence I never thought I'd say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉每个人说 你找不到圣诞老公公衣服…
sense_groups.english: You said you were having trouble finding a Santa costume...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我向同事借了一件
sense_groups.english: ...so I borrowed one from a guy at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 可是你必须离开
sense_groups.english: Thank you, but you gotta leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为…
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于让他对光明节有兴趣…
sense_groups.english: ...I'm finally getting him excited about Hanukkah...

sense_groups.chinese: 而你正在破坏
sense_groups.english: ...and you're wrecking it.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我还没摇我的肚子呢
sense_groups.english: But I didn't get to shake my belly like a bowlful of jelly.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 钱德 这对我很重要
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Chandler, but this is really important to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我去还这套衣服
sense_groups.english: Fine, I'll give the suit back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你可以再多借一晚吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you think you can keep it another night?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公？真的？
sense_groups.english: Santa, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, is that okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸有扮过圣诞老公公吗？
sense_groups.english: Did your dad ever dress up like Santa?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 那就可以
sense_groups.english: No. - Then it's okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 班 圣诞老公公要走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ben. Santa has to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 说再见
sense_groups.english: Say goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 他为什么要走？
sense_groups.english: No, why does he have to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为圣诞老公公和佳节…
sense_groups.english: Because if Santa and the Holiday...

sense_groups.chinese: 犰狳…
sense_groups.english: ...Armadillo...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果在同一个房子里太久…
sense_groups.english: ...are ever in the same room for too long...

sense_groups.chinese: 宇宙会爆炸
sense_groups.english: ...the universe will implode!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Merry Christmas!

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 为什么不是犰狳走呢？ 我要圣诞老公公
sense_groups.english: No, why can't the armadillo leave? I want Santa.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我放弃 圣诞老公公…
sense_groups.english: Fine, I give up. Santa...

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公可以留下来
sense_groups.english: Santa can stay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我留下来…
sense_groups.english: Well, I'll stay...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我想听光明节的故事
sense_groups.english: ...but only because I want to hear about Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 班 你要不要和圣诞老公公…
sense_groups.english: Ben, will you sit here with Santa...

sense_groups.chinese: 一起坐下来听光明节的故事？
sense_groups.english: ...and learn about Hanukkah?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 圣诞老人
sense_groups.english: Okay, Santa.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 来听…
sense_groups.english: All right, it's time...

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节的故事了
sense_groups.english: ...for the story of Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多年以前…
sense_groups.english: Years and years ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 有一群人叫玛加伯人
sense_groups.english: ...there were these people called the Maccabees!

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Merry Christmas!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 看看这地方
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow, look at this place!

sense_groups.chinese: 真糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们改了很多…
sense_groups.english: They've made so many changes...

sense_groups.chinese: 我感受不到我祖母的存在了
sense_groups.english: ...I can't even feel my grandmother's presence anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 新的烛台
sense_groups.english: Oh, new sconces!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得你告诉我你祖母要做一道墙…
sense_groups.english: Remember, uh, how you told me your grandmother put up that wall...

sense_groups.chinese: 来隔成两间房？ - 对
sense_groups.english: ...to make that into two bedrooms? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说房东可能会发现…
sense_groups.english: And that the landlord might find out...

sense_groups.chinese: 把它拆了？ - 对？
sense_groups.english: ...and then tear it down? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不知道我说这些的原因？
sense_groups.english: Do you really not know where I'm going?

sense_groups.chinese: 墙没有了 是一间大房间
sense_groups.english: It left. It's one huge room.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow!

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧？
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们必须要把墙弄回来
sense_groups.english: I guess we'll have to put the wall back up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 因为新的天窗 - 有天窗？
sense_groups.english: You can't because of the new skylight. - There's a skylight?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办？要开始找新地方吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh. So should we start looking for a new place?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗？我感受到…
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm sensing...

sense_groups.chinese: 我祖母可能不喜欢那样
sense_groups.english: ...that, um, my grandmother would not be comfortable with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 又能感觉到她了 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Starting to feel her again there, are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点 对 - 是
sense_groups.english: A little bit. Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你祖母是不是说 你应该一个人住这里？
sense_groups.english: Is your grandmother maybe saying that you should live here alone?

sense_groups.chinese: 你也听见了？你有天分
sense_groups.english: You heard it too? You have the gift.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 没关系
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢和乔伊住
sense_groups.english: I like living with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定吗？ - 拜托 我讨厌收拾行李…
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Please. I hate packing...

sense_groups.chinese: 那里离公司比较近
sense_groups.english: ...it's closer to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在一起很开心
sense_groups.english: And we do have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我真的会想念和你住在一起
sense_groups.english: Although, I'm really gonna miss living with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, me too. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你有没有听到？
sense_groups.english: Oh. Did you hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 听 我听到你祖母在说话
sense_groups.english: I'm getting something from your grandmother.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说既然你要一个人住这里…
sense_groups.english: She said since you get to keep the one-bedroom apartment...

sense_groups.chinese: 你该把那把紫色椅子给瑞秋
sense_groups.english: ...you should give Rachel the purple chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我没有听到
sense_groups.english: No, I do not hear that.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇迹在于那一点点的油…
sense_groups.english: And the miracle was that that little bit of oil...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该只够烧一天的 却烧了…
sense_groups.english: ...that should have lasted just one day, burned for...

sense_groups.chinese: 整整8天 - 对
sense_groups.english: Eight whole days. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是为什么我们 今天庆祝光明节 故事完结
sense_groups.english: And that's why we celebrate Hanukkah today. The end.

sense_groups.chinese: 好棒 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Awesome. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最喜欢的部分…
sense_groups.english: My favorite part...

sense_groups.chinese: 是超人救出全埃及的犹太人
sense_groups.english: ...was when Superman flew all the Jews out of Egypt.

sense_groups.chinese: 犰狳不是那么喜欢那部分
sense_groups.english: The armadillo was actually not so thrilled about that part.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 班 该来点…
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ben, it's time to light...

sense_groups.chinese: 光明节蜡烛了
sense_groups.english: ...the Hanukkah candles!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ho-ho-ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像是复活节兔子的葬礼
sense_groups.english: Looks like the Easter Bunny's funeral in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 来 我们要点蜡烛
sense_groups.english: Come on, come on. We're lighting the candles.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解为什么超人在这里…
sense_groups.english: I understand why Superman is here...

sense_groups.chinese: 但为什么有豪猪 参加复活节兔子的葬礼？
sense_groups.english: ...but why is there a porcupine at the Easter Bunny's funeral?

sense_groups.chinese: 你弄好了吗？ - 弄好了
sense_groups.english: You get it? - I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他进笼子了没？
sense_groups.english: Back in the cage?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在笼子里了
sense_groups.english: It's back in the cage.

sense_groups.chinese: 笼子关好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Is the cage closed?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 出来好吗？ 别像个小孩一样
sense_groups.english: Joey, will you just come out here and stop being such a baby?

questions.name: S07E11
questions.en:
Oh. Mm.
Hi. - Hey.
You have got to try this cheesecake.
Oh, you know, I'm not that much of a sweet tooth...
Oh, my God, it's so creamy. - Oh.
Oh, my God. That's the best cheesecake I've ever had.
Where did you get this?
It was at the front door when I got home. Somebody sent it to us.
Chandler, this isn't addressed to you.
This is addressed to Mrs. Braverman downstairs.
Thief.
I didn't read the box before I opened it...
...and you can't return a box after you opened it.
Why not? - Because it's too delicious.
Chandler, you stole this cheesecake. That is wrong.
No, no, no, it is going to be okay...
...because Mrs. Braverman is gonna send away for a free one.
And that way, we all win.
The only losers are the big cheesecake conglomerate
"Mama's Little Bakery."
I feel terrible.
I'm a horrible, horrible, horrible person.
Well, I'm sorry, what?
I should get going. Big day at work.
You know how I'm in a coma?
Today they do a test on me and it turns out I'm not brain-dead.
So...
Ah-ah, Mr. Smarty-Pants.
It's just my character that's not brain-dead.
Pheebs, still on for tonight?
Absolutely. Okay. - All right, I'll see you at 8.
Oh, what's at 8?
Oh, I have dinner plans with Joey.
We get together about once a month to discuss the rest of you guys.
Wow. Did not know that.
May I say how lovely you look today?
Duly noted.
Oh, so for tomorrow...
...do you want to rent a car and drive down together or what?
What are you talking about?
Cousin Frannie's wedding. It's tomorrow night.
You were invited?
No.
Oh, my God, I can't believe this.
I knew Mom and Dad were invited. I thought that was it.
I mean, from the ages of 7 to 9, Frannie and I were inseparable.
Well, maybe since the age of 9, Frannie's made some new friends.
Look, it's probably just a mistake. Let me call Aunt Cheryl, okay?
Maybe you are invited and the invitation just got lost in the mail.
Yeah, well, you call her and tell her that, you know, when we were kids...
...her precious little Frannie tried to undress me several times, okay?
If I hadn't stopped her, there probably wouldn't be a wedding to go to.
She tried to undress me too.
I used to undress my cousin Glenn.
Joseph Francis Tribbiani, are you home yet?
Um, I think he's still out. What's wrong?
Well, I'll tell you, Rachel Karen Green.
I had plans with Joey tonight, and he left me this note.
"Pheebs, can't make it. Got a date. Talk to you later.
Big Daddy."
"Big Daddy"? - Oh, that's a nickname we were trying out.
Hey, you know what nickname never caught on? "The Ross-a-tron."
Hey. - Oh, here's Joseph Francis.
Whoa, what are you middle-naming me for?
I left you a note.
So what? That doesn't give you the right to ditch me.
Hey, you can cancel plans with friends if there's a possibility for sex.
Phoebe, he's right. That is the rule.
I don't accept this rule.
When we make plans, I expect you to show up.
Okay, I can't just be a way to kill time till you meet someone better.
You know, boyfriends and girlfriends are gonna come and go, but this is for life.
Wow. I'm so sorry. I had no idea it would bother you this much.
Well, it does.
Okay, can I make it up to you? Huh?
I'm sorry.
How about dinner tomorrow night? I'll pay for myself.
Okay, you wore me down.
Joe, while you're over there, how about another beer for "The Ross-a-tron"?
"Ross..." Is that back?
Hi. - The other cheesecake came.
They delivered it to the wrong address again.
So just bring it back downstairs. What's the problem?
I can't seem to say goodbye.
Are you serious? Chandler, we ate an entire cheesecake two days ago...
...and you want more?
Well, I've forgotten what it tastes like, okay?
It was cheesecake. It was fine.
It had a buttery, crumbly, graham-cracker crust...
...with a very rich...
...yet light cream-cheese filling.
Wow, my whole mouth just filled with saliva. Ahem.
Know what? Forget it. We are just hungry.
We have not had lunch. We are just lightheaded.
So let us go out and have lunch and forget about the cheesecake.
We'll drop it off downstairs so we're not tempted.
Where do you wanna go to lunch?
Mama's Little Bakery, Chicago, Illinois.
Aw.
Mel Tormé died.

sense_groups.english: Well, maybe since the age of 9, Frannie's made some new friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许这只是个误会 我打电话去问雪若阿姨
sense_groups.english: Look, it's probably just a mistake. Let me call Aunt Cheryl, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他们邀请你了 只是请帖寄丢了
sense_groups.english: Maybe you are invited and the invitation just got lost in the mail.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以打电话告诉她 我们小时候…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, you call her and tell her that, you know, when we were kids...

sense_groups.chinese: 她的宝贝芬妮好几次想脱光我的衣服
sense_groups.english: ...her precious little Frannie tried to undress me several times, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是我阻止了她 她也结不了婚
sense_groups.english: If I hadn't stopped her, there probably wouldn't be a wedding to go to.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也想脱我的衣服
sense_groups.english: She tried to undress me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前会帮葛兰表弟脱衣服
sense_groups.english: I used to undress my cousin Glenn.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔瑟夫法兰西斯崔比亚尼 你回家了吗？
sense_groups.english: Joseph Francis Tribbiani, are you home yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他还没有回家 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Um, I think he's still out. What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你 瑞秋凯伦葛林
sense_groups.english: Well, I'll tell you, Rachel Karen Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟乔伊有约 他留了这张字条给我
sense_groups.english: I had plans with Joey tonight, and he left me this note.

sense_groups.chinese: "菲比 我没办法赴约 我有约会 待会再谈
sense_groups.english: "Pheebs, can't make it. Got a date. Talk to you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 大爹地"
sense_groups.english: Big Daddy."

sense_groups.chinese: "大爹地"？ - 那是我们之间的昵称
sense_groups.english: "Big Daddy"? - Oh, that's a nickname we were trying out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道什么样的昵称 不会跟 别人重覆吗？"罗斯原子超人"
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what nickname never caught on? "The Ross-a-tron."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 乔瑟夫法兰西斯回来了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Oh, here's Joseph Francis.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你干嘛叫我的全名？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, what are you middle-naming me for?

sense_groups.chinese: 我留了字条给你
sense_groups.english: I left you a note.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是你放我鸽子的好理由
sense_groups.english: So what? That doesn't give you the right to ditch me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你有机会上床 当然可以取消跟朋友的约会
sense_groups.english: Hey, you can cancel plans with friends if there's a possibility for sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说的对 这是规则
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, he's right. That is the rule.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法接受这种事
sense_groups.english: I don't accept this rule.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们约好后 我期待你会出现
sense_groups.english: When we make plans, I expect you to show up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是你泡到马子前 打发时间的代替品
sense_groups.english: Okay, I can't just be a way to kill time till you meet someone better.

sense_groups.chinese: 男女朋友来来去去 但朋友是一辈子的
sense_groups.english: You know, boyfriends and girlfriends are gonna come and go, but this is for life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 我不知道 这对你来说那么重要
sense_groups.english: Wow. I'm so sorry. I had no idea it would bother you this much.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 它的确很重要
sense_groups.english: Well, it does.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以弥补你吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, can I make it up to you? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天晚上一起吃饭吧？我会自己付钱
sense_groups.english: How about dinner tomorrow night? I'll pay for myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说服了我
sense_groups.english: Okay, you wore me down.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你站在那边 拿罐啤酒给 "罗斯原子超人"吧？
sense_groups.english: Joe, while you're over there, how about another beer for "The Ross-a-tron"?

sense_groups.chinese: "罗斯…" 它又回来了？
sense_groups.english: "Ross..." Is that back?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 又有起司蛋糕
sense_groups.english: Hi. - The other cheesecake came.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们又把它送到这里来
sense_groups.english: They delivered it to the wrong address again.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它送到楼下去 那有什么问题？
sense_groups.english: So just bring it back downstairs. What's the problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该怎么说再见
sense_groups.english: I can't seem to say goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是认真的吗？两天前我们吃掉 一个蛋糕
sense_groups.english: Are you serious? Chandler, we ate an entire cheesecake two days ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 你还想再吃？
sense_groups.english: ...and you want more?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我已经忘记它的味道了
sense_groups.english: Well, I've forgotten what it tastes like, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 它是起司蛋糕 它很好吃
sense_groups.english: It was cheesecake. It was fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有又香又浓 酥酥的饼干…
sense_groups.english: It had a buttery, crumbly, graham-cracker crust...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有非常浓郁…
sense_groups.english: ...with a very rich...

sense_groups.chinese: 但不油腻的奶油起司
sense_groups.english: ...yet light cream-cheese filling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的嘴巴全是口水
sense_groups.english: Wow, my whole mouth just filled with saliva. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？忘了它 我们只是饿了
sense_groups.english: Know what? Forget it. We are just hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有吃午餐 所以头昏脑胀
sense_groups.english: We have not had lunch. We are just lightheaded.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去吃午餐 忘了那个起司蛋糕吧
sense_groups.english: So let us go out and have lunch and forget about the cheesecake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得把它还回去 才不会被诱惑
sense_groups.english: We'll drop it off downstairs so we're not tempted.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里吃午餐？
sense_groups.english: Where do you wanna go to lunch?

sense_groups.chinese: 芝加哥小妈妈面包店
sense_groups.english: Mama's Little Bakery, Chicago, Illinois.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 梅尔多米死了
sense_groups.english: Mel Tormé died.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 那是一年前的报纸
sense_groups.english: Joey, that paper's like a year old.

sense_groups.chinese: 那表示山姆古迪商店的大特卖结束了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, does that mean the Sam Goody's sale is over?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于收到雪若阿姨的回音…
sense_groups.english: So I finally heard back from Aunt Cheryl...

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地这不是误会
sense_groups.english: ...and apparently it wasn't a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼现场座位有限…
sense_groups.english: Uh, there's limited seating in the hall...

sense_groups.chinese: 座位有限？我是个瘦皮猴
sense_groups.english: Limited seating? I am just one tiny person.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是她不知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but she doesn't know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说上次她看到你…
sense_groups.english: I mean, the last time she saw you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会把婚礼用的小椅子给压垮
sense_groups.english: ...you would've turned one of those little wedding chairs into kindling.

sense_groups.chinese: "座位有限"那真是个烂借口
sense_groups.english: "Limited seating." That's such a lame excuse.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是她不邀请我的原因
sense_groups.english: That's not the reason why she's not inviting me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有什么大不了的呢？ 我没办法观礼 只能去吃喜酒
sense_groups.english: What's the big deal? I wasn't even invited to the ceremony, just the reception.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这能让你觉得开心一点
sense_groups.english: And you know what? If it makes you feel any better...

sense_groups.chinese: 琼安跟我只会去亮个相…
sense_groups.english: ...Joan and I will just make an appearance...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会提早离开 以示抗议
sense_groups.english: ...and then we'll leave early as a sign of protest.

sense_groups.chinese: 琼安？ - 对 她是我的女伴
sense_groups.english: Joan? - Yeah, Joan Tedeschi, my date.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是语官学系的助教
sense_groups.english: She's an assistant professor in the Linguistics Department.

sense_groups.chinese: 又高又漂亮
sense_groups.english: Tall, very beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然有些人说 别挑太魁梧的女孩
sense_groups.english: And despite what some people say, not broad-backed.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你收到的喜帖 是"请携伴参加"？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. You got "Ross Geller and guest"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有被邀请 你却可以"携伴参加"？
sense_groups.english: I wasn't invited, and you got "and guest"?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我真的得解释罗斯的行为
sense_groups.english: Uh, excuse me, I do have to interrupt on Ross' behalf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想规则也适用在这里
sense_groups.english: I think the rule applies here.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他有机会跟魁梧女人上床…
sense_groups.english: Since he has a chance to get on broad-back...

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有那么魁梧
sense_groups.english: Not broad-back!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你得带我去
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. You're bringing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能放琼安鸽子
sense_groups.english: What? I can't cancel on Joan.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 你没有听到吗？
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Did you not hear me?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是语言学系的助教
sense_groups.english: She's an assistant professor in the Linguistics Department, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 她们很辣
sense_groups.english: They're wild.

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底为什么想去？ - 因为…
sense_groups.english: Why do you want to come anyway? - Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我表妹
sense_groups.english: ...she's my cousin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是一起长大的
sense_groups.english: I mean, we grew up together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是家人 你知道吗？ 对我来说那很重要
sense_groups.english: Family, you know? And all that's important to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我带你去
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right. I'll take you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去打电话给琼安
sense_groups.english: I'll go call Joan.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 家人应该要出席的
sense_groups.english: Family should be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是她的婚礼 她一生中最快乐的日子
sense_groups.english: This is her wedding. Happiest day of her life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们等着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: We'll see. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你请我吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Well, thank you for lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我以为你付了钱
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute, I didn't pay. I thought you paid.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显的 我们不用再掏钱买食物了
sense_groups.english: So apparently, we just don't pay for food anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有看错吧？ - 它还在那里
sense_groups.english: Do you see what I see? - Huh! It's still there.

sense_groups.chinese: 布雷曼太太一定是出去了
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Braverman must be out.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能出城去了 或许几个月后才会回来
sense_groups.english: She could be out of town. Maybe she'll be gone for months.

sense_groups.chinese: 到时候蛋糕一定坏了
sense_groups.english: By then, the cheesecake may have gone bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 不能让她回来时看到坏掉的起司蛋糕
sense_groups.english: We don't want her to come back to bad cheesecake.

sense_groups.chinese: 她可能会中毒死掉 - 我不希望发生那种事
sense_groups.english: That could kill her. - Wouldn't want that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是在保护她
sense_groups.english: No, we're protecting her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把它拿走 - 但是快一点
sense_groups.english: We should take it. - But move quick.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我听到她在里面走动的声音
sense_groups.english: Why? - I heard her moving around in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 快走…
sense_groups.english: Go, go, go.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是大卫
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, that's David.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 那个科学家大卫
sense_groups.english: Who? - David, the scientist guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱上的那个大卫
sense_groups.english: David that I was in love with.

sense_groups.chinese: 他到俄国去 伤了我的心 大卫
sense_groups.english: David who went to Russia and broke my heart, David.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要一直念某人的名字 那个人就会转过身来
sense_groups.english: Oh, you say someone's name enough, they turn around.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 大卫
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - David.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？你不是在俄国吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? Aren't you supposed to be in Russia?

sense_groups.chinese: 我到城里来开会
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm just in town for a conference.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你看起来美得出奇
sense_groups.english: Um, God, you look phenomenal.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Well, ha, ha...

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来也很棒 你剪了头发吗？
sense_groups.english: You look great too. Did you get a haircut?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我大概剪了三十次
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Well, I got like 30 of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我得跟你坦诚一件事 - 额
sense_groups.english: Um, look, I got a confession to make. - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望能在这里遇到你
sense_groups.english: Um, I was hoping to run into you here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该不该打电话给你 我只会在城里待几天…
sense_groups.english: I didn't know that I should call or not. You know, I was only in town a few days...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想打扰你的生活
sense_groups.english: ...and, you know, I didn't want to intrude on your life or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的想见你…
sense_groups.english: But I really wanted to see you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不知道你要不要见我
sense_groups.english: ...but I didn't know if you wanted to see me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然想见你 我常常想到你
sense_groups.english: Of course I would want to see you. I think about you all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？因为我也常常想到你
sense_groups.english: Really? Because I think about you all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 明斯克有一座雕像
sense_groups.english: Really? - There's a statue in Minsk...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我常常想起你
sense_groups.english: ...that reminds me of you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上那是列宁的雕像…
sense_groups.english: I mean, um, it's actually of Lenin...

sense_groups.chinese: 但有些角度…
sense_groups.english: ...but, you know, at certain angles... PHOEBE: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 今晚你想跟我共进晚餐吗？
sense_groups.english: Anyway, do you want to have dinner tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我不能
sense_groups.english: Uh, what? - I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 我有约了 明天可以吗？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I have plans. I can't. Can you do it tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 再过几小时我就得离开 我得赶回去
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, I have to go in a few hours. I have to be on the redeye.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 下次你到明斯克…
sense_groups.english: Well, listen, you know, next time you're in Minsk, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我能跟你谈一谈吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? Can I talk to you for a second? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟乔伊有约 - 所以呢？他会谅解的
sense_groups.english: Well, I have plans with Joey tonight. - So? He'll understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他不会的 那根本不是重点
sense_groups.english: No, he won't. And that's not even the point.

sense_groups.chinese: 我教训他不该见色忘友
sense_groups.english: Monica, I made a whole speech about how you do not cancel plans with friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在只因为可能是我真爱的人…
sense_groups.english: And now, you know, what? Just because, potentially, the love of my life...

sense_groups.chinese: 明天就要回俄国去… 我就应该改变我的想法？
sense_groups.english: ...comes back from Russia just for one night, I should change my beliefs?

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该改变我的想法
sense_groups.english: I should change my beliefs.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 如果失去了原则 那么我什么都不会有
sense_groups.english: No. No, no. If I don't have my principles, I don't have anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太有说服力了
sense_groups.english: God, you are so strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以赶快跟乔伊吃完晚餐 然后九点跟大卫见面
sense_groups.english: Or I should rush through dinner with Joey and I could meet David at 9.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, that is so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃饱了 但我知道 如果我现在停下来…
sense_groups.english: I'm full. And yet I know if I stop eating this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会后悔
sense_groups.english: ...I'll regret it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在吃什么？ 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, what have you got there?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是… 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 豆腐蛋糕 你要吃一点吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: It's tofu cake. Do you want some? - Aah.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚你要做什么？ - 哈？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing tonight? - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Uh. - Dude. Dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我跟菲比有约
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Uh, I got those plans with Phoebe. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？摩妮卡说她九点有约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? Uh, Monica said she had a date at 9.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？今晚？ - 摩妮卡是那么说的
sense_groups.english: What? Tonight? - That's what Monica said.

sense_groups.chinese: 她教训了我一顿
sense_groups.english: After she gave me that big speech...

sense_groups.chinese: 却同时约了我跟她的男伴？
sense_groups.english: ...she goes and makes a date on the same night she has plans with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 她想草草解决大爹地
sense_groups.english: I think she's trying to pull a fast one on Big Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们的位置应该是这一桌
sense_groups.english: Here, I think this is us. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 座位有限个屁
sense_groups.english: Limited seating, my ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来看看谁被邀请了
sense_groups.english: Let's just see who made the cut.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是摩妮卡盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi. I'm Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们跟新人是什么关系？ - 我是芬妮以前的同事
sense_groups.english: How do you know the bride and groom? - I worked with Frannie.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前的同事 以前
sense_groups.english: Used to work with her. Used to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是她的亲戚却没有被邀请
sense_groups.english: I'm a relative and I didn't get invited, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是她的血亲 血
sense_groups.english: A blood relative. Blood.

sense_groups.chinese: 别在陌生人面前提到"血"
sense_groups.english: Stop saying "blood" to strangers.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢？你跟快乐的新人是什么关系？
sense_groups.english: So how about you? How do you know the happy couple?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是他们的大学同学 现在是他们的邻居
sense_groups.english: We went to college with both of them. And now we live next door.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你还够格
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要点菜了吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Hey. Are you guys ready? - Hey. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要沙拉 特调酱汁 给我水就好了
sense_groups.english: I will have a green salad, um, house dressing and water's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 你呢？先生
sense_groups.english: Okay. - And for you, sir?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 慢烤鲑鱼…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. This slow-roasted salmon...

sense_groups.chinese: 那到底有多慢呢？
sense_groups.english: ...just how slow are we talking?

sense_groups.chinese: 它已经烤好了
sense_groups.english: It's already been roasted.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我不要 麻烦你 再告诉我一次今日特色
sense_groups.english: Oh, then no. Maybe I should hear those specials again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经听了三次
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey, we've heard the specials three times, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 有烤肋排 鬼头刀鱼跟特制龙虾饺子
sense_groups.english: There's prime rib, mahi-mahi and a very special lobster ravioli.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我们没有饺子了 - 那我们得重来一次
sense_groups.english: Actually, we're out of the lobster ravioli. - Oh, well, that changes everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？ - 额
sense_groups.english: You know what, Pheebs? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 之前你说的话是对的 朋友太重要了
sense_groups.english: You were right before. Friends are so important.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我很聪明 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm very wise. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我想做什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what I really want?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我想花时间跟你长谈
sense_groups.english: What? - Is to have a long, long talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？告诉我多一点人生道理
sense_groups.english: You know? Get Joey out on the open road and really open him up.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以点菜了吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Any progress? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要点龙虾饺子
sense_groups.english: I will have the lobster ravioli.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 乔伊 这得花一辈子的时间
sense_groups.english: God, Joey, this is taking forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛这么急呢？ - 喔…
sense_groups.english: What's the rush? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个约会
sense_groups.english: ...I just have, you know, an appointment.

sense_groups.chinese: 它非常重要
sense_groups.english: And it's very important.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么说？
sense_groups.english: What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我约了一个男人
sense_groups.english: ...it's a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 你约了男人？不 你一定弄错了
sense_groups.english: A date? No, no, Pheebs, you must be mistaken...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你不能跟男人约会…
sense_groups.english: ...because you wouldn't schedule a date...

sense_groups.chinese: 同时又跟朋友约吃饭
sense_groups.english: ...on the night you have plans with a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让我觉得内疚
sense_groups.english: Come on. Don't make me feel badly about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我就是要那么做
sense_groups.english: No, I'm gonna.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟那个女孩出去
sense_groups.english: That's right. Yeah, you made me feel really guilty...

sense_groups.chinese: 你让我觉得非常内疚
sense_groups.english: ...about going out with that girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 好像我做了什么可怕的事 现在你也那么做
sense_groups.english: Like I did something terrible to you. Now, Pheebs, you're doing the same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪 这完全不一样
sense_groups.english: That's not the same thing. This is totally different.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟大卫有约 你还记得科学家大卫吗？
sense_groups.english: This is with David. Remember David, the scientist guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说他非常特别
sense_groups.english: Okay, he's very special to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那晚我约的女孩也很特别
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, my girl from the other night was special.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也是个科学家
sense_groups.english: She was a scientist too.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 她高中毕业
sense_groups.english: She was? - Well, she graduated high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便啦 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, whatever. Know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没时间跟你讲道理
sense_groups.english: I don't have time to convince you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只会在这里待四小时 我得去见他
sense_groups.english: He's only here for four hours and I'm gonna go see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 对
sense_groups.english: Fine. Fine! - Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在这里做什么？ 我说过了 龙虾饺子
sense_groups.english: What are you still doing here? I told you, lobster ravioli.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正要离开 我以为你不会来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I was just about to leave. I didn't think you were coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我绝不会错过这次约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wouldn't have missed this. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你来了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm very glad you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个绅士
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're such a gentleman.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 到我家去
sense_groups.english: Come on, we're going to my place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想一个人独吞起司蛋糕？
sense_groups.english: Are you eating the cheesecake without me?

sense_groups.chinese: 恩
sense_groups.english: Mm-mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你现在能吹出口哨 我就给你一百块
sense_groups.english: I will give you $100 to whistle right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可以不管我一个人独吞？
sense_groups.english: How can you eat the cheesecake without me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会怎么做呢？
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉摩妮卡或乔伊？ 不 你得把一切都告诉他们
sense_groups.english: Gonna run and tell Monica or Joey? No, you'd have to tell them what we did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是甜点小偷 我们犯了法
sense_groups.english: We are dessert stealers. We are living outside the law.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能让你跟蛋糕独处
sense_groups.english: You know what? I don't trust you with this cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先发现它的 我要把它拿回来 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: And I got it first, and I'm taking it back. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不 - 对
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, no, you don't. - Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我就能相信你吗？
sense_groups.english: You think I trust you with it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们平分它
sense_groups.english: We're gonna split it. You take half, I take half.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不公平 你已经吃掉一点了
sense_groups.english: That's not fair. You had some.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想摩妮卡一定想知道…
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? I think Monica would be very interested to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你说她做的起司蛋糕"又干又粗"
sense_groups.english: ...that you called her cheesecake dry and mealy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要用什么来切蛋糕？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: What do we use to split it? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 中间一块 - 好的
sense_groups.english: All right, pick a half. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这块比较大 - 恩
sense_groups.english: Well, this side looks bigger. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这块饼干比较多
sense_groups.english: Uh, but there's more crust on this side.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该量一下…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. So maybe if I measure it...

sense_groups.chinese: 快挑一块
sense_groups.english: For God's sake, pick a piece.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我挑那一块 - 那一块比较小
sense_groups.english: All right, I pick that one. - So the smaller piece.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好享受你的蛋糕吧 我的朋友 因为大势已定
sense_groups.english: Enjoy your half, my friend. But that is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会跟你分 或跟你换 别哭着跑来找我…
sense_groups.english: No sharing, no switching, and don't come crying to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你一下子就把蛋糕吃完了
sense_groups.english: ...if you eat your piece too fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你要给我一点蛋糕吗？ - 不
sense_groups.english: You gonna give me some of your piece? - Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会跟你分 或跟你换 别哭着跑来找我
sense_groups.english: No switching, no sharing. And don't come crying to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要坐在这里 花一整天好好享用我的蛋糕
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. I may just sit here and have my cake all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要坐在走廊上吃我的…
sense_groups.english: Just sit here in the hallway and eat my...

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没遇到过一个女孩…
sense_groups.english: Never met a girl that could me feel...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 甜心
sense_groups.english: Ross, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 米莉阿姨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Aunt Millie.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个婚礼很温馨吧？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Isn't it a beautiful wedding? - Yes. Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 她每次都亲嘴巴
sense_groups.english: Every time, on the lips.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？为什么要亲嘴巴？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why on the lips?

sense_groups.chinese: 芬妮在那边 她看到我 一定会很高兴吧？
sense_groups.english: There's Frannie. Won't she be happy to see me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得乖乖的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Now, wait a minute. You be nice, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是带你来欺负她
sense_groups.english: I didn't bring you here so you could ambush her.

sense_groups.chinese: 芬妮把你的《花花公子》拿给妈妈看
sense_groups.english: Frannie was the one who found your Playboys and showed them to Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个死小孩
sense_groups.english: That bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 什么…？
sense_groups.english: Monica. What...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里做什么？ 你看到我很讶异吗？
sense_groups.english: Am I doing here? Surprised to see me?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯带我来的 你还喜欢吗？
sense_groups.english: Ross brought me. How do you like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 芬妮 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Hi, Frannie. Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 你邀请我的家人 却不邀请我 为什么？
sense_groups.english: You invite my brother, you invite my whole family, and not me? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不希望我来？
sense_groups.english: Why wouldn't you want me at your wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了什么？
sense_groups.english: What could I have possibly done?

sense_groups.chinese: 史都华
sense_groups.english: Stuart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信你认识我丈夫
sense_groups.english: I believe you know my husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 问题应该是 你把"谁"上了
sense_groups.english: So it's really a question of "who" could you have possibly done.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌这样 但我得走了 - 恩
sense_groups.english: I hate this, but I have to go. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能错过飞机
sense_groups.english: I can't miss my flight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说下一班飞往 明斯克的飞机是在…
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? I bet there's another flight to Minsk in...

sense_groups.chinese: 七月
sense_groups.english: July.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的好窝心 它是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: That's really beautiful. What does it mean?

sense_groups.chinese: "请帮我把杯子洗干净"
sense_groups.english: "Please clean my beakers."

sense_groups.chinese: 我不常离开实验室
sense_groups.english: I don't get out of the lab much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为它有别的意思
sense_groups.english: I thought it meant something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 事实上 我想说…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I really actually wanted to say, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 那个
sense_groups.english: ...that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想或许我不该说 因为…
sense_groups.english: But, um, I figured I probably shouldn't because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得离开
sense_groups.english: ...you know, I have to leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你说的对 别说
sense_groups.english: Hmm. No, you're right. Don't say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的那么想
sense_groups.english: I do, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: I do too.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 菲比
sense_groups.english: Well, bye, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在不是时候 乔伊 明天你可以骂我
sense_groups.english: Okay, now's not the time, Joey, all right? You can yell at me tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 不 菲比 我不会骂你
sense_groups.english: No, no. No, Pheebs. I'm not gonna yell at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是开始想到你跟大卫…
sense_groups.english: I just started thinking about you and David...

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得他第一次离开时你有多难过
sense_groups.english: ...and I remember how bummed you were the first time he left.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 过来
sense_groups.english: Oh, Pheebs, come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧？ - 不 我一点都不好
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - No, I'm not okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我唯一喜欢的男人要去明斯克…
sense_groups.english: The only guy I've ever been crazy about is going to Minsk...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我永远都不会再见到他
sense_groups.english: ...and I may never see him again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以去看他
sense_groups.english: Hey, you could always visit him.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你以为他们会给我护照
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Like they're gonna let me have a passport.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么我可以帮忙的吗？什么都行
sense_groups.english: Anything I can do? Whatever you need.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Well, now...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你可以比他先 蒸馏出副原子粒子…
sense_groups.english: ...if you achieve positronic distillation of subatomic particles before he does...

sense_groups.chinese: 他就可以回来了
sense_groups.english: ...then he could come back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以试试看
sense_groups.english: I could give it a shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 有一小块没有沾到地板
sense_groups.english: Oh, look. There's a piece that doesn't have floor on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别越界 - 快点
sense_groups.english: Stick to your side. - Come on, now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们要吃什么？
sense_groups.english: All right, what are we having?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我忘了拿披肩
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, I forgot my wrap.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你在这里等我
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, wait here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 甜心 你要走了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, sweetie. Are you leaving?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔… - 亲阿姨一下 快点
sense_groups.english: Well... - Give us a kiss. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？为什么要亲嘴巴？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why on the lips?

questions.name: S07E12
questions.en:
Ross, when's this comet thing start?
Well, technically, it started 7 billion years ago.
No, no. - Oh, God.
Okay. Fine, I'll stop. No teaching, okay?
We'll just watch the pretty light streaking across the sky.
Okay? - Okay.
Whose official name is Bapstein-King. Okay! Okay!
There it is. Oh, look at that!
Isn't Mother Nature amazing?
That's a plane.
Well, all right, 1700 bags of peanuts flying that high...
...that's pretty amazing too.
I wonder if you can see my apartment. - No, you can't.
What? - I don't know.
Man, look at all those stars.
Infinite space. It really makes you wonder, doesn't it?
Know what else makes you wonder? - Huh?
Check out the rack on that chick.
We've been out here for two hours...
...and we haven't seen any stupid comets. Can we go now?
I mean, Chandler's getting chilly.
No, I'm not.
Then why are you wearing Monica's jacket?
Because it's flattering!
Come on, Monica. Come on, Monica.
We're taking off too. We rented a movie. - Oh, I won't say no to a movie.
Oh, Pheebs, we just actually wanted to be alone.
Shh. Get me out of here. - Oh, okay.
Hey, Ross. - What?
Check this out. - Is it the comet?
No. Look, there's a bug stuck in tar right here.
I can't believe...
I bring you to see the Bapstein-King comet...
...one of nature's most spectacular phenomena...
...and all you care about are bugs stuck in tar and some woman.
You know, there's two women, dude.
Show me where.
Right... Right up here.
Joey, where's the pipe that was holding the door open?
I don't know.
Yeah, I do.
Joey! - What? Hey, don't look at me!
You wanted to come up here and look for some stupid Burger King comet.
It's called the Bapstein-King comet, okay?
Hey, Bapstein was a very well-respected astronomer from...
No! No!
No!
Monica. - She's sleeping.
I know. Just a quick question.
Which one was Deep Impact and which one was Armageddon?
Deep Impact was the one with Robert Duvall.
Armageddon is what's going to happen to you if you wake me up.
Sorry, I just can't sleep.
Ooh!
Where's that book you're reading with two women who are ice-skating...
...and wearing those hats with the flowers on it.
Because every time I look at that cover, I'm like
It's in the living room, where there's also a light...
...and no one will kick you in the shin.
What?
Ow!
Please don't be a spaceship. Please don't be a spaceship.
Oh, thank God.
Hm.
How could you be beeping? I just disconnected you!
I took out your battery! How can...?
Don't interrupt me!
Monica! Monica!
Come on!
I can't believe this!
All right, well, I guess we know what we have to do to get down.
Yeah, I guess we don't have a choice.
Help us! Please, help us!
We're stuck up on the roof, and we can't get down!
Ross.
I was thinking we'd just go down the fire escape.
I know. I wasn't finished.
But don't worry!
We're gonna go down the fire escape!
Shh-shh-shh!
I'm sorry, I thought I'd make some warm milk and it would help me sleep.
With a wok?
I thought my boring book was gonna put you to sleep.
It got interesting.
Damn you, Oprah!
Here, let me make the milk. I'm up anyway.
You know what we could do now that we're up?
We could just talk to each other all night long.
Like when we were first going out. It'd be fun.
Okay, that does sound fun. - Yeah.
So how bummed were you when the second sister died, huh?
The second sister dies?!
No.
No, I was talking about the book I was reading.
The second sister dies in Archie and Jughead Double Digest?
That's correct.
Want to go in the bedroom? It's more comfortable.
Sure. - Okay.
Oh, wait, did you send those contracts to Milan?
If this is your idea of sexy talk... - No.
Seriously. Did you overnight the contracts I gave you?
What contracts?
Please tell me this is just one of your jokes that I don't get. Heh, heh.
Like what?
Like the thing when you put the phone in your pants?
Tag, I'm serious. This isn't funny.
Those contracts had to go out today.
You didn't give me any contracts.
Yes, I did. I put a little Post-it on it that said
"Must go out today," and I underlined "today" three times.
Then I put a little heart in the corner because I didn't wanna seem too bossy.
You never gave them to me.
If we went to the office, you would see those contracts sitting on your desk.
No, I'd see you looking embarrassed because they are not on my desk.
Maybe I'm embarrassed because you talk on the phone with your crotch.
You want to go to the office now? - No.
Come on, it's late. We're not going down to the office.
Yeah, I understand. I wouldn't want to be proved wrong either.
All right, get your coat!
Oh! When did you unhook this? Nice work!
It won't go down any further. It's stuck.
We'll just have to jump.
Yep. Now, we're gonna have to make sure to land...
...to the right of that patch of ice, okay?
Not hit the dumpster on the other side.
And try to avoid that weird brownish-red stuff in the middle.
So when you get down there...
...you go up to the roof and you let me in.
Whoa. Wait a minute. I have to do it? - Yeah. You'll be fine.
It'll be just like bungee jumping, you know?
But instead of bouncing back up, you won't.
Well, what if I smack my head on the concrete?
Well, I'm not gonna lie to you, Joey. It's a possibility.
I don't know. Tell you what, let's flip to see who does it.
You call it in the air, all right? - Oh, all right. Tail. Oh!
Can you see what it is? - No.
Okay. Well, you be careful. - No. No, Ross, stop.
I'm not jumping.
Look, I have an audition tomorrow, and I can't go if I break my leg.
Well, I'm not jumping. I have a son. He won't have a father if I die.
So it looks like we're even.
Okay, so this wire...
...is connected to this wire, which plugs into here.
Okay, so to get the beeping to stop, all I have to do...
Okay.
Well done, Pheebs.
What do you want from me?!
Here's your milk. What should we talk about?
What? What? What?
Oh, were you sleeping, sweetie? I'm sorry. Here.
Okay. Feel free to look...
...but I'm telling you those contracts are not on this desk.
