sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这个彗星的事 到底什么时候开始？
sense_groups.english: Ross, when's this comet thing start?

sense_groups.chinese: 理论上来说 七百万年前
sense_groups.english: Well, technically, it started 7 billion years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 - 噢 天啊
sense_groups.english: No, no. - Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我不讲课 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Fine, I'll stop. No teaching, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只欣赏美丽的流光划过天空
sense_groups.english: We'll just watch the pretty light streaking across the sky.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 它的正式名字 是巴布斯坦王 好 好
sense_groups.english: Whose official name is Bapstein-King. Okay! Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 在那里 你看
sense_groups.english: There it is. Oh, look at that!

sense_groups.chinese: 大自然真是神奇
sense_groups.english: Isn't Mother Nature amazing?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一台飞机
sense_groups.english: That's a plane.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 1700袋的花生 飞在那么高的地方…
sense_groups.english: Well, all right, 1700 bags of peanuts flying that high...

sense_groups.chinese: 也是很神奇
sense_groups.english: ...that's pretty amazing too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想能不能看到我家 - 不能 看不到
sense_groups.english: I wonder if you can see my apartment. - No, you can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这些星星
sense_groups.english: Man, look at all those stars.

sense_groups.chinese: 无涯的天空 让你有无尽遐思 对吗？
sense_groups.english: Infinite space. It really makes you wonder, doesn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道还有什么让你有无尽遐想？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Know what else makes you wonder? - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看那个妞的胸部
sense_groups.english: Check out the rack on that chick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经在外面两个小时了…
sense_groups.english: We've been out here for two hours...

sense_groups.chinese: 还没看到笨彗星 我们可以走了吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and we haven't seen any stupid comets. Can we go now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 钱德冷死了
sense_groups.english: I mean, Chandler's getting chilly.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么穿着摩妮卡的夹克？
sense_groups.english: Then why are you wearing Monica's jacket?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为好看
sense_groups.english: Because it's flattering!

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 摩妮卡 走吧 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Come on, Monica. Come on, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也要走了 租了电影看 - 我从不错过看电影
sense_groups.english: We're taking off too. We rented a movie. - Oh, I won't say no to a movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 其实我们想独处
sense_groups.english: Oh, Pheebs, we just actually wanted to be alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 带我一起走 - 哦 好
sense_groups.english: Shh. Get me out of here. - Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看 - 那是彗星吗？
sense_groups.english: Check this out. - Is it the comet?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是只被焦油黏住的虫
sense_groups.english: No. Look, there's a bug stuck in tar right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能相信…
sense_groups.english: I can't believe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我带你来看巴布斯坦王彗星…
sense_groups.english: I bring you to see the Bapstein-King comet...

sense_groups.chinese: 大自然最壮观的现象之一…
sense_groups.english: ...one of nature's most spectacular phenomena...

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只关心被焦油黏住的虫 和一个女人
sense_groups.english: ...and all you care about are bugs stuck in tar and some woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 有两个女人 老兄
sense_groups.english: You know, there's two women, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 在哪里
sense_groups.english: Show me where.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 在那里
sense_groups.english: Right... Right up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我们拿来顶住门的管子呢？
sense_groups.english: Joey, where's the pipe that was holding the door open?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 怎样？嘿 别看着我
sense_groups.english: Joey! - What? Hey, don't look at me!

sense_groups.chinese: 是你要上来看什么笨汉堡王彗星的
sense_groups.english: You wanted to come up here and look for some stupid Burger King comet.

sense_groups.chinese: 它叫做巴布斯坦王彗星 好吗？
sense_groups.english: It's called the Bapstein-King comet, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 巴布斯坦是一位 很受尊敬的太空人 由…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bapstein was a very well-respected astronomer from...

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 她在睡觉
sense_groups.english: Monica. - She's sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 很快问一个问题
sense_groups.english: I know. Just a quick question.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一部是《彗星撞地球》 哪一部是《世界末日》？
sense_groups.english: Which one was Deep Impact and which one was Armageddon?

sense_groups.chinese: 《彗星撞地球》是有劳勃杜瓦那部
sense_groups.english: Deep Impact was the one with Robert Duvall.

sense_groups.chinese: 《世界末日》是如果你叫醒我 会发生在你身上的
sense_groups.english: Armageddon is what's going to happen to you if you wake me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我睡不着
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I just can't sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ooh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看的那本书在哪儿？ 有两个女人在溜冰…
sense_groups.english: Where's that book you're reading with two women who are ice-skating...

sense_groups.chinese: 戴着有花的帽子的
sense_groups.english: ...and wearing those hats with the flowers on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次我一看到它的封面 我就…
sense_groups.english: Because every time I look at that cover, I'm like

sense_groups.chinese: 在客厅 那里有灯…
sense_groups.english: It's in the living room, where there's also a light...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且没有人会踢你小腿
sense_groups.english: ...and no one will kick you in the shin.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托不要是太空船 拜托不要是太空船
sense_groups.english: Please don't be a spaceship. Please don't be a spaceship.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢上帝
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可能还在哔？我把你断电了
sense_groups.english: How could you be beeping? I just disconnected you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我拿掉了你的电池 怎么还能…？不要打断我说话
sense_groups.english: I took out your battery! How can...?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要打断我
sense_groups.english: Don't interrupt me!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica! Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 真受不了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想我们知道 要怎么做才能下去
sense_groups.english: All right, well, I guess we know what we have to do to get down.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我想我们没有选择
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess we don't have a choice.

sense_groups.chinese: 救命 救救我们
sense_groups.english: Help us! Please, help us!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们被困在屋顶 下不去
sense_groups.english: We're stuck up on the roof, and we can't get down!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是在想用逃生梯下去
sense_groups.english: I was thinking we'd just go down the fire escape.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我还没说完
sense_groups.english: I know. I wasn't finished.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是不用担心
sense_groups.english: But don't worry!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会用逃生梯下去
sense_groups.english: We're gonna go down the fire escape!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘘嘘…
sense_groups.english: Shh-shh-shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我想热点牛奶来帮助睡眠
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I thought I'd make some warm milk and it would help me sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 用炒菜锅？
sense_groups.english: With a wok?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你要看我的书来帮助睡觉？
sense_groups.english: I thought my boring book was gonna put you to sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 它后来变得很有意思
sense_groups.english: It got interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶的欧普拉
sense_groups.english: Damn you, Oprah!

sense_groups.chinese: 这儿 我来替你热牛奶 反正我已经起来了
sense_groups.english: Here, let me make the milk. I'm up anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我们已经起来了 你知道可以做什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what we could do now that we're up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以促膝长谈
sense_groups.english: We could just talk to each other all night long.

sense_groups.chinese: 像我们刚开始约会时那样 会很好玩的
sense_groups.english: Like when we were first going out. It'd be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听来是很有意思 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, that does sound fun. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二个妹妹死的时候 你是不是很生气？
sense_groups.english: So how bummed were you when the second sister died, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 第二个妹妹死了？
sense_groups.english: The second sister dies?!

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我是在说我在看的那本书
sense_groups.english: No, I was talking about the book I was reading.

sense_groups.chinese: 《阿契漫画合集》里第二个妹妹死了？
sense_groups.english: The second sister dies in Archie and Jughead Double Digest?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: That's correct.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要进卧房去？比较舒服一点
sense_groups.english: Want to go in the bedroom? It's more comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你有没有把合约寄去米兰？
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, did you send those contracts to Milan?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得这是性感的谈话… - 不
sense_groups.english: If this is your idea of sexy talk... - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有寄出我拿给你的合约？
sense_groups.english: Seriously. Did you overnight the contracts I gave you?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么合约？
sense_groups.english: What contracts?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 告诉我这是 你另一个我搞不懂的笑话
sense_groups.english: Please tell me this is just one of your jokes that I don't get. Heh, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 像什么？
sense_groups.english: Like what?

sense_groups.chinese: 像是你把电话放在裤档？
sense_groups.english: Like the thing when you put the phone in your pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 泰格 我很认真 这不好笑
sense_groups.english: Tag, I'm serious. This isn't funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 那些合约今天一定要寄出去
sense_groups.english: Those contracts had to go out today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没给我什么合约
sense_groups.english: You didn't give me any contracts.

sense_groups.chinese: 有 我有 我还贴了 一张随手贴 写着
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did. I put a little Post-it on it that said

sense_groups.chinese: "今天一定要寄出" 在"今天"下面划了三道
sense_groups.english: "Must go out today," and I underlined "today" three times.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我还在角落画了一颗心 因为我不想太像上司
sense_groups.english: Then I put a little heart in the corner because I didn't wanna seem too bossy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有给我
sense_groups.english: You never gave them to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们到办公室去 你会看到它在你的办公桌上
sense_groups.english: If we went to the office, you would see those contracts sitting on your desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我会看到你很窘 因为它不在我的办公桌上
sense_groups.english: No, I'd see you looking embarrassed because they are not on my desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我很窘 是因为你用裤档接电话
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'm embarrassed because you talk on the phone with your crotch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要现在去办公室？ - 不
sense_groups.english: You want to go to the office now? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 很晚了 我们不要到办公室去
sense_groups.english: Come on, it's late. We're not going down to the office.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 我了解 我也不会想 被证明是错的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I understand. I wouldn't want to be proved wrong either.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 拿外套
sense_groups.english: All right, get your coat!

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候解开的？好厉害
sense_groups.english: Oh! When did you unhook this? Nice work!

sense_groups.chinese: 不能再下去了 卡住了
sense_groups.english: It won't go down any further. It's stuck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只有跳下去
sense_groups.english: We'll just have to jump.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一定要确定着陆在…
sense_groups.english: Yep. Now, we're gonna have to make sure to land...

sense_groups.chinese: 那块冰的右边 好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...to the right of that patch of ice, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要撞到旁边的垃圾桶
sense_groups.english: Not hit the dumpster on the other side.

sense_groups.chinese: 试着避开中间那棕红色的奇怪东西
sense_groups.english: And try to avoid that weird brownish-red stuff in the middle.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你下到下面以后…
sense_groups.english: So when you get down there...

sense_groups.chinese: 你到屋顶让我进去
sense_groups.english: ...you go up to the roof and you let me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 要我去？ - 你会没事的
sense_groups.english: Whoa. Wait a minute. I have to do it? - Yeah. You'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像高空弹跳
sense_groups.english: It'll be just like bungee jumping, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不会回弹
sense_groups.english: But instead of bouncing back up, you won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我的头撞到水泥呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what if I smack my head on the concrete?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我不想骗你 是有这个可能的
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not gonna lie to you, Joey. It's a possibility.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 这样吧 掷铜板决定谁去
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Tell you what, let's flip to see who does it.

sense_groups.chinese: 在空中时说出你要的那一面 好吧？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: You call it in the air, all right? - Oh, all right. Tail. Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看得到是哪一面吗？ - 不行
sense_groups.english: Can you see what it is? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你小心一点 - 罗斯 不要这样
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, you be careful. - No. No, Ross, stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不跳
sense_groups.english: I'm not jumping.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我要试镜 如果摔断腿就不能去了
sense_groups.english: Look, I have an audition tomorrow, and I can't go if I break my leg.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不跳 我有一个儿子 要是我死了他就没爸爸了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not jumping. I have a son. He won't have a father if I die.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我们平手
sense_groups.english: So it looks like we're even.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这条线…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so this wire...

sense_groups.chinese: 接到这条线 插到这儿
sense_groups.english: ...is connected to this wire, which plugs into here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 让哔声停止 我只要…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so to get the beeping to stop, all I have to do...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 做得好 菲比
sense_groups.english: Well done, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怎样？
sense_groups.english: What do you want from me?!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的牛奶来了 你想谈什么？
sense_groups.english: Here's your milk. What should we talk about?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？什么？什么？
sense_groups.english: What? What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你在睡觉吗？抱歉 给你
sense_groups.english: Oh, were you sleeping, sweetie? I'm sorry. Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你爱怎么找都行…
sense_groups.english: Okay. Feel free to look...

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我告诉你 那些合约没在这张桌上
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm telling you those contracts are not on this desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么可能知道？ 你看看有多乱 泰格
sense_groups.english: How could you know? Look at this mess, Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我说的 你一定要有组织一点
sense_groups.english: This is what I'm talking about. You have to be more organized.

sense_groups.chinese: 有报纸 有杂志 你…喔
sense_groups.english: You've got newspapers, you've got magazines, you... Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 这小妞是谁？
sense_groups.english: And who's this chippy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对你来说太幼稚一点 随便啦
sense_groups.english: A little young for you, but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我妹
sense_groups.english: That's my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？牙套好可爱
sense_groups.english: Really? Very cute braces.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？重点是 泰格 开始找吧…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, you know what? The point is, Tag, start looking...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会在你桌上找到那些合约
sense_groups.english: ...because you're gonna find those contracts on your desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想像是什么时候给我的？ 早上还是下午？
sense_groups.english: So when do you imagine you gave them to me? Morning or afternoon?

sense_groups.chinese: 下午 塞纳先生午餐后 进来我办公室…
sense_groups.english: In the afternoon. Mr. Zelner came into my office after lunch...

sense_groups.chinese: 他把它放在我桌上 我贴了一张随手贴在上面…
sense_groups.english: ...he put them on my desk, and then I put a Post-it on it...

sense_groups.chinese: 写着
sense_groups.english: ...that said

sense_groups.chinese: "今天一定要寄出"
sense_groups.english: "Must go out today."

sense_groups.chinese: 请你继续找 好吗？
sense_groups.english: So you just keep looking in there, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不在这里
sense_groups.english: Not here.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇怪
sense_groups.english: Puzzler.

sense_groups.chinese: 真奇怪
sense_groups.english: Bit of a puzzle.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去影印室找一找 也许你放在那里
sense_groups.english: Why don't you check the copy room? Maybe the contracts are in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么可能放在那里？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: How could I have left them in the copy room? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的私处怎么可能打电话？
sense_groups.english: How can your genitals make phone calls?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？这不是个完美的世界 请你去找一找
sense_groups.english: Okay? It's not a perfect world. Just go, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不懂
sense_groups.english: I still don't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还醒着吗？
sense_groups.english: You still awake?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你呢？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道说话的是我吧？
sense_groups.english: You do know that was me that just said that, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我们都醒着…
sense_groups.english: As long as we're both up...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你不是想要打扫客厅
sense_groups.english: I hope you're not thinking about cleaning the living room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我饿死了 晚饭时我在想什么啊？
sense_groups.english: Man, I'm starving. What the hell was I thinking at dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: "你要汤还是沙拉？" 两样都要 永远都两样都要
sense_groups.english: "Do you want soup or salad?" Both, always order both.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看了半天 我想没人在家
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm looking, and I don't think anyone's home here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我们打破窗户…
sense_groups.english: I say we just break the window...

sense_groups.chinese: 爬进去…
sense_groups.english: ...crawl through...

sense_groups.chinese: 之后再解释
sense_groups.english: ...and you know, explain later.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人在家？ - 我想没有
sense_groups.english: No one's home? - I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你进去之后…
sense_groups.english: So when you get in there...

sense_groups.chinese: 你我该在这里分手了
sense_groups.english: Okay. This is where you and I part ways.

sense_groups.chinese: 吵死人的贱货
sense_groups.english: Noisy bitch!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道刚刚发生什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know what just happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我们做爱 然后睡着了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. We had sex and then we fell asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们做了一半…
sense_groups.english: No. We were in the middle of sex...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你睡着了
sense_groups.english: ...and you fell asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 没有这回事
sense_groups.english: No. No, that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是最棒的一次
sense_groups.english: No, best time ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你震撼了我的世界
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You rock my world.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡？ - 怎么？
sense_groups.english: Monica? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我表现最好的时候 你错过了
sense_groups.english: I was giving you some of my best moves, and you missed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你醒来 好好做完它
sense_groups.english: So please wake up so we can do it right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好 我准备好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. I'm ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 来 大哥 - 好
sense_groups.english: Come on, big fella. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好表现一番 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Give me the good stuff. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 不要睡觉
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Don't fall asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要替你煮咖啡
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm going to make you some coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 我大概不会把咖啡粉洒了一地
sense_groups.english: Well, I probably won't spill coffee grounds all over the kitchen floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我起来了 我起来了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm up. I'm up.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 咖啡来了…
sense_groups.english: Hi. I got you some coffee to...

sense_groups.chinese: 你找到东西了没？
sense_groups.english: So you got anything for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是没有 - 我的天
sense_groups.english: Still no luck. - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有检查过整个桌子 和所有的抽屉吗？
sense_groups.english: You checked your entire desk and all the drawers?

sense_groups.chinese: 要我再找一次？ - 请你再找一次
sense_groups.english: Want me to check again? - I wish you would.

sense_groups.chinese: 它没有在这里
sense_groups.english: Well, no, it's not in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个抽屉呢？
sense_groups.english: How about that drawer?

sense_groups.chinese: 它不在这里 有可能在你办公室吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not out here. Any chance it could be in your office?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找找看
sense_groups.english: I mean, let me check.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？
sense_groups.english: Any luck?

sense_groups.chinese: 请进来说话
sense_groups.english: Can I see you in my office for a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找到了
sense_groups.english: You found them!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会偷笑
sense_groups.english: I'm not even gonna gloat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很安慰整件事… - 你放在我桌上的
sense_groups.english: I'm just really relieved it's... - You put these on my desk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: I did not. - Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 它从你最下面的抽屉溜出来…
sense_groups.english: So they slid out of your bottom drawer...

sense_groups.chinese: 爬过地板 跳到我桌上来？
sense_groups.english: ...crawled across the floor, then jumped onto my desk?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道它在我最下面的抽屉？
sense_groups.english: How did you know they were in my bottom drawer?

sense_groups.chinese: 此刻我令你欲火焚身
sense_groups.english: I am so hot for you right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你怎么回来的？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! How did you get back here?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比•布非？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe Buffay?

sense_groups.chinese: 警报器？
sense_groups.english: Fire Alarm?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 救火员先生 有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Officer Fireman. Can I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在垃圾桶发现你的警报器
sense_groups.english: Your fire alarm was in the trash.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我的 - 是你的
sense_groups.english: That's not mine. - Yes, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: How do you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要扔掉警报器
sense_groups.english: If you dump a fire alarm, don't use a blanket that says

sense_groups.chinese: 不要用写着"菲比•布非的财物 不是摩妮卡的"的毯子
sense_groups.english: "Property of Phoebe Buffay, not Monica."

sense_groups.chinese: 你有搜索令吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a search warrant?

sense_groups.chinese: 我查过了 这里还是美国
sense_groups.english: Because the last time I checked, this was still America.

sense_groups.chinese: 请把它装回去 折除它是违法的
sense_groups.english: Please reattach it. It's against the law to disconnect them.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 拜托告诉我 怎样才能让它不叫？
sense_groups.english: Fine. But please, God, tell me how to stop it from going off?

sense_groups.chinese: 摁下重设的按钮
sense_groups.english: Press the reset button.

sense_groups.chinese: 有重设按钮？谢谢 谢谢
sense_groups.english: There's a reset button? Oh, thank you. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有重设按钮？
sense_groups.english: Oh. There's a reset button?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天
sense_groups.english: My God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么没看到？
sense_groups.english: Why didn't I see that?

sense_groups.chinese: 重设按钮 重设按钮
sense_groups.english: Reset button. Reset button.

sense_groups.chinese: 重设按钮在哪里？ 哦 在这里 喔
sense_groups.english: Where is there a reset button? Oh, here it is! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你抓好了吗？ - 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you have a good grip? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要开始爬过你了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna start to climb down you now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 快一点 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, just hurry up. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该面向你爬下来 所以我们面对面的…
sense_groups.english: Now, should I climb down your front so we're face to face...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是应该背对你爬下来…
sense_groups.english: ...or should I climb down your back so we're...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后屁股对着脸？
sense_groups.english: ...butt to face?

sense_groups.chinese: 面对面 - 我喜欢面对面
sense_groups.english: Face to face. - I like face to face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来了 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, here I come. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天…罗斯 你多重？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my... How much do you weigh, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想回答 过节时胖的还没瘦下去
sense_groups.english: I prefer not to answer that right now. I'm still carrying a little holiday weight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说要面对面时…
sense_groups.english: When we talked about face to face...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们没有想清楚
sense_groups.english: ...I don't think we thought it all the way through.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怎么办？ - 从我身上滑下 跳下去
sense_groups.english: What do you want me to do? - Just shimmy down me and drop.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我该吊着 你爬过我下去
sense_groups.english: You know, maybe I should hang, and you should climb down me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？也许我们应该多讨论一下
sense_groups.english: Yeah? Maybe we should talk about that for a little while!

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来还好远 - 没有那么远 跳就是了
sense_groups.english: It still looks pretty far. - It's not that far. Just drop.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要催我
sense_groups.english: Do not rush me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的裤子开始下滑 我没穿内裤
sense_groups.english: Ross, my pants are starting to come down, and I'm not wearing any underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的脚踝 我伤到我的脚踝
sense_groups.english: Ow! My ankle! I really hurt my ankle!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我扭到了…这里有个硬币
sense_groups.english: I think I twisted it when... Ooh, a quarter!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是你的最佳表现
sense_groups.english: That really was some of your best work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说了嘛
sense_groups.english: I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不能相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只剩两小时我就要打电话请假
sense_groups.english: I've only got two hours until I call in sick for work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我7分钟后就要起床
sense_groups.english: I have to be up in seven minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会相信的 如果你还有7分钟…
sense_groups.english: Well, you're not gonna believe this, but if you have seven minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要？
sense_groups.english: You want to?

sense_groups.chinese: 你去拿吸尘器 我拿家具打亮剂
sense_groups.english: Okay. You get the vacuum cleaner. I'll get the furniture polish.

questions.name: S07E13
questions.en:
Hey. What are you doing? - Hi.
Well, you know, I was thinking of moving the couch over here.
Why would you want to do that?
So that there would be a decent place for me to sit?
Rach, there is a decent place. - And your lap does not count.
Okay? Come on, help me move this. - No, no, no.
No? - No.
Rosita does not move.
I'm sorry. Rosita? As in...?
As in "Rosita does not move."
Joey, it's just a chair. What's the big deal?
The big deal is that it's the exact equal distance from the bathroom to the kitchen...
...and it's at the perfect angle so you don't get any glare coming off of Stevie.
Stevie the TV?
Is there a problem? - No.
Oh, what does he know?
Come on, Rosita. Us chicas gotta stick together.
Ow!
You bitch.
Hey, Ross?
So I was checking out the real-estate section.
Yeah. - Look at this.
Oh, looks like Mom and Dad's house.
Oh, it even has a tree with a broken limb out front.
And the, uh, window in the attic...
Oh, my God.
What? What happened to the window in the attic?
I can't believe Mom and Dad are selling the house.
I can't believe they didn't even tell us.
I can't believe I still don't know what happened to the window in the attic.
Okay, come on. I'll buy you a new one, all right?
We'll go down to the store right now and we'll get you a new chair.
She's not even cold yet.
But don't you think Rosita would've wanted you to move on?
I mean, you know, she did always put your comfort first.
That's true.
Wow.
I can't believe we have to say goodbye to the house we grew up in.
Man, some stranger's gonna be living in my room.
Well, after 15 years of Mom and Dad keeping it as a shrine to you...
...it's time the velvet ropes came down.
They kept your room a while.
Oh, please. Dad turned my room into a gym 20 minutes after I moved out.
And I gotta say, a tanning bed and a stack of Victoria's Secret catalogs?
Not a gym.
Come on. You know they love you. - As much as they love you?
I was their firstborn. They thought she was barren. It's not my fault.
Ugh. I hate this year.
What's wrong with this year?
It's already February and I've only given two massages...
...and they were both the worst tippers in the world.
That was me and Ross.
Oh, that's right.
If you want to pick up some extra cash...
...some friends of mine made good money in college doing telemarketing.
Yeah, it'd probably be better than the last telephone job I had.
You know, I probably won't have to say "spank" as much.
What?
Oh, yeah, like you never called.
So, basically, this is very easy. You read from the script...
...and try to sell as much toner as you possibly can.
Okay, I can do that.
Oh, by the way, I love my office. - Ha, ha.
Why don't we do a trial run? - Oh, okay.
Um, all right.
Hi, this is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.
Can I speak to your supply manager, please?
I'm the supply manager.
Um, okay. I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.
We don't need any toner. - Well, I'm sorry to bother you. Bye-bye.
Yeah, you're right. This is easy.
Okay. What was wrong with that call?
Oh, well, all right.
Um, no offense, but you were kind of rude.
They're always gonna tell you they don't need toner, but that's okay.
Because whatever they say...
...you can find the answer to it, here in the script.
Oh. - So I think you're ready to sell toner.
Do you have any last questions? - No.
Oh, wait, yes, I do. I do have one question
What is toner?
Joey?
Joe?
Full bag?
Beer's still cold.
Something terrible must have happened here.
Oh, no, no, no.
Stevie, I was never here.
Dad? - I'm here.
Hey. - Hi.
God, it seems like just yesterday you guys used to come out to watch me work.
Dad, we can't believe you're selling the house.
It's time for a new family to start their memories here.
And hopefully their check will clear before they find the crack...
...in the foundation and the asbestos in the ceiling.
Let's just grab our stuff and get the hell out of here.
I'm sorry we can't store your childhood things anymore.
Oh, it's okay. I can't wait to see everything again. All the memories.
I don't know what's in the boxes down here.
But I do know that there are six or seven Easy-Bake Ovens in the attic.
I used to love to play restaurant.
Yeah, not as much as you loved to play "uncooked batter eater."
Hey. It is unreasonable to expect a child to wait for a light bulb to cook brownies.
So I think your boxes are over here.
Oh, great.
Hey...
...Dad, whose cigarettes are these?
I don't know.
They must be your mother's.
But please, please don't ask her. I'll throw these away.
Cool. Dad, my report cards.
Hey, check this out. Dad.
Math, A. Science, A. History, A. Gym...
Ooh, my rock polisher.
Uh-oh. - What?
You know how the garage floods every spring?
How are you ever gonna sell this place?
I think I accidentally used Monica's boxes...
...to keep the water away from the Porsche.
Oh, no, Dad. Dad?
What the...?
Oh, God.
Everything's ruined.
Dad, she's gonna be crushed.
You don't secretly smoke, do you?
No.
So it's just your mother, then.
Hi. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.
Can I speak to your supply manager, please?
Earl. Thanks.
Hi, Earl. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.
I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.
I don't need any toner.
I'm hearing what you're saying, but at our prices, everyone needs toner.
Not me.
May I ask why?
You want to know why?
I surely do.
Okay.
I don't need any toner...
...because I'm gonna kill myself.
Um...
Is that because you're out of toner?
Okay, so no toner today. Thanks anyway. Bye-bye.
No, no, wait, wait. I can't just let you hang up.
Just please talk to me.
Well...
I only had one thing to do today.
I guess I could push it back.
Yeah. Now, why do you want to kill yourself?
I've been working for 10 years now at this...
...meaningless, dead-end job...
...and nobody here even knows that I exist.
Chandler?
I'm sorry?
Oh. Look...
...I'm sure that people know you exist.
Oh, yeah? I work in a cubicle surrounded by people.
I've been talking to you for five minutes now about killing myself...
...and no one's even looked up from their desk. Hang on.
Hey, everybody, uh...
...I'm gonna kill myself.
I got nothing.
Good chair.
Now, if anybody asks...
...your name is Rosita.
Poor thing. Cut down in her prime.
Joey, the new chair will be here in an hour.
Maybe we should actually move Rosita out of here, you know?
Start the healing process.
Yeah, I guess you're right. - Okay.
She's healed.
That's weird. - No, it's not weird.
It's a miracle.
It's not a miracle, Joey. I'm sure there's an explanation.
There is. If you want something enough and your heart is pure...
...wondrous things can happen.
Well, she'll understand, right? It's not like I did it on purpose.
Dad, that won't matter to her.
Look, all my stuff is safe and dry. And all her stuff is...
...growing new stuff.
See, this is exactly the kind of thing...
...that makes her think you guys love me more than you love her.
Oh, my God. Does she really think that?
Well, can you blame her?
I don't know. I suppose we may have favored you unconsciously.
You were a medical marvel.
The doctors said your mom couldn't... - I don't want to hear about it.
Really? - Well, not right now.
Okay, look. Monica came here for some memories.
Damn it, we're gonna give her some.
Okay, grab...
Grab some empty boxes, okay? We'll take stuff from mine...
...and whatever we can pass off as hers, we'll put them in there.
Right. - Like, this. She could have made this.
This could have been hers. - Sure.
You know, if you want to tell the medical marvel story while we work...
...that'd be fine.
I am so psyched I kept this chair for myself.
Yeah. Me too.
Wow, you know, that this thing has speakers in the headrest?
No, really? - Yeah.
You can hook it up to your TV and you get radio.
My chair heals itself.
All right. Earl, let's just forget about the people at the office, okay?
There's gotta be someone else in your life that's worth sticking around for.
What about your family or friends? Or maybe a girlfriend?
Heh. Yeah, right.
Oh, sorry. Boyfriend?
Okay, I should...
I should probably be getting back to my thing now.
See you. - No.
I'm not finished yet. Don't you dare hang up on me!
The new girl's good.
So which boxes are mine?
These are yours right here. - Okay.
Oh, a coloring book. - Yeah, yeah. Oh, you loved that thing.
You always had it with you. You never went anywhere without...
Without that coloring book.
Really?
Wow. Looks like I had some trouble staying inside the lines.
Uh-uh.
Wow, look at this.
I can't believe I even fit into this shirt.
Oh, this is yours.
I don't know how that got in there.
Hey, this isn't my stuff.

Um, okay. I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.
We don't need any toner. - Well, I'm sorry to bother you. Bye-bye.
Yeah, you're right. This is easy.
Okay. What was wrong with that call?
Oh, well, all right.
Um, no offense, but you were kind of rude.
They're always gonna tell you they don't need toner, but that's okay.
Because whatever they say...
...you can find the answer to it, here in the script.
Oh. - So I think you're ready to sell toner.
Do you have any last questions? - No.
Oh, wait, yes, I do. I do have one question
What is toner?
Joey?
Joe?
Full bag?
Beer's still cold.
Something terrible must have happened here.
Oh, no, no, no.
Stevie, I was never here.
Dad? - I'm here.
Hey. - Hi.
God, it seems like just yesterday you guys used to come out to watch me work.
Dad, we can't believe you're selling the house.
It's time for a new family to start their memories here.
And hopefully their check will clear before they find the crack...
...in the foundation and the asbestos in the ceiling.
Let's just grab our stuff and get the hell out of here.
I'm sorry we can't store your childhood things anymore.
Oh, it's okay. I can't wait to see everything again. All the memories.
I don't know what's in the boxes down here.
But I do know that there are six or seven Easy-Bake Ovens in the attic.
I used to love to play restaurant.
Yeah, not as much as you loved to play "uncooked batter eater."
Hey. It is unreasonable to expect a child to wait for a light bulb to cook brownies.
So I think your boxes are over here.
Oh, great.
Hey...
...Dad, whose cigarettes are these?
I don't know.
They must be your mother's.
But please, please don't ask her. I'll throw these away.
Cool. Dad, my report cards.
Hey, check this out. Dad.
Math, A. Science, A. History, A. Gym...
Ooh, my rock polisher.
Uh-oh. - What?
You know how the garage floods every spring?
How are you ever gonna sell this place?
I think I accidentally used Monica's boxes...
...to keep the water away from the Porsche.
Oh, no, Dad. Dad?
What the...?
Oh, God.
Everything's ruined.
Dad, she's gonna be crushed.
You don't secretly smoke, do you?
No.
So it's just your mother, then.
Hi. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.
Can I speak to your supply manager, please?
Earl. Thanks.
Hi, Earl. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.
I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.
I don't need any toner.
I'm hearing what you're saying, but at our prices, everyone needs toner.
Not me.
May I ask why?
You want to know why?
I surely do.
Okay.
I don't need any toner...
...because I'm gonna kill myself.
Um...
Is that because you're out of toner?
Okay, so no toner today. Thanks anyway. Bye-bye.
No, no, wait, wait. I can't just let you hang up.
Just please talk to me.
Well...
I only had one thing to do today.
I guess I could push it back.
Yeah. Now, why do you want to kill yourself?
I've been working for 10 years now at this...
...meaningless, dead-end job...
...and nobody here even knows that I exist.
Chandler?
I'm sorry?
Oh. Look...
...I'm sure that people know you exist.
Oh, yeah? I work in a cubicle surrounded by people.
I've been talking to you for five minutes now about killing myself...
...and no one's even looked up from their desk. Hang on.
Hey, everybody, uh...
...I'm gonna kill myself.
I got nothing.
Good chair.
Now, if anybody asks...
...your name is Rosita.
Poor thing. Cut down in her prime.
Joey, the new chair will be here in an hour.
Maybe we should actually move Rosita out of here, you know?
Start the healing process.
Yeah, I guess you're right. - Okay.
She's healed.
That's weird. - No, it's not weird.
It's a miracle.
It's not a miracle, Joey. I'm sure there's an explanation.
There is. If you want something enough and your heart is pure...
...wondrous things can happen.
Well, she'll understand, right? It's not like I did it on purpose.
Dad, that won't matter to her.
Look, all my stuff is safe and dry. And all her stuff is...
...growing new stuff.
See, this is exactly the kind of thing...
...that makes her think you guys love me more than you love her.
Oh, my God. Does she really think that?
Well, can you blame her?
I don't know. I suppose we may have favored you unconsciously.
You were a medical marvel.
The doctors said your mom couldn't... - I don't want to hear about it.
Really? - Well, not right now.
Okay, look. Monica came here for some memories.
Damn it, we're gonna give her some.
Okay, grab...
Grab some empty boxes, okay? We'll take stuff from mine...
...and whatever we can pass off as hers, we'll put them in there.
Right. - Like, this. She could have made this.
This could have been hers. - Sure.
You know, if you want to tell the medical marvel story while we work...
...that'd be fine.
I am so psyched I kept this chair for myself.
Yeah. Me too.
Wow, you know, that this thing has speakers in the headrest?
No, really? - Yeah.
You can hook it up to your TV and you get radio.
My chair heals itself.
All right. Earl, let's just forget about the people at the office, okay?
There's gotta be someone else in your life that's worth sticking around for.
What about your family or friends? Or maybe a girlfriend?
Heh. Yeah, right.
Oh, sorry. Boyfriend?
Okay, I should...
I should probably be getting back to my thing now.
See you. - No.
I'm not finished yet. Don't you dare hang up on me!
The new girl's good.
So which boxes are mine?
These are yours right here. - Okay.
Oh, a coloring book. - Yeah, yeah. Oh, you loved that thing.
You always had it with you. You never went anywhere without...
Without that coloring book.
Really?
Wow. Looks like I had some trouble staying inside the lines.
Uh-uh.
Wow, look at this.
I can't believe I even fit into this shirt.
Oh, this is yours.
I don't know how that got in there.
Hey, this isn't my stuff.
Ross, these are your boxes.
Where are my boxes?
The garage flooded, sweetie, and it ruined everything in your boxes.
I'm sorry.
Just mine? - I'm afraid so.
So why wasn't Ross' stuff ruined?
I used your boxes to divert water away from the Porsche.
So wait. Ross' stuff is fine, but I have no memories...
...because you wanted to keep the bottom two inches of your car from water?
Well, there was also leaves and gook and stuff.
I can't believe this.
Screw it. I'm having one.
Hey, Chandler. - Hey.
How would you like to sit in a chair that fully reclines...
...has a rolling massage...
...and speakers in the headrest?
Yeah, I'd love to, but I've tried that so many times...
...they won't even let me in the store anymore.
Well, what if I told you that you could do it in my apartment?
Are you telling me...
...that you bought the chair that is making all other lounge systems obsolete?
The chair that Sit Magazine called "Chair of the Year"?
I just purchased...
...the La-Z-Boy E-Cliner 3000.
Well, that's awesome. That's great. What made you do it?
Well, it's a long story, but I broke Joey's chair...
Whoa, whoa, whoa. You broke Joey's chair?
Yeah. - I thought I broke Joey's chair.
That's why I replaced it with mine. - Oh.
That's how it got fixed.
Well, what did you think? That elves came in and fixed it?
No.
Angels.
I'm getting my chair back. - Hey.
Well, looks like it wasn't healed after all.
So I guess this chair's mine now.
Joey, you broke my chair!
Your chair?
Yeah, he thought he broke your chair, so he switched the chairs.
So there was no miracle? - No, Joe. No miracle.
Oh, no. This is devastating.
My faith is shaken.
I'm so glad I have the new chair to get me through this difficult time in my life.
Excuse me, could you tell me where can I find Earl?
He's the supply manager here.
Sorry, I don't know any Earl.
I'm right here!
Earl?
I'm Phoebe. - Phoebe?
The lady who sells toner?
Um, look, you can't kill yourself.
Look, um, I really appreciate you coming down...
No, no, I can't let you do it.
Why?
Because it was fate that made me call you today.
I thought it was toner.
No. Think about it, okay? This isn't even my regular job, okay?
And my first day on the job, you're my first call.
And somebody else might have hung up on you, but I wouldn't do that...
...because I know about this stuff.
My mom killed herself. - Really?
Yes. - How?
I'm not gonna give you tips.
Look, don't you see that this...?
This all came together so that I could stop you from doing this.
Couldn't it just be a coincidence? - No, it's fate.
It doesn't really seem like enough to be fate.
Oh, well. Um, okay, here's a weird thing.
My mother was also a supply manager.
I'm actually the office manager.
Oh, my God. So was she!
And get this, okay.
Your name is Earl, right? Her name was Pearl.
Pearl.
Was there anything else?
Sure.
Um, where are you from?
Philadelphia. - Oh, my God, so was she!
Oh, I've got goose bumps.
Really?
Well, I'm wearing layers, and it's warm. - Yeah.
But... Look. Okay. These jerks might not care about you...
...but the universe does, and that says a lot.
Did you hear that?
I don't need you guys to care about me...
...because the universe cares.
The whole universe!
I really wish they'd care just a little bit.
Oh, this is terrible.
Everything is destroyed.
Look at this.
It obviously meant enough for me to save it, and now I can't tell what it is.
It's still soft.
What do you think this is?
Mon, I think it was a mouse.
How are you, honey? - How do you think I am?
You've wrecked all my childhood memories...
...you love Ross more than me.
And I just rubbed a dead mouse on my face.
Sweetheart, we love you just as much as Ross.
Now, I'm sorry about everything that happened...
...and I'll probably never be able to make it up to you...
...but here's a start.
What's this? - It's the key to my Porsche.
Well, the key to your Porsche.
What? - What?
I've been thinking of getting rid of it...
...and I was driving it the other day and I saw my reflection in a window.
Your mother's right, I do look like an ass.
You're giving it to me? You're kidding me, right?
Well, wait a minute.
I mean, a couple of stupid boxes get wet, and she gets a Porsche?
Why don't we take it for a spin? - All right.
What about me? I'm a medical marvel!
Oh, yeah. - Oh.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Know what happened to Chandler's Barcalounger?
Oh, yeah. Joey broke it. Had to get rid of it.
Are you kidding? I get a Porsche and the Barcalounger's gone?
Heh. This is the best day ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你在做什么？ - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. What are you doing? - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想把沙发搬开
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, I was thinking of moving the couch over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要那么做？
sense_groups.english: Why would you want to do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样子我就有好位置可以坐了？
sense_groups.english: So that there would be a decent place for me to sit?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你本来就有好位置坐了 - 你的大腿不算
sense_groups.english: Rach, there is a decent place. - And your lap does not count.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 帮我把它搬开 - 不
sense_groups.english: Okay? Come on, help me move this. - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不要？ - 我不要
sense_groups.english: No? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 萝希塔不想移开
sense_groups.english: Rosita does not move.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 萝希塔 是…？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Rosita? As in...?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是"不想动的萝希塔"
sense_groups.english: As in "Rosita does not move."

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 只不过是一张椅子 有什么大不了的？
sense_groups.english: Joey, it's just a chair. What's the big deal?

sense_groups.chinese: 大不了的是 它到浴室跟到厨房的距离是一样的…
sense_groups.english: The big deal is that it's the exact equal distance from the bathroom to the kitchen...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且它的角度让你完全 看不到史提夫的反光
sense_groups.english: ...and it's at the perfect angle so you don't get any glare coming off of Stevie.

sense_groups.chinese: 电视机史提夫？
sense_groups.english: Stevie the TV?

sense_groups.chinese: 有问题吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Is there a problem? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他又知道什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what does he know?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 萝希塔 我们这些辣妹得合作才行
sense_groups.english: Come on, Rosita. Us chicas gotta stick together.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个臭女人
sense_groups.english: You bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过房地产广告版
sense_groups.english: So I was checking out the real-estate section.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 你看这个
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来好像爸妈的房子
sense_groups.english: Oh, looks like Mom and Dad's house.

sense_groups.chinese: 院子里的树 正前方也有根断掉的树枝
sense_groups.english: Oh, it even has a tree with a broken limb out front.

sense_groups.chinese: 阁楼的窗户…
sense_groups.english: And the, uh, window in the attic...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 阁楼的窗户怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What? What happened to the window in the attic?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信他们要把它卖掉
sense_groups.english: I can't believe Mom and Dad are selling the house.

sense_groups.chinese: 却没有告诉我们
sense_groups.english: I can't believe they didn't even tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 阁楼的窗户到底是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I still don't know what happened to the window in the attic.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我会买张新椅子赔你 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, come on. I'll buy you a new one, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们马上到店里去 帮你买一张新椅子
sense_groups.english: We'll go down to the store right now and we'll get you a new chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还尸骨未寒
sense_groups.english: She's not even cold yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 萝希塔难道不希望 你继续过你的日子吗？
sense_groups.english: But don't you think Rosita would've wanted you to move on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说她永远 把你的幸福放在第一顺位
sense_groups.english: I mean, you know, she did always put your comfort first.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 我们得跟小时候的家说再见
sense_groups.english: I can't believe we have to say goodbye to the house we grew up in.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 有个陌生人 就要搬进我的房间里
sense_groups.english: Man, some stranger's gonna be living in my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 十五年来 他们把你房间 弄得跟神宠差不多
sense_groups.english: Well, after 15 years of Mom and Dad keeping it as a shrine to you...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在一切都该落幕了
sense_groups.english: ...it's time the velvet ropes came down.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们也保留你房间有一阵子
sense_groups.english: They kept your room a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我搬出来二十分钟后 爸就把我的房间变成健身房
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. Dad turned my room into a gym 20 minutes after I moved out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说 一张日光浴椅 跟一堆维多利亚秘密的目录？
sense_groups.english: And I gotta say, a tanning bed and a stack of Victoria's Secret catalogs?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是健身房
sense_groups.english: Not a gym.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你知道他们爱你 - 就跟他们爱你一样？
sense_groups.english: Come on. You know they love you. - As much as they love you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没出生前 他们以为她不会生 那不是我的错
sense_groups.english: I was their firstborn. They thought she was barren. It's not my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌今年
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I hate this year.

sense_groups.chinese: 今年有什么不对的？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with this year?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在已经是二月 我只接到两个按摩客人…
sense_groups.english: It's already February and I've only given two massages...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他们给小费都给得很吝啬
sense_groups.english: ...and they were both the worst tippers in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指我跟罗斯
sense_groups.english: That was me and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你需要钱…
sense_groups.english: If you want to pick up some extra cash...

sense_groups.chinese: 我大学的朋友 做电话行销赚了不少钱
sense_groups.english: ...some friends of mine made good money in college doing telemarketing.

sense_groups.chinese: 它一定比上次 我做的电话行销工作还棒
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it'd probably be better than the last telephone job I had.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我不必常常说"打我屁股吧"
sense_groups.english: You know, I probably won't have to say "spank" as much.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你从来没打过那种电话
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, like you never called.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很简单 你只要照着稿子念…
sense_groups.english: So, basically, this is very easy. You read from the script...

sense_groups.chinese: 试着多卖一点碳粉
sense_groups.english: ...and try to sell as much toner as you possibly can.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我办得到
sense_groups.english: Okay, I can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我喜欢我的办公室 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, I love my office. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不来练习一下？ - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't we do a trial run? - Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Um, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是帝国办公室文具公司的菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, this is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问总务部经理在吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I speak to your supply manager, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是总务部经理
sense_groups.english: I'm the supply manager.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我想跟你谈谈买碳粉的事
sense_groups.english: Um, okay. I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不需要碳粉 - 好吧 抱歉打扰你了 再见
sense_groups.english: We don't need any toner. - Well, I'm sorry to bother you. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 这真的很容易
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right. This is easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那通电话哪里不对劲呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay. What was wrong with that call?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有恶意 但你的态度真的很不好
sense_groups.english: Um, no offense, but you were kind of rude.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们永远都会说 他们不需要碳粉 没关系
sense_groups.english: They're always gonna tell you they don't need toner, but that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管他们说什么…
sense_groups.english: Because whatever they say...

sense_groups.chinese: 你都会在稿子里找到标准解答
sense_groups.english: ...you can find the answer to it, here in the script.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 - 我想你准备好要卖碳粉了
sense_groups.english: Oh. - So I think you're ready to sell toner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有问题吗？ - 没有了
sense_groups.english: Do you have any last questions? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 对了 我的确有一个问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, yes, I do. I do have one question

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是碳粉？
sense_groups.english: What is toner?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊？
sense_groups.english: Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 原封未动？
sense_groups.english: Full bag?

sense_groups.chinese: 啤酒还是冰的
sense_groups.english: Beer's still cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里一定发生了很可怕的事
sense_groups.english: Something terrible must have happened here.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 史提夫 我没来过这里
sense_groups.english: Stevie, I was never here.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸？ - 我在这里
sense_groups.english: Dad? - I'm here.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉上好像昨天你们 跑来这里看我工作的时候
sense_groups.english: God, it seems like just yesterday you guys used to come out to watch me work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不敢相信你们要卖掉房子
sense_groups.english: Dad, we can't believe you're selling the house.

sense_groups.chinese: 也该让新的家庭 在这里开始他们的新生活了
sense_groups.english: It's time for a new family to start their memories here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望在支票兑现前 他们不会发现…
sense_groups.english: And hopefully their check will clear before they find the crack...

sense_groups.chinese: 地基有裂痕 天花板的石棉瓦破了
sense_groups.english: ...in the foundation and the asbestos in the ceiling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们快把东西拿一拿 离开这里吧
sense_groups.english: Let's just grab our stuff and get the hell out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我们不能收藏你们儿时的东西
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry we can't store your childhood things anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及要再看到那些东西了 所有的回忆
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's okay. I can't wait to see everything again. All the memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这里放了什么
sense_groups.english: I don't know what's in the boxes down here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道 阁楼上有六 七箱简易烘焙烤箱
sense_groups.english: But I do know that there are six or seven Easy-Bake Ovens in the attic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前最喜欢玩开餐厅的游戏了
sense_groups.english: I used to love to play restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你最爱的还是"吃面粉糊"
sense_groups.english: Yeah, not as much as you loved to play "uncooked batter eater."

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能要求小孩子 等着要电灯泡把蛋糕烤好
sense_groups.english: Hey. It is unreasonable to expect a child to wait for a light bulb to cook brownies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你的箱子应该都在这里
sense_groups.english: So I think your boxes are over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿…
sense_groups.english: Hey...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是谁的烟？
sense_groups.english: ...Dad, whose cigarettes are these?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定是你妈的
sense_groups.english: They must be your mother's.

sense_groups.chinese: 但求求你别去质问她 我来把烟丢掉
sense_groups.english: But please, please don't ask her. I'll throw these away.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 爸 是我的成绩单
sense_groups.english: Cool. Dad, my report cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 快来看看
sense_groups.english: Hey, check this out. Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 数学"优等" 自然"优等" 历史"优等" 体育…
sense_groups.english: Math, A. Science, A. History, A. Gym...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的磨石机
sense_groups.english: Ooh, my rock polisher.

sense_groups.chinese: 惨了 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Uh-oh. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道每年春天车库都会淹水吗？
sense_groups.english: You know how the garage floods every spring?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不你怎么会把房子卖掉？
sense_groups.english: How are you ever gonna sell this place?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不小心拿摩妮卡的箱子…
sense_groups.english: I think I accidentally used Monica's boxes...

sense_groups.chinese: 来挡水 免得保时捷进了水
sense_groups.english: ...to keep the water away from the Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 爸 爸？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, Dad. Dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 搞什么…
sense_groups.english: What the...?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都毁了
sense_groups.english: Everything's ruined.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 她一定会崩溃的
sense_groups.english: Dad, she's gonna be crushed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该不会是偷偷在抽烟吧？
sense_groups.english: You don't secretly smoke, do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以是你妈在抽烟
sense_groups.english: So it's just your mother, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是帝国办公室文具公司的菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问总务部经理在吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I speak to your supply manager, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 厄尔 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Earl. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 厄尔 我是帝国办公室 文具公司的菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, Earl. This is Phoebe from Empire Office Supplies.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟你谈谈买碳粉的事
sense_groups.english: I'd like to talk to you about your toner needs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要碳粉
sense_groups.english: I don't need any toner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 但是听了我们的价格 大家都会想买碳粉
sense_groups.english: I'm hearing what you're saying, but at our prices, everyone needs toner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要
sense_groups.english: Not me.

sense_groups.chinese: 能请问你为什么吗？
sense_groups.english: May I ask why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想知道为什么？
sense_groups.english: You want to know why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想
sense_groups.english: I surely do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要碳粉…
sense_groups.english: I don't need any toner...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我就要自杀了
sense_groups.english: ...because I'm gonna kill myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为你的碳粉用完了吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that because you're out of toner?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 今天我不需要碳粉 谢谢你 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, so no toner today. Thanks anyway. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我不能让你挂电话
sense_groups.english: No, no, wait, wait. I can't just let you hang up.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你跟我说话
sense_groups.english: Just please talk to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我只需要做一件事
sense_groups.english: I only had one thing to do today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我能把它延期一下吧
sense_groups.english: I guess I could push it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你为什么要自杀？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Now, why do you want to kill yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 十年来 我一直在做…
sense_groups.english: I've been working for 10 years now at this...

sense_groups.chinese: 这份没有意义又没有前途的工作…
sense_groups.english: ...meaningless, dead-end job...

sense_groups.chinese: 办公室里的人根本不知道我的存在
sense_groups.english: ...and nobody here even knows that I exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Look...

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信他们都知道你的存在
sense_groups.english: ...I'm sure that people know you exist.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我在一个小房间工作四周都是人
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? I work in a cubicle surrounded by people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经跟你谈了五分钟 我要自杀的问题…
sense_groups.english: I've been talking to you for five minutes now about killing myself...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人抬头起来看我一眼 等一下
sense_groups.english: ...and no one's even looked up from their desk. Hang on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大伙们…
sense_groups.english: Hey, everybody, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要自杀了
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna kill myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不理我
sense_groups.english: I got nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好漂亮的椅子
sense_groups.english: Good chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 如果有人问起…
sense_groups.english: Now, if anybody asks...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的名字就叫萝希塔
sense_groups.english: ...your name is Rosita.

sense_groups.chinese: 可怜的小东西 她是英年早逝
sense_groups.english: Poor thing. Cut down in her prime.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 新椅子一小时内就会送来
sense_groups.english: Joey, the new chair will be here in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该把萝希塔搬出去
sense_groups.english: Maybe we should actually move Rosita out of here, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 开始疗伤止痛
sense_groups.english: Start the healing process.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我猜你说的对 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess you're right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她恢复了
sense_groups.english: She's healed.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太奇怪了 - 不 一点都不奇怪
sense_groups.english: That's weird. - No, it's not weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是奇迹
sense_groups.english: It's a miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是奇迹 我相信这一定有合理的解释
sense_groups.english: It's not a miracle, Joey. I'm sure there's an explanation.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 只要你的心地纯正…
sense_groups.english: There is. If you want something enough and your heart is pure...

sense_groups.chinese: 奇迹一定会发生
sense_groups.english: ...wondrous things can happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会了解的 我不是故意的
sense_groups.english: Well, she'll understand, right? It's not like I did it on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 对她来说那并不重要
sense_groups.english: Dad, that won't matter to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我的箱子完全没事 她的东西都…
sense_groups.english: Look, all my stuff is safe and dry. And all her stuff is...

sense_groups.chinese: 长出新的东西了
sense_groups.english: ...growing new stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样的事…
sense_groups.english: See, this is exactly the kind of thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 让她认为你们爱我更胜于爱她
sense_groups.english: ...that makes her think you guys love me more than you love her.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她真的那么认为？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Does she really think that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能怪她吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, can you blame her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 或许我们在潜意识里 是偏爱你的
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I suppose we may have favored you unconsciously.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个奇迹
sense_groups.english: You were a medical marvel.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说你妈没办法… - 我不想听了
sense_groups.english: The doctors said your mom couldn't... - I don't want to hear about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 现在不想
sense_groups.english: Really? - Well, not right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡来这里找回忆
sense_groups.english: Okay, look. Monica came here for some memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我们得给她一些回忆
sense_groups.english: Damn it, we're gonna give her some.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 拿…
sense_groups.english: Okay, grab...

sense_groups.chinese: 把空箱子拿过来 我们拿一些我的东西…
sense_groups.english: Grab some empty boxes, okay? We'll take stuff from mine...

sense_groups.chinese: 放在这些箱子里 只要能骗过她的就行
sense_groups.english: ...and whatever we can pass off as hers, we'll put them in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 譬如说这个 这可能是她做的
sense_groups.english: Right. - Like, this. She could have made this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可能是她的 - 没错
sense_groups.english: This could have been hers. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是告诉我那个"医学奇迹"…
sense_groups.english: You know, if you want to tell the medical marvel story while we work...

sense_groups.chinese: 的适当时机了
sense_groups.english: ...that'd be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好高兴我能把这张椅子 留下来给自己用
sense_groups.english: I am so psyched I kept this chair for myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道这张椅子的头垫上 还附了喇叭吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow, you know, that this thing has speakers in the headrest?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真的吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: No, really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以把它跟电视机接在一起 还可以听收音机
sense_groups.english: You can hook it up to your TV and you get radio.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的椅子有自疗的功能
sense_groups.english: My chair heals itself.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们别提 办公室的同事了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: All right. Earl, let's just forget about the people at the office, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 一定有人值得你留恋
sense_groups.english: There's gotta be someone else in your life that's worth sticking around for.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的家人跟朋友呢？ 或许你有女朋友？
sense_groups.english: What about your family or friends? Or maybe a girlfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Heh. Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 抱歉 你的男朋友呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry. Boyfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我应该…
sense_groups.english: Okay, I should...

sense_groups.chinese: 去做我想做的事了
sense_groups.english: I should probably be getting back to my thing now.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 不
sense_groups.english: See you. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有说完 你休想挂我电话
sense_groups.english: I'm not finished yet. Don't you dare hang up on me!

sense_groups.chinese: 新来的女同事真的有一套
sense_groups.english: The new girl's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪些箱子是我的？
sense_groups.english: So which boxes are mine?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的箱子在这里 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: These are yours right here. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 着色簿 - 对 你喜欢那个玩意
sense_groups.english: Oh, a coloring book. - Yeah, yeah. Oh, you loved that thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪里都会…
sense_groups.english: You always had it with you. You never went anywhere without...

sense_groups.chinese: 都会带着那本着色簿
sense_groups.english: Without that coloring book.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来我老是没办法 把颜色涂在线里
sense_groups.english: Wow. Looks like I had some trouble staying inside the lines.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不
sense_groups.english: Uh-uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你看这个
sense_groups.english: Wow, look at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信以前我穿得下这件了恤
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I even fit into this shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这是你的
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道它怎么会跑到那里去
sense_groups.english: I don't know how that got in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 这不是我的东西
sense_groups.english: Hey, this isn't my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这些是你的箱子
sense_groups.english: Ross, these are your boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的箱子在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Where are my boxes?

sense_groups.chinese: 车库淹水 甜心 你的箱子都进了水 对不起
sense_groups.english: The garage flooded, sweetie, and it ruined everything in your boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有我的箱子进水了？ - 恐怕是那样的
sense_groups.english: Just mine? - I'm afraid so.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么罗斯的东西都没坏？
sense_groups.english: So why wasn't Ross' stuff ruined?

sense_groups.chinese: 我用你的箱子挡水来保护我的保时捷
sense_groups.english: I used your boxes to divert water away from the Porsche.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯的东西都没事 但我什么回忆都没有了…
sense_groups.english: So wait. Ross' stuff is fine, but I have no memories...

sense_groups.chinese: 只为了你不希望 你的汽车底盘触到水？
sense_groups.english: ...because you wanted to keep the bottom two inches of your car from water?

sense_groups.chinese: 水里有树叶 泥巴跟杂物
sense_groups.english: Well, there was also leaves and gook and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 去他的 我要抽根烟
sense_groups.english: Screw it. I'm having one.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要试试看一张可以平躺…
sense_groups.english: How would you like to sit in a chair that fully reclines...

sense_groups.chinese: 有滚轮按摩功能…
sense_groups.english: ...has a rolling massage...

sense_groups.chinese: 头垫还附了喇叭的椅子？
sense_groups.english: ...and speakers in the headrest?

sense_groups.chinese: 我试过很多次…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'd love to, but I've tried that so many times...

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们已经不再让我走进他们店里
sense_groups.english: ...they won't even let me in the store anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我说你可以到我家试坐一下呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what if I told you that you could do it in my apartment?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说…
sense_groups.english: Are you telling me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你买了那张让其他椅子 都变成废物的椅子？
sense_groups.english: ...that you bought the chair that is making all other lounge systems obsolete?

sense_groups.chinese: 那张《椅子杂志》封为 "年度最佳椅子"的椅子？
sense_groups.english: The chair that Sit Magazine called "Chair of the Year"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚买了…
sense_groups.english: I just purchased...

sense_groups.chinese: 懒男孩E倾斜3000型
sense_groups.english: ...the La-Z-Boy E-Cliner 3000.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 那真的是太棒了 太帅了 你为什么会买呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, that's awesome. That's great. What made you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 说来话长 但我弄坏了乔伊的椅子…
sense_groups.english: Well, it's a long story, but I broke Joey's chair...

sense_groups.chinese: 哇…你弄坏了乔伊的椅子？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa. You broke Joey's chair?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 我以为是我干的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - I thought I broke Joey's chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我用我的椅子跟它调包 - 哦
sense_groups.english: That's why I replaced it with mine. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以它才会恢复了
sense_groups.english: That's how it got fixed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为是妖精把它修好的？
sense_groups.english: Well, what did you think? That elves came in and fixed it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 是天使干的
sense_groups.english: Angels.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把我的椅子拿回来 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: I'm getting my chair back. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 看起来它根本没有自疗功能
sense_groups.english: Well, looks like it wasn't healed after all.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜这张椅子是我的了
sense_groups.english: So I guess this chair's mine now.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你弄坏了我的椅子
sense_groups.english: Joey, you broke my chair!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的椅子？
sense_groups.english: Your chair?

sense_groups.chinese: 他以为他把它弄坏了 所以他调换了椅子
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he thought he broke your chair, so he switched the chairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 奇迹根本不存在？ - 没错 乔伊 奇迹不存在
sense_groups.english: So there was no miracle? - No, Joe. No miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 这真的是太糟糕了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. This is devastating.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的信念被击垮了
sense_groups.english: My faith is shaken.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴 这张新椅子能陪我走过这一切
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad I have the new chair to get me through this difficult time in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问厄尔在哪里？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, could you tell me where can I find Earl?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是总务部经理
sense_groups.english: He's the supply manager here.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不认识厄尔
sense_groups.english: Sorry, I don't know any Earl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就在这里
sense_groups.english: I'm right here!

sense_groups.chinese: 厄尔？
sense_groups.english: Earl?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菲比 - 菲比？
sense_groups.english: I'm Phoebe. - Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 卖碳粉的小姐？
sense_groups.english: The lady who sells toner?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你不能自杀
sense_groups.english: Um, look, you can't kill yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很感激你赶过来…
sense_groups.english: Look, um, I really appreciate you coming down...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不能让你那么做
sense_groups.english: No, no, I can't let you do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为命运让我今天打电话给你
sense_groups.english: Because it was fate that made me call you today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为你打电话来是要卖碳粉
sense_groups.english: I thought it was toner.

sense_groups.chinese: 好好想一想 好吗？这根本不是我的正职
sense_groups.english: No. Think about it, okay? This isn't even my regular job, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我第一天上班就第一个打电话给你
sense_groups.english: And my first day on the job, you're my first call.

sense_groups.chinese: 其他人可能会挂掉电话 但我不会那么做…
sense_groups.english: And somebody else might have hung up on you, but I wouldn't do that...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我了解这种事
sense_groups.english: ...because I know about this stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈是自杀的 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: My mom killed herself. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 - 她是怎么自杀的
sense_groups.english: Yes. - How?

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不会教你
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna give you tips.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看不出来…
sense_groups.english: Look, don't you see that this...?

sense_groups.chinese: 这些都是注定好的 所以我才会来阻止你自杀？
sense_groups.english: This all came together so that I could stop you from doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是巧合吗？ - 不 这是命中注定
sense_groups.english: Couldn't it just be a coincidence? - No, it's fate.

sense_groups.chinese: 它看起来不像是命中注定
sense_groups.english: It doesn't really seem like enough to be fate.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好吧 好吧 有件事很奇怪
sense_groups.english: Oh, well. Um, okay, here's a weird thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈也是总务部经理
sense_groups.english: My mother was also a supply manager.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我是办公室经理
sense_groups.english: I'm actually the office manager.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 她也是

sense_groups.chinese: 因为宇宙在乎我

sense_groups.chinese: 整个宇宙在乎我
sense_groups.english: The whole universe!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的希望他们能在乎我一下
sense_groups.english: I really wish they'd care just a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这真的是太可怕了

sense_groups.english: Everything is destroyed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看这个

sense_groups.chinese: 它一定很重要我才会保存它 现在我看不出来它是什么东西

sense_groups.chinese: 它还软软的

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得它是什么呢？

sense_groups.chinese: 我想它是老鼠

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？甜心 - 你觉得呢？

sense_groups.chinese: 你毁了我的童年回忆…
sense_groups.english: You've wrecked all my childhood memories...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们爱罗斯比爱我多

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚还拿死了的老鼠触我的脸

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我们爱你就像我们爱罗斯一样

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 什么？
