sense_groups.english: Okay, quick. Help me get this off. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我失去了整整一年
sense_groups.english: I lost a whole year.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不能相信 真不公平
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. This is so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 没有关系的
sense_groups.english: Come on, Pheebs, it'll be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？是吗？
sense_groups.english: Will it? Will it?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你发现你变31岁了 你会怎么成觉？
sense_groups.english: How would you feel if you found out you were 31?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会的 因为我们有个新约定
sense_groups.english: That's not gonna happen, you know, because we have a new deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 这毁了我的时间表
sense_groups.english: Plus, it totally ruined my schedule.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没做那些我31岁前想做的事
sense_groups.english: I haven't done any of the things I wanted to do by the time I was 31.

sense_groups.chinese: 像什么？ - 像…
sense_groups.english: Like what? - Like, okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 像是我还不认识任何葡萄牙人
sense_groups.english: ...I haven't met any Portuguese people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有完美地接吻过
sense_groups.english: I haven't had the perfect kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没去上狙击手学校
sense_groups.english: And I haven't been to sniper school.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去吃蛋糕吧
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, why don't we go upstairs and have some birthday cake?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想一个人静一下 待会见 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, I just feel like being by myself for a while, all right? I'll see you guys later.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 可怜的菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, poor Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 知道吗？我想我要陪她走回家
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what, you guys? I think I'm gonna go walk her home.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天 - 怎么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他会吃了蛋糕
sense_groups.english: He's gonna eat the cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Pheebs. Wait up.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我…
sense_groups.english: Listen, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 闭上眼睛
sense_groups.english: Close your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以将这一项从单子上划掉
sense_groups.english: Maybe that's one you can cross off your list.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 对了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我是16分之1的葡萄牙人
sense_groups.english: Oh, and plus, I'm one-sixteenth Portuguese.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 大家都清楚了？我们要将它抬起来…
sense_groups.english: Okay, is everybody clear? We're gonna pick it up...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后移动它
sense_groups.english: ...and move it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只需要团队工作 我们要抬起这台车…
sense_groups.english: All we need is teamwork, okay? We're gonna lift the car...

sense_groups.chinese: 把它滑出来
sense_groups.english: ...and slide it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 抬起来…
sense_groups.english: Lift...

sense_groups.chinese: 滑出来
sense_groups.english: ...and slide.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯我真的不觉得这…- 抬起来…
sense_groups.english: Ross, I really don't think this... - Lift...

sense_groups.chinese: 滑出来
sense_groups.english: ...and slide.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 开始吧 - 好 大伙儿
sense_groups.english: Okay, here we go. - All right, everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 抬起来…
sense_groups.english: Lift...

sense_groups.chinese: 移出来
sense_groups.english: ...and slide.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊… - 别这样 瑞秋 才刚轮到我
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey... - Oh, come on, Rach, my turn just started.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我是要和泰格说话
sense_groups.english: Actually, I just want to talk to Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好 嘿 我可以到外面溜吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Hey, can I ride this outside?

sense_groups.chinese: 随便 我不是你妈 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Whatever, okay? I'm not your mother. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要到街上 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Not in the street! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有觉得好一点？ - 有 我很好 我…
sense_groups.english: How you doing, you feeling any better? - Yeah, I'm doing okay. I'm, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们谈谈 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Let's talk. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 额… - 什么事？
sense_groups.english: Um... - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 泰格…
sense_groups.english: Uh, Tag, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是个好男人 我们在一起很开心
sense_groups.english: You're such a great guy, and we have so much fun together.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是我… - 等一下
sense_groups.english: But I... - Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我知道你要做什么
sense_groups.english: I think I see where you're going.

sense_groups.chinese: 在你说任何话之前 我可以先说一件事吗？
sense_groups.english: But before you say anything else, can I just say one more thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 说的好
sense_groups.english: Well said.

sense_groups.chinese: 正是我所谓很开心的好例子
sense_groups.english: And a, uh, good example of the fun I was referring to.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想我已经过了只要开心的时候
sense_groups.english: Uh, but, heh, I think I'm past the point where I can, you know, just have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 不要这样 这只是因为你30岁了
sense_groups.english: Rachel, don't do this. This is just because you're turning 30.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只是个孩子 你才25岁
sense_groups.english: But you're just a kid. I mean, you're 25.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是24岁 - 老天
sense_groups.english: Twenty-four, actually. - Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我希望什么？ 我希望你比现在大6岁
sense_groups.english: You know what I wish? I wish you were six years older.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是希望的话 其实我希望自己年轻6岁
sense_groups.english: Well, actually, if I'm wishing for stuff, I actually wish I was six years younger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 - 是啊 对不起
sense_groups.english: Me too. - Yeah. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 谈得怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey, how'd it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我只要生两个孩子 我可以再保留他一年吗？
sense_groups.english: If I only want two kids, can I keep him for another year?

sense_groups.chinese: 你做的对
sense_groups.english: You did the right thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢它了
sense_groups.english: I don't like this anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在这儿 一群30岁的人
sense_groups.english: Well, here we are. Just a bunch of 30-year-olds.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道再过10年 我们就40岁了？
sense_groups.english: Wow, do you realize in 10 years we're gonna be 40?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 上帝？为什么这么对我们？
sense_groups.english: Why, God? Why are you doing this to us?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我的宝贝终于自由了
sense_groups.english: Yes. My baby's finally free.

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 启动 我们走
sense_groups.english: Start it up. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Whoo-hoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们拉不拉风？
sense_groups.english: How hot are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要买车吗？
sense_groups.english: You wanna buy a car?

questions.name: S07E15
questions.en:
So thanks for coming by, guys.
We wanted to bounce some ideas off of you about the wedding ceremony.
Oh.
What's the matter? Are you okay? - Yeah, it's just...
Monica said "wedding."
Uh, so we wanted to know if one of you would like to read something.
Okay, yeah, I guess I can do that too.
Too?
Yeah, I kind of, ahem, have something else planned for you guys.
Do you mind telling us what it is? - Sorry.
I'm kind of keeping this one on the QT.
Well, whatever it is, I hope it involves winking.
Hey. - Hey.
So I talked to one of the DOOL writers...
What is DOOL? - Days Of Our Lives.
You're not gonna believe it. My character is coming out of his coma!
That's wonderful. - Wow, Joey.
And not only that. I'm getting a new brain!
So great things are happening at work and in your personal life.
What do you mean you're getting a new brain?
They're killing off one of the characters, and when she dies...
...and her brain is being transplanted into my body.
Heh, what? A brain transplant?
It's ridiculous.
I think it's ridiculous that you haven't had sex in three and a half months.
It's winter. There are fewer people on the street.
Who are they killing off?
Uh, Cecilia Monroe. She plays Jessica Lockhart.
No! - No!
She is so good at throwing drinks in people's faces.
I don't think I've ever seen her finish a beverage.
The way she slaps people. Wouldn't you love to do that?
Don't do it.
And she's been on the show forever.
It's gonna be really hard to fill her shoes. - Yeah.
Help me out here. When you...
When you come out of the "brain transplant"...
...you are going to be her?
Yes, but in Drake Ramoray's body.
Why is this so hard for you to get? I thought you were a scientist.
Rach, so that guy there
Straight or gay?
Oh.
Oh, yeah, he's too cute to be straight. Ha, ha.
Ooh, Knockers will help us figure it out.
All right, straight.
And not subtle.
He left his cell phone. - Oh?
We could hand it to Gunther, he'll put it in lost and found.
Or we could use it to call China, see how those guys are doing.
What if, uh, he calls his own cell phone to find out who found it, and I answer...
...and we start talking and we fell in love?
Wouldn't that be a great story?
Kind of like a fairy tale for the digital age. - Yeah.
That does sound great. I'm gonna get the phone.
What? Wait. Why do you get the story?
I don't know. I haven't been out on a date in so long.
Phoebe, you had a date three days ago.
That wasn't a date. That was friends getting together and having sex.
Okay. Great. See, I get the phone.
No way. You just broke up with Tag a week ago.
Yeah, and until now, I didn't think I would love again.
Nice try. - Hey, wait.
How do we fairly decide who gets the phone?
I don't know.
Well, um...
Maybe we could, uh...
Ah-ha! Too slow! Ha-ha-ha.
Ah-ha! Too cocky.
I'm going to date him. There's nothing you can do.
Yes, there is.
What, are you going to kill him like you did Charles?
Oh, my baby.
Cut!
That was a great scene. And that slap looked so real. How do you do that?
Oh, just years of experience. - Can I get some ice here?
Anyway, I just wanted to say how wonderful I think you are.
You're not the fan who's dying, are you?
No, uh, I'm Joey Tribbiani. We did a scene together yesterday.
I'm the guy in the coma. - Oh, that was a real person?
I wanted to say, since I'm getting your brain when you leave the show...
...I was wondering if there was any tips... - I'm leaving the show?
I don't know, why? Did you hear something?
Who told you that? - Oh, uh...
One of the writers. - Which? Was it bald or was it tall?
You know, it doesn't matter, because it is not true.
Okay. Whoo, eh.
And if it were true, how dare you come to me and ask me for tips...
...about a character I've been playing for 20 years!
Miss Monroe... Oh, there you go.
Okay, look, I have an idea.
Why don't we see what kind of numbers he has on his speed dial?
And then from that, we can tell who has more in common with him...
...and whoever does gets the phone.
Fine. All right. - All right.
First name on the speed dial is "Mom." - Oh.
I lost my mom to suicide.
Okay, no way.
You can't use that to get the cute guy and the last muffin.
Did I use that already today? I'm sorry.
"Ben, Carlos, David..."
Oh, I win. He's got Barney's on his speed dial.
So? You don't know that it's Barney's the store.
That could be his friend's house, or a bar, or...
Who has Barney's the store on their speed dial?
His new girlfriend.
What is that?
I think it's the Dying Cat Parade.
Sounds like it's coming from across the street.
Oh, my God. - What?
The thing that Ross was gonna do at our wedding?
He was hanging out with me yesterday and he said, "You're half Scottish, right?"
No. There is no way. It cannot be Ross.
Unbelievable. Why is your family Scottish?
Why is your family Ross?
He cannot play at our wedding. Everyone will leave.
I mean, come on. That is just noise!
It's not even a song.
Wait. If you listen very carefully, I think...
...it's "Celebration" by Kool and the Gang.
You're absolutely right. They are writing me out of the show.
They don't know exactly when it's going to happen, but apparently it's soon...
...and then that's it.
I'm sorry. If it was up to me, you would never leave the show.
Yeah, thanks. - No, I mean it.
I can't believe they'd do this to you. And to your fans.
They're gonna be devastated. Heartbroken. They love you so much.
Oh, you're right.
Thank you.
What's your name again?
Joey. - Joey. Well, thank you.
That is so sweet. Oh.
The... The only reason I came up to you before...
...was because, well...
...because I'm really nervous about being you.
You know, if you could help me capture the essence of the character.
Help me keep Jessica alive. Please?
All right, Joey, I will help you.
Not because I owe it to this stupid show...
...but because I owe it to Jessica.
Oh, that's great. Thank you so much. - You're so welcome.
I've been watching some tapes. How's this?
Jessica Lockhart will never step foot in this place again!
Ever!
Oh, but, Jessica doesn't have an English accent.
I can do an English accent?
That baby's going on my resume.
Hi, Pheebs. How are you? - Good.
Um, Phoebe, remember when we were in the coffeehouse...
...we decided I was gonna keep the cute guy's phone?
Yeah. - And I was gonna keep it in my purse...
...so if it rang, I could just pick it up?
And then do you remember going into my purse and stealing the phone?
Ooh, now you lost me.
You stole the phone. - No, I didn't.
No? So you're saying that if I called it, it wouldn't ring?
No. - Hmm. Okay.
But while you dial, let me show you the features of my new ringing handbag.
Mm.
Oh, it does work.
Phoebe. - That is a different phone.
Oh, is it? Hello. Yes, hi. Is Rachel there?
Yes, she is. Just one moment, please. It's for me!
That is damning evidence.
Oh, my God. I bet that's him.
My digital fairy tale's about to begin.
It's ri...
Would you stop doing that?
Hello? Yes, I'm the one who found your phone.
Phoebe, you can't do th... - Shh, I'm on a call.
Well, yeah, I mean, you could pick it up tonight. Say, 8:30?
At my apartment. It's, um...
It's, um, 5 Morton Street, apartment 14.
And then maybe, you know, after, we could grab a bite to eat or whatever.
Okay. Okay, I'll see you then. Bye.
You do know that I will be here when he comes over.
Oh, and how will you know what time to come over?
You just said it.
Oh.
Joey, the essence of the character is rooted in her confidence.
So when Jessica enters a room, for instance...
...she owns everything...
...and every person in that room.
You try it. - Okay.
Right. Well, he's not mad at the room.
Try it again. He owns it. He owns the room.
It is his. He owns, owns, owns the room! He owns it!
It's a little weird, but it's getting better.
Oh, I'm gonna miss this woman so much. I don't know what I'm gonna do.
It's been 20 years of my life.
Hey, hey. Maybe... Maybe, uh... Maybe this is a good thing.
You know? Lt'll give you a chance to shake things up. Play different characters.
You're so talented.
Probably should've just left years ago when the offers were pouring in...
...but, you know, I just got so comfy here and...
Ugh, I turned down some amazing work.
Like what? - Well...
...let's just say if I'd left 15 years ago...
...the landscape of Mexican cinema would be very different today.
Wow.
But, well, now... Now's a different time for me.
Oh, hey, come on. Don't, uh... Don't do this.
Let me tell you something, okay?
When I watch you do a scene, I'm thinking, "Boy, she is a great actress."
But... But I'm also thinking, "She is hot."
You think I'm hot?
You own the room.
We... We should probably get the...
Oh, yeah. Yeah, we should get...
So when Jessica kisses a man...
...she usually puts, um...
...both her hands on the man's face.
Yeah, I notice that. Is that because she's so passionate?
No, it's because that way the camera only sees her.
You want to try it?
Yeah, okay.
That was good. That was really good.
But I think that maybe your hands are just a little off.
They should be, maybe... Like, right... - Mm.
Well, I feel like a snack.
Do you want some shortbread? It's Scottish, like you are.
Oh, no, thanks. I don't like anything from my Scottish heritage.
What?
Well, it's just that my entire family was run out of Scotland by...
...Vikings.
It sounds to me like your family's ready to, uh, rediscover its Scottish roots.
You can't play bagpipes at the wedding!
How did you know about that?
We heard you play all the way from your apartment.
Were you the ones who called the cops?
That's not really important right now. Ahem.
What is important is, while we appreciate the gesture...
...we just don't feel that bagpipes are appropriate for our wedding.
Why not? - Because we hate them.
Just give me a chance to perform for you, and then decide whatever you want.
I'm not gonna tell you what song I'm gonna play, either. But, uh...
...let's just say when it's over...
...I'll bet there'll be a wee bit o' celebration.
Hey, hey!
Who is it?
Hi, It's Tom.
I'm here to pick up the phone. - Ah!
Whoa, why do you get to answer the door?
Why shouldn't I? - Because it's my apartment.
Well, then I get to give him the phone.
Okay. Good luck explaining all the calls to China.
Hi.
Wow, how long were we arguing for?
Um, ha, ha.
You're not the man who left the cell phone.
No, that's my assistant. - Is he coming?
Um, no.
Could you, uh, give us one second?
Sure. - We'll be right back, sir.
Well, what do we do? - I don't know.
Can you believe this?
We were waiting for a hot guy and an even hotter one shows up.
I know...
What?
Rachel, listen...
...if you let me have him, then I will really owe you one.
All right.
All right, Phoebe, I will let you have him.
But you owe me. You owe me big.
So which one of you lovely ladies am I gonna take to dinner, huh?
Oh, that'd be me, sir.
After you. - Okay, thank you.
Nice.
Well, you certainly own that room.
Actually, I rent the whole place.
And I just got what you meant. Thank you.
Hi. - Hey.
Oh, my God.
Aah! Jessica Lockhart! In my apartment!
I am such a huge fan. I am such a huge fan.
Well, it's nice to know that...
Monica! Monica!
That, uh... That's my roommate, Rachel.
Oh, that explains all the women's underwear.
Sure. Yeah.
Oh, my God, it's true!
Oh, my God.
Can I just ask you to do me... Aw... . Just one favor?
Certainly.
Would you slap me? Would you slap me right here in the face?
I'd love to, but my lawyer said I can't do that anymore.
All right, here we go. - Okay.
No, wait. Just one moment. Um...
You're a stupid bitch. - I really can't slap you.
My God, you're great. - Thanks for stopping by. See you.
I am so sorry about that. - Oh, no, no, no.
Being adored, I'm used to it. Don't worry about it.
Oh, my God. - What?
They sent me today's script. They never send me the script.
They don't? - Well, no, I'm in a coma.
This must mean I have lines.
Oh.
How does it happen?
Ooh.
You get thrown from a horse into an electric fence.
A what? Jessica hates horses.
I'm guessing after this she's not gonna be crazy about electricity, either.
Loosening the saddle on Mother's horse was brilliant, Fredrick.
And the electric fence, inspired.
Thank you, sweetheart.
I can't believe she's really gone.
Look around you. All of this is ours.
I don't think so.
Who are you?
What's the matter, Dina?
Don't you recognize your own...
...mother?
Cut! That was great, everybody. Thank you.
That was so wonderful!
Oh, I think that you're a better Jessica than I ever was.
Oh, no. - Of course not, but you were very good.
Heh, thanks.
Guess what? Good news. I got another job.
Great. Hey, all right! What is it?
A film in Guadalajara.
The airport?
No, that's LaGuardia.
This is Mexico. - Oh, wow.
Well, how long will you be gone?
Eight months.
That's a really long time. - Yeah, but you could come and visit me.
I bet that you could, uh, own a few places down there.
Oh, you know, I should probably buy a place in the city first.
And I just got what you meant. That is a...
I'll tell you, that's a tricky one. - It's a tricky one.
Well...
Good luck.
You too.
Ahem. Okay, now, uh, remember, I'm still learning.
One, two, three, four!
You know the song. Sing along.
So?
No! - No!

We were waiting for a hot guy and an even hotter one shows up.
I know...
What?
Rachel, listen...
...if you let me have him, then I will really owe you one.
All right.
All right, Phoebe, I will let you have him.
But you owe me. You owe me big.
So which one of you lovely ladies am I gonna take to dinner, huh?
Oh, that'd be me, sir.
After you. - Okay, thank you.
Nice.
Well, you certainly own that room.
Actually, I rent the whole place.
And I just got what you meant. Thank you.
Hi. - Hey.
Oh, my God.
Aah! Jessica Lockhart! In my apartment!
I am such a huge fan. I am such a huge fan.
Well, it's nice to know that...
Monica! Monica!
That, uh... That's my roommate, Rachel.
Oh, that explains all the women's underwear.
Sure. Yeah.
Oh, my God, it's true!
Oh, my God.
Can I just ask you to do me... Aw... . Just one favor?
Certainly.
Would you slap me? Would you slap me right here in the face?
I'd love to, but my lawyer said I can't do that anymore.
All right, here we go. - Okay.
No, wait. Just one moment. Um...
You're a stupid bitch. - I really can't slap you.
My God, you're great. - Thanks for stopping by. See you.
I am so sorry about that. - Oh, no, no, no.
Being adored, I'm used to it. Don't worry about it.
Oh, my God. - What?
They sent me today's script. They never send me the script.
They don't? - Well, no, I'm in a coma.
This must mean I have lines.
Oh.
How does it happen?
Ooh.
You get thrown from a horse into an electric fence.
A what? Jessica hates horses.
I'm guessing after this she's not gonna be crazy about electricity, either.
Loosening the saddle on Mother's horse was brilliant, Fredrick.
And the electric fence, inspired.
Thank you, sweetheart.
I can't believe she's really gone.
Look around you. All of this is ours.
I don't think so.
Who are you?
What's the matter, Dina?
Don't you recognize your own...
...mother?
Cut! That was great, everybody. Thank you.
That was so wonderful!
Oh, I think that you're a better Jessica than I ever was.
Oh, no. - Of course not, but you were very good.
Heh, thanks.
Guess what? Good news. I got another job.
Great. Hey, all right! What is it?
A film in Guadalajara.
The airport?
No, that's LaGuardia.
This is Mexico. - Oh, wow.
Well, how long will you be gone?
Eight months.
That's a really long time. - Yeah, but you could come and visit me.
I bet that you could, uh, own a few places down there.
Oh, you know, I should probably buy a place in the city first.
And I just got what you meant. That is a...
I'll tell you, that's a tricky one. - It's a tricky one.
Well...
Good luck.
You too.
Ahem. Okay, now, uh, remember, I'm still learning.
One, two, three, four!
You know the song. Sing along.
So?
No! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们赶过来
sense_groups.english: So thanks for coming by, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们希望你们能帮我们 想一些婚礼上用的点子
sense_groups.english: We wanted to bounce some ideas off of you about the wedding ceremony.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？你还好吗？ - 那只是因为…
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? Are you okay? - Yeah, it's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡说了"婚礼"
sense_groups.english: Monica said "wedding."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们希望你们之中 有人能上台念些感性的文章
sense_groups.english: Uh, so we wanted to know if one of you would like to read something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想我应该也能胜任
sense_groups.english: Okay, yeah, I guess I can do that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 也能胜任？
sense_groups.english: Too?

sense_groups.chinese: 我自己想了一个点子 来庆祝你们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I kind of, ahem, have something else planned for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能告诉我们是什么点子吗？ - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Do you mind telling us what it is? - Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想把它当成是高度机密
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of keeping this one on the QT.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你是指哪个 我希望会有眨眼睛
sense_groups.english: Well, whatever it is, I hope it involves winking.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟《我日》的编剧谈过…
sense_groups.english: So I talked to one of the DOOL writers...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是《我日》？ - 《我们的日子》
sense_groups.english: What is DOOL? - Days Of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一定不相信 我演的角色就要醒过来了
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna believe it. My character is coming out of his coma!

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了 - 哇 乔伊
sense_groups.english: That's wonderful. - Wow, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是那个 我会有个新脑子
sense_groups.english: And not only that. I'm getting a new brain!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的工作跟私生活 都有了很棒的进展
sense_groups.english: So great things are happening at work and in your personal life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要换个新脑子？
sense_groups.english: What do you mean you're getting a new brain?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要踢走剧中一个角色…
sense_groups.english: They're killing off one of the characters, and when she dies...

sense_groups.chinese: 将她的脑子移植到我的身体里
sense_groups.english: ...and her brain is being transplanted into my body.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？脑部移植手术？
sense_groups.english: Heh, what? A brain transplant?

sense_groups.chinese: 这太可笑了
sense_groups.english: It's ridiculous.

sense_groups.chinese: 可笑的是你三个半月没有做过爱
sense_groups.english: I think it's ridiculous that you haven't had sex in three and a half months.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是冬天 街上的人少了很多
sense_groups.english: It's winter. There are fewer people on the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要踢走谁？
sense_groups.english: Who are they killing off?

sense_groups.chinese: 西西雅梦露 她饰演洁西卡拉哈特
sense_groups.english: Uh, Cecilia Monroe. She plays Jessica Lockhart.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不
sense_groups.english: No! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 她最擅长将饮料泼到别人脸上
sense_groups.english: She is so good at throwing drinks in people's faces.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没看过她喝完一杯饮料
sense_groups.english: I don't think I've ever seen her finish a beverage.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有她打人巴掌的样子 你不想那么做吗？
sense_groups.english: The way she slaps people. Wouldn't you love to do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 别那么做
sense_groups.english: Don't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她参与这出戏的演出很久了
sense_groups.english: And she's been on the show forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 要代替她一定很难 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be really hard to fill her shoes. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得帮帮我
sense_groups.english: Help me out here. When you...

sense_groups.chinese: 当你做过脑部移植手术后…
sense_groups.english: When you come out of the "brain transplant"...

sense_groups.chinese: 你要变成她？
sense_groups.english: ...you are going to be her?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她被困在德瑞克的身体里
sense_groups.english: Yes, but in Drake Ramoray's body.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么就是搞不懂？ 我还以为你是科学家
sense_groups.english: Why is this so hard for you to get? I thought you were a scientist.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 那边那个男的…
sense_groups.english: Rach, so that guy there

sense_groups.chinese: 是异性恋还是同性恋？
sense_groups.english: Straight or gay?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他太帅了 不可能是异性恋
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, he's too cute to be straight. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 大波霸小姐会帮我们查个清楚
sense_groups.english: Ooh, Knockers will help us figure it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 他是异性恋
sense_groups.english: All right, straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且一眼就看得出来
sense_groups.english: And not subtle.

sense_groups.chinese: 他忘了拿手机 - 哦？
sense_groups.english: He left his cell phone. - Oh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得把它交给阿甘 放在失物招领处
sense_groups.english: We could hand it to Gunther, he'll put it in lost and found.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是用它打电话到中国 看看那些人在做什么
sense_groups.english: Or we could use it to call China, see how those guys are doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他打电话来找手机 我接了电话…
sense_groups.english: What if, uh, he calls his own cell phone to find out who found it, and I answer...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开始聊天 之后坠入爱河呢？
sense_groups.english: ...and we start talking and we fell in love?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个很棒的故事吧？
sense_groups.english: Wouldn't that be a great story?

sense_groups.chinese: 就像是数字时代的童话故事 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Kind of like a fairy tale for the digital age. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那听起来很棒 我要去拿手机
sense_groups.english: That does sound great. I'm gonna get the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？等一下 为什么你会成为故事的女主角？
sense_groups.english: What? Wait. Why do you get the story?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经很久没有约会了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I haven't been out on a date in so long.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 三天前你才约过会
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you had a date three days ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是约会 那只是 朋友聚会 然后做爱
sense_groups.english: That wasn't a date. That was friends getting together and having sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我去拿手机
sense_groups.english: Okay. Great. See, I get the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 一星期前你才跟泰格分手
sense_groups.english: No way. You just broke up with Tag a week ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 直到现在 我才明白 我能再爱一次
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and until now, I didn't think I would love again.

sense_groups.chinese: 说的好 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Nice try. - Hey, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么公平地决定 谁能拿走手机呢？
sense_groups.english: How do we fairly decide who gets the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Well, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以…
sense_groups.english: Maybe we could, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你动作太慢了
sense_groups.english: Ah-ha! Too slow! Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太自大了
sense_groups.english: Ah-ha! Too cocky.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在跟他约会 你管不了
sense_groups.english: I'm going to date him. There's nothing you can do.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我管得了
sense_groups.english: Yes, there is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么做？杀了他吗？ 就像你杀了查尔斯？
sense_groups.english: What, are you going to kill him like you did Charles?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡
sense_groups.english: Cut!

sense_groups.chinese: 你演得太好了 刚刚那一巴掌 很逼真 你怎么办到的？
sense_groups.english: That was a great scene. And that slap looked so real. How do you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是多年的经验 - 快拿冰块过来给我
sense_groups.english: Oh, just years of experience. - Can I get some ice here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想说我觉得你的演技很棒
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I just wanted to say how wonderful I think you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该不会是那个快死掉的影迷吧？
sense_groups.english: You're not the fan who's dying, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊崔比亚尼 昨天我们合拍过一场戏
sense_groups.english: No, uh, I'm Joey Tribbiani. We did a scene together yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是那个昏迷的人 - 那是真人？
sense_groups.english: I'm the guy in the coma. - Oh, that was a real person?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你离开后我要移植你的脑子…
sense_groups.english: I wanted to say, since I'm getting your brain when you leave the show...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想如果… - 我要离开？
sense_groups.english: ...I was wondering if there was any tips... - I'm leaving the show?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 为什么？你听到了什么？
sense_groups.english: I don't know, why? Did you hear something?

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁告诉你的？- 那个…
sense_groups.english: Who told you that? - Oh, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 编剧之一 - 哪个编剧？是秃头佬还是高个子？
sense_groups.english: One of the writers. - Which? Was it bald or was it tall?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不重要 因为那不是真的
sense_groups.english: You know, it doesn't matter, because it is not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Whoo, eh.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果那是真的 你竟然敢来叫我教你…
sense_groups.english: And if it were true, how dare you come to me and ask me for tips...

sense_groups.chinese: 该如何饰演我演了二十年的角色
sense_groups.english: ...about a character I've been playing for 20 years!

sense_groups.chinese: 梦露小姐…喔 你真的那么做了
sense_groups.english: Miss Monroe... Oh, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听着 我有个点子
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, I have an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不看看 他的速拨键记录了哪些电话号码…
sense_groups.english: Why don't we see what kind of numbers he has on his speed dial?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他有最多共通点的人
sense_groups.english: And then from that, we can tell who has more in common with him...

sense_groups.chinese: 就可以把手机拿走
sense_groups.english: ...and whoever does gets the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine. All right. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 速拨键的第一个名字是"妈妈" - 哦
sense_groups.english: First name on the speed dial is "Mom." - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我妈妈自杀死了
sense_groups.english: I lost my mom to suicide.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 你不能利用那一点
sense_groups.english: Okay, no way.

sense_groups.chinese: 抢走帅哥跟最后一块蓝莓松饼
sense_groups.english: You can't use that to get the cute guy and the last muffin.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我已经用过那个借口了？对不起
sense_groups.english: Did I use that already today? I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 班 卡洛斯 大卫…
sense_groups.english: "Ben, Carlos, David..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我赢了 他在速拨键里记下了巴尼斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, I win. He's got Barney's on his speed dial.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道他指的是不是巴尼斯服饰店
sense_groups.english: So? You don't know that it's Barney's the store.

sense_groups.chinese: 那可能是他朋友家或是酒吧的电话…
sense_groups.english: That could be his friend's house, or a bar, or...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会把巴尼斯服饰店的电话 记录成速拨键？
sense_groups.english: Who has Barney's the store on their speed dial?

sense_groups.chinese: 他的新女朋友
sense_groups.english: His new girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么声音？
sense_groups.english: What is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是快死掉的猫在举行游行
sense_groups.english: I think it's the Dying Cat Parade.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来是从对街传来的
sense_groups.english: Sounds like it's coming from across the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得罗斯说他要在 婚礼上给我们惊喜吗？
sense_groups.english: The thing that Ross was gonna do at our wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟我出去混时说 "你有苏格兰的血统吧？"
sense_groups.english: He was hanging out with me yesterday and he said, "You're half Scottish, right?"

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不可能 不可能是罗斯
sense_groups.english: No. There is no way. It cannot be Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 为什么你有苏格兰血统？
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable. Why is your family Scottish?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么罗斯是你哥哥？
sense_groups.english: Why is your family Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不能在婚礼上演奏 大家都会跑光的
sense_groups.english: He cannot play at our wedding. Everyone will leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 那只是噪音
sense_groups.english: I mean, come on. That is just noise!

sense_groups.chinese: 那根本不算是歌
sense_groups.english: It's not even a song.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 如果你仔细听…
sense_groups.english: Wait. If you listen very carefully, I think...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想它是库尔 与伙伴合唱团唱的《庆祝》
sense_groups.english: ...it's "Celebration" by Kool and the Gang.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 他们要将我踢出这出戏
sense_groups.english: You're absolutely right. They are writing me out of the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还没有决定 什么时候 但应该很快…
sense_groups.english: They don't know exactly when it's going to happen, but apparently it's soon...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这样了
sense_groups.english: ...and then that's it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 如果我可以决定 你永远都不会离开这出戏
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. If it was up to me, you would never leave the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 我是认真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, thanks. - No, I mean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信他们会对你这么做 还有你的影迷
sense_groups.english: I can't believe they'd do this to you. And to your fans.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一定会崩溃伤心 他们是那么地爱你
sense_groups.english: They're gonna be devastated. Heartbroken. They love you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: What's your name again?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Joey. - Joey. Well, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太贴心了
sense_groups.english: That is so sweet. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 之前我会来找你
sense_groups.english: The... The only reason I came up to you before...

sense_groups.chinese: 是因为…
sense_groups.english: ...was because, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为要饰演你我真的很紧张
sense_groups.english: ...because I'm really nervous about being you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你帮我抓住角色的精髓
sense_groups.english: You know, if you could help me capture the essence of the character.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮助我让洁西卡 继续活下去 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: Help me keep Jessica alive. Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 乔伊 我会帮你
sense_groups.english: All right, Joey, I will help you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是因为我对这出蠢戏有亏欠…
sense_groups.english: Not because I owe it to this stupid show...

sense_groups.chinese: 而是因为我亏欠洁西卡
sense_groups.english: ...but because I owe it to Jessica.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了 谢谢你 - 别客气
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. Thank you so much. - You're so welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在观摩录影带 你觉得这招如何？
sense_groups.english: I've been watching some tapes. How's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 洁西卡拉哈特 永远都不会再踏入这里
sense_groups.english: Jessica Lockhart will never step foot in this place again!

sense_groups.chinese: 永远都不会
sense_groups.english: Ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 但洁西卡没有英国腔
sense_groups.english: Oh, but, Jessica doesn't have an English accent.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有英国腔？
sense_groups.english: I can do an English accent?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把这点写在我的履历表里
sense_groups.english: That baby's going on my resume.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你好吗？ - 我很好
sense_groups.english: Hi, Pheebs. How are you? - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得我们在咖啡厅时…
sense_groups.english: Um, Phoebe, remember when we were in the coffeehouse...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们决定我可以 拿走那个帅哥的手机吗？
sense_groups.english: ...we decided I was gonna keep the cute guy's phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 我要把它放在我的皮包里
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - And I was gonna keep it in my purse...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果它响了 我就能立刻接听？
sense_groups.english: ...so if it rang, I could just pick it up?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得你从我的皮包 把手机偷走了吗？
sense_groups.english: And then do you remember going into my purse and stealing the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 我听不懂你在说什么
sense_groups.english: Ooh, now you lost me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你偷走了手机 - 不 我没有
sense_groups.english: You stole the phone. - No, I didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我拨号过去它不会响吗？
sense_groups.english: No? So you're saying that if I called it, it wouldn't ring?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: No. - Hmm. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然你要拨号了 我要让你看看 我刚买的响铃皮包
sense_groups.english: But while you dial, let me show you the features of my new ringing handbag.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 它真的有用
sense_groups.english: Oh, it does work.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 那是另一只手机
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - That is a different phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？喂 对 你好 瑞秋在吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, is it? Hello. Yes, hi. Is Rachel there?

sense_groups.chinese: 她在 请稍等 是找我的
sense_groups.english: Yes, she is. Just one moment, please. It's for me!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是铁证
sense_groups.english: That is damning evidence.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我敢说是他打来的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I bet that's him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的数字童话故事就要开始了
sense_groups.english: My digital fairy tale's about to begin.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是…
sense_groups.english: It's ri...

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能别再那么做了？
sense_groups.english: Would you stop doing that?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 对 我就是捡到你手机的人
sense_groups.english: Hello? Yes, I'm the one who found your phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你不能… - 我在讲电话
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you can't do th... - Shh, I'm on a call.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 今晚你能过来拿 就八点半吧？
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, I mean, you could pick it up tonight. Say, 8:30?

sense_groups.chinese: 到我家来
sense_groups.english: At my apartment. It's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩顿街五号 十四号房
sense_groups.english: It's, um, 5 Morton Street, apartment 14.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许之后我们可以去吃点东西
sense_groups.english: And then maybe, you know, after, we could grab a bite to eat or whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 到时候见 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, I'll see you then. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他来的时候我会在这里
sense_groups.english: You do know that I will be here when he comes over.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道他什么时候会来？
sense_groups.english: Oh, and how will you know what time to come over?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚说出来了
sense_groups.english: You just said it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个角色的精髓源自于她的自信
sense_groups.english: Joey, the essence of the character is rooted in her confidence.

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说 当洁西卡走进一个房间时…
sense_groups.english: So when Jessica enters a room, for instance...

sense_groups.chinese: 她拥有那个房间里…
sense_groups.english: ...she owns everything...

sense_groups.chinese: 所有事物跟所有人
sense_groups.english: ...and every person in that room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来试试看 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: You try it. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有对这个房间生气
sense_groups.english: Right. Well, he's not mad at the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 再试一次 他拥有它 他拥有这个房间
sense_groups.english: Try it again. He owns it. He owns the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是他的 他拥有 这个房间 他拥有它
sense_groups.english: It is his. He owns, owns, owns the room! He owns it!

sense_groups.chinese: 这有点奇怪 但已经好多了
sense_groups.english: It's a little weird, but it's getting better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会很想念这个女人 我不知道我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm gonna miss this woman so much. I don't know what I'm gonna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我演这出戏二十年了
sense_groups.english: It's been 20 years of my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许 或许… 这是件好事
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. Maybe... Maybe, uh... Maybe this is a good thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 它给你机会做改变 扮演不一样的角色
sense_groups.english: You know? Lt'll give you a chance to shake things up. Play different characters.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才华洋溢
sense_groups.english: You're so talented.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该在几年前离开 那时很多人要我接戏…
sense_groups.english: Probably should've just left years ago when the offers were pouring in...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我在这里过得太舒服…
sense_groups.english: ...but, you know, I just got so comfy here and...

sense_groups.chinese: 我拒绝了一些大好机会
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I turned down some amazing work.

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说呢？- 呃
sense_groups.english: Like what? - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 就说如果我在十五年前离开…
sense_groups.english: ...let's just say if I'd left 15 years ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在的墨西哥影坛会完全不一样
sense_groups.english: ...the landscape of Mexican cinema would be very different today.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在…现在时机不一样了
sense_groups.english: But, well, now... Now's a different time for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 别这样
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, come on. Don't, uh... Don't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说句话 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Let me tell you something, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 当我看到你演戏时 我想"天啊 她是个很棒的演员"
sense_groups.english: When I watch you do a scene, I'm thinking, "Boy, she is a great actress."

sense_groups.chinese: 但我也会想"她好辣"
sense_groups.english: But... But I'm also thinking, "She is hot."

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我很辣？
sense_groups.english: You think I'm hot?

sense_groups.chinese: 你拥有这个房间
sense_groups.english: You own the room.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们应该…
sense_groups.english: We... We should probably get the...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们应该…
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Yeah, we should get...

sense_groups.chinese: 当洁西卡吻男人时…
sense_groups.english: So when Jessica kisses a man...

sense_groups.chinese: 她通常会把…
sense_groups.english: ...she usually puts, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 双手放在那个男人脸上
sense_groups.english: ...both her hands on the man's face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我注意到了 那是因为她 充满了热情吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I notice that. Is that because she's so passionate?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是因为 那样子摄影机只能拍到她
sense_groups.english: No, it's because that way the camera only sees her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想试试看吗？
sense_groups.english: You want to try it?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 真的很不错
sense_groups.english: That was good. That was really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想你手的位置不对
sense_groups.english: But I think that maybe your hands are just a little off.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们应该… - 呃
sense_groups.english: They should be, maybe... Like, right... - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想吃点点心
sense_groups.english: Well, I feel like a snack.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要吃点脆饼吗？ 它是你故乡苏格兰的点心
sense_groups.english: Do you want some shortbread? It's Scottish, like you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢 我不喜欢苏格兰的东西
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, thanks. I don't like anything from my Scottish heritage.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我的家族被赶出苏格兰…
sense_groups.english: Well, it's just that my entire family was run out of Scotland by...

sense_groups.chinese: 是维京人干的
sense_groups.english: ...Vikings.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来你家人 准备要恢复苏格兰传统
sense_groups.english: It sounds to me like your family's ready to, uh, rediscover its Scottish roots.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能在婚礼上吹风笛
sense_groups.english: You can't play bagpipes at the wedding!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么知道？
sense_groups.english: How did you know about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们听到你在家里吹风笛
sense_groups.english: We heard you play all the way from your apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你们去报警的？
sense_groups.english: Were you the ones who called the cops?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在那真的不重要
sense_groups.english: That's not really important right now. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 重要的是 我们谢谢你的好意…
sense_groups.english: What is important is, while we appreciate the gesture...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是觉得 我们的婚礼上不适合吹风笛
sense_groups.english: ...we just don't feel that bagpipes are appropriate for our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为我们讨厌风笛
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because we hate them.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我机会为你们表演 再做最后的决定
sense_groups.english: Just give me a chance to perform for you, and then decide whatever you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不会告诉你们 我要吹哪首曲子
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna tell you what song I'm gonna play, either. But, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 就说当表演结束后…
sense_groups.english: ...let's just say when it's over...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一定会庆祝一下
sense_groups.english: ...I'll bet there'll be a wee bit o' celebration.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是汤姆
sense_groups.english: Hi, It's Tom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来拿手机的 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I'm here to pick up the phone. - Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么要由你去开门？
sense_groups.english: Whoa, why do you get to answer the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不行？ - 因为这里是我家
sense_groups.english: Why shouldn't I? - Because it's my apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么由我来把手机交给他
sense_groups.english: Well, then I get to give him the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 希望你能好好 跟他解释那些打到中国的电话
sense_groups.english: Okay. Good luck explaining all the calls to China.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们争执了多久？
sense_groups.english: Wow, how long were we arguing for?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Um, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是那个忘了拿手机的人
sense_groups.english: You're not the man who left the cell phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是我的助理 - 他会来吗？
sense_groups.english: No, that's my assistant. - Is he coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: Um, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能让我们谈一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you, uh, give us one second?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 我们马上回来
sense_groups.english: Sure. - We'll be right back, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Well, what do we do? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在等一个帅哥 结果来了一个超级大帅哥
sense_groups.english: We were waiting for a hot guy and an even hotter one shows up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 听我说…
sense_groups.english: Rachel, listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你能把他让给我 我真的欠你一个大人情
sense_groups.english: ...if you let me have him, then I will really owe you one.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我把他让给你
sense_groups.english: All right, Phoebe, I will let you have him.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你欠我一个大人情
sense_groups.english: But you owe me. You owe me big.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一位漂亮的小姐要陪我去吃晚餐？
sense_groups.english: So which one of you lovely ladies am I gonna take to dinner, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我
sense_groups.english: Oh, that'd be me, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 请 - 哦 谢谢
sense_groups.english: After you. - Okay, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的确拥有那个房间
sense_groups.english: Well, you certainly own that room.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我租下整间公寓
sense_groups.english: Actually, I rent the whole place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解你的意思 谢谢夸奖
sense_groups.english: And I just got what you meant. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 洁西卡拉哈特 在我家里面
sense_groups.english: Aah! Jessica Lockhart! In my apartment!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是你的头号大影迷 我是你的头号大影迷
sense_groups.english: I am such a huge fan. I am such a huge fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能知道…
sense_groups.english: Well, it's nice to know that...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica! Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的室友瑞秋
sense_groups.english: That, uh... That's my roommate, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪你家会有女人内衣
sense_groups.english: Oh, that explains all the women's underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Sure. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 是真的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, it's true!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能请你帮我… 一个忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I just ask you to do me... Aw... . Just one favor?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Certainly.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能打我一巴掌吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you slap me? Would you slap me right here in the face?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很愿意 但我的律师说 我不能再那么做了
sense_groups.english: I'd love to, but my lawyer said I can't do that anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们走吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, here we go. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等等
sense_groups.english: No, wait. Just one moment. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你个蠢贱人 - 我真的恨不得一巴掌打死你
sense_groups.english: You're a stupid bitch. - I really can't slap you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你真了不起 - 多谢阻止 再见
sense_groups.english: My God, you're great. - Thanks for stopping by. See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 - 不
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry about that. - Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我习惯被影迷包围 别担心
sense_groups.english: Being adored, I'm used to it. Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们寄了今天的剧本来给我 他们从来没有寄剧本给过我
sense_groups.english: They sent me today's script. They never send me the script.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 我一直都昏迷不醒
sense_groups.english: They don't? - Well, no, I'm in a coma.

sense_groups.chinese: 这代表我有台词了
sense_groups.english: This must mean I have lines.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是怎么死的？
sense_groups.english: How does it happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你摔下马 然后撞到电篱笆
sense_groups.english: You get thrown from a horse into an electric fence.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？洁西卡讨厌马
sense_groups.english: A what? Jessica hates horses.

sense_groups.chinese: 经过这件事 她也不会喜欢电
sense_groups.english: I'm guessing after this she's not gonna be crazy about electricity, either.

sense_groups.chinese: 在妈妈的马鞍上动手脚 是个超级好点子 佛莱德克
sense_groups.english: Loosening the saddle on Mother's horse was brilliant, Fredrick.

sense_groups.chinese: 电篱笆那个点子太妙了
sense_groups.english: And the electric fence, inspired.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Thank you, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信她真的死了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe she's really gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你的四周 一切都是你的
sense_groups.english: Look around you. All of this is ours.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不那么认为
sense_groups.english: I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？笛娜
sense_groups.english: What's the matter, Dina?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不认得你自己的…
sense_groups.english: Don't you recognize your own...

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈吗？
sense_groups.english: ...mother?

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 大家都演得很好 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Cut! That was great, everybody. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: That was so wonderful!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你比我更适合演洁西卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, I think that you're a better Jessica than I ever was.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不 - 当然不是 但你真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - Of course not, but you were very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Heh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 好消息 我找到新工作了
sense_groups.english: Guess what? Good news. I got another job.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 是什么样的工作
sense_groups.english: Great. Hey, all right! What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要到瓜达拉哈拉拍电影
sense_groups.english: A film in Guadalajara.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指那个机场？
sense_groups.english: The airport?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是拉瓜迪亚机场
sense_groups.english: No, that's LaGuardia.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去墨西哥 - 哇
sense_groups.english: This is Mexico. - Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会去多久？
sense_groups.english: Well, how long will you be gone?

sense_groups.chinese: 八个月
sense_groups.english: Eight months.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很久 - 对 但你可以来看我
sense_groups.english: That's a really long time. - Yeah, but you could come and visit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说你能在那里拥有几个地方
sense_groups.english: I bet that you could, uh, own a few places down there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 或许我该先在纽约买房子
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, I should probably buy a place in the city first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚了解你的意思 那…
sense_groups.english: And I just got what you meant. That is a...

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的有难度 - 真的很难
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you, that's a tricky one. - It's a tricky one.

sense_groups.chinese: 那
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是
sense_groups.english: You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 请记住 我还在学吹风笛
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Okay, now, uh, remember, I'm still learning.

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三 四
sense_groups.english: One, two, three, four!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都知道这首歌 一起唱吧
sense_groups.english: You know the song. Sing along.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: So?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不
sense_groups.english: No! - No!

questions.name: S07E16
questions.en:
Hi. - Hi! Hi, Ben.
Hi. - We have a bathroom emergency.
Oh, yeah. Go ahead. - Okay, uh, before we do...
...uh, are any of Joey's special romance magazines in there?
No. - Okay, all clear.
Thanks, Phoebe.
That's Rachel.
But whatever. - Mm-hm.
Could you do me a big favor?
The, uh, dean's office called and said there was an urgent meeting.
Can you watch Ben for an hour?
Well, what about Monica? - Uh, she isn't home.
So it would just be me alone?
Well, Ben would be there. - No...
Huh. Um...
What's the matter? - Well, uh, you know, it's just, uh...
I've never done that before. Me and him, alone.
He's not an ex-con.
Okay, okay, okay. Um...
What do I do with him? - I don't know, talk to him.
Entertain him. Keep him alive.
Okay. - Okay, Ben, come here.
I'm gonna leave you here with Aunt Rachel for about an hour, okay?
Gonna be okay?
I think so. - I wasn't talking to you.
What about the second minister? I kind of liked him.
You mean the spitter? - Come on. He wasn't that bad.
Easy for you to say, you'd be wearing a veil.
And the third guy? - He kept staring at your chest.
Can you blame him?

sense_groups.english: I need... I don't know what I need. I need a walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 钱德 没有什么大不了的 - 对我是
sense_groups.english: Wait, Chandler, it's not a big deal. - It is to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想和蝙蝠侠上床 结果被罗宾打断了
sense_groups.english: You wanted to sleep with Batman and settled for Robin.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太疯狂了 - 不 罗宾是同性恋
sense_groups.english: This is crazy. - No, Robin is so gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都同意了？ - 不再恶作剧
sense_groups.english: So now what have we agreed? - No more pranks.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有呢？ - 你和爸爸不是想分开一下
sense_groups.english: What else? - You and Daddy were not on a break.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Very good.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你在这里干什么？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜访我的好朋友卡萝
sense_groups.english: I'm just visiting my good friend Carol.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的好朋友？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Your good friend? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她姓什么？
sense_groups.english: What's her last name?

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝…
sense_groups.english: Carol...

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋 - 很好
sense_groups.english: ...Lesbian. - Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我脸上那条线…
sense_groups.english: By the way, that, uh... That line down my face...

sense_groups.chinese: 在今天最后一堂课 让一个学生说…
sense_groups.english: The line that prompted a student in my last class of the day to say

sense_groups.chinese: "老兄 你从来不洗脸吗？"的那条线
sense_groups.english: "Dude, don't you ever wash your face?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉没有告诉你
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I didn't tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要你再教我儿子那些东西
sense_groups.english: I don't want you teaching my son that stuff anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？ - 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay? - Fine. Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一教他那些东西 他叫我"好玩的瑞秋阿姨"
sense_groups.english: Once I taught him that stuff, he called me "fun Aunt Rachel."

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢做好玩的瑞秋阿姨
sense_groups.english: And I loved being fun Aunt Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你们能建立感情 但…
sense_groups.english: I'm glad you guys were bonding but...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 他没有任何兄弟姊妹
sense_groups.english: Look, he doesn't have any siblings.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人得教他这些东西
sense_groups.english: Somebody has to teach him this stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有教他任何 正常6岁小孩不知道的事
sense_groups.english: I haven't taught him anything a normal 6-year-old doesn't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 好烂 - 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Crap! - I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要这个司康吗？是给我的 但它比较想和你睡
sense_groups.english: You want this scone? It came for me but it would rather sleep with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么都没发生
sense_groups.english: Nothing even happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只不要你生气
sense_groups.english: I just... I don't want you to be upset.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能不生气？
sense_groups.english: How can I not be upset?

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于和这个很棒的女人坠入爱河…
sense_groups.english: I finally fall in love with this fantastic woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 而她最初要的是你
sense_groups.english: ...and it turns out she wanted you first.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 某一个晚上的半小时
sense_groups.english: Yeah, for like a half an hour one night.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 她要和你共渡一生
sense_groups.english: Chandler, she wants you for the rest of her life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们看着你们 看到你们 在一起 就是…
sense_groups.english: We look at you and we see you together, and it just...

sense_groups.chinese: 很配 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: It fits, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是知道能持续终生
sense_groups.english: And you just know it's gonna last forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是你该讲的
sense_groups.english: That's what you should say.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你替我们证婚时 那就是你该说的
sense_groups.english: When you're marrying us, that's what you should say.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？我可以替你们证婚吗？
sense_groups.english: Really? I could do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你替我证婚
sense_groups.english: I'd love you to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过那些是你的演讲 一模一样的
sense_groups.english: But those are the words. Those exact words.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不太记得了…
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't remember exactly...

sense_groups.chinese: 是关于拥有和付出和分享和接受
sense_groups.english: ...but it's pretty much about having and giving and sharing and receiving.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个没事了？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: So you guys doing okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们谈过了 摩妮卡让我 知道我反应过度了
sense_groups.english: We talked and Monica made me see that I overreacted a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些事是比较重要的 - 是啊 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Some things are more important. - Yeah, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴你们没事了 但我一直在想…
sense_groups.english: I'm really glad you guys are okay, but I just keep thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们两个在一起会是什么样子
sense_groups.english: ...what would've happened if you two had hooked up.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 晚饭好了
sense_groups.english: Honey, dinner's ready!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小厨师今晚替我做了什么？
sense_groups.english: What's my little chef got for me tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 你最喜欢的 - 哦 哦 哦
sense_groups.english: Your favorite. - Ho, ho, ho.

sense_groups.chinese: 起司杂炒
sense_groups.english: Fried stuff with cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多很多
sense_groups.english: And lots of it!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 甜心
sense_groups.english: Thanks, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 来亲一个…
sense_groups.english: Give me a little sugar. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要…
sense_groups.english: You wanna go...?

sense_groups.chinese: 来 来 来
sense_groups.english: Here we go, here we go, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还可以吗？
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉要再麻烦你一次 你可以替我照顾一下小班吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry to do this again, but could you look after Ben for a bit?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在学校有个会要开
sense_groups.english: I've got this meeting at school...

sense_groups.chinese: 他说要找"好玩的瑞秋阿姨"
sense_groups.english: ...and he asked for his "fun Aunt Rachel."

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Well, of course I will watch him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会很开心的 是不是 小班？
sense_groups.english: We have fun, don't we, Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 待会见 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. See you later, pal. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 小班 我不能这么做
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Ben, I can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你背后有东西 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You got something on your back. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好极了
sense_groups.english: That's great. That is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 我们才说完什么？
sense_groups.english: What did we just finish talking about, Ben?

sense_groups.chinese: "小班 我们才说完什么？"
sense_groups.english: "What did we just finish talking about, Ben?"

sense_groups.chinese: 好 够了 过来
sense_groups.english: That's it! Come here!

sense_groups.chinese: 年轻人 你麻烦大了 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: You're in big trouble, young man! - No, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班 过来 我不是开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: Ben, come here! I am not kidding!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要停止…
sense_groups.english: You guys, hold it. Seriously...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

questions.name: S07E17
questions.en:
The caterer sent me this list of 12 appetizers. I have to narrow it to six.
Food? Oh, give me.
So did Monica tell you we're trying to get The Swing Kings to play the wedding?
Since when are you into swing music?
Since forever. I used to go all over town listening to bands.
Chandler. - Gap commercial.
So did you book them? Did you call? - I will.
You want me to call? - No. I'll do it. You stick to your job.
What is your job? - Staying out of the way.
This is impossible. Why don't you just pick all 15?
There were only 12. - Oh, yeah, I added three.
What are "peanut-butter fingers"?
Well, hello.
She's cute.
Should we go try to talk to her?
Sure. The great thing about being engaged, I'm not nervous to talk to pretty girls anymore.
Could you guys help me?
Yeah, let me get that for you.
It's really heavy. - I got it.
Oh!
So hi, I'm Ross, and this is my friend, Chandler.
I'm Kristen.
Kristen. Hi. Are you new to the area?
Because if you are, I'd love to show you around sometime.
I actually just moved from four blocks over. - Oh.
But this block is like a whole other world.
Actually, it does have a very interesting history.
This street is the first street in the city to have an underground sewer system.
Before that, sewage and waste...
...would just flow right down the street. Yeah.
Sometimes ankle-deep.
Smooth.
Excuse me?
You're gonna be starving after moving. What do you say I take you to dinner tonight?
I'd like that. - Yeah? Great.
Let me take this up.
After you. - Oh, no. After you.
Oh, my God!
Am I crazy, or does this totally go?
Oh, my God! You look so beautiful!
Thank you, Rachel. But look at Monica!
This is it. Yeah, this is the one.
I can't believe I found it.
Wow, you look so beautiful. If I knew you, I'd cry.
I'm Monica Geller. Ball like a baby.
I'm Megan Bailey.
Have you found your dress yet? - No. These dresses are all so amazing...
...but I couldn't afford one. - No, I can't afford this either.
I'm here to figure out the one I want, then I'll get it at Kleinman's, this discount place.
Day after tomorrow, they're having a huge sale.
Thanks for the tip. - When are you getting married?
I'm not. I just like to try these on. - I do the same thing.
I'm just kidding. I'm getting married July 25th.
I'm just kidding too. Ha, ha.
I'm getting married in December.
When are you getting married? - May 15th.
Ooh. It's close. So who's your photographer?
Jeffrey. - We met with him.
Did he show you nude wedding photos? - Best Man? Wow!
I know. I almost called off my wedding. Heh, heh, heh.
Oh, who's your band? - My fiancé wants The Swing Kings.
You're lucky. My fiancé wants the heavy metal band, Carcass.
Is that spelled with a "C" or a "K"? Oh, my God, it doesn't matter, they're both great!
Oh, you know what? Don't buy that here.
Now that you know what you want, go to Kleinman's. Get it half off.
This place is so over-priced.
I own this store.
So does this come in another color, or...
Hi. You moving in or moving out?
Moving in. - Can I give you a hand?
Okay, but be careful. The guy who was helping before had to leave because he hurt his back.
Boyfriend? - No.
I'm Joey.
Kristen.
Wow. What a beautiful name.
What is it again?
Kristen. - Ah, that's it. Okay.
You live around here? - Yeah. Yeah, right down there.
Let me give you a tip.
Don't take a nap on this stoop. You could wake up without shoes.
I'll remember that. - Okay.
Listen, would you like to have dinner with me tonight?
I have plans tonight. How about tomorrow?
Sounds great. Well, where does this go?
You look strong. I'll take that, you grab one of the boxes.
Okay. Yeah.
Yeah, I'll get this one.
What's taking so long?
Come on.
So this is Brooklyn?
All right, listen up. There's usually only one dress in each size.
So when they open those doors, fan out.
This is what you're looking for. Memorize it.
When you locate the dress blow on these, all right?
Three sharp blasts. When you hear it, come running.
Okay, got it.
Here he comes!
Oh, they're pushing! - Don't be a baby!
Out of the way! - Let's go!
Hey, Rachel! Come on!
No. No, not it. Not it. Not it. Ugh.
Don't crowd me.
This is it! This is the dress! Oh, my God. It's perfect.
I'm sorry, this one's taken! Whoa!
Megan! - Monica!
You came! - Yeah!
This is my dress! - No!
Yes, it is. You saw me wearing it. - And now you'll see me buying it.
You freak!
You wouldn't even know about this place without me.
Look, you don't want to fight me. - Maybe I do. I'm pretty feisty!
I'm coming! I'm coming! - Hey!
Okay! Hey.
Oh, what do I do?!
What are you doing? Did you find the dress?
Did you find the dress?
No. You gotta get me out of here. These shoppers are crazy.
We've gotta get Monica. - You gotta hold my hand!
Oh, my God.
Excuse me! Excuse me!
Go! Go! Go!
Hey. - Go!
So, Ross, how was your date the other night?
Did you tell her about the magical ride that starts with the flush of every toilet?
Laugh all you want, but she left me a message saying she'd like to go out again.
Oh. - In fact, I'll go call her right now.
And I'll make sure and tell her my friend Chandler says...
Hey, Chandler. - Hey.
Sorry I didn't stop by last night, but I had a date.
Joe, when it's 1:00 in the morning and you don't come by? That's okay.
Check it out. It was with this really hot girl who just moved in right across the street.
Really? Right across the street? - Yeah.
When did you meet her? - Two days ago.
Excellent!
You know, Ross met somebody too. - Oh, yeah?
Hey. - How'd it go?
Great. We're going out again Saturday.
But I found out she's also seeing some other guy.
Really?
Joe, what would you do if you were in Ross' situation?
Well, I sort of am. I'm dating this girl who's also seeing another guy.
But I'm not too worried about it.
You shouldn't be. Believe me, I wouldn't want to be the guy who's up against you.
I mean, that doofus is going to lose.
So this is nice.
I wish I didn't have to go. Believe me.
But I have to.
By the way, what's the name of the girl you're dating?
Kristen Leigh. - Bye.
Well, obviously, only one of us can keep dating her.
Obviously. So how do we decide?
Well now, let's look at this objectively.
I think I should date her.
Uh-huh. Uh-huh.
Or I'm the one who dates her.
That's interesting. But check this out. I date her.
Yeah, I like that. But just to go in another direction...
Okay. This can go on for a while.
We should order some food then. - No, Joey.
Look, why don't we just let her decide, okay?
We'll each go out with her one more time.
And we'll see who she likes best.
That sounds fair.
Maybe I'll take her to that new French restaurant down the street.
Wait a second. We have to set a spending limit on the date.
I don't have the money to take her to a fancy place like that.
Well, sorry. That's what I do on dates.
All right. Well, I guess I'll just have to do what I do on dates.
So let's decide on a spending limit. - Yeah.
Uh...
And a slice...
Six dollars?
I was thinking more like a hundred. - Okay.
Can I borrow 94 dollars?
Uh.
I know. Can you hand me a tissue?
You're out of Diet Coke.
Hello?
What? You what?
You listen here, missy!
What?
That was Megan. She booked The Swing Kings on the day of our wedding...
...and said she'd only give them back for the dress!
Does that mean Carcass is available?
What am I gonna do? That's the dress! That is "the" dress!
Chandler wants the band. What do I do?
Figure out a way to talk him out of it. - How?
You're out of toilet paper!
Hey. - What's up?
I wanted to wish you good luck on your date.
Thanks. - What time are you meeting?
We have 8:00 reservations at Grand Merci Bistro.
That's in 20 minutes. You'd better get dressed.
I am dressed. - Oh, well, good.
For me.
What's this? Did you give yourself a facial?
I have an oily T-zone.
Okay, dude.
Hey, you sent Kristen flowers? - That's right.
You spent 100 dollars. That's the limit. You're screwed!
Actually, I sent the flowers before the actual date, so technically...
...technically, I didn't break any rules. Thanks for stopping by though.
That's how it's gonna be? I can break the rules too.
What are you gonna do? - I don't know.
I'm not surprised. - You won't get away with this.
You don't have much choice. - We'll see!
Bye-bye. - Yeah, bye-bye.
Hey! So just a light layer?
Yeah, just here and there.
Joey got meat sauce on the banister again.
Swing music is so out.
Phoebe, he's gotta be in the room for that to work.
What are you guys talking about?
We're talking about The Swing Kings...
...and whether they're the right way to go.
I went to a wedding where they had swing music...
...and two months later the couple divorced.
I'm not saying there's any connection here...
...but they did tell me that's why they got divorced.
But I love swing music!
But The Swing Kings?
They suck so much that people actually die at their concerts. They just stop living.
When Monica and I went to see them, we had fun.
And there's another reason.
Well, what is the other reason? - I don't want to say.
Well, you have to, because maybe it's stupid.
It's just while Monica and I were dancing to them...
...it was the first time I knew that...
...you were the woman that I wanted to dance all my dances with.
Oh, crap.
Our table will be ready in just a few minutes. - Oh, great.
Is your back feeling better? - Yeah, it's fine.
I guess, ahem, the more muscles you have...
...the more they can spasm out of control.
Kristen? - Joey!
Hi. - Hi.
What are you doing here? - I like this place.
And technically, technically, I'm not breaking any rules, so...
Well, Ross, this is Joey. Joey, Ross.
Hi. - Hi. It's nice to meet you.
I used to have a friend named Joey.
I don't anymore.
Our table will be ready in a couple minutes.
Sure! I would love to wait with you guys! Thanks!
So Joey, you look familiar.
Are you on TV or something?
Joey doesn't like to talk about it...
...but he's one of the stars of Days of Our Lives.
That's right. That's right. Don't you play a woman?
A woman in a man's body.
Much better.
So, Ross, it's funny, because you look familiar to me too.
Have you ever been married?
Yes, I have.
In fact, just the other day...
...Kris and I talked about how I've been married and have a son.
Yeah, little Eric. - That's right. Wait. No, Ben.
So you've just been married the one time then?
Well, um... - You've been married twice?
Yes. And...
...another time after that.
Boy, I'm getting hungry.
Ahem. Hey, Joey, have you ever been so hungry on a date...
...that when the girl goes to the bathroom, you eat some of her food?
You said the waiter ate my crab cake.
So, Ross, now why did that first marriage break up? Hm?
Was it because the woman was straight or because she was a lesbian?
Do you two know each other? - No.
But he seems like a guy who'd marry a woman...
...on the verge of being a lesbian and then push her over the edge.
Wait a minute! Were you on a poster for gonorrhea?
Have you ever slept in the same bed with a monkey?
Hey, you leave Marcel out of this!
Fine! You ever gotten stuck in a pair of your own leather pants?
Hey, hey! Have you ever locked yourself in a TV cabinet, VD-boy?
Monkey-lover!
Where do you think we lost her?
Probably around "gonorrhea."
Hi, honey, I'm home! - Don't come in here!
Why, do you have another boyfriend in there?
No. We only mess around at his place.
It's funny, I started it, but now it's scaring me, so could you come out here, please?
No. I'm wearing a wedding dress.
You got a wedding dress? That's great.
Yeah, but I'm not keeping it. - Then why can't I see it?
Oh. I guess you can.
But I have to return it, so you can't like it.
Okay, I promise. I'll hate it.
Wow. You look hideous.
Really?
Yeah. That's like the most ugliest dress I've ever seen.
Why do you have to return it?
Because it doesn't really fit.
Oh, by the way, I booked The Swing Kings.
Oh, that's great. Great. Thanks.
But that dress, I mean, it's like, ugh, terrible.
It makes me want to rip it right off you. - Okay.
But you can't rip it.
Well, maybe a little. - Okay.
Hey, guys, you want to look at the song list for the wedding?
Guys?
I thought you'd be gone all day.
All right, what's going on?
I'm sorry. I should probably leave you girls alone.
Laugh all you want, but in 10 minutes we'll have younger-looking skin.
Yeah. - Right there.
You know, she could use a little...
Oh, nice shot! Yeah! - Oh! Oh! Oh!

你先请 - 不 你先请
