...Kris and I talked about how I've been married and have a son.
Yeah, little Eric. - That's right. Wait. No, Ben.
So you've just been married the one time then?
Well, um... - You've been married twice?
Yes. And...
...another time after that.
Boy, I'm getting hungry.
Ahem. Hey, Joey, have you ever been so hungry on a date...
...that when the girl goes to the bathroom, you eat some of her food?
You said the waiter ate my crab cake.
So, Ross, now why did that first marriage break up? Hm?
Was it because the woman was straight or because she was a lesbian?
Do you two know each other? - No.
But he seems like a guy who'd marry a woman...
...on the verge of being a lesbian and then push her over the edge.
Wait a minute! Were you on a poster for gonorrhea?
Have you ever slept in the same bed with a monkey?
Hey, you leave Marcel out of this!
Fine! You ever gotten stuck in a pair of your own leather pants?
Hey, hey! Have you ever locked yourself in a TV cabinet, VD-boy?
Monkey-lover!
Where do you think we lost her?
Probably around "gonorrhea."
Hi, honey, I'm home! - Don't come in here!
Why, do you have another boyfriend in there?
No. We only mess around at his place.
It's funny, I started it, but now it's scaring me, so could you come out here, please?
No. I'm wearing a wedding dress.
You got a wedding dress? That's great.
Yeah, but I'm not keeping it. - Then why can't I see it?
Oh. I guess you can.
But I have to return it, so you can't like it.
Okay, I promise. I'll hate it.
Wow. You look hideous.
Really?
Yeah. That's like the most ugliest dress I've ever seen.
Why do you have to return it?
Because it doesn't really fit.
Oh, by the way, I booked The Swing Kings.
Oh, that's great. Great. Thanks.
But that dress, I mean, it's like, ugh, terrible.
It makes me want to rip it right off you. - Okay.
But you can't rip it.
Well, maybe a little. - Okay.
Hey, guys, you want to look at the song list for the wedding?
Guys?
I thought you'd be gone all day.
All right, what's going on?
I'm sorry. I should probably leave you girls alone.
Laugh all you want, but in 10 minutes we'll have younger-looking skin.
Yeah. - Right there.
You know, she could use a little...
Oh, nice shot! Yeah! - Oh! Oh! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 婚宴酒店给我十二道开胃菜清单 我得将选择范围缩小到六项
sense_groups.english: The caterer sent me this list of 12 appetizers. I have to narrow it to six.

sense_groups.chinese: 食物问题？交给我吧
sense_groups.english: Food? Oh, give me.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟你们提过我们结婚时 要请《摇摆国王》来演唱吗？
sense_groups.english: So did Monica tell you we're trying to get The Swing Kings to play the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候喜欢上摇摆音乐？
sense_groups.english: Since when are you into swing music?

sense_groups.chinese: 好久以前就喜欢了 我曾跑遍全城听乐团演奏
sense_groups.english: Since forever. I used to go all over town listening to bands.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？ - 在GAP的广告看到的
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Gap commercial.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打电话订下他们了吗？ - 我会打的
sense_groups.english: So did you book them? Did you call? - I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我打吗？ - 我会打的 你只需要做好你的工作
sense_groups.english: You want me to call? - No. I'll do it. You stick to your job.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的工作是什么？ - 别碍事
sense_groups.english: What is your job? - Staying out of the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是不可能的 你为什么不挑清单上的十五道开胃菜？
sense_groups.english: This is impossible. Why don't you just pick all 15?

sense_groups.chinese: 只有十二道而已 - 对 我加了三道
sense_groups.english: There were only 12. - Oh, yeah, I added three.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是花生酱手指？
sense_groups.english: What are "peanut-butter fingers"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Well, hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 她好可爱
sense_groups.english: She's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该跟她说话吗？
sense_groups.english: Should we go try to talk to her?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 订婚后跟美女说话 我再也不会紧张
sense_groups.english: Sure. The great thing about being engaged, I'm not nervous to talk to pretty girls anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们能过来帮帮我吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you guys help me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来帮你搬那个
sense_groups.english: Yeah, let me get that for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 它真的很重 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: It's really heavy. - I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是罗斯 他是我朋友钱德
sense_groups.english: So hi, I'm Ross, and this is my friend, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是克丽丝汀
sense_groups.english: I'm Kristen.

sense_groups.chinese: 克丽丝汀 嗨 你刚搬来吗？
sense_groups.english: Kristen. Hi. Are you new to the area?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你刚搬来这里 我可以带你四处参观一下
sense_groups.english: Because if you are, I'd love to show you around sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我从四条街外搬来这里 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I actually just moved from four blocks over. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这里好像另一个世界
sense_groups.english: But this block is like a whole other world.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上这个地区的历史非常有趣
sense_groups.english: Actually, it does have a very interesting history.

sense_groups.chinese: 这条街是纽约第一条有下水道系统的街道
sense_groups.english: This street is the first street in the city to have an underground sewer system.

sense_groups.chinese: 之前污水跟废弃物…
sense_groups.english: Before that, sewage and waste...

sense_groups.chinese: 会直接流到街上
sense_groups.english: ...would just flow right down the street. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时深及脚踝
sense_groups.english: Sometimes ankle-deep.

sense_groups.chinese: 说的好
sense_groups.english: Smooth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 搬完家后你一定会肚子饿 你想跟我一起去吃晚餐吗？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna be starving after moving. What do you say I take you to dinner tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意 - 真的？太棒了
sense_groups.english: I'd like that. - Yeah? Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你把箱子搬上去
sense_groups.english: Let me take this up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先请 - 不 你先请
sense_groups.english: After you. - Oh, no. After you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 是我疯了还是这真的很配？
sense_groups.english: Am I crazy, or does this totally go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你看起来好漂亮
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! You look so beautiful!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 瑞秋 但看看摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Rachel. But look at Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 就是它 就是这件
sense_groups.english: This is it. Yeah, this is the one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我找到它了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I found it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来好漂亮 如果我认识你 我会哭的
sense_groups.english: Wow, you look so beautiful. If I knew you, I'd cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡盖勒 尽量哭吧
sense_groups.english: I'm Monica Geller. Ball like a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是梅根巴利
sense_groups.english: I'm Megan Bailey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你找到婚纱了吗？ - 这些婚纱都很漂亮…
sense_groups.english: Have you found your dress yet? - No. These dresses are all so amazing...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我买不起 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: ...but I couldn't afford one. - No, I can't afford this either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是来这里找婚纱 然后我会到克莱门婚纱店买
sense_groups.english: I'm here to figure out the one I want, then I'll get it at Kleinman's, this discount place.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在大减价
sense_groups.english: Day after tomorrow, they're having a huge sale.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你的情报 - 你什么时候结婚？
sense_groups.english: Thanks for the tip. - When are you getting married?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有要结婚 我只是想试穿婚纱 - 我也会那么做
sense_groups.english: I'm not. I just like to try these on. - I do the same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在开玩笑 我的婚期是七月二十五日
sense_groups.english: I'm just kidding. I'm getting married July 25th.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也只是在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: I'm just kidding too. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要在十二月结婚
sense_groups.english: I'm getting married in December.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候结婚？ - 五月十五日
sense_groups.english: When are you getting married? - May 15th.

sense_groups.chinese: 已经很接近了 你请谁拍照？
sense_groups.english: Ooh. It's close. So who's your photographer?

sense_groups.chinese: 杰佛瑞 - 我们跟他谈过
sense_groups.english: Jeffrey. - We met with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他拿裸体婚纱照给你们看了吗？ - 那个伴郎吗？哇
sense_groups.english: Did he show you nude wedding photos? - Best Man? Wow!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我差点取消了婚礼
sense_groups.english: I know. I almost called off my wedding. Heh, heh, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你请了哪个乐团？ - 我未婚夫想请《摇摆国王》
sense_groups.english: Oh, who's your band? - My fiancé wants The Swing Kings.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真幸运 我未婚夫想请《尸体》 那重金属乐团
sense_groups.english: You're lucky. My fiancé wants the heavy metal band, Carcass.

sense_groups.chinese: 是"湿"体还是"尸"体？ 那不重要 他们都很棒
sense_groups.english: Is that spelled with a "C" or a "K"? Oh, my God, it doesn't matter, they're both great!

sense_groups.chinese: 别在这里买婚纱
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what? Don't buy that here.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你知道你喜欢哪一件 到克莱门婚纱店买 才半价
sense_groups.english: Now that you know what you want, go to Kleinman's. Get it half off.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里的婚纱太贵了
sense_groups.english: This place is so over-priced.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是这里的老板
sense_groups.english: I own this store.

sense_groups.chinese: 这件婚纱有别的颜色吗？还是…？
sense_groups.english: So does this come in another color, or...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你要搬进来还是搬走？
sense_groups.english: Hi. You moving in or moving out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要搬进来 - 需要我帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: Moving in. - Can I give you a hand?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但是你得小心一点 来帮我的那个人因为背痛先走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, but be careful. The guy who was helping before had to leave because he hurt his back.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是你男朋友？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: Boyfriend? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是克丽丝汀
sense_groups.english: Kristen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的名字真好听
sense_groups.english: Wow. What a beautiful name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你叫什么来着？
sense_groups.english: What is it again?

sense_groups.chinese: 克丽丝汀 - 对了
sense_groups.english: Kristen. - Ah, that's it. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你住在附近？ - 我就住在那边
sense_groups.english: You live around here? - Yeah. Yeah, right down there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得提供你一些资讯
sense_groups.english: Let me give you a tip.

sense_groups.chinese: 别在那个楼梯上睡觉 醒过来时你的鞋子可能已经被偷了
sense_groups.english: Don't take a nap on this stoop. You could wake up without shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会记住的 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I'll remember that. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 今晚你要跟我一起吃饭吗？
sense_groups.english: Listen, would you like to have dinner with me tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚我有约了 明天可以吗？
sense_groups.english: I have plans tonight. How about tomorrow?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来不错 这个要搬到哪里？
sense_groups.english: Sounds great. Well, where does this go?

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很壮 把它交给我 你去帮我搬箱子吧
sense_groups.english: You look strong. I'll take that, you grab one of the boxes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要中包这一个
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'll get this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么花这么长时间？
sense_groups.english: What's taking so long?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是的
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里就是布鲁克林？
sense_groups.english: So this is Brooklyn?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听着 通常每件婚纱 一个尺寸只有一件
sense_groups.english: All right, listen up. There's usually only one dress in each size.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一开门 马上冲进去
sense_groups.english: So when they open those doors, fan out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是你们的目标 记住它
sense_groups.english: This is what you're looking for. Memorize it.

sense_groups.chinese: 找到婚纱后就吹哨子 好吗？
sense_groups.english: When you locate the dress blow on these, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 用力吹三声 一听到哨音后 马上跑过来
sense_groups.english: Three sharp blasts. When you hear it, come running.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 知道了
sense_groups.english: Okay, got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他来了
sense_groups.english: Here he comes!

sense_groups.chinese: 她们在推我 - 别那么孩子气
sense_groups.english: Oh, they're pushing! - Don't be a baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 别挡路 - 我们冲吧
sense_groups.english: Out of the way! - Let's go!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 快一点
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel! Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是…
sense_groups.english: No. No, not it. Not it. Not it. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 别推我
sense_groups.english: Don't crowd me.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是它 就是这件婚纱 太完美了
sense_groups.english: This is it! This is the dress! Oh, my God. It's perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 这件是我的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, this one's taken! Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 梅根 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Megan! - Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 你来了 - 对
sense_groups.english: You came! - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的婚纱 - 不
sense_groups.english: This is my dress! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 它就是 你看到我试穿它 - 现在你会看到我买下它
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is. You saw me wearing it. - And now you'll see me buying it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这个怪胎
sense_groups.english: You freak!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果没有我你根本不知道这个地方
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't even know about this place without me.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你不会想跟我争 - 或许我想 我是很凶的
sense_groups.english: Look, you don't want to fight me. - Maybe I do. I'm pretty feisty!

sense_groups.chinese: 我来了… - 嘿
sense_groups.english: I'm coming! I'm coming! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 嘿
sense_groups.english: Okay! Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Oh, what do I do?!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么？你找到婚纱了吗？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? Did you find the dress?

sense_groups.chinese: 你找到婚纱了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you find the dress?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 快救我出去 这些女人都疯了
sense_groups.english: No. You gotta get me out of here. These shoppers are crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得去找摩妮卡 - 拉我一把
sense_groups.english: We've gotta get Monica. - You gotta hold my hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起…
sense_groups.english: Excuse me! Excuse me!

sense_groups.chinese: 快走…
sense_groups.english: Go! Go! Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 快走
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 那天你跟她约会还顺利吧？
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, how was your date the other night?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她提过只要一按马桶 魔法之旅就开始了吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you tell her about the magical ride that starts with the flush of every toilet?

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管笑吧 但她说她想再跟我约会
sense_groups.english: Laugh all you want, but she left me a message saying she'd like to go out again.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 事实上 我正要打电话给她
sense_groups.english: Oh. - In fact, I'll go call her right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会确定告诉她我朋友钱德说…
sense_groups.english: And I'll make sure and tell her my friend Chandler says...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉昨晚我失约了 但我有个约会
sense_groups.english: Sorry I didn't stop by last night, but I had a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你说你凌晨一点要过来 就算你放我鸽子没有关系
sense_groups.english: Joe, when it's 1:00 in the morning and you don't come by? That's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟一个辣妹约会 她刚刚搬到对街
sense_groups.english: Check it out. It was with this really hot girl who just moved in right across the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？她住在对街？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? Right across the street? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候认识她的？ - 两天前
sense_groups.english: When did you meet her? - Two days ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Excellent!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯也认识了一个女孩 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: You know, Ross met somebody too. - Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么样？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - How'd it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我们星期六要再出去玩
sense_groups.english: Great. We're going out again Saturday.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我刚刚发现她也在跟别人约会
sense_groups.english: But I found out she's also seeing some other guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果你是罗斯你会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: Joe, what would you do if you were in Ross' situation?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他差不多 跟我约会的女孩也在跟别人约会
sense_groups.english: Well, I sort of am. I'm dating this girl who's also seeing another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我一点都不担心
sense_groups.english: But I'm not too worried about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必担心 我不想当你的竞争者
sense_groups.english: You shouldn't be. Believe me, I wouldn't want to be the guy who's up against you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个混蛋一定会输的
sense_groups.english: I mean, that doofus is going to lose.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太有趣了
sense_groups.english: So this is nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望我能留下来 相信我
sense_groups.english: I wish I didn't have to go. Believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得走了
sense_groups.english: But I have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 跟你们约会的女孩 叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: By the way, what's the name of the girl you're dating?

sense_groups.chinese: 克丽丝汀莱 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Kristen Leigh. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 我们之中 只有一个人能继续跟她约会
sense_groups.english: Well, obviously, only one of us can keep dating her.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我们该怎么决定？
sense_groups.english: Obviously. So how do we decide?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们得客观地来解决这件事
sense_groups.english: Well now, let's look at this objectively.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我该跟她约会
sense_groups.english: I think I should date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是我该跟她约会
sense_groups.english: Or I'm the one who dates her.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很有趣 但是听好了 我跟她约会
sense_groups.english: That's interesting. But check this out. I date her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但是换个角度来说…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I like that. But just to go in another direction...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们是谈不出结论来的
sense_groups.english: Okay. This can go on for a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我们该点些吃的 - 不 乔伊
sense_groups.english: We should order some food then. - No, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们为什么不让她来决定呢？
sense_groups.english: Look, why don't we just let her decide, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都再跟她约会一次
sense_groups.english: We'll each go out with her one more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看她比较喜欢谁
sense_groups.english: And we'll see who she likes best.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很公平
sense_groups.english: That sounds fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我会带她 到新开的法国赛厅吃饭
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'll take her to that new French restaurant down the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我们得对约会费用设下限制
sense_groups.english: Wait a second. We have to set a spending limit on the date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有钱带她到高级餐厅吃饭
sense_groups.english: I don't have the money to take her to a fancy place like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 那是我的约会方式
sense_groups.english: Well, sorry. That's what I do on dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我得用我的约会方式
sense_groups.english: All right. Well, I guess I'll just have to do what I do on dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来决定费用限制 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: So let's decide on a spending limit. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 在加一片…
sense_groups.english: And a slice...

sense_groups.chinese: 六块钱？
sense_groups.english: Six dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是一百块 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I was thinking more like a hundred. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能借我九十四块吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I borrow 94 dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你能帮我拿张面纸吗？
sense_groups.english: I know. Can you hand me a tissue?

sense_groups.chinese: 你家没有健怡可乐了
sense_groups.english: You're out of Diet Coke.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你什么？
sense_groups.english: What? You what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我听好了 小姐
sense_groups.english: You listen here, missy!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 是梅根打来的 她订下《摇摆国王》 日期是我们结婚的那一天…
sense_groups.english: That was Megan. She booked The Swing Kings on the day of our wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 还说如果我不把婚纱让给她 我就没有乐团
sense_groups.english: ...and said she'd only give them back for the dress!

sense_groups.chinese: 那么说的话《尸体》有空了？
sense_groups.english: Does that mean Carcass is available?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办？我好喜欢那件婚纱
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? That's the dress! That is "the" dress!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德喜欢那个乐团 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Chandler wants the band. What do I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 想办法说服他放弃 - 我该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Figure out a way to talk him out of it. - How?

sense_groups.chinese: 你家的卫生纸用完了
sense_groups.english: You're out of toilet paper!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要来祝你约会顺利
sense_groups.english: I wanted to wish you good luck on your date.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 你们约几点？
sense_groups.english: Thanks. - What time are you meeting?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在葛兰梅西养厅 订了八点的位子
sense_groups.english: We have 8:00 reservations at Grand Merci Bistro.

sense_groups.chinese: 时间只剩二十分钟 你最好快去换衣服
sense_groups.english: That's in 20 minutes. You'd better get dressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经换好衣服了 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: I am dressed. - Oh, well, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说
sense_groups.english: For me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？你在敷脸？
sense_groups.english: What's this? Did you give yourself a facial?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的T字部位经常出油
sense_groups.english: I have an oily T-zone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Okay, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 你送克丽丝汀花？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Hey, you sent Kristen flowers? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你花了一百块 你把钱花光了 你完蛋了
sense_groups.english: You spent 100 dollars. That's the limit. You're screwed!

sense_groups.chinese: 我在约会前送她花 所以技术上来说…
sense_groups.english: Actually, I sent the flowers before the actual date, so technically...

sense_groups.chinese: 技术上来说 我没有犯规 谢谢你来看我
sense_groups.english: ...technically, I didn't break any rules. Thanks for stopping by though.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要那么玩？我也可以犯规
sense_groups.english: That's how it's gonna be? I can break the rules too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么办？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我一点都不讶异？ - 我不会放过你的
sense_groups.english: I'm not surprised. - You won't get away with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你没有太多选择 - 我们走着瞧
sense_groups.english: You don't have much choice. - We'll see!

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 对 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye-bye. - Yeah, bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 只要薄薄地敷一层就好？
sense_groups.english: Hey! So just a light layer?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 只要敷这里跟这里
sense_groups.english: Yeah, just here and there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊又把肉酱滴在栏杆上了
sense_groups.english: Joey got meat sauce on the banister again.

sense_groups.chinese: 摇摆音乐太落伍了
sense_groups.english: Swing music is so out.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 他得在这房间里才可以听得到
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, he's gotta be in the room for that to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们到底在说什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you guys talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在谈《摇摆国王》…
sense_groups.english: We're talking about The Swing Kings...

sense_groups.chinese: 讨论到底该不该请他们来
sense_groups.english: ...and whether they're the right way to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次我去参加 请摇摆乐团来表演的婚礼…
sense_groups.english: I went to a wedding where they had swing music...

sense_groups.chinese: 两个月后他们就离婚了
sense_groups.english: ...and two months later the couple divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说这其中有什么关系…
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying there's any connection here...

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们的确告诉我 那是他们离婚的原因
sense_groups.english: ...but they did tell me that's why they got divorced.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我喜欢摇摆音乐
sense_groups.english: But I love swing music!

sense_groups.chinese: 但《摇摆国王》？
sense_groups.english: But The Swing Kings?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们烂到有人听他们的演唱会死掉 他们就是不想活了
sense_groups.english: They suck so much that people actually die at their concerts. They just stop living.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道摩妮卡跟我 去看他们演唱时非常开心
sense_groups.english: When Monica and I went to see them, we had fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上还有一个原因
sense_groups.english: And there's another reason.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么原因？ - 我不想说
sense_groups.english: Well, what is the other reason? - I don't want to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你非说不可 或许它很愚蠢
sense_groups.english: Well, you have to, because maybe it's stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟我 随着他们的音乐起舞时…
sense_groups.english: It's just while Monica and I were dancing to them...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我第一次知道…
sense_groups.english: ...it was the first time I knew that...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是我想一辈子共舞的女人
sense_groups.english: ...you were the woman that I wanted to dance all my dances with.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的桌子马上就会准备好 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Our table will be ready in just a few minutes. - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的背好一点了吗？ - 没事了
sense_groups.english: Is your back feeling better? - Yeah, it's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜肌肉越多…
sense_groups.english: I guess, ahem, the more muscles you have...

sense_groups.chinese: 就越可能抽筋
sense_groups.english: ...the more they can spasm out of control.

sense_groups.chinese: 克丽丝汀？ - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Kristen? - Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么？ - 我喜欢这个地方
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? - I like this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 技术上来说 我没有犯规 所以…
sense_groups.english: And technically, technically, I'm not breaking any rules, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他是乔伊 乔伊 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Well, Ross, this is Joey. Joey, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 很高兴能认识你
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi. It's nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前有个朋友叫乔伊
sense_groups.english: I used to have a friend named Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他不再是我朋友
sense_groups.english: I don't anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的桌子马上就会准备好
sense_groups.english: Our table will be ready in a couple minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我想跟你们一起等 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Sure! I would love to wait with you guys! Thanks!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你看起来好眼熟
sense_groups.english: So Joey, you look familiar.

sense_groups.chinese: 你上过电视吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you on TV or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊不喜欢提这件事…
sense_groups.english: Joey doesn't like to talk about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 但他主演过《我们的日子》
sense_groups.english: ...but he's one of the stars of Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你不是演女人吗？
sense_groups.english: That's right. That's right. Don't you play a woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是被困在男人身体里的女人
sense_groups.english: A woman in a man's body.

sense_groups.chinese: 那可好多了
sense_groups.english: Much better.

sense_groups.chinese: 真有趣 因为我也觉得你很眼熟
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, it's funny, because you look familiar to me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你结过婚吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever been married?

sense_groups.chinese: 我结过婚
sense_groups.english: Yes, I have.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 前几天…
sense_groups.english: In fact, just the other day...

sense_groups.chinese: 克丽丝跟我还谈到 我结过婚 有个儿子
sense_groups.english: ...Kris and I talked about how I've been married and have a son.

sense_groups.chinese: 小艾力克 - 没错 等一下 不 是小班才对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, little Eric. - That's right. Wait. No, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只结过一次婚吗？
sense_groups.english: So you've just been married the one time then?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯… - 你结过两次婚？
sense_groups.english: Well, um... - You've been married twice?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那个…
sense_groups.english: Yes. And...

sense_groups.chinese: 之后又结了一次
sense_groups.english: ...another time after that.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我饿了
sense_groups.english: Boy, I'm getting hungry.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你曾经在约会时饿到…
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Hey, Joey, have you ever been so hungry on a date...

sense_groups.chinese: 趁女伴去上洗手间 偷吃掉她的食物吗？
sense_groups.english: ...that when the girl goes to the bathroom, you eat some of her food?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说服务生吃掉我的蟹饼
sense_groups.english: You said the waiter ate my crab cake.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你的第一段婚姻 为什么会结束？
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, now why did that first marriage break up? Hm?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你前妻是异性恋 或因为她是同性恋？
sense_groups.english: Was it because the woman was straight or because she was a lesbian?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们认识吗？ - 不认识
sense_groups.english: Do you two know each other? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是罗斯看起来像是 会跟有同性恋倾向的女人…
sense_groups.english: But he seems like a guy who'd marry a woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚后 逼得她非得出柜的男人
sense_groups.english: ...on the verge of being a lesbian and then push her over the edge.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你不是 淋病海报上的那个男的吗？
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute! Were you on a poster for gonorrhea?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟猴子同床共枕过吧？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever slept in the same bed with a monkey?

sense_groups.chinese: 别把马塞尔扯进来
sense_groups.english: Hey, you leave Marcel out of this!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你曾经被自己的牛皮裤卡住了？
sense_groups.english: Fine! You ever gotten stuck in a pair of your own leather pants?

sense_groups.chinese: 你曾经把自己锁在电视柜里吗？性病小子
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey! Have you ever locked yourself in a TV cabinet, VD-boy?

sense_groups.chinese: 猴子迷
sense_groups.english: Monkey-lover!

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她是什么时候离开的？
sense_groups.english: Where do you think we lost her?

sense_groups.chinese: 可能是淋病那一段吧
sense_groups.english: Probably around "gonorrhea."

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我回来了 - 别进来
sense_groups.english: Hi, honey, I'm home! - Don't come in here!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？你的另一个男朋友在里面？
sense_groups.english: Why, do you have another boyfriend in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们只会在他家胡搞
sense_groups.english: No. We only mess around at his place.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然是我开的头 但我开始担心了 你能出来吗？
sense_groups.english: It's funny, I started it, but now it's scaring me, so could you come out here, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我正穿着婚纱
sense_groups.english: No. I'm wearing a wedding dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 你买到婚纱了？太棒了
sense_groups.english: You got a wedding dress? That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我要把它退回去 - 那么我为什么不能看到它？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I'm not keeping it. - Then why can't I see it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜应该可以
sense_groups.english: Oh. I guess you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得把它退回去 所以你绝不能喜欢它
sense_groups.english: But I have to return it, so you can't like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我发誓我会恨它
sense_groups.english: Okay, I promise. I'll hate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你看起来好可怕
sense_groups.english: Wow. You look hideous.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是我看过最丑的婚纱
sense_groups.english: Yeah. That's like the most ugliest dress I've ever seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要把它退回去？
sense_groups.english: Why do you have to return it?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为它真的不合适
sense_groups.english: Because it doesn't really fit.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我订了《摇摆国王》
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, I booked The Swing Kings.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's great. Great. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那件婚纱可怕极了
sense_groups.english: But that dress, I mean, it's like, ugh, terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 它让我想把它从你身上扯下来 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: It makes me want to rip it right off you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不可以把它弄破
sense_groups.english: But you can't rip it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许弄破一点也没关系 - 好
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe a little. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想看看婚礼上 演唱歌曲的清单吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, you want to look at the song list for the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为你会去一整天
sense_groups.english: I thought you'd be gone all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: All right, what's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 或许我应该 让你们这些小女生独处一下
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I should probably leave you girls alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管笑吧 但十分钟后 我们的皮肤会变得又白又嫩
sense_groups.english: Laugh all you want, but in 10 minutes we'll have younger-looking skin.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 她该敷一下脸的…
sense_groups.english: You know, she could use a little...

sense_groups.chinese: 好球 太帅了 - 喔 喔 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, nice shot! Yeah! - Oh! Oh! Oh!

questions.name: S07E18
questions.en:
Hey, hey! Guys, you won't believe this!
I just got off the phone with my agent... - Oh, my God!
I'm sorry. Too soon. You go. - Okay.
I got nominated for my part on Days of Our Lives!
Oh, Joey, good for you! - Congratulations!
I can't believe you're nominated for an Emmy! - No, no.
Soap Opera Digest Award? - Nope, I'm up for a "Soapie."
Honey, is that something you're making up?
No, no, no, it's real! And it has been since 1998.
Hey, Rach, Rach. I'm up for a Soapie!
Oh, my God!
Oh, my God! That is the third most prestigious soap opera award there is!
Thank you! Well, I guess now we know who I'm taking to the awards.
Oh, stop that! Don't kid about that! Will all the stars be there?
Many are scheduled to appear.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my God. I can't go. I'll be too nervous! - Okay, I'll go.
No! You are getting married. This is all I have.
And Ernest Muhlbrat first hypothesized that the velociraptor, when threatened...
...would expand its collar and emit a high-pitched noise...
...to frighten off its predator.
Yes, Mr. Lewis?
What kind of noise?
Just a high-pitched, intimidating noise.
But like how?
Well, we... We don't know for sure.
But in my head, it sounded something like this, uh
Of course, this is just conjecture.
Ahem, okay. That's, uh... That's all for today.
Mr. Morse, can I see you for a moment?
Yes, sir?
Mr. Morse, I need to talk to you about your midterm exam.
I'm afraid I had to fail you. - Why?
Well, you need 60 percent to pass.
What'd I get? - Seven.
That's not so good.
No, no, it's not. What happened there, Ned?
Well, maybe you can cut me some slack. I'm sort of in love.
I'm sorry, but that's really not my problem.
I'm in love with you.
Well, that brings me in the loop a little.
See, that's why I did so bad on this test. I'm having a hard time concentrating.
When you're up there and you're teaching...
...and your face gets all serious...
...you look so good. When you wear that tight little turtleneck sweater...
Okay. Ned, um...
I, uh... Ha, ha. I'm your teacher. I'm sorry.
You're... You're a student.
And I... And I like women, ha, ha.
In spite of what may be written on the backs of some of these chairs.
Oh, my God.
That guy at the counter is totally checking you out.
Really?
Oh, my God, he's really cute. - Heh. Go for it.
Phoebe, I'm engaged.
I'm just saying, get his number, just in case.
But if Chandler is in an accident and can't perform sexually, you know...
...then he would want you to take a lover to satisfy the needs he can no longer fulfill.
Hi. I... - Oh.
Can I just tell you something? Um...
I'm very flattered, but, uh, I'm engaged. Ha, ha.
Wow, uh... This is kind of embarrassing.
I was actually coming over to talk to your friend.
Well, you should be embarrassed.
I thought you knew I was looking at you. - I did, but that was really fun.
"The winner is Joey Tribbiani!"
"Oh, wow.
I honestly never expected this. I, uh...
I didn't prepare a speech.
But I'd like to thank my parents, who've always been there for me.
Also like to thank my friends, Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, Rachel..."
I'm fourth? - Jeez!
Look at you with your little maple syrup award!
Maybe you don't tell anyone about this.
What? No.
It's not a big deal. I do that too, with my shampoo bottle.
Really? - Yeah.
What award are you practicing for? - Grammy.
Best New Artist. - Ooh.
Oh, hey, listen. The Soapies people called today. I also get to present an award.
Aw, that's great. - Yeah.
So you'll get on stage even if you don't win.
You... You don't think I'm gonna win? - Of course I do.
Oh.
But, you know, Favorite Returning Character is a tough category, Joey.
I mean, you're up against the guy who survived his own cremation.
Yeah. No, I know I might not win. But it's just...
I've never even been nominated before. I want it so much.
Well, and you'll probably get it.
But you should probably start practicing your "gracious-loser" face.
Like, when the cameras are on you and you wanna look disappointed...
...but also that your colleague deserved to win. Sort of like
Hey. - You know?

sense_groups.english: But if Chandler is in an accident and can't perform sexually, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 他要你找个爱人 满足他无法满足你的那部分
sense_groups.english: ...then he would want you to take a lover to satisfy the needs he can no longer fulfill.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 喔
sense_groups.english: Hi. I... - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能跟你说句话吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I just tell you something? Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的受宠若惊 但我订婚了
sense_groups.english: I'm very flattered, but, uh, I'm engaged. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦 额… 这真的是有点难堪
sense_groups.english: Wow, uh... This is kind of embarrassing.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我想跟你朋友说话
sense_groups.english: I was actually coming over to talk to your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该觉得难堪
sense_groups.english: Well, you should be embarrassed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你知道我在看你 - 我知道 但那真的很好玩
sense_groups.english: I thought you knew I was looking at you. - I did, but that was really fun.

sense_groups.chinese: "得奖的是…乔伊崔比亚尼"
sense_groups.english: "The winner is Joey Tribbiani!"

sense_groups.chinese: "哇
sense_groups.english: "Oh, wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的没想到我会得奖…
sense_groups.english: I honestly never expected this. I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有准备演讲稿…
sense_groups.english: I didn't prepare a speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要谢谢我的父母 他们一直支持着我…
sense_groups.english: But I'd like to thank my parents, who've always been there for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还要谢谢我的朋友 钱德 摩妮卡 菲比 瑞秋…"
sense_groups.english: Also like to thank my friends, Chandler, Monica, Phoebe, Rachel..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我排在第四名？ - 天啊
sense_groups.english: I'm fourth? - Jeez!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 拿着你的枫糖奖
sense_groups.english: Look at you with your little maple syrup award!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你不要告诉别人这件事
sense_groups.english: Maybe you don't tell anyone about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？别
sense_groups.english: What? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那没有什么大不了的 我也会拿着洗发精的瓶子那么做
sense_groups.english: It's not a big deal. I do that too, with my shampoo bottle.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你假装自己得了什么奖？ - 葛莱美奖
sense_groups.english: What award are you practicing for? - Grammy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是最佳新进艺人 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Best New Artist. - Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 肥皂奖的人今天打电话给我 我还得上台颁奖
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, listen. The Soapies people called today. I also get to present an award.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是太好了 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Aw, that's great. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶 所以就算你没得奖你也有机会上台
sense_groups.english: So you'll get on stage even if you don't win.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我不会得奖？ - 你当然会得奖
sense_groups.english: You... You don't think I'm gonna win? - Of course I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 但最受欢迎死而后生奖？ 那个奖的竞争很激烈
sense_groups.english: But, you know, Favorite Returning Character is a tough category, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟一个火葬了之后 还能活过来的人竞争
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're up against the guy who survived his own cremation.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我知道或许我不会得奖 只是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No, I know I might not win. But it's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有被提名过 我真的很想得奖
sense_groups.english: I've never even been nominated before. I want it so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你会得奖
sense_groups.english: Well, and you'll probably get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你应该开始练习 你的"运动家精神"表情
sense_groups.english: But you should probably start practicing your "gracious-loser" face.

sense_groups.chinese: 当摄影机拍到你时 你得表现出失望的样子
sense_groups.english: Like, when the cameras are on you and you wanna look disappointed...

sense_groups.chinese: 但也得表现出对方是 实至名归的表情 就像这样…
sense_groups.english: ...but also that your colleague deserved to win. Sort of like

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 你也假装自己没得到葛莱美奖？ - 不 我是葛莱美奖的常胜军
sense_groups.english: You practice losing at the Grammys too? - Oh, no, at the Grammys, I always win.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 理 - 嘿 你跟杰克约会还顺利吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Hey. How'd your date go with Jake?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我们一直注视着彼此
sense_groups.english: Great. We couldn't keep our eyes off each other all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 每隔一阵子他就会靠过来 摸我的头发跟脖子
sense_groups.english: Then every once in a while, he'd lean over and stroke my hair, and then touch my neck.

sense_groups.chinese: 住手 菲比 你害得我好痒
sense_groups.english: Okay, stop it. You're getting me all tingly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能想着 他要吻我了吗…？
sense_groups.english: All I could think of was, "Is he gonna kiss me? Is he?"

sense_groups.chinese: 他吻了你吗？ - 我是个淑女 绝不会泄露那种事
sense_groups.english: And did he? - I'm a lady, Monica. I don't kiss and tell.

sense_groups.chinese: 但这个吻痕说明了一切
sense_groups.english: But this hickey speaks for itself.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我知道了
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, I got it. I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的好喜欢他 感觉上像是我今天喝了十杯酒
sense_groups.english: I just like him so much that I just feel like I've had 10 drinks today.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我只喝了六杯
sense_groups.english: And I've only had six.

sense_groups.chinese: 我第一次跟钱德约会后 再也没有那样的感觉
sense_groups.english: Oh. You know, I haven't had that feeling since I first starting going out with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远都不会再有那样的感觉了 - 你的口气跟男人一模一样
sense_groups.english: Wow, I'm never gonna have that feeling again. - You sound like a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 男人会说 "我永远 都不能再跟别人上床了"
sense_groups.english: Heh. No, a guy would say, "I'm never gonna get to sleep with anyone else." Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远都不能再跟别人上床了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm never gonna sleep with anyone else!

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直忙着筹备婚礼 完全忘了我要放弃什么
sense_groups.english: I've been so busy planning the wedding, I forgot about all the things I'd be giving up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我再也不会有初吻
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm never gonna have a first kiss again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有最后的吻别
sense_groups.english: You'll have a last kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你一件事吗？ 有男人喜欢过你吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I ask you something? You ever had a guy have a crush on you?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是你要帮我打领带的原因？
sense_groups.english: Is that why you wanted to tie my tie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我班上的学生说他爱上我了
sense_groups.english: There's this kid in my class who said he's in love with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 耶
sense_groups.english: Whoa! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇什么？ - 罗斯有男朋友了
sense_groups.english: Whoa, what? - Ross has a boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有男朋友
sense_groups.english: I do... I do not have a boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我班上有个男学生暗恋我
sense_groups.english: There's a guy in one of my classes who has a crush on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 去年是伊莉莎白 现在是这个孩子…
sense_groups.english: I mean, last year, Elizabeth, now this kid...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么一回事？我散发出…
sense_groups.english: What... What... What is it? Am I giving out some kind of...

sense_groups.chinese: 性感教授的气质吗？
sense_groups.english: ...a sexy-professor vibe?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在看起来不像
sense_groups.english: Not right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是我的天生丽质 让他期中考被当掉
sense_groups.english: The point is, my natural charisma has made him fail his midterm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为那个孩子感到难过
sense_groups.english: Aw, see now I feel bad for the kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也曾经暗恋过老师 那真的很难受
sense_groups.english: I had a crush on a teacher once, and it was so hard, you know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法专心上课 每次他看着我时 我都会脸红
sense_groups.english: I couldn't concentrate and I blushed every time he looked at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得十九岁时的恋爱滋味吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, you remember what it's like to be 19 and in love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是可以放他一马 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, guess I can cut him some slack. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么忘记那个老师的？ - 我没有
sense_groups.english: How'd you get over that teacher? - I didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟他上床了
sense_groups.english: I got under him.

sense_groups.chinese: 问题解决了
sense_groups.english: Problem solved.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 菲比 - 好的 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, Phoebe. - Okay, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: All right. Bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在门边说再见 不想炫耀我们的新恋情
sense_groups.english: We said goodbye at the door so as not to flaunt our new love.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 没关系 你不必顾虑到我
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's okay. You don't have to tiptoe around me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经想过了 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I've been thinking about it, and um... You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以接受没有心动感觉的生活
sense_groups.english: I'm okay about not having that new-relationship feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经开始想你了 - 我也会想你
sense_groups.english: I miss you already! - I miss you too!

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了 但我不会拿我的幸福跟你交换
sense_groups.english: See, that's what I mean. That's great, but I wouldn't trade in what I have for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会一辈子跟钱德相守
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm gonna be with Chandler for the rest of my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 那让我觉得幸福 - 恩
sense_groups.english: That's what makes me happy. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 快坐下 我们正在谈 我们的关系有多深厚…
sense_groups.english: Hey, sweetie, come here, sit down. We were talking about how our relationship is...

sense_groups.chinese: 是那么地有意义 真的是那样 你觉得呢？
sense_groups.english: ...deep and meaningful. It really is, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 一点都没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, totally.

sense_groups.chinese: 拉一下我的手指
sense_groups.english: Pull my finger.

sense_groups.chinese: 最受欢迎死而复生男演员…
sense_groups.english: Presenting the award for Favorite Returning Male...

sense_groups.chinese: 轮到我了
sense_groups.english: This is it. This is my category!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的演讲稿带了吗？ - 带了
sense_groups.english: Got your speech? - Got my speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 运动家精神表情练习好了吗？ - 有
sense_groups.english: Got your gracious-loser face? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住 如果你得奖了 你得抱我
sense_groups.english: Now, Joey, remember, if you win, you have to hug me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我能捏你的屁股吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Can I squeeze your ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 在电视上吗？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: On TV? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 在最受欢迎死而复生 男演员奖方面被提名的有
sense_groups.english: In the category of Favorite Returning Male Character, the nominees are

sense_groups.chinese: 约翰惠勒 《综合医院》
sense_groups.english: John Wheeler from General Hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖文葛拉罕 《年少轻狂》
sense_groups.english: Gavin Graham from The Young and the Restless.

sense_groups.chinese: 唐肯哈灵顿 《热情》
sense_groups.english: Duncan Harrington from Passions.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊崔比亚尼 《我们的日子》
sense_groups.english: And Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 得奖的是
sense_groups.english: And the Soapie goes to

sense_groups.chinese: 盖文葛拉罕 《年少轻狂》
sense_groups.english: Gavin Graham from The Young and the Restless.

sense_groups.chinese: 颁发最受欢迎女配角奖的是
sense_groups.english: Presenting the Favorite Supporting Actress award

sense_groups.chinese: 演《我们的日子》的乔伊崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani from Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有在这个奖项 被提名的优秀女演员…
sense_groups.english: Any one of the brilliant actresses nominated for this award tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 得奖都是实至名归 可惜只有一个人能得奖
sense_groups.english: ...deserves to take it home. Unfortunately, only one can.

sense_groups.chinese: 最受欢迎女配角奖被提名的有
sense_groups.english: The nominees for Favorite Supporting Actress are

sense_groups.chinese: 《热情》 艾玲高菲
sense_groups.english: From Passions, Erin Goff.

sense_groups.chinese: 《一生一次》 玛丽墨琳毕雪
sense_groups.english: From One Life to Live, Mary Lauren Bishop.

sense_groups.chinese: 《我的孩子们》 莎拉蕾妮
sense_groups.english: From All My Children, Sarah Renee.

sense_groups.chinese: 《我们的日子》 洁西卡艾许丽
sense_groups.english: And from Days of Our Lives, Jessica Ashley.

sense_groups.chinese: 得奖的是
sense_groups.english: And the winner is

sense_groups.chinese: 洁西卡艾许丽 《我们的日子》
sense_groups.english: Jessica Ashley from Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 很不幸 洁西卡今晚因故无法出席…
sense_groups.english: Uh, unfortunately, Jessica couldn't be with us tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要代表她接受这个奖
sense_groups.english: ...so I'll be accepting this award on her behalf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信洁西卡…
sense_groups.english: And I'm sure that Jessica...

sense_groups.chinese: 会想谢谢我的父母…
sense_groups.english: ...would like to thank my parents...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一直都很支持我
sense_groups.english: ...who always believed in me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也感谢我的朋友
sense_groups.english: And she'd also like to thank my friends

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡 罗斯 菲比跟瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Chandler, Monica, Ross, Phoebe and Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 她就坐在那边
sense_groups.english: ...who's sitting right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我们为什么要急着离开？
sense_groups.english: Joey, why did we have to rush out of there so fast?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得赶快离开 因为…
sense_groups.english: We had to get out of there because...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看我拿了什么回家 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Look what I won! Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你偷走她的奖杯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You stole her award.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…我代表她收下它
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. I'm accepting it on her behalf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你不知道"代表"是什么意思
sense_groups.english: I don't think you know what "behalf" means.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然知道 它是个动词 意思是"我能分一半"
sense_groups.english: Sure I do. It's a verb. As in "I be half-in' it"!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 你得把它还回去 - 为何？我应该得奖的 我好想得奖
sense_groups.english: You have got to take this back. - Why? I should've won one. I really wanted it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她根本不在乎才没有出席 它也可以拿来当葛莱美
sense_groups.english: She didn't even care enough to come to the thing. It could also be a Grammy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 乔伊
sense_groups.english: No, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人看到我把它拿走 整个桌子上都是奖杯
sense_groups.english: Come on, Rach. No one saw me take it. There was a whole table full of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要一个不属于你的奖杯吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you really want an award that you didn't win?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想要一个属于我的奖杯 但没有人愿意让我得奖
sense_groups.english: No, I want an award I did win. But nobody's given me any of those!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我把它摆在这里 大家就会看到它…
sense_groups.english: Plus, look, hey, Rach. If I put it up, when people come over, they'll see it...

sense_groups.chinese: 以为我真的得奖了
sense_groups.english: ...and they'll think I won it.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 上面写着"最佳女配角奖"
sense_groups.english: Joey, it says "Best Supporting Actress."

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以把那个刮掉
sense_groups.english: I can scratch that right off.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这样是不对的 你得把它还回去
sense_groups.english: Joey, no, this is wrong. You have to take it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会想这样把奖杯拿回家 你真的有演戏天分
sense_groups.english: Okay? You don't wanna win an award this way. You're very talented.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一天你会真的得奖 那对你来说才有意义
sense_groups.english: And someday you're gonna win one of these for real and that one is gonna mean something.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吗？谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right. - All right? Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天就把它还回去 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I'll take it back tomorrow. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我不能拥有它 你也不能拥有它 - 啊
sense_groups.english: If I can't have it, you can't have it! - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授？ - 路易斯？有什么事吗？
sense_groups.english: Professor Geller? - Yes, Mr. Lewis? How can I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我的期中考没有考好
sense_groups.english: I know I didn't do well on my midterms and stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我希望你能帮我改成绩
sense_groups.english: ...but I was kind of hoping you could change my grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要那么做？
sense_groups.english: And why exactly would I do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我爱上你了
sense_groups.english: Because I'm in love with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我爱上你了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'm all in love with you and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以帮我改成绩吗？ - 不行
sense_groups.english: So could you change my grade? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？你帮奈德改成绩
sense_groups.english: Well, why not? You changed Ned's grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不一样 因为他真的爱上我了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's different, okay? Because he was actually in love with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他才没有 他只是在耍你
sense_groups.english: No, he's not! He's totally yanking your chain.

sense_groups.chinese: 他已经用这一招对付过其他三个教授
sense_groups.english: He's done this with three other teachers.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 他有女朋友
sense_groups.english: What? - He's got a girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信有人会为了成绩那么做
sense_groups.english: I can't believe someone would do that for a grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那太可怕了
sense_groups.english: It's awful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到钱德了吗？ - 没有 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Have you seen Chandler? - No, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我一直在想 我会失去的一切
sense_groups.english: I just keep thinking about all these things I'm not gonna have...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的吓坏了 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: ...and it's freaking me out. I don't know what to do about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心
sense_groups.english: Okay. Don't sweat it.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德不在 别管那么多规矩 那个男的很帅
sense_groups.english: Chandler is nowhere around, so get it out of your system. That guy's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 别这样 我是认真的
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, come on, I'm serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得跟他谈这件事 - 你真的不该那么做
sense_groups.english: I've just gotta talk to him about all this. - That is the last thing you wanna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为你要嫁给他
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because you're marrying him!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得说清楚
sense_groups.english: You gotta help me out here, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有订婚过 也没有真正结婚过
sense_groups.english: All right, I've never been engaged and I've never really been married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能告诉你我妈跟我说的话
sense_groups.english: But I can only tell you what my mother told me.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你对一段关系有疑虑 害怕或焦虑时…
sense_groups.english: Whenever you have doubts or fears or anxieties about a relationship...

sense_groups.chinese: 别跟你的丈夫沟通这些问题
sense_groups.english: ...do not communicate them to your husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 我不该跟我要共度一生的男人…
sense_groups.english: So I'm not supposed to share my doubts and fears...

sense_groups.chinese: 分享我的疑虑跟恐惧？
sense_groups.english: ...with the guy I'm spending the rest of my life with?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就是那样
sense_groups.english: That is correct. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该把那件事放在心里…
sense_groups.english: You're supposed to put all that stuff in a little box in your mind...

sense_groups.chinese: 永远不再提
sense_groups.english: ...and then lock it up tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你妈妈告诉你的？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Your mother told you this? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个结了很多次婚 在你十三岁时就自杀了的女人？
sense_groups.english: The woman that got married a bunch of times and killed herself when you were 13?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 去告诉钱德 快点 免得太迟了
sense_groups.english: All right, go. Go tell Chandler. Hurry, before it's too late!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 这也表示 放荡是得不到真爱的吗？
sense_groups.english: Wait, no! Does this also mean that putting out doesn't get you love?

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信我要跟洁西卡艾许丽碰面 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm gonna meet Jessica Ashley! - Wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 拜托你酷一点 好吗？ 我跟这个女人一起工作
sense_groups.english: Please be cool, okay? I work with this woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会很酷的 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm totally cool. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进
sense_groups.english: Come in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 洁西卡
sense_groups.english: Hey, Jessica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 洁西
sense_groups.english: Hey, Jess.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我朋友瑞秋
sense_groups.english: This is my friend Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的肥皂奖 我代表你收下了它
sense_groups.english: Uh, listen, here's your Soapie. I accepted it for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我得奖了？ 你知道这代表什么意义吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I won? Do you have any idea what this means?

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？ 你不把它摆在柜子里吗？
sense_groups.english: That's it. You're not gonna put it on your shelf or anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我只想把真正的奖杯 摆在柜子里 对不起
sense_groups.english: No, I try to save that for real awards. Now if you'll excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 呵
sense_groups.english: Hm!

sense_groups.chinese: 要把它拿回去吗？ - 那当然
sense_groups.english: Take it back? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 做得好
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心？我们快结婚了… - 哈？
sense_groups.english: Honey? As we get closer to the wedding... - Hm?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事你想跟我分享吗？
sense_groups.english: ...is there anything you'd like to talk about or share?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我觉得桌上的装饰太大了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, I think the centerpieces are too big.

sense_groups.chinese: 你错了 桌上的装饰刚刚好
sense_groups.english: You're wrong. The centerpieces are fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你曾经觉得害怕过吗？ - 有一点 它们真的很大
sense_groups.english: Do you ever get scared at all? - Kind of. They're really big.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不害怕自己没办法再认识新的人吗？
sense_groups.english: Doesn't it ever freak you out that you're never gonna be with anybody new again?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是…
sense_groups.english: Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you so much. Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我会很难过 我无法再有那样的感觉
sense_groups.english: It's just sometimes it bothers me that I'm never gonna have that feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你刚认识一个人…
sense_groups.english: When you first meet someone for the first time...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会觉得新鲜刺激 你知道那种心动的感觉吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and it's new and exciting. You know that rush?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 当我刚认识一个人…
sense_groups.english: No, see, when I first meet somebody...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会觉得慌张 焦虑 满头大汗
sense_groups.english: ...it's mostly panic, anxiety and a great deal of sweating.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但你是男人
sense_groups.english: Okay, but... All right, you're a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不害怕你永远不能 再跟别人上床吗？
sense_groups.english: Does it not freak you out that you're never gonna sleep with anybody else?

sense_groups.chinese: 不能跟别人上床
sense_groups.english: Sleeping with somebody, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我害怕的是焦虑 慌张 跟满头大汗
sense_groups.english: Anxiety, panic and I'm afraid even more sweating.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使是跟我在一起？
sense_groups.english: Even with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们刚开始交往的六个月 我严重脱水
sense_groups.english: I was dangerously dehydrated during the first six months of our relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说心动的感觉是 我们会共度余生
sense_groups.english: Look, for me the rush is knowing that we are gonna be together for the rest of our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Well, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道你有这些想法 我们又回到了慌张 焦虑跟…
sense_groups.english: Knowing you're having these thoughts, we're back to panic, anxiety and, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的需要喝点运动饮料
sense_groups.english: ...I'm definitely gonna need some kind of sports drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来 你不必担心
sense_groups.english: Come here. Oh, sweetie, you don't have to worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且你知道吗？跟你在一起 我一定能遇上新鲜的事
sense_groups.english: No. Besides, you know what? I'm gonna have a lot of new things with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们第一次买房子 第一个孩子 第一个孙子
sense_groups.english: The first time we buy a house, our first kid, our first grandkid.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我水…快点
sense_groups.english: Water. Water. Water.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩斯先生？我能跟你谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, Mr. Morse? Can I speak to you for a moment?

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天上课的内容很精彩
sense_groups.english: That was a great lecture today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你剪了头发吗？ - 恩
sense_groups.english: Did you get a haircut? - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你喜欢吗？你爱吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. Do you like it? Do you love it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你我会把你的成绩改回来
sense_groups.english: I want you to know that I'm changing your grade back.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你在搞什么鬼 那是行不通的
sense_groups.english: Because I know what you're trying to pull here. It's not gonna work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有搞什么鬼 听着 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I'm not trying to pull anything. Look, I love you, dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至不想谈这件事 这个小"风流韵事"结束了
sense_groups.english: You know what, I'm not even gonna talk about this. This little "thing" is over.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你有女朋友 也知道其他教授的事
sense_groups.english: I know you have a girlfriend. Yeah. And I know about the other professors.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得那会让我 有什么感觉？你利用我
sense_groups.english: How do you think that makes me feel, Ned? You used me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不爱我 你从来都没有爱过我
sense_groups.english: You don't love me and you never did!

sense_groups.chinese: 温斯顿教授 佛迪瑞克森教授
sense_groups.english: Ah, Professor Winston. Professor Frederickson.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上来
sense_groups.english: I'll be right with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让事情变得更糟糕 我会给你"丙" 我们可以走了吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't make this worse and I'll give you a C. Shall we?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上来 - 恩
sense_groups.english: I'll be out in a second. - Hm.

sense_groups.chinese: "这真的是太意外了
sense_groups.english: "It's just so unexpected! I...

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉大家 能被提名诺贝尔奖…
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you, it's just such an honor to just be nominated...

sense_groups.chinese: 已经是莫大的光荣
sense_groups.english: ...for a Nobel Prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 我竟然因为按摩得了诺贝尔奖
sense_groups.english: And, you know, to win one for a massage! Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 特别是我刚拿下 东尼奖的最佳女演员奖…"
sense_groups.english: Especially after having just won a Tony Award for Best Actress..."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们订了八点的位置
sense_groups.english: We have to go. Our reservations are at 8.

sense_groups.chinese: "以《我们订了八点的位置》得奖 作词人是尼尔赛门
sense_groups.english: "...in Reservations at Eight by Neil Simon.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 尼尔 谢谢你帮我填词"
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Neil. Thank you for the words."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 待会再玩 我们要迟到了
sense_groups.english: You can finish this later. We're gonna be late. We gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 请不要奏乐 还有一件事
sense_groups.english: Please don't play the music. Just one more thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: "纽约现场直播 欢迎收看《周末夜现场》"
sense_groups.english: "Live from New York, it's Saturday Night!"

questions.name: S07E19
questions.en:
Oh, hey! How was your audition?
I'm sorry, do I know you?
What are you doing?
Practicing blowing you off. I'm gonna be a big movie star!
Oh, you got it?
Not yet, but the audition went great! - What's it for?
A big-budget period movie about three Italian brothers...
...who come to America at the turn of the century. It's classy.
The director's supposed to be the next-next Martin Scorsese.
The "next-next"?
A guy from Chicago's supposed to be the next Martin Scorsese.
This guy's right after him.
Hello?
Joey, it's Estelle. I just talked to the casting people. They loved you!
They loved me!
They want to see you again tomorrow.
Oh, my God. - Just one thing.
Do you have a problem with full-frontal nudity?
Are you kidding me? I never rent a movie without it!
Oh.
Uh, okay, let me call you back.
What's the matter? - They want me naked in the movie.
Wow. -I know.
My grandmother's gonna see this. - Grandma's gonna have to get in line.
The wedding's so close. Are you nervous?
Yeah, but I also can't wait till it's over.
We have a pact not to have sex again until the wedding.
A "no sex" pact, huh?
I have one of those with every woman in America.
Will you give me a hand making up the guest bedroom?
Cousin Cassie's staying with us for a few days.
Cassie? I haven't seen her in, like, forever.
I wonder if she still carries a Barbie everywhere?
She's 25 years old. - So? I still...
You're probably right.
Hi. - Hey.
Pheebs, can I talk to you over here for a second?
Yeah.
Subtle, guys.
What?
I know you're planning my surprise bridal shower.
Ha, okay, well, don't ruin it. Just play along, at least.
Okay. Sorry. - Okay.
Oh, my God. We have to throw her a shower?
What'd you decide to do about the movie?
I don't know.
It's not like it's porn. This is a serious, legitimate movie.
Nudity's really important to the story.
That's what you say about porn.
Maybe I shouldn't go on the callback.
No, you should. A lot of major actors do nude scenes.
The chance to star in a movie? Come on!
That's true. And I'm only naked in one scene. It sounds really great.
My character's Catholic. He falls in love with a Jewish girl.
We run away and get caught in a big rainstorm.
We go into a barn, undress each other and hold each other.
It's really sweet and tender.
Plus, everyone is gonna see your thing.
When can we have this shower?
She has so much going on, we have only two options.
We have Friday. - That's just two days away.
What is the other option? - Yesterday.
Well, if we make it yesterday, woo-hoo, we're done.
It's impossible. We can't do this by Friday.
We have to find a place, invite people, get food.
There's too much to do.
We cannot do it! - Calm down!
Okay. I'm sorry, you're right. I'm sorry.
Just calm down, woman!
Phoebe, I already did.
All right, then I need to calm down. - Okay.
I think we can do this if we just get organized.
Uh-huh. - We have two days to plan this party.
We just need to make fast decisions. - Mm-hm.
Where will we have it?
Um, here. What time? - Four o'clock. Food?
Finger sandwiches and tea. - Ooh, great. Very Monica.
And chili. - Ah, you went one too far.
Uh, flowers or balloons? - Both.
We're paying for this. Okay. - Neither.
Um, what should we do for the theme? - "Lusts of the Flesh."
What? - I don't know. Cowboy theme?
Hey. - Hey.
I'm glad we decided not to sleep together before the wedding.
Oh, boy. Me too.
You know, I was thinking, if we had a big fight...
Mm-hm. ...and, uh, we broke up for a few hours.
Yeah. - Technically, we could have sex again.
What do you think, bossy and domineering?
The wedding's off, sloppy and immature.
That's me. Come on. - Okay.
Wait. Cassie's in the guest room. We're going to lunch.
Get rid of her, obsessive and shrill!
Shrill? The wedding is back on.
I thought I heard voices. You must be Chandler.
Hi. Nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you too.
So, ready to go? - Yeah.
Chandler? - I'll be right with you.
Cassie needs to stay at your place. - Why?
Because "Pervie Perverson" here can't stop staring at her.
Chandler, she's our cousin!
I wasn't staring. I was listening intently.
It's called being a good conversationalist. Watch.
Say something.
You were staring about eight inches south of there.
Fine. She can stay at my place.
What does Cassie look like now?
She looks exactly like Aunt Marilyn. - Huh.
So this Aunt Marilyn, is she coming to the wedding?
Wafer-thin ice.
Hey, I'm back.
Hi, Joey.
Uh, so, will I be reading the same scene again?
I tried to call you. You didn't need to come today.
Oh, great.
I'd have been perfect for this part.
You made a bad decision and ruined your movie. Good day!
You didn't need to come, because the director saw your tape and loved it.
And scene.
Huh? Wasn't that fun?
We did a little improv there. Yeah!
So, you... You were saying?
The director wants to meet you tomorrow.
Wow. Sure. That's great.
Your agent said you're okay with nudity.
Yeah, sure. As long as it's handled tastefully.
And that barn is not too cold.
Terrific. Well, uh, there's one more thing.
Uh... Uh, it's important to the director that everything in the movie is authentic.
In your love scene with Sarah...
...she talks about how she's never seen a naked man who wasn't Jewish.
So...
So, what?
So, uh, well, the director is insisting that whoever play that part...
...be authentically, uh, anatomically...
...not Jewish. You know what I'm saying?
Yes!
No. What?
An Italian Catholic immigrant at this time would not be...
Bar mitzvah-ed?
To get this part, you can't be... - No.
But you are? - Yep.
You told them you weren't? - That's right.
Wow. Wow.
It's definitely all gone? There's nothing there to work with?
What were you thinking? - I don't know. I just want this part.
They say no matter what you're asked during an audition, say yes.
They want you to ride a horse, say you can.
You figure out how to do it later.
This is not like learning to ride a horse. This is like learning to...
...grow a turtleneck.
I know, okay? Tomorrow, when I go meet the director...
...I have to take my clothes off so they can see what my body looks like.
Oh, my God. What are you gonna do?
I have to call my agent and tell her I can't do the part.
Unless...
Unless what?
This may sound crazy, but there may be something we could...
...fashion.
Like what? - Well, I'm not sure yet, but, um...
...off the top of my head, I'm thinking...
...double-sided tape and some sort of luncheon meat.
I've got a great idea for party favors for the shower.
We get mahogany boxes and carve everyone's names in them.
Then inside is each person's individual birthstone.
Okay. Okay.
All right, you take care of that. - Okay.
Meanwhile, the party's tomorrow and we don't have a guest list.
Okay. Who do we know that's coming? Me. Are you?
Hey. - Hey, what's up?
I'm making something for Joey. Can I raid your fridge?
Have at it.
All right. Turkey? Mm, that won't work.
Cheese? That won't work.
Olive loaf? I hope that won't work.
Are you making him a sandwich?
No, it's, um, more like a wrap.
Okay, so, um, I'm gonna go, guys.
So you can get back to deciding on what to get me for a present!
We have to get her a present?
Okay, but look. Look at what I got.
It's her address book. We have a guest list.
Ah.
You're amazing. Did you pull that out of her purse?
Uh-huh. And a little seed money for the party.
Oh, nice.
Cassie?
Hey, Ross. - Hi. Ha, ha.
It's been so long!
Last time I saw you...
...you were setting up your tent in line for Return of the Jedi.
Oh, uh, that's right.
So you did see me that day. Because it seemed like you didn't.
Yeah, sorry about that. - It's okay. Come on in.
Thanks for letting me stay here. Monica's place was nice.
But her fiancé sure stares a lot.
Oh.
Oh, my God! You do a great Chandler!
Uh-huh.
Yeah, I have a knack for impressions.
Well, maybe after we get re-acquainted, uh, you could do me.
Yeah. No!
Cassie, how you...? How you doing on that...
...hot dog?
I'm all done. - Thank God.
The last time we hung out was when our parents rented that beach house.
Oh, right, right. Ooh, remember the time...
...l, uh, pinned you down and tickled you until you cried?
We're probably too old to do that now.
I'll always remember that summer. It's when I got all these freckles.
Uh-huh, Uh-huh.
And... And I'll always remember that summer...
...because that's when I realized that we are related.
It took you that long to figure it out, huh?
Um, I'm a little slow.
Just as our children would be.
Hi. - Hi.
How are you? Good. Hi. Thanks for coming.
Oh, thank you. - Thank you. So nice to see you.
No, thanks. - Okay. Hey, Rach?
Yeah? - Who the hell are all these people?
I don't know. I called everybody in her book.
These are the ones that could show up on 24 hours' notice.
There's a word for people like that: Losers.
Hi, I'm Rachel. This is Phoebe. I'm the maid of honor.
How do you know Monica?
I was her accountant four years ago. - Oh...
I'm interested to find out who's been doing her taxes the last four years.
That's great.
When is Monica supposed to get here? - I don't know.
Excuse us.
You didn't tell her? - You were supposed to.
You were supposed to tell her to come! I was bringing the cake!
Fine, I'll go call her. - And please tell her to bring a cake!
We have a lot of options. A number of prototypes for you to try on.
Wow, those look great.
Okay, this one's a mushroom cap. Uh, this one is made of bologna.
And... And the toothpicks? - Just until the glue dries.
Thank God.
These are more realistic, but perishable.
Over here, we have pink suede, which is nice.
But if it gets wet, it'll shrink.
Maybe we'll just take that one away.
I also did a little something in fur, but, uh, that's really just for me.
Why don't you try these on? We'll get a better idea of what works.
Thanks, you are such a good friend. And this is so weird.
Ow.
Toothpick? - Yeah.
What are you trying now? - The Fruit Roll-up.
And? - Delicious.
Joey.
Wait a minute. Wait a minute. We have a winner!
What? Which one?
The Silly Putty. Not so silly anymore!
She's your cousin. She's your cousin.
If she knew what was going on in your head, she'd think you were sick.
Or would she? Let's back up for a second.
She was the one who suggested opening a bottle of wine.
She was the one who turned down the lights.
She was the one that wanted to rent Logan's Run...
...the sexiest movie ever.
I know that look.
Forget it. I want it. She wants it.
I'm going in.
What the hell are you doing?
Say something clever.
Okay, doesn't have to be clever.
Just has to be words. Say some words.
Any words will do.
Oh, my God, this is the longest...
...that anyone has not talked ever!
There is nothing you could say to make this worse...
...so just say something!
I haven't had sex in a very long time.
Yeah, you really shouldn't have said anything.
Phoebe? Rachel? It's Monica.
I wonder what you could possibly need me for on such short notice?
Oh.
Oh, Monica. We are so sorry. - For what?
First, for forgetting to throw you a bridal shower.
Then, forgetting to invite you to it.

Joey.
