sense_groups.chinese: 喔 嘿 试镜如何？
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey! How was your audition?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我认识你吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, do I know you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干嘛？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 练习假装不认识你 因为我要成为电影明星了
sense_groups.english: Practicing blowing you off. I'm gonna be a big movie star!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得到那个角色了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you got it?

sense_groups.chinese: 还没 但试镜很成功 - 什么样的角色？
sense_groups.english: Not yet, but the audition went great! - What's it for?

sense_groups.chinese: 大成本制作 关于三个意大利兄弟…
sense_groups.english: A big-budget period movie about three Italian brothers...

sense_groups.chinese: 在世纪之初来到美国 是个经典故事
sense_groups.english: ...who come to America at the turn of the century. It's classy.

sense_groups.chinese: 导演被认为是 下下个马丁史柯西斯
sense_groups.english: The director's supposed to be the next-next Martin Scorsese.

sense_groups.chinese: "下下个"？
sense_groups.english: The "next-next"?

sense_groups.chinese: 来自芝加哥的那个家伙被认为是 下一个马丁史柯西斯
sense_groups.english: A guy from Chicago's supposed to be the next Martin Scorsese.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个导演在他之后
sense_groups.english: This guy's right after him.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 是伊斯特 刚和选角的谈过 他们很喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Joey, it's Estelle. I just talked to the casting people. They loved you!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很喜欢我
sense_groups.english: They loved me!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他们明天要再见你一次
sense_groups.english: They want to see you again tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 - 只有一个问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Just one thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对正面全裸有问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you have a problem with full-frontal nudity?

sense_groups.chinese: 你开玩笑吗？我从没租过 一部没有正面全裸的电影
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding me? I never rent a movie without it!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我再回你电话
sense_groups.english: Uh, okay, let me call you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事？ - 电影里需要我全裸
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - They want me naked in the movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Wow. -I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我祖母会看到的 - 祖母还得排队咧
sense_groups.english: My grandmother's gonna see this. - Grandma's gonna have to get in line.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼就快到了 你紧张吗？
sense_groups.english: The wedding's so close. Are you nervous?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我等不及赶紧结束
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I also can't wait till it's over.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德和我决定婚礼前不做爱的
sense_groups.english: We have a pact not to have sex again until the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 无性"条约" 嗯？
sense_groups.english: A "no sex" pact, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我和全美每位女性 都有一份这个合约
sense_groups.english: I have one of those with every woman in America.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你能帮我整理客房吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you give me a hand making up the guest bedroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 表妹凯西要来和我们住几天
sense_groups.english: Cousin Cassie's staying with us for a few days.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西？我很久没看到她了
sense_groups.english: Cassie? I haven't seen her in, like, forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是不是还带着 芭比娃娃到处跑？
sense_groups.english: I wonder if she still carries a Barbie everywhere?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 她25岁了 - 所以呢？我还是…
sense_groups.english: She's 25 years old. - So? I still...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你大概是对的
sense_groups.english: You're probably right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我可以和你说句话吗？
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, can I talk to you over here for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 要低调一点
sense_groups.english: Subtle, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们在计划 我的惊喜告别单身女子派对
sense_groups.english: I know you're planning my surprise bridal shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别毁了它 至少假装不知道
sense_groups.english: Ha, okay, well, don't ruin it. Just play along, at least.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 对不起 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Sorry. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我们要替她办告别单身女子派对？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. We have to throw her a shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你决定那部电影该怎么办了吗？
sense_groups.english: What'd you decide to do about the movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我是说…
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是一部色情电影 这是一部严肃 正当的电影
sense_groups.english: It's not like it's porn. This is a serious, legitimate movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个故事里的裸戏很重要
sense_groups.english: Nudity's really important to the story.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是这么说色情电影的
sense_groups.english: That's what you say about porn.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 也许别去参加第二次试镜
sense_groups.english: Maybe I shouldn't go on the callback.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你应该去 很多大明星都有裸戏演出
sense_groups.english: No, you should. A lot of major actors do nude scenes.

sense_groups.chinese: 在电影里演出的机会？别这样
sense_groups.english: The chance to star in a movie? Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 是真的 我只有一场裸戏 听起来真的很不错
sense_groups.english: That's true. And I'm only naked in one scene. It sounds really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的角色是个天主教徒 和一位犹太女孩恋爱了
sense_groups.english: My character's Catholic. He falls in love with a Jewish girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们逃家而被陷在大雨中
sense_groups.english: We run away and get caught in a big rainstorm.

sense_groups.chinese: 躲到了谷仓里 脱掉彼此衣服 抱在一起
sense_groups.english: We go into a barn, undress each other and hold each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很甜蜜而温柔
sense_groups.english: It's really sweet and tender.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 每个人都看到你那活儿
sense_groups.english: Plus, everyone is gonna see your thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们何时能开这个告别单身女子派对？
sense_groups.english: When can we have this shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 她有这么多事要做 我们只有两个选择
sense_groups.english: She has so much going on, we have only two options.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期五 - 那只剩两天了
sense_groups.english: We have Friday. - That's just two days away.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一个选择是什么？ - 昨天
sense_groups.english: What is the other option? - Yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们昨天就办了 问题解决了
sense_groups.english: Well, if we make it yesterday, woo-hoo, we're done.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 我们不可能在星期五办
sense_groups.english: It's impossible. We can't do this by Friday.

sense_groups.chinese: 要找到一个地点 邀请客人 买好食物
sense_groups.english: We have to find a place, invite people, get food.

sense_groups.chinese: 太多事要做
sense_groups.english: There's too much to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 办不到… - 瑞秋 镇静下来
sense_groups.english: We cannot do it! - Calm down!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 抱歉 你是对的 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm sorry, you're right. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 镇静下来 女人
sense_groups.english: Just calm down, woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我已经镇静下来了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I already did.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那我需要镇静 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, then I need to calm down. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有系统一点就能办这件事
sense_groups.english: I think we can do this if we just get organized.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 有两天来计划这个派对
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - We have two days to plan this party.

sense_groups.chinese: 做决定要快 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: We just need to make fast decisions. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 要在哪里办？
sense_groups.english: Where will we have it?

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里 什么时间？ - 4点整 食物？
sense_groups.english: Um, here. What time? - Four o'clock. Food?

sense_groups.chinese: 小三明治和茶 - 好极了 很摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Finger sandwiches and tea. - Ooh, great. Very Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有辣椒 - 太过头了
sense_groups.english: And chili. - Ah, you went one too far.

sense_groups.chinese: 花还是气球？ - 两个都要
sense_groups.english: Uh, flowers or balloons? - Both.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要付钱的 - 两个都不要
sense_groups.english: We're paying for this. Okay. - Neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 主题要什么呢？ - 肌肤之爱
sense_groups.english: Um, what should we do for the theme? - "Lusts of the Flesh."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我不知道 牛仔风？
sense_groups.english: What? - I don't know. Cowboy theme?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴我们决定婚礼前不上床
sense_groups.english: I'm glad we decided not to sleep together before the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Oh, boy. Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想 如果我们大吵一架
sense_groups.english: You know, I was thinking, if we had a big fight...

sense_groups.chinese: 分手几个小时
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. ...and, uh, we broke up for a few hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 技术上来说 我们就可以上床
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Technically, we could have sex again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说呢 颐指气使的人？
sense_groups.english: What do you think, bossy and domineering?

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼取消了 不成熟的邋遢人
sense_groups.english: The wedding's off, sloppy and immature.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正是如此 走吧 - 好
sense_groups.english: That's me. Come on. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 凯西在客房 我们要一起出去吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Wait. Cassie's in the guest room. We're going to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 甩掉她 执拗尖锐的人
sense_groups.english: Get rid of her, obsessive and shrill!

sense_groups.chinese: 尖锐？婚礼照常
sense_groups.english: Shrill? The wedding is back on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到有人讲话 你一定是钱德
sense_groups.english: I thought I heard voices. You must be Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 很高兴认识你 - 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Hi. Nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 要走了吗？ - 好
sense_groups.english: So, ready to go? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？ - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Chandler? - I'll be right with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西必须去住你家 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Cassie needs to stay at your place. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这位"变态人" 一直瞪着她看
sense_groups.english: Because "Pervie Perverson" here can't stop staring at her.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 她是我们的表妹
sense_groups.english: Chandler, she's our cousin!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有瞪着她看 我是很专心地听她说话
sense_groups.english: I wasn't staring. I was listening intently.

sense_groups.chinese: 做一位好的聊天者 看着
sense_groups.english: It's called being a good conversationalist. Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 说话
sense_groups.english: Say something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看着南面8英寸以外的地方
sense_groups.english: You were staring about eight inches south of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 她可以来住我家
sense_groups.english: Fine. She can stay at my place.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西现在长的什么样子？
sense_groups.english: What does Cassie look like now?

sense_groups.chinese: 就像玛丽莲阿姨 - 哈
sense_groups.english: She looks exactly like Aunt Marilyn. - Huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 玛丽莲阿姨会来参加婚礼吗？
sense_groups.english: So this Aunt Marilyn, is she coming to the wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 你快上我的黑名单了
sense_groups.english: Wafer-thin ice.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我回来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, I'm back.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又要演同一场戏吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, so, will I be reading the same scene again?

sense_groups.chinese: 我试着打电话给你 你今天不用来这儿
sense_groups.english: I tried to call you. You didn't need to come today.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会是这个角色的最佳人选
sense_groups.english: I'd have been perfect for this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过随你便 你错误的决定 会毁了你的电影 再见
sense_groups.english: You made a bad decision and ruined your movie. Good day!

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 乔伊 你不需要来这儿 因为导演看了你的带子非常喜欢
sense_groups.english: You didn't need to come, because the director saw your tape and loved it.

sense_groups.chinese: 下台鞠躬
sense_groups.english: And scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好玩吧？
sense_groups.english: Huh? Wasn't that fun?

sense_groups.chinese: MJ的即席表演耶
sense_groups.english: We did a little improv there. Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说？
sense_groups.english: So, you... You were saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 导演们认为你很适合 明天想见你
sense_groups.english: The director wants to meet you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 当然 太好了
sense_groups.english: Wow. Sure. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你经纪人说你对裸戏没问题
sense_groups.english: Your agent said you're okay with nudity.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 只要很有格调地表现
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. As long as it's handled tastefully.

sense_groups.chinese: 谷仓不要太冷
sense_groups.english: And that barn is not too cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 好极了 还有一件事
sense_groups.english: Terrific. Well, uh, there's one more thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 导演希望电影里 每一样事物都很正宗
sense_groups.english: Uh... Uh, it's important to the director that everything in the movie is authentic.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你和莎拉的性爱场面…
sense_groups.english: In your love scene with Sarah...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她从没见过 不是犹太人的裸体男子
sense_groups.english: ...she talks about how she's never seen a naked man who wasn't Jewish.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…怎样？
sense_groups.english: So, what?

sense_groups.chinese: 导演坚持演出这个角色的人…
sense_groups.english: So, uh, well, the director is insisting that whoever play that part...

sense_groups.chinese: 是正宗的 身体组织上…
sense_groups.english: ...be authentically, uh, anatomically...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是犹太人 你知道我在说什么？
sense_groups.english: ...not Jewish. You know what I'm saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是什么？
sense_groups.english: No. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 在那时的意大利 天主教移民不会是…
sense_groups.english: An Italian Catholic immigrant at this time would not be...

sense_groups.chinese: 行过受诫礼的？
sense_groups.english: Bar mitzvah-ed?

sense_groups.chinese: 要得到这个角色 你不能是… - 不能
sense_groups.english: To get this part, you can't be... - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是你是？ - 耶
sense_groups.english: But you are? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他们你不是？ - 对
sense_groups.english: You told them you weren't? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦
sense_groups.english: Wow. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的完全都没有了？ 没剩下一点可努力的余地？
sense_groups.english: It's definitely all gone? There's nothing there to work with?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在想什么？ - 我不知道 我想得到这个角色
sense_groups.english: What were you thinking? - I don't know. I just want this part.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说不管试镜时问什么 都回答是
sense_groups.english: They say no matter what you're asked during an audition, say yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果要你骑马 说你会
sense_groups.english: They want you to ride a horse, say you can.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后再解决
sense_groups.english: You figure out how to do it later.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这和学会骑马不一样 这就像是学会…
sense_groups.english: This is not like learning to ride a horse. This is like learning to...

sense_groups.chinese: 长出长脖子
sense_groups.english: ...grow a turtleneck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 好吗？ 明天我去见导演时…
sense_groups.english: I know, okay? Tomorrow, when I go meet the director...

sense_groups.chinese: 我必须脱掉衣服 让他们看我的身体
sense_groups.english: ...I have to take my clothes off so they can see what my body looks like.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你要怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 必须打给我的经纪人 告诉她我不能接这个角色
sense_groups.english: I have to call my agent and tell her I can't do the part.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非…
sense_groups.english: Unless...

sense_groups.chinese: 除非怎么？
sense_groups.english: Unless what?

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来可能很疯狂 不过我们可能可以做点…
sense_groups.english: This may sound crazy, but there may be something we could...

sense_groups.chinese: 造型
sense_groups.english: ...fashion.

sense_groups.chinese: 像什么？ - 我还不知道
sense_groups.english: Like what? - Well, I'm not sure yet, but, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 随便想想 我在想…
sense_groups.english: ...off the top of my head, I'm thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 双面胶和某种午餐肉
sense_groups.english: ...double-sided tape and some sort of luncheon meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我有个派对主题的好主意
sense_groups.english: I've got a great idea for party favors for the shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 用一个红木箱 刻上每个人的名字
sense_groups.english: We get mahogany boxes and carve everyone's names in them.

sense_groups.chinese: 在里面放着每个人的出生石
sense_groups.english: Then inside is each person's individual birthstone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那由你来弄 - 好
sense_groups.english: All right, you take care of that. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 同时 派对就在明天 我们还没有宾客名单
sense_groups.english: Meanwhile, the party's tomorrow and we don't have a guest list.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们知道要来的有谁？ 有我 你要来吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Who do we know that's coming? Me. Are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 怎么样啊？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在替乔伊弄点东西 可以搜一下你的冰箱吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm making something for Joey. Can I raid your fridge?

sense_groups.chinese: 请便
sense_groups.english: Have at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 火鸡肉？没有用
sense_groups.english: All right. Turkey? Mm, that won't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 起司？没有用
sense_groups.english: Cheese? That won't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 橄榄面包 希望这没用
sense_groups.english: Olive loaf? I hope that won't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在替他做三明治吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you making him a sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 比较像是鸡肉卷
sense_groups.english: No, it's, um, more like a wrap.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, um, I'm gonna go, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以继续讨论 要送我什么礼物
sense_groups.english: So you can get back to deciding on what to get me for a present!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要送她礼物？
sense_groups.english: We have to get her a present?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 看我拿到什么
sense_groups.english: Okay, but look. Look at what I got.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的通讯录 我们有宾客名单了
sense_groups.english: It's her address book. We have a guest list.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你好厉害 你从她皮包拿的？
sense_groups.english: You're amazing. Did you pull that out of her purse?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 还有派对的种子钱
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. And a little seed money for the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮
sense_groups.english: Oh, nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西？
sense_groups.english: Cassie?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 - 嗨 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. - Hi. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好久不见
sense_groups.english: It's been so long!

sense_groups.chinese: 上一次我看到你时…
sense_groups.english: Last time I saw you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你正搭着帐篷 等待绝地武士的归来
sense_groups.english: ...you were setting up your tent in line for Return of the Jedi.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以那天你有看到我 看起来像没看到的样子
sense_groups.english: So you did see me that day. Because it seemed like you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 没关系 请进
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sorry about that. - It's okay. Come on in.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你让我住在这儿 摩妮卡那儿不错
sense_groups.english: Thanks for letting me stay here. Monica's place was nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她的未婚夫一直瞪着人看
sense_groups.english: But her fiancé sure stares a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你学钱德学得真像
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! You do a great Chandler!

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很会做表情的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I have a knack for impressions.

sense_groups.chinese: 等我们熟一点 你也可以学我
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe after we get re-acquainted, uh, you could do me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 不
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No!

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西 你的…
sense_groups.english: Cassie, how you...? How you doing on that...

sense_groups.chinese: 热狗好吃吗？
sense_groups.english: ...hot dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃完了 - 感谢上帝
sense_groups.english: I'm all done. - Thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想上次见面是我们父母 租下海边小屋那时
sense_groups.english: The last time we hung out was when our parents rented that beach house.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我按住你
sense_groups.english: Oh, right, right. Ooh, remember the time...

sense_groups.chinese: 搔你痒直到你哭了？
sense_groups.english: ...l, uh, pinned you down and tickled you until you cried?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在大了 不能这么做了
sense_groups.english: We're probably too old to do that now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都记得那个夏天 我就是那时长了这些雀斑的
sense_groups.english: I'll always remember that summer. It's when I got all these freckles.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh, Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都记得那个夏天…
sense_groups.english: And... And I'll always remember that summer...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那时我才知道我们是亲戚
sense_groups.english: ...because that's when I realized that we are related.

sense_groups.chinese: 你花了那么久才发现？
sense_groups.english: It took you that long to figure it out, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有点反应迟缓
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm a little slow.

sense_groups.chinese: 就如我们的孩子也可能会这样子
sense_groups.english: Just as our children would be.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？好 嗨 谢谢大家来
sense_groups.english: How are you? Good. Hi. Thanks for coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 很高兴见到你
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. - Thank you. So nice to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 谢谢 - 好 瑞秋？
sense_groups.english: No, thanks. - Okay. Hey, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 是？ - 这些是什么人啊？
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Who the hell are all these people?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我打给她本子里的每一个人
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I called everybody in her book.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是在24小时内通知还能来的
sense_groups.english: These are the ones that could show up on 24 hours' notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 有另一个词可以来形容这种人: 输家
sense_groups.english: There's a word for people like that: Losers.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是瑞秋 这是菲比 我是伴娘
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Rachel. This is Phoebe. I'm the maid of honor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么认识摩妮卡的？
sense_groups.english: How do you know Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是她四年前的会计师 - 哦
sense_groups.english: I was her accountant four years ago. - Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想知道 这过去四年是谁替她报税的
sense_groups.english: I'm interested to find out who's been doing her taxes the last four years.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡何时会到？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: When is Monica supposed to get here? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 借一步说话
sense_groups.english: Excuse us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没告诉她？ - 是你该通知她的
sense_groups.english: You didn't tell her? - You were supposed to.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是我 是你该通知她来的 而我要带蛋糕
sense_groups.english: You were supposed to tell her to come! I was bringing the cake!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我打电话给她 - 对 然后要她带蛋糕来
sense_groups.english: Fine, I'll go call her. - And please tell her to bring a cake!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们有很多选择 有几个雏型可以试穿
sense_groups.english: We have a lot of options. A number of prototypes for you to try on.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很好
sense_groups.english: Wow, those look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个有磨结做的头 这个是意大利香肠做的
sense_groups.english: Okay, this one's a mushroom cap. Uh, this one is made of bologna.

sense_groups.chinese: 牙签呢？ - 只是撑着等胶水干掉
sense_groups.english: And... And the toothpicks? - Just until the glue dries.

sense_groups.chinese: 成谢上帝
sense_groups.english: Thank God.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些比较逼真 但会腐烂
sense_groups.english: These are more realistic, but perishable.

sense_groups.chinese: 这儿 粉红色的鞣皮 很不错
sense_groups.english: Over here, we have pink suede, which is nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 但湿了会缩水
sense_groups.english: But if it gets wet, it'll shrink.

sense_groups.chinese: 把这个拿走好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe we'll just take that one away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也做了一个有毛的 不过那是给我自己的
sense_groups.english: I also did a little something in fur, but, uh, that's really just for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不如你去房间试试这些？ 我们就知道哪些有用
sense_groups.english: Why don't you try these on? We'll get a better idea of what works.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你真是位好朋友 这真是奇怪透顶
sense_groups.english: Thanks, you are such a good friend. And this is so weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 牙签？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Toothpick? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在在试那个？ - 水果卷
sense_groups.english: What are you trying now? - The Fruit Roll-up.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后呢？ - 很好吃
sense_groups.english: And? - Delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 等一下 冠军出现了
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Wait a minute. We have a winner!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？哪一个？
sense_groups.english: What? Which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再那么笨了
sense_groups.english: The Silly Putty. Not so silly anymore!

sense_groups.chinese: 她是你表妹 她是你表妹
sense_groups.english: She's your cousin. She's your cousin.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她知道你脑袋里在想什么 她会以为你有病
sense_groups.english: If she knew what was going on in your head, she'd think you were sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会吗？ 回想一下
sense_groups.english: Or would she? Let's back up for a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她提议开红酒的
sense_groups.english: She was the one who suggested opening a bottle of wine.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她把灯光调暗的
sense_groups.english: She was the one who turned down the lights.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她要租《二十三世纪大逃亡》的…
sense_groups.english: She was the one that wanted to rent Logan's Run...

sense_groups.chinese: 有史以来最性感的电影
sense_groups.english: ...the sexiest movie ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这眼神
sense_groups.english: I know that look.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管了 我想要 她想要
sense_groups.english: Forget it. I want it. She wants it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要行动了
sense_groups.english: I'm going in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在干什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 说点机智的
sense_groups.english: Say something clever.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不必机智的
sense_groups.english: Okay, doesn't have to be clever.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要说点什么 说话
sense_groups.english: Just has to be words. Say some words.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么话都好
sense_groups.english: Any words will do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 这是有史以来…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, this is the longest...

sense_groups.chinese: 最长的沉默
sense_groups.english: ...that anyone has not talked ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 说什么都不可能让情形更糟…
sense_groups.english: There is nothing you could say to make this worse...

sense_groups.chinese: 就说点什么
sense_groups.english: ...so just say something!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很久没做爱了
sense_groups.english: I haven't had sex in a very long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不该说话的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you really shouldn't have said anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？瑞秋？是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? Rachel? It's Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事这么急着找我来呢？
sense_groups.english: I wonder what you could possibly need me for on such short notice?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我们很抱歉 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica. We are so sorry. - For what?

sense_groups.chinese: 第一 忘了替你办告别单身女子派对
sense_groups.english: First, for forgetting to throw you a bridal shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后忘了邀请你
sense_groups.english: Then, forgetting to invite you to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们已经办完了？
sense_groups.english: You already had it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们打电话给你通讯录里每一个人 来了很多人
sense_groups.english: We called everyone in your phone book. A bunch of people came.

sense_groups.chinese: 但花了太多时间找到你 客人都走了
sense_groups.english: It took us so long to get you here that they had to leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想给你一个大惊喜 替你办一个大的告别单身女子派对
sense_groups.english: We wanted to throw you a big surprise and a great shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在两个都没了
sense_groups.english: Now you don't have either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们毁了一切 - 额
sense_groups.english: We ruined everything. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下 没有毁了一切 你们真的很好心
sense_groups.english: No, wait a minute, that's not true. What you did was really sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实这样子最好 - 什么意思？
sense_groups.english: It kind of works out for the best, heh. - What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我可以和我真正喜欢的人 一起共渡我的告别单身女子派对
sense_groups.english: Now I get to spend my shower with the only people I really love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我收了所有的礼物 而不必和我不喜欢的人说话
sense_groups.english: I get all those presents without talking to people I don't even like!

sense_groups.chinese: 惊喜 - 惊喜 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Surprise. - Surprise, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 最酷的是 这个角色是从尼泊尔来的
sense_groups.english: What's cool is, the character is from Naples, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 - 我全家都是从尼泊尔来的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - My whole family's from Naples.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我听得差不多了…
sense_groups.english: That's great. Okay. I've heard everything I need to hear...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只需要…
sense_groups.english: We just need to, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 莱斯莉？
sense_groups.english: Leslie?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这有点怪怪的 - 是 没有问题
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey, this is the awkward part. - Oh, hey, right. Not a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全了解…
sense_groups.english: I totally understand you need to...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们需要能确定 我没有可怕的疤痕或刺青
sense_groups.english: ...make sure I don't have any horrible scars or tattoos.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用担心
sense_groups.english: Don't you worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没什么要隐藏的
sense_groups.english: I have nothing to hide.

sense_groups.chinese: 这儿 这就是我
sense_groups.english: So, there you go. That's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 百分之百纯天然
sense_groups.english: One hundred-percent natural.

sense_groups.chinese: 这从来没发生过
sense_groups.english: I tell you, that has never happened before.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯西 一切都还好吗？
sense_groups.english: Cassie, are you finding everything okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你让我住这儿 是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Thank you so much for letting me stay here.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's no problem. I've...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 说话 随便说什么
sense_groups.english: Say something. Say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 约她出去 她不是你表妹
sense_groups.english: Ask her out! She's not your cousin!

questions.name: S07E20
questions.en:
Hey, out of all of us, who do you think will get married next?
Probably Monica and Chandler.
Hi, could I have a pack of Newport Lights?
Oh, um, uh, we don't sell cigarettes, but they do across the street.
That'd be great. Thanks.
Oh, my God.
Melissa Worbert. I don't think I have the energy for this.
Oh, my God! Ray-Ray Green?
Melissa. Hey.
You've been MIA for seven sorority newsletters.
What's up with you?
Why don't I tell you over here?
So last I heard you were gonna get married.
Oh.
Poor Ray-Ray.
Oh, no, no. It's... It's good. It's all good.
I actually work at Ralph Lauren. - Shut up!
I will not. Heh, heh. I'm the divisional head of men's sportswear.
Oh, shut up more! Are you friends with Ralph?
Oh, please. Ha. - Are you?
No.
Listen, we have to have dinner. What are you doing tomorrow?
Oh, tomorrow. I don't know. Um... - You're having dinner with me.
Shut up.
I've gotta go. This has been so great, Ray-Ray.
Oh, there you are.
Um, so listen, just call me. Here's my card.
Oh, wow, thanks.
Oh, you're in real estate? - Oh, no, heh, that's an old card.
Um, I got out of that to do something where I could...
...help people and make a difference.
Wow. What do you do now?
I'm a party planner.
I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.
Hey guys, look who's back. It's Ray-Ray.
That was my friend, Melissa, from college.
She seems really, really fun!
She's actually very sweet, and we used to be very close.
Wait a minute. She's not the one who you?
Who you what? Who you what?
Yes. - Wow!
Wow... Wow, what? Who you what?
Oh, it's not a big deal.
They were lovers.
What? - What?
No, we weren't. It was nothing.
It was one night, senior year, and we went to a party...
...had a lot of sangria, and you know, ended up...
...kissing for a bit.
So that's two of my wives.
Okay, so this is where the band is. And here's the bar.
And all these pins have people's names on them. Rach, here you are.
Oh, wow!
Why don't we just put me with a Manhattan in my hand...
...talking to the cute bartender.
These pins aren't for playing, are they?
Okay, the red ones are my guests, and the blue are yours.
This is so sad. I only have like 10 pins.
Heh, Chandler, relax. It's not a contest.
Certainly not a close one.
Hello. - Hey.
Hey, Rach.
Stop picturing it!
Okay, I think that's it. The seating chart is done. This is our wedding.
Wow. They all look like they're having fun.
So where are my parents gonna be?
Well, if this is the wedding hall, then, um...
...your parents would be over here at home in Queens.
They're not invited? Oh, no, they're gonna be crushed!
Why would they think they're invited?
You got me. I don't...
Joey! - Look, I thought parents were coming.
Your parents are coming. Chandler's parents are coming.
Ross' parents are coming.
Ross' parents are my parents.
Well, see, parents are coming.
We should invite them. - You just want more blue pins.
Well, this is just sad.
All right. Maybe I can fit them in if I just do some rearranging.
Rachel may have to sit at the bar.
That is not a problem.
Maybe you'll order a little sangria. - Oh, get out of here!
These are our tuxedos. If you like anything, we can make a deal.
Anything at all. But these are the three that Monica pre-approved.
Uh, well, thanks a lot for hooking me up.
And I want you to know that I want you to attend our wedding as my guest.
I'm Monica's maid of honor.
Okay, don't try to blue-pin me.
Well, these look nice. - They are nice.
When celebrities are done with them, they send them back.
You mean, like, for award shows? - Some of them.
They've been down the red carpet with people yelling, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是实力相近的比赛
sense_groups.english: Certainly not a close one.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hello. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再想像了
sense_groups.english: Stop picturing it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想这样可以了 座位表好了 这就是我们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think that's it. The seating chart is done. This is our wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们看来好像都很开心 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow. They all look like they're having fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈坐哪里？
sense_groups.english: So where are my parents gonna be?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这是结婚礼堂…
sense_groups.english: Well, if this is the wedding hall, then, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你父母会在皇后区的家里
sense_groups.english: ...your parents would be over here at home in Queens.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们没有被邀请？太糟了 他们一定会很伤心
sense_groups.english: They're not invited? Oh, no, they're gonna be crushed!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们为什么以为会被邀请呢？
sense_groups.english: Why would they think they're invited?

sense_groups.chinese: 你问倒我了 我不…
sense_groups.english: You got me. I don't...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 抱歉 我以为父母都会来
sense_groups.english: Joey! - Look, I thought parents were coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的父母会来 钱德的父母也会来
sense_groups.english: Your parents are coming. Chandler's parents are coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯的父母也会来
sense_groups.english: Ross' parents are coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯的父母就是我的父母
sense_groups.english: Ross' parents are my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 父母们都会来
sense_groups.english: Well, see, parents are coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该请他们 - 拜托 你只是想要增加蓝色大头针
sense_groups.english: We should invite them. - You just want more blue pins.

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在太惨了
sense_groups.english: Well, this is just sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 也许我可以把他们排进来 不过要重新安排位置
sense_groups.english: All right. Maybe I can fit them in if I just do some rearranging.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋可能真的要坐在吧台
sense_groups.english: Rachel may have to sit at the bar.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有问题
sense_groups.english: That is not a problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你可以叫一杯桑格利亚调酒 - 去你的
sense_groups.english: Maybe you'll order a little sangria. - Oh, get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们的礼服 如果有你喜欢的 可以便宜些
sense_groups.english: These are our tuxedos. If you like anything, we can make a deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 全部都可以 但这三件是摩妮卡先核准的
sense_groups.english: Anything at all. But these are the three that Monica pre-approved.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你替我们找到关系 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, thanks a lot for hooking me up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想请你做我的客人 参加我们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: And I want you to know that I want you to attend our wedding as my guest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡的伴娘
sense_groups.english: I'm Monica's maid of honor.

sense_groups.chinese: 别想把我变成蓝色大头针
sense_groups.english: Okay, don't try to blue-pin me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那这些呢？这些看起来不错 - 是不错
sense_groups.english: Well, these look nice. - They are nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 都是帮名人量身打造的 他们穿过后就送回来这儿
sense_groups.english: When celebrities are done with them, they send them back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指像颁奖典礼之后？ - 有些是
sense_groups.english: You mean, like, for award shows? - Some of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 这都上过红地毯 被人叫着
sense_groups.english: They've been down the red carpet with people yelling, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: "你是穿谁的？你看来棒极了 "
sense_groups.english: ..."Who are you wearing? You look fabulous!"

sense_groups.chinese: 容我建议你 多看一点ESPN体育台…
sense_groups.english: Might I suggest watching a little more ESPN...

sense_groups.chinese: 少看一点艺人八卦节目
sense_groups.english: ...and a little less E!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁穿过这些？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Who wore those?

sense_groups.chinese: 额…
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是汤姆布若考穿过的 - 不错嘛
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, this one's Tom Brokaw. - Not bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是保罗欧尼尔穿过的
sense_groups.english: This one is, uh, Paul O'Neil.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who's that?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是《洋基队》的球员 真的 多看ESPN
sense_groups.english: He plays for the Yankees. Seriously, ESPN.

sense_groups.chinese: 有的时候 开着当背景也好
sense_groups.english: Just once in a while. Have it on in the background.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是皮尔斯布洛斯南穿过的
sense_groups.english: Ooh, this one was Pierce Brosnan.

sense_groups.chinese: 皮尔斯布洛斯南？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Pierce Brosnan? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 詹姆士庞德的燕尾服？我一定要穿詹姆士庞德的燕尾服结婚
sense_groups.english: This is James Bond's tux? Oh, I have to get married in James Bond's tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 是很酷的礼服
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. It's a pretty cool tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只如此 我会是 英格兰最强大的武器
sense_groups.english: Ah, it's not just that. I would be England's most powerful weapon.

sense_groups.chinese: 女王陛下的秘密特务 环游世界的负心人
sense_groups.english: A jet-setting heartbreaker on Her Majesty's secret service.

sense_groups.chinese: 有杀人执照 什么都不怕的男人
sense_groups.english: A man who fears no one, with a license to kill.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡会不会让我穿这件？
sense_groups.english: Would Monica let me wear this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该学真正的玩法
sense_groups.english: We should really learn how to play the real way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢我们的玩法
sense_groups.english: I like our way.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 - 嘿 嘿
sense_groups.english: Ah! - Hey, hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 将军
sense_groups.english: Chess!

sense_groups.chinese: 走的好 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Nice move. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我替罗斯和钱德 找到燕尾服 你需要吗？
sense_groups.english: I hooked Ross and Chandler up with tuxedos. Do you need one?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我要主持婚礼 我不要穿燕尾服
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not wearing a tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你要穿什么？ - 多彩的袍子
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna wear? - Multi-colored robes.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许戴一顶帽子
sense_groups.english: Ooh, and maybe a hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡知道吗？ - 不知道
sense_groups.english: Huh. Does Monica know about this? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉她时我可以在场吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I please be there when you tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 晚上要不要去看电影？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, you want to go to a movie tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 没办法 我要和梅莉莎吃饭
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't. I'm having dinner with Melissa.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以跟你去吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I come?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会说话 你只会听见 我摄影机的声音
sense_groups.english: I won't talk. You'll just hear my video camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？怎么回事？ - 我可以告诉她吗？
sense_groups.english: What? What's going on? - Can I tell her?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要听真正发生的事 还是乔伊的淫荡版本？
sense_groups.english: Do you want what happened, or Joey's lewd version?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Joey's. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 少来
sense_groups.english: Okay, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 大学时我有一个朋友…
sense_groups.english: I had this college friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 我犯了一个很蠢的错误 告诉乔伊有一次…
sense_groups.english: ...and I made the mistake of telling Joey that one time...

sense_groups.chinese: 她和我接吻了
sense_groups.english: ...she and I, you know, kissed a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 是噢 我相信你们有
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm sure that happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的啊 - 当然
sense_groups.english: It did. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的发生了
sense_groups.english: Hey, heh. It happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 是大四那年 有一次姐妹会 开夏威夷主题派对…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it was senior year. It was after the Sigma Chi luau...

sense_groups.chinese: 我和梅莉莎喝得大醉
sense_groups.english: ...and Melissa and I got very drunk.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我们两个接吻了 好几分钟呢
sense_groups.english: And we ended up kissing. For several minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那表示她喝了几杯 轻轻吻在脸颊上
sense_groups.english: Which means she had a couple spritzers and a peck on the cheek.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要剥夺我的幻想？ - 额
sense_groups.english: Why are you taking this away from me? - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么这么难让你相信？
sense_groups.english: Why is it so hard for you to believe?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我不知道你是同性恋
sense_groups.english: Okay. I just didn't know that you were a lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说我是同性恋 我只是说那件事发生了
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying that I'm a lesbian. I'm just saying that this happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是那觉得很狂野 而你是这么地…
sense_groups.english: It just seems pretty wild. And you're... You know, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 乖宝宝
sense_groups.english: ...vanilla.

sense_groups.chinese: 乖宝宝？我不是乖宝宝 我会做很多疯狂的事
sense_groups.english: Vanilla? I'm not vanilla. I do lots of crazy things.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还喝醉了 在拉斯维加斯结婚
sense_groups.english: I mean, I got drunk and married in Vegas.

sense_groups.chinese: 和罗斯
sense_groups.english: To Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 如果你不相信我…
sense_groups.english: If you don't believe me...

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚和我一起去吃饭 她会告诉你
sense_groups.english: ...just come with me to dinner tonight and she'll tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 因为我想像不出来
sense_groups.english: Okay. Because I can't picture it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该看看我脑袋里的画面
sense_groups.english: You should get inside my head.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 猜我为你的婚礼弄到什么？
sense_groups.english: Guess what I got for your wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 瘦巴巴的女伴？
sense_groups.english: A freakishly thin date with a hanger for a head?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋替我弄到一件燕尾服 但不是随便一件
sense_groups.english: Rachel hooked me up with a tux. But not just any tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 是蝙蝠侠的
sense_groups.english: Batman's tux!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: What? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 特快速做给方基墨 让他穿在票房冠军电影…
sense_groups.english: Made expressly for Val Kilmer, and worn by him in the hit film...

sense_groups.chinese: 他演的那部蝙蝠侠电影里
sense_groups.english: ...that Batman film he was in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能穿那件 我要穿名人的燕尾服
sense_groups.english: You can't wear that. I'm wearing the famous tux.

sense_groups.chinese: 詹姆士庞德的燕尾服 - 那又怎样？
sense_groups.english: James Bond's tux. - So?

sense_groups.chinese: 那又怎样？如果你穿那件 会让我的不那么特别
sense_groups.english: If you wear that, it'll make mine less special.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要什么东西来让那天特别吗？
sense_groups.english: You need something to to make it special?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 你有了最特别的一样
sense_groups.english: Hello! You have the most special thing of all.

sense_groups.chinese: 你娶了你爱的女人
sense_groups.english: You are marrying the woman you love.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托不要抢走我的锋头 拜托拜托？
sense_groups.english: Don't take away my cool thing. Pretty please?

sense_groups.chinese: "拜托拜托？"不怎么007
sense_groups.english: "Pretty please?" Not very, uh, 007.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要结婚 我不会做任何让你生气的事
sense_groups.english: If you were getting married, I'd never do anything to upset you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我结婚的时候 你和我妹妹上床 - 那就很007
sense_groups.english: You slept with my sister. - That was pretty 007.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 好 你来了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. Okay, good. You're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我想出办法来了
sense_groups.english: All right, I figured it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把这两桌的8个人 加上你父母…
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take 2 tables of 8, add your parents...

sense_groups.chinese: 变成3桌6个人
sense_groups.english: ...and make them into 3 tables of 6.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经通知了办酒席的人 要多做两份 都弄好了
sense_groups.english: And I called the caterer. We are good to go!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不来了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. They're not coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们觉得 你是因为我才邀请他们的
sense_groups.english: They think that you only invited them because of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们觉得不被欢迎
sense_groups.english: They feel unwanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 真糟糕 那是真的 不过还是很糟糕
sense_groups.english: That's too bad. It's true. But too bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你可以打电话给我妈 - 乔伊
sense_groups.english: If you could just call my mom. - Oh, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 让她知道你希望他们去
sense_groups.english: Come on. Just let her know you want them there.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要忘记 多年来 她送过你很多很多千层面
sense_groups.english: Let's not forget this is a woman who has sent you many lasagnas.

sense_groups.chinese: 她哪有
sense_groups.english: No, she hasn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些没送到你手里不是她的错
sense_groups.english: Is it her fault if some didn't make it to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说什么？
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna say?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉她请帖搞乱了 不 怪邮局好了
sense_groups.english: Just tell them you mixed up invitations. No, no, no, blame it on the post office.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们最恨邮局 还有爱尔兰人
sense_groups.english: They hate the post office. And the Irish.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我想你不能怪到他们头上
sense_groups.english: But I don't think you could blame it on them.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？你好 崔比亚尼太太吗？ 我是摩妮卡盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hello? Yeah, hi. Uh, Mrs. Tribbiani? Hi, this is Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想告诉你 钱德跟我很希望 你们能来参加婚礼
sense_groups.english: I'm just calling to say that I really hope you can make the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很多请帖都没寄到
sense_groups.english: Apparently some of our invitations weren't delivered.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜又是可恶的邮局搞砸的
sense_groups.english: Um, I guess there was some screw-up at the damn post office.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是嘛
sense_groups.english: Tell me about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么美国邮局嘛？ 更像是美国遗失局
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the U.S. Post Office? No. More like U.S. Lost Office.

sense_groups.chinese: 搞什么嘛 都是爱尔兰人吗？
sense_groups.english: What are they, Irish?

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫艾伦 我们在一起三年了
sense_groups.english: Anyway, his name's Allen. And we've been going out for three years.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我做宴会规划的第一位客户
sense_groups.english: He was my first client when I became a party planner.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时他正要为当时的女朋友 规划一场宴会
sense_groups.english: He was actually planning a party for his girlfriend at the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果就是这样罗 - 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, well. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是雪城大学兄弟会的 - 真好
sense_groups.english: Ah. He was Theta Beta Pi at Syracuse. - Oh! Oh, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你参加过姐妹会吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, were you ever in a sorority? - Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是大卫生棉条的成员
sense_groups.english: Yes. I was a, um, Thigh Mega Tampon.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一个？
sense_groups.english: What one?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也很庞大 但后来被关掉了…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we were huge too. But they had to shut us down...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为瑞吉娜佛兰姬基死于酒精中毒
sense_groups.english: ...when Regina Phalangie died of alcohol poisoning.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是糟糕 一颗老鼠屎就毁了一锅粥
sense_groups.english: Isn't it a shame when one girl ruins it for the whole bunch?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Mm-hm. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管了…
sense_groups.english: Anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 讲到喝太多 我告诉菲比…
sense_groups.english: Speaking of drinking too much, I was, uh, telling Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 姐妹会开夏威夷派对 很疯的那晚 我们亲吻的事
sense_groups.english: ...about that crazy night after the Sigma Chi luau where we made out.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我们…我们穿着沙龙 还有椰子壳比基尼上衣
sense_groups.english: Remember we... Come on, we had sarongs on and the coconut bikini tops.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后我们回到家 在那儿疯癫…
sense_groups.english: We went back to the house and got really silly...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我们接吻了
sense_groups.english: ...and we made out.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞瑞 我不知道你在说什么
sense_groups.english: Wow, Ray-Ray, I have no idea what you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯是蝙蝠侠
sense_groups.english: Ross is Batman.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还真会掩护秘密身份 瞒了这么久
sense_groups.english: Well, he did manage to keep his identity secret for a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋替罗斯弄到 方基墨在《蝙蝠侠》里穿的燕尾服
sense_groups.english: Rachel got Ross the tuxedo that Val Kilmer wore in Batman.

sense_groups.chinese: 蝙蝠侠比詹姆士庞德酷多了
sense_groups.english: Batman is so much cooler than James Bond.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么啊？007有很多工具 - 蝙蝠侠有工具腰带
sense_groups.english: What? 007 has all those gadgets. - Batman has a utility belt.

sense_groups.chinese: 007有很炫的车 - 蝙蝠侠有蝙蝠车
sense_groups.english: 007 has a fancy car. - Batman has the Batmobile.

sense_groups.chinese: 007有很多女人 - 蝙蝠侠有罗宾
sense_groups.english: 007 gets all the ladies. - Heh. Batman has Robin.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有ESPN台 对吧？
sense_groups.english: We get ESPN, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你何不去穿上你的007燕尾服 我来替你调一杯马丁尼
sense_groups.english: How about you go put on your 007 tuxedo, and I'll make you a nice martini?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢马丁尼
sense_groups.english: Actually I don't like martinis.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有搞笑吸管的摇摇饮料呢？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: A Yoo-Hoo with a funny straw? - Ooh, yum.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 请帖上写晚上6点
sense_groups.english: I know the invitation says 6:00...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是指6点入席 还是6点开始表演？
sense_groups.english: ...but does that mean get there at 6, or the show starts at 6?

sense_groups.chinese: "表演"？
sense_groups.english: The show?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 婚礼 知道了
sense_groups.english: Right, the wedding. Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过婚礼会晚一点开始 对不对？
sense_groups.english: But weddings start a little late, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有参加过我规划的婚礼吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever been to one of my weddings?

sense_groups.chinese: 那天我外甥女也要受洗…
sense_groups.english: Ah, well, it's the same day as my niece's christening...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我父母能准时出席来看我
sense_groups.english: ...and I want my parents to see me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的部分是在开始时 我不在剩下的表演…婚礼
sense_groups.english: My part's in the beginning. I'm not in the rest of the show... Wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼6点开始
sense_groups.english: The wedding starts at 6.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我听到了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I totally hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样如何？我可以表演到他们到达
sense_groups.english: Ooh! How about this? I vamp till they get there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要"表演"？
sense_groups.english: Heh. You'll "vamp"?

sense_groups.chinese: 像是和观众打诨 问他们从哪儿来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah, like warm up the crowd. Ask where they're from.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为有乔伊崔比亚尼在 就同时有教士和演艺人员
sense_groups.english: In Joey Tribbiani, you get a minister and an entertainer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是一位"教演人"
sense_groups.english: I'm a "ministainer."

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？
sense_groups.english: All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有更好的 不会有更棒的
sense_groups.english: There's no one better. There's no one greater.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能不记得我们接吻的事？
sense_groups.english: How can you not remember us kissing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 我不记得 很多从没发生过的事
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I don't remember a lot of things that never happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Wha...

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 记得我们在寝廊里 一直笑一直笑吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember, we were on the sleeping porch? We couldn't stop giggling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的椰子壳撞在一起
sense_groups.english: Our coconuts kept knocking together.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊的头在某处爆炸了
sense_groups.english: Somewhere Joey's head is exploding.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不是想 让你觉得不自在…
sense_groups.english: I don't want to make you uncomfortable...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我告诉菲比那件事 她不相信我
sense_groups.english: ...but I told Phoebe it happened, and she doesn't believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 瑞瑞 如果我认为真有那回事 我会承认的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I mean, if I thought it happened, I would say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许我昏睡过去了 你在我睡觉时对我做了什么
sense_groups.english: Maybe I passed out and you did stuff to me while I was sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 没关系的 不用这么做 我相信你
sense_groups.english: It's okay, you don't have to do this. I believe you.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你说你吻过梅莉莎 你就是吻过梅莉莎
sense_groups.english: If you say you kissed Melissa, then you kissed Melissa.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 菲比 - 好
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Phoebe. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 可是她没有 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: But she didn't. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你带着它走来走去？
sense_groups.english: You carry that around?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现这是个好话题
sense_groups.english: I find it to be something of a conversation piece.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和…？ - 阿甘
sense_groups.english: Between you and? - Gunther.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起穿上吧
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. Why don't we put them on?

sense_groups.chinese: 拍一张蝙蝠侠和 詹姆士庞德一起的照片
sense_groups.english: Get a picture of Batman and James Bond, together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意 但是我的不合身 裤子小了一点
sense_groups.english: I would, but my pants are a little tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 小了一点？我可以看到 里面的两个0和一个7
sense_groups.english: A little tight? I could see 00 and 7 in those things.

sense_groups.chinese: 真糟糕 我还很期持 穿着我们的名人燕尾服一起亮相
sense_groups.english: I was looking forward to wearing our celebrity tuxes together.

sense_groups.chinese: 那表示你不穿你的了？ - 你开玩笑吗？这是蝙蝠侠的燕尾服
sense_groups.english: So you're not gonna be wearing yours? - Are you kidding? It's Batman's tux!

sense_groups.chinese: 我试穿看看
sense_groups.english: Let me try it on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 只有外套 0O和7不要进去
sense_groups.english: Okay. But just the jacket. 00 and 7 are not getting in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 双面通风的舒适感 蝙蝠侠
sense_groups.english: Holy double-vented comfort, Batman!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么？ - 哈？
sense_groups.english: What's this? - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 《真情难舍》首映的请柬？
sense_groups.english: An invitation to the At First Sight premiere?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 方基墨没有 在《蝙蝠侠》里穿这件
sense_groups.english: Val Kilmer didn't wear this in Batman.

sense_groups.chinese: 他穿这件去参加 他演瞎子的那部文艺爱情片首映
sense_groups.english: He wore it to the premiere of a fruity love story where he was a blind guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我看
sense_groups.english: Let me see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 老天
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你唯一的超能力 是稍微强化的嗅觉
sense_groups.english: The only super power you have is the slightly heightened sense of smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 钱德 可以和你们谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, can I talk to you guys for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我放弃了 你要怎样就怎样吧
sense_groups.english: I give up. Whatever you want, you can have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要唱歌还是跳舞？
sense_groups.english: You want to sing a song or do a dance?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是要你妈在祭坛前 吼出种族歧视的字眼？我都不在乎
sense_groups.english: You want your mom at the altar screaming racial slurs? I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要谢谢你们 为我父母做的一切
sense_groups.english: No. I just want to thank you guys for what you did for my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很高兴 能参与你们最特别的一天
sense_groups.english: They're so happy to get to be a part of your special day.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 告诉他们 我们很高兴他们会来
sense_groups.english: Well, your welcome. Tell them we're glad they're coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会的 给你们看 我婚礼要穿的衣服 他们替我准备的
sense_groups.english: I will. Oh, check out what they got me to wear for the ceremony!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我替你们证婚时这样戴 然后…
sense_groups.english: I wear it like this when I marry you guys. And then this...

sense_groups.chinese: 在宴会时这样戴
sense_groups.english: ...is for party time.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是真的 我告诉你那发生过
sense_groups.english: It happened. I am telling you it happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Hey, it was great meeting you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 瑞秋？我想我不会 打电话给你了 因为…
sense_groups.english: And, uh, Rachel? I don't think I'll be calling you because, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你变得好奇怪
sense_groups.english: ...you know, you've gotten weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 保重 两位
sense_groups.english: Take care, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 好 听着
sense_groups.english: Wha... Wait a minute. Okay, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 那天晚上是我所做过 最狂野的一件事
sense_groups.english: That night was the one wild thing I've ever done in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让你这样抹煞掉
sense_groups.english: I won't let you take it away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不记得那件事 也许你会记得这个…
sense_groups.english: So if you don't remember that, maybe you'll remember this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 你爱我
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You love me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我当然记得我们的吻
sense_groups.english: What? - Of course I remember our kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想着这件事
sense_groups.english: I think about it all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还能听到 椰子壳碰在一起的声音…
sense_groups.english: I can still hear the coconuts knocking together, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想告诉你 因为我不觉得 你会回报我的爱 现在你回报…
sense_groups.english: I didn't want to tell you, because I didn't think you'd return my love.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇哦…
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 你害羞了
sense_groups.english: Aw! Look who's being suddenly shy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定和我有一样的感觉
sense_groups.english: You have to feel what I feel.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定要发自于真心 才能吻得那么好
sense_groups.english: Nobody can kiss that good and not mean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是吻功很好
sense_groups.english: I'm just a good kisser.

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必道歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, you don't have to be sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: I'm obviously kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没爱上你 我没爱上她
sense_groups.english: I'm not in love with you. I'm not in love with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没听到椰子壳撞在一起的声音
sense_groups.english: I don't hear coconuts banging together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和男友做爱时没幻想你的脸
sense_groups.english: I don't picture your face when I make love to my boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 吻别一下吧？
sense_groups.english: A kiss goodbye?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要？好吧
sense_groups.english: No? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Wow!

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全不知道那会…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I had no idea that that would...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What the hell was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 想看看这一场混乱是怎么来的
sense_groups.english: Just wanted to see what all the fuss was about.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后呢？ - 我有过更好的
sense_groups.english: And? - I've had better.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我找到一件合身的
sense_groups.english: I found one that fits.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 人们常说 第23次就会成功
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what they say? 23rd time's a charm.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 好英俊
sense_groups.english: Aw! Look at you, all handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁穿过这件？ - 有关系吗？
sense_groups.english: Whose is it? - Oh, does it matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一重要的是你看来很英俊
sense_groups.english: All that matters is that you look so handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁的？ - 我不想讲
sense_groups.english: Whose is it? - I don't want to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 是谁的？
sense_groups.english: Come on, I don't care. Whose is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 黛安基顿
sense_groups.english: Diane Keaton.

questions.name: S07E21
questions.en:
Do you realize we're getting married in four weeks?
Four weeks, baby. Four weeks!
You realize you get louder each week?
There's still so much to do! Have you written your vows?
I figured I'd just buy those. "Pat, I'd like to buy a vow." Ha, ha.
You know I've no sense of humor when it comes to this.
Right. Have you written yours yet? - No, but I know what I'm gonna say.
Do you happen to know what I'm gonna say?
Let's do it now. It won't be hard.
Say what's in your heart.
Look at her go. She must love me more than I love her!
What's wrong with me? Ooh, don't open that door.
Phew. "Monica, there are no words..."
There are no words! This shouldn't be this hard!
Uh... Oh! You've done this before. What did you say in your vows?
With Carol I promised never to love another woman until I die.
She made no such promise.
I'm pathetic. Monica knows what to say, you should have seen her.
What's the emergency?
You have to help me write my vows. All I have is this.
I like the pretty drawing of you in the wedding dress.
Thank you. - Except your breasts look small.
Those are my eyes!
Those are my breasts. - Oh, yeah.
Why don't you start with something simple?
Like, um
"Monica, from the moment I met you I knew I loved you."
I can't do that.
Everyone, this is Chandler.
Hi, I'm Ross' little sister.
Okay.
Okay, okay. Um, maybe you could start with
"Chandler, even though we were friends...
...there was a part of me that knew I wanted more."
All right, there's a nuclear holocaust. I'm the last man on Earth.
Would you go out with me?
Ooh! Are we allowed to lie in the vows?
Okay, don't talk about those feelings. Just say something about...
...all the things he's taught you, like...
Or all the things you taught him.
Everybody knows the erogenous zones. One, two, three...
There are seven?
That's one? - Heh, heh. Kind of an important one.
I was looking at it upside down.
Ha. You know, sometimes that helps.
Okay, start out with a little one...
Oh! I got it. How about something like
"Monica, when I look back over our time together..."
Yeah? - I can't do all of it.
Look back over your time together.
Oh, look, twins!
No fair! I don't even have one, how come they get two?
You'll get one. - Yeah, when?
All right, I'll tell you what.
When we're 40, if neither of us are married...
...what do you say we have one? - Why wouldn't I be married?
Oh, no, no, no. I just meant hypothetically.
Hypothetically, why won't I be married?
No, no.
What is it? Is there something unmarriable about me?
Uh... Uh... - Well?
Dear God, this parachute is a knapsack!
I'm getting married today!
Think he knew I was here?
Nice try.
Wait, wait, wait.
Look, Monica... - Ah!
This is not gonna work. - I bet this'll work.
You are so great! I love you.
What?
I said you're so great, and then I stopped talking.
You said you love me! - No, I didn't.
Yes, you did. - No, I didn't!
You love me! - No, I don't!
Stop it! Stop it!
You know, I was thinking, what if I, uh, unpack here?
Then all your stuff would be here.
Well...
What if it was here?
Then you'd be going back and forth all the time.
Doesn't make any sense.
Okay.
What if we live together, and you understand what I'm saying?
We wanted to surprise you.
Oh, my God!
Chandler...
...in all my life...
...I never thought I'd be so lucky...
...as to fall in love with my best...
My best... There's a reason why girls don't do this!
Okay, okay, okay! I'll do it.
I thought...
I can do this.
I thought...
...that it mattered what I said or where I said it.
Then I realized the only thing that matters is that you...
You make me happier than I ever thought I could be.
And if you let me...
...I'll spend the rest of my life trying to make you feel the same way.
Monica?
Will you marry me?
Yes.
Can we come in? We're dying out here!
Come in! Come in!
We're engaged! - Yes!
Hey. - Hey.
Hi. - What have you guys been up to?
Uh, helping Chandler write his vows. He kicked us out.
Joey kept making inappropriate suggestions.
How is "Monica, I love your sweet ass" inappropriate?
How's Monica doing?
Lucky she's got a sweet ass. She's not so good at writing.
In four weeks they're gonna be married!
Let's just hope it works.
Nine out of 10 marriages end in divorce.
Heh. That's not true.
You're right. How's the missus?
I can't believe...
...they're together 3 years. - That long?
It seems like less because they hid it from us.
Hey, it's me. Coming in.
I've had a very long, hard day.
Uh, I'm getting chicken. Want some? - Uh, no. Bye, then.
Are you okay? I'm so sorry.
He wouldn't leave. He kept asking if I wanted chicken.
Chicken?
I could eat some chicken.
Hey, Joe!
Can I get a, uh, three-piece, uh, coleslaw, beans and a Coke?
Diet Coke.
Why didn't they tell us? - I know, we were cool about it.
You? And you?
You cannot tell. No one knows.
How? When?
It happened in London. - In London?
We didn't want to make a big deal out of it.
But it is a big deal!
I have to tell someone. - No, no!
You can't. - Please!
We don't want to deal with telling them. Just promise you won't tell.
All right!
I can't wait to be with you.
I'll tell Rachel I'm doing laundry.
Laundry, huh? Is that my new nickname?
Aw.
You know your nickname, Mr. Big...
Oh, look, there's Monica and Chandler. Hey! Hey, you guys! Hey!
Chandler and Monica!
Oh, my God!
Aah! Chandler and Monica! - Oh, my God!
Oh, my eyes! My eyes! - Phoebe! Phoebe!
It's okay! It's okay! - No! They're doing it!
I know! I know!
You know? - Yes!
And Joey, but Ross doesn't, so stop screaming!

Joey!

Joey, you can't say anything.
Couldn't if I wanted to.
This is totally getting out of hand.
She wants me to put lotion on her! - She's bluffing!
She's not backing down. She went like this.
He's not backing down. He went to get lotion.

Wow! You didn't rip off any buttons.

Our first kiss.

Love her! That's right, I love her! I love her!

I love you too, Chandler.
I thought you guys were doing it, I didn't know you were in love.

Well, Ross doesn't. - We'd like it if no one told him yet.
No.
What are you doing?
Get off my sister!
Friends getting married, it's gotta change things.
Think it'll be different?
How can it not be? They're gonna have kids...
...and hang out with other couples who have kids.
And maybe they'll leave the city...
...to be near a Volvo dealership.
Things change.
I don't want them to move to a Volvo dealership.
It'll be okay, Joe. Heh.
Sorry. I just... I like things the way they are.
Who's this little naked guy?
Uh, that naked guy would be me.
Ha, aw, look at the little thing. - Ha-ha-ha.
Yes.
Yes, fine, that is my penis. Can we be grownups now?

Oh, that's Nana right there.
Wow. - Let's see.
"Me and the gang at Java Joe's."
Wow. Monica, you look like your grandma. How old was she?
Let's see, 1939.
Yeah, uh, 24, 25.
Huh. Looks like a fun gang.
Ooh! Look, look, look! I got Monica naked.
Let me see.
No, that would be me again.
Hey, you guys.
Hey. - Hey.
What's going on? - Well, we were just talking about...
...you guys getting married and how great it is.
Yeah, you can get a Volvo. If that's what you really want.
That's so sweet. - Hmm.
So, we both finished our vows. - Can we read them?
As long as I don't hear his and he doesn't hear mine.
Okay. - Okay.
Aw. - Oh.
Oh, that's beautiful.
Funny one! Good!
Will you marry me?
Ha-ha-ha. - What? I don't get it.
Oh, yeah!
Man, this is hilarious! - Chandler!
Don't worry, we'll make yours funnier.

sense_groups.english: I think so too. And that little flap? Great for holding my lipstick.
