sense_groups.english: He even came to New York. I said I was too busy.

sense_groups.chinese: 整个就是"恶意缺席" 我真的不想谈
sense_groups.english: It's very "Cat's in the Cradle." I don't want to get into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 节目要开始了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位先生 各位女士 让我们欢迎举世无双的…
sense_groups.english: Ladies and gentlemen...

sense_groups.chinese: 海莲娜汉德巴斯奇
sense_groups.english: ...please welcome the incomparable Helena Handbasket.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我的小亲亲们
sense_groups.english: Hello, darlings.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就是我爸
sense_groups.english: And there's Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 快跟我换位置 快点 我从下面钻过去 你从上面过来
sense_groups.english: Okay. Switch places with me. Come on! I'll go under, you go over.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啦 - 快点 我很愿意 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'll get right on that. - Ugh, come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不 瑞秋 别那样快点
sense_groups.english: What? No. Hey, Rach, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信我们不会因此被捕
sense_groups.english: I'm sure we won't get arrested for this.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: God!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 警官 我的速度有点快吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, officer. Was I going a little too fast?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你把驾照拿出来 - 当然 没问题
sense_groups.english: Can I see your license, please? - Oh, yes, absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太奇怪了 我昨晚做了一个梦 梦到我被警察拦下来
sense_groups.english: It's weird. I had a dream last night that I was stopped by a policeman.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后他…
sense_groups.english: And then he, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我不该告诉你 接下来的情节
sense_groups.english: Well, I probably shouldn't tell you the rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的驾照 - 对 在这里 警官…
sense_groups.english: Your license. - Yes. Ahem. Here you go, Officer, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 帅哥警官
sense_groups.english: ...Handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 是韩森才对 - 喔 对不起 我看错了
sense_groups.english: It's Hanson. - Oops, sorry. My mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Dear Lord!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 这可好了
sense_groups.english: Wow! - Here it comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 这张照片很漂亮
sense_groups.english: This is a great picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？你真的那么想？ 拍照时我才刚刚起床
sense_groups.english: Really? You think so? You know, I had just rolled right out of bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你看起来很美
sense_groups.english: You look phenomenal.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错 那是十年前的照片了
sense_groups.english: She should! It was taken 10 years ago!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 或许…
sense_groups.english: You know, you're probably, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有点纳闷 日期好像不太对劲
sense_groups.english: Probably wondering about the old date.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你是水瓶座吗？
sense_groups.english: Yes, I am. You're an Aquarius, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说你是双子座 - 不是
sense_groups.english: I'll bet you're a Gemini. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 金牛座？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: Taurus? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 处女座？ - 不是
sense_groups.english: Virgo? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 射手座？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Sagittarius? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道
sense_groups.english: I knew it. I knew it!

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧 不要再超速了 好吗？ - 我不会超速了
sense_groups.english: You won't speed anymore, right? - I won't speed.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且发誓你会去换驾照 - 我发誓
sense_groups.english: Promise to take care of this? - I promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 让他开车 他有驾照吗？
sense_groups.english: Let him drive. Does he have a license?

sense_groups.chinese: 有 - 他会开手排的车吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Can he handle a stick?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛… - 我会开手排的车
sense_groups.english: Oh, well... - I can handle a stick!

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋
sense_groups.english: Gay

sense_groups.chinese: 他不可能是你爸 - 多年来我一直这样告诉我自己
sense_groups.english: That can't be your father. - I've been saying that for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 弹钢琴的人就是嘉利巴迪老师
sense_groups.english: That's Mr. Garibaldi playing the piano.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 欢迎大家来看表演
sense_groups.english: Hello, and welcome to the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 在观众席中我看到一些常客
sense_groups.english: I see some of our regulars in the audience.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一些新面孔
sense_groups.english: And a couple of irregulars.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要走进观众席里了 - 别紧张 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: He's coming into the audience. - Relax. You'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好多了 现在你成了隐形人
sense_groups.english: Oh, much better. You're invisible now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是从哪里来的？ - 贝克斯菲德
sense_groups.english: Where are you from? - Bakersfield.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起？ - 贝克斯菲德
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry? - Bakersfield.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我听到了 我只是觉得很遗憾
sense_groups.english: No, no, I heard. I'm just sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法接受这种事情 我们回饭店碰面
sense_groups.english: I'll meet you back at the hotel.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家看 已经有人站起来鼓掌了 节目刚刚开始
sense_groups.english: Look, a standing ovation already. So early in the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 转身吧 小亲亲 让我看看你帅气的脸
sense_groups.english: Turn around, darling. Let me see your pretty face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的饮料能快点送上来吗？ 服务生？小姐？
sense_groups.english: Can we have our drinks, please? Uh, waiter? ...tress?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈？
sense_groups.english: Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 很有男子气概吧？
sense_groups.english: How much of a man am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 太棒了 很有男子气概 但也是个荡妇
sense_groups.english: Wow, nice. Manly, and also kind of a slut.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始了解杰克的意思了
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm beginning to see what Jake was talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 额 - 真丝内裤的感觉真的很舒服
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - The silk feels really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 而那玩意儿不像我想像中那样 会挤成一团
sense_groups.english: And things aren't as smashed down as I thought they would be.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是太棒了 乔伊
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且男人的内裤选择没那么多
sense_groups.english: You have so many more choices than with men's underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 比基尼 三角裤 丁字裤 质料还有棉 丝跟蕾丝
sense_groups.english: Bikini, French cut, thong. And the fabrics: Cotton, silk, lace.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我一直想穿什么吗？裤袜
sense_groups.english: You know what I've always wondered about? Pantyhose!

sense_groups.chinese: 从脚趾头开始一路往上拉到…
sense_groups.english: The way they start at your toe, then they go all the way up to...

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该把内裤脱下来 对吧？ - 我想你最好脱下来
sense_groups.english: I should go take these off. - I think it's important you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: What's your name?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的名字真是与众不同
sense_groups.english: What an unusual name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的父母一定是很精彩的人物
sense_groups.english: You must have had terribly fascinating parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 他们很有趣
sense_groups.english: Oh, they're a hoot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的朋友叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: And who is your friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: I'm Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你们从哪里来的？ - 纽约
sense_groups.english: Monica. Where are you from? - New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不太喜欢纽约
sense_groups.english: I'm not very fond of New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我喜欢皇后区
sense_groups.english: Queens, I like.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个亮晶晶的…
sense_groups.english: Ooh, what is this...

sense_groups.chinese: 东西是什么啊 甜心？
sense_groups.english: ...sparkling something, honey, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 摩妮卡跟我已经订婚了
sense_groups.english: Actually, Monica and I are engaged.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你们
sense_groups.english: Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们什么时候结婚？
sense_groups.english: When's the big day?

sense_groups.chinese: 两星期后
sense_groups.english: In two weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了
sense_groups.english: I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 祝你们两个永远幸福
sense_groups.english: Well, I wish you both a lifetime of happiness.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你是个秃头
sense_groups.english: So you're bald.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们希望你能来参加我们的婚礼
sense_groups.english: We'd really love it if you could be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 那会让我很快乐…
sense_groups.english: I know it would make me happy...

sense_groups.chinese: 夫人
sense_groups.english: ...ma'am.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我一定会去的
sense_groups.english: Then I wouldn't miss it for the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都热泪盈眶了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm getting all misty here. Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一定会以为 我刚刚用热蜡除过腿毛
sense_groups.english: You'd think I was having my legs waxed or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吗？ - 我很好
sense_groups.english: You okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你逼我这么做
sense_groups.english: Thanks for making me do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 在继续表演前 我要跟这对新人说…
sense_groups.english: Before we go on with the show, I want to say to the bride and groom...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们非常幸运能找到彼此
sense_groups.english: ...how lucky they are to have found each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人的人生都会遇到雨天
sense_groups.english: In every life a little rain must fall.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好…
sense_groups.english: Fortunately...

sense_groups.chinese: 在我的人生中…
sense_groups.english: ...in my life...

sense_groups.chinese: 我小时候演过最左边那个角色
sense_groups.english: When I was growing up, I played the one on the far left.

sense_groups.chinese: 提醒我介绍你给某人认识
sense_groups.english: Remind me to introduce you to someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？ - 四档
sense_groups.english: Who? - Fourth gear.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他想做什么？我什么都没做
sense_groups.english: What does he want? I wasn't doing anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他看到你的手 不小心从十点和两点的位置滑下来
sense_groups.english: Maybe he saw your hands slip briefly from the 10 and 2:00 position.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是射手座警官 折回来想泡你
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's, uh, Sergeant Sagittarius coming back to flirt some more.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是刚刚那个警官
sense_groups.english: It's a different guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 警官 - 你知道你的时速有多快吗？
sense_groups.english: Good evening, officer. - Do you know how fast you were going?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不知道 但应该没有超过六十英哩
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, I don't, but it could not have been more than 60.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 只有三十七英哩
sense_groups.english: You're right. It was 37.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该不会因为我开得太慢 要开我罚单吧？
sense_groups.english: You're not ticketing me for driving too slow, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 警官…
sense_groups.english: You know, officer, I, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我做了一个非常奇怪的梦
sense_groups.english: I had the weirdest dream last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你把驾照拿出来
sense_groups.english: Your license, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想听听我做了什么梦…
sense_groups.english: You don't want to hear about my dream...

sense_groups.chinese: 警官…
sense_groups.english: ...Officer...

sense_groups.chinese: 漂亮警官？
sense_groups.english: ...Pretty?

sense_groups.chinese: 是佩堤警官
sense_groups.english: It's Petty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去开罚单马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be right back with your ticket.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有个儿子 - 我知道 我知道
sense_groups.english: You have a son. - I know. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得好一点了吗？ - 我好多了
sense_groups.english: Feel better? - Yeah. Much. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着…
sense_groups.english: Listen, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是想证明我的男子气概…
sense_groups.english: Not that I'm insecure about my manhood or anything, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我觉得我需要马上去泡个女人
sense_groups.english: ...I need to hook up with a woman right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 - 好 好
sense_groups.english: I understand. - Yeah, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来好眼熟 我认识你吗？
sense_groups.english: You look familiar. Do I know you?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该不认识
sense_groups.english: I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许是因为我是电视演员
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's because I'm on television.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在《我们的日子》里演出 - 哇 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm an actor on Days ofour Lives. - Wow. Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 共是四块半 谢谢 - 喔 让我来吧
sense_groups.english: Four-fifty, please. - Oh, let me get this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是送你的
sense_groups.english: These are for you.

questions.name: S07E23
questions.en:
Do you realize this is the last time we'll be here in the coffeehouse...
...as six single people?
What's happening to the coffeehouse?
Oh! Okay.
From now on, it's you four and me and the missus.
The little woman. The wife. The old ball and chain.
Old? - The young, hot ball and chain.
Much better. - We gotta go.
Where? - Get the dress and lunch with mom.
Joey, you too?
I just heard "lunch."
Yeah, I can go. Sure.
Actually, I'm glad they're leaving.
I need to talk to you about something.
What's up? - This may be a little awkward.
If you need money, it's a bad time. I'm buying dinner for 128 people tomorrow.
No, it's not that.
I'm not gonna say this as your friend...
...but as Monica's older brother.
But you're still my friend? - Not for a few minutes.
Right now, are you still my best man? - No.
Do I still call you Ross? - Okay.
You guys are getting married, and I couldn't be more thrilled.
But as Monica's older brother, I have to tell you this
If you ever hurt my little sister...
...if you ever cause her any unhappiness of any kind...
...I will hunt you down...
...and kick your ass.
What? I'm serious.
Dude! Stop it! I'm not kidding. - I hear what you're saying...
...and thanks for the warning.
No problem.
So are we friends again?
Yeah. - Okay.
Ahem. You won't believe what Monica's brother just said to me!
What you doing, Mon?
I'm listing all the things that could go wrong at the wedding.
So I can be prepared.
Mm-hm. What are they? - "The dresses won't get picked up...
...veil gets lost, and I'm missing something blue."
Those are all the things I'm responsible for.
I had to go with the odds.
Hey! You guys!
Remember I had that audition a while ago, and I didn't get that part?
The commercial? - No.
That play? - No.
That other play? - No.
The movie? - Yes!
The one about the pilot and his dog? - No.
But man, that one hurt.
This is the one about WWI soldiers. - Oh, yeah.
Back then we called it "The Great War."
It really was.
A guy they wanted backed out and now they want me! I start shooting today!
Congratulations!
Today's the rehearsal dinner. - I'll be done by then.
Oh. Then way to go, you big movie star!
See you. I'm off to fight the Nazis.
Wait, Joey. We fought the Nazis in WWll, not WWI.
Whoa. Okay.
Who was in WWI?
Go ahead.
You're gonna be late! Go! Go! - Yeah, I'll see you.
Who did we fight in WWI?
Mexico? - Yes. Very good.
Hey, Joey. We're ready. - Yeah, me too.
Richard, we're ready for you.
Joey Tribbiani, Richard Crosby is playing Vincent.
I'm doing my scenes with you? - Nice to meet you.
I can't believe this. Incredible. You just won an Oscar.
No, I didn't.
I think you did.
I think I lost, three times.
Uh, cookie? Would you? - No.
Okay. We're about an hour away from getting the scene lit.
So, uh, can you guys run it a couple times? - Yeah, sure.
All right. Let's do it.
And action!
We have to find the platoon! - Forget the platoon. The platoon is gone!
What? - The platoon's dead! Face facts, Tony!
What'll we do? We have no reinforcements or food.
There's food in the basement. Potatoes and some pasta.
Hang on. Joey, you keep touching your face.
Something wrong?
No.
I, uh...
I thought it might be a cool character thing.
He's a face toucher.
I don't think so.
Let's take it back to Richard's last lines. Action!
We may not have any weapons, but we still have food.
Potatoes, pasta...
...and a few tins of tuna!
Honey, we gotta go! - Okay.
Here's a question you never want to ask
My dad just called and wants to know if he can borrow one of your pearl necklaces?
Did he say what kind of neckline he's wearing?
No.
I've only met him once but I'm guessing, plunging?
He is more of a "If you've got it, flaunt it" kind of father.
I don't have anything but let me see if Rachel does.
Yes, include more people in this.
Hey. Do you realize that tomorrow we're gonna be getting married?
I have a date tomorrow night.
I can't believe we made it. - You don't have to sound so surprised.
I'm sorry, but...
Nothing. - What?
Well, honestly? Ever since we got engaged...
...I've waited for you to flip out.
Honestly? Me too.
Really? - Yeah.
I think that something stupid will come up and I'll...
...go all Chandler.
But nothing has. - I'm so glad.
Thank you for staying so calm during this.
It's made me stay calm.
I could've been worse. - Okay.
I'll be right there.
Hi, if you're calling before Saturday...
...you've reached Monica and Chandler.
But if you're calling after Saturday, you've reached Mr. And Mrs. Bing.
Please leave a message for the Bings!
Maureen! - Hi.
Gosh. This is my cousin, Maureen. - We're the Bings.
Hi! You guys look so beautiful.
Mr. And Mrs. Bing!
Wow, Monica.
So you know, I had my older-brother talk with Chandler.
What is that? - Well, I...
I told him that if he ever hurt you...
...I would hunt him down and kick his ass.
What is the matter with everybody? I'm serious.
I would kick his ass!
Ross, please, my makeup!
Hi.
Chandler. - Mom.
Thanks for wearing... something.
Ohh. This is so exciting! I thought we screwed you up too much for this.
Just think, soon there will be lots of little Bings.
I can't believe I have to go back to work after this and get spit on again.
You're lucky. At least the people who spit on you are famous.
Who spits on you? - I don't wanna talk about work.
Mrs. Bing? These are my parents, Judy and Jack Geller.
It's lovely to meet you. - Are you his mother or father?
Jack!
What? I've never seen one before.
Dad, there's Ross. Go talk to him.
I didn't even have a chance to act as if I'm okay with it.
Hello, all.
Hi... Dad.
Hi, Mr. Bing.
Nora. - Charles.
It's so great to see you both here. - Yes.
Although we may be seeing too much of some people.
Aren't you too old to wear a dress like that?
Don't you have too much penis to wear a dress like that?
Oh, my God.
Of course you can kick his ass, son.
You could kick anyone's ass you want to.
Thanks, you guys.
Rach, Rach? - Yeah?
Do me a favor. Talk to Chandler's dad and keep him away from Chandler's mom.
Yeah, but I don't know what he looks like. - He is the man in a black dress.
Hi. I'm Rachel, a friend of Monica and Chandler's.
I'm Amanda. - Oh, I get it.
"A man, duh!"

sense_groups.english: But nothing has. - I'm so glad.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你在这段时间 一直都非常冷静
sense_groups.english: Thank you for staying so calm during this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我非常地冷静
sense_groups.english: It's made me stay calm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能会更差的 - 好
sense_groups.english: I could've been worse. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你在星期六前打电话来…
sense_groups.english: Hi, if you're calling before Saturday...

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是摩妮卡跟钱德家
sense_groups.english: ...you've reached Monica and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果你在星期六后打电话来 这里就是宾氏夫妇家
sense_groups.english: But if you're calling after Saturday, you've reached Mr. And Mrs. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 请留话给宾氏夫妇
sense_groups.english: Please leave a message for the Bings!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 玛琳 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Maureen! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她是我表妹玛琳 - 我们是宾氏夫妇
sense_groups.english: Gosh. This is my cousin, Maureen. - We're the Bings.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你们都很好看
sense_groups.english: Hi! You guys look so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 宾先生跟宾太太
sense_groups.english: Mr. And Mrs. Bing!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Wow, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 让你知道一下 我以 "大哥的身分"跟钱德谈过
sense_groups.english: So you know, I had my older-brother talk with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说了什么？ - 嗯…
sense_groups.english: What is that? - Well, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉他如果他敢伤害你…
sense_groups.english: I told him that if he ever hurt you...

sense_groups.chinese: 天涯海角我都会找到他 然后痛扁他
sense_groups.english: ...I would hunt him down and kick his ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家是怎么了？我是认真的
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with everybody? I'm serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会痛扁他
sense_groups.english: I would kick his ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 拜托 我的妆要糊掉了
sense_groups.english: Ross, please, my makeup!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 妈
sense_groups.english: Chandler. - Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你记得穿… 衣服来
sense_groups.english: Thanks for wearing... something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很兴奋 我以为我们害得你不敢结婚
sense_groups.english: Ohh. This is so exciting! I thought we screwed you up too much for this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想想 很快地 就会出现很多宾氏小孩
sense_groups.english: Just think, soon there will be lots of little Bings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我要回去 让人家喷口水
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I have to go back to work after this and get spit on again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很幸运 至少喷你口水的人都很有名
sense_groups.english: You're lucky. At least the people who spit on you are famous.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁对你喷口水？ - 我不想谈工作的事
sense_groups.english: Who spits on you? - I don't wanna talk about work.

sense_groups.chinese: 宾太太？他们是我爸妈 茱蒂跟杰克盖勒
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Bing? These are my parents, Judy and Jack Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能见到你 - 你是他妈妈还是他爸爸？
sense_groups.english: It's lovely to meet you. - Are you his mother or father?

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克
sense_groups.english: Jack!

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？我没看过变性人啊
sense_groups.english: What? I've never seen one before.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 罗斯在那边 去跟他谈一谈吧
sense_groups.english: Dad, there's Ross. Go talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至没办法 假装我不会在意
sense_groups.english: I didn't even have a chance to act as if I'm okay with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hello, all.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨… 爸
sense_groups.english: Hi... Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 宾先生
sense_groups.english: Hi, Mr. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 诺拉 - 查尔斯
sense_groups.english: Nora. - Charles.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴你们两个都来了 - 对
sense_groups.english: It's so great to see you both here. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然有些人是衣不蔽体
sense_groups.english: Although we may be seeing too much of some people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得自己太老了 不该穿那种衣服吗？
sense_groups.english: Aren't you too old to wear a dress like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得自己是个男人 不该穿那种衣服吗？
sense_groups.english: Don't you have too much penis to wear a dress like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然可以痛扁他 儿子
sense_groups.english: Of course you can kick his ass, son.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想痛扁任何人都没有问题
sense_groups.english: You could kick anyone's ass you want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: Thanks, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋？ - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Rach, Rach? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮个忙 去跟钱德的老爸聊天 别让他跟钱德的老妈杠上了
sense_groups.english: Do me a favor. Talk to Chandler's dad and keep him away from Chandler's mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但我不知道他长什么样子 - 他穿着黑色洋装
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I don't know what he looks like. - He is the man in a black dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是瑞秋 摩妮卡跟钱德的朋友
sense_groups.english: Hi. I'm Rachel, a friend of Monica and Chandler's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是亚曼达 - 喔 我懂了
sense_groups.english: I'm Amanda. - Oh, I get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人 啊
sense_groups.english: "A man, duh!"

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家听我说
sense_groups.english: Could I have your attention?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯盖勒 - 罗斯盖勒博士
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross Geller. - Dr. Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 拜托 我刚刚说过…
sense_groups.english: Dad, please. As I was saying...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯盖勒博士
sense_groups.english: ...I'm Dr. Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是伴郎
sense_groups.english: Uh, and I'm the best man.

sense_groups.chinese: 这段婚姻对我来说有双重意义…
sense_groups.english: And this marriage is doubly special for me...

sense_groups.chinese: 不只因为新郎是我的好朋友…
sense_groups.english: ...um, because not only is the groom my best friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 更因为新娘是我的妹妹
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, the bride is my little sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是所有男人梦寐以求的好妹妹
sense_groups.english: She's the greatest sister a guy could ask for.

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家跟我一起举杯…
sense_groups.english: Please join me in raising a glass...

sense_groups.chinese: 敬这对新人
sense_groups.english: ...to the couple we're here to celebrate.

sense_groups.chinese: 敬宾氏夫妇 - 敬宾氏夫妇
sense_groups.english: To the Bings. - To the Bings!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去熨婚纱了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna steam my dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁负责确定它不会有问题？
sense_groups.english: Who will make sure nothing happens to it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会负责 - 谁要负责？有人愿意吗？
sense_groups.english: I'll do it. - Who wants it? Anybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我会负责 - 没有人吗？
sense_groups.english: I said I'll do it. - Nobody?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那我就自己来 - 我不会搞砸的
sense_groups.english: All right, I'll do it myself. - I'm not gonna screw it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 对不起 今晚你帮了大忙
sense_groups.english: You're right. I'm sorry. You were a big help tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你帮忙 将我奶奶安全地送回饭店
sense_groups.english: And thanks for putting my grandmother in the cab to get to the hotel.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 那就是我的工作 - 好吧 对不起
sense_groups.english: Of course! That's what I'm here for. - Okay. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Ugh! Pssh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么奶奶？
sense_groups.english: What grandmother?

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到哪里去了？ - 我送我爸妈回饭店
sense_groups.english: Where have you been? - Taking my parents to the hotel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要回去工作了？ - 对
sense_groups.english: Going back to work? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 很酷的太阳眼镜 - 我想如果我能戴上它拍戏…
sense_groups.english: Nice shades. - If I wear these in my scenes...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的眼睛就不会喷到口水了
sense_groups.english: ...I won't get spit in my eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我没有记错 雷朋是一次大战的正式赞助商
sense_groups.english: And, if I remember correctly, Ray-Ban was the official sponsor of WWI.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 帅啊
sense_groups.english: Great! All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 晚点见 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I'll see you later. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德在哪里？ - 我想他在瑞秋的房间里 再见
sense_groups.english: Where's Chandler? - I think he's in Rachel's room. See you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡在吗？ - 她在熨婚纱 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Is Monica here? - She's steaming her dress. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想钱德走了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I think Chandler's gone. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他留下了这个 - "告诉摩妮卡我很抱歉"
sense_groups.english: He left that. - "Tell Monica I'm sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: "告诉摩妮卡我很抱歉"
sense_groups.english: "Tell Monica I'm sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己去告诉她
sense_groups.english: Tell her yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 钱德走了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Chandler just left, though?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许事情不是我们想的那样 或许他是说
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's not what we think. Maybe it's

sense_groups.chinese: "告诉摩妮卡我很抱歉 我把牛奶都喝光了"
sense_groups.english: "Tell Monica I'm sorry I drank the last of the milk."

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他写这张字条告诉她 他改了名字
sense_groups.english: Or maybe he was writing to tell her that he's changed his name

sense_groups.chinese: "告诉摩妮卡我叫抱歉"
sense_groups.english: "Tell Monica, I'm Sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: 这表示他吓得逃跑了 - 别那么消极
sense_groups.english: It means he freaked out and left! - Don't be so negative!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 有没有可能"抱歉" 现在就坐在里面
sense_groups.english: Good God, isn't it possible that "Sorry" is sitting in there right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我想罗斯说得对 我们该怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I think Ross is right. What are we gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去找他 把他带回来
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna have to go find him and bring him back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们别让摩妮卡 发现这件事 好吗？
sense_groups.english: You make sure Monica does not find out, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 但是你如果没办法找到他 把他带回来…
sense_groups.english: But, if you don't find him and bring him back...

sense_groups.chinese: 天涯海角我都会找到你 然后痛扁你
sense_groups.english: ...I am gonna hunt you down and kick your ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 我会找到他的
sense_groups.english: I will find him.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你能跟我对一下台词吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey? Can you go through these lines with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊 他们才帮我补好妆
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, they just re-did my makeup.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要对最后两页 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Just the last two pages. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现照片了
sense_groups.english: I found the picture!

sense_groups.chinese: 照片？什么照片？
sense_groups.english: Picture? What picture?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在你的背包里 发现我太太的照片
sense_groups.english: The picture of my wife! I found it in your pack!

sense_groups.chinese: 你能把剧本放下来吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you lower the script?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想
sense_groups.english: I don't want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得看到你的脸 才能依你的反应演出
sense_groups.english: I need to see your face so I can play off your reaction.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说
sense_groups.english: Okay, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你的演技很棒 演过很多莎翁名剧…
sense_groups.english: I know you're great and play all those Shakespeare guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你喷得我满脸是口水
sense_groups.english: ...but you're spitting all over me, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 那当然 - 你知道你会喷口水？
sense_groups.english: Of course I am! - You know you've been spitting?

sense_groups.chinese: 真正的演员都会那么做
sense_groups.english: That's what real actors do.

sense_groups.chinese: 清晰地发音是好演员的注册商标
sense_groups.english: Enunciation is the mark of a good actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 清晰地发音时就会喷口水
sense_groups.english: And when you enunciate, you spit!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道这件事
sense_groups.english: Wow. Didn't know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 好吧 看我的
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Okay, check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 照片？什么照片？
sense_groups.english: Picture? What picture?

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 你看到钱德了吗？ - 不 我没有看到他
sense_groups.english: Have you seen Chandler? - No, I haven't seen him.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 - 他明天要结婚了 对吧？
sense_groups.english: Damn. - He's getting married tomorrow, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 别担心 一切都会没事的
sense_groups.english: Yes. Don't worry. Everything's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天婚礼上见 - 我没有被邀请
sense_groups.english: See you at the wedding. - I wasn't invited.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么后天见
sense_groups.english: Then we'll see you the day after tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈？爸？
sense_groups.english: Mom? Dad?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们老是聊到这个地方 我们想看看这里有什么特别的
sense_groups.english: You kids talk about this place so much, we thought we'd see what the fuss is all about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道为什么女孩们喜欢来这里 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I see why the girls like coming here. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 为了吧台后面那个性感大帅哥
sense_groups.english: The sexy blond behind the counter.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘？ - 她刚刚把他列入她的名单
sense_groups.english: Gunther? - She just added him to her list.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你的名单？ - 我们可以上床的对象…
sense_groups.english: Your list? - Of people we're allowed to sleep...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道那是什么样的名单
sense_groups.english: I know what the list is.

sense_groups.chinese: 快坐下吧 喝杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: Sit down, have a cup of joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸 我没空 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I can't, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们看到钱德 告诉他我在找他
sense_groups.english: If you see Chandler, tell him I'm looking for him.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你看到丽塔莫雷诺 告诉她我在找她
sense_groups.english: And if you see Rita Moreno, let her know I'm looking for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始
sense_groups.english: Action!

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现照片了
sense_groups.english: I found the picture!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么照片？
sense_groups.english: What picture?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在你的背包里 发现我太太的照片
sense_groups.english: A picture of my wife, in your pack!

sense_groups.chinese: 你偷翻我的私人物品？
sense_groups.english: You went through my personal property?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的背包里 为什么会有宝丽蒂的照片？
sense_groups.english: Why do you have a picture of Paulette in your pack?

sense_groups.chinese: 文森 因为我们…
sense_groups.english: Because, Vincent, we were lovers...

sense_groups.chinese: 交往过两年
sense_groups.english: ...for two years!

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Cut! Wonderful!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Great scene, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很棒 最后那一段你喷得我的脸都湿了
sense_groups.english: You were awesome. In that last speech, you soaked me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是明天的通告表 - 明天我不会工作
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow's call sheet. - I'm not working tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是了 - 不 你得帮我这个忙
sense_groups.english: You are now. - No, you gotta get me out of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经有约了 这件事非常重要
sense_groups.english: I have plans. Important plans!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯说还是没有钱德的消息 - 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Still no word from Chandler. - Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们发现 奶奶在第五大道上游荡
sense_groups.english: But they found the grandmother wandering down 5th.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 至少找到一个人了
sense_groups.english: Okay, well there's one down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天要结婚了
sense_groups.english: I'm getting married today!

sense_groups.chinese: 我断了一根肋骨 但我不在乎 我今天要结婚了
sense_groups.english: I cracked a rib, but I don't care. Today's my wedding!

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于要结婚了
sense_groups.english: My day is finally here!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她不会注意到他不见了
sense_groups.english: She might not even notice he's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要开始准备了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna start getting ready!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不能让她开始准备 这太可怕了
sense_groups.english: We can't let her start getting ready. This is too awful!

sense_groups.chinese: 等她换上婚纱 而他又没有出现时…
sense_groups.english: She'll be in the gown, and he won't show up.

sense_groups.chinese: 这时候她得脱掉婚纱…
sense_groups.english: Then she'll have to take off the gown...

sense_groups.chinese: 冷静点 你不能在这里抓狂
sense_groups.english: Stop it. You can't do this here.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太悲伤了
sense_groups.english: It's just so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 振作一点 别让她看到你这个样子
sense_groups.english: Pull it together. She can't see you like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会发现不对劲的 - 我知道 天啊
sense_groups.english: She'll know something's wrong. - I know. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有面纸了
sense_groups.english: There's no tissue.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能拿张卫生纸给我吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you grab me some toilet paper?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 卫生纸也没有了 这里是摩妮卡的浴室吧？
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's gone too. This is Monica's bathroom, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到一张了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I found one. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 能再给我一张吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I have another one?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要牙线吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you need some floss?

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法想像如果他不出现 会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: I can't imagine what will happen if he doesn't show up.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有一大堆卫生纸

sense_groups.chinese: 大家会窃窃私语 "喔 那个可怜的女孩"

sense_groups.english: Monica's pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜她不会寂寞了

sense_groups.chinese: 下集提要
sense_groups.english: Next time on Friends

sense_groups.chinese: 她很快就会开始做准备

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能拖延她吗？

sense_groups.chinese: 我永远都没办法结婚了
sense_groups.english: I'm never gonna get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只拍一场戏 就你跟理查 他是职业高手

sense_groups.chinese: 你喝醉了吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Are you drunk? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你喝醉了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yes, you are! - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德还好吗？ - 他好极了
sense_groups.english: How's Chandler? - Great!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在哪里？ - 我还在片场里
sense_groups.english: Where are you? - On the set.

sense_groups.chinese: 这将会是有史以来 最糟糕的一场婚礼
sense_groups.english: This is turning into the worst wedding day ever.

questions.name: S07E24
questions.en:
Oh, my God.
I know. Monica's gonna have a baby.
Can this count as her "something new"?
Oh, my God.
Do you think this is why Chandler took off?
She had to have just taken it. I took out the trash last night.
It's turning into the worst wedding ever.
The bride's pregnant, the groom's missing and I'm holding this.
Phoebe, we cannot tell anyone about this.
Right. Yeah. - Okay?
Do you know what kind of birth control she uses?
No. Why?
Just for the future. This is hardly a commercial for it.
Anything?
No. I talked to Joey. He hasn't heard from him.
I talked to Chandler's parents again.
You said he was missing? - No.
It seemed like I called to chat.
Pretty sure they both think I'm interested.
We've got to tell her. - No, we can't.
She'll start getting ready soon.
Can't you stall her? I'll go to the places I went last night.
How much time?
How long before she has to get ready?
One hour. - Give me two.
Then why do you ask?
Wish me luck. - I'm going with you.
Why?
You're tired. You looked all night. And clearly, you suck at this.
See you later.
Wait, do you know how you're gonna stall her?
I'll figure something out. - Okay, good luck.
Let's start with my makeup and then do my hair.
Okay. But before you do that, I need you to talk to me.
About what?
I'm never gonna get married.
You will. The right guy's around the corner.
Okay, are we done with that?
No, I'm serious.
Maybe I should just forget about it. Become a lesbian or something.
Any woman would be lucky to have you.
Maybe I'd feel better if I slept with Joey.
Rachel? Are you okay?
Excuse me, Aaron? I have a little problem with the schedule.
I wasn't supposed to work today. I have a wedding that I have to be at.
It's my best friend's, and I'm officiating...
...so I really can't work past 4.
You've gotta stay until the end. We can't stop filming just for you.
It's not like it's your wedding.
I'm having surgery.
What?
I made up the wedding, because I didn't want you to worry.
But I'm having surgery today.
What kind of surgery?
Transplant.
You're supposed to work on Monday.
Hair transplant.
But you're not bald.
It's not on my head.
There's nothing I can do. You'll probably be out by 4 anyway.
We've got one scene. It's just you and Richard, and he's a pro.
You'll be fine.
Morning, Richard.
Hey, you're here. Great. Let's go, buddy.
We got a scene to shoot.
I'm wearing two belts.
Are you drunk? - No.
Yes, you are.
All right.
So this is your office?
How'd you guys find me? I knew I should've hid at the gym.
What the hell are you doing? - Panicking.
And using the Internet to try to prove that I'm related to Monica.
How is she? - She doesn't know you're gone.
And she doesn't have to know. Come on, we're going home.
I can't do that. - Why not?
If I go home, we're gonna become the Bings.
I can't be the Bings.
What's wrong with it?
The Bings have bad marriages.
They yell, fight, and use the pool boy...
...as a pawn in their sexual games.
Have you ever put on a black dress and asked me up to your hotel room?
No. - Then you are neither of your parents.
It's not just their marriage. Look at yours. Look at everybody's.
Only Paul Newman can make marriage work.
And I am no Paul Newman.
I don't race cars or make popcorn. None of my proceeds go to charity.
But look, Chandler...
...right now no one has a lower opinion of you than I do.
But I totally believe you can do this.
I want to. I love her so much, but I'm afraid...
Ahem. It's too huge.
You're right. It is huge.
So let's take it just a little bit at a time.
Forget getting married for a sec.
Can you just come home and take a shower?
That's not scary, right?
Depends on what you mean by "we."
The nights are the hardest.
But then the day comes...
...and that's every bit as hard as the night.
Then the night comes... - Days and nights are hard, I get it.
I have to start getting ready. I'm getting married today.
I know. At dusk.
That's such a hard time for me.
I'm gonna put makeup on. We have to be there in an hour.
Wait. - What?
Let's go to lunch.
I can't go to lunch.
Right.
Oh, good God, I've fallen down.
What's going on?
Okay.
All right, honey, listen.
When I tell you what I'm about to tell you, remember...
...that we're all here for you, and we love you.
Okay, you're really freaking me out.
We can't find Chandler...
His vest.
We can't find Chandler's vest.
How can that be? Wait, are you serious?
Found the vest.
We'll have to keep an eye on it, make sure we don't lose it again.
Ah.
Oh, wow. Okay, don't scare me like that, okay?
For a minute, I was like, "Oh, my God. The worst has happened."
So you two were married, huh?
What happened, you just drift apart?
Here comes the bride.
Oh, my God, Monica.
I want to wear this every day.
You look so beautiful.
I'm so happy for me.
Hello? - Did Chandler show up yet?
We got him back. Everything's fine. - Damn it.
Where are you? - I'm still on the set.
The wedding is in less than an hour.
I'm sorry. The guy's drunk. They won't let me go until we get it.
Oh, my God. I'm gonna have to find another minister.
No, I'm the minister.
Put them both on the phone and I'll marry them right now.
Joey, I have to go.
Don't hang up on me. I'll marry you and me right now. I have the power.
There you go. You put on a tuxedo.
That wasn't scary, was it?
No.
I'm telling you, just a little bit at a time.
Okay. What's the next little bit?
Getting married. - Oh, ah.
You can do that too. Just like you've done everything else.
Yeah, you're right. I can do that. - Yeah.
Excuse me for a minute. - Where you going?
I'm not gonna run away. I just want some fresh air.
Okay. - Okay.
Oh, fresh air.
Cover for me. - Maybe you overreacted.
We gotta do something.
Joey won't make it, so I'll look around for other weddings.
Don't tell them Monica's pregnant, because they frown on that.
Okay.
"Anastassakis Papasifakis wedding." Excellent.
Congratulations.
Mazel tov.
Hi. Oh, great hat.
I need you to perform another wedding. Can you do that?
I don't know. Are they Greek Orthodox?
Yeah. Yeah.
They're my friends, Monica Stephanopolis.
And Chandler Acidophilus.
Hi. Hi.
Hi.
Has anyone seen Chandler?
I thought he was with you. - He was with me.
We're playing a game. Hide-and-seek.
You can't ask us, son. That's cheating.
You're right. Thanks for keeping me honest, Dad.
He can't come here and see the bride in her wedding dress.
When we got married, I saw the groom in the wedding dress.
That was after the wedding. It's not bad luck then.
Honey, it isn't good luck.
Oh, my God. Monica.
I know.
How's Chandler doing? - Great.
He's doing great. Don't you worry about Chandler.
Phoebe, can I see you for a second? - Yeah.
What's going on? - Chandler's gone again.
Why would you play hide-and-seek with someone you know is a flight risk?
Aaron, you gotta let me go. The guy's hammered.
I'm sorry. As long as he's here and conscious, we're still shooting.
You wouldn't happen to have a very big fork?
So I just talked to the director.
That's it. We're done for the day.
We finished the scene?
Yeah. You were wonderful. - As were you.
So I got your car. It's right outside.
Thank you. You're welcome.
No, we gotta go. Come on. Here we go.
Is that my ass?
There he is! - What?
Hey! Whoa!
You won't get away this time!
Unless you want that ass-kicking we talked about.
Ross. - Hi-yah!
I'm serious. You're not walking out on my sister.
That's right. I'm not.
Then where have you been? - I know about Monica.
You know? - What?
I heard you and Rachel talking. - About what?
You don't know?
If somebody doesn't tell me right now...
What, you'll "hi-yah"?
Monica's pregnant.
Oh, my God.
Oh, my God. And you're not freaking out?
I was. Then I went to the gift shop for cigarettes.
Cigarettes? - Big picture, please.
So I was in the gift shop, that's when I saw this...
And I thought anything that can fit into this can't be scary.
You obviously didn't see Chuckie III.
But come on, look at how cute and small this is.
So I got it to give Monica, so she'd know I was okay.
Dude.
Way to go, son. I knew you'd find him.
Our little boy is getting married.
Look at you, so handsome.
You look beautiful, Mom.
You look beautiful too, Dad.
I love you both.
I'm so glad you're here.
Are you Chandler?
Are you Joey?
Huh. This is nice. - What?
I've never walked down the aisle knowing it can't end in divorce.
I wish your grandmother had lived to see this.
She's right there. - Not that old crone. My mother.
Congratulations, darling.
We love you, sweetheart.
You look beautiful.
Is this new? - Not now.
Who's this? - I'm Father Karabasos.
He's Greek Orthodox.
As are you.
Let us begin.
Dearly beloved...
That's my line.
I can take it from here. Thanks.
Dearly beloved, I'm sorry I'm a little late.
You may be confused by this now...
...but you won't be Memorial Day weekend, 2002.
Let's get started before the groom takes off again.
We are gathered here today...
...to join this man...
...and this woman in the bonds of holy matrimony.
I've known Monica and Chandler for a long time, and I can't...
...imagine two people more perfect for each other.
And now, as I've left my notes in my dressing room...
...we shall proceed to the vows. Monica?
He took off? - Go on. Go on.
Chandler, for so long...
...I wondered if I would ever find my prince.
My soul mate.
Then three years ago, at another wedding...
...I turned to a friend for comfort.
And instead, I found everything that I'd been looking for my whole life.
And now...
...here we are...
...with our future before us.
And I only want to spend it with you.
My prince. My soul mate.
My friend.
Unless you don't want to.
You go.
Chandler?
No, that's okay.
I thought this would be the most difficult thing I ever had to do.
But when I saw you walking down that aisle, I realized it's simple.
I love you.
Any surprises that come our way, it's okay, because I will always love you.
You are the person I was meant to spend the rest of my life with.
You want to know if I'm sure?
You may now kiss the bride.
So...
I guess by the powers vested in me by the State of New York...
...and the Internet guys...
...I now pronounce you husband and wife.
Oh, wait. Do you take each other?
I do. - I do.
Yeah, you do.
Rings?
Oh, crap.
Let's do the rings.
We good? Yeah? Good?
Once again...
...I pronounce you husband and wife.
Now kiss her again.
I love you.
And I know about the baby.
What baby? - Our baby.
We have a baby?
Phoebe found your pregnancy test.
I didn't take a pregnancy test.
Then who did?
Look at them.
And they're gonna have a baby.
Uh-huh.

sense_groups.english: How is she? - She doesn't know you're gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不必知道 来吧 我们回家了
sense_groups.english: And she doesn't have to know. Come on, we're going home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能那么做 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I can't do that. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为如果我回家 我们会成为宾氏夫妇
sense_groups.english: If I go home, we're gonna become the Bings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能当宾氏夫妇
sense_groups.english: I can't be the Bings.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有什么不对的？
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with it?

sense_groups.chinese: 宾氏夫妇的婚姻都很可怕
sense_groups.english: The Bings have bad marriages.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会吵架 打成一团 还会把救生员…
sense_groups.english: They yell, fight, and use the pool boy...

sense_groups.chinese: 当成他们性爱游戏的玩物
sense_groups.english: ...as a pawn in their sexual games.

sense_groups.chinese: 你曾经穿上黑色洋装 要我到你饭店的房间吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever put on a black dress and asked me up to your hotel room?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 那么你不是你父母
sense_groups.english: No. - Then you are neither of your parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是他们的婚姻 看看你的婚姻 看看大家的婚姻
sense_groups.english: It's not just their marriage. Look at yours. Look at everybody's.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有保罗纽曼的婚姻幸福美满
sense_groups.english: Only Paul Newman can make marriage work.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很清楚我自己 我不是保罗纽曼
sense_groups.english: And I am no Paul Newman.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会赛车或做爆米花 也不会捐钱给慈善团体
sense_groups.english: I don't race cars or make popcorn. None of my proceeds go to charity.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 钱德…
sense_groups.english: But look, Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在没有人比我更看不起你
sense_groups.english: ...right now no one has a lower opinion of you than I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我完全相信你做得到
sense_groups.english: But I totally believe you can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想 我很爱她 但我害怕…
sense_groups.english: I want to. I love her so much, but I'm afraid...

sense_groups.chinese: 这太沉重了
sense_groups.english: Ahem. It's too huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 这是件大事
sense_groups.english: You're right. It is huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不一步一步慢慢来？
sense_groups.english: So let's take it just a little bit at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 暂时忘了结婚的事 忘了它
sense_groups.english: Forget getting married for a sec.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能回家洗个澡吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you just come home and take a shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不可怕 对吧？
sense_groups.english: That's not scary, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 那得看你说"我们"是什么意思
sense_groups.english: Depends on what you mean by "we."

sense_groups.chinese: 漫漫长夜是最难熬的
sense_groups.english: The nights are the hardest.

sense_groups.chinese: 但天亮了…
sense_groups.english: But then the day comes...

sense_groups.chinese: 白天就跟黑夜一样难熬
sense_groups.english: ...and that's every bit as hard as the night.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后黑夜又来了… - 白天跟黑夜都很难熬 我知道了
sense_groups.english: Then the night comes... - Days and nights are hard, I get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我得开始准备了 今天我要结婚
sense_groups.english: I have to start getting ready. I'm getting married today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 在黄昏的时候
sense_groups.english: I know. At dusk.

sense_groups.chinese: 对我来说黄昏是很难熬的
sense_groups.english: That's such a hard time for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要化妆了 我们得在一小时内赶到饭店
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna put makeup on. We have to be there in an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Wait. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去吃午饭吧
sense_groups.english: Let's go to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能去吃午饭
sense_groups.english: I can't go to lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 对喔
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我跌倒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, good God, I've fallen down.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 听我说
sense_groups.english: All right, honey, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我告诉你这件事时 我要你记得…
sense_groups.english: When I tell you what I'm about to tell you, remember...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都会支持你 我们都爱你
sense_groups.english: ...that we're all here for you, and we love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你真的吓坏我了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you're really freaking me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们找不到钱德…
sense_groups.english: We can't find Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 的背心
sense_groups.english: His vest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们找不到钱德的背心
sense_groups.english: We can't find Chandler's vest.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能？ 等一下 你是认真的吗？
sense_groups.english: How can that be? Wait, are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 背心找到了
sense_groups.english: Found the vest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得看好它 确定不会再把它弄丢了
sense_groups.english: We'll have to keep an eye on it, make sure we don't lose it again.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别那样吓我 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Okay, don't scare me like that, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚刚我还想说 "天啊 最糟糕的事发生了"
sense_groups.english: For a minute, I was like, "Oh, my God. The worst has happened."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个结过婚？
sense_groups.english: So you two were married, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 后来发生了什么事？ 你们就慢慢疏远了？
sense_groups.english: What happened, you just drift apart?

sense_groups.chinese: 新娘来了
sense_groups.english: Here comes the bride.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想每天都穿这件婚纱
sense_groups.english: I want to wear this every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的好漂亮
sense_groups.english: You look so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为自己感到高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm so happy for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？ - 钱德出现了吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Did Chandler show up yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们找到他了 没事了 - 该死
sense_groups.english: We got him back. Everything's fine. - Damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？你在哪里？ - 我还在片场
sense_groups.english: Where are you? - I'm still on the set.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 不到一小时 婚礼就要开始了
sense_groups.english: The wedding is in less than an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 对不起 跟我对戏的演员 喝醉了 戏没拍好他们不让我离开
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. The guy's drunk. They won't let me go until we get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我得再去找位牧师
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm gonna have to find another minister.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是牧师
sense_groups.english: No, I'm the minister.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 叫他们两个一起听电话 我现在就帮他们证婚
sense_groups.english: Put them both on the phone and I'll marry them right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我得挂电话了
sense_groups.english: Joey, I have to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 别挂我电话 帮你跟我证婚 我现在就可以 我有那样的权力
sense_groups.english: Don't hang up on me. I'll marry you and me right now. I have the power.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看看 你穿上了礼服
sense_groups.english: There you go. You put on a tuxedo.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一点都不可怕吧？
sense_groups.english: That wasn't scary, was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你说 一步一步慢慢来
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, just a little bit at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 接下来我们要做什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay. What's the next little bit?

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚 - 好
sense_groups.english: Getting married. - Oh, ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定能办到 就像其他的事你都做得很好
sense_groups.english: You can do that too. Just like you've done everything else.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 我可以办到 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right. I can do that. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要出去一下 - 你要去哪里？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me for a minute. - Where you going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会再逃走 我只想呼吸点新鲜空气
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna run away. I just want some fresh air.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 新鲜空气
sense_groups.english: Oh, fresh air.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我掩护 - 或许你反应过度了 你常这样
sense_groups.english: Cover for me. - Maybe you overreacted.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得想个办法
sense_groups.english: We gotta do something.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊没办法赶过来 我会看看 饭店里有没有其他人在办婚礼
sense_groups.english: Joey won't make it, so I'll look around for other weddings.

sense_groups.chinese: 别告诉他们摩妮卡怀孕了 因为他们厌恶那种事
sense_groups.english: Don't tell them Monica's pregnant, because they frown on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 安纳斯塔赛奇斯 巴巴西法奇斯联姻 太棒了
sense_groups.english: "Anastassakis Papasifakis wedding." Excellent.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Mazel tov.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 好漂亮的帽子
sense_groups.english: Hi. Oh, great hat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你帮另一场婚礼证婚 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: I need you to perform another wedding. Can you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 他们是希腊正教的信徒吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Are they Greek Orthodox?

sense_groups.chinese: 耶 耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是我的朋友 摩妮卡史蒂芬诺波里斯
sense_groups.english: They're my friends, Monica Stephanopolis.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟钱德艾西多菲利斯
sense_groups.english: And Chandler Acidophilus.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨…
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人看到钱德吗？
sense_groups.english: Has anyone seen Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为他跟你在一起 - 他刚才是跟我在一起
sense_groups.english: I thought he was with you. - He was with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在玩游戏 捉迷藏
sense_groups.english: We're playing a game. Hide-and-seek.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能问我们 儿子 那是作弊
sense_groups.english: You can't ask us, son. That's cheating.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对 谢谢你纠正我 爸
sense_groups.english: You're right. Thanks for keeping me honest, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 他最好别到这里来 他不能看到新娘穿婚纱的样子
sense_groups.english: He can't come here and see the bride in her wedding dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还记得我们结婚的时候 我看到新郎穿婚纱的样子
sense_groups.english: When we got married, I saw the groom in the wedding dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是婚礼后的事 那就不会带来恶运
sense_groups.english: That was after the wedding. It's not bad luck then.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 那也没带来好运
sense_groups.english: Honey, it isn't good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德还好吗？ - 他好极了
sense_groups.english: How's Chandler doing? - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 他非常好 别担心钱德
sense_groups.english: He's doing great. Don't you worry about Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我能跟你谈一下吗？ - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, can I see you for a second? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事？ - 钱德又不见了
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - Chandler's gone again.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你要跟一个可能会逃跑的人 玩捉迷藏呢？
sense_groups.english: Why would you play hide-and-seek with someone you know is a flight risk?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾朗 你得放我走 那家伙烂醉如泥
sense_groups.english: Aaron, you gotta let me go. The guy's hammered.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 只要他还清醒地待在这里 我们就得继续拍下去
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. As long as he's here and conscious, we're still shooting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该不会有根大叉子吧？
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't happen to have a very big fork?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚跟导演谈过
sense_groups.english: So I just talked to the director.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样 今天就拍到这里为止
sense_groups.english: That's it. We're done for the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 戏拍完了吗？
sense_groups.english: We finished the scene?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你表现的很棒 - 你也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You were wonderful. - As were you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把你的车开过来了 车子就停在外面
sense_groups.english: So I got your car. It's right outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 别客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们得走了 来吧 要走了
sense_groups.english: No, we gotta go. Come on. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的屁股吗？
sense_groups.english: Is that my ass?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在那里 - 干嘛？
sense_groups.english: There he is! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey! Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 这次你逃不了 先生
sense_groups.english: You won't get away this time!

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你真的要我痛扁你
sense_groups.english: Unless you want that ass-kicking we talked about.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 嘿呀
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Hi-yah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的 我不准你抛弃我妹妹
sense_groups.english: I'm serious. You're not walking out on my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我不会的
sense_groups.english: That's right. I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你跑到哪里去了？ - 我知道摩妮卡的事
sense_groups.english: Then where have you been? - I know about Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道了？ - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You know? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到你跟瑞秋说话 - 说什么？
sense_groups.english: I heard you and Rachel talking. - About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You don't know?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们不立刻 告诉我发生了什么事…
sense_groups.english: If somebody doesn't tell me right now...

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛？你会"嘿呀"吗？
sense_groups.english: What, you'll "hi-yah"?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Monica's pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你没有被吓跑吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. And you're not freaking out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是吓坏了 后来我去了礼品店 因为我的烟都抽完了
sense_groups.english: I was. Then I went to the gift shop for cigarettes.

sense_groups.chinese: 烟？ - 请谈正事
sense_groups.english: Cigarettes? - Big picture, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在礼品店看到这个东西
sense_groups.english: So I was in the gift shop, that's when I saw this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想"能穿上这玩意的东西 应该不可怕"
sense_groups.english: And I thought anything that can fit into this can't be scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 你没看过 《灵异入侵少年军团》
sense_groups.english: You obviously didn't see Chuckie III.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 看看这件小衣服有多可爱
sense_groups.english: But come on, look at how cute and small this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把它送给摩妮卡 她会知道我没事的
sense_groups.english: So I got it to give Monica, so she'd know I was okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 做得好 儿子 我就知道你一定能找到他
sense_groups.english: Way to go, son. I knew you'd find him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的小儿子要结婚了
sense_groups.english: Our little boy is getting married.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 真的好英俊
sense_groups.english: Look at you, so handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很漂亮 妈
sense_groups.english: You look beautiful, Mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来也很漂亮 爸
sense_groups.english: You look beautiful too, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你们
sense_groups.english: I love you both.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你来了
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是钱德吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是乔伊吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太棒了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Huh. This is nice. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我第一次走在红毯上 知道自己不可能会离婚
sense_groups.english: I've never walked down the aisle knowing it can't end in divorce.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望你祖母能活着看到这一慕
sense_groups.english: I wish your grandmother had lived to see this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但奶奶就在那边啊 - 不是那个老太婆 我是说我妈
sense_groups.english: She's right there. - Not that old crone. My mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Congratulations, darling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱你 甜心
sense_groups.english: We love you, sweetheart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来好美
sense_groups.english: You look beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是新买的吗？ - 不要现在讨论
sense_groups.english: Is this new? - Not now.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是谁？ - 我是卡拉巴索斯神父
sense_groups.english: Who's this? - I'm Father Karabasos.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是希腊正教的神父
sense_groups.english: He's Greek Orthodox.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们也是希腊正教的信徒
sense_groups.english: As are you.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始举行婚礼吧
sense_groups.english: Let us begin.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的来宾…
sense_groups.english: Dearly beloved...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的台词
sense_groups.english: That's my line.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从这里开始接手 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I can take it from here. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的来宾 抱歉我来迟了一点
sense_groups.english: Dearly beloved, I'm sorry I'm a little late.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你们会觉得很困惑…
sense_groups.english: You may be confused by this now...

sense_groups.chinese: 但到了2002年 阵亡将士纪念日 你们就会了解
sense_groups.english: ...but you won't be Memorial Day weekend, 2002.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点开始举行婚礼 免得新郎又逃跑了
sense_groups.english: Let's get started before the groom takes off again.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我们齐聚在这里…
sense_groups.english: We are gathered here today...

sense_groups.chinese: 参加这个男人…
sense_groups.english: ...to join this man...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟这个女人神圣的婚礼
sense_groups.english: ...and this woman in the bonds of holy matrimony.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟摩妮卡及钱德认识很久了 我不能想像…
sense_groups.english: I've known Monica and Chandler for a long time, and I can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 有谁比他们两个更匹配
sense_groups.english: ...imagine two people more perfect for each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我把演讲稿 忘在更衣室里…
sense_groups.english: And now, as I've left my notes in my dressing room...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们直接念誓词吧 摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: ...we shall proceed to the vows. Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 他逃走过？ - 快点
sense_groups.english: He took off? - Go on. Go on.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 从小…
sense_groups.english: Chandler, for so long...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就在想 我能不能找到我的白马王子
sense_groups.english: ...I wondered if I would ever find my prince.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的灵魂伴侣
sense_groups.english: My soul mate.

sense_groups.chinese: 三年前 在另一场婚礼…
sense_groups.english: Then three years ago, at another wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 我向朋友寻求安慰
sense_groups.english: ...I turned to a friend for comfort.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我找到了 我一直在找的一切
sense_groups.english: And instead, I found everything that I'd been looking for my whole life.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在…
sense_groups.english: And now...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在这里…
sense_groups.english: ...here we are...

sense_groups.chinese: 一起迎接未来
sense_groups.english: ...with our future before us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: And I only want to spend it with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的白马王子 我的灵魂伴侣
sense_groups.english: My prince. My soul mate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的朋友
sense_groups.english: My friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你不愿意
sense_groups.english: Unless you don't want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 轮到你了
sense_groups.english: You go.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德？
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为这是我必须做 最困难的一件事
sense_groups.english: I thought this would be the most difficult thing I ever had to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我看到你走过红毯时 我了解到它真的很简单
sense_groups.english: But when I saw you walking down that aisle, I realized it's simple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不论出现什么样的惊喜 没关系 因为我会永远爱你
sense_groups.english: Any surprises that come our way, it's okay, because I will always love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我注定要跟你共度余生
sense_groups.english: You are the person I was meant to spend the rest of my life with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想知道我确不确定吗？
sense_groups.english: You want to know if I'm sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以吻新娘了
sense_groups.english: You may now kiss the bride.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要以纽约州的网友们…
sense_groups.english: I guess by the powers vested in me by the State of New York...

sense_groups.chinese: 赋给我的权力…
sense_groups.english: ...and the Internet guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在宣布你们已结为夫妇
sense_groups.english: ...I now pronounce you husband and wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你们愿意吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. Do you take each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意 - 我愿意
sense_groups.english: I do. - I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你们都愿意
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 戒指？
sense_groups.english: Rings?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 该死 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 来戴婚戒吧
sense_groups.english: Let's do the rings.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以吗？
sense_groups.english: We good? Yeah? Good?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要再一次…
sense_groups.english: Once again...

sense_groups.chinese: 宣布你们结为夫妇
sense_groups.english: ...I pronounce you husband and wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以再吻新娘一次
sense_groups.english: Now kiss her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道宝宝的事了
sense_groups.english: And I know about the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么宝宝？ - 我们的宝宝
sense_groups.english: What baby? - Our baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有宝宝了？
sense_groups.english: We have a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比发现了你的验孕棒
sense_groups.english: Phoebe found your pregnancy test.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有验孕
sense_groups.english: I didn't take a pregnancy test.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么是谁验了孕？
sense_groups.english: Then who did?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看他们
sense_groups.english: Look at them.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他们要有孩子了
sense_groups.english: And they're gonna have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 额
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.
