questions.en:
Great. Great. Just give me a sec to change film.
Okay. I know I'm not supposed to know, but I do and I am so excited for you.
Why? What's going on? - Monica's pregnant.
Oh, my God! Is that why you guys had to get married?
Guys, I'm not pregnant! - Ah, slow swimmers?
What? What do you mean? You're not pregnant?
You didn't tell anybody I was, did you? - No.
I'll be right back.
Now why don't we get a shot of Monica and the bloody soldier?
Oh, about that. Joey, you have to change before the party.
I can't. I don't have any other clothes.
Find some. Please! Anything that doesn't say, "I died tragically in France."
Then why don't we see the bride and the groom, and the bridesmaids?
Hey, Mon? Why did you tell the guys that you weren't pregnant?
Because I'm not.
We found your test in the trash. If you're not pregnant...
...it's because I am.
What are you talking about?
Yes. Ahem. I am with child.
And I didn't wanna say anything because it's your day.
I didn't wanna steal your thunder. - So you told people I was pregnant?
Does this look like a conversation I wanna remember?
Who's the father? - Yeah.
I can't say.
Why? - Why not?
I can't say because he's famous.
Oh, my God, who is it?
Come on, you have to tell us.
Okay, okay. It's James Brolin.
James Brolin is the father of my baby.
As in, Barbra Streisand's husband, James Brolin?
What? He never said that to me.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Monica, if you can step away, we'll get Chandler and the bridesmaids.
How about just the bridesmaids?
I am the groom. I was told it was kind of a big deal.
It is. - Yeah.
Oh, my God! - Thank you for doing that.
I just can't deal with this just quite yet.
So instead you told me Monica was pregnant?
You did, I just didn't disagree.
Sneaky! - Yeah.
Smile, ladies! - Ohh.
By the way, James Brolin? - Ugh. I know.
I could only think of two names: Him and Ed Begley Jr. And then...
I remembered he's gay, so...
Ed Begley Jr. Is not gay. - Really?
Thank you very much. Ladies and gentlemen, it gives me great pleasure...
...to introduce to you for the first time
Mr. And Mrs. Chandler Bing!
Before we go out there, I got a present for you.
I'm not gonna put my hand in your pocket.
No. - No?
I've been taking dancing lessons. - What?
Yeah, for the last 6 weeks. I wanted this to be a moment you'd never forget.
Aww. That is so sweet!
So would you care to join me in our first dance as husband and wife?
Yes. - Okay.
What's the matter? - These new shoes are all slippery.
Are you going to be able to do this? - Not well.
Well, the good news is I don't think anyone's looking at us.
So you ready to talk about it? - No.
Now?
No.
Okay, we'll talk about something else.
Thank you. - Who's the father?
Uh. Look, honey, I haven't told him yet...
...so until I do, I don't think I should tell anybody else.
Yeah. That's fine. That's fair. Is it Tag?
Ugh. Phoebe!
Okay. I'm sorry, I'll stop. - Okay.
Is it Ross? It's Ross, isn't it?
Oh, my God, it's Joey! - Honey, stop it, okay?
I'm not going to tell you until I tell him.
Ah-ha! At least we know it's a him.
Oh, sweet lord.
I'm sorry, okay?
I went down to the gift shop, and it was either this or a bathrobe.
Look, what's more important? The way I'm dressed or me being with you today?
Honey, I'm not even going to pretend I was listening. Hey! Hey.
Hi.
I'm Ross. I don't believe we've met. I'm Monica's older brother.
Hi, I'm Mona from her restaurant. - Oh.
Hello, "Mona from her restaurant."
Mona. What a beautiful name.
You think so? I always kind of hated it.
Aw, come on! Mona Lisa? - Uh-huh.
Mona...
...Klegglachen?
The famous botanist. Huh?
Oh, no. She's... Well, she's dead now.
But supposedly she was once quite the hottie of the plant world.
Really? - Yeah.
Well, see, I never knew about her. - Linda Klegglachen...
So, what table are you at?
Oh, heh, me too.
Good. There will be someone who likes my name.
Yes, there will.
Guess what, Molly Gilbert. You've just been bumped up to table one.
And if it's all right with you, I'm gonna take your place at table six.
Martin Klegglachen!
That's better. Just bend your arms a little more. There you go. Look straight ahead.
Now this time I want you to really put your ass into it.
Chandler, darling, look, my date has finally arrived.
I'd like you to meet Dennis Phillips.
Congratulations. - Thanks.
Dennis is a dear old friend. And a fantastic lover.
Bravo, Dennis, thanks for pleasing my mother so.
I'm so sorry I missed the ceremony. I was stuck at auditions.
Dennis is directing a new Broadway show.
Hi, I don't believe we've met. Joey Tribbiani.
Dennis Phillips. - Wow. I've admired your work for years.
You've done some amazing stuff.
Thank you. Excuse me, I'll get myself a drink.
I'll be back in a moment.
Dennis Phillips! That's great! How did you guys meet?
Well, you know, it's a funny story.
Funny "ha-ha," or funny "boom, uh-oh!"
Thank you very much. Now if everyone will please take their seats,
dinner will be served.
Hey.
Uh, I thought you were at table six. - Uh, no. Nine.
Ohh. See, before, when you showed it to me, you held it that way...
...which was misleading.
Well... I'll... um...
Hello.
Chandler! Will you see if your mom can give my resume to Dennis Phillips?
Because if I can get into a Broadway show, I would've done it all
Film, television and theater.
The only thing left would be radio, and that's just for ugly people.
What size shoes do you wear? - Uh, eleven. Eleven and a half.
Great. My shoes are giving me a problem on the dance floor.
Can I borrow the boots from your costume?
I don't know where I left those, so...
Those aren't eleven and a half. - Okay, fine, I'm a 7!
All right, I have surprisingly small feet. But the rest of me is good! I'll show you!
Can you believe Phoebe got pregnant? - Let's not talk about that now.
This is so huge. - Sure, but as big as your wedding?
Of course not. Nothing is.
Wow. Between me and you? - Yeah.
In this day and age, how dumb do you have to be to get pregnant?
Hey, sometimes you can do everything right, wear what you're supposed to...
...and one of those little guys just gets through.
How? - I don't know, maybe they have tools.
Well, I talked to her, and she's definitely gonna have this baby.
She's gonna raise it on her own.
Well, maybe that's really brave. - Maybe.
I just hope she realizes how hard it's gonna be.
Maybe she hasn't really thought it through that much.
There's a lot to think about.
How is she gonna handle this financially? How is she gonna juggle work?
Does she realize she's not gonna have a date again for the next 18 years?
I don't know.
Are you okay?
Mm-hm.
I'm just thinking about Phoebe. Poor, knocked-up Phoebe.
Champagne? - Oh, yes. Thank you very much. Whew.
That's actually how the French drink it.
Well, I just got off the phone with my lover, James Brolin.
Really? - Yes.
And apparently, he is married to some singer.
But he said he'd leave her for me. So I said, "Are you sure?"
And James Brolin said... - Rachel's the one who's pregnant?
What?
Why bother?
How do you feel?
I don't know how I feel. This is all happening so fast.
I have to make all these decisions that I don't want to make.
Mm! Oh! Someone take this away from me!
Calm down. Maybe you're not pregnant. - What?
When I got pregnant with the triplets, I took the test three times.
Yes. Maybe it's a false-positive. Are you sure you peed on the stick right?
How many ways are there to do that?
I'm just saying, don't freak out until you're 100 percent sure.
I'll take it again at home.
You gotta take it now, as a present to me.
Okay. Thank you.
I'll run out and get you one. - Aw, you girls are so great.
Wait a minute. Who's the father?
She won't tell us. - Come on! It's my wedding.
That could be my present.
Hey! I just gave you peeing on a stick. - See, this is why you register.
It was the chair again, okay? I'm not doing it!
It was... Look, I don't. You know what?
Hi. - Hi.
Would you like to dance? - Sure.
Yeah. - Oh, great.
Dr. Geller? - I wasn't farting!
Uh, a little game from our table.
Yes? - Dr. Geller, will you dance with me?
Oh. Um...
Maybe later. I'm about to dance with this lady.
Okay.
Ooooh.
Unless this lady wouldn't mind letting you go first.
I'd be happy to. You are very sweet.
Ohh. Yes, I am.
In fact, why don't we try it my special way. You can dance on my feet.
Sure. - Yeah? Hop on.
Is the pretty lady looking? - Uh-huh.
Keep dancing.
And the world will never know.
Hey! Did you talk to Dennis? - Yes. I told him how talented you were.
I told him all about Days ofour Lives.
No, you don't tell a Broadway guy that!
Now he thinks I'm just a soap actor. - But you're not just a soap actor.
You are a soap actor with freakishly tiny feet.
Hey.
Thank you. - No, thank you, Miranda.
Melinda. - All right.
How cute was that? - Oh! Were you watching?
Can I go next? - Uh...
Of course you can. Hop on.
Okay. But I get to hop on after her.
I am so gonna score! - What?
I like your bow.
I'd like to propose a toast to Monica and Chandler...
...the greatest couple in the world, and my best friends.
When I first found out they were getting married, I was a little angry.
I was like, "Why, God? How can you take them away from me?!"
But then I thought back over our memories together.
Some happy memories.
Then there were some sad memories.
I'm sorry.
And some scared memories. Whoa!
And then I realized I'll always be their friend.
Their friend who can speak in many dialects...
...has training in stage combat and is willing to do partial nudity.
Oh... To the happy couple.
That was very nice, Ashley. - Can we do it again?
No, no.
So is it my turn? - I'm next.
Oh!
That's okay, you can dance with her first. - Are you sure?
Okay.
So what's your name? - Gert.
That's pretty.
Come on.
Whoa! Whoa!
What are you doing, Gert?
Dancing on your feet like the other girls did it.
Okay.
Hop on, Gert.
Why aren't you moving your feet? - I'm trying.
Faster! You're not going fast enough!
Maybe I should stand on your feet!
So did you happen to catch my toast up there?
Oh, my God. That was for my benefit?
Well, I like to think there was something for everyone.
I know you're casting for this new show.
Look, Joey, I don't think you're right for it.
See, that's where you're wrong. Whatever it is, I can do it.
And if you didn't see it up there, just try me.
It's an all Chinese cast.
Can you be Chinese?
I'm not proud of this, but... - Oh, my God. No, please! Don't!
Ready to get back on the dance floor? - Did it turn into sand?
Come on, I love this song. You'll be fine. - No, I won't.
Do you know why I took all those lessons?
For the first time, I didn't want you to be embarrassed...
to be seen on the dance floor with some clumsy idiot.
Aww. Sweetie, you could never embarrass me.
Okay, you could easily embarrass me.
But it doesn't matter. Right?
I married you.
So I'm gonna dance on my wedding night with my husband. Come on!
Just try not to move your feet at all. - Oh.
There you go.
Chandler, I'm gonna have you arrested. - Why?
You stole my moves.
How much longer? - Thirty seconds.
Thirty seconds. Okay.
Did I miss it?
Rachel, I want you to know...
...that if it's positive, we...
I know. I know. - You do? Okay.
It's time.
No!
Go ahead, Rach. - Oh, wait. You know what? I can't look at it.
I can't look at it. Somebody else tell me.
Okay. - Okay.
It's negative.
What? - It's negative.
Oh.
Well, there you go.
Whew!
That is... That is really great, great news.
Because the whole...
...not being ready, the financial aspects, all that...
This is so just the way it was supposed to be.
Then, great.
God. This is so stupid.
How can I be upset over something I never had?
It's negative?
No, it's positive.
What? - It's not negative, it's positive.
Are you sure? - Yeah, I lied before.
Oh!
Oh, my God!
Now you know how you really feel about it. - Oh! That's a risky little game.
Are you really gonna do this?
Yeah. I'm gonna have a baby.
I'm gonna have a baby!
With who? - No, it's still not the time.
I just didn't see the fast song coming.
Shh. Don't try to talk.
We'll get you up to your room, soak your feet. You'll be okay.
Oh, thank you. - That is so sweet!
Yeah. - No, I mean it.
There's so few genuinely nice guys out there.
Tell me about it.
I feel like I'm holding down the fort all by myself.
It's Joey, right? - Yeah.
Wait a minute! No! I'm the nice one!
I'm the one that danced with the kids all night.
How small are your feet?

sense_groups.english: You didn't tell anybody I was, did you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be right back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不拍张摩妮卡跟英勇士兵的合照
sense_groups.english: Now why don't we get a shot of Monica and the bloody soldier?

sense_groups.chinese: 关于那一点 乔伊 你得在婚宴开始前换套衣服
sense_groups.english: Oh, about that. Joey, you have to change before the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不到 我没带衣服来换 - 拜托你去找套衣服
sense_groups.english: I can't. I don't have any other clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再穿着"我在法国战死"的衣服
sense_groups.english: Find some. Please! Anything that doesn't say, "I died tragically in France."

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不让新人跟伴娘们合照一些照片
sense_groups.english: Then why don't we see the bride and the groom, and the bridesmaids?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你为什么告诉大家你没有怀孕
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mon? Why did you tell the guys that you weren't pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我没有怀孕
sense_groups.english: Because I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们发现了你的验孕棒 如果你没有怀孕…
sense_groups.english: We found your test in the trash. If you're not pregnant...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: ...it's because I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在胡说什么
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我怀了孩子
sense_groups.english: Yes. Ahem. I am with child.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想说是因为今天是你们的大喜之日
sense_groups.english: And I didn't wanna say anything because it's your day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想抢了你的风采 - 于是你告诉大家我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: I didn't wanna steal your thunder. - So you told people I was pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是那种我会想记住的对话吗
sense_groups.english: Does this look like a conversation I wanna remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子的爸是谁 - 对
sense_groups.english: Who's the father? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说
sense_groups.english: I can't say.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 为什么不行
sense_groups.english: Why? - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说 因为他是名人
sense_groups.english: I can't say because he's famous.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他是谁
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, who is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你得告诉我们
sense_groups.english: Come on, you have to tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 是詹姆斯·布洛林
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. It's James Brolin.

sense_groups.chinese: 詹姆斯·布洛林是孩子的爸爸
sense_groups.english: James Brolin is the father of my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说芭芭拉·史翠珊的老公 詹姆斯·布洛林
sense_groups.english: As in, Barbra Streisand's husband, James Brolin?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 他一直都没有告诉我
sense_groups.english: What? He never said that to me.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 请你先离开 我们要拍钱德跟伴娘的合照
sense_groups.english: Monica, if you can step away, we'll get Chandler and the bridesmaids.

sense_groups.chinese: 何不只拍伴娘的合照呢
sense_groups.english: How about just the bridesmaids?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是新郎 听说这个位置很重要
sense_groups.english: I am the groom. I was told it was kind of a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 对
sense_groups.english: It is. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - Thank you for doing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有办法承受那样的压力
sense_groups.english: I just can't deal with this just quite yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 于是你告诉我 摩妮卡怀孕了
sense_groups.english: So instead you told me Monica was pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 是你说她怀孕了 我只是没有反驳你
sense_groups.english: You did, I just didn't disagree.

sense_groups.chinese: 很狡猾 - 对
sense_groups.english: Sneaky! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 笑一个 小姐们 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Smile, ladies! - Ohh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 詹姆斯·布洛林 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: By the way, James Brolin? - Ugh. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我脑海里浮起两个人名 他跟小艾德·贝格利
sense_groups.english: I could only think of two names: Him and Ed Begley Jr. And then...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我想起来他是同志 所以…
sense_groups.english: I remembered he's gay, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 小艾德·贝格利不是同志 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Ed Begley Jr. Is not gay. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 各位先生女士 我很荣幸
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much. Ladies and gentlemen, it gives me great pleasure...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟大家介绍
sense_groups.english: ...to introduce to you for the first time

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾夫妇
sense_groups.english: Mr. And Mrs. Chandler Bing!

sense_groups.chinese: 到舞池前我要送你一份礼物
sense_groups.english: Before we go out there, I got a present for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想把手伸到你的口袋里
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna put my hand in your pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不吗
sense_groups.english: No. - No?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去上了舞蹈课 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I've been taking dancing lessons. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我上了六星期舞蹈课 我希望这一刻能让你永生难忘
sense_groups.english: Yeah, for the last 6 weeks. I wanted this to be a moment you'd never forget.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太体贴了
sense_groups.english: Aww. That is so sweet!

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿不愿意以夫妻的身份跟我跳第一支舞
sense_groups.english: So would you care to join me in our first dance as husband and wife?

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 我的新鞋太滑了
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - These new shoes are all slippery.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能跳舞吗 - 不太行
sense_groups.english: Are you going to be able to do this? - Not well.

sense_groups.chinese: 好消息 我想没有人在看我们
sense_groups.english: Well, the good news is I don't think anyone's looking at us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备要谈了吗 - 不要
sense_groups.english: So you ready to talk about it? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在呢
sense_groups.english: Now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们来谈别的事
sense_groups.english: Okay, we'll talk about something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 孩子的爸是谁
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Who's the father?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我还没有告诉他…
sense_groups.english: Uh. Look, honey, I haven't told him yet...

sense_groups.chinese: 我打算先告诉他 再告诉其他人
sense_groups.english: ...so until I do, I don't think I should tell anybody else.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 那很公平 是泰格吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah. That's fine. That's fair. Is it Tag?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 对不起 我不说了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. I'm sorry, I'll stop. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗斯吗 是罗斯吧
sense_groups.english: Is it Ross? It's Ross, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是乔伊 - 别说了 好吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, it's Joey! - Honey, stop it, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 在告诉他之前 我不会告诉你的
sense_groups.english: I'm not going to tell you until I tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我们知道他是个男的
sense_groups.english: Ah-ha! At least we know it's a him.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweet lord.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 好吗
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跑到礼品店 那里只卖这个跟浴袍
sense_groups.english: I went down to the gift shop, and it was either this or a bathrobe.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事比较重要呢 我的穿着打扮还是我今天能够出席
sense_groups.english: Look, what's more important? The way I'm dressed or me being with you today?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会假装我听到你说什么
sense_groups.english: Honey, I'm not even going to pretend I was listening. Hey! Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯 我相信我们没有见过 我是摩妮卡的哥哥
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross. I don't believe we've met. I'm Monica's older brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是她在餐厅的同事蒙娜 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Mona from her restaurant. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 "她在餐厅的同事蒙娜"
sense_groups.english: Hello, "Mona from her restaurant."

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜 这个名字很美
sense_groups.english: Mona. What a beautiful name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的那么想 我一直都很讨厌这个名字
sense_groups.english: You think so? I always kind of hated it.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 蒙娜丽莎 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Aw, come on! Mona Lisa? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜…
sense_groups.english: Mona...

sense_groups.chinese: 利格拉齐
sense_groups.english: ...Klegglachen?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是著名的植物学家
sense_groups.english: The famous botanist. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她… 她死了 但是…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. She's... Well, she's dead now.

sense_groups.chinese: 她曾经是植物学界最性感的女人
sense_groups.english: But supposedly she was once quite the hottie of the plant world.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不认识她 - 琳达·利格拉齐…
sense_groups.english: Well, see, I never knew about her. - Linda Klegglachen...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在几号桌
sense_groups.english: So, what table are you at?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Oh, heh, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 那么有个喜欢我名字的人会跟我同桌
sense_groups.english: Good. There will be someone who likes my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, there will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜怎么了 茉莉·吉柏特 你刚刚被踢到一号桌
sense_groups.english: Guess what, Molly Gilbert. You've just been bumped up to table one.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你没有意见的话 我要代替你坐到六号桌
sense_groups.english: And if it's all right with you, I'm gonna take your place at table six.

sense_groups.chinese: 马丁·利格拉齐
sense_groups.english: Martin Klegglachen!

sense_groups.chinese: 那样子好多了 现在双手弯曲 眼睛看前方
sense_groups.english: That's better. Just bend your arms a little more. There you go. Look straight ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次我要你臀部用力顶
sense_groups.english: Now this time I want you to really put your ass into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你看 我的男伴终于来了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, darling, look, my date has finally arrived.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你见见丹尼斯·菲利浦斯
sense_groups.english: I'd like you to meet Dennis Phillips.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Congratulations. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼斯是我的老朋友跟很棒的情人
sense_groups.english: Dennis is a dear old friend. And a fantastic lover.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 丹尼斯 谢谢你取悦我老妈
sense_groups.english: Bravo, Dennis, thanks for pleasing my mother so.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我没赶上婚礼 我忙着在试镜
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry I missed the ceremony. I was stuck at auditions.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 丹尼斯正在执导一出百老汇新戏
sense_groups.english: Dennis is directing a new Broadway show.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信能见到你 乔伊·崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: Hi, I don't believe we've met. Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼斯·菲利浦斯 - 多年来我一直很仰慕你的成就
sense_groups.english: Dennis Phillips. - Wow. I've admired your work for years.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很棒
sense_groups.english: You've done some amazing stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 对不起 我要去喝点东西
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Excuse me, I'll get myself a drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in a moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 丹尼斯·菲利浦斯 那真的是太棒了 你们怎么认识的
sense_groups.english: Dennis Phillips! That's great! How did you guys meet?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个有趣的故事
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, it's a funny story.

sense_groups.chinese: 是普通有趣还是爆笑
sense_groups.english: Funny "ha-ha," or funny "boom, uh-oh!"

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 大家请坐
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much. Now if everyone will please take their seats,

sense_groups.chinese: 晚宴马上开始
sense_groups.english: dinner will be served.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你在六号桌 - 不 是九号桌
sense_groups.english: Uh, I thought you were at table six. - Uh, no. Nine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚拿给我看时 是那样子拿的…
sense_groups.english: Ohh. See, before, when you showed it to me, you held it that way...

sense_groups.chinese: 我被你误导了
sense_groups.english: ...which was misleading.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: Well... I'll... um...

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你能请你妈把我的履历表拿给丹尼斯·菲利浦斯吗
sense_groups.english: Chandler! Will you see if your mom can give my resume to Dennis Phillips?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要能演百老汇舞台剧 我就什么戏都能演了
sense_groups.english: Because if I can get into a Broadway show, I would've done it all

sense_groups.chinese: 电影 电视剧跟舞台剧
sense_groups.english: Film, television and theater.

sense_groups.chinese: 唯一例外是广播剧 因为那是给丑八怪演的
sense_groups.english: The only thing left would be radio, and that's just for ugly people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿几号鞋 - 11 11号半
sense_groups.english: What size shoes do you wear? - Uh, eleven. Eleven and a half.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的鞋子太滑没办法跳舞
sense_groups.english: Great. My shoes are giving me a problem on the dance floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的戏靴能借我吗
sense_groups.english: Can I borrow the boots from your costume?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不知道我把靴子丢到哪里去了
sense_groups.english: I don't know where I left those, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脚不可能是11号半 - 好吧 我穿7号的鞋子
sense_groups.english: Those aren't eleven and a half. - Okay, fine, I'm a 7!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的脚非常小 但其他部分都很大 我可以露给你看
sense_groups.english: All right, I have surprisingly small feet. But the rest of me is good! I'll show you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信菲比怀孕了吗 - 现在别谈那件事
sense_groups.english: Can you believe Phoebe got pregnant? - Let's not talk about that now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是大消息 - 没错 但它没有你的婚礼重要
sense_groups.english: This is so huge. - Sure, but as big as your wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我的婚礼是最重要的
sense_groups.english: Of course not. Nothing is.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们私下的谈话 - 是的
sense_groups.english: Wow. Between me and you? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了这个时代 谁会笨到让自己怀孕
sense_groups.english: In this day and age, how dumb do you have to be to get pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候你该做的都做了 大家都戴上他们该戴的东西…
sense_groups.english: Hey, sometimes you can do everything right, wear what you're supposed to...

sense_groups.chinese: 但有个小家伙还是攻过了城池
sense_groups.english: ...and one of those little guys just gets through.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会呢 - 我不知道 或许它们有工具
sense_groups.english: How? - I don't know, maybe they have tools.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她谈过 她想留下孩子
sense_groups.english: Well, I talked to her, and she's definitely gonna have this baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说她要自己抚养孩子
sense_groups.english: She's gonna raise it on her own.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许那真的很勇敢 - 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe that's really brave. - Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是希望她知道那有多辛苦
sense_groups.english: I just hope she realizes how hard it's gonna be.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她没有想那么多
sense_groups.english: Maybe she hasn't really thought it through that much.

sense_groups.chinese: 的确有很多事需要考虑
sense_groups.english: There's a lot to think about.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要怎么处理经济问题 她怎么有办法去工作
sense_groups.english: How is she gonna handle this financially? How is she gonna juggle work?

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道她在未来的18年内都无法再去约会了吗
sense_groups.english: Does she realize she's not gonna have a date again for the next 18 years?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想到了菲比 怀了孕的可怜菲比
sense_groups.english: I'm just thinking about Phoebe. Poor, knocked-up Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 要喝香槟吗 - 好的 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Champagne? - Oh, yes. Thank you very much. Whew.

sense_groups.chinese: 法国人都是那样喝香槟的
sense_groups.english: That's actually how the French drink it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚跟我的情人詹姆斯·布洛林通过电话
sense_groups.english: Well, I just got off the phone with my lover, James Brolin.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 真的
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地他娶了一个歌手
sense_groups.english: And apparently, he is married to some singer.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他说他会为了我离开她 我说"你确定吗"
sense_groups.english: But he said he'd leave her for me. So I said, "Are you sure?"

sense_groups.chinese: 詹姆斯·布洛林说… - 怀孕的人是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: And James Brolin said... - Rachel's the one who's pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 干嘛那么麻烦呢
sense_groups.english: Why bother?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得如何
sense_groups.english: How do you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我有什么感觉 一切发生的太快
sense_groups.english: I don't know how I feel. This is all happening so fast.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得做出这些我不想做的决定
sense_groups.english: I have to make all these decisions that I don't want to make.

sense_groups.chinese: 快把这玩意拿走
sense_groups.english: Mm! Oh! Someone take this away from me!

sense_groups.chinese: 冷静点 或许你没有怀孕 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Calm down. Maybe you're not pregnant. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怀三胞胎时 也验了三次孕才确定
sense_groups.english: When I got pregnant with the triplets, I took the test three times.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 或许是假警报 你确定你尿在验孕棒的方式没错
sense_groups.english: Yes. Maybe it's a false-positive. Are you sure you peed on the stick right?

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我要怎么尿才对
sense_groups.english: How many ways are there to do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说没有百分之百确定前 别大惊小怪
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying, don't freak out until you're 100 percent sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我回家后会再验一次
sense_groups.english: I'll take it again at home.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以现在验 - 就当是送我的礼物
sense_groups.english: You gotta take it now, as a present to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Okay. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去帮你买验孕棒 - 你们真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: I'll run out and get you one. - Aw, you girls are so great.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 孩子的爸是谁
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Who's the father?

sense_groups.chinese: 她不肯告诉我们 - 快说吧 这是我的婚礼
sense_groups.english: She won't tell us. - Come on! It's my wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可以当做是送我的礼物
sense_groups.english: That could be my present.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才刚答应为了你验孕 - 看吧 所以一定要有礼物清单
sense_groups.english: Hey! I just gave you peeing on a stick. - See, this is why you register.

sense_groups.chinese: 又是椅子的声音 好吗 不是我干的
sense_groups.english: It was the chair again, okay? I'm not doing it!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我没有… 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: It was... Look, I don't. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想跳舞吗 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Would you like to dance? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Oh, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒博士 - 我没有放屁
sense_groups.english: Dr. Geller? - I wasn't farting!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我们那一桌玩的小游戏
sense_groups.english: Uh, a little game from our table.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事 - 盖勒博士 你愿意跟我跳舞吗
sense_groups.english: Yes? - Dr. Geller, will you dance with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许待会再说 现在我要跟这位小姐跳舞
sense_groups.english: Maybe later. I'm about to dance with this lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦哦
sense_groups.english: Ooooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非这位小姐不介意让你插队
sense_groups.english: Unless this lady wouldn't mind letting you go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意 你太好心了
sense_groups.english: I'd be happy to. You are very sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Ohh. Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我们来试试我的绝招 你可以踩在我的脚上跳舞
sense_groups.english: In fact, why don't we try it my special way. You can dance on my feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 是吗 跳上来吧
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Yeah? Hop on.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个美丽的小姐在看吗 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Is the pretty lady looking? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续跳
sense_groups.english: Keep dancing.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想得到呢
sense_groups.english: And the world will never know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟丹尼斯提过我的事了吗 - 有 我说你非常有天分
sense_groups.english: Hey! Did you talk to Dennis? - Yes. I told him how talented you were.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有"我们的日子"的事
sense_groups.english: I told him all about Days ofour Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…你不能告诉百老汇导演那种事
sense_groups.english: No, you don't tell a Broadway guy that!

sense_groups.chinese: 他会以为我是肥皂剧演员 - 但你不只是肥皂剧演员
sense_groups.english: Now he thinks I'm just a soap actor. - But you're not just a soap actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是有双小脚的肥皂剧演员
sense_groups.english: You are a soap actor with freakishly tiny feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 不 谢谢你 米兰达
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - No, thank you, Miranda.

sense_groups.chinese: 是梅玲达 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Melinda. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的好可爱 - 你在看我们吗
sense_groups.english: How cute was that? - Oh! Were you watching?

sense_groups.chinese: 下一个是我吗 - 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Can I go next? - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是 来吧
sense_groups.english: Of course you can. Hop on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但我要排在她后面
sense_groups.english: Okay. But I get to hop on after her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定能得分 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I am so gonna score! - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你的蝴蝶结
sense_groups.english: I like your bow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要请大家举杯 向摩妮卡及钱德致意…
sense_groups.english: I'd like to propose a toast to Monica and Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是全世界最速配的夫妻 也是我最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: ...the greatest couple in the world, and my best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚听说他们要结婚时 我有点生气
sense_groups.english: When I first found out they were getting married, I was a little angry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我心想"天啊 为什么 你为什么要把他们从我身边抢走"
sense_groups.english: I was like, "Why, God? How can you take them away from me?!"

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我回想起我们之间所有的回忆
sense_groups.english: But then I thought back over our memories together.

sense_groups.chinese: 快乐的回忆
sense_groups.english: Some happy memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟悲伤的回忆
sense_groups.english: Then there were some sad memories.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有可怕的回忆
sense_groups.english: And some scared memories. Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我了解到 我永远都会是他们的朋友
sense_groups.english: And then I realized I'll always be their friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们的朋友能说许多台词…
sense_groups.english: Their friend who can speak in many dialects...

sense_groups.chinese: 接受过舞台打斗训练 愿意拍部分裸露的戏
sense_groups.english: ...has training in stage combat and is willing to do partial nudity.

sense_groups.chinese: 敬这对金童玉女
sense_groups.english: Oh... To the happy couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那真的是太棒了 艾许莉 - 我们能再跳一次吗
sense_groups.english: That was very nice, Ashley. - Can we do it again?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在轮到我了吗 - 我是下一个
sense_groups.english: So is it my turn? - I'm next.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你可以先跟她跳 - 你确定
sense_groups.english: That's okay, you can dance with her first. - Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫什么名字 - 葛特
sense_groups.english: So what's your name? - Gert.

sense_groups.chinese: 很美的名字
sense_groups.english: That's pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoa! Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 葛特
sense_groups.english: What are you doing, Gert?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟其他女孩一样 踩在你脚上跳舞
sense_groups.english: Dancing on your feet like the other girls did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 跳上来吧 葛特
sense_groups.english: Hop on, Gert.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脚为什么不动 - 我在努力了
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you moving your feet? - I'm trying.

sense_groups.chinese: 快一点 你跳的太慢了
sense_groups.english: Faster! You're not going fast enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该踩在你脚上
sense_groups.english: Maybe I should stand on your feet!

sense_groups.chinese: 你有听到我的致词了吗
sense_groups.english: So did you happen to catch my toast up there?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你那么做是为了我
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. That was for my benefit?

sense_groups.chinese: 我那么做是为了所有人
sense_groups.english: Well, I like to think there was something for everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你在为新戏选角
sense_groups.english: I know you're casting for this new show.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你不适合这个计划
sense_groups.english: Look, Joey, I don't think you're right for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你错了 不论内容是什么 我都办得到
sense_groups.english: See, that's where you're wrong. Whatever it is, I can do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你对刚刚的表演不满意 考考我
sense_groups.english: And if you didn't see it up there, just try me.

sense_groups.chinese: 那出戏的演员全是中国人
sense_groups.english: It's an all Chinese cast.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以变成中国人吗
sense_groups.english: Can you be Chinese?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不以此为荣 但是… - 天啊 求求你别那么做
sense_groups.english: I'm not proud of this, but... - Oh, my God. No, please! Don't!

sense_groups.chinese: 准备重回舞池了吗 - 它变成沙地了吗
sense_groups.english: Ready to get back on the dance floor? - Did it turn into sand?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这首歌 你会跳得很好的 - 不 我不会的
sense_groups.english: Come on, I love this song. You'll be fine. - No, I won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道为什么我要去上舞蹈课吗
sense_groups.english: Do you know why I took all those lessons?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望你被看到
sense_groups.english: For the first time, I didn't want you to be embarrassed...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟一个笨拙的白痴跳舞 丢光了脸
sense_groups.english: to be seen on the dance floor with some clumsy idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你不可能让我出糗
sense_groups.english: Aww. Sweetie, you could never embarrass me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你很容易就会让我出糗
sense_groups.english: Okay, you could easily embarrass me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那不重要 好吗
sense_groups.english: But it doesn't matter. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我嫁给你
sense_groups.english: I married you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要在我的婚礼和我丈夫跳舞 来吧
sense_groups.english: So I'm gonna dance on my wedding night with my husband. Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 尽量不要移动你的脚 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Just try not to move your feet at all. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那样
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我要逮捕你 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I'm gonna have you arrested. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你偷走了我的舞步
sense_groups.english: You stole my moves.

sense_groups.chinese: 还要多久 - 30秒
sense_groups.english: How much longer? - Thirty seconds.

sense_groups.chinese: 30秒 好吧…
sense_groups.english: Thirty seconds. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我错过了吗
sense_groups.english: Did I miss it?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我要你知道
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I want you to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是阳性反应 我们得…
sense_groups.english: ...that if it's positive, we...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 - 你知道 好吧
sense_groups.english: I know. I know. - You do? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 时候到了
sense_groups.english: It's time.

sense_groups.chinese: 不准进来
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 瑞秋 - 等一下 知道吗 我不敢看
sense_groups.english: Go ahead, Rach. - Oh, wait. You know what? I can't look at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢看 谁帮我看一下
sense_groups.english: I can't look at it. Somebody else tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是阴性反应
sense_groups.english: It's negative.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 是阴性反应
sense_groups.english: What? - It's negative.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 真相揭晓
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 哟
sense_groups.english: Whew!

sense_groups.chinese: 那…那真的是太棒了 这真是个天大的好消息
sense_groups.english: That is... That is really great, great news.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这整件事…
sense_groups.english: Because the whole...

sense_groups.chinese: 在经济方面我还没有准备好 所以…
sense_groups.english: ...not being ready, the financial aspects, all that...

sense_groups.chinese: 事情本来就应该是这样的
sense_groups.english: This is so just the way it was supposed to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么说的话 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Then, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这真的是太愚蠢了
sense_groups.english: God. This is so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么会为了我从来没有拥有过的东西难过
sense_groups.english: How can I be upset over something I never had?

sense_groups.chinese: 是阴性反应吗
sense_groups.english: It's negative?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是阳性反应
sense_groups.english: No, it's positive.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 不是阴性反应 是阳性反应
sense_groups.english: What? - It's not negative, it's positive.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定 - 对 刚刚我说谎
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Yeah, I lied before.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你知道真正的感觉了吧 - 那是个危险的小把戏
sense_groups.english: Now you know how you really feel about it. - Oh! That's a risky little game.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要这么做
sense_groups.english: Are you really gonna do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要生下孩子
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'm gonna have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要生下孩子
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna have a baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子的爸是谁 - 不 现在还不是时候
sense_groups.english: With who? - No, it's still not the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道接下来是快歌
sense_groups.english: I just didn't see the fast song coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说话 我们送你回房问
sense_groups.english: Shh. Don't try to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们送你回房间 让你泡泡脚 你会没事的
sense_groups.english: We'll get you up to your room, soak your feet. You'll be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 那真的是太好心了
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. - That is so sweet!

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 - 不 我是认真的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - No, I mean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在好男人不多了
sense_groups.english: There's so few genuinely nice guys out there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Tell me about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得自己像是死守碉堡的士兵
sense_groups.english: I feel like I'm holding down the fort all by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是乔伊 对吧 - 对
sense_groups.english: It's Joey, right? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 不 我才是好人
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute! No! I'm the nice one!

sense_groups.chinese: 是我整晚跟孩子们跳舞 我…
sense_groups.english: I'm the one that danced with the kids all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脚好小喔
sense_groups.english: How small are your feet?

questions.name: S08E02
questions.en:
Listen, you know what? Sir, for the last time, I don't care what the computer says.
We did not take a bag of Meshugga Nuts from the minibar.
And we did not watch Dr. Do-Me-A-Little.
Hey. - Oh.
Joey, were you in our room last night? - No.
I was told the name of the movie would not appear on the bill.
Hi, we're checking out of the bridal suite. - That's right, I'm no longer a bride.
I'll never be a bride again. Now I'm just someone's wife.
And I'm the happiest guy in the world.
Come on, honey. Don't be upset. We have so much to look forward to.
Yeah, right.
The honeymoon. - That's not till Thursday.
The wedding pictures. - Those won't be ready weeks.
Not the disposable cameras from the tables.
That's true! I knew I married you for a reason!
I'll tell you what. I will go get them developed, and you can go home.
What? What did you take a picture of? - Nothing. It was something.
Okay, Ross has the cameras. Is he checked out yet?
Are you joking? Checkout is not till noon.
And he has a good 11 minutes left. - So?
So Ross has never checked out of a room a minute before he had to.
Yeah, one time when we were dating...
...we got a late checkout, he got so excited, it was the best sex we ever had.
Until he screamed out "Radisson" at the end.
Okay, I'm gonna get Ross, get the cameras, and get them developed.
Thirty-two, Joe. You're 32!
Here's a copy of your bill. - Oh, thanks.
Champagne, strawberries...
Oh, my God! I can't believe Chandler ordered porn on our wedding night.
Yeah, that's sad.
Meshugga Nut?
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hi. - Hi.
Soaps, shampoos. Are you really taking all this stuff?
Why not? It's built into the price of the room. - Yeah, but you don't need...
What is this? - Thread.
Score!
Where are the disposable cameras? - What disposable cameras?
Last night I asked you to take them.
No, you didn't. - Yes, before we cut the cake, I said...
Yeah, you came up to me and asked me for a favor.
And then my Uncle Murray came up to you and handed you a check.
Then you said, "Why do they call it a check? Why not a Yugoslavian?"
Yeah, then you did that. - So you don't have the cameras?
No, sorry. - So what? What?
They're gone? Monica's gonna freak!
'm sure they're here somewhere.
I'll help you look for them.
Great. - In three minutes.
Hey - Hey.
Are you gonna open the presents without Chandler?
No.
They're calling out to me.
This little guy even crawled up in my lap.
Come on, Chandler wouldn't mind if I opened just one present.
What do you think it is?
A mirror that when you look into it, you see yourself as an old woman.
A tiny salt shaker!
Oh, my God, for tiny salt!
Oh, wow! Okay, that was fun.
Oh, yeah.
I'm just gonna wait for Chandler to open up the rest of them.
Okay. - Whoo!
Although, you know, this is part of a salt-and-pepper set.
So I guess it may just count as half a present. What do you think?
Well, I guess it's okay to open one more if it's part of a set. It's probably this one.
Or this one!
Hi. - Hey.
How you feeling? Got any morning sickness?
Shh! The guys don't know yet, do they?
No. Joey and Ross don't know anything, and Chandler thinks Phoebe's pregnant.
That's right. Chandler does still think I'm pregnant.
He hasn't asked me how I'm feeling, or offered to carry my bags.
I feel bad for the woman who ends up with him.
After you, of course.
Don't worry. I promise that you will only have to be pregnant a few more hours.
I'm going to tell the father today.
Is it someone in this building? That tall guy from the first floor?
Eww! No! - What? I think he's cute.
Well, then you have his baby. - Believe me, I'm trying.
Wow. It's so weird. You're gonna tell this guy today...
...and he has no idea what's gonna happen.
Yeah. You're just gonna knock on his door and change his life forever.
You're like Ed McMahon, except without the big check.
Or the raw sexual magnetism.
Yeah, I guess it is pretty big news. - Pretty big? It's huge!
God, this guy doesn't have a clue. He's walking around thinking
"I had sex with Rachel Green. I rock!"
Then, bam! He's a father, everything's different.
Well, it's only different if he wants it to be. I'm not gonna ask him for anything.
Then he still has this huge decision to make. Now he's thinking
"Do I want to be a dad?" Then, bam!
What was that "bam"? - I don't know. He's hit by a bus.
Hi. - Hey.
Joey, what would you do if someone you slept with told you she was pregnant?
Who called here?
Did she sound blond? Any accent? I gotta make a call.
Should have never walked into that Sunglass Hut!
Oh, Joey! Joey! It's not you! You didn't get anyone pregnant.
Why would you scare me like that? What the hell's going on?
Is somebody pregnant?
Oh, yeah! That's me.
Oh, my God, Pheebs! You're gonna have a baby?
Yes, I am.
Oh, my God, I'm gonna have a baby!
Wait, who's the father? - You don't know him.
He wants nothing to do with me or the baby.
Who is this guy? Who is he? Because I'll track him down and kick his ass!
David Linn. - David Linn!
David Linn! David Linn!
Who's David Linn? - Some guy from my gym. A little annoying.
Chandler? - Hey. Did you find the cameras?
No. Did you?
Yes, that's why I'm under the table. Celebrating.
I checked in the lost and found.
I talked to the manager. No one's turned them in.
Great. Those cameras were the only thing that will cheer Monica up.
She's depressed.
You guys just got married. Why is she so depressed?
All my energy is going into not asking that question.
I can't believe I screwed this up! - I'm sorry, man.
Here's a thought. This is the same ballroom.
There's a band. There's gonna be plenty of dressed up people.
Are you suggesting we dance our troubles away?
No, we buy more of these at the gift shop,
throw our tuxes on and take a few pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就住在这栋公寓吗 是一楼那个高个儿吗
sense_groups.english: Is it someone in this building? That tall guy from the first floor?

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是 - 什么 我觉得他很可爱
sense_groups.english: Eww! No! - What? I think he's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你可以去怀他的孩子 - 相信我 我正在努力
sense_groups.english: Well, then you have his baby. - Believe me, I'm trying.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的好奇怪 你今天要告诉这个男人…
sense_groups.english: Wow. It's so weird. You're gonna tell this guy today...

sense_groups.chinese: 他不知道会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: ...and he has no idea what's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你要敲敲他的门 然后永远改变他的一生
sense_groups.english: Yeah. You're just gonna knock on his door and change his life forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就像艾德·麦马汉 只不过手上没有拿大额支票
sense_groups.english: You're like Ed McMahon, except without the big check.

sense_groups.chinese: 也没有原始的性吸引力
sense_groups.english: Or the raw sexual magnetism.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我想那的确是个大消息 - 大消息 那是超级大消息
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess it is pretty big news. - Pretty big? It's huge!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这个男人什么都不知道 他走在街上心想
sense_groups.english: God, this guy doesn't have a clue. He's walking around thinking

sense_groups.chinese: "我跟瑞秋·葛林做爱 太帅了"
sense_groups.english: "I had sex with Rachel Green. I rock!"

sense_groups.chinese: 然后 砰 他当了爸爸 一切都不一样了
sense_groups.english: Then, bam! He's a father, everything's different.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非他真的想当爸爸 我不会对他提出任何要求
sense_groups.english: Well, it's only different if he wants it to be. I'm not gonna ask him for anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还是得做出重大的决定 现在他边走边想
sense_groups.english: Then he still has this huge decision to make. Now he's thinking

sense_groups.chinese: "我要当爸爸吗" 然后 砰
sense_groups.english: "Do I want to be a dad?" Then, bam!

sense_groups.chinese: 这次怎么了 - 我不知道 他可能是撞上巴士了
sense_groups.english: What was that "bam"? - I don't know. He's hit by a bus.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 如果跟你上床的女人说她怀孕了 你会怎么办
sense_groups.english: Joey, what would you do if someone you slept with told you she was pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁打电话到这里来
sense_groups.english: Who called here?

sense_groups.chinese: 她听起来像金发美女吗 她有口音吗 我得去打个电话
sense_groups.english: Did she sound blond? Any accent? I gotta make a call.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该走进那家太阳眼镜专卖店的
sense_groups.english: Should have never walked into that Sunglass Hut!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊…不是你 你没有让任何人怀孕
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey! Joey! It's not you! You didn't get anyone pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要那样子吓我 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Why would you scare me like that? What the hell's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人怀孕了吗
sense_groups.english: Is somebody pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah! That's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 菲比 你要生孩子了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Pheebs! You're gonna have a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我要生孩子了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I'm gonna have a baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 孩子的爸是谁 - 你不认识他
sense_groups.english: Wait, who's the father? - You don't know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不重要 他不希望跟我或孩子扯上关系
sense_groups.english: He wants nothing to do with me or the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙是谁 因为我要把他揪出来痛扁他一顿
sense_groups.english: Who is this guy? Who is he? Because I'll track him down and kick his ass!

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫·林恩 - 大卫·林恩
sense_groups.english: David Linn. - David Linn!

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫·林恩 大卫·林恩
sense_groups.english: David Linn! David Linn!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是大卫·林恩 - 我在健身房认识的人 他很讨厌
sense_groups.english: Who's David Linn? - Some guy from my gym. A little annoying.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 嘿 你找到即可拍了吗
sense_groups.english: Chandler? - Hey. Did you find the cameras?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 你呢
sense_groups.english: No. Did you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到了 那就是我躲在桌下的原因 我想要庆祝
sense_groups.english: Yes, that's why I'm under the table. Celebrating.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去失物中心
sense_groups.english: I checked in the lost and found.

sense_groups.chinese: 问过经理 没有人捡到即可拍
sense_groups.english: I talked to the manager. No one's turned them in.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 今天只有那些即可拍能让摩妮卡高兴起来
sense_groups.english: Great. Those cameras were the only thing that will cheer Monica up.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很沮丧
sense_groups.english: She's depressed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们才刚刚结婚 她为什么会沮丧
sense_groups.english: You guys just got married. Why is she so depressed?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有力气问她那个问题
sense_groups.english: All my energy is going into not asking that question.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我搞砸了 - 我很遗憾 兄弟
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I screwed this up! - I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个点子 你们在这个宴会厅请客
sense_groups.english: Here's a thought. This is the same ballroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有乐队 等一下会有很多人盛装前来
sense_groups.english: There's a band. There's gonna be plenty of dressed up people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你建议我们可以丢下问题不管
sense_groups.english: Are you suggesting we dance our troubles away?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是说我们到礼品店买一些即可拍
sense_groups.english: No, we buy more of these at the gift shop,

sense_groups.chinese: 再换上礼服 拍几张照片
sense_groups.english: throw our tuxes on and take a few pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只要 不拍到任何人的脸就好
sense_groups.english: All have to do is make sure not to get people's faces.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是认真的吗
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想到在家等你的新娘
sense_groups.english: I'm just thinking about your new bride.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想在你们共度一生的第一天就让她失望吗
sense_groups.english: Okay? Do you really want to start your life together by letting her down?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的要给我关于婚姻的建议
sense_groups.english: Marriage advice? Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是在告诉你 这看起来很像你的婚宴
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, this looks exactly like your wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些花都一样吧 - 我不知道 花是摩妮卡挑的
sense_groups.english: Aren't these the same flowers? - I don't know. Monica picked them.

sense_groups.chinese: 椅子呢 - 也是她
sense_groups.english: The chairs? - Those too.

sense_groups.chinese: 布置呢 - 她挑的
sense_groups.english: The place settings? - Her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你做了什么 - 我负责看好照相机
sense_groups.english: What did you do? - I was in charge of the cameras.

sense_groups.chinese: 礼品店 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Gift shop? - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说了吗 - 还没有
sense_groups.english: Did you do it yet? - Not yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你在这里做什么 你真的要说吗
sense_groups.english: Then what are you doing here? Are you about to do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 是阿甘吗 - 不是…
sense_groups.english: Is it Gunther? - No...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是阿甘 - 谢天谢地 还好宝宝不会有他的头发
sense_groups.english: It's not Gunther! - Thank God. That hair on a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子的爸不在这里 好吗
sense_groups.english: The father is not here, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有告诉他 我想现在我没办法告诉他
sense_groups.english: I haven't told him, and I don't think I can now.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 让我想想
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Now let me think.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在街上边走边想
sense_groups.english: I was walking down the street, thinking,

sense_groups.chinese: "我要告诉孩子的爸" 然后 砰
sense_groups.english: "I'm gonna tell the father today." And then, bam!

sense_groups.chinese: 你撞到了巴士
sense_groups.english: Bus?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是你 你吓了我一跳 你一直在提醒我这件事有多大
sense_groups.english: No, you! You freaked me out. You kept saying how huge this all is.

sense_groups.chinese: 但它的确是件大事 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: But it is huge. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在想它对我来说有多重要
sense_groups.english: But I was just thinking about how huge it was for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不知道这对孩子的爸来说有多重要
sense_groups.english: I didn't go to how huge this is gonna be for the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想太多了
sense_groups.english: You're thinking about this way too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他把事情做个了断
sense_groups.english: Just tell him and get it over with.

sense_groups.chinese: 它就像撕掉OK绷一样 越快越不痛 你看
sense_groups.english: It's like ripping off this Band-Aid, quick and painless. Watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天杀的…
sense_groups.english: Oh, mother of...!

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧
sense_groups.english: See?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我们要拆礼物了吗 - 不 我根本不该拆开礼物的
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Are we opening presents? - No. I shouldn't have even opened these.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我控制不了自己
sense_groups.english: Joey, I am out of control!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得帮我一个忙
sense_groups.english: You have to do me a favor.

sense_groups.chinese: 不论我说什么 不论我做什么
sense_groups.english: No matter what I say, no matter what I do,

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 不要让我再拆开任何礼物
sense_groups.english: please do not let me open another present.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再给我一个礼物 - 好
sense_groups.english: Give me one more. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 很好 你来了 菲比 听我说…
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Oh, good. You're here. Pheebs? Listen...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下 我要告诉你一件事 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Sit down, I got something I want to say. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 外面的世界很可怕 特别是对单亲妈妈来说
sense_groups.english: It's a scary world out there, especially for a single mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直觉得我跟你之间很特别
sense_groups.english: Now, I always felt that you and I have a special bond.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比·布非 你愿意嫁给我吗
sense_groups.english: So, Phoebe Buffay, will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 我愿意嫁给你
sense_groups.english: Joey! - Oh, yeah, I'll marry you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能嫁给他 - 小姐 你结过婚了 这次轮到我
sense_groups.english: You can't marry him! - Hey, lady, your day's over, it's my turn.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 她为什么不能嫁给我
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! - What? Why can't she marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以 我也愿意
sense_groups.english: I can and I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有怀孕 是瑞秋怀孕了 好吗
sense_groups.english: She's not pregnant. It's Rachel. Rachel's the one who's pregnant, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 九个月后你生不出孩子 他会发现的
sense_groups.english: He'd notice when you didn't have a baby in nine months!

sense_groups.chinese: 他是乔伊
sense_groups.english: It's Joey!

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我不敢相信 瑞秋怀孕了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it! Rachel's pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 孩子的爸是谁
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Who's the father?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不知道
sense_groups.english: We don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道是不是那个家伙 - 有个家伙
sense_groups.english: I wonder if it's that dude. - There's a dude?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 是谁呢
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Who is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个月前这家伙跟瑞秋共度春宵 我没有看到他 但是…
sense_groups.english: A month ago this guy spent the night. I didn't see who it was, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 他把故事说完了吗
sense_groups.english: Was that story over?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个家伙留下这个
sense_groups.english: The guy left this.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我知道孩子的爸是谁
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! I know who the father is.

sense_groups.chinese: 说故事的人得把故事说完
sense_groups.english: People have got to finish their stories.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你能帮我们拍照吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Could you take a picture of us? - Oh. Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我们照一张吗 - 好 没问题
sense_groups.english: Would you take one of us? - Uh. Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 喀
sense_groups.english: Click.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有听到快门声 - 我听到了
sense_groups.english: It didn't click. - I heard it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但闪光灯没亮 - 你为什么不帮我们拍照
sense_groups.english: But there was no flash. - Why won't you take our picture?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我会帮你们拍照
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'll take your picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的手指挡到镜头了 - 你是安瑟·亚当斯吗 快滚吧
sense_groups.english: Your finger was covering the lens. - Who are you, Ansel Adams? Get out of here!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我真的很难过 之前我吓坏你了…
sense_groups.english: Look, I feel really bad about how I freaked you out before...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我请孩子的爸到里面等你 你可以告诉他事实
sense_groups.english: ...so I called the father and asked him to meet you here. Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 等一下 你怎么知道孩子的爸是谁
sense_groups.english: What? Wait a minute. How do you even know who the father is?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许有时候我会装傻…
sense_groups.english: I may play the fool at times...

sense_groups.chinese: 但事实上我是个永不放弃的金发美女
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm more than a pretty blond with an ass that won't quit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信这是孩子爸的衣服…
sense_groups.english: I believe this belongs to the father of your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 他就在里面 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Oh. He's in there right now? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以转身离开或是长痛不如短痛
sense_groups.english: You can turn around, or you can go in there and rip the Band-Aid off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你打算怎么做
sense_groups.english: What do you wanna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把事情做个了断吧 - 你确定
sense_groups.english: Let's rip. - Really? Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 好吧 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! - Okay. Sorry. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不到台上呢 我要拍张你说话时的照片
sense_groups.english: Go on-stage. I'll get a picture of you doing the speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 1995年别克·李萨布利的车主请跟柜台联络
sense_groups.english: Will the owner of a 1995 Buick LeSabre please see the front desk?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的车就要被拖走了
sense_groups.english: Your car is about to be towed.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的车
sense_groups.english: That's my car!

sense_groups.chinese: 1995年的李萨布利 - 对
sense_groups.english: A '95 LeSabre? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 绿色的李萨布利 - 对
sense_groups.english: A green LeSabre? - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我是说蓝色的李萨布利 - 对 我的车是蓝绿色的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I meant blue. - Yes, green-blue.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就快去把它移开吧
sense_groups.english: Well, go. Go move it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 准备要拍最后一张照片了吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ready for the last picture? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 拍完 马上就跑
sense_groups.english: Get ready to run.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜
sense_groups.english: Congratulations on your wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么一回事
sense_groups.english: So, what's this about?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋有事要告诉你
sense_groups.english: Rachel has something that she wants to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信这是你的红毛衣
sense_groups.english: And I believe that this is your red sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这才是我的红毛衣
sense_groups.english: No, this is my red sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 糟糕
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人要喝咖啡吗
sense_groups.english: Could I get anyone a coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是毒药 没有吗 只有我要 好吧
sense_groups.english: Or poison? No? Just for me? Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 菲比弄错了
sense_groups.english: Nothing. Phoebe kind of made a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你的确常穿那件毛衣 你在做什么冒险的事吗
sense_groups.english: But you do wear that sweater a lot. Are you involved in some kind of dare?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我很高兴能接到菲比的电话
sense_groups.english: I'm actually glad Phoebe called.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我们会分手是因为你觉得我太幼雅
sense_groups.english: I know we broke up because you thought I wasn't mature enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我已经长大了 我想我们应该复合
sense_groups.english: ...but I've really grown up. And I think we should get back together.

sense_groups.chinese: 时机很不对
sense_groups.english: It's just not the right time.

sense_groups.chinese: 时机非常恰当 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: It is the right time. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做了万全的准备 - 泰格
sense_groups.english: I'm ready for more. - Tag.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 瑞秋 我们可以再试一次
sense_groups.english: Come on, Rach. Let's give it another try.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怀孕了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: I'm having a baby. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以走了 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You can go. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道礼物怎么会是打开的
sense_groups.english: I don't know how any of these got opened!

sense_groups.chinese: 你拆开了所有的礼物 - 我知道 我是个可怕的人
sense_groups.english: You opened them all? - I know, I am a terrible person.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德永远都不会再信任我任何事了
sense_groups.english: Chandler's never gonna trust me with anything ever again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拆开了我爸妈的礼物 - 对 那是什么
sense_groups.english: Hey! You got my parents' gift. - Yeah. What is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是跟意大利腊肠有关的东西
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I think it does something to salami.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 情况如何 - 泰格怎么说
sense_groups.english: Hey. How'd it go? - Yeah. What did Tag say?

sense_groups.chinese: 泰格不是孩子的爸 乔伊知道了
sense_groups.english: Tag is not the father. And Joey knows now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 瑞秋 我为你感到高兴
sense_groups.english: I do, Rach. I do. And I'm so happy for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊
sense_groups.english: Aww.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直觉得我跟你之间很特别
sense_groups.english: I've always felt like you and I have this special bond.

sense_groups.english: Rachel Green, will you marry me? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 什么
sense_groups.english: What? - What?!

sense_groups.english: Pheebs, give me the ring back. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你真的很体贴
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're so sweet. You are so, so sweet, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不要一个丈夫
sense_groups.english: But I'm not looking for a husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解
sense_groups.english: I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我想去躺一下
sense_groups.english: Now if you'll excuse me, I'm going to go and lie down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说我不心痛
sense_groups.english: I can't say that didn't hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我会原谅你 乔伊·崔比亚尼 - 听着 我只是说
sense_groups.english: But I'll take you back, Joey Tribbiani. - Year,please lisen about that, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 意大利腊肠用具 - 来吧
sense_groups.english: Ohh, a Salami Buddy! - There you go!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回来了 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: We're back! - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们待在厨房吧 待在厨房就好了
sense_groups.english: We're hanging in the kitchen. Let's stay in the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是看照片时间 - 你一定会喜欢的
sense_groups.english: It's picture time. - You're gonna love these.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是罗斯的照片
sense_groups.english: Here's a picture of Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我
sense_groups.english: And that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟罗斯
sense_groups.english: And that's me and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们第一次以新婚夫妻身份接吻的照片
sense_groups.english: Aww. And here's our first kiss as a married couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 那张照片真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Wow. That is a great picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 真的太有趣了 因为我在我们的行李里找到即可拍
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And interesting, because I found the cameras in one of our bags.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没想到会这样
sense_groups.english: Huh. Didn't see that coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这不是我们第一次接吻的照片…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so this isn't the picture of our first kiss...

sense_groups.chinese: 但它的确是我跟这位女士第一次接吻的照片
sense_groups.english: ...but it is a picture of my first kiss with this lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 从你脸上的表情看来 我相信你会记得 所以我不必…
sense_groups.english: Which, by the look on your face, I'm sure you'll remember, so there's no need...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会拿真的底片去洗
sense_groups.english: I'll take the real pictures to them developed.

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 - 好
sense_groups.english: That'd be a good idea. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不管我自己拆开所有礼物 我们说好要一起拆的
sense_groups.english: You opened all the presents without me? We were gonna do that together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你吻了另一个女人
sense_groups.english: You kissed another woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们扯平了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Call it even? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把花插到花瓶里 - 你偷走了那个婚礼的花
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm gonna go get these in some water. - You stole those from that wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这是饭店大厅的花 他们以为能收我黄色电影…
sense_groups.english: No, the hotel lobby. They think they can charge me for some dirty movie

sense_groups.chinese: 还有一袋糖果的钱 我一定要讨回公道
sense_groups.english: and a bag of Meshugga Nuts they got another thing coming!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我的毛衣
sense_groups.english: Hey, my sweater!

sense_groups.chinese: 我找这件毛衣找了一个月
sense_groups.english: I've been looking for this for like a month.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗 - 我很好 好久不见
sense_groups.english: Hey, how you doing? - Good. Long time no see.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你的毛衣 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: Like your sweater. - Oh. Hey. Right back at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋的事真的太疯狂了 - 她一直都疯疯癫癫的
sense_groups.english: It's crazy about Rachel. - Yeah. Well, she's one crazy lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底是谁的呢 - 我不知道 应该是某个意大利人吧
sense_groups.english: So whose is it? - Um, I don't know, some Italian guy.
