Oh, hi! - Hi.
Wow, uh...
How are you? - I'm good, except, um...
...you still owe me a dance.
Oh, that's right. - Mm.
Well, uh, would you be interested in seeing a Ukrainian film?
Oh, you're serious. Sure.
Great. Well, uh...
I think I might need one more cup of coffee.
Sure, uh, let me get it for you. - Okay.
Bob? Bob!
Bob!
What the hell are you doing? - I just found out this is Chandler's office.
Come on, Toby. Give me a hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是三分熟 这是五分熟 快去吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, this one's rare. This one is medium well. Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 晚餐好吃吗 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Phoebe! How was dinner? - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 晚餐很好吃 我只是来打招呼 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Dinner was good! Just saying hi! Now I'm gonna go!

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: All right, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, hello there. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在菜单上没有看到这个
sense_groups.english: I didn't see this on the menu.

sense_groups.chinese: 提姆 她是菲比 菲比 他是我的新二厨提姆
sense_groups.english: Tim,this is Phoebe, Phoebe, this is Tim, my new sous chef.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是摩妮卡的老板 - 不 她是我的老板
sense_groups.english: Oh. So you're Monica's boss? - Actually, she's my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: "二"在法文里是"之下"的意思 - 我"了解"了
sense_groups.english: "Sous" is French for "under." - Ah! I "sous-stand." Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 提姆 我要一份乌贼跟一份凯撒沙拉 你可以给我青酱吗
sense_groups.english: Tim, I need a calamari and a caesar salad. And could you get me the pesto?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 青酱是你做的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - You made pesto?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得你的青酱是最棒的
sense_groups.english: Would you say your pesto is the best-o? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我会说它真的很棒
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I would say it's pretty good-o.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是需要乌贼跟沙拉
sense_groups.english: I still need the calamari and the salad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你的项链 - 那是我自己做的
sense_groups.english: I like your necklace. - Oh, I made it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的好有天分 - 那不是青酱
sense_groups.english: You are so talented. - Well, it's no pesto.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就别玩游戏了 你是单身 你也单身
sense_groups.english: All right, let's just cut to the chase. Okay? You're single, you're single.

sense_groups.chinese: 他11点下班 她会等你的电话
sense_groups.english: He gets off work at 11. She'll be waiting for your call.

sense_groups.chinese: 快给我乌贼跟凯撒沙拉 我就会给他你的电话号码
sense_groups.english: I'll give him your number if I could just get calamari and caesar salad!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有大叫 我不必被罚一块钱
sense_groups.english: I did not yell. I am not putting a dollar in the jar.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 宾 你还在熬夜加班 - 你很了解我的 老板
sense_groups.english: Wow, Bing! Burning the midnight oil. - You know me, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道要怎么避过办公室的电脑网络…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I have a question. Do you know how can I get around the computer network...

sense_groups.chinese: 进去网际网络看超级精彩的黄色电影吗
sense_groups.english: ...so I can access the really good Internet porn?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真爱开玩笑 宾
sense_groups.english: You're a joker, Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有什么好笑的
sense_groups.english: What's funny about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉让你等这么久 - 没关系 你想去哪里
sense_groups.english: Sorry I kept you waiting so long. - That's okay. Where do you wanna go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你知道我要去哪里
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, I think you know where I wanna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 硬石餐厅 - 对
sense_groups.english: The Hard Rock Cafe? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 又要去 - 对
sense_groups.english: Again? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢那里的食物 - 你喜欢那里的紫雨展示品
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, I like the food. - You like the Purple Rain display.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 巴伯 - 嗨 托比 祝你今晚玩得开心
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bob. - Hey, Toby. Have a good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙叫你托比 - 对 他以为那是我的名字
sense_groups.english: Did that guy just call you Toby? - Yeah, he thinks that's my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不更正他 - 那是很久以前的事了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you correct him? - Oh, it's been way too long now.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次我们错身而过 所以我什么都没说
sense_groups.english: The first time, we were passing each other so I didn't say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 第二次他说 "托比 你要吃甜甜圈吗 "
sense_groups.english: The next time he said, "Hey, Toby, want a doughnut?"

sense_groups.chinese: 我想吃甜甜圈
sense_groups.english: And I wanted the doughnut.

sense_groups.chinese: 五年后甜甜圈早就消化光了 我还是托比
sense_groups.english: Five years later, the doughnut's gone and I'm still Toby.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你得告诉他 - 那一定会很可怕
sense_groups.english: Five years? Chandler, you have to tell him. - No, that would be so awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不在同一个楼层工作 他在六楼
sense_groups.english: Besides, we work in different departments. He's on the sixth floor.

sense_groups.chinese: 他每隔一阵子会叫我托比
sense_groups.english: So he calls me Toby once in a while. Big deal. Could be worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正他不是叫我马利欧
sense_groups.english: It's not like he's calling me Muriel.

sense_groups.chinese: 马利欧 他为什么要叫你马利欧
sense_groups.english: Muriel. Why would he call you Muriel?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾 字马利欧
sense_groups.english: Chandler M. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上不是马 你的字是马利欧
sense_groups.english: It's not just an M. Your middle name is Muriel!

sense_groups.chinese: 那是家族名字
sense_groups.english: Shh! It is a family name.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾 字马利欧
sense_groups.english: Chandler Muriel Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你父母真的不给你任何机会 对吧
sense_groups.english: Your parents never even gave you a chance, did they?

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克 我找出你丧失记忆的原因了
sense_groups.english: Drake, I've discovered the reason for your headaches and memory loss.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么
sense_groups.english: What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脑部移植手术失败
sense_groups.english: Apparently, your brain transplant was not entirely successful.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的身体排斥杰西卡的脑部
sense_groups.english: It seems your body is rejecting Jessica's brain.

sense_groups.chinese: 很严重吗
sense_groups.english: Is it serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们可以从捐赠者的身体抽取组织…
sense_groups.english: Not if we extract tissue from the original body...

sense_groups.chinese: 合成抗生素
sense_groups.english: ...synthesize antibodies, introduce them into your system...

sense_groups.chinese: 阻止你排斥移植来的脑部
sense_groups.english: ...which could stop you from rejecting the brain.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很简单 我们就那么做吧
sense_groups.english: That sounds simple enough. Let's just do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以那么做 但我们想挖出杰西卡的尸体时…
sense_groups.english: We would, but when we went to exhume Jessica's body...

sense_groups.chinese: 发现它不见了
sense_groups.english: ...it was gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 非常不错 大伙们
sense_groups.english: Cut. Very nice, people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我换了衣服后我们就能离开 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Let me change and we can go to dinner. - Wh...? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰西卡的尸体怎么了 - 你得看电视才会知道
sense_groups.english: What happened to Jessica's body? - I'm not telling. You'll have to see it on TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道 对吧 - 我也不在乎
sense_groups.english: You don't know, do you? - No. Couldn't care less.

sense_groups.chinese: 你表现的很好 - 你也是
sense_groups.english: Hey, good scene, man. All right. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你根本不是演员
sense_groups.english: What? You weren't in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 凯许 她是我朋友瑞秋 瑞秋 凯许
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry. Uh, Kash, this is my friend Rachel. Rachel, Kash.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 为什么之前我没有见过你
sense_groups.english: Hi. - How come I haven't seen you here before?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊觉得我会丢他的脸
sense_groups.english: Well, heh. Joey probably just thinks I'll embarrass him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他认为我是肥皂剧迷
sense_groups.english: He thinks I'm some kind of soap opera nut. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不是 真的
sense_groups.english: Which I'm not. I'm not. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我真的知道你最喜欢胡桃奶油口味的冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: Although, I do know your favorite ice cream flavor is butter pecan.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的狗叫做华利
sense_groups.english: And, uh... And your dog's name is Wally.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我在摸你的手 - 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Look at that, I'm just stroking your arm. - Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 凯许 帮我跟华利问好
sense_groups.english: We're leaving. Bye, Kash. Say hi to Wally.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, Monica. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我跟提姆玩得很开心 他真的很体贴
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I had the best time with Tim last night. He is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及钻到他的身体下面去
sense_groups.english: Ugh! I can't wait to get "sous-neath" him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得开除他 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Uh, I... I have to fire him. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的很可怕 他的动作超慢 还会把食物烧焦
sense_groups.english: Because He's terrible. He's slow. He burns things.

sense_groups.chinese: 他放火烧我的甜点主厨
sense_groups.english: Last night he lit my pastry chef on fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 他太紧张了 你老是凶巴巴的
sense_groups.english: He was nervous. You can be very intimidating.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的甜点主厨毛发应该可以少一点
sense_groups.english: And I've met your pastry chef. She can stand to be taken down a peg.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在她没有眉毛 任务完成
sense_groups.english: Well, now she has no eyebrows. Mission accomplished.

sense_groups.chinese: 但摩妮卡 他热爱他的工作
sense_groups.english: But Monica, he loves his job so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能再给他一次机会吗 拜托
sense_groups.english: Can't you just give him another chance, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但如果他再放火烧别人 他非走不可
sense_groups.english: All right. But if he lights someone else on fire, he is out of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很公平 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: That's fair. Thank you so much. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来他也烧到你了
sense_groups.english: Oops, looks like when he got the pastry chef, he got you a little bit too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我付钱把头发弄成这样
sense_groups.english: I paid to have this done.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: Love it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 凯许真的喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know, uh, Kash really liked you the other day.

sense_groups.chinese: 他觉得你很迷人
sense_groups.english: He said he thought you were charming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我是个白痴 - 我赞成
sense_groups.english: I thought I was an idiot. - I'm with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他问你愿不愿意跟他约会 - 噢
sense_groups.english: He asked if you'd go out with him. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我得去吐一下
sense_groups.english: Oh, I think I'm gonna throw up a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么说 - "不"
sense_groups.english: What did you say? - I said, "No." Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想因为你怀孕了 你不能跟别人约会
sense_groups.english: I figured since you're pregnant, you're not gonna be seeing people.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Okay, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 他是凯许·福特 不是一般人
sense_groups.english: First of all, Kash Ford? Not people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他我怀孕了吗
sense_groups.english: Second, what did he say when you told him I was pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不知道你要不要告诉别人
sense_groups.english: I didn't. I didn't know if you were telling people.

sense_groups.chinese: 这时候的凯许是"一般人"
sense_groups.english: This was back when I thought Kash was still "people."

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 请他打电话给我 - 我不觉得…
sense_groups.english: Good. Don't. Just have him call me. - I really don't think that's such...

sense_groups.chinese: 照我的话做 不然我会回到摄影棚
sense_groups.english: Okay, you go do it. I'll come back to that set.

sense_groups.chinese: 泡其他的男演员 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I'll meet more actors. I'll meet them all. - Yup.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 巴伯 - 我朋友托比今天还好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bob. - Hey! How's my pal Toby doing today?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到他时会帮你问一下
sense_groups.english: If I see him, I'll ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚在跟六楼的巴伯说话
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bing. Was that Bob from six you were just talking to?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 你认识他
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - You know each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会互叫彼此的名字
sense_groups.english: We're on a semi-first-name basis.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他加入我们的团队呢
sense_groups.english: What do you think of adding him to our team?

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯吗
sense_groups.english: Bob? Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 每天跟我们在这里一起工作
sense_groups.english: Working here with us? Every day?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道他有没有那个能耐
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't know if he has what it takes.

sense_groups.chinese: 六楼的人很喜欢他 - 但这里是11楼
sense_groups.english: Really? They love him down on six. - But this is 11.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里的工作要难上两倍
sense_groups.english: It's almost twice as hard up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听清楚了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I hear you loud and clear.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯还是不能调职 - 我想那么做是最好的
sense_groups.english: Bob will stay put. - I think it's best, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的很缺人 工作开始越积越多了
sense_groups.english: We really do need to find somebody. Work is starting to pile up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一叠文件已经叠到这么高了
sense_groups.english: I've got a stack of documents on my desk this high.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它们丢到碎纸机里
sense_groups.english: What you should do, toss them in the shredder...

sense_groups.chinese: 就说你从来没有收到它们
sense_groups.english: ...and claim you never got them.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很好笑 宾
sense_groups.english: That's a good one, Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么做 他们才会觉得我是认真的
sense_groups.english: What does a guy have to do to be taken seriously around here?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 我再给他一次机会
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Okay, I gave him another chance...

sense_groups.chinese: 但提姆非走不可 - 但
sense_groups.english: ...but Tim has got to go. - But...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他完全不称职
sense_groups.english: No! No, no. He's totally incompetent.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打电话给推荐他给我的厨师
sense_groups.english: I called the chef who recommended him to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说"哈哈 整到你了"
sense_groups.english: He said, "Ha, ha! Gotcha!"

sense_groups.chinese: 但别在今天开除他 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Okay, but you can't fire him today. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为今天我要甩掉他 - 你说他很体贴
sense_groups.english: Because I'm dumping him today. - What? You said he was sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他太体贴了 他老是打电话给我
sense_groups.english: He is sweet. He's too sweet. He calls me all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: "你平安回家了吗 你的洗澡水够热吗 "
sense_groups.english: "Did you get home from work okay? Did you get out of the shower okay?"

sense_groups.chinese: 别接电话 - 他会亲自过来
sense_groups.english: Just don't pick up your phone. - Then he comes over!

sense_groups.chinese: "我好担心你" 有点男子气概吧
sense_groups.english: "I was worried about you." Ugh, be a man!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我不能开除他
sense_groups.english: So now I'm not allowed to fire him?

sense_groups.chinese: 让他在同一天被甩 他会自杀的
sense_groups.english: You can't fire him and dump him in the same day. He'll kill himself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开除他 你再跟他交往一星期
sense_groups.english: I fire him today, you go out with him another week.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗 再跟他交往一个星期 我会自杀的
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? Another week with that simp, I'll kill myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都在今天跟他摊牌 他得自己想办法应付
sense_groups.english: Then we'll both do it today and he'll just have to deal with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但谁要先说呢
sense_groups.english: Okay. But the question is, who's gonna go first?

sense_groups.chinese: 第二个说的人就是臭女人
sense_groups.english: Whoever goes second is the bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 开除一个刚刚被甩的男人
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? - The boss that fires a guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 臭女人
sense_groups.english: ...that's just been dumped? Bitch!

sense_groups.chinese: 甩掉一个刚刚被开除的男人
sense_groups.english: And the woman who dumps a guy that's just been fired?

sense_groups.chinese: 金发臭女人
sense_groups.english: Blond bitch!

sense_groups.chinese: 我几天前就想这么做 所以我想应该让我先说
sense_groups.english: I wanted to do this days ago, so I think I should go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说的有理
sense_groups.english: Ugh. All right, that makes sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 但…
sense_groups.english: Agh, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 去你的 我要先说
sense_groups.english: ...screw you! I'm going first!

sense_groups.chinese: 托比 - 当然 你有空吗 什么事
sense_groups.english: Hey, Toby, you got a sec? - Sure, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想被调职到这里来
sense_groups.english: I just had a meeting. I was hoping to get transferred up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我的美梦破灭
sense_groups.english: But I found out it's not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地有人认为我不是"11楼的材料"
sense_groups.english: Apparently somebody thinks I'm not "11 th-floor material."

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德到底是谁
sense_groups.english: Say, uh, who the hell is this Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚约会时 哪个借口最适合我用来挡酒
sense_groups.english: What do you think is the better excuse for why I'm not drinking on this date?

sense_groups.chinese: "我正在戒酒" "我是摩门教徒"…
sense_groups.english: Um, "I'm a recovering alcoholic," "I'm a Mormon"...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是"我昨晚喝太醉 现在还在宿醉"
sense_groups.english: ...or "I got so hammered last night I'm still a little drunk"?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚你要做什么
sense_groups.english: So, what do you want to do tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 有出很棒的乌克兰电影
sense_groups.english: There's a Ukrainian film at the Angelika that's supposed to be very powerful.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想看吗 - 不
sense_groups.english: Interested? - No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我可以陪你看一般人看的电影
sense_groups.english: But I'll go see a normal-person movie with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 不行 你要一起来吗 我有约会
sense_groups.english: Rach, you wanna come? - Oh, no, I can't. I got a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会 - 对 怎么了 很奇怪吗
sense_groups.english: Heh. A date? - Yeah. Why, is that weird for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 一点都不奇怪 那很正常
sense_groups.english: Why, no. It's the opposite of weird. It's, uh... It's regular. It's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 那太普通了 事实上还有点无聊
sense_groups.english: It's mundane. It's actually a little dull.

sense_groups.chinese: 它不是乌克兰电影
sense_groups.english: It's no Ukrainian film, I'll tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 耳环
sense_groups.english: Ooh! Earrings!

sense_groups.chinese: 她有约会 对方是谁 - 我撮合她跟一个男演员
sense_groups.english: A date? She's got a date? With who? - I set her up with this actor on my show.

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮她牵红线 - 不
sense_groups.english: You set her up? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在想什么 - 那应该没关系…
sense_groups.english: Joey, what were you thinking? - That it would probably be okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你们两个已经分手五年了
sense_groups.english: ...because Ross hasn't gone out with Rachel in five years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我担心我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm not worried about her. I'm worried about my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟她约会的人也在跟我的宝宝约会
sense_groups.english: Whoever she dates, my baby dates.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个"男演员"要带她们去哪里 - 嘿 我也是男演员
sense_groups.english: Where is this "actor" taking them? - Hey! I'm an "actor" too.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要搭渡轮
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure. I think they're taking the ferry

sense_groups.chinese: 到史坦顿岛玩
sense_groups.english: to some Italian place on Staten Island.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的宝宝要搭渡轮
sense_groups.english: A ferry? My baby's going on a ferry?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道那有多危险吗
sense_groups.english: Do you have any idea how dangerous those are?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是在谈那些速度缓慢的大船吧
sense_groups.english: Aren't we talking about those big boats that go, like, five miles an hour?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们为什么不去跳飞机
sense_groups.english: Why don't they just jump out of an airplane? That's a fun date.

sense_groups.chinese: 或点火柴把彼此烧了
sense_groups.english: Or burn each other with matches? That's fun too.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 - 凯许
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey. - Hey, Kash.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 他就是凯许 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Uh, hey, Ross, this is Kash. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说 今晚你们要去搭渡轮 - 对
sense_groups.english: Hey, I hear you're going on a ferry tonight. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有点大胆吧
sense_groups.english: Bit of a daredevil, are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 这件洋装是不是太露了 嗨 凯许
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, do you think this is too slutty? Hi, Kash.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你准备好了吗 - 是的 待会见
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rachel. You ready to go? - Yeah. See you guys later.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你们玩的愉快 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay. Have a great time, you guys. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那件洋装的确太露了
sense_groups.english: And yes, it is too slutty!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你打电话给我 我也觉得自己太黏你了
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you called. I feel like it's always me calling you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事 菲比没事吧
sense_groups.english: So, what's up? Is everything okay with Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 我待会就会没事
sense_groups.english: It will be in a minute. Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 提姆 你真的很棒 - 那是因为我跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: Tim, you're a really great guy. - That's because I'm with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我的人生 现在走到了…
sense_groups.english: I'm just... I'm in a place in my life right now where I...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 "刚刚有消息传过来"
sense_groups.english: Whoops! So sorry. "This just in." Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 是餐厅在呼叫我 摩妮卡要我马上赶过去
sense_groups.english: It's 911 from the restaurant. That means Monica needs me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是的 我知道发生了什么事 你可以留下来
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, she doesn't! I know what that is. You can stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Aw...

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会想你的 菲比
sense_groups.english: I'll miss you too, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会把你放在这里
sense_groups.english: And I will be holding you right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想看哪部电影 我不想看那种得认真看字幕的电影
sense_groups.english: So, what movie do you wanna see? And not another one I have to read.

sense_groups.chinese: 我受够看书了
sense_groups.english: I get enough of that from books.

sense_groups.chinese: 书 - 好吧 汽车杂志 玉米片包装…
sense_groups.english: Books? - All right, car magazines, cereal boxes...

sense_groups.chinese: 但那就够我受的了
sense_groups.english: ...but it's, like, enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们别去看电影
sense_groups.english: I tell you what, why don't we...?

sense_groups.chinese: 就待在家里闲晃吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't we stay. Let's not see a movie. We'll just hang.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要等瑞秋回来
sense_groups.english: Just wait for Rachel to come back from her date?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要那么做的话 我会说不
sense_groups.english: Hey, if that's what you wanna do, I'm not gonna say no.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Dude, what is going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得知道他们之间怎么了 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: I just... I have to find out how it went. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能是我孩子的继父
sense_groups.english: This guy could be my baby's stepfather.

sense_groups.chinese: 才约会一次他们就要结婚了
sense_groups.english: They go on one date and you're worried about them getting married?

sense_groups.chinese: 他不是你
sense_groups.english: He's not you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信她去约会了
sense_groups.english: I just, I can't believe she's dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得她该怎么做呢 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What did you think she was gonna do? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会相信会发生这种事
sense_groups.english: I guess I can't believe any of this is happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是什么意思
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我再生个孩子情况会不一样
sense_groups.english: I always thought when I had another kid, it'd be different.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱班 但每次送他到卡萝跟苏珊家…
sense_groups.english: I love Ben. But every time I drop him off at Carol and Susan's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我都会觉得很伤心
sense_groups.english: ...it breaks my heart a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想像着我跟未来的太太躺在床上…
sense_groups.english: I've always had this picture of me and my next wife in bed on Sunday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的孩子跑过来跳到床上 我们会一起看报纸
sense_groups.english: My kid comes running in, leaps up on the bed and we all read the paper together.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许还会抢着看科学版
sense_groups.english: You know? Maybe fight over the science section.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很棒 你还可以拥有那样的梦想
sense_groups.english: That's a nice picture. Maybe you can still have that.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 瑞秋跟别的男人约会
sense_groups.english: No, I can't. Rachel's out with some guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的孩子跟她一起去了
sense_groups.english: My baby went with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果出了任何事 那个梦想会离我越来越远
sense_groups.english: If anything, that picture keeps moving further away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你一件事吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, can I ask you something?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想像你未来的太太时 她是瑞秋吗
sense_groups.english: In this picture of you and your wife, is your wife Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 以前是的
sense_groups.english: It used to be.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我梦里的人没有脸
sense_groups.english: Now she doesn't really have a face.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她有很辣的身材
sense_groups.english: Smoking body, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 说的好 但是 罗斯 她已经不是瑞秋了
sense_groups.english: Good call. But the face, Ross, the face isn't Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但如果是的话 事情会变得很简单吧
sense_groups.english: No. But, ugh, how much easier would it be if it were?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是她要的
sense_groups.english: I know, but I don't think that's what she wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: It's not what I want either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能逼自己爱上她
sense_groups.english: And I can't force myself to fall in love with her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 或许你需要新梦想
sense_groups.english: Ross, maybe you need a new picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会跟你之前的梦想不一样 但不论如何…
sense_groups.english: Okay? It's not gonna be what you thought. But no matter what...

sense_groups.chinese: 都会有个新宝宝 你的孩子
sense_groups.english: ...there's gonna be a brand-new little baby. Your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁在乎梦想是什么样的呢
sense_groups.english: Who cares what the picture looks like?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起出去好好地玩一玩吧
sense_groups.english: Hey, tell you what. Let's you and me go out and have some fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想做什么都行 来吧
sense_groups.english: Huh? Whatever you want. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还赶得上看乌克兰电影 - 不 我说好玩的事
sense_groups.english: We can catch that Ukrainian film. - No, I said fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 托比 - 嘿 巴比
sense_groups.english: Hey, Toby? - Hey, Bobby.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上是巴伯
sense_groups.english: It's Bob, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里工作 钱德宾的办公室在哪里
sense_groups.english: You work up here. Can you tell me where Chandler Bing's office is?

sense_groups.chinese: 它就在…
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, it's right...

sense_groups.chinese: 就在那里 你问这个做什么
sense_groups.english: Right there. Let me ask you, why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟那个混蛋谈 看他有什么问题
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, I wanna talk to that bastard, see what his problem is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 巴伯 听我说
sense_groups.english: Okay, Bob, listen. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我害你无法调职
sense_groups.english: I'm the reason you didn't get the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 托比 不要 - 巴伯
sense_groups.english: Toby, don't. - Bob.

sense_groups.chinese: 托比 我不会让你帮他说话
sense_groups.english: Toby, I'm not gonna let you cover for him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说任何话只会让我更气钱德
sense_groups.english: Anything you say will just get me more upset with Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的让我很两难
sense_groups.english: Well that puts me in a difficult position.

sense_groups.chinese: 我收到呼叫了 没事吧 - 那得视情况而定
sense_groups.english: I got your page. Is everything okay? - Uh, well, that depends.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟菲比还好吧 - 很好 谢谢你介绍我们认识
sense_groups.english: How are things with Phoebe? - It's great. Thank you for introducing us.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的荣幸 好吧 我得跟你宣布一个坏消息
sense_groups.english: Oh, my pleasure. Okay, I'm afraid I've got some bad news.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! - Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 你被开除了 - 我要跟你分手
sense_groups.english: I'm breaking up with you! - You're fired!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我要跟你分手
sense_groups.english: What? - I'm breaking up with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你被开除了 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: You're fired. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我还没有准备好跟别人长期交往
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm not ready for a relationship right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很抱歉 但我喜欢凡事照我的方法来做
sense_groups.english: And I'm sorry too. But, well, I like things done a certain way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间的化学反应不对 - 我们也一样
sense_groups.english: And the chemistry's just not right. - Ooh, good. The chemistry thing for us too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Wow, heh. Um, okay. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我太黏了
sense_groups.english: I realize I came on a little strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我觉得你很棒
sense_groups.english: But it's only because I think you're so amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有…
sense_groups.english: And, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你 我很感激你给我机会
sense_groups.english: I just wanna tell you how much I appreciate you giving me an opportunity here...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我合作过最有天分的厨师
sense_groups.english: ...because you're the most talented chef I've ever worked for.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 提姆 等一下 - 什么事
sense_groups.english: Tim, wait. Wait. Um... - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我话说得太快了 这份工作需要时间学习
sense_groups.english: I think I spoke too quickly. There's a learning curve with this job.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们能再试一次 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Maybe we could try it again. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我可以表现的更好 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Because I know I can be better. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 提姆 我只想说祝你好运
sense_groups.english: And Tim, I just want to say good luck here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hello. Ha, ha. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你约会情况如何
sense_groups.english: Uh, how was the date?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一个人买了15块的糖果 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm alone and I just bought $15 worth of candy bars. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事 - 我…
sense_groups.english: Huh. What happened? - Made the mistake...

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉他我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: ...of telling him that I was pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不能接受 - 他的反应比你好
sense_groups.english: He didn't, uh, take it so well? - Well, better than you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那仍不是你要的 - 喔
sense_groups.english: But still not what you want. - Oh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他真的是吓坏了 然后他说
sense_groups.english: Yeah. He got all weird and sputtery. Then he said, uh

sense_groups.chinese: "我听说长痔疮真的很难过"
sense_groups.english: "I hear those hemorrhoids are a bitch."

sense_groups.chinese: 说的好 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: He sounds swell. - Doesn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要来点鼓励吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, you want a little cheering up?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 - 坐下
sense_groups.english: Yes. Okay. - Sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 你猜谁字叫马利欧
sense_groups.english: Guess whose middle name is Muriel?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德宾的字是马利欧 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Chandler M. Bing. - Yu-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很遗憾你的约会没有成功 - 没事的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about your date. - It's all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我受够了约会
sense_groups.english: I guess I'm just done with the whole dating thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是我生命中另一件完全改变的事
sense_groups.english: Just one more thing in my life that is suddenly completely different.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很难 - 我了解
sense_groups.english: This is hard. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但反过来说
sense_groups.english: On the other hand, in, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 再过七个月你将能拥有一个孩子…
sense_groups.english: In about seven months you're gonna have something...

sense_groups.chinese: 你对它的爱胜过于你对其他人的感觉
sense_groups.english: ...that you're gonna love more than any guy you've ever gone out with.

sense_groups.chinese: 等着吧
sense_groups.english: Just wait. Wait until, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 等到孩子第一次抓住你的手指
sense_groups.english: Wait until the first time your baby grabs your finger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会了解的
sense_groups.english: You have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 甜心
sense_groups.english: Thanks, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要喝杯咖啡吗 - 不 我要去吃掉10根棒棒糖
sense_groups.english: You wanna grab some coffee? - No. I'm gonna go eat 10 candy bars.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为我让你心情变好了 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I thought I cheered you up. - Oh, you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚买了20根 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: There are 20 in here. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是蒙娜 我们在婚礼上见过
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's Mona. From the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Wow, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗 - 我很好
sense_groups.english: How are you? - I'm good, except, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你欠我一支舞
sense_groups.english: ...you still owe me a dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's right. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想看乌克兰电影吗
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, would you be interested in seeing a Ukrainian film?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是认真的 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're serious. Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 喔…
sense_groups.english: Great. Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想再来一杯咖啡
sense_groups.english: I think I might need one more cup of coffee.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 我去帮你拿 - 好
sense_groups.english: Sure, uh, let me get it for you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯
sense_groups.english: Bob? Bob!

sense_groups.chinese: 巴伯
sense_groups.english: Bob!

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底在做什么 - 这是钱德的办公室
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you doing? - I just found out this is Chandler's office.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 托比 快来帮我
sense_groups.english: Come on, Toby. Give me a hand!

questions.name: S08E06
questions.en:
Hey, guys, guess what. - What?
I know it's last minute, but we've decided to have a Halloween party.
Oh, good! - Great!
And everybody has to wear costumes. - Oh, I don't know...
Come on, it'll be fun.
Uh, I'll be there. I have to wear a costume to my classes that day anyway.
Tell me you're not gonna dress like a dinosaur.
Not two years in a row.
I'll come, but I'm not dressing up. - You have to.
No. Halloween is stupid. Dressing up, pretending to be someone you're not.
You're an actor.
Ross, are you gonna bring Mona?

sense_groups.english: Um, nothing. I mean, I'm getting married next week.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 对
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼很简单 我们只邀请家人观礼
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be a small ceremony. Just family.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的家人
sense_groups.english: His.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为你感到高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm really happy for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 如果你也想来的话 我猜应该没关系
sense_groups.english: Wait. If, um... If you want to come, I guess that'd be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Really? - Sure, why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以当一天我的妹妹
sense_groups.english: You could be my "sister" for the day.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, heh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友今晚要办派对
sense_groups.english: Um, you know, my friends are having a Halloween party tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以来参加
sense_groups.english: ...at my old apartment, so you could come.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以看看他
sense_groups.english: Maybe I could meet the guy you're marrying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚要上班
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm supposed to be working tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在应该去上班 谁在乎呢
sense_groups.english: I'm supposed to be working now, so who cares!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 这是变装派对 - 噢 所以你才会…
sense_groups.english: By the way, it's a costume party. - Oh, okay, so that's why you're...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但谢谢了
sense_groups.english: But thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你应该变装的
sense_groups.english: Hi. - You're supposed to wear a costume.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有啊
sense_groups.english: I am. I am a woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 我扮成花钱买心爱洋装的女人…
sense_groups.english: ...who spent a lot of money on a dress and she wants to wear it...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为很快地她会穿不下它
sense_groups.english: ...because soon she won't be able to fit into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是猫女 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Oh. I'm Catwoman. - Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你穿不下它 可以把它送给我
sense_groups.english: Who wants the dress when you're too big for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不给糖就捣蛋 - 我可以分糖果给他们吗
sense_groups.english: Trick or treat! - Oh! Can I give out candy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟孩子们打成一片
sense_groups.english: I really want to be with kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怀孕后母性的直觉都跑出来了
sense_groups.english: Ever since I got pregnant, I have the strongest maternal instincts.

sense_groups.chinese: 不给糖就捣蛋 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Trick or treat! - Just a minute!

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们
sense_groups.english: We... Aah! Look at you guys!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你是个可怕的巫婆 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Wow! You are a very scary witch. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个好笑的小丑 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: And you are a very funny clown. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你…
sense_groups.english: And you...

sense_groups.chinese: 非常符合现在的流行趋势
sense_groups.english: ...are so in style right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在罗夫·罗兰的公司工作
sense_groups.english: You know, I work at Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 今年秋天流行马术主题
sense_groups.english: The whole fall line has got this equestrian theme going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看过时尚杂志的封面… - 我可以拿糖果吗
sense_groups.english: Did you see the cover of Vogue...? - Could I just have the candy?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以 没问题
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 猫女 我们又见面了
sense_groups.english: Ah, Catwoman. So we meet again.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 女超人
sense_groups.english: So we do, Supergirl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菲比
sense_groups.english: It's me, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我能跟你谈一谈吗
sense_groups.english: Monica, can I talk to you for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你帮我找衣服
sense_groups.english: Listen, I appreciate you getting the costume.

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮他找的
sense_groups.english: Oh, you did this to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得他一定会喜欢啊
sense_groups.english: What? I thought he'd love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他喜欢毛毛兔
sense_groups.english: His favorite book was The Velveteen Rabbit.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只兔子是棕白相间
sense_groups.english: The Velveteen Rabbit was brown and white.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们只剩下粉红色的兔子装
sense_groups.english: It was either a pink bunny, or no bunny at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有兔子装 他们总是说没有兔子装
sense_groups.english: No bunny at all. Always no bunny at all!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你也没有变装
sense_groups.english: Hey. - You didn't dress up either?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我有 我扮成钱德
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did. I'm Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Dude, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么会是那个样子 好
sense_groups.english: How is that me? - Okay, ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是钱德
sense_groups.english: I'm Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很像你
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha! That is so you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么时候会那样 - 我什么时候会那样
sense_groups.english: When have I ever done that? - When have I ever done that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不给糖就捣蛋 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Trick or treat. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是最漂亮的芭蕾舞娘
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're just the prettiest ballerina ever I've ever seen.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该再给你一颗糖果
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. That deserves another candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说我该再给你一些糖果
sense_groups.english: I have to say, that earns "two-two" pieces of candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh! Aw...

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 通通拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, here, take it all.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 糖果没了
sense_groups.english: Monica? We need more candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 刚刚只来了四个孩子 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: What? There's only been four kids. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但有个孩子说她爱我 于是我全部都给她了
sense_groups.english: But one said she loved me, so I gave her everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 难怪你会怀孕
sense_groups.english: No wonder you're pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这次扮成什么了 - 还记得史波尼克号卫星吗
sense_groups.english: What are you supposed to be? - Remember the Russian satellite, Sputnik?

sense_groups.chinese: 我扮成马铃薯或是"波特多"…
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm a potato. Or a "spud"...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的天线
sense_groups.english: ...and these are my antenna.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以史波尼克变成了…
sense_groups.english: So Sputnik becomes?

sense_groups.chinese: 波特多尼克
sense_groups.english: Spud-nik! Spud-nik.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 原来我不是变装最失败的人
sense_groups.english: Wow, I don't have the worst costume anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗斯是团粪
sense_groups.english: Hey, all right! Ross came as doodie.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不是粪 - 对 你是太空之粪
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not doodie. - No, space-doodie.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 甜心
sense_groups.english: Hey, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不吻我吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Aren't you gonna give me a kiss? - Okay, I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我吻了你之后 你得告诉我你是谁
sense_groups.english: But right after, you have to tell me who you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 乌苏拉 - 乌苏拉的未婚夫
sense_groups.english: Ursula? - Ursula's fiance?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你是她的妹妹 - 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You're the sister. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚打了我未来小姨子的屁股 - 对
sense_groups.english: I just slapped my future sister-in-law's ass. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是白痴 你妈妈在这里吗 或许我也可以打她的屁股
sense_groups.english: I'm an idiot. Is your mother here? I could give her a slap on the butt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈自杀死掉了 - 看吧 我就知道
sense_groups.english: My mother killed herself. - See, and I knew that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我满身大汗
sense_groups.english: Now I'm sweating.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看我 我满身大汗 我该走了
sense_groups.english: I'm really sweating. Now I'm saying look at me, I'm even sweatier. I should go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们从头来过
sense_groups.english: No. We'll start over.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是菲比 - 我是艾力克
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Phoebe. - Eric.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要那样子看我 - 汗滴到我眼睛里了
sense_groups.english: Why are you looking at me like that? - The sweat's in my eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 正在燃烧 - 好
sense_groups.english: It's burning. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - There.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么 - 我不知道该怎么说
sense_groups.english: So, what are you? - I don't think they have a name for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一紧张就会满身大汗
sense_groups.english: I get nervous, and I sweat like crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是指你的服装 - 我扮成太阳系
sense_groups.english: No, I meant your costume. - Oh, um, I'm a solar system.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的二年级学生帮我变装
sense_groups.english: My student's helped me. I teach second grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢二年级 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: I love the second grade. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 它比一年级好多了
sense_groups.english: It's better than first grade, where you don't know what's going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 也比三年级好
sense_groups.english: And definitely better than third grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以玩尔虞我诈的斗智游戏
sense_groups.english: You know, with all the politics and the mind games.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是做哪一行的 - 我白天时是按摩师
sense_groups.english: So, what do you do? - I'm a masseuse, by day.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你不必陪我 - 我觉得很开心
sense_groups.english: You don't have to stand here with me. - I'm having fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为你跟乌苏拉高兴 - 我觉得自己很幸运 她太棒了
sense_groups.english: I'm really excited for you and Ursula. - I feel very lucky. She's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是最美丽的女人 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: She's the most beautiful woman ever. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 - 什么事
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会看漫画书吧 - 我是专家
sense_groups.english: You read comic books, right? - Exclusively.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果猫女跟女超人打架 谁会赢呢
sense_groups.english: Who do you think would win in a fight, Catwoman or Supergirl?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是猫女 绝对是 - 对
sense_groups.english: Catwoman, hands down. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你跟菲比吗 我赌菲比会赢
sense_groups.english: Between you and Phoebe? I'd give the edge to Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 真的吗 - 你在开玩笑吗
sense_groups.english: What? Really? - You kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比在街上混过 好吗 而且她生起气来跟疯婆子一样
sense_groups.english: Phoebe lived on the street, okay? Plus, she's got this crazy temper. She...

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有站在我后面吧
sense_groups.english: She's not right behind me, is she?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你很安全
sense_groups.english: No, you're fine. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能打倒瑞秋吗 - 我不确定
sense_groups.english: Do you think I could take Rachel? - I'm not sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 少来了 我很凶的
sense_groups.english: What? Come on, I am tough!

sense_groups.chinese: 用力打我这里 - 好
sense_groups.english: Punch me here, as hard as you can!

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 你为什么那么认真 那不重要
sense_groups.english: Relax. What are you taking this so seriously for? It doesn't matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 如果我告诉你罗斯或钱德能打倒你呢
sense_groups.english: Really? What would you say if I told you Ross or Chandler could beat you up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说"拜托 女人家"
sense_groups.english: I would say, "Woman, please."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乌苏拉的未婚夫真的很贴心
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ursula's fiance is really sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是老师 他会做义工
sense_groups.english: He's a teacher, he does volunteer work.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我不喜欢会流汗的男人 但我愿意帮他擦汗
sense_groups.english: Normally, I don't like sweaty guys. But I could just mop him up.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 菲比 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Phoebe? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在暗恋你姐姐的未婚夫
sense_groups.english: You're getting a crush on your sister's fiance.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我才没有 是你
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not, you are!

sense_groups.chinese: 她的脾气来了
sense_groups.english: Here comes the temper.

sense_groups.chinese: 不给糖就捣蛋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Trick or treat. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我们没有糖果了 但已经有人去买了
sense_groups.english: Hi. Know what? We're out of candy. But someone went to get some.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该给孩子们钱 但我的钱也都给光了
sense_groups.english: And I've been giving out money, but I'm out of that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以开张支票给你吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Can I write you a check? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你叫什么名字 - 李兰妮·马尤拉诺法维奇
sense_groups.english: Okay. What's your name? - Lelani Mayolanofavich.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会写上 "现金支票"
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm just gonna write this out to "cash."

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi, Mona.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊一定会很兴奋 他正希望你扮成风流护士
sense_groups.english: Joey's gonna be thrilled. He was hoping you'd come by as a slutty nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我只是扮成护士
sense_groups.english: Um, actually, I'm just a nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我听了会觉得很丢脸 但我已经丢够脸了
sense_groups.english: You'd think that would embarrass me, but, you see, I'm maxed out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你来了 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hey, you made it. - Hi! Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是马铃薯 - 喔 我是波特多…
sense_groups.english: You're, um... You're a potato? - Well, I'm a spud?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有天线…
sense_groups.english: And the antenna...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你是波特多尼克 - 答对了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you're Spud-nik! - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 娶她吧
sense_groups.english: Marry her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's a good one for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯跟钱德打架谁会赢
sense_groups.english: Who do you think would win a fight between Ross and Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法回答 钱德是我的老公
sense_groups.english: I can't answer that. Chandler's my husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯会赢 - 对
sense_groups.english: So Ross? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 美女 - 哈罗 帅哥
sense_groups.english: Hey, beautiful. - Hello, handsome.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你们两个 你们什么时候认识的
sense_groups.english: Aw, look at you two. So when did you guys meet?

sense_groups.chinese: 两个星期前 - 就那样
sense_groups.english: Two weeks ago. - Two weeks, that's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这听起来很疯狂 我不是个冲动的人 但是…
sense_groups.english: I know. It sounds crazy, and it's not like me to do something impulsive.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有很多共通点
sense_groups.english: But she's so perfect, and we have so much in common.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都是老师
sense_groups.english: We're both teachers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都参加了和平工作团 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: And we were both in the Peace Corps. - Peace Corps, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在乌拉圭做义工时
sense_groups.english: In fact, when we were building houses in Uruguay...

sense_groups.chinese: 只距离两个小镇远 却从来没见过面
sense_groups.english: ...we were just two towns apart and we never met.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我刚到时那里一片荒芜 但我离开时已经是个小镇了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It wasn't a town when I got there, but it was a town when I left.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以去喝一杯吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Shall we get me really drunk? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 粪团
sense_groups.english: Howdy, doodie.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: That's funny, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个最幽默的家伙 穿着你太太帮你挑的兔子装
sense_groups.english: You're the funniest man here in a bunny costume his wife made him wear.

sense_groups.chinese: 别激动 你看起来有点要化掉了
sense_groups.english: Relax, man. Relax. You're looking a little flushed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的问题有解了
sense_groups.english: Hey, I think we might find out the answer to our question.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么问题 - 摩妮卡跟我在聊 如果你跟罗斯打架
sense_groups.english: What question? - Who could kick whose ass in a fight...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会赢
sense_groups.english: ...you or Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是问题 - 那么你也觉得罗斯会赢喽
sense_groups.english: There's no question. - So you think Ross too?

sense_groups.chinese: 你选罗斯 - 罗斯很强壮
sense_groups.english: You picked Ross? - Ross is really strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是你们三个之中最壮的 乔伊除外
sense_groups.english: He's the strongest out of all three of you. Except for Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你没有选我 - 她说得对 我比你壮
sense_groups.english: I can not believe you didn't pick me. - In her defense, she's right. I am stronger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会毁了你
sense_groups.english: I would destroy you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 你觉得你比较壮吗 你为什么不证明给大家看
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? You think you're stronger? Why don't you prove it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会证明的
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'll prove it. I'll prove it like a theorem!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 别吵了
sense_groups.english: All right! Okay, stop it. Stop it!

sense_groups.chinese: 别吵了 谁都不准打架
sense_groups.english: Stop! No one's gonna fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 大家是来这里看人打架 快打给他们看吧
sense_groups.english: People came to see a fight, let's give them what they came for!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们可以比腕力 - 听风流护士的话
sense_groups.english: You guys could arm-wrestle. - Yeah, listen to the slutty nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 你死定了 - 是吗 你才死定了
sense_groups.english: You're going down. - Oh, yeah? You're going further down.

sense_groups.chinese: 市中心
sense_groups.english: Downtown!

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你们的叫阵台词太逊了
sense_groups.english: Seriously, guys, the trash talk is embarrassing.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿甘 你买到糖果了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, Gunther, you brought candy. Thank you so much for picking this up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的是太棒了 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: You are so sweet. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你在一起的人会是全世界最幸运的男朋友
sense_groups.english: Someday, you are gonna make some man the luckiest guy in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 - 不给糖就捣蛋
sense_groups.english: Got to go. - Trick or treat.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Hi! Wow! There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友路易斯说你会给钱
sense_groups.english: My friend Lewis told me you were giving out money.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 但现在我们有糖果了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, we were, but, um, now we've got candy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我宁愿要钱
sense_groups.english: I'd rather have the money.

sense_groups.chinese: 那由不得你来选 万圣节快乐
sense_groups.english: Well, that's not your choice. Happy Halloween!

sense_groups.chinese: 这不公平
sense_groups.english: This isn't fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 你披上斗篷就能跟别人要东西 那公平吗
sense_groups.english: Is it fair that all you did was put on a cape and I gotta give you stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Shut up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你才闭嘴
sense_groups.english: You shut up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能叫我闭嘴 - 我想我刚刚说了
sense_groups.english: You can't tell me to shut up. - Uh, I think I just did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又想说了 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: And uh-oh, here it comes again. Shut up!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 不 我可以 我很厉害的
sense_groups.english: Uh, Rach. - No, I got it. I'm good. I got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我还有一句话要告诉你
sense_groups.english: Wait, I had one more thing to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个可怕的老女人
sense_groups.english: You're a mean old woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 闭嘴…别哭了
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait! No. Shut... Don't cry!

sense_groups.chinese: 我去拿支票簿
sense_groups.english: Let me get my checkbook!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必这么做
sense_groups.english: Honey, you don't have to do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 心地善良才是最重要的
sense_groups.english: It's the strength you have inside that means the most to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你既忠心又老实 而且你的品德高贵
sense_groups.english: You're loyal, you're honest and you have integrity.

sense_groups.chinese: 那才是我要的男人
sense_groups.english: That's the strength I want in the man I love.

sense_groups.chinese: 那对我来说毫无意义 来吧
sense_groups.english: That means nothing to me. Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 骗子 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, liar. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会娶你是因为
sense_groups.english: You know, the only reason he's marrying you...

sense_groups.chinese: 他以为你说的话是真的
sense_groups.english: ...is because he thinks the things you were saying were true.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们有可能是真的 - 但你真的在说谎
sense_groups.english: They could be true. - But they're not.

sense_groups.chinese: 真假只有一线之隔
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's a fine line, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要说谎 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why are you lying to him? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 他做了那些事 我说我也是 他变得很兴奋 很好玩
sense_groups.english: He said he did this stuff, I said I did it too. He got so excited, it was fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心
sense_groups.english: Honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个坏习惯 我要你马上戒烟
sense_groups.english: It's a disgusting habit, and I want you to quit now!

sense_groups.chinese: 她帮助很多人戒烟
sense_groups.english: She's helped so many people quit smoking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得走了
sense_groups.english: We'd better get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还得参加教会的聚会 - 对
sense_groups.english: You have a church group meeting. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能见到你 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: Well, it was nice meeting you. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 乌苏拉 我很高兴今晚能见到你
sense_groups.english: And, Ursula, it was really nice meeting you tonight!

sense_groups.chinese: 快来吧 兔子大战粪团 我们在等你
sense_groups.english: Pheebs, come on! Bunny versus Doodie. We're waiting!

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧
sense_groups.english: Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 一次决胜负 赢的人是英雄
sense_groups.english: Okay, guys. One match, winner take all.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 冠军有什么奖品
sense_groups.english: Wait. What does the winner get?

sense_groups.chinese: 骄傲 - 跟自尊
sense_groups.english: Pride. - And dignity.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们说了算
sense_groups.english: Heh. Okay, if you say so.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 就位 预备 开始
sense_groups.english: All right, ready, set, go!

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 - 加油
sense_groups.english: Come on! - Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都很壮 - 或是一样逊
sense_groups.english: Wow, they're both really strong. - Or equally weak.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 钱德露出他的性感表情了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Chandler's making his sex face.

sense_groups.chinese: 你累了吗 - 不 我可以撑一整天
sense_groups.english: So you getting tired? - No. I could do this all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我有点累了 - 天啊 我累坏了
sense_groups.english: Getting a little tired, though. - God, I'm exhausted.

sense_groups.chinese: 我开始漏气了 好吗 蒙娜就站在那里
sense_groups.english: This is starting to look bad for me, okay? Mona's standing right there.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她在跟乔伊说话 你得让我赢
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, she's talking to Joey! You've got to let me win!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我赢 我太太以为我是三脚猫
sense_groups.english: No way. Let me win. My wife thinks I'm a wimp.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你还有太太
sense_groups.english: Hey, at least you have a wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 我离婚了 还搞大别人的肚子
sense_groups.english: I keep getting divorces and knocking people up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还打扮的跟个傻瓜一样
sense_groups.english: And I'm dressed as doodie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是波特多尼克 - 少来了 我们要骗谁呢 我是傻瓜
sense_groups.english: You're Spud-nik. - Come on, who we kidding? I'm doodie.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 她在看我 - 啊
sense_groups.english: Please? She's watching. - Ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - Oh, yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 耶
sense_groups.english: Yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的英雄
sense_groups.english: My hero!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个怪女人
sense_groups.english: You're a weird lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 乌苏拉忘了拿皮包 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ursula said she left her purse. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太好了 里面放了她祈祷团朋友的电话
sense_groups.english: What a relief. It has the numbers of the people in her prayer chain.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: I'm sure it does. Yeah. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们婚礼上见了
sense_groups.english: Well, guess I'll see you at the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我没办法去参加婚礼
sense_groups.english: Um, listen. I don't think I'm gonna make it to the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 祝你们好运 - 我想我们会没事的
sense_groups.english: I wish you all the luck in the world. - We'll be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切真的太完美了 她一直为我保持处子之身
sense_groups.english: It's so perfect, and she's been saving herself for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能让你这么做 她在说谎 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I can't let you do this. She's lying to you. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她在说谎 我想我可以证明 对不起
sense_groups.english: She is lying. And I bet I could prove it. Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 没有祈祷团的电话
sense_groups.english: Okay. Yeah, not a prayer chain.

sense_groups.chinese: 但它看起来像是银行的平面图
sense_groups.english: But what looks like a detailed drawing of a bank floor plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这是她在餐厅当女服务生的名牌
sense_groups.english: Here's the name tag from the restaurant where she works as a waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是老师 她是女服务生
sense_groups.english: Not a teacher, a waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 她的驾照在这里 她总是会撒这个谎
sense_groups.english: Here's her driver's license. She always lies about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟你说她几岁了 - 她说她二十五岁
sense_groups.english: How old did she say she was? - She told me she was 25.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不想拿给你看
sense_groups.english: Aw. I almost don't want to show you this.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住 我比她年轻一分钟
sense_groups.english: Just remember, I'm a minute younger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太笨了
sense_groups.english: I am so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 她当然不是老师
sense_groups.english: Of course she's lying. She's not a teacher.

sense_groups.chinese: 根本不会有 "超机密儿童间谍学校"
sense_groups.english: There's no such thing as a "Top Secret School for the Children of Spies."

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不笨
sense_groups.english: No, you're not stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不聪明
sense_groups.english: I'm not smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是很想冲动一下
sense_groups.english: I just wanted so much to be impulsive for once.

sense_groups.chinese: 找一点浪漫 - 很好
sense_groups.english: To be romantic. - That's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该要冲动跟浪漫
sense_groups.english: You should be impulsive and you should be romantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是你找错对象了
sense_groups.english: Just, you did it with the wrong person.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 这真的很奇怪 你们长得那么像
sense_groups.english: What? - It's weird, two people look so alike.

sense_groups.chinese: 却完全不一样
sense_groups.english: And so different.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾力克 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Eric! Let's go!

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去解决问题 - 没错 你该那么做
sense_groups.english: Better go deal with it. - Yeah, you should.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 我得去祷告
sense_groups.english: Hurry up! I gotta pray!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得给那孩子五十块 他才不哭
sense_groups.english: Well, I had to give the kid 50 bucks to stop crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还不赖 - 我还得当他的女朋友
sense_groups.english: That's not so bad. - I also had to go to a couple houses...

sense_groups.chinese: 陪他走一段路
sense_groups.english: ...as his girlfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不会应付小孩子
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I am just awful with children.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟孩子们相处的很好 只是小孩子在万圣节都会抓狂
sense_groups.english: Come on, you're good with kids. They're just crazy on Halloween.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们贪心地想多拿一些糖果
sense_groups.english: They're all greedy, hopped up on sugar.

sense_groups.chinese: 就那样 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Really? That's all it is? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 万圣节是最糟糕的 除了圣诞节跟他们的生日
sense_groups.english: Halloween is the worst. Except for Christmas. And their birthdays.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在暑假也会抓狂
sense_groups.english: They get crazy during the summer too.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有他们肚子饿跟想睡觉的时候
sense_groups.english: And any time they're hungry or sleepy.

sense_groups.chinese: 小孩子很难缠 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: Kids are tough. Good luck with that. Pfft.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很遗憾你输了
sense_groups.english: Look, I wanted to tell you, I'm sorry you lost.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你一个秘密 我放水让他赢
sense_groups.english: Oh, listen. I got a secret for you. I let him win.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 那是秘密还是谎话
sense_groups.english: Heh, heh. - Was that a secret, or a lie?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我让他…罗斯 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: No, I let him... Ross? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事 - 麻烦你告诉她我放水让你赢
sense_groups.english: Would you tell her I let you win, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 对 钱德"放水让我赢"
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, uh, Chandler let me win.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 钱德真的好壮 我的手好酸喔 护士
sense_groups.english: No, Chandler's really strong. Oh, my arm is so sore. Oh, nurse?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很强壮 我要证明给你看
sense_groups.english: I am strong. I'll show you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 拜托
sense_groups.english: Chandler, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 你害怕吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, what's the matter? Are you scared?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 大兔子
sense_groups.english: Let's go, big bunny!

sense_groups.chinese: 一 二 三 开始
sense_groups.english: One, two, three. Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去自杀
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna kill myself.

questions.name: S08E07
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey.
Oh, my God, you cleaned! Look at these floors!
You did the windows!
I have been begging for months and you did, you cleaned!
And nagging works! - No, uh, I didn't actually do this.
Oh, no. Was I cleaning in my sleep again?
No, it wasn't you.
Well, then, who? - I got a maid. Yay!
Oh, well, I hope by "maid," you mean "mistress"...
...because if some other woman was cleaning...
Now, honey, I know you don't like to relinquish control.
"Relinquish" is just a fancy word for "lose."
Look, she's really nice, okay?
And she mentioned that she adored the way that you arranged the sponges.
Did she really say that?
Yes, I distinctly remember because I thought it was a joke.
Now, just give her a chance, okay? - Fine, I can do it.
Whoo.
What's the matter? - Usually when I'm anxious, I clean.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Whose cell phone is that? It's just so annoying.
Everywhere you go.
I think it's coming from your bag.
I never get calls!
Hello?
Hi, it's Eric, from the Halloween party. Ursula's fiance.
Oh, my God, Eric, hi! Wait, how'd you get this number?
I have a friend who's a cop, and he got it.
Wow. What an incredible violation and wonderful surprise!
I just... I thought you should know I broke up with Ursula.
Oh, you did? He did it, he did it!
Wow, what did he do? - Shh! I'm talking.
Anyway, I was wondering...
...if you were the sort of person who eats lunch?
Are you asking me out?
Because it'd be weird since you just broke up with my sister.
Yeah, um, okay.
I'm sorry. Bye.
No, wait! I was just saying that so you'd think I was a good person.
Fight for me!
Uh, I won't take no for an answer.
Not great, we can work on it at lunch.
Okay, um, I can be at your apartment in two hours.
Great. Uh, how do you know where I live?
I've got friends too.
Okay, bye. - Bye.
Oh, my God, I'm going out with Eric!
Oh, this day is gonna be much better than I thought it was gonna be. Heh.
Oh, Ross, I can't make lunch.
So apparently I'm available for lunch.
Can't, I'm busy. I'm apartment hunting.
You're moving?
I can't live with Joey once the baby comes.
I don't want my child's first words to be, "How you doing?"
So does Joey know you're moving?
I haven't discussed it, but he's gonna be relieved.
Last week he brought this girl over...
...and I started talking to her about morning sickness.
Then I showed her pictures from my pregnancy book.
That's not really porn. - Not so much.
You know what? If you're looking for a place...
...I heard in the elevator this morning that a woman in my building died.
Oh, my God. Was she old? Does she have a view?
Well I don't know. But how great would that be, huh?
You living in my building?
I could take care of the baby, I could come over whenever I want...
...with your permission.
That really would be great. - Yeah.
Well, can we see it?
Oh, maybe we shouldn't. If she just died this morning. Out of respect.
Yeah. No. No, you're right.
Shall we? - Yeah.
Yes? - Hi. I'm Ross Geller.
I live in the building.
And I'm Rachel, an admirer of the building.
I heard about Mrs. Verhoeven passing away, and I am so sorry for your loss.
She didn't pass away. - What?
My mother's still alive. - Oh, thank God!
It looked like we were gonna lose her this morning...
...but she's a tough old bird.
Are you close with her?
Of course. Heh.
Uh, yeah. She and I would talk all the time...
...in the laundry room.
You speak Dutch?
You know, I would, but it's just too painful.
So she's really not dead.
No. She's hanging in there.
Do you think...? Could you tell me, is she hanging in in a one-bedroom or a two?
Mrs. Bing, this tile cleaner is incredible. Where did you get it?
Oh, well, um, I make it myself.
It's two parts ammonia and one part lemon juice. The secret ingredient is...
You know what? We just met.
Okay. Uh, I'm gonna get the clothes from the laundry room now...
...and when I come back, I'll clean behind the fridge.
I love her.
I'll be back in a minute.
Okay.
See? I told you. - She stole my jeans!
What?
I have been looking for them all week and she is wearing them.
So she stole your pants...
...and then she came back and wore them in front of you?
Don't you see? It's the perfect crime.
She must have been planning this for years.
I will prove it to you.
About a week ago, I was wearing those jeans.
I dropped a pen in my lap and it left an ink stain on the crotch.
When she comes back, I will find it and show you that stain!
Is it possible the company that sold the jeans...
...made more than just the one pair?
I guess.
So shouldn't we give her the benefit of the doubt before we go...
...snooping around her crotch?
Fine. I'm just glad I didn't give her my secret ingredient.
Heh. Out of curiosity, what is your secret ingredient?
Yeah. Ha-ha-ha.
Hi. - Come in. I'm so glad you're here.
Yeah. Me too.
Not in the shaky, angry way you are, though.
Sorry. I just saw Ursula.
I had to get the engagement ring back.
Just seeing her brought it all back.
All the lies, the way she used me.
I just... I get so angry, just looking at her...
Face. - Yeah. Yeah.
I'm sorry. It's just, when I look at you...
...I see her.
And when I see her, I get a little bit angry.
Maybe this is too weird. - No, wait.
There's only a problem...
...when I look at you.
I got it. I got it.
No, don't tear out your eyes!
I was just gonna take out my lenses. - Oh, yeah. Try that.
So is that better?
Not really.
You... Ugh. You're blurry.
But you still look like Ursula. You're "Blursula."
Okay, wait. Maybe...
If I just don't look at you for a while.
See? It works. I'm not angry at all anymore.
This is a great date!
Look, Eric, turn around.
Look, I like you, but it shouldn't be this hard. It's our first date.
First dates are supposed to be about excitement and electricity.
And "Ooh, he touched my hand, did he mean touch my hand?"
And, you know, first kisses, and...
...second kisses.
Thanks for the coffee, or, uh, ahem
Yeah, we're done.
"Ezel"? Ezel...
Hey, Ross. Listen.
You wanna go see that new IMAX movie on tide pools?
Really? - No, ha, ha.
But I got Knicks tickets for you, me, and Chandler.
Sweet! - All right, finish your coffee. Let's go.
Okay, I have to stop by my place.
To tape the game? You do this every time. You're not gonna be on TV!
No, no, I have to see if this apartment became available.
You're switching apartments? - Not for me, it's for Rachel.
Rachel has an apartment. - When the baby comes, she's gonna move.
She is? - Yeah.
You didn't expect her to live there with a baby, did you?
I guess I didn't really think about it.
Ezel.
Hey, Gunther, you're an ezel. Huh.
Damn it.
Nice jeans. - Oh, thanks.
I like your top. - Oh. You're not getting it.
What happened? - Oh. I fell asleep.
I was thinking about taking my lunch break.
Will you do the top of the cabinets? That'll really work up your appetite.
All right.
Hello.
What's going on?
I'm sorry. I've never had a maid before. Is this not okay?
Hey. - Hey.
How was the game? - Uh, it was okay. I ate way too much.
So, um, I was talking to Ross and he said you were looking for a new place?
Oh, yeah. Hopefully across the street. If certain Dutch people would just let go.
I was kind of hoping you'd stay.
But Joey, I have to go. There's no room for a baby here.
No room? It's a baby. It's, like, this big.
You could put it over here.
Or we could put it right here. Aw! Cute, right?
Or over here. You wouldn't even notice it.
