...I heard in the elevator this morning that a woman in my building died.
Oh, my God. Was she old? Does she have a view?
Well I don't know. But how great would that be, huh?
You living in my building?
I could take care of the baby, I could come over whenever I want...
...with your permission.
That really would be great. - Yeah.
Well, can we see it?
Oh, maybe we shouldn't. If she just died this morning. Out of respect.
Yeah. No. No, you're right.
Shall we? - Yeah.
Yes? - Hi. I'm Ross Geller.
I live in the building.
And I'm Rachel, an admirer of the building.
I heard about Mrs. Verhoeven passing away, and I am so sorry for your loss.
She didn't pass away. - What?
My mother's still alive. - Oh, thank God!
It looked like we were gonna lose her this morning...
...but she's a tough old bird.
Are you close with her?
Of course. Heh.
Uh, yeah. She and I would talk all the time...
...in the laundry room.
You speak Dutch?
You know, I would, but it's just too painful.
So she's really not dead.
No. She's hanging in there.
Do you think...? Could you tell me, is she hanging in in a one-bedroom or a two?
Mrs. Bing, this tile cleaner is incredible. Where did you get it?
Oh, well, um, I make it myself.
It's two parts ammonia and one part lemon juice. The secret ingredient is...
You know what? We just met.
Okay. Uh, I'm gonna get the clothes from the laundry room now...
...and when I come back, I'll clean behind the fridge.
I love her.
I'll be back in a minute.
Okay.
See? I told you. - She stole my jeans!
What?
I have been looking for them all week and she is wearing them.
So she stole your pants...
...and then she came back and wore them in front of you?
Don't you see? It's the perfect crime.
She must have been planning this for years.
I will prove it to you.
About a week ago, I was wearing those jeans.
I dropped a pen in my lap and it left an ink stain on the crotch.
When she comes back, I will find it and show you that stain!
Is it possible the company that sold the jeans...
...made more than just the one pair?
I guess.
So shouldn't we give her the benefit of the doubt before we go...
...snooping around her crotch?
Fine. I'm just glad I didn't give her my secret ingredient.
Heh. Out of curiosity, what is your secret ingredient?
Yeah. Ha-ha-ha.
Hi. - Come in. I'm so glad you're here.
Yeah. Me too.
Not in the shaky, angry way you are, though.
Sorry. I just saw Ursula.
I had to get the engagement ring back.
Just seeing her brought it all back.
All the lies, the way she used me.
I just... I get so angry, just looking at her...
Face. - Yeah. Yeah.
I'm sorry. It's just, when I look at you...
...I see her.
And when I see her, I get a little bit angry.
Maybe this is too weird. - No, wait.
There's only a problem...
...when I look at you.
I got it. I got it.
No, don't tear out your eyes!
I was just gonna take out my lenses. - Oh, yeah. Try that.
So is that better?
Not really.
You... Ugh. You're blurry.
But you still look like Ursula. You're "Blursula."
Okay, wait. Maybe...
If I just don't look at you for a while.
See? It works. I'm not angry at all anymore.
This is a great date!
Look, Eric, turn around.
Look, I like you, but it shouldn't be this hard. It's our first date.
First dates are supposed to be about excitement and electricity.
And "Ooh, he touched my hand, did he mean touch my hand?"
And, you know, first kisses, and...
...second kisses.
Thanks for the coffee, or, uh, ahem
Yeah, we're done.
"Ezel"? Ezel...
Hey, Ross. Listen.
You wanna go see that new IMAX movie on tide pools?
Really? - No, ha, ha.
But I got Knicks tickets for you, me, and Chandler.
Sweet! - All right, finish your coffee. Let's go.
Okay, I have to stop by my place.
To tape the game? You do this every time. You're not gonna be on TV!
No, no, I have to see if this apartment became available.
You're switching apartments? - Not for me, it's for Rachel.
Rachel has an apartment. - When the baby comes, she's gonna move.
She is? - Yeah.
You didn't expect her to live there with a baby, did you?
I guess I didn't really think about it.
Ezel.
Hey, Gunther, you're an ezel. Huh.
Damn it.
Nice jeans. - Oh, thanks.
I like your top. - Oh. You're not getting it.
What happened? - Oh. I fell asleep.
I was thinking about taking my lunch break.
Will you do the top of the cabinets? That'll really work up your appetite.
All right.
Hello.
What's going on?
I'm sorry. I've never had a maid before. Is this not okay?
Hey. - Hey.
How was the game? - Uh, it was okay. I ate way too much.
So, um, I was talking to Ross and he said you were looking for a new place?
Oh, yeah. Hopefully across the street. If certain Dutch people would just let go.
I was kind of hoping you'd stay.
But Joey, I have to go. There's no room for a baby here.
No room? It's a baby. It's, like, this big.
You could put it over here.
Or we could put it right here. Aw! Cute, right?
Or over here. You wouldn't even notice it.
"Where's the baby?" "Oh, it's right over..."
Honey, it's not just a matter of where you put it.
A baby changes everything. They cry all the time.
Imagine bringing home some girl...
...and trying to score when there's a screaming baby.
I could use a challenge. It's getting pretty easy.
It's so sweet that you want me to stay, but I can't do that to you.
I mean, it would disrupt your entire life.
It's just...
I love living with you so much.
I wish things didn't have to change. - I know.
You know, I blame Ross for this.
I do too, a little bit. - Yeah.
I'm gonna miss you.
You're the hottest roommate I ever had.
Oh, no, I have to go. Ugh, I have a massage appointment.
No, stay here. We'll keep doing this. I'll pay you.
No, I've gotten in trouble for that before.
I'll see you later? - Absolutely.
I love the way you kiss.
Really? That's the thing I'm worst at!
Heh, you'll see.
Hey. - Hey! Um...
I think Brenda needs a raise. - How come?
Because I put my head between her legs.
To see her pants? - They're my pants!
Are you sure? Did you see the stain?
No. I was getting into position, and everything went dark.
God, she is not stealing from us, okay? Will you let this go?
Fine.
She's wearing my bra! - Oh, dear God.
My pink flowered bra! I recognize the strap!
And yet you don't recognize that you're crazy?
Here's the plan, okay?
I'm going to leave, and you're gonna look at Brenda's bra.
Here's another plan. No.
I would do it, but she thinks I'm attracted to her.
Why? - Did you not hear where my head was?
Come on! We're a team. We're in this together.
I fear a jury will see it the same way.
Do this for me. I catch you looking at women's breasts all the time.
You see that?
Do you see this? Unh...
All right. Yes, okay. I get your point.
But if it's not her bra, will you just let the woman clean?
Yes. Absolutely. Okay?
You'll know it's mine because on the right cup, the lacy part...
...there's very a noticeable rip.
You need new clothes.
Hi. How is she? - It's not looking good.
Oh? Oh. Aw.
Well, I, uh, brought her some bloemen.
That's so sweet.
Would you like to say goodbye? I'm sure it would mean a lot to her.
Oh, I don't know that it would. Heh.
Well, her memory is pretty much gone. - All right, then.
Hey! - Welcome back.
Should we pick up from where we left off? - I don't know.
I'm still tired from this afternoon.
Why? - Uh, the sex.
What sex? - Our sex.
We didn't have sex.
Well if I didn't have sex with you...
...I had sex with somebody that looked an awful lot like...
Ew. Ew. Ew, ew! - No, no, no, no!
You had sex with Ursula? - A little bit.
She walked in, I thought she was you and I kissed her and...
You didn't notice different clothes?
I was just so excited to see you.
Ugh! You know what? This is too weird.
No. I don't wanna lose you. It's like I was saying to Ursula...
...when I was making love to her and thought she was you...
Yeah. It's too weird.
So I guess this is it.
Yeah.
Maybe it's for the best.
You smell just like her. - Yeah, so do you.
What are you doing? - I'm leaning.
This is where I lean.
Okay.
Brenda, a bee! - What?
Yes, it's flown into your blouse.
You better undo your buttons lest it sting you.
I think I know what's going on here. - You do?
Look, I know it must be hard that your wife is a lesbian...
...but it's wrong. You're married.
I totally understand. - Okay, good. Ha-ha-ha.
Could I just see your bra?
Hi.
Where'd you get those jeans? - You gave them to me.
No, I didn't! - All right, I took them.
I figured it was okay, you've got an ink stain on the crotch.
Oh, no! Did you take my bra too? - What bra?
The pink one with the flowers. - You mean the one you're wearing?
I quit!
Sounds about right.
What is this? - Hey.
Uh, this is just to give you an idea.
We can put screens here so the baby has privacy...
...and maybe a mobile, you know, over the crib...
...and, uh, here's a baby monitor which, until the baby comes...
...we can use as walkie-talkies. Eh?
You're so sweet!
Oh, my God! And you gave the baby Hugsy!
That's really just to show where the baby would go.
Why don't I hold on to him so there's no confusion?
Joey, the baby is gonna be crying. It's gonna be loud.
I'm loud. - It's gonna be up all night.
I'm up all night. - It's gonna poop.
Hello?
What about the women you wanna bring home?
Look, if I'm bringing home a woman who can't stand being around a baby...
...then maybe I don't wanna be with that woman.
Or maybe we'll do it in the bathroom of the club!
Joey, are you sure? - Yeah.
Look, I know sometimes it'll be hard, okay...
...but it'll also be really, really great.
Please, Rachel, I really want you to stay.
I want me to stay too. Thank you.
Joey, look at this crib! It's so cute!
I know. I found it on the street.
Are you...? Really?
This is in such good condition. - Yeah.
Wow. Whoa, what's under the cover?
I don't know. - It's moving.
Still...
Aah! It's got a tail! Get it out! - Oh, aah! Okay!
Well, the old lady died. And how do I know?
Because her dying wish was for one last kiss.
But I don't care because you got the apartment. Yes!
Ew, yeah.
Um, I think I'm gonna stay here.
Isn't that great?
What? You... But...
Ezels!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你打扫过了 看看地板
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you cleaned! Look at these floors!

sense_groups.chinese: 你还擦了窗户
sense_groups.english: You did the windows!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你提了好几个月 你真的打扫了
sense_groups.english: I have been begging for months and you did, you cleaned!

sense_groups.chinese: 唠叨是有用的 - 不 事实上这不是我做的
sense_groups.english: And nagging works! - No, uh, I didn't actually do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我又边睡觉边打扫了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Was I cleaning in my sleep again?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 打扫的人也不是你
sense_groups.english: No, it wasn't you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么是谁 - 我请了一个女佣 耶
sense_groups.english: Well, then, who? - I got a maid. Yay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你说的"女佣"是指"情妇"
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, I hope by "maid," you mean "mistress"...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为有其他女人在打扫…
sense_groups.english: ...because if some other woman was cleaning...

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我知道你不喜欢让出控制权
sense_groups.english: Now, honey, I know you don't like to relinquish control.

sense_groups.chinese: "让出"的意思 应该就是"失去"吧
sense_groups.english: "Relinquish" is just a fancy word for "lose."

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Look, she's really nice, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 她还说她喜欢你放海绵的方式
sense_groups.english: And she mentioned that she adored the way that you arranged the sponges.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的那么说
sense_groups.english: Did she really say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我会记得 因为我以为她在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: Yes, I distinctly remember because I thought it was a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 给她一个机会 好吗 - 好吧 我办得到的
sense_groups.english: Now, just give her a chance, okay? - Fine, I can do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Whoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 通常我一焦虑就会打扫
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - Usually when I'm anxious, I clean.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁的行动电话在响 那真的很吵
sense_groups.english: Whose cell phone is that? It's just so annoying.

sense_groups.chinese: 走到哪里都会发生这种事
sense_groups.english: Everywhere you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想声音是从你的包包里传出来的
sense_groups.english: I think it's coming from your bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 从来没有人会打电话给我
sense_groups.english: I never get calls!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是万圣节派对上的艾力克 乌苏拉的未婚夫
sense_groups.english: Hi, it's Eric, from the Halloween party. Ursula's fiance.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 艾力克 嗨 等一下 你怎么知道我的电话号码
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Eric, hi! Wait, how'd you get this number?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个朋友在当警察 他帮我查到的
sense_groups.english: I have a friend who's a cop, and he got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太不可思议了 我吓了一大跳
sense_groups.english: Wow. What an incredible violation and wonderful surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你应该要知道 我跟乌苏拉分手了
sense_groups.english: I just... I thought you should know I broke up with Ursula.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 他办到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, you did? He did it, he did it!

sense_groups.chinese: 他做了什么 - 我在讲电话
sense_groups.english: Wow, what did he do? - Shh! I'm talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我很好奇
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I was wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会不会吃午餐
sense_groups.english: ...if you were the sort of person who eats lunch?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在约我吗
sense_groups.english: Are you asking me out?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那很奇怪 你刚刚才跟我姊姊分手
sense_groups.english: Because it'd be weird since you just broke up with my sister.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, um, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 再见
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下 我会那么说是希望你把我当成好人
sense_groups.english: No, wait! I was just saying that so you'd think I was a good person.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续争取我吧
sense_groups.english: Fight for me!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会接受你的拒绝
sense_groups.english: Uh, I won't take no for an answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然不是很好 但我们能边吃午餐边练习
sense_groups.english: Not great, we can work on it at lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在两个小时里赶到你家
sense_groups.english: Okay, um, I can be at your apartment in two hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你怎么知道我住在哪里
sense_groups.english: Great. Uh, how do you know where I live?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有朋友
sense_groups.english: I've got friends too.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, bye. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我要跟艾力克约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I'm going out with Eric!

sense_groups.chinese: 今天比我想像中还要美好
sense_groups.english: Oh, this day is gonna be much better than I thought it was gonna be. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我没办法跟你吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross, I can't make lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 我午餐时间有空
sense_groups.english: So apparently I'm available for lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法 我很忙 我在找房子
sense_groups.english: Can't, I'm busy. I'm apartment hunting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要搬家
sense_groups.english: You're moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子生下来后 我没办法跟乔伊一起住
sense_groups.english: I can't live with Joey once the baby comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望我的孩子会说的第一句话是"你好吗"
sense_groups.english: I don't want my child's first words to be, "How you doing?"

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊知道你要搬家吗
sense_groups.english: So does Joey know you're moving?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有跟他谈 但我知道他会觉得如释重负
sense_groups.english: I haven't discussed it, but he's gonna be relieved.

sense_groups.chinese: 上星期他带一个女孩回家
sense_groups.english: Last week he brought this girl over...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她谈害喜的问题
sense_groups.english: ...and I started talking to her about morning sickness.

sense_groups.chinese: 还把我怀孕纪念册的照片拿给她看
sense_groups.english: Then I showed her pictures from my pregnancy book.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不会很煽情吗 - 一点都没有
sense_groups.english: That's not really porn. - Not so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天早上我在电梯里听说
sense_groups.english: You know what? If you're looking for a place...

sense_groups.chinese: 我住的公寓里有个女住户过世了
sense_groups.english: ...I heard in the elevator this morning that a woman in my building died.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她很老吗 她的公寓景观好吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Was she old? Does she have a view?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 但那一定会很棒
sense_groups.english: Well I don't know. But how great would that be, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你搬到我的公寓里来
sense_groups.english: You living in my building?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以照顾宝宝 想过去就过去…
sense_groups.english: I could take care of the baby, I could come over whenever I want...

sense_groups.chinese: 当然得先得到你的允许
sense_groups.english: ...with your permission.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒 - 对
sense_groups.english: That really would be great. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能去看看吗
sense_groups.english: Well, can we see it?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们不该那么做 我是说她今天早上才过世
sense_groups.english: Oh, maybe we shouldn't. If she just died this morning. Out of respect.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你说得对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. No. No, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Shall we? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事吗 - 嗨 我是罗斯·盖勒
sense_groups.english: Yes? - Hi. I'm Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我住在这栋公寓里
sense_groups.english: I live in the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是瑞秋 我很喜欢这栋公寓
sense_groups.english: And I'm Rachel, an admirer of the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说佛哈芬太太过世了 我真的很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I heard about Mrs. Verhoeven passing away, and I am so sorry for your loss.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没有过世 - 什么
sense_groups.english: She didn't pass away. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈还活着 - 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: My mother's still alive. - Oh, thank God!

sense_groups.chinese: 她今天早上差点就过世了
sense_groups.english: It looked like we were gonna lose her this morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 但她是个意志力很强的老太婆
sense_groups.english: ...but she's a tough old bird.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她很熟吗
sense_groups.english: Are you close with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Of course. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们常常…
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah. She and I would talk all the time...

sense_groups.chinese: 在洗衣间聊天
sense_groups.english: ...in the laundry room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会说荷兰文
sense_groups.english: You speak Dutch?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会说的 但那太痛苦了
sense_groups.english: You know, I would, but it's just too painful.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的没死
sense_groups.english: So she's really not dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她还在努力
sense_groups.english: No. She's hanging in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能告诉我她住的公寓是一房还是两房吗
sense_groups.english: Do you think...? Could you tell me, is she hanging in in a one-bedroom or a two?

sense_groups.chinese: 宾太太 这个清洁剂太棒了 你在哪里买的
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Bing, this tile cleaner is incredible. Where did you get it?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔… 那是我自己做的
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, um, I make it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 两份的阿摩尼亚加一份的柠檬汁 秘方是…
sense_groups.english: It's two parts ammonia and one part lemon juice. The secret ingredient is...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我们才刚刚认识
sense_groups.english: You know what? We just met.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我去洗衣间拿衣服
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh, I'm gonna get the clothes from the laundry room now...

sense_groups.chinese: 我回来后会打扫冰箱后面
sense_groups.english: ...and when I come back, I'll clean behind the fridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱她
sense_groups.english: I love her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我告诉过你了 - 她偷了我的牛仔裤
sense_groups.english: See? I told you. - She stole my jeans!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是什么
sense_groups.english: What is this? - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我只希望你考虑一下
sense_groups.english: Uh, this is just to give you an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以在这里装拉帘 宝宝还是有隐私…
sense_groups.english: We can put screens here so the baby has privacy...

sense_groups.chinese: 在摇篮上面装个音乐铃
sense_groups.english: ...and maybe a mobile, you know, over the crib...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是宝宝监控器 宝宝没出生前
sense_groups.english: ...and, uh, here's a baby monitor which, until the baby comes...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以把它当对讲机
sense_groups.english: ...we can use as walkie-talkies. Eh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的是太体贴了
sense_groups.english: You're so sweet!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你还把企鹅宝宝送给宝宝
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! And you gave the baby Hugsy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要向你示范宝宝该躺在哪里
sense_groups.english: That's really just to show where the baby would go.

sense_groups.chinese: 快把它交给我吧 免得你误会了
sense_groups.english: Why don't I hold on to him so there's no confusion?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 宝宝会哭的 会非常地吵
sense_groups.english: Joey, the baby is gonna be crying. It's gonna be loud.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很吵 - 他会整晚不睡
sense_groups.english: I'm loud. - It's gonna be up all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会 - 他会大便
sense_groups.english: I'm up all night. - It's gonna poop.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的女朋友们呢
sense_groups.english: What about the women you wanna bring home?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我把一个受不了宝宝的女人带回家…
sense_groups.english: Look, if I'm bringing home a woman who can't stand being around a baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我根本不该跟那个女人在一起
sense_groups.english: ...then maybe I don't wanna be with that woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们该在俱乐部的浴室里做爱
sense_groups.english: Or maybe we'll do it in the bathroom of the club!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你确定吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Joey, are you sure? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我知道 有时候会很辛苦…
sense_groups.english: Look, I know sometimes it'll be hard, okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是也会非常棒
sense_groups.english: ...but it'll also be really, really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 瑞秋 我真的希望你留下来
sense_groups.english: Please, Rachel, I really want you to stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想留下来 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: I want me to stay too. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 看看这个摇篮 它好可爱
sense_groups.english: Joey, look at this crib! It's so cute!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我在街上捡到的
sense_groups.english: I know. I found it on the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是…真的吗
sense_groups.english: Are you...? Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 它看起来还不错 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: This is in such good condition. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 被子下面是什么
sense_groups.english: Wow. Whoa, what's under the cover?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 - 他在动
sense_groups.english: I don't know. - It's moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 还在…
sense_groups.english: Still...

sense_groups.chinese: 他有尾巴 快把他丢出去 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Aah! It's got a tail! Get it out! - Oh, aah! Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 那位老太太过世了 我怎么会知道呢
sense_groups.english: Well, the old lady died. And how do I know?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她的遗愿是给她最后一吻
sense_groups.english: Because her dying wish was for one last kiss.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不在乎 因为你拿到那间公寓了 太棒了
sense_groups.english: But I don't care because you got the apartment. Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 对喔
sense_groups.english: Ew, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我要留在这里
sense_groups.english: Um, I think I'm gonna stay here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't that great?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你… 但是…
sense_groups.english: What? You... But...

sense_groups.chinese: 埃泽尔
sense_groups.english: Ezels!

Sure, yeah, he's kind of sexy.

Okay, so we'll just come up with a signal. If it's going well, you can take off.
No, Phoebe, I just need you there for support.
I haven't told him I'm pregnant yet. - Oh. Why not?
Because I know he's gonna flip out and I hate it when he gets angry.
Oh, Rachel. This is all so "Papa Don't Preach."
No, Pheeb, wait, he's a scary guy. I mean, one time he caught me smoking.
He said if he ever saw me doing that again, he would make me eat the entire pack.
Wow. Well, I will be there. - Okay.
Gosh, I'm not gonna let that man make you eat your baby.
Oh. Hey, who is that guy? I think I know him.
No, you don't. - No, you don't.
Oh, my God. Monica, he's the stripper from your bachelorette party.
Her what?
Your secret bachelorette party.
You had a bachelorette party? - She untied his G-string with her teeth.
Somebody stop me.
I thought we weren't gonna have bachelor, bachelorette parties.
You know, we agreed that it's a silly tradition.
It's a grand tradition.
I'm sorry. They surprised me. There was nothing I could do.
Well, you could have untied it with your hands.
This is so unfair.
The one thing I wanted to do was throw my best friend a bachelor party...
...but, oh, I wasn't allowed to. All we got was a stupid steak dinner.
You went home with the waitress.
Ha. Yeah, that was a good night.
I can't believe you didn't tell me.
You know that the two pillars of marriage are openness and honesty.
Ugh. I knew giving you that book was gonna come back and bite me in the ass.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

How about I order everyone the Moroccan chicken?
Oh, I don't eat meat.
It's chicken.

So, baby, tell me, what is new with you? - Well, actually, um...
Ahem. Your '74 Lafite, sir. - Seventy-four?
I ordered the '75. That's a magnificent wine. The '74 is sewage.
Why would you bring me sewage?
Is that a hard question? Are you an idiot? Is that why you're a waiter?
This is why I told the manager I wouldn't wait on you tonight.
Oh, come on. Don't be such a baby.
In case you didn't notice, that is a scary man.
He's right, though. The '74 is absolute piss.
This was such a huge mistake. I can't tell him, Phoebe. I can't.
Rachel... - No, it's okay. This is what's gonna happen.
I'm gonna wait a couple of years and then the baby will tell him.
Why? So he can get mad at the baby? - Hey, that is the baby's problem.
Oh. Everything okay with the waiter? - I have no idea. I went to the bathroom.
So, sweetie, you were starting to tell me what is, uh...? What is new with you?
Well...
I got TiVo.
What's TiVo? - It's slang for "pregnant."
Phoebe.
Are you really pregnant?
Well, uh, yes and no.
Except, not no.
So to sum it up, yeah.
Who is the father? Oh, no. Please don't tell me it's her.
No, it's Ross. It's Ross. You like Ross.
Oh, Daddy, I hope you're okay with all this.
I mean, think about it, this is a good thing. This is your first grandchild.
You're gonna be a poppy.
That's true. I'm a poppy.
I'm gonna be a poppy.
So when is the wedding? - The who?
The wedding. There's going to be a wedding.
Young lady, don't you sit there and tell me...
...my first grandchild is gonna be a bastard.
Rachel Karen Green, tell me there's gonna be a wedding.
February 2nd.
So it was cool seeing you lecture today.
Oh, thanks. Although it seemed like you were falling asleep there a little.
Oh, no, I had my eyes closed so I could concentrate and take it all in.
Yeah, a lot of my students do that.
So, um, I gotta get going. - Okay, I'll see you tonight?
Yeah. - Okay.
Oh, hey, thanks again for showing me your semi-precious stone collection.
It was amazing.
My God, you must be good in bed.
So you and Mona. It's been a while now. How's it going?
Uh, it's good. It's going good.
I mean, we get along great. She's so...
Hot? - Well, I was gonna say sweet, but yeah.
And she's okay with Rachel and the baby?
Well, I haven't actually told her yet. I don't wanna scare her off.
Well, you have to be honest with her...
...otherwise you may think that you're going down the same path...
...but you're really going down different ones.
I'm gonna take that book and I'm gonna beat you to death with it.
Oh, my God, you are gonna love me so much.
I felt really bad about the whole bachelorette party thing, so tonight...
...you're gonna have a bachelor party. - What?
Yeah, I got this number from this guy at work...
...and I hired a stripper to come dance for you.
Am I going in the wife hall of fame or what?
Honey, that's crazy, I don't you to get me a stripper.
Will you let the lady talk?
Come on. Come on, it'll be fun. It'll make me feel so much better.
Look, I appreciate it, but, uh, it's a little creepy, you know?
I'm not a bachelor anymore.
So don't think of it as a bachelor party.
Think of it as a two-month anniversary present.
Sure. One year is paper, but two months is lap dance.
Please, I feel so bad. Just watch the hot woman get naked.
Fine, but I'm only doing this for you. - Yeah.
And Joey.
Thank you. Now, who else do you wanna invite?
Uh, no, no, no. Just Ross and Joey is embarrassing enough.
Uh, actually, sorry, I can't even make it. I'm seeing Mona again tonight.

I'm sorry. I gotta cancel tonight, baby.

I didn't want him to start yelling at me like I was some '74 Latour.

That's me.

Oh. Wow.

So much more.
Oh, my God. Oh, my God, I am so sorry.
Ah, forget it. It's from Pier 1.
Sorry.

I ought to kill you.
You know, this is actually not a great time for me.
So come on. Explain yourself, Geller.
First you get my Rachel pregnant... - You got Rachel pregnant?
Who did? - You did!
Yes. Ahem.
Yes, yes, I did, but it was just a one-night thing. It meant nothing.
Oh? Really? That's what my daughter means to you, nothing?
No, no, sir. Um, she means a lot to me. I mean, I love Rachel.
What? - Oh, but not in that way. Heh.
I mean, I'm not in love with her.
I love her like a friend. - Oh, really? That's how you treat a friend?
You get her in trouble and then you refuse to marry her?
Hey, I offered to marry her. - What?
But I didn't want to.
Well, why not? So you could spend your time with this tramp?
Tramp?
I'm sorry. Dr. Green, Mona. Mona, Dr. Green.
I can't believe there is a naked hooker in there.

Ma'am?
Are you also a stripper?
Uh, no, but I could pretend to strip.
But that's gonna cost extra.
Okay, here's the extras: Handcuffs, spanking...

My husband. - You hired your husband a hooker?

Go to hell.

I get it. But, Mona, what relationship is not complicated?
We all have our baggage. You must too.
Why else would you still be single?
I'm so gonna leave right now.
Should I leave this open for you too?
I'm not sure yet. Why didn't you just tell me about all this?
Because what's going on with Rachel has nothing to do with how I feel about you.
Well, you still should have told me. - I know, and I was going to...
...but I thought it was better that you heard it from Rachel's father.
Look, I made a mistake...
...but it's only because I really, really like you. Really.
Okay. I guess you can close the door now.
Forgot my purse. Oh, you guys made up.
He's a good kisser, isn't he?
I'm going.
I swear I didn't know she was a hooker. I mean...
Did you let her smoke in here?
Her ass-print is still on your grandmother's quilt.
Do you really want to talk about smoking?
You know what? I'm gonna make this up to you.
I promised you a stripper...
...and you're gonna get a stripper.
Monica, wait. - What?
Carry on.
# If I had to give you up, It's only been a year #
# Now, I got my foot through the door, and I ain't going nowhere #
# It took a while to get me in, and I'm gonna take my time #
Ooh. These tennis shoes are so tight.
I think I'll take them off. - Could you not narrate?
Gotcha, sailor.
Just because you're not in love with the guy...
Oh, you told your dad the truth. - About an hour ago.
Wanna go see a movie? - Yes.
Bye, Dad.
It's unacceptable, Rachel. What the hell does love have to do with it?
There are more important things in a marriage than love.
You have to consider the baby.
You have to think about the consequences of your decisions.
Hey, I do too think about the consequences of my decisions.
Well, what gives you the right to...?
Go to hell.
Stupid guy on my phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 明晚我要跟我爸一起吃饭 你要来吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs, I'm having dinner with my dad tomorrow. Wanna come?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 他很性感
sense_groups.english: Sure, yeah, he's kind of sexy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我也会去
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, I'll be there too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得想个暗号 如果一切进行的很顺利 你可以离开
sense_groups.english: Okay, so we'll just come up with a signal. If it's going well, you can take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我要你去那里支持我
sense_groups.english: No, Phoebe, I just need you there for support.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有告诉他我怀孕了 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: I haven't told him I'm pregnant yet. - Oh. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我知道他会气炸了 我讨厌让他生气
sense_groups.english: Because I know he's gonna flip out and I hate it when he gets angry.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这好像"爸爸别说教"
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rachel. This is all so "Papa Don't Preach."

sense_groups.chinese: 不 菲比 等一下 他是个可怕的人 有次他抓到我抽烟
sense_groups.english: No, Pheeb, wait, he's a scary guy. I mean, one time he caught me smoking.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说如果他再看到我抽烟 他会逼我吃下一整盒烟
sense_groups.english: He said if he ever saw me doing that again, he would make me eat the entire pack.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会去 - 好
sense_groups.english: Wow. Well, I will be there. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我不会让那个男人逼你吃掉你的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Gosh, I'm not gonna let that man make you eat your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个家伙是谁 我想我认识他
sense_groups.english: Oh. Hey, who is that guy? I think I know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪 - 才怪
sense_groups.english: No, you don't. - No, you don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 摩妮卡 他是你单身女郎派对上的脱衣舞男
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Monica, he's the stripper from your bachelorette party.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: Her what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的秘密单身女郎派对
sense_groups.english: Your secret bachelorette party.

sense_groups.chinese: 你办了单身女郎派对 - 她用牙齿解开他的丁字裤
sense_groups.english: You had a bachelorette party? - She untied his G-string with her teeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 快阻止我
sense_groups.english: Somebody stop me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不办单身汉或单身女郎派对
sense_groups.english: I thought we weren't gonna have bachelor, bachelorette parties.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都同意那是愚蠢的传统
sense_groups.english: You know, we agreed that it's a silly tradition.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个很棒的传统
sense_groups.english: It's a grand tradition.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 她们给我一个大惊喜 我真的没有办法
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. They surprised me. There was nothing I could do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以用手解开它
sense_groups.english: Well, you could have untied it with your hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太不公平了
sense_groups.english: This is so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想帮我最好的朋友办单身汉派对…
sense_groups.english: The one thing I wanted to do was throw my best friend a bachelor party...

sense_groups.chinese: 却不能那么做 我们只能一起去吃牛排
sense_groups.english: ...but, oh, I wasn't allowed to. All we got was a stupid steak dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟女服务生一起回家
sense_groups.english: You went home with the waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那一晚真的很美妙
sense_groups.english: Ha. Yeah, that was a good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你没有告诉我
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you didn't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道在婚姻里 开放跟诚实是很重要的
sense_groups.english: You know that the two pillars of marriage are openness and honesty.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道送你那本书 有一天我一定会被报应
sense_groups.english: Ugh. I knew giving you that book was gonna come back and bite me in the ass.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮大家点了摩洛哥鸡肉
sense_groups.english: How about I order everyone the Moroccan chicken?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不吃肉
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't eat meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 它是鸡肉
sense_groups.english: It's chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不吃那个 - 我一直都搞不懂女同志
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't eat that either. - I'll never understand you lesbians.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 告诉我你有什么事 - 事实上…
sense_groups.english: So, baby, tell me, what is new with you? - Well, actually, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你的74年拉菲红酒 - 74年
sense_groups.english: Ahem. Your '74 Lafite, sir. - Seventy-four?

sense_groups.chinese: 我点的是75年的红酒 它的味道很棒 74年的酒烂透了
sense_groups.english: I ordered the '75. That's a magnificent wine. The '74 is sewage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要给我那么烂的酒
sense_groups.english: Why would you bring me sewage?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个难题吗 你是白痴吗 所以你才会来当服务生吗
sense_groups.english: Is that a hard question? Are you an idiot? Is that why you're a waiter?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是为什么我告诉经理我不想为你服务的原因
sense_groups.english: This is why I told the manager I wouldn't wait on you tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 别那么幼雅
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. Don't be such a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该注意到了 他真的很可怕
sense_groups.english: In case you didn't notice, that is a scary man.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他说的对 74年的酒真的很难喝
sense_groups.english: He's right, though. The '74 is absolute piss.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个天大的错误 菲比 我不敢告诉他
sense_groups.english: This was such a huge mistake. I can't tell him, Phoebe. I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 这样吧
sense_groups.english: Rachel... - No, it's okay. This is what's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得等上几年 然后宝宝会告诉他
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna wait a couple of years and then the baby will tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 让他可以对宝宝生气 - 那是宝宝的问题
sense_groups.english: Why? So he can get mad at the baby? - Hey, that is the baby's problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 服务生没问题吧 - 我不知道 我去了洗手间
sense_groups.english: Oh. Everything okay with the waiter? - I have no idea. I went to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你得告诉我 你有什么事
sense_groups.english: So, sweetie, you were starting to tell me what is, uh...? What is new with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有了
sense_groups.english: I got TiVo.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么是有了 - 就是怀孕的意思
sense_groups.english: What's TiVo? - It's slang for "pregnant."

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Are you really pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 对跟不对
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, yes and no.

sense_groups.chinese: 但不对是不对的答案
sense_groups.english: Except, not no.

sense_groups.chinese: 总而言之 对
sense_groups.english: So to sum it up, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子的爸爸是谁 不 拜托 别告诉就是她
sense_groups.english: Who is the father? Oh, no. Please don't tell me it's her.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是罗斯 你喜欢罗斯
sense_groups.english: No, it's Ross. It's Ross. You like Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸 我希望你能接受这件事
sense_groups.english: Oh, Daddy, I hope you're okay with all this.

sense_groups.chinese: 想一想 这是件好事 这是你第一个外孙
sense_groups.english: I mean, think about it, this is a good thing. This is your first grandchild.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要当外公了
sense_groups.english: You're gonna be a poppy.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我要当外公了
sense_groups.english: That's true. I'm a poppy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要当外公了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be a poppy.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼什么时候举行 - 谁的婚礼
sense_groups.english: So when is the wedding? - The who?

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼 你们得举行婚礼
sense_groups.english: The wedding. There's going to be a wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姑娘 你休想坐在那里告诉我
sense_groups.english: Young lady, don't you sit there and tell me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的第一个外孙会是个私生子
sense_groups.english: ...my first grandchild is gonna be a bastard.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我你们会举行婚礼
sense_groups.english: Rachel Karen Green, tell me there's gonna be a wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 二月二日
sense_groups.english: February 2nd.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天去看你上课我觉得很酷
sense_groups.english: So it was cool seeing you lecture today.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 虽然我觉得你看起来像是睡着了
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks. Although it seemed like you were falling asleep there a little.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我闭上了眼睛 要专心听你说话
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, I had my eyes closed so I could concentrate and take it all in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很多学生都会那么做
sense_groups.english: Yeah, a lot of my students do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 - 今晚见
sense_groups.english: So, um, I gotta get going. - Okay, I'll see you tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你让我参观你收集的半宝石
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, thanks again for showing me your semi-precious stone collection.

sense_groups.chinese: 它真的很棒
sense_groups.english: It was amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你的床上功夫一定很厉害
sense_groups.english: My God, you must be good in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟蒙娜交往了一阵子 情况如何
sense_groups.english: So you and Mona. It's been a while now. How's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 很不错
sense_groups.english: Uh, it's good. It's going good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们处得很好 她很…
sense_groups.english: I mean, we get along great. She's so...

sense_groups.chinese: 辣 - 我本来说很温柔 但你答对了
sense_groups.english: Hot? - Well, I was gonna say sweet, but yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她能接受宝宝的事
sense_groups.english: And she's okay with Rachel and the baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有告诉她 我不想吓跑她
sense_groups.english: Well, I haven't actually told her yet. I don't wanna scare her off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得老实说
sense_groups.english: Well, you have to be honest with her...

sense_groups.chinese: 不然的话 你以为你们的方向一样…
sense_groups.english: ...otherwise you may think that you're going down the same path...

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上你们在走不一样的路
sense_groups.english: ...but you're really going down different ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会拿那本书把你打死
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take that book and I'm gonna beat you to death with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你一定会爱死我了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you are gonna love me so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 关于单身女郎派对的事 我真的很难过…
sense_groups.english: I felt really bad about the whole bachelorette party thing, so tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以今晚 你要办单身汉派对 - 什么
sense_groups.english: ...you're gonna have a bachelor party. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在餐厅的同事给我这个电话号码
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I got this number from this guy at work...

sense_groups.chinese: 我雇了一个脱衣舞娘来跳舞给你看
sense_groups.english: ...and I hired a stripper to come dance for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以进太太名人堂了吧
sense_groups.english: Am I going in the wife hall of fame or what?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 这太疯狂了 我不要脱衣舞娘
sense_groups.english: Honey, that's crazy, I don't you to get me a stripper.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能让她说完吗
sense_groups.english: Will you let the lady talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 一定会很好玩的 它会让我觉得好过一点
sense_groups.english: Come on. Come on, it'll be fun. It'll make me feel so much better.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很感激 但它有点可怕
sense_groups.english: Look, I appreciate it, but, uh, it's a little creepy, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经不是单身汉了
sense_groups.english: I'm not a bachelor anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 别把它当成是单身汉派对
sense_groups.english: So don't think of it as a bachelor party.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它当成是结婚两个月的礼物
sense_groups.english: Think of it as a two-month anniversary present.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 结婚一年是纸婚 两个月的话可以看热舞
sense_groups.english: Sure. One year is paper, but two months is lap dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我觉得好难过 去看看那个辣妹脱光衣服吧
sense_groups.english: Please, I feel so bad. Just watch the hot woman get naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但我这么做是为了你 - 太帅了
sense_groups.english: Fine, but I'm only doing this for you. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有乔伊
sense_groups.english: And Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 你还想邀请谁
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Now, who else do you wanna invite?

sense_groups.chinese: 光罗斯跟乔伊就够丢脸了
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, no, no. Just Ross and Joey is embarrassing enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我没办法去 今晚我跟蒙娜有约
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, sorry, I can't even make it. I'm seeing Mona again tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会为了假单身汉派对取消真正的约会
sense_groups.english: I understand. Who would cancel an actual date just to go to a fake bachelor party?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我得取消今晚的约会 宝贝
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I gotta cancel tonight, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我无法参加你想像出来的婚礼
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I won't be able to make it to your imaginary wedding...

sense_groups.chinese: 那天我很忙
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm really busy that day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得参加独角兽受洗礼跟小精灵的戒酒会
sense_groups.english: I already have a unicorn baptism and a leprechaun bar mitzvah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我乱了方寸
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. I panicked. I panicked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要他对着我大叫 把我当成74年拉图红酒
sense_groups.english: I didn't want him to start yelling at me like I was some '74 Latour.

sense_groups.chinese: 是拉菲
sense_groups.english: It's Lafite.

sense_groups.chinese: 74年拉图红酒喝起来真的很不错
sense_groups.english: The '74 Latour is actually drinking quite nicely.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 他来了
sense_groups.english: All right, here he comes. I'm gonna do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉他 我得很坚强
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna tell him. I'm gonna be strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚打了电话给一个朋友 - 对
sense_groups.english: I just called a friend of mine. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想或许我可以在这么短的时间内订到广场饭店
sense_groups.english: I think I may be able to book the Plaza on short notice.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 广场饭店
sense_groups.english: The Plaza?

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸
sense_groups.english: Oh, Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸 我得跟你谈一谈 - 什么事 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Right. Daddy, I need to talk to you please. - What is it, sweetie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会举行婚礼 罗斯跟我不会结婚
sense_groups.english: There's not gonna be a wedding. Ross and I are not getting married.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 爸爸 - 我不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Daddy. - I don't believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 爸爸 请保持冷静
sense_groups.english: Daddy, stay calm, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能要我保持冷静
sense_groups.english: Stay calm? How do you expect me to stay calm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我完全无法接受 瑞秋 我要知道为什么
sense_groups.english: This is unacceptable, Rachel. And I wanna know why.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那个混蛋不愿意娶你吗
sense_groups.english: Is it because that punk Ross won't marry you?

sense_groups.chinese: 是那样吗 - 对 他说我是瑕疵品
sense_groups.english: That's it. Is that it? - Yes. He says I'm damaged goods.

sense_groups.chinese: 快结婚了 你很紧张吧
sense_groups.english: So, you, uh, nervous about getting married?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们假装这是你结婚前的单身汉派对
sense_groups.english: Look, let's pretend it's a real bachelor party, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 那样比较好玩
sense_groups.english: You know, before your wedding. It'll be more fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我不敢相信明天是我的大喜之日
sense_groups.english: All right. I can't believe tomorrow's the big day.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道你永远无法跟别的女人在一起 你有什么感觉
sense_groups.english: How's it feel knowing you're never gonna be with another woman again, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道你每天醒过来都会看到同一张脸…
sense_groups.english: Knowing you're gonna have to wake up to the same face every day...

sense_groups.chinese: 直到死神来拯救你
sense_groups.english: ...until you finally have the sweet release of death.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 这样比较好玩
sense_groups.english: You're right. This is more fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了 快点
sense_groups.english: That's her. Okay, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个幸运儿是钱德
sense_groups.english: So which one of you lucky boys is Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我
sense_groups.english: That's me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊·崔比亚尼 你的头号仰慕者
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani. Big fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是卧房吗 - 对 就在那边
sense_groups.english: So is that a bedroom? - Yeah, yeah, right over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你准备好就进来
sense_groups.english: All right. Whenever you're ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好奇怪
sense_groups.english: That was weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 她为什么要到卧房去 - 我在等着
sense_groups.english: Why would she go in the bedroom? - I'm waiting.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是… - 她是脱光衣服的妓女

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你家 这玩意从哪里来的
sense_groups.english: I love your place. Where is this guy from?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是在加尔各答买的18世纪印度工艺品
sense_groups.english: Uh, that's an 18th-century Indian artifact from Calcutta.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇

sense_groups.chinese: 原来你不只懂恐龙的事

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都没错

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God, I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 那是在一号码头商店买的
sense_groups.english: Ah, forget it. It's from Pier 1.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为你可以搞大我女儿的肚子 然后不娶她吗
sense_groups.english: You think you can knock up my daughter and then not marry her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要杀了你
sense_groups.english: I ought to kill you.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我现在真的很不方便
sense_groups.english: You know, this is actually not a great time for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 快一点 解释给我听 盖勒
sense_groups.english: So come on. Explain yourself, Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 你先让我的瑞秋怀孕 - 你让瑞秋怀孕
sense_groups.english: First you get my Rachel pregnant... - You got Rachel pregnant?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁干的 - 就是你

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yes. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 但那是一夜情 那毫无意义

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 我女儿对你来说毫无意义
sense_groups.english: Oh? Really? That's what my daughter means to you, nothing?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的 她对我来说意义重大 我在乎…我爱瑞秋
sense_groups.english: No, no, sir. Um, she means a lot to me. I mean, I love Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 但不是那样的
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, but not in that way. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有爱上她
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm not in love with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把她当成朋友 - 你就是那样对待朋友的吗
sense_groups.english: I love her like a friend. - Oh, really? That's how you treat a friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞大她的肚子又不肯娶她
sense_groups.english: You get her in trouble and then you refuse to marry her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有跟她求婚 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, I offered to marry her. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不想那么做
sense_groups.english: But I didn't want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 因为你想跟这个荡妇鬼混
sense_groups.english: Well, why not? So you could spend your time with this tramp?

sense_groups.chinese: 荡妇
sense_groups.english: Tramp?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 葛林医生 蒙娜 蒙娜 葛林医生
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Dr. Green, Mona. Mona, Dr. Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信里面有个脱光衣服的妓女
sense_groups.english: I can't believe there is a naked hooker in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她是妓女兼脱衣舞娘…
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait. Maybe she's a hooker and a stripper...

sense_groups.chinese: 但她会搞不清楚该做什么
sense_groups.english: ...but she got confused about what she's supposed to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能 技术上来说她脱光了衣服 只是我们没看到
sense_groups.english: Could be. I mean, technically, she did strip. We just missed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 小姐
sense_groups.english: Ma'am?

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是脱衣舞娘吗
sense_groups.english: Are you also a stripper?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 但我可以假装
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, but I could pretend to strip.

sense_groups.chinese: 那得另外收钱
sense_groups.english: But that's gonna cost extra.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是另外收钱的项目 手铐 鞭打…
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's the extras: Handcuffs, spanking...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 哈哈
sense_groups.english: No, no, ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许摩妮卡是在跟你开玩笑
sense_groups.english: Maybe Monica's playing a joke on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮自己老公找妓女 那真的很好笑
sense_groups.english: You know, getting her own husband a hooker. That's pretty funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很好笑 或许我生日的时候她会去杀人
sense_groups.english: That is funny. Maybe for my birthday she'll murder someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说罗斯也知情 他"刚好"很忙
sense_groups.english: I bet Ross was in on it too. I mean, he was conveniently busy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不介意我抽烟吧 - 事实上我想…
sense_groups.english: Do you mind if I smoke in here? - Oh, actually, I'd rather... Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 抽吧 反正我们会烧掉那个房间
sense_groups.english: Yeah, go ahead. We're gonna have to burn that room down anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么一直没有告诉我
sense_groups.english: How could you have kept all of this from me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我打算告诉你 但是… - 但是什么
sense_groups.english: I was going to tell you, but... - But what?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为你可以得到你要的 然后像甩了瑞秋一样甩掉她
sense_groups.english: You figured you'd get what you wanted, then you'd dump her like Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有甩掉瑞秋 我们也没有在一起
sense_groups.english: Hey, I did not dump Rachel. Nor are we still together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以…
sense_groups.english: Can I...?

sense_groups.chinese: 让答录机接吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't we just let the machine get that?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我是乔伊 这里有个妓女…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, it's Joey. There's a hooker over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想或许你知情
sense_groups.english: We thought maybe you'd know something about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No. No. No. No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要躺一下
sense_groups.english: I need to lie down.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚是单身汉派对之夜
sense_groups.english: So tonight's the night of the big bachelor party?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你给我那个女孩的电话号码
sense_groups.english: Yeah, hey, thanks for giving me that girl's number.

sense_groups.chinese: 别客气 谁要办派对
sense_groups.english: No problem. So who's the party for?

sense_groups.chinese: 我老公 - 你帮你老公雇了一个妓女
sense_groups.english: My husband. - You hired your husband a hooker?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是脱衣舞娘 - 不 她是妓女
sense_groups.english: She's a stripper. - No, she's a hooker.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们不是有时这样称呼脱衣舞娘 - 因为她们是妓女
sense_groups.english: Is that what they call strippers sometimes? - When they're hookers.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 史都 我不敢相信你会这么做
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Stu, I can't believe you did this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定她是妓女
sense_groups.english: You're absolutely sure she's a hooker?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是的话 她是我约过最棒跟最贵的女孩
sense_groups.english: Either that, or she's just the best, most expensive date I ever had.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她是故意帮你雇了个妓女 - 她为什么要那么做
sense_groups.english: Maybe she meant to get you a hooker. - Why would she do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她要你好好学一学
sense_groups.english: Maybe she wants you to learn something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在床上表现的不好吗
sense_groups.english: Is there anything you're really bad at, you know, sexually?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是最糟糕的单身汉派对
sense_groups.english: This is the worst bachelor party ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么那么久 - 再一分钟就好
sense_groups.english: What's taking you boys so long? - In a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: "一分钟" 一分钟内会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: In a minute? What's gonna happen in a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 或许你该去请她离开
sense_groups.english: All right, all right. Maybe you should just ask her to leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么是我 - 这是你的单身汉派对
sense_groups.english: Why me? - Hey, it's your bachelor party.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以应该是你去说 - 我不要 你去
sense_groups.english: Which is why you should do it. - I don't want to. You do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去 - 你去
sense_groups.english: You do it. - You do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 剪刀石头布 决定谁去请那个妓女离开

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我想念这个

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们以前没有这么做过
sense_groups.english: I don't think we've actually done this before.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想念跟你鬼混的日子
sense_groups.english: No, I miss hanging out with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还是混在一起 - 跟以前不一样了
sense_groups.english: Well, we still hang out. - Not like we used to.

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得吗 你跟我 我们以前老是黏在一起
sense_groups.english: Remember? You and me used to be inseparable.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在一切都变得不一样了
sense_groups.english: Well, now it's like things are different.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切的确不一样了 我结婚了
sense_groups.english: Well, you know, things are different. I'm married now.

sense_groups.chinese: 别误会我 我为你们感到高兴
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure. And, hey, don't get me wrong, I am so happy for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想念我们一起鬼混的日子 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: But I just miss hanging out. Just us, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I miss that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 听我说 从现在开始 我们找时间一起出去
sense_groups.english: I'll tell you what, from now on, we'll make time to hang out with each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 过来
sense_groups.english: You got it. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我差一点就要洗劫你们了
sense_groups.english: Listen, I am this close to robbing you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是妓女 她是…
sense_groups.english: She's a hooker! She's a hooker! She's a...!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我们通过电话
sense_groups.english: Hi. Uh, we spoke on the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸到过我家
sense_groups.english: So your dad dropped by.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个好人
sense_groups.english: He's a pleasant man.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 我得走了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. - I better go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要到这里来 我不想错过吵架场面
sense_groups.english: Just over here. I don't wanna miss the fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Ross, I am so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓明天我会亲自跟他把事情讲清楚
sense_groups.english: Okay, I promise I will straighten this out with him tomorrow in person.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是通过电子邮件
sense_groups.english: Or via e-mail.

sense_groups.chinese: 当时她在场 她气疯了
sense_groups.english: She was there and now she's totally freaked out.

sense_groups.english: Ugh, okay, I'll fix that too. What's her e-mail address?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓我会解决的 我发誓我会跟她说

sense_groups.english: Okay. Thank you. - Okay.

sense_groups.english: That's it? You call that a fight? Come on.

sense_groups.english: "We were on a break." "No we weren't." What happened to you two?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你答应回来
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much for coming back over.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 你在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, good. You're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很担心这会是个不愉快的经验
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and I was worried that it was going to be uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 蒙娜 听我说

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我很抱歉 我爸对你大叫
sense_groups.english: First of all, I am so sorry about my father yelling at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我听说你控制住自己的脾气
sense_groups.english: But I heard that you totally held your own.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得告诉我你是怎么做的
sense_groups.english: You're gonna have to tell me how you did that.

sense_groups.chinese: 说重点 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Focus. - Okay. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯跟我以前交往过
sense_groups.english: Okay, yes, Ross and I used to date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的确有宝宝了
sense_groups.english: And yes, we are gonna have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们绝对不可能复合
sense_groups.english: But we are definitely not getting back together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能相信你的话 - 因为我们把彼此逼疯了
sense_groups.english: How can I be sure of that? - Oh, because we drove each other crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他占有欲很强 爱吃醋
sense_groups.english: I mean, he was possessive, he was jealous.

sense_groups.chinese: 他从来不会忘了那些小事
sense_groups.english: He could never just let the little things go.

sense_groups.chinese: 试着去跟这个女人交往吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Trying to date this woman. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那都比不上他的温柔体贴…
sense_groups.english: But none of that compared to how kind and gentle...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟善良
sense_groups.english: ...and thoughtful he is.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你不该碰我
sense_groups.english: You probably shouldn't touch me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想介入这么复杂的事
sense_groups.english: You know, I just don't wanna get in the middle of something so complicated.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明白 但是蒙娜 哪段感情不复杂呢
sense_groups.english: I get it. But, Mona, what relationship is not complicated?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都有自己的包袱 你也一样
sense_groups.english: We all have our baggage. You must too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然你为什么还是单身呢
sense_groups.english: Why else would you still be single?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了
sense_groups.english: I'm so gonna leave right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该让门开着吗
sense_groups.english: Should I leave this open for you too?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还不确定 你为什么不告诉我
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure yet. Why didn't you just tell me about all this?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为那跟我对你的感觉 没有关系
sense_groups.english: Because what's going on with Rachel has nothing to do with how I feel about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是应该告诉我 - 我知道 我打算那么做…
sense_groups.english: Well, you still should have told me. - I know, and I was going to...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想最好还是让瑞秋的爸爸来告诉你
sense_groups.english: ...but I thought it was better that you heard it from Rachel's father.

sense_groups.chinese: 我犯了一个错…
sense_groups.english: Look, I made a mistake...

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是因为我真的很喜欢你 真的
sense_groups.english: ...but it's only because I really, really like you. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我想 你可以把门关上了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I guess you can close the door now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了拿皮包 你们和好了
sense_groups.english: Forgot my purse. Oh, you guys made up.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是接吻高手 对吧
sense_groups.english: He's a good kisser, isn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm going.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓我不知道她是妓女
sense_groups.english: I swear I didn't know she was a hooker. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 你让她在这里抽烟
sense_groups.english: Did you let her smoke in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你奶奶的被单上还有她的屁股印子
sense_groups.english: Her ass-print is still on your grandmother's quilt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的想谈抽烟的事
sense_groups.english: Do you really want to talk about smoking?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我要补偿你
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna make this up to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应要帮你请脱衣舞娘…
sense_groups.english: I promised you a stripper...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会做到
sense_groups.english: ...and you're gonna get a stripper.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 等一下 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Monica, wait. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 继续
sense_groups.english: Carry on.

sense_groups.chinese: # 如果我要放弃你 一年之前就会做了#
sense_groups.english: # If I had to give you up, It's only been a year #

sense_groups.english: # Now, I got my foot through the door, and I ain't going nowhere #

sense_groups.english: # It took a while to get me in, and I'm gonna take my time #

sense_groups.chinese: 这双网球鞋好紧
sense_groups.english: Ooh. These tennis shoes are so tight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想把它们脱掉 - 麻烦你别说话
sense_groups.english: I think I'll take them off. - Could you not narrate?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道了 帅哥
sense_groups.english: Gotcha, sailor.

sense_groups.chinese: 只因为你不爱这个家伙…
sense_groups.english: Just because you're not in love with the guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟你爸说实话了 - 大约是一小时前
sense_groups.english: Oh, you told your dad the truth. - About an hour ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想去看电影吗 - 好
sense_groups.english: Wanna go see a movie? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 爸爸
sense_groups.english: Bye, Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法接受爱跟这件事有什么关系
sense_groups.english: It's unacceptable, Rachel. What the hell does love have to do with it?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有比爱更重要的事
sense_groups.english: There are more important things in a marriage than love.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得考虑宝宝
sense_groups.english: You have to consider the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得想想 你做的决定会有什么后果
sense_groups.english: You have to think about the consequences of your decisions.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确会想我做的决定会有什么后果
sense_groups.english: Hey, I do too think about the consequences of my decisions.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么权利…
sense_groups.english: Well, what gives you the right to...?

sense_groups.chinese: 去死吧
sense_groups.english: Go to hell.

sense_groups.chinese: 讲电话的男人真是笨蛋
sense_groups.english: Stupid guy on my phone.

questions.name: S08E09
questions.en:
Hey, Rach, listen. Did you know that during pregnancy...
...your fingers swell up to twice their size and never go back?
Oh, my God. Let me see that.
You fall for it every time.
Hey. Look, I brought you my old maternity clothes.
Oh, Pheebs, that's so sweet. Oh, those are so cute.
And look. See how they expand as the baby grows?
And then after the baby's born, they're great for shoplifting melons.
Oh, good, you're all here. Okay, Thanksgiving tomorrow, 4:00.
Oh. And guess who I invited? Remember that guy Will Culvert from high school?
No. - He was in Ross' class.
Marching band, was kind of overweight. Well, really overweight.
I mean, I was his thin friend.
Wow, I don't remember him.
Are you sure you're not talking about your imaginary boyfriend?
No, that was Jared.
Wow. Haven't thought about him in a long time.
Anyway, um, Will's here on business...
...and he didn't have a place to go so I invited him here.
Oh, that's nice.
Oh, by the way, he's lost a bunch of weight.
