sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 火鸡是漂亮聪明的动物
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - Turkeys are beautiful, intelligent animals.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的 他们既丑又笨 也很好吃
sense_groups.english: No, they're not. They're ugly and stupid and delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是菲比 威尔还在节食
sense_groups.english: All right, it's not just Phoebe. Will's still on a diet...

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德不吃威恩节食物…
sense_groups.english: ...Chandler doesn't eat Thanksgiving food...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋对家禽类反胃
sense_groups.english: ...and Rachel's having her aversion to poultry.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: She is?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 记得吗 那天你吃鸡肉时我得走开
sense_groups.english: Yeah, remember I had to leave the other day when you had that chicken?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为那是因为我手里…
sense_groups.english: I thought that was just because I put the whole thing on my hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿着鸡要他在桌上走的关系
sense_groups.english: ...and made it walk across the table.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了三个人做一只火鸡太不划算了
sense_groups.english: It just doesn't seem worth it to make a whole turkey for three people.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很费功夫
sense_groups.english: It's a lot of work.

sense_groups.chinese: 但感恩节一定要吃火鸡啊
sense_groups.english: But you gotta have turkey on Thanksgiving.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节不吃火鸡 就像国庆日不吃苹果派
sense_groups.english: I mean, Thanksgiving with no turkey is like Fourth of July with no apple pie.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是星期五不吃两个比萨
sense_groups.english: Or Friday with no two pizzas.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果它真的对你很重要 但到时候一定会剩下很多
sense_groups.english: All right, fine, if it means that much to you, but there's gonna be a ton left over.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我发誓我会把那只火鸡吃完
sense_groups.english: No, there won't. I promise I will finish that turkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说你可以一次吃掉一整只火鸡
sense_groups.english: All right, you're telling me you can eat almost an entire turkey in one sitting?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 因为我是崔比亚尼家的人 这是我们的专长
sense_groups.english: That's right. Because I'm a Tribbiani. This is what we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是伟大的思想家或世界领袖…
sense_groups.english: We may not be great thinkers or world leaders.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们书念的不多 跑不快 但该死 我们是大胃王
sense_groups.english: We don't read a lot or run very fast, but damn it, we can eat.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 第四次长传 第三次18码
sense_groups.english: Four wide receivers. On third and 18.

sense_groups.chinese: 明年桌边会坐一个宝宝
sense_groups.english: Hey, isn't it weird to think about how next year at this time...

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉真的很奇怪吧
sense_groups.english: ...there'll be a little baby at the table?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是指瑞秋的孩子 但我很高兴你还有在听我说话
sense_groups.english: Rachel's. But good to know where you're at.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节快乐 - 你也是
sense_groups.english: Happy Thanksgiving. - You too.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我帮忙吗 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: Anything I can do to help? - Actually, there is.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常钱德会帮忙 但他看球赛看得正入迷
sense_groups.english: Chandler usually helps but he's into the game so I don't wanna bother him.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你帮忙折餐巾 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Could you help me fold these napkins? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去对面看看地瓜泥好了没
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go across the hall to check on the yams.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 不 甜心 不是那样的
sense_groups.english: Okay. - No, no, no, sweetie. No, not like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是在办农场舞会
sense_groups.english: We're not at a barn dance.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它们折成天鹅的形状 我在圣诞节时教过你 记得吗
sense_groups.english: You wanna fold them like swans. Like I showed you at Christmas, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得 一切历历如新
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it all just came screaming back to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 球赛还好看吗 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: So how's the game? - I have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我假装看球赛 那样子就不必帮忙
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm just pretending to watch the game so I don't have to help out with stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 这招太高明了
sense_groups.english: I don't believe you. That is brilliant.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡不知道 - 对
sense_groups.english: And Monica has no idea? - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 偶尔我会对着电视大叫
sense_groups.english: Every once in a while I just yell and scream stuff at the TV.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 什么 啊
sense_groups.english: Hey, what...? Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的球队赢了吗 - 安德森刚刚又得分了
sense_groups.english: Is your team winning, hon? - Oh, yeah. Anderson just scored again.

sense_groups.chinese: 根本就没有安德森这号人物
sense_groups.english: There's no Anderson.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想如法炮制 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Oh, I wanna get in on this. Hey, Mon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的没办法帮你 我不知道球赛打到哪里了
sense_groups.english: I don't think I can't help you after all. I didn't realize this game was on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢美式足球 - 通常我是不喜欢
sense_groups.english: Oh. I didn't know you liked football. - Well, normally, I don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 但今天是绿湾队在比赛
sense_groups.english: But, you know, Green Bay is playing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢绿湾队 - 那是我最喜欢的海湾
sense_groups.english: You like Green Bay? - Well, it's only like my favorite bay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 感恩节快乐 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Happy Thanksgiving. - Aw, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 威尔 我很高兴你能来 你看起来帅呆了
sense_groups.english: God, Will, I'm so glad that you came. You just... You look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定减掉了…
sense_groups.english: You must've lost like...
A hundred and fifty pounds.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会是潜水艇三明治广告的下一号人选
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I'm gonna be in one of those Subway sandwich commercials.

sense_groups.chinese: 是派 - 零脂肪 无糖 也没有奶
sense_groups.english: A pie. - Right. Uh, it's no fat, no sugar, no dairy.

sense_groups.chinese: 它不好吃 丢了它 - 我来介绍你们认识
sense_groups.english: It's no good. Throw it out. - You wanna meet some people?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我丈夫钱德 他是威尔
sense_groups.english: This is, uh, my husband, Chandler. Chandler, this is Will.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很想跟你握手 但我忙着看球赛
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. I'd shake your hand but, uh, I'm really into the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我们两个只要不站在一起 就不会伤了我的自尊
sense_groups.english: Plus, I think it'd be better for my ego if we didn't stand right next to each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是菲比 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: This is Phoebe. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 哇
sense_groups.english: Hey. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 做的好
sense_groups.english: Well done.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要帮我吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Wanna give me a hand? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我真的觉得你很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Monica, I can't get over how great you look. You look stunning.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也很帅 你的身材真棒
sense_groups.english: You look incredible too. You're just so fit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在看球赛 但我没聋
sense_groups.english: I'm watching the game but I'm not deaf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直想告诉你 罗斯也会来
sense_groups.english: Oh, um, I meant to tell you, Ross is coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我喜欢罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross is coming. Great, I love Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 瑞秋·葛林也会来
sense_groups.english: Well, good. And Rachel Green too.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 有问题吗 - 没有 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Is there a problem? - Nope. Uh, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是…
sense_groups.english: It's just, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我恨她
sense_groups.english: God, I hated her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我恨她
sense_groups.english: What? - I hated her.

sense_groups.chinese: 高中时她对我很凶
sense_groups.english: She was horrible to me in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是很久以前的事了 现在我很好
sense_groups.english: But hey, that was a long time ago. I'm in a good place.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许再见到她会很有趣
sense_groups.english: It might be actually fun to see her again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有蛋糕或饼干吗
sense_groups.english: Got any cakes or cookies or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 威尔
sense_groups.english: No, Will. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很久没大叫了 或许我们该大叫一下
sense_groups.english: You know, it's been a while since we screamed something. Maybe we should.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 不 - 加油
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. No! - Oh, come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的裁判 下地狱去吧
sense_groups.english: Damn you, ref. You burn in hell!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, what are you doing? You gotta save room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还得吃掉一整只火鸡
sense_groups.english: You've got almost an entire turkey to eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我跟你解释一下人体的运作方式
sense_groups.english: Let me explain to you how the human body works.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得先让我的胃暖暖身
sense_groups.english: I have to warm up my stomach first.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃薯片像是在做拉筋运动 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Eating chips is like stretching. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 崔比亚尼永远吃不饱
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, Tribbianis never get full.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你们在谈些什么
sense_groups.english: I actually know what you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要告诉你一件事
sense_groups.english: And I'm here to tell you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以吃个不停 但你无法填满内心的空虚
sense_groups.english: You can eat and eat and eat, but nothing will ever fill that void.

sense_groups.chinese: 这家伙到底是谁 - 他是我们的高中同学威尔 他是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Who the hell is this guy? - This is Will, from high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 威尔 - 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Will. - Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来了 天啊 你看起来棒极了 大帅哥
sense_groups.english: Hey, you came. Man, you look incredible. Hot stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 大帅哥 - 很高兴能见到你
sense_groups.english: Hot stuff? - It's good to see you, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 你是做哪一行的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you too. Man, so, what are you up to?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是期货经纪人 - 听起来很有趣
sense_groups.english: I'm a commodities broker. - Really? That sounds interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 才怪
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我现在既有钱又苗条 - 喔
sense_groups.english: But I'm rich and thin. - Oh, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从兰西·戴维斯的毕业派对之后 我就没有见过你
sense_groups.english: Man, I don't think I've seen you since, uh, Lance Davis' graduation party.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一晚真的很疯狂 - 对
sense_groups.english: That was such a fun night. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们都有被邀请就好了 但那还是很疯狂
sense_groups.english: Would've been good if we had gotten in, but still, real fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时我们逊呆了 你还记得我们多迷恐龙吗
sense_groups.english: God, we were lame back then. Do you remember how into dinosaurs we were?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 你是做哪一行的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - So, what do you do now?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要在城里待多久
sense_groups.english: So how long are you in town?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿 甜心 太好了
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey, sweetie. Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋·葛林
sense_groups.english: Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊 对了 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, that's right. Are you gonna be okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 只是… 天啊 罗斯 我恨她
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'll be fine. It's just... God, I hate her, Ross. I hate her.

sense_groups.chinese: 高中是很久以前的事了
sense_groups.english: Will, high school was a long time ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看她拿着地瓜泥站在那里的样子
sense_groups.english: Look at her standing there with those yams.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的两个死对头 瑞秋·葛林跟碳水化合物
sense_groups.english: My two greatest enemies, Rachel Green and complex carbohydrates.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那是谁
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Monica. Who is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我们的高中同学威尔 - 我不记得他了
sense_groups.english: That's Will, from high school. - Ah. I do not remember him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的越来越性感了
sense_groups.english: Wow, really got that sexy smoldering thing going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 看他盯着我瞧的样子
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Look at the way he's just staring at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 他用唇语跟我说话
sense_groups.english: I think he's trying to mouth something to me, but I can't make it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨你
sense_groups.english: I hate you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 晚餐准备好了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, dinner's ready. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很精彩 - 谁赢了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Solid effort. Solid effort. - Oh, so who won?

sense_groups.chinese: 绿湾队 - 底特律队
sense_groups.english: Green Bay. - Detroit.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 技术上来说狮队赢了
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, the Lions technically won.

sense_groups.chinese: 但在士气方面是绿湾美人鱼队赢了
sense_groups.english: But it was a moral victory for the Green Bay Mermen.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你是威尔吧 - 是的
sense_groups.english: Hi. Will, right? - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是瑞秋·葛林
sense_groups.english: Right, hi. I'm Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得你 - 真的吗 你真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, I remember you. - Really? Aren't you sweet?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你 我真的很难记得你的样子
sense_groups.english: I gotta tell you though, I'm having the hardest time placing you.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我想我记得你
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh, hang on. I think I remember you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在兰西·戴维斯的毕业派对上厮混过
sense_groups.english: Did we, um...? Did we fool around at Lance Davis' graduation party?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是不可思议 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: You are unbelievable. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你坐这边 威尔 你坐到那边去
sense_groups.english: Uh, Rachel? Why don't you sit here? And, Will, you sit way over there.

sense_groups.chinese: 就那样 即使没有人帮我 我也可以吃掉它 没问题
sense_groups.english: That's it? Even if nobody helps me, I can eat that, no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少给我一点挑战
sense_groups.english: At least give me a challenge.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是钱德的鸡肉
sense_groups.english: This is Chandler's chicken.

sense_groups.chinese: 这才是火鸡
sense_groups.english: This is the turkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有多大呢
sense_groups.english: Oh. How big is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约19磅 - 它跟我刚出生时差不多大
sense_groups.english: About 19 pounds. - It's like me when I was born.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想吃地瓜泥 威尔
sense_groups.english: All right, who would, uh, like some yams? Will?

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢那样做 对吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, you'd like that, wouldn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 拜托把鸡肉…
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, you know what? Can we please keep the chicken...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟火鸡放到另一边去
sense_groups.english: ...and the turkey and everything on the other side?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个味道真的… - 太典型了
sense_groups.english: The smell is just... Yuck. - Typical. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我说那太典型了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, what? - I said it was typical.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的典型作风 瑞秋女王
sense_groups.english: Typical of you, Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋女王在瑞秋王国想做什么就做什么
sense_groups.english: Queen Rachel, does whatever she wants in her little Rachel-land.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 这家伙是谁
sense_groups.english: Seriously, who is this guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你对我有问题吗
sense_groups.english: Um, ahem, sorry, do you have a problem with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我有吗 - 我想你有
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Do I? Do I? - I think you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在高中时对他有点凶
sense_groups.english: Apparently you were a little mean to him in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点凶 你让我活在痛苦深渊 - 我不知道 抱歉
sense_groups.english: A little mean? You made my life miserable. - I had no idea. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该抱歉的 去他的 把地瓜泥拿过来给我
sense_groups.english: Well, you should be. Screw it. Bring on the yams.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你很努力在减肥
sense_groups.english: Will, but you've worked so hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 地瓜泥 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yams! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不论在高中时我对你做了什么
sense_groups.english: Uh, Will, I just wanna say that I'm real sorry fo...

sense_groups.chinese: 我都非常抱歉
sense_groups.english: whatever I did to you in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是我 我们组了一个社团
sense_groups.english: Oh, it wasn't just me. We had a club.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们组了一个社团 - 没错
sense_groups.english: You had a club? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: "我恨瑞秋·葛林社"
sense_groups.english: The "I Hate Rachel Green Club."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们全都聚在一起恨我
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. So, what, you all just joined together to hate me?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁加入那个社团 - 我跟罗斯
sense_groups.english: Who else was in this club? - Me and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必指我 她知道罗斯是谁
sense_groups.english: No need to point. She knows who Ross is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你参加"我恨瑞秋社" - 没错
sense_groups.english: So you were in an "I Hate Rachel" club? - Yes, he was.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁参加了你们的社团
sense_groups.english: So who else was in this club?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个来自泰国的交换学生
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, there was also that exchange student from Thailand.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想他不知道那是怎么一回事
sense_groups.english: But I don't think he knew what it was.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们交往了两年 你没有告诉我
sense_groups.english: So, Ross, we went out for two years and you never told me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你参加过"我恨瑞秋社"
sense_groups.english: ...you were in an "I Hate Rachel Club."

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她交往过 我们说好的
sense_groups.english: You went out with her? We had a pact.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是永久的约定
sense_groups.english: It was in high school. It's not like it was binding forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的确说了"永远"
sense_groups.english: Then why did it have the word "eternity" in it?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你知道这件事吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, Monica, did you know about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 所以你们才会
sense_groups.english: I swear I didn't. Hey, is that why you guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 常把房门锁上吗
sense_groups.english: ...used to go up to your bedroom and lock the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 我得说我松了一口气
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Huh. A little relieved, I gotta say.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 瑞秋 我很抱歉 好吗 那时我是个愚蠢的孩子
sense_groups.english: Look, Rach, I'm sorry, okay? I was a stupid kid, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会加入社团是因为…
sense_groups.english: The only reason I joined...

sense_groups.chinese: 是一起成立 - 一起成立
sense_groups.english: Cofounded. - Cofounded.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会一起成立那个社团 因为我那时疯狂地爱着你
sense_groups.english: Cofounded the club, was that I was insanely in love with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我处理的不好
sense_groups.english: Obviously I didn't handle it very well...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你把"我恨瑞秋社"…
sense_groups.english: ...but if you think about it, the "I Hate Rachel Club"...

sense_groups.chinese: 想成"我爱瑞秋社"
sense_groups.english: ...was really the "I Love Rachel Club."

sense_groups.chinese: 但它真的是 "我恨瑞秋社"
sense_groups.english: Uh, except that it was really the "I Hate Rachel Club."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一起说我的坏话
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, what, you guys would just get together and say mean things about me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是那样 - 不
sense_groups.english: Well, we did a little more than that. - No, no. No, no. No, no. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还做了什么
sense_groups.english: What? What else did you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们散布一个谣言 - 什么谣言
sense_groups.english: We started a rumor. - What rumor?

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 威尔 挣脱束缚告诉我们
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Will. Just take off your shirt and tell us.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 那真的没什么
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Ugh, it was no big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说…那个谣言是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, we... We said that... The rumor was that, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你同时有男性跟女性的生殖器官
sense_groups.english: ...you had both male and female reproductive parts.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 没错 我们说你爸妈…
sense_groups.english: What? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 丢铜板决定
sense_groups.english: We said your parents flipped a coin...

sense_groups.chinese: 把你当成女孩养大 但你还是有小鸡鸡
sense_groups.english: ...decided to raise you as a girl, but you still had a hint of a penis.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 那是你们编的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - You started that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你也听过 - 我们学校里每个人都听过
sense_groups.english: What, you heard that? - Everyone at our school heard it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的学校里每个人都听过 你就是那个双性啦啦队员
sense_groups.english: Everybody at my school heard it. You were the hermaphrodite cheerleader?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我终于懂了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, this is all making so much sense to me now.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以亚当·卡特不想跟我约会
sense_groups.english: This is why Adam Carter wouldn't go out with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么比利只想停留在这一区
sense_groups.english: This is why Billy Tratt would just stay in this region.

sense_groups.chinese: 比利成了男同志 所以那不是我们的错
sense_groups.english: Actually, Billy Tratt is gay now, so that one's not really our fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不告诉我 - 我想或许那是真的
sense_groups.english: Monica, how come you never told me this? - I thought it might be true.

sense_groups.chinese: 我担心你会大哭 把它掏出来给我看
sense_groups.english: And I was afraid that you were gonna cry and then show it to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 别看了 那里面没有东西 那不是真的
sense_groups.english: Joey, stop staring. There's nothing there. It's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 恐怕我需要证据 - 噢…
sense_groups.english: I'm afraid I'm gonna need proof. - Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我的圣母峰
sense_groups.english: You are my Everest.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必吃完它 - 我要 不然接下来是什么
sense_groups.english: Joey, you don't have to finish that. - Oh, yes, I do. Otherwise, what's next?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我吃不完一只火鸡
sense_groups.english: Today I'm just a guy who can't finish a turkey...

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我只能吃一半的三明治…
sense_groups.english: ...but tomorrow I'm the guy who eats half a Power Bar...

sense_groups.chinese: 把刚下的东西包起来 放在冰箱 不
sense_groups.english: ...wraps up the rest and puts it in the fridge? No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去换条裤子 我在想什么 牛仔裤根本没有伸缩性
sense_groups.english: I just gotta change my pants. What was I thinking? Jeans have no give.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看史恩·麦马洪在我的纪念册上写了什么
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. Listen to what Sean McMahon wrote in my yearbook senior year.

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的瑞秋 你真是个好人" 我不是女孩 我是"人"
sense_groups.english: "Dear Rach, you're such a great person." Not girl, "person."

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你太敏感了
sense_groups.english: Rach, I think you're reading a little too much into it.

sense_groups.chinese: "你是个好人 关于你有小鸡鸡的事我很遗憾"
sense_groups.english: "Dear Rach, you're a great person. Sorry about your teeny weenie."

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我怎么做 你要我…
sense_groups.english: What do you want me to do...

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给全校的人 告诉他们那不是真的
sense_groups.english: ...call everyone in the entire school and tell them it wasn't true?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 顺便告诉他们我变瘦了
sense_groups.english: Yes. - Could you also tell them I'm skinny now?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有我
sense_groups.english: Oh. Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会打电话给任何人 那是很久以前的事了
sense_groups.english: Now, look, I'm not calling anybody, okay? It was like a million years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 你们告诉大家我是双性人
sense_groups.english: I don't care how long ago it was. You told people that I was half and half.

sense_groups.chinese: 在高中时
sense_groups.english: You know what? I just wanna point out...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有做过任何伤害你的事
sense_groups.english: ...I never did anything to hurt you in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不完全是真的
sense_groups.english: That's not totally true.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 什么
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉大家罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Well, you did start that rumor about Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟50岁大的图书馆员亚特曼太太亲亲抱抱
sense_groups.english: ...making out with Mrs. Altmann, our 50-year-old librarian.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道那个的
sense_groups.english: How did you know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是真的 - 不
sense_groups.english: It's true? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那是真的 我看到你们躲在书卡柜的后面
sense_groups.english: Yes, it is. I saw you guys going at it behind the card catalog.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚特曼太太 她在…
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Altmann? She also made out...

sense_groups.chinese: 塔塔卡奇奇回泰国前一晚 也跟他耳鬓厮磨了一下
sense_groups.english: ...with Ta-Taka-Ki-Kek the night before he went back to Thailand.

sense_groups.chinese: 高中时 你跟50岁的女人耳鬓厮磨
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, when you were in high school you made out with a 50-year-old woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看起来不像50岁了 - 她看起来像16岁吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, she didn't look 50. - Did she look 16?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上纪念册里有她的照片
sense_groups.english: Oh, there's a picture of her in the yearbook actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 她不太上相
sense_groups.english: Wow. - She didn't photograph well.

sense_groups.chinese: 或者她不知道该怎么…
sense_groups.english: She probably wasn't familiar with the process...

sense_groups.chinese: 花时间练习坐下来当油画模特儿
sense_groups.english: ...having spent most of her life sitting for oil paintings.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么发生的 她一放学就请你吃晚餐引诱你
sense_groups.english: So how did this happen? Did she lure you to an early-bird dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一天下午我在图书馆里看书看得很晚
sense_groups.english: I was working late in the library one afternoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 馆里只有我们两个
sense_groups.english: It was just the two of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 她需要人帮忙玩填字游戏
sense_groups.english: She needed some help with her word jumble.

sense_groups.chinese: 事情很自然就发生了
sense_groups.english: And one thing led to another.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你们 安妮塔非常仁慈温柔
sense_groups.english: If you must know, Anita was very gentle and tender.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望她能得到安息
sense_groups.english: May she rest in peace.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不是拄着拐杖走路吗 - 只有在天气潮湿时
sense_groups.english: Didn't she walk with a cane? - Only when it was damp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信你告诉大家这件事 大家都知道吗
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you told people about this. Everybody knew?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我要重回社团 - 耶
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm back in the club. - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要加入 - 菲比
sense_groups.english: I wanna join. - What...? Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我从来没有加入过社团 我没有念过高中
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I never got to be in a club. I didn't go to high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们三个可以躲在垃圾箱后面学法文
sense_groups.english: But three of us would meet behind a Dumpster to learn French.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你们可以继续那个愚蠢的小社团
sense_groups.english: All right, you know, fine, you guys can have your stupid little club.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你对我做的事比我对你做的事更糟糕
sense_groups.english: But I would just like to say what you did to me is way worse than what I did to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说我有小鸡鸡 - 对
sense_groups.english: You gave me a teeny weenie. - Ha, ha, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太傻了
sense_groups.english: All right, listen. You're just being silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 即使有那个谣言 你还是最受欢迎的女孩
sense_groups.english: Rachel, even with that rumor you were one of the most popular girls in school.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都希望能跟你一样
sense_groups.english: Everyone wanted to be like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个女孩太想变得跟你一样 她把棒条糖塞进裤档里
sense_groups.english: One girl wanted to be like you so much, she stuffed her pants with a Tootsie Roll.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 要不是她的谣言
sense_groups.english: And, Ross, if it weren't for Rachel's rumor...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人会知道你是谁
sense_groups.english: ...I mean, no one in high school would have even known who you were.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她让你成名 - 以老女人的情人成名
sense_groups.english: She put you on the map. - As a romancer of the elderly.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以看得出来亚特曼太太 她以前很漂亮
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mrs. Altmann was the kind of woman you could tell she used to be pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的眼睛还是会发光
sense_groups.english: The eyes did still sparkle.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是很久以前的事了 你们也经历过很多事
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, this stuff is so way in the past. You've been through so much since then.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的未来还有许多更重要的事
sense_groups.english: And right now, you got so much more important stuff going on in your lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不能忘了这件事吗
sense_groups.english: Can't you just let this go?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说的对
sense_groups.english: She's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的孩子快出生了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I mean, we are having a baby together.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让她怀孕了 - 对
sense_groups.english: You got her pregnant? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们要结婚了 - 不
sense_groups.english: Are you getting married? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你搞大她的肚子 但你不娶她
sense_groups.english: So you knocked her up but you're not gonna marry her.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟
sense_groups.english: Dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人要吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Anybody? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 它跟我想像中完全一样
sense_groups.english: It's exactly how I imagined it would be.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 火鸡在哪里
sense_groups.english: All right, where's that turkey?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的孕妇裤 - 不 这是我的感恩节裤
sense_groups.english: Joey, those are my maternity pants. - No, these are my Thanksgiving pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我吃完了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's it. I'm done.

sense_groups.chinese: 留下了肉汗
sense_groups.english: Here come the meat sweats.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我们非常以你为荣
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey, we're all very proud of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信总统随时都会打电话来
sense_groups.english: Yes, I believe we can expect a call from the president any moment now.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么可以帮忙的吗 - 不必了 但千万别压我的胃
sense_groups.english: Is there anything we can do for you? - No, just nobody press on my stomach.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 那条裤子你不用还了
sense_groups.english: You can keep those pants, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是什么 那是派吗
sense_groups.english: What...? What do you got there? What is that, pie?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你要吃一点吗 - 切一小块给我就行了
sense_groups.english: Heh. Yeah, you want some? - Just cut me a little sliver.

sense_groups.chinese: 大一点
sense_groups.english: A little bigger.

sense_groups.chinese: 再大一点
sense_groups.english: Little bigger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你害怕没派吃吗 切一大块给我
sense_groups.english: What, are you afraid you're gonna run out? Cut me a real piece.

questions.name: S08E10
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey. So, what do you think?
New haircut? Necklace? Dress? Boots? Boots!
Yes! They're a little more than I usually spend on boots. Um, or rent.
Oh, my God.
I know. - I'll miss being able to afford food.
I'm sorry. They just looked so good. The saleswoman was like
"These are too expensive for you." - She had a point.
Hey. - Hi. Oh, my God.
Oh, Monica, those boots are amazing! - They're mine!
Too bad we'll have to return them.
Return them? Shh! They're gonna hear you.
I'm not returning them.
I know they cost a lot, but I'll wear them all the time. You'll see!
Besides, I love the compliments.
Have you ever had something everyone wants?
I have you. - Nice try. I'm keeping the boots.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
That's right. I love you.
And I'm gonna play with you all the time.
How can you let him talk to your crotch like that?
He's talking to the baby. - Oh! Okay.
Okay. When he said, "I can't wait to hear your first words"...
...I thought, "There's a trick."
Okay, well I gotta go, you guys. I'll see you later.
Okay. - Bye.
Bye.
Oh, hey, Rach. Um... - Hi.
Can you do me a favor? My sister knows you work at Ralph Lauren...
Forget it! No way. I'm not sending more clothes to prison.
It is a waste. - No! Not her.
My youngest sister, Dina. She's interested in fashion.
She wants to talk to someone successful to give her some advice.
I'll talk to my supervisor. - No, no. She wants to talk to you.
Really? Oh, my God. I'm successful.
Would you meet with her? - I'd love to. Have her come by.
Great. You'll love her. She's the smartest of all the Tribbiani children.
Yeah, you know the SATs? - Yeah.
She took them.
Hey, Ross, doesn't Ben go to Smithfield School?
Yeah. Why?
Sting has a son that goes there. - I know. He's in Ben's class.
You knew and never said anything?
With all the stupid dinosaur stuff you tell us?
Fine, no more dinosaur stuff. Can I talk about fossils?
"Sting's son, 7." There's a picture.
What are you reading? "A Kidnapper's Guide to Manhattan Private Schools?"
It's New York Magazine, an article about the best schools in the city.
So how well do you know Sting? - I haven't met him.
Uh-huh. That's too bad. I wanna go to his concert Friday, but it's sold out.
I know! Why don't you meet him and get tickets?
If you get two, I'll take you.
I'm picking Ben up tomorrow. Maybe he'll be there.
There you go. Ugh, you're so lucky. You might meet Sting tomorrow.
That's why you have kids.
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Hi, Monica. Hi, boots.
See? I'm getting a lot of use out of them already.
They're very practical. You can wear them with dresses, skirts, pants...
Wear them with shorts on the corner and earn money to pay for them.
Wow, they're beautiful. - They hurt so much.
What? - The guy who made these...
...hates feet and wants to see them die.
Give them to me. I haven't felt my feet in years.
I can't. I spent so much on them, and told Chandler I'd wear them all the time.
I can't just give them away. - Then get your money back, return them.
I can't do that either.
The soles are scuffed up, and the insides are filled with my blood.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey, I, uh, just picked up Ben from school. - Oh.
I don't think you did a very thorough job.
I dropped him off at Carol's.
Anyway, I'm not gonna get those tickets.
Oh, no. Why not?
Well, it turns out Ben and Sting's son do not get along.
How come? - Apparently, Sting's son made fun...
...of the fact that Ben's moms are "les-be-nims."
Wait! If they don't get along, you should smooth things over.
Make them be friends. - You can't force kids to be friends.
Sure you can. Give them some blocks. Put them in a playpen.
Playpen? Ben's 7. - Your kid is 7?
He's really small.
Please! Please get the tickets. - I'm sorry. I just can't do it.
Yes, you can. Sting says so himself. - What?
Ross can!
Look, Pheeb, I'm sorry...
Ross can!
Phoebe?
Ross can get me the tickets!
Ross can get me the tickets!
Here she is. Future fashion superstar.
Oh, Joey, I'm hardly... - My little sister, Dina!
Right. Hi, Dina. Nice to meet you. - Hi.
Thanks for meeting me. Joey's told me so much about you.
This is exciting for her.
Well, I'll let you two fash...
...ists get down to business.
Okay. All right, Dina.
Let's talk about the different areas of fashion...
...you could get involved in.
Let's see. There's design. But you may need another degree for that.
Uh, there's sales, which is great. You get to travel.
I don't care about fashion! I'm pregnant.
And I know you are too, so you gotta help me.
And there's marketing.
What's wrong? - Oh, nothing. I'm just... I just was yawning.
Don't forget my office holiday party tonight.
We don't really have to go tonight, do we?
Sweetie, I know that you don't like my office parties.
But you can wear your new boots.
See? Every cloud has a supple leather lining.
I don't wanna wear the boots tonight. - Why not?
I'm worried your bosses might see them and think they pay you too much money.
Or your assistant will see them and want a raise.
Do you think I work at a boot-pricing company?
Anyway, I picked an outfit, and the boots don't go with it.
You said you paid all that money...
...because those boots go with skirts, dresses and pants.
Fine, if you want me to wear the boots, I'll wear the boots.
In fact, I'll go in to my room now and try the outfit on.
Okay. - Okay.
Christmas party in my boots!
I can't go in there. I can't tell him.
It'll be okay. He's been incredibly supportive of me.
And if he gets a little upset, that's what the meatball sub is for.
Thank you. - Okay.
Hey! It's my fashion girls!
What's wrong? - Why don't you sit down?
Dina has something that she wants to tell you.
Oh. What's going on? Is it Mom?
Is she sick? Is it Dad's heart? Is that a sandwich?
Joe, Mom and Dad are fine. - Is that a sandwich?
Joey, there's something that you should know. Dina?
I'm pregnant. - What?
Now. Give him the sandwich. Give him the sandwich!
Obviously, this is a mistake. You can't be pregnant.
You have to have sex to get pregnant.
Joe, I tried to wait until I was 25, like you did.
What? Dina... - Bub!
I can't believe this! You're the good one. You went to college.
Both years!

sense_groups.english: Hi, Monica. Hi, boots.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 钱德 我常常穿它们 它们真的很实用
sense_groups.english: See? I'm getting a lot of use out of them already.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们可以搭配洋装 裙子 长裤…
sense_groups.english: They're very practical. You can wear them with dresses, skirts, pants...

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以穿着它们搭配的短裤站在街角 赚点钱来付帐单
sense_groups.english: Wear them with shorts on the corner and earn money to pay for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 它们好漂亮 - 它们真的很磨脚
sense_groups.english: Wow, they're beautiful. - They hurt so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 做这双靴子的人…
sense_groups.english: What? - The guy who made these...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定很讨厌脚 想要看到它们死掉
sense_groups.english: ...hates feet and wants to see them die.

sense_groups.chinese: 把它们送给我 我的脚好几年没有感觉了
sense_groups.english: Give them to me. I haven't felt my feet in years.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我告诉钱德我会一直穿着它们
sense_groups.english: I can't. I spent so much on them, and told Chandler I'd wear them all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能把它们送人 - 你可以拿去退货换钱
sense_groups.english: I can't just give them away. - Then get your money back, return them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不能那么做
sense_groups.english: I can't do that either.

sense_groups.chinese: 脚跟的地方有磨损 内衬沾满了我的血
sense_groups.english: The soles are scuffed up, and the insides are filled with my blood.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚去学校接班 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Hey, I, uh, just picked up Ben from school. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的任务还没完成吧
sense_groups.english: I don't think you did a very thorough job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把他送回卡萝家了
sense_groups.english: I dropped him off at Carol's.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 我没有要到门票
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I'm not gonna get those tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 为什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果班跟史汀的儿子处得不好
sense_groups.english: Well, it turns out Ben and Sting's son do not get along.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会呢 - 很明显地史汀的儿子取笑…
sense_groups.english: How come? - Apparently, Sting's son made fun...

sense_groups.chinese: 班的妈妈们是女同志
sense_groups.english: ...of the fact that Ben's moms are "les-be-nims."

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 如果他们处不好 帮他们劝和
sense_groups.english: Wait! If they don't get along, you should smooth things over.

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们做好朋友 - 你不能逼孩子们做朋友
sense_groups.english: Make them be friends. - You can't force kids to be friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 给他们一些积木 让他们在游戏床里玩
sense_groups.english: Sure you can. Give them some blocks. Put them in a playpen.

sense_groups.chinese: 游戏床 班七岁了 - 你的小孩七岁了
sense_groups.english: Playpen? Ben's 7. - Your kid is 7?

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的很矮喔
sense_groups.english: He's really small.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你去要门票 - 抱歉 我办不到
sense_groups.english: Please! Please get the tickets. - I'm sorry. I just can't do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你可以 史汀他自己说的 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Yes, you can. Sting says so himself. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯可以
sense_groups.english: Ross can!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我很抱歉…
sense_groups.english: Look, Pheeb, I'm sorry...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯可以
sense_groups.english: Ross can!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯可以帮我拿到门票
sense_groups.english: Ross can get me the tickets!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯可以帮我拿到门票
sense_groups.english: Ross can get me the tickets!

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了 未来的流行界超级巨星
sense_groups.english: Here she is. Future fashion superstar.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我真的… - 我的妹妹蒂娜
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey, I'm hardly... - My little sister, Dina!

sense_groups.chinese: 蒂娜 很高兴见到你 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Right. Hi, Dina. Nice to meet you. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你答应见我 乔伊告诉我很多关于你的事
sense_groups.english: Thanks for meeting me. Joey's told me so much about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 她好兴奋喔
sense_groups.english: This is exciting for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你们两个"流行大师"
sense_groups.english: Well, I'll let you two fash...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下来好好谈正事
sense_groups.english: ...ists get down to business.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 蒂娜
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right, Dina.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来谈谈 你可以考虑的…
sense_groups.english: Let's talk about the different areas of fashion...

sense_groups.chinese: 服装界的不同领域
sense_groups.english: ...you could get involved in.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看 有设计部门 但那得需要相关文凭
sense_groups.english: Let's see. There's design. But you may need another degree for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 销售部门不错 你可以旅行
sense_groups.english: Uh, there's sales, which is great. You get to travel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎流行服装 我怀孕了
sense_groups.english: I don't care about fashion! I'm pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你也是 你得帮帮我
sense_groups.english: And I know you are too, so you gotta help me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有行销部门
sense_groups.english: And there's marketing.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 没事 我只是在打哈欠
sense_groups.english: What's wrong? - Oh, nothing. I'm just... I just was yawning.

sense_groups.chinese: 别忘了今晚我公司要办派对
sense_groups.english: Don't forget my office holiday party tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今晚不一定要去 对吧
sense_groups.english: We don't really have to go tonight, do we?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你不喜欢参加我公司的派对
sense_groups.english: Sweetie, I know that you don't like my office parties.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你可以穿你的新靴子
sense_groups.english: But you can wear your new boots.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 每件事都有它好的一面
sense_groups.english: See? Every cloud has a supple leather lining.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚我不想穿靴子 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna wear the boots tonight. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我担心你老板看到它们会觉得他们给你的薪水太高了
sense_groups.english: I'm worried your bosses might see them and think they pay you too much money.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是你的助理看到它们会要求加薪
sense_groups.english: Or your assistant will see them and want a raise.

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我是在帮靴子订价的公司上班吗
sense_groups.english: Do you think I work at a boot-pricing company?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经挑好了我要穿的衣服 靴子跟它不配
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I picked an outfit, and the boots don't go with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说过这双靴子
sense_groups.english: You said you paid all that money...

sense_groups.chinese: 可以搭配裙子 洋装跟长裤
sense_groups.english: ...because those boots go with skirts, dresses and pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你要的话 我会穿靴子
sense_groups.english: Fine, if you want me to wear the boots, I'll wear the boots.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我要到卧室去试穿我的衣服
sense_groups.english: In fact, I'll go in to my room now and try the outfit on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 穿着我的靴子参加圣诞节派对
sense_groups.english: Christmas party in my boots!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能进去 我不敢告诉他
sense_groups.english: I can't go in there. I can't tell him.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会没事的 他一直都非常支持我
sense_groups.english: It'll be okay. He's been incredibly supportive of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他大发脾气 快把肉饼潜艇三明治拿给他
sense_groups.english: And if he gets a little upset, that's what the meatball sub is for.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的流行界女王们回来了
sense_groups.english: Hey! It's my fashion girls!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 你为什么不坐下呢
sense_groups.english: What's wrong? - Why don't you sit down?

sense_groups.chinese: 蒂娜有件事想告诉你
sense_groups.english: Dina has something that she wants to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事 是妈妈吗
sense_groups.english: Oh. What's going on? Is it Mom?

sense_groups.chinese: 她生病了吗 是爸爸的心脏吗 那是三明治吗
sense_groups.english: Is she sick? Is it Dad's heart? Is that a sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 妈妈跟爸爸没事 - 那是三明治吗
sense_groups.english: Joe, Mom and Dad are fine. - Is that a sandwich?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 有件事你得知道 蒂娜
sense_groups.english: Joey, there's something that you should know. Dina?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怀孕了 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I'm pregnant. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 快给他三明治
sense_groups.english: Now. Give him the sandwich. Give him the sandwich!

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地这是个误会 你不可能怀孕
sense_groups.english: Obviously, this is a mistake. You can't be pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你得先做爱才会怀孕
sense_groups.english: You have to have sex to get pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我试着学你一样 等到25岁再尝禁果
sense_groups.english: Joe, I tried to wait until I was 25, like you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 蒂娜… - 小家伙
sense_groups.english: What? Dina... - Bub!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 你念过大学 你是个好孩子
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this! You're the good one. You went to college.

sense_groups.chinese: 还念了两年
sense_groups.english: Both years!

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁干的 - 巴比·科索 但他是个很好的人
sense_groups.english: Who did this to you? - Bobby Corso. But he's a real nice guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢他 他很好笑
sense_groups.english: I like him a lot. He's real funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你因为"好笑"而怀孕
sense_groups.english: You got pregnant for "funny"?

sense_groups.chinese: 蒂娜 如果他很好笑 你只要笑就行了
sense_groups.english: Dina, if he's funny, laugh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来 你留在这里 - 为什么 你要去哪里
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in a while. Stay here! - Why? Where are you going.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在没办法看你
sense_groups.english: I can't look at you right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里啊 班
sense_groups.english: Oh, there you are, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比阿姨 你来这里做什么
sense_groups.english: Aunt Phoebe, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我听说你跟一个同学处不好
sense_groups.english: I heard you have a problem with a boy in your class.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想来帮你们冷静下来
sense_groups.english: And so I thought I'd just come down here...

sense_groups.chinese: 好好地谈一谈 解决所有问题
sense_groups.english: ...I'd sit you both down, have a talk and make it all okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个孩子叫做史汀的儿子
sense_groups.english: Now, um, the boy's name is Sting's son.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 我恨他 他是个混蛋
sense_groups.english: Jack? I hate him. He's a jerk.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候人们外表看起来像是混蛋…
sense_groups.english: Now, Ben, sometimes people may seem like jerks on the outside...

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们有个名人爸爸
sense_groups.english: ...but they have famous fathers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了 我朋友道格在等我
sense_groups.english: I have to go. My friend Doug is waiting for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟他做朋友
sense_groups.english: Him you're friends with.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 需要我帮忙吗
sense_groups.english: Excuse me, can I help you with something?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我在找杰克的父母
sense_groups.english: Yes. Yes you can. I'm looking for Jack's parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是家长吗 - 我来找班
sense_groups.english: Are you with a student? - Uh-huh. I'm with Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是班的妈妈 - 我是班的妈妈
sense_groups.english: Are you one of Ben's mothers? - I am one of Ben's mothers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是女同志
sense_groups.english: I'm a lesbian.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸妈很难接受这种事
sense_groups.english: It was difficult coming out to my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是珍妮·布恩 我是新来的老师
sense_groups.english: Heh, well, hi. I'm Jenny Boon. I'm the new teacher here.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 我只见过你的另一半 卡萝
sense_groups.english: Oh. - I've only met your partner, Carol.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我就是苏珊
sense_groups.english: Ah! Okay, that would make me Susan.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你要找杰克父母
sense_groups.english: Right. Are you looking for Jack's parents to discuss...

sense_groups.chinese: 讨论他跟班的问题吗
sense_groups.english: ...the problems he's having with Ben? Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想父母们应该坐下来好好谈一谈
sense_groups.english: I think the parents should sit down together and converse.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们就那么办吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, let's do that!

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很不错 我们应该坐下来谈一谈
sense_groups.english: That sounds good. We should sit and talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我 我的爱人卡萝跟史汀夫妇
sense_groups.english: Just me, my lover, Carol, and the Stings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要怎么联络他们 - 联络簿上有他们的电话号码
sense_groups.english: How will I get in touch with them? - Their number's on the contact sheet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能影印一份吗 卡萝把它丢了 她弄丢了我们的联络簿
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Um, could I get a copy of that? Carol threw it out. She lost ours.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很糊涂 但天啊 她的屁股真的很好看
sense_groups.english: She's such a scatterbrain. But, man, what a hot piece of ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 那场派对还不错 - 对 我不知道还有舞会
sense_groups.english: That wasn't bad. - I didn't know there'd be dancing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个大惊喜
sense_groups.english: That was a fun surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不到计程车 或许我们该走路 - 不 我们不能走路
sense_groups.english: I don't see any, uh, cabs. We should walk. - No, we can't walk.

sense_groups.chinese: 离地铁站只有15条街远 来吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: It's, like, 15 blocks to the subway. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想我们可以从那个下水道孔直接掉到地铁站里吗
sense_groups.english: Do you think we can get to the subway if we climb through that manhole cover?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事不对劲吗 - 我走不动了 好吗
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - I can't walk, okay? Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 买这双靴子是个天大的错误 - 什么
sense_groups.english: These boots were a huge mistake. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 我不该买下它们
sense_groups.english: You were right. I never should've bought them.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们害我的脚好痛 我的脚趾快断了
sense_groups.english: They're killing me, one toe at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说的对 感觉才是最重要的
sense_groups.english: I was right. This is what it feels like to be right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么觉得很不安
sense_groups.english: It's oddly unsettling.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要怎么回家 我们来玩骑马打仗吧
sense_groups.english: How are will gonna get home? Maybe a piggyback ride?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 - 好吧 等一下
sense_groups.english: Hop on. - Okay, wait. Give me a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 我先把靴子脱掉
sense_groups.english: Let me just get my boots off first.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你很痛 但我有点心痒痒的
sense_groups.english: Honey, I know you're in pain right now, but I'm a little turned on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会不会担心走路的时候 宝宝会掉出来
sense_groups.english: Do you worry that you'll be walking and your baby will slip out?

sense_groups.chinese: 你念哪所大学的 蒂娜
sense_groups.english: What college was that, Dina?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 巴比
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Bobby?

sense_groups.chinese: 蒂娜 很高兴能见到你
sense_groups.english: Hi, Dina. Good to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你在做什么 - 我只是在做我该做的事
sense_groups.english: Joey, what are you doing? - Just what needs to be done.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的亲友们 我们齐聚一堂… - 这太疯狂了
sense_groups.english: Dearly beloved, we're gathered here... - Ugh, Joey, this is crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在跟上帝说话 别打断我
sense_groups.english: Don't interrupt me when I'm talking to God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说到哪里了 你愿意嫁这个人… - 不
sense_groups.english: Where were we? Do you take this man...? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得嫁他 - 不 我不会的
sense_groups.english: Oh, you'll take him. - No I won't!

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有权利说话 - 不 我有
sense_groups.english: Hey, you don't get a say. - Yes I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到了 已经完成一半 再来是你
sense_groups.english: Ah, I heard "I do." We're halfway there. Okay, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 乔伊 够了
sense_groups.english: All right, Joey, that is enough!

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然这个婚礼既漂亮又温馨 这是不合法的
sense_groups.english: Listen, as beautiful and moving as this ceremony is, this is not legal.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们没有结婚证书或证婚人
sense_groups.english: They don't have a marriage license, they don't have witnesses...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且新郎只穿一只鞋
sense_groups.english: ...and the groom only has on one shoe.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他把另一只鞋脱了 用它来打我
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he took the other one off and hit me with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: What am I supposed to do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该了解他们是成年人 可以自己做决定
sense_groups.english: You're supposed to realize they are adults and can make their own decisions.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他们不能 他们笨到让自己怀孕
sense_groups.english: No, they can't. They're stupid enough to get knocked up!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 预防措施不一定有效 对吧
sense_groups.english: Contraceptives are not always effective. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们没有做预防措施 - 孩子们 帮帮我吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. We kind of didn't use any. - Oh, come on, kids, a little help here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个地方真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Wow! This place is incredible!

sense_groups.chinese: 史汀的笔 他送给了菲比
sense_groups.english: Sting's pen. That he gave to Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 秘密通道
sense_groups.english: Come on, secret passageway.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是楚蒂 你一定是班的妈妈
sense_groups.english: I'm Trudie. You must be Ben's mum.

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我为什么要到这里来呢
sense_groups.english: Why else would I be here?

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐
sense_groups.english: Why don't you sit down?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道杰克跟班最近处得不太好
sense_groups.english: I gather Jack and Ben haven't been getting along.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 我相信这个故事一定有两面说法
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - I'm sure there are two sides to this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我听到的是班是个"大笨蛋"
sense_groups.english: But all I've heard is that Ben's a bit of a "poo-poo head."

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 杰克的爸爸不会来吗
sense_groups.english: Um, I'm sorry. Won't Jack's father be joining us?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 杰克的爸爸没空
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Jack's father's not available.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们可以再约 星期五晚上八点见吗
sense_groups.english: Well then could we reschedule for Friday night, perhaps at 8:00?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想那是行不通的 我丈夫要办演唱会
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, that wouldn't work. My husband's in concert.

sense_groups.chinese: 演唱会 对 那让问题变得有点棘手
sense_groups.english: Concert. Yeah. Mm. That just put us in quite a pickle.

sense_groups.chinese: 演唱会前后我都有事
sense_groups.english: Because I'm very busy before and after the concert...

sense_groups.chinese: 演唱会的时间他又很忙
sense_groups.english: ...and he's obviously busy during.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你跟我现在该来谈谈杰克跟班的事
sense_groups.english: So you and I should talk about Jack and Ben now.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非…
sense_groups.english: Unless... Unless, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我愿意到演唱会上…
sense_groups.english: Okay, I would be willing to go to the concert...

sense_groups.chinese: 想一想孩子们的事
sense_groups.english: ...um, all the while thinking about the children of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是来要票的吗 - 谢谢 四张就够了
sense_groups.english: Are you here for tickets? - Ugh, thanks. Four would be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会把演唱会门票送给这样利用自己孩子的人
sense_groups.english: I'm not giving tickets to someone who'd use their son like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 那正好 班不是我的儿子
sense_groups.english: Oh, then you're in luck. Ben's not my son.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我已经按下静声警铃
sense_groups.english: Look, I've pressed a button triggering an alarm.

sense_groups.chinese: 警察随时会到 - "警察合唱团"要来
sense_groups.english: Any minute now, the police will be here. - The Police? Here?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们要复合了
sense_groups.english: A reunion? Ooh!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 已经走了十条街 只剩五条
sense_groups.english: Okay, 10 blocks down, five to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 停 - 抱歉 你需要休息吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait! Stop! - Oh, I'm sorry. Do you need a break?

sense_groups.chinese: 是米色的靴子 你能靠近一点让我看看价钱吗
sense_groups.english: My boots in tan! Get closer so I can see the price.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在这里就看到了 它会害得你丢掉一个老公
sense_groups.english: I can see it from right here. It'll cost you one husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我可以自己走了 把我的靴子还给我
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think I can walk the rest of the way now. Just give me my boots.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有拿你的靴子 - 我也没拿 它们在哪里
sense_groups.english: I don't have your boots. - I don't either. Where are they?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不看看马鞍
sense_groups.english: Why don't you check in one of my saddlebags...

sense_groups.chinese: 我先去吃点草
sense_groups.english: ...while I chew on a bale of hay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 天啊 我们得回去找靴子
sense_groups.english: Okay. My God, we gotta go back and get them!

sense_groups.chinese: 你会再穿那双靴子吗
sense_groups.english: Are you seriously ever gonna wear the boots again?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我再也不会穿它们 我只是没机会跟它们说再见
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll never wear them again. I didn't get a chance to say goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你可以跟米色的靴子说再见
sense_groups.english: Know what? You can say goodbye to the tan ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right. Unh. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 靴子 等一下 打五折
sense_groups.english: Bye, boots. Wait! Half off!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们没结婚 不
sense_groups.english: Joey, because they're not getting married...

sense_groups.chinese: 代表那是世界末日
sense_groups.english: ...doesn't mean this is a disaster.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他们有计划 - 好吧 我们听听他们的计划
sense_groups.english: Maybe they have a plan. - Oh. Oh! Okay, let's hear their plan.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒂娜跟巴比会有什么样的未来
sense_groups.english: What's the future look like for Dina and Bobby?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛 我对我的乐团寄望很高
sense_groups.english: Well, I really have high hopes for my band.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 他是很好笑
sense_groups.english: You were right. He is funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我敢说一开始告诉大家你要当演员 大家都笑你
sense_groups.english: Wait! I bet when you told people you wanted to act, they laughed at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 巴比 跟我们谈谈你的乐团
sense_groups.english: Bobby, tell us a little about your band.

sense_groups.chinese: 团员只有我跟我朋友鲁斯特 乐团名字叫做"呆瓜"
sense_groups.english: It's just me and my pal, Rooster. The band's name is Numbnuts.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要生孩子 你应该结婚
sense_groups.english: Dina, if you're having a baby, you should be married.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使是嫁给巴比 我不是在夸奖你
sense_groups.english: Even if it is to Bobby. Dude, that's not a compliment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你不会支持我 - 你打算怎么办
sense_groups.english: I knew you wouldn't be supportive. - What are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要自己带大孩子 没有丈夫帮你
sense_groups.english: You're gonna have the baby and raise it by yourself, without a husband?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没办法当单亲妈妈 你会毁了自己的一生
sense_groups.english: You can't be a single mother alone! You're gonna ruin your life!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我毁了我的一生吗 - 不 你不一样
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. Am I ruining my life? - No, no, it's different for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很坚强
sense_groups.english: You're strong and together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是不知道自己在做什么的笨小孩
sense_groups.english: You're not some dumb kid who doesn't know what she's doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么 - 我一次只能跟一个孕妇说话
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - One pregnant woman at a time, please!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是希望你过得好
sense_groups.english: I just want you to be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 逼她嫁给巴比 她就会过的好吗
sense_groups.english: Forcing her to marry Bobby is gonna make that happen?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 "呆瓜"的音乐是什么类型的…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. So, uh, what kind of music does Numbnuts...?

sense_groups.chinese: 算了 我办不到
sense_groups.english: Ah, forget it! I can't!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很害怕
sense_groups.english: Joey, I am scared to death about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想我办得到 我只是需要帮助
sense_groups.english: But I think I can do it. I just need some help.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴比会一直陪着我 - 没错
sense_groups.english: And Bobby's gonna be here the whole time. - You bet I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 至于你刚刚问的那个问题 我们唱纯黑帮饶舌歌
sense_groups.english: To answer your earlier question, we're straight-up gangster rap.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋告诉我 你一直都很支持她
sense_groups.english: Rachel's told me how much easier you've made this on her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不能支持我 - 因为…
sense_groups.english: Why can't you do that for me? - Because!

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你是我的妹妹
sense_groups.english: Because you're my baby sister!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我哥哥
sense_groups.english: And you're my big brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我全世界最喜欢的人
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're my favorite guy in the whole world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我甚至不怕告诉妈妈跟爸爸 我害怕告诉你
sense_groups.english: I'm not even scared to tell Mom and Dad. I was scared of telling you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也会怕他们 但好吧
sense_groups.english: I'd be scared of them, but all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 想到你会因为我怀孕而生我的气 我就受不了
sense_groups.english: I can't stand the thought of having this baby with you mad at me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要他有舅舅
sense_groups.english: I want him to have his uncle.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的宝宝会有乔伊舅舅吗
sense_groups.english: Is my baby gonna have his Uncle Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 他当然会有乔伊舅舅
sense_groups.english: Of course he's gonna have his Uncle Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会没事的 即使我们没结婚 宝宝还是会得到宠爱
sense_groups.english: We'll be all right. Even if we're not married, this baby is gonna be so loved.

sense_groups.chinese: 不只是我们会爱他 - 没错
sense_groups.english: And not just by us. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的舅舅也会爱他 - 还有你
sense_groups.english: By his uncle too. - And by you.

sense_groups.chinese: 巴比 我们为什么不过来这里让他们独处一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, Bobby, come over here and let them have a little moment, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come here!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 说真的 你到底有什么问题
sense_groups.english: No, seriously, what's wrong with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会很爱我 我弄到史汀的门票了
sense_groups.english: You're gonna love me so much. I got Sting tickets!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我真的爱你 你怎么办到的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I do love you! How did you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 就说
sense_groups.english: Well, let's just say

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯可以
sense_groups.english: Ross can!

sense_groups.chinese: 座位是哪一区 - 在中间包厢
sense_groups.english: Where are the seats? - Middle balcony.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的位置 离史汀他太太…
sense_groups.english: Would you say that that's more than 50 yards away...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他的家人超过50码吗
sense_groups.english: ...from Sting, his wife, or a member of his family?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 那样就不犯法
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Then that's not breaking the law!

sense_groups.chinese: 我会去
sense_groups.english: I'm there!

questions.name: S08E11
questions.en:
Phoebe. - Yeah?
Look at that guy by the window. Wow!
He's awfully short. And I think he's talking to himself.
And to be completely honest, he's not that good in bed.
Ugh, what is wrong with me lately? It's, like, every guy I see.
Look at that guy, for example.
Normally that's not someone that I would be attracted to.
But right now, with the way I'm feeling...
...all I wanna do is rip off his sweatpants and fanny pack.
Wait a second! This is about the fourth month of your pregnancy, right?
Yeah. - This is completely normal.
Around the fourth month, your hormones go crazy.
Really? So this happened to you? - Absolutely, yeah.
And keep in mind, I was carrying triplets.
So in medical terms, I was thrice as randy.
Wow, this explains so much.
Last weekend, I went from store to store, sitting on Santas' laps.
Yeah, I remember trying to steal...
...a cardboard cutout of Evander Holyfield from a Footlocker.
Yeah, ugh.
I go see my doctor tomorrow. I'll ask her about this.
Maybe she can give me a pill or something.
Yeah, that's what you need. A good pill.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey. - Hey.
Hey. - Hi.
Look, I got our pictures developed.
Oh, great. Joey, wanna check out pictures of me and Mona ice-skating?
Oh, uh, ordinarily I would love to, but I am just swamped right now.
Where are the pictures that creepy pretzel vendor took of us together?
Oh, yeah. Probably at the end.
Oh, my God. All he took were pictures of my breasts!
I'm missing picture time?
You know, she has a face, Ross.
Okay, here's a good one of us. - Wow, that is a good one.
Wow, It looks like a holiday card...
...with the tree in the middle and the skaters and the snow. Heh.
Every year I say I'll send cards and I never do it.
Do you wanna send this one out together?
Together? Like, to people?
Yeah, "Happy Holidays, from Mona and Ross." lt'll be cute. Okay?
Heh. Uh, okay.
Oh, I gotta get to work. Call me later? - Sure.
Bye, guys. - Bye.
Bye. - Yeah.
Congratulations! You just got married!
I know. Can you believe that?
I'm sorry. What's the big deal about a holiday card?
Married couples send out cards. Families send out cards.
People who've been dating a few months do not send out cards. Is she crazy?
Hey, hey, hey. That's your wife you're talking about.
Bing! Ho, and the Bingette!
Honey, you remember my boss, Doug. - Yes. Hi.
So, good news, the divorce is final. I signed the papers this a.m.
I didn't know you were getting a divorce. I'm sorry.
Heh, sorry? Finally chewed my leg out of that bear trap.
Hey! Congratulations to you guys. - Heh. No leg-chewing for us.
Well, give it time.
So! The divorce, the marriage, we got a lot to celebrate.
How about we go out to dinner tomorrow night?
I can't think of anything we're doing.
Why can't I think of anything we're doing?
Tomorrow night it is. I should be out of court by 6.
They keep throwing sexual harassment cases at me...
...and I keep knocking them out of the park! Ha-ha-ha.
Okay, see you tomorrow.
Just so you know, we're not seeing him tomorrow.
I cannot spend another evening with that man.
Remember how he behaved at our wedding?
No. - Because he wasn't invited.
Because of the way he behaved at our engagement party.
Oh, yeah. Boy, urine cuts right through an ice sculpture, doesn't it?
Hi! - Hey.
Hey, I went by the photo shop. Take a look.
Here is a mockup of our card. What do you think?
Huh. Wow, this is great.
Now, do you think it should say, "Love, Ross and Mona"?
Well, we haven't said that to each other yet...
...but I guess it's okay to say it to other people.
How many did you want? I'm getting 100. - A hundred? Ha-ha-ha.
Well, I, uh, guess I'll take, uh...
Mona?
Uh, I don't... I'm not sure about the whole, uh, card thing.
Really? Why not?
Sending out a holiday card together?
I just don't know if we're really quite there yet.
I didn't think of it that way. You're right. You're right.
So can I ask you a question? - Yeah.
Where are we?
You know, where are we? Where is this relationship going?
I mean, I love spending time with you. I hope we're moving forward.
We should talk about that, don't you think?
Let's do the card!
What? - The card! I think we're there.
Okay, but I still think we should have this conversation.
Really? I mean, even with the card?
Hi. - Hi.
Just so you know, Dr. Long can't be here today. She was called to the hospital.
So Dr. Schiff will be seeing you.
Okay. Can I ask you a question?
Was it me, or was the guy who took my blood sample really cute? Heh.
You know who I'm talking about? Bowl haircut, hairy fingers?
Hi, Rachel. I'm Dr. Schiff. - Yes, you are.
So how's it going?
Oh, it's really good. But enough about me! Come on. Heh.
Where are you from? What do you do?
I'm a doctor. - Right. I meant...
...you know, in your spare time. Do you cook? Do you ski?
Or hang out with your wife or girlfriend?
Uh, I don't have a wife or girlfriend, but I do like to ski.
I love to ski! How amazing is this?
Are you experiencing any discomfort? - No, I'm very comfortable.
Any painful gas? - No!
Ew, Dr. Schiff! What kind of question is that?
Okay, then. Would you like to lie down on the table?
Would you like me to lie down on the table?
Sorry, is there something going on here? - Do you feel it too?
Hi. - Oh, hey. So...
...how did your doctor's appointment go? - Well, let's see.
Uh, they gave me "cute boy" doctor today.
In the middle of the exam I put my pinkie in his chin dimple.
Oh, my God! - Why did you do that?
Okay, remember that problem I was having during my fourth month of pregnancy?
Oh, yeah, the Evander Holyfield phase.
Oh, man. You were so hard up, you practically came on to me.
You wish!
Hey, I could've had you if I wanted you.
Oh, yeah? Come and get it.
Okay, even this is turning me on.
Hey. - Oh, hey.
Hey, Ross. How's it going with you and Mona?
You guys still together?
Oh, yeah, we're moving forward. You'll be getting our card.
You and Mona are doing a holiday card together?
We're not just doing a card.
She also wants to have the conversation about where the relationship is going.
Ugh, women.
I know! Why do you guys need to have this conversation, huh?
No self-respecting man would ask a woman, "So where is this going?"
Uh, Ross, you asked me that.
Hey, you were a closed book, okay? I'm not a mind reader!
Besides, I hate those conversations. I'm horrible at them, really.
Maybe I need some kind of a gesture.
Something that says we're moving forward without having to talk about it.
Like asking her to move in with you? - Wha...? Ha. Smaller than that.
Making her a mix tape? - Uh, bigger than that.
Give her a key to your apartment. - Whoa, hello. We were closer with the tape.
Have you said "I love you"? Say, "I love you."
I don't... I don't think I'm quite there yet.
But, oh, I could say, "I love spending time with you."
No, we hate that. - That is a slap in the face.
Oh, forget it. You know what? I'll just have the conversation.
I'll just say, "I like things the way they are," and hope for the best.
What do you think, Rach?
I think if it was a little colder in here...
...I could see your nipples through that sweater.
Bing, we're all set for tonight. 8:00.
Oh, uh, as it turns out, we can't do it. Monica has to work.
Oh. My ex-wife didn't work.
Unless you call turning into her mother "work."
Now, fine. Tomorrow night, then.
Oh, uh, well, tomorrow's no good for her, either.
Oh? Why not?
It's the semifinals...
...of her...
...bocce ball tournament.
Ahem. - What's going on, Bing?
Does, uh, your wife have a problem with me, or something?
Well now you're just talking crazy.
Then why can't the three of us go out together?
Because, uh, we split up.
Monica and I split up.
Hold me.
Good God, Bing.
Well, I can't say I'm altogether surprised.
I saw the way she looked at you, and there was no love there.
And the way she looked at me, pure lust.
What would help me through this tough time...
...is choking someone. Can I choke you?
Bing, my boy, we're gonna get you over this.
Here's the plan: Grab your coat, we're going to a strip club!
Oh, no, Monica would freak.
But to hell with that bitch!
Here we go.
Ah, Mona, um...
...I think it's time we had a conversation about where things are with us.
Yeah, I think I suggested that.
Heh. Uh, we are so...
So, um...
...well, I really like you.
And I love, um, you know, hanging out with you.
And I'm having a lot of fun.
Okay.
I mean, there's no point in spending time with someone if it's just fun.
It's gotta be going somewhere, right?
So where is it going?
That's the real question.
And the answer is...
...it's going somewhere...
...fun.
I know what you're thinking. Fun was fine for you 10 years ago.
But you're not getting any younger.
No, I mean, not you. Not you. You are getting younger!
You look like you're getting younger by the second. What's your secret?
I'm sorry, so, uh, where are we?
Well, to sum up
We're having fun. You look young.
Okay... - But that's not enough.
So, heh, so...
...here's a key to my apartment.
Really? - Really.
You don't think this is too fast?
You gave her a key to your apartment?
Not just a key, I gave her the only key!
I am now a homeless person in a very serious relationship.
Oh, Ross, how'd the conversation go? - Great. I live on the street.
Where?
Hey! - Hi.
Okay, Monica, Rachel, this is my friend Roger.
Hi, Roger. - Hi, Roger.
Hi. - So, um, I'm gonna get us some drinks.
Okay. - Could you help me?
Yeah, okay.
Um, he's here to have sex with you.
What? - You're welcome.
Phoebe, no!
It's okay. He's a virgin.
Rachel, um, I was talking to this guy...
...and I think he'll have sex with you. - Okay...
Yeah, okay. Let's leave these two alone.
No. I don't care what my hormones are doing.
I'm not gonna just do it with some random guy.
Fine. Then you tell Roger. He was really looking forward to this.
Ooh, Bing, look at those twin sisters dancing together.
Let me buy you a lap dance with those girls, huh?
That's all right, sir. And that's just one girl.
Bing, what's this?
It's a hand. It's a thing you use as a Jack and Coke holder.
No, it's a wedding ring. You gotta get rid of it.
We're gonna go to the East River and throw it in!
Oh, no, no, no! - Yeah, yeah!
I did, and I felt a hell of a lot better!
If you whip it right, you might hit a seagull in the head.
Okay. Oh, I'm gonna need a bunch of extra keys.
Apparently, I give them away for no reason at all.
Hey, Ross, what's going on? You changing the lock?
No, heh.
That guy is.
I don't understand.
You give me a key to your apartment and then change the lock?
Good luck, buddy.
Um, I thought we were moving forward.
And now you're sending me all these mixed signals.
What are you trying to tell me?
I'm trying to tell you...
...I made you a mix tape.
What? - I love you.
And I love spending time with you.
Hi, honey, I'm home. - From the tequila factory?
It was awful.
To get out of dinner with Doug, I told him you and I split up.
So he took me to all these strip clubs and sleazy bars.
And when I wouldn't give him my wedding ring, he threw a soda can at a bird.
Come here. I can breathe through my mouth.
Know what the worst part was?
I got to see what my life would be like without you.
It was like It's a Wonderful Life with lap dances.
Please promise me that you'll never leave me...
...that we'll grow old together, and be with each other the rest of our lives.
I promise.
Hey, speaking of together, how about we send out a holiday card this year?
Ooh, I don't know if we're there yet.
Yes, I'd like to order a pizza. Can I ask you a question?
Is the cute blond guy delivering tonight? Very "Abercrombie & Fitch."
I'll call you back. - Who was that?
Just the pizza place. - You hung up on the pizza place?
I don't hang up on your friends.
Sorry, I'm just having a rough day. - Oh. What's wrong?
Oh, you really don't wanna hear about it. - Then why did I ask?
Okay. It's just that this is really embarrassing.
But lately with this pregnancy thing...
...I'm just finding myself...
How do I put this? Um...
Erotically charged.
Is that college talk for "horny"?
Yeah. So, you know, I have all of these feelings...
...and I don't know what to do about them.
Because I can't date like a normal person.
Which is fine, I don't need a relationship.
