No, we hate that. - That is a slap in the face.
Oh, forget it. You know what? I'll just have the conversation.
I'll just say, "I like things the way they are," and hope for the best.
What do you think, Rach?
I think if it was a little colder in here...
...I could see your nipples through that sweater.
Bing, we're all set for tonight. 8:00.
Oh, uh, as it turns out, we can't do it. Monica has to work.
Oh. My ex-wife didn't work.
Unless you call turning into her mother "work."
Now, fine. Tomorrow night, then.
Oh, uh, well, tomorrow's no good for her, either.
Oh? Why not?
It's the semifinals...
...of her...
...bocce ball tournament.
Ahem. - What's going on, Bing?
Does, uh, your wife have a problem with me, or something?
Well now you're just talking crazy.
Then why can't the three of us go out together?
Because, uh, we split up.
Monica and I split up.
Hold me.
Good God, Bing.
Well, I can't say I'm altogether surprised.
I saw the way she looked at you, and there was no love there.
And the way she looked at me, pure lust.
What would help me through this tough time...
...is choking someone. Can I choke you?
Bing, my boy, we're gonna get you over this.
Here's the plan: Grab your coat, we're going to a strip club!
Oh, no, Monica would freak.
But to hell with that bitch!
Here we go.
Ah, Mona, um...
...I think it's time we had a conversation about where things are with us.
Yeah, I think I suggested that.
Heh. Uh, we are so...
So, um...
...well, I really like you.
And I love, um, you know, hanging out with you.
And I'm having a lot of fun.
Okay.
I mean, there's no point in spending time with someone if it's just fun.
It's gotta be going somewhere, right?
So where is it going?
That's the real question.
And the answer is...
...it's going somewhere...
...fun.
I know what you're thinking. Fun was fine for you 10 years ago.
But you're not getting any younger.
No, I mean, not you. Not you. You are getting younger!
You look like you're getting younger by the second. What's your secret?
I'm sorry, so, uh, where are we?
Well, to sum up
We're having fun. You look young.
Okay... - But that's not enough.
So, heh, so...
...here's a key to my apartment.
Really? - Really.
You don't think this is too fast?
You gave her a key to your apartment?
Not just a key, I gave her the only key!
I am now a homeless person in a very serious relationship.
Oh, Ross, how'd the conversation go? - Great. I live on the street.
Where?
Hey! - Hi.
Okay, Monica, Rachel, this is my friend Roger.
Hi, Roger. - Hi, Roger.
Hi. - So, um, I'm gonna get us some drinks.
Okay. - Could you help me?
Yeah, okay.
Um, he's here to have sex with you.
What? - You're welcome.
Phoebe, no!
It's okay. He's a virgin.
Rachel, um, I was talking to this guy...
...and I think he'll have sex with you. - Okay...
Yeah, okay. Let's leave these two alone.
No. I don't care what my hormones are doing.
I'm not gonna just do it with some random guy.
Fine. Then you tell Roger. He was really looking forward to this.
Ooh, Bing, look at those twin sisters dancing together.
Let me buy you a lap dance with those girls, huh?
That's all right, sir. And that's just one girl.
Bing, what's this?
It's a hand. It's a thing you use as a Jack and Coke holder.
No, it's a wedding ring. You gotta get rid of it.
We're gonna go to the East River and throw it in!
Oh, no, no, no! - Yeah, yeah!
I did, and I felt a hell of a lot better!
If you whip it right, you might hit a seagull in the head.
Okay. Oh, I'm gonna need a bunch of extra keys.
Apparently, I give them away for no reason at all.
Hey, Ross, what's going on? You changing the lock?
No, heh.
That guy is.
I don't understand.
You give me a key to your apartment and then change the lock?
Good luck, buddy.
Um, I thought we were moving forward.
And now you're sending me all these mixed signals.
What are you trying to tell me?
I'm trying to tell you...
...I made you a mix tape.
What? - I love you.
And I love spending time with you.
Hi, honey, I'm home. - From the tequila factory?
It was awful.
To get out of dinner with Doug, I told him you and I split up.
So he took me to all these strip clubs and sleazy bars.
And when I wouldn't give him my wedding ring, he threw a soda can at a bird.
Come here. I can breathe through my mouth.
Know what the worst part was?
I got to see what my life would be like without you.
It was like It's a Wonderful Life with lap dances.
Please promise me that you'll never leave me...
...that we'll grow old together, and be with each other the rest of our lives.
I promise.
Hey, speaking of together, how about we send out a holiday card this year?
Ooh, I don't know if we're there yet.
Yes, I'd like to order a pizza. Can I ask you a question?
Is the cute blond guy delivering tonight? Very "Abercrombie & Fitch."
I'll call you back. - Who was that?
Just the pizza place. - You hung up on the pizza place?
I don't hang up on your friends.
Sorry, I'm just having a rough day. - Oh. What's wrong?
Oh, you really don't wanna hear about it. - Then why did I ask?
Okay. It's just that this is really embarrassing.
But lately with this pregnancy thing...
...I'm just finding myself...
How do I put this? Um...
Erotically charged.
Is that college talk for "horny"?
Yeah. So, you know, I have all of these feelings...
...and I don't know what to do about them.
Because I can't date like a normal person.
Which is fine, I don't need a relationship.
All I really want is one great night. Just sex.
You know? No strings attached. No relationship.
Just with someone I feel comfortable with and who knows what he's doing.
For just one great night. I mean, is that really so hard...
...to find?
So how was your day?
Good. I, uh, saw a pretty big pigeon.
I gotta get up early, and it's almost 7:00.
Yeah, I gotta go to my room too.
Okay, good night. - Good night!
I can't do it! - I didn't ask you to!
You're Rachel! - You're Joey!
You're my friend! Yeah. - Right back at you.
Plus, it would be wrong, and weird and bad!
So bad! I don't know what you're talking about. I didn't ask you to do anything.
I know!
You wanna do it? - No!
Me neither, I'm just testing you! - That's the end of this conversation!
This conversation never happened. - Never happened.
Good night. - Good night!
Get back in there!
Hi. Listen, ahem, I'm sorry about that whole thing with Roger.
It really wasn't right, and I wanna make it up to you.
So, um, I brought you something...
...that I think you'll really enjoy. Okay.
Now this is just a loan, okay? I'm gonna want him back. So...
I'm gonna go now.
I'm sorry, I thought I could do it, and I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 干嘛
sense_groups.english: Phoebe. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 快看窗边那个男的 哇
sense_groups.english: Look at that guy by the window. Wow!

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的好矮 而且我想他在自言自语
sense_groups.english: He's awfully short. And I think he's talking to himself.

sense_groups.chinese: 老实说 他的床上功夫不怎么样
sense_groups.english: And to be completely honest, he's not that good in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最近是怎么了 我对我看到的每个男人心动
sense_groups.english: Ugh, what is wrong with me lately? It's, like, every guy I see.

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如说那个男的
sense_groups.english: Look at that guy, for example.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不是我喜欢的那一型
sense_groups.english: Normally that's not someone that I would be attracted to.

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在我觉得…
sense_groups.english: But right now, with the way I'm feeling...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想撕开他的运动裤跟霹雳包
sense_groups.english: ...all I wanna do is rip off his sweatpants and fanny pack.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你怀孕大概四个月了吧
sense_groups.english: Wait a second! This is about the fourth month of your pregnancy, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 这真的很正常
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - This is completely normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 怀孕四个月时 你的荷尔蒙会很混乱
sense_groups.english: Around the fourth month, your hormones go crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 你也会这样 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Really? So this happened to you? - Absolutely, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住我怀的是三胞胎
sense_groups.english: And keep in mind, I was carrying triplets.

sense_groups.chinese: 在医学上来说 我的症状要强上三倍
sense_groups.english: So in medical terms, I was thrice as randy.

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是这么一回事
sense_groups.english: Wow, this explains so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 上周末我走遍每一家店 坐在圣诞老人的膝盖上
sense_groups.english: Last weekend, I went from store to store, sitting on Santas' laps.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我记得我想要从运动鞋店偷走 …
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I remember trying to steal...

sense_groups.chinese: 艾凡德·霍利菲尔德的人形立牌
sense_groups.english: ...a cardboard cutout of Evander Holyfield from a Footlocker.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, ugh.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天我得去看医生 我会问问她的
sense_groups.english: I go see my doctor tomorrow. I'll ask her about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她可以开个药给我吃
sense_groups.english: Maybe she can give me a pill or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那正是你需要的东西 你需要吃药
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's what you need. A good pill.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把我们到洛克菲勒中心的照片洗出来了
sense_groups.english: Look, I got our pictures developed.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 乔伊 你想看我跟蒙娜去溜冰的照片吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Joey, wanna check out pictures of me and Mona ice-skating?

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我会想看 但现在我真的好忙
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, ordinarily I would love to, but I am just swamped right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个怪咸酥饼小贩帮我们合拍的照片在哪里
sense_groups.english: Where are the pictures that creepy pretzel vendor took of us together?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 或许在最后面
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Probably at the end.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他只拍了我的胸部
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. All he took were pictures of my breasts!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想看看照片
sense_groups.english: I'm missing picture time?

sense_groups.chinese: 她长得也不错耶 罗斯
sense_groups.english: You know, she has a face, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这张合照很不错 - 那张真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's a good one of us. - Wow, that is a good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来很像节日贺卡
sense_groups.english: Wow, It looks like a holiday card...

sense_groups.chinese: 中间有树还有溜冰客跟雪
sense_groups.english: ...with the tree in the middle and the skaters and the snow. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 每年我都说我会寄节日贺卡 但我从来没有那么做
sense_groups.english: Every year I say I'll send cards and I never do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我一起寄出这张卡片吗
sense_groups.english: Do you wanna send this one out together?

sense_groups.chinese: 一起寄我们的合照给大家
sense_groups.english: Together? Like, to people?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 "佳节愉快 蒙娜跟罗斯上" 那一定会很棒 好吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah, "Happy Holidays, from Mona and Ross." lt'll be cute. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Heh. Uh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去上班了 待会打电话给我 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, I gotta get to work. Call me later? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, guys. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜 你刚刚结婚了
sense_groups.english: Congratulations! You just got married!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你相信吗
sense_groups.english: I know. Can you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 一张节日贺卡有什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. What's the big deal about a holiday card?

sense_groups.chinese: 已婚夫妻跟家人才会一起寄照片
sense_groups.english: Married couples send out cards. Families send out cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会了几个月的情侣不会一起寄卡片 她疯了吗
sense_groups.english: People who've been dating a few months do not send out cards. Is she crazy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的人是你的太太
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, hey. That's your wife you're talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 宾 宾太太
sense_groups.english: Bing! Ho, and the Bingette!

sense_groups.chinese: 老婆 你记得我老板道格 - 对 嗨
sense_groups.english: Honey, you remember my boss, Doug. - Yes. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 好消息 我已经离婚了 我今天早上签了文件
sense_groups.english: So, good news, the divorce is final. I signed the papers this a.m.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你离婚了 我很遗憾
sense_groups.english: I didn't know you were getting a divorce. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 遗憾 我终于可以离开那个苦牢了
sense_groups.english: Heh, sorry? Finally chewed my leg out of that bear trap.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你们 - 我们没有离婚
sense_groups.english: Hey! Congratulations to you guys. - Heh. No leg-chewing for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 等着瞧吧
sense_groups.english: Well, give it time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要庆祝离婚跟结婚
sense_groups.english: So! The divorce, the marriage, we got a lot to celebrate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明晚何不一起吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: How about we go out to dinner tomorrow night?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想不出来我们要做什么事
sense_groups.english: I can't think of anything we're doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我想不出来我们要做什么事
sense_groups.english: Why can't I think of anything we're doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 那么就说定明晚了 我六点可以离开法庭
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow night it is. I should be out of court by 6.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一直把性骚扰案丢给我…
sense_groups.english: They keep throwing sexual harassment cases at me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直把他们打得毫无退路
sense_groups.english: ...and I keep knocking them out of the park! Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 明天见
sense_groups.english: Okay, see you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 我们明天不能跟他见面
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, we're not seeing him tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法再跟他共度一个夜晚
sense_groups.english: I cannot spend another evening with that man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得他在我们的婚礼上做了什么吗
sense_groups.english: Remember how he behaved at our wedding?

sense_groups.chinese: 不记得 - 那是因为我们没有邀请他
sense_groups.english: No. - Because he wasn't invited.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他在我们的订婚派对上为非作歹
sense_groups.english: Because of the way he behaved at our engagement party.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他小便时直接喷中了冰雕 对吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Boy, urine cuts right through an ice sculpture, doesn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去过冲印店了 你看
sense_groups.english: Hey, I went by the photo shop. Take a look.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是卡片的初稿 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: Here is a mockup of our card. What do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Huh. Wow, this is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我们该写上"爱你们的罗斯跟蒙娜"吗
sense_groups.english: Now, do you think it should say, "Love, Ross and Mona"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们还没有对彼此那么说…
sense_groups.english: Well, we haven't said that to each other yet...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我猜跟其他人那么说 应该没关系
sense_groups.english: ...but I guess it's okay to say it to other people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要多少张 我要一百张 - 一百张
sense_groups.english: How many did you want? I'm getting 100. - A hundred? Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我要…
sense_groups.english: Well, I, uh, guess I'll take, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: Mona?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定印卡片这件事对不对
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't... I'm not sure about the whole, uh, card thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 为什么
sense_groups.english: Really? Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起寄节日贺卡
sense_groups.english: Sending out a holiday card together?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我们是不是到了那个地步
sense_groups.english: I just don't know if we're really quite there yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没想到那一点 你说的对
sense_groups.english: I didn't think of it that way. You're right. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你一个问题吗 - 好啊
sense_groups.english: So can I ask you a question? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到了哪个地步
sense_groups.english: Where are we?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到了哪个地步 这段关系会有什么结局
sense_groups.english: You know, where are we? Where is this relationship going?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢跟你在一起 我只是希望我们往前走
sense_groups.english: I mean, I love spending time with you. I hope we're moving forward.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该谈一谈 你不觉得吗
sense_groups.english: We should talk about that, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起印卡片吧
sense_groups.english: Let's do the card!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 卡片 我想我们到了那个地步
sense_groups.english: What? - The card! I think we're there.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但我还是觉得我们应该谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Okay, but I still think we should have this conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 即使我们印了卡片
sense_groups.english: Really? I mean, even with the card?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 朗医生今天没办法过来
sense_groups.english: Just so you know, Dr. Long can't be here today. She was called to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 辛夫医生会帮你检查
sense_groups.english: So Dr. Schiff will be seeing you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我能问你一个问题吗
sense_groups.english: Okay. Can I ask you a question?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我有问题 还是帮我抽血的那个家伙真的很帅
sense_groups.english: Was it me, or was the guy who took my blood sample really cute? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我在说谁吗 那个马桶盖头 手指都是毛的家伙
sense_groups.english: You know who I'm talking about? Bowl haircut, hairy fingers?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 瑞秋 我是辛夫医生 - 你就是啊
sense_groups.english: Hi, Rachel. I'm Dr. Schiff. - Yes, you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况如何
sense_groups.english: So how's it going?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很不错 但别谈我了
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's really good. But enough about me! Come on. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是哪里人 你是做哪一行的
sense_groups.english: Where are you from? What do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是医生 - 对 我是指…
sense_groups.english: I'm a doctor. - Right. I meant...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有空的时候 你会煮饭或滑雪吗
sense_groups.english: ...you know, in your spare time. Do you cook? Do you ski?

sense_groups.chinese: 或你会跟太太 还是女朋友一起出去玩
sense_groups.english: Or hang out with your wife or girlfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有太太或女朋友 但我很喜欢滑雪
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't have a wife or girlfriend, but I do like to ski.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢滑雪 那真的很神奇吧
sense_groups.english: I love to ski! How amazing is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得不舒服吗 - 不 我非常舒服
sense_groups.english: Are you experiencing any discomfort? - No, I'm very comfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 放屁会不舒服吗 - 不会
sense_groups.english: Any painful gas? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 辛夫医生 那是哪门子的问题
sense_groups.english: Ew, Dr. Schiff! What kind of question is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 麻烦你躺下来
sense_groups.english: Okay, then. Would you like to lie down on the table?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我躺下吗
sense_groups.english: Would you like me to lie down on the table?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是怎么一回事 - 你也感觉到了吗
sense_groups.english: Sorry, is there something going on here? - Do you feel it too?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 那个…
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Oh, hey. So...

sense_groups.chinese: 门诊看得如何 - 让我想一想

questions.name: S08E12
questions.en:
Hey, I got you a present!
Oh, my goodness, where did you hide it?
I got it for your wedding, I ordered it weeks ago and it finally got here!
Pheebs, you didn't have to get us anything for our...
I love it! It's huge! Let's open it! Open it!
It's a Ms. Pac-Man machine! - Oh, my God!
I didn't know where to put it so I left.
We can put it in the guest bedroom. - Yeah, okay.
I kind of like it here. - Do you really like it?
Are you kidding? I practically spent my entire childhood at the arcade.
This was, like, my second favorite game. - What was your first?
I don't really remember the name of it. - Well, what did it do?
Well, you'd put a quarter in, pull some handles and win a candy bar.
A vending machine?
Hey, don't feel bad for me. I won every time!
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey! I'm so glad you guys are here.
I've been dying to tell someone what happened in the paleontology department.
Do you think he saw us, or can we still slip out?
Professor Newman, the head of the department, is retiring, so...
They made you head of the department! - No, I get to teach his advanced class!
Why didn't I get head of the department?
Oh, hey, Rach, listen, um... - Yeah.
I got a big date. Do you know a good restaurant?
Uh, Paul's Cafe. It's got great food and it's really romantic.
Ooh. Great, thanks.
And then after, you could take her to the Four Seasons for drinks.
Or go downtown and listen to some jazz.
Or dancing. Oh, take her dancing!
You sure are naming a lot of ways to postpone sex, I'll tell you.
Agh, I miss dating. Getting dressed up, going to a fancy restaurant.
I'm not gonna be able to do that for so long. And it's so much fun.
Not that sitting at home worrying about giving birth to a 16-pound baby is not fun.
Hey, you know what? Why don't I take you out?
What? You don't want to go on a date with a pregnant lady.
Yes, I do. We're gonna go out, we're gonna have a good time.
I'll take your mind off of childbirth, and C-sections...
...and giant baby heads stretching out...
Okay, I'll go with you. I'll go.
It will be fun. - All right. Okay.
No, no! Yes!
Aw, would you look at that, Monica?
I knocked off all your top scores. How sad.
Okay, I'm next.
No, don't start another game. I'm next! Phoebe?
I'm sorry, I couldn't hear you over all the winning.
Chandler! Phoebe's hogging the game. - Who cares? It's a stupid game.
Oh, you only think it's stupid because you suck at it.
I don't suck. It sucks.
You suck.
If this game is gonna cause problems between you...
...maybe I should keep it. - No, I love it. It is a great present.
In fact, why don't you go home and wait for the "Thank You" card?
Why do you want to play so badly? - Yeah, it's not like it spits out...
...a Clark Bar after every game.
Okay. Phoebe, that's it. Out of the chair. Come on. Out of the chair.
Phoebe!
Joey, could you get that?
Ugh, Joey...
What? I thought you were in your room.
No, I'm picking you up for our date. These are for you.
Oh, lilies. They're my favorite. Thank you.
And a brownie.
Well, half a brownie.
Actually, it's just a bag.
It's a long walk from the flower shop and I was starting to feel faint, so...
Oh, man, this is so great!
I actually feel like I'm going on a real date.
With a hint of morning sickness and I'm wearing underwear that goes up to about...
...there.
Hey, come on. This is a real date. Uh...
So, nice place you got here.
Foosball, huh? Pizza box.
Oh, a subscription to Playboy. My kind of woman.
Actually, that's my roommate's.
I'd like to meet him. He sounds like a standup guy.
But he's very protective of me...
...so you'd better watch yourself.
Hey, so, this roommate of yours, is he good-looking?
Oh, yeah.
Must be tough to keep your hands off him.
Yeah, but I'm pretty sure he's gay.
No! No, he's not! Why are you trying to ruin the game?
Which brings us back, of course, to Greely's Theory of Dominance.
That's it for today.
Oh, uh, does anyone know where the Freeman Building is?
Yeah, it's the new building on Avenue A.
What? That's across town.
I'm supposed to teach a seminar there in 10 minutes.
Ooh, dude, that's not gonna happen.
Move it. Move it. Move it!
Hey! I'm the teacher!
Hello.
Sorry I'm a little late. Uh...
Whoa, a lot late.
Uh, well, let me start by, uh, introducing myself.
I'm, uh, Professor Geller.
So to sum up...
...I'm Professor Geller. Good job today.
Now, the filet mignon, what comes with that?
A side of steamed vegetables.
Instead of the vegetables...
...is there any way that I could substitute the, um...
...three-pound lobster?
You know what? Bring her both.
And I'll have the same.
Wow, this is shaping up to be a pretty good date.
Oh, I almost forgot. I didn't pay you the rent.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, no roommate stuff. We're on a date.
Okay. Wow, so I get to see what Joey Tribbiani is like on a date.
Do you have any moves?
No, I'm just myself, and if they don't like me for...
I'm sorry, I couldn't even get through that.
I knew it. Come on, tell me your moves.
Uh, all right. Um...
Well...
I start by having a bottle of wine sent to my table from a fan.
Oh, my God. And that works?
It does when you combine it with, "This is embarrassing.
I just want to have a normal life."
Aw, you poor little famous man.
Oh, okay, how about this one?
I was gonna wait until the end of the night to kiss you...
...but you're just so beautiful, I don't think I can.
Oh, my God! Ha.
Wow, that was fantastic! I almost leaned in. I really almost did.
All right, so tell me one of your moves.
All right. Ahem.
So where'd you grow up?
That's your move?
Boy, Rach, you're lucky you're hot.
Come on, just answer the question. - Ugh. Queens.
And so were you close to your parents?
With my mom. Not so much my dad. - Why not?
I don't know. I guess there's just always been this distance.
I mean, we both try to pretend it's not there, but it is.
It's gotta be rough.
It is. Yeah, it's really tough. You know, sometimes I think...
Nice move!
"Where'd you grow up?" So simple. - Thank you.
Ha, ha. Now, excuse me. I'm gonna go to the restroom.
And now you're watching me walk away. - Yes, I am! Again, so simple.
Hey.
You're not gonna believe what I did today.
Clearly wasn't showering or shaving.
I got good. I played this game all day, and now I rule at it.
They should change the name of it to "Ms. Chandler."
Although, I hope they don't.
You stayed home all day and played Ms. Pac-Man...
...while I went off to work like some chump?
Uh-huh. I got the top ten scores. I erased Phoebe off the board. High-five!
What is the matter with your hand?
I been playing for eight hours.
It'll loosen up. Come on, check out the scores.
And also, look at the initials. They're dirty words.
Chandler, why would you do that? - Because it's awesome.
You think this is clever?
They only give you three letters, so after A-S-S, it is a challenge.
This one's not dirty. - It is when you put it together with that one.
If you don't clear this off, you won't get one of those from me.
Ben's coming over here tomorrow. This can't be there.
He won't know what they mean. - He's 7, not stupid.
Have you talked to him lately? - Look, I'm gonna unplug it.
No, no! I'll have nothing to show for my day.
It'll be like I was at work.
No!
Hey, look! It's still there!
This thing must have some kind of primitive ROM chip in it or something!
You gotta beat your scores. - With the claw?
Fine, I'll do it. We gotta get this off the screen.
Carol's still upset that you taught him "Pull my finger."
Pull my finger. My hand is messed up!
I am not gonna answer that. - Oh, come on. Just pick one.
Between Monica, Phoebe, Chandler and Ross...
...if you had to... If you had to, who would you punch?
No one. They're my friends. I wouldn't punch any of them.
Chandler?
Yeah, but I don't know why.
I'm having a wonderful time! - Me too.
Hey, Rach, can I just say...
...I think this is the best date I ever had. - I know!
I've never laughed so hard. Did you see the wine come out my nose?
Yes. Joey, I think everybody saw the wine come out of your nose.
I gotta say, I never knew I could enjoy the non-sex part of a date so much.
That's because you have never been on a date with me before.
All right. Now don't judge me.
I normally wait till my date leaves, but you live here.
I'm ripping into the swan.
Okay, well then, you don't judge me.
I'm gonna suck on the cellophane from the brownie I had before.
So tell me, what are Joey Tribbiani's end-of-the-night moves?
Uh, well, if I want the girl to kiss me...
...first thing I do is make my lips look irresistible.
How do you do it?
Now you can't tell anyone, but, uh...
...I put on shiny lip balm.
Oh, my God. - Like a moth to a flame, I'm telling you.
Okay, all right, so now you go. - No, I don't want to tell you.
Why not? - It's embarrassing.
More embarrassing than shiny raspberry lip balm?
I didn't say raspberry before, did I?
Just tell me, Rach. Just tell me.
Okay. All right, stand up.
Well, when we're at the door...
...I lightly press my lips against his.
Then move into his body, just for a second.
And then I make this sound
I know it doesn't sound like anything, but it works.
Oh, yeah. That would work, yeah.
All right, I gotta go to bed. I had such a wonderful time.
Oh, yeah.
Me too.
You were 50 minutes late to the class? Did you crawl there?
No, I ran, okay? It's really far.
When did people stop understanding "Get the hell out of my way"?
Why didn't you take a cab?
Ugh. Between the traffic and one-way streets, it'd take me twice as long.
Besides, I teach the class three times a week. Who am I, Rockefeller?
You're not gonna be able to keep doing this.
I have to. If I don't, they'll take the class away from me.
And I already put it in my family newsletter.
Your what? - You've seen it, The Geller Yeller.
Right. Wow.
Besides, I figured out a faster route. I'm sure I can make it this time.
I just can't be afraid to get a little bit hit by cars.
Hey. - Hi!
Hey, remember, um, last night when we were talking about Cujo?
Oh, yeah, I can't believe you haven't seen Cujo. What is wrong with you?
Relax, it's not like it's Citizen Kane.
Have you ever tried to sit through Citizen Kane?
Yeah, I know. It's really boring.
But it's a big deal. - Yeah.
Anyway, I was thinking about renting Cujo sometime.
Well, yeah, all right. Let's do it tonight.
Don't you have that big date tonight? - Oh, right.
Hey, Joey, can I ask you something? - Yeah.
After our date last night, did you feel a little weird?
Oh, my God. You did too? It freaked me out. What was that?
I don't know.
I'm kind of thinking it was the lobster.
Oh, yeah. Yeah, the lobster.
I was up sick all night. - Yeah, me too. All night.
Really? How come we didn't cross paths?
Yeah, well, that's because, uh...
...I stayed in my room.
Yeah, you don't want to look in my hamper.
Okay, I got that.
I'll escape there. I'll come back here.
All right. Come on, Ms. Pac-Man...
Well, you're just a little bitch, aren't you?
Hey, you guys?
I'm sorry that I was hogging the game before.
Oh, my God, your friends have some unfortunate initials.
They're all Chandler. - Chandler sucks.
He couldn't have gotten this good. - I did.
But it came at a price.
Ben's coming, and he can't see this.
Come on, by age 7, kids have already seen orgies.
Was it just me?
Yes, I made it! I'm on time!
Okay, why don't we all, uh...
...open our books to page 23...
...where...
...where you will see a, uh...
...a bunch of, uh, red spots.
Okay, why don't, uh, you all start to read, while I...
Hey, are you all right? You seem a little distracted.
No, no, I'm fine. It's just...
Hey, can I ask you something?
Have you ever looked at someone that you've known for a while...
...and suddenly seen them in a different way?
You mean like from behind?
Yeah. Yeah. That's exactly it.
You know what?
One time I saw this guy from behind, and he seemed totally normal.
And then he turned around and it was Stephen Baldwin!
Ooh, yeah. So you know exactly what I'm talking about.
Totally! Wow.
Would you excuse me for a sec? - Yeah, sure.
God, Phoebe! You're on fire! - I know!
You can do it! - Don't touch me!
Don't touch her!
All right, go left! Go right! Go right!
I can't! I can't!
No! You son of a...
Phoebe!
Oh, hi, Ben. No, don't look at the machine!
Aah! God! Thank God you're home.
I'm watching Cujo. - Alone?
Yes! What is wrong with this dog? - Did you get to the part...
...where they're in the car and Cujo's throwing himself at the windshield?
No. No! Seriously, what's wrong with the dog?
What are you doing home? What happened to your date?
Oh, uh, it didn't work out.
Want to watch the rest of the movie with me?
Oh, uh, okay. Yeah.
I never thought I'd say this about a movie...
...but I hope this dog dies.
What are you doing over there? Come sit here. Protect me.
Oh. Sure, yeah. Why not?
Okay.
That's him, that's him! That's Cujo! - All right, I know.
It's gonna be okay.
Oh, my God. What's he gonna do now? I can't watch.
Ugh, seriously, how can you watch this? Aren't you scared?
Terrified.
So is everybody here? I got here a little early, myself.
Let us begin.
Now, the hadrosaurids have been unearthed in two main locations.
Here...
...and here.
Now, as for the hadrosaurus...

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Great, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后带她到四季饭店喝东西
sense_groups.english: And then after, you could take her to the Four Seasons for drinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是到城里听爵士乐
sense_groups.english: Or go downtown and listen to some jazz.

sense_groups.chinese: 或跳舞 带她去跳舞
sense_groups.english: Or dancing. Oh, take her dancing!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很会拖延性爱游戏
sense_groups.english: You sure are naming a lot of ways to postpone sex, I'll tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想念约会的感觉 盛装打扮去好餐厅吃饭
sense_groups.english: Agh, I miss dating. Getting dressed up, going to a fancy restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很久都无法再那么做了 那真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna be able to do that for so long. And it's so much fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说坐在这里 担心生产的事不好玩
sense_groups.english: Not that sitting at home worrying about giving birth to a 16-pound baby is not fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 我们为什么不去约会
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what? Why don't I take you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你才不想跟孕妇约会
sense_groups.english: What? You don't want to go on a date with a pregnant lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们会玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: Yes, I do. We're gonna go out, we're gonna have a good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会让你忘了生孩子 剖腹生产…
sense_groups.english: I'll take your mind off of childbirth, and C-sections...

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝的头扩大了…
sense_groups.english: ...and giant baby heads stretching out...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我答应你
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll go with you. I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 那会很好玩的 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: It will be fun. - All right. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 太棒了
sense_groups.english: No, no! Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 快来看
sense_groups.english: Aw, would you look at that, Monica?

sense_groups.chinese: 我打败了你的最佳成绩 太惨了
sense_groups.english: I knocked off all your top scores. How sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 轮到我了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm next.

sense_groups.chinese: 别再开始 轮到我了 菲比
sense_groups.english: No, don't start another game. I'm next! Phoebe?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我赢得太开心 听不到你说话
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I couldn't hear you over all the winning.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比在霸占游戏 - 谁在乎啊 那是个愚蠢的游戏
sense_groups.english: Chandler! Phoebe's hogging the game. - Who cares? It's a stupid game.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得它蠢 因为你很逊
sense_groups.english: Oh, you only think it's stupid because you suck at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不逊 它才逊
sense_groups.english: I don't suck. It sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很逊
sense_groups.english: You suck.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这游戏会引起你们的困扰
sense_groups.english: If this game is gonna cause problems between you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该留下它 - 不 我喜欢它 它是很棒的礼物
sense_groups.english: ...maybe I should keep it. - No, I love it. It is a great present.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不回家等贺卡呢
sense_groups.english: In fact, why don't you go home and wait for the "Thank You" card?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要玩这个游戏 - 对啊 玩完之后又不会…
sense_groups.english: Why do you want to play so badly? - Yeah, it's not like it spits out...

sense_groups.chinese: 吐出糖果
sense_groups.english: ...a Clark Bar after every game.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 菲比 够了 快下来
sense_groups.english: Okay. Phoebe, that's it. Out of the chair. Come on. Out of the chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 麻烦你去开门
sense_groups.english: Joey, could you get that?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Ugh, Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 你这是干嘛 我以为你在房里
sense_groups.english: What? I thought you were in your room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来接你的 这是送你的
sense_groups.english: No, I'm picking you up for our date. These are for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 百合花 它们是我最喜欢的花 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, lilies. They're my favorite. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有布朗尼
sense_groups.english: And a brownie.

sense_groups.chinese: 只有一半
sense_groups.english: Well, half a brownie.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上它只剩袋子
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's just a bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 从花店走回来真的很远 我觉得头晕 所以…
sense_groups.english: It's a long walk from the flower shop and I was starting to feel faint, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, this is so great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得好像真的在约会
sense_groups.english: I actually feel like I'm going on a real date.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我会害喜 我穿的内裤裤头高到…
sense_groups.english: With a hint of morning sickness and I'm wearing underwear that goes up to about...

sense_groups.chinese: 这里
sense_groups.english: ...there.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 这是真的约会
sense_groups.english: Hey, come on. This is a real date. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你家好漂亮
sense_groups.english: So, nice place you got here.

sense_groups.chinese: 桌上足球 比萨盒
sense_groups.english: Foosball, huh? Pizza box.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有"花花公子"杂志 你是我喜欢的那种女人
sense_groups.english: Oh, a subscription to Playboy. My kind of woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我室友的杂志
sense_groups.english: Actually, that's my roommate's.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想见见他 他似乎是个好男人
sense_groups.english: I'd like to meet him. He sounds like a standup guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他很保护我
sense_groups.english: But he's very protective of me...

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好小心一点
sense_groups.english: ...so you'd better watch yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你室友很帅吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, so, this roommate of yours, is he good-looking?

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定很努力控制自己不爱上他
sense_groups.english: Must be tough to keep your hands off him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信他是男同志
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I'm pretty sure he's gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的 你为什么要毁了这个游戏
sense_groups.english: No! No, he's not! Why are you trying to ruin the game?

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我想起葛瑞利的骨牌理论
sense_groups.english: Which brings us back, of course, to Greely's Theory of Dominance.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天到此为止
sense_groups.english: That's it for today.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人知道费利曼楼在哪里吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, does anyone know where the Freeman Building is?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是A大道的新大楼
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's the new building on Avenue A.

sense_groups.chinese: 它在城里的另一边
sense_groups.english: What? That's across town.

sense_groups.chinese: 我10分钟内得赶到那里上课
sense_groups.english: I'm supposed to teach a seminar there in 10 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: Ooh, dude, that's not gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 快闪开
sense_groups.english: Move it. Move it. Move it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是老师
sense_groups.english: Hey! I'm the teacher!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我迟到了
sense_groups.english: Sorry I'm a little late. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我严重迟到
sense_groups.english: Whoa, a lot late.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从自我介绍开始吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, let me start by, uh, introducing myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是盖勒教授
sense_groups.english: I'm, uh, Professor Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 总而言之…
sense_groups.english: So to sum up...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是盖勒教授 今天大家做得很好
sense_groups.english: ...I'm Professor Geller. Good job today.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲力牛排搭配什么
sense_groups.english: Now, the filet mignon, what comes with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 蒸蔬菜
sense_groups.english: A side of steamed vegetables.

sense_groups.chinese: 除了蔬菜…
sense_groups.english: Instead of the vegetables...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以用什么东西搭配…
sense_groups.english: ...is there any way that I could substitute the, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 三磅的龙虾
sense_groups.english: ...three-pound lobster?

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 帮她把两道菜都送上来
sense_groups.english: You know what? Bring her both.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要点跟她一样的东西
sense_groups.english: And I'll have the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是个很棒的约会
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is shaping up to be a pretty good date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我差点忘了 我没给你房租
sense_groups.english: Oh, I almost forgot. I didn't pay you the rent.

sense_groups.chinese: 别当我们是室友 我们在约会
sense_groups.english: Whoa, whoa, whoa, no roommate stuff. We're on a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想知道乔伊·崔比亚尼怎么跟女人约会
sense_groups.english: Okay. Wow, so I get to see what Joey Tribbiani is like on a date.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有什么招数
sense_groups.english: Do you have any moves?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我只会做我自己 如果她们不喜欢我…
sense_groups.english: No, I'm just myself, and if they don't like me for...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我无法想像那种事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I couldn't even get through that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道 告诉我你有什么招数
sense_groups.english: I knew it. Come on, tell me your moves.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Uh, all right. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会假装有影迷送一瓶红酒给我们
sense_groups.english: I start by having a bottle of wine sent to my table from a fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 有用吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. And that works?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得加上"这真是太不好意思了
sense_groups.english: It does when you combine it with, "This is embarrassing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想过正常人的生活"
sense_groups.english: I just want to have a normal life."

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这些可怜的名人
sense_groups.english: Aw, you poor little famous man.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这个呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, how about this one?

sense_groups.chinese: 我本来想等到送你回家再吻你…
sense_groups.english: I was gonna wait until the end of the night to kiss you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你真的太美了 我想我做不到
sense_groups.english: ...but you're just so beautiful, I don't think I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了 我差点就被你骗了
sense_groups.english: Wow, that was fantastic! I almost leaned in. I really almost did.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我你用的是什么招数
sense_groups.english: All right, so tell me one of your moves.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在哪里长大的
sense_groups.english: So where'd you grow up?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是你的招数
sense_groups.english: That's your move?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 还好你长得很美
sense_groups.english: Boy, Rach, you're lucky you're hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 快回答我的问题 - 皇后区
sense_groups.english: Come on, just answer the question. - Ugh. Queens.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟父母亲近吗
sense_groups.english: And so were you close to your parents?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟妈妈亲 跟爸爸不太说话 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: With my mom. Not so much my dad. - Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我们之间有距离
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I guess there's just always been this distance.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都假装没有 但事实上不然
sense_groups.english: I mean, we both try to pretend it's not there, but it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一定很辛苦
sense_groups.english: It's gotta be rough.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那真的很辛苦 有时候我认为…
sense_groups.english: It is. Yeah, it's really tough. You know, sometimes I think...

sense_groups.chinese: 太帅了
sense_groups.english: Nice move!

sense_groups.chinese: "你在哪里长大的 " 太简单了 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: "Where'd you grow up?" So simple. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我要去洗手间
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha. Now, excuse me. I'm gonna go to the restroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你正看着我走开 - 没错 太简单了
sense_groups.english: And now you're watching me walk away. - Yes, I am! Again, so simple.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定不相信今天我做了什么
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna believe what I did today.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地你没洗澡或刮胡子
sense_groups.english: Clearly wasn't showering or shaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 我变厉害了 我玩了一整天 现在我是第一名
sense_groups.english: I got good. I played this game all day, and now I rule at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们应该把它改名为 "钱德小姐"
sense_groups.english: They should change the name of it to "Ms. Chandler."

sense_groups.chinese: 还是不要好了
sense_groups.english: Although, I hope they don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你待在家里玩小精灵
sense_groups.english: You stayed home all day and played Ms. Pac-Man...

sense_groups.chinese: 我出门像牛一样在工作
sense_groups.english: ...while I went off to work like some chump?

sense_groups.chinese: 我包办了前10名 把菲比给挤掉了 庆祝一下吧
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. I got the top ten scores. I erased Phoebe off the board. High-five!

sense_groups.chinese: 你的手是怎么了
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with your hand?

sense_groups.chinese: 我打了八小时的电动
sense_groups.english: I been playing for eight hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会放松的 看看我的记录
sense_groups.english: It'll loosen up. Come on, check out the scores.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看我编的名字 它们全是脏话
sense_groups.english: And also, look at the initials. They're dirty words.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你为什么要那么做 - 因为它很棒
sense_groups.english: Chandler, why would you do that? - Because it's awesome.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得那么做很聪明
sense_groups.english: You think this is clever?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能写下三个字母 除了屁股外 其他的可是个大挑战
sense_groups.english: They only give you three letters, so after A-S-S, it is a challenge.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是脏话 - 把它跟那个连在一起
sense_groups.english: This one's not dirty. - It is when you put it together with that one.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你没办法把它清掉 我不会答应你的
sense_groups.english: If you don't clear this off, you won't get one of those from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班明天会过来 不能让他看到这个
sense_groups.english: Ben's coming over here tomorrow. This can't be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不知道它们的意思 - 他七岁了 他不笨
sense_groups.english: He won't know what they mean. - He's 7, not stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 最近你跟他谈过吗 - 我要把插头拔掉
sense_groups.english: Have you talked to him lately? - Look, I'm gonna unplug it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法证明我今天做了什么
sense_groups.english: No, no! I'll have nothing to show for my day.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟我的工作一样
sense_groups.english: It'll be like I was at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 画面还在
sense_groups.english: Hey, look! It's still there!

sense_groups.chinese: 这玩意一定是用原始的记忆晶片
sense_groups.english: This thing must have some kind of primitive ROM chip in it or something!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得打败自己的成绩 - 我的手指都张不开了
sense_groups.english: You gotta beat your scores. - With the claw?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 让我来 我们得把这个消掉
sense_groups.english: Fine, I'll do it. We gotta get this off the screen.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝还在气你教他"拉我的手指"
sense_groups.english: Carol's still upset that you taught him "Pull my finger."

sense_groups.chinese: 拉我的手指 我的手毁了
sense_groups.english: Pull my finger. My hand is messed up!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会回答那个问题 - 来吧 快挑一个
sense_groups.english: I am not gonna answer that. - Oh, come on. Just pick one.

sense_groups.chinese: 在摩妮卡 菲比 钱德跟罗斯之问…
sense_groups.english: Between Monica, Phoebe, Chandler and Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你非那么做不可 你会打谁
sense_groups.english: ...if you had to... If you had to, who would you punch?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁都不打 我们是朋友 我不会打他们
sense_groups.english: No one. They're my friends. I wouldn't punch any of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德吗
sense_groups.english: Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我不知道为什么
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but I don't know why.

sense_groups.chinese: 我玩得很开心 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'm having a wonderful time! - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我只想说…
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, can I just say...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我最棒的约会经验 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: ...I think this is the best date I ever had. - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我笑得好厉害 你看到酒从我鼻子喷出来吗
sense_groups.english: I've never laughed so hard. Did you see the wine come out my nose?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我想大家都看到了
sense_groups.english: Yes. Joey, I think everybody saw the wine come out of your nose.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我会这么喜欢没有性爱的约会
sense_groups.english: I gotta say, I never knew I could enjoy the non-sex part of a date so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为你没有跟我约会过
sense_groups.english: That's because you have never been on a date with me before.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别批评我
sense_groups.english: All right. Now don't judge me.

sense_groups.chinese: 通常我会等我的对象离开了再这么做 但你住这里
sense_groups.english: I normally wait till my date leaves, but you live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要把剩菜吃了
sense_groups.english: I'm ripping into the swan.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你也别批评我
sense_groups.english: Okay, well then, you don't judge me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去舔布朗尼的包装纸
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna suck on the cellophane from the brownie I had before.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我 乔伊·崔比亚尼说晚安的招数是什么
sense_groups.english: So tell me, what are Joey Tribbiani's end-of-the-night moves?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我要那个女孩吻我…
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, if I want the girl to kiss me...

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我会让我的嘴巴看起来难以抵抗
sense_groups.english: ...first thing I do is make my lips look irresistible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你都是怎么做的
sense_groups.english: How do you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能告诉任何人 但是…
sense_groups.english: Now you can't tell anyone, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会涂上护唇膏
sense_groups.english: ...I put on shiny lip balm.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 女人就跟飞蛾扑火一样
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Like a moth to a flame, I'm telling you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 轮到你了 - 不 我不想告诉你
sense_groups.english: Okay, all right, so now you go. - No, I don't want to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 那太丢脸了
sense_groups.english: Why not? - It's embarrassing.

sense_groups.chinese: 比涂覆盆子口味的护唇膏还丢脸
sense_groups.english: More embarrassing than shiny raspberry lip balm?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚没说覆盆子口味吧
sense_groups.english: I didn't say raspberry before, did I?

sense_groups.chinese: 快告诉我 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Just tell me, Rach. Just tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 站起来
sense_groups.english: Okay. All right, stand up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走到门边时…
sense_groups.english: Well, when we're at the door...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会将我的嘴唇轻轻压在他的嘴唇上
sense_groups.english: ...I lightly press my lips against his.

sense_groups.chinese: 将身体靠向他一秒钟
sense_groups.english: Then move into his body, just for a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我会发出这样的声音
sense_groups.english: And then I make this sound

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来没什么 但很有效
sense_groups.english: I know it doesn't sound like anything, but it works.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那的确有效
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. That would work, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得睡了 我玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: All right, I gotta go to bed. I had such a wonderful time.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你迟到了 50分钟 你是用爬的吗
sense_groups.english: You were 50 minutes late to the class? Did you crawl there?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我用跑的 那真的很远
sense_groups.english: No, I ran, okay? It's really far.

sense_groups.chinese: 人们什么时候开始听不懂 "别挡我的路"
sense_groups.english: When did people stop understanding "Get the hell out of my way"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不搭计程车
sense_groups.english: Why didn't you take a cab?

sense_groups.chinese: 塞车太严重 那是单行道 搭计程车得花两倍的时间
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Between the traffic and one-way streets, it'd take me twice as long.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一星期有三堂课 我是洛克菲勒吗
sense_groups.english: Besides, I teach the class three times a week. Who am I, Rockefeller?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没办法再继续下去
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna be able to keep doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不那么做 他们会取消我这堂课
sense_groups.english: I have to. If I don't, they'll take the class away from me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把它登在我家的通讯报上
sense_groups.english: And I already put it in my family newsletter.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 你看过的 "盖勒通讯报"
sense_groups.english: Your what? - You've seen it, The Geller Yeller.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想出一条比较快的路线 我想这次我能及时赶到
sense_groups.english: Besides, I figured out a faster route. I'm sure I can make it this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能害怕被车子撞到
sense_groups.english: I just can't be afraid to get a little bit hit by cars.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得我们谈过"狂犬惊魂记"吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, remember, um, last night when we were talking about Cujo?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你没看过 你是不是有问题啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I can't believe you haven't seen Cujo. What is wrong with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 别紧张 它不是"大国民"
sense_groups.english: Relax, it's not like it's Citizen Kane.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看完了"大国民"
sense_groups.english: Have you ever tried to sit through Citizen Kane?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 它真的很无聊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. It's really boring.

sense_groups.chinese: 但它是名片 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: But it's a big deal. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 我想去租"狂犬惊魂记"
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I was thinking about renting Cujo sometime.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今晚一起看吧
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah, all right. Let's do it tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是有约会吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Don't you have that big date tonight? - Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我能问你一件事吗 - 问吧
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey, can I ask you something? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚约会后你觉不觉得怪怪的
sense_groups.english: After our date last night, did you feel a little weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你也是吗 我吓坏了 那是什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. You did too? It freaked me out. What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该是龙虾的问题
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of thinking it was the lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 龙虾
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Yeah, the lobster.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吐了一整晚 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I was up sick all night. - Yeah, me too. All night.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 我没看到你
sense_groups.english: Really? How come we didn't cross paths?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是因为…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, that's because, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我都待在房里
sense_groups.english: ...I stayed in my room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会想看我的洗衣篮的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you don't want to look in my hamper.

sense_groups.chinese: 我懂了
sense_groups.english: Okay, I got that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要逃离那里 回到这里
sense_groups.english: I'll escape there. I'll come back here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 小精灵
sense_groups.english: All right. Come on, Ms. Pac-Man...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个混蛋 对吧
sense_groups.english: Well, you're just a little bitch, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉之前我霸占着电动玩具
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry that I was hogging the game before.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你朋友名字的缩写真难听
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, your friends have some unfortunate initials.

sense_groups.chinese: 那都是钱德干的 - 钱德烂透了
sense_groups.english: They're all Chandler. - Chandler sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能有这么厉害 - 我很厉害
sense_groups.english: He couldn't have gotten this good. - I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是要付出代价的
sense_groups.english: But it came at a price.

sense_groups.chinese: 小班要过来 他不能看到这个
sense_groups.english: Ben's coming, and he can't see this.

sense_groups.chinese: 七岁的孩子应该都看过杂交
sense_groups.english: Come on, by age 7, kids have already seen orgies.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是只有我而已
sense_groups.english: Was it just me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我办到了 我及时赶到
sense_groups.english: Yes, I made it! I'm on time!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 请大家…
sense_groups.english: Okay, why don't we all, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 翻到第23页…
sense_groups.english: ...open our books to page 23...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们…
sense_groups.english: ...where...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们将会看到…
sense_groups.english: ...where you will see a, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 很多红点
sense_groups.english: ...a bunch of, uh, red spots.

sense_groups.chinese: 请大家先看一下 我要…
sense_groups.english: Okay, why don't, uh, you all start to read, while I...

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吗 你似乎有点心不在焉
sense_groups.english: Hey, are you all right? You seem a little distracted.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没事 我只是…
sense_groups.english: No, no, I'm fine. It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你一件事吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, can I ask you something?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有看着你认识的人…
sense_groups.english: Have you ever looked at someone that you've known for a while...

sense_groups.chinese: 突然间有不一样的感觉
sense_groups.english: ...and suddenly seen them in a different way?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说从背后看吗
sense_groups.english: You mean like from behind?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就是那样
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah. That's exactly it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一次我从背后看这个家伙 觉得他真的很普通
sense_groups.english: One time I saw this guy from behind, and he seemed totally normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 他一转身 我才知道他是史蒂芬·鲍德温
sense_groups.english: And then he turned around and it was Stephen Baldwin!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你完全了解我的意思
sense_groups.english: Ooh, yeah. So you know exactly what I'm talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Totally! Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 请便
sense_groups.english: Would you excuse me for a sec? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你真的很厉害 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: God, Phoebe! You're on fire! - I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 你办得到 - 别碰我
sense_groups.english: You can do it! - Don't touch me!

sense_groups.chinese: 别碰她
sense_groups.english: Don't touch her!

sense_groups.chinese: 左边 右边 右边
sense_groups.english: All right, go left! Go right! Go right!

sense_groups.chinese: 我办不到
sense_groups.english: I can't! I can't!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你这个天杀的…
sense_groups.english: No! You son of a...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小班 不 别看机器
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Ben. No, don't look at the machine!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地 你回来了
sense_groups.english: Aah! God! Thank God you're home.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在看"狂犬惊魂记" - 你一个人
sense_groups.english: I'm watching Cujo. - Alone?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这只狗是怎么了 - 你看到…
sense_groups.english: Yes! What is wrong with this dog? - Did you get to the part...

sense_groups.chinese: 狗自己去撞车的那一幕了吗
sense_groups.english: ...where they're in the car and Cujo's throwing himself at the windshield?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 真的 这只狗是怎么了
sense_groups.english: No. No! Seriously, what's wrong with the dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么在家 你不是去约会了吗
sense_groups.english: What are you doing home? What happened to your date?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间不来电
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, it didn't work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我一起把电影看完吗
sense_groups.english: Want to watch the rest of the movie with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有想过我会这么说…
sense_groups.english: I never thought I'd say this about a movie...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我希望这只狗死掉
sense_groups.english: ...but I hope this dog dies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 坐在这里保护我
sense_groups.english: What are you doing over there? Come sit here. Protect me.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 有何不可呢
sense_groups.english: Oh. Sure, yeah. Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是他 那就是库裘 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That's him, that's him! That's Cujo! - All right, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他现在会怎么做 我不敢看
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What's he gonna do now? I can't watch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么能看这个 你不害怕吗
sense_groups.english: Ugh, seriously, how can you watch this? Aren't you scared?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怕极了
sense_groups.english: Terrified.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家都来了吗 今天我提早到了
sense_groups.english: So is everybody here? I got here a little early, myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 开始上课吧
sense_groups.english: Let us begin.

sense_groups.chinese: 鸭嘴龙在两个地方被发掘
sense_groups.english: Now, the hadrosaurids have been unearthed in two main locations.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里…
sense_groups.english: Here...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟这里
sense_groups.english: ...and here.

sense_groups.chinese: 至于鸭嘴龙…
sense_groups.english: Now, as for the hadrosaurus...

questions.name: S08E13
questions.en:
All right, it's a new day. That stuff about Rachel?
You don't feel that now. It was crazy. You're fine. You're better than fine.
You are, as your friend Tony would say, "Great!"
Everything's normal. She's just your friend, Rachel.
Your friend, Rachel. Your friend. Rachel.
Hi, sweetie. JOEY: Hey, it's your girlfriend, Rachel!
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hi.
Are you...? Are you high?
I had the most amazing bath.
Really? I don't like baths. - You like them with me.
Honey, it's not the bath I enjoy. It's the wet, naked lady.
Baths are so relaxing. - Really? What do you do?
You just sit in there, stewing in your own filth.
How dirty do you think I am?
If you had some candles and bubbles and music, you'd love it.
It'd take all your stress away.
It's 2:00 on Wednesday, I'm watching Road Rules.
How stressed am I?
Hey, Chandler. I really need to talk to you.
Oh, uh, yeah. Is this a cold pizza or a leftover-meat loaf talk?
Well, neither. - Oh, my God, what's up?
I don't know. It's just... Lately, I've been feeling...
Okay, here's what it is. Heh.
I feel a lot better. Thanks. - Wait a minute. Just come back.
Okay. You and Monica, friends for a long time.
And sure, there are rules. But then you went to London.
But that's different. There are rules there too, know what I mean?
Do you?
It was different for you guys. You were both in the same place.
In London. - Yeah.
Yes, when Monica and I were in London, we were both in London.
This is a bad idea. Forget all about it.
This conversation, between you and me.
If that.
Hi. Oh, Ross, don't forget that doctor's appointment.
Right. - To find out the sex of the baby?
We don't wanna know as long as it's happy and healthy.
Yep, healthy. And cute. - And smart.
Popular. - With an aptitude for science.
Are you two talking about the same baby?
Have you thought of names? - Oh, yeah. I've come up with a bunch.
Really? Me too. - Me too.
Really?
If it's a girl, Phoebe. And if it's a boy, Pheebo.
Maybe. But it wouldn't hurt to have a backup, you know?
Rach, what were you thinking? - Okay.
Um, I was thinking if it's a girl...
...how about Sandrene? It's French.
That's a really pretty name for an industrial solvent.
Fine. What do you have? - It's for a boy.
I know it's a little out there, but...
...Darwin.
Our child will be beaten in the schoolyard.
Yeah, by Sandrene.
You're saying that because I said no to you.
I'm really, really not.
How about you each get five vetoes?
All right. - That sounds fair.
I don't think you'll need it.
If it's a girl, Rain.
Veto. - Why?
Rain? "Hi, my name is Rain.
I have my own kiln, and my dress is made out of wheat."
I know her!
I bought a homemade soap from her at a Dead show!
Okay. How about for a guy, Thatcher? - Why do you hate our child?
Fine, you go. - Okay. James.
But only if it's a girl. - Oh, veto.
I like Ruth. What about Ruth?
Oh, I'm sorry. Are we having an 89-year-old?
How about Dayton? - Veto. Stewart.
Veto. Sawyer.
Veto. Helen. - Veto.
Is it me, or is Veto starting to sound really good?
Hey.
Boy, do I have a surprise for you.
Sex on the balcony?
No. But someone's not gonna get over that idea.
What? - I drew you a bath.
I don't like baths. Could you draw me a picture of sex on the balcony?
Try it for me. I used all my best stuff.
I lit candles, I put on music. I used bath salts, plus bubble bath.
And got you this little plastic Navy ship! So it's a boy bath.
This does butch it up a bit. - I swear, you will love it.
If I do this, can we discuss balcony sex?
Absolutely.
But I know how that discussion's gonna go.
# Who can say where the road goes? #
All right, this isn't bad. I like the flowery smell.
Which is okay, because I've got my boat.
So? - Oh, my God.
I told you you were a bath person. Hey, maybe I can give you a facial.
I'm gonna need a bigger boat.
I don't think you had an open mind about Ruth.
Little Ruthie Geller? How cute is that?
Oh, my God, I can practically hear the mahjong tiles.
All your tests look fine. Are you interested in the sex of the baby?
No, we're not. - You have it right there?
You know if it's a boy or a girl? Dayton or Sandrene? Phoebe or Pheebo?
But if you don't wanna know...
No, we wanna wait. Right? - Right. Right.
Oh, I'll be right back.
I know it's really not my place...
...but please don't name your child Pheebo.
So, which of these babies is the ugliest?
What? Rach, come on, that's terrible.
They're babies. They're all beautiful.
Third one from the left? - Yeah. Why is it staring at me?
I think it knows I'm talking about it. Don't you...? You're looking!
I didn't! - I saw you!
Fine, I did, but I didn't see anything.
Shame on you! Ugly baby judges you!
But I didn't... - Don't tell me! I don't wanna know!
I couldn't, because I don't know!
I swear I didn't see anything! It was just a momentary lapse.
"Momentary lapse." Don't you have any self-control?
Okay. A couple months late on the lecture, Ross.
Hello?
Can you come in here? There's something wrong.
You know what? I think I'll wait out here.
I'm in the bathtub.
What's wrong? - I drew a bath, but I did it wrong.
The water's tepid, the salt didn't dissolve and is now lodged places.
And the scents I used don't compliment each other. Eucalyptus and chamomile? Oh!
What? - Bath salts.
They're starting to effervesce.
It's different. It's interesting.
Let's talk about something else.
Yeah. Sure. So, what was going on with you today?
I actually had the weirdest conversation with Joey.
He was talking about rules and right and wrong.
I had the same conversation. - What was he talking about?
He hasn't had this much trouble getting out words since he was in Macbeth.
That was a long night.
All right, let's break this down. What exactly did he say to you?
He was talking about rules and looking at people differently.
Not to me. - What'd he tell you?
He asked about you, me and London.
And the glue that holds this all together, the rules.
Okay. So you, me and London.
Looking at people differently.
Maybe he wants to do what you and I did in London.
But what'd he mean by "rules"?
Wait. He stopped talking the minute Phoebe came in.
He's looking at her differently. - Phoebe is his friend.
That'd be breaking the rules.
My God, he wants to do it with Phoebe in London!
You guys? - Um, just a minute!
That's Mrs. Tribbiani. - You don't say anything.
Why would I? That two of our friends could start a great love affair?
They'd have me to thank. Then we could all start having babies!
I won't let you say anything. - Stay here.
Oh, God!
Oh. I brought back your iron.
You had that? I thought I lost it. I got a new one a month ago.
Oh, just as well. I broke this one.
What? - Nothing.
Okay.
I really shouldn't say. I'm really not supposed to.
Fine.
It's a humdinger. - Too bad you can't tell me.
Somebody likes you!
Ugh. Is it Chandler? - No!
Then tell him to stop staring. - It's Joey.
Really? Joey? You don't say.
Would you be interested? - I don't know, I don't know.
You know, I mean, on the one hand, "Mother, may I?"
But, you know, on the other hand...
No. No, I can't. We're friends.
Oh, no. I don't wanna risk what we have.
I guess that makes sense. You think you're gonna talk to him?
Sure. I mean, it's Joey. I don't want him to get hurt.
Well, I must say, I am on fire! First Chandler, now Joey.
Not Chandler. Just Joey. - Sure.
Hi. - Hey.
You know what? I'm coming around on the name Ruth.
I'd consider naming our child that.
Rach, I can't tell you how much that means to me. Oh...
Wait a minute. Wait a minute.
You hated the name Ruth. Why would you change your mind?
Unless you know we're never gonna have to use it.
You did see. You know it's a boy!
I didn't see anything. I changed my mind.
I don't think so. You're giving me Ruth...
...so you get to name him when it's a boy.
That's when you'll swoop in and name him Heath or Blaine or Sequoia.
I would... Sequoia!
Veto. - Fine.
Unless you anticipated that I would figure all this out...
...and you know that it actually is a girl.
And you really do want her to be named Ruth.
Well, I'm not falling for that! Okay? Ruth is off the table!
But, Ross, you want the name Ruth. - Not like this!
Hey. - Hey. What's up?
Um, Joey, I know. - What?
I know. - What?
I know about your feelings. - Oh, my God, you do?
I'm sorry. Things worked out for Chandler and Monica, but that's rare.
I know. And this is so much more complicated than it was for them.
I mean, it's Rachel, for God's sakes.
For God's sakes, it's Rachel!
I know! She's not only my friend, she's my pregnant friend.
She's my pregnant friend who's Ross' ex!
Yeah, that's Rachel. Beat me over the head with it.
What am I gonna do? I keep trying to get rid of these feelings.
I made a list of everything I don't like about her.
You wanna hear it? - Yeah.
"She made me switch to light mayo." That's it! That's all I got!
You know what? Tastes the same and my pants fit better.
Joey, you're getting upset for nothing.
This is probably just a crush. - You think?
Absolutely. You get this rush of feelings, but it goes away.
Yeah, just a crush. That's all this is. It's a crush!
I'm Joey. I don't get deep feelings.
There you go. Crushes happen all the time.
I've had them for all you guys. Except for Ross and Chandler.
And I'm sure you've had them for us. - Not really.
Throw me a bone here.
So I, uh... I called the doctor.
Now we both know the sex of the baby. - What?
That's right. The student has become the master.
Ross, I swear. I don't know. - Oh, come on, you know it's a girl.
A what? - You really didn't know?
We're having a girl? - No.
That's what you said. - No.
You said girl. - Yes. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
I'm not! We're having a girl!
Sometimes I can't believe it's with you, but still, we're having a girl!
I know! You know what? I'm putting Ruth back on the table.
Yes, we'll have ourselves a little baby Ruth.
Permission to veto. - Yes, please.
Hey. - Do I smell essential oils?
I'm gonna take a bath. I was gonna get a magazine.
Okay.
What do you think you're doing?
Leaving my troubles behind?
You're new at this, but this is unacceptable bath decorum.
It's so hard to care when you're this relaxed.
You can have the bath, but I am taking your boat.
Now you're just a girl in a tub.
Hey! - Hi, bubbles. Manly.
I thought I'd let you know how it went.
You told her? - She pulled it out of me!
She's like a conversational wizard! How did it go?
You were wrong. He doesn't like me. - What?
How would you like it if I told you that Lee Majors liked you...
