He's looking at her differently. - Phoebe is his friend.
That'd be breaking the rules.
My God, he wants to do it with Phoebe in London!
You guys? - Um, just a minute!
That's Mrs. Tribbiani. - You don't say anything.
Why would I? That two of our friends could start a great love affair?
They'd have me to thank. Then we could all start having babies!
I won't let you say anything. - Stay here.
Oh, God!
Oh. I brought back your iron.
You had that? I thought I lost it. I got a new one a month ago.
Oh, just as well. I broke this one.
What? - Nothing.
Okay.
I really shouldn't say. I'm really not supposed to.
Fine.
It's a humdinger. - Too bad you can't tell me.
Somebody likes you!
Ugh. Is it Chandler? - No!
Then tell him to stop staring. - It's Joey.
Really? Joey? You don't say.
Would you be interested? - I don't know, I don't know.
You know, I mean, on the one hand, "Mother, may I?"
But, you know, on the other hand...
No. No, I can't. We're friends.
Oh, no. I don't wanna risk what we have.
I guess that makes sense. You think you're gonna talk to him?
Sure. I mean, it's Joey. I don't want him to get hurt.
Well, I must say, I am on fire! First Chandler, now Joey.
Not Chandler. Just Joey. - Sure.
Hi. - Hey.
You know what? I'm coming around on the name Ruth.
I'd consider naming our child that.
Rach, I can't tell you how much that means to me. Oh...
Wait a minute. Wait a minute.
You hated the name Ruth. Why would you change your mind?
Unless you know we're never gonna have to use it.
You did see. You know it's a boy!
I didn't see anything. I changed my mind.
I don't think so. You're giving me Ruth...
...so you get to name him when it's a boy.
That's when you'll swoop in and name him Heath or Blaine or Sequoia.
I would... Sequoia!
Veto. - Fine.
Unless you anticipated that I would figure all this out...
...and you know that it actually is a girl.
And you really do want her to be named Ruth.
Well, I'm not falling for that! Okay? Ruth is off the table!
But, Ross, you want the name Ruth. - Not like this!
Hey. - Hey. What's up?
Um, Joey, I know. - What?
I know. - What?
I know about your feelings. - Oh, my God, you do?
I'm sorry. Things worked out for Chandler and Monica, but that's rare.
I know. And this is so much more complicated than it was for them.
I mean, it's Rachel, for God's sakes.
For God's sakes, it's Rachel!
I know! She's not only my friend, she's my pregnant friend.
She's my pregnant friend who's Ross' ex!
Yeah, that's Rachel. Beat me over the head with it.
What am I gonna do? I keep trying to get rid of these feelings.
I made a list of everything I don't like about her.
You wanna hear it? - Yeah.
"She made me switch to light mayo." That's it! That's all I got!
You know what? Tastes the same and my pants fit better.
Joey, you're getting upset for nothing.
This is probably just a crush. - You think?
Absolutely. You get this rush of feelings, but it goes away.
Yeah, just a crush. That's all this is. It's a crush!
I'm Joey. I don't get deep feelings.
There you go. Crushes happen all the time.
I've had them for all you guys. Except for Ross and Chandler.
And I'm sure you've had them for us. - Not really.
Throw me a bone here.
So I, uh... I called the doctor.
Now we both know the sex of the baby. - What?
That's right. The student has become the master.
Ross, I swear. I don't know. - Oh, come on, you know it's a girl.
A what? - You really didn't know?
We're having a girl? - No.
That's what you said. - No.
You said girl. - Yes. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.
I'm not! We're having a girl!
Sometimes I can't believe it's with you, but still, we're having a girl!
I know! You know what? I'm putting Ruth back on the table.
Yes, we'll have ourselves a little baby Ruth.
Permission to veto. - Yes, please.
Hey. - Do I smell essential oils?
I'm gonna take a bath. I was gonna get a magazine.
Okay.
What do you think you're doing?
Leaving my troubles behind?
You're new at this, but this is unacceptable bath decorum.
It's so hard to care when you're this relaxed.
You can have the bath, but I am taking your boat.
Now you're just a girl in a tub.
Hey! - Hi, bubbles. Manly.
I thought I'd let you know how it went.
You told her? - She pulled it out of me!
She's like a conversational wizard! How did it go?
You were wrong. He doesn't like me. - What?
How would you like it if I told you that Lee Majors liked you...
...and I told you he liked you and you went there...
...and you found out that he didn't like you? How would you feel?
I don't think I'd care. - Really? Lee Majors is hot.
Hello? - We're in the bathroom!
Why? - Because it's a relaxing and enjoyable time!
What are you guys doing in here? - Oh, my God.
A friend he's looking at differently, but it's wrong.
It's Rachel! - You like Rachel?
It's no big deal. Phoebe and I talked.
It's a crush. It'll go away.
Dude, you gotta rearrange your bubbles.
Mazel tov.
Hey. Oh, hi. Ross and I were looking for you.
What are we all doing in here? Oh, my.
Honey, cover it up with the boat.
Hello?
We're all in here, and we'd love for you to join us!
Well, hey! What's going on? Oh, cool boat. Oh, no.
Did you tell them? - I waited for you.
Tell us what? - We're having a girl.
Oh, wow! Really? Oh, my God!
I'll get you later.
All right. It's a new day. And it's just a crush.
That's all. Just a little crush.
All that worrying I was doing? That was crazy. Crazy.
Like my friend the bird here would say, "It was cuckoo!"
Everything's gonna be fine. It's just a crush.
Hi, sweetie. - I love you.
It's nice to do this together, isn't it?
Yeah. And what you're doing feels so good.
I'm not touching you. - You're not?
It's the salts. - Sweet Lord, new realms of pleasure.
Whatever keeps you off the balcony, big guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 这是全新的一天 关于瑞秋那件事呢
sense_groups.english: All right, it's a new day. That stuff about Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你没有感觉 那太疯了 你没事 你好的不得了
sense_groups.english: You don't feel that now. It was crazy. You're fine. You're better than fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 就像你朋友汤尼说的 "太帅了"
sense_groups.english: You are, as your friend Tony would say, "Great!"

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都很正常 瑞秋她只是你的朋友
sense_groups.english: Everything's normal. She's just your friend, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的朋友瑞秋 你的朋友瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Your friend, Rachel. Your friend. Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 甜心 - 嗨 她是你女朋友瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi, sweetie. JOEY: Hey, it's your girlfriend, Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你…你很兴奋吗
sense_groups.english: Are you...? Are you high?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚泡了一个最舒服的澡
sense_groups.english: I had the most amazing bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 我不喜欢泡澡 - 你喜欢跟我泡鸳鸯浴
sense_groups.english: Really? I don't like baths. - You like them with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我不是喜欢泡澡 我喜欢看全身湿答答的裸体女人
sense_groups.english: Honey, it's not the bath I enjoy. It's the wet, naked lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 泡澡能让你放松 - 真的吗 你在里面做什么
sense_groups.english: Baths are so relaxing. - Really? What do you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你坐在那里 被自己的脏水泡着
sense_groups.english: You just sit in there, stewing in your own filth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我有多脏呢
sense_groups.english: How dirty do you think I am?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有蜡烛 泡泡跟音乐 你一定会喜欢它的
sense_groups.english: If you had some candles and bubbles and music, you'd love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会让你完全地放松
sense_groups.english: It'd take all your stress away.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是星期三两点 我正在看越野单车赛
sense_groups.english: It's 2:00 on Wednesday, I'm watching Road Rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得我的压力会有多大
sense_groups.english: How stressed am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你有空吗 我真的需要跟你谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler. I really need to talk to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这是冷比萨谈话 还是烤肉剩菜谈话
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, yeah. Is this a cold pizza or a leftover-meat loaf talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 都不是 - 天啊 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Well, neither. - Oh, my God, what's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 那只是…最近我觉得…
sense_groups.english: I don't know. It's just... Lately, I've been feeling...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 事情是这样的
sense_groups.english: Okay, here's what it is. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得好多了 谢谢 - 等一下 回来吧
sense_groups.english: I feel a lot better. Thanks. - Wait a minute. Just come back.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你跟摩妮卡当了很久的朋友
sense_groups.english: Okay. You and Monica, friends for a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然这是有规则的 之后你们去了伦敦
sense_groups.english: And sure, there are rules. But then you went to London.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那不一样 这也是有规则的 你了解我的意思吗
sense_groups.english: But that's different. There are rules there too, know what I mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: Do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对你们来说是不一样的 你们刚好去了同一个地方 对吧
sense_groups.english: It was different for you guys. You were both in the same place.

sense_groups.chinese: 在伦敦 - 对
sense_groups.english: In London. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 摩妮卡跟我在伦敦时 我们刚好都在那里
sense_groups.english: Yes, when Monica and I were in London, we were both in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 这是个烂主意 算了
sense_groups.english: This is a bad idea. Forget all about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 帮我一个忙 别把这件事说出去
sense_groups.english: This conversation, between you and me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会尽力的
sense_groups.english: If that.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 别忘了 明天我们要一起去产检
sense_groups.english: Hi. Oh, Ross, don't forget that doctor's appointment.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 你们要知道宝宝的性别
sense_groups.english: Right. - To find out the sex of the baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们不想知道 我们只在乎宝宝是不是健康快乐
sense_groups.english: We don't wanna know as long as it's happy and healthy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 健康快乐 还有可爱 - 跟聪明
sense_groups.english: Yep, healthy. And cute. - And smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 受欢迎 - 还要有科学精神
sense_groups.english: Popular. - With an aptitude for science.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个说的是同一个宝宝吗
sense_groups.english: Are you two talking about the same baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想到名字了吗 - 对 我想到一大堆
sense_groups.english: Have you thought of names? - Oh, yeah. I've come up with a bunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 我也是 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: Really? Me too. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是女孩就叫菲比 如果是男孩就叫菲宝
sense_groups.english: If it's a girl, Phoebe. And if it's a boy, Pheebo.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧 但想些备用名字 应该无伤大雅
sense_groups.english: Maybe. But it wouldn't hurt to have a backup, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你想到什么名字 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Rach, what were you thinking? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想如果是女孩
sense_groups.english: Um, I was thinking if it's a girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 叫她珊德妮好吗 那是法文
sense_groups.english: ...how about Sandrene? It's French.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很适合化学溶剂公司
sense_groups.english: That's a really pretty name for an industrial solvent.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你想到什么 - 我想到男生的名字
sense_groups.english: Fine. What do you have? - It's for a boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道稍微有点夸张 但是…
sense_groups.english: I know it's a little out there, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 达尔文
sense_groups.english: ...Darwin.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我们的孩子会在操场上被打死
sense_groups.english: Our child will be beaten in the schoolyard.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 被珊德妮打死
sense_groups.english: Yeah, by Sandrene.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会那么说因为我不喜欢你想的名字
sense_groups.english: You're saying that because I said no to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的没有
sense_groups.english: I'm really, really not.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们何不各想五个名字
sense_groups.english: How about you each get five vetoes?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 听起来很公平
sense_groups.english: All right. - That sounds fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你不需要 听着
sense_groups.english: I don't think you'll need it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是女孩就叫做小雨
sense_groups.english: If it's a girl, Rain.

sense_groups.chinese: 否决 - 为什么
sense_groups.english: Veto. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 小雨 "嗨 我叫小雨
sense_groups.english: Rain? "Hi, my name is Rain.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有自己的炉子 我的衣服是用麦子做的"
sense_groups.english: I have my own kiln, and my dress is made out of wheat."

sense_groups.chinese: 我认识她
sense_groups.english: I know her!

sense_groups.chinese: 我在死人表演里跟她买了一块手工肥皂
sense_groups.english: I bought a homemade soap from her at a Dead show!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果是男孩就叫柴契尔 - 你为什么恨我们的孩子
sense_groups.english: Okay. How about for a guy, Thatcher? - Why do you hate our child?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 轮到你了 - 詹姆斯
sense_groups.english: Fine, you go. - Okay. James.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我可能生的是女孩 - 否决
sense_groups.english: But only if it's a girl. - Oh, veto.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢萝丝 你觉得呢
sense_groups.english: I like Ruth. What about Ruth?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我们要生下个89岁的宝宝
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Are we having an 89-year-old?

sense_groups.chinese: 戴顿呢 - 否决 史都华
sense_groups.english: How about Dayton? - Veto. Stewart.

sense_groups.chinese: 否决 索耶
sense_groups.english: Veto. Sawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 否决 海伦 - 否决
sense_groups.english: Veto. Helen. - Veto.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我想歪了 还是"否决"会是个好名字
sense_groups.english: Is it me, or is Veto starting to sound really good?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我为你准备了一个大惊喜
sense_groups.english: Boy, do I have a surprise for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要在阳台上做爱
sense_groups.english: Sex on the balcony?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但有个人忘不了那个想法
sense_groups.english: No. But someone's not gonna get over that idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 我帮你放了洗澡水
sense_groups.english: What? - I drew you a bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢洗澡 你愿意帮我画一幅阳台做爱图吗
sense_groups.english: I don't like baths. Could you draw me a picture of sex on the balcony?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托你试试看 我使出了全身解数
sense_groups.english: Try it for me. I used all my best stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我点了蜡烛 放了音乐 用了浴盐跟泡泡澡
sense_groups.english: I lit candles, I put on music. I used bath salts, plus bubble bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还帮你找到海军模型船 这是男人会洗的澡
sense_groups.english: And got you this little plastic Navy ship! So it's a boy bath.

sense_groups.chinese: 这稍微有点男人味 - 我发誓你试过后一定会爱上它
sense_groups.english: This does butch it up a bit. - I swear, you will love it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我这么做 我们能不能讨论在阳台上做爱的事
sense_groups.english: If I do this, can we discuss balcony sex?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我知道我们会怎么讨论它
sense_groups.english: But I know how that discussion's gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: # 谁能说这条路在何方 #
sense_groups.english: # Who can say where the road goes? #

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这还不赖 我喜欢花香味
sense_groups.english: All right, this isn't bad. I like the flowery smell.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 因为我有我的船
sense_groups.english: Which is okay, because I've got my boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样 - 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: So? - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过你会喜欢洗澡 或许我可以帮你做脸
sense_groups.english: I told you you were a bath person. Hey, maybe I can give you a facial.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要大一点的船
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna need a bigger boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你对萝丝这个名字没有抱着开阔的胸襟
sense_groups.english: I don't think you had an open mind about Ruth.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托嘛 小萝丝·盖勒 可爱吧
sense_groups.english: Little Ruthie Geller? How cute is that?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我可以听到麻将声
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I can practically hear the mahjong tiles.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 检查结果都很正常 你们想知道宝宝的性别吗
sense_groups.english: All your tests look fine. Are you interested in the sex of the baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不想知道 - 但病历里面有记录
sense_groups.english: No, we're not. - You have it right there?

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉我们是男孩或是女孩 戴顿或珊德妮 菲比或菲宝
sense_groups.english: You know if it's a boy or a girl? Dayton or Sandrene? Phoebe or Pheebo?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 如果你们不想知道
sense_groups.english: But if you don't wanna know...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们要等 对吧 - 对
sense_groups.english: No, we wanna wait. Right? - Right. Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'll be right back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我不该那么说
sense_groups.english: I know it's really not my place...

sense_groups.chinese: 但请不要将你们的宝宝取名为菲宝
sense_groups.english: ...but please don't name your child Pheebo.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得哪个宝宝最丑
sense_groups.english: So, which of these babies is the ugliest?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 瑞秋 那太可怕了
sense_groups.english: What? Rach, come on, that's terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是宝宝 他们都很可爱
sense_groups.english: They're babies. They're all beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 左边数过来第三个 - 对 它为什么要盯着我看
sense_groups.english: Third one from the left? - Yeah. Why is it staring at me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想它知道我在说它 你不…你在偷看
sense_groups.english: I think it knows I'm talking about it. Don't you...? You're looking!

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有 - 我看到了
sense_groups.english: I didn't! - I saw you!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我在偷看 但我什么都没有看到
sense_groups.english: Fine, I did, but I didn't see anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太可耻了 丑宝宝唾弃你
sense_groups.english: Shame on you! Ugly baby judges you!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 听我说 我没有… - 别告诉我 我不想知道
sense_groups.english: But I didn't... - Don't tell me! I don't wanna know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说也没办法说 因为我不知道
sense_groups.english: I couldn't, because I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓我什么都没看到 我不想知道 刚刚我是一时糊涂
sense_groups.english: I swear I didn't see anything! It was just a momentary lapse.

sense_groups.chinese: 一时糊涂 你不懂得自制吗
sense_groups.english: "Momentary lapse." Don't you have any self-control?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在跟我说教 已经迟了好几个月 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay. A couple months late on the lecture, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在浴室 你能进来一下吗 我觉得不太对劲
sense_groups.english: Can you come in here? There's something wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我在这里等
sense_groups.english: You know what? I think I'll wait out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在浴缸里
sense_groups.english: I'm in the bathtub.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 我自己放洗澡水 但我没有弄对
sense_groups.english: What's wrong? - I drew a bath, but I did it wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 水温温的 浴盐无法溶解 现在它们结块了
sense_groups.english: The water's tepid, the salt didn't dissolve and is now lodged places.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用的香味闻起来很不协调 尤加利树跟甘菊
sense_groups.english: And the scents I used don't compliment each other. Eucalyptus and chamomile? Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 浴盐
sense_groups.english: What? - Bath salts.

sense_groups.chinese: 它们开始冒泡了
sense_groups.english: They're starting to effervesce.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉完全不同 这真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: It's different. It's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们谈谈别的事
sense_groups.english: Let's talk about something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 今天你过得还好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Sure. So, what was going on with you today?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟乔伊谈了一件很奇怪的事
sense_groups.english: I actually had the weirdest conversation with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 他谈到规则及对错
sense_groups.english: He was talking about rules and right and wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也跟他谈过 - 是吗 他到底在说什么
sense_groups.english: I had the same conversation. - What was he talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 自从他演过马克白后 我还没看过他说不出话的样子
sense_groups.english: He hasn't had this much trouble getting out words since he was in Macbeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是漫长的一夜
sense_groups.english: That was a long night.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们来谈谈这件事 他到底跟你说了什么
sense_groups.english: All right, let's break this down. What exactly did he say to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他说到规则 对别人有不同的看法
sense_groups.english: He was talking about rules and looking at people differently.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有跟我说那个 - 他跟你说了什么
sense_groups.english: Not to me. - What'd he tell you?

sense_groups.chinese: 他问到你跟我在伦敦发生的事
sense_groups.english: He asked about you, me and London.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是怎么开始的 还有规则
sense_groups.english: And the glue that holds this all together, the rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你跟我在伦敦
sense_groups.english: Okay. So you, me and London.

sense_groups.chinese: 对别人有不同的看法
sense_groups.english: Looking at people differently.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他想跟某人发生你跟我在伦敦发生的事
sense_groups.english: Maybe he wants to do what you and I did in London.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他说"规则"是什么意思
sense_groups.english: But what'd he mean by "rules"?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 菲比走进来时他就不说了
sense_groups.english: Wait. He stopped talking the minute Phoebe came in.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他用不同的眼光看她 - 菲比是他的朋友
sense_groups.english: He's looking at her differently. - Phoebe is his friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 他觉得那违反了规则
sense_groups.english: That'd be breaking the rules.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他想跟菲比在伦敦上床
sense_groups.english: My God, he wants to do it with Phoebe in London!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在哪里 - 等一下
sense_groups.english: You guys? - Um, just a minute!

sense_groups.chinese: 崔比亚尼太太来了 - 什么都别说
sense_groups.english: That's Mrs. Tribbiani. - You don't say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要说 我们的两个好朋友要真正地谈恋爱
sense_groups.english: Why would I? That two of our friends could start a great love affair?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会谢谢我 然后我们可以开始做宝宝
sense_groups.english: They'd have me to thank. Then we could all start having babies!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要你告诉她 - 你待在这里
sense_groups.english: I won't let you say anything. - Stay here.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我拿熨斗来还你
sense_groups.english: Oh. I brought back your iron.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你把它拿走的 我以为弄丢了 一个月前买了一个新的
sense_groups.english: You had that? I thought I lost it. I got a new one a month ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我把它弄坏了
sense_groups.english: Oh, just as well. I broke this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 没事
sense_groups.english: What? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不该说 我不应该说出来的
sense_groups.english: I really shouldn't say. I'm really not supposed to.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个好消息 - 可惜你不能告诉我
sense_groups.english: It's a humdinger. - Too bad you can't tell me.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人喜欢你
sense_groups.english: Somebody likes you!

sense_groups.chinese: 是钱德吗 - 不
sense_groups.english: Ugh. Is it Chandler? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 叫他别再盯着我看 - 是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Then tell him to stop staring. - It's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 乔伊 你骗人
sense_groups.english: Really? Joey? You don't say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有兴趣吗 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Would you be interested? - I don't know, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我在想 "天啊 我可以吗"
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, on the one hand, "Mother, may I?"

sense_groups.chinese: 但在另一方面
sense_groups.english: But, you know, on the other hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我们是朋友
sense_groups.english: No. No, I can't. We're friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不能冒险 失去我们现在的友谊
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I don't wanna risk what we have.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你说的对 你会跟他谈一谈吗
sense_groups.english: I guess that makes sense. You think you're gonna talk to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 他是乔伊 我不希望他受伤害
sense_groups.english: Sure. I mean, it's Joey. I don't want him to get hurt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说我真的很辣 先是钱德 现在又是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Well, I must say, I am on fire! First Chandler, now Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有钱德 只有乔伊 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Not Chandler. Just Joey. - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我想过了 我接受萝丝这个名字
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm coming around on the name Ruth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以考虑帮孩子取那个名字
sense_groups.english: I'd consider naming our child that.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我无法告诉你 这对我来说意义有多么重大
sense_groups.english: Rach, I can't tell you how much that means to me. Oh...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你讨厌萝丝这个名字 你为什么会改变心意
sense_groups.english: You hated the name Ruth. Why would you change your mind?

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你知道 我们用不着它
sense_groups.english: Unless you know we're never gonna have to use it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到了 你知道宝宝是男孩
sense_groups.english: You did see. You know it's a boy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都没有看到 我真的是改变了心意
sense_groups.english: I didn't see anything. I changed my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不那么认为 你答应让我选萝丝
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. You're giving me Ruth...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你生了儿子 你可以帮他取名字
sense_groups.english: ...so you get to name him when it's a boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那时候你会决定叫他 海瑟 布兰恩或史奎亚
sense_groups.english: That's when you'll swoop in and name him Heath or Blaine or Sequoia.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会…史奎亚
sense_groups.english: I would... Sequoia!

sense_groups.chinese: 否决 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Veto. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非… 你知道我会看穿你的阴谋
sense_groups.english: Unless you anticipated that I would figure all this out...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道宝宝是女生
sense_groups.english: ...and you know that it actually is a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的希望她叫萝丝
sense_groups.english: And you really do want her to be named Ruth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才不会上当 好吧 我们不考虑萝丝
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not falling for that! Okay? Ruth is off the table!

sense_groups.chinese: 但罗斯 你要萝丝这个名字 - 现在我不要了
sense_groups.english: But, Ross, you want the name Ruth. - Not like this!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我知道了 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Um, Joey, I know. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I know. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解你的感觉 - 天啊 真的吗
sense_groups.english: I know about your feelings. - Oh, my God, you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 很遗憾 虽然钱德跟摩妮卡成功了 但那是少有的例子
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Things worked out for Chandler and Monica, but that's rare.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 这比他们的情况复杂多了
sense_groups.english: I know. And this is so much more complicated than it was for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说她是瑞秋 天啊
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's Rachel, for God's sakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: For God's sakes, it's Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 她不只是我的朋友 她是我的孕妇朋友
sense_groups.english: I know! She's not only my friend, she's my pregnant friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的孕妇朋友 还是罗斯的前女友
sense_groups.english: She's my pregnant friend who's Ross' ex!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那就是瑞秋 我真的被搞糊涂了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's Rachel. Beat me over the head with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办 我试着不去想这些事
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do? I keep trying to get rid of these feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我整夜没睡 试着写出我不喜欢她的地方
sense_groups.english: I made a list of everything I don't like about her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想听听看吗 - 好
sense_groups.english: You wanna hear it? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: "她要我改吃低卡美乃滋" 就那样 我只想到那个
sense_groups.english: "She made me switch to light mayo." That's it! That's all I got!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 味道一样 但我的裤子松多了
sense_groups.english: You know what? Tastes the same and my pants fit better.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我觉得你是庸人自扰
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're getting upset for nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你只是被爱情冲昏了头 - 你真的那么认为
sense_groups.english: This is probably just a crush. - You think?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 你只是一时昏了头 但那种感觉会消失的
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. You get this rush of feelings, but it goes away.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我只是冲昏了头 没错 我只是冲昏了头
sense_groups.english: Yeah, just a crush. That's all this is. It's a crush!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是乔伊 我不会玩真的
sense_groups.english: I'm Joey. I don't get deep feelings.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 人常会被冲昏了头
sense_groups.english: There you go. Crushes happen all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对你们这些男生也会有那种感觉 罗斯跟钱德除外
sense_groups.english: I've had them for all you guys. Except for Ross and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信你对我们也是 - 不尽然
sense_groups.english: And I'm sure you've had them for us. - Not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是难倒我了
sense_groups.english: Throw me a bone here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打电话给医生了
sense_groups.english: So I, uh... I called the doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们都知道宝宝的性别 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Now we both know the sex of the baby. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我是青出于蓝而胜于蓝
sense_groups.english: That's right. The student has become the master.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我发誓真的不知道 - 少来了 你知道宝宝是女孩
sense_groups.english: Ross, I swear. I don't know. - Oh, come on, you know it's a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 你真的不知道
sense_groups.english: A what? - You really didn't know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要有个女儿了 - 不
sense_groups.english: We're having a girl? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是那么说的 - 不
sense_groups.english: That's what you said. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说是女孩 - 对 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: You said girl. - Yes. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我们要有个女儿了
sense_groups.english: I'm not! We're having a girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我不敢相信孩子的爸是你 但我们要有个女儿了
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I can't believe it's with you, but still, we're having a girl!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你知道吗 我要重新考虑萝丝这个名字
sense_groups.english: I know! You know what? I'm putting Ruth back on the table.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们要生下小萝丝了
sense_groups.english: Yes, we'll have ourselves a little baby Ruth.

sense_groups.chinese: 允许否决 - 好吧 否决
sense_groups.english: Permission to veto. - Yes, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 这是精油味吗
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Do I smell essential oils?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要去洗澡 我想拿本杂志
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take a bath. I was gonna get a magazine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What do you think you're doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 忘了我的麻烦
sense_groups.english: Leaving my troubles behind?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你是新手 但这不合乎洗澡的礼仪
sense_groups.english: You're new at this, but this is unacceptable bath decorum.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这么轻松的感觉下 我真的什么都不在乎了
sense_groups.english: It's so hard to care when you're this relaxed.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你可以洗澡 但我要拿走你的船
sense_groups.english: You can have the bath, but I am taking your boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你是爱洗澡的女生
sense_groups.english: Now you're just a girl in a tub.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨 泡泡澡 太有男子气概了
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hi, bubbles. Manly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想顺道过来告诉你结果
sense_groups.english: I thought I'd let you know how it went.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她说了 - 是她套我的
sense_groups.english: You told her? - She pulled it out of me!

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很会逼别人 结果如何
sense_groups.english: She's like a conversational wizard! How did it go?

sense_groups.chinese: 你错了 他不喜欢我 - 什么
sense_groups.english: You were wrong. He doesn't like me. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你会有什么感觉 如果我把你送到李·梅杰斯的家
sense_groups.english: How would you like it if I told you that Lee Majors liked you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你他喜欢你 你跑进去…
sense_groups.english: ...and I told you he liked you and you went there...

sense_groups.chinese: 发现他并不喜欢你 你会有什么感觉
sense_groups.english: ...and you found out that he didn't like you? How would you feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我不会在乎 - 真的吗 李·梅杰斯很性感
sense_groups.english: I don't think I'd care. - Really? Lee Majors is hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 我们在浴室里
sense_groups.english: Hello? - We're in the bathroom!

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 因为它既轻松又有趣
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because it's a relaxing and enjoyable time!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在这里做什么 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: What are you guys doing in here? - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 他对一个朋友的感觉不一样 但那是不对的
sense_groups.english: A friend he's looking at differently, but it's wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 是瑞秋 - 你喜欢瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's Rachel! - You like Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 那没什么了不起的 菲比跟我谈过
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal. Phoebe and I talked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是冲昏了头 我会清醒过来的
sense_groups.english: It's a crush. It'll go away.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你重点部位的泡泡散开了
sense_groups.english: Dude, you gotta rearrange your bubbles.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜啊
sense_groups.english: Mazel tov.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯跟我在找你们
sense_groups.english: Hey. Oh, hi. Ross and I were looking for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在这里做什么 天啊
sense_groups.english: What are we all doing in here? Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 用船把它盖起来
sense_groups.english: Honey, cover it up with the boat.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都在这里 希望你能加入我们
sense_groups.english: We're all in here, and we'd love for you to join us!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 发生了什么事 很酷的船 不
sense_groups.english: Well, hey! What's going on? Oh, cool boat. Oh, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你告诉他们了吗 - 不 我在等你
sense_groups.english: Did you tell them? - I waited for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我们什么 - 我们怀的是女儿
sense_groups.english: Tell us what? - We're having a girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow! Really? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我待会再加入你们
sense_groups.english: I'll get you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这是全新的一天 我只是被冲昏了头
sense_groups.english: All right. It's a new day. And it's just a crush.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我冲昏了头
sense_groups.english: That's all. Just a little crush.

sense_groups.chinese: 我到底在担心什么 那太疯狂了
sense_groups.english: All that worrying I was doing? That was crazy. Crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小鸟朋友会说 "那跟疯子一样“
sense_groups.english: Like my friend the bird here would say, "It was cuckoo!"

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都会没事 我只是冲昏了头
sense_groups.english: Everything's gonna be fine. It's just a crush.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 甜心 - 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Hi, sweetie. - I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能一起这么做 真的很棒吧
sense_groups.english: It's nice to do this together, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你让我感觉很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And what you're doing feels so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有碰你 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: I'm not touching you. - You're not?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是浴盐 - 天啊 那是愉悦新领域
sense_groups.english: It's the salts. - Sweet Lord, new realms of pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要能让你忘了阳台的事就行了 大男人
sense_groups.english: Whatever keeps you off the balcony, big guy.

questions.name: S08E14
questions.en:
Hey. What's up? - I left my guitar here again.
Oh, okay. No problem.
Okay. Here you go. - Okay.
Okay, um...
What? - You want to hang out or something?
Phoebe, you caught me at a bad time.
Oh, are you and Chandler...? - Yes. Exactly.
Okay. Want me to play for you? - No.
Hey, Pheebs, what's up?
You ask an intriguing question, Chandler Bing.
Oh, my God! You're getting a massage? You never let me massage you.
Phoebe, I can explain. - You told me you hate massages.
Buy stamps. Pick up dry cleaning. Don't let Phoebe in.
I can't believe this. How long has this been going on?
Well, uh, Alexandra has... - Oh, it has a name?
Phoebe, don't get upset.
Okay. Oh, too late! I'm leaving. Come on, Chandler, let's go.
Well, I thought I'd...
Yeah, what the hell.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Okay, come on. One more push.
Come on, we're almost there.
Joey, I'm so happy things worked out for us and we're having this baby together.
I love you so much. - Oh, I love you too.
Mm. I hope it's not an inappropriate time to say this...
...but you're the best sex I've ever had.
That's always appropriate.
Okay, come on, one more push. One more push.
There we go.
Here is your beautiful baby. Congratulations.

sense_groups.english: No reason. I keep private things in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我搬到这里来一阵子了
sense_groups.english: You know, I've been living here a while...

sense_groups.chinese: 从来没看过里面的东西
sense_groups.english: ...and I've never seen what's in that closet.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面放了什么
sense_groups.english: What is in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 女人的东西
sense_groups.english: Feminine stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 别想用女人的东西来唬我
sense_groups.english: Don't try to make me uncomfortable with feminine stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 那里面没有你喜欢的东西 如果你爱我 忘了这件事
sense_groups.english: Nothing in there concerns you. If you love me, you'll just let it go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 今天天气真好 是你
sense_groups.english: Hello, Chandler. Lovely day, huh? You.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有帮助的话 亚丽珊卓已经帮她按摩了三年
sense_groups.english: If it helps, Alexandra's only been massaging Monica for, like, three years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说如果有帮助的话
sense_groups.english: If! I said, if it helps.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不让我帮你按摩
sense_groups.english: Why won't you let me massage you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会无法放松
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, it's... I'd be self-conscious.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我的朋友 我得脱光衣服
sense_groups.english: You're my friend. I'd be naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们住在一起那么多年 我看过你没穿衣服
sense_groups.english: We lived together for years. I've seen you naked.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不一样 我们是室友 那是什么时候的事
sense_groups.english: That's different. We were roommates. And when?

sense_groups.chinese: 我对人体很好奇
sense_groups.english: I'm curious about the human body.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以了解为什么我会觉得很奇怪
sense_groups.english: You can understand why this would be weird for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是专家 我真的很厉害
sense_groups.english: I'm a professional and I'm really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你觉得不舒服 我们就停止 给我一个机会 拜托
sense_groups.english: If you're uncomfortable, we can stop. Just give me a chance, okay? Please?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你真的觉得很重要
sense_groups.english: Okay, if it means that much to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 如果你无法分享你的厨艺 你会有什么感觉
sense_groups.english: It does. How would you feel if you couldn't share your cooking?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果罗斯没办法教我们龙的事 他会有什么感觉
sense_groups.english: Or imagine how Ross would feel if he couldn't teach us about dragons.

sense_groups.chinese: 是恐龙 - 都一样
sense_groups.english: Dinosaurs. - Potato, "potato."

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 宝宝在踢
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Ross, the baby's kicking.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 是吗
sense_groups.english: What? It is?

sense_groups.chinese: 她现在没有在踢我
sense_groups.english: It's not kicking right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我们很想 看到你再做一次
sense_groups.english: Although we would love to see you do that again.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: When was it kicking? What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我跑到乔伊的房间 他在睡觉
sense_groups.english: Last night. I felt it. I went into Joey's room, and he was sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有做梦
sense_groups.english: A dreamless sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 宝宝会踢了 真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: My God, the baby's kicking. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我可以摸到宝宝第一次踢你的样子
sense_groups.english: I wish I would have been there to feel the kicking for the first time.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你真的想摸 我的肚子正在咕咕叫
sense_groups.english: I got some stuff going on in here if you want to feel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想再错过宝宝的事了 这是我新的呼叫器号码
sense_groups.english: I don't want to miss any more baby stuff. Here's my pager number.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要发生跟怀孕有关的事 立刻通知我
sense_groups.english: Anytime anything pregnancy-related happens, use it. I'll be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎那是凌晨三点 而你想吃冰淇淋
sense_groups.english: I don't care if it's 3 in the morning and you want ice cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能抄一份吗
sense_groups.english: Wow. Can I get a copy of that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你裹着床单吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Are you under the sheet? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们开始吧
sense_groups.english: Great, let's begin.

sense_groups.chinese: 力道还可以吧
sense_groups.english: How's the pressure?

sense_groups.chinese: 很不错 菲比 你真的很厉害
sense_groups.english: It's nice. Wow, Phoebe, you are good.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显 谢谢你的夸奖
sense_groups.english: Stating the obvious, but thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那一点都不奇怪 对吧 - 没错
sense_groups.english: And it's not weird, is it? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 好好享受吧
sense_groups.english: That's right, you just enjoy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那样 就是那里
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's it! That's it, right there! Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓 我没有试着打开你的柜子
sense_groups.english: I wasn't trying to open your closet. I wasn't trying, I swear.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡管你很严 对吧 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: Wow. Monica runs a pretty tight ship here, doesn't she? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡有秘密衣柜 她不肯让我看它
sense_groups.english: Monica has a secret closet. She won't let me see what's in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why not? - I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 她在隐瞒什么
sense_groups.english: What could she possibly be hiding in here what I can't see?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说是理查
sense_groups.english: I'll bet it's Richard.

sense_groups.chinese: 她为什么要把理查关在那里
sense_groups.english: Why would Monica be keeping Richard in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: Well, off the top of my head, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 或者她想鱼与熊掌兼得
sense_groups.english: ...maybe she's having her cake and eating it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是"熊掌" 理查只是"鱼"
sense_groups.english: You being the "cake," Richard being the "too."

sense_groups.chinese: 或是… - 又来了
sense_groups.english: Or... - And here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过一部电影里有一扇门
sense_groups.english: I saw this movie once where there was a door.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人知道里面藏了什么
sense_groups.english: Nobody knew what was behind it.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后他们把门打开后 好几百万只虫跑了出来…
sense_groups.english: And when they finally got it open, millions and millions of bugs came pouring out...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会吃人肉
sense_groups.english: ...and they feasted on human flesh!

sense_groups.chinese: 尊重你老婆的隐私 不会要你的命
sense_groups.english: You know, it wouldn't kill you to respect your wife's privacy!

sense_groups.chinese: 塞满虫的笨衣柜
sense_groups.english: Stupid closet full of bugs!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我觉得怪怪的 那不是好事 我不…
sense_groups.english: Joey, something feels weird and not good weird. I don't... Whoa!

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我妹妹怀孕时…
sense_groups.english: Whoa! Don't worry. When my sisters were pregnant...

sense_groups.chinese: 她们都觉得怪怪的 结果根本没事
sense_groups.english: ...they got every weird feeling and it was always nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Really? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们得到医院检查一下 我会呼叫罗斯
sense_groups.english: But we'll stop by the hospital just to be sure. I'll page Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 天啊
sense_groups.english: Okay, oh, God... Ow.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 看着我 一切都会没事的
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, Rach, look at me. Everything's gonna be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 相信我 握着我的手 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Trust me. Take my hand. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我快骨折了
sense_groups.english: Ow! Crushing bones!

sense_groups.chinese: 还好我们要去医院
sense_groups.english: Good thing we're going to a hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果呢 - 她没事
sense_groups.english: Hey. So? - She's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 她出现不规则的子宫收缩
sense_groups.english: She was experiencing Braxton Hicks contractions.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是子宫壁出现中度不适的现象
sense_groups.english: Mild discomfort in the uterine wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 中度不适 我想你也出现过那种现象
sense_groups.english: Mild discomfort? I take it you've had one of these Braxton thingies?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都很正常 - 对
sense_groups.english: Everything is normal? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有危险 - 对
sense_groups.english: There's no danger to her or the baby? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 收缩虽然会不舒服 但她没事
sense_groups.english: Contractions can be unnerving if you don't know, but she's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 医生 谢谢你这么温和冷静
sense_groups.english: Thank you, doctor. And thank you for being nice and calm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一点都不冷静 我从来没有这么害怕过
sense_groups.english: Calm? I wasn't calm! I've never been more scared in my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说一切都会没事的 - 我知道什么 我不是医生
sense_groups.english: You said everything was okay. - What do I know? I'm not a doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 但一切都没事 我没事 - 你确定
sense_groups.english: But everything is okay. I'm fine. - You sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我真希望那个医生的子宫也会收缩
sense_groups.english: Yes. I got half a mind to contract that doctor's uterus.

sense_groups.chinese: 中度不适 他到底在胡说什么
sense_groups.english: Mild discomfort! What's he talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事吧 - 没事
sense_groups.english: Is everything okay? - Everything's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呼叫我说"赶到医院来" 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Your page said, "Come to the hospital." What happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 她出现不规则的子宫收缩
sense_groups.english: Something called Braxton Hicks contraction.

sense_groups.chinese: 那没什么大不了的 很多女人都不会有感觉
sense_groups.english: That's no big deal. Most women don't feel them.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有子宫的人不能置评
sense_groups.english: Okay, no uterus, no opinion.

sense_groups.chinese: 糖果是怎么一回事
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, what's with the candy?

sense_groups.chinese: 你呼叫我时我在电影院买零食
sense_groups.english: When you beeped me I was at the concession stand at the movies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己去看电影 - 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: You went to the movies by yourself? - No... Mona!

sense_groups.chinese: 我得回检查室去 - 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Oh, I gotta go back in there. - Why? What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得… - 不 告诉我 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Everything's fine, I just gotta... - No, really, tell me. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我忘了穿内裤
sense_groups.english: Look, I forgot my underwear.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你送她来医院
sense_groups.english: So thanks so much for bringing her to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 那没有什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, don't worry about it. No big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 但应该是由我送她来 我是孩子的爸
sense_groups.english: But still, it should have been me. I'm the dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你有问题
sense_groups.english: If you have questions...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是不规则收缩的资料 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: ...here's information on Braxton Hicks. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你送她过来是对的
sense_groups.english: And by the way, you did the right thing by bringing her in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会是个好爸爸
sense_groups.english: You're gonna make a wonderful father.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有这家伙厉害 他买了糖果
sense_groups.english: Hey, not as good as this guy. He brought Twizzlers.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会有办法 - 别紧张 寇克船长
sense_groups.english: There has got to be a way. - Easy there, Captain Kirk.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有小别针吗 - 有
sense_groups.english: Oh, do you have a bobby pin? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等一下 我不是九岁的小女孩
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, wait. I'm not a 9-year-old girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你投球的时候很像
sense_groups.english: Then why do you throw like one?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许摩妮卡有小别针 - 对 "摩妮卡"
sense_groups.english: Maybe Monica has a bobby pin. - Oh, sure, "Monica."

sense_groups.chinese: 你暗恋瑞秋的事 怎么了
sense_groups.english: So how's the hideously inappropriate crush on Rachel coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很不错 我应该随时准备好自杀
sense_groups.english: Really good. I should be ready to kill myself any day now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这么快就发现了
sense_groups.english: Well, you sure found that quick.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我从没有爱过瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I just wish I didn't feel this way about Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望一切能恢复正常
sense_groups.english: I wish things could go back to normal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢跟她一起住 帮助她生产真的很有趣
sense_groups.english: I mean, I love living with her, and helping out with the baby is amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我觉得罗斯觉得自己被排除在外
sense_groups.english: But now I think Ross feels left out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我送瑞秋去医院时
sense_groups.english: You know? When I had to take Rachel to the hospital...

sense_groups.chinese: 医生以为我是孩子的爸
sense_groups.english: ...the doctor thought I was the father. God, you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该看看罗斯的表情
sense_groups.english: You should have seen the look on Ross' face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我在做什么
sense_groups.english: By the way, I have no idea what I'm doing here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道我越开锁得越紧
sense_groups.english: For all I know, I'm locking it more.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想拿信用卡打开它吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, you try opening it with a credit card?

sense_groups.chinese: 好点子 - 对
sense_groups.english: That's a good idea. Okay. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯很难过
sense_groups.english: So, uh, Ross is kind of bummed, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很难过 - 那不是你的错
sense_groups.english: I ju... I feel terrible. - It's not your fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要怎么做 不送她去医院
sense_groups.english: What are you gonna do, not take her to the hospital?

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有做错事
sense_groups.english: You're doing nothing wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你不该爱上怀了他孩子的女人
sense_groups.english: Except for harboring an all-consuming love for the woman carrying his baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 理查 如果你在里面 麻烦你把信用卡还我
sense_groups.english: Richard, if you're in there, could you pass me my credit card?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你昨天真的很棒 按摩感觉很舒服
sense_groups.english: I gotta tell you, yesterday was amazing. That massage felt so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我了解
sense_groups.english: No, no, I got that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能每星期按摩一次吗
sense_groups.english: So, um, what do you say we make it a weekly appointment?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你应该知道我的时薪调成两百块了
sense_groups.english: You should know though, I've, um, raised my rates to $200 an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 我是说五百块
sense_groups.english: Okay. - I mean 500.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 六百块
sense_groups.english: What? - 600.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么回事
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我按摩你时 你会发出性爱叫声
sense_groups.english: Oh, you make sex noises when you get massaged.

sense_groups.chinese: 那把我吓坏了
sense_groups.english: And it really freaked me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后我想弄痛你 你叫得更大声
sense_groups.english: After a while, I even tried to hurt you and it just spurred you on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你疯了 我的叫声一点都不淫荡
sense_groups.english: What? You're crazy. There's nothing sexual about the noises I make.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一点都不淫荡
sense_groups.english: Really? There's nothing sexual about this?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! Oh, oh, oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看什么
sense_groups.english: What are you looking at?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 嗨
sense_groups.english: I mean, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太丢脸了 我永远都不会再按摩了
sense_groups.english: This is so embarrassing. I'm never gonna get massaged again.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让这件事害你放弃按摩
sense_groups.english: No, you can't let this stop you from getting massages.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有很多客人也会发出那种叫声
sense_groups.english: Look, I have lots of clients that make the same noises you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 他们不是客人 他们是情人
sense_groups.english: Really? - Well, not clients. Lovers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再试一次 再来找我 我们会想出办法的
sense_groups.english: Let's just... We'll try it again. Come back, and we'll work through it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定 - 对
sense_groups.english: You sure? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜是吧 - 太棒了 对不起
sense_groups.english: I guess. - Great! Now, if you'll just excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到你喜欢的声音了吗
sense_groups.english: So did you hear something you liked?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你看 我学到新把戏了
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross, check it out! I learned a new trick. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你买了午餐
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, I brought you some lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太贴心了 真好吃
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet of you. Oh, yum.

sense_groups.chinese: 你放了腌黄瓜吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Did you put pickles on this? - Well, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 瑞秋 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What? What? Rach, what?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事 - 我帮她带了腌黄瓜鲔鱼三明治
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - I made her favorite, tuna with pickle.

sense_groups.chinese: 腌黄瓜 那会让她想吐
sense_groups.english: Pickle? Pickle makes her sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 让她吃腌黄瓜就像让我吃沙拉
sense_groups.english: Giving her pickle is like giving me salad.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我不知道 你还好吗
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I didn't know. You gonna be okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'll be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不在的时候 麻烦谁解决掉它
sense_groups.english: But someone make sure that sandwich is gone when I get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在吃了
sense_groups.english: I'm on it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不该让她吐的
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. I shouldn't be the one making her throw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁都可以做出这种事 - 你就不会 你了解她
sense_groups.english: Dude, relax. It could happen to anyone. - Not to you. You know this stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我什么都不懂 而我是孩子的爸
sense_groups.english: I don't know any of it and I'm the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我能多参与一点
sense_groups.english: I just... I wish I could be more involved, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人在帮我记录的话 我绝不会再吃鲔鱼了
sense_groups.english: Well, if anyone is keeping score, I no longer eat tuna.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能跟你们谈一谈吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, can I talk to you guys for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以啊 - 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 坐吧 我想谈谈我们的情况
sense_groups.english: Well... Sit down. I wanna talk about our situation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要跟我们分手吗
sense_groups.english: Are you breaking up with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说的是…
sense_groups.english: The thing is...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我跟瑞秋一起住 我参与了很多事
sense_groups.english: ...because I live with Rachel, I'm here for a lot of the stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗斯…
sense_groups.english: Okay, and Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯错过了一切 所以…
sense_groups.english: Ross is missing everything. So...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个应该住在一起
sense_groups.english: Maybe you two should live together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我搬出来 你不要我住在这里
sense_groups.english: Are you asking me to move out? Do you not want me here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我喜欢跟你一起住 只不过…
sense_groups.english: No, I love living with you. It just seems that...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你需要室友 他最好是孩子的爸
sense_groups.english: ...if you're gonna have a roommate, it may as well be the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我想罗斯不希望
sense_groups.english: But, Joey, I don't think Ross wants me to move in to his apartment...

sense_groups.chinese: 我搬过去干扰他的生活
sense_groups.english: ...and disrupt his life like that. I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他想那么做
sense_groups.english: Or he does.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意照顾你跟宝宝
sense_groups.english: I would love to be around for you and the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可试试看 先试一阵子
sense_groups.english: We can just try it, like on a temporary basis.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是你跟我 - 我们不会有成情牵扯
sense_groups.english: But it's you and me. - It wouldn't be anything romantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在和蒙娜交柱 该死 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: And I'm dating Mona. Damn it, Mona!

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟她约好一小时前要见面 我是怎么了
sense_groups.english: I was supposed to meet her an hour ago. What is wrong with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们觉得呢
sense_groups.english: So, what do you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 那很疯狂吗 - 不
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Is it crazy? - No. No, it's not...

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 这是个聪明点子
sense_groups.english: Joey, this is a smart idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该想到的
sense_groups.english: Well, I was due.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这么办吧 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's do it. I'll move in. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rach, that's great. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 还不错 我用我太太的工具…
sense_groups.english: Not too shabby. I got this all off myself...

sense_groups.chinese: 把自己弄成这个样子
sense_groups.english: ...using my wife's tools.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么把它打开的
sense_groups.english: How did you get in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 你很不整洁
sense_groups.english: You're messy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不该看到这个的 - 我娶了收集狂
sense_groups.english: No! You weren't supposed to see this! - I married Fred Sanford.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你不了解
sense_groups.english: No, Chandler, you don't understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 现在你知道了 我很病态
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay, fine! Now you know. Okay? I'm sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 老婆 你不病态 我爱你不是因为你做事有条不紊
sense_groups.english: No, honey, you're not sick. I don't love you because you're organized.

sense_groups.chinese: 不论如何 我都爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you in spite of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你发誓不会告诉任何人 - 对
sense_groups.english: Promise you won't tell anyone? - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 如果我有多余的东西 可以一起用那个柜子吗
sense_groups.english: Now that I know, if I've got extra stuff lying around, can we share the closet?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…那只是…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, it's just, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我怕你会把它弄乱
sense_groups.english: I'm afraid you might mess it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋搬出去了 你还好吧
sense_groups.english: So Rachel's all moved out, huh? How you taking it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要喝几瓶啤酒…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, I wanted to have a few beers...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我把啤酒都丢了 因为瑞秋受不了那个味道
sense_groups.english: ...but, uh, I got rid of those because Rachel couldn't stand the smell of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我买了很多加钙的柳橙汁
sense_groups.english: I have thrown back a lot of orange juice with calcium though.

sense_groups.chinese: 它已经过期了几星期 所以会有点酸味
sense_groups.english: And, uh, it's a couple weeks past its expiration date, so it's got a bit of a kick.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧 - 你在开玩笑吗 我棒透了
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - You kidding me? Yeah, I'm great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好到不能再好 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm, uh... I'm better than great. I am good.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在她离开了
sense_groups.english: Now that she's gone, I can, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以做以前不能做的事
sense_groups.english: I can do all the stuff around here that I couldn't do before. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 譬如…
sense_groups.english: Like, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我又能脱光衣服乱跑了
sense_groups.english: I can walk around naked again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以…
sense_groups.english: You know? I can, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以在客厅看色情片
sense_groups.english: I can watch porn in the living room. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这对我来说是件好事
sense_groups.english: This is, uh... This is good for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢一个人过生活 我喜欢这个样子
sense_groups.english: I like being on my own. I'm better off this way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是一匹孤独的野狼
sense_groups.english: I'm a... I'm a lone wolf.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个完全孤单的硬汉
sense_groups.english: A loner. Alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 永远都是一个人
sense_groups.english: All alone. Forever.

sense_groups.chinese: 狼要怎么做才能得到一个拥抱呢
sense_groups.english: What's a wolf gotta do to get a hug around here?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 放轻松
sense_groups.english: That's it, just relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 加油 再来 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Come on, more. - Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢那样 对吧
sense_groups.english: You like that, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 就是那样 - 你要吗 我就给你 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Yeah, right there. - Want it there? Take it there, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 对 叫我的名字 快点
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? - Yeah, say my name. Say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我要帮你盖上被子
sense_groups.english: And now I'm going to cover you back up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会有好几个星期不会再跟你说话
sense_groups.english: And, um, I won't be speaking with you for several weeks.

questions.name: S08E15
questions.en:
Oh! Hey, Rach! - Hi.
Happy Valentine's Day! - You too!
Hey, so, uh, how's it going living over at Ross'?
It's good, except he makes us watch the Discovery Channel all day long.
Did you know that something really boring...
...happened to someone really ugly in the Middle Ages?
Thank you. See you guys later. - Okay.
Bye. - Bye.
That is one lucky to-go cup of coffee.
Oh, honey.
I wish you'd get over her. I hate seeing you like this.
Is there anything I can do for you? Do you wanna look down my top?
Thanks. Maybe later.
Oh, Gunther, can I get a scone? - You want anything?
You know what I want? I want a lot of things.
I wanna be with the woman I love on Valentine's Day!
I want her to love me back.
And I want one moment of relief...
...from the gut-wrenching pain of knowing that's never gonna happen!
We have red bagels.
Okay.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
So how does Mona feel about you and Rachel living together?
I'm on my way to tell her right now.
She's been away all week visiting parents, but she'll be cool.
She's been so supportive.
She even got the baby a tiny T-shirt that says, "Fossils are my friends."
Ugh, come on, Mona. Don't kiss ass.
So, uh, I'm gonna take off. - All right.
Oh, shoot! Oh, shoot! Uh, Rachel wanted to see this tape.
What is it? - A video of my friend giving birth.
Could you bring it back to your apartment? - All right.
"Candy and Cookie"?
Yeah, Candy's the mother, Cookie's the daughter.
The father's name is also Cookie.
Why am I friends with these people?
Phoebe, come here. I wanna show you something in the bathroom.
Ugh, Monica, grow up.
What do you got behind your back? - Nothing.
Just something I want Phoebe's opinion on for Valentine's Day.
You don't want my opinion? - Not really.
Come on, I'm your older brother. Ask me.
Oh, okay, big brother. Um...
Which one would make your little sister look hotter...
...so your best friend would want to do her?
The red one.
Hey.
I know you've been depressed lately, so I brought someone to cheer you up.
Right outside this door is a real, live, furry playmate.
No, I'm not sleeping with your friend Jane again.
Hey, a dog! Oh, hi!
Who, you gotta admit, looks a lot like Jane.
This is the happiest dog in the world. I borrowed him from my friend Wendy.
So you can keep him until he cheers you up. And he will cheer you up.
Thanks so much, Pheebs.
We are gonna have so much fun! Yes we are!
Oh, not that kind of fun.
Happy Valentine's! - Hey!
I'll be right out.
I'm slipping into something a little less comfortable and a little more slutty.
"Candy and Cookie"?
"Candy and Cookie"?
Monica got me porn?
Girl-on-girl porn?
She really must love me!
Yeah, just relax. - I love you, St. Valentine.
Whoa, whoa, that's not pretty.
Now push!
Ow! Oh, God, it hurts!
Worst porn ever! Worst porn ever!
Oh, make it stop! - I am trying!
Get the ball. Ready? Get the ball!
You're cute, but you're not too smart.
Yeah. Did I just throw this?
Hi. - Hi.
I accidentally packed these with my stuff.
Who is this? - That's, uh, Phoebe's friend's dog.
I don't know his real name. I call him Mozzarella.
Ohh, you are so cute. I wish I could play with you more, but I've gotta go to work.
I hope I stop talking like this before my marketing meeting. Yes, I do.
Bye-bye, Joey. Seriously, I can't stop it.
Come here! Hey!
Hey. That's Rachel. She's the one who used to live here.
Might as well be honest with you. We love her.
But we can't have her. No.
I really miss her.
Hey, you understand, right? You're a guy.
Well, you used to be.
So, what do you think?
I've still got it.
Why did you get me this? - What is it?
It's yelling, bleeding, dilating.
Oh, the dilating!
Is this the video of the baby being born? This is Phoebe's.
Why were you even watching it?
I thought maybe you got me porn for Valentine's Day.
Chandler, if you thought I was gonna get you porn for Valentine's Day...
...you were right.
Apparently, it's about a girl who moves to the city in search of stardom...
...but ends up having sex with a lot of guys.
It got four stars.
Oh, wait a minute. Those aren't stars.
Anyway, you wanna take a look? - Well...
I'm not really in a sexy mood right now. - Hey, what's going on?
Well, remember the first time you saw Jaws...
...how long it took to go back in the water?
Chandler, we can't let this tape wreck Valentine's Day.
You don't know. You didn't see it. - Childbirth is a natural thing. It's beautiful.
Oh, beautiful? Really? Huh, really?
You think this is beautiful?
Oh, my God! No wonder my mother hates me!
See, honey, there's... - Don't touch me!
Hi! - Hey!
Hi. - Hi.
So how was Atlantic City? - Good.
I brought you back a present. - What...?
Come on, you didn't have to...
Saltwater taffy?
Thanks.
It's interesting, most people think this is made with seawater.
But it's actually made with, uh, salted fresh water.
That's not interesting.
I think it's interesting. - I do too. I missed you!
Me too. How was your week? - Oh, it was good.
Actually, the baby started kicking. - How exciting.
Yeah, aw. It was amazing.
The only sad thing is, I wasn't around when it happened the first time.
Oh, no. - I was missing out on all this stuff.
Joey suggested Rachel move in with me. - Ha, ha. Yeah, right.
What? - Joey cracks me up.
"Yeah, have your ex-wife move in. That wouldn't be awkward at all." Heh.
Hey, imagine, I go away for a few days...
...I come back and my boyfriend is living with some woman he got pregnant.
So, what'd you tell him?
How could you not tell Mona that Rachel is living with you?
I don't know. She seemed to think it was such a crazy idea.
Plus, she, uh... She got me taffy.
Taffy, really? I've never had any. - Ever?
My mother was too busy planning her suicide to provide saltwater treats.
Thank you.
So are you just never gonna tell her?
No, no, I will. I just want to butter her up first.
I'm gonna take her to an amazing Valentine's dinner...
...do all this romantic stuff.
And then, when she thinks I'm the best boyfriend in the world...
...then I tell her my pregnant ex-girlfriend is living with me.
If I haven't said it before, she's a lucky, lucky lady.
So where are...? What the mother of crap is up with this stuff?
God, is it gum? Is it food? What's the deal?
Oh, it's nice. May I try a pink one?
So between her and me being friends, and her history with Ross...
...it just isn't gonna happen.
It'd be like you falling in love with a cat.
Hey. - Hey.
Hey, buddy. How's my favorite dog, huh? How's my favorite dog?
You're subdued.
Did you give him a beer? - No.
Will you excuse us? We need to talk. - Sure.
Oh, me, right.
He's miserable. What happened to him? - Nothing.
We just talked about stuff. - What stuff?
Rachel stuff.
Oh, Joey, you bummed him out! This is the happiest dog in the world.
He spends a day with you, and look at him.
He's breathing.
I'll take him back to Wendy's. - No, no, no. He's fine.
Hey, look. Look.
Here's your ball! Get the ball!
Get your ball! Get your ball! Get your ball!
Get... God, what have I done to you? Huh?
I broke the dog, Pheebs! I broke the dog!
I'm, uh, going to pick up Mona. What you got going on tonight?
Oh, I've got big Valentine's plans.
I've got Chinese food on the way, and the rest of your saltwater taffy.
It's interesting. Most people think that's made with seawater, when in fact...
Ross, we actually watched the documentary together.
Oh, my Chinese food. I'll get my cash.
Mona?
What are...? Hi! - Hi.
What are you doing here? I'm supposed to pick you up.
Change of plans, I made you a Valentine's dinner. Surprise!
Oh! Hey, Mona! - Hi... Hi, Rachel.
What's she doing here?
I have no idea.
I'll be watching TV if anybody needs me.
Seriously, what is she doing?
Uh, you know, lately she just likes hanging out here.
Why? - I think she's lonely.
But it's Valentine's Day. - I know.
Can't we ask her to go?
Well, no, she's way too emotional.
And by emotional, I mean crazy!
I'm not here! That's just my Chinese food.
Oh, my God, she has food delivered here?
Mm-hm, yes, she's emotional, but ballsy.
You know what? I'm gonna get in my sweats and eat this in bed.
And you thought she was gonna be in our way!
Okay, why don't you, uh, open the champagne, and I will be right back.
I've got a surprise for you. - You got another ex-wife back there?
Ho, oh! Heh. Please start drinking.
I'm just gonna grab the phone. - Oh, Rachel, wait. Hey, um...
I hope you don't take this the wrong way, but, um...
What are you doing? - Sorry, do you need the phone?
No. No.
Listen, Ross is too nice to say anything, but this is his apartment.
And we gotta have some boundaries.
So why don't you go to your place and give us some privacy?
But, Mona, I live here.
Happy Valentine's Day!
Or, something to remember me by.
How long has it been this time? - Ninety seconds.
That's better. Ninety seconds is a long time not to think about it.
Except all I did was think about it.
I know. It haunts me.
Up until now, the worst thing I ever saw...
...was my father doing tequila shots off the naked houseboy.
After this, I would gladly make that my screen saver.
We have to get past this.
Why don't we get rid of the tape and pretend it never existed.
I could do that. - Okay.
Okay, now all we gotta do is get rid of this chair.
Come here.
Oh, thank God! - I know.
Come in!
Hi. I'm sorry to barge in on your Valentine.
I had to get away from the yelling. Mona is dumping Ross.
Oh, my God. - Poor Ross.
Oh, great. We have to watch him do yoga in his underwear...
...but for this he closes the drapes.
Rach, you know that birthing tape you wanted to see?
It's here.
Oh, and we should warn you before you watch it. Don't watch it.
Why, you saw it? Is it scary?
Let's just say it's ironic how footage of someone being born...
...can make you want to kill yourself.
Now, wait, now I'm all freaked out. You guys will watch it with me?
No, but I will leave a sweater that smells like me right next to you.
Come on, seriously, you're not gonna make me watch this alone.
She's right. Of course not.
Honey, get the tape.
This reminds me of a very specific part of the tape.
Okay. Here we go.
Okay. Ahem.
Oh, my.
All right, baby. One more time.
Why is that baby torturing that woman?
Why have I seen this thing three times?
It's still beautiful.
Aah! It's horrible! - I know, I know!
I'm so sorry for you! - Oh, my God!
You guys! You guys, look! - What? Did her ass explode?
No, the baby's out. Look. Look.
Look at those little fingers and toes.
And look how happy the mom is now.
Oh, Rach. - Screw you! You don't have to do it!
Hey. - Hey! What...
What's up? - Uh, Mona just dumped me.
Oh, man, I'm sorry. Why?
With everything going on lately, I haven't exactly been the perfect boyfriend.
I didn't tell her I got Rachel pregnant.
I gave her a key to my apartment and then had the locks changed.
Then I lied to her about Rachel moving in with me.
In a way, I judge her for not breaking up with me sooner.
That really sucks. Especially on Valentine's Day.
Yeah. Wait a minute. What are you doing here?
Joey Tribbiani without a date on Valentine's Day?
What's going on, huh? Girl trouble? Heh.
Sort of. Ha, ha. - Really?
You don't have to seem so happy about it.
Sorry. Well, uh, maybe I can help. - Oh, I...
Whatever it is, I am sure it has happened to me.
You know, actually, once I got dumped during sex.
So anyway, uh, what is it? - Forget about it. It's no big deal.
Come on, what is it? - It's nothing.
Hey, it's me. Why can't you tell me?
Okay. Uh, sit down. Um...
There's this woman that I like a lot.
But, uh, it can't happen.
She's not a Tribbiani?
No!
So, uh... So is she someone from work?
Yes.
Well, um, does she like you?
Sometimes I think maybe she could.
But it doesn't matter, I can't do anything about it.
Why not?
It's complicated.
She was with this other guy. For a long time.
Someone from work too.
And, uh...
I could never do that to the guy. We're friends.
So, uh, this guy she used to go out with, is he still in love with her?
No, I don't think so. - Okay.
Is he a good guy?
Yeah, he's the best.
Then talk to him. He might be fine. - I don't know.
It's worth finding out, if you really like her.
I do, so much.
I can't stop thinking about her. I can't sleep...
Okay, Joey, you know what? You have to go for it.
How often does this happen to you? You owe it to yourself.
Here's your warm milk.
I'm gonna put the bourbon in it at home.
Anyway, seriously, just talk to the guy, okay?
Let me know how it goes.
It's Rachel.
You're gonna have a baby and you need to be prepared.
You're gonna make yourself watch the whole thing. Just do it!
Heh, I came to the big city to become a star.
I'll do anything to make that happen. - Anything?
Hmm. Maybe it starts with how she gets pregnant.
