sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你害得他很难过 他是全世界最快乐的狗
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey, you bummed him out! This is the happiest dog in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 他才跟你相处一天 你看
sense_groups.english: He spends a day with you, and look at him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还在呼吸
sense_groups.english: He's breathing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要带他去温蒂家 - 不要 他没事
sense_groups.english: I'll take him back to Wendy's. - No, no, no. He's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: Hey, look. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你的球 快去接球
sense_groups.english: Here's your ball! Get the ball!

sense_groups.chinese: 去接球 去接球
sense_groups.english: Get your ball! Get your ball! Get your ball!

sense_groups.chinese: 去…天啊 我对你做了什么
sense_groups.english: Get... God, what have I done to you? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我害死那只狗了 菲比 我把他弄得精神崩溃了
sense_groups.english: I broke the dog, Pheebs! I broke the dog!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去接蒙娜 今晚你要做什么
sense_groups.english: I'm, uh, going to pick up Mona. What you got going on tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有很棒的情人节计划
sense_groups.english: Oh, I've got big Valentine's plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 我订了中国菜 还有你的咸水太妃糖
sense_groups.english: I've got Chinese food on the way, and the rest of your saltwater taffy.

sense_groups.chinese: 有趣的是 大部分的人认为它是海水做的
sense_groups.english: It's interesting. Most people think that's made with seawater, when in fact...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是一起看那部纪录片的
sense_groups.english: Ross, we actually watched the documentary together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的外卖来了 我去拿钱
sense_groups.english: Oh, my Chinese food. I'll get my cash.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: Mona?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么… 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: What are...? Hi! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么来了 我应该去接你的
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? I'm supposed to pick you up.

sense_groups.chinese: 计划有变 我帮你做了 情人节晚餐 大惊喜
sense_groups.english: Change of plans, I made you a Valentine's dinner. Surprise!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 蒙娜 - 嗨 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Oh! Hey, Mona! - Hi... Hi, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在这里做什么
sense_groups.english: What's she doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I have no idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们要找我 我在房里看电视
sense_groups.english: I'll be watching TV if anybody needs me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在做什么
sense_groups.english: Seriously, what is she doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 最近她喜欢待在这里
sense_groups.english: Uh, you know, lately she just likes hanging out here.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 我想她很寂寞
sense_groups.english: Why? - I think she's lonely.

sense_groups.chinese: 但今天是情人节 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: But it's Valentine's Day. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能请她离开吗
sense_groups.english: Can't we ask her to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 她太激动了
sense_groups.english: Well, no, she's way too emotional.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说她疯了
sense_groups.english: And by emotional, I mean crazy!

sense_groups.chinese: 当我人不在 我的外卖来了
sense_groups.english: I'm not here! That's just my Chinese food.

sense_groups.chinese: 她叫外卖送到这里来
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, she has food delivered here?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她很激动 但也很大胆
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm, yes, she's emotional, but ballsy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去换运动服 躺在床上吃饭
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna get in my sweats and eat this in bed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还以为她会妨碍到我们
sense_groups.english: And you thought she was gonna be in our way!

sense_groups.chinese: 打开香槟 我马上回来
sense_groups.english: Okay, why don't you, uh, open the champagne, and I will be right back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有大惊喜 - 你另一个前妻也藏在里面
sense_groups.english: I've got a surprise for you. - You got another ex-wife back there?

sense_groups.chinese: 请开始喝香槟
sense_groups.english: Ho, oh! Heh. Please start drinking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要打电话 - 瑞秋 等一下
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna grab the phone. - Oh, Rachel, wait. Hey, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你不会误会
sense_groups.english: I hope you don't take this the wrong way, but, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 你要打电话吗
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Sorry, do you need the phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯太好心了 没办法说出口 但这是他的公寓
sense_groups.english: Listen, Ross is too nice to say anything, but this is his apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要隐私
sense_groups.english: And we gotta have some boundaries.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不回你家呢
sense_groups.english: So why don't you go to your place and give us some privacy?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是蒙娜 我住在这里
sense_groups.english: But, Mona, I live here.

sense_groups.chinese: 情人节快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy Valentine's Day!

sense_groups.chinese: 或者这能让你在分手后记得我
sense_groups.english: Or, something to remember me by.

sense_groups.chinese: 这次是多久 - 九十秒
sense_groups.english: How long has it been this time? - Ninety seconds.

sense_groups.chinese: 好多了 没想到九十秒真的很久
sense_groups.english: That's better. Ninety seconds is a long time not to think about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我满脑子都是它
sense_groups.english: Except all I did was think about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我也忘不了
sense_groups.english: I know. It haunts me.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这之前我 看过最糟糕的事
sense_groups.english: Up until now, the worst thing I ever saw...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我爸跟服务生上床
sense_groups.english: ...was my father doing tequila shots off the naked houseboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这之后 我会很乐意把他们的照片做成银幕保护程式
sense_groups.english: After this, I would gladly make that my screen saver.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得忘了这件事
sense_groups.english: We have to get past this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得假装它不存在
sense_groups.english: Why don't we get rid of the tape and pretend it never existed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以那么做 - 好
sense_groups.english: I could do that. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只需要丢掉那张椅子
sense_groups.english: Okay, now all we gotta do is get rid of this chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进
sense_groups.english: Come in!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 破坏了你们的情人节
sense_groups.english: Hi. I'm sorry to barge in on your Valentine.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得远离那些叫骂声 蒙娜要跟罗斯分手
sense_groups.english: I had to get away from the yelling. Mona is dumping Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 可怜的罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - Poor Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们看过他穿内裤做瑜伽
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. We have to watch him do yoga in his underwear...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这次他更惨
sense_groups.english: ...but for this he closes the drapes.

sense_groups.chinese: 关于那卷你想看的生产录影带
sense_groups.english: Rach, you know that birthing tape you wanted to see?

sense_groups.chinese: 它在这里
sense_groups.english: It's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得在你看它之前警告你千万别看它
sense_groups.english: Oh, and we should warn you before you watch it. Don't watch it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看过了 很可怕吗
sense_groups.english: Why, you saw it? Is it scary?

sense_groups.chinese: 讽刺的是 生孩子的画面…
sense_groups.english: Let's just say it's ironic how footage of someone being born...

sense_groups.chinese: 让人想要自杀
sense_groups.english: ...can make you want to kill yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我吓坏了 你们能跟我一起看吗
sense_groups.english: Now, wait, now I'm all freaked out. You guys will watch it with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不能 但我会把有我体味的毛衣放在你旁边
sense_groups.english: No, but I will leave a sweater that smells like me right next to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你们不能逼我一个人看这个
sense_groups.english: Come on, seriously, you're not gonna make me watch this alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说得对 当然不行
sense_groups.english: She's right. Of course not.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 去拿录影带
sense_groups.english: Honey, get the tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我想起了录影带里某一段内容
sense_groups.english: This reminds me of a very specific part of the tape.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 来吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 再来一次
sense_groups.english: All right, baby. One more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么宝宝要折磨那个女人
sense_groups.english: Why is that baby torturing that woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我要看这个玩意三次
sense_groups.english: Why have I seen this thing three times?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是好美
sense_groups.english: It's still beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 好可怕 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Aah! It's horrible! - I know, I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我为你感到难过 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry for you! - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家快看 - 什么 她的屁股爆炸了吗
sense_groups.english: You guys! You guys, look! - What? Did her ass explode?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 宝宝出来了 你们看
sense_groups.english: No, the baby's out. Look. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看那些小手指跟小脚趾
sense_groups.english: Look at those little fingers and toes.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看妈妈现在有多高兴
sense_groups.english: And look how happy the mom is now.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 去你们的 你们又不必生小孩
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rach. - Screw you! You don't have to do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey! What...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 蒙娜刚刚甩了我
sense_groups.english: What's up? - Uh, Mona just dumped me.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我很遗憾 为什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, I'm sorry. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 最近我不是完美男友
sense_groups.english: With everything going on lately, I haven't exactly been the perfect boyfriend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有告诉她我让瑞秋怀孕
sense_groups.english: I didn't tell her I got Rachel pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给她我家的钥匙 然后换了锁
sense_groups.english: I gave her a key to my apartment and then had the locks changed.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我骗她瑞秋搬到我家的事
sense_groups.english: Then I lied to her about Rachel moving in with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 在某方面 我怪她不早点跟我分手
sense_groups.english: In a way, I judge her for not breaking up with me sooner.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很烂 特别是在情人节
sense_groups.english: That really sucks. Especially on Valentine's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你在这里做什么
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Wait a minute. What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊在情人节没有约会
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani without a date on Valentine's Day?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事 你跟女人有麻烦
sense_groups.english: What's going on, huh? Girl trouble? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以那么说 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Sort of. Ha, ha. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必表现得这么高兴
sense_groups.english: You don't have to seem so happy about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 或许我能帮忙 - 噢 我…
sense_groups.english: Sorry. Well, uh, maybe I can help. - Oh, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 不论发生了什么事 我相信我也有相同的经验
sense_groups.english: Whatever it is, I am sure it has happened to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我有次在做爱时被甩了
sense_groups.english: You know, actually, once I got dumped during sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 到底发生了什么事 - 算了 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: So anyway, uh, what is it? - Forget about it. It's no big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 怎么了 - 没事
sense_groups.english: Come on, what is it? - It's nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我耶 你为什么不告诉我
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's me. Why can't you tell me?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 坐下
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh, sit down. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢一个女人
sense_groups.english: There's this woman that I like a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是不可能的
sense_groups.english: But, uh, it can't happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不会是你的姐妹吧
sense_groups.english: She's not a Tribbiani?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是！
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 她是你的同事
sense_groups.english: So, uh... So is she someone from work?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 她喜欢你吗
sense_groups.english: Well, um, does she like you?

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我觉得是的
sense_groups.english: Sometimes I think maybe she could.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我什么事都不能做
sense_groups.english: But it doesn't matter, I can't do anything about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 事情很复杂
sense_groups.english: It's complicated.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟另一个男人交往了很久
sense_groups.english: She was with this other guy. For a long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 他也是我的同事
sense_groups.english: Someone from work too.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后…
sense_groups.english: And, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法那样对他 我们是好朋友
sense_groups.english: I could never do that to the guy. We're friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前跟她交往过的那个男人还爱着她吗
sense_groups.english: So, uh, this guy she used to go out with, is he still in love with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该不爱了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: No, I don't think so. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是好人吗
sense_groups.english: Is he a good guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是最棒的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟他谈一谈 他或许无所谓 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Then talk to him. He might be fine. - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你喜欢她 这值得试一试
sense_groups.english: It's worth finding out, if you really like her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的非常喜欢她
sense_groups.english: I do, so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法不想到她 我睡不着…
sense_groups.english: I can't stop thinking about her. I can't sleep...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你得尽力去争取
sense_groups.english: Okay, Joey, you know what? You have to go for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会常遇到这种事吗 你应该为自己这么做的
sense_groups.english: How often does this happen to you? You owe it to yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的温牛奶来了
sense_groups.english: Here's your warm milk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要回家 加点波本酒
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna put the bourbon in it at home.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 跟那个男的谈一谈 好吗
sense_groups.english: Anyway, seriously, just talk to the guy, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我结果
sense_groups.english: Let me know how it goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: It's Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要生孩子了 你得做好准备
sense_groups.english: You're gonna have a baby and you need to be prepared.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得看完整卷录影带 看吧
sense_groups.english: You're gonna make yourself watch the whole thing. Just do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我来到这个大城市 希望成为大明星
sense_groups.english: Heh, I came to the big city to become a star.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了圆梦我任何事都愿意做 - 任何事
sense_groups.english: I'll do anything to make that happen. - Anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该从她怎么怀孕开始看起
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Maybe it starts with how she gets pregnant.

questions.name: S08E16
questions.en:
I'm sorry, did you just say it's Rachel?
Yes.
Um, you like Rachel?
Yes. I like Rachel.
Rachel?
Yeah. Okay, but look, you know...
You know who else I like? You.
And it doesn't get said enough. I like you, Ross.
"Rachel" Rachel? - It's not a big deal.
It's not a big deal? I'm sorry, I just...
What about the stuff you said?
How you can't stop thinking about her? How you can't sleep?
I'm an actor, you know?
As a group, we tend to be overdramatic.
Rachel-who's-carrying-my-baby Rachel?
I know it's bad. And I know it's wrong, okay?
It's not like anything's ever gonna happen.
These are just feelings. They'll go away.
You know, I gotta go.
Hey, Ross...
You know, I just have one... Rachel?
Rachel?
Rachel?
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Oh, oh! Okay, she's kicking.
She's growing inside you.
That was a big one. - That's the youngest girl to reject me.
You guys! - Hey there.
Let me ask you. Do you believe in soul mates?
Oh, yes, I do.
There's one person out there for everyone.
You know how you find him? Stop looking.
I've stopped looking for Russell Crowe.
He'll find me.
Uh-huh. And you?
No. I believe that, uh, certain people are more suited for each other, but...
Soul mates? I don't think they exist. - Good.
Why? - Well, last night, I met Monica's.
What?
I had a date with this guy. I swear he's her other half.
You don't think there's somebody better suited for Monica than me?
Well, what's he like?
He's tall. He has brown hair. - Of course.
A tall guy with hair similar to mine? Oh, unknowable universe!
He works with food. - Oh, sure. Older?
Obviously. And he's British. - I was just gonna ask!
Yeah? And he's so centered, and mature and confident.
It's so sad they never met.
Luckily, the guy she settled for can't hear you.
Oh, I'm so sorry. Maybe I'm wrong.
We're going out again. I'll find out more.
He's meant for her, and you're gonna date him?
He may not be my soul mate, but a girl's gotta eat.
Hey. - Hey.
I talked to Joey. I wanted to see you.
I still can't believe it. Joey and Rachel?
It's like you and me going out, only weirder.
I know you're hurting...
...but don't say that again.
What if they marry? He'd be the stepfather of my child.
You don't need to worry about.
He'll never tell her how he feels.
If he did, you don't know how she'd react.
Sure, women never like Joey. I think he's a virgin.
He isn't thinking about going for her. - He's not?
All he's thinking about is how you're taking this.
It's freaking him out. He wants to move to Vermont.
Why? - He wants to leave the country.
He thinks you hate him.
Hate him?
No, I don't hate him.
It's just, it's Rachel. You know?
I can't even imagine how hard this must be for you...
...but I don't want you to lose Joey over it.
Right now, he needs to know that you're still his friend.
Okay, I'll talk to him.
I'd do it soon.
He just asked me how to convert his dollars into Vermont money.
Oh, hi! - Hi.
Chandler, Monica, this is Don. - Hello.
Hello, nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you.
Soul mate.
What are you guys doing? - We had lunch at Adriatica.
What's with the sun-dried tomatoes? - I know! Is this 1985?
That's what I said! Isn't it strange? - Not really.
What's wrong with sun-dried tomatoes?
On a barbecued-chicken pizza?
No?
What restaurants do you like? - Octavio. 27-and-7.
There's this place, Alessandro's. - Oh, my God! I'm the chef!
You're kidding! Your food is fantastic!
I want to talk about your menu. Anyone want coffee?
If you're talking about me, I'll go with you.
What are you doing?
I swear, I didn't know you guys would be here.
You don't believe in soul mates, so...
I believe in handsome strangers who hit on my wife.
Just because I think they're soul mates doesn't mean anything'll happen.
Phoebe? Good work. - Yeah?
He's great. I love him.
Don't worry, we'll find you someone else.
Hey. - Hey.
I understand if you came by to hit me. I deserve it.
No, I don't want to hit you.
What, then? Kick me?
No.
Bite me?
I don't want to do anything to you.
I just want to say I'm not mad at you...
...and that I certainly do not hate you.
I just came here to say that.
Hey, wait, Ross?
You wanna come in for a beer or something?
Yeah, sure.
You got any beer?
All I got is melon stuff that Rachel left.
Okay.
You need to understand something.
I am never gonna act on this Rachel thing, okay?
I wouldn't do anything to jeopardize my friendship with you.
Thank you.

What am I gonna say?
Yeah, tell me about it.
I'm phasing out the wine importing and focusing more on the, um, cheese.
Cheese, you say?
That's some pretty smelly work, huh, Don?
Excuse me? - Cheese. It's smelly.
You must smell a lot of the time too.
Uh, not really. But with cheese, I think the smellier, the better.
Me too! Chandler hates it. I can't have blue cheese in the house.
And you're still married to him?
I would like to go to France and eat nothing but bread and cheese.
Not even bread. Just cheese.
No, I want the bread.
And pastries.
And pate.
I'm really not high. I just used to be fat.
I have a villa in the Loire Valley you can stay in.
Is it made of cheese?
No. A house made of cheese, wouldn't that be great?
I'd move in tomorrow! - Oh, come on!
Listen to this! - I'm so sorry.
What do we do? - They both want a house of cheese.
I don't know how you fight that.
Okay, okay. I can do this. I can tell her how I feel.
Okay, stand up straight.
Take a couple deep breaths.
Look confident.
Joey? What's up?
I came by because I want to talk to you about something.
What's up?
Here, in the hall? What are we, animals?
I'm late for a meeting. Could you make it quick?
I just came by to tell you that...
...I want to have dinner with you.
Sure. Just tell me where to meet you. - Okay.
Okay. That's good.
That gives you a couple of hours to prepare.
Don't you people ever knock?
I'd like to have Don and Phoebe over.
Sure. Set it up.
I'll just be browsing through the personals.
Are you okay? You're acting weird.
Yeah. Fine.
Not perfect.
But good enough.
Jeez, what's with you?
I'm sorry, did you say "cheese"?
What's going on? - Phoebe says you and Don are soul mates.
I don't believe in that, but you two get along.
I'll step aside if you wanna go with Don and live in a house of cheese.
You don't believe in soul mates? - No, but I'm sure "tomatoes" does.
I don't believe in soul mates, either.
You don't? - Nope.
We weren't destined to end up together.
We fell in love and work hard at our relationship.
Some days we work really hard.
So you don't want to live with Don in a cheese house?
No, I've had second thoughts. Do you know how hard it'd be to clean?
I love you. - I know.
I'm gonna take you out to dinner.
I found this place that makes the greatest mozzarella sticks and jalapeno poppers.
No? They taste so good.
It happens whenever Chandler touches my stomach.
I'm worried the baby won't like him.
Are you okay? - Yeah, sure.
Uh, look, the reason...
Is it hot in here?
No, not for me. Why don't you take off your sweater?
This is a nice place...
...and my T-shirt has a picture of Calvin doing Hobbes.
Oh, my God, really? Can I see it?
Yeah, sure.
I wouldn't think Hobbes would like that so much.
How long have we known each other?
Um, seven, eight...
Eight years. Wow.
Uh-huh. A long time. - Yeah.
But over the past few weeks, I...
Okay! Sorry about the wait, but it is mega-jammed in here.
Our specials tonight...
Could you give us a second? - Sure.
Second's up!
Not that kind of table.
So you were saying?
I'm not sure.
You asked how long we knew each other, and I said eight years.
Then the waiter came over and cut his tip in half...
...and now here we are.
Yeah. Here we are.
I think I'm falling in love with you.
What?
I'm falling in love with you.
Who are you talking to?
Oh, you're kidding. It's a joke.
Funny. It's funny!
I don't get it.
Okay.
Wow.
Are you, um?
How did, um?
When?
Does it really matter?
Wow. Wow.
It is hot in here.
I know this is a lot.
You don't have to say anything.
You take as much time as you need.
Okay, you gotta say something.
Joey, I love you so much.
But... - But.
Joey?
Right. Hey, that's, uh...
That's okay. That's fine.
It's, uh, pretty much what I was expecting.
It's no big deal, all right?
I think I'm gonna go. - Please don't leave like this.
You can't do this to a pregnant woman!
Don't start doing that.
You can't do that, because you're gonna make me...
Oh, there we go!
Can I? - Sure.
Oh, Joey. I don't want to lose...
Hey, hey.
You can't, okay? Ever.
I'm so sorry.
Please don't be sorry.
Okay? Don't be sorry.
You know, I was only kidding.
Yeah, that was a real good one.
Is this your table? - Yeah.
You'll be here all night. - I know.
I haven't even read the specials.
What's the matter?
I don't know. I think maybe one of them is dying.
I kind of hope it's the girl.
The guy is really cute!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你刚刚说是瑞秋吗
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, did you just say it's Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Um, you like Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我喜欢瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Yes. I like Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 听着 你知道的…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay, but look, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我还喜欢谁吗 你
sense_groups.english: You know who else I like? You.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该要更常说 我喜欢你 罗斯
sense_groups.english: And it doesn't get said enough. I like you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个"瑞秋" - 没什么大不了的
sense_groups.english: "Rachel" Rachel? - It's not a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么大不了的 抱歉 我只是…
sense_groups.english: It's not a big deal? I'm sorry, I just...

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚说的那些话呢
sense_groups.english: What about the stuff you said?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你无法不去想她 你说你睡不着
sense_groups.english: How you can't stop thinking about her? How you can't sleep?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个演员 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: I'm an actor, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 演员习惯了夸张
sense_groups.english: As a group, we tend to be overdramatic.

sense_groups.chinese: 怀着我孩子的瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel-who's-carrying-my-baby Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道那很糟糕 我知道那是不对的 好吗
sense_groups.english: I know it's bad. And I know it's wrong, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不可能会发生的事
sense_groups.english: It's not like anything's ever gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是我的感觉 那会消失的
sense_groups.english: These are just feelings. They'll go away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了
sense_groups.english: You know, I gotta go.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是有个… 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: You know, I just have one... Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 她在踢我
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh! Okay, she's kicking.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在你的体内成长
sense_groups.english: She's growing inside you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一下踢得好用力 - 她是拒绝我最年轻的女孩
sense_groups.english: That was a big one. - That's the youngest girl to reject me.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: You guys! - Hey there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要问你们 你们相信有心灵伴侣吗
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you. Do you believe in soul mates?

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都有失落的另一半
sense_groups.english: There's one person out there for everyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你该怎么找到他吗 停止再找了
sense_groups.english: You know how you find him? Stop looking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经停止寻找罗素·克洛
sense_groups.english: I've stopped looking for Russell Crowe.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会找到我的
sense_groups.english: He'll find me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你呢
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. And you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我相信有些人非常适合彼此 但是…
sense_groups.english: No. I believe that, uh, certain people are more suited for each other, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 心灵伴侣 我想他们并不存在 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Soul mates? I don't think they exist. - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 昨晚我遇到了摩妮卡的心灵伴侣
sense_groups.english: Why? - Well, last night, I met Monica's.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟这个男的约会 我发誓他是她的另一半
sense_groups.english: I had a date with this guy. I swear he's her other half.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得会有人比我更适合摩妮卡吧
sense_groups.english: You don't think there's somebody better suited for Monica than me?

sense_groups.chinese: 他长什么样子
sense_groups.english: Well, what's he like?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很高 是棕发 - 当然
sense_groups.english: He's tall. He has brown hair. - Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个发色跟我一样的高大男人 宇宙真的是太大了
sense_groups.english: A tall guy with hair similar to mine? Oh, unknowable universe!

sense_groups.chinese: 他从事跟食物相关的行业 - 当然 他比较老吗
sense_groups.english: He works with food. - Oh, sure. Older?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 他是英国人 - 我正打算要问你
sense_groups.english: Obviously. And he's British. - I was just gonna ask!

sense_groups.chinese: 他非常聪明 成熟有自信
sense_groups.english: Yeah? And he's so centered, and mature and confident.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜他们彼此不认识
sense_groups.english: It's so sad they never met.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好她老公没听到你那么说
sense_groups.english: Luckily, the guy she settled for can't hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 或许我错了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so sorry. Maybe I'm wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会再约会 我会把他调查得更仔细
sense_groups.english: We're going out again. I'll find out more.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟别人是天生一对 你还要跟他约会
sense_groups.english: He's meant for her, and you're gonna date him?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他不是我的心灵伴侣 但我总得吃饭吧
sense_groups.english: He may not be my soul mate, but a girl's gotta eat.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚跟乔伊谈过 我想知道你好不好
sense_groups.english: I talked to Joey. I wanted to see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是不敢相信 乔伊跟瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I still can't believe it. Joey and Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 那像是你跟我在交往 只不过更奇怪
sense_groups.english: It's like you and me going out, only weirder.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你很难过 我也想安慰你…
sense_groups.english: I know you're hurting...

sense_groups.chinese: 但别再那么说了
sense_groups.english: ...but don't say that again.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他们结婚了呢 他可能是我孩子的继父
sense_groups.english: What if they marry? He'd be the stepfather of my child.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必担心
sense_groups.english: You don't need to worry about.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不会告诉她他的感觉
sense_groups.english: He'll never tell her how he feels.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算他说了 你不知道她会有什么反应
sense_groups.english: If he did, you don't know how she'd react.

sense_groups.chinese: 女人从来就不喜欢乔伊 我想他是个处男
sense_groups.english: Sure, women never like Joey. I think he's a virgin.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不想追她 - 真的吗
sense_groups.english: He isn't thinking about going for her. - He's not?

sense_groups.chinese: 他只想到你的感觉
sense_groups.english: All he's thinking about is how you're taking this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这把他吓坏了 他想搬到佛蒙特去
sense_groups.english: It's freaking him out. He wants to move to Vermont.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 他想离开这个国家
sense_groups.english: Why? - He wants to leave the country.

sense_groups.chinese: 他认为你恨他
sense_groups.english: He thinks you hate him.

sense_groups.chinese: 恨他
sense_groups.english: Hate him?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不恨他
sense_groups.english: No, I don't hate him.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是瑞秋 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: It's just, it's Rachel. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法想像你有多难过…
sense_groups.english: I can't even imagine how hard this must be for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我不希望你跟乔伊因此做不成朋友
sense_groups.english: ...but I don't want you to lose Joey over it.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在他得知道你还是他的朋友
sense_groups.english: Right now, he needs to know that you're still his friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会跟他谈
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll talk to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好快去
sense_groups.english: I'd do it soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 他问我怎么把美金换成佛蒙特货币
sense_groups.english: He just asked me how to convert his dollars into Vermont money.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮卡 他是唐 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Chandler, Monica, this is Don. - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 很高兴能认识你 - 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Hello, nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 心灵伴侣
sense_groups.english: Soul mate.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们做了什么 - 我们在艾德瑞提卡吃午餐
sense_groups.english: What are you guys doing? - We had lunch at Adriatica.

sense_groups.chinese: 番茄干是怎么了 - 对啊 现在是1985年吗
sense_groups.english: What's with the sun-dried tomatoes? - I know! Is this 1985?

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是那么说的 这很奇怪吧 - 一点都不会
sense_groups.english: That's what I said! Isn't it strange? - Not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 番茄干是怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with sun-dried tomatoes?

sense_groups.chinese: 在烤鸡比萨上吗
sense_groups.english: On a barbecued-chicken pizza?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是吗
sense_groups.english: No?

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢哪家餐厅 - 奥克塔维欧 27与7
sense_groups.english: What restaurants do you like? - Octavio. 27-and-7.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有亚利山多洛斯 - 天啊 我是那里的主厨
sense_groups.english: There's this place, Alessandro's. - Oh, my God! I'm the chef!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在开玩笑 你做的菜好吃极了
sense_groups.english: You're kidding! Your food is fantastic!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟你谈谈你的菜单 有人要喝咖啡吗
sense_groups.english: I want to talk about your menu. Anyone want coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要喝拿铁 如果你要谈我的事 我跟你一起去
sense_groups.english: If you're talking about me, I'll go with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发誓我不知道你们在这里
sense_groups.english: I swear, I didn't know you guys would be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正你不相信心灵伴侣 所以…
sense_groups.english: You don't believe in soul mates, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信英俊的陌生人追我的老婆
sense_groups.english: I believe in handsome strangers who hit on my wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我认为他们是心灵伴侣 那不代表会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: Just because I think they're soul mates doesn't mean anything'll happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 做的好 - 哦
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? Good work. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 他很棒 我爱他
sense_groups.english: He's great. I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我们会帮你找到对象
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, we'll find you someone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你是来打我的 我了解 这是我活该
sense_groups.english: I understand if you came by to hit me. I deserve it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不想打你
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want to hit you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你要踢我
sense_groups.english: What, then? Kick me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 咬我
sense_groups.english: Bite me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想对你怎么样
sense_groups.english: I don't want to do anything to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是要说 我没有生你的气…
sense_groups.english: I just want to say I'm not mad at you...

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然也不恨你
sense_groups.english: ...and that I certainly do not hate you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是来告诉你
sense_groups.english: I just came here to say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey, wait, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 你想进来喝瓶啤酒吗
sense_groups.english: You wanna come in for a beer or something?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有啤酒吗
sense_groups.english: You got any beer?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只有瑞秋留下香瓜饮料
sense_groups.english: All I got is melon stuff that Rachel left.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得了解一件事
sense_groups.english: You need to understand something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会对瑞秋采取行动 好吧
sense_groups.english: I am never gonna act on this Rachel thing, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会做出任何会危及你我友谊的事
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't do anything to jeopardize my friendship with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之 我只是…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, it'll just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我得花点时间去遗忘
sense_groups.english: It'll take me a while to get over her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定我该怎么做 我没有陷入爱河过 所以…
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure how to do that. I've never been in love, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爱上她了
sense_groups.english: You're in love with her?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我以为你知道 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I thought you knew that. - Um, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 如果有帮助的话 我真的也不希望自己有那种感觉
sense_groups.english: Look, if it helps, I don't want to feel this way, honest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是一直在想 "我得忘了这件事" 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: I just keep thinking, "I'll get over this," you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 但我越这么想就越忘不了
sense_groups.english: But it just keeps getting harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't know what to do, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: What do I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得告诉她你的感觉 - 那一定是饮料害你这么说的
sense_groups.english: You need to tell her how you feel. - That's the green stuff talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的 你得知道她的感觉
sense_groups.english: I'm serious. You need to find out where she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她不喜欢你 你可以继续往前走
sense_groups.english: If she's not where you are, you can start to move on.

sense_groups.chinese: 但如果 我不是说她会…
sense_groups.english: But what if, and I'm not saying she will be...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她喜欢你…
sense_groups.english: If she is where you are...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的尴尬感觉不该妨碍你们
sense_groups.english: ...then my feeling weird shouldn't stand in the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定 - 对
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她会跟别的男人在一起…
sense_groups.english: If she ends up with somebody else...

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 她找不到更好的人选
sense_groups.english: ...the truth is, she couldn't find a better guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Hey, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么时候要跟她谈 - 天啊 我得跟她谈
sense_groups.english: So when are you gonna talk to her? - Oh, my God. I have to tell her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有想过 我该说什么
sense_groups.english: I haven't thought about it. What should I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 我能体谅你 但我们别太过分了
sense_groups.english: I'm understanding, but let's not get carried away.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 对不起
sense_groups.english: Right, sorry. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该说什么
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna say?

sense_groups.chinese: 很难喝吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah, tell me about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我解决了进口酒的问题 现在全力研究起司
sense_groups.english: I'm phasing out the wine importing and focusing more on the, um, cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说起司吗
sense_groups.english: Cheese, you say?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那种臭臭的东西 唐
sense_groups.english: That's some pretty smelly work, huh, Don?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 - 起司很臭
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - Cheese. It's smelly.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定也常常闻起来很臭
sense_groups.english: You must smell a lot of the time too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会的 但我觉得起司越臭越好
sense_groups.english: Uh, not really. But with cheese, I think the smellier, the better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 钱德讨厌它 在家我不能吃蓝起司
sense_groups.english: Me too! Chandler hates it. I can't have blue cheese in the house.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还是嫁给了他
sense_groups.english: And you're still married to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想到法国只吃面包跟起司
sense_groups.english: I would like to go to France and eat nothing but bread and cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至不要面包 只要起司
sense_groups.english: Not even bread. Just cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我要面包
sense_groups.english: No, I want the bread.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有馅饼
sense_groups.english: And pastries.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟小馅饼
sense_groups.english: And pate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是真的兴奋 只是以前我很胖
sense_groups.english: I'm really not high. I just used to be fat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在罗亚尔谷有栋别墅 你可以住在那里
sense_groups.english: I have a villa in the Loire Valley you can stay in.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是用起司做的吗
sense_groups.english: Is it made of cheese?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 用起司做的房子 那很不可思议吧
sense_groups.english: No. A house made of cheese, wouldn't that be great?

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天就想搬进去 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: I'd move in tomorrow! - Oh, come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 你听到了吗 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: Listen to this! - I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办 - 他们都要起司屋
sense_groups.english: What do we do? - They both want a house of cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I don't know how you fight that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我可以做到 我可以告诉她我的感觉
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. I can do this. I can tell her how I feel.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 挺直腰杆
sense_groups.english: Okay, stand up straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 深呼吸一下
sense_groups.english: Take a couple deep breaths.

sense_groups.chinese: 表现出自信
sense_groups.english: Look confident.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Joey? What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来找你 因为我想告诉你一件事
sense_groups.english: I came by because I want to talk to you about something.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 就在走廊上谈 我们是动物吗
sense_groups.english: Here, in the hall? What are we, animals?

sense_groups.chinese: 我开会要迟到了 你能快点说吗
sense_groups.english: I'm late for a meeting. Could you make it quick?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是来告诉你…
sense_groups.english: I just came by to tell you that...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想跟你一起吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: ...I want to have dinner with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 告诉我到哪里找你 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Sure. Just tell me where to meet you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Okay. That's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 这给你几小时的时间做好准备
sense_groups.english: That gives you a couple of hours to prepare.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们从来不敲门吗
sense_groups.english: Don't you people ever knock?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想请唐跟菲比过来 很棒吧
sense_groups.english: I'd like to have Don and Phoebe over.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 你去安排吧
sense_groups.english: Sure. Set it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去看征友广告
sense_groups.english: I'll just be browsing through the personals.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧 你有点怪怪的
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? You're acting weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不完美
sense_groups.english: Not perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我够好了
sense_groups.english: But good enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你是怎么了
sense_groups.english: Jeez, what's with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 你刚刚说"起司"吗
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, did you say "cheese"?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 菲比说你跟唐是心灵伴侣
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - Phoebe says you and Don are soul mates.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不相信 但你们两个处得很好
sense_groups.english: I don't believe in that, but you two get along.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想跟唐住在起司屋 我可以退出
sense_groups.english: I'll step aside if you wanna go with Don and live in a house of cheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不相信心灵伴侣 - 对 但我相信"番茄干先生"信
sense_groups.english: You don't believe in soul mates? - No, but I'm sure "tomatoes" does.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不相信心灵伴侣
sense_groups.english: I don't believe in soul mates, either.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不相信 - 对
sense_groups.english: You don't? - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不是注定要在一起的
sense_groups.english: We weren't destined to end up together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们陷入爱河 努力经营我们的关系
sense_groups.english: We fell in love and work hard at our relationship.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我们非常努力
sense_groups.english: Some days we work really hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想跟唐住在起司屋
sense_groups.english: So you don't want to live with Don in a cheese house?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我想了一下 你知道它打扫起来有多辛苦吗
sense_groups.english: No, I've had second thoughts. Do you know how hard it'd be to clean?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I love you. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要带你去吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take you out to dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到一个做起司条和墨西哥辣椒卷最好吃的地方
sense_groups.english: I found this place that makes the greatest mozzarella sticks and jalapeno poppers.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要吗 那真的很好吃
sense_groups.english: No? They taste so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道钱德是在开玩笑 但是他一摸我的肚子就会这样
sense_groups.english: It happens whenever Chandler touches my stomach.

sense_groups.chinese: 我担心宝宝不喜欢他
sense_groups.english: I'm worried the baby won't like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧 - 没事
sense_groups.english: Are you okay? - Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我…
sense_groups.english: Uh, look, the reason...

sense_groups.chinese: 这里很热吗
sense_groups.english: Is it hot in here?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会 我不觉得 你为什么不把毛衣脱掉
sense_groups.english: No, not for me. Why don't you take off your sweater?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个地方不错…
sense_groups.english: This is a nice place...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的T恤印了卡尔文上荷比丝的样子
sense_groups.english: ...and my T-shirt has a picture of Calvin doing Hobbes.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真的吗 我能看一下吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, really? Can I see it?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想荷比丝不会太喜欢
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't think Hobbes would like that so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们认识多久了
sense_groups.english: How long have we known each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 七 八…
sense_groups.english: Um, seven, eight...

sense_groups.chinese: 八年了
sense_groups.english: Eight years. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很久了 - 对
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. A long time. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但过去几星期以来 我…
sense_groups.english: But over the past few weeks, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 抱歉让你们久等 今天客人真的很多
sense_groups.english: Okay! Sorry about the wait, but it is mega-jammed in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚的特餐是…
sense_groups.english: Our specials tonight...

sense_groups.chinese: 你能等一下再来吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Could you give us a second? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 时间到
sense_groups.english: Second's up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不是那种客人
sense_groups.english: Not that kind of table.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要说什么
sense_groups.english: So you were saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你问我们认识了多久 我说八年
sense_groups.english: You asked how long we knew each other, and I said eight years.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来服务生走过来 害他少了一半的小费…
sense_groups.english: Then the waiter came over and cut his tip in half...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说到那里了
sense_groups.english: ...and now here we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Here we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我爱上你了
sense_groups.english: I think I'm falling in love with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱上你了
sense_groups.english: I'm falling in love with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在跟谁说话
sense_groups.english: Who are you talking to?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑 这是闹着玩的
sense_groups.english: Oh, you're kidding. It's a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很好笑
sense_groups.english: Funny. It's funny!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不了解
sense_groups.english: I don't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 你…
sense_groups.english: Are you, um?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会…
sense_groups.english: How did, um?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么时候
sense_groups.english: When?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的重要吗
sense_groups.english: Does it really matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow. Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里好热
sense_groups.english: It is hot in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这真的很令人吃惊
sense_groups.english: I know this is a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么都不必说
sense_groups.english: You don't have to say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要花多少时问思考都可以
sense_groups.english: You take as much time as you need.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你得说说话
sense_groups.english: Okay, you gotta say something.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我非常爱你
sense_groups.english: Joey, I love you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是… - 但是
sense_groups.english: But... - But.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是…
sense_groups.english: Right. Hey, that's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 真的
sense_groups.english: That's okay. That's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我料到你会这样
sense_groups.english: It's, uh, pretty much what I was expecting.

sense_groups.chinese: 那没什么大不了的 好吗
sense_groups.english: It's no big deal, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我得走了 - 请不要这样离开
sense_groups.english: I think I'm gonna go. - Please don't leave like this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能这样对一个孕妇
sense_groups.english: You can't do this to a pregnant woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 别那么做
sense_groups.english: Don't start doing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能那么做 因为你把我弄哭了…
sense_groups.english: You can't do that, because you're gonna make me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一起哭吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, there we go!

sense_groups.chinese: 可以吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Can I? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我不想失去…
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey. I don't want to lose...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会的 好吗 永远不会
sense_groups.english: You can't, okay? Ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 请你不要那么说
sense_groups.english: Please don't be sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 别感到抱歉
sense_groups.english: Okay? Don't be sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: You know, I was only kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那真的很好笑
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that was a real good one.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是你的客人 - 对
sense_groups.english: Is this your table? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得在这里待上一整晚 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: You'll be here all night. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我连特餐内容都还没有说
sense_groups.english: I haven't even read the specials.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我想或许他们之中有人快死了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I think maybe one of them is dying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望是那个女的
sense_groups.english: I kind of hope it's the girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个男的真的很帅
sense_groups.english: The guy is really cute!

questions.name: S08E17
questions.en:
Joey? Are you in there?
Oh, my God, that's Rachel. - Joey, you have to talk to her.
No, I can't. Not after the other night. It's just... It's too weird, okay?
Don't tell her I'm here.
Don't eat that.
Hey. - Rach.
Hey, Rachel. - Is Joey here?
I don't see him. You see him? - I don't see him.
Maybe he's in the sugar bowl. Joey? Nope.
Well, at least you make each other laugh.
What's up? - Well, I haven't seen him since that night...
...that he told me how he, you know...
I don't know, I think he's avoiding me.
Why is that bagel on the floor?
We were playing a game. - Ew, was Chandler naked?
Sort of like a ring-toss kind of situation?
Sure. - What? No. No.
All right, well, listen. If you see Joey, will you just tell him that, uh?
Tell him I miss him.
Okay. Did you hear that? - Yeah. That naked bagel game? Heh.
Dude, I don't know. That's a pretty small hole.
Honey, you've gotta talk to her. - I can't.
You guys don't know what it's like to put yourself out there like that...
...and then just get shot down.
I don't know what that's like?
Up until I was 25, I thought the only response to "I love you" was "Oh, crap."
Hello. No rejection?
I got shot down at fat camp.
Boy, kids are mean when they're hungry.
All right, so, what do I do?
This is Rachel. What are you gonna do, never talk to her again?
I know it's weird and it's awkward, but you gotta at least try.
Yeah, okay.
Whoa. I almost forgot this was on your...
We didn't play it.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Okay, so when you're done with your tea,
I'll look at the leaves and tell your fortune.
I didn't know you read tea leaves. - Oh, yeah, I've done it for years.
I actually stopped because I was so accurate.
You know, and one of the great joys of life...
...is its wondrous unpredictability, you know?
And also, tea tends to give me the trots.
Okay. I'm done. Read mine. - Okay.
Ooh. I see a ladder.
Which can mean either a promotion or a violent death.
I'm the head chef. I can't get promoted.
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Who's next?
Okay, I'm done. Do mine.
Okay.
Um... Oh. Okay, I see a circle.
Oh, which can either mean you're having a baby...
...or you're gonna make a scientific discovery.
Well, I have been spending a lot of time in the lab.
What does yours say, Pheebs? - Um... Wow, all right.
Oh, I'm gonna meet a guy. And really soon.
And he's gonna be the man of my dreams.
Probably not the guy I had a dream about last night.
You.
Hey, has anyone seen my shirt?
It's a button-down, like a faded salmon color?
You mean your pink shirt?
Faded salmon color?
No, I haven't seen your pink shirt.
Great, great. Then I must have left it at Mona's. I knew it.
I'm sure you can get another one at Ann Taylor's.
That's my favorite shirt, okay? I love that shirt.
Well, just ask Mona to give it back.
I don't know. I mean, I guess I could.
It's just, we didn't really end things on such good terms.
And if I went over there, I'd be ignoring the one thing she asked me to do...
...when we broke up: Jump up my own ass and die.
Oh, wait a second, you guys.
For the last couple weeks, I've been seeing that guy everywhere I go.
We take the same bus, we go to the same bookstore, same dry cleaner.
Maybe he's the tea guy.
Pheebs, did you see that?
He totally checked you out and he is so cute.
Mine is a picture of the Village People. What does that mean?
Hi. - Hey.
Hi. - Hi.
Tea gives Phoebe the trots.
I thought Joey and I would be okay once we hung out...
...but it's like we don't even know how to be with each other anymore.
I know it's tough, but things will get better. - How do you know that?
What if it just gets worse and worse and worse...
...to the point where we can't even be in the same room with each other?
I'm not great at the advice.
Can I interest you in a sarcastic comment?
Some cheese?
Honey, why is the Bruce Springsteen CD...
in the Cat Stevens case?
Let's just say if I can't find the right CD case, I just put it in the nearest one.
Okay, well, where is the Cat Stevens CD? - In the James Taylor case.
Where's the James Taylor CD? - Honey, I'm gonna save you some time.
Two hundred CDs, not one of them in the right case.
Okay. No need to panic. Deep breaths, everyone.
Okay, um, we're just gonna have to spend some time...
...and put the CDs in the right cases.
If we're gonna do that, we should come up with some order.
Like alphabetically, or by genre.
Hmm, I don't know. We really have to talk this through.
Oh, my God, you guys have such problems. I feel so terrible for you.
All right. Okay, I'm sorry.
Look, you and Joey, you're both focusing on this uncomfortable thing.
What you need to do is change the subject.
Next time you see him, try to get him talking about something else.
Oh, yeah, that makes sense. - Yeah.
I don't know, maybe you have a work problem you need his advice on.
Ooh, I could do that. I could do that. - Good.
Honey, the Miami Vice soundtrack? Really?
They were just giving those away at the store.
In exchange for money.
Hey.
Hi.
I really don't know what to tell you, Rach. I really don't.
Maybe Joey could help you out with your big work problem.
What? - Yeah, Joey, she's...
Rachel's got this really big work problem. It is a head-scratcher. Heh.
Well, you know what? If we're gonna make dinner, we're gonna have to leave. Yeah.
So you, uh, have a big work problem?
Yeah. It's, um...
Yeah, it's, uh...
You know, it's nothing.
Oh. Okay.
So, uh, I think I'm gonna take off.
No, wait, Joey, it is. It's something. It's, um...
It's my boss.
Yeah? - Yeah. And, um...
And my baby.
Yeah?
My boss wants to buy my baby.
What? Oh, my... Oh, my God.
I know, I told you, it's a really big problem.
He wants to buy your baby? - Can you believe that?
That's crazy. - That's what I told him.
How did this even happen? - Well, I'll tell you.
See, uh, my boss and, uh, his wife, they can't have children, so, um...
And then when we were at the Christmas party...
...and he got drunk and said to me, "Rachel, I want to buy your baby."
Man. When you said it was a problem about your boss and the baby...
...I figured it was something about maternity leave.
Oh. Yeah.
Yeah, that would have been a much simpler problem.
Oh, hello. - Oh, it's you. I see you everywhere.
Mm-hm. - I'm Jim. Jim Nelson.
Jim-Jim Nelson. I'm Phoebe-Phoebe Buffay.
We certainly have been seeing a lot of each other.
We have. Maybe we'll see each other at dinner tomorrow. Say, around 8:00?
Well, maybe we will.
Mona?
Okay, if I were a salmon shirt, where would I be?
I am so sorry I spilled wine all over your shirt.
Oh, it's okay. - No, it's still wet.
Let me get it out before it sets. Oh, I have something you could wear.
Here.
I don't know if I wanna wear a woman's shirt.
No, no, that's a man's shirt. - Awfully pink.
It's not pink.
Oh, my God, honey, we are so meant to be together.
Look, we both have the Annie soundtrack. - Honey, both yours.
Hey, great advice on that Joey thing.
Yeah, the work problem? - It was perfect.
It felt like he was my friend again.
What problem did you tell him you have? - Oh, that's not important.
The point is, I really think everything's gonna be okay.
May I help you?
You think you can just buy my friend's baby?
Isn't it funny how we kept running into each other?
It's as if someone really wants us to be together.
Someone does. Me.
Ooh. Witty banter. Well done. Good.
So tell me a little bit about yourself. - Oh, okay. Well, I'm a masseuse.
And I used to work at this place... - Do you like to party?
I... I like parties.
You're wild, aren't you? Heh.
Yeah, I guess. A little. - Ain't no thing. I'm wild too.
So, um, anyway...
...I... I've lived in New York, somewhat wildly, I guess...
...for, um... Well, since I was 14.
I'm sorry. I'm staring.
It's just that you have the most beautiful eyes.
Oh, stop it.
And your breasts. Mm!
Okay. Ahem.
Look, uh, you're coming on a little strong.
But I'm gonna give you the benefit of the doubt.
Because it seems the universe really wants us to be together.
So why don't we start over, okay? You can just tell me about yourself.
All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.english: In exchange for money.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不知道该跟你说什么
sense_groups.english: I really don't know what to tell you, Rach. I really don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许乔伊可以帮你解决工作上的大问题
sense_groups.english: Maybe Joey could help you out with your big work problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 对 乔伊 她…
sense_groups.english: What? - Yeah, Joey, she's...

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋工作上有个大问题 那真的很伤脑筋
sense_groups.english: Rachel's got this really big work problem. It is a head-scratcher. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我们想赶上晚餐预约 就得马上出发
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what? If we're gonna make dinner, we're gonna have to leave. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你工作上出了大问题
sense_groups.english: So you, uh, have a big work problem?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的没什么
sense_groups.english: You know, it's nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我该走了
sense_groups.english: So, uh, I think I'm gonna take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 乔伊 等一下 它真的很严重 我有问题 是…
sense_groups.english: No, wait, Joey, it is. It's something. It's, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我的老板
sense_groups.english: It's my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 - 对 跟…
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Yeah. And, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: And my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我老板想买我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: My boss wants to buy my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, my... Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我跟你说过了 这真的是个大问题
sense_groups.english: I know, I told you, it's a really big problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要买你的宝宝 - 你能相信吗
sense_groups.english: He wants to buy your baby? - Can you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那太疯狂了 - 我就是那么跟他说的
sense_groups.english: That's crazy. - That's what I told him.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会发生这种事 - 我会告诉你
sense_groups.english: How did this even happen? - Well, I'll tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老板跟他太太 他们不能生小孩 所以…
sense_groups.english: See, uh, my boss and, uh, his wife, they can't have children, so, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 在圣诞派对上 我们碰到了面…
sense_groups.english: And then when we were at the Christmas party...

sense_groups.chinese: 他喝醉了跟我说 "瑞秋 我要买下你的宝宝"
sense_groups.english: ...and he got drunk and said to me, "Rachel, I want to buy your baby."

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你老板跟宝宝有问题的时候…
sense_groups.english: Man. When you said it was a problem about your boss and the baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你是指产假的问题
sense_groups.english: ...I figured it was something about maternity leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Oh. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那样子问题简单多了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that would have been a much simpler problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 - 是你 我走到哪里都会碰到你
sense_groups.english: Oh, hello. - Oh, it's you. I see you everywhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是吉米 吉米·尼尔森
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. - I'm Jim. Jim Nelson.

sense_groups.chinese: 吉米吉米·尼尔森 我是菲比菲比·布非
sense_groups.english: Jim-Jim Nelson. I'm Phoebe-Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们最近常见面
sense_groups.english: We certainly have been seeing a lot of each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 的确 或许明天晚餐时 我们也能碰面 八点可以吗
sense_groups.english: We have. Maybe we'll see each other at dinner tomorrow. Say, around 8:00?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许会吧
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe we will.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: Mona?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 如果我是鲑鱼色衬衫 我会在哪里
sense_groups.english: Okay, if I were a salmon shirt, where would I be?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉我把酒洒到你的衬衫上
sense_groups.english: I am so sorry I spilled wine all over your shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 - 不 它还是湿的
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's okay. - No, it's still wet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把它拿去洗干净 免得留下印子 我有件衣服可以借你
sense_groups.english: Let me get it out before it sets. Oh, I have something you could wear.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不想穿女人的衬衫
sense_groups.english: I don't know if I wanna wear a woman's shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是男人的衬衫 - 太粉红了
sense_groups.english: No, no, that's a man's shirt. - Awfully pink.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是粉红色
sense_groups.english: It's not pink.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 甜心 我们注定要在一起
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, honey, we are so meant to be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都有"安妮"的原声带 - 甜心 那都是你买的
sense_groups.english: Look, we both have the Annie soundtrack. - Honey, both yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你给我关于乔伊的建议
sense_groups.english: Hey, great advice on that Joey thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是指工作的问题吗 - 它真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, the work problem? - It was perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得他又是我的朋友了
sense_groups.english: It felt like he was my friend again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你有什么问题 - 那不重要
sense_groups.english: What problem did you tell him you have? - Oh, that's not important.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是 我想一切都会没事
sense_groups.english: The point is, I really think everything's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我效劳吗
sense_groups.english: May I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得你可以买走我朋友的宝宝
sense_groups.english: You think you can just buy my friend's baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一直巧遇 真的很有趣吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't it funny how we kept running into each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就像是有人要我们在一起
sense_groups.english: It's as if someone really wants us to be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 那就是我
sense_groups.english: Someone does. Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 聪明的家伙 做的好
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Witty banter. Well done. Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我谈谈你自己 - 好吧 我是按摩师
sense_groups.english: So tell me a little bit about yourself. - Oh, okay. Well, I'm a masseuse.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以前在这个地方工作… - 你喜欢参加派对吗
sense_groups.english: And I used to work at this place... - Do you like to party?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢派对
sense_groups.english: I... I like parties.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很狂野 对吧
sense_groups.english: You're wild, aren't you? Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我猜是有一点 - 那没有什么 我也很狂野
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess. A little. - Ain't no thing. I'm wild too.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之…
sense_groups.english: So, um, anyway...

sense_groups.chinese: 我住在纽约 我猜那有点狂野…
sense_groups.english: ...I... I've lived in New York, somewhat wildly, I guess...

sense_groups.chinese: 我从14岁就住在这里
sense_groups.english: ...for, um... Well, since I was 14.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我盯着你不放
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I'm staring.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你有双最漂亮的眼睛
sense_groups.english: It's just that you have the most beautiful eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了
sense_groups.english: Oh, stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你的胸部
sense_groups.english: And your breasts. Mm!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你有点太快了
sense_groups.english: Look, uh, you're coming on a little strong.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我就疑中留情吧
sense_groups.english: But I'm gonna give you the benefit of the doubt.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为宇宙要我们在一起
sense_groups.english: Because it seems the universe really wants us to be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们为什么不开始呢 你可以跟我谈谈你自己
sense_groups.english: So why don't we start over, okay? You can just tell me about yourself.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我写小孩子看的…
sense_groups.english: I write erotic novels...

sense_groups.chinese: 色情小说
sense_groups.english: ...for children.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 它们非常不受欢迎
sense_groups.english: What? - They're wildly unpopular.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你会想知道 我有个博士学位
sense_groups.english: Also, you might be interested to know that I have a Ph.D.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对 它真的很大…
sense_groups.english: Wow, you do? - Yep. A pretty huge...

sense_groups.chinese: 够了
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: # 明天太阳依然升起 #
sense_groups.english: # The sun will come out tomorrow #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你可以十分肯定 明天 #
sense_groups.english: # Bet your bottom dollar that tomorrow #

sense_groups.chinese: # 会有阳光 #
sense_groups.english: # There'll be sun #

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 乔伊 听我说
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, Joey, honey, listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你昨天跟我谈
sense_groups.english: Thank you for talking to me yesterday about that thing with my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 那对我来说意义重大 - 别客气 我得告诉你…
sense_groups.english: That really meant a lot. - Not a problem. Oh, and just so you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 那家伙不会再为了宝宝的事来烦你了
sense_groups.english: ...that guy's not gonna be bothering you about that baby thing anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 就说我已经解决了问题
sense_groups.english: What? - Let's just say I took care of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得谈一谈
sense_groups.english: Ooh, let's say more.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我好好地跟他谈过
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, don't worry. I just told him, very nicely

sense_groups.chinese: "你不能买别人的宝宝 别闹了"
sense_groups.english: "You don't go buying people's babies, so back off."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 什么
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 他不想买我的宝宝 那是我编出来的
sense_groups.english: Joey, he doesn't wanna buy my baby. I made that up.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 为什么
sense_groups.english: What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才有话题聊 不会觉得尴尬
sense_groups.english: So that we would have something to talk about so it wouldn't be awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想不出来别的借口吗
sense_groups.english: And you couldn't think of anything else?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你老板要买你的宝宝
sense_groups.english: You said your boss wants to buy your baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 你居然对我老板大叫
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you yelled at my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会被开除 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna lose my job. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以卖掉你的宝宝
sense_groups.english: You could always sell your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你把我老板扯进来 我会被开除
sense_groups.english: Joey, I cannot believe you brought my boss into this. I'm gonna get fired.

sense_groups.chinese: 你骗我 - 是她要我那么做的
sense_groups.english: You lied to me. - Well, she told me to.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德有两张"安妮"的原声带
sense_groups.english: Chandler has two copies of Annie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 哈罗
sense_groups.english: Ross! - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: Ross, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 希望你们听了能够释怀 我没有自摸
sense_groups.english: Not touching myself, if that makes anyone less uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 你找我
sense_groups.english: Morning. You wanted to see me?

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 坐下
sense_groups.english: Please, come in. Have a seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 塞纳先生… - 让我先说吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, Mr. Zelner... - Oh, I think it's best that I speak first.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 人事部的李将是我们谈话的见证人
sense_groups.english: I've asked Lee from human resources to be here as a witness to our conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我有暗示过你 我想买你的宝宝…
sense_groups.english: If I in any way implied that I wanted to buy your baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 好吗
sense_groups.english: ...I am sorry. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 上星期我问你 你的预产期是什么时候…
sense_groups.english: Last week, when I asked you when your due date was, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我并没有要买你的宝宝的意思
sense_groups.english: ...I certainly did not mean that I felt that I was due your baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望清楚地告诉你…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I want to be very clear...

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 它是你的宝宝…
sense_groups.english: ...that I understand that it's your baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能买下它
sense_groups.english: ...and it is not mine to purchase.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要把话说清楚就好了
sense_groups.english: Well, as long as we are clear about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 到了
sense_groups.english: Oh, there it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是你常去的洗衣店 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That's not your regular dry cleaners. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个怪胎会去那里 我得找新的洗衣店
sense_groups.english: But that creep I went on that date with goes there so I had to find a new one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还得找新的录影带店 银行…
sense_groups.english: I also have to find a new video store, a new bank...

sense_groups.chinese: 成人书店 杂货店…
sense_groups.english: ...a new adult bookstore, a new grocery store...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 新的杂货店
sense_groups.english: What? - A new grocery store.

sense_groups.chinese: 宇宙说我会认识一个好男人 那是真的吗
sense_groups.english: The universe said I was gonna meet a nice guy and that's what they gave me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我上天堂后一定会痛扁他
sense_groups.english: When I get up there, I'm gonna kick some ass.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 菲比 你会认识某人的
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, Phoebe, you're gonna meet someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我能找到好男人 你也可以
sense_groups.english: If I can meet a great guy, so can you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们都可以 也都会做到
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we both can. And we both will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必进来 - 你在开玩笑吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, you didn't have to come in with me. - Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在这把衣服洗干净 对我来说这就像是迪士尼乐园
sense_groups.english: This is where they get out stains. This is like Disneyland for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要到这里看干净衬衫跳舞
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna be over here watching the dance of the clean shirts.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我想你掉了…
sense_groups.english: Oh, excuse me. I think you, uh, dropped...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 只是你真的是美得不可思议
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, it's just that you're so incredibly beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也这么觉得 但又能怎么办呢
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, well, I'm sorry about that too. But what are you gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 别认为我疯了 但我觉得我是注定捡这个的
sense_groups.english: I hope you don't think I'm crazy, but I feel like I was meant to pick this up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你相信那种事吗 - 有一点
sense_groups.english: Do you believe in that kind of thing? - A little. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对
sense_groups.english: Now you're talking.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去喝咖啡吗
sense_groups.english: Would you like to go have a cup of coffee?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意 我去跟我朋友说一声
sense_groups.english: I'd love to. Let me just tell my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 是墨水印子 我能看你把它洗干净吗
sense_groups.english: Ooh. An ink stain. Hey, can I watch how you get this out?

sense_groups.chinese: 她一定是离开了
sense_groups.english: She must have left.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 所以呢 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Hi. - So, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事了
sense_groups.english: It's all gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们很高兴我不告他们
sense_groups.english: They're just so happy I'm not suing them...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还能多放一个月领薪产假
sense_groups.english: ...that they gave me one extra month paid maternity leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要我知道那些钱绝不是…
sense_groups.english: So long as I understand that the money should not be construed...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个宝宝或其他宝宝的订金
sense_groups.english: ...as a down payment on this or any other child that I may bear.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗夫·罗兰真的想尽办法…
sense_groups.english: Wow. Ralph Lauren is going out of their way...

sense_groups.chinese: 要证明他们不是贩婴集团
sense_groups.english: ...to show that they're not in the baby-buying business.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 能让我们独处一下吗 - 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Chandler, can you give us a minute? - Oh, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要把我踢出我家的客厅 - 对
sense_groups.english: You're kicking me out of my living room? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会在那里
sense_groups.english: I'll be in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 抱歉我骗了你 我只是希望事情…
sense_groups.english: Joey, I'm really sorry that I lied to you. I was just trying to make things...

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道…
sense_groups.english: I know. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 方法还是有效
sense_groups.english: But it kind of worked.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你是怎么想的
sense_groups.english: I mean, you know, I don't know about you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我一直没想到我们的事
sense_groups.english: ...but I haven't thought about our thing since all this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们又恢复了朋友的样子 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. It's kind of been like us again, a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 我很想念那段时光 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. I've missed that. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有想到 自己怎么会…
sense_groups.english: I mean, I haven't thought at all about how I put myself out there...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你说那些话 你跟我的感觉不同…
sense_groups.english: ...and said that stuff and how you didn't feel the same way about me...

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很尴尬
sense_groups.english: ...and how it was really awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的妇产科医生想杀我
sense_groups.english: My gynecologist tried to kill me.

sense_groups.chinese: 编号是J437A
sense_groups.english: Item J437-A.

sense_groups.chinese: 颜色 冬莓色
sense_groups.english: Winterberry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 听着 进来 进来吧…
sense_groups.english: Hi, um, listen. Come here. Come...

sense_groups.chinese: 关于昨天的事我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm so, so sorry about yesterday.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 那只是…
sense_groups.english: I'm really, really sorry. It's just...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你不必道歉 我了解你为什么会去那里
sense_groups.english: Listen, Ross, you don't have to apologize. I understand why you were there.
