questions.name: S08E18
questions.en:
Ross, Mon, is it okay if I bring someone to your parents' anniversary party?
Sure. - Yeah.
Who's the guy? - Parker, I met him at the dry cleaners.
Did he put a little starch in your bloomers?
Who said that?
No, he's really great, though. He has this incredible zest for life.
And he treats me like a queen.
Except at night, when he treats me like the naughty girl I am.
Oh, by the way, would it be okay if I give the toast this year?
Are you sure you want to after what happened at their 20th?
Yeah, I'd really like to. - Hopefully this time Mom won't boo you.
Yes. Every year Ross makes the toast, and it always makes them cry.
This year, I'm gonna make them cry. - You wonder why Ross is their favorite?
No, really, any time Ross makes a toast, everyone cries and pats him on the back.
And they all come up to me and say, "God, your brother."
You know what they're gonna say this year? "God, you."
Well, I can promise you, at least one person will be crying.
I'm an actor, and any actor worth his salt can cry on cue.
Really? You can do that? - Oh, you kidding me? Watch.
Well, I can't do it with you guys watching me.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
What are you doing? - I'm working on my toast for the party.
Or as I like to call it: "Sob-fest 2002."
Hey, check this out. - It's a dog.
It's a dead dog.
That's Chi-Chi. She died when I was in high school.
You're gonna talk about their dead pet? - It's good stuff, huh?
Hi. - Hey.
Joey? You got a present for my parents? That's so sweet.
Yeah. In honor of their 35th anniversary, I had a star named after them.
That is so cool. - And I got them Kama Sutra for the Elderly.
Do you guys have any extra ribbon? - Oh, yeah, sure.
What do you need? We got, uh, lace, satin, sateen, raffia, gingham, felt...
And I think my testicles may be in here too.
AW. Chi-Chi. Oh, I loved this dog.
You know, uh, Monica couldn't get braces because Chi-Chi needed knee surgery.
What? - You were the 200-pounder who rode her.
Hey. Everybody, this is Parker. Parker, this is...
No, wait, don't tell me. Let me guess: Joey, Monica, Ross, Rachel...
...and I'm sorry, Phoebe didn't mention you.
Chandler, I'm kidding. Already you're my favorite.
Tell me a little about yourselves. - Uh, actually, we should get going.
Classic Ross.
Rachel, Rachel, look how you glow. May I?
I think you already are.
Rachel, you have life growing inside you.
Is there anything more miraculous... Ooh, a picture of a dog. Whose is this?
That's my old dog. He passed away years ago.
Well, at least you were lucky to have him. Bow-wow, old friend. Bow-wow.
So where's the party? - Out on the island. It's in Massapequa.
Massapequa, it sounds magical. Is it steeped in Native American history?
Well, there is an Arby's in the shape of a tepee.
I've got my notes. You got the presents? - Yeah.
I've got the car keys. - We're driving?
Yeah. - Aces.
So, uh, he seems like a nice guy. - Yeah. Yeah, I like him a lot.
You want to hang back and take a cab? - Okay, otherwise I'm not going.
Hey, Mom. - This is such a great party.
Thirty-five years. Very impressive. Do you guys have any pearls of wisdom?
Jack? - Why serve food on such a sharp stick?
It's a good question, Dad. It's a good question.
Congratulations, you two. - Thank you, we're so excited.
And also, congratulations on your wedding.
What?
Can we talk to you for just a moment? - Yeah.
It's just a little thing.
While we think it's simply marvelous that you're having this baby out of wedlock...
...some of our friends are less open-minded.
Which is why we told them you're married. - What?
Thanks for going along with this.
We have to pretend that we're married? - Son, I had to shave my ears for tonight.
You can do this.
Can you believe that? - I know.
If you're gonna do the ears, you may as well take a pass at the nose area.
No, no, I don't want to have to lie about us being married.
I know. I don't either. But it's their party, and it's one night.
We don't even have to lie. We just won't say anything.
If it comes up, we'll smile, we'll nod along...
Ross? - Rachel?
Hi, Aunt Lisa. Uncle Dan.
Congratulations on the baby and on the wedding.
Here's something to get you started. - So how's marriage treating you?
Unbelievable. It's great. - I love marriage.
We'll see you later.
Hey. - Hi.
What a beautiful place. What a great night.
I have to tell you, being here with all of you in Event Room C...
...I feel so lucky. To think of all the good times that have happened here.
The birthdays, the proms, the mitzvahs, both bar and bat.
But none of it will compare with tonight. My God, I don't want to forget this moment.
It's like I want to take a mental picture of you all. Click.
I don't think the flash went off.
I'm gonna go find the men's room. - I'll go with you.
Somewhere, there is someone with a tranquilizer gun...
...and a huge butterfly net looking for that man.
I have to go too, but I don't want him complimenting my thing.
I'm so glad we weren't in the car. Did he ever let up?
He called the Long Island Expressway a concrete miracle.
This room. This night.
That waiter. His shoes. I must take a mental picture.
Sorry.
Were you guys making fun of Parker?
That depends, how much did you hear?
Well, he's a little enthusiastic. What's wrong with that?
It's just... It's so much. - Well, so what? I like him.
Do I make fun of the people you've dated? Tag, Janice, Mona.
No, because friends don't do that. But do you want my opinion?
In my opinion, your collective dating record reads like a who's who of human crap.
I feel terrible. - I know.
What was wrong with Mona?
Open it, open it, open it. - Yeah, baby.
So we never got to hear about your wedding.
We were surprised we weren't invited. - Oh, no, it was just our parents.
It was a small wedding.
But it was beautiful. It was small, but kind of spectacular.
Where did you have it? - On a cliff in Barbados, at sunset.
And Stevie Wonder sang "isn't She Lovely" as I walked down the aisle.
Really? - Yeah.
Stevie's an old family friend. - Oh, my God. That sounds amazing.
I'd love to see pictures. - Yeah, so would I.
You wouldn't think that Annie Leibovitz would forget to put film in the camera.
Would you excuse us for a second?
Um, what are you doing? - What? I'm not you.
This may be the only wedding leverhave.
And I want it to be amazing. - Okay. Okay. Ooh. Ooh.
Maybe I rode in on a Harley.
Okay, Ross, it has to be realistic.
Say, uh, ahem, are you okay? You seem kind of quiet.
No, I'm fine. I'm great. I'm with you. - And I'm with you.
What a great time to be alive.
Look at this plate bouncy thing.
What an inspired solution to man's plate-dispensing problems.
Mm-hm. Yeah.
Ah. Oysters. Let me feed you one. - That's not necessary.
Please? - No, actually, I don't eat...
I won't quit until you try one. - Okay, fine, fine.
Mm. Mm-hm. Good. - What're they like? I've never had one.
Why don't you just try one? - Nah, they look too weird.
What are you doing? - Just going over my toast.
Ah, those two will never know what hit them.
I can't wait. They're gonna cry so hard, they'll be fighting for breath.
You know, if you want to, I could just hold them down and you could just
And my veil was lace, made by blind Belgian nuns.
Blind? - Well, not at first, but it was intricate work.
And they said even though they lost their sight, it was all worth it.
I bet you looked beautiful. - Oh, well, I don't know about that.
But there were some people that said I looked like a floating angel.
How did you propose? - Oh, yeah, that's a great story.
Well, um, actually, I took her to the planetarium.
That's where we had our first date.
Um, she walked in, and I had the room filled with, uh, lilies, her favorite flower.
That is so sweet. - Shh. I want to hear the rest.
Then Fred Astaire singing, uh, "The Way You Look Tonight"...
...came on the sound system and the lights came down...
...and I got on one knee...
...and written across the dome, in the stars, were the words
"Will you marry me?"
And the ring was the size of my fist.
Hey, uh, Phoebe? Look, uh...
...I want to apologize about before, okay? We were being jerks.
Parker's a nice guy, and I'd like to get to know him.
Then you better do it now.
Why? - Because I'm gonna kill him.
What? - You guys were right. He's just too excited about everything.
I mean, I'm all for living life, but this is the Gellers' 35th anniversary.
Let's call a spade a spade. This party stinks.
I know. I'm having the worst time.
There was a 15-minute line for the buffet, and when I finally got up to the plates...
...I slipped on a giant booger.
Are you sure it wasn't an oyster?
I guess it could've been. I didn't really look at it.
I just wiped it on Chandler's coat and got the hell out of there.
I just thought he was such a great guy. I was so excited about him.
Well, hey, you should be excited about him.
There's nothing wrong with him. He's a good guy.
You think? - Yeah, know what I think?
We were all just being too negative. - You're right.
You're right. He's just embracing life. We could all stand to be more like Parker.
You know what? I am like him. I'm a sunny, positive person.
Actually, you have a little bit of an edge. - What's that now?
Oh, it's Parker. - Look, the Bunny Hop.
Oh, I love it. - You do?
Are you kidding? People acting like animals to music? Come on.
Okay, it's time for the toast.
I know that normally Ross gives the toast, but this year I'm gonna do it.
No, it's gonna be great. Really.
Okay, um...
Mom, Dad, when I got married...
...one of the things that made me sure that I could do it...
...was the amazing example the two of you set for me.
For that, and for so many other things, I wanna say thank you.
I know I probably don't say it enough...
...but I love you.
When I look around this room...
...I'm saddened by the thought of those who could not be with us.
Nana, my beloved grandmother, who would so want to be here.
But she can't...
...because she's dead.
As is our dog, Chi-Chi.
I mean, look how cute she is... Was.
Do me a favor, pass this to my parents.
Remember, um, she's dead, okay? Her and Nana, gone.
Hey, does anybody remember when...
...Debra Winger had to say goodbye to her children in Terms of Endearment?
Didn't see that?
No movie fans?
You want to hear something sad?
Um, the other day I was watching 60 Minutes...
...and there was this piece on these orphans in Romania...
...who have been so neglected that they were incapable of love.
You people are made of stone.
Here's to Mom and Dad. Whatever.
Thank you, Monica. That was, uh, interesting.
Wasn't it interesting, Jack? - Why don't I remember this dog?
Ross? Why don't you give us your toast now?
Oh, no, Mom. It's just Monica this year.
You're not gonna say anything? On our 35th wedding anniversary?
No, of course, um...
Um, everybody? Um, ahem, I just wanted to say...
...uh, on behalf of my new bride, Rachel...
...and myself, um, that if...
If in 35 years, we're half as happy as you guys are...
...we'll count ourselves the luckiest people in the world.
Oh, Ross.
I just wish Nana were alive to hear Ross' toast.
My God, what a fantastically well-lit hallway.
Can I, um, get you something to drink, like a water and Valium?
I must say, this apartment, it's...there are no words.
Oh, thank God. - It's a haven.
A third-floor paradise, a modern-day Eden. - Yeah, I know, I know. Uh-huh. Gotcha.
Listen, why don't we just, um, sit and relax,
you know, just be with each other quietly.
That sounds great.
My God, this is the most comfortable couch I've ever sat on in my entire life.
Let's try something else. Let's play a game.
I love games. - Shocking.
Um, let's play the game of...
...who can stay quiet the longest.
Or Jenga.
Let's play this one first, and remember, whoever talks first loses.
I lose, now Jenga. - Oh, my God. Oh, my God.
Is something wrong? - Wrong? You know the word "wrong"?
Everything isn't perfect? Everything isn't magical?
Everything isn't aglow with the light of a million fairies?
They were just brake lights, Parker.
Well, excuse me for putting a good spin on a traffic jam.
But you don't have to put a good spin on everything.
I'm sorry. That's who I am. I'm a positive person.
No, I'm a positive person.
You are like Santa Claus on Prozac.
At Disneyland, getting laid.
So, what do you want me to do? You want me to be more negative?
You want me to be less happy? - Much less happy.
Fine. Well, then to quote Ross, "I better be going."
So long.
Hey. Don't let the best door in the world hit you in the ass on your way out.
Isn't this the most incredible fight you've ever had in your entire life?
We could've gone from the ceremony to the reception with you in the sidecar.
Ross, it just wouldn't have been feasible.
But having a dove place the ring on your finger would've been no problem.
It was really fun being married to you tonight.
Yeah, and it was the easiest 400 bucks I ever made.
Okay, Ross, can I, um, ask you something? - Yeah.
That proposal at the planetarium? - I know, I know. It was stupid.
Are you kidding? With the lilies, and the song and the stars?
It was really wonderful. Did you just make that up?
Uh, no, actually, I thought about it when we were going out.
That's how I imagined I, uh, would ask you to marry me.
Wow.
Well, that would've been, uh, very hard to say no to.
Well, it's a good thing I didn't do it...
...because it sounds like it would have been a very expensive wedding.
Okay, good night. - Good night.
Uh, even if the sidecar had a windscreen so your hair wouldn't get messed up?
I will think about it. - That's all I'm asking.
Okay, that's it. I give up.
At Mom and Dad's 40th anniversary, you're the one giving the speech.
You know, I don't understand why they didn't cry. It was a beautiful speech.
Oh, come on. - Hey. That stuff you said about true love?
You were right. I mean, we did learn a lot from Mom and Dad.
And that picture of Chi-Chi with her mischievous grin.
And what you said about Nana?
Oh, yeah, she really would've wanted to be there.
And you know what?
I think she was.
Oh, good God, Ross, how the hell do you do it'?

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 我在写我的演讲稿
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - I'm working on my toast for the party.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该叫它 "2002年最佳催泪弹"
sense_groups.english: Or as I like to call it: "Sob-fest 2002."

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 - 是小狗
sense_groups.english: Hey, check this out. - It's a dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是只死狗
sense_groups.english: It's a dead dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 琪琪在我高中时死掉了
sense_groups.english: That's Chi-Chi. She died when I was in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸妈的结婚周年 你要谈一只死狗 - 那个主题不错吧
sense_groups.english: You're gonna talk about their dead pet? - It's good stuff, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你准备好要送我爸妈的礼物了吗
sense_groups.english: Joey? You got a present for my parents? That's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了纪念他们结婚35周年 我用他们的名字帮星星取名
sense_groups.english: Yeah. In honor of their 35th anniversary, I had a star named after them.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太酷了 - 我还买了老年人的性爱宝典
sense_groups.english: That is so cool. - And I got them Kama Sutra for the Elderly.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有多余的缎带吗 - 当然有
sense_groups.english: Do you guys have any extra ribbon? - Oh, yeah, sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要什么 我们有蕾丝 缎子 棉布 亚麻 条纹布 你…
sense_groups.english: What do you need? We got, uh, lace, satin, sateen, raffia, gingham, felt...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我的蛋蛋 应该也在这里
sense_groups.english: And I think my testicles may be in here too.

sense_groups.chinese: 琪琪 我爱这只狗
sense_groups.english: AW. Chi-Chi. Oh, I loved this dog.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡没办法装牙套 因为琪琪得动膝盖手术
sense_groups.english: You know, uh, Monica couldn't get braces because Chi-Chi needed knee surgery.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 你是骑着他跑的两百磅重大胖子
sense_groups.english: What? - You were the 200-pounder who rode her.

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 他是派克 派克 这是…
sense_groups.english: Hey. Everybody, this is Parker. Parker, this is...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别告诉我 让我猜 乔伊 摩妮卡 罗斯 瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: No, wait, don't tell me. Let me guess: Joey, Monica, Ross, Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 菲比没有提过你
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm sorry, Phoebe didn't mention you.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我是在开玩笑 你已经是我的最爱了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I'm kidding. Already you're my favorite.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我谈谈你的事 - 事实上 我们该走了
sense_groups.english: Tell me a little about yourselves. - Uh, actually, we should get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 典型的罗斯
sense_groups.english: Classic Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你好漂亮 我可以吗
sense_groups.english: Rachel, Rachel, look how you glow. May I?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你已经不请自来了
sense_groups.english: I think you already are.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你体内孕育着一个小生命
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you have life growing inside you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么更神奇… 一张狗照片 这是谁的狗
sense_groups.english: Is there anything more miraculous... Ooh, a picture of a dog. Whose is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我以前养的狗 他在好几年前过世了
sense_groups.english: That's my old dog. He passed away years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你很幸运能拥有他 贱狗 我的老朋友
sense_groups.english: Well, at least you were lucky to have him. Bow-wow, old friend. Bow-wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 派对在哪里举行 - 在 马沙皮卡
sense_groups.english: So where's the party? - Out on the island. It's in Massapequa.

sense_groups.chinese: 马沙皮卡 听起来像魔法 是美国原住民历史上的名胜吗
sense_groups.english: Massapequa, it sounds magical. Is it steeped in Native American history?

sense_groups.chinese: 那里有原住民帐篷形状的艾比餐厅
sense_groups.english: Well, there is an Arby's in the shape of a tepee.

sense_groups.chinese: 我拿了纸条 你拿了礼物吗 - 拿了
sense_groups.english: I've got my notes. You got the presents? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我拿了车钥匙 - 我们要开车吗
sense_groups.english: I've got the car keys. - We're driving?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Aces.

sense_groups.chinese: 他似乎是个好人 - 对 我很喜欢他
sense_groups.english: So, uh, he seems like a nice guy. - Yeah. Yeah, I like him a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想留晚一点搭计程车去吗 - 好吧 不然我不想去了
sense_groups.english: You want to hang back and take a cab? - Okay, otherwise I'm not going.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 妈 - 这个派对真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Hey, Mom. - This is such a great party.

sense_groups.chinese: 35年 太棒了 你们有什么至理名言吗
sense_groups.english: Thirty-five years. Very impressive. Do you guys have any pearls of wisdom?

sense_groups.chinese: 杰克 - 为什么食物上要插着牙签
sense_groups.english: Jack? - Why serve food on such a sharp stick?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是个好问题 爸爸 那是个好问题
sense_groups.english: It's a good question, Dad. It's a good question.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你们 - 谢谢 我们很兴奋
sense_groups.english: Congratulations, you two. - Thank you, we're so excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 还要恭喜你们结婚了
sense_groups.english: And also, congratulations on your wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能跟你们谈一下吗 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Can we talk to you for just a moment? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是件小事
sense_groups.english: It's just a little thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们觉得你们未婚生子真的很棒…
sense_groups.english: While we think it's simply marvelous that you're having this baby out of wedlock...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们的朋友没有那么开放
sense_groups.english: ...some of our friends are less open-minded.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们告诉他们你们结婚了 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Which is why we told them you're married. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们愿意配合
sense_groups.english: Thanks for going along with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得假装我们结婚了 - 我为了今晚必须要刮耳毛
sense_groups.english: We have to pretend that we're married? - Son, I had to shave my ears for tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你起码可以做到这一点吧
sense_groups.english: You can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信吗 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Can you believe that? - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要掏耳朵 最好顺便挖一下鼻子
sense_groups.english: If you're gonna do the ears, you may as well take a pass at the nose area.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想骗人我结婚了
sense_groups.english: No, no, I don't want to have to lie about us being married.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不想 但这是他们的派对 而且只有一晚而已
sense_groups.english: I know. I don't either. But it's their party, and it's one night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不必说谎 我们只要不说话
sense_groups.english: We don't even have to lie. We just won't say anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人提起 我们只要微笑点头…
sense_groups.english: If it comes up, we'll smile, we'll nod along...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 丽莎阿姨 丹姨丈
sense_groups.english: Hi, Aunt Lisa. Uncle Dan.

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜你们怀孕 还结了婚
sense_groups.english: Congratulations on the baby and on the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个好开始 - 你们婚后还好吧
sense_groups.english: Here's something to get you started. - So how's marriage treating you?

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 太棒了 - 我们喜欢结婚
sense_groups.english: Unbelievable. It's great. - I love marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会儿见
sense_groups.english: We'll see you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 好漂亮的地方 好棒的夜晚
sense_groups.english: What a beautiful place. What a great night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你们 能跟你们一起在C宴会厅…
sense_groups.english: I have to tell you, being here with all of you in Event Room C...

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得好幸运 想想这里曾有过的美好时光
sense_groups.english: ...I feel so lucky. To think of all the good times that have happened here.

sense_groups.chinese: 生日 毕业舞会 犹太教成人礼 男生跟女生的
sense_groups.english: The birthdays, the proms, the mitzvahs, both bar and bat.

sense_groups.chinese: 通通都比不上今晚 我不想忘了它
sense_groups.english: But none of it will compare with tonight. My God, I don't want to forget this moment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想在我心里 帮你们拍张照 喀擦
sense_groups.english: It's like I want to take a mental picture of you all. Click.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想闪光灯没亮
sense_groups.english: I don't think the flash went off.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去男洗手间 - 我跟你一起去
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go find the men's room. - I'll go with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人躲在某个地方 拿着麻醉枪…
sense_groups.english: Somewhere, there is someone with a tranquilizer gun...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟大蝴蝶网 在找那个家伙
sense_groups.english: ...and a huge butterfly net looking for that man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想上厕所 但我不想让他夸奖我的小弟弟
sense_groups.english: I have to go too, but I don't want him complimenting my thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好我们没在车上 他发作了吗
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad we weren't in the car. Did he ever let up?

sense_groups.chinese: 他叫长岛高速公路是"水泥奇迹"
sense_groups.english: He called the Long Island Expressway a concrete miracle.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个房间 今晚
sense_groups.english: This room. This night.

sense_groups.chinese: 服务生 他的鞋子 我得用心拍张照片
sense_groups.english: That waiter. His shoes. I must take a mental picture.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在取笑派克吗
sense_groups.english: Were you guys making fun of Parker?

sense_groups.chinese: 那得看你听到了多少
sense_groups.english: That depends, how much did you hear?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是有点狂热 那有什么不对
sense_groups.english: Well, he's a little enthusiastic. What's wrong with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 他太过火了 - 那又怎么样 我喜欢他
sense_groups.english: It's just... It's so much. - Well, so what? I like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会取笑你们的约会对象吗 泰格 珍妮丝 蒙娜
sense_groups.english: Do I make fun of the people you've dated? Tag, Janice, Mona.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 因为朋友不会那么做 你们想知道我的想法吗
sense_groups.english: No, because friends don't do that. But do you want my opinion?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的约会纪录加起来跟人渣史差不多
sense_groups.english: In my opinion, your collective dating record reads like a who's who of human crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得好难过 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I feel terrible. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 蒙娜有哪里不好
sense_groups.english: What was wrong with Mona?

sense_groups.chinese: 快打开 - 好的 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Open it, open it, open it. - Yeah, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不知道你们结婚了
sense_groups.english: So we never got to hear about your wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很讶异我们没有被邀请 - 不 只有父母
sense_groups.english: We were surprised we weren't invited. - Oh, no, it was just our parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 婚礼的规模很小
sense_groups.english: It was a small wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 但很美 简单而精致
sense_groups.english: But it was beautiful. It was small, but kind of spectacular.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们在哪里举行婚礼 - 在巴巴多斯悬崖上的黄昏婚礼
sense_groups.english: Where did you have it? - On a cliff in Barbados, at sunset.

sense_groups.chinese: 我走上红毯时 史提夫·汪达唱着"她真美"
sense_groups.english: And Stevie Wonder sang "isn't She Lovely" as I walked down the aisle.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 史提夫是我们家的朋友 - 天啊 那真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Stevie's an old family friend. - Oh, my God. That sounds amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想看照片 - 对 我也是
sense_groups.english: I'd love to see pictures. - Yeah, so would I.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会相信 安妮·莱波维兹忘了装底片
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't think that Annie Leibovitz would forget to put film in the camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Would you excuse us for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 什么 我又不是你
sense_groups.english: Um, what are you doing? - What? I'm not you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那可能是我唯一一场婚礼
sense_groups.english: This may be the only wedding leverhave.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望它真的很棒 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: And I want it to be amazing. - Okay. Okay. Ooh. Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我该骑着哈雷机车入场
sense_groups.english: Maybe I rode in on a Harley.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们得编得很像真的
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, it has to be realistic.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗 你似乎很安静
sense_groups.english: Say, uh, ahem, are you okay? You seem kind of quiet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事 我跟你在一起 - 我跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: No, I'm fine. I'm great. I'm with you. - And I'm with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: What a great time to be alive.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这个送盘器
sense_groups.english: Look at this plate bouncy thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个天才发明解决了端盘子的问题
sense_groups.english: What an inspired solution to man's plate-dispensing problems.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 生蚝 让我来喂你 - 你不必那么做
sense_groups.english: Ah. Oysters. Let me feed you one. - That's not necessary.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 - 我不吃…
sense_groups.english: Please? - No, actually, I don't eat...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不吃的话我绝不罢休 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I won't quit until you try one. - Okay, fine, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 - 它们是什么味道 我从来没吃过
sense_groups.english: Mm. Mm-hm. Good. - What're they like? I've never had one.

sense_groups.chinese: 试试看 - 它们看起来好奇怪
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just try one? - Nah, they look too weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么 - 准备我的演讲
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? - Just going over my toast.

sense_groups.chinese: 会让他们好好的吓一跳
sense_groups.english: Ah, those two will never know what hit them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及了 他们会痛哭流涕 他们会喘不过气来
sense_groups.english: I can't wait. They're gonna cry so hard, they'll be fighting for breath.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要的话 我可以抓住他们 让你…
sense_groups.english: You know, if you want to, I could just hold them down and you could just

sense_groups.chinese: 我戴的蕾丝婚纱 是由比利时盲修女织的
sense_groups.english: And my veil was lace, made by blind Belgian nuns.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞎眼 - 本来不是的 但这工作非常伤眼力
sense_groups.english: Blind? - Well, not at first, but it was intricate work.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们说虽然她们眼睛瞎了 但这还是很值得的
sense_groups.english: And they said even though they lost their sight, it was all worth it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说你看起来很漂亮 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I bet you looked beautiful. - Oh, well, I don't know about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 但有些宾客说我看起来像飞天天使
sense_groups.english: But there were some people that said I looked like a floating angel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么求婚的 - 对 那是个很棒的故事
sense_groups.english: How did you propose? - Oh, yeah, that's a great story.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我带她去看太阳系模型展
sense_groups.english: Well, um, actually, I took her to the planetarium.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在那里第一次约会
sense_groups.english: That's where we had our first date.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在房里放满了她最喜欢的百合花
sense_groups.english: Um, she walked in, and I had the room filled with, uh, lilies, her favorite flower.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的太棒了 - 我还想听
sense_groups.english: That is so sweet. - Shh. I want to hear the rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 佛列德·艾斯塔唱着 "你今晚的样子"…
sense_groups.english: Then Fred Astaire singing, uh, "The Way You Look Tonight"...

sense_groups.chinese: 灯光熄了
sense_groups.english: ...came on the sound system and the lights came down...

sense_groups.chinese: 我单脚跪下
sense_groups.english: ...and I got on one knee...

sense_groups.chinese: 圆顶另一端在群星间写着
sense_groups.english: ...and written across the dome, in the stars, were the words

sense_groups.chinese: "你愿意嫁给我吗 "
sense_groups.english: "Will you marry me?"

sense_groups.chinese: 戒指有我的拳头那么大
sense_groups.english: And the ring was the size of my fist.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 听着…
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, Phoebe? Look, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想道歉 好吗 我们太坏了
sense_groups.english: ...I want to apologize about before, okay? We were being jerks.

sense_groups.chinese: 派克人很好 我想多了解他
sense_groups.english: Parker's a nice guy, and I'd like to get to know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好快去找他
sense_groups.english: Then you better do it now.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 因为我要杀了他
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because I'm gonna kill him.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 他对所有事都太热衷了
sense_groups.english: What? - You guys were right. He's just too excited about everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很热爱生命 但这是盖勒夫妇结婚35周年派对
sense_groups.english: I mean, I'm all for living life, but this is the Gellers' 35th anniversary.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算我们扯平了 这个派对烂透了
sense_groups.english: Let's call a spade a spade. This party stinks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的觉得无聊到极点
sense_groups.english: I know. I'm having the worst time.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家排队拿食物 我拿到盘子时…
sense_groups.english: There was a 15-minute line for the buffet, and when I finally got up to the plates...

sense_groups.chinese: 踩到一大沱鼻涕滑倒
sense_groups.english: ...I slipped on a giant booger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定那不是生蚝吗
sense_groups.english: Are you sure it wasn't an oyster?

sense_groups.chinese: 有可能 我没看
sense_groups.english: I guess it could've been. I didn't really look at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我把它抹在钱德的外套上 拔腿就溜
sense_groups.english: I just wiped it on Chandler's coat and got the hell out of there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还以为他是个好人 我对他真的很期待
sense_groups.english: I just thought he was such a great guy. I was so excited about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你应该对他充满期待
sense_groups.english: Well, hey, you should be excited about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没有什么不好的
sense_groups.english: There's nothing wrong with him. He's a good guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You think? - Yeah, know what I think?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们太悲观了 - 你说的对
sense_groups.english: We were all just being too negative. - You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 他只是在拥抱生命 我们可以跟派克学习
sense_groups.english: You're right. He's just embracing life. We could all stand to be more like Parker.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我就跟他一样 我是个乐观的人
sense_groups.english: You know what? I am like him. I'm a sunny, positive person.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 你说的对 - 那是什么
sense_groups.english: Actually, you have a little bit of an edge. - What's that now?

sense_groups.chinese: 是派克 - 看 兔子舞
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's Parker. - Look, the Bunny Hop.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, I love it. - You do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗 跟着音乐学动物跳舞 来吧
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? People acting like animals to music? Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 该致词了
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's time for the toast.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道一向都是由罗斯来致词 但今年由我来
sense_groups.english: I know that normally Ross gives the toast, but this year I'm gonna do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这真的很棒
sense_groups.english: No, it's gonna be great. Really.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 爸 我结婚时…
sense_groups.english: Mom, Dad, when I got married...

sense_groups.chinese: 我很确定
sense_groups.english: ...one of the things that made me sure that I could do it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要以你们为榜样
sense_groups.english: ...was the amazing example the two of you set for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了那一点及其他事 我要感谢你们
sense_groups.english: For that, and for so many other things, I wanna say thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想或许我不常那么说…
sense_groups.english: I know I probably don't say it enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我爱你们
sense_groups.english: ...but I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我转头一看
sense_groups.english: When I look around this room...

sense_groups.chinese: 悲伤地想起没办法出席的人
sense_groups.english: ...I'm saddened by the thought of those who could not be with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我亲爱的外婆 她真的很想来
sense_groups.english: Nana, my beloved grandmother, who would so want to be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她来不了…
sense_groups.english: But she can't...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为她死了
sense_groups.english: ...because she's dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有我们的狗 琪琪
sense_groups.english: As is our dog, Chi-Chi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们看他多可爱… 那是过去的事了
sense_groups.english: I mean, look how cute she is... Was.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮我一个忙 请把这个传给我爸妈
sense_groups.english: Do me a favor, pass this to my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 记住他死了 好吗 他跟外婆都死了
sense_groups.english: Remember, um, she's dead, okay? Her and Nana, gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 有谁记得…
sense_groups.english: Hey, does anybody remember when...

sense_groups.chinese: 黛博拉·威格在"亲密关系"中得跟孩子们说再见的样子
sense_groups.english: ...Debra Winger had to say goodbye to her children in Terms of Endearment?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们没看过
sense_groups.english: Didn't see that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人是影痴
sense_groups.english: No movie fans?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想听些悲伤的事吗
sense_groups.english: You want to hear something sad?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在"60分钟"
sense_groups.english: Um, the other day I was watching 60 Minutes...

sense_groups.chinese: 看到罗马尼亚孤儿院的报导…
sense_groups.english: ...and there was this piece on these orphans in Romania...

sense_groups.chinese: 他们受到忽视 以致于无法爱人
sense_groups.english: ...who have been so neglected that they were incapable of love.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都是铁血心肠
sense_groups.english: You people are made of stone.

sense_groups.chinese: 敬爸妈 随便啦
sense_groups.english: Here's to Mom and Dad. Whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢摩妮卡 那真的是太有趣了
sense_groups.english: Thank you, Monica. That was, uh, interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很有趣吧 杰克 - 为什么我不记得这只狗
sense_groups.english: Wasn't it interesting, Jack? - Why don't I remember this dog?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你为什么不为我们致词
sense_groups.english: Ross? Why don't you give us your toast now?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 妈 今年轮到摩妮卡了
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, Mom. It's just Monica this year.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我们35周年派对上 你不致词吗
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna say anything? On our 35th wedding anniversary?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是这样的
sense_groups.english: No, of course, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 大伙们 我只是想…
sense_groups.english: Um, everybody? Um, ahem, I just wanted to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 代表我的新娘瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: ...uh, on behalf of my new bride, Rachel...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟我自己说…
sense_groups.english: ...and myself, um, that if...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们结婚35年后 有你们一半幸福…
sense_groups.english: If in 35 years, we're half as happy as you guys are...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会觉得自己是全世界最幸运的人
sense_groups.english: ...we'll count ourselves the luckiest people in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望外婆还活着 听到罗斯的致词
sense_groups.english: I just wish Nana were alive to hear Ross' toast.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这个走廊的灯光真漂亮
sense_groups.english: My God, what a fantastically well-lit hallway.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要喝点东西吗 譬如水跟镇静剂
sense_groups.english: Can I, um, get you something to drink, like a water and Valium?

sense_groups.chinese: 它… 我得说这间公寓 我不知道该怎么形容
sense_groups.english: I must say, this apartment, it's...there are no words.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢天谢地 - 是个天堂
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God. - It's a haven.

sense_groups.chinese: 位于三楼的天堂 现代伊甸园 - 我知道 我了解
sense_groups.english: A third-floor paradise, a modern-day Eden. - Yeah, I know, I know. Uh-huh. Gotcha.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们为什么不坐下来放轻松
sense_groups.english: Listen, why don't we just, um, sit and relax,

sense_groups.chinese: 安静地彼此依偎
sense_groups.english: you know, just be with each other quietly.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来很不错
sense_groups.english: That sounds great.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我坐过最舒服的沙发
sense_groups.english: My God, this is the most comfortable couch I've ever sat on in my entire life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们试试别的点子 我们来玩游戏
sense_groups.english: Let's try something else. Let's play a game.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢玩游戏 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: I love games. - Shocking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来玩…
sense_groups.english: Um, let's play the game of...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁能最久不说话的游戏
sense_groups.english: ...who can stay quiet the longest.

sense_groups.chinese: 或层层叠
sense_groups.english: Or Jenga.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们先玩这个 记住 先说话的人就输了
sense_groups.english: Let's play this one first, and remember, whoever talks first loses.

sense_groups.chinese: 我输了 现在来玩层层叠 - 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: I lose, now Jenga. - Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪里不对劲吗 - 你知道什么是"不对劲"吗
sense_groups.english: Is something wrong? - Wrong? You know the word "wrong"?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切不是美好又神奇吗
sense_groups.english: Everything isn't perfect? Everything isn't magical?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切不是都在发光发亮吗
sense_groups.english: Everything isn't aglow with the light of a million fairies?

sense_groups.chinese: 那只是刹车灯 派克
sense_groups.english: They were just brake lights, Parker.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我美化了塞车
sense_groups.english: Well, excuse me for putting a good spin on a traffic jam.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必美化所有事
sense_groups.english: But you don't have to put a good spin on everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我是个乐观的人
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. That's who I am. I'm a positive person.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是个乐观的人
sense_groups.english: No, I'm a positive person.

sense_groups.chinese: 你像吃抗忧郁药的圣诞老人
sense_groups.english: You are like Santa Claus on Prozac.

sense_groups.chinese: 在迪士尼乐园被上
sense_groups.english: At Disneyland, getting laid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我悲观吗
sense_groups.english: So, what do you want me to do? You want me to be more negative?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我不快乐吗 - 比较不快乐
sense_groups.english: You want me to be less happy? - Much less happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 引用罗斯的话 "我最好走了"
sense_groups.english: Fine. Well, then to quote Ross, "I better be going."

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: So long.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让"全世界最棒的门" 在你出去时打到你的屁股了
sense_groups.english: Hey. Don't let the best door in the world hit you in the ass on your way out.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你一辈子吵过最不可思议的架吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't this the most incredible fight you've ever had in your entire life?

sense_groups.chinese: 你坐在边车里 我们从婚礼现场走到接待处
sense_groups.english: We could've gone from the ceremony to the reception with you in the sidecar.

sense_groups.chinese: 那行不通
sense_groups.english: Ross, it just wouldn't have been feasible.

sense_groups.chinese: 但鸽子停在你的戒指上就没有问题
sense_groups.english: But having a dove place the ring on your finger would've been no problem.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你结婚真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: It was really fun being married to you tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 这四百块真好赚
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and it was the easiest 400 bucks I ever made.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我能问你一件事吗 - 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, can I, um, ask you something? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 在天文馆求婚 - 我知道 那太蠢了
sense_groups.english: That proposal at the planetarium? - I know, I know. It was stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗 有百合花 歌跟星星
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? With the lilies, and the song and the stars?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒 你是随便编的吗
sense_groups.english: It was really wonderful. Did you just make that up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们交往时 我想过要那么做
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, actually, I thought about it when we were going out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我想跟你求婚的样子
sense_groups.english: That's how I imagined I, uh, would ask you to marry me.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇
sense_groups.english: Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 要拒绝你一定很难
sense_groups.english: Well, that would've been, uh, very hard to say no to.

sense_groups.chinese: 还好我没有那么做
sense_groups.english: Well, it's a good thing I didn't do it...

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来那会是个昂贵的婚礼
sense_groups.english: ...because it sounds like it would have been a very expensive wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 晚安 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Okay, good night. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 即使边车有挡风玻璃不弄乱你的头发
sense_groups.english: Uh, even if the sidecar had a windscreen so your hair wouldn't get messed up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我会考虑的 - 我已经满足了
sense_groups.english: I will think about it. - That's all I'm asking.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 够了 我放弃了
sense_groups.english: Okay, that's it. I give up.

sense_groups.chinese: 在爸妈的40周年派对上 由你来致词
sense_groups.english: At Mom and Dad's 40th anniversary, you're the one giving the speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不了解他们为什么没哭 你的致词真感人
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't understand why they didn't cry. It was a beautiful speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 - 你说关于真爱的事
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on. - Hey. That stuff you said about true love?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 我们从爸妈那里学到了很多
sense_groups.english: You were right. I mean, we did learn a lot from Mom and Dad.

sense_groups.chinese: 琪琪在照片上调皮地笑着
sense_groups.english: And that picture of Chi-Chi with her mischievous grin.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有外婆那一段
sense_groups.english: And what you said about Nana?

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的会很想去参加
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, she really would've wanted to be there.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: And you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想她就在场
sense_groups.english: I think she was.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 罗斯 你是怎么办到的
sense_groups.english: Oh, good God, Ross, how the hell do you do it'?

sense_groups.chinese: 曼陀珠 - 对
sense_groups.english: A mento? - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃的曼陀珠 - 事实上没错
sense_groups.english: Like the candy? - As a matter of fact, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 读者也想知道…
sense_groups.english: Well, um, another thing that our readers always want to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 肥皂剧明星是怎么维持身材的
sense_groups.english: ...is how soap stars stay in such great shape.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有健身妙方吗
sense_groups.english: Do you have some kind of a fitness regime?

sense_groups.chinese: 明星们会正确地饮食 大量运动
sense_groups.english: Uh, we stars usually just try to eat right and get lots of exercise.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们已经丢了一小时的球 球都没掉吗
sense_groups.english: Wow, you realize we've been throwing this ball without dropping it for an hour?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 半小时前就发现了 但我没说话…
sense_groups.english: I realized it a half-hour ago, but I didn't want to say anything...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我不想破坏它
sense_groups.english: ...because I didn't want to jinx it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的很厉害 - 对
sense_groups.english: Wow, we are pretty good at this. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们忘了吃午餐
sense_groups.english: Hey, we totally forgot about lunch.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我第一次忘了吃饭
sense_groups.english: Oh. I think that's the first time I've ever missed a meal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的裤子都松了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think my pants are a little loose.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's wrong with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我举哑铃时觉得胃好痛
sense_groups.english: Oh, I got this blinding pain in my stomach when I was lifting weights before.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来我昏了过去
sense_groups.english: And then I, uh, passed out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没办法站起来 但我想应该没关系
sense_groups.english: I haven't been able to stand up since. Ha, ha. But I don't think it's serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来像是疝气 快去看医生吧
sense_groups.english: This sounds like a hernia. You have to... Go to the doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No way.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我去看医生
sense_groups.english: Look, if I go to the doctor for anything...

sense_groups.chinese: 就得把这玩意夹出我的胃
sense_groups.english: ...it's gonna be for this thing sticking out of my stomach.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要恢复健身的习惯呢
sense_groups.english: Why'd I have to start working out again?

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的15磅哑铃
sense_groups.english: Damn you, 15's.

sense_groups.chinese: 它是什么 - 蛋糕布丁 它有好几层
sense_groups.english: What is it? - It's a trifle. It's got all of these layers.

sense_groups.chinese: 一层手指饼干 然后一层果酱
sense_groups.english: First, there's a layer of ladyfingers, then a layer of jam.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后是甜冻 我自己做的
sense_groups.english: Then custard, which I made from scratch.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后是覆盆子 更多手指饼干
sense_groups.english: Then raspberries, more ladyfingers...

sense_groups.chinese: 加了豆子跟洋葱的烩牛肉
sense_groups.english: ...then beef sauteed with peas and onions.

sense_groups.chinese: 再加一层甜冻
sense_groups.english: Then a little bit more custard.

sense_groups.chinese: 它的味道好像臭脚丫
sense_groups.english: It tastes like feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: I like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗 - 它有什么不好的 甜冻 好吃
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? - What's not to like? Custard, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 果酱 好吃 肉 好吃
sense_groups.english: Jam, good. Meat, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的脸色不太好 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Well, you don't look good, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 冰箱坏了 我得把所有东西吃掉
sense_groups.english: Well, the fridge broke, so I had to eat everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷盘 冰淇淋 莱姆
sense_groups.english: Cold cuts, ice cream, limes.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个棕色罐子里装了什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, what was in that brown jar?

sense_groups.chinese: 它还在 - 现在不在了
sense_groups.english: That's still in there? - Not anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一块没有沾到地板
sense_groups.english: Oh, look. There's a piece that doesn't have floor on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别越界 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: Stick to your side. - Hey, come on, now.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们要吃什么
sense_groups.english: All right, what are we having?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不相信疯狂的节食法 只要正常饮食就行了
sense_groups.english: Uh, I don't believe in these crazy diets. You know, just everything in moderation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的松饼来了
sense_groups.english: Your muffins. - Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要外带
sense_groups.english: I'll take those to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 给孩子们吃
sense_groups.english: For the kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我想问什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know what I wanted to ask you.

sense_groups.chinese: 多年前他们安排你的角色死掉
sense_groups.english: You were on the show years ago and then they killed you off.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: What happened there?

sense_groups.chinese: 很愚蠢
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在一次访问中说了我不该说的话
sense_groups.english: I said some stuff in an interview that I shouldn't have said.

sense_groups.chinese: 但今天我不会那么做
sense_groups.english: But believe me, that is not gonna happen today.

sense_groups.chinese: 了解 那时你说了什么
sense_groups.english: Understood. So, what did you say back then?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说我…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I said that I...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey! How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是雪丽 她代表"肥皂剧文摘"访问我
sense_groups.english: You guys, this is Shelly. She's interviewing me for Soap Opera Digest.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 雪丽 他们是我的朋友
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Shelly, these are my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是女性朋友瑞秋·葛林
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm gal pal Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想知道八卦消息就来找我
sense_groups.english: Um, and if you want the dirt, I'm the one you come to.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可能是乔伊的孩子 谁知道呢
sense_groups.english: This might be Joey's baby, who knows?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在开玩笑 我只是女性朋友瑞秋·葛林
sense_groups.english: I'm just kidding. Seriously, gal pal Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 她刚刚丢够了她还没有出世的孩子的脸
sense_groups.english: Who just lost the respect of her unborn child.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去加点热水 - 好
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go get this warmed up. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你表现得很好 - 到目前为止没有说傻话
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're doing great. - So far, nothing stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 曼陀珠 - 不 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Mento? - No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 身为乔伊的朋友
sense_groups.english: So as Joey's friends...

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么事是读者应该知道的吗
sense_groups.english: ...is there anything you think our readers ought to know?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他是个大好人
sense_groups.english: Uh, no, just that he is a great guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这话可以让你上 "肥皂剧文摘"才怪呢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's gonna get you into Soap Opera Digest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: Well, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说乔伊
sense_groups.english: I would just like to say that Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 真的丰富了我们的生活
sense_groups.english: ...truly has enriched the days of our lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该没想到这么性感的男人会那么体贴
sense_groups.english: Um, I just think that you don't expect someone so hot to be so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 你叫什么名字 - 菲比·布非
sense_groups.english: Oh, I like that. What's your name? - Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 要怎么拼
sense_groups.english: How do you spell that? So we can get it right.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比的P 希比的H
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's P as in Phoebe. H as in Heebie.

sense_groups.chinese: 欧比的0 艾比的E
sense_groups.english: O as in Obie. E as in Ebie.

sense_groups.chinese: 比比的B "哈罗 朋友"的E
sense_groups.english: B as in Beebee. And E as in, "'ello there, mate."

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 很高兴能认识你们
sense_groups.english: Great. Well, it was nice meeting all of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我也是 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you too. - Thanks, you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 你似乎有很多朋友
sense_groups.english: So it seems like you have a lot of friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 谁是你最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Who would you say is your best friend?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么会有两个
sense_groups.english: How come you have two?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个是送你的
sense_groups.english: Well, this one's for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能 - 对 不可能
sense_groups.english: Get out. - No, I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这对你来说意义重大
sense_groups.english: No, no. Listen, I know how much this means to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不只是首饰而已
sense_groups.english: And I also know this is about more than jewelry.

sense_groups.chinese: 它代表了你跟我是最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: It's about you and me and the fact that we're best buds.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是友谊吗 我想是的
sense_groups.english: Wow. Is this friendship? I think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 我们是手镯兄弟
sense_groups.english: Check it out. We're bracelet buddies.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是那样子叫我们的
sense_groups.english: That's what they'll call us.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 对不起 - 没关系 别担心
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey. I'm sorry. - It's all right. Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 它会留下印子
sense_groups.english: No, but look. Oh, that's gonna leave a stain.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 没关系 你在乔伊家
sense_groups.english: Rach, hey, it's fine. You're at Joey's.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 对 你看
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有过过这种生活 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I've never lived like this before. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 别浪费它 它还是食物 天啊
sense_groups.english: Well, don't waste it. I mean, it's still food. Jeez.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得有罪恶感 我想当个好朋友
sense_groups.english: I've been feeling guilty about this. I wanna be a good friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 我是个好朋友 闭上你的嘴巴跟眼睛
sense_groups.english: ...and damn it, I am a good friend. So shut up and close your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个好朋友
sense_groups.english: You are a good friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天早上去试镜 但我失败了
sense_groups.english: Of course, the audition was this morning, and I didn't get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个吻真的很棒 瑞秋是个幸运的女孩
sense_groups.english: But that was a hell of a kiss. Rachel is a very lucky girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 请参赛者离开隔离区
sense_groups.english: Let's get the contestants out of their isolation booths.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们出发了
sense_groups.english: And they're off. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 别挡住我的选手 裁判
sense_groups.english: Get your foot off my contestant. Judge.

sense_groups.chinese: 裁判判决没有犯规
sense_groups.english: Judge rules: No violation.

sense_groups.chinese: 鸭子踩到奶油了 - 不 等一下 那不是奶油
sense_groups.english: The duck gets the Nutter Butter. - No. Wait, that's not a Nutter Butter.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是以前掉的馄饨 - 裁判判决是奶油
sense_groups.english: That's an old wonton. - Judge rules: Nutter Butter.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很难决定 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh. Tough call. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在探索频道看过
sense_groups.english: I had seen this thing on the Discovery Channel.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我看过它 在探索频道上
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. I saw that. On the Discovery Channel.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 关于水母 如果你…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, about jellyfish, and how if you...

sense_groups.chinese: 你尿在自己身上
sense_groups.english: Ew. You peed on yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 别那么说 你不了解那有多痛
sense_groups.english: ou can't say that. You don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我会痛得昏过去
sense_groups.english: I mean, I thought I was gonna pass out from the pain.

sense_groups.chinese: 总之我试过了 但我没办法那样子弯曲身子
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I tried, but I couldn't bend that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我帮了她一个大忙
sense_groups.english: That's right, I stepped up.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的朋友 她需要帮忙
sense_groups.english: She's my friend and she needed help.

sense_groups.chinese: 有必要的话 我会尿在你们身上
sense_groups.english: If I had to, I'd pee on any one of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有最好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Uh, nope. No best friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只有很多密友
sense_groups.english: No, just a lot of close friends. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在言归正传
sense_groups.english: So, uh, now back to the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 有那么多男同志支持你 你有什么感觉
sense_groups.english: How does it feel to have a huge gay fan base?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 我
sense_groups.english: Really? Me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认识任何男同志
sense_groups.english: Wow, I don't even know any huge gay people.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的觉得心好痛
sense_groups.english: It hurts me. It physically hurts me.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我们的私下谈话 你不是…
sense_groups.english: Now, off the record, you're not...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你指我的男包包吗
sense_groups.english: What? Are you referring to my man's bag?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚开始它看起来不错 但它真的很实用
sense_groups.english: At first, I thought it just looked good, but it's practical too. Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 它有很多放东西的小袋子 你可以放皮夹 钥匙 电话簿
sense_groups.english: It's got compartments for all your stuff: your wallet, your keys, your address book.

sense_groups.chinese: 化妆品
sense_groups.english: Your makeup.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要从你的正面爬下 让我们面对面
sense_groups.english: Now, should I climb down your front so we're face to face...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是从你的背面爬下 屁股对脸
sense_groups.english: ...or should I climb down your back so we're butt to face?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想面对面比较好 - 对 面对面
sense_groups.english: I think face is best. - Yeah, face to face.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我来了 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, here I come. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊… 你有多重 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my... How much do you weigh, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想回答那个问题 假日结束后我胖了不少
sense_groups.english: I'd prefer not to answer that right now. I'm still carrying a little holiday weight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们说面对面时…
sense_groups.english: You know, when we talked about face to face...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有想清楚
sense_groups.english: ...I don't think we thought it all the way through.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看
sense_groups.english: Check it out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很有男子气概吧
sense_groups.english: How much of a man am I?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你是男子汉也是个荡妇
sense_groups.english: Nice. Manly and also kind of a slut.

sense_groups.chinese: 你变成女人了
sense_groups.english: You're turning into a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你为什么会那么说 那太伤人了
sense_groups.english: No, I'm not. Why would you say that? That's just mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 我惹毛你了 我说了什么
sense_groups.english: Now I've upset you? What did I say?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你说的话 是你的语气
sense_groups.english: Not what you said, it's just the way you said it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我是个女人
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! I'm a woman!

sense_groups.chinese: 我睡得很熟 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Great nap. - It really was.

sense_groups.chinese: 我 男同志 不
sense_groups.english: Me? Gay? No. No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我有很多密友是男同志
sense_groups.english: Uh, but I have a number of close friends who are.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来谈谈女人
sense_groups.english: So let's talk about women.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信女性读者对你的爱情生活很有兴趣
sense_groups.english: I'm sure our female readers will be interested to know about your romantic life.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会看着女人 跟她说
sense_groups.english: Oh, what I do is, I look a woman up and down and I say

sense_groups.chinese: "嘿 你好吗 "
sense_groups.english: "Hey. How you doing?"

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你好吗
sense_groups.english: Hey. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 他有一辆很棒的保时捷
sense_groups.english: He has the most amazing Porsche under there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很乐意让你们参观 但我才刚把它停好 它在休息
sense_groups.english: I'd love to show you, but I just tucked her in. She's sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个想去喝一杯吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, would you two girls like to go for a drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋在吗 我是她妹妹 - 天啊 吉儿
sense_groups.english: Is Rachel here? I'm her sister. - Oh, my God. Jill.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瑞秋 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Rachel. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 快帮我们介绍 - 他是钱德
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Introduce us. - Well, this is Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 你认识摩妮卡跟罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hi. - You know Monica and Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 她是菲比 他是乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi. - And that's Phoebe. And that's Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你好吗 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Hey, how you doing? - Don't!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个好人
sense_groups.english: You're a really nice guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢当你的室友跟朋友
sense_groups.english: ...and I'm happy to be your roommate and your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…你知道的 我对你没有那种感觉
sense_groups.english: I'm just... You know, I just don't feel that way about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道发生了什么事
sense_groups.english: Oh, I see what happened. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是因为我试着抗拒你 对吧
sense_groups.english: It's because I was trying to repel you. Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 我发动攻势后 你会有不同的感觉
sense_groups.english: Believe me, you'd feel a lot different if I turned it on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不那么认为 - 我那么认为
sense_groups.english: I don't think so. - Oh, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗
sense_groups.english: How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 天啊
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, dear God.

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么好说的 我真的很害羞
sense_groups.english: Not much to tell there. I'm really shy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我猜我已经问完了
sense_groups.english: So that's it. I guess that's all I need.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该下一期就会刊出
sense_groups.english: I think they will be running this in the beginning of next month.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Great. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 拜拜
sense_groups.english: Bye. - Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办到了 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: I did it. - Amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我差点忘了 我们得问每个人这个问题
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait, I almost forgot. We have to ask everybody this

sense_groups.chinese: 除了"我们的日子"以外 你最喜欢哪出肥皂剧
sense_groups.english: Other than Days of Our Lives, what's your favorite soap opera?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不看肥皂剧 抱歉 我的生活没那么无聊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't watch soap operas. Excuse me? I have a life, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 "肥皂剧文摘"的读者…
sense_groups.english: Thank you. The readers at Soap Opera Digest...

sense_groups.chinese: 知道那一点一定会很高兴
sense_groups.english: ...will be happy to learn that.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好
sense_groups.english: Oh. Good enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 只差一点而已
sense_groups.english: So close.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 他们没登出…
sense_groups.english: Wow, I can't believe they didn't put in the part...

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你不看肥皂剧那一段
sense_groups.english: ...where you said you didn't watch soap operas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打电话告诉那个女记者 我是在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I called the lady about that. I told her I was joking.

sense_groups.chinese: 她接受了
sense_groups.english: She was pretty nice about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟她上床了 对吧 - 可以那么说
sense_groups.english: You slept with her, didn't you? - A little bit. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这张照片蛮性感的
sense_groups.english: Wow. This picture of you sure is steamy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是为了配合我的男同志影迷的喜好
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, that's just a little something for my huge gay fan base.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在跟我眨眼睛吗
sense_groups.english: Did you just wink at me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢那张照片
sense_groups.english: Hey, you're the one who loves the picture.

questions.name: S08E20
questions.en:
Hi. - Hey.
So, what's the final head count on my baby shower?
About 20. A couple people from work who had something else to do.
Also, your sisters called, neither can make it.
What? You mean they're not coming to a social event...
...where there's no men and no booze? That's shocking.
Well, I don't care. As long as my mom's here.
Oh, my God. Your mother. - What, my mom's not gonna be here?
Well, given that we forgot to invite her...
...it would be an awfully big coincidence if she was.
Oh, my God.
Well, it wasn't my fault. Phoebe was in charge of the invitations.
Well, I don't have a mother. So often I forget other people...
Oh, give it a rest.
So my mother is not coming to my baby shower?
No.
Neither is mine.
You know what? Don't worry.
Okay? We'll take care of it. We'll call her. You go home and get ready.
Please make sure she comes. It's really important to me. It's my mom.
I know. What's her number? - I don't know.
Go. I have it in my book. Go.
Wait a minute. If you're in charge of invitations, why am I calling her?
Hello, Mrs. Green. Hi, uh, it's Monica Geller.
Oh, hello, Monica. - Hi.
Um, I know this is last-minute, but we've decided to throw an impromptu...
...baby shower for Rachel today. - I know. My daughters told me about it...
...when they received their impromptu invitations a month ago.
Okay, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. - For what, dear?
For not inviting me, or for lying about it?
Oh, my God. My ass is sweating.
Please, please, can you come? It's today at 4.
Well, all right. I'll see you at 4. - Thank you.
Isn't it at 3? - Son of a bitch.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey, Joe. Wanna shoot some hoops?
No, I can't go, I'm practicing. I got an audition to be the host of a game show.
Cool. - Great.
Yeah, and if I get it, by day, I'll be Dr. Drake Ramoray.
But by night, I'll be Joey Tribbiani.
You'll be perfect for this. That's already your name.
The audition's in a couple hours, and I don't even understand the game.
Do you want some help?
Oh, really? That'd be great. Hey, you guys can be the contestants.
Okay, I guess we can lose to junior-high girls some other time.
All right. Let's play Bamboozled. - Bamboozled?
Isn't that a cool name?
Yeah. - No.
All right. Uh, okay. Our first contestant is Ross Geller.
Why don't you tell us a little bit about yourself, Ross?
Well, uh, I'm a paleontologist. Um, I live in New York.
I have a son, Ben. Uh, hi, Ben. And, uh...
I said a little bit, Ross. Now, how about you, Chandler?
Well, Joey, I'm a headhunter. I hook up out-of-work Soviet scientists...
...with rogue Third World nations. Hi, Rasputin.
Excellent. Let's play Bamboozled. Chandler, you'll go first.
What is the capital of Colombia? - Bogote.
It's Bogoda, but close enough.
Now, you can either pass your turn to Ross or pick a Wicked Wango Card.
What does a Wicked Wango Card do? - I should know that.
Let's see. Just one moment, please, um...
Here we are. A Wicked Wango Card determines whether you go higher or lower.
Higher or lower than what?
This is embarrassing. - Can you believe how lame this is?
I'm sorry. I don't believe contestants are allowed to talk to each other.
Oh, I told the stripper to be here at 5. That's good, right?
You ordered a stripper for the shower? That is totally inappropriate.
Why? He's gonna be dressed as a baby.
Oh, hi, Mrs. Green. I'm so glad you could make it.
Yes, thank you so much. And again, we're so sorry.
We could not feel worse about it.
Try.
There's my little girl.
She's still mad. - Yeah, I know.
Isn't it great? One less person we have to make small talk with.
Phoebe, Sandra's mad at you too. It doesn't bother you?
Look, we've apologized twice. I can't do any more than that.
I know you hate it when people are mad at you...
...but, you know, you just have to be okay with it.
Okay. I can do that. Heh.
I gotta go powder my ass. - Oh.
Look at that face. Just like when you were in high school.
If I didn't know better, I'd say you were a cheerleader in trouble.
Come on, let's get some tea. - Okay.
Ooh, my. Look at that. Only three weeks to go.
Now, have you picked your nanny yet?
I don't want you to just use your housekeeper...
...because it'll just split her focus.
Oh. Actually, I'm not gonna use a nanny. And, uh, I don't even have a housekeeper.
It's like you're a cave person.
Rachel, you must get a nanny.
You don't know how overwhelming this is gonna be.
When you were a baby, I had full-time help. I had Mrs. K.
Mrs. K. Oh, yeah, she was sweet. She taught me Spanish.
I actually think I remember some of it
Such a sweet woman. - Yeah.
Well, however great she was, I just can't afford that.
Oh, Rachel. - What?
I just had the greatest idea. I'm gonna come live with you.
What? What?
Oh, I'm so happy I'm gonna do this for my little girl.
Aw, look at you. You have tears in your eyes.
Yes, yes, I do.
All right, Ross, you're in the lead.
Would you like to take another question, or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?
The Wheel has not been my friend tonight, Joey. Uh...
I'll take another question.
Okay. This is gonna be tough. Hold your breath.
It's okay. I'm ready.
No, dude, you gotta hold your breath till you're ready to answer the question.
It's part of the game. - This is ridiculous. He's not gonna hold...
Okay. What do you have a fear of if you suffer from this phobia? Triska...
Holy cow. That's a big word. Tris...
Seriously, look at this thing, Chandler. How do you say that?
Let me see that. - This one right here.
Triskaidekaphobia. - Fear of Triscuits.
No. No. Fear of the number 13. - Fear of Triscuits?
It's possible. They have really sharp edges.
All right, Chandler, you're up.
Wait a minute. I believe I'm entitled to use my Angel Pass for a free turn.
This game makes no sense. - You're just upset because you're losing.
Oh, come on, Ross. I think we're all losers here.
All right. Chandler, you can either spin the Wheel or pick a Google Card.
Let me think, let me think. Oh, uh, I don't care.
You must choose, Mr. Bing.
Either. It makes no difference. - Choose, you jackass.
I'll take a card. - Okay, you picked the Gimme Card.
You get all of Ross' points. - What?
This game is kind of fun.
You don't think it's a little crazy that you get all my points...?
I don't think the contestants are supposed to speak to each other.
Why did you invite my mother? - What?
She wants to move in with me and Ross to help take care of the baby.
For how long? - Eight weeks.
I mean, I love my mother, but, my God, a long lunch with her is taxing.
I personally would be honored if she wanted to live with me.
She can't hear you.
You guys, come on. What am I gonna do?
If you don't want your mother to move in with you, just tell her.
You're right. You're right. I'm about to have a baby.
I can tell my mother that I don't want her to be sleeping on my couch.
Oh, my God. She's gonna wanna sleep in my bed with me. This cannot happen.
That's right. That is right.
You go over there and tell her you do not want her to live with you.
Do not take no for an answer. - Okay.
This is great. Now she's gonna be mad at Rachel.
And I'm just gonna swoop in there and be like the daughter she never had.
I have new respect for Chandler.
All right, everybody. It's time to open the presents.
Yes, and I think that the first gift that Rachel opens...
...should be from the grandmother of the baby.
Because you're the most important person in this room. And in the world.
Well, um, I don't have a gift because I wasn't invited until the last minute.
But thank you so much, dear, for bringing that to everybody's attention.
How about you less important people? Let's open your presents.
Mom, it's okay that you didn't get a gift. - Well, I kind of did.
Me. Eight weeks of me. - Yeah.
Okay. See, Mom, the truth is, I can do this on my own.
Sweetheart, I know you're gonna be a terrific mom.
I just think you need a little help, especially at the beginning.
But, Mom, I really know what I'm doing. I can handle this.
Really? Remember Twinkles?
He was a hamster. I'm not gonna vacuum up my baby.
Okay, come on, Rach. It's present time.
You know, you're the glue holding this whole party together.
It's kind of falling apart here.
Ooh, look. - Wow.
This is from your friends at work.
Ooh, my gosh. Oh, wow. Oh, I know what this is.
Wait a minute.
That can't be right.
Is that a beer bong for a baby?
Darling, that's a breast pump.
Heh. Did I say I was done guessing? Okay, thank you for that.
Ooh, wow. What's this?
It's a Diaper Genie. - Oh, it dispenses clean diapers.
No, it's where you put dirty ones.
Well, that's gross. Why don't you just take it outside and throw it in a Dumpster?
You're gonna do that 10 times a day? - What, it goes 10 times a day?
What are we feeding this baby, Indian food?
No, dear. That's what babies do.
Rachel, listen to your mother. She is very smart.
Plus, what are you planning on doing with the baby
while you trot out to the garbage?
I don't know, I'd leave it on the changing table?
What? What did I do? What did I do? - You can't leave a baby alone.
Of course, I know that.
I mean, of course you never leave a baby alone. Ha, ha.
I mean, it would... She wouldn't be safe.
You know, not as safe as she would be with me, the baby dummy. Ha, ha.
Okay, you know what? Opening the presents is a little overwhelming right now.
So I think, um, I'm just gonna maybe open them all a little bit later.
But thank you all for coming, and for these beautiful gifts...
...and this basket is beautiful. - It's actually a bassinet.
Okay, Mommy, don't ever leave me.
In what John Huston film would you hear this line
"Badges? We don't need no stinking badges."
Treasure of the Sierra Madre. - Correct.
There's a possible Backwards Bonus.
Madre Sierra the of Treasure. - Yes.
I'd like to go up the Ladder of Chance to the Golden Mud Hut, please.
Wise choice. How many rungs? - Six.
That noise can only mean one thing. - Hungry Monkey.
I'd like a Wicked Wango Card. - Okay. It's an audio question.
Name this television theme song
Oh. Oh, my God. Okay, I know this. Give me a second.
Tell it to the Time Turtle. - Shut up.
I Dream of Jeannie. - Yes. Yes, you're back in the lead.
Uh, I'd like to spin the Wheel.
Oh, come on.
Uh, uh, Super Speedy Speed Round.
Is there a Hopping Bonus? - Of course.
Who invented bifocals? - Ben Franklin.
Correct. Which monarch has ruled Great Britain the longest?
Queen Victoria. - Correct again.
But you forgot to switch legs between questions. So no Hopping Bonus.
Oh! Every time. - Yeah.
Now over to Chandler. - I'd like a Google Card.
Are you sure? - Yes. No. Google.
Oh, my God. Congratulations, Ross. Because, Chandler...
...you've been Bamboozled. - No!
Yes! - This is the best game ever!
So, um, you're gonna stay with me as long as I need you?
Of course I am. - Mom, I swear I'm not an idiot.
I read all kinds of books on pregnancy and giving birth.
But I just didn't think to read the part about what to do when the baby comes.
And, guess what, the baby's coming...
...and I don't know what to do. Oh, can I throw up in my Diaper Genie?
Oh, sweetie, you're gonna be fine.
Wait, where you going? - I'm going to the bathroom.
Now, don't worry. Everything's gonna be okay.
It is gonna be okay.
Worth a shot.
Hey. - Hey.
Why are you all red and sweaty?
I just Bamboozled Chandler.
Which is not a sexual thing.
Well, that was a quick shower. - Not if you were here.
Wow, looks like we got a lot of good stuff.
We did. But my mom got us the greatest gift of all.
A Play-Doh Barbershop?
No. She's going to live with us for eight weeks.
What?
Yes. She's gonna help us take care of the baby. Woo-hoo.
You're not serious.
I mean, she's a very nice woman...
...but there's no way we can take eight weeks of her.
She'll drive us totally crazy... - Hi, Ross.
Hey, roomie.
Hey, Joey, hi, I'm Ray. I'm the producer of the show.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Ray.
And this is Duncan and Erin. They're gonna help out with the audition.
So let's get the camera rolling.
Righty-0, Ray. - Whenever you're ready.
Hello. I'm Joey Tribbiani. Let's play Bamboozled.
Erin, you get the first question. In hockey, who is known as "The Great One"?
Wayne Gretzky. - Correct.
Now, would you like to pick a Wicked Wango Card or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?
Uh, Joey, didn't your agents give you the revised rules?
We've eliminated all that. No wheel. No cards.
What? Why?
Well, the game was too complicated and research showed people didn't follow it.
What's complicated? You spin the Wheel of Mayhem to go up the Ladder of Chance...
...past the Mud Hut through the Rainbow Ring to get to the Golden Monkey.
You yank his tail, and boom, you're in Paradise Pond.
Yeah. All that's gone.
Um, it's basically just a simple question-and-answer game now.
Well, what's fun about that?
You expect me to be the host of a boring game...
...that's just people standing around answering questions?
Well, there'll be women in bikinis holding up the scores.
Let's play Bamboozled.
And all those dinosaur knickknacks you have...
...Ross, I thought they might be more at home in the garage.
Well, we don't have a garage. - Did I say garage? I meant garbage.
You know what, Mrs. Green? Maybe it's not absolutely vital that you live with us.
Well, Rachel needs help with the baby. - I do. I really do. I don't know anything.
I'm sure that's not true.
Oh, no? Pheebs, Monica, do I know anything about babies?
Nope. Not a thing. - Mm-mm. It's frightening.
Well, um, you know what? Even if she doesn't know anything, I do.
I have a son. His mother and I didn't live together.
Whenever he was with me, I took care of him all the time, by myself.
That's true. You do have another child. - Yeah.
With another woman.
Have you no control, Ross?
That's a different issue.
Um, the point is, when the baby comes, I will be there to feed her...
...and bathe her and change her.
And more than that, I want to do all those things.
Well, then you don't need me to live with you.
Yes!
Yes. You're gonna be so missed.
You're gonna be a great father.
Well, you're gonna be a wonderful grandma.
Hello? I still don't know what the hell I'm doing.
Come on, every first-time mother feels that way.
You're gonna pick it up. Hey, you will. Look, when you first came to the city...
...you were this spoiled, helpless little girl...
...who still used Daddy's credit cards, remember?
I hope you're going somewhere with this.
Look at you. You're this big executive.
You are much more capable than you give yourself credit for.
I have no doubt you're gonna be an incredible mother.
Really? - I'm telling you.
Thank you.
All right, you two. I'm gonna get going.
Oh. - Oh, no, sweetheart, you stay put.
I'll let myself out. It's like I'm not here. Which I almost wasn't.
You're just so funny. You're so funny. What do I do?
Nothing. You have apologized to her like a million times.
And she's been nothing but terrible to you.
And don't forget, you just threw her daughter...
...a lovely, albeit slightly boring, shower.
And she hasn't even thanked you for it. - You know what? You're right.
Yeah, I mean, if you wanna say anything to her, I'd tell her off.
Really?
Okay, I will.
Mrs. Green?
Mrs. Green?
It is rude to leave a party without saying goodbye to the host.
And also, when someone apologizes to you...
...the decent thing to do is to accept it.
Because what I did to you, it wasn't on purpose.
But what you're doing to me now is plain spiteful.
Spiteful? - That's right.
Maybe it's time you took a good, hard look in the mirror, young lady.
Old lady.
Lady.
Wrap it up. Wrap it up. Wrap it up.
So whenever you're ready to apologize to me, I will forgive you. Good day.
I can't feel my legs.
You were fantastic. I'm so proud of you.
Yeah? I'm proud of me too. - You should be.
Could you get me something to drink? - You got it.
Mrs. Green? Okay, I'm really sorry. I apologize. If you just... Aah!
Okay. I bit my tongue.
But I'm still really sorry.
Okay, I'm ready. - You sure?
Yes. I've done my studying, and I really know my stuff.
All right, then.
Rachel Green, let's play Bamboozled.
How do you test the temperature of the baby's bathwater?
Uh, put your elbow in it. - Excellent.
How do you put a baby down for a nap?
Full, dry, on its back, and no loose covers.
That's correct.
This is an audio question. What do you do when a baby makes this sound
Uh, check if it's wet, check if it's hungry, burp it.
Excellent. Now, do you want another question or a Wicked Wango Card?
A card. A card. I pick a card. - Oh, I'm sorry.
You've been Bamboozled. You're gonna be a terrible mother.
I've lost sight of why we're doing this.
