Are you sure? - Yes. No. Google.
Oh, my God. Congratulations, Ross. Because, Chandler...
...you've been Bamboozled. - No!
Yes! - This is the best game ever!
So, um, you're gonna stay with me as long as I need you?
Of course I am. - Mom, I swear I'm not an idiot.
I read all kinds of books on pregnancy and giving birth.
But I just didn't think to read the part about what to do when the baby comes.
And, guess what, the baby's coming...
...and I don't know what to do. Oh, can I throw up in my Diaper Genie?
Oh, sweetie, you're gonna be fine.
Wait, where you going? - I'm going to the bathroom.
Now, don't worry. Everything's gonna be okay.
It is gonna be okay.
Worth a shot.
Hey. - Hey.
Why are you all red and sweaty?
I just Bamboozled Chandler.
Which is not a sexual thing.
Well, that was a quick shower. - Not if you were here.
Wow, looks like we got a lot of good stuff.
We did. But my mom got us the greatest gift of all.
A Play-Doh Barbershop?
No. She's going to live with us for eight weeks.
What?
Yes. She's gonna help us take care of the baby. Woo-hoo.
You're not serious.
I mean, she's a very nice woman...
...but there's no way we can take eight weeks of her.
She'll drive us totally crazy... - Hi, Ross.
Hey, roomie.
Hey, Joey, hi, I'm Ray. I'm the producer of the show.
It's a pleasure to meet you, Ray.
And this is Duncan and Erin. They're gonna help out with the audition.
So let's get the camera rolling.
Righty-0, Ray. - Whenever you're ready.
Hello. I'm Joey Tribbiani. Let's play Bamboozled.
Erin, you get the first question. In hockey, who is known as "The Great One"?
Wayne Gretzky. - Correct.
Now, would you like to pick a Wicked Wango Card or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?
Uh, Joey, didn't your agents give you the revised rules?
We've eliminated all that. No wheel. No cards.
What? Why?
Well, the game was too complicated and research showed people didn't follow it.
What's complicated? You spin the Wheel of Mayhem to go up the Ladder of Chance...
...past the Mud Hut through the Rainbow Ring to get to the Golden Monkey.
You yank his tail, and boom, you're in Paradise Pond.
Yeah. All that's gone.
Um, it's basically just a simple question-and-answer game now.
Well, what's fun about that?
You expect me to be the host of a boring game...
...that's just people standing around answering questions?
Well, there'll be women in bikinis holding up the scores.
Let's play Bamboozled.
And all those dinosaur knickknacks you have...
...Ross, I thought they might be more at home in the garage.
Well, we don't have a garage. - Did I say garage? I meant garbage.
You know what, Mrs. Green? Maybe it's not absolutely vital that you live with us.
Well, Rachel needs help with the baby. - I do. I really do. I don't know anything.
I'm sure that's not true.
Oh, no? Pheebs, Monica, do I know anything about babies?
Nope. Not a thing. - Mm-mm. It's frightening.
Well, um, you know what? Even if she doesn't know anything, I do.
I have a son. His mother and I didn't live together.
Whenever he was with me, I took care of him all the time, by myself.
That's true. You do have another child. - Yeah.
With another woman.
Have you no control, Ross?
That's a different issue.
Um, the point is, when the baby comes, I will be there to feed her...
...and bathe her and change her.
And more than that, I want to do all those things.
Well, then you don't need me to live with you.
Yes!
Yes. You're gonna be so missed.
You're gonna be a great father.
Well, you're gonna be a wonderful grandma.
Hello? I still don't know what the hell I'm doing.
Come on, every first-time mother feels that way.
You're gonna pick it up. Hey, you will. Look, when you first came to the city...
...you were this spoiled, helpless little girl...
...who still used Daddy's credit cards, remember?
I hope you're going somewhere with this.
Look at you. You're this big executive.
You are much more capable than you give yourself credit for.
I have no doubt you're gonna be an incredible mother.
Really? - I'm telling you.
Thank you.
All right, you two. I'm gonna get going.
Oh. - Oh, no, sweetheart, you stay put.
I'll let myself out. It's like I'm not here. Which I almost wasn't.
You're just so funny. You're so funny. What do I do?
Nothing. You have apologized to her like a million times.
And she's been nothing but terrible to you.
And don't forget, you just threw her daughter...
...a lovely, albeit slightly boring, shower.
And she hasn't even thanked you for it. - You know what? You're right.
Yeah, I mean, if you wanna say anything to her, I'd tell her off.
Really?
Okay, I will.
Mrs. Green?
Mrs. Green?
It is rude to leave a party without saying goodbye to the host.
And also, when someone apologizes to you...
...the decent thing to do is to accept it.
Because what I did to you, it wasn't on purpose.
But what you're doing to me now is plain spiteful.
Spiteful? - That's right.
Maybe it's time you took a good, hard look in the mirror, young lady.
Old lady.
Lady.
Wrap it up. Wrap it up. Wrap it up.
So whenever you're ready to apologize to me, I will forgive you. Good day.
I can't feel my legs.
You were fantastic. I'm so proud of you.
Yeah? I'm proud of me too. - You should be.
Could you get me something to drink? - You got it.
Mrs. Green? Okay, I'm really sorry. I apologize. If you just... Aah!
Okay. I bit my tongue.
But I'm still really sorry.
Okay, I'm ready. - You sure?
Yes. I've done my studying, and I really know my stuff.
All right, then.
Rachel Green, let's play Bamboozled.
How do you test the temperature of the baby's bathwater?
Uh, put your elbow in it. - Excellent.
How do you put a baby down for a nap?
Full, dry, on its back, and no loose covers.
That's correct.
This is an audio question. What do you do when a baby makes this sound
Uh, check if it's wet, check if it's hungry, burp it.
Excellent. Now, do you want another question or a Wicked Wango Card?
A card. A card. I pick a card. - Oh, I'm sorry.
You've been Bamboozled. You're gonna be a terrible mother.
I've lost sight of why we're doing this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 有多少人会来参加宝宝的欢迎会
sense_groups.english: So, what's the final head count on my baby shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约有20个人 有些同事有事没办法来
sense_groups.english: About 20. A couple people from work who had something else to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的妹妹们打电话来说 她们没办法来
sense_groups.english: Also, your sisters called, neither can make it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你说她们不来参加…
sense_groups.english: What? You mean they're not coming to a social event...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有男人跟酒的社交聚会 那真的是太稀奇了
sense_groups.english: ...where there's no men and no booze? That's shocking.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎 只要我妈能来就行了
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't care. As long as my mom's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你妈 - 什么 我妈不会来吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Your mother. - What, my mom's not gonna be here?

sense_groups.chinese: 说不定我们忘了邀请她
sense_groups.english: Well, given that we forgot to invite her...

sense_groups.chinese: 反而能让她松口气
sense_groups.english: ...it would be an awfully big coincidence if she was.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我的错 菲比负责发请帖的
sense_groups.english: Well, it wasn't my fault. Phoebe was in charge of the invitations.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有妈妈 所以我常忘了…
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't have a mother. So often I forget other people...

sense_groups.chinese: 得了吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, give it a rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈妈不来参加宝宝的欢迎会
sense_groups.english: So my mother is not coming to my baby shower?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈也不会来
sense_groups.english: Neither is mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会处理的
sense_groups.english: You know what? Don't worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会打电话给她 你先回家做准备
sense_groups.english: Okay? We'll take care of it. We'll call her. You go home and get ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 确定她一定会来 这很重要 她是我妈
sense_groups.english: Please make sure she comes. It's really important to me. It's my mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 她电话号码几号 - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I know. What's her number? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去吧 我记在我的电话簿里了
sense_groups.english: Go. I have it in my book. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你负责寄请帖 为什么是我打电话给她
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. If you're in charge of invitations, why am I calling her?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 葛林太太 嗨 我是摩妮卡·盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hello, Mrs. Green. Hi, uh, it's Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 摩妮卡 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, hello, Monica. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是紧急通知 我们打算在今天…
sense_groups.english: Um, I know this is last-minute, but we've decided to throw an impromptu...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮瑞秋的宝宝办欢迎会 - 我的女儿们已经告诉我了…
sense_groups.english: ...baby shower for Rachel today. - I know. My daughters told me about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 她们在一个月前就接到欢迎会的请帖
sense_groups.english: ...when they received their impromptu invitations a month ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我很抱歉 - 为什么呢 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. - For what, dear?

sense_groups.chinese: 为了没有邀请我 还是你说谎骗我呢
sense_groups.english: For not inviting me, or for lying about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我的屁股在流汗
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. My ass is sweating.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 你能来吗 欢迎会四点开始
sense_groups.english: Please, please, can you come? It's today at 4.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 四点见 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Well, all right. I'll see you at 4. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是三点开始吗 - 混蛋
sense_groups.english: Isn't it at 3? - Son of a bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你要去打篮球吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe. Wanna shoot some hoops?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能去 我在练习 我要参加新游戏节目主持人的试镜
sense_groups.english: No, I can't go, I'm practicing. I got an audition to be the host of a game show.

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊 - 太棒了
sense_groups.english: Cool. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我能当上主持人 白天我是德瑞克·拉莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and if I get it, by day, I'll be Dr. Drake Ramoray.

sense_groups.chinese: 但晚上我是乔伊·崔比亚尼
sense_groups.english: But by night, I'll be Joey Tribbiani.

sense_groups.chinese: 你非常适合这份工作 节目名称跟你的名字一样
sense_groups.english: You'll be perfect for this. That's already your name.

sense_groups.chinese: 再过几小时就要试镜 我搞不懂这个游戏
sense_groups.english: The audition's in a couple hours, and I don't even understand the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要帮忙吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want some help?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 那真的太棒了 你们可以当参赛者
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? That'd be great. Hey, you guys can be the contestants.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以下次再去让国中女生赢球
sense_groups.english: Okay, I guess we can lose to junior-high girls some other time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们来玩晕头转向 - 晕头转向
sense_groups.english: All right. Let's play Bamboozled. - Bamboozled?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 名字很酷吧
sense_groups.english: Isn't that a cool name?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 不对
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 第一位参赛者是罗斯·盖勒
sense_groups.english: All right. Uh, okay. Our first contestant is Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 自我介绍一下吧 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Why don't you tell us a little bit about yourself, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是古生物学家 我住在纽约
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, I'm a paleontologist. Um, I live in New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个儿子叫做班 嗨 班 还有…
sense_groups.english: I have a son, Ben. Uh, hi, Ben. And, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫你自我介绍一下 罗斯 你呢 钱德
sense_groups.english: I said a little bit, Ross. Now, how about you, Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个猎头专家 我为叛变的第三世界国家…
sense_groups.english: Well, Joey, I'm a headhunter. I hook up out-of-work Soviet scientists...

sense_groups.chinese: 寻找失业的苏联科学家 嗨 拉斯普廷
sense_groups.english: ...with rogue Third World nations. Hi, Rasputin.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我们开始吧 钱德 你先
sense_groups.english: Excellent. Let's play Bamboozled. Chandler, you'll go first.

sense_groups.chinese: 哥伦比亚的首都在哪里 - 波哥大
sense_groups.english: What is the capital of Colombia? - Bogote.

sense_groups.chinese: 是波格大 但很接近了
sense_groups.english: It's Bogoda, but close enough.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以把机会让给罗斯 或挑魔法机会牌
sense_groups.english: Now, you can either pass your turn to Ross or pick a Wicked Wango Card.

sense_groups.chinese: 魔法机会牌可以做什么 - 我早该知道的
sense_groups.english: What does a Wicked Wango Card do? - I should know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看 请等一下…
sense_groups.english: Let's see. Just one moment, please, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 魔法机会牌能决定你要向上或是向下
sense_groups.english: Here we are. A Wicked Wango Card determines whether you go higher or lower.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么东西向上或是向下
sense_groups.english: Higher or lower than what?

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的是太丢脸了 - 你能相信这有多烂吗
sense_groups.english: This is embarrassing. - Can you believe how lame this is?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我想参赛者不该交谈
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I don't believe contestants are allowed to talk to each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫脱衣舞男五点要到 可以吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, I told the stripper to be here at 5. That's good, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你请脱衣舞男来宝宝欢迎会 那太不得体了
sense_groups.english: You ordered a stripper for the shower? That is totally inappropriate.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 他会打扮成宝宝的样子
sense_groups.english: Why? He's gonna be dressed as a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 葛林太太 我很高兴你赶来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi, Mrs. Green. I'm so glad you could make it.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 我们很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Yes, thank you so much. And again, we're so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的很过意不去
sense_groups.english: We could not feel worse about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 试试看吧
sense_groups.english: Try.

sense_groups.chinese: 我女儿在那边
sense_groups.english: There's my little girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在生气 - 对 我知道
sense_groups.english: She's still mad. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是很棒吗 少了一个人跟你咬耳朵
sense_groups.english: Isn't it great? One less person we have to make small talk with.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 珊卓拉也在生你的气 你不会感到困扰吗
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, Sandra's mad at you too. It doesn't bother you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们道了两次歉 我真的没办法了
sense_groups.english: Look, we've apologized twice. I can't do any more than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你讨厌别人生你的气…
sense_groups.english: I know you hate it when people are mad at you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你得去接受
sense_groups.english: ...but, you know, you just have to be okay with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我办得到
sense_groups.english: Okay. I can do that. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去帮我的屁股擦痱子粉 - 喔
sense_groups.english: I gotta go powder my ass. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你的脸 你跟念高中时还是一样
sense_groups.english: Look at that face. Just like when you were in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不是我很了解你 我会以为你是个有麻烦的啦啦队员
sense_groups.english: If I didn't know better, I'd say you were a cheerleader in trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我们去喝点茶 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, let's get some tea. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你看你 只剩三星期了
sense_groups.english: Ooh, my. Look at that. Only three weeks to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你挑好奶妈了吗
sense_groups.english: Now, have you picked your nanny yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果请管家兼职
sense_groups.english: I don't want you to just use your housekeeper...

sense_groups.chinese: 她会分心的
sense_groups.english: ...because it'll just split her focus.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我不请奶妈 我也没有管家
sense_groups.english: Oh. Actually, I'm not gonna use a nanny. And, uh, I don't even have a housekeeper.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好像山顶洞人
sense_groups.english: It's like you're a cave person.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得请个奶妈
sense_groups.english: Rachel, you must get a nanny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道带孩子有多累
sense_groups.english: You don't know how overwhelming this is gonna be.

sense_groups.chinese: 你小时候我雇用了K太太
sense_groups.english: When you were a baby, I had full-time help. I had Mrs. K.

sense_groups.chinese: K太太 对 她人真的很好 她教我西班牙文
sense_groups.english: Mrs. K. Oh, yeah, she was sweet. She taught me Spanish.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我还记得一点
sense_groups.english: I actually think I remember some of it

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个好人 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Such a sweet woman. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管她多很棒 我出不起那笔钱
sense_groups.english: Well, however great she was, I just can't afford that.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, Rachel. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想到一个好点子 我要搬过去跟你们住
sense_groups.english: I just had the greatest idea. I'm gonna come live with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴我能帮我女儿这个忙
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so happy I'm gonna do this for my little girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 你感动得都快哭了
sense_groups.english: Aw, look at you. You have tears in your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我是快哭了
sense_groups.english: Yes, yes, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 现在是你领先
sense_groups.english: All right, Ross, you're in the lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要再回答一题 或转处罚轮
sense_groups.english: Would you like to take another question, or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我转轮子的运气不太好 乔伊
sense_groups.english: The Wheel has not been my friend tonight, Joey. Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要再回答一题
sense_groups.english: I'll take another question.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这题很难 深呼吸
sense_groups.english: Okay. This is gonna be tough. Hold your breath.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我准备好了
sense_groups.english: It's okay. I'm ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得真的深呼吸再回答问题
sense_groups.english: No, dude, you gotta hold your breath till you're ready to answer the question.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是游戏的一部分 - 这太可笑了 他没办法深呼…
sense_groups.english: It's part of the game. - This is ridiculous. He's not gonna hold...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你害怕恐惧的感觉 那该怎么说 惧…
sense_groups.english: Okay. What do you have a fear of if you suffer from this phobia? Triska...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那个字真长 惧…
sense_groups.english: Holy cow. That's a big word. Tris...

sense_groups.chinese: 看看这个 这该怎么念
sense_groups.english: Seriously, look at this thing, Chandler. How do you say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看 - 就是这个字
sense_groups.english: Let me see that. - This one right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 惧13症 - 害怕树上
sense_groups.english: Triskaidekaphobia. - Fear of Triscuits.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 是害怕13 - 害怕树上
sense_groups.english: No. No. Fear of the number 13. - Fear of Triscuits?

sense_groups.chinese: 这有可能 它们真的都尖尖的
sense_groups.english: It's possible. They have really sharp edges.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 轮到你了
sense_groups.english: All right, Chandler, you're up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要用天使通行证换免费的机会
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. I believe I'm entitled to use my Angel Pass for a free turn.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个游戏真的很不合逻辑 - 你很生气是因为你输了
sense_groups.english: This game makes no sense. - You're just upset because you're losing.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 罗斯 我想我们都是失败者
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on, Ross. I think we're all losers here.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你可以选转轮子 或选张搜索牌
sense_groups.english: All right. Chandler, you can either spin the Wheel or pick a Google Card.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我想想 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: Let me think, let me think. Oh, uh, I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 你非选不可 宾先生
sense_groups.english: You must choose, Mr. Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那还是没有差别 - 快选吧 混蛋
sense_groups.english: Either. It makes no difference. - Choose, you jackass.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要抽卡片 - 你选到了给我卡
sense_groups.english: I'll take a card. - Okay, you picked the Gimme Card.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿到罗斯所有的分数 - 什么
sense_groups.english: You get all of Ross' points. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个游戏开始好玩起来了
sense_groups.english: This game is kind of fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得你拿到我的分数太疯狂了…
sense_groups.english: You don't think it's a little crazy that you get all my points...?

sense_groups.chinese: 参赛者不该交谈的
sense_groups.english: I don't think the contestants are supposed to speak to each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要邀请我妈来 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Why did you invite my mother? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她要搬过来跟我和罗斯住 以便帮忙照顾宝宝
sense_groups.english: She wants to move in with me and Ross to help take care of the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 多久 - 八星期
sense_groups.english: For how long? - Eight weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱我妈 但是天啊 跟她一起吃午餐太久就是种折磨
sense_groups.english: I mean, I love my mother, but, my God, a long lunch with her is taxing.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她想跟我住 我会觉得很光荣
sense_groups.english: I personally would be honored if she wanted to live with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 她听不到
sense_groups.english: She can't hear you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: You guys, come on. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不希望她搬过去 你该直说的
sense_groups.english: If you don't want your mother to move in with you, just tell her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 我就快生了
sense_groups.english: You're right. You're right. I'm about to have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以说我不希望她睡在沙发上
sense_groups.english: I can tell my mother that I don't want her to be sleeping on my couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会跟我一起睡在床上 绝不能让那种事发生
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's gonna wanna sleep in my bed with me. This cannot happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: That's right. That is right.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉她 你不希望她搬过去跟你们住
sense_groups.english: You go over there and tell her you do not want her to live with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 别让她拒绝你 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Do not take no for an answer. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的太棒了 现在她会生瑞秋的气
sense_groups.english: This is great. Now she's gonna be mad at Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跑过去 当她的乖女儿讨好她
sense_groups.english: And I'm just gonna swoop in there and be like the daughter she never had.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的要很尊敬钱德了
sense_groups.english: I have new respect for Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 大伙们 该来拆礼物了
sense_groups.english: All right, everybody. It's time to open the presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 瑞秋要拆的第一样礼物…
sense_groups.english: Yes, and I think that the first gift that Rachel opens...

sense_groups.chinese: 应该是外婆送的礼物
sense_groups.english: ...should be from the grandmother of the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你是这里最重要的人 也是全世界最重要的
sense_groups.english: Because you're the most important person in this room. And in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有准备礼物 因为我在最后一分钟才被邀请
sense_groups.english: Well, um, I don't have a gift because I wasn't invited until the last minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 但非常谢谢你 亲爱的 让大家都注意到这一点
sense_groups.english: But thank you so much, dear, for bringing that to everybody's attention.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们这些不重要的人呢 来拆你们的礼物吧
sense_groups.english: How about you less important people? Let's open your presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没准备礼物也没关系 - 但我也算是送了你一样礼物
sense_groups.english: Mom, it's okay that you didn't get a gift. - Well, I kind of did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟你同住八个星期 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Me. Eight weeks of me. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 妈妈 事实上我可以自己照顾宝宝
sense_groups.english: Okay. See, Mom, the truth is, I can do this on my own.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你会是个好妈妈
sense_groups.english: Sweetheart, I know you're gonna be a terrific mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 但一开始你需要帮忙
sense_groups.english: I just think you need a little help, especially at the beginning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我在做什么 我应付得来
sense_groups.english: But, Mom, I really know what I'm doing. I can handle this.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 还记得亮亮吗
sense_groups.english: Really? Remember Twinkles?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是只仓鼠 我不会拿吸尘器吸我的宝宝
sense_groups.english: He was a hamster. I'm not gonna vacuum up my baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 快来吧 瑞秋 拆礼物的时间到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, come on, Rach. It's present time.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是这个派对的主角
sense_groups.english: You know, you're the glue holding this whole party together.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在这个派对也快毁了
sense_groups.english: It's kind of falling apart here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 - 哇
sense_groups.english: Ooh, look. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你同事送的
sense_groups.english: This is from your friends at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 哇 我知道这是什么
sense_groups.english: Ooh, my gosh. Oh, wow. Oh, I know what this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能
sense_groups.english: That can't be right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是宝宝的啤酒机吗
sense_groups.english: Is that a beer bong for a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 女儿 那是挤奶器
sense_groups.english: Darling, that's a breast pump.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过我不猜了吗 好吧 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Heh. Did I say I was done guessing? Okay, thank you for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 这是什么
sense_groups.english: Ooh, wow. What's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 是尿布精灵 - 用来放干净尿布的
sense_groups.english: It's a Diaper Genie. - Oh, it dispenses clean diapers.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是放脏尿布的
sense_groups.english: No, it's where you put dirty ones.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 为什么不直接把尿布丢在外面的垃圾桶
sense_groups.english: Well, that's gross. Why don't you just take it outside and throw it in a Dumpster?

sense_groups.chinese: 你每天要丢十次吗 - 什么 宝宝一天可以拉十次
sense_groups.english: You're gonna do that 10 times a day? - What, it goes 10 times a day?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是喂她印度食物吗
sense_groups.english: What are we feeding this baby, Indian food?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 宝宝都是那样的
sense_groups.english: No, dear. That's what babies do.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 听你妈妈的话 她非常聪明
sense_groups.english: Rachel, listen to your mother. She is very smart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去倒垃圾桶时
sense_groups.english: Plus, what are you planning on doing with the baby

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝要放在哪里
sense_groups.english: while you trot out to the garbage?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 把她放在尿布台上
sense_groups.english: I don't know, I'd leave it on the changing table?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 我做了什么 - 你不能丢下宝宝一个人
sense_groups.english: What? What did I do? What did I do? - You can't leave a baby alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然知道
sense_groups.english: Of course, I know that.

sense_groups.chinese: 千万不能丢下宝宝一个人
sense_groups.english: I mean, of course you never leave a baby alone. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 它会…那不安全
sense_groups.english: I mean, it would... She wouldn't be safe.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟我这个菜鸟妈妈在一起 也不会安全
sense_groups.english: You know, not as safe as she would be with me, the baby dummy. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在拆礼物太刺激了
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know what? Opening the presents is a little overwhelming right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我待会儿再把它们全部拆开
sense_groups.english: So I think, um, I'm just gonna maybe open them all a little bit later.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们赶来 还送了礼物…
sense_groups.english: But thank you all for coming, and for these beautiful gifts...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个篮子很漂亮 - 这是摇篮
sense_groups.english: ...and this basket is beautiful. - It's actually a bassinet.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 妈妈 别离开我
sense_groups.english: Okay, Mommy, don't ever leave me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会在哪部电影听到这句台词
sense_groups.english: In what John Huston film would you hear this line

sense_groups.chinese: "我们不需要臭警徽"
sense_groups.english: "Badges? We don't need no stinking badges."

sense_groups.chinese: "碧血金沙" - 答对了
sense_groups.english: Treasure of the Sierra Madre. - Correct.

sense_groups.chinese: 倒念还能加分
sense_groups.english: There's a possible Backwards Bonus.

sense_groups.chinese: 沙金血碧 - 对
sense_groups.english: Madre Sierra the of Treasure. - Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要爬上机会梯 到金泥屋去
sense_groups.english: I'd like to go up the Ladder of Chance to the Golden Mud Hut, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 聪明的选择 几阶 - 六阶
sense_groups.english: Wise choice. How many rungs? - Six.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个声音只代表一个意思 - 饥饿的猴子
sense_groups.english: That noise can only mean one thing. - Hungry Monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要魔法机会牌 - 这是声音题
sense_groups.english: I'd like a Wicked Wango Card. - Okay. It's an audio question.

sense_groups.chinese: 说出这出电视剧的主题曲
sense_groups.english: Name this television theme song

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我知道 让我想一想
sense_groups.english: Oh. Oh, my God. Okay, I know this. Give me a second.

sense_groups.chinese: 去跟时间乌龟说吧 - 闭嘴
sense_groups.english: Tell it to the Time Turtle. - Shut up.

sense_groups.chinese: "太空仙女恋" - 答对了 你再度领先
sense_groups.english: I Dream of Jeannie. - Yes. Yes, you're back in the lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要转轮子
sense_groups.english: Uh, I'd like to spin the Wheel.

sense_groups.chinese: 快点
sense_groups.english: Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 超级快速回合
sense_groups.english: Uh, uh, Super Speedy Speed Round.

sense_groups.chinese: 跳跃有加分吗 - 当然
sense_groups.english: Is there a Hopping Bonus? - Of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁发明了双焦点透镜 - 本·富兰克林
sense_groups.english: Who invented bifocals? - Ben Franklin.

sense_groups.chinese: 答对了 哪个君王统治英国最久
sense_groups.english: Correct. Which monarch has ruled Great Britain the longest?

sense_groups.chinese: 维多莉亚女王 - 又答对了
sense_groups.english: Queen Victoria. - Correct again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你忘了换题时要换腿跳 跳跃动作没加分
sense_groups.english: But you forgot to switch legs between questions. So no Hopping Bonus.

sense_groups.chinese: 每次都这样 - 对
sense_groups.english: Oh! Every time. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 现在轮到钱德了 - 我要搜索卡
sense_groups.english: Now over to Chandler. - I'd like a Google Card.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定 - 确定 不 搜索卡
sense_groups.english: Are you sure? - Yes. No. Google.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 恭喜你 罗斯 因为钱德…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Congratulations, Ross. Because, Chandler...

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经出局了 - 不
sense_groups.english: ...you've been Bamboozled. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 - 这是我玩过最棒的游戏
sense_groups.english: Yes! - This is the best game ever!

sense_groups.chinese: 只要我有需要 你就会留下来
sense_groups.english: So, um, you're gonna stay with me as long as I need you?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 我发誓我不是白痴
sense_groups.english: Of course I am. - Mom, I swear I'm not an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看了一堆怀孕跟生产的书
sense_groups.english: I read all kinds of books on pregnancy and giving birth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有看如何带宝宝的书
sense_groups.english: But I just didn't think to read the part about what to do when the baby comes.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝出生后…
sense_groups.english: And, guess what, the baby's coming...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我该怎么办 我可以吐在尿布精灵里吗
sense_groups.english: ...and I don't know what to do. Oh, can I throw up in my Diaper Genie?

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 你会没事的
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweetie, you're gonna be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要去哪里 - 我得上洗手间
sense_groups.english: Wait, where you going? - I'm going to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 一切都会没事的
sense_groups.english: Now, don't worry. Everything's gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 会没事的
sense_groups.english: It is gonna be okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 值得一试
sense_groups.english: Worth a shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干嘛满脸通红 全身是汗
sense_groups.english: Why are you all red and sweaty?

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚干掉钱德了
sense_groups.english: I just Bamboozled Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有对他不轨
sense_groups.english: Which is not a sexual thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎会这么快就结束了 - 你没来才这么说
sense_groups.english: Well, that was a quick shower. - Not if you were here.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我们收到不少好礼物
sense_groups.english: Wow, looks like we got a lot of good stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我妈送给我们最棒的礼物
sense_groups.english: We did. But my mom got us the greatest gift of all.

sense_groups.chinese: 培乐多理发师工具组
sense_groups.english: A Play-Doh Barbershop?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她要搬过来跟我们住八星期
sense_groups.english: No. She's going to live with us for eight weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 她要帮我们照顾宝宝
sense_groups.english: Yes. She's gonna help us take care of the baby. Woo-hoo.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是说真的吧
sense_groups.english: You're not serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是个好人
sense_groups.english: I mean, she's a very nice woman...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们无法忍受她八个星期
sense_groups.english: ...but there's no way we can take eight weeks of her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会把我们逼疯… - 嗨 罗斯
sense_groups.english: She'll drive us totally crazy... - Hi, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 室友
sense_groups.english: Hey, roomie.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我是雷 本节目的制作人
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey, hi, I'm Ray. I'm the producer of the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 很荣幸能见到你 雷
sense_groups.english: It's a pleasure to meet you, Ray.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是唐肯跟艾玲
sense_groups.english: And this is Duncan and Erin. They're gonna help out with the audition.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们会帮你试镜
sense_groups.english: So let's get the camera rolling.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 雷 - 你准备好了就开始
sense_groups.english: Righty-0, Ray. - Whenever you're ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 我是乔伊·崔比亚尼 我们来玩晕头转向吧
sense_groups.english: Hello. I'm Joey Tribbiani. Let's play Bamboozled.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玲 第一个问题 在曲棍球史上 谁被称为是“伟人”
sense_groups.english: Erin, you get the first question. In hockey, who is known as "The Great One"?

sense_groups.chinese: 葛瑞·斯基 - 答对了
sense_groups.english: Wayne Gretzky. - Correct.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要挑魔法机会卡或转轮子
sense_groups.english: Now, would you like to pick a Wicked Wango Card or spin the Wheel of Mayhem?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的经纪人没有给你重编的游戏规则吗
sense_groups.english: Uh, Joey, didn't your agents give you the revised rules?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们把那些东西都删掉了 没有轮子或机会卡
sense_groups.english: We've eliminated all that. No wheel. No cards.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么
sense_groups.english: What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 那太复杂了 市场研究显示观众没办法了解
sense_groups.english: Well, the game was too complicated and research showed people didn't follow it.

sense_groups.chinese: 复杂 转轮子上机会梯…
sense_groups.english: What's complicated? You spin the Wheel of Mayhem to go up the Ladder of Chance...

sense_groups.chinese: 经过金泥屋 穿越彩虹环找金猴
sense_groups.english: ...past the Mud Hut through the Rainbow Ring to get to the Golden Monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 拉它的尾巴 就能到天堂池
sense_groups.english: You yank his tail, and boom, you're in Paradise Pond.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那些都删掉了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. All that's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在这只是个简单的问答游戏
sense_groups.english: Um, it's basically just a simple question-and-answer game now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那有什么好玩的呢
sense_groups.english: Well, what's fun about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我主持
sense_groups.english: You expect me to be the host of a boring game...

sense_groups.chinese: 观众回答问题的无聊游戏
sense_groups.english: ...that's just people standing around answering questions?

sense_groups.chinese: 会有比基尼女郎拿得分板
sense_groups.english: Well, there'll be women in bikinis holding up the scores.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来玩晕头转向吧
sense_groups.english: Let's play Bamboozled.

sense_groups.chinese: 你买的那些恐龙小玩意…
sense_groups.english: And all those dinosaur knickknacks you have...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 它们或许比较适合放在车库里
sense_groups.english: ...Ross, I thought they might be more at home in the garage.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有车库 - 我说车库吗 我是说垃圾桶
sense_groups.english: Well, we don't have a garage. - Did I say garage? I meant garbage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 或许你不一定要跟我们住在一起
sense_groups.english: You know what, Mrs. Green? Maybe it's not absolutely vital that you live with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋需要人帮忙带孩子 - 真的 我什么都不会
sense_groups.english: Well, Rachel needs help with the baby. - I do. I really do. I don't know anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信那不是真的
sense_groups.english: I'm sure that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 菲比 摩妮卡 我会带孩子吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, no? Pheebs, Monica, do I know anything about babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 完全不懂 - 那真的很可怕
sense_groups.english: Nope. Not a thing. - Mm-mm. It's frightening.

sense_groups.chinese: 就算她不会 但是我会
sense_groups.english: Well, um, you know what? Even if she doesn't know anything, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个儿子 他妈妈跟我没有住在一起
sense_groups.english: I have a son. His mother and I didn't live together.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟我一起住时 我都是自己照顾他
sense_groups.english: Whenever he was with me, I took care of him all the time, by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你还有一个孩子 - 对
sense_groups.english: That's true. You do have another child. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟另一个女人生的
sense_groups.english: With another woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有自制力吗 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Have you no control, Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是另一个问题
sense_groups.english: That's a different issue.

sense_groups.chinese: 重点是宝宝出生后 我会帮忙喂她…
sense_groups.english: Um, the point is, when the baby comes, I will be there to feed her...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮她洗澡 换尿布
sense_groups.english: ...and bathe her and change her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要照顾她
sense_groups.english: And more than that, I want to do all those things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不需要我搬过去
sense_groups.english: Well, then you don't need me to live with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们会想念你的
sense_groups.english: Yes. You're gonna be so missed.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会是个好爸爸
sense_groups.english: You're gonna be a great father.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会是个好外婆
sense_groups.english: Well, you're gonna be a wonderful grandma.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 我还是不知道我该做什么
sense_groups.english: Hello? I still don't know what the hell I'm doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 新手妈妈都会有那种感觉
sense_groups.english: Come on, every first-time mother feels that way.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以慢慢学 你会的 你刚到纽约来时…
sense_groups.english: You're gonna pick it up. Hey, you will. Look, when you first came to the city...

sense_groups.chinese: 你是个被宠坏的无助小女孩
sense_groups.english: ...you were this spoiled, helpless little girl...

sense_groups.chinese: 只会用爸爸的信用卡
sense_groups.english: ...who still used Daddy's credit cards, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你真的有话要告诉我
sense_groups.english: I hope you're going somewhere with this.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你 你现在是个大主管
sense_groups.english: Look at you. You're this big executive.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很能干 证明了自己的能力
sense_groups.english: You are much more capable than you give yourself credit for.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信 你会是个好妈妈
sense_groups.english: I have no doubt you're gonna be an incredible mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Really? - I'm telling you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得走了
sense_groups.english: All right, you two. I'm gonna get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 甜心 别送了
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Oh, no, sweetheart, you stay put.

sense_groups.chinese: 我自己出去 就当我没来过这里 我差点真的来不了
sense_groups.english: I'll let myself out. It's like I'm not here. Which I almost wasn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太幽默了 我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: You're just so funny. You're so funny. What do I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么也不用做 你跟她道歉很多次
sense_groups.english: Nothing. You have apologized to her like a million times.

sense_groups.chinese: 她完全无视于你的道歉
sense_groups.english: And she's been nothing but terrible to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你让她女儿办了
sense_groups.english: And don't forget, you just threw her daughter...

sense_groups.chinese: 一个可爱 不过有点无聊的欢迎会
sense_groups.english: ...a lovely, albeit slightly boring, shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 她甚至没有谢谢你 - 你知道吗 你说的对
sense_groups.english: And she hasn't even thanked you for it. - You know what? You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果真的有话要说 也该是训她
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I mean, if you wanna say anything to her, I'd tell her off.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我会的
sense_groups.english: Okay, I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林太太
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Green?

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林太太
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Green?

sense_groups.chinese: 不跟主人道别就离开派对是很无礼的
sense_groups.english: It is rude to leave a party without saying goodbye to the host.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果有人跟你道歉
sense_groups.english: And also, when someone apologizes to you...

sense_groups.chinese: 有良心的人都会接受
sense_groups.english: ...the decent thing to do is to accept it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是故意要那么做的
sense_groups.english: Because what I did to you, it wasn't on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你对我的态度太可耻了
sense_groups.english: But what you're doing to me now is plain spiteful.

sense_groups.chinese: 可耻 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Spiteful? - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该好好去照镜子 小姑娘
sense_groups.english: Maybe it's time you took a good, hard look in the mirror, young lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 老太婆
sense_groups.english: Old lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 女士
sense_groups.english: Lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了 别说了 别说了
sense_groups.english: Wrap it up. Wrap it up. Wrap it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你准备好跟我道歉 我会原谅你 再见
sense_groups.english: So whenever you're ready to apologize to me, I will forgive you. Good day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的脚没有感觉
sense_groups.english: I can't feel my legs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的太棒了 我非常以你为荣
sense_groups.english: You were fantastic. I'm so proud of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 我也以自己为荣 - 应该的
sense_groups.english: Yeah? I'm proud of me too. - You should be.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能帮我拿杯饮料吗 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: Could you get me something to drink? - You got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛林太太 我真的很抱歉 对不起 如果你…
sense_groups.english: Mrs. Green? Okay, I'm really sorry. I apologize. If you just... Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我咬到舌头了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I bit my tongue.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我真的很抱歉
sense_groups.english: But I'm still really sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我准备好了 - 你确定
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm ready. - You sure?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过书 把一切都弄清楚了
sense_groups.english: Yes. I've done my studying, and I really know my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right, then.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋·葛林 我们来玩晕头转向
sense_groups.english: Rachel Green, let's play Bamboozled.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该如何测试宝宝洗澡水的温度
sense_groups.english: How do you test the temperature of the baby's bathwater?

sense_groups.chinese: 用手肘去试 - 非常好
sense_groups.english: Uh, put your elbow in it. - Excellent.

sense_groups.chinese: 如何让宝宝小睡一下
sense_groups.english: How do you put a baby down for a nap?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂饱她 换干尿布 趴睡 被子盖紧
sense_groups.english: Full, dry, on its back, and no loose covers.

sense_groups.chinese: 答对了
sense_groups.english: That's correct.

sense_groups.chinese: 这题是声音题 宝宝发出这种声音时你该怎么办
sense_groups.english: This is an audio question. What do you do when a baby makes this sound

sense_groups.chinese: 检查她是尿湿或饿了 帮她拍背
sense_groups.english: Uh, check if it's wet, check if it's hungry, burp it.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 你要再回答一题或抽魔法机会牌
sense_groups.english: Excellent. Now, do you want another question or a Wicked Wango Card?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要抽牌 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: A card. A card. I pick a card. - Oh, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你出局了 你会是个烂妈妈
sense_groups.english: You've been Bamboozled. You're gonna be a terrible mother.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忽略我们这样做的目的了
sense_groups.english: I've lost sight of why we're doing this.

questions.name: S08E21
questions.en:
Hey, guys. I got some bad news. - What?
That's no way to sell newspapers. Try, "Extra! Extra! Read all about it!"
No. Monica's restaurant got a horrible review in the Post.
I didn't want her to see it, so I ran around and bought all the copies I could find.
Man, this is bad. And I've had my share of bad reviews.
I still remember my first good one
"Everything else in this production of Our Town was simply terrible.
Joey Tribbiani was abysmal."
Hey. - Hey.
Oh, my God! Look at all the newspapers.
It must be a good review. Is it great?
Oh, dear God.
But the good news is, no one in a two-block radius will ever know.
What about the rest of Manhattan? - Yeah, they all know.
Oh, my God, this is horrible. - I'm sorry.
I'm so humiliated.
But you know what they say, there is no such thing as bad press.
You don't think that, um, "the chef's mahi-mahi was awful-awful" is bad press?
I didn't write it.
God, is he right? Am I awful? - Oh, no!
Hey, Monica, listen to me, okay?
I'm not saying this because I'm your friend, I say it because it's true.
Your food is abysmal!
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Ross? - What? What?
I am freaking out! - Are you?
My due date is in one week!
What are you doing up? - That is seven days.
Look, I had a lot of water. Can we do this after...?
No, no, no, no, Ross!
Please, come on. We do not have any big stuff we need.
We don't have a changing table. We do not have a crib.
We do not have a diaper service. - Funny you should mention diapers.
I'm serious. - Look. There's nothing to worry about.
We have plenty of time. There's a baby furniture store on West 10th.
Tomorrow, we'll go there...
...and we'll get everything we need. Okay? - Okay. Thank you. That's great.
Wait, where on West 10th? There's a really cute shoe store...
Okay. If, uh... If you're gonna do this...
...then I'm gonna go do that, so...
Wait, Ross! I'm sorry, one more thing. - Yeah.
Um, our situation, you know, um, what we mean to each other...
...and, I mean, we're having this baby together and we live together...
Isn't that...? Isn't that weird?
Well, uh...
I'm just kidding. You can go pee. Ha, ha.
Hey, I can't remember. Did we say we were gonna meet here...
...or at the movie? - At the movies...
I'll see you there. - Joey. Now that you're here...?
Sure, I can hang out till I have to meet you.
How come you're not going? - I've got a job interview to get ready for.
I thought you already have a job. - And people say you don't pay attention.
This is a much better job. It's vice president of the company...
...that does data reconfiguration...
...and statistical factoring and for other companies.
Wow. How do you know how to do that? - That's what I do now.
Joey? Come taste this. - What is it?
Remember the guy that gave me a bad review? Well...
...I'm getting my revenge.
You cooked him?
No. He teaches a course on food criticism at The New School.
Before we go to the movies, I want to make him try my bouillabaisse again.
Ugh, I can't wait to read the front page tomorrow
"Restaurant reviewer admits: 'I was wrong about Monica."'
The front page?
You really do live in your own little world, don't you?
Do you want these delivered, Mr. and Mrs. Geller?
Oh, no, no, no. No, no. - Heh. No, no.
We're not married. - We are having a baby together...
...but we're not involved.
I mean, uh, we... We were seeing each other a while ago...
...but then we were just friends, and then there was one drunken night...
Or, yes, stranger, we'd like this delivered, please.
Why don't you fill out this address card? - Oh, okay.
I noticed you picked out a lot of dinosaurs. - Oh, yeah.
That's one of the reasons why we are not a couple.
I chose those. I'm a paleontologist.
Really? That is so cool.
Oh, don't get too worked up over it. It sounds like he's a doctor, but he's not.
Oh, no. I'm fascinated by paleontology.
Have you read the Walter Alvarez book? - Yeah, heh, I teach it in class.
Oh, my God. Standing at a cash register, I'm holding a credit card, and I'm bored.
I love your neighborhood. There's a great gym around the corner from your building.
That's my gym. - I could tell you work out.
A paleontologist who works out. You're like Indiana Jones.
I am like Indiana Jones.
Hi, Pheebs.
Hey! Oh, how did baby shopping go?
It was great! We got everything we needed.
Oh, and Ross almost got something that wasn't on the list.
Ahem, a whore.
What? - We were paying for our stuff...
...and this sales woman just started flirting with him.
Can you believe that?
Did she know you two weren't married? - Yeah.
Oh, my God. Well, the idea... A woman flirting with a single man?
We must alert the church elders. - No.
You don't understand. You didn't see how brazen she was.
Sounds like you're a little jealous. - No, I'm not.
I just think it's wrong. I mean, here I am, about to pop...
...and he's out picking up some shopgirl at Sluts-R-Us?
Is that a real place?
Are they hiring?
Hey, Phoebe. Fatty.
Hey, Chandler, why so fancy?
Well, I got a job interview. Big deal, too.
It's more money. I'd be doing data reconfiguration and statistical factoring.
I think I know someone who does that. - Me. I do that.
So seriously, do I look okay? I'm nervous.
Oh, yeah. You... Really, you look great.
You know, just don't get your hopes up.
Why not? - Well, the interview.
What about it? - You know.
You don't make a very good first impression.
What? - Oh, you don't know.
Are you serious? - Yes. When I first met you, you were like
I was like
What is it that I do?
It's just, like, you're trying too hard, always making jokes.
You just... You come off a little needy.
Did you like me when we first met?
Chandler, I'm not gonna lie to you.
But I am gonna run away from you.
Hi. I'm Monica Geller, chef at Allessandro's.
Still?
I think the things you said were unfair...
...and I would like you to give my bouillabaisse another chance.
I don't see any reason why I'd do that to myself again.
Either eat it or be in it.
Spoon?
So, what do you think? - I'm torn...
...between my integrity and my desire to avoid a beating.
But I must be honest. Your soup is abysmal.
Thattagirll Eh? We should get out of here, there's a new class coming in.
Welcome to Introduction to Cooking. Before we start...
...can anyone tell me the difference between hollandaise and bearnaise sauce?
I can. - Okay, go ahead.
Well, um, they both have a egg yolk and butter base.
But a bearnaise, um, has shallots, chervil, and most importantly, tarragon.
Ha, ha, very good. What's your name? - Monica.
Monica, you go to the head of the class! - Okay!
All this stuff takes up a lot of room.
Hey, how, uh, serious are you about keeping Ben in your life?
My son? Pretty serious.
Oh, hey, Katie. What are you doing here?
The delivery went out and I realized they forgot this.
Ah, it must have been obvious, since it was the only thing left in your store.
Listen, to be honest, home deliveries aren't really part of my job description.
Oh, um, I actually came here to ask you out.
Oh. Wow. Uh, yeah, that sounds great.
I'm just gonna put this back in my pocket and pretend that didn't happen.
Uh, I'm free now. You want to grab some coffee...?
Sure. - Horny bitch.
No, you're a horny bitch! No, you're a horny bitch!
No, you're a horny bitch!
So you guys go, have a really good time.
I'm just gonna grab my coat. And, uh, my whip.
You know, because of Indiana Jones.
Not because I'm into S&M.
I'm not into anything weird, you know? Heh.
Just normal sex.
So I'm gonna grab my coat.
So you had a good day, huh? Big commission, picked up a daddy.
Are you okay with this?
Oh, yeah. Yeah, please. You guys have fun.
Okay. Heh. - Yeah.
It was nice to see you.
Oh, and it was great to see you too. And you look fantastic.
Although you missed a button.
Oh, actually, I, um...
Oh, okay, I see what you're doing there.
I can't even believe this. I really come off that badly?
Ugh, it's okay. You calm down after a while...
...and then people can see how sweet and wonderful you are.
Good. Because I'm sure this interview's gonna last a couple of weeks.
All right, don't freak out, okay? I will help you.
How long before you have to leave? - An hour.
I can't help you. - Phoebe...
We'll do our best. I'm the interviewer and I'm meeting you for the first time.
Okay. - Hi. Come on in. I'm Regina Phalanges.
Chandler Bing. - Oh, Bing.
What an unusual name. - Well, you should meet my Uncle Bada.
I'll let myself out.
Your alfredo's dry. Did you use your cheese?
When you say "use," do you mean "eat as a pre-cooking snack"?
And the cream? - Cheese makes me thirsty.
Okay. Let's move on. - All right.
Oh. Something smells good over at Monica's station.
My God! This is absolutely amazing! You've never made this before?
Oh, no. I don't know anything about cooking.
I had to ask what it was called when the water makes those bubbles.
Wow. Hats off to the chef.
I'm sorry, your mouth was full. I didn't hear what you said.
Hats off to who now? - The chef!
Heh, that's right!
I think you'll find if I work here that I don't micromanage.
I don't shy away from delegating.
Mm-hm. That's good to know. But let's stop focusing on what you don't do...
...and focus on what you do do.
What I do do...
is manage to, uh, create an atmosphere of support for the people working with me.
I see. Nice sidestep on the "do do" thing.
Hardest thing I've ever done in my life. - Oh, you gotta go!
Okay, don't worry. You're ready. - Really?
Absolutely! Just fight all your natural instincts, and you'll be great.
Ah, Monica, my star student.
Heh. You called me that before...
...so I took the liberty of fashioning a star out of foil.
Now, no pressure. If you like my cookies, you give me the star.
Wow, a star!
I know you all hate me, and I'm sorry, but I don't care.
Okay, Joey, you're up next. - Yeah.
Oh, my God! This is amazing!
You get an A.
I got an A? In school? Hey, I'm a dork!
Joey, I'm so proud of you.
I think you should give him your star. - Excuse me?
He doesn't even know what he's doing. - We're all beginners.
Nobody knows what they're doing. - I do. I'm a professional chef!
Oh, relax. It's not a courtroom drama.
What are you doing taking Introduction to Cooking?
Yeah!
I'm sorry. It's just that, um, I cook at this restaurant, Allessandrds...
...and, um, I just got a really bad review.
Oh, Allessandro's? I love that place! - You do?
Yes, you're an excellent chef. As a person you're a little...
Oh, totally crazy, but you liked the food? - Ha, ha. Very much.
Okay, then. I don't stink. I'm a good chef! Okay.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, I don't want to go. I'm having fun.
Actually, did either of you pay for this class?
Hey, if my friend says it's time to go, it's time to go!
Also, I was the point person on my company's transition...
...from the KL5 to GR6 systems.
You must have had your hands full. - That I did. That I did.
So let's talk a little bit about your duties.
My duties?
All right.
You'll be heading a whole division, so you'll have a lot of duties.
I see. - But there'll be 30 people under you...
...so you can dump a certain amount on them.
Good to know. - We could go into detail...
No, don't, I beg of you.
All right, then. We'll have a definite answer for you on Monday.
But I can say with some confidence, you'll fit in well here.
Really? - Absolutely.
You can relax. You did great. - I gotta say, thank you.
I was really nervous. I'm told I come on too strongly, too many jokes.
And then it was really hard to side step that "duty" thing.
Duties?
Doodies?
Poo?
Poo?
Oh, my God. This doesn't count. Okay? The interview was over.
That was the real Chandler Bing. This is some crazy guy in the hall.
Call security! There's a crazy guy out in the hall!
Poo?
I'll look forward to your call.
Hey. - Hey.
You're back from your date. - How are you?
I'm fine. But that's not important. What's important is how was she?
Uh, it was fun. We just had coffee.
Oh, uh-huh, uh-huh, coffee, a little rub-rub-rub under the table?
Heh, what's going on? Do you not like Katie?
No. No, she was nice.
I mean, she was a little slutty, but who isn't?
Well, I liked her.
Of course you did. You'd date a gorilla if it called you Indiana Jones.
Did you get a fresh batch of pregnancy hormones today?
No. It's just that... Katie bothered me.
Why? What was wrong with her?
Ugh, there was nothing wrong with her. All right? She was perfectly lovely.
Okay. So, what's the matter? - I don't want you to date her.
Heh, what? Why? What, are you jealous?
Yes. And not because I want you to go out with me.
Because I don't want you to go out with anybody.
I know it's a terrible thing to even think this and it's inappropriate...
...but I want you to be at my constant beck and call, 24 hours a day.
I'm very sorry, but that is just the way that I feel.
Okay. - What?
I won't date. I'll, uh...
I'll be here with you all the time.
Really?
But I'm being so unreasonable.
True, but you're allowed to be unreasonable. You're having our baby.
Oh, Ross, thank you. Thank you.
You feel better?
No, not really. You're pressing the baby into my bladder...
...and now I have to pee. Sorry.
Okay. - Rash?
Yeah? - Just one thing. Um...
We live together. You're having our baby. I'm not gonna see anybody else.
Are you sure you don't want something more?
Wow. I don't know, maybe...
Oh, Rach, I was just messing around. Heh.
Like you did when I had to pee? - Oh! Ha! I knew that.
I knew that! I was just messing with you too!
Okay. Because for a minute you seemed...
No, no, no, no. No! It's just... Ha! -...like you actually...
That's just because I'm such a good messer!
Rash? - Yeah?
The bathroom? - Right.
I had a great time. I learned how to bake, ate great food.
The first A I've gotten since 7th grade and I didn't have to sleep with the teacher.
Oh, look. Acting for Beginners. - Yeah.
Wanna feel good about yourself?
What the hell! - Okay.
All right, let's start with some basics.
Can anybody tell me what the difference between upstage and downstage is?
Yeah, this was a stupid idea.

Heh. You called me that before...
...so I took the liberty of fashioning a star out of foil.
Now, no pressure. If you like my cookies, you give me the star.
Wow, a star!
I know you all hate me, and I'm sorry, but I don't care.
Okay, Joey, you're up next. - Yeah.
Oh, my God! This is amazing!
You get an A.
I got an A? In school? Hey, I'm a dork!
Joey, I'm so proud of you.
I think you should give him your star. - Excuse me?
He doesn't even know what he's doing. - We're all beginners.
Nobody knows what they're doing. - I do. I'm a professional chef!
Oh, relax. It's not a courtroom drama.
What are you doing taking Introduction to Cooking?
Yeah!
I'm sorry. It's just that, um, I cook at this restaurant, Allessandrds...
...and, um, I just got a really bad review.
Oh, Allessandro's? I love that place! - You do?
Yes, you're an excellent chef. As a person you're a little...
Oh, totally crazy, but you liked the food? - Ha, ha. Very much.
Okay, then. I don't stink. I'm a good chef! Okay.
Whoa, whoa, whoa, I don't want to go. I'm having fun.
Actually, did either of you pay for this class?
Hey, if my friend says it's time to go, it's time to go!
Also, I was the point person on my company's transition...
...from the KL5 to GR6 systems.
You must have had your hands full. - That I did. That I did.
So let's talk a little bit about your duties.
My duties?
All right.
You'll be heading a whole division, so you'll have a lot of duties.
I see. - But there'll be 30 people under you...
...so you can dump a certain amount on them.
Good to know. - We could go into detail...
No, don't, I beg of you.
All right, then. We'll have a definite answer for you on Monday.
But I can say with some confidence, you'll fit in well here.
Really? - Absolutely.
You can relax. You did great. - I gotta say, thank you.
I was really nervous. I'm told I come on too strongly, too many jokes.
And then it was really hard to side step that "duty" thing.
Duties?
Doodies?
Poo?
Poo?
Oh, my God. This doesn't count. Okay? The interview was over.
That was the real Chandler Bing. This is some crazy guy in the hall.
Call security! There's a crazy guy out in the hall!
Poo?
I'll look forward to your call.
Hey. - Hey.
You're back from your date. - How are you?
I'm fine. But that's not important. What's important is how was she?
Uh, it was fun. We just had coffee.
Oh, uh-huh, uh-huh, coffee, a little rub-rub-rub under the table?
Heh, what's going on? Do you not like Katie?
No. No, she was nice.
I mean, she was a little slutty, but who isn't?
Well, I liked her.
Of course you did. You'd date a gorilla if it called you Indiana Jones.
Did you get a fresh batch of pregnancy hormones today?
No. It's just that... Katie bothered me.
Why? What was wrong with her?
Ugh, there was nothing wrong with her. All right? She was perfectly lovely.
Okay. So, what's the matter? - I don't want you to date her.
Heh, what? Why? What, are you jealous?
Yes. And not because I want you to go out with me.
Because I don't want you to go out with anybody.
I know it's a terrible thing to even think this and it's inappropriate...
...but I want you to be at my constant beck and call, 24 hours a day.
I'm very sorry, but that is just the way that I feel.
Okay. - What?
I won't date. I'll, uh...
I'll be here with you all the time.
Really?
But I'm being so unreasonable.
True, but you're allowed to be unreasonable. You're having our baby.
Oh, Ross, thank you. Thank you.
You feel better?
No, not really. You're pressing the baby into my bladder...
...and now I have to pee. Sorry.
Okay. - Rash?
Yeah? - Just one thing. Um...
We live together. You're having our baby. I'm not gonna see anybody else.
Are you sure you don't want something more?
Wow. I don't know, maybe...
Oh, Rach, I was just messing around. Heh.
Like you did when I had to pee? - Oh! Ha! I knew that.
I knew that! I was just messing with you too!
Okay. Because for a minute you seemed...
No, no, no, no. No! It's just... Ha! -...like you actually...
That's just because I'm such a good messer!
Rash? - Yeah?
The bathroom? - Right.
I had a great time. I learned how to bake, ate great food.
The first A I've gotten since 7th grade and I didn't have to sleep with the teacher.
Oh, look. Acting for Beginners. - Yeah.
Wanna feel good about yourself?
What the hell! - Okay.
All right, let's start with some basics.
Can anybody tell me what the difference between upstage and downstage is?
Yeah, this was a stupid idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个坏消息 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. I got some bad news. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是卖报纸的好方法 试试"快报 快来买喔"
sense_groups.english: That's no way to sell newspapers. Try, "Extra! Extra! Read all about it!"

sense_groups.chinese: 不 摩妮卡的餐厅在纽约邮报上的评价很差
sense_groups.english: No. Monica's restaurant got a horrible review in the Post.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望她看到它 所以跑遍附近报摊买下所有报纸
sense_groups.english: I didn't want her to see it, so I ran around and bought all the copies I could find.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很糟糕 我一直都被批评的很凶
sense_groups.english: Man, this is bad. And I've had my share of bad reviews.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还记得我第一次被赞美
sense_groups.english: I still remember my first good one

sense_groups.chinese: "在"我们的小镇"里 其他的事都很糟糕
sense_groups.english: "Everything else in this production of Our Town was simply terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊·崔比亚尼是个无底洞"
sense_groups.english: Joey Tribbiani was abysmal."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 看看这些报纸
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Look at all the newspapers.

sense_groups.chinese: 评价一定很不错 对吧
sense_groups.english: It must be a good review. Is it great?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear God.

sense_groups.chinese: 但好消息是两条街里没有人会知道
sense_groups.english: But the good news is, no one in a two-block radius will ever know.

sense_groups.chinese: 曼哈顿其他的人呢 - 他们都会知道
sense_groups.english: What about the rest of Manhattan? - Yeah, they all know.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这太可怕了 - 很遗憾
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, this is horrible. - I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得好丢脸
sense_groups.english: I'm so humiliated.

sense_groups.chinese: 人家不是说没有所谓的负面报导
sense_groups.english: But you know what they say, there is no such thing as bad press.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得"鬼头刀难吃极了"是负面报导吗
sense_groups.english: You don't think that, um, "the chef's mahi-mahi was awful-awful" is bad press?

sense_groups.chinese: 那又不是我写的
sense_groups.english: I didn't write it.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他说的对吗 我很逊吗 - 不
sense_groups.english: God, is he right? Am I awful? - Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 听我说
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica, listen to me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我这么做不只因为我是你的朋友
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying this because I'm your friend, I say it because it's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的食物是个无底洞
sense_groups.english: Your food is abysmal!

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Ross? - What? What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我快吓死了 - 是吗
sense_groups.english: I am freaking out! - Are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的预产期是一星期后
sense_groups.english: My due date is in one week!

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不睡觉 - 只剩七天
sense_groups.english: What are you doing up? - That is seven days.

sense_groups.chinese: 我睡前喝了太多水 我们可不可以晚一点再…
sense_groups.english: Look, I had a lot of water. Can we do this after...?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 罗斯
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, no, Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有准备任何东西
sense_groups.english: Please, come on. We do not have any big stuff we need.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没买尿布台或摇篮
sense_groups.english: We don't have a changing table. We do not have a crib.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们甚至没买尿布 - 你现在提起尿布太有趣了
sense_groups.english: We do not have a diaper service. - Funny you should mention diapers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是认真的 - 没什么好担心的
sense_groups.english: I'm serious. - Look. There's nothing to worry about.

sense_groups.chinese: 西10街有家婴儿用品专卖店
sense_groups.english: We have plenty of time. There's a baby furniture store on West 10th.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到那里去…
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow, we'll go there...

sense_groups.chinese: 买我们需要的东西 好吗 - 好吧 谢谢你 太棒了
sense_groups.english: ...and we'll get everything we need. Okay? - Okay. Thank you. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 西10街在哪里 那里有家鞋店…
sense_groups.english: Wait, where on West 10th? There's a really cute shoe store...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你要这么做
sense_groups.english: Okay. If, uh... If you're gonna do this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要那么做 所以…
sense_groups.english: ...then I'm gonna go do that, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 罗斯 抱歉 还有一件事 - 对
sense_groups.english: Wait, Ross! I'm sorry, one more thing. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的情况 我们对彼此的意义…
sense_groups.english: Um, our situation, you know, um, what we mean to each other...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说我们要一起抚养孩子 我们要住在一起…
sense_groups.english: ...and, I mean, we're having this baby together and we live together...

sense_groups.chinese: 那…那不是很奇怪吗
sense_groups.english: Isn't that...? Isn't that weird?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在开玩笑 你可以去上厕所了
sense_groups.english: I'm just kidding. You can go pee. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们约好在这里
sense_groups.english: Hey, I can't remember. Did we say we were gonna meet here...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是在电影院里碰面 - 我们约好在电影院里碰面 但…
sense_groups.english: ...or at the movie? - At the movies...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到电影院见 - 既然你来了…
sense_groups.english: I'll see you there. - Joey. Now that you're here...?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你们碰面之前先和你们混
sense_groups.english: Sure, I can hang out till I have to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不去 - 我要去面试一个新工作
sense_groups.english: How come you're not going? - I've got a job interview to get ready for.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你已经有工作了 - 大家还说你不太关心别人
sense_groups.english: I thought you already have a job. - And people say you don't pay attention.

sense_groups.chinese: 这份工作比较好 它是一家公司的副总栽…
sense_groups.english: This is a much better job. It's vice president of the company...

sense_groups.chinese: 这家公司为其他公司
sense_groups.english: ...that does data reconfiguration...

sense_groups.chinese: 做资料重构
sense_groups.english: ...and statistical factoring and for other companies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道该怎么做 - 那就是我现在的工作
sense_groups.english: Wow. How do you know how to do that? - That's what I do now.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 来试吃一下 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Joey? Come taste this. - What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 还记得给我烂评价的那个人吗 喔…
sense_groups.english: Remember the guy that gave me a bad review? Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要跟他报复
sense_groups.english: ...I'm getting my revenge.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把他煮了
sense_groups.english: You cooked him?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他在新校开了一堂课…
sense_groups.english: No. He teaches a course on food criticism at The New School.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要他再试试我的马赛鱼汤
sense_groups.english: Before we go to the movies, I want to make him try my bouillabaisse again.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及要看明天的报纸头条
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I can't wait to read the front page tomorrow

sense_groups.chinese: "餐厅评监家承认 我错怪了摩妮卡"
sense_groups.english: "Restaurant reviewer admits: 'I was wrong about Monica."'

sense_groups.chinese: 头版
sense_groups.english: The front page?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的活在你的小世界里 对吧
sense_groups.english: You really do live in your own little world, don't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我们做外送服务吗 盖勒先生跟盖勒太太
sense_groups.english: Do you want these delivered, Mr. and Mrs. Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no. No, no. - Heh. No, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有结婚 - 我们的孩子快出世了…
sense_groups.english: We're not married. - We are having a baby together...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们没有结婚
sense_groups.english: ...but we're not involved.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我们曾经交往过…
sense_groups.english: I mean, uh, we... We were seeing each other a while ago...

sense_groups.chinese: 之后我们变成了朋友 有天晚上我们喝醉了…
sense_groups.english: ...but then we were just friends, and then there was one drunken night...

sense_groups.chinese: 对 陌生人 我们需要外送服务
sense_groups.english: Or, yes, stranger, we'd like this delivered, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你填一下住址 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Why don't you fill out this address card? - Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你挑了很多恐龙 - 对
sense_groups.english: I noticed you picked out a lot of dinosaurs. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以那也就是为什么我们没有结婚
sense_groups.english: That's one of the reasons why we are not a couple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我选了那些 我是古生物学家
sense_groups.english: I chose those. I'm a paleontologist.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 那太酷了
sense_groups.english: Really? That is so cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 别太夸他 你可能以为他是博士 但事实上不然
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't get too worked up over it. It sounds like he's a doctor, but he's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我喜欢古生物学
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I'm fascinated by paleontology.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看过华特·艾瓦瑞兹的书吗 - 它是我的教科书
sense_groups.english: Have you read the Walter Alvarez book? - Yeah, heh, I teach it in class.

sense_groups.chinese: 我站在收银台 手里拿着信用卡 却觉得很无聊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Standing at a cash register, I'm holding a credit card, and I'm bored.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你住的社区 街角有家很棒的健身房
sense_groups.english: I love your neighborhood. There's a great gym around the corner from your building.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的健身房 - 我看得出来你有健身
sense_groups.english: That's my gym. - I could tell you work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 一位会健身的古生物学家 你跟印第安纳·琼斯一样
sense_groups.english: A paleontologist who works out. You're like Indiana Jones.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是跟印第安纳·琼斯一样
sense_groups.english: I am like Indiana Jones.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hi, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝的东西买得怎么样了
sense_groups.english: Hey! Oh, how did baby shopping go?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 我们需要的东西都买到了
sense_groups.english: It was great! We got everything we needed.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯差点拿到清单上没有的东西
sense_groups.english: Oh, and Ross almost got something that wasn't on the list.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个妓女
sense_groups.english: Ahem, a whore.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我们正在付帐
sense_groups.english: What? - We were paying for our stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个女销售员开始泡他
sense_groups.english: ...and this sales woman just started flirting with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能相信吗
sense_groups.english: Can you believe that?

sense_groups.chinese: 她知道你们没有结婚吗 - 知道
sense_groups.english: Did she know you two weren't married? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 那… 一个女人在泡一个单身男人
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Well, the idea... A woman flirting with a single man?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得通知教会的长老 - 不
sense_groups.english: We must alert the church elders. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不了解 你没看到她多不要脸
sense_groups.english: You don't understand. You didn't see how brazen she was.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好像在吃醋 - 我才没有
sense_groups.english: Sounds like you're a little jealous. - No, I'm not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得那是不对的 我是说我就快生了…
sense_groups.english: I just think it's wrong. I mean, here I am, about to pop...

sense_groups.chinese: 他在荡妇专门店泡女人
sense_groups.english: ...and he's out picking up some shopgirl at Sluts-R-Us?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的有那种地方吗
sense_groups.english: Is that a real place?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们有缺人吗
sense_groups.english: Are they hiring?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 菲比 肥婆
sense_groups.english: Hey, Phoebe. Fatty.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么那么高兴
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, why so fancy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得到一个面试机会
sense_groups.english: Well, I got a job interview. Big deal, too.

sense_groups.chinese: 薪水比较高 我要做资料重构的工作
sense_groups.english: It's more money. I'd be doing data reconfiguration and statistical factoring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道有个人就做那一行 - 那就是我
sense_groups.english: I think I know someone who does that. - Me. I do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看起来还好吧 我好紧张
sense_groups.english: So seriously, do I look okay? I'm nervous.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你看起来很棒
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. You... Really, you look great.

sense_groups.chinese: 别抱太高的希望
sense_groups.english: You know, just don't get your hopes up.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 - 你要去面试
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Well, the interview.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢 - 你知道的
sense_groups.english: What about it? - You know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你无法给人留下良好的第一印象
sense_groups.english: You don't make a very good first impression.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 喔 你不知道啊
sense_groups.english: What? - Oh, you don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说真的吗 - 我第一次见到你 你是这样的
sense_groups.english: Are you serious? - Yes. When I first met you, you were like

sense_groups.chinese: 我就觉得…
sense_groups.english: I was like

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么了
sense_groups.english: What is it that I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你太努力 想要说笑话…
sense_groups.english: It's just, like, you're trying too hard, always making jokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太急了
sense_groups.english: You just... You come off a little needy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们第一次见面时 你喜欢我吗
sense_groups.english: Did you like me when we first met?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我不想骗你
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I'm not gonna lie to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我要离开了
sense_groups.english: But I am gonna run away from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是摩妮卡·盖勒 亚利山多洛斯的主厨
sense_groups.english: Hi. I'm Monica Geller, chef at Allessandro's.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在还是
sense_groups.english: Still?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的评论有点不公平…
sense_groups.english: I think the things you said were unfair...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要你再试试我的马赛鱼汤
sense_groups.english: ...and I would like you to give my bouillabaisse another chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看不出来 我有什么原因再试一次
sense_groups.english: I don't see any reason why I'd do that to myself again.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不吃就倒霉
sense_groups.english: Either eat it or be in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 汤匙
sense_groups.english: Spoon?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得呢 - 我很为难…
sense_groups.english: So, what do you think? - I'm torn...

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道要老实说还是避免自己被打一顿
sense_groups.english: ...between my integrity and my desire to avoid a beating.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我得老实说 你的汤是个无底洞
sense_groups.english: But I must be honest. Your soup is abysmal.

sense_groups.chinese: 做的好 我们应该离开这里 新的一班要上课了
sense_groups.english: Thattagirll Eh? We should get out of here, there's a new class coming in.

sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! This is amazing!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧

What are you looking at?
A poster for that WWI movie I'm in. Check it out.
Wow! It looks really violent!

I'm in THX. I'm unsuitable for children!
