I started that! - I thought I did!
I just talked to my agent...
...and the premiere is next week and you're all invited!
Will we take a limo? - Sure!
I love taking limos when nobody died.
Well, I won't be able to come.
For those who haven't checked their calendars, today's my due date.
I want to thank you guys for how great you've been during this.
I couldn't have done it without you. I loved these last 9 months.
I'm looking forward to the next part...
...but I am really gonna miss being pregnant.
That's right. Still no baby.
Come on, people, make some room.
Uh, sweetie, maybe you'd be more comfortable here.
You.
Like you haven't done enough.
I know you're miserable. I wish there was something I could do.
I wish I were a sea horse.
Because with sea horses, it's the male. They carry the babies.
And then also, um, I'd be far away in the sea.
God.
I have never been so uncomfortable in my entire life.
I know. I remember toward the end
That's a great story. Tell it while you're getting me some iced tea.
Oh, God, get out! Get out, get out, get out!
Let's.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
Hey, did you have the baby yet?
Do you want me to sit on you? Because I'll do it.
What are you doing here? - They sent me home from work.
They said, "Start your maternity leave now. Just rest."
You know what? Screw them!
If they don't want me there, I'll hang out with you guys.
Or you could do volunteer work.
Hello? - Joey, it's Estelle.
I was able to get you and one guest tickets to your premiere.
You told me I could have six tickets. - I sold four on eBay.
You'll be sitting next to HotGuy372.
So that's it? I only get to bring one guest?
Yeah. What time do you want to pick me up?
Hello?
You hear that? I only get one extra ticket.
So somehow I have to pick between you three and Ross.
What about me? - You said you didn't want to go.
I would still like to be acknowledged.
Because I'm pregnant, I'm invisible? - Definitely not invisible.
Ross didn't care enough to be here, so he's out.
You snooze, you lose. - He's not snoozing. He's teaching class.
Well, then somebody's snoozing.
And, Joey, not that this should, uh, affect you at all, but, um, if you pick me...
...I was planning on wearing a sequin dress out down to here.
I haven't seen this dress. - Star in a movie.
Pick whoever you want. Listen to your heart. What does it tell you?
Phoebe.Phoebe.Phoebe.
Well, uh...
I think I want to take Chandler.
Phoebe,Phoebe,Phoebe.
You want to take me? - Yeah, I wish I could take everybody.
But Chandler's always supported my career.
He's paid for acting classes, headshots and stuff.
This will be my way of paying you back.
So you're never actually going to pay me back?
Just because he paid for your headshots, you're gonna take him?
I don't think you're comprehending just how slutty this dress is.
It's not just the stuff he paid for. It's everything, you know?
He read lines with me. He went with me on auditions.
Then he consoled me after I didn't get parts.
You always believed in me, man, even when I didn't.
I always knew you were gonna make it. I'm so proud of you.
Thanks, that means a lot to me.
Mon, maybe one of these guys wants to wear your dress.
I'm gonna go shave. Ahem. - Yeah, well, I'm gonna go, uh, spit.
Ugh, I have to pee.
If I don't come out, it's because I've choked to death on the potpourri stink.
You hold her nose, I'll blow in her mouth and the kid'll just...
...out of her.
She's a week late. She's got to have it today.
I don't know. I think it's still gonna be a while.
Hmm. Care to make it interesting?
I bet you she'll have it tomorrow. - You're on.
Okay, how much? - One hundred thousand dollars.
How about 50 bucks? - I'll call Zurich and move some money.
All right, whose turn is it to help me get up?
Ahem, no one's here.
Oh, damn it.
This is exciting. So glamorous! People taking our picture. How do I look?
A little tall. - What?
Would you crouch down a bit so that I look taller?
There you go.
It's just so glamorous.
Oh, hey, Mon? Rach is here.
And you're still pregnant.
I'm sorry. I know how uncomfortable you are.
You know what? You look great. - Aw.
Yeah, like 50 bucks.
I have to go pee. Apparently this baby thinks my bladder is a squeeze toy.
Damn it. Here's your 50 bucks.
That's interesting that you lost. Now, I forget, do you like to lose?
All right, stop it.
Double or nothing she has it tomorrow. - Fine.
Okay.
Until then, General Grant, why don't you set up camp right there?
Rachel here? We have an appointment. - In the bathroom.
Rach, we gotta go. - In a minute!
People ask why we're not together. I just don't know what to tell them.
All right, all right, let's go.
Uh, do you want to go change first?
The doctor's keeping the office open late for us, but if you hurry...
No, I'm fine. - You don't think that's inappropriate?
What? - Good God, man. Don't anger it.
Ross, it is 100 degrees outside. For the first time in weeks, I am...
Fine. Whatever you want. You're the mommy.
Uh-uh, pal! Don't call me "Mommy."
It's bad enough you call your own mother that.
I'm actually with her on this one.
I thought I knew who the enemy was...
Okay, this is it. This is my big fight scene coming up.
I'm fighting for every man in the 82nd Ground Division.
Ross? - Yeah?
Can I ask you something? - Uh-huh.
When Carol was pregnant with Ben...
...were you this irritating?
Wow. - Excuse me?
Uh, nothing. You're just, uh...
You've been a little short with me lately. I'm not trying to irritate you.
Well, then, you must have a natural talent for it.
The doctor will be in soon. Why don't we not speak until then?
Okay.
Seriously. Breathe louder, Ross. That's great.
We should ask the doctor if she even knows...
...how to deliver a baby that's half human, half pure evil!
Hi, Dr. Long. How are you? - Hello.
You're nice to her.
She has the drugs.
We'll do a quick check. - Okay.
Eight days late, huh? - Yeah.
You must be getting uncomfortable.
Yeah, just a tad.
You're 80 percent effaced. You're on your way. It still could last a while.
There are ways to help things along. - Do them!
Actually, they're things you can do. Home remedies.
In my experience, I've found some are very effective.
Well, we are ready to try anything. - There's an herbal tea you can drink.
Okay.
You can take some castor oil. There's spicy foods.
We will do all of those.
Taking a long walk. - Good. Done.
And there's the one that's proved most effective: sex.
You've got to be kidding me.
Good job, Joe! Well done! Top-notch!
You liked it'? You really liked it? - Oh, yeah!
Well, which part exactly? - The whole thing! Here we go!
No, no, no. Give me some specifics.
I loved the specifics. The specifics were the best part.
Hey, what about the scene with the kangaroo? Did you like that part?
I was surprised to see a kangaroo in a World War I epic.
You fell asleep!
There was no kangaroo! They didn't take any of my suggestions!
Thanks for coming. See you later. - Don't go. I'm so sorry.
Look, this guy fell asleep! He fell asleep too! Be mad at him!
Or call an ambulance!
Hey. - Hey.
What did the doctor say? Any news on when the baby will come?
No. She gave us ideas on how to induce labor.
We tried them all.
We went for a walk, uh, we tried tea, castor oil, spicy food. Nothing worked.
There is one thing we didn't try.
But someone thinks that that will open up a can of worms.
If it's gonna help bring the baby here, today...
...I think you should do it.
It's sex. - Do it!
Monica. - It's been a really long time for you.
I mean, women have needs. Do it. Get yours.
Oh, I don't know about that.
I think if the two of you had sex, the repercussions would be catastrophic.
All right, let's be practical.
If Ross isn't willing, he's not the only guy you can have sex with.
You could borrow Chandler. Chandler is good.
Monica, what is the matter with you?
I just want the baby to be born today. - Why today?
Okay, fine.
I bet Phoebe that you're gonna have the baby, and I don't want to lose again.
What? While she's been going through this hell, you've been making money?
You're betting on your friend staying in this misery?
I'll take that bet. - What?
I'm miserable. I may as well make some money out of it.
Can I get some of that action?
I'm betting against all of you?
I really feel like tomorrow it's gonna happen.
Okay.
Hey, Sleeping Beauty.
Where have you been? I want to talk to you. I still feel bad.
Oh, no. Were you upset? Did you lose sleep?
I'm so sorry.
The reason I came over is to settle things between us.
I wanted to pay you back with the premiere, but you missed it.
So how much do I owe you? - What?
I don't want to owe you anything. - You don't owe me.
I don't want your... - Ah, ah, ah. We're doing this!
You got me my first headshots. How much?
I don't know, uh, $500. - Okay, $500. What else?
Then there was the second set. The infamous "booger" headshots.
Okay, so that's another 500. That's 500 and 500. That's...
You want a calculator? - Please.
Here.
All right, what else?
Well, uh, there's acting classes, stage-combat classes, tap classes...
Which we're still keeping under our hats.
That dialect coach who helped you with a Southern accent.
Which, after 20 hours of lessons, still came out Jamaican.
What the hell are you talking about?
The South will rise again, man.
Yes, money well-spent. - Yeah.
Okay, what else? Rent.
Uh, two, three years of rent, utilities, food...
Okay, so I'm writing you a check for...
So you fell asleep during my movie. Big deal, right?
How do you clear this thing?
Finish your enchilada.
Ross, we've tried all the spicy food. It's not working.
Okay, here, have one of these peppers.
Oh, God. So hot. Oh, my God.
By the way, you don't want to touch the pepper and then touch your eye.
I am feeling nothing.
Speaking of hot, watching you do that...
...really makes me want to have sex with you.
Stop it. - Come on! Why are we wasting time?
We know it's gonna work. It's doctor-recommended.
I'm sorry. But we have to have some boundaries. My God, I'm dying.
We've done it before. We'll do it again.
It'll be a nice way to bookend the pregnancy.
I'm not gonna make love to you so you'll go into labor.
Make love'? What are you, a girl?
Always a great way to get into a man's pants.
You'll be performing a service. Think of me as a ketchup bottle.
Sometimes, you have to bang on the end of it to get it to come out.
I love when you talk dirty to me.
Oh, I know it. You're right. That's not sexy.
Oh, I seem to have dropped my fork.
Let me just bend over and get it.
Oh, God!
Okay, enough. This is not going to happen.
Come on, Ross. I'm miserable here.
Come on, you started this, now you finish it!
Come on, wuss. Make love to me.
You know what? - What?
Forget it.
What now, Ross, you're not gonna talk?
How on earth will you ever annoy me?
Oh, wait a minute, I know.
You'd think the jalapeno would clear up your sinuses, but no!
That's not enough... What are you doing?
I'm getting that baby out of you!
Oh, God! - I know.
Oh, no, no, no.
I think my water just broke.
I am good!
Okay, I got the pillow. Uh, I got the bag.
You got the keys? - I got the keys. Okay.
Okay.
Hey. - Yeah?
We're having a baby.
I didn't, uh, have time to read this part of the books, but do we have time...?
Not so much. - Okay, let's go.
Two hundred. - Thank you.
That's it. I don't care when the baby comes. No more betting.
Okay.
Hello?
Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Okay.
I guess we could bet one more time.
Is Rachel having the baby? - How did you know that?
Joey! Chandler! It's time! - They're at the coffee house.
You know everything!
Wait. I bet you the baby is over 7 pounds.
I bet you it has hair! I bet you it's a girl.
We know it's a girl. - I'll give you really good odds.

sense_groups.english: Well, then somebody's snoozing.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我不是要你听我的 但如果你选了我…
sense_groups.english: And, Joey, not that this should, uh, affect you at all, but, um, if you pick me...

sense_groups.chinese: 我计划穿露到这里的紧身洋装
sense_groups.english: ...I was planning on wearing a sequin dress out down to here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有看过这套洋装 - 看过电影明星穿
sense_groups.english: I haven't seen this dress. - Star in a movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想挑谁都可以 听你的心说话 它跟你说了什么
sense_groups.english: Pick whoever you want. Listen to your heart. What does it tell you?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比…
sense_groups.english: Phoebe.Phoebe.Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我要挑钱德
sense_groups.english: I think I want to take Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比…
sense_groups.english: Phoebe,Phoebe,Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要挑我 - 对 抱歉 我希望能带大家去
sense_groups.english: You want to take me? - Yeah, I wish I could take everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 但钱德一直都很支持我的工作
sense_groups.english: But Chandler's always supported my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 他帮我付表演课跟沙龙照等等的费用
sense_groups.english: He's paid for acting classes, headshots and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是我回报你的方式
sense_groups.english: This will be my way of paying you back.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你根本打算不还我钱
sense_groups.english: So you're never actually going to pay me back?

sense_groups.chinese: 只因为他帮你付沙龙照的钱 你就要选他
sense_groups.english: Just because he paid for your headshots, you're gonna take him?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我想你不了解那件洋装有多露
sense_groups.english: I don't think you're comprehending just how slutty this dress is.

sense_groups.chinese: 不光只因为他付了钱 他真的很支持我 你们知道吗
sense_groups.english: It's not just the stuff he paid for. It's everything, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟我对台词 我很紧张时陪我去试镜
sense_groups.english: He read lines with me. He went with me on auditions.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我没拿到我要的角色时 他会安慰我
sense_groups.english: Then he consoled me after I didn't get parts.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一直相信我 即使连我都不相信自己
sense_groups.english: You always believed in me, man, even when I didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都知道你会成功 我非常以你为荣
sense_groups.english: I always knew you were gonna make it. I'm so proud of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 那对我来说很重要
sense_groups.english: Thanks, that means a lot to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 或许他们之中有人想穿你的洋装
sense_groups.english: Mon, maybe one of these guys wants to wear your dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去刮胡子 - 对 我得去吐痰了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go shave. Ahem. - Yeah, well, I'm gonna go, uh, spit.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去尿尿了
sense_groups.english: Ugh, I have to pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 五分钟后如果我没出来 那是因为我被花香味熏死了
sense_groups.english: If I don't come out, it's because I've choked to death on the potpourri stink.

sense_groups.chinese: 等她出来时你捏住她的鼻子 我对她的嘴巴吹气
sense_groups.english: You hold her nose, I'll blow in her mouth and the kid'll just...

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝就会掉出来
sense_groups.english: ...out of her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她晚了一个星期 今天她一定会生 对吧
sense_groups.english: She's a week late. She's got to have it today.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我想应该还要一阵子
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I think it's still gonna be a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想来点刺激的吗
sense_groups.english: Hmm. Care to make it interesting?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你赌她明天此时会生 - 没问题
sense_groups.english: I bet you she'll have it tomorrow. - You're on.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 赌多少 - 10万
sense_groups.english: Okay, how much? - One hundred thousand dollars.

sense_groups.chinese: 50块如何 - 我会打电话到苏黎世请他们汇钱来
sense_groups.english: How about 50 bucks? - I'll call Zurich and move some money.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 这次轮到谁来扶我
sense_groups.english: All right, whose turn is it to help me get up?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人在
sense_groups.english: Ahem, no one's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Oh, damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太刺激 太棒了 好多人帮我们拍照 我看起来如何
sense_groups.english: This is exciting. So glamorous! People taking our picture. How do I look?

sense_groups.chinese: 太高了一点 - 什么
sense_groups.english: A little tall. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能蹲低一点 让我看起来高一点
sense_groups.english: Would you crouch down a bit so that I look taller?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好
sense_groups.english: There you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是太光鲜了
sense_groups.english: It's just so glamorous.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 瑞秋来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Mon? Rach is here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没生
sense_groups.english: And you're still pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 真对不起 我知道你很不舒服
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I know how uncomfortable you are.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 你看起来棒极了
sense_groups.english: You know what? You look great. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟50块钞票一样
sense_groups.english: Yeah, like 50 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去尿尿 很明显地这个宝宝 把我的膀胱当成玩具捏
sense_groups.english: I have to go pee. Apparently this baby thinks my bladder is a squeeze toy.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 50块拿去
sense_groups.english: Damn it. Here's your 50 bucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会输真的是太有趣了… 我忘了 你喜欢输吗
sense_groups.english: That's interesting that you lost. Now, I forget, do you like to lose?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 别说了
sense_groups.english: All right, stop it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们加倍来赌她明天会生 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Double or nothing she has it tomorrow. - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 在那之前 葛兰特将军 你为什么不在这里…扎营
sense_groups.english: Until then, General Grant, why don't you set up camp right there?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋在这里吗 我们得去看医生 - 在厕所里
sense_groups.english: Rachel here? We have an appointment. - In the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我们得走了 - 马上好
sense_groups.english: Rach, we gotta go. - In a minute!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家问我们为什么不在一起 我不知道该怎么告诉他们
sense_groups.english: People ask why we're not together. I just don't know what to tell them.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们该走了
sense_groups.english: All right, all right, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要先去换衣服
sense_groups.english: Uh, do you want to go change first?

sense_groups.chinese: 医生会等我们 但如果你快一点…
sense_groups.english: The doctor's keeping the office open late for us, but if you hurry...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我很好 真的 - 你不觉那套衣服很不适当吗
sense_groups.english: No, I'm fine. - You don't think that's inappropriate?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 天啊 别火上加油
sense_groups.english: What? - Good God, man. Don't anger it.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 外面有华氏一百度 这是几星期以来我第一次…
sense_groups.english: Ross, it is 100 degrees outside. For the first time in weeks, I am...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 随便你 你是妈咪
sense_groups.english: Fine. Whatever you want. You're the mommy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 老兄 别叫我"妈味"
sense_groups.english: Uh-uh, pal! Don't call me "Mommy."

sense_groups.chinese: 你那样叫你妈就已经够糟了
sense_groups.english: It's bad enough you call your own mother that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一次我同意她的说法
sense_groups.english: I'm actually with her on this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为我知道敌人是谁 但敌人却是你
sense_groups.english: I thought I knew who the enemy was...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 来了 我的打斗戏要开始了
sense_groups.english: Okay, this is it. This is my big fight scene coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要打倒82地面师的每个人
sense_groups.english: I'm fighting for every man in the 82nd Ground Division.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 什么事
sense_groups.english: Ross? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我能问你一件事吗
sense_groups.english: Can I ask you something? - Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡萝怀小班的时候…
sense_groups.english: When Carol was pregnant with Ben...

sense_groups.chinese: 你有这么暴躁吗
sense_groups.english: ...were you this irritating?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 - 你说什么
sense_groups.english: Wow. - Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 你只是…
sense_groups.english: Uh, nothing. You're just, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 你最近对我很不耐烦 我不想惹毛你
sense_groups.english: You've been a little short with me lately. I'm not trying to irritate you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你一定是有惹毛我的天分
sense_groups.english: Well, then, you must have a natural talent for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生马上到 在那之前我们还是别说话
sense_groups.english: The doctor will be in soon. Why don't we not speak until then?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 呼吸大声一点 罗斯 那真的太棒了
sense_groups.english: Seriously. Breathe louder, Ross. That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该问医生 她知不知道…
sense_groups.english: We should ask the doctor if she even knows...

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么接生半人半恶魔的孩子
sense_groups.english: ...how to deliver a baby that's half human, half pure evil!

sense_groups.chinese: 朗医生 你好吗 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hi, Dr. Long. How are you? - Hello.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对她很好
sense_groups.english: You're nice to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有药
sense_groups.english: She has the drugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很快帮你检查一下 - 好的
sense_groups.english: We'll do a quick check. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 已经迟了八天吗 - 对
sense_groups.english: Eight days late, huh? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会很不舒服
sense_groups.english: You must be getting uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 只有一点
sense_groups.english: Yeah, just a tad.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝已经下降了八成 就快了 但你可能还得等上一阵子
sense_groups.english: You're 80 percent effaced. You're on your way. It still could last a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你很急 有些方式可以帮助你 - 那就做吧
sense_groups.english: There are ways to help things along. - Do them!

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上你可以用这些方法在家做治疗
sense_groups.english: Actually, they're things you can do. Home remedies.

sense_groups.chinese: 根据我的经验 我发现有些方法很有效
sense_groups.english: In my experience, I've found some are very effective.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们愿意尝试任何事 - 好 你可以喝一种药草茶
sense_groups.english: Well, we are ready to try anything. - There's an herbal tea you can drink.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以喝篦麻子油 吃辣的食物
sense_groups.english: You can take some castor oil. There's spicy foods.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们全部都愿意
sense_groups.english: We will do all of those.

sense_groups.chinese: 散很久的步 - 很好 没问题
sense_groups.english: Taking a long walk. - Good. Done.

sense_groups.chinese: 根据证实最有效的方法就是做爱
sense_groups.english: And there's the one that's proved most effective: sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定是在开玩笑
sense_groups.english: You've got to be kidding me.

sense_groups.chinese: 演的好 乔伊 太棒了 一流的
sense_groups.english: Good job, Joe! Well done! Top-notch!

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的喜欢吗 - 喜欢
sense_groups.english: You liked it'? You really liked it? - Oh, yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢哪个部分 - 全部 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Well, which part exactly? - The whole thing! Here we go!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 说详细一点
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Give me some specifics.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢细节 细节是最棒的
sense_groups.english: I loved the specifics. The specifics were the best part.

sense_groups.chinese: 袋鼠的那一段呢 你喜欢吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, what about the scene with the kangaroo? Did you like that part?

sense_groups.chinese: 看到一次大战的电影里出现袋鼠 我吓了一大跳
sense_groups.english: I was surprised to see a kangaroo in a World War I epic.

sense_groups.chinese: 你睡着了
sense_groups.english: You fell asleep!

sense_groups.chinese: 片中没有袋鼠 他们没有接纳我的意见
sense_groups.english: There was no kangaroo! They didn't take any of my suggestions!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你来看 回头见 - 别走了 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Thanks for coming. See you later. - Don't go. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 这家伙睡着了 他也睡着了 生他的气啊
sense_groups.english: Look, this guy fell asleep! He fell asleep too! Be mad at him!

sense_groups.chinese: 或是叫救护车来
sense_groups.english: Or call an ambulance!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说什么 知道宝宝何时会出生吗
sense_groups.english: What did the doctor say? Any news on when the baby will come?

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道 她教我们如何加速生产的脚步
sense_groups.english: No. She gave us ideas on how to induce labor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都试过了
sense_groups.english: We tried them all.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去散步 喝了茶 吃篦麻子油跟辣的食物 通通没用
sense_groups.english: We went for a walk, uh, we tried tea, castor oil, spicy food. Nothing worked.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个方法我们没试
sense_groups.english: There is one thing we didn't try.

sense_groups.chinese: 但有人觉得那会惹来大麻烦
sense_groups.english: But someone thinks that that will open up a can of worms.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么办法 如果有办法让宝宝在今天出生…
sense_groups.english: If it's gonna help bring the baby here, today...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你们应该试试看
sense_groups.english: ...I think you should do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们得做爱 - 就做啊
sense_groups.english: It's sex. - Do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 - 你们很久没做爱了
sense_groups.english: Monica. - It's been a really long time for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说女人也有需要 快去吧 满足你的需要
sense_groups.english: I mean, women have needs. Do it. Get yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个嘛 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想如果你们两个做爱 结果一定会很糟糕
sense_groups.english: I think if the two of you had sex, the repercussions would be catastrophic.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们实际一点
sense_groups.english: All right, let's be practical.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果罗斯不愿意 不只他能跟你做爱
sense_groups.english: If Ross isn't willing, he's not the only guy you can have sex with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以借用钱德 钱德很厉害
sense_groups.english: You could borrow Chandler. Chandler is good.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你是怎么了
sense_groups.english: Monica, what is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是希望宝宝能在今天出生 - 为什么一定要今天
sense_groups.english: I just want the baby to be born today. - Why today?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在跟菲比打赌你会生 我不想再输钱了
sense_groups.english: I bet Phoebe that you're gonna have the baby, and I don't want to lose again.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 她这么痛苦 你却在赢钱
sense_groups.english: What? While she's been going through this hell, you've been making money?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们拿朋友是否会持续这种难忍的痛苦来当赌注
sense_groups.english: You're betting on your friend staying in this misery?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要赌 - 什么
sense_groups.english: I'll take that bet. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经够惨了 还不如找点钱赚
sense_groups.english: I'm miserable. I may as well make some money out of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也可以加入吗
sense_groups.english: Can I get some of that action?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 现在变成我跟你们三个对赌
sense_groups.english: I'm betting against all of you?

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我真的觉得应该是明天
sense_groups.english: I really feel like tomorrow it's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 睡美人
sense_groups.english: Hey, Sleeping Beauty.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跑到哪里去了 我想跟你谈一谈 我还是很难过
sense_groups.english: Where have you been? I want to talk to you. I still feel bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你很难过 你睡不着吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Were you upset? Did you lose sleep?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来这里解决我们之间的问题 你帮了我很多忙
sense_groups.english: The reason I came over is to settle things between us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我请你去看首映会报答你 但你睡着了
sense_groups.english: I wanted to pay you back with the premiere, but you missed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我欠你多少钱 - 什么
sense_groups.english: So how much do I owe you? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 说个数字 我不想欠你 - 你什么都不欠我
sense_groups.english: I don't want to owe you anything. - You don't owe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要你的… - 我们得这么做
sense_groups.english: I don't want your... - Ah, ah, ah. We're doing this!

sense_groups.chinese: 你帮我付第一次沙龙照的费用 多少钱
sense_groups.english: You got me my first headshots. How much?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 五百块 - 好吧 五百块 还有呢
sense_groups.english: I don't know, uh, $500. - Okay, $500. What else?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有第二组沙龙照 可怕的"怪物"大头照
sense_groups.english: Then there was the second set. The infamous "booger" headshots.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 再加五百块 五百加五百是…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so that's another 500. That's 500 and 500. That's...

sense_groups.chinese: 你需要计算机吗 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You want a calculator? - Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 还有呢
sense_groups.english: All right, what else?

sense_groups.chinese: 还有表演课 舞台打斗课 踢踏舞课…
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, there's acting classes, stage-combat classes, tap classes...

sense_groups.chinese: 还不只是那些
sense_groups.english: Which we're still keeping under our hats.

sense_groups.chinese: 我付钱请教练教你说南方腔
sense_groups.english: That dialect coach who helped you with a Southern accent.

sense_groups.chinese: 上了20小时的课后 你还是满口牙买加腔
sense_groups.english: Which, after 20 hours of lessons, still came out Jamaican.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在胡说什么
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: "南方将会再起"
sense_groups.english: The South will rise again, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那笔钱花得很值得 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yes, money well-spent. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 还有呢 房租
sense_groups.english: Okay, what else? Rent.

sense_groups.chinese: 两 三年的房租杂文费 伙食费…
sense_groups.english: Uh, two, three years of rent, utilities, food...

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我写张支票给你
sense_groups.english: Okay, so I'm writing you a check for...

sense_groups.chinese: 你看我的电影看到睡着了 没什么大不了的 对吧
sense_groups.english: So you fell asleep during my movie. Big deal, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这玩意要怎么消除
sense_groups.english: How do you clear this thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 快 把你的墨西哥卷吃掉
sense_groups.english: Finish your enchilada.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会因为要让你生孩子 就跟你做爱

sense_groups.chinese: 做爱 你是娘娘腔吗
sense_groups.english: Make love'? What are you, a girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 那真是惹毛男人最棒的方法
sense_groups.english: Always a great way to get into a man's pants.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是在提供服务 把我当成一罐番茄酱
sense_groups.english: You'll be performing a service. Think of me as a ketchup bottle.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候你得敲敲瓶底 才能把番茄酱倒出来
sense_groups.english: Sometimes, you have to bang on the end of it to get it to come out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢你说脏话的样子
sense_groups.english: I love when you talk dirty to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 你说的对 那一点都不性感
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know it. You're right. That's not sexy.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的叉子掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, I seem to have dropped my fork.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我弯下腰来捡它
sense_groups.english: Let me just bend over and get it.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 够了 这是不可能发生的
sense_groups.english: Okay, enough. This is not going to happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 罗斯 我真的很难受
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross. I'm miserable here.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 这是你惹出来的 你得结束它
sense_groups.english: Come on, you started this, now you finish it!

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 懦夫 跟我做爱
sense_groups.english: Come on, wuss. Make love to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 - 什么
sense_groups.english: You know what? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 算了
sense_groups.english: Forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 罗斯 你不想谈吗
sense_groups.english: What now, Ross, you're not gonna talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 你到底要惹我惹到什么时候
sense_groups.english: How on earth will you ever annoy me?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 我知道了
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait a minute, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得辣椒能治好你的鼻窦炎 但是你错了
sense_groups.english: You'd think the jalapeno would clear up your sinuses, but no!

sense_groups.chinese: 那还是不够… 你在做什么
sense_groups.english: That's not enough... What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要让你把宝宝生出来
sense_groups.english: I'm getting that baby out of you!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 不…
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我的羊水破了
sense_groups.english: I think my water just broke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我太厉害了
sense_groups.english: I am good!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我拿了枕头 还有包包
sense_groups.english: Okay, I got the pillow. Uh, I got the bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿了钥匙吗 - 我拿了
sense_groups.english: You got the keys? - I got the keys. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的宝宝要出生了
sense_groups.english: We're having a baby.

sense_groups.english: I didn't, uh, have time to read this part of the books, but do we have time...?

sense_groups.english: Not so much. - Okay, let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 两百 - 谢谢

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我不在乎宝宝何时出生 我不要赌了
sense_groups.english: That's it. I don't care when the baby comes. No more betting.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. Uh-huh. Okay.

questions.en:
All right!
Yes! From home to the hospital in seven minutes!
Yes. The hard part is truly over.
We're off to a great start, aren't we?
I knew I'd get here fast, but this has to be a record!
Oh, you made it! - Hi.
How the hell did you beat us here?
We took a cab. Did you walk?
No, we took a cab too. But I did test runs...
Hi. - Hey, you made it!
Okay, is there some kind of magic tunnel to this hospital?
Ross, you stay here and talk. I'm gonna go have a baby.
Okay. Hi, this is Rachel Green.
I'm Ross Geller. We called from the car.
We have a semi-private labor room waiting...
Oh, whoa! I'm sorry. Semi-private? We asked for a private room.
Yes, I see that here. Unfortunately, We can't guarantee a private room.
Currently, they're all unavailable. - Man, if only you'd gotten here sooner.
I'm sorry. Semi-private rooms are all we have.
Okay. Just give us a second. Ross?
Yeah?
Give her some money. - I really think they're out of rooms.
They're saving them for important people! What if I was the president?
We'd be in a lot of trouble. You don't know where any countries are.
Okay.
Say, would you mind checking again?
See if any, uh, private rooms may have opened up?
This is a hospital.
You know what? I don't really care for your tone.
This is not the only hospital in the city. We have no problem... Whoa. Oh, gosh!
What, what? - Contraction! Ow! Ow!
Like to see a semi-private room? - Yeah, it couldn't hurt to look.
# So no one told you life was gonna be this way #
# Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #
# It's like you're always stuck in second gear #
# When it hasn't been your day, #
# your week, your month, or even your year #
# but I'll be there for you #
# 'Cause you're there for me too #
You're 2 centimeters dilated. We need to get to 10.
It will be a while. - Oh, okay.
I'll be back in an hour to check on you. - Thank you.
I guess we have some time to kill. - Yeah, guess so.
Oh, check these out.
Never done this before.
Yeah, well, it looks great.
Thank you very much. I think we're ready to...
Hi, I'm Ross. I'm here to ruin this magical day for you.
Not at all. Marc Horger. My wife, Julie. - Don't worry about it.
Hi, Julie. This is Rachel. - Oh, hi, Rachel.
Is this your first? - It is.
Well, little Jamie here is our third.
So if you have any questions, just holler.
That's so sweet. - Yeah.
Let me give you guys some privacy. - Nonsense. We're all in this together.
We are gonna share every moment of this with you.
I think we're gonna have some fun. - Yeah.
Oh, okay, I guess. - Hey, smile!
No. - I really don't want any...
Oh, thank you.
Oh, Ross. Here comes another contraction.
Okay, just breathe...
Oh, honey, I think I'm having one too! - Oh, my God!
Hey, look at this. Here you go! - Oh, no!
Oh, wow. Three hours and still no baby.
Ugh, the miracle of birth sure is a snooze-fest.
Hey, you wanna see something? - Sure. What?
This will be fun. Watch me freak out Chandler.
Honey? - Yeah?
Listen, uh, I've been doing some thinking...
...and I don't know whether it's because we're here...
...or Rachel's giving birth...
...but, um, I think we should try to have a baby.
Okay.
What's that now?
Okay. I've been thinking about it too. I think we're ready.
Are you kidding? You think we're ready to have a baby?
Oh, this is fun.
You're ready to have a baby? My boy's all grown up!
You said you were ready.
I was screwing with you to get your voice high and weird...
...like mine is now!
Yes, but haven't you wanted a kid, like, forever?
Okay, just back off, mister!
Because I am ready to have a baby.
I just want Joey to be the father.
What? Are you crazy? - Right there! That's all I wanted!
I'm sorry. The doctor insisted on closing the curtain for the exam.
Oh, that's very... Really, very, very okay.
Julie's cervix is dilated 7 centimeters. That's about four fingers!
Doctor let me feel it. - Have you felt Rachel's?
No, I don't... - We won't be doing that.
Well, you could feel Rachel's, then feel mine to compare.
Am I interrupting? - Yes! Thank you!
No, no... - Later.
You can't leave me with them. - Sorry.
No, Ross, Ross? Ross? My child has no father!
I'm so glad you're here, but it's gonna be a while. I wish you'd called first.
I'm coming back later with your father. - Oh, good.
I need to talk to you before the birth. - Okay. What's up?
I brought something that I want to give you.
Assuming, of course, that you want it.
Ma, you're asking me to marry you?
Your grandma's engagement ring, I want you to give it to Rachel.
Mom, no. Come on. Thank you... - Just hear me out...
No! Okay? We're not getting married because she's pregnant.
Honestly, this isn't just some girl you picked up in a bar and humped.
A child should have a family.
I can't deal with this now. I'm sorry.
Think about it. If you don't, I'll talk more about humping.
Give me that.
Hi, dear. - Hi. Thank you so much for coming.
Ross, get in here!
She dragged me out of the labor room to ask me why I'm not with Rachel.
Why aren't you with Rachel? - Are you kidding?
We're not gonna be together because we're having a baby.
It seems you belong together.
I can't deal with this right now. I have to go have a baby.
Right. And with who again?
He's crazy. Why doesn't he wanna be with Rachel?
I know.
She's like the perfect woman. I know she turned me down...

I haven't bummed you guys out like this in a while.
Hey. - Hey.
Who's that? - New people.
What happened to the Disgustingtons?
They're having their baby. It's not fair, Ross. I got here first!
After you left, they wheeled her off.
Not before she gave me a nice, juicy shot of little Jamie, crowning away.
Wow. Sorry.
So, uh, how are the new people?
Well, they have some unusual pet names for each other.

Oh, gosh, a contraction. Ooh, ow! - Yeah? Okay, okay. Just breathe.
Are you looking at her? - No!
Don't look at her, you sick bastard! - I swear I wasn't looking at her!
She's in labor. You like that, you sick son of a bitch?
I'm just gonna...
See? It's because you were looking, you fat pervert.
No, no. I'm sure no one was looking. Just want some privacy.
You miss your girlfriend?
Just ignore them.
You okay? - Yeah.
Ross. - What?

Wanna live to see your baby?
Don't you talk to my husband like that, you stupid bastard!
Oh, good God! If you want a baby so bad, just go steal it!

We're really good.
We are pretty good.

Well, maybe I'm ready now.
I mean, it's a little scary, but maybe it's right.
It's not right! We're not ready for a kid!
What? - I'm kidding. This is gonna be fun.
So we're gonna try? I mean, we're trying?
We're trying to get pregnant.
I'm not comfortable doing this in front of the babies.

Period math? - Yeah.
Well, we could start trying now.
Right here? - No, not here.
Maybe here.
We got a lot of time to kill. We're in a building that's full of beds!
And it's so clean!
Come on, you stupid machine! Come on!
Aw, it ate your money? - No.
I'll see you downstairs then. - All right.
All right.
Hey, I got one! I got one!
Hi. - Hi.
Oh, up or down'? - Oh. Down, please.

Could you press up too? - Sure.
I feel bad. I broke my leg once too. - How did yours happen?
It's a long, embarrassing story.
Let's just say, there was a typographical error with a sex manual.
How about you? - Car accident.
Idiot on a cell not paying attention? - Yeah. Me.
Oh, hey, that's me. - Okay.
Hey, uh, I take it you're just visiting someone.
Uh-huh. Yeah.
Well, um, if you have some time, and you wanna visit someone else...
Yeah. I would like that.
Great. I'm in room... - Wait! What? No! Elevator! No!
You gotta press the button.

Oh, Ross! Another contraction. - Oh, okay. Here, here.
That's it.
Oh, that sounded like a bad one. - Yeah, it was.

Oh, that was a big one.
Could you help me'? The patient I'm looking for has a broken leg.
He's in a wheelchair. He's early to mid-30s, very attractive.
I know who you're talking about. - Yay! Great! What room is he in?
Sorry. That information is restricted.

Ramoray. It's Portuguese. We need that information. I'm a doctor.
At this hospital? - Damn it! We're losing precious time.
You want this man's blood on your head...
Hands. - Hands.
It is essential that you tell me what room he is staying in.
He's a patient of mine.
He's in room 816. -816. Thank you.

I think we found a place. - Okay.
Wait. Wanna set the mood a little? - Okay.
We'll dim the lights. - Okay.
Or turn them out altogether.
Uh, no scented candles. Okay, here. There we go.
Okay, okay. Making me sterile, but okay.
Okay. I'm sorry. Oh, wait. Do we have a condom?
Oh, right! Ha, ha.
Yes, 98.6. You're gonna be fine.
Ooh, this is it!
That's him! - Great. Go get him!
Wait a second. Or maybe you could go in first.
He's not really my type.
Not you. Dr. Ramoray. Ask him questions and see what he's like.
People tell doctors everything. - You said he's great.

Three women have had their babies.

I'm not waiting. I'm gonna push this baby out.

Yes.

No. - Excellent. Excellent.

No! - Ooh. Wrong answer.

You have to speak loudly, he's almost completely deaf.
Oh, there you go. - Of course he is.
Congratulations. I didn't even know you got married.
Oh, no. We didn't. - No, no, we...
What?
We're just having this baby together, but, uh, that's all. You know?
Why?
Uh, we're just not in that place, you know? But we're very excited about this.
Oh. Well, then shut me up.
Just tell me how.
Uh-oh. Oh, I feel another one coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 从家里赶到医院花了不到七分钟的时间 我们办到了
sense_groups.english: Yes! From home to the hospital in seven minutes!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 最难的部分完成了
sense_groups.english: Yes. The hard part is truly over.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但打起精神来 我们有个不错的开始 对吧
sense_groups.english: We're off to a great start, aren't we?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我可以很快赶到这里 但这一定是创下了纪录
sense_groups.english: I knew I'd get here fast, but this has to be a record!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们赶到了 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, you made it! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们怎么会比我们先到
sense_groups.english: How the hell did you beat us here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们搭计程车 你们是走过来的吗
sense_groups.english: We took a cab. Did you walk?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们也是搭计程车 但我做过实验…
sense_groups.english: No, we took a cab too. But I did test runs...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿 你们赶到了
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey, you made it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 难不成有魔法地道通到这家医院
sense_groups.english: Okay, is there some kind of magic tunnel to this hospital?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你留下来聊天 我要去生孩子了
sense_groups.english: Ross, you stay here and talk. I'm gonna go have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 嗨 她是瑞秋·葛林
sense_groups.english: Okay. Hi, this is Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯·盖勒 我们在车上打过电话
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross Geller. We called from the car.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我们为你们准备了双人待产室 所以…
sense_groups.english: We have a semi-private labor room waiting...

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 双人房 我们订了单人房
sense_groups.english: Oh, whoa! I'm sorry. Semi-private? We asked for a private room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 不幸地是 我们无法保证一定有单人房
sense_groups.english: Yes, I see that here. Unfortunately, We can't guarantee a private room.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在单人房都满了 - 真是的 你该早点过来的
sense_groups.english: Currently, they're all unavailable. - Man, if only you'd gotten here sooner.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我们只有双人待产室
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Semi-private rooms are all we have.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 等我们一下 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay. Just give us a second. Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 塞点钱给她 - 我真的相信他们没房间了
sense_groups.english: Give her some money. - I really think they're out of rooms.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们为大人物保留房间 好吧 如果我是总统呢
sense_groups.english: They're saving them for important people! What if I was the president?

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我们麻烦大了 你不知道任何国家的地理位置
sense_groups.english: We'd be in a lot of trouble. You don't know where any countries are.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能再帮我们看看吗
sense_groups.english: Say, would you mind checking again?

sense_groups.chinese: 有没有我们可以使用的单人待产室
sense_groups.english: See if any, uh, private rooms may have opened up?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里是医院
sense_groups.english: This is a hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你知道吗 我得说我真的不太喜欢你的语气
sense_groups.english: You know what? I don't really care for your tone.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不是市里唯一一家医院 我们没有问题…天啊
sense_groups.english: This is not the only hospital in the city. We have no problem... Whoa. Oh, gosh!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 是阵痛
sense_groups.english: What, what? - Contraction! Ow! Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们想看看双人待产室吗 - 好吧 看看也无妨
sense_groups.english: Like to see a semi-private room? - Yeah, it couldn't hurt to look.

sense_groups.chinese: # 没有人告诉你活着有多累 #
sense_groups.english: # So no one told you life was gonna be this way #

sense_groups.chinese: # 上班受罪 口袋空空 爱情变累赘 #
sense_groups.english: # Your job's a joke, you're broke, your love life's D.O.A. #

sense_groups.chinese: # 寂寞又潦倒 受气又受累 #
sense_groups.english: # It's like you're always stuck in second gear #

sense_groups.chinese: # 日复一日 年复一年 #
sense_groups.english: # When it hasn't been your day, #

sense_groups.chinese: # 时运不济 活着受罪 #
sense_groups.english: # your week, your month, or even your year #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我永不离弃 #
sense_groups.english: # but I'll be there for you #

sense_groups.chinese: # 你我相偎相依 #
sense_groups.english: # 'Cause you're there for me too #

sense_groups.chinese: 你只开了两公分 得等到开十公分才行
sense_groups.english: You're 2 centimeters dilated. We need to get to 10.

sense_groups.chinese: 那得等上一段时间 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: It will be a while. - Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一小时后再回来帮你检查 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in an hour to check on you. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我们得想办法消磨时间 - 没错
sense_groups.english: I guess we have some time to kill. - Yeah, guess so.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 你看
sense_groups.english: Oh, check these out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我从来没有这么做过
sense_groups.english: Never done this before.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那看起来很不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, it looks great.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 我想我们准备好…
sense_groups.english: Thank you very much. I think we're ready to...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是罗斯 我来帮你们毁了这美好的一天
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Ross. I'm here to ruin this magical day for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 一点都不会 没关系的 马克·何格 她是我太太茱莉
sense_groups.english: Not at all. Marc Horger. My wife, Julie. - Don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菜莉 她是瑞秋 - 嗨 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hi, Julie. This is Rachel. - Oh, hi, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的第一胎 - 对
sense_groups.english: Is this your first? - It is.

sense_groups.chinese: 小吉米是我们的第三胎
sense_groups.english: Well, little Jamie here is our third.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们有问题或需要帮忙 叫我们一声
sense_groups.english: So if you have any questions, just holler.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太棒了 - 对
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得让你们独处下 - 没关系 我们可以一起来
sense_groups.english: Let me give you guys some privacy. - Nonsense. We're all in this together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们愿意跟你们分享每一刻
sense_groups.english: We are gonna share every moment of this with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们会非常愉快 - 对
sense_groups.english: I think we're gonna have some fun. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想…好吧 - 笑一个
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, I guess. - Hey, smile!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道… - 我真的不要…
sense_groups.english: No. - I really don't want any...

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我又开始阵痛了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross. Here comes another contraction.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 深呼吸
sense_groups.english: Okay, just breathe...

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 我想我也开始阵痛了 - 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, I think I'm having one too! - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 来吧 - 不
sense_groups.english: Hey, look at this. Here you go! - Oh, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 三个小时了 还生不出来
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Three hours and still no baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 生产的奇迹的确让人很想打瞌睡
sense_groups.english: Ugh, the miracle of birth sure is a snooze-fest.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你要看看好玩的事吗 - 当然要 什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, you wanna see something? - Sure. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 这一定会很好玩 看我怎么吓钱德
sense_groups.english: This will be fun. Watch me freak out Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Honey? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我一直在想…
sense_groups.english: Listen, uh, I've been doing some thinking...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道是因为 我们来到这里…
sense_groups.english: ...and I don't know whether it's because we're here...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是瑞秋要生孩子…
sense_groups.english: ...or Rachel's giving birth...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想我们应该试着怀孕
sense_groups.english: ...but, um, I think we should try to have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么
sense_groups.english: What's that now?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我也一直在想那件事 我想我们准备好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. I've been thinking about it too. I think we're ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗 你觉得我们准备好要怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Are you kidding? You think we're ready to have a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的很好玩
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们准备要怀孕了 我的小男孩长大了
sense_groups.english: You're ready to have a baby? My boy's all grown up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你也准备好了
sense_groups.english: You said you were ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我只是想跟你开玩笑 让你用高八度的怪声音说话…
sense_groups.english: I was screwing with you to get your voice high and weird...

sense_groups.chinese: 就像我现在一样
sense_groups.english: ...like mine is now!

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但你不是一直都想要生孩子吗
sense_groups.english: Yes, but haven't you wanted a kid, like, forever?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 滚开 先生
sense_groups.english: Okay, just back off, mister!

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我准备生孩子了
sense_groups.english: Because I am ready to have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是希望乔伊是孩子的爸
sense_groups.english: I just want Joey to be the father.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你疯了吗 - 就是那样 那就是我的目的
sense_groups.english: What? Are you crazy? - Right there! That's all I wanted!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 医生坚持拉上布幕做检查
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. The doctor insisted on closing the curtain for the exam.

sense_groups.chinese: 那非常… 真的没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's very... Really, very, very okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 茱莉的子宫颈开了七公分 大约是四指宽
sense_groups.english: Julie's cervix is dilated 7 centimeters. That's about four fingers!

sense_groups.chinese: 医生让我自己摸摸看 - 你摸过瑞秋的子宫颈吗 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Doctor let me feel it. - Have you felt Rachel's?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有…我们不会那么做 - 我们不会那么做
sense_groups.english: No, I don't... - We won't be doing that.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你要的话 你可以摸摸瑞秋的 再摸摸我的做比较
sense_groups.english: Well, you could feel Rachel's, then feel mine to compare.

sense_groups.chinese: 我打扰了你们吗 - 太棒了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Am I interrupting? - Yes! Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 - 待会见
sense_groups.english: No, no... - Later.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不能丢下我跟他们独处 - 对不起
sense_groups.english: You can't leave me with them. - Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 罗斯 我的孩子没有父亲
sense_groups.english: No, Ross, Ross? Ross? My child has no father!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你来了 可能还要再等一下 你该先打电话来
sense_groups.english: I'm so glad you're here, but it's gonna be a while. I wish you'd called first.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我待会会再跟你爸来一趟 - 喔 好
sense_groups.english: I'm coming back later with your father. - Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 在孩子出生前我得跟你谈一谈 - 好吧 什么事
sense_groups.english: I need to talk to you before the birth. - Okay. What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有样东西要给你
sense_groups.english: I brought something that I want to give you.

sense_groups.chinese: 假设你真的要它
sense_groups.english: Assuming, of course, that you want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 你要我娶你
sense_groups.english: Ma, you're asking me to marry you?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你外婆的订婚戒指 我要你把它送给瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Your grandma's engagement ring, I want you to give it to Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 不 别这样 谢谢你 - 听我说…
sense_groups.english: Mom, no. Come on. Thank you... - Just hear me out...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 好吗 我们谈过了 我们不会因为她怀孕了就去结婚
sense_groups.english: No! Okay? We're not getting married because she's pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 罗斯 她不是你在酒吧泡到就上的女孩
sense_groups.english: Honestly, this isn't just some girl you picked up in a bar and humped.

sense_groups.chinese: 孩子应该要有家庭
sense_groups.english: A child should have a family.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我现在无法思考此事 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I can't deal with this now. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 考虑一下 如果你不那么做 我会再跟你谈上女孩的事
sense_groups.english: Think about it. If you don't, I'll talk more about humping.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我吧
sense_groups.english: Give me that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 亲爱的 - 谢谢你赶过来
sense_groups.english: Hi, dear. - Hi. Thank you so much for coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 快进来
sense_groups.english: Ross, get in here!

sense_groups.chinese: 她把我拖出待产室 问我为什么不跟瑞秋结婚
sense_groups.english: She dragged me out of the labor room to ask me why I'm not with Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不跟瑞秋结婚 - 你在开玩笑吗
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you with Rachel? - Are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不会因为孩子的关系就去办结婚 好吗
sense_groups.english: We're not gonna be together because we're having a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 但看起来你们两个属于彼此
sense_groups.english: It seems you belong together.

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了 现在我无法想这件事 我得去等孩子出生
sense_groups.english: I can't deal with this right now. I have to go have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你是要跟谁生孩子
sense_groups.english: Right. And with who again?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他疯了 他为什么不跟瑞秋结婚
sense_groups.english: He's crazy. Why doesn't he wanna be with Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的她是个完美女性 我知道她拒绝了我…
sense_groups.english: She's like the perfect woman. I know she turned me down...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她没有 她想跟我在一起 我会抱着她…
sense_groups.english: ...but if she wanted to be with me, I would take her in my arms and...

sense_groups.chinese: 我有一阵子没有这样吓你们了吧
sense_groups.english: I haven't bummed you guys out like this in a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是谁 - 新来的人
sense_groups.english: Who's that? - New people.

sense_groups.chinese: 那对恶心夫妇怎么了
sense_groups.english: What happened to the Disgustingtons?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们去生孩子了 真不公平 罗斯 是我先来的
sense_groups.english: They're having their baby. It's not fair, Ross. I got here first!

sense_groups.chinese: 你离开不久 他们就将她推进产房了
sense_groups.english: After you left, they wheeled her off.

sense_groups.chinese: 但她走之前 让我看了一下她的产道
sense_groups.english: Not before she gave me a nice, juicy shot of little Jamie, crowning away.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Wow. Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 新来的人怎么样
sense_groups.english: So, uh, how are the new people?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们帮彼此取了很不寻常的绰号
sense_groups.english: Well, they have some unusual pet names for each other.

sense_groups.chinese: 包括"坏心死人"跟"病态混蛋"
sense_groups.english: Including, um, "Evil Bitch" and, uh, "Sick Bastard."

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 是阵痛 - 是吗 好了 深呼吸
sense_groups.english: Oh, gosh, a contraction. Ooh, ow! - Yeah? Okay, okay. Just breathe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在看她吗 - 没有
sense_groups.english: Are you looking at her? - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 别看她 病态混蛋 - 甜心 我发誓我没有看她
sense_groups.english: Don't look at her, you sick bastard! - I swear I wasn't looking at her!

sense_groups.chinese: 她要生了 你喜欢吗 你这病态贱人
sense_groups.english: She's in labor. You like that, you sick son of a bitch?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是…
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna...

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 那都是你偷看的关系 胖变态
sense_groups.english: See? It's because you were looking, you fat pervert.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我相信没有人在偷看 我们只是需要一点隐私
sense_groups.english: No, no. I'm sure no one was looking. Just want some privacy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想念你的女朋友吗
sense_groups.english: You miss your girlfriend?

sense_groups.chinese: 别理他们
sense_groups.english: Just ignore them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧 - 没事
sense_groups.english: You okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Ross. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他在偷看我 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: He's looking at me. - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你想活着看到你的孩子吗
sense_groups.english: Wanna live to see your baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 别那样跟我先生说话 你这个白痴混蛋
sense_groups.english: Don't you talk to my husband like that, you stupid bastard!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 如果你那么想要孩子 去偷一个吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, good God! If you want a baby so bad, just go steal it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么了 你什么时候这么喜欢孩子了
sense_groups.english: Since when are you so crazy about babies?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是喜欢孩子 我是为我们感到疯狂
sense_groups.english: I'm not crazy about babies. I'm crazy about us.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们总是说以后要生孩子 不是现在…
sense_groups.english: We talk about having babies someday, not now...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我开始认为我们应付得来 我们准备好了
sense_groups.english: ...but I'm starting to think that we can handle it. We're good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的准备好了
sense_groups.english: We're really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们准备齐全
sense_groups.english: We are pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你没准备好前 我是不会行动的
sense_groups.english: But nothing has to happen until you're ready.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我现在准备好了
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I'm ready now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说是有点可怕 或许没关系
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's a little scary, but maybe it's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 才不会没关系 我们才没有准备好要生孩子
sense_groups.english: It's not right! We're not ready for a kid!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 我是在开玩笑 这一定会很好玩
sense_groups.english: What? - I'm kidding. This is gonna be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要试试看吗 我们现在要试吗
sense_groups.english: So we're gonna try? I mean, we're trying?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要试着怀孕
sense_groups.english: We're trying to get pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想在宝宝面前那么做
sense_groups.english: I'm not comfortable doing this in front of the babies.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想什么时候开始试 - 好吧 等一下
sense_groups.english: So when do you want to start trying? - All right, hold on a sec.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在算生理周期 - 对
sense_groups.english: Period math? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以从现在开始

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 我办不到 - 不 我知道你办得到
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I can't. I can't. - Yes, you can. I know you can do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 拜托 帮我推吧
sense_groups.english: I had no idea. please, you do it for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 再一次 最后一次 准备好了吗 一 二 三
sense_groups.english: Let's go. One more time. One final push. Ready? One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续用力
sense_groups.english: Keep pushing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没事吧
sense_groups.english: Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不知道那有多痛
sense_groups.english: You have no idea how much this hurts.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续用力
sense_groups.english: Keep going! Keep going!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝宝胎位不正 但她要出来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, oh! She's upside down, but she's coming. She's coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God! - Oh. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她出来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, she's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 她太完美了
sense_groups.english: Oh, she's perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 她好小
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Oh, she's so tiny.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要去哪里 - 他们得先把她包起来
sense_groups.english: Where'd she go? - They're just wrapping her up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 小心一点 她真的很小
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, be careful with her, she's really tiny.

sense_groups.chinese: 她来了
sense_groups.english: Here she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 小家伙
sense_groups.english: Oh, you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你终于出来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, thanks for coming out of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yes. Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在看我 嗨 我认识你
sense_groups.english: Oh, she's looking at me. Hi. I know you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们取好名字了吗 - 还没有
sense_groups.english: Do we have a name yet? - No, not yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 先叫她葛林之女
sense_groups.english: That's fine. For now we'll just call her Baby Girl Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 盖勒·葛林之女
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. Baby Girl Geller-Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 小女孩
sense_groups.english: Hello, Baby Girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能进去吗 - 请进
sense_groups.english: Can we come in? - Oh, come on in.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在那里 - 她好漂亮
sense_groups.english: Oh, there she is. - Oh, she's so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Here.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她好神奇
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很高兴你们喝醉后上了床
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm so glad you guys got drunk and had sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 太不可思议了 前一分钟她还在你肚子里…
sense_groups.english: It's incredible. I mean, one minute she's inside you...

sense_groups.chinese: 47小时后她就出现了
sense_groups.english: ...and then 47 hours later, here she is.

sense_groups.chinese: 她看起来好真实
sense_groups.english: She looks so real.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们了解我的意思
sense_groups.english: You know what I mean.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 轮到我了 - 菲比阿姨
sense_groups.english: Okay, my turn. My turn. - Aunt Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 你好可爱
sense_groups.english: Yes. Oh, baby. Oh, you're so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以捏碎你小小的头
sense_groups.english: Oh, I could squeeze your little head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会那么做的
sense_groups.english: I won't.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 怎么了 - 没事 我只是不由自主地哭了
sense_groups.english: Honey, what's the matter? - Nothing. Sorry, I just can't stop crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生说这很正常 都是荷尔蒙害的
sense_groups.english: The doctor said it's completely normal, with the hormones...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我还会睡不着 - 你们都会失眠
sense_groups.english: ...plus you're sleep-deprived. - So? You guys are all sleep-deprived.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没看过你因为鞋子穿错脚就哭个不停
sense_groups.english: I don't see you weeping because you put your slippers on the wrong feet.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, God.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 我又想起来了
sense_groups.english: What's the matter now? - I was reliving it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们帮她取好名字了吗
sense_groups.english: So do you know what you're gonna call her yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 她不是叫女儿吗
sense_groups.english: Oh. Wait a minute, it's not gonna be Baby Girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得那个名字很有创意
sense_groups.english: I thought that was so original.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我们正在考虑两个名字
sense_groups.english: Uh, actually, we've narrowed it down to two names.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 两个名字我都很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and you know what? I love them both.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们帮忙挑一个
sense_groups.english: So why don't you just pick one, and that'll be it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 大伙们…
sense_groups.english: Wow, um, okay. Uh, everyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是伊莎贝儿
sense_groups.english: This is Isabella.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 伊莎贝儿 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, Isabella. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 - 那不是她的名字
sense_groups.english: What? - That's not her name.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 她感觉上不像伊莎贝儿
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, she just doesn't feel like an Isabella.

sense_groups.chinese: 另一个名字是什么 - 笛莉拉
sense_groups.english: What was the other one, Ross? - Um, Delilah.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 突然间她成了圣经里的妓女
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Suddenly she sounds like a biblical whore.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜还是叫她女儿吧
sense_groups.english: Ahem, so I guess we're back to Baby Girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办
sense_groups.english: What are we gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 你们会想到好名字的 - 你说的倒容易
sense_groups.english: It's okay, honey. You'll find a name. - Ugh. Easy for you to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经知道你的孩子要叫什么名字了
sense_groups.english: You already know what your kids' names are gonna be.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 - 我14岁时就帮他们取好了名字
sense_groups.english: You do? - Yeah. I had them picked out since I was 14.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你的宝宝会以点心或烘烤食物的名字来命名吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no, it's gonna be named after some snack or baked good, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我们你想了什么名字
sense_groups.english: Well, tell us, what are they?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果是男孩的话就叫丹尼尔
sense_groups.english: Um, okay. If it's a boy, it's Daniel.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是女孩呢 - 我不想说
sense_groups.english: And if it's a girl? - I don't want to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 少来了 告诉我们 我们不会抢走它的
sense_groups.english: Oh, stop. Tell us. We're not gonna want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 她叫艾玛
sense_groups.english: Okay. It's Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛
sense_groups.english: Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 我不喜欢它
sense_groups.english: See, I don't want it.

sense_groups.chinese: 拿去吧 - 什么
sense_groups.english: Take it. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很适合叫艾玛
sense_groups.english: She's clearly an Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 甜心 但你喜欢那个名字
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, but you love that name.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但我更爱你
sense_groups.english: Yeah. But I love you more.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且什么名字都跟宾不配 所以我是死定了
sense_groups.english: Besides, you know, nothing goes with Bing. So I'm screwed.

sense_groups.chinese: 亚朗·利普曼·古拉尼要跟他未来的新娘打个招呼
sense_groups.english: Aaron Lipman-Guralnick would like to say hello to his future bride.

sense_groups.chinese: 他真的会让人说不出话来 对吧
sense_groups.english: Wow, he kind of takes your breath away, doesn't he?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是个谦虚的人
sense_groups.english: He's a keeper. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得如何 - 我很好
sense_groups.english: How are you feeling? - Oh, you know, I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很佩服你做的事
sense_groups.english: Can I just say, I really admire what you're doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要自己抚养她
sense_groups.english: Just raising her all alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是一个人 我有罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm not doing it alone. I have Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在是的
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure. Now.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他认识别人结了婚 那时又会是怎么样的呢
sense_groups.english: But what happens when he meets somebody else and gets married?

sense_groups.chinese: 他会离婚的 那就是罗斯
sense_groups.english: Well, then he gets a divorce. It's Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得告诉你 瑞秋 听珍妮丝的话
sense_groups.english: I'm telling you, Rachel. Listen to Janice.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人都说他们会在 但他们会成立自己的家庭
sense_groups.english: They all say they're gonna be there, until they start their real family.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯不会那么做的
sense_groups.english: That's never gonna happen with Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 以前我也那么相信
sense_groups.english: That's what I thought about my first husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我的孩子能跟她爸及新的波霸小姐共度一个周末…
sense_groups.english: Now, I'm lucky if my kid gets to spend the weekend with her father...

sense_groups.chinese: 那算我运气好
sense_groups.english: ...and little Miss New-Boobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 我讨厌跟你这么说…
sense_groups.english: I hate to be the one to say it...

sense_groups.chinese: 但你们两个得靠自己
sense_groups.english: ...but, honey, you two are on your own.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是…你知道的 那是…
sense_groups.english: Well, that's, you know, that's...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们已经单独相处了20分钟 我们表现的很好
sense_groups.english: We've been alone for the last 20 minutes and we're doing okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们不会孤单的
sense_groups.english: You know what? Maybe we won't be alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为最近
sense_groups.english: Because lately things have been happening...

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟罗斯之间有些事发生
sense_groups.english: ...between me and Ross, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来医院前 我们还接了吻 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: And right before I went into labor, we had this kiss. You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许那会是个开始
sense_groups.english: So it might be the beginning of something.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 珍妮丝 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Janice. - Oh, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个小家伙是谁
sense_groups.english: Oh. Who's this little guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 亚朗 那是你未来的岳父 - 不
sense_groups.english: Say hello to Aaron, your future son-in-law. - Oh, no, no. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我让你们一家人好好独处 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna leave you three alone. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你看到那孩子的鼻子了吗
sense_groups.english: Man, you see the kid on that nose?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我刚刚想到什么吗
sense_groups.english: You know what I was thinking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们出门前的那个吻
sense_groups.english: Um, that kiss before we left the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很特别吧
sense_groups.english: That was something, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 真的是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah, it really was.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们…我们得小心点
sense_groups.english: But we, we gotta be careful. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们…你知道的 我们不能让历史重演
sense_groups.english: We...You know, we can't let that happen again, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不希望再发生那种事
sense_groups.english: We don't want to go down that road, do we?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 所以我才会跟你提这件事
sense_groups.english: No. No, of course not. No, that's why I brought it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们没有汽水吗 - 天啊 对不起
sense_groups.english: They didn't have any sodas? - Oh, my God. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忙着跟护士说话 完全忘了
sense_groups.english: I was talking to this nurse. Completely forgot.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在就已经开始了
sense_groups.english: And so it begins.

sense_groups.chinese: 她在里面吗
sense_groups.english: She in there?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 护士正把她放在床上 那就是她
sense_groups.english: Yeah. She's putting her down now. That's her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 快看艾玛 - 我无法决定
sense_groups.english: Look at Emma. - I can't decide who she looks more like.

sense_groups.chinese: 她长得像你或瑞秋
sense_groups.english: You or Rachel?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你在开玩笑吗 她美极了 完全是瑞秋的遗传
sense_groups.english: Oh, what, are you kidding? She's gorgeous. It's all Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 这是我最后一次问你 你们两个为什么不结婚
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. For the last time, why aren't you two together again?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我知道 因为你们没有到那个程度
sense_groups.english: No, I know. Because you're not in that place.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很棒 但事实上你们真的到了
sense_groups.english: Which would be fine, except you totally are.

sense_groups.chinese: 情况很复杂 好吗
sense_groups.english: It's complicated, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 那是真的 你一直都爱着她
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's true. Yeah, you love her, you always have...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们生了一个孩子 没有答案是百分之百的正确
sense_groups.english: ...you have a child together. There's no right answer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们曾经交往过
sense_groups.english: Look, we've been together. Okay, and then apart.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来分手 后合后又分手
sense_groups.english: And then together, and then apart.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们生了一个孩子
sense_groups.english: And now we have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们又复合 结果还是不行…
sense_groups.english: It's just, if we got together again and it didn't work out?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会对艾玛那么做
sense_groups.english: I could never do that to Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 她来到这个世界 想像每件事都…这是我的想法
sense_groups.english: I mean, she came into this world thinking everything... Now me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 他们在水里放东西
sense_groups.english: What, do they put something in the water in this place?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋跟我现在过得很好
sense_groups.english: It's just, Rachel and I, we're doing really well now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know, I know, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想更进一步 就得突破现状
sense_groups.english: If you try to make it more, you might wreck it.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, exactly. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许你可以得到你从15岁开始梦想的世界
sense_groups.english: Or you might get everything you've wanted since you were 15.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到一个女人同时在喂双胞胎母乳
sense_groups.english: I just saw a woman breastfeeding both of her twins at the same time.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很像怪物秀
sense_groups.english: It is like a freak show up here.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 - 没事
sense_groups.english: What's the matter? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 嘿
sense_groups.english: What is it? Hey?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的没事 我… - 瑞秋 别这样 什么
sense_groups.english: Really, it's nothing. I'm... - Rach, come on. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想 我跟宝宝要怎么独自活下去
sense_groups.english: I've just been thinking about how my baby and I are gonna be all alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么 罗斯呢
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about: "alone"? What about Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 他会有自己的家庭 双胞胎跟新波霸小姐
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. He'll be with his real family. The twins and little Miss New-Boobs.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我看那个女人多久了
sense_groups.english: Okay, how long was I watching that woman?

sense_groups.chinese: 我那么说…
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying that, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为有一天 罗斯会认识别人…
sense_groups.english: ...someday Ross is gonna meet somebody...

sense_groups.chinese: 他会去过自己的生活
sense_groups.english: ...and he's gonna have his own life.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧
sense_groups.english: Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你说的对
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I guess so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有想过 我要自己抚养这个宝宝
sense_groups.english: I just never thought I'd be raising this baby all by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的很傻吧
sense_groups.english: Pretty dumb, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得听我说 听着
sense_groups.english: Hey, you listen to me. Listen to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你永远都不会是一个人
sense_groups.english: You are never, ever gonna be alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我发誓我不会让那种事发生
sense_groups.english: Okay? I promise I won't let that happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 喔 甜心 没有你我该怎么办
sense_groups.english: Oh, Joey. Oh, sweetie, what would I do without you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不必担心 好吗
sense_groups.english: You don't have to worry about that, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你能再帮我 拿盒面纸来吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, could you grab me my other box of tissues?

sense_groups.chinese: 就在罗斯的外套下面
sense_groups.english: They're right on that chair under Ross' coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的是太神奇了 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That was amazing. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我们很可能已经永远地改变了我们的生活吗
sense_groups.english: Hey, do you realize that we may have just changed our lives forever?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可能已经开始组成了我们的家庭
sense_groups.english: We may have started our family.

sense_groups.chinese: 九个月后我们可能会来这里…
sense_groups.english: Nine months from now, we could be here...

sense_groups.chinese: 生下我们的孩子
sense_groups.english: ...having our own baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是没办法的话 我们得把宝宝生在桶子里
sense_groups.english: And if not, we got to do it on a bucket.

Joey?
Oh, my God.
Okay.
So...
...I guess we should make it official, huh?
Look, Rach, I...
Hey, Ross is here! Hey, look, it's my good friend Ross!
Hey, Ross. - Hey, Joey.
Hey, you. - Hey, you.
And he brought flowers! Thanks, Ross. I'm really more of a candy kind of guy.
You're weird today.
Listen, I wanted to talk to you about something.
Yeah. Actually, I kind of need to talk to you too.
Joey, could you give us a minute? - No.
What? - I'm sorry. I meant, "No."
Hi. Hey, look who's here.
Where's my granddaughter? I've been practicing my magic tricks.
He pulled a quarter out of my ear.
Hey, where's Mom? - She went to pick up Aunt Liddy.
Aunt Liddy's coming? That means we get $5 each!
So when do I get to meet Emma and show her this
Okay, wow.
Emma's in the nursery. I'll take you now if you want.
But I really want to talk to you. - I know. I still need to talk to you.
But before you guys do that, I need to talk to you.
And Ross, I need to talk to you.
And I need to talk to you. - About what?
To see if you know what these guys are talking about.
Isn't she beautiful?
Look at her, my first grandchild.
What about Ben?
Well, of course, Ben. I meant my first granddaughter.
Have you thought any more about you and Rachel?
Yeah, actually I was gonna talk to her when you guys came in the room.
That's so exciting! Wow. You could've done that with us there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的很幸运
