sense_groups.chinese: 好了 试试看这个 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: All right, here's something. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里说试着把婴儿抱起 贴近身体
sense_groups.english: It says to try holding the baby close to your body...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后快速的左右摇
sense_groups.english: ...and then swing her rapidly from side to side.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 太有效了
sense_groups.english: It worked!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只是让她吐了一点奶
sense_groups.english: No. Just stopped to throw up a little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 莫妮卡 我应该怎么办呢？
sense_groups.english: Mon, what am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 已经好几个小时了它就是哭个不停
sense_groups.english: It's been hours, and it won't stop crying.

sense_groups.chinese: 她 瑞秋 不是它 是她 - 是哦 我可不太确定了
sense_groups.english: She, Rach. Not it. She. - Yeah. I'm not so sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天啊 我快疯了 - 是啊 说得没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I'm losing my mind. - Yeah, no kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 这正好证明 跟罗斯做爱绝对没有好事会发生
sense_groups.english: All right, this just proves no good can come from having sex with Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 甘瑟 我要外带几个蓝莓松饼
sense_groups.english: Hey, Gunther. Can I get a couple of blueberry muffins to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 尿布 是吧？- 是的
sense_groups.english: Diapers, huh? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜瑞秋生下你的小孩了
sense_groups.english: So I guess Rachel had your baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你能相信吗？- 不能
sense_groups.english: Yep. Can you believe it? - Nope.

sense_groups.chinese: 首先我就不能相信她竟然会跟你上床
sense_groups.english: I can't even believe she slept with you in the first place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说 像是
sense_groups.english: You mean, like...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你生我的气 但是我们必须谈一谈
sense_groups.english: I know you're pissed at me, but we have to talk about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我们不需要
sense_groups.english: Actually, we don't.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便 但是我要说技术上而言 我并没有做错什么
sense_groups.english: Fine. Okay. But I gotta say, technically, I didn't even do anything wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你并没有做错什么？
sense_groups.english: What? You didn't do anything wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说是技术上而言 - 好的
sense_groups.english: I said I didn't technically. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们暂时不管你"不小心"…
sense_groups.english: Let's put aside the fact that you "accidentally"...

sense_groups.chinese: 捡起我祖母的戒指 然后又"不小心"跟瑞秋求婚
sense_groups.english: ...picked up my grandmother's ring and you "accidentally" proposed to Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以先打断你一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Can I just stop you there for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 当有人做这个动作时…
sense_groups.english: When people do this

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的不知道是什么意思
sense_groups.english: I don't really know what that means.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚说什么？
sense_groups.english: You were saying?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还可以谅解你没有跟瑞秋解释
sense_groups.english: And I could even understand that you couldn't tell Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是为什么你没有告诉我呢？你有一整天可以说 你却没有
sense_groups.english: But why couldn't you tell me? You had all day to, and you didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我应该说"我很抱歉"
sense_groups.english: I know. I should've. "I'm sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: 你用错地方了 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Not using it right, Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: "我很抱歉"
sense_groups.english: "I'm sorry."

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了 - 不 别这样
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go. - No, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们必须要放下这件事 - 把袋子给我
sense_groups.english: Ross, we have to get past this. - Give me the bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不知道还能怎样 我已经道歉了 现在…
sense_groups.english: No, I don't know what else to do. I said I'm sorry, now...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你应该对我吼叫 咒骂或是打我
sense_groups.english: Now you should scream at me or curse me or hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会打你的- 你会比较好过 我也会比较好过
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna hit you. - You'll feel better. I'll feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 你想打我 我从你眼中看得出来
sense_groups.english: You know you want to, I can see it in your eyes.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想 - 有一点
sense_groups.english: I don't. - A little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 不想 - 有一点
sense_groups.english: No. - Little bit.

sense_groups.chinese: 不想 - 多一点了
sense_groups.english: No. - A little bit more.

sense_groups.chinese: 把那个袋子给我 把袋子给我 - 不 打我 打我
sense_groups.english: Give me the bag. Give me the bag. - No, hit me. Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我袋子 给我袋子 - 打我
sense_groups.english: Give me the bag. I'm not kidding. - Hit me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 - 打我 打我 打我
sense_groups.english: No. - Hit me. Hit me. Hit me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你闪开了 - 我很抱歉 这是反射动作
sense_groups.english: You ducked! - I'm sorry! It was a reflex!

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天啊 真的好痛 - 我不得不闪哪
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! This really hurts! - I couldn't help it.

sense_groups.chinese: 当有拳头要打上你的脸 你会闪啊 瞧
sense_groups.english: When a fist comes at your face, you duck. Look.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么搞的？
sense_groups.english: What is the matter with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该要闪的 为什么没闪呢？
sense_groups.english: You were supposed to duck! Why didn't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们去医院的路上再谈
sense_groups.english: Let's talk on the way to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是啊 或许当我们过去的时候他们可以检查一下你的反射神经
sense_groups.english: Good. Yeah, maybe while we're there, they can check your reflexes.

sense_groups.chinese: 再喂她看看 - 我已经喂过了
sense_groups.english: Try feeding her again. - I already fed her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 所以我说"再"
sense_groups.english: I know. That's why I said, "Again! "

sense_groups.chinese: 你们 我们不可以窝里反 好吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys, we can't turn on each other, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 这正是她想要的
sense_groups.english: That's just what she wants.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以到外面谈谈吗？- 待在这里
sense_groups.english: Can I talk to you outside? - Just stay here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去检查她的尿布 菲比 你要不要一起来呢？
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna check her diaper. Pheebs, you want to come?

sense_groups.chinese: 这事与我也有关
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of part of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 这是夫妻两人之间的事
sense_groups.english: Actually, it's a husband-and-wife kind of thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道 我应该嫁给钱德的
sense_groups.english: I knew I should've married Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 怎么回事呢？- 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay, what's up? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们曾经讨论过 如果能搬到巴黎住一年一定会很棒
sense_groups.english: You know we said it would be fun to move to Paris for a year?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以学习法式烹饪 我可以写作…
sense_groups.english: And you could study French cooking, and I could write...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以在塞纳河畔野餐 去波尔多品酒
sense_groups.english: ...and we could picnic along the Seine, and go wine-tasting in Bordeaux.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道有些人说土尔沙…
sense_groups.english: You know how people say that Tulsa...

sense_groups.chinese: 就像是奥克拉荷马州的巴黎吗？
sense_groups.english: ...is the Paris of Oklahoma?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？是谁说的？
sense_groups.english: What? Who says that?

sense_groups.chinese: 那些从没去过巴黎的人说的
sense_groups.english: People who have never been to Paris?

sense_groups.chinese: 到底是怎么回事？- 我们要搬去土尔沙了
sense_groups.english: Well, what's going on? - We're moving to Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？- 好吧
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老板的上司 麦肯纳小姐
sense_groups.english: Ms. McKenna, she kind of works above my boss.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要我搬到土尔沙去当那边分公司的总经理
sense_groups.english: She asked me to move to Tulsa and be president of our office there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我当时正在打磕睡 然后显然我是答应她了
sense_groups.english: And I was sleeping and apparently said yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 奥克拉荷马州的土尔沙？- 早到者之州
sense_groups.english: Tulsa, Oklahoma? - The Sooner State.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管那是什么东东
sense_groups.english: Whatever that is.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我连歌舞剧《奥克拉荷马》都不想看
sense_groups.english: Chandler, I don't even want to see the musical Oklahoma.

sense_groups.chinese: "喔 美妙的早晨""坐在马车上头"(奥剧内容)
sense_groups.english: "Oh, What a Beautiful Morning, " "Surrey With the Fringe on Top"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在说我们要搬去奥克拉荷马 还是说你是同性恋？
sense_groups.english: Are you trying to tell me we're moving to Oklahoma or that you're gay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这些都没关系 但至少他们有帮你加薪吧？
sense_groups.english: All right, not that this matters, but did they at least offer you a huge raise?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但是他们会帮我们租一台福特小车
sense_groups.english: No. But they are going to lease us a Ford Focus.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会试着脱身 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I'll get out of it. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛是怎么了？- 她误会了
sense_groups.english: What is wrong with Emma? - She misunderstood.

sense_groups.chinese: 她以为是她要搬到土尔沙
sense_groups.english: She thought she was moving to Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 请问您现在有空吗？
sense_groups.english: Ma'am, do you have a minute?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有些坏消息 我想我不能去土尔沙了
sense_groups.english: I kind of have some bad news. I don't think I can move to Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？- 事实上这是件很好笑的事
sense_groups.english: What? - It's a funny story, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在今天早上的会议上睡着了
sense_groups.english: I kind of fell asleep in the meeting this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以当我说我可以搬到土尔沙时 我根本不知道我在说什么
sense_groups.english: So when I said I'd move to Tulsa, I didn't really know what I was saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 你睡着了？
sense_groups.english: You fell asleep?

sense_groups.chinese: 但那是因为我整晚为会议担心而失眠
sense_groups.english: But only because I was up all night worried about this meeting.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是很好笑呢？
sense_groups.english: Isn't that funny?

sense_groups.chinese: 很讽刺 不好笑？好吧
sense_groups.english: Irony. Not a fan? All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 事情是这样的
sense_groups.english: See, here's the thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我回家告诉我老婆土尔沙的事 但是她不想去
sense_groups.english: I went home and told my wife about Tulsa, and she won't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 至于我 我爱死土尔沙了 土尔沙是天堂 土尔沙是意大利
sense_groups.english: See me, I love Tulsa. Tulsa is heaven. Tulsa is Italy.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 别逼我搬去那里
sense_groups.english: Please don't make me go there.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德
sense_groups.english: Chandler... I...

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 凯萝 我可以叫你凯萝吗？
sense_groups.english: No, look, Carol. Can I call you Carol?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不应该 因为你的名字是依莲
sense_groups.english: Why would I when your name is Elaine?

sense_groups.chinese: 你儿子拍得真棒 雄壮威武
sense_groups.english: What a great picture of your son. Strapping.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是你女儿的照片 对吧？
sense_groups.english: That's a picture of your daughter, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 她真是甜美 我喜欢有坚毅下巴的女孩
sense_groups.english: Well, she's lovely. I like a girl with a strong jaw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会从土尔沙打电话给你的
sense_groups.english: I'll call you from Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 怎样呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey. So how is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的拇指断了 - 你的拇指？
sense_groups.english: I broke my thumb. - Your thumb?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是奇怪 你确定你出拳的方式是正确的吗？
sense_groups.english: That's weird. Are you sure you're punching right?

sense_groups.chinese: 握拳
sense_groups.english: Make a fist.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许等一下好了
sense_groups.english: Maybe later.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我觉得很糟糕
sense_groups.english: Ross, I feel terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以走了 我只要填一些表格就可以了
sense_groups.english: You know what, you can go. I just have to fill out some forms.

sense_groups.chinese: 需要我帮忙吗？
sense_groups.english: You want me to help you with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？我看起来像是没办法使用我的畸形爪子吗？
sense_groups.english: Why, does it look like I'm having trouble with my misshapen claw?

sense_groups.chinese: 姓名？
sense_groups.english: Name?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道罗斯 但是那是什么的简称呢？
sense_groups.english: No, I know Ross. But what's it short for?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 像是罗素
sense_groups.english: You know, like Rossell.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是罗斯多福
sense_groups.english: Or Rosstrophor.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是罗斯
sense_groups.english: Just Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 好名字
sense_groups.english: It's pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 生日呢？- 你知道我生日的
sense_groups.english: Okay, date of birth? - You know my birthday.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 五…九月？
sense_groups.english: May... tember?

sense_groups.chinese: 十月十八日 - 职业？恐龙
sense_groups.english: October 18. - Occupation? Dinosaurs.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我是古生物… 恐龙也可以啦
sense_groups.english: Actually, I'm a paleon... Dinosaurs is fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 图画的并不是
sense_groups.english: The drawing is not.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 紧急联络人是谁呢？
sense_groups.english: All right, who do you want as your emergency contact?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我想应该是吧 - 好的 关系呢？
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I guess. - Okay. Relationship?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这可能要花上一点时间
sense_groups.english: Boy, this could take a while.

sense_groups.chinese: 写室友 - 少来了
sense_groups.english: Just put roommate. - Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们比室友还更进一步 你们要在一起了 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys are more than that. You're gonna get together, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认为我们有要在一起
sense_groups.english: I don't think that we are.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你们应该要在一起的
sense_groups.english: But you two are supposed to be together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也这样想过 但是她却答应要嫁给你
sense_groups.english: Well, I thought so too. But then she said she'd marry you.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 罗斯 那根本没有什么
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross, that didn't mean anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 她才刚生产完 吓坏了 要独自扛起一切
sense_groups.english: She'd just had the baby. She was freaked out about doing it alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 任何人求婚 她都会答应的 - 是啊 她也是这样说
sense_groups.english: She would have said yes to anybody. - Yeah, that's what she said.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？- 所以我不想要当任何人
sense_groups.english: So? - So I don't want to be just anybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow. - You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正这样也比较好
sense_groups.english: It's better this way anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道我在想什么 再回到之前的关系
sense_groups.english: I don't know what I was thinking, going down that road again with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们纯粹做朋友 只是有个小孩 那事情就会简单多了
sense_groups.english: It's just much easier if we're just friends who have a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？- 是啊
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样没关系吗？- 是啊 这本来就是我们的计划
sense_groups.english: And you're okay with that? - Yes. That's what we always planned.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你有计划 你就应该照计划执行
sense_groups.english: And if you have a plan, you should stick to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是计划的意义 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: That's why they call them plans. Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事的
sense_groups.english: I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 关于瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Hey, for what it's won'th...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不认为你会只是"任何人"而己
sense_groups.english: ...with Rachel, I don't think you'll ever be just "anybody."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你做对了
sense_groups.english: Hey, there you go.

sense_groups.chinese: "谢谢"
sense_groups.english: "Thanks."

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊 她哭多久了？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. How long has she been crying?

sense_groups.chinese: 大约一个星期半
sense_groups.english: About a week and a half.

sense_groups.chinese: 看起来你们都已经处理好了 所以我先回去了
sense_groups.english: Well, it looks like you guys got it under control, so I'm just gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好吗？真的？需要有人和你共享悲惨命运吗？
sense_groups.english: No? Really? Misery really does love company?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 试着用另一种方式抱她 - 我已经尽力而为了
sense_groups.english: Try holding her a different way. - Look, I'm doing the best I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 任何人都欢迎来试试看 - 好吧 我来试试看
sense_groups.english: Anyone else is welcome to try. - All right, I'll try. Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 好的 好的 - 抱去吧
sense_groups.english: Yes. Okay. Okay. - Here you go.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 喔 天啊
sense_groups.english: Hey. Oh, gosh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这小孩什么都不好使
sense_groups.english: Nothing works with this child!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我该怎么办呢？我根本照顾不了我自己的孩子
sense_groups.english: God, what am I gonna do, you guys? I can't even comfort my own baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是史上最糟的母亲 - 不 你只不过是不熟悉罢了
sense_groups.english: I'm the worst mother ever. - No, you're just new at this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会克服的 想想你第一天上班的时候
sense_groups.english: You'll get better. Think about your first day at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 那也不是很简单的事 但你也摆平了啊
sense_groups.english: That couldn't have been easy, but you figured that out.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我不认为现在穿得辣一点会管用
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I don't think dressing provocatively is going to help me here!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 请帮我抱一下 - 好 我来抱 来吧
sense_groups.english: God, just please take her. - Okay, I'll take her. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 天啊 我要去上一下厕所
sense_groups.english: Oh, boy, I have to go to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去枕头堆里吼一吼
sense_groups.english: I have to go scream into a pillow.

sense_groups.chinese: 活泼 活泼的宝贝 活泼的宝贝
sense_groups.english: Bouncy. Bouncy baby. Bouncy baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 宝贝 宝贝 哦 宝贝 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, baby, baby. Oh, baby, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 宝贝 宝贝 宝贝
sense_groups.english: Oh, baby, baby, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我聋了吗？
sense_groups.english: Have I gone deaf?

sense_groups.chinese: 有效了 哦 宝贝 宝贝 宝贝 哦 宝贝 宝贝 宝贝
sense_groups.english: It worked. Oh, baby, baby, baby. Oh, baby, baby, baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在床上一定像个火球
sense_groups.english: You must be a fireball in bed!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 她睡着了 我让她睡着了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. She's asleep. I got her to go to sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的有神奇的魔力
sense_groups.english: I have actual magical powers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以听到汽车跟鸟叫声
sense_groups.english: I can hear traffic and birds.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又再度听到我脑海中的声音了
sense_groups.english: I can hear the voices in my head again.

sense_groups.chinese: 开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: I'm kidding.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天 你让她不再哭了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! You got her to stop crying!

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我办到了 我是超级莫妮卡姑姑
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did. I'm Monica, super aunt.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是正式的婴儿止哭专家 - 是啊 我正是
sense_groups.english: You are the official baby-crier stopper. - Yes, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 你永远都不能离开这间公寓了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You're never leaving the apartment. - Say what?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是你的新工作 日夜兼顾 只要她一哭 你就得在这里
sense_groups.english: That's your new job, day or night. She starts crying, I need you here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 - 很庆幸 你一点都不需要我
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. - Thankfully, you don't need me at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 嘿 超级姑姑下次见咯
sense_groups.english: So okay. Hey, super aunt? See you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我们试试看六到八个月
sense_groups.english: Rachel? Let's give it six to eight months.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 听着 我要去睡一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, so listen, I'm gonna go lay down.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 书上说只要她一睡我也应该要睡
sense_groups.english: The book says whenever she's sleeping, I should be sleeping.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们才刚让她睡着 - 所以现在不能大声吼叫咯
sense_groups.english: We just got her to go to sleep. - So there can't be any yelling?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要搬去土尔沙了 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: We're moving to Tulsa. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我听不到
sense_groups.english: I can't... I can't hear.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 你去哪了？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. Where have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 发生什么事了？- 我跟乔伊打了起来
sense_groups.english: What happened to you? - I had a little thing with Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你认为这很糟糕 你应该看看乔伊
sense_groups.english: If you think this is bad, you should see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 罗斯 这真的很糟
sense_groups.english: No, Ross, this is not good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们必须谈谈这件事 请坐下
sense_groups.english: We have to talk about this Joey thing. Please sit.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你必须放下乔伊这件事
sense_groups.english: All right, you have got to get over this Joey thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？我从未真的想要嫁给乔伊 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay? I never really wanted to marry Joey, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我真的很想 很想要什么吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what I really, really want?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What, Rach?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要睡觉
sense_groups.english: I wanna sleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要吃东西 我想要洗澡
sense_groups.english: I wanna eat. I wanna take a shower.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 她醒来以后我们又有得忙了
sense_groups.english: I mean, before she wakes up, and we gotta do this all over again.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 因为我必须告诉你
sense_groups.english: Right. - I mean, because I got news for you, mister.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛 一点都不好带
sense_groups.english: Emma: Not easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那正是我在这里的用意
sense_groups.english: Well, that's what I'm here for.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我去吗？- 不 真的没关系
sense_groups.english: You want me to get that? - No, that's really okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 莫妮卡？- 来了 来了 来了
sense_groups.english: Monica? - Got it, got it, got it, got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直在想 而且我要告诉你 这不是我的错
sense_groups.english: I've been thinking about this. And I gotta tell you, it's not my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是自然的本能 - 你们在说什么？
sense_groups.english: It's a natural instinct. - What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果我这样你会怎么做？
sense_groups.english: Okay, what would you do if I did this?

questions.name: S09E03
questions.en:
So, what's the big news you had us rush all the way over here for?
Our news. My company has asked me to head up our office in Tulsa.
So as of Monday, I'm being officially relocated.
Oh, my God! - What? Monday?
How long do you have to go for? - They said it could be up to a year.
A year? - Well, do you have to go?
Well, I kind of have to, don't I?
Because of this stupid thing.
There's nothing like the support of your loving wife, huh?
Wait a minute. Wait, you can't go to Tulsa.
Maybe you forgot, but we have tickets to the Jets game next week!
I'm sorry, but I don't think I'll be able to make it.
But we were gonna go see the Jets!
You can't go. I mean, you're the glue that holds this group together.
Really? - Not you.
I can't believe you guys are moving.
I call their apartment! - No!
Here you go, Rach. - Thank you, Joey.
You know what? I'm not even sure I can have caffeine.
I went through this with Ben and Carol. One coffee won't affect your milk.
Just to be sure, I'm gonna call Dr. Wiener.
Every time?
You don't have to call him whenever you have a question, okay?
Trust me. I know this. - All right. I trust you.
I can see you dialing. I don't understand why...
I'm on the phone! Dr. Wiener?
It's so weird seeing Ross and Rachel with a baby. It's just so grownup.
I know, yeah. I feel like we're all growing up.
A person named "Wiener." God, that kills me.
Look at you all grownup. - Well, actually, you know what?
I am, you know?
Well, that whole thing with Rachel made me realize...
...that maybe I'm ready for a more serious relationship, you know?
Like, I'd like to meet a nice, mature, commitment-minded lady.
And looks aren't as important as...
Nah, she's gotta be hot.
You know, I might know somebody.
How about you set me up with someone, and we double-date?
I can do that. Yeah. How's Friday?
Done! - All right.
Good, really? Okay, let's see.
All right.
You know who's great? Sandy Poopack.
"Poopack"?
Yeah. All right. Well, that rules out Lana Titwyler.
I've got good news. - You got out of the whole Tulsa thing?
Okay, I have news.
You don't have to move to Tulsa. You can stay here and keep your job.
That's great! How?
My boss and I worked out a deal where I'm in Tulsa four days a week.
So the other three, I can be here with you.
So you're gonna be gone four days a week?
No.
I'm sorry, are you just used to saying that?
No. I can't be away from you for that long.
Really? - Yeah, you're my husband.
I won't live in a different state than you for 208 days out of the year.
That's fast math. We could use you in Tulsa.
Thanks for trying to figure out a way, but if you go to Tulsa, I go with you.
You said that without gagging.
I know!
Well, excuse me?
Oh, yeah? Well, up yours too!
Who the hell was that? - Dr. Wiener.
Rach, you can't call people at 3:00 in the morning.
You know what? You sound just like his wife.
Was there anything even wrong with Emma?
Yes, of course there is! Okay? I'm not insane.
What was it?
Hiccups.
I told you, you can't call him every time any little thing comes up.
Well, not anymore I can't. He fired us!
What are we gonna do? We have to find a pediatrician.
Wait, Monica said that when you guys were growing up...
...you liked your doctor. What was his name?
Dr. Gettleman?
Yeah, no, I don't think that's a good idea.
In fact, I think he's dead.
Why does everything happen to me?
I promise, first thing tomorrow, we'll find another doctor.
But I gotta get up early, and I'm not feeling well.
You're not feeling well? What do you have? Rubella?
Because don't go near Emma, she has not had that shot.
You know, come to think of it, it does feel rubella-like.
Wiener!
Wiener! Wiener! Wiener!
Rachel!
Great! Now he's gonna know it was me!
So how is this for our big double date tonight?
Oh, my God.
Great. Just the reaction I was hoping for.
Yeah, so you found someone for me? You didn't forget?
Of course not. And you'll love Mary Ellen.
She's really smart and cute and funny and...
I can't tell you how I know this, but she is not opposed to threesomes.
All right.
So tell me something about my guy. - No.
Come on, give me something. What's his name?
Mike. - Mike. Okay, what's his last name?
Damn it! Is there no mystery left in romance anymore? !
We'll see you and Mike at the restaurant in a couple hours.
All right, great. See you. Bye-bye.
Why'd I have to say Mike? I don't know a Mike! Why couldn't I have said...?
There's no guys in there!
It's impossible to find a good doctor. How do you know the good ones...
...from the ones who'll push their penis against your knee?
Excuse me?
I know what she's talking about.
Well, we've gotta find a new pediatrician.
Ross was getting sick last night, and Emma may have caught it.
Why don't you see Dr. Gettleman? - Ross said he died.
He didn't die. I just saw his daughter last week.
She said he was fine. Her, on the other hand, botched Botox.
Great. Well then, I'm gonna take Emma to see him.
I wonder why Ross said that he died?
Maybe he confused him with his childhood therapist.
He saw a therapist?
He used to have a recurring nightmare. It freaked him out.
Wow, what was it?
That I was going to eat him.
Mike!
Yeah?
Okay.
I can't believe I'm doing this with you.
Although I did just end a nine-year relationship...
...so I should be open to taking some risks.
Everything is gonna be fine. Follow my lead, okay?
All you have to do is pretend to be Mike.
I am Mike. - Attaboy.
Here they come.
I'm Phoebe. - Phoebe. Mike. How you doing?
Nice to meet you. - Joey, this is Mary Ellen Jenkins.
So, Mike, how do you and Joey know each other, anyway?
How do Joey and I know each other?
If I had a nickel for every time somebody's asked me that.
From school. - We met in college.
I mean high school.
You guys go way back, then. So, what are you up to these days?
Well, I'm a lawyer. - Mike, attorney at law!
Actually, I just gave up my practice. - What?
That's the kind of thing you usually run by me.
I want to play piano professionally. If I don't do this now, I never will.
Great. I like that better than the lawyer thing.
Which is why I waited until now to introduce you to Mike.
You thought he was still a lawyer.
No, that's not what I meant. Let's get you a cocktail.
What are you doing?
Looking for restaurant jobs for you in Tulsa.
That's so sweet. Did you find anything?
Slim Pickins. - Nothing, huh?
No. Slim Pickins. It's a barbecue joint.
They're looking for a cook. Actually, "cook" may be a bit of a stretch.
They're looking for somebody to shovel mesquite.
"Slim Pickins"? That is so cheesy.
Well, So Cheesy also has an opening.
Honey, that's okay. I know this woman, Nancy...
...who's a restaurant biz headhunter. She may know something.
Can I say how much I appreciate you coming with me?
When we get to Tulsa, I am taking you for a great dinner at Slim Pickins.
So Cheesy?
Whole Hog?
It's gonna be tough to keep kosher in Tulsa.
Hi, Nancy? Hi, it's Monica Geller.
I'm good. Listen, I'm looking for a job in Tulsa.
Yeah, well, my husband's been relocated.
Because I love him.
No, I don't want a job in New York.
Javu's looking? Oh, my God!
He asked for me personally? Oh, my God!
Wow, this is really, really flattering.
But I'm moving to Tulsa.
So, just, if you would tell Javu...
...l'll take it!
My name's Rachel Greene. I have an appointment for Emma.
Dr. Gettleman is finishing up with a patient. He'll be out shortly.
Okay, thank you
I think you just have a cold. It's definitely not strep.
Thanks, doctor.
Would you like a lollipop? - Do you even have to ask?
He is alive!
It's so surprising that you and Joey have known each other for so long...
...and I've never heard about you.
That's because we had a bit of a falling out.
Mike hit my mom with a car.
No, I didn't. - That's okay. I have forgiven you.
Now we're friends again, and everything's great.
Well, wait. Is your mom okay?
Please, we're trying to have a conversation.
You're a lot nicer on Days of Our Lives.
Days of Our Lives! That's why you look so familiar!
What? - What?
What?
Do you not know each other?
Of course we do. He's playing a game we used to play in high school.
We pretend we don't know each other. We played all kinds of games.
You remember that one where I punch you in the face for not being cool?
Let me ask you something: How many sisters does Joey have?
Six.
What are you doing? I said seven!
Joey, why did you set me up with a stranger?
Because I forgot about our date. I'm so sorry.
I'm sorry too. And just to be clear, I didn't hit his mother with a car.
You are unbelievable. I spent so much time finding the perfect girl for you.
Mary Ellen is really smart and cute and loose.
Who are you kidding?
You find some guy off the street for me?
God, this is humiliating!
I'm so sorry. If you don't like this guy, I can find you a better one.
Mike? Mike?
I'm out of here.
It was nice meeting you.
You're leaving too? - I'll stay if you can tell me my name.
Have a good night.
We leave tomorrow, and you still have a lot to pack.
You're right.
Maybe I shouldn't go.
What?
So Nancy told me about this job at this great restaurant, Javu?
But it's just a little outside of Tulsa.
Well, how far outside?
Manattan?
And you're thinking of taking it?
Before, you said that being with me was more important than any job.
But I guess now it's old job, me, new job.
I'm gonna miss this hand!
I know this is a lot to ask...
...but, my God, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.
What happened to "you can't live without me four days a week"?
Well, if you really think about it, I mean, four days is not that long.
I see you Monday before you go to work...
...and Thursday when you get back...
...and I always work late on Tuesdays, so really if you think about it...
...it's really just one day.
And well, if we can't make it one day, we got real problems, my friend.
I think you should take the job. - Really?
I know it must be important to you when you start chattering like a monkey.
That's the nicest thing anybody's ever said to me.
How was the pediatrician? - I really liked him.
Yeah, yeah. It was really, really, really good.
You promised not to say anything. - I know.
Ross still sees his pediatrician!
I don't care.
Are you serious? You still see Dr. Gettleman?
He is a brilliant diagnostician!
Diagnostician or boo-boo fixer?
Seriously, you gotta go to an appropriate doctor.
Why? I know it's a little weird, but he is a great doctor, okay?
He knows my medical history.
And every time I go in there, he makes a big deal.
You know, "Look, it's my favorite patient."
Does he say that before he sticks his thermometer in your tushy?
I seem to remember someone bringing his security blanket to college.
That was not a security blanket. That was a wall hanging.
It didn't spend much time on the wall!
Excuse me.
Hi. I was hoping to run into you. Can we talk?
Sure.
Look, I'm sorry, really. I'm so embarrassed.
Really, I'm a pretty nice guy. Just ask my parole officer.
Apparently, I'm not a funny guy.
Well, why did you go along with that?
Because I was told that I'd get a free dinner, which I didn't.
And that I'd meet a pretty girl, which I did.
That's true.
Well, is anything you told me about yourself true?
My name is Mike. And I do play piano.
Prove it. - There isn't a piano here.
That wouldn't stand in the way of a true pianist.
Okay.
You are really good.
I play a little guitar myself. - Really? That's great.
What kind of music do you play? - Like acoustic, folksy stuff, you know?
But right now I'm working on a couple Iron Maiden covers.
Do you think that, maybe, sometime, I could...
It's okay. Go ahead, ask me out.
Okay. You think, maybe, sometime I could take you out?
You just caught me off guard.
Yeah, that would be nice.
Look at this! My two best friends!
Excuse me. I don't mean to be a jerk...
...but the baby with the rash came in after me.
The doctor will be right with you, sir. - I hear you...
Mommy, I can't find Waldo.
What, the circus? He's behind the elephant.
Wow. So your child's a big fan of the Waldo books too?
Yeah, that's how I know.
I'm Ross, by the way. - Hi, I'm Sally.
So no ring. Can I assume you're also a single parent?
I am a single parent. - It's hard, isn't it?
There's no time for a social life. Where are you gonna meet someone?
Let's say, I don't know, you met someone in the pediatriciars office.
Rossie? We're ready for you.
Yeah...
Come on, Ross Jr. It's time to go in.
Mommy.
Mommy, what's wrong with that man?
Hey, I helped you find Waldo!
Good, you haven't left yet. - Where have you been?
I got held up at Dr. Gettlemars office.
There was some guy that freaked everybody out.
You got here just in time. I really have to go, buddy.
Oh, man.
Promise to call me when you land? - Of course I will. I love you.
I love you too.
Watch the tongue, people. We got a baby over here.
Bye, Chandler. - Bye.
Bye, honey. - Bye.
What's the matter, Joe? - I'm mad at you for leaving.
You know, you're nothing but a big leaver.
A big leaver with a stupid suitcase.
Any chance you're trying to pick a fight to make all of this easier?
Dude, you see right through me!
Okay, well... Bye, Mon.
Bye, Ross. Rachel.
Bye, Emma. - Okay, bye-bye.
Have a good trip. Okay. Oh, my God.
Wait.
It goes old job...
...new job...
...and you.
This is just something I have to do.
I know.
I love you so much.
I know that too.
Don't worry. I'll be back before you know it.
Yes, it will be the same.
Because I know, that's how.
I promise.
You double promise?
Call me when you land.
Can I talk now? - Okay, bye.
Joey! - He had to board.

没问题 - 好的

你知道谁不错吗？珊蒂普霸
"普霸"？

谢谢你试着想出更好的方式 但是如果你要去土尔沙 我会跟你去
你这样说的时候竟然没有做呕吐状

当然是有怎样 好吗？我又不是疯了

How was the pediatrician? - I really liked him.
Yeah, yeah. It was really, really, really good.
You promised not to say anything. - I know.
Ross still sees his pediatrician!
I don't care.
Are you serious? You still see Dr. Gettleman?
He is a brilliant diagnostician!
Diagnostician or boo-boo fixer?
Seriously, you gotta go to an appropriate doctor.
Why? I know it's a little weird, but he is a great doctor, okay?
He knows my medical history.
And every time I go in there, he makes a big deal.
You know, "Look, it's my favorite patient."
Does he say that before he sticks his thermometer in your tushy?
I seem to remember someone bringing his security blanket to college.
That was not a security blanket. That was a wall hanging.
It didn't spend much time on the wall!
Excuse me.
Hi. I was hoping to run into you. Can we talk?
Sure.
Look, I'm sorry, really. I'm so embarrassed.
Really, I'm a pretty nice guy. Just ask my parole officer.
Apparently, I'm not a funny guy.
Well, why did you go along with that?
Because I was told that I'd get a free dinner, which I didn't.
And that I'd meet a pretty girl, which I did.
That's true.
Well, is anything you told me about yourself true?
My name is Mike. And I do play piano.
Prove it. - There isn't a piano here.
That wouldn't stand in the way of a true pianist.
Okay.
You are really good.
I play a little guitar myself. - Really? That's great.
What kind of music do you play? - Like acoustic, folksy stuff, you know?
But right now I'm working on a couple Iron Maiden covers.
Do you think that, maybe, sometime, I could...
It's okay. Go ahead, ask me out.
Okay. You think, maybe, sometime I could take you out?
You just caught me off guard.
Yeah, that would be nice.
Look at this! My two best friends!
Excuse me. I don't mean to be a jerk...
...but the baby with the rash came in after me.
The doctor will be right with you, sir. - I hear you...
Mommy, I can't find Waldo.
What, the circus? He's behind the elephant.
Wow. So your child's a big fan of the Waldo books too?
Yeah, that's how I know.
I'm Ross, by the way. - Hi, I'm Sally.
So no ring. Can I assume you're also a single parent?
I am a single parent. - It's hard, isn't it?
There's no time for a social life. Where are you gonna meet someone?
Let's say, I don't know, you met someone in the pediatriciars office.
Rossie? We're ready for you.
Yeah...
Come on, Ross Jr. It's time to go in.
Mommy.
Mommy, what's wrong with that man?
Hey, I helped you find Waldo!
Good, you haven't left yet. - Where have you been?
I got held up at Dr. Gettlemars office.
There was some guy that freaked everybody out.
You got here just in time. I really have to go, buddy.
Oh, man.
Promise to call me when you land? - Of course I will. I love you.
I love you too.
Watch the tongue, people. We got a baby over here.
Bye, Chandler. - Bye.
Bye, honey. - Bye.
What's the matter, Joe? - I'm mad at you for leaving.
You know, you're nothing but a big leaver.
A big leaver with a stupid suitcase.
Any chance you're trying to pick a fight to make all of this easier?
Dude, you see right through me!
Okay, well... Bye, Mon.
Bye, Ross. Rachel.
Bye, Emma. - Okay, bye-bye.
Have a good trip. Okay. Oh, my God.
Wait.
It goes old job...
...new job...
...and you.
This is just something I have to do.
I know.
I love you so much.
I know that too.
Don't worry. I'll be back before you know it.
Yes, it will be the same.
Because I know, that's how.
I promise.
You double promise?
Call me when you land.
Can I talk now? - Okay, bye.
Joey! - He had to board.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么天惊地动的大消息 要我们马上赶过来？
sense_groups.english: So, what's the big news you had us rush all the way over here for?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要宣布的消息就是公司要我去土尔沙带领新的分公司
sense_groups.english: Our news. My company has asked me to head up our office in Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以从星期一开始 我已经正式被调职了
sense_groups.english: So as of Monday, I'm being officially relocated.

sense_groups.chinese: 猩 我的天 - 什么？星期一？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - What? Monday?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得要去多久呢？- 他们说有可能会长达一年
sense_groups.english: How long do you have to go for? - They said it could be up to a year.

sense_groups.chinese: 一年？- 那你也要去吗？
sense_groups.english: A year? - Well, do you have to go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我似乎是没有选择 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, I kind of have to, don't I?

sense_groups.chinese: 都是因为这个愚蠢的东西
sense_groups.english: Because of this stupid thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 再也没有比爱妻的支持更棒的东西了
sense_groups.english: There's nothing like the support of your loving wife, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你不能去土尔沙
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute. Wait, you can't go to Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许你忘了 但是下星期我们要去看球赛的
sense_groups.english: Maybe you forgot, but we have tickets to the Jets game next week!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 但是我想我可能去不了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, but I don't think I'll be able to make it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们是要去看球赛耶
sense_groups.english: But we were gonna go see the Jets!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能离开我们 你就像是维系这个圈子的灵魂人物
sense_groups.english: You can't go. I mean, you're the glue that holds this group together.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？- 不是你
sense_groups.english: Really? - Not you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不敢相信你们要搬走了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you guys are moving.

sense_groups.chinese: 我承接他们的公寓 - 不行
sense_groups.english: I call their apartment! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 咖啡来了 瑞秋 - 谢谢你 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Here you go, Rach. - Thank you, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我不确定可不可以喝有咖啡因的东西
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm not even sure I can have caffeine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我养育班还有凯萝的经验告诉我一杯咖啡不会影响你的母乳的
sense_groups.english: I went through this with Ben and Carol. One coffee won't affect your milk.

sense_groups.chinese: 为了安全起见我要打电话给维纳医师
sense_groups.english: Just to be sure, I'm gonna call Dr. Wiener.

sense_groups.chinese: 这么哼洇吗？
sense_groups.english: Every time?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有必要每次有问题都打电话给他 好吗？
sense_groups.english: You don't have to call him whenever you have a question, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我 我是有经验的 - 好吧 我相信你
sense_groups.english: Trust me. I know this. - All right. I trust you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看到你在拨电话 我不了解为什么…
sense_groups.english: I can see you dialing. I don't understand why...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在讲电话 维纳医师吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm on the phone! Dr. Wiener?

sense_groups.chinese: 看到罗斯跟瑞秋有了小孩 真是奇怪 好像大人
sense_groups.english: It's so weird seeing Ross and Rachel with a baby. It's just so grownup.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 是啊觉得好像我们都一起长大了
sense_groups.english: I know, yeah. I feel like we're all growing up.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人的名字叫"维纳(香肠)"真是笑死我了
sense_groups.english: A person named "Wiener." God, that kills me.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧你就像个大人 - 事实上 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Look at you all grownup. - Well, actually, you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的确是长大了 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I am, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 跟瑞秋发生的那件事让我意识到…
sense_groups.english: Well, that whole thing with Rachel made me realize...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我已经准备好要接受更认真的交往了
sense_groups.english: ...that maybe I'm ready for a more serious relationship, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要找一个…善良 成熟 稳重的女孩子
sense_groups.english: Like, I'd like to meet a nice, mature, commitment-minded lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 外表并不是非常…
sense_groups.english: And looks aren't as important as...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 她一定要很辣才行
sense_groups.english: Nah, she's gotta be hot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也许认识这样的人
sense_groups.english: You know, I might know somebody.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要你帮我找个对象 然后我们一起两对约会
sense_groups.english: How about you set me up with someone, and we double-date?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以啊 星期五怎样呢？
sense_groups.english: I can do that. Yeah. How's Friday?

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Done! - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 真的？好 我们来看看
sense_groups.english: Good, really? Okay, let's see.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道谁不错吗？珊蒂普霸
sense_groups.english: You know who's great? Sandy Poopack.

sense_groups.chinese: "普霸"？
sense_groups.english: "Poopack"?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 没关系 那莱娜缓婉乐可能也不行了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. All right. Well, that rules out Lana Titwyler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有好消息 - 你不用去土尔沙了吗？
sense_groups.english: I've got good news. - You got out of the whole Tulsa thing?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我有新消息
sense_groups.english: Okay, I have news.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用跟我一起搬到土尔沙 你可以待在这里 保有工作
sense_groups.english: You don't have to move to Tulsa. You can stay here and keep your job.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 是怎么回事呢？
sense_groups.english: That's great! How?

sense_groups.chinese: 老板跟我达成一个协议 我一星期在土尔沙待4天就可以了
sense_groups.english: My boss and I worked out a deal where I'm in Tulsa four days a week.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以另外二天我可以跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: So the other three, I can be here with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以一星期有四天你不在？
sense_groups.english: So you're gonna be gone four days a week?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 你是不是太习惯说不行了呢？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, are you just used to saying that?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我不能跟你分开那么久的
sense_groups.english: No. I can't be away from you for that long.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？- 是啊 你是我先生
sense_groups.english: Really? - Yeah, you're my husband.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要一年两百零八天跟你住在不同州
sense_groups.english: I won't live in a different state than you for 208 days out of the year.

sense_groups.chinese: 算的真快 我们土尔沙的分公司可以聘请你的
sense_groups.english: That's fast math. We could use you in Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你试着想出更好的方式 但是如果你要去土尔沙 我会跟你去
sense_groups.english: Thanks for trying to figure out a way, but if you go to Tulsa, I go with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样说的时候竟然没有做呕吐状
sense_groups.english: You said that without gagging.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的耶
sense_groups.english: I know!

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦？那你也去吃屎吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Well, up yours too!

sense_groups.chinese: 那到底是谁啊？- 维纳医师
sense_groups.english: Who the hell was that? - Dr. Wiener.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你不能在凌晨三点打电话给人家的
sense_groups.english: Rach, you can't call people at 3:00 in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？你听起来就像他老婆一样
sense_groups.english: You know what? You sound just like his wife.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛有怎样吗？
sense_groups.english: Was there anything even wrong with Emma?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然是有怎样 好吗？我又不是疯了
sense_groups.english: Yes, of course there is! Okay? I'm not insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 是怎样？
sense_groups.english: What was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 打隔
sense_groups.english: Hiccups.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉过你了 不能每次有鸡毛蒜皮小事都打电话给他
sense_groups.english: I told you, you can't call him every time any little thing comes up.

sense_groups.chinese: 看来我是真的不能了 他不接我们了
sense_groups.english: Well, not anymore I can't. He fired us!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该怎么办呢？我们得再另找一个小儿科医师了
sense_groups.english: What are we gonna do? We have to find a pediatrician.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 莫妮卡说你们小时候
sense_groups.english: Wait, Monica said that when you guys were growing up...

sense_groups.chinese: 很喜欢你们的医师 他叫什么名字呢？
sense_groups.english: ...you liked your doctor. What was his name?

sense_groups.chinese: 葛曼医师吗？
sense_groups.english: Dr. Gettleman?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我认为这不是个好主意
sense_groups.english: Yeah, no, I don't think that's a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我想他死了
sense_groups.english: In fact, I think he's dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么坏事都发生在我身上？
sense_groups.english: Why does everything happen to me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证 明天第一件事就是找到一个新的医生
sense_groups.english: I promise, first thing tomorrow, we'll find another doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我要很早起床 而且我现在觉得不是很舒服
sense_groups.english: But I gotta get up early, and I'm not feeling well.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不舒服？是怎么回事呢？德国麻疹吗？
sense_groups.english: You're not feeling well? What do you have? Rubella?

sense_groups.chinese: 别靠近艾玛 她还没有注射预防针
sense_groups.english: Because don't go near Emma, she has not had that shot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我仔细想想 感觉真像是德国麻疹
sense_groups.english: You know, come to think of it, it does feel rubella-like.

sense_groups.chinese: 维纳
sense_groups.english: Wiener!

sense_groups.chinese: 维纳 维纳 维纳
sense_groups.english: Wiener! Wiener! Wiener!

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Rachel!

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 现在他就知道那是我了
sense_groups.english: Great! Now he's gonna know it was me!

sense_groups.chinese: 看我为今晚我们两对约会打扮如何？
sense_groups.english: So how is this for our big double date tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 这正是我要的反应
sense_groups.english: Great. Just the reaction I was hoping for.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你有帮我找到人吗？你没有忘记吧？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, so you found someone for me? You didn't forget?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然没有 你会爱死玛莉艾伦的
sense_groups.english: Of course not. And you'll love Mary Ellen.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真的很聪明 可爱风趣 而且
sense_groups.english: She's really smart and cute and funny and...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能告诉你我是怎么知道的 但是她并不反对三人行
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how I know this, but she is not opposed to threesomes.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 说一点我的约会对象吧 - 不行
sense_groups.english: So tell me something about my guy. - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 透露一点嘛 他叫什么名字？
sense_groups.english: Come on, give me something. What's his name?

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克 - 麦克 好的 他姓什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Mike. - Mike. Okay, what's his last name?

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶 就不能为浪漫而保有神秘感吗？
sense_groups.english: Damn it! Is there no mystery left in romance anymore? !

sense_groups.chinese: 几个小时之后在餐厅与你跟麦克见
sense_groups.english: We'll see you and Mike at the restaurant in a couple hours.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 没问题 待会见 拜拜
sense_groups.english: All right, great. See you. Bye-bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要说麦克呢？根本不认识谁叫麦克的 为什么不说…？
sense_groups.english: Why'd I have to say Mike? I don't know a Mike! Why couldn't I have said...?

sense_groups.chinese: 这里面根本就没有男生
sense_groups.english: There's no guys in there!

sense_groups.chinese: 要找好医生真是好难 要如何分辨哪个是好医生
sense_groups.english: It's impossible to find a good doctor. How do you know the good ones...

sense_groups.chinese: 哪个又会倪洹弟弟摩擦你的膝盖呢？
sense_groups.english: ...from the ones who'll push their penis against your knee?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道她的意思
sense_groups.english: I know what she's talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要找新的小儿科医生
sense_groups.english: Well, we've gotta find a new pediatrician.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯昨晚不舒服 艾玛或许也被感染到了
sense_groups.english: Ross was getting sick last night, and Emma may have caught it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不去找葛曼医生呢？- 罗斯说他死了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you see Dr. Gettleman? - Ross said he died.

sense_groups.chinese: 他没死我 上星期才遇到他女儿
sense_groups.english: He didn't die. I just saw his daughter last week.

sense_groups.chinese: 她说他很好 但是她呢可被肉毒杆菌搞惨了
sense_groups.english: She said he was fine. Her, on the other hand, botched Botox.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 那我要带艾玛去找他
sense_groups.english: Great. Well then, I'm gonna take Emma to see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么罗斯说他死了呢？
sense_groups.english: I wonder why Ross said that he died?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他把他跟他小时候的心理医生搞混了
sense_groups.english: Maybe he confused him with his childhood therapist.

sense_groups.chinese: 他有心理医生？
sense_groups.english: He saw a therapist?

sense_groups.chinese: 他以前常常做重复的噩梦 吓死他了
sense_groups.english: He used to have a recurring nightmare. It freaked him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 什么噩梦呢？
sense_groups.english: Wow, what was it?

sense_groups.chinese: 梦到我要吃掉他
sense_groups.english: That I was going to eat him.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克
sense_groups.english: Mike!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信 我竟然跟你做这件事
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm doing this with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我才刚结束一段九年的恋情…
sense_groups.english: Although I did just end a nine-year relationship...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我应该敞开心胸迎接一些挑战
sense_groups.english: ...so I should be open to taking some risks.

sense_groups.chinese: 一切安啦 跟着我就没事 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Everything is gonna be fine. Follow my lead, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你只要假装是麦克就可以了
sense_groups.english: All you have to do is pretend to be Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是麦克啊 - 演的真不错
sense_groups.english: I am Mike. - Attaboy.

sense_groups.chinese: 她们来了
sense_groups.english: Here they come.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菲比 - 菲比 这位是麦克 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm Phoebe. - Phoebe. Mike. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你 - 乔伊 这位是玛莉艾伦珍金
sense_groups.english: Nice to meet you. - Joey, this is Mary Ellen Jenkins.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克 你跟乔伊是怎么认识的呢？
sense_groups.english: So, Mike, how do you and Joey know each other, anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟乔伊是怎么认识的呢？
sense_groups.english: How do Joey and I know each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果每次有人间我这问题 我就有五块钱赚 那我就变富翁了
sense_groups.english: If I had a nickel for every time somebody's asked me that.

sense_groups.chinese: 在学校认识的 - 我们在大学认识的
sense_groups.english: From school. - We met in college.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说高中
sense_groups.english: I mean high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你们认识可久了 那你现在是做什么的呢？
sense_groups.english: You guys go way back, then. So, what are you up to these days?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是律师 - 麦克 律师
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm a lawyer. - Mike, attorney at law!

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我才刚放弃执业 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Actually, I just gave up my practice. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 这种事你应该先跟我讨论的
sense_groups.english: That's the kind of thing you usually run by me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要成为专业钢琴音乐家 如果现在不赶快做 就来不及了
sense_groups.english: I want to play piano professionally. If I don't do this now, I never will.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我喜欢音乐家胜过律师
sense_groups.english: Great. I like that better than the lawyer thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是为什么我等到现在才介绍麦克给你
sense_groups.english: Which is why I waited until now to introduce you to Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是还以为他是律师吗？
sense_groups.english: You thought he was still a lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我并没有那样说 我们帮你点杯鸡尾酒吧
sense_groups.english: No, that's not what I meant. Let's get you a cocktail.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 帮你在土尔沙找餐厅的工作
sense_groups.english: Looking for restaurant jobs for you in Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是窝心 有找到吗？
sense_groups.english: That's so sweet. Did you find anything?

sense_groups.chinese: 速食外餐 - 什么都没有 是吧？
sense_groups.english: Slim Pickins. - Nothing, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 速食外餐 是家烤肉店
sense_groups.english: No. Slim Pickins. It's a barbecue joint.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在找厨师 事实上并不全然是"厨师"
sense_groups.english: They're looking for a cook. Actually, "cook" may be a bit of a stretch.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们在找炒豆子的帮手
sense_groups.english: They're looking for somebody to shovel mesquite.

sense_groups.chinese: "速食外餐"？听起来真是不高级
sense_groups.english: "Slim Pickins"? That is so cheesy.

sense_groups.chinese: "布高吉"也有在征人
sense_groups.english: Well, So Cheesy also has an opening.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 没关系 我认识一个叫南西的人
sense_groups.english: Honey, that's okay. I know this woman, Nancy...

sense_groups.chinese: 她是专门帮餐厅猖人头的 她或许会知道一些职缺
sense_groups.english: ...who's a restaurant biz headhunter. She may know something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的是太感激你愿意跟我去
sense_groups.english: Can I say how much I appreciate you coming with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 当我们抵达土尔沙我会带你去速食外餐吃大餐的
sense_groups.english: When we get to Tulsa, I am taking you for a great dinner at Slim Pickins.

sense_groups.chinese: 那布高吉呢？
sense_groups.english: So Cheesy?

sense_groups.chinese: 全猪餐厅呢？
sense_groups.english: Whole Hog?

sense_groups.chinese: 在土尔沙要找到正式餐厅还真是不简单
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be tough to keep kosher in Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 南西吗？嗨 我是莫妮卡盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hi, Nancy? Hi, it's Monica Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好 我需要在土尔沙找份工作
sense_groups.english: I'm good. Listen, I'm looking for a job in Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 因为我先生被调职到那边
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, my husband's been relocated.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我爱他
sense_groups.english: Because I love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我不想要纽约的工作
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want a job in New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 杰屋在找人？哦 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Javu's looking? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 他特别指名要我？哦 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: He asked for me personally? Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我真的是太受宠若惊了
sense_groups.english: Wow, this is really, really flattering.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我要搬到土尔沙了
sense_groups.english: But I'm moving to Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 请你告诉杰屋…
sense_groups.english: So, just, if you would tell Javu...

sense_groups.chinese: 我接受这份工作
sense_groups.english: ...l'll take it!

sense_groups.chinese: 我是瑞秋葛林 我有帮艾玛预约看诊
sense_groups.english: My name's Rachel Greene. I have an appointment for Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 葛曼医生快看完病人了 他等一下就会出来
sense_groups.english: Dr. Gettleman is finishing up with a patient. He'll be out shortly.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Okay, thank you

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你只是感冒了 没有什么严重性
sense_groups.english: I think you just have a cold. It's definitely not strep.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 医生
sense_groups.english: Thanks, doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要来根棒棒糖呢？- 还用问吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you like a lollipop? - Do you even have to ask?

sense_groups.chinese: 他还活着
sense_groups.english: He is alive!

sense_groups.chinese: 好奇怪 你跟乔伊认识这么久了
sense_groups.english: It's so surprising that you and Joey have known each other for so long...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我却从没有听说过你
sense_groups.english: ...and I've never heard about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们有吵过架
sense_groups.english: That's because we had a bit of a falling out.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克开车撞到我妈
sense_groups.english: Mike hit my mom with a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没 我没有 - 没关系 我已经原谅你了
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't. - That's okay. I have forgiven you.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们又是朋友了 一切都很美好
sense_groups.english: Now we're friends again, and everything's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 你妈还好吧？
sense_groups.english: Well, wait. Is your mom okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我们在讲话耶
sense_groups.english: Please, we're trying to have a conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在《我们的日子》中亲切多了
sense_groups.english: You're a lot nicer on Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 《我们的日子》 怪不得你看起来有点眼熟
sense_groups.english: Days of Our Lives! That's why you look so familiar!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？- 什么？
sense_groups.english: What? - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们彼此不认识吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you not know each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们当然认识 他是在玩我们高中常玩的游戏
sense_groups.english: Of course we do. He's playing a game we used to play in high school.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们假装不认识 我们玩很多种游戏的
sense_groups.english: We pretend we don't know each other. We played all kinds of games.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得有一次你因为太蠢而被我揍吗？
sense_groups.english: You remember that one where I punch you in the face for not being cool?

sense_groups.chinese: 让我问你一个问题 乔伊有几个姐妹呢？
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you something: How many sisters does Joey have?

sense_groups.chinese: 六个
sense_groups.english: Six.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在搞什么鬼？我比了七个
sense_groups.english: What are you doing? I said seven!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 为什么你要介绍陌生人给我呢？
sense_groups.english: Joey, why did you set me up with a stranger?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我忘记了 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Because I forgot about our date. I'm so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很抱歉 还有要澄清一下 我没有开车撞他妈
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry too. And just to be clear, I didn't hit his mother with a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是太不应该了 我花这么多时间帮你找完美的对象
sense_groups.english: You are unbelievable. I spent so much time finding the perfect girl for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 玛莉艾伦真的很聪明很可爱又很随便
sense_groups.english: Mary Ellen is really smart and cute and loose.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你别装了吧？
sense_groups.english: Who are you kidding?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在街上随便捉个男的塞给我？
sense_groups.english: You find some guy off the street for me?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 这真是太羞辱人了
sense_groups.english: God, this is humiliating!

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 如果你不喜欢这一个我可以帮你找更好的
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. If you don't like this guy, I can find you a better one.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克？麦克？
sense_groups.english: Mike? Mike?

sense_groups.chinese: 我要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: It was nice meeting you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也要走？- 你说的出我的名字 我就留下
sense_groups.english: You're leaving too? - I'll stay if you can tell me my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Have a good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明天就要走了 而你还有好多东西要打包
sense_groups.english: We leave tomorrow, and you still have a lot to pack.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说得对
sense_groups.english: You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我不应该去
sense_groups.english: Maybe I shouldn't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 南西告诉我有一个很棒的餐厅在征人 杰屋？
sense_groups.english: So Nancy told me about this job at this great restaurant, Javu?

sense_groups.chinese: 离土尔沙不会太远
sense_groups.english: But it's just a little outside of Tulsa.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是多远呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, how far outside?

sense_groups.chinese: 曼哈顿远吗？
sense_groups.english: Manattan?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要接受这份工作吗？
sense_groups.english: And you're thinking of taking it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你之前说跟我在一起比任何工作都重要
sense_groups.english: Before, you said that being with me was more important than any job.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我猜 现在是旧工作 我 新工作
sense_groups.english: But I guess now it's old job, me, new job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会想念这只手的
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna miss this hand!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这很过份…
sense_groups.english: I know this is a lot to ask...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 天啊 这是千载难逢的好机会
sense_groups.english: ...but, my God, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你说无法忍受每星期4天要分开 是怎么回事呢？
sense_groups.english: What happened to "you can't live without me four days a week"?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你仔细想想4天并不是很长的时间
sense_groups.english: Well, if you really think about it, I mean, four days is not that long.

sense_groups.chinese: 星期一你去上班前我会见到你…
sense_groups.english: I see you Monday before you go to work...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后星期四晚上我也会见到你…
sense_groups.english: ...and Thursday when you get back...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我总是在星期二忙得很晚 所以如果你仔细想想…
sense_groups.english: ...and I always work late on Tuesdays, so really if you think about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上只有分开一天而己
sense_groups.english: ...it's really just one day.

sense_groups.chinese: 而如果我们连一天都撑不住 我们真的是有大问题了
sense_groups.english: And well, if we can't make it one day, we got real problems, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为你应该接受这份工作 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: I think you should take the job. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你开始像猴子一样鬼吼时 我就知道这对你一定很重要
sense_groups.english: I know it must be important to you when you start chattering like a monkey.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我听过最美好的形容了
sense_groups.english: That's the nicest thing anybody's ever said to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 新医生怎样呢？- 我真的很喜欢他
sense_groups.english: How was the pediatrician? - I really liked him.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 是啊 真的 真的 真的很不错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, yeah. It was really, really, really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应我不会说出去的 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: You promised not to say anything. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯还在看他小时候的医生
sense_groups.english: Ross still sees his pediatrician!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎
sense_groups.english: I don't care.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？你还在看葛曼医师
sense_groups.english: Are you serious? You still see Dr. Gettleman?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是医术高明的诊断师
sense_groups.english: He is a brilliant diagnostician!

sense_groups.chinese: 诊断师还是医生叔叔呢？
sense_groups.english: Diagnostician or boo-boo fixer?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 你应该去看适合你的医生才对
sense_groups.english: Seriously, you gotta go to an appropriate doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？我知道这是有点怪 但是他是个很棒的医生 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Why? I know it's a little weird, but he is a great doctor, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他知道我的病史
sense_groups.english: He knows my medical history.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且每次我去看病他都非常的慎重其事
sense_groups.english: And every time I go in there, he makes a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的"瞧 这是我最喜欢的病人"
sense_groups.english: You know, "Look, it's my favorite patient."

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是在把体温计插到你嘴里之前说的呢？
sense_groups.english: Does he say that before he sticks his thermometer in your tushy?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还记得有人把他的安全毛毯带到大学宿舍
sense_groups.english: I seem to remember someone bringing his security blanket to college.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是安全毛毯 那是壁毯
sense_groups.english: That was not a security blanket. That was a wall hanging.

sense_groups.chinese: 它倒是没有被挂在墙上太久
sense_groups.english: It didn't spend much time on the wall!

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我原本就希望可以再遇到你 我们可以谈谈吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi. I was hoping to run into you. Can we talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很抱歉 我实在太不好意思了
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry, really. I'm so embarrassed.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我是个还不错的人 你可以问我的保释官
sense_groups.english: Really, I'm a pretty nice guy. Just ask my parole officer.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 我并不是很风趣
sense_groups.english: Apparently, I'm not a funny guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么要这样做呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, why did you go along with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他说 我可以吃一顿免费的晚餐 不过并没有
sense_groups.english: Because I was told that I'd get a free dinner, which I didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有他说 我可以认识漂亮的女生 这倒是有
sense_groups.english: And that I'd meet a pretty girl, which I did.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒是真的
sense_groups.english: That's true.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你告诉我的事有哪些是真的呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, is anything you told me about yourself true?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的名字真的是麦克 还有我真的会弹钢琴
sense_groups.english: My name is Mike. And I do play piano.

sense_groups.chinese: 证明给我看 - 这里并没有钢琴
sense_groups.english: Prove it. - There isn't a piano here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那对真正的钢琴家不会是问题吧
sense_groups.english: That wouldn't stand in the way of a true pianist.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很棒
sense_groups.english: You are really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会弹一点吉他 - 真的？太棒了
sense_groups.english: I play a little guitar myself. - Really? That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你弹奏什么种音乐呢？- 像是重原音 有民俗风味的
sense_groups.english: What kind of music do you play? - Like acoustic, folksy stuff, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我现在在制作伍佰的CD封面
sense_groups.english: But right now I'm working on a couple Iron Maiden covers.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许 有空的话 我可以…
sense_groups.english: Do you think that, maybe, sometime, I could...

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系的 来吧 约我吧
sense_groups.english: It's okay. Go ahead, ask me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你想 或许有空的话我可以约你出去吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. You think, maybe, sometime I could take you out?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是让我一点心理准备都没有
sense_groups.english: You just caught me off guard.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 我很乐意
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that would be nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧 我两个最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: Look at this! My two best friends!

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 我不想要太八婆…
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. I don't mean to be a jerk...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是那个长疹子的婴儿是在我后面进来的
sense_groups.english: ...but the baby with the rash came in after me.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生等一下就可以看你了 先生 - 我知道…
sense_groups.english: The doctor will be right with you, sir. - I hear you...

sense_groups.chinese: 妈咪 我找不到华多
sense_groups.english: Mommy, I can't find Waldo.

sense_groups.chinese: 游乐场吗？他在大象后面
sense_groups.english: What, the circus? He's behind the elephant.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你的孩子一定也很迷华多
sense_groups.english: Wow. So your child's a big fan of the Waldo books too?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 所以我也很熟
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's how I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我叫罗斯 - 嗨 我叫莎莉
sense_groups.english: I'm Ross, by the way. - Hi, I'm Sally.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有戒指 所以我想你也是单亲？
sense_groups.english: So no ring. Can I assume you're also a single parent?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是单亲没错 - 很难 对吧？
sense_groups.english: I am a single parent. - It's hard, isn't it?

sense_groups.chinese: 根本没有可以社交的时间 要去哪里认识朋友呢？
sense_groups.english: There's no time for a social life. Where are you gonna meet someone?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 可以在小儿科医生那里认识人吧
sense_groups.english: Let's say, I don't know, you met someone in the pediatriciars office.

sense_groups.chinese: 小罗斯？轮到你了
sense_groups.english: Rossie? We're ready for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊…
sense_groups.english: Yeah...

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 小罗斯 轮到我们了
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross Jr. It's time to go in.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈咪
sense_groups.english: Mommy.

sense_groups.chinese: 妈咪 那个人是怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Mommy, what's wrong with that man?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 是我帮你找到华多的耶
sense_groups.english: Hey, I helped you find Waldo!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你还没走 - 你去哪了？
sense_groups.english: Good, you haven't left yet. - Where have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 有事情在葛曼医师那耽搁了一下
sense_groups.english: I got held up at Dr. Gettlemars office.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个人吓坏了所有的人
sense_groups.english: There was some guy that freaked everybody out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你正好赶上 我得要走了 兄弟
sense_groups.english: You got here just in time. I really have to go, buddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 真是的
sense_groups.english: Oh, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 答应我一下飞机就打电话 - 当然 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Promise to call me when you land? - Of course I will. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要舌吻 你们 儿童不宜
sense_groups.english: Watch the tongue, people. We got a baby over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 钱德 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, Chandler. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 亲爱的 - 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye, honey. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 乔伊？- 我很生气你要走
sense_groups.english: What's the matter, Joe? - I'm mad at you for leaving.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？你什么都不会就最会抛弃人家
sense_groups.english: You know, you're nothing but a big leaver.

sense_groups.chinese: 带着笨行李的负心汉
sense_groups.english: A big leaver with a stupid suitcase.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是故意说一些气话让自己好过点呢？
sense_groups.english: Any chance you're trying to pick a fight to make all of this easier?

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你真是太了解我了
sense_groups.english: Dude, you see right through me!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 那么…再见了 莫妮卡
sense_groups.english: Okay, well... Bye, Mon.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 罗斯 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Bye, Ross. Rachel.

questions.en:
Hey, Ross.
I'm so glad someone's here. Could you zip me up?
Sure. - Thank you.
Can you believe no one between my apartment and here...
...offered to do that for me?
People.
So why are you so dressed up?
Mike's picking me up for a date.
How's that going? Is it getting serious?
I don't know. I don't know. I mean, I like him.
But am I ready to take my Grade A loins off the meat market?
I'm not quite sure.
You know, I really admire your whole dating attitude.
It's so healthy. I'm always like, "Is this moving too fast?
Is this moving too slow? Where's this going? "
I know. You are a bit of a drama queen.
You're so much better off. You just go from guy to guy having fun...
...and not worrying that it never turns into anything serious.
I wouldn't say "never."
You know, there is that guy.
Okay, well, what about...?
Okay, there's gotta be someone.
There isn't! That's what I'm saying. - Oh, my God, you're right!
I know. And yet, here you are, all ready for the next date.
I can't believe I never realized this before.
I'm in my 30s, and I've never been in a long-term relationship.
Oh, my God, what's wrong with me?
There's nothing wrong with you.
I mean, you don't strike me as the type of person that wants to get married.
I want to get married!
No, please... Please don't cry because of me.
I don't know what I'm talking about, okay? I've been divorced three times.
At least you've been married.
Oh, my God! I want to trade lives with Ross? !
Phoebe.
What's wrong? - Nothing. I'm excited about our date.
Mike, this is Ross Geller. Ross, this is Mike...
Sorry, I didn't catch that. - Mike Hanigan.
Ross Geller. - Hey.
So are you sure you're ready to go?
How do I look?
Do you have a compact in your purse? - No.
You look great.
Hey, Joey. - This girl won't turn around.
I can't tell if she's hot or not. What do you think?
Joey, I am not going to objectify women with you.
But if her face is as nice as her ass...
Mama! - All right. Thanks.
Have you talked to Chandler? - He has to stay in Tulsa this weekend.
How come? - I don't know. He has to work.
There's some big rush on the...
Damn it. I'm gonna have to start listening when he talks about his job.
Why don't you fly out there and surprise him?
Maybe I will go.
We'll have a little second honeymoon at the Tulsa Ramada.
You should bring your black see-through teddy with the attached garters.
How do you know I have one of those? - Didrt until just now.
Hot. Not hot.
Hot!
Excuse me?
I said that I think you're hot.
And... now I'm embarrassed.
I thought you said "hi."
That would've been better.
I'll try that. Hi, I'm Joey.
I'm Hayley.
Look, I don't normally ask out women that I meet in coffeehouses.
Gesundheit.
But...
I would love to go out with you.
Really? Great.
Did I...? Did I actually ask you?
That's just where you were going. I figured I'd help you out.
You don't seem like the kind of guy who does this a lot?
So how'd the date go? - Well, it was awful.
Every time I thought about what you said, I cried.
So he hasn't called? - Would you call this girl
"Thanks for... a lovely... evening"?
Now I feel terrible. This is all my fault.
You know what you should feel terrible about?
This could have been my serious guy.
He was sweet and smart and funny.
You know how hard it is to meet a guy like that?
We are a rare breed.
What a great dinner.
Thanks again for letting me have that last piece of cake at the restaurant.
You're welcome again. I'm gonna go make some coffee.
Can I get you anything? - Do you have any cake?
So this is going pretty good.
Dinner was nice. We've got a lot in common.
Victoria's Secret.
We even like the same books.
There's a scary painting.
Wait a minute.
I think I've been scared by that painting before.
You know what? This whole place looks familiar.
I have definitely been in this apartment.
I know I've seen this weird plant before.
It did that the last time!
Oh, my God. I've gone out with this girl before.
Yeah! We had sex on this couch!
And then on that chair, and... No.
No, we didn't do it here...
...which is weird, because it seems like a perfectly good place.
That's why.
Hey, Mike. Sorry to just drop by like this. Can I come in?
Sure.
Who are you?
I'm Ross. Phoebe's friend from the coffeehouse?
I really, really need to talk to you about something.
Unless...
You're not gonna try and get me to join a cult, are you?
No, it's just, you know, you have that look.
Damn Supercuts!
Well, what's up? Is Phoebe okay? - Oh, yeah, yeah.
Phoebe is great. But...
I'm an idiot, okay?
Right before you guys went out...
...I accidentally got her all upset.
That's why she was weird.
Yes. Yeah, I...
Yeah, I said something stupid about her never having had a serious relationship.
But you should know, she is so much fun. A wonderful person.
Please, don't blow her off. - I'm not gonna blow her off.
I just spoke to her. We're going out tomorrow night.
I mean, I hope that's okay with you, stranger from the coffeehouse.
Well, then, I didn't need to bother you.
You or the four other Mike Hanigans I bothered.
Wait. Wait. Wait. Wait. Is that true what you said?
Phoebe's never had a serious relationship?
Of course she has.
If she's never had a serious relationship...
...do you think I'd go around broadcasting it...
...like some kind of unstoppable moron?
But you did say it. - Yes. Yes, I did.
And I will also say...
...what I'm about to say...
...vis-? vis...
...the following.
Phoebe has never had a serious relationship...
...since...
...her super-serious relationship...
...with...
...Vikram.
Vikram? - What? That's a real name.
Stop it!
Why couldn't they have sent me to Texas?
Seven o'clock.
Maybe I'll hit the gym.
Who am I kidding? Pay-per-view porn.
Do not disturb! Do not disturb! - Surprise!
Monica? - Is everything all right?
Yeah, everything's great. I was just...
...watching some regular television there.
What a pleasant surprise.
I'm gonna go freshen up, okay? - Okay, honey.
That was close.
Hello. - Hey, Rach, it's me.
Okay, I just got to Chandler's room, and I caught him...

But you know, guys do that.
Well, the weird part is...
...he was getting off... to a shark-attack show!
No! - Yes! Chandler watches shark porn!
While watching sharks? - Yeah.
Are you sure that's what he was doing?
You know how many times I've seen him jump up like that?
Believe me, I know what he was doing.
Man! Sharks!
I always knew there was something weird about that dude.
You promised to love him no matter what.

Not if he gets his jollies to Jaws.

They like things that we can't understand.

...that he was an archeologist, and I was this...
...naughty cavewoman who he unfroze from a block of ice.
Are you talking about my brother?
I didn't disguise that very well, did I?
Hey. - Hi.
I went out with this girl last night. Halfway through our date I realized...
...I already slept with her.
You've slept with all the women in N.Y., and now you're going around again?
That's not even the weird part.
She didn't remember sleeping with me! - You don't remember sleeping with her.
But she should remember sleeping with me. I am very memorable!
You guys know. - How do we know?
We've never slept with you. - And whose fault is that?
What's the big deal? You forgot, she forgot.
Maybe you were having an off night. - Hey!
I never have an off night. Okay?
Although, sometimes if I'm a little bloated, I don't feel that sexy.
But even then, I'm better than most!
Honey, why don't you just let it go and ask her out again?
You're both so slutty, you don't remember who you slept with.
You're made for each other.
Interesting.
Well, I'll go out with her again and I'll try to get past it.
No salt! Bloaty!
Joey? - What?
You don't think sharks are sexy, do you?
No.
Wait a minute. Wait, what was the Little Mermaid?
It's open!
Hey. - Mike called! We're going out again!
Quick thing. I went to talk to Mike.
What?
What did you...? What did you do, Ross?
Oh, boy. You got mad at that part.
I went over there, you know, to tell him how...
How great you are. But...
Well, you know me. Blah-blah-blah.
And I ended up telling him that... - What?
You had a six-year-long relationship...
...with a guy named Vikram.
What? Why?
Well, he seemed...
...to bum hard when I told him you'd never been in a serious relationship.

...I swear to Lucifer...
...a rabid dog would be feasting on your danglers right now!
I think you'll feel differently when you know...
...a little bit about Vikram.
Okay, he's a...
He's a kite designer.
And he used to date Oprah.
I'm not going along with some lie you made up, Ross.
I'm just gonna be honest with him. - Good.
Just be honest with him.
I have nothing to be ashamed of. - No.
So I haven't been in a relationship that lasted longer than a month.
Okay? I haven't had a real boyfriend.

You know, all right. It'll be fine. It'll be fine.

I'll get it. - Okay.
I'm trying to remember the last time I opened a door and you werert there.
Phoebe, are you okay?
Yeah. There's just...
There's something you should know.
Vikram just called.

What?
