I like my job. - I love my job.

but for Christmas...

Thanks.

Did I not mention that? - No.

and you'd rather be with your families, but there is no call for writing

Hey. - Hey. Where you been?

but at least it's gonna smell like ham in here.
My kid's in a play right now.
You know what? I know what will cheer you guys up.
I had a talk with the boys in New York.
I told them about all the hard work you've been doing...
and that a little Christmas bonus may be in order.
"A donation has been made in your name to the New York City Ballet."
Well, that's like money in your pocket.
All right, look, you want me to say it? This sucks.
Being here sucks. This work sucks.
Now it feels like Christmas.
I'm sorry.
Hey, at least you get to go home and be with your families tonight.
I have to back to an empty hotel room and lay down...
on a very questionable bedspread.

Which, by the way, none of you have invited me to.

I'm actually thinking about becoming a motivational speaker.

that I wrote for some very important people to me.

What? That's terrible. - No, no. We do it every year.
Oh, well, that makes it not terrible.
No. Yeah, we never find them. She's always bested us, that wily...
minx.
Don't worry. We're gonna search here for an hour...
and then we're gonna go to Joey's and search. Okay?
No, not okay. You can't look for Monica's presents.
No, we have to. - No, you don't have to.
And you can't, because I live here too.
Well, then you should look with us. - Why?

No, I have a great idea for a present for her.

two medium presents and a bunch of little presents...
and you got her one great present? That's just gonna make her feel bad.

Ooh, ooh, we have a live one. - It's a Macy's bag.
Yeah.
Oh. - Ooh. Who's it for?
"Dear Losers: Do you really think I'd hide presents under the couch?

Wiper blades. I don't even have a car.

You guys.

And last, but not least...

weird turtle-man?

so I borrowed one from a guy at work.

One. - Two.
Three.
Well, I think it's safe to say that our friendship is effectively ruined.
Eh, we weren't that close anyway.
So are you really gonna go out with that nurse-man?
Well, uh, you and I are just goofing around.
I thought, why not just goof around with him?
I don't know if you've ever looked up the term "goofing around" in the dictionary.
Well, I have.
And the technical definition is two friends...
who care a lot about each other and have amazing sex...
and just want to spend more time together.
But if you have this newfangled dictionary that gets you mad at me...
then we have to, you know, get you my original dictionary.
I am so bad at this.
I think you're better than you think you are.
Really? Okay. So if...? - Know when to stop.
You know, I sensed that I should stop.
So we're okay? - Yeah.
Don't do the dance. - Right.
I can't get married without something old, something new...
something borrowed, something blue. - Okay, okay.
Here's something blue and new.
You are so efficient. I love you.
Let's go. - No, no, wait.
We need something old.
Okay. I have a condom in my wallet that I've had since I was 12.
That'll work.
I don't think so.
Okay. Now we just need something borrowed.
Here, just take this. - That's stealing.
We'll bring it back. Just put it under your dress.
Aw.
Okay, one thing at a time.
Listen, um...
I've been thinking.
It's not fair for me to ask you to spend all of your money on our wedding.
I mean, you work... You work really hard for that.
Well... - Well, you work for that.
Look, I've thought about it too. And...
I'm sorry. I think we should spend all of the money on the wedding.
You do? - Yeah. I'm putting my foot down.
Yeah, look, when I proposed...
I told you that I would do anything to make you happy.
And if having the perfect wedding makes you happy, then...
Then that's what we're gonna do.
You are so sweet.
But wait. What about our...? What about the future and stuff?
Ah, forget about the future and stuff. So we only have two kids.
You know, we'll pick our favorite, and that one will get to go to college.
You've thought about that? - Yeah.
How many kids were we gonna have? - Uh, four. A boy, twin girls...
and another boy.
What else did you think about? - Well, heh...
stuff like where we'd live, you know.
Like a small place outside the city where our kids could ride their bikes and stuff.
You know, we could have a cat that had a bell on its collar...
and we could hear it every time it ran through the little kitty door.
Of course we'd have an apartment over the garage where Joey could grow old.
You know what?
I don't... I don't want a big, fancy wedding.
Sure you do. - No.
I want everything that you've just said.
I want a marriage.
You sure? - Mm-hm.
I love you so much. - I love you.
Ah! Oh, I love it. - Really? You're not gonna return it?
Well, not this second.
Hey, look, you guys. It's snowing.
Oh.
Oh, wow, it's so beautiful. - Wow, it really is.
Ah.
Wendy's a fat-girl name.
Aren't we done with that?
Okay, fine. Fine. Let's talk about snow.
Do you think it's snowing in Tulsa...
where my husband's having sex on a copying machine?
Hey. - Oh, my God.
Hey. - Aw.
Hey. Look at that. It's a Christmas miracle.
What are you doing here? - I wanted to be with you.
I missed you so much.
Hey, hey, uh, who'd you miss the most? - Monica.
Gotcha.
I never wanna leave you again. - But I thought if you left, you'd get fired.
Turns out they can't fire me. Because I quit.
What? - What? You...? You really quit your job?
Yeah. It was a stupid job, and I could not stand leaving you.
And why should I be the only one who doesn't get to do...
what he really wants to do?
Well, what do you really wanna do? - I have not thought this through.
Oh, my God. - I know. I should've talked to you first.
No, I think that this is what you wanna do. I think it's great.
Thanks.
Chandler, your being here is the best Christmas present I could ever imagine.
Aw.
Now give me my real gift. - Yeah.
Thank you. - Here, pass those around.
Oh, hey.
"A donation has been made in your name to the New York City Ballet."
How did you know?
What? Are you kidding? I can't return this.
I thought it was time we started thinking about other people.
And besides, this gift still says "I love you guys".
Mine says, "To Lillian Myers." - I don't have a job.
Actuary? No.
Bookkeeper? Hmm, no.
Topless dancer?
Hey, you know what I just realized? You are the sole wage earner.
You are the head of the household. I don't do anything. I'm a kept man.
You are.
Honey, here's 20 bucks.
Go buy yourself something pretty while I'm at work tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 他拉起他的雪橇 他吹起他的口哨
sense_groups.english: He sprang to his sleigh To his team gave a whistle

sense_groups.chinese: 他们奔驰而去 如同蓟草的细毛
sense_groups.english: And away they all flew Like the down of a thistle

sense_groups.chinese: 但我听他喊出 就在他要消失飞去之前
sense_groups.english: But I heard him exclaim Ere he drove out of sight

sense_groups.chinese: "祝大家圣诞快乐 还有大家有个美好的夜晚"
sense_groups.english: "Merry Christmas to all And to all a good night."

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真是太棒了 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Wow. That was great. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是你自己创作的吗？
sense_groups.english: You really wrote that?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了 精灵们 我要去土尔沙了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Say goodbye, elves. I'm off to Tulsa. - Aw.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信圣诞节你竟然会不在这里
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're not gonna be here for Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的不回来吗？
sense_groups.english: You're really not coming back?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有很多报告都要 在年底的时候归档
sense_groups.english: Yeah, we have this paperwork that needs to be filed by the end of the year.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我不去做 我就会被炒鱿鱼 - 真是不公平
sense_groups.english: If I don't get it done, I'll be fired. - It's so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 你根本就不喜欢你的工作 - 那又如何 谁喜欢的？
sense_groups.english: You don't even like your job. - So? Who does?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢我的 - 我爱我的工作
sense_groups.english: I like my job. - I love my job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我等不及要回去上班了 - 我对恐龙就是玩不厌
sense_groups.english: I can't wait to go back to work. - I can't get enough dinosaurs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉没有办法回来
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry I won't be here.

sense_groups.chinese: 平常没有办法见到你已经够难受了…
sense_groups.english: It's just hard enough not seeing you during the week...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是圣诞节…
sense_groups.english: but for Christmas...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果这就是你必须要做的事 我会谅解
sense_groups.english: If this is what you have to do, I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 新年当天见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you New Year's Day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你除夕也不回来吗？
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna be here New Year's Eve?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有提过吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Did I not mention that? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那大家晚安了
sense_groups.english: And to all a good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了大家 我知道今晚是圣诞夜…
sense_groups.english: All right, everybody. I know that it is Christmas Eve...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都想要跟家人在一起 但是也不可以写…
sense_groups.english: and you'd rather be with your families, but there is no call for writing

sense_groups.chinese: "去你的 宾先生" 站在我的椅子后面
sense_groups.english: "Screw you, Mr. Bing" on the back of my chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你们叫我钱德就可以了
sense_groups.english: By the way, you can all call me Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿 你跑哪去了？
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey. Where you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 我去三楼看那间保险公司的圣诞派对
sense_groups.english: I was, uh, checking out that insurance company's Christmas party on three.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的是很美 他们有很多装饰品 还有一颗很大的树
sense_groups.english: It was really beautiful. They have all these decorations and this huge tree.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我就想 去他们的 我们竟然要工作
sense_groups.english: And I just thought, to hell with them, we have to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我偷了他们的火腿
sense_groups.english: So I stole their ham.

sense_groups.chinese: 听到了没？你们或许没有跟家人在一起…
sense_groups.english: You hear that? You may not be with your families...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是至少这里也可以 闻到过节的火腿味
sense_groups.english: but at least it's gonna smell like ham in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的小孩现在正在表演话剧
sense_groups.english: My kid's in a play right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗？我知道要怎么鼓舞你们
sense_groups.english: You know what? I know what will cheer you guys up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟纽约那边的人谈过了
sense_groups.english: I had a talk with the boys in New York.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉他们你们全是如何辛勤工作…
sense_groups.english: I told them about all the hard work you've been doing...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们可能都会 得到一些圣诞奖金
sense_groups.english: and that a little Christmas bonus may be in order.

sense_groups.chinese: "已经以您的名义把一项捐款…捐赠给纽约市立芭蕾舞团"
sense_groups.english: "A donation has been made in your name to the New York City Ballet."

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那其实就像是进了你们的口袋一样啊？
sense_groups.english: Well, that's like money in your pocket.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你们一定要逼我说吗？这实在很烂
sense_groups.english: All right, look, you want me to say it? This sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 在这里真是烂 这份工作真是烂
sense_groups.english: Being here sucks. This work sucks.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在就有点像是圣诞节了
sense_groups.english: Now it feels like Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少今晚你们都还可以 回家跟家人在一起
sense_groups.english: Hey, at least you get to go home and be with your families tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能回去一间空荡荡的旅馆房间 然后躺在…
sense_groups.english: I have to back to an empty hotel room and lay down...

sense_groups.chinese: 一张很有问题题的床单上
sense_groups.english: on a very questionable bedspread.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后明天 你们都可以 在自己家里过节
sense_groups.english: Then tomorrow morning, you get to have Christmas morning in your own houses.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便提一下 你们没有一个邀请我去
sense_groups.english: Which, by the way, none of you have invited me to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以来我家 - 不用了 谢谢
sense_groups.english: You can come to my house. - Ha, ha. No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是精彩的精神讲话 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: It was a nice pep talk. - Oh, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是真的有在想要成为激励演说家
sense_groups.english: I'm actually thinking about becoming a motivational speaker.

sense_groups.chinese: 那如果你现在在家 你会是在做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: So if you were home right now, what would you be doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 一般的圣诞节活动 你知道的 我们过节的方式是很传统的
sense_groups.english: Typical Christmassy stuff, you know. Our holidays are pretty traditional.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一首十分特殊的节庆歌曲…
sense_groups.english: So here's a very special holiday song...

sense_groups.chinese: 是我为一些对我很重要的人写的
sense_groups.english: that I wrote for some very important people to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 去店里坐在圣诞老公公的腿上
sense_groups.english: Went to the store, sat on Santa's lap

sense_groups.chinese: 要他为我的朋友带一对烂东西
sense_groups.english: Asked him to bring my friends All kinds of crap

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只需要为他们写首歌
sense_groups.english: Said all you need Is to write them a song

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还没听过 所以不要试着一起唱
sense_groups.english: They haven't heard it yet So don't try to sing along

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不要一起唱
sense_groups.english: No don't sing along

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 摩妮卡 光明节快乐
sense_groups.english: Monica, Monica Have a happy Hanukkah

sense_groups.chinese: 看到圣诞老公公 他对罗斯打招呼
sense_groups.english: Saw Santa Claus He said hello to Ross

sense_groups.chinese: 请告诉乔伊 圣诞节会下雪
sense_groups.english: And please tell Joey Christmas will be snowy

sense_groups.chinese: 还有瑞秋和钱德
sense_groups.english: And Rachel and Chandler

sense_groups.chinese: 大家圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Happy holidays, everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 去检查厨房 我去看衣橱后面
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, look in the kitchen. I'll look in the back closet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以节省你们的时间 女士们 我就坐在这里
sense_groups.english: I can save you time, ladies. I'm right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你何不出去散一下步
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Chandler, why don't you take a walk?

sense_groups.chinese: 这跟你没有关系
sense_groups.english: This doesn't concern you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在找摩妮卡准备的圣诞礼物
sense_groups.english: We are looking for our Christmas presents from Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？这实在太过分了 - 不 不 我们每年都这样
sense_groups.english: What? That's terrible. - No, no. We do it every year.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 那就样就不过分了
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, that makes it not terrible.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我们从来没有找到过 她总是高明过我们 那个狡猾又…
sense_groups.english: No. Yeah, we never find them. She's always bested us, that wily...

sense_groups.chinese: 邪恶的女人
sense_groups.english: minx.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会在这边找一个小时…
sense_groups.english: Don't worry. We're gonna search here for an hour...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后再过去乔伊家找 好吗？
sense_groups.english: and then we're gonna go to Joey's and search. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不好 你们不可以找摩妮卡的礼物
sense_groups.english: No, not okay. You can't look for Monica's presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们一定要 - 不 你们不需要这样
sense_groups.english: No, we have to. - No, you don't have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不行 因为我也住在这里
sense_groups.english: And you can't, because I live here too.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你应该帮我们找 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Well, then you should look with us. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你难道不烦恼要买什么 圣诞礼物给摩妮卡吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, aren't you worried about what to get Monica for Christmas?

sense_groups.chinese: 不担心 我已想好一个 很棒的礼物要给她
sense_groups.english: No, I have a great idea for a present for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 就这样？"已经想好"？
sense_groups.english: Oh, pfft. That's it? A great idea again?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 那是不够的 万一她送你的是一个很棒的礼物…
sense_groups.english: Chandler, that's not enough. What if she gets you a great present...

sense_groups.chinese: 两个中等的礼物 还有很多的小礼物…
sense_groups.english: two medium presents and a bunch of little presents...

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只送她一个很棒的礼物？那会让她很伤心的
sense_groups.english: and you got her one great present? That's just gonna make her feel bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要那样对待她呢？为什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: Why would you do that to her, Chandler? Why? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我帮忙 我们就可以更快找到 - 没错
sense_groups.english: If I helped, we could find them faster. - That's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔…我找到一个了 - 这是梅西百货的袋子
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh, we have a live one. - It's a Macy's bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 好耶
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 - 这是要给谁的？
sense_groups.english: Oh. - Ooh. Who's it for?

sense_groups.chinese: "亲爱的失败者 你们真的认为 我会将礼物藏在沙发下面吗？
sense_groups.english: "Dear Losers: Do you really think I'd hide presents under the couch?

sense_groups.chinese: 附注 钱德 我就知道 她们可以说服你"
sense_groups.english: P.S. Chandler, I knew they'd break you."

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 这些是给你的
sense_groups.english: Rach, these are for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 雨刷 但是我根本就没有车子
sense_groups.english: Wiper blades. I don't even have a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 是没有 但是加上这个有 新车味道的芳香剂 你会以为你有
sense_groups.english: No, but with this new car smell, you'll think you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 菲比 轮到你了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Pheebs, your turn.

sense_groups.chinese: 马桶座盖纸
sense_groups.english: Ah. Toilet seat covers.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是不是在我加油的时候 你们去弄来的呢？
sense_groups.english: Is that what you were doing while I was getting gas?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们两个
sense_groups.english: You guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有给罗斯 甜食先生
sense_groups.english: And for Ross, Mr. Sweet Tooth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们送我可乐？ - 还有…柠檬口味
sense_groups.english: You got me a cola drink? - And... a lemon-lime.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这… 这礼物真是太大了
sense_groups.english: Wow. Well, this... This is too much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我应该再送你一件毛衣
sense_groups.english: I feel like I should get you another sweater.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后一位…
sense_groups.english: And last, but not least...

sense_groups.chinese: 是罗纹保险套 让你得到绝顶满足
sense_groups.english: They're ribbed, for your pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 班
sense_groups.english: Well, hey, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 要不要节庆抗捺来告诉你 光明节的由来呢？
sense_groups.english: What if the Holiday Armadillo told you all about the Festival of Lights?

sense_groups.chinese: 酷啊
sense_groups.english: Cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 班
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 很多年以前 有一群叫做玛加伯的人…
sense_groups.english: Years and years ago, there were these people called the Maccabees.

sense_groups.chinese: 呵…圣诞快乐
sense_groups.english: Ho, ho, ho! Merry Christmas.

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Santa. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里做什么呢？圣诞老公公？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here, Santa?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我是来看我的老朋友班的
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm here to see my old buddy Ben.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里做什么呢？你这只…
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here...

sense_groups.chinese: 奇怪的乌龟男？
sense_groups.english: weird turtle-man?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是节日犰狳 你的有犹太血统的朋友
sense_groups.english: I'm the Holiday Armadillo, your part-Jewish friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要我过来送些礼物给班的
sense_groups.english: You sent me here to give Ben some presents.

sense_groups.chinese: 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: Remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 班 你何不去打开更多的礼物
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ben, why don't you open some more presents?

sense_groups.chinese: 圣诞老公公 犰狳跟我要去厨房谈谈
sense_groups.english: Santa, the armadillo and I will have a talk in the kitchen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我说了我以为这辈子 都认为不可能说的话
sense_groups.english: There's a sentence I never thought I'd say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你打电话告诉大家 说你找不到圣诞老公公的服装…
sense_groups.english: You called everyone and said you had trouble finding a Santa costume...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我跟公司的同事借了这一套
sense_groups.english: so I borrowed one from a guy at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 但是你必须离开
sense_groups.english: Thank you, but you gotta leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为…
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because...

sense_groups.chinese: 我终于让他对光明节有兴趣了
sense_groups.english: I'm finally getting him excited about Hanukkah.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你破坏了这一切
sense_groups.english: And you're wrecking it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我还没有机会把肚子 像果冻一样摇的晃来见去
sense_groups.english: But I didn't get to shake my belly like a bowl full of jelly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 钱德 但是这对我真的很重要
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, Chandler, but this is really important to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 没关系 我去还这套衣服
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. I'll give the suit back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会知道我要这个呢？

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你知道我刚刚才想通什么吗？你是家里唯一收入来源

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天去上班的时候 你去买一些漂亮的东西

sense_groups.english: Let me just get this straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去生个小孩 他们就派人过来接我的工作？
sense_groups.english: So I go have a baby, and they send some guy in to do my job?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 本来有说 要关闭整家罗夫罗兰的
sense_groups.english: Well, there was talk of shutting down Ralph Lauren altogether.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你真是个不要脸的临时工
sense_groups.english: Okay. Right. You're very cheeky for a temp.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是临时工 我是从别的部门调过来的
sense_groups.english: I'm not a temp. I was transferred here from another department.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么部门？浑蛋部门吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, and what department was that? The, uh, jerk department?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们并没有告诉我 你反应如此之快
sense_groups.english: They didn't tell me about your quick wit.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他们也没有告诉你 我是橡皮擦 你是胶水吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, did they mention that I'm rubber and you're glue?

sense_groups.chinese: 盖文 罗夫很喜欢你的创意 - 嗨 塞纳先生
sense_groups.english: Gavin, Ralph loved your ideas. - Oh, hi, Mr. Zelner.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我想你见过盖文了
sense_groups.english: Ah, Rachel. I see you've met Gavin.

sense_groups.chinese: 你离开的时候 我们都不知道该怎么办
sense_groups.english: When you left us, we weren't sure what we were gonna do.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 盖文拯救了我们 超级盖文
sense_groups.english: But then, Gavin to the rescue. Super Gavin. Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 太好了
sense_groups.english: Well, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 超级盖文 我回来以后…
sense_groups.english: So now, uh, Super Gavin, when I come back...

sense_groups.chinese: 你计划要飞到哪儿去呢？
sense_groups.english: uh, where do you plan on flying off to?

sense_groups.chinese: 全看塞纳先生的意思 我相信他会做出正确的决定
sense_groups.english: That's up to Mr. Zelner. I'm sure he'll make the right decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 超级马屁精
sense_groups.english: Oh, wow. Super ass-kissing power.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你什么时候要回来呢？
sense_groups.english: Incidentally, when, uh, are you coming back?

sense_groups.chinese: 今天
sense_groups.english: Uh, today.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚不是说两星期后？ - 不 我是说今天
sense_groups.english: You said two weeks. - No, I said today.

sense_groups.chinese: 看吧 身为超级英雄 听话能力也不怎么样
sense_groups.english: See, for a superhero, not so much with the listening.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他怎么说？
sense_groups.english: So, what'd he say?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 他有时候有点粗鲁…
sense_groups.english: He can be a little rough around the edges...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要"小狗" 代换掉他常用的一个字眼
sense_groups.english: so I'm gonna replace a word he used a lot with the word "puppy."

sense_groups.chinese: 他说"如果你的小狗朋友 不把小狗的角色演好…
sense_groups.english: Okay? So he said, "If your puppy friend doesn't get her puppy act together...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会小狗的开除她"
sense_groups.english: I am gonna fire her mother-puppy ass."

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我办不到 我不是演员的料
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I can't do this. I'm just not an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你不是演员 你是护士
sense_groups.english: That's right. You're not. You're a nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是拿托盘的护士 - 不 乔伊…
sense_groups.english: You're Nurse With Tray. - Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿托盘的护士不认识乔伊 她没有时间交朋友
sense_groups.english: Nurse With Tray doesn't know Joey. She has no time for friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 她进去手术室把托盘交给医生…
sense_groups.english: She gets in that operating room and she carries that tray to the doctor...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为如果她不这样做 有人会死的
sense_groups.english: because if she doesn't, people die.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁会死？
sense_groups.english: Who dies?

sense_groups.chinese: 戴眼罩的男人！
sense_groups.english: Man With Eye Patch!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你过去做好你的工作
sense_groups.english: Now, you get in there, and you do your job.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 医师 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Yes, doctor. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我们再试一次
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's try this one more time.

sense_groups.chinese: 撑着点 戴眼罩的男人 你的托盘来了
sense_groups.english: Hang in there, Man With Eye Patch. Your tray is coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 开麦拉
sense_groups.english: And, action.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我办到了 我搞定了
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did it! I nailed it!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Whoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 接下来是什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What's next?

sense_groups.chinese: 是后面的剧情
sense_groups.english: The rest of the scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 大家 从头开始
sense_groups.english: Okay, from the top, people.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 计划改变 我的产假要结束了
sense_groups.english: Listen, sudden change of plans. Um, my maternity leave just ended.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说如果我不今天回去工作 他们就要开除我
sense_groups.english: They said if I didn't come back today, they'd fire me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？那样是非法的
sense_groups.english: What? No, that's illegal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要马上通知劳委会 他们不…
sense_groups.english: I'll have the Labor Department here so fast, they won't...

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 冷静点 诺玛 他们并没有真的那样说
sense_groups.english: All right, calm down, Norma Rae. They didn't actually say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是害怕如果不现在回去 那个男的会把我挤掉
sense_groups.english: I'm just afraid if I don't come back now, this guy will try and squeeze me out.

sense_groups.chinese: 那艾玛怎么办？ 我们还没有找到保姆
sense_groups.english: But what about Emma? I mean, we don't have a nanny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我们只好今晚再想办法了
sense_groups.english: I know. We're just gonna have to figure out a plan tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你今天可以先照顾她吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you please just take care of her for today?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 只要你的胸部给我 我们马上就走
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. Just give me your breasts, and we'll be on our way.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我不知道还能怎么办
sense_groups.english: Come on. I don't know what else to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 好啦 - 好
sense_groups.english: Fine. Fine. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开心的 对不对？对 会很开心的 对 我们…
sense_groups.english: We'll have fun, won't we? Yes, we will. Yes, we...

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 - 嗯？
sense_groups.english: Ross. - Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你好漂亮
sense_groups.english: You're pretty.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管我决定要做什么 都得从基层做起
sense_groups.english: Whatever I decide to do, I'm gonna be starting a new career from scratch.

sense_groups.chinese: 要一阵子我才有办法真正赚些钱
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be a while before I make a living at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许现在不是生小孩的好时机
sense_groups.english: Maybe now's not the right time to be starting a family.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你要跟摩妮卡说 你现在不想要生小孩？
sense_groups.english: So you have to tell Monica you don't want to have a baby right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见了
sense_groups.english: Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 生小孩时间 裤子脱掉 宾
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's baby time. Pants off, Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 没看到你也在 盖勒
sense_groups.english: Didn't see you there, Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯在这里 所以…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Ross is here, so...

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊是啊
sense_groups.english: Uh, yeah, uh-huh. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在想 可以在你们这里混一下
sense_groups.english: Uh, and I was really hoping that maybe I could hang out.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 - 你们想要做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Mm. - What do you, uh, feel like doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想要做爱
sense_groups.english: Well, uh, we're gonna have sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 我倒是不太想做爱
sense_groups.english: I don't feel like having sex.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许…我不知道
sense_groups.english: Uh, maybe, uh... I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以一起看电影什么的
sense_groups.english: Maybe we can watch a movie or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 我这样说好了
sense_groups.english: Uh, let me put it this way

sense_groups.chinese: 不管你在不在 我们都要做爱
sense_groups.english: We're having sex whether you're here or not.

sense_groups.chinese: 裤子脱掉 宾
sense_groups.english: Pants off, Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在既然我回来了 何不告诉我你做了什么
sense_groups.english: Now that I'm back, why don't you just fill me in on what you've been up to?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我把你《F4》的屏幕保护程式改了
sense_groups.english: Well, I've changed your screen saver from that picture of *NSYNC.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我离开时 他们可是很受欢迎的
sense_groups.english: Hey, they were popular when I left.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在准备明天一个很重要的报告
sense_groups.english: I'm working on this big presentation for tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该要参与的 跟我说明吧
sense_groups.english: I should be involved in that, so get me up to speed.

sense_groups.chinese: 那会花上好几个星期 让我处理这个报告就可以了
sense_groups.english: That'll take weeks. Let me take care of the presentation.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我知道 你在玩什么花样 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. I see what you're doing here, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我的工作 我已经做了五年 我知道一切流程
sense_groups.english: This is my job, buddy. I've had it for five years, and I know how it works.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以赶快跟我解释 - 好
sense_groups.english: So why don't you just catch me up? - Fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你把我椅背的角度完全变了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. You've totally messed with the back support on my chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么弄的？ - 你已经在这里五年了
sense_groups.english: How do you fix this? - You've been here five years.

sense_groups.chinese: 你自己想 - 很好 我自己来
sense_groups.english: You figure it out. - Fine, I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 跟我说吧
sense_groups.english: All right, fill me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有蓝色的领带跟这件配？ 艾玛吐奶到我的领带上
sense_groups.english: Do you have a blue tie that would go with this? Emma spit up on mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 有啊 但是我找到工作时要还我
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, but you have to give it back if I get a job.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 到那时候 领带已经被淘汰了…
sense_groups.english: Of course, by that time, ties will be obsolete...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我们全都穿银色的连身装
sense_groups.english: and we'll all be wearing silver jumpsuits.

sense_groups.chinese: 早安 爱人 - 早安
sense_groups.english: Hey, good morning, lover. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说 经过昨晚之后 我的双腿还在发软
sense_groups.english: I gotta say, after last night, I'm a little weak in the knees.

sense_groups.chinese: 麻烦你 每次走进来的时候 先快速看一下四周吧
sense_groups.english: Here's an idea. You walk into a room, take a quick scan.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我有点觉得 我们昨晚做人成功了
sense_groups.english: But I kind of have this feeling that we may have made a baby last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天 我得告诉你一件事
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I have to tell you something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有怀孕
sense_groups.english: You're not pregnant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那件能使你怀孕的事？
sense_groups.english: Well, that thing that I have to do to make a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 我装的
sense_groups.english: I faked it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你装的？
sense_groups.english: What? You faked it?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要领带了
sense_groups.english: I don't need a tie.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 比较好 领子闻着 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's... It's better open collar, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 比较轻松自在
sense_groups.english: It's, uh, ahem, it's more casual.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 听着 我办不到 这实在不合常理
sense_groups.english: Joey. Listen, I can't do this. It doesn't make any sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨天我是护士 今天我是服务生？
sense_groups.english: Yesterday I was a nurse, and today I'm a waitress at a café?

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我们会用相同的临时演员 扮演不同的角色 没关系的
sense_groups.english: Oh, sometimes we use the same extras for different parts. It's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 有关系 因为昨天我扮演护士 演出让人印象深刻
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not okay, because I gave a very memorable performance as the nurse.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在突然间我变成服务生？ 我的影迷会混淆的
sense_groups.english: And now, suddenly, I'm the waitress? That's gonna confuse my fans.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Um, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 或许你是护士…
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe you are a nurse...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你晚上兼差当服务生
sense_groups.english: but you moonlight as a waitress.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我是抚养两个小孩的单亲妈妈
sense_groups.english: Because I'm a single mother supporting my two children.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 - 对啊
sense_groups.english: Nice. Yeah. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Okay. Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克雷莫瑞医生跟我在同间医院工作 我不用过来打招呼吗？
sense_groups.english: Dr. Drake Ramoray and I work at the same hospital. Wouldn't I come say hi?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 你跟德瑞克在吵架
sense_groups.english: No. No, see, uh, you and Drake are having a fight.

sense_groups.chinese: 吵什么？
sense_groups.english: About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 他跟你上床 然后再也没有打电话给你
sense_groups.english: He slept with you and then never called you.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我只想帮 大卫跟贝琪找个新爸爸
sense_groups.english: And I just wanted a new daddy for Davey and Becky.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 好了 从头开始
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, from the top.

sense_groups.chinese: 开麦拉
sense_groups.english: And, action.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很讶异你会同意 跟我出来吃午餐
sense_groups.english: So I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很讶异 但我终究是来了
sense_groups.english: I'm surprised too. But yet, here I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 卡
sense_groups.english: Cut! Cut!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是在做什么？
sense_groups.english: What...? What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很气他 因为他跟我上过床之后 就再也没有打电话给我了
sense_groups.english: I'm very angry at him because he slept with me and never called me back.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 - 还有我
sense_groups.english: Me too. - Me too!

sense_groups.chinese: 冷静点 她是说在剧情里面
sense_groups.english: Oh, calm down. She means on the show.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要新的临时演员
sense_groups.english: We need some new extras around here.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你已经到了
sense_groups.english: Wow. You're here already.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 艾玛跟我 提早进来做研究 准备报告
sense_groups.english: Yes. Emma and I came in a little early to do research on the presentation.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我做了一些修改 我想我都准备好了
sense_groups.english: Actually, I made a few changes. I think I'm caught up on everything.

sense_groups.chinese: 随便问我一个问题吧
sense_groups.english: So ask me anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要怎么调整椅子呢？ - 除了这个
sense_groups.english: How do you fix the chair? - Ugh, except that!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 塞纳先生 今天下午的报告 我们都已经准备好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hello, Mr. Zelner. We are all ready for our presentation this afternoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 因为十分钟之后就要开始了
sense_groups.english: Good, because it's in 10 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我没办法 我宝宝在这里
sense_groups.english: What? I can't do that. I have the baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯一个小时之后才会来接她
sense_groups.english: Ross is not gonna pick her up for an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 那盖文可以上台报告 我们现在就要开始了
sense_groups.english: Then Gavin can give the presentation. We have to do it now.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗夫今天要提早走 他要去买直升机
sense_groups.english: Ralph needs to leave early today. He's going helicopter shopping. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 满你的意了 你赢了 你赢了
sense_groups.english: Well, there you go, you win. You win.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以上台报告 让他们爱死你
sense_groups.english: You get to do the presentation. You'll knock them dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人会记得我在这里工作过 然后罗夫会买到直升机…
sense_groups.english: No one will remember that I worked here, and then Ralph will buy his helicopter...

sense_groups.chinese: 超级盖文会跟他一起飞
sense_groups.english: and Super Gavin will just fly right alongside of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以上台去报告 - 不 我不行 我宝宝在这里
sense_groups.english: You can do the presentation. - No, I can't. I have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会看着她
sense_groups.english: I'll watch her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么要这样？
sense_groups.english: Why would you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你工作很辛苦 而这是你的工作 还有你有点疯狂
sense_groups.english: Because you worked really hard, and it's your job. And you're a little crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你人真好
sense_groups.english: [VOICE BREAKING] That's really nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该告诉你 哭泣的女人让我觉得很不自在
sense_groups.english: I should tell you that crying women make me very uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那你可能不会喜欢 接下来要发生的事
sense_groups.english: Well, you're not gonna like what's coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 我很抱歉 我很抱歉 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪
sense_groups.english: God.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Um.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事的 别担心 我很会带小孩
sense_groups.english: I'm really fine. Don't worry. I'm great with children.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是盖文米丘 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: Gavin Mitchell. Pleased to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请不要开除我的朋友 让我先跟她谈谈
sense_groups.english: Please don't fire my friend. Just let me talk to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但这是她最后一次机会 - 谢谢 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Okay, but this is her last chance. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮你一个忙如何？
sense_groups.english: How about I do something for you?

sense_groups.chinese: 明天 我帮你带一顶帽子 让你遮住秃头
sense_groups.english: Tomorrow, uh, I'll bring you a hat, cover up the bald.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着菲比 我刚跟导演谈完…
sense_groups.english: Hey, uh, listen, Pheebs. I was just talking to the director...

sense_groups.chinese: 他说这一次你不要打德瑞克
sense_groups.english: and he was thinking maybe this time you don't hit Drake.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只要端盘子就可以了
sense_groups.english: You just wait on the tables.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能那样做 我是演员 我有我的程序
sense_groups.english: I can't do that. I'm an actor. I have a process.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是按摩师 你有的是挖了个洞的桌子
sense_groups.english: You're a masseuse. You have a table with a hole in it.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我知道这是怎么回事了 你感到威胁了
sense_groups.english: Wait, I see what's happening here. You're threatened.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的演技好到抢了你的锋头
sense_groups.english: I'm so good in the scene that I'm stealing focus from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 接受挑战吧 崔比亚尼 因为我只会提高你的水准
sense_groups.english: Well, rise to the challenge, Tribbiani, because I just raised the bar.

sense_groups.chinese: 提升自己 向我看齐吧 - 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Come join me up here. - Ha-ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以开除她 但是最好叫保全过来 请神容易送神难哦
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you can fire her, but I would call security. She won't go easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你装的？你不可能装的
sense_groups.english: You faked it? You couldn't have faked it.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 只要装点表情跟声音
sense_groups.english: Yes, you can. You just make the faces and the noises.

sense_groups.chinese: 男生可以装吗？
sense_groups.english: Guys can fake it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不可思议 这明明是女生的专长
sense_groups.english: Ugh, unbelievable. The one thing that's ours.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么在我们想要生小孩的时候 你要假装呢？
sense_groups.english: Why would you fake it when we're trying to have a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 这正是我要装的原因
sense_groups.english: Well, that's actually why.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我正在换工作
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm starting a whole new career now.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说我不想要孩子
sense_groups.english: I'm not saying I don't want a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是或许我们可以等一阵子
sense_groups.english: I'm just saying maybe we could wait a little while.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个月吗？
sense_groups.english: Like...? Like a month?

sense_groups.chinese: 或是一年？ - 真的吗？你想要等一年？
sense_groups.english: Or a year? - Really? You wanna wait a year?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该不用到一年 你知道我的能力
sense_groups.english: It could be less than a year. I mean, you've heard my stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: "长裤 跟短裤一样 只是长一点"
sense_groups.english: "Pants. Like shorts but longer."

sense_groups.chinese: 可能不只一年吧
sense_groups.english: It'll probably be more than a year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我…
sense_groups.english: Wow. I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很想要生小孩 - 是啊 我也很想
sense_groups.english: I really wanna have a baby. - Well, yeah, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样好了 我回去做老本行好了
sense_groups.english: Look, I'll just get my old job back.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我要你做你热爱的工作
sense_groups.english: No, I want you to have a job that you love...

sense_groups.chinese: 不是什么数据分析跟资料重组的
sense_groups.english: not statistical analysis and data reconfiguration.

sense_groups.chinese: 我辞职后 你才了解我在做什么？
sense_groups.english: I quit, and you learn what I do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想 永远不会有 适合生小孩的时机
sense_groups.english: I think there's never gonna be a right time to have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你失业了 但过了一阵子…
sense_groups.english: Now you're unemployed, and in a little while...

sense_groups.chinese: 你就会找到一份让你忙不过来的工作
sense_groups.english: you'll find a new job that'll keep you really busy.

sense_groups.chinese: 总是会有理由不能生小孩的
sense_groups.english: There's always gonna be a reason not to do this...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我想 一旦有了宝宝 我们就会忘了所有的理由
sense_groups.english: but I think once the baby comes, we'll forget about all those reasons.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想也是
sense_groups.english: I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 有小孩一直是很吓人的事
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's always gonna be scary when we have a baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的会很吓人
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be really scary.

sense_groups.chinese: 有小孩的时候…
sense_groups.english: I mean, God, when we have a baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 会有许多事情是我们无法控制的
sense_groups.english: there's gonna be so much that we're not able to control.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 这间公寓会是一团乱
sense_groups.english: I mean, the apartment's gonna be a mess.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会没有时间 整理
sense_groups.english: I won't have time to clean it.

sense_groups.chinese: 要是宝宝跑到缎带抽屉里…
sense_groups.english: What if the baby gets into the ribbon drawer...

sense_groups.chinese: 把所有的缎带都弄乱了呢？
sense_groups.english: and messes up all the ribbons?

sense_groups.chinese: 万一没有地方可以放缎带…
sense_groups.english: What if there's no room for a ribbon drawer...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为所有的空间 都被宝宝的东西占满了呢？
sense_groups.english: because the baby's stuff takes up all the space?

sense_groups.chinese: 缎带要放哪儿？
sense_groups.english: Where will all the ribbons go?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们该不该在你改变主意之前 赶快去做人？
sense_groups.english: Should we go make a baby before you change your mind?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 拜托快点 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Yes, please! - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我保证 这一次我不会装了
sense_groups.english: Oh, and I promise I will not fake it this time.

sense_groups.chinese: 真希望我也可以说相同的话 我现在有点激动
sense_groups.english: Well, I wish I could say the same. I'm a little shook up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你故意让手术失败
sense_groups.english: I know you botched that operation on purpose.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有办法证明 等我可以证明 你会因谋杀而坐牢的
sense_groups.english: I can't prove it yet, but when I do, you'll be going to jail for murder.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎你是不是我弟弟
sense_groups.english: I don't care if you are my brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是你弟弟
sense_groups.english: I'm not your brother.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的孩子怎么办呢？德瑞克！
sense_groups.english: What about my children, Drake? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: No! No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不
sense_groups.english: No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: God!

questions.name: S09E12
questions.en:
Hey. - Hey.
Where's Mon? - She's at home...
putting up decorations for Rachel's birthday party tonight.
And you're not helping? - I tried...
but apparently singing "I Will Survive" in a helium voice, not helping.
Hey, you guys. - Hey.
Happy birth...
Shh. Don't say that loud. Gunther's gonna want to hug me.
Uh, good news, everyone. We finally found a nanny.
This is Molly. Molly, Chandler, Joey. - Hi.
Ooh, somebody's getting a little fussy.
You're damn right I am. I've been waiting for a cookie for seven minutes.
Okay. You know what, I'm just gonna take her outside.
No, you stay. I'll do it. - Okay. Thank you.
Nice to meet you guys. - Yeah, you too.
Wow, Molly's just great. - Yeah.
Yes, bravo on the hot nanny.
What? You really think she's hot? - Are you kidding?
If I wasn't married, she'd be rejecting me right now.
Joey?
How do you think she's doing?
Am I the only one that doesn't think she's hot? Ross?
Ah, I mean, she's not unattractive, but... - Right.
but hot? Ah...
Thank you. Ha, ha.
Now that Rachel's gone?
So hot, I cried myself to sleep last night.
Hey, Mike, what's the capital of Peru?
Lima. - No.
It starts with a V and ends with an X.
And hopefully with a T-O in the middle.
You know, come to think of it, the capital of Peru is "Vtox."
Oh, God! - What?
Okay. I don't want to freak you out or anything...
but I just saw a rat in your cupboard.
Oh, yeah. No, that's Bob.
Well, he's your pet rat?
Well, not so much a pet as, you know, an occasional visitor...
who I put food out for. You know, kind of like Santa.
Except Santa doesn't poop on the plate of cookies.
You can't keep a rat in your apartment. They're extremely unsanitary.
I mean, they transmit leptospirosis and hantavirus.
What are those? - I don't know...
but they don't sound like spa treatments.
You have to get rid of it. - Okay, fine.
If it means that much to you, I'll get rid of Bob.
Thank you.
It's so weird you think he's so gross, yet you're willing to eat his crackers.
Hello. - Hello.
Gavin, I just want to say thank you again...
for watching Emma yesterday during the presentation.
I really owe you an apology.
For what? - When we first met, you know...
I thought you were pompous and arrogant and obnoxious.
Is this your first apology?
No, I just mean, you know, first impressions don't mean anything.
And I think you're a really good guy. And I'm sorry that I misjudged you.
Morning. - Hello.
But you know what? Hey, new day, new leaf.
I am just really, really happy...
I'm sorry. Obviously, Heather's ass has something more important to say...
so I'll just wait till it's finished.
What? - I was giving you an apology...
and you were totally checking her out.
I wasn't checking her out. I'm in fashion. I was looking at her skirt.
Or was it pants? I didn't really see what happened below the ass area.
Wow, you are really... You're really a creep.
What do you even care if I was looking at her?
Are you jealous?
Oh, yeah. I'm jealous.
"Oh, Gavin. Please, please look at my ass."
Stop looking at my ass.
I mean, I just think you are totally inappropriate. Okay?
This is a work environment. She's your subordinate.
But it was okay when you slept with your old assistant, Tag?
That is totally different for two reasons.
One, I didn't know that you knew that.
And two, I wasn't some creep staring at his ass.
We had a... We had a deep, meaningful relationship.
Huh. What was Tag's last name?
It was...
Oh, my God.
He didn't have a last name.
It was just Tag, you know, like Cher or...
you know, Moses.
But it was a deep, meaningful relationship.
You know what? My first impression of you was absolutely right.
You are arrogant. You are pompous. Morgan! Morgan!
Tag's last name was Morgan! Ha! - It was Jones.
What are you, his boyfriend?
Man, I wish I had a nanny like you.
You mean when you were a baby?
Sure.
Would you stop staring at her?
I wasn't staring.
I was leering.
What's the big deal with her?
Maybe she's attractive in an obvious kind of way.
Yeah, obvious beauty's the worst.
You know, when it's right there in your face.
Me, I like to have to work to find someone attractive.
Makes me feel like I earned it.
Looks like Joey's doing all right with her.
Yeah. Hey, that was nice of you guys to back off...
and let Joey get the girl for once.
I'm gonna take her to the apartment. - Okay, I'll be home right after work.
Okay. - Okay, bye, Emma-wemma-demma.
I lovey-wovey-dove you.
Bye. - Bye.
They've elected me to talk to you about the baby talk.
It's not so good.
I think it's sweet.
Bye, Emma-wemma!
Hey, listen, Joey. About Molly, I would really prefer if you didn't go after her.
Why not?
Because it took months to find a good nanny.
And I wouldn't want anything to, you know, drive her away.
So you think I'm just gonna sleep with her...
and never call her again, and things are gonna get uncomfortable?
Yeah, that sounds about right.
Come on, there are plenty of other women out there, okay?
Just forget about her, okay? She's off-limits.
Oh, man. What'd you have to go and say that for?
Now that you told me I can't have her, makes me want her even more!
What are you, a child? - Yes.
Look, Joey, come on now. For me, please.
Just try to focus your sexual energy on someone else.
Fine.
Take me home.
Hey, Mikey. - Hey, Pheeb.
What are you doing? - Setting rattraps.
To kill Bob? - No. No, to test his neck strength.
But no, I don't want to kill him. I thought we were gonna capture him...
and, you know, set him free in the countryside...
where he could meet a friendly possum...
and a wisecracking owl.
Okay, okay. I'll throw away the traps.
All right, I'll find Bob. I'll get him.
Bob? Bob?
Robert?
Wait, I think I hear him.
Oh, my God! Bob had babies! Bob's a mom!
We'll have to think of a new name.
Oh, I don't know, I kind of like "Bob" for a girl.
No, no. I mean, I'm not sure that we...
Oh, my God. We killed Bob?
Well, maybe it wasn't Bob. Maybe it was a mouse.
Susie?
What's up?
Seriously, dude. Three years ago.
Listen, can you do me a favor? I'm gonna be out today.
Can you keep an eye on Joey...
make sure nothing happens between him and Molly?
You don't trust him? - Well, no.
Some woman who sounded a lot like Joey called earlier...
and asked for her daughter, uh, the "hot nanny."
Is this really your long-term plan, for me to run interference?
Because I could get a job any day now.
You do appear right on the cusp of something.
Look, come on, man. I'm sure he'll lose interest in a week or two...
but for now, could you please just do this for me?
Fine, but don't blame me if it doesn't work.
Because you know once Joey sets his mind on something...
more often than not, he's going to have sex with it.
Well, I mean, we've gotta do something. Okay?
Nannies like her don't grow on trees.
Picturing that tree? - I am, yes.
Where you going, Joe?
For a walk.
Oh, you mind if I join you?
Actually, uh, I'd rather be alone. You know, I really need to organize my thoughts.
Your thoughts?
Plural?
All right, fine. I only have one thought.
It's about the hot nanny. I gotta see her.
I'm afraid I can't let you do that, Joe. - Now you're telling me I can't see her?
You guys are killing me. She's forbidden fruit. It's like, like...
Like she's the princess and I'm the stable boy.
Why are you doing this, huh?
Did Ross tell you not to let me go over there?
Yes, as a matter of fact, he did. So I can't let you go.
Huh. Interesting. Now there are obstacles.
Hot nanny and me against the world.
This is the stuff great novels are made of.
Great novels? - Fine. Mediocre porn.
Gavin Mitchell's office. - Rachel Green's office.
Give me that phone.
Hello, this is Rachel Green. How can I help you?
Uh-huh. Okay, then. I'll pass you back to your son.
Hey, Mom. No, that's just my secretary.
Um, excuse me, Gavin. I have a question I need to ask you.
Mom, I'll call you later. Yeah.
Yes? - If you like looking at butts so much...
why don't you just go look in a mirror?
Thank God you finally said that.
I saw you make a note on your pad three hours ago.
Man, I really bug you. Don't I? - Oh, no. Please...
I don't care about you enough to bug me.
In fact, from now on, I'm going to take the high road...
and I'm going to be very, very nice to you, you mama's boy...
starting right now.
Hey, Rach. - Hi.
Ready for your birthday lunch? - I am.
But first, Monica, I would like to introduce you...
to my very talented colleague and more importantly...
my wonderful friend, Gavin Mitchell.
Pleased to meet you. - Pleased to meet you.
Are you coming to Rachel's party?
Oh, no, no, no. Gavin can't. He already has plans...
most likely with his mother.
I don't mind. I'll cancel them. I would never miss my secretary's birthday.
Why did you invite him? I can't stand that guy.
You were being so nice to him. - I was faking it.
Can't you tell when I'm being fake?
Hey, Mr. Phillips. Nice suit.
Right there. That was so fake! - Shh!
Oh, hi.
I still can't believe you invited Gavin.
I mean, he is just the last person I want to see.
You're welcome for the party. I'm glad you're having a good time.
God, I hope he doesn't show up. Of course he's not gonna show up, the guy hates me.
Does he? - What?
Maybe he keeps bothering you so much because he likes you.
It's like in first grade when Skippy Lange would push me...
because he secretly had a crush on me.
Oh, Monica, you think Skippy liked you?
Honey, all those boys had a bet to see if he could knock you over.
She's out. I'm gonna take her home. - Oh, okay. Thank you.
Bye, sweetheart.
Do you see what all the guys see in her?
Wouldn't kick her out of bed.
No more vodka for me.
Hey, Rach. So can I sing "Happy Birthday" to you now?
Yeah, sure. - Oh. All right.
Happy birth...
See you later.
Hey, Rach. Somebody got you shoes.
Give me.
Wow. Wow. Oh, my God! - Careful! Careful!
These are my rat babies!
Yeah. We have rat babies now.
Oh, you brought rats to my birthday party?
So this is what a stroke feels like.
Well, I had to bring them. We killed their mother.
They're our responsibility now.
You know, they require constant care.
You should know that, Rachel, you're a mother.
Are you comparing my daughter to a rat?
No. Seven rats.
I think we should take them home. We need to feed them.
Wait, you're gonna leave my party to take care of a box of rats?
Well, I'm sorry, Rachel, but I'm not like you. Okay?
Not everyone can afford help.
Hey, where the hell are Joey and Molly?
I asked you to watch them.
I'm sorry. I got a little preoccupied.
Look, we have to stop them before something happens.
Right behind you, big guy.
So you see, Molly, what people don't understand...
is that acting is a discipline. It takes a lot of hard work.
So where'd you study? - Oh, I didn't go to college.
No, where'd you study acting? - Molly, people don't study acting.
Molly, uh, do you mind giving us just a minute?
Sure. I'll go check on Emma. - Thanks.
Will the stable boy never get the princess?
What do you think you were gonna do, have sex with her here on my couch?
No. The leather sticks to my ass.
This isn't fair. What makes you think I'm gonna sleep with her...
and then blow her off, huh?
Can't you guys open your minds to the possibility that I actually like her...
and might want something real?
Look, the truth is I haven't felt this way about anyone since Rachel.
Okay? I didn't think I could ever love again.
Come on. - Joe.
Hi. Is Molly here?
Uh, yeah, yeah. Come on in. Molly?
Hey. Guys, this is Tabitha. - Hey.
I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.
Uh, well, Joey, I guess we have no problem.
It's like my favorite fairy tale come true.
The princess, the stable boy and the lesbian.
Okay. Okay, you start preparing the formula...
and I'll start changing the box.
And then we gotta put them straight to bed.
When did we become one of those couples...
whose lives revolve around their rats?
Well, you know what? They're our responsibility now.
Okay, fine. These rats are our responsibility.
What happens when they mate and there are hundreds?
Mate? They're all brothers and sisters.
Yeah, uh, not such a problem with rats.
No, they're more of a "love the one you're with" kind of animal.
No. Really?
Oh, my... Get off your sister! Ew.
Oh, my God. What are we gonna do?
The... We have seven rats. - Uh-huh.
So, what if each of them has seven rats...
and then each of those have seven rats? That's like...
That's math I can't even do.
What are we gonna do?
Well, I know this is gonna sound crazy...
but we could not let the box of rats ruin our lives.
Yeah, okay. I guess you're right.
All right, so we should just give them away.
But to nice families with children and reduced-fat Wheat Thins.
Those were Bob's favorites.
It's gonna be okay.
You must think I'm crazy. - No, I think you're sweet.
Good.
This is just so hard.
It's hard for me to let them go.
I guess it just brings back memories, you know...
from when I gave birth to my brother's triplets and I had to give them up.
I haven't told you about that yet, have I?
Hey. - Hi.
Thanks for the party, honey. Should I help you clean up?
No way. You had your party. Now I have mine.
Is everything all right? - I just get bummed...
when my birthday's over.
Well, at least you have one thing to be happy about.
Mm? - That jerk, Gavin, from your office...
didn't show up. - Ah.
Yeah, I hate him.
We weren't talking about you. We were...
No. No way to recover. No. Okay.
Fun party. - Well, it was.
And you would have seen it if you didn't show up at...
Nine-thirty? God. Ugh, this party was lame.
Again, you're welcome.
Look, I'll just give you this and go.
Oh, you bought me a present. Why?
Let me explain how birthday parties usually work. There are presents...
and a cake, perhaps a fourth or fifth person.
Okay, I, uh...
I got you the present to make up for being such a jerk to you.
Aw. Well, okay. Well, that's very nice. And you wrote a card.
"From Gavin." - I really mean it.
Oh. Oh.
Oh, it's beautiful.
If you don't mind? Let me. - No.
Well, what do you know, it fits.
See, Gavin. You're capable of being a nice guy.
Why do you give me such a hard time?
I'm not sure.
Well, Monica seems to think it's because you have feelings for me.
I do have feelings for you.
You do? - Yes. I feel that you're a little annoying.
See, why? Gavin, why?
Right when I'm about to change my opinion of you, you go and you...
And you do that.
First I was afraid, I was petrified
Hey. - Hi.
Listen, um, I think I left something here.
Oh. Uh, well, somebody left this. Is this yours?
Oh. No, but I like it.
No, I think I left one of my rat babies.
Oh. Uh, well, no. I haven't seen it, but if I do, I'll let you know.
Aah! Rat baby! Rat baby! Rat baby! Rat baby!
Maybe that's him.

sense_groups.chinese: 帮瑞秋今晚的生日派对做布置

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用帮忙吗？ - 我有试过…

sense_groups.english: but apparently singing "I Will Survive" in a helium voice, not helping.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我想我带她出去好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. You know what, I'm just gonna take her outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你留下来 我去 - 好的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: No, you stay. I'll do it. - Okay. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你们 - 是啊 我们也是

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 莫莉真的很不错 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Wow, Molly's just great. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 真棒 请了个辣保姆
sense_groups.english: Yes, bravo on the hot nanny.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你真的觉得她很辣吗？ - 你看不出来吗？
sense_groups.english: What? You really think she's hot? - Are you kidding?

sense_groups.english: I wasn't staring.
