questions.en:
Morning, roomie. - Hey!
You remembered to put clothes on this morning.
Fifth day's the charm. - Oh.
It's so great to be back here. You're making it so easy on me and Emma.
It's great having you back. Stay as long as you want.
And when does she stop crying all night?
Hey! You're not naked. Heh.
So, hey, Rach, when will we expect to see you tonight?
I'll probably be back around 6. But she's in the bedroom, all ready to go.
But she did fall back to sleep, so...
She's probably exhausted from all that adorable screaming she did last night.
Bye. - Bye.
Hey, I hope Emma isn't making it too hard on you.
No, hey, it's been great.
Yeah? - Yeah.
I want you to know that with Rachel staying here...
all my feelings from before are totally over.
And even if they weren't...
when you walk in on a woman using a breast pump...
Yeah, that'll do it. - Wow.
So how are you?
I'm okay. - Really?
Sure. I mean, do I wish me and Rachel living together would have worked out?
Of course. You know, I'm disappointed, but it's not like it's a divorce.
Well, actually it... - It's not a divorce. It is not a divorce!
Anyway, I think Rachel and I need to get on with our lives.
Maybe start seeing other people.
Wow. Really?
Sure, why not? In fact, if you know anyone that'd be good for me?
Sure. I know lots of girls. - Yeah? Any names come to mind?
Ooh. Names?
Hey. - Hey.
I was just gonna eat. Want something? - What you got?
Okay, let's see, we got strained peas, strained carrots...
Ooh, strained plums. We haven't tried that yet.
Goody!
Thanks. Ha, ha.
So how is it living with Rachel again?
I mean, apart from the great food? - Ha, ha.
I'm fine, I'm fine. It's just...
It's just weird what's happening with her and Ross.
Yesterday he asked me to fix him up with somebody.
Rachel asked me if I knew anyone for her too.
Why are they doing this? - I don't know.
They're so perfect for each other. It's crazy.
You know what's crazy? These jars.
What is there, like, two bites in here?
I just wish they'd realize they should be together.
When they moved in together,
I figured that's where things were headed. - They should be a family.
They should marry and have more children.
Yes. And they should name one of their kids Joey.
I may not have kids. Someone's gotta carry on the family name.
You know what? Maybe once they start dating and see what's out there...
they'll realize how good they are for each other.
Yeah, because it is slim pickings.
I had this date last night. Yuck! - Mm.
But we should probably keep it down, she's still in the bedroom.
So, what are we gonna do? Are we just gonna set them up with people?
I know, that just pushes them further and further apart.
I know what we can do. We could set Ross and Rachel up on horrible dates...
so they'll realize how good they are together.
Ooh, that's a great plan. - Yeah.
You know what the best part of it is? I get to do my plan laugh
Okay. Shh, shh. Not so loud. We don't wanna wake up, uh...
Hi. You guys aren't doing anything tonight, are you?
See, now, why would you assume that? Just because we're married?
I mean, I will have you know that we are very hip, happening people.
Now if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to reading the obituaries.
I was just asking because I need someone to watch Emma tonight.
Sure we'll do it. What are you up to?
Well, Phoebe set me up on a date.
Oh, my God. - Wow.
Why? What's the big deal? - I figured because you and Ross are...
What? Slept together a year and a half ago? Yeah, I'm all set.
I think it's great you're going on a date. It sounds healthy.
I mean, you have needs. Embrace your womanhood.
You want a job? Turn off Oprah and send out a resume.
I'll bring her by around 7, okay? - That's perfect.
You guys are gonna have so much fun. She's at such a cute age.
A couple things. Now that she eats solid food, she poops around the clock.
And watch out for your hair because she likes to grab it.
She's also in this phase where if you leave the room, she screams, but, oh...
thanks, you guys. Have fun.
Suddenly I wish I was reading my own name.
Ooh, Joey, hey. I'm so excited. - Hey.
I just set Rachel up with the worst guy. - All right. Who is he?
It's this guy I used to massage. By "massage"...
I mean hold down so he wouldn't turn over and flash me.
Okay, okay.
Wait till you hear who I got for Ross. - Oh, yeah.
She's this really boring woman. She's a teacher.
A teacher? - She's into history and foreign movies.
Oh, oh. And she loves puzzles. Huh?
Come on, who loves puzzles?
Well, Ross does.
You're ruining the plan!
Joey, you fixed him up with his perfect woman.
Oh, my God, you're right! - Yeah.
She even reads for pleasure! - Ugh.
How do you know a woman like that? - I'm not allowed to know smart women?
Joey? - I met her at the library. I went in to pee.
So now what do we do? - Well, okay.
I'll call her and tell her the date's canceled and find him somebody else.
What if we don't find him somebody else? We'll just tell her the date's off...
but we don't tell Ross. He goes to the restaurant and gets stood up.
Ooh!
Ooh, I hear that's bad.
Ooh, so this is great. Rachel's gonna have a terrible date...
Ross gets stood up, and then they'll realize how good they have it together.
Ah, yes, the plan.
Ho-ho-ho.
It's not Santa's plan.
No, it's
Yeah, you know, it's not that fun. - No, I think we killed it.
Emma? Emma, look at me.
Well, I think I'll go downstairs for a while.
No, no, no. No, no, no. It's okay. It's okay. I didn't go.
Don't cry, it's just a bit.
I'm your Uncle Chandler. Funny is all I have!
Okay, just so you know, I'm gonna be ovulating from tomorrow until the 6th.
So don't touch yourself for the next 48 hours.
I don't do that.
I'll try to stop.
Wait, did you say until the 6th? - Yeah.
Today is the 6th.
No, it's not. Look.
Yes, it's also 2003.
Oh, my God. Today's the 6th?
I may be done ovulating!
I may have also served some very questionable meat at the restaurant.
Go take the test, see if we're okay. - Okay.
Tough crib.
Hey, where are all my ovulation sticks? There's only one here.
I might have checked to see if I was ovulating a couple times.
Chandler.
I am not working! There's not much to do around here!
Excuse me. Um... Heh.
Is there a woman waiting at the bar?
Um, someone average height, dark hair? Or perhaps doing a puzzle?
Uh, there's a drunk Chinese guy.
Well, if I'm still here in an hour, buy him a drink on me.
Um, can I get you another glass of wine?
I don't know if I should. I don't wanna be drunk when I...
go home alone tonight.
Got stood up, huh? - Eh, it's no big deal. It's just a blind date.
Are you worried your date came, saw you and left?
No!
We're okay. I'm still ovulating.
Oh, good, because as of 4:00 this afternoon, I am not.
So let's do this.
I don't think I can. - Oh, come on.
I know you're not 18 anymore, but give it a minute.
Because of Emma. - Oh, my God, Emma.
Oh, sweetie, I forgot you were here.
Oh, you're right, we can't do this. We can't leave her alone.
Sorry.
Unless...
maybe we do it here.
I mean, how much can she even be aware of at this age?
Well, she's aware when we leave a room. She may notice if we start...
canoodling in it.

in front of the B-A-B-Y.
I don't know, I guess having sex in front of a baby...
isn't so... - Horrifying? Scarring?
Something people go to jail for?
I guess you're right. - You guess?

because you thought a deer was staring through the window.
Well, what kind of a sick bastard wants to do it in front of a deer?
Wow, everything looks so good.
I think I'm gonna have the chicken.
I just have to say this.
You're really beautiful. - Oh. Wow, that's very sweet. Thank you.
I'm kind of funny-looking.
What? - Look, I mean, come on...
you're way out of my league. Everybody in here knows it.
I bet that guy over there is probably saying
"Ooh, why's she out with him? He must be rich."
Well, I'm not.
What do you think you want to order? I'm real excited about that chicken.
I'm not funny, either.
So if you were thinking, "Well, he's not that good-looking...
but maybe we'll have some laughs," that ain't gonna happen.
Well, come on, Steve, let's not rule out nervous laughter. Ha-ha-ha.
Hey, now, wait a minute, Phoebe told me...
that you owned your own restaurant. That's impressive.
I lost it to drugs.
I silk-screen T-shirts now.
Really? What's that like?
It's really fulfilling doing something you hate for no money.
That's right. I have no money, I'm not funny...
I live in a studio apartment with two other guys.
And I'm pretty sure I'm infertile.
Now, come on. Come on, Steve.
There must be something that you like about yourself.
I do like my hair.
Really?
Hello? - Phoebe, it's me!
I'm going to hunt you down and kill you.
Hey, Rach.
This is the worst date ever! How could you set me up with this creep?
You know, you are talking about one of my dear, dear friends.
I don't care. This guy is a nightmare.
All right, so he gets a little crazy when he's stoned.
He's not stoned. - Did he go out for a cigarette?
Yeah. Four times. - My dear, sweet Rach.
Oh.
Well, our plan is working. Rachel's having a miserable time...
and Ross is just stood up somewhere at a restaurant all alone.
Great. Pretty soon they'll be back together.
By the time anyone's figured out what we've done, we'll be in sunny Mexico.
Oh, wait, that's the end of a different plan.
Oh, she's asleep. Chandler?
What are you doing? - Emma was doing it.
She's asleep.
Ooh!
She's asleep. That means we can... - Yes. But we have to be fast.
Oh, okay, I'll try.
And you can't make any noise. - Okay, I'll try.
Hello?
Emma?
Hey! Hi!
How are you? How are you?
Where are your babysitters, huh?
Why is the bedroom door closed?
You can't have S-E-X when you're taking care of a B-A-B-I-E.
I've got bad news. The Chinese guy left.
Eh, if it was meant to be, it's meant to be.
Look, you got stood up. Who cares?
We're gonna show you a good time. Sit and relax.
In fact, let me bring you a crab-cake appetizer on the house.
Wow, free crab cakes? Well, that's nice.
Although I was hoping to have sex tonight. Heh.
Ooh.
Just the crab cakes.
What are you doing? Are you trying to get him to stay? You can't do that.
Just get out of here, okay? - I'm sorry, what's going on?
Uh, okay, um, the waiters have a little pool going.
We have a bet on how long it'll take before you give up and go home.
What?
You're making money off my misery?
Well, if you stay till 9:20, I am.
This is unbelievable. I have never been so insulted in my life.
Now, if you'll wrap up my free crab cakes, I'll be on my way.
Well, that was weird. You were loud and I was fast.
I think we may have done it this time.
Oh, I wish I didn't have to wait to take a pregnancy test.
You may wanna get some more of those too.
Where's Emma?
Oh, my God, where's Emma? Where's Emma?
Don't ask me. I was in there canoodling you.
Okay. Okay. I'm sure that Rachel came home early and picked up Emma.
You go look across the hall, I'll call her cell.
Okay. - You better hope we're pregnant...
because one way or another, we're giving a baby back to Rachel!
I can't believe I'm crying in front of you.
You must think I'm so pathetic.
No, no, no, I admire a man who can cry.
Really? - Don't touch my coat!

Hello? - Hey, Rach, how's it going?

What's up? - Hey, did you stop by here?
No. - Oh, my God! Then...

Uh, we were playing peekaboo. She loves it when I'm dramatic. Heh.
Why the hell did you take her? - Because you two were having sex!

I'm gonna have to tell Rachel about this.

and somebody's gotta carry on my family name.
Your family name is Tribbiani.

would you like to make love to me?
Really, really not.
Ah, it's just as well.
It doesn't work anyway.
All right, well, that's good to know. Good night, Steve.
Hey, what's wrong? - I just had a rough night.
Oh. Crab cake?
Ugh.

Well, I... It's kind of weird to talk to you about this, but...
Monica told me you had a blind date.
Yeah.
I did too. - Oh.
Uh, but is it technically a date if the other person doesn't show up?
Oh.
Oh, no. Do you think she walked in, saw you and left?
Why does everyone keep saying that?
If it makes you feel any better, I wish my date hadn't shown up.
That bad? - Well, he makes T-shirts for a living...
and he thought it would be appropriate to give me...
this.
"Female Body Inspector"?
What size is that? - Ugh.
Now wait a minute.

How do I get them to name the next one after me?
It's easy. You just walk in on them having sex.
Oh, so they owe me, like, three Phoebes.
Oh, my God! Look, it's Ross and Rachel!
The plan is working!
Don't do the plan laugh.
The first dates we've had in months, and they were both such disasters.
Oh.
Huh. You know, it is weird...
that Phoebe would set me up on a date that was awful...
on the same night Joey set you up on a date that didn't even show.
Wait a minute.
You don't think it was intentional?
I mean, that's just stupid.
We're geniuses. Huh?
Look at them! They're really bonding. - They're falling in love all over again.
Oh, they see us. Oh, they look mad.
Oh, they figured it out. They're coming. Run!
Where? - Mexico!
Can you believe they're still not here?
I know. A double blind date and we both get stood up.
What are the chances?
I know, I'm so bummed.
Could we have our free crab cakes now?
What? - We've been stood up.
And we want our free crab cakes.
Guys, give it a rest. Nobody's betting on you tonight.
Although we do have a pool going to see how long it takes that guy to cry.
I have such fat hands!

sense_groups.english: that Phoebe would set me up on a date that was awful...

sense_groups.chinese: 而在同一晚 乔伊帮你安排了一个 根本没有人出现的约会
sense_groups.english: on the same night Joey set you up on a date that didn't even show.

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下
sense_groups.english: Wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会认为这是故意的吧
sense_groups.english: You don't think it was intentional?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 这实在太愚蠢了
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's just stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真是天才
sense_groups.english: We're geniuses. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧他们 合得不得了 - 再度坠入爱河了
sense_groups.english: Look at them! They're really bonding. - They're falling in love all over again.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 他们看到我们了 看起来很生气
sense_groups.english: Oh, they see us. Oh, they look mad.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们知道了 他们过来了 快跑
sense_groups.english: Oh, they figured it out. They're coming. Run!

sense_groups.chinese: 跑去哪？ - 墨西哥
sense_groups.english: Where? - Mexico!

sense_groups.chinese: 谁敢相信她们居然还没有出现？
sense_groups.english: Can you believe they're still not here?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 双对约会 我们竟然一起被放鸽子
sense_groups.english: I know. A double blind date and we both get stood up.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能呢？
sense_groups.english: What are the chances?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我好难过
sense_groups.english: I know, I'm so bummed.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在可以上免费的蟹肉饼了吗？
sense_groups.english: Could we have our free crab cakes now?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我们被放鸽子了
sense_groups.english: What? - We've been stood up.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想要上免费的蟹肉饼了
sense_groups.english: And we want our free crab cakes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们俩 不用装了 今晚没有人在拿你们打赌
sense_groups.english: Guys, give it a rest. Nobody's betting on you tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过我们倒是有在赌 看那个男的多久才会哭
sense_groups.english: Although we do have a pool going to see how long it takes that guy to cry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的手好肥
sense_groups.english: I have such fat hands!

questions.name: S09E15
questions.en:
Guys! Guys! I've got great news. Guess what.
Uh, Monica's pregnant! - Really?
Let's get past the moment.
What's your news? - Thank you.
I got a job in advertising.
Oh, honey, that's incredible! - Wow.
Gosh, what's the pay like?
Oh, come on, people.
If I don't know who makes the most...
how do I know who I like the most? Hi, Joey.
It pays nothing. It's an internship.
We have interns at Days of our Lives.
Right. So it'll be the same, except less sex with you.
So, uh, what do you think they'll have you do there?
It's a training program, but they hire the people they like.
That's great! - There's gonna be some grunt work...
which will stink. A grown man getting people coffee is humiliating.
Humiliating and noble.
Thank you.
You know, if I didn't already have a job...
I would've been good in advertising.
Ross, you did not come up with "got milk?"
Yes, I did! I did!
I should've written it down.
Hey. - Hey.
Where's Chandler? I wanna wish him good luck on his first day.
And I smelled bacon. Ha, ha.
He just left. - Who did?
Joey, you're never gonna believe it! She called!
She did'? - You got it!
I did? - What is she talking about?
I don't know, but it sounds great!
No, your agent called. You got that audition!
With Leonard Hayes? - Yes!
Oh, my God, that is great! It's for a play on Broadway.
And in a real theater. Not that little one underneath the deli like last time.
Is it a good play'? - It must be.
I read it and didn't understand a single word!
Leonard Hayes is starring in it. - Yeah, and directing.
Oh, he was so good in that movie of Macbeth.
You saw that? - No, but I saw the previews.
They played it right before Jackass. - Ah.
Oh, yeah, yeah. He has.
He's done some amazing work. - Oh, yeah.
Oh, I loved him in those phone commercials.
When the monkey hits him in the face with the giant rubber phone. Ha-ha-ha.
Maybe the monkey will be at the audition.
Don't make me more nervous than I already am!
Good morning. - Can I get you a cup of coffee, sir?
Oh, no, no. I'm an intern, just like you guys.
Except for the tie, the briefcase and the fact that I can rent a car.
Seriously, you're an intern?
I'm heading in a new career direction and you gotta start at the bottom.
Dude.
I know I'm a little older than you guys, but it's not like I'm Bob Hope.
The comedian. USO.
Uh, it's U.S.A., sir.
This is Joey Tribbiani. Joey, these are the producers.
And as you probably already know, this is Leonard Hayes.
Wow.
It is so amazing to meet you. I am such a big fan of your work.
Well, I've been blessed with a lot of great roles.
Tell me about it, huh? "Unlimited nights and weekends!"
Are you making fun of me? Because I am not a sellout.
I didn't do it for money. I believe in those phones!
I almost lost a cousin because of bad wireless service.
No, I wasn't making fun of you. I think you were great in those commercials.
Really? - Yeah.
Well, I do bring a certain credibility to the role.
It's true. - Are you kidding?
When they shoot you out of that cannon...
"Hang up that phone!"
One take. - Wow.
Did that in one. I know.
So shall we read? - Oh, yeah, sure.
Top of Act 2. This is my entrance. You got it?
Mm-hm.
What the hell are you still doing here?
Oh. Uh.
I think you know. - Bastard!
I am what you made me. You know what? I could go right now.
Go! Go! - I can't.
Oh, I want to, Long Pause...
but I can't.
I'm so sorry. You're not supposed to say "long pause."
Oh! Oh, I thought that was your character's name. You know?
I thought you were, like, an Indian or something, you know, with the...
Sorry. - Long Pause.
No. Thank you so much for coming in. We appreciate it. Thank you.
Sure you don't want me to do it again?
I could do it with an accent. - No.
You know, Southern.
"I could go right now, mon!"
Huh?
My God in heaven.
Joey, hang on for a second. Leonard, can we talk to you for a moment?
Yes?
You've gotta be kidding. See, he can't act.
I don't care if you think he's hot.
If you wanna sleep with him, do it on your own time. This is a play.
No, listen, if you insist on this...
I will call my agent so fast...
on a cell phone connection so clear, he's gonna think I'm next door!
Uh, hi. Uh, thank you so much for whispering for my benefit.
If you tell me what I did wrong, I would love to work on it and try it again for you.
And also, how you doing?
Would you please just give me another chance? I really wanna get better. Please?
Really?
Well, if you wanna come back today...
here are my notes. Ready? - Yeah.
Um, you're in your head. You're thinking way too much.
I really doubt that.
No, no, no. It's that you're not connected with anything in your body.
No urgency. The scene is a struggle. - Uh-huh.
It's a race. - Uh-huh.
Also, what you did was horizontal.
Don't be afraid to explore the vertical. - Uh-huh.
And don't learn the words. Let the words learn you.
Couldn't I just sleep with the producer?
Hey, do you wanna go to dinner tonight?
Oh, I can't. I've got a date with that waitress, Katie.
Yeah, I know we've only gone out, like, twice, but I don't know...
I have a good feeling about her. - Oh, I hear divorce bells.
Give me your wallets, and there won't be a problem.
What? - I have a gun.
Okay, just relax, Phoebe. Just stay calm.
Oh, my God, I can't find my wallet!
All right, lady, now give me your purse. - No.
What do you mean, "no"? I knew you'd be my death, Phoebe Buffay!
Lowell, is that you? - Phoebe?
Oh, my God! - Unbelievable! Oh, my God! Oh!
I'm sorry. Ross, this is my old friend, Lowell, from the streets! Ha, ha.
Lowell, Ross. - Ross, nice to meet you.
Yeah, a real pleasure.
Oh, it's been so long! Oh, so long. - Ha-ha-ha.
I can't believe you're still doing this. - Ah, I know. But I quit smoking.
Good for you.
You look like you're doing well.
I guess your mugging days are behind you.
Oh.
Oh, my God. Phoebe, you used to mug people?
Excuse me, Ross, old friends catching up.
HeY! - HeY!
How'd the audition go? - They wanna see me again, but, uh...
boy, Leonard Hayes did not like me.
What happened? - Oh, he said I wasn't urgent enough.
Everything I did was horizontal, and I should be more vertical.
Oh, and he said that I should think less. - Well, so far so good.
Honey, I'm old!
What's wrong?
I am so much older than these other interns. I can't compete with them.
So you're a little older.
Look at the positive. You have all this life experience.
Yes, but I don't think life experience is gonna help me with these.
Wow! It's like they're on fire!
Ooh.
What are they? - Prototype sneakers.
I need ideas on how to sell them. Which I can't do...
because no self-respecting adult would ever wear these.
I'll give you $500 for them.
What am I supposed to do? - Come on, sneakers are easy.
You wear them all the time. - They're not called sneakers anymore.
They're called "kicks" or "skids." I think I heard somebody say "slorps."
They've got wheels that pop out from the bottom so you can roll around...
because apparently walking is too much exercise.
"Kids! Kids! Roll your way to childhood obesity!"
Would you help me try to sell these?
Okay. Have you considered using a girl with huge knockers?
That's not what they're looking for.
Hey, that would work on me.
Why do you think I buy Mrs. Butten/vorth's?
Hey. - Hey.
Hey. - You'll never guess what just happened.
Phoebe and I got mugged! - Are you okay?
Yeah, because Phoebe knew the mugger.
How do you know a mugger?
I'm sorry, I have friends outside the six of us.
Know how she knew him? Because Phoebe used to mug people.
Seriously?
Well, I'm not proud of it, but, you know...
when I was living on the street and I needed money for food and stuff...
That is awful. - I wasn't rich like you guys, okay?
I didn't eat gold and have a flying pony.
I had a hard life. My mother was killed by a drug dealer.
Your mother killed herself. - She was a drug dealer.
It was a good thing Phoebe knew him. I was about to do some serious damage.
Okay.
This must have brought back some bad memories for you, Ross.
Why? - Well, Ross was mugged as a kid.
You were? - Yeah. And it was pretty traumatic.
It was outside St. Mark's Comics.
I was minding my business, seeing what kind of trouble Spider-Man got into.
Ahem, Wonder Woman. Ahem.
Anyway, I was heading towards this bakery...
to pick up a couple of dozen linzer tortes for someone...
when out of nowhere, this thug with a pipe jumps out and says
"Give me your money, punk!" - Oh, my God.
I know. And the worst part was they took my backpack...
which had all the original artwork I had done for my own comic book, Science Boy.
Oh, yeah! What was his superpower again?
A superhuman thirst for knowledge.
I better get to class.
Are there any more of your friends I should look out for on my way?
No. Actually, you might wanna stay away from Jane Street.
That's where Stabby Joe works.
Okay, I think we have a problem here. - What?
Well, um, back in my mugging days, I, um, worked St. Mark's Comics.
Yeah? - Well, a pipe was my weapon of choice...
and, um, preteen comic-book nerds were my meat.
So?
There was one kid who had a sticker on his backpack that said
"Geology rocks!"
Oh, my God! - I know! I mugged Ross!
You're late. - I know. I'm sorry.
But can I just run to the bathroom?
No. Leonard doesn't wait. - But I am bursting with Yoo-hoo!
Joey, here we go! Let's go. Very quickly.
I really need... - We must go now, quickly.
Yeah. Yes, sir. Ahh. - Ready?
What the hell are you still doing here? - I think you know!
Oh, you sick bastard! - I am what you made me! Know what?
What? - I could go right now.
Then go. Go! - Oh, I can't. I want to, but I can't!
Cut. That was good!
Very good. You did everything I asked. - I did?
Yes. Plus which, you've got this, I don't know, this squirmy quality...
you bring to the character I couldn't have imagined.
Wow, hey, here's what we're gonna do
Come back tomorrow for the final callbacks.
Do all of this, what you got going now. But you know what?
More. More. Can you do that?
Sure. I don't have time to say thank you because I really gotta go!
Look at that! Still in character. I like him.
I plant seeds. I can't explain it. I don't know.
Hey. What are you doing? - Hey. Putting on the sneakers...
to get in the young mindset, see if it sparks anything.
Oh, anything yet? - Yes, how's this?
"They're so uncomfortable, it's like getting kicked in the nuts for your feet."
Hey. - Hey.
You're probably wondering what I'm doing. Ha, ha.
No, that seems about right.
Yesterday at my audition, I had to pee. Apparently, that makes me a good actor.
I got a callback, so I'm drinking everything. Oh, by the way...
Mm-hm. - that eggnog in our fridge was great!
Joey, that was formula. - We gotta get more of that.
These aren't half bad. You should suggest these to Ralph Lauren.
Okay, first of all, that's stupid. Second, I'm not allowed to talk to Ralph.
All right. I feel younger already.
Yeah, I think I broke my hip.
PHOEBE: Hey, you! - Hey.
Hey. How was class?
No one ever asks me that. What's wrong?
Nothing. I really wanna know. - Oh, uh.
Well, there was actually a rather lively discussion about the Pleistocene...
All right, nothing is worth this.
Um, I have a confession to make. Um...
Okay, you know that, um, girl that mugged you when you were a kid?
What are you talking about? It wasn't a girl. It was this huge dude.
You don't have to lie anymore. I know that it was a 14-year-old girl.
No, it wasn't. - Yes, it was.
No, it wasn't. You don't think I would have defended myself against a 14-year-old...?
"Give me your money, punk!" - Oh, my God, it was you!
I can't believe it. You mugged me?
Yeah. And I'm so, so sorry, Ross. I'm sorry.
But, you know, if you think about it, it's kind of neat.
I mean, well, it's just that I've always felt kind of like an outsider.
You know, the rest of you have these connections that go way back...
and, you know, now you and I have a great one.
It's not the best!
I know. Please forgive me. I don't know what to say.
There's nothing you can say! That was the most humiliating thing ever.
Really? Even more humiliating than... - Let's not do this!
And then, at the end of the commercial, the girls get out of the hot tub...
and start making out with each other. Huh? Huh? Huh?
That's interesting.
Just one thought: You didn't mention the shoes.
Who's next? Chandler. - Okay.
You start on the image of a guy putting on the shoes.
He's about my age. - Pfft! Your age?
Uh-huh.
So he's rolling down the street and he starts to lose control.
Maybe he falls. Maybe he hurts himself.
Just then, a kid comes flying by wearing the shoes.
He jumps over the old guy and laughs. And the line reads
"Not suitable for adults."
Well, Chandler, that's great. - Oh, thank you, sir.
Or, man who's two years younger than me.
You see, that has a clear selling point. It appeals to our key demographic.
How did you come up with that? - I don't know! I don't know!
I was just trying to get into a young mindset, and stuff started to flow.
That is great. Good work. - Thank you.
We'll see all of you tomorrow.
The cold weather hurts my hip.
Hey, Ross. I know you're still mad at me, but can I just talk to you for a sec?
Sure, go ahead. Oh, sorry. Sure, go ahead.
I just really wanted to apologize again.
And also show you something I think you'll find very exciting.
Oh, my God! "Crap from the street!"
Look, Ross. In this box...
are all the things I got from mugging that I thought were too special to sell...
or smoke.
Anyway, I was looking through it, and I found...
Science Boy.
Qh, my God!
I never thought I'd see this again. - Yeah.
What...?
It's all here!
Yeah. - Ha, ha.
What made you save it all these years?
I guess I just thought it was really good.
And maybe it would be worth something one day.
You really thought Science Boy was worth saving?
Yeah. But you should know I also have a jar of Vaseline and a cat skull in here.
Still, this is amazing!
Oh, my God. Thank you, Phoebe.
You're welcome. And thank you for Science Boy. I learned a lot from him.
You're welcome.
I need an answer! - I can't tell you something I don't know.
You know! - I don't know!
I need an answer now! - You want an answer? The answer is...
Aw...
She never loved me. She only loved you.
You knew this all along and you never told me?
I can never forgive you, or myself. I have nothing to live for. Bang! And scene!
Absolutely amazing.
The part is yours. - Thanks! Now I really got to get going.
Wait, wait, wait! Congratulations. You did it.
You did it. You can relax now. Yeah.
Wow! That's a big cable bill.
Ha. You don't have a job, but you have no problem ordering porn.
On a Saturday afternoon?
I was in the house!
Hey, uh, Phoebe didn't by any chance mention that...
She was the huge guy that mugged you? Yeah.
I see. You didn't happen to tell...
Everybody we know? Yeah. - Great. Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 往好处想 你有更多的生活经历
sense_groups.english: Look at the positive. You have all this life experience.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 但是我不认为生活经历 可以帮助我这个
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I don't think life experience is gonna help me with these.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 它们就像着火了
sense_groups.english: Wow! It's like they're on fire!

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ooh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是什么？ - 样品鞋
sense_groups.english: What are they? - Prototype sneakers.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要想出该怎么卖 而我办不到
sense_groups.english: I need ideas on how to sell them. Which I can't do...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为有自尊的成人不会穿这种东西的
sense_groups.english: because no self-respecting adult would ever wear these.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给你五百块买下这双
sense_groups.english: I'll give you $500 for them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该怎么办呢？ - 别这样 步鞋很容易啦
sense_groups.english: What am I supposed to do? - Come on, sneakers are easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也常常在穿啊 - 它们现在不叫做步鞋了
sense_groups.english: You wear them all the time. - They're not called sneakers anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 改叫"溜鞋"或是"滑轮鞋" 我还听到有人说"轮鞋"
sense_groups.english: They're called "kicks" or "skids." I think I heard somebody say "slorps."

sense_groups.chinese: 它们底部有轮子突出来 让你可以滑来滑去
sense_groups.english: They've got wheels that pop out from the bottom so you can roll around...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为很显然 走路太耗费体力了
sense_groups.english: because apparently walking is too much exercise.

sense_groups.chinese: "孩子们 孩子们 向前滑到儿童肥胖区吧 "
sense_groups.english: "Kids! Kids! Roll your way to childhood obesity!"

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以帮我卖这些东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you help me try to sell these?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 有没有想过用大波霸呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Have you considered using a girl with huge knockers?

sense_groups.chinese: 那不会是他们想要的
sense_groups.english: That's not what they're looking for.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 那对我很有用喔
sense_groups.english: Hey, that would work on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想我为什么要买津津芦笋汁呢？
sense_groups.english: Why do you think I buy Mrs. Butten/vorth's?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 你不会相信刚刚发生什么事
sense_groups.english: Hey. - You'll never guess what just happened.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟我被抢了 - 你们没事吧
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and I got mugged! - Are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 因为菲比认识那捆抢匪
sense_groups.english: Yeah, because Phoebe knew the mugger.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么会认识抢匪呢？
sense_groups.english: How do you know a mugger?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 除了我们六个人之外 我还是有其他朋友的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I have friends outside the six of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他们是怎么认识的吗？因为菲比以前也是在抢劫别人
sense_groups.english: Know how she knew him? Because Phoebe used to mug people.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Seriously?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不觉得很光荣 但是你们知道的
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not proud of it, but, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 当我流落街头的时候 我也需要钱买食物之类的东西
sense_groups.english: when I was living on the street and I needed money for food and stuff...

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太糟糕了 - 我不像你们那么有钱 好吗？
sense_groups.english: That is awful. - I wasn't rich like you guys, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有金汤匙也没有飞天马
sense_groups.english: I didn't eat gold and have a flying pony.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的生活很苦 我妈被毒贩给杀了
sense_groups.english: I had a hard life. My mother was killed by a drug dealer.

sense_groups.chinese: 你妈是自杀的 - 她自己就是毒贩
sense_groups.english: Your mother killed herself. - She was a drug dealer.

sense_groups.chinese: 幸好菲比认识他 否则我会让他死得很难看
sense_groups.english: It was a good thing Phoebe knew him. I was about to do some serious damage.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一定让你想起不好的回忆 罗斯
sense_groups.english: This must have brought back some bad memories for you, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 罗斯小时候被抢过
sense_groups.english: Why? - Well, Ross was mugged as a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 是的 受到非常严重的创伤
sense_groups.english: You were? - Yeah. And it was pretty traumatic.

sense_groups.chinese: 就在漫画王外面
sense_groups.english: It was outside St. Mark's Comics.

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在做我自己的事 看蜘珠人又惹上什么麻烦了
sense_groups.english: I was minding my business, seeing what kind of trouble Spider-Man got into.

sense_groups.chinese: 是神力女超人
sense_groups.english: Ahem, Wonder Woman. Ahem.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正 我正在要去面包店的路上
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I was heading towards this bakery...

sense_groups.chinese: 帮某人买几个蛋糕
sense_groups.english: to pick up a couple of dozen linzer tortes for someone...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后不知道从哪里冒出来的恶棍 拿着一条管子跳出来说…
sense_groups.english: when out of nowhere, this thug with a pipe jumps out and says

sense_groups.chinese: "小子 钱交出来" - 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: "Give me your money, punk!" - Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 最糟糕的是 他们抢走了我的背包
sense_groups.english: I know. And the worst part was they took my backpack...

sense_groups.chinese: 里面有我自己画的漫画 《科学小子》
sense_groups.english: which had all the original artwork I had done for my own comic book, Science Boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 他的超能力是什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah! What was his superpower again?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个渴望知识的超人
sense_groups.english: A superhuman thirst for knowledge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要赶去上课了
sense_groups.english: I better get to class.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有其他朋友 我需要小心的吗 菲比？
sense_groups.english: Are there any more of your friends I should look out for on my way?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 事实上 你或许得离詹恩街远点
sense_groups.english: No. Actually, you might wanna stay away from Jane Street.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是刺客乔的地盘
sense_groups.english: That's where Stabby Joe works.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们有麻烦了 - 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Okay, I think we have a problem here. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 在我当抢匪的时候 漫画王是我的地盘
sense_groups.english: Well, um, back in my mugging days, I, um, worked St. Mark's Comics.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？ - 我用的武器是管子
sense_groups.english: Yeah? - Well, a pipe was my weapon of choice...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且小孩子 漫画书虫 都是我的目标
sense_groups.english: and, um, preteen comic-book nerds were my meat.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？
sense_groups.english: So?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一个小孩子 在背包上有张贴纸写着…
sense_groups.english: There was one kid who had a sticker on his backpack that said

sense_groups.chinese: 地质学酷毙了 地质学酷毙了
sense_groups.english: "Geology rocks!"

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 - 我知道 我抢了罗斯
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! - I know! I mugged Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 你迟到了 - 我知道 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: You're late. - I know. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我可以先去上厕所吗？
sense_groups.english: But can I just run to the bathroom?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 李奥是不等人的 - 但是我快尿出来了
sense_groups.english: No. Leonard doesn't wait. - But I am bursting with Yoo-hoo!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 来吧 我们开始 快一点
sense_groups.english: Joey, here we go! Let's go. Very quickly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的想要… - 我们现在就得开始 快点
sense_groups.english: I really need... - We must go now, quickly.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 是的 - 好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yes, sir. Ahh. - Ready?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还在这里做什么呢？ - 我想你知道
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you still doing here? - I think you know!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 你该死的浑蛋 - 这都是你造成的 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, you sick bastard! - I am what you made me! Know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我可以现在就走
sense_groups.english: What? - I could go right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就走 走啊 - 喔 我不行 我很想 但是我不行
sense_groups.english: Then go. Go! - Oh, I can't. I want to, but I can't!

sense_groups.chinese: 停 演得好
sense_groups.english: Cut. That was good!

sense_groups.chinese: 非常精釆 你做到我的要求了 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Very good. You did everything I asked. - I did?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 而且你把这种扭曲的特质…
sense_groups.english: Yes. Plus which, you've got this, I don't know, this squirmy quality...

sense_groups.chinese: 加入到这个角色中 我想都没想过
sense_groups.english: you bring to the character I couldn't have imagined.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们接下来可以这样…
sense_groups.english: Wow, hey, here's what we're gonna do

sense_groups.chinese: 明天过来参加最后的试演
sense_groups.english: Come back tomorrow for the final callbacks.

sense_groups.chinese: 照你今天演的 但是你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Do all of this, what you got going now. But you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 加强 再加强 你可以吗？
sense_groups.english: More. More. Can you do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我没有时间说谢了 我真的得走了
sense_groups.english: Sure. I don't have time to say thank you because I really gotta go!

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧他 还那么入戏 我喜欢他
sense_groups.english: Look at that! Still in character. I like him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我播了种 快得无法解释 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I plant seeds. I can't explain it. I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你在做什么？ - 在试穿步鞋
sense_groups.english: Hey. What are you doing? - Hey. Putting on the sneakers...

sense_groups.chinese: 融入年轻人的世界 看会不会激发出什么点子
sense_groups.english: to get in the young mindset, see if it sparks anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 想出什么了吗？ - 是的 听听看这个
sense_groups.english: Oh, anything yet? - Yes, how's this?

sense_groups.chinese: "它们舒服到就像是 被脚踢到蛋蛋一样"
sense_groups.english: "They're so uncomfortable, it's like getting kicked in the nuts for your feet."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能很纳闷 不知道我在做什么
sense_groups.english: You're probably wondering what I'm doing. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 看起来很正常
sense_groups.english: No, that seems about right.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨天在试演的时候我好想尿尿 很明显地 那让我演的很棒
sense_groups.english: Yesterday at my audition, I had to pee. Apparently, that makes me a good actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以参加最后试演 所以我要喝多一点东西 对了
sense_groups.english: I got a callback, so I'm drinking everything. Oh, by the way...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们冰箱里面的蛋奶实在太好喝了
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm. - that eggnog in our fridge was great!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 那是特调婴儿奶粉 - 我们一定要多买- 些
sense_groups.english: Joey, that was formula. - We gotta get more of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些东西挺不错的 你应该要向洛夫罗伦推荐
sense_groups.english: These aren't half bad. You should suggest these to Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 第一 那很蠢 再来 他们不允许我跟洛夫说话
sense_groups.english: Okay, first of all, that's stupid. Second, I'm not allowed to talk to Ralph.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我已经开始觉得年轻多了
sense_groups.english: All right. I feel younger already.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我摔伤臀部了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think I broke my hip.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你来了 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: PHOEBE: Hey, you! - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 课上得怎样？
sense_groups.english: Hey. How was class?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人这样问过我 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No one ever asks me that. What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 我真的想知道而已 - 喔
sense_groups.english: Nothing. I really wanna know. - Oh, uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们针对更新世 有很热烈的讨论
sense_groups.english: Well, there was actually a rather lively discussion about the Pleistocene...

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我不需要这样折磨自己
sense_groups.english: All right, nothing is worth this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有件事需要对你坦白
sense_groups.english: Um, I have a confession to make. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你记得那个在你小时候 抢劫过你的女生吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you know that, um, girl that mugged you when you were a kid?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么呢？那不是女生 是个高壮的男生
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? It wasn't a girl. It was this huge dude.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要说谎了 我知道是个十四岁女生
sense_groups.english: You don't have to lie anymore. I know that it was a 14-year-old girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是 - 是 是的
sense_groups.english: No, it wasn't. - Yes, it was.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我不会反抗 一个十四岁女生吗？
sense_groups.english: No, it wasn't. You don't think I would have defended myself against a 14-year-old...?

sense_groups.chinese: "小子 钱交出来" - 我的天 那是你
sense_groups.english: "Give me your money, punk!" - Oh, my God, it was you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我真不敢相信 你抢劫我
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it. You mugged me?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 而且我很抱歉 罗斯 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And I'm so, so sorry, Ross. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是如果你仔细想想 这倒是有点酷
sense_groups.english: But, you know, if you think about it, it's kind of neat.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我常常觉得我像是个局外人
sense_groups.english: I mean, well, it's just that I've always felt kind of like an outsider.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们其他的人都彼此认识很久了
sense_groups.english: You know, the rest of you have these connections that go way back...

sense_groups.chinese: 而现在 你跟我也有老交情了
sense_groups.english: and, you know, now you and I have a great one.

sense_groups.chinese: 这并不是好事
sense_groups.english: It's not the best!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 请原谅我 我不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: I know. Please forgive me. I don't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用说什么 那是我这辈子 最可耻的事了
sense_groups.english: There's nothing you can say! That was the most humiliating thing ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至比… - 我们不要说了
sense_groups.english: Really? Even more humiliating than... - Let's not do this!

sense_groups.chinese: 然后在广告结尾 女孩子们离开浴池
sense_groups.english: And then, at the end of the commercial, the girls get out of the hot tub...

sense_groups.chinese: 开始一起亲热
sense_groups.english: and start making out with each other. Huh? Huh? Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 有趣
sense_groups.english: That's interesting.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便提一下 你没有提到鞋子
sense_groups.english: Just one thought: You didn't mention the shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一个是谁？钱德
sense_groups.english: Who's next? Chandler. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 一开始有梱男的穿上这鞋
sense_groups.english: You start on the image of a guy putting on the shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他大约是我的年纪 - 你的年纪？
sense_groups.english: He's about my age. - Pfft! Your age?

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh.

sense_groups.chinese: 他在街上滑行着 接着就失去控制
sense_groups.english: So he's rolling down the street and he starts to lose control.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许他跌例了 或者受伤了
sense_groups.english: Maybe he falls. Maybe he hurts himself.

sense_groups.chinese: 就在这时候 有个小孩 穿着这双鞋飞过去
sense_groups.english: Just then, a kid comes flying by wearing the shoes.

sense_groups.chinese: 他跳过那个老男人 然后大笑 接着广告词出现…
sense_groups.english: He jumps over the old guy and laughs. And the line reads

sense_groups.chinese: "成人不宜"
sense_groups.english: "Not suitable for adults."

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 这个很棒 - 谢谢你 先生
sense_groups.english: Well, Chandler, that's great. - Oh, thank you, sir.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是 比我小两岁的人
sense_groups.english: Or, man who's two years younger than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们瞧 销售讯息很清楚 抓住了我们主要客户群的心态
sense_groups.english: You see, that has a clear selling point. It appeals to our key demographic.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是怎么想出来的呢？ - 我不知道 我不知道
sense_groups.english: How did you come up with that? - I don't know! I don't know!

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是设法用年轻的心态去思考 然后点子就出现了
sense_groups.english: I was just trying to get into a young mindset, and stuff started to flow.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 做得好 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: That is great. Good work. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们大家明天见
sense_groups.english: We'll see all of you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 冷天让我的臀部很痛
sense_groups.english: The cold weather hurts my hip.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 我知道你还在生我的气 但是我可以跟你谈一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. I know you're still mad at me, but can I just talk to you for a sec?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 说吧 喔 等等 当然 说吧
sense_groups.english: Sure, go ahead. Oh, sorry. Sure, go ahead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的想要再次跟你道歉
sense_groups.english: I just really wanted to apologize again.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且让你看些 你会觉得很兴奋的东西
sense_groups.english: And also show you something I think you'll find very exciting.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 "街上的垃圾 "
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! "Crap from the street!"

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 罗斯 在这箱子里
sense_groups.english: Look, Ross. In this box...

sense_groups.chinese: 都是在抢来的东西之中 我觉得太特别 而不想卖掉…
sense_groups.english: are all the things I got from mugging that I thought were too special to sell...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是烧掉的东西
sense_groups.english: or smoke.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正 我在整理时发现了…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, I was looking through it, and I found...

sense_groups.chinese: 《科学小子》
sense_groups.english: Science Boy.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Qh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我从没想过我会再见到它 - 是的
sense_groups.english: I never thought I'd see this again. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What...?

sense_groups.chinese: 全部都在里面
sense_groups.english: It's all here!

sense_groups.chinese: 是 - 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么这些年都留着它呢？
sense_groups.english: What made you save it all these years?

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我只是觉得它很棒
sense_groups.english: I guess I just thought it was really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且或许有一天会很值钱
sense_groups.english: And maybe it would be worth something one day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的认为《科学小子》值得收藏？
sense_groups.english: You really thought Science Boy was worth saving?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 但是你应该知道 我还留了一罐凡士林跟一副猫骨头
sense_groups.english: Yeah. But you should know I also have a jar of Vaseline and a cat skull in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管 这还是很今人惊喜
sense_groups.english: Still, this is amazing!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 谢谢你 菲比
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Thank you, Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用客气 谢谢你的科学小子 我从他身上学到很多

questions.en:
Have you seen our bank statement? Can this be right?
I know. God, I haven't seen my savings take a hit like this...
since I was a kid and they came up with Double Stuf Oreos.
What happened to all of our money? - Well, I'm not sure exactly what they did...
but I'm inclined to blame Enron.
Well, I guess with you doing the internship...
we're just spending more than we're bringing in.
Yeah, maybe I should quit and get a job that pays.
But you're finally doing something that you love.
I mean, I can't ask you to give that up.
Although it would be nice if the thing that you loved was, you know, finding gold.
You know what? I think we're making too big a deal out of this.
Okay? So we pay our bills late this month.
Maybe next month, we cut back on a few things.
And maybe we start eating out of Joey's refrigerator for a change.
You're a chef. What can you make out of baking soda and beer?
All right. Worst-case scenario is, we borrow some money from my parents.
No, we're not borrowing money.
Why not? - Because we don't do that. We are Bings.
If there's one thing my father taught me, it was...
well, to always knock before going into the pool house.
But the other thing was, never borrow money.
Wow, I had no idea you had this much pride.
That's right, I do. I am your man.
And I'm gonna get us through this situation...
even if it means you working twice as hard.
I'm gonna go. - Why?
I haven't been home in a couple days and I need to get more clothes.
You don't have to go. I have something that'll fit you.
I put that tube top on as a joke.
I want you to stay. - I want to stay too.
But I've got as much use out of these boxers as I can.
Why don't you turn them inside... - Done it.
I'll be back in a couple of hours. - All right. I'll miss you.
Me too.
You know what? I just realized something. I don't want to go home.
Great! Okay, I'll go get the tube top. - No, no, what I mean is...
I hate going back to my apartment now. - Mm-hm.
Partly because I live above a known crack den...
but, you know, mostly because when I'm there, I really miss you.
So...
do you want to move in together?
Wow, Mike Hannigan...
you sure know how to make a girl say "Hell, yeah."
So we're doing it? - Yeah, let's do it. Let's live together.
Wow. We're really gonna move in together?
Yeah.
I've always wanted to live with a guy.
Pick up your socks. Put down the toilet seat.
No, we are not having sex anymore.
It's gonna be fun.
Hey, JOEY- - Hey.
Listen, I need to know that what I'm about to ask you...
will never get back to Chandler.
I'd be lying if I said I hadn't thought about it myself.
But Chandler is my best friend. It would be wrong.
Good, but wrong.
Okay, first of all, it would be great.
But that's not what I'm here to talk to you about. I need to borrow money.
Oh, I don't know, Monica. You know...
lending friends money is always a mistake.
But Chandler lent you money. - And he would tell you it was a mistake.
Come on, I just... I need it for some rent and some other bills.
Oh, well... Well, how much?
Two thousand dollars? - Two thousand dollars?
What do you think I am, a soap-opera star?
Yeah. - That's right, I am.
Hi, you guys. - Hey.
What's in the bag? - You know how Emma started crawling?
I realized that this place is very unsafe for a baby...
so I went to the store and I got some stuff to baby-proof the apartment.
Oh, God, baby-proofing.
Why is it such a big deal now? You know, when I was a kid, it was like
"Whoops, Joey fell down the stairs."
Or, "Whoops, Joey electrocuted himself again."
Anyway, um, are you going to get a handyman to install this stuff?
No, I was just gonna do it myself. - Ha, ha.
You're gonna do it'? - Yeah. Why?
You don't think a woman can do this? - Women can. You can't.
Monica, will you please tell Joey that he is a pig.
You're a pig. And you can't do this. - What?
What? Come on, I found the hardware store all by myself.
The hardware store's right down the street.
There is a hardware store right down the street?
Hey, you guys? Okay, we've got great news.
Phoebe and I are moving in together. - Congratulations.
I know, it's so exciting. You know, I've never lived with a guy before.
Well, it's just like living with a girl, only they don't steal your makeup.
Unless they're playing "This ls What My Sister Would Look Like."
Yeah, she's not so cute.
I'm gonna go to the bathroom. - Well, you put down the toilet seat.
Yes, dear.
Is that a bit you guys do? - Uh-huh. We're playing you two.
We don't do that. Tell her we don't do that.
Yes, dear.
I can't believe you're moving in together. That's gre... I'm happy for you guys.
I hear wedding bells. - Monica, slow down, okay?
I'm just excited to be living with him.
You know, I mean, I don't know...
can I see someday being married to Mike? Sure. Yeah.
You know, I could picture myself walking down the aisle...
in a wedding dress that highlights my breasts in an obvious yet classy way.
But do I want that house in Connecticut, you know, near the good schools...
where Mike and I could send little Sophie and Mike Jr.?
Oh, my God, I do.
Phoebe, I had no idea you were so conventional.
I know. I guess I am.
Oh, my God, load up the Volvo, I want to be a soccer mom.
You ready to go? - Yeah, you bet, roomie.
Don't you mean "groomie"?
What are you talking about? - Please.
These guys. We haven't even moved in yet...
and they have us picking out china patterns.
China patterns!
This is easy. "Can't do this..."
Wow, seriously. Can't do this.
Hey, Joe. - Hey.
Listen, um, I need to ask you a favor,and we can't tell Monica anything about it.
I thought you guys didn't have secrets. - That will remain the official party line.
Look, Monica and I are having a little financial trouble.
Yeah, I know. - What? What do you mean, you "know"?
Uh...
I just figured it out, you know?
I mean, you're not working and, uh, the economy is bad.
Oh, right.
That is the fastest I have ever thought.
Anyway, uh...
I need to borrow some money.
Oh, sure. Yeah, how much? Two thousand dollars?
Yes, $2000 exactly. How did you know that?
Uh, well, I know how much you used to make...and I know how much your rent is.
Oh, okay.
I am on fire.
Listen, this is really nice.
Did you write a check to Monica for $2000?
Did Monica borrow money from you?
Uh, kind of. - I can't believe her.
Did she tell you we were having money problems?
No, no, no. It wasn't because of your money problems.
It was for something for her.
What?
Something personal.
What would she get for $2000 that she wouldn't tell me about?
Excuse me.
Boob job.
I don't want her to get a boob job. That's crazy.
Well, it's not that crazy, okay?
Making them smaller, that would be crazy.
Oh, hey, I wanted to ask you about Monica's little "groomie" joke.
Well, I think the reason people laughed is that it's a play on the word "roomie."
No...
I get the joke. Sophisticated as it was.
No, the thing I want to say is...
Maybe we should've talked about this before.
Us living together, you're not expecting a proposal, right?
Oh, no, no. Not at all. - Okay.
We're just moving in right now. We'll see where it goes.
Yeah, well, that's the thing. For me, it's as far as it can ever go.
What do you mean? - Look, Phoebe, I...
I love you very much. But I never want to get married again.
Oh.
Wow. - It's just, my first marriage was...
you know, such a disaster that I kind of lost faith in the whole idea.
Mm-hm. Was it really that bad? - At one point, near the end...
she deliberately defecated on my... - Okay, well, that's bad. Yeah.
But don't you think it might be different with someone else? Perhaps...
a blond who always uses the toilet?
Except for once in the ocean.
Look, it's not about who I would marry.
I was certain the first time I got married it would last forever. I was wrong.
But, it just... - Look, Phoebe, it's not about you.
I just never want to get married again.
Ah. - I'm sorry.
Are you okay with that? If not, maybe us moving in together isn't the best idea.
No. Oh, I definitely don't want to get married.
No, I just wanted to make sure you didn't want to, too.
Because, you know, if we move in and you start changing your mind...
there is gonna be hell to pay, mister.
Trust me. I will never... - Yeah, I get that. Yeah.
Hi. So you gave in and decided to call someone?
Yeah. I don't know who I was kidding. I can barely use chopsticks.
You're all set. - Oh, thank you so much.
Wait. You forgot your, um...
Your game.
Thank you.
Hey, Rach. There she is, my perfectly proportioned wife.
Don't look at me. I never get his jokes.
Thank you? - No, no. Don't thank me.
Thank you. Do you know there is not one thing that I would change about you?
Not one single thing. And definitely not...
two single things.
Okay, you're being weird. Do you want sex...
or did you do something bad?
No. No. No. I just love the way you look. I am warm...
for your form.
Okay, um, you know the old classics like, you know, "You look nice"?
They're still okay.
But "you look nice" could mean that I'm saying, "Your face looks nice."
I want to compliment your body.
I mean, I wouldn't change it at all.
And more specifically, I wouldn't want anything to get any bigger.
Okay. - I mean...
you wouldn't want any part of me to get any bigger, would you?
Don't answer that.
Just when you thought that dude couldn't get any weirder.
I know. Why do you think he was so worried about me getting bigger?
I don't know. I mean, what brought that on'?
Oh, my God. Oh, my God. You know what? We're trying to get pregnant...
so he's probably starting to freak out that my body's gonna change.
You think that's what it is? - You heard him.
"No bigger. You're perfect. Just don't get any bigger."
My God, he sounded just like my high-school wrestling coach.
I'm gonna have to talk to Chandler. - Yeah. If you don't, I will.
Of course your body's gonna change. Your breasts are gonna get bigger...
your ass is gonna get bigger...
you're gonna lose bladder control.
God, it's just such a magical time.
Hi. - Hey.
Listen, I wanted to ask you something about marriage.
Now you're seeking me out to make jokes?
I mean, I can see if we're all hanging out, but to come to my home...
No, I really want to know how you feel about it.
Why? - Mike doesn't ever want to get married.
Never? - Never.
Wow. Are you still gonna move in with him?
I want to, but I wanted you to tell me that marriage really isn't that big a deal.
You know, that I won't be missing out on anything. That marriage stinks.
Yeah, marriage stinks.
I mean, if you want to see a man gain weight and a woman stop shaving...
get them married.
That's not how you really feel, is it? - No, I'm sorry.
Look, I know it's not what you want to hear, but I can't help it.
I love marriage.
Seriously, you? Divorce-0?
If you have to call me a name, I'd prefer "Ross, the Divorcer." It's just cooler.
Look, look, I know my marriages didn't exactly work out...
but, you know, I loved being that committed to another person.
And Carol and I had some good times before she became a lesbian.
And once afterward.
Anyway, I'm sorry.
Ugh. It's okay. That's how you feel.
But, come on, I mean, living together will be great.
I mean, you guys have so much fun. And you love Mike.
I do love Mike. - Yeah, see?
And you were so excited about moving in together before...
and you know what? You should be. It's a big deal.
Yeah, I guess you're right.
Yeah, thanks. This helped. Thanks.
The Divorcer to the rescue.
It's not cooler. - Yeah, I just heard it.
Oh.
Rash?
Rachel?
So I can't do anything I like?
Hey, Rach.
Ah, perfection. Wouldn't change a thing. Not a thing.
Honey? - Yeah?
About that.
Um, I'm going to change. - Yes, but, honey, you don't have to.
I'm gonna get bigger.
Honey, I...
I love your breasts the way they are.

Your ass?

God, why? Why would you want to do that to yourself?
I thought it was something that we both wanted.

but the giant ass and the big clown feet?
Oh, my God, Chandler.

with the blood and screaming and the little person that's shooting out of her?

Right.

Someday.
And hernia.

But it feels like now it's my turn to have some of the regular stuff.

I wanna live with you too. I mean, let's do that.
But I don't think I can.
It was okay to move in when I didn't know what was gonna happen.
But I can't move in knowing nothing is ever gonna happen.

Are you gonna change yours?
No.
Me neither.
Um, I think I need to be with someone who wants what I want.

No, I don't want it to end either.
I can't believe this is gonna end.
I guess I'll have my stuff picked up.
Yeah. Okay.
Okay, so, uh...

Take it easy, Mike. - Bye, Mike. See you later, Mike.
I'm so sorry, Pheebs.
We're all sorry.
Look on the bright side.
I mean, at least you won't have to live with this ugly chair.

I love you.
I did it! I did it! Ha, ha!

Hey, Pheebs? You know,I'm really glad you came to talk to me the other day...
and I hope I was a little helpful. - Oh, yeah, you were helpful.
Yeah. No, thank you. - Good. Good.
Because the more I thought about it, the more I realized...
I don't think marriage is necessarily the right path for you.
What do you mean?
I know the other day in the coffeehouse...
you were all caught up in the whole soccer-mom thing...
but is that really you? I mean, can you honestly picture yourself in a Volvo?
They are awfully boxy.
I mean, I don't know, you'd be so bored with marriage. I mean, it's so normal.
Uh-huh. Yeah.
Hey, can I help?
Well, we climbed up four flights of stairs, maneuvered a narrow hallway...
dodged a rabid pit bull.But these last three feet are where it gets really tricky.
You know, sometimes your words, they hurt.
Hey, where do you guys want this?
Yeah, seriously, because this is really heavy.
I mean, not for me, because I'm only pretending to hold it, but for these guys.
Just one last time on the marriage thing. There's no wiggle room? None at all?
No, but you don't want to get married either, right?
Right.
Except that I do want to get married.
Couldn't have had this conversation down at the truck, huh?
What? You want to get married?
Someday.
And hernia.
I haven't had a normal life.And I never felt like I was missing out on anything.
But it feels like now it's my turn to have some of the regular stuff.
If you wanted to get married, why didn't you say something before?
Because I didn't know how much I wanted it.
And I love you, and I wanted to live with you.
I wanna live with you too. I mean, let's do that.
But I don't think I can.
It was okay to move in when I didn't know what was gonna happen.
But I can't move in knowing nothing is ever gonna happen.
Can we at least try living together? You might change your mind about marriage.
Are you gonna change yours?
No.
Me neither.
Um, I think I need to be with someone who wants what I want.
But I don't want this to end.
No, I don't want it to end either.
I can't believe this is gonna end.
I guess I'll have my stuff picked up.
Yeah. Okay.
Okay, so, uh...
Good bye.
Take it easy, Mike. - Bye, Mike. See you later, Mike.
I'm so sorry, Pheebs.
We're all sorry.
Look on the bright side.
I mean, at least you won't have to live with this ugly chair.
That was here already, huh?
I love you.
I did it! I did it! Ha, ha!
All right.
I'd better take all I can carry.
Who knows when I'll be able to get in here again, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看过我们的银行对帐单了吗？没错吗？
sense_groups.english: Have you seen our bank statement? Can this be right?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是嘛 天啊 从我小时候双层夹心饼上市之后…
sense_groups.english: I know. God, I haven't seen my savings take a hit like this...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的存款就没这么少过
sense_groups.english: since I was a kid and they came up with Double Stuf Oreos.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的钱跑哪去了呢？ - 我不清楚他们做了什么…
sense_groups.english: What happened to all of our money? - Well, I'm not sure exactly what they did...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我倾向于责怪恩隆案
sense_groups.english: but I'm inclined to blame Enron.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想是因为你在做实习工作
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess with you doing the internship...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们花的比赚的还多
sense_groups.english: we're just spending more than we're bringing in.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 或许我应该辞掉 然后找个有薪水的工作
sense_groups.english: Yeah, maybe I should quit and get a job that pays.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你终于找到你喜欢的工作了
sense_groups.english: But you're finally doing something that you love.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我不能要求你放弃
sense_groups.english: I mean, I can't ask you to give that up.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过如果你喜欢做的事 是淘金 那就会好多了
sense_groups.english: Although it would be nice if the thing that you loved was, you know, finding gold.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我们太小题大作了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I think we're making too big a deal out of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们这个月会比较紧
sense_groups.english: Okay? So we pay our bills late this month.

sense_groups.chinese: 下个月我们就节省一些开销
sense_groups.english: Maybe next month, we cut back on a few things.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且或许我们可以改变一下 到乔伊家的冰箱找食物
sense_groups.english: And maybe we start eating out of Joey's refrigerator for a change.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是厨师 你可以用苏打粉跟啤酒做出什么呢？
sense_groups.english: You're a chef. What can you make out of baking soda and beer?

sense_groups.chinese: 最糟糕的情况下 我们只好跟我父母借钱
sense_groups.english: All right. Worst-case scenario is, we borrow some money from my parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我们不借钱
sense_groups.english: No, we're not borrowing money.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不行？ - 因为我们不那样做 我们是宾家的人
sense_groups.english: Why not? - Because we don't do that. We are Bings.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸有教过我
sense_groups.english: If there's one thing my father taught me, it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 在进入撞球间时一定要先敲门
sense_groups.english: well, to always knock before going into the pool house.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 永远都不要借钱
sense_groups.english: But the other thing was, never borrow money.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你是如此有荣誉感
sense_groups.english: Wow, I had no idea you had this much pride.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 我就是 我是你男人
sense_groups.english: That's right, I do. I am your man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会让我们度过难关的
sense_groups.english: And I'm gonna get us through this situation...

sense_groups.chinese: 就算要你加倍努力工作也是
sense_groups.english: even if it means you working twice as hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要回去了 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有好几天没有回家了 而且我需要多拿几件衣服
sense_groups.english: I haven't been home in a couple days and I need to get more clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用回去 我有衣服可以给你穿
sense_groups.english: You don't have to go. I have something that'll fit you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我穿女生的紧身衣是为了好玩
sense_groups.english: I put that tube top on as a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要你留下来 - 我也想要留下来
sense_groups.english: I want you to stay. - I want to stay too.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我已经不能再穿这几件内裤了
sense_groups.english: But I've got as much use out of these boxers as I can.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不反过来再穿呢？ - 已经反过了
sense_groups.english: Why don't you turn them inside... - Done it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我几个小时之后就回来 - 好吧 我会想你的
sense_groups.english: I'll be back in a couple of hours. - All right. I'll miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我刚惊觉到一件事 我不想要回家
sense_groups.english: You know what? I just realized something. I don't want to go home.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 好的 我去拿紧身衣 - 不 我的意思是…
sense_groups.english: Great! Okay, I'll go get the tube top. - No, no, what I mean is...

sense_groups.chinese: 我不喜欢回去自己的公寓 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I hate going back to my apartment now. - Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 一方面是因为我住在一间脏乱的小房间里面
sense_groups.english: Partly because I live above a known crack den...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 主要是因为我回去的时候 我真的好想你
sense_groups.english: but, you know, mostly because when I'm there, I really miss you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So...

sense_groups.chinese: 你想不想搬一起住呢？
sense_groups.english: do you want to move in together?

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 麦克汉尼根
sense_groups.english: Wow, Mike Hannigan...

sense_groups.chinese: 你倒是挺清楚要如何 让女生说"好"
sense_groups.english: you sure know how to make a girl say "Hell, yeah."

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们要这样做吗？ - 好啊 就这样做 我们- 起住
sense_groups.english: So we're doing it? - Yeah, let's do it. Let's live together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真的要同居吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow. We're really gonna move in together?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都想要跟男生同居
sense_groups.english: I've always wanted to live with a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 袜子捡起来 马桶坐垫放下来
sense_groups.english: Pick up your socks. Put down the toilet seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我再也不跟你做爱了
sense_groups.english: No, we are not having sex anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会很好玩
sense_groups.english: It's gonna be fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, JOEY- - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我需要你保证 我接下来要问你的事…
sense_groups.english: Listen, I need to know that what I'm about to ask you...

sense_groups.chinese: 不会被钱德知道
sense_groups.english: will never get back to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果说我没有想过那件事 我就是在说谎
sense_groups.english: I'd be lying if I said I hadn't thought about it myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是钱德是我最好的朋友 那是不对的
sense_groups.english: But Chandler is my best friend. It would be wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 感觉不错 却是不对的
sense_groups.english: Good, but wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 首先 感觉会是棒透了
sense_groups.english: Okay, first of all, it would be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那不是我想跟你说的事 我需要跟你借钱
sense_groups.english: But that's not what I'm here to talk to you about. I need to borrow money.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我不知道 摩妮卡 你知道的
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know, Monica. You know...

sense_groups.chinese: 借钱给朋友不是什么好事
sense_groups.english: lending friends money is always a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 但钱德借过你钱 - 而他也会告诉你那不是什么好事
sense_groups.english: But Chandler lent you money. - And he would tell you it was a mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我只是… 我需要付房租跟一些帐单
sense_groups.english: Come on, I just... I need it for some rent and some other bills.

sense_groups.chinese: 多少钱呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, well... Well, how much?

sense_groups.chinese: 两千块 - 两千块？
sense_groups.english: Two thousand dollars? - Two thousand dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为我是谁？肥皂剧明星吗？
sense_groups.english: What do you think I am, a soap-opera star?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 - 没错 我就是
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - That's right, I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你们好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 袋子里面是什么？ - 你们都知道艾玛已经开始会爬了
sense_groups.english: What's in the bag? - You know how Emma started crawling?

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现这地方对婴儿而言 是很不安全的
sense_groups.english: I realized that this place is very unsafe for a baby...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我去店里买了一些东西 来让公寓更适合婴儿活动
sense_groups.english: so I went to the store and I got some stuff to baby-proof the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊 适合婴儿
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, baby-proofing.

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么了不起的呢？我小的时候 常常都…
sense_groups.english: Why is it such a big deal now? You know, when I was a kid, it was like

sense_groups.chinese: "哇 乔伊跌下楼梯了"
sense_groups.english: "Whoops, Joey fell down the stairs."

sense_groups.chinese: 或是"哇 乔伊又电到自己了"
sense_groups.english: Or, "Whoops, Joey electrocuted himself again."

sense_groups.chinese: 你要找人帮忙安装这些东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Anyway, um, are you going to get a handyman to install this stuff?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我自己来就行了 - 哈 哈
sense_groups.english: No, I was just gonna do it myself. - Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 你要自己来？ - 是啊 不行吗？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna do it'? - Yeah. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得女人不可能自己做吗？ - 女人可以 你不行
sense_groups.english: You don't think a woman can do this? - Women can. You can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 可以请你告诉乔伊 他是猪吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica, will you please tell Joey that he is a pig.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是猪 而你不会做 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: You're a pig. And you can't do this. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 我自己找到五金店的
sense_groups.english: What? Come on, I found the hardware store all by myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 那间店就在街尾
sense_groups.english: The hardware store's right down the street.

sense_groups.chinese: 街尾就有一间五金店吗？
sense_groups.english: There is a hardware store right down the street?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 各位 我们有好消息要宣布
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys? Okay, we've got great news.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟我要一起同居了 - 恭喜了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and I are moving in together. - Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 好兴奋 我从来都没有跟男生同居过
sense_groups.english: I know, it's so exciting. You know, I've never lived with a guy before.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 那就像跟女生一起住一样 只是他们不会偷用你的化妆品
sense_groups.english: Well, it's just like living with a girl, only they don't steal your makeup.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非他们是在玩 "我妹妹就是长这样"
sense_groups.english: Unless they're playing "This ls What My Sister Would Look Like."

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 她不太可爱
sense_groups.english: Yeah, she's not so cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要上洗手间 - 上完把马桶坐垫放下来
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go to the bathroom. - Well, you put down the toilet seat.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Yes, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是你们在玩的游戏吗？ - 是啊 我们在模仿你们俩个
sense_groups.english: Is that a bit you guys do? - Uh-huh. We're playing you two.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没有那样 告诉她我们没有
sense_groups.english: We don't do that. Tell her we don't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Yes, dear.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你们要同居了 我真替你们高兴
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you're moving in together. That's gre... I'm happy for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听到婚礼进行曲了 - 摩妮卡 别急好吗？
sense_groups.english: I hear wedding bells. - Monica, slow down, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是很兴奋要跟他一起住而已
sense_groups.english: I'm just excited to be living with him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 我是说 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: You know, I mean, I don't know...

sense_groups.chinese: 我能预见有天跟麦克结婚吗？是的 当然
sense_groups.english: can I see someday being married to Mike? Sure. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以想像自己 穿着婚纱走在红毯上
sense_groups.english: You know, I could picture myself walking down the aisle...

sense_groups.chinese: 婚纱以很明显 但高雅的方式 集中突出我的胸部
sense_groups.english: in a wedding dress that highlights my breasts in an obvious yet classy way.

sense_groups.chinese: 但问我想不想要在康乃狄克州 有好学区的房子…
sense_groups.english: But do I want that house in Connecticut, you know, near the good schools...

sense_groups.chinese: 让麦克跟我送我们的 小苏菲跟小麦克去上学？
sense_groups.english: where Mike and I could send little Sophie and Mike Jr.?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天 我好想
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我不晓得你是这么传统的人
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I had no idea you were so conventional.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我是的
sense_groups.english: I know. I guess I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 开着富豪汽车 大包小包的 我要变成足球妈妈了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, load up the Volvo, I want to be a soccer mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备好要走了吗？ - 当然好罗 新室友
sense_groups.english: You ready to go? - Yeah, you bet, roomie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说"新郎"吧
sense_groups.english: Don't you mean "groomie"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？ - 拜托
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? - Please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都还没一起住
sense_groups.english: These guys. We haven't even moved in yet...

sense_groups.chinese: 而他们就要我们选结婚礼物了
sense_groups.english: and they have us picking out china patterns.

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚礼物
sense_groups.english: China patterns!

sense_groups.chinese: 这很容易的 "你不行…"
sense_groups.english: This is easy. "Can't do this..."

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 还真的咧 就是不行
sense_groups.english: Wow, seriously. Can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我需要你帮个忙 而且不能跟摩妮卡说
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, I need to ask you a favor,and we can't tell Monica anything about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你们之间没有秘密 - 表面上是那样没错
sense_groups.english: I thought you guys didn't have secrets. - That will remain the official party line.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟我有一点点经济上的问题
sense_groups.english: Look, Monica and I are having a little financial trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我知道 - 什么？你知道是什么意思？
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I know. - What? What do you mean, you "know"?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜的 你知道的
sense_groups.english: I just figured it out, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 你没有工作 而且现在经济又很萧条
sense_groups.english: I mean, you're not working and, uh, the economy is bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对
sense_groups.english: Oh, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我反应最快的一次了
sense_groups.english: That is the fastest I have ever thought.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正…
sense_groups.english: Anyway, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要跟你借点钱
sense_groups.english: I need to borrow some money.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然罗 多少钱？两千块吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure. Yeah, how much? Two thousand dollars?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 正是两千块 你是怎么知道的？
sense_groups.english: Yes, $2000 exactly. How did you know that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你之前赚多少钱 而且我也知道你们的房租
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, I know how much you used to make...and I know how much your rent is.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 好的
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真是天才
sense_groups.english: I am on fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你真好 你…
sense_groups.english: Listen, this is really nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 你开一张两千块的支票给摩妮卡？
sense_groups.english: Did you write a check to Monica for $2000?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡跟你借钱？
sense_groups.english: Did Monica borrow money from you?

sense_groups.chinese: 好像是 - 我不敢相信她竟然这样做
sense_groups.english: Uh, kind of. - I can't believe her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有跟你说我们有经济问题吗？
sense_groups.english: Did she tell you we were having money problems?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是为了你们的经济问题
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. It wasn't because of your money problems.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她自己的东西
sense_groups.english: It was for something for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 很和人的东西
sense_groups.english: Something personal.

sense_groups.chinese: 她要花两千块还不能告诉我的 是什么东西？
sense_groups.english: What would she get for $2000 that she wouldn't tell me about?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 隆胸术
sense_groups.english: Boob job.

sense_groups.chinese: 她根本不需要隆乳手术 这真是疯狂
sense_groups.english: I don't want her to get a boob job. That's crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不算太疯狂 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not that crazy, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 把咪咪变小才叫做疯狂
sense_groups.english: Making them smaller, that would be crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我想要问你关于 摩妮卡的"新郎"笑话
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, I wanted to ask you about Monica's little "groomie" joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想大家会笑 是因为她在玩"新室友"这个词
sense_groups.english: Well, I think the reason people laughed is that it's a play on the word "roomie."
