sense_groups.chinese: 但在知道将来什么事都不会发生之后 我就没办法了
sense_groups.english: But I can't move in knowing nothing is ever gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以至少先试试同居吧？你或许会改变对婚姻的想法
sense_groups.english: Can we at least try living together? You might change your mind about marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会改变你的想法吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you gonna change yours?

sense_groups.chinese: 不会
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不会
sense_groups.english: Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我需要跟想法一样的人在一起
sense_groups.english: Um, I think I need to be with someone who wants what I want.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不想要结束
sense_groups.english: But I don't want this to end.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也不想要结束
sense_groups.english: No, I don't want it to end either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信就要这样结束了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is gonna end.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会把我的东西打包好
sense_groups.english: I guess I'll have my stuff picked up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 那么…
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Good bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 麦克 - 拜 麦克
sense_groups.english: Take it easy, Mike. - Bye, Mike. See you later, Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很难过 菲比
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry, Pheebs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都很难过
sense_groups.english: We're all sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 往好处想
sense_groups.english: Look on the bright side.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你不用跟那张丑椅子在一起
sense_groups.english: I mean, at least you won't have to live with this ugly chair.

sense_groups.chinese: 那早就在这里了 对不对？
sense_groups.english: That was here already, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我办到了 我办到了
sense_groups.english: I did it! I did it! Ha, ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了
sense_groups.english: All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 最好拿多一点
sense_groups.english: I'd better take all I can carry.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁知道下次能不能打得住呢？
sense_groups.english: Who knows when I'll be able to get in here again, huh?

questions.name: S09E17
questions.en:
You ready to go? - Let me just finish this.
Hey, Ross. Check this out.
Yeah, I can't do that. Heh.
What are you doing? - Have you seen this?
It's our new alumni website for college.
You can post messages for people, let everyone know what you're up to.
Oh, great. A faster way to tell people that I'm unemployed and childless.
It's actually interesting to find out what people are doing.
Remember Andrea Rich?
Tall girl, wouldn't sleep with you? - Uh-huh.
Well, her Internet company went under, and she lost an ear in a boating accident.
Bet she'd sleep with you now.
No, I already e-mailed her.
Let me see what you wrote about yourself.
Oh. -"Doctor of paleontology, two kids."
Wait a second. You split with Carol because you had different interests?
I think you split with Carol because you had one very similar interest.
You know what? I'm gonna finish this later, okay? Let me just grab my coat.
Okay.
What, did you think you learned how to do it in the last two minutes?
Maybe we finish this for him.
Also, I cloned a dinosaur in my lab.
She is now my girlfriend.
I don't care what society says, it's the best sex I've ever had.
And send. - No, no... You can't do that to him.
All right, let's go. - Dude!
Uh, I think you made it clear you can't be trusted with the ball inside the house.
And send.
Hey. How was basketball?
It was fun. Right up until Chandler got a finger in the eye.
Oh, no. Who did that?
Chandler.
Yeah.
Rash? - Yeah?
What's Huggsy doing in the crib with Emma?
She was just crawling around and she found him...
so I just let her sleep with him.
That's all right, isn't it? - Of course. Yeah.
It's a stuffed animal, you know? It's for kids. Not for adults.
I know that.
Joey, you're sure? I mean, I know how much you love him.
Rachel, let's be clear on this, okay? I do not love Huggsy.
I like him a normal amount.
All right. Well, Emma loves him.
Yeah. Well, why wouldn't she? He's a wonderful person.
Hi. - Hey, Phoebe. How you doing?
You feeling better? - Breaking up sucks.
Oh, I really miss Mike. - Oh, I'm so sorry.
I've tried everything to feel better. I even tried writing a song about it...
but I can't think of anything that rhymes with
Hey, Monica, I'm gonna need your help getting through this.
You're saying you're not gonna need my help?
No. When I get to the point where I'm ready...
to hear cruel, mocking jokes about Mike, I'm gonna come to you.
Oh, good, because I've already thought of three. Four! I just thought of a fourth.
Okay. I mean, I know I did the right thing.
Mike never wants to get married...
and I shouldn't be in a relationship that has no future.
But pretty soon, I'm gonna miss him so much...
I'm gonna want to see him again, and you have to stop me.
Okay, you got it.
Unless... Am I being too crazy about this?
All right, so, you know, there's no future.
But that doesn't mean we still can't have fun.
You know what? Forget what I said. - Really?
All right, if that's what you want. - That was a test, and you just failed.
Damn it! Rookie mistake.
I have sex with dinosaurs?
I believe I read that somewhere.
Not only is it not funny, it's physically impossible. Okay?
Depending on the species, I'd have to have a 6-foot-long... It's not funny!
I respectfully disagree.
I can't believe you put that on my alumni page.
Who cares? Nobody reads those. - You better hope not...
because I just read what you put on your page.
I don't have a page. - Oh, I respectfully disagree!
Look at you. All sweet and innocent, sleeping like an angel.
With Emma's chubby little hands wrapped around you.
It's okay, Emma. You stay asleep.
Step away from the crib! I have a weapon!
It's okay! It's okay, Rach! It's me! Put down the scrunchie.
What are you doing? - Well, I heard Emma stirring...
so I came in to make sure she could reach Huggsy.
Oh. Oh, thanks. All right, well, now that I'm up, I'm gonna go to the bathroom.
Okay, there you go, sweetie.
This isn't over.
Wait a second. Why would Ross tell everyone in your class...
that you are "as gay as the day is long"?
Because I told everyone he slept with dinosaurs.
Well, that's clearly a joke. This could easily be true.
Would you get that, please? People have been calling to congratulate me all day.
Hello?
No, he's not here. Yeah, this is his wife.
Yeah. Well, it came as quite a shock to me too.
Well, I guess I should've known. Yeah.
He just kept making me watch Moulin Rouge.
Hang up- Hang UP
And that was a great movie.
I'm so gonna get back at Ross.
Oh, yeah, this'll show him. Here we go.
What are you doing? - Oh, you'll see, my friend!
I'm dead?
And so young.
Posting that I died? That really isn't funny.
Well, how you died was funny.
Oh, please. Hit by a blimp?
It kills over one Americans every year.
Unbelievable. My classmates are gonna think I'm dead.
My professors. My parents are gonna get phone calls.
You're messing with people's feelings here.
You wanna talk about people's feelings?
You should have heard how hurt Professor Stern was...
when I told him I wouldn't be able to go with him to Key West!
You've really crossed a line here. But that's okay.
Because I'm on my way to buy some Photoshop software...
and a stack of gay porn.
That's right. Your coming-out is about to get real graphic!
God, I wish Mike were here.
Okay, if Mike were here, what would the two of you be doing?
What are you, animals? It's 4:00 in the afternoon.
I gotta call him. Just to talk to him. There's no harm in that.
Phoebe, that's how it starts.
"I don't need to eat the cake, I'll just smell the icing.
Why not just a little sliver?" Or, "Okay, just a slice or two."
You know, the next thing you know, you're 210 pounds...
and you get wedged in going down the tunnel slide.
Phoebe, honey, I know this is hard.
But look, if you talk to him, then you're gonna want to see him.
And if you see him, you're gonna wanna get back together.
And I know that's not what you want.
All right, so give me your phone.
Here. - Thank you.
And now your cell. - Okay.
There you go.
This is your cell phone? - Yes.
This is your current cell phone?
Yes. It reminds me of a simpler time.
Phoebe? Where's your purse?
Hey! No! - No!
Give it to me! - You can't have it.
Give it to me! - No.
I'll go in there. - Oh, yeah.
Come here! - No!
Give it to me! - You're crazy! God.
Aha!
Damn you, Monica Geller hyphen Bing!
Hey, look who's here. It's Joey. And he brought home a friend.
Joey, Emma's right here.
You promised not to bring girls home in the middle of the day anymore.
No, no, no, it's not a girl. It's...
a brand-new Huggsy! - Oh.
Oh, that's so great. Now Emma has two Huggsies.
No, no. Oh, no. No, Emma has one Huggsy.
The new Huggsy. Huh?
The other Huggsy, I don't know, I guess I'll just take him back.
You know what? When I was a little girl, I had a little pink pony named Cotton.
Oh, I loved her so much. I took her everywhere. I would braid her tail...
Make the transfer!
Should I be concerned that a button fell off the old Huggsy and I can't find it?
Don't worry about it. I swallowed that years ago. Hey.
Oh, what? I don't think she likes the new Huggsy.
But he's the same. - I think she wants the old one back.
Yeah, but he's the same. - Joey, come on.
But he's the same.
You're not the same.
Aha!
You know, it's a lot less surprising to do that...
after I've buzzed you into the building.
So, Phoebe, why are there men's shoes by the door?
Those are my shoes. - Oh.
Well, when you get over this breakup, we need to go shopping.
Look, Monica, I really appreciate you checking in on me.
But I'm actually feeling a lot better. - You are?
Yeah, I just kind of want to be alone right now.
Who's that? - I ordered Chinese food.
What are the chances?
One billion Chinese people, and they send Mike!
What are you doing here? - Phoebe called me.
Phoebe! - I'm sorry. I broke down.
I wanted to see him.
Damn it, Phoebe, how did you even call him?
There's a speakerphone on the base unit.
Base unit. Think, Monica, think!
Look, if I want to see Phoebe, and she... - This doesn't concern you.
Sorry. I guess I was thrown off by the mention of my name.
Look, guys, you can't do this.
It's gonna make getting over each other harder.
Not if nothing happens. Why can't we just hang out as friends?
Sure. If you're just gonna hang out as friends, then maybe I'll join you.
I'm your friend and Mike's friend.
Well...
Sit down.
Oh, whoa, whoa, whoa. Make room for your friend.
So how have you been? - I've been pretty good.
You look really beautiful. - Thanks. You look good too.
No, no, no. This is dangerous territory. Keep it clean.
So how's the piano playing going?
Actually, I've been playing a lot of love songs lately.
I've missed you. - I've missed you too.
You know, on the way over here, I saw this drunk guy throw up.
And then a pigeon ate it.
Hey. Ross.
Look, I just wanted to apologize.
Don't tell me you actually made those gay pictures of me.
Uh-huh, uh-huh. Check this out.
So that's what I'd look like if I worked out.
And was being serviced by a policeman.
You're not gonna actually send these out, are you?
Actually, I don't need to, because your little "Ross is dead" joke didn't work.
Okay? There were no responses.
Nobody posted anything on the website, nobody called my parents...
so the joke, my friend, is on you.
Nobody called, nobody wrote anything, nobody cares that I'm dead.
Oh, my God.
Nobody cares that I'm dead? - Oh, come on, you know that's not true.
What are you talking about? You get 60 responses...
just for coming out of the closet.
I didn't get one response, and I'm dead!
Well, the gay community is a lot more vocal than the dead community.
I can't believe this. Not even my geology lab partner. And I carried that guy.
All right. Look, let's think about this, okay?
You think people are gonna disturb your family at this tragic time?
That people are gonna post condolences on a website?
This isn't about people not caring that you're dead.
This is about people not having a decent outlet for their grief.
You're right. There isn't a decent outlet. - Right.
Come on. I'm sure if you had a funeral or memorial service...
tons of people would come.
Exactly!
Ross, what are you doing?
You're having a memorial service for yourself?
No, that would be stupid. You're having it for me.
Ross, don't press send. Don't press... - No, too late. Too late. It's sent.
Sorry, so is that picture of you and the policeman.
I'm trying to put Emma down for a nap. Have you seen Huggsy?
Uh, original or crappy?
Original. - No. Sorry. Haven't seen him.
Then what's that big lump under your covers'?
It's Monica, okay? - That's not Monica!
All right, fine! It's original Huggsy!
I know Emma wants him, but he's mine and I need him.
She's being unreasonable.
Joey, there is a reason that Emma loves that stupid penguin so much!
Oh, don't cover its ears!
It's because it reminds her of her Uncle Joey.
It does? - Yeah.
And she's comforted by him because she loves her Uncle Joey so much.
Really? She loves me? - Oh, yeah.
But you know what? If you need Huggsy, don't worry.
Emma will totally understand. I won't, but whatever.
Okay, wait a minute, wait a minute, Rach. I mean, if...
If Huggsy means that much to Emma, then...
Well, she can have him.
Oh, sweet, I knew Uncle Joey would step up.
Look, Emma. Look who's back. - No, forget it! Forget it! I can't do it!
Are you...? You're gonna take Huggsy away from a little child?
How do you think I got him in the first place?
All right, you two. I'm gonna go to the bathroom.
I don't want anything going on while I'm gone.
Here's a few things you can discuss
Mucus, fungus, and the idea of me and Ross doing it.
I've missed you so much.
I'm not gonna ask you to get back together. I know we want different things, but...
Just to be with you one more night. - I want that too.
But is that gonna make it too hard? - It can't be any harder than this.
I mean, if I had known the last time I saw you would be the last time, I...
I would have stopped to memorize your face, the way you moved.
Everything about you.
If I had known the last time I kissed you would be the last time...
I never would have stopped.
Kiss him, you fool!
What? - Didn't you hear that speech?
If you don't kiss him, then I will.
I missed you so much.
I knew you'd be here! - Aw, crap.
Who is this? - It's my friend Manny.
I asked him to keep me away from you.
Hey, that's what I'm doing for Phoebe. - Well, you're not doing a very good job.
Excuse me? - What's with the kissing?
Hey, at least I knew where my guy was.
Yeah, thank God you were here to oversee all the kissing.
You didn't hear the speech. MANNY: I've heard the speech.
If he knew it was gonna be the last time...
Hey, it was very moving. You're just heartless!
You're weak! - You're weird!
Your pants are undone. - Oh!
Where'd they go?
Damn it. - Well, we blew it.
I blame myself.
And I blame you too.
It's been an hour, and not one of my classmates has shown up?
I tell you, when I actually die, some people are gonna get seriously haunted.
There you go. Someone came.
Okay. Okay. I'm gonna go hide.
This is so exciting. My first mourner!
Hi. Glad you could come.
Please come in. - Hi. You're Chandler Bing, right?
I'm Tom Gordon. I was in your class.
Oh, yes. Yes, let me take your coat.
Thanks. Uh, I'm so sorry about Ross, it's...
No, at least he died doing what he loved.
Watching blimps.
Who is it? - You know some guy, Tom Gordon?
I don't remember him.
But then again, I touched so many lives.
So did you know Ross well?
Actually, I barely knew him. I came because I heard Chandler's news.
Do you know if he's seeing anyone?
Yes, he is. Me. - What? You mean...? Oh.
Can I ask you a personal question? How do you shave your beard so close'?
Okay, Tommy! That's enough mourning for you.
Here we go. Bye-bye. All right.
Hey, listen. Call me. - Okay.
I'm dead and no one cares? - I look like a man?
Please, one ridiculous problem at a time.
This isn't ridiculous. Look around, no one's here.
You gave them one day's notice. Not everyone checks the website every day.
And Monica, it's probably the way you stand!
I guess you're right. Still, somebody must have seen it.
I mean, I went to that school for four years and I didn't have an impact on anyone?
Well, that's not true. You had an impact on me.
I mean, it's 15 years later and we're still best friends.
Doesn't that count for something?
Oh, great, more party boys for Chandler.
I'm sure it's somebody for you. Now go hide.
Hi. I'm here for Ross Geller's memorial service.
Kori? Kori Weston? - Yeah.
You look amazing. - And you are?
Chandler. Chandler Bing. And I'm not gay. I'm not gay at all.
You are married, though.
Don't listen to him. He's in a really bad mood.
I can't believe that Ross is gone. It is just so sad.
I didn't know Ross and you were so close.
Oh, we weren't. But we had one class together. He was such a great guy.
And he talked so passionately about science.
I always remembered him. - I'm sure that would mean a lot to him.
And if heaven has a door...
I'm sure he's pressing his ear up against it and listening intently.
I thought so many times about calling him and asking him out.
I guess I really missed my chance.
No, you didn't!
I'm still alive!
Kori, I know this is a big surprise for you.
It's a long story. But the things you just said really made my day.
The fact that you're here means more to me...
than if this room were filled with people.
You sick freak! Who does that?
I can't believe I had a crush on you.
Did you hear that?
Kori Weston had a crush on me!
No, Mom, I am not dead.
I know it's not something to kid about.
It was just a practical joke between Chandler and me, but it's over, okay?
Actually, no. Even if I had died, you would not be left childless.
Monica?

sense_groups.english: This is your current cell phone?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 它让我想起简单的时日
sense_groups.english: Yes. It reminds me of a simpler time.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？你的皮包呢？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? Where's your purse?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 不行 - 不
sense_groups.english: Hey! No! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 给我 - 不给你
sense_groups.english: Give it to me! - You can't have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 给我 - 不要
sense_groups.english: Give it to me! - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会伸进去拿的 - 喔 是喔
sense_groups.english: I'll go in there. - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 过来 - 不
sense_groups.english: Come here! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 给我 - 你疯了
sense_groups.english: Give it to me! - You're crazy! God.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Aha!

sense_groups.chinese: 去你的 摩妮卡盖勒宾
sense_groups.english: Damn you, Monica Geller hyphen Bing!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瞧瞧是谁来了 是乔伊 而且他带新朋友来了
sense_groups.english: Hey, look who's here. It's Joey. And he brought home a friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛在这里
sense_groups.english: Joey, Emma's right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你答应不会在白天 带女生回来的
sense_groups.english: You promised not to bring girls home in the middle of the day anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 不 不是女生 是…
sense_groups.english: No, no, no, it's not a girl. It's...

sense_groups.chinese: 全新的哈吉 - 哦
sense_groups.english: a brand-new Huggsy! - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这真是太棒了 现在艾玛有两个哈吉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's so great. Now Emma has two Huggsies.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不 喔不 不 艾玛只有一个哈吉
sense_groups.english: No, no. Oh, no. No, Emma has one Huggsy.

sense_groups.chinese: 新的哈吉
sense_groups.english: The new Huggsy. Huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 另外那个哈吉 我不知道 我想我就拿回来好了
sense_groups.english: The other Huggsy, I don't know, I guess I'll just take him back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？当我还是小女孩时 我有一只粉红色小马 叫小棉花
sense_groups.english: You know what? When I was a little girl, I had a little pink pony named Cotton.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我好爱她 去哪我都带着她 我会梳她的尾巴…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I loved her so much. I took her everywhere. I would braid her tail...

sense_groups.chinese: 快点移交吧
sense_groups.english: Make the transfer!

sense_groups.chinese: 旧哈吉身上有个钮扣不见了 我找不到 有没有关系？
sense_groups.english: Should I be concerned that a button fell off the old Huggsy and I can't find it?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不用担心 很多年前被我吞下去了 嘿
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it. I swallowed that years ago. Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 怎么了？我想她不喜欢新哈吉
sense_groups.english: Oh, what? I don't think she likes the new Huggsy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他是- 样的啊 - 我想她要旧的哈吉
sense_groups.english: But he's the same. - I think she wants the old one back.

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔 但他们一模一样啊 - 乔伊 拿来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, but he's the same. - Joey, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 根本是一样的嘛
sense_groups.english: But he's the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不一样
sense_groups.english: You're not the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Aha!

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样吓不到我…
sense_groups.english: You know, it's a lot less surprising to do that...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为是我按开楼下的门让你进来的
sense_groups.english: after I've buzzed you into the building.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 为什么门边有男人的鞋子呢？
sense_groups.english: So, Phoebe, why are there men's shoes by the door?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是我的鞋子 - 喔
sense_groups.english: Those are my shoes. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你复元之后 我们一定要去血拼
sense_groups.english: Well, when you get over this breakup, we need to go shopping.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 摩妮卡 我真的很感激你这样关心我
sense_groups.english: Look, Monica, I really appreciate you checking in on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我已经觉得好多了 - 真的？
sense_groups.english: But I'm actually feeling a lot better. - You are?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我只是有点想自己独处
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I just kind of want to be alone right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁啊？ - 我叫了中餐外送
sense_groups.english: Who's that? - I ordered Chinese food.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是太巧了
sense_groups.english: What are the chances?

sense_groups.chinese: 在十亿的中国人当中 他们竟然派麦克来
sense_groups.english: One billion Chinese people, and they send Mike!

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这里做什么呢？ - 菲比打电话给我
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here? - Phoebe called me.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 - 我很抱歉 我受不了
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! - I'm sorry. I broke down.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要见他
sense_groups.english: I wanted to see him.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的 菲比 你是怎么打电话给他的？
sense_groups.english: Damn it, Phoebe, how did you even call him?

sense_groups.chinese: 电话主机有免持听筒功能
sense_groups.english: There's a speakerphone on the base unit.

sense_groups.chinese: 主机 用脑啊 摩妮卡 用用脑
sense_groups.english: Base unit. Think, Monica, think!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 如果我想见菲比 而她… - 这不关你的事
sense_groups.english: Look, if I want to see Phoebe, and she... - This doesn't concern you.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 我只是听到有人提到我的名字
sense_groups.english: Sorry. I guess I was thrown off by the mention of my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你们不能这样做
sense_groups.english: Look, guys, you can't do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 这会使事情更复杂的
sense_groups.english: It's gonna make getting over each other harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果什么事都没发生就不会 我们不能就当朋友吗？
sense_groups.english: Not if nothing happens. Why can't we just hang out as friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然可以 如果你们只是朋友 那我也可以加入你们
sense_groups.english: Sure. If you're just gonna hang out as friends, then maybe I'll join you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 我是你的朋友 也是麦克的朋友
sense_groups.english: I'm your friend and Mike's friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 坐下吧
sense_groups.english: Sit down.

sense_groups.chinese: 让个位置给你们的朋友
sense_groups.english: Oh, whoa, whoa, whoa. Make room for your friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 你过得好不好？ - 我还挺不错的
sense_groups.english: So how have you been? - I've been pretty good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的很美 - 谢谢 你看起来也不错
sense_groups.english: You look really beautiful. - Thanks. You look good too.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 这太危险了 放干净点
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. This is dangerous territory. Keep it clean.

sense_groups.chinese: 那钢琴演奏还好吗？
sense_groups.english: So how's the piano playing going?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我最近弹了许多情歌
sense_groups.english: Actually, I've been playing a lot of love songs lately.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直很想你 - 我也是
sense_groups.english: I've missed you. - I've missed you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我要过来这里的路上 我看到一个酒鬼吐了一地
sense_groups.english: You know, on the way over here, I saw this drunk guy throw up.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后一只鸽子还去吃
sense_groups.english: And then a pigeon ate it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey. Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我只是想过来跟你道歉
sense_groups.english: Look, I just wanted to apologize.

sense_groups.chinese: 别告诉我你真的在做我的同志照
sense_groups.english: Don't tell me you actually made those gay pictures of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧这个
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh, uh-huh. Check this out.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以如果我有健身 看起来就会是这样
sense_groups.english: So that's what I'd look like if I worked out.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且还有警察先生为我服务
sense_groups.english: And was being serviced by a policeman.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是真的要贴出这些照片吧？
sense_groups.english: You're not gonna actually send these out, are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 我没有必要 因为你"罗斯死了"的笑话根本没用
sense_groups.english: Actually, I don't need to, because your little "Ross is dead" joke didn't work.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吗？根本就没有人回应
sense_groups.english: Okay? There were no responses.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人张贴任何东西 没有人打电话给我父母
sense_groups.english: Nobody posted anything on the website, nobody called my parents...

sense_groups.chinese: 你才好笑
sense_groups.english: so the joke, my friend, is on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人来电 没有人写什么 没有人在乎我死了
sense_groups.english: Nobody called, nobody wrote anything, nobody cares that I'm dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 没人在乎我死了吗？ - 喔 别这样 你知道不是那样的
sense_groups.english: Nobody cares that I'm dead? - Oh, come on, you know that's not true.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么呢？你有六十个回复…
sense_groups.english: What are you talking about? You get 60 responses...

sense_groups.chinese: 只不过是因为出柜而已
sense_groups.english: just for coming out of the closet.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我死了 却连一个回复都没有
sense_groups.english: I didn't get one response, and I'm dead!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 同志社团比死人社团还要活跃
sense_groups.english: Well, the gay community is a lot more vocal than the dead community.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 连我地质学伴都没有回复 以前都是我罩他的
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. Not even my geology lab partner. And I carried that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们不要再多想了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: All right. Look, let's think about this, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为大家会想要在 这悲伤的时刻打扰你的家人吗？
sense_groups.english: You think people are gonna disturb your family at this tragic time?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人会在网站上张贴哀悼辞吗？
sense_groups.english: That people are gonna post condolences on a website?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是说大家不在乎
sense_groups.english: This isn't about people not caring that you're dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 而是那并非适合的抒发悲情的管道
sense_groups.english: This is about people not having a decent outlet for their grief.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的没错 那不是适合的管道 - 没错
sense_groups.english: You're right. There isn't a decent outlet. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我确定如果你有举办追悼会
sense_groups.english: Come on. I'm sure if you had a funeral or memorial service...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定会有很多人来的
sense_groups.english: tons of people would come.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Exactly!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你要干嘛？
sense_groups.english: Ross, what are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你要帮自己办追悼会？
sense_groups.english: You're having a memorial service for yourself?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 那会太离谱了 你要帮我办
sense_groups.english: No, that would be stupid. You're having it for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 不要寄出 不要寄… - 不 太迟了 寄出了
sense_groups.english: Ross, don't press send. Don't press... - No, too late. Too late. It's sent.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 还有你 跟警察先生的照片也寄了
sense_groups.english: Sorry, so is that picture of you and the policeman.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚要哄艾玛睡一下 你有看到哈吉吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm trying to put Emma down for a nap. Have you seen Huggsy?

sense_groups.chinese: 原版的还是烂的？
sense_groups.english: Uh, original or crappy?

sense_groups.chinese: 原版的 - 没有 抱歉 没有看到
sense_groups.english: Original. - No. Sorry. Haven't seen him.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你床上突起来的是什么？
sense_groups.english: Then what's that big lump under your covers'?

sense_groups.chinese: 是摩妮卡 好吗？ - 那不是摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: It's Monica, okay? - That's not Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 没关系 是原版的哈吉
sense_groups.english: All right, fine! It's original Huggsy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道艾玛要他 但他是我的 而我需要他
sense_groups.english: I know Emma wants him, but he's mine and I need him.

sense_groups.chinese: 她真是不讲道理
sense_groups.english: She's being unreasonable.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 艾玛爱那个蠢企鹅是有原因的
sense_groups.english: Joey, there is a reason that Emma loves that stupid penguin so much!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 不要捣住他的耳朵
sense_groups.english: Oh, don't cover its ears!

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他让她想起她的乔伊叔叔
sense_groups.english: It's because it reminds her of her Uncle Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: It does? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她很喜欢他是因为 她是那么爱她的乔伊叔叔
sense_groups.english: And she's comforted by him because she loves her Uncle Joey so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？她爱我？ - 喔 是的
sense_groups.english: Really? She loves me? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你知道吗？如果你需要哈吉 没关系
sense_groups.english: But you know what? If you need Huggsy, don't worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛会谅解的 我不会 但是那又如何呢
sense_groups.english: Emma will totally understand. I won't, but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 等等 瑞秋 我是说如果…
sense_groups.english: Okay, wait a minute, wait a minute, Rach. I mean, if...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果艾玛那么喜欢哈吉 那么…
sense_groups.english: If Huggsy means that much to Emma, then...

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 就给她吧
sense_groups.english: Well, she can have him.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 亲爱的 我就知道乔伊叔叔最好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweet, I knew Uncle Joey would step up.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛 瞧是谁回来了 - 不 算了 算了 我做不到
sense_groups.english: Look, Emma. Look who's back. - No, forget it! Forget it! I can't do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你…你要把哈吉从一个小孩手上抢走？
sense_groups.english: Are you...? You're gonna take Huggsy away from a little child?

sense_groups.chinese: 要不然你认为我当初怎么拿到哈吉的？
sense_groups.english: How do you think I got him in the first place?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你们两个 我要去上厕所
sense_groups.english: All right, you two. I'm gonna go to the bathroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不希望在我离开时 发生什么事
sense_groups.english: I don't want anything going on while I'm gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 有几件事你们可以讨论
sense_groups.english: Here's a few things you can discuss

sense_groups.chinese: 黏液 菌类 还有我跟罗斯如何把玩这些东西
sense_groups.english: Mucus, fungus, and the idea of me and Ross doing it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的好想你
sense_groups.english: I've missed you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会要求你复合 我知道我们要的是不同的东西 但…
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna ask you to get back together. I know we want different things, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 只要跟你再共度- 晚就好 - 我也想要
sense_groups.english: Just to be with you one more night. - I want that too.

sense_groups.chinese: 但那不是会使事情更困难吗？ - 再不会比现在更困难了
sense_groups.english: But is that gonna make it too hard? - It can't be any harder than this.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我知道上一次见到你 就是最后一次 我…
sense_groups.english: I mean, if I had known the last time I saw you would be the last time, I...

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会努力记住你的脸 你的一举一动
sense_groups.english: I would have stopped to memorize your face, the way you moved.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的一切
sense_groups.english: Everything about you.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我知道上次亲吻你 就是最后一次…
sense_groups.english: If I had known the last time I kissed you would be the last time...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不会停下来
sense_groups.english: I never would have stopped.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲啊 你这个傻瓜
sense_groups.english: Kiss him, you fool!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 你没有听到他说什么吗？
sense_groups.english: What? - Didn't you hear that speech?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不亲他 我来亲
sense_groups.english: If you don't kiss him, then I will.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好想你
sense_groups.english: I missed you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道你在这里 - 妈的
sense_groups.english: I knew you'd be here! - Aw, crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是谁？ - 我朋友曼尼
sense_groups.english: Who is this? - It's my friend Manny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我请他看好我 远离你
sense_groups.english: I asked him to keep me away from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也在帮菲比做同样的事 - 那你根本没做好你工作
sense_groups.english: Hey, that's what I'm doing for Phoebe. - Well, you're not doing a very good job.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 亲吻是怎么回事呢？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? - What's with the kissing?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 至少我也在现场哪
sense_groups.english: Hey, at least I knew where my guy was.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 感谢上帝 你在这里监看他们亲吻
sense_groups.english: Yeah, thank God you were here to oversee all the kissing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有听到他说的话 - 我听到了
sense_groups.english: You didn't hear the speech. MANNY: I've heard the speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他知道那是最后一次…
sense_groups.english: If he knew it was gonna be the last time...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 那很令人感动 你真是没心肝
sense_groups.english: Hey, it was very moving. You're just heartless!

sense_groups.chinese: 你太软弱了 - 你太奇怪了
sense_groups.english: You're weak! - You're weird!

sense_groups.chinese: 你裤子拉链没拉 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Your pants are undone. - Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 他们去哪儿了呢？
sense_groups.english: Where'd they go?

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的 - 我们搞砸了
sense_groups.english: Damn it. - Well, we blew it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只能怪我自己
sense_groups.english: I blame myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我也只能怪你
sense_groups.english: And I blame you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 已经一个小时了 而我同学竟然一个都没来？
sense_groups.english: It's been an hour, and not one of my classmates has shown up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你 要是我真的死了 有些人一定会被鬼缠死的
sense_groups.english: I tell you, when I actually die, some people are gonna get seriously haunted.

sense_groups.chinese: 来了 有人来了
sense_groups.english: There you go. Someone came.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 好了 我要去躲起来了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. I'm gonna go hide.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是兴奋 我第一个追悼者
sense_groups.english: This is so exciting. My first mourner!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 很高兴你能够来
sense_groups.english: Hi. Glad you could come.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 - 嗨 你是钱德宾吗？
sense_groups.english: Please come in. - Hi. You're Chandler Bing, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是汤姆高登 是你班上的同学
sense_groups.english: I'm Tom Gordon. I was in your class.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 是的 是的 让我帮你拿外套
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes. Yes, let me take your coat.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 很难过听到罗斯的事 真是…
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Uh, I'm so sorry about Ross, it's...

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 至少他死时正在做喜欢的事
sense_groups.english: No, at least he died doing what he loved.

sense_groups.chinese: 看飞船
sense_groups.english: Watching blimps.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是谁？ - 你认识- 个叫汤姆高登的吗？
sense_groups.english: Who is it? - You know some guy, Tom Gordon?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不记得他了
sense_groups.english: I don't remember him.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 我启发过太多人了
sense_groups.english: But then again, I touched so many lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你跟罗斯很熟吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you know Ross well?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我不太认识他 我来是因为听到钱德的事
sense_groups.english: Actually, I barely knew him. I came because I heard Chandler's news.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道他有在跟谁交往吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you know if he's seeing anyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 他有 就是我 - 什么？你是说…
sense_groups.english: Yes, he is. Me. - What? You mean...? Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以问你一个私人问题吗？你是怎么将胡子刮得这么干净的？
sense_groups.english: Can I ask you a personal question? How do you shave your beard so close'?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 汤姆 你哀悼得够了
sense_groups.english: Okay, Tommy! That's enough mourning for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 走吧 再见 好了
sense_groups.english: Here we go. Bye-bye. All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 听着 打电话给我 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Hey, listen. Call me. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我死了却没有人在乎？ - 我看起来像男人吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm dead and no one cares? - I look like a man?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 一次一个荒谬的问题就好
sense_groups.english: Please, one ridiculous problem at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 这并不荒谬 瞧瞧四周 根本没有人来
sense_groups.english: This isn't ridiculous. Look around, no one's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你才通知他们一天而已 又不是每个人天天都上网
sense_groups.english: You gave them one day's notice. Not everyone checks the website every day.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有摩妮卡 或许是因为你的站相
sense_groups.english: And Monica, it's probably the way you stand!

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你说的对 但是 总该要有人看到啊
sense_groups.english: I guess you're right. Still, somebody must have seen it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我读那所学校四年了 而我竟然没有影响到任何人？
sense_groups.english: I mean, I went to that school for four years and I didn't have an impact on anyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 不是那样的 你有影响到我
sense_groups.english: Well, that's not true. You had an impact on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 已经十五年了 而我们依然是最要好的朋友
sense_groups.english: I mean, it's 15 years later and we're still best friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不算什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Doesn't that count for something?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 更多狂野男孩来找钱德了
sense_groups.english: Oh, great, more party boys for Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说一定是来看你的 去躲起来
sense_groups.english: I'm sure it's somebody for you. Now go hide.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我来参加罗斯盖勒的追悼会
sense_groups.english: Hi. I'm here for Ross Geller's memorial service.

sense_groups.chinese: 可苗？可苗薇丝顿？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Kori? Kori Weston? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来真棒 - 你是谁呢？
sense_groups.english: You look amazing. - And you are?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 钱德宾 而且我不是同志 我一点都不是
sense_groups.english: Chandler. Chandler Bing. And I'm not gay. I'm not gay at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你已经结婚了
sense_groups.english: You are married, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 别听他说 他只是心情很差
sense_groups.english: Don't listen to him. He's in a really bad mood.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信罗斯已经走了 真是难过
sense_groups.english: I can't believe that Ross is gone. It is just so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道罗斯跟你很熟
sense_groups.english: I didn't know Ross and you were so close.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 并没有 但是我们一起上过一堂课 他是个很棒的人
sense_groups.english: Oh, we weren't. But we had one class together. He was such a great guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他总是很热情地讨论科学
sense_groups.english: And he talked so passionately about science.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直记得他 - 我确定这对他的意义深远
sense_groups.english: I always remembered him. - I'm sure that would mean a lot to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且如果天堂有一扇门
sense_groups.english: And if heaven has a door...

sense_groups.chinese: 我敢说他一定耳朵贴着门仔细在听
sense_groups.english: I'm sure he's pressing his ear up against it and listening intently.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好多次都想打电话约他出去
sense_groups.english: I thought so many times about calling him and asking him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我真的再也没有机会了
sense_groups.english: I guess I really missed my chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你还有机会
sense_groups.english: No, you didn't!

sense_groups.chinese: 我还活着
sense_groups.english: I'm still alive!

sense_groups.chinese: 可苗 我知道这件事让你很惊讶
sense_groups.english: Kori, I know this is a big surprise for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 说来话长 但是你刚说的话 让我这一天变得很美好
sense_groups.english: It's a long story. But the things you just said really made my day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的到来真是对我意义重大
sense_groups.english: The fact that you're here means more to me...

sense_groups.chinese: 比房间都充满了人还要好
sense_groups.english: than if this room were filled with people.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这变态的怪物 谁会做这种事？
sense_groups.english: You sick freak! Who does that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信我喜欢过你
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I had a crush on you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有听到吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you hear that?

sense_groups.chinese: 可苗薇丝顿喜欢过我
sense_groups.english: Kori Weston had a crush on me!

sense_groups.chinese: 没啦 妈 我没死
sense_groups.english: No, Mom, I am not dead.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这是不可以开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: I know it's not something to kid about.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是我跟钱德在玩的恶作剧 已经结束了 好吗？
sense_groups.english: It was just a practical joke between Chandler and me, but it's over, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上不会的 即使我死了 你也不会没有孩子
sense_groups.english: Actually, no. Even if I had died, you would not be left childless.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡不算吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica?

questions.name: S09E18
questions.en:
Monica? Hey, can I borrow the Porsche?
Okay. - All right!
But, uh, ahem, what is it not?
A place to entertain my lady friends.
And what else is it not? - A place to eat spaghetti.
Very good. - Thanks.
What do you need it for anyway?
The, uh, lottery is up to 300 million...
and they don't sell tickets here.
So you're driving up to Connecticut?
Yeah, Connecticut. Not West Virginia.
Maybe I'll drive you up there. I'd like to buy some tickets myself.
Yeah, with Chandler not getting paid, we could really use $300 million.
Yes, because if I was at my old job,
we'd say, "300 million? No, thank you."
Will you get me tickets too? - Yeah, me too.
Sure. - Ooh! I have an idea.
Why don't we all pitch in 50 bucks, we'll pool our money together...
and then if we win, we'll split it. - That's a great idea!
No, thanks.
You don't want to win the lottery? - Uh, sure I do.
I also want to be king of my own country...
and find out what happened to Amelia Earhart.
Still on Amelia Earhart? - The woman just vanished!
Seriously, you don't want in on this?
No. Do you know what your odds are of winning the lottery?
I mean, you have a better chance of being struck by lightning 42 times.
But there's six of us, so we'd only have to get struck 7 times.
I like those odds!
Seriously, you guys, I can't believe you're gonna spend $250 on the lottery.
I mean, that's such a bunch of boo-hockey.
I'll ask.
"Boo-hockey"?
Oh, we think Emma's about to start talking...
so we're trying to be careful about what words we use in front of her.
So get ready to hear a lot of, uh, boo-hockey...
gosh darn it and brother pucker.
How do you know she's gonna start talking?
When I talk to her, I almost feel like she understands what I'm saying.
Kind of like Joey.
What's that now?
God, look at all these tickets. It's so exciting.
I haven't won anything since sixth grade.
Pie-eating contest?
You assume because I was heavy that's the only way I could win something?
No, I saw a picture of you covered in blueberries.
That was a good day. - Yeah.
They're towing your car! - I'm parked in a garage on Morton.
They're towing a car.
And I am seeing spots.
Ross, you don't have Emma! Rachel, you don't have Emma!
Where's Emma? Who has Emma? - Joey, relax.
My mother picked her up two hours ago. You were there.
I was? - Yes, and you talked to her.
I did? - She dropped off a casserole.
Oh, yeah, the casserole lady.
Did you come by to watch us win the big bucks?
Yeah. And then I figured after you win, we can all go out to the balcony...
and see a night rainbow with gremlins dancing on top of it.
Don't touch the phone! I'll get it! I'll get it!
You think he washed his hands? - Hello?
Hey, Charlie, what do you know? - What's going on?
Chandler's supposed to find out if he's getting a job at his agency.
But out of 15 interns, they're only hiring three.
Ooh. Tough odds. - Yeah.
If only it were a sure thing like your 24-state lottery.
Yeah, look who's coming around!
Damn it. All right, call me when you know more.
Did you get it? - One of the slots got filled.
By you? - Sense the tone.
No, that kid Nate got it. - Oh, I hate that guy.
I mean, come on, pull up your pants! - I know.
Well, there's two spots left, right?
Yeah. I mean, I want this so much. I want to get one.
I want my friend Charlie to get one.
Except I don't care about Charlie.
Hey!
You are not gonna believe this. I just saw my psychic...
and she said I was definitely gonna win the lottery tonight!
I thought we could use some extra luck...
so I brought a wishbone home from work.
A psychic and a wishbone? Guys, give someone else a chance.
All right, who wants to do it? - Ooh, can I?
Vegetarians never get to do the wishbone.
It's really not fair. Just because we don't eat the meat...
doesn't mean we don't like to play with the carcasses.
All right. Rash'?
I don't want that turkey smell all over my hands.
I'll do it! It'll get the casserole stink off of mine.
I hope I win. - Well, it doesn't really matter.
You're both wishing for the same thing.
I can't tell you what I'm wishing for, or else, you know, it won't come true. Ha, ha.
Right. But we know what you're wishing for.
I can't really say. - I understand.
But you're wishing for what we think, aren't you?
I'm not really comfortable with these questions!
Please! - Just do it!
Okay. One, two, three.
I won! Hey!
You know what? I'm sure your wish is gonna come true.
But, you guys, just in case, maybe a genie will come out if we rub this lamp.
Ow!
That thing gets hot!
Ross, just keep making yourjokes.
How are you gonna feel if we actually do win?
Uh, you're not gonna win. - I know the odds are against us...
but somebody has to win, and it could be us. And then how you gonna feel?
We're gonna be like, "Everybody, let's take our helicopters up to the Cape."
And you're gonna be all, like, "Oh, I can't, guys.
I'll have to meet you up there. I gotta gas up the Hyundai."
Okay, I've heard myself on tape, and I sound nothing like that.
I can see the headline now: "Lottery Winners' Friend...
Filled With Regret, Eats Own Arm."
Why would I eat my own arm?
Well, you wouldn't, but we own the paper. We can print whatever we want.
You know what? I'm gonna throw in 50 bucks for you.
Why? - Because I know that you think...
that the lottery is boo-hockey...
but we're all here, and we're gonna watch the numbers and have fun.
And you're my brother, and I want you to be a part of this.
You don't have to do that. I mean, I'll pay for myself.
But just the fact that you want me to have fun with you guys, that's so sweet.
Come here.
Get a room.
So now that you're in, what are you gonna do if we win?
I don't know. I'll probably just invest it. - Ooh. Calm down.
Seriously, that's your fantasy? To invest it?
Oh, I'm sorry. Did I say,
"invest it"? I meant, "Be cool and piss it all away."
Oh! Oh! I know! We should pool all our money and buy the Knicks!
I don't really care about the Knicks.
You will when I pick you as starting forward.
You would do that? I never get picked!
I'm not sure a sports team is the way to go.
You won't let me buy the Knicks? I can't believe you're taking this away.
You're right, it has been your dream for over 15 seconds.
Uh, how long until they announce the numbers, Mommy?
I'll take this one too. Uh, "Mommy"?
Oh, I've gotten into the habit of calling Rachel "Mommy"...
when we're around Emma.
Which I now realize we are not.
I'm hoping that if she hears it enough...
it'll be her first word. - Oh.
Although if we're gonna do that, we should probably call me "Daddy" too.
Mm. I like that, Daddy.
I, uh... I was just talking about Rachel.
Ooh, is Daddy getting angry?
Is Daddy gonna spank me?
Well, that depends.
Have you been a bad...? No, I can't.
Hello? Hello? Hey, Charlie. Did anybody else hear?
What? Susan got it? How?
Oh, man, I would've slept with him!
All right, bye.
Dude, I'm sorry. But hey, there's one spot left, right?
Well, Charlie's gonna get that. - Hey, don't say that.
You've got just as good a chance of getting that job.
He is the boss' son.
Come on, lottery! - Yeah!
It starts in, like, 20 minutes. - Okay, here we go.
We need to sort through the tickets quickly to see if we've won.
So does anybody have any ideas how to organize this?
Okay, how about this
We divide them into six groups of 40.
The remaining 10 can be read by whoever finishes first.
I have another idea. - I'm sorry, idea time is over.
Well, are all the tickets in the bowl? - Yeah.
What about the ones on the nightstand? - There are no tickets there.
Yes, there are. I just saw them a few minutes ago.
Heh. Uh, no, you didn't. You must be mistaken.
There are 20 tickets on the nightstand. - Chandler, sense the tone.
Well, well, well. Look what Mommy found.
Okay, fine. I bought 20 extra tickets for me and Chandler.
The psychic also said that I would be betrayed.
I can't believe this. I thought we were all in this together.
Hey, you just got in five minutes ago! - Three minutes ago!
I don't know why that's important.
I was with you the whole time. When did you even get those?
When you were reading the dirty magazines without taking off the plastic.
I'll show you how.
Okay. Well, Monica, suppose one of your special tickets wins?
How are you gonna feel when you win and lose your friends?
Please. If I win the lottery, you guys are not gonna leave me.
Someone gave me muffins last week. I couldn't get rid of you for three days!
Chandler, would you just tell her what she did was wrong?
She's right. You shouldn't have bought tickets just for us.
Let me finish.
However, it doesn't look like I'm gonna get this job...
so I can't afford to have principles. So screw you! The tickets are ours!
There's the man I married.
All right. Believe me, if you win the lottery...
it's the last you're gonna hear from us.
Fine. Don't be my friends. I'll buy new friends.
Yeah, and then I'll pay for their plastic surgery
so they look just like you!
You know what? I want my share of the tickets.
I want my tickets too! And I'm buying the Knicks!
And Steffi Graf! Ha, ha.
Cool. Then I want mine too! And if I win...
I'm gonna put it all into a very low-yield bond!
No. You guys, we gotta keep all the tickets together.
No. No, we should divide them up...
and I should get extra because we used my car!
Hey! Hey! If anybody gets extra tickets, it should be me!
This whole thing was my idea! - Yeah. Thanks for inventing the lottery!
Just give them to me, and I'll split them up!
OW! - Ah!
Hey - Aah!
God, I can't take it anymore! I'm putting an end to this!
Okay, if she jumps, I get her tickets! - Wait, no, no! Hey!
If we're not doing this together, we're not doing it at all.
Say goodbye to your tickets. - No! No! No!
Do not come any closer!
Can I come a little bit closer? Valuable things are getting squished.
Now, what's more important, your friends or money?
Friends! - Money!
Friends.
Hey, Monica, what about your extra tickets?
They're all in there.
Even these five that I hid in my bra. - Monica!
Okay. Good. You guys were so scared.
There is no way I was gonna dump this...
Aah!
I think I broke your bowl.
Go! Go! Go!
What a beautiful night to be running around the street, looking for tickets.
And the wind sure made it fun.
Phoebe, we lost half of them. - So what?
Monica, we have the winning ticket.
My psychic said I was gonna win, remember?
Weird your psychic didn't mention anything about the scary pigeon.
As a matter of fact, she said that's how I'm going to die.
So excuse me for being a little skittish.
There's two messages. This could be from work.
Oh, play them. - Okay. Here we go.
Hello. This is the pigeon from the balcony calling to apologize.
I shouldn't have knocked the tickets out of the pretty lady's hand.
It was all my fault. Not hers. Bye. Coo.
Well, I bet that was very hard for him to do.
Hey, Chandler, it's Charlie.
This is it. Shh, Shh!
Listen, um, it turns out I got the last spot.
I'm really sorry, man. It was a lot of fun working with you
Give me a call if you want.
Gosh, I'm so sorry, honey.
Sorry, Chandler.
It is so unfair. It's like that time they promoted Saundra over me at work.
Was she related to Ralph Lauren?
No, she was just much better at her job than me.
You guys, the drawing's about to start.
We should call my mom's and say good night to Emma...
before she goes down. - Good idea.
Honey, you're being really strong about this.
I know how badly you wanted that job.
Yeah, you know, I really thought I deserved it.
But let's go win the lottery. I mean, we still have a 130 chances to win, right?
Hundred and thirty-one.
Yeah, good night, sweetheart. I love you.
And remember, you're Daddy's little girl. Heh.
Phoebe's totally ruined that for me.
Hi, Mom. Put her back on.
Rach, they're announcing the numbers!
My God, I can already feel myself changing.
Here are your official Powerball numbers. We have 53.
I've got that. - We have one too!
We are on the road, people!
Come on!
Mom, please, I know you love your new lips, but I can barely understand you.
Would you please just let me say good night to my daughter?
And here we go. The Powerball is seven.
All right, check your numbers! Make me rich.
You guys, you're not gonna believe this.
I was just saying good night to Emma, and she said her first words.
What? - Well, what did she say?
She said, "Gleba"!
Make me rich!
Isn't that amazing? - Oh, yeah. No, no, no, that's great.
Why aren't you more excited?
Rach, heh, "gleba" is not a word.
Well, of course it is. - Okay. What does it mean?
Well, I don't know all the words.
You know, I'm just glad I didn't miss my daughter's first word.
Yes you did! Gleba is a word! - Okay. Use it in a sentence.
Okay. Uh, Emma just said, "Gleba
It's not a word. - Ugh. Okay, fine. I'm gonna look it up.
Oh, okay, great.
While you're at it, she said another word the other day. Why don't you look up
All right. Okay. Okay. Gleba Gleba. Gleba. Gleba!
Here it is! "The fleshy, spore-bearing inner mass of a certain fungi."
Heh.
She's gonna be a scientist.
Damn it. Anybody got anything? - No.
I'm still looking through mine.
Just double-checking. No.
No. No.
No!
Hello? Hold on.
It's your boss.
Ah, the "I'm sorry I rejected you" phone call.
I'm not used to getting these from guys.
Hey, Steve. - Chandler, hi.
I'm sure you've heard we filled the three positions.
We felt that with your maturity and experience...
you wouldn't be happy being someone's assistant.
I'd love to be somebody's assistant. Answering phones...
getting coffee, I live for that stuff.
And I'm not too mature. Farts, boobies, butt cracks!
Chandler, you were the strongest person in the program.
We're offering you the position of junior copywriter.
Me? That guy who just said, "butt cracks"?
Yes, that's right.
We're excited about the level of sophistication...
you'll be bringing to the job.
Okay. Well, thanks, you won't regret it. I'll see you tomorrow.
What?
Oh, yeah, I'm gonna be a junior copywriter!
Congratulations! Oh, sweetie, I'm so proud of you.
Thanks. Does that mean I get the good loving tonight?
You bet. No TV or anything.
Hey, that is so great about the job. - Thanks, man.
I'd like to think I had something to do with it.
Really? Why? - Well, before with the wishbone.
I, uh, didn't wish we would win the lottery. I wished you'd get the job.
Qh, yeah?
Don't tell Monica. She'll rip your heart out.
Oh, yeah.
Well, you know what? There was a little part of me...
that really thought we were gonna win.
Me too. So much for my dinosaur Amelia Earhart theme park.
You guys? What was the Powerball number again?
Seven. - We won.
What? - We won!
Let me see! Let me see! - Don't tear it!
Phoebe, you don't have any of the first five numbers!
I know that, but look, we got the Powerball number. We won $3!
Wow, you think we should get that over 20 years or go for the big payout?
I don't care. I've never won anything before. I can't believe this!
So, Pheebs, what are you gonna do with your $3?
Well, it's not all mine. We all get 50 cents.
Aw. You know what? You can have mine.
Me too. - Me too.
Me too. Ha, ha.
Well, I guess if everybody else is.
Hey, guys. So I just called the Powerball hot line.
Can you believe it? Nobody won. - Um, I beg to differ.
Maybe nobody won the jackpot, but there was this guy in here earlier...
and he found a ticket on the street right outside and won $10,000.
Coo. Again, don't blame the pretty lady.
It was not her fault. It was me, the pigeon. Coo.
Seriously, stop staring at her.

摩妮卡 我可以借你的保时捷吗？
好的 - 太好了
有什么"不准"的呢？
不准在车上和我女性朋友玩乐
还有什么呢？ - 不准在车上吃意大利面
非常好 - 谢了
你为什么会需要开车呢？
超级大乐透奖金已经累积到三亿了
但是这袒没有在卖彩券
所以你要开车到康乃狄克州买？
对 康乃狄克州 不是西维吉尼亚
或许我可以开车载你去 我自己也想买几张彩券
钱德现在没有在赚钱 三亿对我们可是会很好用的
是的 因为如果我还是在老工作
我们会说"要三亿吗？不用 谢谢"
你可以帮我买吗？ - 对啊 我也要
当然 - 我有个点子
我们可以各出资五十块 把钱集合起来
然后如果我们中奖 我们就照分 - 这主意很棒
不用 谢了
你不想要中乐透吗？ - 我当然想
我还想当国王咧
探索第一位飞越大西洋的女飞行员 是怎么了
还在想女飞行员吗？ - 那女人就这样消失了
说真的 你真的不要加入吗？
不要 你们知道 中乐透的机率有多大吗？
比你被闪电打到四十二次的机率还小
但是我们有六个人 所以我们只需要被打到七次
我喜欢这种机率
真的 你们 我不敢相信你们会 愿意花两百块钱在乐透上面
这实在太唬烂了吧？
我来问
"唬烂"？
我们认为艾玛已经快要开始说话了
所以在她面前我们会小心用字

Oh! Oh! I know! We should pool all our money and buy the Knicks!
I don't really care about the Knicks.
You will when I pick you as starting forward.
You would do that? I never get picked!
I'm not sure a sports team is the way to go.
You won't let me buy the Knicks? I can't believe you're taking this away.
You're right, it has been your dream for over 15 seconds.
Uh, how long until they announce the numbers, Mommy?
I'll take this one too. Uh, "Mommy"?
Oh, I've gotten into the habit of calling Rachel "Mommy"...
when we're around Emma.
Which I now realize we are not.
I'm hoping that if she hears it enough...
it'll be her first word. - Oh.

Mm. I like that, Daddy.
I, uh... I was just talking about Rachel.
Ooh, is Daddy getting angry?
Is Daddy gonna spank me?
Well, that depends.
Have you been a bad...? No, I can't.
Hello? Hello? Hey, Charlie. Did anybody else hear?
What? Susan got it? How?
Oh, man, I would've slept with him!
All right, bye.
Dude, I'm sorry. But hey, there's one spot left, right?
Well, Charlie's gonna get that. - Hey, don't say that.
You've got just as good a chance of getting that job.
He is the boss' son.
Come on, lottery! - Yeah!
It starts in, like, 20 minutes. - Okay, here we go.

So does anybody have any ideas how to organize this?
Okay, how about this

I have another idea. - I'm sorry, idea time is over.

Yes, there are. I just saw them a few minutes ago.
Heh. Uh, no, you didn't. You must be mistaken.
There are 20 tickets on the nightstand. - Chandler, sense the tone.

The psychic also said that I would be betrayed.
I can't believe this. I thought we were all in this together.

I don't know why that's important.
I was with you the whole time. When did you even get those?
When you were reading the dirty magazines without taking off the plastic.
I'll show you how.
Okay. Well, Monica, suppose one of your special tickets wins?
How are you gonna feel when you win and lose your friends?
Please. If I win the lottery, you guys are not gonna leave me.
Someone gave me muffins last week. I couldn't get rid of you for three days!
Chandler, would you just tell her what she did was wrong?
She's right. You shouldn't have bought tickets just for us.
Let me finish.

so I can't afford to have principles. So screw you! The tickets are ours!
There's the man I married.
All right. Believe me, if you win the lottery...
it's the last you're gonna hear from us.
Fine. Don't be my friends. I'll buy new friends.
Yeah, and then I'll pay for their plastic surgery
so they look just like you!
You know what? I want my share of the tickets.
I want my tickets too! And I'm buying the Knicks!
And Steffi Graf! Ha, ha.
Cool. Then I want mine too! And if I win...
I'm gonna put it all into a very low-yield bond!
No. You guys, we gotta keep all the tickets together.
No. No, we should divide them up...
and I should get extra because we used my car!
Hey! Hey! If anybody gets extra tickets, it should be me!
This whole thing was my idea! - Yeah. Thanks for inventing the lottery!
Just give them to me, and I'll split them up!
OW! - Ah!
Hey - Aah!
God, I can't take it anymore! I'm putting an end to this!
Okay, if she jumps, I get her tickets! - Wait, no, no! Hey!
If we're not doing this together, we're not doing it at all.
Say goodbye to your tickets. - No! No! No!
Do not come any closer!
Can I come a little bit closer? Valuable things are getting squished.
Now, what's more important, your friends or money?
Friends! - Money!
Friends.
Hey, Monica, what about your extra tickets?
They're all in there.
Even these five that I hid in my bra. - Monica!
Okay. Good. You guys were so scared.
There is no way I was gonna dump this...
Aah!
I think I broke your bowl.
Go! Go! Go!
What a beautiful night to be running around the street, looking for tickets.
And the wind sure made it fun.
Phoebe, we lost half of them. - So what?
Monica, we have the winning ticket.
My psychic said I was gonna win, remember?
Weird your psychic didn't mention anything about the scary pigeon.
As a matter of fact, she said that's how I'm going to die.
So excuse me for being a little skittish.
There's two messages. This could be from work.
Oh, play them. - Okay. Here we go.
Hello. This is the pigeon from the balcony calling to apologize.
I shouldn't have knocked the tickets out of the pretty lady's hand.
It was all my fault. Not hers. Bye. Coo.
Well, I bet that was very hard for him to do.
Hey, Chandler, it's Charlie.
This is it. Shh, Shh!
Listen, um, it turns out I got the last spot.
I'm really sorry, man. It was a lot of fun working with you
Give me a call if you want.
Gosh, I'm so sorry, honey.
Sorry, Chandler.
It is so unfair. It's like that time they promoted Saundra over me at work.
Was she related to Ralph Lauren?
No, she was just much better at her job than me.
You guys, the drawing's about to start.
We should call my mom's and say good night to Emma...
before she goes down. - Good idea.
Honey, you're being really strong about this.
I know how badly you wanted that job.
Yeah, you know, I really thought I deserved it.
But let's go win the lottery. I mean, we still have a 130 chances to win, right?
Hundred and thirty-one.
Yeah, good night, sweetheart. I love you.
And remember, you're Daddy's little girl. Heh.
Phoebe's totally ruined that for me.
Hi, Mom. Put her back on.
Rach, they're announcing the numbers!
My God, I can already feel myself changing.
Here are your official Powerball numbers. We have 53.
I've got that. - We have one too!
We are on the road, people!
Come on!
Mom, please, I know you love your new lips, but I can barely understand you.
Would you please just let me say good night to my daughter?
And here we go. The Powerball is seven.
All right, check your numbers! Make me rich.
You guys, you're not gonna believe this.
I was just saying good night to Emma, and she said her first words.
What? - Well, what did she say?
She said, "Gleba"!
Make me rich!
Isn't that amazing? - Oh, yeah. No, no, no, that's great.
Why aren't you more excited?
Rach, heh, "gleba" is not a word.
Well, of course it is. - Okay. What does it mean?
Well, I don't know all the words.
You know, I'm just glad I didn't miss my daughter's first word.
Yes you did! Gleba is a word! - Okay. Use it in a sentence.
Okay. Uh, Emma just said, "Gleba
It's not a word. - Ugh. Okay, fine. I'm gonna look it up.
Oh, okay, great.
While you're at it, she said another word the other day. Why don't you look up
All right. Okay. Okay. Gleba Gleba. Gleba. Gleba!
Here it is! "The fleshy, spore-bearing inner mass of a certain fungi."
Heh.
She's gonna be a scientist.
Damn it. Anybody got anything? - No.
I'm still looking through mine.
Just double-checking. No.
No. No.
No!
Hello? Hold on.
It's your boss.
Ah, the "I'm sorry I rejected you" phone call.
I'm not used to getting these from guys.
Hey, Steve. - Chandler, hi.
I'm sure you've heard we filled the three positions.
We felt that with your maturity and experience...
you wouldn't be happy being someone's assistant.
I'd love to be somebody's assistant. Answering phones...
getting coffee, I live for that stuff.
And I'm not too mature. Farts, boobies, butt cracks!
Chandler, you were the strongest person in the program.
We're offering you the position of junior copywriter.
Me? That guy who just said, "butt cracks"?
Yes, that's right.
We're excited about the level of sophistication...
you'll be bringing to the job.
Okay. Well, thanks, you won't regret it. I'll see you tomorrow.
What?
Oh, yeah, I'm gonna be a junior copywriter!
Congratulations! Oh, sweetie, I'm so proud of you.
Thanks. Does that mean I get the good loving tonight?
You bet. No TV or anything.
Hey, that is so great about the job. - Thanks, man.
I'd like to think I had something to do with it.
Really? Why? - Well, before with the wishbone.
I, uh, didn't wish we would win the lottery. I wished you'd get the job.
Qh, yeah?
Don't tell Monica. She'll rip your heart out.
Oh, yeah.
Well, you know what? There was a little part of me...
that really thought we were gonna win.
Me too. So much for my dinosaur Amelia Earhart theme park.
You guys? What was the Powerball number again?
Seven. - We won.
What? - We won!
Let me see! Let me see! - Don't tear it!
Phoebe, you don't have any of the first five numbers!
I know that, but look, we got the Powerball number. We won $3!
Wow, you think we should get that over 20 years or go for the big payout?
I don't care. I've never won anything before. I can't believe this!
So, Pheebs, what are you gonna do with your $3?
Well, it's not all mine. We all get 50 cents.
Aw. You know what? You can have mine.
Me too. - Me too.
Me too. Ha, ha.
Well, I guess if everybody else is.
Hey, guys. So I just called the Powerball hot line.
Can you believe it? Nobody won. - Um, I beg to differ.
Maybe nobody won the jackpot, but there was this guy in here earlier...
and he found a ticket on the street right outside and won $10,000.
Coo. Again, don't blame the pretty lady.
It was not her fault. It was me, the pigeon. Coo.
Seriously, stop staring at her.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我可以借你的保时捷吗？
sense_groups.english: Monica? Hey, can I borrow the Porsche?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Okay. - All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么"不准"的呢？
sense_groups.english: But, uh, ahem, what is it not?

sense_groups.chinese: 不准在车上和我女性朋友玩乐
sense_groups.english: A place to entertain my lady friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有什么呢？ - 不准在车上吃意大利面
sense_groups.english: And what else is it not? - A place to eat spaghetti.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常好 - 谢了
sense_groups.english: Very good. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么会需要开车呢？
sense_groups.english: What do you need it for anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 超级大乐透奖金已经累积到三亿了
sense_groups.english: The, uh, lottery is up to 300 million...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是这袒没有在卖彩券
sense_groups.english: and they don't sell tickets here.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你要开车到康乃狄克州买？
sense_groups.english: So you're driving up to Connecticut?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 康乃狄克州 不是西维吉尼亚
sense_groups.english: Yeah, Connecticut. Not West Virginia.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我可以开车载你去 我自己也想买几张彩券
sense_groups.english: Maybe I'll drive you up there. I'd like to buy some tickets myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德现在没有在赚钱 三亿对我们可是会很好用的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, with Chandler not getting paid, we could really use $300 million.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 因为如果我还是在老工作
sense_groups.english: Yes, because if I was at my old job,

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会说"要三亿吗？不用 谢谢"
sense_groups.english: we'd say, "300 million? No, thank you."

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以帮我买吗？ - 对啊 我也要
sense_groups.english: Will you get me tickets too? - Yeah, me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 我有个点子
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Ooh! I have an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以各出资五十块 把钱集合起来
sense_groups.english: Why don't we all pitch in 50 bucks, we'll pool our money together...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后如果我们中奖 我们就照分 - 这主意很棒
sense_groups.english: and then if we win, we'll split it. - That's a great idea!

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 谢了
sense_groups.english: No, thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想要中乐透吗？ - 我当然想
sense_groups.english: You don't want to win the lottery? - Uh, sure I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还想当国王咧
sense_groups.english: I also want to be king of my own country...

sense_groups.chinese: 探索第一位飞越大西洋的女飞行员 是怎么了
sense_groups.english: and find out what happened to Amelia Earhart.

sense_groups.chinese: 还在想女飞行员吗？ - 那女人就这样消失了
sense_groups.english: Still on Amelia Earhart? - The woman just vanished!

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你真的不要加入吗？
sense_groups.english: Seriously, you don't want in on this?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 你们知道 中乐透的机率有多大吗？
sense_groups.english: No. Do you know what your odds are of winning the lottery?

sense_groups.chinese: 比你被闪电打到四十二次的机率还小
sense_groups.english: I mean, you have a better chance of being struck by lightning 42 times.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们有六个人 所以我们只需要被打到七次
sense_groups.english: But there's six of us, so we'd only have to get struck 7 times.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢这种机率
sense_groups.english: I like those odds!

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 你们 我不敢相信你们会 愿意花两百块钱在乐透上面
sense_groups.english: Seriously, you guys, I can't believe you're gonna spend $250 on the lottery.

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在太唬烂了吧？
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's such a bunch of boo-hockey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来问
sense_groups.english: I'll ask.

sense_groups.chinese: "唬烂"？
sense_groups.english: "Boo-hockey"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们认为艾玛已经快要开始说话了
sense_groups.english: Oh, we think Emma's about to start talking...

sense_groups.english: so we're trying to be careful about what words we use in front of her.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以准备好 你们会听到很多的"胡说"…

sense_groups.chinese: "讨厌"还有"惹人烦"等等
sense_groups.english: gosh darn it and brother pucker.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么知道她要开始说话了呢？
sense_groups.english: How do you know she's gonna start talking?

sense_groups.chinese: 当我跟她说话时 我几乎可以感觉到 她听得懂我在说什么
sense_groups.english: When I talk to her, I almost feel like she understands what I'm saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 有点像乔伊
sense_groups.english: Kind of like Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么？
sense_groups.english: What's that now?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 瞧瞧这全部的彩券 真是紧张刺激
sense_groups.english: God, look at all these tickets. It's so exciting.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从六年级后 我就没有赢过任何东西了
sense_groups.english: I haven't won anything since sixth grade.

sense_groups.chinese: 吃派大赛吗？
sense_groups.english: Pie-eating contest?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我很胖 你就以为 那是我唯一能赢的比赛吗？?
sense_groups.english: You assume because I was heavy that's the only way I could win something?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我看过你埋在蓝莓派里面的照片

sense_groups.chinese: 那时候真快乐 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: That was a good day. - Yeah.

sense_groups.english: They're towing a car.

sense_groups.chinese: 我眼花了
sense_groups.english: And I am seeing spots.
