sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛呢？艾玛谁在带呢？ - 乔伊 别紧张
sense_groups.english: Where's Emma? Who has Emma? - Joey, relax.

sense_groups.chinese: 我妈两小时前来带走她了 你也在场啊
sense_groups.english: My mother picked her up two hours ago. You were there.

sense_groups.chinese: 有吗？ - 是的 而且你还跟她说话
sense_groups.english: I was? - Yes, and you talked to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有吗？ - 她还带来了砂锅菜来
sense_groups.english: I did? - She dropped off a casserole.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 对啊 那个砂锅女士
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, the casserole lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 你过来看我们中大奖的吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you come by to watch us win the big bucks?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 然后我想在你们中奖后 我们全部到阳台上…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And then I figured after you win, we can all go out to the balcony...

sense_groups.chinese: 看有小精灵…在跳舞的夜间彩虹
sense_groups.english: and see a night rainbow with gremlins dancing on top of it.

sense_groups.chinese: 别接电话 我来接
sense_groups.english: Don't touch the phone! I'll get it! I'll get it!

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得他有洗手吗？ - 哈罗？
sense_groups.english: You think he washed his hands? - Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 查理 有什么消息？ - 怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Charlie, what do you know? - What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德想知道他有没有得到 公司内部的一个工作机会
sense_groups.english: Chandler's supposed to find out if he's getting a job at his agency.

sense_groups.chinese: 但在十五名实习生中 他们只聘请三个人
sense_groups.english: But out of 15 interns, they're only hiring three.

sense_groups.chinese: 机率真小 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Ooh. Tough odds. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 还真希望能像你们二十四州…联合彩券的机率一样高
sense_groups.english: If only it were a sure thing like your 24-state lottery.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 瞧瞧谁想通了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, look who's coming around!

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 好啦 有更多消息再告诉我
sense_groups.english: Damn it. All right, call me when you know more.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有得到吗？ －一个名额已经被占了
sense_groups.english: Did you get it? - One of the slots got filled.

sense_groups.chinese: 被你吗？ - 注意我的语气
sense_groups.english: By you? - Sense the tone.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 一个叫做奈特的小子 - 喔 我讨厌那个人
sense_groups.english: No, that kid Nate got it. - Oh, I hate that guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 真是的 穿上裤子吧 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: I mean, come on, pull up your pants! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有两个名额不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, there's two spots left, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我真的好想要 我想要被录取
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I mean, I want this so much. I want to get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 也希望我朋友查理被录取
sense_groups.english: I want my friend Charlie to get one.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我不是很在乎查理
sense_groups.english: Except I don't care about Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们好 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会相信的 我刚刚去找过我的算命师
sense_groups.english: You are not gonna believe this. I just saw my psychic...

sense_groups.chinese: 她说我今晚一定会中乐透
sense_groups.english: and she said I was definitely gonna win the lottery tonight!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要增加好运…
sense_groups.english: I thought we could use some extra luck...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以从餐厅带幸运骨头回来
sense_groups.english: so I brought a wishbone home from work.

sense_groups.chinese: 算命师跟幸运骨头？拜托给别人一点机会吧
sense_groups.english: A psychic and a wishbone? Guys, give someone else a chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 谁要来做呢？ - 我可以吗？
sense_groups.english: All right, who wants to do it? - Ooh, can I?

sense_groups.chinese: 素食者从来就没有机会玩幸运骨头
sense_groups.english: Vegetarians never get to do the wishbone.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是不公平 我们只是不吃肉
sense_groups.english: It's really not fair. Just because we don't eat the meat...

sense_groups.chinese: 不代表我们不喜欢玩骨头
sense_groups.english: doesn't mean we don't like to play with the carcasses.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 瑞秋呢？
sense_groups.english: All right. Rash'?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想要双手沾满火鸡的味道
sense_groups.english: I don't want that turkey smell all over my hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来 我要把砂锅菜的味道盖过去
sense_groups.english: I'll do it! It'll get the casserole stink off of mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 希望我会赢 - 嗯 没有关系
sense_groups.english: I hope I win. - Well, it doesn't really matter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们的愿望是一样的
sense_groups.english: You're both wishing for the same thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能告诉你我许什么愿 要不然不会实现的
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you what I'm wishing for, or else, you know, it won't come true. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 但是我们都知道你许什么愿
sense_groups.english: Right. But we know what you're wishing for.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能说 - 我了解
sense_groups.english: I can't really say. - I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你许的愿 跟我们想的一样 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: But you're wishing for what we think, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很不喜欢这些问题
sense_groups.english: I'm not really comfortable with these questions!

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 - 赶快做
sense_groups.english: Please! - Just do it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay. One, two, three.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赢了 嘿
sense_groups.english: I won! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗？我确定 你们的愿望会成真
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm sure your wish is gonna come true.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 为了以防万一 我们来磨擦这个灯 或许精灵会出现
sense_groups.english: But, you guys, just in case, maybe a genie will come out if we rub this lamp.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Ow!

sense_groups.chinese: 那东西好烫
sense_groups.english: That thing gets hot!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 继续说你的笑话吧
sense_groups.english: Ross, just keep making yourjokes.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们中了 你有什么感受？
sense_groups.english: How are you gonna feel if we actually do win?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会中的 - 我知道机率很小
sense_groups.english: Uh, you're not gonna win. - I know the odds are against us...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是总是有人会中 可能就是我们 然后你会觉得如何呢？
sense_groups.english: but somebody has to win, and it could be us. And then how you gonna feel?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会说"大家开直升机去海角玩吧"
sense_groups.english: We're gonna be like, "Everybody, let's take our helicopters up to the Cape."

sense_groups.chinese: 而你只能说"喔 我不行…
sense_groups.english: And you're gonna be all, like, "Oh, I can't, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们到那边趣面好了 我先帮我的车子加满油"
sense_groups.english: I'll have to meet you up there. I gotta gas up the Hyundai."

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我听过自己在录音带里的声音 我听起来根本不像那样
sense_groups.english: Okay, I've heard myself on tape, and I sound nothing like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以想像头条新闻是 "彩券赢家的朋友…
sense_groups.english: I can see the headline now: "Lottery Winners' Friend...

sense_groups.chinese: 充满懊悔 吃下自己的手臂"
sense_groups.english: Filled With Regret, Eats Own Arm."

sense_groups.chinese: 我为什么要吃自己的手臂？
sense_groups.english: Why would I eat my own arm?

sense_groups.chinese: 你当然不会 但是报纸是我们的 我们爱怎么写就怎么写
sense_groups.english: Well, you wouldn't, but we own the paper. We can print whatever we want.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我帮你出五十块好了
sense_groups.english: You know what? I'm gonna throw in 50 bucks for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 因为我知道你认为…
sense_groups.english: Why? - Because I know that you think...

sense_groups.chinese: 乐透是很唬烂的东西
sense_groups.english: that the lottery is boo-hockey...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们全都聚在一起 看开奖 会很好玩的
sense_groups.english: but we're all here, and we're gonna watch the numbers and have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你是我哥哥 我希望你能参与
sense_groups.english: And you're my brother, and I want you to be a part of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不需要这样做的 我可以自己出钱
sense_groups.english: You don't have to do that. I mean, I'll pay for myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你想要让我跟你们一起同乐 真的是太窝心了
sense_groups.english: But just the fact that you want me to have fun with you guys, that's so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 过来
sense_groups.english: Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 去开个房间吧
sense_groups.english: Get a room.

sense_groups.chinese: 那既然你已经加入了 要是中奖 你要做什么事呢？
sense_groups.english: So now that you're in, what are you gonna do if we win?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 或许投资吧 - 对 要冷静
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I'll probably just invest it. - Ooh. Calm down.

sense_groups.chinese: 正经点 你的梦想呢？投资？
sense_groups.english: Seriously, that's your fantasy? To invest it?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我很抱歉 我是说投资吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. Did I say,

sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是"快乐的全部花光光"
sense_groups.english: "invest it"? I meant, "Be cool and piss it all away."

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 我们该把全部的钱凑起来 买下尼克队
sense_groups.english: Oh! Oh! I know! We should pool all our money and buy the Knicks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是很在乎尼克队
sense_groups.english: I don't really care about the Knicks.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我选你当前锋 你就会了
sense_groups.english: You will when I pick you as starting forward.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会那样做吗？我从没有被选上
sense_groups.english: You would do that? I never get picked!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定球队会是正确的选择
sense_groups.english: I'm not sure a sports team is the way to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不让我买尼克队吗？我不敢相信你要打碎我的梦想
sense_groups.english: You won't let me buy the Knicks? I can't believe you're taking this away.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的对 这个梦想 已经有十五秒之久了
sense_groups.english: You're right, it has been your dream for over 15 seconds.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们还有多久才会公布号码呢？妈味
sense_groups.english: Uh, how long until they announce the numbers, Mommy?

sense_groups.chinese: 这个也让我来 什么"妈味"啊？
sense_groups.english: I'll take this one too. Uh, "Mommy"?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我已经习惯叫瑞秋…
sense_groups.english: Oh, I've gotten into the habit of calling Rachel "Mommy"...

sense_groups.chinese: "妈味" 只要是艾玛在场
sense_groups.english: when we're around Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在发现她并不在
sense_groups.english: Which I now realize we are not.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望如果她听久了
sense_groups.english: I'm hoping that if she hears it enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 这将成为她第一句会说的话 - 喔
sense_groups.english: it'll be her first word. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们真的要这样做 你也应该叫我"爹地"才对
sense_groups.english: Although if we're gonna do that, we should probably call me "Daddy" too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢 爹地
sense_groups.english: Mm. I like that, Daddy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在说瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I, uh... I was just talking about Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 爹地生气了吗？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, is Daddy getting angry?

sense_groups.chinese: 爹地要打我吗？
sense_groups.english: Is Daddy gonna spank me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 要看情况
sense_groups.english: Well, that depends.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是坏…？不 我演不下去了
sense_groups.english: Have you been a bad...? No, I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗？哈罗？嘿 查理 还有其他人知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? Hello? Hey, Charlie. Did anybody else hear?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？苏珊拿到了？怎么会呢？
sense_groups.english: What? Susan got it? How?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊 早知道我也跟他上床
sense_groups.english: Oh, man, I would've slept with him!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 拜
sense_groups.english: All right, bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 我很抱歉 但是 还有一个名额不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Dude, I'm sorry. But hey, there's one spot left, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 查理会得到的 - 嘿 别那样说
sense_groups.english: Well, Charlie's gonna get that. - Hey, don't say that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也有机会得到那工作的
sense_groups.english: You've got just as good a chance of getting that job.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是老板的儿子
sense_groups.english: He is the boss' son.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 乐透 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Come on, lottery! - Yeah!

sense_groups.chinese: 再大概二十分钟就开奖了 - 好了 我们来吧
sense_groups.english: It starts in, like, 20 minutes. - Okay, here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们需要快点分配这些彩券来对奖
sense_groups.english: We need to sort through the tickets quickly to see if we've won.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人有什么主意要怎么安排吗？
sense_groups.english: So does anybody have any ideas how to organize this?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 看看这样如何
sense_groups.english: Okay, how about this

sense_groups.chinese: 我们分成六组各四十张
sense_groups.english: We divide them into six groups of 40.

sense_groups.chinese: 剩下的十张就由先对完的人来对
sense_groups.english: The remaining 10 can be read by whoever finishes first.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有一个主意 - 很抱歉 提议时间已经过了
sense_groups.english: I have another idea. - I'm sorry, idea time is over.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有的彩券都在碗里了吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Well, are all the tickets in the bowl? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那床头柜上面的那些呢？ - 那边没有彩券
sense_groups.english: What about the ones on the nightstand? - There are no tickets there.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 那边有 我几分钟前才看到
sense_groups.english: Yes, there are. I just saw them a few minutes ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 不对 没有 你看错了
sense_groups.english: Heh. Uh, no, you didn't. You must be mistaken.

sense_groups.chinese: 床头柜上有二十张彩券 - 钱德 注意我的语气
sense_groups.english: There are 20 tickets on the nightstand. - Chandler, sense the tone.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 喔 喔 瞧瞧妈咪找到了什么
sense_groups.english: Well, well, well. Look what Mommy found.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啦 我帮自己跟钱德多买了二十张
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. I bought 20 extra tickets for me and Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 算命的还说我会被朋友给背叛
sense_groups.english: The psychic also said that I would be betrayed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信 我以为我们是一起的
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this. I thought we were all in this together.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你五分钟前才加入的 - 是三分钟
sense_groups.english: Hey, you just got in five minutes ago! - Three minutes ago!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道那有什么重要的
sense_groups.english: I don't know why that's important.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直都跟你在一起 你是什么时候买的？
sense_groups.english: I was with you the whole time. When did you even get those?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你在看未拆封的色情书刊的时候
sense_groups.english: When you were reading the dirty magazines without taking off the plastic.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以后再教你怎么看
sense_groups.english: I'll show you how.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 摩妮卡 假设你的彩券中奖了怎么办？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, Monica, suppose one of your special tickets wins?

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得中了彩券 失去了朋友又怎样？
sense_groups.english: How are you gonna feel when you win and lose your friends?

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 如果我中奖了 你们才不会离开我
sense_groups.english: Please. If I win the lottery, you guys are not gonna leave me.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人上星期给我一堆松饼 害我整整三天都被你们骚扰
sense_groups.english: Someone gave me muffins last week. I couldn't get rid of you for three days!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你可以告诉她这是不对的吗？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, would you just tell her what she did was wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说的对 你不应该 帮我们两个另买彩券
sense_groups.english: She's right. You shouldn't have bought tickets just for us.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我说完
sense_groups.english: Let me finish.

sense_groups.chinese: 然而 看起来我好像得不到这份工作了
sense_groups.english: However, it doesn't look like I'm gonna get this job...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我不能太有原则 去你们的 彩券是我们的
sense_groups.english: so I can't afford to have principles. So screw you! The tickets are ours!

sense_groups.chinese: 这才是我嫁的好男人
sense_groups.english: There's the man I married.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 相信我 如果你们中奖了
sense_groups.english: All right. Believe me, if you win the lottery...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们就跟我们不是朋友了
sense_groups.english: it's the last you're gonna hear from us.

sense_groups.chinese: 无所谓 不要当我的朋友就算了 我会买新朋友的
sense_groups.english: Fine. Don't be my friends. I'll buy new friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我还会付钱让他们动整形手术
sense_groups.english: Yeah, and then I'll pay for their plastic surgery

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们看起来跟你们一模一样
sense_groups.english: so they look just like you!

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我要拿回我的份
sense_groups.english: You know what? I want my share of the tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也要拿回我的彩券 而且我要买下尼克队
sense_groups.english: I want my tickets too! And I'm buying the Knicks!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有葛拉芙
sense_groups.english: And Steffi Graf! Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 那我也要拿回我的 而且如果我中奖…
sense_groups.english: Cool. Then I want mine too! And if I win...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要拿全部的钱去买低利公债
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna put it all into a very low-yield bond!

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我们必须要 把全部的彩券集合在一起
sense_groups.english: No. You guys, we gotta keep all the tickets together.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我们应该分一分
sense_groups.english: No. No, we should divide them up...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我应该多分点 因为是开我的车买的
sense_groups.english: and I should get extra because we used my car!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 如果有人可以多拿一些 那个人应该是我
sense_groups.english: Hey! Hey! If anybody gets extra tickets, it should be me!

sense_groups.chinese: 这整件事都是我想出来的 - 是啊 谢谢你发明乐透
sense_groups.english: This whole thing was my idea! - Yeah. Thanks for inventing the lottery!

sense_groups.chinese: 把彩春给我 我来分
sense_groups.english: Just give them to me, and I'll split them up!

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: OW! - Ah!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 啊哈
sense_groups.english: Hey - Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我再也受不了了 我来结束这一切
sense_groups.english: God, I can't take it anymore! I'm putting an end to this!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果她跳楼了 她的彩春就是我的 - 等等 不 嘿
sense_groups.english: Okay, if she jumps, I get her tickets! - Wait, no, no! Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我们不要一起合资 那我们就什么都不要
sense_groups.english: If we're not doing this together, we're not doing it at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 跟你们的彩券说再见吧 - 不 不 不
sense_groups.english: Say goodbye to your tickets. - No! No! No!

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再靠近过来了
sense_groups.english: Do not come any closer!

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以再靠近一点点吗？我的宝贝被压到了
sense_groups.english: Can I come a little bit closer? Valuable things are getting squished.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在 什么比较重要？朋友还是钱？
sense_groups.english: Now, what's more important, your friends or money?

sense_groups.chinese: 朋友 - 钱
sense_groups.english: Friends! - Money!

sense_groups.chinese: 朋友
sense_groups.english: Friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 摩妮卡 那你其它的彩券呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Monica, what about your extra tickets?

sense_groups.chinese: 全都在里面了
sense_groups.english: They're all in there.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有我内衣藏的这五张 - 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Even these five that I hid in my bra. - Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 很好 你们都吓坏了
sense_groups.english: Okay. Good. You guys were so scared.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不可能会丢掉这些…
sense_groups.english: There is no way I was gonna dump this...

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 不
sense_groups.english: Aah!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我把你的碗摔破了
sense_groups.english: I think I broke your bowl.

sense_groups.chinese: 快 快 快
sense_groups.english: Go! Go! Go!

sense_groups.chinese: 到卫上去找彩券 真是美好的夜晚啊
sense_groups.english: What a beautiful night to be running around the street, looking for tickets.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且被风一吹就更有趣了
sense_groups.english: And the wind sure made it fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 有一半不见了 - 那又如何呢？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, we lost half of them. - So what?

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我们还是会中奖的
sense_groups.english: Monica, we have the winning ticket.

sense_groups.chinese: 算命师说我会中奖的 记得吗？
sense_groups.english: My psychic said I was gonna win, remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 奇怪的是 算命师并没有算到可怕的鹄子
sense_groups.english: Weird your psychic didn't mention anything about the scary pigeon.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上她是有说过 我会那样死去
sense_groups.english: As a matter of fact, she said that's how I'm going to die.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 原谅我有点被吓到
sense_groups.english: So excuse me for being a little skittish.

sense_groups.chinese: 有两通留官 可能是工作的消．急
sense_groups.english: There's two messages. This could be from work.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 放来听听 - 好了 来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, play them. - Okay. Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 我是阳台上的鸽子 打电话过来道歉的
sense_groups.english: Hello. This is the pigeon from the balcony calling to apologize.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不应该把彩券 从那捆漂亮小姐手中弄翻
sense_groups.english: I shouldn't have knocked the tickets out of the pretty lady's hand.

sense_groups.chinese: 这全是我的错 不关她的事 拜
sense_groups.english: It was all my fault. Not hers. Bye. Coo.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我敢说要他这样道歉 一定很难
sense_groups.english: Well, I bet that was very hard for him to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德 我是查理
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler, it's Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是这个了
sense_groups.english: This is it. Shh, Shh!

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 结果是我拿到最后的名额
sense_groups.english: Listen, um, it turns out I got the last spot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 老兄 很高兴跟你共事过
sense_groups.english: I'm really sorry, man. It was a lot of fun working with you

sense_groups.chinese: 再打电话给我吧
sense_groups.english: Give me a call if you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我很难过 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Gosh, I'm so sorry, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 真替你难过 钱德
sense_groups.english: Sorry, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是不公平 这就像那次 他们升珊卓 而不是我一样
sense_groups.english: It is so unfair. It's like that time they promoted Saundra over me at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 她跟洛夫罗伦有亲戚关系吗？
sense_groups.english: Was she related to Ralph Lauren?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 只是她工作能力比我强太多了
sense_groups.english: No, she was just much better at her job than me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们大家 快要开奖了
sense_groups.english: You guys, the drawing's about to start.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该打电话给我妈 跟艾玛说晚安
sense_groups.english: We should call my mom's and say good night to Emma...

sense_groups.chinese: 赶在她睡着以前 - 好主意
sense_groups.english: before she goes down. - Good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 面对这件事你真的很坚强
sense_groups.english: Honey, you're being really strong about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你很想要这份工作
sense_groups.english: I know how badly you wanted that job.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你知道的 我真的以为这是该给我的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you know, I really thought I deserved it.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我们来中乐透吧 我们还有一百三十个机会不是吗？
sense_groups.english: But let's go win the lottery. I mean, we still have a 130 chances to win, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 一百三十一个
sense_groups.english: Hundred and thirty-one.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 晚安甜心 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Yeah, good night, sweetheart. I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有记住 你是爹地的小女孩
sense_groups.english: And remember, you're Daddy's little girl. Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比完全毁了"爹地"
sense_groups.english: Phoebe's totally ruined that for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 妈 让艾玛听
sense_groups.english: Hi, Mom. Put her back on.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 他们在开奖了
sense_groups.english: Rach, they're announcing the numbers!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我可以感到自己在改变了
sense_groups.english: My God, I can already feel myself changing.

sense_groups.chinese: 这袒是正式超级大乐透中奖号码 我们有五十三
sense_groups.english: Here are your official Powerball numbers. We have 53.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有 - 我们也有一个
sense_groups.english: I've got that. - We have one too!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们快中奖了
sense_groups.english: We are on the road, people!

sense_groups.chinese: 快点
sense_groups.english: Come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 妈 拜托 我知道你喜欢你的新嘴唇 但是我不太懂你在说什么
sense_groups.english: Mom, please, I know you love your new lips, but I can barely understand you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以让我跟我女儿道晚安吗？
sense_groups.english: Would you please just let me say good night to my daughter?

sense_groups.chinese: 然后接下来的号码是七
sense_groups.english: And here we go. The Powerball is seven.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你们快对号码 让我发财吧
sense_groups.english: All right, check your numbers! Make me rich.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们大家 你们不会相信这个的
sense_groups.english: You guys, you're not gonna believe this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚在跟艾玛说晚安的时候 她说了第一句话
sense_groups.english: I was just saying good night to Emma, and she said her first words.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 那她说了什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What? - Well, what did she say?

sense_groups.chinese: 她说了"葛利巴"

sense_groups.chinese: 让我发财吧

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是很惊人呢？ - 是啊 真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Isn't that amazing? - Oh, yeah. No, no, no, that's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么你没有很兴奋呢？
sense_groups.english: Why aren't you more excited?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 葛利巴不算一句话

sense_groups.chinese: 它当然算 - 好吧 那它是什么意思呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, of course it is. - Okay. What does it mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我又不认识所有的字词
sense_groups.english: Well, I don't know all the words.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是很高兴我没有错过 我女儿说第一句话
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm just glad I didn't miss my daughter's first word.

sense_groups.chinese: 你就是错过了 葛利巴算 - 好的 那用它造句
sense_groups.english: Yes you did! Gleba is a word! - Okay. Use it in a sentence.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 艾玛刚刚说了"葛利巴"
sense_groups.english: Okay. Uh, Emma just said, "Gleba

sense_groups.chinese: 那不算说话 - 好的 我来查字典
sense_groups.english: It's not a word. - Ugh. Okay, fine. I'm gonna look it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 顺便查一下 有天她也说了另外一句…你何不也查查看这个
sense_groups.english: While you're at it, she said another word the other day. Why don't you look up

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 葛利巴 葛利巴 葛利巴
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay. Okay. Gleba Gleba. Gleba. Gleba!

sense_groups.chinese: 找到了 "含抱子的丰厚菌种"
sense_groups.english: Here it is! "The fleshy, spore-bearing inner mass of a certain fungi."

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Heh.

sense_groups.chinese: 她会成为科学家的
sense_groups.english: She's gonna be a scientist.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的 有人有对到吗？ - 没有
sense_groups.english: Damn it. Anybody got anything? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还在对我的
sense_groups.english: I'm still looking through mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 再对一次 没有
sense_groups.english: Just double-checking. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 没有
sense_groups.english: No. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗？等一下
sense_groups.english: Hello? Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你老板
sense_groups.english: It's your boss.

sense_groups.chinese: "很抱歉没用你"的电话来了
sense_groups.english: Ah, the "I'm sorry I rejected you" phone call.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还真不习惯男生打这种电话来
sense_groups.english: I'm not used to getting these from guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 史提夫 - 钱德 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey, Steve. - Chandler, hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你已经听说我们三个名额都满了
sense_groups.english: I'm sure you've heard we filled the three positions.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们觉得以你的成熟度及经验
sense_groups.english: We felt that with your maturity and experience...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会想要当助理的
sense_groups.english: you wouldn't be happy being someone's assistant.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱死当助理了 接听电话…
sense_groups.english: I'd love to be somebody's assistant. Answering phones...

sense_groups.chinese: 倒咖啡 我就是为那些工作而活的
sense_groups.english: getting coffee, I live for that stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我并没有很成熟 放屁 咪咪 屁蛋
sense_groups.english: And I'm not too mature. Farts, boobies, butt cracks!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 你是全部的人里面最优秀的
sense_groups.english: Chandler, you were the strongest person in the program.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要聘请你当初级广告文案
sense_groups.english: We're offering you the position of junior copywriter.

sense_groups.chinese: 我？那个刚刚才说"屁蚤"的人？
sense_groups.english: Me? That guy who just said, "butt cracks"?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 没错
sense_groups.english: Yes, that's right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很期望你能带给这份工作…
sense_groups.english: We're excited about the level of sophistication...

sense_groups.chinese: 一定程度的深度
sense_groups.english: you'll be bringing to the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 谢谢 你不会失望的 明天见
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, thanks, you won't regret it. I'll see you tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 我要当初级广告文案了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, I'm gonna be a junior copywriter!

sense_groups.chinese: 恭喜了 亲爱的 我真以你为荣
sense_groups.english: Congratulations! Oh, sweetie, I'm so proud of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 这表示我今晚可以被爱爱吗？
sense_groups.english: Thanks. Does that mean I get the good loving tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 不看电视或什么其它的
sense_groups.english: You bet. No TV or anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 恭喜你找到工作了 - 谢了 老兄
sense_groups.english: Hey, that is so great about the job. - Thanks, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 我其实也有帮到忙
sense_groups.english: I'd like to think I had something to do with it.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？怎么说？ - 刚刚在玩幸福骨头的时候…
sense_groups.english: Really? Why? - Well, before with the wishbone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有许愿我们中乐透 我许的愿是你找到工作
sense_groups.english: I, uh, didn't wish we would win the lottery. I wished you'd get the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 是吗？
sense_groups.english: Qh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 别告诉摩妮卡 她会把你的心脏挖出来的
sense_groups.english: Don't tell Monica. She'll rip your heart out.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗？我一直有一点点感觉
sense_groups.english: Well, you know what? There was a little part of me...

sense_groups.chinese: 觉得我们好像真的会中奖
sense_groups.english: that really thought we were gonna win.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 都是为了我的恐龙与女飞行员主题公园
sense_groups.english: Me too. So much for my dinosaur Amelia Earhart theme park.

sense_groups.chinese: 各位？幸运球号码是什么？
sense_groups.english: You guys? What was the Powerball number again?

sense_groups.chinese: 七 - 我们中奖了
sense_groups.english: Seven. - We won.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 我们中奖了
sense_groups.english: What? - We won!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看 让我看 - 别撕掉了
sense_groups.english: Let me see! Let me see! - Don't tear it!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你其它五个号码都不对
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, you don't have any of the first five numbers!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 但是我们中了特别号 我们中了三块钱
sense_groups.english: I know that, but look, we got the Powerball number. We won $3!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你觉得我们应该分二十年提颌 还是一次颌光呢？
sense_groups.english: Wow, you think we should get that over 20 years or go for the big payout?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不管 我从来就没有 中过任何东西 我真不敢相信
sense_groups.english: I don't care. I've never won anything before. I can't believe this!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 你要怎么运用这三块钱呢？
sense_groups.english: So, Pheebs, what are you gonna do with your $3?

sense_groups.chinese: 又不是全都是我的 我们每个人都有五十分
sense_groups.english: Well, it's not all mine. We all get 50 cents.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我的份给你
sense_groups.english: Aw. You know what? You can have mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的也是 - 我的也是
sense_groups.english: Me too. - Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的也是
sense_groups.english: Me too. Ha, ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 既然大家都要给你
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess if everybody else is.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我刚刚打电话给乐透公司
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. So I just called the Powerball hot line.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们敢相信吗？没有人中奖耶 - 我希望不是那样
sense_groups.english: Can you believe it? Nobody won. - Um, I beg to differ.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许没有人中头奖 但是稍早有个人在这里…
sense_groups.english: Maybe nobody won the jackpot, but there was this guy in here earlier...

sense_groups.chinese: 在外面检到一张彩春 中了一万块钱
sense_groups.english: and he found a ticket on the street right outside and won $10,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再责怪漂亮小姐了
sense_groups.english: Coo. Again, don't blame the pretty lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是她的错 是鹄子我的错
sense_groups.english: It was not her fault. It was me, the pigeon. Coo.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 不要再瞪她了
sense_groups.english: Seriously, stop staring at her.

questions.en:
God, you're beautiful.
Why are we fighting this?
You know you want it to happen as much as I do.
I want you. I need you.
Let me make love to you.

but I think a cantaloupe might hurt less.

Wow, I haven't seen you this worked-up since you did that dog-food commercial...
and you thought you were gonna be with a real talking dog.

"Oh, my God. Is this the men's room? I feel so foolish.

Sure!
I'd love to.

because my license has been revoked again.

and I need to change it.

It still seems a little... "Moonlight boat ride"?
Joey, is this the bed where Olivia lost her virginity?
I don't know, but one of the extras sure did.

if these guys were gay, I don't know if I could do this.
I'm sorry, you're right. I'm sorry. Good luck.
On a bell, please.Quietly.
And action!
Drake, what are you doing here?
Stopping you from marrying the wrong man...
and making the biggest mistake of your life.
Get out. - You don't love him.

I know what I felt that night when we kissed under the bridge.
That kiss never happened. - Well, what about this one?
Now, I told you to get out.

Yes, you do. I'm the one who doesn't have a choice because I...

Just
tell me to stop.

Or, cut. You know, that's your call.

Thank you.

Human spleen
Ow

because they requested a bunch of my songs.

and, um, "Shut Up and Go Home."
Listen, Phoebe. - Yeah.

but... - But what?

Okay, say no more.
It wasn't just that she was fat The woman smelled like garbage

New York. - The Big Apple.

and now we don't have a reservation? - I don't know what to say.

and if they're closed, then maybe we'll tap a tree and make some ourselves.

um, I take six.

weird, romantic dreams?

in no way.

maybe I wasn't clear before.

my bar sales have gone up like crazy.

MY maple candy!

how many of you were bothered by this woman's singing outside?

but not in keeping with the tone of the restaurant?

that she made a big deal about her friend playing her music...

sense_groups.english: Oh. Ahem. - Okay. All right, wish me luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不是真的需要运气才做的好 但… 天啊那是杰斯莱西特吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Not that you need it, but good... God! Is that Chase Lassiter?

sense_groups.chinese: 他是异性恋 对吧？ - 瑞秋 如果没有你在这里猜测…
sense_groups.english: He's straight, right? - Rash, if you weren't here wondering...

sense_groups.chinese: 这些男的是不是同志… 我还真的不知道我能不能演的好
sense_groups.english: if these guys were gay, I don't know if I could do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 你说的对 很抱歉 祝你好运
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, you're right. I'm sorry. Good luck.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托准备好 安静
sense_groups.english: On a bell, please.Quietly.

sense_groups.chinese: 开拍
sense_groups.english: And action!

sense_groups.chinese: 德瑞克 你在这里做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Drake, what are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 阻止你嫁给不对的人…
sense_groups.english: Stopping you from marrying the wrong man...

sense_groups.chinese: 犯下你这辈子最大的错误
sense_groups.english: and making the biggest mistake of your life.

sense_groups.chinese: 出去 - 你并不爱他
sense_groups.english: Get out. - You don't love him.

sense_groups.chinese: 你懂什么是爱？
sense_groups.english: What do you know about love?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道那晚我们在 桥下接吻的感觉是什么
sense_groups.english: I know what I felt that night when we kissed under the bridge.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个吻并没有发生 - 那么 这个呢？
sense_groups.english: That kiss never happened. - Well, what about this one?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说过了 滚出去
sense_groups.english: Now, I told you to get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我走
sense_groups.english: Fine, I'll go.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是让我问你一个问题
sense_groups.english: But let me ask you one question.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看起来很面熟 我们有…？ - 嘘 他要问她问题
sense_groups.english: You look real familiar. Have we...? - Shh! He's asking her a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以度过一生而不知道 我们如果在一起会是如何吗？
sense_groups.english: Can you live the rest of your life never knowing what we could have been?

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有选择 - 你有选择的
sense_groups.english: I don't have a choice. - Yes, you do.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有的 我才是那个没有选择的人 因为我…
sense_groups.english: Yes, you do. I'm the one who doesn't have a choice because I...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我无法停止爱你
sense_groups.english: Because I can't stop loving you.

sense_groups.chinese: 别那样说 - 你叫我停下来吧
sense_groups.english: Don't say that. - Tell me to stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只要…
sense_groups.english: Just

sense_groups.chinese: 叫我停下来
sense_groups.english: tell me to stop.

sense_groups.chinese: 卡 - 不
sense_groups.english: Cut! - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 卡也好 那是你的决定
sense_groups.english: Or, cut. You know, that's your call.

sense_groups.chinese: 每道菜都很美味 - 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Everything was delicious. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 尤其是鸭肉更是美味绝伦
sense_groups.english: It was. The duck in particular was superb.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还没有开口说话
sense_groups.english: You haven't said anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实我有一捆小小的抱怨
sense_groups.english: Actually, I do have one small complaint.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 请说 我欢迎各种批评指教
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, please, I welcome criticism.

sense_groups.chinese: 餐厅外面的歌手有点破坏气气
sense_groups.english: The musician right outside the restaurant is kind of a mood killer.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么歌手？
sense_groups.english: What musician?

sense_groups.chinese: 有个国家叫阿根廷
sense_groups.english: And there's a country called Argentina

sense_groups.chinese: 这是我从未见过的地方
sense_groups.english: It's a place I've never seen

sense_groups.chinese: 但我被告知 你付50比索可买人的怨气
sense_groups.english: But I'm told for 50 pesos You can buy a human spleen

sense_groups.chinese: 人的怨气
sense_groups.english: Human spleen

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Ow

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你们的客人都排队排到街上 所以我就过来娱乐他们了
sense_groups.english: You said you had customers lined up in the street, so I'm here to entertain.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 - 是啊 一切都进行的很好
sense_groups.english: Great. - Yeah, it really has been great too.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们一定有看我表演过
sense_groups.english: They must have seen me play before...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为他们一直要点我的许多歌曲
sense_groups.english: because they requested a bunch of my songs.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是《你逊毙了》
sense_groups.english: Yeah, "You Suck"...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有《闭嘴回家去》
sense_groups.english: and, um, "Shut Up and Go Home."

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 菲比 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Listen, Phoebe. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我很爱听你的歌
sense_groups.english: You know how much I love listening to your music...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是… - 但是什么？
sense_groups.english: but... - But what?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个蛮高级的场所
sense_groups.english: Um, this is kind of a classy place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 不用多说了
sense_groups.english: Okay, say no more.

sense_groups.chinese: 这不只是因为她很胖 女人才像垃圾
sense_groups.english: It wasn't just that she was fat The woman smelled like garbage

sense_groups.chinese: 大家一起来
sense_groups.english: Everyone!

sense_groups.chinese: 这不只是因为她很胖 女人才像垃圾
sense_groups.english: It wasn't just that she was fat The woman smelled like garbage

sense_groups.chinese: 高级 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Classy, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是钱德宾 我有订房
sense_groups.english: Hi, Chandler Bing. I have a reservation.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎来到小木屋 宾先生 你们是从哪里来的呢？
sense_groups.english: Welcome to the Chestnut Inn. Where are you joining us from?

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约 - 大苹果
sense_groups.english: New York. - The Big Apple.

sense_groups.chinese: 他太兴奋了 我们来这里的路上 每间枫糖糖果店都有停下来
sense_groups.english: He's wound up. We had to stop at every maple-candy stand on the way here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我吃光了要买给大家的礼物
sense_groups.english: I ate all my gifts for everybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 电脑没有登记您的预订
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, there's no record of your reservation in the computer.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不可能的 请再查一次 - 请再查一次
sense_groups.english: That's impossible. Check again, please. - Check again, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 没有 - 没有
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, it's not here. - It's not there.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我搞清楚 我有打过电话来 试着要取消我的预约
sense_groups.english: Let me get this straight. I called to try to cancel my reservation...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们告诉我不能取消 然后我们开了六小时的车到这里
sense_groups.english: was told it's not refundable. We drove six hours all the way up here...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在你又说我们没有订房？ - 我不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: and now we don't have a reservation? - I don't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 她不知道该说什么
sense_groups.english: She doesn't know what to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 那给我们最便宜的房间就好了
sense_groups.english: Just give us the cheapest room you have.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们现在剩下来的房间就只有精致套房 价格是每晚六百元
sense_groups.english: The only thing we have available is our deluxe suite. The rate is $600.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真的过分 - 真是太过分了
sense_groups.english: That's insane. - It's totally insane.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们开车回家吧 可以在回家路上 再去袭击每间枫糖糖果店
sense_groups.english: Let's drive home. We'll hit all the maple-candy stores on the way back...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且如果他们关门了 或许我们可以找树 自己做枫糖
sense_groups.english: and if they're closed, then maybe we'll tap a tree and make some ourselves.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个房间有个衣橱 可以让我把他锁起来吗？
sense_groups.english: Does that room have a closet I can lock him in?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要那间房 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: We'll take it. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们完全就是在剥削我们 - 老兄 别担心
sense_groups.english: They are totally ripping us off! - Dude, don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道要如何让你花的钱回本
sense_groups.english: I know how to make your money back.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是间不错的饭店 有很多福利设施
sense_groups.english: This is a nice hotel. Plenty of amenities.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只要尽量拿走那些东西就好了 像是这些苹果不要只拿一个
sense_groups.english: We just load up on those. Like those apples. Instead of taking one...

sense_groups.chinese: 我给他拿六个
sense_groups.english: um, I take six.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 一个苹果一百块 我们办到了
sense_groups.english: Great. At $100 an apple, we're there.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 你知道我的意思的 我们很快就可以回本了
sense_groups.english: Come on, you get the idea. You know, we'll make our money back in no time.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 你在发抖 - 是糖在搞怪 可帮我拿苹果吗？
sense_groups.english: Dude, you're shaking. - It's the sugar. Could you hold the apple?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我要跟你说 我整天都在想你的演出
sense_groups.english: Joey, I got to tell you, I have been thinking all day about that scene you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真是棒透了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: You were amazing. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 编剧很棒 导演也很棒
sense_groups.english: You know, the writing was good. And the director's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的对戏演员也很棒
sense_groups.english: And my costar's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是他们还是不如我棒
sense_groups.english: But they're not as good as me!

sense_groups.chinese: 你得告诉我明天会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: You have to tell me what happens tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在正在看剧本 你要帮我一起对台词吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm going over the script now. Wanna read lines with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我吗？喔 我不是演员的料
sense_groups.english: Me? Oh, I'm not an actress.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我去找摩妮卡 - 去她的 那角色是我的
sense_groups.english: I can ask Monica. - Screw her! That part is mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Right.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 从这一页开头开始
sense_groups.english: Okay, so, uh, just from the top of the page right here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈罗 德瑞克 我很讶异会在此看到你
sense_groups.english: Hello, Drake. I'm surprised to see you here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信你嫁给他了 - 我能有什么选择呢？
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you married him. - Well, what choice did I have?

sense_groups.chinese: 他把我妹妹关在地牢里
sense_groups.english: He was keeping my sister in a dungeon.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们呢？我们对彼此的感觉呢？
sense_groups.english: So, what about us? Everything we feel for each other?

sense_groups.chinese: 结束了 你必须要接受
sense_groups.english: It's over. You have to accept that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我如何接受？当我知道我再也无法把你拥入怀中
sense_groups.english: How can I, knowing I'll never hold you in my arms again...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是碰触你的肌肤 感觉你的双唇 或是永远无法跟你做爱
sense_groups.english: or touch your skin or feel your lips...knowing I'll never make love to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能接受 我再也无法亲吻你
sense_groups.english: How can I accept that I can never kiss you again...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我现在最想要做的 就只是亲吻你
sense_groups.english: when it's all I can do not to kiss you right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲我
sense_groups.english: Kiss me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲我
sense_groups.english: Kiss me.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 剧本不是那样写的 - 不 是我说的
sense_groups.english: Uh, Rach, it doesn't say that. - No, I'm saying it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是… - 不要说话
sense_groups.english: But... - Just don't talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 那却是新的梦
sense_groups.english: Well, that's new.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是206号房的罗斯盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hi, this is Ross Geller in suite 206.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘了带几样东西
sense_groups.english: Um, I've forgotten a couple of things.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以帮我送几样赠送的卫生用品到我房间里来吗？
sense_groups.english: Could you have some complimentary toiletries sent up to my room?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 好的 牙刷 牙膏
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Okay, a toothbrush, toothpaste...

sense_groups.chinese: 刮胡刀 漱口水 体香剂 牙线 绷带 刮胡乳液 收敛水
sense_groups.english: razor, mouthwash, deodorant, floss, Band-Aids, shaving cream, after shave.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我好像漏了什么东西
sense_groups.english: And I feel like I'm forgetting something.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还有什么东西是我没有提到的呢？
sense_groups.english: Um, is there anything else you have that I haven't asked for already?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那就送一些卫生棉条上来
sense_groups.english: Yeah, go ahead, send up some tampons.

sense_groups.chinese: 你拿了什么？ - 《美国时报》
sense_groups.english: What'd you get? - USA Today.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 跟其他的放在一起
sense_groups.english: Nice. Put it with the others.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我还多拿了两个苹果
sense_groups.english: And I also got two more apples.

sense_groups.chinese: 还差四个就可以做水果花篮了
sense_groups.english: We're four short of a bushel!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我觉得充满活力 我喜欢乡间生活
sense_groups.english: God, I feel so alive. I love being in the country!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有 我从餐厅里拿了这些…
sense_groups.english: Also, got these great salt and pepper shakers...

sense_groups.chinese: 盐巴胡椒罐 - 这不好
sense_groups.english: from the restaurant. - That's not cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 兄弟 这一切都不好
sense_groups.english: Dude, none of this is cool.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 钱德 你要找出介于偷窃跟…
sense_groups.english: Look, Chandler, you have to find the line between stealing...

sense_groups.chinese: 拿取饭店欠你的东西之间的界线
sense_groups.english: and taking what the hotel owes you.

sense_groups.chinese: 例如 吹风机 不不不
sense_groups.english: For example: a hair dryer, no, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是洗发精跟润发乳 可以可以可以
sense_groups.english: But shampoos and conditioners, yes,yes,yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 盐巴罐是不行的
sense_groups.english: Now, the salt shaker is off limits. Ah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是盐巴…
sense_groups.english: But the salt...

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我刚刚有想清楚点
sense_groups.english: I wish I'd thought this through.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我知道你的意思了 就像台灯是饭店的…
sense_groups.english: I think I get what you mean, though. Like, the lamp is the hotel's...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是灯泡… 喔 你已经拿了
sense_groups.english: but the bulbs... Oh, you already got that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的朋友 这可不是我第一次住饭店
sense_groups.english: Not my first time in a hotel, my friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 那这个呢？ - 不不不
sense_groups.english: Okay, uh, how about this? - No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能拿遥控器 - 是的 但是可以拿电池
sense_groups.english: You can't take the remote control. - Yes, but the batteries.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 太谢谢你了
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Thank you very much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来吃枫糖庆祝吧 - 不
sense_groups.english: Ooh! Let's celebrate with some maple candy. - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 至少告诉我你把它藏哪里去了
sense_groups.english: At least tell me where you hid it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以问你一个问题吗？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: Can I ask you a question? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有作过任何…
sense_groups.english: Have you ever had any...

sense_groups.chinese: 奇异的… 浪漫的梦呢？
sense_groups.english: weird, romantic dreams?

sense_groups.chinese: 让我想想
sense_groups.english: Hmm, let me think.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我较年轻的时候 我曾经梦过跟麦当劳的卡通市长结婚
sense_groups.english: Oh. When I was younger, I used to dream that I got married to Mayor McCheese.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后在我们新婚之夜 我吃了他的头
sense_groups.english: And on our wedding night, I ate his head.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一点也…
sense_groups.english: Well, this is like that...

sense_groups.chinese: 不像是那样
sense_groups.english: in no way.

sense_groups.chinese: 我昨晚梦到我想要亲乔伊
sense_groups.english: I had a dream last night that I wanted to kiss Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你是说真的亲吻他吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow! You mean like "kiss him" kiss him?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我是说那种很激情的
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. I mean, it was pretty intense.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么会那样呢？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: What brought that on? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许跟我看到他演出那场爱情戏有关
sense_groups.english: Maybe it had to do with the fact I saw him do a love scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 爱情戏？跟谁呢？ - 奥莉维亚
sense_groups.english: A love scene? With who? - Olivia.

sense_groups.chinese: 奥莉维亚？我以为她要跟康纳结婚了
sense_groups.english: Olivia? I thought she was marrying Connor?

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 现实生活比较重要
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. Real life more important.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我的梦代表什么吗？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: You think my dream means anything? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看到他演出爱情戏
sense_groups.english: I mean, you saw him do a love scene. Maybe you don't have a thing for Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许对乔伊没有感觉 或许你是对德瑞克有感觉
sense_groups.english: Maybe you have a thing for Drake.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Huh...

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 在梦里是当乔伊 在念德瑞克台词的时候
sense_groups.english: Well, it was Joey reading Drake's lines in the dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然罗 相信我 只要是跟心理学有关的
sense_groups.english: Of course it was. Trust me, when it comes to psychology...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是很内行的
sense_groups.english: I know what I'm talking about.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在大学的时候修过两堂心理学 你是同一堂课修两次
sense_groups.english: I took two psych classes in college. - You took the same class twice.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很难耶 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: It was hard! - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嗨 菲比
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 瞧瞧我为了要到你餐厅演唱 买了什么
sense_groups.english: Here, Monica, look what I got to wear when I play at your restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Ah. Ah. Wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧 我想这会提高 "没有割包皮男人之民谣"的格调
sense_groups.english: Right? I think this might even class up "The Ballad of the Uncircumcised Man."

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比…
sense_groups.english: Um, Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我之前说的不够清楚
sense_groups.english: maybe I wasn't clear before.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢在这里听你的音乐
sense_groups.english: I really love listening to your music here.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的餮厅是比较高级的地方
sense_groups.english: But my restaurant, it's sort of an upscale place.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 好吧 我会要管家帮我把 我的钻石从保险箱拿出来
sense_groups.english: Right, yeah, okay. I'll ask the butler to fetch my diamonds out of the vault.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 不是你穿的衣服的关系
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's not what you wear.

sense_groups.chinese: 是你的歌
sense_groups.english: It's sort of your songs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得你不应该再到餮厅演唱了
sense_groups.english: I just don't think you should play at the restaurant anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 没关系 我就…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Okay. Fine, I'll just...

sense_groups.chinese: 我把帽子拿回去退
sense_groups.english: I'll take the hat back.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: There.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我办公室发生一件最好笑…
sense_groups.english: Hey, so you guys, the funniest thing happened at work the...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的歌不够格登上你们餐厅的大堂吗？
sense_groups.english: My songs aren't good enough for your restaurant?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们还在谈那个
sense_groups.english: Okay, we're still on that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有说它们不够格 - 那有什么不对呢？
sense_groups.english: I didn't say they weren't good enough. - Then what's wrong with them?

sense_groups.chinese: 是怎样？他们不够格配你的一丁点的自命不凡的食物？
sense_groups.english: What, they don't go with your tiny portions of pretentious food?

sense_groups.chinese: 一丁点？ - 是啊 不好意思…
sense_groups.english: Tiny portions? - Yeah, well, um, "Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我点了燻鲑鱼开味菜 但是我看不到鲑鱼 我看不到"
sense_groups.english: I ordered the smoked salmon appetizer, but I can't see it. I can't see it."

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 份量不是最重要的 - 品质也不是最重要的
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, it's not about quantity. - Well, it's not about quality.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？你想要谈品质吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? You wanna talk about quality?

sense_groups.chinese: 你有听过什么叫"调"吗？那是大家唱歌要对的
sense_groups.english: Have you ever heard of a "key"? It's what some people sing in.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少我所有的歌都没有蒜头味
sense_groups.english: Well, at least all my songs don't taste like garlic.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 摩妮卡 还有其他的东西可以拿来调味的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, there are other ingredients, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们要这样做罗
sense_groups.english: So that's what we're doing.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我在咖啡厅里跟着你的歌打拍子时
sense_groups.english: When I'm in a coffeehouse bopping along to one of your songs...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是有戴耳塞的 是耳塞还是蒜头塞呢？
sense_groups.english: I'm wearing earplugs. - Earplugs or cloves of garlic?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？我收回我所说的话
sense_groups.english: You know what? I take back what I said before.

sense_groups.chinese: 继续到餐厅演唱吧 因为你的音乐会把人逼进餐厅里…
sense_groups.english: Keep playing at the restaurant, because with your music driving people inside...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们吧台的营业量会疯狂激长的
sense_groups.english: my bar sales have gone up like crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都点什么呢？蒜头马丁尼吗？
sense_groups.english: What are people having, the garlic martini?

sense_groups.chinese: 这是您的帐单 希望您还住的愉快
sense_groups.english: Here's your bill. We hope you enjoyed your stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我们很愉快 而且你们的台灯都还在
sense_groups.english: Oh, we did. And you still have all your lamps.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有算进税金 - 兄弟 不用担心
sense_groups.english: I didn't factor in the room tax. - Dude, don't worry about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我找到了一台没人看管的女佣拖车 我们是居领先地位的
sense_groups.english: I found an unattended maid's cart. We're way ahead of the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天？ - 怎样
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 那盆子里有新的东西
sense_groups.english: There's something new in the bowl.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 我们拿够了 走吧 - 不 但是我想要松果
sense_groups.english: Look, we have enough. Just walk away. - No, but I want the pine cones.

sense_groups.chinese: 外面就有一片森林 - 那不一样
sense_groups.english: There's a forest right outside. - It's not the same.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 快点
sense_groups.english: Okay, go quick.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们今人愉快的服务
sense_groups.english: Thank you for a delightful stay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的枫糖糖果
sense_groups.english: MY maple candy!

sense_groups.chinese: 这里的食物在javu会杀了你
sense_groups.english: The food here at Javu Will kill you

sense_groups.chinese: 这里的食物在javu会杀了你
sense_groups.english: The food here at Javu Will kill you

sense_groups.chinese: 原来是你 我还以为有人 拿了一袋子的猫往墙上撞
sense_groups.english: It's just you. I thought someone was swinging a bag of cats against the wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好回去厨房 蒜头是不会自己多用自己的
sense_groups.english: You'd better get back in that kitchen. The garlic's not gonna overuse itself.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你．马上给我停唱 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you have to stop playing now. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的歌干扰到的人只有你
sense_groups.english: The only person my playing is bothering is you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？我们来解决这事 来吧 - 把你的蒜头手拿开
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Let's settle this. Come on. - Get your garlic peelers off me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Excuse me? Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡盖勒 这里的主厨
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Monica Geller. I'm the head chef here.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我本来真的希望有人鼓掌的 但是没关系
sense_groups.english: Okay, I was actually expecting a little applause there, but whatever.

sense_groups.chinese: 一个问题 请大家举手回答
sense_groups.english: Quick question. By a show of hands...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有谁被这女人 在外面唱歌干扰到呢？
sense_groups.english: how many of you were bothered by this woman's singing outside?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的… 你们有谁喜欢外面的音乐呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay. How many of you enjoyed the music outside?

sense_groups.chinese: 哈
sense_groups.english: Ha!

sense_groups.chinese: 让我问你们这个问题 有谁认为音乐还好…
sense_groups.english: Let me ask you this question. How many thought the music was fine...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是跟本餮厅的格调不符呢？
sense_groups.english: but not in keeping with the tone of the restaurant?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 谁认为这个餐厅的格调是 "自以为是又充满蒜头味"？
sense_groups.english: Who identified this restaurant's tone as "pretentious-comma-garlicky"?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 有谁觉得食物是很美味的 而一点点做作是没关系的？
sense_groups.english: Okay, who thinks the food is delicious and a little pretension never hurt anyone?

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 没关系 有谁觉得食物很好 音乐也很棒
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, all right, who thinks the food is fine, the music was fine...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你的晚餐已经被这个持续不断 的民意调查给毁了？
sense_groups.english: but your evening was ruined by this incessant poll-taking?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Excuse us.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 我问你
sense_groups.english: All right, here's a question.

sense_groups.chinese: 有谁认为她的誉厅是那么的高级…
sense_groups.english: Uh, who was so worried about her restaurant being fancy...

sense_groups.chinese: 让她过分的担心 她的朋友会演唱不适当的音乐…
sense_groups.english: that she made a big deal about her friend playing her music...

sense_groups.chinese: 而现在真的觉得很难过呢？
sense_groups.english: and feels really bad about it now?

sense_groups.chinese: 有谁很愚蠢又很顽固…
sense_groups.english: Well, who was so stupid and stubborn...

sense_groups.chinese: 批评了她朋友的烹饪技术…
sense_groups.english: that she lashed out against her friend's cooking...

sense_groups.chinese: 而其实她觉得她的烹饪很好呢？
sense_groups.english: which she actually thinks is pretty great?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 - 我也很抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. - I'm sorry too.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你要不要留下来 然后我帮你准备晚餐呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you wanna stick around and I'll whip you up some dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 只要是免费的 这里的食物真的是超贵…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, as long as it's free. The food here is ridiculously overpr...

sense_groups.chinese: 谁希望举手这件事 还可爱到使你不要恨我呢？
sense_groups.english: Who hopes the hand-raising thing is still cute enough that you won't hate me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey - Hi

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你的头后面有花生酱吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey, do you have peanut butter on the back of your head?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 天啊 我以为我都擦掉了
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. I thought I got it all.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么会…
sense_groups.english: How...?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么弄到的呢？
sense_groups.english: How?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在做花生酱冰沙
sense_groups.english: I was making a peanut butter smoothie, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我找不到果汁机上面那个小塑胶盖
sense_groups.english: I couldn't find this little plastic thingy that goes in the top of the blender.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我想 "那个小东西有什么重要的呢？"
sense_groups.english: And I thought, "Well, you know, how important can that be?" Right?

sense_groups.chinese: 结果是非常重要
sense_groups.english: Turns out, very.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 一定只是因为德瑞克
sense_groups.english: Wow, definitely just Drake.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 德瑞克演的如何呢？
sense_groups.english: What? - How's it going with Drake?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想可能演的不是很好 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: I don't think it's going very well. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我看的那一场戏很好啊
sense_groups.english: That scene I saw was so good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对明天要拍的那场戏 觉得很没安全感
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm feeling really insecure about the one we're shooting tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你是不是又故意说自己很糟 然后让我来赞美你呢？
sense_groups.english: Is this that thing you do when you say you're bad so I'll give you a compliment?

sense_groups.chinese: 有点
sense_groups.english: A little.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我是真的很担心 我必须要演得像是我真的爱上奥莉维亚
sense_groups.english: No, I really am worried. I have to make it convincing that I'm in love with Olivia.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以呢？ - 所以…我从来没有演过那种戏
sense_groups.english: So? - So I've never played that.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 亲爱的 那不会很难的 你也有谈过恋爱啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey, it can't be that hard. I mean, you've been in love before.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 只有一次…
sense_groups.english: Uh, well, just once...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是跟你
sense_groups.english: with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 这实在是有点尴尬
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, this could be a little awkward.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们跳过好了
sense_groups.english: I'm just gonna blow past it.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 你何不运用你那个特殊方法
sense_groups.english: Well, look, can't you just use that method-actor thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 就是利用你的真实生活回忆 来帮助演出呢？
sense_groups.english: where you use your real-life memories to help you in your performance?

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说什么？
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you talking about?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 只要试着回忆起 你在谈恋爱时候的感觉
sense_groups.english: All right, look, just, um, try to remember how you felt when you were in love...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后在演出的时候回想起那些感觉
sense_groups.english: and think about that when you're playing the scene.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 是啊 我想我做的到
sense_groups.english: Okay. Yeah, I think I can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 有个晚会的剧情
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay, there's this party scene coming up.

sense_groups.chinese: 奥莉维亚跟她老公就在那里
sense_groups.english: Uh-huh. - And Olivia and her husband are there...

sense_groups.chinese: 而德瑞克想要做的只有抓住她 然后亲吻她 但是他不能
sense_groups.english: and all Drake wants to do is grab her and kiss her, but he can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那让我想起许多时候我好想抓住你 然后亲吻你
sense_groups.english: That makes me think about those times I wanted to grab you and kiss you...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你并不知道 所以我只能假装没事
sense_groups.english: but you didn't know, so I would just pretend everything was cool...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这真的让我很受折磨
sense_groups.english: but really it was killing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你从来没有说过这些
sense_groups.english: Joey, you never talked about that before.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你知道我还可以用什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, you know what else I could use?

sense_groups.chinese: 有一场戏是德瑞克偷偷溜进 奥莉维亚的房间
sense_groups.english: There's this scene where Drake sneaks into Olivia's bedroom...

sense_groups.chinese: 她不知道他就在那里 当然 我们之间没有发生过这样的事
sense_groups.english: and she doesn't know he's there, which never happened with us.

sense_groups.chinese: 他知道他不应该去那袒 但是他只想看看她
sense_groups.english: I mean, he knows he shouldn't be there, but he just wants to look at her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: You know?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我记得有好几个早上 就在你开始要化妆之前
sense_groups.english: And I remember all those mornings before you even put on your makeup...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会想"天啊 她真是美丽"
sense_groups.english: when I would think to myself, "My God, she is beautiful."

sense_groups.chinese: 而且让我好心痛 因为我知道我永远不能告诉你
sense_groups.english: And it hurt so much because I knew I could never tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是光是看着你 我就觉得心满意足了
sense_groups.english: But it was worth it just to be there looking at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了 真是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Thanks, dude. This is great!

sense_groups.chinese: 我从佛蒙特州帮你带了些东西
sense_groups.english: I got you something from Vermont.

sense_groups.chinese: 卫生棉条跟盐巴以外的东西吗？
sense_groups.english: Besides tampons and salt?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 枫糖糖果 你真是贴心
sense_groups.english: Maple candy. That's so sweet of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是奇怪 里面是空的
sense_groups.english: That's weird, it's empty.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们好 怎么了呢？你们要一起做点什么吗？
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. What's going on? You guys wanna hang out, or...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们有听到嗡嗡声吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you guys hear a buzzing?

questions.name: S09E20
questions.en:
Hey, you guys? What are you doing tomorrow night?
Oh, well, let me see. I believe I'm...
Yes, falling asleep in front of the TV.
Well, my agent hooked me up with six tickets to a great play.
I could fall asleep at a play.
What is it? - It's a one-woman play called
Why Don't You Like Me? A Bitter Woman's Journey Through Life.
Ooh.
That sounds interesting. - That does sound interesting.
To listen to a woman complain for two hours. I don't think it gets bet...
I know! I know. We can drive. We can vote. We can work.
What more do these broads want?
Well, you guys will have a great time. I promise.
What? How come you don't have to go?
I wish I could, but I found out...
that I have to be at work really early the next day, so I can't go.
But take the extra ticket and invite whoever you want.
Ooh. Let's see. Who do I hate?
Oh, sorry.
Oops, sorry. - Okay.
Okay. - Okay. Up you 90
Oh, gosh, okay! - All right.
Can I ask you a question? - Yeah.
Do you think it's possible for two friends to fool around...
and not have it be a big deal?
No, I don't think that ever works. Why?
No reason. - No, no. Rachel?
Who do you want to fool around with? - Nobody! Forget it.
Joey?
Maybe.
You can't. - Why?
Because.
Okay, seriously, did not understand a word you just said.
In the hall. - Okay.
You wanna fool around with Joey? - Yeah.
Ever since I had that dream about him, I can't get it out of my head.
I mean, what's the big deal? People do it all the time.
Who do you know that are friends that just fool around?
Okay. Off the top of my head... Don and Janet.
Who are they? - I know them from work.
Both of them? - No, just one of them.
Which one?
I don't know. What were the names I just said?
No, Rachel, things could get incredibly complicated.
You're right. I won't do anything with Joey. I just thought it...
Okay, so that's two cups of tarragon, a pound of baking soda and a red onion?
What the hell are you cooking?
Hey. - Hey.
You guys won't believe what I have to do for work today.
Yes, but, Ross, you chose a career of talking about dinosaurs.
There are these two professors who are joining my department...
and I have to meet them here and show them around campus.
What's bad about that?
I just know they'll be a couple of old windbags...
wearing tweed jackets with suede elbow patches.
Ross?
What? These aren't suede.
Excuse me. I'm looking for someone.
You don't, by any chance, know a Ross Geller?
No.
Hi. Hi, I'm Ross Geller.
Oh, hi. I'm Professor Wheeler. - Oh.
Oh, that's... That's... That's nice.
It's good to meet you.
Thank you so much for taking the time to show me around.
No, it's no big deal.
If I weren't doing this, I'd just, you know, be at the gym working out.
Is he gonna introduce us?
I think we're just blurry shapes to him now.
By the way, I really enjoyed your paper...
on the connection between geographic isolation and rapid mutagenesis.
I wrote that in one night.
Twenty bucks says they're married within the month.
Well, we should probably get going.
We've got a lot of ground to cover.
Isn't another professor supposed to come with us?
I don't think so.
I'm pretty sure. A Professor Spafford from Cornell?
Well, he's obviously late, and the rule in my class is
If you can't come on time, then don't come at all.
An option that many of my students use.
Shall we? - We shouldn't wait for him?
You know what, he's a big boy. I'm sure he'll find us, okay?
Professor Geller? - Oh, damn it!
Hi, it's Jan Rogers. Can't wait for your party tonight.
Listen, I forgot your address. Can you give me a call? Thanks. Bye.
Hey! - Hey!
What's happening?
It's a real shame you can't make it to that one-woman show tonight.
I'd love to, but I gotta get up so early the next day.
You know me, work comes first. - Oh, yeah, yeah.
Hi, it's Jan Rogers. Can't wait for your party tonight.
Stupid Jan Rogers!
You are having a party tonight?
I'm kind of having a thing for the Days of our Lives people.
You weren't gonna tell us?
How did you think you'd get away with that?
I do it every year.
You do that every year?!
I didn't have to tell you that!
God, I'm stupider than Jan Rogers!
That's why you got us tickets to that play, to get rid of us!
Yeah.
Last year is that why you sent us to that Medieval Times restaurant?
Yeah.
The year before that, you set up that nighttime tour of that button factory?
I can't believe you guys went for that one.
Why wouldn't you invite us to your parties?
You're fine, okay? But everyone else acts like an idiot around famous people.
Well, then, so just invite me.
Please, I was trying to be nice. You're the worst one.
Joey, come on! Please, please? Let me come. I will behave. I promise.
I will behave. Please, please, please. - Okay, fine. You can come.
But don't tell anybody else. It's up on the roof at 8.
A soap-opera roof party?!
I'm going to a soap-opera roof party! Uh, my God! Oh, my God!
And it's out of my system.
And then my wife and I went on a cruise to the Galépagos.
There was a seafood buffet you wouldn't believe.
There were clams and mussels and oysters...
and cracked crab...
and snow crab...
and king crab.
It's a pity I'm allergic to shellfish.
So where did you get your undergraduate degree?
And that's not all I'm allergic to. - Oh, it's not over.
I'm also allergic to peanuts and cashews...
and almonds and filberts...
So basically all nuts!
Interestingly, no.
You're kind of playing it fast and loose with the word "interesting."
If you'll excuse me, I'm going to use the restroom.
Qh, my God!
I've lost the will to live.
Let's ditch him. - What?
While he's still in the bathroom. I am begging you.
