sense_groups.chinese: 你想要跟谁打情骂俏呢？ - 没有人 别想太多
sense_groups.english: Who do you want to fool around with? - Nobody! Forget it.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊吗？
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 - 为什么？
sense_groups.english: You can't. - Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为
sense_groups.english: Because.

sense_groups.chinese: 说真的 你说什么 我一点都不了解
sense_groups.english: Okay, seriously, did not understand a word you just said.

sense_groups.chinese: 到走廊去 - 好
sense_groups.english: In the hall. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要跟乔伊打情骂俏？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: You wanna fool around with Joey? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 自从我做过那个梦之后 我就一直忘不了
sense_groups.english: Ever since I had that dream about him, I can't get it out of my head.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说那又会怎样？很多人都是那样做的
sense_groups.english: I mean, what's the big deal? People do it all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？你认识谁只在打情骂俏的？
sense_groups.english: Who do you know that are friends that just fool around?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 随便想想… 唐跟珍娜
sense_groups.english: Okay. Off the top of my head... Don and Janet.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们是谁？ - 工作上认识的人
sense_groups.english: Who are they? - I know them from work.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个都是吗？ - 不 只有其中一个
sense_groups.english: Both of them? - No, just one of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 哪一个？
sense_groups.english: Which one?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 我刚才说了哪些名字呢？
sense_groups.english: I don't know. What were the names I just said?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 事情会变得很复杂的
sense_groups.english: No, Rachel, things could get incredibly complicated.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说的对 我不会对乔伊怎样的 我只是以为…
sense_groups.english: You're right. I won't do anything with Joey. I just thought it...

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 那就两杯的龙蒿 一磅的苏打粉 还有红洋葱
sense_groups.english: Okay, so that's two cups of tarragon, a pound of baking soda and a red onion?

sense_groups.chinese: 你是想要煮什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What the hell are you cooking?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会相信 我今天要做什么样的工作
sense_groups.english: You guys won't believe what I have to do for work today.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是罗斯 是你自己选择 要谈论恐龙的工作的
sense_groups.english: Yes, but, Ross, you chose a career of talking about dinosaurs.

sense_groups.chinese: 有两个教授要加入我的部门
sense_groups.english: There are these two professors who are joining my department...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我要在这里跟他们碰面 然后带他们到校园看看
sense_groups.english: and I have to meet them here and show them around campus.

sense_groups.chinese: 那怎么会糟糕呢？
sense_groups.english: What's bad about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我只知道他们会是那种老盖仙
sense_groups.english: I just know they'll be a couple of old windbags...

sense_groups.chinese: 穿着在手肘的地方 缝上仿尘皮的花呢外套
sense_groups.english: wearing tweed jackets with suede elbow patches.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯？
sense_groups.english: Ross?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？这些不是仿麂皮
sense_groups.english: What? These aren't suede.

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思 我在找人
sense_groups.english: Excuse me. I'm looking for someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认不认识 一个叫做罗斯盖勒的？
sense_groups.english: You don't, by any chance, know a Ross Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 不认识
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是罗斯盖勒
sense_groups.english: Hi. Hi, I'm Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我是魏勒教授 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi. I'm Professor Wheeler. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 这…这太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's... That's... That's nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴见到你
sense_groups.english: It's good to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你愿意花时间帮我介绍环境
sense_groups.english: Thank you so much for taking the time to show me around.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 这一点也不麻烦的
sense_groups.english: No, it's no big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我没有这样做 反正我也只是 在健身房健身而已
sense_groups.english: If I weren't doing this, I'd just, you know, be at the gym working out.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会介绍我们吗？
sense_groups.english: Is he gonna introduce us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他现在跟本就看不到我们
sense_groups.english: I think we're just blurry shapes to him now.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我真的很喜欢你写的…
sense_groups.english: By the way, I really enjoyed your paper...

sense_groups.chinese: 地域隔绝与快速突变之关系的论文
sense_groups.english: on the connection between geographic isolation and rapid mutagenesis.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一个晚上就写完了
sense_groups.english: I wrote that in one night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我赌二十块钱 他们一个月内就会结婚
sense_groups.english: Twenty bucks says they're married within the month.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么我们最好走吧
sense_groups.english: Well, we should probably get going.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有很多地方要去
sense_groups.english: We've got a lot of ground to cover.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是有另外一位教授要加入我们吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't another professor supposed to come with us?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想应该没有
sense_groups.english: I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常确定 是从康乃尔来的史伯夫教授
sense_groups.english: I'm pretty sure. A Professor Spafford from Cornell?

sense_groups.chinese: 他可能是迟到了 而我上课的规矩就是
sense_groups.english: Well, he's obviously late, and the rule in my class is

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不能准时到 那就干脆不要到
sense_groups.english: If you can't come on time, then don't come at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很多学生 最后都选择后者
sense_groups.english: An option that many of my students use.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要走了吗？ - 我们不用等他吗？
sense_groups.english: Shall we? - We shouldn't wait for him?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？他是个大男孩了 我确定他可以找到我们的 好吗？
sense_groups.english: You know what, he's a big boy. I'm sure he'll find us, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 盖勒教授吗？ - 喔 妈的
sense_groups.english: Professor Geller? - Oh, damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 我是珍罗杰 等不及要参加你今晚的派对了
sense_groups.english: Hi, it's Jan Rogers. Can't wait for your party tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我忘记你的地址了 可以回电给我吗？谢谢 拜
sense_groups.english: Listen, I forgot your address. Can you give me a call? Thanks. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey! - Hey!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's happening?

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜你没有办法参加 今晚的女人独角戏
sense_groups.english: It's a real shame you can't make it to that one-woman show tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也想去 但是我隔天要好早起来
sense_groups.english: I'd love to, but I gotta get up so early the next day.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道我的 工作最重要 - 是啊 是啊
sense_groups.english: You know me, work comes first. - Oh, yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 乔伊 我是珍罗杰 等不及参加你今晚的派对了
sense_groups.english: Hi, it's Jan Rogers. Can't wait for your party tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 珍罗杰 你还真蠢
sense_groups.english: Stupid Jan Rogers!

sense_groups.chinese: 你今晚要开派对？
sense_groups.english: You are having a party tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我帮《我们的日子》的人员 办了一个聚会
sense_groups.english: I'm kind of having a thing for the Days of our Lives people.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你却不告诉我们？
sense_groups.english: You weren't gonna tell us?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以为你可以逃得掉吗？
sense_groups.english: How did you think you'd get away with that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我每年都这样做啊
sense_groups.english: I do it every year.

sense_groups.chinese: 你每年都这样做？
sense_groups.english: You do that every year?!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要告诉你的
sense_groups.english: I didn't have to tell you that!

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 我比珍罗杰还愚蠢
sense_groups.english: God, I'm stupider than Jan Rogers!

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你就给我们去看舞台剧的票 甩掉我们
sense_groups.english: That's why you got us tickets to that play, to get rid of us!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 去年你就送我们去那间中古世纪餐厅？
sense_groups.english: Last year is that why you sent us to that Medieval Times restaurant?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 而前年 你帮我们安排晚上去钮扣工厂之旅？
sense_groups.english: The year before that, you set up that nighttime tour of that button factory?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信那个你们也会去
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you guys went for that one.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你为什么不邀请我们参加你的派对呢？
sense_groups.english: Why wouldn't you invite us to your parties?

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好 但是其他人在名人面前 都表现的像傻瓜一样
sense_groups.english: You're fine, okay? But everyone else acts like an idiot around famous people.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 就只邀请我就好了啊
sense_groups.english: Well, then, so just invite me.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 我只是在说好听话 你是最糟糕的
sense_groups.english: Please, I was trying to be nice. You're the worst one.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 别这样 拜托啦 让我参加 我会克制自己 我保证
sense_groups.english: Joey, come on! Please, please? Let me come. I will behave. I promise.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会克制自己 拜托 - 好啦 你可以参加
sense_groups.english: I will behave. Please, please, please. - Okay, fine. You can come.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是不要告诉其他人 八点钟在屋顶上面
sense_groups.english: But don't tell anybody else. It's up on the roof at 8.

sense_groups.chinese: 肥皂剧屋顶派对
sense_groups.english: A soap-opera roof party?!

sense_groups.chinese: 我要参加肥皂剧屋顶派对 喔 我的天啊 …
sense_groups.english: I'm going to a soap-opera roof party! Uh, my God! Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 发泄完了
sense_groups.english: And it's out of my system.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我老婆跟我搭游轮到加扛巴哥
sense_groups.english: And then my wife and I went on a cruise to the Galépagos.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会相信他们的 吃到饱海鲜餐厅有多棒
sense_groups.english: There was a seafood buffet you wouldn't believe.

sense_groups.chinese: 有蛤蜊 河蚌还有生蚝
sense_groups.english: There were clams and mussels and oysters...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有螃蟹…
sense_groups.english: and cracked crab...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有花蟹…
sense_groups.english: and snow crab...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有帝王蟹
sense_groups.english: and king crab.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可惜我对带壳类海鲜过敏
sense_groups.english: It's a pity I'm allergic to shellfish.

sense_groups.chinese: 你大学是在哪念的呢？
sense_groups.english: So where did you get your undergraduate degree?

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我不只对那些过敏 - 喔 还没有结束啊
sense_groups.english: And that's not all I'm allergic to. - Oh, it's not over.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还有对花生跟腰果过敏
sense_groups.english: I'm also allergic to peanuts and cashews...

sense_groups.chinese: 还有杏仁果跟榛果…
sense_groups.english: and almonds and filberts...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以基本上是所有的坚果类
sense_groups.english: So basically all nuts!

sense_groups.chinese: 有趣的是 并不尽然
sense_groups.english: Interestingly, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在说"有趣的是"时说的挺慢的 让人以为就是如此
sense_groups.english: You're kind of playing it fast and loose with the word "interesting."

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思失陪一下 我要去洗手间
sense_groups.english: If you'll excuse me, I'm going to use the restroom.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Qh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经丧失活下去的意志力了
sense_groups.english: I've lost the will to live.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们甩了他 - 什么？
sense_groups.english: Let's ditch him. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 快点 在他还在洗手间的时候 我求求你
sense_groups.english: While he's still in the bathroom. I am begging you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 但是我有个问题要先问你
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay, fine, but I just have one question for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们出去的时候 应该是用走的 跑的…
sense_groups.english: When we exit, should we walk or run...

sense_groups.chinese: 跳的还是散步出去？
sense_groups.english: or prance or stroll...?

sense_groups.chinese: 别说了 他的话说得漫 搞不好尿得很快 我们快走
sense_groups.english: Stop it! Stop it! He talks slow, but he might pee fast. Okay, let's move!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 这位是查莉
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, you guys, this is Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 查莉 这是菲比 还有我妹妹摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Charlie, this is Phoebe and my sister, Monica.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 查莉将要加入我们系上
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Charlie will be joining my department.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也是古生物学家吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: You're a paleontologist too? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好 你对于…
sense_groups.english: Oh, okay. Now, what do you think...

sense_groups.chinese: 雷诺的分割类人猿物种多样性的新理论 有何评价？
sense_groups.english: of Renyard's new theory of species variegation in segmented arthropods?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得他有点太前卫了 但是他是有些有趣的观点
sense_groups.english: I think he's a little out there, but he does have some interesting ideas.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我要接一下电话 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Oh, I'm sorry. I have to take this. Excuse me.

sense_groups.chinese: 雷诺的物种多样性？
sense_groups.english: Renyard's theory of species variegation?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在你的咖啡桌上看到一篇文章 我背下了标题想要来吓你
sense_groups.english: I saw the article on your coffee table. I memorized the title to freak you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们俩个相处的愉快吗？
sense_groups.english: So did you two have fun?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 她真的是太棒了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. She's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有许多共同点 她真是太酷了 你知道吗？还很风趣
sense_groups.english: We have so much in common, and she's just cool, you know? And funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我不知道你有没有注意到 她还真辣
sense_groups.english: And I don't know if you've noticed, but she's a hottie!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家听着 我觉得不太舒服…
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. Listen, you know what, I'm not feeling really well...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我可能不能去看舞台剧表演了
sense_groups.english: and I don't think I'm gonna get to go to the play.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？怎么了？
sense_groups.english: Really? What's wrong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 好像蛮严重的
sense_groups.english: I don't know. I think it's kind of serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今天早上在电视上有看到…
sense_groups.english: You know, I was watching this thing on TV this morning...

sense_groups.chinese: 什么关于新堡疾病的 我想我可能感染到了
sense_groups.english: about Newcastle disease, and I think I might have it.

sense_groups.chinese: 新堡疾病是跟分泌物有关的病毒
sense_groups.english: Newcastle disease is a secretion-borne virus...

sense_groups.chinese: 只有鸡或是其他家禽才会被传染到
sense_groups.english: that only affects chickens and other poultry.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 这是谁呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, who's this?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 瑞秋 这位是查莉魏勒 她是我同事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Rachel, this is Charlie Wheeler. She's a colleague.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 我应该要跟你握手的…
sense_groups.english: Hi. Well, I would shake your hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我想你不会想要 被传染到我的鸡病
sense_groups.english: but I'm sure you don't want to get my chicken disease.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我可以跟你谈一下吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: Rachel, can I see you for a second? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没有生病
sense_groups.english: You're not sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我当然有
sense_groups.english: What? Yes, I am!

sense_groups.chinese: 那么为什么你要穿成这样呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, then why are you all dressed up?

sense_groups.chinese: 当你生病的时候 你会做任何事情 来让自己觉得好过一些
sense_groups.english: When you're sick, you do whatever you can to make yourself feel better.

sense_groups.chinese: 你只是想要持在家里 对乔伊采取行动
sense_groups.english: You just want to stay home so you can make a move on Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我听进去了你之前说的话 事情不是这样的
sense_groups.english: No, I heard you before. That is so not what this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 那是怎么回事呢？
sense_groups.english: Okay, then what is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊帮《我们的日子》在屋顶举行 秘密派对
sense_groups.english: Joey is having a secret Days of our Lives party up on the roof.

sense_groups.chinese: 他送你们去看舞台剧来甩掉你们
sense_groups.english: And he sent you guys to the play to get rid of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？这是怎么回事？
sense_groups.english: What? What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊帮《我们的日子》 在屋顶举行秘密派对
sense_groups.english: Joey is having a secret Days of our Lives party up on the roof!

sense_groups.chinese: 他不想要让你们知道 但是我还是过来告诉你们了
sense_groups.english: He didn't want you to know about it, but I came over here to tell you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你是来说你生病的 - 你到底是教授还是侦探
sense_groups.english: You came to say you were sick. - All right, professor or detective?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 乔伊要开派对 但不邀请我们？
sense_groups.english: Wait, Joey's having a party, and he wasn't gonna invite us?

sense_groups.chinese: 他每年都那样做的 这就是为什么他要请我们去看舞台剧
sense_groups.english: He does it every year. That's why he's sending you to the play.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是为什么他请我们去中古世纪餐厅 还有钮扣工厂
sense_groups.english: That's why he sent us to that medieval restaurant and to that button factory.

sense_groups.chinese: 而有那次糟糕的博物馆之旅吗？
sense_groups.english: And that horrible museum tour?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 那是我安排的
sense_groups.english: No, I arranged that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们好 我要睡了 祝你们玩的愉快
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys, I'm turning in. Have fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们知道你的派对了 乔伊
sense_groups.english: We know about your party, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么派对？ - 游戏结束了 把睡袍脱掉吧
sense_groups.english: What party? - The game's over. Take off your robe.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我是说…
sense_groups.english: Okay, I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 穿起来 穿起来
sense_groups.english: Close it up! Close it up!

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴见到你
sense_groups.english: Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你来了 太好了
sense_groups.english: Hey, you made it! All right!

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴你来了 谢谢你参加
sense_groups.english: Glad you could make it. Thanks for coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 凯尔罗德 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Kyle Lowder! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 这就是我为什么不想邀请你 你要冷静点 好吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey. That's why I didn't invite you. You have to calm down, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 去喝点饮料什么的
sense_groups.english: Just get yourself a drink or something.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 你就是要让我的自制力溃堤
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, that's what you want. My inhibitions lowered.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你敢相信我们 被这些人包围着吗？
sense_groups.english: My God, can you believe we're surrounded by all this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我几乎控制不了自己
sense_groups.english: I can barely control myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你该了解到你已经结婚了
sense_groups.english: You might want to remember that you're married.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德呢？
sense_groups.english: Where is Chandler anyway?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 钱德
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! Chandler!

sense_groups.chinese: 大家死哪去了？
sense_groups.english: Where the hell is everybody?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不喜欢我？
sense_groups.english: Why Don '2' You Like Me?

sense_groups.chinese: 第一章 我的第一次生理期
sense_groups.english: Chapter 1: My First Period.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊说不能要签名的
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joey said no autographs.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是如果她有 那我也要
sense_groups.english: But if she's getting one, I want one too!

sense_groups.chinese: "给摩妮卡" 而且别写什么 "祝福"之类的 要写"爱"
sense_groups.english: "To Monica." And none of this "best wishes" crap. I want "love."

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 摩妮卡 马修只是给我他的电话
sense_groups.english: Okay, actually, Mon, Matthew was giving me his phone number.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 如果我知道 我要参加这个派对…
sense_groups.english: Oh, man! lfl had known I was coming to this party...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就一定不会结婚
sense_groups.english: I never would've gotten married!

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你 瑞秋 - 很高兴认识你
sense_groups.english: It was nice to meet you. - Nice to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给我 - 我们会的
sense_groups.english: Call me. - We will!

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧你周旋在众多男生之间 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Look at you with all the guys! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜你把乔伊都忘光了
sense_groups.english: I guess you've forgotten Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 我想我是忘了乔伊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, I guess I have forgotten aboutJoey.

sense_groups.chinese: 而很明显地 你也忘了钱德
sense_groups.english: And clearly, you've forgotten about Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 钱德是我的挚爱
sense_groups.english: Please. Chandler's the love of my life.

sense_groups.chinese: 皮裤耶 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, leather pants! Have mercy!

sense_groups.chinese: 离开波士顿对你而官 一定很困难吧？
sense_groups.english: So it's probably gonna be hard for you to leave Boston, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我很高兴离开那里 我刚分手
sense_groups.english: Actually, I'm kind of happy to be leaving. I just broke up with someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 真令人伤心
sense_groups.english: Oh, so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是离开哈佛 一定也是不容易
sense_groups.english: Still, it can't be easy for you to leave Harvard.

sense_groups.chinese: 尤其是跟诺贝尔得主 亚伯特温麦尔共事过
sense_groups.english: Especially after working with a Nobel Prize winner like Albert Wintermeyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 阿亚就是我分手的人
sense_groups.english: Actually, Albie is the guy I broke up with.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟亚伯特温麦尔交征过？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: You dated Albert Wintermeyer? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 而你叫他"阿亚"？
sense_groups.english: And you called him "Albie"?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 这就像是叫 亚伯特爱因斯坦…
sense_groups.english: I mean, that's like calling Albert Einstein...

sense_groups.chinese: 阿亚一样
sense_groups.english: Albie.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 他是个很聪明的男人
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, he is a brilliant man.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为吗？我是说 你跟一个…
sense_groups.english: You think? I mean, you dated the guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 提升了碳十四的精准测定法的 男人交往
sense_groups.english: who improved the accuracy of radiocarbon dating by a factor of 10!

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 而那正是每个人 对男朋友的需求
sense_groups.english: Yes, and while that is everything one looks for in a boyfriend...

sense_groups.chinese: 他有很多问题
sense_groups.english: he had a lot of issues.

sense_groups.chinese: 像是什么呢？
sense_groups.english: Oh, like what?

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我不是要刺探隐私 只是跟…
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I don't mean to pry. It's just that this must be...

sense_groups.chinese: 一般人看《娱乐新闱》 有一样的反应
sense_groups.english: what regular people experience when they watch Access Hollywood.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 你想要知道内慕吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay, you want the dirt?

sense_groups.chinese: 阿亚有很严重的没安全感
sense_groups.english: Albie was seriously insecure.

sense_groups.chinese: 他对我之前男朋友感到非常地不安
sense_groups.english: He was really intimidated by the guy I dated before him.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁能够威胁到诺贝尔奖得主呢？
sense_groups.english: Who's intimidating to a guy who won the Nobel Prize?

sense_groups.chinese: 得过两掴诺贝尔奖的人
sense_groups.english: A guy who won two.

sense_groups.chinese: 两个？什么？
sense_groups.english: Two? What...?

sense_groups.chinese: 别告诉我你跟班杰明赫伯交拄过？
sense_groups.english: Don't tell me you dated Benjamin Hobart?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 交往了三年
sense_groups.english: Yeah, for three years.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有没有跟没得过 诺贝尔奖的人交往过呢？
sense_groups.english: Have you ever dated someone who hasn't won the Nobel Prize?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我的第一个男朋友比利没有
sense_groups.english: But there was my first boyfriend, Billy.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗？他没有得诺贝尔吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? No Nobel Prizes for him?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但是他倒是得过麦克阿瑟的 "天才奖学金"
sense_groups.english: No, but he did just win a MacArthur "genius grant."

sense_groups.chinese: 真是个窝囊废
sense_groups.english: What a loser.

sense_groups.chinese: 要再喝点酒吗？
sense_groups.english: Some more wine?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 罗斯 跟查莉进行的如何呢？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross. How's it going with Charlie?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 在我喝完酒之后…
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. After I finish my wine...

sense_groups.chinese: 我正常的脑袋会爆炸
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna blow my average-sized brains out.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？
sense_groups.english: What's the matter?

sense_groups.chinese: 她只跟天才还有诺贝尔奖得主交往
sense_groups.english: She only dates geniuses and Nobel Prize winners.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 今天稍早在中国餐厅…
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, at the Chinese restaurant earlier today...

sense_groups.chinese: 我把筷子放在嘴中假装是长毛象
sense_groups.english: I put chopsticks in my mouth and pretended to be a woolly mammoth.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很喜欢那样耶
sense_groups.english: I always loved that.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然你会喜欢 你的大脑比我的小
sense_groups.english: Of course you would! Your brains are smaller than mine!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能跟她交往的男人相比
sense_groups.english: I can't compete with the guys she goes out with.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们比我好太多了
sense_groups.english: They're so out of my league.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 还有更糟的吗？ - 比那还糟
sense_groups.english: Worse? - Oh, much, much worse.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还模仿琼瑞薇演出最早的两栖人
sense_groups.english: I did my impression of Joan Rivers as one of the earliest amphibians.

sense_groups.chinese: "我们可以去散步吗？"
sense_groups.english: "Can we walk?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢吗？ - 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, you like that? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎样？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 我觉得这样很好笑啊
sense_groups.english: Come on! I think that's funny!

sense_groups.chinese: 长毛象
sense_groups.english: Woolly mammoth.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好笑耶
sense_groups.english: It's good!

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你们一定在想现在该中场休息了 是吗？
sense_groups.english: I bet you're thinking that now would be a great time for an intermission, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 上帝 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, yes. God, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不会休息的
sense_groups.english: Well, you're not gonna get one!

sense_groups.chinese: 因为现实生活是没有中场休息的
sense_groups.english: Because in life, there are no intermissions, people!

sense_groups.chinese: 现在开始第七章 离婚是四个字
sense_groups.english: Now, Chapter 7: Divorce is a Four-Letter Word!

sense_groups.chinese: 他怎么可以离开我呢？
sense_groups.english: How could he leave me?!

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道 你看起来挺可爱的
sense_groups.english: I don't know. You seem lovely.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 这是我同事登克 登克 这是我好朋友罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross, this is one of my costars, Dirk. Dirk, this is my good friend Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴认识你 - 你是哪出戏的呢？
sense_groups.english: Nice to meet you. - So, what show are you on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是演员 我是古生物学教授
sense_groups.english: I'm not an actor. I'm a professor of paleontology.

sense_groups.chinese: 科学的东东 - 喔
sense_groups.english: That's science. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 听着 我在 《我们的日子》袒面演的是科学家
sense_groups.english: Hey, well, listen, I play a scientist on Days.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的角色刚刚赢得诺贝尔奖
sense_groups.english: Yeah, my character just won a Nobel Prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 登克想问你带来的那个女生 是不是你的女朋友
sense_groups.english: Dirk was wondering about the woman you brought and if you two are together?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 不是 不过…
sense_groups.english: Oh. Well, no, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 她只跟非常 非常聪明的男生交往
sense_groups.english: I mean, she only goes out with really, really smart guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我大学入学考考了六百九十分
sense_groups.english: Hey, I got a 690 on my SATs.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是高分啊
sense_groups.english: I'd lead with that.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 就签在胸罩上面就可以了
sense_groups.english: That's it. Just sign right on the bra.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡
sense_groups.english: Monica!

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心乔伊 我明年不会来了
sense_groups.english: Don't worry, Joe. I won't come next year!

sense_groups.chinese: 是怎样？
sense_groups.english: What the...?

sense_groups.chinese: 你那是什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What do you got there?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是一些男生给我的电话
sense_groups.english: Just some boys gave me their phone numbers.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 让我看看
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? Let me see. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死 还真多男生呢
sense_groups.english: Damn, that's a lot of guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是不是有点骚呢？
sense_groups.english: Are you a little slutty?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: I think I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我看看有哪些小丑是够格的
sense_groups.english: Let me see if I approve of any of these clowns.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个男的戴假发 - 喔…
sense_groups.english: This guy wears a rug. - Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 这个男的是加拿大人
sense_groups.english: This guy's Canadian.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个男的参加秘密教派
sense_groups.english: Oh, and this guy is in a cult, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你得花五千块才能升到第三级 但我也没有感觉到有什么不同
sense_groups.english: It'll cost you $5000 to get to level three, and I don't feel any different.

sense_groups.chinese: 跳过 哈…喔 跳过 跳过
sense_groups.english: Pass. Pa... Oh, pass. Pass.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？这些男生有什么不好的？ - 没什么特别不好
sense_groups.english: Why? What's wrong with these guys? - Well, nothing major.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是他们全都配不上你
sense_groups.english: It's just that, you know, they're not really good enough for you...

sense_groups.chinese: 而你应该跟最好的人在一起
sense_groups.english: and you deserve the best.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你真是贴心
sense_groups.english: Joey, you're so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒是 不过没关系 我已经知道你会跟谁回家了
sense_groups.english: It's true, but it doesn't matter. I already know who you're going home with.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁？
sense_groups.english: Who?

sense_groups.chinese: 我
sense_groups.english: Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 因为我们住在一起 开玩笑的 开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, because we live together. It's a joke! It's a joke.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 真好笑 我听懂了
sense_groups.english: Right! That's funny! I get it!

sense_groups.chinese: 吓到你了 - 你真好笑 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Got you! - You're funny, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢那场舞台剧表演吗？
sense_groups.english: So how did you enjoy the play?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 亲爱的 我真是抱歉
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Honey, I am so, so, so, so sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错
sense_groups.english: You should be.

sense_groups.chinese: 你错失了戏剧史上最强劲的三个小时
sense_groups.english: You missed the most powerful three hours in the history of the theater.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的喜欢吗？ - 对 一开始我是很讨厌的
sense_groups.english: You really liked it? - Oh, yeah. I mean, at first I hated it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一定会的啊 因为身为男人 我就是被训练成不要聆听的
sense_groups.english: But why wouldn't I? Because as a man, I've been trained not to listen!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是在第十六章之后 《肥胖 单身而且准备好要乱搞》
sense_groups.english: But after Chapter 16: Fat, Single and Ready to Mingle...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就被鼓舞起来了
sense_groups.english: I was uplifted.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? - Oh, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本不晓得 女人的经历过程是这样的神奇
sense_groups.english: I had no idea the amazing journey you go through as a woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我 跟我说你的第一次生理期
sense_groups.english: Tell me... Tell me about your first period.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 有人在你的胸罩上签名吗？
sense_groups.english: Did somebody sign your bra?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是十三岁的时候来的 非常难过
sense_groups.english: So I got it when I was 13. Very difficult.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 听着 关于你跟那国恐龙女生的事
sense_groups.english: Hey, Ross? So listen, about you and the dinosaur girl?

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的就要让几个诺贝尔奖 把你吓走吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you really just gonna let a couple of Nobel Prizes scare you off?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是怎样？不过是几张论文不是吗？
sense_groups.english: What is that? Come on, a piece of paper?

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上是一百万的奖金
sense_groups.english: It's actually a million-dollar prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 查莉你真行
sense_groups.english: Go, Charlie!

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我的重点是…
sense_groups.english: But my point is...

sense_groups.chinese: 她是跟他们交往过 不过都分手了啊
sense_groups.english: okay, so she dated them, but she also broke up with them.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她正在寻找一般平凡的博士而已
sense_groups.english: Maybe she's looking to, you know, slum it with some average Joe Ph.D.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许吧 而我的事业正在发展中
sense_groups.english: Yeah, maybe, and I do have my whole career in front of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说…
sense_groups.english: I mean...

sense_groups.chinese: 我还是有可能赢得诺贝尔奖的
sense_groups.english: I could still win a Nobel Prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 虽然我上两份论文被广泛地批评过
sense_groups.english: Although the last two papers I've written were widely discredited.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不只是聪明而已 你很贴心 很仁慈又很风趣
sense_groups.english: You're so much more than just brains. You are sweet and kind and funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有性感
sense_groups.english: And sexy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 给她一个机会见识这全部
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, give her a chance to see all that.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你说的没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah. You're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 菲比 我要去找她了 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: Thanks. I'm gonna go find her. - Good for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有你关于泥盆纪时期突显均势的论文 是有很精辟见解的
sense_groups.english: Your paper on punctuated equilibrium in the Devonian Era was topnotch.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要再翻我的东西了
sense_groups.english: Stop going through my stuff!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只想让你知道 我改变主意了
sense_groups.english: I just wanted to let you know I've changed my mind.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要做了 我要去亲乔伊
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna do it. I'm gonna kiss Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你不行 朋友乱搞是件坏事
sense_groups.english: No! You can't! Friends hooking up is a bad idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 那你跟钱德呢？
sense_groups.english: Please! What about you and Chandler?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是不一样的 我喝醉了而且很蠢
sense_groups.english: That's different. I was drunk and stupid.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我现在呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 那些给你电话的男生呢？
sense_groups.english: What about all the guys that you got the phone numbers from?

sense_groups.chinese: 你为什么不去亲其中一个 - 我是可以…
sense_groups.english: Why don't you just kiss one of them. - I could...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我不想 我想要亲乔伊
sense_groups.english: but I don't want to. I want to kiss Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我认为这样是不对的 但那是你自己的决定
sense_groups.english: All right. I think it's a big mistake, but it's your decision.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 而我无法阻止你吗？ - 对
sense_groups.english: And I can't stop you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋 你有看到查莉吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, Rach, have you seen Charlie anywhere?

sense_groups.chinese: 我比他聪明多了
sense_groups.english: I'm smarter than him!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 谢谢你送我们票 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, thank you so much for these tickets, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 这对我是很重要的经历 而我想跟你们分享
sense_groups.english: This was a really important experience for me. I wanted to share it with you.

and Joey's raw sexual magnetism...
those nerds would get laid!

I'm...
Well, I'm kind of embarrassed. I really hope you don't think less of me.
Think less of you? No. I don't think less of you.
I mean, you saw someone you liked and you kissed them.
Those people who like someone and don't kiss them...
those people are stupid. I hate those people.
Actually, I'm a little surprised at myself.
I mean, Joey's so different from the guys I usually date.
They're all professors, intellectuals. Paleontologists mostly.

If we want to grab a bite before work, we'd better get acrimonious.

sense_groups.chinese: 待会见 - 好的 拜
sense_groups.english: We'll see you guys. - Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: See you. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 验孕诊所怎么说？ - 不像上次一样好玩
sense_groups.english: So how did it go at the fertility clinic? - Not as much fun as last time.

sense_groups.chinese: 很明显地 他们只有在采精子样本时 才会给你看色情书刊
sense_groups.english: Apparently, you only get porn if you're giving a sperm sample.

sense_groups.chinese: 那医生怎么说呢？
sense_groups.english: So, uh, what did the doctor say?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以用代理孕母 但摩妮卡这一辈子 都在梦想怀孕…
sense_groups.english: There's surrogacy, but Monica's dreamt her whole life of carrying a child...

sense_groups.chinese: 而她会觉得看着代理孕母怀孕 对她而言会太难受了
sense_groups.english: and she just felt that watching a surrogate would be too hard for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你们不考虑代理孕母？ - 没错
sense_groups.english: So you're ruling out surrogacy? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我不用知道那是什么意思罗？
sense_groups.english: So I don't have to learn what that means?

sense_groups.chinese: 除了领养外 剩下的选择 就是接受精子捐赠
sense_groups.english: Aside from adoption, the only other choice is insemination...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们现在在讨论精子捐赠者的事
sense_groups.english: so we're talking about sperm donors.

sense_groups.chinese: 够了 我随时为你效劳 兄弟 她在哪？楼上吗？
sense_groups.english: Enough said. I'm there for you, man. Where is she, upstairs?

sense_groups.chinese: 那你的感觉呢？
sense_groups.english: How do you feel about all this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我真希望我们有更简单的方式可生孩子 但是我们别无选择
sense_groups.english: I wish there was an easier way for us to have a child, but there isn't one.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 罗斯 做做好人 挺身而出吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, Ross, be a good guy. Step up and do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？不 我不会把班给他们的
sense_groups.english: What? No! I'm not gonna give them Ben!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们从磁共振造影跟脱氧核醣核酸测试里取得的数据…
sense_groups.english: The data we're receiving from MRI scans and DNA testing...

sense_groups.chinese: 资料是很惊人的
sense_groups.english: of these fossils are staggering.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm-hm.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的意思是 我们一直以来都将李奇年代法视为理所当然
sense_groups.english: I mean, we've been accepting Leakey's dates as a given.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是如果它的误差 即使只有十万年左右…
sense_groups.english: But if they're off by even a 100,000 years or so...

sense_groups.chinese: 那你可以舍弃我们大部分推论…
sense_groups.english: then you can just throw most of our assumptions...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 丢到垃圾桶里
sense_groups.english: you know, right in the trash.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以 我要说的是…
sense_groups.english: So, what I'm saying is...

sense_groups.chinese: 是那…
sense_groups.english: Is that...

sense_groups.chinese: 是所受影响的后果是很大的
sense_groups.english: Is that, uh, repercussions could be huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 不只是在古生物学 但是如果你仔细想想…
sense_groups.english: I mean, not just in paleontology, but if you think about it...

sense_groups.chinese: 甚至是在进化生物学 基因学 地质学
sense_groups.english: in evolutionary biology, uh genetics, uh, geology.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 真的 无限想象的空间
sense_groups.english: I mean, truly, the mind boggles.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 结果不该是这样的
sense_groups.english: Well, that's not what you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 男人的动机？ - 我要喷一点
sense_groups.english: Incentive for Men? - I'll take some of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 那是男生的香水 - 我知道
sense_groups.english: That's for men. - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我等一下去派对时…
sense_groups.english: When I go to the party later...

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克会知道我已经忘了他 因为我闻起来会有另一个男人的味道
sense_groups.english: Mike will know I'm over him because I'll smell like another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 我在跟俄罗斯计程车司机约会
sense_groups.english: Oh, good, I'm dating a Russian cabdriver.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 有人买这个吗？这闻起来像是甜菜
sense_groups.english: Seriously, does anyone buy this? I smell like beets.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真的很喜欢那些有垫肩的外套 在哪边有呢？
sense_groups.english: I really like those jackets with the shoulder pads in them. Where are those?

sense_groups.chinese: 梅兰妮葛丽芬在《上班女郎》里面穿的
sense_groups.english: Um, on Melanie Griffith in Working Girl.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想适合你穿的在这边
sense_groups.english: Um, I think what you want is over here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就知道 我需要有人帮我
sense_groups.english: See, I told you I needed someone.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 为了要谢谢你 我真的很想请你吃饭
sense_groups.english: By the way, as a thank you, I would really love to take you out.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 对 乔伊跟我今晚要去看电影
sense_groups.english: Really? - Joey and I are going to a movie tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要一起去吗？ - 我不行
sense_groups.english: You want to come? - Oh, I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我看过了
sense_groups.english: Because I've seen them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你已经看过所有的电影了？
sense_groups.english: You've seen all the movies?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我为之入迷
sense_groups.english: Yeah. I'm a big fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 电影迷
sense_groups.english: Of the movies.

sense_groups.chinese: 所有的电影
sense_groups.english: You know, motion pictures.

sense_groups.chinese: 包括老电影
sense_groups.english: The talkies.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你可以跟我进去试衣间试穿吗？
sense_groups.english: Rach, will you come with me to a dressing room?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们可以做别的事
sense_groups.english: Maybe we could do something else.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 那要看是什么事 很多东西我都做过了
sense_groups.english: You know, that depends on what it is. I've done a lot of stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚刚是怎么了？ 你不喜欢查莉吗？
sense_groups.english: So, what were you doing out there? Do you not like Charlie?

sense_groups.chinese: 她还好啦 我不知道 我只是跟她不投缘吧
sense_groups.english: She's okay. I don't know, I just don't get a really good vibe from her.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？ - 我不知道
sense_groups.english: Why? - I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 只是她的一举一动 聪明的要命…
sense_groups.english: You know, just the way she waltzed in here all smart...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且又高挑 你知道的…
sense_groups.english: and tall, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后又把乔伊迷的东倒西歪的 别人都没有机会
sense_groups.english: and just swept Joey off his feet. Nobody else has a chance.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有谁呢？
sense_groups.english: Who else?

sense_groups.chinese: 任何人啊
sense_groups.english: Anybody.

sense_groups.chinese: 你
sense_groups.english: You.

sense_groups.chinese: 我
sense_groups.english: Me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道的 摩妮卡的妈
sense_groups.english: You know, Monica's mom.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢乔伊？ - 菲比
sense_groups.english: You like Joey? - Shh! Phoebe!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 你说的没错 我对他是有点感觉 只是…
sense_groups.english: All right, look, I do. I have a little thing for him. Just...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 - 是肉欲的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. - It's just physical.

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经完全控制住了 好吗？只是当我看到他们在一起…
sense_groups.english: I have it totally under control, okay? It's just when I see them together...

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候 我就会有点嫉妒
sense_groups.english: sometimes, I just get a little jealous.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 好讽刺喔 他以前喜欢你过 然后现在你喜欢…
sense_groups.english: Wow. Isn't that ironic that he liked you, and now you like...?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道啦
sense_groups.english: I get it!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 一切都控制住就好了
sense_groups.english: All right, as long as it's under control.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不可以采取任何行动 他已经跟她在一起了
sense_groups.english: You can't do anything about it. He's already dating her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她是个好人 那样是不对的
sense_groups.english: She is a nice person. That wouldn't be right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我知道 所以没事啦
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. So it's just not a big deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以不要说出去吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: So can we keep this between us? - Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 因为我得出去了 我快被甜菜味熏死了
sense_groups.english: Great, because I gotta get out of here. The smell of beets is killing me.

sense_groups.chinese: 查莉可能会有耳聋的双胞胎妹妹吗？ - 嗯
sense_groups.english: Any chance Charlie has a deaf twin? - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 亲爱的 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hi, honey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带个朋友回来吃晚餐 这是我同事柴克
sense_groups.english: I brought a friend home for dinner. This is Zack from work.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然啦 很高兴再见到你 柴克
sense_groups.english: Oh, of course. It's so nice to see you again, Zack.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是 - 你们并没有见过面
sense_groups.english: You too. - You guys haven't actually met before.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你们还真有礼貌
sense_groups.english: But, boy, you're both polite.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 我帮你拿啤酒
sense_groups.english: Have a seat. I'll get you a beer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来拿 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: I got it. - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 柴克不错吧？ - 是啊 应该吧
sense_groups.english: So Zack's pretty nice, huh? - Yeah, I guess.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你想不想和他生个小孩呢？
sense_groups.english: So how would you like to have a baby that's half yours and half his?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们在讲的是精子捐赠者 而柴克或许就是适当的人选
sense_groups.english: We're talking about sperm donors, and Zack may be the guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 他很聪明 健康 体格强壮 我是说 他是最佳人选了
sense_groups.english: Look. He's intelligent, he's healthy, he's athletic. I mean, he's sperm-tastic!

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 这太疯狂了 你是怎么跟他说的？
sense_groups.english: Chandler, this is crazy. Well, what did you even say to him?

sense_groups.chinese: "上来看看我老婆 给我们你的精子"
sense_groups.english: "Come up. Meet my wife. Give us your sperm."

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 我邀请他来吃晚餐让你见见他
sense_groups.english: I invited him to dinner so you'd get a chance to get to know him.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果去精子银行 我们根本不能见到那个捐赠者
sense_groups.english: With a sperm bank, you never meet the guy, get to check him out.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 - 我告诉你 他棒透了
sense_groups.english: Chandler! - I'm telling you, he's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 即使我的精子没有问题 我也认为我们应该选择他
sense_groups.english: I mean, even if my sperm worked fine, I think he'd be the way to go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要淌这浑水
sense_groups.english: I'm not going to be a part of this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能随便带个男的回来 就当精子捐赠者
sense_groups.english: You can't bring some random guy home and expect him to be our sperm donor.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 柴克？ - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Zack? - Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有杯垫吗？我不想留下杯印
sense_groups.english: Do you have a coaster? I don't want to make a ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 多聊聊你自己 柴克
sense_groups.english: Tell me about yourself, Zack.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你觉得她听到了吗？如果她听到就惨了
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, do you think she heard? It'd be so bad if she heard.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许她没有听到 我到隔壁间说话 你待在这里
sense_groups.english: Maybe she didn't hear. I'll go into that dressing room and talk. You stay here.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看你是不是可以听到我说话 - 好的
sense_groups.english: See if you can hear me. - Okay, great.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 感谢上帝 我听不到你说话
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank God, I can't hear a word that you're saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我还没有开始说话 - 那回去里面然后说话啊
sense_groups.english: I didn't say anything yet. - Well, get back in there and talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是瑞秋
sense_groups.english: I'm Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 让艾玛在电话上跟我朋友讲话 真的很讨厌
sense_groups.english: It's so annoying when I put Emma on the phone to talk with my friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 有些事是很难当你的面说的
sense_groups.english: Well, some things are just hard to say to your face.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我听到了 表示她也听到了
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, I heard that. Which means that she heard it too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们有麻烦了 - 喔 我们该怎么办呢？
sense_groups.english: We have a problem. - Oh, what are we gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 就老实跟她说吧
sense_groups.english: Just be honest with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 父母让婴儿听电话 的确是很讨厌
sense_groups.english: It is annoying when parents put babies on the phone.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 你说够了
sense_groups.english: All right, enough out of you!

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？ - 乔伊 我要跟查莉讲话 她在吗？
sense_groups.english: Hello? - I need to talk to Charlie. Is she there?

sense_groups.chinese: 不在 她跟瑞秋去逛街了 为什么？怎么了？
sense_groups.english: No, she, uh, went shopping with Rachel. Why? What's up?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在跟薛曼教授 讨论关于我当主讲人的事
sense_groups.english: I'm meeting with Professor Sherman about my being the keynote speaker.

sense_groups.chinese: 进行的如何呢？ - 可以更顺利的
sense_groups.english: How's it going? - It could be better.

sense_groups.chinese: 他… 他睡着了
sense_groups.english: He, um... He fell asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？但是我已经 订了到百慕达的机票了
sense_groups.english: What? But I already bought my ticket to Bermuda!

sense_groups.chinese: 是巴贝多 - 好啦 我再租车开过去
sense_groups.english: Barbados. - Fine, I'll rent a car and drive.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你一定要得到这工作
sense_groups.english: You have to get that job.

sense_groups.chinese: 我应该怎么办呢？他完全睡着了
sense_groups.english: What am I supposed to do? He's out cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 刚刚他还在说梦话
sense_groups.english: In fact, he was just talking in his sleep before...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他还要一个叫法兰的人 "再打用力点"
sense_groups.english: and evidently he wants someone named Fran to "spank him harder."

sense_groups.chinese: 那叫醒他吧 - 我不行
sense_groups.english: Well, just wake him up. - I can't.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果他发现我是让他睡着的人 我就得不到这个工作了
sense_groups.english: If he realizes that I'm the one who put him to sleep, I won't get the job.

sense_groups.chinese: 那倒是挺难的
sense_groups.english: Ooh, that's a tough one.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 这以前也发生在我身上过
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait a minute. This happened to me before.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我之前在试演一出戏剧的时候 那个制片睡着了 我…
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I was auditioning for a play, and the producer fell asleep. I...

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等等
sense_groups.english: No, wait a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实是我睡着了
sense_groups.english: It was me who fell asleep.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托 莎士比亚 来点动作场面吧？
sense_groups.english: I mean, hey, Shakespeare, how about a chase scene once in a while?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 晚餐好了 - 我先去洗手
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys, dinner's ready. - I'm gonna go wash up first.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢了
sense_groups.english: Thanks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得呢？我要我的孩子有他的基因 那双眼睛 那颧骨
sense_groups.english: What do you think? I want his genes for my kid. Those eyes, those cheekbones.

sense_groups.chinese: 好了 可能是过度狂热 也有可能是同志
sense_groups.english: Okay, there's enthusiastic, and there's just plain gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不喜欢他 - 我想他不错
sense_groups.english: You don't like him. - I think he's fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我们对他了解不够
sense_groups.english: But we don't know anything real about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我们可知道多一点 - 好的 跟着我的话锋转
sense_groups.english: I wish we could get more information. - All right, just follow my lead.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们家真是好棒 - 谢谢 我很喜欢这地方
sense_groups.english: You guys have a great place here. - Thanks. I'm crazy about our place.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 说到疯狂…
sense_groups.english: Hey, speaking of crazy...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们家有遗传性精神疾病吗？
sense_groups.english: do you have a history of mental illness in the family?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 但是我是有个叔叔投票给杜凯吉斯
sense_groups.english: Uh, no. Although, I did have an uncle who voted for Dukakis.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的不是我们想知道的
sense_groups.english: That's really not the kind of thing we're looking for.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我 你们是怎么认识的呢？
sense_groups.english: So, um, tell me, how'd you guys meet?

sense_groups.chinese: 刚开始是朋友 在伦敦喝醉 你知道的
sense_groups.english: Oh, friends first, drunk in London, you know the story.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个更棒的问题要问你
sense_groups.english: I've got a better question for you

sense_groups.chinese: 你或是你的近亲 有人有糖尿病吗？
sense_groups.english: Do you or any of your blood relatives have diabetes?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 心脏病？阿兹海默症？痛风？
sense_groups.english: Uh, heart disease? Alzheimer's? Gout?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们不常请朋友到家里用餐 是吗？
sense_groups.english: You guys don't have people for dinner a lot, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们只是在找话题聊聊
sense_groups.english: We're just making conversation.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我今天听到一个笑话 真的是挺好笑的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, well, okay. I heard a joke today. It's pretty funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道有什么是不好笑的吗？雄性秃头
sense_groups.english: You know what's not funny? Male pattern baldness.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们今晚对我很有兴趣 我很受宠若惊
sense_groups.english: You guys have shown a lot of interest in me tonight, and I'm flattered...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且老实说 是有点受惊
sense_groups.english: and quite frankly, a little frightened.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以聊聊别的话题吗？
sense_groups.english: Can we just talk about something else?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Sure. - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个意大利水饺真是美味
sense_groups.english: This ravioli's delicious.

sense_groups.chinese: 我发现你享用那水饺的牙齿真是整齐
sense_groups.english: I notice you're enjoying that ravioli with a beautiful set of teeth.

sense_groups.chinese: 你小时候有戴牙套吗？
sense_groups.english: Did you have braces as a child?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没有 - 太好了
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't. - Yes!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们很重视牙齿的 柴克
sense_groups.english: We're teeth people, Zack.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们直接过去问她有没有听到
sense_groups.english: Let's just do it. Let's just go over there and see if she heard.

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Good plan. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你是在做什么呢？ - 对不起 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: What? Where are you going? - Oh, I'm sorry, Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有时问玩你的幼稚游戏 好吗？
sense_groups.english: I don't have time for your childish games, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我还得去找很惊艳的衣服穿
sense_groups.english: I still have to find something incredible to wear...

sense_groups.chinese: 那我才可以在"谁先忘了谁"上 打败麦克
sense_groups.english: so I can beat Mike at "Who's More Over Who"!

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 - 你好
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去哪里了？ - 去试穿衣服
sense_groups.english: Where have you been? - Trying on clothes.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？在试衣间吗？喔 真奇怪
sense_groups.english: Oh, really? In the dressing room? Well, that's so weird.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟我刚刚也在试衣间 天啊 这世界真是小
sense_groups.english: Phoebe and I were in the dressing room. Gosh, it's just such a small world.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我听到你们俩的对谈了
sense_groups.english: Rachel, I heard you two guys whispering.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你听到了 好的 听着 让我解释
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, you did, you heard. Okay, look, let me explain.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有必要解释 我都听到了
sense_groups.english: There's nothing to explain. I heard you.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比喜欢乔伊
sense_groups.english: Phoebe likes Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不明白 我是说菲比喜欢乔伊
sense_groups.english: I don't understand it. I mean, Phoebe likes Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 可是她却来买衣服 来惊艳另一个男人？
sense_groups.english: and then she's here to buy a dress to impress another guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 菲比就是那样 她就是那样 你知道的 她就是全部都要
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that's Phoebe. That's Phoebe. You know, she just wants them all.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就像是女色情狂
sense_groups.english: It's, like, she's nympho.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Wow! - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我有听到你告诉她 不可以做任何事
sense_groups.english: You know, by the way, I heard you tell her not to do anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你替我说话 天啊 你真是个好人
sense_groups.english: Thanks for sticking up for me. God, you are such a nice person.

sense_groups.chinese: 我尽量
sense_groups.english: I try.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦
sense_groups.english: Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 你真的要我当主讲人吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, you really want me to be the keynote speaker?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Thank you!

sense_groups.chinese: 不用客气
sense_groups.english: You're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你看起来…
sense_groups.english: Wow! You look...

sense_groups.chinese: 真是辣得让人不想吃东西
sense_groups.english: stop-eating hot!

sense_groups.chinese: 这是最高阶级的辣耶
sense_groups.english: Which is like the highest level of hotness.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定吗？因为我真的很不想去这派对
sense_groups.english: Okay, are you sure? Because I am really dreading going to this party.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就别去啊
sense_groups.english: Then don't go.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克知道我要去 如果我没出现 他会以为那是因为他…
sense_groups.english: Mike knows I'm coming. If I don't show up, he'll think it's because of him...

sense_groups.chinese: 我那样就会很没面子 这对我来说是很严重的事
sense_groups.english: and then I'm gonna lose face. That's a very serious thing in my culture.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 那就去派对吧 然后假装已经完全不受麦克影响
sense_groups.english: All right, then you go to that party, and you pretend to be over Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 之后你再来我家 我再帮你好好借酒解愁
sense_groups.english: Afterward, you come to my place and I'll get you good and drunk.

sense_groups.chinese: 没问题 好的
sense_groups.english: You got it. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是不要喝你自己酿的酒好吗？
sense_groups.english: But not on the wine that you made, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我不想要再进急诊室了
sense_groups.english: Because I just don't want to go back to the emergency room.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫？
sense_groups.english: David?

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比
sense_groups.english: Phoebe! Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Oh my god - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 你看起来真是漂亮极了
sense_groups.english: Wow! You look unbelievable.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 是啊 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, well...

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里做什么呢？
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我从明斯克回来了 永久
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm back from Minsk. Uh, permanently.

sense_groups.chinese: 发生什么事呢？
sense_groups.english: Well, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 记得我正在尝试制造…
sense_groups.english: Remember how I was trying to achieve...

sense_groups.chinese: 次原子阳电子净化吗？
sense_groups.english: the positronic distillation of subatomic particles?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 在经过八年的研究之后 我发现…
sense_groups.english: Well, after eight years of research, I discovered...

sense_groups.chinese: 那是做不到的
sense_groups.english: that it can't be done.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 你终于回来了真是好 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: great that you're back. How are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 过的还不错 - 很好
sense_groups.english: Good. Good. Life is good. - Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在有交往的对象了 - 噢
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm seeing someone. - Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样啊 恭喜你了 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Good for you. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也是科学家 很聪明也很漂亮
sense_groups.english: She's also a scientist, so she's very smart and pretty and, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且事实上是因为你 我们才在一起的
sense_groups.english: It's actually because of you that we're together.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我看到你跟那个麦克在一起
sense_groups.english: I mean, I saw what you had with that Mike guy...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我告诉自己 "天啊 我也想要那样"
sense_groups.english: and I just said, "Boy, I want that."

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克跟我分手了 - 你在开玩笑吧
sense_groups.english: Mike and I broke up. - You're kidding me.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我没有在跟谁交往 完全是我编出来的
sense_groups.english: Because I'm not seeing anybody. I just totally made that up.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？ - 我不知道为什么 我很抱歉
sense_groups.english: Really? - I don't know why, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜我只是不想没面子
sense_groups.english: I guess I just didn't want to lose face.

sense_groups.chinese: 我能了解
sense_groups.english: I understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 好的 那…
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Okay. So then, okay...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都住在纽约 没有交往对象
sense_groups.english: So we're both living in New York, not seeing anyone.

sense_groups.chinese: 这太不像我们了 - 是啊 我知道
sense_groups.english: That's so not like us. - Yeah, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 这或许是个蠢问题 看到你穿成这样…
sense_groups.english: Well, this is probably a stupid question, seeing that you look like that...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你现在有要去什么地方吗？
sense_groups.english: but, um, do you have someplace that you need to be right now?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯…
sense_groups.english: Well...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你想不想去喝点东西呢？ - 我很想
sense_groups.english: Well, do you want to get a drink? - I'd love to.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 - 好的
sense_groups.english: Great. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有闻到甜菜味吗？
sense_groups.english: Uh, do you smell beets?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 站到我的逆风边
sense_groups.english: Oh, all right, stay upwind of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 那是菲比 那是麦克吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, there's Phoebe. Is that Mike she's with?

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 那是大卫
sense_groups.english: No, that's David.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有第三个男人？
sense_groups.english: There's a third guy?

sense_groups.chinese: 只是冰山的一角
sense_groups.english: Tip of the iceberg.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在要走了
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna take off now.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会让我回家吗？
sense_groups.english: You're gonna let me go home, aren't you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定不要再多坐一下吗？
sense_groups.english: Sure you don't want to stay a little longer?

sense_groups.chinese: 不了 我应该回家了 我有点累
sense_groups.english: No, I should get home. I'm kind of tired.

sense_groups.chinese: 你很容易累吗？
sense_groups.english: Are you always tired?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为这很有可能是忧郁症的前兆
sense_groups.english: Because that could be a sign of clinical depression.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只是要想出我祖父母是几岁过世的 这让我很累
sense_groups.english: No, it's tiring to figure out the age at which all my grandparents died.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天见 - 好的
sense_groups.english: I'll see you tomorrow. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们找到我们的精子了
sense_groups.english: I think we found our sperm.

sense_groups.chinese: 他看起来是挺完美的
sense_groups.english: He does seem pretty perfect.

sense_groups.chinese: 你也这么认为吗？我要开口问他吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah? You think so? Should I ask him?

sense_groups.chinese: 不要
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么呢？就只因为他曾祖母有肥胖症吗？
sense_groups.english: Why not? Just because his great-grandmother was obese?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我们的孩子也是会从你那遗传到
sense_groups.english: Our kid's gonna get that from you anyway.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 不是那个缘故
sense_groups.english: No, that's not it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是在我们问他那些问题时…
sense_groups.english: It's just that when we were asking him all those questions before...

sense_groups.chinese: 我才意识到我不在乎他是不是世上最完美的男人
sense_groups.english: I just realized I don't care if he is the most perfect guy in the world.

sense_groups.chinese: 他不是你 - 是啊 他比我更好
sense_groups.english: He's not you. - Yeah, he's better!

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他不是
sense_groups.english: No, he's not.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我不能跟你怀孕 我也不想跟他…
sense_groups.english: If I can't get pregnant with you, then I don't want to get pregnant by him...

sense_groups.chinese: 或是跟任何人
sense_groups.english: or anyone else.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的？你确定吗？ - 是的 我确定
sense_groups.english: Really? Are you sure? - Yeah, I'm sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢上帝 因为我也不想这样做
sense_groups.english: Thank God, because I don't wanna do this either.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会这样做 是因为我以为你想这样
sense_groups.english: I was just doing it because I thought that was what you wanted.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是丈夫 我理当要提供精子的
sense_groups.english: I'm the husband. I'm supposed to bring the sperm.

sense_groups.chinese: 这真是太贴心了
sense_groups.english: That is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你
sense_groups.english: I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你知道我们唯一的选择就是…
sense_groups.english: So you know this leaves us with...

sense_groups.chinese: 领养
sense_groups.english: Adoption.

sense_groups.chinese: 你觉得如何呢？
sense_groups.english: How do you feel about that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我没问题
sense_groups.english: I think I feel okay about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上我觉得非常的好
sense_groups.english: Actually, I think I feel really good about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是
sense_groups.english: Me too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想找到一个需要家庭温暖的小孩 然后跟你一起抚养他
sense_groups.english: I wanna find a baby that needs a home, and I wanna raise it with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我想用我们自己的方式来乱养他
sense_groups.english: And I wanna mess it up in our own specific way.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是决定吗？我们真的要领养？
sense_groups.english: So this is it? We're really gonna adopt?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 我们要当父母亲了 - 我们会是很棒的父母
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God! We're gonna be parents! - We are gonna be great parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且可能会很快
sense_groups.english: And it could be soon.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 想想看 就是现在 在外面某个地方…
sense_groups.english: I mean, think about it. Right now, somewhere out there...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们的孩子可能正被受孕
sense_groups.english: our baby could be being conceived.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 如果我们够幸运 而且我们真的 真的 真的很安静…
sense_groups.english: Wait. If we're lucky, and we're really, really, really quiet...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们或许可以听到保险套破裂的声音
sense_groups.english: we may be able to hear the sound of a condom breaking.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 柴克
sense_groups.english: Hey, Zack.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 钱德
sense_groups.english: Hey, Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想为昨晚的事道歉
sense_groups.english: I wanted to apologize for last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 我感到我们让你很不舒服
sense_groups.english: I got the feeling we made you uncomfortable.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 并没有 - 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: No, you didn't. - Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你们是有
sense_groups.english: No, you did.

sense_groups.chinese: 我老婆跟我越界了
sense_groups.english: My wife and I have some boundary issues.

sense_groups.chinese: 有时候我们会问些很不适当的问题
sense_groups.english: Sometimes we ask inappropriate questions.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们正在改进中
sense_groups.english: We're working on it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些是星期五推销会的看板 - 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Here are the boards for Friday's pitch. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知不知道珍娜是否要留着她的孩子？
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't know if she's planning on keeping her baby, would you?

questions.name: S09E23
questions.en:
Hey! I'm all packed and ready to go.
Oh, that's right. Daddy and Uncle Joey are going on a trip today.
We're going to a conference in Barbados. Right?
Uh-huh. - Can you say, "Barbados"?
Barbados.
Okay. I've gotta say, it means so much to me that you guys are coming...
all the way over there to hear me give my speech.
Ooh, and I have a surprise. I had to pull some strings...
but I was able to get everyone passes to the entire conference. That's right!
These babies will get you into all the paleontology lectures and seminars.
Do you have anything that will get us out of them?
We're excited to hear the speech, but the rest of the time...
we're gonna want to do island stuff.
David'll probably want to hear a few lectures.
Right, because he's a scientist. - No, no.
He's been in Minsk for eight years. If he gets too much direct sunlight...
he'll die.
Okay, we'd better go. - Yeah?
So we'll see you guys tomorrow. - All right, let's do it.
A five-hour flight with Charlie, have a couple drinks...
get under that blanket and do what comes natural.
It's a blanket, Joe, not a cloak of invisibility.
Wow, this place is beautiful! - Look at all these paleontologists!
I know. There are gonna be some pasty folks by the pool tomorrow.
Oh, my God, I can't believe you're here!
I think I've been recognized.
This happens all the time. - Dr. Geller? I am such a huge fan.
That never happens.
I've been following your career for years. I can't wait for your keynote speech.
Wow. This is very flattering... - I would love your autograph.
Well, sure. Um...
"Dear?" - Sarah.
"Sarah. I dig you."
"Dr. Ross Geller." - Oh, thank you so much.
Sure. Sarah, I'd like you to introduce you to my colleague, Professor Wheeler.
And this is Joey Tribbiani. - Are you a paleontologist?
No, God, no, no. I'm an actor.
You probably recognize me from a little show called The Days of Our Lives.
Dude, it's just Days of Our Lives. There's no "the."
Okay, Ross, boy, you... Yeah. No, no. I play Dr. Drake Ramoray.
I'm sorry. I don't own a TV. - You don't own a TV?
What's all your furniture pointed at?
David, can you help me?
I'm trying to explain to Chandler how a plane stays in the air.
Oh, certainly. That's a combination of Bernoulli's Principle...
and Newton's third law of motion. - See?
Yeah. That's the same as, "It has something to do with wind."
I'm gonna go pick up a few things for the trip.
I should go too. Now, tomorrow do you want to share a cab to the airport...
or should Mike and I meet you?
Mike? Who's Mike?
Mike's your ex-boyfriend. - That's right!
Oh, yeah. Wow, I had totally forgotten about him.
That's a blast from the past, huh? - No, it's okay. Honest mistake.
It really doesn't mean anything. I mean, you know...
Monica refers to Chandler as Richard all the time.
She does? - Let's get you out of here.
Well, at least you took me down with you.
I'm so sorry. I just... I keep thinking about Mike.
I'm crazy about David, and we're having so much fun together.
Why? Why do I miss Mike? That's just... That's gonna go away, right?
Well, I guess. In time. - Yeah.
I mean, my feelings for Richard are certainly gone.
You just did it again. Chandler. Your feelings for Chandler are certainly gone.
Boy, Phoebe's still pretty hung up on that Mike, huh?
I wouldn't read too much into it.
Still, a girl calls you by her ex-boyfriend's name...
that's not a good thing, right? - Let me stop you there.
Because I think I see where this is going. I'm not very good at giving advice.
See, if you want advice, go to Ross or Monica. Or Joey...
for advice about pizza toppings or a burning sensation when you pee.
I'm sorry, I just wish there was something I could do, you know?
Well, you know Phoebe... - Seriously, we're gonna do this?
I'm sorry, I just wish I could make her forget about Mike already.
Why did Phoebe and Mike break up? - Oh, because his penis was too big.
I'm sorry. That's the kind of thing I do.
They broke up because Mike didn't want to get married.
What if you let Phoebe know you'd be open to marriage?
That's great. That's great. I'll propose to her.
What?
I was probably going to do it at some point.
No, I didn't mean now. - Well, why not? It's brilliant.
"Goodbye, Mike. We'll see you at the wedding, fella.
Well, we probably won't invite you to the wedding, but..."
Well, thank you, Chandler. Sincerely. - Well, you're welcome.
Glad I could help.
How do you think I should propose? - I'm pretending to read here.
I'm sorry.
Yeah. How you doing?
Hey, hey. - Hey.
You said you were gonna wear a thong. Where's the thong?
Ha, ha, I didn't mean a thong. I meant thongs.
You really should have been more clear about that.
You're never gonna guess who I just saw downstairs.
Oh, uh, uh, Britney Spears!
Yeah. She never misses these conferences.
No, I just saw Dr. Kenneth Schwartz! - Oh, my God!
I know! - Did you talk to him?
Oh, yeah. What am I gonna say to Kenneth Schwartz?
You could say, "Hey, Kenny, how come you're not Britney Spears?"
You ready to go? - You're gonna go now?
I thought we could hang out. - I can't. I have seminars all day.
I promised Ross I'd look at his speech.
But maybe we could have dinner later? Out on the balcony? Lt'll be romantic.
Will you wear a thong?
I will if you will.
You got yourself a very weird deal.
I'm good. I have dinner plans.
So you gonna be okay? - Yeah, yeah.
I got tons of stuff I could do. I'm gonna hit the beach, go swimming.
Joe, have you looked outside?
No. Why?
Oh, man. - There's an indoor pool.
You could swim there. - Yeah.
I wasn't gonna swim. I was gonna dig a hole.
That "Mike" was interesting. I don't know what's gonna happen...
with Phoebe and David. - I do. Want a hint, huh?
I do. I do.
Okay, I'm sensing this is some kind of wordplay...
because you are pink with barely controlled glee.
David's gonna propose to Phoebe. - What? Why?
Because we were talking about ways he could beat Mike...
and I told him Phoebe wanted to get married.
Chandler, we have talked about this.
You are not supposed to give people advice!
Couldn't you have made some inappropriate joke?
I did! A penis one!
Just so I know, what was so wrong about what I said?
They've only been going out for a few weeks.
Phoebe is completely hung up on Mike. I mean, she'll say no...
David's heart will be broken, it'll be too hard for them to recover...
and then Phoebe will end up alone again.
Man, that's some bad advice.
Oh, hey. Thank God. You guys are here.
What's going on? - Everything is upside-down here.
It rains all day long and nobody watches TV, and Ross is famous.
I don't want to alarm anybody...
but Monica's hair is twice as big as it was when we landed.
Okay. When I go places with high humidity...
it gets a little extra body, okay?
