sense_groups.english: Wow. This is very flattering... - I would love your autograph.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 当然
sense_groups.english: Well, sure. Um...

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的？ - 莎拉
sense_groups.english: "Dear?" - Sarah.

sense_groups.chinese: "莎拉 我挖(喜欢)你"
sense_groups.english: "Sarah. I dig you."

sense_groups.chinese: "罗斯盖勒博士" - 哇 真是太谢谢你了
sense_groups.english: "Dr. Ross Geller." - Oh, thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 不客气 莎拉 容我介绍一下 我的同事 魏勒教授
sense_groups.english: Sure. Sarah, I'd like you to introduce you to my colleague, Professor Wheeler.

sense_groups.chinese: 这位是乔伊崔比亚尼 - 你是古生物学家吗？
sense_groups.english: And this is Joey Tribbiani. - Are you a paleontologist?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 天啊 不是 我是演员
sense_groups.english: No, God, no, no. I'm an actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 你或许有看过我… 演的一出小戏 叫做《那个我们的日子》
sense_groups.english: You probably recognize me from a little show called The Days of Our Lives.

sense_groups.chinese: 老兄 是《我们的日子》 没有"那个"
sense_groups.english: Dude, it's just Days of Our Lives. There's no "the."

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 罗斯 天啊 你… 不 我扮演德瑞克雷莫瑞医生
sense_groups.english: Okay, Ross, boy, you... Yeah. No, no. I play Dr. Drake Ramoray.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我家没有电视 - 你家没有电视？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I don't own a TV. - You don't own a TV?

sense_groups.chinese: 那你家的家俱是摆向哪个方向？
sense_groups.english: What's all your furniture pointed at?

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 你可以帮个忙吗？
sense_groups.english: David, can you help me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我正在跟钱德解释 飞机怎么能停留在空中
sense_groups.english: I'm trying to explain to Chandler how a plane stays in the air.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 那是伯努利原理加上…
sense_groups.english: Oh, certainly. That's a combination of Bernoulli's Principle...

sense_groups.chinese: 牛顿第三运动定律 - 懂了？
sense_groups.english: and Newton's third law of motion. - See?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 完全就是你所说的 "跟风有关"
sense_groups.english: Yeah. That's the same as, "It has something to do with wind."

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去为这次旅行买几样东西
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go pick up a few things for the trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也应该走了 明天你们要一起搭计程车到机场吗？
sense_groups.english: I should go too. Now, tomorrow do you want to share a cab to the airport...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是说我跟麦克到机场 跟你们碰面呢？
sense_groups.english: or should Mike and I meet you?

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克？谁是麦克啊？
sense_groups.english: Mike? Who's Mike?

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克是你的前男友 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Mike's your ex-boyfriend. - That's right!

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 我已经完全忘掉他了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Wow, I had totally forgotten about him.

sense_groups.chinese: 过去的事突然脱口而出 - 不 没关系 无心之过
sense_groups.english: That's a blast from the past, huh? - No, it's okay. Honest mistake.

sense_groups.chinese: 那真的不代表什么 我是说 你知道的…
sense_groups.english: It really doesn't mean anything. I mean, you know...

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡也常常把钱德叫成理查
sense_groups.english: Monica refers to Chandler as Richard all the time.

sense_groups.chinese: 她有吗？ - 我们快让你离开吧
sense_groups.english: She does? - Let's get you out of here.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你也拖我一起下水了
sense_groups.english: Well, at least you took me down with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 我只是… 我一直在想麦克
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. I just... I keep thinking about Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 我非常喜欢大卫 而且我们在一起很开心
sense_groups.english: I'm crazy about David, and we're having so much fun together.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么我会想念麦克？这真是… 这会消失的 对吗？
sense_groups.english: Why? Why do I miss Mike? That's just... That's gonna go away, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我猜是吧 总有一天 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Well, I guess. In time. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我对理查的感觉已经消失了
sense_groups.english: I mean, my feelings for Richard are certainly gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 你又来了 是钱德 你对钱德的感觉已经消失了
sense_groups.english: You just did it again. Chandler. Your feelings for Chandler are certainly gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 菲比还在想麦克吗？
sense_groups.english: Boy, Phoebe's still pretty hung up on that Mike, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 要是我就不会想太多
sense_groups.english: I wouldn't read too much into it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是女生把你叫成 她前男友的名字…
sense_groups.english: Still, a girl calls you by her ex-boyfriend's name...

sense_groups.chinese: 那不是什么好事 对不对？ - 让我先打断你一下
sense_groups.english: that's not a good thing, right? - Let me stop you there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我知道这是怎么回事了 我不太擅长给人忠告
sense_groups.english: Because I think I see where this is going. I'm not very good at giving advice.

sense_groups.chinese: 想要建议 最好去找罗斯或摩妮卡 如果你想了解…
sense_groups.english: See, if you want advice, go to Ross or Monica. Or Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 披萨馅料或是尿尿时 为何有灼热感 那就去找乔伊
sense_groups.english: for advice about pizza toppings or a burning sensation when you pee.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我只是希望能做点什么 你知道吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I just wish there was something I could do, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 你知道菲比… - 你真的想跟我谈这个吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, you know Phoebe... - Seriously, we're gonna do this?

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我只希望 我能让她忘了麦克
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I just wish I could make her forget about Mike already.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟麦克为什么分手？ - 因为他的老二太大了
sense_groups.english: Why did Phoebe and Mike break up? - Oh, because his penis was too big.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 那才是我擅长的事
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. That's the kind of thing I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们分手 是因为麦克不想要结婚
sense_groups.english: They broke up because Mike didn't want to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果让菲比知道 你愿意结婚呢？
sense_groups.english: What if you let Phoebe know you'd be open to marriage?

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 太棒了 我会跟她求婚
sense_groups.english: That's great. That's great. I'll propose to her.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我迟早都会这么做的
sense_groups.english: I was probably going to do it at some point.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有说现在 - 为什么不呢？这实在太聪明了
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't mean now. - Well, why not? It's brilliant.

sense_groups.chinese: "再见 麦克 我们婚礼见 老兄
sense_groups.english: "Goodbye, Mike. We'll see you at the wedding, fella.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可能也不会 邀请你参加婚礼 但是…"
sense_groups.english: Well, we probably won't invite you to the wedding, but..."

sense_groups.chinese: 衷心地谢谢你 钱德 - 不用客气
sense_groups.english: Well, thank you, Chandler. Sincerely. - Well, you're welcome.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴能够帮得上忙
sense_groups.english: Glad I could help.

sense_groups.chinese: 你认为我该怎么求婚呢？ - 大卫 我在假装看杂志
sense_groups.english: How do you think I should propose? - I'm pretending to read here.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好吗？嘿 你好吗？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. How you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 嘿 - 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说你要穿丁字裤的 丁字裤呢？
sense_groups.english: You said you were gonna wear a thong. Where's the thong?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是说丁字裤 我是说夹脚凉鞋
sense_groups.english: Ha, ha, I didn't mean a thong. I meant thongs.

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该要说清楚的
sense_groups.english: You really should have been more clear about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们绝对猜不出来 我在楼下看到谁
sense_groups.english: You're never gonna guess who I just saw downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 小甜甜布兰妮
sense_groups.english: Oh, uh, uh, Britney Spears!

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 她绝对不会错过 这种研讨会的
sense_groups.english: Yeah. She never misses these conferences.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚刚看到肯尼斯史华兹博士 - 喔 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: No, I just saw Dr. Kenneth Schwartz! - Oh, my God!

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 - 你有跟他说话吗？
sense_groups.english: I know! - Did you talk to him?

sense_groups.chinese: 是喔 我要跟 肯尼斯史华兹说什么？
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. What am I gonna say to Kenneth Schwartz?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以说"嗨 肯尼 为什么你不是小甜甜布兰妮？"
sense_groups.english: You could say, "Hey, Kenny, how come you're not Britney Spears?"

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好要走了吗？ - 你现在就要走了？
sense_groups.english: You ready to go? - You're gonna go now?

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你可陪我一下 - 我不行 我整天都有研讨会
sense_groups.english: I thought we could hang out. - I can't. I have seminars all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 我答应罗斯 我会看看他的演说稿
sense_groups.english: I promised Ross I'd look at his speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 或许我们晚点可以一起 在阳台上吃晚餐 很浪漫哦
sense_groups.english: But maybe we could have dinner later? Out on the balcony? Lt'll be romantic.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以穿丁字裤吗？
sense_groups.english: Will you wear a thong?

sense_groups.chinese: 你穿我就穿
sense_groups.english: I will if you will.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的交换条件真是奇怪
sense_groups.english: You got yourself a very weird deal.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很好 我晚餐已经有安排了
sense_groups.english: I'm good. I have dinner plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一个人可以吗？ - 当然 可以
sense_groups.english: So you gonna be okay? - Yeah, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有很多事可以做 我要去海滩 去游泳
sense_groups.english: I got tons of stuff I could do. I'm gonna hit the beach, go swimming.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 你有看看外面吗？
sense_groups.english: Joe, have you looked outside?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 为什么？
sense_groups.english: No. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 - 这里有室内游泳池
sense_groups.english: Oh, man. - There's an indoor pool.

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以在那边游泳 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: You could swim there. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有要游泳 我是要去挖洞的
sense_groups.english: I wasn't gonna swim. I was gonna dig a hole.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克那件事真是有趣 我不知道…
sense_groups.english: That "Mike" was interesting. I don't know what's gonna happen...

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比跟大卫之间会有什么事 - 我知道 要提示吗？
sense_groups.english: with Phoebe and David. - I do. Want a hint, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 我知 我知道
sense_groups.english: I do. I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我可以感觉到 这是某种文字游戏
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm sensing this is some kind of wordplay...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你已经有点 无法控制 兴奋到脸红了
sense_groups.english: because you are pink with barely controlled glee.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫要跟菲比求婚 - 什么？为什么？
sense_groups.english: David's gonna propose to Phoebe. - What? Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们本来在谈 他有哪些可以赢过麦克的方式
sense_groups.english: Because we were talking about ways he could beat Mike...

sense_groups.chinese: 而我告诉他菲比想要结婚
sense_groups.english: and I told him Phoebe wanted to get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我们已经谈过了
sense_groups.english: Chandler, we have talked about this.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不可以给别人建议
sense_groups.english: You are not supposed to give people advice!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不能说一些 不得体的笑话就好了吗？
sense_groups.english: Couldn't you have made some inappropriate joke?

sense_groups.chinese: 我说了 一个老二的笑话
sense_groups.english: I did! A penis one!

sense_groups.chinese: 说明一下 我说的有什么不对？
sense_groups.english: Just so I know, what was so wrong about what I said?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们才交往几个星期而已
sense_groups.english: They've only been going out for a few weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比还无法忘记麦克 我想她会拒绝的
sense_groups.english: Phoebe is completely hung up on Mike. I mean, she'll say no...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后大卫会心碎 他们会很难复合
sense_groups.english: David's heart will be broken, it'll be too hard for them to recover...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后菲比又会孤单一个人
sense_groups.english: and then Phoebe will end up alone again.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真是糟糕的建议
sense_groups.english: Man, that's some bad advice.

sense_groups.chinese: 感谢上帝 你们来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey. Thank God. You guys are here.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？ - 这里一切都不对劲
sense_groups.english: What's going on? - Everything is upside-down here.

sense_groups.chinese: 整天都在下雨 没有人看电视 而且罗斯还很有名
sense_groups.english: It rains all day long and nobody watches TV, and Ross is famous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想要惊动大家…
sense_groups.english: I don't want to alarm anybody...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是摩妮卡的头发 比下飞机时膨了一倍
sense_groups.english: but Monica's hair is twice as big as it was when we landed.

sense_groups.chinese: 我去湿度高的地方…
sense_groups.english: Okay. When I go places with high humidity...

sense_groups.chinese: 头发就会比较蓬松 好吗？
sense_groups.english: it gets a little extra body, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 那就是为什么我们的蜜月照 看起来是我跟戴安娜罗丝
sense_groups.english: That's why our honeymoon photos look like me and Diana Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带你们去登记住房
sense_groups.english: I'll show you guys where to check in.

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 要确定我们可以拿到 超大尺寸的床哦
sense_groups.english: Oh, honey? Can you make sure we get a king-size bed?

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 也帮我们确定一下 还有看看他们有没有心型的床
sense_groups.english: Oh, David, get one for us too. Oh, and see if they have a heart-shaped one.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且天花板上要有镜子
sense_groups.english: And with mirrors on the ceiling.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有确定我们的房间 不要在他们的隔壁
sense_groups.english: And make sure our room isn't next to theirs.

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 你们真幸运 有人陪你们来这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, you guys are so lucky you're here with people.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个很浪漫的地方
sense_groups.english: You know, it's just such a romantic place.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只希望可以跟一个男人共享
sense_groups.english: I just wish I could share it with a guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是跟乔伊 - 不是跟乔伊 不是
sense_groups.english: Not Joey. - Not Joey. No.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是在垂涎钱德 - 是噢
sense_groups.english: I was just lusting after Chandler. - Yeah, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今晚要跟菲比求婚
sense_groups.english: So I'm proposing to Phoebe tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 今晚？
sense_groups.english: Tonight?

sense_groups.chinese: 订婚戒指不是应该要有钻石吗？
sense_groups.english: Isn't an engagement ring supposed to have a diamond?

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, there it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 一个失败的科学家
sense_groups.english: Yes, well, being a failed scientist...

sense_groups.chinese: 并没有像你想的赚那么多
sense_groups.english: doesn't pay quite as well as you might think.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是七十分之一克拉
sense_groups.english: That's one-seventieth of a carat.

sense_groups.chinese: 清晰度是很差
sense_groups.english: And the clarity is quite poor.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好
sense_groups.english: Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 我可以跟你谈一下吗？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: Monica, can I talk to you for a second? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫要在今晚跟菲比求婚
sense_groups.english: David's gonna propose to Phoebe tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看 这就是你给别人建议的结果
sense_groups.english: See what happens when you give people advice?

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望你有告诉他不可以 - 那也是一个建议
sense_groups.english: Well, I hope you told him not to. - That would be advice!

sense_groups.chinese: 好 没关系 让我来处理
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine. I'll handle this.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比？ - 怎样？
sense_groups.english: Phoebe? - Yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要跟你谈谈 - 你要离开《至上女声三重唱》？
sense_groups.english: I need to talk to you. - Are you leaving the Supremes?

sense_groups.chinese: 我老公刚给了你男友 一个很糟糕的建议
sense_groups.english: Okay, my husband just gave your boyfriend some very bad advice.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫今晚要跟你求婚
sense_groups.english: David's gonna propose to you tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Wow, really?

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's fantastic!

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？你是说真的吗？你想嫁给他？
sense_groups.english: What? Are you serious? You want to marry him?

sense_groups.chinese: 那麦克呢？ - 是吗 你要我嫁给麦克吗？
sense_groups.english: What about Mike? - Oh, okay, you want me to marry Mike?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 我们把他 嘴巴塞住 手铐铐上
sense_groups.english: Let's just gag him and handcuff him...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后逼他踏上红毯 好吗？
sense_groups.english: ...and force him down the aisle, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经可以预见到 "麦克 你愿意娶菲比吗？"
sense_groups.english: I can just see it. "Mike, do you take Phoebe?"

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？那真是每个女孩的梦想
sense_groups.english: You know? It's every girl's dream.

sense_groups.chinese: 你真的认为 嫁给别人就可以解决？
sense_groups.english: Do you really think marrying someone else is the right answer?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 听着 最重要的是 我爱麦克…大卫
sense_groups.english: Sure. Look, okay, bottom line? I love Mike... David!

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 我爱大卫
sense_groups.english: David! I love David.

sense_groups.chinese: 别那样看我 戴安娜罗丝
sense_groups.english: Don't look at me that way, Roseanne Roseannadanna.

sense_groups.chinese: "藉由电脑断层扫描跟电脑成像 我们可以用非常逼真的方式…
sense_groups.english: "By using CT scans and computer imaging, we can, in a very real way...

sense_groups.chinese: 将中生代时期带到二十一世纪"
sense_groups.english: bring the Mesozoic Era into the 21st century."

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了
sense_groups.english: It's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 你会成为此次研讨会的明星
sense_groups.english: You'll be the hit of the conference.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？明天还会更好
sense_groups.english: It'll be even better tomorrow...

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我不会一直被乔伊打断…
sense_groups.english: because I won't be constantly interrupted by Joey...

sense_groups.chinese: 他一直来检查我枕头上 放了巧克力没有
sense_groups.english: checking to see if they put chocolates on my pillow yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家好 - 巧克力还没送来
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - The chocolates aren't here.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯刚念完他的演讲稿给我听 真是精彩
sense_groups.english: Ross just read me his speech. It's fantastic.

sense_groups.chinese: 在电脑里面吗？因为我也想看
sense_groups.english: Oh, is it on the computer? Because I'd love to give it a read.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你想要查电子邮件就说吧
sense_groups.english: If you want to check your e-mail, just ask.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我可以吗？
sense_groups.english: What? May I?

sense_groups.chinese: 这雨是怎么回事 盖勒？我报名参加恐龙营的时候…
sense_groups.english: What's with the rain, Geller? I mean, when I signed up for dino week...

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人说过现在是雨季
sense_groups.english: nobody said anything about it being monsoon season.

sense_groups.chinese: 雨季其实是六月到十二月 - 现在不是时候 查莉
sense_groups.english: The wet season is June to December. - It's not the time, Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 哎呀 糟糕 天哪 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, no. No, no! Dear God, no!

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了？有人比你抢先标下茶壶吗？
sense_groups.english: What, did someone outbid you for the teapot?

sense_groups.chinese: 秘密茶壶
sense_groups.english: Secret teapot.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的电脑 我不知道怎么… 全部消失了
sense_groups.english: Your computer. I don't know what... Everything's gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思？ - 定是病毒
sense_groups.english: What do you mean? - Must be a virus.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想它把你的硬碟全杀掉了
sense_groups.english: I think it erased your hard drive.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？我的天啊 你干了什么好事？
sense_groups.english: What? Oh, my God. What did you do?

sense_groups.chinese: 一个我不认识的人寄信给我 然后我打开了
sense_groups.english: Someone I don't know sent me an e-mail and I opened it.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么？你为何要打开？ - 那又没有写"这是病毒“!
sense_groups.english: Why? Why would you open it? - Well, it didn't say, "This is a virus."

sense_groups.chinese: 那上面写什么？ - "裸体的…"
sense_groups.english: What did it say? - "Nude..."

sense_groups.chinese: "安娜库妮可娃的照片"
sense_groups.english: "Pictures of Anna Kournikova."

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 - 那我怎么办？
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. - What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 我的演讲稿不见了 - 没有不见
sense_groups.english: My speech is gone! - It's not gone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我相信你有列印出来 你有印出来吧？
sense_groups.english: I'm sure you printed out a copy. You have a hard copy?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 我没有
sense_groups.english: No, I don't!

sense_groups.chinese: 那你现在一定很气自己
sense_groups.english: Well, you must be pretty mad at yourself right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的不见了吗？ - 不见了
sense_groups.english: It's really gone? - Yep.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想要谢谢你们来这里…
sense_groups.english: I'd like to thank you guys for coming down here...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱怨雨 而且毁了我的事业前途
sense_groups.english: to complain about the rain and ruin my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得非常抱歉 - 你是应该要抱歉
sense_groups.english: I just feel awful. - Yeah, you should.

sense_groups.chinese: 安娜库妮可娃的裸照？她根本什么大赛都没赢过
sense_groups.english: Nude pictures of Anna Kournikova? She's never even won a major tournament.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有试过比莉珍金 但是…
sense_groups.english: Well, I tried Billie Jean King, but...

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗？你跟摩妮卡 那种我要杀了你的表情一模一样
sense_groups.english: You know, you and Monica have the same I'm-gonna-kill-you look.

sense_groups.chinese: 我通常亲她一下 就可以逃过一劫
sense_groups.english: I can usually make it go away by kissing her.

sense_groups.chinese: 滚出去
sense_groups.english: Get out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我工作的电脑也常常发生这种事
sense_groups.english: You know, this happens all the time to my computer at work.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你怎么办？ - 我通常会…
sense_groups.english: What do you do? - I usually go...

sense_groups.chinese: 到别人的电脑上 玩俄罗斯方块
sense_groups.english: play Tetris on somebody else's computer.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信会发生这种事
sense_groups.english: I can't believe this is happening.

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天就要演讲了
sense_groups.english: I have to give the keynote speech tomorrow.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要站在所有人面前 我要说什么呢？
sense_groups.english: I have to stand up in front of all these people. What am I gonna say?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可以用我背下来 参加试镜的那段话
sense_groups.english: You can use a speech I memorized for auditions.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为你在《星际大战》里的独白 不会对我有帮助 乔伊
sense_groups.english: I don't think your monologue from Star Wars is gonna help me right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我们可以一起解决问题 我听过你的演讲
sense_groups.english: Ross, we can solve this. I just heard your speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以重建 我们有一整晚的时间
sense_groups.english: We can re-create it. We've got all night.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么？你真的认为我们办得到？
sense_groups.english: What, you really think we can do that?

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 乔伊跟我已经约好 一起去吃晚餐
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. Joey and I are supposed to have dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 别担心 我知道罗斯需要你
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about that. I mean, Ross needs you.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋跟我会留下来尽量帮忙
sense_groups.english: Rachel and I will stay and help any way we can.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们现在就开始
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay, let's do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道我们一开始 是讨论碳年代测定法的缺点
sense_groups.english: Well, I know we start by discussing the shortcomings of carbon dating.

sense_groups.chinese: 我接着解说 什么事件显然…
sense_groups.english: And then I move on to what is clearly the defining moment...

sense_groups.chinese: 是中生代的关键时刻 原始大陆的分裂 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: of the Mesozoic Era, the breakup of Pangaea. Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 再来是三叠纪的概观
sense_groups.english: And then there's the overview of the Triassic.

sense_groups.chinese: 这一切有没有可能 是在很遥远的银河系发生的？
sense_groups.english: Ooh, ooh. Any chance any of this happened in a galaxy far, far away?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂？ - 好了 麦克？
sense_groups.english: Hello? - Okay, Mike?

sense_groups.chinese: 闹够了 你爱菲比 而她也爱你
sense_groups.english: Enough is enough. You love Phoebe, and she loves you.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以不要再说什么 "我不想结婚"的话了
sense_groups.english: So get over your I-never-wanna-get-married thing...

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快站出来
sense_groups.english: and step up!

sense_groups.chinese: 你是谁？
sense_groups.english: Who is this?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是摩妮卡 菲比的朋友
sense_groups.english: This is Monica, Phoebe's friend.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 菲比跟大卫复合了
sense_groups.english: Listen. Phoebe is back with David.

sense_groups.chinese: 他即将要求婚 而她会答应
sense_groups.english: He's gonna propose, and she's gonna say yes...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我知道 她真正想要的是跟你在一起
sense_groups.english: but I know she really wants to be with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 他要求婚了？
sense_groups.english: He's gonna propose?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 你说什么？该死的头发遮住我听不到
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, did you say something? I can't hear through all this damned hair!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果菲比想要嫁给大卫 那就去吧
sense_groups.english: If Phoebe wants to marry David, she should.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会从中作梗 你也不应该
sense_groups.english: I'm not gonna stand in the way of that. Neither should you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用你来告诉我该怎么做 是我来告诉你怎么做
sense_groups.english: You don't tell me what to do. I tell you what to do.

sense_groups.chinese: 打电话给她 她在巴贝多的天堂饭店
sense_groups.english: Just call her. She's at the Paradise Hotel in Barbados.

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 你也有卷发
sense_groups.english: And while I've got you, you've got curly hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 在湿气重的地方你怎么办？
sense_groups.english: What do you do in the humidity?

sense_groups.chinese: 该死
sense_groups.english: Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 我希望你很快乐 - 我也希望你很快乐 老婆
sense_groups.english: Well, I hope you're happy. - Aw, I hope you're happy too, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比会答应大卫的求婚
sense_groups.english: Phoebe's going to say yes to David.

sense_groups.chinese: 这就是你爱管闲事的结果 - 菲比要答应？太棒了
sense_groups.english: That's what happens when you meddle. - Phoebe's gonna say yes? That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 一点也不棒 她还爱着麦克
sense_groups.english: No, it's not. She's still in love with Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不会有什么结果吗？ - 不会 我已经打过电话了
sense_groups.english: There's no chance that will work? - No, I called.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会有结果 - 鸡婆 鸡婆
sense_groups.english: It's not gonna happen. - Meddler! Meddler!

sense_groups.chinese: 如果不是你先多管闲事…
sense_groups.english: If you hadn't meddled to start with...

sense_groups.chinese: 我就不用插手进来管事了
sense_groups.english: then I wouldn't have had to go in and meddle myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管我们怎么插手 都没有办法补救…
sense_groups.english: No matter how much we meddle, we'll never be able to unmeddle...

sense_groups.chinese: 你一开始多管闲事惹出来的祸
sense_groups.english: the thing that you meddled up in the first place!

sense_groups.chinese: 这场假期真是烂
sense_groups.english: This vacation sucks!

sense_groups.chinese: 我好无聊 - 嗯
sense_groups.english: I'm so bored. - Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 该死的雨 我们什么事都做不了
sense_groups.english: Stupid rain. We can't do anything.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带了一些书来 我们可以看点书
sense_groups.english: Well, I brought some books. We could read.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 还没糟糕到那个地步
sense_groups.english: Hey, it hasn't come to that yet.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 等一下 不好意思
sense_groups.english: Hey, hey, hey, don't mind if I do.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 先生 这是给药学研讨会的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, sir, these are for the pharmaceutical convention.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你想要去参加研讨会吗？
sense_groups.english: You feel like going to a convention?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不行 我们不是药剂师 - 我知道我们不是…
sense_groups.english: We can't. We're not pharmacists. - I know we're not...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是法兰克马迭欧跟伊娃齐罗欧…
sense_groups.english: but Frank Madaio and Eva...

sense_groups.chinese: 凯特米勒 - 凯特米勒就对了
sense_groups.english: Kate Miller. - Kate Miller it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 喔 很好…
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Oh, good...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是这个周末 我最接近性爱的时刻了
sense_groups.english: And that's the most sex I'm gonna have this weekend.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果是这样 我应该要确定这黏得够牢罗？
sense_groups.english: Well, in that case, should I make sure it's on real good?

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你 - 不客气
sense_groups.english: Thank you. - you're welcome

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 然后你开始谈 将中生代世纪…
sense_groups.english: Oh, and then you said that thing about bringing the Mesozoic Era...

sense_groups.chinese: 带到二十一世纪
sense_groups.english: into the 21st century.

sense_groups.chinese: 对喔 就这样吗？
sense_groups.english: Well, yeah. That's it?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 - 天啊 我们办到了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Oh, my God. We did it.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上是我办到了 罗斯 演讲稿是你的 你记得的却少得惊人
sense_groups.english: Actually, I did it, Ross. You remembered shockingly little of your own speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 但是我用沐浴产品 做了个金字塔
sense_groups.english: Yes, but I did make a pyramid out of the bath products.

sense_groups.chinese: 真是佩服 谢谢你 真的很谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is amazing. Thank you. Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 这项链真漂亮
sense_groups.english: That's a pretty necklace.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们庆祝一下吧？要来点香槟吗？
sense_groups.english: Hey, what do you say we celebrate? Champagne?

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊 软木塞留着 我们可以把瓶子装满水…
sense_groups.english: Yeah! Save the cork, and that way, we can fill the bottle with water...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后再放回去 这样他们就不会收钱了
sense_groups.english: and put it back so they don't charge you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛这张照片真是可爱 而这是你儿子…
sense_groups.english: This is such a cute picture of Emma. And is this your son...

sense_groups.chinese: 还是某个你渡假时 会带在身上的小男孩照片？
sense_groups.english: or just some kid whose picture you bring on vacation?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是班 我第一次婚姻生的儿子
sense_groups.english: That's Ben, my son from my first marriage.

sense_groups.chinese: 你第一次婚姻？ - 是的
sense_groups.english: Your first marriage? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你结过不只一次婚吗？
sense_groups.english: You've been married more than once?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯
sense_groups.english: Mm.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你为什么离婚呢？
sense_groups.english: So why'd you break up?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗯 因为…
sense_groups.english: Oh, it was...

sense_groups.chinese: 很复杂 她是…
sense_groups.english: It's complicated, you know? She was, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋
sense_groups.english: guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 这实在太酷了
sense_groups.english: This is so cool!

sense_groups.chinese: 为这种事兴奋是很奇怪的事
sense_groups.english: Okay. Odd thing to get excited about.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是 只是我曾经订过婚 而那梱男的竟然是同志
sense_groups.english: No, it's just that I was engaged to a guy who turned out to be gay.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 击掌吧
sense_groups.english: Hey! High-five!

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得没有看出瑞倪 实在是很笨？
sense_groups.english: Didn't you feel so stupid that you didn't see the signs?

sense_groups.chinese: 我未婚夫总是跟 他的"网球球友"一起度周末
sense_groups.english: My fiancé was always going on long weekends with his "tennis partner."

sense_groups.chinese: 我老婆有一年跟一个朋友 天天都到健身房报到
sense_groups.english: My wife had a workout friend she went to the gym with every day for a year.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也没有变结实
sense_groups.english: She didn't get any fitter.

sense_groups.chinese: 每个人都说"我早就知道了" - 对嘛
sense_groups.english: Everybody's like, "I knew all along." - I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你们知道 怎么不告诉我？打个电话 留个字条什么的
sense_groups.english: If you knew, why didn't you tell me? I mean, call, leave a note.

sense_groups.chinese: "嗨 只是过来告诉你 你老婆是同性恋"
sense_groups.english: "Hi. Just dropped by to say your wife's gay."

sense_groups.chinese: 对嘛 - 然后…
sense_groups.english: I know. - And then...

sense_groups.chinese: 然后你试着把危机变转机…
sense_groups.english: And then you try to make the best of a bad situation...

sense_groups.chinese: 所以提出三人行的建议
sense_groups.english: so you float the idea of a threesome.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有那样做
sense_groups.english: I didn't do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也没有
sense_groups.english: Me neither.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁想得到药剂师们会这么好玩
sense_groups.english: Well, who knew? Pharmacists are fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 对啊 那位老太太 最后都已经准备要带你回家了
sense_groups.english: I know. That old lady at the end was ready to take you home.

sense_groups.chinese: 全世界的药都还不够 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Not enough pills in the world, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你呢？你才是单身的人 有没有看到喜欢的？
sense_groups.english: What about you, huh? You're the single one. See anybody in there you like?

sense_groups.chinese: 让我想想 那梱跟我 说过话的大个儿…
sense_groups.english: Well, let's see. There was that really big guy that I was talking to...

sense_groups.chinese: 他的胸部很不错
sense_groups.english: with the really nice breasts.

sense_groups.chinese: 那在家乡呢？
sense_groups.english: But what about back home?

sense_groups.chinese: 有什么吗？你有喜欢的人吗？
sense_groups.english: Anything going on there? Anybody you like?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 有的 你脸红了 - 没有 我才没有脸红
sense_groups.english: There is. You're blushing. - No, I'm not blushing...

sense_groups.chinese: 这是晒伤的…
sense_groups.english: and I'm sunburned.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为下雨的缘故
sense_groups.english: From, you know, the rain.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有喜欢的人 告诉我是谁
sense_groups.english: You like someone. Tell me who.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉我是谁 说啦 - 不 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Tell me who it is. Come on. - No. Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢谁啊？别想轻易躲掉
sense_groups.english: Who do you like? You're not getting away that easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你喜欢谁？ - 乔伊 别这样
sense_groups.english: Who do you like? - Joey, come on!

sense_groups.chinese: 没什么大不了的 你知道吗？又不是说会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: It doesn't matter, you know? It's not like anything's gonna happen.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？为什么不会？瑞秋 有谁是你得不到的？
sense_groups.english: What? Why not? Rach, who can you not get?

sense_groups.chinese: 好 你真想知道是谁吗？
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. You really want to know who it is?

sense_groups.chinese: 很想 是谁？ - 你真的想？
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Who is it? - Do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 对 - 嗨
sense_groups.english: Yeah. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 - 我才刚留言给你
sense_groups.english: Hey. - I just left you a message.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯跟我本来要去吃点东西…
sense_groups.english: Ross and I were gonna go grab a bite...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是既然你在这里 我们可以一起去吃晚餐了
sense_groups.english: but now that you're here, we could have that dinner.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 当然 演讲稿写完了吗？
sense_groups.english: Right! Of course. Hey, did you guys finish the speech?

sense_groups.chinese: 完成了 我们完成了 非常谢谢你
sense_groups.english: Yep! We got it. We got it. Thank you so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我做得很开心 - 是啊
sense_groups.english: I had a great time. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这还没完 因为我真的想知道…
sense_groups.english: This isn't over, because I really want to know...

sense_groups.chinese: 等一下 等一下
sense_groups.english: Later. Later.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我们走吧？ - 好的
sense_groups.english: So shall we? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 - 晚安
sense_groups.english: Okay. - Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 晚安 - 晚安 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay, good night. - Good night, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不敢相信她要答应
sense_groups.english: I can't believe she's gonna say yes to David.

sense_groups.chinese: 她显然还爱着麦克
sense_groups.english: She's clearly in love with Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这样子 实在很难把你的话当真
sense_groups.english: You know, it's very hard to take you seriously when you look like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我有一些话要说
sense_groups.english: Um... Phoebe, um, I have, uh, something I want to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 他要开口了 我看不下去 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, he's gonna do it. I cannot watch this. Let's go.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们还有时间 你有听过他说话吗？
sense_groups.english: I think we have time. Have you heard him talk?

sense_groups.chinese: "菲比 我将会很荣幸如果…" 说快点 大卫
sense_groups.english: "Uh, Phoebe, um, I would be honored if, uh, uh..." Spit it out, David!

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比…
sense_groups.english: Uh, Phoebe, um...

sense_groups.chinese: 你实在是太迷人了 我们分开的那段日子非常难熬
sense_groups.english: You're an amazing woman, and the time we spent apart was unbearable.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然明斯克卫生设施员工罢工 让情况更糟
sense_groups.english: Of course, the sanitation strikes in Minsk didn't help.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 好的 然后呢？
sense_groups.english: Sure. Okay. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是现在我们又在一起了 我再也不想跟你分开
sense_groups.english: But, um, well, now that we're together again, I don't ever want to be apart.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以…
sense_groups.english: So to that end...

sense_groups.chinese: 喔 我的天啊 麦克 - 事实上 我是大卫
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Mike. - It's David, actually.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克在这里 不
sense_groups.english: No, Mike's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克 嘿
sense_groups.english: Oh, hey, Mike.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 大卫
sense_groups.english: Hi, David.

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德 摩妮…哇
sense_groups.english: Chandler. Monic... Oh!

sense_groups.chinese: 是湿气
sense_groups.english: It's the humidity!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 菲比 - 你在这里做什么？
sense_groups.english: Hi, Phoebe. - What are you doing here?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有个问题一定要问你
sense_groups.english: I have a question I need to ask you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也有问题要问她
sense_groups.english: I have a question I was kind of gonna ask her myself.

sense_groups.chinese: 我了解 但是你问之前 她真的需要先听我说
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I understand, but before you do, she really needs to hear this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那我的座位你也想要坐喽？ - 噢 那就谢谢你了
sense_groups.english: Would you care for my seat as well? - Actually, yeah, that'd be great.

sense_groups.chinese: 很公平 你大老远赶来
sense_groups.english: Well, that's fair, you've had a long trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 我爱你
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, I love you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我过去这几个月非常想念你
sense_groups.english: I've missed you so much these last few months.

sense_groups.chinese: 我原本以为 导致我们分手的是个好理由
sense_groups.english: I thought we were apart for a good reason...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我发现 根本没有理由好到…
sense_groups.english: but I realized that there was no reason good enough...

sense_groups.chinese: 让我决定不和你共度下半辈子
sense_groups.english: to keep me from spending the rest of my life with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这有点毁了 我本来打算要说的话
sense_groups.english: Kind of steps on the toes of what I was going to say.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 大卫 但是她真的需要知道
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, David, but she really has to know this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 但是之后 我要在外面跟你单挑
sense_groups.english: All right, but after this, I want to see you outside.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果外面雨停了的话
sense_groups.english: If the rain stops.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我遇过最不可思议的女人
sense_groups.english: You're the most incredible woman I've ever met.

sense_groups.chinese: 我怎么能够失去你？我现在身上没有戒指
sense_groups.english: How could I lose you? Now, I don't actually have a ring.

sense_groups.chinese: 我有戒指 - 我不会在这时候炫耀 老兄
sense_groups.english: I have a ring. - I wouldn't brag about that, big guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 菲比…
sense_groups.english: But, Phoebe...

sense_groups.chinese: 你愿意嫁给我吗？
sense_groups.english: will you marry me?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 哈哈
sense_groups.english: Ha-ha.

sense_groups.chinese: 我爱你 但是我从来不需要你求婚
sense_groups.english: I love you, but I never needed a proposal from you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只需要知道 我们之间可以有发展
sense_groups.english: I just needed to know we were headed somewhere.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们是有未来的 - 我们可以有任何你想要的未来
sense_groups.english: That we had a future. - We can have any future you want.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我要走了
sense_groups.english: Okay, well, I'm gonna take off.

sense_groups.chinese: 大卫 我很抱歉 真对不起
sense_groups.english: David, I'm so sorry. I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我知道一下 如果我先问了…
sense_groups.english: Just so I know, if I had asked first?

sense_groups.chinese: 我有可能会答应 但那是不对的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I might have said yes, but that would've been wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不用解释 没关系
sense_groups.english: Please, you don't have to explain.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我当初没有去明斯克…
sense_groups.english: I mean, perhaps if I hadn't gone to Minsk...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们之间可能就没问题了 而我也不会毁了我的事业
sense_groups.english: things would have worked out for us, and I wouldn't have ruined my career.

sense_groups.chinese: 或是因冻疮而失去那只脚趾
sense_groups.english: Or lost that toe to frostbite.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是趟好旅程
sense_groups.english: It was a good trip.

sense_groups.chinese: 我现在可以拥抱你吗？ - 喔 可以
sense_groups.english: Is it okay if I hug you now? - Oh, yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是因为我们多管闲事 知道吗？
sense_groups.english: Because of our meddling! All right?

sense_groups.chinese: 很舒服吧？如此安静 我可以整天都躺在这里
sense_groups.english: Oh, isn't this nice? It's so quiet. I could just lie here all day.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 打开窗帘 打开窗帘 - 真高兴我们的房间是相通的
sense_groups.english: Open your drapes! Open your drapes! - So glad we got adjoining rooms.

sense_groups.chinese: 太阳出来了 - 嘿 记得我还有眼角膜的时候吗？
sense_groups.english: The sun is out! - Hey! Remember when I had corneas?

sense_groups.chinese: 赶快去游泳池占位子
sense_groups.english: Go to the pool and reserve chairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会拿杂志跟防晒乳液
sense_groups.english: I will get the magazines and the lotion.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯的演讲再四十五分钟就开始了
sense_groups.english: Ladies? Ross' speech is in 45 minutes.

sense_groups.chinese: 不会吧 - 该死
sense_groups.english: No! - Damn it!

sense_groups.chinese: 墙壁很薄的 你们这些人
sense_groups.english: Walls are pretty thin, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: "我们必须考量最近核磁共振与去气核醣核酸测试的资料…
sense_groups.english: "Then we have to weigh the data from recent MRI scans and DNA testing...

sense_groups.chinese: 对多年来通过碳年代测定 收集资料的方式形成了一些疑点
sense_groups.english: which call into question information gathered from years of carbon dating."

sense_groups.chinese: 瞧瞧那个坐在游泳池畔 晒太阳的女人
sense_groups.english: Look at the woman sitting out by the pool getting tan.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的皮都变粗生皱纹了 我真是嫉妒
sense_groups.english: She's all leathery and wrinkled. I'm so jealous!

sense_groups.chinese: 最后 再加上 最近发现的大量新物种
sense_groups.english: "Finally, factor in the profusion of new species recently discovered.

sense_groups.chinese: 巨兽龙
sense_groups.english: Giganotosaurus.

sense_groups.chinese: 阿根廷龙 - 更不用提冷龙(音似唇泡疹)
sense_groups.english: Argentinosaurus." - Not to mention Coldsaurus.

sense_groups.chinese: "而这些只是草食性的 我还没有要提到肉食性··
sense_groups.english: "And that's just the herbivores. I'm not even gonna discuss the carnivores.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们都已经有大头症了
sense_groups.english: Their heads are already too big.

sense_groups.chinese: 蛮讽刺的 因为他们大脑发育不良"
sense_groups.english: Which is ironic, considering their stunted cerebral development."

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗？
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: "但是撇开玩笑不谈 这近似于…
sense_groups.english: "But all kidding aside, in much the same way...

sense_groups.chinese: 匠人现在被认为 与直立人(音近勃起)不同种"
sense_groups.english: that Homo ergaster is thought to be a separate species from Homo erectus..."

sense_groups.chinese: 什么？ - 他说"直立人"
sense_groups.english: What? - He said "erectus."

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗？ - 不 他是真的那样说
sense_groups.english: You're kidding, right? - No, he really said it.

sense_groups.chinese: "虽然介于这些中生代化石…
sense_groups.english: "And while there are certainly vast differences...

sense_groups.chinese: 跟直立人例子之间 有许多巨大的差异"
sense_groups.english: between these Mesozoic fossils and the example of Homo erectus..."

sense_groups.chinese: 勃起？
sense_groups.english: Erectus?

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋 - 没错
sense_groups.english: Homo. - Right.

sense_groups.chinese: "以非常逼真的方式 我们可以将中生代时期带到二十一世纪"
sense_groups.english: "In a very real way, we can bring the Mesozoic Era into the 21 st century."

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢大家
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的很棒 - 谢谢你们
sense_groups.english: Really great. - Thanks, guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我认为那很精采
sense_groups.english: I thought it was wonderful.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是康乃尔大学的 杰维斯欧伯劳
sense_groups.english: Jarvis Oberblau. Cornell.

sense_groups.chinese: 你突显出来的议题 尤其是你这样年轻而且…
sense_groups.english: I mean, the ideas you put forth, and from someone so young and...

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们只是握着手
sense_groups.english: Okay, now we're just holding hands.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 我们要去海滩了 演讲真的很棒
sense_groups.english: Alrighty. We're gonna hit the beach. That was really great.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 - 是啊 而且很好笑
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you. - Yeah. Oh, and so funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 别太累 - 好的 谢谢 非常谢谢
sense_groups.english: Take it easy. - All right, thanks. Thanks so much.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法形容 你们在这里对我的意义有多重大
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how much it means that you were here.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在开玩笑吗？我们不可能会错过的
sense_groups.english: You kidding? We wouldn't have missed it.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 我回来了
sense_groups.english: I'm back.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 失陪一下
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么样？ - 你真是了不起
sense_groups.english: Well? - You were incredible.

sense_groups.chinese: 你完全迷住他们了
sense_groups.english: You blew them away.

sense_groups.chinese: 我无法形容 在人群中看到你的脸感觉有多棒
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how great it was to look in the crowd and see your face.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道你嘴巴在跟着我念吗？
sense_groups.english: I mean, did you know you were mouthing the words along with me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我才没有 - 不 没关系
sense_groups.english: I was not. - No, it's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 那让我自觉像个摇滚巨星
sense_groups.english: It made me feel like a rock star.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 我居然是个追星大粉丝
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I'm your groupie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最好不要脱光光 躲在我的房间里喔
sense_groups.english: Hey, I better not find you naked in my hotel room.

sense_groups.chinese: 哎呀 我扯太远了
sense_groups.english: Look, I took it too far.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信又在下雨了 真是不公平
sense_groups.english: I can't believe it's raining again. It's so unfair.

sense_groups.chinese: 往好处想就是我们不用看到…
sense_groups.english: Well, on the bright side, now we won't have to see...

sense_groups.chinese: 那些古生物学家脱掉上衣
sense_groups.english: all these paleontologists with their shirts off.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是你们
sense_groups.english: Not you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们还不错
sense_groups.english: You've got it going on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今天要做什么？ - 他们楼下有游戏间
sense_groups.english: What will we do today? - They have a game room downstairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 有兵乓球和其他的东西
sense_groups.english: They have Ping-Pong and stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 乒乓球？亲爱的 他们有乒乓球耶
sense_groups.english: Ping-Pong? Honey, they have Ping-Pong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来玩 - 我不要
sense_groups.english: Let's play. - I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么不要？ - 你知道你得失心很重
sense_groups.english: Why not? - You know how competitive you get.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以说那样很可爱 但别人都不同意 而且我是在说谎
sense_groups.english: And while I say it's cute, others disagree, and I'm lying.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又不是- 直都那样糟糕 - 是吗？
sense_groups.english: I'm not always that bad. - Oh, yeah?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们上次玩的时候 发生什么事？
sense_groups.english: What happened when we played last time?

sense_groups.chinese: 我揍了你
sense_groups.english: I punched you.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有呢？ - 还有菲比
sense_groups.english: And? - Phoebe.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有呢？ - 我把你们的头撞在一起
sense_groups.english: And? - I clunked your heads together.

sense_groups.chinese: 你在这里 - 嘿 听着
sense_groups.english: There you are. - Hey. Listen.

sense_groups.chinese: 只要雨一停 我们一定要去浮潜
sense_groups.english: As soon as it stops raining, we have got to go snorkeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 有个小孩告诉我有海龟 如果你对着他的脸吹泡泡…
sense_groups.english: Some kid told me about this sea turtle. If you blow bubbles in his face...

sense_groups.chinese: 他会追着你跑喔
sense_groups.english: he chases you.

sense_groups.chinese: 很抱歉 我不能去 我整个下午都要主持小组讨论
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, I can't. I'm running a discussion group all afternoon.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢
sense_groups.english: Oh.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系 我找别人去好了
sense_groups.english: That's okay. I'll find someone else to do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是可以一个人去 但是…
sense_groups.english: I'd do it alone, but, uh...

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道海龟 如果抓到我会发生什么事
sense_groups.english: I don't know what happens if the sea turtle catches you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得很不好意思
sense_groups.english: You know, I feel so bad.

sense_groups.chinese: 我整趟旅途都没有跟你在一起 尤其是昨晚…
sense_groups.english: I haven't seen you this whole trip. Especially last night...

sense_groups.chinese: 不用担心 没关系 我跟瑞秋玩得很开心
sense_groups.english: Don't worry about it. It was fine. I had the best time with Rachel.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是为你难过 跟罗斯关在房间里赶演讲稿
sense_groups.english: I just felt bad for you, stuck in that room working on Ross' speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 事实上 结果还蛮好玩的
sense_groups.english: Actually, it turned out to be a lot of fun.

sense_groups.chinese: 那至少我们都过得很愉快 不是吗？
sense_groups.english: Oh, well, at least we're both having fun, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不在一起却很快乐 很怪吧？ - 是啊
sense_groups.english: Is it weird that it's not with each other? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 有一点 是啊
sense_groups.english: A little bit, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们需要谈谈
sense_groups.english: I think we need to talk.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我想我们是需要
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I think we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 谈什么呢？
sense_groups.english: About what?

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 会很好玩的啦 - 好吧
sense_groups.english: Come on, you guys, it'll be fun! - All right.

sense_groups.chinese: 不计分我才要玩 - 那我们怎么知道谁赢呢？
sense_groups.english: I'll play if we don't keep score. - Well, then how do we know who wins?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有人会赢 - 所以我们是四个输家 太好了
sense_groups.english: Nobody wins. - So we're just four losers. Super.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不要跟她玩 - 我不玩了
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm not playing with her. - I'm out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我跟你玩 - 好的
sense_groups.english: I'll play you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 麦克 你不知道你在做什么 - 她会很疯狂的
sense_groups.english: You don't know what you're doing. - She gets crazy.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个疤痕是从画图猜字游戏来的
sense_groups.english: This scar? That's from Pictionary.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我会没事的
sense_groups.english: I think I'll be all right.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想要先热身一下吗？ - 当然 如果你想要的话
sense_groups.english: You want to volley a bit for serve? - Sure, if you want to.

sense_groups.chinese: 嚯
sense_groups.english: Ho!

sense_groups.chinese: 对了 我很厉害
sense_groups.english: Oh, by the way, I'm awesome.

sense_groups.chinese: 天哪 这两个人一模一样
sense_groups.english: Oh, dear God, there's two of them.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备好要上场了吗？ - 当然
sense_groups.english: You ready to play? - Hell, yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你有看过他这一面吗？ - 没有 我以为他跟你一样软弱
sense_groups.english: Did you know this about him? - No idea. I thought he was soft like you.

sense_groups.chinese: 想要更刺激点吗？ - 你想赌多少？
sense_groups.english: Want to make it more interesting? - How much you thinking?

sense_groups.chinese: 十块钱一局？ - 加到五十块钱好了
sense_groups.english: Ten bucks a game? - Make it 50.

sense_groups.chinese: 我加到一百块钱 －一千…
sense_groups.english: I'll make it 100. - One thousand...

sense_groups.chinese: 好了
sense_groups.english: Okay!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们掷铜板来决定谁先开球 你有铜板吗？
sense_groups.english: We'll flip to see who goes first. You got a quarter?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 你们两个女生谁有铜板？
sense_groups.english: No. Either of you girls got a quarter?

sense_groups.chinese: 亲爱的 这种骂人的话 都用到他身上
sense_groups.english: Honey, try to focus the trash talk on him.

sense_groups.chinese: 摩妮卡 你来猜 - 正面 不 背面 正面
sense_groups.english: Monica, you call it. - Heads. No, tails! Heads!

sense_groups.chinese: 背面 - 机率有这样低吗？
sense_groups.english: Tails. - Oh, what are the chances?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得分 - 不 我可不这么认为
sense_groups.english: Hah! My point! - Oh, no, I don't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 根据桌球标准规则 若参赛者 在任何时间将没握球拍的手…
sense_groups.english: Standard rules: If at any time a player uses his nonracket-bearing hand...

sense_groups.chinese: 碰触到球桌表面 得分不算
sense_groups.english: to touch the playing surface, he or she forfeits the point.

sense_groups.chinese: 他曾经是律师
sense_groups.english: He was a lawyer.

sense_groups.chinese: 东岸的天气十分良好
sense_groups.english: All the East Coast is having beautiful weather.

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约摄氏二十二度 而且阳光普照
sense_groups.english: In New York, it's 72 and sunny.

sense_groups.chinese: 气象婊子
sense_groups.english: Oh. Weather bitch.

sense_groups.chinese: 门没锁

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 -我们成室友了
sense_groups.english: What? - We're gonna be roomies!

sense_groups.chinese: 来
sense_groups.english: Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你睡在外面 -是啊
sense_groups.english: You slept out here? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 她梦中总踢我
sense_groups.english: Amy kept kicking me in her sleep,

sense_groups.chinese: 还嚷嚷 米伦 滚出去
sense_groups.english: yelling, "Myron, get off!"

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会把她赶走对吧
sense_groups.english: But we're getting rid of her, right?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 答应我 赶走她
sense_groups.english: Rachel,please tell me we're getting rid of her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我下不了手 乔伊 -噢 不会吧
sense_groups.english: Joey, I can't do that. - Oh, come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨晚我正在干光一个披萨
sense_groups.english: Last night I was finishing off a pizza,

sense_groups.chinese: 她就说
sense_groups.english: and she said

sense_groups.chinese: 嘴巴爽一秒 屁股胖一生
sense_groups.english: "A moment on the lips, forever on the hips."

sense_groups.chinese: 在我家不需要这种屁话
sense_groups.english: I don't need that kind of talk in my house!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我知道她难相处
sense_groups.english: Joey, look, I know that she's difficult...

sense_groups.chinese: 但她来这里也不错
sense_groups.english: ...but I think it's really good that she's here.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样她滚蛋后我们才能更欢喜
sense_groups.english: Because we'll appreciate it more when she's gone?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 只是 我刚来这城市的时候
sense_groups.english: No, it's just-- Look, when I first moved to this city,

sense_groups.chinese: 还不是一样
sense_groups.english: I was a lot like her.

sense_groups.chinese: 被惯坏 自我中心
sense_groups.english: I was spoiled, self-centered.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们几个却照顾我
sense_groups.english: And you guys really took care of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 莫妮卡强迫我们来着
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Monica made us.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管怎样我都很感激
sense_groups.english: Well, whatever. I really appreciate it...

sense_groups.chinese: 如果没有你们
sense_groups.english: ...because I don't think I would be the person I am today...

sense_groups.chinese: 也就没有现在的我
sense_groups.english: ...if it wasn't for you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想帮帮艾米
sense_groups.english: So I want to help Amy

sense_groups.chinese: 就像你们帮我那样
sense_groups.english: the way you guys helped me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道这需要极大的耐性
sense_groups.english: And I know it's gonna take patience,

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以
sense_groups.english: but that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 早 -早
sense_groups.english: Good morning. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 艾米 那是我今天要穿的衣服
sense_groups.english: That's what I'm wearing today.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我才挂在门上
sense_groups.english: That's why I hung it on the door.

sense_groups.chinese: 宝贝 你总不能给我扒下来
sense_groups.english: Oh, sweetie, you can't pull this off.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我们也许应当坐下来
sense_groups.english: I was thinking that maybe now would be a good time...

sense_groups.chinese: 好好谈谈你的将来
sense_groups.english: ...for us to sit down and, you know, talk about your future.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没空
sense_groups.english: Oh, I can't, honey.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要去修眉
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna go get my eyebrows shaped.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样的眉毛像哭丧着脸
sense_groups.english: I am not happy.

sense_groups.chinese: 你确定要吃吗
sense_groups.english: Sure you want to eat that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不就是丰满点吗 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: I'm curvy and I like it!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 -嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 最烂的周年庆
sense_groups.english: I just had the worst anniversary ever.

sense_groups.chinese: 才不是呢
sense_groups.english: I doubt that.

sense_groups.chinese: 给她讲讲我们去年怎么过的周年
sense_groups.english: Tell her about us last year.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给钱德勒买了一只500块的表
sense_groups.english: Well, I bought Chandler a $500 watch,

sense_groups.chinese: 而他 给我写了首饶舌歌
sense_groups.english: and he wrote me a rap song.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 -用的办公软件
sense_groups.english: Seriously? - Word.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的比你还逊
sense_groups.english: Mine was worse than that.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么啦
sense_groups.english: Well, what happened?

sense_groups.chinese: 球赛时
sense_groups.english: We were at the game.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人在大屏幕上求婚
sense_groups.english: This guy proposed to his girlfriend on the big screen thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 老套
sense_groups.english: That is so tacky.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也是那么说
sense_groups.english: Well, that's what I said.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果呢 原来迈克昨晚上就想用
sense_groups.english: But it turns out Mike was planning on

sense_groups.chinese: 这种方式向我求婚
sense_groups.english: proposing to me the same way last night.

sense_groups.chinese: 天 迈克要求婚
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Mike was gonna propose?

sense_groups.chinese: 大件事
sense_groups.english: That's huge.

sense_groups.chinese: 你想嫁他吗
sense_groups.english: Do you want to marry him?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然想啦
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I really do. Yes.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果我那句话把他堵回去了
sense_groups.english: But after I dumped on the way he was gonna do it...

sense_groups.chinese: 我想他一辈子都不会求婚了
sense_groups.english: ...l don't think he'll ever ask again.

sense_groups.chinese: 在巴贝多斯我拒绝过他一次了 现在又一次
sense_groups.english: I said no in Barbados, and now this?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 如果我是男人
sense_groups.english: She's right. If I were a guy and....

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才是不是说 如果我是男人
sense_groups.english: Did I just say, "lf I were a guy"?

sense_groups.chinese: 别等他求婚了
sense_groups.english: You don't need him to propose to you.

sense_groups.chinese: 主动出击吧
sense_groups.english: Maybe you could propose to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 不知道
sense_groups.english: Oh, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 我又不是想嫁想疯了
sense_groups.english: I don't know. Isn't that a little desperate?

sense_groups.chinese: 我向钱德勒求的婚
sense_groups.english: I proposed to Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 继续讲
sense_groups.english: All right, moving on.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不觉得你想嫁想疯了
sense_groups.english: I don't think it was desperate.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得你很棒
sense_groups.english: It was amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们都认为我该求婚
sense_groups.english: Well, do you think I should propose?

sense_groups.chinese: 那一定很棒
sense_groups.english: I think it could be kind of great.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 世上再没有比求婚
sense_groups.english: You'll love the feeling.

sense_groups.chinese: 更美妙的感觉了
sense_groups.english: There's nothing like it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 那么以何种方式呢
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. So how should I do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 就在球赛的大屏幕上啊
sense_groups.english: How about at a game on the big screen?

sense_groups.chinese: 那去体育用品专卖店吧
sense_groups.english: How about at a Foot Locker?

sense_groups.chinese: 他既然选择过大屏幕求婚
sense_groups.english: What? What, he obviously thinks

sense_groups.chinese: 可见他能接受这种方式
sense_groups.english: that's a nice way to be proposed to.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且他也不会起疑心
sense_groups.english: Plus, he'd never suspect it.

sense_groups.chinese: 有理
sense_groups.english: Yeah, that does make sense.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们会喜欢吗
sense_groups.english: Okay, now, would you two like that?

sense_groups.chinese: 我喜欢
sense_groups.english: Sounds good to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过男性会怎么想
sense_groups.english: But what would a guy think?

sense_groups.chinese: 奶奶电话 -哇
sense_groups.english: Nana's on the phone. - Wow.

sense_groups.chinese: 有趣
sense_groups.english: That's interesting,

sense_groups.chinese: 她七年前就死了
sense_groups.english: since she died seven years ago.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗
sense_groups.english: She did?

sense_groups.chinese: 那她在博卡的房子归谁了
sense_groups.english: Who got her condo in Boca?

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我们的保姆
sense_groups.english: It's our nanny.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 希望你早点康复 再见
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, I hope you feel better. Okay. Bye.

sense_groups.chinese: 是莫利 她病了
sense_groups.english: That's Molly. She's sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天你看艾玛可以吗
sense_groups.english: Can you watch Emma today?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我要连堂上课
sense_groups.english: I can't. I have back-to-back classes.

sense_groups.chinese: 莫利说她生什么病
sense_groups.english: Did Molly say what she had?

sense_groups.chinese: 我的喉咙也不舒服
sense_groups.english: Because my throat's been hurting.

sense_groups.chinese: 痛经
sense_groups.english: Menstrual cramps.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可能不是这毛病
sense_groups.english: I don't think that's what this is.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们帮忙看着艾玛成吗
sense_groups.english: Can any of you watch Emma?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: No, I'm sorry, sweetie.

sense_groups.chinese: 我要上班 还要求婚
sense_groups.english: No, I've got work, and then I'm proposing.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 那怎么办
sense_groups.english: Great. Shoot. What am I gonna do?

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以帮忙
sense_groups.english: Well, I could do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 实际上...
sense_groups.english: Well, actually....

sense_groups.chinese: 能跟你说句话吗
sense_groups.english: Can I talk to you for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想让她看我们的孩子
sense_groups.english: I do not want her babysitting our child.

sense_groups.chinese: 为啥
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 首先 她老是把我们的孩子喊成"艾拉"
sense_groups.english: For one thing, she keeps calling her Ella.

sense_groups.chinese: 这名字也不错嘛
sense_groups.english: Ella's a nice name.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 下一胎叫"艾拉"
sense_groups.english: Fine, we'll call the next one Ella.

sense_groups.chinese: 下一胎 -好
sense_groups.english: The next one? - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不赞成她帮我们看孩子
sense_groups.english: I don't want her watching our baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是想改造她
sense_groups.english: Ross, I am trying to help her become a better person.

sense_groups.chinese: 这是个好机会
sense_groups.english: This is a huge breakthrough for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她刚刚主动要求
sense_groups.english: She just offered to do something

sense_groups.chinese: 帮助别的人类了
sense_groups.english: for another human being.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不确定
sense_groups.english: You know, I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我是说
sense_groups.english: Ross, I'm telling you...

sense_groups.chinese: 她宁愿牺牲修眉的时间看孩子
sense_groups.english: ...she's giving up getting her eyebrows shaped to do this, all right?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道这件事
sense_groups.english: Do you understand

sense_groups.chinese: 对我们女人来说牺牲多重大吗
sense_groups.english: how important that is in our world?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不小心听到你们的谈话
sense_groups.english: Listen, I couldn't help but overhear,

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我想听
sense_groups.english: because I was trying to.

sense_groups.chinese: 就让我带孩子吧
sense_groups.english: Listen, let me do this.

sense_groups.chinese: 我真心想帮你们
sense_groups.english: I really want to help you guys out.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且 瑞秋对我太好了
sense_groups.english: And plus, Rachel's been so wonderful to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 -太好了
sense_groups.english: Absolutely. - Oh, great!

sense_groups.chinese: 付多少工钱
sense_groups.english: So how much does it pay?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hi,Joe.

sense_groups.chinese: 二稿如何
sense_groups.english: How's the second draft of the letter coming?

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 我已经写完了
sense_groups.english: Great. I'm finished.

sense_groups.chinese: 实际上 我已经交了
sense_groups.english: In fact, I just dropped it off at the agency.

sense_groups.chinese: 交了 -是啊
sense_groups.english: You dropped it off? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能读读吗
sense_groups.english: Can we read it?

sense_groups.chinese: 能再打印一份给我们吗
sense_groups.english: Can you print out another copy?

sense_groups.chinese: 恐怕不行啊 朋友
sense_groups.english: No can do, amigo.

sense_groups.chinese: 没用电脑
sense_groups.english: No, I didn't use the computer.

sense_groups.chinese: 手写的 显得更亲切
sense_groups.english: It felt more personal to handwrite it.

sense_groups.chinese: 还手写 -别担心
sense_groups.english: You handwrote it? - Yeah, and don't worry.

sense_groups.chinese: 我根本没有装聪明
sense_groups.english: I didn't try to sound smart at all.

sense_groups.chinese: 再见
sense_groups.english: See you later.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天 我的天
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 那信会放入我们的档案里
sense_groups.english: That letter is gonna go in our file.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们这辈子别想有孩子了
sense_groups.english: We're never gonna get a kid.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会孤独终老
sense_groups.english: We're gonna be one of those old couples...

sense_groups.chinese: 养花弄鸟
sense_groups.english: ...that collects orchids or has a lot of birds.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事的
sense_groups.english: It's okay. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我打电话给领养中心
sense_groups.english: I will just call the agency

sense_groups.chinese: 请他们扔掉那封信
sense_groups.english: and tell them to throw out the letter.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 喂 我是钱德勒·宾
sense_groups.english: Hello, this is Chandler Bing.

sense_groups.chinese: 有人手写了
sense_groups.english: Someone just dropped off

sense_groups.chinese: 一封推荐信
sense_groups.english: a handwritten recommendation letter and....

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢 再见
sense_groups.english: Thank you. Goodbye.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们完蛋了 是不是
sense_groups.english: We're screwed, aren't we?

sense_groups.chinese: 这样吧
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 买鸟的路上说给我听
sense_groups.english: Just tell me on the way to the bird store.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们喜欢那封信 -什么
sense_groups.english: They loved it. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他们说我们很聪明
sense_groups.english: They thought it was very smart of us

sense_groups.chinese: 叫个小孩写推荐信
sense_groups.english: to have a child write the letter.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们以为乔伊是小孩
sense_groups.english: They thought Joey was a child?

sense_groups.chinese: 她看了他的画 以为他只八九岁
sense_groups.english: She guessed 8, 9, based on his drawings.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 -嗨 你们今天干嘛了
sense_groups.english: Hi. - Hey, what'd you guys do today?

sense_groups.chinese: 艾拉想上街
sense_groups.english: Ella wanted to go out,

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们去购物 还吃了寿司
sense_groups.english: so we went shopping and got some sushi.

sense_groups.chinese: 有趣 -也不是啦
sense_groups.english: That sounds like fun. - Yeah, not really.

sense_groups.chinese: 婴儿都好无趣
sense_groups.english: Babies are dull.

sense_groups.chinese: 我家小妹妹怎样了 -我很好
sense_groups.english: Hey. Hi, how's my girl? - I'm fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我准备送你礼物
sense_groups.english: And I got you a present

sense_groups.chinese: 来谢谢你留我住
sense_groups.english: for letting me stay with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 准备好了 -嗯
sense_groups.english: Ready? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 你给她穿了耳洞
sense_groups.english: You pierced her ears?

sense_groups.chinese: 她的鼻子看来小点了吗
sense_groups.english: Doesn't it make her nose look smaller?

sense_groups.chinese: 你给她穿了耳洞
sense_groups.english: You pierced her ears?

sense_groups.chinese: 竟然不征求我同意
sense_groups.english: How could you do this without telling me?

sense_groups.chinese: 我若先告诉你
sense_groups.english: If I had told you,

sense_groups.chinese: 就不是惊喜了
sense_groups.english: then it wouldn't have been a surprise, now would it?

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得她看来很可爱
sense_groups.english: I think she looks cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我错了
sense_groups.english: But I am wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 罗斯来了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. Oh, my God. Here comes Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯会发飚的
sense_groups.english: He's gonna flip out.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 他卖三明治的推车
sense_groups.english: Why, did something happen

sense_groups.chinese: 让城管收了吗
sense_groups.english: to his falafel cart?

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 各位 -罗斯
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Ross!

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 艾玛
sense_groups.english: Hi, Emma.

sense_groups.chinese: 她的帽子干嘛压这么低
sense_groups.english: Why is she wearing her hat so low?

sense_groups.chinese: 她都看不见了
sense_groups.english: She can barely see.

sense_groups.chinese: 人家不想她看见嘛
sense_groups.english: I don't really want her to see.

sense_groups.chinese: 为啥
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 世界太可怕
sense_groups.english: Because there are so many terrible sights in this world.

sense_groups.chinese: 有战争 还有乔伊冰箱里那玩意儿
sense_groups.english: Like war. Or that thing in Joey's refrigerator. Remember?

sense_groups.chinese: 一只牛奶盒 但看来像块肉
sense_groups.english: It was in a milk carton, but it looked like meat?

sense_groups.chinese: 快来
sense_groups.english: Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 看她多乖
sense_groups.english: There she is. Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么啦 -没啥
sense_groups.english: What? - Nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What--?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是夹上去的吧
sense_groups.english: Please tell me those are clip-ons!

sense_groups.chinese: 是扎的耳洞
sense_groups.english: Oh, they're real.

sense_groups.chinese: 是她干的
sense_groups.english: Did she do this to her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我早说过
sense_groups.english: I told you

sense_groups.chinese: 不能把艾玛交到她手上
sense_groups.english: we shouldn't have left Emma with her!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道了 你说得对
sense_groups.english: I know, I know. And you were right, Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 你太不负责
sense_groups.english: Okay? You are so irresponsible!

sense_groups.chinese: 绝不再让你看孩子
sense_groups.english: I am never letting you babysit again!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们知道吗 她需要我
sense_groups.english: You know what? This kid needs me, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 她需要一个又酷又有趣的阿姨
sense_groups.english: She needs to have a cool, fun aunt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是
sense_groups.english: I'm a cool, fun aunt.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 莫妮本来就是又酷又有趣
sense_groups.english: Hey! Monica can be cool and fun

sense_groups.chinese: 而且有条有理
sense_groups.english: at organized indoor projects.
