sense_groups.english: The part's a stuffy college professor.

sense_groups.chinese: 也可以啊
sense_groups.english: I can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你好 我是你们的教授
sense_groups.english: Hello, I'm your professor.

sense_groups.chinese: 当我停下来没想重要事情的时候...
sense_groups.english: When I'm not busy thinking of important things,

sense_groups.chinese: 或者没在教授的时候...
sense_groups.english: or professing...

sense_groups.chinese: 我会用... 噢 是什么产品
sense_groups.english: ...l like to use-- What's the product?

sense_groups.chinese: 电子商务网络解决方案
sense_groups.english: Software that facilitates inter-business networking e-solutions.

sense_groups.chinese: 我很冷
sense_groups.english: I'm cold.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 -嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 猜猜谁有可能得到
sense_groups.english: Guess who's a finalist

sense_groups.chinese: 一笔庞大的科研补助金
sense_groups.english: for a huge research grant?

sense_groups.chinese: 给你个提示
sense_groups.english: I'll give you a hint.

sense_groups.chinese: 他正在看着你
sense_groups.english: He's looking right at you.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你说的是
sense_groups.english: Well, unless it's the creepy guy

sense_groups.chinese: 那个把手伸入他裙子的怪人
sense_groups.english: with his hand up his kilt...

sense_groups.chinese: 我要说 恭喜你
sense_groups.english: ...I'm gonna say, "Congratulations."

sense_groups.chinese: 我实在是太兴奋了
sense_groups.english: I'm so excited.

sense_groups.chinese: 我击败了其他的几百个竞争者
sense_groups.english: Apparently, I beat out hundreds of other applicants...

sense_groups.chinese: 包括我上研究生时的五个同学
sense_groups.english: ...including five guys I went to graduate school with.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是我吹嘘 但...五个人
sense_groups.english: Not that I'm keeping score, or anything. Five.

sense_groups.chinese: 哇 太厉害了 -是啊
sense_groups.english: Wow, that's great. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那个是什么补助金
sense_groups.english: So tell me about the grant.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是两万五千元的资金
sense_groups.english: Well, okay, it's for $25,000.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我得到了
sense_groups.english: And if I get it,

sense_groups.chinese: 那我就可以完成我那领域的研究了
sense_groups.english: I'll be able to complete my field research.

sense_groups.chinese: 然后我就可以在《古生物学刊》里
sense_groups.english: And there will be an article about me

sense_groups.chinese: 发表我的论文了
sense_groups.english: in the Paleontology Review.

sense_groups.chinese: 那将会是我头一次在那本书上发表论文
sense_groups.english: It'll be the first time my name is in there...

sense_groups.chinese: 而其他人就不会怀疑我的研究了
sense_groups.english: ...without people raising serious questions about my work.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 你是说杜瓦补助金
sense_groups.english: Are you talking about the Dewer Grant?

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 怎么了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Why?

sense_groups.chinese: 本杰明·哈伯特管理着那个补助金
sense_groups.english: Benjamin Hobart is administering that grant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的前任男朋友 -对
sense_groups.english: Your ex-boyfriend? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么说 你的前男友决定了
sense_groups.english: So your ex-boyfriend is gonna determine

sense_groups.chinese: 你现任男友是否能得到那笔钱
sense_groups.english: if your new boyfriend gets this grant?

sense_groups.chinese: 你的现任男友完蛋了
sense_groups.english: Wow, your new boyfriend is screwed.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 我们很愉快地分手
sense_groups.english: No. No, we ended on great terms.

sense_groups.chinese: 我意思是 如果对此事有影响的话
sense_groups.english: I mean if anything,

sense_groups.chinese: 那也肯定是帮助你的
sense_groups.english: I think this could help you. You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以把他约出来吃个饭啊
sense_groups.english: Why don't we all go out to dinner,

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以把你介绍给他
sense_groups.english: and I can introduce you.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 你觉得有帮助吗
sense_groups.english: If you think it'd help.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然啦 我给他打电话啦
sense_groups.english: Yeah, absolutely. I'll call him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以做什么去...迎合他啊
sense_groups.english: Now, is there anything I could do to butter him up?

sense_groups.chinese: 他有什么嗜好
sense_groups.english: Anything he really likes?

sense_groups.chinese: 他确实有严重的乳胶恋物情结
sense_groups.english: He does have a pretty serious latex fetish.

sense_groups.chinese: 还是看看晚饭会怎么样吧
sense_groups.english: We'll see how dinner goes.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 -嘿 想去看电影吗
sense_groups.english: Hey. - Hey, you want to go see a movie?

sense_groups.chinese: 我已经告诉过你我今天一整天要打扫
sense_groups.english: I told you I had to spend all day clearing out stuff

sense_groups.chinese: 好让迈克搬进来住
sense_groups.english: so Mike could move in.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 对哦 -没错.
sense_groups.english: Oh, right. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 既然我都来了
sense_groups.english: Now that I'm here,

sense_groups.chinese: 我就帮你清洁和收拾一下吧
sense_groups.english: I might as well help with the cleaning and organizing.

sense_groups.chinese: 刚好我还带了打标签机
sense_groups.english: I just happen to have my label maker.

sense_groups.chinese: 要丢弃自己的物品太难了
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's so hard to get rid of stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和钱德勒要同居的时候
sense_groups.english: Did you and Chandler make compromises

sense_groups.chinese: 有为丢弃东西妥协过吗
sense_groups.english: when you moved in together?

sense_groups.chinese: 钱德勒有
sense_groups.english: Chandler did.

sense_groups.chinese: 他想你丢弃什么
sense_groups.english: What does he want you to give up?

sense_groups.chinese: 很多东西啊
sense_groups.english: A bunch of stuff.

sense_groups.chinese: 我最舍不得的是...
sense_groups.english: And the worst one,

sense_groups.chinese: 他要我丢掉格拉达斯
sense_groups.english: he wants me to get rid of Gladys.

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是格拉达斯
sense_groups.english: Who's Gladys?

sense_groups.chinese: 多么可怕的损失
sense_groups.english: What a tragic loss.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是说 我真的不想放弃她啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I really hate to give her up.

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 我想到了 你可以带她走啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, I know. Oh, you should take her.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样...不好吧...
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 为什么 你不喜欢她吗
sense_groups.english: What, you don't like her?

sense_groups.chinese: 我当然喜欢她啊 有什么好不喜欢的呢
sense_groups.english: Of course I do. What's not to like?

sense_groups.chinese: 我恨不得马上就把她拿走
sense_groups.english: I'd take her in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我觉得你现在说放弃太早了
sense_groups.english: But I think that you're giving up too easy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想你应该为她而斗争
sense_groups.english: Honey, I think that you need to fight for her.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 你这么觉得 -当然啦
sense_groups.english: Really, you think? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 你对他说
sense_groups.english: You say to him,

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 迈克 没有她我就活不了
sense_groups.english: "I'm sorry, Mike, I can't live without her.

sense_groups.chinese: 她对我来说太重要了
sense_groups.english: She means too much to me."

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我是该为她争取一下
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'll fight for her. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等 我忽然想到... 如果我这样做
sense_groups.english: Oh, wait. I just realized, if I do that,

sense_groups.chinese: 你就无法得到她了
sense_groups.english: that means you don't get her.

sense_groups.chinese: 可恶 我怎么没想到呢
sense_groups.english: Damn it, I did not think this through.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 你们 -嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, guys. - Hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 你给我的推荐有回复了吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, any word on casting yet?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 我已经说过了 你不适合那个角色
sense_groups.english: I told you, you're not right for the part.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么意思啊
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你会不会花钱
sense_groups.english: Rach, don't I seem like a professor

sense_groups.chinese: 买像我这样的教授介绍的电子货啊
sense_groups.english: you'd buy some kind of e-crap from?

sense_groups.chinese: 不好意思
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry,

sense_groups.chinese: 你说的东西估计我这辈子也不会感兴趣
sense_groups.english: this sounds like something I'm never gonna be interested in.

sense_groups.chinese: 拜托啦
sense_groups.english: Look, come on, please?

sense_groups.chinese: 又不是要诚心为难你
sense_groups.english: It's not like I'm asking you for some crazy favor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我就是干这行的啊
sense_groups.english: This is what I do for a living.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是个职业的演员呢
sense_groups.english: I am a professional actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 迟到了两小时了
sense_groups.english: Man, I'm two hours late for work.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里有我的一盘磁带
sense_groups.english: Here's a copy of my reel.

sense_groups.chinese: 里面有我拍过的所有广告
sense_groups.english: It's got all the commercials that I've been in.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊... -你就看一下吧
sense_groups.english: Joe-- - Just watch it.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你不喜欢
sense_groups.english: If you don't like it,

sense_groups.chinese: 就别给你上司就是了
sense_groups.english: don't pass it on to your bosses.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 -谢谢
sense_groups.english: Fine. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 工作啦 乔伊 -可恶
sense_groups.english: Work, Joe. - Damn it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我该怎么办啦
sense_groups.english: What am I gonna do now?

sense_groups.chinese: 就给你上司看看咯
sense_groups.english: Just pass the tape along.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的确不适合演这个
sense_groups.english: He's not right for the part.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我推荐他
sense_groups.english: If I suggest him,

sense_groups.chinese: 我的老板会觉得我是个白痴
sense_groups.english: my bosses will think I'm an idiot.

sense_groups.chinese: 我希望我的老板能迟些才发现这一点
sense_groups.english: And that's something they should learn on their own.

sense_groups.chinese: 那就告诉乔伊你看过带子
sense_groups.english: Just tell Joey that you watched the tape...

sense_groups.chinese: 你很喜欢 但你的老板们不喜欢
sense_groups.english: ...and you liked it, but your bosses didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 那样 你就成了好人
sense_groups.english: Then that way, you're the good guy,

sense_groups.chinese: 坏人就是你的老板啦
sense_groups.english: and they're the bad guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 好主意 我喜欢 老板不喜欢
sense_groups.english: That's good. I liked it, they didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 看在上帝份上 去工作啦
sense_groups.english: Joey, for God's sake, go to work.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信我马上就要见到本杰明·哈伯特
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm about to meet Benjamin Hobart.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直以为
sense_groups.english: I've always thought of him as someone I'd invite...

sense_groups.chinese: 只有在梦中才能和他共聚晚餐呢
sense_groups.english: ...to my fantasy dinner party.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会不会带上一些
sense_groups.english: Do you think there's any chance

sense_groups.chinese: 他喜欢的小玩偶来呢
sense_groups.english: he'll bring Christie Brinkley or C-3PO?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 看来他是自己来的
sense_groups.english: Sorry, it looks like it's just him.

sense_groups.chinese: 查莉
sense_groups.english: Charlie.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 你简直太美了
sense_groups.english: My God, you look absolutely stunning.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 今天我特地去了理发
sense_groups.english: Well, I am having a good hair day.

sense_groups.chinese: 见到你真好 -我也是
sense_groups.english: It's so good to see you. - Oh, you too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没事
sense_groups.english: I'm okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起...罗斯·盖勒 本杰明·哈伯特
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. Ross Geller, Benjamin Hobart.

sense_groups.chinese: 很荣幸见到你
sense_groups.english: It's an honor to meet you.

sense_groups.chinese: 我仰慕你都不知道多久了
sense_groups.english: I can't tell you how long...

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 你得了诺贝尔奖 喔...
sense_groups.english: ...I've been an admirer of your work. I mean, that Nobel Prize.

sense_groups.chinese: 不得不对你说
sense_groups.english: I mean, I have to tell you

sense_groups.chinese: 你是我进入这个领域原因之一
sense_groups.english: that you're one of the reasons I got into the field.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 我也久仰大名
sense_groups.english: Well, likewise.

sense_groups.chinese: 其实没有久仰
sense_groups.english: Actually not likewise.

sense_groups.chinese: 我今早才第一次听到你的名字
sense_groups.english: I'd never heard of you until this morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 但为人随和没什么不好
sense_groups.english: But it's nice to be nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们坐 -好的 谢谢
sense_groups.english: Shall we? - Yeah. Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不敢相信你选了这个餐馆
sense_groups.english: I can't believe that you chose this restaurant.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还记得那天晚上吗
sense_groups.english: Do you remember the night?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢天啊 我完全忘记了
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. I completely forgot.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 真不敢相信他们能让我们进门
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I can't believe they let us back in this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 你当时不在场
sense_groups.english: You weren't there.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不在 但想想都好笑
sense_groups.english: No, but, you know, it's just a funny image.

sense_groups.chinese: 想想你们两个 在这个餐馆 还...
sense_groups.english: You know, the two of you in this restaurant with the....

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 我去洗手间的时候
sense_groups.english: Ross, why don't you tell Benji

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟本杰说说你的方案吧
sense_groups.english: about your proposal while I go to the ladies' room.

sense_groups.chinese: 来吧 告诉我吧
sense_groups.english: So tell me about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们会在彩色沙漠里进行挖掘
sense_groups.english: Okay. Well, I would like to do a dig in the Painted Desert.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为里面有些地区还没完全挖掘
sense_groups.english: There are still several areas that haven't been fully excavated.

sense_groups.chinese: 和查莉分手吧 -什么
sense_groups.english: Break up with Charlie. - What?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 你刚才说 "和查莉分手"吗
sense_groups.english: Did you just say, "Break up with Charlie"?

sense_groups.chinese: 可以说是 也可以说不是
sense_groups.english: Well, yes and no.

sense_groups.chinese: 是 我是这样说了 不是的话就是说我没有不说
sense_groups.english: Yes, I did say it. And no, I didn't not say it.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不觉得这么说有点不妥吗
sense_groups.english: Kind of inappropriate, don't you think?

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Listen, I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我太久没有见她了
sense_groups.english: I just haven't seen her for so long,

sense_groups.chinese: 以前的感觉又涌上心头
sense_groups.english: all these feelings are rushing back.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我意识到
sense_groups.english: I'm starting to realize

sense_groups.chinese: 我有多想念她
sense_groups.english: how much I've missed her.

sense_groups.chinese: 我需要你和她分手
sense_groups.english: And I'm gonna need you to break up with her.

sense_groups.chinese: 你是说真的吗
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你说行 那我就是认真的
sense_groups.english: If you say, yes, then I'm serious.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你说不行 那我就是开玩笑
sense_groups.english: If you say, no, then I'm joking.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 -我开玩笑的
sense_groups.english: No. - Joking it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 对不起 我迟到了
sense_groups.english: Hi, sorry I'm late.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 和迈克谈得怎样
sense_groups.english: Hey, how'd it go with Mike?

sense_groups.chinese: 他肯让你保留那幅画吗
sense_groups.english: Is he gonna let you keep the painting?

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 他实在很讨厌它
sense_groups.english: No, he really hates it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但他肯让我留下我那盒头发
sense_groups.english: But he's gonna let me keep my box of human hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我只能妥协了
sense_groups.english: So you gotta pick your battles.

sense_groups.chinese: 但好消息是 格拉达斯已经属于你了
sense_groups.english: But the good news is, Gladys is yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 那坏消息呢
sense_groups.english: Wow, what's the bad news?

sense_groups.chinese: 谁是格拉达斯
sense_groups.english: Who's Gladys?

sense_groups.chinese: 她是我的手工作品
sense_groups.english: Oh, she's that work of art I made.

sense_groups.chinese: 就是女人从相框里出来的那幅
sense_groups.english: You know, with the woman coming out of the frame.

sense_groups.chinese: 给莫尼卡了吗
sense_groups.english: And Monica gets to keep her?

sense_groups.chinese: 放在她房间里 羡慕嫉妒恨啊
sense_groups.english: In her house? I am so jealous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道你也想要她啊
sense_groups.english: I didn't know you wanted her too.

sense_groups.chinese: 我...当然想要啊
sense_groups.english: Well, I mean, sure, of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 但...你已经给了莫尼卡了 所以...
sense_groups.english: But you already gave that to Monica, so....

sense_groups.chinese: 为了你 我可以放弃她
sense_groups.english: You know, I would give her up for you.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 我不可以让你这样做的
sense_groups.english: No, I couldn't let you do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我想这样做 -但我不想你这样做
sense_groups.english: No, but I want to. - But I don't want you to.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我坚持 -但我更坚持
sense_groups.english: But I insist. - But I insist harder.

sense_groups.chinese: 女生们 停一停好吗 我们投硬币决定吧
sense_groups.english: Girls. Girls. Stop. Okay, we'll flip a coin.

sense_groups.chinese: 正面 她是瑞秋的
sense_groups.english: Heads, she's Rachel's.

sense_groups.chinese: 反面 她就是莫尼卡的
sense_groups.english: Tails, she's Monica's.

sense_groups.chinese: 反面 莫尼卡 她是你的了
sense_groups.english: Tails. Monica, she's yours.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 它掉到你的食物里了
sense_groups.english: No, that landed in your food.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 没关系
sense_groups.english: No, no, that's okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你赢得光明正大 我太难过了
sense_groups.english: You won fair and square. I'm so sad.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 乔伊
sense_groups.english: Hey, Joe?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么事 -坏消息
sense_groups.english: What's up? - Bad news.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看过了带子
sense_groups.english: I watched the tape

sense_groups.chinese: 并把它交给我的老板们
sense_groups.english: and passed it along to my bosses

sense_groups.chinese: 但他们不感兴趣
sense_groups.english: and they weren't interested.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 老兄
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry, man.

sense_groups.chinese: 但...你看过这带子吗
sense_groups.english: But you watched the tape?

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 我...我很喜欢啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I liked it.

sense_groups.chinese: 但...我的老板不喜欢
sense_groups.english: But my bosses didn't go for it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这些愚蠢的狗杂种
sense_groups.english: Stupid sons of bitches.

questions.name: S10E07
questions.en:
Hey, you guys. Hey, what are you doing?
Figuring out our wedding plans.
Funny. We were doing the same thing.
It's really crazy. The hall, the dress, the food.
I had no idea how expensive this was.
Yeah, it is really pricey.
I freaked when I heard the numbers.
So, what did you two do about it?
It was simple.
I came up with some cost-cutting solutions...
...wrote out a list, and Monica told me to go to hell.
There's no way around it.
Just accept that this is gonna cost a lot of money.
I heard that weddings are, like, a $40 billion-a-year industry.
Yeah. And I'm responsible for just, like, half of that.
But really, it does seem like this money could be put to better use.
Are you serious?
Yeah. How would you feel
if we gave all the wedding money to charity...
...and we just got married at City Hall?
I think it would make me wanna marry you even more.
I gotta say, you guys, that's an incredible gesture.
Maybe you do that next time you get married.
No, no, no. The next time's gonna be Hawaii at sunset.
But maybe the time after that.
Hey. What's going on? - Hey.
Our adoption social worker is coming,
so we're cleaning the apartment.
"We"?
You know you don't want me to help.
You can't have it both ways.
Is this the person who decides
whether or not you get a baby?
Kind of. She's coming by to interview us and see where we live.
And it has to go perfectly,
because if she doesn't like something about us
she can keep us off
every adoption list in the state.
Hey, maybe I should stop by.
She could be a soap opera fan.
It's very impressive
when the little people know a celebrity.
"Little people"?
"Celebrity."
So I think I'm just about done here.
Unless you have any bad stuff hidden somewhere,
like porn or cigarettes?
What?
No. - Chandler.
I don't,
and I'm offended by the insinuation.
So there's not a magazine under the couch...
...or cigarettes taped to the back of the toilet tank...
...or a filthy video in the VCR?
I'll admit to the cigarettes and magazine.
But that tape is not mine.
It isn't mine.
I guess we'll never know whose it is.
May I help you?
Yes. We're here
to make a rather sizable donation to the children.
Any contribution, large or small,
is appreciated.
I think you're gonna appreciate
the crap out of this one.
Well, this is very generous.
And we don't want any recognition.
This is completely anonymous.
Completely anonymous. From two kind strangers.
Mr. X and Phoebe Buffay.
Well if you like,
we can include your names in our newsletter.
Not necessary.
Buffay is spelled B-U-F-F-A-Y.
And X is spelled "Mike Hannigan."
Well, on behalf of the children, thank you both very much.
I'm glad we did this. It feels so good.
It does. It feels really good.
Oh, look. And we get these free T-shirts.
Actually, that's the shirt I wore to the gym.
It's moist.
Hi. Emma will be up in a minute.
Oh, good.
Hey, Ross, listen. I heard about you and Charlie.
I'm really sorry.
That's okay.
I'm sure there are tons of other beautiful paleontologists out there.
Absolutely.
There was one. She's it.
All the rest look like they should live under a bridge.
So, what are you gonna do today?
I was thinking of taking Emma to the playground.
Oh, my God. What?
Like I said, I was thinking of
taking Emma to the Museum of Knives and Fire.
Okay, look, Ross.
I do not want Emma going to the playground.
Because...?
All right, if you must know, I had a traumatic...
...swing incident when I was little.
Seriously? - Yes. I was 4 years old.
And I was on the swing...
...and then all of a sudden my hair got tangled in the chain.
And to get me out,
my mom had to cut a big chunk of my hair.
And it was uneven for weeks.
And you made it through that?
I wonder who's gonna play you in the movie.
Okay, fine, you can make fun of me.
I do not want Emma going there.
And I was thinking Claire Danes.
Look, I'm sorry to hear about your tragedy.
But the swings are perfectly safe.
And besides, Emma loves them.
You should come, and you'll see.
Those things go, like, 40 miles an hour.
And there's that moment when you're at the top...
...when you just don't know if you're gonna return back to Earth.
Space is filled with orbiting children.
Look, please, just come on.
When you see the look on Emma's face,
I swear, you won't regret it.
All right. - Good.
You don't wanna be a mom
who passes her irrational fears to her children.
"Irrational," huh?
I'll remember that next time
you freak out about a spider in your apartment.
That's the same. I'm sure there are 30
different species of poisonous swings.
Oh, my God. The adoption lady is early.
Okay. Okay. Here we go. Here we go.
Stand up straight.
Big smile.
Hello. Is this the Creepy residence?
We're waiting for the adoption lady.
But I'm glad you're here.
I was cleaning this morning
and I found this.
I don't know if you wanna use it, but....
Oh, this is so sweet of you.
But you know what?
I won't be needing a veil,
I actually won't be wearing a dress at all!
I told you,
I am not coming to a naked wedding!
No. We're not having a big reception.
we took the money we were gonna spend on a wedding
and we donate them to the children charity.
That's crazy!
I'm sorry. I can't imagine giving up
my one wedding day like that.
Well, we're different.
I don't care about having a huge party.
This is really nice for you, but....
Oh, please. I put this on and I just look like
Well, radiant.
All right, but who cares?
I don't need a pretty veil and a fancy dress.
That's right. You're making a commitment.
You know, that's the same whether you do it at the Plaza or....
Where you gonna do it? - City Hall.
Oh, that sounds nice.
I was just there for jury duty.
They've really spruced that place up.
Okay. It's okay...
I've made my decision.
What I really want is a great big wedding.
But you gave all the money to charity.
Well, I'll just ask for it back.
I don't think you can do that.
Why not?
This is her wedding day.
That's way more important than some stupid kids.
That's sweet, honey,
but save something for the adoption lady.
All right, okay. Be careful. - Okay.
Careful. Watch her hair. Watch her hair!
Rach, she's got, like, three hairs.
I know. I know.
But they're just so beautiful.
Oh, my God, I just pulled one out.
I promise you she's safe.
Watch how much she loves this.
Okay. Okay.
Are you ready, sweetie? Here we go.
Okay, careful. Okay.
She's smiling.
Look at that, she does like it.
See, I told you.
Oh, my God.
Look at her, she's a little daredevil.
Oh, God. Let me push. Can I push?
Oh, absolutely.
Oh, God. Okay, get the camera.
It's in the diaper bag.
Okay.
See? Scared of the swings.
I bet you feel pretty silly.
We're asking for the money back?
It's for our wedding day.
Now, is this guy gay or straight?
Because one of us has to start flirting.
You here to make another donation the same day?
I don't think that's ever happened before.
Gay. Go.
Oh, my God, I love your shirt.
The donation we made earlier?
Well, we want it back.
Excuse me?
Okay, that money was for a big wedding
we thought we didn't want.
But it turns out we do.
So you're asking us
to refund your donation to the children?
Yeah.
This feels really good.
I'm sorry. I am.
But this wedding's just really important to me.
Hey, it's none of my business.
Besides, this is probably a good thing.
We've really been spoiling the children,
what with all the food and warm clothing.
That's not fair.
A person's wedding is important.
And especially to me.
I didn't have a graduation party.
And I didn't go to prom.
And I spent my sweet 16 being chased around a tire yard...
...by an escaped mental patient
who, in his own words, wanted to
"Kill me, or whatever."
So I deserve a real celebration.
And I'm not gonna let some sweaty little man
make me feel badly about it.
She could've been talking about either one of us.
Hi, I'm Laura.
I'm here for your adoption interview.
Hi, I'm Monica. And this is Chandler.
Please come in. - Thank you.
Would you like something to drink?
Water would be fine.
We're so glad that you're here.
We're excited about getting this process started.
Because we love kids. Love them to death.
Well, not actually to death.
That's just a figure of speech.
We love kids the appropriate amount...
...as allowed by law.
Your place is just lovely. - Thank you.
Yes, this building does have a wholesome,
family feel to it.
I feel like I've been here before.
Any other couples in the building adopting?
Is that that couple on the first floor?
Because we should get a baby before them.
That guy tried to sell me drugs.
But other than that,
wholesome, wholesome building.
What?
I realized why I remember this place.
Really? What is it?
Oh, it's nothing.
I went on a date with a guy who lived in this building.
It didn't end very well.
That wouldn't, by any chance, be Joey Tribbiani?
Yes! - Of course it was.
We had a great night.
In the morning, he promised he'd call
and he didn't.
Rat bastard!
So you're not friends with him?
Oh, God, no.
No, no, no.
No. Nope.
No...
No...
No...
No...
No...
Well, I'm sorry I brought it up.
So are either one of you planning on staying at home?
Hello? Anybody in there order a celebrity?
What was that?
That's just some crazy guy who roams the halls here.
He's great with kids, though.
Ross. Oh, my God, are you okay?
Son of a bitch!
Oh, relax. I didn't say the F-word.
Ross, see,
I told you! Those swings are evil!
That is it.
That's the last time Emma is getting on
one of those things for her entire life.
No, no, no. Okay, it wasn't the swing's fault.
It was my fault.
And kind of that kid's fault.
Who is still laughing. Nice.
Come on. Can we just get out of here
before somebody else gets hurt?
No. Wait. Ok, ok. I have an idea.
I want you to get on the swing...
...and you'll see that there's nothing to be afraid of.
I know what this is all about.
You've always been jealous of my hair.
I just think you're an adult, okay?
And you should get over your silly fears.
All right, fine. I'll do it.
Good.
If you hold a spider.
Where?! Where?!
If you hold a spider.
I know.
Guys, is everything okay?
It's me, Joey.
Adoption!
What's going on?
Oh, it's just like I said, that crazy...
...Bert, roaming the halls.
Guys?
Keep on roaming, Bert!
We don't want any crazy today!
What's going on?
We'll talk later! Bert. Everything's fine!
Everything doesn't sound fine.
Is he all right out there by himself?
Oh, yeah. He has a caretaker.
His older brother...
...Ernie.
Bert and Ernie?
You can't make this stuff up.
You never told me about that guy
and your sweet 16.
I'm sorry about that.
Oh, it ended okay.
One of my friends shot him.
At least you'll get a proper wedding.
You really deserve that.
Yeah, I really do.
You know, I had nothing growing up.
Just like the kids I took the money from.
No... I see where this is going.
Don't make me go back there.
Look, I can't have a wedding with this money now.
It's tainted.
Fine, we'll give the money back.
If that guy at the charity
gives us a hard time...
...my friend hasn't shot anyone in a really long time.
I must say this seems like
a lovely environment to raise a child in.
You are welcome to look under
any of the furniture...
...because, believe me,
you won't find any porn or cigarettes under there.
Before we look around,
let me make sure
I have everything I need up to here.
Why don't I show you the baby's room.
What are you doing?
You wouldn't let me in.
I thought you were in trouble.
Well, we're not.
But you called me "Bert."
That's our code word for danger.
We don't have a code word.
We don't?
We really should.
From now on,
"Bert" will be our code word for danger.
So that was the baby's room.
What room should we see next?
Any room that isn't behind this couch.
Some people don't get him,
but I think he's really funny.
I did not care for that.
You have to leave.
You slept with our social worker
and never called her back.
She is still pissed,
so she can't see you.
Okay, okay.
What? - I forgot my bat.
Oh, my God.
And for the last time,
we do not want to be friends with you!
And we don't wanna buy your bat!
What are you doing here?
Bert...
Are you friends with him?
I can explain.
Joey?
All right. Okay.
You have got some nerve coming back here.
I can't believe you never called me.
Excuse me?
You probably don't even remember my name.
It's Joey, by the way.
And don't bother telling me yours,
because I totally remember it, lady.
I waited weeks for you to call me.
I gave you my number.
You never called me.
Don't try to turn this around on me.
I am not some kind of social work...
...that you can just...
...do.
I'm pretty sure I gave you my number.
Really? Think about it. Come on.
You're a beautiful woman.
Smart, funny.
We had a really good time.
If I had your number,
why wouldn't I call you?
I don't know.
Well, maybe I'm wrong.
I'm sorry.
Hey, too late for apologies. Okay?
You broke my heart.
You know how many women
I had to sleep with to get over you?
Joey, wait-- - No!
I waited a long time!
I can't wait anymore.
I'm sorry that you had to see that.
I'm so embarrassed.
Oh, that's really okay.
Yeah. We totally understand.
Dating is hard.
Boy, you people are nice.
And I've got to say...
...l think you're going to make excellent parents.
Laura!
We're back.
Are you here to take more money?
Because I think what you're looking for is an ATM.
No, no, we're here to give the money back.
Yeah. Because you know what?
It's all about the children.
Although it's also about the wedding.
All right, here.
No. Oh, God.
If I haven't said so already,
sir, congratulations.
Enough, all right?
I'm stepping in and putting my foot down.
As your future husband,
I'm gonna make this decision for us.
What do you think we should do?
You know what. It's not your decision anymore.
What?
On behalf of the children of New York,
I reject your money.
But we're giving you this.
And I'm giving it back to you.
Come on. Consider it a contribution.
Well, this is very generous.
Please take the check.
Have a great wedding
and a wonderful life together.
Sounds good to me.
We can save up, come back in a few years...
...and make an even bigger donation.
Absolutely. And when you do, make sure you ask for Brian.
Oh, is that you? - No.
Hello?
Oh, hi.
Oh, my God, really?
I can't wait to tell Chandler.
Okay. Goodbye.
Wrong number?
That was Laura.
She gave us a great report
and we're officially on the waiting list.
That's great.
Now we just wait for a call...
...and someone tells us
there's a baby waiting for us.
Hello?
Have you seen Joey's bat?
Okay. I got a spider.
There were two, I picked the bigger one.
Okay. - Okay.
This feels perfectly normal.
Okay, get on the swing.
Okay.
Okay.
Okay.
See?
All right. I can do this.
There you go. Good for you.
You know what? I'm getting used to this little guy.
I don't even feel him in here anymore.
That's because he's on your neck.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 你俩在干什么
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys. Hey, what are you doing?

sense_groups.english: Figuring out our wedding plans.

sense_groups.chinese: 疯了 场地 服装 食品
sense_groups.english: It's really crazy. The hall, the dress, the food.

sense_groups.english: I had no idea how expensive this was.

sense_groups.chinese: 是很贵
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it is really pricey.

sense_groups.chinese: 第一次算出结婚费用 我被那个数字吓呆了
sense_groups.english: I freaked when I heard the numbers.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果你们怎么做的
sense_groups.english: So, what did you two do about it?

sense_groups.chinese: 简单
sense_groups.english: It was simple.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想出了一些省钱方案
sense_groups.english: I came up with some cost-cutting solutions...

sense_groups.chinese: 列了个清单 结果莫妮卡叫我去死
sense_groups.english: ...wrote out a list, and Monica told me to go to hell.

sense_groups.chinese: 没钱好省的
sense_groups.english: There's no way around it.

sense_groups.chinese: 只能接受现实 确实会花很多钱
sense_groups.english: Just accept that this is gonna cost a lot of money.

sense_groups.chinese: 听说每年花在结婚上的钱高达400亿
sense_groups.english: I heard that weddings are, like, a $40 billion-a-year industry.

sense_groups.chinese: 这其中我贡献过半
sense_groups.english: Yeah. And I'm responsible for just, like, half of that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得这钱应该用在更有意义的事上
sense_groups.english: But really, it does seem like this money could be put to better use.

sense_groups.chinese: 当真
sense_groups.english: Are you serious?

sense_groups.chinese: 把婚礼经费
sense_groups.english: Yeah. How would you feel

sense_groups.chinese: 捐献给慈善事业
sense_groups.english: if we gave all the wedding money to charity...

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就到市政厅登个记 如何

sense_groups.chinese: 这让我越发想娶你了
sense_groups.english: I think it would make me wanna marry you even more.

sense_groups.chinese: 不得不说 你们的高姿态 很好
sense_groups.english: I gotta say, you guys, that's an incredible gesture.

sense_groups.chinese: 下次你结婚也这么干如何
sense_groups.english: Maybe you do that next time you get married.

sense_groups.chinese: 不不不 下次我要在夏威夷斜阳下结婚
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. The next time's gonna be Hawaii at sunset.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过下下次可以听取你的意见
sense_groups.english: But maybe the time after that.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 忙啥呢 -嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey. What's going on? - Hey.

sense_groups.english: Our adoption social worker is coming,

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我们在扫除
sense_groups.english: so we're cleaning the apartment.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们
sense_groups.english: "We"?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不想我掺和
sense_groups.english: You know you don't want me to help.

sense_groups.chinese: 别现在又说这个
sense_groups.english: You can't have it both ways.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个人能决定
sense_groups.english: Is this the person who decides

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是否收养一个孩子
sense_groups.english: whether or not you get a baby?

sense_groups.chinese: 差不多 这人来视察我们的生活环境
sense_groups.english: Kind of. She's coming by to interview us and see where we live.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们必须表现得完美
sense_groups.english: And it has to go perfectly,

sense_groups.chinese: 若她对我们有丝毫不满
sense_groups.english: because if she doesn't like something about us

sense_groups.english: she can keep us off

sense_groups.chinese: 全国任何一个领养的名单里
sense_groups.english: every adoption list in the state.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以过来友情协力一把
sense_groups.english: Hey, maybe I should stop by.

sense_groups.chinese: 她没准爱看肥皂剧
sense_groups.english: She could be a soap opera fan.

sense_groups.chinese: 小人物认识演艺名流
sense_groups.english: It's very impressive

sense_groups.chinese: 可以蓬壁生辉呢
sense_groups.english: when the little people know a celebrity.

sense_groups.chinese: 小人物
sense_groups.english: "Little people"?

sense_groups.chinese: 名流
sense_groups.english: "Celebrity."

sense_groups.chinese: 我觉得我做的差不多了
sense_groups.english: So I think I'm just about done here.

sense_groups.chinese: 除非你还在哪
sense_groups.english: Unless you have any bad stuff hidden somewhere,

sense_groups.english: like porn or cigarettes?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有 -钱德勒
sense_groups.english: No. - Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没有
sense_groups.english: I don't,

sense_groups.chinese: 这样玷污人家清白太气人了
sense_groups.english: and I'm offended by the insinuation.

sense_groups.chinese: 沙发下没有杂志
sense_groups.english: So there's not a magazine under the couch...

sense_groups.chinese: 厕所水箱后没有一包香烟
sense_groups.english: ...or cigarettes taped to the back of the toilet tank...

sense_groups.chinese: 录象机里没有A片
sense_groups.english: ...or a filthy video in the VCR?

sense_groups.chinese: 香烟和杂志我认帐
sense_groups.english: I'll admit to the cigarettes and magazine.

sense_groups.chinese: 但带子不是我的
sense_groups.english: But that tape is not mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 也不是我的
sense_groups.english: It isn't mine.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们永远不会知道是谁的了
sense_groups.english: I guess we'll never know whose it is.

sense_groups.chinese: 可以帮忙吗
sense_groups.english: May I help you?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们来给孩子们
sense_groups.english: Yes. We're here

sense_groups.chinese: 捐一大笔钱
sense_groups.english: to make a rather sizable donation to the children.

sense_groups.chinese: 捐钱不论多少 心意都是一样重
sense_groups.english: Any contribution, large or small,

sense_groups.chinese: 我们都会感激
sense_groups.english: is appreciated.

sense_groups.chinese: 数目这样大
sense_groups.english: I think you're gonna appreciate

sense_groups.chinese: 你一定会把屎都感动出来了
sense_groups.english: the crap out of this one.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真大方
sense_groups.english: Well, this is very generous.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们要匿名捐助
sense_groups.english: And we don't want any recognition.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全匿名
sense_groups.english: This is completely anonymous.

sense_groups.chinese: 完全匿名 就写两个陌生人
sense_groups.english: Completely anonymous. From two kind strangers.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生甲和菲比·布菲
sense_groups.english: Mr. X and Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.english: Well if you like,

sense_groups.chinese: 我们可以把二位的名字登到新闻通讯里
sense_groups.english: we can include your names in our newsletter.

sense_groups.chinese: 没必要
sense_groups.english: Not necessary.

sense_groups.chinese: 布菲的拼法是 B-U-F-F-A-Y
sense_groups.english: Buffay is spelled B-U-F-F-A-Y.

sense_groups.chinese: 先生甲的写法是 迈克·汉尼根
sense_groups.english: And X is spelled "Mike Hannigan."

sense_groups.chinese: 我代表孩子们多谢两位
sense_groups.english: Well, on behalf of the children, thank you both very much.

sense_groups.english: I'm glad we did this. It feels so good.

sense_groups.english: It does. It feels really good.

sense_groups.english: Actually, that's the shirt I wore to the gym.

sense_groups.english: It's moist.

sense_groups.english: Hi. Emma will be up in a minute.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, good.

sense_groups.english: That's okay.

sense_groups.english: Absolutely.

sense_groups.english: All the rest look like they should live under a bridge.

sense_groups.english: So, what are you gonna do today?

sense_groups.english: I was thinking of taking Emma to the playground.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊 什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我又没说
sense_groups.english: Like I said, I was thinking of

sense_groups.english: taking Emma to the Museum of Knives and Fire.

sense_groups.chinese: 听着 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Okay, look, Ross.

sense_groups.english: I do not want Emma going to the playground.

sense_groups.english: Because...?

sense_groups.english: ...swing incident when I was little.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 -我才四岁
sense_groups.english: Seriously? - Yes. I was 4 years old.

sense_groups.chinese: 我荡秋千
sense_groups.english: And I was on the swing...

sense_groups.chinese: 突然头发缠到铁链上
sense_groups.english: ...and then all of a sudden my hair got tangled in the chain.

sense_groups.english: And to get me out,

sense_groups.chinese: 才救我出来
sense_groups.english: my mom had to cut a big chunk of my hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果有好几星期头发才长齐
sense_groups.english: And it was uneven for weeks.

sense_groups.chinese: 你竟熬了过来
sense_groups.english: And you made it through that?

sense_groups.english: I wonder who's gonna play you in the movie.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尽管拿我取笑
sense_groups.english: Okay, fine, you can make fun of me.

sense_groups.chinese: 反正我就是不想艾玛去
sense_groups.english: I do not want Emma going there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我在想能不能让克莱尔·丹妮丝扮演我
sense_groups.english: And I was thinking Claire Danes.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的悲剧令我同情
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sorry to hear about your tragedy.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过秋千很安全
sense_groups.english: But the swings are perfectly safe.

sense_groups.chinese: 而且艾玛喜欢荡秋千
sense_groups.english: And besides, Emma loves them.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们同去 你就知道了
sense_groups.english: You should come, and you'll see.

sense_groups.chinese: 秋千速度高达40英里/小时
sense_groups.english: Those things go, like, 40 miles an hour.

sense_groups.chinese: 当你荡到最高处
sense_groups.english: And there's that moment when you're at the top...

sense_groups.chinese: 鬼才知道会不会返回地球
sense_groups.english: ...when you just don't know if you're gonna return back to Earth.

sense_groups.chinese: 宇宙充满小孩子绕轨道运行
sense_groups.english: Space is filled with orbiting children.

sense_groups.chinese: 求你了 来嘛
sense_groups.english: Look, please, just come on.

sense_groups.english: When you see the look on Emma's face,

sense_groups.chinese: 决不会后悔
sense_groups.english: I swear, you won't regret it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 -太好了
sense_groups.english: All right. - Good.

sense_groups.english: You don't wanna be a mom

sense_groups.english: who passes her irrational fears to her children.

sense_groups.english: "Irrational," huh?

sense_groups.english: I'll remember that next time

sense_groups.english: Oh, my God. The adoption lady is early.

sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay. Here we go. Here we go.

sense_groups.english: Stand up straight.

sense_groups.chinese: 微笑
sense_groups.english: Big smile.

sense_groups.english: Hello. Is this the Creepy residence?

sense_groups.english: We're waiting for the adoption lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来得正好
sense_groups.english: But I'm glad you're here.

sense_groups.english: I was cleaning this morning

sense_groups.chinese: 不知道你用不用得上
sense_groups.english: and I found this.

sense_groups.english: I don't know if you wanna use it, but....

sense_groups.chinese: 你真好
sense_groups.english: Oh, this is so sweet of you.

sense_groups.english: But you know what?

sense_groups.english: I won't be needing a veil,

sense_groups.english: I told you,

sense_groups.english: I am not coming to a naked wedding!

sense_groups.english: No. We're not having a big reception.

sense_groups.english: we took the money we were gonna spend on a wedding

sense_groups.chinese: 你真疯狂
sense_groups.english: That's crazy!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 只是无法想象
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I can't imagine giving up

sense_groups.chinese: 一生只有一次啊
sense_groups.english: my one wedding day like that.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不同
sense_groups.english: Well, we're different.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎什么盛大婚礼
sense_groups.english: I don't care about having a huge party.

sense_groups.chinese: 头纱你戴是很美 但是...
sense_groups.english: This is really nice for you, but....

sense_groups.chinese: 你看我一戴上 简直就...
sense_groups.english: Oh, please. I put this on and I just look like

sense_groups.chinese: 美极了
sense_groups.english: Well, radiant.

sense_groups.chinese: 管它呢
sense_groups.english: All right, but who cares?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不需要头纱婚纱这些玩意
sense_groups.english: I don't need a pretty veil and a fancy dress.

sense_groups.chinese: 对 你们是互许终身
sense_groups.english: That's right. You're making a commitment.

sense_groups.chinese: 不管在广场举行还是别的什么地方都是一样
sense_groups.english: You know, that's the same whether you do it at the Plaza or....

sense_groups.english: Where you gonna do it? - City Hall.

sense_groups.chinese: 好地方
sense_groups.english: Oh, that sounds nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚去过那做评审委员
sense_groups.english: I was just there for jury duty.

sense_groups.chinese: 他们把那打理得非常整洁漂亮呢
sense_groups.english: They've really spruced that place up.

sense_groups.chinese: 没关系...
sense_groups.english: Okay. It's okay...

sense_groups.english: I've made my decision.

sense_groups.english: What I really want is a great big wedding.

sense_groups.english: But you gave all the money to charity.

sense_groups.english: Well, I'll just ask for it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 不行吧
sense_groups.english: I don't think you can do that.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么不行
sense_groups.english: Why not?

sense_groups.chinese: 她这可是结婚
sense_groups.english: This is her wedding day.

sense_groups.chinese: 这可比什么愚蠢的小孩子重要多了
sense_groups.english: That's way more important than some stupid kids.

sense_groups.chinese: 说得好 亲爱的
sense_groups.english: That's sweet, honey,

sense_groups.chinese: 但这些话省下来说给领养中心的人听吧
sense_groups.english: but save something for the adoption lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 小心点 -好
sense_groups.english: All right, okay. Be careful. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心 小心她头发
sense_groups.english: Careful. Watch her hair. Watch her hair!

sense_groups.english: Rach, she's got, like, three hairs.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 我知道
sense_groups.english: I know. I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是很漂亮
sense_groups.english: But they're just so beautiful.

sense_groups.chinese: 糟糕 扯掉一根
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I just pulled one out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我保证 她很安全
sense_groups.english: I promise you she's safe.

sense_groups.chinese: 你看她多喜欢玩秋千
sense_groups.english: Watch how much she loves this.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你准备好了吗 亲爱的 开始喽
sense_groups.english: Are you ready, sweetie? Here we go.

sense_groups.chinese: 小心
sense_groups.english: Okay, careful. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 她笑了
sense_groups.english: She's smiling.

sense_groups.chinese: 看 她真的很喜欢
sense_groups.english: Look at that, she does like it.

sense_groups.english: See, I told you.

sense_groups.chinese: 天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 看看她真有不怕死的精神
sense_groups.english: Look at her, she's a little daredevil.

sense_groups.chinese: 让我推好不好
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Let me push. Can I push?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 当然
sense_groups.english: Oh, absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去拿相机
sense_groups.english: Oh, God. Okay, get the camera.

sense_groups.chinese: 在尿布包里
sense_groups.english: It's in the diaper bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 还怕秋千
sense_groups.english: See? Scared of the swings.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在觉得傻了吧
sense_groups.english: I bet you feel pretty silly.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们真要把钱要回来
sense_groups.english: We're asking for the money back?

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚要用
sense_groups.english: It's for our wedding day.

sense_groups.chinese: 这小子喜欢男的女的
sense_groups.english: Now, is this guy gay or straight?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们非得出美人计
sense_groups.english: Because one of us has to start flirting.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一天来捐两次钱
sense_groups.english: You here to make another donation the same day?

sense_groups.chinese: 真是前所未有呢
sense_groups.english: I don't think that's ever happened before.

sense_groups.chinese: 同性恋 你上
sense_groups.english: Gay. Go.

sense_groups.chinese: 天呐 你的衬衣好帅
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, I love your shirt.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们今天捐的钱
sense_groups.english: The donation we made earlier?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们想要回来
sense_groups.english: Well, we want it back.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 那是办婚礼的钱
sense_groups.english: Okay, that money was for a big wedding

sense_groups.chinese: 我们本来不想大办
sense_groups.english: we thought we didn't want.

sense_groups.chinese: 但现在我们改变了主意
sense_groups.english: But it turns out we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以你要我们退还
sense_groups.english: So you're asking us

sense_groups.chinese: 你们捐给孩子们的钱
sense_groups.english: to refund your donation to the children?

sense_groups.chinese: 对
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样感觉真不错
sense_groups.english: This feels really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起 真的
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. I am.

sense_groups.chinese: 但婚礼对我相当重要
sense_groups.english: But this wedding's just really important to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 不关我事
sense_groups.english: Hey, it's none of my business.

sense_groups.chinese: 也许这是件好事
sense_groups.english: Besides, this is probably a good thing.

sense_groups.chinese: 别把孩子惯坏了
sense_groups.english: We've really been spoiling the children,

sense_groups.chinese: 让他们吃饱穿暖干嘛
sense_groups.english: what with all the food and warm clothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这么说不公平
sense_groups.english: That's not fair.

sense_groups.chinese: 结婚是大事
sense_groups.english: A person's wedding is important.

sense_groups.chinese: 尤其对于我来说
sense_groups.english: And especially to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没参加过毕业典礼
sense_groups.english: I didn't have a graduation party.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有毕业舞会
sense_groups.english: And I didn't go to prom.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我的16岁生日的时候
sense_groups.english: And I spent my sweet 16 being chased around a tire yard...

sense_groups.chinese: 我被精神病人在一个废旧轮胎场地狂追
sense_groups.english: ...by an escaped mental patient

sense_groups.chinese: 他还说
sense_groups.english: who, in his own words, wanted to

sense_groups.chinese: 杀我什么的
sense_groups.english: "Kill me, or whatever."

sense_groups.chinese: 我应当有个隆重的婚礼
sense_groups.english: So I deserve a real celebration.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不会让你个流汗男
sense_groups.english: And I'm not gonna let some sweaty little man

sense_groups.chinese: 弄的我觉得内疚
sense_groups.english: make me feel badly about it.

sense_groups.chinese: 她也有可能是在说我
sense_groups.english: She could've been talking about either one of us.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是劳拉
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Laura.

sense_groups.chinese: 我来做领养家访
sense_groups.english: I'm here for your adoption interview.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是莫妮卡 这是钱德勒
sense_groups.english: Hi, I'm Monica. And this is Chandler.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 -谢谢
sense_groups.english: Please come in. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 请进 喝点什么
sense_groups.english: Would you like something to drink?

sense_groups.chinese: 喝水可以了
sense_groups.english: Water would be fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 你总算来了
sense_groups.english: We're so glad that you're here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们好兴奋 终于开始领养小孩的流程了
sense_groups.english: We're excited about getting this process started.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为我们爱小孩 爱得要死
sense_groups.english: Because we love kids. Love them to death.

sense_groups.chinese: 不是真的要孩子"死"
sense_groups.english: Well, not actually to death.

sense_groups.chinese: 只是这么形容一下
sense_groups.english: That's just a figure of speech.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们爱孩子 恰当合理
sense_groups.english: We love kids the appropriate amount...

sense_groups.chinese: 符合法律法规
sense_groups.english: ...as allowed by law.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们家好可爱 -谢谢
sense_groups.english: Your place is just lovely. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 这栋楼的确看起来很卫生
sense_groups.english: Yes, this building does have a wholesome,

sense_groups.chinese: 给人家的感觉
sense_groups.english: family feel to it.

sense_groups.chinese: 我好像来过这里
sense_groups.english: I feel like I've been here before.

sense_groups.chinese: 这里还有谁家在申请领养吗
sense_groups.english: Any other couples in the building adopting?

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是一楼那家
sense_groups.english: Is that that couple on the first floor?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该比他们先得到孩子
sense_groups.english: Because we should get a baby before them.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还想卖毒品给我
sense_groups.english: That guy tried to sell me drugs.

sense_groups.chinese: 但其他人都好
sense_groups.english: But other than that,

sense_groups.chinese: 这是栋干净卫生的楼
sense_groups.english: wholesome, wholesome building.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 我想起来了为什么我对这楼有记忆了
sense_groups.english: I realized why I remember this place.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 怎么回事
sense_groups.english: Really? What is it?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 没什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's nothing.

sense_groups.chinese: 我和住在这栋楼里的一个男人约会
sense_groups.english: I went on a date with a guy who lived in this building.

sense_groups.chinese: 结果无疾而终
sense_groups.english: It didn't end very well.

sense_groups.chinese: 那人该不是叫乔伊·崔比安尼吧
sense_groups.english: That wouldn't, by any chance, be Joey Tribbiani?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是他 -当然是他
sense_groups.english: Yes! - Of course it was.

sense_groups.chinese: 良宵过后
sense_groups.english: We had a great night.

sense_groups.chinese: 他说他再打电话给我
sense_groups.english: In the morning, he promised he'd call

sense_groups.chinese: 结果再没联络
sense_groups.english: and he didn't.

sense_groups.chinese: 真他妈混蛋
sense_groups.english: Rat bastard!

sense_groups.chinese: 你们该不是他朋友
sense_groups.english: So you're not friends with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是 不
sense_groups.english: Oh, God, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是 不
sense_groups.english: No, no, no.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然不是
sense_groups.english: No. Nope.
No...
No...
No...
No...
No...

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉提到这事
sense_groups.english: Well, I'm sorry I brought it up.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么你们当中有人打算待在家里吗
sense_groups.english: So are either one of you planning on staying at home?

sense_groups.chinese: 有人吗 名人驾到
sense_groups.english: Hello? Anybody in there order a celebrity?

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了
sense_groups.english: What was that?

sense_groups.chinese: 过道上乱跑的疯子
sense_groups.english: That's just some crazy guy who roams the halls here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不过他对小孩很慈祥
sense_groups.english: He's great with kids, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 天啊 你还好
sense_groups.english: Ross. Oh, my God, are you okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他妹的
sense_groups.english: Son of a bitch!

sense_groups.chinese: 别紧张 我又没说F打头那个字
sense_groups.english: Oh, relax. I didn't say the F-word.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 看吧
sense_groups.english: Ross, see,

sense_groups.chinese: 早告诉你了 秋千太邪恶了
sense_groups.english: I told you! Those swings are evil!

sense_groups.chinese: 就这一次了
sense_groups.english: That is it.

sense_groups.chinese: 这辈子再也不许
sense_groups.english: That's the last time Emma is getting on

sense_groups.chinese: 艾玛接近它
sense_groups.english: one of those things for her entire life.

sense_groups.chinese: 别这样 不是秋千的错
sense_groups.english: No, no, no. Okay, it wasn't the swing's fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 是我错
sense_groups.english: It was my fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 还有那孩子的错
sense_groups.english: And kind of that kid's fault.

sense_groups.chinese: 他还笑呢 算你恨
sense_groups.english: Who is still laughing. Nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 在再有人受伤之前
sense_groups.english: Come on. Can we just get out of here

sense_groups.chinese: 我们走吧
sense_groups.english: before somebody else gets hurt?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 等等 这样吧
sense_groups.english: No. Wait. Ok, ok. I have an idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 你去荡秋千
sense_groups.english: I want you to get on the swing...

sense_groups.chinese: 你会发现没什么好担心的
sense_groups.english: ...and you'll see that there's nothing to be afraid of.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道你意欲何为了
sense_groups.english: I know what this is all about.

sense_groups.chinese: 你一贯嫉妒我满头秀发
sense_groups.english: You've always been jealous of my hair.

sense_groups.chinese: 这只是想你已经成年了
sense_groups.english: I just think you're an adult, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 该克服那些愚蠢的恐惧了
sense_groups.english: And you should get over your silly fears.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 上就上
sense_groups.english: All right, fine. I'll do it.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Good.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你敢抓蜘蛛
sense_groups.english: If you hold a spider.

sense_groups.chinese: 在哪儿 在哪儿
sense_groups.english: Where?! Where?!

sense_groups.chinese: 我说"如果"你敢抓蜘蛛
sense_groups.english: If you hold a spider.

sense_groups.chinese: 我听见了
sense_groups.english: I know.

sense_groups.chinese: 伙计们 没事吧
sense_groups.english: Guys, is everything okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 是我 乔伊
sense_groups.english: It's me, Joey.

sense_groups.chinese: 领养
sense_groups.english: Adoption!

sense_groups.chinese: 到底怎么回事
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是那个叫波特疯子
sense_groups.english: Oh, it's just like I said, that crazy...

sense_groups.chinese: 在过道上跑
sense_groups.english: ...Bert, roaming the halls.

sense_groups.chinese: 伙计们
sense_groups.english: Guys?

sense_groups.chinese: 接着跑吧 波特
sense_groups.english: Keep on roaming, Bert!

sense_groups.chinese: 今天我们不看你疯了
sense_groups.english: We don't want any crazy today!

sense_groups.chinese: 到底怎么了
sense_groups.english: What's going on?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们等会再说 波特 一切都好
sense_groups.english: We'll talk later! Bert. Everything's fine!

sense_groups.chinese: 听起来就是有问题
sense_groups.english: Everything doesn't sound fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 他独自一个在外面 不会出事吧
sense_groups.english: Is he all right out there by himself?

sense_groups.chinese: 没事 他有监管人
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. He has a caretaker.

sense_groups.chinese: 是他哥
sense_groups.english: His older brother...

sense_groups.chinese: 叫欧尼
sense_groups.english: ...Ernie.

sense_groups.chinese: 波特和欧尼
sense_groups.english: Bert and Ernie?

sense_groups.chinese: 无巧不成书
sense_groups.english: You can't make this stuff up.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没说过你16岁生日时
sense_groups.english: You never told me about that guy

sense_groups.chinese: 被男人追杀的故事
sense_groups.english: and your sweet 16.

sense_groups.chinese: 真可怜
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry about that.

sense_groups.chinese: 结局还算好
sense_groups.english: Oh, it ended okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友毙了他
sense_groups.english: One of my friends shot him.

sense_groups.chinese: 至少你会有个体面婚礼
sense_groups.english: At least you'll get a proper wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 你该得的
sense_groups.english: You really deserve that.

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 没错
sense_groups.english: Yeah, I really do.

sense_groups.chinese: 知道吗 长这么大我还没风光过
sense_groups.english: You know, I had nothing growing up.

sense_groups.chinese: 就像被我剥夺金钱的那些孩子一样
sense_groups.english: Just like the kids I took the money from.

sense_groups.chinese: 不... 看出你苗头了
sense_groups.english: No... I see where this is going.

sense_groups.chinese: 别又想让我退回去
sense_groups.english: Don't make me go back there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不能用这钱办婚事
sense_groups.english: Look, I can't have a wedding with this money now.

sense_groups.chinese: 这样就有污点了
sense_groups.english: It's tainted.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 退回就是了
sense_groups.english: Fine, we'll give the money back.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果慈善捐助处那家伙
sense_groups.english: If that guy at the charity

sense_groups.chinese: 又叫咱们难看
sense_groups.english: gives us a hard time...

sense_groups.chinese: 我朋友的老枪好久没见过血了
sense_groups.english: ...my friend hasn't shot anyone in a really long time.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想说 这种环境
sense_groups.english: I must say this seems like

sense_groups.chinese: 培养小孩似乎很理想
sense_groups.english: a lovely environment to raise a child in.

sense_groups.chinese: 你尽可以在各种家具
sense_groups.english: You are welcome to look under

sense_groups.chinese: 下面搜查
sense_groups.english: any of the furniture...

sense_groups.chinese: 相信我
sense_groups.english: ...because, believe me,

sense_groups.chinese: 绝无黄书和香烟什么的
sense_groups.english: you won't find any porn or cigarettes under there.

sense_groups.chinese: 在到处看看之前
sense_groups.english: Before we look around,

sense_groups.chinese: 让我先检查下我的表
sense_groups.english: let me make sure

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是都填好了
sense_groups.english: I have everything I need up to here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我带你去看看婴儿房
sense_groups.english: Why don't I show you the baby's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干啥
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不让我进来
sense_groups.english: You wouldn't let me in.

sense_groups.chinese: 我以为你们出事了
sense_groups.english: I thought you were in trouble.

sense_groups.chinese: 才没有
sense_groups.english: Well, we're not.

sense_groups.chinese: 但你叫我"波特"
sense_groups.english: But you called me "Bert."

sense_groups.chinese: 那是"危险"的暗号
sense_groups.english: That's our code word for danger.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们没约定过什么暗号
sense_groups.english: We don't have a code word.

sense_groups.chinese: 没有吗
sense_groups.english: We don't?

sense_groups.chinese: 应该约一个
sense_groups.english: We really should.

sense_groups.chinese: 从今往后
sense_groups.english: From now on,

sense_groups.chinese: "波特"就用来作为遇到危险的暗号
sense_groups.english: "Bert" will be our code word for danger.

sense_groups.chinese: 参观完婴儿房
sense_groups.english: So that was the baby's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 下面参观哪里
sense_groups.english: What room should we see next?

sense_groups.chinese: 除了沙发后面都可以参观
sense_groups.english: Any room that isn't behind this couch.

sense_groups.chinese: 有些人不懂他的笑话
sense_groups.english: Some people don't get him,

sense_groups.chinese: 但我觉得他真幽默
sense_groups.english: but I think he's really funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不在乎被你粗暴对待
sense_groups.english: I did not care for that.

sense_groups.chinese: 你得回避
sense_groups.english: You have to leave.

sense_groups.chinese: 你和这个社工睡过
sense_groups.english: You slept with our social worker

sense_groups.chinese: 再没联络她
sense_groups.english: and never called her back.

sense_groups.chinese: 她还在生你的气
sense_groups.english: She is still pissed,

sense_groups.chinese: 不能让她见到你
sense_groups.english: so she can't see you.

sense_groups.chinese: 好 好
sense_groups.english: Okay, okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么了 -忘了拿球棒
sense_groups.english: What? - I forgot my bat.

sense_groups.chinese: 天呐
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 最后一次告诉你
sense_groups.english: And for the last time,

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不想和你做朋友
sense_groups.english: we do not want to be friends with you!

sense_groups.chinese: 也不想买你的球棒
sense_groups.english: And we don't wanna buy your bat!

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这儿干什么
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here?
Bert...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是朋友
sense_groups.english: Are you friends with him?

sense_groups.chinese: 我来解释
sense_groups.english: I can explain.

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊你说
sense_groups.english: Joey?

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: All right. Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还敢回来 太有种了
sense_groups.english: You have got some nerve coming back here.

sense_groups.chinese: 真不敢相信你竟从来没给我打过电话
sense_groups.english: I can't believe you never called me.

sense_groups.chinese: 你说什么呢
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 你可能连我名字也忘了吧
sense_groups.english: You probably don't even remember my name.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 我叫乔伊
sense_groups.english: It's Joey, by the way.

sense_groups.chinese: 不必说你的名字
sense_groups.english: And don't bother telling me yours,

sense_groups.chinese: 我记得 女士
sense_groups.english: because I totally remember it, lady.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一直等你电话
sense_groups.english: I waited weeks for you to call me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给你电话号码了
sense_groups.english: I gave you my number.

sense_groups.chinese: 你没联系我啊
sense_groups.english: You never called me.

sense_groups.chinese: 还想把屎盆子往我身上扣
sense_groups.english: Don't try to turn this around on me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我可不是
sense_groups.english: I am not some kind of social work...

sense_groups.chinese: 让你可以随便做的
sense_groups.english: ...that you can just...

sense_groups.chinese: 社会工作
我确信给过你电话
sense_groups.english: I'm pretty sure I gave you my number.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的吗 那你想想看
sense_groups.english: Really? Think about it. Come on.

sense_groups.chinese: 你这么漂亮
sense_groups.english: You're a beautiful woman.

sense_groups.chinese: 聪明又有趣
sense_groups.english: Smart, funny.

sense_groups.chinese: 你我春风一度
sense_groups.english: We had a really good time.

sense_groups.chinese: 如果我有你电话
sense_groups.english: If I had your number,

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么可能不打给你
sense_groups.english: why wouldn't I call you?

sense_groups.chinese: 就是不知道呀
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 可能我搞错了
sense_groups.english: Well, maybe I'm wrong.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 现在道歉太晚啦
sense_groups.english: Hey, too late for apologies. Okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 你伤了我的心
sense_groups.english: You broke my heart.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道就为了忘掉你
sense_groups.english: You know how many women

sense_groups.chinese: 我睡了多少女人吗
sense_groups.english: I had to sleep with to get over you?

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 留步... -不
sense_groups.english: Joey, wait-- - No!

sense_groups.chinese: 我等得够久
sense_groups.english: I waited a long time!

sense_groups.chinese: 不可能再等了
sense_groups.english: I can't wait anymore.

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉让你们笑话了
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry that you had to see that.

sense_groups.chinese: 太丢人了
sense_groups.english: I'm so embarrassed.

sense_groups.chinese: 没事
sense_groups.english: Oh, that's really okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们理解
sense_groups.english: Yeah. We totally understand.

sense_groups.chinese: 约会可够人受的
sense_groups.english: Dating is hard.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们真是好人
sense_groups.english: Boy, you people are nice.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得说…
sense_groups.english: And I've got to say...

sense_groups.chinese: 你们一定会是很棒的父母
sense_groups.english: ...l think you're going to make excellent parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 劳拉
sense_groups.english: Laura!

sense_groups.chinese: 我们回来啦
sense_groups.english: We're back.

sense_groups.chinese: 你们是想再多要点钱
sense_groups.english: Are you here to take more money?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们应该找提款机
sense_groups.english: Because I think what you're looking for is an ATM.

sense_groups.chinese: 不不 我们把钱退给你们
sense_groups.english: No, no, we're here to give the money back.

sense_groups.chinese: 因为你知道
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Because you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 一切都是为了孩子
sense_groups.english: It's all about the children.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 我们的婚礼也很重要
sense_groups.english: Although it's also about the wedding.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 给
sense_groups.english: All right, here.

sense_groups.chinese: 不要 天呐

sense_groups.english: Hello?

sense_groups.english: This feels perfectly normal.

sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 好啊
sense_groups.english: Okay.
