questions.name: S10E08
questions.en:
Hey, guys. - Hey.
Hi. - Hey.
We need to talk about something.
Yeah. We don't feel like
we can host Thanksgiving this year.
What... - Are you kidding?
Well, it's just with work and the stress of adoption...
...we don't feel like we have the energy.
Plus, we don't think it's fair
that every year the burden falls on us.
That doesn't sound like you.
That's Monica talking.
No, no, we made this decision together.
She's putting words in your mouth.
Don't you put words in people's mouths.
You put turkey in people's mouths.
I can't believe this.
This is Emma's first Thanksgiving.
No, it's not.
It's not? When was she born?
Well, personally,
I think it's great you're giving yourself a break.
Thank you, Pheebs.
Sure. It's just as well.
I mean, last year wasn't very good.
I think she's losing her touch.
What? You are way off, lady.
Am l? Really? Am l?
Well, why don't you cook Thanksgiving dinner
and prove me wrong.
Well, think about it.
You'd be trying to top what you did last year.
You'd be in competition with yourself.
That's my favorite kind.
Okay, we are doing this.
Don't let yourself get manipulated this way.
Stay out of this, Chandler.
This is between me and me.
We are supposed to
make these decisions together.
Did you not watch the Dr. Phil I taped for you?
Hey. - Hi. Happy Thanksgiving.
Happy Needless Turkey-Murder Day.
You guys, I ordered some chocolate pies
from that bakery on Bleeker.
Could you pick them up for me?
You're not making the pies?
I don't make chocolate pies.
When I was younger,
I entered this pie-eating contest.
I ate so many
that the thought of them makes me sick.
Did you at least win the contest?
Two minutes, twelve pies and a part of one tin.
Okay, I'll see you guys at 4.
Can't wait.
This dinner is gonna be so great.
In your face, last-year me.
Hey, Rach? - Yeah.
What's Emma doing today?
Well, let's see,
I know that she has a meeting with her lawyer...
...and then she has to make a very big poop.
Why?
Well, I want to enter her in a baby pageant.
Oh, my God.
That's the creepiest thing I've ever heard.
Okay, but before you say no,
my friend Suzanne is entering her kid.
And compared to Emma,
she's a real dog.
Phoebe, all babies are beautiful.
Oh, okay.
No. Phoebe,
just the idea of pitting one baby against another...
...l mean, you know,
and judging who's cuter just for a trophy...
And a thousand dollars.
...is something I'm very interested in.
Oh, please, do not tell Ross.
He still believes that
what's on the inside is important.
Okay. And Emma needs a cowgirl outfit
for the competition.
Where am I gonna get a cowgirl outfit on Thanksgiving?
Well, I was thinking
Take the clothes off Joey's Cabbage Patch Kid!
Did someone drop the baton again?
Why come all the way from Kansas
to do that?
I don't get older, I just get better.
You know what just occurred to me?
This could be our last Thanksgiving
just the two of us.
I mean, we could be getting a baby soon.
You don't know that.
Somebody's gonna pick us.
But we haven't heard a thing
from the adoption agency.
I'm telling you, it's gonna happen.
Next year,
it's gonna be you, me and little Hemingway Bing.
What? He's my favorite author.
Name one of his books.
The Firm?
Okay, let's see. Okay, the turkey's in the oven.
The stuffing is ready.
You know,
you always cook this meal all by yourself.
Let me help this year.
Oh, Chandler, that's sweet.
But you don't have to do everything Dr. Phil tells you to do.
I'm serious, let me do something.
Just not the turkey. Nothing high-profile.
Okay, let's see.
Oh, the cranberry sauce.
It's easy to make,
and no one really cares about it.
Tell me more.
I'm gonna go check on something across the hall.
You start by washing these.
Not with soap!
You obviously haven't tasted my Palmolive potatoes.
Hi. Hey, guess what Joey has.
Three tickets to today's Rangers game!
Dude, I wanted him to guess.
Oh, my God.
Yeah, they're great seats too.
Guess where they are.
Center ice.
Did I do something to you?
The game's at 1.
So?
Dinner's at 4. We'll never make it back.
So we'll leave before it's over.
We'll be back in time.
You said that now.
But it could take us a long time to get back home.
Plus, Joey could get lost
and they could have to page us to go pick him up.
Dude, two times that happened!
Look, Monica's been working hard all day.
She didn't want to host in the first place.
We shouldn't go.
He's right, man.
Yeah, I guess. So we'll see you at 4.
Okay.
And get ready to taste
my very special cranberries.
Or should I say "Chan-berries"?
That's some gentle comedy, dude.
We're still going to the game, right?
Yeah.
Hey.
Phoebe, listen, I think we gotta go.
This place is freaking me out.
I've been watching this guy over there.
I don't think he came with a kid.
But we can't leave now.
There was this one baby, Haley,
who was favored to win...
...she got croup, so she had to stay home.
This competition just blew wide-open, folks.
Phoebe, it's just too weird.
I just saw a 1 -year-old with pantyhose on.
Oh, I know. We should've been more prepared.
It's okay. Now, the way I see it,
our real competition now is Cameron.
My God, they just took her sweater off.
Look at those arms. Hello, Michelin Man.
Phoebe, come on.
You know what, it's already 3:00.
They haven't even gotten to Emma's group yet.
We got dinner.
But Emma's got what it takes.
She could go all the way!
Phoebe, you have to calm down.
Okay.
Rachel, the hottest babies in the tri-state area
are in this room right now.
I overheard a judge say
that not one of them holds a candle to Emma.
Really? - Yeah.
You heard him say that?
Yeah.
All right. Okay. All right,
let's give these babies something to cry about.
Good. Let's get down to business.
Emma needs some makeup.
What?
She's gonna look washed-out next to the others.
No, Phoebe, I'm not letting you put makeup on my baby.
Why not?
Because I already did.
You suck! Get off the ice, you idiot!
What a game. - I know. Yeah.
I can't believe Chandler's missing this.
I'm sorry he's not here.
But I gotta say,
I am really enjoying nacho chair.
Yeah, I'd probably enjoy it more
if you didn't keep batting my hand away.
These seats are great.
I know, I know.
When I was here for "Holidays on lce" ...
...l was sitting so far away,
Michelle Kwan couldn't read my banner.
We'd better get going.
If we don't leave now, we're gonna be late.
But it's a tie game.
So we're a little late.
The girls will be there.
Let's just stay for one more goal.
I don't know. - One more fight.
Okay. - Okay.
Where is everybody?
They're 45 minutes late.
I can't believe they're not here.
I slave and I slave for what?
They've ruined Cranberry Day.
How late are we?
Forty-five minutes.
Here. - Okay.
Rachel and Phoebe are already there,
so they probably started without us.
We could just slip in,
and no one needs to know where we were.
You may want to lose the foam finger.
Oh, no, no, no.
You just want to put it on your hand.
You're not at Thanksgiving?
No, we're late.
What are you doing here?
We're late too.
We figured we could be late
because you'd be on time.
Don't point that thing at me, Tribbiani.
So nobody's here?
Monica's gonna kill us.
Yeah, where were you?
Yeah, what's with the trophy?
Well, we were at a spelling bee.
And I won.
You won an adult
Thanksgiving Day spelling bee?
Yes. Y-E-S. Yes.
Let me see this.
"Grand Supreme Little Darling, New York Division"?
That's me.
You entered Emma in a beauty pageant?
And it looks like she put makeup on her.
Wait a second...
Where have I seen that cowgirl outfit before?
I can't believe this.
She's our daughter.
That you would treat her like some kind of show dog
is inexcusable.
She won a thousand dollars.
So this is an annual thing?
That's Alicia May Emory's outfit!
Guys, there are people in there
who are not getting any happier.
What are we gonna do?
I don't know, you guys figure it out.
I gotta put Emma down for a nap.
And, Rach, while you're in there,
throw something on Alicia May.
All right, what are we gonna say?
We'll say that we were mugged.
You can't get mad at someone
who's been mugged.
Good. But you don't look like you were mugged.
No. Here.
Hey!
Do you hear something?
They're out there. - Let me see.
I can't believe this.
They're an hour late,
and they're just standing there talking.
Everything's so distorted.
It looks like Joey has a giant hand.
That says "Rangers" on it.
They went to the game.
Oh, they are in for a world of pain.
Ross' shirt is torn.
They're late and they're sloppy.
All right, Emma's napping.
What happened to your shirt?
I got mugged,
and they stole my pocket.
We're just trying to figure out an excuse.
How about this?
We could say that
Monica told us 5:00, not 4:00.
That way we're right on time.
Or we could plant PCP in the apartment
and call the cops on her.
That would be a good way
to get rid of all the PCP we have lying around.
We'll just say that she said it was 5:00.
We'll just act casual.
We're not late, we're right on time.
"We know you're out there."
Who do you think it's from?
Oh, God, this is bad. This is so bad.
Well, let's just go in there and face them.
I'm not going in first.
I bet that vein on Monica's forehead is popping like crazy.
I hate that thing.
It's like a bolt of lightning.
I have an idea.
Why don't we play Rock, Paper, Scissors,
and whoever loses, goes in first.
All right, I'm in. - Ready.
I win.
What is that?
That's fire. It beats everything.
Oh, really? Does it beat water balloon?
Well-played, Phoebe Buffay. Well-played.
All right, enough,
let's all go in at the same time.
Okay. - Okay.
It's locked.
What? Oh, sure, now they lock it.
When they're having sex
on the couch, it's like
"Come on in, my butt is surprisingly hairy!"
All right, come on. All right, you guys,
we're so sorry we're late.
Please let us in so we can have dinner together.
No, everything's cold.
The turkey's dried out and the stuffing's all soggy.
Yeah, and there's a bowl of cranberry sauce that's
What happens to cranberry sauce?
Nothing, it's fine.
Oh, thank God.
Come on, you guys, we're sorry.
Our subway broke down.
That's a lie!
You went to the game.
I can see Joey's hand.
For the love of God, take it off!
Guys, it doesn't matter why we're late.
We're all here now.
Please let us in so we can
have some of your delicious turkey.
I had a dream once
about a fax machine that did that.
That's all the turkey you're gonna get.
How are we gonna decide who gets this?
Water balloon!
What are we gonna do?
I'm starving.
I just remembered,
we do have something to eat.
Monica put something
in our oven this morning.
You touch that, and you will be sorry!
Guys, I'd listen to her.
The vein is bigger than I've ever seen it!
Oh, my God, it's Brussels sprouts!
That's worse than no food.
All you got was Monica's stinky Brussels sprouts.
Stinky?
Please let me stay on this side of the door.
Oh, I know! I still have my old key.
We can just unlock the door.
I don't know if that's a good idea.
They don't wanna be with us.
You know what.
I don't wanna be with them either...
...but it's Thanksgiving,
and we should not want to be together together.
If I could just get in there,
make a face-to-face apology...
...look them in the eye,
I could get them to forgive us.
I don't know.
I'm telling you...
...l can do it.
Yeah, he can do it.
It all looks so beautiful.
The turkey, the stuffing.
The cranberries.
Enough! A monkey could've made them.
Hey, listen, guys, we feel really terrible.
He's doing that weird eye-contact thing.
Don't look at him.
Come on, you guys.
We want you to know we're very, very sorry.
Right, guys?
I feel terrible. - Oh, so sorry.
But let's not ruin this day.
You've worked so hard.
Let's move past this
and try to have a nice meal all together, huh?
The floating heads do make a good point.
Yeah, they do seem to feel pretty bad.
So bad.
So bad.
Okay.
Okay, you two go get the dessert,
and I'll let you in.
Dessert?
Yeah, I asked you and Phoebe to pick up the pies.
You did remember, right?
Pies. Oh, we thought you said "prize."
Here.
"Grand Supreme Little Darling"?
Congratulations!
Oh, my God, you forgot the pies?
Well, I cannot believe this.
You forced me to make dinner,
you're an hour late...
...and you forget the one little thing
that I asked you to do.
Really, girls, not cool.
Well, you man-heads aren't any better.
You lied about going to the game.
You knew it'd make you late,
and you went anyway.
Hey, I'm getting a little tired of this.
We said we're sorry.
It's Thanksgiving, for Pete's sakes!
A day of forgiveness.
It's a day to be thankful.
Don't make me come up there!
It's too late for apologies.
Fine, let's just go.
I don't need your stupid dinner.
That would be a lot more convincing
if you weren't drooling.
Oh, is that what that is?
Sorry.
Come on, you guys, let's just do our own Thanksgiving.
Yeah, I'll cook.
Yeah, let's go out.
Yeah, you three have a nice Thanksgiving.
The three of us?
Yeah. You, Chan and the vein.
I'm stuck.
Joey, that is not gonna work.
No, seriously.
I'm really wedged in here.
I'll pull you through.
Okay.
Stop.
I'm worried about damaging my head.
It's a little late for that.
Hurry up, you gotta do something.
All right, well, this does not change anything.
We need to get something
to grease the sides of his face
We got turkey grease.
Bring it.
I just want to say that I'm sorry
I referred to the vein as a separate person.
Here you go.
Oh, that smells good.
Okay? - Okay, try it.
It isn't working.
We're gonna have to unscrew the chain.
Hurry, I can't feel my ears.
Can you ever feel your ears?
Interesting.
Chandler, where are your tools?
Oh, I left them on my bulldozer.
I don't have tools.
Well, I do, but Rachel borrowed them.
I lent them to Ross.
I gave them to Joey.
I left them at the park.
I'm finding it really hard not to mess with him.
I stuffed Brussels sprouts down his pants.
Nice.
Okay, I have to get that.
Now, when I get back,
I want you and your friends to be gone.
Thanksgiving is over.
The vein has spoken.
It's really starting to hurt.
Look, I'm gonna pull on the door...
...and you guys push.
Maybe we can get enough room to wiggle him out, okay?
Okay, so push.
Just a sec.
We're kind of in the middle of something here.
Hey, stop putting things down my pants.
Come on, guys, push!
Yeah, come on, push!
Push! Push!
My cranberries!
Man, I got food all over me.
I can't believe what you did.
Monica's gonna kill you.
Look! Look! Look
what the-- Look what the floating heads did!
I don't care.
What's going on?
That was the adoption agency.
And?
We're getting a baby!
Are you serious?!
There's a pregnant woman in Ohio,
and she picked us.
Oh, my God, that's great!
That's incredible.
I'm so happy for you.
This Thanksgiving kicks last Thanksgiving's ass!
To Monica and Chandler
and that knocked-up girl in Ohio.
I'm just so happy
you guys are finally getting a kid.
I know. Have you considered pageanting?
I can't believe they called.
I mean, we're actually getting a baby.
I know how you feel.
Really? - Sure.
I went through the exact same thing
with Alicia May Emory.
The waiting, the wondering.
Then one day,
I get that call from Toys"R"Us.
She was in stock.
That is the exact same thing.

sense_groups.english: Well, if it annoys you so much,

sense_groups.chinese: 你干吗也那么做呢
sense_groups.english: then why do you do it?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 嗨 谢天谢地
sense_groups.english: Oh, hi. Hi. Thanks for showing up

sense_groups.chinese: 你才晚了30分钟
sense_groups.english: 30 minutes late.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯
sense_groups.english: Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用多费口舌 我肯定你有个好借口
sense_groups.english: No, I'm sure you have a great excuse.

sense_groups.chinese: 是什么 美发预约
sense_groups.english: What was it, a hair appointment?

sense_groups.chinese: 美甲
sense_groups.english: A mani-pedi?

sense_groups.chinese: 还是巴尼斯大降价
sense_groups.english: Was there a sale at Barneys?{

sense_groups.chinese: 我爸爸得了心脏病
sense_groups.english: My father had a heart attack.

sense_groups.chinese: 在我逛巴尼斯的时候
sense_groups.english: While I was at Barneys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊 瑞秋 -亲爱的
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God, Rach. - Honey?

sense_groups.chinese: 我很抱歉 -他还好吧
sense_groups.english: I'm so sorry. - Is he okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 是的 他们说他会好的
sense_groups.english: Yeah, he's gonna be fine,

sense_groups.chinese: 但还是打了很多镇静剂
sense_groups.english: but he's heavily sedated.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我跟你一起去长岛
sense_groups.english: Okay, I'm gonna go to Long lsland with you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在一个人怎么行
sense_groups.english: I mean, you can't be alone right now.

sense_groups.chinese: 不用了 我还行
sense_groups.english: No, come on, I'm totally okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 我用不着你来
sense_groups.english: I don't need you to come.

sense_groups.chinese: 我一个人能行
sense_groups.english: I can totally handle this on my own.

sense_groups.chinese: 尽管如此 还是让我来吧… 就算是为了我
sense_groups.english: Still, still, let me come for me.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 如果你真的需要的话
sense_groups.english: Okay. If you really need to.

sense_groups.chinese: 我看吃点莫妮卡刚烤好的饼干
sense_groups.english: I bet someone could use

sense_groups.chinese: 你感觉会好点
sense_groups.english: one of Monica's freshly baked cookies.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我还真想吃点
sense_groups.english: Oh, I really could.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 这看起来很简单
sense_groups.english: All right, it seems pretty simple.

sense_groups.chinese: 你的第一句台词是 "我的名字叫克劳德"
sense_groups.english: Your first line is, "My name is Claude."

sense_groups.chinese: 好 跟我念
sense_groups.english: So just repeat after me.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 我们再试一遍 -好
sense_groups.english: Well, let's try it again. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你跟我说的
sense_groups.english: It's not...

sense_groups.chinese: 不太一样
sense_groups.english: ...quite what I'm saying.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我听着一模一样啊
sense_groups.english: Really? Sounds exactly the same to me.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吗 真的 -好吧
sense_groups.english: It does, really? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们再试一遍 -好吧
sense_groups.english: Let's just try it again. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 仔细听着 -好嘞
sense_groups.english: Really listen. - Got it.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 伙计们 -嘿
sense_groups.english: Hey, you guys! - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 给你们介绍一个很特别的贵宾
sense_groups.english: I want you to meet someone really special.

sense_groups.chinese: 菲比 这是艾瑞卡 这是小宝宝
sense_groups.english: Phoebe, this is Erica. And this is the baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 乔伊 艾瑞卡 宝宝 -嘿
sense_groups.english: Joey, Erica, baby. - Hi.

sense_groups.chinese: 大家伙儿 艾瑞卡 宝宝
sense_groups.english: Everyone, Erica! Baby!

sense_groups.chinese: 莫妮卡 冷静...点儿
sense_groups.english: Monica. Calm. Self.

sense_groups.chinese: 请坐 -谢谢
sense_groups.english: Hey, sit down. - Thank you.

sense_groups.chinese: 真高兴见到你们
sense_groups.english: It's really nice to meet you guys.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都不敢相信来到这儿了
sense_groups.english: I can't believe I'm here.

sense_groups.chinese: 欢迎来到纽约 或者我应该说
sense_groups.english: Well, welcome to New York City, or should I say

sense_groups.chinese: 你干吗要说那个
sense_groups.english: Why would you say that?

sense_groups.chinese: 你们今天打算干什么
sense_groups.english: Okay. What are you gonna be doing today?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我想看看所有的地方
sense_groups.english: Well, I wanna see everything!

sense_groups.chinese: 时代广场 科尼岛 洛克菲勒中心
sense_groups.english: Times Square, Coney lsland, Rockefeller Center.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 你知道你该干什么吗
sense_groups.english: Oh, you know what you should do?

sense_groups.chinese: 你应该一路爬到
sense_groups.english: You should walk to

sense_groups.chinese: 自由女神像的顶上
sense_groups.english: the top of the Statue of Liberty.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 对呀 我们去爬吧 -太好了
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah, let's do that. - Great.

sense_groups.chinese: 这个小宝宝得够结实才行
sense_groups.english: This baby better be really good.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 打扰一下
sense_groups.english: Hi. Excuse me,

sense_groups.chinese: 我来看望我的父亲
sense_groups.english: I'm here to see my father.

sense_groups.chinese: 我叫瑞秋·格林
sense_groups.english: My name is Rachel Green.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是罗斯·盖勒博士
sense_groups.english: And I'm Dr. Ross Geller.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 行了吧 这里是医院
sense_groups.english: Ross, please, this is a hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 这词儿在这儿是有其他意义的
sense_groups.english: That actually means something here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 我们能进去吗 -当然
sense_groups.english: So can we please go in? - Absolutely.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 我想我还是等在外面吧
sense_groups.english: Rach, I think I'm gonna wait out here...

sense_groups.chinese: 我的喉咙有点痒
sense_groups.english: ...because my throat is feeling a little scratchy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想传染给他
sense_groups.english: I don't wanna infect him.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 得了 别那么怕他
sense_groups.english: Ross, please. Don't be so scared of him.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不是怕他 我真的病了
sense_groups.english: I am not scared of him. I'm really sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 镇静剂药效还没退
sense_groups.english: He's under sedation,

sense_groups.chinese: 所以他还在昏睡着
sense_groups.english: so he's pretty much out.

sense_groups.chinese: 我感觉好多了
sense_groups.english: I'm feeling better.

sense_groups.chinese: 我的天啊
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 我给他买的耳毛和鼻毛剪
sense_groups.english: That ear and nose hair trimmer I got him

sense_groups.chinese: 算是白花钱了
sense_groups.english: was just money down the drain, huh?

sense_groups.chinese: 格林小姐
sense_groups.english: Ms. Green?

sense_groups.chinese: 你爸爸的医生在电话上
sense_groups.english: Your father's doctor's on the phone

sense_groups.chinese: 你要不要跟他谈谈
sense_groups.english: if you'd like to speak to him.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好的 呃 你在这等着没事吧
sense_groups.english: Oh, great. Are you gonna be okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 他还不省人事 我想我们没事儿
sense_groups.english: He's unconscious. We'll be just fine.

sense_groups.chinese: 好
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是电视吧你吵醒了 -不是
sense_groups.english: Did the TV wake you? - No.

sense_groups.chinese: 你把脚翘到我床上
sense_groups.english: When you put your feet up on my bed,

sense_groups.chinese: 压住我的导尿管了
sense_groups.english: you tugged on my catheter.

sense_groups.chinese: 你来这儿干吗
sense_groups.english: What are you doing here, Geller?

sense_groups.chinese: 我和瑞秋一块儿来的
sense_groups.english: Well, I came with Rachel,

sense_groups.chinese: 她一会儿就回来
sense_groups.english: who should be back any second.

sense_groups.chinese: 最近怎么样
sense_groups.english: So, what's new?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我得了点儿心脏病
sense_groups.english: Oh, I had a little heart attack.

sense_groups.chinese: 是吧 疼吗
sense_groups.english: Right. Is it painful?

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 你是指心脏病
sense_groups.english: What, the heart attack

sense_groups.chinese: 还是指在这跟你聊天
sense_groups.english: or sitting here talking to you?

sense_groups.chinese: 看看能不能把瑞秋叫过来
sense_groups.english: Let's see if we can get that Rachel back in here.

sense_groups.chinese: 那你最近怎么样
sense_groups.english: So, what's new with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 是不是又让我别的女儿也怀孕了
sense_groups.english: Knocked up any more of my daughters lately?

sense_groups.chinese: 没有 只有那一个 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: Nope. Just the one. Rach!

sense_groups.chinese: 不对
sense_groups.english: No!

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 也许我们应该拆散了试试
sense_groups.english: Okay, maybe if we just break it down.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我们试试一次一个音节
sense_groups.english: Okay, let's try it one syllable at a time.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 跟我念
sense_groups.english: Okay, so repeat after me.

sense_groups.chinese: 很好 快一点
sense_groups.english: Great! Okay, faster.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 这太难了 我教不了你
sense_groups.english: Okay, it's too hard. I can't teach you.

sense_groups.chinese: 你干吗
sense_groups.english: What are you doing?

sense_groups.chinese: 我得走了
sense_groups.english: I have to go

sense_groups.chinese: 不然我要拿你的头撞墙了
sense_groups.english: before I put your head through a wall.

sense_groups.chinese: 不 别走 我需要你
sense_groups.english: Don't go, I need you!

sense_groups.chinese: 我明天就要试镜了
sense_groups.english: My audition is tomorrow!

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 我本来想做晚饭的
sense_groups.english: Hey. I was gonna make us some dinner...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是你爸的冰箱里
sense_groups.english: ...but all I found in your dad's fridge

sense_groups.chinese: 只有培根和奶油
sense_groups.english: was bacon and heavy cream.

sense_groups.chinese: 我想我们找到
sense_groups.english: I think we solved

sense_groups.chinese: 他得心脏病的原因了
sense_groups.english: the mystery of the heart attack.

sense_groups.chinese: 你给你父母打电话了吗
sense_groups.english: Did you call your parents?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 打过了 艾玛很好
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah. Emma's doing great.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 好
sense_groups.english: Oh, good.

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么 -只是不敢相信
sense_groups.english: What? - I just can't believe...

sense_groups.chinese: 我在瑞秋·格林的房间里
sense_groups.english: ...I'm in Rachel Green's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 你什么意思
sense_groups.english: What do you mean?

sense_groups.chinese: 你以前到过我的房间
sense_groups.english: You've been in my room before.

sense_groups.chinese: 可不是
sense_groups.english: Yeah, sure, right.

sense_groups.chinese: 就跟我真来过瑞秋·格林房间似的
sense_groups.english: Like I'd ever be in Rachel Green's room.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 我得跟你说
sense_groups.english: Okay, I gotta tell you,

sense_groups.chinese: 你叫我的全名可真有点儿怪
sense_groups.english: it's really weird when you use my whole name.

sense_groups.chinese: 对不起
sense_groups.english: Sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 你还好吧 -还行
sense_groups.english: You okay? - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 今天太累了 是吧 -是啊
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you had a rough day. - Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到他那个样子很奇怪 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: It's just so weird seeing him like that, you know?

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 他是个医生
sense_groups.english: I mean, he's a doctor.

sense_groups.chinese: 医生怎么会得病的呢
sense_groups.english: You don't expect doctors to get sick.

sense_groups.chinese: 但我们确实会得病
sense_groups.english: But we do.

sense_groups.chinese: 他会好的 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: He's gonna be okay, Rach.

sense_groups.chinese: 我不想让他醒来一个人
sense_groups.english: I don't want him to wake up alone.

sense_groups.chinese: 我得去医院
sense_groups.english: I should go to the hospital.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 不 等等 嘿 你看
sense_groups.english: What? No, no. Hey, hey, look.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.chinese: 他服了很多镇静药
sense_groups.english: They gave him a lot of medication.

sense_groups.chinese: 他甚至都不会知道你在不在那儿
sense_groups.english: He wouldn't even know if you were there.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们明天一早就去看他 好吗
sense_groups.english: We'll go see him first thing in the morning. Ok?

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 我不去也不用于心有愧
sense_groups.english: Really? I shouldn't feel guilty?

sense_groups.chinese: 不用 天啊 嘿
sense_groups.english: No-- God, hey.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋 你是个好女儿 知道吗
sense_groups.english: Rach, you've been an amazing daughter, okay?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在 你需要好好休息一下
sense_groups.english: Right now you need to get some rest.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧 也许你说得对
sense_groups.english: Okay, maybe you're right.

sense_groups.chinese: 晚安
sense_groups.english: Good night.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等...
sense_groups.english: Wait, wait, wait.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能不能在这
sense_groups.english: Would you stay here

sense_groups.chinese: 陪我呆一会儿
sense_groups.english: with me for a little while?

sense_groups.chinese: 当然 -好
sense_groups.english: Sure. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你今天陪我来
sense_groups.english: Thank you for coming with me today.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 应该的
sense_groups.english: Oh, of course.

sense_groups.chinese: 瑞秋·格林很高兴你在她房间里
sense_groups.english: Rachel Green is very happy you're in her room.

sense_groups.chinese: 我也很高兴 来
sense_groups.english: Me too. Come here.

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是不想晚上一个人在这儿
sense_groups.english: I just don't wanna be alone tonight.

sense_groups.chinese: 那好
sense_groups.english: Okay, well,

sense_groups.chinese: 我可以找条睡袋什么的...
sense_groups.english: I can maybe grab a sleeping bag or

sense_groups.chinese: 不行 瑞秋
sense_groups.english: No, Rach!

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry,

sense_groups.chinese: 我只是觉得这样不好
sense_groups.english: I just don't think this is a good idea.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们不做怎么知道好不好
sense_groups.english: Well, we won't know that until we do it,

sense_groups.chinese: 对吧
sense_groups.english: will we?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 你看 嗯…
sense_groups.english: No, look, uh.

sense_groups.chinese: 你为你父亲的事儿心烦
sense_groups.english: You are upset about your father,

sense_groups.chinese: 你现在很脆弱
sense_groups.english: and you're feeling vulnerable...

sense_groups.chinese: 而且我觉得这时候
sense_groups.english: ...and I just don't feel it

sense_groups.chinese: 这么做不对
sense_groups.english: would be right.

sense_groups.chinese: 我会觉得
sense_groups.english: I feel like I'd be, you know,

sense_groups.chinese: 这是在占你便宜
sense_groups.english: taking advantage of you.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么 占便宜
sense_groups.english: What--? Taking advantage?

sense_groups.chinese: 我在主动投怀送抱 你尽兴好啦
sense_groups.english: I am giving you the advantage. Enjoy!

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道肯定会很美妙...
sense_groups.english: Look, I'm sure it would be great...

sense_groups.chinese: 但我认为我们俩得有一个保持清醒
sense_groups.english: ...but I think one of us has to be thinking clearly.

sense_groups.chinese: 所以我要走了
sense_groups.english: So I'm gonna go.

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 明天早上见
sense_groups.english: I'll see you in the morning.

sense_groups.chinese: 我都4个月没有做爱了
sense_groups.english: I haven't had sex in four months.

sense_groups.chinese: 我刚才的高姿态应该得块奖章
sense_groups.english: I should get a medal for that!

sense_groups.chinese: 谢谢你们带我去了那么多地方
sense_groups.english: Thanks so much for taking me to all those places.

sense_groups.chinese: 我玩得很高兴
sense_groups.english: I had a great time.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我也很高兴
sense_groups.english: I'm glad.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是 我得为钱德勒道歉
sense_groups.english: Listen, I wanna apologize about Chandler, though.

sense_groups.chinese: 我没想到他会这样
sense_groups.english: I just did not see this coming.

sense_groups.chinese: 纽约可真棒
sense_groups.english: New York is awesome!

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么回事儿
sense_groups.english: What is with you?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗 我以前去过那些地方
sense_groups.english: You know, I've been to these places before...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是我都没有好好看过风景
sense_groups.english: ...but I've never really seen them.

sense_groups.chinese: 没错 你学牛叫的时候错过好多风景
sense_groups.english: Yeah, you miss a lot when you're mooing.

sense_groups.chinese: 非常感谢你们带我观光
sense_groups.english: Thank you for showing me around.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我们很高兴陪你去
sense_groups.english: Oh, it was our pleasure.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们也想跟你熟悉熟悉
sense_groups.english: We're so much enjoying getting to know you.

sense_groups.chinese: 呃 你们还有什么想了解的吗
sense_groups.english: Well, if there's anything else you wanna know....

sense_groups.chinese: 好吧
sense_groups.english: Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会介意我问几个
sense_groups.english: Can we ask you some questions

sense_groups.chinese: 有关孩子父亲的问题吧
sense_groups.english: about the father?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 没关系
sense_groups.english: Oh, sure. Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 他是我高中的男朋友
sense_groups.english: Well, he was my high-school boyfriend,

sense_groups.chinese: 足球队长 很可爱
sense_groups.english: captain of the football team, really cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 后来他得到奖学金 上了大学
sense_groups.english: Got a scholarship and went to college.

sense_groups.chinese: 那不错啊
sense_groups.english: That's great.

sense_groups.chinese: 是啊 差不多就是他了
sense_groups.english: Yeah, it's almost definitely him.

sense_groups.chinese: 那怎么说
sense_groups.english: How's that, now?

sense_groups.chinese: 也有可能是另外一个人
sense_groups.english: Well, there's a chance it's another guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 我只跟两个人好过
sense_groups.english: I mean, I've only ever been with two guys...

sense_groups.chinese: 但是时间上有些重叠
sense_groups.english: ...but they sort of overlapped.

sense_groups.chinese: 那么 另一个人是干什么的
sense_groups.english: So, what does the other guy do?

sense_groups.chinese: 他也上大学了吗
sense_groups.english: Does he go to college too?

sense_groups.chinese: 不 他在蹲监狱
sense_groups.english: No, he's in prison.

sense_groups.chinese: 那他是被诬告的吧
sense_groups.english: Was he falsely accused of something?

sense_groups.chinese: 不
sense_groups.english: No.

sense_groups.chinese: 他用铁铲杀了他爸爸
sense_groups.english: He killed his father with a shovel.

sense_groups.chinese: 但是除此之外 他还是个不错的人
sense_groups.english: Other than that, he's a great guy.

sense_groups.chinese: 我猜他爸爸不这么想
sense_groups.english: I'll bet his dad doesn't think so.

sense_groups.chinese: 你醒着呢吗 -我当然还醒着
sense_groups.english: Are you awake? - Of course I'm awake.

sense_groups.chinese: 从今往后我是睡不着啦
sense_groups.english: Assume from now on that I'm always awake.

sense_groups.english: We had an inspection

sense_groups.chinese: 不是的

sense_groups.english: Well, then great.

sense_groups.chinese: 我八岁

sense_groups.english: and Phoebe's married to Mike...

sense_groups.english: Well, if moving here is gonna make them happy,

sense_groups.english: Oh, I hate to admit it, but you're

sense_groups.english: You're probably right.

sense_groups.english: I read a lot.

sense_groups.chinese: 还以为我们能成为朋友
sense_groups.english: Just when I thought we could be friends.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 瑞秋 我刚听说 很抱歉

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 谢谢你...
sense_groups.english: Oh, thank you....

sense_groups.chinese: 还是不知道我的名字 对吗
sense_groups.english: You still don't know my name, do you?

sense_groups.chinese: 现在我不用知道了
sense_groups.english: Well, now I don't have to.

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 你怎么那么慢
sense_groups.english: Ross, what is taking you so long?

sense_groups.chinese: 抱歉 他们建造这门的时候
sense_groups.english: I'm sorry. It's almost as if

sense_groups.chinese: 怎么不考虑让你搬家能快些呢
sense_groups.english: this wasn't built for a quick getaway.

sense_groups.english: Mark? Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 你怎么样
sense_groups.english: How have you been?

sense_groups.chinese: 太好了 你记得罗斯
sense_groups.english: Fantastic. You remember Ross.

sense_groups.chinese: 当然
sense_groups.english: Sure.

sense_groups.chinese: 搬椅子干嘛
sense_groups.english: What's with the chair?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 在地铁上
sense_groups.english: You know, you can't always

sense_groups.chinese: 没有座位...
sense_groups.english: get a seat on the subway, so....

sense_groups.chinese: 真聪明
sense_groups.english: Clever.

sense_groups.chinese: 你最近怎么样
sense_groups.english: So how are you?

sense_groups.chinese: 真不巧 今天出点事儿
sense_groups.english: You're not catching me on my best day.

sense_groups.english: Yeah, a box full of your desk stuff doesn't say "big promotion."

sense_groups.chinese: 不 但也还好
sense_groups.english: No, but it's good.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道...我要休息一段时间...
sense_groups.english: You know, I'm gonna take some time off...

sense_groups.chinese: 做一些慈善工作 -你肯定吗
sense_groups.english: ...and do charity work. - Are you sure?

sense_groups.chinese: LV现在可能需要人
sense_groups.english: We may have something at Louis Vuitton.

sense_groups.chinese: 去它的慈善工作 你有什么消息
sense_groups.english: Screw charity work. What do you got?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们边吃饭边讨论吧
sense_groups.english: Why don't we have dinner and talk?

sense_groups.chinese: 我给你打电话 -好吧
sense_groups.english: Great. I'll call you. - Okay.

sense_groups.chinese: 很高兴又见到你
sense_groups.english: Nice to see you again.

sense_groups.chinese: 啊...我有终身职位了
sense_groups.english: Yeah. Yeah. I got tenure.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 我的天.
sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.chinese: 看到没有 我告诉你好事会来的
sense_groups.english: See? I told you something good would come along.

sense_groups.chinese: 他看起来真不错
sense_groups.english: And he seemed really nice.

sense_groups.english: I've met him before?

sense_groups.chinese: 罗斯 那是马克

sense_groups.english: From Bloomingdale's?

sense_groups.chinese: 当时你嫉妒得发狂
sense_groups.english: You were insanely jealous of him.

sense_groups.english: I hate that guy.

sense_groups.english: Okay, let's talk about it later. There comes security.

sense_groups.english: The trees and the big front yards and the actual picket fences.

sense_groups.english: Man, those two dogs are going at it.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 只是随处走走
sense_groups.english: Oh, just, you know, looking around.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: But you know what?

sense_groups.english: This house is great.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的 什么使你改变了
sense_groups.english: Really? What changed your mind?

sense_groups.english: The little girl who lives here made me feel better about the whole thing.

sense_groups.english: Joey? There was a little girl who lived here,

sense_groups.english: That's not funny.

sense_groups.english: What?

sense_groups.english: I get my own room?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不会认为我们
sense_groups.english: You don't think we'd buy a house

sense_groups.english: Oh, my God.

sense_groups.english: Thank you, Mr. Bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 我会的 这是我的丈夫大便·袋
sense_groups.english: Okay, I will. This is-- This is my husband, Crap Bag.

sense_groups.chinese: 大便·袋
sense_groups.english: Crap Bag?

sense_groups.chinese: 如果你需要记得容易点
sense_groups.english: If you need an easy way to remember it,

sense_groups.chinese: 就把它想象成一袋子大便

sense_groups.chinese: 好的 少陪了 -好

sense_groups.english: Okay, fine, you made your point.

sense_groups.chinese: 你能再做我的迈克·汉尼根
sense_groups.english: Can you please just be Mike Hannigan again?

sense_groups.chinese: 只要你还是菲比·布菲
sense_groups.english: Only if you'll be Phoebe Buffay.

sense_groups.chinese: 真的
sense_groups.english: Really?

sense_groups.chinese: 是
sense_groups.english: Yeah.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是菲比·布菲·汉尼根·巴娜娜·哈莫克
sense_groups.english: I'm Phoebe Buffay-Hannigan-Banana Hammock.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道巴娜娜·哈莫克是什么吗

sense_groups.chinese: 就是个有趣的字
sense_groups.english: It's a funny word.

sense_groups.chinese: 那是一种三角裤

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 糟了
sense_groups.english: Oh, crap.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 瑞秋在吗 -不

sense_groups.english: I guess. Why, who's she with?

sense_groups.chinese: 是马克
sense_groups.english: That guy, Mark...

sense_groups.chinese: 布明岱尔百货那个
sense_groups.english: ...from Bloomingdale's.

sense_groups.chinese: 她认为他只是对她好

sense_groups.english: But I know he really wants to sleep with her.

sense_groups.english: My time machine works.

sense_groups.english: We ran into him on the street today,

sense_groups.english: and he said he might have a job for her.

sense_groups.english: But I know he just wants to get into her pants.

sense_groups.english: I mean, she's single, and he's cute.

sense_groups.chinese: 什么
sense_groups.english: Excuse me?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 拜托
sense_groups.english: Oh, please.

sense_groups.chinese: 昨天在地铁上
sense_groups.english: Yesterday, on the subway, you couldn't stop staring...

sense_groups.chinese: 你不停地盯着一个大胸脯的女人看
sense_groups.english: ...at that woman with the big breasts the whole time.

sense_groups.chinese: 告诉你 我那是看她的小孩呢
sense_groups.english: For your information, I was staring at her baby.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们就要做父母了
sense_groups.english: We're about to be parents.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 对不起
sense_groups.english: Oh, sorry.

sense_groups.chinese: 嗨 大伙 -嗨
sense_groups.english: Hi, you guys. - Hi. So...

sense_groups.chinese: 晚饭怎么样
sense_groups.english: ...how was dinner?

sense_groups.chinese: 噢 很棒 马克人很好
sense_groups.english: Oh, it was great. Mark is so sweet.

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 是吗 我想知道为什么
sense_groups.english: Oh, yeah? Yeah, I wonder why?

sense_groups.chinese: 那个虚情假意的好色者想要什么呢
sense_groups.english: What could that smarmy letch possibly want?

sense_groups.chinese: 哦 罗斯 别这样 他已经结婚了
sense_groups.english: Oh, Ross. Come on. He is happily married.

sense_groups.chinese: 他的妻子生了双胞胎
sense_groups.english: His wife just had twins.

sense_groups.chinese: 我们应该送点什么礼物吗
sense_groups.english: Should we send something?

sense_groups.chinese: 工作怎么样
sense_groups.english: How did the job stuff go?

sense_groups.chinese: 他给了我一个工作机会
sense_groups.english: He offered me one.

sense_groups.chinese: 太棒了 -恭喜你
sense_groups.english: That's great. - Congratulations.

sense_groups.chinese: 我知道 那很棒
sense_groups.english: I know, it's amazing.

sense_groups.chinese: 那很棒 那比我在
sense_groups.english: It's amazing. It's so much better

sense_groups.chinese: 拉夫·劳伦要好得多
sense_groups.english: than what I had at Ralph Lauren.

sense_groups.chinese: 薪水很不错 -我们...
sense_groups.english: The money is great. - Can we--?

sense_groups.chinese: 我们能停一停吗
sense_groups.english: Can we just stop for a second?

sense_groups.chinese: 是谁说一切都会好起来的
sense_groups.english: Who said something better would come along?

sense_groups.chinese: 你不相信我
sense_groups.english: You didn't believe me.

sense_groups.chinese: 我告诉你一切都会有起色
sense_groups.english: I told you everything was gonna work out.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: You know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 这时候该来一瓶以色列佳酿
sense_groups.english: This calls for a bottle of lsrael's finest.

sense_groups.chinese: 工作地点在巴黎
sense_groups.english: The job is in Paris.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是说 这肥皂剧是很好的机会
sense_groups.english: I mean, this soap opera is a great gig...

sense_groups.chinese: 但这样做我是不是就错过机会了
sense_groups.english: ...but am I missing opportunities?

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道 我总是觉得我自己是个正经的演员
sense_groups.english: You know, I've always thought of myself as a serious actor.

sense_groups.chinese: 我是不是应该尝试更多的电影
sense_groups.english: Should I be trying to do more independent movies?

sense_groups.chinese: 我不知道
sense_groups.english: I don't know.

sense_groups.chinese: 你知道吗
sense_groups.english: But you know what?

sense_groups.chinese: 我让我的熊听电话
sense_groups.english: I'm gonna put you on with my bear.

sense_groups.chinese: 等等
sense_groups.english: Hold on.

sense_groups.chinese: 嘿 小熊 我需要一些事业上的意见
sense_groups.english: Hey, Bailey, I need some career advice.

questions.en:
How did the job stuff go?
He offered me one!
You know what?
This calls for a bottle of lsrael's finest!
The job is in Paris.
Oh, God, please, somebody say something.
So if you take this job,
you'll be moving to Paris?
Or facing a bitch of a commute.
I know, it's huge,
and it's scary
and it's really far away from you guys.
But this is such an incredible opportunity for me.
I've already told them about our situation with Emma...
...and they said they'll do whatever we need to make us feel comfortable.
I mean, I'll fly back and forth,
they'll fly you out.
Anything we want.
My boss said I might be getting a new lamp
in my cubicle.
All right. We'll work it out.
Oh, thank you. Thank you.
You sure this is what you want?
I think it is.
What's going on?
I got a really incredible job offer.
Hey, great! All right! - Good for you!
It's in Paris. - What?
No...
No, too much is changing, okay?
First Phoebe getting married.
Congratulations.
And then these two move in to
a stupid house in the stupid suburbs.
Earlier, you said you'd be supportive.
It comes and goes. I wouldn't trust it!
You guys, this is really,
really important to me.
It means a lot
if you could try to get onboard.
Of course we can. Congratulations.
Thank you.
Joey?
No, my hugs are reserved for people staying in America!
Joey, it would mean
No! Get your France-going arms away from me!
Are you okay with this?
Well, it makes me feel sad, but
Talking to Ross.
I see.
Rachel moving to another country?
Not being able to see her every day?
How could I be okay with this?
But what are we gonna do?
She really needs this job.
Do you think if Ralph Lauren offered her her old job back,
she would take it?
How's that gonna happen?
Is this the best way to use one of your three magic wishes?
Like, I don't know,
I could talk to her boss. Yeah.
I met him at that Christmas party.
I mean, we really hit it off.
The guy who kept calling you "Ron"?
I didn't say we were brothers!
Hey, Phoebe. Hey.
Hi.
The house next door to the one
that we're buying just went on the market.
I wanna take a look at it,
but Chandler doesn't.
We close escrow tomorrow.
Seeing another house can only confuse us.
We're easily confused.
We're not very bright.
But what if it's better than ours?
Shouldn't we look?
What do you think, Pheebs?
Well, I think that shirt makes you look like
you should work at a Baskin-Robbins.
Anyway....
Hey, isn't Joey's agent Estelle Leonard?
Yeah.
She died. - You're kidding!
That's terrible. - Yeah, last Saturday.
Wow! She was the first black man
to fly solo across the Atlantic!
Wait a minute, I read the wrong one.
Oh, yeah?
Yeah, she was just an agent.
Joey's gonna be so upset.
I know. He always wanted to be
the first black man to cross the Atlantic.
We cannot tell Joey about this.
He's already flipping out
about everything changing.
This'll push him over the edge.
You don't think we should tell him?
Not for a while.
Let's just give him a few days
to get used to everything else.
What if he reads the paper?
Unless Snoopy says it to Charlie Brown,
I think we're okay.
May I help you?
Yeah. I'm a friend of Rachel Green's.
Actually, we met at the Christmas party about two years ago.
Oh, right. Don? - Close. Ron.
Well, what can I do for you?
Well, I'm here to see
if you'll give Rachel her job back.
Did she ask you to come here and do this?
First I have to get you to agree...
...then we'll see if she wants to come back.
Wow, that is tempting.
She loved her job here.
Let's face it, you're not gonna find anyone...
...who did it as well as she did. Isn't that true?
She is good. - I took a shot there.
But I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.
Oh, that's not true. There's nothing I want to do.
I see.
Thanks very much.
Is this your son? - Yeah, his name is Ross.
What?
Nothing, it's just that it's close to Ron.
Does little Ross like dinosaurs, by any chance?
Yeah, they're all he talks about. Why?
How would he like to
come with me to the Museum of Natural History...
...after everyone else has left,
just the two of us...
...and he can touch anything he wants?
I just heard it how you must have heard it, and that's not good.
Let me start again. I'm a paleontologist.
You'll be there with us, and the touching refers only to bones-- fossils!
You could really arrange that?
You let Rachel come back and it's done.
I guess having Rachel back wouldn't be the worst thing in the world.
Yes! Thank you! This is great! Thank you so much.
I swear, your kid's gonna have the time of his life.
That's great. I worry about little Ross.
He's always reading,
collecting rocks and he's obsessed with dinosaurs.
He'll be fine!
Hey, Pheebs. - Hey.
Everything okay?
I'm just mad at my agent.
Estelle? Why?
There's a part in this TV movie that I would be perfect for...
...and I didn't even get put up for it. She better have a good reason.
I'm guessing she does.
Well, I wanna hear it, because she keeps doing this.
No, wait, wait, wait! All right, I gotta go.
Just listen. Promise me that you will wait a minute before you call her.
Well, okay. Why?
Because a promise between friends means never having to give a reason.
I love that saying!
Hello? - Joey, it's Estelle.
I was just gonna call you. That's weird.
It's a little coincidental, but believable.
Listen, I'm sure you're wondering
why I didn't get you...
...an audition for that TV movie.
Yeah, actually I am.
I guess I dropped the ball there.
That's it?
You know, it seems like all you do lately is drop the ball.
Don't take that tone with me.
Who do you think you are?
Alan Lemon,
the first black man to fly solo across the Atlantic?
No, look, all I'm saying is you're my agent...
...and you're not getting me any auditions
and I'm tired of it.
What are you saying?
I'm saying that this isn't working for me anymore, okay, Estelle?
You're fired. Goodbye.
Man, tough week for Estelle.
Hi. - Hi.
Emma left her stuffed T. Rex at my house.
You know she can't sleep without it.
Well, she's asleep now.
Stop forcing that thing on her.
Okay.
You're not gonna believe what happened to me today!
Ralph Lauren called and gave me my job back!
No! - I mean, it was the weirdest thing.
They fire me and then out of nowhere, they just hire me back.
I mean, that place must just be falling apart without me!
So you're not going to Paris?
No, I'm still going!
What?
Well, when the Louis Vuitton people found out...
...that Ralph Lauren wanted me back,
they offered me more money!
Ross, isn't that great?
Hi. We're buying the house next door.
Could we just take a look around?
Sure,
I'm showing it to someone else right now,
but please, look around.
I feel like we're cheating on our house.
If we cheat, shouldn't it
be with a hot, younger house...
...that does stuff that our house won't do?
Ours is so much better!
This living room is smaller,
the dining room looks like a cave.
What a hole!
So, what do you think? - Love it!
We already have one offer.
I think the lady upstairs will make another one.
They could be our neighbors. What are they like?
The woman upstairs is nice.
She and her husband have two kids.
He's on Wall Street, and she's a
Oh... my... God!
Sure.
Hey, Joey, you wanna come with me to--?
Are you okay?
Yeah, I just feel bad about firing Estelle.
This has gotta be killing her.
No, that wouldn't kill her.
A coronary embolism might.
I don't know. She's gotta be taking it hard. I was her only client.
Except for this guy who eats paper.
And I'm guessing he eats more money than he makes.
Look, I know she's not a great agent,
but she did stick with me for 10 years.
I'm gonna call her and hire her again.
No, no, no! Don't call her.
You wait for her to call you. - Why?
Because patience is the road to understanding.
Which is the key to a happy heart.
You blow me away.
All right, so promise you're gonna wait for her to call you?
I promise. - Okay.
And that means never having to give a reason.
What a small world!
And yet I never run into Beyonce.
You two know each other?
We go way back.
Before Monica made an honest man out of him...
...Chandler used to be my little love muffin.
So are you guys thinking of getting this house too?
Are we gonna have a bidding war?
I better warn you, I'm a toughie.
Don't...
Don't do that.
No, actually, we are buying the house next door.
Why?
I don't know why.
Oh, that decides it, then! I was on the fence.
But knowing that you two would be our neighbors?
Now we have to get it!
Ellen, we're gonna talk numbers.
This cannot be happening.
The realtor said another couple made an offer.
Maybe the Janices won't get it!
Maybe the other couple will.
The only way that'll happen is
if the other couple are the Hitlers!
Okay, okay! All right, what if we get both houses?
We can turn this one into a guesthouse!
That's a great idea!
By the way, I don't mean to sound distasteful...
...but when did you start crapping money?
You come up with an idea. - All right.
We've still got three hours till escrow closes on our house.
We can still get out.
But we love our house.
Will we love it so much with her next door?
And she's gonna be louder out here too!
Just the crickets and, "Oh... my... God!"
Okay. But if we don't get this house,
she'll still show up wherever we go.
At least if she's here,
it eliminates the element of surprise.
Never again will you have to hear the three words...
...that make your balls jump back up inside your body!
Well, we have to do something.
We can't have her living next door.
Oh, that does it too.
Who is it?
It's me. Ron.
Look, I know Rachel turned you down...
...but I think there's a way you might be able to get her to come back.
This may surprise you,
but rehiring fired employees is not my main job.
Just hear me out.
How would you feel about offering her a raise?
Not good, Ron.
Perhaps I can persuade you.
What if you could give your son...
...this genuine pterodactyl egg replica.
Wow! That's pretty cool.
So? Do we have a deal?
Okay, you got it. - Yes! Yes!
This is gonna make me very popular.
Believe me, the ladies, they love it.
I meant with my son.
Good, because the ladies, not so much.
Joey, this is Al Zebooker, the guy who eats paper.
I'm sure you've heard that Estelle passed away.
I wanted to let you know there's a memorial for her...
...at the Westside Chapel tomorrow at 1O.
Hope you can make it.
Oh, my God.
Hello? - Joey, it's Estelle.
Estelle?
Yeah, I wanted to call and tell you
that there's no hard feelings for firing me.
Okay. I just-- I can't believe you're calling me.
I didn't think I should just drop by.
No, no! Don't drop by! Don't drop by!
Anyway, you did what you had to do. I'm okay.
Can I ask you something?
What's it like there?
It's all right.
Look, kiddo, I gotta go.
Good luck with the career. You're gonna be huge!
Thanks for everything, Estelle. Bye.
"Out of area." Boy, I'll say!
Well, I just talked to Sid.
We are definitely putting in an offer on the house.
And I'll bet we get it!
The Hitlers will be so disappointed.
All right, I gotta run. Tell Monica I say goodbye.
I'll see you later, neighbor.
Wait!
I just want you to know that I'm so happy you're going to be here.
Oh, me too!
Because...
...that way...
...we can pick up where we left off.
I never stopped loving you.
Oh... my-- - Yeah...
I want you.
I need you.
I must have you,
Janice Litman-Goralnik ne Hosenstein.
Chandler, what are you talking about?
Now that you live next door, we can be together every day.
Sid and Monica never have to know a thing.
I don't know what to say.
I mean, you know, obviously we have this heat between us.
Obviously.
But I love my husband.
And I know you love your wife.
I don't think we should get this house now.
Don't say that. Don't dangle the dream and take it away.
Chandler, one of us has got to be strong.
I understand.
Although....
Maybe just one last moment of weakness.
Goodbye, Chandler Bing.
They're never coming down now!
Hi. - Hi!
You are never going to believe what happened to me today.
What?
Ralph Lauren called, again,
and they offered me more money.
They did? - Yes! It was the weirdest thing.
Zelner called me and said, "We will do anything we can to get you back."
And that I should thank some "Ron."
I don't even know what department that guy's in!
So, what are you gonna do? - Well, I took it!
That's great! So you're staying in New York!
You're excited, right?
You know, the money's great.
It's certainly the easier choice. - Right.
But, you know, I mean, was I looking forward to going to Paris? Sure.
Was I excited about working in the fashion capital of the world?
Oh, absolutely.
Yeah, but you know, this is....
It's fine. I'm fine going back to a job where I've pretty much...
...gotten everything out of it that I possibly can.
I had no idea
I had no idea you were so excited about Paris.
I mean, you said you were scared.
I mean, it was "good" scared, though, you know?
I mean, like "when I moved to New York" scared.
Or "when I found out I was gonna have Emma" scared.
But this is fine. This is gonna be good.
You should go.
What?
It's what you want. You should go.
You really think so?
I really do.
But I already told Zelner that I would come back.
I'm sure he'll understand.
All right. All right! I'm gonna do it! I'm gonna go to Paris!
Yeah. - Yeah.
I'm going to Paris!
Thank you, Ross. - Yeah, yeah.
Oh, I'm so happy.
Then I'm happy too.
Thank you all for coming.
We're here today to pay our respects to a wonderful agent...
...and a beautiful woman.
Inside.
As Estelle's only two clients,
we would like to say a few words.
Dude, where's my speech?
That is entertaining.
Al Zebooker, everybody!
